theorem eval_eq_of_rel {ρ : ∀ {A : Type} [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A], Syn T A → Syn T A → Prop}
    (hf : ∀ {A : Type} [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] (x y : Syn T A), ρ x y → eval f x = eval f y)
    {A : Type} [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] {x y : Syn T A} (h : Rel ρ x y) :
    eval f x = eval f y
proof:
:= by
  induction h with
  | of h => exact hf _ _ h
  | refl => rfl
  | symm _ ih => exact ih.symm
  | trans _ _ ih ih' => exact ih.trans ih'
  | map e _ ih => simp only [eval_map, ih]
  | comp i _ _ ih ih' => simp only [eval_comp, ih, ih']
  | map_refl x => exact SetOperad.map_refl (eval f x)
  | map_trans e e' x => exact SetOperad.map_trans e e' (eval f x)
  | map_comp σ τ i x y => exact SetOperad.map_comp σ τ i (eval f x) (eval f y)
  | comp_one i x => exact SetOperad.comp_one i (eval f x)
  | one_comp y => exact SetOperad.one_comp (eval f y)
  | assoc_seq i j x y z => exact SetOperad.comp_assoc_seq i j (eval f x) (eval f y) (eval f z)
  | assoc_par hik x y z => exact SetOperad.comp_assoc_par hik (eval f x) (eval f y) (eval f z)

name: Operad.Pres.mk_surjective
statement:
lemma mk_surjective {A : Type} [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] :
    Function.Surjective (mk (ρ := ρ) (A := A))
proof: := Quot.exists_rep

name: Operad.Pres.mk_eq_mk
statement:
lemma mk_eq_mk {A : Type} [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] {x y : Syn T A} (h : Syn.Rel ρ x y) :
    mk (ρ := ρ) x = mk y
proof: := Quot.sound h

name: Operad.Pres.mk_eq_mk_of_rel
statement:
lemma mk_eq_mk_of_rel {A : Type} [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] {x y : Syn T A} (h : ρ x y) :
    mk (ρ := ρ) x = mk y
proof: := Quot.sound (.of h)

name: Operad.Pres.map_mk
statement:
@[simp] lemma map_mk {A B : Type} [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] [Fintype B] [DecidableEq B]
    (e : A ≃ B) (x : Syn T A) : SetOperad.map e (mk (ρ := ρ) x) = mk (.map e x)
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.Pres.comp_mk
statement:
@[simp] lemma comp_mk {A B : Type} [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] [Fintype B] [DecidableEq B]
    (i : A) (x : Syn T A) (y : Syn T B) :
    SetOperad.comp i (mk (ρ := ρ) x) (mk y) = mk (.comp i x y)
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.Pres.one_eq
statement: lemma one_eq : (SetOperad.one : Pres T ρ Unit) = mk .one
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.Pres.mk_eq_eval
statement:
lemma mk_eq_eval {A : Type} [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] (x : Syn T A) :
    mk (ρ := ρ) x = Syn.eval (fun _ g => gen g) x
proof:
:= by
  induction x with
  | one => rfl
  | gen g => rfl
  | map e x ih => rw [Syn.eval_map, ← ih]; rfl
  | comp i x y ihx ihy => rw [Syn.eval_comp, ← ihx, ← ihy]; rfl

name: Operad.Pres.lift_mk
statement:
@[simp] lemma lift_mk (f : ∀ n, T n → S (Fin n)) (hf : Respects ρ f) {A : Type} [Fintype A]
    [DecidableEq A] (x : Syn T A) : (lift f hf).app A (mk x) = Syn.eval f x
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.Pres.lift_gen
statement:
@[simp] lemma lift_gen (f : ∀ n, T n → S (Fin n)) (hf : Respects ρ f) {n : ℕ} (g : T n) :
    (lift f hf).app (Fin n) (gen g) = f n g
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.Pres.app_mk
statement:
lemma app_mk (φ : SetOperadHom (Pres T ρ) S) {A : Type} [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A]
    (x : Syn T A) : φ.app A (mk x) = Syn.eval (fun _ g => φ.app _ (gen g)) x
proof:
:= by
  induction x with
  | one => exact φ.app_one
  | gen g => rfl
  | map e x ih => rw [Syn.eval_map, ← ih, ← φ.app_map]; rfl
  | comp i x y ihx ihy => rw [Syn.eval_comp, ← ihx, ← ihy, ← φ.app_comp]; rfl

name: Operad.Pres.hom_ext
statement:
theorem hom_ext {φ ψ : SetOperadHom (Pres T ρ) S}
    (h : ∀ (n : ℕ) (g : T n), φ.app _ (gen g) = ψ.app _ (gen g)) : φ = ψ
proof:
:= by
  ext A _ _ x
  obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := mk_surjective x
  rw [app_mk, app_mk]
  congr 1
  funext n g
  exact h n g

name: Operad.Pres.respects_app
statement:
lemma respects_app (φ : SetOperadHom (Pres T ρ) S) :
    Respects ρ (fun _ g => φ.app _ (gen g))
proof:
:= by
  intro A _ _ x y h
  rw [← app_mk, ← app_mk, mk_eq_mk_of_rel h]

name: Operad.STree.lset_subst
statement:
lemma lset_subst (t : STree E) (xs : ℕ → STree E) :
    lset (t.subst xs) = (lset t).biUnion fun a => lset (xs a)
proof:
:= by
  ext n
  simp only [lset, labels_subst, Multiset.mem_toFinset, Multiset.mem_bind, Finset.mem_biUnion]

name: Operad.STree.disjoint_lset_of_nodup_bind
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨-, l, rfl, hl⟩ := Multiset.nodup_bind.1 h
  have := hl.forall (fun _ _ h => h.symm) (Multiset.mem_coe.1 ha) (Multiset.mem_coe.1 hb) hab
  exact Finset.disjoint_left.2 fun _ hn hn' =>
    Multiset.disjoint_left.1 this (mem_lset.1 hn) (mem_lset.1 hn')

name: Operad.STree.Valid.subst
statement:
lemma Valid.subst {s : STree E} (hs : Valid s) {xs : ℕ → STree E}
    (hx : ∀ a ∈ lset s, Valid (xs a)) (hfirst : ∀ a ∈ lset s, (xs a).first = a)
    (hdisj : ∀ a ∈ lset s, ∀ b ∈ lset s, a ≠ b → Disjoint (lset (xs a)) (lset (xs b))) :
    Valid (s.subst xs)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨isShuffle_subst hs.shuffle (fun a ha => (hx a (mem_lset.2 ha)).shuffle)
    fun a ha b hb hab => ?_, ?_⟩
  · show (xs a).first < (xs b).first
    rw [hfirst a (mem_lset.2 ha), hfirst b (mem_lset.2 hb)]
    exact hab
  · rw [labels_subst, Multiset.nodup_bind]
    refine ⟨fun a ha => (hx a (mem_lset.2 ha)).nodup,
      Multiset.Nodup.pairwise (fun a ha b hb hab => ?_) hs.nodup⟩
    have := hdisj a (mem_lset.2 ha) b (mem_lset.2 hb) hab
    exact Multiset.disjoint_left.2 fun hn hn' =>
      Finset.disjoint_left.1 this (mem_lset.2 hn) (mem_lset.2 hn')

name: Operad.STree.valid_leaf
statement: lemma valid_leaf (a : ℕ) : Valid (leaf a : STree E)
proof:
:=
  ⟨isShuffle_leaf a, Multiset.nodup_singleton a⟩

name: Operad.STree.substOn_of_mem
statement:
lemma substOn_of_mem {S : Finset ℕ} {ys : ℕ → STree E} {b : ℕ} (hb : b ∈ S) :
    substOn S ys b = ys b
proof: := if_pos hb

name: Operad.STree.substOn_of_notMem
statement:
lemma substOn_of_notMem {S : Finset ℕ} {ys : ℕ → STree E} {b : ℕ} (hb : b ∉ S) :
    substOn S ys b = leaf b
proof: := if_neg hb

name: Operad.STree.atFirst_first
proof:
:= by
  have hc : ∃ a' ∈ A, (xs a').first = (xs a).first := ⟨a, ha, rfl⟩
  rw [atFirst, dif_pos hc, hm hc.choose_spec.1 ha hc.choose_spec.2]

name: Operad.ev_subst_on
statement:
theorem ev_subst_on {A : Finset ℕ} {ys : ℕ → STree E} (hys : ∀ b ∈ A, Valid (ys b))
    (hfirst : ∀ b ∈ A, (ys b).first = b)
    (hdisj : ∀ b ∈ A, ∀ b' ∈ A, b ≠ b' → Disjoint (lset (ys b)) (lset (ys b'))) :
    ∀ S ⊆ A, ∃ Θ : P (NS A) →ₗ[R] P (NS (A.biUnion fun b => lset (substOn S ys b))),
      ∀ s : STree E, Valid s → ∀ hs : lset s = A,
        castN R P (by rw [lset_subst, hs]) (ev R P φ (s.subst (substOn S ys))) =
          Θ (castN R P hs (ev R P φ s))
proof:
:= by
  intro S hS
  induction S using Finset.induction_on with
  | empty =>
    have h0 : substOn (∅ : Finset ℕ) ys = leaf := funext fun b => substOn_of_notMem
      (Finset.notMem_empty b)
    have hA : A = A.biUnion fun b => lset (substOn ∅ ys b) := by
      rw [h0]
      ext n
      simp
    refine ⟨castN R P hA, fun s _ hsA => ?_⟩
    rw [ev_congr φ (show s.subst (substOn ∅ ys) = s by rw [h0, subst_leaf]), castN_castN,
      castN_castN]
  | insert b S hb ih =>
    have hbA : b ∈ A := hS (Finset.mem_insert_self b S)
    obtain ⟨Θ, hΘ⟩ := ih ((Finset.subset_insert b S).trans hS)
    
    have hmem : ∀ c ∈ A, c ∈ lset (ys c) := fun c hc => by
      have := first_mem (hys c hc).shuffle
      rw [hfirst c hc] at this
      exact mem_lset.2 this
    have hnot : ∀ c ∈ A, c ≠ b → b ∉ lset (ys c) := fun c hc hcb h =>
      Finset.disjoint_left.1 (hdisj c hc b hbA hcb) h (hmem b hbA)
    have hbL : b ∈ A.biUnion fun c => lset (substOn S ys c) := Finset.mem_biUnion.2 ⟨b, hbA, by
      rw [substOn_of_notMem hb, lset_leaf]
      exact Finset.mem_singleton_self b⟩
    have hdL : Disjoint ((A.biUnion fun c => lset (substOn S ys c)).erase b) (lset (ys b)) := by
      refine Finset.disjoint_left.2 fun n hn hn' => ?_
      obtain ⟨hnb, hn⟩ := Finset.mem_erase.1 hn
      obtain ⟨c, hc, hnc⟩ := Finset.mem_biUnion.1 hn
      by_cases hcS : c ∈ S
      · rw [substOn_of_mem hcS] at hnc
        exact Finset.disjoint_left.1 (hdisj c hc b hbA fun h => hb (h ▸ hcS)) hnc hn'
      · rw [substOn_of_notMem hcS, lset_leaf, Finset.mem_singleton] at hnc
        rw [hnc] at hnb hn'
        exact Finset.disjoint_left.1 (hdisj c hc b hbA hnb) (hmem c hc) hn'
    have hL' : (A.biUnion fun c => lset (substOn S ys c)).erase b ∪ lset (ys b) =
        A.biUnion fun c => lset (substOn (insert b S) ys c) := by
      ext n
      simp only [Finset.mem_union, Finset.mem_erase, Finset.mem_biUnion]
      constructor
      · rintro (⟨hnb, c, hc, hn⟩ | hn)
        · refine ⟨c, hc, ?_⟩
          by_cases hcS : c ∈ S
          · rwa [substOn_of_mem (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem hcS), ← substOn_of_mem (ys := ys) hcS]
          · rw [substOn_of_notMem hcS, lset_leaf, Finset.mem_singleton] at hn
            have hc' : c ∉ insert b S := by
              rw [Finset.mem_insert, not_or]
              exact ⟨fun h => hnb (hn.trans h), hcS⟩
            rw [substOn_of_notMem hc', lset_leaf, hn]
            exact Finset.mem_singleton_self c
        · exact ⟨b, hbA, by rwa [substOn_of_mem (Finset.mem_insert_self b S)]⟩
      · rintro ⟨c, hc, hn⟩
        by_cases hcb : c = b
        · rw [hcb, substOn_of_mem (Finset.mem_insert_self b S)] at hn
          exact Or.inr hn
        · by_cases hcS : c ∈ S
          · rw [substOn_of_mem (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem hcS)] at hn
            refine Or.inl ⟨fun h => hnot c hc hcb (h ▸ hn), c, hc, ?_⟩
            rwa [substOn_of_mem hcS]
          · have hc' : c ∉ insert b S := by
              rw [Finset.mem_insert, not_or]
              exact ⟨hcb, hcS⟩
            rw [substOn_of_notMem hc', lset_leaf, Finset.mem_singleton] at hn
            refine Or.inl ⟨by rw [hn]; exact hcb, c, hc, ?_⟩
            rw [substOn_of_notMem hcS, lset_leaf, hn]
            exact Finset.mem_singleton_self c
    refine ⟨castN R P hL' ∘ₗ (compN R P (A.biUnion fun c => lset (substOn S ys c)) (lset (ys b))
      b).flip (ev R P φ (ys b)) ∘ₗ Θ, fun s hs hsA => ?_⟩
    have hsub : ∀ c ∈ lset s, Valid (substOn S ys c) := fun c hc => by
      by_cases hcS : c ∈ S
      · rw [substOn_of_mem hcS]
        exact hys c (hsA ▸ hc)
      · rw [substOn_of_notMem hcS]
        exact valid_leaf c
    have hsubf : ∀ c ∈ lset s, (substOn S ys c).first = c := fun c hc => by
      by_cases hcS : c ∈ S
      · rw [substOn_of_mem hcS]
        exact hfirst c (hsA ▸ hc)
      · rw [substOn_of_notMem hcS, first_leaf]
    have hsubd : ∀ c ∈ lset s, ∀ c' ∈ lset s, c ≠ c' →
        Disjoint (lset (substOn S ys c)) (lset (substOn S ys c')) := by
      intro c hc c' hc' hcc'
      rw [hsA] at hc hc'
      by_cases hcS : c ∈ S <;> by_cases hc'S : c' ∈ S
      · rw [substOn_of_mem hcS, substOn_of_mem hc'S]
        exact hdisj c hc c' hc' hcc'
      · rw [substOn_of_mem hcS, substOn_of_notMem hc'S, lset_leaf, Finset.disjoint_singleton_right]
        exact Finset.disjoint_left.1 (hdisj c' hc' c hc (Ne.symm hcc')) (hmem c' hc')
      · rw [substOn_of_notMem hcS, substOn_of_mem hc'S, lset_leaf, Finset.disjoint_singleton_left]
        exact Finset.disjoint_left.1 (hdisj c hc c' hc' hcc') (hmem c hc)
      · rw [substOn_of_notMem hcS, substOn_of_notMem hc'S, lset_leaf, lset_leaf,
          Finset.disjoint_singleton]
        exact hcc'
    have hv₁ : Valid (s.subst (substOn S ys)) := hs.subst hsub hsubf hsubd
    have hl₁ : lset (s.subst (substOn S ys)) = A.biUnion fun c => lset (substOn S ys c) := by
      rw [lset_subst, hsA]
    have hsplit : s.subst (substOn (insert b S) ys) =
        (s.subst (substOn S ys)).subst (Function.update leaf b (ys b)) := by
      rw [subst_subst]
      refine subst_congr _ fun c hc => ?_
      show substOn (insert b S) ys c = (substOn S ys c).subst (Function.update leaf b (ys b))
      have hcA : c ∈ A := hsA ▸ mem_lset.2 hc
      by_cases hcb : c = b
      · rw [hcb, substOn_of_mem (Finset.mem_insert_self b S), substOn_of_notMem hb, subst_leaf',
          Function.update_self]
      · by_cases hcS : c ∈ S
        · rw [substOn_of_mem (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem hcS), substOn_of_mem hcS]
          conv_lhs => rw [← subst_leaf (ys c)]
          refine subst_congr _ fun n hn => (Function.update_of_ne ?_ _ _).symm
          rintro rfl
          exact hnot c hcA hcb (mem_lset.2 hn)
        · have hc' : c ∉ insert b S := by
            rw [Finset.mem_insert, not_or]
            exact ⟨hcb, hcS⟩
          rw [substOn_of_notMem hc', substOn_of_notMem hcS, subst_leaf',
            Function.update_of_ne hcb]
    have hb₁ : b ∈ lset (s.subst (substOn S ys)) := hl₁ ▸ hbL
    have hd₁ : Disjoint ((lset (s.subst (substOn S ys))).erase b) (lset (ys b)) := hl₁ ▸ hdL
    have key := hΘ s hs hsA
    simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearMap.flip_apply]
    rw [← key, ev_congr φ hsplit, ev_subst φ hv₁ (hys b hbA) hb₁ (hfirst b hbA) hd₁,
      ← castN_rfl (R := R) (ev R P φ (ys b)), compN_castN]
    simp only [castN_castN, castN_rfl]

name: Operad.ev_ctx
statement:
theorem ev_ctx {A B : Finset ℕ} {f : SMono E A → SMono E B} (hf : IsSCtx f) :
    ∃ Φ : P (NS A) →ₗ[R] P (NS B), ∀ g : SMono E A,
      castN R P (lset_smono (f g)) (ev R P φ (f g).1) =
        Φ (castN R P (lset_smono g) (ev R P φ g.1))
proof:
:= by
  rcases isEmpty_or_nonempty (SMono E A) with hA | hA
  · exact ⟨0, fun g => (hA.false g).elim⟩
  obtain ⟨g₀⟩ := hA
  obtain ⟨T, p, xs, hp, hxs, hfx⟩ := hf
  
  have hU : ∀ g : SMono E A, (g.1.subst xs).labels ≤ B.val := fun g => by
    rw [← (f g).labels_eq, hfx g]
    exact labels_get?_le (get?_replace hp _)
  have hnd := Multiset.nodup_of_le (hU g₀) B.nodup
  rw [labels_subst, g₀.labels_eq] at hnd
  have hvx : ∀ a ∈ A, Valid (xs a) := fun a ha =>
    ⟨hxs.shuffle a ha, (Multiset.nodup_bind.1 hnd).1 a ha⟩
  have hdx : ∀ a ∈ A, ∀ a' ∈ A, a ≠ a' → Disjoint (lset (xs a)) (lset (xs a')) :=
    fun a ha a' ha' h => disjoint_lset_of_nodup_bind hnd ha ha' h
  
  set h : ℕ → ℕ := fun a => (xs a).first with hh
  have hmono : StrictMonoOn h ↑A := hxs.mono
  set ys := atFirst A xs with hys_def
  have hys : ∀ a ∈ A, ys (h a) = xs a := fun a ha => atFirst_first hmono.injOn ha
  set A' := A.image h with hA'
  have hysv : ∀ c ∈ A', Valid (ys c) := fun c hc => by
    obtain ⟨a, ha, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.1 hc
    rw [hys a ha]
    exact hvx a ha
  have hysf : ∀ c ∈ A', (ys c).first = c := fun c hc => by
    obtain ⟨a, ha, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.1 hc
    rw [hys a ha]
  have hysd : ∀ c ∈ A', ∀ c' ∈ A', c ≠ c' → Disjoint (lset (ys c)) (lset (ys c')) := by
    intro c hc c' hc' hcc'
    obtain ⟨a, ha, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.1 hc
    obtain ⟨a', ha', rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.1 hc'
    rw [hys a ha, hys a' ha']
    exact hdx a ha a' ha' fun e => hcc' (congrArg h e)
  obtain ⟨Θ, hΘ⟩ := ev_subst_on (R := R) φ hysv hysf hysd A' (Finset.Subset.refl _)
  have hsubst : ∀ g : SMono E A, (g.1.relabel h).subst (substOn A' ys) = g.1.subst xs :=
    fun g => by
      rw [relabel_subst]
      refine subst_congr _ fun a ha => ?_
      have haA : a ∈ A := g.mem_labels.1 ha
      rw [substOn_of_mem (Finset.mem_image_of_mem h haA), hys a haA]
  have hlr : ∀ g : SMono E A, lset (g.1.relabel h) = A' := fun g => by
    rw [lset_relabel, lset_smono]
  have hfg : ∀ g : SMono E A, StrictMonoOn h ↑(lset g.1) := fun g => by
    rw [lset_smono]
    exact hmono
  have hLg : ∀ g : SMono E A, lset (g.1.subst xs) = A'.biUnion fun c => lset (substOn A' ys c) :=
    fun g => by
    rw [← hsubst g, lset_subst, hlr g]
  
  have hin : ∀ g : SMono E A, Θ (ShuffleOperad.map (R := R) (relIso h hmono)
      (castN R P (lset_smono g) (ev R P φ g.1))) =
      castN R P (hLg g) (ev R P φ (g.1.subst xs)) := fun g => by
    have := hΘ (g.1.relabel h) (g.valid.relabel (hfg g)) (hlr g)
    rw [ev_relabel φ g.valid (hfg g), castN_castN] at this
    rw [map_relIso_castN, ← this, ev_congr φ (hsubst g).symm, castN_castN]
  
  obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ : ∃ b, (g₀.1.subst xs).first = b := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨T', hT'⟩ : ∃ T', T.replace p (leaf b) = T' := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hUfirst : ∀ g : SMono E A, (g.1.subst xs).first = b := fun g => by
    rw [← hb, first_subst g.isShuffle, first_subst g₀.isShuffle, g.first_eq g₀]
  have hUl : ∀ g : SMono E A, (g.1.subst xs).labels = (g₀.1.subst xs).labels := fun g => by
    rw [labels_subst, labels_subst, g.labels_eq, g₀.labels_eq]
  have hUv : ∀ g : SMono E A, Valid (g.1.subst xs) := fun g =>
    ⟨isShuffle_get? (p := p) (f g).isShuffle (by rw [hfx g]; exact get?_replace hp _),
      Multiset.nodup_of_le (hU g) B.nodup⟩
  have hW : (T.replace p (g₀.1.subst xs)).replace p (leaf b) = T' := by
    rw [replace_replace, hT']
  have hlab := labels_replace (get?_replace hp (g₀.1.subst xs)) (leaf b)
  rw [hW, ← hfx g₀, (f g₀).labels_eq, labels_leaf] at hlab
  have hbU : b ∈ (g₀.1.subst xs).labels := hb ▸ first_mem (hUv g₀).shuffle
  obtain ⟨U', hU'⟩ := Multiset.exists_cons_of_mem hbU
  have hTU : T'.labels + U' = B.val := by
    have : b ::ₘ (T'.labels + U') = b ::ₘ B.val := by
      rw [← Multiset.add_cons, ← hU', hlab, ← Multiset.singleton_add, add_comm]
    exact (Multiset.cons_inj_right b).1 this
  have hBnd := B.nodup
  rw [← hTU, Multiset.nodup_add] at hBnd
  obtain ⟨hT'nd, -, hT'U'⟩ := hBnd
  have hT'get : T'.get? p = some (leaf b) := hT' ▸ get?_replace hp (leaf b)
  have hbT : b ∈ lset T' := mem_lset.2 (mem_labels_of_get? hT'get)
  have hT'v : Valid T' := ⟨by
    rw [← hW]
    exact isShuffle_replace (by rw [← hfx g₀]; exact (f g₀).isShuffle) (get?_replace hp _)
      (isShuffle_leaf b) ((first_leaf b).trans hb.symm), hT'nd⟩
  have hdT : ∀ g : SMono E A, Disjoint ((lset T').erase b) (lset (g.1.subst xs)) := fun g => by
    refine Finset.disjoint_left.2 fun n hn hn' => ?_
    obtain ⟨hnb, hn⟩ := Finset.mem_erase.1 hn
    rw [mem_lset, hUl g, hU', Multiset.mem_cons] at hn'
    exact Multiset.disjoint_left.1 hT'U' (mem_lset.1 hn) (hn'.resolve_left hnb)
  have hsplit : ∀ g : SMono E A,
      (f g).1 = T'.subst (Function.update leaf b (g.1.subst xs)) := fun g => by
    rw [subst_update hT'nd hT'get, subst_leaf, ← hT', replace_replace, hfx g]
  have hB : (lset T').erase b ∪ (A'.biUnion fun c => lset (substOn A' ys c)) = B := by
    rw [← hLg g₀, ← lset_subst_update hbT, ← hsplit g₀, lset_smono]
  refine ⟨castN R P hB ∘ₗ compN R P (lset T') (A'.biUnion fun c => lset (substOn A' ys c)) b
    (ev R P φ T') ∘ₗ Θ ∘ₗ ShuffleOperad.map (R := R) (relIso h hmono), fun g => ?_⟩
  simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply]
  rw [hin g, ← castN_rfl (R := R) (ev R P φ T'), compN_castN, ev_congr φ (hsplit g),
    ev_subst φ hT'v (hUv g) hbT (hUfirst g) (hdT g)]
  simp only [castN_castN]

name: Operad.evL_single
statement:
lemma evL_single {C : Finset ℕ} (m : SMono E C) :
    evL R P φ C (Finsupp.single m 1) = castN R P (lset_smono m) (ev R P φ m.1)
proof:
:= by
  rw [evL, Finsupp.linearCombination_single, one_smul]

name: Operad.evL_cast
statement:
lemma evL_cast {C C' : Finset ℕ} (h : C = C') (v : SMono E C →₀ R) :
    evL R P φ C' (Finsupp.mapDomain (SMono.cast h) v) = castN R P h (evL R P φ C v)
proof:
:= by
  subst h
  have : (SMono.cast rfl : SMono E C → SMono E C) = id := funext fun t => Subtype.ext rfl
  rw [this, Finsupp.mapDomain_id]
  rfl

name: Operad.evL_mapDomain
statement:
theorem evL_mapDomain {A B : Finset ℕ} {f : SMono E A → SMono E B} (hf : IsSCtx f) :
    ∃ Φ : P (NS A) →ₗ[R] P (NS B), ∀ v : SMono E A →₀ R,
      evL R P φ B (Finsupp.mapDomain f v) = Φ (evL R P φ A v)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨Φ, hΦ⟩ := ev_ctx (R := R) φ hf
  refine ⟨Φ, fun v => ?_⟩
  induction v using Finsupp.induction_linear with
  | zero => simp
  | add v w hv hw => rw [Finsupp.mapDomain_add, map_add, map_add, map_add, hv, hw]
  | single m r =>
    simp only [Finsupp.mapDomain_single, evL, Finsupp.linearCombination_single, map_smul]
    rw [hΦ]

name: Operad.Rules.evL_ideal
statement:
theorem Rules.evL_ideal (hφ : G.Holds φ) (C : Finset ℕ) {v : SMono E C →₀ R}
    (hv : v ∈ (G.rw C).ideal) : evL R P φ C v = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [Rules.ideal_eq_span] at hv
  induction hv using Submodule.span_induction with
  | mem x hx =>
    obtain ⟨r, f, hf, rfl⟩ := hx
    obtain ⟨Φ, hΦ⟩ := evL_mapDomain (R := R) φ (f := f) hf
    rw [hΦ, hφ r, map_zero]
  | zero => exact map_zero _
  | add x y _ _ hx hy => rw [map_add, hx, hy, add_zero]
  | smul a x _ hx => rw [map_smul, hx, smul_zero]

name: Operad.FreeSh.liftApp_eq_evL
statement:
lemma FreeSh.liftApp_eq_evL (A : Type) [Fintype A] [LinearOrder A] (x : FreeSh R E A) :
    FreeSh.liftApp R P φ A x = ShuffleOperad.map (R := R) (rangeIso A) (evL R P φ _ x)
proof:
:= by
  induction x using Finsupp.induction_linear with
  | zero => simp
  | add x y hx hy => rw [map_add, hx, hy, map_add, map_add]
  | single m r => simp only [FreeSh.liftApp, evL, Finsupp.linearCombination_single, map_smul]

name: Operad.Rules.presLift_proj
statement:
lemma Rules.presLift_proj (hφ : G.Holds φ) (A : Type) [Fintype A] [LinearOrder A]
    (x : FreeSh R E A) :
    (G.presLift hφ).app A (G.shuffleIdeal.proj A x) = (FreeSh.lift R P φ).app A x
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.Rules.presLift_gen
statement:
theorem Rules.presLift_gen (hφ : G.Holds φ) {k : ℕ} (hk : 0 < k) (g : E k) :
    (G.presLift hφ).app (Fin k) (G.shuffleIdeal.proj _ (Finsupp.single (FreeSh.genM hk g) 1)) =
      φ k g
proof:
:=
  FreeSh.lift_gen φ hk g

name: Operad.Rules.presented_hom_ext
statement:
theorem Rules.presented_hom_ext {ψ₁ ψ₂ : ShuffleOperadHom R G.Presented P}
    (h : ∀ k (hk : 0 < k) (g : E k),
      ψ₁.app (Fin k) (G.shuffleIdeal.proj _ (Finsupp.single (FreeSh.genM hk g) 1)) =
        ψ₂.app (Fin k) (G.shuffleIdeal.proj _ (Finsupp.single (FreeSh.genM hk g) 1))) :
    ψ₁ = ψ₂
proof:
:=
  ShuffleOperadHom.ext fun A _ _ q => G.shuffleIdeal.hom_ext_proj
    (fun A _ _ x => FreeSh.hom_ext (ψ₁ := ψ₁.comp G.shuffleIdeal.projHom)
      (ψ₂ := ψ₂.comp G.shuffleIdeal.projHom) h A x) A q

name: Operad.castN_eq_zero_iff
statement:
lemma castN_eq_zero_iff {S S' : Finset ℕ} (h : S = S') {x : P (NS S)} :
    castN R P h x = 0 ↔ x = 0
proof:
:= by
  subst h
  rfl

name: Operad.map_eq_zero_iff
statement:
lemma map_eq_zero_iff {A B : Type} [Fintype A] [LinearOrder A] [Fintype B] [LinearOrder B]
    (e : A ≃o B) {x : P A} : ShuffleOperad.map (R := R) e x = 0 ↔ x = 0
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun h => ?_, fun h => by rw [h, map_zero]⟩
  have := congrArg (ShuffleOperad.map (R := R) e.symm) h
  rwa [← ShuffleOperad.map_trans, OrderIso.self_trans_symm, ShuffleOperad.map_refl, map_zero]
    at this

name: Operad.isSCtx_normalize
statement:
lemma isSCtx_normalize (C : Finset ℕ) :
    IsSCtx (fun m : SMono E C => normalize m.valid (lset_smono m))
proof:
:=
  ⟨leaf 0, [], fun a => leaf (posIn C a), rfl, ⟨fun _ _ => trivial, fun a ha n hn => by
      rw [labels_leaf, Multiset.mem_singleton] at hn
      rw [hn, ← image_posIn C]
      exact Finset.mem_image_of_mem _ ha, strictMonoOn_posIn C⟩,
    fun _ => (replace_nil _ _).symm⟩

name: Operad.evL_normalize
statement:
lemma evL_normalize (C : Finset ℕ) (v : SMono E C →₀ R) :
    evL R P φ _ (Finsupp.mapDomain (fun m : SMono E C => normalize m.valid (lset_smono m)) v) =
      castN R P (image_posIn C) (ShuffleOperad.map (R := R)
        (relIso (posIn C) (strictMonoOn_posIn C)) (evL R P φ C v))
proof:
:= by
  induction v using Finsupp.induction_linear with
  | zero => simp
  | add v w hv hw => simp only [Finsupp.mapDomain_add, map_add, hv, hw]
  | single m r =>
    simp only [Finsupp.mapDomain_single, evL, Finsupp.linearCombination_single, map_smul]
    congr 1
    have hf : StrictMonoOn (posIn C) ↑(lset m.1) := by
      rw [lset_smono]
      exact strictMonoOn_posIn C
    rw [ev_congr φ (normalize_val m.valid (lset_smono m)), ev_relabel φ m.valid hf,
      map_relIso_castN]
    simp only [castN_castN]

name: Operad.Rules.holds_of_hom
statement: theorem Rules.holds_of_hom (ψ : ShuffleOperadHom R G.Presented P) : G.Holds (G.homValues ψ)
proof:
:= by
  intro r
  have hv : Finsupp.single (G.lead r) 1 - G.tail r ∈ (G.rw (G.src r)).ideal := by
    rw [Rules.ideal_eq_span]
    exact Submodule.subset_span ⟨r, id, O.toCtxOrder.ctx_id _, by rw [Finsupp.mapDomain_id]⟩
  have hν := G.mapDomain_mem_ideal (isSCtx_normalize (G.src r)) hv
  have hψ : ∀ x, ψ.app (NS (G.src r)) (G.shuffleIdeal.proj _ x) =
      FreeSh.liftApp R P (G.homValues ψ) (NS (G.src r)) x := fun x =>
    FreeSh.eq_lift (G.homValues ψ) (ψ := ψ.comp G.shuffleIdeal.projHom) (fun k hk g => by
      show ψ.app (Fin k) (G.shuffleIdeal.proj _ _) = _
      rw [Rules.homValues, dif_pos hk]) (NS (G.src r)) x
  have hp : G.shuffleIdeal.proj (NS (G.src r)) (Finsupp.mapDomain
      (fun m : SMono E (G.src r) => normalize m.valid (lset_smono m))
      (Finsupp.single (G.lead r) 1 - G.tail r)) = 0 := (Submodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero _).2 hν
  have h0 := congrArg (ψ.app (NS (G.src r))) hp
  rw [map_zero, hψ, FreeSh.liftApp_eq_evL, evL_normalize] at h0
  rwa [map_eq_zero_iff, castN_eq_zero_iff, map_eq_zero_iff] at h0

name: Operad.Rules.eq_presLift
statement:
theorem Rules.eq_presLift (ψ : ShuffleOperadHom R G.Presented P) :
    ψ = G.presLift (Rules.holds_of_hom ψ)
proof:
:=
  Rules.presented_hom_ext fun k hk g => by
    rw [Rules.presLift_gen, Rules.homValues, dif_pos hk]

name: Operad.Rules.rel_mem_ideal
statement:
lemma Rules.rel_mem_ideal (r : ρ) :
    Finsupp.single (G.lead r) 1 - G.tail r ∈ (G.rw (G.src r)).ideal
proof:
:= by
  rw [Rules.ideal_eq_span]
  exact Submodule.subset_span ⟨r, id, O.toCtxOrder.ctx_id _, by rw [Finsupp.mapDomain_id]⟩

name: Operad.Rules.shuffleIdeal_eq_span
statement:
theorem Rules.shuffleIdeal_eq_span (hsrc : ∀ r, ∃ n, G.src r = Finset.range n) :
    G.shuffleIdeal = ShuffleOperadIdeal.span R G.relSet
proof:
:= by
  refine le_antisymm ?_ (ShuffleOperadIdeal.span_le.2 fun A _ _ x hx => ?_)
  · set S := ShuffleOperadIdeal.span R G.relSet with hS
    let φ : ∀ k, E k → S.Quot (Fin k) := fun k g =>
      if hk : 0 < k then S.proj _ (Finsupp.single (FreeSh.genM hk g) 1) else 0
    have hL : ∀ (A : Type) [Fintype A] [LinearOrder A] (x : FreeSh R E A),
        FreeSh.liftApp R S.Quot φ A x = S.proj A x := fun A _ _ x =>
      FreeSh.hom_ext (ψ₁ := FreeSh.lift R S.Quot φ) (ψ₂ := S.projHom) (fun k hk g => by
        show FreeSh.liftApp R S.Quot φ (Fin k) _ = S.proj _ _
        rw [show FreeSh.liftApp R S.Quot φ (Fin k) (Finsupp.single (FreeSh.genM hk g) 1) =
          φ k g from FreeSh.lift_gen φ hk g]
        simp only [φ, dif_pos hk]) A x
    have hφ : G.Holds φ := by
      intro r
      obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := hsrc r
      have hn' : G.src r = Finset.range (Fintype.card (Fin n)) := by rw [hn, Fintype.card_fin]
      have h0 : S.proj (Fin n) (Finsupp.mapDomain (SMono.cast hn')
          (Finsupp.single (G.lead r) 1 - G.tail r)) = 0 :=
        (Submodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero _).2 (ShuffleOperadIdeal.subset_span (Fin n) ⟨r, hn', rfl⟩)
      rwa [← hL, FreeSh.liftApp_eq_evL, evL_cast, map_eq_zero_iff, castN_eq_zero_iff] at h0
    intro A _ _ x hx
    have h1 : FreeSh.liftApp R S.Quot φ A x = 0 := by
      rw [FreeSh.liftApp_eq_evL, Rules.evL_ideal hφ _ hx, map_zero]
    rw [hL] at h1
    exact (Submodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero _).1 h1
  · obtain ⟨r, h, rfl⟩ := hx
    exact G.ideal_cast h (G.rel_mem_ideal r)

name: Operad.STree.allT_leaf
statement: @[simp] lemma allT_leaf (a : ℕ) : allT (leaf a : STree E) = leaf a
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.STree.allT_node
statement:
@[simp] lemma allT_node {k : ℕ} (e : E k) (c : Fin k → STree E) :
    allT (node e c) = node (e, true) fun i => allT (c i)
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.STree.cutAll_leaf
statement: @[simp] lemma cutAll_leaf (a : ℕ) : cutAll (leaf a : STree E) = leaf a
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.STree.cutAll_node
statement:
@[simp] lemma cutAll_node {k : ℕ} (e : E k) (c : Fin k → STree E) :
    cutAll (node e c) = node (e, false) fun i => allT (c i)
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.STree.forget_allT
statement: @[simp] lemma forget_allT (t : STree E) : forget (allT t) = t
proof:
:= by
  rw [forget, allT, mapG_mapG]
  exact mapG_id t

name: Operad.STree.forget_cutAll
statement:
@[simp] lemma forget_cutAll : ∀ t : STree E, forget (cutAll t) = t
  | leaf _ => rfl
  | node e c => by simp

@[simp] lemma rootF_cutAll : ∀ t : STree E, rootF (cutAll t) = false
  | leaf _ => rfl
  | node _ _ => rfl

name: Operad.STree.rootF_cutAll
statement:
@[simp] lemma rootF_cutAll : ∀ t : STree E, rootF (cutAll t) = false
  | leaf _ => rfl
  | node _ _ => rfl

name: Operad.STree.mem_cutKeys_allT
statement:
lemma mem_cutKeys_allT : ∀ (t : STree E) (y : ℕ ×ₗ ℕ), y ∈ cutKeys (allT t) ↔ y ∈ t.vkeys
  | leaf _, y => by simp [cutKeys]
  | node e c, y => by
    rw [allT_node, mem_cutKeys_node, mem_vkeys_node]
    simp only [mem_cutKeys_allT, true_and]
    rw [show key (node (e, true) fun i => allT (c i)) = key (node e c) from key_mapG _ (node e c)]

name: Operad.STree.cutKeys_cutAll
statement:
theorem cutKeys_cutAll : ∀ t : STree E, cutKeys (cutAll t) = t.edgeKeys
  | leaf _ => rfl
  | node e c => by
    ext y
    rw [cutAll_node, mem_cutKeys_node, mem_edgeKeys_node]
    simp only [Bool.false_eq_true, false_and, false_or, mem_cutKeys_allT]

name: Operad.STree.eq_allT
statement:
theorem eq_allT : ∀ {Y : STree (BE E)}, Y.vkeys.Nodup → (∀ y ∈ Y.vkeys, y ∈ cutKeys Y) →
    Y = allT (forget Y)
  | leaf _, _, _ => rfl
  | node d c, hn, h => by
    obtain ⟨hroot, hnc, hdisj⟩
proof:
:= nodup_vkeys_children hn
    obtain ⟨e, b⟩ := d
    have hb : b = true := by
      rcases mem_cutKeys_node.1 (h _ (mem_vkeys_node.2 (Or.inl rfl))) with ⟨hb, -⟩ | ⟨i, hi⟩
      · exact hb
      · exact absurd ((Multiset.mem_sum (s := Finset.univ)).2
          ⟨i, Finset.mem_univ _, mem_vkeys_of_mem_cutKeys hi⟩) hroot
    subst hb
    rw [forget_node, allT_node]
    congr 1
    funext i
    refine eq_allT (hnc i) fun y hy => ?_
    rcases mem_cutKeys_node.1 (h y (mem_vkeys_node.2 (Or.inr ⟨i, hy⟩))) with ⟨-, rfl⟩ | ⟨j, hj⟩
    · exact absurd ((Multiset.mem_sum (s := Finset.univ)).2 ⟨i, Finset.mem_univ _, hy⟩) hroot
    · by_cases hij : j = i
      · subst hij
        exact hj
      · exact absurd hy (Multiset.disjoint_left.1 (hdisj j i hij) (mem_vkeys_of_mem_cutKeys hj))

name: Operad.STree.eq_cutAll
statement:
theorem eq_cutAll : ∀ {X : STree (BE E)}, X.vkeys.Nodup → rootF X = false →
    X.edgeKeys ⊆ cutKeys X → X = cutAll (forget X)
  | leaf _, _, _, _ => rfl
  | node d c, hn, hr, h => by
    obtain ⟨-, hnc, hdisj⟩
proof:
:= nodup_vkeys_children hn
    obtain ⟨e, b⟩ := d
    have hb : b = false := hr
    subst hb
    rw [forget_node, cutAll_node]
    congr 1
    funext i
    refine eq_allT (hnc i) fun y hy => ?_
    rcases mem_cutKeys_node.1 (h (mem_edgeKeys_node.2 ⟨i, hy⟩)) with ⟨hf, -⟩ | ⟨j, hj⟩
    · exact absurd hf Bool.false_ne_true
    · by_cases hij : j = i
      · subst hij
        exact hj
      · exact absurd hy (Multiset.disjoint_left.1 (hdisj j i hij) (mem_vkeys_of_mem_cutKeys hj))

name: Operad.STree.mem_vkeys_of_mem_wk
statement:
lemma mem_vkeys_of_mem_wk (xs : ℕ → STree E) :
    ∀ (g : STree E) {y : ℕ ×ₗ ℕ}, y ∈ wk xs g → y ∈ (g.subst xs).vkeys
  | leaf _, _, h => absurd h (Finset.notMem_empty _)
  | node e c, y, h => by
    rw [wk_node, Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_biUnion] at h
    rw [subst_node, mem_vkeys_node]
    rcases h with rfl | ⟨i, -, hi⟩
    · left
      rw [subst_node]
    · exact Or.inr ⟨i, mem_vkeys_of_mem_wk xs (c i) hi⟩

name: Operad.STree.edgeKeys_subset_of_get?
statement:
theorem edgeKeys_subset_of_get? : ∀ {t s : STree E} {p : List ℕ}, t.get? p = some s →
    s.edgeKeys ⊆ t.edgeKeys
  | t, s, [], h => by
    rw [get?_nil, Option.some_inj] at h
    rw [h]
  | leaf _, _, _ :: _, h => by simp at h
  | node e c, s, i :: p, h => by
    obtain ⟨hi, h⟩
proof:
:= get?_node_cons_eq_some.1 h
    intro y hy
    rw [mem_edgeKeys_node]
    exact ⟨⟨i, hi⟩, edgeKeys_subset_vkeys (edgeKeys_subset_of_get? h hy)⟩

name: Operad.STree.cutAllM_val
statement: @[simp] lemma cutAllM_val (t : SMono E A) : (cutAllM t).1 = cutAll t.1
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.STree.forgetM_cutAllM
statement: @[simp] lemma forgetM_cutAllM (t : SMono E A) : forgetM (cutAllM t) = t
proof:
:=
  Subtype.ext (forget_cutAll t.1)

name: Operad.STree.cutAllM_injective
statement: lemma cutAllM_injective : Function.Injective (cutAllM : SMono E A → SMono (BE E) A)
proof:
:=
  fun s t h => by rw [← forgetM_cutAllM s, h, forgetM_cutAllM]

name: Operad.STree.cuts_cutAllM
statement: lemma cuts_cutAllM (t : SMono E A) : cuts (cutAllM t) = t.1.edgeKeys
proof: := cutKeys_cutAll t.1

name: Operad.STree.Bar.cuts_eq_of_mem_P
statement: theorem cuts_eq_of_mem_P {X : SMono (BE E) A} (hX : X ∈ P A w w) : cuts X = X.1.edgeKeys
proof:
:= by
  have hn := nodup_vkeys X.isShuffle X.nodup
  refine Finset.eq_of_subset_of_card_le (cutKeys_subset_edgeKeys hX.1) ?_
  rw [card_edgeKeys hn, hX.2.1]
  have := hX.2.2
  omega

name: Operad.STree.Bar.eq_cutAllM_of_mem_P
statement:
theorem eq_cutAllM_of_mem_P {X : SMono (BE E) A} (hX : X ∈ P A w w) :
    X = cutAllM (forgetM X)
proof:
:=
  Subtype.ext (eq_cutAll (nodup_vkeys X.isShuffle X.nodup) hX.1 fun y hy => by
    rw [show cutKeys X.1 = cuts X from rfl, cuts_eq_of_mem_P hX]
    exact hy)

name: Operad.STree.Bar.cutAllM_mem_P
statement:
theorem cutAllM_mem_P (hw : 0 < w) {t : SMono E A} (ht : t.1.weight = w) :
    cutAllM t ∈ P A w w
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨rootF_cutAll t.1, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [cutAllM_val, ← weight_forget, forget_cutAll]
    exact ht
  · rw [cuts_cutAllM, card_edgeKeys (nodup_vkeys t.isShuffle t.nodup), ht]
    omega

name: Operad.Rules.leadKeys_subset_edgeKeys
statement:
theorem Rules.leadKeys_subset_edgeKeys {A : Finset ℕ} (t : SMono E A) :
    G.leadKeys t ⊆ ↑t.1.edgeKeys
proof:
:= by
  rintro y ⟨r, p, xs₀, hp, -, hy⟩
  refine edgeKeys_subset_of_get? hp ?_
  rcases hL : (G.lead r).1 with a | ⟨e, c⟩
  · rw [hL] at hy
    exact absurd hy (Finset.notMem_empty _)
  · rw [hL] at hy
    rw [subst_node, mem_edgeKeys_node]
    rw [nwk_node, Finset.mem_biUnion] at hy
    obtain ⟨i, -, hi⟩ := hy
    exact ⟨i, mem_vkeys_of_mem_wk xs₀ (c i) hi⟩

name: Operad.Rules.dL_cutAllM
statement:
lemma Rules.dL_cutAllM {A : Finset ℕ} {t : SMono E A} (ht : G.IsFull t) :
    G.dL A (Finsupp.single (cutAllM t) 1) = 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [Rules.dL, CutComplex.dL_single, one_smul, CutComplex.dLX]
  refine Finset.sum_eq_zero fun k hk => ?_
  rw [Finset.mem_filter, forgetM_cutAllM, cuts_cutAllM] at hk
  exact absurd (ht hk.1) hk.2

name: Operad.Rules.mem_irr_of_mem_P
statement:
theorem Rules.mem_irr_of_mem_P {A : Finset ℕ} {w : ℕ} {X : SMono (BE E) A}
    (hX : X ∈ Bar.P A w w) : X ∈ (G.bar.rw A).Irr
proof:
:= by
  rw [G.bar.mem_irr_iff, G.bar_normal_iff_quad hquad, Bar.cuts_eq_of_mem_P hX]
  have h := G.leadKeys_subset_edgeKeys (forgetM X)
  rwa [forgetM_val, edgeKeys_forget] at h

name: Operad.Rules.isFull_of_mem_KD
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨hvC, hvd⟩ := Submodule.mem_inf.1 hv
  have hvP : ∀ Y ∈ v.support, Y ∈ Bar.P A w w := fun Y hY => (Finsupp.mem_supported K v).1 hvC hY
  have hXP := hvP X hX
  have hS : (G.bar.rw A).Resolvable :=
    G.bar_resolvable (G.hlead_of_quad hquad) (G.hom_of_quad hquad hom) hres A
  have hDv : (G.bar.rw A).nf (Bar.d K v) = 0 := hS.ideal_le_ker (Submodule.mem_comap.1 hvd)
  
  have hvt : Finsupp.single X (v X) ∈ Finsupp.supported K K
      ((G.bar.rw A).Irr ∩ Bar.P A w w ∩ forgetM ⁻¹' {forgetM X}) :=
    Finsupp.single_mem_supported K _ ⟨⟨G.mem_irr_of_mem_P hquad hXP, hXP⟩, rfl⟩
  have hvr : v - Finsupp.single X (v X) ∈ Finsupp.supported K K ((G.bar.rw A).Irr ∩
      Bar.P A w w ∩ {Y | forgetM Y ≠ forgetM X ∧ ¬ O.lt (forgetM X) (forgetM Y)}) := by
    rw [Finsupp.mem_supported]
    intro Y hY
    rw [Finset.mem_coe, Finsupp.mem_support_iff, Finsupp.sub_apply] at hY
    have hYX : Y ≠ X := by
      rintro rfl
      rw [Finsupp.single_eq_same, sub_self] at hY
      exact hY rfl
    have hYv : Y ∈ v.support := by
      rw [Finsupp.mem_support_iff]
      rwa [Finsupp.single_eq_of_ne hYX, sub_zero] at hY
    have hYP := hvP Y hYv
    refine ⟨⟨G.mem_irr_of_mem_P hquad hYP, hYP⟩, fun h => hYX ?_, hmax Y hYv⟩
    rw [Bar.eq_cutAllM_of_mem_P hYP, Bar.eq_cutAllM_of_mem_P hXP, h]
  have h0 : G.dL A (Finsupp.single X (v X)) = 0 :=
    Hoffbeck.leading_cycle (fun x y => O.lt x y) forgetM (fun a => (O.wf A).irrefl.irrefl a)
      ((G.bar.rw A).nf ∘ₗ Bar.d K) (G.dL A) (fun Y hY => G.d_sub_dL_mem hquad hY.1)
      (fun Y _ => G.dL_mem_fib Y) hvt hvr (by rw [add_sub_cancel]; exact hDv)
  
  intro k₀ hk₀
  by_contra hk₀L
  have hc := G.dL_cut_add hk₀ hk₀L (Y := X) rfl
  have hcut : Bar.cut K k₀ (Finsupp.single X (1 : K)) = 0 := by
    rw [Bar.cut, CutComplex.hL_single, one_smul, CutComplex.hX, if_pos]
    rw [Bar.cuts_eq_of_mem_P hXP, ← edgeKeys_forget, ← forgetM_val]
    exact hk₀
  rw [hcut, map_zero, zero_add] at hc
  have e1 : Finsupp.single X (v X) = v X • Finsupp.single X (1 : K) := by
    rw [Finsupp.smul_single_one]
  have h2 : Finsupp.single X (v X) = 0 := by
    rw [e1, ← hc, ← map_smul, ← map_smul, ← e1, h0, map_zero]
  exact (Finsupp.mem_support_iff.1 hX) (Finsupp.single_eq_zero.1 h2)

name: Operad.Rules.exists_kappa
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hS : (G.bar.rw A).Resolvable :=
    G.bar_resolvable (G.hlead_of_quad hquad) (G.hom_of_quad hquad hom) hres A
  have hXP : cutAllM t ∈ Bar.P A w w := Bar.cutAllM_mem_P hw ht
  
  have hDX : (G.bar.rw A).nf (Bar.d K (Finsupp.single (cutAllM t) 1)) ∈ Finsupp.supported K K
      ((G.bar.rw A).Irr ∩ Bar.P A w (w - 1) ∩ forgetM ⁻¹' {m | O.lt m t}) := by
    rw [Finsupp.supported_inter]
    refine ⟨G.nf_mem_P hquad hom (Bar.d_mem_P (n := w - 1) (by rwa [Nat.sub_add_cancel hw])), ?_⟩
    have h := G.d_sub_dL_mem hquad (G.mem_irr_of_mem_P hquad hXP)
    rwa [G.dL_cutAllM hfull, sub_zero, forgetM_cutAllM] at h
  have hDDX : (G.bar.rw A).nf (Bar.d K ((G.bar.rw A).nf
      (Bar.d K (Finsupp.single (cutAllM t) 1)))) = 0 := by
    rw [G.nf_d_nf hquad hom hres, Bar.d_d, map_zero]
  
  obtain ⟨u, hu, hDu⟩ := G.bar_exact_down hquad hom hres (s := w - 1) (by omega)
    (Z := {m | O.lt m t}) (fun m hm m' h => O.trans h hm) hDX hDDX
  rw [Nat.sub_add_cancel hw] at hu
  refine ⟨Finsupp.single (cutAllM t) 1 - u, Submodule.mem_inf.2 ⟨?_, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
  · exact Submodule.sub_mem _ (Finsupp.single_mem_supported K _ hXP)
      (Finsupp.supported_mono (fun Y hY => hY.1.2) hu)
  · rw [Submodule.mem_comap, ← hS.nf_eq_zero_iff, map_sub, map_sub, hDu, sub_self]
  · rw [sub_sub_cancel_left]
    exact Submodule.neg_mem _ (Finsupp.supported_mono (fun Y hY => hY.2) hu)

name: Operad.Rules.kappa_mem
statement: lemma Rules.kappa_mem (t : G.Full A w) : G.kappa hquad hom hres hw t ∈ G.KD A w
proof:
:=
  (Classical.choose_spec (G.exists_kappa hquad hom hres hw t.2.1 t.2.2)).1

name: Operad.Rules.kappa_sub
proof:
:= by
  rw [forgetM_cutAllM]
  exact (Classical.choose_spec (G.exists_kappa hquad hom hres hw t.2.1 t.2.2)).2

name: Operad.Rules.linearIndependent_kappa
statement: theorem Rules.linearIndependent_kappa : LinearIndependent K (G.kappa hquad hom hres hw (A := A))
proof:
:=
  Hoffbeck.linearIndependent_of_triangular (fun x y => O.lt x y) forgetM
    (fun a => (O.wf A).irrefl.irrefl a) O.trans (e := fun t : G.Full A w => cutAllM t.1)
    (fun _ _ h => Subtype.ext (cutAllM_injective h)) (G.kappa_sub hquad hom hres hw)

name: Operad.Rules.KD_eq_span
statement:
theorem Rules.KD_eq_span :
    G.KD A w = Submodule.span K (Set.range (G.kappa hquad hom hres hw (A := A)))
proof:
:= by
  refine le_antisymm (Hoffbeck.span_of_triangular (fun x y => O.lt x y) forgetM (O.wf A) O.trans
    (e := fun t : G.Full A w => cutAllM t.1) (G.kappa_mem hquad hom hres hw)
    (G.kappa_sub hquad hom hres hw) fun v hv X hX hmax => ?_)
    (Submodule.span_le.2 (Set.range_subset_iff.2 (G.kappa_mem hquad hom hres hw)))
  have hXP : X ∈ Bar.P A w w := (Finsupp.mem_supported K v).1 (Submodule.mem_inf.1 hv).1 hX
  refine ⟨⟨forgetM X, ?_, G.isFull_of_mem_KD hquad hom hres hv hX hmax⟩,
    (Bar.eq_cutAllM_of_mem_P hXP).symm⟩
  rw [forgetM_val, weight_forget]
  exact hXP.2.1

name: Operad.Rules.kdBasis_apply
statement:
theorem Rules.kdBasis_apply (t : G.Full A w) :
    (G.kdBasis hquad hom hres hw t : SMono (BE E) A →₀ K) = G.kappa hquad hom hres hw t
proof:
:= by
  simp [Rules.kdBasis]

name: Operad.Rules.rank_KD
statement:
theorem Rules.rank_KD [Nontrivial K] :
    Cardinal.lift.{v} (Module.rank K (G.KD A w)) =
      Cardinal.lift.{max u v} (Cardinal.mk (G.Full A w))
proof:
:=
  (G.kdBasis hquad hom hres hw).mk_eq_rank.symm

name: Operad.Rules.finrank_KD
statement:
theorem Rules.finrank_KD [Nontrivial K] :
    Module.finrank K (G.KD A w) = Nat.card (G.Full A w)
proof:
:=
  Module.finrank_eq_nat_card_basis (G.kdBasis hquad hom hres hw)

name: RightPreLieRing.commutator_def
statement: lemma commutator_def (x y : L) : commutator x y = x * y - y * x
proof: := rfl

name: RightPreLieRing.commutator_self
statement: @[simp] lemma commutator_self (x : L) : commutator x x = 0
proof: := sub_self _

name: RightPreLieRing.commutator_antisymm
statement: lemma commutator_antisymm (x y : L) : commutator x y = -commutator y x
proof:
:= by
  simp only [commutator_def, neg_sub]

name: RightPreLieRing.commutator_add_left
statement:
lemma commutator_add_left (x x' y : L) :
    commutator (x + x') y = commutator x y + commutator x' y
proof:
:= by
  simp only [commutator_def, add_mul, mul_add]; abel

name: RightPreLieRing.commutator_add_right
statement:
lemma commutator_add_right (x y y' : L) :
    commutator x (y + y') = commutator x y + commutator x y'
proof:
:= by
  simp only [commutator_def, add_mul, mul_add]; abel

name: RightPreLieRing.commutator_neg_right
statement: lemma commutator_neg_right (x y : L) : commutator x (-y) = -commutator x y
proof:
:= by
  simp only [commutator_def, mul_neg, neg_mul]; abel

name: RightPreLieRing.jacobi_aux
statement:
private lemma jacobi_aux (x y z : L) :
    commutator (commutator x y) z + commutator (commutator y z) x
        + commutator (commutator z x) y
      = (associator x y z - associator x z y) + (associator y z x - associator y x z)
        + (associator z x y - associator z y x)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [commutator_def, associator_apply, sub_mul, mul_sub]
  abel

name: RightPreLieRing.jacobi
statement:
theorem jacobi (x y z : L) :
    commutator (commutator x y) z + commutator (commutator y z) x
        + commutator (commutator z x) y = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [jacobi_aux, assoc_symm x y z, assoc_symm y z x, assoc_symm z x y]
  abel

name: Operad.ML.finsupp_ext
proof:
:= by
  classical
  ext x
  have hx : x = fun i => ∑ y ∈ (x i).support, (x i) y • Finsupp.single y (1 : R) := by
    funext i
    conv_lhs => rw [← Finsupp.sum_single (x i)]
    simp only [Finsupp.sum, Finsupp.smul_single, smul_eq_mul, mul_one]
  rw [hx, MultilinearMap.map_sum_finset, MultilinearMap.map_sum_finset]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun t _ => ?_
  rw [MultilinearMap.map_smul_univ, MultilinearMap.map_smul_univ, h]

name: Operad.ML.finsuppLift_single
statement:
@[simp] lemma finsuppLift_single (g : (ι → X) → W) (t : ι → X) :
    finsuppLift (R := R) g (fun i => Finsupp.single (t i) 1) = g t
proof:
:= by
  haveI := Classical.decEq R
  haveI := Classical.decEq X
  unfold finsuppLift
  simp only [LinearMap.compMultilinearMap_apply, LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearEquiv.coe_coe,
    PiTensorProduct.ofFinsuppEquiv'_tprod_single, Finset.prod_const_one, Finsupp.lift_apply,
    Finsupp.sum_single_index, one_smul, zero_smul]

name: Operad.ML.finsuppLift_eq_zero
statement:
theorem finsuppLift_eq_zero [Nonempty X] (g : (ι → X) → W) (N : Submodule R (X →₀ R))
    (hg : ∀ (t : ι → X) (i : ι),
      N ≤ LinearMap.ker (Finsupp.lift W R X fun y => g (update t i y)))
    (x : ι → X →₀ R) (i : ι) (hx : x i ∈ N) : finsuppLift (R := R) g x = 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  set m := finsuppLift (R := R) g
  
  let ℓ : (X →₀ R) →ₗ[R] (X →₀ R) := Finsupp.lift (X →₀ R) R X fun _ => x i
  let F := m.compLinearMap fun j => if j = i then ℓ else LinearMap.id
  have hF : F = 0 := by
    refine finsupp_ext fun t => ?_
    have hupd : (fun j => (if j = i then ℓ else LinearMap.id) (Finsupp.single (t j) (1 : R)))
        = update (fun j => Finsupp.single (t j) (1 : R)) i (x i) := by
      funext j
      by_cases hj : j = i
      · subst hj
        simp [ℓ]
      · simp [hj]
    show m _ = 0
    rw [hupd]
    have hlin : (m.toLinearMap (fun j => Finsupp.single (t j) (1 : R)) i)
        = Finsupp.lift W R X fun y => g (update t i y) := by
      refine Finsupp.lhom_ext fun y c => ?_
      rw [MultilinearMap.toLinearMap_apply, Finsupp.lift_apply, Finsupp.sum_single_index
        (by simp), ← Finsupp.smul_single_one, MultilinearMap.map_update_smul]
      congr 1
      rw [show update (fun j => Finsupp.single (t j) (1 : R)) i (Finsupp.single y 1)
          = fun j => Finsupp.single (update t i y j) 1 from by
        funext j
        by_cases hj : j = i
        · subst hj
          simp
        · simp [hj]]
      exact finsuppLift_single g _
    have := congrArg (fun L => L (x i)) hlin
    simp only [MultilinearMap.toLinearMap_apply] at this
    rw [this]
    exact hg t i hx
  obtain ⟨y₀⟩ := ‹Nonempty X›
  have hx' : x = fun j => (if j = i then ℓ else LinearMap.id)
      (update x i (Finsupp.single y₀ 1) j) := by
    funext j
    by_cases hj : j = i
    · subst hj
      simp [ℓ]
    · simp [hj]
  rw [hx']
  exact congrArg (fun G : MultilinearMap R (fun _ : ι => X →₀ R) W =>
    G (update x i (Finsupp.single y₀ 1))) hF

name: Operad.ML.finsupp_ext'
statement:
theorem finsupp_ext' {f g : MultilinearMap R (fun i => X i →₀ R) W}
    (h : ∀ t : ∀ i, X i,
      f (fun i => Finsupp.single (t i) 1) = g (fun i => Finsupp.single (t i) 1)) :
    f = g
proof:
:= by
  classical
  ext x
  have hx : x = fun i => ∑ y ∈ (x i).support, (x i) y • Finsupp.single y (1 : R) := by
    funext i
    conv_lhs => rw [← Finsupp.sum_single (x i)]
    simp only [Finsupp.sum, Finsupp.smul_single, smul_eq_mul, mul_one]
  rw [hx, MultilinearMap.map_sum_finset, MultilinearMap.map_sum_finset]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun t _ => ?_
  rw [MultilinearMap.map_smul_univ, MultilinearMap.map_smul_univ, h]

name: Operad.ML.finsuppLift'_single
statement:
@[simp] lemma finsuppLift'_single (g : (∀ i, X i) → W) (t : ∀ i, X i) :
    finsuppLift' (R := R) g (fun i => Finsupp.single (t i) 1) = g t
proof:
:= by
  haveI := Classical.decEq R
  haveI := fun i => Classical.decEq (X i)
  unfold finsuppLift'
  simp only [LinearMap.compMultilinearMap_apply, LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearEquiv.coe_coe,
    PiTensorProduct.ofFinsuppEquiv'_tprod_single, Finset.prod_const_one, Finsupp.lift_apply,
    Finsupp.sum_single_index, one_smul, zero_smul]

name: Operad.ML.finsuppLift'_update
statement:
lemma finsuppLift'_update (g : (∀ i, X i) → W) (t : ∀ i, X i) (i : ι) (z : X i →₀ R) :
    finsuppLift' (R := R) g (update (fun j => Finsupp.single (t j) 1) i z)
      = Finsupp.lift W R (X i) (fun y => g (update t i y)) z
proof:
:= by
  have h := congrArg (fun L : (X i →₀ R) →ₗ[R] W => L z)
    (show (finsuppLift' (R := R) g).toLinearMap (fun j => Finsupp.single (t j) 1) i
        = Finsupp.lift W R (X i) (fun y => g (update t i y)) from
      Finsupp.lhom_ext fun y c => by
        rw [MultilinearMap.toLinearMap_apply, Finsupp.lift_apply, Finsupp.sum_single_index
          (by simp), ← Finsupp.smul_single_one, MultilinearMap.map_update_smul]
        congr 1
        rw [show update (fun j => Finsupp.single (t j) (1 : R)) i (Finsupp.single y 1)
            = fun j => Finsupp.single (update t i y j) 1 from by
          funext j
          by_cases hj : j = i
          · subst hj
            simp
          · simp [hj]]
        exact finsuppLift'_single g _)
  simpa only [MultilinearMap.toLinearMap_apply] using h

name: Operad.ML.dsLift_lof
statement:
@[simp] lemma dsLift_lof (g : ∀ n : ι → κ, (∀ i, X (n i)) → W) (n : ι → κ)
    (y : ∀ i, X (n i) →₀ R) :
    dsLift (R := R) g (fun i => lof R κ (fun k => X k →₀ R) (n i) (y i))
      = finsuppLift' (R := R) (X := fun i => X (n i)) (g n) y
proof:
:= by
  unfold dsLift
  exact MultilinearMap.fromDirectSumEquiv_lof (R := R) (κ := fun _ : ι => κ)
    (M := fun _ k => X k →₀ R) _ n y

name: Operad.ML.dsLift_lof_single
statement:
lemma dsLift_lof_single (g : ∀ n : ι → κ, (∀ i, X (n i)) → W) (n : ι → κ) (t : ∀ i, X (n i)) :
    dsLift (R := R) g (fun i => lof R κ (fun k => X k →₀ R) (n i) (Finsupp.single (t i) 1))
      = g n t
proof:
:= by
  rw [dsLift_lof, finsuppLift'_single]

name: Operad.ML.ds_ext
statement:
theorem ds_ext {f g : MultilinearMap R (fun _ : ι => ⨁ k, (X k →₀ R)) W}
    (h : ∀ (n : ι → κ) (t : ∀ i, X (n i)),
      f (fun i => lof R κ (fun k => X k →₀ R) (n i) (Finsupp.single (t i) 1))
        = g (fun i => lof R κ (fun k => X k →₀ R) (n i) (Finsupp.single (t i) 1))) :
    f = g
proof:
:=
  MultilinearMap.directSum_ext fun n => finsupp_ext' fun t => h n t

name: Operad.ML.update_lof
statement:
lemma update_lof (n : ι → κ) (y : ∀ j, X (n j) →₀ R) (i : ι) (z : X (n i) →₀ R) :
    update (fun j => lof R κ (fun k => X k →₀ R) (n j) (y j)) i
        (lof R κ (fun k => X k →₀ R) (n i) z)
      = fun j => lof R κ (fun k => X k →₀ R) (n j) (update y i z j)
proof:
:= by
  funext j
  by_cases hj : j = i
  · subst hj
    simp
  · simp [hj]

name: Operad.ML.dsLift_update
statement:
lemma dsLift_update (g : ∀ n : ι → κ, (∀ i, X (n i)) → W) (n : ι → κ) (t : ∀ i, X (n i))
    (i : ι) (z : X (n i) →₀ R) :
    dsLift (R := R) g (update (fun j => lof R κ (fun k => X k →₀ R) (n j)
      (Finsupp.single (t j) 1)) i (lof R κ (fun k => X k →₀ R) (n i) z))
      = Finsupp.lift W R (X (n i)) (fun y => g n (update t i y)) z
proof:
:= by
  rw [update_lof, dsLift_lof]
  exact finsuppLift'_update (X := fun i => X (n i)) (g n) t i z

name: Operad.ML.dsLift_eq_zero
statement:
theorem dsLift_eq_zero (g : ∀ n : ι → κ, (∀ i, X (n i)) → W) (S : ∀ k, Set (X k →₀ R))
    (hg : ∀ (n : ι → κ) (t : ∀ i, X (n i)) (i : ι),
      S (n i) ⊆ LinearMap.ker (Finsupp.lift W R (X (n i)) fun y => g n (update t i y)))
    (x : ι → ⨁ k, (X k →₀ R)) (i : ι)
    (hx : x i ∈ Submodule.span R (⋃ k, lof R κ (fun k => X k →₀ R) k '' S k)) :
    dsLift (R := R) g x = 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have key : ∀ k (ρ : X k →₀ R), ρ ∈ S k → ∀ x : ι → ⨁ k, (X k →₀ R),
      dsLift (R := R) g (update x i (lof R κ (fun k => X k →₀ R) k ρ)) = 0 := by
    intro k ρ hρ x
    rcases isEmpty_or_nonempty (X k) with hX | ⟨⟨y₀⟩⟩
    · rw [show ρ = 0 from Subsingleton.elim _ _, map_zero, MultilinearMap.map_update_zero]
    let φ : (⨁ k, (X k →₀ R)) →ₗ[R] R :=
      (Finsupp.lapply y₀).comp (component R κ (fun k => X k →₀ R) k)
    let ℓ : (⨁ k, (X k →₀ R)) →ₗ[R] (⨁ k, (X k →₀ R)) :=
      LinearMap.smulRight φ (lof R κ (fun k => X k →₀ R) k ρ)
    let F : MultilinearMap R (fun _ : ι => ⨁ k, (X k →₀ R)) W :=
      (dsLift (R := R) g).compLinearMap fun j => if j = i then ℓ else LinearMap.id
    have hFapp : ∀ z, F z = dsLift (R := R) g (update z i (ℓ (z i))) := by
      intro z
      simp only [F, MultilinearMap.compLinearMap_apply]
      congr 1
      funext j
      by_cases hj : j = i
      · subst hj
        simp
      · simp [hj]
    have hF : F = 0 := by
      refine MultilinearMap.directSum_ext fun n => ?_
      refine finsupp_ext' fun t => ?_
      show F (fun j => lof R κ (fun k => X k →₀ R) (n j) (Finsupp.single (t j) 1)) = 0
      rw [hFapp]
      by_cases hk : n i = k
      · subst hk
        rw [show ℓ (lof R κ (fun k => X k →₀ R) (n i) (Finsupp.single (t i) 1))
            = (Finsupp.single (t i) (1 : R)) y₀ • lof R κ (fun k => X k →₀ R) (n i) ρ by
              simp [ℓ, φ],
          ← map_smul, dsLift_update, map_smul, LinearMap.mem_ker.1 (hg n t i hρ), smul_zero]
      · rw [show ℓ (lof R κ (fun k => X k →₀ R) (n i) (Finsupp.single (t i) 1)) = 0 by
              simp [ℓ, φ, component.of, hk],
          MultilinearMap.map_update_zero]
    have hℓ : ℓ (lof R κ (fun k => X k →₀ R) k (Finsupp.single y₀ 1))
        = lof R κ (fun k => X k →₀ R) k ρ := by
      simp [ℓ, φ]
    have h := hFapp (update x i (lof R κ (fun k => X k →₀ R) k (Finsupp.single y₀ 1)))
    rw [hF, MultilinearMap.zero_apply, update_idem, update_self, hℓ] at h
    exact h.symm
  have h := Submodule.span_induction
    (p := fun z _ => ∀ x : ι → ⨁ k, (X k →₀ R), dsLift (R := R) g (update x i z) = 0)
    (fun z hz x => by
      obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.1 hz
      obtain ⟨ρ, hρ, rfl⟩ := hk
      exact key k ρ hρ x)
    (fun x => MultilinearMap.map_update_zero _ _ _)
    (fun z z' _ _ hz hz' x => by rw [MultilinearMap.map_update_add, hz, hz', add_zero])
    (fun c z _ hz x => by rw [MultilinearMap.map_update_smul, hz, smul_zero]) hx
  simpa using h x

name: Operad.ML.eq_of_sub_mem
statement:
theorem eq_of_sub_mem (f : MultilinearMap R (fun _ : ι => M) W)
    (hf : ∀ (x : ι → M) (i : ι), x i ∈ N → f x = 0) (x y : ι → M)
    (h : ∀ i, x i - y i ∈ N) : f x = f y
proof:
:= by
  suffices key : ∀ s : Finset ι, ∀ x y : ι → M, (∀ i, x i - y i ∈ N) →
      (∀ i ∉ s, x i = y i) → f x = f y from
    key Finset.univ x y h fun i hi => absurd (Finset.mem_univ i) hi
  intro s
  induction s using Finset.induction_on with
  | empty =>
    intro x y _ hs
    exact congrArg f (funext fun i => hs i (Finset.notMem_empty i))
  | insert j s hj ih =>
    intro x y hxy hs
    have h1 : f (update x j (y j)) = f y := by
      refine ih _ _ (fun i => ?_) (fun i hi => ?_)
      · by_cases hij : i = j
        · subst hij
          simp
        · rw [update_of_ne hij]
          exact hxy i
      · by_cases hij : i = j
        · subst hij
          simp
        · rw [update_of_ne hij]
          exact hs i (by simp [hij, hi])
    have h2 : f x - f (update x j (y j)) = 0 := by
      rw [← hf (update x j (x j - y j)) j (by simpa using hxy j),
        MultilinearMap.map_update_sub, update_eq_self]
    rw [← h1, ← sub_eq_zero, h2]

name: Operad.ML.mkQ_rep
statement: lemma mkQ_rep (q : M ⧸ N) : N.mkQ (rep N q) = q
proof:
:=
  Function.surjInv_eq (Submodule.mkQ_surjective N) q

name: Operad.ML.quot_ext
statement:
theorem quot_ext {f g : MultilinearMap R (fun _ : ι => M ⧸ N) W}
    (h : ∀ x : ι → M, f (fun i => N.mkQ (x i)) = g (fun i => N.mkQ (x i))) : f = g
proof:
:= by
  ext y
  have hy : y = fun i => N.mkQ (rep N (y i)) := funext fun i => (mkQ_rep N (y i)).symm
  rw [hy]
  exact h _

name: Operad.ML.rep_add_sub_mem
statement: lemma rep_add_sub_mem (a b : M ⧸ N) : rep N (a + b) - (rep N a + rep N b) ∈ N
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Submodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero, Submodule.Quotient.mk_sub, Submodule.Quotient.mk_add]
  simp only [← Submodule.mkQ_apply, mkQ_rep, sub_self]

name: Operad.ML.rep_smul_sub_mem
statement: lemma rep_smul_sub_mem (c : R) (a : M ⧸ N) : rep N (c • a) - c • rep N a ∈ N
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Submodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero, Submodule.Quotient.mk_sub, Submodule.Quotient.mk_smul]
  simp only [← Submodule.mkQ_apply, mkQ_rep, sub_self]

name: Operad.ML.rep_mkQ_sub_mem
statement: lemma rep_mkQ_sub_mem (x : M) : rep N (N.mkQ x) - x ∈ N
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Submodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero, Submodule.Quotient.mk_sub]
  simp only [← Submodule.mkQ_apply, mkQ_rep, sub_self]

name: Operad.ML.liftQ_mkQ
statement:
lemma liftQ_mkQ (f : MultilinearMap R (fun _ : ι => M) W)
    (hf : ∀ (x : ι → M) (i : ι), x i ∈ N → f x = 0) (x : ι → M) :
    liftQ N f hf (fun i => N.mkQ (x i)) = f x
proof:
:=
  eq_of_sub_mem N f hf _ _ fun i => rep_mkQ_sub_mem N (x i)

name: Operad.ML.liftQ_mk
statement:
@[simp] lemma liftQ_mk (f : MultilinearMap R (fun _ : ι => M) W)
    (hf : ∀ (x : ι → M) (i : ι), x i ∈ N → f x = 0) (x : ι → M) :
    liftQ N f hf (fun i => Submodule.Quotient.mk (x i)) = f x
proof:
:=
  liftQ_mkQ N f hf x

name: Operad.ML.eq_of_sub_mem'
statement:
theorem eq_of_sub_mem' (f : MultilinearMap R M W)
    (hf : ∀ (x : ∀ i, M i) (i : ι), x i ∈ N i → f x = 0) (x y : ∀ i, M i)
    (h : ∀ i, x i - y i ∈ N i) : f x = f y
proof:
:= by
  suffices key : ∀ s : Finset ι, ∀ x y : ∀ i, M i, (∀ i, x i - y i ∈ N i) →
      (∀ i ∉ s, x i = y i) → f x = f y from
    key Finset.univ x y h fun i hi => absurd (Finset.mem_univ i) hi
  intro s
  induction s using Finset.induction_on with
  | empty =>
    intro x y _ hs
    exact congrArg f (funext fun i => hs i (Finset.notMem_empty i))
  | insert j s hj ih =>
    intro x y hxy hs
    have h1 : f (update x j (y j)) = f y := by
      refine ih _ _ (fun i => ?_) (fun i hi => ?_)
      · by_cases hij : i = j
        · subst hij
          simp
        · rw [update_of_ne hij]
          exact hxy i
      · by_cases hij : i = j
        · subst hij
          simp
        · rw [update_of_ne hij]
          exact hs i (by simp [hij, hi])
    have h2 : f x - f (update x j (y j)) = 0 := by
      rw [← hf (update x j (x j - y j)) j (by simpa using hxy j),
        MultilinearMap.map_update_sub, update_eq_self]
    rw [← h1, ← sub_eq_zero, h2]

name: Operad.ML.liftQ'_mkQ
statement:
lemma liftQ'_mkQ (f : MultilinearMap R M W)
    (hf : ∀ (x : ∀ i, M i) (i : ι), x i ∈ N i → f x = 0) (x : ∀ i, M i) :
    liftQ' N f hf (fun i => (N i).mkQ (x i)) = f x
proof:
:=
  eq_of_sub_mem' N f hf _ _ fun i => rep_mkQ_sub_mem (N i) (x i)

name: Operad.ML.liftQ'_mk
statement:
@[simp] lemma liftQ'_mk (f : MultilinearMap R M W)
    (hf : ∀ (x : ∀ i, M i) (i : ι), x i ∈ N i → f x = 0) (x : ∀ i, M i) :
    liftQ' N f hf (fun i => Submodule.Quotient.mk (x i)) = f x
proof:
:=
  liftQ'_mkQ N f hf x

name: Operad.ML.quot_ext'
proof:
:= by
  ext y
  have hy : y = fun i => (N i).mkQ (rep (N i) (y i)) :=
    funext fun i => (mkQ_rep (N i) (y i)).symm
  rw [hy]
  exact h _

name: Operad.ML.finsuppLift'_eq_zero
statement:
theorem finsuppLift'_eq_zero (g : (∀ i, X i) → W) (S : ∀ i, Set (X i →₀ R))
    (hg : ∀ (t : ∀ i, X i) (i : ι),
      S i ⊆ LinearMap.ker (Finsupp.lift W R (X i) fun y => g (update t i y)))
    (x : ∀ i, X i →₀ R) (i : ι) (hx : x i ∈ Submodule.span R (S i)) :
    finsuppLift' (R := R) g x = 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have key : ∀ ρ ∈ S i, ∀ x : ∀ i, X i →₀ R,
      finsuppLift' (R := R) g (update x i ρ) = 0 := by
    intro ρ hρ x
    rcases isEmpty_or_nonempty (X i) with hX | ⟨⟨y₀⟩⟩
    · rw [show ρ = 0 from Subsingleton.elim _ _, MultilinearMap.map_update_zero]
    let ℓ : (X i →₀ R) →ₗ[R] (X i →₀ R) := LinearMap.smulRight (Finsupp.lapply y₀) ρ
    let F : MultilinearMap R (fun i => X i →₀ R) W :=
      (finsuppLift' (R := R) g).compLinearMap (update (fun _ => LinearMap.id) i ℓ)
    have hFapp : ∀ z, F z = finsuppLift' (R := R) g (update z i (ℓ (z i))) := by
      intro z
      simp only [F, MultilinearMap.compLinearMap_apply]
      congr 1
      funext j
      by_cases hj : j = i
      · subst hj
        simp
      · simp [hj]
    have hF : F = 0 := by
      refine finsupp_ext' fun t => ?_
      rw [MultilinearMap.zero_apply, hFapp]
      rw [show ℓ (Finsupp.single (t i) 1) = (Finsupp.single (t i) (1 : R)) y₀ • ρ by simp [ℓ],
        MultilinearMap.map_update_smul, finsuppLift'_update, LinearMap.mem_ker.1 (hg t i hρ),
        smul_zero]
    have hℓ : ℓ (Finsupp.single y₀ 1) = ρ := by simp [ℓ]
    have h := hFapp (update x i (Finsupp.single y₀ 1))
    rw [hF, MultilinearMap.zero_apply, update_idem, update_self, hℓ] at h
    exact h.symm
  have h := Submodule.span_induction
    (p := fun z _ => ∀ x : ∀ i, X i →₀ R, finsuppLift' (R := R) g (update x i z) = 0)
    (fun z hz x => key z hz x)
    (fun x => MultilinearMap.map_update_zero _ _ _)
    (fun z z' _ _ hz hz' x => by rw [MultilinearMap.map_update_add, hz, hz', add_zero])
    (fun c z _ hz x => by rw [MultilinearMap.map_update_smul, hz, smul_zero]) hx
  simpa using h x

name: Operad.DiasData.eval_lc
statement:
lemma eval_lc (p q : DiOp) :
    (⟨3, NSSyn.eval d.gens (DiasGen.lc p q)⟩ : Arr S) = leftComb (d.op p) (d.op q)
proof:
:=
  (leftComb_eq _ _).symm

name: Operad.DiasData.eval_rc
statement:
lemma eval_rc (p q : DiOp) :
    (⟨3, NSSyn.eval d.gens (DiasGen.rc p q)⟩ : Arr S) = rightComb (d.op p) (d.op q)
proof:
:=
  (rightComb_eq _ _).symm

name: Operad.DiasData.respects
statement: theorem respects : NSPres.Respects DiasRel d.gens
proof:
:= by
  intro n x y h
  cases h
  · exact mk_eq_mk_iff.1 (by rw [eval_lc, eval_rc]; exact d.d1)
  · exact mk_eq_mk_iff.1 (by rw [eval_lc, eval_rc]; exact d.d2)
  · exact mk_eq_mk_iff.1 (by rw [eval_lc, eval_rc]; exact d.d3)
  · exact mk_eq_mk_iff.1 (by rw [eval_lc, eval_rc]; exact d.d4)
  · exact mk_eq_mk_iff.1 (by rw [eval_lc, eval_rc]; exact d.d5)

name: Operad.DiasData.rotClosed
statement: theorem rotClosed : RotClosed (Set.range d.op)
proof:
:= by
  rintro _ ⟨g, rfl⟩ _ ⟨h, rfl⟩
  cases g <;> cases h
  · exact ⟨_, ⟨.left, rfl⟩, _, ⟨.left, rfl⟩, d.d1⟩
  · exact ⟨_, ⟨.right, rfl⟩, _, ⟨.left, rfl⟩, d.d3⟩
  · exact ⟨_, ⟨.right, rfl⟩, _, ⟨.right, rfl⟩, d.d4⟩
  · exact ⟨_, ⟨.right, rfl⟩, _, ⟨.right, rfl⟩, d.d5⟩

name: Operad.DiasData.bin_left_right
statement:
lemma bin_left_right (o : DiOp) (X Y Z : Arr S) :
    bin (d.op .left) X (bin (d.op o) Y Z) = bin (d.op .left) X (bin (d.op .left) Y Z)
proof:
:= by
  cases o
  · rfl
  · exact (bin_right_of (d.d2.symm.trans d.d1) X Y Z)

name: Operad.DiasData.bin_left_rcomb
statement:
lemma bin_left_rcomb (X : Arr S) (l : List DiOp) :
    bin (d.op .left) X (rcomb (l.map d.op))
      = bin (d.op .left) X (rcomb ((List.replicate l.length DiOp.left).map d.op))
proof:
:= by
  induction l generalizing X with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons o l ih =>
    rw [List.map_cons, rcomb_cons, d.bin_left_right, ih one, List.length_cons,
      List.replicate_succ, List.map_cons, rcomb_cons]

name: Operad.DiasData.rcomb_norm
statement: theorem rcomb_norm (l : List DiOp) : rcomb (l.map d.op) = rcomb ((norm l).map d.op)
proof:
:= by
  induction l with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons o l ih =>
    cases o
    · rw [norm, List.map_cons, List.map_cons, rcomb_cons, rcomb_cons, bin_left_rcomb]
    · rw [norm, List.map_cons, List.map_cons, rcomb_cons, rcomb_cons, ih]

name: Operad.PDias.pt_lt
statement: lemma pt_lt (X : Arr PDias) : pt X < X.1
proof: := (toFin X.2).isLt

name: Operad.PDias.pt_mk
statement: lemma pt_mk {n : ℕ} (x : PDias n) : pt ⟨n, x⟩ = (toFin x : ℕ)
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.PDias.arr_ext
statement: lemma arr_ext {X Y : Arr PDias} (h1 : X.1 = Y.1) (h2 : pt X = pt Y) : X = Y
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨n, x⟩ := X
  obtain ⟨m, y⟩ := Y
  obtain rfl : n = m := h1
  exact mk_eq_mk_iff.2 (Fin.ext h2)

name: Operad.PDias.pt_one
statement: @[simp] lemma pt_one : pt (one : Arr PDias) = 0
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.PDias.pt_mk_comp
statement:
lemma pt_mk_comp (a b : ℕ) {n : ℕ} (x : PDias (a + 1 + b)) (y : PDias n) :
    pt ⟨a + n + b, NSSetOperad.comp a b x y⟩ =
      if (toFin x : ℕ) < a then (toFin x : ℕ)
      else if (toFin x : ℕ) = a then a + (toFin y : ℕ) else (toFin x : ℕ) + n - 1
proof:
:= by
  show ((insertEquiv a b n (PointedSet.comp (⟨a, by omega⟩ : Fin (a + 1 + b)) (toFin x)
    (toFin y)) : Fin _) : ℕ) = _
  by_cases h : toFin x = ⟨a, by omega⟩
  · rw [h, PointedSet.comp_self, insertEquiv_inr_val, if_neg (by simp), if_pos rfl]
  · have hx : (toFin x : ℕ) ≠ a := fun e => h (Fin.ext e)
    rw [PointedSet.comp_of_ne h, insertEquiv_inl_val, if_neg hx]

name: Operad.PDias.pt_comp
statement:
lemma pt_comp (X : Arr PDias) {a : ℕ} (ha : a < X.1) (Y : Arr PDias) :
    pt (comp X a Y) = if pt X < a then pt X else if pt X = a then a + pt Y else pt X + Y.1 - 1
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨b, x, rfl⟩ := exists_mk X ha
  obtain ⟨n, y⟩ := Y
  rw [mk_comp, pt_mk_comp]
  rfl

name: Operad.PDias.pt_bin
statement:
lemma pt_bin (g : PDias 2) (X Y : Arr PDias) :
    pt (bin g X Y) = if (toFin g : ℕ) = 0 then pt X else X.1 + pt Y
proof:
:= by
  have hZ : (comp ⟨2, g⟩ 1 Y).1 = Y.1 + 1 := by
    rw [comp_fst (by show 1 < 2; omega)]
    show 2 + Y.1 - 1 = Y.1 + 1
    omega
  have hg := (toFin g).isLt
  unfold bin
  rw [pt_comp _ (by omega), pt_comp _ (by show 1 < 2; omega), pt_mk]
  by_cases h0 : (toFin g : ℕ) = 0
  · simp [h0]
  · have h1 : (toFin g : ℕ) = 1 := by omega
    simp [h1]
    omega

name: Operad.PDias.pt_rcomb
statement: lemma pt_rcomb (l : List DiOp) : pt (rcomb (l.map DiOp.toPD)) = ptOf l
proof:
:= by
  induction l with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons o l ih =>
    rw [List.map_cons, rcomb_cons, pt_bin]
    cases o
    · rfl
    · show (if (PDias.toFin (1 : Fin 2) : ℕ) = 0 then _ else _) = _
      rw [if_neg (by simp [PDias.toFin]), one_fst, ih, ptOf]
      omega

name: Operad.PDias.norm_eq_of_ptOf_eq
statement:
theorem norm_eq_of_ptOf_eq {l₁ l₂ : List DiOp} (h1 : l₁.length = l₂.length)
    (h2 : ptOf l₁ = ptOf l₂) : DiasData.norm l₁ = DiasData.norm l₂
proof:
:= by
  induction l₁ generalizing l₂ with
  | nil =>
    cases l₂ with
    | nil => rfl
    | cons _ _ => simp at h1
  | cons o₁ l₁ ih =>
    cases l₂ with
    | nil => simp at h1
    | cons o₂ l₂ =>
      have hl : l₁.length = l₂.length := by simpa using h1
      cases o₁ <;> cases o₂
      · rw [DiasData.norm, DiasData.norm, hl]
      · simp [ptOf] at h2
      · simp [ptOf] at h2
      · rw [DiasData.norm, DiasData.norm, ih hl (by simpa [ptOf] using h2)]

name: Operad.PDias.length_ofPt
statement:
lemma length_ofPt : ∀ (m k : ℕ), (ofPt m k).length = m
  | 0, _ => rfl
  | m + 1, 0 => by simp [ofPt]
  | m + 1, k + 1 => by simp [ofPt, length_ofPt m k]

name: Operad.PDias.ptOf_ofPt
statement:
lemma ptOf_ofPt : ∀ (m k : ℕ), k ≤ m → ptOf (ofPt m k) = k
  | 0, _, h => by simp only [Nat.le_zero] at h; subst h; rfl
  | m + 1, 0, _ => rfl
  | m + 1, k + 1, h => by simp [ofPt, ptOf, ptOf_ofPt m k (by omega)]

end PDias

section DiasPresentation

variable {p q p' q' : DiOp}

private lemma dias_lr (h : DiasRel 3 (DiasGen.lc p q) (DiasGen.rc p' q')) :
    leftComb (NSPres.gen (ρ := DiasRel) (DiasGen.op p)) (NSPres.gen (DiasGen.op q))
      = rightComb (NSPres.gen (DiasGen.op p')) (NSPres.gen (DiasGen.op q'))
proof:
:= by
  rw [leftComb_eq, rightComb_eq]
  exact congrArg (fun x => (⟨3, x⟩ : Arr (NSPres DiasGen DiasRel))) (NSPres.mk_eq_mk_of_rel h)

name: Operad.dias_lr
proof:
:= by
  rw [leftComb_eq, rightComb_eq]
  exact congrArg (fun x => (⟨3, x⟩ : Arr (NSPres DiasGen DiasRel))) (NSPres.mk_eq_mk_of_rel h)

name: Operad.pd_eq
statement:
private lemma pd_eq {X Y : Arr PDias} (hX : X.1 = 3) (hY : Y.1 = 3) (h : PDias.pt X = PDias.pt Y) :
    X = Y
proof:
:=
  PDias.arr_ext (hX.trans hY.symm) h

name: Operad.PDias.map_ev_rcomb
statement:
lemma map_ev_rcomb (l : List DiOp) :
    Arr.map ev (rcomb (l.map DiasData.pres.op)) = rcomb (l.map DiOp.toPD)
proof:
:= by
  rw [map_rcomb, List.map_map]
  rfl

name: Operad.PDias.exists_map_of_forall_mem_range
statement:
private lemma exists_map_of_forall_mem_range {α β : Type*} {f : α → β} {l : List β}
    (h : ∀ x ∈ l, x ∈ Set.range f) : ∃ l' : List α, l = l'.map f
proof:
:= by
  induction l with
  | nil => exact ⟨[], rfl⟩
  | cons x l ih =>
    obtain ⟨a, rfl⟩ := h x (by simp)
    obtain ⟨l', rfl⟩ := ih (fun y hy => h y (by simp [hy]))
    exact ⟨a :: l', rfl⟩

name: Operad.PDias.exists_rcomb
statement:
theorem exists_rcomb (X : Arr (NSPres DiasGen DiasRel)) :
    ∃ l : List DiOp, X = rcomb (l.map DiasData.pres.op)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨l, hl, rfl⟩ := pres_isRComb DiasData.pres.rotClosed
    (fun n g => by cases g with | op o => exact isRComb_of_mem ⟨o, rfl⟩) X
  obtain ⟨l', rfl⟩ := exists_map_of_forall_mem_range hl
  exact ⟨l', rfl⟩

name: Operad.PDias.map_ev_injective
statement: theorem map_ev_injective : Function.Injective (Arr.map ev)
proof:
:= by
  intro X Y h
  obtain ⟨l₁, rfl⟩ := exists_rcomb X
  obtain ⟨l₂, rfl⟩ := exists_rcomb Y
  rw [map_ev_rcomb, map_ev_rcomb] at h
  have h1 : l₁.length = l₂.length := by
    have := congrArg Sigma.fst h
    simpa using this
  have h2 : ptOf l₁ = ptOf l₂ := by rw [← pt_rcomb, ← pt_rcomb, h]
  rw [DiasData.pres.rcomb_norm l₁, DiasData.pres.rcomb_norm l₂, norm_eq_of_ptOf_eq h1 h2]

name: Operad.PDias.map_ev_surjective
statement: theorem map_ev_surjective : Function.Surjective (Arr.map ev)
proof:
:= by
  rintro ⟨n, x⟩
  obtain ⟨m, rfl⟩ : ∃ m, n = m + 1 := ⟨n - 1, by have := (toFin x).2; omega⟩
  refine ⟨rcomb ((ofPt m (toFin x)).map DiasData.pres.op), ?_⟩
  rw [map_ev_rcomb]
  refine arr_ext (by simp [length_ofPt]) ?_
  rw [pt_rcomb, ptOf_ofPt _ _ (by have := (toFin x).2; omega)]
  rfl

name: Operad.PDias.ev_bijective
statement: theorem ev_bijective (n : ℕ) : Function.Bijective (ev.app n)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro x y h
    exact mk_eq_mk_iff.1 (map_ev_injective (a₁ := ⟨n, x⟩) (a₂ := ⟨n, y⟩)
      (by rw [map_mk, map_mk, h]))
  · intro s
    obtain ⟨⟨m, x⟩, hX⟩ := map_ev_surjective ⟨n, s⟩
    obtain rfl : m = n := congrArg Sigma.fst hX
    exact ⟨x, mk_eq_mk_iff.1 hX⟩

name: Operad.TriasData.eval_lc
statement:
lemma eval_lc (p q : TriOp) :
    (⟨3, NSSyn.eval d.gens (TriasGen.lc p q)⟩ : Arr S) = leftComb (d.op p) (d.op q)
proof:
:=
  (leftComb_eq _ _).symm

name: Operad.TriasData.eval_rc
statement:
lemma eval_rc (p q : TriOp) :
    (⟨3, NSSyn.eval d.gens (TriasGen.rc p q)⟩ : Arr S) = rightComb (d.op p) (d.op q)
proof:
:=
  (rightComb_eq _ _).symm

name: Operad.TriasData.respects
statement: theorem respects : NSPres.Respects TriasRel d.gens
proof:
:= by
  intro n x y h
  cases h
  · exact mk_eq_mk_iff.1 (by rw [eval_lc, eval_rc]; exact d.t1)
  · exact mk_eq_mk_iff.1 (by rw [eval_lc, eval_rc]; exact d.t2)
  · exact mk_eq_mk_iff.1 (by rw [eval_lc, eval_rc]; exact d.t3)
  · exact mk_eq_mk_iff.1 (by rw [eval_lc, eval_rc]; exact d.t4)
  · exact mk_eq_mk_iff.1 (by rw [eval_lc, eval_rc]; exact d.t5)
  · exact mk_eq_mk_iff.1 (by rw [eval_lc, eval_rc]; exact d.t6)
  · exact mk_eq_mk_iff.1 (by rw [eval_lc, eval_rc]; exact d.t7)
  · exact mk_eq_mk_iff.1 (by rw [eval_lc, eval_rc]; exact d.t8)
  · exact mk_eq_mk_iff.1 (by rw [eval_lc, eval_rc]; exact d.t9)
  · exact mk_eq_mk_iff.1 (by rw [eval_lc, eval_rc]; exact d.t10)
  · exact mk_eq_mk_iff.1 (by rw [eval_lc, eval_rc]; exact d.t11)

name: Operad.TriasData.rotClosed
statement: theorem rotClosed : RotClosed (Set.range d.op)
proof:
:= by
  rintro _ ⟨g, rfl⟩ _ ⟨h, rfl⟩
  cases g <;> cases h
  · exact ⟨_, ⟨.left, rfl⟩, _, ⟨.left, rfl⟩, d.t1⟩
  · exact ⟨_, ⟨.right, rfl⟩, _, ⟨.left, rfl⟩, d.t3⟩
  · exact ⟨_, ⟨.middle, rfl⟩, _, ⟨.left, rfl⟩, d.t7⟩
  · exact ⟨_, ⟨.right, rfl⟩, _, ⟨.right, rfl⟩, d.t4⟩
  · exact ⟨_, ⟨.right, rfl⟩, _, ⟨.right, rfl⟩, d.t5⟩
  · exact ⟨_, ⟨.right, rfl⟩, _, ⟨.right, rfl⟩, d.t10⟩
  · exact ⟨_, ⟨.middle, rfl⟩, _, ⟨.right, rfl⟩, d.t8⟩
  · exact ⟨_, ⟨.right, rfl⟩, _, ⟨.middle, rfl⟩, d.t9⟩
  · exact ⟨_, ⟨.middle, rfl⟩, _, ⟨.middle, rfl⟩, d.t11⟩

name: Operad.TriasData.bin_left_right
statement:
lemma bin_left_right (o : TriOp) (X Y Z : Arr S) :
    bin (d.op .left) X (bin (d.op o) Y Z) = bin (d.op .left) X (bin (d.op .left) Y Z)
proof:
:= by
  cases o
  · rfl
  · exact bin_right_of (d.t2.symm.trans d.t1) X Y Z
  · exact bin_right_of (d.t6.symm.trans d.t1) X Y Z

name: Operad.TriasData.bin_left_rcomb
statement:
lemma bin_left_rcomb (X : Arr S) (l : List TriOp) :
    bin (d.op .left) X (rcomb (l.map d.op))
      = bin (d.op .left) X (rcomb ((List.replicate l.length TriOp.left).map d.op))
proof:
:= by
  induction l generalizing X with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons o l ih =>
    rw [List.map_cons, rcomb_cons, d.bin_left_right, ih one, List.length_cons,
      List.replicate_succ, List.map_cons, rcomb_cons]

name: Operad.TriasData.rcomb_norm
statement: theorem rcomb_norm (l : List TriOp) : rcomb (l.map d.op) = rcomb ((norm l).map d.op)
proof:
:= by
  induction l with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons o l ih =>
    cases o
    · rw [norm, List.map_cons, List.map_cons, rcomb_cons, rcomb_cons, bin_left_rcomb]
    · rw [norm, List.map_cons, List.map_cons, rcomb_cons, rcomb_cons, ih]
    · rw [norm, List.map_cons, List.map_cons, rcomb_cons, rcomb_cons, ih]

name: Operad.PTrias.val_of_le
statement: lemma val_of_le {X : Arr PTrias} {k : ℕ} (h : X.1 ≤ k) : val X k = false
proof:
:= by
  unfold val
  rw [dif_neg (by omega)]

name: Operad.PTrias.val_mk
statement:
lemma val_mk {n : ℕ} (x : PTrias n) (k : Fin n) :
    val ⟨n, x⟩ k = (x : NonemptySubset (Fin n)).1 k
proof:
:= by
  unfold val
  rw [dif_pos k.2]

name: Operad.PTrias.arr_ext
statement: lemma arr_ext {X Y : Arr PTrias} (h1 : X.1 = Y.1) (h2 : ∀ k, val X k = val Y k) : X = Y
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨n, x⟩ := X
  obtain ⟨m, y⟩ := Y
  obtain rfl : n = m := h1
  refine mk_eq_mk_iff.2 (Subtype.ext (funext fun k => ?_))
  rw [← val_mk, ← val_mk, h2]

name: Operad.PTrias.val_one
statement: @[simp] lemma val_one (k : ℕ) : val one k = decide (k = 0)
proof:
:= by
  unfold val
  by_cases h : k = 0
  · subst h
    rfl
  · rw [dif_neg (by show ¬ k < 1; omega)]
    simp [h]

name: Operad.PTrias.val_mk_comp
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hk : k < a + n + b
  · rw [val_mk _ ⟨k, hk⟩]
    show NonemptySubset.compFun (⟨a, by omega⟩ : Fin (a + 1 + b)) x.1 y.1
      ((insertEquiv a b n).symm ⟨k, hk⟩) = _
    by_cases h1 : k < a
    · have : (insertEquiv a b n).symm ⟨k, hk⟩ = Sum.inl ⟨⟨k, by omega⟩, fun e => by
          have := congrArg Fin.val e; simp only at this; omega⟩ := by
        simp [insertEquiv, h1]
      rw [this, if_pos h1, val_mk _ ⟨k, by omega⟩]
      rfl
    · by_cases h2 : k < a + n
      · have : (insertEquiv a b n).symm ⟨k, hk⟩ = Sum.inr ⟨k - a, by omega⟩ := by
          simp [insertEquiv, h1, h2]
        rw [this, if_neg h1, if_pos h2, val_mk _ ⟨a, by omega⟩, val_mk _ ⟨k - a, by omega⟩]
        rfl
      · have : (insertEquiv a b n).symm ⟨k, hk⟩ = Sum.inl ⟨⟨k - n + 1, by omega⟩, fun e => by
            have := congrArg Fin.val e; simp only at this; omega⟩ := by
          simp [insertEquiv, h1, h2]
        rw [this, if_neg h1, if_neg h2, val_mk _ ⟨k - n + 1, by omega⟩]
        rfl
  · rw [val_of_le (by show a + n + b ≤ k; omega)]
    have h1 : ¬ k < a := by omega
    rw [if_neg h1]
    by_cases h2 : k < a + n
    · rw [if_pos h2, val_of_le (X := ⟨n, y⟩) (by show n ≤ k - a; omega), Bool.and_false]
    · rw [if_neg h2, val_of_le (by show a + 1 + b ≤ k - n + 1; omega)]

name: Operad.PTrias.val_comp
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨b, x, rfl⟩ := exists_mk X ha
  obtain ⟨n, y⟩ := Y
  rw [mk_comp, val_mk_comp]

name: Operad.PTrias.val_bin
proof:
:= by
  have hZ : (comp ⟨2, g⟩ 1 Y).1 = Y.1 + 1 := by
    rw [comp_fst (by show 1 < 2; omega)]
    show 2 + Y.1 - 1 = Y.1 + 1
    omega
  unfold bin
  rw [val_comp _ (by omega)]
  simp only [Nat.not_lt_zero, if_false, Nat.zero_add, Nat.sub_zero]
  by_cases hk : k < X.1
  · rw [if_pos hk, if_pos hk, val_comp _ (by show 1 < 2; omega), if_pos (by omega)]
  · rw [if_neg hk, if_neg hk, val_comp _ (by show 1 < 2; omega), if_neg (by omega)]
    by_cases h2 : k - X.1 + 1 < 1 + Y.1
    · rw [if_pos h2, show k - X.1 + 1 - 1 = k - X.1 by omega]
    · rw [if_neg h2, val_of_le (by show 2 ≤ k - X.1 + 1 - Y.1 + 1; omega),
        val_of_le (X := Y) (by omega), Bool.and_false]

name: Operad.PTrias.marks_of_lt
statement: lemma marks_of_lt {l : List TriOp} {k : ℕ} (h : l.length < k) : marks l k = false
proof:
:= by
  induction l generalizing k with
  | nil => simp only [marks, decide_eq_false_iff_not]; simp at h; omega
  | cons o l ih =>
    obtain ⟨k, rfl⟩ : ∃ j, k = j + 1 := ⟨k - 1, by simp at h; omega⟩
    simp only [marks, ih (show l.length < k by simp at h; omega), Bool.and_false]

name: Operad.PTrias.exists_marks
statement: lemma exists_marks (l : List TriOp) : ∃ k, marks l k = true
proof:
:= by
  induction l with
  | nil => exact ⟨0, rfl⟩
  | cons o l ih =>
    cases o
    · exact ⟨0, rfl⟩
    · obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := ih
      exact ⟨k + 1, by simp [marks, TriOp.snd, hk]⟩
    · exact ⟨0, rfl⟩

name: Operad.PTrias.norm_eq_of_marks_eq
statement:
theorem norm_eq_of_marks_eq {l₁ l₂ : List TriOp} (h1 : l₁.length = l₂.length)
    (h2 : ∀ k, marks l₁ k = marks l₂ k) : TriasData.norm l₁ = TriasData.norm l₂
proof:
:= by
  induction l₁ generalizing l₂ with
  | nil =>
    cases l₂ with
    | nil => rfl
    | cons _ _ => simp at h1
  | cons o₁ l₁ ih =>
    cases l₂ with
    | nil => simp at h1
    | cons o₂ l₂ =>
      have h0 := h2 0
      have hs : ∀ k, (o₁.snd && marks l₁ k) = (o₂.snd && marks l₂ k) := fun k => h2 (k + 1)
      have hl : l₁.length = l₂.length := by simpa using h1
      cases o₁ <;> cases o₂
      · rw [TriasData.norm, TriasData.norm, hl]
      · simp [marks, TriOp.fst] at h0
      · obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := exists_marks l₂
        simpa [TriOp.snd, hk] using (hs k).symm
      · simp [marks, TriOp.fst] at h0
      · rw [TriasData.norm, TriasData.norm, ih hl (fun k => by simpa [TriOp.snd] using hs k)]
      · simp [marks, TriOp.fst] at h0
      · obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := exists_marks l₁
        simpa [TriOp.snd, hk] using hs k
      · simp [marks, TriOp.fst] at h0
      · rw [TriasData.norm, TriasData.norm, ih hl (fun k => by simpa [TriOp.snd] using hs k)]

name: Operad.PTrias.length_ofMarks
statement: lemma length_ofMarks (m : ℕ) (s : ℕ → Bool) : (ofMarks m s).length = m
proof:
:= by
  induction m generalizing s with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ m ih =>
    unfold ofMarks
    split_ifs <;> simp [ih]

name: Operad.PTrias.marks_ofMarks
statement:
theorem marks_ofMarks (m : ℕ) (s : ℕ → Bool) (hs : ∃ k ≤ m, s k = true) {k : ℕ} (hk : k ≤ m) :
    marks (ofMarks m s) k = s k
proof:
:= by
  induction m generalizing s k with
  | zero =>
    obtain rfl : k = 0 := by omega
    obtain ⟨j, hj, hsj⟩ := hs
    obtain rfl : j = 0 := by omega
    rw [hsj]
    rfl
  | succ m ih =>
    unfold ofMarks
    by_cases h0 : s 0 = true
    · rw [if_pos h0]
      by_cases hany : ((List.range (m + 1)).any (fun k => s (k + 1))) = true
      · rw [if_pos hany]
        rcases k with _ | k
        · rw [h0]; rfl
        · have hs' : ∃ j ≤ m, s (j + 1) = true := by
            obtain ⟨j, hj, hsj⟩ := List.any_eq_true.1 hany
            exact ⟨j, by simp at hj; omega, hsj⟩
          simp only [marks, TriOp.snd, Bool.true_and]
          exact ih (fun j => s (j + 1)) hs' (by omega)
      · rw [if_neg hany]
        rcases k with _ | k
        · rw [h0]; rfl
        · simp only [marks, TriOp.snd, Bool.false_and]
          have : ¬ s (k + 1) = true := fun hsk =>
            hany (List.any_eq_true.2 ⟨k, List.mem_range.2 (by omega), hsk⟩)
          simpa using this
    · rw [if_neg h0]
      rcases k with _ | k
      · simp only [marks, TriOp.fst]; simpa using h0
      · have hs' : ∃ j ≤ m, s (j + 1) = true := by
          obtain ⟨j, hj, hsj⟩ := hs
          rcases j with _ | j
          · exact absurd hsj h0
          · exact ⟨j, by omega, hsj⟩
        simp only [marks, TriOp.snd, Bool.true_and]
        exact ih (fun j => s (j + 1)) hs' (by omega)

name: Operad.TriOp.val_toPT_zero
statement: @[simp] lemma val_toPT_zero (o : TriOp) : PTrias.val ⟨2, o.toPT⟩ 0 = o.fst
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.TriOp.val_toPT_one
statement: @[simp] lemma val_toPT_one (o : TriOp) : PTrias.val ⟨2, o.toPT⟩ 1 = o.snd
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.trias_lr
proof:
:= by
  rw [leftComb_eq, rightComb_eq]
  exact congrArg (fun x => (⟨3, x⟩ : Arr (NSPres TriasGen TriasRel))) (NSPres.mk_eq_mk_of_rel h)

name: Operad.pt_eq
proof:
:= by
  refine PTrias.arr_ext (hX.trans hY.symm) fun k => ?_
  rcases k with _ | _ | _ | k
  · exact h0
  · exact h1
  · exact h2
  · rw [PTrias.val_of_le (by omega), PTrias.val_of_le (by omega)]

name: Operad.PTrias.val_rcomb
statement: lemma val_rcomb (l : List TriOp) (k : ℕ) : val (rcomb (l.map TriOp.toPT)) k = marks l k
proof:
:= by
  induction l generalizing k with
  | nil => rw [List.map_nil, rcomb_nil, val_one]; rfl
  | cons o l ih =>
    rw [List.map_cons, rcomb_cons, val_bin]
    rcases k with _ | k
    · simp [marks]
    · simp only [one_fst, show ¬ k + 1 < 1 by omega, if_false, TriOp.val_toPT_one,
        Nat.add_sub_cancel, ih]
      rfl

name: Operad.PTrias.map_ev_rcomb
statement:
lemma map_ev_rcomb (l : List TriOp) :
    Arr.map ev (rcomb (l.map TriasData.pres.op)) = rcomb (l.map TriOp.toPT)
proof:
:= by
  rw [map_rcomb, List.map_map]
  rfl

name: Operad.PTrias.exists_map_of_forall_mem_range
statement:
private lemma exists_map_of_forall_mem_range {α β : Type*} {f : α → β} {l : List β}
    (h : ∀ x ∈ l, x ∈ Set.range f) : ∃ l' : List α, l = l'.map f
proof:
:= by
  induction l with
  | nil => exact ⟨[], rfl⟩
  | cons x l ih =>
    obtain ⟨a, rfl⟩ := h x (by simp)
    obtain ⟨l', rfl⟩ := ih (fun y hy => h y (by simp [hy]))
    exact ⟨a :: l', rfl⟩

name: Operad.PTrias.exists_rcomb
statement:
theorem exists_rcomb (X : Arr (NSPres TriasGen TriasRel)) :
    ∃ l : List TriOp, X = rcomb (l.map TriasData.pres.op)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨l, hl, rfl⟩ := pres_isRComb TriasData.pres.rotClosed
    (fun n g => by cases g with | op o => exact isRComb_of_mem ⟨o, rfl⟩) X
  obtain ⟨l', rfl⟩ := exists_map_of_forall_mem_range hl
  exact ⟨l', rfl⟩

name: Operad.PTrias.map_ev_injective
statement: theorem map_ev_injective : Function.Injective (Arr.map ev)
proof:
:= by
