  intro X Y h
  obtain ⟨l₁, rfl⟩ := exists_rcomb X
  obtain ⟨l₂, rfl⟩ := exists_rcomb Y
  rw [map_ev_rcomb, map_ev_rcomb] at h
  have h1 : l₁.length = l₂.length := by
    have := congrArg Sigma.fst h
    simpa using this
  have h2 : ∀ k, marks l₁ k = marks l₂ k := fun k => by rw [← val_rcomb, ← val_rcomb, h]
  rw [TriasData.pres.rcomb_norm l₁, TriasData.pres.rcomb_norm l₂, norm_eq_of_marks_eq h1 h2]

name: Operad.PTrias.map_ev_surjective
statement: theorem map_ev_surjective : Function.Surjective (Arr.map ev)
proof:
:= by
  rintro ⟨n, x⟩
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := (x : NonemptySubset (Fin n)).2
  obtain ⟨m, rfl⟩ : ∃ m, n = m + 1 := ⟨n - 1, by have := a.2; omega⟩
  have hs : ∃ k ≤ m, val ⟨m + 1, x⟩ k = true :=
    ⟨a, by have := a.2; omega, by rw [val_mk]; exact ha⟩
  refine ⟨rcomb ((ofMarks m (val ⟨m + 1, x⟩)).map TriasData.pres.op), ?_⟩
  rw [map_ev_rcomb]
  refine arr_ext (by simp [length_ofMarks]) fun k => ?_
  rw [val_rcomb]
  by_cases hk : k ≤ m
  · exact marks_ofMarks m _ hs hk
  · rw [marks_of_lt (by rw [length_ofMarks]; omega), val_of_le (by show m + 1 ≤ k; omega)]

name: Operad.PTrias.ev_bijective
statement: theorem ev_bijective (n : ℕ) : Function.Bijective (ev.app n)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro x y h
    exact mk_eq_mk_iff.1 (map_ev_injective (a₁ := ⟨n, x⟩) (a₂ := ⟨n, y⟩)
      (by rw [map_mk, map_mk, h]))
  · intro s
    obtain ⟨⟨m, x⟩, hX⟩ := map_ev_surjective ⟨n, s⟩
    obtain rfl : m = n := congrArg Sigma.fst hX
    exact ⟨x, mk_eq_mk_iff.1 hX⟩

name: Operad.AssBin.perm_ev
statement:
theorem perm_ev : ∀ t : LTree (AssShGen 2), (ev t).Perm t.labels
  | leaf _ => List.Perm.refl _
  | node mu l r => (perm_ev l).append (perm_ev r)
  | node op l r => List.perm_append_comm.trans ((perm_ev l).append (perm_ev r))

name: Operad.AssBin.ev_ne_nil
statement:
theorem ev_ne_nil : ∀ t : LTree (AssShGen 2), ev t ≠ []
  | leaf _ => List.cons_ne_nil _ _
  | node mu l r => by simp [ev, ap, ev_ne_nil l]
  | node op l r => by simp [ev, ap, ev_ne_nil r]

                                                                                        
def evRep : LTree (AssShGen 2) → List Bool → List ℕ → List ℕ
  | _, [], w => w
  | leaf a, _ :: _, _ => [a]
  | node e l r, false :: p, w => ap e (evRep l p w) (ev r)
  | node e l r, true :: p, w => ap e (ev l) (evRep r p w)

name: Operad.AssBin.ev_replaceAt
statement:
theorem ev_replaceAt : ∀ (t : LTree (AssShGen 2)) (p : List Bool) (u : LTree (AssShGen 2)),
    ev (t.replaceAt p u) = evRep t p (ev u)
  | leaf _, [], _ => rfl
  | node _ _ _, [], _ => rfl
  | leaf _, _ :: _, _ => rfl
  | node e l r, false :: p, u => by
    simp only [replaceAt, ev, evRep, ev_replaceAt l p u]
  | node e l r, true :: p, u => by
    simp only [replaceAt, ev, evRep, ev_replaceAt r p u]

name: Operad.AssBin.ev_plug
statement:
theorem ev_plug (ins : ℕ → LTree (AssShGen 2)) : ∀ m : LTree (AssShGen 2),
    ev (m.plug ins) = (ev m).flatMap fun a => ev (ins a)
  | leaf a => by simp [plug, ev]
  | node mu l r => by simp [plug, ev, ap, ev_plug ins l, ev_plug ins r]
  | node op l r => by simp [plug, ev, ap, ev_plug ins l, ev_plug ins r]

name: Operad.AssBin.ev_substAt
statement:
theorem ev_substAt (t : LTree (AssShGen 2)) (p : List Bool) (s : Bool) (m : LTree (AssShGen 2)) :
    ev (t.substAt p s m) = evRep t p ((ev m).flatMap fun a => ev ((t.subtreeAt p).winIns s a))
proof:
:= by
  rw [substAt, ev_replaceAt, ev_plug]

name: Operad.AssBin.lead3_mem
statement: lemma lead3_mem (e f : AssShGen 2) (s : Bool) : lead3 e f s ∈ monomials 3
proof:
:= by
  cases e <;> cases f <;> cases s <;> exact (mem_monomials 3 _).2 ⟨by decide, by decide⟩

name: Operad.AssBin.tail3_mem
statement: lemma tail3_mem (e f : AssShGen 2) (s : Bool) : tail3 e f s ∈ monomials 3
proof:
:= by
  cases e <;> cases f <;> cases s <;> exact (mem_monomials 3 _).2 ⟨by decide, by decide⟩

name: Operad.AssBin.spec3
statement:
lemma spec3 {e f : AssShGen 2} (hef : (e, f) ≠ (mu, op)) (s : Bool) :
    tail3 e f s ≠ lead3 e f s ∧ ev (lead3 e f s) = ev (tail3 e f s) ∧
      pathKey rk 3 (tail3 e f s) < pathKey rk 3 (lead3 e f s) ∧ tail3 e f s ∉ leads
proof:
:= by
  cases e <;> cases f <;> cases s <;> first
    | exact absurd rfl hef
    | refine ⟨by decide, rfl, by decide, ?_⟩
      rintro ⟨e', f', s', hne, h⟩
      cases e' <;> cases f' <;> cases s' <;>
        first | exact absurd rfl hne | exact absurd h (by decide)

name: Operad.AssBin.eq_of_normal
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hne'
  have hne : (e, f) ≠ (mu, op) := fun h => hne' (Prod.mk.inj h)
  have hw : window e f false a.minLabel b.minLabel r.minLabel ∈ leads := by
    rcases window_left_shape hs hnd with h | h <;> rw [h]
    · exact ⟨e, f, true, hne, rfl⟩
    · exact ⟨e, f, false, hne, rfl⟩
  exact hn _ (by simp [windows]) hw

name: Operad.AssBin.exists_split
statement:
theorem exists_split {e : AssShGen 2} {l r : LTree (AssShGen 2)}
    (hs : (node e l r).IsShuffle) (hnd : (node e l r).labels.Nodup)
    (hn : IsNormal leads (node e l r)) :
    ∃ A B, ev (node e l r) = A ++ l.minLabel :: B ∧
      (e = mu ∧ l = leaf l.minLabel ∧ A = [] ∧ B = ev r ∨
        e = op ∧ l = leaf l.minLabel ∧ A = ev r ∧ B = [] ∨
        e = mu ∧ ev l = A ++ [l.minLabel] ∧ A ≠ [] ∧ B = ev r)
proof:
:= by
  cases l with
  | leaf a =>
    cases e
    · exact ⟨[], ev r, rfl, Or.inl ⟨rfl, rfl, rfl, rfl⟩⟩
    · exact ⟨ev r, [], by simp [ev, ap], Or.inr (Or.inl ⟨rfl, rfl, rfl, rfl⟩)⟩
  | node g a b =>
    obtain ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ := eq_of_normal hs hnd hn
    have hm := minLabel_node_of_shuffle hs.2.1
    cases a with
    | leaf c =>
      rw [hm, minLabel_leaf]
      exact ⟨ev b, ev r, by simp [ev, ap], Or.inr (Or.inr ⟨rfl, by simp [ev, ap], ev_ne_nil b,
        rfl⟩)⟩
    | node g' a' b' =>
      have hnd' : (node op (node g' a' b') b).labels.Nodup :=
        (List.nodup_append.1 hnd).1
      exact absurd (eq_of_normal hs.2.1 hnd' hn.left).1 (fun h => by cases h)

name: Operad.AssBin.ev_inj
statement:
theorem ev_inj (x : LTree (AssShGen 2)) : ∀ {y : LTree (AssShGen 2)}, x.IsShuffle →
    y.IsShuffle → x.labels.Nodup → y.labels.Nodup → IsNormal leads x → IsNormal leads y →
    ev x = ev y → x = y
proof:
:= by
  induction x with
  | leaf a =>
    intro y _ _ _ _ _ _ h
    cases y with
    | leaf b =>
      simp only [ev, List.singleton_inj] at h
      rw [h]
    | node e l r =>
      have h2 := (perm_ev (node e l r)).length_eq
      rw [← h, length_labels] at h2
      have := arity_pos l
      have := arity_pos r
      simp only [ev, List.length_singleton, arity] at h2
      omega
  | node e l r ihl ihr =>
    intro y hs hs' hn hn' hg hg' h
    cases y with
    | leaf b =>
      have h2 := (perm_ev (node e l r)).length_eq
      rw [h, length_labels] at h2
      have := arity_pos l
      have := arity_pos r
      simp only [ev, List.length_singleton, arity] at h2
      omega
    | node e' l' r' =>
      have hm : l.minLabel = l'.minLabel := by
        rw [← minLabel_node_of_shuffle hs, ← minLabel_node_of_shuffle hs']
        exact minLabel_eq_of_perm ((perm_ev _).symm.trans (h ▸ perm_ev _))
      have hnd : (ev (node e l r)).Nodup := (perm_ev _).nodup_iff.2 hn
      have hnl := (List.nodup_append.1 hn).1
      have hnr := (List.nodup_append.1 hn).2.1
      have hnl' := (List.nodup_append.1 hn').1
      have hnr' := (List.nodup_append.1 hn').2.1
      obtain ⟨A, B, hA, hx⟩ := exists_split hs hn hg
      obtain ⟨A', B', hA', hy⟩ := exists_split hs' hn' hg'
      rw [hA, List.nodup_middle, List.nodup_cons, List.mem_append, not_or, hm] at hnd
      obtain ⟨rfl, -, rfl⟩ :=
        (List.append_cons_inj_of_notMem hnd.1.1 hnd.1.2).1 (hA.symm.trans (h.trans hA'))
      have hR : ev r = ev r' → r = r' :=
        fun hrr => ihr hs.2.2 hs'.2.2 hnr hnr' hg.right hg'.right hrr
      rcases hx with ⟨rfl, hl1, rfl, rfl⟩ | ⟨rfl, hl1, rfl, rfl⟩ | ⟨rfl, hl1, hA0, rfl⟩ <;>
        rcases hy with ⟨rfl, hl1', hA0', hB'⟩ | ⟨rfl, hl1', hA0', hB'⟩ | ⟨rfl, hl1', hA0', hB'⟩
      · rw [hR hB', hl1, hl1', hm]
      · exact absurd hA0'.symm (ev_ne_nil r')
      · exact absurd rfl hA0'
      · exact absurd hA0' (ev_ne_nil r)
      · rw [hR hA0', hl1, hl1', hm]
      · exact absurd hB'.symm (ev_ne_nil r')
      · exact absurd hA0' hA0
      · exact absurd hB' (ev_ne_nil r)
      · rw [hR hB', ihl hs.2.1 hs'.2.1 hnl hnl' hg.left hg'.left (by rw [hl1, hl1', hm])]

name: Operad.AssBin.evL_apply
statement:
lemma evL_apply {n : ℕ} (v : Mono (AssShGen 2) n → K) :
    evL K n v = ∑ σ, v σ • Finsupp.single (ev σ.1) 1
proof:
:= by
  simp [evL]

name: Operad.AssBin.evL_vecOf
statement:
lemma evL_vecOf {n : ℕ} {t : LTree (AssShGen 2)} (ht : t ∈ monomials n) :
    evL K n (vecOf K n t) = Finsupp.single (ev t) 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [evL_apply, Finset.sum_eq_single ⟨t, ht⟩ (fun σ _ hσ => ?_) (by simp)]
  · simp [vecOf]
  · rw [show vecOf K n t σ = 0 from if_neg fun h => hσ (Subtype.ext h), zero_smul]

name: Operad.AssBin.idealOf_le_ker
statement: theorem idealOf_le_ker (n : ℕ) : idealOf K (rel K) n ≤ LinearMap.ker (evL K n)
proof:
:= by
  refine Submodule.span_le.2 ?_
  rintro _ ⟨t, p, s, r, hr, he, rfl⟩
  set F : List ℕ → List ℕ :=
    fun w => evRep t.1 p (w.flatMap fun a => ev ((t.1.subtreeAt p).winIns s a))
  have h1 : ∀ σ : Mono (AssShGen 2) 3, evL K n (r σ • vecOf K n (t.1.substAt p s σ.1)) =
      Finsupp.mapDomain F (r σ • Finsupp.single (ev σ.1) 1) := fun σ => by
    rw [map_smul, evL_vecOf (substAt_mem_monomials t.2 he σ.2), ev_substAt,
      Finsupp.mapDomain_smul, Finsupp.mapDomain_single]
  rw [SetLike.mem_coe, LinearMap.mem_ker, substVec, map_sum, Finset.sum_congr rfl fun σ _ => h1 σ,
    ← Finsupp.mapDomain_finsetSum, ← evL_apply, LinearMap.mem_ker.1 hr, Finsupp.mapDomain_zero]

name: Operad.AssBin.eq_zero_of_evL
statement:
theorem eq_zero_of_evL {n : ℕ} {v : Mono (AssShGen 2) n → K}
    (hv : v ∈ supportedOn K (normalSet leads n)) (h0 : evL K n v = 0) : v = 0
proof:
:= by
  funext y
  by_cases hy : y ∈ normalSet leads n
  · have := congrArg (· (ev y.1)) h0
    simp only [evL_apply, Finsupp.finsetSum_apply, Finsupp.smul_apply, Finsupp.single_apply,
      smul_eq_mul, mul_ite, mul_one, mul_zero, Finsupp.coe_zero, Pi.zero_apply] at this
    rw [Finset.sum_eq_single y (fun σ _ hσ => ?_) (by simp)] at this
    · simpa using this
    · split_ifs with h
      · by_contra hσ0
        have hσN : σ ∈ normalSet leads n := by
          by_contra hN
          exact hσ0 (hv σ hN)
        have hσm := (mem_monomials n σ.1).1 σ.2
        have hym := (mem_monomials n y.1).1 y.2
        exact hσ (Subtype.ext (ev_inj σ.1 hσm.1 hym.1 (hσm.2.nodup_iff.2 List.nodup_range)
          (hym.2.nodup_iff.2 List.nodup_range) hσN hy h))
      · rfl
  · exact hv y hy

name: Operad.AssBin.windows_mono3
statement: lemma windows_mono3 (σ : Mono (AssShGen 2) 3) : σ.1.windows = [σ.1]
proof:
:= by
  have hm := (mem_monomials 3 σ.1).1 σ.2
  obtain ⟨e, f, h | h | h⟩ := mono3_cases hm.1 hm.2 <;> rw [h] <;> rfl

name: Operad.AssBin.lead3_inj
statement:
lemma lead3_inj {e f e' f' : AssShGen 2} {s s' : Bool} (h : lead3 e f s = lead3 e' f' s') :
    e = e' ∧ f = f' ∧ s = s'
proof:
:= by
  cases s <;> cases s' <;> simp_all [lead3]

name: Operad.AssBin.rel_eq_span
statement:
theorem rel_eq_span : rel K = Submodule.span K (Set.range fun r : AssShGen.Rule =>
    vecOf K 3 (lead3 r.1.1.1 r.1.1.2 r.2) - vecOf K 3 (tail3 r.1.1.1 r.1.1.2 r.2))
proof:
:= by
  set g : AssShGen.Rule → Mono (AssShGen 2) 3 → K :=
    fun r => vecOf K 3 (lead3 r.1.1.1 r.1.1.2 r.2) - vecOf K 3 (tail3 r.1.1.1 r.1.1.2 r.2)
  have hg : ∀ r, g r ∈ rel K := fun r => by
    obtain ⟨-, hev, -, -⟩ := spec3 r.1.2 r.2
    rw [rel, LinearMap.mem_ker, map_sub, evL_vecOf (lead3_mem _ _ _), evL_vecOf (tail3_mem _ _ _),
      hev, sub_self]
  refine le_antisymm (fun v hv => ?_) (Submodule.span_le.2 ?_)
  · set u : Mono (AssShGen 2) 3 → K :=
      ∑ r : AssShGen.Rule, v ⟨lead3 r.1.1.1 r.1.1.2 r.2, lead3_mem _ _ _⟩ • g r
    have hu : u ∈ Submodule.span K (Set.range g) :=
      Submodule.sum_mem _ fun r _ => Submodule.smul_mem _ _ (Submodule.subset_span ⟨r, rfl⟩)
    have hw : v - u ∈ rel K :=
      Submodule.sub_mem _ hv (Submodule.sum_mem _ fun r _ => Submodule.smul_mem _ _ (hg r))
    have hN : v - u ∈ supportedOn K (normalSet leads 3) := by
      intro σ hσ
      have hσL : σ.1 ∈ leads := by
        by_contra hL
        refine hσ fun w hw => ?_
        rw [windows_mono3, List.mem_singleton] at hw
        exact hw ▸ hL
      obtain ⟨e, f, s, hne, hσ1⟩ := hσL
      have hval : ∀ r : AssShGen.Rule, g r σ =
          if lead3 e f s = lead3 r.1.1.1 r.1.1.2 r.2 then 1 else 0 := fun r => by
        have ht : σ.1 ≠ tail3 r.1.1.1 r.1.1.2 r.2 :=
          fun h => (spec3 r.1.2 r.2).2.2.2 (h ▸ hσ1 ▸ ⟨e, f, s, hne, rfl⟩)
        rw [hσ1] at ht
        simp only [g, Pi.sub_apply, vecOf, hσ1, if_neg ht, sub_zero]
      have hsum : u σ = v σ := by
        simp only [u, Finset.sum_apply, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, hval, mul_ite, mul_one,
          mul_zero]
        rw [Finset.sum_eq_single (⟨⟨(e, f), hne⟩, s⟩ : AssShGen.Rule) (fun r _ hr => ?_)
          (by simp)]
        · rw [if_pos rfl]
          congr 1
          exact Subtype.ext hσ1.symm
        · rw [if_neg]
          intro h
          obtain ⟨h1, h2, h3⟩ := lead3_inj h
          exact hr (Prod.ext (Subtype.ext (Prod.ext h1.symm h2.symm)) h3.symm)
      rw [Pi.sub_apply, hsum, sub_self]
    have h0 := eq_zero_of_evL hN hw
    rw [sub_eq_zero.1 h0]
    exact hu
  · rintro _ ⟨r, rfl⟩
    exact hg r

name: Operad.AssBin.isGroebner
statement:
theorem isGroebner : IsGroebner K rk leads (rel K) where
  mem ℓ hℓ
proof:
:= by
    obtain ⟨e, f, s, -, rfl⟩ := hℓ
    exact lead3_mem e f s
  lead ℓ hℓ := by
    obtain ⟨e, f, s, hne, rfl⟩ := hℓ
    obtain ⟨hne', hev, hkey, -⟩ := spec3 hne s
    refine ⟨vecOf K 3 (lead3 e f s) - vecOf K 3 (tail3 e f s), ?_, ?_, fun σ hσ hσ0 => ?_⟩
    · rw [rel, LinearMap.mem_ker, map_sub, evL_vecOf (lead3_mem e f s),
        evL_vecOf (tail3_mem e f s), hev, sub_self]
    · simp [vecOf, hne'.symm]
    · by_cases hσt : σ.1 = tail3 e f s
      · rwa [hσt]
      · exact absurd (by simp [vecOf, hσ, hσt]) hσ0
  indep _ _ hv hN := eq_zero_of_evL hN (idealOf_le_ker _ hv)

name: Operad.AssBin.isKoszul
statement: theorem isKoszul : ShuffleBar.IsKoszul K (rel K)
proof:
:=
  ShuffleBar.isKoszul K rk (isGroebner K)

name: Operad.AssBin.isKoszul_dualRel
statement: theorem isKoszul_dualRel : ShuffleBar.IsKoszul K (dualRel K (rel K))
proof:
:=
  ShuffleBar.isKoszul_dualRel (isGroebner K)

name: Operad.AssBin.isKoszul_and
statement: theorem isKoszul_and : ShuffleBar.IsKoszul K (rel K) ∧ (AssShGen.rules K).IsKoszul
proof:
:=
  ⟨isKoszul K, AssShGen.isKoszul⟩

name: Operad.Bar.exists_lift_vx_of
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x', rfl⟩ := hπ z
  obtain ⟨cc, hcc, rfl⟩ := exists_decomp I hI1 x'
  refine ⟨cc s, hcc s, (sub_eq_zero.1 (eq_zero_of_mem_iSup_ne I' (s := s)
    (Submodule.sub_mem _ hz (hπv _ _ (hcc s))) ?_)).symm⟩
  rw [map_sum]
  by_cases hs : s ∈ Finset.range n
  · rw [← Finset.add_sum_erase _ _ hs, add_sub_cancel_left]
    exact Submodule.sum_mem _ fun j hj => Submodule.mem_iSup_of_mem j
      (Submodule.mem_iSup_of_mem (Finset.ne_of_mem_erase hj) (hπv _ _ (hcc j)))
  · rw [vx_eq_zero I hI1 (by simpa using hs) (hcc s), map_zero, sub_zero]
    exact Submodule.sum_mem _ fun j hj => Submodule.mem_iSup_of_mem j
      (Submodule.mem_iSup_of_mem (fun h => hs (h ▸ hj)) (hπv _ _ (hcc j)))

name: Operad.Bar.lower_iff_of
statement:
theorem lower_iff_of (hπd : ∀ y, π (d I (Fin n) y) = d I' (Fin n) (π y))
    (𝒦 : Submodule K (FreeGrL K (BarGen I) (Fin n))) (hker : ∀ x, x ∈ 𝒦 ↔ π x = 0) {s : ℕ} :
    (∀ z ∈ FreeGrL.vx K (BarGen I') s (Fin n), d I' (Fin n) z = 0 →
      ∃ w ∈ FreeGrL.vx K (BarGen I') (s + 1) (Fin n), d I' (Fin n) w = z) ↔
    ∀ x ∈ FreeGrL.vx K (BarGen I) s (Fin n), d I (Fin n) x ∈ 𝒦 →
      ∃ y ∈ FreeGrL.vx K (BarGen I) (s + 1) (Fin n), x - d I (Fin n) y ∈ 𝒦
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h x hx hdx
    rw [hker, hπd] at hdx
    obtain ⟨w, hw, hdw⟩ := h _ (hπv _ _ hx) hdx
    obtain ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩ := exists_lift_vx_of I I' hI1 π hπ hπv hw
    refine ⟨y, hy, ?_⟩
    rw [hker, map_sub, hπd, hdw, sub_self]
  · intro h z hz hdz
    obtain ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩ := exists_lift_vx_of I I' hI1 π hπ hπv hz
    obtain ⟨y, hy, hxy⟩ := h x hx (by rw [hker, hπd, hdz])
    rw [hker, map_sub, hπd, sub_eq_zero] at hxy
    exact ⟨_, hπv _ _ hy, hxy.symm⟩

name: Operad.Submodule.lower_iff_of_map
statement:
theorem Submodule.lower_iff_of_map {R : Type*} [CommRing R] {V W : Type*} [AddCommGroup V]
    [Module R V] [AddCommGroup W] [Module R W] {dV : V →ₗ[R] V} {dW : W →ₗ[R] W} (Φ : V →ₗ[R] W)
    (hΦ : Function.Injective Φ) (hd : ∀ x, Φ (dV x) = dW (Φ x)) (Vs : ℕ → Submodule R V)
    (Ws : ℕ → Submodule R W) (hVW : ∀ t, Submodule.map Φ (Vs t) = Ws t) (𝒦 : Submodule R V)
    (J : Submodule R W) (hJ : Submodule.map Φ 𝒦 = J ⊓ LinearMap.range Φ) (s : ℕ) :
    (∀ x ∈ Vs s, dV x ∈ 𝒦 → ∃ y ∈ Vs (s + 1), x - dV y ∈ 𝒦) ↔
    ∀ X ∈ Ws s, dW X ∈ J → ∃ Y ∈ Ws (s + 1), X - dW Y ∈ J
proof:
:= by
  have hmem : ∀ x, Φ x ∈ J ↔ x ∈ 𝒦 := fun x => by
    constructor
    · intro h
      have h' : Φ x ∈ J ⊓ LinearMap.range Φ := ⟨h, LinearMap.mem_range_self _ x⟩
      rw [← hJ] at h'
      obtain ⟨k, hk, hkx⟩ := h'
      rwa [← hΦ hkx]
    · intro h
      have h' : Φ x ∈ Submodule.map Φ 𝒦 := Submodule.mem_map_of_mem h
      rw [hJ] at h'
      exact h'.1
  have hC : ∀ t X, X ∈ Ws t ↔ ∃ x ∈ Vs t, Φ x = X := fun t X => by
    rw [← hVW t]
    rfl
  constructor
  · intro h X hX hdX
    obtain ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩ := (hC s X).1 hX
    rw [← hd, hmem] at hdX
    obtain ⟨y, hy, hxy⟩ := h x hx hdX
    refine ⟨Φ y, (hC _ _).2 ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩, ?_⟩
    rw [← hd, ← map_sub, hmem]
    exact hxy
  · intro h x hx hdx
    rw [← hmem, hd] at hdx
    obtain ⟨Y, hY, hXY⟩ := h _ ((hC s _).2 ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩) hdx
    obtain ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩ := (hC _ Y).1 hY
    refine ⟨y, hy, ?_⟩
    rw [← hmem, map_sub, hd]
    exact hXY

name: Operad.ShuffleBarSym.proj_mem_Ipres
statement:
lemma proj_mem_Ipres {A : Type} [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] (x : FreeGrL K E A)
    (hx : x ∈ (Ibar K E c hc).sub A) : (𝒥).proj A x ∈ (Ipres K E c hc r).sub A
proof:
:= by
  by_cases h : 2 ≤ Fintype.card A
  · rw [GrOperadIdeal.atLeastTwo_sub_of_le h]
    trivial
  · rw [GrOperadIdeal.atLeastTwo_sub_of_lt (by omega), Submodule.mem_bot] at hx
    rw [hx, map_zero]
    exact zero_mem _

name: Operad.ShuffleBarSym.val_barProjGen
statement:
lemma val_barProjGen {A : Type} [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] (w : BarGen (Ibar K E c hc) A) :
    IdealSp.val _ ((barProjGen c hc r).app A w) = (𝒥).proj A (IdealSp.val _ w)
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.ShuffleBarSym.barProjGen_eq_zero_iff
statement:
lemma barProjGen_eq_zero_iff {A : Type} [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A]
    (w : BarGen (Ibar K E c hc) A) :
    (barProjGen c hc r).app A w = 0 ↔ IdealSp.val _ w ∈ (𝒥).sub A
proof:
:= by
  rw [← GrOperadIdeal.proj_eq_zero_iff, ← val_barProjGen]
  exact ⟨fun h => by rw [h]; rfl, fun h => IdealSp.ext _ h⟩

name: Operad.ShuffleBarSym.barProjGen_surjective
statement:
theorem barProjGen_surjective (A : Type) [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] :
    Function.Surjective ((barProjGen c hc r).app A)
proof:
:= by
  intro w
  by_cases h : 2 ≤ Fintype.card A
  · obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := (𝒥).proj_surjective A (IdealSp.val _ w)
    refine ⟨IdealSp.mk _ y (by rw [GrOperadIdeal.atLeastTwo_sub_of_le h]; trivial),
      IdealSp.ext _ ?_⟩
    rw [val_barProjGen]
    exact hy
  · have hw : IdealSp.val _ w = 0 := by
      have := IdealSp.mem _ w
      rwa [GrOperadIdeal.atLeastTwo_sub_of_lt (by omega), Submodule.mem_bot] at this
    exact ⟨0, IdealSp.ext _ (by rw [map_zero, hw]; rfl)⟩

name: Operad.ShuffleBarSym.barProj_surjective
statement:
theorem barProj_surjective (A : Type) [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] :
    Function.Surjective ((FreeGrL.mapSp (barProjGen c hc r)).app A)
proof:
:=
  FreeGrL.mapSp_surjective _ (barProjGen_surjective c hc r) A

name: Operad.ShuffleBarSym.barProj_d
statement:
theorem barProj_d {A : Type} [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A]
    (x : FreeGrL K (BarGen (Ibar K E c hc)) A) :
    (FreeGrL.mapSp (barProjGen c hc r)).app A (Bar.d (Ibar K E c hc) A x)
      = Bar.d (Ipres K E c hc r) A ((FreeGrL.mapSp (barProjGen c hc r)).app A x)
proof:
:=
  Bar.map_d _ _ x

name: Operad.ShuffleBarSym.mem_Krel_iff
statement:
theorem mem_Krel_iff {A : Type} [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A]
    (x : FreeGrL K (BarGen (Ibar K E c hc)) A) :
    x ∈ (Krel K E c hc r).sub A ↔ (FreeGrL.mapSp (barProjGen c hc r)).app A x = 0
proof:
:=
  FreeGrL.mem_kerSpan_iff _ (barProjGen_surjective c hc r) x

name: Operad.ShuffleBarSym.exists_lift_vx
proof:
:=
  Bar.exists_lift_vx_of (Ibar K E c hc) (Ipres K E c hc r)
    (GrOperadIdeal.atLeastTwo_hI1 (free_zero c hc)) _ (barProj_surjective c hc r (Fin n))
    (fun _ _ hy => FreeGrL.mapSp_mem_vx hy) hz

name: Operad.ShuffleBarSym.lower_iff
statement:
theorem lower_iff {n s : ℕ} :
    (∀ z ∈ 𝒱P s (Fin n), Bar.d (Ipres K E c hc r) (Fin n) z = 0 →
      ∃ w ∈ 𝒱P (s + 1) (Fin n), Bar.d (Ipres K E c hc r) (Fin n) w = z) ↔
    ∀ x ∈ 𝒱T s (Fin n), Bar.d (Ibar K E c hc) (Fin n) x ∈ (Krel K E c hc r).sub (Fin n) →
      ∃ y ∈ 𝒱T (s + 1) (Fin n),
        x - Bar.d (Ibar K E c hc) (Fin n) y ∈ (Krel K E c hc r).sub (Fin n)
proof:
:=
  Bar.lower_iff_of (Ibar K E c hc) (Ipres K E c hc r)
    (GrOperadIdeal.atLeastTwo_hI1 (free_zero c hc)) _ (barProj_surjective c hc r (Fin n))
    (fun _ _ hy => FreeGrL.mapSp_mem_vx hy) (barProj_d c hc r) _ (mem_Krel_iff c hc r)

name: Operad.ShuffleBarSym.isKoszul_iff_free
statement:
theorem isKoszul_iff_free (hr2 : ∀ n, n < 3 → r n = ∅) :
    Koszul.IsKoszul K E r ↔ ∀ n, 2 ≤ n →
      (∀ z ∈ 𝒱P (n - 1) (Fin n), Bar.d (Ipres K E c hc r) (Fin n) z = 0 →
        ∃ x, (Koszul.toBar (Ipres K E c hc r) (hE_pres c hc r)).app (Fin n) x = z) ∧
      ∀ s, s + 1 < n → ∀ x ∈ 𝒱T s (Fin n),
        Bar.d (Ibar K E c hc) (Fin n) x ∈ (Krel K E c hc r).sub (Fin n) →
        ∃ y ∈ 𝒱T (s + 1) (Fin n),
          x - Bar.d (Ibar K E c hc) (Fin n) y ∈ (Krel K E c hc r).sub (Fin n)
proof:
:=
  (isKoszul_iff_cycles c hc r hr2).trans (forall_congr' fun _ => imp_congr_right fun _ =>
    and_congr_right fun _ => forall_congr' fun _ => imp_congr_right fun _ => lower_iff c hc r)

name: Operad.ShuffleBarSym.lower_iff_shuffle
statement:
theorem lower_iff_shuffle (R : Submodule K (LTree.Mono G 3 → K)) {n : ℕ} (hn : 2 ≤ n)
    (hJ : Submodule.map (ΦL c hc n) ((Krel K E c hc r).sub (Fin n))
      = ShuffleBar.J K R ⊓ Finsupp.supported K K (barSet G n)) (s : ℕ) :
    (∀ x ∈ 𝒱T s (Fin n), Bar.d (Ibar K E c hc) (Fin n) x ∈ (Krel K E c hc r).sub (Fin n) →
      ∃ y ∈ 𝒱T (s + 1) (Fin n),
        x - Bar.d (Ibar K E c hc) (Fin n) y ∈ (Krel K E c hc r).sub (Fin n)) ↔
    ∀ X ∈ ShuffleBar.C (E := G) K n s, ShuffleBar.d K X ∈ ShuffleBar.J K R →
      ∃ Y ∈ ShuffleBar.C (E := G) K n (s + 1), X - ShuffleBar.d K Y ∈ ShuffleBar.J K R
proof:
:=
  Submodule.lower_iff_of_map (ΦL c hc n) (ΦL_injective c hc n) (ΦL_d c hc)
    (fun t => FreeGrL.vx K (BarGen (Ibar K E c hc)) t (Fin n))
    (fun t => ShuffleBar.C (E := G) K n t)
    (fun t => (congrArg (Submodule.map (ΦL c hc n)) (deg_eq_vx c hc n t)).symm.trans
      (map_ΦL_deg c hc hn t)) ((Krel K E c hc r).sub (Fin n))
    (ShuffleBar.J K R) (by rw [hJ, ΦL_range]) s

name: Operad.ShuffleBarSym.isKoszul_iff_shuffle_of
statement:
theorem isKoszul_iff_shuffle_of (hr2 : ∀ n, n < 3 → r n = ∅)
    (R : Submodule K (LTree.Mono G 3 → K))
    (hJ : ∀ n, 2 ≤ n → Submodule.map (ΦL c hc n) ((Krel K E c hc r).sub (Fin n))
      = ShuffleBar.J K R ⊓ Finsupp.supported K K (barSet G n))
    (htop : ∀ n, 2 ≤ n → ∀ z ∈ 𝒱P (n - 1) (Fin n), Bar.d (Ipres K E c hc r) (Fin n) z = 0 →
      ∃ x, (Koszul.toBar (Ipres K E c hc r) (hE_pres c hc r)).app (Fin n) x = z) :
    Koszul.IsKoszul K E r ↔ ShuffleBar.IsKoszul K R
proof:
:= by
  rw [isKoszul_iff_free c hc hr2]
  constructor
  · intro h n s hs
    exact (lower_iff_shuffle c hc r R (by omega) (hJ n (by omega)) s).1
      ((h n (by omega)).2 s hs)
  · intro h n hn
    exact ⟨htop n hn, fun s hs => (lower_iff_shuffle c hc r R hn (hJ n hn) s).2 (h n s hs)⟩

name: Operad.GrComposite.ltB_asymm
statement:
lemma ltB_asymm {A : Type} (L : LinOrd A) {a b : A} (h : ltB L a b = true) :
    ltB L b a = false
proof:
:= by
  rw [ltB_eq_true] at h
  by_contra h'
  rw [Bool.not_eq_false, ltB_eq_true] at h'
  exact L.irrefl a (L.trans _ _ _ h h')

name: Operad.GrComposite.leafLin_comm_ne
statement:
lemma leafLin_comm_ne (gm : GrSpEnd R N q) (gn : GrSpEnd R N q') {A : Type} [DecidableEq A]
    (L : LinOrd A) {j k : A} (hjk : j ≠ k) {B : A → Type} [∀ a, Fintype (B a)]
    [∀ a, DecidableEq (B a)] (a : A) {c : Bool} {y : N (B a)}
    (hy : GrSpecies.par (R := R) c y = y) :
    leafLin gm L k a (leafLin gn L j a y)
      = (if (a = k ∧ ltB L k j = true) ∨ (a = j ∧ ltB L j k = true) then σ R (q && q') else 1)
        • leafLin gn L j a (leafLin gm L k a y)
proof:
:= by
  have hgm : GrSpecies.par (R := R) (xor c q) (gm.app _ y) = gm.app _ y := by
    rw [← gm.app_par, hy]
  have hgn : GrSpecies.par (R := R) (xor c q') (gn.app _ y) = gn.app _ y := by
    rw [← gn.app_par, hy]
  unfold leafLin
  by_cases hak : a = k
  · subst hak
    have haj : a ≠ j := fun h => hjk h.symm
    rw [if_pos rfl, if_neg haj]
    by_cases hl : ltB L a j = true
    · rw [if_pos hl, if_pos (Or.inl ⟨rfl, hl⟩), GrSpecies.tw_hom q' hy, map_smul,
        GrSpecies.tw_hom q' hgm, smul_smul]
      congr 1
      cases q <;> cases q' <;> cases c <;> simp
    · rw [if_neg hl, if_neg (show ¬((a = a ∧ ltB L a j = true) ∨ (a = j ∧ ltB L j a = true))
        from fun h => h.elim (fun h' => hl h'.2) (fun h' => haj h'.1)), one_smul]
      rfl
  · by_cases haj : a = j
    · subst haj
      rw [if_neg hak, if_pos rfl]
      by_cases hl : ltB L a k = true
      · rw [if_pos hl, if_pos (Or.inr ⟨rfl, hl⟩), GrSpecies.tw_hom q hgn, GrSpecies.tw_hom q hy,
          map_smul, smul_smul]
        congr 1
        cases q <;> cases q' <;> cases c <;> simp
      · rw [if_neg hl, if_neg (show ¬((a = k ∧ ltB L k a = true) ∨ (a = a ∧ ltB L a k = true))
          from fun h => h.elim (fun h' => hak h'.1) (fun h' => hl h'.2)), one_smul]
        rfl
    · rw [if_neg hak, if_neg haj,
        if_neg (show ¬((a = k ∧ ltB L k j = true) ∨ (a = j ∧ ltB L j k = true))
        from fun h => h.elim (fun h' => hak h'.1) (fun h' => haj h'.1)), one_smul]
      by_cases h1 : ltB L a k = true <;> by_cases h2 : ltB L a j = true <;>
        simp only [h1, h2, ↓reduceIte, Bool.false_eq_true, LinearMap.id_apply, GrSpecies.tw_tw,
          Bool.xor_comm]

name: Operad.GrComposite.leafLin_comm_self
statement:
lemma leafLin_comm_self (gm : GrSpEnd R N q) (gn : GrSpEnd R N q') {A : Type} [DecidableEq A]
    (L : LinOrd A) (j : A) {B : A → Type} [∀ a, Fintype (B a)] [∀ a, DecidableEq (B a)]
    (y : ∀ a, N (B a)) :
    (fun a => leafLin gm L j a (leafLin gn L j a (y a)))
      = update (fun a => leafLin (gm.gcomm gn) L j a (y a)) j (gm.app _ (gn.app _ (y j)))
proof:
:= by
  funext a
  by_cases haj : a = j
  · subst haj
    simp only [update_self]
    unfold leafLin
    simp
  · rw [update_of_ne haj]
    unfold leafLin
    simp only [if_neg haj]
    cases ltB L a j <;> simp [GrSpecies.tw_tw]

name: Operad.GrComposite.leafLin_comm_self'
statement:
lemma leafLin_comm_self' (gm : GrSpEnd R N q) (gn : GrSpEnd R N q') {A : Type} [DecidableEq A]
    (L : LinOrd A) (j : A) {B : A → Type} [∀ a, Fintype (B a)] [∀ a, DecidableEq (B a)]
    (y : ∀ a, N (B a)) :
    (fun a => leafLin gn L j a (leafLin gm L j a (y a)))
      = update (fun a => leafLin (gm.gcomm gn) L j a (y a)) j (gn.app _ (gm.app _ (y j)))
proof:
:= by
  funext a
  by_cases haj : a = j
  · subst haj
    simp only [update_self]
    unfold leafLin
    simp
  · rw [update_of_ne haj]
    unfold leafLin
    simp only [if_neg haj]
    cases ltB L a j <;> simp [GrSpecies.tw_tw, Bool.xor_comm]

name: Operad.GrComposite.prod_sign_ne
statement:
lemma prod_sign_ne {A : Type} [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] (L : LinOrd A) {j k : A} (hjk : j ≠ k)
    (s : R) :
    ∏ a : A, (if (a = k ∧ ltB L k j = true) ∨ (a = j ∧ ltB L j k = true) then s else 1) = s
proof:
:= by
  rcases L.total j k hjk with h | h
  · have h1 : ltB L j k = true := (ltB_eq_true L j k).2 h
    have h2 := ltB_asymm L h1
    simp only [h1, h2, Bool.false_eq_true, and_false, false_or, and_true]
    rw [Finset.prod_ite_eq' Finset.univ j, if_pos (Finset.mem_univ _)]
  · have h1 : ltB L k j = true := (ltB_eq_true L k j).2 h
    have h2 := ltB_asymm L h1
    simp only [h1, h2, Bool.false_eq_true, and_false, or_false, and_true]
    rw [Finset.prod_ite_eq' Finset.univ k, if_pos (Finset.mem_univ _)]

name: Operad.GrComposite.mk_leafGen_leafGen_ne
statement:
lemma mk_leafGen_leafGen_ne (gm : GrSpEnd R N q) (gn : GrSpEnd R N q') (g : GrCompGen M N S)
    {c : g.A → Bool} (hy : ∀ a, GrSpecies.par (R := R) (c a) (g.y a) = g.y a) {j k : g.A}
    (hjk : j ≠ k) :
    mk R (leafGen gm (leafGen gn g j) k)
      = σ R (q && q') • mk R (leafGen gn (leafGen gm g k) j)
proof:
:= by
  set G : GrCompGen M N S := ⟨g.A, g.B, g.L, GrSpecies.tw (R := R) q'
    (GrSpecies.tw (R := R) q g.m), g.y, g.e⟩
  have hm : GrSpecies.tw (R := R) q (GrSpecies.tw (R := R) q' g.m)
      = GrSpecies.tw (R := R) q' (GrSpecies.tw (R := R) q g.m) := by
    rw [GrSpecies.tw_tw, GrSpecies.tw_tw, Bool.xor_comm]
  have hfun : (fun a => leafLin gm g.L k a (leafLin gn g.L j a (g.y a)))
      = fun a => (if (a = k ∧ ltB g.L k j = true) ∨ (a = j ∧ ltB g.L j k = true)
          then σ R (q && q') else 1) • leafLin gn g.L j a (leafLin gm g.L k a (g.y a)) :=
    funext fun a => leafLin_comm_ne gm gn g.L hjk a (hy a)
  have h := (mkY (R := R) G).map_smul_univ
    (fun a => if (a = k ∧ ltB g.L k j = true) ∨ (a = j ∧ ltB g.L j k = true)
      then σ R (q && q') else 1)
    (fun a => leafLin gn g.L j a (leafLin gm g.L k a (g.y a)))
  rw [prod_sign_ne g.L hjk] at h
  show mk R ⟨g.A, g.B, g.L, GrSpecies.tw (R := R) q (GrSpecies.tw (R := R) q' g.m),
      fun a => leafLin gm g.L k a (leafLin gn g.L j a (g.y a)), g.e⟩
    = σ R (q && q') • mk R ⟨g.A, g.B, g.L, GrSpecies.tw (R := R) q' (GrSpecies.tw (R := R) q g.m),
      fun a => leafLin gn g.L j a (leafLin gm g.L k a (g.y a)), g.e⟩
  rw [hm, hfun]
  exact h

name: Operad.GrComposite.mk_leafGen_leafGen_self
statement:
lemma mk_leafGen_leafGen_self (gm : GrSpEnd R N q) (gn : GrSpEnd R N q') (g : GrCompGen M N S)
    (j : g.A) :
    mk R (leafGen gm (leafGen gn g j) j)
      = σ R (q && q') • mk R (leafGen gn (leafGen gm g j) j)
        + mk R (leafGen (gm.gcomm gn) g j)
proof:
:= by
  set G : GrCompGen M N S := leafGen (gm.gcomm gn) g j
  have h1 : mk R (leafGen gm (leafGen gn g j) j)
      = mkY G (update G.y j (gm.app _ (gn.app _ (g.y j)))) := by
    show mk R ⟨g.A, g.B, g.L, GrSpecies.tw (R := R) q (GrSpecies.tw (R := R) q' g.m), _, g.e⟩ = _
    rw [GrSpecies.tw_tw, leafLin_comm_self gm gn g.L j g.y]
    rfl
  have h2 : mk R (leafGen gn (leafGen gm g j) j)
      = mkY G (update G.y j (gn.app _ (gm.app _ (g.y j)))) := by
    show mk R ⟨g.A, g.B, g.L, GrSpecies.tw (R := R) q' (GrSpecies.tw (R := R) q g.m), _, g.e⟩ = _
    rw [GrSpecies.tw_tw, Bool.xor_comm, leafLin_comm_self' gm gn g.L j g.y]
    rfl
  have hy3 : update G.y j (gm.app _ (gn.app _ (g.y j))
      - σ R (q && q') • gn.app _ (gm.app _ (g.y j))) = G.y := by
    funext a
    by_cases haj : a = j
    · rw [haj, update_self]
      show _ = leafLin (gm.gcomm gn) g.L j j (g.y j)
      unfold leafLin
      simp
    · rw [update_of_ne haj]
  have h3 : mk R G = mkY G (update G.y j (gm.app _ (gn.app _ (g.y j))
      - σ R (q && q') • gn.app _ (gm.app _ (g.y j)))) := by
    rw [hy3]
    rfl
  rw [h1, h2, h3, MultilinearMap.map_update_sub, MultilinearMap.map_update_smul]
  abel

name: Operad.GrComposite.leafMap_comm
statement:
theorem leafMap_comm (gm : GrSpEnd R N q) (gn : GrSpEnd R N q') (x : GrComposite R M N S) :
    leafMap R M gm (leafMap R M gn x)
      = σ R (q && q') • leafMap R M gn (leafMap R M gm x) + leafMap R M (gm.gcomm gn) x
proof:
:= by
  have h : (leafMap R M gm).comp (leafMap (S := S) R M gn)
      = (σ R (q && q') • (leafMap R M gn).comp (leafMap R M gm) + leafMap R M (gm.gcomm gn) :
        GrComposite R M N S →ₗ[R] GrComposite R M N S) :=
    hom_ext fun g => by
      simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearMap.add_apply, LinearMap.smul_apply]
      rw [mk_eq_sum (R := R) g]
      simp only [map_sum, Finset.smul_sum, ← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun p _ => Finset.sum_congr rfl fun c _ => ?_
      set g' := parGen (R := R) g p c
      have hy : ∀ a, GrSpecies.par (R := R) (c a) (g'.y a) = g'.y a := fun a => by
        show GrSpecies.par (R := R) (c a) (GrSpecies.par (R := R) (c a) (g.y a)) = _
        rw [GrSpecies.par_par, if_pos rfl]
      simp only [leafMap_mk, leafFun, map_sum, Finset.smul_sum]
      have hF : ∀ j k : g'.A, mk R (leafGen gm (leafGen gn g' j) k)
          = σ R (q && q') • mk R (leafGen gn (leafGen gm g' k) j)
            + if j = k then mk R (leafGen (gm.gcomm gn) g' j) else 0 := fun j k => by
        by_cases hjk : j = k
        · subst hjk
          rw [if_pos rfl]
          exact mk_leafGen_leafGen_self gm gn g' j
        · rw [if_neg hjk, add_zero]
          exact mk_leafGen_leafGen_ne gm gn g' hy hjk
      simp only [hF, Finset.sum_add_distrib, Finset.sum_ite_eq, Finset.mem_univ, if_true]
      rw [add_left_inj]
      show (∑ x : g.A, ∑ y : g.A, σ R (q && q') • mk R (leafGen gn (leafGen gm g' y) x))
        = ∑ x : g.A, ∑ y : g.A, σ R (q && q') • mk R (leafGen gn (leafGen gm g' x) y)
      exact Finset.sum_comm
  exact LinearMap.congr_fun h x

name: Operad.GrSpeciesHom.app_tw
proof:
:= by
  simp only [GrSpecies.tw_apply, map_add, map_smul, ψ.app_par]

name: Operad.GrComposite.map₂_map₂
statement:
lemma map₂_map₂ (ψ₁ : GrSpeciesHom R N' N'') (ψ₂ : GrSpeciesHom R N N')
    (ψ₃ : GrSpeciesHom R N N'')
    (h : ∀ (A : Type) [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] (y : N A), ψ₁.app A (ψ₂.app A y) = ψ₃.app A y)
    (x : GrComposite R M N S) :
    (map₂ idSpHom ψ₁).app S ((map₂ idSpHom ψ₂).app S x) = (map₂ idSpHom ψ₃).app S x
proof:
:= by
  have h' : ((map₂ (idSpHom (M := M)) ψ₁).app S).comp ((map₂ idSpHom ψ₂).app S)
      = (map₂ idSpHom ψ₃).app S := hom_ext fun g => by
    simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply, map₂_mk]
    show mk R ⟨g.A, g.B, g.L, g.m, fun a => ψ₁.app _ (ψ₂.app _ (g.y a)), g.e⟩
      = mk R ⟨g.A, g.B, g.L, g.m, fun a => ψ₃.app _ (g.y a), g.e⟩
    simp only [h]
  exact LinearMap.congr_fun h' x

name: Operad.GrComposite.leafLin_app
statement:
lemma leafLin_app (ψ : GrSpeciesHom R N N') (gm : GrSpEnd R N q) (gm' : GrSpEnd R N' q)
    (h : ∀ (A : Type) [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] (y : N A),
      ψ.app A (gm.app A y) = gm'.app A (ψ.app A y))
    {A : Type} [DecidableEq A] (L : LinOrd A) (j : A) {B : A → Type} [∀ a, Fintype (B a)]
    [∀ a, DecidableEq (B a)] (a : A) (y : N (B a)) :
    ψ.app _ (leafLin gm L j a y) = leafLin gm' L j a (ψ.app _ y)
proof:
:= by
  unfold leafLin
  split_ifs
  · exact h _ y
  · exact ψ.app_tw q y
  · rfl

name: Operad.GrComposite.map₂_leafMap
statement:
lemma map₂_leafMap (φ : SymSpeciesHom R M M)
    (hφ : ∀ (A : Type) [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] (m : M A),
      φ.app A (GrSpecies.tw (R := R) q m) = GrSpecies.tw (R := R) q (φ.app A m))
    (ψ : GrSpeciesHom R N N') (gm : GrSpEnd R N q) (gm' : GrSpEnd R N' q)
    (h : ∀ (A : Type) [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] (y : N A),
      ψ.app A (gm.app A y) = gm'.app A (ψ.app A y))
    (x : GrComposite R M N S) :
    (map₂ φ ψ).app S (leafMap R M gm x) = leafMap R M gm' ((map₂ φ ψ).app S x)
proof:
:= by
  have h' : ((map₂ φ ψ).app S).comp (leafMap R M gm)
      = (leafMap R M gm').comp ((map₂ φ ψ).app S) := hom_ext fun g => by
    simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply, leafMap_mk, leafFun, map_sum, map₂_mk]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => ?_
    show mk R ⟨g.A, g.B, g.L, φ.app _ (GrSpecies.tw (R := R) q g.m),
        fun a => ψ.app _ (leafLin gm g.L j a (g.y a)), g.e⟩
      = mk R ⟨g.A, g.B, g.L, GrSpecies.tw (R := R) q (φ.app _ g.m),
        fun a => leafLin gm' g.L j a (ψ.app _ (g.y a)), g.e⟩
    rw [hφ]
    simp only [leafLin_app ψ gm gm' h]
  exact LinearMap.congr_fun h' x

name: Operad.GrComposite.leafMap_congr
proof:
:= by
  have : gm = gm' := by
    cases gm
    cases gm'
    congr
    funext A _ _
    exact LinearMap.ext (h A)
  rw [this]

name: Operad.GrComposite.leafMap_eq_zero
proof:
:= by
  have h' : leafMap (S := S) R M gm = 0 := hom_ext fun g => by
    rw [leafMap_mk, LinearMap.zero_apply, leafFun]
    refine Finset.sum_eq_zero fun j _ => mk_of_y_eq_zero _ (a := j) ?_
    show leafLin gm g.L j j (g.y j) = 0
    unfold leafLin
    rw [if_pos rfl]
    exact h _ _
  rw [h', LinearMap.zero_apply]

name: Operad.GrComposite.leafMap_compl_piecewise
statement:
lemma leafMap_compl_piecewise (g : GrCompGen M N S) (T : Finset g.A) :
    leafMap R M (FreeGrL.GrSpEnd.compl R N π) (mk R { g with y := (T.piecewise
        (fun a => g.y a - π.app _ (g.y a)) (fun a => π.app _ (g.y a))) })
      = (T.card : R) • mk R { g with y := (T.piecewise
        (fun a => g.y a - π.app _ (g.y a)) (fun a => π.app _ (g.y a))) }
proof:
:= by
  set yT : ∀ a, N (g.B a) := T.piecewise (fun a => g.y a - π.app _ (g.y a))
    (fun a => π.app _ (g.y a))
  rw [leafMap_mk, leafFun]
  have hj : ∀ j : g.A, mk R (leafGen (FreeGrL.GrSpEnd.compl R N π) { g with y := yT } j)
      = if j ∈ T then mk R { g with y := yT } else 0 := fun j => by
    have hy : (fun a => leafLin (FreeGrL.GrSpEnd.compl R N π) g.L j a (yT a))
        = update yT j (yT j - π.app _ (yT j)) := by
      funext a
      by_cases haj : a = j
      · subst haj
        rw [update_self]
        unfold leafLin
        rw [if_pos rfl]
        rfl
      · rw [update_of_ne haj]
        unfold leafLin
        rw [if_neg haj]
        split_ifs
        · exact GrSpecies.tw_false _
        · rfl
    show mk R ⟨g.A, g.B, g.L, GrSpecies.tw (R := R) false g.m,
      fun a => leafLin (FreeGrL.GrSpEnd.compl R N π) g.L j a (yT a), g.e⟩ = _
    rw [GrSpecies.tw_false, hy]
    by_cases hjT : j ∈ T
    · rw [if_pos hjT]
      have : yT j - π.app _ (yT j) = yT j := by
        simp only [yT, Finset.piecewise_eq_of_mem _ _ _ hjT, map_sub, hπ, sub_self, sub_zero]
      rw [this, update_eq_self]
    · rw [if_neg hjT]
      have : yT j - π.app _ (yT j) = 0 := by
        simp only [yT, Finset.piecewise_eq_of_notMem _ _ _ hjT, hπ, sub_self]
      refine mk_of_y_eq_zero _ (a := j) ?_
      show update yT j (yT j - π.app _ (yT j)) j = 0
      rw [update_self, this]
  simp only [hj]
  rw [Finset.sum_ite_mem, Finset.univ_inter, Finset.sum_const, ← Nat.cast_smul_eq_nsmul R]

name: Operad.GrComposite.map₂_toHom_mk
proof:
:= by
  rw [map₂_mk]
  rfl

name: Operad.GrComposite.sub_map₂_mem
statement:
theorem sub_map₂_mem (x : GrComposite R M N S) :
    x - (map₂ idSpHom π.toHom).app S x
      ∈ ⨆ j : ℕ, Module.End.eigenspace (leafMap R M (FreeGrL.GrSpEnd.compl R N π))
        ((j + 1 : ℕ) : R)
proof:
:= by
  induction x using induction_on with
  | h0 => simp
  | hadd x y hx hy =>
    rw [map_add, add_sub_add_comm]
    exact Submodule.add_mem _ hx hy
  | hsmul c x hx =>
    rw [map_smul, ← smul_sub]
    exact Submodule.smul_mem _ c hx
  | hmk g =>
    have hsplit : g.y = (fun a => g.y a - π.app _ (g.y a)) + fun a => π.app _ (g.y a) := by
      funext a
      simp
    have h1 : mk R g = ∑ T : Finset g.A, mk R { g with y := (T.piecewise
        (fun a => g.y a - π.app _ (g.y a)) (fun a => π.app _ (g.y a))) } := by
      have := (mkY (R := R) g).map_add_univ (fun a => g.y a - π.app _ (g.y a))
        (fun a => π.app _ (g.y a))
      rw [← hsplit] at this
      exact this
    rw [map₂_toHom_mk, h1, ← Finset.add_sum_erase _ _ (Finset.mem_univ ∅),
      Finset.piecewise_empty, add_sub_cancel_left]
    refine Submodule.sum_mem _ fun T hT => ?_
    have hpos : 0 < T.card := Finset.card_pos.2
      (Finset.nonempty_iff_ne_empty.2 (Finset.ne_of_mem_erase hT))
    refine Submodule.mem_iSup_of_mem (T.card - 1) (Module.End.mem_eigenspace_iff.2 ?_)
    rw [leafMap_compl_piecewise π hπ, Nat.sub_add_cancel hpos]

name: Operad.GrComposite.outerN_mk
statement:
lemma outerN_mk (g : GrCompGen M N S) :
    outerN R M N S (mk R g) = (Fintype.card g.A : R) • mk R g
proof:
:= by
  rw [outerN, map₂_mk, ← mk_smul_m]
  rfl

name: Operad.GrComposite.outerN_map₂
statement:
lemma outerN_map₂ (ψ : GrSpeciesHom R N N') (x : GrComposite R M N S) :
    outerN R M N' S ((map₂ idSpHom ψ).app S x) = (map₂ idSpHom ψ).app S (outerN R M N S x)
proof:
:= by
  have h : (outerN R M N' S).comp ((map₂ idSpHom ψ).app S)
      = ((map₂ idSpHom ψ).app S).comp (outerN R M N S) := hom_ext fun g => by
    simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply, outerN_mk, map_smul, map₂_mk]
  exact LinearMap.congr_fun h x

name: Operad.GrComposite.outerN_leafMap
statement:
lemma outerN_leafMap (gm : GrSpEnd R N q) (x : GrComposite R M N S) :
    outerN R M N S (leafMap R M gm x) = leafMap R M gm (outerN R M N S x)
proof:
:=
  map₂_leafMap (cardHom R M) (fun A _ _ m => by
    simp only [cardHom, LinearMap.smul_apply, LinearMap.id_apply, map_smul])
    (GrSpEnd.id R N).toHom gm gm (fun _ _ _ _ => rfl) x

name: Operad.GrComposite.mk_mem_outerEig
statement: lemma mk_mem_outerEig (g : GrCompGen M N S) : mk R g ∈ outerEig R M N S (Fintype.card g.A)
proof:
:=
  Module.End.mem_eigenspace_iff.2 (outerN_mk g)

name: Operad.GrComposite.map₂_mem_outerEig
statement:
lemma map₂_mem_outerEig (ψ : GrSpeciesHom R N N') {k : ℕ} {x : GrComposite R M N S}
    (hx : x ∈ outerEig R M N S k) : (map₂ idSpHom ψ).app S x ∈ outerEig R M N' S k
proof:
:=
  Module.End.mem_eigenspace_iff.2 (by rw [outerN_map₂, Module.End.mem_eigenspace_iff.1 hx,
    map_smul])

name: Operad.GrComposite.leafMap_mem_outerEig
statement:
lemma leafMap_mem_outerEig (gm : GrSpEnd R N q) {k : ℕ} {x : GrComposite R M N S}
    (hx : x ∈ outerEig R M N S k) : leafMap R M gm x ∈ outerEig R M N S k
proof:
:=
  Module.End.mem_eigenspace_iff.2 (by rw [outerN_leafMap, Module.End.mem_eigenspace_iff.1 hx,
    map_smul])

name: Operad.GrComposite.Splitting.map₂_leafMap_d
statement:
lemma map₂_leafMap_d (x : GrComposite R M N S) :
    (map₂ idSpHom s.p.toHom).app S (leafMap R M d x) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [map₂_leafMap idSpHom (fun _ _ _ _ => rfl) s.p.toHom d (GrSpEnd.zero R N true)
    (fun A _ _ y => by rw [GrSpEnd.toHom_app, s.pd, GrSpEnd.zero_app]),
    leafMap_eq_zero (fun _ _ _ _ => rfl)]

name: Operad.GrComposite.Splitting.leafMap_d_map₂
statement:
lemma leafMap_d_map₂ (x : GrComposite R M N S) :
    leafMap R M d ((map₂ idSpHom s.p.toHom).app S x) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [← map₂_leafMap idSpHom (fun _ _ _ _ => rfl) s.p.toHom (GrSpEnd.zero R N true) d
    (fun A _ _ y => by simp only [GrSpEnd.toHom_app, GrSpEnd.zero_app, map_zero, s.dp]),
    leafMap_eq_zero (fun _ _ _ _ => rfl), map_zero]

name: Operad.GrComposite.Splitting.map₂_map₂_p
statement:
lemma map₂_map₂_p (x : GrComposite R M N S) :
    (map₂ idSpHom s.p.toHom).app S ((map₂ idSpHom s.p.toHom).app S x)
      = (map₂ idSpHom s.p.toHom).app S x
proof:
:=
  map₂_map₂ _ _ _ (fun A _ _ y => s.pp A y) x

name: Operad.GrComposite.Splitting.leaf_contract
statement:
lemma leaf_contract (x : GrComposite R M N S) :
    leafMap R M d (leafMap R M s.h x) + leafMap R M s.h (leafMap R M d x)
      = leafMap R M (FreeGrL.GrSpEnd.compl R N s.p) x
proof:
:= by
  rw [leafMap_comm d s.h, Bool.and_self, σ_true, neg_one_smul,
    show ∀ a b : GrComposite R M N S, -a + b + a = b from fun a b => by abel]
  refine leafMap_congr (fun A _ _ y => ?_) x
  rw [GrSpEnd.gcomm_app, Bool.and_self, σ_true, neg_one_smul, sub_neg_eq_add, s.dh]
  rfl

name: Operad.GrComposite.Splitting.leaf_compl_d
statement:
lemma leaf_compl_d (x : GrComposite R M N S) :
    leafMap R M (FreeGrL.GrSpEnd.compl R N s.p) (leafMap R M d x)
      = leafMap R M d (leafMap R M (FreeGrL.GrSpEnd.compl R N s.p) x)
proof:
:= by
  rw [leafMap_comm, Bool.false_and, σ_false, one_smul,
    leafMap_eq_zero (gm := (FreeGrL.GrSpEnd.compl R N s.p).gcomm d) (fun A _ _ y => by
      rw [GrSpEnd.gcomm_app, FreeGrL.GrSpEnd.compl_app, FreeGrL.GrSpEnd.compl_app, map_sub,
        s.pd, s.dp, Bool.false_and, σ_false, one_smul]
      abel), add_zero]

name: Operad.GrComposite.Splitting.leafRetract
statement:
theorem leafRetract [Algebra ℚ R] (k : ℕ) :
    QIso.Retract (outerEig R M N S k) (leafMap R M d) ((map₂ idSpHom s.p.toHom).app S) where
  mem x hx
proof:
:= map₂_mem_outerEig _ hx
  memD x hx := leafMap_mem_outerEig _ hx
  rr x := Splitting.map₂_map₂_p s x
  rD x := Splitting.map₂_leafMap_d s x
  Dr x := Splitting.leafMap_d_map₂ s x
  acyc x hx hδx hpx := by
    have hpos := sub_map₂_mem (M := M) s.p s.pp x
    rw [hpx, sub_zero] at hpos
    obtain ⟨z, hz, hδz⟩ := exists_eq_of_contract
      (leafMap R M (FreeGrL.GrSpEnd.compl R N s.p)) (leafMap R M d) (leafMap R M s.h)
      (outerN R M N S) (k : R) (fun y => Splitting.leaf_compl_d s y)
      (fun y => (outerN_leafMap _ y).symm) (fun y => outerN_leafMap _ y)
      (fun y => Splitting.leaf_contract s y) hpos hδx (Module.End.mem_eigenspace_iff.1 hx)
    exact ⟨z, Module.End.mem_eigenspace_iff.2 hz, hδz⟩

name: Operad.GrComposite.qiso_leaf
statement:
theorem qiso_leaf [Algebra ℚ R] (g : GrSpeciesHom R N N')
    (hg : ∀ (A : Type) [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] (y : N A),
      g.app A (d.app A y) = d'.app A (g.app A y))
    (k : GrSpeciesHom R N' N) (n : ℕ)
    (hKG : ∀ x ∈ outerEig R M N S n, (map₂ idSpHom k).app S
      ((map₂ idSpHom (s'.p.toHom.comp (g.comp s.p.toHom))).app S x)
        = (map₂ idSpHom s.p.toHom).app S x)
    (hGK : ∀ y ∈ outerEig R M N' S n,
      (map₂ idSpHom (s'.p.toHom.comp (g.comp s.p.toHom))).app S ((map₂ idSpHom k).app S y)
        = (map₂ idSpHom s'.p.toHom).app S y) :
    QIso.Surj (outerEig R M N S n) (outerEig R M N' S n) (leafMap R M d) (leafMap R M d')
        ((map₂ idSpHom g).app S)
      ∧ QIso.Inj (outerEig R M N S n) (outerEig R M N' S n) (leafMap R M d) (leafMap R M d')
        ((map₂ idSpHom g).app S)
proof:
:= by
  have hr := Splitting.leafRetract s (M := M) (S := S) n
  have hr' := Splitting.leafRetract s' (M := M) (S := S) n
  have hFS : ∀ x ∈ outerEig R M N S n, (map₂ idSpHom g).app S x ∈ outerEig R M N' S n :=
    fun x hx => map₂_mem_outerEig _ hx
  have hFD : ∀ x, (map₂ idSpHom g).app S (leafMap R M d x)
      = leafMap R M d' ((map₂ idSpHom g).app S x) :=
    fun x => map₂_leafMap idSpHom (fun _ _ _ _ => rfl) g d d' hg x
  have hG : ∀ x, (map₂ idSpHom s'.p.toHom).app S ((map₂ idSpHom g).app S
      ((map₂ idSpHom s.p.toHom).app S x))
        = (map₂ idSpHom (s'.p.toHom.comp (g.comp s.p.toHom))).app S x := fun x => by
    rw [map₂_map₂ (M := M) (S := S) g s.p.toHom (g.comp s.p.toHom) (fun _ _ _ _ => rfl),
      map₂_map₂ (M := M) (S := S) s'.p.toHom (g.comp s.p.toHom)
        (s'.p.toHom.comp (g.comp s.p.toHom)) (fun _ _ _ _ => rfl)]
  exact ⟨QIso.surj_of_retract hr hr' hFS hFD hG (fun y hy => map₂_mem_outerEig _ hy) hGK,
    QIso.inj_of_retract hr hr' hFD hG hKG⟩

name: Operad.outVal_some
statement:
@[simp] lemma outVal_some {S : Finset X} (x : {x : X // x ∉ S}) (h : some x ≠ none) :
    outVal (some x) h = x.1
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.outVal_eq_of_eq
statement:
lemma outVal_eq_of_eq {S : Finset X} {o : SOut S} (h : o ≠ none) {x : {x : X // x ∉ S}}
    (hx : o = some x) : outVal o h = x.1
proof:
:= by
  subst hx
  rfl

name: Operad.outVal_not_mem
statement: lemma outVal_not_mem {S : Finset X} (o : SOut S) (h : o ≠ none) : outVal o h ∉ S
proof:
:= by
  cases o with
  | none => exact absurd rfl h
  | some x => exact x.2

name: Operad.splitEquiv_inl
statement:
@[simp] lemma splitEquiv_inl (S : Finset X) (o : Without (SOut S) none) :
    splitEquiv S (Sum.inl o) = outVal o.1 o.2
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.splitEquiv_inr
statement: @[simp] lemma splitEquiv_inr (S : Finset X) (x : SIn S) : splitEquiv S (Sum.inr x) = x.1
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.none_mem_liftOut
statement:
@[simp] lemma none_mem_liftOut (S : Finset X) (b : Bool) (T₀ : Finset X) :
    (none : SOut S) ∈ liftOut S b T₀ ↔ b = true
proof:
:= by
  simp [liftOut]

name: Operad.some_mem_liftOut
statement:
@[simp] lemma some_mem_liftOut (S : Finset X) (b : Bool) (T₀ : Finset X) (x : {x : X // x ∉ S}) :
    (some x : SOut S) ∈ liftOut S b T₀ ↔ x.1 ∈ T₀
proof:
:= by
  simp [liftOut]

name: Operad.mem_restrIn
statement: @[simp] lemma mem_restrIn (V U₀ : Finset X) (v : SIn V) : v ∈ restrIn V U₀ ↔ v.1 ∈ U₀
proof:
:= by
  simp [restrIn]

name: Operad.mem_projOut
statement:
lemma mem_projOut {S : Finset X} {T : Finset (SOut S)} {x : X} :
    x ∈ projOut S T ↔ ∃ h : x ∉ S, (some ⟨x, h⟩ : SOut S) ∈ T
proof:
:= by
  simp [projOut]

name: Operad.disjoint_projOut
statement: lemma disjoint_projOut (S : Finset X) (T : Finset (SOut S)) : Disjoint S (projOut S T)
proof:
:=
  Finset.disjoint_right.2 fun _ hx => (mem_projOut.1 hx).1

name: Operad.projOut_liftOut
statement:
lemma projOut_liftOut {S T₀ : Finset X} (hd : Disjoint S T₀) (b : Bool) :
    projOut S (liftOut S b T₀) = T₀
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  rw [mem_projOut]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨_, h⟩
    exact (some_mem_liftOut _ _ _ _).1 h
  · intro hx
    exact ⟨Finset.disjoint_right.1 hd hx, (some_mem_liftOut _ _ _ _).2 hx⟩

name: Operad.liftOut_projOut
statement:
lemma liftOut_projOut {S : Finset X} {T : Finset (SOut S)} {b : Bool}
    (hb : (none : SOut S) ∈ T ↔ b = true) : liftOut S b (projOut S T) = T
proof:
:= by
  ext o
  rcases o with (_ | ⟨x, hx⟩)
  · rw [none_mem_liftOut, hb]
  · rw [some_mem_liftOut, mem_projOut]
    exact ⟨fun ⟨_, h⟩ => h, fun h => ⟨hx, h⟩⟩

name: Operad.sum_nonempties_out
statement:
lemma sum_nonempties_out (S : Finset X) (f : Finset (SOut S) → M) :
    ∑ T ∈ nonempties (SOut S), f T
      = ∑ T₀ ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun T₀ => Disjoint S T₀), f (liftOut S true T₀)
        + ∑ T₀ ∈ (nonempties X).filter (fun T₀ => Disjoint S T₀), f (liftOut S false T₀)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Finset.sum_filter_add_sum_filter_not (nonempties (SOut S)) (fun T => none ∈ T)]
  congr 1
  · symm
    refine Finset.sum_nbij' (liftOut S true) (projOut S) ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ (fun _ _ => rfl)
    · intro T₀ _
      simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and]
      exact ⟨⟨none, (none_mem_liftOut _ _ _).2 rfl⟩, (none_mem_liftOut _ _ _).2 rfl⟩
    · intro T _
      simpa using disjoint_projOut S T
    · intro T₀ hT₀
      exact projOut_liftOut (by simpa using hT₀) true
    · intro T hT
      simp only [Finset.mem_filter] at hT
      exact liftOut_projOut (by simpa using hT.2)
  · symm
    refine Finset.sum_nbij' (liftOut S false) (projOut S) ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ (fun _ _ => rfl)
    · intro T₀ hT₀
      simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and] at hT₀ ⊢
      obtain ⟨⟨x, hx⟩, hd⟩ := hT₀
      exact ⟨⟨some ⟨x, Finset.disjoint_right.1 hd hx⟩, (some_mem_liftOut _ _ _ _).2 hx⟩,
        by simp⟩
    · intro T hT
      simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and] at hT ⊢
      refine ⟨?_, disjoint_projOut S T⟩
      obtain ⟨⟨o, ho⟩, hn⟩ := hT
      rcases o with (_ | ⟨x, hx⟩)
      · exact absurd ho hn
      · exact ⟨x, mem_projOut.2 ⟨hx, ho⟩⟩
    · intro T₀ hT₀
      simp only [Finset.mem_filter] at hT₀
      exact projOut_liftOut hT₀.2 false
    · intro T hT
      simp only [Finset.mem_filter] at hT
      exact liftOut_projOut (by simpa using hT.2)

name: Operad.sum_nonempties_in
statement:
lemma sum_nonempties_in (V : Finset X) (f : Finset (SIn V) → M) :
    ∑ U ∈ nonempties (SIn V), f U
      = ∑ U₀ ∈ (nonempties X).filter (· ⊆ V), f (restrIn V U₀)
proof:
:= by
  symm
  refine Finset.sum_nbij' (restrIn V) (fun U => U.map (Function.Embedding.subtype _)) ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_
    (fun _ _ => rfl)
  · intro U₀ hU₀
    simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and] at hU₀ ⊢
    obtain ⟨⟨x, hx⟩, hV⟩ := hU₀
    exact ⟨⟨x, hV hx⟩, (mem_restrIn _ _ _).2 hx⟩
  · intro U hU
    simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and] at hU ⊢
    refine ⟨hU.map, fun x hx => ?_⟩
    obtain ⟨v, _, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_map.1 hx
    exact v.2
  · intro U₀ hU₀
    simp only [Finset.mem_filter] at hU₀
    ext x
    simp only [Finset.mem_map, mem_restrIn, Function.Embedding.coe_subtype]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨v, hv, rfl⟩
      exact hv
    · intro hx
      exact ⟨⟨x, hU₀.2 hx⟩, hx, rfl⟩
  · intro U _
    ext v
    simp only [mem_restrIn, Finset.mem_map, Function.Embedding.coe_subtype]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨w, hw, hwv⟩
      rwa [← Subtype.ext hwv]
    · intro hv
      exact ⟨v, hv, rfl⟩

name: Operad.sum_nested_pairs
statement:
lemma sum_nested_pairs (F : Finset X → Finset X → M) :
    ∑ S ∈ nonempties X, ∑ T₀ ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun T₀ => Disjoint S T₀), F (S ∪ T₀) S
      = ∑ V ∈ nonempties X, ∑ U₀ ∈ (nonempties X).filter (· ⊆ V), F V U₀
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : ∀ S : Finset X, ∑ T₀ ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun T₀ => Disjoint S T₀), F (S ∪ T₀) S
      = ∑ V ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun V => S ⊆ V), F V S := fun S => by
    refine Finset.sum_nbij' (S ∪ ·) (· \ S) ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ (fun _ _ => rfl)
    · intro T₀ _
      simp
    · intro V _
      simp [Finset.disjoint_sdiff]
    · intro T₀ hT₀
      simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and] at hT₀
      exact Finset.union_sdiff_cancel_left hT₀
    · intro V hV
      simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and] at hV
      exact Finset.union_sdiff_of_subset hV
  rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl fun S _ => h1 S]
  refine Finset.sum_comm' fun S V => ?_
  simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hS, hSV⟩
    exact ⟨⟨hS, hSV⟩, hS.mono hSV⟩
  · rintro ⟨⟨hS, hSV⟩, _⟩
    exact ⟨hS, hSV⟩

name: Operad.sum_disj_pairs
statement:
lemma sum_disj_pairs (G : Finset X → Finset X → M) :
    ∑ S ∈ nonempties X, ∑ T₀ ∈ (nonempties X).filter (fun T₀ => Disjoint S T₀), G S T₀
      = ∑ p ∈ disjPairs X, G p.1 p.2
proof:
:=
  (Finset.sum_finset_product' _ _ _ fun p => by
    simp only [disjPairs, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_product]
    tauto).symm

name: Operad.GrOperad.comp_slot
proof:
:= by
  subst h
  have : slotEquiv (B := B) (rfl : j = j) = Equiv.refl _ := Equiv.ext fun z => by
    rcases z with (⟨a, ha⟩ | b) <;> rfl
  rw [this, map_refl]

name: Operad.GrOperad.comp_map_left
statement:
lemma comp_map_left {A A' B : Type} [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] [Fintype A'] [DecidableEq A']
    [Fintype B] [DecidableEq B] (σ : A ≃ A') (i : A) (j : A') (h : σ i = j) (x : Q A) (y : Q B) :
    comp (R := R) j (map (R := R) σ x) y
      = map (R := R) ((compEquiv σ (Equiv.refl B) i).trans (slotEquiv (B := B) h))
          (comp (R := R) i x y)
proof:
:= by
  rw [map_trans, map_comp, map_refl, ← comp_slot]

name: Operad.GrOperad.comp_map_right
statement:
lemma comp_map_right {A B B' : Type} [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] [Fintype B] [DecidableEq B]
    [Fintype B'] [DecidableEq B'] (τ : B ≃ B') (i : A) (x : Q A) (y : Q B) :
    comp (R := R) i x (map (R := R) τ y)
      = map (R := R) (compEquiv (Equiv.refl A) τ i) (comp (R := R) i x y)
proof:
:= by
  rw [map_comp, map_refl]
  rfl

name: Operad.GrOperad.comp_assoc_seq'
statement:
lemma comp_assoc_seq' {A B D : Type} [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] [Fintype B] [DecidableEq B]
    [Fintype D] [DecidableEq D] (i : A) (j : B) (x : Q A) (y : Q B) (z : Q D) :
    comp (R := R) (Sum.inr j) (comp (R := R) i x y) z
      = map (R := R) (seqEquiv i j D).symm (comp (R := R) i x (comp (R := R) j y z))
proof:
:= by
  rw [← comp_assoc_seq i j x y z, ← map_trans, Equiv.self_trans_symm, map_refl]

name: Operad.GrOperad.comp_assoc_par'
statement:
lemma comp_assoc_par' {A B D : Type} [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] [Fintype B] [DecidableEq B]
    [Fintype D] [DecidableEq D] {i k : A} (hik : i ≠ k) (x : Q A) {q r : Bool} {y : Q B} {z : Q D}
    (hy : par (R := R) q y = y) (hz : par (R := R) r z = z) :
    comp (R := R) (Sum.inl ⟨k, Ne.symm hik⟩) (comp (R := R) i x y) z
      = σ R (q && r) • map (R := R) (parEquiv hik B D).symm
          (comp (R := R) (Sum.inl ⟨i, hik⟩) (comp (R := R) k x z) y)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← map_smul, ← comp_assoc_par hik x hy hz, ← map_trans, Equiv.self_trans_symm, map_refl]

name: Operad.GrOperad.canon_not_mem
statement: lemma canon_not_mem {a : A} (ha : a ≠ i) : e (Sum.inl ⟨a, ha⟩) ∉ S
proof:
:= by
  rw [hS]
  rintro ⟨b, hb⟩
  exact Sum.inr_ne_inl (e.injective hb)

name: Operad.GrOperad.canonOut_self
statement: @[simp] lemma canonOut_self : canonOut e S hS i = none
proof:
:= by
  simp [canonOut]

name: Operad.GrOperad.canonOut_ne
statement:
lemma canonOut_ne {a : A} (ha : a ≠ i) :
    canonOut e S hS a = some ⟨e (Sum.inl ⟨a, ha⟩), canon_not_mem e S hS ha⟩
proof:
:= by
  simp [canonOut, ha]

name: Operad.GrOperad.canonIn_apply
statement: @[simp] lemma canonIn_apply (b : B) : (canonIn e S hS b).1 = e (Sum.inr b)
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.GrOperad.map_comp_canon
statement:
theorem map_comp_canon (x : Q A) (y : Q B) :
    map (R := R) e (comp (R := R) i x y)
      = map (R := R) (splitEquiv S) (comp (R := R) none (map (R := R) (canonOut e S hS) x)
          (map (R := R) (canonIn e S hS) y))
proof:
:= by
  have hE : (compEquiv (canonOut e S hS) (canonIn e S hS) i).trans
      ((slotEquiv (B := SIn S) (canonOut_self e S hS)).trans (splitEquiv S)) = e := by
    ext z
    rcases z with (⟨a, ha⟩ | b)
    · simp only [Equiv.trans_apply, compEquiv_inl, slotEquiv_inl, splitEquiv_inl]
      exact outVal_eq_of_eq _ (canonOut_ne e S hS ha)
    · rfl
  rw [comp_slot (canonOut_self e S hS), ← map_comp, ← map_trans, ← map_trans, hE]

name: Operad.GrOperad.Inv.map_apply
statement:
lemma map_apply (q : Inv R Q) {A B : Type} [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] [Fintype B]
    [DecidableEq B] (e : A ≃ B) : map (R := R) e (q.1 A) = q.1 B
proof:
:=
  q.2 A B e

name: Operad.GrOperad.Inv.starF_apply
statement:
lemma starF_apply (q q' : Fam Q) (X : Type) [Fintype X] [DecidableEq X] :
    starF R q q' X = ∑ S ∈ nonempties X, term (R := R) q q' X S
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.GrOperad.Inv.map_term
statement:
lemma map_term (q q' : Inv R Q) {X Y : Type} [Fintype X] [DecidableEq X] [Fintype Y]
    [DecidableEq Y] (e : X ≃ Y) (S : Finset X) :
    map (R := R) e (term (R := R) q.1 q'.1 X S) = term (R := R) q.1 q'.1 Y (S.map e.toEmbedding)
proof:
:= by
  have hS : ∀ y, y ∈ S.map e.toEmbedding ↔ ∃ b : SIn S, ((splitEquiv S).trans e) (Sum.inr b) = y :=
    fun y => by
      simp only [Finset.mem_map_equiv, Equiv.trans_apply, splitEquiv_inr]
      constructor
      · intro h
        exact ⟨⟨e.symm y, h⟩, by simp⟩
      · rintro ⟨b, rfl⟩
        simp [b.2]
  unfold term
  rw [← map_trans, map_comp_canon _ _ hS, map_apply, map_apply]

name: Operad.GrOperad.Inv.starF_mem
statement: lemma starF_mem (q q' : Inv R Q) : starF R q.1 q'.1 ∈ Inv R Q
proof:
:= by
  intro X Y _ _ _ _ e
  simp only [starF_apply, map_sum, map_term]
  refine Finset.sum_nbij' (fun S => S.map e.toEmbedding) (fun S => S.map e.symm.toEmbedding)
    ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ (fun _ _ => rfl)
  · intro S hS
    simpa using hS
  · intro S hS
    simpa using hS
  · intro S _
    simp [Finset.map_map]
  · intro S _
    simp [Finset.map_map]

name: Operad.GrOperad.Inv.term_add_left
statement:
lemma term_add_left (q₁ q₂ q' : Fam Q) (X : Type) [Fintype X] [DecidableEq X] (S : Finset X) :
    term (R := R) (q₁ + q₂) q' X S = term (R := R) q₁ q' X S + term (R := R) q₂ q' X S
proof:
:= by
  simp only [term, Pi.add_apply, map_add, LinearMap.add_apply]

name: Operad.GrOperad.Inv.term_add_right
statement:
lemma term_add_right (q q'₁ q'₂ : Fam Q) (X : Type) [Fintype X] [DecidableEq X] (S : Finset X) :
    term (R := R) q (q'₁ + q'₂) X S = term (R := R) q q'₁ X S + term (R := R) q q'₂ X S
proof:
:= by
  simp only [term, Pi.add_apply, map_add]

name: Operad.GrOperad.Inv.term_smul_left
statement:
lemma term_smul_left (c : R) (q q' : Fam Q) (X : Type) [Fintype X] [DecidableEq X]
    (S : Finset X) : term (R := R) (c • q) q' X S = c • term (R := R) q q' X S
proof:
:= by
  simp only [term, Pi.smul_apply, map_smul, LinearMap.smul_apply]

name: Operad.GrOperad.Inv.term_smul_right
statement:
lemma term_smul_right (c : R) (q q' : Fam Q) (X : Type) [Fintype X] [DecidableEq X]
    (S : Finset X) : term (R := R) q (c • q') X S = c • term (R := R) q q' X S
proof:
:= by
  simp only [term, Pi.smul_apply, map_smul]

name: Operad.GrOperad.Inv.star_apply
statement:
lemma star_apply (q q' : Inv R Q) (X : Type) [Fintype X] [DecidableEq X] :
    (star R Q q q').1 X = ∑ S ∈ nonempties X, term (R := R) q.1 q'.1 X S
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.GrOperad.Inv.star_star_left
statement:
lemma star_star_left (q q' q'' : Inv R Q) (X : Type) [Fintype X] [DecidableEq X] :
    (star R Q (star R Q q q') q'').1 X
      = ∑ S ∈ nonempties X, ∑ T ∈ nonempties (SOut S), outerTerm (R := R) q.1 q'.1 q''.1 X S T
proof:
:= by
  simp only [star_apply, term, outerTerm, map_sum, LinearMap.coe_sum, Finset.sum_apply]

name: Operad.GrOperad.Inv.star_star_right
statement:
lemma star_star_right (q q' q'' : Inv R Q) (X : Type) [Fintype X] [DecidableEq X] :
    (star R Q q (star R Q q' q'')).1 X
      = ∑ V ∈ nonempties X, ∑ U ∈ nonempties (SIn V), innerTerm (R := R) q.1 q'.1 q''.1 X V U
proof:
:= by
  simp only [star_apply, term, innerTerm, map_sum]

name: Operad.GrOperad.Inv.nested_canon
statement:
lemma nested_canon (q q' q'' : Inv R Q) {i : A} {j : B}
    (E : Without A i ⊕ (Without B j ⊕ D) ≃ X) (V U₀ : Finset X)
    (hV : ∀ x, x ∈ V ↔ ∃ w, E (Sum.inr w) = x)
    (hU : ∀ x, x ∈ U₀ ↔ ∃ d, E (Sum.inr (Sum.inr d)) = x) :
    map (R := R) E (comp (R := R) i (q.1 A) (comp (R := R) j (q'.1 B) (q''.1 D)))
      = innerTerm (R := R) q.1 q'.1 q''.1 X V (restrIn V U₀)
proof:
:= by
  have hU' : ∀ v, v ∈ restrIn V U₀ ↔ ∃ d, canonIn E V hV (Sum.inr d) = v := fun v => by
    rw [mem_restrIn, hU]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨d, hd⟩
      exact ⟨d, Subtype.ext hd⟩
    · rintro ⟨d, rfl⟩
      exact ⟨d, rfl⟩
  rw [map_comp_canon E V hV, map_apply, map_comp_canon _ _ hU', map_apply, map_apply]
  rfl

name: Operad.GrOperad.Inv.disj_canon
statement:
lemma disj_canon (q q' q'' : Inv R Q) {k : A} {l : Without A k ⊕ D}
    (hl : ∀ d, Sum.inr d ≠ l) (E : Without (Without A k ⊕ D) l ⊕ B ≃ X) (S T₀ : Finset X)
    (hT : ∀ x, x ∈ T₀ ↔ ∃ b, E (Sum.inr b) = x)
    (hS : ∀ x, x ∈ S ↔ ∃ d, E (Sum.inl ⟨Sum.inr d, hl d⟩) = x) :
    map (R := R) E (comp (R := R) l (comp (R := R) k (q.1 A) (q''.1 D)) (q'.1 B))
      = outerTerm (R := R) q.1 q''.1 q'.1 X T₀ (liftOut T₀ false S)
proof:
:= by
  have hS' : ∀ o, o ∈ liftOut T₀ false S ↔ ∃ d, canonOut E T₀ hT (Sum.inr d) = o := fun o => by
    rcases o with (_ | ⟨x, hx⟩)
    · simp only [none_mem_liftOut, Bool.false_eq_true, false_iff, not_exists]
      intro d
      rw [canonOut_ne E T₀ hT (hl d)]
      simp
    · rw [some_mem_liftOut, hS]
      constructor
      · rintro ⟨d, hd⟩
        refine ⟨d, ?_⟩
        rw [canonOut_ne E T₀ hT (hl d)]
        simp [hd]
      · rintro ⟨d, hd⟩
        rw [canonOut_ne E T₀ hT (hl d)] at hd
        exact ⟨d, by simpa using hd⟩
  rw [map_comp_canon E T₀ hT, map_apply, map_comp_canon _ _ hS', map_apply, map_apply]
  rfl

name: Operad.GrOperad.Inv.outerTerm_nested
statement:
lemma outerTerm_nested (q q' q'' : Inv R Q) (S T₀ : Finset X) :
    outerTerm (R := R) q.1 q'.1 q''.1 X S (liftOut S true T₀)
      = innerTerm (R := R) q.1 q'.1 q''.1 X (S ∪ T₀) (restrIn (S ∪ T₀) S)
proof:
:= by
  have hnT : (none : SOut S) ∈ liftOut S true T₀ := (none_mem_liftOut _ _ _).2 rfl
  unfold outerTerm term
  rw [comp_map_left (splitEquiv (liftOut S true T₀)) (Sum.inr ⟨none, hnT⟩) none rfl,
    comp_assoc_seq', ← map_trans,
    ← map_trans, nested_canon q q' q'' _ (S ∪ T₀) S]
  · intro x
    constructor
    · intro hx
      by_cases hxS : x ∈ S
      · exact ⟨Sum.inr ⟨x, hxS⟩, rfl⟩
      · have hxT : x ∈ T₀ := by
          rcases Finset.mem_union.1 hx with h | h
          · exact absurd h hxS
          · exact h
        exact ⟨Sum.inl ⟨⟨some ⟨x, hxS⟩, (some_mem_liftOut _ _ _ _).2 hxT⟩,
          fun h => by simp at h⟩, rfl⟩
    · rintro ⟨w, rfl⟩
      rcases w with (⟨⟨(_ | ⟨x, hx⟩), ho⟩, hne⟩ | ⟨x, hx⟩)
      · exact absurd (Subtype.ext rfl) hne
      · exact Finset.mem_union_right _ ((some_mem_liftOut _ _ _ _).1 ho)
      · exact Finset.mem_union_left _ hx
  · intro x
    constructor
    · intro hx
      exact ⟨⟨x, hx⟩, rfl⟩
    · rintro ⟨d, rfl⟩
      exact d.2

name: Operad.GrOperad.Inv.outerTerm_disj
statement:
lemma outerTerm_disj (q q' q'' : Inv R Q) {p' p'' : Bool} (hq' : IsPar p' q') (hq'' : IsPar p'' q'')
    (S T₀ : Finset X) (hd : Disjoint S T₀) :
    outerTerm (R := R) q.1 q'.1 q''.1 X S (liftOut S false T₀)
      = σ R (p' && p'') • outerTerm (R := R) q.1 q''.1 q'.1 X T₀ (liftOut T₀ false S)
proof:
:= by
  have hnT : (none : SOut S) ∉ liftOut S false T₀ := by simp
  have hik : (none : SOut (liftOut S false T₀)) ≠ some ⟨none, hnT⟩ := by simp
  unfold outerTerm term
  rw [comp_map_left (splitEquiv (liftOut S false T₀))
      (Sum.inl ⟨some ⟨none, hnT⟩, Option.some_ne_none _⟩) none rfl,
    comp_assoc_par' hik _ (hq' _) (hq'' _), map_smul, map_smul, ← map_trans, ← map_trans,
    disj_canon q q' q'' (fun d => Sum.inr_ne_inl) _ S T₀]
  · rfl
  · intro x
    constructor
    · intro hx
      have hxS : x ∉ S := Finset.disjoint_right.1 hd hx
      exact ⟨⟨some ⟨x, hxS⟩, (some_mem_liftOut _ _ _ _).2 hx⟩, rfl⟩
    · rintro ⟨⟨(_ | ⟨x, hx⟩), ho⟩, rfl⟩
      · exact absurd ho hnT
      · exact (some_mem_liftOut _ _ _ _).1 ho
  · intro x
    constructor
    · intro hx
      exact ⟨⟨x, hx⟩, rfl⟩
    · rintro ⟨d, rfl⟩
      exact d.2

name: Operad.GrOperad.Inv.assoc_eq_sum_disj
statement:
theorem assoc_eq_sum_disj (q q' q'' : Inv R Q) (X : Type) [Fintype X] [DecidableEq X] :
    (star R Q (star R Q q q') q'').1 X - (star R Q q (star R Q q' q'')).1 X
      = ∑ p ∈ disjPairs X, outerTerm (R := R) q.1 q'.1 q''.1 X p.1 (liftOut p.1 false p.2)
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : (star R Q (star R Q q q') q'').1 X
      = (∑ S ∈ nonempties X, ∑ T₀ ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun T₀ => Disjoint S T₀),
          innerTerm (R := R) q.1 q'.1 q''.1 X (S ∪ T₀) (restrIn (S ∪ T₀) S))
        + ∑ S ∈ nonempties X, ∑ T₀ ∈ (nonempties X).filter (fun T₀ => Disjoint S T₀),
          outerTerm (R := R) q.1 q'.1 q''.1 X S (liftOut S false T₀) := by
    rw [star_star_left, ← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun S _ => ?_
    rw [sum_nonempties_out]
    congr 1
    exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun T₀ _ => outerTerm_nested q q' q'' S T₀
  have h2 : (star R Q q (star R Q q' q'')).1 X
      = ∑ V ∈ nonempties X, ∑ U₀ ∈ (nonempties X).filter (· ⊆ V),
          innerTerm (R := R) q.1 q'.1 q''.1 X V (restrIn V U₀) := by
    rw [star_star_right]
    exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun V _ => sum_nonempties_in V _
  rw [h1, h2, sum_nested_pairs (fun V U₀ => innerTerm (R := R) q.1 q'.1 q''.1 X V (restrIn V U₀)),
    add_sub_cancel_left, sum_disj_pairs]

name: Operad.GrOperad.Inv.coe_sub_apply
statement:
lemma coe_sub_apply (a b : Inv R Q) (X : Type) [Fintype X] [DecidableEq X] :
    (a - b).1 X = a.1 X - b.1 X
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.GrOperad.Inv.coe_smul_apply
statement:
lemma coe_smul_apply (c : R) (a : Inv R Q) (X : Type) [Fintype X] [DecidableEq X] :
    (c • a).1 X = c • a.1 X
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.GrOperad.Inv.preLie
statement:
theorem preLie (q q' q'' : Inv R Q) {p' p'' : Bool} (hq' : IsPar p' q') (hq'' : IsPar p'' q'') :
    star R Q (star R Q q q') q'' - star R Q q (star R Q q' q'')
      = σ R (p' && p'') • (star R Q (star R Q q q'') q' - star R Q q (star R Q q'' q'))
proof:
:= by
  refine Subtype.ext (funext fun X => funext fun _ => funext fun _ => ?_)
  show (star R Q (star R Q q q') q'' - star R Q q (star R Q q' q'')).1 X
    = (σ R (p' && p'') • (star R Q (star R Q q q'') q' - star R Q q (star R Q q'' q'))).1 X
  rw [coe_smul_apply, coe_sub_apply, coe_sub_apply, assoc_eq_sum_disj, assoc_eq_sum_disj,
    Finset.smul_sum]
  refine Finset.sum_nbij' Prod.swap Prod.swap ?_ ?_ (fun _ _ => rfl) (fun _ _ => rfl) ?_
  · intro p hp
    simp only [disjPairs, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_product] at hp ⊢
    exact ⟨⟨hp.1.2, hp.1.1⟩, hp.2.symm⟩
  · intro p hp
    simp only [disjPairs, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_product] at hp ⊢
    exact ⟨⟨hp.1.2, hp.1.1⟩, hp.2.symm⟩
  · intro p hp
    simp only [disjPairs, Finset.mem_filter] at hp
    exact outerTerm_disj q q' q'' hq' hq'' p.1 p.2 hp.2

name: Operad.GrOperad.Inv.assoc_odd
statement:
theorem assoc_odd (q α : Inv R Q) (hα : IsPar true α) :
    star R Q (star R Q q α) α = star R Q q (star R Q α α)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← sub_eq_zero]
  refine Subtype.ext (funext fun X => funext fun _ => funext fun _ => ?_)
  show (star R Q (star R Q q α) α - star R Q q (star R Q α α)).1 X = 0
  rw [coe_sub_apply, assoc_eq_sum_disj]
  refine Finset.sum_involution (fun p _ => p.swap) ?_ ?_ ?_ (fun _ _ => rfl)
  · intro p hp
    have hd : Disjoint p.1 p.2 := (Finset.mem_filter.1 hp).2
    show outerTerm (R := R) q.1 α.1 α.1 X p.1 (liftOut p.1 false p.2)
      + outerTerm (R := R) q.1 α.1 α.1 X p.2 (liftOut p.2 false p.1) = 0
    rw [outerTerm_disj q α α hα hα p.1 p.2 hd, Bool.and_self, σ_true, neg_one_smul,
      neg_add_cancel]
  · intro p hp _ h
    simp only [disjPairs, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_product, Finset.mem_univ,
      true_and] at hp
    have h12 : p.2 = p.1 := congrArg Prod.fst h
    obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := hp.1.1
    have hx2 : x ∈ p.2 := by rw [h12]; exact hx
    exact Finset.disjoint_left.1 hp.2 hx hx2
  · intro p hp
    simp only [disjPairs, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_product] at hp ⊢
    exact ⟨⟨hp.1.2, hp.1.1⟩, hp.2.symm⟩

name: Operad.GrOperad.Inv.isPar_star
statement:
theorem isPar_star {p p' : Bool} {q q' : Inv R Q} (hq : IsPar p q) (hq' : IsPar p' q') :
    IsPar (xor p p') (star R Q q q')
proof:
:= by
  intro X _ _
  show par (R := R) (xor p p') (∑ S ∈ nonempties X, term (R := R) q.1 q'.1 X S)
    = ∑ S ∈ nonempties X, term (R := R) q.1 q'.1 X S
  rw [map_sum]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun S _ => ?_
  simp only [term, ← map_par]
  rw [par_comp_hom none rfl (hq _) (hq' _)]

name: Operad.GrOperad.Inv.appHom_apply
statement:
@[simp] lemma appHom_apply (φ : GrOperadHom R Q Q') (q : Inv R Q) (A : Type) [Fintype A]
    [DecidableEq A] : (appHom φ q).1 A = φ.app A (q.1 A)
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.GrOperad.Inv.appHom_star
statement:
theorem appHom_star (φ : GrOperadHom R Q Q') (q q' : Inv R Q) :
    appHom φ (star R Q q q') = star R Q' (appHom φ q) (appHom φ q')
proof:
:= by
  refine Subtype.ext (funext fun X => funext fun _ => funext fun _ => ?_)
  show φ.app X (∑ S ∈ nonempties X, term (R := R) q.1 q'.1 X S)
    = ∑ S ∈ nonempties X, term (R := R) (appHom φ q).1 (appHom φ q').1 X S
  rw [map_sum]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun S _ => ?_
  simp only [term, φ.app_map, φ.app_comp, appHom_apply]

name: Operad.GrOperad.Inv.appDer_apply
statement:
@[simp] lemma appDer_apply {e : Bool} (D : GrDer (GrOperadHom.id R Q) e) (q : Inv R Q)
    (A : Type) [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] : (appDer D q).1 A = D.app A (q.1 A)
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.GrOperad.Inv.isPar_appDer
statement:
theorem isPar_appDer {e p : Bool} (D : GrDer (GrOperadHom.id R Q) e) {q : Inv R Q}
    (hq : IsPar p q) : IsPar (xor p e) (appDer D q)
proof:
:= by
  intro A _ _
  show par (R := R) (xor p e) (D.app A (q.1 A)) = D.app A (q.1 A)
  rw [← D.app_par, hq A]

name: Operad.GrOperad.Inv.appDer_star
statement:
theorem appDer_star {e p : Bool} (D : GrDer (GrOperadHom.id R Q) e) {q : Inv R Q}
    (hq : IsPar p q) (q' : Inv R Q) :
    appDer D (star R Q q q')
      = star R Q (appDer D q) q' + σ R (e && p) • star R Q q (appDer D q')
proof:
:= by
  refine Subtype.ext (funext fun X => funext fun _ => funext fun _ => ?_)
  show D.app X (∑ S ∈ nonempties X, term (R := R) q.1 q'.1 X S)
    = ∑ S ∈ nonempties X, term (R := R) (appDer D q).1 q'.1 X S
      + σ R (e && p) • ∑ S ∈ nonempties X, term (R := R) q.1 (appDer D q').1 X S
  rw [map_sum, Finset.smul_sum, ← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun S _ => ?_
  simp only [term, D.app_map, D.app_comp, appDer_apply, GrOperadHom.id_app]
  rw [tw_hom e (hq _), map_smul, LinearMap.smul_apply, map_add, map_smul]

name: Operad.GrOperad.Inv.neg_one_smul_inv
statement: lemma neg_one_smul_inv (X : Inv R Q) : (-1 : R) • X = -X
proof:
:=
  Subtype.ext (funext fun _ => funext fun _ => funext fun _ => neg_one_smul R _)

name: Operad.GrOperad.Inv.appDer_star_self
statement:
theorem appDer_star_self {α : Inv R Q} (hα : IsPar true α) (D : GrDer (GrOperadHom.id R Q) true)
    (hD : appDer D α = -star R Q α α) : appDer D (star R Q α α) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [appDer_star D hα, hD, Bool.and_self, σ_true, neg_one_smul_inv, map_neg, map_neg,
    LinearMap.neg_apply, neg_neg, assoc_odd α α hα, neg_add_cancel]

name: Operad.DayMonoid.η_whiskerRight
statement:
@[reassoc]
lemma η_whiskerRight {F F' : C ⊛⥤ V} (f : F ⟶ F') (G : C ⊛⥤ V) (x y : C) :
    ηa F G x y ≫ (f ▷ G).natTrans.app (x ⊗ y) =
      (f.natTrans.app x ▷ G.functor.obj y) ≫ ηa F' G x y
proof:
:=
  convolutionExtensionUnit_comp_ι_map_whiskerRight_app C V f G x y

name: Operad.DayMonoid.η_whiskerLeft
statement:
@[reassoc]
lemma η_whiskerLeft (F : C ⊛⥤ V) {G G' : C ⊛⥤ V} (g : G ⟶ G') (x y : C) :
    ηa F G x y ≫ (F ◁ g).natTrans.app (x ⊗ y) =
      (F.functor.obj x ◁ g.natTrans.app y) ≫ ηa F G' x y
proof:
:=
  convolutionExtensionUnit_comp_ι_map_whiskerLeft_app V F g x y

name: Operad.DayMonoid.η_tensorHom
statement:
@[reassoc]
lemma η_tensorHom {F F' G G' : C ⊛⥤ V} (f : F ⟶ F') (g : G ⟶ G') (x y : C) :
    ηa F G x y ≫ (f ⊗ₘ g).natTrans.app (x ⊗ y) =
      (f.natTrans.app x ⊗ₘ g.natTrans.app y) ≫ ηa F' G' x y
proof:
:=
  convolutionExtensionUnit_comp_ι_map_tensorHom_app C V f g x y

name: Operad.DayMonoid.η_associator
statement:
@[reassoc]
lemma η_associator (F G H : C ⊛⥤ V) (x y z : C) :
    ηa F G x y ▷ H.functor.obj z ≫ ηa (F ⊗ G) H (x ⊗ y) z ≫
        (α_ F G H).hom.natTrans.app ((x ⊗ y) ⊗ z) =
      (α_ _ _ _).hom ≫ (F.functor.obj x ◁ ηa G H y z) ≫
        ηa F (G ⊗ H) x (y ⊗ z) ≫ (F ⊗ G ⊗ H).functor.map (α_ x y z).inv
proof:
:=
  associator_hom_unit_unit V F G H x y z

name: Operad.DayMonoid.ν_leftUnitor
statement:
@[reassoc]
lemma ν_leftUnitor (F : C ⊛⥤ V) (y : C) :
    ν C V ▷ F.functor.obj y ≫ ηa (𝟙_ (C ⊛⥤ V)) F (𝟙_ C) y ≫
        (λ_ F).hom.natTrans.app (𝟙_ C ⊗ y) =
      (λ_ (F.functor.obj y)).hom ≫ F.functor.map (λ_ y).inv
proof:
:=
  leftUnitor_hom_unit_app V F y

name: Operad.DayMonoid.ν_rightUnitor
statement:
@[reassoc]
lemma ν_rightUnitor (F : C ⊛⥤ V) (y : C) :
    F.functor.obj y ◁ ν C V ≫ ηa F (𝟙_ (C ⊛⥤ V)) y (𝟙_ C) ≫
        (ρ_ F).hom.natTrans.app (y ⊗ 𝟙_ C) =
      (ρ_ (F.functor.obj y)).hom ≫ F.functor.map (ρ_ y).inv
proof:
:=
  rightUnitor_hom_unit_app V F y

name: Operad.DayMonoid.η_naturality_right
statement:
@[reassoc]
lemma η_naturality_right (F G : C ⊛⥤ V) {x x' : C} (f : x ⟶ x') (y : C) :
    F.functor.map f ▷ G.functor.obj y ≫ ηa F G x' y =
      ηa F G x y ≫ (F ⊗ G).functor.map (f ▷ y)
proof:
:= by
  simpa [ηa, tensorHom_def] using (η F G).naturality (f ×ₘ 𝟙 y)

name: Operad.DayMonoid.η_naturality_left

lemma η_naturality_left (F G : C ⊛⥤ V) (x : C) {y y' : C} (g : y ⟶ y') :
    F.functor.obj x ◁ G.functor.map g ≫ ηa F G x y' =
      ηa F G x y ≫ (F ⊗ G).functor.map (x ◁ g)
proof:
:= by
  simpa [ηa, tensorHom_def] using (η F G).naturality (𝟙 x ×ₘ g)

name: Operad.DayMonoid.ηa_tensorDesc

lemma mem_sInf {S : Set (ShuffleOperadIdeal R P)} {A : Type} [Fintype A] [LinearOrder A]

proof:

name: Operad.ShuffleOperadIdeal.subset_span
statement: lemma subset_span (A : Type) [Fintype A] [LinearOrder A] : r A ⊆ (span R r).sub A
proof:

name: Operad.ShuffleOperadIdeal.span_le
statement:
