    · subst hjj
      have hnd' := nodup_preKeys_child ht hnd j
      rw [preKeys_eq_cons hw'] at hnd'
      exact (List.nodup_cons.1 hnd').1 hκ
    · exact not_mem_preKeys_of_ne ht hnd (Ne.symm hjj) (List.mem_of_mem_tail hκ)
        (by rw [preKeys_eq_cons hw']; exact List.mem_cons_self ..)
  rw [kzAt, dif_neg hno, Fintype.prod_eq_single a fun j hj =>
    kzAt_of_not_mem K (not_mem_preKeys_of_ne ht hnd (Ne.symm hj) (List.mem_of_mem_tail hκ))]

name: Operad.ShuffleBarSym.exists_mem_preKeys_of_cut
proof:
:= by
  rw [preKeys_node, List.tail_cons, mem_flatten_ofFn] at hκ
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := hκ
  have haj : a ≠ j := fun e => by
    subst e
    rw [update_self] at ha
    simp [preKeys] at ha
  rw [update_of_ne haj] at ha
  exact ⟨a, haj, ha⟩

name: Operad.ShuffleBarSym.exists_node_of_weight_ne_zero
statement:
lemma exists_node_of_weight_ne_zero {t : STree (VMono G)} (hw : t.weight ≠ 0) :
    ∃ (l : ℕ) (m₂ : VMono G l) (c₂ : Fin l → STree (VMono G)), t = .node m₂ c₂
proof:
:= by
  cases t with
  | leaf => simp at hw
  | node m₂ c₂ => exact ⟨_, m₂, c₂, rfl⟩

name: Operad.ShuffleBarSym.mergeT_cut_subst
statement:
theorem mergeT_cut_subst {k : ℕ} (m₁ : VMono G k) (ch : Fin k → STree (VMono G)) (j : Fin k)
    (ht : (STree.node m₁ ch).IsShuffle) (hnd : (STree.node m₁ ch).labels.Nodup) (m : ℕ)
    (hm : (ch j).first = m) {κ : ℕ ×ₗ ℕ}
    (hκ : κ ∈ (preKeys (STree.node m₁ (update ch j (.leaf m)))).tail) :
    (mergeT (STree.node m₁ (update ch j (.leaf m))) κ).subst (update STree.leaf m (ch j))
      = mergeT (STree.node m₁ ch) κ
proof:
:= by
  have hmj : m ∈ (ch j).labels := hm ▸ first_mem (ht.child j)
  have ht₁ : (STree.node m₁ (update ch j (.leaf m))).IsShuffle :=
    isShuffle_update_child ht j (isShuffle_leaf m) (by rw [first_leaf, hm])
  have hnd₁ : (STree.node m₁ (update ch j (.leaf m))).labels.Nodup :=
    Multiset.nodup_of_le (labels_update_leaf_le m₁ ch j hmj) hnd
  have hdm : ∀ a, a ≠ j → m ∉ (ch a).labels := fun a ha => not_mem_of_node hnd (Ne.symm ha) hmj
  have hex := exists_mem_preKeys_of_cut hκ
  obtain ⟨a, haj, ha⟩ := hex
  have hw := weight_ne_zero_of_mem ha
  rw [preKeys_eq_cons hw, List.mem_cons] at ha
  rcases ha with rfl | ha
  · have hn := exists_node_of_weight_ne_zero hw
    obtain ⟨l, m₂, c₂, hc⟩ := hn
    have hc₁ : update ch j (.leaf m) a = .node m₂ c₂ := (update_of_ne haj _ _).trans hc
    have e1 := mergeT_root ht₁ hc₁
    rw [update_of_ne haj] at e1
    rw [e1, mergeT_root ht hc]
    refine rootMerge_subst hc hc₁ ht ht₁ (posEquivF a l _ (mergeN_eq m₁ l) (Sum.inl ⟨j, haj.symm⟩))
      (planar_update_left ch a c₂ _ j haj.symm _) (planar_inl ch a c₂ _ _) hm fun r hr => ?_
    obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := (posEquivF a l _ (mergeN_eq m₁ l)).surjective r
    rcases x with b | i
    · rw [planar_inl]
      exact hdm b.1 fun e => hr (by rw [show b = ⟨j, haj.symm⟩ from Subtype.ext e])
    · rw [planar_inr]
      intro hmc
      exact hdm a haj (by rw [hc]; exact mem_labels_node.2 ⟨i, hmc⟩)
  · have ha₁ : κ ∈ (preKeys (update ch j (.leaf m) a)).tail := by
      rw [update_of_ne haj]
      exact ha
    rw [mergeT_child ht₁ hnd₁ ha₁, mergeT_child ht hnd ha, update_of_ne haj,
      update_comm (Ne.symm haj)]
    have hX := (mergeT_spec (ch a) κ (ht.child a) (nodup_of_node hnd a) ha).2.1
    rw [subst_update_child m₁ _ j m (ch j) fun b hb => by
      by_cases hba : b = a
      · subst hba
        rw [update_self, hX]
        exact hdm b hb
      · rw [update_of_ne hba]
        exact hdm b hb]
    rw [show ch j = update ch a (mergeT (ch a) κ) j from (update_of_ne (Ne.symm haj) _ _).symm,
      update_eq_self]

name: Operad.ShuffleBarSym.kzAt_cut
statement:
theorem kzAt_cut {k : ℕ} (m₁ : VMono G k) (ch : Fin k → STree (VMono G)) (j : Fin k)
    (ht : (STree.node m₁ ch).IsShuffle) (hnd : (STree.node m₁ ch).labels.Nodup)
    (hlast : ∀ a, j < a → (ch a).weight = 0) (m : ℕ) (hm : (ch j).first = m) {κ : ℕ ×ₗ ℕ}
    (hκ : κ ∈ (preKeys (STree.node m₁ (update ch j (.leaf m)))).tail) :
    kzAt K (STree.node m₁ (update ch j (.leaf m))) κ
        * σ K (vpar (fun _ _ => true) (ch j)
          && vaft (fun _ _ => true) (mergeT (STree.node m₁ (update ch j (.leaf m))) κ) m)
      = kzAt K (STree.node m₁ ch) κ
proof:
:= by
  have hmj : m ∈ (ch j).labels := hm ▸ first_mem (ht.child j)
  have ht₁ : (STree.node m₁ (update ch j (.leaf m))).IsShuffle :=
    isShuffle_update_child ht j (isShuffle_leaf m) (by rw [first_leaf, hm])
  have hnd₁ : (STree.node m₁ (update ch j (.leaf m))).labels.Nodup :=
    Multiset.nodup_of_le (labels_update_leaf_le m₁ ch j hmj) hnd
  have hdm : ∀ a, a ≠ j → m ∉ (ch a).labels := fun a ha => not_mem_of_node hnd (Ne.symm ha) hmj
  have hex := exists_mem_preKeys_of_cut hκ
  obtain ⟨a, haj, ha⟩ := hex
  have hw := weight_ne_zero_of_mem ha
  have haj' : a < j := by
    rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne haj with h | h
    · exact h
    · exact absurd (hlast a h) hw
  rw [preKeys_eq_cons hw, List.mem_cons] at ha
  rcases ha with rfl | ha
  · have hn := exists_node_of_weight_ne_zero hw
    obtain ⟨l, m₂, c₂, hc⟩ := hn
    have hc₁ : update ch j (.leaf m) a = .node m₂ c₂ := (update_of_ne haj _ _).trans hc
    have e1 := mergeT_root ht₁ hc₁
    have k1 := kzAt_root K ht₁ hc₁
    rw [update_of_ne haj] at e1 k1
    rw [e1, k1, kzAt_root K ht hc]
    have hQ := planar_update_left ch a c₂ (mergeN_eq m₁ l) j haj.symm (.leaf m)
    have hyQ : planar ch a c₂ (mergeN_eq m₁ l)
        (posEquivF a l _ (mergeN_eq m₁ l) (Sum.inl ⟨j, haj.symm⟩)) = ch j :=
      planar_inl ch a c₂ _ _
    have hdQ : ∀ r, r ≠ posEquivF a l _ (mergeN_eq m₁ l) (Sum.inl ⟨j, haj.symm⟩) →
        m ∉ (planar ch a c₂ (mergeN_eq m₁ l) r).labels := by
      intro r hr
      obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := (posEquivF a l _ (mergeN_eq m₁ l)).surjective r
      rcases x with b | i
      · rw [planar_inl]
        exact hdm b.1 fun e => hr (by rw [show b = ⟨j, haj.symm⟩ from Subtype.ext e])
      · rw [planar_inr]
        intro hmc
        exact hdm a haj (by rw [hc]; exact mem_labels_node.2 ⟨i, hmc⟩)
    have hπ : sortP (planar (update ch j (.leaf m)) a c₂ (mergeN_eq m₁ l))
        = sortP (planar ch a c₂ (mergeN_eq m₁ l)) := by
      rw [hQ]
      refine sortP_congr fun r => ?_
      by_cases hr : r = posEquivF a l _ (mergeN_eq m₁ l) (Sum.inl ⟨j, haj.symm⟩)
      · rw [hr, update_self, first_leaf, hyQ, hm]
      · rw [update_of_ne hr]
    have hRM := exists_rootMerge_eq hc₁ ht₁
    obtain ⟨M, -, hReq⟩ := hRM
    rw [hπ, hQ] at hReq
    rw [hReq, hπ, hQ]
    have hcv := kz_mul_σ_vaft K M (planar ch a c₂ (mergeN_eq m₁ l))
      (posEquivF a l _ (mergeN_eq m₁ l) (Sum.inl ⟨j, haj.symm⟩)) m hdQ
      (sortP (planar ch a c₂ (mergeN_eq m₁ l)))
    rw [prod_after_merged K ch a c₂ (mergeN_eq m₁ l) j haj.symm haj' hlast, mul_one, hyQ] at hcv
    have hKz := kz_mul_self K (fun r => preKeys (planar ch a c₂ (mergeN_eq m₁ l) r))
      (sortP (planar ch a c₂ (mergeN_eq m₁ l)))
    have hKz' := kz_mul_self K (fun r => preKeys (update (planar ch a c₂ (mergeN_eq m₁ l))
      (posEquivF a l _ (mergeN_eq m₁ l) (Sum.inl ⟨j, haj.symm⟩)) (.leaf m) r))
      (sortP (planar ch a c₂ (mergeN_eq m₁ l)))
    linear_combination kz K (fun r => preKeys (update (planar ch a c₂ (mergeN_eq m₁ l))
        (posEquivF a l _ (mergeN_eq m₁ l) (Sum.inl ⟨j, haj.symm⟩)) (.leaf m) r))
        (sortP (planar ch a c₂ (mergeN_eq m₁ l)))
        * (kz K (fun r => preKeys (planar ch a c₂ (mergeN_eq m₁ l) r))
          (sortP (planar ch a c₂ (mergeN_eq m₁ l))) * hcv
          - σ K (vpar (fun _ _ => true) (ch j) && vaft (fun _ _ => true) (STree.node M
            (update (planar ch a c₂ (mergeN_eq m₁ l))
              (posEquivF a l _ (mergeN_eq m₁ l) (Sum.inl ⟨j, haj.symm⟩)) (.leaf m)
            ∘ sortP (planar ch a c₂ (mergeN_eq m₁ l)))) m) * hKz)
      + kz K (fun r => preKeys (planar ch a c₂ (mergeN_eq m₁ l) r))
        (sortP (planar ch a c₂ (mergeN_eq m₁ l))) * hKz'
  · have ha₁ : κ ∈ (preKeys (update ch j (.leaf m) a)).tail := by
      rw [update_of_ne haj]
      exact ha
    rw [kzAt_of_mem_tail_child K ht₁ hnd₁ ha₁, kzAt_of_mem_tail_child K ht hnd ha,
      update_of_ne haj, mergeT_child ht₁ hnd₁ ha₁]
    have hX := (mergeT_spec (ch a) κ (ht.child a) (nodup_of_node hnd a) ha).2.1
    rw [σ_and_vaft_node_of_leaf K _ m₁ _ j m (by rw [update_of_ne (Ne.symm haj), update_self])
      fun b hb => by
        by_cases hba : b = a
        · subst hba
          rw [update_self, update_of_ne haj, hX]
          exact hdm b hb
        · rw [update_of_ne hba, update_of_ne hb]
          exact hdm b hb]
    rw [Finset.prod_eq_one fun b _ => ?_, mul_one]
    split_ifs with hb
    · have hba : b ≠ a := fun e => absurd (e ▸ hb) (not_lt.2 (le_of_lt haj'))
      rw [update_of_ne hba, update_of_ne (ne_of_gt hb),
        vpar_true_of_weight_eq_zero (hlast b hb), Bool.and_false, σ_false]
    · rfl

name: Operad.ShuffleBarSym.evM_eq
statement:
lemma evM_eq {t : STree (VMono G)} {κ : ℕ ×ₗ ℕ} (hκ : κ ∈ (preKeys t).tail) (ht : t.IsShuffle)
    (hnd : t.labels.Nodup) (Y : Finset ℕ) (h : t.labels = Y.val)
    (h' : (mergeT t κ).labels = Y.val) :
    evM c hc t κ Y h = FreeGrL.shEv (genBasis c hc) (mergeT t κ) Y h'
proof:
:= by
  unfold evM
  rw [dif_pos ⟨hκ, ht, hnd⟩]

name: Operad.ShuffleBarSym.d_unitL
statement:
lemma d_unitL (A : Type) [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] :
    Bar.d (Ibar K E c hc) A (FreeGrL.unitL K (BarGen (Ibar K E c hc)) A) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [FreeGrL.unitL, map_sum]
  refine Finset.sum_eq_zero fun e _ => ?_
  rw [Bar.d_map]
  have := Bar.d_one (I := Ibar K E c hc)
  erw [this, map_zero]

name: Operad.ShuffleBarSym.dProp_leaf
statement: lemma dProp_leaf (a : ℕ) : DProp c hc (.leaf a)
proof:
:= by
  intro Y h
  rw [FreeGrL.shEv_leaf, d_unitL]
  rfl

name: Operad.ShuffleBarSym.dProp_of_weight_one
statement: lemma dProp_of_weight_one {t : STree (VMono G)} (hw : t.weight = 1) : DProp c hc t
proof:
:= by
  intro Y h
  have hco := exists_corolla_of_weight_eq_one hw
  obtain ⟨l, m, ch, rfl, hl⟩ := hco
  have hcor := FreeGrL.exists_shEv_corolla (genBasis c hc) m ch Y h hl
  obtain ⟨θ, -, hev⟩ := hcor
  have htail : (preKeys (STree.node m ch)).tail = [] :=
    List.eq_nil_of_length_eq_zero (by rw [List.length_tail, length_preKeys, hw])
  rw [htail]
  exact (congrArg _ hev).trans (Bar.d_map_ι _ θ _)

name: Operad.ShuffleBarSym.dProp_step
statement:
theorem dProp_step {k : ℕ} (m₁ : VMono G k) (ch : Fin k → STree (VMono G)) (j : Fin k)
    (ht : (STree.node m₁ ch).IsShuffle) (hnd : (STree.node m₁ ch).labels.Nodup)
    (hlast : ∀ a, j < a → (ch a).weight = 0) (hj0 : (ch j).weight ≠ 0) (m : ℕ)
    (hm : (ch j).first = m) (ih₁ : DProp c hc (STree.node m₁ (update ch j (.leaf m))))
    (ih₂ : DProp c hc (ch j)) : DProp c hc (STree.node m₁ ch)
proof:
:= by
  intro Y h
  have hn := exists_node_of_weight_ne_zero hj0
  obtain ⟨l, m₂, c₂, hc₂⟩ := hn
  have hmj : m ∈ (ch j).labels := hm ▸ first_mem (ht.child j)
  have ht₁ : (STree.node m₁ (update ch j (.leaf m))).IsShuffle :=
    isShuffle_update_child ht j (isShuffle_leaf m) (by rw [first_leaf, hm])
  have hnd₁ : (STree.node m₁ (update ch j (.leaf m))).labels.Nodup :=
    Multiset.nodup_of_le (labels_update_leaf_le m₁ ch j hmj) hnd
  have hnd₂ : (ch j).labels.Nodup := nodup_of_node hnd j
  have hdm : ∀ a, a ≠ j → m ∉ (ch a).labels := fun a ha => not_mem_of_node hnd (Ne.symm ha) hmj
  have hm₁ : m ∈ (STree.node m₁ (update ch j (.leaf m))).labels :=
    mem_labels_node.2 ⟨j, by
      rw [update_self]
      exact Multiset.mem_singleton_self _⟩
  have hsub : (STree.node m₁ (update ch j (.leaf m))).subst (update STree.leaf m (ch j))
      = STree.node m₁ ch := by
    rw [subst_update_child m₁ ch j m (ch j) hdm, update_eq_self]
  have hY₁ := FreeGrL.labels_eq_toFinset hnd₁
  have hY₂ := FreeGrL.labels_eq_toFinset hnd₂
  have s : LabSplit Y (STree.node m₁ (update ch j (.leaf m))).labels.toFinset
      (ch j).labels.toFinset m := LabSplit.of_val (Multiset.mem_toFinset.2 hm₁) (by
    rw [← h, ← hY₁, ← hY₂, ← hsub]
    exact labels_subst_update_add _ _ hm₁ hnd₁)
  
  have hvaft : ∀ x, σ K (x && vaft (fun _ _ => true) (STree.node m₁ (update ch j (.leaf m))) m)
      = 1 := fun x => by
    rw [σ_and_vaft_node_of_leaf K _ m₁ _ j m (update_self _ _ _) fun a ha => by
      rw [update_of_ne ha]
      exact hdm a ha]
    refine Finset.prod_eq_one fun a _ => ?_
    split_ifs with ha
    · rw [update_of_ne (ne_of_gt ha), vpar_true_of_weight_eq_zero (hlast a ha), Bool.and_false,
        σ_false]
    · rfl
  
  have hsplit := ((compL_shEv (genBasis c hc) (par_genBasis c hc) s _ (ch j) hY₁ hY₂
    (by rw [hsub]; exact h)).trans ((congrArg (· • _) (hvaft _)).trans ((one_smul K _).trans
      (shEv_congr c hc hsub Y _ h)))).symm
  have hd := (congrArg (Bar.d (Ibar K E c hc) (Lab Y)) hsplit).trans (d_compL s _ _)
  have hL : (preKeys (STree.node m₁ ch)).tail
      = (preKeys (STree.node m₁ (update ch j (.leaf m)))).tail
        ++ vkey (ch j) :: (preKeys (ch j)).tail := by
    rw [tail_preKeys_cut m₁ ch j hlast m]
    exact congrArg _ (preKeys_eq_cons hj0)
  have hw₁ : 1 ≤ (STree.node m₁ (update ch j (.leaf m))).weight := by
    rw [weight_node]
    omega
  have hlen : (preKeys (STree.node m₁ (update ch j (.leaf m)))).tail.length + 1
      = (STree.node m₁ (update ch j (.leaf m))).weight := by
    rw [List.length_tail, length_preKeys]
    omega
  
  have hA : compL K s (Bar.d (Ibar K E c hc) _ (FreeGrL.shEv (genBasis c hc)
      (STree.node m₁ (update ch j (.leaf m))) _ hY₁)) (FreeGrL.shEv (genBasis c hc) (ch j) _ hY₂)
      = ((preKeys (STree.node m₁ (update ch j (.leaf m)))).tail.mapIdx fun i κ =>
          ((-1 : K) ^ i * kzAt K (STree.node m₁ ch) κ)
            • evM c hc (STree.node m₁ ch) κ Y h).sum := by
    refine (congrArg (fun X => compL K s X (FreeGrL.shEv (genBasis c hc) (ch j) _ hY₂))
      (ih₁ _ hY₁)).trans ?_
    refine (map_sum_mapIdx ((compL K s).flip
      (FreeGrL.shEv (genBasis c hc) (ch j) _ hY₂)).toAddMonoidHom _ _).trans ?_
    refine sum_mapIdx_congr _ fun i κ hκ => ?_
    have hκt : κ ∈ (preKeys (STree.node m₁ ch)).tail := by
      rw [hL]
      exact List.mem_append_left _ hκ
    have hs₁ := (mergeT_spec _ κ ht₁ hnd₁ hκ).2.1
    have hst := (mergeT_spec _ κ ht hnd hκt).2.1
    have hcut := mergeT_cut_subst m₁ ch j ht hnd m hm hκ
    have e₁ := evM_eq c hc hκ ht₁ hnd₁ _ hY₁ (hs₁.trans hY₁)
    have e₂ := evM_eq c hc hκt ht hnd Y h (hst.trans h)
    have hcs := compL_shEv (genBasis c hc) (par_genBasis c hc) s
      (mergeT (STree.node m₁ (update ch j (.leaf m))) κ) (ch j) (hs₁.trans hY₁) hY₂
      (by rw [hcut]; exact hst.trans h)
    have hk := kzAt_cut K m₁ ch j ht hnd hlast m hm hκ
    show compL K s (((-1 : K) ^ i * kzAt K _ κ) • evM c hc _ κ _ hY₁)
      (FreeGrL.shEv (genBasis c hc) (ch j) _ hY₂) = _
    refine (LinearMap.map_smul₂ _ _ _ _).trans ?_
    refine (congrArg (fun X => ((-1 : K) ^ i * kzAt K (STree.node m₁ (update ch j (.leaf m))) κ)
      • compL K s X (FreeGrL.shEv (genBasis c hc) (ch j) _ hY₂)) e₁).trans ?_
    refine (congrArg (fun X => ((-1 : K) ^ i
      * kzAt K (STree.node m₁ (update ch j (.leaf m))) κ) • X) hcs).trans ?_
    refine (smul_smul _ _ _).trans ?_
    refine (congrArg₂ (· • ·) ?_ (shEv_congr c hc hcut Y _ (hst.trans h))).trans
      (congrArg _ e₂.symm)
    rw [mul_assoc, hk]
  
  have hB : compL K s (GrOperad.tw (R := K) true (FreeGrL.shEv (genBasis c hc)
      (STree.node m₁ (update ch j (.leaf m))) _ hY₁))
      (Bar.d (Ibar K E c hc) _ (FreeGrL.shEv (genBasis c hc) (ch j) _ hY₂))
      = ((preKeys (ch j)).tail.mapIdx fun i κ =>
          ((-1 : K) ^ (i + (preKeys (STree.node m₁ (update ch j (.leaf m)))).tail.length + 1)
            * kzAt K (STree.node m₁ ch) κ) • evM c hc (STree.node m₁ ch) κ Y h).sum := by
    have htw := GrOperad.tw_hom (R := K) true
      (FreeGrL.par_shEv (genBasis c hc) (par_genBasis c hc) _ _ hY₁)
    refine (congrArg₂ (fun X Z => compL K s X Z) htw (ih₂ _ hY₂)).trans ?_
    refine (LinearMap.map_smul₂ _ _ _ _).trans ?_
    refine (congrArg (fun X => σ K (true && vpar (fun _ _ => true)
      (STree.node m₁ (update ch j (.leaf m)))) • X) (map_sum_mapIdx (compL K s
        (FreeGrL.shEv (genBasis c hc) (STree.node m₁ (update ch j (.leaf m))) _ hY₁)).toAddMonoidHom
          _ _)).trans ?_
    refine (map_sum_mapIdx (DistribSMul.toAddMonoidHom _ (σ K (true && vpar (fun _ _ => true)
      (STree.node m₁ (update ch j (.leaf m)))))) _ _).trans ?_
    refine sum_mapIdx_congr _ fun i κ hκ => ?_
    have hκt : κ ∈ (preKeys (STree.node m₁ ch)).tail := by
      rw [hL]
      exact List.mem_append_right _ (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hκ)
    have hs₂ := (mergeT_spec _ κ (ht.child j) hnd₂ hκ).2.1
    have hst := (mergeT_spec _ κ ht hnd hκt).2.1
    have hchild : (STree.node m₁ (update ch j (.leaf m))).subst
        (update STree.leaf m (mergeT (ch j) κ)) = mergeT (STree.node m₁ ch) κ := by
      rw [subst_update_child m₁ ch j m _ hdm, mergeT_child ht hnd hκ]
    have e₁ := evM_eq c hc hκ (ht.child j) hnd₂ _ hY₂ (hs₂.trans hY₂)
    have e₂ := evM_eq c hc hκt ht hnd Y h (hst.trans h)
    have hcs := compL_shEv (genBasis c hc) (par_genBasis c hc) s _ (mergeT (ch j) κ) hY₁
      (hs₂.trans hY₂) (by rw [hchild]; exact hst.trans h)
    have hk := kzAt_of_mem_tail_child K ht hnd hκ
    show σ K _ • compL K s _ (((-1 : K) ^ i * kzAt K (ch j) κ) • evM c hc (ch j) κ _ hY₂) = _
    refine (congrArg (fun X => σ K (true && vpar (fun _ _ => true)
      (STree.node m₁ (update ch j (.leaf m)))) • X) ((LinearMap.map_smul _ _ _).trans
        (congrArg (fun X => ((-1 : K) ^ i * kzAt K (ch j) κ) • X)
          ((congrArg (compL K s _) e₁).trans (hcs.trans ((congrArg (· • _) (hvaft _)).trans
            ((one_smul K _).trans (shEv_congr c hc hchild Y _ (hst.trans h))))))))).trans ?_
    refine (smul_smul _ _ _).trans ((congrArg (· • _) ?_).trans (congrArg _ e₂.symm))
    rw [hk, Bool.true_and, vpar_true, σ_bodd, ← hlen, pow_add, pow_add]
    ring
  
  have hC : mcL s (FreeGrL.shEv (genBasis c hc) (STree.node m₁ (update ch j (.leaf m))) _ hY₁)
      (FreeGrL.shEv (genBasis c hc) (ch j) _ hY₂)
      = ((-1 : K) ^ (preKeys (STree.node m₁ (update ch j (.leaf m)))).tail.length
          * kzAt K (STree.node m₁ ch) (vkey (ch j)))
        • evM c hc (STree.node m₁ ch) (vkey (ch j)) Y h := by
    have hκ₀ : vkey (ch j) ∈ (preKeys (STree.node m₁ ch)).tail := by
      rw [hL]
      exact List.mem_append_right _ List.mem_cons_self
    have hroot := mergeT_root ht hc₂
    have hR : (rootMerge m₁ ch j m₂ c₂).labels = Y.val := by
      rw [← hroot]
      exact (mergeT_spec _ _ ht hnd hκ₀).2.1.trans h
    have hrm := rmProp c hc _ m₁ ch j m₂ c₂ le_rfl hc₂ ht hnd hlast _ _ _ m s _ _ _
      (hm.symm.trans (by rw [hc₂])) rfl hc₂ rfl hY₁ hY₂ hR
    have hR' : (mergeT (STree.node m₁ ch) (vkey (ch j))).labels = Y.val := by
      rw [hroot]
      exact hR
    refine hrm.trans (congrArg₂ (· • ·) ?_ ((shEv_congr c hc hroot.symm Y hR hR').trans
      (evM_eq c hc hκ₀ ht hnd Y h hR').symm))
    have e0 := weight_update_child m₁ ch j (.leaf 0)
    have em := weight_update_child m₁ ch j (.leaf m)
    rw [weight_leaf, add_zero] at e0 em
    rw [kzAt_root K ht hc₂]
    unfold rmCoeff
    rw [List.length_tail, length_preKeys]
    congr 2
    omega
  refine hd.trans ((congrArg₂ (· + ·) (congrArg₂ (· + ·) hA hB) hC).trans
    ((add_right_comm _ _ _).trans ?_))
  refine Eq.trans ?_ (congrArg (fun L => (L.mapIdx fun i κ =>
    ((-1 : K) ^ i * kzAt K (STree.node m₁ ch) κ) • evM c hc (STree.node m₁ ch) κ Y h).sum) hL).symm
  exact (sum_mapIdx_append_cons _ _ _ _).symm

name: Operad.ShuffleBarSym.dProp_all
statement:
theorem dProp_all : ∀ (n : ℕ) (t : STree (VMono G)), t.weight ≤ n → t.IsShuffle →
    t.labels.Nodup → DProp c hc t
  | _, .leaf a, _, _, _ => dProp_leaf c hc a
  | 0, .node _ _, hw, _, _ => by
    simp only [weight_node] at hw
    omega
  | n + 1, .node m₁ ch, hw, ht, hnd => by
    by_cases hA : ∃ a, (ch a).weight ≠ 0
    · have hS : (Finset.univ.filter fun a => (ch a).weight ≠ 0).Nonempty
proof:
:= by
        obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := hA
        exact ⟨a, Finset.mem_filter.2 ⟨Finset.mem_univ _, ha⟩⟩
      have hex : ∃ j, (ch j).weight ≠ 0 ∧ ∀ a, (ch a).weight ≠ 0 → a ≤ j :=
        ⟨(Finset.univ.filter fun a => (ch a).weight ≠ 0).max' hS,
          (Finset.mem_filter.1 (Finset.max'_mem _ hS)).2, fun a ha =>
            Finset.le_max' _ a (Finset.mem_filter.2 ⟨Finset.mem_univ _, ha⟩)⟩
      obtain ⟨j, hj0, hle⟩ := hex
      have hlast : ∀ a, j < a → (ch a).weight = 0 := fun a ha => by
        by_contra hne
        exact absurd (hle a hne) (not_le.2 ha)
      have hw' := weight_update_child m₁ ch j (.leaf (ch j).first)
      rw [weight_leaf, add_zero] at hw'
      have hwj : (ch j).weight ≤ ∑ a, (ch a).weight :=
        Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun a => (ch a).weight) (fun _ _ => Nat.zero_le _)
          (Finset.mem_univ j)
      have hwn : (STree.node m₁ ch).weight = 1 + ∑ a, (ch a).weight := weight_node _ _
      refine dProp_step c hc m₁ ch j ht hnd hlast hj0 _ rfl
        (dProp_all n _ (by omega)
          (isShuffle_update_child ht j (isShuffle_leaf _) rfl)
          (Multiset.nodup_of_le (labels_update_leaf_le m₁ ch j (first_mem (ht.child j))) hnd))
        (dProp_all n (ch j) (by omega) (ht.child j) (nodup_of_node hnd j))
    · push Not at hA
      refine dProp_of_weight_one c hc ?_
      rw [weight_node, Finset.sum_eq_zero fun a _ => hA a, Nat.add_zero]

name: Operad.ShuffleBarSym.dExpansion
statement: theorem dExpansion {n : ℕ} (t : SMono (VMono G) (Finset.range n)) : DExpansion c hc t
proof:
:= by
  unfold DExpansion
  have hnd := nodup_smono t
  have h : t.1.labels = (Finset.range (Fintype.card (Fin n))).val := by
    rw [Fintype.card_fin]
    exact t.2.2
  have hdp := dProp_all c hc _ t.1 le_rfl t.2.1 hnd _ h
  refine ((congrArg (Bar.d _ _) (barBasisN_eq_shEv c hc n t h)).trans (Bar.d_map _ _)).trans ?_
  refine (congrArg _ hdp).trans ?_
  refine (map_sum_mapIdx (GrOperad.map (R := K) (P := FreeGrL K (BarGen (Ibar K E c hc)))
    (FreeGrL.posEquiv (Fin n)).symm).toAddMonoidHom
    _ _).trans ?_
  refine (sum_mapIdx_eq_sum_toFinset _ (nodup_tail_preKeys t.2.1 hnd) _).trans ?_
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun κ hκ => ?_
  rw [List.mem_toFinset] at hκ
  have hs := (mergeT_spec t.1 κ t.2.1 hnd hκ).2.1
  have hS : (mergeS t κ).1.labels = (Finset.range (Fintype.card (Fin n))).val := by
    rw [mergeS_val t hκ, hs]
    exact h
  show GrOperad.map (R := K) (P := FreeGrL K (BarGen (Ibar K E c hc)))
    (FreeGrL.posEquiv (Fin n)).symm (_ • evM c hc t.1 κ _ h) = _
  refine (map_smul _ _ _).trans (congrArg (fun X => ((-1 : K) ^ (preKeys t.1).tail.idxOf κ
    * kzAt K t.1 κ) • X) ((congrArg (GrOperad.map (R := K) (FreeGrL.posEquiv (Fin n)).symm)
      ((evM_eq c hc hκ t.2.1 hnd _ h (hs.trans h)).trans
        (shEv_congr c hc (mergeS_val t hκ).symm _ _ hS))).trans
      (barBasisN_eq_shEv c hc n (mergeS t κ) hS).symm))

name: Operad.ShuffleBarSym.ΦL_d
statement:
theorem ΦL_d {n : ℕ} (x : BarCoop (Ibar K E c hc) (Fin n)) :
    ΦL c hc n (Bar.d (Ibar K E c hc) (Fin n) x) = ShuffleBar.d K (ΦL c hc n x)
proof:
:=
  ΦL_d_of_expansion c hc (fun t => dExpansion c hc t) x

name: Operad.Presentation.proj_app
statement:
@[simp] lemma proj_app (p : Presentation R E) (n : ℕ) (x : Free R E n) :
    p.proj.app n x = p.ideal.proj n x
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.Presentation.gen_def
statement:
lemma gen_def (p : Presentation R E) {k : ℕ} (e : E k) :
    p.gen e = p.ideal.proj k (genOf (R := R) e)
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.Presentation.rel_eq_zero
statement:
theorem rel_eq_zero (p : Presentation R E) {n : ℕ} {x : Free R E n} (hx : x ∈ p.rel n) :
    p.ideal.proj n x = 0
proof:
:=
  (Submodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero _).2 (subset_generated _ hx)

name: Operad.Presentation.lift_proj
statement:
lemma lift_proj {p : Presentation R E} (ρ : p.Rep Q) (n : ℕ) (x : Free R E n) :
    (lift ρ).app n (p.ideal.proj n x) = ρ.free.app n x
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.Presentation.lift_mk
statement:
@[simp] lemma lift_mk {p : Presentation R E} (ρ : p.Rep Q) (n : ℕ) (x : Free R E n) :
    (lift ρ).app n (Submodule.Quotient.mk x) = ρ.free.app n x
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.Presentation.lift_gen
statement:
@[simp] theorem lift_gen {p : Presentation R E} (ρ : p.Rep Q) {k : ℕ} (e : E k) :
    (lift ρ).app k (p.gen e) = ρ.toFun k e
proof:
:= by
  show (lift ρ).app k (p.ideal.proj k (genOf e)) = ρ.toFun k e
  rw [lift_proj]
  show (extendHom (R := R) ρ.toFun).app k (genOf e) = ρ.toFun k e
  rw [genOf_def, extendHom_corolla]

name: Operad.Presentation.hom_ext
statement:
theorem hom_ext {p : Presentation R E} (φ ψ : NSOperadHom R p.Op Q)
    (h : ∀ (k : ℕ) (e : E k), φ.app k (p.gen e) = ψ.app k (p.gen e)) :
    φ = ψ
proof:
:= by
  have key : ∀ σ : NSOperadHom R p.Op Q,
      (∀ (k : ℕ) (e : E k), σ.app k (p.gen e) = ψ.app k (p.gen e)) →
      σ.comp p.proj = extendHom (R := R) (fun k (e : E k) => ψ.app k (p.gen e)) := by
    intro σ hσ
    refine extendHom_unique _ _ fun k e => ?_
    rw [NSOperadHom.comp_app]
    exact hσ k e
  have h1 := key φ h
  have h2 := key ψ (fun _ _ => rfl)
  refine NSOperadHom.ext fun n => ?_
  refine LinearMap.ext fun x => ?_
  obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := p.ideal.proj_surjective n x
  have e1 : φ.app n (p.ideal.proj n y)
      = (extendHom (R := R) (fun k (e : E k) => ψ.app k (p.gen e))).app n y := by
    have := congrArg (fun σ => σ.app n y) h1
    simpa using this
  have e2 : ψ.app n (p.ideal.proj n y)
      = (extendHom (R := R) (fun k (e : E k) => ψ.app k (p.gen e))).app n y := by
    have := congrArg (fun σ => σ.app n y) h2
    simpa using this
  rw [e1, e2]

name: Operad.Presentation.lift_unique
statement:
theorem lift_unique {p : Presentation R E} (ρ : p.Rep Q) (φ : NSOperadHom R p.Op Q)
    (hφ : ∀ (k : ℕ) (e : E k), φ.app k (p.gen e) = ρ.toFun k e) :
    φ = lift ρ
proof:
:=
  hom_ext φ (lift ρ) fun k e => by rw [hφ k e, lift_gen]

name: Operad.assPresToAssOfRep_eq
statement:
theorem assPresToAssOfRep_eq (R : Type u) [CommRing R] :
    assPresToAssOfRep R = assPresToAss R
proof:
:= by
  refine Presentation.hom_ext (p := assPresentation R) _ _ fun k e => ?_
  have hL : (assPresToAssOfRep R).app k ((assPresentation R).gen e) = magToAss R k e := by
    show (Presentation.lift (p := assPresentation R) (assRep R)).app k
      ((assPresentation R).gen e) = _
    rw [Presentation.lift_gen]
    rfl
  have hR : (assPresToAss R).app k ((assPresentation R).gen e) = magToAss R k e := by
    show (assPresToAss R).app k ((generated (R := R) (assocRels R)).proj k (genOf e)) = _
    rw [assPresToAss, OperadIdeal.liftHom_proj]
    show (extendHom (R := R) (magToAss R)).app k (genOf e) = _
    rw [genOf_def, extendHom_corolla]
  exact hL.trans hR.symm

name: Operad.STree.mem_cutKeys_iff
statement:
theorem mem_cutKeys_iff : ∀ {t : STree (BE E)} {y : ℕ ×ₗ ℕ}, y ∈ cutKeys t ↔
    ∃ q, ∃ k, ∃ (d : BE E k) (c : Fin k → STree (BE E)), t.get? q = some (node d c) ∧
      d.2 = true ∧ y = key (node d c)
  | leaf _, y => by
    simp only [cutKeys, Finset.notMem_empty, false_iff]
    rintro ⟨q, k, d, c, hq, -, -⟩
    rcases q with _ | ⟨i, q⟩
    · simp at hq
    · simp at hq
  | @node _ k d c, y => by
    rw [mem_cutKeys_node]
    constructor
    · rintro (⟨hd, rfl⟩ | ⟨i, hi⟩)
      · exact ⟨[], k, d, c, rfl, hd, rfl⟩
      · obtain ⟨q, k', d', c', hq, hd', rfl⟩
proof:
:= mem_cutKeys_iff.1 hi
        refine ⟨i :: q, k', d', c', ?_, hd', rfl⟩
        rw [get?_node_cons, dif_pos i.2]
        exact hq
    · rintro ⟨q, k', d', c', hq, hd', rfl⟩
      rcases q with _ | ⟨i, q⟩
      · rw [get?_nil, Option.some_inj] at hq
        cases hq
        exact Or.inl ⟨hd', rfl⟩
      · obtain ⟨hi, hq⟩ := get?_node_cons_eq_some.1 hq
        exact Or.inr ⟨⟨i, hi⟩, mem_cutKeys_iff.2 ⟨q, k', d', c', hq, hd', rfl⟩⟩

name: Operad.STree.weight_le_of_mem_vkeys
statement:
lemma weight_le_of_mem_vkeys : ∀ {t : STree E} {x : ℕ ×ₗ ℕ}, x ∈ t.vkeys →
    (ofLex x).2 ≤ t.weight
  | leaf _, _, hx => absurd hx (Multiset.notMem_zero _)
  | node e c, x, hx => by
    rcases mem_vkeys_node.1 hx with rfl | ⟨i, hi⟩
    · exact le_rfl
    · exact (weight_le_of_mem_vkeys hi).trans (weight_lt_node e c i).le

name: Operad.STree.eq_allF_of_cutKeys
statement:
theorem eq_allF_of_cutKeys : ∀ {t : STree (BE E)}, cutKeys t = ∅ → t = allF (forget t)
  | leaf _, _ => rfl
  | node d c, h => by
    have hd : d.2 = false
proof:
:= by
      cases hd : d.2
      · rfl
      · have : key (node d c) ∈ cutKeys (node d c) := mem_cutKeys_node.2 (Or.inl ⟨hd, rfl⟩)
        rw [h] at this
        exact absurd this (Finset.notMem_empty _)
    rw [forget_node, allF_node]
    obtain ⟨d₁, d₂⟩ := d
    simp only at hd
    subst hd
    congr 1
    funext i
    refine eq_allF_of_cutKeys (Finset.eq_empty_of_forall_notMem fun y hy => ?_)
    have : y ∈ cutKeys (node (d₁, false) c) := mem_cutKeys_node.2 (Or.inr ⟨i, hy⟩)
    rw [h] at this
    exact absurd this (Finset.notMem_empty _)

name: Operad.STree.allF_eq_fl_false
statement: lemma allF_eq_fl_false (t : STree E) : allF t = fl false t
proof:
:= by
  cases t <;> rfl

name: Operad.STree.eq_fl_of_cutKeys
statement:
theorem eq_fl_of_cutKeys {t : STree (BE E)} (h : ∀ y ∈ cutKeys t, y = key t) :
    t = fl (rootF t) (forget t)
proof:
:= by
  cases t with
  | leaf a => rfl
  | node d c =>
    rw [forget_node, fl_node]
    obtain ⟨d₁, d₂⟩ := d
    congr 1
    funext i
    refine eq_allF_of_cutKeys (Finset.eq_empty_of_forall_notMem fun y hy => ?_)
    have hy' := h y (mem_cutKeys_node.2 (Or.inr ⟨i, hy⟩))
    have hw := weight_le_of_mem_vkeys (mem_vkeys_of_mem_cutKeys hy)
    rw [hy', key, ofLex_toLex] at hw
    exact absurd (weight_lt_node (d₁, d₂) c i) (not_lt.2 hw)

name: Operad.STree.fl_subst
statement:
lemma fl_subst (b : Bool) {t : STree E} (ht : ∀ a, t ≠ leaf a) (xs : ℕ → STree E) :
    fl b (t.subst xs) = (fl b t).subst fun a => allF (xs a)
proof:
:= by
  cases t with
  | leaf a => exact absurd rfl (ht a)
  | node e c =>
    rw [subst_node, fl_node, fl_node, subst_node]
    congr 1
    funext i
    exact allF_subst (c i) xs

name: Operad.STree.fl_replace
statement:
lemma fl_replace (b : Bool) : ∀ (t : STree E) {p : List ℕ}, p ≠ [] → ∀ u : STree E,
    fl b (t.replace p u) = (fl b t).replace p (allF u)
  | _, [], h, _ => absurd rfl h
  | leaf _, _ :: _, _, _ => rfl
  | node e c, i :: p, _, u => by
    rw [replace_node_cons, fl_node, fl_node, replace_node_cons]
    congr 1
    funext j
    split_ifs
    · exact allF_replace (c j) p u
    · rfl

name: Operad.STree.get?_fl
statement:
lemma get?_fl (b : Bool) : ∀ (t : STree E) {p : List ℕ}, p ≠ [] →
    (fl b t).get? p = (t.get? p).map allF
  | _, [], h => absurd rfl h
  | leaf _, _ :: _, _ => rfl
  | @node _ k e c, i :: p, _ => by
    rw [fl_node, get?_node_cons, get?_node_cons]
    split_ifs with h
    · exact get?_mapG _ (c ⟨i, h⟩) p
    · rfl

                          

variable {A B C : Finset ℕ}

name: Operad.STree.lift_ctx
statement:
theorem lift_ctx {g : SMono E C → SMono E B} (hg : IsSCtx g) (L : SMono E C)
    (hL : ∀ a, L.1 ≠ leaf a) (b : Bool) :
    ∃ (g' : SMono (BE E) C → SMono (BE E) B) (b' : Bool), IsSCtx g' ∧
      ∀ h : SMono E C, h.1.weight = L.1.weight → flM b (g h) = g' (flM b' h)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨p, xs, hget, hin, hrep⟩ := IsSCtx.normal hg L
  have hmono : StrictMonoOn (fun a => (allF (xs a)).first) (C : Set ℕ) :=
    fun a ha a' ha' h => by simpa only [first_allF] using hin.mono ha ha' h
  have hnl : ∀ h : SMono E C, h.1.weight = L.1.weight → ∀ a, h.1 ≠ leaf a :=
    fun h hw => not_leaf_of_weight hw hL
  by_cases hp : p = []
  · subst hp
    have hgL : (g L).1 = L.1.subst xs := by
      rw [get?_nil, Option.some_inj] at hget
      exact hget
    have hget' : (flM b (g L)).1.get? [] = some ((flM b L).1.subst fun a => allF (xs a)) := by
      rw [get?_nil, flM_val, hgL, fl_subst b hL]
      rfl
    refine ⟨ctxOf (flM b (g L)) [] (flM b L) _ hget' hmono, b, isSCtx_ctxOf _ _ _ _ _ _,
      fun h hw => Subtype.ext ?_⟩
    rw [ctxOf_val, replace_nil, flM_val, hrep, replace_nil, fl_subst b (hnl h hw)]
    rfl
  · have hget' : (flM b (g L)).1.get? p = some ((flM false L).1.subst fun a => allF (xs a)) := by
      rw [flM_val, get?_fl b _ hp, hget, Option.map_some, allF_subst, allF_eq_fl_false]
      rfl
    refine ⟨ctxOf (flM b (g L)) p (flM false L) _ hget' hmono, false, isSCtx_ctxOf _ _ _ _ _ _,
      fun h hw => Subtype.ext ?_⟩
    rw [ctxOf_val, flM_val, hrep, fl_replace b _ hp, allF_subst, allF_eq_fl_false, flM_val,
      flM_val]

name: Operad.STree.get?_eq_of_replace_eq
statement:
lemma get?_eq_of_replace_eq {T u : STree (BE E)} {p : List ℕ} (h : T = T.replace p u)
    (hp : (T.get? p).isSome) : T.get? p = some u
proof:
:= by
  conv_lhs => rw [h]
  exact get?_replace hp u

name: Operad.STree.isSome_of_append
statement:
lemma isSome_of_append {T : STree (BE E)} {p q : List ℕ} (h : (T.get? (p ++ q)).isSome) :
    (T.get? p).isSome
proof:
:= by
  rw [get?_append] at h
  cases hp : T.get? p with
  | none => rw [hp] at h; simp at h
  | some _ => rfl

name: Operad.STree.rootF_get?_window
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨k, d, c, hq⟩ := hq
  rw [get?_fl b ℓ hq0] at hq
  obtain ⟨u, hu, hu'⟩ := Option.map_eq_some_iff.1 hq
  rw [get?_append_of hT, get?_subst (get?_fl b ℓ hq0 ▸ Option.map_eq_some_iff.2 ⟨u, hu, hu'⟩) xs,
    Option.some_inj] at hZ
  subst hZ
  cases u with
  | leaf a => cases hu'
  | node e c' =>
    rw [allF_node] at hu'
    cases hu'
    rfl

name: Operad.STree.rootF_eq_false_aux
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hqp : q = p
  · subst hqp
    rcases hcov (nil_mem_vert hT) with ⟨x, -, hx⟩ | ⟨x, -, hx⟩
    · exact absurd (List.append_eq_nil_iff.1 hx).1 hq0
    · have hp' : p' = [] := (List.append_eq_nil_iff.1 hx).1
      subst hp'
      obtain ⟨z, ⟨z₁, hz₁, rfl⟩, ⟨z₂, hz₂, hz⟩⟩ := hov
      simp only [List.nil_append] at hz
      have hqv : q ∈ vert ℓ' := by
        by_cases hqz : q = z₂
        · rw [hqz]
          exact hz₂
        · exact vert_of_prefix hz₂ ⟨z₁, hz.symm⟩ hqz
      exact hW' q ⟨q, hqv, rfl⟩ hq0 Z hZ
  · exact hW q hq hqp Z hZ

name: Operad.Rules.critical_cuts
statement:
theorem Rules.critical_cuts {C : Finset ℕ} {r₁ r₂ : ρ × Bool} (B : G.bar.Amb C r₁ r₂)
    (hB : Critical G.bar B) : ∀ y ∈ cutKeys B.top.1, y = key B.top.1
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨p₁, p₂, xs₁, xs₂, h₁, h₂, hcov, hov⟩ := hB
  set T := B.top.1 with hT
  have e₁ : T = T.replace p₁ ((G.bar.lead r₁).1.subst xs₁) := h₁ (G.bar.lead r₁)
  have e₂ : T = T.replace p₂ ((G.bar.lead r₂).1.subst xs₂) := by
    rw [← h₂ (G.bar.lead r₂), ← B.eq]
    rfl
  have W : ∀ {p : List ℕ} {r : ρ × Bool} {xs : ℕ → STree (BE E)},
      T = T.replace p ((G.bar.lead r).1.subst xs) → ∀ z ∈ occVert p (G.bar.lead r).1, z ≠ p →
        ∀ Z, T.get? z = some Z → rootF Z = false := by
    rintro p r xs e z ⟨q, hq, rfl⟩ hne Z hZ
    have hq0 : q ≠ [] := fun h => hne (by simp only [h, List.append_nil])
    have hp : T.get? p = some ((G.bar.lead r).1.subst xs) :=
      get?_eq_of_replace_eq e (isSome_of_append (q := q) (by rw [hZ]; rfl))
    exact rootF_get?_window hp hq hq0 hZ
  intro y hy
  obtain ⟨q, k, d, c, hq, hd, rfl⟩ := mem_cutKeys_iff.1 hy
  by_cases hq0 : q = []
  · subst hq0
    rw [get?_nil, Option.some_inj] at hq
    rw [hq]
  · exfalso
    have hTl : ∀ a, T ≠ leaf a := fun a h => by
      rw [h] at hq
      rcases q with _ | ⟨i, q⟩
      · exact hq0 rfl
      · simp at hq
    have hflag : rootF (node d c) = true := hd
    rcases hcov ⟨k, d, c, hq⟩ with hq1 | hq2
    · rw [rootF_eq_false_aux (W e₁) (W e₂) hcov hov hTl hq1 hq0 hq] at hflag
      exact Bool.false_ne_true hflag
    · rw [rootF_eq_false_aux (W e₂) (W e₁) (by rwa [Set.union_comm]) (by rwa [Set.inter_comm])
        hTl hq2 hq0 hq] at hflag
      exact Bool.false_ne_true hflag

name: Operad.occ_flag
statement:
theorem occ_flag {A C : Finset ℕ} {f : SMono (BE E) C → SMono (BE E) A} (hf : IsSCtx f)
    (b : Bool) {f₀ : SMono E C → SMono E A} (he : ∀ X, forgetM (f X) = f₀ (forgetM X))
    (L : SMono E C) (hL : ∀ a, L.1 ≠ leaf a)
    (hcut : ∀ y ∈ cutKeys (f (flM b L)).1, y = key (f (flM b L)).1) (m : SMono E C)
    (hm : m.1.weight = L.1.weight) :
    f (flM b m) = flM (rootF (f (flM b L)).1) (f₀ m)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨fk, b', -, H⟩ := exists_merge_ctx hf L hL b
  obtain ⟨hc, hr, hw, -⟩ := H m hm
  have hk : key (f (flM b m)).1 = key (f (flM b L)).1 := by
    rw [key, key, (f (flM b m)).first_eq (f (flM b L)), hw]
  have h1 := eq_fl_of_cutKeys (t := (f (flM b m)).1) fun y hy => by
    rw [hk]
    exact hcut y (by rw [← cuts, hc] at hy; exact hy)
  have h2 : forget (f (flM b m)).1 = (f₀ m).1 := by rw [← forgetM_val, he, forgetM_flM]
  apply Subtype.ext
  rw [flM_val, ← hr, ← h2]
  exact h1

name: Operad.Rules.flM_mem_idealOn
statement:
theorem Rules.flM_mem_idealOn {C : Finset ℕ} {T : SMono (BE E) C} (b : Bool)
    {v : SMono E C →₀ K} (hv : v ∈ (G.rw C).idealOn ((G.rw C).below (forgetM T))) :
    Finsupp.mapDomain (flM b) v ∈ (G.bar.rw C).idealOn ((G.bar.rw C).below T)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction hv using Submodule.span_induction with
  | mem x hx =>
    obtain ⟨m, hm, u, ⟨r, g, hg, rfl, rfl⟩, rfl⟩ := hx
    obtain ⟨g', b', hg', H⟩ := lift_ctx hg (G.lead r) (hlead r) b
    have h1 : flM b (g (G.lead r)) = g' (G.bar.lead (r, b')) := H _ rfl
    have h2 : Finsupp.mapDomain (flM b) (Finsupp.mapDomain g (G.tail r)) =
        Finsupp.mapDomain g' (G.bar.tail (r, b')) := by
      rw [← Finsupp.mapDomain_comp]
      show _ = Finsupp.mapDomain g' (Finsupp.mapDomain (flM b') (G.tail r))
      rw [← Finsupp.mapDomain_comp]
      exact Finsupp.mapDomain_congr fun m hm => H m (hom r m hm)
    rw [Finsupp.mapDomain_sub (f := flM b), Finsupp.mapDomain_single, h1, h2]
    refine (G.bar.rw C).sub_mem_idealOn ?_ ⟨(r, b'), g', hg', rfl, rfl⟩
    show O.lt (forgetM (g' (G.bar.lead (r, b')))) (forgetM T)
    rw [← h1, forgetM_flM]
    exact hm
  | zero => rw [Finsupp.mapDomain_zero]; exact Submodule.zero_mem _
  | add x y _ _ hx hy => rw [Finsupp.mapDomain_add]; exact Submodule.add_mem _ hx hy
  | smul a x _ hx => rw [Finsupp.mapDomain_smul]; exact Submodule.smul_mem _ _ hx

name: Operad.Rules.bar_crit_res
statement:
theorem Rules.bar_crit_res (hres : ∀ C, (G.rw C).Resolvable) {C : Finset ℕ} {r₁ r₂ : ρ × Bool}
    (B : G.bar.Amb C r₁ r₂) (hB : Critical G.bar B) : B.Res
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hcut := G.critical_cuts B hB
  obtain ⟨f₁, hf₁, he₁⟩ := IsSCtx.forget B.ctx₁
  obtain ⟨f₂, hf₂, he₂⟩ := IsSCtx.forget B.ctx₂
  have ht₁ : f₁ (G.lead r₁.1) = forgetM B.top :=
    ((he₁ (G.bar.lead r₁)).trans (congrArg f₁ (forgetM_flM r₁.2 (G.lead r₁.1)))).symm
  have ht₂ : f₂ (G.lead r₂.1) = forgetM B.top :=
    ((congrArg forgetM B.eq).trans ((he₂ (G.bar.lead r₂)).trans
      (congrArg f₂ (forgetM_flM r₂.2 (G.lead r₂.1))))).symm
  let B₀ : G.Amb C r₁.1 r₂.1 := ⟨f₁, f₂, hf₁, hf₂, ht₁.trans ht₂.symm⟩
  have hB₀ : B₀.Res := Rules.resolvable_iff.1 (hres C) r₁.1 r₂.1 B₀
  have hB₀top : B₀.top = forgetM B.top := ht₁
  have hcut₂ : ∀ y ∈ cutKeys (B.f₂ (flM r₂.2 (G.lead r₂.1))).1,
      y = key (B.f₂ (flM r₂.2 (G.lead r₂.1))).1 := by
    have : B.f₂ (flM r₂.2 (G.lead r₂.1)) = B.top := B.eq.symm
    rw [this]
    exact hcut
  have hroot₂ : rootF (B.f₂ (flM r₂.2 (G.lead r₂.1))).1 = rootF B.top.1 := by
    have : B.f₂ (flM r₂.2 (G.lead r₂.1)) = B.top := B.eq.symm
    rw [this]
  have hT₁ : Finsupp.mapDomain B.f₁ (G.bar.tail r₁) =
      Finsupp.mapDomain (flM (rootF B.top.1)) (Finsupp.mapDomain f₁ (G.tail r₁.1)) := by
    show Finsupp.mapDomain B.f₁ (Finsupp.mapDomain (flM r₁.2) (G.tail r₁.1)) = _
    rw [← Finsupp.mapDomain_comp, ← Finsupp.mapDomain_comp]
    exact Finsupp.mapDomain_congr fun m hm =>
      occ_flag B.ctx₁ r₁.2 he₁ (G.lead r₁.1) (hlead _) hcut m (hom _ m hm)
  have hT₂ : Finsupp.mapDomain B.f₂ (G.bar.tail r₂) =
      Finsupp.mapDomain (flM (rootF B.top.1)) (Finsupp.mapDomain f₂ (G.tail r₂.1)) := by
    show Finsupp.mapDomain B.f₂ (Finsupp.mapDomain (flM r₂.2) (G.tail r₂.1)) = _
    rw [← Finsupp.mapDomain_comp, ← Finsupp.mapDomain_comp, ← hroot₂]
    exact Finsupp.mapDomain_congr fun m hm =>
      occ_flag B.ctx₂ r₂.2 he₂ (G.lead r₂.1) (hlead _) hcut₂ m (hom _ m hm)
  have := G.flM_mem_idealOn hlead hom (T := B.top) (rootF B.top.1) (v := Finsupp.mapDomain f₁
    (G.tail r₁.1) - Finsupp.mapDomain f₂ (G.tail r₂.1)) (hB₀top ▸ hB₀)
  rw [Finsupp.mapDomain_sub (f := flM (rootF B.top.1)), ← hT₁, ← hT₂] at this
  exact this

name: Operad.Rules.bar_resolvable
statement:
theorem Rules.bar_resolvable (hres : ∀ C, (G.rw C).Resolvable) (A : Finset ℕ) :
    (G.bar.rw A).Resolvable
proof:
:=
  resolvable_of_critical G.bar (fun r a h => by
      have hl := hlead r.1
      change fl r.2 (G.lead r.1).1 = leaf a at h
      rcases hL : (G.lead r.1).1 with a' | ⟨e, c⟩
      · exact hl a' hL
      · rw [hL, fl_node] at h
        cases h)
    (fun B hB => G.bar_crit_res hlead hom hres B hB) A

name: Operad.Deformed.fst_neg

name: Operad.Deformed.fstL_apply

name: Operad.SymOperad.eq_map_symm_of_map_eq'
statement:
lemma SymOperad.eq_map_symm_of_map_eq' {A B : Type} [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] [Fintype B]
    [DecidableEq B] {e : A ≃ B} {x : P A} {y : P B} (h : SymOperad.map (R := R) e x = y) :
    x = SymOperad.map (R := R) e.symm y
proof:
:= by
  rw [← h, SymOperad.map_symm_map]

name: Operad.SymCochain.isCocycle_zero
statement:
theorem isCocycle_zero : (SymCochain.zero : SymCochain R P).IsCocycle where
  map_comp _ _ _ _ _
proof:
:= by simp
  comp_one _ _ := rfl
  one_comp _ := rfl
  assoc_seq _ _ _ _ _ := by simp
  assoc_par _ _ _ _ := by simp

name: Operad.SymCochain.IsCocycle.add_smul
statement:
theorem IsCocycle.add_smul {ω ω' : SymCochain R P} (h : ω.IsCocycle) (h' : ω'.IsCocycle)
    (c c' : R) : (c • ω + c' • ω').IsCocycle where
  map_comp σ τ i x y
proof:
:= by
    simp only [Pi.add_apply, Pi.smul_apply, LinearMap.add_apply, LinearMap.smul_apply, map_add,
      map_smul, h.map_comp, h'.map_comp]
  comp_one i x := by
    simp only [Pi.add_apply, Pi.smul_apply, LinearMap.add_apply, LinearMap.smul_apply,
      h.comp_one, h'.comp_one, smul_zero, add_zero]
  one_comp y := by
    simp only [Pi.add_apply, Pi.smul_apply, LinearMap.add_apply, LinearMap.smul_apply,
      h.one_comp, h'.one_comp, smul_zero, add_zero]
  assoc_seq i j x y z := by
    have e := h.assoc_seq i j x y z
    have e' := h'.assoc_seq i j x y z
    simp only [Pi.add_apply, Pi.smul_apply, LinearMap.add_apply, LinearMap.smul_apply, map_add,
      map_smul] at e e' ⊢
    linear_combination (norm := module) c • e + c' • e'
  assoc_par hik x y z := by
    have e := h.assoc_par hik x y z
    have e' := h'.assoc_par hik x y z
    simp only [Pi.add_apply, Pi.smul_apply, LinearMap.add_apply, LinearMap.smul_apply, map_add,
      map_smul] at e e' ⊢
    linear_combination (norm := module) c • e + c' • e'

name: Operad.Deformed.fst_map
statement:
@[simp] lemma fst_map (e : A ≃ B) (z : Deformed ω A) :

name: Operad.Deformed.snd_map

name: Operad.Deformed.fst_comp

@[simp] lemma fst_comp (i : A) (z : Deformed ω A) (z' : Deformed ω B) :

proof: := rfl

name: Operad.Deformed.snd_comp
statement:
@[simp] lemma snd_comp (i : A) (z : Deformed ω A) (z' : Deformed ω B) :
    snd (comp ω i z z') = SymOperad.comp (R := R) i (snd z) (fst z')
      + SymOperad.comp (R := R) i (fst z) (snd z') + ω i (fst z) (fst z')
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.Deformed.fst_symMap

@[simp] lemma fst_symMap (e : A ≃ B) (z : Deformed ω A) :

name: Operad.Deformed.fst_symComp

@[simp] lemma fst_symComp (i : A) (z : Deformed ω A) (z' : Deformed ω B) :

name: Operad.Deformed.snd_symComp
statement:
@[simp] lemma snd_symComp (i : A) (z : Deformed ω A) (z' : Deformed ω B) :
    snd (SymOperad.comp (R := R) i z z') = SymOperad.comp (R := R) i (snd z) (fst z')
      + SymOperad.comp (R := R) i (fst z) (snd z') + ω i (fst z) (fst z')
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.Deformed.fst_one
statement: @[simp] lemma fst_one : fst (SymOperad.one R : Deformed ω Unit) = SymOperad.one R
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.Deformed.snd_one

name: Operad.Deformed.symMap_mk
statement:
lemma symMap_mk (e : A ≃ B) (x x' : P A) :
    SymOperad.map (R := R) e (mk (ω := ω) x x')
      = mk (SymOperad.map (R := R) e x) (SymOperad.map (R := R) e x')

name: Operad.Deformed.comp_mk_zero_left
statement:
lemma comp_mk_zero_left (i : A) (ξ : P A) (z : Deformed ω B) :
    SymOperad.comp (R := R) i (mk (ω := ω) 0 ξ) z
