name: Operad.Deformed.fstHom_app
statement: @[simp] lemma fstHom_app (z : Deformed ω A) : (fstHom ω).app A z = fst z
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.Deformed.isCocycle_of_symOperad
statement:
theorem isCocycle_of_symOperad (S : SymOperad R (Deformed ω))
    (hmap : ∀ {A B : Type} [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] [Fintype B] [DecidableEq B] (e : A ≃ B),
      @SymOperad.map R _ (Deformed ω) _ _ S A B _ _ _ _ e = map ω e)
    (hone : @SymOperad.one R _ (Deformed ω) _ _ S = mk (SymOperad.one R) 0)
    (hcomp : ∀ {A B : Type} [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] [Fintype B] [DecidableEq B] (i : A),
      @SymOperad.comp R _ (Deformed ω) _ _ S A B _ _ _ _ i = comp ω i) :
    ω.IsCocycle where
  map_comp σ τ i x y
proof:
:= by
    have h := congrArg snd (@SymOperad.map_comp R _ (Deformed ω) _ _ S _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _
      σ τ i (mk x 0) (mk y 0))
    simpa [hmap, hcomp] using h
  comp_one i x := by
    have h := congrArg snd (@SymOperad.comp_one R _ (Deformed ω) _ _ S _ _ _ i (mk x 0))
    simp only [hmap, hcomp, hone, snd_map, snd_comp, fst_mk, snd_mk, map_zero,
      LinearMap.zero_apply, zero_add] at h
    exact SymOperad.map_injective (R := R) _ (h.trans (map_zero _).symm)
  one_comp y := by
    have h := congrArg snd (@SymOperad.one_comp R _ (Deformed ω) _ _ S _ _ _ (mk y 0))
    simp only [hmap, hcomp, hone, snd_map, snd_comp, fst_mk, snd_mk, map_zero,
      LinearMap.zero_apply, zero_add] at h
    exact SymOperad.map_injective (R := R) _ (h.trans (map_zero _).symm)
  assoc_seq i j x y z := by
    have h := congrArg snd (@SymOperad.comp_assoc_seq R _ (Deformed ω) _ _ S _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _
      i j (mk x 0) (mk y 0) (mk z 0))
    simpa [hmap, hcomp] using h
  assoc_par hik x y z := by
    have h := congrArg snd (@SymOperad.comp_assoc_par R _ (Deformed ω) _ _ S _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _
      _ _ hik (mk x 0) (mk y 0) (mk z 0))
    simpa [hmap, hcomp] using h

name: Operad.SymEndo.coboundary_apply
statement:
@[simp] lemma coboundary_apply (φ : SymEndo R P) (i : A) (x : P A) (y : P B) :
    φ.coboundary i x y = φ.app _ (SymOperad.comp (R := R) i x y)
      - SymOperad.comp (R := R) i (φ.app A x) y - SymOperad.comp (R := R) i x (φ.app B y)
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: Operad.SymEndo.isCocycle_coboundary
statement:
theorem isCocycle_coboundary (φ : SymEndo R P) (h : φ.app Unit (SymOperad.one R) = 0) :
    φ.coboundary.IsCocycle where
  map_comp σ τ i x y
proof:
:= by
    simp only [coboundary_apply, map_sub, ← φ.app_map, SymOperad.map_comp (R := R)]
  comp_one i x := by
    simp only [coboundary_apply, h, map_zero, SymOperad.comp_one' (R := R), φ.app_map, sub_self]
  one_comp y := by
    simp only [coboundary_apply, h, map_zero, LinearMap.zero_apply, SymOperad.one_comp' (R := R),
      φ.app_map, sub_zero, sub_self]
  assoc_seq i j x y z := by
    simp only [coboundary_apply, map_sub, LinearMap.sub_apply, map_add, ← φ.app_map,
      SymOperad.comp_assoc_seq (R := R)]
    abel
  assoc_par hik x y z := by
    simp only [coboundary_apply, map_sub, LinearMap.sub_apply, map_add, ← φ.app_map,
      SymOperad.comp_assoc_par (R := R)]
    abel

name: Operad.SymCochain.app_one_eq_zero
statement:
lemma app_one_eq_zero {ω : SymCochain R P} (hω : ω.IsCocycle) (φ : SymEndo R P)
    (hφ : ∀ {A B : Type} [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] [Fintype B] [DecidableEq B]
      (i : A) (x : P A) (y : P B), ω i x y = φ.coboundary i x y) :
    φ.app Unit (SymOperad.one R) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have h := (hφ () (SymOperad.one R) (SymOperad.one R)).symm.trans (hω.comp_one () _)
  rw [SymEndo.coboundary_apply, SymOperad.comp_one' (R := R), SymOperad.comp_one' (R := R),
    SymOperad.one_comp' (R := R), φ.app_map, sub_self, zero_sub, neg_eq_zero] at h
  exact SymOperad.map_injective (R := R) _ (h.trans (map_zero _).symm)

name: Operad.isCoboundary_iff_exists_lift
statement:
theorem isCoboundary_iff_exists_lift :
    ω.IsCoboundary ↔ ∃ F : SymOperadHom R P (Deformed ω),
      ∀ (A : Type) [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] (x : P A), Deformed.fst (F.app A x) = x
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨φ, hφ⟩
    exact ⟨φ.lift hφ, fun _ _ _ _ => rfl⟩
  · rintro ⟨F, hF⟩
    refine ⟨⟨fun A _ _ => (Deformed.sndL ω A).comp (F.app A), fun e x => ?_⟩, ?_⟩
    · simp only [LinearMap.coe_comp, Function.comp_apply, Deformed.sndL_apply, F.app_map]
      rfl
    · intro A B _ _ _ _ i x y
      have h := congrArg Deformed.snd (F.app_comp i x y)
      simp only [Deformed.snd_symComp, hF] at h
      simp only [SymEndo.coboundary_apply, LinearMap.coe_comp, Function.comp_apply,
        Deformed.sndL_apply, h]
      abel

name: Operad.SymDerivation.ext
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨⟨Da, _⟩, _⟩ := D
  obtain ⟨⟨D'a, _⟩, _⟩ := D'
  have : @Da = @D'a := by
    funext A _ _
    exact LinearMap.ext (h A)
  subst this
  rfl

name: Operad.SymDerivation.app_one
statement: theorem app_one (D : SymDerivation R P) : D.app Unit (SymOperad.one R) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have h := D.app_comp () (SymOperad.one R) (SymOperad.one R)
  rw [SymOperad.comp_one' (R := R), SymOperad.comp_one' (R := R), SymOperad.one_comp' (R := R),
    D.app_map] at h
  have h2 : SymOperad.map (R := R) (leftUnitEquiv Unit).symm (D.app Unit (SymOperad.one R)) = 0 :=
    by linear_combination (norm := module) (-1 : R) • h
  exact SymOperad.map_injective (R := R) _ (h2.trans (map_zero _).symm)

name: Operad.SymDerivation.fst_lift
statement: @[simp] lemma fst_lift (D : SymDerivation R P) (x : P A) : Deformed.fst (D.lift.app A x) = x
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: Operad.SymDerivation.snd_lift
statement:
@[simp] lemma snd_lift (D : SymDerivation R P) (x : P A) :
    Deformed.snd (D.lift.app A x) = D.app A x
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.SymDerivation.zero_app
statement: @[simp] lemma zero_app (x : P A) : (0 : SymDerivation R P).app A x = 0
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.SymDerivation.add_app
statement:
@[simp] lemma add_app (D D' : SymDerivation R P) (x : P A) :
    (D + D').app A x = D.app A x + D'.app A x
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.SymDerivation.smul_app
statement:
@[simp] lemma smul_app (c : R) (D : SymDerivation R P) (x : P A) :
    (c • D).app A x = c • D.app A x
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.SymDerivation.eq_of_lift_eq
statement: lemma eq_of_lift_eq {D D' : SymDerivation R P} (h : D.lift = D'.lift) : D = D'
proof:
:=
  liftEquiv.injective (Subtype.ext h)

name: Operad.SymDerivation.card_without
statement: lemma card_without (i : A) : Fintype.card (Without A i) + 1 = Fintype.card A
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Fintype.card_option, Fintype.card_congr (Equiv.optionSubtypeNe i)]

name: Operad.SymDerivation.euler_app
statement:
@[simp] lemma euler_app (x : P A) :
    (euler : SymDerivation R P).app A x = ((Fintype.card A : R) - 1) • x
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.SymDerivation.adLeft_apply
statement:
@[simp] lemma adLeft_apply (θ : P Unit) (x : P A) :
    adLeft (R := R) θ A x
      = SymOperad.map (R := R) (leftUnitEquiv A) (SymOperad.comp (R := R) () θ x)
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.SymDerivation.adRight_apply
statement:
@[simp] lemma adRight_apply (θ : P Unit) (a : A) (x : P A) :
    adRight (R := R) θ A a x
      = SymOperad.map (R := R) (rightUnitEquiv a) (SymOperad.comp (R := R) a x θ)
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.SymDerivation.map_congr_equiv
statement:
lemma map_congr_equiv {e f : A ≃ B} (h : ∀ a, e a = f a) (x : P A) :
    SymOperad.map (R := R) e x = SymOperad.map (R := R) f x
proof:
:= by
  rw [Equiv.ext h]

name: Operad.SymDerivation.adLeft_map
statement:
lemma adLeft_map (θ : P Unit) (e : A ≃ B) (x : P A) :
    adLeft (R := R) θ B (SymOperad.map (R := R) e x)
      = SymOperad.map (R := R) e (adLeft (R := R) θ A x)
proof:
:= by
  have h := SymOperad.map_comp (R := R) (Equiv.refl Unit) e () θ x
  rw [SymOperad.map_refl (R := R)] at h
  rw [adLeft_apply, adLeft_apply, ← h, SymOperad.map_map, SymOperad.map_map]
  refine map_congr_equiv (fun c => ?_) _
  rcases c with ⟨u, hu⟩ | a
  · exact absurd (Subsingleton.elim u ()) hu
  · rfl

name: Operad.SymDerivation.adRight_map
statement:
lemma adRight_map (θ : P Unit) (e : A ≃ B) (a : A) (x : P A) :
    adRight (R := R) θ B (e a) (SymOperad.map (R := R) e x)
      = SymOperad.map (R := R) e (adRight (R := R) θ A a x)
proof:
:= by
  have h := SymOperad.map_comp (R := R) e (Equiv.refl Unit) a x θ
  rw [SymOperad.map_refl (R := R)] at h
  rw [adRight_apply, adRight_apply, ← h, SymOperad.map_map, SymOperad.map_map]
  refine map_congr_equiv (fun c => ?_) _
  rcases c with ⟨c, hc⟩ | u
  · rfl
  · rfl

name: Operad.SymDerivation.adLeft_comp
statement:
lemma adLeft_comp (θ : P Unit) (i : A) (x : P A) (y : P B) :
    adLeft (R := R) θ _ (SymOperad.comp (R := R) i x y)
      = SymOperad.comp (R := R) i (adLeft (R := R) θ A x) y
proof:
:= by
  have h1 := SymOperad.comp_assoc_seq (R := R) () i θ x y
  have h2 := SymOperad.map_comp (R := R) (leftUnitEquiv A) (Equiv.refl B) (Sum.inr i)
    (SymOperad.comp (R := R) () θ x) y
  rw [SymOperad.map_refl (R := R)] at h2
  rw [adLeft_apply, adLeft_apply, ← h1, SymOperad.map_map]
  refine Eq.trans ?_ h2
  refine map_congr_equiv (fun c => ?_) _
  rcases c with ⟨⟨u, hu⟩ | a, h⟩ | b
  · exact absurd (Subsingleton.elim u ()) hu
  · rfl
  · rfl

name: Operad.SymDerivation.adRight_comp_inl
statement:
lemma adRight_comp_inl (θ : P Unit) (i : A) (a : Without A i) (x : P A) (y : P B) :
    adRight (R := R) θ _ (Sum.inl a) (SymOperad.comp (R := R) i x y)
      = SymOperad.comp (R := R) i (adRight (R := R) θ A a.1 x) y
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := a
  have h1 := SymOperad.comp_assoc_par (R := R) (Ne.symm ha) x y θ
  have h2 := SymOperad.map_comp (R := R) (rightUnitEquiv a) (Equiv.refl B)
    (Sum.inl ⟨i, Ne.symm ha⟩) (SymOperad.comp (R := R) a x θ) y
  rw [SymOperad.map_refl (R := R)] at h2
  rw [adRight_apply, adRight_apply, SymOperad.eq_map_symm_of_map_eq' h1, SymOperad.map_map]
  refine Eq.trans ?_ h2
  refine map_congr_equiv (fun c => ?_) _
  rcases c with ⟨⟨c, hc⟩ | b, h⟩ | u
  · rfl
  · rfl
  · rfl

name: Operad.SymDerivation.adRight_comp_inr
statement:
lemma adRight_comp_inr (θ : P Unit) (i : A) (b : B) (x : P A) (y : P B) :
    adRight (R := R) θ _ (Sum.inr b) (SymOperad.comp (R := R) i x y)
      = SymOperad.comp (R := R) i x (adRight (R := R) θ B b y)
proof:
:= by
  have h1 := SymOperad.comp_assoc_seq (R := R) i b x y θ
  have h2 := SymOperad.map_comp (R := R) (Equiv.refl A) (rightUnitEquiv b) i x
    (SymOperad.comp (R := R) b y θ)
  rw [SymOperad.map_refl (R := R), ← h1, SymOperad.map_map] at h2
  rw [adRight_apply, adRight_apply]
  refine Eq.trans ?_ h2
  refine map_congr_equiv (fun c => ?_) _
  rcases c with ⟨a | b', h⟩ | u
  · rfl
  · rfl
  · rfl

name: Operad.SymDerivation.adRight_self_comp
statement:
lemma adRight_self_comp (θ : P Unit) (i : A) (x : P A) (y : P B) :
    SymOperad.comp (R := R) i (adRight (R := R) θ A i x) y
      = SymOperad.comp (R := R) i x (adLeft (R := R) θ B y)
proof:
:= by
  have h1 := SymOperad.comp_assoc_seq (R := R) i () x θ y
  have h2 := SymOperad.map_comp (R := R) (rightUnitEquiv i) (Equiv.refl B) (Sum.inr ())
    (SymOperad.comp (R := R) i x θ) y
  have h3 := SymOperad.map_comp (R := R) (Equiv.refl A) (leftUnitEquiv B) i x
    (SymOperad.comp (R := R) () θ y)
  rw [SymOperad.map_refl (R := R)] at h2 h3
  rw [← h1, SymOperad.map_map] at h3
  rw [adRight_apply, adLeft_apply]
  refine h2.symm.trans (Eq.trans ?_ h3)
  refine map_congr_equiv (fun c => ?_) _
  rcases c with ⟨a | u, h⟩ | b
  · rfl
  · exact absurd rfl h
  · rfl

name: Operad.SymDerivation.adApp_apply
statement:
lemma adApp_apply (θ : P Unit) (x : P A) :
    adApp (R := R) θ A x = adLeft (R := R) θ A x - ∑ a : A, adRight (R := R) θ A a x
proof:
:= by
  simp [adApp, LinearMap.coe_sum]

name: Operad.SymDerivation.ad_app
statement:
@[simp] lemma ad_app (θ : P Unit) (x : P A) :
    (ad (R := R) θ).app A x = adLeft (R := R) θ A x - ∑ a : A, adRight (R := R) θ A a x
proof:
:=
  adApp_apply θ x

name: Operad.SymDerivation.ad_one
statement:
theorem ad_one (x : P A) :
    (ad (R := R) (SymOperad.one R)).app A x = -(euler : SymDerivation R P).app A x
proof:
:= by
  simp only [ad_app, adLeft_apply, SymOperad.one_comp (R := R), adRight_apply,
    SymOperad.comp_one (R := R), Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, euler_app, sub_smul,
    one_smul, neg_sub, ← Nat.cast_smul_eq_nsmul R]

name: Operad.SymDerivation.ad_smul
statement:
theorem ad_smul (c : R) (θ : P Unit) (x : P A) :
    (ad (R := R) (c • θ)).app A x = c • (ad (R := R) θ).app A x
proof:
:= by
  simp only [ad_app, adLeft_apply, adRight_apply, map_smul, LinearMap.smul_apply, smul_sub,
    Finset.smul_sum]

name: Operad.SymDerivation.smul_euler_eq_ad
statement:
theorem smul_euler_eq_ad (c : R) :
    c • (euler : SymDerivation R P) = ad (-c • SymOperad.one R)
proof:
:= by
  ext A _ _ x
  rw [smul_app, ad_smul, ad_one, smul_neg, neg_smul, neg_neg]

name: Operad.SymCochain.comap_apply
statement:
@[simp] lemma SymCochain.comap_apply (e : SymOperadIso R P P') (ω' : SymCochain R P') (i : A)
    (x : P A) (y : P B) :
    SymCochain.comap e ω' i x y = e.inv.app _ (ω' i (e.hom.app A x) (e.hom.app B y))
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.SymCochain.isCocycle_comap
proof:
:= by
    apply (e.bijective _).1
    simp only [comap_apply, e.hom.app_map, SymOperadIso.hom_inv_apply, h.map_comp]
  comp_one i x := by
    simp only [comap_apply, e.hom.app_one, h.comp_one, map_zero]
  one_comp y := by
    simp only [comap_apply, e.hom.app_one, h.one_comp, map_zero]
  assoc_seq i j x y z := by
    apply (e.bijective _).1
    have h' := h.assoc_seq i j (e.hom.app _ x) (e.hom.app _ y) (e.hom.app _ z)
    rw [map_add] at h'
    simp only [comap_apply, map_add, e.hom.app_map, e.hom.app_comp,
      SymOperadIso.hom_inv_apply]
    linear_combination (norm := module) h'
  assoc_par hik x y z := by
    apply (e.bijective _).1
    have h' := h.assoc_par hik (e.hom.app _ x) (e.hom.app _ y) (e.hom.app _ z)
    rw [map_add] at h'
    simp only [comap_apply, map_add, e.hom.app_map, e.hom.app_comp,
      SymOperadIso.hom_inv_apply]
    linear_combination (norm := module) h'

name: Operad.SymOperadIso.forall_isCoboundary
statement:
theorem SymOperadIso.forall_isCoboundary (e : SymOperadIso R P P')
    (h : ∀ ω : SymCochain R P, ω.IsCocycle → ω.IsCoboundary) (ω' : SymCochain R P')
    (hω' : ω'.IsCocycle) : ω'.IsCoboundary
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨φ, hφ⟩ := h _ (SymCochain.isCocycle_comap e hω')
  refine ⟨⟨fun A _ _ => (e.hom.app A).comp ((φ.app A).comp (e.inv.app A)), fun f x => ?_⟩,
    fun i x y => ?_⟩
  · simp only [LinearMap.coe_comp, Function.comp_apply, e.inv.app_map, φ.app_map, e.hom.app_map]
  · have h1 := congrArg (e.hom.app _) (hφ i (e.inv.app _ x) (e.inv.app _ y))
    simp only [SymCochain.comap_apply, SymOperadIso.hom_inv_apply, SymEndo.coboundary_apply,
      map_sub, e.hom.app_comp] at h1
    simp only [SymEndo.coboundary_apply, LinearMap.coe_comp, Function.comp_apply, h1,
      e.inv.app_comp]

name: Operad.SymDerivation.transport_app
statement:
@[simp] lemma SymDerivation.transport_app (e : SymOperadIso R P P') (D : SymDerivation R P)
    (x : P' A) : (D.transport e).app A x = e.hom.app A (D.app A (e.inv.app A x))
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.SymOperadIso.forall_eq_smul_euler
statement:
theorem SymOperadIso.forall_eq_smul_euler (e : SymOperadIso R P P')
    (h : ∀ D : SymDerivation R P, ∃ c : R, D = c • SymDerivation.euler)
    (D' : SymDerivation R P') : ∃ c : R, D' = c • SymDerivation.euler
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := h (D'.transport e.symm)
  refine ⟨c, SymDerivation.ext fun A _ _ x => ?_⟩
  have h1 := congrArg (fun D : SymDerivation R P => D.app A (e.inv.app A x)) hc
  simp only [SymDerivation.transport_app, SymDerivation.smul_app, SymDerivation.euler_app] at h1
  have h2 := congrArg (e.hom.app A) h1
  simp only [SymOperadIso.symm, SymOperadIso.hom_inv_apply, map_smul] at h2
  rw [SymDerivation.smul_app, SymDerivation.euler_app]
  exact h2

name: Operad.ConvOp.toLin_star_mem
statement:
theorem toLin_star_mem {F G H : ∀ (A : Type) [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A], Submodule R (P A)}
    (hG : ∀ (A : Type) [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] (b : Bool) (y : P A), y ∈ G A →
      GrOperad.par (R := R) b y ∈ G A)
    (hH : ∀ (A B : Type) [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] [Fintype B] [DecidableEq B] (e : A ≃ B)
      (y : P A), y ∈ H A → GrOperad.map (R := R) e y ∈ H B)
    (hFG : ∀ (A B : Type) [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] [Fintype B] [DecidableEq B] (i : A)
      (y : P A) (z : P B), y ∈ F A → z ∈ G B → GrOperad.comp (R := R) i y z ∈ H _)
    {f g : GrOperad.Inv R (ConvOp R C P)}
    (hf : ∀ (A : Type) [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] (x : C A), toLin (f.1 A) x ∈ F A)
    (hg : ∀ (A : Type) [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] (x : C A), toLin (g.1 A) x ∈ G A)
    (A : Type) [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] (x : C A) :
    toLin ((GrOperad.Inv.star R _ f g).1 A) x ∈ H A
proof:
:= by
  rw [GrOperad.Inv.star_apply, toLin_sum, LinearMap.coe_sum, Finset.sum_apply]
  refine Submodule.sum_mem _ fun S _ => ?_
  show toLin (mapC (splitEquiv S) (compC none (f.1 (SOut S)) (g.1 (SIn S)))) x ∈ H A
  rw [mapC_apply, toLin_compC, LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearMap.comp_apply]
  refine hH _ _ _ _ ?_
  generalize GrCooperad.decomp (R := R) (C := C) (B := SIn S) (none : SOut S) _ = t
  induction t using TensorProduct.induction_on with
  | zero => rw [map_zero, map_zero]; exact zero_mem _
  | tmul a b =>
    simp only [kap, LinearMap.coe_sum, Finset.sum_apply, TensorProduct.map_tmul, map_sum,
      LinearMap.comp_apply, mu_tmul]
    refine Submodule.sum_mem _ fun q _ => hFG _ _ _ _ _ (hf _ _) ?_
    rw [parC_apply]
    exact Submodule.sum_mem _ fun c _ => hG _ _ _ (hg _ _)
  | add a b ha hb => rw [map_add, map_add]; exact add_mem ha hb

name: Operad.DualExt.snd_mapHom
statement:
lemma snd_mapHom (φ : GrOperadHom R Q Q') {A : Type} [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A]
    (X : DualExt R Q e A) :
    snd (R := R) (e := e) ((mapHom φ).app A X) = φ.app A (snd (R := R) (e := e) X)
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.DualExt.fst_epsDer
statement:
@[simp] lemma fst_epsDer {A : Type} [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] (X : DualExt R Q e A) :
    fst ((epsDer R Q e).app A X) = 0
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.DualExt.snd_epsDer
statement:
@[simp] lemma snd_epsDer {A : Type} [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] (X : DualExt R Q e A) :
    snd ((epsDer R Q e).app A X) = snd X
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.FreeGrL.epsDer_app
statement:
lemma epsDer_app {A : Type} [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] (x : FreeGrL R V A) :
    (DualExt.epsDer R Q e).app A (Ψ.app A x) = Ψ.app A ((derSp (GrSpEnd.id R V)).app A x)
proof:
:= by
  have h : (DualExt.epsDer R Q e).compHom Ψ = GrDer.homComp Ψ (derSp (GrSpEnd.id R V)) :=
    der_ext fun A _ _ v => by
      rw [GrDer.compHom_app, GrDer.homComp_app, derSp_ι, GrSpEnd.id_app]
      exact DualExt.ext (((DualExt.fst_epsDer _).trans (hΨ A v).symm)) rfl
  exact congrArg (fun D : GrDer Ψ false => D.app A x) h

name: Operad.FreeGrL.snd_eq_zero_of_vx
statement:
lemma snd_eq_zero_of_vx [Algebra ℚ R] {A : Type} [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] {j : ℕ}
    (hj : j ≠ 1) {x : FreeGrL R V A} (hx : x ∈ vx R V j A) : DualExt.snd (Ψ.app A x) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have h := congrArg DualExt.snd (epsDer_app Ψ hΨ x)
  rw [DualExt.snd_epsDer, mem_eig.1 hx, map_smul] at h
  have h' : ((j : R) - 1) • DualExt.snd (Ψ.app A x) = 0 := by
    rw [sub_smul, one_smul, ← map_smul, ← h, sub_self]
  rcases Nat.lt_or_gt_of_ne hj with hl | hl
  · have : j = 0 := by omega
    subst this
    simpa using h'
  · rw [show ((j : R) - 1) = ((j - 1 : ℕ) : R) by rw [Nat.cast_sub (by omega), Nat.cast_one]]
      at h'
    exact (isUnit_natCast_of_ne_zero (show j - 1 ≠ 0 by omega)).smul_left_cancel.1
      (h'.trans (smul_zero _).symm)

name: Operad.LTree.wt_pow
statement:
lemma wt_pow (w : E → ℕ) (a : K) : ∀ t : LTree E, wt (fun e => a ^ w e) t = a ^ wdeg w t
  | leaf _ => by simp
  | node e l r => by
    rw [wt_node, wdeg_node, wt_pow w a l, wt_pow w a r, pow_add, pow_add]

end LTree

namespace ShuffleBar

open LTree Graded

variable {E : Type v} [Fintype E] [DecidableEq E] {K : Type u} [Field K]

omit [Fintype E] [DecidableEq E] in

name: Operad.ShuffleBar.scaleBar_apply
statement:
lemma scaleBar_apply (l : E → K) (v : BarTree E →₀ K) (x : BarTree E) :
    scaleBar K l v x = wtB l x * v x
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction v using Finsupp.induction_linear with
  | zero => simp
  | add v v' hv hv' => rw [map_add, Finsupp.add_apply, hv, hv', Finsupp.add_apply, mul_add]
  | single y c =>
    rw [scaleBar_single, Finsupp.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, Finsupp.single_apply,
      Finsupp.single_apply]
    split_ifs with h
    · subst h
      ring
    · simp

name: Operad.ShuffleBar.wtB_fullBar
statement: lemma wtB_fullBar (l : E → K) (m : LTree E) : wtB l (fullBar m) = wt l m
proof:
:= by
  rw [wtB_eq, full_fullBar]

name: Operad.ShuffleBar.toMono_scaleBar
statement:
lemma toMono_scaleBar (l : E → K) (n : ℕ) (v : BarTree E →₀ K) :
    toMono K n (scaleBar K l v) = scaleMono K l n (toMono K n v)
proof:
:= by
  funext m
  show (tauS m.1 : K) * scaleBar K l v (fullBar m.1) =
    wt l m.1 * ((tauS m.1 : K) * v (fullBar m.1))
  rw [scaleBar_apply, wtB_fullBar]
  ring

name: Operad.ShuffleBar.KDmono_rescale
statement:
theorem KDmono_rescale (l : E → K) (hl : ∀ e, l e ≠ 0) (R : Submodule K (Mono E 3 → K)) {n : ℕ}
    (hn : 2 ≤ n) : KDmono K (R.map (rescale K l)) n = (KDmono K R n).map (scaleMono K l n)
proof:
:= by
  rw [KDmono_eq_map _ hn, KDmono_eq_map R hn, ← map_scaleBar_KD K l hl R n,
    ← Submodule.map_comp, ← Submodule.map_comp]
  congr 1
  exact LinearMap.ext fun v => toMono_scaleBar l n v

name: Operad.ShuffleBar.scaleMono_pow
statement:
lemma scaleMono_pow (w : E → ℕ) (n : ℕ) (c : K) :
    scaleMono K (fun e => c⁻¹ ^ w e) n = scaleInv (wMono w n) c
proof:
:= by
  refine LinearMap.ext fun x => funext fun m => ?_
  show wt (fun e => c⁻¹ ^ w e) m.1 * x m = c⁻¹ ^ wdeg w m.1 * x m
  rw [wt_pow]

name: Operad.ShuffleBar.KDmono_rescale_pow
statement:
theorem KDmono_rescale_pow (w : E → ℕ) {c : K} (hc : c ≠ 0) (R : Submodule K (Mono E 3 → K))
    {n : ℕ} (hn : 2 ≤ n) :
    KDmono K (R.map (rescale K fun e => c⁻¹ ^ w e)) n =
      (KDmono K R n).map (scaleInv (wMono w n) c)
proof:
:= by
  rw [KDmono_rescale _ (fun e => pow_ne_zero _ (inv_ne_zero hc)) R hn, scaleMono_pow]

name: Operad.ShuffleBar.fiber_rees_KDmono_of_ne_zero
statement:
theorem fiber_rees_KDmono_of_ne_zero (hn : 2 ≤ n) {c : K} (hc : c ≠ 0) :
    fiber (W := wMono w n) (KDmono K R n) c =
      KDmono K (R.map (rescale K fun e => c⁻¹ ^ w e)) n
proof:
:= by
  rw [evalAt_rees_of_ne_zero _ hc, KDmono_rescale_pow w hc R hn]

name: Operad.ShuffleBar.fiber_rees_KDmono_zero
statement:
theorem fiber_rees_KDmono_zero (hn : 2 ≤ n) (h : KD K R₀ n = grW K (wdegB w) (KD K R n)) :
    fiber (W := wMono w n) (KDmono K R n) 0 = KDmono K R₀ n
proof:
:= by
  rw [evalAt_rees_zero, KDmono_eq_grF w hn h]

name: Operad.ShuffleBar.finrank_rees_KDmono
statement:
theorem finrank_rees_KDmono (hn : 2 ≤ n) :
    Module.finrank K[X] (rees K (wMono w n) (KDmono K R n)) = Module.finrank K (KD K R n)
proof:
:= by
  rw [finrank_rees _ 1, evalAt_rees_one, (kdEquivKDmono R hn).finrank_eq]

name: Operad.ShuffleBar.sections_KDmono_eq_rees
statement:
theorem sections_KDmono_eq_rees [Infinite K] (hn : 2 ≤ n)
    (h : KD K R₀ n = grW K (wdegB w) (KD K R n)) (Rc : K → Submodule K (Mono E 3 → K))
    (h0 : Rc 0 = R₀) (hc : ∀ c, c ≠ 0 → Rc c = R.map (rescale K fun e => c⁻¹ ^ w e)) :
    sections K (fun c => KDmono K (Rc c) n) = rees K (wMono w n) (KDmono K R n)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← sections_fiber]
  congr 1
  funext c
  rcases eq_or_ne c 0 with rfl | hc0
  · rw [h0, fiber_rees_KDmono_zero w hn h]
  · rw [hc c hc0, fiber_rees_KDmono_of_ne_zero w hn hc0]

name: Operad.Conv.reindex_toLinearMap_self
statement:
@[simp] lemma reindex_toLinearMap_self {Q : ℕ → Type*} [∀ n, AddCommGroup (Q n)]
    [∀ n, Module R (Q n)] {n : ℕ} (h : n = n) :
    (reindex R Q h).toLinearMap = LinearMap.id
proof:
:= by
  ext x; exact reindex_self h x

name: Operad.Conv.apply_reindex
statement:
lemma apply_reindex (f : Conv R C P) {k k' : ℕ} (e : k = k') (x : C k) :
    f k' (reindex R C e x) = reindex R P e (f k x)
proof:
:= by
  subst e; rfl

name: Operad.Conv.cterm_of_eq
statement:
lemma cterm_of_eq {m a b n : ℕ} (h : a + n + b = m) (φ : C (a + 1 + b) →ₗ[R] P (a + 1 + b))
    (ψ : C n →ₗ[R] P n) :
    cterm m a b n φ ψ
      = (reindex R P h).toLinearMap ∘ₗ compT a b ∘ₗ TensorProduct.map φ ψ ∘ₗ
          NSCooperad.decomp a b n ∘ₗ (reindex R C h.symm).toLinearMap
proof:
:=
  dif_pos h

name: Operad.Conv.cterm_of_ne
statement:
lemma cterm_of_ne {m a b n : ℕ} (h : a + n + b ≠ m) (φ : C (a + 1 + b) →ₗ[R] P (a + 1 + b))
    (ψ : C n →ₗ[R] P n) : cterm m a b n φ ψ = 0
proof:
:=
  dif_neg h

name: Operad.Conv.convTerm_eq_cterm
statement:
lemma convTerm_eq_cterm (f g : Conv R C P) (m a n b : ℕ) :
    convTerm f g m a n b = cterm m a b n (f (a + 1 + b)) (g n)
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.Conv.cterm_add_left
statement:
lemma cterm_add_left (m a b n : ℕ) (φ₁ φ₂ : C (a + 1 + b) →ₗ[R] P (a + 1 + b))
    (ψ : C n →ₗ[R] P n) :
    cterm m a b n (φ₁ + φ₂) ψ = cterm m a b n φ₁ ψ + cterm m a b n φ₂ ψ
proof:
:= by
  by_cases h : a + n + b = m
  · simp only [cterm_of_eq h, TensorProduct.map_add_left, LinearMap.add_comp,
      LinearMap.comp_add]
  · simp only [cterm_of_ne h, add_zero]

name: Operad.Conv.cterm_add_right
statement:
lemma cterm_add_right (m a b n : ℕ) (φ : C (a + 1 + b) →ₗ[R] P (a + 1 + b))
    (ψ₁ ψ₂ : C n →ₗ[R] P n) :
    cterm m a b n φ (ψ₁ + ψ₂) = cterm m a b n φ ψ₁ + cterm m a b n φ ψ₂
proof:
:= by
  by_cases h : a + n + b = m
  · simp only [cterm_of_eq h, TensorProduct.map_add_right, LinearMap.add_comp,
      LinearMap.comp_add]
  · simp only [cterm_of_ne h, add_zero]

name: Operad.Conv.cterm_zero_left
statement:
lemma cterm_zero_left (m a b n : ℕ) (ψ : C n →ₗ[R] P n) :
    cterm m a b n (0 : C (a + 1 + b) →ₗ[R] P (a + 1 + b)) ψ = 0
proof:
:= by
  by_cases h : a + n + b = m
  · simp only [cterm_of_eq h, TensorProduct.map_zero_left, LinearMap.zero_comp,
      LinearMap.comp_zero]
  · exact cterm_of_ne h _ _

name: Operad.Conv.cterm_zero_right
statement:
lemma cterm_zero_right (m a b n : ℕ) (φ : C (a + 1 + b) →ₗ[R] P (a + 1 + b)) :
    cterm m a b n φ (0 : C n →ₗ[R] P n) = 0
proof:
:= by
  by_cases h : a + n + b = m
  · simp only [cterm_of_eq h, TensorProduct.map_zero_right, LinearMap.zero_comp,
      LinearMap.comp_zero]
  · exact cterm_of_ne h _ _

name: Operad.Conv.cterm_sum_left
statement:
lemma cterm_sum_left {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι) (m a b n : ℕ)
    (φ : ι → (C (a + 1 + b) →ₗ[R] P (a + 1 + b))) (ψ : C n →ₗ[R] P n) :
    cterm m a b n (∑ i ∈ s, φ i) ψ = ∑ i ∈ s, cterm m a b n (φ i) ψ
proof:
:=
  map_sum (ctermLeft m a b n ψ) φ s

name: Operad.Conv.cterm_sum_right
statement:
lemma cterm_sum_right {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι) (m a b n : ℕ)
    (φ : C (a + 1 + b) →ₗ[R] P (a + 1 + b)) (ψ : ι → (C n →ₗ[R] P n)) :
    cterm m a b n φ (∑ i ∈ s, ψ i) = ∑ i ∈ s, cterm m a b n φ (ψ i)
proof:
:=
  map_sum (ctermRight m a b n φ) ψ s

name: Operad.Conv.mem_decomps
statement:
@[simp] lemma mem_decomps {m : ℕ} {x : ℕ × ℕ × ℕ} :
    x ∈ decomps m ↔ x.1 + x.2.1 + x.2.2 = m
proof:
:= by
  simp only [decomps, mem_filter, mem_product, mem_range]
  omega

name: Operad.Conv.star_eq_sum
statement:
lemma star_eq_sum (f g : Conv R C P) (m : ℕ) :
    (f ⋆c g) m = ∑ x ∈ decomps m, cterm m x.1 x.2.2 x.2.1 (f (x.1 + 1 + x.2.2)) (g x.2.1)
proof:
:= by
  rw [star_apply, decomps, sum_filter, sum_product]
  refine sum_congr rfl fun a _ => ?_
  rw [sum_product]
  refine sum_congr rfl fun n _ => sum_congr rfl fun b _ => ?_
  dsimp only
  split_ifs with h
  · rfl
  · exact cterm_of_ne h _ _

name: Operad.Conv.star_star_left_eq
statement:
lemma star_star_left_eq (f g h : Conv R C P) (m : ℕ) :
    ((f ⋆c g) ⋆c h) m
      = ∑ x ∈ decomps m, ∑ y ∈ decomps (x.1 + 1 + x.2.2), lterm f g h m x y
proof:
:= by
  rw [star_eq_sum]
  refine sum_congr rfl fun x _ => ?_
  rw [star_eq_sum, cterm_sum_left]
  rfl

name: Operad.Conv.star_star_right_eq
statement:
lemma star_star_right_eq (f g h : Conv R C P) (m : ℕ) :
    (f ⋆c (g ⋆c h)) m = ∑ x ∈ decomps m, ∑ y ∈ decomps x.2.1, rterm f g h m x y
proof:
:= by
  rw [star_eq_sum]
  refine sum_congr rfl fun x _ => ?_
  rw [star_eq_sum, cterm_sum_right]
  rfl

name: Operad.Conv.sum_split3
statement:
lemma sum_split3 {M : Type*} [AddCommMonoid M] (x : ℕ × ℕ × ℕ) (s : Finset (ℕ × ℕ × ℕ))
    (F : ℕ × ℕ × ℕ → M) :
    ∑ y ∈ s, F y
      = ∑ y ∈ s.filter (fun y => y.1 ≤ x.1 ∧ x.1 < y.1 + y.2.1), F y
        + ∑ y ∈ s.filter (fun y => x.1 < y.1), F y
        + ∑ y ∈ s.filter (fun y => y.1 + y.2.1 ≤ x.1), F y
proof:
:= by
  simp only [sum_filter, ← sum_add_distrib]
  refine sum_congr rfl fun y _ => ?_
  by_cases h1 : y.1 ≤ x.1 ∧ x.1 < y.1 + y.2.1
  · rw [if_pos h1, if_neg (by omega), if_neg (by omega), add_zero, add_zero]
  · by_cases h2 : x.1 < y.1
    · rw [if_neg h1, if_pos h2, if_neg (by omega), zero_add, add_zero]
    · rw [if_neg h1, if_neg h2, if_pos (by omega), zero_add, zero_add]

name: Operad.Conv.nested_term
statement:
theorem nested_term {a b c d p : ℕ} (m : ℕ) (hm : a + (c + p + d) + b = m)
    (φ : C (a + 1 + b) →ₗ[R] P (a + 1 + b)) (χ : C (c + 1 + d) →ₗ[R] P (c + 1 + d))
    (ψ : C p →ₗ[R] P p) :
    cterm m (a + c) (d + b) p (cterm (a + c + 1 + (d + b)) a b (c + 1 + d) φ χ) ψ
      = cterm m a b (c + p + d) φ (cterm (c + p + d) c d p χ ψ)
proof:
:= by
  subst hm
  have e1 : a + c + 1 + (d + b) = a + (c + 1 + d) + b := by omega
  have e2 : a + (c + p + d) + b = a + c + p + (d + b) := by omega
  rw [cterm_of_eq e2.symm, cterm_of_eq e1.symm, cterm_of_eq rfl, cterm_of_eq rfl]
  simp only [reindex_toLinearMap_self, LinearMap.id_comp, LinearMap.comp_id]
  
  let D : C (a + (c + p + d) + b) →ₗ[R] (C (a + 1 + b) ⊗[R] C (c + 1 + d)) ⊗[R] C p :=
    LinearMap.rTensor (C p)
        (NSCooperad.decomp a b (c + 1 + d) ∘ₗ (reindex R C e1).toLinearMap) ∘ₗ
      NSCooperad.decomp (a + c) (d + b) p ∘ₗ (reindex R C e2).toLinearMap
  let Φ₁ : (C (a + 1 + b) ⊗[R] C (c + 1 + d)) ⊗[R] C p →ₗ[R] P (a + (c + p + d) + b) :=
    (reindex R P e2.symm).toLinearMap ∘ₗ compT (a + c) (d + b) ∘ₗ
      TensorProduct.map ((reindex R P e1.symm).toLinearMap ∘ₗ compT a b ∘ₗ
        TensorProduct.map φ χ) ψ
  let Φ₂ : (C (a + 1 + b) ⊗[R] C (c + 1 + d)) ⊗[R] C p →ₗ[R] P (a + (c + p + d) + b) :=
    compT a b ∘ₗ TensorProduct.map φ (compT c d ∘ₗ TensorProduct.map χ ψ) ∘ₗ
      (TensorProduct.assoc R (C (a + 1 + b)) (C (c + 1 + d)) (C p)).toLinearMap
  have hΦ : Φ₁ = Φ₂ := by
    refine TensorProduct.ext_threefold fun x y z => ?_
    simp only [Φ₁, Φ₂, LinearMap.comp_apply, TensorProduct.map_tmul, compT_tmul,
      LinearEquiv.coe_coe, TensorProduct.assoc_tmul]
    exact NSOperad.comp_assoc_seq a b c d (φ x) (χ y) (ψ z)
  calc _ = Φ₁ ∘ₗ D := by
        ext x
        simp only [Φ₁, D, LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearMap.map_rTensor, LinearMap.comp_assoc]
    _ = Φ₂ ∘ₗ D := by rw [hΦ]
    _ = _ := by
        ext x
        have hco := LinearMap.congr_fun
          (NSCooperad.decomp_assoc_seq (R := R) (C := C) a b c d p) x
        simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearEquiv.coe_coe] at hco
        simp only [Φ₂, D, LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearEquiv.coe_coe]
        rw [← hco, LinearMap.map_lTensor, LinearMap.comp_assoc]

name: Operad.Conv.nested_term'
statement:
theorem nested_term' (f g h : Conv R C P) (m a b c d p A N B A' N' B' A₂ N₂ B₂ C₂ P₂ D₂ : ℕ)
    (hA : A = a + c) (hN : N = p) (hB : B = d + b) (hA' : A' = a) (hN' : N' = c + 1 + d)
    (hB' : B' = b) (hA₂ : A₂ = a) (hN₂ : N₂ = c + p + d) (hB₂ : B₂ = b) (hC₂ : C₂ = c)
    (hP₂ : P₂ = p) (hD₂ : D₂ = d) (hm : a + (c + p + d) + b = m) :
    lterm f g h m (A, N, B) (A', N', B') = rterm f g h m (A₂, N₂, B₂) (C₂, P₂, D₂)
proof:
:= by
  subst_vars
  exact nested_term _ rfl _ _ _

name: Operad.Conv.sum_nested
statement:
lemma sum_nested (f g h : Conv R C P) (m : ℕ) :
    ∑ x ∈ decomps m, ∑ y ∈ (decomps (x.1 + 1 + x.2.2)).filter
        (fun y => y.1 ≤ x.1 ∧ x.1 < y.1 + y.2.1), lterm f g h m x y
      = ∑ x ∈ decomps m, ∑ y ∈ decomps x.2.1, rterm f g h m x y
proof:
:= by
  rw [sum_sigma', sum_sigma']
  refine sum_nbij'
    (fun q => ⟨(q.2.1, q.1.1 - q.2.1 + q.1.2.1 + (q.2.1 + q.2.2.1 - 1 - q.1.1), q.2.2.2),
      (q.1.1 - q.2.1, q.1.2.1, q.2.1 + q.2.2.1 - 1 - q.1.1)⟩)
    (fun q => ⟨(q.1.1 + q.2.1, q.2.2.1, q.2.2.2 + q.1.2.2),
      (q.1.1, q.2.1 + 1 + q.2.2.2, q.1.2.2)⟩) ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_
  · rintro ⟨⟨A, N, B⟩, ⟨A', N', B'⟩⟩ hq
    simp only [mem_sigma, mem_decomps, mem_filter, and_true] at hq ⊢
    omega
  · rintro ⟨⟨A, N, B⟩, ⟨C₂, P₂, D₂⟩⟩ hq
    simp only [mem_sigma, mem_decomps, mem_filter] at hq ⊢
    omega
  · rintro ⟨⟨A, N, B⟩, ⟨A', N', B'⟩⟩ hq
    simp only [mem_sigma, mem_decomps, mem_filter] at hq
    simp only [Sigma.mk.injEq, Prod.mk.injEq, heq_eq_eq, and_true, true_and]
    omega
  · rintro ⟨⟨A, N, B⟩, ⟨C₂, P₂, D₂⟩⟩ hq
    simp only [mem_sigma, mem_decomps] at hq
    simp only [Sigma.mk.injEq, Prod.mk.injEq, heq_eq_eq, and_true, true_and]
    omega
  · rintro ⟨⟨A, N, B⟩, ⟨A', N', B'⟩⟩ hq
    simp only [mem_sigma, mem_decomps, mem_filter] at hq
    dsimp only
    exact nested_term' f g h m A' B' (A - A') (A' + N' - 1 - A) N A N B A' N' B' _ _ _ _ _ _
      (by omega) rfl (by omega) rfl (by omega) rfl rfl (by omega) rfl rfl rfl rfl (by omega)

name: Operad.Conv.parallel_term
statement:
theorem parallel_term (f : Conv R C P) {a b c n p : ℕ} (m : ℕ) (hm : a + n + b + p + c = m)
    (X : C n →ₗ[R] P n) (Y : C p →ₗ[R] P p) :
    cterm m (a + n + b) c p
        (cterm (a + n + b + 1 + c) a (b + 1 + c) n (f (a + 1 + (b + 1 + c))) X) Y
      = cterm m a (b + p + c) n
          (cterm (a + 1 + (b + p + c)) (a + 1 + b) c p (f (a + 1 + b + 1 + c)) Y) X
proof:
:= by
  subst hm
  have k1 : a + n + (b + 1 + c) = a + n + b + 1 + c := by omega
  have l1 : a + 1 + b + p + c = a + 1 + (b + p + c) := by omega
  have l2 : a + n + (b + p + c) = a + n + b + p + c := by omega
  have q2 : a + 1 + b + 1 + c = a + 1 + (b + 1 + c) := by omega
  rw [cterm_of_eq rfl, cterm_of_eq k1, cterm_of_eq l2, cterm_of_eq l1]
  simp only [reindex_toLinearMap_self, LinearMap.id_comp, LinearMap.comp_id]
  
  let E : C (a + n + b + p + c) →ₗ[R] (C (a + 1 + b + 1 + c) ⊗[R] C p) ⊗[R] C n :=
    LinearMap.rTensor (C n)
        (NSCooperad.decomp (a + 1 + b) c p ∘ₗ (reindex R C l1.symm).toLinearMap) ∘ₗ
      NSCooperad.decomp a (b + p + c) n ∘ₗ (reindex R C l2.symm).toLinearMap
  let Ψ₁ : (C (a + 1 + b + 1 + c) ⊗[R] C p) ⊗[R] C n →ₗ[R] P (a + n + b + p + c) :=
    compT (a + n + b) c ∘ₗ
      TensorProduct.map ((reindex R P k1).toLinearMap ∘ₗ compT a (b + 1 + c) ∘ₗ
        TensorProduct.map (f (a + 1 + (b + 1 + c))) X) Y ∘ₗ
      (swapLast R (C (a + 1 + (b + 1 + c))) (C p) (C n)).toLinearMap ∘ₗ
      LinearMap.rTensor (C n)
        (TensorProduct.congr (reindex R C q2) (LinearEquiv.refl R (C p))).toLinearMap
  let Ψ₂ : (C (a + 1 + b + 1 + c) ⊗[R] C p) ⊗[R] C n →ₗ[R] P (a + n + b + p + c) :=
    (reindex R P l2).toLinearMap ∘ₗ compT a (b + p + c) ∘ₗ
      TensorProduct.map ((reindex R P l1).toLinearMap ∘ₗ compT (a + 1 + b) c ∘ₗ
        TensorProduct.map (f (a + 1 + b + 1 + c)) Y) X
  have hΨ : Ψ₁ = Ψ₂ := by
    refine TensorProduct.ext_threefold fun x y z => ?_
    simp only [Ψ₁, Ψ₂, swapLast, LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearMap.rTensor_tmul,
      TensorProduct.map_tmul, compT_tmul, LinearEquiv.coe_coe, LinearEquiv.trans_apply,
      TensorProduct.congr_tmul, LinearEquiv.refl_apply, TensorProduct.assoc_tmul,
      TensorProduct.comm_tmul, TensorProduct.assoc_symm_tmul, apply_reindex]
    rw [← NSOperad.comp_assoc_par a b c (f (a + 1 + b + 1 + c) x) (X z) (Y y), reindex_reindex,
      reindex_self]
  calc _ = Ψ₁ ∘ₗ E := by
        ext x
        have hco := LinearMap.congr_fun
          (NSCooperad.decomp_assoc_par (R := R) (C := C) a b c n p) x
        simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearEquiv.coe_coe] at hco
        simp only [Ψ₁, E, LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearEquiv.coe_coe]
        rw [← LinearMap.rTensor_comp_apply, ← hco, LinearMap.map_rTensor]
        simp only [LinearMap.comp_assoc]
    _ = Ψ₂ ∘ₗ E := by rw [hΨ]
    _ = _ := by
        ext x
        simp only [Ψ₂, E, LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearMap.map_rTensor, LinearMap.comp_assoc]

name: Operad.Conv.parallel_term'
statement:
theorem parallel_term' (f g h : Conv R C P)
    (m a b c n p A N B A' N' B' A₂ N₂ B₂ A₂' N₂' B₂' : ℕ)
    (hA : A = a + n + b) (hN : N = p) (hB : B = c) (hA' : A' = a) (hN' : N' = n)
    (hB' : B' = b + 1 + c) (hA₂ : A₂ = a) (hN₂ : N₂ = n) (hB₂ : B₂ = b + p + c)
    (hA₂' : A₂' = a + 1 + b) (hN₂' : N₂' = p) (hB₂' : B₂' = c) (hm : a + n + b + p + c = m) :
    lterm f g h m (A, N, B) (A', N', B') = lterm f h g m (A₂, N₂, B₂) (A₂', N₂', B₂')
proof:
:= by
  subst_vars
  exact parallel_term f _ rfl _ _

name: Operad.Conv.sum_after_eq_sum_before
statement:
lemma sum_after_eq_sum_before (f g h : Conv R C P) (m : ℕ) :
    ∑ x ∈ decomps m, ∑ y ∈ (decomps (x.1 + 1 + x.2.2)).filter (fun y => y.1 + y.2.1 ≤ x.1),
        lterm f g h m x y
      = ∑ x ∈ decomps m, ∑ y ∈ (decomps (x.1 + 1 + x.2.2)).filter (fun y => x.1 < y.1),
          lterm f h g m x y
proof:
:= by
  rw [sum_sigma', sum_sigma']
  refine sum_nbij'
    (fun q => ⟨(q.2.1, q.2.2.1, q.1.1 - q.2.1 - q.2.2.1 + q.1.2.1 + q.1.2.2),
      (q.1.1 + 1 - q.2.2.1, q.1.2.1, q.1.2.2)⟩)
    (fun q => ⟨(q.2.1 - 1 + q.1.2.1, q.2.2.1, q.2.2.2),
      (q.1.1, q.1.2.1, q.2.1 - q.1.1 + q.2.2.2)⟩) ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_
  · rintro ⟨⟨A, N, B⟩, ⟨A', N', B'⟩⟩ hq
    simp only [mem_sigma, mem_decomps, mem_filter] at hq ⊢
    omega
  · rintro ⟨⟨A, N, B⟩, ⟨A', N', B'⟩⟩ hq
    simp only [mem_sigma, mem_decomps, mem_filter] at hq ⊢
    omega
  · rintro ⟨⟨A, N, B⟩, ⟨A', N', B'⟩⟩ hq
    simp only [mem_sigma, mem_decomps, mem_filter] at hq
    simp only [Sigma.mk.injEq, Prod.mk.injEq, heq_eq_eq, and_true, true_and]
    omega
  · rintro ⟨⟨A, N, B⟩, ⟨A', N', B'⟩⟩ hq
    simp only [mem_sigma, mem_decomps, mem_filter] at hq
    simp only [Sigma.mk.injEq, Prod.mk.injEq, heq_eq_eq, and_true, true_and]
    omega
  · rintro ⟨⟨A, N, B⟩, ⟨A', N', B'⟩⟩ hq
    simp only [mem_sigma, mem_decomps, mem_filter] at hq
    dsimp only
    exact parallel_term' f g h m A' (A - A' - N') B N' N A N B A' N' B' _ _ _ _ _ _
      (by omega) rfl rfl rfl rfl (by omega) rfl rfl (by omega) (by omega) rfl rfl (by omega)

name: Operad.Conv.associator_eq
statement:
lemma associator_eq (f g h : Conv R C P) (m : ℕ) :
    ((f ⋆c g) ⋆c h) m - (f ⋆c (g ⋆c h)) m = beforePart f g h m + afterPart f g h m
proof:
:= by
  rw [star_star_left_eq, star_star_right_eq, ← sum_nested]
  simp only [fun x => sum_split3 x (decomps (x.1 + 1 + x.2.2)) (lterm f g h m x),
    sum_add_distrib, beforePart, afterPart]
  abel

name: Operad.Conv.star_assoc_symm
statement:
theorem star_assoc_symm (f g h : Conv R C P) :
    (f ⋆c g) ⋆c h - f ⋆c (g ⋆c h) = (f ⋆c h) ⋆c g - f ⋆c (h ⋆c g)
proof:
:= by
  funext m
  show ((f ⋆c g) ⋆c h) m - (f ⋆c (g ⋆c h)) m = ((f ⋆c h) ⋆c g) m - (f ⋆c (h ⋆c g)) m
  rw [associator_eq, associator_eq, afterPart, afterPart, sum_after_eq_sum_before,
    sum_after_eq_sum_before]
  exact add_comm _ _

name: Operad.ConvAlg.mul_def
statement: lemma mul_def (f g : ConvAlg R C P) : f * g = of (Conv.star (of.symm f) (of.symm g))
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.ConvAlg.lie_def
statement: lemma lie_def (f g : ConvAlg R C P) : ⁅f, g⁆ = f * g - g * f
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.ConvAlg.lie_eq_bracket
statement:
lemma lie_eq_bracket (f g : Conv R C P) :
    ⁅of f, of g⁆ = of (Conv.bracket f g)
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.Conv.compT_tmul
statement:
@[simp] lemma compT_tmul (a b : ℕ) {n : ℕ} (α : P (a + 1 + b)) (β : P n) :
    compT (R := R) a b (α ⊗ₜ[R] β) = NSOperad.comp (R := R) a b α β
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.Conv.convTerm_of_ne
statement:
lemma convTerm_of_ne (f g : Conv R C P) {m a n b : ℕ} (h : a + n + b ≠ m) :
    convTerm f g m a n b = 0
proof: := dif_neg h

name: Operad.Conv.convTerm_of_eq
statement:
lemma convTerm_of_eq (f g : Conv R C P) {m a n b : ℕ} (h : a + n + b = m) :
    convTerm f g m a n b
      = (reindex R P h).toLinearMap ∘ₗ compT a b ∘ₗ
          TensorProduct.map (f (a + 1 + b)) (g n) ∘ₗ NSCooperad.decomp a b n ∘ₗ
          (reindex R C h.symm).toLinearMap
proof: := dif_pos h

name: Operad.Conv.star_apply
statement:
lemma star_apply (f g : Conv R C P) (m : ℕ) :
    (f ⋆c g) m = ∑ a ∈ Finset.range (m + 1), ∑ n ∈ Finset.range (m + 1),
      ∑ b ∈ Finset.range (m + 1), convTerm f g m a n b
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.Conv.convTerm_add_left
statement:
lemma convTerm_add_left (f₁ f₂ g : Conv R C P) (m a n b : ℕ) :
    convTerm (f₁ + f₂) g m a n b = convTerm f₁ g m a n b + convTerm f₂ g m a n b
proof:
:= by
  by_cases h : a + n + b = m
  · rw [convTerm_of_eq _ _ h, convTerm_of_eq _ _ h, convTerm_of_eq _ _ h]
    show _ = _
    rw [show (f₁ + f₂) (a + 1 + b) = f₁ (a + 1 + b) + f₂ (a + 1 + b) from rfl,
      TensorProduct.map_add_left]
    ext x
    simp [LinearMap.add_comp, LinearMap.comp_add]
  · rw [convTerm_of_ne _ _ h, convTerm_of_ne _ _ h, convTerm_of_ne _ _ h, add_zero]

name: Operad.Conv.convTerm_add_right
statement:
lemma convTerm_add_right (f g₁ g₂ : Conv R C P) (m a n b : ℕ) :
    convTerm f (g₁ + g₂) m a n b = convTerm f g₁ m a n b + convTerm f g₂ m a n b
proof:
:= by
  by_cases h : a + n + b = m
  · rw [convTerm_of_eq _ _ h, convTerm_of_eq _ _ h, convTerm_of_eq _ _ h]
    rw [show (g₁ + g₂) n = g₁ n + g₂ n from rfl, TensorProduct.map_add_right]
    ext x
    simp [LinearMap.add_comp, LinearMap.comp_add]
  · rw [convTerm_of_ne _ _ h, convTerm_of_ne _ _ h, convTerm_of_ne _ _ h, add_zero]

name: Operad.Conv.convTerm_smul_left
statement:
lemma convTerm_smul_left (r : R) (f g : Conv R C P) (m a n b : ℕ) :
    convTerm (r • f) g m a n b = r • convTerm f g m a n b
proof:
:= by
  by_cases h : a + n + b = m
  · rw [convTerm_of_eq _ _ h, convTerm_of_eq _ _ h]
    rw [show (r • f) (a + 1 + b) = r • f (a + 1 + b) from rfl, TensorProduct.map_smul_left]
    ext x
    simp [LinearMap.smul_comp, LinearMap.comp_smul]
  · rw [convTerm_of_ne _ _ h, convTerm_of_ne _ _ h, smul_zero]

name: Operad.Conv.convTerm_smul_right
statement:
lemma convTerm_smul_right (r : R) (f g : Conv R C P) (m a n b : ℕ) :
    convTerm f (r • g) m a n b = r • convTerm f g m a n b
proof:
:= by
  by_cases h : a + n + b = m
  · rw [convTerm_of_eq _ _ h, convTerm_of_eq _ _ h]
    rw [show (r • g) n = r • g n from rfl, TensorProduct.map_smul_right]
    ext x
    simp [LinearMap.smul_comp, LinearMap.comp_smul]
  · rw [convTerm_of_ne _ _ h, convTerm_of_ne _ _ h, smul_zero]

name: Operad.Conv.star_add_left
statement: theorem star_add_left (f₁ f₂ g : Conv R C P) : (f₁ + f₂) ⋆c g = f₁ ⋆c g + f₂ ⋆c g
proof:
:= by
  funext m
  simp only [star_apply, convTerm_add_left, Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  rfl

name: Operad.Conv.star_add_right
statement: theorem star_add_right (f g₁ g₂ : Conv R C P) : f ⋆c (g₁ + g₂) = f ⋆c g₁ + f ⋆c g₂
proof:
:= by
  funext m
  simp only [star_apply, convTerm_add_right, Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  rfl

name: Operad.Conv.smul_sum_conv
statement:
private lemma smul_sum_conv (r : R) (m : ℕ) (s : Finset ℕ) (F : ℕ → (C m →ₗ[R] P m)) :
    r • (∑ i ∈ s, F i) = ∑ i ∈ s, r • F i
proof:
:=
  map_sum (LinearMap.lsmul R (C m →ₗ[R] P m) r) F s

name: Operad.Conv.star_smul_left
statement: theorem star_smul_left (r : R) (f g : Conv R C P) : (r • f) ⋆c g = r • (f ⋆c g)
proof:
:= by
  funext m
  show ∑ a ∈ Finset.range (m + 1), ∑ n ∈ Finset.range (m + 1), ∑ b ∈ Finset.range (m + 1),
      convTerm (r • f) g m a n b
    = r • (∑ a ∈ Finset.range (m + 1), ∑ n ∈ Finset.range (m + 1),
        ∑ b ∈ Finset.range (m + 1), convTerm f g m a n b)
  rw [smul_sum_conv]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun a _ => ?_
  rw [smul_sum_conv]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun n _ => ?_
  rw [smul_sum_conv]
  exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun b _ => convTerm_smul_left r f g m a n b

name: Operad.Conv.star_smul_right
statement: theorem star_smul_right (r : R) (f g : Conv R C P) : f ⋆c (r • g) = r • (f ⋆c g)
proof:
:= by
  funext m
  show ∑ a ∈ Finset.range (m + 1), ∑ n ∈ Finset.range (m + 1), ∑ b ∈ Finset.range (m + 1),
      convTerm f (r • g) m a n b
    = r • (∑ a ∈ Finset.range (m + 1), ∑ n ∈ Finset.range (m + 1),
        ∑ b ∈ Finset.range (m + 1), convTerm f g m a n b)
  rw [smul_sum_conv]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun a _ => ?_
  rw [smul_sum_conv]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun n _ => ?_
  rw [smul_sum_conv]
  exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun b _ => convTerm_smul_right r f g m a n b

name: Operad.Conv.star_zero_left
statement: @[simp] theorem star_zero_left (g : Conv R C P) : (0 : Conv R C P) ⋆c g = 0
proof:
:= by
  have h := star_smul_left (0 : R) (0 : Conv R C P) g
  rwa [zero_smul, zero_smul] at h

name: Operad.Conv.star_zero_right
statement: @[simp] theorem star_zero_right (f : Conv R C P) : f ⋆c (0 : Conv R C P) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have h := star_smul_right (0 : R) f 0
  rwa [zero_smul, zero_smul] at h

name: Operad.Conv.bracket_antisymm
statement: theorem bracket_antisymm (f g : Conv R C P) : bracket f g = - bracket g f
proof:
:= by
  rw [bracket, bracket, neg_sub]

name: Operad.Conv.bracket_self
statement: @[simp] theorem bracket_self (f : Conv R C P) : bracket f f = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [bracket, sub_self]

name: Operad.Conv.bracket_add_left
statement:
theorem bracket_add_left (f₁ f₂ g : Conv R C P) :
    bracket (f₁ + f₂) g = bracket f₁ g + bracket f₂ g
proof:
:= by
  rw [bracket, bracket, bracket, star_add_left, star_add_right]
  abel

name: Operad.Conv.bracket_add_right
statement:
theorem bracket_add_right (f g₁ g₂ : Conv R C P) :
    bracket f (g₁ + g₂) = bracket f g₁ + bracket f g₂
proof:
:= by
  rw [bracket, bracket, bracket, star_add_left, star_add_right]
  abel

name: Operad.Conv.convTerm_ass
statement:
theorem convTerm_ass (f g : Conv R (Ass R) (Ass R)) {m a n b : ℕ} (h : a + n + b = m) (x : R) :
    convTerm f g m a n b x = f (a + 1 + b) x * g n 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [convTerm_of_eq _ _ h]
  simp only [LinearMap.coe_comp, Function.comp_apply, LinearEquiv.coe_coe, reindex_ass]
  show compT a b (TensorProduct.map (f (a + 1 + b)) (g n) ((TensorProduct.rid R R).symm x)) = _
  rw [TensorProduct.rid_symm_apply, TensorProduct.map_tmul, compT_tmul]
  rfl

name: Operad.ComBin.lcomb_mem
statement: lemma lcomb_mem : lcomb ∈ monomials 3
proof: := (mem_monomials 3 _).2 ⟨by decide, by decide⟩

name: Operad.ComBin.tcomb_mem
statement: lemma tcomb_mem : tcomb ∈ monomials 3
proof: := (mem_monomials 3 _).2 ⟨by decide, by decide⟩

name: Operad.ComBin.rcomb_mem
statement: lemma rcomb_mem : rcomb ∈ monomials 3
proof: := (mem_monomials 3 _).2 ⟨by decide, by decide⟩

name: Operad.ComBin.mono3_eq
statement: lemma mono3_eq (σ : Mono (ComGen 2) 3) : σ.1 = lcomb ∨ σ.1 = tcomb ∨ σ.1 = rcomb
proof:
:= by
  have hm := (mem_monomials 3 σ.1).1 σ.2
  obtain ⟨e, f, h | h | h⟩ := mono3_cases hm.1 hm.2 <;> cases e <;> cases f <;> simp [h, lcomb,
    tcomb, rcomb]

name: Operad.ComBin.key_rcomb_lt_lcomb
statement: lemma key_rcomb_lt_lcomb : pathKey rk 3 rcomb < pathKey rk 3 lcomb
proof: := by decide

name: Operad.ComBin.key_rcomb_lt_tcomb
statement: lemma key_rcomb_lt_tcomb : pathKey rk 3 rcomb < pathKey rk 3 tcomb
proof: := by decide

name: Operad.ComBin.aug_apply
statement: lemma aug_apply {n : ℕ} (v : Mono (ComGen 2) n → K) : aug K n v = ∑ σ, v σ
proof:
:= by
  simp [aug]

name: Operad.ComBin.aug_vecOf
statement:
lemma aug_vecOf {n : ℕ} {t : LTree (ComGen 2)} (ht : t ∈ monomials n) :
    aug K n (vecOf K n t) = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [aug_apply, Finset.sum_eq_single ⟨t, ht⟩ (fun σ _ hσ => ?_) (by simp)]
  · simp [vecOf]
  · exact if_neg fun h => hσ (Subtype.ext h)

name: Operad.ComBin.vecOf_apply_ne
statement:
lemma vecOf_apply_ne {n : ℕ} {t : LTree (ComGen 2)} {σ : Mono (ComGen 2) n} (h : σ.1 ≠ t) :
    vecOf K n t σ = 0
proof: := if_neg h

name: Operad.ComBin.vecOf_apply_of_eq
statement:
lemma vecOf_apply_of_eq {n : ℕ} {t : LTree (ComGen 2)} {σ : Mono (ComGen 2) n} (h : σ.1 = t) :
    vecOf K n t σ = 1
proof: := if_pos h

name: Operad.ComBin.rel_eq_span
statement:
theorem rel_eq_span : rel K = Submodule.span K
    {vecOf K 3 lcomb - vecOf K 3 rcomb, vecOf K 3 tcomb - vecOf K 3 rcomb}
proof:
:= by
  refine le_antisymm (fun v hv => ?_) (Submodule.span_le.2 ?_)
  · have h0 : ∑ σ, v σ = 0 := by rw [← aug_apply]; exact hv
    set l : Mono (ComGen 2) 3 := ⟨lcomb, lcomb_mem⟩
    set t : Mono (ComGen 2) 3 := ⟨tcomb, tcomb_mem⟩
    set r : Mono (ComGen 2) 3 := ⟨rcomb, rcomb_mem⟩
    have huniv : (Finset.univ : Finset (Mono (ComGen 2) 3)) = {l, t, r} := by
      ext σ
      simp only [Finset.mem_univ, Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_singleton, true_iff]
      rcases mono3_eq σ with h | h | h
      · exact Or.inl (Subtype.ext h)
      · exact Or.inr (Or.inl (Subtype.ext h))
      · exact Or.inr (Or.inr (Subtype.ext h))
    have hlt : l ≠ t := fun h => by simpa [l, t, lcomb, tcomb] using congrArg Subtype.val h
    have hlr : l ≠ r := fun h => by simpa [l, r, lcomb, rcomb] using congrArg Subtype.val h
    have htr : t ≠ r := fun h => by simpa [t, r, tcomb, rcomb] using congrArg Subtype.val h
    rw [huniv, Finset.sum_insert (by simp [hlt, hlr]), Finset.sum_insert (by simp [htr]),
      Finset.sum_singleton] at h0
    have hv : v = v l • (vecOf K 3 lcomb - vecOf K 3 rcomb) +
        v t • (vecOf K 3 tcomb - vecOf K 3 rcomb) := by
      funext σ
      simp only [Pi.add_apply, Pi.smul_apply, Pi.sub_apply, smul_eq_mul]
      rcases mono3_eq σ with h | h | h
      · rw [vecOf_apply_of_eq h, vecOf_apply_ne (by rw [h]; decide),
          vecOf_apply_ne (by rw [h]; decide), show σ = l from Subtype.ext h]
        ring
      · rw [vecOf_apply_of_eq h, vecOf_apply_ne (by rw [h]; decide),
          vecOf_apply_ne (by rw [h]; decide), show σ = t from Subtype.ext h]
        ring
      · rw [vecOf_apply_of_eq h, vecOf_apply_ne (by rw [h]; decide),
          vecOf_apply_ne (by rw [h]; decide), show σ = r from Subtype.ext h]
        linear_combination h0
    rw [hv]
    exact Submodule.add_mem _ (Submodule.smul_mem _ _ (Submodule.subset_span (by simp)))
      (Submodule.smul_mem _ _ (Submodule.subset_span (by simp)))
  · rintro _ (rfl | rfl) <;>
      simp [rel, map_sub, aug_vecOf lcomb_mem, aug_vecOf tcomb_mem, aug_vecOf rcomb_mem]

name: Operad.ComBin.idealOf_le_ker
statement: theorem idealOf_le_ker (n : ℕ) : idealOf K (rel K) n ≤ LinearMap.ker (aug K n)
proof:
:= by
  refine Submodule.span_le.2 ?_
  rintro _ ⟨t, p, s, r, hr, he, rfl⟩
  rw [SetLike.mem_coe, LinearMap.mem_ker, substVec, map_sum]
  have h1 : ∀ σ : Mono (ComGen 2) 3,
      aug K n (r σ • vecOf K n (t.1.substAt p s σ.1)) = r σ := fun σ => by
    rw [map_smul, aug_vecOf (substAt_mem_monomials t.2 he σ.2), smul_eq_mul, mul_one]
  rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl fun σ _ => h1 σ, ← aug_apply]
  exact hr

name: Operad.ComBin.leads_spec
statement:
lemma leads_spec (e f : ComGen 2) :
    node e (node f (leaf 0) (leaf 1)) (leaf 2) ∈ leads ∧
      node e (node f (leaf 0) (leaf 2)) (leaf 1) ∈ leads
proof:
:= by
  cases e
  cases f
  exact ⟨Or.inl rfl, Or.inr rfl⟩

name: Operad.ComBin.normal_unique
statement:
theorem normal_unique {n : ℕ} {x y : Mono (ComGen 2) n} (hx : IsNormal leads x.1)
    (hy : IsNormal leads y.1) : x = y
proof:
:= by
  have hxm := (mem_monomials n x.1).1 x.2
  have hym := (mem_monomials n y.1).1 y.2
  obtain ⟨w, hw, -⟩ := (isNormal_iff leads_spec hxm.1 hxm.2).1 hx
  obtain ⟨w', hw', -⟩ := (isNormal_iff leads_spec hym.1 hym.2).1 hy
  have hlen : w.length = w'.length := by
    have h1 := hxm.2.length_eq
    have h2 := hym.2.length_eq
    rw [hw, labels_rightComb] at h1
    rw [hw', labels_rightComb] at h2
    simp only [List.length_range'] at h1 h2
    omega
  have : w = w' := List.ext_getElem hlen fun _ _ _ => Subsingleton.elim _ _
  exact Subtype.ext (by rw [hw, hw', this])

name: Operad.ComBin.isGroebner
statement:
theorem isGroebner : IsGroebner K rk leads (rel K) where
  mem ℓ hℓ
proof:
:= by
    rcases hℓ with rfl | rfl
    · exact lcomb_mem
    · exact tcomb_mem
  lead ℓ hℓ := by
    have hℓm : ℓ ∈ monomials 3 := by
      rcases hℓ with rfl | rfl
      · exact lcomb_mem
      · exact tcomb_mem
    have hℓr : ℓ ≠ rcomb := by rcases hℓ with rfl | rfl <;> decide
    have hkey : pathKey rk 3 rcomb < pathKey rk 3 ℓ := by
      rcases hℓ with rfl | rfl
      · exact key_rcomb_lt_lcomb
      · exact key_rcomb_lt_tcomb
    refine ⟨vecOf K 3 ℓ - vecOf K 3 rcomb, ?_, ?_, fun σ hσ hne => ?_⟩
    · simp [rel, map_sub, aug_vecOf hℓm, aug_vecOf rcomb_mem]
    · simp [vecOf, hℓr]
    · by_cases hσr : σ.1 = rcomb
      · rwa [hσr]
      · exact absurd (by simp [vecOf, hσ, hσr]) hne
  indep n v hv hN := by
    by_contra hne
    obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ : ∃ y, v y ≠ 0 := by
      by_contra h
      push Not at h
      exact hne (funext h)
    have hyN : IsNormal leads y.1 := by
      by_contra h
      exact hy (hN y h)
    have h0 : aug K n v = 0 := idealOf_le_ker n hv
    rw [aug_apply, Finset.sum_eq_single y (fun σ _ hσ => ?_) (by simp)] at h0
    · exact hy h0
    · by_contra h
      exact hσ (normal_unique (by by_contra h'; exact h (hN σ h')) hyN)

name: Operad.ComBin.isKoszul
statement: theorem isKoszul : ShuffleBar.IsKoszul K (rel K)
proof:
:=
  ShuffleBar.isKoszul K rk (isGroebner K)

name: Operad.ComBin.isKoszul_dualRel
statement: theorem isKoszul_dualRel : ShuffleBar.IsKoszul K (dualRel K (rel K))
proof:
:=
  ShuffleBar.isKoszul_dualRel (isGroebner K)

name: Operad.ComBin.isKoszul_and
statement: theorem isKoszul_and : ShuffleBar.IsKoszul K (rel K) ∧ (ComGen.rules K).IsKoszul
proof:
:=
  ⟨isKoszul K, ComGen.isKoszul⟩

name: Operad.DGOperad.d_eps
statement: lemma d_eps (x : P A) : 𝐝 (𝐩 false x - 𝐩 true x) = -(𝐩 false (𝐝 x) - 𝐩 true (𝐝 x))
proof:
:= by
  rw [map_sub, d_par, d_par]
  simp only [Bool.not_false, Bool.not_true]
  abel

name: Operad.DGOperad.eps_eps
statement:
lemma eps_eps (x : P A) :
    𝐩 false (𝐩 false x - 𝐩 true x) - 𝐩 true (𝐩 false x - 𝐩 true x) = x
proof:
:= by
  simp only [map_sub, par_par, if_true, Bool.false_eq_true, if_false, Bool.true_eq_false,
    sub_zero, zero_sub, sub_neg_eq_add]
  exact par_add x

name: Operad.DGOperad.comp_cycle
statement:
lemma comp_cycle (i : A) {x : P A} {y : P B} (hx : 𝐝 x = 0) (hy : 𝐝 y = 0) :
    𝐝 (𝐜 i x y) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [d_comp, hx, hy, map_zero, LinearMap.zero_apply, map_zero, add_zero]

name: Operad.DGOperad.comp_boundary_left
statement:
lemma comp_boundary_left (i : A) (w : P A) {y : P B} (hy : 𝐝 y = 0) :
    𝐜 i (𝐝 w) y = 𝐝 (𝐜 i w y)
proof:
:= by
  rw [d_comp, hy, map_zero, add_zero]

name: Operad.DGOperad.comp_boundary_right
statement:
lemma comp_boundary_right (i : A) {x : P A} (hx : 𝐝 x = 0) (w : P B) :
    𝐜 i x (𝐝 w) = 𝐝 (𝐜 i (𝐩 false x - 𝐩 true x) w)
proof:
:= by
  rw [d_comp, d_eps, hx]
  simp only [map_zero, sub_zero, neg_zero, LinearMap.zero_apply, zero_add]
  rw [eps_eps]

name: Operad.DGOperad.cls_congr
statement:
lemma cls_congr {x x' : P A} (h : x = x') (hx : 𝐝 x = 0) (hx' : 𝐝 x' = 0) :
    cls x hx = cls x' hx'
proof:
:= by
  subst h
  rfl

name: Operad.DGOperad.exists_cls
statement: lemma exists_cls (X : HomologyOp R P A) : ∃ (x : P A) (hx : 𝐝 x = 0), cls x hx = X
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨⟨x, hx⟩, rfl⟩ := Homology.mk_surjective _ X
  exact ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩

name: Operad.DGOperad.cls_add
statement:
lemma cls_add {x y : P A} (hx : 𝐝 x = 0) (hy : 𝐝 y = 0) :
    cls x hx + cls y hy = cls (x + y) (by rw [map_add, hx, hy, add_zero])
proof:
:=
  (map_add (Homology.mk 𝐝) ⟨x, hx⟩ ⟨y, hy⟩).symm

name: Operad.DGOperad.cls_smul
statement:
lemma cls_smul (c : R) {x : P A} (hx : 𝐝 x = 0) :
    c • cls x hx = cls (c • x) (by rw [map_smul, hx, smul_zero])
proof:
:=
  (map_smul (Homology.mk 𝐝) c ⟨x, hx⟩).symm

name: Operad.DGOperad.cls_zero
statement: lemma cls_zero : cls (0 : P A) (map_zero (𝐝 : P A →ₗ[R] P A)) = 0
proof: := map_zero (Homology.mk 𝐝)

name: Operad.DGOperad.cls_boundary
statement: lemma cls_boundary (w : P A) : cls (𝐝 w) (d_d w) = 0
proof:
:=
  Homology.mk_boundary d_d w

name: Operad.DGOperad.homMap_cls
statement:
lemma homMap_cls (f : P A →ₗ[R] P B) (hc : ∀ x, 𝐝 x = 0 → 𝐝 (f x) = 0)
    (hb : ∀ w, ∃ w', f (𝐝 w) = 𝐝 w') (x : P A) (hx : 𝐝 x = 0) :
    homMap f hc hb (cls x hx) = cls (f x) (hc x hx)
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.DGOperad.hcomp_cls
statement:
lemma hcomp_cls (i : A) (x : P A) (hx : 𝐝 x = 0) (y : P B) (hy : 𝐝 y = 0) :
    hcomp i (cls x hx) (cls y hy) = cls (𝐜 i x y) (comp_cycle i hx hy)
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.DGOperad.d_par_cycle
statement: lemma d_par_cycle (b : Bool) {x : P A} (hx : 𝐝 x = 0) : 𝐝 (𝐩 b x) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [d_par, hx, map_zero]

name: Operad.DGOperad.par_boundary
statement: lemma par_boundary (b : Bool) (w : P A) : ∃ w', 𝐩 b (𝐝 w) = 𝐝 w'
proof:
:=
  ⟨𝐩 (!b) w, by rw [d_par, Bool.not_not]⟩

name: Operad.DGOperad.map_cycle
statement:
lemma map_cycle (e : A ≃ B) {x : P A} (hx : 𝐝 x = 0) :
    𝐝 (GrOperad.map (R := R) (P := P) e x) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [← map_d, hx, map_zero]

name: Operad.DGOperad.map_boundary
statement:
lemma map_boundary (e : A ≃ B) (w : P A) :
    ∃ w', GrOperad.map (R := R) (P := P) e (𝐝 w) = 𝐝 w'
proof:
:=
  ⟨GrOperad.map (R := R) (P := P) e w, map_d e w⟩

name: Operad.GrOperad.Inv.counit_tw
statement:
lemma counit_tw (e : Bool) (x : C Unit) :
    GrCooperad.counit (R := R) (GrSpecies.tw (R := R) e x) = GrCooperad.counit (R := R) x
proof:
:= by
  have h := LinearMap.congr_fun (GrCooperad.counit_par (R := R) (C := C)) x
  simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearMap.zero_apply] at h
  rw [GrSpecies.tw_apply, map_add, map_smul, h, smul_zero, add_zero]
  have h' := congrArg (GrCooperad.counit (R := R) (C := C)) (GrSpecies.par_add (R := R) x)
  rwa [map_add, h, add_zero] at h'

name: Operad.GrOperad.Inv.qmap_congr
statement:
lemma qmap_congr {A B : Type} [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] [Fintype B] [DecidableEq B]
    {e e' : A ≃ B} (h : ∀ a, e a = e' a) (x : Q A) :
    GrOperad.map (R := R) e x = GrOperad.map (R := R) e' x
proof:
:= by
  rw [Equiv.ext h]

name: Operad.GrOperad.Inv.card_sOut_ne
statement: lemma card_sOut_ne {S : Finset X} (hS : S ≠ Finset.univ) : IsEmpty (Unit ≃ SOut S)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x, -, hx⟩ := Finset.exists_of_ssubset (Finset.ssubset_univ_iff.2 hS)
  refine ⟨fun e => ?_⟩
  have h1 : e.symm none = e.symm (some ⟨x, hx⟩) := Subsingleton.elim _ _
  exact Option.some_ne_none _ (e.symm.injective h1).symm

name: Operad.GrOperad.Inv.star_counit_left
statement:
theorem star_counit_left (G q : Inv R (ConvOp R C Q)) (g₀ : Q Unit)
    (hG : ∀ (A : Type) [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] (e : Unit ≃ A) (x : C A),
      toLin (G.1 A) x = GrCooperad.counit (R := R) (SymSpecies.map (R := R) e.symm x)
        • GrOperad.map (R := R) e g₀)
    (hG0 : ∀ (A : Type) [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A], IsEmpty (Unit ≃ A) → G.1 A = 0)
    {p : Bool} (hq : IsPar p q) [Nonempty X] (c : C X) :
    toLin ((star R _ G q).1 X) c
      = GrOperad.map (R := R) (leftUnitEquiv X) (GrOperad.comp (R := R) () g₀ (toLin (q.1 X) c))
proof:
:= by
  rw [star_apply, toLin_sum, LinearMap.coe_sum, Finset.sum_apply,
    Finset.sum_eq_single (Finset.univ : Finset X)]
  · 
    set U : Finset X := Finset.univ
    have hq' : IsParC p (q.1 (SIn U)) := parC_eq_self_iff.1 (hq _)
    show GrOperad.map (R := R) (splitEquiv U) (mu none (kap (G.1 (SOut U)) (q.1 (SIn U))
      (GrCooperad.decomp (R := R) none (SymSpecies.map (R := R) (splitEquiv U).symm c)))) = _
    rw [kap_hom _ hq']
    set v := SymSpecies.map (R := R) (splitEquiv U).symm c
    
    have hd := LinearMap.congr_fun (GrCooperad.decomp_map (R := R) (C := C) (univOut (X := X))
      (Equiv.refl (SIn U)) ()) (SymSpecies.map (R := R)
        (compEquiv (univOut (X := X)) (Equiv.refl (SIn U)) ()).symm v)
    simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply, ← SymSpecies.map_trans, Equiv.symm_trans_self,
      SymSpecies.map_refl] at hd
    erw [hd]
    set v₀ := SymSpecies.map (R := R) (compEquiv (univOut (X := X)) (Equiv.refl (SIn U)) ()).symm v
    have hcl := LinearMap.congr_fun (GrCooperad.counit_left (R := R) (C := C) (B := SIn U))
      (SymSpecies.map (R := R) (leftUnitEquiv (SIn U)) v₀)
    simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply, ← SymSpecies.map_trans, Equiv.self_trans_symm,
      SymSpecies.map_refl, LinearEquiv.coe_coe, LinearMap.id_apply] at hcl
    
    have key : ∀ t : C Unit ⊗[R] C (SIn U),
        mu (R := R) none (TensorProduct.map (toLin (G.1 (SOut U)) ∘ₗ GrSpecies.tw (R := R) p)
          (toLin (q.1 (SIn U))) (TensorProduct.map (SymSpecies.map (R := R) (univOut (X := X)))
            (SymSpecies.map (R := R) (Equiv.refl (SIn U))) t))
        = GrOperad.map (R := R) (compEquiv (univOut (X := X)) (Equiv.refl (SIn U)) ())
            (GrOperad.comp (R := R) () g₀ (toLin (q.1 (SIn U))
              (TensorProduct.lid R (C (SIn U))
                (LinearMap.rTensor (C (SIn U)) (GrCooperad.counit (R := R)) t)))) := by
      intro t
      induction t using TensorProduct.induction_on with
      | zero =>
        simp only [map_zero]
        try rfl
      | tmul x y =>
        simp only [TensorProduct.map_tmul, LinearMap.comp_apply, mu_tmul,
          LinearMap.rTensor_tmul, TensorProduct.lid_tmul, map_smul, SymSpecies.map_refl]
        rw [← GrSpecies.map_tw, hG _ (univOut (X := X)), ← SymSpecies.map_trans,
          Equiv.self_trans_symm,
          SymSpecies.map_refl, counit_tw, LinearMap.map_smul₂, GrOperad.map_comp,
          GrOperad.map_refl]
        rfl
      | add a b ha hb =>
        simp only [map_add, ha, hb]
        try rfl
    rw [key, hcl]
    
    have hqmap : ∀ {A B : Type} [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] [Fintype B] [DecidableEq B]
        (τ : A ≃ B) (x : C A), toLin (q.1 B) (SymSpecies.map (R := R) τ x)
          = GrOperad.map (R := R) τ (toLin (q.1 A) x) := fun {A B} _ _ _ _ τ x => by
      rw [← map_apply q τ]
      show GrOperad.map (R := R) τ (toLin (q.1 A) (SymSpecies.map (R := R) τ.symm _)) = _
      rw [← SymSpecies.map_trans, Equiv.self_trans_symm, SymSpecies.map_refl]
    simp only [v₀, v, ← SymSpecies.map_trans]
    rw [hqmap, comp_map_right]
    erw [hqmap (splitEquiv U).symm c]
    erw [comp_map_right]
    simp only [← GrOperad.map_trans]
    erw [← GrOperad.map_trans]
    apply qmap_congr
    intro z
    rcases z with ⟨a, ha⟩ | x
    · exact absurd (Subsingleton.elim a ()) ha
    · have hx : (splitEquiv U).symm x = Sum.inr ⟨x, Finset.mem_univ x⟩ :=
        (Equiv.symm_apply_eq _).2 rfl
      erw [Equiv.trans_apply, Equiv.trans_apply, Equiv.trans_apply, compEquiv_inr,
        Equiv.refl_apply, Equiv.trans_apply, hx]
      rfl
  · intro S _ hS
    have h0 := hG0 _ (card_sOut_ne hS)
    show GrOperad.map (R := R) (splitEquiv S) (mu none (kap (G.1 (SOut S)) (q.1 (SIn S))
      (GrCooperad.decomp (R := R) none (SymSpecies.map (R := R) (splitEquiv S).symm c)))) = 0
    rw [h0]
    simp [kap]
  · intro h
    exact absurd (Finset.mem_filter.2 ⟨Finset.mem_univ _, Finset.univ_nonempty⟩) h

name: Operad.Sym.LinOrd.rank_eq_sum
statement:
lemma rank_eq_sum (x : LinOrd A) (a : A) :
    x.rank a = ∑ b, if x.lt b a then 1 else 0
proof:
:= by
  unfold rank
  rw [Finset.card_filter]

name: Operad.Sym.LinOrd.rank_map
statement: lemma rank_map (e : A ≃ B) (x : LinOrd A) (b : B) : (map e x).rank b = x.rank (e.symm b)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [rank_eq_sum, rank_eq_sum, ← e.sum_comp]
  simp only [map_lt, Equiv.symm_apply_apply]

name: Operad.Sym.LinOrd.rank_comp_inr
statement:
lemma rank_comp_inr (i : A) (x : LinOrd A) (y : LinOrd B) (b : B) :
    (comp i x y).rank (Sum.inr b) = x.rank i + y.rank b
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [rank_eq_sum, rank_eq_sum, rank_eq_sum, Fintype.sum_sum_type]
  congr 1
  show (∑ a : Without A i, if x.lt a.1 i then 1 else 0) = _
  rw [← Finset.sum_subtype (Finset.univ.filter (· ≠ i)) (by simp)
    (fun a => if x.lt a i then 1 else 0)]
  refine Finset.sum_filter_of_ne fun a _ ha => ?_
  rintro rfl
  exact ha (if_neg (x.irrefl a))

name: Operad.Sym.LinOrd.rank_comp_inl_of_lt
statement:
lemma rank_comp_inl_of_lt (i : A) (x : LinOrd A) (y : LinOrd B) (a : Without A i)
    (h : x.lt a.1 i) : (comp i x y).rank (Sum.inl a) = x.rank a.1
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [rank_eq_sum, rank_eq_sum, Fintype.sum_sum_type]
  have h2 : (∑ b : B, if (comp i x y).lt (Sum.inr b) (Sum.inl a) then 1 else 0) = 0 := by
    refine Finset.sum_eq_zero fun b _ => if_neg ?_
    exact fun h' => x.irrefl _ (x.trans _ _ _ h h')
  rw [h2, add_zero]
  show (∑ a' : Without A i, if x.lt a'.1 a.1 then 1 else 0) = _
  rw [← Finset.sum_subtype (Finset.univ.filter (· ≠ i)) (by simp)
    (fun a' => if x.lt a' a.1 then 1 else 0)]
  refine Finset.sum_filter_of_ne fun a' _ ha' => ?_
  rintro rfl
  exact ha' (if_neg fun h' => x.irrefl _ (x.trans _ _ _ h h'))

name: Operad.Sym.LinOrd.rank_comp_inl_of_gt
statement:
lemma rank_comp_inl_of_gt (i : A) (x : LinOrd A) (y : LinOrd B) (a : Without A i)
    (h : x.lt i a.1) :
    (comp i x y).rank (Sum.inl a) = x.rank a.1 - 1 + Fintype.card B
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [rank_eq_sum, rank_eq_sum, Fintype.sum_sum_type]
  have h2 : (∑ b : B, if (comp i x y).lt (Sum.inr b) (Sum.inl a) then 1 else 0)
      = Fintype.card B := by
    refine (Finset.sum_congr rfl fun b _ =>
      if_pos (show (comp i x y).lt (Sum.inr b) (Sum.inl a) from h)).trans ?_
    simp
  rw [h2]
  have h1 : (∑ a' : Without A i, if (comp i x y).lt (Sum.inl a') (Sum.inl a) then 1 else 0) + 1
      = ∑ a' : A, if x.lt a' a.1 then 1 else 0 := by
    show (∑ a' : Without A i, if x.lt a'.1 a.1 then 1 else 0) + 1 = _
    rw [← Finset.sum_subtype (Finset.univ.filter (· ≠ i)) (by simp)
      (fun a' => if x.lt a' a.1 then 1 else 0), Finset.filter_ne',
      ← Finset.sum_erase_add Finset.univ _ (Finset.mem_univ i), if_pos h]
  omega

name: Operad.Sym.LinOrd.rank_std
statement: lemma rank_std (n : ℕ) (k : Fin n) : (std n).rank k = k
proof:
:=
  rank_ofRank (Equiv.refl (Fin n)) k

name: Operad.Sym.LinOrd.rank_one
statement: lemma rank_one (u : Unit) : LinOrd.one.rank u = 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [rank_eq_sum]
  exact Finset.sum_eq_zero fun _ _ => if_neg id

name: Operad.Sym.LinOrd.toRank_apply
statement:
lemma toRank_apply {A : Type} [Fintype A] (x : LinOrd A) (a : A) :
    (x.toRank a : ℕ) = x.rank a
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.Sym.LinOrd.eq_of_subsingleton
statement: lemma eq_of_subsingleton {A : Type} [Subsingleton A] (x y : LinOrd A) : x = y
proof:
:=
  LinOrd.ext fun a b => by
    rw [Subsingleton.elim a b]
    exact ⟨fun h => absurd h (x.irrefl b), fun h => absurd h (y.irrefl b)⟩

name: Operad.SetOperadHom.toNSSet_app

    φ.toNSSet.app n x = φ.app (Fin n) x
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.Reg.ext
statement: lemma ext {x y : Reg N A} (h1 : x.1 = y.1) (h2 : x.2.1 = y.2.1) : x = y
proof:
:=
  Prod.ext h1 (Subtype.ext h2)

name: Operad.Reg.card_without
statement: lemma card_without (i : A) : Fintype.card (Without A i) = Fintype.card A - 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [Fintype.card_subtype_compl, Fintype.card_subtype_eq]

name: Operad.Reg.rank_lt
statement: lemma rank_lt (x : Reg N A) (i : A) : x.1.rank i < x.2.1.1
proof:
:= by
  rw [x.2.2]
  exact x.1.rank_lt_card i

name: Operad.Reg.compR_fst
statement:
lemma compR_fst (i : A) (x : Reg N A) (y : Reg N B) :
    (compR i x y).2.1 = Arr.comp x.2.1 (x.1.rank i) y.2.1
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.Reg.map_def
statement: @[simp] lemma map_def (e : A ≃ B) (x : Reg N A) : SetOperad.map e x = mapR e x
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.Reg.comp_def
statement:
@[simp] lemma comp_def (i : A) (x : Reg N A) (y : Reg N B) :
    SetOperad.comp i x y = compR i x y
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.Reg.one_def
statement: @[simp] lemma one_def : (SetOperad.one : Reg N Unit) = oneR
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.Reg.eta_app
statement: lemma eta_app {n : ℕ} (x : N n) : (eta (N := N)).app n x = std x
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.Reg.eq_map_std
statement:
lemma eq_map_std (x : Reg N A) :
    x = mapR ((finCongr x.2.2).trans x.1.toRank.symm) (std x.2.1.2)
proof:
:= by
  refine ext ?_ rfl
  refine LinOrd.ext fun a b => ?_
  simp only [mapR, std, LinOrd.map_lt, LinOrd.std_lt, Equiv.symm_trans_apply, Equiv.symm_symm,
    Fin.lt_def, finCongr_symm_apply_coe]
  rw [LinOrd.toRank_apply, LinOrd.toRank_apply]
  exact x.1.lt_iff_rank_lt a b

name: Operad.Reg.place_map
statement:
lemma place_map (e : A ≃ B) (L : LinOrd A) (X : Arr (toNSSet S)) (h : X.1 = Fintype.card A)
    (h' : X.1 = Fintype.card B) :
    place (LinOrd.map e L) X h' = SetOperad.map e (place L X h)
proof:
:= by
  unfold place
  rw [← SetOperad.map_trans]
  congr 1
  refine Equiv.ext fun k => ?_
  apply (LinOrd.map e L).toRank.injective
  rw [Equiv.trans_apply, Equiv.apply_symm_apply, Equiv.trans_apply, Equiv.trans_apply]
  refine Fin.ext ?_
  rw [LinOrd.toRank_apply, LinOrd.rank_map, Equiv.symm_apply_apply, ← LinOrd.toRank_apply,
    Equiv.apply_symm_apply]
  simp

name: Operad.Reg.place_congr
statement:
lemma place_congr {L : LinOrd A} {X X' : Arr (toNSSet S)} (e : X = X')
    (h : X.1 = Fintype.card A) : place L X h = place L X' (e ▸ h)
proof:
:= by
  subst e
  rfl

name: Operad.Reg.rank_toRank_symm
statement:
lemma rank_toRank_symm (L : LinOrd A) (k : Fin (Fintype.card A)) :
    L.rank (L.toRank.symm k) = k
proof:
:= by
  rw [← LinOrd.toRank_apply, Equiv.apply_symm_apply]

name: Operad.Reg.place_comp
statement:
lemma place_comp (i : A) (L : LinOrd A) (M : LinOrd B) (X Y : Arr (toNSSet S))
    (hX : X.1 = Fintype.card A) (hY : Y.1 = Fintype.card B) (h) :
    place (LinOrd.comp i L M) (Arr.comp X (L.rank i) Y) h
      = SetOperad.comp i (place L X hX) (place M Y hY)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨m, y⟩ := Y
  have hrlt := L.rank_lt_card i
  generalize hrdef : L.rank i = r at h ⊢
  obtain ⟨c, x, rfl⟩ := Arr.exists_mk X (show r < X.1 by omega)
  simp only at hX hY
  clear hrlt
  have hi : ((finCongr hX).trans L.toRank.symm)
      ⟨r, Nat.lt_of_lt_of_le (Nat.lt_succ_self r) (Nat.le_add_right _ _)⟩ = i := by
    apply L.toRank.injective
    refine Fin.ext ?_
    rw [Equiv.trans_apply, Equiv.apply_symm_apply, LinOrd.toRank_apply, hrdef]
    rfl
  subst hi
  rw [place_congr (Arr.mk_comp r c x y)]
  unfold place
  simp only [SetOperad.toNSSet_comp, SetOperad.nsCompSet]
  rw [← SetOperad.map_trans, ← SetOperad.map_comp]
  congr 1
  refine Equiv.ext fun u => ?_
  change (LinOrd.comp _ L M).toRank.symm (finCongr _ (insertEquiv r c m u)) = _
  rw [Equiv.symm_apply_eq]
  refine Fin.ext ?_
  rw [LinOrd.toRank_apply, finCongr_apply, Fin.val_cast]
  symm
  rcases u with k | j
  · have hk : (k.1 : ℕ) ≠ r := fun e => k.2 (Fin.ext e)
    have hrk : L.rank ((finCongr hX).trans L.toRank.symm k.1) = k.1 := by
      rw [Equiv.trans_apply, rank_toRank_symm]
      rfl
    have hrr : L.rank ((finCongr hX).trans L.toRank.symm ⟨r, by omega⟩) = r := by
      rw [Equiv.trans_apply, rank_toRank_symm]
      rfl
    rw [compEquiv_inl, insertEquiv_inl_val]
    rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne hk with hlt | hgt
    · rw [LinOrd.rank_comp_inl_of_lt _ _ _ _ (by rw [L.lt_iff_rank_lt, hrk, hrr]; exact hlt),
        hrk, if_pos hlt]
    · rw [LinOrd.rank_comp_inl_of_gt _ _ _ _ (by rw [L.lt_iff_rank_lt, hrk, hrr]; exact hgt),
        hrk, if_neg (by omega), ← hY]
      omega
  · rw [compEquiv_inr, LinOrd.rank_comp_inr, insertEquiv_inr_val, Equiv.trans_apply,
      rank_toRank_symm, Equiv.trans_apply, rank_toRank_symm]
    rfl

name: Operad.Reg.lift_app
statement:
lemma lift_app (F : NSSetOperadHom N (toNSSet S)) (x : Reg N A) :
    (lift F).app A x = place x.1 (Arr.map F x.2.1) x.2.2
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.Reg.lift_std
statement:
theorem lift_std (F : NSSetOperadHom N (toNSSet S)) {n : ℕ} (x : N n) :
    (lift F).app (Fin n) (std x) = F.app n x
proof:
:= by
  show SetOperad.map _ (F.app n x) = F.app n x
  convert SetOperad.map_refl (S := S) (F.app n x)
  refine Equiv.ext fun k => ?_
  change (LinOrd.std n).toRank.symm (finCongr _ k) = k
  rw [Equiv.symm_apply_eq]
  exact Fin.ext (by rw [LinOrd.toRank_apply, LinOrd.rank_std]; rfl)

name: Operad.Reg.hom_ext
statement:
theorem hom_ext {G G' : SetOperadHom (Reg N) S}
    (h : ∀ (n : ℕ) (x : N n), G.app (Fin n) (std x) = G'.app (Fin n) (std x)) : G = G'
proof:
:= by
  ext A _ _ x
  rw [eq_map_std x, ← map_def, G.app_map, G'.app_map, h]

name: Operad.Reg.homEquiv_apply
statement:
@[simp] lemma homEquiv_apply (G : SetOperadHom (Reg N) S) {n : ℕ} (x : N n) :
    (homEquiv G).app n x = G.app (Fin n) (std x)
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.Reg.homEquiv_symm_apply
statement:
@[simp] lemma homEquiv_symm_apply (F : NSSetOperadHom N (toNSSet S)) :
    homEquiv.symm F = lift F
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.Reg.toHadamard_bijective
statement:
lemma toHadamard_bijective (A : Type) [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] :
    Function.Bijective (toHadamard (S := S) |>.app A)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨L, ⟨k, x⟩, hx⟩ ⟨L', ⟨k', x'⟩, hx'⟩ h
    simp only at hx hx'
    subst hx
    subst hx'
    obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := Prod.ext_iff.1 h
    change L = L' at h1
    subst h1
    have hxx : x = x' := SetOperad.map_injective _ h2
    subst hxx
    rfl
  · rintro ⟨L, s⟩
    refine ⟨(L, ⟨⟨Fintype.card A, SetOperad.map L.toRank s⟩, rfl⟩), Prod.ext rfl ?_⟩
    show SetOperad.map _ (SetOperad.map L.toRank s) = s
    rw [← SetOperad.map_trans]
    convert SetOperad.map_refl (S := S) s
    exact Equiv.ext fun a => by simp

name: Operad.SetOperadIso.precompEquiv_apply
statement:
@[simp] lemma precompEquiv_apply (φ : SetOperadIso S T) (ψ : SetOperadHom T U) :
    φ.precompEquiv ψ = ψ.comp φ.hom
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.Reg.mapHom_std
statement:
@[simp] lemma mapHom_std (φ : NSSetOperadHom N N') {n : ℕ} (x : N n) :
    (mapHom φ).app (Fin n) (std x) = std (φ.app n x)
proof:
:=
  lift_std _ x

name: Operad.NSSyn.eval_toSyn
statement:
lemma eval_toSyn {S : (A : Type) → [Fintype A] → [DecidableEq A] → Type v} [SetOperad S]
    (f : ∀ n, T n → S (Fin n)) : ∀ {n : ℕ} (p : NSSyn T n),
    Syn.eval f p.toSyn = NSSyn.eval (S := toNSSet S) f p
  | _, .one => rfl
  | _, .gen _ => rfl
  | _, .comp a b x y => by
    simp only [toSyn, Syn.eval_map, Syn.eval_comp, eval_toSyn f x, eval_toSyn f y]
    rfl

end NSSyn

variable {T : ℕ → Type w}

                                                                                                 
                                                       
def symRel (ρ : ∀ n : ℕ, NSSyn T n → NSSyn T n → Prop) :
    ∀ {A : Type} [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A], Syn T A → Syn T A → Prop
proof:
:=
  fun {A} _ _ x y => ∃ (n : ℕ) (p q : NSSyn T n) (e : Fin n ≃ A),
    ρ n p q ∧ x = Syn.map e p.toSyn ∧ y = Syn.map e q.toSyn

name: Operad.respects_symRel_iff
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h n p q hpq
    have := h _ _ ⟨n, p, q, Equiv.refl _, hpq, rfl, rfl⟩
    rwa [Syn.eval_map, Syn.eval_map, SetOperad.map_refl, SetOperad.map_refl, NSSyn.eval_toSyn,
      NSSyn.eval_toSyn] at this
  · rintro h A _ _ x y ⟨n, p, q, e, hpq, rfl, rfl⟩
    rw [Syn.eval_map, Syn.eval_map, NSSyn.eval_toSyn, NSSyn.eval_toSyn, h p q hpq]

name: Operad.Reg.respects_gen
statement:
lemma respects_gen :
    NSPres.Respects (S := toNSSet (Pres T (symRel ρ))) ρ (fun _ g => Pres.gen g)
proof:
:=
  (respects_symRel_iff ρ _).1 (Pres.respects_app SetOperadHom.id)

name: Operad.sum_Ico_graft
statement:
lemma sum_Ico_graft {M : Type*} [AddCommMonoid M] (f : ℕ → M) {n m v : ℕ} (hv1 : 1 ≤ v)
    (hv : v ≤ n) (hm : 1 ≤ m) :
    ∑ k ∈ Finset.Ico 1 (n + m), f k
      = ∑ k ∈ Finset.Ico 1 n, f (k + if v ≤ k then m else 0) + f v
        + ∑ k ∈ Finset.Ico 1 m, f (v + k)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Finset.sum_Ico_consecutive _ hv1 (show v ≤ n + m by omega),
    ← Finset.sum_Ico_consecutive _ (show v ≤ v + m by omega) (show v + m ≤ n + m by omega),
    ← Finset.sum_Ico_consecutive _ hv1 hv,
    Finset.sum_eq_sum_Ico_succ_bot (show v < v + m by omega)]
  have h1 : ∑ k ∈ Finset.Ico 1 v, f (k + if v ≤ k then m else 0) = ∑ k ∈ Finset.Ico 1 v, f k :=
    Finset.sum_congr rfl fun k hk => by
      rw [Finset.mem_Ico] at hk
      rw [if_neg (by omega), Nat.add_zero]
  have h2 : ∑ k ∈ Finset.Ico v n, f (k + if v ≤ k then m else 0)
      = ∑ k ∈ Finset.Ico (v + m) (n + m), f k := by
    rw [← Finset.sum_Ico_add']
    exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun k hk => by
      rw [Finset.mem_Ico] at hk
      rw [if_pos hk.1]
  have h3 : ∑ k ∈ Finset.Ico 1 m, f (v + k) = ∑ k ∈ Finset.Ico (v + 1) (v + m), f k := by
    rw [show v + 1 = 1 + v by omega, show v + m = m + v by omega, ← Finset.sum_Ico_add']
    exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun k _ => by rw [Nat.add_comm]
  rw [h1, h2, h3]
  abel

name: Operad.FreeGr.reg_ext
statement:
lemma reg_ext {x y : Reg (TreeOfArity T) A} (h1 : x.1 = y.1) (h2 : treeOf x = treeOf y) :

:=
  Reg.ext h1 (arr_ext h2)

name: Operad.FreeGr.contrR_fst
statement: @[simp] lemma contrR_fst (x : Reg (TreeOfArity T) A) (k : ℕ) : (contrR μ x k).1 = x.1

name: Operad.FreeGr.treeOf_contrR

@[simp] lemma treeOf_contrR (x : Reg (TreeOfArity T) A) (k : ℕ) :

name: Operad.FreeGr.mcompR_fst

@[simp] lemma mcompR_fst (i : A) (x : Reg (TreeOfArity T) A) (y : Reg (TreeOfArity T) B) :
    (mcompR μ i x y).1 = (SetOperad.comp i x y : Reg (TreeOfArity T) _).1

name: Operad.FreeGr.comp_fst
statement:
lemma comp_fst (i : A) (x : Reg (TreeOfArity T) A) (y : Reg (TreeOfArity T) B) :

name: Operad.FreeGr.sgn_treeSgn
statement:
lemma sgn_treeSgn (i : A) (x : Reg (TreeOfArity T) A) (y : Reg (TreeOfArity T) B) :
    SgnData.sgn i ((treeSgn gp).app A x) ((treeSgn gp).app B y)
      = (Tree.tpar gp (treeOf y) && Tree.apar gp (treeOf x) (x.1.rank i))
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.FreeGr.tot_treeSgn
statement:
lemma tot_treeSgn (x : Reg (TreeOfArity T) A) :
    ((treeSgn gp).app A x).tot = Tree.tpar gp (treeOf x)
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.FreeGr.barD_bas
statement:
lemma barD_bas (x : Reg (TreeOfArity T) A) :
    barD μ gp R A (SgnLin.bas (treeSgn gp) R x)
      = ∑ k ∈ Finset.Ico 1 (treeOf x).weight,
          σ R (Tree.contrSgn gp (treeOf x) k) • SgnLin.bas (treeSgn gp) R (contrR μ x k)
proof:
:= by
  unfold barD
  exact (Finsupp.linearCombination_single R _ _).trans (one_smul R _)

name: Operad.FreeGr.mcomp_bas
statement:
lemma mcomp_bas (i : A) (x : Reg (TreeOfArity T) A) (y : Reg (TreeOfArity T) B) :
    mcomp μ gp R i (SgnLin.bas (treeSgn gp) R x) (SgnLin.bas (treeSgn gp) R y)
      = if (treeOf x).isLeaf = false ∧ (treeOf y).isLeaf = false then
          σ R (mcompSgn gp i x y) • SgnLin.bas (treeSgn gp) R (mcompR μ i x y) else 0
proof:
:= by
  unfold mcomp
  exact (LinearMap.congr_fun
    ((Finsupp.linearCombination_single R (1 : R) x).trans (one_smul R _)) _).trans
      ((Finsupp.linearCombination_single R (1 : R) y).trans (one_smul R _))

name: Operad.FreeGr.comp_bas_eq
statement:
lemma comp_bas_eq (i : A) (x : Reg (TreeOfArity T) A) (y : Reg (TreeOfArity T) B) :
    GrOperad.comp (R := R) i (SgnLin.bas (treeSgn gp) R x) (SgnLin.bas (treeSgn gp) R y)
      = σ R (Tree.tpar gp (treeOf y) && Tree.apar gp (treeOf x) (x.1.rank i)) •
          SgnLin.bas (treeSgn gp) R (SetOperad.comp i x y)
proof:
:=
  SgnLin.comp_bas i x y

name: Operad.FreeGr.barD_bas_of_isLeaf
statement:
lemma barD_bas_of_isLeaf {x : Reg (TreeOfArity T) A} (hx : (treeOf x).isLeaf = true) :
    barD μ gp R A (SgnLin.bas (treeSgn gp) R x) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [barD_bas, Tree.eq_leaf_of_isLeaf hx, Tree.weight_leaf, Finset.Ico_eq_empty_of_le zero_le_one,
    Finset.sum_empty]

name: Operad.FreeGr.contrR_comp_outer
statement:
lemma contrR_comp_outer (i : A) (x : Reg (TreeOfArity T) A) (y : Reg (TreeOfArity T) B)
    {k : ℕ} (hk1 : 1 ≤ k) (hk : k < (treeOf x).weight) :
    contrR μ (SetOperad.comp i x y)
        (k + if (treeOf x).vb (x.1.rank i) ≤ k then (treeOf y).weight else 0)
      = SetOperad.comp i (contrR μ x k) y
proof:
:= by
  refine reg_ext rfl ?_
  rw [treeOf_contrR, treeOf_comp, treeOf_comp, treeOf_contrR, contrR_fst]
  by_cases hy : (treeOf y).isLeaf = true
  · rw [Tree.eq_leaf_of_isLeaf hy, Tree.graft_leaf_right, Tree.graft_leaf_right, Tree.weight_leaf]
    simp
  · exact Tree.contr_graft_outer μ (rank_lt_arity x i) (by simpa using hy) hk1 hk

name: Operad.FreeGr.contrR_comp_inner
statement:
lemma contrR_comp_inner (i : A) (x : Reg (TreeOfArity T) A) (y : Reg (TreeOfArity T) B)
    {k : ℕ} (hk1 : 1 ≤ k) (hk : k < (treeOf y).weight) :
    contrR μ (SetOperad.comp i x y) ((treeOf x).vb (x.1.rank i) + k)
      = SetOperad.comp i x (contrR μ y k)
proof:
:= by
  refine reg_ext rfl ?_
  rw [treeOf_contrR, treeOf_comp, treeOf_comp, treeOf_contrR]
  exact Tree.contr_graft_inner μ (rank_lt_arity x i) hk1 hk

name: Operad.FreeGr.contrR_comp_root
statement:
lemma contrR_comp_root (i : A) (x : Reg (TreeOfArity T) A) (y : Reg (TreeOfArity T) B)
    (hy : (treeOf y).isLeaf = false) :
    contrR μ (SetOperad.comp i x y) ((treeOf x).vb (x.1.rank i)) = mcompR μ i x y
proof:
:= by
  refine reg_ext rfl ?_
  rw [treeOf_contrR, treeOf_comp, treeOf_mcompR]
