  exact Tree.contr_graft_root μ (rank_lt_arity x i) hy

name: Operad.FreeGr.barD_comp_bas
statement:
theorem barD_comp_bas (hμ : MergeFn.Odd gp μ) (i : A) (x : Reg (TreeOfArity T) A)
    (y : Reg (TreeOfArity T) B) :
    barD μ gp R _ (GrOperad.comp (R := R) i (SgnLin.bas (treeSgn gp) R x)
        (SgnLin.bas (treeSgn gp) R y))
      = GrOperad.comp (R := R) i (barD μ gp R A (SgnLin.bas (treeSgn gp) R x))
          (SgnLin.bas (treeSgn gp) R y)
        + σ R (Tree.tpar gp (treeOf x)) • GrOperad.comp (R := R) i (SgnLin.bas (treeSgn gp) R x)
          (barD μ gp R B (SgnLin.bas (treeSgn gp) R y))
        + mcomp μ gp R i (SgnLin.bas (treeSgn gp) R x) (SgnLin.bas (treeSgn gp) R y)
proof:
:= by
  have hr := rank_lt_arity x i
  have ht := treeOf_comp i x y
  have hw : (treeOf (SetOperad.comp i x y)).weight = (treeOf x).weight + (treeOf y).weight := by
    rw [ht, Tree.weight_graft _ _ _ hr]
  
  have houter : ∀ k ∈ Finset.Ico 1 (treeOf x).weight,
      σ R (Tree.tpar gp (treeOf y) && Tree.apar gp (treeOf x) (x.1.rank i)) •
        σ R (Tree.contrSgn gp (treeOf (SetOperad.comp i x y))
          (k + if (treeOf x).vb (x.1.rank i) ≤ k then (treeOf y).weight else 0)) •
        SgnLin.bas (treeSgn gp) R (contrR μ (SetOperad.comp i x y)
          (k + if (treeOf x).vb (x.1.rank i) ≤ k then (treeOf y).weight else 0))
      = σ R (Tree.contrSgn gp (treeOf x) k) • GrOperad.comp (R := R) i
          (SgnLin.bas (treeSgn gp) R (contrR μ x k)) (SgnLin.bas (treeSgn gp) R y) := by
    intro k hk
    rw [Finset.mem_Ico] at hk
    rw [contrR_comp_outer i x y hk.1 hk.2, comp_bas_eq, smul_smul, smul_smul, ← σ_xor, ← σ_xor,
      treeOf_contrR, contrR_fst]
    congr 2
    by_cases hy : (treeOf y).isLeaf = true
    · rw [ht, Tree.eq_leaf_of_isLeaf hy, Tree.graft_leaf_right, Tree.tpar_leaf, Tree.weight_leaf]
      simp
    · rw [ht]
      exact Tree.contrSgn_graft_outer μ gp hμ hr (by simpa using hy) hk.1 hk.2
  
  have hinner : ∀ k ∈ Finset.Ico 1 (treeOf y).weight,
      σ R (Tree.tpar gp (treeOf y) && Tree.apar gp (treeOf x) (x.1.rank i)) •
        σ R (Tree.contrSgn gp (treeOf (SetOperad.comp i x y))
          ((treeOf x).vb (x.1.rank i) + k)) •
        SgnLin.bas (treeSgn gp) R (contrR μ (SetOperad.comp i x y)
          ((treeOf x).vb (x.1.rank i) + k))
      = σ R (Tree.tpar gp (treeOf x)) • σ R (Tree.contrSgn gp (treeOf y) k) •
          GrOperad.comp (R := R) i (SgnLin.bas (treeSgn gp) R x)
            (SgnLin.bas (treeSgn gp) R (contrR μ y k)) := by
    intro k hk
    rw [Finset.mem_Ico] at hk
    rw [contrR_comp_inner i x y hk.1 hk.2, comp_bas_eq, smul_smul, smul_smul, smul_smul,
      ← σ_xor, ← σ_xor, ← σ_xor, treeOf_contrR, ht,
      Tree.contrSgn_graft_inner gp hr hk.1 hk.2, Tree.tpar_contr μ gp hμ hk.1 hk.2]
    congr 2
    cases Tree.tpar gp (treeOf y) <;> cases Tree.apar gp (treeOf x) (x.1.rank i) <;>
      cases Tree.tpar gp (treeOf x) <;> cases Tree.contrSgn gp (treeOf y) k <;> rfl
  
  have hroot (hy : (treeOf y).isLeaf = false) (hx : (treeOf x).isLeaf = false) :
      σ R (Tree.tpar gp (treeOf y) && Tree.apar gp (treeOf x) (x.1.rank i)) •
        σ R (Tree.contrSgn gp (treeOf (SetOperad.comp i x y)) ((treeOf x).vb (x.1.rank i))) •
        SgnLin.bas (treeSgn gp) R (contrR μ (SetOperad.comp i x y) ((treeOf x).vb (x.1.rank i)))
      = mcomp μ gp R i (SgnLin.bas (treeSgn gp) R x) (SgnLin.bas (treeSgn gp) R y) := by
    rw [mcomp_bas, if_pos ⟨hx, hy⟩, contrR_comp_root i x y hy, smul_smul, ← σ_xor, ht,
      Tree.contrSgn_graft_root gp hr hy]
    rfl
  have hL : barD μ gp R _ (GrOperad.comp (R := R) i (SgnLin.bas (treeSgn gp) R x)
        (SgnLin.bas (treeSgn gp) R y))
      = ∑ k ∈ Finset.Ico 1 ((treeOf x).weight + (treeOf y).weight),
          σ R (Tree.tpar gp (treeOf y) && Tree.apar gp (treeOf x) (x.1.rank i)) •
            σ R (Tree.contrSgn gp (treeOf (SetOperad.comp i x y)) k) •
            SgnLin.bas (treeSgn gp) R (contrR μ (SetOperad.comp i x y) k) := by
    rw [comp_bas_eq, map_smul, barD_bas, Finset.smul_sum, hw]
  have hR1 : GrOperad.comp (R := R) i (barD μ gp R A (SgnLin.bas (treeSgn gp) R x))
        (SgnLin.bas (treeSgn gp) R y)
      = ∑ k ∈ Finset.Ico 1 (treeOf x).weight, σ R (Tree.contrSgn gp (treeOf x) k) •
          GrOperad.comp (R := R) i (SgnLin.bas (treeSgn gp) R (contrR μ x k))
            (SgnLin.bas (treeSgn gp) R y) := by
    rw [barD_bas, map_sum, LinearMap.sum_apply]
    simp only [map_smul, LinearMap.smul_apply]
  have hR2 : σ R (Tree.tpar gp (treeOf x)) • GrOperad.comp (R := R) i
        (SgnLin.bas (treeSgn gp) R x) (barD μ gp R B (SgnLin.bas (treeSgn gp) R y))
      = ∑ k ∈ Finset.Ico 1 (treeOf y).weight, σ R (Tree.tpar gp (treeOf x)) •
          σ R (Tree.contrSgn gp (treeOf y) k) • GrOperad.comp (R := R) i
            (SgnLin.bas (treeSgn gp) R x) (SgnLin.bas (treeSgn gp) R (contrR μ y k)) := by
    rw [barD_bas, map_sum, Finset.smul_sum]
    simp only [map_smul]
  rw [hL, hR1, hR2]
  by_cases hy : (treeOf y).isLeaf = true
  · have hwy : (treeOf y).weight = 0 := by rw [Tree.eq_leaf_of_isLeaf hy]; rfl
    rw [mcomp_bas, if_neg (by simp [hy]), add_zero, hwy, Nat.add_zero,
      Finset.Ico_eq_empty_of_le zero_le_one, Finset.sum_empty, add_zero]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun k hk => ?_
    rw [← houter k hk, hwy]
    simp only [ite_self, Nat.add_zero]
  by_cases hx : (treeOf x).isLeaf = true
  · have hv : (treeOf x).vb (x.1.rank i) = 0 := by rw [Tree.eq_leaf_of_isLeaf hx]; rfl
    have hwx : (treeOf x).weight = 0 := by rw [Tree.eq_leaf_of_isLeaf hx]; rfl
    rw [mcomp_bas, if_neg (by simp [hx]), add_zero, hwx, Nat.zero_add,
      Finset.Ico_eq_empty_of_le zero_le_one, Finset.sum_empty, zero_add]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun k hk => ?_
    rw [← hinner k hk, hv, Nat.zero_add]
  have hx' : (treeOf x).isLeaf = false := by simpa using hx
  have hy' : (treeOf y).isLeaf = false := by simpa using hy
  rw [sum_Ico_graft _ (Tree.vb_pos hx' _) (Tree.vb_le_weight _ _) (Tree.weight_pos hy'),
    hroot hy' hx']
  rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl houter, Finset.sum_congr rfl hinner]
  abel

name: Operad.FreeGr.withTree_fst
statement:
@[simp] lemma withTree_fst (x : Reg (TreeOfArity T) A) (t : Tree T)
    (h : t.arity = (treeOf x).arity) : (withTree x t h).1 = x.1
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.FreeGr.treeOf_withTree
statement:
@[simp] lemma treeOf_withTree (x : Reg (TreeOfArity T) A) (t : Tree T)
    (h : t.arity = (treeOf x).arity) : treeOf (withTree x t h) = t
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.FreeGr.decomp_bas
statement:
lemma decomp_bas (i : A) (s : Reg (TreeOfArity T) (Without A i ⊕ B)) :
    GrCooperad.decomp (R := R) (C := FreeGr R gp) i (SgnLin.bas (treeSgn gp) R s)
      = ∑ pq ∈ (SetOperad.FiniteFact.finite i s).toFinset,
          σ R (Tree.tpar gp (treeOf pq.2) && Tree.apar gp (treeOf pq.1) (pq.1.1.rank i)) •
            (SgnLin.bas (treeSgn gp) R pq.1 ⊗ₜ[R] SgnLin.bas (treeSgn gp) R pq.2)
proof:
:= by
  refine (SgnLin.decompT_single (treeSgn gp) i s (1 : R)).trans
    (Finset.sum_congr rfl fun pq _ => ?_)
  rw [mul_one]
  rfl

name: Operad.FreeGr.mem_fib
proof:
:=
  SgnLin.mem_fact_iff i s pq

name: Operad.FreeGr.comp_eq_iff
statement:
lemma comp_eq_iff {i : A} {p : Reg (TreeOfArity T) A} {q : Reg (TreeOfArity T) B}
    {s : Reg (TreeOfArity T) (Without A i ⊕ B)} :
    SetOperad.comp i p q = s ↔
      LinOrd.comp i p.1 q.1 = s.1 ∧ (treeOf p).graft (p.1.rank i) (treeOf q) = treeOf s
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro rfl
    exact ⟨rfl, (treeOf_comp i p q).symm⟩
  · rintro ⟨h1, h2⟩
    exact reg_ext h1 ((treeOf_comp i p q).trans h2)

name: Operad.FreeGr.decomp_barD_bas_eq
statement:
lemma decomp_barD_bas_eq (i : A) (s : Reg (TreeOfArity T) (Without A i ⊕ B)) :
    GrCooperad.decomp (R := R) (C := FreeGr R gp) i (barD μ gp R _ (SgnLin.bas (treeSgn gp) R s))
      = ∑ x ∈ (Finset.Ico 1 (treeOf s).weight).sigma
          (fun k => (SetOperad.FiniteFact.finite i (contrR μ s k)).toFinset),
          decTermL gp R i s x
proof:
:= by
  rw [barD_bas, map_sum, Finset.sum_sigma]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun k _ => ?_
  rw [map_smul, decomp_bas, Finset.smul_sum]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun pq _ => ?_
  rw [smul_smul]
  rfl

name: Operad.FreeGr.map_barD_id_decomp_bas
statement:
lemma map_barD_id_decomp_bas (i : A) (s : Reg (TreeOfArity T) (Without A i ⊕ B)) :
    TensorProduct.map (barD μ gp R A) LinearMap.id
        (GrCooperad.decomp (R := R) (C := FreeGr R gp) i (SgnLin.bas (treeSgn gp) R s))
      = ∑ y ∈ (SetOperad.FiniteFact.finite i s).toFinset.sigma
          (fun pq => Finset.Ico 1 (treeOf pq.1).weight), decTermO μ gp R i y
proof:
:= by
  rw [decomp_bas, map_sum, Finset.sum_sigma]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun pq _ => ?_
  rw [map_smul, TensorProduct.map_tmul, LinearMap.id_apply, barD_bas, TensorProduct.sum_tmul,
    Finset.smul_sum]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun k _ => ?_
  rw [TensorProduct.smul_tmul', smul_smul]
  rfl

name: Operad.FreeGr.map_tw_barD_decomp_bas
statement:
lemma map_tw_barD_decomp_bas (i : A) (s : Reg (TreeOfArity T) (Without A i ⊕ B)) :
    TensorProduct.map (GrSpecies.tw (R := R) (V := FreeGr R gp) true) (barD μ gp R B)
        (GrCooperad.decomp (R := R) (C := FreeGr R gp) i (SgnLin.bas (treeSgn gp) R s))
      = ∑ y ∈ (SetOperad.FiniteFact.finite i s).toFinset.sigma
          (fun pq => Finset.Ico 1 (treeOf pq.2).weight), decTermI μ gp R i y
proof:
:= by
  have htw : ∀ p : Reg (TreeOfArity T) A, GrSpecies.tw (R := R) (V := FreeGr R gp) true
      (SgnLin.bas (treeSgn gp) R p)
        = σ R (Tree.tpar gp (treeOf p)) • SgnLin.bas (treeSgn gp) R p :=
    fun p => (GrSpecies.tw_hom true (SgnLin.par_bas p)).trans (by rw [Bool.true_and]; rfl)
  rw [decomp_bas, map_sum, Finset.sum_sigma]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun pq _ => ?_
  rw [map_smul, TensorProduct.map_tmul, htw, barD_bas, TensorProduct.tmul_sum, Finset.smul_sum]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun k _ => ?_
  simp only [decTermI, TensorProduct.smul_tmul', TensorProduct.tmul_smul, smul_smul]
  congr 1
  ring_nf

name: Operad.FreeGr.decomp_barD_bas
statement:
theorem decomp_barD_bas (hμ : MergeFn.Odd gp μ) (i : A)
    (s : Reg (TreeOfArity T) (Without A i ⊕ B)) :
    GrCooperad.decomp (R := R) (C := FreeGr R gp) i
        (barD μ gp R _ (SgnLin.bas (treeSgn gp) R s))
      = TensorProduct.map (barD μ gp R A) LinearMap.id
          (GrCooperad.decomp (R := R) (C := FreeGr R gp) i (SgnLin.bas (treeSgn gp) R s))
        + TensorProduct.map (GrSpecies.tw (R := R) (V := FreeGr R gp) true) (barD μ gp R B)
          (GrCooperad.decomp (R := R) (C := FreeGr R gp) i (SgnLin.bas (treeSgn gp) R s))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hfac : ∀ {p : Reg (TreeOfArity T) A} {q : Reg (TreeOfArity T) B},
      SetOperad.comp i p q = s →
        treeOf s = (treeOf p).graft (p.1.rank i) (treeOf q) ∧
          (treeOf s).weight = (treeOf p).weight + (treeOf q).weight ∧
            LinOrd.comp i p.1 q.1 = s.1 := by
    intro p q h
    have e := (comp_eq_iff.1 h)
    refine ⟨e.2.symm, ?_, e.1⟩
    rw [← e.2, Tree.weight_graft _ _ _ (rank_lt_arity p i)]
  rw [decomp_barD_bas_eq, map_barD_id_decomp_bas, map_tw_barD_decomp_bas, ← Finset.sum_sumElim]
  symm
  refine Finset.sum_bij (fun z _ => liftIdx μ i z) ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_
  · 
    rintro (⟨⟨p, q⟩, k⟩ | ⟨⟨p, q⟩, k⟩) hz
    · rw [Finset.inl_mem_disjSum, Finset.mem_sigma, mem_fib, Finset.mem_Ico] at hz
      dsimp only at hz
      obtain ⟨hpq, hk1, hk⟩ := hz
      obtain ⟨-, hw, -⟩ := hfac hpq
      subst hpq
      simp only [liftIdx, Sum.elim_inl, Finset.mem_sigma, Finset.mem_Ico, mem_fib]
      refine ⟨⟨by omega, by rw [hw]; split_ifs <;> omega⟩, ?_⟩
      exact (contrR_comp_outer i p q hk1 hk).symm
    · rw [Finset.inr_mem_disjSum, Finset.mem_sigma, mem_fib, Finset.mem_Ico] at hz
      dsimp only at hz
      obtain ⟨hpq, hk1, hk⟩ := hz
      obtain ⟨-, hw, -⟩ := hfac hpq
      subst hpq
      have := Tree.vb_le_weight (treeOf p) (p.1.rank i)
      simp only [liftIdx, Sum.elim_inr, Finset.mem_sigma, Finset.mem_Ico, mem_fib]
      refine ⟨⟨by omega, by rw [hw]; omega⟩, ?_⟩
      exact (contrR_comp_inner i p q hk1 hk).symm
  · 
    rintro (⟨⟨p, q⟩, k⟩ | ⟨⟨p, q⟩, k⟩) h₁ (⟨⟨p', q'⟩, k'⟩ | ⟨⟨p', q'⟩, k'⟩) h₂ heq
    · rw [Finset.inl_mem_disjSum, Finset.mem_sigma, mem_fib, Finset.mem_Ico] at h₁ h₂
      dsimp only at h₁ h₂
      simp only [liftIdx, Sum.elim_inl, Sigma.mk.inj_iff, heq_eq_eq, Prod.mk.injEq] at heq
      obtain ⟨hi, hc, rfl⟩ := heq
      obtain ⟨ht, -, -⟩ := hfac h₁.1
      obtain ⟨ht', -, -⟩ := hfac h₂.1
      have h1 : p.1 = p'.1 := by rw [← contrR_fst μ p k, hc, contrR_fst]
      rw [← h1] at ht' hi
      have hc' : (treeOf p).contr μ k = (treeOf p').contr μ k' := by
        rw [← treeOf_contrR, ← treeOf_contrR, hc]
      by_cases hq : (treeOf q).isLeaf = true
      · rw [Tree.eq_leaf_of_isLeaf hq, Tree.graft_leaf_right] at ht ht'
        have e : p = p' := reg_ext h1 (ht.symm.trans ht')
        subst e
        rw [Tree.eq_leaf_of_isLeaf hq, Tree.weight_leaf] at hi
        simp only [ite_self, Nat.add_zero] at hi
        rw [hi]
      · have hr' : p.1.rank i < (treeOf p').arity := by rw [h1]; exact rank_lt_arity p' i
        obtain ⟨e1, e2⟩ := Tree.contr_outer_inj μ (rank_lt_arity p i) hr' (by simpa using hq)
          h₁.2.1 h₁.2.2 h₂.2.1 h₂.2.2 (ht.symm.trans ht') hc' hi
        have e : p = p' := reg_ext h1 e1
        subst e
        rw [e2]
    · rw [Finset.inl_mem_disjSum, Finset.mem_sigma, mem_fib, Finset.mem_Ico] at h₁
      rw [Finset.inr_mem_disjSum, Finset.mem_sigma, mem_fib, Finset.mem_Ico] at h₂
      dsimp only at h₁ h₂
      simp only [liftIdx, Sum.elim_inl, Sum.elim_inr, Sigma.mk.inj_iff, heq_eq_eq,
        Prod.mk.injEq] at heq
      obtain ⟨hi, hc, hc'⟩ := heq
      exfalso
      obtain ⟨ht, -, -⟩ := hfac h₁.1
      obtain ⟨ht', -, -⟩ := hfac h₂.1
      have h1 : p.1 = p'.1 := by rw [← contrR_fst μ p k, hc]
      rw [← h1] at ht' hi
      have hct : (treeOf p).contr μ k = treeOf p' := by rw [← treeOf_contrR, hc]
      have hct' : (treeOf q').contr μ k' = treeOf q := by rw [← treeOf_contrR, hc']
      have hcw := Tree.weight_contr μ h₂.2.1 h₂.2.2
      exact Tree.contr_outer_ne_inner μ (rank_lt_arity p i) (Tree.isLeaf_of_weight (by omega))
        h₁.2.1 h₁.2.2 h₂.2.1 h₂.2.2 (ht.symm.trans ht') hct hct' hi
    · rw [Finset.inr_mem_disjSum, Finset.mem_sigma, mem_fib, Finset.mem_Ico] at h₁
      rw [Finset.inl_mem_disjSum, Finset.mem_sigma, mem_fib, Finset.mem_Ico] at h₂
      dsimp only at h₁ h₂
      simp only [liftIdx, Sum.elim_inl, Sum.elim_inr, Sigma.mk.inj_iff, heq_eq_eq,
        Prod.mk.injEq] at heq
      obtain ⟨hi, hc, hc'⟩ := heq
      exfalso
      obtain ⟨ht, -, -⟩ := hfac h₁.1
      obtain ⟨ht', -, -⟩ := hfac h₂.1
      have h1 : p.1 = p'.1 := by rw [hc, contrR_fst]
      rw [← h1] at ht' hi
      have hct : (treeOf p').contr μ k' = treeOf p := by rw [← treeOf_contrR, ← hc]
      have hct' : (treeOf q).contr μ k = treeOf q' := by rw [← treeOf_contrR, hc']
      have hcw := Tree.weight_contr μ h₁.2.1 h₁.2.2
      have hr' : p.1.rank i < (treeOf p').arity := by rw [h1]; exact rank_lt_arity p' i
      exact Tree.contr_outer_ne_inner μ hr' (Tree.isLeaf_of_weight (by omega))
        h₂.2.1 h₂.2.2 h₁.2.1 h₁.2.2 (ht'.symm.trans ht) hct hct' hi.symm
    · rw [Finset.inr_mem_disjSum, Finset.mem_sigma, mem_fib, Finset.mem_Ico] at h₁ h₂
      dsimp only at h₁ h₂
      simp only [liftIdx, Sum.elim_inr, Sigma.mk.inj_iff, heq_eq_eq, Prod.mk.injEq] at heq
      obtain ⟨hi, rfl, hc⟩ := heq
      obtain ⟨ht, -, -⟩ := hfac h₁.1
      obtain ⟨ht', -, -⟩ := hfac h₂.1
      have h1 : q.1 = q'.1 := by rw [← contrR_fst μ q k, hc, contrR_fst]
      have e : q = q' := reg_ext h1
        (Tree.graft_inj_right (rank_lt_arity p i) (ht.symm.trans ht'))
      subst e
      have e2 : k = k' := by omega
      subst e2
      rfl
  · 
    rintro ⟨k, ⟨p, q⟩⟩ hx
    rw [Finset.mem_sigma, Finset.mem_Ico, mem_fib] at hx
    dsimp only at hx
    obtain ⟨⟨hk1, hk⟩, hpq⟩ := hx
    have hr := rank_lt_arity p i
    have hst : (treeOf s).contr μ k = (treeOf p).graft (p.1.rank i) (treeOf q) := by
      rw [← treeOf_contrR, ← hpq, treeOf_comp]
    have hord : LinOrd.comp i p.1 q.1 = s.1 := by
      rw [← comp_fst, hpq, contrR_fst]
    by_cases hq : (treeOf q).isLeaf = true
    · have hst' : (treeOf s).contr μ k = treeOf p := by
        rw [hst, Tree.eq_leaf_of_isLeaf hq, Tree.graft_leaf_right]
      have har : (treeOf s).arity = (treeOf p).arity := by
        rw [← hst', Tree.arity_contr]
      refine ⟨Sum.inl ⟨(withTree p (treeOf s) har, q), k⟩, ?_, ?_⟩
      · rw [Finset.inl_mem_disjSum, Finset.mem_sigma, mem_fib, Finset.mem_Ico]
        refine ⟨comp_eq_iff.2 ⟨hord, ?_⟩, hk1, hk⟩
        rw [treeOf_withTree, withTree_fst, Tree.eq_leaf_of_isLeaf hq, Tree.graft_leaf_right]
      · simp only [liftIdx, Sum.elim_inl, Tree.eq_leaf_of_isLeaf hq, Tree.weight_leaf, ite_self,
          Nat.add_zero]
        congr 1
        exact Prod.ext (reg_ext rfl (by rw [treeOf_contrR, treeOf_withTree, hst'])) rfl
    · rcases Tree.contr_eq_graft μ hk1 hk hr (by simpa using hq) hst with
        ⟨a', k₁, ha', hra, hk₁1, hk₁, hca, hkk⟩ | ⟨b', k₂, hb', hbl, hk₂1, hk₂, hcb, hkk⟩
      · have har : a'.arity = (treeOf p).arity := by rw [← hca, Tree.arity_contr]
        refine ⟨Sum.inl ⟨(withTree p a' har, q), k₁⟩, ?_, ?_⟩
        · rw [Finset.inl_mem_disjSum, Finset.mem_sigma, mem_fib, Finset.mem_Ico]
          exact ⟨comp_eq_iff.2 ⟨hord, by rw [treeOf_withTree, withTree_fst, ha']⟩, hk₁1, hk₁⟩
        · simp only [liftIdx, Sum.elim_inl, treeOf_withTree, withTree_fst]
          rw [← hkk]
          congr 1
          exact Prod.ext (reg_ext rfl (by rw [treeOf_contrR, treeOf_withTree, hca])) rfl
      · have hbr : b'.arity = (treeOf q).arity := by rw [← hcb, Tree.arity_contr]
        refine ⟨Sum.inr ⟨(p, withTree q b' hbr), k₂⟩, ?_, ?_⟩
        · rw [Finset.inr_mem_disjSum, Finset.mem_sigma, mem_fib, Finset.mem_Ico]
          exact ⟨comp_eq_iff.2 ⟨by rw [withTree_fst, hord], by rw [treeOf_withTree, hb']⟩,
            hk₂1, hk₂⟩
        · simp only [liftIdx, Sum.elim_inr]
          rw [← hkk]
          congr 1
          exact Prod.ext rfl (reg_ext rfl (by rw [treeOf_contrR, treeOf_withTree, hcb]))
  · 
    rintro (⟨⟨p, q⟩, k⟩ | ⟨⟨p, q⟩, k⟩) hz
    · rw [Finset.inl_mem_disjSum, Finset.mem_sigma, mem_fib, Finset.mem_Ico] at hz
      dsimp only at hz
      obtain ⟨hpq, hk1, hk⟩ := hz
      obtain ⟨ht, -, -⟩ := hfac hpq
      have e := Tree.contrSgn_graft_outer' μ gp hμ (z := treeOf q) (rank_lt_arity p i) hk1 hk
      rw [← ht] at e
      simp only [liftIdx, Sum.elim_inl, decTermO, decTermL, cSgn, contrR_fst, treeOf_contrR]
      congr 1
      simp only [← σ_xor]
      congr 1
      revert e
      cases Tree.tpar gp (treeOf q) && Tree.apar gp (treeOf p) (p.1.rank i) <;>
        cases Tree.contrSgn gp (treeOf p) k <;>
        cases Tree.tpar gp (treeOf q) && Tree.apar gp ((treeOf p).contr μ k) (p.1.rank i) <;>
        cases Tree.contrSgn gp (treeOf s) (k + if (treeOf p).vb (p.1.rank i) ≤ k
          then (treeOf q).weight else 0) <;> decide
    · rw [Finset.inr_mem_disjSum, Finset.mem_sigma, mem_fib, Finset.mem_Ico] at hz
      dsimp only at hz
      obtain ⟨hpq, hk1, hk⟩ := hz
      obtain ⟨ht, -, -⟩ := hfac hpq
      simp only [liftIdx, Sum.elim_inr, decTermI, decTermL, cSgn, treeOf_contrR]
      rw [ht, Tree.contrSgn_graft_inner gp (rank_lt_arity p i) hk1 hk,
        Tree.tpar_contr μ gp hμ hk1 hk]
      congr 1
      simp only [← σ_xor]
      congr 1
      cases Tree.tpar gp (treeOf q) <;> cases Tree.apar gp (treeOf p) (p.1.rank i) <;>
        cases Tree.tpar gp (treeOf p) <;> cases Tree.contrSgn gp (treeOf q) k <;> rfl

name: Operad.FreeGr.decomp_barD
statement:
theorem decomp_barD (hμ : MergeFn.Odd gp μ) (i : A) (x : FreeGr R gp (Without A i ⊕ B)) :
    GrCooperad.decomp (R := R) (C := FreeGr R gp) i (barD μ gp R _ x)
      = TensorProduct.map (barD μ gp R A) LinearMap.id
          (GrCooperad.decomp (R := R) (C := FreeGr R gp) i x)
        + TensorProduct.map (GrSpecies.tw (R := R) (V := FreeGr R gp) true) (barD μ gp R B)
          (GrCooperad.decomp (R := R) (C := FreeGr R gp) i x)
proof:
:= by
  have h := Lin.induction₁ (S := Reg (TreeOfArity T))
    (GrCooperad.decomp (R := R) (C := FreeGr R gp) (B := B) i ∘ₗ barD μ gp R _)
    (TensorProduct.map (barD μ gp R A) LinearMap.id ∘ₗ
        GrCooperad.decomp (R := R) (C := FreeGr R gp) (B := B) i +
      TensorProduct.map (GrSpecies.tw (R := R) (V := FreeGr R gp) true) (barD μ gp R B) ∘ₗ
        GrCooperad.decomp (R := R) (C := FreeGr R gp) (B := B) i)
    (fun s => decomp_barD_bas hμ i s) x
  simpa using h

name: Operad.FreeGr.barD_comp
statement:
theorem barD_comp (hμ : MergeFn.Odd gp μ) (i : A) (x : FreeGr R gp A) (y : FreeGr R gp B) :
    barD μ gp R _ (GrOperad.comp (R := R) i x y)
      = GrOperad.comp (R := R) i (barD μ gp R A x) y
        + GrOperad.comp (R := R) i (GrSpecies.tw (R := R) (V := FreeGr R gp) true x)
            (barD μ gp R B y)
        + mcomp μ gp R i x y
proof:
:= by
  have htw : ∀ p : Reg (TreeOfArity T) A, GrSpecies.tw (R := R) (V := FreeGr R gp) true
      (SgnLin.bas (treeSgn gp) R p)
        = σ R (Tree.tpar gp (treeOf p)) • SgnLin.bas (treeSgn gp) R p :=
    fun p => (GrSpecies.tw_hom true (SgnLin.par_bas p)).trans (by rw [Bool.true_and]; rfl)
  have h : (GrOperad.comp (R := R) (P := FreeGr R gp) (B := B) i).compr₂ (barD μ gp R _)
      = (GrOperad.comp (R := R) (P := FreeGr R gp) (B := B) i).comp (barD μ gp R A)
        + ((GrOperad.comp (R := R) (P := FreeGr R gp) (B := B) i).comp
            (GrSpecies.tw (R := R) (V := FreeGr R gp) true)).compl₂ (barD μ gp R B)
        + mcomp μ gp R i := by
    refine Finsupp.lhom_ext' fun s => LinearMap.ext_ring
      (Finsupp.lhom_ext' fun t => LinearMap.ext_ring ?_)
    have e := barD_comp_bas (R := R) hμ i s t
    show barD μ gp R _ (GrOperad.comp (R := R) i (SgnLin.bas (treeSgn gp) R s)
        (SgnLin.bas (treeSgn gp) R t))
      = GrOperad.comp (R := R) i (barD μ gp R A (SgnLin.bas (treeSgn gp) R s))
          (SgnLin.bas (treeSgn gp) R t)
        + GrOperad.comp (R := R) i (GrSpecies.tw (R := R) (V := FreeGr R gp) true
            (SgnLin.bas (treeSgn gp) R s)) (barD μ gp R B (SgnLin.bas (treeSgn gp) R t))
        + mcomp μ gp R i (SgnLin.bas (treeSgn gp) R s) (SgnLin.bas (treeSgn gp) R t)
    rw [htw, map_smul, LinearMap.smul_apply]
    exact e
  have := LinearMap.congr_fun (LinearMap.congr_fun h x) y
  simpa using this

name: Operad.FreeGr.par_barD
statement:
theorem par_barD (hμ : MergeFn.Odd gp μ) (b : Bool) (x : FreeGr R gp A) :
    GrOperad.par (R := R) b (barD μ gp R A x) = barD μ gp R A (GrOperad.par (R := R) (!b) x)
proof:
:= by
  have h := Lin.induction₁ (S := Reg (TreeOfArity T)) (GrOperad.par (R := R) b ∘ₗ barD μ gp R A)
    (barD μ gp R A ∘ₗ GrOperad.par (R := R) (P := FreeGr R gp) (A := A) (!b)) (fun s => ?_) x
  · simpa using h
  show GrOperad.par (R := R) b (barD μ gp R A (SgnLin.bas (treeSgn gp) R s))
    = barD μ gp R A (GrOperad.par (R := R) (!b) (SgnLin.bas (treeSgn gp) R s))
  have hp : ∀ (c : Bool) (t : Reg (TreeOfArity T) A),
      GrOperad.par (R := R) c (SgnLin.bas (treeSgn gp) R t)
        = if Tree.tpar gp (treeOf t) = c then SgnLin.bas (treeSgn gp) R t else 0 :=
    fun c t => SgnLin.parT_single c t 1
  rw [hp, barD_bas, map_sum]
  simp only [map_smul, hp, treeOf_contrR]
  by_cases hs : Tree.tpar gp (treeOf s) = !b
  · rw [if_pos hs, barD_bas]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun k hk => ?_
    rw [Finset.mem_Ico] at hk
    rw [if_pos (by rw [Tree.tpar_contr μ gp hμ hk.1 hk.2, hs, Bool.not_not])]
  · rw [if_neg hs, map_zero]
    refine Finset.sum_eq_zero fun k hk => ?_
    rw [Finset.mem_Ico] at hk
    have hc := Tree.tpar_contr μ gp hμ hk.1 hk.2
    rw [if_neg (fun h => hs (by rw [hc] at h; rw [← h, Bool.not_not])), smul_zero]

name: Operad.FreeGr.map_barD
statement:
theorem map_barD {A' : Type} [Fintype A'] [DecidableEq A'] (e : A ≃ A') (x : FreeGr R gp A) :
    GrOperad.map (R := R) e (barD μ gp R A x) = barD μ gp R A' (GrOperad.map (R := R) e x)
proof:
:= by
  have h := Lin.induction₁ (S := Reg (TreeOfArity T)) (GrOperad.map (R := R) e ∘ₗ barD μ gp R A)
    (barD μ gp R A' ∘ₗ GrOperad.map (R := R) (P := FreeGr R gp) e) (fun s => ?_) x
  · simpa using h
  show GrOperad.map (R := R) e (barD μ gp R A (SgnLin.bas (treeSgn gp) R s))
    = barD μ gp R A' (GrOperad.map (R := R) e (SgnLin.bas (treeSgn gp) R s))
  rw [SgnLin.map_bas, barD_bas, barD_bas, map_sum]
  simp only [map_smul, SgnLin.map_bas]
  rfl

name: Operad.FreeGr.counit_barD
statement:
theorem counit_barD (x : FreeGr R gp Unit) :
    GrCooperad.counit (R := R) (C := FreeGr R gp) (barD μ gp R Unit x) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have h := Lin.induction₁ (S := Reg (TreeOfArity T))
    (GrCooperad.counit (R := R) (C := FreeGr R gp) ∘ₗ barD μ gp R Unit) 0 (fun s => ?_) x
  · simpa using h
  show GrCooperad.counit (R := R) (C := FreeGr R gp)
      (barD μ gp R Unit (SgnLin.bas (treeSgn gp) R s)) = 0
  rw [barD_bas, map_sum]
  refine Finset.sum_eq_zero fun k hk => ?_
  rw [Finset.mem_Ico] at hk
  rw [map_smul]
  have hw := Tree.weight_contr μ hk.1 hk.2
  have hne : contrR μ s k ≠ SetOperad.one := fun h => by
    have := congrArg (fun x => (treeOf x).weight) h
    simp only [treeOf_contrR] at this
    rw [this] at hw
    have h1 : (treeOf (SetOperad.one : Reg (TreeOfArity T) Unit)).weight = 0 := rfl
    omega
  show σ R _ • (Finsupp.single (contrR μ s k) (1 : R)) SetOperad.one = 0
  rw [Finsupp.single_eq_of_ne hne.symm, smul_zero]

name: Operad.FreeGr.barD_one
statement: theorem barD_one : barD μ gp R Unit (GrCooperad.Coaug.one (R := R) (C := FreeGr R gp)) = 0
proof:
:=
  barD_bas_of_isLeaf (x := (SetOperad.one : Reg (TreeOfArity T) Unit)) rfl

name: Operad.FreeGr.weightF_leaves
statement:
lemma weightF_leaves : ∀ k : ℕ, (TreeOfArity.leaves (E := T) k).weightF = 0
  | 0 => rfl
  | k + 1 => by
    simp only [TreeOfArity.leaves, Tree.weightF_cons, Tree.weight_leaf, weightF_leaves k]

name: Operad.FreeGr.barD_gen
statement:
theorem barD_gen {k : ℕ} (g : T k) :
    barD μ gp R (Fin k) (FreeGr.gen (R := R) (gp := gp) g) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [FreeGr.gen, barD_bas]
  have h : (treeOf (Reg.std (corolla g) : Reg (TreeOfArity T) (Fin k))).weight = 1 := by
    show (Tree.node g (TreeOfArity.leaves k)).weight = 1
    rw [Tree.weight_node, weightF_leaves]
  rw [h, Finset.Ico_self, Finset.sum_empty]

name: Operad.diagForm_apply
statement: lemma diagForm_apply (c : ι → K) (x y : ι → K) : diagForm c x y = ∑ i, c i * x i * y i
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.diagForm_isRefl
statement: lemma diagForm_isRefl (c : ι → K) : (diagForm c).IsRefl
proof:
:= fun x y h => by
  rw [diagForm_apply] at h ⊢
  rw [← h]
  exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => by ring

name: Operad.diagForm_nondegenerate
statement: lemma diagForm_nondegenerate {c : ι → K} (hc : ∀ i, c i ≠ 0) : (diagForm c).Nondegenerate
proof:
:= by
  classical
  refine ⟨fun x hx => funext fun i => ?_, fun y hy => funext fun i => ?_⟩
  · have h := hx (Pi.single i 1)
    rw [diagForm_apply, Finset.sum_eq_single i] at h
    · simpa [hc i] using h
    · intro j _ hj
      simp [hj]
    · simp
  · have h := hy (Pi.single i 1)
    rw [diagForm_apply, Finset.sum_eq_single i] at h
    · simpa [hc i] using h
    · intro j _ hj
      simp [hj]
    · simp

name: Operad.ShuffleBar.full_fullBar
statement: lemma full_fullBar (m : LTree E) : (fullBar m).mapDec Prod.fst = m
proof: := full_flagBy _ m

name: Operad.ShuffleBar.cutKeys_fullBar
statement: lemma cutKeys_fullBar (m : LTree E) : cutKeys (fullBar m) = m.edgeKeys
proof:
:= by
  rw [fullBar, cutKeys_flagBy, Finset.inter_eq_left.2 (edgeKeys_subset_nodeKeys m)]

name: Operad.ShuffleBar.mergeK_flagBy
statement:
lemma mergeK_flagBy (C : Finset (ℕ ×ₗ ℕ)) (k : ℕ ×ₗ ℕ) {m : LTree E} (hnd : m.labels.Nodup) :
    mergeK (flagBy C m) k = flagBy (C.erase k) m
proof:
:= by
  have hnd' : (flagBy C m).labels.Nodup := by rwa [labels_flagBy]
  have hc : cutKeys (mergeK (flagBy C m) k) = (C ∩ m.nodeKeys).erase k := by
    by_cases hk : k ∈ cutKeys (flagBy C m)
    · rw [cutKeys_mergeK _ hnd' hk, cutKeys_flagBy]
    · rw [mergeK_of_not_mem _ hk, cutKeys_flagBy]
      rw [cutKeys_flagBy] at hk
      exact (Finset.erase_eq_of_notMem hk).symm
  have hndm : (mergeK (flagBy C m) k).labels.Nodup := by rwa [labels_mergeK]
  rw [← flagBy_cutKeys _ hndm, hc, full_mergeK, full_flagBy]
  refine flagBy_congr m fun k' hk' => ?_
  simp only [Finset.mem_erase, Finset.mem_inter]
  tauto

name: Operad.ShuffleBar.key_subtreeAt_flagBy
statement:
lemma key_subtreeAt_flagBy (C : Finset (ℕ ×ₗ ℕ)) (m : LTree E) (q : List Bool) :
    key ((flagBy C m).subtreeAt q) = key (m.subtreeAt q)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← key_mapDec Prod.fst, ← subtreeAt_mapDec, full_flagBy]

name: Operad.ShuffleBar.flagAt_flagBy
proof:
:= by
  have hnd' : (flagBy C m).labels.Nodup := by rwa [labels_flagBy]
  have hq' : ∃ d l r, (flagBy C m).subtreeAt q = node d l r := by
    obtain ⟨e, l, r, h⟩ := hq
    have h' : ((flagBy C m).subtreeAt q).mapDec Prod.fst = node e l r := by
      rw [← subtreeAt_mapDec, full_flagBy, h]
    generalize (flagBy C m).subtreeAt q = u at h'
    cases u with
    | leaf => simp at h'
    | node d a b => exact ⟨d, a, b, rfl⟩
  rw [flagAt_eq _ q hnd' hq', key_subtreeAt_flagBy, cutKeys_flagBy]
  refine decide_eq_decide.2 ⟨fun h => (Finset.mem_inter.1 h).1, fun h => Finset.mem_inter.2
    ⟨h, key_subtreeAt_mem_nodeKeys m q hq⟩⟩

name: Operad.ShuffleBar.nodup_of_mem_monomials
statement: lemma nodup_of_mem_monomials {n : ℕ} {m : LTree E} (hm : m ∈ monomials n) : m.labels.Nodup
proof:
:=
  ((mem_monomials n m).1 hm).2.nodup_iff.2 List.nodup_range

name: Operad.ShuffleBar.arity_of_mem_monomials
statement: lemma arity_of_mem_monomials {n : ℕ} {m : LTree E} (hm : m ∈ monomials n) : m.arity = n
proof:
:= by
  rw [← length_labels, ((mem_monomials n m).1 hm).2.length_eq, List.length_range]

name: Operad.ShuffleBar.card_edgeKeys_of_mem_monomials
statement:
lemma card_edgeKeys_of_mem_monomials {n : ℕ} (hn : 2 ≤ n) {m : LTree E} (hm : m ∈ monomials n) :
    m.edgeKeys.card + 2 = n
proof:
:= by
  have ha := arity_of_mem_monomials hm
  cases m with
  | leaf => simp [arity] at ha; omega
  | node e l r => rw [card_edgeKeys (nodup_of_mem_monomials hm), ha]

name: Operad.ShuffleBar.valid_flagBy
statement:
lemma valid_flagBy {C : Finset (ℕ ×ₗ ℕ)} {m : LTree E} (hs : m.IsShuffle) (hnd : m.labels.Nodup)
    (hC : C ⊆ m.edgeKeys) : Valid (flagBy C m)
proof:
:=
  ⟨by rw [← isShuffle_mapDec Prod.fst, full_flagBy]; exact hs, by rwa [labels_flagBy],
    rootFlag_flagBy hC⟩

name: Operad.ShuffleBar.adm_fullBar
statement:
lemma adm_fullBar {n : ℕ} (hn : 2 ≤ n) {m : LTree E} (hm : m ∈ monomials n) :
    Adm n (n - 1) (fullBar m)
proof:
:= by
  have h := (mem_monomials n m).1 hm
  refine ⟨valid_flagBy h.1 (nodup_of_mem_monomials hm) subset_rfl, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [fullBar, labels_flagBy]
    exact h.2
  · rw [cutKeys_fullBar]
    have := card_edgeKeys_of_mem_monomials hn hm
    omega

name: Operad.ShuffleBar.eq_fullBar_of_adm
statement:
lemma eq_fullBar_of_adm {n : ℕ} {x : BarTree E} (hx : Adm n (n - 1) x) :
    x = fullBar (x.mapDec Prod.fst)
proof:
:= by
  have hm := full_mem_monomials hx
  have hsub := cutKeys_subset_edgeKeys hx.1.root
  have h1 := hx.2.2
  have hn : 2 ≤ n := by omega
  have h2 := card_edgeKeys_of_mem_monomials hn hm
  have heq : cutKeys x = (x.mapDec Prod.fst).edgeKeys :=
    Finset.eq_of_subset_of_card_le hsub (by omega)
  rw [fullBar, ← heq, flagBy_cutKeys x hx.1.nodup]

name: Operad.ShuffleBar.fullBar_injective
statement: lemma fullBar_injective {m m' : LTree E} (h : fullBar m = fullBar m') : m = m'
proof:
:= by
  rw [← full_fullBar m, h, full_fullBar]

name: Operad.ShuffleBar.monoVal_mono
statement: lemma monoVal_mono {n : ℕ} (x : Mono E n → K) (t : Mono E n) : monoVal K x t.1 = x t
proof:
:= by
  simp [monoVal, t.2]

name: Operad.ShuffleBar.monoVal_of_mem
statement:
lemma monoVal_of_mem {n : ℕ} (x : Mono E n → K) {t : LTree E} (ht : t ∈ monomials n) :
    monoVal K x t = x ⟨t, ht⟩
proof:
:= by
  simp [monoVal, ht]

name: Operad.ShuffleBar.monoVal_add
statement:
lemma monoVal_add {n : ℕ} (x y : Mono E n → K) (t : LTree E) :
    monoVal K (x + y) t = monoVal K x t + monoVal K y t
proof:
:= by
  unfold monoVal
  split_ifs <;> simp

name: Operad.ShuffleBar.monoVal_smul
statement:
lemma monoVal_smul {n : ℕ} (c : K) (x : Mono E n → K) (t : LTree E) :
    monoVal K (c • x) t = c * monoVal K x t
proof:
:= by
  unfold monoVal
  split_ifs <;> simp

name: Operad.ShuffleBar.sum_vecOf_mul
statement:
lemma sum_vecOf_mul {n : ℕ} (t : LTree E) (x : Mono E n → K) :
    ∑ m, vecOf K n t m * x m = monoVal K x t
proof:
:= by
  unfold monoVal vecOf
  split_ifs with ht
  · rw [Finset.sum_eq_single ⟨t, ht⟩]
    · simp
    · intro m _ hm
      rw [if_neg fun h => hm (Subtype.ext h), zero_mul]
    · simp
  · exact Finset.sum_eq_zero fun m _ => by
      rw [if_neg fun h => ht (by rw [← h]; exact m.2), zero_mul]

name: Operad.ShuffleBar.tauS_cast_mul_self
statement: lemma tauS_cast_mul_self (t : LTree E) : (tauS t : K) * (tauS t : K) = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Int.cast_mul, tauS_mul_self, Int.cast_one]

name: Operad.ShuffleBar.ofMono_apply
statement:
lemma ofMono_apply {n : ℕ} (x : Mono E n → K) (b : BarTree E) :
    ofMono K n x b = ∑ m : Mono E n, (tauS m.1 : K) * x m * if fullBar m.1 = b then 1 else 0
proof:
:= by
  simp [ofMono, Finsupp.finsetSum_apply, Finsupp.single_apply]

name: Operad.ShuffleBar.ofMono_apply_fullBar
statement:
lemma ofMono_apply_fullBar {n : ℕ} (x : Mono E n → K) (m : Mono E n) :
    ofMono K n x (fullBar m.1) = (tauS m.1 : K) * x m
proof:
:= by
  rw [ofMono_apply, Finset.sum_eq_single m]
  · simp
  · intro m' _ hm'
    rw [if_neg fun h => hm' (Subtype.ext (fullBar_injective h)), mul_zero]
  · simp

name: Operad.ShuffleBar.toMono_ofMono
statement: theorem toMono_ofMono {n : ℕ} (x : Mono E n → K) : toMono K n (ofMono K n x) = x
proof:
:= by
  funext m
  show (tauS m.1 : K) * ofMono K n x (fullBar m.1) = x m
  rw [ofMono_apply_fullBar, ← mul_assoc, tauS_cast_mul_self, one_mul]

name: Operad.ShuffleBar.ofMono_mem_C
statement: lemma ofMono_mem_C {n : ℕ} (hn : 2 ≤ n) (x : Mono E n → K) : ofMono K n x ∈ C K n (n - 1)
proof:
:=
  Submodule.sum_mem _ fun m _ => Submodule.smul_mem _ _
    (Finsupp.single_mem_supported K _ (adm_fullBar hn m.2))

name: Operad.ShuffleBar.ofMono_toMono
statement:
theorem ofMono_toMono {n : ℕ} {v : BarTree E →₀ K} (hv : v ∈ C K n (n - 1)) :
    ofMono K n (toMono K n v) = v
proof:
:= by
  ext b
  rw [ofMono_apply]
  by_cases hb : ∃ m : Mono E n, fullBar m.1 = b
  · obtain ⟨m, rfl⟩ := hb
    rw [Finset.sum_eq_single m]
    · show (tauS m.1 : K) * ((tauS m.1 : K) * v (fullBar m.1)) * _ = _
      rw [if_pos rfl, mul_one, ← mul_assoc, tauS_cast_mul_self, one_mul]
    · intro m' _ hm'
      rw [if_neg fun h => hm' (Subtype.ext (fullBar_injective h)), mul_zero]
    · simp
  · push Not at hb
    rw [Finset.sum_eq_zero fun m _ => by rw [if_neg (hb m), mul_zero]]
    by_contra h0
    have hA : Adm n (n - 1) b := hv (Finsupp.mem_support_iff.2 (Ne.symm h0))
    exact hb ⟨_, full_mem_monomials hA⟩ (eq_fullBar_of_adm hA).symm

name: Operad.ShuffleBar.sgn_fullBar
statement: lemma sgn_fullBar (m : LTree E) (k : ℕ ×ₗ ℕ) : sgn K (fullBar m) k = (topSgn m k : K)
proof:
:= by
  simp [sgn, topSgn, cutKeys_fullBar]

name: Operad.ShuffleBar.dTree_fullBar_apply
statement:
lemma dTree_fullBar_apply {m : LTree E} (hnd : m.labels.Nodup) (b : BarTree E) :
    dTree K (fullBar m) b =
      ∑ k ∈ m.edgeKeys, (topSgn m k : K) * if flagBy (m.edgeKeys.erase k) m = b then 1 else 0
proof:
:= by
  simp only [dTree, Finsupp.finsetSum_apply, Finsupp.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul,
    Finsupp.single_apply, cutKeys_fullBar, sgn_fullBar]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun k _ => ?_
  rw [fullBar, mergeK_flagBy _ _ hnd]

name: Operad.ShuffleBar.key_side3_mem
statement:
lemma key_side3_mem {y : BarTree E} (hy : Valid y) {p : List Bool} {s : Bool}
    (h : IsUncut y p s) (σ : Mono E 3) :
    key (((y.mapDec Prod.fst).substAt p s σ.1).subtreeAt (p ++ [side3 σ.1])) ∈
        ((y.mapDec Prod.fst).substAt p s σ.1).edgeKeys ∧
      key (((y.mapDec Prod.fst).substAt p s σ.1).subtreeAt (p ++ [side3 σ.1])) ∉
        cutKeys (substBar y p s σ.1)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hσs, hσl, -⟩ := mono_shape σ
  obtain ⟨b₀, q₀, hq₀⟩ : ∃ b q, p ++ [side3 σ.1] = b :: q := by
    cases p <;> exact ⟨_, _, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨f, A, B, hfab⟩ := substBar_subtreeAt_side3 h.1 hσs hσl
  have hY : Valid (substBar y p s σ.1) := hy.substBar h σ
  rw [← full_substBar h.1 σ.1, edgeKeys_mapDec, subtreeAt_mapDec, key_mapDec]
  refine ⟨?_, fun h' => ?_⟩
  · rw [hq₀]
    exact key_subtreeAt_mem_edgeKeys _ b₀ q₀ ⟨_, _, _, hq₀ ▸ hfab⟩
  · have hf := flagAt_eq _ _ hY.nodup ⟨_, _, _, hfab⟩
    rw [show flagAt (substBar y p s σ.1) (p ++ [side3 σ.1]) = false by
      simp [flagAt, hfab, rootFlag]] at hf
    simp [h'] at hf

name: Operad.ShuffleBar.cutKeys_substBar_eq_erase
statement:
lemma cutKeys_substBar_eq_erase {n : ℕ} {y : BarTree E} (hy : Adm n (n - 2) y) {p : List Bool}
    {s : Bool} (h : IsUncut y p s) (σ : Mono E 3) :
    cutKeys (substBar y p s σ.1) = ((y.mapDec Prod.fst).substAt p s σ.1).edgeKeys.erase
      (key (((y.mapDec Prod.fst).substAt p s σ.1).subtreeAt (p ++ [side3 σ.1])))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hσs, hσl, hσn⟩ := mono_shape σ
  obtain ⟨hk₀E, hk₀C⟩ := key_side3_mem hy.1 h σ
  have hY : Valid (substBar y p s σ.1) := hy.1.substBar h σ
  have hfull := full_substBar h.1 σ.1
  have hsubY : cutKeys (substBar y p s σ.1) ⊆ ((y.mapDec Prod.fst).substAt p s σ.1).edgeKeys := by
    have := cutKeys_subset_edgeKeys hY.root
    rwa [hfull] at this
  refine Finset.eq_of_subset_of_card_le (fun k' hk' => Finset.mem_erase.2
    ⟨fun h' => hk₀C (h' ▸ hk'), hsubY hk'⟩) ?_
  rw [Finset.card_erase_of_mem hk₀E]
  have hMm : (y.mapDec Prod.fst).substAt p s σ.1 ∈ monomials n :=
    substAt_mem_monomials (full_mem_monomials hy) ((isEdge_mapDec _ _ _ _).2 h.1) σ.2
  have hn : 2 ≤ n := by have := hy.2.2; omega
  have h1 := card_edgeKeys_of_mem_monomials hn hMm
  have h2 := card_add_three_of_adm hy
  have h3 : y.arity = n := by rw [← length_labels, hy.2.1.length_eq, List.length_range]
  rw [cutKeys_substBar hy.1.shuffle hy.1.nodup h hσl hσn]
  omega

name: Operad.ShuffleBar.flagBy_erase_eq_substBar_iff
statement:
lemma flagBy_erase_eq_substBar_iff {n : ℕ} {y : BarTree E} (hy : Adm n (n - 2) y)
    {p : List Bool} {s : Bool} (h : IsUncut y p s) (σ : Mono E 3) {m : LTree E}
    {k : ℕ ×ₗ ℕ} (hk : k ∈ m.edgeKeys) :
    flagBy (m.edgeKeys.erase k) m = substBar y p s σ.1 ↔
      m = (y.mapDec Prod.fst).substAt p s σ.1 ∧
        k = key (((y.mapDec Prod.fst).substAt p s σ.1).subtreeAt (p ++ [side3 σ.1]))
proof:
:= by
  have hY : Valid (substBar y p s σ.1) := hy.1.substBar h σ
  have hfull := full_substBar h.1 σ.1
  have hcutY := cutKeys_substBar_eq_erase hy h σ
  have hk₀E := (key_side3_mem hy.1 h σ).1
  constructor
  · intro heq
    have hm : m = (y.mapDec Prod.fst).substAt p s σ.1 := by
      rw [← full_flagBy (m.edgeKeys.erase k) m, heq, hfull]
    subst hm
    refine ⟨rfl, ?_⟩
    have hc := congrArg cutKeys heq
    rw [cutKeys_flagBy, Finset.inter_eq_left.2 ((Finset.erase_subset _ _).trans
      (edgeKeys_subset_nodeKeys _)), hcutY] at hc
    by_contra hne
    have h' := Finset.mem_erase.2 ⟨Ne.symm hne, hk₀E⟩
    rw [hc] at h'
    exact (Finset.notMem_erase _ _) h'
  · rintro ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
    rw [← hcutY, ← hfull]
    exact flagBy_cutKeys _ hY.nodup

name: Operad.ShuffleBar.d_ofMono_substBar
statement:
theorem d_ofMono_substBar {n : ℕ} {y : BarTree E} (hy : Adm n (n - 2) y) {p : List Bool}
    {s : Bool} (h : IsUncut y p s) (x : Mono E n → K) (σ : Mono E 3) :
    d K (ofMono K n x) (substBar y p s σ.1) =
      (tauS ((y.mapDec Prod.fst).substAt p s σ.1) : K) *
        monoVal K x ((y.mapDec Prod.fst).substAt p s σ.1) *
        (topSgn ((y.mapDec Prod.fst).substAt p s σ.1)
          (key (((y.mapDec Prod.fst).substAt p s σ.1).subtreeAt (p ++ [side3 σ.1]))) : K)
proof:
:= by
  have hMm : (y.mapDec Prod.fst).substAt p s σ.1 ∈ monomials n :=
    substAt_mem_monomials (full_mem_monomials hy) ((isEdge_mapDec _ _ _ _).2 h.1) σ.2
  have hk₀E := (key_side3_mem hy.1 h σ).1
  have hd : d K (ofMono K n x) =
      ∑ m : Mono E n, ((tauS m.1 : K) * x m) • dTree K (fullBar m.1) := by
    simp only [ofMono, LinearMap.coe_mk, AddHom.coe_mk, map_sum, map_smul, d_single, one_smul]
  rw [hd, Finsupp.finsetSum_apply, Finset.sum_eq_single ⟨_, hMm⟩]
  · rw [Finsupp.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, dTree_fullBar_apply (nodup_of_mem_monomials hMm),
      Finset.sum_eq_single
        (key (((y.mapDec Prod.fst).substAt p s σ.1).subtreeAt (p ++ [side3 σ.1]))),
      monoVal_of_mem x hMm]
    · rw [if_pos ((flagBy_erase_eq_substBar_iff hy h σ hk₀E).2 ⟨rfl, rfl⟩)]
      dsimp only
      ring
    · intro k hk hkk
      rw [if_neg fun h' => hkk ((flagBy_erase_eq_substBar_iff hy h σ hk).1 h').2, mul_zero]
    · exact fun h' => absurd hk₀E h'
  · intro m _ hm
    rw [Finsupp.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, dTree_fullBar_apply (nodup_of_mem_monomials m.2)]
    refine mul_eq_zero_of_right _ (Finset.sum_eq_zero fun k hk => ?_)
    rw [if_neg fun h' => hm (Subtype.ext ((flagBy_erase_eq_substBar_iff hy h σ hk).1 h').1),
      mul_zero]
  · simp

name: Operad.ShuffleBar.adm_flagBy_erase
statement:
lemma adm_flagBy_erase {n : ℕ} (hn : 2 ≤ n) {t : LTree E} (ht : t ∈ monomials n)
    {p : List Bool} {s : Bool} (he : t.IsEdge p s) :
    Adm n (n - 2) (flagBy (t.edgeKeys.erase (key (t.subtreeAt (p ++ [s])))) t) ∧
      IsUncut (flagBy (t.edgeKeys.erase (key (t.subtreeAt (p ++ [s])))) t) p s
proof:
:= by
  have hst := (mem_monomials n t).1 ht
  have hnd := nodup_of_mem_monomials ht
  obtain ⟨b, q, hq⟩ : ∃ b q, p ++ [s] = b :: q := by
    cases p <;> exact ⟨_, _, rfl⟩
  have hkE : key (t.subtreeAt (p ++ [s])) ∈ t.edgeKeys := by
    have hn' := he.exists_node_child
    rw [hq] at hn' ⊢
    exact key_subtreeAt_mem_edgeKeys t b q hn'
  refine ⟨⟨valid_flagBy hst.1 hnd (Finset.erase_subset _ _), by rw [labels_flagBy]; exact hst.2,
    ?_⟩, (isEdge_mapDec Prod.fst _ p s).1 (by rw [full_flagBy]; exact he), ?_⟩
  · rw [cutKeys_flagBy, Finset.inter_eq_left.2 ((Finset.erase_subset _ _).trans
      (edgeKeys_subset_nodeKeys t)), Finset.card_erase_of_mem hkE]
    have := card_edgeKeys_of_mem_monomials hn ht
    have : 1 ≤ t.edgeKeys.card := Finset.card_pos.2 ⟨_, hkE⟩
    omega
  · rw [flagAt_flagBy _ hnd he.exists_node_child]
    simp

name: Operad.ShuffleBar.winCoef_d_ofMono
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨c, hc, hcoh⟩ := topSgn_mul_tauS_substAt (t := y.mapDec Prod.fst)
    ((isShuffle_mapDec _ _).2 hy.1.shuffle) (by simpa using hy.1.nodup)
    ((isEdge_mapDec _ _ _ _).2 h.1)
  refine ⟨(c : K), by rw [← Int.cast_mul, hc, Int.cast_one], fun x => funext fun σ => ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨hσs, hσl, -⟩ := mono_shape σ
  have hcast := congrArg (fun z : ℤ => (z : K)) (hcoh σ.1 hσs hσl)
  push_cast at hcast
  rw [winCoef_apply, d_ofMono_substBar hy h x σ, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, winVal]
  calc _ = ((topSgn ((y.mapDec Prod.fst).substAt p s σ.1)
          (key (((y.mapDec Prod.fst).substAt p s σ.1).subtreeAt (p ++ [side3 σ.1]))) : K) *
          (tauS ((y.mapDec Prod.fst).substAt p s σ.1) : K)) *
          monoVal K x ((y.mapDec Prod.fst).substAt p s σ.1) := by ring
    _ = _ := by
      rw [hcast]
      ring

name: Operad.ShuffleBar.d_ofMono_mem_J_iff
statement:
theorem d_ofMono_mem_J_iff {R : Submodule K (Mono E 3 → K)} {n : ℕ} (hn : 2 ≤ n)
    (x : Mono E n → K) : d K (ofMono K n x) ∈ J K R ↔ x ∈ KDmono K R n
proof:
:= by
  have hC : d K (ofMono K n x) ∈ C K n (n - 2) := by
    have := ofMono_mem_C hn x
    rw [show n - 1 = (n - 2) + 1 by omega] at this
    exact d_mem_C K this
  rw [mem_J_iff_winCoef hC]
  constructor
  · intro hJ t p s he
    obtain ⟨hy, hu⟩ := adm_flagBy_erase hn t.2 he
    obtain ⟨c, hc, hw⟩ := winCoef_d_ofMono (K := K) hy hu
    have h1 := hJ _ p s hy hu
    rw [hw x, full_flagBy] at h1
    have : winVal K x t.1 p s = c • (c • winVal K x t.1 p s) := by rw [smul_smul, hc, one_smul]
    rw [this]
    exact Submodule.smul_mem _ c h1
  · intro hx y p s hy hu
    obtain ⟨c, -, hw⟩ := winCoef_d_ofMono (K := K) hy hu
    rw [hw x]
    exact Submodule.smul_mem _ c
      (hx ⟨_, full_mem_monomials hy⟩ p s ((isEdge_mapDec _ _ _ _).2 hu.1))

name: Operad.ShuffleBar.chi3_cast_ne_zero
statement: lemma chi3_cast_ne_zero (σ : LTree E) : (chi3 σ : K) ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  have := congrArg (fun z : ℤ => (z : K)) (chi3_sq σ)
  push_cast at this
  rw [h, zero_mul] at this
  exact zero_ne_one this

name: Operad.ShuffleBar.mem_dualRel
statement:
lemma mem_dualRel {R : Submodule K (Mono E 3 → K)} {ρ : Mono E 3 → K} :
    ρ ∈ dualRel K R ↔ ∀ r ∈ R, ∑ σ, (chi3 σ.1 : K) * r σ * ρ σ = 0
proof: := Iff.rfl

name: Operad.ShuffleBar.dualRel_dualRel
statement: theorem dualRel_dualRel (R : Submodule K (Mono E 3 → K)) : dualRel K (dualRel K R) = R
proof:
:=
  LinearMap.BilinForm.orthogonal_orthogonal
    (diagForm_nondegenerate (c := fun σ : Mono E 3 => (chi3 σ.1 : K))
      fun σ => chi3_cast_ne_zero σ.1) (diagForm_isRefl _) R

name: Operad.ShuffleBar.finrank_dualRel
statement:
theorem finrank_dualRel (R : Submodule K (Mono E 3 → K)) :
    finrank K (dualRel K R) = finrank K (Mono E 3 → K) - finrank K R
proof:
:=
  LinearMap.BilinForm.finrank_orthogonal
    (diagForm_nondegenerate (c := fun σ : Mono E 3 => (chi3 σ.1 : K))
      fun σ => chi3_cast_ne_zero σ.1) R

name: Operad.ShuffleBar.diagForm_one_substVec
statement:
lemma diagForm_one_substVec {n : ℕ} (t : LTree E) (p : List Bool) (s : Bool)
    (ρ : Mono E 3 → K) (x : Mono E n → K) :
    diagForm (fun _ : Mono E n => (1 : K)) (substVec K n t p s ρ) x =
      ∑ σ, ρ σ * monoVal K x (t.substAt p s σ.1)
proof:
:= by
  rw [diagForm_apply]
  simp only [one_mul, substVec, Finset.sum_apply, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, Finset.sum_mul]
  rw [Finset.sum_comm]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun σ _ => ?_
  rw [← sum_vecOf_mul, Finset.mul_sum]
  exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun m _ => by ring

name: Operad.ShuffleBar.KDmono_eq_orthogonal
statement:
theorem KDmono_eq_orthogonal (R : Submodule K (Mono E 3 → K)) (n : ℕ) :
    KDmono K R n =
      (diagForm fun _ : Mono E n => (1 : K)).orthogonal (idealOf K (dualRel K R) n)
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  rw [LinearMap.BilinForm.mem_orthogonal_iff]
  constructor
  · intro hx v hv
    induction hv using Submodule.span_induction with
    | mem v hv =>
      obtain ⟨t, p, s, ρ, hρ, he, rfl⟩ := hv
      show diagForm _ (substVec K n t.1 p s ρ) x = 0
      rw [diagForm_one_substVec, ← hρ _ (hx t p s he)]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun σ _ => ?_
      have h2 : (chi3 σ.1 : K) * (chi3 σ.1 : K) = 1 := by
        rw [← Int.cast_mul, chi3_sq, Int.cast_one]
      simp only [winVal]
      linear_combination (-(ρ σ * monoVal K x (t.1.substAt p s σ.1))) * h2
    | zero => exact LinearMap.BilinForm.isOrtho_zero_left x
    | add v w _ _ hv hw =>
      show diagForm _ (v + w) x = 0
      rw [map_add, LinearMap.add_apply, hv, hw, add_zero]
    | smul c v _ hv =>
      show diagForm _ (c • v) x = 0
      rw [map_smul, LinearMap.smul_apply, hv, smul_zero]
  · intro hx t p s he
    rw [← dualRel_dualRel R, mem_dualRel]
    intro ρ hρ
    have h1 := hx _ (substVec_mem_idealOf K (dualRel K R) t he hρ)
    change diagForm _ (substVec K n t.1 p s ρ) x = 0 at h1
    rw [diagForm_one_substVec] at h1
    rw [← h1]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun σ _ => ?_
    have h2 : (chi3 σ.1 : K) * (chi3 σ.1 : K) = 1 := by
      rw [← Int.cast_mul, chi3_sq, Int.cast_one]
    simp only [winVal]
    linear_combination (ρ σ * monoVal K x (t.1.substAt p s σ.1)) * h2

name: Operad.ShuffleBar.finrank_KDmono
statement:
theorem finrank_KDmono (R : Submodule K (Mono E 3 → K)) (n : ℕ) :
    finrank K (KDmono K R n) = finrank K ((Mono E n → K) ⧸ idealOf K (dualRel K R) n)
proof:
:= by
  rw [KDmono_eq_orthogonal, LinearMap.BilinForm.finrank_orthogonal
    (diagForm_nondegenerate fun _ => one_ne_zero)]
  have := Submodule.finrank_quotient_add_finrank (idealOf K (dualRel K R) n)
  omega

name: Operad.ShuffleBar.finrank_quotient_dualRel
statement:
theorem finrank_quotient_dualRel (R : Submodule K (Mono E 3 → K)) {n : ℕ} (hn : 2 ≤ n) :
    finrank K ((Mono E n → K) ⧸ idealOf K (dualRel K R) n) = finrank K (KD K R n)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← finrank_KDmono, (kdEquivKDmono R hn).finrank_eq]

name: Operad.ShuffleBar.finrank_quotient_dualRel_eq_ncard
statement:
theorem finrank_quotient_dualRel_eq_ncard (rk : E → ℕ) {L : Set (LTree E)}
    {R : Submodule K (Mono E 3 → K)} (hG : IsGroebner K rk L R) {n : ℕ} (hn : 2 ≤ n) :
    finrank K ((Mono E n → K) ⧸ idealOf K (dualRel K R) n) =
      {m | m ∈ monomials (E := E) n ∧ IsFull L m}.ncard
proof:
:= by
  rw [finrank_quotient_dualRel R hn, finrank_KD_eq_ncard K rk hG hn]

name: Operad.SymCooperad.mem_filt_succ
statement:
lemma mem_filt_succ {n : ℕ} {c : C A} :
    c ∈ filt R C (n + 1) A ↔ ∀ (B D : Type) [Fintype B] [DecidableEq B] [Fintype D]
      [DecidableEq D] (i : B) (e : Without B i ⊕ D ≃ A),
      decomp (R := R) i (map (R := R) e.symm c) ∈ filtTarget R C (filt R C n) B D
proof:
:=
  Iff.rfl

name: Operad.SymCooperad.filt_zero
statement: lemma filt_zero : filt R C 0 A = coaugSpan R C A
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: Operad.SymCooperad.map_mem_unitSpan
statement:
lemma map_mem_unitSpan (one : C Unit) (e : A ≃ A') {c : C A} (hc : c ∈ unitSpan R C one A) :
    map (R := R) e c ∈ unitSpan R C one A'
proof:
:= by
  induction hc using Submodule.span_induction with
  | mem x hx =>
    obtain ⟨e', rfl⟩ := hx
    exact Submodule.subset_span ⟨e'.trans e, map_trans (R := R) (C := C) e' e one⟩
  | zero => simp
  | add x y _ _ hx hy => simpa only [map_add] using add_mem hx hy
  | smul r x _ hx => simpa only [map_smul] using Submodule.smul_mem _ r hx

name: Operad.SymCooperad.decomp_mem_coaugSpan
proof:
:= by
  induction hc using Submodule.span_induction with
  | mem x hx =>
    obtain ⟨e, rfl⟩ := hx
    exact Coaug.decomp_mem i e
  | zero => simp
  | add x y _ _ hx hy => simpa only [map_add] using add_mem hx hy
  | smul r x _ hx => simpa only [map_smul] using Submodule.smul_mem _ r hx

name: Operad.SymCooperad.filtTarget_mono
proof:
:=
  sup_le_sup_left (Submodule.map₂_le_map₂ (h B) (h D)) _

name: Operad.SymCooperad.map_mem_filt
statement:
lemma map_mem_filt (n : ℕ) (e : A ≃ A') {c : C A} (hc : c ∈ filt R C n A) :
    map (R := R) e c ∈ filt R C n A'
proof:
:= by
  cases n with
  | zero => exact map_mem_unitSpan _ e hc
  | succ n =>
    intro B D _ _ _ _ i e'
    have h := hc B D i (e'.trans e.symm)
    rwa [← map_trans, show e.trans e'.symm = (e'.trans e.symm).symm by ext; simp]

name: Operad.SymCooperad.coaugSpan_le_filt
statement:
lemma coaugSpan_le_filt (n : ℕ) (A : Type) [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] :
    coaugSpan R C A ≤ filt R C n A
proof:
:= by
  induction n generalizing A with
  | zero => exact le_rfl
  | succ n ih =>
    intro c hc B D _ _ _ _ i e
    have := decomp_mem_coaugSpan (R := R) (C := C) i (map_mem_unitSpan _ e.symm hc)
    exact Submodule.mem_sup_right ((Submodule.map₂_le_map₂ (ih B) (ih D)) this)

name: Operad.SymCooperad.filt_mono
statement:
lemma filt_mono (n : ℕ) (A : Type) [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] :
    filt R C n A ≤ filt R C (n + 1) A
proof:
:= by
  induction n generalizing A with
  | zero => exact coaugSpan_le_filt 1 A
  | succ n ih =>
    intro c hc B D _ _ _ _ i e
    exact filtTarget_mono (fun A _ _ => ih A) (hc B D i e)

name: Operad.SymCooperad.filt_le_filt
statement:
lemma filt_le_filt {m n : ℕ} (h : m ≤ n) (A : Type) [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] :
    filt R C m A ≤ filt R C n A
proof:
:= by
  induction h with
  | refl => exact le_rfl
  | step _ ih => exact ih.trans (filt_mono _ A)

name: Operad.SetOperad.ConnectedWeight.w_map
statement: lemma w_map (e : A ≃ B) (t : S A) : w (SetOperad.map e t) = w t
proof:
:=
  (wt (S := S)).app_map e t

name: Operad.SetOperad.ConnectedWeight.w_one
statement: lemma w_one : w (SetOperad.one : S Unit) = 0
proof:
:=
  (wt (S := S)).app_one

name: Operad.SetOperad.ConnectedWeight.w_comp
statement: lemma w_comp (i : A) (p : S A) (q : S B) : w (SetOperad.comp i p q) = w p + w q
proof:
:=
  (wt (S := S)).app_comp i p q

name: Operad.SetOperad.ConnectedWeight.w_eq_zero_iff
statement: lemma w_eq_zero_iff (t : S A) : w t = 0 ↔ ∃ e : Unit ≃ A, t = SetOperad.map e SetOperad.one
proof:
:=
  ⟨eq_unit t, fun ⟨e, he⟩ => by rw [he, w_map, w_one]⟩

name: Operad.Lin.decompL_mem
statement:
lemma decompL_mem (i : A) (x : S (Without A i ⊕ B) →₀ R)
    (P : Submodule R ((S A →₀ R) ⊗[R] (S B →₀ R)))
    (h : ∀ p q, x (SetOperad.comp i p q) ≠ 0 →
      Finsupp.single p (1 : R) ⊗ₜ Finsupp.single q (1 : R) ∈ P) :
    decompL R i x ∈ P
proof:
:= by
  set y := finComap (R := R) (fun pq : S A × S B => SetOperad.comp i pq.1 pq.2)
    (SetOperad.FiniteFact.finite i) x with hy
  have hdec : decompL R i x = (tens R (S A) (S B)).symm y := rfl
  rw [hdec, ← Finsupp.sum_single y, Finsupp.sum, map_sum]
  refine Submodule.sum_mem _ fun pq hpq => ?_
  rw [finsuppTensorFinsupp'_symm_single_eq_tmul_single_one, ← mul_one (y pq), ← smul_eq_mul,
    ← Finsupp.smul_single, ← TensorProduct.smul_tmul']
  exact Submodule.smul_mem _ _ (h _ _ (show y pq ≠ 0 from Finsupp.mem_support_iff.1 hpq))

name: Operad.Lin.single_unit_mem
statement:
lemma single_unit_mem (one : S Unit →₀ R) (hone : one = Finsupp.single SetOperad.one 1)
    (e : Unit ≃ A) :
    Finsupp.single (SetOperad.map e SetOperad.one : S A) (1 : R)
      ∈ unitSpan R (Lin R S) one A
proof:
:= by
  refine Submodule.subset_span ⟨e, ?_⟩
  rw [hone]
  exact mapL_single e _ _

name: Operad.Lin.one_eq
statement: lemma one_eq : Coaug.one (R := R) (C := Lin R S) = Finsupp.single SetOperad.one 1
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: Operad.Lin.single_mem_filt
statement: theorem single_mem_filt (t : S A) : Finsupp.single t (1 : R) ∈ filt R (Lin R S) (w t) A
proof:
:= by
  suffices h : ∀ n (A : Type) [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] (t : S A), w t = n →
      Finsupp.single t (1 : R) ∈ filt R (Lin R S) n A from h _ A t rfl
  intro n
  induction n using Nat.strong_induction_on with
  | _ n ih =>
    intro A _ _ t ht
    cases n with
    | zero =>
      obtain ⟨e, rfl⟩ := eq_unit t ht
      exact single_unit_mem _ rfl e
    | succ m =>
      intro B D _ _ _ _ i e
      show decompL R i (mapL R e.symm (Finsupp.single t 1)) ∈ _
      rw [mapL_single]
      refine decompL_mem i _ _ fun p q hpq => ?_
      have hx : SetOperad.comp i p q = SetOperad.map e.symm t := by
        by_contra hne
        exact hpq (Finsupp.single_eq_of_ne hne)
      have hw := congrArg w hx
      rw [w_comp, w_map, ht] at hw
      by_cases hp : w p = 0
      · obtain ⟨e₁, rfl⟩ := eq_unit p hp
        exact Submodule.mem_sup_left (Submodule.mem_sup_left
          (Submodule.apply_mem_map₂ _ (single_unit_mem _ rfl e₁) Submodule.mem_top))
      by_cases hq : w q = 0
      · obtain ⟨e₂, rfl⟩ := eq_unit q hq
        exact Submodule.mem_sup_left (Submodule.mem_sup_right
          (Submodule.apply_mem_map₂ _ Submodule.mem_top (single_unit_mem _ rfl e₂)))
      refine Submodule.mem_sup_right (Submodule.apply_mem_map₂ _ ?_ ?_)
      · exact filt_le_filt (by omega) B (ih _ (by omega) B p rfl)
      · exact filt_le_filt (by omega) D (ih _ (by omega) D q rfl)

name: Operad.Lin.conilpotent
statement: theorem conilpotent : Conilpotent R (Lin R S)
proof:
:= by
  intro A _ _ x
  refine ⟨x.support.sup w, ?_⟩
  have key : ∀ t ∈ x.support, Finsupp.single t (x t) ∈ filt R (Lin R S) (x.support.sup w) A :=
    fun t ht => by
      rw [← mul_one (x t), ← smul_eq_mul, ← Finsupp.smul_single]
      exact Submodule.smul_mem _ _
        (filt_le_filt (Finset.le_sup (f := w) ht) A (single_mem_filt t))
  generalize x.support.sup w = n at key ⊢
  have hx : x = ∑ t ∈ x.support, Finsupp.single t (x t) := (Finsupp.sum_single x).symm
  rw [hx]
  exact Submodule.sum_mem _ key

name: Operad.gbracket_add_right
statement:
lemma gbracket_add_right {j k : ℕ} (α : P (j + 1)) (β β' : P (k + 1)) :
    gbracket (R := R) α (β + β') = gbracket (R := R) α β + gbracket (R := R) α β'
proof:
:= by
  simp only [gbracket, sstar_add_right, sstar_add_left, map_add, smul_add]
  abel

name: Operad.gbracket_smul_right
statement:
lemma gbracket_smul_right {j k : ℕ} (r : R) (α : P (j + 1)) (β : P (k + 1)) :
    gbracket (R := R) α (r • β) = r • gbracket (R := R) α β
proof:
:= by
  simp only [gbracket, sstar_smul_right, sstar_smul_left, map_smul, smul_sub]
  rw [smul_comm]

name: Operad.dLin_apply
statement:
@[simp] lemma dLin_apply (T : PieceS R P 1) (m : ℕ) (x : PieceS R P m) :
    dLin T m x = gbracket (R := R) (P := P) (j := 1) (k := m) T x
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.incS_injective
statement: lemma incS_injective {i : ℕ} : Function.Injective (incS (R := R) (P := P) i)
proof:
:= by
  intro a b h
  have h' := congrArg (fun y : TotS R P => y i) h
  simpa only [DirectSum.of_eq_same] using h'

name: Operad.brT_incS
statement:
lemma brT_incS (m : ℕ) (T : PieceS R P 1) (x : PieceS R P m) :
    brT 1 m (incS 1 T) (incS m x) = incS (1 + m) (dLin T m x)
proof:
:= by
  rw [brT, incS_mul_incS, incS_mul_incS,
    incS_reindex (show m + 1 = 1 + m by omega)
      (sstar (R := R) (P := P) (j := m) (k := 1) x T), smul_incS, ← map_sub]
  rfl

name: Operad.incS_mul_self_eq_zero
proof:
:= by
  rw [incS_mul_incS, hMC]
  exact map_zero _

name: Operad.dLin_dLin
statement:
theorem dLin_dLin (T : PieceS R P 1)
    (hMC : sstar (R := R) (P := P) (j := 1) (k := 1) T T = 0)
    (m : ℕ) (x : PieceS R P m) : dLin T (1 + m) (dLin T m x) = 0
proof:
:= by
  apply incS_injective (i := 1 + (1 + m))
  rw [map_zero, ← brT_incS, ← brT_incS]
  exact dsq_eq_zero m T x (incS_mul_self_eq_zero hMC)

name: Operad.coboundaries_le_cocycles
statement:
theorem coboundaries_le_cocycles (T : PieceS R P 1)
    (hMC : sstar (R := R) (P := P) (j := 1) (k := 1) T T = 0) (m : ℕ) :
    coboundaries T m ≤ cocycles T m
proof:
:= by
  rintro y ⟨x, rfl⟩
  exact dLin_dLin T hMC m x

name: Operad.cohomologyMk_eq_zero_iff
statement:
theorem cohomologyMk_eq_zero_iff (T : PieceS R P 1) (m : ℕ) (x : cocycles (R := R) T m) :
    cohomologyMk T m x = 0 ↔ (x : PieceS R P (1 + m)) ∈ coboundaries (R := R) T m
proof:
:=
  Submodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero _

name: Operad.ShuffleBarSym.cross_nil_left
statement: @[simp] lemma cross_nil_left (l : List α) : cross [] l = 0
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.ShuffleBarSym.cross_cons_left
statement:
lemma cross_cons_left (a : α) (l₁ l₂ : List α) :
    cross (a :: l₁) l₂ = l₂.countP (· < a) + cross l₁ l₂
proof:
:= by
  simp [cross]

name: Operad.ShuffleBarSym.cross_nil_right
statement: @[simp] lemma cross_nil_right (l : List α) : cross l [] = 0
proof:
:= by
  induction l with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons a l ih => rw [cross_cons_left, ih]; rfl

name: Operad.ShuffleBarSym.cross_append_left
statement: lemma cross_append_left (l₁ l₂ l : List α) : cross (l₁ ++ l₂) l = cross l₁ l + cross l₂ l
proof:
:= by
  simp [cross]

name: Operad.ShuffleBarSym.cross_append_right
statement: lemma cross_append_right (l l₂ l₃ : List α) : cross l (l₂ ++ l₃) = cross l l₂ + cross l l₃
proof:
:= by
  induction l with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons a l ih =>
    rw [cross_cons_left, cross_cons_left, cross_cons_left, ih, List.countP_append]
    omega

name: Operad.ShuffleBarSym.cross_cons_right
statement:
lemma cross_cons_right (b : α) (l₁ l₂ : List α) :
    cross l₁ (b :: l₂) = l₁.countP (b < ·) + cross l₁ l₂
proof:
:= by
  induction l₁ with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons a l ih =>
    rw [cross_cons_left, cross_cons_left, ih, List.countP_cons, List.countP_cons]
    split_ifs <;> simp_all <;> omega

name: Operad.ShuffleBarSym.cross_perm
statement:
lemma cross_perm {l₁ l₁' l₂ l₂' : List α} (h₁ : l₁.Perm l₁') (h₂ : l₂.Perm l₂') :
    cross l₁ l₂ = cross l₁' l₂'
proof:
:= by
  unfold cross
  rw [(h₁.map _).sum_eq]
  congr 1
  exact List.map_congr_left fun x _ => h₂.countP_eq _

name: Operad.ShuffleBarSym.cross_add_cross
statement:
lemma cross_add_cross {l₁ l₂ : List α} (h : ∀ x ∈ l₁, x ∉ l₂) :
    cross l₁ l₂ + cross l₂ l₁ = l₁.length * l₂.length
proof:
:= by
  induction l₁ with
  | nil => simp
  | cons a l ih =>
    have ha : a ∉ l₂ := h a (List.mem_cons_self ..)
    have ih' := ih fun x hx => h x (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hx)
    rw [cross_cons_left, cross_cons_right, List.length_cons, Nat.succ_mul]
    have hsplit : l₂.countP (· < a) + l₂.countP (a < ·) = l₂.length := by
      rw [List.length_eq_countP_add_countP (· < a)]
      congr 1
      refine List.countP_congr fun y hy => ?_
      have hne : y ≠ a := fun e => ha (e ▸ hy)
      simp only [decide_eq_true_eq, not_lt]
      exact ⟨le_of_lt, fun h' => lt_of_le_of_ne h' (Ne.symm hne)⟩
    omega

name: Operad.ShuffleBarSym.inv_append
statement: lemma inv_append (l₁ l₂ : List α) : inv (l₁ ++ l₂) = inv l₁ + inv l₂ + cross l₁ l₂
proof:
:= by
  induction l₁ with
  | nil => simp [inv]
  | cons a l ih =>
    simp only [List.cons_append, inv, ih, cross_cons_left, List.filter_append,
      List.length_append, ← List.countP_eq_length_filter]
    omega

name: Operad.ShuffleBarSym.inv_cons
statement: lemma inv_cons (a : α) (l : List α) : inv (a :: l) = l.countP (· < a) + inv l
proof:
:= by
  rw [inv, List.countP_eq_length_filter]

name: Operad.ShuffleBarSym.cross_flatten_ofFn_right
statement:
lemma cross_flatten_ofFn_right (l : List α) :
    ∀ {N : ℕ} (D : Fin N → List α), cross l (List.ofFn D).flatten = ∑ b, cross l (D b)
  | 0, _ => by simp
  | N + 1, D => by
    rw [List.ofFn_succ, List.flatten_cons, cross_append_right, Fin.sum_univ_succ,
      cross_flatten_ofFn_right l (fun i => D i.succ)]

variable (K : Type u) [CommRing K]

name: Operad.ShuffleBarSym.neg_one_pow_mul_self
statement: lemma neg_one_pow_mul_self (n : ℕ) : (-1 : K) ^ n * (-1) ^ n = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [← pow_add, ← two_mul, pow_mul, neg_one_sq, one_pow]

name: Operad.ShuffleBarSym.prod_prod_orient
statement:
lemma prod_prod_orient {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [LinearOrder ι] {M : Type*} [CommMonoid M]
    (F : ι → ι → M) (hF : ∀ a, F a a = 1) :
    ∏ a, ∏ b, F a b = ∏ a, ∏ b, if a < b then F a b * F b a else 1
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : ∀ a b, F a b = (if a < b then F a b else 1) * (if b < a then F a b else 1) := by
    intro a b
    rcases lt_trichotomy a b with h | rfl | h
    · rw [if_pos h, if_neg (lt_asymm h), mul_one]
    · rw [if_neg (lt_irrefl a), hF, one_mul]
    · rw [if_neg (lt_asymm h), if_pos h, one_mul]
  calc ∏ a, ∏ b, F a b
      = ∏ a, ∏ b, (if a < b then F a b else 1) * (if b < a then F a b else 1) :=
        Finset.prod_congr rfl fun a _ => Finset.prod_congr rfl fun b _ => h1 a b
    _ = (∏ a, ∏ b, if a < b then F a b else 1) * ∏ a, ∏ b, if b < a then F a b else 1 := by
        simp only [Finset.prod_mul_distrib]
    _ = (∏ a, ∏ b, if a < b then F a b else 1) * ∏ a, ∏ b, if a < b then F b a else 1 := by
        rw [Finset.prod_comm (f := fun a b => if b < a then F a b else 1)]
    _ = ∏ a, ∏ b, if a < b then F a b * F b a else 1 := by
        simp only [← Finset.prod_mul_distrib]
        refine Finset.prod_congr rfl fun a _ => Finset.prod_congr rfl fun b _ => ?_
        split_ifs <;> simp

name: Operad.ShuffleBarSym.neg_one_pow_inv_flatten
statement:
theorem neg_one_pow_inv_flatten : ∀ {N : ℕ} (C : Fin N → List α),
    (-1 : K) ^ inv (List.ofFn C).flatten
      = (∏ a, (-1 : K) ^ inv (C a)) * ∏ a, ∏ b, if a < b then (-1 : K) ^ cross (C a) (C b) else 1
  | 0, _ => by simp [inv]
  | N + 1, C => by
    rw [List.ofFn_succ, List.flatten_cons, inv_append, cross_flatten_ofFn_right, pow_add, pow_add,
      neg_one_pow_inv_flatten (fun i => C i.succ), Fin.prod_univ_succ, Fin.prod_univ_succ,
      Fin.prod_univ_succ, if_neg (lt_irrefl _), one_mul, ← Finset.prod_pow_eq_pow_sum]
    have h1 : ∀ i : Fin N, (∏ b : Fin (N + 1), if i.succ < b then (-1 : K) ^ cross (C i.succ) (C b)
        else 1) = ∏ b : Fin N, if i < b then (-1 : K) ^ cross (C i.succ) (C b.succ) else 1
proof:
:= by
      intro i
      rw [Fin.prod_univ_succ, if_neg (Fin.not_lt_zero _), one_mul]
      simp only [Fin.succ_lt_succ_iff]
    simp only [Fin.succ_pos, if_true, h1]
    ring

name: Operad.ShuffleBarSym.kz_mul_self
statement:
lemma kz_mul_self {N : ℕ} (B : Fin N → List α) (π : Equiv.Perm (Fin N)) :
    kz K B π * kz K B π = 1
proof:
:= by
  unfold kz
  rw [← Finset.prod_mul_distrib]
  refine Finset.prod_eq_one fun a _ => ?_
  rw [← Finset.prod_mul_distrib]
  refine Finset.prod_eq_one fun b _ => ?_
  split_ifs
  · exact neg_one_pow_mul_self K _
  · exact one_mul 1

name: Operad.ShuffleBarSym.neg_one_pow_inv_flatten_perm
statement:
theorem neg_one_pow_inv_flatten_perm {N : ℕ} (B : Fin N → List α) (π : Equiv.Perm (Fin N))
    (hd : ∀ a b, a ≠ b → ∀ x ∈ B a, x ∉ B b) :
    (-1 : K) ^ inv (List.ofFn (B ∘ π)).flatten = kz K B π * (-1) ^ inv (List.ofFn B).flatten
proof:
:= by
  rw [neg_one_pow_inv_flatten, neg_one_pow_inv_flatten]
  simp only [Function.comp_apply]
  rw [Equiv.prod_comp π (fun a => (-1 : K) ^ inv (B a))]
  suffices hpair : (∏ a, ∏ b, if a < b then (-1 : K) ^ cross (B (π a)) (B (π b)) else 1)
      = kz K B π * ∏ a, ∏ b, if a < b then (-1 : K) ^ cross (B a) (B b) else 1 by
    rw [hpair]
    ring
  set f : Fin N → Fin N → K := fun a b => (-1 : K) ^ cross (B a) (B b) with hf
  have hre : (∏ a, ∏ b, if a < b then f (π a) (π b) else 1)
      = ∏ a, ∏ b, if π.symm a < π.symm b then f a b else 1 := by
    rw [← Equiv.prod_comp π.symm]
    refine Finset.prod_congr rfl fun a _ => ?_
    rw [← Equiv.prod_comp π.symm]
    simp only [Equiv.apply_symm_apply]
  have hff : ∀ a b, a ≠ b → f a b * f b a = (-1 : K) ^ ((B a).length * (B b).length) := by
    intro a b hab
    rw [hf]
    dsimp only
    rw [← pow_add, cross_add_cross (hd a b hab)]
  have hsq : ∀ a b, f a b * f a b = 1 := fun a b => neg_one_pow_mul_self K _
  change (∏ a, ∏ b, if a < b then f (π a) (π b) else 1)
    = kz K B π * ∏ a, ∏ b, if a < b then f a b else 1
  rw [hre, prod_prod_orient (fun a b => if π.symm a < π.symm b then f a b else 1)
      (fun a => if_neg (lt_irrefl _)),
    prod_prod_orient (fun a b => if a < b then f a b else 1) (fun a => if_neg (lt_irrefl _)),
    kz, prod_prod_orient (fun a b => if a < b ∧ π.symm b < π.symm a then
      (-1 : K) ^ ((B a).length * (B b).length) else 1) (fun a => if_neg fun h => lt_irrefl _ h.1),
    ← Finset.prod_mul_distrib]
  refine Finset.prod_congr rfl fun a _ => ?_
  rw [← Finset.prod_mul_distrib]
  refine Finset.prod_congr rfl fun b _ => ?_
  by_cases hab : a < b
  · have hne : π.symm a ≠ π.symm b := fun h => hab.ne (π.symm.injective h)
    have hba : ¬b < a := lt_asymm hab
    rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne hne with h | h
    · have h' : ¬π.symm b < π.symm a := lt_asymm h
      simp only [hab, hba, h, h', and_false, false_and, if_true, if_false, mul_one, one_mul]
    · have h' : ¬π.symm a < π.symm b := lt_asymm h
      simp only [hab, hba, h, h', and_self, if_true, if_false, mul_one, one_mul]
      rw [← hff a b hab.ne, mul_comm (f a b) (f b a), mul_assoc, hsq, mul_one]
  · simp only [if_neg hab, mul_one]

name: Operad.ShuffleBarSym.neg_one_pow_inv_erase
statement:
theorem neg_one_pow_inv_erase (A B : List α) (w : α) (hw : w ∉ A) :
    (-1 : K) ^ inv (A ++ w :: B) * (-1) ^ A.length
      = (-1) ^ inv (A ++ B) * (-1) ^ (A ++ B).countP (· < w)
proof:
:= by
  rw [inv_append, inv_append, inv_cons, cross_cons_right, List.countP_append]
  have hA : A.length = A.countP (· < w) + A.countP (w < ·) := by
    rw [List.length_eq_countP_add_countP (· < w)]
    congr 1
    refine List.countP_congr fun y hy => ?_
    have hne : y ≠ w := fun e => hw (e ▸ hy)
    simp only [decide_eq_true_eq, not_lt]
    exact ⟨fun h' => lt_of_le_of_ne h' (Ne.symm hne), le_of_lt⟩
  rw [hA]
  have e : inv A + (B.countP (· < w) + inv B) + (A.countP (w < ·) + cross A B)
      + (A.countP (· < w) + A.countP (w < ·))
      = (inv A + inv B + cross A B) + (A.countP (· < w) + B.countP (· < w))
        + 2 * A.countP (w < ·) := by ring
  rw [← pow_add, e, pow_add, pow_add, pow_mul, neg_one_sq, one_pow, mul_one]

name: Operad.ShuffleBarSym.neg_one_pow_inv_perm_mid
statement:
theorem neg_one_pow_inv_perm_mid (P M M' S : List α) (h : M.Perm M') :
    (-1 : K) ^ inv (P ++ M' ++ S)
      = (-1) ^ inv (P ++ M ++ S) * ((-1) ^ inv M' * (-1) ^ inv M)
proof:
:= by
  have hc1 : cross P (M' ++ S) = cross P (M ++ S) :=
    cross_perm (List.Perm.refl P) (h.symm.append_right S)
  have hc2 : cross M' S = cross M S := cross_perm h.symm (List.Perm.refl S)
  simp only [List.append_assoc, inv_append, hc1, hc2]
  have e : inv P + (inv M + inv S + cross M S) + cross P (M ++ S) + (inv M' + inv M)
      = (inv P + (inv M' + inv S + cross M S) + cross P (M ++ S)) + 2 * inv M := by ring
  rw [← pow_add, ← pow_add, e, pow_add (-1 : K) _ (2 * inv M), pow_mul, neg_one_sq, one_pow,
    mul_one]

name: Operad.ShuffleBarSym.sign_rule_list
statement:
theorem sign_rule_list {N : ℕ} (P X Y S : List α) (w : α) (B : Fin N → List α)
    (π : Equiv.Perm (Fin N)) (hB : (List.ofFn B).flatten = X ++ Y)
    (hd : ∀ a b, a ≠ b → ∀ x ∈ B a, x ∉ B b) (hw : w ∉ P ++ X) :
    (-1 : K) ^ inv (P ++ (X ++ w :: Y) ++ S) * (-1) ^ (P.length + X.length) * kz K B π
        * (-1) ^ inv (P ++ (List.ofFn (B ∘ π)).flatten ++ S)
      = (-1) ^ (P ++ (X ++ w :: Y) ++ S).countP (· < w)
proof:
:= by
  have hperm : (List.ofFn (B ∘ π)).flatten.Perm (X ++ Y) :=
    hB ▸ (Equiv.Perm.ofFn_comp_perm π B).flatten
  have hmid := neg_one_pow_inv_perm_mid K P (X ++ Y) _ S hperm.symm
  have hblk := neg_one_pow_inv_flatten_perm K B π hd
  rw [hB] at hblk
  have hL : P ++ (X ++ w :: Y) ++ S = (P ++ X) ++ w :: (Y ++ S) := by simp
  have hL' : P ++ (X ++ Y) ++ S = (P ++ X) ++ (Y ++ S) := by simp
  have her := neg_one_pow_inv_erase K (P ++ X) (Y ++ S) w hw
  rw [List.length_append] at her
  rw [hmid, hblk, hL, hL', her]
  have hc : (P ++ X ++ w :: (Y ++ S)).countP (· < w) = (P ++ X ++ (Y ++ S)).countP (· < w) := by
    simp [List.countP_append]
  rw [hc]
  have h1 := kz_mul_self K B π
  have h2 := neg_one_pow_mul_self K (inv (X ++ Y))
  have h3 := neg_one_pow_mul_self K (inv (P ++ X ++ (Y ++ S)))
  linear_combination (-1 : K) ^ (P ++ X ++ (Y ++ S)).countP (· < w) *
    ((-1) ^ inv (P ++ X ++ (Y ++ S)) * (-1) ^ inv (P ++ X ++ (Y ++ S)) * (kz K B π * kz K B π) * h2
      + (-1) ^ inv (P ++ X ++ (Y ++ S)) * (-1) ^ inv (P ++ X ++ (Y ++ S)) * h1 + h3)

name: Operad.ShuffleBarSym.cutKeys_cutRoot_toBar_node
statement:
lemma cutKeys_cutRoot_toBar_node {k : ℕ} (m : VMono G k) (ch : Fin k → STree (VMono G)) :
    ShuffleBar.cutKeys (cutRoot (toBar (STree.node m ch)))
      = insert (LTree.key (toBar (STree.node m ch)))
        (ShuffleBar.cutKeys (toBar (STree.node m ch)))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨e, l, r, hT⟩ := toBar_node_eq m ch
  rw [hT]
  simp only [cutRoot, ShuffleBar.cutKeys, Bool.false_eq_true, if_false, if_true,
    Finset.empty_union, Finset.singleton_union]
  rfl

name: Operad.ShuffleBarSym.key_toBar
statement: lemma key_toBar {t : STree (VMono G)} (ht : t.IsShuffle) : LTree.key (toBar t) = vkey t
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : (toBar t).arity = Multiset.card t.labels := by
    rw [← length_labels, ← Multiset.coe_card, labels_toBar]
  simp only [LTree.key, vkey, minLabel_toBar t ht, h1]

name: Operad.ShuffleBarSym.cutKeys_toBar_node_of
statement:
lemma cutKeys_toBar_node_of {k : ℕ} (m : VMono G k) (ch : Fin k → STree (VMono G))
    (ih : ∀ j, ShuffleBar.cutKeys (cutRoot (toBar (ch j))) = (preKeys (ch j)).toFinset) :
    ShuffleBar.cutKeys (toBar (STree.node m ch))
      = (List.ofFn fun j => preKeys (ch j)).flatten.toFinset
proof:
:= by
  rw [cutKeys_toBar_node]
  ext κ
  simp only [Finset.mem_biUnion, Finset.mem_range, List.mem_toFinset, List.mem_flatten,
    List.mem_ofFn]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨a, ha, hκ⟩
    rw [kids_of_lt ch ha, ih, List.mem_toFinset] at hκ
    exact ⟨_, ⟨⟨a, ha⟩, rfl⟩, hκ⟩
  · rintro ⟨_, ⟨j, rfl⟩, hκ⟩
    refine ⟨j, j.2, ?_⟩
    rw [kids_fin, ih, List.mem_toFinset]
    exact hκ

name: Operad.ShuffleBarSym.cutKeys_cutRoot_toBar
statement:
theorem cutKeys_cutRoot_toBar : ∀ t : STree (VMono G), t.IsShuffle →
    ShuffleBar.cutKeys (cutRoot (toBar t)) = (preKeys t).toFinset
  | STree.leaf _, _ => rfl
  | STree.node m ch, ht => by
    rw [cutKeys_cutRoot_toBar_node]
    rw [key_toBar ht]
    rw [cutKeys_toBar_node_of m ch fun j => cutKeys_cutRoot_toBar (ch j) (ht.child j)]
    rw [preKeys, List.toFinset_cons]

name: Operad.ShuffleBarSym.cutKeys_toBar
statement:
theorem cutKeys_toBar {t : STree (VMono G)} (ht : t.IsShuffle) :
    ShuffleBar.cutKeys (toBar t) = (preKeys t).tail.toFinset
proof:
:= by
  cases t with
  | leaf => rfl
  | node m ch =>
    rw [cutKeys_toBar_node_of m ch fun j => cutKeys_cutRoot_toBar (ch j) (ht.child j), preKeys,
      List.tail_cons]

name: Operad.ShuffleBarSym.nodup_tail_preKeys
statement:
theorem nodup_tail_preKeys {t : STree (VMono G)} (ht : t.IsShuffle) (hnd : t.labels.Nodup) :
    (preKeys t).tail.Nodup
proof:
:= by
  cases t with
  | leaf => exact List.nodup_nil
  | node m ch =>
    have hc := card_cutKeys_toBar m ch hnd
    have hl := length_preKeys (STree.node m ch)
    rw [cutKeys_toBar ht] at hc
    have hlen : (preKeys (STree.node m ch)).tail.toFinset.card
        = (preKeys (STree.node m ch)).tail.length := by
      rw [List.length_tail]
      omega
    have := (Multiset.toFinset_card_eq_card_iff_nodup
      (m := ((preKeys (STree.node m ch)).tail : Multiset (ℕ ×ₗ ℕ)))).1 hlen
    exact Multiset.coe_nodup.1 this

name: Operad.ShuffleBarSym.sgn_toBar
statement:
theorem sgn_toBar {t : STree (VMono G)} (ht : t.IsShuffle) (hnd : t.labels.Nodup)
    (κ : ℕ ×ₗ ℕ) :
    ShuffleBar.sgn K (toBar t) κ = (-1) ^ (preKeys t).tail.countP (· < κ)
proof:
:= by
  unfold ShuffleBar.sgn
  have hf : ((preKeys t).tail.toFinset.filter (· < κ))
      = ((preKeys t).tail.filter (· < κ)).toFinset := by
    ext x
    simp
  rw [cutKeys_toBar ht, hf, List.toFinset_card_of_nodup ((nodup_tail_preKeys ht hnd).filter _),
    ← List.countP_eq_length_filter]

name: Operad.ShuffleBarSym.planar_inl
statement:
lemma planar_inl {B : ℕ → Type*} {k l N : ℕ} (ch : Fin k → STree B) (j : Fin k)
    (c₂ : Fin l → STree B) (hN : N + 1 = k + l) (a : Without (Fin k) j) :
    planar ch j c₂ hN (posEquivF j l N hN (Sum.inl a)) = ch a.1
proof:
:= by
  simp [planar]

name: Operad.ShuffleBarSym.planar_inr
statement:
lemma planar_inr {B : ℕ → Type*} {k l N : ℕ} (ch : Fin k → STree B) (j : Fin k)
    (c₂ : Fin l → STree B) (hN : N + 1 = k + l) (i : Fin l) :
    planar ch j c₂ hN (posEquivF j l N hN (Sum.inr i)) = c₂ i
proof:
:= by
  simp [planar]

name: Operad.ShuffleBarSym.monotone_sortP
statement:
lemma monotone_sortP {B : ℕ → Type*} {N : ℕ} (Q : Fin N → STree B) :
    Monotone fun r => (Q (sortP Q r)).first
proof:
:=
  Tuple.monotone_sort fun r => (Q r).first

name: Operad.ShuffleBarSym.sortP_symm_lt
statement:
lemma sortP_symm_lt {B : ℕ → Type*} {N : ℕ} (Q : Fin N → STree B) {r r' : Fin N}
    (h : (Q r).first < (Q r').first) : (sortP Q).symm r < (sortP Q).symm r'
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hle
  have := monotone_sortP Q (not_lt.1 hle)
  simp only [Equiv.apply_symm_apply] at this
  omega

name: Operad.ShuffleBarSym.rk₁_of
statement:
lemma rk₁_of {k l N : ℕ} (j : Fin k) (hN : N + 1 = k + l) (π : Equiv.Perm (Fin N))
    (a : Without (Fin k) j) : rk₁ j hN π a.1 = π.symm (posEquivF j l N hN (Sum.inl a))
proof:
:= by
  rw [rk₁, dif_pos a.1.2, dif_neg a.2]

name: Operad.ShuffleBarSym.rk₂_of
statement:
lemma rk₂_of {k l N : ℕ} (j : Fin k) (hN : N + 1 = k + l) (π : Equiv.Perm (Fin N)) (i : Fin l) :
    rk₂ j hN π i = π.symm (posEquivF j l N hN (Sum.inr i))
proof:
:= by
  rw [rk₂, dif_pos i.2]

name: Operad.ShuffleBarSym.VMono.two_le
statement: lemma VMono.two_le {k : ℕ} (m : VMono G k) : 2 ≤ k

name: Operad.ShuffleBarSym.mergedMono_mem
statement:
theorem mergedMono_mem {k l N : ℕ} (m₁ : VMono G k) (ch : Fin k → STree (VMono G)) (j : Fin k)
    (m₂ : VMono G l) (c₂ : Fin l → STree (VMono G)) (hj : ch j = STree.node m₂ c₂)
    (ht : (STree.node m₁ ch).IsShuffle) (hN : N + 1 = k + l) :
    mergedMono m₁.1 j m₂.1 hN (sortP (planar ch j c₂ hN)) ∈ LTree.monomials N ∧ 2 ≤ N
proof:
:= by
  set Q := planar ch j c₂ hN with hQ
  set π := sortP Q with hπ
  have hk := m₁.two_le
  have hl := m₂.two_le
  have ht₂ : (STree.node m₂ c₂).IsShuffle := hj ▸ ht.child j
  have hF₁ : ∀ a : Without (Fin k) j, (Q (posEquivF j l N hN (Sum.inl a))).first
      = (ch a.1).first := fun a => by rw [hQ, planar_inl]
  have hF₂ : ∀ i : Fin l, (Q (posEquivF j l N hN (Sum.inr i))).first = (c₂ i).first :=
    fun i => by rw [hQ, planar_inr]
  have hl0 : 0 < l := by omega
  have hc0 : (c₂ ⟨0, hl0⟩).first = (ch j).first := by rw [hj, first_node _ _ hl0]
  
  have hs₂ : StrictOn (fun i => (LTree.leaf (rk₂ j hN π i) : LTree G).minLabel) m₂.1 := by
    intro a ha b hb hab
    have ha' := m₂.lt ha
    have hb' := m₂.lt hb
    show rk₂ j hN π a < rk₂ j hN π b
    rw [rk₂, dif_pos ha', rk₂, dif_pos hb']
    refine sortP_symm_lt Q ?_
    rw [hF₂, hF₂]
    exact ht₂.mono (show (⟨a, ha'⟩ : Fin l) < ⟨b, hb'⟩ from hab)
  
  let ins : ℕ → LTree G := fun a =>
    if a = (j : ℕ) then m₂.1.plug (fun i => LTree.leaf (rk₂ j hN π i))
    else LTree.leaf (rk₁ j hN π a)
  have hmin : ∀ a : Fin k, (ins a).minLabel = π.symm (if h : a = j then
      posEquivF j l N hN (Sum.inr ⟨0, hl0⟩) else posEquivF j l N hN (Sum.inl ⟨a, h⟩)) := by
    intro a
    by_cases h : a = j
    · subst h
      rw [dif_pos rfl]
      simp only [ins, if_true]
      rw [minLabel_plug_of_strictOn _ hs₂, m₂.minLabel]
      show rk₂ a hN π 0 = _
      rw [rk₂, dif_pos hl0]
    · simp only [ins, if_neg (fun h' => h (Fin.ext h')), dif_neg h]
      show rk₁ j hN π a = _
      rw [rk₁, dif_pos a.2, dif_neg (by simpa using h)]
  have hfirst : ∀ a : Fin k, (Q (if h : a = j then posEquivF j l N hN (Sum.inr ⟨0, hl0⟩)
      else posEquivF j l N hN (Sum.inl ⟨a, h⟩))).first = (ch a).first := by
    intro a
    by_cases h : a = j
    · subst h
      rw [dif_pos rfl, hF₂, hc0]
    · rw [dif_neg h, hF₁]
  have hstrict : StrictOn (fun a => (ins a).minLabel) m₁.1 := by
    intro a ha b hb hab
    have ha' := m₁.lt ha
    have hb' := m₁.lt hb
    show (ins (⟨a, ha'⟩ : Fin k)).minLabel < (ins (⟨b, hb'⟩ : Fin k)).minLabel
    rw [hmin, hmin]
    refine sortP_symm_lt Q ?_
    rw [hfirst, hfirst]
    exact ht.mono (show (⟨a, ha'⟩ : Fin k) < ⟨b, hb'⟩ from hab)
  have hshuf : (mergedMono m₁.1 j m₂.1 hN π).IsShuffle := by
    refine isShuffle_plug_of_strictOn _ m₁.isShuffle hstrict fun a _ => ?_
    show (ins a).IsShuffle
    simp only [ins]
    split_ifs
    · exact isShuffle_plug_of_strictOn _ m₂.isShuffle hs₂ fun _ _ => trivial
    · trivial
  
  have hlabs : ((mergedMono m₁.1 j m₂.1 hN π).labels : Multiset ℕ) = Multiset.range N := by
    have e1 : ((mergedMono m₁.1 j m₂.1 hN π).labels : Multiset ℕ)
        = ∑ a : Fin k, ((ins a).labels : Multiset ℕ) := by
      rw [mergedMono, mergeMono, labels_plug, ← Multiset.coe_bind, bind_kids m₁]
    have e2 : ((ins j).labels : Multiset ℕ) = ∑ i : Fin l, {rk₂ j hN π i} := by
      simp only [ins, if_true]
      rw [labels_plug_leaf, ← Multiset.map_coe,
        show Multiset.map (rk₂ j hN π) (m₂.1.labels : Multiset ℕ)
          = Multiset.bind (m₂.1.labels : Multiset ℕ) fun a => {rk₂ j hN π a} by
            rw [Multiset.bind_singleton], bind_kids m₂]
    have e3 : ∀ a : Without (Fin k) j, ((ins a.1).labels : Multiset ℕ) = {rk₁ j hN π a.1} := by
      intro a
      simp only [ins, if_neg (fun h' => a.2 (Fin.ext h'))]
      rfl
    have e4 : Multiset.range N = ∑ r : Fin N, {(r : ℕ)} := by
      rw [Fin.sum_univ_eq_sum_range (fun i => ({i} : Multiset ℕ)) N, Finset.sum_eq_multiset_sum,
        Multiset.sum_map_singleton]
      rfl
    rw [e1, Fintype.sum_eq_add_sum_subtype_ne _ j, e2, e4,
      ← Equiv.sum_comp ((posEquivF j l N hN).trans π.symm), Fintype.sum_sum_type,
      add_comm]
    congr 1
    · refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun a _ => ?_
      rw [e3, rk₁_of]
      rfl
    · refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
      rw [rk₂_of]
      rfl
  refine ⟨(LTree.mem_monomials N _).2 ⟨hshuf, Multiset.coe_eq_coe.1 ?_⟩, by omega⟩
  rw [hlabs, Multiset.coe_range]

name: Operad.ShuffleBarSym.mem_preKeys
statement:
lemma mem_preKeys {B : ℕ → Type*} : ∀ {t : STree B} {κ : ℕ ×ₗ ℕ}, t.IsShuffle → κ ∈ preKeys t →
    (ofLex κ).1 ∈ t.labels ∧ (ofLex κ).2 ≤ Multiset.card t.labels
  | STree.leaf _, _, _, h => by simp [preKeys] at h
  | STree.node _ ch, κ, ht, h => by
    simp only [preKeys, List.mem_cons, List.mem_flatten, List.mem_ofFn] at h
    rcases h with rfl | ⟨_, ⟨j, rfl⟩, hj⟩
    · exact ⟨first_mem ht, le_rfl⟩
