    · have
proof:
:= mem_preKeys (ht.child j) hj
      exact ⟨Multiset.mem_of_le (labels_le_node _ _ j) this.1,
        this.2.trans (Multiset.card_le_card (labels_le_node _ _ j))⟩

name: Operad.ShuffleBarSym.vkey_mem_preKeys
statement:
lemma vkey_mem_preKeys {B : ℕ → Type*} {k : ℕ} (β : B k) (ch : Fin k → STree B) :
    vkey (STree.node β ch) ∈ preKeys (STree.node β ch)
proof:
:= by
  simp [preKeys]

name: Operad.ShuffleBarSym.preKeys_node
statement:
lemma preKeys_node {B : ℕ → Type*} {k : ℕ} (β : B k) (ch : Fin k → STree B) :
    preKeys (STree.node β ch)
      = vkey (STree.node β ch) :: (List.ofFn fun j => preKeys (ch j)).flatten
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.ShuffleBarSym.first_eq_of_labels
statement:
lemma first_eq_of_labels {B : ℕ → Type*} {t t' : STree B} (ht : t.IsShuffle) (ht' : t'.IsShuffle)
    (h : t.labels = t'.labels) : t.first = t'.first
proof:
:=
  le_antisymm (first_le ht _ (h ▸ first_mem ht')) (first_le ht' _ (h.symm ▸ first_mem ht))

name: Operad.ShuffleBarSym.vkey_eq_of_labels
statement:
lemma vkey_eq_of_labels {B : ℕ → Type*} {t t' : STree B} (ht : t.IsShuffle) (ht' : t'.IsShuffle)
    (h : t.labels = t'.labels) : vkey t = vkey t'
proof:
:= by
  rw [vkey, vkey, first_eq_of_labels ht ht' h, h]

name: Operad.ShuffleBarSym.mergeN_eq
statement: lemma mergeN_eq {k : ℕ} (m₁ : VMono G k) (l : ℕ) : k + l - 1 + 1 = k + l
proof:
:= by
  have := m₁.two_le
  omega

name: Operad.ShuffleBarSym.rootMerge_eq
statement:
lemma rootMerge_eq (hj : ch j = STree.node m₂ c₂) (ht : (STree.node m₁ ch).IsShuffle) :
    rootMerge m₁ ch j m₂ c₂ = STree.node
      (⟨_, mergedMono_mem m₁ ch j m₂ c₂ hj ht (mergeN_eq m₁ l)⟩ : VMono G (k + l - 1))
      (planar ch j c₂ (mergeN_eq m₁ l) ∘ sortP (planar ch j c₂ (mergeN_eq m₁ l)))
proof:
:=
  dif_pos _

name: Operad.ShuffleBarSym.isShuffle_planar
statement:
lemma isShuffle_planar {N : ℕ} (hN : N + 1 = k + l) (hj : ch j = STree.node m₂ c₂)
    (ht : (STree.node m₁ ch).IsShuffle) (r : Fin N) : (planar ch j c₂ hN r).IsShuffle
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := (posEquivF j l N hN).surjective r
  rcases x with a | i
  · rw [planar_inl]
    exact ht.child _
  · rw [planar_inr]
    exact (hj ▸ ht.child j : (STree.node m₂ c₂).IsShuffle).child i

name: Operad.ShuffleBarSym.first_planar_injective
statement:
lemma first_planar_injective {N : ℕ} (hN : N + 1 = k + l) (hj : ch j = STree.node m₂ c₂)
    (ht : (STree.node m₁ ch).IsShuffle) (hnd : (STree.node m₁ ch).labels.Nodup) :
    Function.Injective fun r => (planar ch j c₂ hN r).first
proof:
:= by
  have ht₂ : (STree.node m₂ c₂).IsShuffle := hj ▸ ht.child j
  have hsub : ∀ i, (c₂ i).labels ≤ (ch j).labels := fun i => by
    rw [hj]
    exact labels_le_node _ _ i
  have hcross : ∀ (a : Without (Fin k) j) (i : Fin l), (ch a.1).first ≠ (c₂ i).first := by
    intro a i h
    have h1 := first_mem (ht.child a.1)
    have h2 := Multiset.mem_of_le (hsub i) (first_mem (ht₂.child i))
    rw [← h] at h2
    exact not_mem_of_node hnd a.2 h1 h2
  intro r r' h
  obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := (posEquivF j l N hN).surjective r
  obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := (posEquivF j l N hN).surjective r'
  congr 1
  rcases x with a | i <;> rcases y with b | i' <;>
    simp only [planar_inl, planar_inr] at h
  · exact congrArg Sum.inl (Subtype.ext (ht.mono.injective h))
  · exact absurd h (hcross a i')
  · exact absurd h.symm (hcross b i)
  · exact congrArg Sum.inr (ht₂.mono.injective h)

name: Operad.ShuffleBarSym.isShuffle_rootMerge
statement:
theorem isShuffle_rootMerge (hj : ch j = STree.node m₂ c₂) (ht : (STree.node m₁ ch).IsShuffle)
    (hnd : (STree.node m₁ ch).labels.Nodup) : (rootMerge m₁ ch j m₂ c₂).IsShuffle
proof:
:= by
  rw [rootMerge_eq hj ht]
  have hk := m₁.two_le
  refine ⟨by omega, fun r => isShuffle_planar _ hj ht _, ?_⟩
  exact (monotone_sortP _).strictMono_of_injective
    ((first_planar_injective _ hj ht hnd).comp (Equiv.injective _))

name: Operad.ShuffleBarSym.labels_rootMerge
statement:
theorem labels_rootMerge (hj : ch j = STree.node m₂ c₂) (ht : (STree.node m₁ ch).IsShuffle) :
    (rootMerge m₁ ch j m₂ c₂).labels = (STree.node m₁ ch).labels
proof:
:= by
  rw [rootMerge_eq hj ht, STree.labels_node, STree.labels_node]
  simp only [Function.comp_apply]
  rw [Equiv.sum_comp (sortP (planar ch j c₂ (mergeN_eq m₁ l)))
      (fun r => (planar ch j c₂ (mergeN_eq m₁ l) r).labels),
    ← Equiv.sum_comp (posEquivF j l (k + l - 1) (mergeN_eq m₁ l)), Fintype.sum_sum_type]
  simp only [planar_inl, planar_inr]
  rw [Fintype.sum_eq_add_sum_subtype_ne (fun a => (ch a).labels) j, hj, STree.labels_node,
    add_comm]

name: Operad.ShuffleBarSym.kids_planar_sortP
statement:
lemma kids_planar_sortP {N : ℕ} (Q : Fin N → STree (VMono G)) (r : Fin N) :
    kids (Q ∘ sortP Q) ((sortP Q).symm r : ℕ) = cutRoot (toBar (Q r))
proof:
:= by
  rw [kids_fin]
  simp

name: Operad.ShuffleBarSym.key_cutRoot
statement: lemma key_cutRoot (y : BarTree G) : LTree.key (cutRoot y) = LTree.key y
proof:
:= by
  cases y <;> rfl

name: Operad.ShuffleBarSym.toBar_rootMerge
statement:
theorem toBar_rootMerge (hj : ch j = STree.node m₂ c₂) (ht : (STree.node m₁ ch).IsShuffle)
    (hnd : (STree.node m₁ ch).labels.Nodup) :
    toBar (rootMerge m₁ ch j m₂ c₂) = mergeK (toBar (STree.node m₁ ch)) (vkey (ch j))
proof:
:= by
  set hN := mergeN_eq m₁ l
  set Q := planar ch j c₂ hN with hQ
  set π := sortP Q with hπ
  have ht₂ : (STree.node m₂ c₂).IsShuffle := hj ▸ ht.child j
  rw [rootMerge_eq hj ht, toBar_node]
  show (liftW false (mergedMono m₁.1 j m₂.1 hN π)).plug (kids (Q ∘ π)) = _
  rw [mergedMono, mergeMono, liftW_false_plug, plug_plug]
  obtain ⟨e, l', r', hm⟩ := m₁.exists_node
  rw [toBar_node, hm, mergeK_plug_liftW (kids ch) false e l' r' _ (by simp), ← hm]
  refine plug_congr fun a ha => ?_
  rw [labels_liftW] at ha
  have hak := m₁.lt ha
  by_cases haj : a = (j : ℕ)
  · have hja : (⟨a, hak⟩ : Fin k) = j := Fin.ext haj
    simp only [if_pos haj]
    rw [liftW_false_plug, plug_plug]
    obtain ⟨e₂, l₂, r₂, hm₂⟩ := m₂.exists_node
    have hkid : kids ch a = (liftW true (LTree.node e₂ l₂ r₂)).plug (kids c₂) := by
      rw [kids_of_lt ch hak, hja, hj, toBar_node, hm₂]
      rfl
    have hkey : LTree.key ((liftW true (LTree.node e₂ l₂ r₂)).plug (kids c₂)) = vkey (ch j) := by
      rw [← hkid, kids_of_lt ch hak, hja, key_cutRoot, key_toBar (ht.child j)]
    rw [hkid, mergeK_plug_liftW_root _ true e₂ l₂ r₂ _ ⟨rfl, hkey⟩, ← hm₂]
    refine plug_congr fun i hi => ?_
    rw [labels_liftW] at hi
    have hil := m₂.lt hi
    show kids (Q ∘ π) (rk₂ j hN π i) = kids c₂ i
    rw [show rk₂ j hN π i = rk₂ j hN π ((⟨i, hil⟩ : Fin l) : ℕ) from rfl, rk₂_of, hπ,
      kids_planar_sortP, hQ, planar_inr, kids_of_lt c₂ hil]
  · have hja : (⟨a, hak⟩ : Fin k) ≠ j := fun h => haj (congrArg Fin.val h)
    simp only [if_neg haj]
    show kids (Q ∘ π) (rk₁ j hN π a) = _
    rw [show rk₁ j hN π a = rk₁ j hN π ((⟨⟨a, hak⟩, hja⟩ : Without (Fin k) j).1 : ℕ) from rfl,
      rk₁_of, hπ, kids_planar_sortP, hQ, planar_inl, ← kids_of_lt ch hak]
    refine (mergeK_of_not_mem _ fun hmem => ?_).symm
    rw [kids_of_lt ch hak, cutKeys_cutRoot_toBar _ (ht.child _), List.mem_toFinset] at hmem
    have h1 := (mem_preKeys (ht.child _) hmem).1
    have h2 : (ofLex (vkey (ch j))).1 ∈ (ch j).labels := first_mem (ht.child j)
    exact not_mem_of_node hnd hja h1 h2

name: Operad.ShuffleBarSym.mem_flatten_ofFn
statement:
lemma mem_flatten_ofFn {α : Type*} {k : ℕ} (f : Fin k → List α) (x : α) :
    x ∈ (List.ofFn f).flatten ↔ ∃ j, x ∈ f j
proof:
:= by
  simp only [List.mem_flatten, List.mem_ofFn]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨_, ⟨j, rfl⟩, hx⟩
    exact ⟨j, hx⟩
  · rintro ⟨j, hx⟩
    exact ⟨_, ⟨j, rfl⟩, hx⟩

name: Operad.ShuffleBarSym.preKeys_eq_cons
statement:
lemma preKeys_eq_cons {B : ℕ → Type*} {t : STree B} (hw : t.weight ≠ 0) :
    preKeys t = vkey t :: (preKeys t).tail
proof:
:= by
  cases t with
  | leaf => simp [STree.weight] at hw
  | node β ch => rfl

name: Operad.ShuffleBarSym.weight_ne_zero_of_mem
statement:
lemma weight_ne_zero_of_mem {B : ℕ → Type*} {t : STree B} {κ : ℕ ×ₗ ℕ} (h : κ ∈ preKeys t) :
    t.weight ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  cases t with
  | leaf => simp [preKeys] at h
  | node β ch => simp [STree.weight]

name: Operad.ShuffleBarSym.mergeT_of_not_mem
statement:
lemma mergeT_of_not_mem : ∀ {t : STree (VMono G)} {κ : ℕ ×ₗ ℕ}, κ ∉ preKeys t → mergeT t κ = t
  | .leaf _, _, _ => rfl
  | .node m ch, κ, h => by
    have hmem : ∀ j, κ ∉ preKeys (ch j)
proof:
:= fun j hj => h (by
      rw [preKeys_node]
      exact List.mem_cons_of_mem _ ((mem_flatten_ofFn _ _).2 ⟨j, hj⟩))
    have hno : ¬∃ j, vkey (ch j) = κ ∧ (ch j).weight ≠ 0 := by
      rintro ⟨j, rfl, hw⟩
      exact hmem j (by rw [preKeys_eq_cons hw]; exact List.mem_cons_self ..)
    rw [mergeT, dif_neg hno]
    congr 1
    funext j
    exact mergeT_of_not_mem (hmem j)

name: Operad.ShuffleBarSym.mergeT_root
proof:
:= by
  have hex : ∃ j', vkey (ch j') = vkey (ch j) ∧ (ch j').weight ≠ 0 :=
    ⟨j, rfl, by rw [hj]; simp [STree.weight]⟩
  rw [mergeT, dif_pos hex]
  have hc : hex.choose = j := by
    have := congrArg (fun κ : ℕ ×ₗ ℕ => (ofLex κ).1) hex.choose_spec.1
    simp only [vkey, ofLex_toLex] at this
    exact ht.mono.injective this
  rw [hc, hj]
  rfl

name: Operad.ShuffleBarSym.nodup_preKeys_child
statement:
lemma nodup_preKeys_child (ht : (STree.node m ch).IsShuffle)
    (hnd : (STree.node m ch).labels.Nodup) (j : Fin k) : (preKeys (ch j)).Nodup
proof:
:= by
  have := nodup_tail_preKeys ht hnd
  rw [preKeys_node, List.tail_cons] at this
  exact (List.nodup_flatten.1 this).1 _ (List.mem_ofFn.2 ⟨j, rfl⟩)

name: Operad.ShuffleBarSym.not_mem_preKeys_of_ne
proof:
:= fun h' =>
  not_mem_of_node hnd hab (mem_preKeys (ht.child a) hκ).1 (mem_preKeys (ht.child b) h').1

name: Operad.ShuffleBarSym.mergeT_child
statement:
lemma mergeT_child (ht : (STree.node m ch).IsShuffle) (hnd : (STree.node m ch).labels.Nodup)
    {j₀ : Fin k} {κ : ℕ ×ₗ ℕ} (hκ : κ ∈ (preKeys (ch j₀)).tail) :
    mergeT (STree.node m ch) κ = STree.node m (Function.update ch j₀ (mergeT (ch j₀) κ))
proof:
:= by
  have hκ' : κ ∈ preKeys (ch j₀) := List.mem_of_mem_tail hκ
  have hno : ¬∃ j, vkey (ch j) = κ ∧ (ch j).weight ≠ 0 := by
    rintro ⟨j, rfl, hw⟩
    by_cases hjj : j = j₀
    · subst hjj
      have hnd' := nodup_preKeys_child ht hnd j
      rw [preKeys_eq_cons hw] at hnd'
      exact (List.nodup_cons.1 hnd').1 hκ
    · exact not_mem_preKeys_of_ne ht hnd (Ne.symm hjj) hκ'
        (by rw [preKeys_eq_cons hw]; exact List.mem_cons_self ..)
  rw [mergeT, dif_neg hno]
  congr 1
  funext j
  by_cases hjj : j = j₀
  · subst hjj
    rw [Function.update_self]
  · rw [Function.update_of_ne hjj]
    exact mergeT_of_not_mem (not_mem_preKeys_of_ne ht hnd (Ne.symm hjj) hκ')

name: Operad.ShuffleBarSym.cutRoot_mergeK
statement:
lemma cutRoot_mergeK {y : BarTree G} (hy : rootFlag y = false) {κ : ℕ ×ₗ ℕ}
    (hκ : LTree.key y ≠ κ) : cutRoot (mergeK y κ) = mergeK (cutRoot y) κ
proof:
:= by
  cases y with
  | leaf => rfl
  | node d l r =>
    simp only [rootFlag] at hy
    have h1 : mergeK (LTree.node d l r) κ = LTree.node d (mergeK l κ) (mergeK r κ) := by
      rw [mergeK, if_neg (by simp [hy])]
    have h2 : mergeK (cutRoot (LTree.node d l r)) κ
        = LTree.node (d.1, true) (mergeK l κ) (mergeK r κ) := by
      rw [cutRoot, mergeK, if_neg]
      rintro ⟨-, h⟩
      exact hκ h
    rw [h1, h2]
    rfl

name: Operad.ShuffleBarSym.mergeT_spec
statement:
theorem mergeT_spec : ∀ (t : STree (VMono G)) (κ : ℕ ×ₗ ℕ), t.IsShuffle → t.labels.Nodup →
    κ ∈ (preKeys t).tail → (mergeT t κ).IsShuffle ∧ (mergeT t κ).labels = t.labels ∧
      toBar (mergeT t κ) = mergeK (toBar t) κ
  | .leaf _, _, _, _, h => by simp [preKeys] at h
  | .node (k := k) m ch, κ, ht, hnd, hκ => by
    rw [preKeys_node, List.tail_cons, mem_flatten_ofFn] at hκ
    obtain ⟨j₀, hj₀⟩
proof:
:= hκ
    have hw := weight_ne_zero_of_mem hj₀
    rw [preKeys_eq_cons hw, List.mem_cons] at hj₀
    rcases hj₀ with rfl | hj₀
    · obtain ⟨l, m₂, c₂, hc⟩ : ∃ (l : ℕ) (m₂ : VMono G l) (c₂ : Fin l → STree (VMono G)),
          ch j₀ = STree.node m₂ c₂ := by
        cases h : ch j₀ with
        | leaf => rw [h] at hw; simp [STree.weight] at hw
        | node m₂ c₂ => exact ⟨_, m₂, c₂, rfl⟩
      rw [mergeT_root ht hc]
      exact ⟨isShuffle_rootMerge hc ht hnd, labels_rootMerge hc ht, toBar_rootMerge hc ht hnd⟩
    · have hjs := ht.child j₀
      have hjnd := nodup_of_node hnd j₀
      obtain ⟨ih1, ih2, ih3⟩ := mergeT_spec (ch j₀) κ hjs hjnd hj₀
      rw [mergeT_child ht hnd hj₀]
      have hfirst : ∀ j, (Function.update ch j₀ (mergeT (ch j₀) κ) j).first = (ch j).first := by
        intro j
        by_cases hjj : j = j₀
        · subst hjj
          rw [Function.update_self]
          exact first_eq_of_labels ih1 hjs ih2
        · rw [Function.update_of_ne hjj]
      refine ⟨⟨ht.pos, fun j => ?_, ?_⟩, ?_, ?_⟩
      · by_cases hjj : j = j₀
        · subst hjj
          rw [Function.update_self]
          exact ih1
        · rw [Function.update_of_ne hjj]
          exact ht.child j
      · simp only [hfirst]
        exact ht.mono
      · simp only [STree.labels_node]
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => ?_
        by_cases hjj : j = j₀
        · subst hjj
          rw [Function.update_self, ih2]
        · rw [Function.update_of_ne hjj]
      · have hne : LTree.key (toBar (ch j₀)) ≠ κ := by
          rw [key_toBar hjs]
          intro h
          have hnd' := nodup_preKeys_child ht hnd j₀
          rw [preKeys_eq_cons hw] at hnd'
          exact (List.nodup_cons.1 hnd').1 (h ▸ hj₀)
        rw [toBar_node, toBar_node]
        obtain ⟨e, l', r', hm⟩ := m.exists_node
        rw [hm, mergeK_plug_liftW (kids ch) false e l' r' _ (by simp), ← hm]
        refine plug_congr fun a ha => ?_
        rw [labels_liftW] at ha
        have hak := m.lt ha
        rw [kids_of_lt _ hak, kids_of_lt _ hak]
        by_cases haj : (⟨a, hak⟩ : Fin k) = j₀
        · rw [haj, Function.update_self, ih3]
          exact cutRoot_mergeK (rootFlag_toBar _) hne
        · rw [Function.update_of_ne haj]
          refine (mergeK_of_not_mem _ ?_).symm
          rw [cutKeys_cutRoot_toBar _ (ht.child _), List.mem_toFinset]
          exact not_mem_preKeys_of_ne ht hnd (Ne.symm haj) (List.mem_of_mem_tail hj₀)

name: Operad.ShuffleBarSym.planar_of_lt
statement:
lemma planar_of_lt {r : ℕ} (hr : r < N) (h : r < j) :
    planar ch j c₂ hN ⟨r, hr⟩ = ch ⟨r, by omega⟩
proof:
:= by
  have hne : (⟨r, by omega⟩ : Fin k) ≠ j := fun e => by
    have := congrArg Fin.val e
    simp only at this
    omega
  rw [show (⟨r, hr⟩ : Fin N) = posEquivF j l N hN (Sum.inl ⟨⟨r, by omega⟩, hne⟩) from
    Fin.ext (posEquivF_inl_of_lt j hN ⟨⟨r, by omega⟩, hne⟩ h).symm, planar_inl]

name: Operad.ShuffleBarSym.planar_of_mid
statement:
lemma planar_of_mid {r : ℕ} (hr : r < N) (h₁ : (j : ℕ) ≤ r) (h₂ : r < j + l) :
    planar ch j c₂ hN ⟨r, hr⟩ = c₂ ⟨r - j, by omega⟩
proof:
:= by
  rw [show (⟨r, hr⟩ : Fin N) = posEquivF j l N hN (Sum.inr ⟨r - j, by omega⟩) from
    Fin.ext (by rw [posEquivF_inr]; simp only; omega), planar_inr]

name: Operad.ShuffleBarSym.planar_of_gt
statement:
lemma planar_of_gt {r : ℕ} (hr : r < N) (h : j + l ≤ r) :
    planar ch j c₂ hN ⟨r, hr⟩ = ch ⟨r + 1 - l, by omega⟩
proof:
:= by
  have hne : (⟨r + 1 - l, by omega⟩ : Fin k) ≠ j := fun e => by
    have := congrArg Fin.val e
    simp only at this
    omega
  have hgt : j < (⟨⟨r + 1 - l, by omega⟩, hne⟩ : Without (Fin k) j).1 := by
    show (j : ℕ) < r + 1 - l
    omega
  have := posEquivF_inl_of_gt j hN _ hgt
  rw [show (⟨r, hr⟩ : Fin N) = posEquivF j l N hN (Sum.inl ⟨⟨r + 1 - l, by omega⟩, hne⟩) from
    Fin.ext (by simp only at this ⊢; omega), planar_inl]

name: Operad.ShuffleBarSym.ofFn_planar
statement:
lemma ofFn_planar {β : Type*} (g : STree B → β) :
    (List.ofFn fun r => g (planar ch j c₂ hN r))
      = (List.ofFn fun a => g (ch a)).take j ++ (List.ofFn fun i => g (c₂ i))
        ++ (List.ofFn fun a => g (ch a)).drop (j + 1)
proof:
:= by
  have hj := j.2
  apply List.ext_getElem
  · simp only [List.length_ofFn, List.length_append, List.length_take, List.length_drop]
    omega
  · intro r h₁ h₂
    have hr : r < N := by simpa using h₁
    rw [List.getElem_ofFn]
    simp only [List.getElem_append, List.length_append, List.length_take, List.length_ofFn,
      List.getElem_take, List.getElem_drop, List.getElem_ofFn]
    split_ifs with ha hb
    · rw [planar_of_lt ch j c₂ hN hr (by omega)]
    · rw [planar_of_mid ch j c₂ hN hr (by omega) (by omega)]
      congr 2
      ext
      simp only
      omega
    · rw [planar_of_gt ch j c₂ hN hr (by omega)]
      congr 2
      ext
      simp only
      omega

name: Operad.ShuffleBarSym.flatten_ofFn_split
statement:
lemma flatten_ofFn_split {α : Type*} {k : ℕ} (f : Fin k → List α) (j : Fin k) :
    (List.ofFn f).flatten
      = ((List.ofFn f).take j).flatten ++ (f j ++ ((List.ofFn f).drop (j + 1)).flatten)
proof:
:= by
  conv_lhs => rw [← List.take_append_drop j (List.ofFn f)]
  rw [List.drop_eq_getElem_cons (by simp), List.getElem_ofFn, List.flatten_append,
    List.flatten_cons]

name: Operad.ShuffleBarSym.take_ofFn_update
statement:
lemma take_ofFn_update {α β : Type*} {k : ℕ} (g : α → β) (f : Fin k → α) (j : Fin k) (x : α) :
    (List.ofFn fun i => g (Function.update f j x i)).take j = (List.ofFn fun i => g (f i)).take j
proof:
:= by
  apply List.ext_getElem
  · simp
  · intro i h₁ h₂
    simp only [List.getElem_take, List.getElem_ofFn]
    rw [Function.update_of_ne]
    intro e
    have := congrArg Fin.val e
    simp only [List.length_take, List.length_ofFn] at h₁
    simp only at this
    omega

name: Operad.ShuffleBarSym.drop_ofFn_update
statement:
lemma drop_ofFn_update {α β : Type*} {k : ℕ} (g : α → β) (f : Fin k → α) (j : Fin k) (x : α) :
    (List.ofFn fun i => g (Function.update f j x i)).drop (j + 1)
      = (List.ofFn fun i => g (f i)).drop (j + 1)
proof:
:= by
  apply List.ext_getElem
  · simp
  · intro i h₁ h₂
    simp only [List.getElem_drop, List.getElem_ofFn]
    rw [Function.update_of_ne]
    intro e
    have := congrArg Fin.val e
    simp only at this
    omega

name: Operad.ShuffleBarSym.disjoint_planar
proof:
:= by
  have hnd₂ : (STree.node m₂ c₂).labels.Nodup := hj ▸ nodup_of_node hnd j
  have hsub : ∀ i, (c₂ i).labels ≤ (ch j).labels := fun i => by
    rw [hj]
    exact labels_le_node _ _ i
  obtain ⟨x₁, rfl⟩ := (posEquivF j l N hN).surjective r
  obtain ⟨x₂, rfl⟩ := (posEquivF j l N hN).surjective r'
  have hne : x₁ ≠ x₂ := fun e => hrr (by rw [e])
  intro hx'
  rcases x₁ with a | i <;> rcases x₂ with b | i' <;> simp only [planar_inl, planar_inr] at hx hx'
  · exact not_mem_of_node hnd (fun e => hne (by rw [Subtype.ext e])) hx hx'
  · exact not_mem_of_node hnd a.2 hx (Multiset.mem_of_le (hsub i') hx')
  · exact not_mem_of_node hnd b.2 hx' (Multiset.mem_of_le (hsub i) hx)
  · exact not_mem_of_node hnd₂ (fun e => hne (by rw [e])) hx hx'

name: Operad.ShuffleBarSym.kzAt_of_not_mem
statement:
lemma kzAt_of_not_mem : ∀ {t : STree (VMono G)} {κ : ℕ ×ₗ ℕ}, κ ∉ preKeys t → kzAt K t κ = 1
  | .leaf _, _, _ => rfl
  | .node m ch, κ, h => by
    have hmem : ∀ j, κ ∉ preKeys (ch j)
proof:
:= fun j hj => h (by
      rw [preKeys_node]
      exact List.mem_cons_of_mem _ ((mem_flatten_ofFn _ _).2 ⟨j, hj⟩))
    have hno : ¬∃ j, vkey (ch j) = κ ∧ (ch j).weight ≠ 0 := by
      rintro ⟨j, rfl, hw⟩
      exact hmem j (by rw [preKeys_eq_cons hw]; exact List.mem_cons_self ..)
    rw [kzAt, dif_neg hno]
    exact Finset.prod_eq_one fun j _ => kzAt_of_not_mem (hmem j)

name: Operad.ShuffleBarSym.weight_mergeT_node
statement:
lemma weight_mergeT_node {k : ℕ} (m : VMono G k) (ch : Fin k → STree (VMono G)) (κ : ℕ ×ₗ ℕ) :
    (mergeT (STree.node m ch) κ).weight ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [mergeT]
  split_ifs with h
  · generalize h.choose = j
    cases ch j with
    | leaf => simp [mergeAt]
    | node m₂ c₂ =>
      simp only [mergeAt, rootMerge]
      split_ifs <;> simp [STree.weight]
  · simp [STree.weight]

name: Operad.ShuffleBarSym.preKeys_mergeT
statement:
theorem preKeys_mergeT : ∀ (t : STree (VMono G)) (κ : ℕ ×ₗ ℕ), t.IsShuffle → t.labels.Nodup →
    κ ∈ (preKeys t).tail → ∃ (P X Y S : List (ℕ ×ₗ ℕ)) (N : ℕ) (B : Fin N → List (ℕ ×ₗ ℕ))
      (π : Equiv.Perm (Fin N)), (preKeys t).tail = P ++ (X ++ κ :: Y) ++ S ∧
        (preKeys (mergeT t κ)).tail = P ++ (List.ofFn (B ∘ π)).flatten ++ S ∧
        (List.ofFn B).flatten = X ++ Y ∧ (∀ a b, a ≠ b → ∀ x ∈ B a, x ∉ B b) ∧
        kzAt K t κ = kz K B π
  | .leaf _, _, _, _, h => by simp [preKeys] at h
  | .node (k := k) m ch, κ, ht, hnd, hκ => by
    have hκ0
proof:
:= hκ
    rw [preKeys_node, List.tail_cons, mem_flatten_ofFn] at hκ
    obtain ⟨j₀, hj₀⟩ := hκ
    have hw := weight_ne_zero_of_mem hj₀
    have hsplit := flatten_ofFn_split (fun a => preKeys (ch a)) j₀
    rw [preKeys_eq_cons hw, List.mem_cons] at hj₀
    rcases hj₀ with rfl | hj₀
    · obtain ⟨l, m₂, c₂, hc⟩ : ∃ (l : ℕ) (m₂ : VMono G l) (c₂ : Fin l → STree (VMono G)),
          ch j₀ = STree.node m₂ c₂ := by
        cases h : ch j₀ with
        | leaf => rw [h] at hw; simp [STree.weight] at hw
        | node m₂ c₂ => exact ⟨_, m₂, c₂, rfl⟩
      set hN := mergeN_eq m l
      set Q := planar ch j₀ c₂ hN with hQ
      have hpre : preKeys (ch j₀)
          = vkey (ch j₀) :: (List.ofFn fun i => preKeys (c₂ i)).flatten := by
        rw [hc, preKeys_node]
      refine ⟨[], ((List.ofFn fun a => preKeys (ch a)).take j₀).flatten,
        (List.ofFn fun i => preKeys (c₂ i)).flatten
          ++ ((List.ofFn fun a => preKeys (ch a)).drop (j₀ + 1)).flatten, [], _,
        fun r => preKeys (Q r), sortP Q, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
      · rw [preKeys_node, List.tail_cons, hsplit, hpre]
        simp
      · rw [mergeT_root ht hc, rootMerge_eq hc ht, preKeys_node, List.tail_cons]
        simp only [List.nil_append, List.append_nil]
        rfl
      · rw [hQ, ofFn_planar ch j₀ c₂ hN preKeys, List.flatten_append, List.flatten_append]
        simp
      · intro a b hab x hx hx'
        have h1 := (mem_preKeys (isShuffle_planar hN hc ht a) hx).1
        have h2 := (mem_preKeys (isShuffle_planar hN hc ht b) hx').1
        exact disjoint_planar hN hc hnd hab h1 h2
      · have hex : ∃ j', vkey (ch j') = vkey (ch j₀) ∧ (ch j').weight ≠ 0 := ⟨j₀, rfl, hw⟩
        rw [kzAt, dif_pos hex]
        have hch : hex.choose = j₀ := by
          have := congrArg (fun κ : ℕ ×ₗ ℕ => (ofLex κ).1) hex.choose_spec.1
          simp only [vkey, ofLex_toLex] at this
          exact ht.mono.injective this
        rw [hch, hc]
        rfl
    · have hjs := ht.child j₀
      have hjnd := nodup_of_node hnd j₀
      obtain ⟨P, X, Y, S, N, B, π, h1, h2, h3, h4, h5⟩ := preKeys_mergeT (ch j₀) κ hjs hjnd hj₀
      obtain ⟨ih1, ih2, -⟩ := mergeT_spec (ch j₀) κ hjs hjnd hj₀
      have hwm : (mergeT (ch j₀) κ).weight ≠ 0 := by
        cases h : ch j₀ with
        | leaf => rw [h] at hw; simp [STree.weight] at hw
        | node m₂ c₂ => exact weight_mergeT_node m₂ c₂ κ
      have hvk : vkey (mergeT (ch j₀) κ) = vkey (ch j₀) := vkey_eq_of_labels ih1 hjs ih2
      set A := ((List.ofFn fun a => preKeys (ch a)).take j₀).flatten
      set C := ((List.ofFn fun a => preKeys (ch a)).drop (j₀ + 1)).flatten
      refine ⟨A ++ vkey (ch j₀) :: P, X, Y, S ++ C, N, B, π, ?_, ?_, h3, h4, ?_⟩
      · rw [preKeys_node, List.tail_cons, hsplit, preKeys_eq_cons hw, h1]
        simp
      · rw [mergeT_child ht hnd hj₀, preKeys_node, List.tail_cons,
          flatten_ofFn_split _ j₀]
        simp only [Function.update_self]
        rw [take_ofFn_update preKeys ch j₀ (mergeT (ch j₀) κ),
          drop_ofFn_update preKeys ch j₀ (mergeT (ch j₀) κ)]
        rw [preKeys_eq_cons hwm, h2, hvk]
        simp only [List.append_assoc, List.cons_append]
        rfl
      · have hno : ¬∃ j, vkey (ch j) = κ ∧ (ch j).weight ≠ 0 := by
          rintro ⟨j, rfl, hw'⟩
          by_cases hjj : j = j₀
          · subst hjj
            have hnd' := nodup_preKeys_child ht hnd j
            rw [preKeys_eq_cons hw'] at hnd'
            exact (List.nodup_cons.1 hnd').1 hj₀
          · exact not_mem_preKeys_of_ne ht hnd (Ne.symm hjj) (List.mem_of_mem_tail hj₀)
              (by rw [preKeys_eq_cons hw']; exact List.mem_cons_self ..)
        rw [kzAt, dif_neg hno, Fintype.prod_eq_single j₀ fun j hj =>
          kzAt_of_not_mem K (not_mem_preKeys_of_ne ht hnd (Ne.symm hj) (List.mem_of_mem_tail hj₀))]
        exact h5

name: Operad.ShuffleBarSym.sign_mergeT
statement:
theorem sign_mergeT {t : STree (VMono G)} (ht : t.IsShuffle) (hnd : t.labels.Nodup)
    {κ : ℕ ×ₗ ℕ} (hκ : κ ∈ (preKeys t).tail) :
    sign K t * (-1) ^ (preKeys t).tail.idxOf κ * kzAt K t κ * sign K (mergeT t κ)
      = ShuffleBar.sgn K (toBar t) κ
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨P, X, Y, S, N, B, π, h1, h2, h3, h4, h5⟩ := preKeys_mergeT K t κ ht hnd hκ
  have hL := nodup_tail_preKeys ht hnd
  rw [h1] at hL
  have hw : κ ∉ P ++ X := by
    intro hmem
    have hL' : (P ++ X ++ κ :: (Y ++ S)).Nodup := by simpa using hL
    exact (List.nodup_append.1 hL').2.2 _ hmem _ (List.mem_cons_self ..) rfl
  have hidx : (preKeys t).tail.idxOf κ = P.length + X.length := by
    rw [h1, show P ++ (X ++ κ :: Y) ++ S = (P ++ X) ++ κ :: (Y ++ S) by simp,
      List.idxOf_append_of_notMem hw, List.idxOf_cons_self, List.length_append, add_zero]
  rw [sign, sign, hidx, h5, h1, h2, sign_rule_list K P X Y S κ B π h3 h4 hw, sgn_toBar K ht hnd, h1]

name: Operad.ShuffleBarSym.nodup_smono
statement: lemma nodup_smono {n : ℕ} (t : SMono (VMono G) (Finset.range n)) : t.1.labels.Nodup
proof:
:= by
  rw [t.2.2]
  exact Finset.nodup _

name: Operad.ShuffleBarSym.mergeS_val
statement:
lemma mergeS_val {n : ℕ} (t : SMono (VMono G) (Finset.range n)) {κ : ℕ ×ₗ ℕ}
    (h : κ ∈ (preKeys t.1).tail) : (mergeS t κ).1 = mergeT t.1 κ
proof:
:= by
  rw [mergeS, dif_pos h]

name: Operad.ShuffleBarSym.ΦL_d_barBasisN_of_expansion
statement:
theorem ΦL_d_barBasisN_of_expansion {n : ℕ} (t : SMono (VMono G) (Finset.range n))
    (hexp : DExpansion c hc t) :
    ΦL c hc n (Bar.d (Ibar K E c hc) (Fin n) (barBasisN c hc n t))
      = ShuffleBar.d K (ΦL c hc n (barBasisN c hc n t))
proof:
:= by
  have hnd := nodup_smono t
  unfold DExpansion at hexp
  rw [hexp, map_sum, Φ_barBasisN, map_smul, ShuffleBar.d_single, one_smul, ShuffleBar.dTree,
    cutKeys_toBar t.2.1, Finset.smul_sum]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun κ hκ => ?_
  rw [List.mem_toFinset] at hκ
  rw [map_smul, Φ_barBasisN, mergeS_val t hκ, (mergeT_spec t.1 κ t.2.1 hnd hκ).2.2, smul_smul,
    smul_smul]
  congr 1
  rw [← sign_mergeT K t.2.1 hnd hκ]
  linear_combination (-((-1 : K) ^ (preKeys t.1).tail.idxOf κ * kzAt K t.1 κ
    * sign K (mergeT t.1 κ))) * sign_mul_self K t.1

name: Operad.ShuffleBarSym.ΦL_d_of_expansion
statement:
theorem ΦL_d_of_expansion {n : ℕ} (hexp : ∀ t : SMono (VMono G) (Finset.range n),
      DExpansion c hc t) (x : BarCoop (Ibar K E c hc) (Fin n)) :
    ΦL c hc n (Bar.d (Ibar K E c hc) (Fin n) x) = ShuffleBar.d K (ΦL c hc n x)
proof:
:= by
  have h : (ΦL c hc n).comp (Bar.d (Ibar K E c hc) (Fin n))
      = (ShuffleBar.d K).comp (ΦL c hc n) :=
    (barBasisN c hc n).ext fun t => ΦL_d_barBasisN_of_expansion c hc t (hexp t)
  exact LinearMap.congr_fun h x

name: Operad.ShuffleBarSym.kz_eq_one_of_nil
statement:
lemma kz_eq_one_of_nil (K : Type u) [CommRing K] {α : Type*} {N : ℕ} {B : Fin N → List α}
    (hB : ∀ a, B a = []) (π : Equiv.Perm (Fin N)) : kz K B π = 1
proof:
:= by
  unfold kz
  refine Finset.prod_eq_one fun a _ => Finset.prod_eq_one fun b _ => ?_
  split_ifs
  · rw [hB a, List.length_nil, zero_mul, pow_zero]
  · rfl

name: Operad.ShuffleBarSym.kzAt_root
proof:
:= by
  have hex : ∃ j', vkey (ch j') = vkey (ch j) ∧ (ch j').weight ≠ 0 :=
    ⟨j, rfl, by rw [hj]; simp [STree.weight]⟩
  rw [kzAt, dif_pos hex]
  have hch : hex.choose = j := by
    have := congrArg (fun κ : ℕ ×ₗ ℕ => (ofLex κ).1) hex.choose_spec.1
    simp only [vkey, ofLex_toLex] at this
    exact ht.mono.injective this
  rw [hch, hj]
  rfl

name: Operad.ShuffleBarSym.dExpansion_of_weight
statement:
theorem dExpansion_of_weight {n : ℕ} (t : SMono (VMono G) (Finset.range n))
    (hw : t.1.weight = 1 ∨ t.1.weight = 2) : DExpansion c hc t
proof:
:= by
  unfold DExpansion
  rcases hw with hw | hw
  · have htail : (preKeys t.1).tail = [] :=
      List.eq_nil_of_length_eq_zero (by rw [List.length_tail, length_preKeys, hw])
    rw [htail, d_barBasisN_of_weight_one c hc t hw]
    simp
  · obtain ⟨t, ht, hlab⟩ := t
    obtain ⟨k, m₁, ch, j₀, l, m₂, c₂, rfl, hj₀, hl₁, hl₂⟩ := exists_two hw
    have hnd : (STree.node m₁ ch).labels.Nodup := by
      rw [hlab]
      exact Finset.nodup _
    have hw₀ : (ch j₀).weight ≠ 0 := by
      rw [hj₀]
      simp [STree.weight]
    have hmem : vkey (ch j₀) ∈ (preKeys (STree.node m₁ ch)).tail := by
      rw [preKeys_node, List.tail_cons, mem_flatten_ofFn]
      exact ⟨j₀, by rw [preKeys_eq_cons hw₀]; exact List.mem_cons_self ..⟩
    have htail : (preKeys (STree.node m₁ ch)).tail = [vkey (ch j₀)] := by
      have hlen : (preKeys (STree.node m₁ ch)).tail.length = 1 := by
        rw [List.length_tail, length_preKeys, hw]
      obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := List.length_eq_one_iff.1 hlen
      rw [ha] at hmem ⊢
      rw [List.mem_singleton.1 hmem]
    have hleaf : ∀ r, preKeys (planar ch j₀ c₂ (mergeN_eq m₁ l) r) = [] := by
      intro r
      obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := (posEquivF j₀ l _ (mergeN_eq m₁ l)).surjective r
      rcases x with a | i
      · obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := hl₁ a.1 a.2
        rw [planar_inl, hy]
        rfl
      · obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := hl₂ i
        rw [planar_inr, hy]
        rfl
    have hspec := mergeT_spec (STree.node m₁ ch) (vkey (ch j₀)) ht hnd hmem
    have hkey : vkey (ch j₀) = twoKey ch j₀ := by
      rw [twoKey, kids_fin, key_cutRoot, key_toBar (ht.child j₀)]
    have hS : mergeS ⟨STree.node m₁ ch, ht, hlab⟩ (vkey (ch j₀))
        = corollaS ⟨_, twoMono_mem hj₀ hl₂ hl₁ ht hlab⟩ := by
      refine Subtype.ext ?_
      rw [mergeS_val _ hmem]
      refine (toBar_injective (isShuffle_corolla _) hspec.1 ?_).symm
      rw [toBar_corolla, hspec.2.2, hkey, mergeK_toBar_two hj₀ hl₂ hl₁]
    dsimp only
    rw [htail, d_barBasisN_two c hc m₁ ch j₀ m₂ c₂ hj₀ hl₁ hl₂ ht hlab]
    simp only [List.toFinset_cons, List.toFinset_nil, insert_empty_eq, Finset.sum_singleton,
      List.idxOf_cons_self, pow_zero, one_mul]
    rw [kzAt_root K ht hj₀, kz_eq_one_of_nil K hleaf, one_smul, hS]

name: Operad.ShuffleBar.mem_Lkeys
statement: lemma mem_Lkeys {T : LTree E} {k : ℕ ×ₗ ℕ} : k ∈ Lkeys L T ↔ ∃ w ∈ L, (k, w) ∈ T.edgeWins
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp only [Lkeys, List.mem_toFinset, List.mem_map, List.mem_filter, decide_eq_true_eq]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨⟨k', w⟩, ⟨hw, hL⟩, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨w, hL, hw⟩
  · rintro ⟨w, hL, hw⟩
    exact ⟨(k, w), ⟨hw, hL⟩, rfl⟩

name: Operad.ShuffleBar.Lkeys_subset_cutKeys
statement:
lemma Lkeys_subset_cutKeys {x : BarTree E} (h : NormalBar L x) :
    Lkeys L (x.mapDec Prod.fst) ⊆ cutKeys x
proof:
:= fun k hk => by
  obtain ⟨w, hL, hw⟩ := (mem_Lkeys L).1 hk
  by_contra hc
  exact h (k, w) hw hc hL

name: Operad.ShuffleBar.normalBar_mergeK_iff
statement:
lemma normalBar_mergeK_iff {x : BarTree E} (hnd : x.labels.Nodup) (hN : NormalBar L x)
    {k : ℕ ×ₗ ℕ} (hk : k ∈ cutKeys x) :
    NormalBar L (mergeK x k) ↔ k ∉ Lkeys L (x.mapDec Prod.fst)
proof:
:= by
  rw [normalBar_mergeK hnd hk, mem_Lkeys]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨-, h⟩ ⟨w, hL, hw⟩
    exact h w hw hL
  · intro h
    exact ⟨hN, fun w hw hL => h ⟨w, hL, hw⟩⟩

name: Operad.ShuffleBar.d₀_single
statement:
@[simp] lemma d₀_single (x : BarTree E) (c : K) :
    d₀ K L (Finsupp.single x c) = c • d₀Tree K L x
proof:
:= by
  simp [d₀]

name: Operad.ShuffleBar.hL_single
statement:
@[simp] lemma hL_single (x : BarTree E) (c : K) :
    hL K L (Finsupp.single x c) = c • hTree K L x
proof:
:= by
  simp [hL]

name: Operad.ShuffleBar.sgn_mul_self
statement: lemma sgn_mul_self (x : BarTree E) (k : ℕ ×ₗ ℕ) : sgn K x k * sgn K x k = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [sgn, ← pow_add, ← two_mul, pow_mul]
  simp

name: Operad.ShuffleBar.sgn_cutK
proof:
:= by
  unfold sgn
  rw [cutKeys_cutK hnd hk₀, Finset.filter_insert]
  split_ifs with h
  · rw [Finset.card_insert_of_notMem (fun h' => hc (Finset.mem_filter.1 h').1), pow_succ]
    ring
  · rw [one_mul]

name: Operad.ShuffleBar.d₀_hTree_add
statement:
theorem d₀_hTree_add {x : BarTree E} (hnd : x.labels.Nodup) (hx : rootFlag x = false)
    (hne : (Nkeys L (x.mapDec Prod.fst)).Nonempty) :
    d₀ K L (hTree K L x) + hL K L (d₀Tree K L x) = Finsupp.single x 1
proof:
:= by
  set T := x.mapDec Prod.fst with hT
  set k₀ := (Nkeys L T).min' hne with hk₀def
  have hk₀N : k₀ ∈ Nkeys L T := Finset.min'_mem _ hne
  have hk₀E : k₀ ∈ T.edgeKeys := (Finset.mem_sdiff.1 hk₀N).1
  have hmin : ∀ k ∈ Nkeys L T, k ≠ k₀ → k₀ < k := fun k hk hkk =>
    lt_of_le_of_ne (Finset.min'_le _ k hk) (Ne.symm hkk)
  
  have hT_merge : ∀ k ∈ cutKeys x, (mergeK x k).mapDec Prod.fst = T := fun k _ => full_mergeK k x
  by_cases hc : k₀ ∈ cutKeys x
  · 
    have hh : hTree K L x = 0 := by
      simp only [hTree, ← hT, dif_pos hne, ← hk₀def, if_pos hc]
    rw [hh, map_zero, zero_add, d₀Tree, map_sum]
    rw [Finset.sum_eq_single k₀]
    · rw [map_smul, hL_single, one_smul, hTree, full_mergeK, ← hT, dif_pos hne, ← hk₀def,
        cutKeys_mergeK x hnd hc, if_neg (Finset.notMem_erase k₀ _), cutK_mergeK hnd hx hc,
        smul_smul, sgn_mul_self, one_smul]
    · intro k hk hkk
      have hk' := (Finset.mem_filter.1 hk).1
      rw [map_smul, hL_single, one_smul, hTree, full_mergeK, ← hT, dif_pos hne, ← hk₀def,
        cutKeys_mergeK x hnd hk', if_pos (Finset.mem_erase.2 ⟨Ne.symm hkk, hc⟩), smul_zero]
    · intro h
      exact absurd (Finset.mem_filter.2 ⟨hc, hk₀N⟩) h
  · 
    set y := cutK x k₀ with hy
    have hcy : cutKeys y = insert k₀ (cutKeys x) := cutKeys_cutK hnd hk₀E
    have hh : hTree K L x = sgn K y k₀ • Finsupp.single y 1 := by
      simp only [hTree, ← hT, dif_pos hne, ← hk₀def, if_neg hc, hy]
    have hfy : y.mapDec Prod.fst = T := full_cutK k₀ x
    have hfilter : (cutKeys y).filter (· ∈ Nkeys L (y.mapDec Prod.fst)) =
        insert k₀ ((cutKeys x).filter (· ∈ Nkeys L T)) := by
      rw [hfy, hcy, Finset.filter_insert, if_pos hk₀N]
    have hnot : k₀ ∉ (cutKeys x).filter (· ∈ Nkeys L T) := fun h => hc (Finset.mem_filter.1 h).1
    rw [hh, map_smul, d₀_single, one_smul, d₀Tree, hfilter, Finset.sum_insert hnot,
      mergeK_cutK hx hc, d₀Tree, map_sum, smul_add, smul_smul, sgn_mul_self, one_smul,
      add_assoc, Finset.smul_sum, ← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
    conv_rhs => rw [← add_zero (Finsupp.single x (1 : K))]
    congr 1
    refine Finset.sum_eq_zero fun k hk => ?_
    obtain ⟨hkc, hkN⟩ := Finset.mem_filter.1 hk
    have hkk : k ≠ k₀ := fun h => hc (h ▸ hkc)
    have hlt : k₀ < k := hmin k hkN hkk
    
    set z := mergeK x k with hz
    have hcz : cutKeys z = (cutKeys x).erase k := cutKeys_mergeK x hnd hkc
    have hk₀z : k₀ ∉ cutKeys z := by rw [hcz]; exact fun h => hc (Finset.mem_of_mem_erase h)
    have hfz : z.mapDec Prod.fst = T := by rw [hz]; exact full_mergeK k x
    have hhz : hTree K L z = sgn K (cutK z k₀) k₀ • Finsupp.single (cutK z k₀) 1 := by
      simp only [hTree, hfz, dif_pos hne, ← hk₀def, if_neg hk₀z]
    have hnz : z.labels.Nodup := by rw [hz, labels_mergeK]; exact hnd
    have hk₀Ez : k₀ ∈ (z.mapDec Prod.fst).edgeKeys := by rw [hz, full_mergeK]; exact hk₀E
    have hs1 : sgn K (cutK z k₀) k₀ = sgn K y k₀ := by
      rw [sgn_cutK K hnz hk₀Ez hk₀z, sgn_cutK K hnd hk₀E hc, if_neg (lt_irrefl _), one_mul,
        one_mul]
      unfold sgn
      have hnk : k ∉ (cutKeys x).filter (· < k₀) := fun h =>
        absurd (Finset.mem_filter.1 h).2 (not_lt.2 hlt.le)
      rw [hcz, Finset.filter_erase, Finset.erase_eq_of_notMem hnk]
    have hs2 : sgn K y k = -sgn K x k := by
      rw [hy, sgn_cutK K hnd hk₀E hc, if_pos hlt, neg_one_mul]
    rw [map_smul, hL_single, one_smul, hhz, hs1, hs2, mergeK_cutK_comm hkk, ← hz, smul_smul,
      smul_smul, ← add_smul]
    rw [mul_neg, mul_comm (sgn K x k), neg_add_cancel, zero_smul]

name: Operad.LTree.plug_congr
statement:
lemma _root_.Operad.LTree.plug_congr {X : Type*} {ins ins' : ℕ → LTree X} :
    ∀ {m : LTree X}, (∀ a ∈ m.labels, ins a = ins' a) → m.plug ins = m.plug ins'
  | leaf a, h => h a (by simp)
  | node e l r, h => by
    simp only [plug]
    rw [plug_congr fun a ha => h a (by simp [ha]), plug_congr fun a ha => h a (by simp [ha])]

section Components

                                                                                                  
               
def topAux : BarTree E → LTree E
  | leaf a => leaf a
  | node d l r => if d.2 then leaf (min l.minLabel r.minLabel) else node d.1 (topAux l) (topAux r)

                                                                                                 
                                  
def top : BarTree E → LTree E
  | leaf a => leaf a
  | node d l r => node d.1 (topAux l) (topAux r)

                                                                                                 
                    
def hangAux : BarTree E → ℕ → BarTree E
  | leaf _, a => leaf a
  | node d l r, a =>
    if d.2 then (if min l.minLabel r.minLabel = a then node d l r else leaf a)
    else if a ∈ (topAux l).labels then hangAux l a else hangAux r a

                                                                                                
                                                        
def hang : BarTree E → ℕ → BarTree E
  | leaf _, a => leaf a
  | node _ l r, a => if a ∈ (topAux l).labels then hangAux l a else hangAux r a

name: Operad.ShuffleBar.topAux_of_flag
statement:
lemma topAux_of_flag {d : E × Bool} {l r : BarTree E} (h : d.2 = false) :
    topAux (node d l r) = top (node d l r)
proof:
:= by
  simp [topAux, top, h]

name: Operad.ShuffleBar.hangAux_of_flag
statement:
lemma hangAux_of_flag {d : E × Bool} {l r : BarTree E} (h : d.2 = false) :
    hangAux (node d l r) = hang (node d l r)
proof:
:= by
  funext a
  simp [hangAux, hang, h]

name: Operad.ShuffleBar.minLabel_topAux
statement:
@[simp] lemma minLabel_topAux : ∀ y : BarTree E, (topAux y).minLabel = y.minLabel
  | leaf _ => rfl
  | node d l r => by
    simp only [topAux]
    split_ifs
    · rfl
    · simp [minLabel_topAux l, minLabel_topAux r]

@[simp] lemma minLabel_top (y : BarTree E) : (top y).minLabel = y.minLabel
proof:
:= by
  cases y with
  | leaf => rfl
  | node d l r => simp [top]

name: Operad.ShuffleBar.minLabel_top
statement: @[simp] lemma minLabel_top (y : BarTree E) : (top y).minLabel = y.minLabel
proof:
:= by
  cases y with
  | leaf => rfl
  | node d l r => simp [top]

name: Operad.ShuffleBar.sublist_topAux
statement:
lemma sublist_topAux : ∀ y : BarTree E, (topAux y).labels.Sublist y.labels
  | leaf _ => List.Sublist.refl _
  | node d l r => by
    simp only [topAux]
    split_ifs
    · simp only [labels_leaf, List.singleton_sublist]
      rw [← minLabel_node d l r]
      exact minLabel_mem _
    · exact (sublist_topAux l).append (sublist_topAux r)

name: Operad.ShuffleBar.sublist_top
statement: lemma sublist_top (y : BarTree E) : (top y).labels.Sublist y.labels
proof:
:= by
  cases y with
  | leaf => exact List.Sublist.refl _
  | node d l r => exact (sublist_topAux l).append (sublist_topAux r)

name: Operad.ShuffleBar.isShuffle_topAux
statement:
lemma isShuffle_topAux : ∀ y : BarTree E, y.IsShuffle → (topAux y).IsShuffle
  | leaf _, _ => trivial
  | node d l r, h => by
    simp only [topAux]
    split_ifs
    · trivial
    · exact ⟨by simpa using h.1, isShuffle_topAux l h.2.1, isShuffle_topAux r h.2.2⟩

name: Operad.ShuffleBar.isShuffle_top
statement: lemma isShuffle_top {y : BarTree E} (h : y.IsShuffle) : (top y).IsShuffle
proof:
:= by
  cases y with
  | leaf => trivial
  | node d l r => exact ⟨by simpa using h.1, isShuffle_topAux l h.2.1, isShuffle_topAux r h.2.2⟩

name: Operad.ShuffleBar.nodup_top
statement: lemma nodup_top {y : BarTree E} (h : y.labels.Nodup) : (top y).labels.Nodup
proof:
:=
  (sublist_top y).nodup h

name: Operad.ShuffleBar.size_hangAux_le
statement:
lemma size_hangAux_le : ∀ (y : BarTree E) (a : ℕ), (hangAux y a).size ≤ y.size
  | leaf _, _ => le_rfl
  | node d l r, a => by
    simp only [hangAux]
    split_ifs
    · exact le_rfl
    · simp
    · have
proof:
:= size_hangAux_le l a
      simp only [size_node]
      omega
    · have := size_hangAux_le r a
      simp only [size_node]
      omega

name: Operad.ShuffleBar.size_hang_lt
statement:
lemma size_hang_lt (d : E × Bool) (l r : BarTree E) (a : ℕ) :
    (hang (node d l r) a).size < (node d l r).size
proof:
:= by
  simp only [hang]
  split_ifs
  · have := size_hangAux_le l a
    simp only [size_node]
    omega
  · have := size_hangAux_le r a
    simp only [size_node]
    omega

name: Operad.ShuffleBar.hangAux_of_not_mem
statement:
lemma hangAux_of_not_mem : ∀ (y : BarTree E) (a : ℕ), a ∉ (topAux y).labels → hangAux y a = leaf a
  | leaf b, a, _ => rfl
  | node d l r, a, ha => by
    simp only [topAux] at ha
    simp only [hangAux]
    split_ifs at ha ⊢ with h1 h2 h3
    · simp [h2] at ha
    · rfl
    · simp only [labels_node, List.mem_append, not_or] at ha
      exact absurd h3 ha.1
    · simp only [labels_node, List.mem_append, not_or] at ha
      exact hangAux_of_not_mem r a ha.2

name: Operad.ShuffleBar.plug_topAux
statement:
theorem plug_topAux : ∀ y : BarTree E, y.labels.Nodup → (unflag (topAux y)).plug (hangAux y) = y
  | leaf a, _ => rfl
  | node d l r, hnd => by
    by_cases hd : d.2
    · simp [topAux, hd, plug, hangAux]
    · have hd' : d.2 = false
proof:
:= by simpa using hd
      have hl := plug_topAux l (List.nodup_append.1 hnd).1
      have hr := plug_topAux r (List.nodup_append.1 hnd).2.1
      simp only [topAux, hd', Bool.false_eq_true, if_false, mapDec_node, plug]
      have el : (unflag (topAux l)).plug (hangAux (node d l r)) = l := by
        refine (plug_congr fun a ha => ?_).trans hl
        rw [labels_mapDec] at ha
        simp [hangAux, hd', ha]
      have er : (unflag (topAux r)).plug (hangAux (node d l r)) = r := by
        refine (plug_congr fun a ha => ?_).trans hr
        rw [labels_mapDec] at ha
        have ha' : a ∉ (topAux l).labels := fun h =>
          ne_of_nodup_append hnd ((sublist_topAux l).subset h) ((sublist_topAux r).subset ha) rfl
        simp [hangAux, hd', ha']
      rw [el, er]
      obtain ⟨e, c⟩ := d
      simp only at hd'
      subst hd'
      rfl

name: Operad.ShuffleBar.plug_top
statement:
theorem plug_top (y : BarTree E) (hnd : y.labels.Nodup) :
    (liftW (rootFlag y) (top y)).plug (hang y) = y
proof:
:= by
  cases y with
  | leaf => rfl
  | node d l r =>
    have := plug_topAux (node (d.1, false) l r) hnd
    simp only [topAux, Bool.false_eq_true, if_false, mapDec_node, plug, hangAux] at this
    simp only [top, liftW, plug, rootFlag]
    simp only [node.injEq] at this
    have e : hang (node d l r) =
        fun x => if x ∈ (topAux l).labels then hangAux l x else hangAux r x := rfl
    rw [e, this.2.1, this.2.2]

name: Operad.ShuffleBar.pick_append
statement:
lemma pick_append (ins : ℕ → BarTree E) (a : ℕ) : ∀ ks ks' : List ℕ,
    pick ins a (ks ++ ks') =
      if a ∈ ks.flatMap (fun k => (topAux (ins k)).labels) then pick ins a ks else pick ins a ks'
  | [], ks' => by simp
  | k :: ks, ks' => by
    simp only [List.cons_append, pick, List.flatMap_cons, List.mem_append]
    by_cases h : a ∈ (topAux (ins k)).labels
    · simp [h]
    · simp only [h, if_false, false_or]
      exact pick_append ins a ks ks'

name: Operad.ShuffleBar.topAux_plug_unflag
statement:
lemma topAux_plug_unflag (ins : ℕ → BarTree E) :
    ∀ m : LTree E, topAux ((unflag m).plug ins) = m.plug fun k => topAux (ins k)
  | leaf _ => rfl
  | node e l r => by
    simp only [mapDec_node, plug, topAux, Bool.false_eq_true, if_false]
    rw [topAux_plug_unflag ins l, topAux_plug_unflag ins r]

name: Operad.ShuffleBar.labels_topAux_plug_unflag
statement:
lemma labels_topAux_plug_unflag (ins : ℕ → BarTree E) (m : LTree E) :
    (topAux ((unflag m).plug ins)).labels = m.labels.flatMap fun k => (topAux (ins k)).labels
proof:
:= by
  rw [topAux_plug_unflag, labels_plug]

name: Operad.ShuffleBar.hangAux_plug_unflag
statement:
lemma hangAux_plug_unflag (ins : ℕ → BarTree E) (a : ℕ) :
    ∀ m : LTree E, hangAux ((unflag m).plug ins) a = pick ins a m.labels
  | leaf k => by
    simp only [mapDec_leaf, plug, labels_leaf, pick]
    split_ifs with h
    · rfl
    · exact hangAux_of_not_mem _ a h
  | node e l r => by
    simp only [mapDec_node, plug, hangAux, Bool.false_eq_true, if_false, labels_node,
      pick_append, labels_topAux_plug_unflag]
    rw [hangAux_plug_unflag ins a l, hangAux_plug_unflag ins a r]

name: Operad.ShuffleBar.top_plug_liftW
statement:
lemma top_plug_liftW (ins : ℕ → BarTree E) (c : Bool) (e : E) (l r : LTree E) :
    top ((liftW c (node e l r)).plug ins) = (node e l r).plug fun k => topAux (ins k)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [liftW, plug, top]
  rw [topAux_plug_unflag, topAux_plug_unflag]

name: Operad.ShuffleBar.hang_plug_liftW
statement:
lemma hang_plug_liftW (ins : ℕ → BarTree E) (c : Bool) (e : E) (l r : LTree E) (a : ℕ) :
    hang ((liftW c (node e l r)).plug ins) a = pick ins a (node e l r).labels
proof:
:= by
  simp only [liftW, plug, hang, labels_node, pick_append, labels_topAux_plug_unflag]
  rw [hangAux_plug_unflag, hangAux_plug_unflag]

name: Operad.ShuffleBar.pick_perm
statement:
lemma pick_perm (ins : ℕ → BarTree E) (a : ℕ) {ks ks' : List ℕ} (h : ks.Perm ks')
    (hdisj : ∀ k ∈ ks, ∀ k' ∈ ks, k ≠ k' → a ∈ (topAux (ins k)).labels →
      a ∉ (topAux (ins k')).labels) (hnd : ks.Nodup) : pick ins a ks = pick ins a ks'
proof:
:= by
  induction h with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons x _ ih =>
    simp only [pick]
    rw [ih (fun k hk k' hk' => hdisj k (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hk) k' (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hk'))
      (List.nodup_cons.1 hnd).2]
  | swap x y l =>
    simp only [pick]
    have hxy : y ≠ x := fun h => by
      subst h
      exact (List.nodup_cons.1 hnd).1 List.mem_cons_self
    by_cases hx : a ∈ (topAux (ins x)).labels
    · by_cases hy : a ∈ (topAux (ins y)).labels
      · exact absurd hx (hdisj y (by simp) x (by simp) hxy hy)
      · simp [hx, hy]
    · by_cases hy : a ∈ (topAux (ins y)).labels <;> simp [hx, hy]
  | trans h₁ _ ih₁ ih₂ =>
    rw [ih₁ hdisj hnd, ih₂ (fun k hk k' hk' => hdisj k (h₁.symm.subset hk) k' (h₁.symm.subset hk'))
      (h₁.nodup_iff.1 hnd)]

name: Operad.ShuffleBar.winIns_top
statement:
lemma winIns_top : ∀ (y : BarTree E) (s : Bool), y.IsEdgeRoot s →
    rootFlag (y.subtreeAt [s]) = false →
    (top y).IsEdgeRoot s ∧ (top y).winIns s = fun k => topAux (y.winIns s k)
  | node d (node f a b) e, false, _, hf => by
    simp only [subtreeAt, rootFlag] at hf
    simp only [top, topAux, hf, Bool.false_eq_true, if_false]
    refine ⟨trivial, ?_⟩
    funext k
    simp only [winIns, winInputs, minLabel_topAux, ins3]
    split_ifs <;> rfl
  | node d e (node f a b), true, _, hf => by
    simp only [subtreeAt, rootFlag] at hf
    simp only [top, topAux, hf, Bool.false_eq_true, if_false]
    have e1 : (node d.1 (topAux e) (node f.1 (topAux a) (topAux b))).winInputs true =
        (topAux e, topAux a, topAux b)
proof:
:= by cases topAux e <;> rfl
    have e2 : (node d e (node f a b)).winInputs true = (e, a, b) := by cases e <;> rfl
    refine ⟨by cases topAux e <;> trivial, ?_⟩
    funext k
    simp only [winIns, e1, e2, ins3]
    split_ifs <;> rfl

name: Operad.ShuffleBar.substBar_cons_false
statement:
lemma substBar_cons_false (d : E × Bool) (l r : BarTree E) (p : List Bool) (s : Bool)
    (σ : LTree E) : substBar (node d l r) (false :: p) s σ = node d (substBar l p s σ) r
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.ShuffleBar.substBar_cons_true
statement:
lemma substBar_cons_true (d : E × Bool) (l r : BarTree E) (p : List Bool) (s : Bool)
    (σ : LTree E) : substBar (node d l r) (true :: p) s σ = node d l (substBar r p s σ)
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.ShuffleBar.topAux_cut
statement:
lemma topAux_cut {d : E × Bool} {l r : BarTree E} (h : d.2 = true) :
    topAux (node d l r) = leaf (node d l r).minLabel
proof:
:= by
  simp [topAux, h]

name: Operad.ShuffleBar.hangAux_cut
statement:
lemma hangAux_cut {d : E × Bool} {l r : BarTree E} (h : d.2 = true) (a : ℕ) :
    hangAux (node d l r) a = if (node d l r).minLabel = a then node d l r else leaf a
proof:
:= by
  simp [hangAux, h]

name: Operad.ShuffleBar.minLabel_substBar
proof:
:=
  minLabel_eq_of_perm (perm_labels_substBar hs hnd h hσ)

name: Operad.ShuffleBar.topAux_eq_top
statement: lemma topAux_eq_top {y : BarTree E} (h : rootFlag y = false) : topAux y = top y
proof:
:= by
  cases y with
  | leaf => rfl
  | node d l r => exact topAux_of_flag (by simpa [rootFlag] using h)

name: Operad.ShuffleBar.hangAux_eq_hang
statement: lemma hangAux_eq_hang {y : BarTree E} (h : rootFlag y = false) : hangAux y = hang y
proof:
:= by
  cases y with
  | leaf => rfl
  | node d l r => exact hangAux_of_flag (by simpa [rootFlag] using h)

name: Operad.ShuffleBar.top_hang_substBar
statement:
theorem top_hang_substBar : ∀ (p : List Bool) (y : BarTree E) (s : Bool), y.IsShuffle →
    y.labels.Nodup → IsUncut y p s →
    ((top y).IsEdge p s ∧ ∀ σ : Mono E 3,
      top (substBar y p s σ.1) = (top y).substAt p s σ.1 ∧ hang (substBar y p s σ.1) = hang y) ∨
    ∃ a q, IsUncut (hang y a) q s ∧ (hang y a).size < y.size ∧ (hang y a).IsShuffle ∧
      (hang y a).labels.Nodup ∧ a ∈ (top y).labels ∧ ∀ σ : Mono E 3,
        top (substBar y p s σ.1) = top y ∧
          hang (substBar y p s σ.1) = Function.update (hang y) a (substBar (hang y a) q s σ.1)
  | [], y, s, hs, hnd, h => by
    have he : y.IsEdgeRoot s
proof:
:= by simpa [IsEdge] using h.1
    have hw := winSpec he hs hnd
    have hf : rootFlag (y.subtreeAt [s]) = false := h.2
    obtain ⟨hte, htw⟩ := winIns_top y s he hf
    have hwin := windowRoot_of_uncut y s he hf
    obtain ⟨-, hwl, e, wl, wr, hwe⟩ := windowRoot_shape (y.mapDec Prod.fst) s
      ((isEdgeRoot_mapDec _ y s).2 he) (by simpa using hs) (by simpa using hnd)
    have hdisj := winIns_disjoint (p := []) h.1 hs hnd
    simp only [subtreeAt_nil] at hdisj
    refine Or.inl ⟨by simpa [IsEdge] using hte, fun σ => ?_⟩
    obtain ⟨-, hσ, e', σl, σr, hσe⟩ := mono_shape σ
    have hsub : substBar y [] s σ.1 = (liftW (rootFlag y) σ.1).plug (y.winIns s) := by
      simp [substBar, substAt, flagAt]
    rw [hsub, hσe]
    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [top_plug_liftW, substAt, subtreeAt_nil, replaceAt_nil, htw]
    · funext a
      rw [hang_plug_liftW]
      conv_rhs => rw [← hw.window, hwin, hwe, hang_plug_liftW]
      have hσ' : (node e' σl σr).labels.Perm (List.range 3) := hσe ▸ hσ
      have hw' : (node e wl wr).labels.Perm (List.range 3) := hwe ▸ hwl
      refine pick_perm _ a (hσ'.trans hw'.symm) (fun k hk k' hk' hkk ha ha' => ?_)
        (hσ'.nodup_iff.2 List.nodup_range)
      have hk3 := List.mem_range.1 (hσ'.subset hk)
      have hk3' := List.mem_range.1 (hσ'.subset hk')
      exact hdisj k hk3 k' hk3' hkk a ((sublist_topAux _).subset ha)
        ((sublist_topAux _).subset ha')
  | _ :: _, leaf _, s, _, _, h => by
    exact absurd h.1 (by cases s <;> simp [IsEdge, subtreeAt, IsEdgeRoot])
  | b :: p, node d l r, s, hs, hnd, h => by
    have hdisj : ∀ a ∈ (topAux l).labels, a ∉ (topAux r).labels := fun a ha ha' =>
      ne_of_nodup_append hnd ((sublist_topAux l).subset ha) ((sublist_topAux r).subset ha') rfl
    have hang_eq : ∀ (L R : BarTree E) a, hang (node d L R) a =
        if a ∈ (topAux L).labels then hangAux L a else hangAux R a := fun _ _ _ => rfl
    cases b with
    | false =>
      have hl : IsUncut l p s := h
      have hls : l.IsShuffle := hs.2.1
      have hlnd : l.labels.Nodup := (List.nodup_append.1 hnd).1
      have hsize : l.size < (node d l r).size := by simp only [size_node]; omega
      have hroot : ∀ σ : Mono E 3, rootFlag (substBar l p s σ.1) = rootFlag l := fun σ =>
        rootFlag_substBar hls hlnd hl (mono_shape σ).2.2
      have hmin : ∀ σ : Mono E 3, (substBar l p s σ.1).minLabel = l.minLabel := fun σ =>
        minLabel_substBar hls hlnd hl (mono_shape σ).2.1
      by_cases hc : rootFlag l = true
      · 
        have hcut : ∀ t : BarTree E, rootFlag t = true →
            topAux t = leaf t.minLabel ∧ ∀ a, hangAux t a = if t.minLabel = a then t else leaf a :=
          fun t ht => by
            cases t with
            | leaf => simp [rootFlag] at ht
            | node d' a' b' =>
              simp only [rootFlag] at ht
              exact ⟨topAux_cut ht, hangAux_cut ht⟩
        obtain ⟨htl, hhl⟩ := hcut l hc
        have hyl : hang (node d l r) l.minLabel = l := by
          rw [hang_eq, if_pos (by simp [htl]), hhl, if_pos rfl]
        refine Or.inr ⟨l.minLabel, p, by rw [hyl]; exact hl, by rw [hyl]; exact hsize,
          by rw [hyl]; exact hls, by rw [hyl]; exact hlnd, by simp [top, htl],
          fun σ => ⟨?_, ?_⟩⟩
        · rw [substBar_cons_false]
          simp only [top, (hcut _ ((hroot σ).trans hc)).1, hmin σ, htl]
        · rw [substBar_cons_false, hyl]
          funext a
          simp only [hang_eq, (hcut _ ((hroot σ).trans hc)).1, Function.update_apply, htl,
            (hcut _ ((hroot σ).trans hc)).2, hmin σ, hhl, labels_leaf, List.mem_singleton]
          by_cases ha : a = l.minLabel
          · subst ha
            simp
          · simp [ha]
      · have hc' : rootFlag l = false := by simpa using hc
        rcases top_hang_substBar p l s hls hlnd hl with ⟨hte, hσ⟩ | ⟨a, q, hq, hsz, hhs, hhnd, ha,
          hσ⟩
        · refine Or.inl ⟨?_, fun σ => ⟨?_, ?_⟩⟩
          · show (topAux l).IsEdge p s
            rw [topAux_eq_top hc']
            exact hte
          · rw [substBar_cons_false]
            simp only [top]
            rw [topAux_eq_top ((hroot σ).trans hc'), (hσ σ).1, topAux_eq_top hc']
            rfl
          · rw [substBar_cons_false]
            funext a
            have hperm : ((top l).substAt p s σ.1).labels.Perm (top l).labels :=
              perm_labels_substAt hte (isShuffle_top hls) (nodup_top hlnd) (mono_shape σ).2.1
            simp only [hang_eq, topAux_eq_top ((hroot σ).trans hc'), (hσ σ).1, hperm.mem_iff,
              hangAux_eq_hang ((hroot σ).trans hc'), (hσ σ).2, topAux_eq_top hc',
              hangAux_eq_hang hc']
        · have hya : hang (node d l r) a = hang l a := by
            rw [hang_eq, if_pos (by rw [topAux_eq_top hc']; exact ha), hangAux_eq_hang hc']
          refine Or.inr ⟨a, q, by rw [hya]; exact hq, by rw [hya]; exact hsz.trans hsize,
            by rw [hya]; exact hhs, by rw [hya]; exact hhnd, ?_, fun σ => ⟨?_, ?_⟩⟩
          · simp only [top, labels_node, List.mem_append]
            left
            rw [topAux_eq_top hc']
            exact ha
          · rw [substBar_cons_false]
            simp only [top]
            rw [topAux_eq_top ((hroot σ).trans hc'), (hσ σ).1, topAux_eq_top hc']
          · rw [substBar_cons_false, hya]
            funext a'
            simp only [hang_eq, topAux_eq_top ((hroot σ).trans hc'), (hσ σ).1,
              hangAux_eq_hang ((hroot σ).trans hc'), (hσ σ).2, Function.update_apply,
              topAux_eq_top hc', hangAux_eq_hang hc']
            by_cases haa : a' = a
            · subst haa
              simp [ha]
            · simp [haa]
    | true =>
      have hr : IsUncut r p s := h
      have hrs : r.IsShuffle := hs.2.2
      have hrnd : r.labels.Nodup := (List.nodup_append.1 hnd).2.1
      have hsize : r.size < (node d l r).size := by simp only [size_node]; omega
      have hroot : ∀ σ : Mono E 3, rootFlag (substBar r p s σ.1) = rootFlag r := fun σ =>
        rootFlag_substBar hrs hrnd hr (mono_shape σ).2.2
      have hmin : ∀ σ : Mono E 3, (substBar r p s σ.1).minLabel = r.minLabel := fun σ =>
        minLabel_substBar hrs hrnd hr (mono_shape σ).2.1
      by_cases hc : rootFlag r = true
      · have hcut : ∀ t : BarTree E, rootFlag t = true →
            topAux t = leaf t.minLabel ∧ ∀ a, hangAux t a = if t.minLabel = a then t else leaf a :=
          fun t ht => by
            cases t with
            | leaf => simp [rootFlag] at ht
            | node d' a' b' =>
              simp only [rootFlag] at ht
              exact ⟨topAux_cut ht, hangAux_cut ht⟩
        obtain ⟨htr, hhr⟩ := hcut r hc
        have hnl : r.minLabel ∉ (topAux l).labels := fun h' =>
          hdisj _ h' (by simp [htr])
        have hyr : hang (node d l r) r.minLabel = r := by
          rw [hang_eq, if_neg hnl, hhr, if_pos rfl]
        refine Or.inr ⟨r.minLabel, p, by rw [hyr]; exact hr, by rw [hyr]; exact hsize,
          by rw [hyr]; exact hrs, by rw [hyr]; exact hrnd, by simp [top, htr],
          fun σ => ⟨?_, ?_⟩⟩
        · rw [substBar_cons_true]
          simp only [top, (hcut _ ((hroot σ).trans hc)).1, hmin σ, htr]
        · rw [substBar_cons_true, hyr]
          funext a
          simp only [hang_eq, (hcut _ ((hroot σ).trans hc)).2, Function.update_apply, hhr,
            hmin σ]
          by_cases ha : a = r.minLabel
          · subst ha
            simp [hnl]
          · simp [ha, Ne.symm ha]
      · have hc' : rootFlag r = false := by simpa using hc
        rcases top_hang_substBar p r s hrs hrnd hr with ⟨hte, hσ⟩ | ⟨a, q, hq, hsz, hhs, hhnd, ha,
          hσ⟩
        · refine Or.inl ⟨?_, fun σ => ⟨?_, ?_⟩⟩
          · show (topAux r).IsEdge p s
            rw [topAux_eq_top hc']
            exact hte
          · rw [substBar_cons_true]
            simp only [top]
            rw [topAux_eq_top ((hroot σ).trans hc'), (hσ σ).1, topAux_eq_top hc']
            rfl
          · rw [substBar_cons_true]
            funext a
            simp only [hang_eq]
            rw [hangAux_eq_hang ((hroot σ).trans hc'), (hσ σ).2, hangAux_eq_hang hc']
        · have hna : a ∉ (topAux l).labels := fun h' =>
            hdisj a h' (by rw [topAux_eq_top hc']; exact ha)
          have hya : hang (node d l r) a = hang r a := by
            rw [hang_eq, if_neg hna, hangAux_eq_hang hc']
          refine Or.inr ⟨a, q, by rw [hya]; exact hq, by rw [hya]; exact hsz.trans hsize,
            by rw [hya]; exact hhs, by rw [hya]; exact hhnd, ?_, fun σ => ⟨?_, ?_⟩⟩
          · simp only [top, labels_node, List.mem_append]
            right
            rw [topAux_eq_top hc']
            exact ha
          · rw [substBar_cons_true]
            simp only [top]
            rw [topAux_eq_top ((hroot σ).trans hc'), (hσ σ).1, topAux_eq_top hc']
          · rw [substBar_cons_true, hya]
            funext a'
            simp only [hang_eq, hangAux_eq_hang ((hroot σ).trans hc'), (hσ σ).2,
              Function.update_apply, hangAux_eq_hang hc']
            by_cases haa : a' = a
            · subst haa
              simp [hna]
            · simp [haa]

name: Operad.ShuffleBar.nodeL_single
statement:
lemma nodeL_single (d : E × Bool) (s t : BarTree E) (a b : K) :
    nodeL K d (Finsupp.single s a) (Finsupp.single t b) =
      Finsupp.single (node d s t) (a * b)
proof:
:= by
  simp [nodeL, Finsupp.smul_single, smul_eq_mul]

name: Operad.ShuffleBar.graftL_single
statement:
lemma graftL_single (ins : ℕ → BarTree E) :
    ∀ m : BarTree E, graftL K (fun a => Finsupp.single (ins a) 1) m = Finsupp.single (m.plug ins) 1
  | leaf _ => rfl
  | node d l r => by
    rw [graftL, graftL_single ins l, graftL_single ins r, nodeL_single, one_mul]
    rfl

name: Operad.ShuffleBar.graftL_congr
statement:
lemma graftL_congr {H H' : ℕ → (BarTree E →₀ K)} :
    ∀ {m : BarTree E}, (∀ a ∈ m.labels, H a = H' a) → graftL K H m = graftL K H' m
  | leaf a, h => h a (by simp)
  | node d l r, h => by
    rw [graftL, graftL, graftL_congr fun a ha => h a (by simp [ha]),
      graftL_congr fun a ha => h a (by simp [ha])]

name: Operad.ShuffleBar.graftL_update_sum
statement:
lemma graftL_update_sum {ι : Type*} (H : ℕ → (BarTree E →₀ K)) (a : ℕ) (t : Finset ι) (c : ι → K)
    (u : ι → (BarTree E →₀ K)) : ∀ m : BarTree E, m.labels.Nodup → a ∈ m.labels →
      graftL K (Function.update H a (∑ i ∈ t, c i • u i)) m =
        ∑ i ∈ t, c i • graftL K (Function.update H a (u i)) m
  | leaf b, _, ha => by
    simp only [labels_leaf, List.mem_singleton] at ha
    subst ha
    simp [graftL]
  | node d l r, hnd, ha => by
    have hdisj : ∀ x ∈ l.labels, x ∉ r.labels
proof:
:= fun x hx hx' =>
      ne_of_nodup_append hnd hx hx' rfl
    simp only [labels_node, List.mem_append] at ha
    rcases ha with ha | ha
    · have hr : ∀ v, graftL K (Function.update H a v) r = graftL K H r := fun v =>
        graftL_congr K fun x hx => by
          have hxa : x ≠ a := fun h => hdisj a ha (h ▸ hx)
          rw [Function.update_of_ne hxa]
      simp only [graftL, hr]
      rw [graftL_update_sum H a t c u l (List.nodup_append.1 hnd).1 ha, map_sum,
        LinearMap.coe_sum, Finset.sum_apply]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
      rw [map_smul, LinearMap.smul_apply]
    · have hl : ∀ v, graftL K (Function.update H a v) l = graftL K H l := fun v =>
        graftL_congr K fun x hx => by
          have hxa : x ≠ a := fun h => hdisj x hx (h ▸ ha)
          rw [Function.update_of_ne hxa]
      simp only [graftL, hl]
      rw [graftL_update_sum H a t c u r (List.nodup_append.1 hnd).2.1 ha, map_sum]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
      rw [map_smul]

name: Operad.ShuffleBar.graftL_update_zero
statement:
lemma graftL_update_zero (H : ℕ → (BarTree E →₀ K)) (a : ℕ) (m : BarTree E)
    (hnd : m.labels.Nodup) (ha : a ∈ m.labels) : graftL K (Function.update H a 0) m = 0
proof:
:= by
  have := graftL_update_sum K H a (∅ : Finset ℕ) (fun _ => 0) (fun _ => 0) m hnd ha
  simpa using this

name: Operad.ShuffleBar.mem_edgeWins_left
statement:
lemma mem_edgeWins_left {d : E × Bool} {l r : BarTree E} {kw : (ℕ ×ₗ ℕ) × LTree E}
    (h : kw ∈ (l.mapDec Prod.fst).edgeWins) : kw ∈ ((node d l r).mapDec Prod.fst).edgeWins
proof:
:= by
  simp only [mapDec_node, edgeWins, List.mem_append]
  exact Or.inl (Or.inr h)

name: Operad.ShuffleBar.mem_edgeWins_right
statement:
lemma mem_edgeWins_right {d : E × Bool} {l r : BarTree E} {kw : (ℕ ×ₗ ℕ) × LTree E}
    (h : kw ∈ (r.mapDec Prod.fst).edgeWins) : kw ∈ ((node d l r).mapDec Prod.fst).edgeWins
proof:
:= by
  simp only [mapDec_node, edgeWins, List.mem_append]
  exact Or.inr h

name: Operad.ShuffleBar.NormalBar.left
statement:
lemma NormalBar.left {d : E × Bool} {l r : BarTree E} (hnd : (node d l r).labels.Nodup)
    (h : NormalBar L (node d l r)) : NormalBar L l
proof:
:= by
  rintro ⟨k, w⟩ hkw hc
  have hk := (mem_edgeWins_key _ hkw).1
  rw [nodeKeys_mapDec] at hk
  refine h (k, w) (mem_edgeWins_left hkw) fun hc' => ?_
  rw [cutKeys, Finset.mem_union, Finset.mem_union] at hc'
  rcases hc' with hc' | hc' | hc'
  · split_ifs at hc'
    · exact key_not_mem_left d l r (Finset.mem_singleton.1 hc' ▸ hk)
    · simp at hc'
  · exact hc hc'
  · exact Finset.disjoint_left.1 (disjoint_nodeKeys hnd) hk (cutKeys_subset r hc')

name: Operad.ShuffleBar.NormalBar.right
statement:
lemma NormalBar.right {d : E × Bool} {l r : BarTree E} (hnd : (node d l r).labels.Nodup)
    (h : NormalBar L (node d l r)) : NormalBar L r
proof:
:= by
  rintro ⟨k, w⟩ hkw hc
  have hk := (mem_edgeWins_key _ hkw).1
  rw [nodeKeys_mapDec] at hk
  refine h (k, w) (mem_edgeWins_right hkw) fun hc' => ?_
  rw [cutKeys, Finset.mem_union, Finset.mem_union] at hc'
  rcases hc' with hc' | hc' | hc'
  · split_ifs at hc'
    · exact key_not_mem_right d l r (Finset.mem_singleton.1 hc' ▸ hk)
    · simp at hc'
  · exact Finset.disjoint_left.1 (disjoint_nodeKeys hnd) (cutKeys_subset l hc') hk
  · exact hc hc'

name: Operad.ShuffleBar.key_not_mem_cutKeys_left
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  rw [cutKeys, Finset.mem_union, Finset.mem_union] at h
  rcases h with h | h | h
  · split_ifs at h
    · exact key_not_mem_left d (node d' a b) r
        (Finset.mem_singleton.1 h ▸ by simp [nodeKeys])
    · simp at h
  · rw [cutKeys, if_neg (by simp [hd]), Finset.empty_union, Finset.mem_union] at h
    rcases h with h | h
    · exact key_not_mem_left d' a b (cutKeys_subset a h)
    · exact key_not_mem_right d' a b (cutKeys_subset b h)
  · exact Finset.disjoint_left.1 (disjoint_nodeKeys hnd) (by simp [nodeKeys]) (cutKeys_subset r h)

name: Operad.ShuffleBar.key_not_mem_cutKeys_right
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  rw [cutKeys, Finset.mem_union, Finset.mem_union] at h
  rcases h with h | h | h
  · split_ifs at h
    · exact key_not_mem_right d l (node d' a b)
        (Finset.mem_singleton.1 h ▸ by simp [nodeKeys])
    · simp at h
  · exact Finset.disjoint_left.1 (disjoint_nodeKeys hnd) (cutKeys_subset l h) (by simp [nodeKeys])
  · rw [cutKeys, if_neg (by simp [hd]), Finset.empty_union, Finset.mem_union] at h
    rcases h with h | h
    · exact key_not_mem_left d' a b (cutKeys_subset a h)
    · exact key_not_mem_right d' a b (cutKeys_subset b h)

name: Operad.ShuffleBar.isNormal_topAux
statement:
lemma isNormal_topAux {t : BarTree E} (ih : rootFlag t = false → IsNormal L (top t)) :
    IsNormal L (topAux t)
proof:
:= by
  cases t with
  | leaf => exact fun w hw => by simp [topAux, windows] at hw
  | node d' a b =>
    by_cases hd : d'.2
    · rw [topAux_cut hd]
      exact fun w hw => by simp [windows] at hw
    · have hd' : d'.2 = false := by simpa using hd
      rw [topAux_of_flag hd']
      exact ih hd'

name: Operad.ShuffleBar.isNormal_top
statement:
theorem isNormal_top : ∀ y : BarTree E, y.labels.Nodup → NormalBar L y → IsNormal L (top y)
  | leaf _, _, _ => fun w hw => by simp [top, windows] at hw
  | node d l r, hnd, h => by
    have hnl
proof:
:= (List.nodup_append.1 hnd).1
    have hnr := (List.nodup_append.1 hnd).2.1
    have hl : IsNormal L (topAux l) :=
      isNormal_topAux L fun _ => isNormal_top l hnl (NormalBar.left L hnd h)
    have hr : IsNormal L (topAux r) :=
      isNormal_topAux L fun _ => isNormal_top r hnr (NormalBar.right L hnd h)
    intro w hw
    simp only [top, windows, List.mem_append] at hw
    rcases hw with ((hw | hw) | hw) | hw
    · cases l with
      | leaf => simp [topAux] at hw
      | node d' a b =>
        by_cases hd : d'.2
        · simp [topAux, hd] at hw
        · have hd' : d'.2 = false := by simpa using hd
          obtain rfl : w = window d.1 d'.1 false a.minLabel b.minLabel r.minLabel := by
            simpa [topAux, hd'] using hw
          refine h (key (node d' a b), window d.1 d'.1 false a.minLabel b.minLabel r.minLabel)
            ?_ (key_not_mem_cutKeys_left hnd hd')
          simp [edgeWins, key_node]
    · cases r with
      | leaf => cases topAux l <;> simp [topAux] at hw
      | node d' a b =>
        by_cases hd : d'.2
        · cases topAux l <;> simp [topAux, hd] at hw
        · have hd' : d'.2 = false := by simpa using hd
          obtain rfl : w = window d.1 d'.1 true a.minLabel b.minLabel l.minLabel := by
            cases hl' : topAux l <;> simp [topAux, hd', hl'] at hw <;>
              simpa [← minLabel_topAux l, hl'] using hw
          refine h (key (node d' a b), window d.1 d'.1 true a.minLabel b.minLabel l.minLabel)
            ?_ (key_not_mem_cutKeys_right hnd hd')
          cases l <;> simp [edgeWins, key_node]
    · exact hl w hw
    · exact hr w hw
  termination_by y => y.size
  decreasing_by all_goals (simp only [size_node]; omega)

name: Operad.ShuffleBar.hangAux_props
statement:
lemma hangAux_props : ∀ (y : BarTree E) (a : ℕ), y.IsShuffle → y.labels.Nodup → NormalBar L y →
    (hangAux y a).IsShuffle ∧ (hangAux y a).labels.Nodup ∧ NormalBar L (hangAux y a)
  | leaf _, a, _, _, _ => ⟨trivial, by simp [hangAux], fun kw hkw => by
      simp [hangAux, edgeWins] at hkw⟩
  | node d l r, a, hs, hnd, h => by
    simp only [hangAux]
    split_ifs
    · exact ⟨hs, hnd, h⟩
    · exact ⟨trivial, by simp, fun kw hkw => by simp [edgeWins] at hkw⟩
    · exact hangAux_props l a hs.2.1 (List.nodup_append.1 hnd).1 (NormalBar.left L hnd h)
    · exact hangAux_props r a hs.2.2 (List.nodup_append.1 hnd).2.1 (NormalBar.right L hnd h)

name: Operad.ShuffleBar.hang_props
statement:
lemma hang_props (y : BarTree E) (a : ℕ) (hs : y.IsShuffle) (hnd : y.labels.Nodup)
    (h : NormalBar L y) :
    (hang y a).IsShuffle ∧ (hang y a).labels.Nodup ∧ NormalBar L (hang y a)
proof:
:= by
  cases y with
  | leaf => exact ⟨trivial, by simp [hang], fun kw hkw => by simp [hang, edgeWins] at hkw⟩
  | node d l r =>
    simp only [hang]
    split_ifs
    · exact hangAux_props L l a hs.2.1 (List.nodup_append.1 hnd).1 (NormalBar.left L hnd h)
    · exact hangAux_props L r a hs.2.2 (List.nodup_append.1 hnd).2.1
        (NormalBar.right L hnd h)

name: Operad.ShuffleBar.Φ_node
statement:
lemma Φ_node (d : E × Bool) (l r : BarTree E) :
    Φ K G (node d l r) = Finsupp.linearCombination K
      (fun m => graftL K (fun a => Φ K G (hang (node d l r) a)) (liftW d.2 m))
      (nfOf G.compl (top (node d l r)))
proof:
:= by
  rw [Φ]

name: Operad.ShuffleBar.Φ_of_normal
statement:
theorem Φ_of_normal : ∀ (n : ℕ) (y : BarTree E), y.size ≤ n → y.IsShuffle → y.labels.Nodup →
    NormalBar L y → Φ K G y = Finsupp.single y 1
  | 0, y, hy, _, _, _ => absurd hy (by cases y <;> simp)
  | _ + 1, leaf a, _, _, _, _ => by rw [Φ]
  | n + 1, node d l r, hy, hs, hnd, h => by
    rw [Φ_node, nfOf_of_isNormal G.compl (isShuffle_top hs) (nodup_top hnd)
      (isNormal_top L _ hnd h), Finsupp.linearCombination_single, one_smul]
    have hsub : ∀ a, Φ K G (hang (node d l r) a) = Finsupp.single (hang (node d l r) a) 1
proof:
:=
      fun a => by
        obtain ⟨h1, h2, h3⟩ := hang_props L (node d l r) a hs hnd h
        exact Φ_of_normal n _ (by have := size_hang_lt d l r a; omega) h1 h2 h3
    rw [graftL_congr K (fun a _ => hsub a), graftL_single]
    congr 1
    exact plug_top (node d l r) hnd

name: Operad.ShuffleBar.Φ_substRel
statement:
theorem Φ_substRel : ∀ (n : ℕ) (y : BarTree E), y.size ≤ n → y.IsShuffle → y.labels.Nodup →
    ∀ {p : List Bool} {s : Bool}, IsUncut y p s → ∀ {r : Mono E 3 → K}, r ∈ R →
      ΦL K G (substRel K y p s r) = 0
  | 0, y, hy, _, _, _, _, _, _, _ => absurd hy (by cases y <;> simp)
  | n + 1, y, hy, hs, hnd, p, s, h, r, hr => by
    obtain ⟨d, l', r', hy'⟩ : ∃ d l r, y = node d l r
proof:
:= by
      cases y with
      | leaf => exact absurd h.1 (by cases p <;> cases s <;> simp [IsEdge, subtreeAt, IsEdgeRoot])
      | node d l r => exact ⟨d, l, r, rfl⟩
    have hnode : ∀ σ : Mono E 3, ∃ d' l'' r'', substBar y p s σ.1 = node d' l'' r'' := by
      intro σ
      have := rootFlag_substBar hs hnd h (mono_shape σ).2.2
      cases hz : substBar y p s σ.1 with
      | leaf a =>
        exfalso
        have hl := perm_labels_substBar hs hnd h (mono_shape σ).2.1
        rw [hz, hy'] at hl
        have := hl.length_eq
        simp only [labels_leaf, List.length_singleton, labels_node, List.length_append,
          length_labels] at this
        have := arity_pos l'
        have := arity_pos r'
        omega
      | node d' l'' r'' => exact ⟨d', l'', r'', rfl⟩
    have hΦ : ∀ σ : Mono E 3, Φ K G (substBar y p s σ.1) = Finsupp.linearCombination K
        (fun m => graftL K (fun a => Φ K G (hang (substBar y p s σ.1) a)) (liftW (rootFlag y) m))
        (nfOf G.compl (top (substBar y p s σ.1))) := fun σ => by
      obtain ⟨d', l'', r'', hz⟩ := hnode σ
      have hroot := rootFlag_substBar hs hnd h (mono_shape σ).2.2
      rw [← hroot, hz, Φ_node]
      rfl
    simp only [ΦL, substRel, map_sum, map_smul, Finsupp.linearCombination_single, one_smul, hΦ]
    rcases top_hang_substBar p y s hs hnd h with ⟨hte, hσ⟩ | ⟨a, q, hq, hsz, hhs, hhnd, ha, hσ⟩
    · 
      simp only [fun σ => (hσ σ).1, fun σ => (hσ σ).2]
      set lc := Finsupp.linearCombination K
        (fun m => graftL K (fun a => Φ K G (hang y a)) (liftW (rootFlag y) m)) with hlc
      have : ∑ σ : Mono E 3, r σ • lc (nfOf G.compl ((top y).substAt p s σ.1)) =
          lc (∑ σ : Mono E 3, r σ • nfOf G.compl ((top y).substAt p s σ.1)) := by
        rw [map_sum]
        simp [map_smul]
      rw [this, sum_nfOf_substAt G.compl (isShuffle_top hs) (nodup_top hnd) hte hr, map_zero]
    · 
      simp only [fun σ => (hσ σ).1, fun σ => (hσ σ).2, Finsupp.linearCombination_apply,
        Finsupp.sum, Finset.smul_sum]
      rw [Finset.sum_comm]
      refine Finset.sum_eq_zero fun m hm => ?_
      obtain ⟨-, hml, -⟩ := mem_support_nfOf G.compl (nodup_top hnd) hm
      have hmnd : (liftW (rootFlag y) m).labels.Nodup := by
        rw [labels_liftW]
        exact hml.nodup_iff.2 (nodup_top hnd)
      have hma : a ∈ (liftW (rootFlag y) m).labels := by
        rw [labels_liftW]
        exact hml.symm.subset ha
      have hcomp : ∀ σ : Mono E 3, (fun b => Φ K G (Function.update (hang y) a
          (substBar (hang y a) q s σ.1) b)) =
          Function.update (fun b => Φ K G (hang y b)) a (Φ K G (substBar (hang y a) q s σ.1)) :=
        fun σ => by
          funext b
          by_cases hb : b = a
          · subst hb
            simp
          · simp [hb]
      simp only [hcomp]
      simp only [smul_comm (r _) ((nfOf G.compl (top y)) m)]
      rw [← Finset.smul_sum]
      rw [← graftL_update_sum K _ a Finset.univ r (fun σ => Φ K G (substBar (hang y a) q s σ.1))
        _ hmnd hma]
      have h0 : ∑ σ : Mono E 3, r σ • Φ K G (substBar (hang y a) q s σ.1) = 0 := by
        have := Φ_substRel n (hang y a) (by omega) hhs hhnd hq hr
        simpa [ΦL, substRel, map_sum, map_smul] using this
      rw [h0, graftL_update_zero K _ a _ hmnd hma, smul_zero]

name: Operad.ShuffleBar.map_mem_of_supported
proof:
:= by
  rw [Finsupp.supported_eq_span_single] at hv
  induction hv using Submodule.span_induction with
  | mem x hx =>
    obtain ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩ := hx
    exact h y hy
  | zero => simp
  | add x y _ _ hx hy => rw [map_add]; exact add_mem hx hy
  | smul c x _ hx => rw [map_smul]; exact P.smul_mem c hx

name: Operad.ShuffleBar.mem_of_supported
proof:
:=
  map_mem_of_supported K LinearMap.id h hv

name: Operad.ShuffleBar.Adm.mergeK
statement:
lemma Adm.mergeK {n s : ℕ} {x : BarTree E} (hx : Adm n (s + 1) x) {k : ℕ ×ₗ ℕ}
    (hk : k ∈ cutKeys x) : Adm n s (mergeK x k)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨hx.1.mergeK k, by simpa using hx.2.1, ?_⟩
  rw [cutKeys_mergeK x hx.1.nodup hk, Finset.card_erase_of_mem hk]
  have := hx.2.2
  have : 0 < (cutKeys x).card := Finset.card_pos.2 ⟨k, hk⟩
  omega

name: Operad.ShuffleBar.d_mem_C
statement: lemma d_mem_C {n s : ℕ} {v : BarTree E →₀ K} (hv : v ∈ C K n (s + 1)) : d K v ∈ C K n s
proof:
:= by
  refine map_mem_of_supported K (d K) (fun y hy => ?_) hv
  rw [d_single, one_smul, dTree]
  exact Submodule.sum_mem _ fun k hk => Submodule.smul_mem _ _
    (Finsupp.single_mem_supported K _ (Adm.mergeK hy hk))

name: Operad.ShuffleBar.full_mem_monomials
statement:
lemma full_mem_monomials {n s : ℕ} {x : BarTree E} (hx : Adm n s x) :
    x.mapDec Prod.fst ∈ monomials n
proof:
:=
  (mem_monomials _ _).2 ⟨(isShuffle_mapDec _ x).2 hx.1.shuffle, by simpa using hx.2.1⟩

name: Operad.ShuffleBar.lev_pos
statement: lemma lev_pos {n s : ℕ} {x : BarTree E} (hx : Adm n s x) : 0 < G.lev n x
proof:
:=
  G.lv_pos (full_mem_monomials hx)

name: Operad.ShuffleBar.reduce
statement:
theorem reduce (n s : ℕ) : ∀ (N : ℕ) (y : BarTree E), G.lev n y ≤ N → Adm n s y →
    ¬ NormalBar L y → Finsupp.single y (1 : K) ∈
      Finsupp.supported K K {z | z ∈ Nrm L n s ∧ G.lev n z < G.lev n y} ⊔ J K R
  | 0, y, hN, hy, _ => absurd (lev_pos K G hy) (by omega)
  | N + 1, y, hN, hy, hn => by
    obtain ⟨⟨k, w⟩, hkw, hkc, hwL⟩ : ∃ kw ∈ (y.mapDec Prod.fst).edgeWins, kw.1 ∉ cutKeys y ∧
        kw.2 ∈ L
proof:
:= by
      unfold NormalBar at hn
      push Not at hn
      exact hn
    obtain ⟨p, s', he, hk, hw⟩ := exists_of_mem_edgeWins _ hkw
    have hs := hy.1.shuffle
    have hnd := hy.1.nodup
    have hfull := full_mem_monomials hy
    have hu : IsUncut y p s' := by
      refine ⟨(isEdge_mapDec _ y p s').1 he, ?_⟩
      by_contra hf
      obtain ⟨d', a, b, hab⟩ : ∃ d' a b, y.subtreeAt (p ++ [s']) = node d' a b := by
        have := (isEdge_mapDec _ y p s').1 he
        unfold IsEdge at this
        rw [subtreeAt_append]
        cases hsub : y.subtreeAt p with
        | leaf => rw [hsub] at this; exact absurd this (by cases s' <;> simp [IsEdgeRoot])
        | node d0 l0 r0 =>
          rw [hsub] at this
          cases s' with
          | false =>
            cases l0 with
            | leaf => exact absurd this (by simp [IsEdgeRoot])
            | node d1 a1 b1 => exact ⟨d1, a1, b1, rfl⟩
          | true =>
            cases r0 with
            | leaf => exact absurd this (by cases l0 <;> simp [IsEdgeRoot])
            | node d1 a1 b1 => exact ⟨d1, a1, b1, rfl⟩
      have hflag : d'.2 = true := by
        simpa [flagAt, hab, rootFlag] using hf
      have := key_mem_cutKeys y (p ++ [s']) d' a b hab hflag
      rw [← hab, ← key_mapDec Prod.fst, ← subtreeAt_mapDec, hk] at this
      exact hkc this
    obtain ⟨r, hr, w', hw'w, hrw, hlt⟩ := G.lead hfull he (by rw [hw]; exact hwL)
    rw [hw] at hw'w
    have hself : substBar y p s' w'.1 = y := by
      rw [hw'w, substBar, ← hw, ← windowAt_of_uncut hu]
      exact substAt_windowAt hu.1 hs hnd
    have hJ : substRel K y p s' r ∈ J K R := Submodule.subset_span ⟨y, p, s', r, hy.1, hu, hr, rfl⟩
    have hsplit : substRel K y p s' r = r w' • Finsupp.single y 1 +
        ∑ σ ∈ Finset.univ.erase w', r σ • Finsupp.single (substBar y p s' σ.1) 1 := by
      rw [substRel, ← Finset.add_sum_erase _ _ (Finset.mem_univ w'), hself]
    
    have hlow : ∀ σ ∈ Finset.univ.erase w', r σ • Finsupp.single (substBar y p s' σ.1) (1 : K) ∈
        Finsupp.supported K K {z | z ∈ Nrm L n s ∧ G.lev n z < G.lev n y} ⊔ J K R := by
      intro σ hσ
      by_cases hrσ : r σ = 0
      · simp [hrσ]
      refine Submodule.smul_mem _ _ ?_
      have hσne : σ ≠ w' := (Finset.mem_erase.1 hσ).1
      obtain ⟨-, hσp, hσn⟩ := mono_shape σ
      have hadm : Adm n s (substBar y p s' σ.1) :=
        ⟨hy.1.substBar hu σ, (perm_labels_substBar hs hnd hu hσp).trans hy.2.1,
          by rw [cutKeys_substBar hs hnd hu hσp hσn]; exact hy.2.2⟩
      have hlev : G.lev n (substBar y p s' σ.1) < G.lev n y := by
        show G.lv n ((substBar y p s' σ.1).mapDec Prod.fst) < G.lv n (y.mapDec Prod.fst)
        rw [full_substBar hu.1]
        exact hlt σ hσne hrσ
      by_cases hσN : NormalBar L (substBar y p s' σ.1)
      · exact Submodule.mem_sup_left (Finsupp.single_mem_supported K _ ⟨⟨hadm, hσN⟩, hlev⟩)
      · have := reduce n s N _ (by omega) hadm hσN
        refine (sup_le_sup_right (Finsupp.supported_mono fun z hz => ?_) _) this
        exact ⟨hz.1, hz.2.trans hlev⟩
    have : Finsupp.single y (1 : K) = (r w')⁻¹ • substRel K y p s' r -
        (r w')⁻¹ • ∑ σ ∈ Finset.univ.erase w', r σ • Finsupp.single (substBar y p s' σ.1) 1 := by
      rw [hsplit, smul_add, smul_smul, inv_mul_cancel₀ hrw, one_smul, add_sub_cancel_right]
    rw [this]
    refine Submodule.sub_mem _ (Submodule.mem_sup_right (Submodule.smul_mem _ _ hJ))
      (Submodule.smul_mem _ _ (Submodule.sum_mem _ hlow))

name: Operad.ShuffleBar.single_mem_sup
statement:
theorem single_mem_sup {n s : ℕ} {y : BarTree E} (hy : Adm n s y) :
    Finsupp.single y (1 : K) ∈ Finsupp.supported K K (Nrm L n s) ⊔ J K R
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hN : NormalBar L y
  · exact Submodule.mem_sup_left (Finsupp.single_mem_supported K _ ⟨hy, hN⟩)
  · exact (sup_le_sup_right (Finsupp.supported_mono fun z hz => hz.1) _)
      (reduce K G n s _ y le_rfl hy hN)

name: Operad.ShuffleBar.mem_sup_of_C
statement:
lemma mem_sup_of_C {n s : ℕ} {v : BarTree E →₀ K} (hv : v ∈ C K n s) :
    v ∈ Finsupp.supported K K (Nrm L n s) ⊔ J K R
proof:
:=
  mem_of_supported K (fun _ hy => single_mem_sup K G hy) hv

name: Operad.ShuffleBar.ΦL_J
statement: lemma ΦL_J {v : BarTree E →₀ K} (hv : v ∈ J K R) : ΦL K G v = 0
proof:
:= by
  induction hv using Submodule.span_induction with
  | mem v hv =>
    obtain ⟨x, p, s, r, hx, h, hr, rfl⟩ := hv
    exact Φ_substRel K G x.size x le_rfl hx.shuffle hx.nodup h hr
  | zero => simp
  | add x y _ _ hx hy => rw [map_add, hx, hy, add_zero]
  | smul c x _ hx => rw [map_smul, hx, smul_zero]

name: Operad.ShuffleBar.ΦL_normal
statement:
lemma ΦL_normal {n s : ℕ} {v : BarTree E →₀ K} (hv : v ∈ Finsupp.supported K K (Nrm L n s)) :
    ΦL K G v = v
proof:
:= by
  have : ∀ v ∈ Finsupp.supported K K (Nrm L n s), ΦL K G v - v ∈ (⊥ : Submodule K _) :=
    fun v hv => by
      have := map_mem_of_supported K (P := ⊥) (ΦL K G - LinearMap.id) (fun y hy => by
        simp only [LinearMap.sub_apply, LinearMap.id_apply, Submodule.mem_bot, ΦL,
