  refine Eq.trans ?_ (congrArg (fun z => -(σ R (!(Tree.tpar (grGenPar R V)
    (treeOf (SetOperad.comp r₁ p₁ q₁)))) * σ R (cSgn (grGenPar R V) (Sum.inl ⟨u, Ne.symm hu⟩)
      (SetOperad.comp r₁ p₁ q₁) t₂)) • z) (map_trans_smul (parEquiv hu B₁ B).symm
        (compEquiv e₁ (Equiv.refl B) (Sum.inl ⟨u, Ne.symm hu⟩)) _ _).symm)
  refine Eq.trans ?_ (smul_smul _ _ _).symm
  congr 1
  rw [tpar_comp, tpar_comp]
  exact sgn_outer_inl _ _ _ _ _ _ _ (cSgn_par (grGenPar R V) hu p₁ q₁ t₂)

name: Operad.Cobar.mM_repI_ιL
statement:
lemma mM_repI_ιL {A₁ B₁ : Type} [Fintype A₁] [DecidableEq A₁] [Fintype B₁] [DecidableEq B₁]
    (r : A₁) (p : Reg (TreeOfArity (GrGen R V)) A₁) (q : Reg (TreeOfArity (GrGen R V)) B₁)
    (e : Without A₁ r ⊕ B₁ ≃ A) (hp : (treeOf p).isLeaf = false)
    (hq : (treeOf q).isLeaf = false) (j : A) (t₂ : Reg (TreeOfArity (GrGen R V)) B)
    (h₂ : (treeOf t₂).isLeaf = false) {t₁ : Reg (TreeOfArity (GrGen R V)) A}
    (he : SetOperad.map e (SetOperad.comp r p q) = t₁) {k : ℕ} (hk : vert r p = k) :
    mM R V j (repI R V e p q) (Cobar.ιL R 𝒞 B ((𝒥).proj B (𝔟 t₂)))
      = -(σ R (!(Tree.tpar (grGenPar R V) (treeOf t₁))) * σ R (cSgn (grGenPar R V) j t₁ t₂)) •
        starI R V (SetOperad.comp j t₁ t₂)
          (k + if vert j t₁ ≤ k then (treeOf t₂).weight else 0)
proof:
:= by
  subst he hk
  obtain ⟨j', rfl⟩ := e.surjective j
  rw [cSgn_map_left]
  rcases j' with ⟨u, hu⟩ | w
  · refine (mM_repI_ιL_inl (Ne.symm hu) p q e t₂ hp h₂).trans ?_
    have hst2 := starI_eq (R := R) (V := V) (map_parRel (B := B) (Ne.symm hu) e p q t₂) hq
    rw [vert_comp_inl] at hst2
    have hif : (if vert (e (Sum.inl ⟨u, hu⟩)) (SetOperad.map e (SetOperad.comp r p q)) ≤ vert r p
        then (treeOf t₂).weight else 0)
        = (if p.1.rank u < p.1.rank r then (treeOf t₂).weight else 0) := by
      rcases p.1.total u r hu with h | h
      · rw [if_pos (vert_le_of_inl_lt rfl hu (e.symm_apply_apply _) h),
          if_pos (p.1.rank_lt_rank h)]
      · rw [if_neg (not_le.2 (vert_lt_of_inl_gt rfl hq hu (e.symm_apply_apply _) h)),
          if_neg (not_lt.2 (p.1.rank_lt_rank h).le)]
    exact (congrArg _ ((congrArg (fun n => starI R V _ (vert r p + n)) hif).trans hst2)).symm
  · refine (mM_repI_ιL_inr r p q e w t₂ hq h₂).trans ?_
    have hq' : (treeOf (SetOperad.comp w q t₂)).isLeaf = false := by
      rw [treeOf_comp]
      exact Tree.isLeaf_graft_left hq _ _
    have hst2 := starI_eq (R := R) (V := V) (map_seqRel' (B := B) r w e p q t₂) hq'
    have hlt := vert_lt_of_inr (rfl : SetOperad.map e (SetOperad.comp r p q) = _) hq
      (j := e (Sum.inr w)) (b := w) (e.symm_apply_apply _)
    have hne : ¬ vert (e (Sum.inr w)) (SetOperad.map e (SetOperad.comp r p q)) ≤ vert r p := by
      omega
    have h3 : (vert r p + if vert (e (Sum.inr w)) (SetOperad.map e (SetOperad.comp r p q))
        ≤ vert r p then (treeOf t₂).weight else 0) = vert r p := by
      rw [if_neg hne, Nat.add_zero]
    rw [treeOf_map]
    exact (congrArg _ ((congrArg (starI R V _) h3).trans hst2)).symm

name: Operad.Cobar.mM_starI_ιL
statement:
theorem mM_starI_ιL (j : A) (t₁ : Reg (TreeOfArity (GrGen R V)) A)
    (t₂ : Reg (TreeOfArity (GrGen R V)) B) (h₂ : (treeOf t₂).isLeaf = false) {k : ℕ}
    (hk : k ∈ Finset.Ico 1 (treeOf t₁).weight) :
    mM R V j (starI R V t₁ k) (Cobar.ιL R 𝒞 B ((𝒥).proj B (𝔟 t₂)))
      = -(σ R (!(Tree.tpar (grGenPar R V) (treeOf t₁))) * σ R (cSgn (grGenPar R V) j t₁ t₂)) •
          starI R V (SetOperad.comp j t₁ t₂)
            (k + if vert j t₁ ≤ k then (treeOf t₂).weight else 0)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Finset.mem_Ico] at hk
  obtain ⟨e, he⟩ := exists_rep t₁ hk.2
  have hst := starI_eq (R := R) (V := V) he (Tree.isLeaf_cutV _ _ hk.2)
  have hvert : vert (⟨((treeOf t₁).cutV k).2.2, Tree.lt_arity_cutV _ k hk.2⟩ :
      Fin ((treeOf t₁).cutV k).1.arity) (stdT ((treeOf t₁).cutV k).1) = k := by
    show (treeOf (stdT _)).vb ((stdT _).1.rank _) = k
    rw [treeOf_stdT, rank_stdT]
    exact Tree.vb_cutV _ _ hk.2
  rw [hvert] at hst
  exact (congrArg (fun z => mM R V j z (Cobar.ιL R 𝒞 B ((𝒥).proj B (𝔟 t₂)))) hst).trans
    (mM_repI_ιL _ (stdT ((treeOf t₁).cutV k).1) (stdT ((treeOf t₁).cutV k).2.1) e
      (Tree.isLeaf_cutV_fst hk.1 hk.2 rfl) (Tree.isLeaf_cutV _ _ hk.2) j t₂ h₂ he hvert)

name: Operad.Cobar.sgn_root
statement: lemma sgn_root (x c : Bool) : σ R (!x) * σ R c * (σ R c * σ R x) = -1
proof:
:= by
  cases x <;> cases c <;> simp

name: Operad.Cobar.d_mM_ιL_bas
statement:
theorem d_mM_ιL_bas (j : A) (t₁ : Reg (TreeOfArity (GrGen R V)) A)
    (t₂ : Reg (TreeOfArity (GrGen R V)) B) (h₁ : (treeOf t₁).isLeaf = false)
    (h₂ : (treeOf t₂).isLeaf = false) (hn₁ : (treeOf t₁).NoNull) (hn₂ : (treeOf t₂).NoNull) :
    (Cobar.d R 𝒞).app _ (mM R V j (Cobar.ιL R 𝒞 A ((𝒥).proj A (𝔟 t₁)))
        (Cobar.ιL R 𝒞 B ((𝒥).proj B (𝔟 t₂))))
      + mM R V j ((Cobar.d R 𝒞).app A (Cobar.ιL R 𝒞 A ((𝒥).proj A (𝔟 t₁))))
          (Cobar.ιL R 𝒞 B ((𝒥).proj B (𝔟 t₂)))
      + mM R V j (GrOperad.tw (R := R) true (Cobar.ιL R 𝒞 A ((𝒥).proj A (𝔟 t₁))))
          ((Cobar.d R 𝒞).app B (Cobar.ιL R 𝒞 B ((𝒥).proj B (𝔟 t₂))))
      = GrOperad.comp (R := R) j (Cobar.ιL R 𝒞 A ((𝒥).proj A (𝔟 t₁)))
          (Cobar.ιL R 𝒞 B ((𝒥).proj B (𝔟 t₂)))
proof:
:= by
  have hw : (treeOf (SetOperad.comp j t₁ t₂)).weight
      = (treeOf t₁).weight + (treeOf t₂).weight := by
    rw [treeOf_comp]
    exact Tree.weight_graft _ _ _ (rank_lt_arity t₁ j)
  have hn : (treeOf (SetOperad.comp j t₁ t₂)).NoNull := (noNull_comp j t₁ t₂).2 ⟨hn₁, hn₂⟩
  have hd := d_ιL_bas (R := R) (V := V) (SetOperad.comp j t₁ t₂) hn
  rw [hw] at hd
  have hi := (congrArg ((Cobar.d R 𝒞).app _) (mM_ιL_bas j t₁ t₂ h₁ h₂)).trans
    ((map_smul _ _ _).trans (congrArg (fun z =>
      (σ R (!(Tree.tpar (grGenPar R V) (treeOf t₁))) * σ R (cSgn (grGenPar R V) j t₁ t₂)) • z)
        hd))
  have hii : mM R V j ((Cobar.d R 𝒞).app A (Cobar.ιL R 𝒞 A ((𝒥).proj A (𝔟 t₁))))
        (Cobar.ιL R 𝒞 B ((𝒥).proj B (𝔟 t₂)))
      = (σ R (!(Tree.tpar (grGenPar R V) (treeOf t₁))) * σ R (cSgn (grGenPar R V) j t₁ t₂)) •
          ∑ k ∈ Finset.Ico 1 (treeOf t₁).weight, starI R V (SetOperad.comp j t₁ t₂)
            (k + if vert j t₁ ≤ k then (treeOf t₂).weight else 0) := by
    refine (congrArg (fun z => mM R V j z (Cobar.ιL R 𝒞 B ((𝒥).proj B (𝔟 t₂))))
      (d_ιL_bas t₁ hn₁)).trans ?_
    refine (bilin_neg_sum_left (mM R V j) _ _ _).trans ?_
    refine Eq.trans ?_ (neg_sum_neg_smul _ _ _)
    exact congrArg Neg.neg (Finset.sum_congr rfl fun k hk => mM_starI_ιL j t₁ t₂ h₂ hk)
  have hiii : mM R V j (GrOperad.tw (R := R) true (Cobar.ιL R 𝒞 A ((𝒥).proj A (𝔟 t₁))))
        ((Cobar.d R 𝒞).app B (Cobar.ιL R 𝒞 B ((𝒥).proj B (𝔟 t₂))))
      = (σ R (!(Tree.tpar (grGenPar R V) (treeOf t₁))) * σ R (cSgn (grGenPar R V) j t₁ t₂)) •
          ∑ k ∈ Finset.Ico 1 (treeOf t₂).weight,
            starI R V (SetOperad.comp j t₁ t₂) (vert j t₁ + k) := by
    have htw : GrOperad.tw (R := R) true (Cobar.ιL R 𝒞 A ((𝒥).proj A (𝔟 t₁)))
        = σ R (true && !(Tree.tpar (grGenPar R V) (treeOf t₁))) •
            Cobar.ιL R 𝒞 A ((𝒥).proj A (𝔟 t₁)) :=
      GrOperad.tw_hom true (par_ιL_bas t₁)
    refine (congrArg₂ (fun z y => mM R V j z y) htw (d_ιL_bas t₂ hn₂)).trans ?_
    refine (LinearMap.map_smul₂ _ _ _ _).trans ?_
    refine (congrArg _ (bilin_neg_sum_right (mM R V j) _ _ _)).trans ?_
    refine (congrArg _ (congrArg Neg.neg
      (Finset.sum_congr rfl fun k hk => mM_ιL_starI j t₁ t₂ h₁ hk))).trans ?_
    refine (congrArg _ (neg_sum_neg_smul _ _ _)).trans ?_
    exact smul_smul _ _ _
  have hiv : starI R V (SetOperad.comp j t₁ t₂) (vert j t₁)
      = (σ R (cSgn (grGenPar R V) j t₁ t₂) * σ R (Tree.tpar (grGenPar R V) (treeOf t₁))) •
          GrOperad.comp (R := R) j (Cobar.ιL R 𝒞 A ((𝒥).proj A (𝔟 t₁)))
            (Cobar.ιL R 𝒞 B ((𝒥).proj B (𝔟 t₂))) :=
    (starI_eq (R := R) (V := V) (SetOperad.map_refl (SetOperad.comp j t₁ t₂)) h₂).trans
      (GrOperad.map_refl _)
  refine (congrArg₂ (· + ·) (congrArg₂ (· + ·) hi hii) hiii).trans ?_
  exact combine_cuts (Tree.one_le_vb h₁ _) (Tree.vb_le_weight _ _) (Tree.one_le_weight h₂)
    (fun k => starI R V (SetOperad.comp j t₁ t₂) k) _ _ (sgn_root _ _) _ hiv

name: Operad.PermElt.snocAdj_inl_inl
statement:
@[simp] lemma snocAdj_inl_inl (k : ℕ) (c : C) :
    snocAdj C k (Sum.inl (Sum.inl c)) = Sum.inl c
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.PermElt.snocAdj_inl_inr
statement:
@[simp] lemma snocAdj_inl_inr (k : ℕ) (j : Fin k) :
    snocAdj C k (Sum.inl (Sum.inr j)) = Sum.inr j.castSucc
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.PermElt.snocAdj_inr
statement:
@[simp] lemma snocAdj_inr (k : ℕ) (u : Unit) :
    snocAdj C k (Sum.inr u) = Sum.inr (Fin.last k)
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.PermElt.nu_assoc
statement:
lemma nu_assoc (x : S A) (y : S B) (z : S C) :
    bin P.nu (bin P.nu x y) z = map (Equiv.sumAssoc A B C).symm (bin P.nu x (bin P.nu y z))
proof:
:=
  eq_map_symm_of_map_eq (bin_assoc_of P.r2a x y z)

name: Operad.PermElt.nu_swap
statement:
lemma nu_swap (x : S A) (y : S B) (z : S C) :
    bin P.nu x (bin P.nu y z)
      = map (Equiv.sumCongr (Equiv.refl A) (Equiv.sumComm C B)) (bin P.nu x (bin P.nu z y))
proof:
:= by
  rw [bin_right_of P.r2b x y z, bin_swap, bin_map_right]

name: Operad.PermElt.nu_nu_comm
statement:
lemma nu_nu_comm (Y : S C) (a : S A) (b : S B) :
    bin P.nu (bin P.nu Y a) b = map (swapEquiv C A B) (bin P.nu (bin P.nu Y b) a)
proof:
:= by
  rw [P.nu_assoc Y a b, P.nu_swap Y a b, P.nu_assoc Y b a]
  simp only [map_map]
  refine map_congr (fun x => ?_) _
  rcases x with c | (b | a) <;> rfl

name: Operad.PermElt.adj_zero
statement: lemma adj_zero (X : S C) : P.adj X 0 = map (Equiv.sumEmpty C (Fin 0)).symm X
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.PermElt.adj_succ
statement:
lemma adj_succ (X : S C) (k : ℕ) :
    P.adj X (k + 1) = map (snocAdj C k) (bin P.nu (P.adj X k) one)
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.PermElt.adj_swap_last
statement:
lemma adj_swap_last (X : S C) (k : ℕ) :
    map (Equiv.sumCongr (Equiv.refl C) (Equiv.swap (Fin.last k).castSucc (Fin.last (k + 1))))
      (P.adj X (k + 2)) = P.adj X (k + 2)
proof:
:= by
  rw [adj_succ, adj_succ, bin_map_left]
  conv_lhs => rw [P.nu_nu_comm]
  simp only [map_map]
  refine map_congr (fun x => ?_) _
  rcases x with ((c | j) | ⟨⟩) | ⟨⟩
  · rfl
  · show Sum.inr (Equiv.swap _ _ j.castSucc.castSucc) = Sum.inr j.castSucc.castSucc
    rw [Equiv.swap_apply_of_ne_of_ne]
    · simp [Fin.ext_iff]
      omega
    · simp [Fin.ext_iff]
      omega
  · show Sum.inr (Equiv.swap _ _ (Fin.last (k + 1))) = Sum.inr (Fin.last k).castSucc
    rw [Equiv.swap_apply_right]
  · show Sum.inr (Equiv.swap _ _ (Fin.last k).castSucc) = Sum.inr (Fin.last (k + 1))
    rw [Equiv.swap_apply_left]

name: Operad.PermElt.adj_perm
statement:
theorem adj_perm (X : S C) : ∀ (k : ℕ) (σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin k)),
    map (Equiv.sumCongr (Equiv.refl C) σ) (P.adj X k) = P.adj X k
  | 0, σ => map_eq_self (fun x => by rcases x with c | j; rfl; exact j.elim0) _
  | k + 1, σ => by
    have key : ∀ i : Fin k, map (Equiv.sumCongr (Equiv.refl C) (Equiv.swap i.castSucc i.succ))
        (P.adj X (k + 1)) = P.adj X (k + 1)
proof:
:= by
      intro i
      by_cases hi : (i : ℕ) + 1 < k
      · have e : ∀ x, (Equiv.sumCongr (Equiv.refl C) (Equiv.swap i.castSucc i.succ))
            (snocAdj C k x) = snocAdj C k (Equiv.sumCongr (Equiv.sumCongr (Equiv.refl C)
              (Equiv.swap (⟨i, by omega⟩ : Fin k) ⟨i + 1, hi⟩)) (Equiv.refl Unit) x) := by
          have h1 : i.castSucc = (⟨i, by omega⟩ : Fin k).castSucc := Fin.ext rfl
          have h2 : i.succ = (⟨i + 1, hi⟩ : Fin k).castSucc := Fin.ext rfl
          rintro ((c | j) | ⟨⟩)
          · rfl
          · show Sum.inr (Equiv.swap _ _ j.castSucc) = Sum.inr (Equiv.swap _ _ j).castSucc
            rw [h1, h2]
            exact congrArg Sum.inr ((Fin.castSucc_injective _).swap_apply _ _ _)
          · show Sum.inr (Equiv.swap _ _ (Fin.last k)) = Sum.inr (Fin.last k)
            rw [Equiv.swap_apply_of_ne_of_ne] <;>
              simp only [ne_eq, Fin.ext_iff, Fin.val_last, Fin.val_castSucc, Fin.val_succ] <;>
              omega
        rw [adj_succ, map_map, map_congr (f := (Equiv.sumCongr (Equiv.sumCongr (Equiv.refl C)
          (Equiv.swap (⟨i, by omega⟩ : Fin k) ⟨i + 1, hi⟩)) (Equiv.refl Unit)).trans
          (snocAdj C k)) e, ← map_map, ← bin_map_left, adj_perm X k]
      · obtain ⟨m, rfl⟩ : ∃ m, k = m + 1 := ⟨k - 1, by have := i.isLt; omega⟩
        obtain rfl : i = Fin.last m := Fin.ext (by simp only [Fin.val_last]; omega)
        exact P.adj_swap_last X m
    have hσ : σ ∈ Submonoid.closure
        (Set.range fun i : Fin k => Equiv.swap i.castSucc i.succ) := by
      rw [Equiv.Perm.mclosure_swap_castSucc_succ]
      exact Submonoid.mem_top σ
    induction hσ using Submonoid.closure_induction with
    | mem x hx =>
      obtain ⟨i, rfl⟩ := hx
      exact key i
    | one => exact map_eq_self (fun x => by rcases x with c | j <;> rfl) _
    | mul x y _ _ hx hy =>
      rw [show Equiv.sumCongr (Equiv.refl C) (x * y)
          = (Equiv.sumCongr (Equiv.refl C) y).trans (Equiv.sumCongr (Equiv.refl C) x) by
        ext z; rcases z with c | j <;> rfl, map_trans, hy, hx]

name: Operad.PermElt.adjN_eq
statement:
lemma adjN_eq (X : S C) {N : Type} [Fintype N] [DecidableEq N] {k : ℕ} (e : N ≃ Fin k) :
    P.adjN X N = map (Equiv.sumCongr (Equiv.refl C) e.symm) (P.adj X k)
proof:
:= by
  obtain rfl : k = Fintype.card N := by simpa using (Fintype.card_congr e).symm
  unfold adjN
  induction Fintype.truncEquivFin N using Trunc.induction_on with
  | h f =>
    show map (Equiv.sumCongr (Equiv.refl C) f.symm) (P.adj X _) = _
    conv_rhs => rw [← P.adj_perm X _ (f.symm.trans e)]
    rw [map_map]
    exact map_congr (fun x => by rcases x with c | j <;> simp) _

name: Operad.PermElt.adj_map_left
statement:
lemma adj_map_left {C' : Type} [Fintype C'] [DecidableEq C'] (σ : C ≃ C') (X : S C) :
    ∀ k, P.adj (map σ X) k = map (Equiv.sumCongr σ (Equiv.refl (Fin k))) (P.adj X k)
  | 0 => by
    rw [adj_zero, adj_zero, map_map, map_map]
    exact map_congr (fun c => by rfl) _
  | k + 1 => by
    rw [adj_succ, adj_succ, adj_map_left σ X k, bin_map_left, map_map, map_map]
    exact map_congr (fun x => by rcases x with (c | j) | ⟨⟩ <;> rfl) _

name: Operad.PermElt.adjN_map_left
statement:
lemma adjN_map_left {C' : Type} [Fintype C'] [DecidableEq C'] (σ : C ≃ C') (X : S C)
    (N : Type) [Fintype N] [DecidableEq N] :
    P.adjN (map σ X) N = map (Equiv.sumCongr σ (Equiv.refl N)) (P.adjN X N)
proof:
:= by
  rw [P.adjN_eq _ (Fintype.equivFin N), P.adjN_eq _ (Fintype.equivFin N), adj_map_left,
    map_map, map_map]
  exact map_congr (fun x => by rcases x with c | j <;> rfl) _

name: Operad.PermElt.map_adjN_right
statement:
lemma map_adjN_right (X : S C) {N N' : Type} [Fintype N] [DecidableEq N] [Fintype N']
    [DecidableEq N'] (τ : N ≃ N') :
    map (Equiv.sumCongr (Equiv.refl C) τ) (P.adjN X N) = P.adjN X N'
proof:
:= by
  rw [P.adjN_eq _ (Fintype.equivFin N), P.adjN_eq _ (τ.symm.trans (Fintype.equivFin N)),
    map_map]
  exact map_congr (fun x => by rcases x with c | j <;> simp) _

name: Operad.PermElt.adjN_isEmpty
statement:
lemma adjN_isEmpty (X : S C) (N : Type) [Fintype N] [DecidableEq N] [IsEmpty N] :
    P.adjN X N = map (Equiv.sumEmpty C N).symm X
proof:
:= by
  rw [P.adjN_eq _ (Equiv.equivOfIsEmpty N (Fin 0)), adj_zero, map_map]
  exact map_congr (fun c => by rfl) _

name: Operad.PermElt.adjN_unit
statement: lemma adjN_unit (X : S C) : P.adjN X Unit = bin P.nu X one
proof:
:= by
  rw [P.adjN_eq _ unitFinOne, adj_succ, adj_zero, bin_map_left, map_map, map_map]
  exact map_eq_self (fun x => by rcases x with c | ⟨⟩ <;> rfl) _

name: Operad.PermElt.adj_add
statement:
lemma adj_add (X : S C) (k : ℕ) :
    ∀ l, P.adj X (k + l) = map (addEquiv C k l) (P.adj (P.adj X k) l)
  | 0 => by
    rw [adj_zero, map_map]
    exact (map_eq_self (fun x => by
      rcases x with c | j
      · rfl
      · exact congrArg Sum.inr (Fin.ext rfl)) _).symm
  | l + 1 => by
    show P.adj X (k + l + 1) = _
    rw [adj_succ, adj_add X k l, adj_succ, bin_map_left, map_map, map_map]
    refine map_congr (fun x => ?_) _
    rcases x with ((c | j) | j) | ⟨⟩
    · rfl
    · exact congrArg Sum.inr (Fin.ext (by simp))
    · exact congrArg Sum.inr (Fin.ext (by simp))
    · exact congrArg Sum.inr (Fin.ext (by simp))

name: Operad.PermElt.adjN_sum
statement:
lemma adjN_sum (X : S C) (N M : Type) [Fintype N] [DecidableEq N] [Fintype M] [DecidableEq M] :
    P.adjN X (N ⊕ M) = map (Equiv.sumAssoc C N M) (P.adjN (P.adjN X N) M)
proof:
:= by
  rw [P.adjN_eq _ ((Equiv.sumCongr (Fintype.equivFin N) (Fintype.equivFin M)).trans
      finSumFinEquiv), P.adjN_eq _ (Fintype.equivFin M), P.adjN_eq _ (Fintype.equivFin N),
    adj_map_left, adj_add, map_map, map_map, map_map]
  refine map_congr (fun x => ?_) _
  rcases x with (c | j) | j
  · rfl
  · simp [addEquiv]
  · simp [addEquiv]

name: Operad.PermElt.adjN_adjN
statement:
lemma adjN_adjN (X : S C) (N M : Type) [Fintype N] [DecidableEq N] [Fintype M]
    [DecidableEq M] :
    P.adjN (P.adjN X N) M = map (Equiv.sumAssoc C N M).symm (P.adjN X (N ⊕ M))
proof:
:=
  eq_map_symm_of_map_eq (P.adjN_sum X N M).symm

name: Operad.PermElt.adjN_split
statement:
lemma adjN_split (X : S C) {N : Type} [Fintype N] [DecidableEq N] (n : N) :
    P.adjN X N = map ((Equiv.sumAssoc C (Without N n) Unit).trans
      (Equiv.sumCongr (Equiv.refl C) (rightUnitEquiv n)))
      (bin P.nu (P.adjN X (Without N n)) one)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← P.map_adjN_right X (rightUnitEquiv n), P.adjN_sum, P.adjN_unit, map_map]

name: Operad.PermElt.comp_inl_adj
statement:
lemma comp_inl_adj (c : C) (X : S C) (y : S B) :
    ∀ k, comp (Sum.inl c) (P.adj X k) y = map (binLeftEquiv c) (P.adj (comp c X y) k)
  | 0 => by
    rw [adj_zero, adj_zero, comp_map_left_of _ (i := c) ?h0, map_map]
    · exact map_congr (fun x => by rcases x with a | b <;> rfl) _
    · rfl
  | k + 1 => by
    rw [adj_succ, adj_succ, comp_map_left_of _ (i := Sum.inl (Sum.inl c)) ?h1, comp_inl_bin,
      comp_inl_adj c X y k, bin_map_left]
    · simp only [map_map]
      refine map_congr (fun x => ?_) _
      rcases x with ((a | b) | j) | ⟨⟩ <;> rfl
    · rfl

name: Operad.PermElt.comp_inl_adjN
statement:
lemma comp_inl_adjN (c : C) (X : S C) (y : S B) (N : Type) [Fintype N] [DecidableEq N] :
    comp (Sum.inl c) (P.adjN X N) y = map (binLeftEquiv c) (P.adjN (comp c X y) N)
proof:
:= by
  rw [P.adjN_eq _ (Fintype.equivFin N), P.adjN_eq _ (Fintype.equivFin N),
    comp_map_left_of _ (i := Sum.inl c) ?h, comp_inl_adj, map_map, map_map]
  · exact map_congr (fun x => by rcases x with (a | b) | j <;> rfl) _
  · rfl

name: Operad.PermElt.bin_adj_of
statement:
lemma bin_adj_of {g : S (Fin 2)}
    (hg : map (Equiv.sumAssoc Unit Unit Unit) (bin P.nu (bin g one one) one)
      = bin g one (bin P.nu one one)) (Y : S D) (W : S C) :
    ∀ k, bin g Y (P.adj W k) = map (Equiv.sumAssoc D C (Fin k)) (P.adj (bin g Y W) k)
  | 0 => by
    rw [adj_zero, adj_zero, bin_map_right, map_map]
    exact map_congr (fun x => by rcases x with a | c <;> rfl) _
  | k + 1 => by
    rw [adj_succ, adj_succ, bin_map_right, ← bin_assoc_of hg Y (P.adj W k) one,
      bin_adj_of hg Y W k, bin_map_left]
    simp only [map_map]
    refine map_congr (fun x => ?_) _
    rcases x with ((d | c) | j) | ⟨⟩ <;> rfl

name: Operad.PermElt.bin_adjN_of
statement:
lemma bin_adjN_of {g : S (Fin 2)}
    (hg : map (Equiv.sumAssoc Unit Unit Unit) (bin P.nu (bin g one one) one)
      = bin g one (bin P.nu one one)) (Y : S D) (W : S C) (N : Type) [Fintype N]
    [DecidableEq N] :
    bin g Y (P.adjN W N) = map (Equiv.sumAssoc D C N) (P.adjN (bin g Y W) N)
proof:
:= by
  rw [P.adjN_eq _ (Fintype.equivFin N), P.adjN_eq _ (Fintype.equivFin N), bin_map_right,
    P.bin_adj_of hg, map_map, map_map]
  exact map_congr (fun x => by rcases x with (d | c) | j <;> rfl) _

name: Operad.PermElt.bin_nu_adjN
statement:
lemma bin_nu_adjN (Y : S D) (W : S C) (N : Type) [Fintype N] [DecidableEq N] :
    bin P.nu Y (P.adjN W N) = map (Equiv.sumAssoc D C N) (P.adjN (bin P.nu Y W) N)
proof:
:=
  P.bin_adjN_of P.r2a Y W N

name: Operad.PermElt.app_adj
statement:
lemma app_adj (φ : SetOperadHom S T) (X : S C) :
    ∀ k, φ.app _ (P.adj X k) = (P.map φ).adj (φ.app _ X) k
  | 0 => by rw [adj_zero, adj_zero, φ.app_map]
  | k + 1 => by
    rw [adj_succ, adj_succ, φ.app_map, φ.app_bin, φ.app_one, app_adj φ X k]
    rfl

name: Operad.PermElt.app_adjN
statement:
lemma app_adjN (φ : SetOperadHom S T) (X : S C) (N : Type) [Fintype N] [DecidableEq N] :
    φ.app _ (P.adjN X N) = (P.map φ).adjN (φ.app _ X) N
proof:
:= by
  rw [P.adjN_eq _ (Fintype.equivFin N), (P.map φ).adjN_eq _ (Fintype.equivFin N), φ.app_map,
    app_adj]

name: Operad.PermElt.pointEquiv_inl
statement:
@[simp] lemma pointEquiv_inl {A : Type} [DecidableEq A] (a : A) (u : Unit) :
    pointEquiv a (Sum.inl u) = a
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.PermElt.pointEquiv_inr
statement:
@[simp] lemma pointEquiv_inr {A : Type} [DecidableEq A] (a : A) (b : Without A a) :
    pointEquiv a (Sum.inr b) = b.1
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.PermElt.psi_eq
statement:
theorem psi_eq {N : Type} [Fintype N] [DecidableEq N] (a : A) (E : Unit ⊕ N ≃ A)
    (hE : E (Sum.inl ()) = a) : P.psi A a = SetOperad.map E (P.adjN one N)
proof:
:= by
  have hne : ∀ n, E (Sum.inr n) ≠ a := fun n h => by
    rw [← hE] at h
    exact Sum.inr_ne_inl (E.injective h)
  let τ : N ≃ Without A a := Equiv.ofBijective (fun n => ⟨E (Sum.inr n), hne n⟩)
    ⟨fun n m h => Sum.inr_injective (E.injective (congrArg Subtype.val h)), fun ⟨x, hx⟩ => by
      rcases hy : E.symm x with u | n
      · exact absurd (show x = a by rw [← hE, ← hy, Equiv.apply_symm_apply]) hx
      · exact ⟨n, Subtype.ext (show E (Sum.inr n) = x by rw [← hy, Equiv.apply_symm_apply])⟩⟩
  rw [psi, ← P.map_adjN_right one τ, map_map]
  refine map_congr (fun x => ?_) _
  rcases x with ⟨⟩ | n
  · exact hE.symm
  · rfl

name: Operad.PermElt.psi_map
statement:
theorem psi_map {A' : Type} [Fintype A'] [DecidableEq A'] (e : A ≃ A') (a : A) :
    P.psi A' (e a) = SetOperad.map e (P.psi A a)
proof:
:= by
  rw [P.psi_eq (e a) ((pointEquiv a).trans e) rfl, psi, map_map]

name: Operad.PermElt.psi_one
statement: lemma psi_one : P.psi Unit () = one
proof:
:= by
  rw [P.psi_eq () (Equiv.sumEmpty Unit Empty) rfl, P.adjN_isEmpty, map_map]
  exact map_eq_self (fun _ => rfl) _

name: Operad.PermElt.psi_nu
statement: lemma psi_nu : P.psi (Fin 2) 0 = P.nu
proof:
:= by
  rw [P.psi_eq 0 finTwoSum.symm rfl, P.adjN_unit, bin_one_one, map_map]
  exact map_eq_self (fun k => by fin_cases k <;> rfl) _

name: Operad.PermElt.psi_comp
statement:
theorem psi_comp (i : A) (a : A) (b : B) :
    P.psi _ (PointedSet.comp i a b) = comp i (P.psi A a) (P.psi B b)
proof:
:= by
  symm
  by_cases h : a = i
  · subst h
    rw [PointedSet.comp_self, psi, comp_map_left_of _ (i := Sum.inl ()) ?h, P.comp_inl_adjN,
      one_comp', psi, P.adjN_map_left, P.adjN_map_left, P.adjN_adjN]
    case h => rfl
    simp only [map_map]
    exact (P.psi_eq _ _ rfl).symm
  · rw [PointedSet.comp_of_ne h, psi, P.adjN_split _ ⟨i, Ne.symm h⟩, map_map,
      comp_map_left_of _ (i := Sum.inr ()) ?h, comp_inr_bin, one_comp', bin_map_right, psi,
      bin_map_right, P.bin_nu_adjN, ← P.adjN_unit, P.adjN_adjN, P.adjN_adjN]
    case h => rfl
    simp only [map_map]
    exact (P.psi_eq _ _ rfl).symm

name: Operad.PermElt.lift_app
statement: @[simp] lemma lift_app (a : A) : P.lift.app A a = P.psi A a
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.PermElt.lift_nu
statement: lemma lift_nu : P.lift.app (Fin 2) 0 = P.nu
proof: := P.psi_nu

name: Operad.PointedSet.bin_zero
statement:
lemma bin_zero {B C : Type} [Fintype B] [DecidableEq B] [Fintype C] [DecidableEq C] (x : B)
    (y : C) : bin (S := PointedSet) (0 : Fin 2) x y = Sum.inl x
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.PointedSet.permElt_adj
statement:
lemma permElt_adj {C : Type} [Fintype C] [DecidableEq C] (x : C) :
    ∀ k, permElt.adj (S := PointedSet) x k = Sum.inl x
  | 0 => rfl
  | k + 1 => by
    rw [PermElt.adj_succ, permElt_adj x k]
    rfl

name: Operad.PointedSet.permElt_adjN
statement:
lemma permElt_adjN {C : Type} [Fintype C] [DecidableEq C] (x : C) (N : Type) [Fintype N]
    [DecidableEq N] : permElt.adjN (S := PointedSet) x N = Sum.inl x
proof:
:= by
  rw [PermElt.adjN_eq _ _ (Fintype.equivFin N), permElt_adj]
  rfl

name: Operad.PointedSet.permElt_psi
statement: lemma permElt_psi (a : A) : permElt.psi A a = a
proof:
:= by
  rw [PermElt.psi, permElt_adjN]
  rfl

name: Operad.PointedSet.hom_ext
statement:
theorem hom_ext {φ ψ : SetOperadHom PointedSet S}
    (h : φ.app (Fin 2) (0 : Fin 2) = ψ.app (Fin 2) (0 : Fin 2)) : φ = ψ
proof:
:= by
  ext A _ _ a
  rw [← permElt_psi a, PermElt.psi, φ.app_map, ψ.app_map, PermElt.app_adjN, PermElt.app_adjN,
    φ.app_one, ψ.app_one]
  have hP : permElt.map φ = permElt.map ψ := by
    cases hφ : permElt.map φ
    cases hψ : permElt.map ψ
    simp only [PermElt.map, PermElt.mk.injEq] at hφ hψ ⊢
    rw [← hφ, ← hψ]
    exact h
  rw [hP]

name: Operad.und_map_zero
statement: @[simp] lemma und_map_zero (e : A ≃ B) : map e (Und.of R Q (0 : Q A)) = Und.of R Q 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [Und.map_eq, map_zero]

name: Operad.und_comp_zero_left
statement:
@[simp] lemma und_comp_zero_left (i : A) (y : Und R Q B) :
    comp i (Und.of R Q (0 : Q A)) y = Und.of R Q 0
proof:
:= by
  show Und.of R Q (SymOperad.comp (R := R) i 0 ((Und.of R Q).symm y)) = _
  rw [map_zero, LinearMap.zero_apply]

name: Operad.und_comp_zero_right
statement:
@[simp] lemma und_comp_zero_right (i : A) (x : Und R Q A) :
    comp i x (Und.of R Q (0 : Q B)) = Und.of R Q 0
proof:
:= by
  show Und.of R Q (SymOperad.comp (R := R) i ((Und.of R Q).symm x) 0) = _
  rw [map_zero]

name: Operad.und_bin_zero_left
statement:
@[simp] lemma und_bin_zero_left (x : Und R Q A) (y : Und R Q B) :
    bin (Und.of R Q (0 : Q (Fin 2))) x y = Und.of R Q 0
proof:
:= by
  unfold bin
  rw [und_comp_zero_left, und_comp_zero_left, und_map_zero]

name: Operad.und_bin_zero_mid
statement:
@[simp] lemma und_bin_zero_mid (g : Und R Q (Fin 2)) (y : Und R Q B) :
    bin g (Und.of R Q (0 : Q A)) y = Und.of R Q 0
proof:
:= by
  unfold bin
  rw [und_comp_zero_right, und_comp_zero_left, und_map_zero]

name: Operad.PermElt.adj_und_zero
statement:
lemma PermElt.adj_und_zero (P : PermElt (Und R Q)) :
    ∀ k, P.adj (Und.of R Q (0 : Q C)) k = Und.of R Q 0
  | 0 => und_map_zero _
  | k + 1 => by rw [PermElt.adj_succ, PermElt.adj_und_zero P k, und_bin_zero_mid, und_map_zero]

name: Operad.PermElt.adjN_und_zero
statement:
lemma PermElt.adjN_und_zero (P : PermElt (Und R Q)) (N : Type) [Fintype N] [DecidableEq N] :
    P.adjN (Und.of R Q (0 : Q C)) N = Und.of R Q 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [P.adjN_eq _ (Fintype.equivFin N), P.adj_und_zero, und_map_zero]

name: Operad.FreeGrL.exists_svalEquiv
statement:
lemma exists_svalEquiv {Y₁ Y₂ Y : Finset ℕ} (i₁ : Lab Y₁)
    (hd : ∀ x ∈ Y₁, x ≠ i₁.1 → x ∉ Y₂) (hY : ∀ x, x ∈ Y ↔ (x ∈ Y₁ ∧ x ≠ i₁.1) ∨ x ∈ Y₂) :
    ∃ Ψ : Without (Lab Y₁) i₁ ⊕ Lab Y₂ ≃ Lab Y, ∀ z, (Ψ z).1 = sval z
proof:
:= by
  have hmem : ∀ z : Without (Lab Y₁) i₁ ⊕ Lab Y₂, sval z ∈ Y := by
    rintro (⟨⟨x, hx⟩, hne⟩ | ⟨x, hx⟩)
    · exact (hY x).2 (Or.inl ⟨hx, fun h => hne (Subtype.ext h)⟩)
    · exact (hY x).2 (Or.inr hx)
  refine ⟨Equiv.ofBijective (fun z => ⟨sval z, hmem z⟩) ⟨?_, ?_⟩, fun _ => rfl⟩
  · rintro (⟨⟨x, hx⟩, hne⟩ | ⟨x, hx⟩) (⟨⟨x', hx'⟩, hne'⟩ | ⟨x', hx'⟩) h <;>
      simp only [Subtype.mk.injEq, sval_inl, sval_inr] at h
    · subst h
      rfl
    · subst h
      exact absurd hx' (hd x hx fun h => hne (Subtype.ext h))
    · subst h
      exact absurd hx (hd x hx' fun h => hne' (Subtype.ext h))
    · subst h
      rfl
  · rintro ⟨x, hx⟩
    rcases (hY x).1 hx with ⟨hx₁, hne⟩ | hx₂
    · exact ⟨Sum.inl ⟨⟨x, hx₁⟩, fun h => hne (congrArg Subtype.val h)⟩, rfl⟩
    · exact ⟨Sum.inr ⟨x, hx₂⟩, rfl⟩

name: Operad.FreeGrL.exists_sort
statement:
theorem exists_sort {A B : Type} [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] [Fintype B] [DecidableEq B] (i : A)
    (b₀ : B) {Y : Finset ℕ} (e : Without A i ⊕ B ≃ Lab Y) :
    ∃ (Y₁ Y₂ : Finset ℕ) (e₁ : A ≃ Lab Y₁) (e₂ : B ≃ Lab Y₂)
      (Ψ : Without (Lab Y₁) (e₁ i) ⊕ Lab Y₂ ≃ Lab Y),
      (∀ z, (Ψ z).1 = sval z) ∧ (e₁ i).1 ∈ Y₂ ∧ (∀ y ∈ Y₂, (e₁ i).1 ≤ y) ∧
      ∀ (x : P A) (y : P B), GrOperad.map (R := R) e (GrOperad.comp (R := R) i x y)
        = GrOperad.map (R := R) Ψ (GrOperad.comp (R := R) (e₁ i) (GrOperad.map (R := R) e₁ x)
          (GrOperad.map (R := R) e₂ y))
proof:
:= by
  let Y₂ : Finset ℕ := Finset.univ.image fun b => (e (Sum.inr b)).1
  have hY₂ : Y₂.Nonempty := ⟨_, Finset.mem_image_of_mem _ (Finset.mem_univ b₀)⟩
  let m := Y₂.min' hY₂
  have hm₂ : m ∈ Y₂ := Finset.min'_mem _ _
  have hne : ∀ a : Without A i, (e (Sum.inl a)).1 ≠ m := fun a h => by
    obtain ⟨b, -, hb⟩ := Finset.mem_image.1 hm₂
    have := e.injective (Subtype.ext (h.trans hb.symm))
    simp at this
  let Y₁ : Finset ℕ := insert m (Finset.univ.image fun a : Without A i => (e (Sum.inl a)).1)
  let f₁ : A → Lab Y₁ := fun a => if h : a = i then ⟨m, Finset.mem_insert_self _ _⟩ else
    ⟨(e (Sum.inl ⟨a, h⟩)).1, Finset.mem_insert_of_mem (Finset.mem_image_of_mem _ (by simp))⟩
  have hf₁i : f₁ i = ⟨m, Finset.mem_insert_self _ _⟩ := dif_pos rfl
  have hf₁a : ∀ a (h : a ≠ i), f₁ a = ⟨(e (Sum.inl ⟨a, h⟩)).1,
      Finset.mem_insert_of_mem (Finset.mem_image_of_mem _ (by simp))⟩ := fun a h => dif_neg h
  have hbij₁ : Bijective f₁ := by
    refine ⟨fun a a' h => ?_, fun ⟨y, hy⟩ => ?_⟩
    · by_cases ha : a = i <;> by_cases ha' : a' = i
      · rw [ha, ha']
      · rw [ha, hf₁i, hf₁a a' ha'] at h
        exact absurd (congrArg Subtype.val h).symm (hne _)
      · rw [ha', hf₁i, hf₁a a ha] at h
        exact absurd (congrArg Subtype.val h) (hne _)
      · rw [hf₁a a ha, hf₁a a' ha'] at h
        have h' : (e (Sum.inl ⟨a, ha⟩)).1 = (e (Sum.inl ⟨a', ha'⟩)).1 := Subtype.mk.inj h
        have := e.injective (Subtype.ext h')
        simpa using this
    · rcases Finset.mem_insert.1 hy with rfl | hy
      · exact ⟨i, hf₁i⟩
      · obtain ⟨a, -, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.1 hy
        exact ⟨a.1, by rw [hf₁a a.1 a.2]⟩
  let f₂ : B → Lab Y₂ := fun b => ⟨(e (Sum.inr b)).1, Finset.mem_image_of_mem _ (by simp)⟩
  have hbij₂ : Bijective f₂ := by
    refine ⟨fun b b' h => ?_, fun ⟨y, hy⟩ => ?_⟩
    · have h' : (e (Sum.inr b)).1 = (e (Sum.inr b')).1 :=
        (congrArg Subtype.val h : (f₂ b).1 = (f₂ b').1)
      have := e.injective (Subtype.ext h')
      simpa using this
    · obtain ⟨b, -, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.1 hy
      exact ⟨b, rfl⟩
  let e₁ := Equiv.ofBijective f₁ hbij₁
  let e₂ := Equiv.ofBijective f₂ hbij₂
  have he₁i : (e₁ i).1 = m := congrArg Subtype.val hf₁i
  refine ⟨Y₁, Y₂, e₁, e₂, (compEquiv e₁ e₂ i).symm.trans e, ?_, he₁i ▸ hm₂,
    fun y hy => he₁i ▸ Finset.min'_le _ _ hy, fun x y => ?_⟩
  · rintro (⟨a', ha'⟩ | b')
    · show (e (Sum.inl ⟨e₁.symm a', _⟩)).1 = a'.1
      have hai : e₁.symm a' ≠ i := fun h => ha' (by rw [← h, Equiv.apply_symm_apply])
      have := congrArg Subtype.val (hf₁a _ hai)
      rw [show f₁ (e₁.symm a') = a' from e₁.apply_symm_apply a'] at this
      exact this.symm
    · show (e (Sum.inr (e₂.symm b'))).1 = b'.1
      exact congrArg Subtype.val (e₂.apply_symm_apply b')
  · rw [← GrOperad.map_comp, ← GrOperad.map_trans]
    rw [← Equiv.trans_assoc, Equiv.self_trans_symm, Equiv.refl_trans]

name: Operad.ShuffleBarSym.IsMonY.nodup
statement: lemma IsMonY.nodup (h : IsMonY Y u) : u.labels.Nodup
proof:
:= by
  have := Y.nodup
  rw [← h.2] at this
  exact Multiset.coe_nodup.1 this

name: Operad.ShuffleBarSym.IsMonY.toS_val
statement: @[simp] lemma IsMonY.toS_val (h : IsMonY Y u) : h.toS.1 = toBinSTree u
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.ShuffleBarSym.IsMonY.toS_congr
statement:
lemma IsMonY.toS_congr {u' : LTree G} (h : IsMonY Y u) (h' : IsMonY Y u') (hu : u = u') :
    h.toS = h'.toS
proof: := Subtype.ext (by subst hu; rfl)

name: Operad.ShuffleBarSym.IsMonY.substAt
statement:
lemma IsMonY.substAt [Fintype G] [DecidableEq G] (h : IsMonY Y u) {p : List Bool} {s : Bool}
    (he : u.IsEdge p s) (σ : Mono G 3) : IsMonY Y (u.substAt p s σ.1)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hσs, hσ, -⟩ := ShuffleBar.mono_shape σ
  refine ⟨isShuffle_substAt he h.1 h.nodup hσs hσ, ?_⟩
  rw [← h.2]
  exact Multiset.coe_eq_coe.2 (perm_labels_substAt he h.1 h.nodup hσ)

name: Operad.ShuffleBarSym.isMonY_ofBinSTree
statement: lemma isMonY_ofBinSTree (t : SMono (BinGen G) Y) : IsMonY Y (ofBinSTree t.1)
proof:
:=
  ⟨isShuffle_of_toBinSTree _ (by rw [toBinSTree_ofBinSTree]; exact t.2.1), by
    rw [← labels_toBinSTree, toBinSTree_ofBinSTree]; exact t.2.2⟩

name: Operad.ShuffleBarSym.toS_ofBinSTree
statement: lemma toS_ofBinSTree (t : SMono (BinGen G) Y) : (isMonY_ofBinSTree t).toS = t
proof:
:=
  Subtype.ext (toBinSTree_ofBinSTree t.1)

name: Operad.ShuffleBarSym.toBinSTree_plug
statement:
lemma toBinSTree_plug (F : ℕ → LTree G) :
    ∀ u : LTree G, toBinSTree (u.plug F) = (toBinSTree u).subst fun a => toBinSTree (F a)
  | .leaf _ => rfl
  | .node e l r => by
    show STree.node (BinGen.op e) ![toBinSTree (l.plug F), toBinSTree (r.plug F)] =
      STree.node (BinGen.op e) fun i => (![toBinSTree l, toBinSTree r] i).subst _
    congr 1
    funext i
    fin_cases i
    · exact toBinSTree_plug F l
    · exact toBinSTree_plug F r

name: Operad.ShuffleBarSym.toBinSTree_update
statement:
lemma toBinSTree_update (m : ℕ) (w : LTree G) :
    (fun a => toBinSTree (update LTree.leaf m w a)) = update STree.leaf m (toBinSTree w)
proof:
:= by
  funext a
  by_cases ha : a = m
  · subst ha
    rw [update_self, update_self]
  · rw [update_of_ne ha, update_of_ne ha]
    rfl

name: Operad.ShuffleBarSym.minLabel_update
statement:
lemma minLabel_update {m : ℕ} {w : LTree G} (hw : w.minLabel = m) (a : ℕ) :
    (update LTree.leaf m w a).minLabel = a
proof:
:= by
  by_cases ha : a = m
  · subst ha
    rw [update_self, hw]
  · rw [update_of_ne ha]
    rfl

name: Operad.ShuffleBarSym.strictOn_update
statement:
lemma strictOn_update {m : ℕ} {w : LTree G} (hw : w.minLabel = m) (y : LTree G) :
    StrictOn (fun a => (update LTree.leaf m w a).minLabel) y
proof:
:= fun a _ b _ hab => by
  simp only [minLabel_update hw]
  exact hab

name: Operad.ShuffleBarSym.substAt_plug_update
statement:
lemma substAt_plug_update {u₁ : LTree G} {p : List Bool} {s : Bool} (he : u₁.IsEdge p s)
    {m : ℕ} {w : LTree G} (hw : w.minLabel = m) (σ : LTree G) :
    (u₁.plug (update LTree.leaf m w)).IsEdge p s ∧
      (u₁.plug (update LTree.leaf m w)).substAt p s σ
        = (u₁.substAt p s σ).plug (update LTree.leaf m w)
proof:
:=
  ⟨isEdge_ctx (M := LTree.leaf 0) (q := []) trivial _ he,
    substAt_ctx (M := LTree.leaf 0) (q := []) trivial _ he (strictOn_update hw u₁) σ⟩

name: Operad.ShuffleBarSym.plug_update_substAt
statement:
lemma plug_update_substAt {u₁ : LTree G} (hnd : u₁.labels.Nodup) {m : ℕ} (hm : m ∈ u₁.labels)
    {w : LTree G} {p : List Bool} {s : Bool} (he : w.IsEdge p s) (σ : LTree G) :
    (u₁.plug (update LTree.leaf m w)).IsEdge (leafPos m u₁ ++ p) s ∧
      (u₁.plug (update LTree.leaf m w)).substAt (leafPos m u₁ ++ p) s σ
        = u₁.plug (update LTree.leaf m (w.substAt p s σ))
proof:
:= by
  have hw : update LTree.leaf m w m = w := update_self _ _ _
  refine ⟨isEdge_ctx_ins (M := LTree.leaf 0) (q := []) trivial _ hm (by rw [hw]; exact he), ?_⟩
  have := substAt_ctx_ins (M := LTree.leaf 0) (q := []) trivial (update LTree.leaf m w) hnd hm
    p s σ
  rw [hw, update_idem] at this
  exact this

name: Operad.ShuffleBarSym.svalEquiv_spec
statement:
lemma svalEquiv_spec {Y₁ Y₂ Y : Finset ℕ} {i₁ : Lab Y₁} (Ψ : Without (Lab Y₁) i₁ ⊕ Lab Y₂ ≃ Lab Y)
    (hΨ : ∀ z, (Ψ z).1 = FreeGrL.sval z) :
    ∃ hd : Disjoint (Y₁.erase i₁.1) Y₂, (Y₁.erase i₁.1).disjUnion Y₂ hd = Y
proof:
:= by
  have hd : Disjoint (Y₁.erase i₁.1) Y₂ := Finset.disjoint_left.2 fun {x} hx₁ hx₂ => by
    have h1 := hΨ (Sum.inl ⟨⟨x, Finset.mem_of_mem_erase hx₁⟩, fun h =>
      Finset.ne_of_mem_erase hx₁ (congrArg Subtype.val h)⟩)
    have h2 := hΨ (Sum.inr ⟨x, hx₂⟩)
    have := Ψ.injective (Subtype.ext (h1.trans h2.symm))
    simp at this
  refine ⟨hd, Finset.ext fun x => ⟨fun hx => ?_, fun hx => ?_⟩⟩
  · rcases Finset.mem_disjUnion.1 hx with hx | hx
    · have := (Ψ (Sum.inl ⟨⟨x, Finset.mem_of_mem_erase hx⟩, fun h =>
        Finset.ne_of_mem_erase hx (congrArg Subtype.val h)⟩)).2
      rwa [hΨ] at this
    · have := (Ψ (Sum.inr ⟨x, hx⟩)).2
      rwa [hΨ] at this
  · have h := hΨ (Ψ.symm ⟨x, hx⟩)
    rw [Equiv.apply_symm_apply] at h
    rcases hz : Ψ.symm ⟨x, hx⟩ with ⟨⟨y, hy⟩, hne⟩ | ⟨y, hy⟩ <;> rw [hz] at h <;>
      simp only [FreeGrL.sval_inl, FreeGrL.sval_inr] at h <;> subst h
    · exact Finset.mem_disjUnion.2 (Or.inl (Finset.mem_erase.2
        ⟨fun h => hne (Subtype.ext h), hy⟩))
    · exact Finset.mem_disjUnion.2 (Or.inr hy)

name: Operad.ShuffleBarSym.subst_mem
statement:
lemma subst_mem {Y₁ Y₂ Y : Finset ℕ} (t₁ : SMono (BinGen G) Y₁) (t₂ : SMono (BinGen G) Y₂)
    (i₁ : Lab Y₁) (hf : t₂.1.first = i₁.1) (Ψ : Without (Lab Y₁) i₁ ⊕ Lab Y₂ ≃ Lab Y)
    (hΨ : ∀ z, (Ψ z).1 = FreeGrL.sval z) :
    (t₁.1.subst (update STree.leaf i₁.1 t₂.1)).IsShuffle ∧
      (t₁.1.subst (update STree.leaf i₁.1 t₂.1)).labels = Y.val
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hd, hY⟩ := svalEquiv_spec Ψ hΨ
  refine ⟨FreeGrL.isShuffle_subst_update t₁.2.1 t₂.2.1 hf, ?_⟩
  rw [FreeGrL.labels_subst_update t₁.2.2 t₂.2.2 i₁.2 hd, hY]

name: Operad.ShuffleBarSym.comp_labBasis
statement:
theorem comp_labBasis {Y₁ Y₂ Y : Finset ℕ} (t₁ : SMono (BinGen G) Y₁) (t₂ : SMono (BinGen G) Y₂)
    (i₁ : Lab Y₁) (hf : t₂.1.first = i₁.1) (Ψ : Without (Lab Y₁) i₁ ⊕ Lab Y₂ ≃ Lab Y)
    (hΨ : ∀ z, (Ψ z).1 = FreeGrL.sval z) (t : SMono (BinGen G) Y)
    (ht : t.1 = t₁.1.subst (update STree.leaf i₁.1 t₂.1)) :
    GrOperad.map (R := K) Ψ (GrOperad.comp (R := K) i₁ (labBasis c hc Y₁ t₁)
      (labBasis c hc Y₂ t₂)) = labBasis c hc Y t
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hd, hY⟩ := svalEquiv_spec Ψ hΨ
  obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := i₁
  let E : Lab ((Y₁.erase m).disjUnion Y₂ hd) ≃ Without (Lab Y₁) ⟨m, hm⟩ ⊕ Lab Y₂ :=
    (Equiv.subtypeEquivRight fun x => by rw [hY]).trans Ψ.symm
  have hE : ∀ x, FreeGrL.sval (E x) = x.1 := fun x => by
    rw [← hΨ]
    show (Ψ (Ψ.symm _)).1 = _
    rw [Equiv.apply_symm_apply]
    rfl
  rw [labBasis, FreeGrL.comp_shBasisLab c hc t₁ t₂ hm hf hd E hE, vpar_false, Bool.false_and,
    σ_false, one_smul, ← GrOperad.map_trans, FreeGrL.shBasisLab_apply, FreeGrL.shBasisLab_apply]
  exact FreeGrL.map_shEv _ ht.symm hY _ _ _ fun x => by
    show (Ψ (Ψ.symm _)).1 = x.1
    rw [Equiv.apply_symm_apply]
    rfl

name: Operad.ShuffleBarSym.mem_of_basis
statement:
lemma mem_of_basis {Y : Finset ℕ} (S : Submodule K (FreeGrL K E (Lab Y)))
    (h : ∀ t, labBasis c hc Y t ∈ S) (x : FreeGrL K E (Lab Y)) : x ∈ S
proof:
:= by
  have hle : Submodule.span K (Set.range (labBasis c hc Y)) ≤ S :=
    Submodule.span_le.2 (Set.range_subset_iff.2 h)
  rw [(labBasis c hc Y).span_eq] at hle
  exact hle Submodule.mem_top

name: Operad.ShuffleBarSym.coord3_mem_Rsh
statement: lemma coord3_mem_Rsh {y : FreeGrL K E (Fin 3)} (hy : y ∈ r 3) : coord3 c hc y ∈ Rsh c hc r
proof:
:=
  Submodule.subset_span ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩

name: Operad.ShuffleBarSym.relGen_mem_ShIT
proof:
:=
  Submodule.subset_span ⟨u, hu, p, s, he, ρ, hρ, rfl⟩

name: Operad.ShuffleBarSym.first_eq_of_min
statement:
lemma first_eq_of_min {Y : Finset ℕ} (t : SMono (BinGen G) Y) {i : ℕ} (hi : i ∈ Y)
    (hmin : ∀ y ∈ Y, i ≤ y) : t.1.first = i
proof:
:= by
  refine le_antisymm (first_le t.2.1 i (by rw [t.2.2]; exact hi)) (hmin _ ?_)
  have := first_mem t.2.1
  rwa [t.2.2] at this

name: Operad.ShuffleBarSym.isMonY_of_toBinSTree
statement:
lemma isMonY_of_toBinSTree {Y : Finset ℕ} {w : LTree G} {t : STree (BinGen G)}
    (ht : t.IsShuffle ∧ t.labels = Y.val) (h : toBinSTree w = t) : IsMonY Y w
proof:
:=
  ⟨isShuffle_of_toBinSTree _ (h ▸ ht.1), by rw [← labels_toBinSTree, h]; exact ht.2⟩

name: Operad.ShuffleBarSym.comp_mem_ShIT_left
statement:
theorem comp_mem_ShIT_left {Y₁ Y₂ Y : Finset ℕ} (i₁ : Lab Y₁) (hi₂ : i₁.1 ∈ Y₂)
    (hmin : ∀ y ∈ Y₂, i₁.1 ≤ y) (Ψ : Without (Lab Y₁) i₁ ⊕ Lab Y₂ ≃ Lab Y)
    (hΨ : ∀ z, (Ψ z).1 = FreeGrL.sval z) {x : FreeGrL K E (Lab Y₁)} (hx : x ∈ ShIT c hc r Y₁)
    (y : FreeGrL K E (Lab Y₂)) :
    GrOperad.map (R := K) Ψ (GrOperad.comp (R := K) i₁ x y) ∈ ShIT c hc r Y
proof:
:= by
  have key : ∀ t₂ : SMono (BinGen G) Y₂, ShIT c hc r Y₁ ≤ (ShIT c hc r Y).comap
      ((GrOperad.map (R := K) Ψ).comp ((GrOperad.comp (R := K) i₁).flip
        (labBasis c hc Y₂ t₂))) := by
    intro t₂
    have hf : t₂.1.first = i₁.1 := first_eq_of_min t₂ hi₂ hmin
    set w := ofBinSTree t₂.1
    have hw : w.minLabel = i₁.1 := by
      rw [← first_toBinSTree w (isMonY_ofBinSTree t₂).1, toBinSTree_ofBinSTree]
      exact hf
    have hT : ∀ v : LTree G, toBinSTree (v.plug (update LTree.leaf i₁.1 w))
        = (toBinSTree v).subst (update STree.leaf i₁.1 t₂.1) := fun v => by
      rw [toBinSTree_plug, toBinSTree_update, toBinSTree_ofBinSTree]
    rw [ShIT, Submodule.span_le]
    rintro _ ⟨u, hu, p, s, he, ρ, hρ, rfl⟩
    have hu' : IsMonY Y (u.plug (update LTree.leaf i₁.1 w)) :=
      isMonY_of_toBinSTree (subst_mem hu.toS t₂ i₁ hf Ψ hΨ) (hT u)
    have he' := (substAt_plug_update he hw (LTree.leaf 0)).1
    show _ ∈ ShIT c hc r Y
    have : (GrOperad.map (R := K) Ψ).comp ((GrOperad.comp (R := K) i₁).flip
        (labBasis c hc Y₂ t₂)) (relGen c hc hu he ρ) = relGen c hc hu' he' ρ := by
      simp only [relGen, map_sum, map_smul]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun σ _ => congrArg _ ?_
      refine comp_labBasis c hc _ t₂ i₁ hf Ψ hΨ _ ?_
      rw [IsMonY.toS_val, IsMonY.toS_val, (substAt_plug_update he hw σ.1).2, hT]
    rw [this]
    exact relGen_mem_ShIT c hc r hu' he' hρ
  exact mem_of_basis c hc ((ShIT c hc r Y).comap
    ((GrOperad.map (R := K) Ψ).comp (GrOperad.comp (R := K) i₁ x))) (fun t₂ => key t₂ hx) y

name: Operad.ShuffleBarSym.comp_mem_ShIT_right
statement:
theorem comp_mem_ShIT_right {Y₁ Y₂ Y : Finset ℕ} (i₁ : Lab Y₁) (hi₂ : i₁.1 ∈ Y₂)
    (hmin : ∀ y ∈ Y₂, i₁.1 ≤ y) (Ψ : Without (Lab Y₁) i₁ ⊕ Lab Y₂ ≃ Lab Y)
    (hΨ : ∀ z, (Ψ z).1 = FreeGrL.sval z) (x : FreeGrL K E (Lab Y₁)) {y : FreeGrL K E (Lab Y₂)}
    (hy : y ∈ ShIT c hc r Y₂) :
    GrOperad.map (R := K) Ψ (GrOperad.comp (R := K) i₁ x y) ∈ ShIT c hc r Y
proof:
:= by
  have key : ∀ t₁ : SMono (BinGen G) Y₁, ShIT c hc r Y₂ ≤ (ShIT c hc r Y).comap
      ((GrOperad.map (R := K) Ψ).comp (GrOperad.comp (R := K) i₁ (labBasis c hc Y₁ t₁))) := by
    intro t₁
    set w := ofBinSTree t₁.1
    have hw : IsMonY Y₁ w := isMonY_ofBinSTree t₁
    have hm : i₁.1 ∈ w.labels := by
      have := i₁.2
      rw [← Finset.mem_val, ← hw.2] at this
      exact Multiset.mem_coe.1 this
    have hT : ∀ v : LTree G, toBinSTree (w.plug (update LTree.leaf i₁.1 v))
        = t₁.1.subst (update STree.leaf i₁.1 (toBinSTree v)) := fun v => by
      rw [toBinSTree_plug, toBinSTree_update, toBinSTree_ofBinSTree]
    rw [ShIT, Submodule.span_le]
    rintro _ ⟨u, hu, p, s, he, ρ, hρ, rfl⟩
    have hf : ∀ σ : Mono G 3, (hu.substAt he σ).toS.1.first = i₁.1 := fun σ =>
      first_eq_of_min _ hi₂ hmin
    have hf₀ : hu.toS.1.first = i₁.1 := first_eq_of_min _ hi₂ hmin
    have hu' : IsMonY Y (w.plug (update LTree.leaf i₁.1 u)) :=
      isMonY_of_toBinSTree (subst_mem t₁ hu.toS i₁ hf₀ Ψ hΨ) (hT u)
    have he' := (plug_update_substAt hw.nodup hm he (LTree.leaf 0)).1
    show _ ∈ ShIT c hc r Y
    have : (GrOperad.map (R := K) Ψ).comp (GrOperad.comp (R := K) i₁ (labBasis c hc Y₁ t₁))
        (relGen c hc hu he ρ) = relGen c hc hu' he' ρ := by
      simp only [relGen, map_sum, map_smul]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun σ _ => congrArg _ ?_
      refine comp_labBasis c hc t₁ _ i₁ (hf σ) Ψ hΨ _ ?_
      rw [IsMonY.toS_val, IsMonY.toS_val, (plug_update_substAt hw.nodup hm he σ.1).2, hT]
    rw [this]
    exact relGen_mem_ShIT c hc r hu' he' hρ
  exact mem_of_basis c hc ((ShIT c hc r Y).comap
    ((GrOperad.map (R := K) Ψ).comp ((GrOperad.comp (R := K) i₁).flip y)))
    (fun t₁ => key t₁ hy) x

name: Operad.ShuffleBarSym.par_labBasis
statement:
lemma par_labBasis {Y : Finset ℕ} (b : Bool) (x : FreeGrL K E (Lab Y)) :
    GrOperad.par (R := K) b x = if b then 0 else x
proof:
:= by
  have h0 : ∀ t, GrOperad.par (R := K) false (labBasis c hc Y t) = labBasis c hc Y t := fun t => by
    rw [labBasis, FreeGrL.shBasisLab_apply]
    have := FreeGrL.par_shEv c hc t.1 Y t.2.2
    rwa [vpar_false] at this
  have hfalse : GrOperad.par (R := K) (P := FreeGrL K E) (A := Lab Y) false = LinearMap.id :=
    (labBasis c hc Y).ext h0
  have htrue : GrOperad.par (R := K) (P := FreeGrL K E) (A := Lab Y) true = 0 :=
    (labBasis c hc Y).ext fun t => by
      rw [← h0 t, GrOperad.par_par, if_neg (by decide), LinearMap.zero_apply]
  cases b
  · exact LinearMap.congr_fun hfalse x
  · exact LinearMap.congr_fun htrue x

name: Operad.ShuffleBarSym.mem_relIdeal
statement:
lemma mem_relIdeal {A : Type} [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] {x : FreeGrL K E A} :
    x ∈ (relIdeal c hc r).sub A ↔
      ∀ (Y : Finset ℕ) (e : A ≃ Lab Y), GrOperad.map (R := K) e x ∈ ShIT c hc r Y
proof:
:= by
  simp only [relIdeal, Submodule.mem_iInf, Submodule.mem_comap]

name: Operad.ShuffleBarSym.shEv_congr_tree
statement:
lemma shEv_congr_tree {t t' : STree (BinGen G)} (ht : t = t') (Y : Finset ℕ)
    (h : t.labels = Y.val) (h' : t'.labels = Y.val) :
    FreeGrL.shEv (R := K) c t Y h = FreeGrL.shEv c t' Y h'
proof:
:= by
  subst ht
  rfl

name: Operad.ShuffleBarSym.map_tBasis3
statement:
theorem map_tBasis3 {Y : Finset ℕ} (θ : Fin 3 ≃ Lab Y) (ins : ℕ → LTree G)
    (hins : ∀ j : Fin 3, ins j = LTree.leaf (θ j).1) (v : Mono G 3 → SMono (BinGen G) Y)
    (hv : ∀ σ, (v σ).1 = toBinSTree (σ.1.plug ins)) (y : FreeGrL K E (Fin 3)) :
    GrOperad.map (R := K) θ y = ∑ σ : Mono G 3, coord3 c hc y σ • labBasis c hc Y (v σ)
proof:
:= by
  let eqv : {t // t ∈ LTree.monomials (E := G) (Fintype.card (Fin 3))} ≃ Mono G 3 :=
    Equiv.subtypeEquivRight fun t => by rw [Fintype.card_fin]
  let f : ℕ → ℕ := fun j => if h : j < 3 then (θ ⟨j, h⟩).1 else j
  conv_lhs => rw [← (tBasis c hc (Fin 3)).sum_repr y]
  rw [map_sum]
  refine Fintype.sum_equiv eqv _ _ fun m => ?_
  rw [map_smul]
  congr 1
  have hlt : ∀ a ∈ m.1.labels, a < 3 := fun a ha => by
    have := (List.mem_range.1 (((LTree.mem_monomials _ m.1).1 m.2).2.subset ha))
    simpa using this
  have hrel : (v (eqv m)).1 = (LTree.binMonoEquiv _ m).1.relabel f := by
    rw [hv]
    show toBinSTree (m.1.plug ins) = (toBinSTree m.1).subst fun a => STree.leaf (f a)
    rw [toBinSTree_plug]
    refine subst_congr _ fun a ha => ?_
    rw [labels_toBinSTree, Multiset.mem_coe] at ha
    have ha3 := hlt a ha
    rw [show ins a = ins (⟨a, ha3⟩ : Fin 3) from rfl, hins]
    simp only [f, dif_pos ha3]
    rfl
  have he : ∀ x : Lab (Finset.range (Fintype.card (Fin 3))),
      (((FreeGrL.posEquiv (Fin 3)).symm.trans θ) x).1 = f x.1 := by
    intro x
    have hx : x.1 = (((FreeGrL.posEquiv (Fin 3)).symm x : Fin 3) : ℕ) := by
      conv_lhs => rw [← (FreeGrL.posEquiv (Fin 3)).apply_symm_apply x]
      rw [FreeGrL.posEquiv_apply, opos_fin]
    have hx3 : x.1 < 3 := by
      rw [hx]
      exact Fin.is_lt _
    simp only [Equiv.trans_apply, f, dif_pos hx3]
    congr 2
    exact Fin.ext hx.symm
  rw [tBasis_apply, FreeGrL.shuffleBasis_apply, ← GrOperad.map_trans, labBasis,
    FreeGrL.shBasisLab_apply, ← FreeGrL.shEv_relabel c f _ _ _ Y (by rw [← hrel]; exact
      (v (eqv m)).2.2) _ he]
  exact shEv_congr_tree c hrel.symm Y _ _

name: Operad.ShuffleBarSym.isEmpty_mono3
statement: lemma isEmpty_mono3 (hG : IsEmpty G) : IsEmpty (Mono G 3)
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun σ => by
    obtain ⟨e, -, -, -⟩ := (ShuffleBar.mono_shape σ).2.2
    exact hG.elim e⟩

name: Operad.ShuffleBarSym.map_mem_ShIT_three
statement:
theorem map_mem_ShIT_three {Y : Finset ℕ} (θ : Fin 3 ≃ Lab Y) (hθ : StrictMono fun j => (θ j).1)
    {y : FreeGrL K E (Fin 3)} (hy : coord3 c hc y ∈ Rsh c hc r) :
    GrOperad.map (R := K) θ y ∈ ShIT c hc r Y
proof:
:= by
  rcases isEmpty_or_nonempty G with hG | hG
  · haveI := isEmpty_mono3 hG
    rw [map_tBasis3 c hc θ (fun a => LTree.leaf (if h : a < 3 then (θ ⟨a, h⟩).1 else 0))
      (fun j => by simp only [dif_pos j.2]) isEmptyElim (fun σ => isEmptyElim σ) y]
    simp only [Finset.univ_eq_empty, Finset.sum_empty]
    exact zero_mem _
  obtain ⟨g⟩ := hG
  let l : Fin 3 → ℕ := fun j => (θ j).1
  have h01 : l 0 < l 1 := hθ (by decide)
  have h12 : l 1 < l 2 := hθ (by decide)
  let u₀ : LTree G := LTree.node g (LTree.node g (LTree.leaf (l 0)) (LTree.leaf (l 1)))
    (LTree.leaf (l 2))
  have hu₀ : IsMonY Y u₀ := by
    refine ⟨⟨by simp only [LTree.minLabel_node, LTree.minLabel_leaf]; omega,
      ⟨h01, trivial, trivial⟩, trivial⟩, ?_⟩
    have hnd : ((u₀.labels : List ℕ) : Multiset ℕ).Nodup := by
      simp only [Multiset.coe_nodup, u₀, LTree.labels_node, LTree.labels_leaf, List.cons_append,
        List.nil_append, List.nodup_cons, List.mem_cons, List.not_mem_nil, or_false,
        List.nodup_nil, not_false_eq_true, and_true]
      omega
    refine (Multiset.Nodup.ext hnd Y.nodup).2 fun a => ?_
    simp only [Multiset.mem_coe, Finset.mem_val, u₀, LTree.labels_node, LTree.labels_leaf,
      List.cons_append, List.nil_append, List.mem_cons, List.not_mem_nil, or_false]
    constructor
    · rintro (rfl | rfl | rfl) <;> exact (θ _).2
    · intro ha
      obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := θ.surjective ⟨a, ha⟩
      have hja : (θ j).1 = a := congrArg Subtype.val hj
      subst hja
      fin_cases j
      · exact Or.inl rfl
      · exact Or.inr (Or.inl rfl)
      · exact Or.inr (Or.inr rfl)
  have he₀ : u₀.IsEdge [] false := trivial
  have hins : ∀ j : Fin 3, u₀.winIns false j = LTree.leaf (θ j).1 := fun j => by
    fin_cases j <;> simp [u₀, winIns, winInputs, ins3, h12, l]
  rw [map_tBasis3 c hc θ (u₀.winIns false) hins (fun σ => (hu₀.substAt he₀ σ).toS)
    (fun σ => by simp only [IsMonY.toS_val, substAt, subtreeAt_nil, replaceAt_nil]) y]
  exact relGen_mem_ShIT c hc r hu₀ he₀ hy

name: Operad.ShuffleBarSym.span_le_relIdeal
statement:
theorem span_le_relIdeal (hr3 : ∀ n ≠ 3, r n = ∅)
    (hrS : ∀ σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin 3), ∀ x ∈ r 3,
      GrOperad.map (R := K) σ x ∈ Submodule.span K (r 3)) :
    GrOperadIdeal.span K r ≤ relIdeal c hc r
proof:
:= by
  rw [GrOperadIdeal.span_le]
  intro n x hx
  by_cases hn : n = 3
  · subst hn
    rw [SetLike.mem_coe, mem_relIdeal]
    intro Y e
    have hY : Y.card = 3 := by
      have := Fintype.card_congr e
      simpa using this.symm
    let θ : Fin 3 ≃ Lab Y := (Y.orderIsoOfFin hY).toEquiv
    have hθ : StrictMono fun j => (θ j).1 := fun a b hab =>
      (Y.orderIsoOfFin hY).strictMono hab
    have hmap : GrOperad.map (R := K) e x
        = GrOperad.map (R := K) θ (GrOperad.map (R := K) (e.trans θ.symm) x) := by
      rw [← GrOperad.map_trans, Equiv.trans_assoc, Equiv.symm_trans_self, Equiv.trans_refl]
    rw [hmap]
    refine Submodule.span_induction (p := fun z _ => GrOperad.map (R := K) θ z ∈ ShIT c hc r Y)
      (fun z hz => map_mem_ShIT_three c hc r θ hθ (coord3_mem_Rsh c hc r hz)) ?_ ?_ ?_
      (hrS (e.trans θ.symm) x hx)
    · show GrOperad.map (R := K) θ 0 ∈ _
      rw [map_zero]
      exact zero_mem _
    · intro a b _ _ ha hb
      show GrOperad.map (R := K) θ (a + b) ∈ _
      rw [map_add]
      exact add_mem ha hb
    · intro a z _ hz
      show GrOperad.map (R := K) θ (a • z) ∈ _
      rw [map_smul]
      exact Submodule.smul_mem _ a hz
  · rw [hr3 n hn] at hx
    exact hx.elim

name: Operad.ShuffleBarSym.plug_update_of_not_mem
statement:
lemma plug_update_of_not_mem {a : ℕ} {t : LTree G} (C : LTree G) (ha : a ∉ t.labels) :
    t.plug (update LTree.leaf a C) = t
proof:
:= by
  rw [plug_congr (ins' := LTree.leaf) fun x hx => update_of_ne (fun h => ha (by rw [← h]; exact hx))
    _ _, ShuffleBar.plug_leaf]

name: Operad.ShuffleBarSym.graftOff_labels
statement:
lemma graftOff_labels {u' C : LTree G} {a : ℕ} (hCa : a ∈ C.labels) (ha : a ∈ u'.labels)
    (hnd : (u'.plug (update LTree.leaf a C)).labels.Nodup) :
    u'.labels.Nodup ∧ C.labels.Nodup ∧ (∀ x ∈ u'.labels, x ≠ a → x ∉ C.labels) ∧
      ∀ x, x ∈ (u'.plug (update LTree.leaf a C)).labels ↔ (x ∈ u'.labels ∧ x ≠ a) ∨ x ∈ C.labels
proof:
:= by
  rw [labels_plug] at hnd ⊢
  have hF : ∀ z, z ∈ (update LTree.leaf a C z).labels := fun z => by
    by_cases hz : z = a
    · subst hz
      rw [update_self]
      exact hCa
    · rw [update_of_ne hz]
      simp
  obtain ⟨hnd1, hpw⟩ := List.nodup_flatMap.1 hnd
  have hdis := hpw.forall (fun x y h => List.Disjoint.symm h)
  refine ⟨hpw.imp_of_mem fun {x y} _ _ hd hxy => ?_, by simpa using hnd1 a ha, ?_, fun x => ?_⟩
  · subst hxy
    exact hd (hF x) (hF x)
  · intro x hx hxa hxC
    have := hdis hx ha hxa
    exact this (hF x) (show x ∈ (update LTree.leaf a C a).labels by rw [update_self]; exact hxC)
  · rw [List.mem_flatMap]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨z, hz, hxz⟩
      by_cases hza : z = a
      · subst hza
        rw [update_self] at hxz
        exact Or.inr hxz
      · rw [update_of_ne hza] at hxz
        simp only [LTree.labels_leaf, List.mem_singleton] at hxz
        subst hxz
        exact Or.inl ⟨hz, hza⟩
    · rintro (⟨hx, hxa⟩ | hx)
      · exact ⟨x, hx, by rw [update_of_ne hxa]; simp⟩
      · exact ⟨a, ha, by rw [update_self]; exact hx⟩

name: Operad.ShuffleBarSym.isMonY_toFinset
statement:
lemma isMonY_toFinset {u : LTree G} (hs : u.IsShuffle) (hnd : u.labels.Nodup) :
    IsMonY u.labels.toFinset u
proof:
:=
  ⟨hs, by rw [List.toFinset_val, hnd.dedup]⟩

name: Operad.ShuffleBarSym.graftOff
statement:
lemma graftOff {Y : Finset ℕ} {u' C : LTree G} {a : ℕ}
    (hu : IsMonY Y (u'.plug (update LTree.leaf a C))) (hu' : u'.IsShuffle) (hC : C.IsShuffle)
    (hCa : C.minLabel = a) (ha : a ∈ u'.labels) :
    ∃ (_ : IsMonY u'.labels.toFinset u') (_ : IsMonY C.labels.toFinset C)
      (Ψ : Without (Lab u'.labels.toFinset) ⟨a, List.mem_toFinset.2 ha⟩ ⊕ Lab C.labels.toFinset
        ≃ Lab Y),
      (∀ z, (Ψ z).1 = FreeGrL.sval z) ∧ a ∈ C.labels.toFinset ∧ ∀ y ∈ C.labels.toFinset, a ≤ y
proof:
:= by
  have hCa' : a ∈ C.labels := hCa ▸ minLabel_mem C
  obtain ⟨hnd₁, hnd₂, hd, hmem⟩ := graftOff_labels hCa' ha hu.nodup
  obtain ⟨Ψ, hΨ⟩ := FreeGrL.exists_svalEquiv (Y₁ := u'.labels.toFinset) (Y₂ := C.labels.toFinset)
    (Y := Y) ⟨a, List.mem_toFinset.2 ha⟩ (fun x hx hxa hx₂ => hd x (List.mem_toFinset.1 hx) hxa
      (List.mem_toFinset.1 hx₂)) fun x => by
    rw [← Finset.mem_val, ← hu.2, Multiset.mem_coe, hmem]
    simp only [List.mem_toFinset]
  exact ⟨isMonY_toFinset hu' hnd₁, isMonY_toFinset hC hnd₂, Ψ, hΨ, List.mem_toFinset.2 hCa',
    fun y hy => hCa ▸ minLabel_le_of_mem C (List.mem_toFinset.1 hy)⟩

name: Operad.ShuffleBarSym.relGen_mem_graftOff_left
statement:
theorem relGen_mem_graftOff_left {Y : Finset ℕ} {u u' C : LTree G} {a : ℕ} (hu : IsMonY Y u)
    (hplug : u'.plug (update LTree.leaf a C) = u) (hu' : u'.IsShuffle) (hC : C.IsShuffle)
    (hCa : C.minLabel = a) (ha : a ∈ u'.labels) {p : List Bool} {s : Bool} (he : u.IsEdge p s)
    (he' : u'.IsEdge p s) (ρ : Mono G 3 → K)
    (ih : ∀ hu₁ : IsMonY u'.labels.toFinset u', relGen c hc hu₁ he' ρ
      ∈ I.sub (Lab u'.labels.toFinset)) :
    relGen c hc hu he ρ ∈ I.sub (Lab Y)
proof:
:= by
  subst hplug
  obtain ⟨hu₁, hC₂, Ψ, hΨ, ha₂, hmin⟩ := graftOff hu hu' hC hCa ha
  have hf : hC₂.toS.1.first = a := first_eq_of_min _ ha₂ hmin
  have : relGen c hc hu he ρ = GrOperad.map (R := K) Ψ (GrOperad.comp (R := K)
      ⟨a, List.mem_toFinset.2 ha⟩ (relGen c hc hu₁ he' ρ) (labBasis c hc _ hC₂.toS)) := by
    simp only [relGen, map_sum, map_smul, LinearMap.sum_apply, LinearMap.smul_apply]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun σ _ => congrArg _ ?_
    refine (comp_labBasis c hc _ hC₂.toS _ hf Ψ hΨ _ ?_).symm
    rw [IsMonY.toS_val, IsMonY.toS_val, IsMonY.toS_val, (substAt_plug_update he' hCa σ.1).2,
      toBinSTree_plug, toBinSTree_update]
  rw [this]
  exact I.map_mem _ (I.comp_mem_left _ _ (ih hu₁))

name: Operad.ShuffleBarSym.relGen_mem_graftOff_right
statement:
theorem relGen_mem_graftOff_right {Y : Finset ℕ} {u u' C : LTree G} {a : ℕ} (hu : IsMonY Y u)
    (hplug : u'.plug (update LTree.leaf a C) = u) (hu' : u'.IsShuffle) (hC : C.IsShuffle)
    (hCa : C.minLabel = a) (ha : a ∈ u'.labels) {P p' : List Bool} {s : Bool}
    (hP : P = leafPos a u' ++ p') (he : u.IsEdge P s) (he' : C.IsEdge p' s) (ρ : Mono G 3 → K)
    (ih : ∀ hC₂ : IsMonY C.labels.toFinset C, relGen c hc hC₂ he' ρ
      ∈ I.sub (Lab C.labels.toFinset)) :
    relGen c hc hu he ρ ∈ I.sub (Lab Y)
proof:
:= by
  subst hplug hP
  obtain ⟨hu₁, hC₂, Ψ, hΨ, ha₂, hmin⟩ := graftOff hu hu' hC hCa ha
  have : relGen c hc hu he ρ = GrOperad.map (R := K) Ψ (GrOperad.comp (R := K)
      ⟨a, List.mem_toFinset.2 ha⟩ (labBasis c hc _ hu₁.toS) (relGen c hc hC₂ he' ρ)) := by
    simp only [relGen, map_sum, map_smul]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun σ _ => congrArg _ ?_
    refine (comp_labBasis c hc hu₁.toS _ _ (first_eq_of_min _ ha₂ hmin) Ψ hΨ _ ?_).symm
    rw [IsMonY.toS_val, IsMonY.toS_val, IsMonY.toS_val,
      (plug_update_substAt hu₁.nodup ha he' σ.1).2, toBinSTree_plug, toBinSTree_update]
  rw [this]
  exact I.map_mem _ (I.comp_mem_right _ _ (ih hC₂))

name: Operad.ShuffleBarSym.relGen_mem_base
statement:
theorem relGen_mem_base {y : FreeGrL K E (Fin 3)} (hy : y ∈ I.sub (Fin 3)) {Y : Finset ℕ}
    {u : LTree G} (hu : IsMonY Y u) {s : Bool} (he : u.IsEdge [] s)
    (hleaf : ∀ j : Fin 3, u.winIns s j = LTree.leaf (u.winIns s j).minLabel) :
    relGen c hc hu he (coord3 c hc y) ∈ I.sub (Lab Y)
proof:
:= by
  have w := winSpec_of_edge he hu.1 hu.nodup
  simp only [subtreeAt_nil] at w
  let l : Fin 3 → ℕ := fun j => (u.winIns s j).minLabel
  have hmono : StrictMono l := fun i j hij => w.mono i j hij j.2
  have h0 : u.winIns s 0 = LTree.leaf (u.winIns s 0).minLabel := hleaf 0
  have h1 : u.winIns s 1 = LTree.leaf (u.winIns s 1).minLabel := hleaf 1
  have h2 : u.winIns s 2 = LTree.leaf (u.winIns s 2).minLabel := hleaf 2
  have hmemY : ∀ x, x ∈ Y ↔ ∃ j, l j = x := fun x => by
    rw [← Finset.mem_val, ← hu.2, Multiset.mem_coe]
    refine ⟨fun hx => ?_, fun ⟨j, hj⟩ => ?_⟩
    · have hx' := w.perm.subset hx
      rw [h0, h1, h2] at hx'
      simp only [LTree.labels_leaf, List.cons_append, List.nil_append, List.mem_cons,
        List.not_mem_nil, or_false] at hx'
      rcases hx' with h | h | h
      · exact ⟨0, h.symm⟩
      · exact ⟨1, h.symm⟩
      · exact ⟨2, h.symm⟩
    · refine w.perm.symm.subset ?_
      rw [h0, h1, h2]
      subst hj
      fin_cases j <;> simp [l]
  let θ : Fin 3 ≃ Lab Y := Equiv.ofBijective (fun j => ⟨l j, (hmemY _).2 ⟨j, rfl⟩⟩)
    ⟨fun i j h => hmono.injective (congrArg Subtype.val h), fun x => by
      obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := (hmemY x.1).1 x.2
      exact ⟨j, Subtype.ext hj⟩⟩
  have : relGen c hc hu he (coord3 c hc y) = GrOperad.map (R := K) θ y :=
    (map_tBasis3 c hc θ (u.winIns s) (fun j => hleaf j) (fun σ => (hu.substAt he σ).toS)
      (fun σ => by simp only [IsMonY.toS_val, substAt, subtreeAt_nil, replaceAt_nil]) y).symm
  rw [this]
  exact I.map_mem θ hy

name: Operad.ShuffleBarSym.size_pos'
statement:
lemma size_pos' : ∀ t : LTree G, 0 < t.size
  | .leaf _ => by simp
  | .node _ _ _ => by simp

name: Operad.ShuffleBarSym.not_mem_right
statement: lemma not_mem_right {l₁ l₂ : List ℕ} (h : (l₁ ++ l₂).Nodup) {x : ℕ} (hx : x ∈ l₁) : x ∉ l₂
proof:
:=
  fun hx₂ => (List.nodup_append.1 h).2.2 x hx x hx₂ rfl

name: Operad.ShuffleBarSym.not_mem_left
statement: lemma not_mem_left {l₁ l₂ : List ℕ} (h : (l₁ ++ l₂).Nodup) {x : ℕ} (hx : x ∈ l₂) : x ∉ l₁
proof:
:=
  fun hx₁ => (List.nodup_append.1 h).2.2 x hx₁ x hx rfl

name: Operad.ShuffleBarSym.relGen_mem
statement:
theorem relGen_mem {y : FreeGrL K E (Fin 3)} (hy : y ∈ I.sub (Fin 3)) :
    ∀ (N : ℕ) {Y : Finset ℕ} {u : LTree G} (hu : IsMonY Y u), u.size ≤ N →
      ∀ {p : List Bool} {s : Bool} (he : u.IsEdge p s),
        relGen c hc hu he (coord3 c hc y) ∈ I.sub (Lab Y)
  | 0, _, u, _, hN, _, _, _ => by
    have
proof:
:= size_pos' u
    omega
  | N + 1, Y, .leaf a, hu, hN, p, s, he => by
    exfalso
    rcases p with _ | ⟨b, p⟩ <;> rcases s with _ | _ <;> exact he
  | N + 1, Y, .node g l r, hu, hN, false :: p', s, he => by
    have hnd := hu.nodup
    simp only [LTree.labels_node] at hnd
    have hs := hu.1
    have hlr : l.minLabel ∉ r.labels := not_mem_right hnd (minLabel_mem l)
    refine relGen_mem_graftOff_right c hc I hu (u' := .node g (.leaf l.minLabel) r) (C := l)
      (a := l.minLabel) ?_ ⟨hs.1, trivial, hs.2.2⟩ hs.2.1 rfl (by simp) (p' := p') ?_ he he _
      fun hC₂ => relGen_mem hy N hC₂ (by simp only [size_node] at hN; omega) he
    · simp only [plug, update_self]
      rw [plug_update_of_not_mem l hlr]
    · simp [leafPos]
  | N + 1, Y, .node g l r, hu, hN, true :: p', s, he => by
    have hnd := hu.nodup
    simp only [LTree.labels_node] at hnd
    have hs := hu.1
    have hrl : r.minLabel ∉ l.labels := not_mem_left hnd (minLabel_mem r)
    refine relGen_mem_graftOff_right c hc I hu (u' := .node g l (.leaf r.minLabel)) (C := r)
      (a := r.minLabel) ?_ ⟨hs.1, hs.2.1, trivial⟩ hs.2.2 rfl (by simp) (p' := p') ?_ he he _
      fun hC₂ => relGen_mem hy N hC₂ (by simp only [size_node] at hN; omega) he
    · simp only [plug, update_self]
      rw [plug_update_of_not_mem r hrl]
    · simp [leafPos, hrl]
  | N + 1, Y, .node g (.leaf x) Z, hu, hN, [], false, he => by
    exfalso
    rcases Z with _ | _ <;> exact he
  | N + 1, Y, .node g (.node g' A B) Z, hu, hN, [], false, he => by
    have hnd := hu.nodup
    simp only [LTree.labels_node] at hnd
    have hAB := (List.nodup_append.1 hnd).1
    obtain ⟨h1, ⟨h2, hA, hB⟩, hZ⟩ := hu.1
    simp only [LTree.minLabel_node] at h1
    have hsz := hN
    simp only [size_node] at hsz
    rcases A with x | ⟨gA, Al, Ar⟩
    · rcases B with x' | ⟨gB, Bl, Br⟩
      · rcases Z with x'' | ⟨gZ, Zl, Zr⟩
        · refine relGen_mem_base c hc I hy hu he fun j => ?_
          fin_cases j <;> simp only [winIns, winInputs, ins3] <;> split_ifs <;> rfl
        · 
          have ha : (LTree.node gZ Zl Zr).minLabel ∉ (LTree.leaf x).labels ++ (LTree.leaf x').labels
            := not_mem_left hnd (minLabel_mem _)
          have hx : x ≠ (LTree.node gZ Zl Zr).minLabel := fun h => ha (by simp [h])
          have hx' : x' ≠ (LTree.node gZ Zl Zr).minLabel := fun h => ha (by simp [h])
          refine relGen_mem_graftOff_left c hc I hu
            (u' := .node g (.node g' (.leaf x) (.leaf x')) (.leaf (LTree.node gZ Zl Zr).minLabel))
            (C := .node gZ Zl Zr) ?_ ⟨h1, ⟨h2, trivial, trivial⟩, trivial⟩ hZ rfl (by simp) he
            trivial _ fun hu₁ => relGen_mem hy N hu₁ ?_ (p := []) (s := false) trivial
          · simp only [plug, update_self, update_of_ne hx, update_of_ne hx']
          · have := size_pos' Zl
            have := size_pos' Zr
            simp only [size_node, size_leaf] at hsz ⊢
            omega
      · 
        have hb : (LTree.node gB Bl Br).minLabel ∉ (LTree.leaf x).labels :=
          not_mem_left hAB (minLabel_mem _)
        have hx : x ≠ (LTree.node gB Bl Br).minLabel := fun h => hb (by simp [h])
        have hbZ : (LTree.node gB Bl Br).minLabel ∉ Z.labels :=
          not_mem_right hnd (List.mem_append_right _ (minLabel_mem _))
        refine relGen_mem_graftOff_left c hc I hu
          (u' := .node g (.node g' (.leaf x) (.leaf (LTree.node gB Bl Br).minLabel)) Z)
          (C := .node gB Bl Br) ?_ ⟨by simpa using h1, ⟨h2, trivial, trivial⟩, hZ⟩ hB rfl
          (by simp) he trivial _ fun hu₁ => relGen_mem hy N hu₁ ?_ (p := []) (s := false) trivial
        · simp only [plug, update_self, update_of_ne hx]
          rw [plug_update_of_not_mem _ hbZ]
        · have := size_pos' Bl
          have := size_pos' Br
          simp only [size_node, size_leaf] at hsz ⊢
          omega
    · 
      have ha : (LTree.node gA Al Ar).minLabel ∉ B.labels :=
        not_mem_right hAB (minLabel_mem _)
      have haZ : (LTree.node gA Al Ar).minLabel ∉ Z.labels :=
        not_mem_right hnd (List.mem_append_left _ (minLabel_mem _))
      refine relGen_mem_graftOff_left c hc I hu
        (u' := .node g (.node g' (.leaf (LTree.node gA Al Ar).minLabel) B) Z)
        (C := .node gA Al Ar) ?_ ⟨by simpa [LTree.minLabel_node] using h1, ⟨h2, trivial, hB⟩, hZ⟩
        hA rfl (by simp) he trivial _
        fun hu₁ => relGen_mem hy N hu₁ ?_ (p := []) (s := false) trivial
      · simp only [plug, update_self]
        rw [plug_update_of_not_mem _ ha, plug_update_of_not_mem _ haZ]
      · have := size_pos' Al
        have := size_pos' Ar
        simp only [size_node, size_leaf] at hsz ⊢
        omega
  | N + 1, Y, .node g X (.leaf x), hu, hN, [], true, he => by
    exfalso
    rcases X with _ | _ <;> exact he
  | N + 1, Y, .node g X (.node g' A B), hu, hN, [], true, he => by
    have hnd := hu.nodup
    simp only [LTree.labels_node] at hnd
    have hAB := (List.nodup_append.1 hnd).2.1
    obtain ⟨h1, hX, ⟨h2, hA, hB⟩⟩ := hu.1
    simp only [LTree.minLabel_node] at h1
    have hsz := hN
    simp only [size_node] at hsz
    rcases X with x | ⟨gX, Xl, Xr⟩
    · rcases A with x' | ⟨gA, Al, Ar⟩
      · rcases B with x'' | ⟨gB, Bl, Br⟩
        · refine relGen_mem_base c hc I hy hu he fun j => ?_
          fin_cases j <;> simp only [winIns, winInputs_true, ins3] <;> rfl
        · 
          have hb : (LTree.node gB Bl Br).minLabel ∉ (LTree.leaf x').labels :=
            not_mem_left hAB (minLabel_mem _)
          have hbX : (LTree.node gB Bl Br).minLabel ∉ (LTree.leaf x).labels :=
            not_mem_left hnd (List.mem_append_right _ (minLabel_mem _))
          have hx : x ≠ (LTree.node gB Bl Br).minLabel := fun h => hbX (by simp [h])
          have hx' : x' ≠ (LTree.node gB Bl Br).minLabel := fun h => hb (by simp [h])
          refine relGen_mem_graftOff_left c hc I hu
            (u' := .node g (.leaf x) (.node g' (.leaf x') (.leaf (LTree.node gB Bl Br).minLabel)))
            (C := .node gB Bl Br) ?_ ⟨by simpa using h1, trivial, ⟨h2, trivial, trivial⟩⟩ hB rfl
            (by simp) he (isEdgeRoot_true _ _ _ _ _) _
            fun hu₁ => relGen_mem hy N hu₁ ?_ (p := []) (s := true) (isEdgeRoot_true _ _ _ _ _)
          · simp only [plug, update_self, update_of_ne hx, update_of_ne hx']
          · have := size_pos' Bl
            have := size_pos' Br
            simp only [size_node, size_leaf] at hsz ⊢
            omega
      · 
        have ha : (LTree.node gA Al Ar).minLabel ∉ B.labels :=
          not_mem_right hAB (minLabel_mem _)
        have haX : (LTree.node gA Al Ar).minLabel ∉ (LTree.leaf x).labels :=
          not_mem_left hnd (List.mem_append_left _ (minLabel_mem _))
        have hx : x ≠ (LTree.node gA Al Ar).minLabel := fun h => haX (by simp [h])
        refine relGen_mem_graftOff_left c hc I hu
          (u' := .node g (.leaf x) (.node g' (.leaf (LTree.node gA Al Ar).minLabel) B))
          (C := .node gA Al Ar) ?_ ⟨by simpa [LTree.minLabel_node] using h1, trivial,
            ⟨by simpa [LTree.minLabel_node] using h2, trivial, hB⟩⟩ hA rfl (by simp) he
          (isEdgeRoot_true _ _ _ _ _) _
          fun hu₁ => relGen_mem hy N hu₁ ?_ (p := []) (s := true) (isEdgeRoot_true _ _ _ _ _)
        · simp only [plug, update_self, update_of_ne hx]
          rw [plug_update_of_not_mem _ ha]
        · have := size_pos' Al
          have := size_pos' Ar
          simp only [size_node, size_leaf] at hsz ⊢
          omega
    · 
      have hx : (LTree.node gX Xl Xr).minLabel ∉ A.labels ++ B.labels :=
        not_mem_right hnd (minLabel_mem _)
      have hxA : (LTree.node gX Xl Xr).minLabel ∉ A.labels := fun h => hx (List.mem_append_left _ h)
      have hxB : (LTree.node gX Xl Xr).minLabel ∉ B.labels :=
        fun h => hx (List.mem_append_right _ h)
      refine relGen_mem_graftOff_left c hc I hu
        (u' := .node g (.leaf (LTree.node gX Xl Xr).minLabel) (.node g' A B))
        (C := .node gX Xl Xr) ?_ ⟨by simpa [LTree.minLabel_node] using h1, trivial, ⟨h2, hA, hB⟩⟩
        hX rfl (by simp) he (isEdgeRoot_true _ _ _ _ _) _
        fun hu₁ => relGen_mem hy N hu₁ ?_ (p := []) (s := true) (isEdgeRoot_true _ _ _ _ _)
      · simp only [plug, update_self]
        rw [plug_update_of_not_mem _ hxA, plug_update_of_not_mem _ hxB]
      · have := size_pos' Xl
        have := size_pos' Xr
        simp only [size_node, size_leaf] at hsz ⊢
        omega

name: Operad.ShuffleBarSym.ShIT_le
statement:
theorem ShIT_le (hr : ∀ y ∈ r 3, y ∈ I.sub (Fin 3)) (Y : Finset ℕ) :
    ShIT c hc r Y ≤ I.sub (Lab Y)
proof:
:= by
  rw [ShIT, Submodule.span_le]
  rintro _ ⟨u, hu, p, s, he, ρ, hρ, rfl⟩
  refine Submodule.span_induction (p := fun ρ _ => relGen c hc hu he ρ ∈ I.sub (Lab Y)) ?_ ?_ ?_
    ?_ hρ
  · rintro _ ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩
    exact relGen_mem c hc I (hr y hy) _ hu le_rfl he
  · simp only [relGen, Pi.zero_apply, zero_smul, Finset.sum_const_zero]
    exact zero_mem _
  · intro a b _ _ ha hb
    simp only [relGen, Pi.add_apply, add_smul, Finset.sum_add_distrib] at ha hb ⊢
    exact add_mem ha hb
  · intro a b _ hb
    simp only [relGen, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, mul_smul, ← Finset.smul_sum] at hb ⊢
    exact Submodule.smul_mem _ a hb

name: Operad.Homology.map_bijective_congr
statement:
lemma Homology.map_bijective_congr {R : Type*} [CommRing R] {M N : Type*} [AddCommGroup M]
    [Module R M] [AddCommGroup N] [Module R N] {dV dV' : M →ₗ[R] M} {dW : N →ₗ[R] N}
    {F F' : M →ₗ[R] N} (hd : dV = dV') (hFF : F = F') (hF : ∀ v, F (dV v) = dW (F v))
    (hF' : ∀ v, F' (dV' v) = dW (F' v)) :
    Function.Bijective (Homology.map (dV := dV) F hF)
      ↔ Function.Bijective (Homology.map (dV := dV') F' hF')
proof:
:= by
  subst hd hFF
  rfl

name: Operad.Homology.bijective_comp_iff
proof:
:= by
  subst hH
  rw [Homology.map_comp F hF G hG, LinearMap.coe_comp]
  exact hGb.of_comp_iff' _

name: Operad.FreeGrL.mem_unitSpan_of_card_le
statement:
theorem mem_unitSpan_of_card_le
    (hred : ∀ (B : Type) [Fintype B] [DecidableEq B], Fintype.card B ≤ 1 → ∀ v : V B, v = 0)
    {A : Type} [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] (hA : Fintype.card A ≤ 1) (x : FreeGrL R V A) :
    x ∈ GrCooperad.unitSpan R (FreeGrL R V) A
proof:
:= by
  have hx : x ∈ ⨆ j : ℕ, vx R V j A := (iSup_vx (R := R) (V := V) A).symm ▸ Submodule.mem_top
  refine (iSup_le (fun j z hz => ?_) : (⨆ j : ℕ, vx R V j A)
    ≤ GrCooperad.unitSpan R (FreeGrL R V) A) hx
  rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos j with h | h
  · subst h
    have h3 := Cobar.ιL_vx_zero hz
    rw [Cobar.ιL_apply, ← map_zero ((FreeGrL.ι R (CobarGen R (FreeGrL R V))).app A)] at h3
    exact (Submodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero _).1 (FreeGrL.ι_injective h3)
  · rw [eig_card_eq_bot hred (by omega) hz]
    exact zero_mem _

name: Operad.Bar.counit_comp_map
statement:
theorem counit_comp_map (hI0 : ∀ x ∈ I.sub (Fin 0), x = 0) (f : GrCooperadHom R C (BarCoop I))
    (hf : f.app Unit (GrCooperad.Coaug.one (R := R) (C := C))
      = GrCooperad.Coaug.one (R := R) (C := BarCoop I))
    (φ : GrOperadHom R (CobarGr R C) (ZeroDG R P))
    (hφ : ∀ (A : Type) [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] (x : C A),
      φ.app A (Cobar.ιL R C A x) = piL I A (f.app A x)) :
    (counit I hI0).1.comp (CobarMap.map f hf) = φ
proof:
:=
  FreeGrL.hom_ext fun A _ _ v => by
    obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := GrCooperad.Red.proj_surjective (R := R) (C := C) A v
    show (counit I hI0).1.app A ((CobarMap.map f hf).app A (Cobar.ιL R C A x))
      = φ.app A (Cobar.ιL R C A x)
    rw [CobarMap.map_ιL, counit_ιL, hφ]

name: Operad.Koszul.dual_mem_unitSpan
statement:
theorem dual_mem_unitSpan
    (hEred : ∀ (B : Type) [Fintype B] [DecidableEq B], Fintype.card B ≤ 1 → ∀ v : E B, v = 0)
    {A : Type} [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] (hA : Fintype.card A ≤ 1) (x : Dual R E r A) :
    x ∈ GrCooperad.unitSpan R (Dual R E r) A
proof:
:= by
  have hx := FreeGrL.mem_unitSpan_of_card_le (R := R) (V := GrSpecies.Shift E R)
    (fun B _ _ hB v => hEred B hB v) hA ((dualSub R E r).incl A x)
  have h : Submodule.map ((dualSub R E r).incl A) (GrCooperad.unitSpan R (Dual R E r) A)
      = GrCooperad.unitSpan R (Cut R E) A := by
    rw [GrCooperad.unitSpan, GrCooperad.unitSpanOf, Submodule.map_span, ← Set.range_comp]
    rfl
  rw [← h] at hx
  obtain ⟨y, hy, hxy⟩ := hx
  rwa [(dualSub R E r).incl_injective A hxy] at hy

name: Operad.Koszul.bar_mem_unitSpan
statement:
theorem bar_mem_unitSpan {A : Type} [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] (hA : Fintype.card A ≤ 1)
    (x : BarCoop I A) : x ∈ GrCooperad.unitSpan R (BarCoop I) A
proof:
:=
  FreeGrL.mem_unitSpan_of_card_le (R := R) (V := BarGen I)
    (fun B _ _ hB v => IdealSp.ext I (hI1 B hB _ (IdealSp.mem I v))) hA x

name: Operad.Koszul.toBar_one
statement:
lemma toBar_one : (toBar I hE).app Unit (GrCooperad.Coaug.one (R := R) (C := Dual R E r))
    = GrCooperad.Coaug.one (R := R) (C := BarCoop I)
proof:
:=
  (FreeGrL.mapSp (barGen I hE)).app_one

name: Operad.Koszul.counit_comp
statement:
theorem counit_comp (hI0 : ∀ x ∈ I.sub (Fin 0), x = 0) :
    (Bar.counit I hI0).1.comp (CobarMap.map (toBar I hE) (toBar_one I hE)) = (cobarMor R E r).1
proof:
:=
  Bar.counit_comp_map hI0 (toBar I hE) (toBar_one I hE) _ fun _ _ _ x =>
    (Cobar.homOf_ιL _ _ _ x).trans ((kappa_apply r x).trans (piL_mapSp I hE _).symm)

name: Operad.Koszul.isKoszul_iff
statement:
theorem isKoszul_iff
    (hEred : ∀ (B : Type) [Fintype B] [DecidableEq B], Fintype.card B ≤ 1 → ∀ v : E B, v = 0)
    (hcompl : ∀ (A : Type) [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A],
      IsCompl (Bar.unitsP (Pres R E r) A) (I.sub A))
    (hone : ∀ a : R, a • GrOperad.one (R := R) (P := Pres R E r) = 0 → a = 0) :
    IsKoszul R E r ↔ ∀ (B : Type) [Fintype B] [DecidableEq B], 2 ≤ Fintype.card B →
      Function.Bijective (Homology.map (dV := (0 : Dual R E r B →ₗ[R] Dual R E r B))
        (dW := DGCooperad.d (R := R) (C := BarCoop I) (A := B)) ((toBar I hE).app B)
          fun x => by rw [LinearMap.zero_apply, map_zero, d_toBar I hE hI1])
proof:
:= by
  have hI0 : ∀ y ∈ I.sub (Fin 0), y = 0 := hI1 (Fin 0) (by simp)
  refine Iff.trans ?_ (CobarZero.map_bijective_iff (toBar I hE) (toBar_one I hE)
    (fun A _ _ x => d_toBar I hE hI1 x) (fun B _ _ hB x => dual_mem_unitSpan hEred hB x)
    (fun B _ _ hB x => bar_mem_unitSpan I hI1 hB x)).symm
  refine forall_congr' fun A => forall_congr' fun _ => forall_congr' fun _ => ?_
  exact Homology.bijective_comp_iff
    (congrArg (fun φ : GrOperadHom R (CobarGr R (Dual R E r)) (ZeroDG R (Pres R E r)) =>
      φ.app A) (counit_comp I hE hI0)).symm _ ((Bar.counit I hI0).2 A) _
    (Bar.counit_bijective (I := I) (A := A) hI0 (hcompl A) hone)

name: Operad.FreeGrL.iSup_vx
statement: lemma iSup_vx (A : Type) [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] : ⨆ j : ℕ, vx R V j A = ⊤
proof:
:=
  iSup_eig_eq_top (a := GrSpEnd.id R V) (fun A _ _ v =>
    Submodule.mem_iSup_of_mem 1 (by
      rw [Module.End.mem_eigenspace_iff, Nat.cast_one, one_smul]
      rfl)) A

name: Operad.FreeGrL.vxGe_anti
statement:
lemma vxGe_anti {A : Type} [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] {p q : ℕ} (h : q ≤ p) :
    vxGe R V p A ≤ vxGe R V q A
proof:
:=
  iSup_le fun j => le_iSup_of_le (⟨j.1, le_trans h j.2⟩ : {j : ℕ // q ≤ j}) le_rfl

name: Operad.Cobar.par_mem_wt
statement:
lemma par_mem_wt (b : Bool) {j : ℕ} {Y : CobarGr R 𝒞 A} (hY : Y ∈ wt R V j A) :
    GrOperad.par (R := R) b Y ∈ wt R V j A
proof:
:=
  mem_wt.2 (((wtΩ R V).app_par b Y).trans (by
    rw [Bool.xor_false, mem_wt.1 hY, map_smul]))

name: Operad.Cobar.wtGe_par
statement:
lemma wtGe_par (k : ℕ) (b : Bool) {Y : CobarGr R 𝒞 A} (hY : Y ∈ wtGe k A) :
    GrOperad.par (R := R) b Y ∈ wtGe (V := V) k A
proof:
:=
  (iSup_le (fun j _ hz => Submodule.mem_iSup_of_mem j (par_mem_wt b hz)) :
    wtGe (V := V) k A ≤ (wtGe k A).comap (GrOperad.par (R := R) b)) hY

name: Operad.Cobar.wtGe_map
statement:
lemma wtGe_map {B : Type} [Fintype B] [DecidableEq B] (k : ℕ) (e : A ≃ B)
    {Y : CobarGr R 𝒞 A} (hY : Y ∈ wtGe k A) :
    GrOperad.map (R := R) e Y ∈ wtGe (V := V) k B
proof:
:=
  (iSup_le (fun j _ hz => Submodule.mem_iSup_of_mem j (map_mem_wt e hz)) :
    wtGe (V := V) k A ≤ (wtGe k B).comap (GrOperad.map (R := R) e)) hY

name: Operad.Cobar.wtGe_comp
statement:
lemma wtGe_comp {B : Type} [Fintype B] [DecidableEq B] (a b : ℕ) (r : A)
    {Y : CobarGr R 𝒞 A} {Z : CobarGr R 𝒞 B} (hY : Y ∈ wtGe a A) (hZ : Z ∈ wtGe b B) :
    GrOperad.comp (R := R) r Y Z ∈ wtGe (V := V) (a + b) _
proof:
:= by
  refine (iSup_le (fun i y hy => ?_) : wtGe (V := V) a A ≤ (wtGe (a + b) _).comap
    ((GrOperad.comp (R := R) r).flip Z)) hY
  refine (iSup_le (fun j z hz => ?_) : wtGe (V := V) b B ≤ (wtGe (a + b) _).comap
    (GrOperad.comp (R := R) r y)) hZ
  exact Submodule.mem_iSup_of_mem (⟨i.1 + j.1, by have := i.2; have := j.2; omega⟩ :
    {j : ℕ // a + b ≤ j}) (comp_mem_wt r hy hz)

name: Operad.Cobar.wtGe_par_all
statement:
lemma wtGe_par_all (k : ℕ) : ∀ (A : Type) [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] (b : Bool)
    (Y : CobarGr R 𝒞 A), Y ∈ wtGe (V := V) k A → GrOperad.par (R := R) b Y ∈ wtGe (V := V) k A
proof:
:=
  fun _ _ _ b _ hY => wtGe_par k b hY

name: Operad.Cobar.wtGe_map_all
statement:
lemma wtGe_map_all (k : ℕ) : ∀ (A B : Type) [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] [Fintype B]
    [DecidableEq B] (e : A ≃ B) (Y : CobarGr R 𝒞 A), Y ∈ wtGe (V := V) k A →
    GrOperad.map (R := R) e Y ∈ wtGe (V := V) k B
proof:
:=
  fun _ _ _ _ _ _ e _ hY => wtGe_map k e hY

name: Operad.Cobar.wtGe_comp_all
statement:
lemma wtGe_comp_all (a b c : ℕ) (h : c ≤ a + b) : ∀ (A B : Type) [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A]
    [Fintype B] [DecidableEq B] (r : A) (Y : CobarGr R 𝒞 A) (Z : CobarGr R 𝒞 B),
    Y ∈ wtGe (V := V) a A → Z ∈ wtGe (V := V) b B →
    GrOperad.comp (R := R) r Y Z ∈ wtGe (V := V) c _
proof:
:=
  fun _ _ _ _ _ _ r _ _ hY hZ =>
    (iSup_le fun j => le_iSup_of_le (⟨j.1, le_trans h j.2⟩ : {j : ℕ // c ≤ j}) le_rfl :
      wtGe (V := V) (a + b) _ ≤ wtGe c _) (wtGe_comp a b r hY hZ)

name: Operad.Cobar.ιL_mem_wtGe
statement: lemma ιL_mem_wtGe {k : ℕ} {y : 𝒞 A} (hy : y ∈ vxGe R V k A) : ιL R 𝒞 A y ∈ wtGe (V := V) k A
proof:
:=
  (iSup_le (fun j _ hz => Submodule.mem_iSup_of_mem j (ιL_mem_wt hz)) :
    vxGe R V k A ≤ (wtGe (V := V) k A).comap (ιL R 𝒞 A)) hy

name: Operad.Cobar.ιL_vx_zero
statement: lemma ιL_vx_zero [Algebra ℚ R] {y : 𝒞 A} (hy : y ∈ vx R V 0 A) : ιL R 𝒞 A y = 0
proof:
:= by
  have h := mem_unitsΩ_of_mem_wt (ιL_mem_wt hy)
  rw [← FreeGrL.secC_of_unitCoeff (unitCoeffL_ιL y)]
  refine Submodule.span_induction (p := fun Y _ => FreeGrL.secC R (CobarGen R 𝒞) A Y = 0)
    ?_ (map_zero _) (fun Y Z _ _ hY hZ => by beta_reduce at hY hZ ⊢; rw [map_add, hY, hZ, add_zero])
    (fun c Y _ hY => by beta_reduce at hY ⊢; rw [map_smul, hY, smul_zero]) h
  rintro _ ⟨e, rfl⟩
  exact FreeGrL.secC_unit e

name: Operad.Cobar.ιL_mem_wtGe_one
statement: lemma ιL_mem_wtGe_one [Algebra ℚ R] (y : 𝒞 A) : ιL R 𝒞 A y ∈ wtGe (V := V) 1 A
proof:
:= by
  have hy : y ∈ ⨆ j : ℕ, vx R V j A := (iSup_vx (R := R) (V := V) A).symm ▸ Submodule.mem_top
  refine (iSup_le (fun j z hz => ?_) : (⨆ j : ℕ, vx R V j A) ≤ (wtGe (V := V) 1 A).comap
    (ιL R 𝒞 A)) hy
  rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos j with h | h
  · subst h
    rw [Submodule.mem_comap, ιL_vx_zero hz]
    exact zero_mem _
  · exact Submodule.mem_iSup_of_mem (⟨j, h⟩ : {j : ℕ // 1 ≤ j}) (ιL_mem_wt hz)

name: Operad.ConvOp.toLin_appHom_preDer
statement:
lemma toLin_appHom_preDer {A : Type} [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] (x : C A) :
    toLin ((GrOperad.Inv.appHom (preHom (P := Q) f)
      (GrOperad.Inv.appDer (preDer (C := C') (P := Q)) ι')).1 A) x
      = -toLin (ι'.1 A) (DGCooperad.d (R := R) (f.app A x))
proof:
:= by
  show toLin (GrOperad.tw (R := R) true (ι'.1 A)) (DGCooperad.d (R := R) (f.app A x)) = _
  rw [GrOperad.tw_hom true (hι A), Bool.and_self, σ_true, neg_one_smul, toLin_neg,
    LinearMap.neg_apply]

name: Operad.ConvOp.toLin_star_d
statement:
lemma toLin_star_d {A : Type} [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] (x : C A) :
    toLin ((GrOperad.Inv.star R _ ι' ι').1 A) (DGCooperad.d (R := R) (f.app A x))
      = toLin ((GrOperad.Inv.star R _
          (GrOperad.Inv.appHom (preHom (P := Q) f)
            (GrOperad.Inv.appDer (preDer (C := C') (P := Q)) ι'))
          (GrOperad.Inv.appHom (preHom (P := Q) f) ι')).1 A) x
        - toLin ((GrOperad.Inv.star R _ (GrOperad.Inv.appHom (preHom (P := Q) f) ι')
          (GrOperad.Inv.appHom (preHom (P := Q) f)
            (GrOperad.Inv.appDer (preDer (C := C') (P := Q)) ι'))).1 A) x
proof:
:= by
  have h := GrOperad.Inv.appDer_star (preDer (C := C') (P := Q)) hι ι'
  have h2 := congrArg (GrOperad.Inv.appHom (preHom (P := Q) f)) h
