  rw [map_add, map_smul, GrOperad.Inv.appHom_star, GrOperad.Inv.appHom_star] at h2
  have e := congrArg (fun q : GrOperad.Inv R (ConvOp R C Q) => toLin (q.1 A) x) h2
  simp only [Submodule.coe_add, Submodule.coe_smul, Pi.add_apply, Pi.neg_apply, Bool.and_self,
    σ_true, neg_one_smul, ← sub_eq_add_neg] at e
  have hιι : GrOperad.Inv.IsPar false (GrOperad.Inv.star R _ ι' ι') := by
    have := GrOperad.Inv.isPar_star hι hι
    rwa [Bool.xor_self] at this
  refine Eq.trans ?_ e
  show _ = toLin (GrOperad.tw (R := R) true ((GrOperad.Inv.star R _ ι' ι').1 A))
    (DGCooperad.d (R := R) (f.app A x))
  rw [GrOperad.tw_hom true (hιι A), Bool.true_and, σ_false, one_smul]

name: Operad.ConvOp.toLin_star_d_mem
statement:
theorem toLin_star_d_mem {F G H : ∀ (A : Type) [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A], Submodule R (Q A)}
    (hF : ∀ (A : Type) [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] (b : Bool) (y : Q A), y ∈ F A →
      GrOperad.par (R := R) b y ∈ F A)
    (hG : ∀ (A : Type) [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] (b : Bool) (y : Q A), y ∈ G A →
      GrOperad.par (R := R) b y ∈ G A)
    (hH : ∀ (A B : Type) [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] [Fintype B] [DecidableEq B] (e : A ≃ B)
      (y : Q A), y ∈ H A → GrOperad.map (R := R) e y ∈ H B)
    (hFG : ∀ (A B : Type) [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] [Fintype B] [DecidableEq B] (i : A)
      (y : Q A) (z : Q B), y ∈ F A → z ∈ G B → GrOperad.comp (R := R) i y z ∈ H _)
    (hGF : ∀ (A B : Type) [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] [Fintype B] [DecidableEq B] (i : A)
      (y : Q A) (z : Q B), y ∈ G A → z ∈ F B → GrOperad.comp (R := R) i y z ∈ H _)
    (hα : ∀ (A : Type) [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] (x : C A),
      toLin (ι'.1 A) (DGCooperad.d (R := R) (f.app A x)) ∈ F A)
    (hβ : ∀ (A : Type) [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] (x : C A), toLin (ι'.1 A) (f.app A x) ∈ G A)
    (A : Type) [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] (x : C A) :
    toLin ((GrOperad.Inv.star R _ ι' ι').1 A) (DGCooperad.d (R := R) (f.app A x)) ∈ H A
proof:
:= by
  have hα' : ∀ (A : Type) [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] (x : C A),
      toLin ((GrOperad.Inv.appHom (preHom (P := Q) f)
        (GrOperad.Inv.appDer (preDer (C := C') (P := Q)) ι')).1 A) x ∈ F A := fun A _ _ x => by
    rw [toLin_appHom_preDer f hι]
    exact neg_mem (hα A x)
  rw [toLin_star_d f hι x]
  exact sub_mem (toLin_star_mem hG hH hFG hα' hβ A x) (toLin_star_mem hF hH hGF hβ hα' A x)

name: Operad.Bar.d_map
statement:
lemma d_map (e : A ≃ B) (X : 𝒞 A) :
    d I B (GrOperad.map (R := R) e X) = GrOperad.map (R := R) e (d I A X)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := (𝒥).proj_surjective A X
  show (𝒥).proj B (barD (barMerge I) (grGenPar R (BarGen I)) R B (GrOperad.map (R := R) e x))
    = (𝒥).proj B (GrOperad.map (R := R) e (barD (barMerge I) (grGenPar R (BarGen I)) R A x))
  rw [map_barD]

name: Operad.Bar.d_ι
statement: lemma d_ι (w : BarGen I A) : d I A ((FreeGrL.ι R (BarGen I)).app A w) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [GrSpeciesHom.app_eq_chart (FreeGrL.ι R (BarGen I)) (Fintype.equivFin A).symm,
    FreeGrL.ι_app_fin]
  show d I A (GrOperad.map (R := R) (Fintype.equivFin A).symm
    ((𝒥).proj _ (FreeGr.gen _) + (𝒥).proj _ (FreeGr.gen _))) = 0
  rw [d_map, map_add, d_proj, d_proj, barD_gen, barD_gen, map_zero, add_zero, map_zero]

name: Operad.Bar.d_vx_succ
statement:
lemma d_vx_succ {j : ℕ} {z : 𝒞 A} (hz : z ∈ vx R (BarGen I) (j + 1) A) :
    d I A z ∈ vx R (BarGen I) j A
proof:
:=
  mem_eig.2 (by
    rw [← Cobar.wtD_eq_derSp, wtD_d, Cobar.wtD_eq_derSp, mem_eig.1 hz, map_smul, Nat.cast_succ,
      add_smul, one_smul, add_sub_cancel_right])

name: Operad.Bar.d_vx_zero
statement: lemma d_vx_zero [Algebra ℚ R] {z : 𝒞 A} (hz : z ∈ vx R (BarGen I) 0 A) : d I A z = 0
proof:
:= by
  refine eq_zero_of_eigen_neg R ((derSp (GrSpEnd.id R (BarGen I))).app A)
    (iSup_vx (R := R) (V := BarGen I) A) (m := 1) one_ne_zero ?_
  rw [← Cobar.wtD_eq_derSp, wtD_d, Cobar.wtD_eq_derSp, mem_eig.1 hz, Nat.cast_zero, zero_smul,
    map_zero, zero_sub, Nat.cast_one, neg_one_smul]

name: Operad.Bar.d_vx_one
statement: lemma d_vx_one [Algebra ℚ R] {z : 𝒞 A} (hz : z ∈ vx R (BarGen I) 1 A) : d I A z = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [FreeGrL.eq_ι_genCoef hz, d_ι]

name: Operad.Bar.d_mem_vxGe_one
statement: lemma d_mem_vxGe_one [Algebra ℚ R] (y : 𝒞 A) : d I A y ∈ vxGe R (BarGen I) 1 A
proof:
:= by
  have hy : y ∈ ⨆ j : ℕ, vx R (BarGen I) j A :=
    (iSup_vx (R := R) (V := BarGen I) A).symm ▸ Submodule.mem_top
  refine (iSup_le (fun j z hz => ?_) : (⨆ j : ℕ, vx R (BarGen I) j A)
    ≤ (vxGe R (BarGen I) 1 A).comap (d I A)) hy
  rw [Submodule.mem_comap]
  match j, hz with
  | 0, hz => rw [d_vx_zero hz]; exact zero_mem _
  | 1, hz => rw [d_vx_one hz]; exact zero_mem _
  | j + 2, hz => exact mem_vxGe (by omega) (d_vx_succ hz)

name: Operad.Bar.piL_vx
statement:
lemma piL_vx [Algebra ℚ R] {j : ℕ} (hj : j ≠ 1) {z : 𝒞 A} (hz : z ∈ vx R (BarGen I) j A) :
    piL I A z = 0
proof:
:=
  FreeGrL.snd_eq_zero_of_vx (epsHom I) (fun A _ _ w => by rw [epsHom_ι]; rfl) hj hz

name: Operad.Bar.mem_vxGe_two
statement:
lemma mem_vxGe_two [Algebra ℚ R] {y : 𝒞 A} (hy : y ∈ vxGe R (BarGen I) 1 A)
    (hπ : piL I A y = 0) : y ∈ vxGe R (BarGen I) 2 A
proof:
:= by
  rw [vxGe_eq 1] at hy
  obtain ⟨z, hz, y', hy', rfl⟩ := Submodule.mem_sup.1 hy
  have h2 : piL I A y' = 0 :=
    (iSup_le (fun j w hw => by
      rw [LinearMap.mem_ker, piL_vx (by have := j.2; omega) hw]) :
      vxGe R (BarGen I) 2 A ≤ LinearMap.ker (piL I A)) hy'
  rw [map_add, h2, add_zero, FreeGrL.eq_ι_genCoef hz, piL_ι] at hπ
  have hg : FreeGrL.genCoef R (BarGen I) A z = 0 := IdealSp.ext I hπ
  rw [FreeGrL.eq_ι_genCoef hz, hg, map_zero, zero_add]
  exact hy'

name: Operad.Bar.ιι_d_mem
statement:
lemma ιι_d_mem [Algebra ℚ R] {C : (A : Type) → [Fintype A] → [DecidableEq A] → Type w}
    [∀ (A : Type) [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A], AddCommGroup (C A)]
    [∀ (A : Type) [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A], Module R (C A)] [GrCooperad R C]
    (f : GrCooperadHom R C 𝒞) {k : ℕ}
    (hk : ∀ (A' : Type) [Fintype A'] [DecidableEq A'] (x' : C A'),
      d I A' (f.app A' x') ∈ vxGe R (BarGen I) k A')
    (A : Type) [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] (x : C A) :
    ConvOp.toLin ((Cobar.ιι R 𝒞).1 A) (d I A (f.app A x))
      ∈ Cobar.wtGe (V := BarGen I) (k + 1) A
proof:
:= by
  exact ConvOp.toLin_star_d_mem (D := dgFree I) f (Cobar.isPar_ι R 𝒞)
    (Cobar.wtGe_par_all k) (Cobar.wtGe_par_all 1) (Cobar.wtGe_map_all (k + 1))
    (Cobar.wtGe_comp_all k 1 (k + 1) le_rfl) (Cobar.wtGe_comp_all 1 k (k + 1) (by omega))
    (fun A' _ _ x' => Cobar.ιL_mem_wtGe (hk A' x')) (fun A' _ _ x' => Cobar.ιL_mem_wtGe_one _) A x

name: Operad.Bar.d_app_eq_zero
statement:
theorem d_app_eq_zero [Algebra ℚ R]
    (hred : ∀ (B : Type) [Fintype B] [DecidableEq B], Fintype.card B ≤ 1 →
      ∀ v : BarGen I B, v = 0)
    {C : (A : Type) → [Fintype A] → [DecidableEq A] → Type w}
    [∀ (A : Type) [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A], AddCommGroup (C A)]
    [∀ (A : Type) [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A], Module R (C A)] [GrCooperad R C]
    (f : GrCooperadHom R C 𝒞)
    (hπ : ∀ (A : Type) [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] (x : C A), piL I A (d I A (f.app A x)) = 0)
    (A : Type) [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] (x : C A) : d I A (f.app A x) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hV0 : ∀ v : BarGen I (Fin 0), v = 0 := hred (Fin 0) (by simp)
  have key : ∀ k, 2 ≤ k → ∀ (A' : Type) [Fintype A'] [DecidableEq A'] (x' : C A'),
      d I A' (f.app A' x') ∈ vxGe R (BarGen I) k A' := by
    intro k hk
    induction k, hk using Nat.le_induction with
    | base => exact fun A' _ _ x' => mem_vxGe_two (d_mem_vxGe_one _) (hπ A' x')
    | succ k hk ih =>
      exact fun A' _ _ x' => Cobar.mem_vxGe_succ hV0 hk (ih A' x') (ιι_d_mem f ih A' x')
  have h := key (max 2 (Fintype.card A)) (le_max_left _ _) A x
  have hle := vxGe_anti (R := R) (V := BarGen I) (A := A) (le_max_right 2 (Fintype.card A))
  rw [vxGe_card hred] at hle
  exact (Submodule.mem_bot R).1 (hle h)

name: Operad.Graded.wproj_apply
statement:
lemma wproj_apply (N : ℕ) (v : α →₀ K) (x : α) :
    wproj K W N v x = if W x = N then v x else 0
proof:
:= by
  simp [wproj, Finsupp.filter_apply]

name: Operad.Graded.wproj_wproj
statement:
lemma wproj_wproj (M N : ℕ) (v : α →₀ K) :
    wproj K W N (wproj K W M v) = if M = N then wproj K W N v else 0
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  by_cases hMN : M = N
  · subst hMN
    simp only [wproj_apply, if_true]
    split_ifs <;> rfl
  · rw [if_neg hMN, wproj_apply, wproj_apply]
    split_ifs with h1 h2
    · exact absurd (h2.symm.trans h1) hMN
    · rfl
    · rfl

name: Operad.Graded.wproj_single
statement:
lemma wproj_single (N : ℕ) (x : α) (c : K) :
    wproj K W N (Finsupp.single x c) = if W x = N then Finsupp.single x c else 0
proof:
:= by
  ext y
  rw [wproj_apply]
  by_cases hxy : x = y
  · subst hxy
    split_ifs <;> simp
  · split_ifs <;> simp [hxy]

name: Operad.Graded.mem_filt
statement:
lemma mem_filt {V : Submodule K (α →₀ K)} {N : ℕ} {v : α →₀ K} :
    v ∈ filt K W V N ↔ v ∈ V ∧ IsBelow (K := K) (W := W) N v
proof:
:= by
  simp [filt, Submodule.mem_iInf, IsBelow]

name: Operad.Graded.wproj_mem_grW
statement:
lemma wproj_mem_grW {V : Submodule K (α →₀ K)} {N : ℕ} {v : α →₀ K} (hv : v ∈ V)
    (hN : IsBelow (K := K) (W := W) N v) : wproj K W N v ∈ grW K W V
proof:
:=
  Submodule.mem_iSup_of_mem N (Submodule.mem_map_of_mem (mem_filt.2 ⟨hv, hN⟩))

name: Operad.Graded.grW_le
statement:
lemma grW_le {V P : Submodule K (α →₀ K)}
    (h : ∀ N, ∀ v ∈ V, IsBelow (K := K) (W := W) N v → wproj K W N v ∈ P) : grW K W V ≤ P
proof:
:=
  iSup_le fun N => Submodule.map_le_iff_le_comap.2 fun v hv =>
    h N v (mem_filt.1 hv).1 (mem_filt.1 hv).2

name: Operad.Graded.filt_mono
statement:
lemma filt_mono (V : Submodule K (α →₀ K)) {M N : ℕ} (h : M ≤ N) :
    filt K W V M ≤ filt K W V N
proof:
:= fun _ hv =>
  mem_filt.2 ⟨(mem_filt.1 hv).1, fun k hk => (mem_filt.1 hv).2 k (lt_of_le_of_lt h hk)⟩

name: Operad.Graded.grLe_le_ker
statement:
lemma grLe_le_ker (V : Submodule K (α →₀ K)) (m : ℕ) :
    grLe K W V m ≤ LinearMap.ker (wproj K W (m + 1))
proof:
:= by
  refine Finset.sup_le fun N hN => Submodule.map_le_iff_le_comap.2 fun _ _ => ?_
  rw [Submodule.mem_comap, LinearMap.mem_ker, wproj_wproj,
    if_neg (by rw [Finset.mem_range] at hN; omega)]

name: Operad.Graded.disjoint_grLe
statement:
lemma disjoint_grLe (V : Submodule K (α →₀ K)) (m : ℕ) :
    grLe K W V m ⊓ (filt K W V (m + 1)).map (wproj K W (m + 1)) = ⊥
proof:
:= by
  refine (Submodule.eq_bot_iff _).2 fun x hx => ?_
  obtain ⟨hx1, v, -, rfl⟩ := hx
  have := grLe_le_ker V m hx1
  rwa [LinearMap.mem_ker, wproj_wproj, if_pos rfl] at this

name: Operad.Graded.wproj_eq_self_of_filt_zero
statement: lemma wproj_eq_self_of_filt_zero {v : α →₀ K} (hv : v ∈ filt K W V 0) : wproj K W 0 v = v
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  rw [wproj_apply]
  split_ifs with hx
  · rfl
  · have h := congrArg (fun f => f x) ((mem_filt.1 hv).2 (W x) (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hx))
    simp only [wproj_apply, if_true, Finsupp.coe_zero, Pi.zero_apply] at h
    exact h.symm

name: Operad.Graded.finrank_grLe
statement: lemma finrank_grLe (m : ℕ) : finrank K (grLe K W V m) = finrank K (filt K W V m)
proof:
:= by
  induction m with
  | zero =>
    have hG : grLe K W V 0 = filt K W V 0 := by
      rw [grLe, Finset.range_one, Finset.sup_singleton]
      ext x
      constructor
      · rintro ⟨v, hv, rfl⟩
        rw [wproj_eq_self_of_filt_zero V hv]
        exact hv
      · intro hx
        exact ⟨x, hx, wproj_eq_self_of_filt_zero V hx⟩
    rw [hG]
  | succ m ih =>
    have hG : grLe K W V (m + 1)
        = grLe K W V m ⊔ (filt K W V (m + 1)).map (wproj K W (m + 1)) := by
      rw [grLe, grLe, Finset.range_add_one, Finset.sup_insert, sup_comm]
    have h1 := Submodule.finrank_sup_add_finrank_inf_eq (grLe K W V m)
      ((filt K W V (m + 1)).map (wproj K W (m + 1)))
    rw [disjoint_grLe, finrank_bot, add_zero, ← hG, ih] at h1
    have h2 := ShuffleBar.finrank_eq_map_add K (wproj K W (m + 1)) (filt K W V (m + 1))
    have hker : filt K W V (m + 1) ⊓ LinearMap.ker (wproj K W (m + 1)) = filt K W V m := by
      ext v
      simp only [Submodule.mem_inf, LinearMap.mem_ker]
      constructor
      · rintro ⟨hv, h0⟩
        refine mem_filt.2 ⟨(mem_filt.1 hv).1, fun k hk => ?_⟩
        rcases Nat.lt_or_ge (m + 1) k with h | h
        · exact (mem_filt.1 hv).2 k h
        · rwa [show k = m + 1 by omega]
      · intro h
        exact ⟨filt_mono V (Nat.le_succ m) h, (mem_filt.1 h).2 (m + 1) (Nat.lt_succ_self m)⟩
    rw [hker] at h2
    omega

name: Operad.Graded.finrank_grW
statement:
theorem finrank_grW {B : ℕ} (hB : ∀ v ∈ V, IsBelow (K := K) (W := W) B v) :
    finrank K (grW K W V) = finrank K V
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : grW K W V = grLe K W V B := by
    apply le_antisymm
    · refine iSup_le fun N => ?_
      by_cases hN : N ≤ B
      · exact Finset.le_sup (f := fun N => (filt K W V N).map (wproj K W N))
          (Finset.mem_range.2 (by omega))
      · rintro _ ⟨v, hv, rfl⟩
        rw [hB v (mem_filt.1 hv).1 N (by omega)]
        exact zero_mem _
    · exact Finset.sup_le fun N _ => le_iSup (fun N => (filt K W V N).map (wproj K W N)) N
  have h2 : filt K W V B = V := le_antisymm inf_le_left fun v hv => mem_filt.2 ⟨hv, hB v hv⟩
  rw [h1, finrank_grLe, h2]

name: Operad.LTree.wdeg_leaf
statement: @[simp] lemma wdeg_leaf (w : E → ℕ) (a : ℕ) : wdeg w (leaf a : LTree E) = 0
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.LTree.wdeg_node
statement:
@[simp] lemma wdeg_node (w : E → ℕ) (e : E) (a b : LTree E) :
    wdeg w (node e a b) = w e + wdeg w a + wdeg w b
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.LTree.wdeg_mapDec
statement:
lemma wdeg_mapDec {F : Type*} (f : E → F) (w : F → ℕ) :
    ∀ t : LTree E, wdeg w (t.mapDec f) = wdeg (w ∘ f) t
  | leaf _ => rfl
  | node e a b => by
    simp only [mapDec_node, wdeg_node, wdeg_mapDec f w a, wdeg_mapDec f w b, Function.comp_apply]

name: Operad.LTree.wdeg_plug
statement:
lemma wdeg_plug (w : E → ℕ) (ins : ℕ → LTree E) :
    ∀ m : LTree E, wdeg w (m.plug ins) = wdeg w m + (m.labels.map fun a => wdeg w (ins a)).sum
  | leaf a => by simp [plug, labels]
  | node e a b => by
    simp only [plug, wdeg_node, wdeg_plug w ins a, wdeg_plug w ins b, labels, List.map_append,
      List.sum_append]
    ring

name: Operad.LTree.wdeg_replaceAt
statement:
lemma wdeg_replaceAt (w : E → ℕ) :
    ∀ (t : LTree E) (p : List Bool), (∃ e a b, t.subtreeAt p = node e a b) →
      ∃ c : ℕ, ∀ u : LTree E, wdeg w (t.replaceAt p u) = c + wdeg w u
  | t, [], _ => ⟨0, fun u => by simp⟩
  | leaf _, _ :: _, h => by simp [subtreeAt] at h
  | node e a b, false :: p, h => by
    obtain ⟨c, hc⟩
proof:
:= wdeg_replaceAt w a p h
    exact ⟨w e + wdeg w b + c, fun u => by simp only [replaceAt, wdeg_node, hc]; ring⟩
  | node e a b, true :: p, h => by
    obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := wdeg_replaceAt w b p h
    exact ⟨w e + wdeg w a + c, fun u => by simp only [replaceAt, wdeg_node, hc]; ring⟩

name: Operad.LTree.wdeg_substAt
statement:
lemma wdeg_substAt (w : E → ℕ) {t : LTree E} {p : List Bool} {s : Bool} (h : t.IsEdge p s) :
    ∃ c : ℕ, ∀ m : LTree E, m.labels.Perm (List.range 3) →
      wdeg w (t.substAt p s m) = c + wdeg w m
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := wdeg_replaceAt w t p h.exists_node
  refine ⟨c + (wdeg w ((t.subtreeAt p).winIns s 0) + wdeg w ((t.subtreeAt p).winIns s 1)
    + wdeg w ((t.subtreeAt p).winIns s 2)), fun m hm => ?_⟩
  rw [substAt, hc, wdeg_plug, (hm.map _).sum_eq]
  simp only [List.range_succ, List.range_zero, List.nil_append, List.cons_append, List.map_cons,
    List.map_nil, List.sum_cons, List.sum_nil, add_zero]
  ring

name: Operad.ShuffleBar.wdegB_mergeK
statement:
lemma wdegB_mergeK (w : E → ℕ) : ∀ (x : BarTree E) (k : ℕ ×ₗ ℕ), wdegB w (mergeK x k) = wdegB w x
  | leaf _, _ => rfl
  | node d a b, k => by
    unfold mergeK
    split_ifs
    · rfl
    · have ha
proof:
:= wdegB_mergeK w a k
      have hb := wdegB_mergeK w b k
      simp only [wdegB, wdeg_node] at ha hb ⊢
      rw [ha, hb]

name: Operad.ShuffleBar.wdegB_substBar
statement:
lemma wdegB_substBar (w : E → ℕ) {x : BarTree E} {p : List Bool} {s : Bool} (h : x.IsEdge p s) :
    ∃ c : ℕ, ∀ σ : LTree E, σ.labels.Perm (List.range 3) →
      wdegB w (substBar x p s σ) = c + wdeg w σ
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := wdeg_substAt (w ∘ Prod.fst) h
  refine ⟨c, fun σ hσ => ?_⟩
  rw [wdegB, substBar, hc _ (by rwa [labels_liftW])]
  congr 1
  rw [← wdeg_mapDec Prod.fst w, liftW_mapDec]

name: Operad.ShuffleBar.d_wproj
statement:
lemma d_wproj (N : ℕ) (v : BarTree E →₀ K) :
    d K (wproj K (wdegB w) N v) = wproj K (wdegB w) N (d K v)
proof:
:= by
  induction v using Finsupp.induction_linear with
  | zero => simp
  | add v v' hv hv' => simp only [map_add, hv, hv']
  | single x c =>
    rw [wproj_single, d_single, dTree, Finset.smul_sum]
    simp only [map_sum, map_smul, wproj_single, wdegB_mergeK]
    split_ifs with hx
    · rw [d_single, dTree, Finset.smul_sum]
    · simp

name: Operad.ShuffleBar.wproj_mem_supported
proof:
:= by
  rw [Finsupp.mem_supported] at hv ⊢
  intro x hx
  rw [Finset.mem_coe, Finsupp.mem_support_iff, wproj_apply] at hx
  split_ifs at hx
  · exact hv (Finset.mem_coe.2 (Finsupp.mem_support_iff.2 hx))
  · exact absurd rfl hx

name: Operad.ShuffleBar.wproj_mem_C
statement:
lemma wproj_mem_C {n s : ℕ} {v : BarTree E →₀ K} (hv : v ∈ C K n s) (N : ℕ) :
    wproj K (wdegB w) N v ∈ C K n s
proof:
:=
  wproj_mem_supported w hv N

name: Operad.ShuffleBar.exists_isBelow_C
statement:
lemma exists_isBelow_C (n s : ℕ) :
    ∃ B, ∀ v ∈ C K n s, IsBelow (K := K) (W := wdegB w) B v
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨(finite_adm (E := E) n s).toFinset.sup (wdegB w), fun v hv k hk => ?_⟩
  ext x
  rw [wproj_apply, Finsupp.coe_zero, Pi.zero_apply]
  split_ifs with hx
  · by_contra h0
    have hxA : Adm n s x := hv (Finset.mem_coe.2 (Finsupp.mem_support_iff.2 h0))
    have := Finset.le_sup (f := wdegB w) ((finite_adm (E := E) n s).mem_toFinset.2 hxA)
    omega
  · rfl

name: Operad.ShuffleBar.substRel_add
statement:
lemma substRel_add (x : BarTree E) (p : List Bool) (s : Bool) (r r' : Mono E 3 → K) :
    substRel K x p s (r + r') = substRel K x p s r + substRel K x p s r'
proof:
:= by
  simp only [substRel, Pi.add_apply, add_smul, Finset.sum_add_distrib]

name: Operad.ShuffleBar.substRel_smul
statement:
lemma substRel_smul (x : BarTree E) (p : List Bool) (s : Bool) (c : K) (r : Mono E 3 → K) :
    substRel K x p s (c • r) = c • substRel K x p s r
proof:
:= by
  simp only [substRel, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, mul_smul, Finset.smul_sum]

name: Operad.ShuffleBar.substRel_zero
statement:
lemma substRel_zero (x : BarTree E) (p : List Bool) (s : Bool) :
    substRel K x p s (0 : Mono E 3 → K) = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp [substRel]

name: Operad.ShuffleBar.adm_substBar_iff
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨-, hσ, hσn⟩ := mono_shape σ
  have hv := hx.substBar h σ
  have hl := perm_labels_substBar hx.shuffle hx.nodup h hσ
  have hc := cutKeys_substBar hx.shuffle hx.nodup h hσ hσn
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨-, hp, hk⟩
    exact ⟨hx, hl.symm.trans hp, by rwa [hc] at hk⟩
  · rintro ⟨-, hp, hk⟩
    exact ⟨hv, hl.trans hp, by rwa [hc]⟩

name: Operad.ShuffleBar.restr_single
statement:
lemma restr_single (S : Set (BarTree E)) (x : BarTree E) (c : K) :
    restr S (Finsupp.single x c) = if x ∈ S then Finsupp.single x c else 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  ext y
  simp only [restr, LinearMap.coe_mk, AddHom.coe_mk, Finsupp.filter_apply]
  by_cases hxy : x = y
  · subst hxy
    split_ifs <;> simp_all
  · split_ifs <;> simp_all

name: Operad.ShuffleBar.restr_of_supported
statement:
lemma restr_of_supported {S : Set (BarTree E)} {v : BarTree E →₀ K}
    (hv : v ∈ Finsupp.supported K K S) : restr S v = v
proof:
:= by
  classical
  ext y
  simp only [restr, LinearMap.coe_mk, AddHom.coe_mk, Finsupp.filter_apply]
  split_ifs with hy
  · rfl
  · by_contra h0
    exact hy (hv (Finset.mem_coe.2 (Finsupp.mem_support_iff.2 (Ne.symm h0))))

name: Operad.ShuffleBar.J_inf_C_le
statement: lemma J_inf_C_le (R : Submodule K (Mono E 3 → K)) (n s : ℕ) : J K R ⊓ C K n s ≤ Jgen K R n s
proof:
:= by
  rintro y ⟨hyJ, hyC⟩
  rw [← restr_of_supported hyC]
  have : (J K R).map (restr {x | Adm n s x}) ≤ Jgen K R n s := by
    rw [J, Submodule.map_span, Submodule.span_le]
    rintro _ ⟨_, ⟨x, p, s', r, hx, h, hr, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
    simp only [substRel, map_sum, map_smul, restr_single, Set.mem_setOf_eq,
      adm_substBar_iff hx h]
    split_ifs with hA
    · exact Submodule.subset_span ⟨x, p, s', r, hA, h, hr, by simp [substRel]⟩
    · simp
  exact this (Submodule.mem_map_of_mem hyJ)

name: Operad.ShuffleBar.substRel_wproj
statement:
lemma substRel_wproj {x : BarTree E} {p : List Bool} {s : Bool} (h : IsUncut x p s) :
    ∃ c : ℕ, ∀ (M : ℕ) (r : Mono E 3 → K),
      wproj K (wdegB w) (c + M) (substRel K x p s r) = substRel K x p s (wprojM w M r) ∧
      (IsBelowM w M r → IsBelow (K := K) (W := wdegB w) (c + M) (substRel K x p s r))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := wdegB_substBar w h.1
  have hc' : ∀ σ : Mono E 3, wdegB w (substBar x p s σ.1) = c + wdeg w σ.1 :=
    fun σ => hc σ.1 (mono_shape σ).2.1
  refine ⟨c, fun M r => ⟨?_, fun hr k hk => ?_⟩⟩
  · simp only [substRel, map_sum, map_smul, wproj_single, hc', wprojM]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun σ _ => ?_
    by_cases hσ : wdeg w σ.1 = M
    · simp [hσ]
    · simp [hσ]
  · simp only [substRel, map_sum, map_smul, wproj_single, hc']
    refine Finset.sum_eq_zero fun σ _ => ?_
    by_cases hσ : c + wdeg w σ.1 = k
    · rw [hr σ (by omega), zero_smul]
    · simp [hσ]

name: Operad.ShuffleBar.substRel_mem_C
statement:
lemma substRel_mem_C {x : BarTree E} {p : List Bool} {s : Bool} {n s' : ℕ} (hA : Adm n s' x)
    (h : IsUncut x p s) (r : Mono E 3 → K) : substRel K x p s r ∈ C K n s'
proof:
:= by
  refine Submodule.sum_mem _ fun σ _ => Submodule.smul_mem _ _
    (Finsupp.single_mem_supported K _ ?_)
  exact (adm_substBar_iff hA.1 h σ).2 hA

name: Operad.ShuffleBar.Jgen_le_grW
statement:
theorem Jgen_le_grW (hs : ∀ i, IsBelowM w (N i) (sr i)) {R : Submodule K (Mono E 3 → K)}
    (hsR : ∀ i, sr i ∈ R) (n s : ℕ) :
    Jgen K (Submodule.span K (Set.range fun i => wprojM w (N i) (sr i))) n s ≤
      grW K (wdegB w) (J K R ⊓ C K n s)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Jgen, Submodule.span_le]
  rintro _ ⟨x, p, s', r, hA, h, hr, rfl⟩
  rw [SetLike.mem_coe]
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := substRel_wproj (K := K) w h
  induction hr using Submodule.span_induction with
  | mem r hr =>
    obtain ⟨i, rfl⟩ := hr
    rw [← (hc (N i) (sr i)).1]
    exact wproj_mem_grW ⟨Submodule.subset_span ⟨x, p, s', sr i, hA.1, h, hsR i, rfl⟩,
      substRel_mem_C hA h _⟩ ((hc (N i) (sr i)).2 (hs i))
  | zero => rw [substRel_zero]; exact zero_mem _
  | add r r' _ _ h1 h2 => rw [substRel_add]; exact add_mem h1 h2
  | smul a r _ h1 => rw [substRel_smul]; exact Submodule.smul_mem _ a h1

name: Operad.ShuffleBar.finiteDimensional_C
statement: lemma finiteDimensional_C (n s : ℕ) : FiniteDimensional K (C (E := E) K n s)
proof:
:=
  finiteDimensional_supported K (finite_adm n s)

name: Operad.ShuffleBar.grW_le_C
statement:
lemma grW_le_C {V : Submodule K (BarTree E →₀ K)} {n s : ℕ} (hV : V ≤ C K n s) :
    grW K (wdegB w) V ≤ C K n s
proof:
:=
  grW_le fun _ _ hv _ => wproj_mem_C w (hV hv) _

name: Operad.ShuffleBar.finrank_grW_of_le_C
statement:
lemma finrank_grW_of_le_C {V : Submodule K (BarTree E →₀ K)} {n s : ℕ} (hV : V ≤ C K n s) :
    finrank K (grW K (wdegB w) V) = finrank K V
proof:
:= by
  haveI := finiteDimensional_C (K := K) (E := E) n s
  haveI : FiniteDimensional K V := Submodule.finiteDimensional_of_le hV
  obtain ⟨B, hB⟩ := exists_isBelow_C (K := K) w n s
  exact finrank_grW V fun v hv => hB v (hV hv)

name: Operad.ShuffleBar.J_inf_C_eq_grW
statement:
theorem J_inf_C_eq_grW (hs : ∀ i, IsBelowM w (N i) (sr i)) {R R₀ : Submodule K (Mono E 3 → K)}
    (hsR : ∀ i, sr i ∈ R) (hR₀ : R₀ = Submodule.span K (Set.range fun i => wprojM w (N i) (sr i)))
    (n s : ℕ) (hdim : finrank K (J K R ⊓ C K n s : Submodule K _) =
      finrank K (J K R₀ ⊓ C K n s : Submodule K _)) :
    J K R₀ ⊓ C K n s = grW K (wdegB w) (J K R ⊓ C K n s)
proof:
:= by
  haveI := finiteDimensional_C (K := K) (E := E) n s
  have hle : J K R₀ ⊓ C K n s ≤ grW K (wdegB w) (J K R ⊓ C K n s) :=
    (J_inf_C_le R₀ n s).trans (hR₀ ▸ Jgen_le_grW w sr N hs hsR n s)
  haveI : FiniteDimensional K (grW K (wdegB w) (J K R ⊓ C K n s)) :=
    Submodule.finiteDimensional_of_le (grW_le_C w inf_le_right)
  refine Submodule.eq_of_le_of_finrank_eq hle ?_
  rw [finrank_grW_of_le_C w inf_le_right, hdim]

name: Operad.ShuffleBar.grW_KD_le
statement:
theorem grW_KD_le {R R₀ : Submodule K (Mono E 3 → K)} {n : ℕ} (hn : 2 ≤ n)
    (hJ : J K R₀ ⊓ C K n (n - 2) = grW K (wdegB w) (J K R ⊓ C K n (n - 2))) :
    grW K (wdegB w) (KD K R n) ≤ KD K R₀ n
proof:
:= by
  refine grW_le fun M v hv hM => ?_
  rw [KD, Submodule.mem_inf] at hv ⊢
  refine ⟨wproj_mem_C w hv.1 M, ?_⟩
  rw [Submodule.mem_comap, d_wproj]
  have hdC : d K v ∈ C K n (n - 2) :=
    d_mem_C K (by rw [show n - 2 + 1 = n - 1 by omega]; exact hv.1)
  have hbelow : IsBelow (K := K) (W := wdegB w) M (d K v) := fun k hk => by
    rw [← d_wproj, hM k hk, map_zero]
  have := wproj_mem_grW (K := K) (W := wdegB w) (V := J K R ⊓ C K n (n - 2))
    ⟨Submodule.mem_comap.1 hv.2, hdC⟩ hbelow
  rw [← hJ] at this
  exact this.1

name: Operad.ShuffleBar.KD_eq_grW
statement:
theorem KD_eq_grW (hs : ∀ i, IsBelowM w (N i) (sr i)) {R R₀ : Submodule K (Mono E 3 → K)}
    (hsR : ∀ i, sr i ∈ R) (hR₀ : R₀ = Submodule.span K (Set.range fun i => wprojM w (N i) (sr i)))
    {n : ℕ} (hn : 2 ≤ n) (hJ : finrank K (J K R ⊓ C K n (n - 2) : Submodule K _) =
      finrank K (J K R₀ ⊓ C K n (n - 2) : Submodule K _))
    (hKD : finrank K (KD K R n) = finrank K (KD K R₀ n)) :
    KD K R₀ n = grW K (wdegB w) (KD K R n)
proof:
:= by
  haveI := finiteDimensional_C (K := K) (E := E) n (n - 1)
  have hle := grW_KD_le w hn (J_inf_C_eq_grW w sr N hs hsR hR₀ n (n - 2) hJ)
  haveI : FiniteDimensional K (KD K R₀ n) := Submodule.finiteDimensional_of_le inf_le_left
  have hKDC : KD K R n ≤ C K n (n - 1) := inf_le_left
  refine (Submodule.eq_of_le_of_finrank_eq hle ?_).symm
  rw [finrank_grW_of_le_C w hKDC, hKD]

name: Operad.ShuffleBar.finrank_J_inf_C_add
statement:
theorem finrank_J_inf_C_add (hG : IsGroebner K rk L R) (n s : ℕ) :
    finrank K (J K R ⊓ C K n s : Submodule K _) + (Nrm L n s).ncard =
      finrank K (C (E := E) K n s)
proof:
:= by
  haveI := finiteDimensional_C (K := K) (E := E) n s
  have h := finrank_eq_map_add K (ΦL K hG.data) (C K n s)
  have hmap : (C K n s).map (ΦL K hG.data) = Finsupp.supported K K (Nrm L n s) := by
    apply le_antisymm
    · rintro _ ⟨v, hv, rfl⟩
      exact (normalized_eq K rk hG hv).1
    · intro v hv
      exact ⟨v, C_of_nrm K hv, ΦL_normal K hG.data hv⟩
  have hker : C K n s ⊓ LinearMap.ker (ΦL K hG.data) = J K R ⊓ C K n s := by
    ext v
    simp only [Submodule.mem_inf, LinearMap.mem_ker]
    exact ⟨fun ⟨hv, h0⟩ => ⟨(mem_J_iff K rk hG hv).2 h0, hv⟩,
      fun ⟨hJ, hv⟩ => ⟨hv, (mem_J_iff K rk hG hv).1 hJ⟩⟩
  rw [hmap, hker, finrank_supported K (finite_nrm L n s)] at h
  omega

name: Operad.ShuffleBar.KD_eq_grW_of_isGroebner
proof:
:= by
  refine KD_eq_grW w sr N hs hsR hR₀ hn ?_ (finrank_KD_eq K rk hG hG₀ n)
  have h1 := finrank_J_inf_C_add rk hG n (n - 2)
  have h2 := finrank_J_inf_C_add rk hG₀ n (n - 2)
  omega

name: Operad.CobarHom.postcomp_app
statement:
lemma CobarHom.postcomp_app [DGOperad R P] [DGOperad R Q] (φ : CobarHom R C P)
    (ψ : GrOperadHom R P Q) (hψ : ∀ (A : Type) [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] (x : P A),
      ψ.app A (DGOperad.d (R := R) x) = DGOperad.d (R := R) (ψ.app A x))
    {A : Type} [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] (y : CobarGr R C A) :
    (CobarHom.postcomp φ ψ hψ).1.app A y = ψ.app A (φ.1.app A y)
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.CobarHom.postcomp_twisting
statement:
lemma CobarHom.postcomp_twisting [DGOperad R P] [DGOperad R Q] (φ : CobarHom R C P)
    (ψ : GrOperadHom R P Q) (hψ : ∀ (A : Type) [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] (x : P A),
      ψ.app A (DGOperad.d (R := R) x) = DGOperad.d (R := R) (ψ.app A x))
    {A : Type} [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] (x : C A) :
    ConvOp.toLin ((Cobar.homEquiv (CobarHom.postcomp φ ψ hψ)).1.1 A) x
      = ψ.app A (ConvOp.toLin ((Cobar.homEquiv φ).1.1 A) x)
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.GrOperadHom.ofZeroDG_app
statement:
lemma GrOperadHom.ofZeroDG_app [GrOperad R Q] (φ : GrOperadHom R P Q) {A : Type} [Fintype A]
    [DecidableEq A] (x : P A) : φ.ofZeroDG.app A x = φ.app A x
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.ZeroDG.d_apply
statement:
lemma ZeroDG.d_apply {A : Type} [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] (x : ZeroDG R P A) :
    DGOperad.d (R := R) (P := ZeroDG R P) x = 0
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.GrOperadHom.ofZeroDG_d
statement:
lemma GrOperadHom.ofZeroDG_d [DGOperad R Q] (φ : GrOperadHom R P Q)
    (hφ : ∀ (A : Type) [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] (x : P A), DGOperad.d (R := R) (φ.app A x) = 0)
    (A : Type) [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] (x : ZeroDG R P A) :
    φ.ofZeroDG.app A (DGOperad.d (R := R) x) = DGOperad.d (R := R) (φ.ofZeroDG.app A x)
proof:
:= by
  rw [ZeroDG.d_apply, map_zero]
  exact (hφ A x).symm

name: Operad.Koszul.DGAlgebra.toPInf_app
statement:
lemma toPInf_app (φ : DGAlgebra R E r V) {A : Type} [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A]
    (y : CobarGr R (Dual R E r) A) :
    (toPInf φ).1.app A y = φ.1.app A ((cobarMor R E r).1.app A y)
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.Koszul.DGAlgebra.toPInf_twisting
statement:
theorem toPInf_twisting (φ : DGAlgebra R E r V) {A : Type} [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A]
    (x : Dual R E r A) :
    ConvOp.toLin ((HoAlgebra.equivTwisting (toPInf φ)).1.1 A) x
      = φ.1.app A ((GrOperadIdeal.span R r).proj A (kapL R E A ((dualSub R E r).incl A x)))
proof:
:=
  (CobarHom.postcomp_twisting _ _ _ x).trans
    (congrArg (φ.1.app A) ((Cobar.homOf_ιL _ _ _ x).trans (kappa_apply r x)))

name: Operad.Koszul.DGAlgebra.toPInf_gen
statement:
theorem toPInf_gen (φ : DGAlgebra R E r V) {A : Type} [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] (w : E A) :
    ConvOp.toLin ((HoAlgebra.equivTwisting (toPInf φ)).1.1 A) (gen (r := r) w)
      = φ.1.app A ((GrOperadIdeal.span R r).proj A ((FreeGrL.ι R E).app A w))
proof:
:=
  (toPInf_twisting φ _).trans (congrArg (fun z => φ.1.app A ((GrOperadIdeal.span R r).proj A z))
    (kapL_ι w))

name: Operad.Koszul.DGAlgebra.toPInf_injective
statement:
theorem toPInf_injective :
    Function.Injective (toPInf : DGAlgebra R E r V → PInfAlgebra R E r V)
proof:
:= by
  intro φ ψ h
  have hgen : ∀ (A : Type) [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] (w : E A),
      φ.1.app A ((GrOperadIdeal.span R r).proj A ((FreeGrL.ι R E).app A w))
        = ψ.1.app A ((GrOperadIdeal.span R r).proj A ((FreeGrL.ι R E).app A w)) :=
    fun A _ _ w => (toPInf_gen φ w).symm.trans ((congrArg (fun χ : PInfAlgebra R E r V =>
      ConvOp.toLin ((HoAlgebra.equivTwisting χ).1.1 A) (gen (r := r) w)) h).trans
        (toPInf_gen ψ w))
  have hc : φ.1.comp (GrOperadIdeal.span R r).projHom
      = ψ.1.comp (GrOperadIdeal.span R r).projHom :=
    FreeGrL.hom_ext fun A _ _ w => hgen A w
  refine Subtype.ext (GrOperadHom.ext fun A _ _ x => ?_)
  obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := (GrOperadIdeal.span R r).proj_surjective A x
  exact congrArg (fun χ : GrOperadHom R (FreeGrL R E) (EndGr R V) => χ.app A y) hc

name: Operad.map_tpar
statement:
lemma map_tpar {pX : Bool → X →ₗ[R] X} {pX' : Bool → X' →ₗ[R] X'} {pY : Bool → Y →ₗ[R] Y}
    {pY' : Bool → Y' →ₗ[R] Y'} (f : X →ₗ[R] X') (g : Y →ₗ[R] Y')
    (hf : ∀ c, f ∘ₗ pX c = pX' c ∘ₗ f) (hg : ∀ c, g ∘ₗ pY c = pY' c ∘ₗ g) (b : Bool) :
    TensorProduct.map f g ∘ₗ tpar R pX pY b = tpar R pX' pY' b ∘ₗ TensorProduct.map f g
proof:
:=
  TensorProduct.ext' fun x y => by
    simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply, tpar_tmul, map_add, TensorProduct.map_tmul,
      ← LinearMap.comp_apply f, ← LinearMap.comp_apply g, hf, hg]

name: Operad.map_sswapLast
statement:
lemma map_sswapLast {pY : Bool → Y →ₗ[R] Y} {pY' : Bool → Y' →ₗ[R] Y'}
    {pZ : Bool → Z →ₗ[R] Z} {pZ' : Bool → Z' →ₗ[R] Z'} (f : X →ₗ[R] X') (g : Y →ₗ[R] Y')
    (h : Z →ₗ[R] Z') (hg : ∀ c, g ∘ₗ pY c = pY' c ∘ₗ g) (hh : ∀ c, h ∘ₗ pZ c = pZ' c ∘ₗ h) :
    TensorProduct.map (TensorProduct.map f h) g ∘ₗ sswapLast R (X := X) pY pZ
      = sswapLast R (X := X') pY' pZ' ∘ₗ TensorProduct.map (TensorProduct.map f g) h
proof:
:=
  TensorProduct.ext_threefold fun x y z => by
    simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply, sswapLast_tmul, map_sum, map_smul, TensorProduct.map_tmul,
      ← LinearMap.comp_apply g, ← LinearMap.comp_apply h, hg, hh]

statement:
lemma map_comp_proj (e : A ≃ B) :

name: Operad.GrCoideal.par_comp_proj
statement:
lemma par_comp_proj (b : Bool) :

name: Operad.GrCoideal.map_proj_eq_zero
statement:
lemma map_proj_eq_zero (i : A) {x : C (Without A i ⊕ B)} (hx : x ∈ J.sub (Without A i ⊕ B)) :
    TensorProduct.map (J.proj A) (J.proj B) (GrCooperad.decomp (R := R) i x) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : LinearMap.range (LinearMap.lTensor (C A) (J.sub B).subtype)
      ≤ LinearMap.ker (TensorProduct.map (J.proj A) (J.proj B)) := by
    rw [LinearMap.range_le_ker_iff]
    refine TensorProduct.ext' fun a b => ?_
    simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearMap.lTensor_tmul, TensorProduct.map_tmul,
      Submodule.subtype_apply, LinearMap.zero_apply]
    rw [(J.proj_eq_zero_iff _).2 b.2, TensorProduct.tmul_zero]
  have h2 : LinearMap.range (LinearMap.rTensor (C B) (J.sub A).subtype)
      ≤ LinearMap.ker (TensorProduct.map (J.proj A) (J.proj B)) := by
    rw [LinearMap.range_le_ker_iff]
    refine TensorProduct.ext' fun a b => ?_
    simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearMap.rTensor_tmul, TensorProduct.map_tmul,
      Submodule.subtype_apply, LinearMap.zero_apply]
    rw [(J.proj_eq_zero_iff _).2 a.2, TensorProduct.zero_tmul]
  exact LinearMap.mem_ker.1 (sup_le h1 h2 (J.decomp_mem i hx))

    J.decompQ (B := B) i ∘ₗ J.proj _

name: Operad.GrCoideal.lTensor_decompQ_map
statement:
lemma lTensor_decompQ_map {M : Type v} [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] (f : M →ₗ[R] J.Quot A)
    (j : B) (t : M ⊗[R] C (Without B j ⊕ D)) :
    LinearMap.lTensor (J.Quot A) (J.decompQ j) (TensorProduct.map f (J.proj _) t)
      = TensorProduct.map f (TensorProduct.map (J.proj B) (J.proj D))
          (LinearMap.lTensor M (GrCooperad.decomp (R := R) j) t)
proof:
:= by
  induction t using TensorProduct.induction_on with
  | zero => simp
  | tmul a w => simp
  | add t t' ht ht' => simp only [map_add, ht, ht']

name: Operad.GrCoideal.rTensor_decompQ_map
statement:
lemma rTensor_decompQ_map {M : Type v} [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] (f : M →ₗ[R] J.Quot D)
    (i : A) (t : C (Without A i ⊕ B) ⊗[R] M) :
    LinearMap.rTensor (J.Quot D) (J.decompQ i) (TensorProduct.map (J.proj _) f t)
      = TensorProduct.map (TensorProduct.map (J.proj A) (J.proj B)) f
          (LinearMap.rTensor M (GrCooperad.decomp (R := R) i) t)
proof:
:= by
  induction t using TensorProduct.induction_on with
  | zero => simp
  | tmul w a => simp
  | add t t' ht ht' => simp only [map_add, ht, ht']

name: Operad.GrCoideal.decompQ_par
statement:
lemma decompQ_par (i : A) (b : Bool) :
    J.decompQ (B := B) i ∘ₗ GrSpecies.par (R := R) (V := J.Quot) b
      = tpar R (fun c => GrSpecies.par (R := R) (V := J.Quot) c)
          (fun c => GrSpecies.par (R := R) (V := J.Quot) c) b ∘ₗ J.decompQ i
proof:
:= by
  refine J.hom_ext (LinearMap.ext fun x => ?_)
  have h := LinearMap.congr_fun (GrCooperad.decomp_par (R := R) (C := C) (B := B) i b) x
  have hn := LinearMap.congr_fun (map_tpar (pX := fun c => GrSpecies.par (R := R) (V := C) c)
    (pX' := fun c => GrSpecies.par (R := R) (V := J.Quot) c)
    (pY := fun c => GrSpecies.par (R := R) (V := C) c)
    (pY' := fun c => GrSpecies.par (R := R) (V := J.Quot) c) (J.proj A) (J.proj B)
    (fun c => (J.par_comp_proj c).symm) (fun c => (J.par_comp_proj c).symm) b)
    (GrCooperad.decomp (R := R) i x)
  simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply] at h hn ⊢
  rw [par_proj, decompQ_proj, decompQ_proj, h, hn]

name: Operad.GrCoideal.decompQ_map
statement:
lemma decompQ_map (σ' : A ≃ A') (τ : B ≃ B') (i : A) :
    J.decompQ (σ' i) ∘ₗ SymSpecies.map (R := R) (V := J.Quot) (compEquiv σ' τ i)
      = TensorProduct.map (SymSpecies.map (R := R) (V := J.Quot) σ')
          (SymSpecies.map (R := R) (V := J.Quot) τ) ∘ₗ J.decompQ i
proof:
:= by
  refine J.hom_ext (LinearMap.ext fun x => ?_)
  have h := LinearMap.congr_fun (GrCooperad.decomp_map (R := R) (C := C) σ' τ i) x
  simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply] at h ⊢
  rw [map_proj, decompQ_proj, decompQ_proj, h]
  induction GrCooperad.decomp (R := R) (C := C) (B := B) i x using TensorProduct.induction_on with
  | zero => simp
  | tmul a b => simp
  | add t t' ht ht' => simp only [map_add, ht, ht']

name: Operad.GrCoideal.decompQ_counit_right
statement:
lemma decompQ_counit_right (i : A) :
    (TensorProduct.rid R (J.Quot A)).toLinearMap ∘ₗ LinearMap.lTensor (J.Quot A) J.counitQ ∘ₗ
        J.decompQ i ∘ₗ SymSpecies.map (R := R) (V := J.Quot) (rightUnitEquiv i).symm
      = LinearMap.id
proof:
:= by
  refine J.hom_ext (LinearMap.ext fun x => ?_)
  have h := LinearMap.congr_fun (GrCooperad.counit_right (R := R) (C := C) i) x
  simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearEquiv.coe_coe, LinearMap.id_apply] at h ⊢
  rw [map_proj, decompQ_proj]
  conv_rhs => rw [← h]
  induction GrCooperad.decomp (R := R) (C := C) (B := Unit) i
    (SymSpecies.map (R := R) (rightUnitEquiv i).symm x) using TensorProduct.induction_on with
  | zero => simp
  | tmul a u => simp
  | add t t' ht ht' => simp only [map_add, ht, ht']

name: Operad.GrCoideal.decompQ_counit_left
statement:
lemma decompQ_counit_left :
    (TensorProduct.lid R (J.Quot B)).toLinearMap ∘ₗ LinearMap.rTensor (J.Quot B) J.counitQ ∘ₗ
        J.decompQ () ∘ₗ SymSpecies.map (R := R) (V := J.Quot) (leftUnitEquiv B).symm
      = LinearMap.id
proof:
:= by
  refine J.hom_ext (LinearMap.ext fun x => ?_)
  have h := LinearMap.congr_fun (GrCooperad.counit_left (R := R) (C := C) (B := B)) x
  simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearEquiv.coe_coe, LinearMap.id_apply] at h ⊢
  rw [map_proj, decompQ_proj]
  conv_rhs => rw [← h]
  induction GrCooperad.decomp (R := R) (C := C) (B := B) ()
    (SymSpecies.map (R := R) (leftUnitEquiv B).symm x) using TensorProduct.induction_on with
  | zero => simp
  | tmul u b => simp
  | add t t' ht ht' => simp only [map_add, ht, ht']

name: Operad.GrCoideal.decompQ_assoc_seq
statement:
lemma decompQ_assoc_seq (i : A) (j : B) :
    LinearMap.lTensor (J.Quot A) (J.decompQ (B := D) j) ∘ₗ J.decompQ i
      = (TensorProduct.assoc R (J.Quot A) (J.Quot B) (J.Quot D)).toLinearMap ∘ₗ
          LinearMap.rTensor (J.Quot D) (J.decompQ i) ∘ₗ J.decompQ (Sum.inr j) ∘ₗ
            SymSpecies.map (R := R) (V := J.Quot) (seqEquiv i j D).symm
proof:
:= by
  refine J.hom_ext (LinearMap.ext fun x => ?_)
  have h := LinearMap.congr_fun (GrCooperad.decomp_assoc_seq (R := R) (C := C) (D := D) i j) x
  have ha := LinearMap.congr_fun (TensorProduct.map_map_comp_assoc_eq (R := R) (J.proj A)
    (J.proj B) (J.proj D))
  simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearEquiv.coe_coe] at h ha ⊢
  rw [decompQ_proj, lTensor_decompQ_map, h, map_proj, decompQ_proj, rTensor_decompQ_map, ha]

name: Operad.GrCoideal.decompQ_assoc_par
statement:
lemma decompQ_assoc_par {i k : A} (hik : i ≠ k) :
    LinearMap.rTensor (J.Quot B) (J.decompQ (B := D) k) ∘ₗ J.decompQ (Sum.inl ⟨i, hik⟩)
      = sswapLast R (fun c => GrSpecies.par (R := R) (V := J.Quot) c)
          (fun c => GrSpecies.par (R := R) (V := J.Quot) c) ∘ₗ
          LinearMap.rTensor (J.Quot D) (J.decompQ i) ∘ₗ
            J.decompQ (Sum.inl ⟨k, Ne.symm hik⟩) ∘ₗ
              SymSpecies.map (R := R) (V := J.Quot) (parEquiv hik B D).symm
proof:
:= by
  refine J.hom_ext (LinearMap.ext fun x => ?_)
  have h := LinearMap.congr_fun (GrCooperad.decomp_assoc_par (R := R) (C := C) (B := B)
    (D := D) hik) x
  have hs := LinearMap.congr_fun (map_sswapLast (pY := fun c => GrSpecies.par (R := R) (V := C) c)
    (pY' := fun c => GrSpecies.par (R := R) (V := J.Quot) c)
    (pZ := fun c => GrSpecies.par (R := R) (V := C) c)
    (pZ' := fun c => GrSpecies.par (R := R) (V := J.Quot) c) (J.proj A) (J.proj B) (J.proj D)
    (fun c => (J.par_comp_proj c).symm) (fun c => (J.par_comp_proj c).symm))
  simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply] at h hs ⊢
  rw [decompQ_proj, rTensor_decompQ_map, h, hs, map_proj, decompQ_proj, rTensor_decompQ_map]

name: Operad.GrCoideal.counitQ_par
statement: lemma counitQ_par : J.counitQ ∘ₗ GrSpecies.par (R := R) (V := J.Quot) true = 0
proof:
:= by
  refine J.hom_ext (LinearMap.ext fun x => ?_)
  have h := LinearMap.congr_fun (GrCooperad.counit_par (R := R) (C := C)) x
  simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearMap.zero_apply] at h ⊢
  rw [par_proj, counitQ_proj, h]

name: Operad.GrCoideal.proj_unitSpan_le
statement:
lemma proj_unitSpan_le :
    (GrCooperad.unitSpan R C A).map (J.proj A)
      ≤ GrCooperad.unitSpanOf R J.Quot (J.proj Unit (GrCooperad.Coaug.one (R := R))) A
proof:

  rw [GrCooperad.unitSpan, GrCooperad.unitSpanOf, Submodule.map_span, Submodule.span_le]
  rintro _ ⟨_, ⟨e, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
  exact Submodule.subset_span ⟨e, rfl⟩

proof: := rfl

name: Operad.Sym.Perm.map_fn
statement:
lemma map_fn {A' : Type} [Fintype A'] [DecidableEq A'] (e : A ≃ A') (x : Und R (Perm R) A)

name: Operad.Sym.Perm.mul_eq_zero_of_isAssoc
statement:
lemma mul_eq_zero_of_isAssoc {m : Und R (Perm R) (Fin 2)} (ha : IsAssoc m) :
    fn m 0 * fn m 1 = 0
proof:
:= by
  have h := congrArg (fun z => fn z (Sum.inl ())) ha
  simp only [map_fn, Equiv.sumAssoc_symm_apply_inl, bin_inl, one_fn, Fintype.sum_unique,
    Fintype.sum_sum_type, bin_inr, mul_one] at h
  linear_combination -h

name: Operad.Sym.Perm.eq_zero_of_isComm_isAssoc
statement:
theorem eq_zero_of_isComm_isAssoc [NoZeroDivisors R] {m : Und R (Perm R) (Fin 2)}
    (hc : IsComm m) (ha : IsAssoc m) (k : Fin 2) : fn m k = 0
proof:
:= by
  have h01 : fn m 0 = fn m 1 := by
    have := congrArg (fun z => fn z 0) hc
    simpa [map_fn] using this.symm
  have h0 : fn m 0 = 0 := by
    have := mul_eq_zero_of_isAssoc ha
    rw [← h01] at this
    exact mul_self_eq_zero.mp this
  fin_cases k
  · exact h0
  · exact h01 ▸ h0

name: Operad.Sym.Perm.app_eq_zero_of_isComm_isAssoc
statement:
theorem app_eq_zero_of_isComm_isAssoc [NoZeroDivisors R]
    {P : (A : Type) → [Fintype A] → [DecidableEq A] → Type*}
    [∀ (A : Type) [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A], AddCommGroup (P A)]
    [∀ (A : Type) [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A], Module R (P A)] [SymOperad R P]
    (f : SymOperadHom R P (Perm R)) {μ : P (Fin 2)} (hc : IsComm (Und.of R P μ))
    (ha : IsAssoc (Und.of R P μ)) : f.app _ μ = 0
proof:
:= by
  funext k
  exact eq_zero_of_isComm_isAssoc (isComm_app hc f.und) (isAssoc_app ha f.und) k

statement:
@[simp] lemma minLabel_node (e : E) (l r : LTree E) :
    (node e l r).minLabel = min l.minLabel r.minLabel
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.LTree.isShuffle_leaf
statement: @[simp] lemma isShuffle_leaf (a : ℕ) : (leaf a : LTree E).IsShuffle
proof: := trivial

name: Operad.LTree.isShuffle_node
statement:
@[simp] lemma isShuffle_node (e : E) (l r : LTree E) :
    (node e l r).IsShuffle ↔ l.minLabel < r.minLabel ∧ l.IsShuffle ∧ r.IsShuffle
proof: := Iff.rfl

name: Operad.LTree.minLabel_node_of_shuffle
statement:
lemma minLabel_node_of_shuffle {e : E} {l r : LTree E} (h : (node e l r).IsShuffle) :
    (node e l r).minLabel = l.minLabel
proof:
:= by
  simp only [minLabel_node]
  exact min_eq_left h.1.le

name: Operad.LTree.minLabel_le_of_mem
statement:
lemma minLabel_le_of_mem : ∀ (t : LTree E) {b : ℕ}, b ∈ t.labels → t.minLabel ≤ b
  | leaf a, b, hb => by simp at hb; simp [hb]
  | node e l r, b, hb => by
    simp only [labels_node, List.mem_append] at hb
    rcases hb with hb | hb
    · exact le_trans (min_le_left _ _) (minLabel_le_of_mem l hb)
    · exact le_trans (min_le_right _ _) (minLabel_le_of_mem r hb)

name: Operad.LTree.minLabel_mem
statement:
lemma minLabel_mem : ∀ t : LTree E, t.minLabel ∈ t.labels
  | leaf a => by simp
  | node _ l r => by
    simp only [minLabel_node, labels_node, List.mem_append]
    rcases min_choice l.minLabel r.minLabel with h | h <;> rw [h]
    · exact Or.inl (minLabel_mem l)
    · exact Or.inr (minLabel_mem r)

                 

                                                                         
def rank3 (a b c x : ℕ) : ℕ
proof:
:= (if a < x then 1 else 0) + (if b < x then 1 else 0) +
  (if c < x then 1 else 0)

name: Operad.LTree.IsNormal.left
statement:
lemma IsNormal.left {L : Set (LTree E)} {e : E} {l r : LTree E} (h : IsNormal L (node e l r)) :
    IsNormal L l
proof:
:= fun w hw => h w (by
  simp only [windows, List.mem_append]
  exact Or.inl (Or.inr hw))

name: Operad.LTree.IsNormal.right
statement:
lemma IsNormal.right {L : Set (LTree E)} {e : E} {l r : LTree E} (h : IsNormal L (node e l r)) :
    IsNormal L r
proof:
:= fun w hw => h w (by
  simp only [windows, List.mem_append]
  exact Or.inr hw)

name: Operad.LTree.window_left_shape
statement:
theorem window_left_shape {e f : E} {a b r : LTree E} (h : (node e (node f a b) r).IsShuffle)
    (hnd : (node e (node f a b) r).labels.Nodup) :
    window e f false a.minLabel b.minLabel r.minLabel = node e (node f (leaf 0) (leaf 1)) (leaf 2)
      ∨ window e f false a.minLabel b.minLabel r.minLabel
        = node e (node f (leaf 0) (leaf 2)) (leaf 1)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨h1, ⟨h2, -, -⟩, -⟩ := h
  simp only [minLabel_node] at h1
  have hne : b.minLabel ≠ r.minLabel := by
    simp only [labels_node] at hnd
    exact (List.nodup_append.1 hnd).2.2 _ (List.mem_append.2 (Or.inr (minLabel_mem b))) _
      (minLabel_mem r)
  have e0 : rank3 a.minLabel b.minLabel r.minLabel a.minLabel = 0 := by
    simp only [rank3]
    split_ifs <;> omega
  rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne hne with hlt | hlt
  · left
    have e1 : rank3 a.minLabel b.minLabel r.minLabel b.minLabel = 1 := by
      simp only [rank3]
      split_ifs <;> omega
    have e2 : rank3 a.minLabel b.minLabel r.minLabel r.minLabel = 2 := by
      simp only [rank3]
      split_ifs <;> omega
    simp only [window, Bool.false_eq_true, ↓reduceIte, e0, e1, e2]
  · right
    have e1 : rank3 a.minLabel b.minLabel r.minLabel b.minLabel = 2 := by
      simp only [rank3]
      split_ifs <;> omega
    have e2 : rank3 a.minLabel b.minLabel r.minLabel r.minLabel = 1 := by
      simp only [rank3]
      split_ifs <;> omega
    simp only [window, Bool.false_eq_true, ↓reduceIte, e0, e1, e2]

name: Operad.LTree.window_right_eq
statement:
theorem window_right_eq {e f : E} {l a b : LTree E} (h : (node e l (node f a b)).IsShuffle) :
    window e f true a.minLabel b.minLabel l.minLabel
      = node e (leaf 0) (node f (leaf 1) (leaf 2))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨h1, -, h2, -, -⟩ := h
  simp only [minLabel_node] at h1
  have e0 : rank3 a.minLabel b.minLabel l.minLabel l.minLabel = 0 := by
    simp only [rank3]
    split_ifs <;> omega
  have e1 : rank3 a.minLabel b.minLabel l.minLabel a.minLabel = 1 := by
    simp only [rank3]
    split_ifs <;> omega
  have e2 : rank3 a.minLabel b.minLabel l.minLabel b.minLabel = 2 := by
    simp only [rank3]
    split_ifs <;> omega
  simp only [window, ↓reduceIte, e0, e1, e2]

name: Operad.LTree.isRightCombShape_of_normal
statement:
theorem isRightCombShape_of_normal {L : Set (LTree E)}
    (hL : ∀ e f : E, node e (node f (leaf 0) (leaf 1)) (leaf 2) ∈ L ∧
      node e (node f (leaf 0) (leaf 2)) (leaf 1) ∈ L) :
    ∀ t : LTree E, t.IsShuffle → t.labels.Nodup → IsNormal L t → t.IsRightCombShape
  | leaf _, _, _, _ => trivial
  | node e (leaf a) r, hs, hnd, hn =>
    isRightCombShape_of_normal hL r hs.2.2 (List.nodup_append.1 hnd).2.1 hn.right
  | node e (node f a b) r, hs, hnd, hn => by
    have hw : window e f false a.minLabel b.minLabel r.minLabel ∈ L
proof:
:= by
      rcases window_left_shape hs hnd with h | h <;> rw [h]
      · exact (hL e f).1
      · exact (hL e f).2
    refine (hn _ ?_ hw).elim
    simp [windows]

name: Operad.LTree.labels_sorted_of_rightCombShape
statement:
theorem labels_sorted_of_rightCombShape :
    ∀ t : LTree E, t.IsShuffle → t.IsRightCombShape → t.labels.Pairwise (· < ·)
  | leaf _, _, _ => List.pairwise_singleton _ _
  | node e (leaf a) r, hs, hr => by
    have ih
proof:
:= labels_sorted_of_rightCombShape r hs.2.2 hr
    simp only [labels_node, labels_leaf, List.singleton_append, List.pairwise_cons]
    exact ⟨fun b hb => lt_of_lt_of_le hs.1 (minLabel_le_of_mem r hb), ih⟩
  | node e (node f a b) r, _, hr => hr.elim

name: Operad.LTree.length_labels
statement:
@[simp] lemma length_labels : ∀ t : LTree E, t.labels.length = t.arity
  | leaf _ => rfl
  | node _ l r => by simp [labels, arity, length_labels l, length_labels r]

name: Operad.LTree.arity_pos
statement:
lemma arity_pos : ∀ t : LTree E, 0 < t.arity
  | leaf _ => Nat.one_pos
  | node _ l _ => Nat.add_pos_left (arity_pos l) _

name: Operad.LTree.labels_rightComb
statement:
lemma labels_rightComb : ∀ (w : List E) (k : ℕ),
    (rightComb w k).labels = List.range' k (w.length + 1)
  | [], k => rfl
  | e :: w, k => by
    simp only [rightComb, labels_node, labels_leaf, labels_rightComb w (k + 1),
      List.length_cons, List.singleton_append]
    exact List.range'_succ.symm

name: Operad.LTree.decorations_rightComb
statement:
lemma decorations_rightComb : ∀ (w : List E) (k : ℕ), (rightComb w k).decorations = w
  | [], _ => rfl
  | e :: w, k => by simp [rightComb, decorations, decorations_rightComb w (k + 1)]

name: Operad.LTree.eq_rightComb_of_rightCombShape
statement:
theorem eq_rightComb_of_rightCombShape : ∀ (t : LTree E) (k : ℕ), t.IsRightCombShape →
    t.labels = List.range' k t.arity → t = rightComb t.decorations k
  | leaf a, k, _, hl => by
    simp only [labels_leaf, arity, List.range'_one] at hl
    obtain rfl
proof:
:= List.singleton_injective hl
    rfl
  | node e (leaf a) r, k, hr, hl => by
    have hpos := arity_pos r
    simp only [labels_node, labels_leaf, arity, List.singleton_append] at hl
    rw [show 1 + r.arity = r.arity + 1 by omega, List.range'_succ] at hl
    obtain ⟨rfl, hl'⟩ := List.cons_eq_cons.1 hl
    have ih := eq_rightComb_of_rightCombShape r (a + 1) hr hl'
    simp only [decorations, List.nil_append, rightComb]
    exact congrArg _ ih
  | node e (node f a b) r, _, hr, _ => hr.elim

name: Operad.LTree.minLabel_rightComb
statement:
lemma minLabel_rightComb : ∀ (w : List E) (k : ℕ), (rightComb w k).minLabel = k
  | [], _ => rfl
  | g :: u, j => by
    simp only [rightComb, minLabel_node, minLabel_leaf, minLabel_rightComb u (j + 1)]
    omega

name: Operad.LTree.windows_rightComb
statement:
theorem windows_rightComb : ∀ (w : List E) (k : ℕ),
    (rightComb w k).windows
      = (w.zip w.tail).map fun p => node p.1 (leaf 0) (node p.2 (leaf 1) (leaf 2))
  | [], _ => rfl
  | [e], _ => rfl
  | e :: f :: w, k => by
    have hs :
        (node e (leaf k) (node f (leaf (k + 1)) (rightComb w (k + 1 + 1))) :
          LTree E).IsShuffle
proof:
:= by
      refine ⟨?_, trivial, ?_, trivial, isShuffle_rightComb w _⟩
      · simp only [minLabel_leaf, minLabel_node, minLabel_rightComb]
        omega
      · simp only [minLabel_leaf, minLabel_rightComb]
        omega
    show [window e f true (leaf (k + 1) : LTree E).minLabel (rightComb w (k + 1 + 1)).minLabel
        (leaf k : LTree E).minLabel] ++ (rightComb (f :: w) (k + 1)).windows = _
    rw [window_right_eq hs, windows_rightComb (f :: w) (k + 1)]
    rfl

name: Operad.LTree.isNormal_iff
statement:
theorem isNormal_iff {L : Set (LTree E)}
    (hL : ∀ e f : E, node e (node f (leaf 0) (leaf 1)) (leaf 2) ∈ L ∧
      node e (node f (leaf 0) (leaf 2)) (leaf 1) ∈ L)
    {n : ℕ} {t : LTree E} (hs : t.IsShuffle) (hl : t.labels.Perm (List.range n)) :
    IsNormal L t ↔ ∃ w : List E, t = rightComb w 0 ∧
      ∀ p ∈ w.zip w.tail, node p.1 (leaf 0) (node p.2 (leaf 1) (leaf 2)) ∉ L
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hn
    have hr := isRightCombShape_of_normal hL t hs (hl.nodup_iff.2 List.nodup_range) hn
    have hsorted := labels_sorted_of_rightCombShape t hs hr
    have heq : t.labels = List.range' 0 t.arity := by
      have hlen := hl.length_eq
      rw [length_labels, List.length_range] at hlen
      rw [hlen, ← List.range_eq_range']
      exact List.Perm.eq_of_pairwise' (r := (· ≤ ·)) (hsorted.imp le_of_lt)
        (List.pairwise_lt_range.imp le_of_lt) hl
    refine ⟨t.decorations, eq_rightComb_of_rightCombShape t 0 hr heq, fun p hp hpL => ?_⟩
    refine hn _ ?_ hpL
    rw [eq_rightComb_of_rightCombShape t 0 hr heq, windows_rightComb]
    exact List.mem_map_of_mem hp
  · rintro ⟨w, rfl, hw⟩ x hx
    rw [windows_rightComb] at hx
    obtain ⟨p, hp, rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.1 hx
    exact hw p hp

name: Operad.LTree.size_leaf
statement: @[simp] lemma size_leaf (a : ℕ) : (leaf a : LTree E).size = 1
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.LTree.size_node
statement: @[simp] lemma size_node (e : E) (l r : LTree E) : (node e l r).size = l.size + r.size + 1
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.LTree.size_add_one
statement:
lemma size_add_one : ∀ t : LTree E, t.size + 1 = 2 * t.arity
  | leaf _ => rfl
  | node _ l r => by
    have
proof:
:= size_add_one l
    have := size_add_one r
    simp only [size_node, arity]
    omega

name: Operad.LTree.graft_zero
statement: @[simp] lemma graft_zero (e : E) (a : ℕ) (t : LTree E) : graft e a t 0 = node e t (leaf a)
proof:
:= by
  cases t <;> rfl

name: Operad.LTree.graft_node_succ
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.LTree.size_graft
statement:
lemma size_graft (e : E) (a : ℕ) : ∀ (t : LTree E) (p : ℕ), p < t.size →
    (graft e a t p).size = t.size + 2
  | t, 0, _ => by simp
  | leaf _, _ + 1, h => by simp at h
  | node f l r, p + 1, h => by
    simp only [size_node] at h
    rw [graft_node_succ]
    split_ifs with hp
    · simp only [size_node, size_graft e a l p hp]
      omega
    · simp only [size_node, size_graft e a r (p - l.size) (by omega)]
      omega

name: Operad.LTree.labels_graft
statement:
lemma labels_graft (e : E) (a : ℕ) : ∀ (t : LTree E) (p : ℕ), p < t.size →
    (graft e a t p).labels.Perm (t.labels ++ [a])
  | t, 0, _ => by simp
  | leaf _, _ + 1, h => by simp at h
  | node f l r, p + 1, h => by
    simp only [size_node] at h
    rw [graft_node_succ]
    split_ifs with hp
    · simp only [labels_node, List.append_assoc]
      refine ((labels_graft e a l p hp).append_right _).trans ?_
      rw [List.append_assoc]
      exact List.Perm.append_left _ List.perm_append_comm
    · simp only [labels_node, List.append_assoc]
      exact (labels_graft e a r _ (by omega)).append_left _

name: Operad.LTree.minLabel_graft
statement:
lemma minLabel_graft (e : E) {a : ℕ} : ∀ (t : LTree E) (p : ℕ), (∀ b ∈ t.labels, b < a) →
    p < t.size → (graft e a t p).minLabel = t.minLabel
  | t, 0, ha, _ => by
    simp only [graft_zero, minLabel_node, minLabel_leaf]
    exact min_eq_left (ha _ (minLabel_mem t)).le
  | leaf _, _ + 1, _, h => by simp at h
  | node f l r, p + 1, ha, h => by
    simp only [size_node] at h
    simp only [labels_node, List.mem_append] at ha
    rw [graft_node_succ]
    split_ifs with hp
    · simp only [minLabel_node, minLabel_graft e l p (fun b hb => ha b (Or.inl hb)) hp]
    · simp only [minLabel_node,
        minLabel_graft e r (p - l.size) (fun b hb => ha b (Or.inr hb)) (by omega)]

name: Operad.LTree.isShuffle_graft
statement:
lemma isShuffle_graft (e : E) {a : ℕ} : ∀ (t : LTree E) (p : ℕ), t.IsShuffle →
    (∀ b ∈ t.labels, b < a) → p < t.size → (graft e a t p).IsShuffle
  | t, 0, hs, ha, _ => by
    simp only [graft_zero, isShuffle_node, minLabel_leaf, isShuffle_leaf, and_true]
    exact ⟨ha _ (minLabel_mem t), hs⟩
  | leaf _, _ + 1, _, _, h => by simp at h
  | node f l r, p + 1, hs, ha, h => by
    simp only [size_node] at h
    simp only [labels_node, List.mem_append] at ha
    have hal : ∀ b ∈ l.labels, b < a
proof:
:= fun b hb => ha b (Or.inl hb)
    have har : ∀ b ∈ r.labels, b < a := fun b hb => ha b (Or.inr hb)
    obtain ⟨h1, hl, hr⟩ := hs
    rw [graft_node_succ]
    split_ifs with hp
    · exact ⟨by rw [minLabel_graft e l p hal hp]; exact h1, isShuffle_graft e l p hl hal hp, hr⟩
    · exact ⟨by rw [minLabel_graft e r _ har (by omega)]; exact h1, hl,
        isShuffle_graft e r _ hr har (by omega)⟩

name: Operad.LTree.graft_eq_node
statement:
lemma graft_eq_node (e : E) (a : ℕ) : ∀ (t : LTree E) (p : ℕ), p < t.size →
    ∃ g x y, graft e a t p = node g x y
  | t, 0, _ => ⟨e, t, leaf a, graft_zero e a t⟩
  | leaf _, _ + 1, h => by simp at h
  | node f l r, p + 1, _ => by
    rw [graft_node_succ]
    split_ifs
    · exact ⟨_, _, _, rfl⟩
    · exact ⟨_, _, _, rfl⟩

                                                                                              
         
def prune (a : ℕ) : LTree E → LTree E
  | leaf b => leaf b
  | node f l (leaf b) => if b = a then l else node f (prune a l) (leaf b)
  | node f l (node g x y) =>
    if a ∈ l.labels then node f (prune a l) (node g x y) else node f l (prune a (node g x y))

name: Operad.LTree.prune_graft
statement:
lemma prune_graft (e : E) {a : ℕ} : ∀ (t : LTree E) (p : ℕ), a ∉ t.labels → p < t.size →
    prune a (graft e a t p) = t
  | t, 0, _, _ => by simp [prune]
  | leaf _, _ + 1, _, h => by simp at h
  | node f l r, p + 1, ha, h => by
    simp only [size_node] at h
    simp only [labels_node, List.mem_append, not_or] at ha
    rw [graft_node_succ]
    split_ifs with hp
    · have ih
proof:
:= prune_graft e l p ha.1 hp
      have hmem : a ∈ (graft e a l p).labels := (labels_graft e a l p hp).mem_iff.2 (by simp)
      cases r with
      | leaf b =>
        have hb : b ≠ a := fun hb => ha.2 (by simp [hb])
        simp [prune, hb, ih]
      | node g x y => simp [prune, hmem, ih]
    · have hq : p - l.size < r.size := by omega
      have ih := prune_graft e r _ ha.2 hq
      obtain ⟨g, x, y, hg⟩ := graft_eq_node e a r _ hq
      rw [hg] at ih ⊢
      simp [prune, ha.1, ih]

name: Operad.LTree.graft_zero_ne
statement:
lemma graft_zero_ne (e e' : E) {a : ℕ} : ∀ {t : LTree E} {p : ℕ}, a ∉ t.labels →
    p + 1 < t.size → graft e a t 0 ≠ graft e' a t (p + 1)
  | leaf _, _, _, h => by simp at h
  | node f l r, p, ha, h => by
    simp only [size_node] at h
    simp only [labels_node, List.mem_append, not_or] at ha
    rw [graft_zero, graft_node_succ]
    split_ifs with hp
    · intro he
      simp only [node.injEq] at he
      obtain ⟨-, -, rfl⟩
proof:
:= he
      exact ha.2 (by simp)
    · intro he
      simp only [node.injEq] at he
      have := congrArg size he.2.2
      rw [size_graft e' a r _ (by omega)] at this
      simp at this

name: Operad.LTree.graft_inj
statement:
theorem graft_inj {e e' : E} {a : ℕ} : ∀ (t : LTree E) (p p' : ℕ), a ∉ t.labels → p < t.size →
    p' < t.size → graft e a t p = graft e' a t p' → p = p' ∧ e = e'
  | t, 0, 0, _, _, _, h => by
    simp only [graft_zero, node.injEq] at h
    exact ⟨rfl, h.1⟩
  | _, 0, _ + 1, ha, _, hp', h => absurd h (graft_zero_ne e e' ha hp')
  | _, _ + 1, 0, ha, hp, _, h => absurd h.symm (graft_zero_ne e' e ha hp)
  | leaf _, _ + 1, _ + 1, _, hp, _, _ => by simp at hp
  | node f l r, p + 1, p' + 1, ha, hp, hp', h => by
    simp only [size_node] at hp hp'
    simp only [labels_node, List.mem_append, not_or] at ha
    rw [graft_node_succ, graft_node_succ] at h
    split_ifs at h with h1 h2 h2
    · simp only [node.injEq, true_and, and_true] at h
      obtain ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
proof:
:= graft_inj l p p' ha.1 h1 h2 h
      exact ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
    · simp only [node.injEq, true_and] at h
      have := congrArg size h.1
      rw [size_graft e a l p h1] at this
      omega
    · simp only [node.injEq, true_and] at h
      have := congrArg size h.1
      rw [size_graft e' a l p' h2] at this
      omega
    · simp only [node.injEq, true_and] at h
      obtain ⟨h3, rfl⟩ := graft_inj r _ _ ha.2 (by omega) (by omega) h
      exact ⟨by omega, rfl⟩

name: Operad.LTree.exists_graft
statement:
theorem exists_graft {a : ℕ} : ∀ (t : LTree E), t.IsShuffle → t.labels.Nodup → a ∈ t.labels →
    (∀ b ∈ t.labels, b ≤ a) → 2 ≤ t.arity →
    ∃ (s : LTree E) (p : ℕ) (e : E), p < s.size ∧ s.IsShuffle ∧ (∀ b ∈ s.labels, b < a) ∧
      graft e a s p = t
  | leaf _, _, _, _, _, h2 => absurd h2 (by simp [arity])
  | node f l r, hs, hnd, ha, hle, _ => by
    obtain ⟨h1, hsl, hsr⟩
proof:
:= hs
    simp only [labels_node, List.mem_append] at ha hle
    have hnd' := List.nodup_append.1 hnd
    by_cases hr : r = leaf a
    · subst hr
      refine ⟨l, 0, f, by have := size_add_one l; omega, hsl, fun b hb => ?_, graft_zero f a l⟩
      have hba : b ≠ a := fun hba => hnd'.2.2 b hb a (by simp) hba
      exact lt_of_le_of_ne (hle b (Or.inl hb)) hba
    by_cases hal : a ∈ l.labels
    · cases l with
      | leaf c =>
        exfalso
        have hc : c = a := (by simpa using hal : a = c).symm
        subst hc
        have := hle _ (Or.inr (minLabel_mem r))
        simp only [minLabel_leaf] at h1
        omega
      | node g x y =>
        have h2 : 2 ≤ (node g x y).arity := by
          have := arity_pos x
          have := arity_pos y
          simp only [arity]
          omega
        obtain ⟨s, p, e, hp, hs, hsa, hg⟩ := exists_graft (node g x y) hsl hnd'.1 hal
          (fun b hb => hle b (Or.inl hb)) h2
        have hra : ∀ b ∈ r.labels, b < a := fun b hb => lt_of_le_of_ne (hle b (Or.inr hb))
          fun hba => hnd'.2.2 a hal b hb hba.symm
        refine ⟨node f s r, p + 1, e, by simp only [size_node]; omega,
          ⟨?_, hs, hsr⟩, ?_, ?_⟩
        · rw [← minLabel_graft e s p hsa hp, hg]
          exact h1
        · intro b hb
          simp only [labels_node, List.mem_append] at hb
          exact hb.elim (hsa b) (hra b)
        · rw [graft_node_succ, if_pos hp, hg]
    · have har : a ∈ r.labels := ha.resolve_left hal
      cases r with
      | leaf c =>
        exfalso
        have hc : c = a := (by simpa using har : a = c).symm
        exact hr (by rw [hc])
      | node g x y =>
        have h2 : 2 ≤ (node g x y).arity := by
          have := arity_pos x
          have := arity_pos y
          simp only [arity]
          omega
        obtain ⟨s, p, e, hp, hs, hsa, hg⟩ := exists_graft (node g x y) hsr hnd'.2.1 har
          (fun b hb => hle b (Or.inr hb)) h2
        have hla : ∀ b ∈ l.labels, b < a := fun b hb => lt_of_le_of_ne (hle b (Or.inl hb))
          fun hba => hal (hba ▸ hb)
        refine ⟨node f l s, l.size + p + 1, e, by simp only [size_node]; omega,
          ⟨?_, hsl, hs⟩, ?_, ?_⟩
        · rw [← minLabel_graft e s p hsa hp, hg]
          exact h1
        · intro b hb
          simp only [labels_node, List.mem_append] at hb
          exact hb.elim (hla b) (hsa b)
        · rw [graft_node_succ, if_neg (by omega), show l.size + p - l.size = p by omega, hg]

name: Operad.LTree.size_of_perm
statement:
lemma size_of_perm {t : LTree E} {n : ℕ} (h : t.labels.Perm (List.range (n + 1))) :
    t.size = 2 * n + 1
proof:
:= by
  have h1 := size_add_one t
  have h2 := h.length_eq
  rw [length_labels, List.length_range] at h2
  omega

name: Operad.LTree.mem_monomials
statement:
theorem mem_monomials : ∀ (n : ℕ) (t : LTree E),
    t ∈ monomials n ↔ t.IsShuffle ∧ t.labels.Perm (List.range n)
  | 0, t => by
    simp only [monomials, Finset.notMem_empty, false_iff, not_and, List.range_zero,
      List.perm_nil]
    intro _ h
    have h1
proof:
:= length_labels t
    have h2 := arity_pos t
    rw [h, List.length_nil] at h1
    omega
  | 1, t => by
    simp only [monomials, Finset.mem_singleton, List.range_one, List.perm_singleton]
    constructor
    · rintro rfl
      exact ⟨trivial, rfl⟩
    · rintro ⟨-, h⟩
      cases t with
      | leaf b => simpa using h
      | node f l r =>
        have h1 := length_labels (node f l r)
        have := arity_pos l
        have := arity_pos r
        rw [h] at h1
        simp only [List.length_singleton, arity] at h1
        omega
  | n + 2, t => by
    simp only [monomials, Finset.mem_biUnion, Finset.mem_image, Finset.mem_product,
      Finset.mem_range, Finset.mem_univ, and_true, Prod.exists, mem_monomials (n + 1)]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨s, ⟨hs, hsl⟩, p, e, hp, rfl⟩
      have hsize := size_of_perm hsl
      have hlt : ∀ b ∈ s.labels, b < n + 1 := fun b hb => List.mem_range.1 (hsl.subset hb)
      refine ⟨isShuffle_graft e s p hs hlt (by omega), ?_⟩
      refine (labels_graft e (n + 1) s p (by omega)).trans ?_
      rw [List.range_succ]
      exact hsl.append_right _
    · rintro ⟨hs, hl⟩
      have hlen := hl.length_eq
      rw [length_labels, List.length_range] at hlen
      obtain ⟨s, p, e, hp, hss, hsa, rfl⟩ := exists_graft (a := n + 1) t hs
        (hl.nodup_iff.2 List.nodup_range) (hl.mem_iff.2 (by simp))
        (fun b hb => by have := List.mem_range.1 (hl.subset hb); omega) (by omega)
      have hsl : s.labels.Perm (List.range (n + 1)) := by
        have h1 := labels_graft e (n + 1) s p hp
        rw [List.range_succ] at hl
        exact (List.perm_append_right_iff _).1 (h1.symm.trans hl)
      exact ⟨s, ⟨hss, hsl⟩, p, e, by rw [size_of_perm hsl] at hp; exact hp, rfl⟩

name: Operad.LTree.doubleFactorial_two_mul_add_one
statement: lemma doubleFactorial_two_mul_add_one (n : ℕ) : (2 * n + 1)‼ = (2 * n + 1) * (2 * n - 1)‼
proof:
:= by
  rcases n with _ | n
  · rfl
  · rw [show 2 * (n + 1) + 1 = (2 * (n + 1) - 1) + 2 by omega, Nat.doubleFactorial_add_two]

name: Operad.LTree.card_monomials
statement:
theorem card_monomials : ∀ n : ℕ,
    (monomials (E := E) (n + 1)).card = (2 * n - 1)‼ * Fintype.card E ^ n
  | 0 => by simp [monomials]
  | n + 1 => by
    show ((monomials (E := E) (n + 1)).biUnion _).card = _
    rw [Finset.card_biUnion]
    · have hc : ∀ s ∈ monomials (E := E) (n + 1),
          ((Finset.range (2 * n + 1) ×ˢ (Finset.univ : Finset E)).image
            fun pe : ℕ × E => graft pe.2 (n + 1) s pe.1).card = (2 * n + 1) * Fintype.card E
proof:
:= by
        intro s hs
        obtain ⟨-, hsl⟩ := (mem_monomials (n + 1) s).1 hs
        have hsize := size_of_perm hsl
        have hna : n + 1 ∉ s.labels := fun h => by simpa using hsl.subset h
        rw [Finset.card_image_of_injOn, Finset.card_product, Finset.card_range, Finset.card_univ]
        rintro ⟨p, e⟩ hpe ⟨p', e'⟩ hpe' h
        simp only [Finset.coe_product, Finset.coe_range, Finset.coe_univ, Set.mem_prod,
          Set.mem_Iio, Set.mem_univ, and_true] at hpe hpe'
        obtain ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ := graft_inj s p p' hna (by omega) (by omega) h
        rfl
      rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl hc, Finset.sum_const, smul_eq_mul, card_monomials n,
        show 2 * (n + 1) - 1 = 2 * n + 1 by omega, doubleFactorial_two_mul_add_one]
      ring
    · intro s hs s' hs' hne
      simp only [Function.onFun]
      rw [Finset.disjoint_left]
      intro t ht ht'
      simp only [Finset.mem_image, Finset.mem_product, Finset.mem_range, Finset.mem_univ,
        and_true, Prod.exists] at ht ht'
      obtain ⟨p, e, hp, rfl⟩ := ht
      obtain ⟨p', e', hp', h⟩ := ht'
      obtain ⟨-, hsl⟩ := (mem_monomials (n + 1) s).1 hs
      obtain ⟨-, hsl'⟩ := (mem_monomials (n + 1) s').1 hs'
      have hna : n + 1 ∉ s.labels := fun h => by simpa using hsl.subset h
      have hna' : n + 1 ∉ s'.labels := fun h => by simpa using hsl'.subset h
      apply hne
      rw [← prune_graft e s p hna (by rw [size_of_perm hsl]; omega),
        ← prune_graft e' s' p' hna' (by rw [size_of_perm hsl']; omega), h]

name: Operad.FreeGrL.isShift_ι
statement: lemma isShift_ι : IsShift (ι R V).toSymSpeciesHom false
proof:
:= by
  intro A _ _ c v
  rw [Bool.xor_false]
  exact (ι R V).app_par c v

name: Operad.FreeGrL.wtD_ι
statement: lemma wtD_ι (v : V A) : (wtD R V).app A ((ι R V).app A v) = (ι R V).app A v
proof:
:=
  derOf_ι _ _ _ v

name: Operad.FreeGrL.wtD_unit
statement:
lemma wtD_unit (e : Unit ≃ A) :
    (wtD R V).app A (GrOperad.map (R := R) e (GrOperad.one (R := R) (P := FreeGrL R V))) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [GrDer.app_map, GrDer.app_one, map_zero]

name: Operad.FreeGrL.wtD_proj_bas
statement:
theorem wtD_proj_bas (x : Reg (TreeOfArity (GrGen R V)) A) :
    (wtD R V).app A ((𝒥).proj A (𝔟 x)) = ((treeOf x).weight : R) • (𝒥).proj A (𝔟 x)
proof:
:= by
  refine tree_induction (motive := fun A _ _ x =>
    (wtD R V).app A ((𝒥).proj A (𝔟 x)) = ((treeOf x).weight : R) • (𝒥).proj A (𝔟 x))
    ?_ ?_ ?_ A x
  · intro X _ _ x hl
    obtain ⟨e, he⟩ := proj_bas_leaf hl
    rw [he, wtD_unit, Tree.eq_leaf_of_isLeaf hl, Tree.weight_leaf, Nat.cast_zero, zero_smul]
  · intro X _ _ k g e
    have hw : (treeOf (SetOperad.map e (Reg.std (corolla g)))).weight = 1 := by
      show (Tree.node g (TreeOfArity.leaves k)).weight = 1
      rw [Tree.weight_node, weightF_leaves]
    rw [hw, Nat.cast_one, one_smul, proj_bas_map, proj_bas_corolla, GrDer.app_map]
    exact congrArg (GrOperad.map (R := R) e) (wtD_ι g.1.1)
  · intro X A B _ _ _ _ _ _ r p q e _ _ hp hq
    have hw : (treeOf (SetOperad.map e (SetOperad.comp r p q))).weight
        = (treeOf p).weight + (treeOf q).weight := by
      rw [treeOf_map, treeOf_comp, Tree.weight_graft _ _ _ (rank_lt_arity p r)]
    rw [hw, proj_bas_map, proj_bas_comp, GrDer.app_map, map_smul, GrDer.app_comp, hp,
      GrOperadHom.id_app, GrOperadHom.id_app, GrOperad.tw_false, hq, LinearMap.map_smul₂,
      map_smul (GrOperad.comp (R := R) r ((𝒥).proj A (𝔟 p))), ← add_smul, smul_comm, map_smul,
      Nat.cast_add]

name: Operad.FreeGrL.symMap_eq
statement:
lemma symMap_eq (e : A ≃ B) (x : FreeGrL R V A) :
    SymSpecies.map (R := R) e x = GrOperad.map (R := R) e x
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := (𝒥).proj_surjective A x
  rfl

name: Operad.FreeGrL.grPar_eq
statement:
lemma grPar_eq (c : Bool) (x : FreeGrL R V A) :
    GrSpecies.par (R := R) c x = GrOperad.par (R := R) c x
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := (𝒥).proj_surjective A x
  rfl

name: Operad.alg_kM
statement:
private lemma alg_kM (dM hM' tM : M →ₗ[R] M) (dN hN : N →ₗ[R] N) (dP hP : P →ₗ[R] P)
    (c m : M →ₗ[R] N →ₗ[R] P)
    (hcd : ∀ x y, dP (c x y) = c (dM x) y + c (tM x) (dN y))
    (hch : ∀ x y, hP (c x y) = c (hM' x) y + c (tM x) (hN y) + m x y)
    (hdt : ∀ x, dM (tM x) = -tM (dM x)) (hht : ∀ x, hM' (tM x) = -tM (hM' x))
    (htt : ∀ x, tM (tM x) = x) (x : M) (y : N) :
    dP (hP (c x y)) + hP (dP (c x y))
      = c (dM (hM' x) + hM' (dM x)) y + c x (dN (hN y) + hN (dN y))
        + (dP (m x y) + m (dM x) y + m (tM x) (dN y))
proof:
:= by
  simp only [hch, hcd, map_add, map_neg, LinearMap.add_apply, LinearMap.neg_apply, hdt, hht, htt]
  abel

name: Operad.alg_ct
proof:
:= by
  rw [hK, hx, hy, hXi, hE, hS]
  simp only [map_sub, LinearMap.sub_apply]
  abel

name: Operad.alg_map
proof:
:= by
  rw [hK, hE, hS, hz, map_sub]

name: Operad.alg_smul
statement:
private lemma alg_smul (K E S : M →ₗ[R] M) (a : R) {z : M} (hz : K z = E z - S z) :
    K (a • z) = E (a • z) - S (a • z)
proof:
:= by
  rw [map_smul, map_smul, map_smul, hz, smul_sub]

name: Operad.lin_eq_of_single
proof:
:=
  LinearMap.congr_fun (Finsupp.lhom_ext' fun a => LinearMap.ext_ring (h a) :
    F.comp f = G.comp f) x

name: Operad.nsmul_pred
statement: private lemma nsmul_pred {w : ℕ} (hw : 1 ≤ w) (z : M) : (w - 1) • z = (w : R) • z - z
proof:
:= by
  rw [Nat.cast_smul_eq_nsmul, eq_sub_iff_add_eq, ← succ_nsmul, Nat.sub_add_cancel hw]

name: Operad.Cobar.wtD_unitSpan
statement:
lemma wtD_unitSpan {x : 𝒞 A} (hx : x ∈ GrCooperad.unitSpan R 𝒞 A) :
    (FreeGrL.wtD R V).app A x = 0
proof:
:= by
  induction hx using Submodule.span_induction with
  | mem y hy =>
    obtain ⟨e, rfl⟩ := hy
    exact (congrArg ((FreeGrL.wtD R V).app A) (FreeGrL.symMap_eq e _)).trans
      (FreeGrL.wtD_unit e)
  | zero => exact map_zero _
  | add y z _ _ hy hz => rw [map_add, hy, hz, add_zero]
  | smul c y _ hy => rw [map_smul, hy, smul_zero]

name: Operad.Cobar.genE_proj
statement:
lemma genE_proj (x : 𝒞 A) :
    genE R V A (GrCooperad.Red.proj R 𝒞 A x) = Cobar.ιL R 𝒞 A ((FreeGrL.wtD R V).app A x)
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: Operad.Cobar.isShift_genE
statement: lemma isShift_genE : FreeGrL.IsShift (genESp R V) false
proof:
:= by
  intro A _ _ c v
  obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := GrCooperad.Red.proj_surjective (R := R) (C := 𝒞) A v
  show genE R V A (GrCooperad.Red.proj R 𝒞 A (GrSpecies.par (R := R) (!c) x))
    = GrOperad.par (R := R) (xor c false) (genE R V A (GrCooperad.Red.proj R 𝒞 A x))
  have h1 := (congrArg (fun z => Cobar.ιL R 𝒞 A ((FreeGrL.wtD R V).app A z))
    (FreeGrL.grPar_eq (!c) x)).trans (congrArg (Cobar.ιL R 𝒞 A)
      ((FreeGrL.wtD R V).app_par (!c) x))
  refine h1.trans ?_
  rw [Bool.xor_false, Bool.xor_false, ← FreeGrL.grPar_eq, Cobar.ιL_par, Bool.not_not]
  rfl

name: Operad.Cobar.wtΩ_ιL
statement:
lemma wtΩ_ιL (c : 𝒞 A) :
    (wtΩ R V).app A (Cobar.ιL R 𝒞 A c) = Cobar.ιL R 𝒞 A ((FreeGrL.wtD R V).app A c)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Cobar.ιL_apply, wtΩ, FreeGrL.derOf_ι]
  rfl

name: Operad.Cobar.hM_unit
statement:
lemma hM_unit (e : Unit ≃ A) :
    hM R V A (GrOperad.map (R := R) e (GrOperad.one (R := R) (P := CobarGr R 𝒞))) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : hM R V Unit (GrOperad.one (R := R) (P := CobarGr R 𝒞)) = 0 :=
    ((cobarMerge R V).d_proj
      (𝔅 (SetOperad.one : Reg (TreeOfArity (GrGen R (CobarGen R 𝒞))) Unit))).trans
      ((congrArg ((𝒥Ω).proj Unit) (barD_bas_of_isLeaf (μ := (cobarMerge R V).fn)
        (gp := grGenPar R (CobarGen R 𝒞)) (R := R)
        (x := (SetOperad.one : Reg (TreeOfArity (GrGen R (CobarGen R 𝒞))) Unit)) rfl)).trans
        (map_zero _))
  exact ((cobarMerge R V).map_d e _).symm.trans
    ((congrArg (GrOperad.map (R := R) e) h1).trans (map_zero _))

name: Operad.Cobar.hM_tw
statement:
lemma hM_tw (X : CobarGr R 𝒞 A) :
    hM R V A (GrOperad.tw (R := R) true X) = -GrOperad.tw (R := R) true (hM R V A X)
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : hM R V A (GrOperad.par (R := R) false X)
      = GrOperad.par (R := R) true (hM R V A X) := ((cobarMerge R V).par_d true X).symm
  have h2 : hM R V A (GrOperad.par (R := R) true X)
      = GrOperad.par (R := R) false (hM R V A X) := ((cobarMerge R V).par_d false X).symm
  exact (congrArg (hM R V A) (GrOperad.tw_true X)).trans ((map_sub (hM R V A) _ _).trans
    ((congrArg₂ (· - ·) h1 h2).trans ((neg_sub _ _).symm.trans
      (congrArg Neg.neg (GrOperad.tw_true (hM R V A X)).symm))))

name: Operad.Cobar.kM_apply
statement:
lemma kM_apply (X : CobarGr R 𝒞 A) :
    kM R V A X = (Cobar.d R 𝒞).app A (hM R V A X) + hM R V A ((Cobar.d R 𝒞).app A X)
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.Cobar.kM_comp
statement:
lemma kM_comp (r : A) (P : CobarGr R 𝒞 A) (Q : CobarGr R 𝒞 B) :
    kM R V _ (GrOperad.comp (R := R) r P Q)
      = GrOperad.comp (R := R) r (kM R V A P) Q + GrOperad.comp (R := R) r P (kM R V B Q)
        + xiM R V r P Q
proof:
:=
  alg_kM ((Cobar.d R 𝒞).app A) (hM R V A) (GrOperad.tw (R := R) true) ((Cobar.d R 𝒞).app B)
    (hM R V B) ((Cobar.d R 𝒞).app _) (hM R V _) (GrOperad.comp (R := R) r) (mM R V r)
    (d_comp r) ((cobarMerge R V).d_comp r) d_tw hM_tw (GrOperad.tw_tw true) P Q

name: Operad.Cobar.kM_map
statement:
lemma kM_map {A' : Type} [Fintype A'] [DecidableEq A'] (e : A ≃ A') (X : CobarGr R 𝒞 A) :
    kM R V A' (GrOperad.map (R := R) e X) = GrOperad.map (R := R) e (kM R V A X)
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : (Cobar.d R 𝒞).app A' (hM R V A' (GrOperad.map (R := R) e X))
      = GrOperad.map (R := R) e ((Cobar.d R 𝒞).app A (hM R V A X)) :=
    (congrArg ((Cobar.d R 𝒞).app A') ((cobarMerge R V).map_d e X).symm).trans
      ((Cobar.d R 𝒞).app_map e _)
  have h2 : hM R V A' ((Cobar.d R 𝒞).app A' (GrOperad.map (R := R) e X))
      = GrOperad.map (R := R) e (hM R V A ((Cobar.d R 𝒞).app A X)) :=
    (congrArg (hM R V A') ((Cobar.d R 𝒞).app_map e X)).trans ((cobarMerge R V).map_d e _).symm
  exact (congrArg₂ (· + ·) h1 h2).trans (map_add (GrOperad.map (R := R) e) _ _).symm

name: Operad.Cobar.kM_unit
statement:
private lemma kM_unit (e : Unit ≃ A) :
    kM R V A (GrOperad.map (R := R) e (GrOperad.one (R := R) (P := CobarGr R 𝒞)))
      = (wtΩ R V).app A (GrOperad.map (R := R) e (GrOperad.one (R := R) (P := CobarGr R 𝒞)))
        - FreeGrL.secC R (CobarGen R 𝒞) A
            (GrOperad.map (R := R) e (GrOperad.one (R := R) (P := CobarGr R 𝒞)))
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : kM R V A (GrOperad.map (R := R) e (GrOperad.one (R := R) (P := CobarGr R 𝒞))) = 0 :=
    (congrArg₂ (· + ·) ((congrArg ((Cobar.d R 𝒞).app A) (hM_unit e)).trans (map_zero _))
      ((congrArg (hM R V A) (d_unit e)).trans (map_zero _))).trans (add_zero 0)
  have h2 : (wtΩ R V).app A
      (GrOperad.map (R := R) e (GrOperad.one (R := R) (P := CobarGr R 𝒞))) = 0 :=
    ((wtΩ R V).app_map e _).trans
      ((congrArg (GrOperad.map (R := R) e) (wtΩ R V).app_one).trans (map_zero _))
  have h3 : FreeGrL.secC R (CobarGen R 𝒞) A
      (GrOperad.map (R := R) e (GrOperad.one (R := R) (P := CobarGr R 𝒞))) = 0 :=
    FreeGrL.secC_unit e
  exact h1.trans ((congrArg₂ (· - ·) h2 h3).trans (sub_zero 0)).symm

name: Operad.Cobar.kM_zero
statement:
private lemma kM_zero {Z : CobarGr R 𝒞 A} (hZ : Z = 0) :
    kM R V A Z = (wtΩ R V).app A Z - FreeGrL.secC R (CobarGen R 𝒞) A Z
proof:
:= by
  subst hZ
  exact (map_zero (kM R V A)).trans (((congrArg₂ (· - ·) (map_zero ((wtΩ R V).app A))
    (map_zero (FreeGrL.secC R (CobarGen R 𝒞) A))).trans (sub_zero 0)).symm)

name: Operad.Cobar.kM_ιL_bas
statement:
private lemma kM_ιL_bas (hV0 : ∀ v : V (Fin 0), v = 0) (t : Reg (TreeOfArity (GrGen R V)) A) :
    kM R V A (Cobar.ιL R 𝒞 A ((𝒥).proj A (𝔟 t)))
      = (wtΩ R V).app A (Cobar.ιL R 𝒞 A ((𝒥).proj A (𝔟 t)))
        - FreeGrL.secC R (CobarGen R 𝒞) A (Cobar.ιL R 𝒞 A ((𝒥).proj A (𝔟 t)))
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hl : (treeOf t).isLeaf = true
  · exact kM_zero (ιL_bas_leaf hl)
  by_cases hn : (treeOf t).NoNull
  swap
  · exact kM_zero (ιL_bas_null hV0 hn)
  have hw : 1 ≤ (treeOf t).weight := Tree.one_le_weight (by simpa using hl)
  have h1 : kM R V A (Cobar.ιL R 𝒞 A ((𝒥).proj A (𝔟 t)))
      = ((treeOf t).weight - 1) • Cobar.ιL R 𝒞 A ((𝒥).proj A (𝔟 t)) :=
    (congrArg₂ (· + ·) ((congrArg ((Cobar.d R 𝒞).app A) (hM_ιL _)).trans (map_zero _))
      (hM_d_ιL_bas t hn)).trans (zero_add _)
  have h2 : (wtΩ R V).app A (Cobar.ιL R 𝒞 A ((𝒥).proj A (𝔟 t)))
      = ((treeOf t).weight : R) • Cobar.ιL R 𝒞 A ((𝒥).proj A (𝔟 t)) :=
    (wtΩ_ιL _).trans ((congrArg (Cobar.ιL R 𝒞 A) (FreeGrL.wtD_proj_bas t)).trans
      (map_smul _ _ _))
  have h3 : FreeGrL.secC R (CobarGen R 𝒞) A (Cobar.ιL R 𝒞 A ((𝒥).proj A (𝔟 t)))
      = Cobar.ιL R 𝒞 A ((𝒥).proj A (𝔟 t)) :=
    FreeGrL.secC_of_unitCoeff (unitCoeffL_ιL _)
  rw [h1, h2, h3]
  exact nsmul_pred hw _

name: Operad.Cobar.kM_ιL
statement:
private lemma kM_ιL (hV0 : ∀ v : V (Fin 0), v = 0) (y : FreeGr R (grGenPar R V) A) :
    kM R V A (Cobar.ιL R 𝒞 A ((𝒥).proj A y))
      = (wtΩ R V).app A (Cobar.ιL R 𝒞 A ((𝒥).proj A y))
        - FreeGrL.secC R (CobarGen R 𝒞) A (Cobar.ιL R 𝒞 A ((𝒥).proj A y))
proof:
:=
  lin_eq_of_single (kM R V A) ((wtΩ R V).app A - FreeGrL.secC R (CobarGen R 𝒞) A)
    ((Cobar.ιL R 𝒞 A).comp ((𝒥).proj A)) (fun t => kM_ιL_bas hV0 t) y

name: Operad.Cobar.kM_comp_ct
statement:
private lemma kM_comp_ct (hV0 : ∀ v : V (Fin 0), v = 0) (r : A) {P : CobarGr R 𝒞 A}
    {Q : CobarGr R 𝒞 B} (hP0 : FreeGrL.unitCoeffL R (CobarGen R 𝒞) A P = 0)
    (hQ0 : FreeGrL.unitCoeffL R (CobarGen R 𝒞) B Q = 0)
    (hP : kM R V A P = (wtΩ R V).app A P - FreeGrL.secC R (CobarGen R 𝒞) A P)
    (hQ : kM R V B Q = (wtΩ R V).app B Q - FreeGrL.secC R (CobarGen R 𝒞) B Q) :
    kM R V _ (GrOperad.comp (R := R) r P Q)
      = (wtΩ R V).app _ (GrOperad.comp (R := R) r P Q)
        - FreeGrL.secC R (CobarGen R 𝒞) _ (GrOperad.comp (R := R) r P Q)
proof:
:= by
  have sP : FreeGrL.secC R (CobarGen R 𝒞) A P = P := FreeGrL.secC_of_unitCoeff hP0
  have sQ : FreeGrL.secC R (CobarGen R 𝒞) B Q = Q := FreeGrL.secC_of_unitCoeff hQ0
  have hE : (wtΩ R V).app _ (GrOperad.comp (R := R) r P Q)
      = GrOperad.comp (R := R) r ((wtΩ R V).app A P) Q
        + GrOperad.comp (R := R) r P ((wtΩ R V).app B Q) :=
    ((wtΩ R V).app_comp r P Q).trans (congrArg (fun z => GrOperad.comp (R := R) r
      ((wtΩ R V).app A P) Q + GrOperad.comp (R := R) r z ((wtΩ R V).app B Q))
        (GrOperad.tw_false P))
  exact alg_ct (GrOperad.comp (R := R) r) (kM_comp r P Q)
    (hP.trans (congrArg (fun z => (wtΩ R V).app A P - z) sP))
    (hQ.trans (congrArg (fun z => (wtΩ R V).app B Q - z) sQ))
    ((xiM_eq hV0 r P Q).trans (congrArg₂ (fun a b => GrOperad.comp (R := R) r a b) sP sQ))
    hE (FreeGrL.secC_comp hP0 Q)

name: Operad.Cobar.kM_bas_leaf
statement:
private lemma kM_bas_leaf {x : Reg (TreeOfArity (GrGen R (CobarGen R 𝒞))) A} (e : Unit ≃ A)
    (he : (𝒥Ω).proj A (𝔅 x) = GrOperad.map (R := R) e (GrOperad.one (R := R))) :
    kM R V A ((𝒥Ω).proj A (𝔅 x)) = (wtΩ R V).app A ((𝒥Ω).proj A (𝔅 x))
      - FreeGrL.secC R (CobarGen R 𝒞) A ((𝒥Ω).proj A (𝔅 x))
proof:
:= by
  rw [he]
  exact kM_unit e

name: Operad.Cobar.kM_bas_corolla
statement:
