      simp only [LinearMap.add_apply, LinearMap.comp_apply, leafD_act, map_add, twD, twF_act]
      rw [show twF ε _ _ (GrSpecies.tw (R := R) true w)
          = twD ε α S (GrSpecies.tw (R := R) true w) from rfl, twD_tw ε hα, map_neg]
      simp only [twD]
      abel)
    (fun S Y _ _ _ _ i z w => twF_act ε _ i z w)
    (fun A _ _ c => by
      rw [LinearMap.add_apply, LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearMap.comp_apply, leafD_corolla,
        map_zero, zero_add, twD_corolla, twD_corolla]
      exact leafD_snd_star ε D hα c)
    w

name: Operad.GrComposite.twDiff_indep_aug
statement:
theorem twDiff_indep_aug (ε' : GrAug R P) (α : GrOperad.Inv R (ConvOp R C P)) (S : Type)
    [Fintype S] [DecidableEq S] : twDiff R C ε D α S = twDiff R C ε' D α S
proof:
:= by
  rw [twDiff, twDiff, twD_indep_aug ε ε' α S]

name: Operad.GrComposite.twDiff_sq_eq
statement:
theorem twDiff_sq_eq (hD : ∀ (A : Type) [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] (x : P A),
    D.app A (D.app A x) = 0) {α : GrOperad.Inv R (ConvOp R C P)} (hα : GrOperad.Inv.IsPar true α)
    {S : Type} [Fintype S] [DecidableEq S] (w : GrComposite R C P S) :
    twDiff R C ε D α S (twDiff R C ε D α S w)
      = twD ε (dFam D α + GrOperad.Inv.star R _ α α) S w
proof:
:= by
  simp only [twDiff, LinearMap.add_apply, map_add]
  rw [twD_add, twD_sq ε hα, leaf_sq D hD, add_zero, ← twD_leaf_anticomm ε D hα]
  abel

name: Operad.GrComposite.twDiff_sq
statement:
theorem twDiff_sq (hD : ∀ (A : Type) [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] (x : P A),
    D.app A (D.app A x) = 0) {α : GrOperad.Inv R (ConvOp R C P)} (hα : GrOperad.Inv.IsPar true α)
    (hmc : dFam D α + GrOperad.Inv.star R _ α α = 0) {S : Type} [Fintype S] [DecidableEq S]
    (w : GrComposite R C P S) : twDiff R C ε D α S (twDiff R C ε D α S w) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [twDiff_sq_eq ε D hD hα, hmc, twD_zero]

name: Operad.FreeGr.noNullF_leaves
statement:
lemma noNullF_leaves : ∀ k : ℕ, (TreeOfArity.leaves (E := T) k).NoNullF
  | 0 => trivial
  | k + 1 => ⟨trivial, noNullF_leaves k⟩

name: Operad.FreeGr.tree_induction
statement:
theorem tree_induction
    {motive : ∀ (X : Type) [Fintype X] [DecidableEq X], Reg (TreeOfArity T) X → Prop}
    (hleaf : ∀ (X : Type) [Fintype X] [DecidableEq X] (x : Reg (TreeOfArity T) X),
      (treeOf x).isLeaf = true → motive X x)
    (hcor : ∀ (X : Type) [Fintype X] [DecidableEq X] (k : ℕ) (g : T k) (e : Fin k ≃ X),
      motive X (SetOperad.map e (Reg.std (corolla g))))
    (hcomp : ∀ (X A B : Type) [Fintype X] [DecidableEq X] [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] [Fintype B]
      [DecidableEq B] (r : A) (p : Reg (TreeOfArity T) A) (q : Reg (TreeOfArity T) B)
      (e : Without A r ⊕ B ≃ X), (treeOf p).isLeaf = false → (treeOf q).isLeaf = false →
        motive A p → motive B q → motive X (SetOperad.map e (SetOperad.comp r p q)))
    (X : Type) [Fintype X] [DecidableEq X] (x : Reg (TreeOfArity T) X) : motive X x
proof:
:= by
  suffices h : ∀ n, ∀ (X : Type) [Fintype X] [DecidableEq X] (x : Reg (TreeOfArity T) X),
      (treeOf x).weight = n → motive X x from h _ X x rfl
  intro n
  induction n using Nat.strong_induction_on with
  | _ n ih =>
    intro X _ _ x hx
    by_cases hl : (treeOf x).isLeaf = true
    · exact hleaf X x hl
    have hl' : (treeOf x).isLeaf = false := by simpa using hl
    by_cases h1 : n = 1
    · obtain ⟨k, g, hg⟩ := eq_corolla_of_nVert (x := x) (by rw [nVert_eq, hx, h1])
      obtain ⟨e, he⟩ := exists_map_eq (x := Reg.std (corolla g)) (y := x) hg.symm
      rw [← he]
      exact hcor X k g e
    have h2 : 1 < (treeOf x).weight := by
      have := Tree.one_le_weight hl'
      omega
    obtain ⟨e, he⟩ := exists_rep x h2
    have hq := Tree.isLeaf_cutV _ _ h2
    have hp := Tree.isLeaf_cutV_fst le_rfl h2 rfl
    have hw := weight_rep he
    rw [treeOf_stdT, treeOf_stdT] at hw
    have w1 := Tree.one_le_weight hp
    have w2 := Tree.one_le_weight hq
    rw [← he]
    exact hcomp X _ _ _ _ _ e hp hq (ih _ (by simp only [treeOf_stdT]; omega) _ _ rfl)
      (ih _ (by simp only [treeOf_stdT]; omega) _ _ rfl)

name: Operad.FreeGrL.unitCoeffL_comp
statement:
lemma unitCoeffL_comp (i : A) (X : FreeGrL R V A) (Y : FreeGrL R V B) :
    unitCoeffL R V _ (GrOperad.comp (R := R) i X Y) = unitCoeffL R V A X * unitCoeffL R V B Y
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := (𝒥).proj_surjective A X
  obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := (𝒥).proj_surjective B Y
  exact unitCoeff_comp i x y

name: Operad.FreeGrL.unitCoeffL_tw
statement:
lemma unitCoeffL_tw (e : Bool) (X : FreeGrL R V A) :
    unitCoeffL R V A (GrOperad.tw (R := R) e X) = unitCoeffL R V A X
proof:
:= by
  rw [GrOperad.tw_apply, map_add, map_smul, unitCoeffL_par, unitCoeffL_par, if_neg (by decide),
    if_pos rfl, smul_zero, add_zero]

name: Operad.FreeGrL.secC_comp
statement:
lemma secC_comp {i : A} {X : FreeGrL R V A} (hX : unitCoeffL R V A X = 0) (Y : FreeGrL R V B) :
    secC R V _ (GrOperad.comp (R := R) i X Y) = GrOperad.comp (R := R) i X Y
proof:
:=
  secC_of_unitCoeff (by rw [unitCoeffL_comp, hX, zero_mul])

name: Operad.FreeGrL.proj_bas_map
statement:
lemma proj_bas_map (e : A ≃ B) (x : Reg (TreeOfArity (GrGen R V)) A) :
    (𝒥).proj B (𝔟 (SetOperad.map e x)) = GrOperad.map (R := R) e ((𝒥).proj A (𝔟 x))
proof:
:= by
  rw [← SgnLin.map_bas]
  rfl

name: Operad.FreeGrL.proj_bas_comp
statement:
lemma proj_bas_comp (r : A) (p : Reg (TreeOfArity (GrGen R V)) A)
    (q : Reg (TreeOfArity (GrGen R V)) B) :
    (𝒥).proj _ (𝔟 (SetOperad.comp r p q))
      = σ R (cSgn (grGenPar R V) r p q) •
          GrOperad.comp (R := R) r ((𝒥).proj A (𝔟 p)) ((𝒥).proj B (𝔟 q))
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : GrOperad.comp (R := R) r ((𝒥).proj A (𝔟 p)) ((𝒥).proj B (𝔟 q))
      = σ R (cSgn (grGenPar R V) r p q) • (𝒥).proj _ (𝔟 (SetOperad.comp r p q)) := by
    show (𝒥).proj _ (GrOperad.comp (R := R) r _ _) = _
    rw [comp_bas_eq, map_smul]
  rw [h1, smul_smul, show σ R (cSgn (grGenPar R V) r p q) * σ R (cSgn (grGenPar R V) r p q) = 1
    by cases cSgn (grGenPar R V) r p q <;> simp, one_smul]

name: Operad.FreeGrL.proj_bas_one
statement:
lemma proj_bas_one :
    (𝒥).proj Unit (𝔟 (SetOperad.one : Reg (TreeOfArity (GrGen R V)) Unit))
      = GrOperad.one (R := R) (P := FreeGrL R V)
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.FreeGrL.proj_bas_corolla
statement:
lemma proj_bas_corolla {k : ℕ} (g : GrGen R V k) :
    (𝒥).proj (Fin k) (𝔟 (Reg.std (corolla g))) = (ι R V).app (Fin k) g.1.1
proof:
:=
  (ι_app_hom g.2).symm

name: Operad.FreeGrL.unitCoeffL_proj_bas
statement:
lemma unitCoeffL_proj_bas {x : Reg (TreeOfArity (GrGen R V)) A} (hx : (treeOf x).isLeaf = false) :
    unitCoeffL R V A ((𝒥).proj A (𝔟 x)) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [unitCoeffL_proj, unitCoeff_bas, if_neg (by rw [hx]; decide)]

name: Operad.FreeGrL.proj_bas_leaf
statement:
lemma proj_bas_leaf {x : Reg (TreeOfArity (GrGen R V)) A} (hx : (treeOf x).isLeaf = true) :
    ∃ e : Unit ≃ A, (𝒥).proj A (𝔟 x) = GrOperad.map (R := R) e (GrOperad.one (R := R))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨e, rfl⟩ := eq_map_one_of_isLeaf hx
  exact ⟨e, proj_bas_map e _⟩

name: Operad.FreeGrL.proj_bas_eq_zero
statement:
theorem proj_bas_eq_zero (hV0 : ∀ v : V (Fin 0), v = 0) (x : Reg (TreeOfArity (GrGen R V)) A)
    (hx : ¬ (treeOf x).NoNull) : (𝒥).proj A (𝔟 x) = 0
proof:
:= by
  revert hx
  refine tree_induction (motive := fun A _ _ x => ¬ (treeOf x).NoNull → (𝒥).proj A (𝔟 x) = 0)
    ?_ ?_ ?_ A x
  · intro X _ _ x hl hx
    rw [Tree.eq_leaf_of_isLeaf hl] at hx
    exact absurd Tree.noNull_leaf hx
  · intro X _ _ k g e hx
    rw [proj_bas_map, proj_bas_corolla]
    rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos k with rfl | hk
    · rw [hV0 g.1.1, map_zero, map_zero]
    · exact absurd (show (corolla g).1.NoNull from ⟨hk, noNullF_leaves k⟩) hx
  · intro X A B _ _ _ _ _ _ r p q e _ _ hp hq hx
    rw [proj_bas_map, proj_bas_comp]
    rcases not_and_or.1 (fun h => hx (by rw [treeOf_map]; exact (noNull_comp r p q).2 h)) with h | h
    · rw [hp h, LinearMap.map_zero₂, smul_zero, map_zero]
    · rw [hq h, map_zero, smul_zero, map_zero]

name: Operad.MergeSp.par_mc
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := (𝒥).proj_surjective A X
  obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := (𝒥).proj_surjective B Y
  rw [← hX, ← hY, ← proj_par', ← proj_par', mc_proj, ← proj_par', par_mcomp M.fn M.fn_odd,
    if_pos rfl]

name: Operad.MergeSp.tw_mc
statement:
theorem tw_mc (i : A) (X : FreeGrL R W A) (Y : FreeGrL R W B) :
    GrOperad.tw (R := R) true (M.mc i X Y)
      = -M.mc i (GrOperad.tw (R := R) true X) (GrOperad.tw (R := R) true Y)
proof:
:= by
  have key : ∀ a b : Bool, GrOperad.tw (R := R) true
      (M.mc i (GrOperad.par (R := R) a X) (GrOperad.par (R := R) b Y))
      = -M.mc i (GrOperad.tw (R := R) true (GrOperad.par (R := R) a X))
          (GrOperad.tw (R := R) true (GrOperad.par (R := R) b Y)) := by
    intro a b
    rw [GrOperad.tw_hom true (M.par_mc i (GrOperad.par_par_self a X)
        (GrOperad.par_par_self b Y)),
      GrOperad.tw_hom true (GrOperad.par_par_self a X),
      GrOperad.tw_hom true (GrOperad.par_par_self b Y), map_smul, LinearMap.map_smul₂,
      smul_smul, ← neg_smul]
    congr 1
    cases a <;> cases b <;> simp
  conv_lhs => rw [← GrOperad.par_add (R := R) X, ← GrOperad.par_add (R := R) Y]
  conv_rhs => rw [← GrOperad.par_add (R := R) X, ← GrOperad.par_add (R := R) Y]
  simp only [map_add, LinearMap.add_apply, key, neg_add]

name: Operad.map_add₃
statement: lemma map_add₃ (f : M →ₗ[R] N) (a b c : M) : f (a + b + c) = f a + f b + f c
proof:
:= by
  rw [map_add, map_add]

name: Operad.lin_eq_zero_of_single
statement:
lemma lin_eq_zero_of_single {α : Type*} (F : (α →₀ R) →ₗ[R] M)
    (h : ∀ a, F (Finsupp.single a 1) = 0) (x : α →₀ R) : F x = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hF : F = 0 := Finsupp.lhom_ext' fun a => LinearMap.ext_ring (h a)
  rw [hF, LinearMap.zero_apply]

name: Operad.bilin_ext_single
statement:
lemma bilin_ext_single {α β : Type*} {P : Type*} [AddCommGroup P] [Module R P]
    (F G : M →ₗ[R] N →ₗ[R] P) (f : (α →₀ R) →ₗ[R] M) (g : (β →₀ R) →ₗ[R] N)
    (h : ∀ a b, F (f (Finsupp.single a 1)) (g (Finsupp.single b 1))
      = G (f (Finsupp.single a 1)) (g (Finsupp.single b 1)))
    (x : α →₀ R) (y : β →₀ R) : F (f x) (g y) = G (f x) (g y)
proof:
:= by
  have hF : F.compl₁₂ f g = G.compl₁₂ f g :=
    Finsupp.lhom_ext' fun a => LinearMap.ext_ring
      (Finsupp.lhom_ext' fun b => LinearMap.ext_ring (h a b))
  exact LinearMap.congr_fun₂ hF x y

name: Operad.Cobar.xiM_apply
statement:
lemma xiM_apply (i : A) (X : CobarGr R 𝒞 A) (Y : CobarGr R 𝒞 B) :
    xiM R V i X Y = (Cobar.d R 𝒞).app _ (mM R V i X Y) + mM R V i ((Cobar.d R 𝒞).app A X) Y
      + mM R V i (GrOperad.tw (R := R) true X) ((Cobar.d R 𝒞).app B Y)
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.Cobar.d_tw
statement:
lemma d_tw (X : CobarGr R 𝒞 A) :
    (Cobar.d R 𝒞).app A (GrOperad.tw (R := R) true X)
      = -GrOperad.tw (R := R) true ((Cobar.d R 𝒞).app A X)
proof:
:= by
  exact (GrDer.app_tw (Cobar.d R 𝒞) true X).trans (neg_one_smul R _)

name: Operad.Cobar.d_comp
statement:
lemma d_comp (j : A) (W : CobarGr R 𝒞 A) (Q : CobarGr R 𝒞 B) :
    (Cobar.d R 𝒞).app _ (GrOperad.comp (R := R) j W Q)
      = GrOperad.comp (R := R) j ((Cobar.d R 𝒞).app A W) Q
        + GrOperad.comp (R := R) j (GrOperad.tw (R := R) true W) ((Cobar.d R 𝒞).app B Q)
proof:
:=
  (Cobar.d R 𝒞).app_comp j W Q

name: Operad.Cobar.d_unit
statement:
lemma d_unit (e : Unit ≃ A) :
    (Cobar.d R 𝒞).app A (GrOperad.map (R := R) e (GrOperad.one (R := R) (P := CobarGr R 𝒞)))
      = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [GrDer.app_map, GrDer.app_one, map_zero]

name: Operad.Cobar.tw_unit
statement:
lemma tw_unit (e : Unit ≃ A) :
    GrOperad.tw (R := R) true (GrOperad.map (R := R) e (GrOperad.one (R := R) (P := CobarGr R 𝒞)))
      = GrOperad.map (R := R) e (GrOperad.one (R := R) (P := CobarGr R 𝒞))
proof:
:= by
  rw [← GrOperad.map_tw, GrOperad.tw_one]

name: Operad.Cobar.xiM_map_right
statement:
lemma xiM_map_right {B' : Type} [Fintype B'] [DecidableEq B'] (e : B ≃ B') (i : A)
    (X : CobarGr R 𝒞 A) (Y : CobarGr R 𝒞 B) :
    xiM R V i X (GrOperad.map (R := R) e Y)
      = GrOperad.map (R := R) (compEquiv (Equiv.refl A) e i) (xiM R V i X Y)
proof:
:= by
  have h1 := (cobarMerge R V).mc_map_right e i X Y
  have h2 := (cobarMerge R V).mc_map_right e i ((Cobar.d R 𝒞).app A X) Y
  have h3 := (congrArg (mM R V i (GrOperad.tw (R := R) true X)) ((Cobar.d R 𝒞).app_map e Y)).trans
    ((cobarMerge R V).mc_map_right e i (GrOperad.tw (R := R) true X) ((Cobar.d R 𝒞).app B Y))
  have h4 := (congrArg ((Cobar.d R 𝒞).app _) h1).trans ((Cobar.d R 𝒞).app_map _ _)
  exact (congrArg₂ (· + ·) (congrArg₂ (· + ·) h4 h2) h3).trans (map_add₃ _ _ _ _).symm

name: Operad.Cobar.xiM_map_left
statement:
lemma xiM_map_left {A' : Type} [Fintype A'] [DecidableEq A'] (e : A ≃ A') (i : A)
    (X : CobarGr R 𝒞 A) (Y : CobarGr R 𝒞 B) :
    xiM R V (e i) (GrOperad.map (R := R) e X) Y
      = GrOperad.map (R := R) (compEquiv e (Equiv.refl B) i) (xiM R V i X Y)
proof:
:= by
  have h1 := (cobarMerge R V).mc_map_left e i X Y
  have h2 := (congrArg (fun z => mM R V (e i) z Y) ((Cobar.d R 𝒞).app_map e X)).trans
    ((cobarMerge R V).mc_map_left e i ((Cobar.d R 𝒞).app A X) Y)
  have h3 := (congrArg (fun z => mM R V (e i) z ((Cobar.d R 𝒞).app B Y))
    (GrOperad.map_tw true e X).symm).trans
    ((cobarMerge R V).mc_map_left e i (GrOperad.tw (R := R) true X) ((Cobar.d R 𝒞).app B Y))
  have h4 := (congrArg ((Cobar.d R 𝒞).app _) h1).trans ((Cobar.d R 𝒞).app_map _ _)
  exact (congrArg₂ (· + ·) (congrArg₂ (· + ·) h4 h2) h3).trans (map_add₃ _ _ _ _).symm

name: Operad.Cobar.xiM_eq_of_left
statement:
private lemma xiM_eq_of_left {i : A} {X : CobarGr R 𝒞 A} (hX : X = 0) (Y : CobarGr R 𝒞 B) :
    xiM R V i X Y = GrOperad.comp (R := R) i X Y
proof:
:= by
  subst hX
  exact (LinearMap.map_zero₂ (xiM R V i) Y).trans (LinearMap.map_zero₂ _ Y).symm

name: Operad.Cobar.xiM_eq_of_right
statement:
private lemma xiM_eq_of_right {i : A} (X : CobarGr R 𝒞 A) {Y : CobarGr R 𝒞 B} (hY : Y = 0) :
    xiM R V i X Y = GrOperad.comp (R := R) i X Y
proof:
:= by
  subst hY
  exact (map_zero (xiM R V i X)).trans (map_zero _).symm

name: Operad.Cobar.ιL_bas_leaf
statement:
lemma ιL_bas_leaf {x : Reg (TreeOfArity (GrGen R V)) A} (hx : (treeOf x).isLeaf = true) :
    Cobar.ιL R 𝒞 A ((𝒥).proj A (𝔟 x)) = 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨e, rfl⟩ := eq_map_one_of_isLeaf hx
  rw [← SgnLin.map_bas]
  exact Cobar.ιL_unitSpan R 𝒞 (GrCooperad.map_one_mem e)

name: Operad.Cobar.ιL_bas_null
statement:
lemma ιL_bas_null (hV0 : ∀ v : V (Fin 0), v = 0) {x : Reg (TreeOfArity (GrGen R V)) A}
    (hx : ¬ (treeOf x).NoNull) : Cobar.ιL R 𝒞 A ((𝒥).proj A (𝔟 x)) = 0
proof:
:=
  (congrArg (Cobar.ιL R 𝒞 A) (FreeGrL.proj_bas_eq_zero hV0 x hx)).trans (map_zero _)

name: Operad.Cobar.xiM_ιL
statement:
theorem xiM_ιL (hV0 : ∀ v : V (Fin 0), v = 0) (i : A) (y : FreeGr R (grGenPar R V) A)
    (y' : FreeGr R (grGenPar R V) B) :
    xiM R V i (Cobar.ιL R 𝒞 A ((𝒥).proj A y)) (Cobar.ιL R 𝒞 B ((𝒥).proj B y'))
      = GrOperad.comp (R := R) i (Cobar.ιL R 𝒞 A ((𝒥).proj A y))
          (Cobar.ιL R 𝒞 B ((𝒥).proj B y'))
proof:
:= by
  have key : ∀ (s : Reg (TreeOfArity (GrGen R V)) A) (t : Reg (TreeOfArity (GrGen R V)) B),
      xiM R V i (Cobar.ιL R 𝒞 A ((𝒥).proj A (𝔟 s))) (Cobar.ιL R 𝒞 B ((𝒥).proj B (𝔟 t)))
        = GrOperad.comp (R := R) i (Cobar.ιL R 𝒞 A ((𝒥).proj A (𝔟 s)))
            (Cobar.ιL R 𝒞 B ((𝒥).proj B (𝔟 t))) := by
    intro s t
    by_cases hs : (treeOf s).isLeaf = true
    · exact xiM_eq_of_left (ιL_bas_leaf hs) _
    by_cases ht : (treeOf t).isLeaf = true
    · exact xiM_eq_of_right _ (ιL_bas_leaf ht)
    by_cases hns : (treeOf s).NoNull
    swap
    · exact xiM_eq_of_left (ιL_bas_null hV0 hns) _
    by_cases hnt : (treeOf t).NoNull
    swap
    · exact xiM_eq_of_right _ (ιL_bas_null hV0 hnt)
    exact (xiM_apply i _ _).trans
      (d_mM_ιL_bas i s t (by simpa using hs) (by simpa using ht) hns hnt)
  exact bilin_ext_single (xiM R V i) (GrOperad.comp (R := R) (P := CobarGr R 𝒞) i)
    ((Cobar.ιL R 𝒞 A).comp ((𝒥).proj A)) ((Cobar.ιL R 𝒞 B).comp ((𝒥).proj B)) key y y'

name: Operad.Cobar.xiM_unit_right
statement:
private lemma xiM_unit_right (e : Unit ≃ B) (i : A) (X : CobarGr R 𝒞 A) :
    xiM R V i X (GrOperad.map (R := R) e (GrOperad.one (R := R) (P := CobarGr R 𝒞))) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have h1 := (cobarMerge R V).mc_unit_right e i X
  have h2 := (cobarMerge R V).mc_unit_right e i ((Cobar.d R 𝒞).app A X)
  have h3 := (congrArg (mM R V i (GrOperad.tw (R := R) true X)) (d_unit e)).trans
    (map_zero (mM R V i (GrOperad.tw (R := R) true X)))
  refine (xiM_apply i X _).trans ((congrArg₂ (· + ·) (congrArg₂ (· + ·)
    ((congrArg ((Cobar.d R 𝒞).app _) h1).trans (map_zero _)) h2) h3).trans ?_)
  simp only [add_zero]

name: Operad.Cobar.xiM_unit_left
statement:
private lemma xiM_unit_left (e : Unit ≃ A) (i : A) (Y : CobarGr R 𝒞 B) :
    xiM R V i (GrOperad.map (R := R) e (GrOperad.one (R := R) (P := CobarGr R 𝒞))) Y = 0
proof:
:= by
  have h1 := (cobarMerge R V).mc_unit_left e i Y
  have h2 := (congrArg (fun z => mM R V i z Y) (d_unit e)).trans
    (LinearMap.map_zero₂ (mM R V i) Y)
  have h3 := (congrArg (fun z => mM R V i z ((Cobar.d R 𝒞).app B Y)) (tw_unit e)).trans
    ((cobarMerge R V).mc_unit_left e i ((Cobar.d R 𝒞).app B Y))
  refine (xiM_apply i _ Y).trans ((congrArg₂ (· + ·) (congrArg₂ (· + ·)
    ((congrArg ((Cobar.d R 𝒞).app _) h1).trans (map_zero _)) h2) h3).trans ?_)
  simp only [add_zero]

name: Operad.Cobar.alg_outer
statement:
private lemma alg_outer {M N P P' : Type*} [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] [AddCommGroup N]
    [Module R N]
    [AddCommGroup P] [Module R P] [AddCommGroup P'] [Module R P'] (S : P →ₗ[R] P')
    (c : M →ₗ[R] N →ₗ[R] P) (a b e t f : M) (q q' : N) (h : t = -f) :
    S (c a q + c t q') + S (c b q) + (S (c e q) + S (c f q')) = S (c (a + b + e) q)
proof:
:= by
  subst h
  simp only [map_add, LinearMap.add_apply, map_neg, LinearMap.neg_apply]
  abel

name: Operad.Cobar.xiM_comp_outer
statement:
private lemma xiM_comp_outer (i : A) (r : B) (X : CobarGr R 𝒞 A) {P : CobarGr R 𝒞 B}
    (hP : FreeGrL.unitCoeffL R (CobarGen R 𝒞) B P = 0)
    (hdP : FreeGrL.unitCoeffL R (CobarGen R 𝒞) B ((Cobar.d R 𝒞).app B P) = 0)
    (Q : CobarGr R 𝒞 D) :
    xiM R V i X (GrOperad.comp (R := R) r P Q)
      = GrOperad.map (R := R) (seqEquiv i r D)
          (GrOperad.comp (R := R) (Sum.inr r) (xiM R V i X P) Q)
proof:
:= by
  have htP : FreeGrL.unitCoeffL R (CobarGen R 𝒞) B (GrOperad.tw (R := R) true P) = 0 := by
    rw [FreeGrL.unitCoeffL_tw, hP]
  have o1 := (cobarMerge R V).comp_mc_outer i r X hP Q
  have o2 := (cobarMerge R V).comp_mc_outer i r ((Cobar.d R 𝒞).app A X) hP Q
  have o3 := (cobarMerge R V).comp_mc_outer i r (GrOperad.tw (R := R) true X) hdP Q
  have o4 := (cobarMerge R V).comp_mc_outer i r (GrOperad.tw (R := R) true X) htP
    ((Cobar.d R 𝒞).app D Q)
  have dl : (Cobar.d R 𝒞).app _ (GrOperad.comp (R := R) r P Q)
      = GrOperad.comp (R := R) r ((Cobar.d R 𝒞).app B P) Q
        + GrOperad.comp (R := R) r (GrOperad.tw (R := R) true P) ((Cobar.d R 𝒞).app D Q) :=
    d_comp r P Q
  have dl2 : (Cobar.d R 𝒞).app _ (GrOperad.comp (R := R) (Sum.inr r) (mM R V i X P) Q)
      = GrOperad.comp (R := R) (Sum.inr r) ((Cobar.d R 𝒞).app _ (mM R V i X P)) Q
        + GrOperad.comp (R := R) (Sum.inr r) (GrOperad.tw (R := R) true (mM R V i X P))
            ((Cobar.d R 𝒞).app D Q) :=
    d_comp _ _ _
  have tm := (cobarMerge R V).tw_mc i X P
  have hA := (congrArg ((Cobar.d R 𝒞).app _) o1.symm).trans (((Cobar.d R 𝒞).app_map _ _).trans
    (congrArg (GrOperad.map (R := R) (seqEquiv i r D)) dl2))
  have hC := (congrArg (mM R V i (GrOperad.tw (R := R) true X)) dl).trans
    ((map_add _ _ _).trans (congrArg₂ (· + ·) o3.symm o4.symm))
  refine (xiM_apply i X _).trans ((congrArg₂ (· + ·) (congrArg₂ (· + ·) hA o2.symm) hC).trans ?_)
  refine (alg_outer _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ tm).trans ?_
  exact congrArg (fun z => GrOperad.map (R := R) (seqEquiv i r D)
    (GrOperad.comp (R := R) (Sum.inr r) z Q)) (xiM_apply i X P).symm

name: Operad.Cobar.alg_inner
statement:
private lemma alg_inner {M N P : Type*} [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] [AddCommGroup N] [Module R N]
    [AddCommGroup P] [Module R P] (c : M →ₗ[R] N →ₗ[R] P) (a a' p p' : M) (m dm x y : N)
    (ha : a = -a') (hp : p' = p) :
    c a m + c p' dm + (c a' m + c p' x) + c p' y = c p (dm + x + y)
proof:
:= by
  subst ha hp
  simp only [map_add, map_neg, LinearMap.neg_apply]
  abel

name: Operad.Cobar.xiM_comp_inner
statement:
private lemma xiM_comp_inner (r : A) (w : B) (P : CobarGr R 𝒞 A) {Q : CobarGr R 𝒞 B}
    (hQ : FreeGrL.unitCoeffL R (CobarGen R 𝒞) B Q = 0)
    (hdQ : FreeGrL.unitCoeffL R (CobarGen R 𝒞) B ((Cobar.d R 𝒞).app B Q) = 0)
    (Z : CobarGr R 𝒞 D) :
    GrOperad.map (R := R) (seqEquiv r w D) (xiM R V (Sum.inr w) (GrOperad.comp (R := R) r P Q) Z)
      = GrOperad.comp (R := R) r P (xiM R V w Q Z)
proof:
:= by
  have htQ : FreeGrL.unitCoeffL R (CobarGen R 𝒞) B (GrOperad.tw (R := R) true Q) = 0 := by
    rw [FreeGrL.unitCoeffL_tw, hQ]
  have i1 := (cobarMerge R V).mc_comp_inner r w P hQ Z
  have i2 := (cobarMerge R V).mc_comp_inner r w ((Cobar.d R 𝒞).app A P) hQ Z
  have i3 := (cobarMerge R V).mc_comp_inner r w (GrOperad.tw (R := R) true P) hdQ Z
  have i4 := (cobarMerge R V).mc_comp_inner r w (GrOperad.tw (R := R) true P) htQ
    ((Cobar.d R 𝒞).app D Z)
  have dl : (Cobar.d R 𝒞).app _ (GrOperad.comp (R := R) r P Q)
      = GrOperad.comp (R := R) r ((Cobar.d R 𝒞).app A P) Q
        + GrOperad.comp (R := R) r (GrOperad.tw (R := R) true P) ((Cobar.d R 𝒞).app B Q) :=
    d_comp r P Q
  have dl2 : (Cobar.d R 𝒞).app _ (GrOperad.comp (R := R) r (GrOperad.tw (R := R) true P)
      (mM R V w Q Z))
      = GrOperad.comp (R := R) r ((Cobar.d R 𝒞).app A (GrOperad.tw (R := R) true P))
          (mM R V w Q Z)
        + GrOperad.comp (R := R) r (GrOperad.tw (R := R) true (GrOperad.tw (R := R) true P))
            ((Cobar.d R 𝒞).app _ (mM R V w Q Z)) :=
    d_comp _ _ _
  have h1 := ((Cobar.d R 𝒞).app_map _ _).symm.trans
    ((congrArg ((Cobar.d R 𝒞).app _) i1).trans dl2)
  have h2 := (congrArg (fun z => GrOperad.map (R := R) (seqEquiv r w D)
    (mM R V (Sum.inr w) z Z)) dl).trans ((congrArg (GrOperad.map (R := R) (seqEquiv r w D))
      (LinearMap.map_add₂ _ _ _ _)).trans ((map_add _ _ _).trans (congrArg₂ (· + ·) i2 i3)))
  have h3 := (congrArg (fun z => GrOperad.map (R := R) (seqEquiv r w D)
    (mM R V (Sum.inr w) z ((Cobar.d R 𝒞).app D Z))) (GrOperad.tw_comp true r P Q)).trans i4
  refine (congrArg (GrOperad.map (R := R) (seqEquiv r w D)) (xiM_apply _ _ _)).trans
    ((map_add₃ _ _ _ _).trans ((congrArg₂ (· + ·) (congrArg₂ (· + ·) h1 h2) h3).trans ?_))
  refine (alg_inner _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ (d_tw P) (GrOperad.tw_tw true P)).trans ?_
  exact congrArg (GrOperad.comp (R := R) r P) (xiM_apply w Q Z).symm

name: Operad.Cobar.alg_par
statement:
private lemma alg_par {M N P : Type*} [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] [AddCommGroup N] [Module R N]
    [AddCommGroup P] [Module R P] (c : M →ₗ[R] N →ₗ[R] P) (a b e W : M) (Q dQ : N)
    (s s₁ s₂ tz tq : R) (h₁ : s₁ = s * tz) (h₂ : s₂ * tq = s) :
    s • (c a Q + c (-(tz • W)) dQ) + (s • c b Q + s₁ • c W dQ) + s₂ • c e (tq • Q)
      = s • c (a + b + e) Q
proof:
:= by
  subst h₁ h₂
  simp only [map_add, map_neg, map_smul, LinearMap.add_apply, LinearMap.neg_apply,
    LinearMap.smul_apply, smul_add, smul_neg, smul_smul]
  abel

name: Operad.Cobar.xiM_comp_par
statement:
private lemma xiM_comp_par {r u : A} (hru : r ≠ u) (P : CobarGr R 𝒞 A) {q z : Bool}
    {Q : CobarGr R 𝒞 B} {Z : CobarGr R 𝒞 D} (hQ : GrOperad.par (R := R) q Q = Q)
    (hZ : GrOperad.par (R := R) z Z = Z) :
    GrOperad.map (R := R) (parEquiv hru B D)
        (xiM R V (Sum.inl ⟨u, Ne.symm hru⟩) (GrOperad.comp (R := R) r P Q) Z)
      = σ R (q && z) • GrOperad.comp (R := R) (Sum.inl ⟨r, hru⟩) (xiM R V u P Z) Q
proof:
:= by
  have hdQ : GrOperad.par (R := R) (!q) ((Cobar.d R 𝒞).app B Q) = (Cobar.d R 𝒞).app B Q := by
    have h := ((congrArg ((Cobar.d R 𝒞).app B) hQ).symm.trans ((Cobar.d R 𝒞).app_par q Q)).symm
    rwa [Bool.xor_true] at h
  have hdZ : GrOperad.par (R := R) (!z) ((Cobar.d R 𝒞).app D Z) = (Cobar.d R 𝒞).app D Z := by
    have h := ((congrArg ((Cobar.d R 𝒞).app D) hZ).symm.trans ((Cobar.d R 𝒞).app_par z Z)).symm
    rwa [Bool.xor_true] at h
  have htQ : GrOperad.par (R := R) q (GrOperad.tw (R := R) true Q)
      = GrOperad.tw (R := R) true Q :=
    (GrOperad.par_tw true q Q).trans (congrArg (GrOperad.tw (R := R) true) hQ)
  have p1 := (cobarMerge R V).mc_comp_par hru P hQ hZ
  have p2 := (cobarMerge R V).mc_comp_par hru ((Cobar.d R 𝒞).app A P) hQ hZ
  have p3 := (cobarMerge R V).mc_comp_par hru (GrOperad.tw (R := R) true P) hdQ hZ
  have p4 := (cobarMerge R V).mc_comp_par hru (GrOperad.tw (R := R) true P) htQ hdZ
  have dl : (Cobar.d R 𝒞).app _ (GrOperad.comp (R := R) r P Q)
      = GrOperad.comp (R := R) r ((Cobar.d R 𝒞).app A P) Q
        + GrOperad.comp (R := R) r (GrOperad.tw (R := R) true P) ((Cobar.d R 𝒞).app B Q) :=
    d_comp r P Q
  have dl2 := d_comp (R := R) (V := V) (Sum.inl ⟨r, hru⟩ : Without A u ⊕ D) (mM R V u P Z) Q
  have tm : GrOperad.tw (R := R) true (mM R V u P Z)
      = -(σ R (true && z) • mM R V u (GrOperad.tw (R := R) true P) Z) :=
    ((cobarMerge R V).tw_mc u P Z).trans (congrArg Neg.neg
      ((congrArg (mM R V u (GrOperad.tw (R := R) true P)) (GrOperad.tw_hom true hZ)).trans
        (map_smul _ _ _)))
  have h1 := ((Cobar.d R 𝒞).app_map _ _).symm.trans
    ((congrArg ((Cobar.d R 𝒞).app _) p1).trans ((map_smul ((Cobar.d R 𝒞).app _)
      (σ R (q && z)) _).trans
      (congrArg (fun x => σ R (q && z) • x) (dl2.trans (congrArg (fun x =>
        GrOperad.comp (R := R) (Sum.inl ⟨r, hru⟩ : Without A u ⊕ D)
            ((Cobar.d R 𝒞).app _ (mM R V u P Z)) Q
          + GrOperad.comp (R := R) (Sum.inl ⟨r, hru⟩ : Without A u ⊕ D) x
              ((Cobar.d R 𝒞).app B Q)) tm)))))
  have h2 := (congrArg (fun x => GrOperad.map (R := R) (parEquiv hru B D)
    (mM R V (Sum.inl ⟨u, Ne.symm hru⟩ : Without A r ⊕ B) x Z)) dl).trans
      ((congrArg (GrOperad.map (R := R) (parEquiv hru B D)) (LinearMap.map_add₂ _ _ _ _)).trans
        ((map_add (GrOperad.map (R := R) (parEquiv hru B D)) _ _).trans
        (congrArg₂ (· + ·) p2 p3)))
  have h3 := (congrArg (fun x => GrOperad.map (R := R) (parEquiv hru B D)
    (mM R V (Sum.inl ⟨u, Ne.symm hru⟩ : Without A r ⊕ B) x ((Cobar.d R 𝒞).app D Z)))
      (GrOperad.tw_comp true r P Q)).trans (p4.trans (congrArg (fun x => σ R (q && !z) •
        GrOperad.comp (R := R) (Sum.inl ⟨r, hru⟩ : Without A u ⊕ D)
          (mM R V u (GrOperad.tw (R := R) true P) ((Cobar.d R 𝒞).app D Z)) x)
        (GrOperad.tw_hom true hQ)))
  refine (congrArg (GrOperad.map (R := R) (parEquiv hru B D)) (xiM_apply _ _ _)).trans
    ((map_add₃ _ _ _ _).trans ((congrArg₂ (· + ·) (congrArg₂ (· + ·) h1 h2) h3).trans ?_))
  refine (alg_par _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ (by cases q <;> cases z <;> simp)
    (by cases q <;> cases z <;> simp)).trans ?_
  exact congrArg (fun x => σ R (q && z) •
    GrOperad.comp (R := R) (Sum.inl ⟨r, hru⟩ : Without A u ⊕ D) x Q) (xiM_apply u P Z).symm

name: Operad.Cobar.exists_ιL_eq
statement:
lemma exists_ιL_eq (v : CobarGen R 𝒞 A) :
    ∃ y : FreeGr R (grGenPar R V) A,
      Cobar.ιL R 𝒞 A ((𝒥).proj A y) = (FreeGrL.ι R (CobarGen R 𝒞)).app A v
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := GrCooperad.Red.proj_surjective (R := R) (C := 𝒞) A
    ((GrSpecies.Shift.of (R := R) (V := GrCooperad.Red R 𝒞) A).symm v)
  obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := (𝒥).proj_surjective A c
  refine ⟨y, (Cobar.ιL_apply R 𝒞 _).trans (congrArg ((FreeGrL.ι R (CobarGen R 𝒞)).app A) ?_)⟩
  rw [hc]
  exact LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply _ v

name: Operad.Cobar.unitCoeffL_starI
proof:
:= by
  rw [Finset.mem_Ico] at hv
  obtain ⟨e, he⟩ := exists_rep t hv.2
  have hst := starI_eq (R := R) (V := V) he (Tree.isLeaf_cutV _ _ hv.2)
  have hvert : vert ⟨((treeOf t).cutV v).2.2, Tree.lt_arity_cutV _ v hv.2⟩
      (stdT ((treeOf t).cutV v).1) = v := by
    show (treeOf (stdT _)).vb ((stdT _).1.rank _) = v
    rw [treeOf_stdT, rank_stdT]
    exact Tree.vb_cutV _ _ hv.2
  rw [hvert] at hst
  rw [hst]
  unfold repI
  rw [FreeGrL.unitCoeffL_map, map_smul, FreeGrL.unitCoeffL_comp, unitCoeffL_ιL, zero_mul,
    smul_zero]

name: Operad.Cobar.unitCoeffL_d_ιL
proof:
:= by
  refine lin_eq_zero_of_single ((FreeGrL.unitCoeffL R (CobarGen R 𝒞) A).comp
    (((Cobar.d R 𝒞).app A).comp ((Cobar.ιL R 𝒞 A).comp ((𝒥).proj A)))) (fun t => ?_) y
  show FreeGrL.unitCoeffL R (CobarGen R 𝒞) A
    ((Cobar.d R 𝒞).app A (Cobar.ιL R 𝒞 A ((𝒥).proj A (𝔟 t)))) = 0
  by_cases ht : (treeOf t).isLeaf = true
  · rw [ιL_bas_leaf ht, map_zero, map_zero]
  by_cases hn : (treeOf t).NoNull
  · rw [d_ιL_bas t hn, map_neg, map_sum, Finset.sum_eq_zero fun v hv => unitCoeffL_starI t hv,
      neg_zero]
  · rw [ιL_bas_null hV0 hn, map_zero, map_zero]

name: Operad.Cobar.uc_d_map
proof:
:= by
  rw [GrDer.app_map, FreeGrL.unitCoeffL_map]

name: Operad.Cobar.uc_d_smul
proof:
:= by
  rw [map_smul, map_smul]

name: Operad.Cobar.uc_d_comp
statement:
private lemma uc_d_comp (r : A) {P : CobarGr R 𝒞 A} {Q : CobarGr R 𝒞 B}
    (hp : FreeGrL.unitCoeffL R (CobarGen R 𝒞) A ((Cobar.d R 𝒞).app A P) = 0)
    (hq : FreeGrL.unitCoeffL R (CobarGen R 𝒞) B ((Cobar.d R 𝒞).app B Q) = 0) :
    FreeGrL.unitCoeffL R (CobarGen R 𝒞) _ ((Cobar.d R 𝒞).app _ (GrOperad.comp (R := R) r P Q))
      = 0
proof:
:= by
  refine (congrArg (FreeGrL.unitCoeffL R (CobarGen R 𝒞) _) (d_comp r P Q)).trans
    ((map_add _ _ _).trans ((congrArg₂ (· + ·) (FreeGrL.unitCoeffL_comp r _ _)
      (FreeGrL.unitCoeffL_comp r _ _)).trans ?_))
  exact (congrArg₂ (fun a b => a * FreeGrL.unitCoeffL R (CobarGen R 𝒞) B Q
    + FreeGrL.unitCoeffL R (CobarGen R 𝒞) A (GrOperad.tw (R := R) true P) * b) hp hq).trans
      (by simp only [zero_mul, mul_zero, add_zero])

name: Operad.Cobar.unitCoeffL_d_bas
proof:
:= by
  refine tree_induction (motive := fun A _ _ x => FreeGrL.unitCoeffL R (CobarGen R 𝒞) A
    ((Cobar.d R 𝒞).app A ((𝒥Ω).proj A (𝔅 x))) = 0) ?_ ?_ ?_ A x
  · intro X _ _ x hl
    obtain ⟨e, he⟩ := FreeGrL.proj_bas_leaf hl
    exact (congrArg (fun z => FreeGrL.unitCoeffL R (CobarGen R 𝒞) X ((Cobar.d R 𝒞).app X z))
      he).trans ((congrArg (FreeGrL.unitCoeffL R (CobarGen R 𝒞) X) (d_unit e)).trans
        (map_zero _))
  · intro X _ _ k g e
    obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := exists_ιL_eq (R := R) (V := V) g.1.1
    have hZ : (𝒥Ω).proj X (𝔅 (SetOperad.map e (Reg.std (corolla g))))
        = GrOperad.map (R := R) e (Cobar.ιL R 𝒞 (Fin k) ((𝒥).proj (Fin k) y)) :=
      (FreeGrL.proj_bas_map e _).trans (congrArg (GrOperad.map (R := R) e)
        ((FreeGrL.proj_bas_corolla g).trans hy.symm))
    exact (congrArg (fun z => FreeGrL.unitCoeffL R (CobarGen R 𝒞) X ((Cobar.d R 𝒞).app X z))
      hZ).trans ((uc_d_map e _).trans (unitCoeffL_d_ιL hV0 y))
  · intro X A B _ _ _ _ _ _ r p q e _ _ hp hq
    have hX : (𝒥Ω).proj X (𝔅 (SetOperad.map e (SetOperad.comp r p q)))
        = GrOperad.map (R := R) e (σ R (cSgn (grGenPar R (CobarGen R 𝒞)) r p q) •
            GrOperad.comp (R := R) r ((𝒥Ω).proj A (𝔅 p)) ((𝒥Ω).proj B (𝔅 q))) :=
      (FreeGrL.proj_bas_map e _).trans (congrArg (GrOperad.map (R := R) e)
        (FreeGrL.proj_bas_comp r p q))
    exact (congrArg (fun z => FreeGrL.unitCoeffL R (CobarGen R 𝒞) X ((Cobar.d R 𝒞).app X z))
      hX).trans ((uc_d_map e _).trans ((uc_d_smul _ _).trans
        ((congrArg _ (uc_d_comp r hp hq)).trans (smul_zero _))))

name: Operad.Cobar.unitCoeffL_d
statement:
theorem unitCoeffL_d (hV0 : ∀ v : V (Fin 0), v = 0) (Y : CobarGr R 𝒞 A) :
    FreeGrL.unitCoeffL R (CobarGen R 𝒞) A ((Cobar.d R 𝒞).app A Y) = 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := (𝒥Ω).proj_surjective A Y
  exact lin_eq_zero_of_single ((FreeGrL.unitCoeffL R (CobarGen R 𝒞) A).comp
    (((Cobar.d R 𝒞).app A).comp ((𝒥Ω).proj A))) (fun x => unitCoeffL_d_bas hV0 x) y

name: Operad.Cobar.isLeaf_map_comp
statement:
private lemma isLeaf_map_comp {A₁ B₁ : Type} [Fintype A₁] [DecidableEq A₁] [Fintype B₁]
    [DecidableEq B₁]
    {T : ℕ → Type v} {r : A₁} {p : Reg (TreeOfArity T) A₁} (q : Reg (TreeOfArity T) B₁)
    (e : Without A₁ r ⊕ B₁ ≃ X) (hp : (treeOf p).isLeaf = false) :
    (treeOf (SetOperad.map e (SetOperad.comp r p q))).isLeaf = false
proof:
:= by
  rw [treeOf_map, treeOf_comp]
  exact Tree.isLeaf_graft_left hp _ _

name: Operad.Cobar.comp_map_right
statement:
lemma comp_map_right (i : A) (X : CobarGr R 𝒞 A) (e : B ≃ D) (W : CobarGr R 𝒞 B) :
    GrOperad.comp (R := R) i X (GrOperad.map (R := R) e W)
      = GrOperad.map (R := R) (compEquiv (Equiv.refl A) e i) (GrOperad.comp (R := R) i X W)
proof:
:=
  ((congrArg (fun z => GrOperad.comp (R := R) i z (GrOperad.map (R := R) e W))
    (GrOperad.map_refl X)).symm.trans (GrOperad.map_comp (Equiv.refl A) e i X W).symm)

name: Operad.Cobar.xiM_bas_right_leaf
statement:
private lemma xiM_bas_right_leaf {i : A} (X : CobarGr R 𝒞 A)
    {x : Reg (TreeOfArity (GrGen R (CobarGen R 𝒞))) B} (e : Unit ≃ B)
    (he : (𝒥Ω).proj B (𝔅 x) = GrOperad.map (R := R) e (GrOperad.one (R := R))) :
    xiM R V i X ((𝒥Ω).proj B (𝔅 x))
      = GrOperad.comp (R := R) i X (FreeGrL.secC R (CobarGen R 𝒞) B ((𝒥Ω).proj B (𝔅 x)))
proof:
:= by
  exact (congrArg (xiM R V i X) he).trans ((xiM_unit_right e i X).trans
    ((congrArg (fun z => GrOperad.comp (R := R) i X (FreeGrL.secC R (CobarGen R 𝒞) B z))
      he).trans ((congrArg (GrOperad.comp (R := R) i X) (FreeGrL.secC_unit e)).trans
        (map_zero _))).symm)

name: Operad.Cobar.xiM_bas_right_corolla
statement:
private lemma xiM_bas_right_corolla {i : A} {X : CobarGr R 𝒞 A}
    (hgen : ∀ (B : Type) [Fintype B] [DecidableEq B] (y : FreeGr R (grGenPar R V) B),
      xiM R V i X (Cobar.ιL R 𝒞 B ((𝒥).proj B y))
        = GrOperad.comp (R := R) i X (Cobar.ιL R 𝒞 B ((𝒥).proj B y)))
    {k : ℕ} (g : GrGen R (CobarGen R 𝒞) k) (e : Fin k ≃ B) :
    xiM R V i X ((𝒥Ω).proj B (𝔅 (SetOperad.map e (Reg.std (corolla g)))))
      = GrOperad.comp (R := R) i X (FreeGrL.secC R (CobarGen R 𝒞) B
          ((𝒥Ω).proj B (𝔅 (SetOperad.map e (Reg.std (corolla g))))))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := exists_ιL_eq (R := R) (V := V) g.1.1
  have hZ : (𝒥Ω).proj B (𝔅 (SetOperad.map e (Reg.std (corolla g))))
      = GrOperad.map (R := R) e (Cobar.ιL R 𝒞 (Fin k) ((𝒥).proj (Fin k) y)) :=
    (FreeGrL.proj_bas_map e _).trans (congrArg (GrOperad.map (R := R) e)
      ((FreeGrL.proj_bas_corolla g).trans hy.symm))
  have hs : FreeGrL.secC R (CobarGen R 𝒞) B
      (GrOperad.map (R := R) e (Cobar.ιL R 𝒞 (Fin k) ((𝒥).proj (Fin k) y)))
      = GrOperad.map (R := R) e (Cobar.ιL R 𝒞 (Fin k) ((𝒥).proj (Fin k) y)) :=
    (FreeGrL.secC_map e _).trans (congrArg (GrOperad.map (R := R) e)
      (FreeGrL.secC_of_unitCoeff (unitCoeffL_ιL _)))
  refine (congrArg (xiM R V i X) hZ).trans ((xiM_map_right e i X _).trans
    ((congrArg _ (hgen _ y)).trans ?_))
  exact ((comp_map_right i X e _).symm.trans (congrArg (GrOperad.comp (R := R) i X)
    hs.symm)).trans (congrArg (fun z => GrOperad.comp (R := R) i X
      (FreeGrL.secC R (CobarGen R 𝒞) B z)) hZ.symm)

name: Operad.Cobar.xiM_bas_right_comp
statement:
private lemma xiM_bas_right_comp (hV0 : ∀ v : V (Fin 0), v = 0) {i : A} (X : CobarGr R 𝒞 A)
    {A₁ B₁ : Type} [Fintype A₁] [DecidableEq A₁] [Fintype B₁] [DecidableEq B₁] (r : A₁)
    (p : Reg (TreeOfArity (GrGen R (CobarGen R 𝒞))) A₁)
    (q : Reg (TreeOfArity (GrGen R (CobarGen R 𝒞))) B₁) (e : Without A₁ r ⊕ B₁ ≃ B)
    (hpl : (treeOf p).isLeaf = false)
    (hp : xiM R V i X ((𝒥Ω).proj A₁ (𝔅 p))
      = GrOperad.comp (R := R) i X (FreeGrL.secC R (CobarGen R 𝒞) A₁ ((𝒥Ω).proj A₁ (𝔅 p)))) :
    xiM R V i X ((𝒥Ω).proj B (𝔅 (SetOperad.map e (SetOperad.comp r p q))))
      = GrOperad.comp (R := R) i X (FreeGrL.secC R (CobarGen R 𝒞) B
          ((𝒥Ω).proj B (𝔅 (SetOperad.map e (SetOperad.comp r p q)))))
proof:
:= by
  have hP0 : FreeGrL.unitCoeffL R (CobarGen R 𝒞) A₁ ((𝒥Ω).proj A₁ (𝔅 p)) = 0 :=
    FreeGrL.unitCoeffL_proj_bas hpl
  have hIH : xiM R V i X ((𝒥Ω).proj A₁ (𝔅 p))
      = GrOperad.comp (R := R) i X ((𝒥Ω).proj A₁ (𝔅 p)) :=
    hp.trans (congrArg (GrOperad.comp (R := R) i X) (FreeGrL.secC_of_unitCoeff hP0))
  have hX : (𝒥Ω).proj B (𝔅 (SetOperad.map e (SetOperad.comp r p q)))
      = GrOperad.map (R := R) e (σ R (cSgn (grGenPar R (CobarGen R 𝒞)) r p q) •
          GrOperad.comp (R := R) r ((𝒥Ω).proj A₁ (𝔅 p)) ((𝒥Ω).proj B₁ (𝔅 q))) :=
    (FreeGrL.proj_bas_map e _).trans (congrArg (GrOperad.map (R := R) e)
      (FreeGrL.proj_bas_comp r p q))
  have hs : FreeGrL.secC R (CobarGen R 𝒞) B ((𝒥Ω).proj B (𝔅 (SetOperad.map e
      (SetOperad.comp r p q)))) = (𝒥Ω).proj B (𝔅 (SetOperad.map e (SetOperad.comp r p q))) :=
    FreeGrL.secC_of_unitCoeff (FreeGrL.unitCoeffL_proj_bas (isLeaf_map_comp q e hpl))
  have hL := (congrArg (xiM R V i X) hX).trans ((xiM_map_right e i X _).trans
    (congrArg (GrOperad.map (R := R) (compEquiv (Equiv.refl A) e i))
      ((map_smul (xiM R V i X) _ _).trans (congrArg (fun z =>
        σ R (cSgn (grGenPar R (CobarGen R 𝒞)) r p q) • z)
        ((xiM_comp_outer i r X hP0 (unitCoeffL_d hV0 _) _).trans
          ((congrArg (fun z => GrOperad.map (R := R) (seqEquiv i r B₁)
            (GrOperad.comp (R := R) (Sum.inr r) z ((𝒥Ω).proj B₁ (𝔅 q)))) hIH).trans
            (GrOperad.comp_assoc_seq i r X _ _)))))))
  have hR := ((congrArg (GrOperad.comp (R := R) i X) hs).trans
    (congrArg (GrOperad.comp (R := R) i X) hX)).trans ((comp_map_right i X e _).trans
      (congrArg (GrOperad.map (R := R) (compEquiv (Equiv.refl A) e i))
        (map_smul (GrOperad.comp (R := R) i X) _ _)))
  exact hL.trans hR.symm

name: Operad.Cobar.xiM_bas_right
statement:
private theorem xiM_bas_right (hV0 : ∀ v : V (Fin 0), v = 0) {i : A} {X : CobarGr R 𝒞 A}
    (hgen : ∀ (B : Type) [Fintype B] [DecidableEq B] (y : FreeGr R (grGenPar R V) B),
      xiM R V i X (Cobar.ιL R 𝒞 B ((𝒥).proj B y))
        = GrOperad.comp (R := R) i X (Cobar.ιL R 𝒞 B ((𝒥).proj B y)))
    (x : Reg (TreeOfArity (GrGen R (CobarGen R 𝒞))) B) :
    xiM R V i X ((𝒥Ω).proj B (𝔅 x))
      = GrOperad.comp (R := R) i X (FreeGrL.secC R (CobarGen R 𝒞) B ((𝒥Ω).proj B (𝔅 x)))
proof:
:=
  tree_induction (motive := fun B _ _ x => xiM R V i X ((𝒥Ω).proj B (𝔅 x))
    = GrOperad.comp (R := R) i X (FreeGrL.secC R (CobarGen R 𝒞) B ((𝒥Ω).proj B (𝔅 x))))
    (fun _ _ _ _ hl => (FreeGrL.proj_bas_leaf hl).elim fun e he => xiM_bas_right_leaf X e he)
    (fun _ _ _ _ g e => xiM_bas_right_corolla hgen g e)
    (fun _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ r p q e hpl _ hp _ => xiM_bas_right_comp hV0 X r p q e hpl hp) B x

name: Operad.Cobar.par_proj_bas
statement:
lemma par_proj_bas (x : Reg (TreeOfArity (GrGen R (CobarGen R 𝒞))) A) :
    GrOperad.par (R := R) (Tree.tpar (grGenPar R (CobarGen R 𝒞)) (treeOf x)) ((𝒥Ω).proj A (𝔅 x))
      = (𝒥Ω).proj A (𝔅 x)
proof:
:=
  congrArg ((𝒥Ω).proj A) (SgnLin.par_bas x)

name: Operad.Cobar.secC_proj_bas_par
statement:
private lemma secC_proj_bas_par (x : Reg (TreeOfArity (GrGen R (CobarGen R 𝒞))) A) :
    GrOperad.par (R := R) (Tree.tpar (grGenPar R (CobarGen R 𝒞)) (treeOf x))
        (FreeGrL.secC R (CobarGen R 𝒞) A ((𝒥Ω).proj A (𝔅 x)))
      = FreeGrL.secC R (CobarGen R 𝒞) A ((𝒥Ω).proj A (𝔅 x))
proof:
:=
  (FreeGrL.secC_par _ _).symm.trans (congrArg (FreeGrL.secC R (CobarGen R 𝒞) A) (par_proj_bas x))

name: Operad.Cobar.comp_map_left
statement:
lemma comp_map_left {A' : Type} [Fintype A'] [DecidableEq A'] (e : A ≃ A') (j : A)
    (W : CobarGr R 𝒞 A) (Y : CobarGr R 𝒞 B) :
    GrOperad.comp (R := R) (e j) (GrOperad.map (R := R) e W) Y
      = GrOperad.map (R := R) (compEquiv e (Equiv.refl B) j) (GrOperad.comp (R := R) j W Y)
proof:
:=
  ((congrArg (fun z => GrOperad.comp (R := R) (e j) (GrOperad.map (R := R) e W) z)
    (GrOperad.map_refl Y)).symm.trans (GrOperad.map_comp e (Equiv.refl B) j W Y).symm)

name: Operad.Cobar.xiM_bas_leaf
statement:
private lemma xiM_bas_leaf {x : Reg (TreeOfArity (GrGen R (CobarGen R 𝒞))) A} (e : Unit ≃ A)
    (he : (𝒥Ω).proj A (𝔅 x) = GrOperad.map (R := R) e (GrOperad.one (R := R)))
    (i : A) (Y : CobarGr R 𝒞 B) :
    xiM R V i ((𝒥Ω).proj A (𝔅 x)) Y
      = GrOperad.comp (R := R) i (FreeGrL.secC R (CobarGen R 𝒞) A ((𝒥Ω).proj A (𝔅 x)))
          (FreeGrL.secC R (CobarGen R 𝒞) B Y)
proof:
:= by
  have hL : xiM R V i ((𝒥Ω).proj A (𝔅 x)) Y = 0 :=
    (congrArg (fun z => xiM R V i z Y) he).trans (xiM_unit_left e i Y)
  have hs : FreeGrL.secC R (CobarGen R 𝒞) A ((𝒥Ω).proj A (𝔅 x)) = 0 :=
    (congrArg (FreeGrL.secC R (CobarGen R 𝒞) A) he).trans
      (FreeGrL.secC_unit (R := R) (V := CobarGen R 𝒞) e)
  have hR : GrOperad.comp (R := R) i (FreeGrL.secC R (CobarGen R 𝒞) A ((𝒥Ω).proj A (𝔅 x)))
      (FreeGrL.secC R (CobarGen R 𝒞) B Y) = 0 :=
    (congrArg (fun z => GrOperad.comp (R := R) i z (FreeGrL.secC R (CobarGen R 𝒞) B Y)) hs).trans
      (LinearMap.map_zero₂ (GrOperad.comp (R := R) (P := CobarGr R 𝒞) i) _)
  exact hL.trans hR.symm

name: Operad.Cobar.xiM_bas_corolla
statement:
private lemma xiM_bas_corolla (hV0 : ∀ v : V (Fin 0), v = 0) {k : ℕ} (g : GrGen R (CobarGen R 𝒞) k)
    (e : Fin k ≃ A) (j : Fin k) (y : Reg (TreeOfArity (GrGen R (CobarGen R 𝒞))) B) :
    xiM R V (e j) ((𝒥Ω).proj A (𝔅 (SetOperad.map e (Reg.std (corolla g))))) ((𝒥Ω).proj B (𝔅 y))
      = GrOperad.comp (R := R) (e j) (FreeGrL.secC R (CobarGen R 𝒞) A
          ((𝒥Ω).proj A (𝔅 (SetOperad.map e (Reg.std (corolla g))))))
          (FreeGrL.secC R (CobarGen R 𝒞) B ((𝒥Ω).proj B (𝔅 y)))
proof:
:= by
  have hex := exists_ιL_eq (R := R) (V := V) g.1.1
  cases hex with
  | intro y₀ hy =>
  have hZ : (𝒥Ω).proj A (𝔅 (SetOperad.map e (Reg.std (corolla g))))
      = GrOperad.map (R := R) e (Cobar.ιL R 𝒞 (Fin k) ((𝒥).proj (Fin k) y₀)) :=
    (FreeGrL.proj_bas_map e _).trans (congrArg (GrOperad.map (R := R) e)
      ((FreeGrL.proj_bas_corolla g).trans hy.symm))
  have hs : FreeGrL.secC R (CobarGen R 𝒞) A
      (GrOperad.map (R := R) e (Cobar.ιL R 𝒞 (Fin k) ((𝒥).proj (Fin k) y₀)))
      = GrOperad.map (R := R) e (Cobar.ιL R 𝒞 (Fin k) ((𝒥).proj (Fin k) y₀)) :=
    (FreeGrL.secC_map e _).trans (congrArg (GrOperad.map (R := R) e)
      (FreeGrL.secC_of_unitCoeff (unitCoeffL_ιL _)))
  have hL := (congrArg (fun z => xiM R V (e j) z ((𝒥Ω).proj B (𝔅 y))) hZ).trans
    ((xiM_map_left e j _ _).trans (congrArg (GrOperad.map (R := R) (compEquiv e (Equiv.refl B) j))
      (xiM_bas_right hV0 (fun B _ _ c => xiM_ιL hV0 j y₀ c) y)))
  have hR := (congrArg (fun z => GrOperad.comp (R := R) (e j) (FreeGrL.secC R (CobarGen R 𝒞) A z)
    (FreeGrL.secC R (CobarGen R 𝒞) B ((𝒥Ω).proj B (𝔅 y)))) hZ).trans
      ((congrArg (fun z => GrOperad.comp (R := R) (e j) z
        (FreeGrL.secC R (CobarGen R 𝒞) B ((𝒥Ω).proj B (𝔅 y)))) hs).trans
        (comp_map_left e j _ _))
  exact hL.trans hR.symm

name: Operad.Cobar.map_inj_eq
proof:
:=
  (map_symm_map e a).symm.trans ((congrArg (GrOperad.map (R := R) e.symm) h).trans
    (map_symm_map e b))

name: Operad.Cobar.xiM_bas_comp_inr
statement:
private lemma xiM_bas_comp_inr (hV0 : ∀ v : V (Fin 0), v = 0) {A₁ B₁ : Type} [Fintype A₁]
    [DecidableEq A₁] [Fintype B₁] [DecidableEq B₁] (r : A₁)
    (p : Reg (TreeOfArity (GrGen R (CobarGen R 𝒞))) A₁)
    (q : Reg (TreeOfArity (GrGen R (CobarGen R 𝒞))) B₁) (e : Without A₁ r ⊕ B₁ ≃ A)
    (hpl : (treeOf p).isLeaf = false) (hql : (treeOf q).isLeaf = false) (w : B₁)
    (y : Reg (TreeOfArity (GrGen R (CobarGen R 𝒞))) B)
    (hq : xiM R V w ((𝒥Ω).proj B₁ (𝔅 q)) ((𝒥Ω).proj B (𝔅 y))
      = GrOperad.comp (R := R) w (FreeGrL.secC R (CobarGen R 𝒞) B₁ ((𝒥Ω).proj B₁ (𝔅 q)))
          (FreeGrL.secC R (CobarGen R 𝒞) B ((𝒥Ω).proj B (𝔅 y)))) :
    xiM R V (e (Sum.inr w)) ((𝒥Ω).proj A (𝔅 (SetOperad.map e (SetOperad.comp r p q))))
        ((𝒥Ω).proj B (𝔅 y))
      = GrOperad.comp (R := R) (e (Sum.inr w)) (FreeGrL.secC R (CobarGen R 𝒞) A
          ((𝒥Ω).proj A (𝔅 (SetOperad.map e (SetOperad.comp r p q)))))
          (FreeGrL.secC R (CobarGen R 𝒞) B ((𝒥Ω).proj B (𝔅 y)))
proof:
:= by
  have hQ0 : FreeGrL.unitCoeffL R (CobarGen R 𝒞) B₁ ((𝒥Ω).proj B₁ (𝔅 q)) = 0 :=
    FreeGrL.unitCoeffL_proj_bas hql
  have hIH : xiM R V w ((𝒥Ω).proj B₁ (𝔅 q)) ((𝒥Ω).proj B (𝔅 y))
      = GrOperad.comp (R := R) w ((𝒥Ω).proj B₁ (𝔅 q))
          (FreeGrL.secC R (CobarGen R 𝒞) B ((𝒥Ω).proj B (𝔅 y))) :=
    hq.trans (congrArg (fun z => GrOperad.comp (R := R) w z
      (FreeGrL.secC R (CobarGen R 𝒞) B ((𝒥Ω).proj B (𝔅 y)))) (FreeGrL.secC_of_unitCoeff hQ0))
  have hX : (𝒥Ω).proj A (𝔅 (SetOperad.map e (SetOperad.comp r p q)))
      = GrOperad.map (R := R) e (σ R (cSgn (grGenPar R (CobarGen R 𝒞)) r p q) •
          GrOperad.comp (R := R) r ((𝒥Ω).proj A₁ (𝔅 p)) ((𝒥Ω).proj B₁ (𝔅 q))) :=
    (FreeGrL.proj_bas_map e _).trans (congrArg (GrOperad.map (R := R) e)
      (FreeGrL.proj_bas_comp r p q))
  have hs : FreeGrL.secC R (CobarGen R 𝒞) A ((𝒥Ω).proj A (𝔅 (SetOperad.map e
      (SetOperad.comp r p q)))) = (𝒥Ω).proj A (𝔅 (SetOperad.map e (SetOperad.comp r p q))) :=
    FreeGrL.secC_of_unitCoeff (FreeGrL.unitCoeffL_proj_bas (isLeaf_map_comp q e hpl))
  
  have hin : xiM R V (Sum.inr w) (GrOperad.comp (R := R) r ((𝒥Ω).proj A₁ (𝔅 p))
      ((𝒥Ω).proj B₁ (𝔅 q))) ((𝒥Ω).proj B (𝔅 y))
      = GrOperad.comp (R := R) (Sum.inr w) (GrOperad.comp (R := R) r ((𝒥Ω).proj A₁ (𝔅 p))
          ((𝒥Ω).proj B₁ (𝔅 q))) (FreeGrL.secC R (CobarGen R 𝒞) B ((𝒥Ω).proj B (𝔅 y))) :=
    map_inj_eq (seqEquiv r w B) ((xiM_comp_inner r w _ hQ0 (unitCoeffL_d hV0 _) _).trans
      ((congrArg (GrOperad.comp (R := R) r ((𝒥Ω).proj A₁ (𝔅 p))) hIH).trans
        (GrOperad.comp_assoc_seq r w _ _ _).symm))
  have hL := (congrArg (fun z => xiM R V (e (Sum.inr w)) z ((𝒥Ω).proj B (𝔅 y))) hX).trans
    ((xiM_map_left e (Sum.inr w) _ _).trans (congrArg (GrOperad.map (R := R)
      (compEquiv e (Equiv.refl B) (Sum.inr w))) ((LinearMap.map_smul₂ _ _ _ _).trans
        (congrArg (fun z => σ R (cSgn (grGenPar R (CobarGen R 𝒞)) r p q) • z) hin))))
  have hR := (congrArg (fun z => GrOperad.comp (R := R) (e (Sum.inr w)) z
    (FreeGrL.secC R (CobarGen R 𝒞) B ((𝒥Ω).proj B (𝔅 y)))) (hs.trans hX)).trans
      ((comp_map_left e (Sum.inr w) _ _).trans (congrArg (GrOperad.map (R := R)
        (compEquiv e (Equiv.refl B) (Sum.inr w))) (LinearMap.map_smul₂ _ _ _ _)))
  exact hL.trans hR.symm

name: Operad.Cobar.xiM_bas_comp_inl
statement:
private lemma xiM_bas_comp_inl {A₁ B₁ : Type} [Fintype A₁]
    [DecidableEq A₁] [Fintype B₁] [DecidableEq B₁] (r : A₁)
    (p : Reg (TreeOfArity (GrGen R (CobarGen R 𝒞))) A₁)
    (q : Reg (TreeOfArity (GrGen R (CobarGen R 𝒞))) B₁) (e : Without A₁ r ⊕ B₁ ≃ A)
    (hpl : (treeOf p).isLeaf = false) {u : A₁} (hu : u ≠ r)
    (y : Reg (TreeOfArity (GrGen R (CobarGen R 𝒞))) B)
    (hp : xiM R V u ((𝒥Ω).proj A₁ (𝔅 p)) ((𝒥Ω).proj B (𝔅 y))
      = GrOperad.comp (R := R) u (FreeGrL.secC R (CobarGen R 𝒞) A₁ ((𝒥Ω).proj A₁ (𝔅 p)))
          (FreeGrL.secC R (CobarGen R 𝒞) B ((𝒥Ω).proj B (𝔅 y)))) :
    xiM R V (e (Sum.inl ⟨u, hu⟩)) ((𝒥Ω).proj A (𝔅 (SetOperad.map e (SetOperad.comp r p q))))
        ((𝒥Ω).proj B (𝔅 y))
      = GrOperad.comp (R := R) (e (Sum.inl ⟨u, hu⟩)) (FreeGrL.secC R (CobarGen R 𝒞) A
          ((𝒥Ω).proj A (𝔅 (SetOperad.map e (SetOperad.comp r p q)))))
          (FreeGrL.secC R (CobarGen R 𝒞) B ((𝒥Ω).proj B (𝔅 y)))
proof:
:= by
  have hP0 : FreeGrL.unitCoeffL R (CobarGen R 𝒞) A₁ ((𝒥Ω).proj A₁ (𝔅 p)) = 0 :=
    FreeGrL.unitCoeffL_proj_bas hpl
  have hIH : xiM R V u ((𝒥Ω).proj A₁ (𝔅 p)) ((𝒥Ω).proj B (𝔅 y))
      = GrOperad.comp (R := R) u ((𝒥Ω).proj A₁ (𝔅 p))
          (FreeGrL.secC R (CobarGen R 𝒞) B ((𝒥Ω).proj B (𝔅 y))) :=
    hp.trans (congrArg (fun z => GrOperad.comp (R := R) u z
      (FreeGrL.secC R (CobarGen R 𝒞) B ((𝒥Ω).proj B (𝔅 y)))) (FreeGrL.secC_of_unitCoeff hP0))
  have hX : (𝒥Ω).proj A (𝔅 (SetOperad.map e (SetOperad.comp r p q)))
      = GrOperad.map (R := R) e (σ R (cSgn (grGenPar R (CobarGen R 𝒞)) r p q) •
          GrOperad.comp (R := R) r ((𝒥Ω).proj A₁ (𝔅 p)) ((𝒥Ω).proj B₁ (𝔅 q))) :=
    (FreeGrL.proj_bas_map e _).trans (congrArg (GrOperad.map (R := R) e)
      (FreeGrL.proj_bas_comp r p q))
  have hs : FreeGrL.secC R (CobarGen R 𝒞) A ((𝒥Ω).proj A (𝔅 (SetOperad.map e
      (SetOperad.comp r p q)))) = (𝒥Ω).proj A (𝔅 (SetOperad.map e (SetOperad.comp r p q))) :=
    FreeGrL.secC_of_unitCoeff (FreeGrL.unitCoeffL_proj_bas (isLeaf_map_comp q e hpl))
  
  have hin : xiM R V (Sum.inl ⟨u, hu⟩ : Without A₁ r ⊕ B₁) (GrOperad.comp (R := R) r
      ((𝒥Ω).proj A₁ (𝔅 p)) ((𝒥Ω).proj B₁ (𝔅 q))) ((𝒥Ω).proj B (𝔅 y))
      = GrOperad.comp (R := R) (Sum.inl ⟨u, hu⟩ : Without A₁ r ⊕ B₁)
          (GrOperad.comp (R := R) r ((𝒥Ω).proj A₁ (𝔅 p)) ((𝒥Ω).proj B₁ (𝔅 q)))
          (FreeGrL.secC R (CobarGen R 𝒞) B ((𝒥Ω).proj B (𝔅 y))) :=
    map_inj_eq (parEquiv (Ne.symm hu) B₁ B) ((xiM_comp_par (Ne.symm hu) _ (par_proj_bas q)
      (par_proj_bas y)).trans ((congrArg (fun z => σ R (Tree.tpar (grGenPar R (CobarGen R 𝒞))
        (treeOf q) && Tree.tpar (grGenPar R (CobarGen R 𝒞)) (treeOf y)) •
          GrOperad.comp (R := R) (Sum.inl ⟨r, Ne.symm hu⟩ : Without A₁ u ⊕ B) z
            ((𝒥Ω).proj B₁ (𝔅 q))) hIH).trans
        (GrOperad.comp_assoc_par (Ne.symm hu) _ (par_proj_bas q) (secC_proj_bas_par y)).symm))
  have hL := (congrArg (fun z => xiM R V (e (Sum.inl ⟨u, hu⟩)) z ((𝒥Ω).proj B (𝔅 y))) hX).trans
    ((xiM_map_left e (Sum.inl ⟨u, hu⟩) _ _).trans (congrArg (GrOperad.map (R := R)
      (compEquiv e (Equiv.refl B) (Sum.inl ⟨u, hu⟩))) ((LinearMap.map_smul₂ _ _ _ _).trans
        (congrArg (fun z => σ R (cSgn (grGenPar R (CobarGen R 𝒞)) r p q) • z) hin))))
  have hR := (congrArg (fun z => GrOperad.comp (R := R) (e (Sum.inl ⟨u, hu⟩)) z
    (FreeGrL.secC R (CobarGen R 𝒞) B ((𝒥Ω).proj B (𝔅 y)))) (hs.trans hX)).trans
      ((comp_map_left e (Sum.inl ⟨u, hu⟩) _ _).trans (congrArg (GrOperad.map (R := R)
        (compEquiv e (Equiv.refl B) (Sum.inl ⟨u, hu⟩))) (LinearMap.map_smul₂ _ _ _ _)))
  exact hL.trans hR.symm

name: Operad.Cobar.xiM_bas_all
statement:
private theorem xiM_bas_all (hV0 : ∀ v : V (Fin 0), v = 0)
    (x : Reg (TreeOfArity (GrGen R (CobarGen R 𝒞))) A) :
    ∀ (B : Type) [Fintype B] [DecidableEq B] (y : Reg (TreeOfArity (GrGen R (CobarGen R 𝒞))) B)
      (i : A), xiM R V i ((𝒥Ω).proj A (𝔅 x)) ((𝒥Ω).proj B (𝔅 y))
        = GrOperad.comp (R := R) i (FreeGrL.secC R (CobarGen R 𝒞) A ((𝒥Ω).proj A (𝔅 x)))
            (FreeGrL.secC R (CobarGen R 𝒞) B ((𝒥Ω).proj B (𝔅 y)))
proof:
:=
  tree_induction (motive := fun A _ _ x => ∀ (B : Type) [Fintype B] [DecidableEq B]
    (y : Reg (TreeOfArity (GrGen R (CobarGen R 𝒞))) B) (i : A),
      xiM R V i ((𝒥Ω).proj A (𝔅 x)) ((𝒥Ω).proj B (𝔅 y))
        = GrOperad.comp (R := R) i (FreeGrL.secC R (CobarGen R 𝒞) A ((𝒥Ω).proj A (𝔅 x)))
            (FreeGrL.secC R (CobarGen R 𝒞) B ((𝒥Ω).proj B (𝔅 y))))
    (fun _ _ _ _ hl _ _ _ _ i =>
      (FreeGrL.proj_bas_leaf hl).elim fun e he => xiM_bas_leaf e he i _)
    (fun _ _ _ _ g e _ _ _ y i => (e.apply_symm_apply i) ▸ xiM_bas_corolla hV0 g e (e.symm i) y)
    (fun A A₁ B₁ _ _ _ _ _ _ r p q e hpl hql hp hq B _ _ y i => by
      have key : ∀ j : Without A₁ r ⊕ B₁, xiM R V (e j)
          ((𝒥Ω).proj A (𝔅 (SetOperad.map e (SetOperad.comp r p q)))) ((𝒥Ω).proj B (𝔅 y))
          = GrOperad.comp (R := R) (e j) (FreeGrL.secC R (CobarGen R 𝒞) A
              ((𝒥Ω).proj A (𝔅 (SetOperad.map e (SetOperad.comp r p q)))))
              (FreeGrL.secC R (CobarGen R 𝒞) B ((𝒥Ω).proj B (𝔅 y))) := by
        rintro (⟨u, hu⟩ | w)
        · exact xiM_bas_comp_inl r p q e hpl hu y (hp B y u)
        · exact xiM_bas_comp_inr hV0 r p q e hpl hql w y (hq B y w)
      exact (e.apply_symm_apply i) ▸ key (e.symm i)) A x

name: Operad.Cobar.xiM_eq
statement:
theorem xiM_eq (hV0 : ∀ v : V (Fin 0), v = 0) (i : A) (X : CobarGr R 𝒞 A)
    (Y : CobarGr R 𝒞 B) :
    xiM R V i X Y = GrOperad.comp (R := R) i (FreeGrL.secC R (CobarGen R 𝒞) A X)
      (FreeGrL.secC R (CobarGen R 𝒞) B Y)
proof:
:= by
  have hx := Function.surjInv_eq ((𝒥Ω).proj_surjective A) X
  have hy := Function.surjInv_eq ((𝒥Ω).proj_surjective B) Y
  rw [← hx, ← hy]
  exact bilin_ext_single (xiM R V i) ((GrOperad.comp (R := R) (P := CobarGr R 𝒞) i).compl₁₂
    (FreeGrL.secC R (CobarGen R 𝒞) A) (FreeGrL.secC R (CobarGen R 𝒞) B)) ((𝒥Ω).proj A)
    ((𝒥Ω).proj B) (fun s t => xiM_bas_all hV0 s B t i) _ _

name: Operad.BTree.mirror_leaf
statement: @[simp] lemma mirror_leaf (f : E → E) : mirror f (leaf : BTree E) = leaf
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.BTree.mirror_node
statement:
@[simp] lemma mirror_node (f : E → E) (e : E) (l r : BTree E) :
    mirror f (node e l r) = node (f e) (mirror f r) (mirror f l)
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.BTree.arity_mirror
statement:
lemma arity_mirror (f : E → E) : ∀ t : BTree E, (mirror f t).arity = t.arity
  | leaf => rfl
  | node e l r => by
    rw [mirror_node, arity_node, arity_node, arity_mirror f l, arity_mirror f r, Nat.add_comm]

name: Operad.BTree.mirror_mirror
statement:
lemma mirror_mirror {f : E → E} (hf : Function.Involutive f) :
    ∀ t : BTree E, mirror f (mirror f t) = t
  | leaf => rfl
  | node e l r => by rw [mirror_node, mirror_node, mirror_mirror hf l, mirror_mirror hf r, hf e]

namespace OfArity

                                                   
def mirror (f : E → E) {n : ℕ} (t : OfArity E n) : OfArity E n
proof:
:=
  ⟨BTree.mirror f t.1, (BTree.arity_mirror f t.1).trans t.2⟩

name: Operad.BTree.OfArity.mirror_mirror
statement:
lemma mirror_mirror {f : E → E} (hf : Function.Involutive f) {n : ℕ} (t : OfArity E n) :
    mirror f (mirror f t) = t
proof:
:=
  Subtype.ext (BTree.mirror_mirror hf t.1)

name: Operad.BTree.OfArity.mirrorEquiv_apply
statement:
@[simp] lemma mirrorEquiv_apply {f : E → E} (hf : Function.Involutive f) {n : ℕ}
    (t : OfArity E n) : mirrorEquiv hf n t = mirror f t
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.BTree.OfArity.mirror_cor
statement: @[simp] lemma mirror_cor (f : E → E) (e : E) : mirror f (cor e) = cor (f e)
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.BTree.OfArity.mirror_lc
statement: @[simp] lemma mirror_lc (f : E → E) (e e' : E) : mirror f (lc e e') = rc (f e) (f e')
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.BTree.OfArity.mirror_rc
statement: @[simp] lemma mirror_rc (f : E → E) (e e' : E) : mirror f (rc e e') = lc (f e) (f e')
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.BTree.OfArity.mirror_ll
statement:
@[simp] lemma mirror_ll (f : E → E) (e₁ e₂ e₃ : E) :
    mirror f (ll e₁ e₂ e₃) = rr (f e₁) (f e₂) (f e₃)
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.BTree.OfArity.mirror_lr
statement:
@[simp] lemma mirror_lr (f : E → E) (e₁ e₂ e₃ : E) :
    mirror f (lr e₁ e₂ e₃) = rl (f e₁) (f e₂) (f e₃)
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.BTree.OfArity.mirror_bl
statement:
@[simp] lemma mirror_bl (f : E → E) (e₁ e₂ e₃ : E) :
    mirror f (bl e₁ e₂ e₃) = bl (f e₁) (f e₃) (f e₂)
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.BTree.OfArity.mirror_rl
statement:
@[simp] lemma mirror_rl (f : E → E) (e₁ e₂ e₃ : E) :
    mirror f (rl e₁ e₂ e₃) = lr (f e₁) (f e₂) (f e₃)
proof: := rfl

@[simp] lemma mirror_rr (f : E → E) (e₁ e₂ e₃ : E) :

name: Operad.STree.SMono.isShuffle
statement: lemma isShuffle : g.1.IsShuffle

name: Operad.STree.SMono.labels_eq
statement: lemma labels_eq : g.1.labels = A.val

name: Operad.STree.SMono.nodup
statement: lemma nodup : g.1.labels.Nodup
proof: := by rw [g.labels_eq]; exact A.nodup

name: Operad.STree.SMono.mem_labels
statement: lemma mem_labels {a : ℕ} : a ∈ g.1.labels ↔ a ∈ A
proof: := by rw [g.labels_eq]; rfl

name: Operad.STree.SMono.first_eq
statement: lemma first_eq (g' : SMono E A) : g.1.first = g'.1.first
proof:
:=
  first_eq_of_labels_eq g.isShuffle g'.isShuffle (g.labels_eq.trans g'.labels_eq.symm)

name: Operad.STree.Inputs.subst_isShuffle
statement:
lemma Inputs.subst_isShuffle {A B : Finset ℕ} {xs : ℕ → STree E} (h : Inputs A B xs)
    (g : SMono E A) : (g.1.subst xs).IsShuffle
proof:
:=
  isShuffle_subst g.isShuffle (fun a ha => h.shuffle a (g.mem_labels.1 ha))
    (fun _ ha _ hb hab => h.mono (g.mem_labels.1 ha) (g.mem_labels.1 hb) hab)

name: Operad.STree.inputs_leaf
statement:
lemma inputs_leaf (A : Finset ℕ) : Inputs A A (leaf : ℕ → STree E) where
  shuffle _ _
proof:
:= trivial
  labels _ ha _ hb := by rw [labels_leaf, Multiset.mem_singleton] at hb; exact hb ▸ ha
  mono _ _ _ _ h := h

name: Operad.STree.Inputs.comp
statement:
lemma Inputs.comp {A A' B : Finset ℕ} {xs xs' : ℕ → STree E} (h : Inputs A B xs)
    (h' : Inputs A' A xs') : Inputs A' B fun a => (xs' a).subst xs where
  shuffle a ha
proof:
:= isShuffle_subst (h'.shuffle a ha) (fun b hb => h.shuffle b (h'.labels a ha b hb))
    (fun b hb c hc hbc => h.mono (h'.labels a ha b hb) (h'.labels a ha c hc) hbc)
  labels a ha b hb := by
    rw [labels_subst, Multiset.mem_bind] at hb
    obtain ⟨c, hc, hbc⟩ := hb
    exact h.labels c (h'.labels a ha c hc) b hbc
  mono a ha a' ha' haa' := by
    simp only [first_subst (h'.shuffle a ha), first_subst (h'.shuffle a' ha')]
    exact h.mono (h'.labels a ha _ (first_mem (h'.shuffle a ha)))
      (h'.labels a' ha' _ (first_mem (h'.shuffle a' ha'))) (h'.mono ha ha' haa')

name: Operad.STree.isSCtx_id
statement: theorem isSCtx_id (A : Finset ℕ) : IsSCtx (id : SMono E A → SMono E A)
proof:
:=
  ⟨leaf 0, [], leaf, rfl, inputs_leaf A, fun g => by rw [replace_nil, subst_leaf]; rfl⟩

name: Operad.STree.isSCtx_comp
statement:
theorem isSCtx_comp {A A' B : Finset ℕ} {f : SMono E A → SMono E B}
    {g : SMono E A' → SMono E A} (hf : IsSCtx f) (hg : IsSCtx g) : IsSCtx (f ∘ g)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨T, p, xs, hp, hxs, hf⟩ := hf
  obtain ⟨T', p', xs', hp', hxs', hg⟩ := hg
  obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ := Option.isSome_iff_exists.1 hp'
  refine ⟨T.replace p (T'.subst xs), p ++ p', fun a => (xs' a).subst xs, ?_, hxs.comp hxs',
    fun h => ?_⟩
  · rw [get?_replace_append hp, get?_subst hw]
    rfl
  · rw [Function.comp_apply, hf, hg, replace_subst hp', subst_subst,
      replace_append (get?_replace hp _), replace_replace]

name: Operad.STree.get?_input
proof:
:= by
  rw [get?_append_of hU, get?_subst (get?_pos ha)]
  rfl

name: Operad.STree.inputs_of_occ
statement:
theorem inputs_of_occ {A B : Finset ℕ} (U : SMono E B) {p : List ℕ} {ℓ : SMono E A}
    {xs : ℕ → STree E} (hU : U.1.get? p = some (ℓ.1.subst xs))
    (hm : StrictMonoOn (fun a => (xs a).first) (A : Set ℕ)) : Inputs A B xs where
  shuffle _ ha
proof:
:= isShuffle_get? U.isShuffle (get?_input hU (ℓ.mem_labels.2 ha))
  labels _ ha _ hb := U.mem_labels.1
    (Multiset.mem_of_le (labels_get?_le (get?_input hU (ℓ.mem_labels.2 ha))) hb)
  mono := hm

name: Operad.STree.replace_mem
statement:
theorem replace_mem {A B : Finset ℕ} (U : SMono E B) {p : List ℕ} {ℓ : SMono E A}
    {xs : ℕ → STree E} (hU : U.1.get? p = some (ℓ.1.subst xs))
    (hm : StrictMonoOn (fun a => (xs a).first) (A : Set ℕ)) (g : SMono E A) :
    (U.1.replace p (g.1.subst xs)).IsShuffle ∧
      (U.1.replace p (g.1.subst xs)).labels = B.val
proof:
:= by
  have hin := inputs_of_occ U hU hm
  refine ⟨isShuffle_replace U.isShuffle hU (hin.subst_isShuffle g) ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [first_subst g.isShuffle, first_subst ℓ.isShuffle, g.first_eq ℓ]
  · rw [labels_replace_of_eq hU (by rw [labels_subst, labels_subst, g.labels_eq, ℓ.labels_eq]),
      U.labels_eq]

name: Operad.STree.ctxOf_val
statement:
@[simp] lemma ctxOf_val (g : SMono E A) :
    (ctxOf U p ℓ xs hU hm g).1 = U.1.replace p (g.1.subst xs)
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.STree.isSCtx_ctxOf
statement: theorem isSCtx_ctxOf : IsSCtx (ctxOf U p ℓ xs hU hm)
proof:
:=
  ⟨U.1, p, xs, by rw [hU]; rfl, inputs_of_occ U hU hm, fun _ => rfl⟩

name: Operad.STree.ctxOf_self
statement: lemma ctxOf_self : ctxOf U p ℓ xs hU hm ℓ = U
proof: := Subtype.ext (replace_self hU)

name: Operad.STree.IsSCtx.normal
statement:
lemma IsSCtx.normal {A B : Finset ℕ} {f : SMono E A → SMono E B} (hf : IsSCtx f)
    (ℓ : SMono E A) : ∃ p xs, (f ℓ).1.get? p = some (ℓ.1.subst xs) ∧ Inputs A B xs ∧
      ∀ g, (f g).1 = (f ℓ).1.replace p (g.1.subst xs)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨T, p, xs, hp, hxs, hf⟩ := hf
  refine ⟨p, xs, ?_, hxs, fun g => ?_⟩
  · rw [hf]
    exact get?_replace hp _
  · rw [hf, hf, replace_replace]

name: Operad.STree.vert_of_prefix
statement:
lemma vert_of_prefix {t : STree E} {q q' : List ℕ} (hq : q ∈ vert t) (h : q' <+: q)
    (hne : q' ≠ q) : q' ∈ vert t
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨k, e, c, hq⟩ := hq
  obtain ⟨r, rfl⟩ := h
  cases r with
  | nil => exact absurd (List.append_nil q') (Ne.symm hne)
  | cons i r =>
    rw [get?_append] at hq
    cases hw : t.get? q' with
    | none => rw [hw] at hq; simp at hq
    | some w =>
      rw [hw, Option.bind_some] at hq
      cases w with
      | leaf a => simp at hq
      | node e' c' => exact ⟨_, e', c', hw⟩

name: Operad.STree.nil_mem_vert
statement: lemma nil_mem_vert {t : STree E} (h : ∀ a, t ≠ leaf a) : [] ∈ vert t
proof:
:= by
  cases t with
  | leaf a => exact absurd rfl (h a)
  | node e c => exact ⟨_, e, c, get?_nil _⟩

name: Operad.STree.disjoint_of_incomp
proof:
:= by
  have hx : ∀ x, (f₁ x).1.get? p₂ = some (ℓ₂.1.subst xs₂) := fun x => by
    rw [hf₁, get?_replace_of_incomp' h, hT₂]
  refine ⟨fun x => ctxOf (f₁ x) p₂ ℓ₂ xs₂ (hx x) hin₂.mono, fun y => ?_,
    fun x => isSCtx_ctxOf _ _ _ _ _ _, ?_, ?_⟩
  · refine ⟨(f₂ y).1, p₁, xs₁, ?_, hin₁, fun x => ?_⟩
    · rw [hf₂, get?_replace_of_incomp' h.symm, hT₁]
      rfl
    · simp only [ctxOf_val]
      rw [hf₁, hf₂, replace_comm h]
  · funext x
    exact Subtype.ext (replace_self (hx x)).symm
  · funext y
    apply Subtype.ext
    simp only [ctxOf_val]
    rw [hf₁, replace_self hT₁, hf₂]

name: Operad.STree.disjoint_of_nested
proof:
:= by
  have hv : (T.1.get? p₁).isSome := by rw [hT₁]; rfl
  have hU₀ : (ℓ₁.1.subst xs₁).get? q₀ = some (xs₁ a) := get?_subst h₀ xs₁
  have hXf : ∀ (y : SMono E A₂) b, (updIn xs₁ a q'' (y.1.subst xs₂) b).first = (xs₁ b).first :=
    fun y b => by
      by_cases hb : b = a
      · subst hb
        rw [updIn, Function.update_self]
        exact first_replace h'' (by
          rw [first_subst y.isShuffle, first_subst ℓ₂.isShuffle, y.first_eq ℓ₂])
      · rw [updIn, Function.update_of_ne hb]
  have hXm : ∀ y : SMono E A₂,
      StrictMonoOn (fun b => (updIn xs₁ a q'' (y.1.subst xs₂) b).first) (A₁ : Set ℕ) :=
    fun y b hb b' hb' hbb' => by
      simp only [hXf]
      exact hin₁.mono hb hb' hbb'
  have F1 : ∀ y, (f₂ y).1 = T.1.replace p₁ (ℓ₁.1.subst (updIn xs₁ a q'' (y.1.subst xs₂))) :=
    fun y => by rw [hf₂, replace_append hT₁, replace_append hU₀, updIn,
      subst_update ℓ₁.nodup h₀]
  have F2 : ∀ y, (f₂ y).1.get? p₁ = some (ℓ₁.1.subst (updIn xs₁ a q'' (y.1.subst xs₂))) :=
    fun y => by rw [F1]; exact get?_replace hv _
  refine ⟨fun x y => ctxOf (f₂ y) p₁ ℓ₁ _ (F2 y) (hXm y) x,
    fun y => isSCtx_ctxOf _ _ _ _ _ _, fun x => ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · have hxa : a ∈ x.1.labels := x.mem_labels.2 (ℓ₁.mem_labels.1 (mem_labels_of_get? h₀))
    have hxp := get?_pos hxa
    have hxs : (x.1.subst xs₁).get? (x.1.pos a) = some (xs₁ a) := get?_subst hxp xs₁
    refine ⟨(f₁ x).1, p₁ ++ (x.1.pos a ++ q''), xs₂, ?_, hin₂, fun y => ?_⟩
    · rw [hf₁, get?_replace_append hv, get?_append_of hxs, h'']
      rfl
    · simp only [ctxOf_val]
      rw [F1, replace_replace, updIn, subst_update x.nodup hxp, ← replace_append hxs, hf₁,
        replace_append (get?_replace hv _), replace_replace]
  · funext x
    apply Subtype.ext
    have hX : updIn xs₁ a q'' (ℓ₂.1.subst xs₂) = xs₁ := by
      rw [updIn, replace_self h'', Function.update_eq_self]
    have hT₂ : T.1.get? (p₁ ++ (q₀ ++ q'')) = some (ℓ₂.1.subst xs₂) := by
      rw [get?_append_of hT₁, get?_append_of hU₀]
      exact h''
    simp only [ctxOf_val]
    rw [hX, hf₂, replace_self hT₂, hf₁]
  · funext y
    exact Subtype.ext (replace_self (F2 y)).symm

name: Operad.STree.factors_of_overlap
statement:
theorem factors_of_overlap {A₁ A₂ B : Finset ℕ} {f₁ : SMono E A₁ → SMono E B}
    {f₂ : SMono E A₂ → SMono E B} {ℓ₁ : SMono E A₁} {ℓ₂ : SMono E A₂} {T : SMono E B}
    {p₁ q : List ℕ} {xs₁ xs₂ : ℕ → STree E}
    (hT₁ : T.1.get? p₁ = some (ℓ₁.1.subst xs₁))
    (hT₂ : T.1.get? (p₁ ++ q) = some (ℓ₂.1.subst xs₂))
    (hin₁ : Inputs A₁ B xs₁) (hin₂ : Inputs A₂ B xs₂)
    (hf₁ : ∀ g, (f₁ g).1 = T.1.replace p₁ (g.1.subst xs₁))
    (hf₂ : ∀ g, (f₂ g).1 = T.1.replace (p₁ ++ q) (g.1.subst xs₂))
    (hq : q ∈ vert ℓ₁.1) (hℓ₂ : [] ∈ vert ℓ₂.1) :
    ∃ (C : Finset ℕ) (m : SMono E C) (e₁ : SMono E A₁ → SMono E C)
      (e₂ : SMono E A₂ → SMono E C) (g : SMono E C → SMono E B) (ys₁ ys₂ : ℕ → STree E),
      IsSCtx e₁ ∧ IsSCtx e₂ ∧ IsSCtx g ∧ e₁ ℓ₁ = m ∧ e₂ ℓ₂ = m ∧ f₁ = g ∘ e₁ ∧ f₂ = g ∘ e₂ ∧
      (∀ h, (e₁ h).1 = m.1.replace [] (h.1.subst ys₁)) ∧
      (∀ h, (e₂ h).1 = m.1.replace q (h.1.subst ys₂)) ∧
      vert m.1 ⊆ occVert [] ℓ₁.1 ∪ occVert q ℓ₂.1 ∧
      (occVert [] ℓ₁.1 ∩ occVert q ℓ₂.1).Nonempty
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hUs : (ℓ₁.1.subst xs₁).IsShuffle := isShuffle_get? T.isShuffle hT₁
  have hUn : (ℓ₁.1.subst xs₁).labels.Nodup :=
    Multiset.nodup_of_le (labels_get?_le hT₁) T.nodup
  have hU₂ : (ℓ₁.1.subst xs₁).get? q = some (ℓ₂.1.subst xs₂) := by
    rw [get?_append_of hT₁] at hT₂
    exact hT₂
  let V : Set (List ℕ) := vert ℓ₁.1 ∪ occVert q ℓ₂.1
  obtain ⟨zs, hzs, hzs'⟩ := exists_subst_trunc hUs hUn V
  have hm₀s : ((ℓ₁.1.subst xs₁).trunc V).IsShuffle := isShuffle_trunc hUs V
  have hm₀n : ((ℓ₁.1.subst xs₁).trunc V).labels.Nodup :=
    Multiset.nodup_of_le (labels_trunc_le hUs V) hUn
  let C := ((ℓ₁.1.subst xs₁).trunc V).labels.toFinset
  let m : SMono E C := ⟨(ℓ₁.1.subst xs₁).trunc V, hm₀s,
    ((Multiset.toFinset_val _).trans (Multiset.dedup_eq_self.2 hm₀n)).symm⟩
  have hmv : m.1 = (ℓ₁.1.subst xs₁).trunc V := rfl
  
  let ys₁ : ℕ → STree E := fun a => (xs₁ a).trunc (shift V (ℓ₁.1.pos a))
  let ys₂ : ℕ → STree E := fun b => (xs₂ b).trunc (shift V (q ++ ℓ₂.1.pos b))
  have M1 : m.1 = ℓ₁.1.subst ys₁ :=
    trunc_subst ℓ₁.nodup xs₁ (V := V) fun r k e c h => Or.inl ⟨k, e, c, h⟩
  have M2 : m.1.get? q = some (ℓ₂.1.subst ys₂) := by
    rw [hmv, get?_trunc hU₂ (V := V) fun q' h1 h2 => Or.inl (vert_of_prefix hq h1 h2),
      trunc_subst ℓ₂.nodup xs₂ (V := shift V q) fun r k e c h => Or.inr ⟨r, ⟨k, e, c, h⟩, rfl⟩]
    simp only [ys₂, shift_shift]
  have hm₁ : StrictMonoOn (fun a => (ys₁ a).first) (A₁ : Set ℕ) := fun a ha a' ha' h => by
    simp only [ys₁, first_trunc (hin₁.shuffle a ha), first_trunc (hin₁.shuffle a' ha')]
    exact hin₁.mono ha ha' h
  have hm₂ : StrictMonoOn (fun b => (ys₂ b).first) (A₂ : Set ℕ) := fun b hb b' hb' h => by
    simp only [ys₂, first_trunc (hin₂.shuffle b hb), first_trunc (hin₂.shuffle b' hb')]
    exact hin₂.mono hb hb' h
  have hM1 : m.1.get? [] = some (ℓ₁.1.subst ys₁) := by rw [get?_nil, M1]
  have hTm : T.1.get? p₁ = some (m.1.subst zs) := by rw [hT₁, hmv, hzs]
  have hzm : StrictMonoOn (fun a => (zs a).first) (C : Set ℕ) := fun a ha a' ha' h => by
    have ha2 : a ∈ ((ℓ₁.1.subst xs₁).trunc V).labels := Multiset.mem_toFinset.1 ha
    have ha2' : a' ∈ ((ℓ₁.1.subst xs₁).trunc V).labels := Multiset.mem_toFinset.1 ha'
    simp only [(hzs' a ha2).2.1, (hzs' a' ha2').2.1]
    exact h
  
  have hsub₁ : ∀ a ∈ A₁, (ys₁ a).subst zs = xs₁ a := fun a ha => by
    have h1 : m.1.get? (ℓ₁.1.pos a) = some (ys₁ a) := by
      rw [M1]
      exact get?_subst (get?_pos (ℓ₁.mem_labels.2 ha)) ys₁
    have h2 := get?_subst h1 zs
    rw [hmv, hzs, get?_subst (get?_pos (ℓ₁.mem_labels.2 ha)) xs₁, Option.some_inj] at h2
    exact h2.symm
  have hsub₂ : ∀ b ∈ A₂, (ys₂ b).subst zs = xs₂ b := fun b hb => by
    have h1 : m.1.get? (q ++ ℓ₂.1.pos b) = some (ys₂ b) := by
      rw [get?_append_of M2]
      exact get?_subst (get?_pos (ℓ₂.mem_labels.2 hb)) ys₂
    have h2 := get?_subst h1 zs
    rw [hmv, hzs, get?_append_of hU₂, get?_subst (get?_pos (ℓ₂.mem_labels.2 hb)) xs₂,
      Option.some_inj] at h2
    exact h2.symm
  refine ⟨C, m, ctxOf m [] ℓ₁ ys₁ hM1 hm₁, ctxOf m q ℓ₂ ys₂ M2 hm₂, ctxOf T p₁ m zs hTm hzm,
    ys₁, ys₂, isSCtx_ctxOf _ _ _ _ _ _, isSCtx_ctxOf _ _ _ _ _ _, isSCtx_ctxOf _ _ _ _ _ _,
    Subtype.ext ?_, ctxOf_self _ _ _ _ _ _, ?_, ?_, fun _ => rfl, fun _ => rfl, ?_, ?_⟩
  · simp only [ctxOf_val, replace_nil]
    exact M1.symm
  · funext h
    apply Subtype.ext
    simp only [Function.comp_apply, ctxOf_val, replace_nil]
    rw [subst_subst, subst_congr h.1 fun a ha => hsub₁ a (h.mem_labels.1 ha), hf₁]
  · funext h
    apply Subtype.ext
    simp only [Function.comp_apply, ctxOf_val]
    rw [replace_subst (by rw [M2]; rfl), subst_subst,
      subst_congr h.1 fun b hb => hsub₂ b (h.mem_labels.1 hb), hmv, hzs, hf₂, replace_append hT₁]
  · rintro r ⟨k, e, c, hr⟩
    rcases get?_trunc_node hr with hr | hr
    · exact Or.inl ⟨r, hr, rfl⟩
    · exact Or.inr hr
  · exact ⟨q, ⟨q, hq, rfl⟩, ⟨[], hℓ₂, List.append_nil q⟩⟩

name: Operad.STree.Critical.swap
statement:
lemma Critical.swap {C : Finset ℕ} {r₁ r₂ : ρ} {B : G.Amb C r₁ r₂} (h : Critical G B) :
    Critical G B.swap
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨p₁, p₂, xs₁, xs₂, h₁, h₂, hc, ho⟩ := h
  refine ⟨p₂, p₁, xs₂, xs₁, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [Rules.Amb.swap_top]
    exact h₂
  · rw [Rules.Amb.swap_top]
    exact h₁
  · rw [Rules.Amb.swap_top, Set.union_comm]
    exact hc
  · rw [Set.inter_comm]
    exact ho

name: Operad.STree.Amb.data
statement:
lemma Amb.data {B : Finset ℕ} {r₁ r₂ : ρ} (A : G.Amb B r₁ r₂) :
    ∃ p₁ xs₁ p₂ xs₂, A.top.1.get? p₁ = some ((G.lead r₁).1.subst xs₁) ∧
      A.top.1.get? p₂ = some ((G.lead r₂).1.subst xs₂) ∧
      Inputs (G.src r₁) B xs₁ ∧ Inputs (G.src r₂) B xs₂ ∧
      (∀ g, (A.f₁ g).1 = A.top.1.replace p₁ (g.1.subst xs₁)) ∧
      (∀ g, (A.f₂ g).1 = A.top.1.replace p₂ (g.1.subst xs₂))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨p₁, xs₁, h₁, hin₁, hf₁⟩ := IsSCtx.normal A.ctx₁ (G.lead r₁)
  obtain ⟨p₂, xs₂, h₂, hin₂, hf₂⟩ := IsSCtx.normal A.ctx₂ (G.lead r₂)
  have ht : A.f₂ (G.lead r₂) = A.top := A.eq.symm
  rw [ht] at h₂ hf₂
  exact ⟨p₁, xs₁, p₂, xs₂, h₁, h₂, hin₁, hin₂, hf₁, hf₂⟩

name: Operad.STree.classify_of_prefix
statement:
theorem classify_of_prefix (hlead : ∀ r a, (G.lead r).1 ≠ leaf a) {B : Finset ℕ} {r₁ r₂ : ρ}
    (A : G.Amb B r₁ r₂) {p₁ p₂ : List ℕ} {xs₁ xs₂ : ℕ → STree E}
    (hT₁ : A.top.1.get? p₁ = some ((G.lead r₁).1.subst xs₁))
    (hT₂ : A.top.1.get? p₂ = some ((G.lead r₂).1.subst xs₂))
    (hin₁ : Inputs (G.src r₁) B xs₁) (hin₂ : Inputs (G.src r₂) B xs₂)
    (hf₁ : ∀ g, (A.f₁ g).1 = A.top.1.replace p₁ (g.1.subst xs₁))
    (hf₂ : ∀ g, (A.f₂ g).1 = A.top.1.replace p₂ (g.1.subst xs₂)) (hp : p₁ <+: p₂) :
    A.IsDisjoint ∨ ∃ C, ∃ B' : G.Amb C r₁ r₂, Critical G B' ∧ A.FactorsThrough B'
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨q, rfl⟩ := hp
  have hU₂ : ((G.lead r₁).1.subst xs₁).get? q = some ((G.lead r₂).1.subst xs₂) := by
    rw [get?_append_of hT₁] at hT₂
    exact hT₂
  rcases get?_subst_cases hU₂ with ⟨u, hu, heq⟩ | ⟨q₀, i, q', a, rfl, h₀, h''⟩
  · cases u with
    | leaf a =>
      left
      exact disjoint_of_nested (q'' := []) hT₁ hin₁ hin₂ hf₁
        (by rw [List.append_nil]; exact hf₂) hu (by rw [get?_nil, heq]; rfl)
    | node e c =>
      right
      obtain ⟨C, m, e₁, e₂, g, ys₁, ys₂, he₁, he₂, hg, hm₁, hm₂, hfe₁, hfe₂, hy₁, hy₂, hc, ho⟩ :=
        factors_of_overlap hT₁ hT₂ hin₁ hin₂ hf₁ hf₂ ⟨_, e, c, hu⟩
          (nil_mem_vert (hlead r₂))
      have htop : e₁ (G.lead r₁) = m := hm₁
      refine ⟨C, ⟨e₁, e₂, he₁, he₂, hm₁.trans hm₂.symm⟩, ⟨[], q, ys₁, ys₂, ?_, ?_, ?_, ho⟩,
        ⟨g, hg, hfe₁, hfe₂⟩⟩
      · show ∀ h, (e₁ h).1 = (e₁ (G.lead r₁)).1.replace [] (h.1.subst ys₁)
        rw [htop]
        exact hy₁
      · show ∀ h, (e₂ h).1 = (e₁ (G.lead r₁)).1.replace q (h.1.subst ys₂)
        rw [htop]
        exact hy₂
      · show vert (e₁ (G.lead r₁)).1 ⊆ _
        rw [htop]
        exact hc
  · left
    exact disjoint_of_nested hT₁ hin₁ hin₂ hf₁ hf₂ h₀ h''

name: Operad.STree.classify
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨p₁, xs₁, p₂, xs₂, hT₁, hT₂, hin₁, hin₂, hf₁, hf₂⟩ := Amb.data G A
  rcases prefix_or_incomp p₁ p₂ with hp | hp | hp
  · exact classify_of_prefix G hlead A hT₁ hT₂ hin₁ hin₂ hf₁ hf₂ hp
  · have hT : A.swap.top = A.top := Rules.Amb.swap_top A
    rcases classify_of_prefix G hlead A.swap (hT ▸ hT₂) (hT ▸ hT₁) hin₂ hin₁ (hT ▸ hf₂)
      (hT ▸ hf₁) hp with h | ⟨C, B', hB', h⟩
    · exact Or.inl (Rules.Amb.IsDisjoint.of_swap h)
    · exact Or.inr ⟨C, B'.swap, hB'.swap, Rules.Amb.FactorsThrough.of_swap h⟩
  · exact Or.inl (disjoint_of_incomp hT₁ hT₂ hin₁ hin₂ hf₁ hf₂ hp)

name: Operad.STree.resolvable_of_critical
statement:
theorem resolvable_of_critical (hlead : ∀ r a, (G.lead r).1 ≠ leaf a)
    (hcrit : ∀ {C : Finset ℕ} {r₁ r₂ : ρ} (B : G.Amb C r₁ r₂), Critical G B → B.Res)
    (A : Finset ℕ) : (G.rw A).Resolvable
proof:
:=
  Rules.resolvable_of_crit (fun B => Critical G B) (fun B hB => hcrit B hB)
    (fun A => classify G hlead A) A

name: Operad.STree.isCompl_of_critical
statement:
theorem isCompl_of_critical (hlead : ∀ r a, (G.lead r).1 ≠ leaf a)
    (hcrit : ∀ {C : Finset ℕ} {r₁ r₂ : ρ} (B : G.Amb C r₁ r₂), Critical G B → B.Res)
    (A : Finset ℕ) :
    IsCompl (Finsupp.supported R R {t : SMono E A | G.Normal t}) (G.rw A).ideal
proof:
:= by
  rw [← G.irr_eq]
  exact (resolvable_of_critical G hlead hcrit A).isCompl

name: Operad.STree.Critical.res_of_isCompl
statement:
theorem Critical.res_of_isCompl {C : Finset ℕ} {r₁ r₂ : ρ} (B : G.Amb C r₁ r₂)
    (h : Disjoint (Finsupp.supported R R {t : SMono E C | G.Normal t}) (G.rw C).ideal) :
    B.Res
proof:
:=
  B.res_of_isCompl h

name: Operad.BTree.subAt_nil
statement: @[simp] lemma subAt_nil (t : BTree E) : t.subAt [] = t
proof: := by cases t <;> rfl

name: Operad.BTree.cutAt_nil
statement: @[simp] lemma cutAt_nil (t : BTree E) : t.cutAt [] = leaf
proof: := by cases t <;> rfl

name: Operad.BTree.posAt_nil
statement: @[simp] lemma posAt_nil (t : BTree E) : t.posAt [] = 0
proof: := by cases t <;> rfl

name: Operad.BTree.subAt_false
statement:
@[simp] lemma subAt_false (e : E) (l r : BTree E) (p : List Bool) :
    (node e l r).subAt (false :: p) = l.subAt p
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.BTree.subAt_true
statement:
@[simp] lemma subAt_true (e : E) (l r : BTree E) (p : List Bool) :
    (node e l r).subAt (true :: p) = r.subAt p
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.BTree.cutAt_false
statement:
@[simp] lemma cutAt_false (e : E) (l r : BTree E) (p : List Bool) :
    (node e l r).cutAt (false :: p) = node e (l.cutAt p) r
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.BTree.cutAt_true
statement:
@[simp] lemma cutAt_true (e : E) (l r : BTree E) (p : List Bool) :
    (node e l r).cutAt (true :: p) = node e l (r.cutAt p)
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.BTree.posAt_false
statement:
@[simp] lemma posAt_false (e : E) (l r : BTree E) (p : List Bool) :
    (node e l r).posAt (false :: p) = l.posAt p
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.BTree.posAt_true
statement:
@[simp] lemma posAt_true (e : E) (l r : BTree E) (p : List Bool) :
    (node e l r).posAt (true :: p) = l.arity + r.posAt p
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.BTree.mem_paths_leaf
statement: @[simp] lemma mem_paths_leaf (p : List Bool) : p ∈ (leaf : BTree E).paths ↔ p = []
proof:
:= by
  simp [paths]

name: Operad.BTree.nil_mem_paths
statement: @[simp] lemma nil_mem_paths (t : BTree E) : [] ∈ t.paths
proof:
:= by
  cases t <;> simp [paths]

name: Operad.BTree.cons_false_mem_paths
statement:
@[simp] lemma cons_false_mem_paths (e : E) (l r : BTree E) (p : List Bool) :
    false :: p ∈ (node e l r).paths ↔ p ∈ l.paths
proof:
:= by
  simp [paths]

name: Operad.BTree.cons_true_mem_paths
statement:
@[simp] lemma cons_true_mem_paths (e : E) (l r : BTree E) (p : List Bool) :
    true :: p ∈ (node e l r).paths ↔ p ∈ r.paths
proof:
:= by
  simp [paths]

name: Operad.BTree.cons_not_mem_paths_leaf
statement: lemma cons_not_mem_paths_leaf (b : Bool) (p : List Bool) : b :: p ∉ (leaf : BTree E).paths
proof:
:= by
  simp

name: Operad.BTree.graft_cutAt_subAt
statement:
theorem graft_cutAt_subAt : ∀ (t : BTree E) (p : List Bool), p ∈ t.paths →
    (t.cutAt p).graft (t.posAt p) (t.subAt p) = t
  | leaf, [], _ => rfl
  | node e l r, [], _ => rfl
  | leaf, _ :: _, h => absurd h (cons_not_mem_paths_leaf _ _)
  | node e l r, false :: p, h => by
    rw [cons_false_mem_paths] at h
    have hlt
proof:
:= posAt_lt_arity_cutAt l p h
    simp only [cutAt_false, posAt_false, subAt_false]
    rw [graft_node_of_lt r _ hlt, graft_cutAt_subAt l p h]
  | node e l r, true :: p, h => by
    rw [cons_true_mem_paths] at h
    simp only [cutAt_true, posAt_true, subAt_true]
    rw [graft_node_of_ge l _ (by omega), show l.arity + r.posAt p - l.arity = r.posAt p by omega,
      graft_cutAt_subAt r p h]

name: Operad.BTree.posAt_lt
statement:
lemma posAt_lt (t : BTree E) {p : List Bool} (h : p ∈ t.paths) :
    t.posAt p < (t.cutAt p).arity
proof:
:=
  graft_cutAt_subAt.posAt_lt_arity_cutAt t p h

name: Operad.BTree.arity_cutAt
statement:
lemma arity_cutAt (t : BTree E) {p : List Bool} (h : p ∈ t.paths) :
    (t.cutAt p).arity + (t.subAt p).arity = t.arity + 1
proof:
:= by
  have := arity_graft (t.cutAt p) (t.posAt p) (t.subAt p) (t.posAt_lt h)
  rw [graft_cutAt_subAt t p h] at this
  omega

name: Operad.BTree.leafPath_graft
statement:
theorem leafPath_graft : ∀ (t : BTree E) (a : ℕ) (s : BTree E), a < t.arity →
    t.leafPath a ∈ (t.graft a s).paths ∧ (t.graft a s).subAt (t.leafPath a) = s ∧
      (t.graft a s).cutAt (t.leafPath a) = t ∧ (t.graft a s).posAt (t.leafPath a) = a
  | leaf, a, s, h => by
    obtain rfl : a = 0
proof:
:= by simp only [arity_leaf] at h; omega
    simp [leafPath]
  | node e l r, a, s, h => by
    simp only [arity_node] at h
    by_cases ha : a < l.arity
    · obtain ⟨h1, h2, h3, h4⟩ := leafPath_graft l a s ha
      simp only [leafPath, if_pos ha, graft_node_of_lt r s ha, cons_false_mem_paths, subAt_false,
        cutAt_false, posAt_false]
      exact ⟨h1, h2, by rw [h3], h4⟩
    · obtain ⟨h1, h2, h3, h4⟩ := leafPath_graft r (a - l.arity) s (by omega)
      simp only [leafPath, if_neg ha, graft_node_of_ge l s (by omega : l.arity ≤ a),
        cons_true_mem_paths, subAt_true, cutAt_true, posAt_true]
      exact ⟨h1, h2, by rw [h3], by omega⟩

name: Operad.BTree.eq_of_posAt_eq
statement:
theorem eq_of_posAt_eq : ∀ (t : BTree E) {p p' : List Bool}, p ∈ t.paths → p' ∈ t.paths →
    t.posAt p = t.posAt p' → (t.subAt p).arity = (t.subAt p').arity → p = p'
  | leaf, p, p', h, h', _, _ => by
    rw [mem_paths_leaf] at h h'
    rw [h, h']
  | node e l r, [], [], _, _, _, _ => rfl
  | node e l r, [], false :: p', _, h', _, ha => by
    rw [cons_false_mem_paths] at h'
    have
proof:
:= arity_cutAt l h'
    have := arity_pos (l.cutAt p')
    have := arity_pos r
    simp only [subAt_nil, arity_node, subAt_false] at ha
    omega
  | node e l r, [], true :: p', _, h', _, ha => by
    rw [cons_true_mem_paths] at h'
    have := arity_cutAt r h'
    have := arity_pos (r.cutAt p')
    have := arity_pos l
    simp only [subAt_nil, arity_node, subAt_true] at ha
    omega
  | node e l r, false :: p, [], h, _, _, ha => by
    rw [cons_false_mem_paths] at h
    have := arity_cutAt l h
    have := arity_pos (l.cutAt p)
    have := arity_pos r
    simp only [subAt_nil, arity_node, subAt_false] at ha
    omega
  | node e l r, true :: p, [], h, _, _, ha => by
    rw [cons_true_mem_paths] at h
    have := arity_cutAt r h
    have := arity_pos (r.cutAt p)
    have := arity_pos l
    simp only [subAt_nil, arity_node, subAt_true] at ha
    omega
  | node e l r, false :: p, false :: p', h, h', hp, ha => by
    rw [cons_false_mem_paths] at h h'
    rw [eq_of_posAt_eq l h h' hp ha]
  | node e l r, true :: p, true :: p', h, h', hp, ha => by
    rw [cons_true_mem_paths] at h h'
    simp only [posAt_true] at hp
    rw [eq_of_posAt_eq r h h' (by omega) ha]
  | node e l r, false :: p, true :: p', h, _, hp, _ => by
    rw [cons_false_mem_paths] at h
    have := posAt_lt l h
    have := arity_cutAt l h
    have := arity_pos (l.subAt p)
    simp only [posAt_false, posAt_true] at hp
    omega
  | node e l r, true :: p, false :: p', _, h', hp, _ => by
    rw [cons_false_mem_paths] at h'
    have := posAt_lt l h'
    have := arity_cutAt l h'
    have := arity_pos (l.subAt p')
    simp only [posAt_false, posAt_true] at hp
    omega

name: Operad.BTree.swapAt_leaf
statement: @[simp] lemma swapAt_leaf (q : List Bool) : (leaf : BTree E).swapAt tw q = leaf
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.BTree.swapAt_nil
statement:
@[simp] lemma swapAt_nil (e : E) (l r : BTree E) :
    (node e l r).swapAt tw [] = node (tw e) r l
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.BTree.swapAt_false
statement:
@[simp] lemma swapAt_false (e : E) (l r : BTree E) (q : List Bool) :
    (node e l r).swapAt tw (false :: q) = node e (l.swapAt tw q) r
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.BTree.swapAt_true
statement:
@[simp] lemma swapAt_true (e : E) (l r : BTree E) (q : List Bool) :
    (node e l r).swapAt tw (true :: q) = node e l (r.swapAt tw q)
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.BTree.arity_swapAt
statement:
@[simp] theorem arity_swapAt : ∀ (t : BTree E) (q : List Bool), (t.swapAt tw q).arity = t.arity
  | leaf, _ => rfl
