    (map₂ idSpHom h.toGrSpeciesHom).app S (twD ε γ₁ S w)
      = (map₂ idSpHom h.toGrSpeciesHom).app S (twD ε γ₂ S w)
proof:
:=
  eq_of_corolla_hom h (fun S _ _ => (map₂ idSpHom h.toGrSpeciesHom).app S ∘ₗ twD ε γ₁ S)
    (fun S _ _ => (map₂ idSpHom h.toGrSpeciesHom).app S ∘ₗ twD ε γ₂ S)
    (fun S S' _ _ _ _ σ w => by
      simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply, twD, twF_map]
      exact (map₂ idSpHom h.toGrSpeciesHom).app_map σ _)
    (fun S S' _ _ _ _ σ w => by
      simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply, twD, twF_map]
      exact (map₂ idSpHom h.toGrSpeciesHom).app_map σ _)
    (fun S Y _ _ _ _ i z w => by simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply, twD, twF_act, map₂_act])
    (fun S Y _ _ _ _ i z w => by simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply, twD, twF_act, map₂_act])
    (fun A _ _ c => map₂_twD_corolla ε ε h h hγ₁ hγ₂ hh c) w

name: Operad.GrComposite.factor_ownGen
statement:
lemma factor_ownGen {A : Type} [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] (L : LinOrd A) (m : V A)
    (F : Finset A) :
    ∀ (S : Type) [Fintype S] [DecidableEq S] (f : S → A) (yy yy' : ∀ a, Q (Fib f a))
    (c : A → Bool), (∀ a, GrOperad.par (R := R) (c a) (yy a) = yy a) →
    (∀ a, GrOperad.par (R := R) (c a) (yy' a) = yy' a) → (∀ a ∉ F, yy a = yy' a) →
    (∀ a, π.app _ (yy a) = π.app _ (yy' a)) →
    T S (mk R (ownGen L m f yy)) = T S (mk R (ownGen L m f yy'))
proof:
:= by
  induction F using Finset.induction_on with
  | empty =>
    intro S _ _ f yy yy' c _ _ he _
    rw [show yy = yy' from funext fun a => he a (Finset.notMem_empty a)]
  | insert a₀ F ha₀ ih =>
    intro S _ _ f yy yy' c hyy hyy' he hπ
    have hpar : ∀ yy₀ : ∀ a, Q (Fib f a), (∀ a, GrOperad.par (R := R) (c a) (yy₀ a) = yy₀ a) →
        ∀ a, GrOperad.par (R := R) (update c a₀ false a) (extY (R := R) f yy₀ a₀ a)
          = extY (R := R) f yy₀ a₀ a := fun yy₀ hyy₀ a => by
      by_cases h : a₀ = a
      · subst h
        rw [update_self, extY, dif_pos rfl, ← GrOperad.map_par, GrOperad.par_one]
      · rw [update_of_ne (Ne.symm h), extY, dif_neg h, ← GrOperad.map_par, hyy₀]
    have h1 := ih (Ext f a₀) (extOwner f a₀) (extY (R := R) f yy a₀) (extY (R := R) f yy' a₀)
      (update c a₀ false) (hpar yy hyy) (hpar yy' hyy')
      (fun a ha => by
        by_cases h : a₀ = a
        · rw [extY, extY, dif_pos h, dif_pos h]
        · rw [extY, extY, dif_neg h, dif_neg h,
            he a (by simp [Finset.mem_insert, Ne.symm h, ha])])
      (fun a => by
        by_cases h : a₀ = a
        · rw [extY, extY, dif_pos h, dif_pos h]
        · rw [extY, extY, dif_neg h, dif_neg h, π.app_map, π.app_map, hπ])
    have e1 := map_act_ext L m f yy c hyy a₀
    have e2 := map_act_ext L m f yy' c hyy' a₀
    have h2 : (∏ a, σ R ((c a₀ && ltB L a₀ a) && c a)) • T S (mk R (ownGen L m f yy))
        = (∏ a, σ R ((c a₀ && ltB L a₀ a) && c a)) • T S (mk R (ownGen L m f yy')) := by
      rw [← map_smul, ← map_smul, ← e1, ← e2, hTm, hTm, hTa, hTa, hπ a₀, h1]
    have h3 := congrArg ((∏ a, σ R ((c a₀ && ltB L a₀ a) && c a)) • ·) h2
    simp only [smul_smul, ← Finset.prod_mul_distrib,
      Finset.prod_congr rfl fun a _ => σ_mul_self R ((c a₀ && ltB L a₀ a) && c a),
      Finset.prod_const_one, one_smul] at h3
    exact h3

name: Operad.GrComposite.factor_mk
statement:
lemma factor_mk (ψ : GrSpeciesHom R Q Q)
    (hψ : ∀ (A : Type) [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] (y : Q A), π.app A (ψ.app A y) = π.app A y)
    {S : Type} [Fintype S] [DecidableEq S] (g : GrCompGen V Q S) :
    T S (mk R (genMap₂ idSpHom ψ g)) = T S (mk R g)
proof:
:= by
  rw [mk_eq_sum (R := R) (genMap₂ idSpHom ψ g), mk_eq_sum (R := R) g, map_sum, map_sum]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun p _ => ?_
  rw [map_sum, map_sum]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun c _ => ?_
  rw [mk_eq_ownGen (R := R) (parGen (R := R) (genMap₂ idSpHom ψ g) p c),
    mk_eq_ownGen (R := R) (parGen (R := R) g p c)]
  refine factor_ownGen π T hTm hTa g.L (GrSpecies.par (R := R) p g.m) Finset.univ S (owner g)
    _ _ c (fun a => ?_) (fun a => ?_) (fun a ha => absurd (Finset.mem_univ a) ha) (fun a => ?_)
  · show GrOperad.par (R := R) (c a) (GrOperad.map (R := R) _ (GrSpecies.par (R := R) (c a)
      (ψ.app _ (g.y a)))) = _
    rw [← GrOperad.map_par]
    exact congrArg _ (GrOperad.par_par_self (R := R) (c a) _)
  · show GrOperad.par (R := R) (c a) (GrOperad.map (R := R) _ (GrSpecies.par (R := R) (c a)
      (g.y a))) = _
    rw [← GrOperad.map_par]
    exact congrArg _ (GrOperad.par_par_self (R := R) (c a) _)
  · show π.app _ (GrOperad.map (R := R) _ (GrOperad.par (R := R) (c a) (ψ.app _ (g.y a))))
      = π.app _ (GrOperad.map (R := R) _ (GrOperad.par (R := R) (c a) (g.y a)))
    rw [π.app_map, π.app_map, π.app_par, π.app_par, hψ]
    rfl

name: Operad.GrComposite.factor_map₂
statement:
theorem factor_map₂ (ψ : GrSpeciesHom R Q Q)
    (hψ : ∀ (A : Type) [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] (y : Q A), π.app A (ψ.app A y) = π.app A y)
    {S : Type} [Fintype S] [DecidableEq S] (w : GrComposite R V Q S) :
    T S ((map₂ idSpHom ψ).app S w) = T S w
proof:
:= by
  have h : (T S).comp ((map₂ idSpHom ψ).app S) = T S := hom_ext fun g => by
    rw [LinearMap.comp_apply, map₂_mk]
    exact factor_mk π T hTm hTa ψ hψ g
  exact LinearMap.congr_fun h w

name: Operad.GrComposite.freeEval_ι
statement:
@[simp] lemma freeEval_ι {A : Type} [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] (y : P A) :
    (freeEval R P).app A ((FreeGrL.ι R P).app A y) = y
proof:
:=
  FreeGrL.homEquiv_symm_ι _ y

name: Operad.GrComposite.map₂_id_app
statement:
lemma map₂_id_app {N : (A : Type) → [Fintype A] → [DecidableEq A] → Type*}
    [∀ (A : Type) [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A], AddCommGroup (N A)]
    [∀ (A : Type) [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A], Module R (N A)] [GrOperad R N]
    (x : GrComposite R C N S) : (map₂ idSpHom (GrOperadHom.id R N).toGrSpeciesHom).app S x = x
proof:
:= by
  have h : (map₂ idSpHom (GrOperadHom.id R N).toGrSpeciesHom).app S = LinearMap.id :=
    hom_ext (M := C) (N := N) fun g => by rw [map₂_mk]; rfl
  rw [h, LinearMap.id_apply]

name: Operad.GrComposite.map₂_eval_ι
statement:
lemma map₂_eval_ι (x : GrComposite R C P S) :
    (map₂ idSpHom (freeEval R P).toGrSpeciesHom).app S ((map₂ idSpHom (FreeGrL.ι R P)).app S x)
      = x
proof:
:= by
  rw [map₂_map₂ _ _ (GrOperadHom.id R P).toGrSpeciesHom (fun A _ _ y => freeEval_ι y),
    map₂_id_app]

name: Operad.GrComposite.isPar_parFam
statement:
lemma isPar_parFam (b : Bool) (β : GrOperad.Inv R (ConvOp R C P)) :
    GrOperad.Inv.IsPar b (parFam b β)
proof: := fun A _ _ => GrOperad.par_par_self (R := R) b (β.1 A)

name: Operad.GrComposite.parFam_add
statement: lemma parFam_add (β : GrOperad.Inv R (ConvOp R C P)) : parFam false β + parFam true β = β
proof:
:=
  Subtype.ext (funext fun A => funext fun _ => funext fun _ => GrOperad.par_add (R := R) (β.1 A))

name: Operad.GrComposite.twD'_eval
statement:
theorem twD'_eval (β : GrOperad.Inv R (ConvOp R C P)) (w : GrComposite R C (FreeGrL R P) S) :
    twD' β S ((map₂ idSpHom (freeEval R P).toGrSpeciesHom).app S w)
      = (map₂ idSpHom (freeEval R P).toGrSpeciesHom).app S
          (twD (FreeGrL.aug R P) (liftSp (FreeGrL.ι R P) β) S w)
proof:
:= by
  rw [twD', LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearMap.comp_apply, map₂_map₂ _ _
    ((FreeGrL.ι R P).comp (freeEval R P).toGrSpeciesHom) (fun _ _ _ _ => rfl)]
  exact factor_map₂ (freeEval R P)
    (fun S _ _ => (map₂ idSpHom (freeEval R P).toGrSpeciesHom).app S
      ∘ₗ twD (FreeGrL.aug R P) (liftSp (FreeGrL.ι R P) β) S)
    (fun S S' _ _ _ _ σ w => by
      simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply, twD, twF_map]
      exact (map₂ idSpHom (freeEval R P).toGrSpeciesHom).app_map σ _)
    (fun S Y _ _ _ _ i z w => by simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply, twD, twF_act, map₂_act])
    ((FreeGrL.ι R P).comp (freeEval R P).toGrSpeciesHom)
    (fun A _ _ y => by rw [GrSpeciesHom.comp_app]; exact freeEval_ι _) w

name: Operad.GrComposite.twD'_map
statement:
theorem twD'_map {S' : Type} [Fintype S'] [DecidableEq S'] (β : GrOperad.Inv R (ConvOp R C P))
    (σ : S ≃ S') (w : GrComposite R C P S) : twD' β S' (map σ w) = map σ (twD' β S w)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [twD', LinearMap.comp_apply]
  rw [show (map₂ idSpHom (FreeGrL.ι R P)).app S' (map σ w)
      = map σ ((map₂ idSpHom (FreeGrL.ι R P)).app S w) from
    (map₂ idSpHom (FreeGrL.ι R P)).app_map σ w, twD, twF_map]
  exact (map₂ idSpHom (freeEval R P).toGrSpeciesHom).app_map σ _

name: Operad.GrComposite.twD'_act
statement:
theorem twD'_act {Y : Type} [Fintype Y] [DecidableEq Y] (β : GrOperad.Inv R (ConvOp R C P))
    (i : S) (z : P Y) (w : GrComposite R C P S) :
    twD' β _ (act R C i z w) = act R C i z (twD' β S w)
proof:
:= by
  conv_lhs => rw [← map₂_eval_ι w, ← freeEval_ι (R := R) z, ← map₂_act, twD'_eval, twD,
    twF_act, map₂_act, freeEval_ι]
  rfl

name: Operad.GrComposite.twD'_corolla
statement:
theorem twD'_corolla (β : GrOperad.Inv R (ConvOp R C P)) {A : Type} [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A]
    (c : C A) : twD' β A (corolla R P A c)
      = (map₂ idSpHom (freeEval R P).toGrSpeciesHom).app A
          (twD (FreeGrL.aug R P) (liftSp (FreeGrL.ι R P) β) A (corolla R (FreeGrL R P) A c))
proof:
:= by
  rw [← twD'_eval, map₂_corolla]

name: Operad.GrComposite.twD'_add
statement:
theorem twD'_add (β β' : GrOperad.Inv R (ConvOp R C P)) (w : GrComposite R C P S) :
    twD' (β + β') S w = twD' β S w + twD' β' S w
proof:
:= by
  simp only [twD', LinearMap.comp_apply, map_add, twD_add]

name: Operad.GrComposite.twD'_zero
statement: theorem twD'_zero (w : GrComposite R C P S) : twD' (0 : GrOperad.Inv R (ConvOp R C P)) S w = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp only [twD', LinearMap.comp_apply, map_zero, twD_zero]

name: Operad.GrComposite.twD'_eq_of_isPar
statement:
theorem twD'_eq_of_isPar (ε : GrAug R P) {p : Bool} {β : GrOperad.Inv R (ConvOp R C P)}
    (hβ : GrOperad.Inv.IsPar p β) (w : GrComposite R C P S) : twD' β S w = twD ε β S w
proof:
:=
  eq_of_corolla (fun S _ _ => twD' β S) (fun S _ _ => twD ε β S)
    (fun S S' _ _ _ _ σ w => twD'_map β σ w) (fun S S' _ _ _ _ σ w => twF_map ε _ σ w)
    (fun S Y _ _ _ _ i z w => twD'_act β i z w) (fun S Y _ _ _ _ i z w => twF_act ε _ i z w)
    (fun A _ _ c => by
      rw [twD'_corolla, map₂_twD_corolla (FreeGrL.aug R P) ε (freeEval R P)
        (GrOperadHom.id R P) (isPar_liftSp _ hβ) hβ (fun A _ _ y => freeEval_ι _) c,
        map₂_id_app]) w

name: Operad.GrComposite.twD'_eq
statement:
theorem twD'_eq (ε : GrAug R P) (β : GrOperad.Inv R (ConvOp R C P)) (S : Type) [Fintype S]
    [DecidableEq S] : twD' β S = twD ε β S
proof:
:= by
  refine LinearMap.ext fun w => ?_
  conv_lhs => rw [← parFam_add β]
  conv_rhs => rw [← parFam_add β]
  rw [twD'_add, twD_add, twD'_eq_of_isPar ε (isPar_parFam false β),
    twD'_eq_of_isPar ε (isPar_parFam true β)]

name: Operad.GrComposite.appHom_liftSp
statement:
lemma appHom_liftSp (β : GrOperad.Inv R (ConvOp R C P)) :
    GrOperad.Inv.appHom (postHom (C := C) (freeEval R P)) (liftSp (FreeGrL.ι R P) β) = β
proof:
:=
  Subtype.ext (funext fun A => funext fun _ => funext fun _ =>
    ConvOp.ext fun c => freeEval_ι (toLin (β.1 A) c))

name: Operad.GrComposite.isPar_add'
proof:
:= fun A _ _ => by
  show GrOperad.par (R := R) p (q.1 A + q'.1 A) = q.1 A + q'.1 A
  rw [map_add, hq A, hq' A]

name: Operad.GrComposite.twD'_sq
statement:
theorem twD'_sq {α : GrOperad.Inv R (ConvOp R C P)} (hα : GrOperad.Inv.IsPar true α)
    (w : GrComposite R C P S) :
    twD' α S (twD' α S w) = twD' (GrOperad.Inv.star R _ α α) S w
proof:
:= by
  rw [← map₂_eval_ι w, twD'_eval, twD'_eval, twD'_eval, twD_sq _ (isPar_liftSp _ hα)]
  refine map₂_twD_congr (FreeGrL.aug R P) (freeEval R P)
    (GrOperad.Inv.isPar_star (isPar_liftSp _ hα) (isPar_liftSp _ hα))
    (isPar_liftSp _ (GrOperad.Inv.isPar_star hα hα)) (fun A _ _ y => ?_) _
  rw [toLin_liftSp, freeEval_ι]
  show toLin ((GrOperad.Inv.appHom (postHom (C := C) (freeEval R P)) _).1 A) y = _
  rw [GrOperad.Inv.appHom_star, appHom_liftSp]

name: Operad.GrComposite.twD'_twD'_eq_zero
statement:
theorem twD'_twD'_eq_zero {α : GrOperad.Inv R (ConvOp R C P)} (hα : GrOperad.Inv.IsPar true α)
    (h : GrOperad.Inv.star R _ α α = 0) (w : GrComposite R C P S) :
    twD' α S (twD' α S w) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [twD'_sq hα, h, twD'_zero]

name: Operad.GrComposite.twD'_mem_outerLt
statement:
theorem twD'_mem_outerLt {β : GrOperad.Inv R (ConvOp R C P)} {p : Bool}
    (hβ : GrOperad.Inv.IsPar p β)
    (hβ1 : ∀ (A : Type) [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A], Fintype.card A = 1 →
      ∀ x : C A, toLin (β.1 A) x = 0)
    {k : ℕ} {x : GrComposite R C P S} (hx : x ∈ outerSpan R C P S k) :
    twD' β S x ∈ outerLt R C P S k
proof:
:=
  map₂_mem_outerSpanP _ (twD_mem_outerLt (FreeGrL.aug R P) (isPar_liftSp _ hβ)
    (fun A _ _ hA y => by rw [toLin_liftSp, hβ1 A hA y, map_zero]) (map₂_mem_outerSpanP _ hx))

name: Operad.GrComposite.twD'_mem_outerLt_of_lt
statement:
lemma twD'_mem_outerLt_of_lt {β : GrOperad.Inv R (ConvOp R C P)} {p : Bool}
    (hβ : GrOperad.Inv.IsPar p β)
    (hβ1 : ∀ (A : Type) [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A], Fintype.card A = 1 →
      ∀ x : C A, toLin (β.1 A) x = 0)
    {k : ℕ} {x : GrComposite R C P S} (hx : x ∈ outerLt R C P S k) :
    twD' β S x ∈ outerLt R C P S k
proof:
:=
  map₂_mem_outerSpanP _ (twD_mem_outerLt_of_lt (FreeGrL.aug R P) (isPar_liftSp _ hβ)
    (fun A _ _ hA y => by rw [toLin_liftSp, hβ1 A hA y, map_zero]) (map₂_mem_outerSpanP _ hx))

name: Operad.GrComposite.twD'_unitOf
statement:
theorem twD'_unitOf [GrCooperad.Coaug R C] {β : GrOperad.Inv R (ConvOp R C P)} {p : Bool}
    (hβ : GrOperad.Inv.IsPar p β)
    (hβ1 : ∀ (A : Type) [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A], Fintype.card A = 1 →
      ∀ x : C A, toLin (β.1 A) x = 0)
    {B : Type} [Fintype B] [DecidableEq B] (z : P B) : twD' β B (unitOf R C P B z) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have h := twD'_mem_outerLt hβ hβ1
    (corolla_mem_outerSpan (R := R) (P := P) (GrCooperad.Coaug.one (R := R) (C := C)))
  rw [Fintype.card_unit, outerLt_one_eq_bot ⟨()⟩, Submodule.mem_bot] at h
  rw [unitOf_apply, twD'_map, twD'_act, h, map_zero, map_zero]

name: Operad.GrComposite.map₂_twD_twD'
statement:
theorem map₂_twD_twD' (ε : GrAug R Q) (g : GrOperadHom R Q P)
    {γ : GrOperad.Inv R (ConvOp R C Q)} {p : Bool} (hγ : GrOperad.Inv.IsPar p γ)
    (w : GrComposite R C Q S) :
    (map₂ idSpHom g.toGrSpeciesHom).app S (twD ε γ S w)
      = twD' (GrOperad.Inv.appHom (postHom (C := C) g) γ) S
          ((map₂ idSpHom g.toGrSpeciesHom).app S w)
proof:
:=
  eq_of_corolla_hom g (fun S _ _ => (map₂ idSpHom g.toGrSpeciesHom).app S ∘ₗ twD ε γ S)
    (fun S _ _ => twD' (GrOperad.Inv.appHom (postHom (C := C) g) γ) S
      ∘ₗ (map₂ idSpHom g.toGrSpeciesHom).app S)
    (fun S S' _ _ _ _ σ w => by
      simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply, twD, twF_map]
      exact (map₂ idSpHom g.toGrSpeciesHom).app_map σ _)
    (fun S S' _ _ _ _ σ w => by
      simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply]
      rw [show (map₂ idSpHom g.toGrSpeciesHom).app S' (map σ w)
        = map σ ((map₂ idSpHom g.toGrSpeciesHom).app S w) from
          (map₂ idSpHom g.toGrSpeciesHom).app_map σ w, twD'_map])
    (fun S Y _ _ _ _ i z w => by simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply, twD, twF_act, map₂_act])
    (fun S Y _ _ _ _ i z w => by simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply, map₂_act, twD'_act])
    (fun A _ _ c => by
      rw [LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearMap.comp_apply, map₂_corolla, twD'_corolla]
      exact map₂_twD_corolla ε (FreeGrL.aug R P) g (freeEval R P) hγ
        (isPar_liftSp _ (isPar_appHom g hγ)) (fun A _ _ y => (freeEval_ι _).symm) c) w

name: Operad.GrComposite.map₂_twD'
statement:
theorem map₂_twD' (g : GrOperadHom R Q P) {β : GrOperad.Inv R (ConvOp R C Q)} {p : Bool}
    (hβ : GrOperad.Inv.IsPar p β) (w : GrComposite R C Q S) :
    (map₂ idSpHom g.toGrSpeciesHom).app S (twD' β S w)
      = twD' (GrOperad.Inv.appHom (postHom (C := C) g) β) S
          ((map₂ idSpHom g.toGrSpeciesHom).app S w)
proof:
:= by
  conv_lhs => rw [← map₂_eval_ι w, twD'_eval, map₂_map₂ _ _
    (g.comp (freeEval R Q)).toGrSpeciesHom (fun _ _ _ _ => rfl), map₂_twD_twD' (FreeGrL.aug R Q)
    _ (isPar_liftSp _ hβ)]
  rw [← map₂_map₂ g.toGrSpeciesHom (freeEval R Q).toGrSpeciesHom
    (g.comp (freeEval R Q)).toGrSpeciesHom (fun _ _ _ _ => rfl), map₂_eval_ι]
  congr 2
  exact Subtype.ext (funext fun A => funext fun _ => funext fun _ =>
    ConvOp.ext fun c => congrArg (g.app A) (freeEval_ι (toLin (β.1 A) c)))

name: Operad.GrComposite.freeEval_freeDer
statement:
lemma freeEval_freeDer {A : Type} [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] (x : FreeGrL R P A) :
    (freeEval R P).app A ((freeDer D).app A x) = D.app A ((freeEval R P).app A x)
proof:
:= by
  have h : evalDer D = derEval D := FreeGrL.der_ext fun A _ _ v => by
    show (freeEval R P).app A ((FreeGrL.derSp D.toSpEnd).app A ((FreeGrL.ι R P).app A v))
      = D.app A ((freeEval R P).app A ((FreeGrL.ι R P).app A v))
    rw [FreeGrL.derSp_ι, freeEval_ι, freeEval_ι]
    rfl
  exact congrArg (fun d : GrDer (freeEval R P) true => d.app A x) h

name: Operad.GrComposite.freeDer_sq
statement:
lemma freeDer_sq (hD : ∀ (A : Type) [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] (x : P A), D.app A (D.app A x) = 0)
    {A : Type} [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] (x : FreeGrL R P A) :
    (freeDer D).app A ((freeDer D).app A x) = 0
proof:
:=
  FreeGrL.sq_eq_zero (fun A _ _ v => by
    rw [FreeGrL.derSp_ι, FreeGrL.derSp_ι]
    show (FreeGrL.ι R P).app A (D.app A (D.app A v)) = 0
    rw [hD, map_zero]) x

name: Operad.GrComposite.appHom_dFam_liftSp
statement:
lemma appHom_dFam_liftSp (α : GrOperad.Inv R (ConvOp R C P)) :
    GrOperad.Inv.appHom (postHom (C := C) (freeEval R P))
      (dFam (freeDer D) (liftSp (FreeGrL.ι R P) α)) = dFam D α
proof:
:=
  Subtype.ext (funext fun A => funext fun _ => funext fun _ => ConvOp.ext fun c => by
    show (freeEval R P).app A ((freeDer D).app A ((FreeGrL.ι R P).app A (toLin (α.1 A) c)))
      = D.app A (toLin (α.1 A) c)
    rw [freeEval_freeDer, freeEval_ι])

name: Operad.GrComposite.twDiff'_eq
statement:
theorem twDiff'_eq (ε : GrAug R P) (α : GrOperad.Inv R (ConvOp R C P)) (S : Type) [Fintype S]
    [DecidableEq S] : twDiff' R C D α S = twDiff R C ε D α S
proof:
:= by
  rw [twDiff', twDiff, twD'_eq ε]

name: Operad.GrComposite.twDiff'_eval
statement:
theorem twDiff'_eval (α : GrOperad.Inv R (ConvOp R C P)) (w : GrComposite R C (FreeGrL R P) S) :
    twDiff' R C D α S ((map₂ idSpHom (freeEval R P).toGrSpeciesHom).app S w)
      = (map₂ idSpHom (freeEval R P).toGrSpeciesHom).app S
          (twDiff R C (FreeGrL.aug R P) (freeDer D) (liftSp (FreeGrL.ι R P) α) S w)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [twDiff', twDiff, LinearMap.add_apply, map_add, twD'_eval]
  rw [map₂_leafMap idSpHom (fun _ _ _ _ => rfl) (freeEval R P).toGrSpeciesHom
    (freeDer D).toSpEnd D.toSpEnd (fun A _ _ y => freeEval_freeDer D y) w]

name: Operad.GrComposite.twDiff'_sq_eq
statement:
theorem twDiff'_sq_eq
    (hD : ∀ (A : Type) [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] (x : P A), D.app A (D.app A x) = 0)
    {α : GrOperad.Inv R (ConvOp R C P)} (hα : GrOperad.Inv.IsPar true α)
    (w : GrComposite R C P S) :
    twDiff' R C D α S (twDiff' R C D α S w)
      = twD' (dFam D α + GrOperad.Inv.star R _ α α) S w
proof:
:= by
  rw [← map₂_eval_ι w, twDiff'_eval, twDiff'_eval,
    twDiff_sq_eq _ _ (fun A _ _ x => freeDer_sq D hD x) (isPar_liftSp _ hα), twD'_eval]
  refine map₂_twD_congr (FreeGrL.aug R P) (freeEval R P)
    (isPar_add' (GrOperad.Inv.isPar_appDer _ (isPar_liftSp _ hα))
      (GrOperad.Inv.isPar_star (isPar_liftSp _ hα) (isPar_liftSp _ hα)))
    (isPar_liftSp _ (isPar_add' (GrOperad.Inv.isPar_appDer _ hα)
      (GrOperad.Inv.isPar_star hα hα))) (fun A _ _ y => ?_) _
  rw [toLin_liftSp, freeEval_ι]
  show toLin ((GrOperad.Inv.appHom (postHom (C := C) (freeEval R P)) _).1 A) y = _
  rw [map_add, GrOperad.Inv.appHom_star, appHom_liftSp, appHom_dFam_liftSp]

name: Operad.GrComposite.twDiff'_sq
statement:
theorem twDiff'_sq
    (hD : ∀ (A : Type) [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] (x : P A), D.app A (D.app A x) = 0)
    {α : GrOperad.Inv R (ConvOp R C P)} (hα : GrOperad.Inv.IsPar true α)
    (hmc : dFam D α + GrOperad.Inv.star R _ α α = 0) (w : GrComposite R C P S) :
    twDiff' R C D α S (twDiff' R C D α S w) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [twDiff'_sq_eq D hD hα, hmc, twD'_zero]

name: Operad.LTree.cons_lt_cons_self_iff
statement: lemma cons_lt_cons_self_iff (c : α) (x y : List α) : c :: x < c :: y ↔ x < y
proof:
:= by
  rw [List.cons_lt_cons_iff]
  simp

name: Operad.LTree.append_lt_append_left_iff
statement: lemma append_lt_append_left_iff (c x y : List α) : c ++ x < c ++ y ↔ x < y
proof:
:= by
  induction c with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons a c ih => rw [List.cons_append, List.cons_append, cons_lt_cons_self_iff, ih]

name: Operad.LTree.append_lt_append_of_length_eq
statement:
lemma append_lt_append_of_length_eq {x y : List α} (hxy : x.length = y.length) (h : x < y)
    (u v : List α) : x ++ u < y ++ v
proof:
:= by
  induction x generalizing y with
  | nil =>
    cases y with
    | nil => exact absurd h (lt_irrefl _)
    | cons => simp at hxy
  | cons a x ih =>
    cases y with
    | nil => simp at hxy
    | cons b y =>
      rw [List.cons_lt_cons_iff] at h
      rw [List.cons_append, List.cons_append, List.cons_lt_cons_iff]
      rcases h with h | ⟨rfl, h⟩
      · exact Or.inl h
      · exact Or.inr ⟨rfl, ih (by simpa using hxy) h⟩

name: Operad.LTree.map_range_lt_iff
statement:
lemma map_range_lt_iff (f g : ℕ → α) (n : ℕ) :
    (List.range n).map f < (List.range n).map g ↔
      ∃ i < n, (∀ j < i, f j = g j) ∧ f i < g i
proof:
:= by
  induction n generalizing f g with
  | zero => simp
  | succ n ih =>
    rw [List.range_succ_eq_map, List.map_cons, List.map_cons, List.map_map, List.map_map,
      List.cons_lt_cons_iff, ih]
    constructor
    · rintro (h | ⟨h0, i, hi, hlt, h⟩)
      · exact ⟨0, n.succ_pos, fun j hj => absurd hj (Nat.not_lt_zero j), h⟩
      · refine ⟨i + 1, by omega, fun j hj => ?_, h⟩
        rcases j with _ | j
        · exact h0
        · exact hlt j (by omega)
    · rintro ⟨i, hi, hlt, h⟩
      rcases i with _ | i
      · exact Or.inl h
      · exact Or.inr ⟨hlt 0 (by omega), i, by omega, fun j hj => hlt (j + 1) (by omega), h⟩

name: Operad.LTree.append_lt_append_of_lengthCoded
statement:
lemma append_lt_append_of_lengthCoded {x y : List ℕ} (hx : LengthCoded x) (hy : LengthCoded y)
    (h : x < y) (u v : List ℕ) : x ++ u < y ++ v
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := hx
  obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := hy
  rw [List.cons_lt_cons_iff] at h
  rw [List.cons_append, List.cons_append, List.cons_lt_cons_iff]
  rcases h with h | ⟨hl, h⟩
  · exact Or.inl h
  · exact Or.inr ⟨hl, append_lt_append_of_length_eq hl h u v⟩

name: Operad.LTree.flatten_lt_flatten_iff
statement:
lemma flatten_lt_flatten_iff {a b : List (List ℕ)} (hab : a.length = b.length)
    (ha : ∀ x ∈ a, LengthCoded x) (hb : ∀ x ∈ b, LengthCoded x) :
    a.flatten < b.flatten ↔ a < b
proof:
:= by
  induction a generalizing b with
  | nil =>
    cases b with
    | nil => simp
    | cons => simp at hab
  | cons x a ih =>
    cases b with
    | nil => simp at hab
    | cons y b =>
      have ha' : ∀ z ∈ a, LengthCoded z := fun z hz => ha z (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hz)
      have hb' : ∀ z ∈ b, LengthCoded z := fun z hz => hb z (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hz)
      have hab' : a.length = b.length := by simpa using hab
      rw [List.flatten_cons, List.flatten_cons, List.cons_lt_cons_iff]
      rcases lt_trichotomy x y with hxy | rfl | hxy
      · simp only [hxy, true_or, iff_true]
        exact append_lt_append_of_lengthCoded (ha x (by simp)) (hb y (by simp)) hxy _ _
      · rw [append_lt_append_left_iff, ih hab' ha' hb']
        simp
      · simp only [not_lt_of_gt hxy, false_or, ne_of_gt hxy, false_and, iff_false]
        exact not_lt_of_gt
          (append_lt_append_of_lengthCoded (hb y (by simp)) (ha x (by simp)) hxy _ _)

name: Operad.LTree.subtreeAt_nil
statement: @[simp] lemma subtreeAt_nil (t : LTree E) : t.subtreeAt [] = t
proof: := by cases t <;> rfl

name: Operad.LTree.replaceAt_nil
statement: @[simp] lemma replaceAt_nil (t u : LTree E) : t.replaceAt [] u = u
proof: := by cases t <;> rfl

name: Operad.LTree.replaceAt_subtreeAt
statement:
lemma replaceAt_subtreeAt : ∀ (t : LTree E) (p : List Bool), t.replaceAt p (t.subtreeAt p) = t
  | leaf _, [] => rfl
  | leaf _, _ :: _ => rfl
  | node _ _ _, [] => rfl
  | node e l r, false :: p => by
    simp only [replaceAt, subtreeAt, replaceAt_subtreeAt l p]
  | node e l r, true :: p => by
    simp only [replaceAt, subtreeAt, replaceAt_subtreeAt r p]

name: Operad.LTree.labels_replaceAt_perm
statement:
lemma labels_replaceAt_perm : ∀ (t : LTree E) (p : List Bool) (u : LTree E),
    (∃ e l r, t.subtreeAt p = node e l r) → u.labels.Perm (t.subtreeAt p).labels →
    (t.replaceAt p u).labels.Perm t.labels
  | leaf _, [], _, _, h => by simpa using h
  | leaf _, _ :: _, _, ⟨_, _, _, h⟩, _ => by simp [subtreeAt] at h
  | node _ _ _, [], _, _, h => by simpa using h
  | node e l r, false :: p, u, hv, h => by
    simp only [replaceAt, labels_node]
    exact (labels_replaceAt_perm l p u hv h).append_right _
  | node e l r, true :: p, u, hv, h => by
    simp only [replaceAt, labels_node]
    exact (labels_replaceAt_perm r p u hv h).append_left _

name: Operad.LTree.labels_subtreeAt_subset
statement:
lemma labels_subtreeAt_subset : ∀ (t : LTree E) (p : List Bool),
    (t.subtreeAt p).labels ⊆ t.labels
  | leaf _, [] => fun _ h => h
  | leaf _, _ :: _ => fun _ h => h
  | node _ _ _, [] => fun _ h => h
  | node _ l _, false :: p => fun _ h => by
    simp only [labels_node, List.mem_append]
    exact Or.inl (labels_subtreeAt_subset l p h)
  | node _ _ r, true :: p => fun _ h => by
    simp only [labels_node, List.mem_append]
    exact Or.inr (labels_subtreeAt_subset r p h)

name: Operad.LTree.path_of_mem_subtreeAt
statement:
lemma path_of_mem_subtreeAt {i : ℕ} : ∀ (t : LTree E) (p : List Bool), t.labels.Nodup →
    i ∈ (t.subtreeAt p).labels → t.path i = t.decAt p ++ (t.subtreeAt p).path i
  | leaf _, [], _, _ => rfl
  | leaf _, _ :: _, _, _ => rfl
  | node _ _ _, [], _, _ => rfl
  | node e l r, false :: p, hnd, hi => by
    have hl : i ∈ l.labels
proof:
:= labels_subtreeAt_subset l p hi
    simp only [path, subtreeAt, decAt, hl, if_true, List.cons_append]
    rw [path_of_mem_subtreeAt l p (List.nodup_append.1 hnd).1 hi]
  | node e l r, true :: p, hnd, hi => by
    have hr : i ∈ r.labels := labels_subtreeAt_subset r p hi
    have hl : i ∉ l.labels := fun hl => (List.nodup_append.1 hnd).2.2 i hl i hr rfl
    simp only [path, subtreeAt, decAt, hl, if_false, List.cons_append]
    rw [path_of_mem_subtreeAt r p (List.nodup_append.1 hnd).2.1 hi]

name: Operad.LTree.path_replaceAt_of_mem
statement:
lemma path_replaceAt_of_mem {i : ℕ} : ∀ (t : LTree E) (p : List Bool) (u : LTree E),
    t.labels.Nodup → (∃ e l r, t.subtreeAt p = node e l r) →
    u.labels.Perm (t.subtreeAt p).labels → i ∈ u.labels →
    (t.replaceAt p u).path i = t.decAt p ++ u.path i
  | leaf _, [], _, _, _, _, _ => rfl
  | leaf _, _ :: _, _, _, ⟨_, _, _, h⟩, _, _ => by simp [subtreeAt] at h
  | node _ _ _, [], _, _, _, _, _ => rfl
  | node e l r, false :: p, u, hnd, hv, hu, hi => by
    have hl : i ∈ (l.replaceAt p u).labels
proof:
:=
      (labels_replaceAt_perm l p u hv hu).symm.subset (labels_subtreeAt_subset l p (hu.subset hi))
    simp only [replaceAt, path, decAt, hl, if_true, List.cons_append]
    rw [path_replaceAt_of_mem l p u (List.nodup_append.1 hnd).1 hv hu hi]
  | node e l r, true :: p, u, hnd, hv, hu, hi => by
    have hr : i ∈ r.labels := labels_subtreeAt_subset r p (hu.subset hi)
    have hl : i ∉ l.labels := fun hl => (List.nodup_append.1 hnd).2.2 i hl i hr rfl
    simp only [replaceAt, path, decAt, hl, if_false, List.cons_append]
    rw [path_replaceAt_of_mem r p u (List.nodup_append.1 hnd).2.1 hv hu hi]

name: Operad.LTree.path_replaceAt_of_not_mem
statement:
lemma path_replaceAt_of_not_mem {i : ℕ} : ∀ (t : LTree E) (p : List Bool) (u : LTree E),
    t.labels.Nodup → (∃ e l r, t.subtreeAt p = node e l r) →
    u.labels.Perm (t.subtreeAt p).labels → i ∈ t.labels → i ∉ (t.subtreeAt p).labels →
    (t.replaceAt p u).path i = t.path i
  | leaf _, [], _, _, _, _, hi, hi' => absurd hi hi'
  | leaf _, _ :: _, _, _, ⟨_, _, _, h⟩, _, _, _ => by simp [subtreeAt] at h
  | node _ _ _, [], _, _, _, _, hi, hi' => absurd hi hi'
  | node e l r, false :: p, u, hnd, hv, hu, hi, hi' => by
    have hp
proof:
:= labels_replaceAt_perm l p u hv hu
    simp only [replaceAt, path]
    by_cases hl : i ∈ l.labels
    · simp only [hp.mem_iff, hl, if_true]
      rw [path_replaceAt_of_not_mem l p u (List.nodup_append.1 hnd).1 hv hu hl hi']
    · simp only [hp.mem_iff, hl, if_false]
  | node e l r, true :: p, u, hnd, hv, hu, hi, hi' => by
    simp only [replaceAt, path]
    by_cases hl : i ∈ l.labels
    · simp only [hl, if_true]
    · have hr : i ∈ r.labels := by
        simp only [labels_node, List.mem_append, hl, false_or] at hi
        exact hi
      simp only [hl, if_false]
      rw [path_replaceAt_of_not_mem r p u (List.nodup_append.1 hnd).2.1 hv hu hr hi']

name: Operad.LTree.labels_plug
statement:
lemma labels_plug (ins : ℕ → LTree E) :
    ∀ m : LTree E, (m.plug ins).labels = m.labels.flatMap fun k => (ins k).labels
  | leaf a => by simp [plug]
  | node e l r => by
    simp only [plug, labels_node, List.flatMap_append, labels_plug ins l, labels_plug ins r]

name: Operad.LTree.path_plug
statement:
lemma path_plug (ins : ℕ → LTree E) {N : ℕ}
    (hdisj : ∀ k < N, ∀ k' < N, k ≠ k' → ∀ i ∈ (ins k).labels, i ∉ (ins k').labels) {i k : ℕ}
    (hk : k < N) (hi : i ∈ (ins k).labels) :
    ∀ m : LTree E, (∀ a ∈ m.labels, a < N) → m.labels.Nodup → k ∈ m.labels →
      (m.plug ins).path i = m.path k ++ (ins k).path i
  | leaf a, _, _, hkm => by
    simp only [labels_leaf, List.mem_singleton] at hkm
    subst hkm
    rfl
  | node e l r, hN, hnd, hkm => by
    have hNl : ∀ a ∈ l.labels, a < N
proof:
:= fun a ha => hN a (by simp [ha])
    have hNr : ∀ a ∈ r.labels, a < N := fun a ha => hN a (by simp [ha])
    have hiff : i ∈ (l.plug ins).labels ↔ k ∈ l.labels := by
      rw [labels_plug, List.mem_flatMap]
      constructor
      · rintro ⟨k', hk', hik'⟩
        by_cases hkk : k = k'
        · exact hkk ▸ hk'
        · exact absurd hik' (hdisj k hk k' (hNl k' hk') hkk i hi)
      · exact fun hk => ⟨k, hk, hi⟩
    simp only [plug, path, hiff]
    by_cases hkl : k ∈ l.labels
    · simp only [hkl, if_true, List.cons_append]
      rw [path_plug ins hdisj hk hi l hNl (List.nodup_append.1 hnd).1 hkl]
    · have hkr : k ∈ r.labels := by
        simp only [labels_node, List.mem_append, hkl, false_or] at hkm
        exact hkm
      simp only [hkl, if_false, List.cons_append]
      rw [path_plug ins hdisj hk hi r hNr (List.nodup_append.1 hnd).2.1 hkr]

name: Operad.LTree.IsEdge.exists_node
statement:
lemma IsEdge.exists_node {t : LTree E} {p : List Bool} {s : Bool} (h : t.IsEdge p s) :
    ∃ e l r, t.subtreeAt p = node e l r
proof:
:= by
  unfold IsEdge at h
  generalize t.subtreeAt p = u at h
  match u, s, h with
  | node e l r, _, _ => exact ⟨e, l, r, rfl⟩

name: Operad.LTree.mem_windows_iff
statement:
theorem mem_windows_iff {w : LTree E} :
    ∀ t : LTree E, w ∈ t.windows ↔ ∃ p s, t.IsEdge p s ∧ t.windowAt p s = w
  | leaf a => by
    simp only [windows, List.not_mem_nil, false_iff, not_exists, not_and]
    intro p s h
    cases p <;> cases s <;> simp [IsEdge, IsEdgeRoot, subtreeAt] at h
  | node e l r => by
    constructor
    · intro hw
      simp only [windows, List.mem_append] at hw
      rcases hw with ((hw | hw) | hw) | hw
      · match l, hw with
        | node f a b, hw =>
          refine ⟨[], false, trivial, ?_⟩
          simp only [List.mem_singleton] at hw
          simp [windowAt, windowRoot, hw]
      · match r, hw with
        | node f a b, hw =>
          refine ⟨[], true, ?_, ?_⟩
          · show IsEdgeRoot (node e l (node f a b)) true
            cases l <;> trivial
          · show windowRoot (node e l (node f a b)) true = w
            simp only [List.mem_singleton] at hw
            cases l <;> simp [windowRoot, hw]
      · obtain ⟨p, s, hp, rfl⟩
proof:
:= (mem_windows_iff l).1 hw
        exact ⟨false :: p, s, hp, rfl⟩
      · obtain ⟨p, s, hp, rfl⟩ := (mem_windows_iff r).1 hw
        exact ⟨true :: p, s, hp, rfl⟩
    · rintro ⟨p, s, hp, rfl⟩
      simp only [windows, List.mem_append]
      rcases p with _ | ⟨_ | _, p⟩
      · rcases s with _ | _
        · match l, hp with
          | leaf _, hp => simp [IsEdge, IsEdgeRoot] at hp
          | node f a b, _ => simp [windowAt, windowRoot]
        · match r, hp with
          | leaf _, hp => cases l <;> simp [IsEdge, IsEdgeRoot] at hp
          | node f a b, _ =>
            left; left; right
            cases l <;> simp [windowAt, windowRoot]
      · exact Or.inl (Or.inr ((mem_windows_iff l).2 ⟨p, s, hp, rfl⟩))
      · exact Or.inr ((mem_windows_iff r).2 ⟨p, s, hp, rfl⟩)

name: Operad.LTree.minLabel_eq_of_perm
statement:
lemma minLabel_eq_of_perm {t u : LTree E} (h : t.labels.Perm u.labels) :
    t.minLabel = u.minLabel
proof:
:=
  le_antisymm (minLabel_le_of_mem t (h.symm.subset (minLabel_mem u)))
    (minLabel_le_of_mem u (h.subset (minLabel_mem t)))

name: Operad.LTree.ne_of_nodup_append
statement:
lemma ne_of_nodup_append {l₁ l₂ : List ℕ} (h : (l₁ ++ l₂).Nodup) {a b : ℕ} (ha : a ∈ l₁)
    (hb : b ∈ l₂) : a ≠ b
proof:
:=
  fun hab => (List.nodup_append.1 h).2.2 a ha b hb hab

name: Operad.LTree.ins3_eq_of_ne
statement: lemma ins3_eq_of_ne {x y z : LTree E} {k : ℕ} (h0 : k ≠ 0) (h1 : k ≠ 1) : ins3 x y z k = z
proof:
:= by
  simp [ins3, h0, h1]

name: Operad.LTree.winSpec
statement:
theorem winSpec {u : LTree E} {s : Bool} (he : u.IsEdgeRoot s) (hs : u.IsShuffle)
    (hnd : u.labels.Nodup) : u.WinSpec s
proof:
:= by
  match u, s, he with
  | node e (node f a b) c, false, _ =>
    obtain ⟨h1, ⟨h2, ha, hb⟩, hc⟩ := hs
    simp only [minLabel_node] at h1
    have hab : a.minLabel < b.minLabel := h2
    have hac : a.minLabel < c.minLabel := by
      rw [min_eq_left hab.le] at h1
      exact h1
    have hbc : b.minLabel ≠ c.minLabel := by
      simp only [labels_node] at hnd
      exact ne_of_nodup_append hnd (List.mem_append.2 (Or.inr (minLabel_mem b))) (minLabel_mem c)
    have e0 : rank3 a.minLabel b.minLabel c.minLabel a.minLabel = 0 := by
      simp only [rank3]
      split_ifs <;> omega
    by_cases hbc' : b.minLabel < c.minLabel
    · have e1 : rank3 a.minLabel b.minLabel c.minLabel b.minLabel = 1 := by
        simp only [rank3]
        split_ifs <;> omega
      have e2 : rank3 a.minLabel b.minLabel c.minLabel c.minLabel = 2 := by
        simp only [rank3]
        split_ifs <;> omega
      refine ⟨fun k => ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
      · simp only [winIns, winInputs, hbc', if_true, ins3]
        split_ifs
        exacts [ha, hb, hc]
      · simpa [winIns, winInputs, hbc', ins3] using hab
      · simp [winIns, winInputs, hbc', ins3]
      · simp [winIns, winInputs, hbc', ins3, List.append_assoc]
      · simp [windowRoot, window, winIns, winInputs, hbc', ins3, plug, e0, e1, e2]
    · have hcb : c.minLabel < b.minLabel := lt_of_le_of_ne (not_lt.1 hbc') (Ne.symm hbc)
      have e1 : rank3 a.minLabel b.minLabel c.minLabel b.minLabel = 2 := by
        simp only [rank3]
        split_ifs <;> omega
      have e2 : rank3 a.minLabel b.minLabel c.minLabel c.minLabel = 1 := by
        simp only [rank3]
        split_ifs <;> omega
      refine ⟨fun k => ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
      · simp only [winIns, winInputs, hbc', if_false, ins3]
        split_ifs
        exacts [ha, hc, hb]
      · simpa [winIns, winInputs, hbc', ins3] using hac
      · simpa [winIns, winInputs, hbc', ins3] using hcb
      · simp only [winIns, winInputs, hbc', if_false, ins3, labels_node, if_true,
          one_ne_zero, OfNat.ofNat_ne_zero, OfNat.ofNat_ne_one, List.append_assoc]
        exact List.Perm.append_left _ List.perm_append_comm
      · simp [windowRoot, window, winIns, winInputs, hbc', ins3, plug, e0, e1, e2]
  | node e c (node f a b), true, _ =>
    obtain ⟨h1, hc, ⟨h2, ha, hb⟩⟩ := hs
    simp only [minLabel_node] at h1
    have hab : a.minLabel < b.minLabel := h2
    rw [min_eq_left hab.le] at h1
    have e0 : rank3 a.minLabel b.minLabel c.minLabel c.minLabel = 0 := by
      simp only [rank3]
      split_ifs <;> omega
    have e1 : rank3 a.minLabel b.minLabel c.minLabel a.minLabel = 1 := by
      simp only [rank3]
      split_ifs <;> omega
    have e2 : rank3 a.minLabel b.minLabel c.minLabel b.minLabel = 2 := by
      simp only [rank3]
      split_ifs <;> omega
    have hw : winInputs (node e c (node f a b)) true = (c, a, b) := by
      cases c <;> rfl
    have hwr : windowRoot (node e c (node f a b)) true
        = window e f true a.minLabel b.minLabel c.minLabel := by
      cases c <;> rfl
    refine ⟨fun k => ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · simp only [winIns, hw, ins3]
      split_ifs
      exacts [hc, ha, hb]
    · simpa [winIns, hw, ins3] using h1
    · simpa [winIns, hw, ins3] using hab
    · simp [winIns, hw, ins3, List.append_assoc]
    · rw [hwr]
      simp [window, winIns, hw, ins3, plug, e0, e1, e2]

name: Operad.LTree.perm_labels_plug
statement:
lemma perm_labels_plug {m : LTree E} (hm : m.labels.Perm (List.range 3)) (ins : ℕ → LTree E) :
    (m.plug ins).labels.Perm ((ins 0).labels ++ (ins 1).labels ++ (ins 2).labels)
proof:
:= by
  rw [labels_plug]
  refine (hm.flatMap_right _).trans ?_
  simp [List.range_succ, List.append_assoc]

name: Operad.LTree.lt_three_of_perm
statement:
lemma lt_three_of_perm {m : LTree E} (hm : m.labels.Perm (List.range 3)) :
    ∀ a ∈ m.labels, a < 3
proof: := fun _ ha => List.mem_range.1 (hm.subset ha)

name: Operad.LTree.minLabel_plug
statement:
lemma minLabel_plug {ins : ℕ → LTree E}
    (hmono : ∀ j k, j < k → k < 3 → (ins j).minLabel < (ins k).minLabel) :
    ∀ m : LTree E, (∀ a ∈ m.labels, a < 3) → (m.plug ins).minLabel = (ins m.minLabel).minLabel
  | leaf _, _ => rfl
  | node e l r, h3 => by
    have hl
proof:
:= minLabel_plug hmono l fun a ha => h3 a (by simp [ha])
    have hr := minLabel_plug hmono r fun a ha => h3 a (by simp [ha])
    have hl3 : l.minLabel < 3 := h3 _ (by simp [minLabel_mem l])
    have hr3 : r.minLabel < 3 := h3 _ (by simp [minLabel_mem r])
    simp only [plug, minLabel_node, hl, hr]
    rcases lt_trichotomy l.minLabel r.minLabel with h | h | h
    · rw [min_eq_left h.le, min_eq_left (hmono _ _ h hr3).le]
    · rw [h, min_self, min_self]
    · rw [min_eq_right h.le, min_eq_right (hmono _ _ h hl3).le]

name: Operad.LTree.isShuffle_plug
statement:
lemma isShuffle_plug {ins : ℕ → LTree E}
    (hmono : ∀ j k, j < k → k < 3 → (ins j).minLabel < (ins k).minLabel)
    (hs : ∀ k < 3, (ins k).IsShuffle) :
    ∀ m : LTree E, m.IsShuffle → (∀ a ∈ m.labels, a < 3) → (m.plug ins).IsShuffle
  | leaf a, _, h3 => hs a (h3 a (by simp))
  | node e l r, ⟨hlr, hl, hr⟩, h3 => by
    have h3l : ∀ a ∈ l.labels, a < 3
proof:
:= fun a ha => h3 a (by simp [ha])
    have h3r : ∀ a ∈ r.labels, a < 3 := fun a ha => h3 a (by simp [ha])
    refine ⟨?_, isShuffle_plug hmono hs l hl h3l, isShuffle_plug hmono hs r hr h3r⟩
    rw [minLabel_plug hmono l h3l, minLabel_plug hmono r h3r]
    exact hmono _ _ hlr (h3r _ (minLabel_mem r))

name: Operad.LTree.isShuffle_subtreeAt
statement:
lemma isShuffle_subtreeAt : ∀ (t : LTree E) (p : List Bool), t.IsShuffle →
    (t.subtreeAt p).IsShuffle
  | leaf _, [], h => h
  | leaf _, _ :: _, h => h
  | node _ _ _, [], h => h
  | node _ l _, false :: p, h => isShuffle_subtreeAt l p h.2.1
  | node _ _ r, true :: p, h => isShuffle_subtreeAt r p h.2.2

name: Operad.LTree.nodup_subtreeAt
statement:
lemma nodup_subtreeAt : ∀ (t : LTree E) (p : List Bool), t.labels.Nodup →
    (t.subtreeAt p).labels.Nodup
  | leaf _, [], h => h
  | leaf _, _ :: _, h => h
  | node _ _ _, [], h => h
  | node _ l _, false :: p, h => nodup_subtreeAt l p (List.nodup_append.1 h).1
  | node _ _ r, true :: p, h => nodup_subtreeAt r p (List.nodup_append.1 h).2.1

name: Operad.LTree.isShuffle_replaceAt
statement:
lemma isShuffle_replaceAt : ∀ (t : LTree E) (p : List Bool) (u : LTree E),
    (∃ e l r, t.subtreeAt p = node e l r) → t.IsShuffle → u.IsShuffle →
    u.labels.Perm (t.subtreeAt p).labels → (t.replaceAt p u).IsShuffle
  | leaf _, [], _, _, _, hu, _ => hu
  | leaf _, _ :: _, _, ⟨_, _, _, h⟩, _, _, _ => by simp [subtreeAt] at h
  | node _ _ _, [], _, _, _, hu, _ => hu
  | node e l r, false :: p, u, hv, ⟨hlr, hl, hr⟩, hu, hp => by
    refine ⟨?_, isShuffle_replaceAt l p u hv hl hu hp, hr⟩
    rw [minLabel_eq_of_perm (labels_replaceAt_perm l p u hv hp)]
    exact hlr
  | node e l r, true :: p, u, hv, ⟨hlr, hl, hr⟩, hu, hp => by
    refine ⟨?_, hl, isShuffle_replaceAt r p u hv hr hu hp⟩
    rw [minLabel_eq_of_perm (labels_replaceAt_perm r p u hv hp)]
    exact hlr

section Subst

variable {t : LTree E} {p : List Bool} {s : Bool}

name: Operad.LTree.WinSpec.mono
statement:
lemma WinSpec.mono {u : LTree E} (h : u.WinSpec s) :
    ∀ j k, j < k → k < 3 → (u.winIns s j).minLabel < (u.winIns s k).minLabel
proof:
:= by
  intro j k hjk hk
  interval_cases k <;> interval_cases j
  · exact h.lt01
  · exact h.lt01.trans h.lt12
  · exact h.lt12

name: Operad.LTree.winSpec_of_edge
statement:
lemma winSpec_of_edge (he : t.IsEdge p s) (hs : t.IsShuffle) (hnd : t.labels.Nodup) :
    (t.subtreeAt p).WinSpec s
proof:
:=
  winSpec he (isShuffle_subtreeAt t p hs) (nodup_subtreeAt t p hnd)

name: Operad.LTree.substAt_windowAt
statement:
theorem substAt_windowAt (he : t.IsEdge p s) (hs : t.IsShuffle) (hnd : t.labels.Nodup) :
    t.substAt p s (t.windowAt p s) = t
proof:
:= by
  rw [substAt, windowAt, (winSpec_of_edge he hs hnd).window, replaceAt_subtreeAt]

name: Operad.LTree.perm_labels_plug_winIns
statement:
lemma perm_labels_plug_winIns (he : t.IsEdge p s) (hs : t.IsShuffle) (hnd : t.labels.Nodup)
    (hm : m.labels.Perm (List.range 3)) :
    (m.plug ((t.subtreeAt p).winIns s)).labels.Perm (t.subtreeAt p).labels
proof:
:=
  (perm_labels_plug hm _).trans (winSpec_of_edge he hs hnd).perm.symm

name: Operad.LTree.perm_labels_substAt
statement:
theorem perm_labels_substAt (he : t.IsEdge p s) (hs : t.IsShuffle) (hnd : t.labels.Nodup)
    (hm : m.labels.Perm (List.range 3)) : (t.substAt p s m).labels.Perm t.labels
proof:
:=
  labels_replaceAt_perm t p _ he.exists_node (perm_labels_plug_winIns he hs hnd hm)

name: Operad.LTree.isShuffle_substAt
statement:
theorem isShuffle_substAt (he : t.IsEdge p s) (hs : t.IsShuffle) (hnd : t.labels.Nodup)
    (hms : m.IsShuffle) (hm : m.labels.Perm (List.range 3)) : (t.substAt p s m).IsShuffle
proof:
:= by
  have hw := winSpec_of_edge he hs hnd
  exact isShuffle_replaceAt t p _ he.exists_node hs
    (isShuffle_plug hw.mono (fun k _ => hw.shuffle k) m hms (lt_three_of_perm hm))
    (perm_labels_plug_winIns he hs hnd hm)

name: Operad.LTree.winIns_disjoint
statement:
lemma winIns_disjoint (he : t.IsEdge p s) (hs : t.IsShuffle) (hnd : t.labels.Nodup) :
    ∀ k < 3, ∀ k' < 3, k ≠ k' → ∀ i ∈ ((t.subtreeAt p).winIns s k).labels,
      i ∉ ((t.subtreeAt p).winIns s k').labels
proof:
:= by
  have hw := winSpec_of_edge he hs hnd
  have hnd' : ((t.subtreeAt p).winIns s 0).labels ++ ((t.subtreeAt p).winIns s 1).labels
      ++ ((t.subtreeAt p).winIns s 2).labels |>.Nodup :=
    hw.perm.nodup_iff.1 (nodup_subtreeAt t p hnd)
  rw [List.nodup_append, List.nodup_append] at hnd'
  obtain ⟨⟨-, -, h01⟩, -, h2⟩ := hnd'
  intro k hk k' hk' hkk' i hi hi'
  interval_cases k <;> interval_cases k'
  all_goals first
    | exact absurd rfl hkk'
    | exact h01 i hi i hi' rfl
    | exact h01 i hi' i hi rfl
    | exact h2 i (List.mem_append.2 (Or.inl hi)) i hi' rfl
    | exact h2 i (List.mem_append.2 (Or.inr hi)) i hi' rfl
    | exact h2 i (List.mem_append.2 (Or.inl hi')) i hi rfl
    | exact h2 i (List.mem_append.2 (Or.inr hi')) i hi rfl

name: Operad.LTree.path_substAt_of_mem
statement:
theorem path_substAt_of_mem (he : t.IsEdge p s) (hs : t.IsShuffle) (hnd : t.labels.Nodup)
    (hm : m.labels.Perm (List.range 3)) {i k : ℕ} (hk : k < 3)
    (hi : i ∈ ((t.subtreeAt p).winIns s k).labels) :
    (t.substAt p s m).path i
      = t.decAt p ++ m.path k ++ ((t.subtreeAt p).winIns s k).path i
proof:
:= by
  have hmem : i ∈ (m.plug ((t.subtreeAt p).winIns s)).labels := by
    rw [labels_plug, List.mem_flatMap]
    exact ⟨k, hm.symm.subset (List.mem_range.2 hk), hi⟩
  rw [substAt, path_replaceAt_of_mem t p _ hnd he.exists_node
    (perm_labels_plug_winIns he hs hnd hm) hmem, List.append_assoc]
  rw [path_plug _ (winIns_disjoint he hs hnd) hk hi m (lt_three_of_perm hm)
    (hm.nodup_iff.2 List.nodup_range) (hm.symm.subset (List.mem_range.2 hk))]

name: Operad.LTree.path_substAt_of_not_mem
statement:
theorem path_substAt_of_not_mem (he : t.IsEdge p s) (hs : t.IsShuffle) (hnd : t.labels.Nodup)
    (hm : m.labels.Perm (List.range 3)) {i : ℕ} (hi : i ∈ t.labels)
    (hi' : i ∉ (t.subtreeAt p).labels) : (t.substAt p s m).path i = t.path i
proof:
:=
  path_replaceAt_of_not_mem t p _ hnd he.exists_node (perm_labels_plug_winIns he hs hnd hm) hi hi'

name: Operad.LTree.lengthCoded_seg
statement: lemma lengthCoded_seg (rk : E → ℕ) (t : LTree E) (i : ℕ) : LengthCoded (seg rk t i)
proof:
:=
  ⟨(t.path i).map rk, by simp [seg]⟩

name: Operad.LTree.pathKey_eq_flatten
statement:
lemma pathKey_eq_flatten (rk : E → ℕ) (n : ℕ) (t : LTree E) :
    pathKey rk n t = ((List.range n).map (seg rk t)).flatten
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.LTree.pathKey_lt_iff
statement:
lemma pathKey_lt_iff (rk : E → ℕ) (n : ℕ) (t t' : LTree E) :
    pathKey rk n t < pathKey rk n t' ↔
      (List.range n).map (seg rk t) < (List.range n).map (seg rk t')
proof:
:= by
  rw [pathKey_eq_flatten, pathKey_eq_flatten]
  refine flatten_lt_flatten_iff (by simp) ?_ ?_ <;>
  · intro x hx
    obtain ⟨i, -, rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.1 hx
    exact lengthCoded_seg rk _ i

name: Operad.LTree.pathKey_substAt_lt
proof:
:= by
  have hnd : t.labels.Nodup := ht.nodup_iff.2 List.nodup_range
  have hw := winSpec_of_edge he hs hnd
  set u := t.subtreeAt p with hu
  set ins := u.winIns s with hins
  rw [pathKey_lt_iff, map_range_lt_iff] at h ⊢
  obtain ⟨k₀, hk₀, heq, hlt⟩ := h
  
  have hmemu : ∀ i ∈ u.labels, ∃ k < 3, i ∈ (ins k).labels := by
    intro i hi
    have := hw.perm.subset hi
    simp only [List.mem_append] at this
    rcases this with (h | h) | h
    · exact ⟨0, by omega, h⟩
    · exact ⟨1, by omega, h⟩
    · exact ⟨2, by omega, h⟩
  have hinsu : ∀ k < 3, ∀ i ∈ (ins k).labels, i ∈ u.labels := by
    intro k hk i hi
    refine hw.perm.symm.subset ?_
    rw [hins] at hi
    interval_cases k <;> simp [hi]
  have hut : ∀ i ∈ u.labels, i ∈ t.labels := fun i hi => labels_subtreeAt_subset t p hi
  
  have hseg : ∀ (m : LTree E), m.labels.Perm (List.range 3) → ∀ k < 3, ∀ i ∈ (ins k).labels,
      seg rk (t.substAt p s m) i
        = ((t.decAt p).length + (m.path k).length + ((ins k).path i).length) ::
          ((t.decAt p).map rk ++ (m.path k).map rk ++ ((ins k).path i).map rk) := by
    intro m hm k hk i hi
    rw [seg, path_substAt_of_mem he hs hnd hm hk hi, ← hu, ← hins]
    simp only [List.length_append, List.map_append, Nat.add_assoc, List.append_assoc]
  set i₀ := (ins k₀).minLabel with hi₀
  have hi₀mem : i₀ ∈ (ins k₀).labels := minLabel_mem _
  refine ⟨i₀, List.mem_range.1 (ht.subset (hut _ (hinsu k₀ hk₀ _ hi₀mem))), ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro j hj
    have hjt : j ∈ t.labels := ht.symm.subset (List.mem_range.2 (by
      have := List.mem_range.1 (ht.subset (hut _ (hinsu k₀ hk₀ _ hi₀mem)))
      omega))
    by_cases hju : j ∈ u.labels
    · obtain ⟨k, hk, hjk⟩ := hmemu j hju
      rcases lt_or_ge k k₀ with hkk | hkk
      · rw [hseg m hm k hk j hjk, hseg m' hm' k hk j hjk]
        have := heq k hkk
        simp only [seg, List.cons.injEq] at this
        rw [this.1, this.2]
      · exfalso
        have h1 : (ins k).minLabel ≤ j := minLabel_le_of_mem _ hjk
        have h2 : (ins k₀).minLabel ≤ (ins k).minLabel := by
          rcases hkk.lt_or_eq with hkk | hkk
          · exact (hw.mono k₀ k hkk hk).le
          · rw [hkk]
        omega
    · rw [seg, seg, path_substAt_of_not_mem he hs hnd hm hjt hju,
        path_substAt_of_not_mem he hs hnd hm' hjt hju]
  · rw [hseg m hm k₀ hk₀ i₀ hi₀mem, hseg m' hm' k₀ hk₀ i₀ hi₀mem]
    simp only [seg] at hlt
    rw [List.cons_lt_cons_iff] at hlt ⊢
    rcases hlt with hlt | ⟨hl, hlt⟩
    · left
      omega
    · right
      refine ⟨by rw [hl], ?_⟩
      rw [List.append_assoc, List.append_assoc, append_lt_append_left_iff]
      exact append_lt_append_of_length_eq (by simp [hl]) hlt _ _

name: Operad.LTree.substAt_mem_monomials
statement:
theorem substAt_mem_monomials (ht : t ∈ monomials n) (he : t.IsEdge p s) {m : LTree E}
    (hm : m ∈ monomials 3) : t.substAt p s m ∈ monomials n
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_monomials] at ht hm ⊢
  have hnd : t.labels.Nodup := ht.2.nodup_iff.2 List.nodup_range
  exact ⟨isShuffle_substAt he ht.1 hnd hm.1 hm.2, (perm_labels_substAt he ht.1 hnd hm.2).trans ht.2⟩

name: Operad.LTree.not_isNormal_iff
statement:
theorem not_isNormal_iff {L : Set (LTree E)} :
    ¬ IsNormal L t ↔ ∃ p s, t.IsEdge p s ∧ t.windowAt p s ∈ L
proof:
:= by
  simp only [IsNormal, not_forall, not_not, mem_windows_iff]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨w, ⟨p, s, he, rfl⟩, hw⟩
    exact ⟨p, s, he, hw⟩
  · rintro ⟨p, s, he, hw⟩
    exact ⟨_, ⟨p, s, he, rfl⟩, hw⟩

name: Operad.LTree.pathKey_substAt_lt'
statement:
theorem pathKey_substAt_lt' (rk : E → ℕ) (ht : t ∈ monomials n) (he : t.IsEdge p s)
    {m m' : LTree E} (hm : m ∈ monomials 3) (hm' : m' ∈ monomials 3)
    (h : pathKey rk 3 m < pathKey rk 3 m') :
    pathKey rk n (t.substAt p s m) < pathKey rk n (t.substAt p s m')
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_monomials] at ht hm hm'
  exact pathKey_substAt_lt rk he ht.1 ht.2 hm.2 hm'.2 h

name: Operad.Sym.ComAlg.act_eq_smul_prod
statement:
lemma act_eq_smul_prod {A : Type} [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] (p : Com R A) (s : A → V) :
    α.act p s = p • prod α s
proof:
:= by
  unfold prod SymAlgebra.act
  conv_lhs => rw [show p = p • (1 : R) by rw [smul_eq_mul, mul_one]]
  rw [map_smul]
  rfl

name: Operad.Sym.ComAlg.prod_relabel
statement:
lemma prod_relabel {A B : Type} [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] [Fintype B] [DecidableEq B]
    (e : A ≃ B) (s : B → V) : prod α (fun a => s (e a)) = prod α s
proof:
:=
  (SymAlgebra.act_map α e (1 : Com R A) s).symm

name: Operad.Sym.ComAlg.prod_comp
statement:
lemma prod_comp {A B : Type} [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] [Fintype B] [DecidableEq B] (i : A)
    (s : Without A i ⊕ B → V) : prod α s = prod α (feed i s (prod α fun b => s (Sum.inr b)))
proof:
:= by
  have h := SymAlgebra.act_comp α i (1 : Com R A) (1 : Com R B) s
  rw [show SymOperad.comp (R := R) i (1 : Com R A) (1 : Com R B)
    = (1 : Com R (Without A i ⊕ B)) from mul_one (1 : R)] at h
  exact h

name: Operad.Sym.ComAlg.prod_unit
statement: lemma prod_unit (s : Unit → V) : prod α s = s ()
proof:
:=
  SymAlgebra.act_one α s

name: Operad.Sym.ComAlg.prod_unique
statement:
lemma prod_unique {A : Type} [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] [Unique A] (s : A → V) :
    prod α s = s default
proof:
:= by
  rw [← prod_relabel α (Equiv.equivPUnit A).symm, prod_unit]
  rfl

name: Operad.Sym.ComAlg.prod_eq_of_forall_eq
statement:
lemma prod_eq_of_forall_eq {A : Type} [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] (a₀ : A) (h : ∀ a, a = a₀)
    (s : A → V) : prod α s = s a₀
proof:
:= by
  letI : Unique A := ⟨⟨a₀⟩, h⟩
  exact prod_unique α s

name: Operad.Sym.ComAlg.prod_congr_empty
statement:
lemma prod_congr_empty {A B : Type} [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] [Fintype B] [DecidableEq B]
    [IsEmpty A] [IsEmpty B] (s : A → V) (t : B → V) : prod α s = prod α t
proof:
:= by
  rw [← prod_relabel α (Equiv.equivOfIsEmpty A B) t]
  congr 1
  funext a
  exact isEmptyElim a

name: Operad.Sym.ComAlg.prod_empty
statement:
lemma prod_empty {A : Type} [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] [IsEmpty A] (s : A → V) :
    prod α s = one α
proof:
:=
  prod_congr_empty α s _

name: Operad.Sym.ComAlg.prod_split
statement:
lemma prod_split {A : Type} [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] (i : A) (s : A → V) :
    prod α s = mul α (s i) (prod α fun a : Without A i => s a.1)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← prod_relabel α (splitEquiv i) s, prod_comp α 1]
  unfold mul
  congr 1
  funext k
  fin_cases k <;> rfl

name: Operad.Sym.ComAlg.mul_comm'
statement: lemma mul_comm' (x y : V) : mul α x y = mul α y x
proof:
:= by
  unfold mul
  rw [← prod_relabel α (Equiv.swap 0 1) ![x, y]]
  congr 1
  funext k
  fin_cases k <;> rfl

name: Operad.Sym.ComAlg.one_mul'
statement: lemma one_mul' (x : V) : mul α (one α) x = x
proof:
:= by
  have h := prod_comp α (B := Fin 0) (0 : Fin 2) fun _ => x
  have hu : ∀ c : Without (Fin 2) 0 ⊕ Fin 0, c = Sum.inl ⟨1, by decide⟩ := by decide
  rw [prod_eq_of_forall_eq α _ hu] at h
  refine Eq.trans ?_ h.symm
  unfold mul one
  congr 1
  funext k
  fin_cases k
  · exact prod_congr_empty α _ _
  · rfl

name: Operad.Sym.ComAlg.mul_one'
statement: lemma mul_one' (x : V) : mul α x (one α) = x
proof:
:= by
  rw [mul_comm', one_mul']

name: Operad.Sym.ComAlg.mul_assoc'
statement: lemma mul_assoc' (x y z : V) : mul α (mul α x y) z = mul α x (mul α y z)
proof:
:= by
  have h0 := prod_split α (0 : Fin 3) ![x, y, z]
  have h2 := prod_split α (2 : Fin 3) ![x, y, z]
  have u0 : ∀ c : Without (Without (Fin 3) 0) ⟨1, by decide⟩, c = ⟨⟨2, by decide⟩, by decide⟩ := by
    decide
  have u2 : ∀ c : Without (Without (Fin 3) 2) ⟨0, by decide⟩, c = ⟨⟨1, by decide⟩, by decide⟩ := by
    decide
  rw [prod_split α (⟨1, by decide⟩ : Without (Fin 3) 0), prod_eq_of_forall_eq α _ u0] at h0
  rw [prod_split α (⟨0, by decide⟩ : Without (Fin 3) 2), prod_eq_of_forall_eq α _ u2] at h2
  rw [mul_comm' α (mul α x y)]
  exact h2.symm.trans h0

name: Operad.Sym.ComAlg.mul_add'
statement: lemma mul_add' (x y z : V) : mul α x (y + z) = mul α x y + mul α x z
proof:
:= by
  unfold mul prod SymAlgebra.act
  have h := (α.app (Fin 2) (1 : Com R (Fin 2))).map_update_add ![x, y] 1 y z
  simp only [show ∀ t : V, update ![x, y] 1 t = ![x, t] from fun t => by
    funext k
    fin_cases k <;> rfl] at h
  exact h

name: Operad.Sym.ComAlg.mul_smul'
statement: lemma mul_smul' (c : R) (x y : V) : mul α x (c • y) = c • mul α x y
proof:
:= by
  unfold mul prod SymAlgebra.act
  have h := (α.app (Fin 2) (1 : Com R (Fin 2))).map_update_smul ![x, y] 1 c y
  simp only [show ∀ t : V, update ![x, y] 1 t = ![x, t] from fun t => by
    funext k
    fin_cases k <;> rfl] at h
  exact h

name: Operad.Sym.ComAlg.mul_zero'
statement: lemma mul_zero' (x : V) : mul α x 0 = 0
proof:
:= by
  have h := mul_smul' α (0 : R) x 0
  rwa [zero_smul, zero_smul] at h

name: Operad.Sym.ComAlg.act_eq_prod
statement:
theorem act_eq_prod {A : Type} [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] (p : Com R A) (s : A → V) :
    letI
proof:
:= toCommRing α
    α.act p s = p • ∏ a, s a := by
  letI := toCommRing α
  rw [act_eq_smul_prod]
  congr 1
  suffices h : ∀ (n : ℕ) (t : Fin n → V), prod α t = ∏ k, t k by
    rw [← prod_relabel α (Fintype.equivFin A).symm, h, Equiv.prod_comp]
  intro n
  induction n with
  | zero =>
    intro t
    rw [prod_empty, Finset.univ_eq_empty, Finset.prod_empty]
    rfl
  | succ n ih =>
    intro t
    rw [prod_split α 0, Fin.prod_univ_succ, ← ih]
    congr 1
    rw [← prod_relabel α (finSuccAboveEquiv (0 : Fin (n + 1)))]
    rfl

name: Operad.Sym.ComAlg.ofCommAlgebra_act
statement:
lemma ofCommAlgebra_act {B : Type} [Fintype B] [DecidableEq B] (p : Com R B) (s : B → A) :
    (ofCommAlgebra R A).act p s = p • ∏ b, s b
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: Operad.Sym.ComAlg.mul_ofCommAlgebra
statement: lemma mul_ofCommAlgebra (x y : A) : mul (ofCommAlgebra R A) x y = x * y
proof:
:= by
  show (1 : R) • ∏ k, ![x, y] k = x * y
  simp

name: Operad.Sym.ComAlg.one_ofCommAlgebra
statement: lemma one_ofCommAlgebra : one (ofCommAlgebra R A) = 1
proof:
:= by
  show (1 : R) • ∏ k, (Fin.elim0 : Fin 0 → A) k = 1
  simp

name: Operad.Sym.ComAlg.ofCommAlgebra_toCommRing
statement: theorem ofCommAlgebra_toCommRing : toCommRing (ofCommAlgebra R A) = ‹CommRing A›
proof:
:= by
  refine CommRing.ext rfl ?_
  funext x y
  exact mul_ofCommAlgebra (R := R) A x y

name: Operad.Sym.ComAlg.toCommRing_ofCommAlgebra
statement:
theorem toCommRing_ofCommAlgebra :
    letI
proof:
:= toCommRing α
    letI := toAlgebra α
    ofCommAlgebra R V = α := by
  letI := toCommRing α
  letI := toAlgebra α
  exact SymOperadHom.ext fun B _ _ p => MultilinearMap.ext fun s => (act_eq_prod α p s).symm

name: Operad.Schur.act_com
statement:
lemma act_com {A : Type} [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] (p : Com R A) (s : A → Schur R (Com R) V) :
    act p s = p • ∏ a, s a
proof:
:=
  ComAlg.act_eq_prod (algebra R (Com R) V) p s

name: Operad.Schur.isSymmetricAlgebra_com
statement: theorem isSymmetricAlgebra_com : IsSymmetricAlgebra (ι R (Com R) V)
proof:
:= by
  let G : Schur R (Com R) V →ₐ[R] SymmetricAlgebra R V :=
    algHomOf (liftHom (ComAlg.ofCommAlgebra R (SymmetricAlgebra R V)) (SymmetricAlgebra.ι R V))
  let L : SymmetricAlgebra R V →ₐ[R] Schur R (Com R) V := SymmetricAlgebra.lift (ι R (Com R) V)
  have hGL : G.comp L = AlgHom.id R (SymmetricAlgebra R V) := by
    refine SymmetricAlgebra.algHom_ext (LinearMap.ext fun v => ?_)
    show G (L (SymmetricAlgebra.ι R V v)) = SymmetricAlgebra.ι R V v
    rw [SymmetricAlgebra.lift_ι_apply]
    exact liftHom_ι _ _ v
  have hLG : L.comp G = AlgHom.id R (Schur R (Com R) V) := by
    have h := algHom_ext (F := comHom (L.comp G)) (G := comHom (AlgHom.id R _)) fun v => by
      show L (G (ι R (Com R) V v)) = ι R (Com R) V v
      rw [show G (ι R (Com R) V v) = SymmetricAlgebra.ι R V v from liftHom_ι _ _ v,
        SymmetricAlgebra.lift_ι_apply]
    exact AlgHom.ext fun x => congrArg (fun F => F.toLinearMap x) h
  refine ⟨fun x y hxy => ?_, fun y => ⟨G y, congrArg (fun F => F y) hLG⟩⟩
  have hx : G (L x) = x := congrArg (fun F => F x) hGL
  have hy : G (L y) = y := congrArg (fun F => F y) hGL
  rw [← hx, ← hy]
  exact congrArg G hxy

name: Operad.GrComposite.extOwner_extEquiv
statement:
lemma extOwner_extEquiv :
    actOwner (Y := Fib f a₀) (extOwner f a₀) (Sum.inr ()) ∘ (extEquiv f a₀).symm = f
proof:
:= by
  funext s
  by_cases h : f s = a₀
  · simp [extEquiv, h, actOwner, extOwner]
  · simp [extEquiv, h, actOwner, extOwner]

name: Operad.GrComposite.map_act_ext
statement:
lemma map_act_ext (L : LinOrd A) (w : V A) (f : S → A) (yy : ∀ a, C (Fib f a)) (c : A → Bool)
    (hyy : ∀ a, GrOperad.par (R := R) (c a) (yy a) = yy a) (a₀ : A) :
    map (extEquiv f a₀) (act R V (Sum.inr ()) (yy a₀)
        (mk R (ownGen L w (extOwner f a₀) (extY (R := R) f yy a₀))))
      = (∏ a, σ R ((c a₀ && ltB L a₀ a) && c a)) • mk R (ownGen L w f yy)
proof:
:= by
  rw [act_mk_ownGen, actOwn_hom L w _ _ _ (yy a₀) (hyy a₀), map_mk_ownGen,
    mk_ownGen_congr _ w (extOwner_extEquiv f a₀)]
  have hS := (mkY (R := R) (ownGen L w f yy)).map_smul_univ
    (fun a => σ R ((c a₀ && ltB L a₀ a) && c a)) yy
  refine Eq.trans ?_ hS
  show mk R (ownGen L w f _) = mk R (ownGen L w f fun a => _ • yy a)
  congr 2
  funext a
  show GrOperad.map (R := R) _ (GrOperad.map (R := R) _ (actLin (R := R) L (extOwner f a₀)
      (Sum.inr ()) (yy a₀) (c a₀) a (extY (R := R) f yy a₀ a))) = _
  by_cases h : a₀ = a
  · subst h
    have h1 := GrOperad.one_comp (R := R) (yy a₀)
    rw [actLin_eq L (extOwner f a₀) (Sum.inr ()) (yy a₀) (c a₀) a₀ rfl, extY, dif_pos rfl,
      GrOperad.comp_map_left (extUnit f a₀ rfl) () ⟨Sum.inr (), rfl⟩ rfl,
      show GrOperad.comp (R := R) () (GrOperad.one (R := R)) (yy a₀)
        = GrOperad.map (R := R) (leftUnitEquiv (Fib f a₀)).symm (yy a₀) by
          conv_rhs => rw [← h1]
          rw [← GrOperad.map_trans, Equiv.self_trans_symm, GrOperad.map_refl],
      ltB_self, Bool.and_false, Bool.false_and, σ_false, one_smul]
    simp only [← GrOperad.map_trans]
    refine (gmap_congr (e' := Equiv.refl _) ?_ _).trans (GrOperad.map_refl _)
    intro t
    exact Subtype.ext rfl
  · have hv : GrOperad.par (R := R) (c a) (GrOperad.map (R := R) (actNe (Y := Fib f a₀)
        (extOwner f a₀) (Sum.inr ()) a h) (GrOperad.map (R := R) (extIncl f a₀ h) (yy a)))
        = GrOperad.map (R := R) (actNe (Y := Fib f a₀) (extOwner f a₀) (Sum.inr ()) a h)
          (GrOperad.map (R := R) (extIncl f a₀ h) (yy a)) := by
      rw [← GrOperad.map_par, ← GrOperad.map_par, hyy]
    rw [actLin_ne L (extOwner f a₀) (Sum.inr ()) (yy a₀) (c a₀) a h, extY, dif_neg h,
      GrOperad.tw_hom _ hv, map_smul, map_smul]
    congr 1
    simp only [← GrOperad.map_trans]
    refine (gmap_congr (e' := Equiv.refl _) ?_ _).trans (GrOperad.map_refl _)
    intro t
    exact Subtype.ext rfl

name: Operad.GrComposite.induction_units
statement:
lemma induction_units {S A : Type} [Fintype S] [DecidableEq S] [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A]
    (hcorA : ∀ w : V A, Pr A (corolla R C A w))
    (L : LinOrd A) (w : V A) (f : S → A) (yy : ∀ a, C (Fib f a)) (e : ∀ a, Unit ≃ Fib f a)
    (he : ∀ a, yy a = GrOperad.map (R := R) (e a) (GrOperad.one (R := R))) :
    Pr S (mk R (ownGen L w f yy))
proof:
:= by
  let τ : A ≃ S := ⟨fun a => (e a ()).1, f, fun a => (e a ()).2, fun s => by
    show ((e (f s)) ()).1 = s
    rw [show (e (f s)) () = ⟨s, rfl⟩ from by rw [← (e (f s)).apply_symm_apply ⟨s, rfl⟩]]⟩
  have h1 := hmap A S τ _ (hcorA w)
  rw [corolla_apply, map_mk, show (corGen (C := C) (R := R) (ordOf A) w (Equiv.refl A)).relabel τ
      = corGen (C := C) (R := R) (ordOf A) w τ from rfl,
    mk_corGen_reorder (C := C) (R := R) (ordOf A) L w τ,
    ← mk_inner (corGen (C := C) (R := R) L w τ) e] at h1
  convert h1 using 3
  · exact funext he
  · refine Equiv.ext fun x => ?_
    obtain ⟨a, t, ht⟩ := x
    show t = (e a ((e a).symm ⟨t, ht⟩)).1
    rw [Equiv.apply_symm_apply]

name: Operad.GrComposite.induction_finset
statement:
lemma induction_finset {A : Type} [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A]
    (hcorA : ∀ w : V A, Pr A (corolla R C A w)) (L : LinOrd A) (w : V A) (F : Finset A) :
    ∀ (S : Type) [Fintype S] [DecidableEq S] (f : S → A)
    (yy : ∀ a, C (Fib f a)) (c : A → Bool), (∀ a, GrOperad.par (R := R) (c a) (yy a) = yy a) →
    (∀ a ∉ F, ∃ e : Unit ≃ Fib f a, yy a = GrOperad.map (R := R) e (GrOperad.one (R := R))) →
    Pr S (mk R (ownGen L w f yy))
proof:
:= by
  induction F using Finset.induction_on with
  | empty =>
    intro S _ _ f yy c _ hu
    choose e he using fun a => hu a (Finset.notMem_empty a)
    exact induction_units Pr hmap hcorA L w f yy e he
  | insert a₀ F ha₀ ih =>
    intro S _ _ f yy c hyy hu
    have h1 := ih (Ext f a₀) (extOwner f a₀) (extY (R := R) f yy a₀) (update c a₀ false)
      (fun a => by
        by_cases h : a₀ = a
        · subst h
          rw [update_self, extY, dif_pos rfl, ← GrOperad.map_par, GrOperad.par_one]
        · rw [update_of_ne (Ne.symm h), extY, dif_neg h, ← GrOperad.map_par, hyy])
      (fun a ha => by
        by_cases h : a₀ = a
        · exact ⟨extUnit f a₀ h, by rw [extY, dif_pos h]⟩
        · obtain ⟨e, he⟩ := hu a (by simp [Finset.mem_insert, Ne.symm h, ha])
          exact ⟨e.trans (extIncl f a₀ h), by rw [extY, dif_neg h, he, GrOperad.map_trans]⟩)
    have h2 := hmap _ S (extEquiv f a₀) _ (hact _ _ (Sum.inr ()) (yy a₀) _ h1)
    rw [map_act_ext L w f yy c hyy a₀] at h2
    have h3 := hsmul S (∏ a, σ R ((c a₀ && ltB L a₀ a) && c a)) _ h2
    rwa [smul_smul, ← Finset.prod_mul_distrib, Finset.prod_congr rfl fun a _ => σ_mul_self R _,
      Finset.prod_const_one, one_smul] at h3

name: Operad.GrComposite.induction_act
statement:
theorem induction_act {S : Type} [Fintype S] [DecidableEq S] (x : GrComposite R V C S) :
    Pr S x
proof:
:= by
  induction x using induction_on with
  | h0 => exact h0 S
  | hadd x y hx hy => exact hadd S x y hx hy
  | hsmul r x hx => exact hsmul S r x hx
  | hmk g =>
    rw [mk_eq_sum (R := R) g]
    refine Finset.sum_induction _ (Pr S) (hadd S) (h0 S) fun p _ => ?_
    refine Finset.sum_induction _ (Pr S) (hadd S) (h0 S) fun c _ => ?_
    rw [mk_eq_ownGen (R := R) (parGen (R := R) g p c)]
    refine induction_finset Pr hsmul hmap hact (hcor _) _ _ Finset.univ S _ _ c (fun a => ?_)
      (fun a ha => absurd (Finset.mem_univ a) ha)
    show GrOperad.par (R := R) (c a) (GrOperad.map (R := R) _ (GrSpecies.par (R := R) (c a)
      (g.y a))) = _
    rw [← GrOperad.map_par]
    exact congrArg _ (GrOperad.par_par_self (R := R) (c a) (g.y a))

name: Operad.GrComposite.induction_card
statement:
theorem induction_card {k : ℕ}
    (hcorK : ∀ (A : Type) [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] (w : V A), Fintype.card A = k →
      Pr A (corolla R C A w))
    {S : Type} [Fintype S] [DecidableEq S] (g : GrCompGen V C S) (hg : Fintype.card g.A = k) :
    Pr S (mk R g)
proof:
:= by
  rw [mk_eq_sum (R := R) g]
  refine Finset.sum_induction _ (Pr S) (hadd S) (h0 S) fun p _ => ?_
  refine Finset.sum_induction _ (Pr S) (hadd S) (h0 S) fun c _ => ?_
  rw [mk_eq_ownGen (R := R) (parGen (R := R) g p c)]
  refine induction_finset Pr hsmul hmap hact (fun w => hcorK _ w hg) _ _ Finset.univ S _ _ c
    (fun a => ?_) (fun a ha => absurd (Finset.mem_univ a) ha)
  show GrOperad.par (R := R) (c a) (GrOperad.map (R := R) _ (GrSpecies.par (R := R) (c a)
    (g.y a))) = _
  rw [← GrOperad.map_par]
  exact congrArg _ (GrOperad.par_par_self (R := R) (c a) (g.y a))

name: Operad.SymSuboperad.incl_app
statement: @[simp] lemma incl_app (x : S.Op A) : S.incl.app A x = x.1
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.SymSuboperad.mem_comap
statement:
@[simp] lemma mem_comap (φ : SymOperadHom R Q P) (x : Q A) :
    x ∈ (S.comap φ).sub A ↔ φ.app A x ∈ S.sub A
proof: := Iff.rfl

name: Operad.SymSuboperad.mem_of_gen
statement:
theorem mem_of_gen (S : SymSuboperad R (Lin R (FreeSet T)))
    (h : ∀ n (g : T n), Finsupp.single (Pres.gen g) 1 ∈ S.sub (Fin n))
    {A : Type} [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] (x : Lin R (FreeSet T) A) : x ∈ S.sub A
proof:
:= by
  let Φ : SymOperadHom R (Lin R (FreeSet T)) S.Op :=
    linHomEquiv R (FreeSet.homEquiv.symm fun n g => Und.of R S.Op ⟨_, h n g⟩)
  have hΦ : S.incl.comp Φ = SymOperadHom.id := Pres.lin_hom_ext fun n g => by
    show ((Finsupp.lift _ R _ _ (Finsupp.single (Pres.gen g) 1) : S.Op (Fin n)) :
      Lin R (FreeSet T) (Fin n)) = _
    simp only [Finsupp.lift_apply, Finsupp.sum_single_index, zero_smul, one_smul]
    rfl
  have := congrArg (fun φ : SymOperadHom R (Lin R (FreeSet T)) (Lin R (FreeSet T)) =>
    φ.app A x) hΦ
  simp only [SymOperadHom.comp_app, incl_app] at this
  rw [show x = (Φ.app A x).1 from this.symm]
  exact (Φ.app A x).2

name: Operad.SymSuboperad.mem_of_presGen
statement:
theorem mem_of_presGen {r : ∀ n : ℕ, Set (Lin R (FreeSet T) (Fin n))}
    (S : SymSuboperad R (SymOperadIdeal.span R r).Quot)
    (h : ∀ n (g : T n),
      (SymOperadIdeal.span R r).proj _ (Finsupp.single (Pres.gen g) 1) ∈ S.sub (Fin n))
    {A : Type} [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] (x : (SymOperadIdeal.span R r).Quot A) :
    x ∈ S.sub A
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := (SymOperadIdeal.span R r).proj_surjective A x
  exact mem_of_gen (S.comap (SymOperadIdeal.span R r).projHom) h y

name: Operad.TConv.outerSlice_apply
statement:
@[simp] lemma outerSlice_apply (a b : ℕ) {n : ℕ} (t₂ : OfArity E n) (x : Chain R E (a + n + b))
    (t₁ : OfArity E (a + 1 + b)) : outerSlice a b t₂ x t₁ = x (OfArity.graft a b t₁ t₂)
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.TConv.innerSlice_apply
statement:
@[simp] lemma innerSlice_apply (a b : ℕ) {n : ℕ} (t₁ : OfArity E (a + 1 + b))
    (x : Chain R E (a + n + b)) (t₂ : OfArity E n) :
    innerSlice a b t₁ x t₂ = x (OfArity.graft a b t₁ t₂)
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.TConv.koszulDual_two
statement: lemma koszulDual_two (Rel : Submodule R (Chain R E 3)) : koszulDual Rel 2 = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  rw [koszulDual]

name: Operad.TConv.koszulDual_one
statement: lemma koszulDual_one (Rel : Submodule R (Chain R E 3)) : koszulDual Rel 1 = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  rw [koszulDual]

name: Operad.TConv.koszulDual_three
statement: lemma koszulDual_three (Rel : Submodule R (Chain R E 3)) : koszulDual Rel 3 = Rel
proof:
:= by
  rw [koszulDual]

name: Operad.TConv.mem_koszulDual_add_four
statement:
lemma mem_koszulDual_add_four (Rel : Submodule R (Chain R E 3)) (m : ℕ)
    (x : Chain R E (m + 4)) :
    x ∈ koszulDual Rel (m + 4) ↔ ∀ (a b k : ℕ) (h : a + k + b = m + 4), 2 ≤ k → 1 ≤ a + b →
      (∀ t₂ : OfArity E k, outerSlice a b t₂ (fun t => x (OfArity.cast h t))
        ∈ koszulDual Rel (a + 1 + b)) ∧
      (∀ t₁ : OfArity E (a + 1 + b), innerSlice a b t₁ (fun t => x (OfArity.cast h t))
        ∈ koszulDual Rel k)
proof:
:= by
  rw [koszulDual]
  rfl

name: Operad.TConv.mem_koszulDual_of_le_two
statement:
lemma mem_koszulDual_of_le_two (Rel : Submodule R (Chain R E 3)) {n : ℕ} (hn : n ≤ 2)
    (x : Chain R E n) : x ∈ koszulDual Rel n
proof:
:= by
  rcases (show n = 0 ∨ n = 1 ∨ n = 2 by omega) with rfl | rfl | rfl <;>
    (rw [koszulDual]; exact Submodule.mem_top)

name: Operad.TConv.slice_trivial_outer
statement:
lemma slice_trivial_outer (a b : ℕ) (x : Chain R E (a + 1 + b)) :
    outerSlice (R := R) a b OfArity.one x = x
proof:
:= by
  funext t₁
  rw [outerSlice_apply]
  congr 1
  exact Subtype.ext (graft_leaf_right t₁.1 a)

name: Operad.TConv.mem_koszulDual_cast
statement:
lemma mem_koszulDual_cast (Rel : Submodule R (Chain R E 3)) {m n : ℕ} (h : m = n)
    {x : Chain R E n} (hx : x ∈ koszulDual Rel n) :
    (fun t => x (OfArity.cast h t)) ∈ koszulDual Rel m
proof:
:= by
  subst h
  exact hx

name: Operad.TConv.koszulDual_sliceClosed
statement:
theorem koszulDual_sliceClosed (Rel : Submodule R (Chain R E 3)) :
    SliceClosed R E (koszulDual Rel) where
  outer {a b n x} hx t₂
proof:
:= by
    by_cases hn : n = 1
    · subst hn
      have ht₂ : t₂ = OfArity.one := eq_one t₂
      subst ht₂
      rw [slice_trivial_outer]
      exact hx
    by_cases hab : a + b = 0
    · exact mem_koszulDual_of_le_two Rel (by omega) _
    have hn2 : 2 ≤ n := by
      have := t₂.2
      have := arity_pos t₂.1
      omega
    by_cases hbig : a + n + b ≤ 3
    · exact mem_koszulDual_of_le_two Rel (by omega) _
    obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ : ∃ m, a + n + b = m + 4 := ⟨a + n + b - 4, by omega⟩
    have hx' : (fun t : OfArity E (m + 4) => x (OfArity.cast hm.symm t))
        ∈ koszulDual Rel (m + 4) := mem_koszulDual_cast Rel hm.symm hx
    rw [mem_koszulDual_add_four] at hx'
    have := (hx' a b n hm hn2 (by omega)).1 t₂
    simpa using this
  inner {a b n x} hx t₁ := by
    by_cases hab : a + b = 0
    · have ha : a = 0 := by omega
      have hb : b = 0 := by omega
      subst ha
      subst hb
      have ht₁ : t₁ = OfArity.cast (by omega) (OfArity.one (E := E)) := Subtype.ext
        (eq_leaf_of_arity_eq_one (by rw [t₁.2]))
      subst ht₁
      have : innerSlice (R := R) 0 0 (OfArity.cast (by omega) OfArity.one) x
          = fun t => x (OfArity.cast (by omega) t) := by
        funext t₂
        rw [innerSlice_apply]
        congr 1
      rw [this]
      exact mem_koszulDual_cast Rel (by omega) hx
    by_cases hn : n ≤ 2
    · exact mem_koszulDual_of_le_two Rel hn _
    by_cases hbig : a + n + b ≤ 3
    · exfalso
      omega
    obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ : ∃ m, a + n + b = m + 4 := ⟨a + n + b - 4, by omega⟩
    have hx' : (fun t : OfArity E (m + 4) => x (OfArity.cast hm.symm t))
        ∈ koszulDual Rel (m + 4) := mem_koszulDual_cast Rel hm.symm hx
    rw [mem_koszulDual_add_four] at hx'
    have := (hx' a b n hm (by omega) (by omega)).2 t₁
    simpa using this

name: Operad.TConv.eval_apply
statement:
lemma eval_apply {n : ℕ} (f : TConv R E Q n) (x : Chain R E n) :
    eval f x = ∑ t, x t • f t
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.TConv.eval_add
statement:
lemma eval_add {n : ℕ} (f g : TConv R E Q n) (x : Chain R E n) :
    eval (f + g) x = eval f x + eval g x
proof:
:= by
  simp only [eval_apply, Pi.add_apply, smul_add, Finset.sum_add_distrib]

name: Operad.TConv.eval_smul
statement:
lemma eval_smul {n : ℕ} (c : R) (f : TConv R E Q n) (x : Chain R E n) :
    eval (c • f) x = c • eval f x
proof:
:= by
  simp only [eval_apply, Pi.smul_apply, Finset.smul_sum, smul_comm c]

name: Operad.TConv.eval_neg
statement: lemma eval_neg {n : ℕ} (f : TConv R E Q n) (x : Chain R E n) : eval (-f) x = -eval f x
proof:
:= by
  simp only [eval_apply, Pi.neg_apply, smul_neg, Finset.sum_neg_distrib]

name: Operad.TConv.eval_sub
statement:
lemma eval_sub {n : ℕ} (f g : TConv R E Q n) (x : Chain R E n) :
    eval (f - g) x = eval f x - eval g x
proof:
:= by
  simp only [eval_apply, Pi.sub_apply, smul_sub, Finset.sum_sub_distrib]

name: Operad.TConv.eval_zero
statement: @[simp] lemma eval_zero {n : ℕ} (x : Chain R E n) : eval (0 : TConv R E Q n) x = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp [eval_apply]

name: Operad.TConv.eval_single
statement:
lemma eval_single {n : ℕ} (f : TConv R E Q n) (t : OfArity E n) (r : R) :
    eval f (Pi.single t r) = r • f t
proof:
:= by
  rw [eval_apply, Finset.sum_eq_single t]
  · rw [Pi.single_eq_same]
  · intro s _ hs
    rw [Pi.single_eq_of_ne hs, zero_smul]
  · intro h
    exact absurd (Finset.mem_univ t) h

name: Operad.TConv.ext_eval
statement: lemma ext_eval {n : ℕ} {f g : TConv R E Q n} (h : ∀ x, eval f x = eval g x) : f = g
proof:
:=
  funext fun t => by simpa [eval_single] using h (Pi.single t 1)

name: Operad.TConv.eval_comp_pairs
statement:
lemma eval_comp_pairs (a b : ℕ) {n : ℕ} (f : TConv R E Q (a + 1 + b)) (g : TConv R E Q n)
    (x : Chain R E (a + n + b)) :
    eval (compL a b f g) x = ∑ p : OfArity E (a + 1 + b) × OfArity E n,
      x (OfArity.graft a b p.1 p.2) • NSOperad.comp (R := R) a b (f p.1) (g p.2)
proof:
:= by
  rw [eval_apply]
  refine (Fintype.sum_of_injective (fun p : OfArity E (a + 1 + b) × OfArity E n =>
      OfArity.graft a b p.1 p.2) (fun p q h => ?_) _ _ (fun t ht => ?_) (fun p => ?_)).symm
  · obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := OfArity.graft_inj a b h
    exact Prod.ext h1 h2
  · rw [compL_apply, compFun_eq_zero a b f g (fun t₁ t₂ h => ht ⟨(t₁, t₂), Subtype.ext h⟩),
      smul_zero]
  · rw [compL_apply, compFun_eq a b f g p.1 p.2 rfl]

name: Operad.TConv.eval_comp_outer
statement:
theorem eval_comp_outer (a b : ℕ) {n : ℕ} (f : TConv R E Q (a + 1 + b)) (g : TConv R E Q n)
    (x : Chain R E (a + n + b)) :
    eval (compL a b f g) x
      = ∑ t₂, NSOperad.comp (R := R) a b (eval f (outerSlice a b t₂ x)) (g t₂)
proof:
:= by
  rw [eval_comp_pairs, Fintype.sum_prod_type_right]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun t₂ _ => ?_
  rw [eval_apply, map_sum, LinearMap.sum_apply]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun t₁ _ => ?_
  rw [map_smul, LinearMap.smul_apply, outerSlice_apply]

name: Operad.TConv.eval_comp_inner
statement:
theorem eval_comp_inner (a b : ℕ) {n : ℕ} (f : TConv R E Q (a + 1 + b)) (g : TConv R E Q n)
    (x : Chain R E (a + n + b)) :
    eval (compL a b f g) x
      = ∑ t₁, NSOperad.comp (R := R) a b (f t₁) (eval g (innerSlice a b t₁ x))
proof:
:= by
  rw [eval_comp_pairs, Fintype.sum_prod_type]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun t₁ _ => ?_
  rw [eval_apply, map_sum]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun t₂ _ => ?_
  rw [map_smul, innerSlice_apply]

name: Operad.TConv.mem_ann
statement:
lemma mem_ann {C : ∀ n, Submodule R (Chain R E n)} (hC : SliceClosed R E C) {n : ℕ}
    (f : TConv R E Q n) : f ∈ (ann Q hC).carrier n ↔ ∀ x ∈ C n, eval f x = 0
proof: := Iff.rfl

name: Operad.Cobar.ιL_apply
statement:
lemma ιL_apply (x : C A) :
    ιL R C A x = (FreeGrL.ι R (CobarGen R C)).app A
      (GrSpecies.Shift.of (R := R) (V := GrCooperad.Red R C) A (GrCooperad.Red.proj R C A x))
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: Operad.Cobar.ιL_map
statement:
lemma ιL_map (e : A ≃ B) (x : C A) :
    ιL R C B (SymSpecies.map (R := R) e x) = GrOperad.map (R := R) e (ιL R C A x)
proof:
:= by
  rw [ιL_apply, ιL_apply, ← GrCooperad.Red.map_proj, ← GrSpecies.Shift.map_of]
  exact (FreeGrL.ι R (CobarGen R C)).app_map e _

name: Operad.Cobar.ιL_par
statement:
lemma ιL_par (c : Bool) (x : C A) :
    ιL R C A (GrSpecies.par (R := R) c x) = GrOperad.par (R := R) (!c) (ιL R C A x)
proof:
:= by
  rw [ιL_apply, ιL_apply, ← GrCooperad.Red.par_proj]
  have h : GrSpecies.Shift.of (R := R) (V := GrCooperad.Red R C) A
      (GrSpecies.par (R := R) c (GrCooperad.Red.proj R C A x))
      = GrSpecies.par (R := R) (!c) (GrSpecies.Shift.of (R := R) (V := GrCooperad.Red R C) A
          (GrCooperad.Red.proj R C A x)) := by
    rw [GrSpecies.Shift.par_of, Bool.not_not]
  rw [h]
  exact (FreeGrL.ι R (CobarGen R C)).app_par _ _

name: Operad.Cobar.ιL_unitSpan
statement: lemma ιL_unitSpan {x : C A} (hx : x ∈ GrCooperad.unitSpan R C A) : ιL R C A x = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [ιL_apply, show GrCooperad.Red.proj R C A x = 0 from
    (Submodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero _).2 hx, map_zero, map_zero]

name: Operad.Cobar.ι_apply
statement:
lemma ι_apply (A : Type) [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] :
    (ι R C).1 A = ConvOp.of (ιL R C A)
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.Cobar.isPar_ι
statement: lemma isPar_ι : GrOperad.Inv.IsPar true (ι R C)
proof:
:= by
  intro A _ _
  show ConvOp.parC true (ConvOp.of (ιL R C A)) = ConvOp.of (ιL R C A)
  rw [ConvOp.parC_eq_self_iff]
  intro c x
  rw [ConvOp.toLin_of, ιL_par, Bool.xor_true]

name: Operad.Cobar.isPar_ιι
statement: lemma isPar_ιι : GrOperad.Inv.IsPar false (ιι R C)
proof:
:= by
  have h := GrOperad.Inv.isPar_star (isPar_ι R C) (isPar_ι R C)
  rwa [Bool.xor_self] at h

name: Operad.Cobar.kap_ι_unit
statement:
lemma kap_ι_unit {D : Type} [Fintype D] [DecidableEq D] (f : ConvOp R C (CobarGr R C) D)
    (a : C D) {b : C A} (hb : b ∈ GrCooperad.unitSpan R C A) :
    ConvOp.kap f ((ι R C).1 A) (a ⊗ₜ b) = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp only [ConvOp.kap, LinearMap.coe_sum, Finset.sum_apply, TensorProduct.map_tmul]
  refine Finset.sum_eq_zero fun q _ => ?_
  rw [ConvOp.parC_apply]
  have : ∀ c : Bool, ConvOp.toLin ((ι R C).1 A) (GrSpecies.par (R := R) c b) = 0 := fun c =>
    ιL_unitSpan R C (GrCooperad.unitSpan_le_comap_par c hb)
  simp [this]

name: Operad.Cobar.star_ι_ι_unit
statement:
lemma star_ι_ι_unit {x : C A} (hx : x ∈ GrCooperad.unitSpan R C A) :
    ConvOp.toLin ((ιι R C).1 A) x = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [GrOperad.Inv.star_apply, ConvOp.toLin_sum, LinearMap.coe_sum, Finset.sum_apply]
  refine Finset.sum_eq_zero fun S _ => ?_
  show ConvOp.toLin (ConvOp.mapC (splitEquiv S)
    (ConvOp.compC none ((ι R C).1 (SOut S)) ((ι R C).1 (SIn S)))) x = 0
  rw [ConvOp.mapC_apply, ConvOp.toLin_compC, LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearMap.comp_apply]
  have hmem : GrCooperad.decomp (R := R) (C := C) (none : SOut S)
      (SymSpecies.map (R := R) (splitEquiv S).symm x)
      ∈ Submodule.map₂ (TensorProduct.mk R (C (SOut S)) (C (SIn S)))
          (GrCooperad.unitSpan R C (SOut S)) (GrCooperad.unitSpan R C (SIn S)) := by
    have hx' := GrCooperad.unitSpan_le_comap_map (R := R) (C := C) (splitEquiv S).symm hx
    have key : GrCooperad.unitSpan R C (Without (SOut S) none ⊕ SIn S)
        ≤ Submodule.comap (GrCooperad.decomp (R := R) (C := C) (none : SOut S))
          (Submodule.map₂ (TensorProduct.mk R (C (SOut S)) (C (SIn S)))
            (GrCooperad.unitSpan R C (SOut S)) (GrCooperad.unitSpan R C (SIn S))) := by
      rw [GrCooperad.unitSpan, GrCooperad.unitSpanOf, Submodule.span_le]
      rintro _ ⟨e, rfl⟩
      exact GrCooperad.Coaug.decomp_mem none e
    exact key hx'
  have hk : ∀ t ∈ Submodule.map₂ (TensorProduct.mk R (C (SOut S)) (C (SIn S)))
      (GrCooperad.unitSpan R C (SOut S)) (GrCooperad.unitSpan R C (SIn S)),
      ConvOp.kap ((ι R C).1 (SOut S)) ((ι R C).1 (SIn S)) t = 0 := by
    intro t ht
    refine (Submodule.map₂_le.2 ?_ : Submodule.map₂ _ _ _ ≤ LinearMap.ker
      (ConvOp.kap ((ι R C).1 (SOut S)) ((ι R C).1 (SIn S)))) ht
    intro a _ b hb
    exact kap_ι_unit R C _ a hb
  rw [hk _ hmem, map_zero, map_zero]

name: Operad.Cobar.genD_proj
statement:
lemma genD_proj (x : C A) :
    genD R C A (GrCooperad.Red.proj R C A x) = -ConvOp.toLin ((ιι R C).1 A) x
proof:
:= by
  simp only [genD]
  rfl

name: Operad.Cobar.ιι_map
statement:
lemma ιι_map (e : A ≃ B) (x : C A) :
    ConvOp.toLin ((ιι R C).1 B) (SymSpecies.map (R := R) e x)
      = GrOperad.map (R := R) e (ConvOp.toLin ((ιι R C).1 A) x)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← GrOperad.Inv.map_apply (ιι R C) e]
  show ConvOp.toLin (ConvOp.mapC e _) _ = _
  rw [ConvOp.mapC_apply, SymSpecies.map_symm_map]

name: Operad.Cobar.isShift_genD
statement: lemma isShift_genD : FreeGrL.IsShift (genDSp R C) true
proof:
:= by
  intro A _ _ c v
  obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := GrCooperad.Red.proj_surjective (R := R) (C := C) A v
  show genD R C A (GrCooperad.Red.proj R C A (GrSpecies.par (R := R) (!c) x))
    = GrOperad.par (R := R) (xor c true) (genD R C A (GrCooperad.Red.proj R C A x))
  have hev := ConvOp.parC_eq_self_iff.1 (isPar_ιι R C A)
  rw [genD_proj, genD_proj, hev, map_neg, Bool.xor_false, Bool.xor_true]

name: Operad.Cobar.d_ιL
