statement: lemma d_ιL (x : C A) : (d R C).app A (ιL R C A x) = -ConvOp.toLin ((ιι R C).1 A) x
proof:
:= by
  rw [ιL_apply, d, FreeGrL.derOf_ι]
  exact genD_proj R C x

name: Operad.Cobar.d_ι
statement: theorem d_ι : GrOperad.Inv.appDer (ConvOp.postDer (C := C) (d R C)) (ι R C) = -ιι R C
proof:
:= by
  refine Subtype.ext (funext fun A => funext fun _ => funext fun _ => ?_)
  show ConvOp.postL ((d R C).app A) (ConvOp.of (ιL R C A)) = -(ιι R C).1 A
  ext x
  rw [ConvOp.toLin_postL, LinearMap.comp_apply, ConvOp.toLin_of, d_ιL, ConvOp.toLin_neg,
    LinearMap.neg_apply]

name: Operad.Cobar.d_d
statement: theorem d_d (y : CobarGr R C A) : (d R C).app A ((d R C).app A y) = 0
proof:
:= by
  refine FreeGrL.sq_eq_zero (fun A _ _ v => ?_) y
  obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := GrCooperad.Red.proj_surjective (R := R) (C := C) A v
  have h1 : (d R C).app A ((FreeGrL.ι R (CobarGen R C)).app A (GrCooperad.Red.proj R C A x))
      = -ConvOp.toLin ((ιι R C).1 A) x := d_ιL R C x
  rw [h1, map_neg, neg_eq_zero, ← ConvOp.appDer_postDer_apply,
    GrOperad.Inv.appDer_star_self (isPar_ι R C) _ (d_ι R C)]
  rfl

name: Operad.GrComposite.unitOf_apply
statement:
lemma unitOf_apply {B : Type} [Fintype B] [DecidableEq B] (z : P B) :
    unitOf R C P B z = map (leftUnitEquiv B)
      (act R C () z (corolla R P Unit (Coaug.one (R := R) (C := C))))
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.GrComposite.unitOf_comp
statement:
lemma unitOf_comp {A Y : Type} [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] [Fintype Y] [DecidableEq Y] (i : A)
    (x : P A) (z : P Y) :
    unitOf R C P _ (GrOperad.comp (R := R) i x z) = act R C i z (unitOf R C P A x)
proof:
:= by
  set w := act R C () x (corolla R P Unit (Coaug.one (R := R) (C := C)))
  have h1 := map_act_seq (V := C) () i x z (corolla R P Unit (Coaug.one (R := R) (C := C)))
  have h2 := map_act (V := C) (leftUnitEquiv A) (Equiv.refl Y) (Sum.inr i) z w
  rw [GrOperad.map_refl] at h2
  rw [unitOf_apply, unitOf_apply, ← h1]
  refine Eq.trans ?_ h2
  rw [← map_trans]
  refine map_congr (fun s => ?_) _
  rcases s with ⟨u | a, hs⟩ | y
  · exact absurd (Subsingleton.elim u.1 ()) u.2
  · rfl
  · rfl

name: Operad.GrComposite.unitOf_map
statement:
lemma unitOf_map {A B : Type} [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] [Fintype B] [DecidableEq B]
    (σ : A ≃ B) (x : P A) :
    unitOf R C P B (GrOperad.map (R := R) σ x) = map σ (unitOf R C P A x)
proof:
:= by
  rw [unitOf_apply, unitOf_apply]
  have h := map_act (V := C) (Equiv.refl Unit) σ () x
    (corolla R P Unit (Coaug.one (R := R) (C := C)))
  rw [map_refl] at h
  erw [← h]
  simp only [← map_trans]
  exact map_congr (fun s => by rcases s with ⟨a, ha⟩ | y <;> first | rfl | exact absurd rfl ha) _

name: Operad.GrComposite.unitOf_one
statement:
lemma unitOf_one : unitOf R C P Unit (GrOperad.one (R := R)) = corolla R P Unit
    (Coaug.one (R := R) (C := C))
proof:
:= by
  rw [unitOf_apply]
  refine Eq.trans ?_ (map_act_one (V := C) () _)
  exact map_congr (fun s => by rcases s with ⟨a, ha⟩ | y <;> rfl) _

name: Operad.GrComposite.unitOf_mem
statement:
lemma unitOf_mem {B : Type} [Fintype B] [DecidableEq B] (z : P B) :
    unitOf R C P B z ∈ outerSpan R C P B 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [unitOf_apply]
  exact relabel_mem_outerSpanP _ (act_mem_outerSpanP _ _ (corolla_mem_outerSpan _))

name: Operad.GrComposite.counitHom_apply
statement:
lemma counitHom_apply {A : Type} [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] (x : C A) :
    (counitHom R C P).app A x = ∑ e : Unit ≃ A, counit (R := R) (SymSpecies.map (R := R) e.symm x)
      • GrOperad.map (R := R) (P := P) e (GrOperad.one (R := R))
proof:
:= by
  simp [counitHom]

name: Operad.GrComposite.counitHom_one
statement:
lemma counitHom_one :
    (counitHom R C P).app Unit (Coaug.one (R := R) (C := C)) = GrOperad.one (R := R)
proof:
:= by
  rw [counitHom_apply, Fintype.sum_unique]
  rw [show (default : Unit ≃ Unit) = Equiv.refl Unit from Subsingleton.elim _ _,
    Equiv.refl_symm, SymSpecies.map_refl, GrOperad.map_refl, Coaug.counit_one, one_smul]

name: Operad.GrComposite.counitE_act
statement:
lemma counitE_act {Y : Type} [Fintype Y] [DecidableEq Y] (i : S) (z : P Y)
    (w : GrComposite R C P S) :
    counitE R C P _ (act R C i z w) = GrOperad.comp (R := R) i (counitE R C P S w) z
proof:
:=
  total_act R C (counitHom R C P) i z w

name: Operad.GrComposite.counitE_map
statement:
lemma counitE_map {S' : Type} [Fintype S'] [DecidableEq S'] (σ : S ≃ S')
    (w : GrComposite R C P S) :
    counitE R C P S' (map σ w) = GrOperad.map (R := R) σ (counitE R C P S w)
proof:
:=
  total_map (counitHom R C P) σ w

name: Operad.GrComposite.counitE_corolla
statement:
lemma counitE_corolla {A : Type} [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] (c : C A) :
    counitE R C P A (corolla R P A c) = (counitHom R C P).app A c
proof:
:= by
  rw [corolla_apply, total_corGen, GrOperad.map_refl]

name: Operad.GrComposite.counitE_unitOf
statement:
lemma counitE_unitOf {B : Type} [Fintype B] [DecidableEq B] (z : P B) :
    counitE R C P B (unitOf R C P B z) = z
proof:
:= by
  rw [unitOf_apply, counitE_map, counitE_act, counitE_corolla, counitHom_one]
  exact GrOperad.one_comp z

name: Operad.GrComposite.eq_unitOf_of_mem
statement:
theorem eq_unitOf_of_mem
    (hred : ∀ (A : Type) [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A], Fintype.card A ≤ 1 →
      ∀ x : C A, x ∈ unitSpan R C A) {x : GrComposite R C P S}
    (hx : x ∈ outerSpan R C P S 1) : x = unitOf R C P S (counitE R C P S x)
proof:
:= by
  have h := map_mem_outerSpanP (LinearMap.id - (unitOf R C P S).comp (counitE R C P S))
    (⊥ : Submodule R (GrComposite R C P S)) (fun g hg => ?_) hx
  · rw [Submodule.mem_bot, LinearMap.sub_apply, LinearMap.id_apply, LinearMap.comp_apply,
      sub_eq_zero] at h
    exact h
  · rw [Submodule.mem_bot, LinearMap.sub_apply, LinearMap.id_apply, LinearMap.comp_apply,
      sub_eq_zero]
    exact induction_card (fun S _ _ w => w = unitOf R C P S (counitE R C P S w))
      (fun S _ _ => by beta_reduce; simp)
      (fun S _ _ x y hx hy => by beta_reduce at hx hy ⊢; rw [map_add, map_add, ← hx, ← hy])
      (fun S _ _ r x hx => by beta_reduce at hx ⊢; rw [map_smul, map_smul, ← hx])
      (fun S S' _ _ _ _ σ x hx => by
        beta_reduce at hx ⊢
        rw [counitE_map, unitOf_map, ← hx])
      (fun S Y _ _ _ _ i z x hx => by
        beta_reduce at hx ⊢
        rw [counitE_act, unitOf_comp, ← hx])
      (fun A _ _ c hA => by
        beta_reduce
        have e : Unit ≃ A := (Fintype.equivOfCardEq (by rw [Fintype.card_unit, hA]))
        haveI := subsingleton_of_unit e
        have hc := eq_counit_smul (hred A hA.le) e c
        rw [counitE_corolla, counitHom_apply, Fintype.sum_subsingleton _ e, map_smul,
          unitOf_map, unitOf_one, map_corolla]
        conv_lhs => rw [hc]
        rw [map_smul]) g hg

name: Operad.GrComposite.outerProj_add
statement:
lemma outerProj_add (P Q : ℕ → Prop) [DecidablePred P] [DecidablePred Q]
    (h : ∀ k, Q k ↔ ¬ P k) (x : GrComposite R M N S) :
    outerProj R M N S P x + outerProj R M N S Q x = x
proof:
:= by
  induction x using induction_on with
  | h0 => simp
  | hadd x y hx hy => rw [map_add, map_add, add_add_add_comm, hx, hy]
  | hsmul c x hx => rw [map_smul, map_smul, ← smul_add, hx]
  | hmk g =>
    rw [outerProj_mk, outerProj_mk]
    by_cases hP : P (Fintype.card g.A)
    · rw [if_pos hP, if_neg ((h _).not.2 (not_not.2 hP)), add_zero]
    · rw [if_neg hP, if_pos ((h _).2 hP), zero_add]

name: Operad.GrComposite.outerProj_mem_and
proof:
:=
  map_mem_outerSpanP _ _ (fun g hg => by
    rw [outerProj_mk]
    split_ifs with hP
    · exact mk_mem_outerSpanP g ⟨hP, hg⟩
    · exact zero_mem _) hx

name: Operad.GrComposite.mk_eq_zero_of_card_lt
statement:
lemma mk_eq_zero_of_card_lt
    (hN0 : ∀ (B : Type) [Fintype B] [DecidableEq B], IsEmpty B → ∀ y : N B, y = 0)
    (g : GrCompGen M N S) (hg : Fintype.card S < Fintype.card g.A) : mk R g = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hex : ∃ a, IsEmpty (g.B a) := by
    by_contra hne
    simp only [not_exists, not_isEmpty_iff] at hne
    have h1 : Fintype.card g.A ≤ Fintype.card S := by
      rw [← Fintype.card_congr g.e, Fintype.card_sigma]
      calc Fintype.card g.A = ∑ _a : g.A, 1 := by simp
        _ ≤ ∑ a, Fintype.card (g.B a) := Finset.sum_le_sum fun a _ =>
          Fintype.card_pos_iff.2 (hne a)
    omega
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := hex
  exact mk_of_y_eq_zero g (hN0 _ ha (g.y a))

name: Operad.GrComposite.card_fib_lt
statement:
lemma card_fib_lt (g : GrCompGen M N S) (hg : 2 ≤ Fintype.card g.A) (a : g.A) :
    Fintype.card (g.B a) < Fintype.card S ∨ ∃ b, IsEmpty (g.B b)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hne : ∃ b, IsEmpty (g.B b)
  · exact Or.inr hne
  · left
    simp only [not_exists, not_isEmpty_iff] at hne
    obtain ⟨a', ha'⟩ : ∃ a', a' ≠ a := by
      by_contra h
      simp only [not_exists, not_not] at h
      have : Fintype.card g.A ≤ 1 := Fintype.card_le_one_iff.2 fun x y => (h x).trans (h y).symm
      omega
    rw [← Fintype.card_congr g.e, Fintype.card_sigma,
      ← Finset.add_sum_erase _ _ (Finset.mem_univ a)]
    have : 0 < ∑ b ∈ Finset.univ.erase a, Fintype.card (g.B b) :=
      Finset.sum_pos' (fun b _ => Nat.zero_le _)
        ⟨a', Finset.mem_erase.2 ⟨ha', Finset.mem_univ _⟩, Fintype.card_pos_iff.2 (hne a')⟩
    omega

name: Operad.GrComposite.projU_add_projW
statement: lemma projU_add_projW (x : GrComposite R C P S) : projU R C P S x + projW R C P S x = x
proof:
:=
  outerProj_add _ _ (fun k => by omega) x

name: Operad.GrComposite.diffUT_add_diffWT
statement: lemma diffUT_add_diffWT : diffUT D S T + diffWT S T = T + leafD R C D S
proof:
:= by
  refine LinearMap.ext fun x => ?_
  simp only [LinearMap.add_apply, LinearMap.comp_apply]
  rw [add_assoc, projU_add_projW, add_comm]

name: Operad.GrComposite.projU_T_projW
statement: lemma projU_T_projW (x : GrComposite R C P S) : projU R C P S (T (projW R C P S x)) = 0
proof:
:=
  outerProj_eq_zero _ (· < 2) (fun k hk => by omega) (hT 2 _ (outerProj_mem _ x))

name: Operad.GrComposite.splitUWT
statement:
lemma splitUWT (hdd : ∀ x, (T + leafD R C D S) ((T + leafD R C D S) x) = 0) :
    QIso.Split (diffUT D S T) (diffWT S T) (outerSpanP R C P S (2 ≤ ·)) (outerLt R C P S 2) where
  disj
proof:
:= Submodule.disjoint_def.2 fun x hU hW => by
    rw [← outerProj_of_mem (2 ≤ ·) hU]
    exact outerProj_eq_zero _ (· < 2) (fun k hk => by omega) hW
  dd x := by rw [diffUT_add_diffWT]; exact hdd x
  mem₀ u hu := by
    rw [LinearMap.add_apply]
    exact add_mem (leafMap_mem_outerSpanP _ hu) (outerProj_mem _ _)
  mem₁ u _ := outerProj_mem _ _
  memW w hw := by
    rw [diffUT_add_diffWT, LinearMap.add_apply]
    exact add_mem (hT 2 _ hw) (leafMap_mem_outerSpanP _ hw)

name: Operad.GrComposite.diffUT_sq
statement:
lemma diffUT_sq
    (hD : ∀ (A : Type) [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] (x : P A), D.app A (D.app A x) = 0)
    (hdd : ∀ x, (T + leafD R C D S) ((T + leafD R C D S) x) = 0) (x : GrComposite R C P S) :
    diffUT D S T (diffUT D S T x) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have h1 := hdd x
  simp only [LinearMap.add_apply, map_add] at h1
  have h1' := congrArg (projU R C P S) h1
  simp only [map_add, map_zero] at h1'
  have h2 := leaf_sq D hD x
  have h2' : projU R C P S (leafD R C D S (leafD R C D S x)) = 0 := by rw [h2, map_zero]
  have h3 := projU_T_projW S T hT (T x)
  have h4 := projU_add_projW S (T x)
  have h5 : T (projU R C P S (T x)) = T (T x) - T (projW R C P S (T x)) := by
    rw [eq_sub_of_add_eq h4, map_sub]
  have h6 := outerProj_leafMap (2 ≤ ·) (D.toSpEnd) (T x)
  simp only [LinearMap.add_apply, LinearMap.comp_apply, map_add]
  rw [h5, map_sub, h3, sub_zero, h2]
  erw [← h6]
  linear_combination (norm := module) h1' - h2'

name: Operad.GrComposite.diffU_add_diffW
statement: lemma diffU_add_diffW : diffU ε D β S + diffW ε β S = twDiff R C ε D β S
proof:
:=
  diffUT_add_diffWT D S (twD ε β S)

name: Operad.GrComposite.twD_projW_mem
statement: lemma twD_projW_mem (x : GrComposite R C P S) : twD ε β S (projW R C P S x) ∈ outerLt R C P S 2
proof:
:=
  twD_mem_outerLt_of_lt ε hβ hβ1 (outerProj_mem _ x)

name: Operad.GrComposite.projU_twD_projW
statement:
lemma projU_twD_projW (x : GrComposite R C P S) :
    projU R C P S (twD ε β S (projW R C P S x)) = 0
proof:
:=
  outerProj_eq_zero _ (· < 2) (fun k hk => by omega) (twD_projW_mem ε hβ hβ1 S x)

name: Operad.GrComposite.splitUW
statement:
lemma splitUW (hdd : ∀ x, twDiff R C ε D β S (twDiff R C ε D β S x) = 0) :
    QIso.Split (diffU ε D β S) (diffW ε β S) (outerSpanP R C P S (2 ≤ ·)) (outerLt R C P S 2)
proof:
:=
  splitUWT D S (twD ε β S) (fun _ _ hx => twD_mem_outerLt_of_lt ε hβ hβ1 hx) hdd

name: Operad.GrComposite.diffU_sq
statement:
lemma diffU_sq (hD : ∀ (A : Type) [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] (x : P A), D.app A (D.app A x) = 0)
    (hdd : ∀ x, twDiff R C ε D β S (twDiff R C ε D β S x) = 0) (x : GrComposite R C P S) :
    diffU ε D β S (diffU ε D β S x) = 0
proof:
:=
  diffUT_sq D S (twD ε β S) (fun _ _ hx => twD_mem_outerLt_of_lt ε hβ hβ1 hx) hD hdd x

name: Operad.GrComposite.leafD_unitOf
statement:
lemma leafD_unitOf (D : GrDer (GrOperadHom.id R P) true) {B : Type} [Fintype B] [DecidableEq B]
    (z : P B) : leafD R C D B (unitOf R C P B z) = unitOf R C P B (D.app B z)
proof:
:= by
  rw [unitOf_apply, unitOf_apply, ← leafMap_map, leafD_act, leafD_corolla, map_zero, zero_add,
    tw_corolla, GrSpecies.tw_hom true (Coaug.par_one (R := R) (C := C)), Bool.and_false, σ_false,
    one_smul]

name: Operad.GrComposite.twD_unitOf
statement:
lemma twD_unitOf (ε : GrAug R P) {β : GrOperad.Inv R (ConvOp R C P)} {p : Bool}
    (hβ : GrOperad.Inv.IsPar p β)
    (hβ1 : ∀ (A : Type) [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A], Fintype.card A = 1 →
      ∀ x : C A, toLin (β.1 A) x = 0)
    {B : Type} [Fintype B] [DecidableEq B] (z : P B) : twD ε β B (unitOf R C P B z) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have h := twD_corolla_mem ε hβ hβ1 (Coaug.one (R := R) (C := C))
  rw [Fintype.card_unit, outerLt_one_eq_bot ⟨()⟩, Submodule.mem_bot] at h
  rw [unitOf_apply, twD, twF_map, twF_act]
  erw [h]
  rw [map_zero, map_zero]

name: Operad.GrComposite.map₂_unitOf
statement:
lemma map₂_unitOf [GrCooperad.Coaug R C] (g : GrOperadHom R P' P) {B : Type} [Fintype B]
    [DecidableEq B] (z : P' B) :
    (map₂ idSpHom g.toGrSpeciesHom).app B (unitOf R C P' B z) = unitOf R C P B (g.app B z)
proof:
:= by
  rw [unitOf_apply, unitOf_apply, show (map₂ idSpHom g.toGrSpeciesHom).app B (map _ _)
    = map _ ((map₂ idSpHom g.toGrSpeciesHom).app _ _) from
      (map₂ idSpHom g.toGrSpeciesHom).app_map _ _, map₂_act, map₂_corolla]

name: Operad.GrComposite.twDiff_unitOf
statement:
lemma twDiff_unitOf (ε : GrAug R P) (D : GrDer (GrOperadHom.id R P) true)
    {β : GrOperad.Inv R (ConvOp R C P)} {p : Bool} (hβ : GrOperad.Inv.IsPar p β)
    (hβ1 : ∀ (A : Type) [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A], Fintype.card A = 1 →
      ∀ x : C A, toLin (β.1 A) x = 0)
    {B : Type} [Fintype B] [DecidableEq B] (z : P B) :
    twDiff R C ε D β B (unitOf R C P B z) = unitOf R C P B (D.app B z)
proof:
:= by
  rw [twDiff, LinearMap.add_apply, twD_unitOf ε hβ hβ1, zero_add, leafD_unitOf]

name: Operad.GrComposite.unitOf_of_T
statement:
lemma unitOf_of_T (D : GrDer (GrOperadHom.id R P) true) {B : Type} [Fintype B] [DecidableEq B]
    {T : GrComposite R C P B →ₗ[R] GrComposite R C P B}
    (hT : ∀ z : P B, T (unitOf R C P B z) = 0) (z : P B) :
    (T + leafD R C D B) (unitOf R C P B z) = unitOf R C P B (D.app B z)
proof:
:= by
  rw [LinearMap.add_apply, hT, zero_add, leafD_unitOf]

name: Operad.GrComposite.filtSU_sup
statement:
lemma filtSU_sup (P₀ : (A : Type) → [Fintype A] → [DecidableEq A] → Type w)
    [∀ (A : Type) [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A], AddCommGroup (P₀ A)]
    [∀ (A : Type) [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A], Module R (P₀ A)] [GrOperad R P₀] (p : ℕ) :
    filtSU (R := R) (C := C) P₀ S p
      = filtXU (R := R) (C := C) P₀ S p ⊔ filtSU (R := R) (C := C) P₀ S (p + 1)
proof:
:= by
  unfold filtXU
  split_ifs with hp
  · refine le_antisymm ?_ (sup_le (outerSpanP_mono fun k hk => by omega)
      (outerSpanP_mono fun k hk => by omega))
    apply Submodule.span_le.2
    rintro _ ⟨g, ⟨h1, h2⟩, rfl⟩
    by_cases hk : Fintype.card g.A = Fintype.card S - p
    · exact Submodule.mem_sup_left (mk_mem_outerSpanP g hk)
    · exact Submodule.mem_sup_right (mk_mem_outerSpanP g ⟨h1, by omega⟩)
  · rw [bot_sup_eq]
    refine le_antisymm ?_ (outerSpanP_mono fun k hk => by omega)
    apply Submodule.span_le.2
    rintro _ ⟨g, ⟨h1, h2⟩, rfl⟩
    exact absurd h2 (by omega)

name: Operad.GrComposite.TwCompareGen.filtDataU
statement:
lemma TwCompareGen.filtDataU :
    QIso.FiltData (filtXU P' S) (filtSU P' S) (filtXU P S) (filtSU P S) (Fintype.card S)
      (leafD R C D' S) ((projU R C P' S).comp (T' S)) (leafD R C D S)
      ((projU R C P S).comp (T S)) ((map₂ idSpHom g.toGrSpeciesHom).app S) where
  split p
proof:
:= by
    refine ⟨?_, fun x => diffUT_sq D' S (T' S) (fun _ _ hx => hc.lower_of_lt' hx) hc.hD'
      (hc.dd' S) x, fun u hu => ?_, fun u hu => ?_, fun w hw => ?_⟩
    · unfold filtXU
      split_ifs with hp
      · exact (disjoint_outerSpan_outerLt _).mono_right (outerSpanP_mono fun k hk => by omega)
      · exact disjoint_bot_left
    · unfold filtXU at hu ⊢
      split_ifs at hu ⊢ with hp
      · exact leafMap_mem_outerSpanP _ hu
      · rw [Submodule.mem_bot] at hu ⊢
        rw [hu, map_zero]
    · unfold filtXU at hu
      split_ifs at hu with hp
      · exact outerSpanP_mono (P := fun k => 2 ≤ k ∧ k < Fintype.card S - p)
          (fun k hk => ⟨hk.1, by omega⟩)
          (outerProj_mem_and _ _ (hc.lower' S _ _ hu))
      · rw [Submodule.mem_bot] at hu
        rw [hu, map_zero]
        exact zero_mem _
    · rw [LinearMap.add_apply]
      refine add_mem (leafMap_mem_outerSpanP _ hw) ?_
      exact outerSpanP_mono (P := fun k => 2 ≤ k ∧ k < Fintype.card S - p)
        (fun k hk => ⟨hk.1, by omega⟩)
        (outerProj_mem_and _ _ (hc.lower_of_lt'
          (outerSpanP_mono (P' := (· < Fintype.card S - p)) (fun k hk => by omega) hw)))
  split' p := by
    refine ⟨?_, fun x => diffUT_sq D S (T S) (fun _ _ hx => hc.lower_of_lt hx) hc.hD
      (hc.dd S) x, fun u hu => ?_, fun u hu => ?_, fun w hw => ?_⟩
    · unfold filtXU
      split_ifs with hp
      · exact (disjoint_outerSpan_outerLt _).mono_right (outerSpanP_mono fun k hk => by omega)
      · exact disjoint_bot_left
    · unfold filtXU at hu ⊢
      split_ifs at hu ⊢ with hp
      · exact leafMap_mem_outerSpanP _ hu
      · rw [Submodule.mem_bot] at hu ⊢
        rw [hu, map_zero]
    · unfold filtXU at hu
      split_ifs at hu with hp
      · exact outerSpanP_mono (P := fun k => 2 ≤ k ∧ k < Fintype.card S - p)
          (fun k hk => ⟨hk.1, by omega⟩)
          (outerProj_mem_and _ _ (hc.lower S _ _ hu))
      · rw [Submodule.mem_bot] at hu
        rw [hu, map_zero]
        exact zero_mem _
    · rw [LinearMap.add_apply]
      refine add_mem (leafMap_mem_outerSpanP _ hw) ?_
      exact outerSpanP_mono (P := fun k => 2 ≤ k ∧ k < Fintype.card S - p)
        (fun k hk => ⟨hk.1, by omega⟩)
        (outerProj_mem_and _ _ (hc.lower_of_lt
          (outerSpanP_mono (P' := (· < Fintype.card S - p)) (fun k hk => by omega) hw)))
  hom p := by
    refine ⟨fun u hu => ?_, fun w hw => map₂_mem_outerSpanP _ hw, fun x => hc.leaf_comm x,
      fun x => ?_⟩
    · unfold filtXU at hu ⊢
      split_ifs at hu ⊢ with hp
      · exact map₂_mem_outerSpanP _ hu
      · rw [Submodule.mem_bot] at hu ⊢
        rw [hu, map_zero]
    · simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply]
      rw [← outerProj_map₂, hc.nat]
  sup p := filtSU_sup P' p
  sup' p := filtSU_sup P p
  top := eq_bot_iff.2 (Submodule.span_le.2 fun _ ⟨_, ⟨h1, h2⟩, _⟩ => absurd h2 (by omega))
  top' := eq_bot_iff.2 (Submodule.span_le.2 fun _ ⟨_, ⟨h1, h2⟩, _⟩ => absurd h2 (by omega))

name: Operad.GrComposite.TwCompareData.filtDataU
statement:
lemma TwCompareData.filtDataU :
    QIso.FiltData (filtXU P' S) (filtSU P' S) (filtXU P S) (filtSU P S) (Fintype.card S)
      (leafD R C D' S) ((projU R C P' S).comp (twD ε' β' S)) (leafD R C D S)
      ((projU R C P S).comp (twD ε β S)) ((map₂ idSpHom g.toGrSpeciesHom).app S)
proof:
:=
  hd.toGen.filtDataU

name: Operad.GrComposite.filtSU_zero
statement:
lemma filtSU_zero (P₀ : (A : Type) → [Fintype A] → [DecidableEq A] → Type w)
    [∀ (A : Type) [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A], AddCommGroup (P₀ A)]
    [∀ (A : Type) [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A], Module R (P₀ A)] [GrOperad R P₀]
    (hP0 : ∀ (B : Type) [Fintype B] [DecidableEq B], IsEmpty B → ∀ y : P₀ B, y = 0) :
    filtSU (R := R) (C := C) P₀ S 0 = outerSpanP R C P₀ S (2 ≤ ·)
proof:
:= by
  refine le_antisymm (outerSpanP_mono fun k hk => hk.1) ?_
  apply Submodule.span_le.2
  rintro _ ⟨g, hg, rfl⟩
  by_cases hk : Fintype.card g.A < Fintype.card S + 1
  · exact mk_mem_outerSpanP g ⟨hg, by omega⟩
  · rw [mk_eq_zero_of_card_lt hP0 g (by omega)]
    exact zero_mem _

name: Operad.GrComposite.map₂_eq_on_outerSpan
statement:
lemma map₂_eq_on_outerSpan {N N' : (A : Type) → [Fintype A] → [DecidableEq A] → Type w}
    [∀ (A : Type) [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A], AddCommGroup (N A)]
    [∀ (A : Type) [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A], Module R (N A)] [GrSpecies R N]
    [∀ (A : Type) [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A], AddCommGroup (N' A)]
    [∀ (A : Type) [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A], Module R (N' A)] [GrSpecies R N']
    (ψ₁ ψ₂ : GrSpeciesHom R N N')
    (hN0 : ∀ (B : Type) [Fintype B] [DecidableEq B], IsEmpty B → ∀ y : N B, y = 0)
    (h : ∀ (B : Type) [Fintype B] [DecidableEq B], Fintype.card B < Fintype.card S →
      ∀ y : N B, ψ₁.app B y = ψ₂.app B y)
    {j : ℕ} (hj : 2 ≤ j) {x : GrComposite R C N S} (hx : x ∈ outerSpan R C N S j) :
    (map₂ idSpHom ψ₁).app S x = (map₂ idSpHom ψ₂).app S x
proof:
:= by
  have h' := map_mem_outerSpanP ((map₂ idSpHom ψ₁).app S - (map₂ idSpHom ψ₂).app S)
    (⊥ : Submodule R (GrComposite R C N' S)) (fun g hg => ?_) hx
  · rwa [Submodule.mem_bot, LinearMap.sub_apply, sub_eq_zero] at h'
  · rw [Submodule.mem_bot, LinearMap.sub_apply, sub_eq_zero]
    by_cases hex : ∃ b, IsEmpty (g.B b)
    · obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := hex
      rw [mk_of_y_eq_zero g (hN0 _ hb (g.y b)), map_zero, map_zero]
    · have hlt : ∀ a, Fintype.card (g.B a) < Fintype.card S := fun a =>
        (card_fib_lt g (hg ▸ hj) a).resolve_right hex
      rw [map₂_mk, map₂_mk]
      show mk R ⟨g.A, g.B, g.L, g.m, fun a => ψ₁.app _ (g.y a), g.e⟩
        = mk R ⟨g.A, g.B, g.L, g.m, fun a => ψ₂.app _ (g.y a), g.e⟩
      simp only [fun a => h _ (hlt a) (g.y a)]

name: Operad.GrComposite.TwCompareGen.qiso_step
statement:
theorem TwCompareGen.qiso_step
    (hred : ∀ (A : Type) [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A], Fintype.card A ≤ 1 →
      ∀ x : C A, x ∈ unitSpan R C A) (hS : Nonempty S)
    (hlow : ∀ (B : Type) [Fintype B] [DecidableEq B], Fintype.card B < Fintype.card S →
      FreeGrL.SurjAt R D'.toSpEnd D.toSpEnd g.toGrSpeciesHom B
        ∧ FreeGrL.InjAt R D'.toSpEnd D.toSpEnd g.toGrSpeciesHom B)
    (hqS : QIso.Surj ⊤ ⊤ (T' S + leafD R C D' S) (T S + leafD R C D S)
        ((map₂ idSpHom g.toGrSpeciesHom).app S)
      ∧ QIso.Inj ⊤ ⊤ (T' S + leafD R C D' S) (T S + leafD R C D S)
        ((map₂ idSpHom g.toGrSpeciesHom).app S)) :
    FreeGrL.SurjAt R D'.toSpEnd D.toSpEnd g.toGrSpeciesHom S
      ∧ FreeGrL.InjAt R D'.toSpEnd D.toSpEnd g.toGrSpeciesHom S
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨s'⟩ := Splitting.exists_of_field D'.toSpEnd (fun A _ _ x => hc.hD' A x)
  obtain ⟨s⟩ := Splitting.exists_of_field D.toSpEnd (fun A _ _ x => hc.hD A x)
  obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := exists_compat g.toGrSpeciesHom (fun A _ _ x => (hc.hg A x).symm) s' s
    (· < Fintype.card S) (fun m hm => (hlow (Fin m) (by simpa using hm)).1)
    (fun m hm => (hlow (Fin m) (by simpa using hm)).2)
  
  have hpiece : ∀ p, QIso.Surj (filtXU P' S p) (filtXU P S p) (leafD R C D' S) (leafD R C D S)
        ((map₂ idSpHom g.toGrSpeciesHom).app S)
      ∧ QIso.Inj (filtXU P' S p) (filtXU P S p) (leafD R C D' S) (leafD R C D S)
        ((map₂ idSpHom g.toGrSpeciesHom).app S) := fun p => by
    unfold filtXU
    split_ifs with hp
    · have hX := le_antisymm (outerSpanP_le_outerEig (R := R) (M := C) (N := P') (S := S)
        (Fintype.card S - p)) (outerEig_le_outerSpan _)
      have hX' := le_antisymm (outerSpanP_le_outerEig (R := R) (M := C) (N := P) (S := S)
        (Fintype.card S - p)) (outerEig_le_outerSpan _)
      rw [hX, hX']
      refine qiso_leaf s' s g.toGrSpeciesHom (fun A _ _ y => hc.hg A y) k _
        (fun x hx => ?_) (fun y hy => ?_)
      · rw [map₂_map₂ k (s.p.toHom.comp (g.toGrSpeciesHom.comp s'.p.toHom))
          (k.comp (s.p.toHom.comp (g.toGrSpeciesHom.comp s'.p.toHom))) (fun _ _ _ _ => rfl)]
        exact map₂_eq_on_outerSpan _ _ hc.hP0' (fun B _ _ hB y => (hk B hB).1 y) (by omega)
          (outerEig_le_outerSpan _ hx)
      · rw [map₂_map₂ (s.p.toHom.comp (g.toGrSpeciesHom.comp s'.p.toHom)) k
          ((s.p.toHom.comp (g.toGrSpeciesHom.comp s'.p.toHom)).comp k) (fun _ _ _ _ => rfl)]
        exact map₂_eq_on_outerSpan _ _ hc.hP0 (fun B _ _ hB y => (hk B hB).2 y) (by omega)
          (outerEig_le_outerSpan _ hy)
    · exact ⟨QIso.surj_bot _ _ _, QIso.inj_bot _ _ _⟩
  have hU := QIso.qiso_filt hc.filtDataU (fun p => (hpiece p).1) (fun p => (hpiece p).2) 0
  rw [filtSU_zero P' hc.hP0', filtSU_zero P hc.hP0] at hU
  
  have hs := splitUWT D' S (T' S) (fun _ _ hx => hc.lower_of_lt' hx) (hc.dd' S)
  have hs' := splitUWT D S (T S) (fun _ _ hx => hc.lower_of_lt hx) (hc.dd S)
  have hF : QIso.SplitHom ((map₂ idSpHom g.toGrSpeciesHom).app S) (diffUT D' S (T' S))
      (diffWT S (T' S)) (diffUT D S (T S)) (diffWT S (T S)) (outerSpanP R C P' S (2 ≤ ·))
      (outerLt R C P' S 2) (outerSpanP R C P S (2 ≤ ·)) (outerLt R C P S 2) := by
    refine ⟨fun u hu => map₂_mem_outerSpanP _ hu, fun w hw => map₂_mem_outerSpanP _ hw,
      fun x => ?_, fun x => ?_⟩
    · simp only [LinearMap.add_apply, LinearMap.comp_apply, map_add]
      rw [hc.leaf_comm, ← outerProj_map₂, hc.nat]
    · simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply]
      rw [← outerProj_map₂, hc.nat]
  have htop : ∀ (P₀ : (A : Type) → [Fintype A] → [DecidableEq A] → Type w)
      [∀ (A : Type) [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A], AddCommGroup (P₀ A)]
      [∀ (A : Type) [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A], Module R (P₀ A)] [GrOperad R P₀],
      outerSpanP R C P₀ S (2 ≤ ·) ⊔ outerLt R C P₀ S 2 = ⊤ := fun P₀ _ _ _ =>
    eq_top_iff.2 fun x _ => by
      rw [← projU_add_projW S x]
      exact Submodule.add_mem_sup (outerProj_mem _ x) (outerProj_mem _ x)
  have hT := hqS
  rw [← htop P', ← htop P, ← diffUT_add_diffWT D' S (T' S), ← diffUT_add_diffWT D S (T S)]
    at hT
  have hWs := QIso.surj_sub hs hs' hF hU.1 hU.2 hT.1
  have hWi := QIso.inj_sub hs hs' hF hU.2 hT.1 hT.2
  rw [diffUT_add_diffWT, diffUT_add_diffWT] at hWs hWi
  
  have hW1 : ∀ (P₀ : (A : Type) → [Fintype A] → [DecidableEq A] → Type w)
      [∀ (A : Type) [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A], AddCommGroup (P₀ A)]
      [∀ (A : Type) [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A], Module R (P₀ A)] [GrOperad R P₀]
      {x : GrComposite R C P₀ S}, x ∈ outerLt R C P₀ S 2 → x ∈ outerSpan R C P₀ S 1 :=
    fun P₀ _ _ _ x hx => by
      rw [show (2 : ℕ) = 1 + 1 from rfl, outerLt_succ, outerLt_one_eq_bot hS, sup_bot_eq] at hx
      exact hx
  have hW2 : ∀ (P₀ : (A : Type) → [Fintype A] → [DecidableEq A] → Type w)
      [∀ (A : Type) [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A], AddCommGroup (P₀ A)]
      [∀ (A : Type) [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A], Module R (P₀ A)] [GrOperad R P₀] (z : P₀ S),
      unitOf R C P₀ S z ∈ outerLt R C P₀ S 2 := fun P₀ _ _ _ z =>
    outerSpanP_mono (fun k hk => by omega) (unitOf_mem z)
  have e : ∀ z : P S, (T S + leafD R C D S) (unitOf R C P S z) = unitOf R C P S (D.app S z) :=
    unitOf_of_T D (hu S)
  have e' : ∀ z : P' S,
      (T' S + leafD R C D' S) (unitOf R C P' S z) = unitOf R C P' S (D'.app S z) :=
    unitOf_of_T D' (hu' S)
  constructor
  · intro y hy
    have hcy : (T S + leafD R C D S) (unitOf R C P S y) = 0 := by
      rw [e]
      exact (congrArg (unitOf R C P S) hy).trans (map_zero _)
    obtain ⟨x, hx, hdx, z, hz, hxz⟩ := hWs (unitOf R C P S y) (hW2 P y) hcy
    have hx1 := eq_unitOf_of_mem hred (hW1 P' hx)
    have hz1 := eq_unitOf_of_mem hred (hW1 P hz)
    refine ⟨counitE R C P' S x, ?_, counitE R C P S z, ?_⟩
    · have h := congrArg (counitE R C P' S) hdx
      rw [hx1, e', counitE_unitOf, map_zero] at h
      exact h
    · have h := congrArg (counitE R C P S) hxz
      rw [hx1, map₂_unitOf, hz1, e, map_sub, counitE_unitOf, counitE_unitOf,
        counitE_unitOf] at h
      exact h
  · intro x hx w' hw'
    have hcx : (T' S + leafD R C D' S) (unitOf R C P' S x) = 0 := by
      rw [e']
      exact (congrArg (unitOf R C P' S) hx).trans (map_zero _)
    obtain ⟨z, hz, hdz⟩ := hWi (unitOf R C P' S x) (hW2 P' x) hcx (unitOf R C P S w') (hW2 P w')
      (by rw [map₂_unitOf, e]; exact congrArg _ hw')
    have hz1 := eq_unitOf_of_mem hred (hW1 P' hz)
    refine ⟨counitE R C P' S z, ?_⟩
    have h := congrArg (counitE R C P' S) hdz
    rw [hz1, e', counitE_unitOf, counitE_unitOf] at h
    exact h

name: Operad.GrComposite.TwCompareGen.qiso_converse
statement:
theorem TwCompareGen.qiso_converse
    (hred : ∀ (A : Type) [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A], Fintype.card A ≤ 1 →
      ∀ x : C A, x ∈ unitSpan R C A)
    (hq : ∀ (S : Type) [Fintype S] [DecidableEq S],
      QIso.Surj ⊤ ⊤ (T' S + leafD R C D' S) (T S + leafD R C D S)
          ((map₂ idSpHom g.toGrSpeciesHom).app S)
        ∧ QIso.Inj ⊤ ⊤ (T' S + leafD R C D' S) (T S + leafD R C D S)
          ((map₂ idSpHom g.toGrSpeciesHom).app S))
    (A : Type) [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] :
    FreeGrL.SurjAt R D'.toSpEnd D.toSpEnd g.toGrSpeciesHom A
      ∧ FreeGrL.InjAt R D'.toSpEnd D.toSpEnd g.toGrSpeciesHom A
proof:
:= by
  suffices h : ∀ (n : ℕ) (A : Type) [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A], Fintype.card A = n →
      FreeGrL.SurjAt R D'.toSpEnd D.toSpEnd g.toGrSpeciesHom A
        ∧ FreeGrL.InjAt R D'.toSpEnd D.toSpEnd g.toGrSpeciesHom A from h _ A rfl
  intro n
  induction n using Nat.strong_induction_on with
  | _ n ih =>
    intro A _ _ hA
    by_cases hA0 : IsEmpty A
    · refine ⟨fun y _ => ⟨0, map_zero _, 0, ?_⟩, fun x _ _ _ => ⟨0, ?_⟩⟩
      · rw [map_zero, map_zero, hc.hP0 A hA0 y, sub_zero]
      · rw [map_zero, hc.hP0' A hA0 x]
    · exact hc.qiso_step hu hu' hred (not_isEmpty_iff.1 hA0)
        (fun B _ _ hB => ih _ (hA ▸ hB) B rfl) (hq A)

name: Operad.GrComposite.TwCompareData.qiso_step
statement:
theorem TwCompareData.qiso_step
    (hred : ∀ (A : Type) [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A], Fintype.card A ≤ 1 →
      ∀ x : C A, x ∈ unitSpan R C A) (hS : Nonempty S)
    (hlow : ∀ (B : Type) [Fintype B] [DecidableEq B], Fintype.card B < Fintype.card S →
      FreeGrL.SurjAt R D'.toSpEnd D.toSpEnd g.toGrSpeciesHom B
        ∧ FreeGrL.InjAt R D'.toSpEnd D.toSpEnd g.toGrSpeciesHom B)
    (hqS : QIso.Surj ⊤ ⊤ (twDiff R C ε' D' β' S) (twDiff R C ε D β S)
        ((map₂ idSpHom g.toGrSpeciesHom).app S)
      ∧ QIso.Inj ⊤ ⊤ (twDiff R C ε' D' β' S) (twDiff R C ε D β S)
        ((map₂ idSpHom g.toGrSpeciesHom).app S)) :
    FreeGrL.SurjAt R D'.toSpEnd D.toSpEnd g.toGrSpeciesHom S
      ∧ FreeGrL.InjAt R D'.toSpEnd D.toSpEnd g.toGrSpeciesHom S
proof:
:=
  hd.toGen.qiso_step (fun _ _ _ z => twD_unitOf ε hd.hβ hd.hβ1 z)
    (fun _ _ _ z => twD_unitOf ε' hd.hβ' hd.hβ1' z) hred hS hlow hqS

name: Operad.GrComposite.TwCompareData.qiso_converse
statement:
theorem TwCompareData.qiso_converse
    (hred : ∀ (A : Type) [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A], Fintype.card A ≤ 1 →
      ∀ x : C A, x ∈ unitSpan R C A)
    (hq : ∀ (S : Type) [Fintype S] [DecidableEq S],
      QIso.Surj ⊤ ⊤ (twDiff R C ε' D' β' S) (twDiff R C ε D β S)
          ((map₂ idSpHom g.toGrSpeciesHom).app S)
        ∧ QIso.Inj ⊤ ⊤ (twDiff R C ε' D' β' S) (twDiff R C ε D β S)
          ((map₂ idSpHom g.toGrSpeciesHom).app S))
    (A : Type) [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] :
    FreeGrL.SurjAt R D'.toSpEnd D.toSpEnd g.toGrSpeciesHom A
      ∧ FreeGrL.InjAt R D'.toSpEnd D.toSpEnd g.toGrSpeciesHom A
proof:
:=
  hd.toGen.qiso_converse (fun _ _ _ z => twD_unitOf ε hd.hβ hd.hβ1 z)
    (fun _ _ _ z => twD_unitOf ε' hd.hβ' hd.hβ1' z) hred hq A

name: Operad.LTree.zipDec_mapDec
statement:
lemma zipDec_mapDec : ∀ x : LTree (E × Bool), zipDec (x.mapDec Prod.fst) (x.mapDec Prod.snd) = x
  | leaf _ => rfl
  | node d l r => by simp only [mapDec_node, zipDec, zipDec_mapDec l, zipDec_mapDec r]

end LTree

namespace ShuffleBar

open LTree Module

section Flags

variable {E : Type v}

                                                                        
def flagBy (C : Finset (ℕ ×ₗ ℕ)) : LTree E → BarTree E
  | leaf a => leaf a
  | node e l r => node (e, decide (key (node e l r) ∈ C)) (flagBy C l) (flagBy C r)

name: Operad.ShuffleBar.full_flagBy
statement:
lemma full_flagBy (C : Finset (ℕ ×ₗ ℕ)) : ∀ m : LTree E, (flagBy C m).mapDec Prod.fst = m
  | leaf _ => rfl
  | node e l r => by rw [flagBy, mapDec_node, full_flagBy C l, full_flagBy C r]

name: Operad.ShuffleBar.minLabel_flagBy
statement:
lemma minLabel_flagBy (C : Finset (ℕ ×ₗ ℕ)) (m : LTree E) :
    (flagBy C m).minLabel = m.minLabel
proof:
:= by
  rw [← minLabel_mapDec Prod.fst, full_flagBy]

name: Operad.ShuffleBar.arity_flagBy
statement: lemma arity_flagBy (C : Finset (ℕ ×ₗ ℕ)) (m : LTree E) : (flagBy C m).arity = m.arity
proof:
:= by
  rw [← arity_mapDec Prod.fst, full_flagBy]

name: Operad.ShuffleBar.labels_flagBy
statement: lemma labels_flagBy (C : Finset (ℕ ×ₗ ℕ)) (m : LTree E) : (flagBy C m).labels = m.labels
proof:
:= by
  rw [← labels_mapDec Prod.fst, full_flagBy]

name: Operad.ShuffleBar.key_flagBy_node
statement:
lemma key_flagBy_node (C : Finset (ℕ ×ₗ ℕ)) (b : Bool) (e : E) (l r : LTree E) :
    key (node (e, b) (flagBy C l) (flagBy C r)) = key (node e l r)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [key_node, minLabel_flagBy, arity_flagBy]

name: Operad.ShuffleBar.cutKeys_flagBy
statement:
lemma cutKeys_flagBy (C : Finset (ℕ ×ₗ ℕ)) :
    ∀ m : LTree E, cutKeys (flagBy C m) = C ∩ m.nodeKeys
  | leaf _ => by simp [flagBy, cutKeys, nodeKeys]
  | node e l r => by
    rw [flagBy, cutKeys, cutKeys_flagBy C l, cutKeys_flagBy C r, nodeKeys, key_flagBy_node]
    ext k
    by_cases hk : key (node e l r) ∈ C
    · simp only [hk, decide_true, if_true, Finset.mem_union, Finset.mem_singleton,
        Finset.mem_inter, Finset.mem_insert]
      constructor
      · rintro (rfl | ⟨h1, h2⟩ | ⟨h1, h2⟩)
        · exact ⟨hk, Or.inl rfl⟩
        · exact ⟨h1, Or.inr (Or.inl h2)⟩
        · exact ⟨h1, Or.inr (Or.inr h2)⟩
      · rintro ⟨h1, rfl | h2 | h2⟩
        · exact Or.inl rfl
        · exact Or.inr (Or.inl ⟨h1, h2⟩)
        · exact Or.inr (Or.inr ⟨h1, h2⟩)
    · simp only [hk, decide_false, Bool.false_eq_true, if_false, Finset.empty_union,
        Finset.mem_union, Finset.mem_inter, Finset.mem_insert]
      constructor
      · rintro (⟨h1, h2⟩ | ⟨h1, h2⟩)
        · exact ⟨h1, Or.inr (Or.inl h2)⟩
        · exact ⟨h1, Or.inr (Or.inr h2)⟩
      · rintro ⟨h1, rfl | h2 | h2⟩
        · exact absurd h1 hk
        · exact Or.inl ⟨h1, h2⟩
        · exact Or.inr ⟨h1, h2⟩

name: Operad.ShuffleBar.edgeKeys_subset_nodeKeys
statement:
lemma edgeKeys_subset_nodeKeys : ∀ m : LTree E, m.edgeKeys ⊆ m.nodeKeys
  | leaf _ => by simp [edgeKeys, edgeWins]
  | node e l r => by
    rw [edgeKeys_node, nodeKeys]
    exact Finset.subset_insert _ _

name: Operad.ShuffleBar.key_not_mem_edgeKeys
statement: lemma key_not_mem_edgeKeys (e : E) (l r : LTree E) : key (node e l r) ∉ (node e l r).edgeKeys
proof:
:= by
  rw [edgeKeys_node, Finset.mem_union, not_or]
  exact ⟨key_not_mem_left e l r, key_not_mem_right e l r⟩

name: Operad.ShuffleBar.rootFlag_flagBy
statement:
lemma rootFlag_flagBy {C : Finset (ℕ ×ₗ ℕ)} :
    ∀ {m : LTree E}, C ⊆ m.edgeKeys → rootFlag (flagBy C m) = false
  | leaf _, _ => rfl
  | node e l r, hC => by
    simp only [flagBy, rootFlag, decide_eq_false_iff_not]
    exact fun h => key_not_mem_edgeKeys e l r (hC h)

name: Operad.ShuffleBar.flagBy_congr
statement:
lemma flagBy_congr {C C' : Finset (ℕ ×ₗ ℕ)} :
    ∀ m : LTree E, (∀ k ∈ m.nodeKeys, k ∈ C ↔ k ∈ C') → flagBy C m = flagBy C' m
  | leaf _, _ => rfl
  | node e l r, h => by
    have hk
proof:
:= h _ (Finset.mem_insert_self _ _)
    rw [flagBy, flagBy,
      flagBy_congr l fun k hk' => h k (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem (Finset.mem_union_left _ hk')),
      flagBy_congr r fun k hk' => h k (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem (Finset.mem_union_right _ hk')),
      decide_eq_decide.2 hk]

name: Operad.ShuffleBar.flagBy_cutKeys
statement:
lemma flagBy_cutKeys : ∀ x : BarTree E, x.labels.Nodup → flagBy (cutKeys x) (x.mapDec Prod.fst) = x
  | leaf _, _ => rfl
  | node d l r, hnd => by
    have hnd' : (l.labels ++ r.labels).Nodup
proof:
:= by simpa using hnd
    have hl : l.labels.Nodup := (List.nodup_append.1 hnd').1
    have hr : r.labels.Nodup := (List.nodup_append.1 hnd').2.1
    have hdisj := disjoint_nodeKeys hnd
    have hkey : key (node d.1 (l.mapDec Prod.fst) (r.mapDec Prod.fst)) = key (node d l r) :=
      key_mapDec Prod.fst (node d l r)
    rw [mapDec_node, flagBy, hkey,
      flagBy_congr (l.mapDec Prod.fst) (C' := cutKeys l) ?_, flagBy_cutKeys l hl,
      flagBy_congr (r.mapDec Prod.fst) (C' := cutKeys r) ?_, flagBy_cutKeys r hr]
    · refine congrArg (fun b => node b l r) (Prod.ext rfl ?_)
      cases hd : d.2
      · rw [decide_eq_false_iff_not]
        intro h
        simp only [cutKeys, hd, Bool.false_eq_true, if_false, Finset.empty_union,
          Finset.mem_union] at h
        rcases h with h | h
        · exact key_not_mem_left d l r (cutKeys_subset l h)
        · exact key_not_mem_right d l r (cutKeys_subset r h)
      · rw [decide_eq_true_iff]
        simp [cutKeys, hd]
    · intro k hk
      rw [nodeKeys_mapDec] at hk
      have h1 : k ≠ key (node d l r) := fun h => key_not_mem_right d l r (by rw [← h]; exact hk)
      have h2 : k ∉ cutKeys l := fun h => Finset.disjoint_left.1 hdisj (cutKeys_subset l h) hk
      simp only [cutKeys, Finset.mem_union]
      split_ifs <;> simp [h1, h2]
    · intro k hk
      rw [nodeKeys_mapDec] at hk
      have h1 : k ≠ key (node d l r) := fun h => key_not_mem_left d l r (by rw [← h]; exact hk)
      have h2 : k ∉ cutKeys r := fun h => Finset.disjoint_left.1 hdisj hk (cutKeys_subset r h)
      simp only [cutKeys, Finset.mem_union]
      split_ifs <;> simp [h1, h2]

name: Operad.ShuffleBar.edgeWins_map_snd
statement:
lemma edgeWins_map_snd : ∀ t : LTree E, t.edgeWins.map Prod.snd = t.windows
  | leaf _ => rfl
  | node e l r => by
    have hl
proof:
:= edgeWins_map_snd l
    have hr := edgeWins_map_snd r
    simp only [edgeWins, windows, List.map_append, hl, hr]
    cases l <;> cases r <;> rfl

name: Operad.ShuffleBar.isFull_iff_windows
statement:
lemma isFull_iff_windows {L : Set (LTree E)} {t : LTree E} :
    IsFull L t ↔ ∀ w ∈ t.windows, w ∈ L
proof:
:= by
  rw [← edgeWins_map_snd, IsFull, List.forall_mem_map]

name: Operad.ShuffleBar.isFull_std
statement: lemma isFull_std {L : Set (LTree E)} {t : LTree E} : IsFull L (std t) ↔ IsFull L t
proof:
:= by
  simp only [isFull_iff_windows, std, mem_windows_relabel (strictOn_count t)]

name: Operad.ShuffleBar.mem_barTrees
statement: lemma mem_barTrees {n s : ℕ} {x : BarTree E} (hx : Adm n s x) : x ∈ barTrees n
proof:
:= by
  refine Finset.mem_image.2 ⟨(x.mapDec Prod.fst, x.mapDec Prod.snd),
    Finset.mem_product.2 ⟨full_mem_monomials hx, ?_⟩, zipDec_mapDec x⟩
  exact (mem_monomials _ _).2 ⟨(isShuffle_mapDec _ x).2 hx.1.shuffle, by simpa using hx.2.1⟩

name: Operad.ShuffleBar.finite_adm
statement: lemma finite_adm (n s : ℕ) : {x : BarTree E | Adm n s x}.Finite
proof:
:=
  (barTrees n).finite_toSet.subset fun _ hx => mem_barTrees hx

name: Operad.ShuffleBar.finite_nrm
statement: lemma finite_nrm (L : Set (LTree E)) (n s : ℕ) : (Nrm L n s).Finite
proof:
:=
  (finite_adm n s).subset fun _ hx => hx.1

name: Operad.ShuffleBar.nrm_zero
statement: lemma nrm_zero (L : Set (LTree E)) (n : ℕ) : Nrm L n 0 = ∅
proof:
:=
  Set.eq_empty_of_forall_notMem fun _ hx => by have := hx.1.2.2; omega

name: Operad.ShuffleBar.adm_top_normal
statement:
lemma adm_top_normal (L : Set (LTree E)) {n : ℕ} {x : BarTree E} (hx : Adm n (n - 1) x) :
    NormalBar L x
proof:
:= by
  intro kw hkw hc
  exfalso
  have hsub := cutKeys_subset_edgeKeys hx.1.root
  have hlen : x.arity = n := by rw [← length_labels, hx.2.1.length_eq, List.length_range]
  cases x with
  | leaf a =>
    simp [mapDec, edgeWins] at hkw
  | node d l r =>
    have hnd : (node d.1 (l.mapDec Prod.fst) (r.mapDec Prod.fst)).labels.Nodup := by
      simpa using hx.1.nodup
    have hcard := card_edgeKeys hnd
    have harity : (node d.1 (l.mapDec Prod.fst) (r.mapDec Prod.fst)).arity = n := by
      rw [← hlen]
      simp [arity]
    have hc2 := hx.2.2
    simp only [mapDec_node] at hsub hkw
    have heq : cutKeys (node d l r) = (node d.1 (l.mapDec Prod.fst) (r.mapDec Prod.fst)).edgeKeys :=
      Finset.eq_of_subset_of_card_le hsub (by omega)
    exact hc (heq ▸ mem_edgeKeys.2 ⟨kw.2, hkw⟩)

name: Operad.ShuffleBar.finiteDimensional_supported
statement:
lemma finiteDimensional_supported {S : Set (BarTree E)} (hS : S.Finite) :
    FiniteDimensional K (Finsupp.supported K K S)
proof:
:= by
  haveI := hS.fintype
  exact LinearEquiv.finiteDimensional (Finsupp.supportedEquivFinsupp S).symm

name: Operad.ShuffleBar.finrank_supported
statement:
lemma finrank_supported {S : Set (BarTree E)} (hS : S.Finite) :
    finrank K (Finsupp.supported K K S) = S.ncard
proof:
:= by
  haveI := hS.fintype
  rw [(Finsupp.supportedEquivFinsupp S).finrank_eq, Module.finrank_finsupp_self,
    ← Nat.card_eq_fintype_card, Nat.card_coe_set_eq]

name: Operad.ShuffleBar.finrank_eq_map_add
statement:
lemma finrank_eq_map_add {M M' : Type*} [AddCommGroup M] [Module K M] [AddCommGroup M']
    [Module K M'] (f : M →ₗ[K] M') (p : Submodule K M) [FiniteDimensional K p] :
    finrank K p = finrank K (p.map f) + finrank K (p ⊓ LinearMap.ker f : Submodule K M)
proof:
:= by
  have h := (f.domRestrict p).finrank_range_add_finrank_ker
  rw [LinearMap.range_domRestrict, LinearMap.ker_domRestrict] at h
  rw [← h, ← Submodule.map_comap_subtype,
    ← (Submodule.equivMapOfInjective _ p.injective_subtype _).finrank_eq]

name: Operad.ShuffleBar.altSum_succ
statement:
lemma altSum_succ (a : ℕ → ℤ) (m : ℕ) :
    ∑ s ∈ Finset.range (m + 2), (-1) ^ (m + 1 - s) * a s =
      a (m + 1) - ∑ s ∈ Finset.range (m + 1), (-1) ^ (m - s) * a s
proof:
:= by
  rw [Finset.sum_range_succ, Nat.sub_self, pow_zero, one_mul, sub_eq_add_neg, add_comm,
    ← Finset.sum_neg_distrib]
  congr 1
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun s hs => ?_
  rw [Finset.mem_range] at hs
  rw [show m + 1 - s = (m - s) + 1 by omega, pow_succ]
  ring

name: Operad.ShuffleBar.euler
statement:
lemma euler (a z b : ℕ → ℤ) (top : ℕ) (ha0 : a 0 = 0) (hb0 : b 0 = 0)
    (ha : ∀ s, 1 ≤ s → s ≤ top → a s = z s + b (s - 1))
    (hz : ∀ s, 1 ≤ s → s < top → z s = b s) :
    ∀ m, 1 ≤ m → m ≤ top → ∑ s ∈ Finset.range (m + 1), (-1) ^ (m - s) * a s = z m
proof:
:= by
  intro m hm hmt
  induction m with
  | zero => omega
  | succ m ih =>
    rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos m with rfl | hm'
    · simp [Finset.sum_range_succ, ha0, ha 1 le_rfl hmt, hb0]
    · rw [altSum_succ, ih hm' (by omega), ha (m + 1) (by omega) hmt, Nat.add_sub_cancel,
        hz m hm' (by omega)]
      ring

name: Operad.ShuffleBar.C_zero
statement: lemma C_zero (n : ℕ) : C (E := E) K n 0 = ⊥
proof:
:= by
  refine (Submodule.eq_bot_iff _).2 fun v hv => ?_
  ext y
  by_contra h
  have := (Finsupp.mem_supported K v).1 hv (Finsupp.mem_support_iff.2 h)
  exact absurd this.2.2 (by omega)

name: Operad.ShuffleBar.KD_of_lt_two
statement: lemma KD_of_lt_two (R : Submodule K (Mono E 3 → K)) {n : ℕ} (hn : n < 2) : KD K R n = ⊥
proof:
:= by
  rw [KD, show n - 1 = 0 by omega, C_zero, bot_inf_eq]

name: Operad.ShuffleBar.mem_J_iff
statement:
lemma mem_J_iff {n s : ℕ} {v : BarTree E →₀ K} (hv : v ∈ C K n s) :
    v ∈ J K R ↔ ΦL K hG.data v = 0
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨ΦL_J K hG.data, fun h => ?_⟩
  have := (ΦL_spec K hG.data hv).2
  rwa [h, sub_zero] at this

name: Operad.ShuffleBar.C_of_nrm
statement:
lemma C_of_nrm {n s : ℕ} {v : BarTree E →₀ K} (hv : v ∈ Finsupp.supported K K (Nrm L n s)) :
    v ∈ C K n s
proof:
:=
  Finsupp.supported_mono (fun _ hy => hy.1) hv

name: Operad.ShuffleBar.normalized_eq
statement:
lemma normalized_eq {n s : ℕ} {v : BarTree E →₀ K} (hv : v ∈ C K n s) :
    ΦL K hG.data v ∈ Finsupp.supported K K (Nrm L n s) ∧ v - ΦL K hG.data v ∈ J K R
proof:
:=
  ΦL_spec K hG.data hv

name: Operad.ShuffleBar.normalized_injective
statement:
lemma normalized_injective {n s : ℕ} {v : BarTree E →₀ K}
    (hv : v ∈ Finsupp.supported K K (Nrm L n s)) (hJ : v ∈ J K R) : v = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [← ΦL_normal K hG.data hv, ΦL_J K hG.data hJ]

name: Operad.ShuffleBar.dN_mem
statement:
lemma dN_mem {n s : ℕ} {v : BarTree E →₀ K} (hv : v ∈ Finsupp.supported K K (Nrm L n (s + 1))) :
    dN K rk hG v ∈ Finsupp.supported K K (Nrm L n s)
proof:
:=
  (ΦL_spec K hG.data (d_mem_C K (C_of_nrm K hv))).1

name: Operad.ShuffleBar.dN_dN
statement:
lemma dN_dN {n s : ℕ} {v : BarTree E →₀ K} (hv : v ∈ Finsupp.supported K K (Nrm L n (s + 2))) :
    dN K rk hG (dN K rk hG v) = 0
proof:
:=
  ΦL_d_ΦL_d K hG.data (C_of_nrm K hv)

name: Operad.ShuffleBar.exact_dN
proof:
:= by
  have hvC := C_of_nrm K hv
  have hdv : d K v ∈ J K R := (mem_J_iff K rk hG (d_mem_C K hvC)).2 h
  obtain ⟨y, hy, hvy⟩ := isKoszul K rk hG n (s + 1) (by omega) v hvC hdv
  obtain ⟨hyN, hyJ⟩ := ΦL_spec K hG.data hy
  refine ⟨ΦL K hG.data y, hyN, ?_⟩
  have h1 : ΦL K hG.data (d K y) = v := by
    have := ΦL_J K hG.data hvy
    rw [map_sub, ΦL_normal K hG.data hv, sub_eq_zero] at this
    exact this.symm
  have h2 : ΦL K hG.data (d K (y - ΦL K hG.data y)) = 0 := ΦL_J K hG.data (d_mem_J K R hyJ)
  rw [map_sub, map_sub, h1, sub_eq_zero] at h2
  exact h2.symm

name: Operad.ShuffleBar.KD_eq
statement:
lemma KD_eq {n : ℕ} (hn : 2 ≤ n) :
    KD K R n = Finsupp.supported K K (Nrm L n (n - 1)) ⊓ LinearMap.ker (dN K rk hG)
proof:
:= by
  have hC : C K n (n - 1) = Finsupp.supported K K (Nrm L n (n - 1)) :=
    le_antisymm (Finsupp.supported_mono fun x hx => ⟨hx, adm_top_normal L hx⟩)
      (Finsupp.supported_mono fun _ hx => hx.1)
  ext v
  simp only [KD, Submodule.mem_inf, Submodule.mem_comap, LinearMap.mem_ker, hC]
  refine and_congr_right fun hv => ?_
  have hdv : d K v ∈ C K n (n - 2) :=
    d_mem_C K (n := n) (s := n - 2) (by rw [show n - 2 + 1 = n - 1 by omega, hC]; exact hv)
  exact mem_J_iff K rk hG hdv

name: Operad.ShuffleBar.finrank_KD
statement:
theorem finrank_KD {n : ℕ} (hn : 2 ≤ n) :
    (finrank K (KD K R n) : ℤ) =
      ∑ s ∈ Finset.range n, (-1) ^ (n - 1 - s) * ((Nrm L n s).ncard : ℤ)
proof:
:= by
  set N : ℕ → Submodule K (BarTree E →₀ K) := fun s => Finsupp.supported K K (Nrm L n s)
  have hfd : ∀ s, FiniteDimensional K (N s) := fun s =>
    finiteDimensional_supported K (finite_nrm L n s)
  let a : ℕ → ℤ := fun s => (Nrm L n s).ncard
  let z : ℕ → ℤ := fun s => finrank K (N s ⊓ LinearMap.ker (dN K rk hG) : Submodule K _)
  let b : ℕ → ℤ := fun s => finrank K ((N (s + 1)).map (dN K rk hG))
  have hmap : ∀ s, (N (s + 1)).map (dN K rk hG) ≤ N s := by
    rintro s _ ⟨v, hv, rfl⟩
    exact dN_mem K rk hG hv
  have ha0 : a 0 = 0 := by simp [a, nrm_zero]
  have hb0 : b 0 = 0 := by
    have : (N 1).map (dN K rk hG) = ⊥ := by
      refine eq_bot_iff.2 ((hmap 0).trans ?_)
      simp [N, nrm_zero]
    simp [b, this]
  have ha : ∀ s, 1 ≤ s → s ≤ n - 1 → a s = z s + b (s - 1) := by
    intro s hs _
    obtain ⟨t, rfl⟩ : ∃ t, s = t + 1 := ⟨s - 1, by omega⟩
    have := finrank_eq_map_add K (dN K rk hG) (N (t + 1))
    rw [finrank_supported K (finite_nrm L n (t + 1))] at this
    simp only [a, z, b, Nat.add_sub_cancel, this]
    push_cast
    ring
  have hz : ∀ s, 1 ≤ s → s < n - 1 → z s = b s := by
    intro s hs hsn
    obtain ⟨t, rfl⟩ : ∃ t, s = t + 1 := ⟨s - 1, by omega⟩
    have : N (t + 1) ⊓ LinearMap.ker (dN K rk hG) = (N (t + 1 + 1)).map (dN K rk hG) := by
      refine le_antisymm ?_ ?_
      · rintro v ⟨hv, hdv⟩
        obtain ⟨w, hw, rfl⟩ := exact_dN K rk hG (by omega) hv hdv
        exact ⟨w, hw, rfl⟩
      · rintro _ ⟨w, hw, rfl⟩
        exact ⟨hmap (t + 1) ⟨w, hw, rfl⟩, dN_dN K rk hG hw⟩
    simp only [z, b]
    rw [this]
  have key := euler a z b (n - 1) ha0 hb0 ha hz (n - 1) (by omega) le_rfl
  rw [show n - 1 + 1 = n by omega] at key
  rw [key, KD_eq K rk hG hn]

name: Operad.ShuffleBar.finrank_KD_eq
statement:
theorem finrank_KD_eq {R' : Submodule K (Mono E 3 → K)} (hG' : IsGroebner K rk L R') (n : ℕ) :
    finrank K (KD K R n) = finrank K (KD K R' n)
proof:
:= by
  rcases lt_or_ge n 2 with hn | hn
  · rw [KD_of_lt_two K R hn, KD_of_lt_two K R' hn]
  · have h := finrank_KD K rk hG hn
    rw [← finrank_KD K rk hG' hn] at h
    exact_mod_cast h

name: Operad.ShuffleBar.nodup_edgeWins_keys
statement:
lemma nodup_edgeWins_keys {m : LTree E} (hnd : m.labels.Nodup) :
    (m.edgeWins.map Prod.fst).Nodup
proof:
:=
  (List.nodup_append.1 ((perm_keyList m).nodup_iff.1 (nodup_keyList m hnd))).2.1

name: Operad.ShuffleBar.ncard_nrm
statement:
lemma ncard_nrm (L : Set (LTree E)) (n s : ℕ) :
    (Nrm L n s).ncard = ∑ m ∈ monomials (E := E) n, (m.edgeKeys.powerset.filter
      fun C => C.card + 1 = s ∧ ∀ kw ∈ m.edgeWins, kw.1 ∉ C → kw.2 ∉ L).card
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Finset.card_sigma]
  set T := (monomials (E := E) n).sigma fun m => m.edgeKeys.powerset.filter
    fun C => C.card + 1 = s ∧ ∀ kw ∈ m.edgeWins, kw.1 ∉ C → kw.2 ∉ L
  have hT : Nrm L n s = ↑(T.image fun p => flagBy p.2 p.1) := by
    ext x
    simp only [T, Finset.coe_image, Set.mem_image, Finset.mem_coe, Finset.mem_sigma,
      Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_powerset]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨hx, hN⟩
      exact ⟨⟨x.mapDec Prod.fst, cutKeys x⟩, ⟨full_mem_monomials hx,
        cutKeys_subset_edgeKeys hx.1.root, hx.2.2, hN⟩, flagBy_cutKeys x hx.1.nodup⟩
    · rintro ⟨⟨m, C⟩, ⟨hm, hC, hs, hg⟩, rfl⟩
      obtain ⟨hms, hml⟩ := (mem_monomials _ _).1 hm
      have hcut : cutKeys (flagBy C m) = C :=
        (cutKeys_flagBy C m).trans (Finset.inter_eq_left.2 (hC.trans (edgeKeys_subset_nodeKeys m)))
      refine ⟨⟨⟨(isShuffle_mapDec Prod.fst _).1 (by rw [full_flagBy]; exact hms),
        by rw [labels_flagBy]; exact hml.nodup_iff.2 List.nodup_range, rootFlag_flagBy hC⟩,
        by rw [labels_flagBy]; exact hml, by rw [hcut]; exact hs⟩, ?_⟩
      intro kw hkw hk
      rw [full_flagBy] at hkw
      rw [hcut] at hk
      exact hg kw hkw hk
  rw [hT, Set.ncard_coe_finset, Finset.card_image_of_injOn]
  rintro ⟨m, C⟩ hp ⟨m', C'⟩ hp' h
  simp only [T, Finset.coe_sigma, Set.mem_sigma_iff, Finset.mem_coe, Finset.mem_filter,
    Finset.mem_powerset] at hp hp' h
  have hm : m = m' := by rw [← full_flagBy C m, h, full_flagBy]
  subst hm
  have hC : C = C' := by
    have h1 := cutKeys_flagBy C m
    have h2 := cutKeys_flagBy C' m
    rw [h, h2, Finset.inter_eq_left.2 (hp'.2.1.trans (edgeKeys_subset_nodeKeys m)),
      Finset.inter_eq_left.2 (hp.2.1.trans (edgeKeys_subset_nodeKeys m))] at h1
    exact h1.symm
  rw [hC]

name: Operad.ShuffleBar.sum_good_sets
statement:
lemma sum_good_sets (L : Set (LTree E)) {m : LTree E} (hnd : m.labels.Nodup) [DecidablePred
    fun C : Finset (ℕ ×ₗ ℕ) => ∀ kw ∈ m.edgeWins, kw.1 ∉ C → kw.2 ∉ L] [Decidable (IsFull L m)] :
    ∑ C ∈ m.edgeKeys.powerset.filter (fun C => ∀ kw ∈ m.edgeWins, kw.1 ∉ C → kw.2 ∉ L),
      (-1 : ℤ) ^ (m.edgeKeys \ C).card = if IsFull L m then 1 else 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  set Ed := m.edgeKeys
  set G := Ed.filter fun k => ∃ w, (k, w) ∈ m.edgeWins ∧ w ∈ L
  have hgood : ∀ C ⊆ Ed, (∀ kw ∈ m.edgeWins, kw.1 ∉ C → kw.2 ∉ L) ↔ G ⊆ C := by
    intro C _
    constructor
    · intro h k hk
      obtain ⟨-, w, hw, hwL⟩ := Finset.mem_filter.1 hk
      by_contra hkC
      exact h (k, w) hw hkC hwL
    · intro h kw hkw hkC hL
      exact hkC (h (Finset.mem_filter.2 ⟨mem_edgeKeys.2 ⟨kw.2, hkw⟩, kw.2, hkw, hL⟩))
  have hGEd : G ⊆ Ed := Finset.filter_subset _ _
  calc ∑ C ∈ Ed.powerset.filter (fun C => ∀ kw ∈ m.edgeWins, kw.1 ∉ C → kw.2 ∉ L),
        (-1 : ℤ) ^ (Ed \ C).card
      = ∑ D ∈ (Ed \ G).powerset, (-1 : ℤ) ^ D.card := by
        refine Finset.sum_nbij' (fun C => Ed \ C) (fun D => Ed \ D) ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_
        · intro C hC
          rw [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_powerset] at hC
          rw [Finset.mem_powerset]
          exact Finset.sdiff_subset_sdiff (subset_refl _) ((hgood C hC.1).1 hC.2)
        · intro D hD
          rw [Finset.mem_powerset] at hD
          rw [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_powerset]
          refine ⟨Finset.sdiff_subset, (hgood _ Finset.sdiff_subset).2 fun k hk => ?_⟩
          refine Finset.mem_sdiff.2 ⟨hGEd hk, fun hkD => ?_⟩
          exact (Finset.mem_sdiff.1 (hD hkD)).2 hk
        · intro C hC
          rw [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_powerset] at hC
          exact Finset.sdiff_sdiff_eq_self hC.1
        · intro D hD
          rw [Finset.mem_powerset] at hD
          exact Finset.sdiff_sdiff_eq_self (hD.trans Finset.sdiff_subset)
        · intro C _
          rfl
    _ = if IsFull L m then 1 else 0 := by
        rw [Finset.sum_powerset_neg_one_pow_card]
        congr 1
        apply propext
        rw [Finset.sdiff_eq_empty_iff_subset]
        constructor
        · intro h kw hkw
          obtain ⟨-, w, hw, hwL⟩ := Finset.mem_filter.1 (h (mem_edgeKeys.2 ⟨kw.2, hkw⟩))
          have := List.inj_on_of_nodup_map (nodup_edgeWins_keys hnd) hkw hw rfl
          rw [this]
          exact hwL
        · intro h k hk
          obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ := mem_edgeKeys.1 hk
          exact Finset.mem_filter.2 ⟨hk, w, hw, h _ hw⟩

name: Operad.ShuffleBar.sum_ncard_nrm
statement:
theorem sum_ncard_nrm (L : Set (LTree E)) {n : ℕ} (hn : 2 ≤ n) :
    ∑ s ∈ Finset.range n, (-1 : ℤ) ^ (n - 1 - s) * ((Nrm L n s).ncard : ℤ) =
      (((monomials (E := E) n).filter (IsFull L)).card : ℤ)
proof:
:= by
  simp_rw [ncard_nrm, Nat.cast_sum, Finset.mul_sum]
  rw [Finset.sum_comm, Finset.card_filter, Nat.cast_sum]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun m hm => ?_
  obtain ⟨-, hml⟩ := (mem_monomials _ _).1 hm
  have hnd : m.labels.Nodup := hml.nodup_iff.2 List.nodup_range
  have hEd : m.edgeKeys.card + 2 = n := by
    cases m with
    | leaf a =>
      have := hml.length_eq
      simp at this
      omega
    | node e l r =>
      rw [card_edgeKeys hnd, ← length_labels, hml.length_eq, List.length_range]
  rw [Nat.cast_ite, Nat.cast_one, Nat.cast_zero, ← sum_good_sets L hnd]
  simp_rw [Finset.card_filter, Nat.cast_sum, Finset.mul_sum, Nat.cast_ite, Nat.cast_one,
    Nat.cast_zero, mul_ite, mul_one, mul_zero]
  rw [Finset.sum_comm, Finset.sum_filter]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun C hC => ?_
  rw [Finset.mem_powerset] at hC
  have hcard := Finset.card_le_card hC
  split_ifs with hg
  · rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl fun x _ => if_congr (and_iff_left hg) rfl rfl,
      Finset.sum_ite_eq (Finset.range n) (C.card + 1), if_pos (Finset.mem_range.2 (by omega)),
      Finset.card_sdiff_of_subset hC]
    congr 1
    omega
  · exact Finset.sum_eq_zero fun x _ => if_neg fun h => hg h.2

name: Operad.ShuffleBar.finrank_KD_eq_ncard
statement:
theorem finrank_KD_eq_ncard {n : ℕ} (hn : 2 ≤ n) :
    finrank K (KD K R n) = {m | m ∈ monomials (E := E) n ∧ IsFull L m}.ncard
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have h := finrank_KD K rk hG hn
  rw [sum_ncard_nrm L hn] at h
  have hset : {m | m ∈ monomials (E := E) n ∧ IsFull L m} =
      ↑((monomials (E := E) n).filter (IsFull L)) := by
    ext m
    simp
  rw [hset, Set.ncard_coe_finset]
  exact_mod_cast h

name: Operad.TreeOfArity.reindexS_val
statement:
lemma reindexS_val {m n : ℕ} (h : m = n) (t : TreeOfArity E m) :
    (reindexS (TreeOfArity E) h t).1 = t.1
proof:
:= by
  subst h
  rfl

name: Operad.TreeOfArity.one_val
statement: @[simp] lemma one_val : (NSSetOperad.one : TreeOfArity E 1).1 = .leaf
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.TreeOfArity.comp_val
statement:
@[simp] lemma comp_val (a b : ℕ) {n : ℕ} (t : TreeOfArity E (a + 1 + b)) (s : TreeOfArity E n) :
    (NSSetOperad.comp a b t s).1 = t.1.graft a s.1
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.TreeOfArity.arr_ext
statement: lemma arr_ext {X Y : Arr (TreeOfArity E)} (h : X.2.1 = Y.2.1) : X = Y
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨n, t, rfl⟩ := X
  obtain ⟨m, t', rfl⟩ := Y
  simp only at h
  subst h
  rfl

name: Operad.TreeOfArity.toArr_comp
statement:
lemma toArr_comp (t : Tree E) (i : ℕ) (s : Tree E) (h : i < t.arity) :
    (toArr t).comp i (toArr s) = toArr (t.graft i s)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨b, x, hx⟩ := Arr.exists_mk (toArr t) h
  refine arr_ext ?_
  rw [hx, Arr.mk_comp]
  show (x.1.graft i s) = t.graft i s
  have : x.1 = t := by
    have := congrArg (fun X : Arr (TreeOfArity E) => X.2.1) hx
    exact this.symm
  rw [this]

name: Operad.TreeOfArity.arityF_leaves
statement:
@[simp] lemma arityF_leaves : ∀ k : ℕ, (leaves (E := E) k).arityF = k
  | 0 => rfl
  | k + 1 => by
    simp only [leaves, Tree.arityF_cons, Tree.arity_leaf, arityF_leaves k]
    omega

                                      
def corolla {k : ℕ} (e : E k) : TreeOfArity E k
proof:
:=
  ⟨.node e (leaves k), by simp⟩

name: Operad.TreeOfArity.evalArr_fst
statement:
lemma evalArr_fst : ∀ t : Tree E, (evalArr f t).1 = t.arity
  | .leaf => rfl
  | .node e fo => by
    rw [evalArr, fillF_fst fo (⟨_, f _ e⟩ : Arr S) 0 (by simp)]
    simp

name: Operad.TreeOfArity.fillF_fst
statement:
lemma fillF_fst : ∀ {k : ℕ} (fo : Forest E k) (X : Arr S) (p : ℕ), p + k ≤ X.1 →
    (fillF f X p fo).1 = X.1 - k + fo.arityF
  | _, .nil, X, p, _ => by simp [fillF]
  | k + 1, .cons t fo, X, p, h => by
    have hp : p < X.1
proof:
:= by omega
    have h1 : (X.comp p (evalArr f t)).1 = X.1 + t.arity - 1 := by
      rw [Arr.comp_fst hp, evalArr_fst t]
    rw [fillF, fillF_fst fo _ (p + t.arity) (by rw [h1]; omega), h1, Tree.arityF_cons]
    omega

name: Operad.TreeOfArity.fillF_comp_left
statement:
lemma fillF_comp_left : ∀ {k : ℕ} (fo : Forest E k) (X Y : Arr S) (a p : ℕ), a < p →
    p + k ≤ X.1 → fillF f (X.comp a Y) (p + Y.1 - 1) fo = (fillF f X p fo).comp a Y
  | _, .nil, _, _, _, _, _, _ => rfl
  | k + 1, .cons t fo, X, Y, a, p, hap, h => by
    have hp : p < X.1
proof:
:= by omega
    have h1 : (X.comp p (evalArr f t)).1 = X.1 + t.arity - 1 := by
      rw [Arr.comp_fst hp, evalArr_fst f t]
    rw [fillF, fillF, Arr.comp_comp_disjoint Y (evalArr f t) hap hp,
      show p + Y.1 - 1 + t.arity = p + t.arity + Y.1 - 1 by omega,
      fillF_comp_left fo _ Y a (p + t.arity) (by omega) (by rw [h1]; omega)]

name: Operad.TreeOfArity.evalArr_graft
statement:
theorem evalArr_graft : ∀ (t : Tree E) (i : ℕ) (s : Tree E), i < t.arity →
    evalArr f (t.graft i s) = (evalArr f t).comp i (evalArr f s)
  | .leaf, i, s, h => by
    obtain rfl : i = 0
proof:
:= by simp only [Tree.arity_leaf] at h; omega
    rw [Tree.graft_leaf, evalArr]
    exact (Arr.one_comp _).symm
  | .node e fo, i, s, h => by
    rw [Tree.graft_node, evalArr, evalArr,
      fillF_graftF fo (⟨_, f _ e⟩ : Arr S) 0 i s (by simpa using h) (by simp), zero_add]

name: Operad.TreeOfArity.fillF_graftF
statement:
theorem fillF_graftF : ∀ {k : ℕ} (fo : Forest E k) (X : Arr S) (p i : ℕ) (s : Tree E),
    i < fo.arityF → p + k ≤ X.1 →
    fillF f X p (fo.graftF i s) = (fillF f X p fo).comp (p + i) (evalArr f s)
  | _, .nil, _, _, _, _, h, _ => by simp at h
  | k + 1, .cons t fo, X, p, i, s, h, hX => by
    simp only [Tree.arityF_cons] at h
    have hp : p < X.1
proof:
:= by omega
    by_cases hi : i < t.arity
    · rw [Tree.graftF_cons_of_lt s hi, fillF, fillF, evalArr_graft t i s hi,
        ← Arr.comp_comp_nested (evalArr f s) hp (by rw [evalArr_fst f t]; exact hi),
        Tree.arity_graft t i s hi, ← evalArr_fst f s,
        show p + (t.arity - 1 + (evalArr f s).1) = p + t.arity + (evalArr f s).1 - 1 by omega,
        fillF_comp_left f fo _ (evalArr f s) (p + i) (p + t.arity) (by omega)
          (by rw [Arr.comp_fst hp, evalArr_fst f t]; omega)]
    · rw [Tree.graftF_cons_of_ge s (by omega), fillF, fillF,
        fillF_graftF fo _ (p + t.arity) (i - t.arity) s (by omega)
          (by rw [Arr.comp_fst hp, evalArr_fst f t]; omega),
        show p + t.arity + (i - t.arity) = p + i by omega]

name: Operad.TreeOfArity.fillF_leaves
statement:
lemma fillF_leaves : ∀ (k : ℕ) (X : Arr S) (p : ℕ), p + k ≤ X.1 → fillF f X p (leaves k) = X
  | 0, _, _, _ => rfl
  | k + 1, X, p, h => by
    rw [leaves, fillF, show evalArr f (Tree.leaf : Tree E) = Arr.one from rfl,
      Arr.comp_one (by omega), Tree.arity_leaf, fillF_leaves k X (p + 1) (by omega)]

mutual

name: Operad.TreeOfArity.map_evalArr
statement:
lemma map_evalArr {T : ℕ → Type x} [NSSetOperad T] (φ : NSSetOperadHom S T) :
    ∀ t : Tree E, Arr.map φ (evalArr f t) = evalArr (fun k e => φ.app k (f k e)) t
  | .leaf => by rw [evalArr, Arr.map_one]; rfl
  | .node e fo => by
    rw [evalArr, evalArr]
    exact map_fillF φ fo _ 0

name: Operad.TreeOfArity.map_fillF
statement:
lemma map_fillF {T : ℕ → Type x} [NSSetOperad T] (φ : NSSetOperadHom S T) :
    ∀ {k : ℕ} (fo : Forest E k) (X : Arr S) (p : ℕ),
      Arr.map φ (fillF f X p fo) = fillF (fun k e => φ.app k (f k e)) (Arr.map φ X) p fo
  | _, .nil, _, _ => rfl
  | _, .cons t fo, X, p => by
    rw [fillF, fillF, map_fillF φ fo, Arr.map_comp, map_evalArr φ t]

end


end Eval

end TreeOfArity

                                

namespace TreeOfArity

variable {E : ℕ → Type v}

                                                                                                   
            
def graftAll {m : ℕ} : {k : ℕ} → Forest E m → ℕ → Forest E k → Forest E m
  | _, F, _, .nil => F
  | _, F, p, .cons t fo => graftAll (F.graftF p t) (p + t.arity) fo

name: Operad.TreeOfArity.graftAll_cons_ge
statement:
lemma graftAll_cons_ge {m : ℕ} (t : Tree E) (G : Forest E m) (q : ℕ) :
    ∀ {k : ℕ} (fo : Forest E k),
      graftAll (Forest.cons t G) (t.arity + q) fo = Forest.cons t (graftAll G q fo)
  | _, .nil => rfl
  | _, .cons s fo => by
    rw [graftAll, graftAll, Tree.graftF_cons_of_ge s (by omega),
      show t.arity + q - t.arity = q by omega, show t.arity + q + s.arity = t.arity + (q + s.arity)
        by omega, graftAll_cons_ge t _ (q + s.arity) fo]

name: Operad.TreeOfArity.graftAll_leaves
statement:
lemma graftAll_leaves : ∀ {k : ℕ} (fo : Forest E k), graftAll (leaves k) 0 fo = fo
  | _, .nil => rfl
  | _, .cons t fo => by
    rw [graftAll, leaves, Tree.graftF_cons_of_lt t (by simp), Tree.graft_leaf, zero_add,
      ← add_zero t.arity, graftAll_cons_ge t _ 0 fo, graftAll_leaves fo]

mutual

name: Operad.TreeOfArity.evalArr_corolla
statement:
theorem evalArr_corolla : ∀ t : Tree E, evalArr (fun _ e => corolla e) t = toArr t
  | .leaf => rfl
  | .node e fo => by
    rw [evalArr, show (⟨_, corolla e⟩ : Arr (TreeOfArity E)) = toArr (.node e (leaves _)) from
      arr_ext rfl, fillF_corolla fo e (leaves _) 0 (by simp), graftAll_leaves]

name: Operad.TreeOfArity.fillF_corolla
statement:
theorem fillF_corolla : ∀ {k : ℕ} (fo : Forest E k) {m : ℕ} (e : E m) (F : Forest E m) (p : ℕ),
    p + k ≤ F.arityF →
    fillF (fun _ e => corolla e) (toArr (.node e F)) p fo = toArr (.node e (graftAll F p fo))
  | _, .nil, _, _, _, _, _ => rfl
  | k + 1, .cons t fo, m, e, F, p, h => by
    rw [fillF, evalArr_corolla t, toArr_comp _ p t (by simp; omega), Tree.graft_node]
    exact fillF_corolla fo e (F.graftF p t) (p + t.arity)
      (by rw [Forest.arityF_graftF F p t (by omega)]; omega)

end

variable {S : ℕ → Type w} [NSSetOperad S]

                                                                              
def lift (f : ∀ k, E k → S k) : NSSetOperadHom (TreeOfArity E) S where
  app n t
proof:
:= reindexS S ((evalArr_fst f t.1).trans t.2) (evalArr f t.1).2
  app_one := rfl
  app_comp a b n α β := by
    apply Arr.mk_eq_mk_iff.1
    rw [Arr.mk_reindexS, ← Arr.mk_comp, Arr.mk_reindexS, Arr.mk_reindexS]
    exact evalArr_graft f α.1 a β.1 (by rw [α.2]; omega)

name: Operad.TreeOfArity.lift_mk
statement:
lemma lift_mk (f : ∀ k, E k → S k) (t : Tree E) :
    Arr.map (lift f) (toArr t) = evalArr f t
proof:
:= by
  unfold toArr lift
  rw [Arr.map_mk]
  exact Arr.mk_reindexS _ _

name: Operad.TreeOfArity.lift_corolla
statement:
@[simp] lemma lift_corolla (f : ∀ k, E k → S k) {k : ℕ} (e : E k) :
    (lift f).app k (corolla e) = f k e
proof:
:= by
  apply Arr.mk_eq_mk_iff.1
  rw [← Arr.map_mk, show (⟨k, corolla e⟩ : Arr (TreeOfArity E)) = toArr (.node e (leaves k)) from
    arr_ext rfl, lift_mk, evalArr, fillF_leaves f k _ 0 (by simp)]

name: Operad.TreeOfArity.map_toArr
statement:
lemma map_toArr (φ : NSSetOperadHom (TreeOfArity E) S) (t : Tree E) :
    Arr.map φ (toArr t) = evalArr (fun k e => φ.app k (corolla e)) t
proof:
:= by
  rw [← evalArr_corolla t, map_evalArr]

name: Operad.TreeOfArity.hom_ext
statement:
theorem hom_ext {φ ψ : NSSetOperadHom (TreeOfArity E) S}
    (h : ∀ k (e : E k), φ.app k (corolla e) = ψ.app k (corolla e)) : φ = ψ
proof:
:= by
  ext n t
  obtain ⟨t, rfl⟩ := t
  have := map_toArr φ t
  rw [show (fun k e => φ.app k (corolla e)) = fun k e => ψ.app k (corolla e) from
    funext fun k => funext (h k), ← map_toArr ψ t] at this
  exact Arr.mk_eq_mk_iff.1 this

name: Operad.FreeReg.regHom_ext
statement:
theorem regHom_ext {S : (A : Type) → [Fintype A] → [DecidableEq A] → Type w} [SetOperad S]
    {G G' : SetOperadHom (Reg (TreeOfArity T)) S}
    (h : ∀ k (e : T k),
      G.app (Fin k) (Reg.std (corolla e)) = G'.app (Fin k) (Reg.std (corolla e))) :
    G = G'
proof:
:=
  Reg.hom_ext fun n x => by
    have := TreeOfArity.hom_ext (φ := (SetOperadHom.toNSSet G).comp Reg.eta)
      (ψ := (SetOperadHom.toNSSet G').comp Reg.eta) h
    exact congrArg (fun φ => NSSetOperadHom.app φ n x) this

name: Operad.FreeReg.toReg_gen
statement: lemma toReg_gen {k : ℕ} (e : T k) : toReg.app (Fin k) (Pres.gen e) = Reg.std (corolla e)
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.FreeReg.ofReg_std
statement:
lemma ofReg_std {k : ℕ} (e : T k) :
    ofReg.app (Fin k) (Reg.std (corolla e)) = (Pres.gen e : FreeSet T (Fin k))
proof:
:= by
  rw [ofReg, Reg.lift_std]
  exact TreeOfArity.lift_corolla (S := SetOperad.toNSSet (FreeSet T)) _ e

name: Operad.FreeReg.finrank_eq
statement:
theorem finrank_eq [Nontrivial R] (A : Type) [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A]
    [Finite (TreeOfArity T (Fintype.card A))] :
    Module.finrank R (Lin R (FreeSet T) A)
      = (Fintype.card A).factorial * Nat.card (TreeOfArity T (Fintype.card A))
proof:
:= by
  haveI : Finite (Reg (TreeOfArity T) A) := by
    unfold Reg
    haveI : Finite {X : Arr (TreeOfArity T) // X.1 = Fintype.card A} :=
      Finite.of_equiv _ (FreeBin.arrEquiv (TreeOfArity T) (Fintype.card A)).symm
    infer_instance
  haveI := Fintype.ofFinite (Reg (TreeOfArity T) A)
  rw [Module.finrank_eq_nat_card_basis (basis R T A), FreeBin.card_reg]

name: Operad.EndOp.ext_ap
statement: lemma ext_ap {x y : Und R (EndOp R V) A} (h : ∀ w, ap x w = ap y w) : x = y
proof:
:=
  (Und.of R (EndOp R V)).symm.injective (MultilinearMap.ext h)

name: Operad.EndOp.ap_map
statement:
@[simp] lemma ap_map (e : A ≃ B) (x : Und R (EndOp R V) A) (w : B → V) :
    ap (map e x) w = ap x fun a => w (e a)
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.EndOp.ap_one
statement: @[simp] lemma ap_one (w : Unit → V) : ap (one : Und R (EndOp R V) Unit) w = w ()
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.EndOp.ap_comp
statement:
lemma ap_comp (i : A) (x : Und R (EndOp R V) A) (y : Und R (EndOp R V) B)
    (w : Without A i ⊕ B → V) :
    ap (comp i x y) w = ap x (feed i w (ap y fun b => w (Sum.inr b)))
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.EndOp.ap_bin
statement:
lemma ap_bin (g : Und R (EndOp R V) (Fin 2)) (x : Und R (EndOp R V) A)
    (y : Und R (EndOp R V) B) (w : A ⊕ B → V) :
    ap (bin g x y) w = ap g ![ap x fun a => w (Sum.inl a), ap y fun b => w (Sum.inr b)]
proof:
:= by
  unfold SetOperad.bin
  rw [ap_map, ap_comp, ap_comp]
  congr 1
  funext k
  fin_cases k <;> rfl

name: Operad.EndOp.vec_two
statement: lemma vec_two (w : Fin 2 → V) : w = ![w 0, w 1]
proof:
:= by
  funext k
  fin_cases k <;> rfl

name: Operad.EndOp.vec_swap
statement: @[simp] lemma vec_swap (x y : V) : (fun a => ![x, y] (Equiv.swap (0 : Fin 2) 1 a)) = ![y, x]
proof:
:= by
  funext k
  fin_cases k <;> simp [Equiv.swap_apply_left, Equiv.swap_apply_right]

name: Operad.EndOp.isComm_iff
statement:
theorem isComm_iff (g : Und R (EndOp R V) (Fin 2)) :
    IsComm g ↔ ∀ x y, ap g ![x, y] = ap g ![y, x]
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h x y
    conv_lhs => rw [← h]
    rw [ap_map]
    congr 1
    funext k
    fin_cases k <;> rfl
  · intro h
    refine ext_ap fun w => ?_
    rw [ap_map, vec_two w, h]
    congr 1
    funext k
    fin_cases k <;> rfl

name: Operad.EndOp.isAssoc_iff
statement:
theorem isAssoc_iff (g : Und R (EndOp R V) (Fin 2)) :
    IsAssoc g ↔ ∀ x y z, ap g ![ap g ![x, y], z] = ap g ![x, ap g ![y, z]]
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h x y z
    have := congrArg (fun t => ap t (Sum.elim (fun _ => x) (Sum.elim (fun _ => y) fun _ => z))) h
    simpa [ap_bin] using this
  · intro h
    refine ext_ap fun w => ?_
    simp only [ap_map, ap_bin, ap_one]
    exact h _ _ _

name: Operad.EndOp.r2b_iff
statement:
theorem r2b_iff (g : Und R (EndOp R V) (Fin 2)) :
    bin g one (bin g one one) = bin g one (bin (map (Equiv.swap 0 1) g) one one) ↔
      ∀ x y z, ap g ![x, ap g ![y, z]] = ap g ![x, ap g ![z, y]]
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h x y z
    have := congrArg (fun t => ap t (Sum.elim (fun _ => x) (Sum.elim (fun _ => y) fun _ => z))) h
    simpa only [ap_bin, ap_one, ap_map, vec_swap, Sum.elim_inl, Sum.elim_inr] using this
  · intro h
    refine ext_ap fun w => ?_
    simp only [ap_bin, ap_one, ap_map, vec_swap]
    exact h _ _ _

name: Operad.EndOp.assocShape_iff
statement:
theorem assocShape_iff (g h g' h' : Und R (EndOp R V) (Fin 2)) :
    map (Equiv.sumAssoc Unit Unit Unit) (bin g (bin h one one) one) = bin g' one (bin h' one one)
      ↔ ∀ x y z, ap g ![ap h ![x, y], z] = ap g' ![x, ap h' ![y, z]]
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hgh x y z
    have := congrArg (fun t => ap t (Sum.elim (fun _ => x) (Sum.elim (fun _ => y) fun _ => z)))
      hgh
    simpa [ap_bin] using this
  · intro hgh
    refine ext_ap fun w => ?_
    simp only [ap_map, ap_bin, ap_one]
    exact hgh _ _ _

name: Operad.EndOp.rightShape_iff
statement:
theorem rightShape_iff (g h g' h' : Und R (EndOp R V) (Fin 2)) :
    bin g one (bin h one one) = bin g' one (bin h' one one)
      ↔ ∀ x y z, ap g ![x, ap h ![y, z]] = ap g' ![x, ap h' ![y, z]]
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hgh x y z
    have := congrArg (fun t => ap t (Sum.elim (fun _ => x) (Sum.elim (fun _ => y) fun _ => z)))
      hgh
    simpa [ap_bin] using this
  · intro hgh
    refine ext_ap fun w => ?_
    simp only [ap_bin, ap_one]
    exact hgh _ _ _

name: Operad.EndOp.leftComb_eq_rightComb_iff
statement:
theorem leftComb_eq_rightComb_iff (p q p' q' : toNSSet (Und R (EndOp R V)) 2) :
    leftComb p q = rightComb p' q' ↔
      ∀ x y z, ap p ![ap q ![x, y], z] = ap p' ![x, ap q' ![y, z]]
proof:
:= by
  have hl : ∀ w : Fin 3 → V, ap (NSSetOperad.comp 0 1 p q : toNSSet (Und R (EndOp R V)) 3) w
      = ap p ![ap q ![w 0, w 1], w 2] := fun w => by
    show ap (map _ (comp _ p q)) w = _
    rw [ap_map, ap_comp]
    congr 1
    funext k
    fin_cases k
    · show ap q _ = ap q _
      congr 1
      funext b
      fin_cases b <;> rfl
    · rfl
  have hr : ∀ w : Fin 3 → V, ap (NSSetOperad.comp 1 0 p' q' : toNSSet (Und R (EndOp R V)) 3) w
      = ap p' ![w 0, ap q' ![w 1, w 2]] := fun w => by
    show ap (map _ (comp _ p' q')) w = _
    rw [ap_map, ap_comp]
    congr 1
    funext k
    fin_cases k
    · rfl
    · show ap q' _ = ap q' _
      congr 1
      funext b
      fin_cases b <;> rfl
  rw [leftComb_eq, rightComb_eq]
  constructor
  · intro h x y z
    have h' := mk_eq_mk_iff.1 h
    have := congrArg (fun t => ap t ![x, y, z]) h'
    simp only at this
    rw [hl, hr] at this
    exact this
  · intro h
    refine mk_eq_mk_iff.2 (ext_ap fun w => ?_)
    rw [hl, hr]
    exact h _ _ _

name: Operad.LTree.mem_monomials_mapDec
statement:
@[simp] lemma mem_monomials_mapDec [Fintype E] [DecidableEq E] [Fintype F] [DecidableEq F]
    (f : E → F) (n : ℕ) (t : LTree E) : t.mapDec f ∈ monomials n ↔ t ∈ monomials n
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_monomials, mem_monomials, isShuffle_mapDec, labels_mapDec]

name: Operad.LTree.mapDec_equiv_symm
statement: lemma mapDec_equiv_symm (π : E ≃ F) (t : LTree E) : (t.mapDec π).mapDec π.symm = t
proof:
:= by
  rw [mapDec_mapDec, show (π.symm ∘ π : E → E) = id from funext π.symm_apply_apply, mapDec_id]

name: Operad.LTree.mapDec_symm_equiv
statement: lemma mapDec_symm_equiv (π : E ≃ F) (t : LTree F) : (t.mapDec π.symm).mapDec π = t
proof:
:= by
  simpa using mapDec_equiv_symm π.symm t

name: Operad.LTree.monoMap_val
statement: @[simp] lemma monoMap_val (π : E ≃ F) (n : ℕ) (t : Mono E n) : (monoMap π n t).1 = t.1.mapDec π
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: Operad.LTree.relabelVec_apply
statement:
lemma relabelVec_apply (π : E ≃ F) (n : ℕ) (v : Mono E n → K) (τ : Mono F n) :
    relabelVec K π n v τ = v ((monoMap π n).symm τ)
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.LTree.relabelVec_symm_apply
statement:
lemma relabelVec_symm_apply (π : E ≃ F) (n : ℕ) (v : Mono E n → K) :
    relabelVec K π.symm n (relabelVec K π n v) = v
proof:
:= by
  funext τ
  rw [relabelVec_apply, relabelVec_apply]
  exact congrArg v (Subtype.ext (mapDec_equiv_symm π τ.1))

name: Operad.LTree.relabelVec_vecOf
statement:
lemma relabelVec_vecOf (π : E ≃ F) (n : ℕ) (t : LTree E) :
    relabelVec K π n (vecOf K n t) = vecOf K n (t.mapDec π)
proof:
:= by
  funext τ
  rw [relabelVec_apply]
  simp only [vecOf]
  congr 1
  apply propext
  constructor
  · intro h
    show τ.1 = t.mapDec π
    rw [← h]
    exact (mapDec_symm_equiv π τ.1).symm
  · intro h
    show τ.1.mapDec π.symm = t
    rw [h, mapDec_equiv_symm]

name: Operad.LTree.relabelVec_substVec
statement:
lemma relabelVec_substVec (π : E ≃ F) (n : ℕ) {t : LTree E} {p : List Bool} {s : Bool}
    (he : t.IsEdge p s) (r : Mono E 3 → K) :
    relabelVec K π n (substVec K n t p s r) =
      substVec K n (t.mapDec π) p s (relabelVec K π 3 r)
proof:
:= by
  rw [substVec, substVec, map_sum]
  refine (Fintype.sum_equiv (monoMap π 3) _ _ fun σ => ?_)
  rw [map_smul, relabelVec_vecOf, ← substAt_mapDec π t p s he, relabelVec_apply,
    Equiv.symm_apply_apply]
  rfl

name: Operad.LTree.map_relabelVec_idealOf_le
statement:
theorem map_relabelVec_idealOf_le (π : E ≃ F) (R : Submodule K (Mono E 3 → K)) (n : ℕ) :
    (idealOf K R n).map (relabelVec K π n).toLinearMap ≤
      idealOf K (R.map (relabelVec K π 3).toLinearMap) n
proof:
:= by
  rw [Submodule.map_le_iff_le_comap, idealOf, Submodule.span_le]
  rintro _ ⟨t, p, s, r, hr, he, rfl⟩
  rw [SetLike.mem_coe, Submodule.mem_comap, LinearEquiv.coe_coe, relabelVec_substVec π n he]
  exact substVec_mem_idealOf K _ (monoMap π n t) ((isEdge_mapDec π t.1 p s).2 he)
    (Submodule.mem_map_of_mem hr)

name: Operad.LTree.map_relabelVec_symm
statement:
lemma map_relabelVec_symm (π : E ≃ F) (R : Submodule K (Mono E 3 → K)) :
    (R.map (relabelVec K π 3).toLinearMap).map (relabelVec K π.symm 3).toLinearMap = R
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Submodule.map_comp]
  convert Submodule.map_id R
  exact LinearMap.ext fun v => relabelVec_symm_apply π 3 v

name: Operad.LTree.map_relabelVec_idealOf
statement:
theorem map_relabelVec_idealOf (π : E ≃ F) (R : Submodule K (Mono E 3 → K)) (n : ℕ) :
    (idealOf K R n).map (relabelVec K π n).toLinearMap =
      idealOf K (R.map (relabelVec K π 3).toLinearMap) n
proof:
:= by
  refine le_antisymm (map_relabelVec_idealOf_le π R n) fun v hv => ?_
  have h := map_relabelVec_idealOf_le π.symm (R.map (relabelVec K π 3).toLinearMap) n
    (Submodule.mem_map_of_mem hv)
  rw [map_relabelVec_symm] at h
  refine ⟨_, h, ?_⟩
  simpa using relabelVec_symm_apply π.symm n v

name: Operad.ShuffleBar.cutKeys_mapDec
statement:
lemma cutKeys_mapDec (π : E ≃ F) : ∀ x : BarTree E, cutKeys (x.mapDec (relDec π)) = cutKeys x
  | leaf _ => rfl
  | node d l r => by
    show (if d.2 then {key ((node d l r).mapDec (relDec π))} else ∅) ∪
      (cutKeys (l.mapDec (relDec π)) ∪ cutKeys (r.mapDec (relDec π))) = _
    rw [key_mapDec, cutKeys_mapDec π l, cutKeys_mapDec π r]
    rfl

name: Operad.ShuffleBar.mergeK_mapDec
statement:
lemma mergeK_mapDec (π : E ≃ F) (k : ℕ ×ₗ ℕ) :
    ∀ x : BarTree E, mergeK (x.mapDec (relDec π)) k = (mergeK x k).mapDec (relDec π)
  | leaf _ => rfl
  | node d l r => by
    have hk : key (node (relDec π d) (l.mapDec (relDec π)) (r.mapDec (relDec π))) =
        key (node d l r)
proof:
:= key_mapDec _ (node d l r)
    rw [mapDec_node, mergeK, mergeK, hk]
    simp only [relDec, Prod.map_snd, id_eq]
    split_ifs
    · rfl
    · rw [mergeK_mapDec π k l, mergeK_mapDec π k r]
      rfl

name: Operad.ShuffleBar.rootFlag_mapDec
statement:
lemma rootFlag_mapDec (π : E ≃ F) : ∀ x : BarTree E, rootFlag (x.mapDec (relDec π)) = rootFlag x
  | leaf _ => rfl
  | node _ _ _ => rfl

name: Operad.ShuffleBar.flagAt_mapDec
statement:
lemma flagAt_mapDec (π : E ≃ F) (x : BarTree E) (p : List Bool) :
    flagAt (x.mapDec (relDec π)) p = flagAt x p
proof:
:= by
  rw [flagAt, flagAt, subtreeAt_mapDec, rootFlag_mapDec]

name: Operad.ShuffleBar.liftW_mapDec'
statement:
lemma liftW_mapDec' (π : E ≃ F) (c : Bool) :
    ∀ σ : LTree E, liftW c (σ.mapDec π) = (liftW c σ).mapDec (relDec π)
  | leaf _ => rfl
  | node e l r => by
    simp only [mapDec_node, liftW, mapDec_mapDec]
    rfl

name: Operad.ShuffleBar.substBar_mapDec
statement:
lemma substBar_mapDec (π : E ≃ F) {x : BarTree E} {p : List Bool} {s : Bool} (h : x.IsEdge p s)
    (σ : LTree E) :
    substBar (x.mapDec (relDec π)) p s (σ.mapDec π) = (substBar x p s σ).mapDec (relDec π)
proof:
:= by
  rw [substBar, substBar, liftW_mapDec', flagAt_mapDec, substAt_mapDec _ x p s h]

name: Operad.ShuffleBar.isUncut_mapDec
statement:
lemma isUncut_mapDec (π : E ≃ F) {x : BarTree E} {p : List Bool} {s : Bool} :
    IsUncut (x.mapDec (relDec π)) p s ↔ IsUncut x p s
proof:
:= by
  rw [IsUncut, IsUncut, isEdge_mapDec, flagAt_mapDec]

name: Operad.ShuffleBar.valid_mapDec
statement: lemma valid_mapDec (π : E ≃ F) {x : BarTree E} (hx : Valid x) : Valid (x.mapDec (relDec π))
proof:
:=
  ⟨(isShuffle_mapDec _ x).2 hx.shuffle, by rw [labels_mapDec]; exact hx.nodup,
    by rw [rootFlag_mapDec]; exact hx.root⟩

name: Operad.ShuffleBar.relabelBar_single
statement:
lemma relabelBar_single (π : E ≃ F) (x : BarTree E) (c : K) :
    relabelBar K π (Finsupp.single x c) = Finsupp.single (x.mapDec (relDec π)) c
proof:
:= by
  simp [relabelBar]

name: Operad.ShuffleBar.relabelBar_symm
statement:
lemma relabelBar_symm (π : E ≃ F) (v : BarTree E →₀ K) :
    relabelBar K π.symm (relabelBar K π v) = v
proof:
:= by
  rw [relabelBar, relabelBar, Finsupp.lmapDomain_apply, Finsupp.lmapDomain_apply,
    ← Finsupp.mapDomain_comp]
  convert Finsupp.mapDomain_id
  funext x
  rw [Function.comp_apply, mapDec_mapDec]
  convert mapDec_id x
  funext d
  exact Prod.ext (π.symm_apply_apply d.1) rfl

name: Operad.ShuffleBar.d_relabelBar
statement:
theorem d_relabelBar (π : E ≃ F) (v : BarTree E →₀ K) :
    d K (relabelBar K π v) = relabelBar K π (d K v)
proof:
:= by
  induction v using Finsupp.induction_linear with
  | zero => simp
  | add v w hv hw => simp only [map_add, hv, hw]
  | single x c =>
    rw [relabelBar_single, d_single, d_single, map_smul, dTree, dTree, map_sum,
      cutKeys_mapDec]
    congr 1
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun k _ => ?_
    rw [map_smul, relabelBar_single, mergeK_mapDec, sgn, sgn, cutKeys_mapDec]

name: Operad.ShuffleBar.adm_mapDec
statement:
lemma adm_mapDec [Fintype E] [DecidableEq E] [Fintype F] [DecidableEq F] (π : E ≃ F)
    {n s : ℕ} {x : BarTree E} (hx : Adm n s x) : Adm n s (x.mapDec (relDec π))
proof:
:=
  ⟨valid_mapDec π hx.1, by rw [labels_mapDec]; exact hx.2.1, by rw [cutKeys_mapDec]; exact hx.2.2⟩

name: Operad.ShuffleBar.relabelBar_mem_C
statement:
lemma relabelBar_mem_C [Fintype E] [DecidableEq E] [Fintype F] [DecidableEq F] (π : E ≃ F)
    {n s : ℕ} {v : BarTree E →₀ K} (hv : v ∈ C K n s) : relabelBar K π v ∈ C K n s
proof:
:= by
  rw [C, Finsupp.mem_supported] at hv ⊢
  intro y hy
  rw [relabelBar, Finsupp.lmapDomain_apply] at hy
  obtain ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.1 (Finsupp.mapDomain_support hy)
  exact adm_mapDec π (hv hx)

name: Operad.ShuffleBar.relabelBar_substRel
statement:
lemma relabelBar_substRel (π : E ≃ F) {x : BarTree E} {p : List Bool} {s : Bool}
    (h : x.IsEdge p s) (r : Mono E 3 → K) :
    relabelBar K π (substRel K x p s r) =
      substRel K (x.mapDec (relDec π)) p s (relabelVec K π 3 r)
proof:
:= by
