  rw [substRel, substRel, map_sum]
  refine (Fintype.sum_equiv (monoMap π 3) _ _ fun σ => ?_)
  rw [map_smul, relabelBar_single, relabelVec_apply, Equiv.symm_apply_apply, monoMap_val,
    substBar_mapDec π h]

name: Operad.ShuffleBar.map_relabelBar_J_le
statement:
theorem map_relabelBar_J_le (π : E ≃ F) (R : Submodule K (Mono E 3 → K)) :
    (J K R).map (relabelBar K π) ≤ J K (R.map (relabelVec K π 3).toLinearMap)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Submodule.map_le_iff_le_comap, J, Submodule.span_le]
  rintro _ ⟨x, p, s, r, hx, h, hr, rfl⟩
  show relabelBar K π (substRel K x p s r) ∈ J K _
  rw [relabelBar_substRel π h.1]
  exact Submodule.subset_span ⟨_, p, s, _, valid_mapDec π hx, (isUncut_mapDec π).2 h,
    Submodule.mem_map_of_mem hr, rfl⟩

name: Operad.ShuffleBar.isKoszul_relabel
statement:
theorem isKoszul_relabel (π : E ≃ F) {R : Submodule K (Mono E 3 → K)} (hR : IsKoszul K R) :
    IsKoszul K (R.map (relabelVec K π 3).toLinearMap)
proof:
:= by
  intro n s hs x hx hdx
  have hdx' : d K (relabelBar K π.symm x) ∈ J K R := by
    rw [d_relabelBar, ← map_relabelVec_symm π R]
    exact map_relabelBar_J_le π.symm _ (Submodule.mem_map_of_mem hdx)
  obtain ⟨y, hy, hxy⟩ := hR n s hs _ (relabelBar_mem_C π.symm hx) hdx'
  refine ⟨relabelBar K π y, relabelBar_mem_C π hy, ?_⟩
  have := map_relabelBar_J_le π R (Submodule.mem_map_of_mem hxy)
  have hinv : relabelBar K π (relabelBar K π.symm x) = x := by
    simpa using relabelBar_symm π.symm x
  rwa [map_sub, hinv, ← d_relabelBar] at this

name: Operad.GrOperadIdeal.eq_zero_of_card_eq_zero
statement:
lemma eq_zero_of_card_eq_zero (h0 : ∀ y : P (Fin 0), y = 0) {B : Type} [Fintype B]
    [DecidableEq B] (hB : Fintype.card B = 0) (y : P B) : y = 0
proof:
:= by
  let e : B ≃ Fin 0 := Fintype.equivFinOfCardEq hB
  have : y = GrOperad.map (R := R) e.symm (GrOperad.map (R := R) e y) := by
    rw [← GrOperad.map_trans, Equiv.self_trans_symm, GrOperad.map_refl]
  rw [this, h0 (GrOperad.map (R := R) e y), map_zero]

name: Operad.GrOperadIdeal.atLeastTwo_sub_of_le
statement:
lemma atLeastTwo_sub_of_le {h0 : ∀ y : P (Fin 0), y = 0} {A : Type} [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A]
    (h : 2 ≤ Fintype.card A) : (atLeastTwo R P h0).sub A = ⊤
proof:
:=
  if_pos h

name: Operad.GrOperadIdeal.atLeastTwo_sub_of_lt
statement:
lemma atLeastTwo_sub_of_lt {h0 : ∀ y : P (Fin 0), y = 0} {A : Type} [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A]
    (h : Fintype.card A < 2) : (atLeastTwo R P h0).sub A = ⊥
proof:
:=
  if_neg (by omega)

name: Operad.GrOperadIdeal.atLeastTwo_hI1
statement:
theorem atLeastTwo_hI1 (h0 : ∀ y : P (Fin 0), y = 0) (B : Type) [Fintype B] [DecidableEq B]
    (hB : Fintype.card B ≤ 1) (y : P B) (hy : y ∈ (atLeastTwo R P h0).sub B) : y = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [atLeastTwo_sub_of_lt (by omega), Submodule.mem_bot] at hy
  exact hy

name: Operad.Bar.val_msVal
statement:
lemma val_msVal {k l : ℕ} (b : Bool) (x : BarGen I (Fin k)) (q : Fin k)
    (y : BarGen I (Fin l)) (m : ℕ) (h : m + 1 = k + l) :
    IdealSp.val I (msVal I b x q y m h) = σ R (!b) • GrOperad.map (R := R) (posEquivF q l m h)
      (GrOperad.comp (R := R) q (IdealSp.val I x) (IdealSp.val I y))
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.Bar.mergeSp_fn
statement: theorem mergeSp_fn : (mergeSp I).fn = barMerge I
proof:
:= by
  funext k l x j y m
  unfold MergeSp.fn barMerge
  split_ifs
  · rfl
  · rfl

name: Operad.Bar.d_eq_mergeSp_d
statement: theorem d_eq_mergeSp_d (A : Type) [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] : d I A = (mergeSp I).d A
proof:
:= by
  unfold d MergeSp.d
  congr 1

name: Operad.Bar.d_comp
statement:
theorem d_comp {A B : Type} [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] [Fintype B] [DecidableEq B] (i : A)
    (X : FreeGrL R (BarGen I) A) (Y : FreeGrL R (BarGen I) B) :
    d I _ (GrOperad.comp (R := R) (P := FreeGrL R (BarGen I)) i X Y)
      = GrOperad.comp (R := R) i (d I A X) Y
        + GrOperad.comp (R := R) i (GrOperad.tw (R := R) true X) (d I B Y)
        + (mergeSp I).mc i X Y
proof:
:= by
  rw [d_eq_mergeSp_d, d_eq_mergeSp_d, d_eq_mergeSp_d]
  exact (mergeSp I).d_comp i X Y

name: Operad.FreeGrL.sval_labSplit
statement:
lemma sval_labSplit {Y Y₁ Y₂ : Finset ℕ} {m : ℕ} (hm : m ∈ Y₁)
    (hY : ∀ x, x ∈ Y ↔ (x ∈ Y₁ ∧ x ≠ m) ∨ x ∈ Y₂) (hd : ∀ x ∈ Y₁, x ≠ m → x ∉ Y₂) (x : Lab Y) :
    sval (labSplit hm hY hd x) = x.1
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hx : x.1 ∈ Y₂
  · simp [labSplit, hx]
  · simp [labSplit, hx]

name: Operad.FreeGrL.labels_eq_toFinset
statement:
lemma labels_eq_toFinset {t : STree B} (h : t.labels.Nodup) :
    t.labels = t.labels.toFinset.val
proof:
:= by
  rw [Multiset.toFinset_val, Multiset.dedup_eq_self.2 h]

name: Operad.FreeGrL.shEv_mem_vx
statement:
theorem shEv_mem_vx : ∀ (n : ℕ) (t : STree B), t.weight ≤ n → t.IsShuffle →
    ∀ (Y : Finset ℕ) (h : t.labels = Y.val), shEv b t Y h ∈ vx R W t.weight (Lab Y)
  | _, .leaf a, _, _, Y, h => by
    rw [shEv_leaf, weight]
    have hY : Y = {a}
proof:
:= Finset.val_inj.1 (by rw [← h]; rfl)
    subst hY
    rw [unitL_eq (Equiv.ofUnique Unit (Lab {a}))]
    exact unit_mem_eig _
  | 0, .node β c, hw, _, _, _ => by simp [weight] at hw
  | n + 1, .node (k := k) β c, hw, ht, Y, h => by
    have hnd : (STree.node β c).labels.Nodup := h ▸ Y.nodup
    by_cases hall : ∀ j, ∃ a, c j = .leaf a
    · choose a ha using hall
      have hmem : ∀ j, a j ∈ Y := fun j => by
        rw [← Finset.mem_val, ← h]
        exact mem_labels_node.2 ⟨j, by rw [ha j]; simp⟩
      have hinj : Injective a := fun i j hij => by
        by_contra hne
        have := disjoint_of_node hnd hne
        rw [ha i, ha j, hij] at this
        simp at this
      have hsurj : ∀ y : Lab Y, ∃ j, a j = y.1 := fun y => by
        have hy : y.1 ∈ (STree.node β c).labels := by rw [h]; exact y.2
        obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := mem_labels_node.1 hy
        rw [ha j] at hj
        exact ⟨j, (Multiset.mem_singleton.1 hj).symm⟩
      let θ : Fin k ≃ Lab Y := Equiv.ofBijective (fun j => ⟨a j, hmem j⟩)
        ⟨fun i j hij => hinj (congrArg Subtype.val hij), fun y => by
          obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := hsurj y
          exact ⟨j, Subtype.ext hj⟩⟩
      have hc : c = fun j => STree.leaf (θ j).1 := funext fun j => ha j
      have hw1 : (STree.node β c).weight = 1 := by
        simp [weight, ha]
      subst hc
      rw [hw1, shEv_corolla]
      exact map_mem_eig θ (ι_mem_vx _)
    · push Not at hall
      obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := hall
      set t₂ := c j with ht₂
      set m := t₂.first with hm_def
      have hjs : t₂.IsShuffle := ht.child j
      have hmj : m ∈ t₂.labels := first_mem hjs
      let c₁ : Fin k → STree B := update c j (.leaf m)
      let t₁ : STree B := .node β c₁
      have hle : t₁.labels ≤ (STree.node β c).labels := by
        simp only [t₁, labels_node]
        refine Finset.sum_le_sum fun i _ => ?_
        by_cases hij : i = j
        · subst hij
          simp only [c₁, update_self, labels_leaf]
          exact Multiset.singleton_le.2 hmj
        · simp only [c₁, update_of_ne hij]
          exact le_rfl
      have hnd₁ : t₁.labels.Nodup := Multiset.nodup_of_le hle hnd
      have hnd₂ : t₂.labels.Nodup := nodup_of_node hnd j
      set Y₁ := t₁.labels.toFinset
      set Y₂ := t₂.labels.toFinset
      have h₁ : t₁.labels = Y₁.val := labels_eq_toFinset hnd₁
      have h₂ : t₂.labels = Y₂.val := labels_eq_toFinset hnd₂
      have hm₁ : m ∈ Y₁ := Multiset.mem_toFinset.2
        (mem_labels_node.2 ⟨j, by simp [c₁]⟩)
      have hother : ∀ i, i ≠ j → ∀ x ∈ (c i).labels, x ∉ t₂.labels := fun i hij x hx hx' =>
        Multiset.disjoint_left.1 (disjoint_of_node hnd hij) hx hx'
      have hsub : t₁.subst (update STree.leaf m t₂) = STree.node β c := by
        simp only [t₁, subst_node]
        congr 1
        funext i
        by_cases hij : i = j
        · subst hij
          simp [c₁, ht₂]
        · simp only [c₁, update_of_ne hij]
          rw [subst_congr (ys := STree.leaf) (c i) fun x hx => update_of_ne
            (fun hxm => hother i hij x hx (by rw [hxm]; exact hmj)) _ _, subst_leaf]
      have hY : ∀ x, x ∈ Y ↔ (x ∈ Y₁ ∧ x ≠ m) ∨ x ∈ Y₂ := fun x => by
        rw [← Finset.mem_val, ← h, ← hsub, labels_subst, h₁]
        simp only [Multiset.mem_bind, Finset.mem_val]
        constructor
        · rintro ⟨y, hy, hxy⟩
          by_cases hym : y = m
          · subst hym
            rw [update_self] at hxy
            exact Or.inr (Multiset.mem_toFinset.2 hxy)
          · rw [update_of_ne hym, labels_leaf, Multiset.mem_singleton] at hxy
            subst hxy
            exact Or.inl ⟨hy, hym⟩
        · rintro (⟨hx, hxm⟩ | hx)
          · exact ⟨x, hx, by rw [update_of_ne hxm]; simp⟩
          · exact ⟨m, hm₁, by rw [update_self]; exact Multiset.mem_toFinset.1 hx⟩
      have hd : ∀ x ∈ Y₁, x ≠ m → x ∉ Y₂ := fun x hx hxm hx₂ => by
        obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := mem_labels_node.1 (Multiset.mem_toFinset.1 hx)
        by_cases hij : i = j
        · subst hij
          simp [c₁] at hi
          exact hxm hi
        · simp only [c₁, update_of_ne hij] at hi
          exact hother i hij x hi (Multiset.mem_toFinset.1 hx₂)
      have hh : (t₁.subst (update STree.leaf m t₂)).labels = Y.val := by rw [hsub, h]
      let E := labSplit hm₁ hY hd
      have hcomp := comp_shEv b hb t₂ Y₂ h₂ t₁ Y₁ h₁ m hm₁ Y hh E (sval_labSplit hm₁ hY hd)
      have hev := map_shEv b hsub rfl hh h (Equiv.refl _) fun _ => rfl
      rw [GrOperad.map_refl] at hev
      rw [hev] at hcomp
      have hwsum : t₁.weight + t₂.weight = (STree.node β c).weight := by
        have hupd : ∀ i, (c₁ i).weight = update (fun i => (c i).weight) j 0 i := fun i => by
          by_cases hij : i = j
          · subst hij
            simp [c₁]
          · simp [c₁, update_of_ne hij]
        simp only [t₁, weight, hupd]
        rw [Finset.sum_update_of_mem (Finset.mem_univ j),
          ← Finset.add_sum_erase _ _ (Finset.mem_univ j), Finset.sdiff_singleton_eq_erase, ht₂]
        omega
      have ht₂w : 1 ≤ t₂.weight := by
        rcases hj' : t₂ with a | ⟨β', c'⟩
        · exact absurd hj' (hj a)
        · simp [weight]
      have ht₁s : t₁.IsShuffle := by
        refine ⟨ht.pos, fun i => ?_, ?_⟩
        · by_cases hij : i = j
          · subst hij
            simp [c₁]
          · simp only [c₁, update_of_ne hij]
            exact ht.child i
        · have : (fun i => (c₁ i).first) = fun i => (c i).first := funext fun i => by
            by_cases hij : i = j
            · subst hij
              simp [c₁, hm_def, ht₂]
            · simp [c₁, update_of_ne hij]
          rw [this]
          exact ht.mono
      have ih₁ := shEv_mem_vx n t₁ (by omega) ht₁s Y₁ h₁
      have ht₁w : 1 ≤ t₁.weight := by
        simp only [t₁, weight]
        omega
      have ih₂ := shEv_mem_vx n t₂ (by omega) hjs Y₂ h₂
      have hc' := comp_mem_eig (a := GrSpEnd.id R W) (⟨m, hm₁⟩ : Lab Y₁) ih₁ ih₂
      rw [hcomp, hwsum] at hc'
      have := map_mem_eig E.symm (Submodule.smul_mem _ (σ R (vpar p t₂ && vaft p t₁ m)) hc')
      rwa [smul_smul, σ_mul_self, one_smul, ← GrOperad.map_trans, Equiv.self_trans_symm,
        GrOperad.map_refl] at this

name: Operad.ShuffleBarSym.vpar_false
statement:
lemma vpar_false {B : ℕ → Type*} : ∀ t : STree B, STree.vpar (fun _ _ => false) t = false
  | .leaf _ => rfl
  | .node _ ch => by
    rw [STree.vpar_node]
    simp only [vpar_false (ch _)]
    simp [GrEnd.tot]

                                                                                                  
                                                             
noncomputable def tBasis (A : Type) [Fintype A] [LinearOrder A] :
    Module.Basis {t // t ∈ LTree.monomials (E := G) (Fintype.card A)} K (FreeGrL K E A)
proof:
:=
  (FreeGrL.shuffleBasis c (p := fun _ _ => false) hc A).reindex (LTree.binMonoEquiv _).symm

name: Operad.ShuffleBarSym.tBasis_apply
statement:
lemma tBasis_apply (A : Type) [Fintype A] [LinearOrder A]
    (t : {t // t ∈ LTree.monomials (E := G) (Fintype.card A)}) :
    tBasis c hc A t = FreeGrL.shuffleBasis c (p := fun _ _ => false) hc A
      (LTree.binMonoEquiv _ t)
proof:
:= by
  rw [tBasis, Module.Basis.reindex_apply, Equiv.symm_symm]

name: Operad.ShuffleBarSym.par_tBasis
statement:
lemma par_tBasis (A : Type) [Fintype A] [LinearOrder A]
    (t : {t // t ∈ LTree.monomials (E := G) (Fintype.card A)}) :
    GrOperad.par (R := K) false (tBasis c hc A t) = tBasis c hc A t
proof:
:= by
  rw [tBasis_apply]
  have := FreeGrL.par_shuffleBasis c (p := fun _ _ => false) hc A (LTree.binMonoEquiv _ t)
  rwa [vpar_false] at this

name: Operad.ShuffleBarSym.free_zero
statement: lemma free_zero (y : FreeGrL K E (Fin 0)) : y = 0
proof:
:= by
  haveI : IsEmpty {t // t ∈ LTree.monomials (E := G) (Fintype.card (Fin 0))} :=
    ⟨fun ⟨t, ht⟩ => by
      rw [Fintype.card_fin] at ht
      simp [LTree.monomials] at ht⟩
  exact (tBasis c hc (Fin 0)).repr.injective (Subsingleton.elim _ _)

name: Operad.ShuffleBarSym.idealBasis_apply
statement:
lemma idealBasis_apply {k : ℕ} (t : VMono G k) :
    (idealBasis c hc k t : FreeGrL K E (Fin k)) =
      tBasis c hc (Fin k) ⟨t.1, by simpa using t.2.1⟩
proof:
:= by
  rw [idealBasis, dif_pos t.2.2, Module.Basis.reindex_apply, Module.Basis.map_apply,
    LinearEquiv.coe_ofTop_symm_apply]
  rfl

name: Operad.ShuffleBarSym.par_genBasis
statement:
lemma par_genBasis (k : ℕ) (t : VMono G k) :
    GrSpecies.par (R := K) ((fun _ _ => true) k t) (genBasis c hc k t) = genBasis c hc k t
proof:
:= by
  refine IdealSp.ext _ ?_
  show GrOperad.par (R := K) false (idealBasis c hc k t : FreeGrL K E (Fin k)) = _
  rw [idealBasis_apply, par_tBasis]
  exact (idealBasis_apply c hc t).symm

name: Operad.ShuffleBarSym.uncutRoot_cutRoot
statement: lemma uncutRoot_cutRoot {y : BarTree G} (hy : rootFlag y = false) : uncutRoot (cutRoot y) = y
proof:

  cases y with
  | leaf => rfl
  | node d l r =>
    obtain ⟨e, b⟩ := d
    simp only [rootFlag] at hy

name: Operad.ShuffleBarSym.cutRoot_injective
statement:
lemma cutRoot_injective {y y' : BarTree G} (hy : rootFlag y = false) (hy' : rootFlag y' = false)
    (h : cutRoot y = cutRoot y') : y = y'
proof:
:= by
  rw [← uncutRoot_cutRoot hy, ← uncutRoot_cutRoot hy', h]

name: Operad.ShuffleBarSym.card_cutKeys_cutRoot_node
statement:
lemma card_cutKeys_cutRoot_node {d : G × Bool} {l r : BarTree G} (hd : d.2 = false) :
    (cutKeys (cutRoot (LTree.node d l r))).card = (cutKeys (LTree.node d l r)).card + 1
proof:
:= by
  have e1 : cutKeys (cutRoot (LTree.node d l r)) =
      insert (key (LTree.node d l r)) (cutKeys l ∪ cutKeys r) := by
    simp only [cutRoot, ShuffleBar.cutKeys]
    rfl
  have e2 : cutKeys (LTree.node d l r) = cutKeys l ∪ cutKeys r := by
    simp [ShuffleBar.cutKeys, hd]
  rw [e1, e2, Finset.card_insert_of_notMem]
  intro h
  rcases Finset.mem_union.1 h with h | h
  · exact key_not_mem_left d l r (cutKeys_subset l h)
  · exact key_not_mem_right d l r (cutKeys_subset r h)

name: Operad.ShuffleBarSym.toBar_node
statement:
lemma toBar_node {k : ℕ} (m : VMono G k) (ch : Fin k → STree (VMono G)) :
    toBar (STree.node m ch) = (liftW false m.1).plug (kids ch)
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.ShuffleBarSym.kids_fin
statement:
lemma kids_fin {k : ℕ} (ch : Fin k → STree (VMono G)) (j : Fin k) :
    kids ch j = cutRoot (toBar (ch j))
proof:
:= by
  rw [kids, dif_pos j.2]

name: Operad.ShuffleBarSym.kids_of_lt
statement:
lemma kids_of_lt {k : ℕ} (ch : Fin k → STree (VMono G)) {a : ℕ} (h : a < k) :
    kids ch a = cutRoot (toBar (ch ⟨a, h⟩))
proof:
:= by
  rw [kids, dif_pos h]

name: Operad.ShuffleBarSym.VMono.perm
statement: lemma VMono.perm {k : ℕ} (m : VMono G k) : m.1.labels.Perm (List.range k)
proof:
:=
  ((LTree.mem_monomials k m.1).1 m.2.1).2

name: Operad.ShuffleBarSym.VMono.isShuffle
statement: lemma VMono.isShuffle {k : ℕ} (m : VMono G k) : m.1.IsShuffle
proof:
:=
  ((LTree.mem_monomials k m.1).1 m.2.1).1

name: Operad.ShuffleBarSym.VMono.lt
statement: lemma VMono.lt {k : ℕ} (m : VMono G k) {a : ℕ} (ha : a ∈ m.1.labels) : a < k
proof:
:=
  List.mem_range.1 (m.perm.subset ha)

name: Operad.ShuffleBarSym.VMono.mem
statement: lemma VMono.mem {k : ℕ} (m : VMono G k) {a : ℕ} (ha : a < k) : a ∈ m.1.labels
proof:
:=
  m.perm.symm.subset (List.mem_range.2 ha)

name: Operad.ShuffleBarSym.VMono.exists_node
statement: lemma VMono.exists_node {k : ℕ} (m : VMono G k) : ∃ e l r, m.1 = LTree.node e l r
proof:
:= by
  rcases h : m.1 with a | ⟨e, l, r⟩
  · have h1 := m.perm.length_eq
    rw [h, List.length_range] at h1
    have h2 := m.2.2
    simp only [LTree.labels_leaf, List.length_singleton] at h1
    omega
  · exact ⟨e, l, r, rfl⟩

name: Operad.ShuffleBarSym.VMono.minLabel
statement: lemma VMono.minLabel {k : ℕ} (m : VMono G k) : m.1.minLabel = 0
proof:
:= by
  have h0 : 0 ∈ m.1.labels := m.mem (by have := m.2.2; omega)
  exact Nat.le_zero.1 (LTree.minLabel_le_of_mem _ h0)

name: Operad.ShuffleBarSym.bind_kids
statement:
lemma bind_kids {k : ℕ} (m : VMono G k) (f : ℕ → Multiset ℕ) :
    Multiset.bind (m.1.labels : Multiset ℕ) f = ∑ j : Fin k, f j
proof:
:= by
  rw [Multiset.coe_eq_coe.2 m.perm, Multiset.coe_range,
    Fin.sum_univ_eq_sum_range f, Finset.sum_eq_multiset_sum, Multiset.bind]
  rfl

name: Operad.ShuffleBarSym.labels_toBar
statement:
theorem labels_toBar : ∀ t : STree (VMono G), ((toBar t).labels : Multiset ℕ) = t.labels
  | STree.leaf _ => rfl
  | STree.node m ch => by
    rw [toBar_node, labels_plug, labels_liftW, ← Multiset.coe_bind, bind_kids m, STree.labels]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => ?_
    rw [kids_fin, labels_cutRoot, labels_toBar (ch j)]

name: Operad.ShuffleBarSym.rootFlag_toBar
statement:
lemma rootFlag_toBar : ∀ t : STree (VMono G), rootFlag (toBar t) = false
  | STree.leaf _ => rfl
  | STree.node m ch => by
    obtain ⟨e, l, r, h⟩
proof:
:= m.exists_node
    rw [toBar_node, h]
    rfl

name: Operad.ShuffleBarSym.strictOn_kids
statement:
lemma strictOn_kids {k : ℕ} (m : VMono G k) {ch : Fin k → STree (VMono G)}
    (hmin : ∀ j, (toBar (ch j)).minLabel = (ch j).first)
    (hmono : StrictMono fun j => (ch j).first) :
    StrictOn (fun a => (kids ch a).minLabel) (liftW false m.1)
proof:
:= by
  intro a ha b hb hab
  rw [labels_liftW] at ha hb
  have ha' := m.lt ha
  have hb' := m.lt hb
  show (kids ch a).minLabel < (kids ch b).minLabel
  rw [kids_of_lt ch ha', kids_of_lt ch hb', minLabel_cutRoot, minLabel_cutRoot, hmin, hmin]
  exact hmono (show (⟨a, ha'⟩ : Fin k) < ⟨b, hb'⟩ from hab)

name: Operad.ShuffleBarSym.minLabel_toBar
statement:
theorem minLabel_toBar : ∀ t : STree (VMono G), t.IsShuffle → (toBar t).minLabel = t.first
  | STree.leaf _, _ => rfl
  | STree.node (k := k) m ch, ht => by
    have hmin : ∀ j, (toBar (ch j)).minLabel = (ch j).first
proof:
:= fun j =>
      minLabel_toBar (ch j) (ht.child j)
    rw [toBar_node, minLabel_plug_of_strictOn _ (strictOn_kids m hmin ht.mono),
      show (liftW false m.1).minLabel = m.1.minLabel by
        rw [← minLabel_mapDec Prod.fst, liftW_mapDec],
      m.minLabel, first_node _ _ ht.pos, ← hmin, kids_of_lt ch ht.pos, minLabel_cutRoot]

name: Operad.ShuffleBarSym.isShuffle_toBar
statement:
theorem isShuffle_toBar : ∀ t : STree (VMono G), t.IsShuffle → (toBar t).IsShuffle
  | STree.leaf _, _ => trivial
  | STree.node (k := k) m ch, ht => by
    rw [toBar_node]
    refine isShuffle_plug_of_strictOn _ ((isShuffle_liftW _ _).2 m.isShuffle)
      (strictOn_kids m (fun j => minLabel_toBar (ch j) (ht.child j)) ht.mono) fun a ha => ?_
    rw [labels_liftW] at ha
    rw [kids_of_lt ch (m.lt ha), isShuffle_cutRoot]
    exact isShuffle_toBar _ (ht.child _)

name: Operad.ShuffleBarSym.mem_labels_toBar
statement: lemma mem_labels_toBar {t : STree (VMono G)} {a : ℕ} : a ∈ (toBar t).labels ↔ a ∈ t.labels
proof:
:= by
  rw [← labels_toBar t, Multiset.mem_coe]

name: Operad.ShuffleBarSym.nodup_toBar
statement: lemma nodup_toBar {t : STree (VMono G)} (h : t.labels.Nodup) : (toBar t).labels.Nodup
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Multiset.coe_nodup, labels_toBar]
  exact h

name: Operad.ShuffleBarSym.toFinset_labels
statement: lemma toFinset_labels {k : ℕ} (m : VMono G k) : m.1.labels.toFinset = Finset.range k
proof:
:= by
  ext a
  rw [List.mem_toFinset, Finset.mem_range]
  exact ⟨m.lt, m.mem⟩

name: Operad.ShuffleBarSym.cutKeys_toBar_node
statement:
lemma cutKeys_toBar_node {k : ℕ} (m : VMono G k) (ch : Fin k → STree (VMono G)) :
    ShuffleBar.cutKeys (toBar (STree.node m ch)) =
      (Finset.range k).biUnion fun a => ShuffleBar.cutKeys (kids ch a)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨e, l, r, h⟩ := m.exists_node
  rw [toBar_node, h, cutKeys_plug_liftW, if_neg Bool.false_ne_true, Finset.empty_union, ← h,
    toFinset_labels]

name: Operad.ShuffleBarSym.disjoint_cutKeys_kids
proof:
:= by
  intro a ha b hb hab
  have ha' : a < k := Finset.mem_range.1 ha
  have hb' : b < k := Finset.mem_range.1 hb
  have hd := disjoint_of_node hnd (show (⟨a, ha'⟩ : Fin k) ≠ ⟨b, hb'⟩ from
    fun h => hab (congrArg Fin.val h))
  refine Finset.disjoint_left.2 fun κ h1 h2 => ?_
  simp only [kids_of_lt ch ha', kids_of_lt ch hb'] at h1 h2
  have m1 := (mem_nodeKeys_labels _ (cutKeys_subset _ h1)).1
  have m2 := (mem_nodeKeys_labels _ (cutKeys_subset _ h2)).1
  rw [labels_cutRoot, mem_labels_toBar] at m1 m2
  exact Multiset.disjoint_left.1 hd m1 m2

name: Operad.ShuffleBarSym.toBar_node_eq
statement:
lemma toBar_node_eq {k : ℕ} (m : VMono G k) (ch : Fin k → STree (VMono G)) :
    ∃ e l r, toBar (STree.node m ch) = LTree.node (e, false) l r
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨e, l, r, h⟩ := m.exists_node
  refine ⟨e, (unflag l).plug (kids ch), (unflag r).plug (kids ch), ?_⟩
  rw [toBar_node, h]
  rfl

name: Operad.ShuffleBarSym.card_cutKeys_cutRoot_toBar
statement:
theorem card_cutKeys_cutRoot_toBar : ∀ t : STree (VMono G), t.labels.Nodup →
    (ShuffleBar.cutKeys (cutRoot (toBar t))).card = t.weight
  | STree.leaf _, _ => rfl
  | STree.node (k := k) m ch, hnd => by
    obtain ⟨e, l, r, hT⟩
proof:
:= toBar_node_eq m ch
    rw [hT, card_cutKeys_cutRoot_node rfl, ← hT, cutKeys_toBar_node,
      Finset.card_biUnion (disjoint_cutKeys_kids hnd), STree.weight, add_comm,
      ← Fin.sum_univ_eq_sum_range (fun a => (ShuffleBar.cutKeys (kids ch a)).card)]
    congr 1
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => ?_
    rw [kids_fin, card_cutKeys_cutRoot_toBar (ch j) (nodup_of_node hnd j)]

name: Operad.ShuffleBarSym.card_cutKeys_toBar
statement:
theorem card_cutKeys_toBar {k : ℕ} (m : VMono G k) (ch : Fin k → STree (VMono G))
    (hnd : (STree.node m ch).labels.Nodup) :
    (ShuffleBar.cutKeys (toBar (STree.node m ch))).card + 1 = (STree.node m ch).weight
proof:
:= by
  rw [← card_cutKeys_cutRoot_toBar _ hnd]
  obtain ⟨e, l, r, hT⟩ := toBar_node_eq m ch
  rw [hT, card_cutKeys_cutRoot_node rfl]

name: Operad.ShuffleBarSym.topAux_cutRoot
statement: lemma topAux_cutRoot (y : BarTree G) : topAux (cutRoot y) = LTree.leaf y.minLabel
proof:
:= by
  cases y with
  | leaf => rfl
  | node d l r => simp [cutRoot, topAux]

name: Operad.ShuffleBarSym.hangAux_cutRoot
statement: lemma hangAux_cutRoot (y : BarTree G) : hangAux (cutRoot y) y.minLabel = cutRoot y
proof:
:= by
  cases y with
  | leaf => rfl
  | node d l r => simp [cutRoot, hangAux]

name: Operad.ShuffleBarSym.pick_eq
statement:
lemma pick_eq {ins : ℕ → BarTree G} {a j : ℕ} :
    ∀ {ks : List ℕ}, j ∈ ks → a ∈ (topAux (ins j)).labels →
      (∀ i ∈ ks, i ≠ j → a ∉ (topAux (ins i)).labels) → pick ins a ks = hangAux (ins j) a
  | [], hj, _, _ => absurd hj List.not_mem_nil
  | i :: ks, hj, ha, hother => by
    rw [pick]
    by_cases hij : i = j
    · subst hij
      rw [if_pos ha]
    · rw [if_neg (hother i (by simp) hij)]
      exact pick_eq (List.mem_of_ne_of_mem (Ne.symm hij) hj) ha
        fun i' hi' => hother i' (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hi')

                                                                                       
def firstOf {k : ℕ} (ch : Fin k → STree (VMono G)) (a : ℕ) : ℕ
proof: := (kids ch a).minLabel

name: Operad.ShuffleBarSym.top_toBar
statement:
lemma top_toBar {k : ℕ} (m : VMono G k) (ch : Fin k → STree (VMono G)) :
    top (toBar (STree.node m ch)) = m.1.plug fun a => LTree.leaf (firstOf ch a)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨e, l, r, h⟩ := m.exists_node
  rw [toBar_node, h, top_plug_liftW, ← h]
  refine plug_congr fun a ha => ?_
  rw [kids_of_lt ch (m.lt ha), topAux_cutRoot, firstOf, kids_of_lt ch (m.lt ha), minLabel_cutRoot]

name: Operad.ShuffleBarSym.firstOf_lt
statement:
lemma firstOf_lt {k : ℕ} (ch : Fin k → STree (VMono G)) (hch : ∀ j, (ch j).IsShuffle)
    (j : Fin k) : firstOf ch j = (ch j).first
proof:
:= by
  rw [firstOf, kids_fin, minLabel_cutRoot, minLabel_toBar _ (hch j)]

name: Operad.ShuffleBarSym.hang_toBar
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨e, l, r, h⟩ := m.exists_node
  rw [toBar_node, h, hang_plug_liftW, ← h]
  have hfj : (ch j).first = (kids ch j).minLabel := by
    rw [kids_fin, minLabel_cutRoot, minLabel_toBar _ (ht.child j)]
  rw [pick_eq (j := j) (m.mem j.2), hfj, kids_fin, minLabel_cutRoot, hangAux_cutRoot]
  · rw [kids_fin, topAux_cutRoot, minLabel_toBar _ (ht.child j)]
    simp
  · intro i hi hij
    rw [kids_of_lt ch (m.lt hi), topAux_cutRoot, minLabel_toBar _ (ht.child _),
      LTree.labels_leaf, List.mem_singleton]
    intro heq
    refine hij ?_
    have := ht.mono.injective heq
    exact (congrArg Fin.val this).symm

name: Operad.ShuffleBarSym.plug_leaf_injective
statement:
lemma plug_leaf_injective {X : Type*} {F : ℕ → ℕ} :
    ∀ {m m' : LTree X}, (∀ a ∈ m.labels, ∀ b ∈ m'.labels, F a = F b → a = b) →
      m.plug (fun a => LTree.leaf (F a)) = m'.plug (fun a => LTree.leaf (F a)) → m = m'
  | LTree.leaf a, LTree.leaf b, hF, h => by
    simp only [plug, LTree.leaf.injEq] at h
    rw [hF a (by simp) b (by simp) h]
  | LTree.leaf _, LTree.node _ _ _, _, h => by simp [plug] at h
  | LTree.node _ _ _, LTree.leaf _, _, h => by simp [plug] at h
  | LTree.node e l r, LTree.node e' l' r', hF, h => by
    simp only [plug, LTree.node.injEq] at h
    obtain ⟨he, hl, hr⟩
proof:
:= h
    rw [he, plug_leaf_injective (fun a ha b hb => hF a (by simp [ha]) b (by simp [hb])) hl,
      plug_leaf_injective (fun a ha b hb => hF a (by simp [ha]) b (by simp [hb])) hr]

name: Operad.ShuffleBarSym.labels_plug_leaf
statement:
lemma labels_plug_leaf {X : Type*} (F : ℕ → ℕ) (m : LTree X) :
    (m.plug fun a => LTree.leaf (F a)).labels = m.labels.map F
proof:
:= by
  induction m with
  | leaf a => rfl
  | node e l r hl hr => simp only [plug, LTree.labels_node, hl, hr, List.map_append]

name: Operad.ShuffleBarSym.node_ne_leaf
statement:
lemma node_ne_leaf {k : ℕ} (m : VMono G k) (ch : Fin k → STree (VMono G)) (a : ℕ) :
    toBar (STree.node m ch) ≠ LTree.leaf a
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨e, l, r, h⟩ := toBar_node_eq m ch
  rw [h]
  exact fun h' => by cases h'

name: Operad.ShuffleBarSym.toBar_injective
statement:
theorem toBar_injective : ∀ {t t' : STree (VMono G)}, t.IsShuffle → t'.IsShuffle →
    toBar t = toBar t' → t = t'
  | STree.leaf a, STree.leaf b, _, _, h => by
    simp only [toBar, LTree.leaf.injEq] at h
    rw [h]
  | STree.leaf _, STree.node _ _, _, _, h => absurd h.symm (node_ne_leaf _ _ _)
  | STree.node _ _, STree.leaf _, _, _, h => absurd h (node_ne_leaf _ _ _)
  | STree.node (k := k) m ch, STree.node (k := k') m' ch', ht, ht', h => by
    have htop
proof:
:= congrArg top h
    rw [top_toBar, top_toBar] at htop
    have hlab := congrArg LTree.labels htop
    rw [labels_plug_leaf, labels_plug_leaf] at hlab
    have hk : k = k' := by
      have := congrArg List.length hlab
      rw [List.length_map, List.length_map, m.perm.length_eq, m'.perm.length_eq,
        List.length_range, List.length_range] at this
      exact this
    subst hk
    have key : ∀ (c : Fin k → STree (VMono G)) (mm : VMono G k), (∀ j, (c j).IsShuffle) →
        ∀ x, (x ∈ Set.range fun j => (c j).first) ↔ x ∈ mm.1.labels.map (firstOf c) := by
      intro c mm hc x
      simp only [Set.mem_range, List.mem_map]
      constructor
      · rintro ⟨j, rfl⟩
        exact ⟨j, mm.mem j.2, firstOf_lt c hc j⟩
      · rintro ⟨a, ha, rfl⟩
        exact ⟨⟨a, mm.lt ha⟩, (firstOf_lt c hc ⟨a, mm.lt ha⟩).symm⟩
    have hf : (fun j => (ch j).first) = fun j => (ch' j).first :=
      (StrictMono.range_inj ht.mono ht'.mono).1 (Set.ext fun x => by
        rw [key ch m ht.child, key ch' m' ht'.child, hlab])
    have hF : ∀ a < k, firstOf ch a = firstOf ch' a := fun a ha => by
      have h1 := firstOf_lt ch ht.child ⟨a, ha⟩
      have h2 := firstOf_lt ch' ht'.child ⟨a, ha⟩
      exact h1.trans ((congrFun hf _).trans h2.symm)
    rw [plug_congr (m := m'.1) (ins' := fun a => LTree.leaf (firstOf ch a))
      fun a ha => by show _ = LTree.leaf (firstOf ch a); rw [hF a (m'.lt ha)]] at htop
    have hm : m = m' := Subtype.ext (plug_leaf_injective (fun a ha b hb hab => by
      have ha' := m.lt ha
      have hb' := m'.lt hb
      have h1 := firstOf_lt ch ht.child ⟨a, ha'⟩
      have h2 := firstOf_lt ch ht.child ⟨b, hb'⟩
      have h3 : (ch ⟨a, ha'⟩).first = (ch ⟨b, hb'⟩).first := h1.symm.trans (hab.trans h2)
      exact congrArg Fin.val (ht.mono.injective h3)) htop)
    subst hm
    have hch : ch = ch' := funext fun j => by
      have h1 := hang_toBar m ht j
      have h2 := hang_toBar m ht' j
      rw [h, show (ch j).first = (ch' j).first from congrFun hf j, h2, kids_fin,
        kids_fin] at h1
      exact toBar_injective (ht.child j) (ht'.child j)
        (cutRoot_injective (rootFlag_toBar _) (rootFlag_toBar _) h1).symm
    rw [hch]

name: Operad.ShuffleBarSym.hangAux_spec
statement:
lemma hangAux_spec : ∀ (y : BarTree G) (a : ℕ), a ∈ (topAux y).labels →
    (hangAux y a).minLabel = a ∧ cutRoot (uncutRoot (hangAux y a)) = hangAux y a ∧
      (y.IsShuffle → (hangAux y a).IsShuffle)
  | LTree.leaf b, a, ha => by
    simp only [topAux, LTree.labels_leaf, List.mem_singleton] at ha
    subst ha
    exact ⟨rfl, rfl, fun h => h⟩
  | LTree.node d l r, a, ha => by
    by_cases hd : d.2 = true
    · simp only [topAux, hd, if_true, LTree.labels_leaf, List.mem_singleton] at ha
      subst ha
      simp only [hangAux, hd, if_true]
      refine ⟨rfl, ?_, fun h => h⟩
      obtain ⟨e, b⟩
proof:
:= d
      simp only at hd
      subst hd
      rfl
    · simp only [topAux, hd, Bool.false_eq_true, if_false, LTree.labels_node,
        List.mem_append] at ha
      simp only [hangAux, hd, Bool.false_eq_true, if_false]
      split_ifs with hl
      · obtain ⟨h1, h2, h3⟩ := hangAux_spec l a hl
        exact ⟨h1, h2, fun h => h3 h.2.1⟩
      · obtain ⟨h1, h2, h3⟩ := hangAux_spec r a (ha.resolve_left hl)
        exact ⟨h1, h2, fun h => h3 h.2.2⟩

name: Operad.ShuffleBarSym.unflag_plug_leaf
statement:
lemma unflag_plug_leaf {X : Type*} (F : ℕ → ℕ) (K : ℕ → LTree (X × Bool)) :
    ∀ l : LTree X, (unflag (l.plug fun a => LTree.leaf (F a))).plug K =
      (unflag l).plug fun a => K (F a)
  | LTree.leaf _ => rfl
  | LTree.node e l r => by
    simp only [plug, mapDec_node]
    rw [unflag_plug_leaf F K l, unflag_plug_leaf F K r]

name: Operad.ShuffleBarSym.liftW_plug_leaf
statement:
lemma liftW_plug_leaf {X : Type*} (c : Bool) (F : ℕ → ℕ) (K : ℕ → LTree (X × Bool)) :
    ∀ T : LTree X, (liftW c (T.plug fun a => LTree.leaf (F a))).plug K =
      (liftW c T).plug fun a => K (F a)
  | LTree.leaf _ => rfl
  | LTree.node e l r => by
    simp only [plug, liftW]
    exact congrArg₂ _ (unflag_plug_leaf F K l) (unflag_plug_leaf F K r)

name: Operad.ShuffleBarSym.exists_toBar
statement:
theorem exists_toBar : ∀ (N : ℕ) (y : BarTree G), y.size ≤ N → Valid y →
    ∃ t : STree (VMono G), t.IsShuffle ∧ t.labels = (y.labels : Multiset ℕ) ∧ toBar t = y
  | _, LTree.leaf a, _, _ => ⟨STree.leaf a, trivial, rfl, rfl⟩
  | 0, LTree.node _ _ _, hN, _ => by simp at hN
  | N + 1, LTree.node d l r, hN, hy => by
    set y
proof:
:= LTree.node d l r with hy_def
    have hnd := hy.nodup
    have hroot : rootFlag y = false := hy.root
    set T := top y with hT
    set S := T.labels.toFinset with hS
    set k := S.card with hk
    have hTnd : T.labels.Nodup := nodup_top hnd
    have hk2 : 2 ≤ k := by
      rw [hk, hS, List.toFinset_card_of_nodup hTnd, length_labels, hT, hy_def]
      simp only [top, arity]
      have := arity_pos (topAux l)
      have := arity_pos (topAux r)
      omega
    let iso := S.orderIsoOfFin hk.symm
    let g : Fin k → ℕ := fun j => (iso j : ℕ)
    let rank : ℕ → ℕ := fun a => if h : a ∈ S then (iso.symm ⟨a, h⟩ : ℕ) else 0
    have hgS : ∀ j, g j ∈ S := fun j => (iso j).2
    have hrank_lt : ∀ a, rank a < k ∨ a ∉ S := fun a => by
      by_cases h : a ∈ S
      · left
        simp only [rank, dif_pos h]
        exact (iso.symm ⟨a, h⟩).2
      · exact Or.inr h
    have hrank_g : ∀ j, rank (g j) = j := fun j => by
      simp only [rank, dif_pos (hgS j)]
      rw [show (⟨g j, hgS j⟩ : S) = iso j from rfl, OrderIso.symm_apply_apply]
    have hg_rank : ∀ a (h : a ∈ S), g ⟨rank a, by simp only [rank, dif_pos h]; exact
        (iso.symm ⟨a, h⟩).2⟩ = a := fun a h => by
      simp only [g, rank, dif_pos h]
      rw [Fin.eta, OrderIso.apply_symm_apply]
    have hgmono : StrictMono g := fun i j hij => iso.strictMono hij
    have hrank_on : StrictOn rank T := fun a ha b hb hab => by
      have ha' : a ∈ S := List.mem_toFinset.2 ha
      have hb' : b ∈ S := List.mem_toFinset.2 hb
      simp only [rank, dif_pos ha', dif_pos hb']
      exact iso.symm.strictMono (show (⟨a, ha'⟩ : S) < ⟨b, hb'⟩ from hab)
    
    set m : LTree G := T.plug fun a => LTree.leaf (rank a) with hm_def
    have hm_mem : m ∈ LTree.monomials k := by
      refine (LTree.mem_monomials k m).2 ⟨isShuffle_plug_of_strictOn _ (isShuffle_top hy.shuffle)
        hrank_on fun _ _ => trivial, ?_⟩
      rw [hm_def, labels_plug_leaf]
      refine List.perm_of_nodup_nodup_toFinset_eq
        (hTnd.map_on fun a ha b hb hab => ?_) List.nodup_range ?_
      · rcases lt_trichotomy a b with h | h | h
        · exact absurd hab (hrank_on a ha b hb h).ne
        · exact h
        · exact absurd hab.symm (hrank_on b hb a ha h).ne
      · rw [List.toFinset_range]
        ext x
        simp only [List.mem_toFinset, List.mem_map, Finset.mem_range]
        constructor
        · rintro ⟨a, ha, rfl⟩
          exact (hrank_lt a).resolve_right (by simpa [hS] using ha)
        · intro hx
          exact ⟨g ⟨x, hx⟩, List.mem_toFinset.1 (hgS _), hrank_g ⟨x, hx⟩⟩
    let mm : VMono G k := ⟨m, hm_mem, hk2⟩
    
    have hhang : hang y = hangAux y := (hangAux_eq_hang hroot).symm
    have htop : T = topAux y := (topAux_eq_top hroot).symm
    have hspec : ∀ a ∈ S, (hang y a).minLabel = a ∧ cutRoot (uncutRoot (hang y a)) = hang y a ∧
        (hang y a).IsShuffle := fun a ha => by
      rw [hhang]
      obtain ⟨h1, h2, h3⟩ := hangAux_spec y a (by rw [← htop]; exact List.mem_toFinset.1 ha)
      exact ⟨h1, h2, h3 hy.shuffle⟩
    have hplug := plug_top y hnd
    rw [hroot] at hplug
    have hlabels : y.labels = T.labels.flatMap fun a => (hang y a).labels := by
      conv_lhs => rw [← hplug]
      rw [labels_plug, labels_liftW]
    have hnd_hang : ∀ a ∈ T.labels, (hang y a).labels.Nodup := fun a ha => by
      rw [hlabels] at hnd
      exact (List.nodup_flatMap.1 hnd).1 a ha
    let z : Fin k → BarTree G := fun j => uncutRoot (hang y (g j))
    have hz : ∀ j, Valid (z j) := fun j =>
      ⟨(isShuffle_uncutRoot _).2 (hspec _ (hgS j)).2.2,
        by rw [labels_uncutRoot]; exact hnd_hang _ (List.mem_toFinset.1 (hgS j)),
        rootFlag_uncutRoot _⟩
    have hzsize : ∀ j, (z j).size ≤ N := fun j => by
      have := size_hang_lt d l r (g j)
      simp only [z, size_uncutRoot]
      rw [← hy_def] at this
      omega
    choose s hs using fun j => exists_toBar N (z j) (hzsize j) (hz j)
    refine ⟨STree.node mm s, ⟨by omega, fun j => (hs j).1, fun i j hij => ?_⟩, ?_, ?_⟩
    · show (s i).first < (s j).first
      rw [← minLabel_toBar _ (hs i).1, ← minLabel_toBar _ (hs j).1, (hs i).2.2, (hs j).2.2]
      simp only [z, minLabel_uncutRoot]
      rw [(hspec _ (hgS i)).1, (hspec _ (hgS j)).1]
      exact hgmono hij
    · rw [STree.labels, hlabels, ← Multiset.coe_bind]
      have hval : ((T.labels : List ℕ) : Multiset ℕ) = S.val := by
        rw [hS, List.toFinset_val, List.dedup_eq_self.2 hTnd]
      rw [hval]
      have : ∀ j, (s j).labels = (((hang y (g j)).labels : List ℕ) : Multiset ℕ) := fun j => by
        rw [(hs j).2.1]
        simp [z]
      simp only [this]
      rw [← S.map_orderEmbOfFin_univ hk.symm, Finset.map_val, Multiset.bind_map]
      show _ = (Multiset.map (fun a => (((hang y ((S.orderEmbOfFin hk.symm).toEmbedding a)).labels
        : List ℕ) : Multiset ℕ)) Finset.univ.val).sum
      rw [← Finset.sum_eq_multiset_sum]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => ?_
      simp only [g, iso, RelEmbedding.coe_toEmbedding, Finset.coe_orderIsoOfFin_apply]
    · rw [toBar_node]
      show (liftW false (T.plug fun a => LTree.leaf (rank a))).plug (kids s) = y
      rw [liftW_plug_leaf]
      conv_rhs => rw [← hplug]
      refine plug_congr fun a ha => ?_
      rw [labels_liftW] at ha
      have haS : a ∈ S := List.mem_toFinset.2 ha
      have hra : rank a < k := (hrank_lt a).resolve_right (not_not.2 haS)
      rw [kids_of_lt s hra, (hs _).2.2]
      simp only [z]
      rw [hg_rank a haS]
      exact (hspec a haS).2.1

name: Operad.ShuffleBarSym.valid_toBar
statement: lemma valid_toBar {Y : Finset ℕ} (t : SMono (VMono G) Y) : Valid (toBar t.1)
proof:
:=
  ⟨isShuffle_toBar _ t.2.1, nodup_toBar (by rw [t.2.2]; exact Y.nodup), rootFlag_toBar _⟩

name: Operad.ShuffleBarSym.labels_toBar_range
statement:
lemma labels_toBar_range {n : ℕ} (t : SMono (VMono G) (Finset.range n)) :
    (toBar t.1).labels.Perm (List.range n)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Multiset.coe_eq_coe, labels_toBar, t.2.2, Finset.range_val, Multiset.coe_range]

name: Operad.ShuffleBarSym.treeEquiv_apply
statement:
@[simp] lemma treeEquiv_apply {n : ℕ} (t : SMono (VMono G) (Finset.range n)) :
    (treeEquiv n t : BarTree G) = toBar t.1
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.ShuffleBarSym.exists_node_of_two_le
statement:
lemma exists_node_of_two_le {n : ℕ} (hn : 2 ≤ n) (t : SMono (VMono G) (Finset.range n)) :
    ∃ (k : ℕ) (m : VMono G k) (ch : Fin k → STree (VMono G)), t.1 = STree.node m ch
proof:
:= by
  rcases h : t.1 with a | ⟨m, ch⟩
  · have h1 := congrArg Multiset.card t.2.2
    rw [h, STree.labels_leaf, Multiset.card_singleton, Finset.range_val, Multiset.card_range] at h1
    omega
  · exact ⟨_, m, ch, rfl⟩

name: Operad.ShuffleBarSym.adm_treeEquiv
statement:
theorem adm_treeEquiv {n : ℕ} (hn : 2 ≤ n) (t : SMono (VMono G) (Finset.range n)) :
    Adm n t.1.weight (treeEquiv n t : BarTree G)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨valid_toBar t, labels_toBar_range t, ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨k, m, ch, h⟩ := exists_node_of_two_le hn t
  rw [treeEquiv_apply, h, card_cutKeys_toBar m ch (by rw [← h, t.2.2]; exact Finset.nodup _)]

name: Operad.ShuffleBarSym.mem_barSet_of_adm
statement: lemma mem_barSet_of_adm {n s : ℕ} {x : BarTree G} (h : Adm n s x) : x ∈ barSet G n

name: Operad.ShuffleBarSym.adm_iff
statement:
theorem adm_iff {n s : ℕ} (hn : 2 ≤ n) (t : SMono (VMono G) (Finset.range n)) :
    Adm n s (treeEquiv n t : BarTree G) ↔ t.1.weight = s
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    have h' := adm_treeEquiv hn t
    exact h'.2.2.symm.trans h.2.2
  · rintro rfl
    exact adm_treeEquiv hn t

name: Operad.ShuffleBarSym.isUnit_sign
statement: lemma isUnit_sign {B : ℕ → Type*} (t : STree B) : IsUnit (sign K t)
proof:
:=
  (isUnit_neg_one (α := K)).pow _

name: Operad.ShuffleBarSym.sign_mul_self
statement: lemma sign_mul_self {B : ℕ → Type*} (t : STree B) : sign K t * sign K t = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [sign, ← pow_add, ← two_mul, pow_mul, neg_one_sq, one_pow]

name: Operad.ShuffleBarSym.barBasisN_apply
statement:
lemma barBasisN_apply (n : ℕ) (t : SMono (VMono G) (Finset.range n)) :
    barBasisN c hc n t = barBasis c hc (Fin n) (t.cast (by rw [Fintype.card_fin]))
proof:
:= by
  rw [barBasisN, Module.Basis.reindex_apply]
  rfl

name: Operad.ShuffleBarSym.ΦL_injective
statement: lemma ΦL_injective (n : ℕ) : Function.Injective (ΦL c hc n)
proof:
:=
  (Submodule.subtype_injective _).comp (Φ c hc n).injective

name: Operad.ShuffleBarSym.ΦL_range
statement: lemma ΦL_range (n : ℕ) : LinearMap.range (ΦL c hc n) = Finsupp.supported K K (barSet G n)
proof:
:= by
  rw [ΦL, LinearMap.range_comp, LinearEquiv.range, Submodule.map_top, Submodule.range_subtype]

name: Operad.ShuffleBarSym.ΦL_signedBasis
statement:
lemma ΦL_signedBasis (n : ℕ) (t : SMono (VMono G) (Finset.range n)) :
    ΦL c hc n (signedBasis c hc n t) = Finsupp.single (toBar t.1) 1
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp only [ΦL, Φ, LinearMap.coe_comp, Function.comp_apply, LinearEquiv.coe_coe,
    LinearEquiv.trans_apply, Module.Basis.repr_self, Finsupp.domLCongr_single,
    Submodule.coe_subtype]
  rw [Finsupp.supportedEquivFinsupp_symm_apply_coe, Finsupp.extendDomain_single]
  rfl

name: Operad.ShuffleBarSym.Φ_barBasisN
statement:
theorem Φ_barBasisN (n : ℕ) (t : SMono (VMono G) (Finset.range n)) :
    ΦL c hc n (barBasisN c hc n t) = sign K t.1 • Finsupp.single (toBar t.1) 1
proof:
:= by
  have : barBasisN c hc n t = sign K t.1 • signedBasis c hc n t := by
    rw [signedBasis, Module.Basis.isUnitSMul_apply, smul_smul, sign_mul_self, one_smul]
  rw [this, map_smul, ΦL_signedBasis]

name: Operad.ShuffleBarSym.map_ΦL_deg
statement:
theorem map_ΦL_deg {n : ℕ} (hn : 2 ≤ n) (s : ℕ) :
    Submodule.map (ΦL c hc n) (deg c hc n s) = ShuffleBar.C (E := G) K n s
proof:
:= by
  rw [deg, Submodule.map_span, ShuffleBar.C, Finsupp.supported_eq_span_single]
  apply le_antisymm
  · rw [Submodule.span_le]
    rintro _ ⟨_, ⟨t, ht, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
    rw [SetLike.mem_coe, Φ_barBasisN c hc n t]
    refine Submodule.smul_mem _ _ (Submodule.subset_span ⟨toBar t.1, ?_, rfl⟩)
    exact (adm_iff hn t).2 ht
  · rw [Submodule.span_le]
    rintro _ ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := (treeEquiv n).surjective ⟨x, mem_barSet_of_adm hx⟩
    have hx' : toBar t.1 = x := congrArg Subtype.val ht
    have hw : t.1.weight = s := (adm_iff hn t).1 (by rw [treeEquiv_apply, hx']; exact hx)
    have hmem : ΦL c hc n (barBasisN c hc n t) ∈
        Submodule.span K (ΦL c hc n '' (barBasisN c hc n ''
          {t : SMono (VMono G) (Finset.range n) | t.1.weight = s})) :=
      Submodule.subset_span ⟨_, ⟨t, hw, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
    rw [Φ_barBasisN c hc n t, hx'] at hmem
    have := Submodule.smul_mem _ (sign K t.1) hmem
    rwa [smul_smul, sign_mul_self, one_smul] at this

name: Operad.ShuffleBarSym.iSup_deg
statement: theorem iSup_deg (n : ℕ) : ⨆ s, deg c hc n s = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  refine eq_top_iff.2 ?_
  rw [← (barBasisN c hc n).span_eq, Submodule.span_le]
  rintro _ ⟨t, rfl⟩
  exact Submodule.mem_iSup_of_mem t.1.weight (Submodule.subset_span ⟨t, rfl, rfl⟩)

name: Operad.ShuffleBarSym.barBasisN_mem_vx
statement:
theorem barBasisN_mem_vx (n : ℕ) (t : SMono (VMono G) (Finset.range n)) :
    barBasisN c hc n t ∈ FreeGrL.vx K (BarGen (Ibar K E c hc)) t.1.weight (Fin n)
proof:
:= by
  rw [barBasisN_apply, barBasis]
  erw [FreeGrL.shuffleBasis_apply (genBasis c hc) (par_genBasis c hc)]
  exact FreeGrL.map_mem_eig _ (FreeGrL.shEv_mem_vx (genBasis c hc) (par_genBasis c hc) _ t.1
    le_rfl t.2.1 _ _)

name: Operad.ShuffleBarSym.deg_le_vx
statement: lemma deg_le_vx (n s : ℕ) : deg c hc n s ≤ FreeGrL.vx K (BarGen (Ibar K E c hc)) s (Fin n)
proof:
:= by
  rw [deg, Submodule.span_le]
  rintro _ ⟨t, ht, rfl⟩
  have := barBasisN_mem_vx c hc n t
  rw [ht] at this
  exact this

name: Operad.ShuffleBarSym.deg_eq_vx
statement: theorem deg_eq_vx (n s : ℕ) : deg c hc n s = FreeGrL.vx K (BarGen (Ibar K E c hc)) s (Fin n)
proof:
:= by
  refine le_antisymm (deg_le_vx c hc n s) fun x hx => ?_
  have hx' : x ∈ deg c hc n s ⊔ ⨆ i, ⨆ (_ : i ≠ s), deg c hc n i := by
    rw [← iSup_split_single (fun i => deg c hc n i) s, iSup_deg]
    exact Submodule.mem_top
  obtain ⟨y, hy, z, hz, rfl⟩ := Submodule.mem_sup.1 hx'
  have hzv : z ∈ FreeGrL.vx K (BarGen (Ibar K E c hc)) s (Fin n) := by
    have := Submodule.sub_mem _ hx (deg_le_vx c hc n s hy)
    rwa [add_sub_cancel_left] at this
  have hzo : z ∈ ⨆ i, ⨆ (_ : i ≠ s), FreeGrL.vx K (BarGen (Ibar K E c hc)) i (Fin n) :=
    (iSup₂_mono fun i _ => deg_le_vx c hc n i) hz
  have hind := iSupIndep_def.1 (iSupIndep_eigenspace_nat
    ((FreeGrL.derSp (GrSpEnd.id K (BarGen (Ibar K E c hc)))).app (Fin n))) s
  have hz0 : z = 0 := Submodule.disjoint_def.1 hind z hzv hzo
  rw [hz0, add_zero]
  exact hy

name: Operad.ShuffleBarSym.d_mem_deg
statement:
theorem d_mem_deg {n s : ℕ} {x : BarCoop (Ibar K E c hc) (Fin n)} (hx : x ∈ deg c hc n (s + 1)) :
    Bar.d (Ibar K E c hc) (Fin n) x ∈ deg c hc n s
proof:
:= by
  rw [deg_eq_vx] at hx ⊢
  exact Bar.d_vx_succ hx

name: Operad.ShuffleBarSym.ΦL_d_mem_C
statement:
theorem ΦL_d_mem_C {n s : ℕ} (hn : 2 ≤ n) {x : BarCoop (Ibar K E c hc) (Fin n)}
    (hx : x ∈ deg c hc n (s + 1)) :
    ΦL c hc n (Bar.d (Ibar K E c hc) (Fin n) x) ∈ ShuffleBar.C (E := G) K n s ∧
      ShuffleBar.d K (ΦL c hc n x) ∈ ShuffleBar.C (E := G) K n s
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨?_, ShuffleBar.d_mem_C K ?_⟩
  · rw [← map_ΦL_deg c hc hn s]
    exact Submodule.mem_map_of_mem (d_mem_deg c hc hx)
  · rw [← map_ΦL_deg c hc hn (s + 1)]
    exact Submodule.mem_map_of_mem hx

name: Operad.ExtBV.induction
statement:
@[elab_as_elim]
theorem induction {P : E → Prop} (alg : ∀ r, P (algebraMap R E r))
    (add : ∀ x y, P x → P y → P (x + y)) (ι_mul : ∀ m x, P x → P (ι R m * x)) (x : E) : P x
proof:
:= by
  induction x using CliffordAlgebra.left_induction with
  | algebraMap r => exact alg r
  | add x y hx hy => exact add x y hx hy
  | ι_mul x m hx => exact ι_mul m x hx

name: Operad.ExtBV.prZ_apply
statement: lemma prZ_apply (i : ZMod 2) (x : E) : prZ i x = DirectSum.decompose (evenOdd Q₀) x i
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.ExtBV.prZ_mem
statement: lemma prZ_mem (i : ZMod 2) (x : E) : prZ i x ∈ evenOdd Q₀ i
proof:
:= by
  exact (DirectSum.decompose (evenOdd Q₀) x i).2

name: Operad.ExtBV.prZ_of_mem
statement: lemma prZ_of_mem {i : ZMod 2} {x : E} (h : x ∈ evenOdd Q₀ i) : prZ i x = x
proof:
:=
  DirectSum.decompose_of_mem_same _ h

name: Operad.ExtBV.prZ_of_mem_ne
statement: lemma prZ_of_mem_ne {i j : ZMod 2} {x : E} (h : x ∈ evenOdd Q₀ i) (hij : i ≠ j) : prZ j x = 0
proof:
:=
  DirectSum.decompose_of_mem_ne _ h hij

name: Operad.ExtBV.ι_mem
statement: lemma ι_mem (m : L) : ι R m ∈ evenOdd Q₀ 1
proof: := ι_mem_evenOdd_one Q₀ m

name: Operad.ExtBV.prZ_ι_mul
statement: lemma prZ_ι_mul (i : ZMod 2) (m : L) (x : E) : prZ (1 + i) (ι R m * x) = ι R m * prZ i x
proof:
:=
  DirectSum.coe_decompose_mul_add_of_left_mem (evenOdd Q₀) (ι_mem (R := R) m)

name: Operad.ExtBV.prZ_zero_ι_mul
statement: lemma prZ_zero_ι_mul (m : L) (x : E) : prZ 0 (ι R m * x) = ι R m * prZ 1 x
proof:
:= by
  rw [← prZ_ι_mul]
  rfl

name: Operad.ExtBV.prZ_one_ι_mul
statement: lemma prZ_one_ι_mul (m : L) (x : E) : prZ 1 (ι R m * x) = ι R m * prZ 0 x
proof:
:= by
  rw [← prZ_ι_mul]
  rfl

name: Operad.ExtBV.algebraMap_mem
statement: lemma algebraMap_mem (r : R) : algebraMap R E r ∈ evenOdd Q₀ 0
proof:
:=
  SetLike.algebraMap_mem_graded _ _

name: Operad.ExtBV.parity_induction
statement:
theorem parity_induction {Pe Po : E → Prop} (alg : ∀ r, Pe (algebraMap R E r)) (zero : Po 0)
    (adde : ∀ x y, Pe x → Pe y → Pe (x + y)) (addo : ∀ x y, Po x → Po y → Po (x + y))
    (ιe : ∀ m x, x ∈ evenOdd Q₀ 1 → Po x → Pe (ι R m * x))
    (ιo : ∀ m x, x ∈ evenOdd Q₀ 0 → Pe x → Po (ι R m * x)) (x : E) :
    Pe (prZ 0 x) ∧ Po (prZ 1 x)
proof:
:= by
  induction x using induction with
  | alg r =>
    rw [prZ_of_mem (algebraMap_mem r), prZ_of_mem_ne (algebraMap_mem r) (by decide)]
    exact ⟨alg r, zero⟩
  | add x y hx hy =>
    rw [map_add, map_add]
    exact ⟨adde _ _ hx.1 hy.1, addo _ _ hx.2 hy.2⟩
  | ι_mul m x hx =>
    rw [prZ_zero_ι_mul, prZ_one_ι_mul]
    exact ⟨ιe m _ (prZ_mem 1 x) hx.2, ιo m _ (prZ_mem 0 x) hx.1⟩

name: Operad.ExtBV.even_induction'
statement:
lemma even_induction' {Pe Po : E → Prop} (alg : ∀ r, Pe (algebraMap R E r)) (zero : Po 0)
    (adde : ∀ x y, Pe x → Pe y → Pe (x + y)) (addo : ∀ x y, Po x → Po y → Po (x + y))
    (ιe : ∀ m x, x ∈ evenOdd Q₀ 1 → Po x → Pe (ι R m * x))
    (ιo : ∀ m x, x ∈ evenOdd Q₀ 0 → Pe x → Po (ι R m * x)) {x : E} (hx : x ∈ evenOdd Q₀ 0) :
    Pe x
proof:
:= by
  have h := (parity_induction alg zero adde addo ιe ιo x).1
  rwa [prZ_of_mem hx] at h

name: Operad.ExtBV.odd_induction'
statement:
lemma odd_induction' {Pe Po : E → Prop} (alg : ∀ r, Pe (algebraMap R E r)) (zero : Po 0)
    (adde : ∀ x y, Pe x → Pe y → Pe (x + y)) (addo : ∀ x y, Po x → Po y → Po (x + y))
    (ιe : ∀ m x, x ∈ evenOdd Q₀ 1 → Po x → Pe (ι R m * x))
    (ιo : ∀ m x, x ∈ evenOdd Q₀ 0 → Pe x → Po (ι R m * x)) {x : E} (hx : x ∈ evenOdd Q₀ 1) :
    Po x
proof:
:= by
  have h := (parity_induction alg zero adde addo ιe ιo x).2
  rwa [prZ_of_mem hx] at h

name: Operad.ExtBV.prZ_add
statement: lemma prZ_add (x : E) : prZ 0 x + prZ 1 x = x
proof:
:= by
  induction x using induction with
  | alg r =>
    rw [prZ_of_mem (algebraMap_mem r), prZ_of_mem_ne (algebraMap_mem r) (by decide), add_zero]
  | add x y hx hy =>
    rw [map_add, map_add, add_add_add_comm, hx, hy]
  | ι_mul m x hx =>
    rw [prZ_zero_ι_mul, prZ_one_ι_mul, ← mul_add, add_comm, hx]

name: Operad.ExtBV.ι_anti
statement: lemma ι_anti (a b : L) (x : E) : ι R a * (ι R b * x) = -(ι R b * (ι R a * x))
proof:
:= by
  rw [← mul_assoc, ← mul_assoc, eq_neg_of_add_eq_zero_left (ι_add_mul_swap (R := R) a b),
    neg_mul]

name: Operad.ExtBV.ι_ι
statement: lemma ι_ι (a : L) (x : E) : ι R a * (ι R a * x) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [← mul_assoc, ι_sq_zero, zero_mul]

name: Operad.ExtBV.ι_mul_comm
statement: lemma ι_mul_comm (m : L) (x : E) : ι R m * x = involute x * ι R m
proof:
:= by
  induction x using induction with
  | alg r => rw [AlgHom.commutes, Algebra.commutes]
  | add x y hx hy => rw [mul_add, hx, hy, map_add, add_mul]
  | ι_mul n x hx =>
    rw [ι_anti, hx, map_mul, involute_ι]
    noncomm_ring

name: Operad.ExtBV.ι_mul_involute
statement: lemma ι_mul_involute (m : L) (x : E) : ι R m * involute x = x * ι R m
proof:
:= by
  rw [ι_mul_comm, involute_involutive]

name: Operad.ExtBV.mul_comm_parity
statement:
theorem mul_comm_parity (x : E) :
    (∀ y, prZ 0 x * y = y * prZ 0 x) ∧ (∀ y, prZ 1 x * y = involute y * prZ 1 x)
proof:
:= by
  refine parity_induction (Pe := fun x => ∀ y, x * y = y * x)
    (Po := fun x => ∀ y, x * y = involute y * x) (fun r y => Algebra.commutes r y)
    (fun y => by rw [zero_mul, mul_zero]) (fun x x' hx hx' y => by rw [add_mul, mul_add, hx, hx'])
    (fun x x' hx hx' y => by rw [add_mul, mul_add, hx, hx']) (fun m x _ hx y => ?_)
    (fun m x _ hx y => ?_) x
  · rw [mul_assoc, hx, ← mul_assoc, ι_mul_involute, mul_assoc]
  · rw [mul_assoc, hx, ← mul_assoc, ι_mul_comm, mul_assoc]

name: Operad.ExtBV.mul_comm_even
statement: lemma mul_comm_even {x : E} (hx : x ∈ evenOdd Q₀ 0) (y : E) : x * y = y * x
proof:
:= by
  have h := (mul_comm_parity x).1 y
  rwa [prZ_of_mem hx] at h

name: Operad.ExtBV.mul_comm_odd
statement: lemma mul_comm_odd {x : E} (hx : x ∈ evenOdd Q₀ 1) (y : E) : x * y = involute y * x
proof:
:= by
  have h := (mul_comm_parity x).2 y
  rwa [prZ_of_mem hx] at h

name: Operad.ExtBV.dStep_apply
statement:
lemma dStep_apply (f : L →ₗ[R] L) (m : L) (p : E × E) :
    dStep f m p = ι R (f m) * p.1 + ι R m * p.2
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.ExtBV.D_ι_mul
statement:
lemma D_ι_mul (f : L →ₗ[R] L) (m : L) (x : E) :
    D f (ι R m * x) = ι R (f m) * x + ι R m * D f x
proof:
:=
  foldr'_ι_mul _ _ _ _ _ _

name: Operad.ExtBV.D_algebraMap
statement: lemma D_algebraMap (f : L →ₗ[R] L) (r : R) : D f (algebraMap R E r) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [D, foldr'_algebraMap, smul_zero]

name: Operad.ExtBV.D_one
statement: lemma D_one (f : L →ₗ[R] L) : D f 1 = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [← map_one (algebraMap R E), D_algebraMap]

name: Operad.ExtBV.D_ι
statement: lemma D_ι (f : L →ₗ[R] L) (m : L) : D f (ι R m) = ι R (f m)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← mul_one (ι R m), D_ι_mul, D_one, mul_zero, add_zero, mul_one]

name: Operad.ExtBV.D_mul
statement: theorem D_mul (f : L →ₗ[R] L) (x y : E) : D f (x * y) = D f x * y + x * D f y
proof:
:= by
  induction x using induction with
  | alg r =>
    rw [D_algebraMap, zero_mul, zero_add, ← Algebra.smul_def, ← Algebra.smul_def, map_smul]
  | add x x' hx hx' => rw [add_mul, map_add, hx, hx', map_add, add_mul, add_mul]; abel
  | ι_mul m x hx =>
    rw [mul_assoc, D_ι_mul, hx, D_ι_mul]
    noncomm_ring

name: Operad.ExtBV.D_add
statement: lemma D_add (f g : L →ₗ[R] L) (x : E) : D (f + g) x = D f x + D g x
proof:
:= by
  induction x using induction with
  | alg r => rw [D_algebraMap, D_algebraMap, D_algebraMap, add_zero]
  | add x x' hx hx' => rw [map_add, map_add, map_add, hx, hx']; abel
  | ι_mul m x hx =>
    rw [D_ι_mul, D_ι_mul, D_ι_mul, hx, LinearMap.add_apply, map_add, add_mul, mul_add]; abel

name: Operad.ExtBV.D_smul
statement: lemma D_smul (c : R) (f : L →ₗ[R] L) (x : E) : D (c • f) x = c • D f x
proof:
:= by
  induction x using induction with
  | alg r => rw [D_algebraMap, D_algebraMap, smul_zero]
  | add x x' hx hx' => rw [map_add, map_add, hx, hx', smul_add]
  | ι_mul m x hx =>
    rw [D_ι_mul, D_ι_mul, hx, LinearMap.smul_apply, map_smul, smul_mul_assoc, mul_smul_comm,
      smul_add]

name: Operad.ExtBV.D_comm
statement:
theorem D_comm (f g : L →ₗ[R] L) (x : E) :
    D f (D g x) - D g (D f x) = D (f ∘ₗ g - g ∘ₗ f) x
proof:
:= by
  induction x using induction with
  | alg r => rw [D_algebraMap, D_algebraMap, map_zero, map_zero, sub_zero, D_algebraMap]
  | add x x' hx hx' =>
    rw [map_add, map_add, map_add, map_add, map_add, ← hx, ← hx']; abel
  | ι_mul m x hx =>
    rw [D_ι_mul, D_ι_mul, map_add, map_add, D_ι_mul, D_ι_mul, D_ι_mul, D_ι_mul, D_ι_mul,
      ← hx, LinearMap.sub_apply, LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearMap.comp_apply, map_sub, sub_mul,
      mul_sub]
    abel

name: Operad.ExtBV.Dm_apply
statement: lemma Dm_apply (m : L) (x : E) : Dm R L m x = D (LieAlgebra.ad R L m) x
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.ExtBV.Dm_ι_mul
statement: lemma Dm_ι_mul (m n : L) (x : E) : Dm R L m (ι R n * x) = ι R ⁅m, n⁆ * x + ι R n * Dm R L m x
proof:
:=
  D_ι_mul _ _ _

name: Operad.ExtBV.Dm_algebraMap
statement: lemma Dm_algebraMap (m : L) (r : R) : Dm R L m (algebraMap R E r) = 0
proof: := D_algebraMap _ _

name: Operad.ExtBV.Dm_one
statement: lemma Dm_one (m : L) : Dm R L m 1 = 0
proof: := D_one _

name: Operad.ExtBV.Dm_ι
statement: lemma Dm_ι (m n : L) : Dm R L m (ι R n) = ι R ⁅m, n⁆

name: Operad.ExtBV.Dm_mul
statement: lemma Dm_mul (m : L) (x y : E) : Dm R L m (x * y) = Dm R L m x * y + x * Dm R L m y
proof:
:=
  D_mul _ _ _

name: Operad.ExtBV.Dm_self
statement: lemma Dm_self (m : L) (x : E) : Dm R L m (ι R m * x) = ι R m * Dm R L m x
proof:
:= by
  rw [Dm_ι_mul, lie_self, map_zero, zero_mul, zero_add]

name: Operad.ExtBV.Dm_comm
statement:
theorem Dm_comm (m n : L) (x : E) :
    Dm R L m (Dm R L n x) - Dm R L n (Dm R L m x) = Dm R L ⁅m, n⁆ x
proof:
:= by
  rw [Dm_apply, Dm_apply, Dm_apply, Dm_apply, D_comm, Dm_apply]
  congr 2
  ext k
  simp only [LinearMap.sub_apply, LinearMap.comp_apply, LieAlgebra.ad_apply, lie_lie]

name: Operad.ExtBV.δStep_apply
statement: lemma δStep_apply (m : L) (p : E × E) : δStep (R := R) m p = -Dm R L m p.1 - ι R m * p.2
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.ExtBV.Δ_ι_mul
statement: lemma Δ_ι_mul (m : L) (x : E) : Δ R L (ι R m * x) = -Dm R L m x - ι R m * Δ R L x
proof:
:=
  foldr'_ι_mul _ _ _ _ _ _

name: Operad.ExtBV.Δ_algebraMap
statement: lemma Δ_algebraMap (r : R) : Δ R L (algebraMap R E r) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [Δ, foldr'_algebraMap, smul_zero]

name: Operad.ExtBV.Δ_one
statement: lemma Δ_one : Δ R L (1 : E) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [← map_one (algebraMap R E), Δ_algebraMap]

name: Operad.ExtBV.Δ_ι
statement: lemma Δ_ι (m : L) : Δ R L (ι R m) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [← mul_one (ι R m), Δ_ι_mul, Δ_one, Dm_one, mul_zero, neg_zero, sub_zero]

name: Operad.ExtBV.Δ_Dm
statement: theorem Δ_Dm (m : L) (x : E) : Δ R L (Dm R L m x) = Dm R L m (Δ R L x)
proof:
:= by
  induction x using induction with
  | alg r => rw [Dm_algebraMap, Δ_algebraMap, map_zero, map_zero]
  | add x x' hx hx' => rw [map_add, map_add, hx, hx', map_add, map_add]
  | ι_mul n x hx =>
    have h := Dm_comm (R := R) m n x
    rw [Dm_ι_mul, map_add, Δ_ι_mul, Δ_ι_mul, Δ_ι_mul, hx, map_sub, map_neg, Dm_ι_mul]
    rw [← h]
    abel

name: Operad.ExtBV.Δ_Δ
statement: theorem Δ_Δ (x : E) : Δ R L (Δ R L x) = 0
proof:
:= by
  induction x using induction with
  | alg r => rw [Δ_algebraMap, map_zero]
  | add x x' hx hx' => rw [map_add, map_add, hx, hx', add_zero]
  | ι_mul n x hx =>
    rw [Δ_ι_mul, map_sub, map_neg, Δ_Dm, Δ_ι_mul, hx, mul_zero, sub_zero]
    abel

name: Operad.ExtBV.dv_apply
statement:
lemma dv_apply (x y : E) :
    dv R L x y = Δ R L (x * y) - Δ R L x * y - involute x * Δ R L y
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.ExtBV.dv_algebraMap
statement: lemma dv_algebraMap (r : R) (y : E) : dv R L (algebraMap R E r) y = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [dv_apply, Δ_algebraMap, zero_mul, sub_zero, AlgHom.commutes, ← Algebra.smul_def,
    ← Algebra.smul_def, map_smul, sub_self]

name: Operad.ExtBV.dv_ι_mul
statement:
theorem dv_ι_mul (m : L) (x y : E) :
    dv R L (ι R m * x) y = -(x * Dm R L m y) - ι R m * dv R L x y
proof:
:= by
  rw [dv_apply, dv_apply, mul_assoc, Δ_ι_mul, Δ_ι_mul, Dm_mul, map_mul involute (ι R m) x,
    involute_ι]
  noncomm_ring

name: Operad.ExtBV.dv_ι
statement: lemma dv_ι (m : L) (y : E) : dv R L (ι R m) y = -Dm R L m y
proof:
:= by
  rw [← mul_one (ι R m), dv_ι_mul, ← map_one (algebraMap R E), dv_algebraMap, map_one, one_mul,
    mul_zero, sub_zero]

name: Operad.ExtBV.dv_ι_ι
statement: lemma dv_ι_ι (m n : L) : dv R L (ι R m) (ι R n) = -ι R ⁅m, n⁆
proof:
:= by
  rw [dv_ι, Dm_ι]

name: Operad.ExtBV.dv_mul_parity
statement:
theorem dv_mul_parity (x : E) :
    (∀ y z, dv R L (prZ 0 x) (y * z)
      = dv R L (prZ 0 x) y * z + involute y * dv R L (prZ 0 x) z) ∧
    (∀ y z, dv R L (prZ 1 x) (y * z) = dv R L (prZ 1 x) y * z + y * dv R L (prZ 1 x) z)
proof:
:= by
  refine parity_induction
    (Pe := fun x => ∀ y z, dv R L x (y * z) = dv R L x y * z + involute y * dv R L x z)
    (Po := fun x => ∀ y z, dv R L x (y * z) = dv R L x y * z + y * dv R L x z)
    (fun r y z => by rw [dv_algebraMap, dv_algebraMap, dv_algebraMap, zero_mul, mul_zero,
      add_zero])
    (fun y z => by simp only [map_zero, LinearMap.zero_apply, zero_mul, mul_zero, add_zero])
    (fun x x' hx hx' y z => by
      simp only [map_add, LinearMap.add_apply, add_mul, mul_add, hx y z, hx' y z]; abel)
    (fun x x' hx hx' y z => by
      simp only [map_add, LinearMap.add_apply, add_mul, mul_add, hx y z, hx' y z]; abel)
    (fun m x hxo hx y z => ?_) (fun m x hxe hx y z => ?_) x
  · rw [dv_ι_mul, dv_ι_mul, dv_ι_mul, hx, Dm_mul, mul_add, mul_add, ← mul_assoc x y,
      mul_comm_odd hxo y, ← mul_assoc (ι R m) y, ι_mul_comm m y]
    noncomm_ring
  · rw [dv_ι_mul, dv_ι_mul, dv_ι_mul, hx, Dm_mul, mul_add, mul_add, ← mul_assoc x y,
      mul_comm_even hxe y, ← mul_assoc (ι R m) (involute y), ι_mul_involute m y]
    noncomm_ring

name: Operad.ExtBV.dv_mul_even
statement:
lemma dv_mul_even {x : E} (hx : x ∈ evenOdd Q₀ 0) (y z : E) :
    dv R L x (y * z) = dv R L x y * z + involute y * dv R L x z
proof:
:= by
  have h := (dv_mul_parity x).1 y z
  rwa [prZ_of_mem hx] at h

name: Operad.ExtBV.dv_mul_odd
statement:
lemma dv_mul_odd {x : E} (hx : x ∈ evenOdd Q₀ 1) (y z : E) :
    dv R L x (y * z) = dv R L x y * z + y * dv R L x z
proof:
:= by
  have h := (dv_mul_parity x).2 y z
  rwa [prZ_of_mem hx] at h

name: Operad.ExtBV.mul_mem'
statement:
lemma mul_mem' {i j k : ZMod 2} (h : i + j = k) {x y : E} (hx : x ∈ evenOdd Q₀ i)
    (hy : y ∈ evenOdd Q₀ j) : x * y ∈ evenOdd Q₀ k
proof:
:=
  h ▸ SetLike.mul_mem_graded hx hy

name: Operad.ExtBV.zmod2_cases
statement: lemma zmod2_cases (i : ZMod 2) : i = 0 ∨ i = 1
proof:
:= by
  fin_cases i
  · exact Or.inl rfl
  · exact Or.inr rfl

name: Operad.ExtBV.involute_mem
statement: lemma involute_mem {i : ZMod 2} {x : E} (hx : x ∈ evenOdd Q₀ i) : involute x ∈ evenOdd Q₀ i
proof:
:= by
  obtain rfl | rfl := zmod2_cases i
  · rw [CliffordAlgebra.involute_eq_of_mem_even hx]
    exact hx
  · rw [CliffordAlgebra.involute_eq_of_mem_odd hx]
    exact Submodule.neg_mem _ hx

name: Operad.ExtBV.mem_of_parity
statement:
lemma mem_of_parity {P : ZMod 2 → E → Prop} (h : ∀ x, P 0 (prZ 0 x) ∧ P 1 (prZ 1 x)) {i : ZMod 2}
    {x : E} (hx : x ∈ evenOdd Q₀ i) : P i x
proof:
:= by
  obtain rfl | rfl := zmod2_cases i
  · have := (h x).1
    rwa [prZ_of_mem hx] at this
  · have := (h x).2
    rwa [prZ_of_mem hx] at this

name: Operad.ExtBV.D_mem
statement:
lemma D_mem (f : L →ₗ[R] L) {i : ZMod 2} {x : E} (hx : x ∈ evenOdd Q₀ i) :
    D f x ∈ evenOdd Q₀ i
proof:
:= by
  refine mem_of_parity (P := fun i x => D f x ∈ evenOdd Q₀ i) (fun x => parity_induction
    (Pe := fun x => D f x ∈ evenOdd Q₀ 0) (Po := fun x => D f x ∈ evenOdd Q₀ 1)
    (fun r => by beta_reduce; rw [D_algebraMap]; exact Submodule.zero_mem _)
    (by beta_reduce; rw [map_zero]; exact Submodule.zero_mem _)
    (fun x y hx hy => by beta_reduce; rw [map_add]; exact Submodule.add_mem _ hx hy)
    (fun x y hx hy => by beta_reduce; rw [map_add]; exact Submodule.add_mem _ hx hy)
    (fun m x hx h => ?_) (fun m x hx h => ?_) x) hx
  · beta_reduce
    rw [D_ι_mul]
    exact Submodule.add_mem _ (mul_mem' (by decide) (ι_mem _) hx) (mul_mem' (by decide) (ι_mem _) h)
  · beta_reduce
    rw [D_ι_mul]
    exact Submodule.add_mem _ (mul_mem' (by decide) (ι_mem _) hx) (mul_mem' (by decide) (ι_mem _) h)

name: Operad.ExtBV.Δ_mem
statement: lemma Δ_mem {i : ZMod 2} {x : E} (hx : x ∈ evenOdd Q₀ i) : Δ R L x ∈ evenOdd Q₀ (i + 1)
proof:
:= by
  refine mem_of_parity (P := fun i x => Δ R L x ∈ evenOdd Q₀ (i + 1)) (fun x => parity_induction
    (Pe := fun x => Δ R L x ∈ evenOdd Q₀ (0 + 1)) (Po := fun x => Δ R L x ∈ evenOdd Q₀ (1 + 1))
    (fun r => by beta_reduce; rw [Δ_algebraMap]; exact Submodule.zero_mem _)
    (by beta_reduce; rw [map_zero]; exact Submodule.zero_mem _)
    (fun x y hx hy => by beta_reduce; rw [map_add]; exact Submodule.add_mem _ hx hy)
    (fun x y hx hy => by beta_reduce; rw [map_add]; exact Submodule.add_mem _ hx hy)
    (fun m x hx h => ?_) (fun m x hx h => ?_) x) hx
  · beta_reduce
    rw [Δ_ι_mul]
    exact Submodule.sub_mem _ (Submodule.neg_mem _ (D_mem _ hx))
      (mul_mem' (by decide) (ι_mem _) h)
  · beta_reduce
    rw [Δ_ι_mul]
    exact Submodule.sub_mem _ (Submodule.neg_mem _ (D_mem _ hx))
      (mul_mem' (by decide) (ι_mem _) h)

name: Operad.ExtBV.dv_mem
statement:
lemma dv_mem {i j : ZMod 2} {x y : E} (hx : x ∈ evenOdd Q₀ i) (hy : y ∈ evenOdd Q₀ j) :
    dv R L x y ∈ evenOdd Q₀ (i + j + 1)
proof:
:= by
  rw [dv_apply]
  refine Submodule.sub_mem _ (Submodule.sub_mem _ (Δ_mem (mul_mem' rfl hx hy))
    (mul_mem' (by ring) (Δ_mem hx) hy)) (mul_mem' (by ring) (involute_mem hx) (Δ_mem hy))

name: Operad.ExtBV.bz_xor
statement: lemma bz_xor (a b : Bool) : bz (xor a b) = bz a + bz b
proof:
:= by
  cases a <;> cases b <;> decide

name: Operad.ExtBV.bz_not
statement: lemma bz_not (a : Bool) : bz (!a) = bz a + 1
proof:
:= by
  cases a <;> decide

name: Operad.ExtBV.bz_injective
statement: lemma bz_injective : Function.Injective bz
proof:
:= by
  intro a b h
  cases a <;> cases b <;> first | rfl | exact absurd h (by decide)

name: Operad.ExtBV.isP_iff
statement: lemma isP_iff (p : Bool) (x : E) : EndGr.IsP (R := R) p x ↔ x ∈ evenOdd Q₀ (bz p)
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun h => h ▸ prZ_mem _ _, fun h => prZ_of_mem h⟩

name: Operad.ExtBV.involute_eq_σ
statement:
lemma involute_eq_σ {p : Bool} {x : E} (hx : x ∈ evenOdd Q₀ (bz p)) :
    involute x = GerBV.σ R p • x
proof:
:= by
  cases p
  · rw [CliffordAlgebra.involute_eq_of_mem_even hx, GerBV.σ_false, one_smul]
  · rw [CliffordAlgebra.involute_eq_of_mem_odd hx, GerBV.σ_true, neg_one_smul]

name: Operad.ExtBV.mul_comm_σ
statement:
lemma mul_comm_σ {p q : Bool} {x y : E} (hx : x ∈ evenOdd Q₀ (bz p))
    (hy : y ∈ evenOdd Q₀ (bz q)) : x * y = GerBV.σ R (p && q) • (y * x)
proof:
:= by
  cases p
  · rw [mul_comm_even hx, Bool.false_and, GerBV.σ_false, one_smul]
  · rw [mul_comm_odd hx, involute_eq_σ hy, Bool.true_and, smul_mul_assoc]

name: Operad.ExtBV.dv_comm
statement:
lemma dv_comm {p q : Bool} {x y : E} (hx : x ∈ evenOdd Q₀ (bz p))
    (hy : y ∈ evenOdd Q₀ (bz q)) : dv R L x y = GerBV.σ R (p && q) • dv R L y x
proof:
:= by
  have c1 := congrArg (Δ R L) (mul_comm_σ hx hy)
  have c2 := mul_comm_σ (R := R) (L := L) (p := !p) (q := q) (by rw [bz_not]; exact Δ_mem hx) hy
  have c3 := mul_comm_σ (R := R) (L := L) (p := p) (q := !q) hx (by rw [bz_not]; exact Δ_mem hy)
  rw [map_smul] at c1
  rw [dv_apply, dv_apply, involute_eq_σ hx, involute_eq_σ hy]
  cases p <;> cases q <;> simp at c1 c2 c3 ⊢
  · rw [c1, c2, c3]; abel
  · rw [c1, c2, c3]; abel
  · rw [c1, c2, c3]; abel
  · rw [c1, c2, c3]; module

name: Operad.ExtBV.dev_eq
statement:
lemma dev_eq {p : Bool} {x : E} (hx : x ∈ evenOdd Q₀ (bz p)) (y : E) :
    GerBV.dev (LinearMap.mul R E) (Δ R L) p x y = dv R L x y
proof:
:= by
  rw [dv_apply, involute_eq_σ hx, smul_mul_assoc]
  rfl

name: Operad.ExtBV.dv_mul_σ
statement:
lemma dv_mul_σ {p q : Bool} {x y : E} (hx : x ∈ evenOdd Q₀ (bz p)) (hy : y ∈ evenOdd Q₀ (bz q))
    (z : E) :
    dv R L x (y * z) = dv R L x y * z + GerBV.σ R ((!p) && q) • (y * dv R L x z)
proof:
:= by
  cases p
  · rw [dv_mul_even hx, involute_eq_σ hy, smul_mul_assoc]
    rfl
  · rw [dv_mul_odd hx, Bool.not_true, Bool.false_and, GerBV.σ_false, one_smul]

name: Operad.ExtBV.dv_jacobi
statement:
lemma dv_jacobi {p q : Bool} {x y : E} (hx : x ∈ evenOdd Q₀ (bz p))
    (hy : y ∈ evenOdd Q₀ (bz q)) (z : E) :
    dv R L (dv R L x y) z + GerBV.σ R p • dv R L x (dv R L y z)
      + GerBV.σ R ((!p) && q) • dv R L y (dv R L x z) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have J := GerBV.dev_jacobi (μ := LinearMap.mul R E) (Δ := Δ R L)
    (H := fun p x => x ∈ evenOdd Q₀ (bz p)) Δ_Δ
    (fun p q x y z hx hy => by
      simp only [dev_eq hx, LinearMap.mul_apply']
      exact dv_mul_σ hx hy z)
    (fun p x hx => by beta_reduce at hx ⊢; rw [bz_not]; exact Δ_mem hx) z hx hy
  have hxy : dv R L x y ∈ evenOdd Q₀ (bz (!(xor p q))) := by
    rw [bz_not, bz_xor]
    exact dv_mem hx hy
  rw [dev_eq hy, dev_eq hx, dev_eq hx, dev_eq hxy, dev_eq hx, dev_eq hy] at J
  cases p <;> cases q <;> simp at J ⊢
  · rw [J]; abel
  · rw [J]; abel
  · rw [J]; module
  · rw [J]; module

name: Operad.ExtBV.mulOp_apply
statement: lemma mulOp_apply (x y : E) : mulOp R L ![x, y] = x * y
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.ExtBV.dvOp_apply
statement: lemma dvOp_apply (x y : E) : dvOp R L ![x, y] = dv R L x y
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.ExtBV.parML_two
statement:
lemma parML_two {b : Bool} {f : EndOp R E (Fin 2)}
    (h : ∀ p q x y, x ∈ evenOdd Q₀ (bz p) → y ∈ evenOdd Q₀ (bz q) →
      f ![x, y] ∈ evenOdd Q₀ (bz b + bz p + bz q)) :
    parML R E b f = f
proof:
:= by
  refine ext_hom fun c v hv => ?_
  rw [parML_apply_hom hv, EndGr.vec_two v, EndGr.vec_two c, Ger.tot_two]
  refine prZ_of_mem ?_
  rw [bz_xor, bz_xor, ← add_assoc]
  exact h _ _ _ _ ((isP_iff _ _).1 (hv 0)) ((isP_iff _ _).1 (hv 1))

name: Operad.ExtBV.isGer
statement:
theorem isGer : Ger.IsGer (mulOp R L) (dvOp R L) where
  par_m
proof:
:= parML_two fun p q x y hx hy => mul_mem' (by simp [bz]) hx hy
  par_l := parML_two fun p q x y hx hy => by
    rw [dvOp_apply]
    convert dv_mem hx hy using 1
    simp only [bz, cond_true]
    ring_nf
  comm p q x y hx hy := mul_comm_σ ((isP_iff _ _).1 hx) ((isP_iff _ _).1 hy)
  symm p q x y hx hy := dv_comm ((isP_iff _ _).1 hx) ((isP_iff _ _).1 hy)
  assoc p q r x y z _ _ _ := mul_assoc x y z
  leibniz p q r x y z hx hy _ := dv_mul_σ ((isP_iff _ _).1 hx) ((isP_iff _ _).1 hy) z
  jacobi p q r x y z hx hy _ := dv_jacobi ((isP_iff _ _).1 hx) ((isP_iff _ _).1 hy) z

name: Operad.ExtBV.sv_gerAlg_mul
statement:
lemma sv_gerAlg_mul :
    EndGr.sv ((gerAlg R L).app _ (FreeGr.presGen (Ger.rel R) GerGen.mul)) = mulOp R L
proof:
:=
  congrArg (fun z => z.1.1) (Ger.algebraEquiv.apply_symm_apply
    (⟨(mulOp R L, dvOp R L), isGer⟩ : {ml : EndOp R E (Fin 2) × EndOp R E (Fin 2) //
      Ger.IsGer ml.1 ml.2}))

name: Operad.ExtBV.ΔOp_apply
statement: lemma ΔOp_apply (x : E) : ΔOp R L ![x] = Δ R L x
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.ExtBV.BV_dv_eq
statement:
lemma BV_dv_eq {p : Bool} {x : E} (hx : x ∈ evenOdd Q₀ (bz p)) (y : E) :
    BV.dv (mulOp R L) (ΔOp R L) p x y = dv R L x y
proof:
:= by
  rw [BV.dv, dv_apply, involute_eq_σ hx, smul_mul_assoc]
  rfl

name: Operad.ExtBV.isBV
statement:
theorem isBV : BV.IsBV (mulOp R L) (ΔOp R L) where
  par_m
proof:
:= isGer.par_m
  par_d := by
    refine ext_hom fun c v hv => ?_
    rw [parML_apply_hom hv]
    refine prZ_of_mem ?_
    have h0 : v = ![v 0] := funext fun i => by fin_cases i; rfl
    have hc : tot c = c 0 := by
      have : c = ![c 0] := funext fun i => by fin_cases i; rfl
      rw [this]
      cases c 0 <;> rfl
    rw [h0, ΔOp_apply, hc, Bool.true_xor, bz_not]
    exact Δ_mem ((isP_iff _ _).1 (hv 0))
  comm := isGer.comm
  assoc := isGer.assoc
  sq p x _ := by
    rw [ΔOp_apply, ΔOp_apply, Δ_Δ]
  order p q r x y z hx hy _ := by
    have hx' := (isP_iff _ _).1 hx
    have hy' := (isP_iff _ _).1 hy
    rw [BV_dv_eq hx', BV_dv_eq hx', BV_dv_eq hx']
    exact dv_mul_σ hx' hy' z

name: Operad.SymSpeciesHom.id_app
statement: @[simp] lemma id_app {A : Type} [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] (x : V A) : (id R V).app A x = x
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: Operad.SymOperad.sigmaCongr_refl_right
statement:
lemma sigmaCongr_refl_right {A A' : Type} {B : A' → Type} (σ : A ≃ A') :
    Equiv.sigmaCongr σ (fun a => Equiv.refl (B (σ a))) = Equiv.sigmaCongrLeft σ
proof:
:=
  Equiv.ext fun _ => rfl

name: Operad.SymOperad.totalFun_respects
statement:
lemma totalFun_respects : CompGen.Respects R (totalFun (R := R) (P := P) (S := S)) where
  add_m g m'
proof:
:= by
    simp only [totalFun, SymOperad.total_add, map_add]
  smul_m g c := by
    simp only [totalFun, SymOperad.total_smul, map_smul]
  add_y g a z z' := by
    simp only [totalFun, SymOperad.total_update_add, map_add]
  smul_y g a c z := by
    simp only [totalFun, SymOperad.total_update_smul, map_smul]
  outer := @fun g A' _ _ σ m => by
    have h := SymOperad.total_map (R := R) σ (fun a => Equiv.refl (g.B (σ a))) m
      (fun a => g.y (σ a)) g.y (fun a => (SymOperad.map_refl _).symm)
    show SymOperad.map (R := R) g.e (SymOperad.total R (SymOperad.map (R := R) σ m) g.y)
      = SymOperad.map (R := R) ((Equiv.sigmaCongrLeft σ).trans g.e)
        (SymOperad.total R m fun a => g.y (σ a))
    rw [← h, ← SymOperad.map_trans, sigmaCongr_refl_right]
  inner := @fun g B' _ _ τ => by
    have h := SymOperad.total_map (R := R) (Equiv.refl g.A) τ g.m g.y
      (fun a => SymOperad.map (R := R) (τ a) (g.y a)) (fun a => rfl)
    rw [SymOperad.map_refl] at h
    show SymOperad.map (R := R) ((Equiv.sigmaCongrRight τ).symm.trans g.e)
        (SymOperad.total R g.m fun a => SymOperad.map (R := R) (τ a) (g.y a))
      = SymOperad.map (R := R) g.e (SymOperad.total R g.m g.y)
    rw [← h, ← SymOperad.map_trans]
    congr 2
    ext ⟨a, b⟩
    show g.e ((Equiv.sigmaCongrRight τ).symm ⟨a, τ a b⟩) = g.e ⟨a, b⟩
    congr 1
    rw [Equiv.symm_apply_eq]
    rfl

name: Operad.SymOperad.mulApp_mk
statement:
lemma mulApp_mk (g : CompGen P P S) :
    mulApp S (Composite.mk R g) = SymOperad.map (R := R) g.e (SymOperad.total R g.m g.y)
proof:
:=
  lift_mk _ _ g

name: Operad.SymOperad.mulHom_app_mk
statement:
lemma mulHom_app_mk (g : CompGen P P S) :
    (mulHom R P).app S (Composite.mk R g)
      = SymOperad.map (R := R) g.e (SymOperad.total R g.m g.y)
proof:
:=
  mulApp_mk g

name: Operad.SymOperad.unitHom_app
statement:
lemma unitHom_app (x : UnitSp R S) :
    (unitHom R P).app S x
      = Finsupp.lift (P S) R (Unit ≃ S) (fun u => SymOperad.map (R := R) u (SymOperad.one R)) x
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: Operad.SymOperad.mulHom_assoc
statement:
theorem mulHom_assoc (z : Composite R (Composite R P P) P S) :
    (mulHom R P).app S ((map₂ (mulHom R P) (SymSpeciesHom.id R P)).app S z)
      = (mulHom R P).app S ((map₂ (SymSpeciesHom.id R P) (mulHom R P)).app S (assoc.app S z))
proof:
:= by
  have h : ((mulHom R P).app S).comp ((map₂ (mulHom R P) (SymSpeciesHom.id R P)).app S)
      = ((mulHom R P).app S).comp (((map₂ (SymSpeciesHom.id R P) (mulHom R P)).app S).comp
          (assoc.app S)) := hom_ext fun h => by
    simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply]
    rw [map₂_mk]
    show mulApp S (mkM (genMap₂ (mulHom R P) (SymSpeciesHom.id R P) h) (mulApp h.A h.m))
      = mulApp S ((map₂ (SymSpeciesHom.id R P) (mulHom R P)).app S
          (assocApp S (Composite.mk R h)))
    rw [assocApp_mk]
    induction h.m using induction_on with
    | h0 => simp only [map_zero, MultilinearMap.zero_apply]
    | hadd x y hx hy => simp only [map_add, MultilinearMap.add_apply, hx, hy]
    | hsmul c x hx => simp only [map_smul, MultilinearMap.smul_apply, hx]
    | hmk k =>
      simp only [assocLin_mk, map₂_mk, mkM_apply, mulApp_mk, mulHom_app_mk,
        SymSpeciesHom.id_app, SymOperad.map_refl]
      have h1 := SymOperad.total_map (R := R) k.e (fun p => Equiv.refl (h.B (k.e p)))
        (SymOperad.total R k.m k.y) (fun p => h.y (k.e p)) h.y
        (fun p => (SymOperad.map_refl _).symm)
      have h2 := SymOperad.total_assoc (R := R) k.m k.y fun a b => h.y (k.e ⟨a, b⟩)
      rw [← h1, ← h2, ← SymOperad.map_trans, ← SymOperad.map_trans, sigmaCongr_refl_right]
      congr 2
  exact LinearMap.congr_fun h z

name: Operad.SymOperad.mulHom_one
statement:
theorem mulHom_one (z : Composite R (UnitSp R) P S) :
    (mulHom R P).app S ((map₂ (unitHom R P) (SymSpeciesHom.id R P)).app S z)
      = leftUnitor.app S z
proof:
:= by
  have h : ((mulHom R P).app S).comp ((map₂ (unitHom R P) (SymSpeciesHom.id R P)).app S)
      = leftUnitor.app S := hom_ext fun g => by
    rw [LinearMap.comp_apply, map₂_mk]
    show mulApp S (Composite.mk R (genMap₂ (unitHom R P) (SymSpeciesHom.id R P) g))
      = leftUnitorApp S (Composite.mk R g)
    rw [mulApp_mk, leftUnitorApp_mk, leftUnitorFun]
    show totalLeft g.e g.y (Finsupp.lift (P g.A) R _
      (fun u => SymOperad.map (R := R) u (SymOperad.one R)) g.m) = _
    rw [Finsupp.linear_lift]
    refine Finsupp.lift_congr_fun (fun u => ?_) g.m
    show SymOperad.map (R := R) g.e (SymOperad.total R (SymOperad.map (R := R) u
        (SymOperad.one R)) g.y)
      = SymOperad.map (R := R) ((unitSigma u g.B).trans g.e) (g.y (u ()))
    have h1 := SymOperad.total_map (R := R) u (fun x => Equiv.refl (g.B (u x))) (SymOperad.one R)
      (fun x => g.y (u x)) g.y (fun x => (SymOperad.map_refl _).symm)
    have h2 := SymOperad.total_one_left (R := R) (E := fun x => g.B (u x)) fun x => g.y (u x)
    have h3 : SymOperad.total R (SymOperad.one R) (fun x => g.y (u x))
        = SymOperad.map (R := R) (Equiv.uniqueSigma fun x => g.B (u x)).symm (g.y (u ())) := by
      rw [← h2, ← SymOperad.map_trans, Equiv.self_trans_symm, SymOperad.map_refl]
    rw [← h1, h3, ← SymOperad.map_trans, ← SymOperad.map_trans]
    congr 2
  exact LinearMap.congr_fun h z

name: Operad.SymOperad.mulHom_unit
statement:
theorem mulHom_unit (z : Composite R P (UnitSp R) S) :
    (mulHom R P).app S ((map₂ (SymSpeciesHom.id R P) (unitHom R P)).app S z)
      = rightUnitor.app S z
proof:
:= by
  have h : ((mulHom R P).app S).comp ((map₂ (SymSpeciesHom.id R P) (unitHom R P)).app S)
      = rightUnitor.app S := hom_ext fun g => by
    rw [LinearMap.comp_apply, map₂_mk]
    show mulApp S (Composite.mk R (genMap₂ (SymSpeciesHom.id R P) (unitHom R P) g))
      = rightUnitorApp S (Composite.mk R g)
    rw [mulApp_mk, rightUnitorApp_mk, rightUnitorFun]
    have hy : (fun a => (unitHom R P).app (g.B a) (g.y a)) = fun a =>
        ∑ v : Unit ≃ g.B a, g.y a v • SymOperad.map (R := R) v (SymOperad.one R) :=
      funext fun a => by
        rw [unitHom_app, Finsupp.lift_apply, Finsupp.sum_fintype]
        exact fun _ => zero_smul R _
    show SymOperad.map (R := R) g.e (SymOperad.totalML R g.m
      (fun a => (unitHom R P).app (g.B a) (g.y a))) = _
    rw [hy, MultilinearMap.map_sum, map_sum]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun u _ => ?_
    rw [MultilinearMap.map_smul_univ, map_smul]
    congr 1
    have h1 := SymOperad.total_map (R := R) (Equiv.refl g.A) u g.m
      (fun _ => SymOperad.one R) (fun a => SymOperad.map (R := R) (u a) (SymOperad.one R))
      (fun a => rfl)
    rw [SymOperad.map_refl] at h1
    have h2 := SymOperad.total_one_right (R := R) g.m
    have h3 : SymOperad.total R g.m (fun _ => (SymOperad.one R : P Unit))
        = SymOperad.map (R := R) (Equiv.sigmaPUnit g.A).symm g.m := by
      conv_rhs => rw [← h2]
      rw [← SymOperad.map_trans, Equiv.self_trans_symm, SymOperad.map_refl]
    show SymOperad.map (R := R) g.e (SymOperad.total R g.m
      fun a => SymOperad.map (R := R) (u a) (SymOperad.one R)) = _
    rw [← h1, h3, ← SymOperad.map_trans, ← SymOperad.map_trans]
    congr 2
  exact LinearMap.congr_fun h z

name: Operad.SymMonoid.mk_eq_map
statement:
lemma mk_eq_map (g : CompGen P P S) :
    Composite.mk R g = SymSpecies.map (R := R) (V := Composite R P P) g.e
      (Composite.mk R ⟨g.A, g.B, g.m, g.y, Equiv.refl _⟩)
proof:
:= by
  rw [symSpecies_map_mk]
  rfl

name: Operad.SymMonoid.mul_mk
statement:
lemma mul_mk (g : CompGen P P S) :
    μ.mul.app S (Composite.mk R g) = SymSpecies.map (R := R) g.e (μ.total g.m g.y)
proof:
:= by
  rw [mk_eq_map, μ.mul.app_map]
  rfl

name: Operad.SymMonoid.total_map
statement:
theorem total_map {A' : Type} [Fintype A'] [DecidableEq A'] {B' : A' → Type}
    [∀ a, Fintype (B' a)] [∀ a, DecidableEq (B' a)] (σ : A ≃ A') (τ : ∀ a, B a ≃ B' (σ a))
    (x : P A) (y : ∀ a, P (B a)) (y' : ∀ a, P (B' a))
    (hy : ∀ a, y' (σ a) = SymSpecies.map (R := R) (τ a) (y a)) :
    SymSpecies.map (R := R) (Equiv.sigmaCongr σ τ) (μ.total x y)
      = μ.total (SymSpecies.map (R := R) σ x) y'
proof:
:= by
  rw [total, ← μ.mul.app_map, symSpecies_map_mk, total]
  have h1 := mk_outer (R := R) (⟨A', B', SymSpecies.map (R := R) σ x, y', Equiv.refl _⟩ :
    CompGen P P _) σ x
  have h2 := mk_inner (R := R) (⟨A, B, x, y, Equiv.sigmaCongr σ τ⟩ : CompGen P P _)
    (B := fun a => B' (σ a)) τ
  rw [show (Equiv.sigmaCongrRight τ).symm.trans (Equiv.sigmaCongr σ τ)
      = (Equiv.sigmaCongrLeft σ).trans (Equiv.refl _) from Equiv.ext fun ⟨a, b'⟩ => by
        show (⟨σ a, τ a ((τ a).symm b')⟩ : Σ a', B' a') = ⟨σ a, b'⟩
        rw [Equiv.apply_symm_apply],
    ← funext hy] at h2
  exact congrArg (μ.mul.app _) (h2.symm.trans h1.symm)

name: Operad.SymMonoid.total_one_left
statement:
theorem total_one_left {E : Unit → Type} [∀ u, Fintype (E u)] [∀ u, DecidableEq (E u)]
    (y : (u : Unit) → P (E u)) :
    SymSpecies.map (R := R) (Equiv.uniqueSigma E) (μ.total μ.one y) = y ()
proof:
:= by
  have h := μ.one_mul _ (Composite.mk R ⟨Unit, E, Finsupp.single (Equiv.refl Unit) 1, y,
    Equiv.refl _⟩)
  rw [map₂_mk] at h
  change μ.total μ.one y = leftUnitorApp _ _ at h
  rw [h, leftUnitorApp_mk, leftUnitorFun]
  show SymSpecies.map (R := R) _ (Finsupp.lift _ R (Unit ≃ Unit) _
    (Finsupp.single (Equiv.refl Unit) 1)) = _
  rw [Finsupp.lift_single', one_smul, ← SymSpecies.map_trans]
  exact (map_congr_equiv (fun _ => rfl) _).trans (SymSpecies.map_refl _)

name: Operad.SymMonoid.total_one_right
statement:
theorem total_one_right (x : P A) :
    SymSpecies.map (R := R) (Equiv.sigmaPUnit A) (μ.total x fun _ => μ.one) = x
proof:
:= by
  have h := μ.mul_one _ (Composite.mk R ⟨A, fun _ => Unit, x,
    fun _ => Finsupp.single (Equiv.refl Unit) 1, Equiv.refl _⟩)
  rw [map₂_mk] at h
  change μ.total x (fun _ => μ.one) = rightUnitorApp _ _ at h
  rw [h, rightUnitorApp_mk, rightUnitorFun]
  show SymSpecies.map (R := R) _ (∑ u : (A → Unit ≃ Unit),
    (∏ a, (Finsupp.single (Equiv.refl Unit) (1 : R)) (u a)) •
      SymSpecies.map (R := R) ((unitsEquiv u).trans (Equiv.refl _)) x) = x
  rw [Fintype.sum_eq_single (fun _ => Equiv.refl Unit) fun u hu =>
      absurd (funext fun _ => Subsingleton.elim _ _) hu]
  simp only [Finsupp.single_eq_same, Finset.prod_const_one, one_smul]
  rw [← SymSpecies.map_trans]
  exact (map_congr_equiv (fun _ => rfl) _).trans (SymSpecies.map_refl _)

name: Operad.SymMonoid.total_assoc
statement:
theorem total_assoc {C : (a : A) → B a → Type} [∀ a b, Fintype (C a b)]
    [∀ a b, DecidableEq (C a b)] (x : P A) (y : (a : A) → P (B a))
    (z : (a : A) → (b : B a) → P (C a b)) :
    SymSpecies.map (R := R) (Equiv.sigmaAssoc C) (μ.total (μ.total x y) fun p => z p.1 p.2)
      = μ.total x fun a => μ.total (y a) (z a)
proof:
:= by
  have h := μ.mul_assoc _ (Composite.mk R (⟨Σ a, B a, fun p => C p.1 p.2,
