statement: lemma compFun_self (i : A) (y : PTree T B) : compFun i y i = y.map Sum.inr
proof: := dif_pos rfl

name: Operad.LT.compFun_ne
statement:
lemma compFun_ne (i : A) (y : PTree T B) {a : A} (h : a ≠ i) :
    compFun i y a = leaf (Sum.inl ⟨a, h⟩)
proof: := dif_neg h

name: Operad.LT.eq_univ_iff
statement: lemma eq_univ_iff {s : Multiset A} : s = (Finset.univ : Finset A).val ↔ ∀ a, s.count a = 1
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro rfl a
    exact Multiset.count_eq_one_of_mem Finset.univ.nodup (Finset.mem_univ a)
  · intro h
    ext a
    rw [h a, Multiset.count_eq_one_of_mem Finset.univ.nodup (Finset.mem_univ a)]

name: Operad.LT.leaves_map_equiv
proof:
:= by
  rw [leaves_map, ht, eq_univ_iff]
  intro b
  rw [← e.apply_symm_apply b, Multiset.count_map_eq_count' _ _ e.injective]
  exact Multiset.count_eq_one_of_mem Finset.univ.nodup (Finset.mem_univ _)

name: Operad.LT.leaves_comp
statement:
lemma leaves_comp (i : A) {x : PTree T A} (hx : x.leaves = (Finset.univ : Finset A).val)
    {y : PTree T B} (hy : y.leaves = (Finset.univ : Finset B).val) :
    (x.bind (compFun i y)).leaves = (Finset.univ : Finset (Without A i ⊕ B)).val
proof:
:= by
  rw [eq_univ_iff]
  intro c
  rw [leaves_bind, hx, Multiset.count_bind]
  change ∑ a, Multiset.count c (compFun i y a).leaves = 1
  rcases c with ⟨a₀, ha₀⟩ | b
  · rw [Finset.sum_eq_single a₀]
    · rw [compFun_ne i y ha₀, leaves_leaf, Multiset.count_singleton_self]
    · intro a _ ha
      by_cases hai : a = i
      · rw [hai, compFun_self, leaves_map, Multiset.count_eq_zero]
        simp
      · rw [compFun_ne i y hai, leaves_leaf, Multiset.count_singleton]
        exact if_neg fun h => ha (congrArg Subtype.val (Sum.inl_injective h)).symm
    · exact fun h => (h (Finset.mem_univ _)).elim
  · rw [Finset.sum_eq_single i]
    · rw [compFun_self, leaves_map, Multiset.count_map_eq_count' _ _ Sum.inr_injective, hy]
      exact Multiset.count_eq_one_of_mem Finset.univ.nodup (Finset.mem_univ b)
    · intro a _ ha
      rw [compFun_ne i y ha, leaves_leaf, Multiset.count_singleton]
      exact if_neg Sum.inr_ne_inl
    · exact fun h => (h (Finset.mem_univ _)).elim

name: Operad.LT.map_val
statement: @[simp] lemma map_val (e : A ≃ B) (x : LT T A) : (SetOperad.map e x).1 = x.1.map e
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.LT.comp_val
statement:
@[simp] lemma comp_val (i : A) (x : LT T A) (y : LT T B) :
    (SetOperad.comp i x y).1 = x.1.bind (compFun i y.1)
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.LT.one_val
statement: @[simp] lemma one_val : (SetOperad.one : LT T Unit).1 = leaf ()
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.PTree.sort_comp_strictMonoOn
statement:
lemma sort_comp_strictMonoOn {n : ℕ} (w : Fin n → ℕ) {g : ℕ → ℕ}
    (hg : StrictMonoOn g (Set.range w)) : Tuple.sort (fun j => g (w j)) = Tuple.sort w
proof:
:= by
  refine (Tuple.eq_sort_iff.2 ⟨fun i j hij => ?_, fun i j hij h => ?_⟩).symm
  · exact hg.monotoneOn ⟨_, rfl⟩ ⟨_, rfl⟩ (Tuple.monotone_sort w hij)
  · exact (Tuple.eq_sort_iff.1 rfl).2 i j hij (hg.injOn ⟨_, rfl⟩ ⟨_, rfl⟩ h)

name: Operad.PTree.sortTree_leaf
statement: @[simp] lemma sortTree_leaf (a : ℕ) : sortTree (leaf a : PTree T ℕ) = STree.leaf a
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.PTree.sortTree_node
statement:
lemma sortTree_node {k : ℕ} (e : T k) (c : Fin k → PTree T ℕ) :
    sortTree (node e c) = STree.node (e, Tuple.sort fun j => (sortTree (c j)).first)
      fun j => sortTree (c (Tuple.sort (fun j => (sortTree (c j)).first) j))
proof:
:= by
  rw [sortTree]

name: Operad.PTree.labels_sortTree
statement:
lemma labels_sortTree : ∀ t : PTree T ℕ, (sortTree t).labels = t.leaves
  | leaf _ => rfl
  | node e c => by
    rw [sortTree_node, STree.labels_node, leaves_node]
    exact (Equiv.sum_comp _ fun j => (sortTree (c j)).labels).trans
      (Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => labels_sortTree (c j))

name: Operad.PTree.nodup_child
statement:
lemma nodup_child {k : ℕ} {e : T k} {c : Fin k → PTree T ℕ} (h : (node e c).leaves.Nodup)
    (j : Fin k) : (c j).leaves.Nodup
proof:
:=
  Multiset.nodup_of_le (leaves_child_le e c j) h

name: Operad.PTree.disjoint_child
statement:
lemma disjoint_child {k : ℕ} {e : T k} {c : Fin k → PTree T ℕ} (h : (node e c).leaves.Nodup)
    {i j : Fin k} (hij : i ≠ j) : Disjoint (c i).leaves (c j).leaves
proof:
:= by
  have hle : (c i).leaves + (c j).leaves ≤ (node e c).leaves := by
    rw [leaves_node, ← Finset.sum_pair (f := fun x => (c x).leaves) hij]
    exact Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg (Finset.subset_univ _)
      fun _ _ _ => Multiset.zero_le _
  exact (Multiset.nodup_add.1 (Multiset.nodup_of_le hle h)).2.2

name: Operad.PTree.pos_of_node
statement: lemma pos_of_node [IsEmpty (T 0)] {k : ℕ} (e : T k) : 0 < k
proof:
:=
  Nat.pos_of_ne_zero fun h => by
    subst h
    exact IsEmpty.false e

name: Operad.PTree.first_mem_leaves
statement:
lemma first_mem_leaves {t : PTree T ℕ} (h : (sortTree t).IsShuffle) :
    (sortTree t).first ∈ t.leaves
proof:
:= by
  have := STree.first_mem h
  rwa [labels_sortTree] at this

name: Operad.PTree.isShuffle_sortTree
statement:
theorem isShuffle_sortTree : ∀ t : PTree T ℕ, t.leaves.Nodup → (sortTree t).IsShuffle
  | leaf _, _ => trivial
  | node e c, hn => by
    have hc : ∀ j, (sortTree (c j)).IsShuffle
proof:
:= fun j =>
      isShuffle_sortTree (c j) (nodup_child hn j)
    have hinj : Function.Injective fun j => (sortTree (c j)).first := fun i j h => by
      by_contra hij
      have h' : (sortTree (c i)).first = (sortTree (c j)).first := h
      have hj := first_mem_leaves (hc j)
      rw [← h'] at hj
      exact Multiset.disjoint_left.1 (disjoint_child hn hij) (first_mem_leaves (hc i)) hj
    rw [sortTree_node]
    exact ⟨pos_of_node e, fun j => hc _,
      (Tuple.monotone_sort _).strictMono_of_injective (hinj.comp (Equiv.injective _))⟩

name: Operad.PTree.sortTree_map
statement:
theorem sortTree_map (f : ℕ → ℕ) : ∀ t : PTree T ℕ, t.leaves.Nodup →
    StrictMonoOn f {a | a ∈ t.leaves} → sortTree (t.map f) = (sortTree t).relabel f
  | leaf _, _, _ => rfl
  | node e c, hn, hf => by
    have hcf : ∀ j, StrictMonoOn f {a | a ∈ (c j).leaves}
proof:
:= fun j =>
      hf.mono fun a ha => Multiset.mem_of_le (leaves_child_le e c j) ha
    have ih : ∀ j, sortTree ((c j).map f) = (sortTree (c j)).relabel f := fun j =>
      sortTree_map f (c j) (nodup_child hn j) (hcf j)
    have hv : ∀ j, (sortTree ((c j).map f)).first = f (sortTree (c j)).first := fun j => by
      rw [ih j, STree.first_relabel f (isShuffle_sortTree (c j) (nodup_child hn j))]
    have hσ : Tuple.sort (fun j => f (sortTree (c j)).first) =
        Tuple.sort fun j => (sortTree (c j)).first := by
      refine sort_comp_strictMonoOn _ (hf.mono ?_)
      rintro _ ⟨j, rfl⟩
      exact Multiset.mem_of_le (leaves_child_le e c j)
        (first_mem_leaves (isShuffle_sortTree (c j) (nodup_child hn j)))
    rw [map_node, sortTree_node, sortTree_node]
    simp only [hv]
    simp only [hσ, ih]
    rfl

name: Operad.PTree.sortTree_bind
statement:
theorem sortTree_bind (xs : ℕ → PTree T ℕ) : ∀ t : PTree T ℕ, t.leaves.Nodup →
    StrictMonoOn (fun a => (sortTree (xs a)).first) {a | a ∈ t.leaves} →
    sortTree (t.bind xs) = (sortTree t).subst fun a => sortTree (xs a)
  | leaf _, _, _ => rfl
  | node e c, hn, hm => by
    have hcm : ∀ j, StrictMonoOn (fun a => (sortTree (xs a)).first) {a | a ∈ (c j).leaves}
proof:
:=
      fun j => hm.mono fun a ha => Multiset.mem_of_le (leaves_child_le e c j) ha
    have ih : ∀ j, sortTree ((c j).bind xs) = (sortTree (c j)).subst fun a => sortTree (xs a) :=
      fun j => sortTree_bind xs (c j) (nodup_child hn j) (hcm j)
    have hv : ∀ j, (sortTree ((c j).bind xs)).first =
        (sortTree (xs (sortTree (c j)).first)).first := fun j => by
      rw [ih j, STree.first_subst (isShuffle_sortTree (c j) (nodup_child hn j))]
    have hσ : Tuple.sort (fun j => (sortTree (xs (sortTree (c j)).first)).first) =
        Tuple.sort fun j => (sortTree (c j)).first := by
      refine sort_comp_strictMonoOn (fun j => (sortTree (c j)).first)
        (g := fun a => (sortTree (xs a)).first) (hm.mono ?_)
      rintro _ ⟨j, rfl⟩
      exact Multiset.mem_of_le (leaves_child_le e c j)
        (first_mem_leaves (isShuffle_sortTree (c j) (nodup_child hn j)))
    rw [node_bind, sortTree_node, sortTree_node]
    simp only [hv]
    simp only [hσ, ih]
    rfl

name: Operad.LT.leaves_map_opos
proof:
:= by
  rw [leaves_map, ht]
  refine (Multiset.Nodup.ext (Multiset.Nodup.map opos_injective Finset.univ.nodup)
    (Finset.range _).nodup).2 fun n => ?_
  simp only [Multiset.mem_map, Finset.mem_val, Finset.mem_univ, true_and, Finset.mem_range]
  exact ⟨fun ⟨a, ha⟩ => ha ▸ opos_lt_card a, fun h => ⟨oelt n h, opos_oelt n h⟩⟩

name: Operad.LT.sorted_val
statement:
@[simp] lemma sorted_val {A : Type} [Fintype A] [LinearOrder A] (x : LT T A) :
    (sorted x).1 = sortTree (x.1.map opos)
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.LT.sorted_map
statement:
lemma sorted_map {A B : Type} [Fintype A] [LinearOrder A] [Fintype B] [LinearOrder B]
    (e : A ≃o B) (x : LT T A) :
    sorted (SetOperad.map e.toEquiv x) =
      (sorted x).cast (congrArg Finset.range (Fintype.card_congr e.toEquiv))
proof:
:= by
  refine Subtype.ext ?_
  simp only [sorted_val, SMono.cast_val, map_val, PTree.map_map]
  congr 2
  funext a
  exact opos_orderIso e a

name: Operad.LT.sorted_one
statement: lemma sorted_one : sorted (SetOperad.one : LT T Unit) = oneM
proof:
:= by
  refine Subtype.ext ?_
  simp only [sorted_val, one_val, PTree.map_leaf, sortTree_leaf, opos_unit]
  rfl

name: Operad.LT.sorted_comp
statement:
lemma sorted_comp {A B C : Type} [Fintype A] [LinearOrder A] [Fintype B] [LinearOrder B]
    [Fintype C] [LinearOrder C] (i : A) {e : Without A i ⊕ B ≃ C} (he : Operad.IsShuffle i e)
    (x : LT T A) (y : LT T B) :
    sorted (SetOperad.map e (SetOperad.comp i x y)) = graft he (sorted x) (sorted y)
proof:
:= by
  set g : ℕ → PTree T ℕ := fun n =>
    if n = opos i then (y.1.map opos).map (posR i e) else leaf (posL i e n) with hg
  have hy : (y.1.map opos).leaves.Nodup := by
    rw [leaves_map_opos y.2]
    exact (Finset.range _).nodup
  have hyR : StrictMonoOn (posR i e) {m | m ∈ (y.1.map opos).leaves} := fun m hm m' hm' h =>
    strictMonoOn_posR he (show m < Fintype.card B by
      rw [Set.mem_setOf_eq, leaves_map_opos y.2] at hm
      exact Finset.mem_range.1 hm) (show m' < Fintype.card B by
      rw [Set.mem_setOf_eq, leaves_map_opos y.2] at hm'
      exact Finset.mem_range.1 hm') h
  have hsg : ∀ n, sortTree (g n) = graftFam i e (sortTree (y.1.map opos)) n := fun n => by
    simp only [hg, graftFam]
    split_ifs
    · exact sortTree_map _ _ hy hyR
    · rfl
  have htree : ((x.1.bind (compFun i y.1)).map e).map opos = (x.1.map opos).bind g := by
    rw [PTree.map_map, PTree.map_bind, PTree.bind_map]
    congr 1
    funext a
    by_cases h : a = i
    · subst h
      rw [compFun_self, PTree.map_map]
      simp only [hg, if_pos rfl, PTree.map_map]
      congr 1
      funext b
      exact (posR_opos _ e b).symm
    · rw [compFun_ne i _ h]
      simp only [hg, if_neg fun h' => h (opos_injective h'), PTree.map_leaf]
      exact congrArg PTree.leaf (posL_opos i e ⟨a, h⟩).symm
  have hfirst : ∀ n, (sortTree (g n)).first = fL i e n := fun n => by
    rw [hsg, fL, graftFam]
    split_ifs with hn
    · have h0 : (sortTree (y.1.map opos)).first = 0 :=
        (first_eq_zero (sorted y).isShuffle (sorted y).labels_eq).1
      rw [first_relabel _ (isShuffle_sortTree _ hy), h0]
    · rfl
  have hmono : StrictMonoOn (fun n => (sortTree (g n)).first) {a | a ∈ (x.1.map opos).leaves} := by
    intro n hn n' hn' h
    rw [Set.mem_setOf_eq, leaves_map_opos x.2, Finset.mem_val, Finset.mem_range] at hn hn'
    simp only [hfirst]
    exact strictMonoOn_fL he (sorted y).isShuffle (sorted y).labels_eq hn hn' h
  refine Subtype.ext ?_
  show sortTree (((x.1.bind (compFun i y.1)).map e).map opos) =
    (sortTree (x.1.map opos)).subst (graftFam i e (sortTree (y.1.map opos)))
  rw [htree, sortTree_bind g _ (by rw [leaves_map_opos x.2]; exact (Finset.range _).nodup) hmono]
  congr 1
  funext n
  exact hsg n

name: Operad.FreeSet.toLT_gen
statement: lemma toLT_gen {k : ℕ} (e : T k) : (toLT T).app (Fin k) (Pres.gen e) = LT.corolla e
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.FreeSet.fromSh_gen
statement:
lemma fromSh_gen {k : ℕ} (hk : 0 < k) (g : SGen T k) :
    (fromSh R T).app (Fin k) (Finsupp.single (FreeSh.genM hk g) 1) =
      Finsupp.single (SetOperad.map g.2.symm (Pres.gen g.1)) 1
proof:
:=
  FreeSh.lift_gen _ hk g

name: Operad.FreeSet.sorted_corolla
statement:
lemma sorted_corolla {k : ℕ} (hk : 0 < k) (σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin k)) (e : T k) :
    sorted (SetOperad.map σ (LT.corolla e)) = FreeSh.genM hk (e, σ.symm)
proof:
:= by
  have hv : Tuple.sort (fun j => (sortTree (leaf (σ j).1 : PTree T ℕ)).first) = σ.symm := by
    refine (Tuple.eq_sort_iff.2 ⟨fun i j hij => ?_, fun i j hij h => ?_⟩).symm
    · simp only [Function.comp_apply, sortTree_leaf, STree.first_leaf, Equiv.apply_symm_apply]
      exact hij
    · simp only [sortTree_leaf, STree.first_leaf, Equiv.apply_symm_apply] at h
      exact absurd (Fin.ext h) hij.ne
  refine Subtype.ext ?_
  show sortTree (((PTree.node e fun j => PTree.leaf j).map σ).map opos) = STree.node (e, σ.symm) _
  simp only [PTree.map_node, PTree.map_leaf, opos_fin]
  rw [sortTree_node, hv]
  simp only [sortTree_leaf, Equiv.apply_symm_apply]

name: Operad.FreeSet.toSh_gen
statement:
lemma toSh_gen {k : ℕ} (hk : 0 < k) (σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin k)) (e : T k) :
    (toSh R T).app (Fin k) (Finsupp.single (SetOperad.map σ (Pres.gen e)) 1) =
      Finsupp.single (FreeSh.genM hk (e, σ.symm)) 1
proof:
:= by
  show Finsupp.mapDomain sorted (Finsupp.mapDomain ((toLT T).app (Fin k))
    (Finsupp.single (SetOperad.map σ (Pres.gen e)) (1 : R))) = _
  rw [Finsupp.mapDomain_single, Finsupp.mapDomain_single, (toLT T).app_map, toLT_gen,
    sorted_corolla hk]

name: Operad.FreeSet.toSh_comp_fromSh
statement: theorem toSh_comp_fromSh : (toSh R T).comp (fromSh R T) = ShuffleOperadHom.id
proof:
:=
  ShuffleOperadHom.ext fun A _ _ x => FreeSh.hom_ext (fun k hk g => by
    show (toSh R T).app (Fin k) ((fromSh R T).app (Fin k) (Finsupp.single (FreeSh.genM hk g) 1))
      = Finsupp.single (FreeSh.genM hk g) 1
    rw [fromSh_gen, toSh_gen R hk, Equiv.symm_symm]) A x

name: Operad.FreeSet.fromSh_comp_toSh
statement: theorem fromSh_comp_toSh : (fromSh R T).comp (toSh R T) = ShuffleOperadHom.id
proof:
:=
  Pres.shuffle_hom_ext fun n g σ => by
    show (fromSh R T).app (Fin n) ((toSh R T).app (Fin n)
      (Finsupp.single (SetOperad.map σ (Pres.gen g)) 1)) = _
    rw [toSh_gen R (pos_of_node g), fromSh_gen, Equiv.symm_symm]
    rfl

name: Operad.FreeSet.toSh_fromSh
statement:
lemma toSh_fromSh (A : Type) [Fintype A] [LinearOrder A] (x : FreeSh R (SGen T) A) :
    (toSh R T).app A ((fromSh R T).app A x) = x
proof:
:=
  congrArg (fun φ : ShuffleOperadHom R (FreeSh R (SGen T)) (FreeSh R (SGen T)) => φ.app A x)
    (toSh_comp_fromSh R)

name: Operad.FreeSet.fromSh_toSh
statement:
lemma fromSh_toSh (A : Type) [Fintype A] [LinearOrder A] (x : Lin R (FreeSet T) A) :
    (fromSh R T).app A ((toSh R T).app A x) = x
proof:
:=
  congrArg (fun φ : ShuffleOperadHom R (Shuf (Lin R (FreeSet T))) (Shuf (Lin R (FreeSet T))) =>
    φ.app A x) (fromSh_comp_toSh R)

name: Operad.FreeSet.shuffleBasis_apply
statement:
theorem shuffleBasis_apply (A : Type) [Fintype A] [LinearOrder A]
    (m : SMono (SGen T) (Finset.range (Fintype.card A))) :
    shuffleBasis R A m = (fromSh R T).app A (Finsupp.single m 1)
proof:
:= by
  rw [shuffleBasis, Module.Basis.map_apply, Finsupp.coe_basisSingleOne]
  rfl

name: Operad.SymOperadFiltration.mem_map
statement:
lemma mem_map (Φ : SymOperadFiltration R P) (f : SymOperadHom R P Q)
    (hf : ∀ (A : Type) [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A], Function.Surjective (f.app A)) {p : ℕ}
    {A : Type} [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] (x : P A) (hx : x ∈ Φ.F p A) :
    f.app A x ∈ (Φ.map f hf).F p A
proof:
:=
  ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩

name: Operad.SetSpecies.map_symm_map
statement: @[simp] lemma map_symm_map (e : A ≃ B) (x : X A) : map e.symm (map e x) = x
proof:
:= by
  rw [← map_trans, Equiv.self_trans_symm, map_refl]

name: Operad.SetSpecies.map_map_symm
statement: @[simp] lemma map_map_symm (e : A ≃ B) (y : X B) : map e (map e.symm y) = y
proof:
:= by
  rw [← map_trans, Equiv.symm_trans_self, map_refl]

name: Operad.SetSpeciesHom.ext
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨φa, _⟩ := φ
  obtain ⟨ψa, _⟩ := ψ
  have : @φa = @ψa := by
    funext A _ _ x
    exact h A x
  subst this
  rfl

name: Operad.SetSpeciesHom.extendApp_chart
proof:
:= by
  have hn : n = Fintype.card A := by simpa using Fintype.card_congr φ
  subst hn
  set ψ := (Fintype.equivFin A).symm
  have hσ : SetSpecies.map ψ.symm x
      = SetSpecies.map (φ.trans ψ.symm) (SetSpecies.map φ.symm x) := by
    rw [← SetSpecies.map_trans, ← Equiv.trans_assoc, Equiv.symm_trans_self, Equiv.refl_trans]
  show SetSpecies.map ψ (f _ (SetSpecies.map ψ.symm x)) = _
  rw [hσ, hf, ← SetSpecies.map_trans, Equiv.trans_assoc, Equiv.symm_trans_self,
    Equiv.trans_refl]

name: Operad.SetSpeciesHom.extend_app_fin
statement:
@[simp] lemma extend_app_fin {f : ∀ n : ℕ, X (Fin n) → Y (Fin n)} (hf : Equivariant f)
    (n : ℕ) (x : X (Fin n)) : (extend f hf).app (Fin n) x = f n x
proof:
:= by
  show extendApp f (Fin n) x = f n x
  rw [extendApp_chart hf (Equiv.refl (Fin n)), Equiv.refl_symm, SetSpecies.map_refl,
    SetSpecies.map_refl]

name: Operad.SetSpeciesHom.app_eq_chart
proof:
:= by
  rw [← φ.app_map, SetSpecies.map_map_symm]

name: Operad.SymSpeciesHom.ext
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨φa, _⟩ := φ
  obtain ⟨ψa, _⟩ := ψ
  have : @φa = @ψa := by
    funext A _ _
    exact LinearMap.ext (h A)
  subst this
  rfl

name: Operad.TConv.compFun_eq
statement:
lemma compFun_eq (a b : ℕ) {n : ℕ} (f : TConv R E Q (a + 1 + b)) (g : TConv R E Q n)
    {t : OfArity E (a + n + b)} (t₁ : OfArity E (a + 1 + b)) (t₂ : OfArity E n)
    (ht : t₁.1.graft a t₂.1 = t.1) :
    compFun a b f g t = NSOperad.comp (R := R) a b (f t₁) (g t₂)
proof:
:= by
  have h : ∃ p : OfArity E (a + 1 + b) × OfArity E n, (OfArity.graft a b p.1 p.2).1 = t.1 :=
    ⟨(t₁, t₂), ht⟩
  rw [compFun, dif_pos h]
  have hs := Classical.choose_spec h
  obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := OfArity.graft_inj a b (Subtype.ext (hs.trans ht.symm) :
    OfArity.graft a b (Classical.choose h).1 (Classical.choose h).2 = OfArity.graft a b t₁ t₂)
  rw [h1, h2]

name: Operad.TConv.compFun_eq_zero
statement:
lemma compFun_eq_zero (a b : ℕ) {n : ℕ} (f : TConv R E Q (a + 1 + b)) (g : TConv R E Q n)
    {t : OfArity E (a + n + b)}
    (ht : ∀ (t₁ : OfArity E (a + 1 + b)) (t₂ : OfArity E n), t₁.1.graft a t₂.1 ≠ t.1) :
    compFun a b f g t = 0
proof:
:=
  dif_neg fun ⟨p, hp⟩ => ht p.1 p.2 hp

name: Operad.TConv.compL_apply
statement:
@[simp] lemma compL_apply (a b : ℕ) {n : ℕ} (f : TConv R E Q (a + 1 + b)) (g : TConv R E Q n)
    (t : OfArity E (a + n + b)) : compL a b f g t = compFun a b f g t
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.TConv.reindex_apply
statement:
lemma reindex_apply {m n : ℕ} (h : m = n) (f : TConv R E Q m) (t : OfArity E n) :
    reindex R (TConv R E Q) h f t = reindex R Q h (f (OfArity.cast h.symm t))
proof:
:= by
  subst h
  rfl

name: Operad.TConv.eq_one
statement: lemma eq_one (t : OfArity E 1) : t = OfArity.one
proof:
:=
  Subtype.ext (eq_leaf_of_arity_eq_one t.2)

name: Operad.TConv.comp_apply
statement:
lemma comp_apply (a b : ℕ) {n : ℕ} (f : TConv R E Q (a + 1 + b)) (g : TConv R E Q n)
    (t : OfArity E (a + n + b)) :
    NSOperad.comp (R := R) (P := TConv R E Q) a b f g t = compFun a b f g t
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.Suboperad.coe_reindex
statement:
lemma coe_reindex {m n : ℕ} (h : m = n) (x : S.carrier m) :
    ((reindex R (fun k => (S.carrier k : Type v)) h x : S.carrier n) : P n)
      = reindex R P h (x : P m)
proof:
:= by
  subst h; rfl

name: Operad.Suboperad.coe_compSub
statement:
@[simp] lemma coe_compSub (a b : ℕ) {n : ℕ} (α : S.carrier (a + 1 + b)) (β : S.carrier n) :
    ((S.compSub a b α β : S.carrier (a + n + b)) : P (a + n + b))
      = comp (R := R) a b (α : P _) (β : P _)
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.Suboperad.incl_app
statement: @[simp] lemma incl_app (n : ℕ) (x : S.carrier n) : S.incl.app n x = (x : P n)
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.HCAlg.scalOps_apply
statement:
lemma scalOps_apply (c : ℕ → R) {n : ℕ} (h : 2 ≤ n) (v : Fin n → R) :
    scalOps R c n h v = c n * ∏ i, v i
proof:
:= by
  simp [scalOps, MultilinearMap.mkPiAlgebra_apply]

name: Operad.HCAlg.prod_orderEmbOfFin
statement:
lemma prod_orderEmbOfFin {n : ℕ} (S : Finset (Fin n)) (v : Fin n → R) :
    ∏ t, v (S.orderEmbOfFin rfl t) = ∏ a ∈ S, v a
proof:
:= by
  refine (Fintype.prod_equiv (S.orderIsoOfFin rfl).toEquiv (fun t => v (S.orderEmbOfFin rfl t))
    (fun x : S => v x) fun t => ?_).trans (Finset.prod_coe_sort S v)
  simp

name: Operad.HCAlg.wVal_scal
statement:
lemma wVal_scal (c : ℕ → R) {n : ℕ} (S : Finset (Fin n)) (v : Fin n → R) :
    HyperCom.wVal R (scalOps R c) S v
      = (if 2 ≤ S.card ∧ 1 ≤ Sᶜ.card then c (Sᶜ.card + 1) * c S.card else 0) * ∏ i, v i
proof:
:= by
  unfold HyperCom.wVal
  split_ifs with h
  · rw [scalOps_apply, Fin.prod_cons, scalOps_apply, prod_orderEmbOfFin, prod_orderEmbOfFin,
      ← Finset.prod_mul_prod_compl S v]
    ring
  · rw [zero_mul]

name: Operad.HyperCom.map_opGen
statement:
lemma map_opGen {n : ℕ} (h : 2 ≤ n) (σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin n)) :
    SymOperad.map (R := R) σ (opGen (R := R) n h) = opGen n h
proof:
:= by
  have hrel : mono (R := R) n h σ - mono n h 1 ∈ (I).sub (Fin n) :=
    SymOperadIdeal.subset_span (R := R) n (Or.inl ⟨h, σ, rfl⟩)
  rw [← SymOperadIdeal.proj_eq_zero_iff, map_sub, sub_eq_zero] at hrel
  have h1 : SymOperad.map (R := R) σ (Finsupp.single (Pres.gen (⟨h⟩ : HCGen n)) (1 : R))
      = mono n h σ := by
    show Lin.mapL R σ _ = _
    rw [Lin.mapL_single]
    rfl
  have h2 : mono (R := R) n h 1 = Finsupp.single (Pres.gen (⟨h⟩ : HCGen n)) 1 := by
    unfold mono
    congr 1
    exact SetOperad.map_refl (Pres.mk (gen n h))
  unfold opGen
  rw [← SymOperadIdeal.projHom_app, ← SymOperadHom.app_map, SymOperadIdeal.projHom_app, h1,
    hrel, h2]
  rfl

name: Operad.HyperCom.card_W
statement: lemma card_W : Fintype.card W = 3
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.HyperCom.perm_W
statement:
lemma perm_W (f : Equiv.Perm W) (hf : f outer = outer) :
    f = 1 ∨ f = Equiv.swap (Sum.inr 0) (Sum.inr 1)
proof:
:= by
  revert f
  decide

name: Operad.HyperCom.map_c22_swap
statement:
lemma map_c22_swap :
    SymOperad.map (R := R) (Equiv.swap (Sum.inr 0 : W) (Sum.inr 1)) (c22 R) = c22 R
proof:
:= by
  have hs : Equiv.swap (Sum.inr 0 : W) (Sum.inr 1)
      = compEquiv (Equiv.refl (Fin 2)) (Equiv.swap 0 1) 0 := by
    ext w
    revert w
    decide
  have := SymOperad.map_comp (R := R) (Equiv.refl (Fin 2)) (Equiv.swap (0 : Fin 2) 1) 0
    (opGen (R := R) 2 le_rfl) (opGen 2 le_rfl)
  rw [SymOperad.map_refl, map_opGen] at this
  rw [hs]
  exact this

name: Operad.HyperCom.map_c22_eq
statement:
lemma map_c22_eq {A : Type} [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] (e e' : W ≃ A)
    (h : e outer = e' outer) :
    SymOperad.map (R := R) e (c22 R) = SymOperad.map (R := R) e' (c22 R)
proof:
:= by
  have he : e = (e.trans e'.symm).trans e' := by
    ext w
    simp
  rw [he, SymOperad.map_trans]
  rcases perm_W (e.trans e'.symm) (by simp [h]) with hf | hf
  · rw [hf]
    exact congrArg _ (SymOperad.map_refl (R := R) _)
  · rw [hf, map_c22_swap]

name: Operad.HyperCom.wTerm_eq
statement:
lemma wTerm_eq (S : Finset (Fin 3)) (hS : S.card = 2) :
    ∃ e : W ≃ Fin 3, wTerm (R := R) S = SymOperad.map (R := R) e (SymOperad.comp (R := R)
      (0 : Fin 2) (Finsupp.single (Pres.gen (⟨le_rfl⟩ : HCGen 2)) 1)
      (Finsupp.single (Pres.gen (⟨le_rfl⟩ : HCGen 2)) 1)) ∧ e outer ∉ S
proof:
:= by
  have hc : Sᶜ.card = 1 := by rw [Finset.card_compl, hS]; rfl
  have key : ∀ (a b : ℕ) (_ : a = 1) (_ : b = 2) (E : Without (Fin (a + 1)) 0 ⊕ Fin b ≃ Fin 3)
      (h1 : 2 ≤ a + 1) (h2 : 2 ≤ b), (∀ x, E (Sum.inl x) ∉ S) →
      ∃ e : W ≃ Fin 3, (Finsupp.single (Pres.mk (.map E (.comp 0 (gen (a + 1) h1) (gen b h2))))
        (1 : R) : FreeHC R (Fin 3)) = SymOperad.map (R := R) (P := FreeHC R) e
          (SymOperad.comp (R := R) (0 : Fin 2) (Finsupp.single (Pres.gen (⟨le_rfl⟩ : HCGen 2)) 1)
          (Finsupp.single (Pres.gen (⟨le_rfl⟩ : HCGen 2)) 1)) ∧ e outer ∉ S := by
    rintro a b rfl rfl E h1 h2 hE
    refine ⟨E, ?_, hE _⟩
    show _ = Lin.mapL R E (Lin.compL R 0 _ _)
    rw [Lin.compL_single, Lin.mapL_single, mul_one]
    rfl
  unfold wTerm
  rw [dif_pos ⟨by omega, by omega⟩]
  exact key _ _ hc hS (wEquiv S) _ _ fun x => by
    rw [wEquiv_inl]
    exact Finset.mem_compl.1 (Finset.orderEmbOfFin_mem _ _ _)

name: Operad.HyperCom.proj_wTerm
statement:
lemma proj_wTerm (S : Finset (Fin 3)) (hS : S.card = 2) :
    ∃ e : W ≃ Fin 3, (I).proj _ (wTerm (R := R) S) = SymOperad.map (R := R) e (c22 R) ∧
      e outer ∉ S
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨e, he, hS⟩ := wTerm_eq (R := R) S hS
  refine ⟨e, ?_, hS⟩
  rw [he, ← SymOperadIdeal.projHom_app, SymOperadHom.app_map, SymOperadHom.app_comp]
  rfl

name: Operad.HyperCom.filter_pair
statement:
lemma filter_pair (p q r : Fin 3) (hpq : p ≠ q) (hpr : p ≠ r) (hqr : q ≠ r) :
    univ.filter (fun S : Finset (Fin 3) => p ∈ S ∧ q ∈ S ∧ r ∉ S) = {{p, q}}
proof:
:= by
  revert p q r
  decide

name: Operad.HyperCom.eq_of_not_mem_pair
statement:
lemma eq_of_not_mem_pair {p q r x : Fin 3} (hpq : p ≠ q) (hpr : p ≠ r) (hqr : q ≠ r)
    (hx : x ∉ ({p, q} : Finset (Fin 3))) : x = r
proof:
:= by
  revert p q r x
  decide

name: Operad.HyperCom.map_c22_eq_all
statement:
lemma map_c22_eq_all (e e' : W ≃ Fin 3) :
    SymOperad.map (R := R) e (c22 R) = SymOperad.map (R := R) e' (c22 R)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases h : e outer = e' outer
  · exact map_c22_eq e e' h
  obtain ⟨i, hij, hik⟩ : ∃ i : Fin 3, i ≠ e' outer ∧ i ≠ e outer := by
    revert h
    generalize e outer = k
    generalize e' outer = j
    revert j k
    decide
  have hrel : wdvv (R := R) i (e' outer) (e outer) ∈ (I).sub (Fin 3) :=
    SymOperadIdeal.subset_span (R := R) 3
      (Or.inr ⟨i, e' outer, e outer, hij, hik, Ne.symm h, rfl⟩)
  rw [← SymOperadIdeal.proj_eq_zero_iff, wdvv, filter_pair _ _ _ hij hik (Ne.symm h),
    filter_pair _ _ _ hik hij h, Finset.sum_singleton, Finset.sum_singleton, map_sub,
    sub_eq_zero] at hrel
  obtain ⟨e₁, he₁, hS₁⟩ := proj_wTerm (R := R) {i, e' outer} (Finset.card_pair hij)
  obtain ⟨e₂, he₂, hS₂⟩ := proj_wTerm (R := R) {i, e outer} (Finset.card_pair hik)
  rw [he₁, he₂] at hrel
  rw [map_c22_eq e e₁ (eq_of_not_mem_pair hij hik (Ne.symm h) hS₁).symm, hrel,
    map_c22_eq e₂ e' (eq_of_not_mem_pair hik hij h hS₂)]

name: Operad.HyperCom.mem_truncSp_of_card
statement: lemma mem_truncSp_of_card (h : 4 ≤ Fintype.card A) (x : HyperComOp R A) : x ∈ truncSp R A
proof:
:= by
  rw [truncSp, if_pos h]
  exact Submodule.mem_top

name: Operad.HyperCom.mem_truncSp_of_basic
statement: lemma mem_truncSp_of_basic {x : HyperComOp R A} (hx : x ∈ basic R A) : x ∈ truncSp R A
proof:
:= by
  unfold truncSp
  split_ifs
  · exact Submodule.mem_top
  · exact Submodule.subset_span hx

name: Operad.HyperCom.map_mem_basic
statement:
lemma map_mem_basic (e : A ≃ B) {x : HyperComOp R A} (hx : x ∈ basic R A) :
    SymOperad.map (R := R) e x ∈ basic R B
proof:
:= by
  rcases hx with ⟨f, rfl⟩ | ⟨f, rfl⟩ | ⟨f, rfl⟩ | ⟨f, rfl⟩
  · exact Or.inl ⟨f.trans e, (SymOperad.map_trans (R := R) f e _).symm⟩
  · exact Or.inr (Or.inl ⟨f.trans e, (SymOperad.map_trans (R := R) f e _).symm⟩)
  · exact Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inl ⟨f.trans e, (SymOperad.map_trans (R := R) f e _).symm⟩))
  · exact Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inr ⟨f.trans e, (SymOperad.map_trans (R := R) f e _).symm⟩))

name: Operad.HyperCom.map_mem_truncSp
statement:
lemma map_mem_truncSp (e : A ≃ B) {x : HyperComOp R A} (hx : x ∈ truncSp R A) :
    SymOperad.map (R := R) e x ∈ truncSp R B
proof:
:= by
  have hc := Fintype.card_congr e
  unfold truncSp at hx ⊢
  split_ifs at hx ⊢ with h₁ h₂ h₂
  · exact Submodule.mem_top
  · exact absurd (hc ▸ h₁) h₂
  · exact absurd (hc ▸ h₂) h₁
  · refine (Submodule.span_le.2 ?_ : Submodule.span R (basic R A) ≤
      (Submodule.span R (basic R B)).comap (SymOperad.map (R := R) e)) hx
    exact fun y hy => Submodule.subset_span (map_mem_basic e hy)

name: Operad.HyperCom.nonempty_of_basic
statement: lemma nonempty_of_basic {x : HyperComOp R A} (hx : x ∈ basic R A) : Nonempty A
proof:
:= by
  rcases hx with ⟨f, -⟩ | ⟨f, -⟩ | ⟨f, -⟩ | ⟨f, -⟩
  exacts [⟨f ()⟩, ⟨f 0⟩, ⟨f 0⟩, ⟨f (Sum.inr 0)⟩]

name: Operad.HyperCom.card_comp
statement:
lemma card_comp {X Y : Type} [Fintype X] [DecidableEq X] [Fintype Y] [DecidableEq Y] (j : X) :
    Fintype.card (Without X j ⊕ Y) + 1 = Fintype.card X + Fintype.card Y
proof:
:= by
  rw [Fintype.card_sum, Fintype.card_subtype_compl, Fintype.card_subtype_eq]
  have := Fintype.card_pos_iff.2 ⟨j⟩
  omega

name: Operad.HyperCom.comp_map_mem
statement:
lemma comp_map_mem {X Y : Type} [Fintype X] [DecidableEq X] [Fintype Y] [DecidableEq Y]
    (g : HyperComOp R X) (g' : HyperComOp R Y)
    (H : ∀ j : X, SymOperad.comp (R := R) j g g' ∈ truncSp R (Without X j ⊕ Y))
    (e : X ≃ A) (f : Y ≃ B) (i : A) :
    SymOperad.comp (R := R) i (SymOperad.map (R := R) e g) (SymOperad.map (R := R) f g')
      ∈ truncSp R (Without A i ⊕ B)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨j, rfl⟩ := e.surjective i
  rw [← SymOperad.map_comp]
  exact map_mem_truncSp _ (H j)

name: Operad.HyperCom.comp_one_left
proof:
:= by
  have := congrArg (SymOperad.map (R := R) (leftUnitEquiv Y).symm)
    (SymOperad.one_comp (R := R) g')
  rw [SymOperad.map_symm_map] at this
  rw [this]
  exact map_mem_truncSp _ hg'

name: Operad.HyperCom.comp_one_right
proof:
:= by
  have := congrArg (SymOperad.map (R := R) (rightUnitEquiv j).symm)
    (SymOperad.comp_one (R := R) j g)
  rw [SymOperad.map_symm_map] at this
  rw [this]
  exact map_mem_truncSp _ hg

name: Operad.HyperCom.comp_m2_m2
statement:
lemma comp_m2_m2 (j : Fin 2) :
    SymOperad.comp (R := R) j (opGen 2 le_rfl) (opGen 2 le_rfl)
      ∈ truncSp R (Without (Fin 2) j ⊕ Fin 2)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨σ, rfl⟩ : ∃ σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin 2), σ 0 = j := ⟨Equiv.swap 0 j, Equiv.swap_apply_left _ _⟩
  have := SymOperad.map_comp (R := R) σ (Equiv.refl (Fin 2)) 0 (opGen (R := R) 2 le_rfl)
    (opGen 2 le_rfl)
  rw [map_opGen, SymOperad.map_refl] at this
  rw [← this]
  exact mem_truncSp_of_basic (Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inr ⟨_, rfl⟩)))

name: Operad.HyperCom.comp_big
statement:
lemma comp_big {X Y : Type} [Fintype X] [DecidableEq X] [Fintype Y] [DecidableEq Y]
    (h : 5 ≤ Fintype.card X + Fintype.card Y) (g : HyperComOp R X) (g' : HyperComOp R Y)
    (j : X) : SymOperad.comp (R := R) j g g' ∈ truncSp R (Without X j ⊕ Y)
proof:
:=
  mem_truncSp_of_card (by have := card_comp (Y := Y) j; omega) _

name: Operad.HyperCom.one_mem_truncSp
statement: lemma one_mem_truncSp : SymOperad.one R ∈ truncSp R Unit
proof:
:=
  mem_truncSp_of_basic (Or.inl ⟨Equiv.refl _, (SymOperad.map_refl (R := R) _).symm⟩)

name: Operad.HyperCom.m2_mem_truncSp
statement: lemma m2_mem_truncSp : opGen (R := R) 2 le_rfl ∈ truncSp R (Fin 2)
proof:
:=
  mem_truncSp_of_basic (Or.inr (Or.inl ⟨Equiv.refl _, (SymOperad.map_refl (R := R) _).symm⟩))

name: Operad.HyperCom.m3_mem_truncSp
statement: lemma m3_mem_truncSp : opGen (R := R) 3 (by norm_num) ∈ truncSp R (Fin 3)
proof:
:=
  mem_truncSp_of_basic
    (Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inl ⟨Equiv.refl _, (SymOperad.map_refl (R := R) _).symm⟩)))

name: Operad.HyperCom.c22_mem_truncSp
statement: lemma c22_mem_truncSp : c22 R ∈ truncSp R W
proof:
:=
  mem_truncSp_of_basic
    (Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inr ⟨Equiv.refl _, (SymOperad.map_refl (R := R) _).symm⟩)))

name: Operad.HyperCom.comp_mem_truncSp
proof:
:= by
  by_cases h4 : 4 ≤ Fintype.card (Without A i ⊕ B)
  · exact mem_truncSp_of_card h4 _
  have hc := card_comp (Y := B) i
  have hA1 := Fintype.card_pos_iff.2 ⟨i⟩
  have hyS : y ∈ Submodule.span R (basic R B) := by
    unfold truncSp at hy
    rwa [if_neg (by omega)] at hy
  by_cases hA : 4 ≤ Fintype.card A
  · have hB : Fintype.card B = 0 := by omega
    haveI := Fintype.card_eq_zero_iff.1 hB
    have hT : basic R B = ∅ := Set.eq_empty_of_forall_notMem fun z hz =>
      (nonempty_of_basic hz).elim isEmptyElim
    rw [hT, Submodule.span_empty, Submodule.mem_bot] at hyS
    rw [hyS, map_zero]
    exact zero_mem _
  have hxS : x ∈ Submodule.span R (basic R A) := by
    unfold truncSp at hx
    rwa [if_neg hA] at hx
  have hm := Submodule.apply_mem_map₂ (SymOperad.comp (R := R) i) hxS hyS
  rw [Submodule.map₂_span_span] at hm
  refine (Submodule.span_le.2 ?_) hm
  rintro _ ⟨x, hx, y, hy, rfl⟩
  rcases hx with ⟨e, rfl⟩ | ⟨e, rfl⟩ | ⟨e, rfl⟩ | ⟨e, rfl⟩ <;>
  rcases hy with ⟨f, rfl⟩ | ⟨f, rfl⟩ | ⟨f, rfl⟩ | ⟨f, rfl⟩ <;>
  refine comp_map_mem _ _ ?_ e f i
  · exact comp_one_left one_mem_truncSp
  · exact comp_one_left m2_mem_truncSp
  · exact comp_one_left m3_mem_truncSp
  · exact comp_one_left c22_mem_truncSp
  · exact comp_one_right m2_mem_truncSp
  · exact comp_m2_m2
  · exact comp_big (by simp) _ _
  · exact comp_big (by simp) _ _
  · exact comp_one_right m3_mem_truncSp
  · exact comp_big (by simp) _ _
  · exact comp_big (by simp) _ _
  · exact comp_big (by simp) _ _
  · exact comp_one_right c22_mem_truncSp
  · exact comp_big (by simp) _ _
  · exact comp_big (by simp) _ _
  · exact comp_big (by simp) _ _

name: Operad.HyperCom.mem_truncSp
statement: theorem mem_truncSp (x : HyperComOp R A) : x ∈ truncSp R A
proof:
:= by
  refine SymSuboperad.mem_of_presGen (truncSub R) (fun n g => ?_) x
  obtain ⟨hg⟩ := g
  obtain rfl | rfl | h4 : n = 2 ∨ n = 3 ∨ 4 ≤ n := by omega
  · exact m2_mem_truncSp
  · exact m3_mem_truncSp
  · exact mem_truncSp_of_card (by simpa using h4) _

name: Operad.HyperCom.mem_span_basic
statement:
theorem mem_span_basic (hA : Fintype.card A ≤ 3) (x : HyperComOp R A) :
    x ∈ Submodule.span R (basic R A)
proof:
:= by
  have := mem_truncSp x
  unfold truncSp at this
  rwa [if_neg (by omega)] at this

name: Operad.HyperCom.subsingleton_of_card
statement: theorem subsingleton_of_card (hA : Fintype.card A = 0) : Subsingleton (HyperComOp R A)
proof:
:= by
  haveI := Fintype.card_eq_zero_iff.1 hA
  have h : ∀ z : HyperComOp R A, z = 0 := fun z => by
    have := mem_span_basic (by omega) z
    rwa [show basic R A = ∅ from Set.eq_empty_of_forall_notMem fun z hz =>
      (nonempty_of_basic hz).elim isEmptyElim, Submodule.span_empty, Submodule.mem_bot] at this
  exact ⟨fun x y => by rw [h x, h y]⟩

name: Operad.HyperCom.basic_one
statement: lemma basic_one : basic R (Fin 1) ⊆ {unit1 R}
proof:
:= by
  rintro _ (⟨e, rfl⟩ | ⟨e, rfl⟩ | ⟨e, rfl⟩ | ⟨e, rfl⟩)
  · rw [Set.mem_singleton_iff, unit1, Subsingleton.elim e]
  · exact absurd (Fintype.card_congr e) (by simp)
  · exact absurd (Fintype.card_congr e) (by simp)
  · exact absurd (Fintype.card_congr e) (by simp)

name: Operad.HyperCom.basic_two
statement: lemma basic_two : basic R (Fin 2) ⊆ {opGen 2 le_rfl}
proof:
:= by
  rintro _ (⟨e, rfl⟩ | ⟨e, rfl⟩ | ⟨e, rfl⟩ | ⟨e, rfl⟩)
  · exact absurd (Fintype.card_congr e) (by simp)
  · exact map_opGen le_rfl e
  · exact absurd (Fintype.card_congr e) (by simp)
  · exact absurd (Fintype.card_congr e) (by simp)

name: Operad.HyperCom.basic_three
statement: lemma basic_three : basic R (Fin 3) ⊆ Set.range ![opGen 3 (by norm_num), t3 R]
proof:
:= by
  rintro _ (⟨e, rfl⟩ | ⟨e, rfl⟩ | ⟨e, rfl⟩ | ⟨e, rfl⟩)
  · exact absurd (Fintype.card_congr e) (by simp)
  · exact absurd (Fintype.card_congr e) (by simp)
  · exact ⟨0, (map_opGen _ e).symm⟩
  · exact ⟨1, map_c22_eq_all _ _⟩

name: Operad.HyperCom.alg_opGen
statement:
lemma alg_opGen {V : Type v} [AddCommGroup V] [Module R V] (a : HCAlg R V) {n : ℕ} (h : 2 ≤ n) :
    ((HyperComOp.algebraEquiv R V).symm a).app (Fin n) (opGen n h) = a.μ n h
proof:
:= by
  show (hcHom V a.μ).app (Fin n) (Finsupp.single (Pres.mk (.gen ⟨h⟩)) 1) = _
  rw [hcHom_single]
  rfl

name: Operad.HyperCom.scal_opGen
statement:
lemma scal_opGen (c : ℕ → R) {n : ℕ} (h : 2 ≤ n) (v : Fin n → R) :
    ((HyperComOp.algebraEquiv R R).symm (HCAlg.scal c)).app (Fin n) (opGen n h) v
      = c n * ∏ i, v i
proof:
:= by
  rw [alg_opGen]
  exact HCAlg.scalOps_apply c h v

name: Operad.HyperCom.scal_t3
statement:
lemma scal_t3 (c : ℕ → R) :
    ((HyperComOp.algebraEquiv R R).symm (HCAlg.scal c)).app (Fin 3) (t3 R) (fun _ => 1)
      = c 2 * c 2
proof:
:= by
  rw [t3, SymOperadHom.app_map, c22, SymOperadHom.app_comp, alg_opGen]
  show HCAlg.scalOps R c 2 le_rfl (feed 0 _ (HCAlg.scalOps R c 2 le_rfl _)) = _
  rw [HCAlg.scalOps_apply, HCAlg.scalOps_apply, Fin.prod_univ_two, Fin.prod_univ_two, feed_self,
    feed_of_ne (by decide)]
  simp

name: Operad.HyperCom.scal_unit1
statement:
lemma scal_unit1 (c : ℕ → R) :
    ((HyperComOp.algebraEquiv R R).symm (HCAlg.scal c)).app (Fin 1) (unit1 R) (fun _ => 1)
      = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [unit1, SymOperadHom.app_map, SymOperadHom.app_one]
  rfl

name: Operad.HyperCom.linearIndependent_three
statement:
theorem linearIndependent_three :
    LinearIndependent K ![opGen (R := K) 3 (by norm_num), t3 K]
proof:
:= by
  refine LinearIndependent.pair_iff.2 fun s t hst => ?_
  have e₂ := congrArg (fun x => ((HyperComOp.algebraEquiv K K).symm
    (HCAlg.scal fun n => if n = 2 then 1 else 0)).app (Fin 3) x (fun _ => 1)) hst
  have e₃ := congrArg (fun x => ((HyperComOp.algebraEquiv K K).symm
    (HCAlg.scal fun n => if n = 3 then 1 else 0)).app (Fin 3) x (fun _ => 1)) hst
  simp only [map_add, map_smul, MultilinearMap.add_apply, MultilinearMap.smul_apply, scal_opGen,
    scal_t3, map_zero, MultilinearMap.zero_apply, smul_eq_mul] at e₂ e₃
  simp at e₂ e₃
  exact ⟨e₃, e₂⟩

name: Operad.HyperCom.opGen_two_ne_zero
statement: lemma opGen_two_ne_zero : opGen (R := K) 2 le_rfl ≠ 0
proof:
:= fun h => by
  have := congrArg (fun x => ((HyperComOp.algebraEquiv K K).symm
    (HCAlg.scal fun _ => 1)).app (Fin 2) x (fun _ => 1)) h
  simp [scal_opGen] at this

name: Operad.HyperCom.unit1_ne_zero
statement: lemma unit1_ne_zero : unit1 K ≠ 0
proof:
:= fun h => by
  have := congrArg (fun x => ((HyperComOp.algebraEquiv K K).symm
    (HCAlg.scal fun _ => 1)).app (Fin 1) x (fun _ => 1)) h
  simp [scal_unit1] at this

name: Operad.HyperCom.finrank_fin_one
statement: theorem finrank_fin_one : Module.finrank K (HyperComOp K (Fin 1)) = 1
proof:
:= by
  have htop : Submodule.span K {unit1 K} = ⊤ :=
    eq_top_iff.2 fun x _ => Submodule.span_mono basic_one (mem_span_basic (by simp) x)
  rw [← finrank_top, ← htop, finrank_span_singleton (unit1_ne_zero K)]

name: Operad.HyperCom.finrank_fin_two
statement: theorem finrank_fin_two : Module.finrank K (HyperComOp K (Fin 2)) = 1
proof:
:= by
  have htop : Submodule.span K {opGen (R := K) 2 le_rfl} = ⊤ :=
    eq_top_iff.2 fun x _ => Submodule.span_mono basic_two (mem_span_basic (by simp) x)
  rw [← finrank_top, ← htop, finrank_span_singleton (opGen_two_ne_zero K)]

name: Operad.HyperCom.finrank_fin_three
statement: theorem finrank_fin_three : Module.finrank K (HyperComOp K (Fin 3)) = 2
proof:
:= by
  have htop : Submodule.span K (Set.range ![opGen (R := K) 3 (by norm_num), t3 K]) = ⊤ :=
    eq_top_iff.2 fun x _ => Submodule.span_mono basic_three (mem_span_basic (by simp) x)
  rw [← finrank_top, ← htop, finrank_span_eq_card (linearIndependent_three K)]
  simp

name: Operad.HyperCom.finrank_one
statement: theorem finrank_one (hA : Fintype.card A = 1) : Module.finrank K (HyperComOp K A) = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [← (SymOperad.mapEquiv (R := K) (P := HyperComOp K)
    (Fintype.equivFinOfCardEq hA).symm).finrank_eq, finrank_fin_one]

name: Operad.HyperCom.finrank_two
statement: theorem finrank_two (hA : Fintype.card A = 2) : Module.finrank K (HyperComOp K A) = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [← (SymOperad.mapEquiv (R := K) (P := HyperComOp K)
    (Fintype.equivFinOfCardEq hA).symm).finrank_eq, finrank_fin_two]

name: Operad.HyperCom.finrank_three
statement: theorem finrank_three (hA : Fintype.card A = 3) : Module.finrank K (HyperComOp K A) = 2
proof:
:= by
  rw [← (SymOperad.mapEquiv (R := K) (P := HyperComOp K)
    (Fintype.equivFinOfCardEq hA).symm).finrank_eq, finrank_fin_three]

name: Operad.GrSpecies.par_par_self
statement: lemma par_par_self (b : Bool) (x : V A) : par (R := R) b (par (R := R) b x) = par (R := R) b x
proof:
:=
  by rw [par_par, if_pos rfl]

name: Operad.GrSpecies.par_par_ne
statement:
lemma par_par_ne {b b' : Bool} (h : b ≠ b') (x : V A) :
    par (R := R) b (par (R := R) b' x) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [par_par, if_neg h]

name: Operad.GrOperad.toGrSpecies_par
statement:
@[simp] lemma toGrSpecies_par (b : Bool) (x : P A) :
    GrSpecies.par (R := R) b x = GrOperad.par (R := R) b x
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.GrOperad.toGrSpecies_map
statement:
@[simp] lemma toGrSpecies_map (e : A ≃ B) (x : P A) :
    SymSpecies.map (R := R) e x = GrOperad.map (R := R) e x
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.GrSpeciesHom.ext
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨φ', _⟩ := φ
  obtain ⟨ψ', _⟩ := ψ
  have : φ' = ψ' := SymSpeciesHom.ext h
  subst this
  rfl

name: Operad.GrSpeciesHom.extendApp_chart
proof:
:= by
  have hn : n = Fintype.card A := by simpa using Fintype.card_congr φ
  subst hn
  set ψ := (Fintype.equivFin A).symm
  have hσ : SymSpecies.map (R := R) ψ.symm x
      = SymSpecies.map (R := R) (φ.trans ψ.symm) (SymSpecies.map (R := R) φ.symm x) := by
    rw [← SymSpecies.map_trans, ← Equiv.trans_assoc, Equiv.symm_trans_self, Equiv.refl_trans]
  show SymSpecies.map (R := R) ψ (f _ (SymSpecies.map (R := R) ψ.symm x)) = _
  rw [hσ, hf.1, ← SymSpecies.map_trans, Equiv.trans_assoc, Equiv.symm_trans_self,
    Equiv.trans_refl]

name: Operad.GrSpeciesHom.extend_app_fin
statement:
@[simp] lemma extend_app_fin {f : ∀ n : ℕ, V (Fin n) →ₗ[R] W (Fin n)} (hf : Skel f) (n : ℕ)
    (x : V (Fin n)) : (extend f hf).app (Fin n) x = f n x
proof:
:= by
  show extendApp f (Fin n) x = f n x
  rw [extendApp_chart hf (Equiv.refl (Fin n)), Equiv.refl_symm, SymSpecies.map_refl,
    SymSpecies.map_refl]

name: Operad.GrSpeciesHom.app_eq_chart
statement:
lemma app_eq_chart (φ : GrSpeciesHom R V W) {A : Type} [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] {n : ℕ}
    (e : Fin n ≃ A) (x : V A) :
    φ.app A x
      = SymSpecies.map (R := R) e (φ.app (Fin n) (SymSpecies.map (R := R) e.symm x))
proof:
:= by
  rw [← φ.app_map, ← SymSpecies.map_trans, Equiv.symm_trans_self, SymSpecies.map_refl]

name: Operad.lgen_congr
statement:
lemma lgen_congr {k : ℕ} {b : Bool} {v v' : V (Fin k)} (e : v = v')
    (h : GrSpecies.par (R := R) b v = v) (h' : GrSpecies.par (R := R) b v' = v') :
    lgen v b h = lgen v' b h'
proof:
:= by
  subst e
  rfl

name: Operad.FreeGrL.homEquiv_symm_lgen
statement:
lemma homEquiv_symm_lgen (f : FreeGr.GenVal R (grGenPar R V) Q) {k : ℕ} (v : V (Fin k))
    (b : Bool) (h : GrSpecies.par (R := R) b v = v) :
    (FreeGr.homEquiv.symm f).app (Fin k) (lgen v b h) = f.1 k ⟨(v, b), h⟩
proof:
:=
  FreeGr.homEquiv_symm_gen f _

name: Operad.FreeGrL.val_congr
proof:
:= by
  subst e
  rfl

name: Operad.FreeGrL.par_val
statement:
lemma par_val (f : FreeGr.GenVal R (grGenPar R V) Q) {k : ℕ} (b' : Bool) (g : GrGen R V k) :
    GrOperad.par (R := R) b' (f.1 k g) = if b' = g.1.2 then f.1 k g else 0
proof:
:= by
  have h := f.2 k g
  conv_lhs => rw [← h]
  rw [GrOperad.par_par, h]
  rfl

name: Operad.FreeGrL.Kills.add
statement:
lemma Kills.add (hf : Kills f) {n : ℕ} {b : Bool} {v w : V (Fin n)}
    (hv : GrSpecies.par (R := R) b v = v) (hw : GrSpecies.par (R := R) b w = w)
    (h : GrSpecies.par (R := R) b (v + w) = v + w) :
    f.1 n ⟨(v + w, b), h⟩ = f.1 n ⟨(v, b), hv⟩ + f.1 n ⟨(w, b), hw⟩
proof:
:= by
  have := hf n _ (Or.inl (Or.inl ⟨b, v, w, hv, hw, rfl⟩))
  rwa [map_sub, map_sub, homEquiv_symm_lgen, homEquiv_symm_lgen, homEquiv_symm_lgen, sub_sub,
    sub_eq_zero] at this

name: Operad.FreeGrL.Kills.smul
proof:
:= by
  have := hf n _ (Or.inl (Or.inr ⟨b, c, v, hv, rfl⟩))
  rwa [map_sub, map_smul, homEquiv_symm_lgen, homEquiv_symm_lgen, sub_eq_zero] at this

name: Operad.FreeGrL.Kills.map
statement:
lemma Kills.map (hf : Kills f) {n : ℕ} {b : Bool} (σ : Fin n ≃ Fin n) {v : V (Fin n)}
    (hv : GrSpecies.par (R := R) b v = v)
    (h : GrSpecies.par (R := R) b (SymSpecies.map (R := R) σ v) = SymSpecies.map (R := R) σ v) :
    f.1 n ⟨(SymSpecies.map (R := R) σ v, b), h⟩
      = GrOperad.map (R := R) σ (f.1 n ⟨(v, b), hv⟩)
proof:
:= by
  have := hf n _ (Or.inr ⟨b, σ, v, hv, rfl⟩)
  rw [map_sub, GrOperadHom.app_map, homEquiv_symm_lgen, homEquiv_symm_lgen, sub_eq_zero] at this
  exact this.symm

name: Operad.FreeGrL.Kills.zero
statement:
lemma Kills.zero (hf : Kills f) {n : ℕ} {b : Bool}
    (h : GrSpecies.par (R := R) b (0 : V (Fin n)) = 0) : f.1 n ⟨(0, b), h⟩ = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [val_congr f (zero_smul R (0 : V (Fin n))).symm h (by rw [zero_smul]; exact h),
    hf.smul 0 h, zero_smul]

name: Operad.FreeGrL.Kills.part_add
statement:
lemma Kills.part_add (hf : Kills f) {n : ℕ} (b : Bool) (v w : V (Fin n)) :
    f.1 n (GrGen.part b (v + w)) = f.1 n (GrGen.part b v) + f.1 n (GrGen.part b w)
proof:
:=
  (val_congr f (map_add (GrSpecies.par (R := R) b) v w) _
    (by rw [map_add, GrSpecies.par_par_self, GrSpecies.par_par_self])).trans (hf.add _ _ _)

name: Operad.FreeGrL.Kills.part_smul
statement:
lemma Kills.part_smul (hf : Kills f) {n : ℕ} (b : Bool) (c : R) (v : V (Fin n)) :
    f.1 n (GrGen.part b (c • v)) = c • f.1 n (GrGen.part b v)
proof:
:=
  (val_congr f (map_smul (GrSpecies.par (R := R) b) c v) _
    (by rw [map_smul, GrSpecies.par_par_self])).trans (hf.smul c _ _)

name: Operad.FreeGrL.Kills.part_map
statement:
lemma Kills.part_map (hf : Kills f) {n : ℕ} (b : Bool) (σ : Fin n ≃ Fin n) (v : V (Fin n)) :
    f.1 n (GrGen.part b (SymSpecies.map (R := R) σ v))
      = GrOperad.map (R := R) σ (f.1 n (GrGen.part b v))
proof:
:=
  (val_congr f (GrSpecies.map_par σ b v).symm _
    (by rw [GrSpecies.map_par, GrSpecies.par_par_self])).trans (hf.map σ _ _)

name: Operad.FreeGrL.Kills.part_par
statement:
lemma Kills.part_par (hf : Kills f) {n : ℕ} (b b' : Bool) (v : V (Fin n)) :
    f.1 n (GrGen.part b (GrSpecies.par (R := R) b' v))
      = if b = b' then f.1 n (GrGen.part b v) else 0
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hb : b = b'
  · subst hb
    rw [if_pos rfl]
    exact val_congr f (GrSpecies.par_par_self b v) _ _
  · rw [if_neg hb]
    exact (val_congr f (GrSpecies.par_par_ne hb v) _ (map_zero _)).trans (hf.zero _)

name: Operad.FreeGrL.linOf_skel
statement: lemma linOf_skel (hf : Kills f) : GrSpeciesHom.Skel (linOf f hf)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun n σ v => ?_, fun n b v => ?_⟩
  · show f.1 n (GrGen.part false _) + f.1 n (GrGen.part true _)
      = GrOperad.map (R := R) σ (f.1 n (GrGen.part false v) + f.1 n (GrGen.part true v))
    rw [hf.part_map, hf.part_map, map_add]
  · show f.1 n (GrGen.part false _) + f.1 n (GrGen.part true _)
      = GrOperad.par (R := R) b (f.1 n (GrGen.part false v) + f.1 n (GrGen.part true v))
    rw [hf.part_par, hf.part_par, map_add, par_val, par_val]
    cases b <;> simp [GrGen.part]

name: Operad.FreeGrL.valOf_kills
statement:
lemma valOf_kills (F : {F : ∀ n : ℕ, V (Fin n) →ₗ[R] Q (Fin n) // GrSpeciesHom.Skel F}) :
    Kills (valOf F)
proof:
:= by
  rintro n x ((⟨b, v, w, hv, hw, rfl⟩ | ⟨b, c, v, hv, rfl⟩) | ⟨b, σ, v, hv, rfl⟩)
  · rw [map_sub, map_sub, homEquiv_symm_lgen, homEquiv_symm_lgen, homEquiv_symm_lgen]
    show F.1 n (v + w) - F.1 n v - F.1 n w = 0
    rw [map_add, sub_sub, sub_self]
  · rw [map_sub, map_smul, homEquiv_symm_lgen, homEquiv_symm_lgen]
    show F.1 n (c • v) - c • F.1 n v = 0
    rw [map_smul, sub_self]
  · rw [map_sub, GrOperadHom.app_map, homEquiv_symm_lgen, homEquiv_symm_lgen]
    show GrOperad.map (R := R) σ (F.1 n v) - F.1 n (SymSpecies.map (R := R) σ v) = 0
    rw [F.2.1, sub_eq_zero]
    rfl

name: Operad.FreeGrL.homEquiv_app_fin
statement:
lemma homEquiv_app_fin (φ : GrOperadHom R (FreeGrL R V) Q) {n : ℕ} (v : V (Fin n)) :
    (homEquiv φ).app (Fin n) v = φ.app (Fin n)
      (FreeGr.presGen (grLinRel R V) (GrGen.part false v)
        + FreeGr.presGen (grLinRel R V) (GrGen.part true v))
proof:
:= by
  rw [map_add]
  exact GrSpeciesHom.extend_app_fin (killsEquiv (FreeGr.presHomEquiv φ)).2 n v

name: Operad.FreeGrL.ι_app_fin
statement:
lemma ι_app_fin {n : ℕ} (v : V (Fin n)) :
    (ι R V).app (Fin n) v = FreeGr.presGen (grLinRel R V) (GrGen.part false v)
      + FreeGr.presGen (grLinRel R V) (GrGen.part true v)
proof:
:=
  homEquiv_app_fin _ v

name: Operad.FreeGrL.proj_rel
statement:
lemma proj_rel {n : ℕ} {x : FreeGr R (grGenPar R V) (Fin n)} (hx : x ∈ grLinRel R V n) :
    (GrOperadIdeal.span R (grLinRel R V)).proj (Fin n) x = 0
proof:
:=
  ((GrOperadIdeal.span R _).proj_eq_zero_iff x).2 (GrOperadIdeal.subset_span n hx)

name: Operad.FreeGrL.ι_app_hom
statement:
lemma ι_app_hom {n : ℕ} {v : V (Fin n)} {b : Bool} (h : GrSpecies.par (R := R) b v = v) :
    (ι R V).app (Fin n) v = FreeGr.presGen (grLinRel R V) (⟨(v, b), h⟩ : GrGen R V n)
proof:
:= by
  have hz : ∀ (b' : Bool) (h0 : GrSpecies.par (R := R) b' (0 : V (Fin n)) = 0),
      FreeGr.presGen (grLinRel R V) (⟨(0, b'), h0⟩ : GrGen R V n) = 0 := by
    intro b' h0
    have := proj_rel (Or.inl (Or.inl ⟨b', 0, 0, h0, h0, rfl⟩) : _ ∈ grLinRel R V n)
    rw [map_sub, map_sub, lgen_congr (add_zero (0 : V (Fin n))) _ h0, sub_self, zero_sub,
      neg_eq_zero] at this
    exact this
  have hp : ∀ b' : Bool, b' ≠ b → FreeGr.presGen (grLinRel R V) (GrGen.part b' v) = 0 := by
    intro b' hb
    have e : GrGen.part b' v = (⟨(0, b'), map_zero _⟩ : GrGen R V n) :=
      Subtype.ext (Prod.ext (by
        show GrSpecies.par (R := R) b' v = 0
        rw [← h, GrSpecies.par_par_ne hb]) rfl)
    rw [e, hz]
  have e : GrGen.part b v = (⟨(v, b), h⟩ : GrGen R V n) := Subtype.ext (Prod.ext h rfl)
  rw [ι_app_fin]
  cases b
  · rw [hp true (by decide), add_zero, e]
  · rw [hp false (by decide), zero_add, e]

name: Operad.FreeGrL.homEquiv_apply
statement:
lemma homEquiv_apply (φ : GrOperadHom R (FreeGrL R V) Q) {A : Type} [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A]
    (v : V A) : (homEquiv φ).app A v = φ.app A ((ι R V).app A v)
proof:
:= by
  rw [GrSpeciesHom.app_eq_chart (homEquiv φ) (Fintype.equivFin A).symm,
    GrSpeciesHom.app_eq_chart (ι R V) (Fintype.equivFin A).symm, homEquiv_app_fin, ι_app_fin]
  show _ = φ.app A (GrOperad.map (R := R) _ _)
  rw [φ.app_map]
  rfl

name: Operad.FreeGrL.homEquiv_symm_ι
statement:
@[simp] lemma homEquiv_symm_ι (F : GrSpeciesHom R V Q) {A : Type} [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A]
    (v : V A) : (homEquiv.symm F).app A ((ι R V).app A v) = F.app A v
proof:
:= by
  rw [← homEquiv_apply, Equiv.apply_symm_apply]

name: Operad.FreeGrL.hom_ext
proof:
:=
  homEquiv.injective (GrSpeciesHom.ext fun A _ _ v => by
    rw [homEquiv_apply, homEquiv_apply, h])

name: Operad.KK.der_X
statement: lemma der_X (u v : σ) : der c u (X v) = c u v
proof: := mkDerivation_X _ _ _

name: Operad.KK.brk_X
statement: lemma brk_X (g : MvPolynomial σ K) (u : σ) : brk c g (X u) = der c u g
proof: := mkDerivation_X _ _ _

name: Operad.KK.bracket_X_X
statement: @[simp] lemma bracket_X_X (u v : σ) : bracket c (X u) (X v) = c u v
proof:
:= by
  rw [bracket, brk_X, der_X]

name: Operad.KK.bracket_X_left
statement: lemma bracket_X_left (u : σ) (g : MvPolynomial σ K) : bracket c (X u) g = der c u g
proof:
:=
  brk_X c g u

name: Operad.KK.brk_add
statement: lemma brk_add (g₁ g₂ : MvPolynomial σ K) : brk c (g₁ + g₂) = brk c g₁ + brk c g₂
proof:
:=
  derivation_ext fun u => by
    rw [Derivation.add_apply, brk_X, brk_X, brk_X, map_add]

name: Operad.KK.brk_smul
statement: lemma brk_smul (a : K) (g : MvPolynomial σ K) : brk c (a • g) = a • brk c g
proof:
:=
  derivation_ext fun u => by
    rw [Derivation.smul_apply, brk_X, brk_X, Derivation.map_smul]

name: Operad.KK.brk_mul
statement: lemma brk_mul (g₁ g₂ : MvPolynomial σ K) : brk c (g₁ * g₂) = g₁ • brk c g₂ + g₂ • brk c g₁
proof:
:=
  derivation_ext fun u => by
    rw [Derivation.add_apply, Derivation.smul_apply, Derivation.smul_apply, brk_X, brk_X, brk_X,
      Derivation.leibniz]

name: Operad.KK.brk_C
statement: lemma brk_C (a : K) : brk c (C a) = 0
proof:
:=
  derivation_ext fun u => by
    rw [brk_X, Derivation.zero_apply, ← algebraMap_eq, Derivation.map_algebraMap]

name: Operad.KK.bracket_add_left
statement:
lemma bracket_add_left (f₁ f₂ g : MvPolynomial σ K) :
    bracket c (f₁ + f₂) g = bracket c f₁ g + bracket c f₂ g
proof: := map_add _ _ _

name: Operad.KK.bracket_add_right
statement:
lemma bracket_add_right (f g₁ g₂ : MvPolynomial σ K) :
    bracket c f (g₁ + g₂) = bracket c f g₁ + bracket c f g₂
proof:
:= by
  rw [bracket, brk_add, Derivation.add_apply]
  rfl

name: Operad.KK.bracket_smul_left
statement:
lemma bracket_smul_left (a : K) (f g : MvPolynomial σ K) :
    bracket c (a • f) g = a • bracket c f g
proof: := Derivation.map_smul _ _ _

name: Operad.KK.bracket_smul_right
statement:
lemma bracket_smul_right (a : K) (f g : MvPolynomial σ K) :
    bracket c f (a • g) = a • bracket c f g
proof:
:= by
  rw [bracket, brk_smul, Derivation.smul_apply]
  rfl

name: Operad.KK.bracket_sub_right
statement:
lemma bracket_sub_right (f g₁ g₂ : MvPolynomial σ K) :
    bracket c f (g₁ - g₂) = bracket c f g₁ - bracket c f g₂
proof:
:= by
  rw [sub_eq_add_neg, bracket_add_right, ← neg_one_smul K g₂, bracket_smul_right, neg_one_smul,
    ← sub_eq_add_neg]

name: Operad.KK.bracket_mul_left
statement:
lemma bracket_mul_left (f₁ f₂ g : MvPolynomial σ K) :
    bracket c (f₁ * f₂) g = f₁ * bracket c f₂ g + f₂ * bracket c f₁ g
proof:
:=
  Derivation.leibniz _ _ _

name: Operad.KK.bracket_mul_right
statement:
lemma bracket_mul_right (f g₁ g₂ : MvPolynomial σ K) :
    bracket c f (g₁ * g₂) = g₁ * bracket c f g₂ + g₂ * bracket c f g₁
proof:
:= by
  rw [bracket, brk_mul, Derivation.add_apply, Derivation.smul_apply, Derivation.smul_apply]
  rfl

name: Operad.KK.bracket_C_right
statement: lemma bracket_C_right (f : MvPolynomial σ K) (a : K) : bracket c f (C a) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [bracket, brk_C, Derivation.zero_apply]

name: Operad.KK.bracket_C_left
statement: lemma bracket_C_left (a : K) (g : MvPolynomial σ K) : bracket c (C a) g = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [bracket, ← algebraMap_eq, Derivation.map_algebraMap]

name: Operad.KK.bracket_zero_right
statement: lemma bracket_zero_right (f : MvPolynomial σ K) : bracket c f 0 = 0
proof:
:= by
  simpa using bracket_C_right c f 0

name: Operad.KK.bracket_X_right
statement:
lemma bracket_X_right (hc : ∀ u v, c u v = -c v u) (f : MvPolynomial σ K) (v : σ) :
    bracket c f (X v) = -der c v f
proof:
:= by
  have h : brk c (X v) = -der c v := derivation_ext fun u => by
    rw [brk_X, der_X, Derivation.neg_apply, der_X, hc]
  rw [bracket, h, Derivation.neg_apply]

name: Operad.KK.bracket_antisymm
statement:
theorem bracket_antisymm (hc : ∀ u v, c u v = -c v u) (f g : MvPolynomial σ K) :
    bracket c f g = -bracket c g f
proof:
:= by
  induction g using MvPolynomial.induction_on with
  | C a => rw [bracket_C_right, bracket_C_left, neg_zero]
  | add p q hp hq => rw [bracket_add_right, bracket_add_left, hp, hq, neg_add]
  | mul_X p v hp =>
    rw [bracket_mul_right, bracket_mul_left, hp, bracket_X_right hc, bracket_X_left]
    ring

name: Operad.KK.jac_cycle
statement: lemma jac_cycle (f g h : MvPolynomial σ K) : jac c f g h = jac c g h f
proof:
:= by
  rw [jac, jac]
  abel

name: Operad.KK.jac_add
statement:
lemma jac_add (f₁ f₂ g h : MvPolynomial σ K) :
    jac c (f₁ + f₂) g h = jac c f₁ g h + jac c f₂ g h
proof:
:= by
  simp only [jac, bracket_add_left, bracket_add_right]
  abel

name: Operad.KK.jac_C
statement: lemma jac_C (a : K) (g h : MvPolynomial σ K) : jac c (C a) g h = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp only [jac, bracket_C_left, bracket_C_right, bracket_zero_right, add_zero]

name: Operad.KK.jac_mul
statement:
lemma jac_mul (hc : ∀ u v, c u v = -c v u) (f₁ f₂ g h : MvPolynomial σ K) :
    jac c (f₁ * f₂) g h = f₁ * jac c f₂ g h + f₂ * jac c f₁ g h
proof:
:= by
  simp only [jac, bracket_mul_left, bracket_mul_right, bracket_add_right]
  have e1 := bracket_antisymm hc f₂ g
  have e2 := bracket_antisymm hc f₁ g
  linear_combination bracket c h f₁ * e1 + bracket c h f₂ * e2

name: Operad.KK.jacobi
statement:
theorem jacobi (hc : ∀ u v, c u v = -c v u)
    (hJ : ∀ u v w, jac c (X u) (X v) (X w) = 0) (f g h : MvPolynomial σ K) :
    jac c f g h = 0
proof:
:= by
  
  have h3 : ∀ u v (h : MvPolynomial σ K), jac c (X u) (X v) h = 0 := fun u v h => by
    rw [jac_cycle, jac_cycle]
    induction h using MvPolynomial.induction_on with
    | C a => exact jac_C a _ _
    | add p q hp hq => rw [jac_add, hp, hq, add_zero]
    | mul_X p w hp => rw [jac_mul hc, hp, hJ, mul_zero, mul_zero, add_zero]
  have h2 : ∀ u (g h : MvPolynomial σ K), jac c (X u) g h = 0 := fun u g h => by
    rw [jac_cycle]
    induction g using MvPolynomial.induction_on generalizing h with
    | C a => exact jac_C a _ _
    | add p q hp hq => rw [jac_add, hp, hq, add_zero]
    | mul_X p v hp =>
      rw [jac_mul hc, hp, ← jac_cycle, h3, mul_zero, mul_zero, add_zero]
  induction f using MvPolynomial.induction_on generalizing g h with
  | C a => exact jac_C a _ _
  | add p q hp hq => rw [jac_add, hp, hq, add_zero]
  | mul_X p u hp => rw [jac_mul hc, hp, h2, mul_zero, mul_zero, add_zero]

name: Operad.KK.poisAlg_mul
statement:
lemma poisAlg_mul (hc : ∀ u v, c u v = -c v u) (hJ : ∀ u v w, jac c (X u) (X v) (X w) = 0)
    (x y : MvPolynomial σ K) : (poisAlg hc hJ).mul ![x, y] = x * y
proof:
:=
  FreeBin.bilinOp_apply K _ x y

name: Operad.KK.poisAlg_bracket
statement:
lemma poisAlg_bracket (hc : ∀ u v, c u v = -c v u)
    (hJ : ∀ u v w, jac c (X u) (X v) (X w) = 0) (x y : MvPolynomial σ K) :
    (poisAlg hc hJ).bracket ![x, y] = bracket c x y
proof:
:=
  FreeBin.bilinOp_apply K _ x y

name: Operad.KK.wordBracket_antisymm
statement: lemma wordBracket_antisymm (u v : List ℕ) : wordBracket K u v = -wordBracket K v u
proof:
:= by
  rw [wordBracket, wordBracket, neg_sub]

name: Operad.KK.wordBracket_jac
statement:
lemma wordBracket_jac (u v w : List ℕ) :
    jac (wordBracket K) (X u) (X v) (X w) = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp only [jac, bracket_X_X, wordBracket, bracket_sub_right, List.append_assoc]
  abel

name: Operad.BVGer.Rl_perm
statement:
lemma Rl_perm {l l' : List A} (h : l.Perm l') :
    ∃ c : R, ∀ x : BVOp R A, Rl R l x = c • Rl R l' x
proof:
:= by
  induction h with
  | nil => exact ⟨1, fun x => (one_smul _ _).symm⟩
  | cons a _ ih =>
    obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := ih
    exact ⟨c, fun x => by rw [Rl_cons, Rl_cons, hc, map_smul]⟩
  | swap a b l =>
    by_cases hab : b = a
    · subst hab
      exact ⟨1, fun x => (one_smul _ _).symm⟩
    · exact ⟨-1, fun x => by
        rw [Rl_cons, Rl_cons, Rl_cons, Rl_cons, rcomp_rcomp_ne _ (par_DB R) hab, neg_one_smul]⟩
  | trans _ _ ih₁ ih₂ =>
    obtain ⟨c₁, h₁⟩ := ih₁
    obtain ⟨c₂, h₂⟩ := ih₂
    exact ⟨c₁ * c₂, fun x => by rw [h₁, h₂, smul_smul]⟩

name: Operad.BVGer.Rl_toFinset
statement:
lemma Rl_toFinset : ∀ l : List A, ∃ c : R, ∀ x : BVOp R A, Rl R l x = c • Rl R l.toFinset.toList x
  | [] => ⟨1, fun x => by simp [Rl_nil]⟩
  | a :: l => by
    obtain ⟨c, hc⟩
proof:
:= Rl_toFinset l
    by_cases ha : a ∈ l
    · have hm : a ∈ l.toFinset.toList := by simpa using ha
      obtain ⟨c', hc'⟩ := Rl_perm (R := R) (List.perm_cons_erase hm)
      refine ⟨0, fun x => ?_⟩
      rw [Rl_cons, hc, map_smul, hc', map_smul, Rl_cons,
        rcomp_rcomp_self _ (DB_DB R), smul_zero, smul_zero, zero_smul]
    · have hp : (a :: l.toFinset.toList).Perm (a :: l).toFinset.toList := by
        refine (List.perm_ext_iff_of_nodup ?_ (Finset.nodup_toList _)).2 fun b => ?_
        · exact List.nodup_cons.2 ⟨by simpa using ha, Finset.nodup_toList _⟩
        · simp
      obtain ⟨c', hc'⟩ := Rl_perm (R := R) hp
      exact ⟨c * c', fun x => by rw [Rl_cons, hc, map_smul, ← Rl_cons, hc', smul_smul]⟩

name: Operad.BVGer.spanMap_single
statement:
lemma spanMap_single (s : Finset A) (q : GerOp K A) :
    spanMap K A (Pi.single s q) = Rl K s.toList ((gerToBV K).app A q)
proof:
:= by
  rw [spanMap, LinearMap.coe_sum, Finset.sum_apply, Finset.sum_eq_single s]
  · simp
  · intro t _ ht
    simp [ht]
  · intro h
    exact absurd (Finset.mem_univ s) h

name: Operad.BVGer.spanMap_surjective
statement: theorem spanMap_surjective : Function.Surjective (spanMap K A)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← LinearMap.range_eq_top, eq_top_iff]
  intro x _
  refine (Submodule.span_le.2 ?_ : SB K A ≤ LinearMap.range (spanMap K A)) (mem_SB x)
  rintro _ ⟨l, q, -, -, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := Rl_toFinset (R := K) l
  refine ⟨Pi.single l.toFinset (c • q), ?_⟩
  rw [spanMap_single, map_smul, map_smul, hc]

name: Operad.BVGer.finite_finrank_le
statement:
theorem finite_finrank_le [Nonempty A] :
    Module.Finite K (BVOp K A) ∧
      Module.finrank K (BVOp K A) ≤ 2 ^ Fintype.card A * (Fintype.card A).factorial
proof:
:= by
  haveI : Module.Finite K (GerOp K A) := Module.finite_of_finrank_pos (by
    rw [GerDim.finrank_ger_eq K A]
    exact Nat.factorial_pos _)
  haveI : Module.Finite K (BVOp K A) := Module.Finite.of_surjective _ (spanMap_surjective K A)
  refine ⟨inferInstance, ?_⟩
  have h := LinearMap.finrank_range_le (spanMap K A)
  rw [LinearMap.range_eq_top.2 (spanMap_surjective K A), finrank_top,
    Module.finrank_pi_fintype, Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_finset,
    GerDim.finrank_ger_eq K A, smul_eq_mul] at h
  exact h

name: Operad.SymGr.par_false
statement:
@[simp] lemma SymGr.par_false {A : Type} [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] (x : SymGr Q A) :
    SymGr.par (R := R) Q false x = x
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.SymGr.par_true
statement:
@[simp] lemma SymGr.par_true {A : Type} [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] (x : SymGr Q A) :

name: Operad.SymGr.grPar

@[simp] lemma SymGr.grPar (b : Bool) {A : Type} [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] (x : SymGr Q A) :

name: Operad.GrOperadHom.toSymOfEven_app
statement:
@[simp] lemma GrOperadHom.toSymOfEven_app (φ : GrOperadHom R P (SymGr Q)) {A : Type} [Fintype A]
    [DecidableEq A] (x : GrOperad.EvenOp R P A) : φ.toSymOfEven.app A x = φ.app A x.val
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.GrOperad.EvenOp.par_false_val
statement:
lemma GrOperad.EvenOp.par_false_val {A : Type} [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A]
    (x : GrOperad.EvenOp R P A) : GrOperad.par (R := R) false x.val = x.val
proof:
:= by
  have e := GrOperad.par_add (R := R) x.val
  rwa [(GrOperad.mem_evenSub x.val).1 x.2, add_zero] at e

name: Operad.GrOperad.EvenOp.par_true_val
statement:
lemma GrOperad.EvenOp.par_true_val {A : Type} [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A]

name: Operad.SymOperadHom.toGrEven_app
statement:
@[simp] lemma SymOperadHom.toGrEven_app (ψ : SymOperadHom R Q (GrOperad.EvenOp R P))
    {A : Type} [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] (x : SymGr Q A) :
    ψ.toGrEven.app A x = (ψ.app A x).val
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.GrSpecies.par_false_of_isEven
statement:
lemma par_false_of_isEven (hV : IsEven R V) {A : Type} [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] (v : V A) :
    GrSpecies.par (R := R) false v = v
proof:
:= by
  have e := GrSpecies.par_add (R := R) v
  rwa [hV A v, add_zero] at e

name: Operad.FreeGrL.toFreeL_ι
statement:
@[simp] lemma toFreeL_ι {A : Type} [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] (v : E A) :
    (toFreeL hE).app A ((ι R E).app A v) = (FreeL.ι R E).app A v
proof:
:=
  homEquiv_symm_ι _ v

name: Operad.FreeGrL.ofFreeL_ι_val
statement:
@[simp] lemma ofFreeL_ι_val {A : Type} [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] (v : E A) :
    ((ofFreeL hE).app A ((FreeL.ι R E).app A v)).val = (ι R E).app A v
proof:
:= by
  rw [ofFreeL, FreeL.homEquiv_symm_ι]
  rfl

name: Operad.FreeGrL.ofFreeL_toFreeL
statement: theorem ofFreeL_toFreeL : (ofFreeL hE).toGrEven.comp (toFreeL hE) = GrOperadHom.id R _
proof:
:=
  hom_ext fun A _ _ v => by
    rw [GrOperadHom.comp_app, toFreeL_ι, SymOperadHom.toGrEven_app, ofFreeL_ι_val]
    rfl

name: Operad.FreeGrL.toFreeL_ofFreeL
statement: theorem toFreeL_ofFreeL : (toFreeL hE).toSymOfEven.comp (ofFreeL hE) = SymOperadHom.id
proof:
:=
  FreeL.hom_ext fun A _ _ v => by
    rw [SymOperadHom.comp_app, GrOperadHom.toSymOfEven_app, ofFreeL_ι_val, toFreeL_ι]
    rfl

name: Operad.FreeGrL.ofFreeL_toFreeL_app
statement:
lemma ofFreeL_toFreeL_app {A : Type} [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] (x : FreeGrL R E A) :
    ((ofFreeL hE).app A ((toFreeL hE).app A x)).val = x
proof:
:=
  congrArg (fun φ : GrOperadHom R (FreeGrL R E) (FreeGrL R E) => φ.app A x) (ofFreeL_toFreeL hE)

name: Operad.FreeGrL.toFreeL_ofFreeL_app
statement:
lemma toFreeL_ofFreeL_app {A : Type} [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] (y : FreeL R E A) :
    (toFreeL hE).app A ((ofFreeL hE).app A y).val = y
proof:
:=
  congrArg (fun φ : SymOperadHom R (FreeL R E) (FreeL R E) => φ.app A y) (toFreeL_ofFreeL hE)

name: Operad.FreeGrL.evenFreeLHom_bijective
statement:
theorem evenFreeLHom_bijective (A : Type) [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] :
    Function.Bijective ((evenFreeLHom hE).app A)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun x y h => GrOperad.EvenOp.ext ?_, fun y => ⟨(ofFreeL hE).app A y, ?_⟩⟩
  · have hx := ofFreeL_toFreeL_app hE x.val
    have hy := ofFreeL_toFreeL_app hE y.val
    have h' : (toFreeL hE).app A x.val = (toFreeL hE).app A y.val := h
    rw [← hx, ← hy, h']
  · exact toFreeL_ofFreeL_app hE y

name: Operad.STree.wk_leaf
statement: @[simp] lemma wk_leaf (xs : ℕ → STree E) (a : ℕ) : wk xs (leaf a) = ∅
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.STree.wk_node
statement:
lemma wk_node (xs : ℕ → STree E) {k : ℕ} (e : E k) (c : Fin k → STree E) :
    wk xs (node e c) =
      insert (key ((node e c).subst xs)) (Finset.univ.biUnion fun i => wk xs (c i))
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.STree.nwk_node
statement:
lemma nwk_node (xs : ℕ → STree E) {k : ℕ} (e : E k) (c : Fin k → STree E) :
    nwk xs (node e c) = Finset.univ.biUnion fun i => wk xs (c i)
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.STree.cutKeys_subset_of_get?
statement:
theorem cutKeys_subset_of_get? : ∀ {T Y : STree (BE E)} {p : List ℕ}, T.get? p = some Y →
    cutKeys Y ⊆ cutKeys T
  | T, Y, [], h => by
    rw [get?_nil, Option.some_inj] at h
    rw [h]
  | leaf _, _, _ :: _, h => by simp at h
  | node d c, Y, i :: p, h => by
    obtain ⟨hi, h⟩
proof:
:= get?_node_cons_eq_some.1 h
    intro y hy
    exact mem_cutKeys_node.2 (Or.inr ⟨⟨i, hi⟩, cutKeys_subset_of_get? h hy⟩)

name: Operad.STree.mem_vkeys_of_get?
statement:
lemma mem_vkeys_of_get? : ∀ {T Y : STree (BE E)} {p : List ℕ}, T.get? p = some Y →
    Y.vkeys ≤ T.vkeys
  | T, Y, [], h => by
    rw [get?_nil, Option.some_inj] at h
    rw [h]
  | leaf _, _, _ :: _, h => by simp at h
  | node d c, Y, i :: p, h => by
    obtain ⟨hi, h⟩
proof:
:= get?_node_cons_eq_some.1 h
    refine (mem_vkeys_of_get? h).trans ?_
    rw [vkeys_node]
    exact (Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun j => (c j).vkeys) (fun _ _ => Multiset.zero_le _)
      (Finset.mem_univ _)).trans (Multiset.le_cons_self _ _)

name: Operad.STree.nodup_vkeys_children
statement:
lemma nodup_vkeys_children {k : ℕ} {d : BE E k} {c : Fin k → STree (BE E)}
    (hn : (node d c).vkeys.Nodup) :
    key (node d c) ∉ ∑ i, (c i).vkeys ∧ (∀ i, (c i).vkeys.Nodup) ∧
      ∀ i j, i ≠ j → Disjoint (c i).vkeys (c j).vkeys
proof:
:= by
  rw [vkeys_node, Multiset.nodup_cons] at hn
  refine ⟨hn.1, fun i => Multiset.nodup_of_le (Finset.single_le_sum
    (f := fun j => (c j).vkeys) (fun _ _ => Multiset.zero_le _) (Finset.mem_univ i)) hn.2,
    fun i j hij => ?_⟩
  have hle : (c i).vkeys + (c j).vkeys ≤ ∑ l, (c l).vkeys := by
    rw [← Finset.sum_pair (f := fun l => (c l).vkeys) hij]
    exact Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg (Finset.subset_univ _)
      fun _ _ _ => Multiset.zero_le _
  exact (Multiset.nodup_add.1 (Multiset.nodup_of_le hle hn.2)).2.2

name: Operad.STree.mem_cutKeys_of_get?
statement:
theorem mem_cutKeys_of_get? : ∀ {T Y : STree (BE E)} {p : List ℕ}, T.vkeys.Nodup →
    T.get? p = some Y → ∀ {y : ℕ ×ₗ ℕ}, y ∈ cutKeys T → y ∈ Y.vkeys → y ∈ cutKeys Y
  | T, Y, [], _, h, _, hy, _ => by
    rw [get?_nil, Option.some_inj] at h
    rwa [← h]
  | leaf _, _, _ :: _, _, h, _, _, _ => by simp at h
  | node d c, Y, i :: p, hn, h, y, hy, hyY => by
    obtain ⟨hi, h⟩
proof:
:= get?_node_cons_eq_some.1 h
    obtain ⟨hroot, hnc, hdisj⟩ := nodup_vkeys_children hn
    have hyc : y ∈ (c ⟨i, hi⟩).vkeys := Multiset.mem_of_le (mem_vkeys_of_get? h) hyY
    rcases mem_cutKeys_node.1 hy with ⟨-, rfl⟩ | ⟨j, hj⟩
    · exact absurd ((Multiset.mem_sum (s := Finset.univ)).2 ⟨⟨i, hi⟩, Finset.mem_univ _, hyc⟩)
        hroot
    · by_cases hij : j = ⟨i, hi⟩
      · subst hij
        exact mem_cutKeys_of_get? (hnc _) h hj hyY
      · exact absurd hyc (Multiset.disjoint_left.1 (hdisj j _ hij) (mem_vkeys_of_mem_cutKeys hj))

name: Operad.STree.wk_props
statement:
theorem wk_props : ∀ (g : STree E) (F : ℕ → STree (BE E)),
    ((allF g).subst F).vkeys.Nodup → ∀ y ∈ wk (fun a => forget (F a)) g,
      y ∈ ((allF g).subst F).vkeys ∧ y ∉ cutKeys ((allF g).subst F)
  | leaf _, _, _, y, hy => absurd hy (Finset.notMem_empty _)
  | node e c, F, hn, y, hy => by
    rw [allF_node, subst_node] at hn ⊢
    obtain ⟨hroot, hnc, hdisj⟩
proof:
:= nodup_vkeys_children hn
    have hf : forget (node (e, false) fun i => (allF (c i)).subst F) =
        (node e c).subst fun a => forget (F a) := by
      rw [forget_node, subst_node]
      congr 1
      funext i
      rw [forget_subst, forget_allF]
    have hkey : key ((node e c).subst fun a => forget (F a)) =
        key (node (e, false) fun i => (allF (c i)).subst F) := by
      rw [← hf, key_forget]
    rw [wk_node, Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_biUnion] at hy
    rcases hy with rfl | ⟨i, -, hi⟩
    · rw [hkey]
      refine ⟨mem_vkeys_node.2 (Or.inl rfl), fun h => ?_⟩
      rcases mem_cutKeys_node.1 h with ⟨h, -⟩ | ⟨j, hj⟩
      · exact Bool.false_ne_true h
      · exact hroot ((Multiset.mem_sum (s := Finset.univ)).2
          ⟨j, Finset.mem_univ _, mem_vkeys_of_mem_cutKeys hj⟩)
    · obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := wk_props (c i) F (hnc i) y hi
      refine ⟨mem_vkeys_node.2 (Or.inr ⟨i, h1⟩), fun h => ?_⟩
      rcases mem_cutKeys_node.1 h with ⟨-, rfl⟩ | ⟨j, hj⟩
      · exact hroot ((Multiset.mem_sum (s := Finset.univ)).2 ⟨i, Finset.mem_univ _, h1⟩)
      · by_cases hij : j = i
        · subst hij
          exact h2 hj
        · exact Multiset.disjoint_left.1 (hdisj j i hij) (mem_vkeys_of_mem_cutKeys hj) h1

name: Operad.STree.exists_glue
statement:
lemma exists_glue {k : ℕ} {e : E k} {c : Fin k → STree E} (hn : (node e c).labels.Nodup)
    (F : Fin k → ℕ → STree (BE E)) :
    ∃ G : ℕ → STree (BE E), ∀ i, ∀ a ∈ (c i).labels, G a = F i a
proof:
:= by
  classical
  refine ⟨fun a => if h : ∃ i, a ∈ (c i).labels then F h.choose a else leaf a, fun i a ha => ?_⟩
  have h : ∃ i, a ∈ (c i).labels := ⟨i, ha⟩
  dsimp only
  rw [dif_pos h]
  by_cases hi : h.choose = i
  · rw [hi]
  · exact absurd ha (not_mem_of_node hn hi h.choose_spec)

name: Operad.STree.node_injective_forget
proof:
:= by
  rw [forget_node] at h
  injection h with hk he hc
  subst hk
  exact ⟨rfl, eq_of_heq he, fun i => congrFun (eq_of_heq hc) i⟩

name: Operad.STree.lift_allF
statement:
theorem lift_allF : ∀ (g : STree E) (Y : STree (BE E)) (xs₀ : ℕ → STree E), g.labels.Nodup →
    forget Y = g.subst xs₀ → (∀ y ∈ wk xs₀ g, y ∉ cutKeys Y) →
    ∃ F : ℕ → STree (BE E), Y = (allF g).subst F ∧ ∀ a ∈ g.labels, forget (F a) = xs₀ a
  | leaf a, Y, xs₀, _, hY, _ => ⟨fun _ => Y, rfl, fun b hb => by
      rw [labels_leaf, Multiset.mem_singleton] at hb
      subst hb
      exact hY⟩
  | node e c, Y, xs₀, hn, hY, hcut => by
    cases Y with
    | leaf a => cases hY
    | node d c' =>
      rw [subst_node] at hY
      obtain ⟨hk, hd, hc⟩
proof:
:= node_injective_forget hY
      subst hk
      have hd2 : d.2 = false := by
        cases hd2 : d.2
        · rfl
        · refine absurd (mem_cutKeys_node.2 (Or.inl ⟨hd2, rfl⟩)) (hcut _ ?_)
          rw [wk_node, ← key_forget, hY, ← subst_node]
          exact Finset.mem_insert_self _ _
      have hcut' : ∀ i, ∀ y ∈ wk xs₀ (c i), y ∉ cutKeys (c' i) := fun i y hy h =>
        hcut y (by
          rw [wk_node]
          exact Finset.mem_insert_of_mem (Finset.mem_biUnion.2 ⟨i, Finset.mem_univ _, hy⟩))
          (mem_cutKeys_node.2 (Or.inr ⟨i, h⟩))
      choose F hF hF' using fun i =>
        lift_allF (c i) (c' i) xs₀ (nodup_of_node hn i) (hc i) (hcut' i)
      obtain ⟨G, hG⟩ := exists_glue hn F
      refine ⟨G, ?_, fun a ha => ?_⟩
      · obtain ⟨d₁, d₂⟩ := d
        simp only at hd hd2
        subst hd hd2
        rw [allF_node, subst_node]
        congr 1
        funext i
        rw [hF i]
        exact subst_congr _ fun a ha => (hG i a (by rwa [labels_allF] at ha)).symm
      · obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := mem_labels_node.1 ha
        rw [hG i a hi]
        exact hF' i a hi

name: Operad.STree.lift_fl
statement:
theorem lift_fl {k : ℕ} (e : E k) (c : Fin k → STree E) (Y : STree (BE E)) (xs₀ : ℕ → STree E)
    (hn : (node e c).labels.Nodup) (hY : forget Y = (node e c).subst xs₀)
    (hcut : ∀ y ∈ nwk xs₀ (node e c), y ∉ cutKeys Y) :
    ∃ F : ℕ → STree (BE E), Y = (fl (rootF Y) (node e c)).subst F ∧
      ∀ a ∈ (node e c).labels, forget (F a) = xs₀ a
proof:
:= by
  cases Y with
  | leaf a => cases hY
  | node d c' =>
    rw [subst_node] at hY
    obtain ⟨hk, hd, hc⟩ := node_injective_forget hY
    subst hk
    have hcut' : ∀ i, ∀ y ∈ wk xs₀ (c i), y ∉ cutKeys (c' i) := fun i y hy h =>
      hcut y (by rw [nwk_node]; exact Finset.mem_biUnion.2 ⟨i, Finset.mem_univ _, hy⟩)
        (mem_cutKeys_node.2 (Or.inr ⟨i, h⟩))
    choose F hF hF' using fun i =>
      lift_allF (c i) (c' i) xs₀ (nodup_of_node hn i) (hc i) (hcut' i)
    obtain ⟨G, hG⟩ := exists_glue hn F
    refine ⟨G, ?_, fun a ha => ?_⟩
    · obtain ⟨d₁, d₂⟩ := d
      simp only at hd
      subst hd
      rw [fl_node, subst_node]
      congr 1
      funext i
      rw [hF i]
      exact subst_congr _ fun a ha => (hG i a (by rwa [labels_allF] at ha)).symm
    · obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := mem_labels_node.1 ha
      rw [hG i a hi]
      exact hF' i a hi

name: Operad.STree.weight_eq_zero_iff
statement: lemma weight_eq_zero_iff {t : STree E} : t.weight = 0 ↔ ∃ a, t = leaf a
proof:
:= by
  cases t with
  | leaf a => exact ⟨fun _ => ⟨a, rfl⟩, fun _ => rfl⟩
  | node e c =>
    simp only [weight_node, reduceCtorEq, exists_const, iff_false]
    omega

name: Operad.STree.wk_of_weight_one
statement:
lemma wk_of_weight_one (xs : ℕ → STree E) {g : STree E} (hg : g.weight = 1) :
    wk xs g = {key (g.subst xs)}
proof:
:= by
  cases g with
  | leaf a => simp at hg
  | node f d =>
    rw [weight_node] at hg
    have h0 : ∀ l, (d l).weight = 0 := fun l => by
      have := Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun j => (d j).weight) (fun _ _ => Nat.zero_le _)
        (Finset.mem_univ l)
      simp only at this
      omega
    have hb : (Finset.univ.biUnion fun l => wk xs (d l)) = ∅ :=
      Finset.eq_empty_of_forall_notMem fun y hy => by
        obtain ⟨l, -, hl⟩ := Finset.mem_biUnion.1 hy
        obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := weight_eq_zero_iff.1 (h0 l)
        rw [ha, wk_leaf] at hl
        exact Finset.notMem_empty _ hl
    rw [wk_node, hb]
    rfl

name: Operad.STree.nwk_eq_singleton
statement:
theorem nwk_eq_singleton (xs : ℕ → STree E) {L : STree E} (hL : L.weight = 2) :
    ∃ y, nwk xs L = {y}
proof:
:= by
  cases L with
  | leaf a => simp at hL
  | @node k e c =>
    rw [weight_node] at hL
    have hsum : ∑ i, (c i).weight = 1 := by omega
    obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ : ∃ i, (c i).weight ≠ 0 := by
      by_contra h
      push Not at h
      rw [Finset.sum_eq_zero fun i _ => h i] at hsum
      exact absurd hsum (by norm_num)
    have hrest : ∑ j ∈ Finset.univ.erase i, (c j).weight = 1 - (c i).weight := by
      rw [← Finset.add_sum_erase _ _ (Finset.mem_univ i)] at hsum
      omega
    have hi1 : (c i).weight = 1 := by
      have := Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun j => (c j).weight) (fun _ _ => Nat.zero_le _)
        (Finset.mem_univ i)
      simp only at this
      omega
    have hj : ∀ j, j ≠ i → (c j).weight = 0 := fun j hj => by
      rw [hi1, Nat.sub_self] at hrest
      exact (Finset.sum_eq_zero_iff.1 hrest) j (Finset.mem_erase.2 ⟨hj, Finset.mem_univ _⟩)
    refine ⟨key ((c i).subst xs), ?_⟩
    rw [nwk_node]
    ext y
    simp only [Finset.mem_biUnion, Finset.mem_univ, true_and, Finset.mem_singleton]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨j, hy⟩
      by_cases hji : j = i
      · subst hji
        rwa [wk_of_weight_one xs hi1, Finset.mem_singleton] at hy
      · obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := weight_eq_zero_iff.1 (hj j hji)
        rw [ha, wk_leaf] at hy
        exact absurd hy (Finset.notMem_empty _)
    · rintro rfl
      exact ⟨i, by rw [wk_of_weight_one xs hi1]; exact Finset.mem_singleton_self _⟩

name: Operad.STree.card_vkeys
statement:
lemma card_vkeys : ∀ t : STree E, Multiset.card t.vkeys = t.weight
  | leaf _ => rfl
  | node e c => by
    rw [vkeys_node, Multiset.card_cons, Multiset.card_sum, weight_node, add_comm,
      Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => card_vkeys (c i)]

name: Operad.STree.card_edgeKeys
statement: lemma card_edgeKeys {t : STree E} (hn : t.vkeys.Nodup) : t.edgeKeys.card = t.weight - 1
proof:
:= by
  cases t with
  | leaf a => rfl
  | node e c =>
    rw [vkeys_node, Multiset.nodup_cons] at hn
    rw [edgeKeys_node, Multiset.card_toFinset, Multiset.dedup_eq_self.2 hn.2, Multiset.card_sum,
      weight_node]
    rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => card_vkeys (c i)]
    omega

name: Operad.STree.edgeKeys_subset_vkeys
statement: lemma edgeKeys_subset_vkeys {t : STree E} {y : ℕ ×ₗ ℕ} (hy : y ∈ t.edgeKeys) : y ∈ t.vkeys
proof:
:= by
  cases t with
  | leaf a => exact absurd hy (Finset.notMem_empty _)
  | node e c =>
    rw [edgeKeys_node, Multiset.mem_toFinset] at hy
    exact Multiset.mem_cons_of_mem hy

name: Operad.STree.key_notMem_edgeKeys
statement: lemma key_notMem_edgeKeys {t : STree E} (hn : t.vkeys.Nodup) : t.key ∉ t.edgeKeys
proof:
:= by
  cases t with
  | leaf a => exact Finset.notMem_empty _
  | node e c =>
    rw [vkeys_node, Multiset.nodup_cons] at hn
    rw [edgeKeys_node, Multiset.mem_toFinset]
    exact hn.1

name: Operad.STree.cutKeys_subset_edgeKeys
statement:
lemma cutKeys_subset_edgeKeys {t : STree (BE E)} (h : rootF t = false) :
    cutKeys t ⊆ t.edgeKeys
proof:
:= by
  cases t with
  | leaf a => exact Finset.empty_subset _
  | node d c =>
    intro y hy
    rw [edgeKeys_node, Multiset.mem_toFinset]
    rcases mem_cutKeys_node.1 hy with ⟨hd, -⟩ | ⟨i, hi⟩
    · exact absurd hd (by simp only [rootF] at h; rw [h]; decide)
    · exact (Multiset.mem_sum (s := Finset.univ)).2 ⟨i, Finset.mem_univ _,
        mem_vkeys_of_mem_cutKeys hi⟩

name: Operad.STree.rootF_setF_false
statement:
lemma rootF_setF_false (x : ℕ ×ₗ ℕ) {t : STree (BE E)} (h : rootF t = false) :
    rootF (setF x false t) = false
proof:
:= by
  cases t with
  | leaf a => rfl
  | node d c =>
    rw [rootF_setF_node]
    split_ifs
    · rfl
    · exact h

name: Operad.STree.rootF_setF_of_ne
statement:
lemma rootF_setF_of_ne {x : ℕ ×ₗ ℕ} (b : Bool) {t : STree (BE E)} (h : t.key ≠ x) :
    rootF (setF x b t) = rootF t
proof:
:= by
  cases t with
  | leaf a => rfl
  | node d c =>
    rw [rootF_setF_node, if_neg h]
    rfl

name: Operad.Rules.bar_normal_iff
statement:
theorem Rules.bar_normal_iff (hlead : ∀ r a, (G.lead r).1 ≠ leaf a) {A : Finset ℕ}
    (X : SMono (BE E) A) :
    G.bar.Normal X ↔ ∀ r p xs₀, (forget X.1).get? p = some ((G.lead r).1.subst xs₀) →
      StrictMonoOn (fun a => (xs₀ a).first) (G.src r : Set ℕ) →
        ∃ y ∈ nwk xs₀ (G.lead r).1, y ∈ cutKeys X.1
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hN r p xs₀ hp hm
    by_contra hc
    push Not at hc
    rw [get?_forget] at hp
    obtain ⟨Y, hXY, hY⟩ := Option.map_eq_some_iff.1 hp
    rcases hL : (G.lead r).1 with a | ⟨e, c⟩
    · exact hlead r a hL
    have hn : (node e c).labels.Nodup := hL ▸ (G.lead r).nodup
    rw [hL] at hY hc
    obtain ⟨F, hF, hF'⟩ := lift_fl e c Y xs₀ hn hY
      fun y hy h => hc y hy (cutKeys_subset_of_get? hXY h)
    have hget : X.1.get? p = some ((G.bar.lead (r, rootF Y)).1.subst F) := by
      rw [hXY, hF]
      show some ((fl (rootF Y) (node e c)).subst F) = some ((fl (rootF Y) (G.lead r).1).subst F)
      rw [hL]
    have hmono : StrictMonoOn (fun a => (F a).first) (G.bar.src (r, rootF Y) : Set ℕ) :=
      fun a ha a' ha' h => by
        have hla : ∀ b ∈ G.src r, (F b).first = (xs₀ b).first := fun b hb => by
          rw [← first_forget, hF' b (by rw [← hL]; exact (G.lead r).mem_labels.2 hb)]
        simp only
        rw [hla a ha, hla a' ha']
        exact hm ha ha' h
    exact hN (r, rootF Y) _ (isSCtx_ctxOf X p _ F hget hmono) (ctxOf_self X p _ F hget hmono)
  · rintro H ⟨r, b⟩ f hf hfX
    obtain ⟨p, xs, hget, hin, -⟩ := IsSCtx.normal hf (G.bar.lead (r, b))
    rw [hfX] at hget
