    have hget' : X.1.get? p = some ((fl b (G.lead r).1).subst xs) := hget
    have hp : (forget X.1).get? p = some ((G.lead r).1.subst fun a => forget (xs a)) := by
      rw [get?_forget, hget', Option.map_some, forget_subst, forget_fl]
    have hm : StrictMonoOn (fun a => (forget (xs a)).first) (G.src r : Set ℕ) :=
      fun a ha a' ha' h => by simpa only [first_forget] using hin.mono ha ha' h
    obtain ⟨y, hy, hyX⟩ := H r p _ hp hm
    rcases hL : (G.lead r).1 with a | ⟨e, c⟩
    · exact hlead r a hL
    rw [hL] at hget' hy
    rw [nwk_node, Finset.mem_biUnion] at hy
    obtain ⟨i, -, hy⟩ := hy
    have hnX : X.1.vkeys.Nodup := nodup_vkeys X.isShuffle X.nodup
    have hnW := Multiset.nodup_of_le (mem_vkeys_of_get? hget') hnX
    rw [fl_node, subst_node] at hget' hnW
    obtain ⟨hroot, hnc, hdisj⟩ := nodup_vkeys_children hnW
    obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := wk_props (c i) xs (hnc i) y hy
    have hyW := mem_cutKeys_of_get? hnX hget' hyX
      (mem_vkeys_node.2 (Or.inr ⟨i, h1⟩))
    rcases mem_cutKeys_node.1 hyW with ⟨-, rfl⟩ | ⟨j, hj⟩
    · exact hroot ((Multiset.mem_sum (s := Finset.univ)).2 ⟨i, Finset.mem_univ _, h1⟩)
    · by_cases hij : j = i
      · subst hij
        exact h2 hj
      · exact Multiset.disjoint_left.1 (hdisj j i hij) (mem_vkeys_of_mem_cutKeys hj) h1

name: Operad.Rules.bar_normal_iff_quad
statement:
theorem Rules.bar_normal_iff_quad (hquad : ∀ r, (G.lead r).1.weight = 2) {A : Finset ℕ}
    (X : SMono (BE E) A) : G.bar.Normal X ↔ G.leadKeys (forgetM X) ⊆ ↑(cuts X)
proof:
:= by
  have hlead : ∀ r a, (G.lead r).1 ≠ leaf a := fun r a h => by
    have := hquad r
    rw [h, weight_leaf] at this
    exact absurd this (by norm_num)
  rw [G.bar_normal_iff hlead]
  constructor
  · rintro H y ⟨r, p, xs₀, hp, hm, hy⟩
    obtain ⟨y', hy'⟩ := nwk_eq_singleton xs₀ (hquad r)
    obtain ⟨z, hz, hzX⟩ := H r p xs₀ hp hm
    rw [hy', Finset.mem_singleton] at hy hz
    rw [hy, ← hz]
    exact hzX
  · intro H r p xs₀ hp hm
    obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := nwk_eq_singleton xs₀ (hquad r)
    exact ⟨y, by rw [hy]; exact Finset.mem_singleton_self y,
      H ⟨r, p, xs₀, hp, hm, by rw [hy]; exact Finset.mem_singleton_self y⟩⟩

name: Operad.STree.Bar.d_mem_P
statement:
lemma d_mem_P {A : Finset ℕ} {w n : ℕ} {X : SMono (BE E) A} (hX : X ∈ P A w (n + 1)) :
    d K (Finsupp.single X 1) ∈ Finsupp.supported K K (P A w n)
proof:
:= by
  rw [d, CutComplex.d_single, one_smul, CutComplex.dX]
  refine Submodule.sum_mem _ fun k hk => Submodule.smul_mem _ _
    (Finsupp.single_mem_supported K _ ⟨rootF_setF_false k hX.1, ?_, ?_⟩)
  · rw [setM_val, weight_setF]
    exact hX.2.1
  · have hc : cuts (setM k false X) = (cuts X).erase k := cutKeys_setF_false k X.1
    have h2 := hX.2.2
    have hpos := Finset.card_pos.2 ⟨k, hk⟩
    rw [hc, Finset.card_erase_of_mem hk]
    omega

name: Operad.Rules.dL_mem_fib
statement:
lemma Rules.dL_mem_fib {A : Finset ℕ} (X : SMono (BE E) A) :
    G.dL A (Finsupp.single X 1) ∈ Finsupp.supported K K {Y | forgetM Y = forgetM X}
proof:
:= by
  rw [Rules.dL, CutComplex.dL_single, one_smul, CutComplex.dLX]
  exact Submodule.sum_mem _ fun k _ => Submodule.smul_mem _ _
    (Finsupp.single_mem_supported K _ (forgetM_setM k false X))

name: Operad.Rules.dL_cut_add
proof:
:= by
  have hedge : ∀ Y : SMono (BE E) A, forgetM Y = t → k₀ ∈ Y.1.edgeKeys := fun Y hY => by
    rw [← edgeKeys_forget, ← forgetM_val, hY]
    exact hk₀e
  exact CutComplex.dL_hL_add (t := t) hk₀L (fun x => forgetM_setM k₀ true x)
    (fun x _ k _ => cutKeys_setF_false k x.1)
    (fun x hx _ => cutKeys_setF_true (edgeKeys_subset_vkeys (hedge x hx)))
    (fun x _ h => Subtype.ext (by
      rw [setM_val, setM_val, setF_setF_self, setF_false_of_notMem h]))
    (fun x _ h => Subtype.ext (by
      rw [setM_val, setM_val, setF_setF_self,
        setF_true_of_mem (nodup_vkeys x.isShuffle x.nodup) h]))
    (fun x _ h k hk => Subtype.ext (setF_comm (fun e => h (by rw [← e]; exact hk))
      false true x.1)) hY

name: Operad.Rules.bar_normal_setM_false
statement:
theorem Rules.bar_normal_setM_false {A : Finset ℕ} {X : SMono (BE E) A} (hX : G.bar.Normal X)
    {k : ℕ ×ₗ ℕ} :
    G.bar.Normal (setM k false X) ↔ k ∉ G.leadKeys (forgetM X)
proof:
:= by
  rw [G.bar_normal_iff_quad hquad, forgetM_setM]
  have hX' := (G.bar_normal_iff_quad hquad X).1 hX
  have hc : cuts (setM k false X) = (cuts X).erase k := cutKeys_setF_false k X.1
  rw [hc, Finset.coe_erase]
  constructor
  · intro h hk
    exact (h hk).2 rfl
  · intro hk y hy
    refine ⟨hX' hy, fun h => hk ?_⟩
    rw [Set.mem_singleton_iff] at h
    rw [← h]
    exact hy

name: Operad.Rules.bar_normal_setM_true
statement:
theorem Rules.bar_normal_setM_true {A : Finset ℕ} {X : SMono (BE E) A} (hX : G.bar.Normal X)
    (k : ℕ ×ₗ ℕ) : G.bar.Normal (setM k true X)
proof:
:= by
  rw [G.bar_normal_iff_quad hquad, forgetM_setM]
  have hX' := (G.bar_normal_iff_quad hquad X).1 hX
  intro y hy
  show y ∈ cutKeys (setF k true X.1)
  rw [mem_cutKeys_setF_true]
  exact Or.inr (hX' hy)

name: Operad.Rules.d_sub_dL_mem
proof:
:= by
  classical
  set S := G.bar.rw A with hSdef
  have hirr : ∀ X, X ∈ S.Irr ↔ G.bar.Normal X := fun X => G.bar.mem_irr_iff
  have hXn : G.bar.Normal X := (hirr X).1 hX
  rw [Rules.dL, Bar.d, CutComplex.d_single, CutComplex.dL_single, one_smul, one_smul,
    CutComplex.dX, CutComplex.dLX, map_sum, Finset.sum_filter, ← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
  refine Submodule.sum_mem _ fun k _ => ?_
  by_cases hk : k ∈ G.leadKeys (forgetM X)
  · rw [if_neg (not_not.2 hk), sub_zero, map_smul]
    refine Submodule.smul_mem _ _ ?_
    have hne : (S.red (setM k false X)).Nonempty := by
      by_contra hne
      exact ((G.bar_normal_setM_false hquad hXn).1 ((hirr _).1 (S.mem_irr_iff.2 hne))) hk
    rw [Rewriting.nf_single, one_smul]
    refine Finsupp.supported_mono (fun Y hY => ?_) (S.nfMono_mem_below hne)
    show O.lt (forgetM Y) (forgetM X)
    have : O.bar.lt Y (setM k false X) := hY
    rw [← forgetM_setM k false X]
    exact this
  · rw [if_pos hk, map_smul, S.nf_single_of_irr ((hirr _).2
      ((G.bar_normal_setM_false hquad hXn).2 hk)), sub_self]
    exact Submodule.zero_mem _

name: Operad.eq_of_supported
statement:
lemma eq_of_supported {X M : Type*} [AddCommGroup M] [Module K M]
    {f g : (X →₀ K) →ₗ[K] M} {s : Set X}
    (h : ∀ x ∈ s, f (Finsupp.single x 1) = g (Finsupp.single x 1))
    {v : X →₀ K} (hv : v ∈ Finsupp.supported K K s) : f v = g v
proof:
:= by
  have := Hoffbeck.map_mem_of_supported (P := LinearMap.eqLocus f g) LinearMap.id
    (fun x hx => LinearMap.mem_eqLocus.2 (h x hx)) hv
  exact LinearMap.mem_eqLocus.1 this

name: Operad.Rules.hlead_of_quad
statement: lemma Rules.hlead_of_quad : ∀ r a, (G.lead r).1 ≠ leaf a
proof:
:= fun r a h => by
  have := hquad r
  rw [h, weight_leaf] at this
  exact absurd this (by norm_num)

name: Operad.Rules.hom_of_quad
statement: lemma Rules.hom_of_quad : ∀ r, ∀ m ∈ (G.tail r).support, m.1.weight = (G.lead r).1.weight
proof:
:=
  fun r m hm => by rw [hom r m hm, hquad r]

name: Operad.Rules.bar_P_closed
statement:
lemma Rules.bar_P_closed {A : Finset ℕ} {w n : ℕ} :
    ∀ X ∈ Bar.P A w n, ∀ u ∈ (G.bar.rw A).red X, u ∈ Finsupp.supported K K (Bar.P A w n)
proof:
:= by
  intro X hX u hu
  refine Finsupp.supported_mono (fun Y hY => ?_)
    (G.bar_red_inv (G.hlead_of_quad hquad) (G.hom_of_quad hquad hom) hu)
  obtain ⟨h1, h2, h3⟩ := hY
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [h2]
    exact hX.1
  · rw [h3]
    exact hX.2.1
  · rw [h1]
    exact hX.2.2

name: Operad.Rules.nf_mem_P
proof:
:= by
  rw [Finsupp.supported_inter]
  exact ⟨(G.bar.rw A).nf_mem_supported u,
    (G.bar.rw A).nf_mem_of_closed (G.bar_P_closed hquad hom) hu⟩

name: Operad.Rules.nf_d_nf
statement:
lemma Rules.nf_d_nf {A : Finset ℕ} (u : SMono (BE E) A →₀ K) :
    (G.bar.rw A).nf (Bar.d K ((G.bar.rw A).nf u)) = (G.bar.rw A).nf (Bar.d K u)
proof:
:= by
  have hlead := G.hlead_of_quad hquad
  have hom' := G.hom_of_quad hquad hom
  have h := (G.bar_resolvable hlead hom' hres A).ideal_le_ker
    (G.bar_d_mem_ideal hlead hom' ((G.bar.rw A).nf_sub_mem u))
  rw [LinearMap.mem_ker, map_sub, map_sub, sub_eq_zero] at h
  exact h

name: Operad.Rules.bar_exact_down
proof:
:= by
  classical
  set S := G.bar.rw A with hSdef
  have hirr : ∀ X, X ∈ S.Irr ↔ G.bar.Normal X := fun X => G.bar.mem_irr_iff
  have hnfd := G.nf_d_nf hquad hom hres (A := A)
  let V := S.Irr ∩ Bar.P A w s
  let V' := S.Irr ∩ Bar.P A w (s + 1)
  let D : (SMono (BE E) A →₀ K) →ₗ[K] (SMono (BE E) A →₀ K) := S.nf ∘ₗ Bar.d K
  have hD : ∀ X ∈ V', D (Finsupp.single X 1) ∈ Finsupp.supported K K V := fun X hX =>
    G.nf_mem_P hquad hom (Bar.d_mem_P hX.2)
  have hDD : ∀ u ∈ Finsupp.supported K K V', D (D u) = 0 := fun u _ => by
    show S.nf (Bar.d K (S.nf (Bar.d K u))) = 0
    rw [hnfd, Bar.d_d, map_zero]
  have hlead' : ∀ X ∈ V ∪ V', D (Finsupp.single X 1) - G.dL A (Finsupp.single X 1) ∈
      Finsupp.supported K K {Y | O.lt (forgetM Y) (forgetM X)} := fun X hX =>
    G.d_sub_dL_mem hquad (by rcases hX with h | h <;> exact h.1)
  have hfib : ∀ X ∈ V ∪ V', G.dL A (Finsupp.single X 1) ∈
      Finsupp.supported K K {Y | forgetM Y = forgetM X} := fun X _ => G.dL_mem_fib X
  have hexact : ∀ t, ∀ u ∈ Finsupp.supported K K (V ∩ forgetM ⁻¹' {t}), G.dL A u = 0 →
      ∃ u' ∈ Finsupp.supported K K (V' ∩ forgetM ⁻¹' {t}), G.dL A u' = u := by
    intro t u hu hDu
    by_cases hu0 : u = 0
    · exact ⟨0, Submodule.zero_mem _, by rw [hu0, map_zero]⟩
    obtain ⟨X, hX⟩ := Finsupp.support_nonempty_iff.2 hu0
    obtain ⟨⟨hXirr, hXr, hXw, hXc⟩, hXt⟩ := (Finsupp.mem_supported K u).1 hu hX
    have hXt' : forgetM X = t := hXt
    have hnX := nodup_vkeys X.isShuffle X.nodup
    have hcard : (cuts X).card < X.1.edgeKeys.card := by
      rw [card_edgeKeys hnX, hXw]
      omega
    obtain ⟨k₀, hk₀e, hk₀c⟩ := Finset.exists_mem_notMem_of_card_lt_card hcard
    have hk₀L : k₀ ∉ G.leadKeys t := fun h => hk₀c
      ((G.bar_normal_iff_quad hquad X).1 ((hirr X).1 hXirr) (hXt' ▸ h))
    have hk₀t : k₀ ∈ t.1.edgeKeys := by
      rw [← hXt', forgetM_val, edgeKeys_forget]
      exact hk₀e
    have hedge : ∀ Y : SMono (BE E) A, forgetM Y = t → k₀ ∈ Y.1.edgeKeys := fun Y hY => by
      rw [← edgeKeys_forget, ← forgetM_val, hY]
      exact hk₀t
    have hhom : ∀ Y ∈ V ∩ forgetM ⁻¹' {t},
        (G.dL A ∘ₗ Bar.cut K k₀ + Bar.cut K k₀ ∘ₗ G.dL A) (Finsupp.single Y (1 : K)) =
          LinearMap.id (R := K) (Finsupp.single Y (1 : K)) := fun Y hY => by
      rw [LinearMap.add_apply, LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearMap.id_apply]
      exact G.dL_cut_add hk₀t hk₀L hY.2
    refine ⟨Bar.cut K k₀ u, Hoffbeck.map_mem_of_supported (Bar.cut K k₀) (fun Y hY => ?_) hu, ?_⟩
    · rw [Bar.cut, CutComplex.hL_single, one_smul, CutComplex.hX]
      split_ifs with h
      · exact Submodule.zero_mem _
      · obtain ⟨⟨hYirr, hYr, hYw, hYc⟩, hYt⟩ := hY
        have hYt' : forgetM Y = t := hYt
        refine Submodule.smul_mem _ _ (Finsupp.single_mem_supported K _ ⟨⟨(hirr _).2
          (G.bar_normal_setM_true hquad ((hirr Y).1 hYirr) k₀), ?_, ?_, ?_⟩, ?_⟩)
        · rw [setM_val, rootF_setF_of_ne true]
          · exact hYr
          · intro he
            exact key_notMem_edgeKeys (nodup_vkeys Y.isShuffle Y.nodup) (he ▸ hedge Y hYt')
        · rw [setM_val, weight_setF]
          exact hYw
        · have hc : cuts (setM k₀ true Y) = insert k₀ (cuts Y) :=
            cutKeys_setF_true (edgeKeys_subset_vkeys (hedge Y hYt'))
          rw [hc, Finset.card_insert_of_notMem h, hYc]
        · show forgetM (setM k₀ true Y) = t
          rw [forgetM_setM, hYt']
    · have h := eq_of_supported hhom hu
      rw [LinearMap.add_apply, LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearMap.comp_apply, hDu, map_zero,
        add_zero, LinearMap.id_apply] at h
      exact h
  exact Hoffbeck.exact_of_leading_down (fun x y => O.lt x y) forgetM (O.wf A)
    O.trans D (G.dL A) hD hDD hlead' hfib hexact hZ v hv hDv

name: Operad.Rules.bar_exact
statement:
theorem Rules.bar_exact {A : Finset ℕ} {w s : ℕ} (hsw : s < w) {v : SMono (BE E) A →₀ K}
    (hv : v ∈ Finsupp.supported K K ((G.bar.rw A).Irr ∩ Bar.P A w s))
    (hDv : (G.bar.rw A).nf (Bar.d K v) = 0) :
    ∃ u ∈ Finsupp.supported K K ((G.bar.rw A).Irr ∩ Bar.P A w (s + 1)),
      (G.bar.rw A).nf (Bar.d K u) = v
proof:
:= by
  have e : ∀ n, (G.bar.rw A).Irr ∩ Bar.P A w n ∩ forgetM ⁻¹' (Set.univ : Set (SMono E A)) =
      (G.bar.rw A).Irr ∩ Bar.P A w n := fun n => by rw [Set.preimage_univ, Set.inter_univ]
  obtain ⟨u, hu, hDu⟩ := G.bar_exact_down hquad hom hres hsw (Z := Set.univ)
    (fun _ _ _ _ => Set.mem_univ _) (by rwa [e]) hDv
  exact ⟨u, by rwa [e] at hu, hDu⟩

name: Operad.Rules.isKoszul_of_resolvable
statement: theorem Rules.isKoszul_of_resolvable : G.IsKoszul
proof:
:= by
  have hlead := G.hlead_of_quad hquad
  have hom' := G.hom_of_quad hquad hom
  intro A w s hsw v hv hdv
  set S := G.bar.rw A with hSdef
  have hS : S.Resolvable := G.bar_resolvable hlead hom' hres A
  have hDv₀ : S.nf (Bar.d K (S.nf v)) = 0 := by
    rw [G.nf_d_nf hquad hom hres]
    exact hS.ideal_le_ker hdv
  obtain ⟨u, hu, hDu⟩ := G.bar_exact hquad hom hres hsw (G.nf_mem_P hquad hom hv) hDv₀
  refine ⟨u, Finsupp.supported_mono Set.inter_subset_right hu, ?_⟩
  have e : v - Bar.d K u = (v - S.nf v) + (S.nf (Bar.d K u) - Bar.d K u) := by
    rw [hDu, sub_add_sub_cancel]
  rw [e]
  refine Submodule.add_mem _ ?_ (S.nf_sub_mem _)
  rw [← neg_sub]
  exact Submodule.neg_mem _ (S.nf_sub_mem v)

name: Operad.Rules.isKoszul_of_critical
statement:
theorem Rules.isKoszul_of_critical (hquad : ∀ r, (G.lead r).1.weight = 2)
    (hom : ∀ r, ∀ m ∈ (G.tail r).support, m.1.weight = 2)
    (hcrit : ∀ {C : Finset ℕ} {r₁ r₂ : ρ} (B : G.Amb C r₁ r₂), Critical G B → B.Res) :
    G.IsKoszul
proof:
:= by
  exact G.isKoszul_of_resolvable hquad hom
    (STree.resolvable_of_critical G (G.hlead_of_quad hquad) hcrit)

name: Operad.FreeBin.mono3_false
statement: lemma mono3_false (g h : G) (σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin 3)) : mono3 R (false, g, h, σ) = binL g h σ
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: Operad.FreeBin.mono3_true
statement: lemma mono3_true (g h : G) (σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin 3)) : mono3 R (true, g, h, σ) = binR g h σ
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: Operad.FreeBin.graftL_single
statement:
lemma graftL_single (g : G) (a b : LTree G) :
    graftL R g (Finsupp.single a 1) (Finsupp.single b 1) = Finsupp.single (.node g a b) 1
proof:
:= by
  simp [graftL]

name: Operad.FreeBin.bilinOp_apply
statement:
lemma bilinOp_apply {V : Type v} [AddCommGroup V] [Module R V] (β : V →ₗ[R] V →ₗ[R] V)
    (x y : V) : bilinOp β ![x, y] = β x y
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.FreeBin.perm3_ext
statement:
lemma perm3_ext {σ σ' : Equiv.Perm (Fin 3)} (h0 : (σ 0 : ℕ) = σ' 0) (h1 : (σ 1 : ℕ) = σ' 1)
    (h2 : (σ 2 : ℕ) = σ' 2) : σ = σ'
proof:
:= by
  ext k
  fin_cases k
  · exact h0
  · exact h1
  · exact h2

name: Operad.FreeBin.word_injective
statement: lemma word_injective : Function.Injective (word (G := G))
proof:
:= by
  rintro ⟨_ | _, g, h, σ⟩ ⟨_ | _, g', h', σ'⟩ heq <;>
    simp only [word, LTree.node.injEq, LTree.leaf.injEq, reduceCtorEq, and_false] at heq
  · obtain ⟨rfl, ⟨rfl, h0, h1⟩, h2⟩ := heq
    rw [perm3_ext h0 h1 h2]
  · obtain ⟨rfl, h0, rfl, h1, h2⟩ := heq
    rw [perm3_ext h0 h1 h2]

name: Operad.FreeBin.binHom_mono3_word
statement:
lemma binHom_mono3_word (m : Mono3 G) :
    (binHom (fun g => bilinOp (graftL R g))).app (Fin 3) (mono3 R m)
      (fun k => Finsupp.single (.leaf k) 1) = Finsupp.single (word m) 1
proof:
:= by
  rcases m with ⟨_ | _, g, h, σ⟩
  · rw [mono3_false, binHom_binL]
    simp only [bilinOp_apply, graftL_single]
    rfl
  · rw [mono3_true, binHom_binR]
    simp only [bilinOp_apply, graftL_single]
    rfl

name: Operad.FreeBin.mono3_independent
statement: theorem mono3_independent : LinearIndependent R (mono3 (G := G) R)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [linearIndependent_iff']
  intro s c hc m hm
  have := congrArg (fun x => (binHom (fun g => bilinOp (graftL R g))).app (Fin 3) x
    (fun k => Finsupp.single (.leaf k) 1)) hc
  simp only [map_sum, map_smul, MultilinearMap.coe_sum, MultilinearMap.smul_apply,
    Finset.sum_apply, binHom_mono3_word, map_zero, MultilinearMap.zero_apply] at this
  have h2 := congrArg (fun f : Words G R => f (word m)) this
  simp only [Finsupp.coe_finsetSum, Finset.sum_apply, Finsupp.coe_smul, Pi.smul_apply,
    smul_eq_mul, Finsupp.coe_zero, Pi.zero_apply] at h2
  rw [Finset.sum_eq_single m] at h2
  · simpa using h2
  · intro b _ hb
    rw [Finsupp.single_apply, if_neg (fun h => hb (word_injective h)), mul_zero]
  · intro hm'
    exact absurd hm hm'

name: Operad.FreeBin.comb3_bijective
statement: lemma comb3_bijective : Function.Bijective (comb3 (G := G))
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro x y hxy
    have h := congrArg Subtype.val hxy
    rcases x with ⟨_ | _, g, h₁⟩ <;> rcases y with ⟨_ | _, g', h₁'⟩ <;>
      simp only [comb3, BTree.node.injEq, reduceCtorEq, and_false, and_true, true_and] at h
    · obtain ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ := h
      rfl
    · obtain ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ := h
      rfl
  · rintro ⟨t, ht⟩
    rcases t with _ | ⟨g, l, r⟩
    · simp at ht
    · simp only [BTree.arity_node] at ht
      have hl := BTree.arity_pos l
      have hr := BTree.arity_pos r
      have two : ∀ u : BTree G, u.arity = 2 → ∃ h, u = .node h .leaf .leaf := by
        intro u hu
        rcases u with _ | ⟨h, a, b⟩
        · simp at hu
        · simp only [BTree.arity_node] at hu
          have ha := BTree.arity_pos a
          have hb := BTree.arity_pos b
          exact ⟨h, by rw [BTree.eq_leaf_of_arity_eq_one (by omega : a.arity = 1),
            BTree.eq_leaf_of_arity_eq_one (by omega : b.arity = 1)]⟩
      by_cases h1 : l.arity = 1
      · obtain rfl := BTree.eq_leaf_of_arity_eq_one h1
        obtain ⟨h, rfl⟩ := two r (by simp only [BTree.arity_leaf] at ht; omega)
        exact ⟨(true, g, h), rfl⟩
      · obtain ⟨h, rfl⟩ := two l (by omega)
        obtain rfl := BTree.eq_leaf_of_arity_eq_one
          (by simp only [BTree.arity_node, BTree.arity_leaf] at ht; omega : r.arity = 1)
        exact ⟨(false, g, h), rfl⟩

name: Operad.FreeBin.card_ofArity_three
statement: lemma card_ofArity_three : Fintype.card (BTree.OfArity G 3) = 2 * Fintype.card G ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Fintype.card_congr (Equiv.ofBijective _ comb3_bijective), Fintype.card_prod,
    Fintype.card_prod, Fintype.card_bool]
  ring

name: Operad.FreeBin.finite_reg
statement:
lemma finite_reg (N : ℕ → Type v) [∀ n, Finite (N n)] (A : Type) [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] :
    Finite (Reg N A)
proof:
:=
  Finite.of_equiv (LinOrd A × N (Fintype.card A))
    (Equiv.prodCongr (Equiv.refl _) (arrEquiv N _).symm)

name: Operad.FreeBin.natCard_freeSet_three
statement: lemma natCard_freeSet_three : Nat.card (FreeSet (BinGen G) (Fin 3)) = 12 * Fintype.card G ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  rw [Nat.card_congr (regIso.equiv (Fin 3)), card_reg, Fintype.card_fin, Nat.card_eq_fintype_card,
    card_ofArity_three, show (3 : ℕ).factorial = 6 from rfl]
  ring

name: Operad.FreeBin.mono3Set_bijective
statement: theorem mono3Set_bijective : Function.Bijective (mono3Set (G := G))
proof:
:= by
  have hinj : Function.Injective (mono3Set (G := G)) := fun m m' h =>
    (mono3_independent (G := G) ℤ).injective (by
      show Finsupp.single (mono3Set m) (1 : ℤ) = Finsupp.single (mono3Set m') 1
      rw [h])
  haveI := finite_reg (BTree.OfArity G) (Fin 3)
  haveI : Finite (FreeSet (BinGen G) (Fin 3)) := Finite.of_equiv _ (regIso.equiv (Fin 3)).symm
  refine hinj.bijective_of_nat_card_le ?_
  rw [natCard_freeSet_three, Nat.card_eq_fintype_card]
  simp only [Fintype.card_prod, Fintype.card_bool, Fintype.card_perm, Fintype.card_fin,
    show (3 : ℕ).factorial = 6 from rfl]
  nlinarith [sq_nonneg (Fintype.card G)]

name: Operad.FreeBin.span_mono3
statement: theorem span_mono3 : Submodule.span R (Set.range (mono3 (G := G) R)) = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  rw [eq_top_iff]
  rintro x -
  induction x using Finsupp.induction_linear with
  | zero => exact Submodule.zero_mem _
  | add x y hx hy => exact Submodule.add_mem _ hx hy
  | single a r =>
    obtain ⟨m, rfl⟩ := mono3Set_bijective.2 a
    have : Finsupp.single (mono3Set m) r = r • mono3 R m := by
      rw [mono3, Finsupp.smul_single, smul_eq_mul, mul_one]
    rw [this]
    exact Submodule.smul_mem _ _ (Submodule.subset_span ⟨m, rfl⟩)

name: Operad.FreeBin.basis3_apply
statement: @[simp] lemma basis3_apply (m : Mono3 G) : basis3 R m = mono3 R m
proof:
:= by
  simp [basis3]

name: Operad.FreeBin.isEmpty_freeSet
statement: lemma isEmpty_freeSet (h : Fintype.card A = 0) : IsEmpty (FreeSet (BinGen G) A)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun x => ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨_, ⟨⟨n, t⟩, hn⟩⟩ := regIso.equiv A x
  have := BTree.arity_pos t.1
  rw [t.2] at this
  simp only at hn
  omega

name: Operad.FreeBin.subsingleton_freeSet
statement: lemma subsingleton_freeSet (h : Fintype.card A = 1) : Subsingleton (FreeSet (BinGen G) A)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun x y => (regIso.equiv A).injective ?_⟩
  haveI : Subsingleton A := Fintype.card_le_one_iff_subsingleton.1 h.le
  obtain ⟨L, ⟨⟨n, t⟩, hn⟩⟩ := regIso.equiv A x
  obtain ⟨L', ⟨⟨n', t'⟩, hn'⟩⟩ := regIso.equiv A y
  simp only at hn hn'
  refine Reg.ext (LinOrd.eq_of_subsingleton _ _) (BTree.OfArity.arr_ext ?_)
  show t.1 = t'.1
  rw [BTree.eq_leaf_of_arity_eq_one (t.2.trans (hn.trans h)),
    BTree.eq_leaf_of_arity_eq_one (t'.2.trans (hn'.trans h))]

name: Operad.FreeBin.freeBin_eq_zero
statement: lemma freeBin_eq_zero (h : Fintype.card A = 0) (x : FreeBin R G A) : x = 0
proof:
:= by
  haveI := isEmpty_freeSet (G := G) h
  exact Finsupp.ext fun a => isEmptyElim a

name: Operad.FreeBin.freeBin_eq_smul_single
statement:
lemma freeBin_eq_smul_single (h : Fintype.card A = 1) (t : FreeSet (BinGen G) A)
    (x : FreeBin R G A) : x = x t • Finsupp.single t 1
proof:
:= by
  haveI := subsingleton_freeSet (G := G) h
  ext a
  rw [Subsingleton.elim a t]
  simp

name: Operad.FreeBin.comp_map_one
statement:
lemma comp_map_one {S : (A : Type) → [Fintype A] → [DecidableEq A] → Type v} [SetOperad S]
    [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] {B : Type} [Fintype B] [DecidableEq B] (i : A) (s : S A)
    (u : Unit ≃ B) :
    SetOperad.comp i s (SetOperad.map u SetOperad.one)
      = SetOperad.map ((rightUnitEquiv i).symm.trans (Equiv.sumCongr (Equiv.refl _) u)) s
proof:
:= by
  rw [comp_map_right, comp_one', map_trans]

name: Operad.FreeBin.map_one_comp
statement:
lemma map_one_comp {S : (A : Type) → [Fintype A] → [DecidableEq A] → Type v} [SetOperad S]
    [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] {B : Type} [Fintype B] [DecidableEq B] (u : Unit ≃ A) {i : A}
    (hi : u () = i) (y : S B) :
    SetOperad.comp i (SetOperad.map u SetOperad.one) y
      = SetOperad.map ((leftUnitEquiv B).symm.trans
          ((compEquiv u (Equiv.refl B) ()).trans (slotEquiv hi))) y
proof:
:= by
  rw [comp_map_left_of u hi, one_comp']
  simp only [map_trans]

name: Operad.FreeBin.comp_single_unit
statement:
lemma comp_single_unit {A : Type} [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] {B : Type} [Fintype B] [DecidableEq B]
    (i : A) (u : Unit ≃ B) (x : FreeBin R G A) :
    SymOperad.comp (R := R) i x (Finsupp.single (SetOperad.map u SetOperad.one) 1)
      = SymOperad.map (R := R)
          ((rightUnitEquiv i).symm.trans (Equiv.sumCongr (Equiv.refl _) u)) x
proof:
:= by
  induction x using Finsupp.induction_linear with
  | zero => simp
  | add x y hx hy => simp only [map_add, LinearMap.add_apply, hx, hy]
  | single s r =>
    show Lin.compL R i (Finsupp.single s r) (Finsupp.single _ 1) = Lin.mapL R _ (Finsupp.single s r)
    rw [Lin.compL_single, Lin.mapL_single, comp_map_one, mul_one]

name: Operad.FreeBin.comp_unit_single
statement:
lemma comp_unit_single {A : Type} [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] {B : Type} [Fintype B] [DecidableEq B]
    (u : Unit ≃ A) {i : A} (hi : u () = i) (y : FreeBin R G B) :
    SymOperad.comp (R := R) i (Finsupp.single (SetOperad.map u SetOperad.one) 1) y
      = SymOperad.map (R := R) ((leftUnitEquiv B).symm.trans
          ((compEquiv u (Equiv.refl B) ()).trans (slotEquiv hi))) y
proof:
:= by
  induction y using Finsupp.induction_linear with
  | zero => simp
  | add x y hx hy => simp only [map_add, hx, hy]
  | single s r =>
    show Lin.compL R i (Finsupp.single _ 1) (Finsupp.single s r) = Lin.mapL R _ (Finsupp.single s r)
    rw [Lin.compL_single, Lin.mapL_single, map_one_comp u hi, one_mul]

name: Operad.FreeBin.mem_ideal3Sub
statement:
lemma mem_ideal3Sub {A : Type} [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] {x : FreeBin R G A} :
    x ∈ ideal3Sub R W A ↔
      (Fintype.card A < 3 → x = 0) ∧ ∀ f : A ≃ Fin 3, SymOperad.map (R := R) f x ∈ W
proof:
:= by
  unfold ideal3Sub
  split_ifs with h
  · rw [Submodule.mem_bot]
    refine ⟨fun hx => ⟨fun _ => hx, fun f => ?_⟩, fun hx => hx.1 h⟩
    have := Fintype.card_congr f
    simp only [Fintype.card_fin] at this
    omega
  · simp only [Submodule.mem_iInf, Submodule.mem_comap]
    exact ⟨fun hx => ⟨fun h' => absurd h' h, hx⟩, fun hx => hx.2⟩

name: Operad.FreeBin.card_target
statement:
lemma card_target {A B : Type} [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] [Fintype B] (i : A) :
    Fintype.card (Without A i ⊕ B) = Fintype.card A - 1 + Fintype.card B
proof:
:= by
  rw [Fintype.card_sum, Reg.card_without]

name: Operad.FreeBin.not_equiv_fin3
statement: lemma not_equiv_fin3 {A : Type} [Fintype A] (h : Fintype.card A ≠ 3) (f : A ≃ Fin 3) : False
proof:
:= by
  have := Fintype.card_congr f
  simp only [Fintype.card_fin] at this
  exact h this

name: Operad.FreeBin.ideal3_map_mem
statement:
lemma ideal3_map_mem {A B : Type} [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] [Fintype B] [DecidableEq B]
    (e : A ≃ B) {x : FreeBin R G A} (hx : x ∈ ideal3Sub R W A) :
    SymOperad.map (R := R) e x ∈ ideal3Sub R W B
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_ideal3Sub] at hx ⊢
  have hcard := Fintype.card_congr e
  refine ⟨fun h => ?_, fun f => ?_⟩
  · rw [hx.1 (by omega), map_zero]
  · rw [← SymOperad.map_trans]
    exact hx.2 (e.trans f)

name: Operad.FreeBin.ideal3_comp_left
statement:
lemma ideal3_comp_left {A B : Type} [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] [Fintype B] [DecidableEq B]
    (i : A) (y : FreeBin R G B) {x : FreeBin R G A} (hx : x ∈ ideal3Sub R W A) :
    SymOperad.comp (R := R) i x y ∈ ideal3Sub R W (Without A i ⊕ B)
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_ideal3Sub] at hx ⊢
  have hc := card_target (B := B) i
  have hA : 0 < Fintype.card A := Fintype.card_pos_iff.2 ⟨i⟩
  by_cases ha : Fintype.card A < 3
  · rw [hx.1 ha]
    simp only [map_zero, LinearMap.zero_apply, implies_true, true_and]
    exact fun _ => W.zero_mem
  · by_cases hb0 : Fintype.card B = 0
    · rw [freeBin_eq_zero R hb0 y]
      simp only [map_zero, implies_true, true_and]
      exact fun _ => W.zero_mem
    · by_cases hb1 : Fintype.card B = 1
      · obtain ⟨u⟩ : Nonempty (Unit ≃ B) :=
          ⟨Fintype.equivOfCardEq (by rw [Fintype.card_unit, hb1])⟩
        rw [freeBin_eq_smul_single R hb1 (SetOperad.map u SetOperad.one) y, map_smul,
          comp_single_unit]
        refine ⟨fun h => absurd h (by omega), fun f => ?_⟩
        rw [map_smul, ← SymOperad.map_trans]
        exact W.smul_mem _ (hx.2 _)
      · exact ⟨fun h => absurd h (by omega), fun f => (not_equiv_fin3 (by omega) f).elim⟩

name: Operad.FreeBin.ideal3_comp_right
statement:
lemma ideal3_comp_right {A B : Type} [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] [Fintype B] [DecidableEq B]
    (i : A) (x : FreeBin R G A) {y : FreeBin R G B} (hy : y ∈ ideal3Sub R W B) :
    SymOperad.comp (R := R) i x y ∈ ideal3Sub R W (Without A i ⊕ B)
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_ideal3Sub] at hy ⊢
  have hc := card_target (B := B) i
  have hA : 0 < Fintype.card A := Fintype.card_pos_iff.2 ⟨i⟩
  by_cases hb : Fintype.card B < 3
  · rw [hy.1 hb]
    simp only [map_zero, implies_true, true_and]
    exact fun _ => W.zero_mem
  · by_cases ha1 : Fintype.card A = 1
    · obtain ⟨u⟩ : Nonempty (Unit ≃ A) :=
        ⟨Fintype.equivOfCardEq (by rw [Fintype.card_unit, ha1])⟩
      have hi : u () = i := by
        haveI : Subsingleton A := Fintype.card_le_one_iff_subsingleton.1 ha1.le
        exact Subsingleton.elim _ _
      rw [freeBin_eq_smul_single R ha1 (SetOperad.map u SetOperad.one) x, map_smul,
        LinearMap.smul_apply, comp_unit_single R u hi]
      refine ⟨fun h => absurd h (by omega), fun f => ?_⟩
      rw [map_smul, ← SymOperad.map_trans]
      exact W.smul_mem _ (hy.2 _)
    · exact ⟨fun h => absurd h (by omega), fun f => (not_equiv_fin3 (by omega) f).elim⟩

name: Operad.FreeBin.span_sub_three
statement:
theorem span_sub_three (r : Set (FreeBin R G (Fin 3))) :
    (SymOperadIdeal.span R (rel23 (∅ : Set (FreeBin R G (Fin 2))) r)).sub (Fin 3)
      = Submodule.span R (orbit3 R r)
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · have hle : SymOperadIdeal.span R (rel23 (∅ : Set (FreeBin R G (Fin 2))) r)
        ≤ ideal3 R (Submodule.span R (orbit3 R r)) := by
      rw [SymOperadIdeal.span_le]
      intro n x hx
      rcases n with _ | _ | _ | _ | n
      · exact absurd hx (by simp [rel23])
      · exact absurd hx (by simp [rel23])
      · exact absurd hx (by simp [rel23])
      · show x ∈ ideal3Sub R _ (Fin 3)
        rw [mem_ideal3Sub]
        exact ⟨fun h => absurd h (by simp), fun f => Submodule.subset_span ⟨f, x, hx, rfl⟩⟩
      · exact absurd hx (by simp [rel23])
    intro x hx
    have := ((mem_ideal3Sub R).1 (hle (Fin 3) hx)).2 (Equiv.refl _)
    rwa [SymOperad.map_refl] at this
  · rw [Submodule.span_le]
    rintro _ ⟨τ, y, hy, rfl⟩
    exact (SymOperadIdeal.span R _).map_mem τ (SymOperadIdeal.subset_span 3 hy)

name: Operad.FreeBin.map_mono3
statement:
lemma map_mono3 (τ : Equiv.Perm (Fin 3)) (m : Mono3 G) :
    SymOperad.map (R := R) τ (mono3 R m) = mono3 R (act3 τ m)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨s, g, h, σ⟩ := m
  show Lin.mapL R τ (Finsupp.single _ 1) = Finsupp.single _ 1
  rw [Lin.mapL_single]
  congr 1
  cases s
  · show SetOperad.map τ (Pres.mk _) = Pres.mk _
    rw [Pres.map_mk]
    exact Pres.mk_eq_mk (Syn.Rel.symm (Syn.Rel.map_trans (fin3Left.symm.trans σ) τ _))
  · show SetOperad.map τ (Pres.mk _) = Pres.mk _
    rw [Pres.map_mk]
    exact Pres.mk_eq_mk (Syn.Rel.symm (Syn.Rel.map_trans (fin3Right.symm.trans σ) τ _))

name: Operad.FreeBin.act3_injective
statement: lemma act3_injective (τ : Equiv.Perm (Fin 3)) : Function.Injective (act3 (G := G) τ)
proof:
:= by
  rintro ⟨s, g, h, σ⟩ ⟨s', g', h', σ'⟩ heq
  simp only [act3, Prod.mk.injEq, mul_right_inj] at heq
  obtain ⟨rfl, rfl, rfl, rfl⟩ := heq
  rfl

name: Operad.FreeBin.map_mem_span_orbit3
statement:
lemma map_mem_span_orbit3 {r : Set (FreeBin R G (Fin 3))} (τ : Equiv.Perm (Fin 3))
    {x : FreeBin R G (Fin 3)} (hx : x ∈ Submodule.span R (orbit3 R r)) :
    SymOperad.map (R := R) τ x ∈ Submodule.span R (orbit3 R r)
proof:
:= by
  induction hx using Submodule.span_induction with
  | mem y hy =>
    obtain ⟨τ', y, hy, rfl⟩ := hy
    refine Submodule.subset_span ⟨τ * τ', y, hy, ?_⟩
    rw [← SymOperad.map_trans]
    rfl
  | zero => simp
  | add x y _ _ hx hy => rw [map_add]; exact Submodule.add_mem _ hx hy
  | smul c x _ hx => rw [map_smul]; exact Submodule.smul_mem _ c hx

name: Operad.FreeBin.span_orbit3_eq
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · rw [Submodule.span_le]
    rintro _ ⟨τ, y, hy, rfl⟩
    exact hW τ y hy
  · intro x hx
    refine Submodule.subset_span ⟨1, x, hx, ?_⟩
    exact (SymOperad.map_refl x).symm

name: Operad.FreeBin.span_eq_of_span_orbit3_eq
statement:
theorem span_eq_of_span_orbit3_eq {r r' : Set (FreeBin R G (Fin 3))}
    (h : Submodule.span R (orbit3 R r) = Submodule.span R (orbit3 R r')) :
    SymOperadIdeal.span R (rel23 (∅ : Set (FreeBin R G (Fin 2))) r)
      = SymOperadIdeal.span R (rel23 (∅ : Set (FreeBin R G (Fin 2))) r')
proof:
:= by
  have key : ∀ r r' : Set (FreeBin R G (Fin 3)),
      Submodule.span R (orbit3 R r) ≤ Submodule.span R (orbit3 R r') →
      SymOperadIdeal.span R (rel23 (∅ : Set (FreeBin R G (Fin 2))) r)
        ≤ SymOperadIdeal.span R (rel23 (∅ : Set (FreeBin R G (Fin 2))) r') := by
    intro r r' hle
    rw [SymOperadIdeal.span_le]
    intro n x hx
    rcases n with _ | _ | _ | _ | n
    · exact absurd hx (by simp [rel23])
    · exact absurd hx (by simp [rel23])
    · exact absurd hx (by simp [rel23])
    · rw [span_sub_three]
      exact hle (Submodule.subset_span ⟨1, x, hx, (SymOperad.map_refl x).symm⟩)
    · exact absurd hx (by simp [rel23])
  exact le_antisymm (key r r' h.le) (key r' r h.ge)

name: Operad.FreeBin.sign3_ne_zero
statement: lemma sign3_ne_zero (m : Mono3 G) : sign3 K m ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  unfold sign3
  rcases Int.units_eq_one_or (Equiv.Perm.sign m.2.2.2) with h | h <;> split_ifs <;> simp [h]

name: Operad.FreeBin.sign3_act3
statement:
lemma sign3_act3 (τ : Equiv.Perm (Fin 3)) (m : Mono3 G) :
    sign3 K (act3 τ m) = ((Equiv.Perm.sign τ : ℤ) : K) * sign3 K m
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨s, g, h, σ⟩ := m
  cases s <;> simp [sign3, act3, Equiv.Perm.sign_mul]

name: Operad.FreeBin.pair3_apply
statement:
lemma pair3_apply (x y : FreeBin K G (Fin 3)) :
    pair3 G K x y = ∑ m, sign3 K m * (basis3 K).repr x m * (basis3 K).repr y m
proof:
:= by
  rw [pair3, Module.Basis.constr_apply, Finsupp.sum_fintype _ _ (by simp)]
  simp only [LinearMap.coe_sum, Finset.sum_apply, LinearMap.smul_apply, Module.Basis.coord_apply,
    smul_eq_mul]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun m _ => ?_
  ring

name: Operad.FreeBin.pair3_mono3
statement:
lemma pair3_mono3 (m m' : Mono3 G) :
    pair3 G K (mono3 K m) (mono3 K m') = if m = m' then sign3 K m else 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [pair3_apply, ← basis3_apply, ← basis3_apply, Module.Basis.repr_self, Module.Basis.repr_self]
  rw [Finset.sum_eq_single m]
  · by_cases h : m = m'
    · subst h
      simp
    · simp [h]
  · intro b _ hb
    simp [Finsupp.single_apply, Ne.symm hb]
  · simp

name: Operad.FreeBin.pair3_comm
statement: lemma pair3_comm (x y : FreeBin K G (Fin 3)) : pair3 G K x y = pair3 G K y x
proof:
:= by
  rw [pair3_apply, pair3_apply]
  exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun m _ => by ring

name: Operad.FreeBin.pair3_isRefl
statement: lemma pair3_isRefl : LinearMap.BilinForm.IsRefl (pair3 G K)
proof:
:= fun x y h => by
  rwa [pair3_comm]

name: Operad.FreeBin.pair3_separatingLeft
statement: lemma pair3_separatingLeft (x : FreeBin K G (Fin 3)) (hx : ∀ y, pair3 G K x y = 0) : x = 0
proof:
:= by
  apply (basis3 K).repr.injective
  ext m
  have := hx (mono3 K m)
  rw [pair3_apply, Finset.sum_eq_single m] at this
  · rw [← basis3_apply, Module.Basis.repr_self, Finsupp.single_eq_same, mul_one] at this
    simpa [sign3_ne_zero] using this
  · intro b _ hb
    rw [← basis3_apply, Module.Basis.repr_self, Finsupp.single_eq_of_ne hb, mul_zero]
  · simp

name: Operad.FreeBin.pair3_nondegenerate
statement: lemma pair3_nondegenerate : LinearMap.BilinForm.Nondegenerate (pair3 G K)
proof:
:=
  ⟨pair3_separatingLeft K, fun y hy => pair3_separatingLeft K y fun x => by
    rw [pair3_comm]; exact hy x⟩

name: Operad.FreeBin.pair3_map
statement:
lemma pair3_map (τ : Equiv.Perm (Fin 3)) (x y : FreeBin K G (Fin 3)) :
    pair3 G K (SymOperad.map (R := K) τ x) (SymOperad.map (R := K) τ y)
      = ((Equiv.Perm.sign τ : ℤ) : K) * pair3 G K x y
proof:
:= by
  have : (pair3 G K).compl₁₂ (SymOperad.map (R := K) τ) (SymOperad.map (R := K) τ)
      = ((Equiv.Perm.sign τ : ℤ) : K) • pair3 G K := by
    refine (basis3 K).ext fun m => (basis3 K).ext fun m' => ?_
    simp only [LinearMap.compl₁₂_apply, basis3_apply, map_mono3, pair3_mono3,
      LinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, (act3_injective τ).eq_iff, sign3_act3]
    split_ifs <;> simp
  exact congrArg (fun B : LinearMap.BilinForm K _ => B x y) this

name: Operad.FreeBin.map_mem_dualRel
statement:
lemma map_mem_dualRel (r : Set (FreeBin K G (Fin 3))) (τ : Equiv.Perm (Fin 3))
    {x : FreeBin K G (Fin 3)} (hx : x ∈ dualRel K r) :
    SymOperad.map (R := K) τ x ∈ dualRel K r
proof:
:= by
  intro n hn
  have hn' := map_mem_span_orbit3 K τ⁻¹ hn
  have h1 := hx _ hn'
  show pair3 G K n (SymOperad.map (R := K) τ x) = 0
  have h2 := pair3_map K τ (SymOperad.map (R := K) τ⁻¹ n) x
  rw [← SymOperad.map_trans, show τ⁻¹.trans τ = Equiv.refl _ from by ext; simp,
    SymOperad.map_refl] at h2
  rw [h2]
  rw [show pair3 G K _ x = 0 from h1, mul_zero]

name: Operad.FreeBin.span_orbit3_dualRel
statement:
lemma span_orbit3_dualRel (r : Set (FreeBin K G (Fin 3))) :
    Submodule.span K (orbit3 K (dualRel K r : Set (FreeBin K G (Fin 3)))) = dualRel K r
proof:
:=
  span_orbit3_eq K fun τ _ hx => map_mem_dualRel K r τ hx

name: Operad.FreeBin.dualRel_dualRel
statement:
theorem dualRel_dualRel (r : Set (FreeBin K G (Fin 3))) :
    dualRel K (dualRel K r : Set (FreeBin K G (Fin 3))) = Submodule.span K (orbit3 K r)
proof:
:= by
  rw [dualRel, span_orbit3_dualRel, dualRel,
    LinearMap.BilinForm.orthogonal_orthogonal (pair3_nondegenerate K) (pair3_isRefl K)]

name: Operad.FreeBin.finrank_dualRel
statement:
theorem finrank_dualRel (r : Set (FreeBin K G (Fin 3))) :
    Module.finrank K (dualRel K r)
      = 12 * Fintype.card G ^ 2 - Module.finrank K (Submodule.span K (orbit3 K r))
proof:
:= by
  rw [dualRel, LinearMap.BilinForm.finrank_orthogonal (pair3_nondegenerate K),
    Module.finrank_eq_card_basis (basis3 K)]
  congr 1
  simp only [Mono3, Fintype.card_prod, Fintype.card_bool, Fintype.card_perm, Fintype.card_fin,
    show (3 : ℕ).factorial = 6 from rfl]
  ring

name: Operad.FreeBin.dual_dual
statement:
theorem dual_dual (r : Set (FreeBin K G (Fin 3))) :
    SymOperadIdeal.span K (rel23 (∅ : Set (FreeBin K G (Fin 2)))
        (dualRel K (dualRel K r : Set (FreeBin K G (Fin 3))) : Set (FreeBin K G (Fin 3))))
      = SymOperadIdeal.span K (rel23 (∅ : Set (FreeBin K G (Fin 2))) r)
proof:
:= by
  apply span_eq_of_span_orbit3_eq K
  rw [span_orbit3_dualRel, dualRel_dualRel]

name: Operad.FreeBin.repr_mono3
statement:
lemma repr_mono3 (m m' : Mono3 G) :
    (basis3 K).repr (mono3 K m) m' = if m = m' then 1 else 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [← basis3_apply, Module.Basis.repr_self, Finsupp.single_apply]

name: Operad.FreeBin.map_binL
statement:
lemma map_binL (τ σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin 3)) (g h : G) :
    SymOperad.map (R := K) τ (binL g h σ) = mono3 K (false, g, h, τ * σ)
proof:
:=
  map_mono3 K τ (false, g, h, σ)

name: Operad.FreeBin.map_binR
statement:
lemma map_binR (τ σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin 3)) (g h : G) :
    SymOperad.map (R := K) τ (binR g h σ) = mono3 K (true, g, h, τ * σ)
proof:
:=
  map_mono3 K τ (true, g, h, σ)

name: Operad.FreeBin.mem_orbit3
statement:
lemma mem_orbit3 {r : Set (FreeBin K G (Fin 3))} {y : FreeBin K G (Fin 3)} (hy : y ∈ r)
    (τ : Equiv.Perm (Fin 3)) : SymOperad.map (R := K) τ y ∈ Submodule.span K (orbit3 K r)
proof:
:=
  Submodule.subset_span ⟨τ, y, hy, rfl⟩

name: Operad.FreeBin.le_dualRel
statement:
lemma le_dualRel {r s : Set (FreeBin K G (Fin 3))}
    (h : ∀ x ∈ s, ∀ y ∈ r, ∀ σ τ : Equiv.Perm (Fin 3),
      pair3 G K (SymOperad.map (R := K) τ y) (SymOperad.map (R := K) σ x) = 0) :
    Submodule.span K (orbit3 K s) ≤ dualRel K r
proof:
:= by
  rw [Submodule.span_le]
  rintro _ ⟨σ, x, hx, rfl⟩ n hn
  show pair3 G K n (SymOperad.map (R := K) σ x) = 0
  induction hn using Submodule.span_induction with
  | mem y hy =>
    obtain ⟨τ, y, hy, rfl⟩ := hy
    exact h x hx y hy σ τ
  | zero => simp
  | add y z _ _ hy hz => rw [map_add, LinearMap.add_apply, hy, hz, add_zero]
  | smul c y _ hy => rw [map_smul, LinearMap.smul_apply, hy, smul_zero]

name: Operad.FreeBin.dualRel_eq_of_orthogonal
statement:
theorem dualRel_eq_of_orthogonal {r s : Set (FreeBin K G (Fin 3))}
    (h : ∀ x ∈ s, ∀ y ∈ r, ∀ σ τ : Equiv.Perm (Fin 3),
      pair3 G K (SymOperad.map (R := K) τ y) (SymOperad.map (R := K) σ x) = 0)
    (hdim : 12 * Fintype.card G ^ 2 ≤ Module.finrank K (Submodule.span K (orbit3 K s))
      + Module.finrank K (Submodule.span K (orbit3 K r))) :
    dualRel K r = Submodule.span K (orbit3 K s) ∧
      dualRel K s = Submodule.span K (orbit3 K r)
proof:
:= by
  have key : ∀ {r s : Set (FreeBin K G (Fin 3))}, Submodule.span K (orbit3 K s) ≤ dualRel K r →
      12 * Fintype.card G ^ 2 ≤ Module.finrank K (Submodule.span K (orbit3 K s))
        + Module.finrank K (Submodule.span K (orbit3 K r)) →
      dualRel K r = Submodule.span K (orbit3 K s) := fun hle hdim => by
    refine (Submodule.eq_of_le_of_finrank_le hle ?_).symm
    rw [finrank_dualRel]
    omega
  refine ⟨key (le_dualRel K h) hdim, key (le_dualRel K fun y hy x hx τ σ => ?_) (by omega)⟩
  rw [pair3_comm]
  exact h x hx y hy σ τ

name: Operad.FreeBin.le_finrank_of_private
statement:
lemma le_finrank_of_private {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] {W : Submodule K (FreeBin K G (Fin 3))}
    (v : ι → FreeBin K G (Fin 3)) (hv : ∀ i, v i ∈ W) (f : ι → Mono3 G)
    (h : ∀ i j, (basis3 K).repr (v j) (f i) ≠ 0 ↔ j = i) :
    Fintype.card ι ≤ Module.finrank K W
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hli : LinearIndependent K v := by
    rw [linearIndependent_iff']
    intro t c hc i hi
    have := congrArg (fun x => (basis3 K).repr x (f i)) hc
    simp only [map_sum, map_smul, Finsupp.coe_finsetSum, Finset.sum_apply, Finsupp.coe_smul,
      Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, map_zero, Finsupp.coe_zero, Pi.zero_apply] at this
    rw [Finset.sum_eq_single i (fun b _ hb => by rw [not_not.1 (mt (h i b).1 hb), mul_zero])
      (fun h' => absurd hi h')] at this
    exact (mul_eq_zero.1 this).resolve_right ((h i i).2 rfl)
  rw [← finrank_span_eq_card hli]
  exact Submodule.finrank_mono (Submodule.span_le.2 (Set.range_subset_iff.2 hv))

name: Operad.FreeBin.BinPres.dual_eq
statement:
theorem BinPres.dual_eq {r s : Set (FreeBin K G (Fin 3))}
    (h : dualRel K r = Submodule.span K (orbit3 K s)) :
    SymOperadIdeal.span K (rel23 (∅ : Set (FreeBin K G (Fin 2))) (dualRel K r : Set _))
      = SymOperadIdeal.span K (rel23 (∅ : Set (FreeBin K G (Fin 2))) s)
proof:
:=
  span_eq_of_span_orbit3_eq K (by rw [span_orbit3_dualRel, h])

name: Operad.FreeBin.perm3_021_mul_self
statement: lemma perm3_021_mul_self : perm3 0 2 1 * perm3 0 2 1 = 1
proof: := by decide

name: Operad.FreeBin.sign_perm3_021
statement: lemma sign_perm3_021 : Equiv.Perm.sign (perm3 0 2 1) = -1
proof: := by decide

name: Operad.FreeBin.perm3_021_ne_one
statement: lemma perm3_021_ne_one : perm3 0 2 1 ≠ 1
proof: := by decide

name: Operad.FreeBin.mul_perm3_021_eq_iff
statement: lemma mul_perm3_021_eq_iff {σ τ : Equiv.Perm (Fin 3)} : σ * perm3 0 2 1 = τ ↔ σ = τ * perm3 0 2 1
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun h => by rw [← h, mul_assoc, perm3_021_mul_self, mul_one],
    fun h => by rw [h, mul_assoc, perm3_021_mul_self, mul_one]⟩

name: Operad.FreeBin.mul_perm3_021_mul_self
statement:
lemma mul_perm3_021_mul_self (σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin 3)) :
    σ * perm3 0 2 1 * perm3 0 2 1 = σ
proof:
:= by
  rw [mul_assoc, perm3_021_mul_self, mul_one]

name: Operad.FreeBin.cyc3_inj
statement: lemma cyc3_inj (j k : Fin 3) : cyc3 j = cyc3 k ↔ j = k
proof:
:= by
  revert j k; unfold cyc3; decide

name: Operad.FreeBin.cyc3_ne_mul
statement: lemma cyc3_ne_mul (j k : Fin 3) : cyc3 j ≠ cyc3 k * perm3 0 2 1
proof:
:= by
  revert j k; unfold cyc3; decide

name: Operad.FreeBin.map_assoc
statement:
lemma map_assoc (τ : Equiv.Perm (Fin 3)) :
    SymOperad.map (R := K) τ (BinRel.assoc K ()) = cL K τ - cR K τ
proof:
:= by
  simp only [BinRel.assoc, map_sub, map_binL, map_binR, mul_one]

name: Operad.FreeBin.map_perm
statement:
lemma map_perm (τ : Equiv.Perm (Fin 3)) :
    SymOperad.map (R := K) τ (BinRel.perm K ()) = cR K τ - cR K (τ * perm3 0 2 1)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [BinRel.perm, map_sub, map_binR, mul_one]

name: Operad.FreeBin.map_preLie
statement:
lemma map_preLie (τ : Equiv.Perm (Fin 3)) :
    SymOperad.map (R := K) τ (BinRel.preLie K ())
      = cL K τ - cR K τ - (cL K (τ * perm3 0 2 1) - cR K (τ * perm3 0 2 1))
proof:
:= by
  simp only [BinRel.preLie, map_sub, map_binL, map_binR, mul_one]

name: Operad.FreeBin.map_leib
statement:
lemma map_leib (τ : Equiv.Perm (Fin 3)) :
    SymOperad.map (R := K) τ (BinRel.leib K ())
      = cL K τ - (cL K (τ * perm3 0 2 1) + cR K τ)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [BinRel.leib, map_sub, map_add, map_binL, map_binR, mul_one]

name: Operad.FreeBin.map_zinb
statement:
lemma map_zinb (τ : Equiv.Perm (Fin 3)) :
    SymOperad.map (R := K) τ (BinRel.zinb K ())
      = cL K τ - (cR K τ + cR K (τ * perm3 0 2 1))
proof:
:= by
  simp only [BinRel.zinb, map_sub, map_add, map_binL, map_binR, mul_one]

name: Operad.FreeBin.dualRel_assoc
statement:
theorem dualRel_assoc :
    dualRel K {BinRel.assoc K ()} = Submodule.span K (orbit3 K {BinRel.assoc K ()})
proof:
:= by
  have h := le_finrank_of_private K (fun σ => SymOperad.map (R := K) σ (BinRel.assoc K ()))
    (fun σ => mem_orbit3 K (Set.mem_singleton _) σ) (fun σ => (false, (), (), σ)) fun i j => by
      by_cases h : j = i <;> simp [map_assoc, repr_mono3, h]
  refine (dualRel_eq_of_orthogonal K (fun x hx y hy σ τ => ?_) ?_).1
  · rw [Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hx hy
    subst hx hy
    simp only [map_assoc, map_sub, LinearMap.sub_apply, pair3_mono3, Prod.mk.injEq, sign3]
    split_ifs <;> simp_all
  · simp only [Fintype.card_perm, Fintype.card_fin, Fintype.card_unit] at h ⊢
    simp only [show (3 : ℕ).factorial = 6 from rfl] at h
    omega

name: Operad.FreeBin.dualRel_leib_zinb
statement:
theorem dualRel_leib_zinb :
    dualRel K {BinRel.leib K ()} = Submodule.span K (orbit3 K {BinRel.zinb K ()}) ∧
      dualRel K {BinRel.zinb K ()} = Submodule.span K (orbit3 K {BinRel.leib K ()})
proof:
:= by
  have h₁ := le_finrank_of_private K (fun σ => SymOperad.map (R := K) σ (BinRel.zinb K ()))
    (fun σ => mem_orbit3 K (Set.mem_singleton _) σ) (fun σ => (false, (), (), σ)) fun i j => by
      by_cases h : j = i <;> simp [map_zinb, repr_mono3, h]
  have h₂ := le_finrank_of_private K (fun σ => SymOperad.map (R := K) σ (BinRel.leib K ()))
    (fun σ => mem_orbit3 K (Set.mem_singleton _) σ) (fun σ => (true, (), (), σ)) fun i j => by
      by_cases h : j = i <;> simp [map_leib, repr_mono3, h]
  refine dualRel_eq_of_orthogonal K (fun x hx y hy σ τ => ?_) ?_
  · rw [Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hx hy
    subst hx hy
    simp [map_leib, map_zinb, pair3_mono3, sign3, mul_perm3_021_eq_iff, Equiv.Perm.sign_mul,
      sign_perm3_021]
    split_ifs <;> simp_all
  · simp only [Fintype.card_perm, Fintype.card_fin, Fintype.card_unit] at h₁ h₂ ⊢
    simp only [show (3 : ℕ).factorial = 6 from rfl] at h₁ h₂
    omega

name: Operad.FreeBin.dualRel_preLie_perm
proof:
:= by
  have h₁ := le_finrank_of_private K
    (fun k => SymOperad.map (R := K) (cyc3 k) (BinRel.preLie K ()))
    (fun k => mem_orbit3 K (Set.mem_singleton _) _) (fun k => (false, (), (), cyc3 k))
    fun i j => by
      by_cases h : j = i <;>
        simp [map_preLie, repr_mono3, h, mul_perm3_021_eq_iff, cyc3_inj, cyc3_ne_mul,
          perm3_021_ne_one]
  have hA := fun τ => mem_orbit3 K (r := {BinRel.assoc K (), BinRel.perm K ()})
    (Set.mem_insert _ _) τ
  have hP := fun τ => mem_orbit3 K (r := {BinRel.assoc K (), BinRel.perm K ()})
    (Set.mem_insert_of_mem _ (Set.mem_singleton _)) τ
  have h₂ := le_finrank_of_private K
    (fun i : Fin 3 × Fin 3 => ![cL K (cyc3 i.1) - cR K (cyc3 i.1 * perm3 0 2 1),
      cL K (cyc3 i.1 * perm3 0 2 1) - cR K (cyc3 i.1 * perm3 0 2 1),
      cR K (cyc3 i.1) - cR K (cyc3 i.1 * perm3 0 2 1)] i.2)
    (fun i => by
      obtain ⟨k, a⟩ := i
      fin_cases a
      · have := add_mem (hA (cyc3 k)) (hP (cyc3 k))
        rw [map_assoc, map_perm, sub_add_sub_cancel] at this
        exact this
      · have := hA (cyc3 k * perm3 0 2 1)
        rwa [map_assoc] at this
      · have := hP (cyc3 k)
        rwa [map_perm] at this)
    (fun i => ![(false, (), (), cyc3 i.1), (false, (), (), cyc3 i.1 * perm3 0 2 1),
      (true, (), (), cyc3 i.1)] i.2)
    (by
      rintro ⟨k, a⟩ ⟨j, b⟩
      fin_cases a <;> fin_cases b <;> by_cases h : j = k <;>
        simp [h, repr_mono3, mul_perm3_021_eq_iff, cyc3_inj, cyc3_ne_mul, perm3_021_ne_one])
  refine (dualRel_eq_of_orthogonal K (fun x hx y hy σ τ => ?_) ?_)
  · rw [Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hy
    subst hy
    rcases hx with rfl | hx
    · simp [map_preLie, map_assoc, pair3_mono3, sign3, mul_perm3_021_eq_iff,
        Equiv.Perm.sign_mul, sign_perm3_021]
      split_ifs <;> simp_all
    · rw [Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hx
      subst hx
      simp [map_preLie, map_perm, pair3_mono3, sign3, mul_perm3_021_eq_iff,
        Equiv.Perm.sign_mul, sign_perm3_021]
      split_ifs <;> simp_all
  · simp only [Fintype.card_prod, Fintype.card_fin, Fintype.card_unit] at h₁ h₂ ⊢
    omega

name: Operad.FreeBin.finrank_dendRel
statement: lemma finrank_dendRel : 18 ≤ Module.finrank K (Submodule.span K (orbit3 K (dendRel K)))
proof:
:=
  le_finrank_of_private K
    (fun i : Fin 3 × Equiv.Perm (Fin 3) => SymOperad.map (R := K) i.2
      (![BinRel.dend₁ K, BinRel.dend₂ K, BinRel.dend₃ K] i.1))
    (fun i => mem_orbit3 K (by obtain ⟨k, τ⟩ := i; fin_cases k <;> simp) _)
    (fun i => (![true, false, false] i.1, ![DiOp.left, .left, .right] i.1,
      ![DiOp.right, .right, .left] i.1, i.2))
    (by
      rintro ⟨k, τ⟩ ⟨k', τ'⟩
      fin_cases k <;> fin_cases k' <;> by_cases h : τ' = τ <;>
        simp [h, repr_mono3, BinRel.dend₁, BinRel.dend₂, BinRel.dend₃, map_binL, map_binR])

name: Operad.FreeBin.finrank_diasRel
statement: lemma finrank_diasRel : 30 ≤ Module.finrank K (Submodule.span K (orbit3 K (diasRel K)))
proof:
:=
  le_finrank_of_private K
    (fun i : Fin 5 × Equiv.Perm (Fin 3) => SymOperad.map (R := K) i.2
      (![BinRel.dias₁ K, BinRel.dias₂ K, BinRel.dias₃ K, BinRel.dias₄ K, BinRel.dias₅ K] i.1))
    (fun i => mem_orbit3 K (by obtain ⟨k, τ⟩ := i; fin_cases k <;> simp) _)
    (fun i => (![true, true, false, false, false] i.1,
      ![DiOp.left, .left, .left, .right, .right] i.1,
      ![DiOp.left, .right, .right, .left, .right] i.1, i.2))
    (by
      rintro ⟨k, τ⟩ ⟨k', τ'⟩
      fin_cases k <;> fin_cases k' <;> by_cases h : τ' = τ <;>
        simp [h, repr_mono3, BinRel.dias₁, BinRel.dias₂, BinRel.dias₃, BinRel.dias₄, BinRel.dias₅,
          map_binL, map_binR])

name: Operad.FreeBin.pair3_dendRel_diasRel
statement:
lemma pair3_dendRel_diasRel : ∀ x ∈ diasRel K, ∀ y ∈ dendRel K, ∀ σ τ : Equiv.Perm (Fin 3),
    pair3 DiOp K (SymOperad.map (R := K) τ y) (SymOperad.map (R := K) σ x) = 0
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx y hy σ τ
  simp only [Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hx hy
  rcases hx with rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl <;> rcases hy with rfl | rfl | rfl <;>
    simp [BinRel.dend₁, BinRel.dend₂, BinRel.dend₃, BinRel.dias₁, BinRel.dias₂, BinRel.dias₃,
      BinRel.dias₄, BinRel.dias₅, map_binL, map_binR, pair3_mono3, sign3] <;>
    split_ifs <;> simp_all

name: Operad.FreeBin.dualRel_dend_dias
statement:
theorem dualRel_dend_dias :
    dualRel K (dendRel K) = Submodule.span K (orbit3 K (diasRel K)) ∧
      dualRel K (diasRel K) = Submodule.span K (orbit3 K (dendRel K))
proof:
:= by
  refine dualRel_eq_of_orthogonal K (pair3_dendRel_diasRel K) ?_
  have := finrank_dendRel K
  have := finrank_diasRel K
  rw [show Fintype.card DiOp = 2 from rfl]
  omega

name: Operad.BinAss.dual
statement: theorem BinAss.dual : BinPres.dual K {BinRel.assoc K ()} = BinAss K
proof:
:=
  congrArg SymOperadIdeal.Quot (BinPres.dual_eq K (dualRel_assoc K))

name: Operad.PreLie.dual
statement: theorem PreLie.dual : BinPres.dual K {BinRel.preLie K ()} = BinPerm K
proof:
:=
  congrArg SymOperadIdeal.Quot (BinPres.dual_eq K (dualRel_preLie_perm K).1)

name: Operad.BinPerm.dual
statement: theorem BinPerm.dual : BinPres.dual K {BinRel.assoc K (), BinRel.perm K ()} = PreLie K
proof:
:=
  congrArg SymOperadIdeal.Quot (BinPres.dual_eq K (dualRel_preLie_perm K).2)

name: Operad.Leib.dual
statement: theorem Leib.dual : BinPres.dual K {BinRel.leib K ()} = Zinb K
proof:
:=
  congrArg SymOperadIdeal.Quot (BinPres.dual_eq K (dualRel_leib_zinb K).1)

name: Operad.Zinb.dual
statement: theorem Zinb.dual : BinPres.dual K {BinRel.zinb K ()} = Leib K
proof:
:=
  congrArg SymOperadIdeal.Quot (BinPres.dual_eq K (dualRel_leib_zinb K).2)

name: Operad.Dend.dual
statement: theorem Dend.dual : BinPres.dual K (dendRel K) = BinDias K
proof:
:=
  congrArg SymOperadIdeal.Quot (BinPres.dual_eq K (dualRel_dend_dias K).1)

name: Operad.BinDias.dual
statement: theorem BinDias.dual : BinPres.dual K (diasRel K) = Dend K
proof:
:=
  congrArg SymOperadIdeal.Quot (BinPres.dual_eq K (dualRel_dend_dias K).2)

name: Operad.map_finCongr_self
statement: lemma map_finCongr_self {n : ℕ} (h : n = n) (x : P (Fin n)) : map (R := R) (finCongr h) x = x
proof:
:= by
  rw [finCongr_refl, map_refl]

name: Operad.lcomp_eq_nsc
statement:
lemma lcomp_eq_nsc (d : P (Fin 1)) {n : ℕ} (x : P (Fin n)) :
    lcomp R (toUnit (R := R) d) x = map (R := R) (finCongr (by omega)) (nsc R 0 0 d x)
proof:
:= by
  rw [lcomp_apply, toUnit, comp_map_left unitFinOne.symm (⟨0, by omega⟩ : Fin (0 + 1 + 0)) ()
    rfl, ← map_trans, nsc, ← map_trans]
  refine congrArg (fun e => map (R := R) e _) (Equiv.ext fun z => ?_)
  rcases z with ⟨⟨k, hk⟩, hne⟩ | j
  · exact absurd (Fin.ext (by omega)) hne
  · refine Fin.ext ?_
    show (j : ℕ) = 0 + (j : ℕ)
    omega

name: Operad.rcomp_eq_nsc
statement:
lemma rcomp_eq_nsc (d : P (Fin 1)) (a b : ℕ) (i : Fin (a + 1 + b)) (hi : i.val = a)
    (x : P (Fin (a + 1 + b))) :
    rcomp R (toUnit (R := R) d) i x = nsc R a b x d
proof:
:= by
  obtain rfl : i = ⟨a, by clear hi; omega⟩ := Fin.ext hi
  rw [rcomp_apply, toUnit, comp_map_right]
  erw [← map_trans]
  rw [nsc]
  refine congrArg (fun e => map (R := R) e _) (Equiv.ext fun z => ?_)
  rcases z with ⟨⟨k, hk⟩, hne⟩ | j
  · have hka : k ≠ a := fun e => hne (Fin.ext e)
    refine Fin.ext ?_
    rw [Equiv.trans_apply, insertEquiv_inl_val]
    show k = _
    dsimp only
    split_ifs <;> omega
  · refine Fin.ext ?_
    show a = a + (j : ℕ)
    have := j.isLt
    omega

name: Operad.innerL_nsc
statement:
lemma innerL_nsc (D : P Unit) (hD : par (R := R) true D = D) (a b : ℕ) {n : ℕ}
    (x : P (Fin (a + 1 + b))) (y : P (Fin n)) :
    innerL R D (nsc R a b x y)
      = nsc R a b (innerL R D x) y + nsc R a b (tw (R := R) true x) (innerL R D y)
proof:
:= by
  rw [nsc, innerL_map, innerL_comp D hD, map_add]
  rfl

name: Operad.BVGer.relOf_eq_zero
statement: lemma relOf_eq_zero {n : ℕ} (r : BV.Rel n) : BV.relOf R (mB R) (dB R) r = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [show mB R = (GrOperadIdeal.span R (BV.rel R)).projHom.app _ (BV.μ R) from rfl,
    show dB R = (GrOperadIdeal.span R (BV.rel R)).projHom.app _ (BV.Δ R) from rfl,
    ← BV.app_relOf]
  exact ((GrOperadIdeal.span R (BV.rel R)).proj_eq_zero_iff _).2
    (GrOperadIdeal.subset_span _ ⟨r, rfl⟩)

name: Operad.BVGer.par_mB
statement: lemma par_mB : par (R := R) false (mB R) = mB R
proof: := FreeGr.par_presGen (gp := bvPar) BVGen.mul

name: Operad.BVGer.par_dB
statement: lemma par_dB : par (R := R) true (dB R) = dB R
proof: := FreeGr.par_presGen (gp := bvPar) BVGen.op

name: Operad.BVGer.par_DB
statement: lemma par_DB : par (R := R) true (DB R) = DB R
proof:
:= by
  rw [DB, toUnit, ← map_par, par_dB]

name: Operad.BVGer.DB_DB
statement: lemma DB_DB : comp (R := R) () (DB R) (DB R) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : comp (R := R) (⟨0, by omega⟩ : Fin (0 + 1 + 0)) (dB R) (dB R) = 0 := by
    have h := congrArg (map (R := R) (insertEquiv 0 0 1).symm) (relOf_eq_zero R BV.Rel.sq)
    rwa [BV.relOf, nsc, ← map_trans, Equiv.self_trans_symm, map_refl,
      map_zero (map (R := R) (insertEquiv 0 0 1).symm)] at h
  show comp (R := R) (unitFinOne.symm ⟨0, by omega⟩) (map (R := R) unitFinOne.symm (dB R))
    (map (R := R) unitFinOne.symm (dB R)) = 0
  rw [← map_comp, h1]
  exact map_zero _

name: Operad.BVGer.bB_eq
statement: lemma bB_eq : bB R = innerL R (DB R) (mB R)
proof:
:= by
  have h0 : lcomp R (DB R) (mB R) = nsc R 0 0 (dB R) (mB R) :=
    (lcomp_eq_nsc (dB R) (mB R)).trans (map_finCongr_self _ _)
  have h1 : rcomp R (DB R) 0 (mB R) = nsc R 0 1 (mB R) (dB R) :=
    rcomp_eq_nsc (dB R) 0 1 0 rfl (mB R)
  have h2 : rcomp R (DB R) 1 (mB R) = nsc R 1 0 (mB R) (dB R) :=
    rcomp_eq_nsc (dB R) 1 0 1 rfl (mB R)
  show BV.devOf R (mB R) (dB R) = _
  rw [innerL_apply, tw_hom true (par_mB R), Bool.true_and, σ_false, one_smul, Fin.sum_univ_two,
    h0, h1, h2, BV.devOf, sub_sub]

name: Operad.BVGer.par_bB
statement: lemma par_bB : par (R := R) true (bB R) = bB R
proof:
:= by
  have h := innerL_hom (DB R) (par_DB R) (par_mB R)
  rwa [← bB_eq] at h

name: Operad.BVGer.innerL_bB
statement: lemma innerL_bB : innerL R (DB R) (bB R) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have h := innerL_innerL (DB R) (par_DB R) (DB_DB R) (mB R)
  rwa [← bB_eq] at h

name: Operad.BVGer.ger_relOf_eq_zero
statement: theorem ger_relOf_eq_zero {n : ℕ} (r : Ger.Rel n) : Ger.relOf R (mB R) (bB R) r = 0
proof:
:= by
  cases r
  · exact relOf_eq_zero R BV.Rel.comm
  · have h := congrArg (innerL R (DB R)) (relOf_eq_zero R BV.Rel.comm)
    rw [BV.relOf, map_sub, innerL_map, ← bB_eq, map_zero] at h
    exact h
  · exact relOf_eq_zero R BV.Rel.assoc
  · exact relOf_eq_zero R BV.Rel.order
  · have h := congrArg (innerL R (DB R)) (relOf_eq_zero R BV.Rel.order)
    rw [BV.relOf, map_sub, map_sub, innerL_map] at h
    have e1 : innerL R (DB R) (A := Fin 3) (nsc R 1 0 (bB R) (mB R))
        = nsc R 1 0 (innerL R (DB R) (bB R)) (mB R)
          + nsc R 1 0 (tw (R := R) true (bB R)) (innerL R (DB R) (mB R)) :=
      innerL_nsc (DB R) (par_DB R) 1 0 (bB R) (mB R)
    have e2 : innerL R (DB R) (A := Fin 3) (nsc R 0 1 (mB R) (bB R))
        = nsc R 0 1 (innerL R (DB R) (mB R)) (bB R)
          + nsc R 0 1 (tw (R := R) true (mB R)) (innerL R (DB R) (bB R)) :=
      innerL_nsc (DB R) (par_DB R) 0 1 (mB R) (bB R)
    have e3 : innerL R (DB R) (A := Fin 3) (nsc R 1 0 (mB R) (bB R))
        = nsc R 1 0 (innerL R (DB R) (mB R)) (bB R)
          + nsc R 1 0 (tw (R := R) true (mB R)) (innerL R (DB R) (bB R)) :=
      innerL_nsc (DB R) (par_DB R) 1 0 (mB R) (bB R)
    rw [e1, e2, e3] at h
    rw [← bB_eq, innerL_bB,
      tw_hom true (par_mB R), tw_hom true (par_bB R), map_zero] at h
    simp only [Bool.true_and, σ_false, σ_true, one_smul, neg_one_smul] at h
    rw [Ger.relOf, ← neg_eq_zero, ← h]
    simp only [nsc, map_zero, map_neg, LinearMap.zero_apply, LinearMap.neg_apply, zero_add,
      add_zero]
    abel

name: Operad.BVGer.gerToBV_mul
statement:
lemma gerToBV_mul :
    (gerToBV R).app _ (FreeGr.presGen (Ger.rel R) GerGen.mul) = mB R
proof:
:= by
  rw [gerToBV, FreeGr.presHomEquiv_symm_gen]
  rfl

name: Operad.BVGer.gerToBV_br
statement:
lemma gerToBV_br :
    (gerToBV R).app _ (FreeGr.presGen (Ger.rel R) GerGen.br) = bB R
proof:
:= by
  rw [gerToBV, FreeGr.presHomEquiv_symm_gen]
  rfl

name: Operad.BVGer.innerL_mem_range
statement:
lemma innerL_mem_range {A : Type} [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] (q : GerOp R A) :
    ∃ q', (gerToBV R).app A q' = innerL R (DB R) ((gerToBV R).app A q)
proof:
:= by
  have h : q ∈ (innerSub R).sub A := FreeGr.mem_of_presGen (innerSub R) (fun k e => by
    cases e
    · show ∃ q', (gerToBV R).app _ q'
        = innerL R (DB R) ((gerToBV R).app _ (FreeGr.presGen (Ger.rel R) GerGen.mul))
      refine ⟨FreeGr.presGen (Ger.rel R) GerGen.br, ?_⟩
      rw [gerToBV_mul, gerToBV_br, bB_eq]
    · show ∃ q', (gerToBV R).app _ q'
        = innerL R (DB R) ((gerToBV R).app _ (FreeGr.presGen (Ger.rel R) GerGen.br))
      refine ⟨0, ?_⟩
      rw [gerToBV_br, innerL_bB, map_zero]) q
  exact h

name: Operad.BVGer.Rl_nil
statement: lemma Rl_nil (x : BVOp R A) : Rl R [] x = x
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.BVGer.Rl_cons
statement:
lemma Rl_cons (a : A) (l : List A) (x : BVOp R A) :
    Rl R (a :: l) x = rcomp R (DB R) a (Rl R l x)
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.BVGer.Rl_map
statement:
lemma Rl_map {A' : Type} [Fintype A'] [DecidableEq A'] (e : A ≃ A') :
    ∀ (l : List A) (x : BVOp R A), map (R := R) e (Rl R l x) = Rl R (l.map e) (map (R := R) e x)
  | [], _ => rfl
  | a :: l, x => by rw [Rl_cons, List.map_cons, Rl_cons, ← Rl_map e l, rcomp_map]

name: Operad.BVGer.par_rcomp
statement:
lemma par_rcomp {p : Bool} {x : BVOp R A} (hx : par (R := R) p x = x) (a : A) :
    par (R := R) (!p) (rcomp R (DB R) a x) = rcomp R (DB R) a x
proof:
:= by
  rw [rcomp_apply, ← map_par, par_comp_hom a (Bool.xor_true p) hx (par_DB R)]

name: Operad.BVGer.par_Rl
statement:
lemma par_Rl : ∀ (l : List A) {p : Bool} {x : BVOp R A}, par (R := R) p x = x →
    ∃ p', par (R := R) p' (Rl R l x) = Rl R l x
  | [], p, _, hx => ⟨p, hx⟩
  | a :: l, _, _, hx => by
    obtain ⟨p', h⟩
proof:
:= par_Rl l hx
    exact ⟨!p', par_rcomp h a⟩

name: Operad.BVGer.gen_mem_SB
statement:
lemma gen_mem_SB (l : List A) {q : GerOp R A} {p : Bool} (hq : par (R := R) p q = q) :
    Rl R l ((gerToBV R).app A q) ∈ SB R A
proof:
:=
  Submodule.subset_span ⟨l, q, p, hq, rfl⟩

name: Operad.BVGer.app_mem_SB
statement: lemma app_mem_SB (l : List A) (q : GerOp R A) : Rl R l ((gerToBV R).app A q) ∈ SB R A
proof:
:= by
  rw [← par_add (R := R) q, map_add, map_add]
  exact add_mem (gen_mem_SB l (par_par_self false q)) (gen_mem_SB l (par_par_self true q))

name: Operad.BVGer.SB_le
statement:
lemma SB_le {A' : Type} [Fintype A'] [DecidableEq A'] (f : BVOp R A →ₗ[R] BVOp R A')
    (h : ∀ (l : List A) (q : GerOp R A) (p : Bool), par (R := R) p q = q →
      f (Rl R l ((gerToBV R).app A q)) ∈ SB R A') {x : BVOp R A} (hx : x ∈ SB R A) :
    f x ∈ SB R A'
proof:
:= by
  refine (Submodule.span_le.2 ?_ : SB R A ≤ (SB R A').comap f) hx
  rintro _ ⟨l, q, p, hq, rfl⟩
  exact h l q p hq

name: Operad.BVGer.par_mem_SB
statement:
lemma par_mem_SB (b : Bool) {x : BVOp R A} (hx : x ∈ SB R A) :
    par (R := R) b x ∈ SB R A
proof:
:= by
  refine SB_le (par (R := R) b) (fun l q p hq => ?_) hx
  have hq' : par (R := R) p ((gerToBV R).app A q) = (gerToBV R).app A q := by
    rw [← GrOperadHom.app_par, hq]
  obtain ⟨p', h⟩ := par_Rl l hq'
  rw [← h, par_par]
  split_ifs
  · rw [h]
    exact gen_mem_SB l hq
  · exact zero_mem _

name: Operad.BVGer.rcomp_mem_SB
statement:
lemma rcomp_mem_SB (a : A) {x : BVOp R A} (hx : x ∈ SB R A) :
    rcomp R (DB R) a x ∈ SB R A
proof:
:=
  SB_le _ (fun l _ _ hq => gen_mem_SB (a :: l) hq) hx

name: Operad.BVGer.Rl_mem_SB
statement:
lemma Rl_mem_SB : ∀ (l : List A) {x : BVOp R A}, x ∈ SB R A → Rl R l x ∈ SB R A
  | [], _, hx => hx
  | a :: l, _, hx => rcomp_mem_SB a (Rl_mem_SB l hx)

name: Operad.BVGer.tw_mem_SB
statement: lemma tw_mem_SB {x : BVOp R A} (hx : x ∈ SB R A) : tw (R := R) true x ∈ SB R A
proof:
:= by
  rw [tw_true]
  exact sub_mem (par_mem_SB false hx) (par_mem_SB true hx)

name: Operad.BVGer.map_mem_SB
statement:
lemma map_mem_SB {A' : Type} [Fintype A'] [DecidableEq A'] (e : A ≃ A') {x : BVOp R A}
    (hx : x ∈ SB R A) : map (R := R) e x ∈ SB R A'
proof:
:= by
  refine SB_le (map (R := R) e) (fun l q p hq => ?_) hx
  rw [Rl_map, ← GrOperadHom.app_map]
  exact gen_mem_SB _ (by rw [← map_par, hq])

name: Operad.BVGer.lcomp_Rl
statement:
lemma lcomp_Rl : ∀ (l : List A) (x : BVOp R A),
    lcomp R (DB R) (Rl R l x) = Rl R l (lcomp R (DB R) x)
  | [], _ => rfl
  | a :: l, x => by rw [Rl_cons, lcomp_rcomp, lcomp_Rl l, Rl_cons]

name: Operad.BVGer.lcomp_mem_SB
statement: lemma lcomp_mem_SB {x : BVOp R A} (hx : x ∈ SB R A) : lcomp R (DB R) x ∈ SB R A
proof:
:= by
  refine SB_le _ (fun l q p hq => ?_) hx
  rw [lcomp_Rl]
  refine Rl_mem_SB l ?_
  have h := innerL_apply (R := R) (DB R) ((gerToBV R).app A q)
  rw [eq_sub_iff_add_eq] at h
  rw [← h]
  obtain ⟨q', hq'⟩ := innerL_mem_range R q
  rw [← hq']
  refine add_mem (app_mem_SB ([] : List A) q') (sum_mem fun a _ => ?_)
  rw [← GrOperadHom.app_tw]
  exact app_mem_SB [a] _

name: Operad.BVGer.comp_gen_mem_SB
statement:
lemma comp_gen_mem_SB (i : A) (q : GerOp R A) {y : BVOp R B} (hy : y ∈ SB R B) :
    comp (R := R) i ((gerToBV R).app A q) y ∈ SB R (Without A i ⊕ B)
proof:
:= by
  refine SB_le (comp (R := R) i ((gerToBV R).app A q)) (fun l q' p hq => ?_) hy
  have key : ∀ l : List B, comp (R := R) i ((gerToBV R).app A q)
      (Rl R l ((gerToBV R).app B q'))
        = Rl R (l.map Sum.inr) ((gerToBV R).app _ (comp (R := R) i q q')) := by
    intro l
    induction l with
    | nil => exact (GrOperadHom.app_comp _ i q q').symm
    | cons b l ih => rw [Rl_cons, ← rcomp_comp_inr, ih, List.map_cons, Rl_cons]
  rw [key]
  exact app_mem_SB _ _

name: Operad.BVGer.comp_mem_SB
statement:
lemma comp_mem_SB (i : A) {x : BVOp R A} (hx : x ∈ SB R A) {y : BVOp R B} (hy : y ∈ SB R B) :
    comp (R := R) i x y ∈ SB R (Without A i ⊕ B)
proof:
:= by
  have key : ∀ (l : List A) (q : GerOp R A) {y : BVOp R B}, y ∈ SB R B →
      comp (R := R) i (Rl R l ((gerToBV R).app A q)) y ∈ SB R (Without A i ⊕ B) := by
    intro l q
    induction l with
    | nil => exact fun hy => comp_gen_mem_SB i q hy
    | cons a l ih =>
      intro y hy
      by_cases hai : a = i
      · subst hai
        rw [Rl_cons, comp_rcomp_self]
        exact ih (lcomp_mem_SB hy)
      · rw [Rl_cons, ← tw_tw (R := R) true y, ← rcomp_comp_inl _ (par_DB R) hai]
        exact rcomp_mem_SB _ (ih (tw_mem_SB hy))
  refine (Submodule.span_le.2 ?_ :
    SB R A ≤ (SB R (Without A i ⊕ B)).comap ((comp (R := R) i).flip y)) hx
  rintro _ ⟨l, q, -, -, rfl⟩
  exact key l q hy

name: Operad.BVGer.rcomp_one
statement: lemma rcomp_one (D : BVOp R Unit) : rcomp R D () (one (R := R) (P := BVOp R)) = D
proof:
:= by
  have he : rightUnitEquiv () = leftUnitEquiv Unit := Equiv.ext fun _ => Subsingleton.elim _ _
  rw [rcomp_apply, he, one_comp]

name: Operad.BVGer.mem_SB
statement: theorem mem_SB (x : BVOp R A) : x ∈ SB R A
proof:
:= by
  refine FreeGr.mem_of_presGen (SBsub (R := R)) (fun k e => ?_) x
  cases e
  · show mB R ∈ SB R (Fin 2)
    rw [← gerToBV_mul R]
    exact app_mem_SB (R := R) ([] : List (Fin 2)) (FreeGr.presGen (Ger.rel R) GerGen.mul)
  · show dB R ∈ SB R (Fin 1)
    have h : dB R = map (R := R) unitFinOne (DB R) := by
      rw [DB, toUnit, ← map_trans, Equiv.symm_trans_self, map_refl]
    rw [h]
    refine map_mem_SB _ ?_
    rw [← rcomp_one (DB R), ← (gerToBV R).app_one]
    exact app_mem_SB [()] _

name: Operad.Cobar.hM_ι
statement: lemma hM_ι (v : CobarGen R 𝒞 A) : hM R V A ((FreeGrL.ι R (CobarGen R 𝒞)).app A v) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [GrSpeciesHom.app_eq_chart (FreeGrL.ι R (CobarGen R 𝒞)) (Fintype.equivFin A).symm,
    FreeGrL.ι_app_fin]
  show (cobarMerge R V).d A (GrOperad.map (R := R) (Fintype.equivFin A).symm
    ((𝒥Ω).proj _ (gen _) + (𝒥Ω).proj _ (gen _))) = 0
  rw [← (cobarMerge R V).map_d, map_add, (cobarMerge R V).d_gen, (cobarMerge R V).d_gen,
    add_zero, map_zero]

name: Operad.Cobar.hM_ιL
statement: lemma hM_ιL (c : 𝒞 A) : hM R V A (Cobar.ιL R 𝒞 A c) = 0
proof: := hM_ι _

name: Operad.Cobar.mM_ι_fin
statement:
lemma mM_ι_fin {k l : ℕ} {v : CobarGen R 𝒞 (Fin k)} {b : Bool}
    (hv : GrSpecies.par (R := R) b v = v) (i : Fin k) (w : CobarGen R 𝒞 (Fin l)) (m : ℕ)
    (h : m + 1 = k + l) :
    mM R V i ((FreeGrL.ι R (CobarGen R 𝒞)).app (Fin k) v)
        ((FreeGrL.ι R (CobarGen R 𝒞)).app (Fin l) w)
      = GrOperad.map (R := R) (posEquivF i l m h).symm
          ((FreeGrL.ι R (CobarGen R 𝒞)).app (Fin m) (cobarVal R V b v i w m h))
proof:
:= by
  have hi : (i : ℕ) < k ∧ m + 1 = k + l := ⟨i.2, h⟩
  have key : ∀ c : Bool, mM R V i ((FreeGrL.ι R (CobarGen R 𝒞)).app (Fin k) v)
      (presGen (grLinRel R (CobarGen R 𝒞)) (GrGen.part c w))
        = GrOperad.map (R := R) (posEquivF i l m h).symm
            ((FreeGrL.ι R (CobarGen R 𝒞)).app (Fin m)
              (cobarVal R V b v i (GrSpecies.par (R := R) c w) m h)) := by
    intro c
    rw [FreeGrL.ι_app_hom (R := R) (V := CobarGen R 𝒞) hv]
    show (cobarMerge R V).mc i ((𝒥Ω).proj _ (gen _)) ((𝒥Ω).proj _ (gen _)) = _
    rw [(cobarMerge R V).mc_gen _ i _ m h]
    congr 1
    have hp : GrSpecies.par (R := R) (!(xor b c))
        (cobarVal R V b v i (GrSpecies.par (R := R) c w) m h)
        = cobarVal R V b v i (GrSpecies.par (R := R) c w) m h :=
      (cobarMerge R V).par _ _ _ _ _ _ _ hv (GrSpecies.par_par_self (R := R) c w)
    rw [FreeGrL.ι_app_hom (R := R) (V := CobarGen R 𝒞) hp]
    show (𝒥Ω).proj _ (gen ((cobarMerge R V).fn k l _ i _ m)) = (𝒥Ω).proj _ (gen _)
    congr 2
    refine Subtype.ext (Prod.ext ?_ ?_)
    · exact (cobarMerge R V).fn_val _ _ hi
    · exact (cobarMerge R V).fn_par _ _
  have e : cobarVal R V b v i (GrSpecies.par (R := R) false w) m h
      + cobarVal R V b v i (GrSpecies.par (R := R) true w) m h = cobarVal R V b v i w m h :=
    ((cobarMerge R V).add_right b v i _ _ m h).symm.trans
      (congrArg (fun y => cobarVal R V b v i y m h) (GrSpecies.par_add (R := R) w))
  have hw := FreeGrL.ι_app_fin (R := R) (V := CobarGen R 𝒞) w
  have h2 := congrArg (mM R V i ((FreeGrL.ι R (CobarGen R 𝒞)).app (Fin k) v)) hw
  refine h2.trans ?_
  refine ((mM R V i ((FreeGrL.ι R (CobarGen R 𝒞)).app (Fin k) v)).map_add _ _).trans ?_
  refine (congrArg₂ (· + ·) (key false) (key true)).trans ?_
  exact ((GrOperad.map (R := R) (posEquivF i l m h).symm).map_add _ _).symm.trans
    (congrArg (GrOperad.map (R := R) (posEquivF i l m h).symm)
      ((((FreeGrL.ι R (CobarGen R 𝒞)).app (Fin m)).map_add _ _).symm.trans
        (congrArg ((FreeGrL.ι R (CobarGen R 𝒞)).app (Fin m)) e)))

name: Operad.Cobar.ι_cobarVal
statement:
lemma ι_cobarVal {k l : ℕ} (b : Bool) (v : CobarGen R 𝒞 (Fin k)) (i : Fin k)
    (w : CobarGen R 𝒞 (Fin l)) (m : ℕ) (h : m + 1 = k + l) :
    (FreeGrL.ι R (CobarGen R 𝒞)).app (Fin m) (cobarVal R V b v i w m h)
      = σ R b • Cobar.ιL R 𝒞 (Fin m) (GrOperad.map (R := R) (posEquivF i l m h)
          (GrOperad.comp (R := R) i (FreeGrL.secR R V (Fin k) v) (FreeGrL.secR R V (Fin l) w)))
proof:
:=
  map_smul ((FreeGrL.ι R (CobarGen R 𝒞)).app (Fin m)) (σ R b) _

name: Operad.Cobar.mM_ιL_fin
statement:
lemma mM_ιL_fin {k l : ℕ} {c : 𝒞 (Fin k)} {pa : Bool} (hc : GrOperad.par (R := R) pa c = c)
    (i : Fin k) (c' : 𝒞 (Fin l)) :
    mM R V i (Cobar.ιL R 𝒞 (Fin k) c) (Cobar.ιL R 𝒞 (Fin l) c')
      = σ R (!pa) • Cobar.ιL R 𝒞 _ (GrOperad.comp (R := R) i (FreeGrL.secC R V (Fin k) c)
          (FreeGrL.secC R V (Fin l) c'))
proof:
:= by
  have hk : 0 < k := Fin.pos i
  have hm : (k + l - 1) + 1 = k + l := by omega
  have hv : GrSpecies.par (R := R) (!pa)
      (GrSpecies.Shift.of (R := R) (V := GrCooperad.Red R 𝒞) (Fin k)
        (GrCooperad.Red.proj R 𝒞 (Fin k) c))
      = GrSpecies.Shift.of (R := R) (V := GrCooperad.Red R 𝒞) (Fin k)
          (GrCooperad.Red.proj R 𝒞 (Fin k) c) := by
    rw [GrSpecies.Shift.par_of, Bool.not_not, GrCooperad.Red.par_proj]
    exact congrArg (fun x => GrSpecies.Shift.of (R := R) (V := GrCooperad.Red R 𝒞) (Fin k)
      (GrCooperad.Red.proj R 𝒞 (Fin k) x)) hc
  have e := mM_ι_fin (R := R) (V := V) hv i (GrSpecies.Shift.of (R := R)
    (V := GrCooperad.Red R 𝒞) (Fin l) (GrCooperad.Red.proj R 𝒞 (Fin l) c')) _ hm
  refine e.trans ?_
  rw [ι_cobarVal, map_smul, ← Cobar.ιL_map]
  show σ R (!pa) • Cobar.ιL R 𝒞 _ (GrOperad.map (R := R) (posEquivF i l (k + l - 1) hm).symm
    (GrOperad.map (R := R) (posEquivF i l (k + l - 1) hm) _)) = _
  rw [map_symm_map]
  rfl

name: Operad.Cobar.ιF_apply
statement:
private lemma ιF_apply (y : FreeGr R (grGenPar R V) A) :
    ConvOp.toLin ((ιF R V).1 A) y = Cobar.ιL R 𝒞 A ((𝒥).proj A y)
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.Cobar.isParC_ιF
statement:
private lemma isParC_ιF (A : Type) [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] :
    ConvOp.IsParC true ((ιF R V).1 A)
proof:
:=
  ConvOp.parC_eq_self_iff.1
    (((ConvOp.preHom (P := CobarGr R 𝒞) (FreeGrL.projHom R V)).app_par true
      ((Cobar.ι R 𝒞).1 A)).symm.trans
      (congrArg ((ConvOp.preHom (P := CobarGr R 𝒞) (FreeGrL.projHom R V)).app A)
        (Cobar.isPar_ι R 𝒞 A)))

name: Operad.Cobar.ιF_leaf
statement:
private lemma ιF_leaf {x : Reg (TreeOfArity (GrGen R V)) A} (hx : (treeOf x).isLeaf = true) :
    ConvOp.toLin ((ιF R V).1 A) (SgnLin.bas (treeSgn (grGenPar R V)) R x) = 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨e, rfl⟩ := eq_map_one_of_isLeaf hx
  rw [ιF_apply, ← SgnLin.map_bas]
  exact Cobar.ιL_unitSpan R 𝒞 (GrCooperad.map_one_mem e)

name: Operad.Cobar.ιι_proj
proof:
:=
  congrArg (fun q : GrOperad.Inv R (ConvOp R (FreeGr R (grGenPar R V)) (CobarGr R 𝒞)) =>
    ConvOp.toLin (q.1 A) y)
    (GrOperad.Inv.appHom_star (ConvOp.preHom (P := CobarGr R 𝒞) (FreeGrL.projHom R V))
      (Cobar.ι R 𝒞) (Cobar.ι R 𝒞))

name: Operad.Cobar.hM_comp_ιL
statement:
lemma hM_comp_ιL {k l : ℕ} {c : 𝒞 (Fin k)} {pa : Bool} (hc : GrOperad.par (R := R) pa c = c)
    (i : Fin k) (c' : 𝒞 (Fin l)) :
    hM R V _ (GrOperad.comp (R := R) i (Cobar.ιL R 𝒞 (Fin k) c) (Cobar.ιL R 𝒞 (Fin l) c'))
      = σ R (!pa) • Cobar.ιL R 𝒞 _ (GrOperad.comp (R := R) i (FreeGrL.secC R V (Fin k) c)
          (FreeGrL.secC R V (Fin l) c'))
proof:
:= by
  refine ((cobarMerge R V).d_comp i _ _).trans ?_
  have h1 : (cobarMerge R V).d (Fin k) (Cobar.ιL R 𝒞 (Fin k) c) = 0 := hM_ιL c
  have h2 : (cobarMerge R V).d (Fin l) (Cobar.ιL R 𝒞 (Fin l) c') = 0 := hM_ιL c'
  refine (congrArg₂ (fun a b => GrOperad.comp (R := R) i a (Cobar.ιL R 𝒞 (Fin l) c')
    + GrOperad.comp (R := R) i (GrOperad.tw (R := R) true (Cobar.ιL R 𝒞 (Fin k) c)) b
    + mM R V i (Cobar.ιL R 𝒞 (Fin k) c) (Cobar.ιL R 𝒞 (Fin l) c')) h1 h2).trans ?_
  refine Eq.trans ?_ (mM_ιL_fin hc i c')
  simp only [map_zero, LinearMap.zero_apply, zero_add]

name: Operad.Cobar.unitCoeffL_bas
statement:
lemma unitCoeffL_bas {x : Reg (TreeOfArity (GrGen R V)) A} (hx : (treeOf x).isLeaf = false) :
    FreeGrL.unitCoeffL R V A ((𝒥).proj A (SgnLin.bas (treeSgn (grGenPar R V)) R x)) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [FreeGrL.unitCoeffL_proj, unitCoeff_bas, if_neg (by rw [hx]; decide)]

name: Operad.Cobar.ιL_proj_smul
statement:
lemma ιL_proj_smul (c : R) (y : FreeGr R (grGenPar R V) A) :
    Cobar.ιL R 𝒞 A ((𝒥).proj A (c • y)) = c • Cobar.ιL R 𝒞 A ((𝒥).proj A y)
proof:
:= by
  rw [map_smul, map_smul]

name: Operad.Cobar.ιL_proj_map
statement:
lemma ιL_proj_map (e : A ≃ B) (y : FreeGr R (grGenPar R V) A) :
    GrOperad.map (R := R) e (Cobar.ιL R 𝒞 A ((𝒥).proj A y))
      = Cobar.ιL R 𝒞 B ((𝒥).proj B (GrOperad.map (R := R) e y))
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Cobar.ιL_map]
  rfl

name: Operad.Cobar.unitCoeffL_ι
statement:
lemma unitCoeffL_ι (v : CobarGen R 𝒞 A) :
    FreeGrL.unitCoeffL R (CobarGen R 𝒞) A ((FreeGrL.ι R (CobarGen R 𝒞)).app A v) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [GrSpeciesHom.app_eq_chart (FreeGrL.ι R (CobarGen R 𝒞)) (Fintype.equivFin A).symm,
    FreeGrL.ι_app_fin]
  show FreeGrL.unitCoeffL R (CobarGen R 𝒞) A (GrOperad.map (R := R) _
    ((𝒥Ω).proj _ (gen _) + (𝒥Ω).proj _ (gen _))) = 0
  rw [FreeGrL.unitCoeffL_map, map_add, FreeGrL.unitCoeffL_proj, FreeGrL.unitCoeffL_proj,
    unitCoeff_gen, unitCoeff_gen, add_zero]

name: Operad.Cobar.unitCoeffL_ιL
statement:
lemma unitCoeffL_ιL (c : 𝒞 A) :
    FreeGrL.unitCoeffL R (CobarGen R 𝒞) A (Cobar.ιL R 𝒞 A c) = 0
proof: := unitCoeffL_ι _

name: Operad.Cobar.repW_ιF
proof:
:= by
  have e1 : ConvOp.toLin ((ιF R V).1 A)
      (GrSpecies.tw (R := R) true (SgnLin.bas (treeSgn (grGenPar R V)) R p))
      = σ R (Tree.tpar (grGenPar R V) (treeOf p)) •
          Cobar.ιL R 𝒞 A ((𝒥).proj A (SgnLin.bas (treeSgn (grGenPar R V)) R p)) := by
    rw [ιF_apply, tw_bas, ιL_proj_smul]
  unfold repW repI
  refine congrArg (GrOperad.map (R := R) e) ?_
  refine (congrArg (fun z => σ R (cSgn (grGenPar R V) i p q) • GrOperad.comp (R := R) i z
    (Cobar.ιL R 𝒞 B ((𝒥).proj B (SgnLin.bas (treeSgn (grGenPar R V)) R q)))) e1).trans ?_
  exact (congrArg (fun z => σ R (cSgn (grGenPar R V) i p q) • z)
    (LinearMap.map_smul₂ _ _ _ _)).trans (smul_smul _ _ _)

name: Operad.Cobar.starI_eq
proof:
:=
  (starV_eq (ιF R V) (ιF R V) h hq).trans (repW_ιF i p q e)

name: Operad.Cobar.d_ιL_bas
statement:
theorem d_ιL_bas (t : Reg (TreeOfArity (GrGen R V)) X) (ht : (treeOf t).NoNull) :
    (Cobar.d R 𝒞).app X
        (Cobar.ιL R 𝒞 X ((𝒥).proj X (SgnLin.bas (treeSgn (grGenPar R V)) R t)))
      = -∑ v ∈ Finset.Ico 1 (treeOf t).weight, starI R V t v
proof:
:= by
  have h1 := Cobar.d_ιL R 𝒞 ((𝒥).proj X (SgnLin.bas (treeSgn (grGenPar R V)) R t))
  rw [ιι_proj, star_bas (ιF R V) (ιF R V) isParC_ιF (fun _ _ _ x hx => ιF_leaf hx)
    (fun _ _ _ x hx => ιF_leaf hx) t] at h1
  have hfilter : (Finset.Ico 1 (treeOf t).weight).filter
      (fun v => 0 < ((treeOf t).cutV v).2.1.arity) = Finset.Ico 1 (treeOf t).weight :=
    Finset.filter_true_of_mem fun v hv =>
      ((ht.cutV (Finset.mem_Ico.1 hv).2).2).arity_pos
  rw [hfilter] at h1
  exact h1

name: Operad.Cobar.hM_repI
statement:
lemma hM_repI {k l : ℕ} (i : Fin k) (p : Reg (TreeOfArity (GrGen R V)) (Fin k))
    (q : Reg (TreeOfArity (GrGen R V)) (Fin l)) (e : Without (Fin k) i ⊕ Fin l ≃ X)
    (hp : (treeOf p).isLeaf = false) (hq : (treeOf q).isLeaf = false) :
    hM R V X (repI R V e p q)
      = -Cobar.ιL R 𝒞 X ((𝒥).proj X (SgnLin.bas (treeSgn (grGenPar R V)) R
          (SetOperad.map e (SetOperad.comp i p q))))
proof:
:= by
  have hpa : GrOperad.par (R := R) (Tree.tpar (grGenPar R V) (treeOf p))
      ((𝒥).proj (Fin k) (SgnLin.bas (treeSgn (grGenPar R V)) R p))
      = (𝒥).proj (Fin k) (SgnLin.bas (treeSgn (grGenPar R V)) R p) :=
    congrArg ((𝒥).proj (Fin k)) (SgnLin.par_bas p)
  have e2 := hM_comp_ιL (R := R) (V := V) hpa i
    ((𝒥).proj (Fin l) (SgnLin.bas (treeSgn (grGenPar R V)) R q))
  have e3 : FreeGrL.secC R V (Fin k) ((𝒥).proj (Fin k) (SgnLin.bas (treeSgn (grGenPar R V)) R p))
      = (𝒥).proj (Fin k) (SgnLin.bas (treeSgn (grGenPar R V)) R p) :=
    FreeGrL.secC_of_unitCoeff (unitCoeffL_bas hp)
  have e4 : FreeGrL.secC R V (Fin l) ((𝒥).proj (Fin l) (SgnLin.bas (treeSgn (grGenPar R V)) R q))
      = (𝒥).proj (Fin l) (SgnLin.bas (treeSgn (grGenPar R V)) R q) :=
    FreeGrL.secC_of_unitCoeff (unitCoeffL_bas hq)
  have e5 : GrOperad.comp (R := R) i
      ((𝒥).proj (Fin k) (SgnLin.bas (treeSgn (grGenPar R V)) R p))
      ((𝒥).proj (Fin l) (SgnLin.bas (treeSgn (grGenPar R V)) R q))
      = σ R (cSgn (grGenPar R V) i p q) • (𝒥).proj _ (SgnLin.bas (treeSgn (grGenPar R V)) R
          (SetOperad.comp i p q)) := by
    show (𝒥).proj _ (GrOperad.comp (R := R) i _ _) = _
    rw [comp_bas_eq, map_smul]
  have e6 : GrOperad.comp (R := R) i
      (FreeGrL.secC R V (Fin k) ((𝒥).proj (Fin k) (SgnLin.bas (treeSgn (grGenPar R V)) R p)))
      (FreeGrL.secC R V (Fin l) ((𝒥).proj (Fin l) (SgnLin.bas (treeSgn (grGenPar R V)) R q)))
      = σ R (cSgn (grGenPar R V) i p q) • (𝒥).proj _ (SgnLin.bas (treeSgn (grGenPar R V)) R
          (SetOperad.comp i p q)) := by
    rw [e3, e4, e5]
  have e7 := e2.trans (congrArg (fun z => σ R (!(Tree.tpar (grGenPar R V) (treeOf p))) •
    Cobar.ιL R 𝒞 _ z) e6)
  have e8 := ιL_proj_smul (R := R) (V := V) (σ R (cSgn (grGenPar R V) i p q))
    (SgnLin.bas (treeSgn (grGenPar R V)) R (SetOperad.comp i p q))
  have s1 : repI R V e p q = GrOperad.map (R := R) e ((σ R (cSgn (grGenPar R V) i p q)
      * σ R (Tree.tpar (grGenPar R V) (treeOf p))) •
      GrOperad.comp (R := R) i
        (Cobar.ιL R 𝒞 (Fin k) ((𝒥).proj (Fin k) (SgnLin.bas (treeSgn (grGenPar R V)) R p)))
        (Cobar.ιL R 𝒞 (Fin l) ((𝒥).proj (Fin l) (SgnLin.bas (treeSgn (grGenPar R V)) R q)))) :=
    rfl
  have s2 := ((cobarMerge R V).map_d e ((σ R (cSgn (grGenPar R V) i p q)
          * σ R (Tree.tpar (grGenPar R V) (treeOf p))) •
          GrOperad.comp (R := R) i
            (Cobar.ιL R 𝒞 (Fin k) ((𝒥).proj (Fin k) (SgnLin.bas (treeSgn (grGenPar R V)) R p)))
            (Cobar.ιL R 𝒞 (Fin l) ((𝒥).proj (Fin l) (SgnLin.bas (treeSgn (grGenPar R V)) R q)))))
  refine (congrArg (hM R V X) s1).trans (s2.symm.trans ?_)
  refine (congrArg (GrOperad.map (R := R) e) ((map_smul _ _ _).trans
    (congrArg _ (e7.trans (congrArg _ e8))))).trans ?_
  have hsign : σ R (cSgn (grGenPar R V) i p q) * σ R (Tree.tpar (grGenPar R V) (treeOf p))
      * σ R (!(Tree.tpar (grGenPar R V) (treeOf p))) * σ R (cSgn (grGenPar R V) i p q) = -1 := by
    generalize Tree.tpar (grGenPar R V) (treeOf p) = a
    generalize cSgn (grGenPar R V) i p q = c
    cases a <;> cases c <;> simp
  have hW := (ιL_proj_map (R := R) (V := V) e
    (SgnLin.bas (treeSgn (grGenPar R V)) R (SetOperad.comp i p q))).trans
    (congrArg (fun y => Cobar.ιL R 𝒞 X ((𝒥).proj X y)) (SgnLin.map_bas e _))
  rw [smul_smul, smul_smul, hsign, neg_one_smul, map_neg]
  exact congrArg Neg.neg hW

name: Operad.Cobar.hM_starI
statement:
theorem hM_starI (t : Reg (TreeOfArity (GrGen R V)) X) {v : ℕ}
    (hv : v ∈ Finset.Ico 1 (treeOf t).weight) :
    hM R V X (starI R V t v)
      = -Cobar.ιL R 𝒞 X ((𝒥).proj X (SgnLin.bas (treeSgn (grGenPar R V)) R t))
proof:
:= by
  rw [Finset.mem_Ico] at hv
  obtain ⟨e, he⟩ := exists_rep t hv.2
  have hst := starI_eq (R := R) (V := V) he (Tree.isLeaf_cutV _ _ hv.2)
  have hvert : vert ⟨((treeOf t).cutV v).2.2, Tree.lt_arity_cutV _ v hv.2⟩
      (stdT ((treeOf t).cutV v).1) = v := by
    show (treeOf (stdT _)).vb ((stdT _).1.rank _) = v
    rw [treeOf_stdT, rank_stdT]
    exact Tree.vb_cutV _ _ hv.2
  rw [hvert] at hst
