  refine (congrArg (hM R V X) hst).trans ((hM_repI _ (stdT ((treeOf t).cutV v).1)
    (stdT ((treeOf t).cutV v).2.1) e
    (Tree.isLeaf_cutV_fst hv.1 hv.2 rfl) (Tree.isLeaf_cutV _ _ hv.2)).trans ?_)
  rw [he]

name: Operad.Cobar.hM_d_ιL_bas
statement:
theorem hM_d_ιL_bas (t : Reg (TreeOfArity (GrGen R V)) X) (ht : (treeOf t).NoNull) :
    hM R V X ((Cobar.d R 𝒞).app X
        (Cobar.ιL R 𝒞 X ((𝒥).proj X (SgnLin.bas (treeSgn (grGenPar R V)) R t))))
      = ((treeOf t).weight - 1) •
          Cobar.ιL R 𝒞 X ((𝒥).proj X (SgnLin.bas (treeSgn (grGenPar R V)) R t))
proof:
:= by
  refine (congrArg (hM R V X) (d_ιL_bas t ht)).trans ?_
  rw [map_neg, map_sum, Finset.sum_congr rfl fun v hv => hM_starI t hv, Finset.sum_neg_distrib,
    neg_neg, Finset.sum_const, Nat.card_Ico]

name: Operad.Hadamard.map_fst
statement:
@[simp] lemma map_fst (e : A ≃ B) (x : Hadamard S T A) :
    (SetOperad.map e x).1 = SetOperad.map e x.1

name: Operad.Hadamard.map_snd

@[simp] lemma map_snd (e : A ≃ B) (x : Hadamard S T A) :

name: Operad.Hadamard.one_fst

name: Operad.Hadamard.one_snd
statement: @[simp] lemma one_snd : (SetOperad.one : Hadamard S T Unit).2 = SetOperad.one

proof: := rfl

statement:
@[simp] lemma fst_comp_lift (φ : SetOperadHom U S) (ψ : SetOperadHom U T) :

proof: := rfl

name: Operad.Hadamard.snd_comp_lift
statement:
@[simp] lemma snd_comp_lift (φ : SetOperadHom U S) (ψ : SetOperadHom U T) :

proof: := rfl

name: Operad.Hadamard.lift_unique
statement:
lemma lift_unique (φ : SetOperadHom U S) (ψ : SetOperadHom U T)
    (χ : SetOperadHom U (Hadamard S T)) (h₁ : fst.comp χ = φ) (h₂ : snd.comp χ = ψ) :
    χ = lift φ ψ
proof:
:= by
  subst h₁ h₂
  rfl

name: Operad.Hadamard.prodMap_app
statement:
@[simp] lemma prodMap_app (φ : SetOperadHom S S') (ψ : SetOperadHom T T') (x : Hadamard S T A) :
    (prodMap φ ψ).app A x = (φ.app A x.1, ψ.app A x.2)
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.Hadamard.prodMap_injective
proof:
:=
  fun _ _ h => Prod.ext (hφ (congrArg Prod.fst h)) (hψ (congrArg Prod.snd h))

name: Operad.PointedSet.comp_self
statement: @[simp] lemma comp_self (i : A) (b : B) : comp i i b = Sum.inr b
proof: := dif_pos rfl

name: Operad.PointedSet.comp_of_ne
statement: lemma comp_of_ne {i a : A} (h : a ≠ i) (b : B) : comp i a b = Sum.inl ⟨a, h⟩
proof: := dif_neg h

name: Operad.NonemptySubset.exists_compFun
statement:
lemma exists_compFun (i : A) {s : A → Bool} {t : B → Bool} (hs : ∃ a, s a = true)
    (ht : ∃ b, t b = true) : ∃ c, compFun i s t c = true
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := hs
  by_cases h : a = i
  · subst h
    obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := ht
    exact ⟨Sum.inr b, by simp [compFun, ha, hb]⟩
  · exact ⟨Sum.inl ⟨a, h⟩, ha⟩

name: Operad.Hadamard.nestL_fst
statement: @[simp] lemma nestL_fst (p q : Hadamard S T (Fin 2)) : (nestL p q).1 = nestL p.1 q.1
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.Hadamard.nestL_snd
statement: @[simp] lemma nestL_snd (p q : Hadamard S T (Fin 2)) : (nestL p q).2 = nestL p.2 q.2
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.Hadamard.nestR_fst
statement: @[simp] lemma nestR_fst (p q : Hadamard S T (Fin 2)) : (nestR p q).1 = nestR p.1 q.1

name: Operad.Sym.LinOrd.rank_lt_card
statement: lemma rank_lt_card (x : LinOrd A) (a : A) : x.rank a < Fintype.card A
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [← Finset.card_univ]
  refine Finset.card_lt_card ((Finset.ssubset_iff_of_subset (Finset.filter_subset _ _)).2 ?_)
  exact ⟨a, Finset.mem_univ _, by simp [x.irrefl]⟩

name: Operad.Sym.LinOrd.rank_lt_rank
statement: lemma rank_lt_rank (x : LinOrd A) {a b : A} (h : x.lt a b) : x.rank a < x.rank b
proof:
:= by
  classical
  refine Finset.card_lt_card ((Finset.ssubset_iff_of_subset fun c hc => ?_).2 ?_)
  · simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and] at hc ⊢
    exact x.trans _ _ _ hc h
  · exact ⟨a, by simp [h], by simp [x.irrefl]⟩

name: Operad.Sym.LinOrd.lt_iff_rank_lt
statement: lemma lt_iff_rank_lt (x : LinOrd A) (a b : A) : x.lt a b ↔ x.rank a < x.rank b
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨x.rank_lt_rank, fun h => ?_⟩
  by_cases hab : a = b
  · subst hab
    exact absurd h (lt_irrefl _)
  · rcases x.total a b hab with h' | h'
    · exact h'
    · exact absurd (x.rank_lt_rank h') (not_lt.2 h.le)

name: Operad.Sym.LinOrd.rank_injective
statement: lemma rank_injective (x : LinOrd A) : Function.Injective x.rank
proof:
:= by
  intro a b h
  by_contra hab
  rcases x.total a b hab with h' | h'
  · exact (x.rank_lt_rank h').ne h
  · exact (x.rank_lt_rank h').ne' h

name: Operad.Sym.LinOrd.rank_ofRank
statement: lemma rank_ofRank {n : ℕ} (e : A ≃ Fin n) (a : A) : (ofRank e).rank a = e a
proof:
:= by
  calc (ofRank e).rank a = ((Finset.Iio (e a)).map e.symm.toEmbedding).card := by
        unfold rank
        congr 1
        ext b
        simp [ofRank]
    _ = e a := by rw [Finset.card_map, Fin.card_Iio]

name: Operad.Sym.LinOrd.card
statement: theorem card [DecidableEq A] : Nat.card (LinOrd A) = (Fintype.card A).factorial
proof:
:= by
  rw [Nat.card_congr equivRank, Nat.card_eq_fintype_card,
    Fintype.card_equiv (Fintype.equivFin A)]

name: Operad.Sym.LinOrd.nestL_std
statement:
theorem nestL_std : nestL (S := fun A _ _ => LinOrd A) (std 2) (std 2)
    = nestR (S := fun A _ _ => LinOrd A) (std 2) (std 2)
proof:
:= by
  refine LinOrd.ext ?_
  rintro (⟨⟩ | ⟨⟩ | ⟨⟩) (⟨⟩ | ⟨⟩ | ⟨⟩) <;>
    simp [nestL, nestR, bin, binEquiv, slotOne, SetOperad.map, SetOperad.comp, SetOperad.one,
      LinOrd.compLt, LinOrd.one]

name: Operad.Sym.Ass.finrank
statement:
theorem Sym.Ass.finrank (R : Type u) [CommRing R] [Nontrivial R] (A : Type) [Fintype A]
    [DecidableEq A] : Module.finrank R (Ass R A) = (Fintype.card A).factorial

name: Operad.PointedSet.linToPerm_apply
statement:
lemma linToPerm_apply {A : Type} [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] (x : A →₀ R) :
    (linToPerm R).app A x = ⇑x
proof:
:= by
  induction x using Finsupp.induction_linear with
  | zero => simp
  | add x y hx hy => rw [map_add, hx, hy, Finsupp.coe_add]
  | single a r =>
    show Finsupp.lift _ R _ _ (Finsupp.single a r) = _
    funext b
    simp [Finsupp.lift_apply, toPerm, Und.of, Pi.single_apply, Finsupp.single_apply, eq_comm]

name: Operad.PointedSet.toNonemptySubset_injective
statement:
lemma toNonemptySubset_injective (A : Type) [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] :
    Function.Injective (toNonemptySubset.app A)
proof:
:= by
  intro a b h
  have := congrArg (fun s : NonemptySubset A => s.1 a) h
  simpa [toNonemptySubset] using this

name: Operad.NonemptySubset.card
statement:
theorem card (A : Type) [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] :
    Fintype.card (NonemptySubset A) = 2 ^ Fintype.card A - 1
proof:
:= by
  have h : (Finset.univ.filter fun s : A → Bool => ∃ a, s a = true)
      = Finset.univ.erase (fun _ => false) := by
    ext s
    simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and, Finset.mem_erase, and_true, ne_eq]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨a, ha⟩ rfl
      simp at ha
    · intro hs
      by_contra h'
      exact hs (funext fun a => Bool.eq_false_iff.2 fun h => h' ⟨a, h⟩)
  rw [Fintype.card_subtype, h, Finset.card_erase_of_mem (Finset.mem_univ _), Finset.card_univ,
    Fintype.card_fun, Fintype.card_bool]

name: Operad.DiasSet.relations
statement:
theorem relations :
    nestL left left = nestR left left ∧ nestL left left = nestR left right ∧
      nestL left right = nestR right left ∧ nestL right left = nestR right right ∧
      nestL right right = nestR right right
proof:
:=
  ⟨Prod.ext LinOrd.nestL_std rfl, Prod.ext LinOrd.nestL_std rfl, Prod.ext LinOrd.nestL_std rfl,
    Prod.ext LinOrd.nestL_std rfl, Prod.ext LinOrd.nestL_std rfl⟩

name: Operad.DiasSet.card
statement:
theorem card (A : Type) [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] :
    Nat.card (DiasSet A) = Fintype.card A * (Fintype.card A).factorial
proof:
:= by
  rw [Nat.card_prod, LinOrd.card, Nat.card_eq_fintype_card, mul_comm]

name: Operad.DiasSet.toTrias_injective
statement:
lemma toTrias_injective (A : Type) [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] :
    Function.Injective (toTrias.app A)
proof:
:=
  Hadamard.prodMap_injective (fun _ _ h => h) (PointedSet.toNonemptySubset_injective A)

name: Operad.Dias.finrank
statement:
theorem Dias.finrank (R : Type u) [CommRing R] [Nontrivial R] (A : Type) [Fintype A]
    [DecidableEq A] :
    Module.finrank R (Dias R A) = Fintype.card A * (Fintype.card A).factorial

name: Operad.TriasSet.relations
statement:
theorem relations :
    nestL left left = nestR left left ∧ nestL left left = nestR left right ∧
      nestL left right = nestR right left ∧ nestL right left = nestR right right ∧
      nestL right right = nestR right right ∧ nestL left left = nestR left middle ∧
      nestL left middle = nestR middle left ∧ nestL middle left = nestR middle right ∧
      nestL middle right = nestR right middle ∧ nestL right middle = nestR right right ∧
      nestL middle middle = nestR middle middle
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩ <;>
    exact Prod.ext LinOrd.nestL_std (by decide)

name: Operad.TriasSet.card
statement:
theorem card (A : Type) [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] :
    Nat.card (TriasSet A) = (2 ^ Fintype.card A - 1) * (Fintype.card A).factorial
proof:
:= by
  rw [Nat.card_prod, LinOrd.card, Nat.card_eq_fintype_card, NonemptySubset.card, mul_comm]

name: Operad.TriasSet.toTrias_left
statement: lemma toTrias_left : DiasSet.toTrias.app _ DiasSet.left = left
proof:
:= by
  refine Prod.ext rfl (Subtype.ext ?_)
  decide

statement: lemma toTrias_right : DiasSet.toTrias.app _ DiasSet.right = right
proof:

  refine Prod.ext rfl (Subtype.ext ?_)
  decide

name: Operad.Trias.finrank
statement:
theorem Trias.finrank (R : Type u) [CommRing R] [Nontrivial R] (A : Type) [Fintype A]
    [DecidableEq A] :
    Module.finrank R (Trias R A) = (2 ^ Fintype.card A - 1) * (Fintype.card A).factorial

name: Operad.Dias.toTrias_injective
statement:
lemma Dias.toTrias_injective (R : Type u) [CommRing R] (A : Type) [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] :
    Function.Injective ((Dias.toTrias R).app A)
proof:
:=

name: Operad.reindex_rfl
statement:
@[simp]
lemma reindex_rfl {n : ℕ} (x : P n) : reindex R P (rfl : n = n) x = x
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.reindex_self
statement:
@[simp]
lemma reindex_self {n : ℕ} (h : n = n) (x : P n) : reindex R P h x = x
proof:
:= by
  obtain rfl : h = rfl := Subsingleton.elim _ _
  rfl

name: Operad.reindex_reindex
statement:
@[simp]
lemma reindex_reindex {l m n : ℕ} (h₁ : l = m) (h₂ : m = n) (x : P l) :
    reindex R P h₂ (reindex R P h₁ x) = reindex R P (h₁.trans h₂) x
proof:
:= by
  subst h₁; subst h₂; rfl

name: Operad.reindex_symm_apply
statement:
@[simp]
lemma reindex_symm_apply {m n : ℕ} (h : m = n) (x : P n) :
    (reindex R P h).symm x = reindex R P h.symm x
proof:
:= by
  subst h; rfl

name: Operad.reindex_injective
statement: lemma reindex_injective {m n : ℕ} (h : m = n) : Function.Injective (reindex R P h)
proof:
:=
  (reindex R P h).injective

name: Operad.reindex_eq_iff
statement:
lemma reindex_eq_iff {m n : ℕ} (h : m = n) (x y : P m) :
    reindex R P h x = reindex R P h y ↔ x = y
proof:
:=
  (reindex R P h).injective.eq_iff

name: Operad.NSOperad.comp_add_left
statement:
lemma comp_add_left (a b : ℕ) {n : ℕ} (α α' : P (a + 1 + b)) (β : P n) :
    comp (R := R) a b (α + α') β = comp (R := R) a b α β + comp (R := R) a b α' β
proof:
:= by
  rw [map_add]; rfl

name: Operad.NSOperad.comp_add_right
statement:
lemma comp_add_right (a b : ℕ) {n : ℕ} (α : P (a + 1 + b)) (β β' : P n) :
    comp (R := R) a b α (β + β') = comp (R := R) a b α β + comp (R := R) a b α β'
proof:
:=
  map_add _ _ _

name: Operad.NSOperad.comp_zero_left
statement:
lemma comp_zero_left (a b : ℕ) {n : ℕ} (β : P n) :
    comp (R := R) a b (0 : P (a + 1 + b)) β = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [map_zero]; rfl

name: Operad.NSOperad.comp_zero_right
statement:
@[simp]
lemma comp_zero_right (a b : ℕ) {n : ℕ} (α : P (a + 1 + b)) :
    comp (R := R) a b α (0 : P n) = 0
proof:
:=
  map_zero _

name: Operad.NSOperad.comp_smul_left
statement:
lemma comp_smul_left (a b : ℕ) {n : ℕ} (r : R) (α : P (a + 1 + b)) (β : P n) :
    comp (R := R) a b (r • α) β = r • comp (R := R) a b α β
proof:
:= by
  rw [map_smul]; rfl

name: Operad.NSOperad.comp_smul_right
statement:
lemma comp_smul_right (a b : ℕ) {n : ℕ} (r : R) (α : P (a + 1 + b)) (β : P n) :
    comp (R := R) a b α (r • β) = r • comp (R := R) a b α β
proof:
:=
  map_smul _ _ _

name: Operad.reindex_ass
statement:
@[simp]
lemma reindex_ass {m n : ℕ} (h : m = n) (x : Ass R m) :
    reindex R (Ass R) h x = x
proof:
:= by
  cases h; rfl

name: Operad.Tree.vb_graft_of_lt
statement:
theorem vb_graft_of_lt : ∀ (s : Tree E) (q : ℕ) (b : Tree E) (p : ℕ), p < q → q < s.arity →
    (s.graft q b).vb p = s.vb p
  | .leaf, q, _, p, hpq, hq => by simp at hq; omega
  | .node e f, q, b, p, hpq, hq => by
    simp only [graft_node, vb_node]
    rw [Forest.vbF_graftF_of_lt f q b p hpq hq]

name: Operad.Forest.vbF_graftF_of_lt
statement:
theorem _root_.Operad.Forest.vbF_graftF_of_lt : ∀ {k : ℕ} (f : Forest E k) (q : ℕ) (b : Tree E)
    (p : ℕ), p < q → q < f.arityF → (f.graftF q b).vbF p = f.vbF p
  | _, .nil, _, _, _, _, hq => by simp at hq
  | _, .cons t f, q, b, p, hpq, hq => by
    simp only [arityF_cons] at hq
    by_cases hqt : q < t.arity
    · have hpt : p < (t.graft q b).arity
proof:
:= by
        rw [arity_graft t q b hqt]
        omega
      rw [graftF_cons_of_lt b hqt, vbF_cons_of_lt hpt, vbF_cons_of_lt (by omega),
        vb_graft_of_lt t q b p hpq hqt]
    · rw [graftF_cons_of_ge b (by omega)]
      by_cases hpt : p < t.arity
      · rw [vbF_cons_of_lt hpt, vbF_cons_of_lt hpt]
      · rw [vbF_cons_of_ge (by omega), vbF_cons_of_ge (by omega),
          Forest.vbF_graftF_of_lt f (q - t.arity) b (p - t.arity) (by omega) (by omega)]

name: Operad.Tree.vb_graft_of_gt
statement:
theorem vb_graft_of_gt : ∀ (s : Tree E) (q : ℕ) (b : Tree E) (p : ℕ), q < p → p < s.arity →
    (s.graft q b).vb (p - 1 + b.arity) = s.vb p + b.weight
  | .leaf, q, _, p, hqp, hp => by simp at hp; omega
  | .node e f, q, b, p, hqp, hp => by
    simp only [graft_node, vb_node]
    rw [Forest.vbF_graftF_of_gt f q b p hqp hp]
    omega

name: Operad.Forest.vbF_graftF_of_gt
statement:
theorem _root_.Operad.Forest.vbF_graftF_of_gt : ∀ {k : ℕ} (f : Forest E k) (q : ℕ)
    (b : Tree E) (p : ℕ), q < p → p < f.arityF →
    (f.graftF q b).vbF (p - 1 + b.arity) = f.vbF p + b.weight
  | _, .nil, _, _, _, _, hp => by simp at hp
  | _, .cons t f, q, b, p, hqp, hp => by
    simp only [arityF_cons] at hp
    by_cases hqt : q < t.arity
    · rw [graftF_cons_of_lt b hqt]
      by_cases hpt : p < t.arity
      · have hpt' : p - 1 + b.arity < (t.graft q b).arity
proof:
:= by
          rw [arity_graft t q b hqt]
          omega
        rw [vbF_cons_of_lt hpt', vbF_cons_of_lt hpt, vb_graft_of_gt t q b p hqp hpt]
      · have hpt' : (t.graft q b).arity ≤ p - 1 + b.arity := by
          rw [arity_graft t q b hqt]
          omega
        rw [vbF_cons_of_ge hpt', vbF_cons_of_ge (by omega), weight_graft t q b hqt,
          arity_graft t q b hqt,
          show p - 1 + b.arity - (t.arity - 1 + b.arity) = p - t.arity by omega]
        omega
    · rw [graftF_cons_of_ge b (by omega), vbF_cons_of_ge (by omega), vbF_cons_of_ge (by omega),
        show p - 1 + b.arity - t.arity = p - t.arity - 1 + b.arity by omega,
        Forest.vbF_graftF_of_gt f (q - t.arity) b (p - t.arity) (by omega) (by omega)]
      omega

name: Operad.Tree.vb_graft_mid
statement:
theorem vb_graft_mid : ∀ (s : Tree E) (q : ℕ) (b : Tree E) (p : ℕ), q < s.arity → q ≤ p →
    p < q + b.arity → (s.graft q b).vb p = s.vb q + b.vb (p - q)
  | .leaf, q, b, p, hq, _, _ => by
    obtain rfl : q = 0
proof:
:= by simpa using hq
    simp
  | .node e f, q, b, p, hq, hqp, hpb => by
    simp only [graft_node, vb_node]
    rw [Forest.vbF_graftF_mid f q b p hq hqp hpb]
    omega

name: Operad.Forest.vbF_graftF_mid
statement:
theorem _root_.Operad.Forest.vbF_graftF_mid : ∀ {k : ℕ} (f : Forest E k) (q : ℕ) (b : Tree E)
    (p : ℕ), q < f.arityF → q ≤ p → p < q + b.arity →
    (f.graftF q b).vbF p = f.vbF q + b.vb (p - q)
  | _, .nil, _, _, _, hq, _, _ => by simp at hq
  | _, .cons t f, q, b, p, hq, hqp, hpb => by
    simp only [arityF_cons] at hq
    by_cases hqt : q < t.arity
    · have hpt : p < (t.graft q b).arity
proof:
:= by
        rw [arity_graft t q b hqt]
        omega
      rw [graftF_cons_of_lt b hqt, vbF_cons_of_lt hpt, vbF_cons_of_lt hqt,
        vb_graft_mid t q b p hqt hqp hpb]
    · rw [graftF_cons_of_ge b (by omega), vbF_cons_of_ge (by omega), vbF_cons_of_ge (by omega),
        Forest.vbF_graftF_mid f (q - t.arity) b (p - t.arity) (by omega) (by omega) (by omega),
        show p - t.arity - (q - t.arity) = p - q by omega]
      omega

name: Operad.Tree.noNull_leaf
statement: @[simp] lemma noNull_leaf : (Tree.leaf : Tree E).NoNull
proof: := trivial

name: Operad.Tree.noNull_node
statement:
@[simp] lemma noNull_node {k : ℕ} (e : E k) (f : Forest E k) :
    (Tree.node e f).NoNull ↔ 0 < k ∧ f.NoNullF
proof: := Iff.rfl

name: Operad.Tree.noNullF_nil
statement: @[simp] lemma noNullF_nil : (Forest.nil : Forest E 0).NoNullF
proof: := trivial

name: Operad.Tree.noNullF_cons
statement:
@[simp] lemma noNullF_cons {k : ℕ} (t : Tree E) (f : Forest E k) :
    (Forest.cons t f).NoNullF ↔ t.NoNull ∧ f.NoNullF
proof: := Iff.rfl

name: Operad.Tree.NoNull.arity_pos
statement:
theorem NoNull.arity_pos : ∀ {t : Tree E}, t.NoNull → 0 < t.arity
  | .leaf, _ => by simp
  | .node (k := k) _ f, h => by
    simp only [arity_node]
    have
proof:
:= Forest.NoNullF.le_arityF h.2
    have := h.1
    omega

name: Operad.Forest.NoNullF.le_arityF
statement:
theorem _root_.Operad.Forest.NoNullF.le_arityF : ∀ {k : ℕ} {f : Forest E k}, f.NoNullF →
    k ≤ f.arityF
  | _, .nil, _ => le_rfl
  | _, .cons t f, h => by
    simp only [arityF_cons]
    have
proof:
:= NoNull.arity_pos h.1
    have := Forest.NoNullF.le_arityF h.2
    omega

name: Operad.Tree.noNull_graft
statement:
theorem noNull_graft : ∀ (s : Tree E) (p : ℕ) (u : Tree E), p < s.arity →
    ((s.graft p u).NoNull ↔ s.NoNull ∧ u.NoNull)
  | .leaf, _, u, _ => by simp
  | .node (k := k) e f, p, u, hp => by
    simp only [graft_node, noNull_node]
    rw [Forest.noNullF_graftF f p u hp, and_assoc]

name: Operad.Forest.noNullF_graftF
statement:
theorem _root_.Operad.Forest.noNullF_graftF : ∀ {k : ℕ} (f : Forest E k) (p : ℕ) (u : Tree E),
    p < f.arityF → ((f.graftF p u).NoNullF ↔ f.NoNullF ∧ u.NoNull)
  | _, .nil, _, _, h => by simp at h
  | _, .cons t f, p, u, h => by
    simp only [arityF_cons] at h
    by_cases hpt : p < t.arity
    · rw [graftF_cons_of_lt u hpt, noNullF_cons, noNullF_cons, noNull_graft t p u hpt]
      tauto
    · rw [graftF_cons_of_ge u (by omega), noNullF_cons, noNullF_cons,
        Forest.noNullF_graftF f (p - t.arity) u (by omega)]
      tauto

end

name: Operad.Tree.NoNull.cutV
statement:
lemma NoNull.cutV {t : Tree E} (ht : t.NoNull) {v : ℕ} (hv : v < t.weight) :
    (t.cutV v).1.NoNull ∧ (t.cutV v).2.1.NoNull
proof:
:= by
  rw [← noNull_graft _ _ _ (lt_arity_cutV t v hv), graft_cutV t v hv]
  exact ht

name: Operad.Tree.exists_null
statement:
theorem exists_null : ∀ (t : Tree E), ¬ t.NoNull →
    ∃ (s : Tree E) (p : ℕ) (g : E 0), p < s.arity ∧ s.graft p (.node g .nil) = t
  | .leaf, h => absurd trivial h
  | .node (k := k) e f, h => by
    rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos k with hk | hk
    · subst hk
      cases f
      exact ⟨.leaf, 0, e, by simp, rfl⟩
    · obtain ⟨g, p, c, hp, hg⟩
proof:
:= Forest.exists_nullF f (fun hf => h ⟨hk, hf⟩)
      exact ⟨.node e g, p, c, hp, by rw [graft_node, hg]⟩

name: Operad.Forest.exists_nullF
statement:
theorem _root_.Operad.Forest.exists_nullF : ∀ {k : ℕ} (f : Forest E k), ¬ f.NoNullF →
    ∃ (g : Forest E k) (p : ℕ) (c : E 0), p < g.arityF ∧ g.graftF p (.node c .nil) = f
  | _, .nil, h => absurd trivial h
  | _, .cons t f, h => by
    by_cases ht : t.NoNull
    · obtain ⟨g, p, c, hp, hg⟩
proof:
:= Forest.exists_nullF f (fun hf => h ⟨ht, hf⟩)
      refine ⟨.cons t g, t.arity + p, c, by simp only [arityF_cons]; omega, ?_⟩
      rw [graftF_cons_of_ge _ (by omega), Nat.add_sub_cancel_left, hg]
    · obtain ⟨s, p, c, hp, hs⟩ := exists_null t ht
      refine ⟨.cons s f, p, c, by simp only [arityF_cons]; omega, ?_⟩
      rw [graftF_cons_of_lt _ hp, hs]

name: Operad.Tree.one_le_vb
statement: lemma one_le_vb {t : Tree E} (ht : t.isLeaf = false) (p : ℕ) : 1 ≤ t.vb p
proof:
:= by
  cases t with
  | leaf => simp [isLeaf] at ht
  | node e f => simp

name: Operad.Tree.one_le_weight
statement: lemma one_le_weight {t : Tree E} (ht : t.isLeaf = false) : 1 ≤ t.weight
proof:
:= by
  cases t with
  | leaf => simp [isLeaf] at ht
  | node e f => simp

name: Operad.FreeGr.treeOf_rep
proof:
:= by
  rw [← h, treeOf_map, treeOf_comp]

name: Operad.FreeGr.cutV_vert
proof:
:= by
  rw [treeOf_rep h]
  exact Tree.cutV_graft _ _ _ (rank_lt_arity p i) hq

name: Operad.FreeGr.weight_rep
proof:
:= by
  rw [treeOf_rep h, Tree.weight_graft _ _ _ (rank_lt_arity p i)]

name: Operad.FreeGr.vert_mem
proof:
:= by
  rw [Finset.mem_Ico, weight_rep h]
  show 1 ≤ (treeOf p).vb (p.1.rank i) ∧ (treeOf p).vb (p.1.rank i) < _
  have h1 := Tree.one_le_vb hp (p.1.rank i)
  have h2 := Tree.vb_le_weight (treeOf p) (p.1.rank i)
  have h3 := Tree.one_le_weight hq
  omega

name: Operad.FreeGr.eq_of_map_eq
statement:
lemma eq_of_map_eq {e e' : A ≃ B} {x : Reg (TreeOfArity T) A}
    (h : SetOperad.map e x = SetOperad.map e' x) : e = e'
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : LinOrd.map e x.1 = LinOrd.map e' x.1 := congrArg Prod.fst h
  ext a
  have r1 : (LinOrd.map e x.1).rank (e a) = x.1.rank a := by
    rw [LinOrd.rank_map, Equiv.symm_apply_apply]
  have r2 : (LinOrd.map e' x.1).rank (e' a) = x.1.rank a := by
    rw [LinOrd.rank_map, Equiv.symm_apply_apply]
  rw [← h1] at r2
  exact (LinOrd.map e x.1).rank_injective (r1.trans r2.symm)

name: Operad.FreeGr.treeOf_stdT
statement: @[simp] lemma treeOf_stdT (s : Tree T) : treeOf (stdT s) = s
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.FreeGr.rank_stdT
statement: @[simp] lemma rank_stdT (s : Tree T) (r : Fin s.arity) : (stdT s).1.rank r = r
proof:
:=
  LinOrd.rank_std _ r

name: Operad.FreeGr.exists_rep
statement:
lemma exists_rep (t : Reg (TreeOfArity T) X) {v : ℕ} (hv : v < (treeOf t).weight) :
    ∃ e : Without (Fin ((treeOf t).cutV v).1.arity)
        ⟨((treeOf t).cutV v).2.2, Tree.lt_arity_cutV _ v hv⟩ ⊕ Fin ((treeOf t).cutV v).2.1.arity
        ≃ X,
      SetOperad.map e (SetOperad.comp ⟨((treeOf t).cutV v).2.2, Tree.lt_arity_cutV _ v hv⟩
        (stdT ((treeOf t).cutV v).1) (stdT ((treeOf t).cutV v).2.1)) = t
proof:
:= by
  refine exists_map_eq ?_
  rw [treeOf_comp, treeOf_stdT, treeOf_stdT, rank_stdT]
  exact Tree.graft_cutV _ v hv

name: Operad.FreeGr.inv_toLin_map
statement:
lemma inv_toLin_map (q : GrOperad.Inv R (ConvOp R (FreeGr R gp) Q)) (e : A ≃ B)
    (y : FreeGr R gp A) :
    ConvOp.toLin (q.1 B) (GrOperad.map (R := R) e y)
      = GrOperad.map (R := R) e (ConvOp.toLin (q.1 A) y)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← GrOperad.Inv.map_apply q e]
  show GrOperad.map (R := R) e (ConvOp.toLin _ (GrOperad.map (R := R) e.symm
    (GrOperad.map (R := R) e y))) = _
  rw [map_symm_map]

name: Operad.FreeGr.repW_eq
proof:
:= by
  have c1 := cutV_vert (rfl : SetOperad.map e (SetOperad.comp i p q) = _) hq
  have c2 := cutV_vert h.symm hq'
  rw [hv, c2] at c1
  simp only [Prod.mk.injEq] at c1
  obtain ⟨hp1, hq1, hr1⟩ := c1
  obtain ⟨α, rfl⟩ := exists_map_eq hp1.symm
  obtain ⟨β, rfl⟩ := exists_map_eq hq1.symm
  have hi : α i = i' := by
    apply (SetOperad.map α p).1.rank_injective
    rw [hr1, map_fst, LinOrd.rank_map, Equiv.symm_apply_apply]
  subst hi
  rw [← SetOperad.map_comp, ← SetOperad.map_trans] at h
  obtain rfl := eq_of_map_eq h
  have hs : cSgn gp (α i) (SetOperad.map α p) (SetOperad.map β q) = cSgn gp i p q := by
    simp only [cSgn, treeOf_map, map_fst, LinOrd.rank_map, Equiv.symm_apply_apply]
  have htw : GrSpecies.tw (R := R) true (GrOperad.map (R := R) α (SgnLin.bas (treeSgn gp) R p))
      = GrOperad.map (R := R) α (GrSpecies.tw (R := R) true (SgnLin.bas (treeSgn gp) R p)) :=
    (GrSpecies.map_tw true α _).symm
  unfold repW
  rw [hs, ← SgnLin.map_bas, ← SgnLin.map_bas, htw, inv_toLin_map f α,
    inv_toLin_map g β, ← GrOperad.map_comp, GrOperad.map_trans, map_smul]

name: Operad.FreeGr.starV_eq
proof:
:= by
  have hv : vert i p < (treeOf t).weight := by
    rw [weight_rep h]
    show (treeOf p).vb (p.1.rank i) < _
    have h2 := Tree.vb_le_weight (treeOf p) (p.1.rank i)
    have h3 := Tree.one_le_weight hq
    omega
  rw [starV, dif_pos hv]
  refine repW_eq f g ?_ (Tree.isLeaf_cutV _ _ hv) hq ?_
  · rw [Classical.choose_spec (exists_rep t hv), h]
  · show (treeOf (stdT _)).vb ((stdT _).1.rank _) = vert i p
    rw [treeOf_stdT, rank_stdT]
    exact Tree.vb_cutV _ _ hv

name: Operad.FreeGr.mem_of_rep
proof:
:= by
  have ht : t.1 = LinOrd.map (splitEquiv S) (LinOrd.comp none p.1 q.1) := by
    rw [← h]
    rfl
  have hc : (treeOf q).arity = Fintype.card (SIn S) := by
    rw [treeOf_arity]
    exact q.2.2
  rw [ht, LinOrd.rank_map, hc, LinOrd.mem_window]
  constructor
  · intro ha
    exact ⟨⟨a, ha⟩, by simp [splitEquiv, ha]⟩
  · rintro ⟨b, hb⟩
    have := congrArg (splitEquiv S) hb
    rw [Equiv.apply_symm_apply, splitEquiv_inr] at this
    rw [this]
    exact b.2

name: Operad.FreeGr.star_bas
statement:
theorem star_bas (hg : ∀ (B : Type) [Fintype B] [DecidableEq B], ConvOp.IsParC true (g.1 B))
    (hf0 : ∀ (A : Type) [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] (x : Reg (TreeOfArity T) A),
      (treeOf x).isLeaf = true → ConvOp.toLin (f.1 A) (SgnLin.bas (treeSgn gp) R x) = 0)
    (hg0 : ∀ (B : Type) [Fintype B] [DecidableEq B] (x : Reg (TreeOfArity T) B),
      (treeOf x).isLeaf = true → ConvOp.toLin (g.1 B) (SgnLin.bas (treeSgn gp) R x) = 0)
    (t : Reg (TreeOfArity T) X) :
    ConvOp.toLin ((GrOperad.Inv.star R _ f g).1 X) (SgnLin.bas (treeSgn gp) R t)
      = ∑ v ∈ (Finset.Ico 1 (treeOf t).weight).filter
          (fun v => 0 < ((treeOf t).cutV v).2.1.arity), starV f g t v
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : ConvOp.toLin ((GrOperad.Inv.star R _ f g).1 X) (SgnLin.bas (treeSgn gp) R t)
      = ∑ x ∈ (nonempties X).sigma (fun S => (SetOperad.FiniteFact.finite none
          (SetOperad.map (splitEquiv S).symm t)).toFinset),
          repW f g (splitEquiv x.1) x.2.1 x.2.2 := by
    rw [GrOperad.Inv.star_apply, ConvOp.toLin_sum, LinearMap.coe_sum, Finset.sum_apply,
      Finset.sum_sigma]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun S _ => ?_
    show ConvOp.toLin (ConvOp.mapC (splitEquiv S)
      (ConvOp.compC none (f.1 (SOut S)) (g.1 (SIn S)))) _ = _
    rw [ConvOp.mapC_apply]
    show GrOperad.map (R := R) (splitEquiv S) (ConvOp.toLin (ConvOp.compC none _ _)
      (GrOperad.map (R := R) (splitEquiv S).symm _)) = _
    rw [SgnLin.map_bas, compC_bas none _ (hg (SIn S)), map_sum]
    rfl
  rw [h1, ← Finset.sum_filter_of_ne (p := fun x => (treeOf x.2.1).isLeaf = false ∧
    (treeOf x.2.2).isLeaf = false)]
  swap
  · rintro ⟨S, p, q⟩ _ hne
    by_contra hc
    apply hne
    dsimp only at hc ⊢
    unfold repW
    by_cases hp : (treeOf p).isLeaf = false
    · have hq : (treeOf q).isLeaf = true := by
        simpa [hp] using hc
      rw [hg0 _ q hq, map_zero, smul_zero, map_zero]
    · have hp' : (treeOf p).isLeaf = true := by simpa using hp
      have h0 : ConvOp.toLin (f.1 (SOut S))
          (GrSpecies.tw (R := R) true (SgnLin.bas (treeSgn gp) R p)) = 0 := by
        rw [tw_bas', map_smul, hf0 _ p hp', smul_zero]
      rw [h0, LinearMap.map_zero₂, smul_zero, map_zero]
  refine Finset.sum_bij (fun x _ => vert none x.2.1) ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_
  · rintro ⟨S, p, q⟩ hx
    rw [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_sigma] at hx
    obtain ⟨⟨hS, hpq⟩, hp, hq⟩ := hx
    have hrep : SetOperad.map (splitEquiv S) (SetOperad.comp none p q) = t := by
      rw [(mem_fib (pq := (p, q))).1 hpq, SetOperad.map_map_symm]
    refine Finset.mem_filter.2 ⟨vert_mem hrep hp hq, ?_⟩
    rw [cutV_vert hrep hq, treeOf_arity, q.2.2]
    exact Fintype.card_pos_iff.2 (by
      obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := (Finset.mem_filter.1 hS).2
      exact ⟨⟨a, ha⟩⟩)
  · rintro ⟨S₁, p₁, q₁⟩ hx₁ ⟨S₂, p₂, q₂⟩ hx₂ hv
    rw [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_sigma] at hx₁ hx₂
    obtain ⟨⟨hS₁, hpq₁⟩, -, hq₁⟩ := hx₁
    obtain ⟨⟨hS₂, hpq₂⟩, -, hq₂⟩ := hx₂
    have hrep₁ : SetOperad.map (splitEquiv S₁) (SetOperad.comp none p₁ q₁) = t := by
      rw [(mem_fib (pq := (p₁, q₁))).1 hpq₁, SetOperad.map_map_symm]
    have hrep₂ : SetOperad.map (splitEquiv S₂) (SetOperad.comp none p₂ q₂) = t := by
      rw [(mem_fib (pq := (p₂, q₂))).1 hpq₂, SetOperad.map_map_symm]
    have c1 := cutV_vert hrep₁ hq₁
    have c2 := cutV_vert hrep₂ hq₂
    dsimp only at hv
    rw [hv, c2] at c1
    simp only [Prod.mk.injEq] at c1
    obtain ⟨hp, hq, hr⟩ := c1
    have hS : S₁ = S₂ := by
      ext a
      rw [mem_of_rep hrep₁, mem_of_rep hrep₂, hr, hq]
    subst hS
    have hc : SetOperad.comp none p₁ q₁ = SetOperad.comp none p₂ q₂ := by
      rw [(mem_fib (pq := (p₁, q₁))).1 hpq₁, (mem_fib (pq := (p₂, q₂))).1 hpq₂]
    obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := (Finset.mem_filter.1 hS₁).2
    have ho := LinOrd.comp_cancel (⟨a, ha⟩ : SIn S₁) (congrArg Prod.fst hc)
    rw [reg_ext ho.1 hp.symm, reg_ext ho.2 hq.symm]
  · intro v hv
    obtain ⟨hv1, hv2⟩ := Finset.mem_filter.1 hv
    rw [Finset.mem_Ico] at hv1
    obtain ⟨e, he⟩ := exists_rep t hv1.2
    obtain ⟨S, hSdef⟩ : ∃ S : Finset X, S = Finset.univ.map ⟨fun b => e (Sum.inr b),
        fun b b' h => by simpa using e.injective h⟩ := ⟨_, rfl⟩
    have hS : ∀ x, x ∈ S ↔ ∃ b, e (Sum.inr b) = x := fun x => by simp [hSdef]
    have hcanon := map_comp_canon_reg e S hS (stdT ((treeOf t).cutV v).1)
      (stdT ((treeOf t).cutV v).2.1)
    rw [he] at hcanon
    have hfact : SetOperad.comp none
        (SetOperad.map (GrOperad.canonOut e S hS) (stdT ((treeOf t).cutV v).1))
        (SetOperad.map (GrOperad.canonIn e S hS) (stdT ((treeOf t).cutV v).2.1))
          = SetOperad.map (splitEquiv S).symm t := by
      conv_rhs => rw [hcanon]
      rw [SetOperad.map_symm_map]
    refine ⟨⟨S, SetOperad.map (GrOperad.canonOut e S hS) (stdT ((treeOf t).cutV v).1),
      SetOperad.map (GrOperad.canonIn e S hS) (stdT ((treeOf t).cutV v).2.1)⟩, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_sigma]
      exact ⟨⟨Finset.mem_filter.2 ⟨Finset.mem_univ _, ⟨e (Sum.inr ⟨0, hv2⟩), (hS _).2 ⟨_, rfl⟩⟩⟩,
        (mem_fib).2 hfact⟩, Tree.isLeaf_cutV_fst hv1.1 hv1.2 rfl, Tree.isLeaf_cutV _ _ hv1.2⟩
    · show (treeOf (SetOperad.map (GrOperad.canonOut e S hS) (stdT _))).vb
        ((SetOperad.map (GrOperad.canonOut e S hS) (stdT _)).1.rank none) = v
      rw [treeOf_map, treeOf_stdT, map_fst, LinOrd.rank_map]
      have hsymm : (GrOperad.canonOut e S hS).symm none
          = ⟨((treeOf t).cutV v).2.2, Tree.lt_arity_cutV _ v hv1.2⟩ := by
        rw [Equiv.symm_apply_eq, GrOperad.canonOut_self]
      rw [hsymm, rank_stdT]
      exact Tree.vb_cutV _ _ hv1.2
  · rintro ⟨S, p, q⟩ hx
    rw [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_sigma] at hx
    obtain ⟨⟨-, hpq⟩, -, hq⟩ := hx
    have hrep : SetOperad.map (splitEquiv S) (SetOperad.comp none p q) = t := by
      rw [(mem_fib (pq := (p, q))).1 hpq, SetOperad.map_map_symm]
    exact (starV_eq f g hrep hq).symm

name: Operad.FreeGr.vert_comp_inr
statement:
lemma vert_comp_inr (j : A) (t₁ : Reg (TreeOfArity T) A) (i₂ : B)
    (p₂ : Reg (TreeOfArity T) B) :
    vert (Sum.inr i₂) (SetOperad.comp j t₁ p₂) = vert j t₁ + vert i₂ p₂
proof:
:= by
  show (treeOf (SetOperad.comp j t₁ p₂)).vb ((SetOperad.comp j t₁ p₂).1.rank (Sum.inr i₂)) = _
  rw [treeOf_comp, comp_fst, LinOrd.rank_comp_inr]
  have h1 := rank_lt_arity t₁ j
  have h2 := rank_lt_arity p₂ i₂
  rw [Tree.vb_graft_mid _ _ _ _ h1 (by omega) (by omega), Nat.add_sub_cancel_left]

name: Operad.FreeGr.vert_comp_inl
statement:
lemma vert_comp_inl {a i₁ : A} (ha : i₁ ≠ a) (p₁ : Reg (TreeOfArity T) A)
    (t₂ : Reg (TreeOfArity T) D) :
    vert (Sum.inl ⟨i₁, ha⟩) (SetOperad.comp a p₁ t₂)
      = vert i₁ p₁ + if p₁.1.rank a < p₁.1.rank i₁ then (treeOf t₂).weight else 0
proof:
:= by
  show (treeOf (SetOperad.comp a p₁ t₂)).vb
    ((SetOperad.comp a p₁ t₂).1.rank (Sum.inl ⟨i₁, ha⟩)) = _
  rw [treeOf_comp, comp_fst]
  have hD : Fintype.card D = (treeOf t₂).arity := by
    rw [treeOf_arity]
    exact t₂.2.2.symm
  rcases p₁.1.total i₁ a ha with h | h
  · have hr := p₁.1.rank_lt_rank h
    rw [LinOrd.rank_comp_inl_of_lt _ _ _ _ h,
      Tree.vb_graft_of_lt _ _ _ _ hr (rank_lt_arity p₁ a), if_neg (by omega), add_zero]
  · have hr := p₁.1.rank_lt_rank h
    rw [LinOrd.rank_comp_inl_of_gt _ _ _ _ h, hD,
      Tree.vb_graft_of_gt _ _ _ _ hr (rank_lt_arity p₁ i₁), if_pos hr]

name: Operad.FreeGr.vert_lt_of_inr
proof:
:= by
  have hr : t₁.1.rank j = p₁.1.rank i₁ + q₁.1.rank b := by
    rw [← h, map_fst, LinOrd.rank_map, hj, comp_fst, LinOrd.rank_comp_inr]
  show (treeOf p₁).vb (p₁.1.rank i₁) < (treeOf t₁).vb (t₁.1.rank j)
  rw [treeOf_rep h, hr, Tree.vb_graft_mid _ _ _ _ (rank_lt_arity p₁ i₁) (by omega)
    (by have := rank_lt_arity q₁ b; omega)]
  have := Tree.one_le_vb hq (p₁.1.rank i₁ + q₁.1.rank b - p₁.1.rank i₁)
  omega

name: Operad.FreeGr.vert_le_of_inl_lt
proof:
:= by
  have hr : t₁.1.rank j = p₁.1.rank a := by
    rw [← h, map_fst, LinOrd.rank_map, hj, comp_fst, LinOrd.rank_comp_inl_of_lt _ _ _ _ hlt]
  show (treeOf t₁).vb (t₁.1.rank j) ≤ (treeOf p₁).vb (p₁.1.rank i₁)
  rw [treeOf_rep h, hr, Tree.vb_graft_of_lt _ _ _ _ (p₁.1.rank_lt_rank hlt)
    (rank_lt_arity p₁ i₁)]
  exact Tree.vb_mono _ _ _ (p₁.1.rank_lt_rank hlt).le (rank_lt_arity p₁ i₁)

name: Operad.FreeGr.vert_lt_of_inl_gt
proof:
:= by
  have hB : Fintype.card B = (treeOf q₁).arity := by
    rw [treeOf_arity]
    exact q₁.2.2.symm
  have hr : t₁.1.rank j = p₁.1.rank a - 1 + (treeOf q₁).arity := by
    rw [← h, map_fst, LinOrd.rank_map, hj, comp_fst, LinOrd.rank_comp_inl_of_gt _ _ _ _ hgt, hB]
  show (treeOf p₁).vb (p₁.1.rank i₁) < (treeOf t₁).vb (t₁.1.rank j)
  rw [treeOf_rep h, hr, Tree.vb_graft_of_gt _ _ _ _ (p₁.1.rank_lt_rank hgt) (rank_lt_arity p₁ a)]
  have h1 := Tree.vb_mono (treeOf p₁) _ _ (p₁.1.rank_lt_rank hgt).le (rank_lt_arity p₁ a)
  have h2 := Tree.one_le_weight hq
  omega

name: Operad.FreeGr.noNull_comp
statement:
lemma noNull_comp (j : A) (t₁ : Reg (TreeOfArity T) A) (t₂ : Reg (TreeOfArity T) B) :
    (treeOf (SetOperad.comp j t₁ t₂)).NoNull ↔ (treeOf t₁).NoNull ∧ (treeOf t₂).NoNull
proof:
:= by
  rw [treeOf_comp]
  exact Tree.noNull_graft _ _ _ (rank_lt_arity t₁ j)

name: Operad.unitEquiv_symm_apply
statement:
@[simp] lemma unitEquiv_symm_apply {A : Type} [DecidableEq A] (e : Unit ≃ A) (i : A) {B : Type}
    (b : B) : (unitEquiv e i B).symm b = Sum.inr b
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.GrComposite.map_refl
statement: lemma map_refl (x : GrComposite R V C S) : map (Equiv.refl S) x = x
proof:
:=
  SymSpecies.map_refl (R := R) (V := GrComposite R V C) x

name: Operad.GrComposite.map_trans
statement:
lemma map_trans (e : S ≃ S') (f : S' ≃ S'') (x : GrComposite R V C S) :
    map (e.trans f) x = map f (map e x)
proof:
:=
  SymSpecies.map_trans (R := R) (V := GrComposite R V C) e f x

name: Operad.GrComposite.map_congr
statement:
lemma map_congr {e e' : S ≃ S'} (h : ∀ s, e s = e' s) (x : GrComposite R V C S) :
    map e x = map e' x
proof:
:= by
  rw [Equiv.ext h]

name: Operad.GrComposite.map_comp_congr
statement:
lemma map_comp_congr (e : S ≃ S') (f : S' ≃ S'') (g : S ≃ S'') (h : ∀ s, f (e s) = g s)
    (x : GrComposite R V C S) : map f (map e x) = map g x
proof:
:= by
  rw [← map_trans]
  exact map_congr h x

name: Operad.GrComposite.map_par'
statement:
lemma map_par' (e : S ≃ S') (b : Bool) (x : GrComposite R V C S) :
    map e (par R V C b x) = par R V C b (map e x)
proof:
:=
  GrSpecies.map_par (R := R) (V := GrComposite R V C) e b x

name: Operad.GrComposite.par_add'
statement: lemma par_add' (x : GrComposite R V C S) : par R V C false x + par R V C true x = x
proof:
:=
  GrSpecies.par_add (R := R) (V := GrComposite R V C) x

name: Operad.GrComposite.par_par'
statement:
lemma par_par' (b b' : Bool) (x : GrComposite R V C S) :
    par R V C b (par R V C b' x) = if b = b' then par R V C b' x else 0
proof:
:=
  GrSpecies.par_par (R := R) (V := GrComposite R V C) b b' x

name: Operad.GrComposite.par_par_self'
statement:
lemma par_par_self' (b : Bool) (x : GrComposite R V C S) :
    par R V C b (par R V C b x) = par R V C b x
proof:
:= by
  rw [par_par', if_pos rfl]

name: Operad.GrComposite.lact_eq
statement:
lemma lact_eq (i : A) (x : C A) (e : Unit ≃ A) (ν : GrComposite R V C B) :
    lact R V ε i x ν = ε.u A x • map (unitEquiv e i B).symm ν
proof:
:= by
  haveI : Subsingleton (Unit ≃ A) := ⟨fun e₁ e₂ => Equiv.ext fun _ => by
    rw [← e.apply_symm_apply (e₁ _), ← e.apply_symm_apply (e₂ _)]⟩
  rw [lact, Fintype.sum_subsingleton _ e]
  rfl

name: Operad.GrComposite.lact_of_isEmpty
statement:
lemma lact_of_isEmpty (h : IsEmpty (Unit ≃ A)) (i : A) (x : C A) :
    lact R V ε i x = (0 : GrComposite R V C B →ₗ[R] GrComposite R V C (Without A i ⊕ B))
proof:
:= by
  rw [lact, Finset.univ_eq_empty, Finset.sum_empty]

name: Operad.GrComposite.lact_of_u
statement:
lemma lact_of_u (i : A) {x : C A} (hx : ε.u A x = 0) :
    lact R V ε i x = (0 : GrComposite R V C B →ₗ[R] GrComposite R V C (Without A i ⊕ B))
proof:
:= by
  simp only [lact, hx, zero_smul, Finset.sum_const_zero]

name: Operad.GrComposite.lact_zero
statement: lemma lact_zero (i : A) (ν : GrComposite R V C B) : lact R V ε i (0 : C A) ν = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [lact_of_u ε i (map_zero (ε.u A)), LinearMap.zero_apply]

name: Operad.GrComposite.u_of_ne
statement: lemma u_of_ne {i k : A} (hik : i ≠ k) (x : C A) : ε.u A x = 0
proof:
:=
  ε.u_eq_zero ⟨fun e => hik (by rw [← e.apply_symm_apply i, ← e.apply_symm_apply k])⟩ x

name: Operad.GrComposite.lact_par_true
statement:
lemma lact_par_true (i : A) (x : C A) :
    lact R V ε i (GrOperad.par (R := R) true x)
      = (0 : GrComposite R V C B →ₗ[R] GrComposite R V C (Without A i ⊕ B))
proof:
:=
  lact_of_u ε i (ε.u_par x)

name: Operad.GrComposite.par_lact
statement:
lemma par_lact (b : Bool) (i : A) (x : C A) (ν : GrComposite R V C B) :
    par R V C b (lact R V ε i x ν) = lact R V ε i x (par R V C b ν)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [lact, LinearMap.coe_sum, Finset.sum_apply, LinearMap.smul_apply, map_sum, map_smul,
    map_par']

name: Operad.GrComposite.map_lact
statement:
lemma map_lact {A' B' : Type} [Fintype A'] [DecidableEq A'] [Fintype B'] [DecidableEq B']
    (σ : A ≃ A') (τ : B ≃ B') (i : A) (x : C A) (ν : GrComposite R V C B) :
    map (compEquiv σ τ i) (lact R V ε i x ν)
      = lact R V ε (σ i) (GrOperad.map (R := R) σ x) (map τ ν)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases h : Nonempty (Unit ≃ A)
  · obtain ⟨e⟩ := h
    rw [lact_eq ε i x e, lact_eq ε (σ i) _ (e.trans σ), ε.u_map, map_smul, ← map_trans,
      ← map_trans]
    refine congrArg _ (map_congr ?_ ν)
    intro b
    rfl
  · have h' : IsEmpty (Unit ≃ A') := ⟨fun e => h ⟨e.trans σ.symm⟩⟩
    rw [lact_of_isEmpty ε (not_nonempty_iff.1 h), lact_of_isEmpty ε h', LinearMap.zero_apply,
      LinearMap.zero_apply, map_zero]

name: Operad.GrComposite.lactL_apply
statement: @[simp] lemma lactL_apply (i : A) (x : C A) : lactL R V ε (B := B) i x = lact R V ε i x
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.GrComposite.SqExt.fst_mk
statement: @[simp] lemma fst_mk (x : C A) (ω : GrComposite R V C A) : fst (mk (ε := ε) x ω) = x
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.GrComposite.SqExt.snd_mk
statement: @[simp] lemma snd_mk (x : C A) (ω : GrComposite R V C A) : snd (mk (ε := ε) x ω) = ω
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.GrComposite.SqExt.ext
statement: @[ext] lemma ext {X Y : SqExt R V C ε A} (h1 : fst X = fst Y) (h2 : snd X = snd Y) : X = Y
proof:
:=
  Prod.ext h1 h2

name: Operad.GrComposite.SqExt.fst_parE
statement:
@[simp] lemma fst_parE (c : Bool) (X : SqExt R V C ε A) :
    fst (parE c X) = GrOperad.par (R := R) c (fst X)
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.GrComposite.SqExt.snd_parE
statement:
@[simp] lemma snd_parE (c : Bool) (X : SqExt R V C ε A) :
    snd (parE c X) = par R V C c (snd X)
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.GrComposite.SqExt.fst_mapE
statement:
@[simp] lemma fst_mapE (σ' : A ≃ B) (X : SqExt R V C ε A) :
    fst (mapE σ' X) = GrOperad.map (R := R) σ' (fst X)
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.GrComposite.SqExt.snd_mapE
statement:
@[simp] lemma snd_mapE (σ' : A ≃ B) (X : SqExt R V C ε A) :
    snd (mapE σ' X) = map σ' (snd X)
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.GrComposite.SqExt.fst_compE
statement:
@[simp] lemma fst_compE (i : A) (X : SqExt R V C ε A) (Y : SqExt R V C ε B) :
    fst (compE i X Y) = GrOperad.comp (R := R) i (fst X) (fst Y)
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.GrComposite.SqExt.snd_compE
statement:
@[simp] lemma snd_compE (i : A) (X : SqExt R V C ε A) (Y : SqExt R V C ε B) :
    snd (compE i X Y) = act R V i (fst Y) (snd X) + lact R V ε i (fst X) (snd Y)
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.GrComposite.SqExt.fst_oneE
statement: @[simp] lemma fst_oneE : fst (oneE (R := R) (V := V) (ε := ε)) = GrOperad.one (R := R)
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.GrComposite.SqExt.snd_oneE
statement: @[simp] lemma snd_oneE : snd (oneE (R := R) (V := V) (ε := ε)) = 0
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.GrComposite.SqExt.parE_add
statement: lemma parE_add (X : SqExt R V C ε A) : parE false X + parE true X = X
proof:
:= by
  ext
  · simp only [map_add, fst_parE, GrOperad.par_add]
  · simp only [map_add, snd_parE, par_add']

name: Operad.GrComposite.SqExt.parE_parE
statement:
lemma parE_parE (c c' : Bool) (X : SqExt R V C ε A) :
    parE c (parE c' X) = if c = c' then parE c' X else 0
proof:
:= by
  by_cases h : c = c'
  · subst h
    rw [if_pos rfl]
    ext
    · simp only [fst_parE, GrOperad.par_par_self]
    · simp only [snd_parE, par_par_self']
  · rw [if_neg h]
    ext
    · simp only [fst_parE, GrOperad.par_par, if_neg h]
      rfl
    · simp only [snd_parE, par_par', if_neg h]
      rfl

name: Operad.GrComposite.SqExt.compE_par
statement:
lemma compE_par (i : A) (p q : Bool) (X : SqExt R V C ε A) (Y : SqExt R V C ε B) :
    parE (xor p q) (compE i (parE p X) (parE q Y)) = compE i (parE p X) (parE q Y)
proof:
:= by
  ext
  · exact GrOperad.comp_par i p q _ _
  · simp only [snd_compE, fst_parE, snd_parE, map_add]
    congr 1
    · rw [par_act _ i _ (GrOperad.par_par_self (R := R) q _), Bool.xor_assoc, Bool.xor_self,
        Bool.xor_false, par_par_self']
    · cases p
      · rw [par_lact, Bool.false_xor, par_par_self']
      · rw [lact_par_true, LinearMap.zero_apply, map_zero]

name: Operad.GrComposite.SqExt.mapE_compE
statement:
lemma mapE_compE {A' B' : Type} [Fintype A'] [DecidableEq A'] [Fintype B'] [DecidableEq B']
    (σ' : A ≃ A') (τ : B ≃ B') (i : A) (X : SqExt R V C ε A) (Y : SqExt R V C ε B) :
    mapE (compEquiv σ' τ i) (compE i X Y) = compE (σ' i) (mapE σ' X) (mapE τ Y)
proof:
:= by
  ext
  · exact GrOperad.map_comp σ' τ i _ _
  · simp only [snd_mapE, snd_compE, fst_mapE, map_add, map_act, map_lact]

name: Operad.GrComposite.SqExt.compE_one
statement:
lemma compE_one (i : A) (X : SqExt R V C ε A) :
    mapE (rightUnitEquiv i) (compE i X oneE) = X
proof:
:= by
  ext
  · exact GrOperad.comp_one i _
  · simp only [snd_mapE, snd_compE, fst_oneE, snd_oneE, map_zero, add_zero, map_act_one]

name: Operad.GrComposite.SqExt.one_compE
statement: lemma one_compE (Y : SqExt R V C ε B) : mapE (leftUnitEquiv B) (compE () oneE Y) = Y
proof:
:= by
  ext
  · exact GrOperad.one_comp _
  · simp only [snd_mapE, snd_compE, fst_oneE, snd_oneE, map_zero, zero_add]
    rw [lact_eq ε () _ (Equiv.refl Unit), ε.u_one, one_smul, map_comp_congr _ _ (Equiv.refl B),
      map_refl]
    intro b
    rfl

name: Operad.GrComposite.SqExt.compE_assoc_seq
statement:
lemma compE_assoc_seq {D : Type} [Fintype D] [DecidableEq D] (i : A) (j : B)
    (X : SqExt R V C ε A) (Y : SqExt R V C ε B) (Z : SqExt R V C ε D) :
    mapE (seqEquiv i j D) (compE (Sum.inr j) (compE i X Y) Z) = compE i X (compE j Y Z)
proof:
:= by
  ext
  · exact GrOperad.comp_assoc_seq i j _ _ _
  · simp only [snd_mapE, snd_compE, fst_compE, map_add]
    rw [map_act_seq, add_assoc]
    congr 1
    have h2 : map (seqEquiv i j D) (act R V (Sum.inr j) (fst Z) (lact R V ε i (fst X) (snd Y)))
        = lact R V ε i (fst X) (act R V j (fst Z) (snd Y)) := by
      by_cases hA : Nonempty (Unit ≃ A)
      · obtain ⟨e⟩ := hA
        rw [lact_eq ε i _ e, lact_eq ε i _ e, ← actL_apply, map_smul, map_smul, actL_apply]
        congr 1
        have h := map_act (R := R) (V := V) (unitEquiv e i B).symm (Equiv.refl D) j (fst Z)
          (snd Y)
        rw [GrOperad.map_refl] at h
        have h' : act R V (Sum.inr j : Without A i ⊕ B) (fst Z)
            (map (unitEquiv e i B).symm (snd Y))
            = map (compEquiv (unitEquiv e i B).symm (Equiv.refl D) j)
              (act R V j (fst Z) (snd Y)) := h.symm
        rw [h']
        refine map_comp_congr _ _ _ ?_ _
        rintro (⟨b, hb⟩ | d) <;> rfl
      · simp only [lact_of_isEmpty ε (not_nonempty_iff.1 hA), LinearMap.zero_apply, map_zero]
    have h3 : map (seqEquiv i j D) (lact R V ε (Sum.inr j : Without A i ⊕ B)
          (GrOperad.comp (R := R) i (fst X) (fst Y)) (snd Z))
        = lact R V ε i (fst X) (lact R V ε j (fst Y) (snd Z)) := by
      by_cases hA : Nonempty (Unit ≃ A)
      · obtain ⟨e⟩ := hA
        by_cases hB : Nonempty (Unit ≃ B)
        · obtain ⟨e'⟩ := hB
          rw [lact_eq ε j _ e', map_smul (lact R V ε i (fst X)), lact_eq ε i _ e,
            lact_eq ε (Sum.inr j : Without A i ⊕ B) _ (e'.trans (unitEquiv e i B).symm),
            ε.u_comp, map_smul, smul_smul, mul_comm (ε.u B _), ← map_trans, ← map_trans]
          refine congrArg _ (map_congr ?_ _)
          intro d
          rfl
        · have hy : ε.u B (fst Y) = 0 := ε.u_eq_zero (not_nonempty_iff.1 hB) _
          rw [lact_of_u ε _ (show ε.u _ (GrOperad.comp (R := R) i (fst X) (fst Y)) = 0 by
            rw [ε.u_comp, hy, mul_zero]), lact_of_u ε j hy]
          simp only [LinearMap.zero_apply, map_zero]
      · have hx : ε.u A (fst X) = 0 := ε.u_eq_zero (not_nonempty_iff.1 hA) _
        rw [lact_of_u ε i hx, lact_of_u ε _ (show ε.u _ (GrOperad.comp (R := R) i (fst X)
          (fst Y)) = 0 by rw [ε.u_comp, hx, zero_mul])]
        simp only [LinearMap.zero_apply, map_zero]
    rw [h2, h3]

name: Operad.GrComposite.SqExt.compE_assoc_par
statement:
lemma compE_assoc_par {D : Type} [Fintype D] [DecidableEq D] {i k : A} (hik : i ≠ k)
    (X : SqExt R V C ε A) {q r : Bool} {Y : SqExt R V C ε B} {Z : SqExt R V C ε D}
    (hy : parE q Y = Y) (hz : parE r Z = Z) :
    mapE (parEquiv hik B D) (compE (Sum.inl ⟨k, Ne.symm hik⟩) (compE i X Y) Z)
      = σ R (q && r) • compE (Sum.inl ⟨i, hik⟩) (compE k X Z) Y
proof:
:= by
  have hy1 : GrOperad.par (R := R) q (fst Y) = fst Y := congrArg fst hy
  have hz1 : GrOperad.par (R := R) r (fst Z) = fst Z := congrArg fst hz
  have hx : ε.u A (fst X) = 0 := u_of_ne ε hik _
  ext
  · exact GrOperad.comp_assoc_par hik _ hy1 hz1
  · have h1 : ε.u _ (GrOperad.comp (R := R) i (fst X) (fst Y)) = 0 := by
      rw [ε.u_comp, hx, zero_mul]
    have h2 : ε.u _ (GrOperad.comp (R := R) k (fst X) (fst Z)) = 0 := by
      rw [ε.u_comp, hx, zero_mul]
    simp only [snd_mapE, snd_compE, fst_compE, map_smul, lact_of_u ε _ hx, lact_of_u ε _ h1,
      lact_of_u ε _ h2, LinearMap.zero_apply, add_zero]
    exact map_act_par hik hy1 hz1 _

name: Operad.GrComposite.SqExt.par_def
statement: lemma par_def (c : Bool) (X : SqExt R V C ε A) : GrOperad.par (R := R) c X = parE c X
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.GrComposite.SqExt.map_def
statement: lemma map_def (σ' : A ≃ B) (X : SqExt R V C ε A) : GrOperad.map (R := R) σ' X = mapE σ' X
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: Operad.GrComposite.SqExt.one_def
statement: lemma one_def : (GrOperad.one (R := R) : SqExt R V C ε Unit) = oneE
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.GrComposite.SqExt.comp_def
statement:
lemma comp_def (i : A) (X : SqExt R V C ε A) (Y : SqExt R V C ε B) :
    GrOperad.comp (R := R) i X Y = compE i X Y
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.GrComposite.SqExt.fstHom_app
statement: @[simp] lemma fstHom_app (X : SqExt R V C ε A) : (fstHom R V C ε).app A X = fst X
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.GerBV.σ_false
statement: @[simp] lemma σ_false : σ R false = 1
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.GerBV.σ_true
statement: @[simp] lemma σ_true : σ R true = -1
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.GerBV.IsPar.add
statement:
lemma IsPar.add {p : Bool} {x y : V} (hx : IsPar ε p x) (hy : IsPar ε p y) :
    IsPar ε p (x + y)
proof:
:= by
  unfold IsPar at *
  rw [map_add, hx, hy, smul_add]

name: Operad.GerBV.IsPar.smul
statement: lemma IsPar.smul {p : Bool} {x : V} (hx : IsPar ε p x) (c : R) : IsPar ε p (c • x)
proof:
:= by
  unfold IsPar at *
  rw [map_smul, hx, smul_comm]

name: Operad.GerBV.IsPar.sub
statement:
lemma IsPar.sub {p : Bool} {x y : V} (hx : IsPar ε p x) (hy : IsPar ε p y) :
    IsPar ε p (x - y)
proof:
:= by
  unfold IsPar at *
  rw [map_sub, hx, hy, smul_sub]

name: Operad.GerBV.IsBV.par_dev
statement:
lemma IsBV.par_dev (h : IsBV ε μ Δ) {p q : Bool} {x y : V} (hx : IsPar ε p x)
    (hy : IsPar ε q y) : IsPar ε (!(xor p q)) (dev μ Δ p x y)
proof:
:= by
  unfold dev
  refine ((h.par_Δ _ _ (h.par_mul _ _ _ _ hx hy)).sub ?_).sub ?_
  · have := h.par_mul _ _ _ _ (h.par_Δ _ _ hx) hy
    cases p <;> cases q <;> simpa using this
  · have := h.par_mul _ _ _ _ hx (h.par_Δ _ _ hy)
    refine IsPar.smul ?_ _
    cases p <;> cases q <;> simpa using this

name: Operad.GerBV.IsBV.par_bracket
statement:
lemma IsBV.par_bracket (h : IsBV ε μ Δ) {p q : Bool} {x y : V} (hx : IsPar ε p x)
    (hy : IsPar ε q y) : IsPar ε (!(xor p q)) (bracket μ Δ p x y)
proof:
:=
  (h.par_dev hx hy).smul _

name: Operad.GerBV.dev_sub_right
statement:
lemma dev_sub_right (p : Bool) (x y z : V) :
    dev μ Δ p x (y - z) = dev μ Δ p x y - dev μ Δ p x z
proof:
:= by
  simp only [dev, map_sub, smul_sub]
  abel

name: Operad.GerBV.dev_smul_right
statement:
lemma dev_smul_right (p : Bool) (c : R) (x y : V) :
    dev μ Δ p x (c • y) = c • dev μ Δ p x y
proof:
:= by
  simp only [dev, map_smul, smul_sub, smul_comm c (σ R p)]

name: Operad.GerBV.dev_sub_left
statement:
lemma dev_sub_left (p : Bool) (x y z : V) :
    dev μ Δ p (x - y) z = dev μ Δ p x z - dev μ Δ p y z
proof:
:= by
  simp only [dev, map_sub, LinearMap.sub_apply, smul_sub]
  abel

name: Operad.GerBV.dev_smul_left
statement:
lemma dev_smul_left (p : Bool) (c : R) (x z : V) :
    dev μ Δ p (c • x) z = c • dev μ Δ p x z
proof:
:= by
  simp only [dev, map_smul, LinearMap.smul_apply, smul_sub, smul_comm c (σ R p)]

name: Operad.GerBV.Δ_dev
statement:
lemma Δ_dev (hΔ : ∀ x, Δ (Δ x) = 0) (p : Bool) (x y : V) :
    Δ (dev μ Δ p x y) = -dev μ Δ (!p) (Δ x) y - σ R p • dev μ Δ p x (Δ y)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [dev, map_sub, map_smul, hΔ, LinearMap.zero_apply, map_zero, smul_zero, sub_zero]
  cases p <;> simp <;> abel

name: Operad.GerBV.IsBV.dev_comm
statement:
lemma IsBV.dev_comm (h : IsBV ε μ Δ) {p q : Bool} {x y : V} (hx : IsPar ε p x)
    (hy : IsPar ε q y) : dev μ Δ p x y = σ R (p && q) • dev μ Δ q y x
proof:
:= by
  have c1 := congrArg Δ (h.comm _ _ _ _ hx hy)
  have c2 := h.comm _ _ _ _ (h.par_Δ _ _ hx) hy
  have c3 := h.comm _ _ _ _ hx (h.par_Δ _ _ hy)
  rw [map_smul] at c1
  unfold dev
  cases p <;> cases q <;> simp at c1 c2 c3 ⊢
  · linear_combination (norm := module) c1 - c2 - c3
  · linear_combination (norm := module) c1 - c2 - c3
  · linear_combination (norm := module) c1 - c2 + c3
  · linear_combination (norm := module) c1 - c2 + c3

name: Operad.GerBV.dev_jacobi
statement:
theorem dev_jacobi {H : Bool → V → Prop} (hΔ : ∀ x, Δ (Δ x) = 0)
    (hord : ∀ p q x y z, H p x → H q y →
      dev μ Δ p x (μ y z) = μ (dev μ Δ p x y) z + σ R ((!p) && q) • μ y (dev μ Δ p x z))
    (hpΔ : ∀ p x, H p x → H (!p) (Δ x)) {p q : Bool} {x y : V} (z : V)
    (hx : H p x) (hy : H q y) :
    dev μ Δ p x (dev μ Δ q y z)
      = -σ R p • dev μ Δ (!(xor p q)) (dev μ Δ p x y) z
        - σ R (xor p ((!p) && q)) • dev μ Δ q y (dev μ Δ p x z)
proof:
:= by
  have O1 := congrArg Δ (hord p q x y z hx hy)
  have O2 := hord p (!q) x (Δ y) z hx (hpΔ q y hy)
  have O3 := hord p q x y (Δ z) hx hy
  have O4 := hord (!p) q (Δ x) y z (hpΔ p x hx) hy
  simp only [dev, map_sub, map_smul, map_add, hΔ, LinearMap.sub_apply, LinearMap.smul_apply,
    LinearMap.zero_apply, map_zero, smul_zero, sub_zero] at O1 O2 O3 O4 ⊢
  cases p <;> cases q <;> simp at O1 O2 O3 O4 ⊢
  · linear_combination (norm := module) -O1 - O4 - O2 - O3
  · linear_combination (norm := module) -O1 - O4 - O2 + O3
  · linear_combination (norm := module) O1 + O4 - O2 - O3
  · linear_combination (norm := module) O1 + O4 - O2 + O3

name: Operad.GerBV.IsBV.bracket_antisymm
statement:
theorem IsBV.bracket_antisymm (h : IsBV ε μ Δ) {p q : Bool} {x y : V} (hx : IsPar ε p x)
    (hy : IsPar ε q y) :
    bracket μ Δ p x y = -σ R ((!p) && (!q)) • bracket μ Δ q y x
proof:
:= by
  unfold bracket
  rw [h.dev_comm hx hy]
  cases p <;> cases q <;> simp

name: Operad.GerBV.IsBV.bracket_mul_right
statement:
theorem IsBV.bracket_mul_right (h : IsBV ε μ Δ) {p q : Bool} {x y : V} (hx : IsPar ε p x)
    (hy : IsPar ε q y) (z : V) :
    bracket μ Δ p x (μ y z)
      = μ (bracket μ Δ p x y) z + σ R ((!p) && q) • μ y (bracket μ Δ p x z)
proof:
:= by
  unfold bracket
  rw [h.order_two p q x y z hx hy, smul_add, map_smul, LinearMap.smul_apply, map_smul,
    smul_comm (σ R p)]

name: Operad.GerBV.IsBV.bracket_jacobi
statement:
theorem IsBV.bracket_jacobi (h : IsBV ε μ Δ) {p q : Bool} {x y : V} (hx : IsPar ε p x)
    (hy : IsPar ε q y) (z : V) :
    bracket μ Δ p x (bracket μ Δ q y z)
      = bracket μ Δ (!(xor p q)) (bracket μ Δ p x y) z
        + σ R ((!p) && (!q)) • bracket μ Δ q y (bracket μ Δ p x z)
proof:
:= by
  unfold bracket
  rw [dev_smul_right, dev_smul_left, dev_smul_right,
    dev_jacobi h.Δ_Δ h.order_two h.par_Δ z hx hy]
  cases p <;> cases q <;> simp
  module

name: Operad.GerBV.Δ_bracket
statement:
theorem Δ_bracket (hΔ : ∀ x, Δ (Δ x) = 0) (p : Bool) (x y : V) :
    Δ (bracket μ Δ p x y)
      = bracket μ Δ (!p) (Δ x) y + σ R (!p) • bracket μ Δ p x (Δ y)
proof:
:= by
  unfold bracket
  rw [map_smul, Δ_dev hΔ]
  cases p <;> simp
  module

name: Operad.Tree.mem_cuts
statement:
theorem mem_cuts : ∀ (s : Tree E) (p : ℕ) (u : Tree E), p < s.arity →
    (s, u) ∈ cuts (s.graft p u) p
  | .leaf, p, u, h => by
      obtain rfl : p = 0
proof:
:= by simpa using h
      cases u with
      | leaf => simp [cuts]
      | node e f => simp [cuts]
  | .node e f, p, u, h => by
      simp only [graft_node, cuts, List.mem_append, List.mem_map]
      exact Or.inr ⟨(f, u), Forest.mem_cutsF f p u h, rfl⟩

name: Operad.Forest.mem_cutsF
statement:
theorem _root_.Operad.Forest.mem_cutsF : ∀ {k : ℕ} (f : Forest E k) (p : ℕ) (u : Tree E),
    p < f.arityF → (f, u) ∈ Forest.cutsF (f.graftF p u) p
  | _, .nil, _, _, h => by simp at h
  | _, .cons t f, p, u, h => by
      simp only [arityF_cons] at h
      by_cases hlt : p < t.arity
      · rw [graftF_cons_of_lt u hlt]
        simp only [Forest.cutsF, List.mem_append, List.mem_map, List.mem_filter,
          decide_eq_true_eq]
        exact Or.inl ⟨(t, u), ⟨mem_cuts t p u hlt, hlt⟩, rfl⟩
      · rw [graftF_cons_of_ge u (by omega)]
        simp only [Forest.cutsF, List.mem_append]
        rw [if_pos (by omega)]
        exact Or.inr (List.mem_map.2
          ⟨(f, u), Forest.mem_cutsF f (p - t.arity) u (by omega), rfl⟩)

end

name: Operad.Tree.finite_graft_fiber
statement:
theorem finite_graft_fiber (t : Tree E) (p : ℕ) :
    {su : Tree E × Tree E | p < su.1.arity ∧ su.1.graft p su.2 = t}.Finite
proof:
:=
  (cuts t p).finite_toSet.subset fun ⟨s, u⟩ ⟨h, ht⟩ => ht ▸ mem_cuts s p u h

name: Operad.SetOperad.FiniteFact.of_injective
statement:
theorem of_injective [FiniteFact S'] (φ : SetOperadHom S S')
    (hφ : ∀ (A : Type) [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A], Function.Injective (φ.app A)) :
    FiniteFact S where
  finite {A B} _ _ _ _ i x
proof:
:= by
    have hinj : Function.Injective (Prod.map (φ.app A) (φ.app B)) := fun a b h =>
      Prod.ext (hφ A (congrArg Prod.fst h)) (hφ B (congrArg Prod.snd h))
    refine ((FiniteFact.finite i (φ.app _ x)).preimage
      (Set.injOn_of_injective hinj)).subset fun pq hpq => ?_
    simp only [Set.mem_preimage, Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hpq ⊢
    rw [Prod.map_fst, Prod.map_snd, ← φ.app_comp, hpq]

name: Operad.TreeOfArity.arr_eq_toArr
statement: lemma arr_eq_toArr (X : Arr (TreeOfArity T)) : X = toArr X.2.1
proof:
:=
  arr_ext rfl

name: Operad.TreeOfArity.arr_comp_tree
statement:
lemma arr_comp_tree (X Y : Arr (TreeOfArity T)) {r : ℕ} (hr : r < X.1) :
    (Arr.comp X r Y).2.1 = X.2.1.graft r Y.2.1
proof:
:= by
  have hr' : r < X.2.1.arity := by rw [X.2.2]; exact hr
  rw [arr_eq_toArr X, arr_eq_toArr Y, toArr_comp _ _ _ hr']
  rfl

name: Operad.FreeReg.toReg_injective
statement:
lemma toReg_injective (A : Type) [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] :
    Function.Injective ((toReg (T := T)).app A)
proof:
:=
  (regIso.equiv A).injective

name: Operad.FreeReg.gen_injective
statement:
lemma gen_injective (k : ℕ) :
    Function.Injective (Pres.gen (ρ := fun _ _ => False) : T k → FreeSet T (Fin k))
proof:
:= by
  intro g g' h
  have h2 := congrArg (fun x => (x.2.1 : Arr (TreeOfArity T)).2.1) (congrArg (toReg.app (Fin k)) h)
  simp only [toReg_gen, Reg.std, corolla] at h2
  simpa using h2

name: Operad.SetOperad.comp_unit_left
statement:
lemma comp_unit_left (i : A) (e : Unit ≃ A) (y : S B) :
    ∃ E : B ≃ Without A i ⊕ B, comp i (map e one) y = map E y
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨(leftUnitEquiv B).symm.trans (compEquiv e.symm (Equiv.refl B) i).symm, ?_⟩
  have h := map_comp e.symm (Equiv.refl B) i (map e one) y
  rw [map_symm_map, map_refl] at h
  have h' : comp (e.symm i) one y = map (leftUnitEquiv B).symm y := by
    rw [← one_comp y, map_symm_map, one_comp]
  rw [map_trans, ← h', ← h, map_symm_map]

name: Operad.SetOperad.comp_unit_right
statement:
lemma comp_unit_right (i : A) (x : S A) (e : Unit ≃ B) :
    ∃ E : A ≃ Without A i ⊕ B, comp i x (map e one) = map E x
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨(rightUnitEquiv ((Equiv.refl A) i)).symm.trans
    (compEquiv (Equiv.refl A) e.symm i).symm, ?_⟩
  have h := map_comp (Equiv.refl A) e.symm i x (map e one)
  rw [map_symm_map, map_refl] at h
  have h' : comp ((Equiv.refl A) i) x one = map (rightUnitEquiv ((Equiv.refl A) i)).symm x := by
    rw [← comp_one ((Equiv.refl A) i) x, map_symm_map, comp_one]
  rw [map_trans, ← h', ← h, map_symm_map]

name: Operad.SetOperad.comp_unit_unit
statement:
lemma comp_unit_unit (i : A) (e₁ : Unit ≃ A) (e₂ : Unit ≃ B) :
    ∃ E : Unit ≃ Without A i ⊕ B, comp i (map e₁ one) (map e₂ one) = map E (one : S Unit)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨E, hE⟩ := comp_unit_left i e₁ (map e₂ (one : S Unit))
  exact ⟨e₂.trans E, by rw [hE, map_trans]⟩

name: Operad.FreeSet.vertices_gen
statement:
@[simp] lemma vertices_gen {k : ℕ} (g : T k) :
    vertices.app (Fin k) (Pres.gen g : FreeSet T (Fin k)) = 1
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: Operad.FreeSet.eq_unit_of_vertices
statement:
lemma eq_unit_of_vertices (s : Syn T A) (h : vertices.app A (Pres.mk s : FreeSet T A) = 0) :
    ∃ e : Unit ≃ A, (Pres.mk s : FreeSet T A) = SetOperad.map e SetOperad.one
proof:
:= by
  induction s with
  | one => exact ⟨Equiv.refl _, (SetOperad.map_refl _).symm⟩
  | gen g => exact absurd h one_ne_zero
  | map e s ih =>
    rw [← Pres.map_mk, vertices.app_map] at h
    obtain ⟨e', he'⟩ := ih h
    exact ⟨e'.trans e, by rw [← Pres.map_mk, he', SetOperad.map_trans]⟩
  | comp i s s' ih ih' =>
    rw [← Pres.comp_mk, vertices.app_comp] at h
    obtain ⟨e₁, he₁⟩ := ih (Nat.eq_zero_of_add_eq_zero_right h)
    obtain ⟨e₂, he₂⟩ := ih' (Nat.eq_zero_of_add_eq_zero_left h)
    rw [← Pres.comp_mk, he₁, he₂]
    exact SetOperad.comp_unit_unit i e₁ e₂

name: Operad.FreeSet.w_gen
statement: lemma w_gen {k : ℕ} (g : T k) : w (Pres.gen g : FreeSet T (Fin k)) = 1
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: Operad.FreeSet.gen_ne_unit
statement:
lemma gen_ne_unit {k : ℕ} (g : T k) (e : Unit ≃ Fin k) :
    (Pres.gen g : FreeSet T (Fin k)) ≠ SetOperad.map e SetOperad.one
proof:
:= fun h => by
  have := congrArg w h
  rw [w_map, w_one, w_gen] at this
  exact one_ne_zero this

name: Operad.FreeSet.Shape.map
statement: lemma Shape.map {t : FreeSet T A} (h : Shape t) (E : A ≃ B) : Shape (SetOperad.map E t)
proof:
:= by
  rcases h with ⟨e, rfl⟩ | ⟨k, g, e, rfl⟩ | ⟨a, b, i, p, q, e, hp, hq, rfl⟩
  · exact Or.inl ⟨e.trans E, (SetOperad.map_trans _ _ _).symm⟩
  · exact Or.inr (Or.inl ⟨k, g, e.trans E, (SetOperad.map_trans _ _ _).symm⟩)
  · exact Or.inr (Or.inr ⟨a, b, i, p, q, e.trans E, hp, hq, (SetOperad.map_trans _ _ _).symm⟩)

name: Operad.FreeSet.shape
statement: theorem shape (t : FreeSet T A) : Shape t
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨s, rfl⟩ := Pres.mk_surjective t
  induction s with
  | one => exact Or.inl ⟨Equiv.refl _, (SetOperad.map_refl _).symm⟩
  | gen g => exact Or.inr (Or.inl ⟨_, g, Equiv.refl _, (SetOperad.map_refl _).symm⟩)
  | map e s ih =>
    rw [← Pres.map_mk]
    exact ih.map e
  | @comp A₁ B₁ _ _ _ _ i s s' ih ih' =>
    rw [← Pres.comp_mk]
    by_cases hx : w (Pres.mk s : FreeSet T A₁) = 0
    · obtain ⟨e₁, he₁⟩ := eq_unit _ hx
      obtain ⟨E, hE⟩ := SetOperad.comp_unit_left i e₁ (Pres.mk s' : FreeSet T B₁)
      rw [he₁, hE]
      exact ih'.map E
    by_cases hy : w (Pres.mk s' : FreeSet T B₁) = 0
    · obtain ⟨e₂, he₂⟩ := eq_unit _ hy
      obtain ⟨E, hE⟩ := SetOperad.comp_unit_right i (Pres.mk s : FreeSet T A₁) e₂
      rw [he₂, hE]
      exact ih.map E
    let σ := Fintype.equivFin A₁
    let τ := Fintype.equivFin B₁
    refine Or.inr (Or.inr ⟨_, _, σ i, SetOperad.map σ (Pres.mk s), SetOperad.map τ (Pres.mk s'),
      (compEquiv σ τ i).symm, by rwa [w_map], by rwa [w_map], ?_⟩)
    rw [← SetOperad.map_comp, SetOperad.map_symm_map]

name: Operad.SymCooperad.pair_eq_zero_of_mem
proof:
:= by
  rw [tensSub, Submodule.map₂_eq_span_image2] at ht
  induction ht using Submodule.span_induction with
  | mem x hx =>
    obtain ⟨m, hm, n, hn, rfl⟩ := hx
    show pair f g (m ⊗ₜ[R] n) = 0
    rw [pair_tmul]
    rcases h with h | h
    · rw [h m hm, zero_mul]
    · rw [h n hn, mul_zero]
  | zero => exact map_zero _
  | add x y _ _ hx hy => rw [map_add, hx, hy, add_zero]
  | smul r x _ hx => rw [map_smul, hx, smul_zero]

name: Operad.SymCooperad.finite_support_pair
statement:
lemma finite_support_pair {X Y : Type*} [AddCommGroup X] [Module R X] [AddCommGroup Y]
    [Module R Y] {PX PY : Type*} {M : Submodule R X} {N : Submodule R Y}
    (F : PX → Module.Dual R X) (G : PY → Module.Dual R Y)
    (hF : ∀ m ∈ M, (Function.support fun p => F p m).Finite)
    (hG : ∀ n ∈ N, (Function.support fun q => G q n).Finite) {t : X ⊗[R] Y}
    (ht : t ∈ tensSub R M N) :
    (Function.support fun pq : PX × PY => pair (F pq.1) (G pq.2) t).Finite
proof:
:= by
  rw [tensSub, Submodule.map₂_eq_span_image2] at ht
  induction ht using Submodule.span_induction with
  | mem x hx =>
    obtain ⟨m, hm, n, hn, rfl⟩ := hx
    refine ((hF m hm).prod (hG n hn)).subset fun pq hpq => ?_
    simp only [Function.mem_support, TensorProduct.mk_apply, pair_tmul] at hpq
    exact ⟨left_ne_zero_of_mul hpq, right_ne_zero_of_mul hpq⟩
  | zero => simp
  | add x y _ _ hx hy =>
    refine (hx.union hy).subset fun pq hpq => ?_
    by_contra hc
    simp only [Set.mem_union, Function.mem_support, not_or, not_not] at hc
    exact hpq (by show pair _ _ (x + y) = 0; rw [map_add, hc.1, hc.2, add_zero])
  | smul r x _ hx =>
    refine hx.subset fun pq hpq => ?_
    simp only [Function.mem_support, map_smul, smul_eq_mul] at hpq ⊢
    exact right_ne_zero_of_mul hpq

name: Operad.Finsupp.support_finite'
statement:
lemma Finsupp.support_finite' {α M : Type*} [Zero M] (f : α →₀ M) :
    (Function.support f).Finite
proof:
:= by
  rw [Finsupp.fun_support_eq]
  exact f.support.finite_toSet

name: Operad.Cofree.proj_apply
statement:
@[simp] lemma proj_apply {k : ℕ} (x : Cofree R T (Fin k)) (g : T k) :
    proj R T k x g = x (Pres.gen g)
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: Operad.Cofree.dualVal_eq_zero_of_coaug
statement:
theorem dualVal_eq_zero_of_coaug (Ψ : SetOperadHom (FreeSet T) (Und R (Dual R C)))
    (hgen : ∀ (k : ℕ) (g : T k), ∀ c ∈ coaugSpan R C (Fin k), dualVal Ψ (Pres.gen g) c = 0)
    {A : Type} [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] (t : FreeSet T A) (ht : w t ≠ 0) :
    ∀ c ∈ coaugSpan R C A, dualVal Ψ t c = 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨s, rfl⟩ := Pres.mk_surjective t
  induction s with
  | one => exact absurd w_one ht
  | gen g => exact hgen _ g
  | map e s ih =>
    intro c hc
    rw [← Pres.map_mk, w_map] at ht
    rw [← Pres.map_mk, dualVal_map]
    exact ih ht _ (map_mem_unitSpan _ e.symm hc)
  | comp i s s' ih ih' =>
    intro c hc
    rw [← Pres.comp_mk, w_comp] at ht
    rw [← Pres.comp_mk, dualVal_comp]
    refine pair_eq_zero_of_mem ?_ (decomp_mem_coaugSpan i hc)
    by_cases hx : w (Pres.mk s : FreeSet T _) = 0
    · exact Or.inr (ih' (by omega))
    · exact Or.inl (ih hx)

name: Operad.Cofree.dualVal_genHom_gen
statement:
@[simp] lemma dualVal_genHom_gen (φ : ∀ k, C (Fin k) →ₗ[R] (T k →₀ R)) {k : ℕ} (g : T k)
    (c : C (Fin k)) : dualVal (genHom φ) (Pres.gen g) c = φ k c g
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: Operad.Cofree.genHom_gen_coaug
statement:
lemma genHom_gen_coaug (φ : ∀ k, C (Fin k) →ₗ[R] (T k →₀ R))
    (hφ : ∀ k (e : Unit ≃ Fin k), φ k (map (R := R) e (Coaug.one (R := R) (C := C))) = 0)
    (k : ℕ) (g : T k) : ∀ c ∈ coaugSpan R C (Fin k), dualVal (genHom φ) (Pres.gen g) c = 0
proof:
:= by
  intro c hc
  induction hc using Submodule.span_induction with
  | mem x hx =>
    obtain ⟨e, rfl⟩ := hx
    rw [dualVal_genHom_gen, hφ k e, Finsupp.coe_zero, Pi.zero_apply]
  | zero => exact map_zero _
  | add x y _ _ hx hy => rw [map_add, hx, hy, add_zero]
  | smul r x _ hx => rw [map_smul, hx, smul_zero]

name: Operad.Cofree.locallyFinite
statement:
theorem locallyFinite (hC : Conilpotent R C) (φ : ∀ k, C (Fin k) →ₗ[R] (T k →₀ R))
    (hφ : ∀ k (e : Unit ≃ Fin k), φ k (map (R := R) e (Coaug.one (R := R) (C := C))) = 0) :
    LocallyFinite (genHom φ)
proof:
:= by
  set Ψ := genHom φ with hΨ
  have hgen := genHom_gen_coaug φ hφ
  have hunit : ∀ {A : Type} [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] (t : FreeSet T A), w t ≠ 0 →
      ∀ c ∈ coaugSpan R C A, dualVal Ψ t c = 0 :=
    fun t ht => dualVal_eq_zero_of_coaug Ψ hgen t ht
  suffices h : ∀ n (A : Type) [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A], ∀ c ∈ filt R C n A,
      (Function.support fun t : FreeSet T A => dualVal Ψ t c).Finite by
    intro A _ _ c
    obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := hC A c
    exact h n A c hn
  intro n
  induction n with
  | zero =>
    intro A _ _ c hc
    refine (Set.finite_range fun e : Unit ≃ A =>
      (SetOperad.map e SetOperad.one : FreeSet T A)).subset fun t ht => ?_
    by_contra hne
    refine ht (hunit t (fun h0 => hne ?_) c hc)
    obtain ⟨e, he⟩ := eq_unit t h0
    exact ⟨e, he.symm⟩
  | succ n ih =>
    intro A _ _ c hc
    have hV : ∀ (B D : Type) [Fintype B] [DecidableEq B] [Fintype D] [DecidableEq D] (i : B)
        (e : Without B i ⊕ D ≃ A),
        {pq : FreeSet T B × FreeSet T D | w pq.1 ≠ 0 ∧ w pq.2 ≠ 0 ∧
          pair (dualVal Ψ pq.1) (dualVal Ψ pq.2)
            (decomp (R := R) i (map (R := R) e.symm c)) ≠ 0}.Finite := by
      intro B D _ _ _ _ i e
      obtain ⟨w₁₂, hw₁₂, w₃, hw₃, hsum⟩ := Submodule.mem_sup.1 (hc B D i e)
      obtain ⟨w₁, hw₁, w₂, hw₂, rfl⟩ := Submodule.mem_sup.1 hw₁₂
      refine (finite_support_pair _ _ (fun m hm => ih B m hm) (fun m hm => ih D m hm)
        hw₃).subset fun pq ⟨hp, hq, hne⟩ => ?_
      rw [← hsum, map_add, map_add, pair_eq_zero_of_mem (Or.inl (hunit pq.1 hp)) hw₁,
        pair_eq_zero_of_mem (Or.inr (hunit pq.2 hq)) hw₂, zero_add, zero_add] at hne
      exact hne
    let U₀ : Set (FreeSet T A) := Set.range fun e : Unit ≃ A => SetOperad.map e SetOperad.one
    let U₁ : Set (FreeSet T A) := ⋃ e : Fin (Fintype.card A) ≃ A,
      (fun g => SetOperad.map e (Pres.gen g)) '' Function.support (φ _ (map (R := R) e.symm c))
    let U₂ : Set (FreeSet T A) := ⋃ a ∈ Finset.range (Fintype.card A + 2),
      ⋃ b ∈ Finset.range (Fintype.card A + 1), ⋃ i : Fin a, ⋃ e : Without (Fin a) i ⊕ Fin b ≃ A,
        (fun pq : FreeSet T (Fin a) × FreeSet T (Fin b) =>
          SetOperad.map e (SetOperad.comp i pq.1 pq.2)) ''
          {pq | w pq.1 ≠ 0 ∧ w pq.2 ≠ 0 ∧ pair (dualVal Ψ pq.1) (dualVal Ψ pq.2)
            (decomp (R := R) i (map (R := R) e.symm c)) ≠ 0}
    have h₀ : U₀.Finite := Set.finite_range _
    have h₁ : U₁.Finite :=
      Set.finite_iUnion fun e => (Finsupp.support_finite' _).image _
    have h₂ : U₂.Finite :=
      Set.Finite.biUnion (Finset.finite_toSet _) fun a _ =>
        Set.Finite.biUnion (Finset.finite_toSet _) fun b _ =>
          Set.finite_iUnion fun i => Set.finite_iUnion fun e => (hV _ _ i e).image _
    refine ((h₀.union h₁).union h₂).subset fun t ht => ?_
    rcases FreeSet.shape t with ⟨e, rfl⟩ | ⟨k, g, e, rfl⟩ | ⟨a, b, i, p, q, e, hp, hq, rfl⟩
    · exact Or.inl (Or.inl ⟨e, rfl⟩)
    · obtain rfl : k = Fintype.card A := by simpa using Fintype.card_congr e
      rw [Function.mem_support, dualVal_map, dualVal_genHom_gen] at ht
      exact Or.inl (Or.inr (Set.mem_iUnion.2 ⟨e, g, ht, rfl⟩))
    · have hcard := Fintype.card_congr e
      rw [Fintype.card_sum, Reg.card_without, Fintype.card_fin, Fintype.card_fin] at hcard
      have ha := i.pos
      rw [Function.mem_support, dualVal_map, dualVal_comp] at ht
      refine Or.inr (Set.mem_iUnion₂.2 ⟨a, ?_, Set.mem_iUnion₂.2 ⟨b, ?_, Set.mem_iUnion.2 ⟨i,
        Set.mem_iUnion.2 ⟨e, ⟨(p, q), ⟨hp, hq, ht⟩, rfl⟩⟩⟩⟩⟩)
      · exact Finset.mem_coe.2 (Finset.mem_range.2 (by omega))
      · exact Finset.mem_coe.2 (Finset.mem_range.2 (by omega))

name: Operad.Cofree.conilpotent
statement: theorem conilpotent : Conilpotent R (Cofree R T)
proof:
:=
  Lin.conilpotent

name: Operad.Cofree.homEquiv_apply
statement:
@[simp] lemma homEquiv_apply (hC : Conilpotent R C)
    (Φ : {Φ : SymCooperadHom R C (Cofree R T) //
      Φ.app Unit (Coaug.one (R := R) (C := C)) = Coaug.one (R := R) (C := Cofree R T)})
    (k : ℕ) : (homEquiv hC Φ).1 k = proj R T k ∘ₗ Φ.1.app (Fin k)
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: Operad.Cofree.existsUnique_lift
statement:
theorem existsUnique_lift (hC : Conilpotent R C) (φ : ∀ k, C (Fin k) →ₗ[R] (T k →₀ R))
    (hφ : ∀ k (e : Unit ≃ Fin k), φ k (map (R := R) e (Coaug.one (R := R) (C := C))) = 0) :
    ∃! Φ : {Φ : SymCooperadHom R C (Cofree R T) //
        Φ.app Unit (Coaug.one (R := R) (C := C)) = Coaug.one (R := R) (C := Cofree R T)},
      ∀ k, proj R T k ∘ₗ Φ.1.app (Fin k) = φ k
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨(homEquiv hC).symm ⟨φ, hφ⟩, fun k => ?_, fun Φ hΦ => ?_⟩
  · exact congrFun (congrArg Subtype.val ((homEquiv hC).apply_symm_apply ⟨φ, hφ⟩)) k
  · rw [Equiv.eq_symm_apply]
    exact Subtype.ext (funext hΦ)

name: Operad.ExtBV.vprod_nil
statement: lemma vprod_nil : vprod (R := R) ([] : List L) = 1
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.ExtBV.vprod_cons
statement: lemma vprod_cons (v : L) (vs : List L) : vprod (R := R) (v :: vs) = ι R v * vprod vs
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.ExtBV.vprod_append
statement: lemma vprod_append (vs ws : List L) : vprod (R := R) (vs ++ ws) = vprod vs * vprod ws
proof:
:= by
  rw [vprod, List.map_append, List.prod_append]
  rfl

name: Operad.ExtBV.Dm_vprod
statement:
lemma Dm_vprod (v : L) : ∀ (ws : List L), (∀ w ∈ ws, ⁅v, w⁆ = 0) →
    Dm R L v (vprod ws) = 0
  | [], _ => Dm_one v
  | w :: ws, h => by
    rw [vprod_cons, Dm_ι_mul, h w (List.mem_cons_self), map_zero, zero_mul, zero_add,
      Dm_vprod v ws fun w' hw' => h w' (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hw'), mul_zero]

name: Operad.ExtBV.dv_vprod_mul
statement:
lemma dv_vprod_mul : ∀ (vs : List L) (Z Y : E), (∀ v ∈ vs, Dm R L v Y = 0) →
    dv R L (vprod vs * Z) Y = (-1 : R) ^ vs.length • (vprod vs * dv R L Z Y)
  | [], Z, Y, _ => by rw [vprod_nil, one_mul, one_mul, List.length_nil, pow_zero, one_smul]
  | v :: vs, Z, Y, h => by
    rw [vprod_cons, mul_assoc, dv_ι_mul, h v (List.mem_cons_self), mul_zero, neg_zero, zero_sub,
      dv_vprod_mul vs Z Y fun w hw => h w (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hw), mul_smul_comm,
      List.length_cons, pow_succ, mul_comm, ← smul_smul, neg_one_smul, mul_assoc]

name: Operad.ExtBV.dv_marked
statement:
lemma dv_marked (vs vs' : List L) (u u' : L) (h₁ : ∀ v ∈ vs, ⁅v, u'⁆ = 0 ∧ ∀ v' ∈ vs', ⁅v, v'⁆ = 0)
    (h₂ : ∀ v' ∈ vs', ⁅u, v'⁆ = 0) :
    dv R L (vprod vs * ι R u) (vprod vs' * ι R u')
      = (-1 : R) ^ (vs.length + 1) • (vprod (vs ++ vs') * ι R ⁅u, u'⁆)
proof:
:= by
  rw [dv_vprod_mul vs _ _ fun v hv => ?_, dv_ι, Dm_mul, Dm_vprod u vs' h₂, zero_mul, zero_add,
    Dm_ι, vprod_append, pow_succ, ← smul_smul, neg_one_smul, mul_neg, smul_neg, ← neg_smul,
    mul_assoc]
  · rw [smul_neg, neg_smul]
  · rw [Dm_mul, Dm_vprod v vs' (h₁ v hv).2, zero_mul, zero_add, Dm_ι, (h₁ v hv).1, map_zero,
      mul_zero]

name: Operad.ExtBV.involute_vprod
statement:
lemma involute_vprod : ∀ vs : List L,
    involute (vprod (R := R) vs) = (-1 : R) ^ vs.length • vprod vs
  | [] => by rw [vprod_nil, map_one, List.length_nil, pow_zero, one_smul]
  | v :: vs => by
    rw [vprod_cons, map_mul, involute_ι, involute_vprod vs, List.length_cons, pow_succ,
      mul_comm, ← smul_smul, neg_one_smul, neg_mul, mul_smul_comm]

name: Operad.ExtBV.ι_mul_vprod
statement:
lemma ι_mul_vprod (u : L) (vs : List L) :
    ι R u * vprod vs = (-1 : R) ^ vs.length • (vprod vs * ι R u)
proof:
:= by
  rw [ι_mul_comm, involute_vprod, smul_mul_assoc]

name: Operad.ExtBV.marked_mul
statement:
lemma marked_mul (vs vs' : List L) (u : L) (Y : E) :
    vprod (R := R) vs * ι R u * (vprod vs' * Y)
      = (-1 : R) ^ vs'.length • (vprod (vs ++ vs') * (ι R u * Y))
proof:
:= by
  rw [mul_assoc, ← mul_assoc (ι R u), ι_mul_vprod, smul_mul_assoc, mul_smul_comm, vprod_append,
    mul_assoc, mul_assoc]

name: Operad.BVDim.bL_inl
statement: lemma bL_inl (u : List ℕ) : bL K n (Sum.inl u) = (wd K u, 0)
proof:
:= by
  rw [bL, Module.Basis.reindex_apply]
  show ((bW K).prod (Pi.basis fun _ : Fin n => Matrix.stdBasis K (Fin 3) (Fin 3))) (Sum.inl u) = _
  simp [bW_apply]

name: Operad.BVDim.bL_inr
statement:
lemma bL_inr (a : Fin n) (i j : Fin 3) :
    bL K n (Sum.inr (a, i, j)) = (0, Pi.single a (Matrix.single i j 1))
proof:
:= by
  rw [bL, Module.Basis.reindex_apply]
  show ((bW K).prod (Pi.basis fun _ : Fin n => Matrix.stdBasis K (Fin 3) (Fin 3)))
    (Sum.inr ⟨a, (i, j)⟩) = _
  simp [Pi.basis_apply, Matrix.stdBasis_eq_single]

name: Operad.BVDim.lie_eG
statement: lemma lie_eG (x y : Gw K) : ⁅eG (n := n) x, eG (n := n) y⁆ = eG (n := n) ⁅x, y⁆
proof:
:=
  Prod.ext rfl (show ⁅(0 : Hn K n), 0⁆ = 0 from lie_self _)

name: Operad.BVDim.lie_eG_inr
statement:
lemma lie_eG_inr (x : Gw K) (a : Fin n) (i j : Fin 3) :
    ⁅eG (n := n) x, bL K n (Sum.inr (a, i, j))⁆ = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [bL_inr]
  exact Prod.ext (show ⁅x, (0 : Gw K)⁆ = 0 from lie_zero _)
    (show ⁅(0 : Hn K n), _⁆ = 0 from zero_lie _)

name: Operad.BVDim.lie_inr_eG
statement:
lemma lie_inr_eG (x : Gw K) (a : Fin n) (i j : Fin 3) :
    ⁅bL K n (Sum.inr (a, i, j)), eG (n := n) x⁆ = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [← lie_skew, lie_eG_inr, neg_zero]

name: Operad.BVDim.lie_inr_ne
statement:
lemma lie_inr_ne {a b : Fin n} (hab : a ≠ b) (i j k l : Fin 3) :
    ⁅bL K n (Sum.inr (a, i, j)), bL K n (Sum.inr (b, k, l))⁆ = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [bL_inr, bL_inr]
  refine Prod.ext (show ⁅(0 : Gw K), 0⁆ = 0 from lie_self _) ?_
  show ⁅(Pi.single a (Matrix.single i j (1 : K)) : Hn K n),
    (Pi.single b (Matrix.single k l (1 : K)) : Hn K n)⁆ = 0
  rw [Ring.lie_def]
  funext c
  by_cases hc : c = a
  · subst hc
    simp [Ne.symm hab]
  · simp [hc]

name: Operad.BVDim.lie_pq
statement:
lemma lie_pq (a : Fin n) :
    ⁅bL K n (Sum.inr (a, 0, 1)), bL K n (Sum.inr (a, 1, 2))⁆ = bL K n (Sum.inr (a, 0, 2))
proof:
:= by
  rw [bL_inr, bL_inr, bL_inr]
  refine Prod.ext (show ⁅(0 : Gw K), 0⁆ = 0 from lie_self _) ?_
  show ⁅(Pi.single a (Matrix.single (0 : Fin 3) (1 : Fin 3) (1 : K)) : Hn K n),
    (Pi.single a (Matrix.single (1 : Fin 3) (2 : Fin 3) (1 : K)) : Hn K n)⁆
      = (Pi.single a (Matrix.single (0 : Fin 3) (2 : Fin 3) (1 : K)) : Hn K n)
  rw [Ring.lie_def]
  funext c
  by_cases hc : c = a
  · subst hc
    simp only [Pi.sub_apply, Pi.mul_apply, Pi.single_eq_same]
    rw [Matrix.single_mul_single_same, Matrix.single_mul_single_of_ne _ _ _ _ (by decide),
      sub_zero, one_mul]
  · simp [hc]

name: Operad.BVDim.vprod_mem
statement:
lemma vprod_mem : ∀ vs : List (Lw K n), vprod (R := K) vs ∈ evenOdd (0 : QuadraticForm K (Lw K n))
    (vs.length : ZMod 2)
  | [] => by
    rw [vprod_nil, List.length_nil, Nat.cast_zero, ← map_one (algebraMap K (Ew K n))]
    exact algebraMap_mem 1
  | v :: vs => by
    rw [vprod_cons, List.length_cons, Nat.cast_succ]
    exact mul_mem' (by ring) (ι_mem v) (vprod_mem vs)

name: Operad.BVDim.yIn_odd
statement: lemma yIn_odd (a : ℕ) : SuperMod.pr (R := K) true (yIn K n a) = yIn K n a
proof:
:= by
  refine (isP_iff true _).2 (mul_mem' ?_ (vprod_mem _) (ι_mem _))
  simp only [mvs, List.flatMap_cons, List.flatMap_nil, List.append_nil]
  split_ifs <;> simp [mv, bz]; decide

name: Operad.BVDim.mvs_append
statement:
lemma mvs_append (ε : Fin n → Bool) (w w' : List ℕ) :
    mvs n ε (w ++ w') = mvs n ε w ++ mvs n ε w'
proof: := List.flatMap_append

name: Operad.BVDim.mem_mvs
statement:
lemma mem_mvs {ε : Fin n → Bool} {w : List ℕ} {x : Idx n} (hx : x ∈ mvs n ε w) :
    ∃ (a : Fin n) (i j : Fin 3), a.1 ∈ w ∧ x = Sum.inr (a, i, j)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, ha, hx⟩ := List.mem_flatMap.1 hx
  split_ifs at hx with h
  · refine ⟨⟨a, h⟩, ?_⟩
    unfold mv at hx
    split_ifs at hx
    · exact ⟨0, 2, ha, List.mem_singleton.1 hx⟩
    · rcases List.mem_pair.1 hx with rfl | rfl
      · exact ⟨0, 1, ha, rfl⟩
      · exact ⟨1, 2, ha, rfl⟩
  · simp at hx

name: Operad.BVDim.lie_mvs_eG
statement:
lemma lie_mvs_eG {ε : Fin n → Bool} {w : List ℕ} {v : Lw K n}
    (hv : v ∈ (mvs n ε w).map (bL K n)) (x : Gw K) : ⁅v, eG (n := n) x⁆ = 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.1 hv
  obtain ⟨a, i, j, -, rfl⟩ := mem_mvs hy
  exact lie_inr_eG x a i j

name: Operad.BVDim.lie_eG_mvs
statement:
lemma lie_eG_mvs {ε : Fin n → Bool} {w : List ℕ} {v : Lw K n}
    (hv : v ∈ (mvs n ε w).map (bL K n)) (x : Gw K) : ⁅eG (n := n) x, v⁆ = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [← lie_skew, lie_mvs_eG hv, neg_zero]

name: Operad.BVDim.lie_mvs_mvs
statement:
lemma lie_mvs_mvs {ε : Fin n → Bool} {w w' : List ℕ} (hd : ∀ a ∈ w, a ∉ w') {v v' : Lw K n}
    (hv : v ∈ (mvs n ε w).map (bL K n)) (hv' : v' ∈ (mvs n ε w').map (bL K n)) : ⁅v, v'⁆ = 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.1 hv
  obtain ⟨a, i, j, ha, rfl⟩ := mem_mvs hy
  obtain ⟨y', hy', rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.1 hv'
  obtain ⟨b, k, l, hb, rfl⟩ := mem_mvs hy'
  exact lie_inr_ne (fun e => hd a ha (by rw [e]; exact hb)) i j k l

name: Operad.BVDim.Δ_yIn
statement:
lemma Δ_yIn {a : ℕ} (h : a < n) :
    Δ K (Lw K n) (yIn K n a)
      = -(vprod ((mv n (fun _ => true) ⟨a, h⟩).map (bL K n)) * ι K (eG (n := n) (wd K [a])))
proof:
:= by
  simp only [yIn, mvs, List.flatMap_cons, List.flatMap_nil, List.append_nil, dif_pos h, mv,
    Bool.false_eq_true, if_false, if_true, List.map_cons, List.map_nil, vprod_cons, vprod_nil,
    mul_one, mul_assoc]
  rw [Δ_ι_mul, Δ_ι_mul, Δ_ι, mul_zero, sub_zero, Dm_ι, Dm_ι_mul, Dm_ι, lie_pq,
    lie_inr_eG, map_zero, mul_zero, add_zero, lie_inr_eG, map_zero, neg_zero]
  simp

name: Operad.BVDim.combZ_single
statement: lemma combZ_single (ε : Fin n → Bool) (a : ℕ) : combZ K n ε [a] = zIn K n ε a
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.BVDim.combZ_append_single
statement:
lemma combZ_append_single (ε : Fin n → Bool) {w : List ℕ} (hw : w ≠ []) (c : ℕ) :
    combZ K n ε (w ++ [c]) = dv K (Lw K n) (combZ K n ε w) (zIn K n ε c)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, rest, rfl⟩ := List.exists_cons_of_ne_nil hw
  simp only [List.cons_append, combZ, List.foldl_append, List.foldl_cons, List.foldl_nil]

name: Operad.BVDim.mvs_single
statement: lemma mvs_single (ε : Fin n → Bool) {a : ℕ} (h : a < n) : mvs n ε [a] = mv n ε ⟨a, h⟩
proof:
:= by
  simp [mvs, h]

name: Operad.BVDim.sign_sq
statement:
lemma sign_sq {s₁ s₂ : K} (hs₁ : s₁ * s₁ = 1) (hs₂ : s₂ * s₂ = 1) (k : ℕ) :
    s₁ * s₂ * (-1) ^ k * (s₁ * s₂ * (-1) ^ k) = 1
proof:
:= by
  calc _ = (s₁ * s₁) * (s₂ * s₂) * ((-1) ^ k * (-1) ^ k) := by ring
    _ = 1 := by rw [hs₁, hs₂, ← mul_pow, neg_one_mul, neg_neg, one_pow, one_mul, one_mul]

name: Operad.BVDim.zIn_marked
statement:
lemma zIn_marked (ε : Fin n → Bool) {a : ℕ} (h : a < n) :
    ∃ s : K, s * s = 1 ∧ zIn K n ε a
      = s • (vprod ((mvs n ε [a]).map (bL K n)) * ι K (eG (n := n) (wd K [a])))
proof:
:= by
  rw [mvs_single ε h, zIn, dif_pos h]
  by_cases he : ε ⟨a, h⟩
  · refine ⟨-1, by ring, ?_⟩
