name: Operad.OperadIdeal.proj_reindex
statement:
lemma proj_reindex {m n : ℕ} (h : m = n) (x : P m) :
    reindex R I.Quot h (I.proj m x) = I.proj n (reindex R P h x)
proof:
:= by
  subst h
  simp only [reindex_self]

name: Operad.subset_generated
statement:
lemma subset_generated (S : ∀ n, Set (P n)) {n : ℕ} {x : P n} (hx : x ∈ S n) :
    x ∈ (generated (R := R) S).carrier n
proof: := IsGenerated.basic hx

name: Operad.apply_eq_zero_of_isGenerated
statement:
lemma apply_eq_zero_of_isGenerated (φ : NSOperadHom R P Q) (S : ∀ n, Set (P n))
    (hS : ∀ n, ∀ x ∈ S n, φ.app n x = 0) :
    ∀ {n : ℕ} {x : P n}, IsGenerated (R := R) S n x → φ.app n x = 0
proof:
:= by
  intro n x hx
  induction hx with
  | basic h => exact hS _ _ h
  | zero => exact map_zero _
  | add _ _ ihx ihy => rw [map_add, ihx, ihy, add_zero]
  | smul r _ ih => rw [map_smul, ih, smul_zero]
  | compL a b β _ ih => rw [φ.app_comp, ih, map_zero, LinearMap.zero_apply]
  | compR a b α _ ih => rw [φ.app_comp, ih, map_zero]

name: Operad.OperadIdeal.liftHom_proj
statement:
lemma OperadIdeal.liftHom_proj (I : OperadIdeal R P) (φ : NSOperadHom R P Q)
    (h : ∀ (n : ℕ), ∀ x ∈ I.carrier n, φ.app n x = 0) (n : ℕ) (x : P n) :
    (I.liftHom φ h).app n (I.proj n x) = φ.app n x
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.OperadIdeal.liftHom_mk
statement:
@[simp] lemma OperadIdeal.liftHom_mk (I : OperadIdeal R P) (φ : NSOperadHom R P Q)
    (h : ∀ (n : ℕ), ∀ x ∈ I.carrier n, φ.app n x = 0) (n : ℕ) (x : P n) :
    (I.liftHom φ h).app n (Submodule.Quotient.mk x) = φ.app n x
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.Tree.relabel_leaf
statement: @[simp] lemma relabel_leaf : relabel f (.leaf : Tree E) = .leaf
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.Tree.relabel_node
statement:
@[simp] lemma relabel_node {k : ℕ} (e : E k) (fo : Forest E k) :
    relabel f (.node e fo) = .node (f _ e) (Forest.relabelF f fo)
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.Tree.relabelF_nil
statement: @[simp] lemma relabelF_nil : Forest.relabelF f (.nil : Forest E 0) = .nil
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.Tree.relabelF_cons
statement:
@[simp] lemma relabelF_cons {k : ℕ} (t : Tree E) (fo : Forest E k) :
    Forest.relabelF f (.cons t fo) = .cons (relabel f t) (Forest.relabelF f fo)
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.Tree.arity_relabel
statement:
theorem arity_relabel : ∀ t : Tree E, (relabel f t).arity = t.arity
  | .leaf => rfl
  | .node _ fo => Forest.arityF_relabelF fo

name: Operad.Forest.arityF_relabelF
statement:
theorem _root_.Operad.Forest.arityF_relabelF : ∀ {k : ℕ} (fo : Forest E k),
    (Forest.relabelF f fo).arityF = fo.arityF
  | _, .nil => rfl
  | _, .cons t fo => by
    simp only [relabelF_cons, arityF_cons, arity_relabel t, Forest.arityF_relabelF fo]

end

mutual

name: Operad.Tree.relabel_graft
statement:
theorem relabel_graft : ∀ (t : Tree E) (i : ℕ) (s : Tree E),
    relabel f (t.graft i s) = (relabel f t).graft i (relabel f s)
  | .leaf, _, _ => rfl
  | .node _ fo, i, s => by
    simp only [graft_node, relabel_node, Forest.relabelF_graftF fo i s]

name: Operad.Forest.relabelF_graftF
statement:
theorem _root_.Operad.Forest.relabelF_graftF : ∀ {k : ℕ} (fo : Forest E k) (i : ℕ) (s : Tree E),
    Forest.relabelF f (fo.graftF i s) = (Forest.relabelF f fo).graftF i (relabel f s)
  | _, .nil, _, _ => rfl
  | _, .cons t fo, i, s => by
    by_cases h : i < t.arity
    · rw [graftF_cons_of_lt s h, relabelF_cons, relabelF_cons,
        graftF_cons_of_lt _ (by rwa [arity_relabel]), relabel_graft t i s]
    · rw [graftF_cons_of_ge s (by omega), relabelF_cons, relabelF_cons,
        graftF_cons_of_ge _ (by rw [arity_relabel]; omega), Forest.relabelF_graftF fo,
        arity_relabel]

end

mutual

name: Operad.Tree.relabel_relabel
statement:
theorem relabel_relabel (g : ∀ k, E' k → E'' k) : ∀ t : Tree E,
    relabel g (relabel f t) = relabel (fun k e => g k (f k e)) t
  | .leaf => rfl
  | .node _ fo => by simp only [relabel_node, Forest.relabelF_relabelF g fo]

name: Operad.Forest.relabelF_relabelF
statement:
theorem _root_.Operad.Forest.relabelF_relabelF (g : ∀ k, E' k → E'' k) :
    ∀ {k : ℕ} (fo : Forest E k),
    Forest.relabelF g (Forest.relabelF f fo) = Forest.relabelF (fun k e => g k (f k e)) fo
  | _, .nil => rfl
  | _, .cons t fo => by
    simp only [relabelF_cons, relabel_relabel g t, Forest.relabelF_relabelF g fo]

end

name: Operad.Tree.graft_eq_leaf'
statement:
lemma graft_eq_leaf' {s u : Tree E} {p : ℕ} (h : s.graft p u = .leaf) :
    s = .leaf ∧ u = .leaf
proof:
:= by
  cases s with
  | leaf => exact ⟨rfl, by simpa using h⟩
  | node e fo => simp at h

name: Operad.Tree.eq_leaf_of_relabel
statement: lemma eq_leaf_of_relabel {t : Tree E} (h : relabel f t = .leaf) : t = .leaf
proof:
:= by
  cases t with
  | leaf => rfl
  | node e fo => simp at h

name: Operad.Tree.graft_cancel
statement:
theorem graft_cancel : ∀ (s₁ s₂ u₁ u₂ : Tree E) (i : ℕ), i < s₁.arity →
    s₁.graft i u₁ = s₂.graft i u₂ → relabel f s₁ = relabel f s₂ → s₁ = s₂ ∧ u₁ = u₂
  | .leaf, s₂, u₁, u₂, i, _, h, hr => by
    have hs₂ : s₂ = .leaf
proof:
:= eq_leaf_of_relabel f hr.symm
    subst hs₂
    exact ⟨rfl, h⟩
  | .node e₁ fo₁, .leaf, _, _, _, _, _, hr => by simp at hr
  | .node e₁ fo₁, .node e₂ fo₂, u₁, u₂, i, hi, h, hr => by
    simp only [graft_node, Tree.node.injEq] at h
    obtain ⟨hk, he, hfo⟩ := h
    subst hk
    have he' : e₁ = e₂ := eq_of_heq he
    subst he'
    have hfo' := eq_of_heq hfo
    simp only [relabel_node, Tree.node.injEq, heq_eq_eq, true_and] at hr
    obtain ⟨hf, hr'⟩ := Forest.graftF_cancel fo₁ fo₂ u₁ u₂ i hi hfo' hr
    subst hf
    exact ⟨rfl, hr'⟩

name: Operad.Forest.graftF_cancel
statement:
theorem _root_.Operad.Forest.graftF_cancel : ∀ {k : ℕ} (fo₁ fo₂ : Forest E k) (u₁ u₂ : Tree E)
    (i : ℕ), i < fo₁.arityF → fo₁.graftF i u₁ = fo₂.graftF i u₂ →
    Forest.relabelF f fo₁ = Forest.relabelF f fo₂ → fo₁ = fo₂ ∧ u₁ = u₂
  | _, .nil, _, _, _, _, hi, _, _ => by simp at hi
  | _, .cons t₁ fo₁, .cons t₂ fo₂, u₁, u₂, i, hi, h, hr => by
    simp only [relabelF_cons, Forest.cons.injEq] at hr
    obtain ⟨hrt, hrf⟩
proof:
:= hr
    have ha : t₁.arity = t₂.arity := by
      rw [← arity_relabel f t₁, ← arity_relabel f t₂, hrt]
    simp only [arityF_cons] at hi
    by_cases hlt : i < t₁.arity
    · rw [graftF_cons_of_lt _ hlt, graftF_cons_of_lt _ (by rwa [← ha])] at h
      simp only [Forest.cons.injEq] at h
      obtain ⟨ht, hfo⟩ := graft_cancel t₁ t₂ u₁ u₂ i hlt h.1 hrt
      subst ht
      exact ⟨by rw [h.2], hfo⟩
    · rw [graftF_cons_of_ge _ (by omega), graftF_cons_of_ge _ (by omega)] at h
      simp only [Forest.cons.injEq] at h
      obtain ⟨ht, hf⟩ := h
      subst ht
      obtain ⟨hfo, hu⟩ := Forest.graftF_cancel fo₁ fo₂ u₁ u₂ (i - t₁.arity)
        (by omega) hf hrf
      exact ⟨by rw [hfo], hu⟩

name: Operad.Tree.exists_graft_of_relabel_graft
statement:
theorem exists_graft_of_relabel_graft : ∀ (t : Tree E) (s' u' : Tree E') (i : ℕ),
    i < s'.arity → s'.graft i u' = relabel f t →
    ∃ s u, s.graft i u = t ∧ relabel f s = s' ∧ relabel f u = u'
  | t, .leaf, u', i, _, h => ⟨.leaf, t, rfl, rfl, h.symm⟩
  | .leaf, .node e' fo', u', i, _, h => by simp at h
  | .node e fo, .node e' fo', u', i, hi, h => by
    simp only [graft_node, relabel_node, Tree.node.injEq] at h
    obtain ⟨hk, he, hfo⟩
proof:
:= h
    subst hk
    have he' := eq_of_heq he
    subst he'
    obtain ⟨fo₀, u, h₀, hr, hu⟩ :=
      Forest.exists_graftF_of_relabelF_graftF fo fo' u' i hi (eq_of_heq hfo)
    exact ⟨.node e fo₀, u, by rw [graft_node, h₀], by rw [relabel_node, hr], hu⟩

name: Operad.Forest.exists_graftF_of_relabelF_graftF
statement:
theorem _root_.Operad.Forest.exists_graftF_of_relabelF_graftF : ∀ {k : ℕ} (fo : Forest E k)
    (fo' : Forest E' k) (u' : Tree E') (i : ℕ), i < fo'.arityF →
    fo'.graftF i u' = Forest.relabelF f fo →
    ∃ fo₀ u, fo₀.graftF i u = fo ∧ Forest.relabelF f fo₀ = fo' ∧ relabel f u = u'
  | _, .nil, _, _, _, hi, _ => by cases ‹Forest E' 0›; simp at hi
  | _, .cons t fo, .cons t' fo', u', i, hi, h => by
    simp only [arityF_cons] at hi
    by_cases hlt : i < t'.arity
    · rw [graftF_cons_of_lt _ hlt, relabelF_cons] at h
      simp only [Forest.cons.injEq] at h
      obtain ⟨ht, hfo⟩
proof:
:= h
      obtain ⟨s, u, hs, hr, hu⟩ := exists_graft_of_relabel_graft t t' u' i hlt ht
      refine ⟨.cons s fo, u, ?_, by rw [relabelF_cons, hr, hfo], hu⟩
      have hsa : i < s.arity := by rw [← arity_relabel f s, hr]; exact hlt
      rw [graftF_cons_of_lt _ hsa, hs]
    · rw [graftF_cons_of_ge _ (by omega), relabelF_cons] at h
      simp only [Forest.cons.injEq] at h
      obtain ⟨ht, hfo⟩ := h
      have ha : t.arity = t'.arity := by rw [← arity_relabel f t, ht]
      obtain ⟨fo₀, u, h₀, hr, hu⟩ :=
        Forest.exists_graftF_of_relabelF_graftF fo fo' u' (i - t'.arity) (by omega) hfo
      refine ⟨.cons t fo₀, u, ?_, by rw [relabelF_cons, hr, ← ht], hu⟩
      rw [graftF_cons_of_ge _ (by omega), ha, h₀]

name: Operad.Tree.cnt_leaf
statement: @[simp] lemma cnt_leaf : cnt w (.leaf : Tree E) = 0
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.Tree.cnt_node
statement:
@[simp] lemma cnt_node {k : ℕ} (e : E k) (fo : Forest E k) :
    cnt w (.node e fo) = w _ e + Forest.cntF w fo
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.Tree.cntF_nil
statement: @[simp] lemma cntF_nil : Forest.cntF w (.nil : Forest E 0) = 0
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.Tree.cntF_cons
statement:
@[simp] lemma cntF_cons {k : ℕ} (t : Tree E) (fo : Forest E k) :
    Forest.cntF w (.cons t fo) = cnt w t + Forest.cntF w fo
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.Tree.cnt_graft
statement:
theorem cnt_graft : ∀ (t : Tree E) (i : ℕ) (s : Tree E), i < t.arity →
    cnt w (t.graft i s) = cnt w t + cnt w s
  | .leaf, _, s, _ => by simp
  | .node _ fo, i, s, h => by
    simp only [graft_node, cnt_node]
    rw [Forest.cntF_graftF fo i s h]
    omega

name: Operad.Forest.cntF_graftF
statement:
theorem _root_.Operad.Forest.cntF_graftF : ∀ {k : ℕ} (fo : Forest E k) (i : ℕ) (s : Tree E),
    i < fo.arityF → Forest.cntF w (fo.graftF i s) = Forest.cntF w fo + cnt w s
  | _, .nil, _, _, h => by simp at h
  | _, .cons t fo, i, s, h => by
    simp only [arityF_cons] at h
    by_cases hlt : i < t.arity
    · rw [graftF_cons_of_lt s hlt]
      simp only [cntF_cons]
      rw [cnt_graft t i s hlt]
      omega
    · rw [graftF_cons_of_ge s (by omega)]
      simp only [cntF_cons]
      rw [Forest.cntF_graftF fo (i - t.arity) s (by omega)]
      omega

end

end Count

section Parity

variable {gp : ∀ k, E k → Bool} {gp' : ∀ k, E' k → Bool}

mutual

name: Operad.Tree.tpar_relabel
statement:
theorem tpar_relabel (hgp : ∀ k e, gp' k (f k e) = gp k e) :
    ∀ t : Tree E, tpar gp' (relabel f t) = tpar gp t
  | .leaf => rfl
  | .node e fo => by
    simp only [relabel_node, tpar_node, hgp, Forest.tparF_relabelF hgp fo]

name: Operad.Forest.tparF_relabelF
statement:
theorem _root_.Operad.Forest.tparF_relabelF (hgp : ∀ k e, gp' k (f k e) = gp k e) :
    ∀ {k : ℕ} (fo : Forest E k), Forest.tparF gp' (Forest.relabelF f fo) = Forest.tparF gp fo
  | _, .nil => rfl
  | _, .cons t fo => by
    simp only [relabelF_cons, tparF_cons, tpar_relabel hgp t, Forest.tparF_relabelF hgp fo]

end

mutual

name: Operad.Tree.apar_relabel
statement:
theorem apar_relabel (hgp : ∀ k e, gp' k (f k e) = gp k e) :
    ∀ (t : Tree E) (p : ℕ), apar gp' (relabel f t) p = apar gp t p
  | .leaf, _ => rfl
  | .node _ fo, p => by
    simp only [relabel_node, apar_node, Forest.aparF_relabelF hgp fo p]

name: Operad.Forest.aparF_relabelF
statement:
theorem _root_.Operad.Forest.aparF_relabelF (hgp : ∀ k e, gp' k (f k e) = gp k e) :
    ∀ {k : ℕ} (fo : Forest E k) (p : ℕ),
    Forest.aparF gp' (Forest.relabelF f fo) p = Forest.aparF gp fo p
  | _, .nil, _ => rfl
  | _, .cons t fo, p => by
    rw [relabelF_cons]
    by_cases h : p < t.arity
    · rw [aparF_cons_of_lt _ _ _ (by rwa [arity_relabel]), aparF_cons_of_lt _ _ _ h,
        apar_relabel hgp t p, Forest.tparF_relabelF f hgp fo]
    · rw [aparF_cons_of_ge _ _ _ (by rw [arity_relabel]; omega),
        aparF_cons_of_ge _ _ _ (by omega), arity_relabel, Forest.aparF_relabelF hgp fo]

end

end Parity

end Tree

                                                 

namespace FreeReg

open TreeOfArity FreeGr Sym

variable {T T' : ℕ → Type v} (f : ∀ k, T k → T' k)
variable {A B : Type} [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] [Fintype B] [DecidableEq B]

                                                                           
def relabelR (x : Reg (TreeOfArity T) A) : Reg (TreeOfArity T') A
proof:
:=
  (x.1, ⟨⟨x.2.1.1, ⟨Tree.relabel f x.2.1.2.1, (Tree.arity_relabel f _).trans x.2.1.2.2⟩⟩, x.2.2⟩)

name: Operad.FreeReg.relabelR_fst
statement: @[simp] lemma relabelR_fst (x : Reg (TreeOfArity T) A) : (relabelR f x).1 = x.1
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.FreeReg.treeOf_relabelR
statement:
@[simp] lemma treeOf_relabelR (x : Reg (TreeOfArity T) A) :
    treeOf (relabelR f x) = Tree.relabel f (treeOf x)
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.FreeReg.relabel_app
statement: @[simp] lemma relabel_app (x : Reg (TreeOfArity T) A) : (relabel f).app A x = relabelR f x
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.FreeReg.relabelF_leaves
statement:
lemma relabelF_leaves : ∀ k : ℕ, Forest.relabelF f (leaves (E := T) k) = leaves k
  | 0 => rfl
  | k + 1 => by
    show Forest.cons (Tree.relabel f .leaf) (Forest.relabelF f (leaves k)) = _
    rw [relabelF_leaves k]
    rfl

name: Operad.FreeReg.relabel_std
statement:
lemma relabel_std {k : ℕ} (e : T k) :
    (relabel f).app (Fin k) (Reg.std (corolla e)) = Reg.std (corolla (f k e))
proof:
:=
  Reg.ext rfl (arr_ext (by
    show Tree.relabel f (.node e (leaves k)) = .node (f k e) (leaves k)
    rw [Tree.relabel_node, relabelF_leaves f k]))

name: Operad.FreeReg.relabel_fact
statement:
theorem relabel_fact (i : A) (x : Reg (TreeOfArity T) (Without A i ⊕ B))
    (p' : Reg (TreeOfArity T') A) (q' : Reg (TreeOfArity T') B)
    (h : SetOperad.comp i p' q' = relabelR f x) :
    ∃ p q, SetOperad.comp i p q = x ∧ relabelR f p = p' ∧ relabelR f q = q'
proof:
:= by
  have ho := congrArg Prod.fst h
  have ht := congrArg treeOf h
  rw [treeOf_comp, treeOf_relabelR] at ht
  obtain ⟨s, u, hsu, hs, hu⟩ := Tree.exists_graft_of_relabel_graft f (treeOf x) (treeOf p')
    (treeOf q') (p'.1.rank i) (rank_lt_arity p' i) ht
  refine ⟨(p'.1, ⟨⟨p'.2.1.1, ⟨s, ?_⟩⟩, p'.2.2⟩), (q'.1, ⟨⟨q'.2.1.1, ⟨u, ?_⟩⟩, q'.2.2⟩), ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [← Tree.arity_relabel f s, hs, treeOf_arity]
  · rw [← Tree.arity_relabel f u, hu, treeOf_arity]
  · refine Reg.ext ho (arr_ext ?_)
    show treeOf (SetOperad.comp i _ _) = treeOf x
    rw [treeOf_comp]
    exact hsu
  · exact Reg.ext rfl (arr_ext hs)
  · exact Reg.ext rfl (arr_ext hu)

name: Operad.FreeReg.relabel_fact_unique
statement:
theorem relabel_fact_unique (i : A) {p₁ p₂ : Reg (TreeOfArity T) A}
    {q₁ q₂ : Reg (TreeOfArity T) B} (h : SetOperad.comp i p₁ q₁ = SetOperad.comp i p₂ q₂)
    (hp : relabelR f p₁ = relabelR f p₂) (hq : relabelR f q₁ = relabelR f q₂) :
    p₁ = p₂ ∧ q₁ = q₂
proof:
:= by
  have hp1 : p₁.1 = p₂.1 := by simpa using congrArg Prod.fst hp
  have hq1 : q₁.1 = q₂.1 := by simpa using congrArg Prod.fst hq
  have ht := congrArg treeOf h
  rw [treeOf_comp, treeOf_comp, hp1] at ht
  have hrp : Tree.relabel f (treeOf p₁) = Tree.relabel f (treeOf p₂) := congrArg treeOf hp
  obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := Tree.graft_cancel f (treeOf p₁) (treeOf p₂) (treeOf q₁) (treeOf q₂)
    (p₂.1.rank i) (by rw [← hp1]; exact rank_lt_arity p₁ i) ht hrp
  exact ⟨Reg.ext hp1 (arr_ext h1), Reg.ext hq1 (arr_ext h2)⟩

name: Operad.FreeReg.treeSgn_relabel
proof:
:=
  SgnData.ext rfl (funext fun _ => Tree.apar_relabel f hgp _ _) (Tree.tpar_relabel f hgp _)

name: Operad.FreeReg.cntF_leaves
statement:
lemma cntF_leaves (w : ∀ k, T k → ℕ) : ∀ k : ℕ, Forest.cntF w (leaves (E := T) k) = 0
  | 0 => rfl
  | k + 1 => by
    show Tree.cnt w .leaf + Forest.cntF w (leaves k) = 0
    rw [cntF_leaves w k]
    rfl

                                                                                          
def cntR (w : ∀ k, T k → ℕ) (x : Reg (TreeOfArity T) A) : ℕ
proof: := Tree.cnt w (treeOf x)

name: Operad.FreeReg.cntR_comp
statement:
lemma cntR_comp (w : ∀ k, T k → ℕ) (i : A) (x : Reg (TreeOfArity T) A)
    (y : Reg (TreeOfArity T) B) :
    cntR w (SetOperad.comp i x y) = cntR w x + cntR w y
proof:
:= by
  unfold cntR
  rw [treeOf_comp, Tree.cnt_graft _ _ _ _ (rank_lt_arity x i)]

name: Operad.FreeReg.cntR_map
statement:
lemma cntR_map (w : ∀ k, T k → ℕ) (e : A ≃ B) (x : Reg (TreeOfArity T) A) :
    cntR w (SetOperad.map e x) = cntR w x
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.FreeReg.cntR_one
statement: lemma cntR_one (w : ∀ k, T k → ℕ) : cntR w (SetOperad.one : Reg (TreeOfArity T) Unit) = 0
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: Operad.FreeReg.cntR_std
statement: lemma cntR_std (w : ∀ k, T k → ℕ) {k : ℕ} (e : T k) : cntR w (Reg.std (corolla e)) = w k e
proof:
:= by
  show Tree.cnt w (.node e (leaves k)) = w k e
  rw [Tree.cnt_node, cntF_leaves, add_zero]

name: Operad.FreeReg.induction
statement:
theorem induction (hgen : ∀ k (e : T k), P (Fin k) (Reg.std (corolla e)))
    (x : Reg (TreeOfArity T) A) : P A x
proof:
:= by
  letI : SetOperad (SubR P) :=
    { map := fun e x => ⟨SetOperad.map e x.1, hmap e x.1 x.2⟩
      map_refl := fun x => Subtype.ext (SetOperad.map_refl x.1)
      map_trans := fun e e' x => Subtype.ext (SetOperad.map_trans e e' x.1)
      one := ⟨SetOperad.one, hone⟩
      comp := fun i x y => ⟨SetOperad.comp i x.1 y.1, hcomp i x.1 y.1 x.2 y.2⟩
      map_comp := fun σ' τ i x y => Subtype.ext (SetOperad.map_comp σ' τ i x.1 y.1)
      comp_one := fun i x => Subtype.ext (SetOperad.comp_one i x.1)
      one_comp := fun y => Subtype.ext (SetOperad.one_comp y.1)
      comp_assoc_seq := fun i j x y z => Subtype.ext (SetOperad.comp_assoc_seq i j x.1 y.1 z.1)
      comp_assoc_par := fun hik x y z => Subtype.ext (SetOperad.comp_assoc_par hik x.1 y.1 z.1) }
  let ι : SetOperadHom (SubR P) (Reg (TreeOfArity T)) :=
    { app := fun _ _ _ z => z.1
      app_map := fun _ _ => rfl
      app_one := rfl
      app_comp := fun _ _ _ => rfl }
  let L : SetOperadHom (Reg (TreeOfArity T)) (SubR P) :=
    Reg.lift (TreeOfArity.lift (S := SetOperad.toNSSet (SubR P))
      fun k e => (⟨Reg.std (corolla e), hgen k e⟩ : SubR P (Fin k)))
  have hid : ι.comp L = SetOperadHom.id := regHom_ext fun k e => by
    show (L.app (Fin k) (Reg.std (corolla e))).1 = Reg.std (corolla e)
    rw [show L.app (Fin k) (Reg.std (corolla e)) = ⟨Reg.std (corolla e), hgen k e⟩ by
      rw [Reg.lift_std]
      exact TreeOfArity.lift_corolla (S := SetOperad.toNSSet (SubR P)) _ e]
  have hx : (L.app A x).1 = x := congrArg (fun φ : SetOperadHom _ _ => φ.app A x) hid
  rw [← hx]
  exact (L.app A x).2

name: Operad.FreeReg.cntR_hom
statement:
lemma cntR_hom (w : ∀ k, T k → ℕ) (w' : ∀ k, T' k → ℕ)
    (ψ : SetOperadHom (Reg (TreeOfArity T)) (Reg (TreeOfArity T')))
    (h : ∀ k (e : T k), cntR w' (ψ.app (Fin k) (Reg.std (corolla e))) = w k e)
    (x : Reg (TreeOfArity T) A) : cntR w' (ψ.app A x) = cntR w x
proof:
:= by
  refine induction (P := fun A _ _ x => cntR w' (ψ.app A x) = cntR w x) ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ x
  · intro A B _ _ _ _ e x hx
    rw [ψ.app_map, cntR_map, cntR_map, hx]
  · beta_reduce
    rw [ψ.app_one, cntR_one, cntR_one]
  · intro A B _ _ _ _ i x y hx hy
    rw [ψ.app_comp, cntR_comp, cntR_comp, hx, hy]
  · intro k e
    rw [h, cntR_std]

name: Operad.FreeReg.cntR_zero
statement: lemma cntR_zero (x : Reg (TreeOfArity T) A) : cntR (fun _ _ => 0) x = 0
proof:
:= by
  refine induction (P := fun A _ _ x => cntR (fun _ _ => 0) x = 0) ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ x
  · intro A B _ _ _ _ e x hx
    rwa [cntR_map]
  · exact cntR_one _
  · intro A B _ _ _ _ i x y hx hy
    rw [cntR_comp, hx, hy]
  · intro k e
    exact cntR_std _ e

name: Operad.FreeReg.cntR_mono
statement:
lemma cntR_mono {w w' : ∀ k, T k → ℕ} (h : ∀ k e, w k e ≤ w' k e) (x : Reg (TreeOfArity T) A) :
    cntR w x ≤ cntR w' x
proof:
:= by
  refine induction (P := fun A _ _ x => cntR w x ≤ cntR w' x) ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ x
  · intro A B _ _ _ _ e x hx
    rwa [cntR_map, cntR_map]
  · beta_reduce
    rw [cntR_one, cntR_one]
  · intro A B _ _ _ _ i x y hx hy
    rw [cntR_comp, cntR_comp]
    exact Nat.add_le_add hx hy
  · intro k e
    rw [cntR_std, cntR_std]
    exact h k e

name: Operad.LTree.vkey_vpair
statement: @[simp] lemma vkey_vpair (e : E) (l r : LTree E) : vkey (vpair e l r) = key (node e l r)
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.LTree.vrl_vpair
statement: @[simp] lemma vrl_vpair (e : E) (l r : LTree E) : vrl (vpair e l r) = r.minLabel
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.LTree.vkey_toLex
statement: @[simp] lemma vkey_toLex (k : ℕ ×ₗ ℕ) (a : ℕ) : vkey (toLex (k, a)) = k
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.LTree.vrl_toLex
statement: @[simp] lemma vrl_toLex (k : ℕ ×ₗ ℕ) (a : ℕ) : vrl (toLex (k, a)) = a
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.LTree.vlist_leaf
statement: @[simp] lemma vlist_leaf (a : ℕ) : vlist (leaf a : LTree E) = []
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.LTree.vlist_node
statement:
@[simp] lemma vlist_node (e : E) (l r : LTree E) :
    vlist (node e l r) = vpair e l r :: (vlist l ++ vlist r)
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.LTree.map_vkey_vlist
statement:
lemma map_vkey_vlist : ∀ t : LTree E, (vlist t).map vkey = t.keyList
  | leaf _ => rfl
  | node e l r => by
    simp only [vlist_node, List.map_cons, List.map_append, map_vkey_vlist l, map_vkey_vlist r,
      vkey_vpair, keyList]

name: Operad.LTree.nodup_map_vkey
statement: lemma nodup_map_vkey {t : LTree E} (hnd : t.labels.Nodup) : ((vlist t).map vkey).Nodup
proof:
:= by
  rw [map_vkey_vlist]
  exact nodup_keyList t hnd

name: Operad.LTree.nodup_vlist
statement: lemma nodup_vlist {t : LTree E} (hnd : t.labels.Nodup) : (vlist t).Nodup
proof:
:=
  (nodup_map_vkey hnd).of_map _

name: Operad.LTree.rl_mem_of_vlist
statement:
lemma rl_mem_of_vlist : ∀ {t : LTree E}, t.IsShuffle → ∀ {x : VD}, x ∈ vlist t →
    vrl x ∈ t.labels ∧ t.minLabel < vrl x
  | leaf _, _, x, hx => by simp at hx
  | node e l r, hs, x, hx => by
    obtain ⟨hlr, hl, hr⟩
proof:
:= hs
    rw [vlist_node, List.mem_cons, List.mem_append] at hx
    simp only [labels_node, List.mem_append, minLabel_node, min_eq_left hlr.le]
    rcases hx with rfl | hx | hx
    · exact ⟨Or.inr (minLabel_mem r), hlr⟩
    · obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := rl_mem_of_vlist hl hx
      exact ⟨Or.inl h1, h2⟩
    · obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := rl_mem_of_vlist hr hx
      exact ⟨Or.inr h1, hlr.trans h2⟩

name: Operad.LTree.nodup_map_vrl
statement:
lemma nodup_map_vrl : ∀ {t : LTree E}, t.IsShuffle → t.labels.Nodup → ((vlist t).map vrl).Nodup
  | leaf _, _, _ => by simp
  | node e l r, hs, hnd => by
    obtain ⟨hlr, hls, hrs⟩
proof:
:= hs
    have hnd' : (l.labels ++ r.labels).Nodup := by simpa using hnd
    have hl : l.labels.Nodup := (List.nodup_append.1 hnd').1
    have hr : r.labels.Nodup := (List.nodup_append.1 hnd').2.1
    have hdis : ∀ a ∈ l.labels, ∀ b ∈ r.labels, a ≠ b := fun a ha b hb =>
      ne_of_nodup_append hnd' ha hb
    rw [vlist_node, List.map_cons, List.map_append, List.nodup_cons, List.nodup_append]
    refine ⟨?_, nodup_map_vrl hls hl, nodup_map_vrl hrs hr, ?_⟩
    · simp only [vrl_vpair, List.mem_append, List.mem_map, not_or, not_exists, not_and]
      exact ⟨fun x hx h => hdis _ (rl_mem_of_vlist hls hx).1 _ (minLabel_mem r) h,
        fun x hx h => (ne_of_lt (rl_mem_of_vlist hrs hx).2) h.symm⟩
    · simp only [List.mem_map]
      rintro _ ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩ _ ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩ h
      exact hdis _ (rl_mem_of_vlist hls hx).1 _ (rl_mem_of_vlist hrs hy).1 h

name: Operad.LTree.validPath_nil
statement: @[simp] lemma validPath_nil (t : LTree E) : ValidPath t []
proof: := by cases t <;> trivial

name: Operad.LTree.validPath_of_node
statement:
lemma validPath_of_node : ∀ (t : LTree E) (p : List Bool), (∃ e l r, t.subtreeAt p = node e l r) →
    ValidPath t p
  | t, [], _ => validPath_nil t
  | leaf _, _ :: _, ⟨_, _, _, h⟩ => by simp [subtreeAt] at h
  | node _ l _, false :: p, h => validPath_of_node l p h
  | node _ _ r, true :: p, h => validPath_of_node r p h

                                                                   
def ctxL : LTree E → List Bool → List VD
  | leaf _, _ => []
  | node _ _ _, [] => []
  | node e l r, false :: p => vpair e l r :: (ctxL l p ++ vlist r)
  | node e l r, true :: p => vpair e l r :: (vlist l ++ ctxL r p)

name: Operad.LTree.subtreeAt_replaceAt
statement:
lemma subtreeAt_replaceAt : ∀ (t : LTree E) (p : List Bool) (u : LTree E), ValidPath t p →
    (t.replaceAt p u).subtreeAt p = u
  | t, [], u, _ => by simp only [replaceAt_nil, subtreeAt_nil]
  | leaf _, _ :: _, _, h => h.elim
  | node _ l _, false :: p, u, h => subtreeAt_replaceAt l p u h
  | node _ _ r, true :: p, u, h => subtreeAt_replaceAt r p u h

name: Operad.LTree.replaceAt_replaceAt
statement:
lemma replaceAt_replaceAt : ∀ (t : LTree E) (p : List Bool) (u w : LTree E),
    (t.replaceAt p u).replaceAt p w = t.replaceAt p w
  | t, [], u, w => by simp only [replaceAt_nil]
  | leaf _, _ :: _, _, _ => rfl
  | node e l r, false :: p, u, w => by simp [replaceAt, replaceAt_replaceAt l p u w]
  | node e l r, true :: p, u, w => by simp [replaceAt, replaceAt_replaceAt r p u w]

name: Operad.LTree.validPath_replaceAt
statement:
lemma validPath_replaceAt : ∀ (t : LTree E) (p : List Bool) (u : LTree E), ValidPath t p →
    ValidPath (t.replaceAt p u) p
  | _, [], _, _ => validPath_nil _
  | leaf _, _ :: _, _, h => h.elim
  | node _ l _, false :: p, u, h => validPath_replaceAt l p u h
  | node _ _ r, true :: p, u, h => validPath_replaceAt r p u h

name: Operad.LTree.labels_replaceAt_perm'
statement:
lemma labels_replaceAt_perm' : ∀ (t : LTree E) (p : List Bool) (u : LTree E), ValidPath t p →
    u.labels.Perm (t.subtreeAt p).labels → (t.replaceAt p u).labels.Perm t.labels
  | t, [], u, _, h => by cases t <;> simpa [replaceAt] using h
  | leaf _, _ :: _, _, h, _ => h.elim
  | node e l r, false :: p, u, h, hu => by
    simp only [replaceAt, labels_node]
    exact (labels_replaceAt_perm' l p u h hu).append_right _
  | node e l r, true :: p, u, h, hu => by
    simp only [replaceAt, labels_node]
    exact (labels_replaceAt_perm' r p u h hu).append_left _

name: Operad.LTree.vlist_replaceAt
statement:
lemma vlist_replaceAt : ∀ (t : LTree E) (p : List Bool) (u : LTree E), ValidPath t p →
    u.labels.Perm (t.subtreeAt p).labels → (vlist (t.replaceAt p u)).Perm (ctxL t p ++ vlist u)
  | t, [], u, _, _ => by cases t <;> simp [ctxL]
  | leaf _, _ :: _, _, h, _ => h.elim
  | node e l r, false :: p, u, h, hu => by
    have hp
proof:
:= labels_replaceAt_perm' l p u h hu
    have ha : (l.replaceAt p u).arity = l.arity := by
      rw [← length_labels, ← length_labels, hp.length_eq]
    have hk : vpair e (l.replaceAt p u) r = vpair e l r := by
      rw [vpair, vpair, key_node, key_node, minLabel_eq_of_perm hp, ha]
    simp only [replaceAt, vlist_node, hk, ctxL, List.cons_append, List.perm_cons]
    refine ((vlist_replaceAt l p u h hu).append_right _).trans ?_
    simp only [List.append_assoc]
    exact List.Perm.append_left _ List.perm_append_comm
  | node e l r, true :: p, u, h, hu => by
    have hp := labels_replaceAt_perm' r p u h hu
    have ha : (r.replaceAt p u).arity = r.arity := by
      rw [← length_labels, ← length_labels, hp.length_eq]
    have hk : vpair e l (r.replaceAt p u) = vpair e l r := by
      rw [vpair, vpair, key_node, key_node, minLabel_eq_of_perm hp, ha]
    simp only [replaceAt, vlist_node, hk, ctxL, List.cons_append, List.perm_cons,
      List.append_assoc]
    exact (vlist_replaceAt r p u h hu).append_left _

name: Operad.LTree.chi3_sq
statement: lemma chi3_sq (σ : LTree E) : chi3 σ * chi3 σ = 1
proof:
:= by
  unfold chi3
  split <;> norm_num

name: Operad.LTree.eq_leaf_of_arity_one
statement:
lemma eq_leaf_of_arity_one : ∀ {t : LTree E}, t.arity = 1 → ∃ a, t = leaf a
  | leaf a, _ => ⟨a, rfl⟩
  | node _ l r, h => by
    have
proof:
:= arity_pos l
    have := arity_pos r
    simp only [arity] at h
    omega

name: Operad.LTree.eq_node_of_arity_two
statement:
lemma eq_node_of_arity_two : ∀ {t : LTree E}, t.arity = 2 → ∃ f a b, t = node f (leaf a) (leaf b)
  | leaf _, h => by simp [arity] at h
  | node f l r, h => by
    have
proof:
:= arity_pos l
    have := arity_pos r
    simp only [arity] at h
    obtain ⟨a, rfl⟩ := eq_leaf_of_arity_one (show l.arity = 1 by omega)
    obtain ⟨b, rfl⟩ := eq_leaf_of_arity_one (show r.arity = 1 by omega)
    exact ⟨f, a, b, rfl⟩

name: Operad.LTree.mono3_cases
statement:
lemma mono3_cases {σ : LTree E} (hs : σ.IsShuffle) (hl : σ.labels.Perm (List.range 3)) :
    ∃ e f, σ = node e (node f (leaf 0) (leaf 1)) (leaf 2) ∨
      σ = node e (node f (leaf 0) (leaf 2)) (leaf 1) ∨
      σ = node e (leaf 0) (node f (leaf 1) (leaf 2))
proof:
:= by
  have harity : σ.arity = 3 := by rw [← length_labels, hl.length_eq]; rfl
  have hnd : σ.labels.Nodup := hl.nodup_iff.2 List.nodup_range
  have h3 : ∀ a < 3, a ∈ σ.labels := fun a ha => hl.symm.subset (List.mem_range.2 ha)
  have hmem : ∀ a ∈ σ.labels, a < 3 := fun a ha => List.mem_range.1 (hl.subset ha)
  match σ, hs, harity, hnd, h3, hmem with
  | leaf a, _, harity, _, _, _ => simp [arity] at harity
  | node e l r, hs, harity, hnd, h3, hmem =>
    have := arity_pos l
    have := arity_pos r
    simp only [arity] at harity
    rcases (show (l.arity = 1 ∧ r.arity = 2) ∨ (l.arity = 2 ∧ r.arity = 1) by omega) with
      ⟨h1, h2⟩ | ⟨h1, h2⟩
    · obtain ⟨a, rfl⟩ := eq_leaf_of_arity_one h1
      obtain ⟨f, b, c, rfl⟩ := eq_node_of_arity_two h2
      obtain ⟨hab, -, hbc, -, -⟩ := hs
      simp only [minLabel_node, minLabel_leaf] at hab hbc
      simp only [labels_node, labels_leaf, List.cons_append, List.nil_append, List.mem_cons,
        List.not_mem_nil, or_false, forall_eq_or_imp, forall_eq] at hmem h3
      have e0 := h3 0 (by norm_num)
      have e1 := h3 1 (by norm_num)
      have e2 := h3 2 (by norm_num)
      have hmin := min_le_left b c
      have hmin' := min_le_right b c
      obtain ⟨rfl, rfl, rfl⟩ : a = 0 ∧ b = 1 ∧ c = 2 := by omega
      exact ⟨e, f, Or.inr (Or.inr rfl)⟩
    · obtain ⟨f, a, b, rfl⟩ := eq_node_of_arity_two h1
      obtain ⟨c, rfl⟩ := eq_leaf_of_arity_one h2
      obtain ⟨hac, ⟨hab, -, -⟩, -⟩ := hs
      simp only [minLabel_node, minLabel_leaf] at hac hab
      have hbc : b ≠ c := by
        simp only [labels_node, labels_leaf, List.cons_append, List.nil_append] at hnd
        simp at hnd
        omega
      simp only [labels_node, labels_leaf, List.cons_append, List.nil_append, List.mem_cons,
        List.not_mem_nil, or_false, forall_eq_or_imp, forall_eq] at hmem h3
      have e0 := h3 0 (by norm_num)
      have e1 := h3 1 (by norm_num)
      have e2 := h3 2 (by norm_num)
      have hmin := min_le_left a b
      rw [min_eq_left hab.le] at hac
      rcases (show (a = 0 ∧ b = 1 ∧ c = 2) ∨ (a = 0 ∧ b = 2 ∧ c = 1) by omega) with
        ⟨rfl, rfl, rfl⟩ | ⟨rfl, rfl, rfl⟩
      · exact ⟨e, f, Or.inl rfl⟩
      · exact ⟨e, f, Or.inr (Or.inl rfl)⟩

name: Operad.LTree.sort_insert_split
statement:
lemma sort_insert_split {S : Finset VD} {x : VD} (hx : x ∉ S) :
    (insert x S).sort (· ≤ ·) =
      (S.filter (· < x)).sort (· ≤ ·) ++ x :: (S.filter (x < ·)).sort (· ≤ ·)
proof:
:= by
  set L := (S.filter (· < x)).sort (· ≤ ·) ++ x :: (S.filter (x < ·)).sort (· ≤ ·) with hL
  have hnd : L.Nodup := by
    rw [hL, List.nodup_append, List.nodup_cons]
    refine ⟨Finset.sort_nodup _ _, ⟨by simp, Finset.sort_nodup _ _⟩, ?_⟩
    intro a ha b hb hab
    subst hab
    simp only [Finset.mem_sort, Finset.mem_filter, List.mem_cons] at ha hb
    rcases hb with rfl | hb
    · exact lt_irrefl _ ha.2
    · exact lt_asymm ha.2 hb.2
  have hfin : L.toFinset = insert x S := by
    ext y
    simp only [hL, List.mem_toFinset, List.mem_append, Finset.mem_sort, Finset.mem_filter,
      List.mem_cons, Finset.mem_insert]
    constructor
    · rintro (⟨h, -⟩ | rfl | ⟨h, -⟩)
      · exact Or.inr h
      · exact Or.inl rfl
      · exact Or.inr h
    · rintro (rfl | h)
      · exact Or.inr (Or.inl rfl)
      · rcases lt_trichotomy y x with hyx | rfl | hxy
        · exact Or.inl ⟨h, hyx⟩
        · exact absurd h hx
        · exact Or.inr (Or.inr ⟨h, hxy⟩)
  have hpw : L.Pairwise (· ≤ ·) := by
    rw [hL, List.pairwise_append, List.pairwise_cons]
    refine ⟨Finset.pairwise_sort _ _, ⟨fun b hb => ?_, Finset.pairwise_sort _ _⟩,
      fun a ha b hb => ?_⟩
    · simp only [Finset.mem_sort, Finset.mem_filter] at hb
      exact hb.2.le
    · simp only [Finset.mem_sort, Finset.mem_filter, List.mem_cons] at ha hb
      rcases hb with rfl | hb
      · exact ha.2.le
      · exact (ha.2.trans hb.2).le
  rw [← hfin]
  exact (List.toFinset_sort (· ≤ ·) hnd).2 hpw

name: Operad.LTree.sort_split
statement:
lemma sort_split {S : Finset VD} {x : VD} (hx : x ∉ S) :
    S.sort (· ≤ ·) = (S.filter (· < x)).sort (· ≤ ·) ++ (S.filter (x < ·)).sort (· ≤ ·)
proof:
:= by
  set L := (S.filter (· < x)).sort (· ≤ ·) ++ (S.filter (x < ·)).sort (· ≤ ·) with hL
  have hnd : L.Nodup := by
    rw [hL, List.nodup_append]
    refine ⟨Finset.sort_nodup _ _, Finset.sort_nodup _ _, ?_⟩
    intro a ha b hb hab
    subst hab
    simp only [Finset.mem_sort, Finset.mem_filter] at ha hb
    exact lt_asymm ha.2 hb.2
  have hfin : L.toFinset = S := by
    ext y
    simp only [hL, List.mem_toFinset, List.mem_append, Finset.mem_sort, Finset.mem_filter]
    constructor
    · rintro (⟨h, -⟩ | ⟨h, -⟩) <;> exact h
    · intro h
      rcases lt_trichotomy y x with hyx | rfl | hxy
      · exact Or.inl ⟨h, hyx⟩
      · exact absurd h hx
      · exact Or.inr ⟨h, hxy⟩
  have hpw : L.Pairwise (· ≤ ·) := by
    rw [hL, List.pairwise_append]
    refine ⟨Finset.pairwise_sort _ _, Finset.pairwise_sort _ _, fun a ha b hb => ?_⟩
    simp only [Finset.mem_sort, Finset.mem_filter] at ha hb
    exact (ha.2.trans hb.2).le
  rw [← hfin]
  exact (List.toFinset_sort (· ≤ ·) hnd).2 hpw

name: Operad.LTree.sgn_rlList_insert
statement:
lemma sgn_rlList_insert (r0 : ℕ) {S : Finset VD} {x : VD} (hx : x ∉ S)
    (hrl : ∀ y ∈ S, vrl y ≠ vrl x) :
    sgn (r0 :: rlList (insert x S)) =
      (-1) ^ (S.filter (· < x)).card * sgn (r0 :: vrl x :: rlList S)
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : rlList (insert x S) =
      rlList (S.filter (· < x)) ++ vrl x :: rlList (S.filter (x < ·)) := by
    simp [rlList, sort_insert_split hx]
  have h2 : rlList S = rlList (S.filter (· < x)) ++ rlList (S.filter (x < ·)) := by
    simp [rlList, sort_split hx]
  have hnot : vrl x ∉ rlList (S.filter (· < x)) := by
    simp only [rlList, List.mem_map, Finset.mem_sort, Finset.mem_filter, not_exists, not_and]
    exact fun y hy h => hrl y hy.1 h
  have hlen : (rlList (S.filter (· < x))).length = (S.filter (· < x)).card := by
    simp [rlList]
  have hc : (rlList (S.filter (· < x)) ++ vrl x :: rlList (S.filter (x < ·))).countP (· < r0) =
      (vrl x :: (rlList (S.filter (· < x)) ++ rlList (S.filter (x < ·)))).countP (· < r0) :=
    List.Perm.countP_eq _ List.perm_middle
  rw [h1, sgn_cons, sgn_move hnot, hc, sgn_cons r0 (vrl x :: _), h2, hlen]
  ring

name: Operad.LTree.lt_iff_vkey
statement: lemma lt_iff_vkey {x y : VD} (h : vkey y ≠ vkey x) : y < x ↔ vkey y < vkey x
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨⟨ky, ay⟩, rfl⟩ := toLex.surjective y
  obtain ⟨⟨kx, ax⟩, rfl⟩ := toLex.surjective x
  simp only [vkey_toLex] at h ⊢
  rw [Prod.Lex.toLex_lt_toLex]
  constructor
  · rintro (h1 | ⟨h1, -⟩)
    · exact h1
    · exact absurd h1 h
  · exact Or.inl

name: Operad.LTree.tauS_mul_self
statement: lemma tauS_mul_self (t : LTree E) : tauS t * tauS t = 1
proof:
:= by
  cases t with
  | leaf => rfl
  | node e l r => exact sgn_mul_self _

name: Operad.LTree.edgeKeys_eq_vlist
statement:
lemma edgeKeys_eq_vlist (e : E) (l r : LTree E) :
    (node e l r).edgeKeys = ((vlist l ++ vlist r).map vkey).toFinset
proof:
:= by
  rw [edgeKeys_node]
  ext k
  simp only [Finset.mem_union, List.map_append, List.mem_toFinset, List.mem_append,
    map_vkey_vlist, mem_keyList_iff]

name: Operad.LTree.nodup_of_perm_vlist
statement:
lemma nodup_of_perm_vlist {e : E} {l r : LTree E} (hs : (node e l r).IsShuffle)
    (hnd : (node e l r).labels.Nodup) {L : List VD} (hperm : (vlist l ++ vlist r).Perm L) :
    (L.map vkey).Nodup ∧ (L.map vrl).Nodup
proof:
:= by
  have h1 := nodup_map_vkey hnd
  have h2 := nodup_map_vrl hs hnd
  rw [vlist_node, List.map_cons, List.nodup_cons] at h1 h2
  exact ⟨(hperm.map vkey).nodup_iff.1 h1.2, (hperm.map vrl).nodup_iff.1 h2.2⟩

name: Operad.LTree.topSgn_mul_tauS
statement:
lemma topSgn_mul_tauS (e : E) (l r : LTree E) (hs : (node e l r).IsShuffle)
    (hnd : (node e l r).labels.Nodup) {x : VD} {S : List VD}
    (hperm : (vlist l ++ vlist r).Perm (x :: S)) :
    topSgn (node e l r) (vkey x) * tauS (node e l r) =
      sgn (r.minLabel :: vrl x :: rlList S.toFinset)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hndk, hndr⟩ := nodup_of_perm_vlist hs hnd hperm
  rw [List.map_cons, List.nodup_cons] at hndk hndr
  have hxS : x ∉ S.toFinset := fun h =>
    hndk.1 (List.mem_map_of_mem (List.mem_toFinset.1 h))
  have hfin : (vlist l ++ vlist r).toFinset = insert x S.toFinset := by
    rw [List.toFinset_eq_of_perm _ _ hperm, List.toFinset_cons]
  have hrl : ∀ y ∈ S.toFinset, vrl y ≠ vrl x := fun y hy h =>
    hndr.1 (h ▸ List.mem_map_of_mem (List.mem_toFinset.1 hy))
  have hcount : ((node e l r).edgeKeys.filter (· < vkey x)).card =
      (S.toFinset.filter (· < x)).card := by
    have hne : ∀ y ∈ S, vkey y ≠ vkey x := fun y hy h =>
      hndk.1 (h ▸ List.mem_map_of_mem hy)
    rw [edgeKeys_eq_vlist, List.toFinset_eq_of_perm _ _ (hperm.map vkey), List.map_cons,
      List.toFinset_cons, Finset.filter_insert, if_neg (lt_irrefl _)]
    rw [← Finset.card_image_of_injOn (f := vkey) (s := S.toFinset.filter (· < x))]
    · congr 1
      ext k
      simp only [Finset.mem_filter, List.mem_toFinset, List.mem_map, Finset.mem_image]
      constructor
      · rintro ⟨⟨y, hy, rfl⟩, hk⟩
        exact ⟨y, ⟨hy, (lt_iff_vkey (hne y hy)).2 hk⟩, rfl⟩
      · rintro ⟨y, ⟨hy, hyx⟩, rfl⟩
        exact ⟨⟨y, hy, rfl⟩, (lt_iff_vkey (hne y hy)).1 hyx⟩
    · intro a ha b hb hab
      simp only [Finset.coe_filter, List.mem_toFinset, Set.mem_setOf_eq] at ha hb
      exact (List.inj_on_of_nodup_map hndk.2) ha.1 hb.1 hab
  rw [tauS, hfin, sgn_rlList_insert _ hxS hrl, topSgn, hcount, ← mul_assoc, ← pow_add,
    ← two_mul, pow_mul]
  norm_num

name: Operad.LTree.sgn_swap_rl
statement:
lemma sgn_swap_rl (r0 : ℕ) {O : List VD} {K : ℕ ×ₗ ℕ} (hK : ∀ y ∈ O, vkey y ≠ K) {β γ : ℕ}
    (hβγ : β ≠ γ) (hβ : ∀ y ∈ O, vrl y ≠ β) (hγ : ∀ y ∈ O, vrl y ≠ γ) :
    sgn (r0 :: β :: rlList (toLex (K, γ) :: O).toFinset) =
      -sgn (r0 :: γ :: rlList (toLex (K, β) :: O).toFinset)
proof:
:= by
  have hnotin : ∀ ρ : ℕ, toLex (K, ρ) ∉ O.toFinset := fun ρ h =>
    hK _ (List.mem_toFinset.1 h) rfl
  have hfl : ∀ ρ : ℕ, O.toFinset.filter (· < toLex (K, ρ)) = O.toFinset.filter (vkey · < K) :=
    fun ρ => Finset.filter_congr fun y hy =>
      lt_iff_vkey (by simpa using hK y (List.mem_toFinset.1 hy))
  have hfr : ∀ ρ : ℕ, O.toFinset.filter (toLex (K, ρ) < ·) = O.toFinset.filter (K < vkey ·) :=
    fun ρ => Finset.filter_congr fun y hy =>
      lt_iff_vkey (by simpa using (hK y (List.mem_toFinset.1 hy)).symm)
  have hsplit : ∀ ρ : ℕ, rlList (toLex (K, ρ) :: O).toFinset =
      rlList (O.toFinset.filter (vkey · < K)) ++ ρ :: rlList (O.toFinset.filter (K < vkey ·)) := by
    intro ρ
    rw [List.toFinset_cons, rlList, sort_insert_split (hnotin ρ), hfl ρ, hfr ρ]
    simp [rlList]
  set A := rlList (O.toFinset.filter (vkey · < K))
  set B := rlList (O.toFinset.filter (K < vkey ·))
  have hA : ∀ ρ, (ρ = β ∨ ρ = γ) → ρ ∉ A := by
    rintro ρ hρ h
    simp only [A, rlList, List.mem_map, Finset.mem_sort, Finset.mem_filter,
      List.mem_toFinset] at h
    obtain ⟨y, ⟨hy, -⟩, rfl⟩ := h
    rcases hρ with h | h
    · exact hβ y hy h
    · exact hγ y hy h
  rw [hsplit, hsplit, sgn_cons, sgn_cons r0, sgn_swap hβγ (hA γ (Or.inr rfl)) (hA β (Or.inl rfl))]
  have hc : (β :: (A ++ γ :: B)).countP (· < r0) = (γ :: (A ++ β :: B)).countP (· < r0) := by
    exact List.Perm.countP_eq _ ((List.perm_middle.cons β).trans
      ((List.Perm.swap γ β _).trans (List.perm_middle.symm.cons γ)))
  rw [hc]
  ring

name: Operad.LTree.chi3_a
statement: @[simp] lemma chi3_a (e f : E) : chi3 (node e (node f (leaf 0) (leaf 1)) (leaf 2)) = 1
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.LTree.chi3_b
statement: @[simp] lemma chi3_b (e f : E) : chi3 (node e (node f (leaf 0) (leaf 2)) (leaf 1)) = -1
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.LTree.chi3_c
statement: @[simp] lemma chi3_c (e f : E) : chi3 (node e (leaf 0) (node f (leaf 1) (leaf 2))) = -1
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.LTree.chi3_cases
statement: lemma chi3_cases (σ : LTree E) : chi3 σ = 1 ∨ chi3 σ = -1
proof:
:= by
  unfold chi3
  split
  · exact Or.inl rfl
  · exact Or.inr rfl

name: Operad.LTree.shape_data
statement:
lemma shape_data {σ : LTree E} (hσs : σ.IsShuffle) (hσl : σ.labels.Perm (List.range 3))
    (ins : ℕ → LTree E) (hlt : (ins 1).minLabel < (ins 2).minLabel) :
    ∃ e X Y x, σ.plug ins = node e X Y ∧
      (vlist X ++ vlist Y).Perm (x :: (vlist (ins 0) ++ vlist (ins 1) ++ vlist (ins 2))) ∧
      vkey x = key ((σ.plug ins).subtreeAt [side3 σ]) ∧
      (chi3 σ = 1 → vrl x = (ins 1).minLabel ∧ Y.minLabel = (ins 2).minLabel) ∧
      (chi3 σ = -1 → vrl x = (ins 2).minLabel ∧ Y.minLabel = (ins 1).minLabel)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨e, f, rfl | rfl | rfl⟩ := mono3_cases hσs hσl
  · refine ⟨e, node f (ins 0) (ins 1), ins 2, vpair f (ins 0) (ins 1), rfl, ?_, rfl,
      fun _ => ⟨rfl, rfl⟩, fun h => by simp at h⟩
    simp only [vlist_node, List.cons_append, List.append_assoc, List.Perm.refl]
  · refine ⟨e, node f (ins 0) (ins 2), ins 1, vpair f (ins 0) (ins 2), rfl, ?_, rfl,
      fun h => by simp at h, fun _ => ⟨rfl, rfl⟩⟩
    simp only [vlist_node, List.cons_append, List.append_assoc]
    perm_by_count
  · refine ⟨e, ins 0, node f (ins 1) (ins 2), vpair f (ins 1) (ins 2), rfl, ?_, rfl,
      fun h => by simp at h, fun _ => ⟨rfl, ?_⟩⟩
    · simp only [vlist_node]
      perm_by_count
    · simp only [minLabel_node]
      exact min_eq_left hlt.le

name: Operad.LTree.topSgn_mul_tauS_substAt
statement:
theorem topSgn_mul_tauS_substAt {t : LTree E} (hs : t.IsShuffle) (hnd : t.labels.Nodup)
    {p : List Bool} {s : Bool} (he : t.IsEdge p s) :
    ∃ c : ℤ, c * c = 1 ∧ ∀ σ : LTree E, σ.IsShuffle → σ.labels.Perm (List.range 3) →
      topSgn (t.substAt p s σ) (key ((t.substAt p s σ).subtreeAt (p ++ [side3 σ]))) *
        tauS (t.substAt p s σ) = c * chi3 σ
proof:
:= by
  have hw := winSpec_of_edge he hs hnd
  have hvp : ValidPath t p := validPath_of_node t p he.exists_node
  set u := t.subtreeAt p with hu
  set A := u.winIns s 0 with hA
  set B := u.winIns s 1 with hB
  set C := u.winIns s 2 with hC
  have hβγ : B.minLabel < C.minLabel := hw.lt12
  have hWp : ∀ σ : LTree E, σ.labels.Perm (List.range 3) →
      (σ.plug (u.winIns s)).labels.Perm u.labels := fun σ h2 =>
    perm_labels_plug_winIns he hs hnd h2
  have htn : ∀ σ : LTree E, σ.labels.Perm (List.range 3) → (t.substAt p s σ).labels.Nodup :=
    fun σ h2 => (perm_labels_substAt he hs hnd h2).nodup_iff.2 hnd
  have hts : ∀ σ : LTree E, σ.IsShuffle → σ.labels.Perm (List.range 3) →
      (t.substAt p s σ).IsShuffle := fun σ h1 h2 => isShuffle_substAt he hs hnd h1 h2
  have hchild : ∀ σ : LTree E, (t.substAt p s σ).subtreeAt (p ++ [side3 σ]) =
      (σ.plug (u.winIns s)).subtreeAt [side3 σ] := fun σ => by
    rw [substAt, subtreeAt_append, subtreeAt_replaceAt _ _ _ hvp]
  rcases p with _ | ⟨b, p'⟩
  · 
    refine ⟨sgn (C.minLabel :: B.minLabel :: rlList (vlist A ++ vlist B ++ vlist C).toFinset),
      sgn_mul_self _, fun σ hσs hσl => ?_⟩
    obtain ⟨e, X, Y, x, hpl, hperm, hkx, h1, h2⟩ := shape_data hσs hσl (u.winIns s) hβγ
    have hσ : t.substAt [] s σ = node e X Y := by
      rw [substAt, replaceAt_nil, ← hpl]
    rw [hchild, ← hkx, hσ]
    have hs' := hts σ hσs hσl
    have hnd' := htn σ hσl
    rw [hσ] at hs' hnd'
    rw [topSgn_mul_tauS e X Y hs' hnd' hperm]
    rcases chi3_cases σ with hχ | hχ
    · obtain ⟨hx, hY⟩ := h1 hχ
      rw [hχ, mul_one, hx, hY]
    · obtain ⟨hx, hY⟩ := h2 hχ
      rw [hχ, hx, hY]
      have := sgn_swap (Ne.symm hβγ.ne) (l₂ := []) (l₃ := rlList (vlist A ++ vlist B ++
        vlist C).toFinset) (by simp) (by simp)
      simp only [List.nil_append] at this
      rw [this]
      ring
  · 
    cases t with
    | leaf a => exact absurd hvp (by simp [ValidPath])
    | node e₀ l r =>
    have hkeyW : ∀ σ : LTree E, σ.labels.Perm (List.range 3) →
        key (σ.plug (u.winIns s)) = key u := fun σ h2 => ShuffleBar.key_eq_of_perm (hWp σ h2)
    cases b with
    | false =>
      set O := ctxL l p' ++ vlist r ++ (vlist A ++ vlist B ++ vlist C) with hO
      refine ⟨sgn (r.minLabel :: B.minLabel :: rlList (toLex (key u, C.minLabel) :: O).toFinset),
        sgn_mul_self _, fun σ hσs hσl => ?_⟩
      obtain ⟨e, X, Y, x, hpl, hperm, hkx, h1, h2⟩ := shape_data hσs hσl (u.winIns s) hβγ
      rw [← hA, ← hB, ← hC] at hperm
      have hσ : (node e₀ l r).substAt (false :: p') s σ =
          node e₀ (l.replaceAt p' (node e X Y)) r := by
        rw [← hpl]
        rfl
      have hvp' : ValidPath l p' := hvp
      have hperm' : (vlist (l.replaceAt p' (node e X Y)) ++ vlist r).Perm
          (x :: (vpair e X Y :: O)) := by
        have h0 := vlist_replaceAt l p' (node e X Y) hvp' (hpl ▸ hWp σ hσl)
        refine (h0.append_right _).trans ?_
        simp only [vlist_node, hO]
        refine ((((hperm.cons _).append_left _).append_right _)).trans ?_
        perm_by_count
      have hxr : vpair e X Y = toLex (key u, Y.minLabel) := by
        rw [vpair, ← hkeyW σ hσl, hpl]
      rw [hchild, ← hkx, hσ]
      have hs' := hts σ hσs hσl
      have hnd' := htn σ hσl
      rw [hσ] at hs' hnd'
      rw [topSgn_mul_tauS e₀ _ r hs' hnd' hperm', hxr]
      obtain ⟨hndk, hndr⟩ := nodup_of_perm_vlist hs' hnd' hperm'
      rcases chi3_cases σ with hχ | hχ
      · obtain ⟨hx, hY⟩ := h1 hχ
        rw [hχ, mul_one, hx, hY]
      · obtain ⟨hx, hY⟩ := h2 hχ
        rw [hχ, hx, hY]
        simp only [List.map_cons, List.nodup_cons, List.mem_cons, List.mem_map, not_or,
          not_exists, not_and, hxr, hx, hY, vkey_toLex, vrl_toLex] at hndk hndr
        rw [sgn_swap_rl r.minLabel (fun y hy h => hndk.2.1 y hy h) hβγ.ne
          (fun y hy h => hndr.2.1 y hy h) (fun y hy h => hndr.1.2 y hy h)]
        ring
    | true =>
      set O := vlist l ++ ctxL r p' ++ (vlist A ++ vlist B ++ vlist C) with hO
      refine ⟨sgn (r.minLabel :: B.minLabel :: rlList (toLex (key u, C.minLabel) :: O).toFinset),
        sgn_mul_self _, fun σ hσs hσl => ?_⟩
      obtain ⟨e, X, Y, x, hpl, hperm, hkx, h1, h2⟩ := shape_data hσs hσl (u.winIns s) hβγ
      rw [← hA, ← hB, ← hC] at hperm
      have hσ : (node e₀ l r).substAt (true :: p') s σ =
          node e₀ l (r.replaceAt p' (node e X Y)) := by
        rw [← hpl]
        rfl
      have hvp' : ValidPath r p' := hvp
      have hr' : (r.replaceAt p' (node e X Y)).minLabel = r.minLabel :=
        minLabel_eq_of_perm (labels_replaceAt_perm' r p' _ hvp' (hpl ▸ hWp σ hσl))
      have hperm' : (vlist l ++ vlist (r.replaceAt p' (node e X Y))).Perm
          (x :: (vpair e X Y :: O)) := by
        have h0 := vlist_replaceAt r p' (node e X Y) hvp' (hpl ▸ hWp σ hσl)
        refine (h0.append_left _).trans ?_
        simp only [vlist_node, hO]
        refine ((((hperm.cons _).append_left _).append_left _)).trans ?_
        perm_by_count
      have hxr : vpair e X Y = toLex (key u, Y.minLabel) := by
        rw [vpair, ← hkeyW σ hσl, hpl]
      rw [hchild, ← hkx, hσ]
      have hs' := hts σ hσs hσl
      have hnd' := htn σ hσl
      rw [hσ] at hs' hnd'
      rw [topSgn_mul_tauS e₀ l _ hs' hnd' hperm', hxr, hr']
      obtain ⟨hndk, hndr⟩ := nodup_of_perm_vlist hs' hnd' hperm'
      rcases chi3_cases σ with hχ | hχ
      · obtain ⟨hx, hY⟩ := h1 hχ
        rw [hχ, mul_one, hx, hY]
      · obtain ⟨hx, hY⟩ := h2 hχ
        rw [hχ, hx, hY]
        simp only [List.map_cons, List.nodup_cons, List.mem_cons, List.mem_map, not_or,
          not_exists, not_and, hxr, hx, hY, vkey_toLex, vrl_toLex] at hndk hndr
        rw [sgn_swap_rl r.minLabel (fun y hy h => hndk.2.1 y hy h) hβγ.ne
          (fun y hy h => hndr.2.1 y hy h) (fun y hy h => hndr.1.2 y hy h)]
        ring

name: Operad.mem_fiberKer
statement:
lemma mem_fiberKer {f : X → Option Y} {v : X → K} :
    v ∈ fiberKer K f ↔ ∀ y, ∑ x ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun x => f x = some y), v x = 0
proof:
:=
  Iff.rfl

name: Operad.IsLeadingOf.unique
statement:
lemma IsLeadingOf.unique {v : X → K} {x x' : X} (h : IsLeadingOf v x) (h' : IsLeadingOf v x') :
    x = x'
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hne
  rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne hne with hlt | hlt
  · exact h'.1 (h.2 x' hlt)
  · exact h.1 (h'.2 x hlt)

name: Operad.isLeading_fiberKer_iff
statement:
theorem isLeading_fiberKer_iff [Nontrivial K] (f : X → Option Y) (x : X) :
    IsLeading (fiberKer K f : Set (X → K)) x ↔ f x = none ∨ ∃ x' < x, f x' = f x
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨v, hv, hx, hmax⟩
    by_contra hcon
    simp only [not_or, not_exists, not_and] at hcon
    obtain ⟨hne, hmin⟩ := hcon
    obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := Option.ne_none_iff_exists'.1 hne
    have h0 := (mem_fiberKer.1 hv) y
    rw [Finset.sum_eq_single x] at h0
    · exact hx h0
    · intro z hz hzx
      rw [Finset.mem_filter] at hz
      rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne hzx with h | h
      · exact absurd (hz.2.trans hy.symm) (hmin z h)
      · exact hmax z h
    · intro hxs
      exact absurd (Finset.mem_filter.2 ⟨Finset.mem_univ x, hy⟩) hxs
  · rintro (h | ⟨x', hx', h⟩)
    · refine ⟨Pi.single x 1, fun y => ?_, by simp, fun z hz => ?_⟩
      · rw [Finset.sum_pi_single', if_neg]
        rw [Finset.mem_filter, h]
        simp
      · simp [hz.ne']
    · refine ⟨Pi.single x 1 - Pi.single x' 1, fun y => ?_, ?_, fun z hz => ?_⟩
      · simp only [Pi.sub_apply, Finset.sum_sub_distrib, Finset.sum_pi_single',
          Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and, h, sub_self]
      · simp [hx'.ne']
      · simp [hz.ne', (hx'.trans hz).ne']

name: Operad.mem_supportedOn
statement: lemma mem_supportedOn {N : Set X} {v : X → K} : v ∈ supportedOn K N ↔ ∀ x ∉ N, v x = 0
proof:
:=
  Iff.rfl

name: Operad.exists_reduction
statement:
theorem exists_reduction (I : Submodule K (X → K)) (N : Set X)
    (hI : ∀ x ∉ N, IsLeading (I : Set (X → K)) x) (v : X → K) :
    ∃ u ∈ I, v - u ∈ supportedOn K N ∧
      ∀ x, (∀ y ∉ N, v y ≠ 0 → y < x) → u x = 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  suffices h : ∀ (b : WithTop X) (v : X → K), (∀ y ∉ N, v y ≠ 0 → (y : WithTop X) < b) →
      ∃ u ∈ I, v - u ∈ supportedOn K N ∧ ∀ x, (∀ y ∉ N, v y ≠ 0 → y < x) → u x = 0 from
    h ⊤ v fun _ _ _ => WithTop.coe_lt_top _
  intro b
  induction b using WellFoundedLT.induction with
  | _ b ih =>
  intro v hb
  by_cases hN : ∀ y ∉ N, v y = 0
  · exact ⟨0, I.zero_mem, by simpa using hN, fun _ _ => rfl⟩
  push Not at hN
  set D := Finset.univ.filter fun y => y ∉ N ∧ v y ≠ 0 with hD
  have hDne : D.Nonempty := by
    obtain ⟨y, hy, hy'⟩ := hN
    exact ⟨y, by simp [hD, hy, hy']⟩
  set y := D.max' hDne with hy
  have hyD : y ∈ D := D.max'_mem hDne
  have hymax : ∀ z ∉ N, v z ≠ 0 → z ≤ y := fun z hz hz' =>
    D.le_max' z (by simp [hD, hz, hz'])
  simp only [hD, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and] at hyD
  obtain ⟨w, hw, hwy, hw0⟩ := hI y hyD.1
  set v' := v - (v y / w y) • w with hv'
  have hv'z : ∀ z, y < z → v' z = v z := fun z hz => by
    simp [hv', hw0 z hz]
  have hv'y : v' y = 0 := by
    simp [hv', div_mul_cancel₀ _ hwy]
  have hv'lt : ∀ z ∉ N, v' z ≠ 0 → z < y := by
    intro z hz hz'
    rcases lt_or_ge z y with h | h
    · exact h
    · rcases h.lt_or_eq with h | h
      · rw [hv'z z h] at hz'
        exact absurd (hymax z hz hz') (not_le.2 h)
      · exact absurd (h ▸ hv'y) hz'
  obtain ⟨u, hu, hvu, hux⟩ := ih (y : WithTop X) (hb y hyD.1 hyD.2) v'
    fun z hz hz' => WithTop.coe_lt_coe.2 (hv'lt z hz hz')
  refine ⟨u + (v y / w y) • w, I.add_mem hu (I.smul_mem _ hw), ?_, fun x hx => ?_⟩
  · have : v - (u + (v y / w y) • w) = v' - u := by
      simp only [hv']
      abel
    rw [this]
    exact hvu
  · have hyx : y < x := hx y hyD.1 hyD.2
    have hu0 : u x = 0 := hux x fun z hz hz' => (hv'lt z hz hz').trans hyx
    simp [hu0, hw0 x hyx]

name: Operad.isLeading_iff_of_supportedOn
statement:
theorem isLeading_iff_of_supportedOn (I : Submodule K (X → K)) (N : Set X)
    (hI : ∀ x ∉ N, IsLeading (I : Set (X → K)) x)
    (hN : ∀ v ∈ I, v ∈ supportedOn K N → v = 0) (x : X) :
    IsLeading (I : Set (X → K)) x ↔ x ∉ N
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun ⟨v, hv, hvx, hmax⟩ hx => ?_, hI x⟩
  obtain ⟨u, hu, hvu, hux⟩ := exists_reduction I N hI v
  have h0 := hN (v - u) (I.sub_mem hv hu) hvu
  have hx' : u x = 0 := hux x fun y hy hy' => by
    rcases lt_or_ge y x with h | h
    · exact h
    · rcases h.lt_or_eq with h | h
      · exact absurd (hmax y h) hy'
      · exact absurd (h ▸ hx) hy
  have := congrFun h0 x
  simp only [Pi.sub_apply, hx', sub_zero, Pi.zero_apply] at this
  exact hvx this

name: Operad.isCompl_supportedOn
statement:
theorem isCompl_supportedOn (I : Submodule K (X → K)) (N : Set X)
    (hI : ∀ x ∉ N, IsLeading (I : Set (X → K)) x)
    (hN : ∀ v ∈ I, v ∈ supportedOn K N → v = 0) : IsCompl I (supportedOn K N)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨Submodule.disjoint_def.2 fun v hv hv' => hN v hv hv', ?_⟩
  rw [codisjoint_iff, eq_top_iff]
  intro v _
  obtain ⟨u, hu, hvu, -⟩ := exists_reduction I N hI v
  have : v = u + (v - u) := by abel
  rw [this]
  exact Submodule.add_mem_sup hu hvu

name: Operad.GrComposite.app_actLin
statement:
lemma app_actLin (ψ : GrOperadHom R C C') {A : Type} [DecidableEq A] (L : LinOrd A) (f : S → A)
    (i : S) (z : C Y) (q : Bool) (a : A) (y : C (Fib f a)) :
    ψ.app _ (actLin (R := R) L f i z q a y)
      = actLin (R := R) L f i (ψ.app Y z) q a (ψ.app _ y)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases h : f i = a
  · rw [actLin_eq _ _ _ _ _ _ h, actLin_eq _ _ _ _ _ _ h, ψ.app_map, ψ.app_comp]
  · rw [actLin_ne _ _ _ _ _ _ h, actLin_ne _ _ _ _ _ _ h, GrOperad.tw_apply, GrOperad.tw_apply,
      map_add, map_smul, ψ.app_par, ψ.app_par, ψ.app_map]

name: Operad.GrComposite.map₂_act
statement:
lemma map₂_act (φ : SymSpeciesHom R V V') (ψ : GrOperadHom R C C') (i : S) (z : C Y)
    (w : GrComposite R V C S) :
    (map₂ φ ψ.toGrSpeciesHom).app _ (act R V i z w)
      = act R V' i (ψ.app Y z) ((map₂ φ ψ.toGrSpeciesHom).app S w)
proof:
:= by
  induction w using induction_on with
  | h0 => simp only [map_zero]
  | hadd x y hx hy => simp only [map_add, hx, hy]
  | hsmul r x hx => simp only [map_smul, hx]
  | hmk g =>
    rw [mk_eq_ownGen (R := R) g, act_mk_ownGen, map₂_mk]
    rw [show genMap₂ φ ψ.toGrSpeciesHom (ownGen g.L g.m (owner g) fun a =>
        SymSpecies.map (R := R) (fibEquiv g a) (g.y a))
      = ownGen g.L (φ.app _ g.m) (owner g) (fun a => ψ.app _
        (SymSpecies.map (R := R) (fibEquiv g a) (g.y a))) from rfl, act_mk_ownGen]
    unfold actOwn
    rw [map_sum]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun q _ => ?_
    rw [map₂_mk, ← ψ.app_par]
    show mk R (ownGen _ _ _ fun a => ψ.app _ (actLin (R := R) g.L (owner g) i
        (GrOperad.par (R := R) q z) q a _))
      = mk R (ownGen _ _ _ fun a => actLin (R := R) g.L (owner g) i
        (ψ.app Y (GrOperad.par (R := R) q z)) q a _)
    congr 2
    funext a
    exact app_actLin ψ g.L (owner g) i _ q a _

name: Operad.GrComposite.fst_corLin
statement:
@[simp] lemma fst_corLin {A : Type} [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] (c : C A) :
    SqExt.fst (corLin ε A c) = 0
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.GrComposite.snd_corLin
statement:
@[simp] lemma snd_corLin {A : Type} [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] (c : C A) :
    SqExt.snd (corLin ε A c) = corolla R P A c

name: Operad.GrComposite.fst_inclHom
statement:
@[simp] lemma fst_inclHom {A : Type} [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] (y : P A) :
    SqExt.fst ((inclHom C ε).app A y) = y
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.GrComposite.snd_inclHom
statement:

name: Operad.GrComposite.twF_act
statement:
theorem twF_act {Y : Type} [Fintype Y] [DecidableEq Y] (F : GrOperad.Inv R (ConvOp R C 𝒬))
    (i : S) (z : P Y) (w : GrComposite R C P S) :
    twF ε F _ (act R C i z w) = act R C i z (twF ε F S w)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [twF, LinearMap.comp_apply]
  rw [map₂_act, total_act, SqExt.comp_def, SqExt.snd_compE, fst_inclHom, snd_inclHom, map_zero,
    add_zero]

name: Operad.GrComposite.twF_map
statement:
theorem twF_map {S' : Type} [Fintype S'] [DecidableEq S'] (F : GrOperad.Inv R (ConvOp R C 𝒬))
    (σ : S ≃ S') (w : GrComposite R C P S) :
    twF ε F S' (map σ w) = map σ (twF ε F S w)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [twF, LinearMap.comp_apply]
  rw [show (map₂ idSpHom (inclHom C ε).toGrSpeciesHom).app S' (map σ w)
      = map σ ((map₂ idSpHom (inclHom C ε).toGrSpeciesHom).app S w) from
    (map₂ idSpHom (inclHom C ε).toGrSpeciesHom).app_map σ w, total_map]
  rfl

name: Operad.GrComposite.twF_corolla
statement:
theorem twF_corolla {A : Type} [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] (F : GrOperad.Inv R (ConvOp R C 𝒬))
    (c : C A) : twF ε F A (corolla R P A c) = SqExt.snd (ConvOp.toLin (F.1 A) c)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [twF, LinearMap.comp_apply]
  rw [corolla_apply, map₂_mk]
  rw [show genMap₂ idSpHom (inclHom C ε).toGrSpeciesHom
      (corGen (C := P) (R := R) (ordOf A) c (Equiv.refl A))
      = corGen (C := 𝒬) (R := R) (ordOf A) c (Equiv.refl A) from rfl, total_corGen,
    GrOperad.map_refl]
  rfl

name: Operad.GrComposite.eq_of_corolla
statement:
theorem eq_of_corolla
    (T T' : ∀ (S : Type) [Fintype S] [DecidableEq S],
      GrComposite R' V N S →ₗ[R'] GrComposite R' V N S)
    (hT : ∀ (S S' : Type) [Fintype S] [DecidableEq S] [Fintype S'] [DecidableEq S'] (σ : S ≃ S')
      (w : GrComposite R' V N S), T S' (map σ w) = map σ (T S w))
    (hT' : ∀ (S S' : Type) [Fintype S] [DecidableEq S] [Fintype S'] [DecidableEq S'] (σ : S ≃ S')
      (w : GrComposite R' V N S), T' S' (map σ w) = map σ (T' S w))
    (hTa : ∀ (S Y : Type) [Fintype S] [DecidableEq S] [Fintype Y] [DecidableEq Y] (i : S)
      (z : N Y) (w : GrComposite R' V N S), T _ (act R' V i z w) = act R' V i z (T S w))
    (hTa' : ∀ (S Y : Type) [Fintype S] [DecidableEq S] [Fintype Y] [DecidableEq Y] (i : S)
      (z : N Y) (w : GrComposite R' V N S), T' _ (act R' V i z w) = act R' V i z (T' S w))
    (hc : ∀ (A : Type) [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] (v : V A),
      T A (corolla R' N A v) = T' A (corolla R' N A v))
    {S : Type} [Fintype S] [DecidableEq S] (w : GrComposite R' V N S) : T S w = T' S w
proof:
:=
  induction_act (fun S _ _ w => T S w = T' S w) (fun S _ _ => by simp)
    (fun S _ _ x y hx hy => by simp only [map_add, hx, hy])
    (fun S _ _ r x hx => by simp only [map_smul, hx])
    (fun S S' _ _ _ _ σ x hx => by beta_reduce at hx ⊢; rw [hT, hT', hx])
    (fun S Y _ _ _ _ i z x hx => by beta_reduce at hx ⊢; rw [hTa, hTa', hx]) hc w

name: Operad.GrComposite.isParC_of_isPar
proof:
:=
  parC_eq_self_iff.1 (hβ A)

name: Operad.GrComposite.isPar_liftFam
statement:
lemma isPar_liftFam {p : Bool} {β : GrOperad.Inv R (ConvOp R C P)}
    (hβ : GrOperad.Inv.IsPar p β) : GrOperad.Inv.IsPar p (liftFam ε β)
proof:
:= fun A _ _ => by
  show GrOperad.par (R := R) p ((ConvOp.postHom (C := C) (inclHom C ε)).app A (β.1 A)) = _
  rw [← GrOperadHom.app_par, hβ A]
  rfl

name: Operad.GrComposite.toLin_term
statement:
lemma toLin_term {Q : (A : Type) → [Fintype A] → [DecidableEq A] → Type*}
    [∀ (A : Type) [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A], AddCommGroup (Q A)]
    [∀ (A : Type) [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A], Module R (Q A)] [GrOperad R Q]
    (G H : GrOperad.Inv R (ConvOp R C Q)) (S : Finset X) (c : C X) :
    toLin (GrOperad.Inv.term (R := R) G.1 H.1 X S) c
      = GrOperad.map (R := R) (splitEquiv S) (mu none (kap (G.1 (SOut S)) (H.1 (SIn S))
          (GrCooperad.decomp (R := R) none
            (SymSpecies.map (R := R) (splitEquiv S).symm c))))
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.GrComposite.toLin_star
statement:
lemma toLin_star {Q : (A : Type) → [Fintype A] → [DecidableEq A] → Type*}
    [∀ (A : Type) [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A], AddCommGroup (Q A)]
    [∀ (A : Type) [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A], Module R (Q A)] [GrOperad R Q]
    (G H : GrOperad.Inv R (ConvOp R C Q)) (c : C X) :
    toLin ((GrOperad.Inv.star R (ConvOp R C Q) G H).1 X) c
      = ∑ S ∈ nonempties X, toLin (GrOperad.Inv.term (R := R) G.1 H.1 X S) c
proof:
:= by
  rw [GrOperad.Inv.star_apply, toLin_sum, LinearMap.coe_sum, Finset.sum_apply]

name: Operad.GrComposite.fst_star
statement:
lemma fst_star {G : GrOperad.Inv R (ConvOp R C 𝒬)}
    (hG : ∀ (A : Type) [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] (c : C A), SqExt.fst (toLin (G.1 A) c) = 0)
    (H : GrOperad.Inv R (ConvOp R C 𝒬)) (c : C X) :
    SqExt.fst (toLin ((GrOperad.Inv.star R (ConvOp R C 𝒬) G H).1 X) c) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [toLin_star, map_sum]
  refine Finset.sum_eq_zero fun S _ => ?_
  rw [toLin_term, SqExt.map_def, SqExt.fst_mapE]
  generalize GrCooperad.decomp (R := R) (C := C) none
    (SymSpecies.map (R := R) (splitEquiv S).symm c) = t
  suffices h : SqExt.fst (mu (R := R) none (kap (G.1 (SOut S)) (H.1 (SIn S)) t)) = 0 by
    rw [h, map_zero]
  induction t using TensorProduct.induction_on with
  | zero => simp
  | tmul x y =>
    simp only [kap, LinearMap.coe_sum, Finset.sum_apply, map_sum, TensorProduct.map_tmul,
      mu_tmul, LinearMap.comp_apply]
    refine Finset.sum_eq_zero fun q _ => ?_
    rw [SqExt.comp_def, SqExt.fst_compE, hG, LinearMap.map_zero₂]
  | add a b ha hb => rw [map_add, map_add, map_add, ha, hb, add_zero]

name: Operad.GrComposite.fst_corFam
statement:
lemma fst_corFam {A : Type} [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] (c : C A) :
    SqExt.fst (toLin ((corFam ε).1 A) c) = 0
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.GrComposite.twF_snd_star
statement:
theorem twF_snd_star (F : GrOperad.Inv R (ConvOp R C 𝒬))
    (hF : ∀ (A : Type) [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] (c : C A), SqExt.fst (toLin (F.1 A) c) = 0)
    {p : Bool} {β : GrOperad.Inv R (ConvOp R C P)} (hβ : GrOperad.Inv.IsPar p β) (c : C X) :
    twF ε F X (SqExt.snd (toLin ((GrOperad.Inv.star R _ (corFam ε) (liftFam ε β)).1 X) c))
      = SqExt.snd (toLin ((GrOperad.Inv.star R _ F (liftFam ε β)).1 X) c)
proof:
:= by
  rw [toLin_star, toLin_star, map_sum, map_sum, map_sum]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun S _ => ?_
  rw [toLin_term, toLin_term, SqExt.map_def, SqExt.map_def, SqExt.snd_mapE, SqExt.snd_mapE,
    twF_map]
  congr 1
  generalize GrCooperad.decomp (R := R) (C := C) none
    (SymSpecies.map (R := R) (splitEquiv S).symm c) = t
  have hβ' := isParC_of_isPar (isPar_liftFam ε hβ) (SIn S)
  rw [kap_hom _ hβ', kap_hom _ hβ']
  induction t using TensorProduct.induction_on with
  | zero => simp
  | tmul x y =>
    simp only [TensorProduct.map_tmul, mu_tmul, LinearMap.comp_apply, SqExt.comp_def,
      SqExt.snd_compE, hF]
    rw [show toLin ((liftFam ε β).1 (SIn S)) y = (inclHom C ε).app _ (toLin (β.1 (SIn S)) y)
      from rfl, fst_inclHom, snd_inclHom, map_zero, add_zero, twF_act]
    rw [map_zero, add_zero]
    congr 1
    exact twF_corolla ε F (A := SOut S) _
  | add a b ha hb => simp only [map_add, ha, hb]

name: Operad.GrComposite.twD_corolla
statement:
lemma twD_corolla {A : Type} [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] (β : GrOperad.Inv R (ConvOp R C P))
    (c : C A) : twD ε β A (corolla R P A c)
      = SqExt.snd (toLin ((GrOperad.Inv.star R _ (corFam ε) (liftFam ε β)).1 A) c)
proof:
:=
  twF_corolla ε _ c

name: Operad.GrComposite.twD_twD
statement:
theorem twD_twD {α β : GrOperad.Inv R (ConvOp R C P)} {p : Bool}
    (hβ : GrOperad.Inv.IsPar p β) (w : GrComposite R C P S) :
    twD ε α S (twD ε β S w) = twF ε (GrOperad.Inv.star R _
      (GrOperad.Inv.star R _ (corFam ε) (liftFam ε α)) (liftFam ε β)) S w
proof:
:=
  eq_of_corolla (fun S _ _ => twD ε α S ∘ₗ twD ε β S) (fun S _ _ => twF ε _ S)
    (fun S S' _ _ _ _ σ w => by simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply, twD, twF_map])
    (fun S S' _ _ _ _ σ w => twF_map ε _ σ w)
    (fun S Y _ _ _ _ i z w => by simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply, twD, twF_act])
    (fun S Y _ _ _ _ i z w => twF_act ε _ i z w)
    (fun A _ _ c => by
      rw [LinearMap.comp_apply, twD_corolla, twF_corolla]
      exact twF_snd_star ε (GrOperad.Inv.star R _ (corFam ε) (liftFam ε α))
        (fun A _ _ c => fst_star ε (fun A _ _ c => fst_corFam ε c) _ c) hβ c)
    w

name: Operad.GrComposite.twD_sq
statement:
theorem twD_sq {α : GrOperad.Inv R (ConvOp R C P)} (hα : GrOperad.Inv.IsPar true α)
    (w : GrComposite R C P S) :
    twD ε α S (twD ε α S w) = twD ε (GrOperad.Inv.star R _ α α) S w
proof:
:= by
  rw [twD_twD ε hα, GrOperad.Inv.assoc_odd _ _ (isPar_liftFam ε hα), twD, liftFam,
    GrOperad.Inv.appHom_star]

name: Operad.GrComposite.twD_zero
statement: theorem twD_zero (w : GrComposite R C P S) : twD ε 0 S w = 0
proof:
:=
  eq_of_corolla (fun S _ _ => twD ε 0 S) (fun S _ _ => 0)
    (fun S S' _ _ _ _ σ w => twF_map ε _ σ w) (fun S S' _ _ _ _ σ w => by simp)
    (fun S Y _ _ _ _ i z w => twF_act ε _ i z w) (fun S Y _ _ _ _ i z w => by simp)
    (fun A _ _ c => by
      rw [twD_corolla, map_zero, map_zero, LinearMap.zero_apply]
      rfl)
    w

name: Operad.GrComposite.twD_twD_eq_zero
statement:
theorem twD_twD_eq_zero {α : GrOperad.Inv R (ConvOp R C P)} (hα : GrOperad.Inv.IsPar true α)
    (h : GrOperad.Inv.star R _ α α = 0) (w : GrComposite R C P S) :
    twD ε α S (twD ε α S w) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [twD_sq ε hα, h, twD_zero]

name: Operad.GrComposite.fst_parC_liftFam
statement:
lemma fst_parC_liftFam (β : GrOperad.Inv R (ConvOp R C P)) (q : Bool) {A : Type} [Fintype A]
    [DecidableEq A] (y : C A) :
    SqExt.fst (toLin (parC q ((liftFam ε β).1 A)) y) = toLin (parC q (β.1 A)) y
proof:
:= by
  rw [parC_apply, parC_apply, map_sum]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun c _ => ?_
  rw [SqExt.par_def, SqExt.fst_parE]
  rfl

name: Operad.GrComposite.snd_star_indep_aug
statement:
lemma snd_star_indep_aug (ε' : GrAug R P) (β : GrOperad.Inv R (ConvOp R C P)) {X : Type}
    [Fintype X] [DecidableEq X] (c : C X) :
    SqExt.snd (toLin ((GrOperad.Inv.star R _ (corFam ε) (liftFam ε β)).1 X) c)
      = SqExt.snd (toLin ((GrOperad.Inv.star R _ (corFam ε') (liftFam ε' β)).1 X) c)
proof:
:= by
  rw [toLin_star, toLin_star, map_sum, map_sum]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun S _ => ?_
  rw [toLin_term, toLin_term, SqExt.map_def, SqExt.map_def, SqExt.snd_mapE, SqExt.snd_mapE]
  refine congrArg (map (splitEquiv S)) ?_
  generalize GrCooperad.decomp (R := R) (C := C) none
    (SymSpecies.map (R := R) (splitEquiv S).symm c) = t
  induction t using TensorProduct.induction_on with
  | zero => simp only [map_zero]
  | tmul x y =>
    simp only [kap, LinearMap.coe_sum, Finset.sum_apply, map_sum, TensorProduct.map_tmul,
      mu_tmul, LinearMap.comp_apply]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun q _ => ?_
    rw [SqExt.comp_def, SqExt.comp_def, SqExt.snd_compE, SqExt.snd_compE, fst_corFam,
      fst_corFam, lact_zero, lact_zero, fst_parC_liftFam, fst_parC_liftFam]
    rfl
  | add a b ha hb => simp only [map_add, ha, hb]

name: Operad.GrComposite.twD_indep_aug
statement:
theorem twD_indep_aug (ε' : GrAug R P) (β : GrOperad.Inv R (ConvOp R C P)) (S : Type)
    [Fintype S] [DecidableEq S] : twD ε β S = twD ε' β S
proof:
:=
  LinearMap.ext fun w => eq_of_corolla (fun S _ _ => twD ε β S) (fun S _ _ => twD ε' β S)
    (fun S S' _ _ _ _ σ w => twF_map ε _ σ w) (fun S S' _ _ _ _ σ w => twF_map ε' _ σ w)
    (fun S Y _ _ _ _ i z w => twF_act ε _ i z w) (fun S Y _ _ _ _ i z w => twF_act ε' _ i z w)
    (fun A _ _ c => by rw [twD_corolla, twD_corolla]; exact snd_star_indep_aug ε ε' β c) w

name: Operad.NonemptySubset.ext
statement: @[ext] lemma ext {s t : NonemptySubset A} (h : ∀ a, s.1 a = t.1 a) : s = t
proof:
:=
  Subtype.ext (funext h)

name: Operad.NonemptySubset.map_val
statement:
lemma map_val {A' : Type} [Fintype A'] [DecidableEq A'] (e : A ≃ A') (s : NonemptySubset A) :
    (SetOperad.map e s).1 = s.1 ∘ e.symm
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.NonemptySubset.comp_val
statement:
lemma comp_val (i : A) (s : NonemptySubset A) (t : NonemptySubset B) :
    (SetOperad.comp i s t).1 = compFun i s.1 t.1
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.respects_iff
statement:
lemma respects_iff {S : (A : Type) → [Fintype A] → [DecidableEq A] → Type*} [SetOperad S]
    (f : ∀ n, ComTriasGen n → S (Fin n)) :
    Pres.Respects ComTriasRel f ↔
      IsComm (f 2 .mid) ∧ IsAssoc (f 2 .mid)
        ∧ map (Equiv.sumAssoc Unit Unit Unit) (bin (f 2 .left) (bin (f 2 .left) one one) one)
          = bin (f 2 .left) one (bin (f 2 .left) one one)
        ∧ bin (f 2 .left) one (bin (f 2 .left) one one)
          = bin (f 2 .left) one (bin (map (Equiv.swap 0 1) (f 2 .left)) one one)
        ∧ bin (f 2 .left) one (bin (f 2 .mid) one one)
          = bin (f 2 .left) one (bin (f 2 .left) one one)
        ∧ map (Equiv.sumAssoc Unit Unit Unit) (bin (f 2 .left) (bin (f 2 .mid) one one) one)
          = bin (f 2 .mid) one (bin (f 2 .left) one one)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    exact ⟨h _ _ .comm, h _ _ .assoc, h _ _ .lassoc, h _ _ .lperm, h _ _ .lmid, h _ _ .midl⟩
  · rintro ⟨h0, h1, h2, h3, h4, h5⟩ A _ _ x y hxy
    cases hxy with
    | comm => exact h0
    | assoc => exact h1
    | lassoc => exact h2
    | lperm => exact h3
    | lmid => exact h4
    | midl => exact h5

name: Operad.ComTriasData.lassoc_eq
statement:
lemma lassoc_eq {A B C : Type} [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] [Fintype B] [DecidableEq B]
    [Fintype C] [DecidableEq C] (x : S A) (y : S B) (z : S C) :
    bin D.left (bin D.left x y) z
      = map (Equiv.sumAssoc A B C).symm (bin D.left x (bin D.left y z))
proof:
:=
  eq_map_symm_of_map_eq (bin_assoc_of D.lassoc x y z)

name: Operad.ComTriasData.lmid_eq
statement:
lemma lmid_eq {A B C : Type} [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] [Fintype B] [DecidableEq B]
    [Fintype C] [DecidableEq C] (x : S A) (y : S B) (z : S C) :
    bin D.left x (bin D.mid y z) = bin D.left x (bin D.left y z)
proof:
:=
  bin_right_of D.lmid x y z

name: Operad.ComTriasData.midl_eq
statement:
lemma midl_eq {A B C : Type} [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] [Fintype B] [DecidableEq B]
    [Fintype C] [DecidableEq C] (x : S A) (y : S B) (z : S C) :
    bin D.mid x (bin D.left y z) = map (Equiv.sumAssoc A B C) (bin D.left (bin D.mid x y) z)
proof:
:=
  (bin_assoc_of D.midl x y z).symm

name: Operad.ComTriasData.nonempty_of_tri
statement: lemma nonempty_of_tri (s : NonemptySubset A) : Nonempty A

name: Operad.ComTriasData.nonempty_true
statement: lemma nonempty_true (s : NonemptySubset A) : Nonempty {a // s.1 a = true}
proof:
:= let ⟨a,
    ha⟩ := s.2; ⟨⟨a, ha⟩⟩

name: Operad.ComTriasData.nonempty_false
statement:
lemma nonempty_false {s : NonemptySubset A} (h : ¬ ∀ a,
    s.1 a = true) : Nonempty {a // ¬ s.1 a = true}
proof:
:=
  let ⟨a, ha⟩ := not_forall.mp h; ⟨⟨a, ha⟩⟩

name: Operad.ComTriasData.psi_of_not_all
statement:
lemma psi_of_not_all (s : NonemptySubset A) (h : ¬ ∀ a, s.1 a = true) :
    D.psi A s = map (Equiv.sumCompl fun a => s.1 a = true)
      (bin D.left (𝐏 {a // s.1 a = true} (nonempty_true s))
        (𝐏 {a // ¬ s.1 a = true} (nonempty_false h)))
proof:
:= by
  rw [psi, dif_neg h]

name: Operad.ComTriasData.psi_of_all
statement:
lemma psi_of_all (s : NonemptySubset A) (h : ∀ a, s.1 a = true) (hA : Nonempty A) :
    D.psi A s = 𝐏 A hA
proof:
:= by
  rw [psi, dif_pos h]

name: Operad.ComTriasData.psi_of_all'
statement:
lemma psi_of_all' {X : Type} [Fintype X] [DecidableEq X] (s : NonemptySubset A) (h : ∀ a,
    s.1 a = true)
    (hX : Nonempty X) (E : X ≃ A) : D.psi A s = map E (𝐏 X hX)
proof:
:= by
  rw [psi_of_all D s h (hX.map E), SetOperad.map_prod]

name: Operad.ComTriasData.psi_eq
statement:
theorem psi_eq {P N : Type} [Fintype P] [DecidableEq P] [Fintype N] [DecidableEq N]
    (s : NonemptySubset A) (hP : Nonempty P) (hN : Nonempty N) (E : P ⊕ N ≃ A)
    (hEP : ∀ p, s.1 (E (Sum.inl p)) = true) (hEN : ∀ n, s.1 (E (Sum.inr n)) = false) :
    D.psi A s = map E (bin D.left (𝐏 P hP) (𝐏 N hN))
proof:
:= by
  have h : ¬ ∀ a, s.1 a = true := by
    obtain ⟨n⟩ := hN
    intro h
    have := hEN n
    rw [h] at this
    exact Bool.noConfusion this
  let σ : P ≃ {a // s.1 a = true} := Equiv.ofBijective (fun p => ⟨E (Sum.inl p), hEP p⟩)
    ⟨fun p q hpq => Sum.inl_injective (E.injective (congrArg Subtype.val hpq)), fun ⟨a, ha⟩ => by
      rcases hx : E.symm a with p | n
      · exact ⟨p, Subtype.ext (show E (Sum.inl p) = a by rw [← hx, Equiv.apply_symm_apply])⟩
      · have := hEN n
        rw [← hx, Equiv.apply_symm_apply, ha] at this
        exact Bool.noConfusion this⟩
  let τ : N ≃ {a // ¬ s.1 a = true} := Equiv.ofBijective
    (fun n => ⟨E (Sum.inr n), by rw [hEN n]; exact Bool.false_ne_true⟩)
    ⟨fun p q hpq => Sum.inr_injective (E.injective (congrArg Subtype.val hpq)), fun ⟨a, ha⟩ => by
      rcases hx : E.symm a with p | n
      · have := hEP p
        rw [← hx, Equiv.apply_symm_apply] at this
        exact absurd this ha
      · exact ⟨n, Subtype.ext (show E (Sum.inr n) = a by rw [← hx, Equiv.apply_symm_apply])⟩⟩
  rw [psi, dif_neg h, ← SetOperad.map_prod hP σ, ← SetOperad.map_prod hN τ, bin_map, map_map]
  exact map_congr (fun c => by rcases c with p | n <;> rfl) _

name: Operad.ComTriasData.psi_map
statement:
theorem psi_map {A' : Type} [Fintype A'] [DecidableEq A'] (e : A ≃ A') (s : NonemptySubset A) :
    D.psi A' (map e s) = map e (D.psi A s)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases h : ∀ a, s.1 a = true
  · obtain ⟨a, _⟩ := s.2
    rw [psi_of_all' D s h ⟨a⟩ (Equiv.refl A),
        psi_of_all' D (map e s) (fun a' => h (e.symm a')) ⟨a⟩ e,
      map_map]
    rfl
  · conv_rhs => rw [psi]
    rw [dif_neg h, map_map]
    refine psi_eq D _ _ _ _ (fun p => ?_) (fun n => ?_)
    · simp only [Equiv.trans_apply, Equiv.sumCompl_apply_inl, NonemptySubset.map_val,
        Function.comp_apply,
        Equiv.symm_apply_apply]
      exact p.2
    · simp only [Equiv.trans_apply, Equiv.sumCompl_apply_inr, NonemptySubset.map_val,
        Function.comp_apply,
        Equiv.symm_apply_apply]
      exact Bool.eq_false_iff.mpr n.2

name: Operad.ComTriasData.comp_prod_of_nonempty
statement:
lemma comp_prod_of_nonempty {W : Type} [Fintype W] [DecidableEq W] (hW : Nonempty W) (j : W)
    (h : Nonempty (Without W j)) (y : S B) :
    comp j (𝐏 W hW) y = bin D.mid (𝐏 (Without W j) h) y
proof:
:= by
  rw [← SetOperad.map_prod (h.map Sum.inl) (rightUnitEquiv j), ← bin_prod_one h,
    comp_map_left_of _ (i := Sum.inr ()) ?h1, comp_inr_bin, one_comp', bin_map_right, map_map,
    map_map]
  · exact map_eq_self (fun c => by rcases c with w | b <;> rfl) _
  · rfl

name: Operad.ComTriasData.comp_prod_of_isEmpty
statement:
lemma comp_prod_of_isEmpty {W : Type} [Fintype W] [DecidableEq W] (hW : Nonempty W) (j : W)
    [IsEmpty (Without W j)] (y : S B) :
    comp j (𝐏 W hW) y = map (Equiv.emptySum (Without W j) B).symm y
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨e, he⟩ : ∃ e : Unit ≃ W, e () = j :=
    ⟨{ toFun := fun _ => j
       invFun := fun _ => ()
       left_inv := fun _ => rfl
       right_inv := fun w => by
         by_contra hne
         exact IsEmpty.false (⟨w, fun h => hne h.symm⟩ : Without W j) }, rfl⟩
  rw [← SetOperad.map_prod ⟨()⟩ e, prod_unit, comp_map_left_of _ (i := ()) he, one_comp', map_map]
  exact map_congr (fun b => by rfl) _

name: Operad.ComTriasData.lassoc_eq'
statement:
lemma lassoc_eq' (x : S A) (y : S B) (z : S C) :
    bin D.left x (bin D.left y z) = map (Equiv.sumAssoc A B C) (bin D.left (bin D.left x y) z)
proof:
:=
  (bin_assoc_of D.lassoc x y z).symm

name: Operad.ComTriasData.bin_left_psi
statement:
theorem bin_left_psi (X : S C) (t : NonemptySubset B) (hB : Nonempty B) :
    bin D.left X (D.psi B t) = bin D.left X (𝐏 B hB)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases h : ∀ b, t.1 b = true
  · rw [psi_of_all D t h hB]
  · rw [psi_of_not_all D t h, bin_map_right, ← D.lmid_eq,
      bin_prod' (nonempty_true t) (nonempty_false h),
      ← bin_map_right, SetOperad.map_prod]

name: Operad.ComTriasData.bin_left_mid_psi
statement:
theorem bin_left_mid_psi {W : Type} [Fintype W] [DecidableEq W] (X : S C) (hW : Nonempty W)
    (t : NonemptySubset B) (hB : Nonempty B) :
    bin D.left X (bin D.mid (𝐏 W hW) (D.psi B t)) = bin D.left X (𝐏 (W ⊕ B) (hW.map Sum.inl))
proof:
:= by
  rw [D.lmid_eq, lassoc_eq', bin_left_psi D _ t hB, ← lassoc_eq', ← D.lmid_eq, bin_prod']

name: Operad.ComTriasData.psi_comp
statement:
theorem psi_comp (i : A) (s : NonemptySubset A) (t : NonemptySubset B) :
    D.psi (Without A i ⊕ B) (comp i s t) = comp i (D.psi A s) (D.psi B t)
proof:
:= by
  have hB : Nonempty B := nonempty_of_tri t
  by_cases hsi : s.1 i = true
  · by_cases hs : ∀ a, s.1 a = true
    · rw [psi_of_all D s hs ⟨i⟩]
      by_cases ht : ∀ b, t.1 b = true
      · 
        rw [psi_of_all D t ht hB, comp_prod]
        exact psi_of_all D _ (by rintro (a | b) <;> simp [NonemptySubset.comp_val,
            NonemptySubset.compFun, hs, ht]) _
      · rw [psi_of_not_all D t ht]
        by_cases hA' : Nonempty (Without A i)
        · rw [comp_prod_of_nonempty D ⟨i⟩ i hA', bin_map_right, D.midl_eq, bin_prod', map_map]
          refine psi_eq D _ _ _ _ (fun p => ?_) (fun n => ?_)
          · rcases p with a | b
            · simp [NonemptySubset.comp_val, NonemptySubset.compFun, hs]
            · simpa [NonemptySubset.comp_val, NonemptySubset.compFun, binLeftEquiv, binRightEquiv,
                hsi] using b.2
          · simpa [NonemptySubset.comp_val, NonemptySubset.compFun, binLeftEquiv, binRightEquiv,
              hsi] using n.2
        · haveI : IsEmpty (Without A i) := not_nonempty_iff.mp hA'
          rw [comp_prod_of_isEmpty D ⟨i⟩ i, map_map]
          refine psi_eq D _ _ _ _ (fun p => ?_) (fun n => ?_)
          · simpa [NonemptySubset.comp_val, NonemptySubset.compFun, binLeftEquiv, binRightEquiv,
              hsi] using p.2
          · simpa [NonemptySubset.comp_val, NonemptySubset.compFun, binLeftEquiv, binRightEquiv,
              hsi] using n.2
    · rw [psi_of_not_all D s hs, comp_map_left_of (Equiv.sumCompl fun a => s.1 a = true)
        (i := Sum.inl ⟨i, hsi⟩) (i' := i) rfl, comp_inl_bin]
      · by_cases ht : ∀ b, t.1 b = true
        · rw [psi_of_all D t ht hB, comp_prod, map_map]
          refine psi_eq D _ _ _ _ (fun p => ?_) (fun n => ?_)
          · rcases p with a | b
            · simpa [NonemptySubset.comp_val, NonemptySubset.compFun, binLeftEquiv,
                binRightEquiv] using a.1.2
            · exact (by simp [hsi, ht] : (s.1 i && t.1 b) = true)
          · simpa [NonemptySubset.comp_val, NonemptySubset.compFun, binLeftEquiv,
              binRightEquiv] using n.2
        · rw [psi_of_not_all D t ht]
          by_cases hT' : Nonempty (Without {a // s.1 a = true} ⟨i, hsi⟩)
          · rw [comp_prod_of_nonempty D _ _ hT', bin_map_right, D.midl_eq, bin_prod']
            simp only [map_map, bin_map_left]
            rw [D.lassoc_eq, ← D.lmid_eq, bin_prod']
            simp only [map_map]
            refine psi_eq D _ _ _ _ (fun p => ?_) (fun n => ?_)
            · rcases p with a | b
              · simpa [NonemptySubset.comp_val, NonemptySubset.compFun, binLeftEquiv,
                  binRightEquiv] using a.1.2
              · simpa [NonemptySubset.comp_val, NonemptySubset.compFun, binLeftEquiv,
                  binRightEquiv, hsi] using b.2
            · rcases n with n | n
              · simpa [NonemptySubset.comp_val, NonemptySubset.compFun, binLeftEquiv,
                  binRightEquiv, hsi] using n.2
              · simpa [NonemptySubset.comp_val, NonemptySubset.compFun, binLeftEquiv,
                  binRightEquiv] using n.2
          · haveI : IsEmpty (Without {a // s.1 a = true} ⟨i, hsi⟩) := not_nonempty_iff.mp hT'
            rw [comp_prod_of_isEmpty D _ _]
            simp only [map_map, bin_map_left]
            rw [D.lassoc_eq, ← D.lmid_eq, bin_prod']
            simp only [map_map]
            refine psi_eq D _ _ _ _ (fun p => ?_) (fun n => ?_)
            · simpa [NonemptySubset.comp_val, NonemptySubset.compFun, binLeftEquiv, binRightEquiv,
                hsi] using p.2
            · rcases n with n | n
              · simpa [NonemptySubset.comp_val, NonemptySubset.compFun, binLeftEquiv,
                  binRightEquiv, hsi] using n.2
              · simpa [NonemptySubset.comp_val, NonemptySubset.compFun, binLeftEquiv,
                  binRightEquiv] using n.2
  · have hs : ¬ ∀ a, s.1 a = true := fun h => hsi (h i)
    rw [psi_of_not_all D s hs, comp_map_left_of (Equiv.sumCompl fun a => s.1 a = true)
      (i := Sum.inr ⟨i, hsi⟩) (i' := i) rfl, comp_inr_bin]
    · by_cases hF' : Nonempty (Without {a // ¬ s.1 a = true} ⟨i, hsi⟩)
      · rw [comp_prod_of_nonempty D _ _ hF', bin_left_mid_psi D _ _ t hB]
        simp only [map_map]
