        refine psi_eq D _ _ _ _ (fun p => ?_) (fun n => ?_)
        · simpa [NonemptySubset.comp_val, NonemptySubset.compFun, binLeftEquiv,
            binRightEquiv] using p.2
        · rcases n with f | b
          · simpa [NonemptySubset.comp_val, NonemptySubset.compFun, binLeftEquiv,
              binRightEquiv] using f.1.2
          · exact (by simp [hsi] : (s.1 i && t.1 b) = false)
      · haveI : IsEmpty (Without {a // ¬ s.1 a = true} ⟨i, hsi⟩) := not_nonempty_iff.mp hF'
        rw [comp_prod_of_isEmpty D _ _, bin_map_right, bin_left_psi D _ t hB]
        simp only [map_map]
        refine psi_eq D _ _ _ _ (fun p => ?_) (fun n => ?_)
        · simpa [NonemptySubset.comp_val, NonemptySubset.compFun, binLeftEquiv,
            binRightEquiv] using p.2
        · exact (by simp [hsi] : (s.1 i && t.1 n) = false)

name: Operad.ComTriasData.app_psi
statement:
lemma app_psi {T : (A : Type) → [Fintype A] → [DecidableEq A] → Type*} [SetOperad T]
    (φ : SetOperadHom S T) (s : NonemptySubset A) : φ.app A (D.psi A s) = (D.map φ).psi A s
proof:
:= by
  by_cases h : ∀ a, s.1 a = true
  · rw [psi_of_all D s h (nonempty_of_tri s), psi_of_all _ s h (nonempty_of_tri s), app_prod]
    rfl
  · rw [psi_of_not_all D s h, psi_of_not_all _ s h, φ.app_map, φ.app_bin, app_prod, app_prod]
    rfl

name: Operad.ComTriasData.comp_lift
statement:
lemma comp_lift {T : (A : Type) → [Fintype A] → [DecidableEq A] → Type*} [SetOperad T]
    (φ : SetOperadHom S T) : φ.comp D.lift = (D.map φ).lift
proof:
:= by
  ext A _ _ s
  exact D.app_psi φ s

name: Operad.ComTriasData.ext'
statement:
@[ext] lemma ext' {D₁ D₂ : ComTriasData S} (hmu : D₁.mid = D₂.mid) (hnu : D₁.left = D₂.left) :
    D₁ = D₂
proof:
:= by
  cases D₁
  cases D₂
  cases hmu
  cases hnu
  rfl

name: Operad.NonemptySubset.bin_val
statement:
lemma bin_val (g : NonemptySubset (Fin 2)) (x : NonemptySubset A) (y : NonemptySubset B) :
    (bin g x y).1 = Sum.elim (fun a => g.1 0 && x.1 a) (fun b => g.1 1 && y.1 b)
proof:
:= by
  funext c
  rcases c with a | b <;> rfl

name: Operad.NonemptySubset.prod_val
statement: lemma prod_val (hA : Nonempty A) (a : A) : (prod data.comm data.assoc A hA).1 a = true
proof:
:= by
  have h : ComSet.lift data.mid data.comm data.assoc = full :=
    ComSet.hom_ext (by rw [ComSet.lift_mu]; rfl)
  have := congrArg (fun φ : SetOperadHom ComSet NonemptySubset => (φ.app A ⟨hA⟩).1 a) h
  exact this

name: Operad.NonemptySubset.data_psi
statement: lemma data_psi (s : NonemptySubset A) : data.psi A s = s
proof:
:= by
  ext a
  by_cases h : ∀ a, s.1 a = true
  · rw [ComTriasData.psi_of_all data s h (ComTriasData.nonempty_of_tri s), prod_val, h a]
  · rw [ComTriasData.psi_of_not_all data s h, map_val, Function.comp_apply, bin_val]
    by_cases ha : s.1 a = true
    · rw [Equiv.sumCompl_symm_apply_of_pos (p := fun a => s.1 a = true) ha, Sum.elim_inl,
        prod_val, ha]
      rfl
    · rw [Equiv.sumCompl_symm_apply_of_neg (p := fun a => s.1 a = true) ha, Sum.elim_inr]
      simp only [Bool.not_eq_true] at ha
      rw [ha]
      rfl

name: Operad.NonemptySubset.data_lift
statement: lemma data_lift : data.lift = SetOperadHom.id
proof:
:= by
  apply SetOperadHom.ext
  intro A _ _ s
  exact data_psi s

name: Operad.NonemptySubset.hom_ext
statement:
theorem hom_ext {S : (A : Type) → [Fintype A] → [DecidableEq A] → Type*} [SetOperad S]
    {φ ψ : SetOperadHom NonemptySubset S} (hmu : φ.app _ mid = ψ.app _ mid)
    (hnu : φ.app _ left = ψ.app _ left) :
    φ = ψ
proof:
:= by
  have hφ : φ = (data.map φ).lift := by rw [← ComTriasData.comp_lift data φ, data_lift]; rfl
  have hψ : ψ = (data.map ψ).lift := by rw [← ComTriasData.comp_lift data ψ, data_lift]; rfl
  rw [hφ, hψ, ComTriasData.ext' (D₁ := data.map φ) (D₂ := data.map ψ) hmu hnu]

name: Operad.ComTriasData.lift_mid
statement: lemma lift_mid : D.lift.app _ NonemptySubset.mid = D.mid
proof:
:= by
  show D.psi _ NonemptySubset.mid = D.mid
  rw [psi_of_all D _ (fun _ => rfl) ⟨0⟩, prod_fin_two]

name: Operad.ComTriasData.lift_left
statement: lemma lift_left : D.lift.app _ NonemptySubset.left = D.left
proof:
:= by
  show D.psi _ NonemptySubset.left = D.left
  rw [psi_eq D NonemptySubset.left ⟨()⟩ ⟨()⟩ finTwoSum.symm (fun _ => rfl) (fun _ => rfl),
      prod_unit,
    bin_one_one, map_map]
  exact map_eq_self (fun k => by fin_cases k <;> rfl) _

name: Operad.ShuffleBridge.kup_injective
statement: lemma kup_injective : Function.Injective kup
proof:
:= fun a b h => by
  have h' := congrArg ofLex h
  simp only [kup, ofLex_toLex, Prod.mk.injEq, Nat.add_right_cancel_iff] at h'
  exact ofLex.injective (Prod.ext h'.1 h'.2)

name: Operad.ShuffleBridge.kup_lt_kup
statement: lemma kup_lt_kup {a b : ℕ ×ₗ ℕ} : kup a < kup b ↔ a < b
proof:
:= by
  rw [kup, kup, Prod.Lex.toLex_lt_toLex, ← toLex_ofLex a, ← toLex_ofLex b,
    Prod.Lex.toLex_lt_toLex]
  simp only [ofLex_toLex, Nat.add_lt_add_iff_right]

name: Operad.ShuffleBridge.key_toS
statement: lemma key_toS (t : LTree (F 2)) (ht : t.IsShuffle) : LTree.key t = kup (STree.key (toS t))
proof:
:= by
  have hw := weight_toS t
  rw [LTree.key, STree.key, kup, ofLex_toLex, first_toS t ht, hw]

name: Operad.ShuffleBridge.rootF_toS
statement:
lemma rootF_toS (x : ShuffleBar.BarTree (F 2)) :
    rootF (toS (F := BE F) x) = ShuffleBar.rootFlag x
proof:
:= by
  cases x <;> rfl

name: Operad.ShuffleBridge.univ_fin_two
statement: lemma univ_fin_two : (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin 2)) = {0, 1}
proof: := by decide

name: Operad.ShuffleBridge.cutKeys_toS
statement:
lemma cutKeys_toS : ∀ x : ShuffleBar.BarTree (F 2), x.IsShuffle →
    ShuffleBar.cutKeys x = (cutKeys (toS (F := BE F) x)).image kup
  | .leaf _, _ => rfl
  | .node d l r, h => by
    have hl
proof:
:= cutKeys_toS l h.2.1
    have hr := cutKeys_toS r h.2.2
    have hk := key_toS (F := BE F) (.node d l r) h
    rw [ShuffleBar.cutKeys, toS_node, STree.cutKeys, univ_fin_two, Finset.biUnion_insert,
      Finset.singleton_biUnion, Finset.image_union, Finset.image_union, hl, hr, ← toS_node]
    congr 1
    split_ifs <;> simp [hk]

name: Operad.ShuffleBridge.toS_mergeK
statement:
lemma toS_mergeK : ∀ x : ShuffleBar.BarTree (F 2), x.IsShuffle → ∀ k : ℕ ×ₗ ℕ,
    toS (F := BE F) (ShuffleBar.mergeK x (kup k)) = setF k false (toS (F := BE F) x)
  | .leaf _, _, _ => rfl
  | .node d l r, h, k => by
    have hkey
proof:
:= key_toS (F := BE F) (.node d l r) h
    have hw := weight_toS (F := BE F) (.node d l r)
    by_cases hk : STree.key (toS (F := BE F) (.node d l r)) = k
    · have hkw : (ofLex k).2 + 1 = (LTree.node d l r).arity := by
        rw [← hk, STree.key, ofLex_toLex]
        exact hw
      have hal : l.arity < (ofLex (kup k)).2 := by
        simp only [kup, ofLex_toLex, LTree.arity] at hkw ⊢
        have := LTree.arity_pos r
        omega
      have har : r.arity < (ofLex (kup k)).2 := by
        simp only [kup, ofLex_toLex, LTree.arity] at hkw ⊢
        have := LTree.arity_pos l
        omega
      have hwl : ∀ t : ShuffleBar.BarTree (F 2), t.IsShuffle → t.arity < (ofLex (kup k)).2 →
          setF k false (toS (F := BE F) t) = toS t := fun t ht hlt => by
        refine setF_of_notMem false fun hm => ?_
        have h1 :=
          (mem_vkeys (t := toS (F := BE F) t) ((isShuffle_toS_iff (F := BE F) t).2 ht) hm).2
        have h2 := weight_toS (F := BE F) t
        simp only [kup, ofLex_toLex] at hlt
        omega
      have hml := ShuffleBar.mergeK_of_not_mem l (ShuffleBar.not_mem_cutKeys_of_arity hal)
      have hmr := ShuffleBar.mergeK_of_not_mem r (ShuffleBar.not_mem_cutKeys_of_arity har)
      rw [toS_node, setF_node, ← toS_node, if_pos hk]
      have hc : (fun i => setF k false ((![toS (F := BE F) l, toS r] : Fin 2 → _) i)) =
          ![toS (F := BE F) l, toS r] := by
        funext i
        fin_cases i
        · exact hwl l h.2.1 hal
        · exact hwl r h.2.2 har
      rw [hc]
      by_cases hd : d.2 = true
      · rw [ShuffleBar.mergeK, if_pos ⟨hd, by rw [hkey, hk]⟩]
        rfl
      · rw [ShuffleBar.mergeK, if_neg (fun h' => hd h'.1), hml, hmr, toS_node]
        congr 1
        exact Prod.ext rfl (by simpa using hd)
    · rw [ShuffleBar.mergeK, if_neg (fun h' => hk (kup_injective (hkey ▸ h'.2))), toS_node,
        toS_node, setF_node,
        if_neg (show ¬ (STree.node d ![toS (F := BE F) l, toS (F := BE F) r]).key = k from hk),
        toS_mergeK l h.2.1 k, toS_mergeK r h.2.2 k]
      congr 1
      funext i
      fin_cases i <;> rfl

name: Operad.ShuffleBridge.sgn_toS
statement:
lemma sgn_toS (K : Type*) [CommRing K] (x : ShuffleBar.BarTree (F 2)) (hx : x.IsShuffle)
    (k : ℕ ×ₗ ℕ) :
    ShuffleBar.sgn K x (kup k) = CutComplex.sgn K (cutKeys (toS (F := BE F) x)) k
proof:
:= by
  rw [ShuffleBar.sgn, CutComplex.sgn, cutKeys_toS x hx, Finset.filter_image,
    Finset.card_image_of_injective _ kup_injective]
  simp only [kup_lt_kup]

name: Operad.ShuffleBridge.barMap_single
statement:
lemma barMap_single {A : Finset ℕ} (X : SMono (BE F) A) (c : K) :
    barMap K A (Finsupp.single X c) = Finsupp.single (ofS X.1) c
proof:
:= by
  rw [barMap, Finsupp.lmapDomain_apply, Finsupp.mapDomain_single]

name: Operad.ShuffleBridge.barMap_injective
statement: lemma barMap_injective (A : Finset ℕ) : Function.Injective (barMap (F := F) K A)
proof:
:=
  Finsupp.mapDomain_injective fun X Y h => Subtype.ext (by
    rw [← toS_ofS X.1, ← toS_ofS Y.1]
    exact congrArg toS h)

name: Operad.ShuffleBridge.isShuffle_ofS
statement: lemma isShuffle_ofS {A : Finset ℕ} (X : SMono (BE F) A) : (ofS X.1).IsShuffle
proof:
:= by
  rw [← isShuffle_toS_iff, toS_ofS]
  exact X.isShuffle

name: Operad.ShuffleBridge.barMap_d
statement:
theorem barMap_d (A : Finset ℕ) (v : SMono (BE F) A →₀ K) :
    barMap K A (Bar.d K v) = ShuffleBar.d K (barMap K A v)
proof:
:= by
  induction v using Finsupp.induction_linear with
  | zero => simp
  | add v w hv hw => simp only [map_add, hv, hw]
  | single X c =>
    rw [Bar.d, CutComplex.d_single, barMap_single, ShuffleBar.d_single, map_smul,
      CutComplex.dX, ShuffleBar.dTree, cutKeys_toS _ (isShuffle_ofS X), toS_ofS,
      Finset.sum_image fun a _ b _ h => kup_injective h, map_sum]
    congr 1
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun k _ => ?_
    rw [map_smul, barMap_single, sgn_toS K _ (isShuffle_ofS X), toS_ofS]
    congr 2
    apply toS_injective
    rw [toS_mergeK _ (isShuffle_ofS X), toS_ofS, toS_ofS]
    rfl

name: Operad.ShuffleBridge.toS_unflag
statement:
lemma toS_unflag : ∀ m : LTree (F 2),
    toS (F := BE F) (m.mapDec (·, false)) = allF (toS m)
  | .leaf _ => rfl
  | .node e l r => by
    rw [LTree.mapDec_node, toS_node, toS_node, allF_node, toS_unflag l, toS_unflag r]
    congr 1
    funext i
    fin_cases i <;> rfl

omit [BinaryGens F] in

name: Operad.ShuffleBridge.toS_liftW
statement:
lemma toS_liftW (b : Bool) : ∀ m : LTree (F 2),
    toS (F := BE F) (ShuffleBar.liftW b m) = fl b (toS m)
  | .leaf _ => rfl
  | .node e l r => by
    show STree.node (e, b) ![toS (F := BE F) (l.mapDec (·, false)), toS (r.mapDec (·, false))] = _
    rw [toS_node, fl_node, toS_unflag, toS_unflag]
    congr 1
    funext i
    fin_cases i <;> rfl

name: Operad.ShuffleBridge.ofS_fl
statement: lemma ofS_fl (b : Bool) (t : STree F) : ofS (F := BE F) (fl b t) = ShuffleBar.liftW b (ofS t)
proof:
:=
  toS_injective (by rw [toS_ofS, toS_liftW, toS_ofS])

name: Operad.ShuffleBridge.flags_of_windowRoot
statement:
lemma flags_of_windowRoot {E : Type*} : ∀ (u : ShuffleBar.BarTree E) (s : Bool), u.IsEdgeRoot s →
    ∀ (b : Bool) (m : LTree E), u.windowRoot s = ShuffleBar.liftW b m →
      ShuffleBar.rootFlag u = b ∧ ShuffleBar.rootFlag (u.subtreeAt [s]) = false
  | .node (e, c) (.node (f, c') a a') d, false, _, b, m, h => by
    cases m with
    | leaf _ => simp [LTree.windowRoot, LTree.window, ShuffleBar.liftW] at h
    | node e' l r =>
      cases l with
      | leaf _ => simp [LTree.windowRoot, LTree.window, ShuffleBar.liftW] at h
      | node f' l' r' =>
        simp only [LTree.windowRoot, LTree.window, ShuffleBar.liftW, LTree.mapDec_node,
          Bool.false_eq_true, if_false, LTree.node.injEq, Prod.mk.injEq] at h
        exact ⟨h.1.2, h.2.1.1.2⟩
  | .node (e, c) d (.node (f, c') a a'), true, _, b, m, h => by
    have hw : LTree.windowRoot (.node (e, c) d (.node (f, c') a a')) true =
        LTree.window (e, c) (f, c') true a.minLabel a'.minLabel d.minLabel
proof:
:= by cases d <;> rfl
    rw [hw] at h
    cases m with
    | leaf _ => simp [LTree.window, ShuffleBar.liftW] at h
    | node e' l r =>
      cases r with
      | leaf _ => simp [LTree.window, ShuffleBar.liftW] at h
      | node f' l' r' =>
        simp only [LTree.window, ShuffleBar.liftW, LTree.mapDec_node, if_true,
          LTree.node.injEq, Prod.mk.injEq] at h
        exact ⟨h.1.2, h.2.2.1.2⟩
  | .leaf _, false, he, _, _, _ => absurd he (by simp [LTree.IsEdgeRoot])
  | .leaf _, true, he, _, _, _ => absurd he (by simp [LTree.IsEdgeRoot])
  | .node _ (.leaf _) _, false, he, _, _, _ => absurd he (by simp [LTree.IsEdgeRoot])
  | .node _ _ (.leaf _), true, he, _, _, _ =>
    absurd he (by cases ‹LTree _› <;> simp [LTree.IsEdgeRoot])

name: Operad.ShuffleBridge.rootF_subst_of_ne_leaf
statement:
lemma rootF_subst_of_ne_leaf {E : ℕ → Type v} {t : STree (BE E)} (ht : ∀ a, t ≠ leaf a)
    (xs : ℕ → STree (BE E)) : rootF (t.subst xs) = rootF t
proof:
:= by
  cases t with
  | leaf a => exact absurd rfl (ht a)
  | node d c => rfl

name: Operad.ShuffleBridge.rootF_ctx
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨T, p, xs, -, -, hfe⟩ := hf
  rw [hfe, hfe]
  rcases p with _ | ⟨i, p⟩
  · rw [replace_nil, replace_nil, rootF_subst_of_ne_leaf hX, rootF_subst_of_ne_leaf hY, h]
  · rw [rootF_replace T (List.cons_ne_nil _ _), rootF_replace T (List.cons_ne_nil _ _)]

name: Operad.ShuffleBridge.proj_of_supported
statement:
lemma proj_of_supported {v : X →₀ K} (hv : v ∈ Finsupp.supported K K {x | P x}) :
    proj K P v = v
proof:
:= by
  rw [Finsupp.supported_eq_span_single] at hv
  induction hv using Submodule.span_induction with
  | mem _ h =>
    obtain ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩ := h
    rw [proj, Finsupp.linearCombination_single, if_pos (show P x from hx), one_smul]
  | zero => rw [map_zero]
  | add _ _ _ _ h₁ h₂ => rw [map_add, h₁, h₂]
  | smul c _ _ h => rw [map_smul, h]

name: Operad.ShuffleBridge.proj_of_supported_not
statement:
lemma proj_of_supported_not {v : X →₀ K} (hv : v ∈ Finsupp.supported K K {x | ¬ P x}) :
    proj K P v = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [Finsupp.supported_eq_span_single] at hv
  induction hv using Submodule.span_induction with
  | mem _ h =>
    obtain ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩ := h
    rw [proj, Finsupp.linearCombination_single, if_neg (show ¬ P x from hx), smul_zero]
  | zero => rw [map_zero]
  | add _ _ _ _ h₁ h₂ => rw [map_add, h₁, h₂, add_zero]
  | smul c _ _ h => rw [map_smul, h, smul_zero]

name: Operad.ShuffleBridge.mapDomain_mem_supported
statement:
lemma mapDomain_mem_supported {X Y : Type*} {f : X → Y} {S : Set Y} (v : X →₀ K)
    (h : ∀ x ∈ v.support, f x ∈ S) : Finsupp.mapDomain f v ∈ Finsupp.supported K K S
proof:
:= by
  classical
  refine (Finsupp.mem_supported K _).2 fun y hy => ?_
  obtain ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.1 (Finsupp.mapDomain_support hy)
  exact h x hx

name: Operad.ShuffleBridge.labels_ofS
statement:
lemma labels_ofS {A : Finset ℕ} (X : SMono (BE F) A) :
    ((ofS X.1).labels : Multiset ℕ) = A.val
proof:
:= by
  rw [← labels_toS, toS_ofS]
  exact X.labels_eq

name: Operad.ShuffleBridge.adm_ofS
statement:
lemma adm_ofS {n w s : ℕ} {X : SMono (BE F) (Finset.range n)}
    (hX : X ∈ Bar.P (Finset.range n) w s) : ShuffleBar.Adm n s (ofS X.1)
proof:
:= by
  have hl := labels_ofS X
  refine ⟨⟨isShuffle_ofS X, ?_, ?_⟩, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [← Multiset.coe_nodup, hl]
    exact (Finset.range n).nodup
  · rw [← rootF_toS, toS_ofS]
    exact hX.1
  · have hl' : ((ofS X.1).labels : Multiset ℕ) = (List.range n : Multiset ℕ) := by
      rw [hl, Finset.range_val, Multiset.coe_range]
    exact Multiset.coe_eq_coe.1 hl'
  · rw [cutKeys_toS _ (isShuffle_ofS X), toS_ofS, Finset.card_image_of_injective _ kup_injective]
    exact hX.2.2

name: Operad.ShuffleBridge.exists_of_adm
statement:
lemma exists_of_adm {n s : ℕ} {y : ShuffleBar.BarTree (F 2)} (hy : ShuffleBar.Adm n s y) :
    ∃ X : SMono (BE F) (Finset.range n), X ∈ Bar.P (Finset.range n) (n - 1) s ∧ ofS X.1 = y
proof:
:= by
  have hl : (toS (F := BE F) y).labels = (Finset.range n).val := by
    rw [labels_toS, Finset.range_val, ← Multiset.coe_range]
    exact Multiset.coe_eq_coe.2 hy.2.1
  refine ⟨⟨toS y, (isShuffle_toS_iff _).2 hy.1.shuffle, hl⟩, ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩, ofS_toS (F := BE F) y⟩
  · show rootF (toS (F := BE F) y) = false
    rw [rootF_toS]
    exact hy.1.root
  · show (toS (F := BE F) y).weight = n - 1
    have h1 := weight_toS (F := BE F) y
    have h2 := hy.2.1.length_eq
    rw [LTree.length_labels, List.length_range] at h2
    omega
  · show (cutKeys (toS (F := BE F) y)).card + 1 = s
    have := hy.2.2
    rwa [cutKeys_toS y hy.1.shuffle, Finset.card_image_of_injective _ kup_injective] at this

name: Operad.ShuffleBridge.C_le_map
statement:
lemma C_le_map (n s : ℕ) : ShuffleBar.C K n s ≤
    (Bar.C K (Finset.range n) (n - 1) s).map (barMap (F := F) K (Finset.range n))
proof:
:= by
  rw [ShuffleBar.C, Finsupp.supported_eq_span_single, Submodule.span_le]
  rintro _ ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨X, hX, rfl⟩ := exists_of_adm (F := F) hy
  exact ⟨Finsupp.single X 1, Finsupp.single_mem_supported K _ hX, barMap_single K X 1⟩

name: Operad.ShuffleBridge.map_C_le
statement:
lemma map_C_le (n w s : ℕ) :
    (Bar.C K (Finset.range n) w s).map (barMap (F := F) K (Finset.range n)) ≤
      ShuffleBar.C K n s
proof:
:= by
  rw [Bar.C, Finsupp.supported_eq_span_single, Submodule.map_span, Submodule.span_le]
  rintro _ ⟨_, ⟨X, hX, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
  rw [SetLike.mem_coe, barMap_single]
  exact Finsupp.single_mem_supported K _ (adm_ofS hX)

name: Operad.ShuffleBridge.exists_ctx_of_edge'
statement:
theorem exists_ctx_of_edge' {B : Finset ℕ} (x : LTree (F 2)) (hxs : x.IsShuffle)
    (hxl : (x.labels : Multiset ℕ) = B.val) {p : List Bool} {s : Bool} (he : x.IsEdge p s) :
    ∃ f : SMono F (Finset.range 3) → SMono F B, IsSCtx f ∧
      ∀ g, (f g).1 = toS (x.substAt p s (ofS g.1))
proof:
:= by
  have hnd : x.labels.Nodup := by
    rw [← Multiset.coe_nodup, hxl]
    exact B.nodup
  have hw := LTree.winSpec_of_edge he hxs hnd
  have hmem : ∀ g : SMono F (Finset.range 3), (toS (x.substAt p s (ofS g.1))).IsShuffle ∧
      (toS (x.substAt p s (ofS g.1))).labels = B.val := fun g => by
    have hg := (LTree.mem_monomials 3 _).1 (ofS_mem g)
    refine ⟨(isShuffle_toS_iff _).2 (LTree.isShuffle_substAt he hxs hnd hg.1 hg.2), ?_⟩
    rw [labels_toS, ← hxl]
    exact Multiset.coe_eq_coe.2 (LTree.perm_labels_substAt he hxs hnd hg.2)
  refine ⟨fun g => ⟨_, hmem g⟩,
    ⟨toS x, bpath p, fun a => toS ((x.subtreeAt p).winIns s a), ?_, ⟨fun a _ => ?_,
      fun a ha b hb => ?_, fun a ha b hb hab => ?_⟩, fun g => ?_⟩, fun g => rfl⟩
  · obtain ⟨e, l, r, h⟩ := he.exists_node
    rw [get?_toS x p h]
    rfl
  · exact (isShuffle_toS_iff _).2 (hw.shuffle a)
  · rw [labels_toS, Multiset.mem_coe] at hb
    have ha3 : a < 3 := Finset.mem_range.1 ha
    have hb' : b ∈ (x.subtreeAt p).labels := by
      refine hw.perm.symm.subset ?_
      simp only [List.mem_append]
      interval_cases a
      · exact Or.inl (Or.inl hb)
      · exact Or.inl (Or.inr hb)
      · exact Or.inr hb
    have : b ∈ (x.labels : Multiset ℕ) := Multiset.mem_coe.2 (LTree.labels_subtreeAt_subset _ _ hb')
    rw [hxl] at this
    exact this
  · simp only
    rw [first_toS _ (hw.shuffle a), first_toS _ (hw.shuffle b)]
    exact hw.mono a b hab (Finset.mem_range.1 hb)
  · show toS (x.substAt p s (ofS g.1)) = _
    rw [toS_substAt, toS_ofS]

name: Operad.ShuffleBridge.mapDomain_flM_mem
statement:
lemma mapDomain_flM_mem {r : LTree.Mono (F 2) 3 → K} (hr : r ∈ R) (c : Bool) :
    Finsupp.mapDomain (flM c) (vecEquiv F K 3 r) ∈ (G.bar.rw (Finset.range 3)).ideal
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : vecEquiv F K 3 r ∈ Submodule.span K (Set.range (ruleVec G hsrc)) := by
    rw [← hR]
    exact Submodule.mem_map_of_mem hr
  suffices ∀ w ∈ Submodule.span K (Set.range (ruleVec G hsrc)),
      Finsupp.mapDomain (flM c) w ∈ (G.bar.rw (Finset.range 3)).ideal from this _ h1
  intro w hw
  induction hw using Submodule.span_induction with
  | mem _ h =>
    obtain ⟨r', rfl⟩ := h
    have hcast : ∀ {A B : Finset ℕ} (h : A = B), (flM (E := F) c ∘ SMono.cast h) =
        SMono.cast h ∘ flM c := fun _ => funext fun _ => Subtype.ext rfl
    have : Finsupp.mapDomain (flM c) (ruleVec G hsrc r') =
        ruleVec G.bar (fun r => hsrc r.1) (r', c) := by
      rw [ruleVec, ruleVec, ← Finsupp.mapDomain_comp, hcast, Finsupp.mapDomain_comp,
        Finsupp.mapDomain_sub, Finsupp.mapDomain_single]
      rfl
    rw [this]
    exact ruleVec_mem G.bar _ (r', c)
  | zero => rw [Finsupp.mapDomain_zero]; exact Submodule.zero_mem _
  | add _ _ _ _ h₁ h₂ => rw [Finsupp.mapDomain_add]; exact Submodule.add_mem _ h₁ h₂
  | smul a _ _ h => rw [Finsupp.mapDomain_smul]; exact Submodule.smul_mem _ a h

name: Operad.ShuffleBridge.flM_ne_leaf
statement: lemma flM_ne_leaf (b : Bool) (σ : SMono F (Finset.range 3)) (a : ℕ) : (flM b σ).1 ≠ leaf a
proof:
:= by
  have hw := weight_eq_two rfl σ
  intro h
  have := congrArg STree.weight h
  rw [flM_val, weight_fl] at this
  rw [this] at hw
  simp at hw

name: Operad.ShuffleBridge.rootF_flM
statement: lemma rootF_flM (b : Bool) (σ : SMono F (Finset.range 3)) : rootF (flM b σ).1 = b
proof:
:= by
  rw [flM_val]
  cases h : σ.1 with
  | leaf a =>
    have hw := weight_eq_two rfl σ
    rw [h] at hw
    simp at hw
  | node e c => rfl

name: Operad.ShuffleBridge.barMap_gen_mem
statement:
lemma barMap_gen_mem {A C : Finset ℕ} (hC : C = Finset.range 3)
    {f : SMono (BE F) C → SMono (BE F) A} (hf : IsSCtx f) (b : Bool) {w : SMono F C →₀ K}
    (hw : Finsupp.mapDomain (SMono.cast hC) w ∈ R.map (vecEquiv F K 3).toLinearMap) :
    barMap K A (proj K (fun X : SMono (BE F) A => rootF X.1 = false)
      (Finsupp.mapDomain f (Finsupp.mapDomain (flM b) w))) ∈ ShuffleBar.J K R
proof:
:= by
  subst hC
  rw [cast_rfl, Finsupp.mapDomain_id] at hw
  obtain ⟨r, hr, rfl⟩ := hw
  by_cases hne : Nonempty (SMono F (Finset.range 3))
  swap
  · have : vecEquiv F K 3 r = 0 := by
      ext g
      exact (hne ⟨g⟩).elim
    show barMap K A (proj K _ (Finsupp.mapDomain f
      (Finsupp.mapDomain (flM b) (vecEquiv F K 3 r)))) ∈ _
    rw [this, Finsupp.mapDomain_zero, Finsupp.mapDomain_zero, map_zero, map_zero]
    exact Submodule.zero_mem _
  obtain ⟨σ₀⟩ := hne
  show barMap K A (proj K _ (Finsupp.mapDomain f
    (Finsupp.mapDomain (flM b) (vecEquiv F K 3 r)))) ∈ _
  have hroot : ∀ σ : SMono F (Finset.range 3),
      rootF (f (flM b σ)).1 = rootF (f (flM b σ₀)).1 := fun σ =>
    rootF_ctx hf (flM_ne_leaf b σ) (flM_ne_leaf b σ₀) (by rw [rootF_flM, rootF_flM])
  rw [← Finsupp.mapDomain_comp]
  cases hc : rootF (f (flM b σ₀)).1
  swap
  · rw [proj_of_supported_not K _ (mapDomain_mem_supported K _ fun σ _ => by
      show ¬ rootF (f (flM b σ)).1 = false
      rw [hroot, hc]
      decide), map_zero]
    exact Submodule.zero_mem _
  rw [proj_of_supported K _ (mapDomain_mem_supported K _ fun σ _ => by
    show rootF (f (flM b σ)).1 = false
    rw [hroot, hc])]
  obtain ⟨p, s, he, hwin, hall⟩ := exists_edge_of_ctx (F := BE F) hf (flM b σ₀)
  rw [flM_val, ofS_fl] at hwin
  have hfl := flags_of_windowRoot _ s he b _ hwin
  have hflag : ShuffleBar.flagAt (ofS (F := BE F) (f (flM b σ₀)).1) p = b := hfl.1
  have huncut : ShuffleBar.IsUncut (ofS (F := BE F) (f (flM b σ₀)).1) p s :=
    ⟨he, by rw [ShuffleBar.flagAt, LTree.subtreeAt_append]; exact hfl.2⟩
  have hvalid : ShuffleBar.Valid (ofS (F := BE F) (f (flM b σ₀)).1) := by
    refine ⟨isShuffle_ofS _, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [← Multiset.coe_nodup, labels_ofS]
      exact A.nodup
    · rw [← rootF_toS, toS_ofS]
      exact hc
  refine Submodule.subset_span ⟨_, p, s, r, hvalid, huncut, hr, ?_⟩
  rw [vecEquiv_eq_sum, Finsupp.mapDomain_finsetSum, map_sum, ShuffleBar.substRel]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun σ _ => ?_
  rw [Finsupp.mapDomain_smul, map_smul, Finsupp.mapDomain_single, barMap_single,
    Function.comp_apply, hall, flM_val, monoEquiv_val, ofS_fl, ofS_toS, ShuffleBar.substBar,
    hflag]

name: Operad.ShuffleBridge.barMap_mem_J
statement:
theorem barMap_mem_J {A : Finset ℕ} {v : SMono (BE F) A →₀ K} (hv : v ∈ (G.bar.rw A).ideal)
    (hr : v ∈ Finsupp.supported K K {X | rootF X.1 = false}) :
    barMap K A v ∈ ShuffleBar.J K R
proof:
:= by
  rw [← proj_of_supported K (fun X : SMono (BE F) A => rootF X.1 = false) hr]
  rw [Rules.ideal_eq_span] at hv
  refine (Submodule.span_le (p := (ShuffleBar.J K R).comap
    ((barMap K A).comp (proj K fun X : SMono (BE F) A => rootF X.1 = false)))).2 ?_ hv
  rintro _ ⟨r, f, hf, rfl⟩
  have hgen : Finsupp.single (G.bar.lead r) 1 - G.bar.tail r =
      Finsupp.mapDomain (flM r.2) (Finsupp.single (G.lead r.1) 1 - G.tail r.1) := by
    rw [Finsupp.mapDomain_sub, Finsupp.mapDomain_single]
    rfl
  rw [SetLike.mem_coe, Submodule.mem_comap, LinearMap.comp_apply]
  erw [hgen]
  exact barMap_gen_mem (hsrc r.1) hf r.2
    (by rw [hR]; exact Submodule.subset_span ⟨r.1, rfl⟩)

name: Operad.ShuffleBridge.mem_ideal_of_barMap
statement:
theorem mem_ideal_of_barMap {A : Finset ℕ} {v : SMono (BE F) A →₀ K}
    (hv : barMap K A v ∈ ShuffleBar.J K R) : v ∈ (G.bar.rw A).ideal
proof:
:= by
  set P : ShuffleBar.BarTree (F 2) → Prop := fun y => (y.labels : Multiset ℕ) = A.val
  have hπ : proj K P (barMap K A v) = barMap K A v :=
    proj_of_supported K P (mapDomain_mem_supported K v fun X _ => labels_ofS X)
  have hmem : barMap K A v ∈ (G.bar.rw A).ideal.map (barMap K A) := by
    rw [← hπ]
    refine (Submodule.span_le (p := ((G.bar.rw A).ideal.map (barMap K A)).comap
      (proj K P))).2 ?_ hv
    rintro _ ⟨x, p, s, r, hx, hu, hr, rfl⟩
    have hlab : ∀ σ : LTree.Mono (F 2) 3,
        ((ShuffleBar.substBar x p s σ.1).labels : Multiset ℕ) = x.labels := fun σ =>
      Multiset.coe_eq_coe.2
        (ShuffleBar.perm_labels_substBar hx.shuffle hx.nodup hu (ShuffleBar.mono_shape σ).2.1)
    rw [SetLike.mem_coe, Submodule.mem_comap]
    by_cases hxl : (x.labels : Multiset ℕ) = A.val
    · have hs : ShuffleBar.substRel K x p s r ∈ Finsupp.supported K K {y | P y} :=
        Submodule.sum_mem _ fun σ _ => Submodule.smul_mem _ _
          (Finsupp.single_mem_supported K _ (show P _ from (hlab σ).trans hxl))
      rw [proj_of_supported K P hs]
      obtain ⟨f, hf, hfv⟩ := exists_ctx_of_edge' (F := BE F) x hx.shuffle hxl hu.1
      refine ⟨_, G.bar.mapDomain_mem_ideal hf
        (mapDomain_flM_mem G hsrc hR hr (ShuffleBar.flagAt x p)), ?_⟩
      rw [vecEquiv_eq_sum, Finsupp.mapDomain_finsetSum, Finsupp.mapDomain_finsetSum, map_sum,
        ShuffleBar.substRel]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun σ _ => ?_
      rw [Finsupp.mapDomain_smul, Finsupp.mapDomain_smul, map_smul, Finsupp.mapDomain_single,
        Finsupp.mapDomain_single, barMap_single, hfv, ofS_toS, flM_val, monoEquiv_val, ofS_fl,
        ofS_toS]
      rfl
    · have hs : ShuffleBar.substRel K x p s r ∈ Finsupp.supported K K {y | ¬ P y} :=
        Submodule.sum_mem _ fun σ _ => Submodule.smul_mem _ _
          (Finsupp.single_mem_supported K _
            (show ¬ P _ from fun h => hxl ((hlab σ).symm.trans h)))
      rw [proj_of_supported_not K P hs]
      exact Submodule.zero_mem _
  obtain ⟨u, hu, he⟩ := hmem
  rwa [← barMap_injective K A he]

name: Operad.ShuffleBridge.d_mem_C
statement:
lemma d_mem_C {A : Finset ℕ} {w s : ℕ} {u : SMono (BE F) A →₀ K}
    (hu : u ∈ Bar.C K A w (s + 1)) : Bar.d K u ∈ Bar.C K A w s
proof:
:= by
  rw [Bar.C, Finsupp.supported_eq_span_single] at hu
  induction hu using Submodule.span_induction with
  | mem _ h =>
    obtain ⟨X, hX, rfl⟩ := h
    exact Bar.d_mem_P hX
  | zero => rw [map_zero]; exact Submodule.zero_mem _
  | add _ _ _ _ h₁ h₂ => rw [map_add]; exact Submodule.add_mem _ h₁ h₂
  | smul a _ _ h => rw [map_smul]; exact Submodule.smul_mem _ a h

name: Operad.ShuffleBridge.shuffleBar_isKoszul_of_isKoszul
statement: theorem shuffleBar_isKoszul_of_isKoszul (hK : G.IsKoszul) : ShuffleBar.IsKoszul K R
proof:
:= by
  intro n s hsn x hx hdx
  obtain ⟨v, hv, rfl⟩ := C_le_map (F := F) K n s hx
  have hdv : Bar.d K v ∈ (G.bar.rw (Finset.range n)).ideal :=
    mem_ideal_of_barMap G hsrc hR (by rw [barMap_d]; exact hdx)
  obtain ⟨u, hu, hvu⟩ := hK (Finset.range n) (n - 1) s (by omega) v hv hdv
  refine ⟨barMap K _ u, map_C_le K n (n - 1) (s + 1) ⟨u, hu, rfl⟩, ?_⟩
  rw [← barMap_d, ← map_sub]
  refine barMap_mem_J G hsrc hR hvu (Submodule.sub_mem _ ?_ ?_)
  · exact Finsupp.supported_mono (fun X hX => hX.1) hv
  · exact Finsupp.supported_mono (fun X hX => hX.1) (d_mem_C hu)

name: Operad.ShuffleBridge.relabel_node
statement:
lemma relabel_node {k : ℕ} (d : E k) (c : Fin k → STree E) (φ : ℕ → ℕ) :
    (node d c).relabel φ = node d fun i => (c i).relabel φ
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.ShuffleBridge.weight_relabel
statement: lemma weight_relabel (φ : ℕ → ℕ) (t : STree E) : (t.relabel φ).weight = t.weight
proof:
:= by
  rw [relabel, weight_subst]
  simp

name: Operad.ShuffleBridge.key_relabel
statement:
lemma key_relabel (φ : ℕ → ℕ) {t : STree E} (ht : t.IsShuffle) :
    key (t.relabel φ) = rkey φ (key t)
proof:
:= by
  rw [key, key, rkey, ofLex_toLex, first_relabel φ ht, weight_relabel]

name: Operad.ShuffleBridge.rootF_relabel
statement: lemma rootF_relabel (φ : ℕ → ℕ) (t : STree (BE E)) : rootF (t.relabel φ) = rootF t
proof:
:= by
  cases t <;> rfl

name: Operad.ShuffleBridge.cutKeys_relabel
statement:
lemma cutKeys_relabel (φ : ℕ → ℕ) : ∀ t : STree (BE E), t.IsShuffle →
    cutKeys (t.relabel φ) = (cutKeys t).image (rkey φ)
  | leaf _, _ => rfl
  | node d c, h => by
    have ih : ∀ i, cutKeys ((c i).relabel φ) = (cutKeys (c i)).image (rkey φ)
proof:
:=
      fun i => cutKeys_relabel φ (c i) (h.child i)
    have hk := key_relabel φ h
    rw [relabel_node] at hk ⊢
    simp only [STree.cutKeys, Finset.image_union, ih, hk]
    congr 1
    · split_ifs <;> simp
    · ext x
      simp only [Finset.mem_biUnion, Finset.mem_image, Finset.mem_univ, true_and]
      exact ⟨fun ⟨i, y, hy, e⟩ => ⟨y, ⟨i, hy⟩, e⟩, fun ⟨y, ⟨i, hy⟩, e⟩ => ⟨i, y, hy, e⟩⟩

name: Operad.ShuffleBridge.rkey_eq_iff
statement:
lemma rkey_eq_iff {φ : ℕ → ℕ} {S : Set ℕ} (hφ : Set.InjOn φ S) {k k' : ℕ ×ₗ ℕ}
    (hk : (ofLex k).1 ∈ S) (hk' : (ofLex k').1 ∈ S) : rkey φ k = rkey φ k' ↔ k = k'
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun h => ?_, fun h => h ▸ rfl⟩
  have h' := congrArg ofLex h
  simp only [rkey, ofLex_toLex, Prod.mk.injEq] at h'
  exact ofLex.injective (Prod.ext (hφ hk hk' h'.1) h'.2)

name: Operad.ShuffleBridge.rkey_lt_iff
statement:
lemma rkey_lt_iff {φ : ℕ → ℕ} {S : Set ℕ} (hφ : StrictMonoOn φ S) {k k' : ℕ ×ₗ ℕ}
    (hk : (ofLex k).1 ∈ S) (hk' : (ofLex k').1 ∈ S) : rkey φ k < rkey φ k' ↔ k < k'
proof:
:= by
  rw [rkey, rkey, Prod.Lex.toLex_lt_toLex, ← toLex_ofLex k, ← toLex_ofLex k',
    Prod.Lex.toLex_lt_toLex, ofLex_toLex, ofLex_toLex, hφ.lt_iff_lt hk hk',
    hφ.injOn.eq_iff hk hk']

name: Operad.ShuffleBridge.setF_relabel
statement:
lemma setF_relabel {φ : ℕ → ℕ} {S : Set ℕ} (hφ : Set.InjOn φ S) {k : ℕ ×ₗ ℕ}
    (hk : (ofLex k).1 ∈ S) (b : Bool) : ∀ t : STree (BE E), t.IsShuffle →
    (∀ a ∈ t.labels, a ∈ S) →
    setF (rkey φ k) b (t.relabel φ) = (setF k b t).relabel φ
  | leaf _, _, _ => rfl
  | node d c, h, hS => by
    have hkey
proof:
:= key_relabel φ h
    have hfirst : (ofLex (key (node d c))).1 ∈ S := hS _ (first_mem h)
    rw [relabel_node] at hkey ⊢
    rw [setF_node, setF_node, relabel_node, hkey]
    simp only [rkey_eq_iff hφ hfirst hk]
    congr 1
    funext i
    exact setF_relabel hφ hk b (c i) (h.child i)
      fun a ha => hS a (Multiset.mem_of_le (labels_le_node d c i) ha)

name: Operad.ShuffleBridge.cuts_relabelM
statement:
lemma cuts_relabelM (X : SMono (BE E) A) :
    cuts (relabelM φ hφ himg X) = (cuts X).image (rkey φ)
proof:
:=
  cutKeys_relabel φ X.1 X.isShuffle

name: Operad.ShuffleBridge.mem_A_of_cut
statement: lemma mem_A_of_cut {X : SMono (BE E) A} {k : ℕ ×ₗ ℕ} (hk : k ∈ cuts X) : (ofLex k).1 ∈ A
proof:
:=
  X.mem_labels.1 (mem_vkeys X.isShuffle (mem_vkeys_of_mem_cutKeys hk)).1

name: Operad.ShuffleBridge.setM_relabelM
statement:
lemma setM_relabelM (X : SMono (BE E) A) {k : ℕ ×ₗ ℕ} (hk : (ofLex k).1 ∈ A) (b : Bool) :
    setM (rkey φ k) b (relabelM φ hφ himg X) = relabelM φ hφ himg (setM k b X)
proof:
:=
  Subtype.ext (setF_relabel hφ.injOn (S := A) hk b X.1 X.isShuffle fun _ ha => X.mem_labels.1 ha)

name: Operad.ShuffleBridge.mem_P_relabelM
statement:
lemma mem_P_relabelM {w s : ℕ} {X : SMono (BE E) A} (hX : X ∈ Bar.P A w s) :
    relabelM φ hφ himg X ∈ Bar.P B w s
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · show rootF (X.1.relabel φ) = false
    rw [rootF_relabel]
    exact hX.1
  · show (X.1.relabel φ).weight = w
    rw [weight_relabel]
    exact hX.2.1
  · rw [cuts_relabelM, Finset.card_image_of_injOn fun k hk k' hk' h =>
      (rkey_eq_iff hφ.injOn (mem_A_of_cut hk) (mem_A_of_cut hk')).1 h]
    exact hX.2.2

name: Operad.ShuffleBridge.d_relabelM
statement:
theorem d_relabelM (v : SMono (BE E) A →₀ K) :
    Bar.d K (Finsupp.mapDomain (relabelM φ hφ himg) v) =
      Finsupp.mapDomain (relabelM φ hφ himg) (Bar.d K v)
proof:
:= by
  induction v using Finsupp.induction_linear with
  | zero => simp
  | add v w hv hw => rw [Finsupp.mapDomain_add, map_add, hv, hw, map_add, Finsupp.mapDomain_add]
  | single X c =>
    have hinj : Set.InjOn (rkey φ) (cuts X : Set (ℕ ×ₗ ℕ)) := fun k hk k' hk' h =>
      (rkey_eq_iff hφ.injOn (mem_A_of_cut hk) (mem_A_of_cut hk')).1 h
    rw [Finsupp.mapDomain_single, Bar.d, CutComplex.d_single, Bar.d, CutComplex.d_single,
      Finsupp.mapDomain_smul, CutComplex.dX, CutComplex.dX, cuts_relabelM,
      Finset.sum_image hinj, Finsupp.mapDomain_finsetSum]
    congr 1
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun k hk => ?_
    rw [Finsupp.mapDomain_smul, Finsupp.mapDomain_single,
      setM_relabelM φ hφ himg X (mem_A_of_cut hk), CutComplex.sgn, CutComplex.sgn,
      Finset.filter_image, Finset.card_image_of_injOn (hinj.mono (Finset.filter_subset _ _))]
    congr 3
    exact Finset.filter_congr fun k' hk' =>
      rkey_lt_iff hφ (mem_A_of_cut hk') (mem_A_of_cut hk)

name: Operad.ShuffleBridge.weight_add_one
statement: lemma weight_add_one {n : ℕ} (X : SMono (BE F) (Finset.range n)) : X.1.weight + 1 = n
proof:
:= by
  have h1 := weight_toS (F := BE F) (ofS X.1)
  rw [toS_ofS] at h1
  have h2 : (ofS (F := BE F) X.1).arity = n := by
    rw [← LTree.length_labels, ← Multiset.coe_card, labels_ofS, Finset.range_val,
      Multiset.card_range]
  omega

name: Operad.ShuffleBridge.exact_range
statement:
theorem exact_range (hK : ShuffleBar.IsKoszul K R) {n w s : ℕ} (hsw : s < w)
    {v : SMono (BE F) (Finset.range n) →₀ K} (hv : v ∈ Bar.C K (Finset.range n) w s)
    (hdv : Bar.d K v ∈ (G.bar.rw (Finset.range n)).ideal) :
    ∃ u ∈ Bar.C K (Finset.range n) w (s + 1),
      v - Bar.d K u ∈ (G.bar.rw (Finset.range n)).ideal
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hmain : w + 1 = n ∧ s ≠ 0
  · obtain ⟨hwn, hs⟩ := hmain
    obtain ⟨s', rfl⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_succ_of_ne_zero hs
    have hx : barMap K _ v ∈ ShuffleBar.C K n (s' + 1) := map_C_le K n w (s' + 1) ⟨v, hv, rfl⟩
    have hdx : ShuffleBar.d K (barMap K _ v) ∈ ShuffleBar.J K R := by
      rw [← barMap_d]
      exact barMap_mem_J G hsrc hR hdv
        (Finsupp.supported_mono (fun X hX => hX.1) (d_mem_C hv))
    obtain ⟨y, hy, hxy⟩ := hK n (s' + 1) (by omega) _ hx hdx
    obtain ⟨u, hu, rfl⟩ := C_le_map (F := F) K n (s' + 1 + 1) hy
    refine ⟨u, by rwa [show w = n - 1 by omega], mem_ideal_of_barMap G hsrc hR ?_⟩
    rw [map_sub, barMap_d]
    exact hxy
  · have hv0 : v = 0 := by
      ext X
      by_contra hX
      obtain ⟨-, hXw, hXs⟩ := (Finsupp.mem_supported K v).1 hv (Finsupp.mem_support_iff.2 hX)
      have := weight_add_one X
      exact hmain ⟨by omega, by omega⟩
    refine ⟨0, Submodule.zero_mem _, ?_⟩
    rw [hv0, map_zero, sub_zero]
    exact Submodule.zero_mem _

name: Operad.ShuffleBridge.isKoszul_of_shuffleBar
statement: theorem isKoszul_of_shuffleBar (hK : ShuffleBar.IsKoszul K R) : G.IsKoszul
proof:
:= by
  intro A w s hsw v hv hdv
  have hβα : ∀ X : SMono (BE F) A, relabelM (eltIn A) (strictMonoOn_eltIn A) (image_eltIn A)
      (relabelM (posIn A) (strictMonoOn_posIn A) (image_posIn A) X) = X := fun X =>
    Subtype.ext (by
      show (X.1.relabel (posIn A)).relabel (eltIn A) = X.1
      rw [relabel_relabel]
      exact relabel_id fun a ha => eltIn_posIn (X.mem_labels.1 ha))
  set α := relabelM (E := BE F) (posIn A) (strictMonoOn_posIn A) (image_posIn A)
  set β := relabelM (E := BE F) (eltIn A) (strictMonoOn_eltIn A) (image_eltIn A)
  have hv' : Finsupp.mapDomain α v ∈ Bar.C K (Finset.range A.card) w s :=
    mapDomain_mem_supported K v fun X hX =>
      mem_P_relabelM _ _ _ ((Finsupp.mem_supported K v).1 hv hX)
  have hdv' : Bar.d K (Finsupp.mapDomain α v) ∈ (G.bar.rw (Finset.range A.card)).ideal := by
    rw [d_relabelM]
    exact G.bar.mapDomain_mem_ideal (isSCtx_relabelM _ _ _) hdv
  obtain ⟨u, hu, hvu⟩ := exact_range G hsrc hR hK hsw hv' hdv'
  refine ⟨Finsupp.mapDomain β u, mapDomain_mem_supported K u fun X hX =>
    mem_P_relabelM _ _ _ ((Finsupp.mem_supported K u).1 hu hX), ?_⟩
  have hvβ : v = Finsupp.mapDomain β (Finsupp.mapDomain α v) := by
    rw [← Finsupp.mapDomain_comp, show β ∘ α = id from funext hβα, Finsupp.mapDomain_id]
  rw [hvβ, d_relabelM, ← Finsupp.mapDomain_sub]
  exact G.bar.mapDomain_mem_ideal (isSCtx_relabelM _ _ _) hvu

name: Operad.ShuffleBridge.isKoszul_iff
statement: theorem isKoszul_iff : ShuffleBar.IsKoszul K R ↔ G.IsKoszul
proof:
:=
  ⟨isKoszul_of_shuffleBar G hsrc hR, shuffleBar_isKoszul_of_isKoszul G hsrc hR⟩

name: Operad.ComBin.isKoszul_iff
statement: theorem isKoszul_iff : ShuffleBar.IsKoszul K (rel K) ↔ (ComGen.rules K).IsKoszul
proof:
:=
  ShuffleBridge.isKoszul_iff _ (src_rules K) (map_rel K)

name: Operad.AssBin.isKoszul_iff
statement: theorem isKoszul_iff : ShuffleBar.IsKoszul K (rel K) ↔ (AssShGen.rules K).IsKoszul
proof:
:=
  ShuffleBridge.isKoszul_iff _ (src_rules K) (map_rel K)

name: Operad.BTree.OfArity.reindexS_val
statement:
lemma reindexS_val {m n : ℕ} (h : m = n) (t : OfArity E m) :
    (reindexS (OfArity E) h t).1 = t.1
proof:
:= by
  subst h
  rfl

name: Operad.BTree.OfArity.one_val
statement: @[simp] lemma one_val : (NSSetOperad.one : OfArity E 1).1 = .leaf
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.BTree.OfArity.comp_val
statement:
@[simp] lemma comp_val (a b : ℕ) {n : ℕ} (t : OfArity E (a + 1 + b)) (s : OfArity E n) :
    (NSSetOperad.comp a b t s).1 = t.1.graft a s.1
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.BTree.OfArity.toArr_leaf
statement: lemma toArr_leaf : toArr (.leaf : BTree E) = Arr.one
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.BTree.OfArity.arr_ext
statement: lemma arr_ext {X Y : Arr (OfArity E)} (h : X.2.1 = Y.2.1) : X = Y
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨n, t, rfl⟩ := X
  obtain ⟨m, t', rfl⟩ := Y
  simp only at h
  subst h
  rfl

name: Operad.BTree.OfArity.toArr_node
statement:
lemma toArr_node (e : E) (l r : BTree E) :
    toArr (.node e l r) = Arr.bin (corolla e) (toArr l) (toArr r)
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : Arr.comp (⟨1 + 1 + 0, corolla e⟩ : Arr (OfArity E)) 1 ⟨r.arity, ⟨r, rfl⟩⟩
      = ⟨0 + 1 + r.arity, ⟨.node e .leaf r, by simp only [arity_node, arity_leaf]⟩⟩ := by
    rw [Arr.mk_comp]
    exact arr_ext rfl
  have h2 : Arr.comp (⟨0 + 1 + r.arity, ⟨.node e .leaf r, by
      simp only [arity_node, arity_leaf]⟩⟩ : Arr (OfArity E)) 0 ⟨l.arity, ⟨l, rfl⟩⟩
      = toArr (.node e l r) := by
    rw [Arr.mk_comp]
    exact arr_ext rfl
  show _ = Arr.comp (Arr.comp ⟨1 + 1 + 0, corolla e⟩ 1 ⟨r.arity, ⟨r, rfl⟩⟩) 0
    ⟨l.arity, ⟨l, rfl⟩⟩
  rw [h1, h2]

name: Operad.BTree.evalArr_fst
statement:
lemma evalArr_fst : ∀ t : BTree E, (evalArr f t).1 = t.arity
  | .leaf => rfl
  | .node e l r => by
    simp only [evalArr, Arr.bin_fst, evalArr_fst l, evalArr_fst r, arity_node]

name: Operad.BTree.evalArr_graft
statement:
theorem evalArr_graft : ∀ (t : BTree E) (i : ℕ) (s : BTree E), i < t.arity →
    evalArr f (t.graft i s) = (evalArr f t).comp i (evalArr f s)
  | .leaf, i, s, h => by
    obtain rfl : i = 0
proof:
:= by simp only [arity_leaf] at h; omega
    simp only [graft_leaf, evalArr]
    exact (Arr.one_comp _).symm
  | .node e l r, i, s, h => by
    simp only [arity_node] at h
    by_cases hi : i < l.arity
    · rw [graft_node_of_lt r s hi]
      simp only [evalArr]
      rw [evalArr_graft l i s hi, Arr.comp_bin_left _ _ _ _ (by rw [evalArr_fst]; exact hi)]
    · rw [graft_node_of_ge l s (by omega)]
      simp only [evalArr]
      rw [evalArr_graft r (i - l.arity) s (by omega),
        Arr.comp_bin_right (c := i - l.arity) _ _ _ _ (by rw [evalArr_fst]; omega)
          (by rw [evalArr_fst]; omega)]

name: Operad.BTree.OfArity.lift_mk
statement:
lemma lift_mk (f : E → S 2) (t : BTree E) :
    Arr.map (lift f) (toArr t) = evalArr f t
proof:
:= by
  unfold toArr lift
  rw [Arr.map_mk]
  exact Arr.mk_reindexS _ _

name: Operad.BTree.OfArity.lift_corolla
statement: @[simp] lemma lift_corolla (f : E → S 2) (e : E) : (lift f).app 2 (corolla e) = f e
proof:
:= by
  apply Arr.mk_eq_mk_iff.1
  rw [← Arr.map_mk, show (⟨2, corolla e⟩ : Arr (OfArity E)) = toArr (.node e .leaf .leaf) from rfl,
    lift_mk]
  exact Arr.bin_one_one (f e)

name: Operad.BTree.OfArity.map_toArr
statement:
lemma map_toArr (φ : NSSetOperadHom (OfArity E) S) :
    ∀ t : BTree E, Arr.map φ (toArr t) = evalArr (fun e => φ.app 2 (corolla e)) t
  | .leaf => by rw [toArr_leaf, Arr.map_one]; rfl
  | .node e l r => by
    rw [toArr_node, Arr.map_bin, map_toArr φ l, map_toArr φ r]
    rfl

name: Operad.BTree.OfArity.hom_ext
statement:
theorem hom_ext {φ ψ : NSSetOperadHom (OfArity E) S}
    (h : ∀ e, φ.app 2 (corolla e) = ψ.app 2 (corolla e)) : φ = ψ
proof:
:= by
  ext n t
  obtain ⟨t, rfl⟩ := t
  have := map_toArr φ t
  rw [show (fun e => φ.app 2 (corolla e)) = fun e => ψ.app 2 (corolla e) from funext h,
    ← map_toArr ψ t] at this
  exact Arr.mk_eq_mk_iff.1 this

name: Operad.FreeBin.regHom_ext
statement:
theorem regHom_ext {S : (A : Type) → [Fintype A] → [DecidableEq A] → Type w} [SetOperad S]
    {G G' : SetOperadHom (Reg (BTree.OfArity E)) S}
    (h : ∀ e, G.app (Fin 2) (Reg.std (corolla e)) = G'.app (Fin 2) (Reg.std (corolla e))) :
    G = G'
proof:
:=
  Reg.hom_ext fun n x => by
    have := BTree.OfArity.hom_ext (φ := (SetOperadHom.toNSSet G).comp Reg.eta)
      (ψ := (SetOperadHom.toNSSet G').comp Reg.eta) h
    exact congrArg (fun φ => NSSetOperadHom.app φ n x) this

name: Operad.FreeBin.toReg_gen
statement: lemma toReg_gen (e : E) : toReg.app (Fin 2) (Pres.gen (.op e)) = Reg.std (corolla e)
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.FreeBin.ofReg_std
statement:
lemma ofReg_std (e : E) :
    ofReg.app (Fin 2) (Reg.std (corolla e)) = (Pres.gen (.op e) : FreeSet (BinGen E) (Fin 2))
proof:
:= by
  rw [ofReg, Reg.lift_std]
  exact BTree.OfArity.lift_corolla (S := SetOperad.toNSSet (FreeSet (BinGen E))) _ e

name: Operad.FreeBin.basis_apply
statement:
lemma basis_apply (A : Type) [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] (x : Reg (BTree.OfArity G) A) :
    basis R G A x = Finsupp.single (ofReg.app A x) 1
proof:
:= by
  simp [basis, SetOperadIso.equiv, regIso]

name: Operad.FreeBin.card_reg
statement:
lemma card_reg (N : ℕ → Type v) (A : Type) [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] :
    Nat.card (Reg N A) = (Fintype.card A).factorial * Nat.card (N (Fintype.card A))
proof:
:= by
  rw [show Nat.card (Reg N A) = Nat.card (LinOrd A × {X : Arr N // X.1 = Fintype.card A}) from rfl,
    Nat.card_prod, LinOrd.card, Nat.card_congr (arrEquiv N _)]

name: Operad.FreeBin.finrank_eq
statement:
theorem finrank_eq [Fintype G] [DecidableEq G] [Nontrivial R] (A : Type) [Fintype A]
    [DecidableEq A] :
    Module.finrank R (FreeBin R G A)
      = (Fintype.card A).factorial * Fintype.card (BTree.OfArity G (Fintype.card A))
proof:
:= by
  rw [Module.finrank_eq_nat_card_basis (basis R G A), card_reg, Nat.card_eq_fintype_card]

name: Operad.finComap_apply
statement:
@[simp] lemma finComap_apply {X Y : Type*} (c : X → Y) (hc : ∀ y, (c ⁻¹' {y}).Finite)
    (x : Y →₀ R) (a : X) : finComap c hc x a = x (c a)
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: Operad.finite_preimage_of_injective
statement:
lemma finite_preimage_of_injective {X Y : Type*} {c : X → Y} (hc : Function.Injective c) (y : Y) :
    (c ⁻¹' {y}).Finite
proof:
:=
  Set.Subsingleton.finite fun _ ha _ hb => hc (ha.trans hb.symm)

name: Operad.tens_tmul_apply
statement:
lemma tens_tmul_apply {X Y : Type*} (x : X →₀ R) (y : Y →₀ R) (a : X) (b : Y) :
    tens R X Y (x ⊗ₜ y) (a, b) = x a * y b
proof:
:=
  finsuppTensorFinsupp'_apply_apply R X Y x y a b

name: Operad.tens_apply_eq_pair
statement:
lemma tens_apply_eq_pair {X Y : Type*} (t : (X →₀ R) ⊗[R] (Y →₀ R)) (a : X) (b : Y) :
    tens R X Y t (a, b) = SymCooperad.pair (Finsupp.lapply a) (Finsupp.lapply b) t
proof:
:= by
  have : (Finsupp.lapply (a, b)) ∘ₗ (tens R X Y).toLinearMap
      = SymCooperad.pair (Finsupp.lapply a) (Finsupp.lapply b) :=
    TensorProduct.ext' fun x y => by simp
  exact LinearMap.congr_fun this t

name: Operad.tens3_tmul_apply
statement:
@[simp] lemma tens3_tmul_apply {X Y Z : Type*} (x : X →₀ R) (y : Y →₀ R) (z : Z →₀ R) (a : X)
    (b : Y) (d : Z) : tens3 R X Y Z (x ⊗ₜ (y ⊗ₜ z)) (a, (b, d)) = x a * (y b * z d)
proof:
:= by
  simp [tens3]

name: Operad.tens3'_tmul_apply
statement:
@[simp] lemma tens3'_tmul_apply {X Y Z : Type*} (x : X →₀ R) (y : Y →₀ R) (z : Z →₀ R) (a : X)
    (b : Y) (d : Z) : tens3' R X Y Z ((x ⊗ₜ y) ⊗ₜ z) ((a, b), d) = x a * y b * z d
proof:
:= by
  simp [tens3']

name: Operad.tens3_lTensor
statement:
lemma tens3_lTensor {X Y Y₁ Y₂ : Type*} (g : (Y →₀ R) →ₗ[R] (Y₁ →₀ R) ⊗[R] (Y₂ →₀ R))
    (c : Y₁ × Y₂ → Y) (hg : ∀ y p, tens R Y₁ Y₂ (g y) p = y (c p))
    (t : (X →₀ R) ⊗[R] (Y →₀ R)) (a : X) (p : Y₁ × Y₂) :
    tens3 R X Y₁ Y₂ (LinearMap.lTensor (X →₀ R) g t) (a, p) = tens R X Y t (a, c p)
proof:
:= by
  induction t using TensorProduct.induction_on with
  | zero => simp
  | tmul x y =>
    obtain ⟨b, d⟩ := p
    simp only [LinearMap.lTensor_tmul, tens_tmul_apply, ← hg y (b, d)]
    simp [tens3]
  | add t t' ht ht' => simp only [map_add, Finsupp.add_apply, ht, ht']

name: Operad.tens3'_rTensor
statement:
lemma tens3'_rTensor {X X₁ X₂ Z : Type*} (g : (X →₀ R) →ₗ[R] (X₁ →₀ R) ⊗[R] (X₂ →₀ R))
    (c : X₁ × X₂ → X) (hg : ∀ x p, tens R X₁ X₂ (g x) p = x (c p))
    (t : (X →₀ R) ⊗[R] (Z →₀ R)) (p : X₁ × X₂) (d : Z) :
    tens3' R X₁ X₂ Z (LinearMap.rTensor (Z →₀ R) g t) (p, d) = tens R X Z t (c p, d)
proof:
:= by
  induction t using TensorProduct.induction_on with
  | zero => simp
  | tmul x z =>
    obtain ⟨a, b⟩ := p
    simp only [LinearMap.rTensor_tmul, tens_tmul_apply, ← hg x (a, b)]
    simp [tens3']
  | add t t' ht ht' => simp only [map_add, Finsupp.add_apply, ht, ht']

name: Operad.tens3_assoc
statement:
lemma tens3_assoc {X Y Z : Type*} (t : ((X →₀ R) ⊗[R] (Y →₀ R)) ⊗[R] (Z →₀ R)) (a : X) (b : Y)
    (d : Z) :
    tens3 R X Y Z (TensorProduct.assoc R _ _ _ t) (a, (b, d)) = tens3' R X Y Z t ((a, b), d)
proof:
:= by
  have : (Finsupp.lapply (a, (b, d))) ∘ₗ (tens3 R X Y Z).toLinearMap ∘ₗ
        (TensorProduct.assoc R (X →₀ R) (Y →₀ R) (Z →₀ R)).toLinearMap
      = (Finsupp.lapply ((a, b), d)) ∘ₗ (tens3' R X Y Z).toLinearMap :=
    TensorProduct.ext_threefold fun x y z => by simp [mul_assoc]
  exact LinearMap.congr_fun this t

name: Operad.tens3'_swapLast
statement:
lemma tens3'_swapLast {X Y Z : Type w} (t : ((X →₀ R) ⊗[R] (Y →₀ R)) ⊗[R] (Z →₀ R)) (a : X)
    (b : Y) (d : Z) :
    tens3' R X Z Y (swapLast R _ _ _ t) ((a, d), b) = tens3' R X Y Z t ((a, b), d)
proof:
:= by
  have : (Finsupp.lapply ((a, d), b)) ∘ₗ (tens3' R X Z Y).toLinearMap ∘ₗ
        (swapLast R (X →₀ R) (Y →₀ R) (Z →₀ R)).toLinearMap
      = (Finsupp.lapply ((a, b), d)) ∘ₗ (tens3' R X Y Z).toLinearMap :=
    TensorProduct.ext_threefold fun x y z => by simp [swapLast, mul_right_comm]
  exact LinearMap.congr_fun this t

name: Operad.tens_map
statement:
lemma tens_map {X X' Y Y' : Type*} (f : (X →₀ R) →ₗ[R] (X' →₀ R)) (g : (Y →₀ R) →ₗ[R] (Y' →₀ R))
    (cf : X' → X) (cg : Y' → Y) (hf : ∀ x a, f x a = x (cf a)) (hg : ∀ y b, g y b = y (cg b))
    (t : (X →₀ R) ⊗[R] (Y →₀ R)) (a : X') (b : Y') :
    tens R X' Y' (TensorProduct.map f g t) (a, b) = tens R X Y t (cf a, cg b)
proof:
:= by
  induction t using TensorProduct.induction_on with
  | zero => simp
  | tmul x y => simp [hf, hg]
  | add t t' ht ht' => simp only [map_add, Finsupp.add_apply, ht, ht']

name: Operad.rid_lTensor_lapply
statement:
lemma rid_lTensor_lapply {X U : Type*} (u : U) (t : (X →₀ R) ⊗[R] (U →₀ R)) (a : X) :
    TensorProduct.rid R (X →₀ R) (LinearMap.lTensor (X →₀ R) (Finsupp.lapply u) t) a
      = tens R X U t (a, u)
proof:
:= by
  induction t using TensorProduct.induction_on with
  | zero => simp
  | tmul x y => simp [mul_comm]
  | add t t' ht ht' => simp only [map_add, Finsupp.add_apply, ht, ht']

name: Operad.lid_rTensor_lapply
statement:
lemma lid_rTensor_lapply {Y U : Type*} (u : U) (t : (U →₀ R) ⊗[R] (Y →₀ R)) (b : Y) :
    TensorProduct.lid R (Y →₀ R) (LinearMap.rTensor (Y →₀ R) (Finsupp.lapply u) t) b
      = tens R U Y t (u, b)
proof:
:= by
  induction t using TensorProduct.induction_on with
  | zero => simp
  | tmul x y => simp
  | add t t' ht ht' => simp only [map_add, Finsupp.add_apply, ht, ht']

name: Operad.Lin.mapL_apply
statement:
lemma mapL_apply (e : A ≃ B) (x : S A →₀ R) (y : S B) :
    mapL R e x y = x (SetOperad.map e.symm y)
proof:
:= by
  conv_lhs => rw [← SetOperad.map_map_symm e y]
  exact Finsupp.mapDomain_apply (SetOperad.map_injective e) x _

name: Operad.Lin.decompL_apply
statement:
lemma decompL_apply (i : A) (x : S (Without A i ⊕ B) →₀ R) (pq : S A × S B) :
    tens R (S A) (S B) (decompL R i x) pq = x (SetOperad.comp i pq.1 pq.2)
proof:
:= by
  simp [decompL]

name: Operad.Lin.decompL_map
statement:
lemma decompL_map (σ : A ≃ A') (τ : B ≃ B') (i : A) :
    decompL R (σ i) ∘ₗ mapL R (compEquiv σ τ i)
      = TensorProduct.map (mapL R σ) (mapL R τ) ∘ₗ decompL (S := S) R i
proof:
:=
  LinearMap.ext fun x => (tens R (S A') (S B')).injective (Finsupp.ext fun ⟨p, q⟩ => by
    rw [LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearMap.comp_apply, decompL_apply, mapL_apply,
      tens_map _ _ _ _ (mapL_apply σ) (mapL_apply τ), decompL_apply]
    congr 1
    rw [← SetOperad.map_symm_map (compEquiv σ τ i) (SetOperad.comp i _ _),
      SetOperad.map_comp, SetOperad.map_map_symm, SetOperad.map_map_symm])

name: Operad.Lin.decompL_counit_right
statement:
lemma decompL_counit_right (i : A) :
    (TensorProduct.rid R (S A →₀ R)).toLinearMap ∘ₗ
        LinearMap.lTensor (S A →₀ R) (Finsupp.lapply SetOperad.one) ∘ₗ decompL (B := Unit) R i ∘ₗ
          mapL R (rightUnitEquiv i).symm
      = LinearMap.id
proof:
:=
  LinearMap.ext fun x => Finsupp.ext fun a => by
    simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearEquiv.coe_coe, rid_lTensor_lapply, decompL_apply,
      mapL_apply, Equiv.symm_symm, SetOperad.comp_one, LinearMap.id_apply]

name: Operad.Lin.decompL_counit_left
statement:
lemma decompL_counit_left :
    (TensorProduct.lid R (S B →₀ R)).toLinearMap ∘ₗ
        LinearMap.rTensor (S B →₀ R) (Finsupp.lapply SetOperad.one) ∘ₗ decompL R () ∘ₗ
          mapL R (leftUnitEquiv B).symm
      = LinearMap.id
proof:
:=
  LinearMap.ext fun x => Finsupp.ext fun b => by
    simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearEquiv.coe_coe, lid_rTensor_lapply, decompL_apply,
      mapL_apply, Equiv.symm_symm, SetOperad.one_comp, LinearMap.id_apply]

name: Operad.Lin.decompL_assoc_seq
statement:
lemma decompL_assoc_seq (i : A) (j : B) :
    LinearMap.lTensor (S A →₀ R) (decompL (B := D) R j) ∘ₗ decompL R i
      = (TensorProduct.assoc R (S A →₀ R) (S B →₀ R) (S D →₀ R)).toLinearMap ∘ₗ
          LinearMap.rTensor (S D →₀ R) (decompL R i) ∘ₗ decompL R (Sum.inr j) ∘ₗ
            mapL R (seqEquiv i j D).symm
proof:
:=
  LinearMap.ext fun x => (tens3 R (S A) (S B) (S D)).injective (Finsupp.ext fun ⟨a, b, d⟩ => by
    simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearEquiv.coe_coe]
    rw [tens3_lTensor _ _ (decompL_apply j), decompL_apply, tens3_assoc,
      tens3'_rTensor _ _ (decompL_apply i), decompL_apply, mapL_apply, Equiv.symm_symm]
    exact congrArg x (SetOperad.comp_assoc_seq i j a b d).symm)

name: Operad.Lin.decompL_assoc_par
statement:
lemma decompL_assoc_par {i k : A} (hik : i ≠ k) :
    LinearMap.rTensor (S B →₀ R) (decompL (B := D) R k) ∘ₗ decompL R (Sum.inl ⟨i, hik⟩)
      = (swapLast R (S A →₀ R) (S B →₀ R) (S D →₀ R)).toLinearMap ∘ₗ
          LinearMap.rTensor (S D →₀ R) (decompL R i) ∘ₗ decompL R (Sum.inl ⟨k, Ne.symm hik⟩) ∘ₗ
            mapL R (parEquiv hik B D).symm
proof:
:=
  LinearMap.ext fun x => (tens3' R (S A) (S D) (S B)).injective (Finsupp.ext fun ⟨⟨a, d⟩, b⟩ => by
    simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearEquiv.coe_coe]
    rw [tens3'_rTensor _ _ (decompL_apply k), decompL_apply, tens3'_swapLast,
      tens3'_rTensor _ _ (decompL_apply i), decompL_apply, mapL_apply, Equiv.symm_symm]
    exact congrArg x (SetOperad.comp_assoc_par hik a b d).symm)

name: Operad.SymCooperadHom.ext
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨φa, _, _, _⟩ := φ
  obtain ⟨ψa, _, _, _⟩ := ψ
  have : @φa = @ψa := by
    funext A _ _
    exact LinearMap.ext (h A)
  subst this
  rfl

name: Operad.Lin.dualVal_map
statement:
lemma dualVal_map (Ψ : SetOperadHom S (Und R (SymCooperad.Dual R C))) {A B : Type} [Fintype A]
    [DecidableEq A] [Fintype B] [DecidableEq B] (e : A ≃ B) (p : S A) (c : C B) :
    dualVal Ψ (SetOperad.map e p) c = dualVal Ψ p (SymCooperad.map (R := R) e.symm c)
proof:
:= by
  rw [dualVal, Ψ.app_map]
  rfl

name: Operad.Lin.dualVal_one
statement:
lemma dualVal_one (Ψ : SetOperadHom S (Und R (SymCooperad.Dual R C))) (c : C Unit) :
    dualVal Ψ SetOperad.one c = SymCooperad.counit (R := R) c
proof:
:= by
  rw [dualVal, Ψ.app_one]
  rfl

name: Operad.Lin.dualVal_comp
statement:
lemma dualVal_comp (Ψ : SetOperadHom S (Und R (SymCooperad.Dual R C))) {A B : Type} [Fintype A]
    [DecidableEq A] [Fintype B] [DecidableEq B] (i : A) (p : S A) (q : S B)
    (c : C (Without A i ⊕ B)) :
    dualVal Ψ (SetOperad.comp i p q) c
      = SymCooperad.pair (dualVal Ψ p) (dualVal Ψ q) (SymCooperad.decomp (R := R) i c)
proof:
:= by
  rw [dualVal, Ψ.app_comp]
  rfl

name: Operad.Lin.dualVal_transpose
statement:
@[simp] lemma dualVal_transpose (Φ : SymCooperadHom R C (Lin R S)) {A : Type} [Fintype A]
    [DecidableEq A] (p : S A) (c : C A) : dualVal (transpose Φ) p c = Φ.app A c p
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: Operad.Lin.transpose_locallyFinite
statement:
lemma transpose_locallyFinite (Φ : SymCooperadHom R C (Lin R S)) :
    LocallyFinite (transpose Φ)
proof:
:=
  fun A _ _ c => by
    rw [show (fun p => dualVal (transpose Φ) p c) = ⇑(Φ.app A c) from rfl, Finsupp.fun_support_eq]
    exact (Φ.app A c).support.finite_toSet

name: Operad.Lin.ofTranspose_apply
statement:
@[simp] lemma ofTranspose_apply (Ψ : SetOperadHom S (Und R (SymCooperad.Dual R C)))
    (hΨ : LocallyFinite Ψ) {A : Type} [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] (c : C A) (p : S A) :
    (ofTranspose Ψ hΨ).app A c p = dualVal Ψ p c
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: Operad.Lin.coHomEquiv_apply_apply
statement:
@[simp] lemma coHomEquiv_apply_apply (Φ : SymCooperadHom R C (Lin R S)) {A : Type} [Fintype A]
    [DecidableEq A] (p : S A) (c : C A) : dualVal (coHomEquiv Φ).1 p c = Φ.app A c p
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: Operad.star_def
statement:
lemma star_def {j k : ℕ} (α : P (j + 1)) (β : P (k + 1)) :
    star (R := R) α β = ∑ i : Fin (j + 1), compFin (R := R) i α β
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.smul_sum'
statement:
private lemma smul_sum' {M : Type*} [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] {n : ℕ} (r : R)
    (f : Fin n → M) : r • ∑ i, f i = ∑ i, r • f i
proof:
:=
  map_sum (LinearMap.lsmul R M r) f Finset.univ

name: Operad.star_add_left
statement:
lemma star_add_left {j k : ℕ} (α α' : P (j + 1)) (β : P (k + 1)) :
    star (R := R) (α + α') β = star (R := R) α β + star (R := R) α' β
proof:
:= by
  unfold star
  rw [← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => compFin_add_left i α α' β

name: Operad.star_add_right
statement:
lemma star_add_right {j k : ℕ} (α : P (j + 1)) (β β' : P (k + 1)) :
    star (R := R) α (β + β') = star (R := R) α β + star (R := R) α β'
proof:
:= by
  unfold star
  rw [← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => compFin_add_right i α β β'

name: Operad.star_smul_left
statement:
lemma star_smul_left {j k : ℕ} (r : R) (α : P (j + 1)) (β : P (k + 1)) :
    star (R := R) (r • α) β = r • star (R := R) α β
proof:
:= by
  unfold star
  rw [smul_sum']
  exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => compFin_smul_left i r α β

name: Operad.star_smul_right
statement:
lemma star_smul_right {j k : ℕ} (r : R) (α : P (j + 1)) (β : P (k + 1)) :
    star (R := R) α (r • β) = r • star (R := R) α β
proof:
:= by
  unfold star
  rw [smul_sum']
  exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => compFin_smul_right i r α β

name: Operad.zero_star
statement:
@[simp] lemma zero_star {j k : ℕ} (β : P (k + 1)) :
    star (R := R) (0 : P (j + 1)) β = 0
proof:
:= by
  unfold star
  exact Finset.sum_eq_zero fun i _ => compFin_zero_left i β

name: Operad.star_zero
statement:
@[simp] lemma star_zero {j k : ℕ} (α : P (j + 1)) :
    star (R := R) α (0 : P (k + 1)) = 0
proof:
:= by
  unfold star
  exact Finset.sum_eq_zero fun i _ => compFin_zero_right i α

name: Operad.compFin_one
statement:
lemma compFin_one {m : ℕ} (i : Fin m) (α : P m) :
    compFin (R := R) i α (one (R := R) (P := P))
      = reindex R P (by have := i.isLt; omega) α
proof:
:= by
  unfold compFin
  rw [comp_one_right]
  simp

name: Operad.compFin_zero_one
statement:
lemma compFin_zero_one {k : ℕ} (β : P (k + 1)) :
    reindex R P (by omega)
        (compFin (R := R) (0 : Fin (0 + 1)) (one (R := R) (P := P)) β) = β
proof:
:= by
  have h0 : (0 : Fin (0 + 1)) = ⟨0, by omega⟩ := by apply Fin.ext; simp
  rw [h0, compFin_eq_comp 0 0, reindex_reindex]
  exact comp_one_left β

name: Operad.one_star
statement:
@[simp] lemma one_star {k : ℕ} (β : P (k + 1)) :
    reindex R P (by omega) (star (R := R) (one (R := R) (P := P)) β) = β
proof:
:= by
  rw [star_def, Fin.sum_univ_one]
  exact compFin_zero_one β

name: Operad.star_one
statement:
@[simp] lemma star_one {j : ℕ} (α : P (j + 1)) :
    star (R := R) α (one (R := R) (P := P)) = (j + 1) • α
proof:
:= by
  rw [star_def]
  have h : ∀ i : Fin (j + 1), compFin (R := R) i α (one (R := R) (P := P)) = α := fun i => by
    rw [compFin_one]; exact reindex_self _ _
  rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => h i, Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ,
    Fintype.card_fin]
  rfl

name: Operad.bracket_def
statement:
lemma bracket_def {j k : ℕ} (α : P (j + 1)) (β : P (k + 1)) :
    bracket (R := R) α β
      = star (R := R) α β - reindex R P (by omega) (star (R := R) β α)
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.bracket_antisymm
statement:
lemma bracket_antisymm {j k : ℕ} (α : P (j + 1)) (β : P (k + 1)) :
    bracket (R := R) α β = - reindex R P (by omega) (bracket (R := R) β α)
proof:
:= by
  rw [bracket_def, bracket_def, map_sub, neg_sub, reindex_reindex, reindex_self]

name: Operad.bracket_self
statement:
@[simp] lemma bracket_self {j : ℕ} (α : P (j + 1)) :
    bracket (R := R) α α = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [bracket_def, reindex_self, sub_self]

name: Operad.bracket_add_left
statement:
lemma bracket_add_left {j k : ℕ} (α α' : P (j + 1)) (β : P (k + 1)) :
    bracket (R := R) (α + α') β = bracket (R := R) α β + bracket (R := R) α' β
proof:
:= by
  rw [bracket_def, bracket_def, bracket_def, star_add_left, star_add_right, map_add]
  abel

name: Operad.bracket_add_right
statement:
lemma bracket_add_right {j k : ℕ} (α : P (j + 1)) (β β' : P (k + 1)) :
    bracket (R := R) α (β + β') = bracket (R := R) α β + bracket (R := R) α β'
proof:
:= by
  rw [bracket_def, bracket_def, bracket_def, star_add_right, star_add_left, map_add]
  abel

name: Operad.incS_mul_incS
statement:
@[simp] lemma incS_mul_incS {i j : ℕ} (a : PieceS R P i) (b : PieceS R P j) :
    (incS i a * incS j b : TotS R P) = incS (i + j) (sstar (R := R) a b)
proof:
:=
  DirectSum.of_mul_of a b

name: Operad.incS_reindex
statement:
lemma incS_reindex {m n : ℕ} (h : m = n) (x : PieceS R P m) :
    (incS m x : TotS R P) = incS n (reindex R P (by rw [h]) x)
proof:
:= by
  subst h
  rw [reindex_self]

name: Operad.smul_incS
statement:
lemma smul_incS (t : R) {i : ℕ} (a : PieceS R P i) :
    t • (incS i a : TotS R P) = incS i (t • a)
proof:
:=
  (DirectSum.of_smul (R := R) i t a).symm

name: Operad.smul_mul_totS
statement: lemma smul_mul_totS (t : R) (x y : TotS R P) : (t • x) * y = t • (x * y)
proof:
:= by
  induction x using DirectSum.induction_on with
  | zero => simp
  | add x₁ x₂ h₁ h₂ => simp only [smul_add, add_mul, h₁, h₂]
  | of i a =>
    induction y using DirectSum.induction_on with
    | zero => simp
    | add y₁ y₂ h₁ h₂ => simp only [mul_add, smul_add, h₁, h₂]
    | of j b =>
      rw [smul_incS, incS_mul_incS, incS_mul_incS, smul_incS]
      exact congrArg _ (sstar_smul_left t a b)

name: Operad.mul_smul_totS
statement: lemma mul_smul_totS (t : R) (x y : TotS R P) : x * (t • y) = t • (x * y)
proof:
:= by
  induction x using DirectSum.induction_on with
  | zero => simp
  | add x₁ x₂ h₁ h₂ => simp only [smul_add, add_mul, h₁, h₂]
  | of i a =>
    induction y using DirectSum.induction_on with
    | zero => simp
    | add y₁ y₂ h₁ h₂ => simp only [mul_add, smul_add, h₁, h₂]
    | of j b =>
      rw [smul_incS, incS_mul_incS, incS_mul_incS, smul_incS]
      exact congrArg _ (sstar_smul_right t a b)

name: Operad.associatorS_inc
statement:
lemma associatorS_inc (i j k : ℕ) (a : PieceS R P i) (b : PieceS R P j) (c : PieceS R P k) :
    associator (incS i a : TotS R P) (incS j b) (incS k c)
      = ((-1 : R) ^ (j * k))
        • associator (incS i a : TotS R P) (incS k c) (incS j b)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [associator, incS_mul_incS]
  rw [incS_reindex (show i + (j + k) = i + j + k by omega),
    incS_reindex (show i + k + j = i + j + k by omega),
    incS_reindex (show i + (k + j) = i + j + k by omega), ← map_sub, ← map_sub, smul_incS]
  exact congrArg _ (sstar_assoc_symm a b c)

name: Operad.neg_one_two_mul
statement: private lemma neg_one_two_mul (n : ℕ) : ((-1 : R)) ^ (2 * n) = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [pow_mul]; norm_num

name: Operad.neg_one_mul_two
statement: private lemma neg_one_mul_two (n : ℕ) : ((-1 : R)) ^ (n * 2) = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [mul_comm]; exact neg_one_two_mul n

name: Operad.jacobi_regroup
statement:
private lemma jacobi_regroup (i j k : ℕ) (x y z : TotS R P) :
    ((-1 : R) ^ (i * k)) • brT (i + j) k (brT i j x y) z
      + ((-1 : R) ^ (j * i)) • brT (j + k) i (brT j k y z) x
      + ((-1 : R) ^ (k * j)) • brT (k + i) j (brT k i z x) y
      = ((-1 : R) ^ (i * k)) • (associator x y z - ((-1 : R) ^ (j * k)) • associator x z y)
        + ((-1 : R) ^ (j * i)) • (associator y z x - ((-1 : R) ^ (k * i)) • associator y x z)
        + ((-1 : R) ^ (k * j)) • (associator z x y - ((-1 : R) ^ (i * j)) • associator z y x)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [brT, associator, sub_mul, mul_sub, smul_mul_totS, mul_smul_totS, smul_sub, smul_smul,
    ← pow_add]
  match_scalars
  all_goals ring_nf
  all_goals try simp only [neg_one_mul_two, one_mul]

name: Operad.jacobiS
statement:
theorem jacobiS (i j k : ℕ) (a : PieceS R P i) (b : PieceS R P j) (c : PieceS R P k) :
    ((-1 : R) ^ (i * k)) • brT (i + j) k (brT i j (incS i a) (incS j b)) (incS k c)
      + ((-1 : R) ^ (j * i)) • brT (j + k) i (brT j k (incS j b) (incS k c)) (incS i a)
      + ((-1 : R) ^ (k * j)) • brT (k + i) j (brT k i (incS k c) (incS i a)) (incS j b) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [jacobi_regroup, associatorS_inc i j k a b c, associatorS_inc j k i b c a,
    associatorS_inc k i j c a b]
  simp

name: Operad.associator_self_one
statement:
lemma associator_self_one (m : ℕ) (x : PieceS R P m) (T : PieceS R P 1) :
    associator (incS m x : TotS R P) (incS 1 T) (incS 1 T) = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp only [associator, incS_mul_incS]
  rw [incS_reindex (show m + (1 + 1) = m + 1 + 1 by omega), ← map_sub,
    sstar_sstar_self_one x T, reindex_reindex, reindex_self, sub_self, map_zero]

name: Operad.two_smul_associator_odd
statement:
lemma two_smul_associator_odd (m : ℕ) (x : PieceS R P m) (T : PieceS R P 1) :
    (2 : ℕ) • associator (incS m x : TotS R P) (incS 1 T) (incS 1 T) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have h := associatorS_inc m 1 1 x T T
  rw [Nat.mul_one, pow_one, neg_one_smul] at h
  rw [two_smul]
  exact add_eq_zero_iff_eq_neg.2 h

name: Operad.dsq_eq
statement:
theorem dsq_eq (m : ℕ) (T : PieceS R P 1) (x : PieceS R P m)
    (hMC : (incS 1 T : TotS R P) * incS 1 T = 0) :
    brT 1 (1 + m) (incS 1 T) (brT 1 m (incS 1 T) (incS m x))
      = - associator (incS m x : TotS R P) (incS 1 T) (incS 1 T)
proof:
:= by
  have hA := associatorS_inc 1 m 1 T x T
  rw [Nat.mul_one] at hA
  have expand : brT 1 (1 + m) (incS 1 T) (brT 1 m (incS 1 T) (incS m x))
      = (incS 1 T * incS 1 T : TotS R P) * incS m x
        - associator (incS 1 T : TotS R P) (incS 1 T) (incS m x)
        + ((-1 : R) ^ m) • associator (incS 1 T : TotS R P) (incS m x) (incS 1 T)
        - associator (incS m x : TotS R P) (incS 1 T) (incS 1 T)
        - (incS m x : TotS R P) * (incS 1 T * incS 1 T) := by
    simp only [brT, associator, mul_sub, sub_mul, smul_mul_totS, mul_smul_totS, smul_sub,
      smul_smul, ← pow_add]
    match_scalars
    all_goals ring_nf
    all_goals try simp only [neg_one_mul_two]
  rw [expand, hA, smul_smul, ← pow_add, show m + m = 2 * m from by ring, neg_one_two_mul,
    one_smul, hMC]
  simp

name: Operad.dsq_eq_zero
statement:
theorem dsq_eq_zero (m : ℕ) (T : PieceS R P 1) (x : PieceS R P m)
    (hMC : (incS 1 T : TotS R P) * incS 1 T = 0) :
    brT 1 (1 + m) (incS 1 T) (brT 1 m (incS 1 T) (incS m x)) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [dsq_eq m T x hMC, associator_self_one, neg_zero]

name: Operad.NSSetOperad.Arr.mk_reindexS
statement:
lemma mk_reindexS {m n : ℕ} (h : m = n) (x : S m) :
    (⟨n, reindexS S h x⟩ : Arr S) = ⟨m, x⟩
proof:
:= by
  subst h
  rfl

name: Operad.NSSetOperad.Arr.mk_eq_mk_iff
statement: lemma mk_eq_mk_iff {n : ℕ} {x y : S n} : (⟨n, x⟩ : Arr S) = ⟨n, y⟩ ↔ x = y
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun h => eq_of_heq (Sigma.mk.inj h).2, fun h => h ▸ rfl⟩

name: Operad.NSSetOperad.Arr.mk_congr
proof:
:= by
  subst hb
  rfl

name: Operad.NSSetOperad.Arr.mk_comp
statement:
lemma mk_comp (a b : ℕ) {n : ℕ} (x : S (a + 1 + b)) (y : S n) :
    comp (⟨_, x⟩ : Arr S) a ⟨n, y⟩ = ⟨a + n + b, NSSetOperad.comp a b x y⟩
proof:
:= by
  unfold comp
  rw [dif_pos (by simp only; omega)]
  exact mk_congr a b _ (by simp only; omega) _ x y (fun b'' => NSSetOperad.comp a b'')

name: Operad.NSSetOperad.Arr.comp_fst
statement:
lemma comp_fst {X : Arr S} {a : ℕ} (h : a < X.1) (Y : Arr S) :
    (comp X a Y).1 = X.1 + Y.1 - 1
proof:
:= by
  unfold comp
  rw [dif_pos h]
  simp only
  omega

name: Operad.NSSetOperad.Arr.exists_mk
statement: lemma exists_mk (X : Arr S) {a : ℕ} (h : a < X.1) : ∃ (b : ℕ) (x : S (a + 1 + b)), X = ⟨_, x⟩
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨n, x⟩ := X
  obtain ⟨b, rfl⟩ : ∃ b, n = a + 1 + b := ⟨n - a - 1, by simp only at h; omega⟩
  exact ⟨b, x, rfl⟩

name: Operad.NSSetOperad.Arr.comp_one
statement: theorem comp_one {X : Arr S} {a : ℕ} (h : a < X.1) : comp X a one = X
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨b, x, rfl⟩ := exists_mk X h
  rw [one, mk_comp, NSSetOperad.comp_one_right]

name: Operad.NSSetOperad.Arr.one_comp
statement: theorem one_comp (Y : Arr S) : comp (one : Arr S) 0 Y = Y
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨n, y⟩ := Y
  rw [one, show (⟨1, NSSetOperad.one⟩ : Arr S) = ⟨0 + 1 + 0, NSSetOperad.one⟩ from rfl, mk_comp,
    ← mk_reindexS (show 0 + n + 0 = n by omega), NSSetOperad.comp_one_left]

name: Operad.NSSetOperad.Arr.comp_comp_nested
statement:
theorem comp_comp_nested {X Y : Arr S} (Z : Arr S) {a c : ℕ} (ha : a < X.1) (hc : c < Y.1) :
    comp (comp X a Y) (a + c) Z = comp X a (comp Y c Z)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨b, x, rfl⟩ := exists_mk X ha
  obtain ⟨d, y, rfl⟩ := exists_mk Y hc
  obtain ⟨p, z⟩ := Z
  rw [mk_comp, mk_comp, mk_comp]
  have e1 : a + (c + 1 + d) + b = a + c + 1 + (d + b) := by omega
  rw [← mk_reindexS e1, mk_comp,
    ← mk_reindexS (show a + c + p + (d + b) = a + (c + p + d) + b by omega),
    NSSetOperad.comp_assoc_seq]

name: Operad.NSSetOperad.Arr.comp_comp_disjoint
statement:
theorem comp_comp_disjoint {X : Arr S} (Y Z : Arr S) {a e : ℕ} (hae : a < e) (he : e < X.1) :
    comp (comp X a Y) (e + Y.1 - 1) Z = comp (comp X e Z) a Y
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨n, x⟩ := X
  obtain ⟨m, y⟩ := Y
  obtain ⟨p, z⟩ := Z
  simp only at he ⊢
  obtain ⟨b, rfl⟩ : ∃ b, e = a + 1 + b := ⟨e - a - 1, by omega⟩
  obtain ⟨c, rfl⟩ : ∃ c, n = a + 1 + b + 1 + c := ⟨n - (a + 1 + b) - 1, by omega⟩
  conv_lhs =>
    rw [← mk_reindexS (show a + 1 + b + 1 + c = a + 1 + (b + 1 + c) by omega) x, mk_comp,
      show a + 1 + b + m - 1 = a + m + b by omega,
      ← mk_reindexS (show a + m + (b + 1 + c) = a + m + b + 1 + c by omega), mk_comp,
      ← mk_reindexS (show a + m + b + p + c = a + m + (b + p + c) by omega)]
  conv_rhs =>
    rw [mk_comp, ← mk_reindexS (show a + 1 + b + p + c = a + 1 + (b + p + c) by omega), mk_comp]
  rw [NSSetOperad.comp_assoc_par]

name: Operad.NSSetOperad.Arr.one_fst
statement: @[simp] lemma one_fst : (one : Arr S).1 = 1
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.NSSetOperad.Arr.fst_comp_two
statement: private lemma fst_comp_two (g : S 2) (Y : Arr S) : (comp ⟨2, g⟩ 1 Y).1 = Y.1 + 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [comp_fst (by show 1 < 2; omega)]
  show 2 + Y.1 - 1 = Y.1 + 1
  omega

name: Operad.NSSetOperad.Arr.bin_fst
statement: @[simp] lemma bin_fst (g : S 2) (X Y : Arr S) : (bin g X Y).1 = X.1 + Y.1
proof:
:= by
  unfold bin
  rw [comp_fst (by rw [fst_comp_two]; omega), fst_comp_two]
  omega

name: Operad.NSSetOperad.Arr.comp_bin_left
statement:
theorem comp_bin_left (g : S 2) (X Y W : Arr S) {a : ℕ} (ha : a < X.1) :
    comp (bin g X Y) a W = bin g (comp X a W) Y
proof:
:= by
  have h := comp_comp_nested (X := comp ⟨2, g⟩ 1 Y) W (a := 0) (c := a)
    (by rw [fst_comp_two]; omega) ha
  rw [Nat.zero_add] at h
  exact h

name: Operad.NSSetOperad.Arr.comp_bin_right
statement:
theorem comp_bin_right (g : S 2) (X Y W : Arr S) {a c : ℕ} (h : a = X.1 + c) (hc : c < Y.1) :
    comp (bin g X Y) a W = bin g X (comp Y c W)
proof:
:= by
  subst h
  have h1 := comp_comp_disjoint (X := comp ⟨2, g⟩ 1 Y) X W (a := 0) (e := 1 + c)
    (by omega) (by rw [fst_comp_two]; omega)
  rw [show 1 + c + X.1 - 1 = X.1 + c by omega] at h1
  have h2 := comp_comp_nested (X := ⟨2, g⟩) W (a := 1) (c := c) (by show 1 < 2; omega) hc
  unfold bin
  rw [h1, h2]

name: Operad.NSSetOperad.Arr.bin_one_one
statement: theorem bin_one_one (g : S 2) : bin g one one = ⟨2, g⟩
proof:
:= by
  unfold bin
  rw [comp_one (a := 1) (by show 1 < 2; omega), comp_one (by show 0 < 2; omega)]

name: Operad.NSSetOperad.Arr.subst_leftComb
statement:
lemma subst_leftComb (p q : S 2) (X Y Z : Arr S) :
    comp (comp (comp (leftComb p q) 2 Z) 1 Y) 0 X = bin p (bin q X Y) Z
proof:
:= by
  unfold leftComb
  rw [comp_bin_right p (bin q one one) one Z (c := 0) (by simp) (by simp), one_comp,
    comp_bin_left p (bin q one one) Z Y (by simp),
    comp_bin_right q one one Y (c := 0) (by simp) (by simp), one_comp,
    comp_bin_left p (bin q one Y) Z X (by simp only [bin_fst, one_fst]; omega),
    comp_bin_left q one Y X (by simp), one_comp]

name: Operad.NSSetOperad.Arr.subst_rightComb
statement:
lemma subst_rightComb (p q : S 2) (X Y Z : Arr S) :
    comp (comp (comp (rightComb p q) 2 Z) 1 Y) 0 X = bin p X (bin q Y Z)
proof:
:= by
  unfold rightComb
  rw [comp_bin_right p one (bin q one one) Z (c := 1) (by simp) (by simp),
    comp_bin_right q one one Z (c := 0) (by simp) (by simp), one_comp,
    comp_bin_right p one (bin q one Z) Y (c := 0) (by simp)
      (by simp only [bin_fst, one_fst]; omega),
    comp_bin_left q one Z Y (by simp), one_comp,
    comp_bin_left p one (bin q Y Z) X (by simp), one_comp]

name: Operad.NSSetOperad.Arr.bin_bin_of_left_right
statement:
theorem bin_bin_of_left_right {p q p' q' : S 2} (h : leftComb p q = rightComb p' q')
    (X Y Z : Arr S) : bin p (bin q X Y) Z = bin p' X (bin q' Y Z)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← subst_leftComb, ← subst_rightComb, h]

name: Operad.NSSetOperad.Arr.bin_right_of
statement:
theorem bin_right_of {p q p' q' : S 2} (h : rightComb p q = rightComb p' q') (X Y Z : Arr S) :
    bin p X (bin q Y Z) = bin p' X (bin q' Y Z)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← subst_rightComb, ← subst_rightComb, h]

name: Operad.NSSetOperad.Arr.bin_left_of
statement:
theorem bin_left_of {p q p' q' : S 2} (h : leftComb p q = leftComb p' q') (X Y Z : Arr S) :
    bin p (bin q X Y) Z = bin p' (bin q' X Y) Z
proof:
:= by
  rw [← subst_leftComb, ← subst_leftComb, h]

name: Operad.NSSetOperad.Arr.leftComb_eq
statement: lemma leftComb_eq (p q : S 2) : leftComb p q = ⟨0 + 2 + 1, NSSetOperad.comp 0 1 p q⟩
proof:
:= by
  unfold leftComb
  rw [bin_one_one]
  unfold bin
  rw [comp_one (by show 1 < 2; omega)]
  exact mk_comp 0 1 p q

name: Operad.NSSetOperad.Arr.rightComb_eq
statement: lemma rightComb_eq (p q : S 2) : rightComb p q = ⟨1 + 2 + 0, NSSetOperad.comp 1 0 p q⟩
proof:
:= by
  unfold rightComb
  rw [bin_one_one]
  unfold bin
  rw [comp_one (by rw [fst_comp_two]; omega)]
  exact mk_comp 1 0 p q

name: Operad.NSSetOperad.Arr.rcomb_nil
statement: @[simp] lemma rcomb_nil : rcomb ([] : List (S 2)) = one
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.NSSetOperad.Arr.rcomb_cons
statement: lemma rcomb_cons (g : S 2) (l : List (S 2)) : rcomb (g :: l) = bin g one (rcomb l)
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.NSSetOperad.Arr.rcomb_fst
statement: @[simp] lemma rcomb_fst (l : List (S 2)) : (rcomb l).1 = l.length + 1
proof:
:= by
  induction l with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons g l ih => rw [rcomb_cons, bin_fst, ih, one_fst, List.length_cons]; omega

name: Operad.NSSetOperad.Arr.rcomb_singleton
statement: lemma rcomb_singleton (g : S 2) : rcomb [g] = ⟨2, g⟩
proof: := bin_one_one g

name: Operad.NSSetOperad.Arr.isRComb_one
statement: lemma isRComb_one : IsRComb G one
proof: := ⟨[], by simp, rfl⟩

name: Operad.NSSetOperad.Arr.isRComb_of_mem
statement: lemma isRComb_of_mem {g : S 2} (hg : g ∈ G) : IsRComb G ⟨2, g⟩
proof:
:=
  ⟨[g], by simpa using hg, (rcomb_singleton g).symm⟩

name: Operad.NSSetOperad.Arr.isRComb_bin
statement:
theorem isRComb_bin (hG : RotClosed G) {g : S 2} (hg : g ∈ G) {X Y : Arr S} (hX : IsRComb G X)
    (hY : IsRComb G Y) : IsRComb G (bin g X Y)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨l, hl, rfl⟩ := hX
  obtain ⟨m, hm, rfl⟩ := hY
  induction l generalizing g with
  | nil => exact ⟨g :: m, List.forall_mem_cons.2 ⟨hg, hm⟩, rfl⟩
  | cons h l ih =>
    obtain ⟨g', hg', h', hh', e⟩ := hG g hg h (List.forall_mem_cons.1 hl).1
    obtain ⟨k, hk, hk'⟩ := ih hh' (List.forall_mem_cons.1 hl).2
    refine ⟨g' :: k, List.forall_mem_cons.2 ⟨hg', hk⟩, ?_⟩
    rw [rcomb_cons, bin_bin_of_left_right e, hk', rcomb_cons]

name: Operad.NSSetOperad.Arr.isRComb_comp
statement:
theorem isRComb_comp (hG : RotClosed G) {X Y : Arr S} (hX : IsRComb G X) (hY : IsRComb G Y)
    {a : ℕ} (ha : a < X.1) : IsRComb G (comp X a Y)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨l, hl, rfl⟩ := hX
  induction l generalizing a with
  | nil =>
    obtain rfl : a = 0 := by simp only [rcomb_fst, List.length_nil] at ha; omega
    rw [rcomb_nil, one_comp]
    exact hY
  | cons g l ih =>
    have hg := (List.forall_mem_cons.1 hl).1
    have hl' := (List.forall_mem_cons.1 hl).2
    simp only [rcomb_fst, List.length_cons] at ha
    rw [rcomb_cons]
    cases a with
    | zero =>
      rw [comp_bin_left _ _ _ _ (by simp), one_comp]
      exact isRComb_bin hG hg hY ⟨l, hl', rfl⟩
    | succ a =>
      rw [comp_bin_right _ _ _ _ (c := a) (by simp only [one_fst]; omega)
        (by simp only [rcomb_fst]; omega)]
      obtain ⟨k, hk, hk'⟩ := ih hl' (a := a) (by simp only [rcomb_fst]; omega)
      exact ⟨g :: k, List.forall_mem_cons.2 ⟨hg, hk⟩, by rw [hk', rcomb_cons]⟩

name: Operad.NSSetOperad.Arr.map_fst
statement: @[simp] lemma map_fst (φ : NSSetOperadHom S T) (X : Arr S) : (map φ X).1 = X.1
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.NSSetOperad.Arr.map_mk
statement:
lemma map_mk (φ : NSSetOperadHom S T) {n : ℕ} (x : S n) :
    map φ ⟨n, x⟩ = ⟨n, φ.app n x⟩
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.NSSetOperad.Arr.map_one
statement: @[simp] lemma map_one (φ : NSSetOperadHom S T) : map φ one = one
proof:
:= by
  rw [one, map_mk, φ.app_one]
  rfl

name: Operad.NSSetOperad.Arr.map_comp
statement:
@[simp] lemma map_comp (φ : NSSetOperadHom S T) (X : Arr S) (a : ℕ) (Y : Arr S) :
    map φ (comp X a Y) = comp (map φ X) a (map φ Y)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases h : a < X.1
  · obtain ⟨b, x, rfl⟩ := exists_mk X h
    obtain ⟨n, y⟩ := Y
    rw [mk_comp, map_mk, map_mk, map_mk, mk_comp, φ.app_comp]
  · have h' : ¬ a < (map φ X).1 := h
    unfold comp
    rw [dif_neg h, dif_neg h']

name: Operad.NSSetOperad.Arr.map_bin
statement:
@[simp] lemma map_bin (φ : NSSetOperadHom S T) (g : S 2) (X Y : Arr S) :
    map φ (bin g X Y) = bin (φ.app 2 g) (map φ X) (map φ Y)
proof:
:= by
  unfold bin
  rw [map_comp, map_comp]
  rfl

name: Operad.NSSetOperad.Arr.map_rcomb
statement:
@[simp] lemma map_rcomb (φ : NSSetOperadHom S T) (l : List (S 2)) :
    map φ (rcomb l) = rcomb (l.map (φ.app 2))
proof:
:= by
  induction l with
  | nil => exact map_one φ
  | cons g l ih => rw [rcomb_cons, map_bin, map_one, ih, List.map_cons, rcomb_cons]

name: Operad.NSSetOperad.Arr.pres_induction
statement:
theorem pres_induction {P : Arr (NSPres T ρ) → Prop} (h_one : P one)
    (h_gen : ∀ (n : ℕ) (g : T n), P ⟨n, NSPres.gen g⟩)
    (h_comp : ∀ (X : Arr (NSPres T ρ)) (a : ℕ) (Y : Arr (NSPres T ρ)), a < X.1 → P X → P Y →
      P (comp X a Y))
    (X : Arr (NSPres T ρ)) : P X
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨n, x⟩ := X
  obtain ⟨s, rfl⟩ := NSPres.mk_surjective x
  induction s with
  | one => exact h_one
  | gen g => exact h_gen _ g
  | comp a b s t ihs iht =>
    have := h_comp _ a _ (by show a < a + 1 + b; omega) ihs iht
    rwa [mk_comp, NSPres.comp_mk] at this

name: Operad.NSSetOperad.Arr.pres_isRComb
statement:
theorem pres_isRComb {G : Set (NSPres T ρ 2)} (hG : RotClosed G)
    (hgen : ∀ (n : ℕ) (g : T n), IsRComb G ⟨n, NSPres.gen g⟩) (X : Arr (NSPres T ρ)) :
    IsRComb G X
proof:
:=
  pres_induction isRComb_one hgen (fun _ _ _ ha hX hY => isRComb_comp hG hX hY ha) X

name: Operad.GrOperad.nsc_sub_left
statement:
lemma GrOperad.nsc_sub_left (a b : ℕ) {n : ℕ} (x x' : P (Fin (a + 1 + b))) (y : P (Fin n)) :
    GrOperad.nsc R a b (x - x') y = GrOperad.nsc R a b x y - GrOperad.nsc R a b x' y
proof:
:= by
  simp only [GrOperad.nsc, map_sub, LinearMap.sub_apply]

name: Operad.GrOperadHom.app_nsc
statement:
lemma GrOperadHom.app_nsc (φ : GrOperadHom R P Q) (a b : ℕ) {n : ℕ} (x : P (Fin (a + 1 + b)))
    (y : P (Fin n)) :
    φ.app _ (GrOperad.nsc R a b x y) = GrOperad.nsc R a b (φ.app _ x) (φ.app _ y)
proof:
:= by
  rw [GrOperad.nsc, φ.app_map, φ.app_comp]
  rfl

name: Operad.GrOperad.par_nsc
proof:
:= by
  rw [GrOperad.nsc, ← GrOperad.map_par]
  congr 1
  conv_lhs => rw [← hx, ← hy]
  rw [GrOperad.comp_par, hx, hy]

name: Operad.EndGr.sv_sub
statement: lemma sv_sub {n : ℕ} (F G : EndGr R V (Fin n)) : sv (F - G) = sv F - sv G
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.EndGr.sv_add
statement: lemma sv_add {n : ℕ} (F G : EndGr R V (Fin n)) : sv (F + G) = sv F + sv G
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.EndGr.ext_sv
statement: lemma ext_sv {n : ℕ} {F G : EndGr R V (Fin n)} (h : sv F = sv G) : F = G
proof:
:=
  ext (LinOrd.std n) h

name: Operad.EndGr.eq_zero_iff_sv
statement: lemma eq_zero_iff_sv {n : ℕ} (F : EndGr R V (Fin n)) : F = 0 ↔ sv F = 0
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun h => h ▸ rfl, fun h => ext_sv h⟩

name: Operad.EndGr.sv_par
statement:
lemma sv_par {n : ℕ} (b : Bool) (F : EndGr R V (Fin n)) :
    sv (GrOperad.par (R := R) b F) = parML R V b (sv F)
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.EndGr.sv_nsc
statement:
lemma sv_nsc (a b : ℕ) {n : ℕ} (F : EndGr R V (Fin (a + 1 + b))) (G : EndGr R V (Fin n)) :
    sv (GrOperad.nsc R a b F G) = EndOp.mapL R V (insertEquiv a b n)
      (kcomp R V (LinOrd.std _) (⟨a, by omega⟩ : Fin (a + 1 + b)) (sv F) (sv G))
proof:
:= by
  have h : LinOrd.map (insertEquiv a b n).symm (LinOrd.std (a + n + b))
      = LinOrd.comp (⟨a, by omega⟩ : Fin (a + 1 + b)) (LinOrd.std _) (LinOrd.std n) := by
    rw [← LinOrd.map_insertEquiv_comp_std a b n, lo_map_symm_map]
  show EndOp.mapL R V (insertEquiv a b n) (compFam _ F G
    (LinOrd.map (insertEquiv a b n).symm (LinOrd.std (a + n + b)))) = _
  rw [h, compFam_comp]
  rfl
