    have hnL : n ∈ L₁.erase a ∪ L₂ := Finset.mem_union_left _ (Finset.mem_erase.2 ⟨hna, hn₁⟩)
    have hfL : fL (⟨a, h.mem⟩ : NS L₁) (canon h) (opos (⟨n, hn₁⟩ : NS L₁)) =
        posIn (L₁.erase a ∪ L₂) n := by
      rw [fL, if_neg hne, posL_opos _ _ ⟨⟨n, hn₁⟩, fun e => hna (congrArg Subtype.val e)⟩,
        posIn_eq_opos hnL]
      rfl
    have hB : 0 < Fintype.card (NS L₂) := Fintype.card_pos_iff.2 ⟨⟨a, h.memT⟩⟩
    rw [Function.comp_apply, posIn_eq_opos hn₁, hfL, Function.update_of_ne hna,
      Function.update_of_ne (by
        rw [← hfL, fL, if_neg hne]
        exact posL_ne_posR (i := (⟨a, h.mem⟩ : NS L₁)) (e := canon h) (opos_lt_card _) hne hB)]
    rfl

name: Operad.STree.weight_relabel
statement: lemma weight_relabel (f : ℕ → ℕ) (t : STree E) : (t.relabel f).weight = t.weight
proof:
:= by
  rw [relabel, weight_subst]
  simp

name: Operad.STree.relabel_posIn_range
statement:
lemma relabel_posIn_range {t : STree E} {N : ℕ} {L : Finset ℕ} (hL : lset t = L)
    (hN : L = Finset.range N) : t.relabel (posIn L) = t
proof:
:= by
  refine relabel_id fun n hn => ?_
  have hnL : n ∈ L := hL ▸ mem_lset.2 hn
  rw [posIn_eq_opos hnL, opos_ns_range hN]

name: Operad.STree.Valid.cut
statement: lemma Valid.cut : Valid (node g (Function.update c l (leaf (c l).first)))
proof:
:= by
  have hfirst : ∀ j, (Function.update c l (leaf (c l).first) j).first = (c j).first := fun j => by
    by_cases hj : j = l
    · subst hj
      rw [Function.update_self, first_leaf]
    · rw [Function.update_of_ne hj]
  refine ⟨⟨hv.shuffle.pos, fun j => ?_, fun i j hij => ?_⟩, ?_⟩
  · by_cases hj : j = l
    · subst hj
      rw [Function.update_self]
      exact isShuffle_leaf _
    · rw [Function.update_of_ne hj]
      exact hv.shuffle.child j
  · simp only [hfirst]
    exact hv.shuffle.mono hij
  · rw [labels_node]
    refine nodup_sum_fin _ (fun j => ?_) fun i j hij => ?_
    · by_cases hj : j = l
      · subst hj
        rw [Function.update_self, labels_leaf]
        exact Multiset.nodup_singleton _
      · rw [Function.update_of_ne hj]
        exact nodup_of_node hv.nodup j
    · have key : ∀ j, ∀ n ∈ (Function.update c l (leaf (c l).first) j).labels, n ∈ (c j).labels :=
        fun j n hn => by
          by_cases hj : j = l
          · subst hj
            rw [Function.update_self, labels_leaf, Multiset.mem_singleton] at hn
            rw [hn]
            exact first_mem (hv.shuffle.child j)
          · rwa [Function.update_of_ne hj] at hn
      exact Multiset.disjoint_left.2 fun hn hn' =>
        Multiset.disjoint_left.1 (disjoint_of_node hv.nodup hij) (key i _ hn) (key j _ hn')

name: Operad.STree.Valid.subst_cut
statement:
lemma Valid.subst_cut : (node g (Function.update c l (leaf (c l).first))).subst
    (Function.update leaf (c l).first (c l)) = node g c
proof:
:= by
  rw [subst_node]
  congr 1
  funext j
  by_cases hj : j = l
  · subst hj
    rw [Function.update_self, subst_leaf', Function.update_self]
  · rw [Function.update_of_ne hj]
    conv_rhs => rw [← subst_leaf (c j)]
    refine subst_congr _ fun n hn => Function.update_of_ne ?_ _ _
    rintro rfl
    exact not_mem_of_node hv.nodup hj hn (first_mem (hv.shuffle.child l))

name: Operad.STree.Valid.graftOK_cut
statement:
lemma Valid.graftOK_cut :
    GraftOK (lset (node g (Function.update c l (leaf (c l).first)))) (lset (c l)) (c l).first where
  mem
proof:
:= mem_lset_node.2 ⟨l, by
    rw [Function.update_self, lset_leaf]
    exact Finset.mem_singleton_self _⟩
  memT := mem_lset.2 (first_mem (hv.shuffle.child l))
  le n hn := first_le (hv.shuffle.child l) n (mem_lset.1 hn)
  disj := by
    refine Finset.disjoint_left.2 fun n hn hn' => ?_
    obtain ⟨hna, hn⟩ := Finset.mem_erase.1 hn
    obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := mem_lset_node.1 hn
    by_cases hjl : j = l
    · subst hjl
      rw [Function.update_self, lset_leaf, Finset.mem_singleton] at hj
      exact hna hj
    · rw [Function.update_of_ne hjl] at hj
      exact not_mem_of_node hv.nodup hjl (mem_lset.1 hj) (mem_lset.1 hn')

name: Operad.STree.weight_cut
statement:
lemma weight_cut (hl : ∀ a, c l ≠ leaf a) :
    (node g (Function.update c l (leaf (c l).first))).weight < (node g c).weight
proof:
:= by
  rw [weight_node, weight_node]
  have hpos : 0 < (c l).weight := by
    rcases h : c l with a | ⟨e, d⟩
    · exact absurd h (hl a)
    · rw [weight_node]
      omega
  have h1 : (c l).weight + ∑ j ∈ Finset.univ.erase l, (c j).weight = ∑ j, (c j).weight :=
    Finset.add_sum_erase Finset.univ (fun j => (c j).weight) (Finset.mem_univ l)
  have h2 : (Function.update c l (leaf (c l).first) l).weight +
      ∑ j ∈ Finset.univ.erase l, (Function.update c l (leaf (c l).first) j).weight =
      ∑ j, (Function.update c l (leaf (c l).first) j).weight :=
    Finset.add_sum_erase Finset.univ
      (fun j => (Function.update c l (leaf (c l).first) j).weight) (Finset.mem_univ l)
  have h3 : ∑ j ∈ Finset.univ.erase l, (Function.update c l (leaf (c l).first) j).weight =
      ∑ j ∈ Finset.univ.erase l, (c j).weight :=
    Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j hj => by rw [Function.update_of_ne (Finset.ne_of_mem_erase hj)]
  rw [h3] at h2
  simp only [Function.update_self, weight_leaf, zero_add] at h2
  omega

name: Operad.FreeSh.single_eq_map
statement:
lemma single_eq_map {A A' : Type} [Fintype A] [LinearOrder A] [Fintype A'] [LinearOrder A']
    (ρ : A' ≃o A) (X : SMono E (Finset.range (Fintype.card A')))
    (m : SMono E (Finset.range (Fintype.card A))) (h : X.1 = m.1) :
    (Finsupp.single m 1 : FreeSh R E A) =
      ShuffleOperad.map (R := R) (P := FreeSh R E) ρ (Finsupp.single X 1)
proof:
:= by
  show _ = mapM ρ _
  rw [mapM_single]
  congr 1
  exact Subtype.ext h.symm

name: Operad.FreeSh.corolla_leaves
statement:
lemma corolla_leaves {k n : ℕ} {g : E k} {c : Fin k → STree E} (hs : (node g c).IsShuffle)
    (hl : (node g c).labels = (Finset.range n).val) (hc : ∀ j, ∃ b, c j = leaf b) :
    k = n ∧ ∀ j, c j = leaf j.1
proof:
:= by
  choose b hb using hc
  have hmem : ∀ j, b j < n := fun j => by
    have h1 : b j ∈ (c j).labels := by
      rw [hb j, labels_leaf]
      exact Multiset.mem_singleton_self _
    have : b j ∈ (node g c).labels := mem_labels_node.2 ⟨j, h1⟩
    rw [hl] at this
    exact Finset.mem_range.1 this
  have hmono : StrictMono b := fun i j hij => by
    have := hs.mono hij
    simp only [hb, first_leaf] at this
    exact this
  have hsurj : ∀ m < n, ∃ j, b j = m := fun m hm => by
    have : m ∈ (node g c).labels := by rw [hl]; exact Finset.mem_range.2 hm
    obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := mem_labels_node.1 this
    rw [hb j, labels_leaf, Multiset.mem_singleton] at hj
    exact ⟨j, hj.symm⟩
  let F : Fin k ≃o NS (Finset.range n) := StrictMono.orderIsoOfSurjective
    (fun j => ⟨b j, Finset.mem_range.2 (hmem j)⟩) (fun i j hij => hmono hij) fun y => by
      obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := hsurj y.1 (Finset.mem_range.1 y.2)
      exact ⟨j, Subtype.ext hj⟩
  have hbj : ∀ j, b j = j.1 := fun j => by
    have := opos_orderIso F j
    rw [opos_fin, opos_ns_range rfl] at this
    exact this
  refine ⟨?_, fun j => by rw [hb j, hbj j]⟩
  have := Fintype.card_congr F.toEquiv
  rwa [Fintype.card_fin, Fintype.card_coe, Finset.card_range] at this

name: Operad.FreeSh.hom_ext
statement:
theorem hom_ext {ψ₁ ψ₂ : ShuffleOperadHom R (FreeSh R E) P}
    (h : ∀ k (hk : 0 < k) (g : E k), ψ₁.app (Fin k) (Finsupp.single (genM hk g) 1) =
      ψ₂.app (Fin k) (Finsupp.single (genM hk g) 1))
    (A : Type) [Fintype A] [LinearOrder A] (x : FreeSh R E A) : ψ₁.app A x = ψ₂.app A x
proof:
:= by
  have key : ∀ n (A : Type) [Fintype A] [LinearOrder A]
      (m : SMono E (Finset.range (Fintype.card A))), m.1.weight ≤ n →
      ψ₁.app A (Finsupp.single m 1) = ψ₂.app A (Finsupp.single m 1) := by
    intro n
    induction n using Nat.strong_induction_on with
    | _ n ih =>
    intro A _ _ m hmn
    obtain ⟨t, hts, htl⟩ := m
    cases t with
    | leaf a =>
      have hcard : Fintype.card Unit = Fintype.card A := by
        have := congrArg Multiset.card htl
        rw [labels_leaf, Multiset.card_singleton, Finset.card_val, Finset.card_range] at this
        rw [Fintype.card_unit, this]
      have ha : a = 0 := by
        have : a ∈ (Finset.range (Fintype.card A)).val := by
          rw [← htl, labels_leaf]
          exact Multiset.mem_singleton_self a
        rw [← hcard, Fintype.card_unit] at this
        simpa using this
      subst ha
      rw [single_eq_map (isoOfCard hcard) oneM _ rfl, ψ₁.app_map, ψ₂.app_map]
      exact congrArg _ (ψ₁.app_one.trans ψ₂.app_one.symm)
    | @node k g c =>
      have hv : Valid (node g c) := ⟨hts, by rw [htl]; exact (Finset.range _).nodup⟩
      by_cases hleaf : ∀ j, ∃ b, c j = leaf b
      · obtain ⟨hk, hc⟩ := corolla_leaves hts htl hleaf
        have hcard : Fintype.card (Fin k) = Fintype.card A := by rw [Fintype.card_fin, hk]
        have htree : (genM hts.pos g).1 = node g c := by
          show node g (fun j => leaf j.1) = node g c
          congr 1
          funext j
          exact (hc j).symm
        rw [single_eq_map (isoOfCard hcard) (genM hts.pos g) _ htree, ψ₁.app_map, ψ₂.app_map,
          h k hts.pos g]
      · push Not at hleaf
        obtain ⟨l, hl⟩ := hleaf
        have hs₀ := hv.cut l
        have ht₀ := hv.child l
        have hOK := hv.graftOK_cut l
        set S := normalize hs₀ rfl
        set T := normalize ht₀ rfl
        have hL : (lset (node g (Function.update c l (leaf (c l).first)))).erase (c l).first ∪
            lset (c l) = Finset.range (Fintype.card A) := by
          rw [← lset_subst_update hOK.mem, hv.subst_cut l]
          exact lset_smono ⟨node g c, hts, htl⟩
        have htree : (graft (isShuffle_canon hOK) S T).1 = node g c := by
          rw [graft_canon_normalize, hv.subst_cut l]
          exact relabel_posIn_range (by rw [← lset_subst_update hOK.mem, hv.subst_cut l]) hL
        have hcard : Fintype.card (NS ((lset (node g (Function.update c l
            (leaf (c l).first)))).erase (c l).first ∪ lset (c l))) = Fintype.card A := by
          rw [Fintype.card_coe, hL, Finset.card_range]
        have hS : S.1.weight < n := by
          show (relabel _ _).weight < n
          rw [weight_relabel]
          exact (weight_cut l hl).trans_le hmn
        have hT : T.1.weight < n := by
          show (relabel _ _).weight < n
          rw [weight_relabel]
          exact (weight_lt_node g c l).trans_le hmn
        rw [single_eq_map (isoOfCard hcard) _ _ htree, ψ₁.app_map, ψ₂.app_map]
        congr 1
        have hcomp : (Finsupp.single (graft (isShuffle_canon hOK) S T) 1 : FreeSh R E _) =
            ShuffleOperad.comp (R := R) (P := FreeSh R E) _ (canon hOK) (isShuffle_canon hOK)
              (Finsupp.single S 1) (Finsupp.single T 1) := by
          show _ = bil (graft (isShuffle_canon hOK)) _ _
          rw [bil_single, mul_one]
        rw [hcomp, ψ₁.app_comp, ψ₂.app_comp, ih _ hS _ S le_rfl, ih _ hT _ T le_rfl]
  induction x using Finsupp.induction_linear with
  | zero => simp
  | add x x' hx hx' => rw [map_add, map_add, hx, hx']
  | single m r =>
    rw [← mul_one r, ← smul_eq_mul, ← Finsupp.smul_single, map_smul, map_smul, key _ A m le_rfl]

name: Operad.FreeSh.eq_lift
statement:
theorem eq_lift (φ : ∀ k, E k → P (Fin k)) {ψ : ShuffleOperadHom R (FreeSh R E) P}
    (h : ∀ k (hk : 0 < k) (g : E k), ψ.app (Fin k) (Finsupp.single (genM hk g) 1) = φ k g)
    (A : Type) [Fintype A] [LinearOrder A] (x : FreeSh R E A) :
    ψ.app A x = (lift R P φ).app A x
proof:
:=
  hom_ext (fun k hk g => (h k hk g).trans (lift_gen φ hk g).symm) A x

name: Operad.ShuffleBar.substRel_mem_supported
proof:
:=
  Submodule.sum_mem _ fun σ _ => Submodule.smul_mem _ _ (Finsupp.single_mem_supported K _
    ⟨hx.substBar h σ, perm_labels_substBar hx.shuffle hx.nodup h (mono_shape σ).2.1⟩)

name: Operad.ShuffleBar.J_inf_supported
statement:
theorem J_inf_supported (R : Submodule K (Mono E 3 → K)) (S : Set (BarTree E))
    (hS : ∀ x y : BarTree E, Valid x → Valid y → x.labels.Perm y.labels → x ∈ S → y ∈ S) :
    J K R ⊓ Finsupp.supported K K S = Submodule.span K
      {v | ∃ x p s r, Valid x ∧ x ∈ S ∧ IsUncut x p s ∧ r ∈ R ∧ v = substRel K x p s r}
proof:
:= by
  classical
  apply le_antisymm
  · rintro v ⟨hvJ, hvS⟩
    have key : ∀ w ∈ J K R, Finsupp.filter (· ∈ S) w ∈ Submodule.span K
        {v | ∃ x p s r, Valid x ∧ x ∈ S ∧ IsUncut x p s ∧ r ∈ R ∧ v = substRel K x p s r} := by
      intro w hw
      refine Submodule.span_induction (p := fun w _ => Finsupp.filter (· ∈ S) w ∈ _) ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_
        hw
      · rintro _ ⟨x, p, s, r, hx, hp, hr, rfl⟩
        have hsupp : ∀ y, substRel K x p s r y ≠ 0 → Valid y ∧ y.labels.Perm x.labels :=
          fun y hy => substRel_mem_supported K hx hp r (Finsupp.mem_support_iff.2 hy)
        by_cases hxS : x ∈ S
        · rw [(Finsupp.filter_eq_self_iff _ _).2 fun y hy => hS x y hx (hsupp y hy).1
            (hsupp y hy).2.symm hxS]
          exact Submodule.subset_span ⟨x, p, s, r, hx, hxS, hp, hr, rfl⟩
        · rw [(Finsupp.filter_eq_zero_iff _ _).2 fun y hyS => by
            by_contra hy
            exact hxS (hS y x (hsupp y hy).1 hx (hsupp y hy).2 hyS)]
          exact zero_mem _
      · beta_reduce
        rw [Finsupp.filter_zero]
        exact zero_mem _
      · intro a b _ _ ha hb
        beta_reduce at ha hb ⊢
        rw [Finsupp.filter_add]
        exact add_mem ha hb
      · intro a w _ hw
        beta_reduce at hw ⊢
        rw [Finsupp.filter_smul]
        exact Submodule.smul_mem _ a hw
    have := key v hvJ
    rwa [(Finsupp.filter_eq_self_iff _ _).2 fun y hy => hvS (Finsupp.mem_support_iff.2 hy)] at this
  · rw [Submodule.span_le]
    rintro _ ⟨x, p, s, r, hx, hxS, hp, hr, rfl⟩
    refine ⟨Submodule.subset_span ⟨x, p, s, r, hx, hp, hr, rfl⟩, fun y hy => ?_⟩
    have := substRel_mem_supported K hx hp r hy
    exact hS x y hx this.1 this.2.symm hxS

name: Operad.compFin_sum_left
statement:
lemma compFin_sum_left {m n : ℕ} {ι : Type w} (s : Finset ι) (i : Fin m) (f : ι → P m)
    (β : P n) :
    compFin (R := R) i (∑ x ∈ s, f x) β = ∑ x ∈ s, compFin (R := R) i (f x) β
proof:
:=
  map_sum (compFinLeftHom (R := R) i β) f s

name: Operad.compFin_sum_right
statement:
lemma compFin_sum_right {m n : ℕ} {ι : Type w} (s : Finset ι) (i : Fin m) (α : P m)
    (g : ι → P n) :
    compFin (R := R) i α (∑ x ∈ s, g x) = ∑ x ∈ s, compFin (R := R) i α (g x)
proof:
:=
  map_sum (compFinRightHom (R := R) i α) g s

name: Operad.star_star_left
statement:
lemma star_star_left {j k l : ℕ} (α : P (j + 1)) (β : P (k + 1)) (γ : P (l + 1)) :
    star (R := R) (star (R := R) α β) γ
      = ∑ i' : Fin (j + k + 1), ∑ i : Fin (j + 1),
          compFin (R := R) i' (compFin (R := R) i α β) γ
proof:
:= by
  rw [star_def]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i' _ => ?_
  rw [star_def]
  exact map_sum (compFinLeftHom (R := R) i' γ) _ _

name: Operad.star_star_right
statement:
lemma star_star_right {j k l : ℕ} (α : P (j + 1)) (β : P (k + 1)) (γ : P (l + 1)) :
    star (R := R) α (star (R := R) β γ)
      = ∑ i : Fin (j + 1), ∑ i'' : Fin (k + 1),
          compFin (R := R) i α (compFin (R := R) i'' β γ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [star_def]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
  rw [star_def]
  exact map_sum (compFinRightHom (R := R) i α) _ _

name: Operad.mem_nested
statement:
@[simp] lemma mem_nested {j k : ℕ} (i : Fin (j + 1)) (i' : Fin (j + k + 1)) :
    i' ∈ nested (k := k) i ↔ ∃ i'' : Fin (k + 1), (i' : ℕ) = (i : ℕ) + (i'' : ℕ)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro h
    obtain ⟨i'', -, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_map.1 h
    exact ⟨i'', rfl⟩
  · rintro ⟨i'', hi''⟩
    exact Finset.mem_map.2 ⟨i'', Finset.mem_univ _, Fin.ext hi''.symm⟩

name: Operad.sum_nested
statement:
lemma sum_nested {j k l : ℕ} (α : P (j + 1)) (β : P (k + 1)) (γ : P (l + 1))
    (i : Fin (j + 1)) :
    reindex R P (by omega)
        (∑ i' ∈ nested (k := k) i, compFin (R := R) i' (compFin (R := R) i α β) γ)
      = ∑ i'' : Fin (k + 1), compFin (R := R) i α (compFin (R := R) i'' β γ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [nested, Finset.sum_map]
  rw [map_sum]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i'' _ => ?_
  exact compFin_assoc_seq i i'' α β γ

name: Operad.star_star_left_split
statement:
lemma star_star_left_split {j k l : ℕ} (α : P (j + 1)) (β : P (k + 1)) (γ : P (l + 1)) :
    star (R := R) (star (R := R) α β) γ
      = reindex R P (by omega) (star (R := R) α (star (R := R) β γ))
        + disjointPart (R := R) α β γ
proof:
:= by
  have key : ∀ i : Fin (j + 1),
      (∑ i' : Fin (j + k + 1), compFin (R := R) i' (compFin (R := R) i α β) γ)
        = reindex R P (by omega)
            (∑ i'' : Fin (k + 1), compFin (R := R) i α (compFin (R := R) i'' β γ))
          + ∑ i' ∈ (nested (k := k) i)ᶜ,
              compFin (R := R) i' (compFin (R := R) i α β) γ := by
    intro i
    rw [← Finset.sum_add_sum_compl (nested (k := k) i)]
    congr 1
    rw [← sum_nested α β γ i, reindex_reindex, reindex_self]
  rw [star_star_left, Finset.sum_comm, disjointPart,
    Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => key i, Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  congr 1
  rw [star_star_right]
  exact (map_sum _ _ _).symm

name: Operad.not_mem_nested_iff
statement:
lemma not_mem_nested_iff {j k : ℕ} (i : Fin (j + 1)) (i' : Fin (j + k + 1)) :
    i' ∉ nested (k := k) i ↔ (i' : ℕ) < (i : ℕ) ∨ (i : ℕ) + k < (i' : ℕ)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [mem_nested, not_exists]
  constructor
  · intro h
    by_contra hc
    push Not at hc
    exact h ⟨(i' : ℕ) - (i : ℕ), by omega⟩
      (by show (i' : ℕ) = (i : ℕ) + ((i' : ℕ) - (i : ℕ)); omega)
  · rintro (h | h) i'' hi''
    · have := i''.isLt; omega
    · have := i''.isLt; omega

name: Operad.mem_before
statement:
@[simp] lemma mem_before {j k : ℕ} (i : Fin (j + 1)) (i' : Fin (j + k + 1)) :
    i' ∈ before (k := k) i ↔ (i' : ℕ) < (i : ℕ)
proof: := by simp [before]

name: Operad.mem_after
statement:
@[simp] lemma mem_after {j k : ℕ} (i : Fin (j + 1)) (i' : Fin (j + k + 1)) :
    i' ∈ after (k := k) i ↔ (i : ℕ) + k < (i' : ℕ)
proof: := by simp [after]

name: Operad.sum_compl_nested
statement:
lemma sum_compl_nested {j k : ℕ} {M : Type w} [AddCommMonoid M] (i : Fin (j + 1))
    (f : Fin (j + k + 1) → M) :
    ∑ i' ∈ (nested (k := k) i)ᶜ, f i'
      = (∑ i' ∈ before (k := k) i, f i') + ∑ i' ∈ after (k := k) i, f i'
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Finset.sum_filter_add_sum_filter_not ((nested (k := k) i)ᶜ)
      fun i' => (i' : ℕ) < (i : ℕ)]
  congr 1
  · refine Finset.sum_congr ?_ fun _ _ => rfl
    ext i'
    simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_compl, not_mem_nested_iff, mem_before]
    omega
  · refine Finset.sum_congr ?_ fun _ _ => rfl
    ext i'
    simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_compl, not_mem_nested_iff, mem_after]
    omega

name: Operad.sum_before_eq
statement:
lemma sum_before_eq {j k l : ℕ} (α : P (j + 1)) (β : P (k + 1)) (γ : P (l + 1)) :
    ((∑ i : Fin (j + 1), ∑ i' ∈ before (k := k) i,
        compFin (R := R) i' (compFin (R := R) i α β) γ) : P (j + k + l + 1))
      = ∑ s : Fin (j + 1), ∑ t ∈ after (k := l) s,
          reindex R P (by omega) (compFin (R := R) t (compFin (R := R) s α γ) β)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Finset.sum_sigma', Finset.sum_sigma']
  refine Finset.sum_nbij'
    (fun x => ⟨⟨min (x.2 : ℕ) j, by omega⟩, ⟨(x.1 : ℕ) + l, by have := x.1.isLt; omega⟩⟩)
    (fun y => ⟨⟨(y.2 : ℕ) - l, by have := y.2.isLt; omega⟩,
               ⟨(y.1 : ℕ), by have := y.1.isLt; omega⟩⟩)
    ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_
  · rintro ⟨i, i'⟩ hx
    simp only [Finset.mem_sigma, Finset.mem_univ, mem_before, true_and] at hx
    have := i.isLt
    simp only [Finset.mem_sigma, Finset.mem_univ, mem_after, true_and]
    show min (i' : ℕ) j + l < (i : ℕ) + l
    omega
  · rintro ⟨s, t⟩ hy
    simp only [Finset.mem_sigma, Finset.mem_univ, mem_after, true_and] at hy
    have := s.isLt
    simp only [Finset.mem_sigma, Finset.mem_univ, mem_before, true_and]
    show (s : ℕ) < (t : ℕ) - l
    omega
  · rintro ⟨i, i'⟩ hx
    simp only [Finset.mem_sigma, Finset.mem_univ, mem_before, true_and] at hx
    have := i.isLt
    simp only [Sigma.mk.injEq, heq_iff_eq, Fin.ext_iff]
    omega
  · rintro ⟨s, t⟩ hy
    simp only [Finset.mem_sigma, Finset.mem_univ, mem_after, true_and] at hy
    have := s.isLt
    simp only [Sigma.mk.injEq, heq_iff_eq, Fin.ext_iff]
    omega
  · rintro ⟨i, i'⟩ hx
    simp only [Finset.mem_sigma, Finset.mem_univ, mem_before, true_and] at hx
    have hij := i.isLt
    have hmin : min (i' : ℕ) j = (i' : ℕ) := by omega
    dsimp only
    have key : compFin (R := R) (⟨(i : ℕ) + l, by omega⟩ : Fin (j + l + 1))
          (compFin (R := R) (⟨min (i' : ℕ) j, by omega⟩ : Fin (j + 1)) α γ) β
        = reindex R P (by omega)
            (compFin (R := R) (⟨min (i' : ℕ) j, by omega⟩ : Fin (j + k + 1))
              (compFin (R := R) i α β) γ) :=
      compFin_assoc_par _ _ (by show min (i' : ℕ) j < (i : ℕ); omega) α γ β
    rw [key, show (⟨min (i' : ℕ) j, by omega⟩ : Fin (j + k + 1)) = i' from Fin.ext hmin,
      reindex_reindex]
    exact (reindex_self (R := R) (P := P) _ _).symm

name: Operad.sum_after_eq
statement:
lemma sum_after_eq {j k l : ℕ} (α : P (j + 1)) (β : P (k + 1)) (γ : P (l + 1)) :
    ((∑ i : Fin (j + 1), ∑ i' ∈ after (k := k) i,
        compFin (R := R) i' (compFin (R := R) i α β) γ) : P (j + k + l + 1))
      = ∑ s : Fin (j + 1), ∑ t ∈ before (k := l) s,
          reindex R P (by omega) (compFin (R := R) t (compFin (R := R) s α γ) β)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Finset.sum_sigma', Finset.sum_sigma']
  refine Finset.sum_nbij'
    (fun x => ⟨⟨(x.2 : ℕ) - k, by have := x.2.isLt; omega⟩,
               ⟨(x.1 : ℕ), by have := x.1.isLt; omega⟩⟩)
    (fun y => ⟨⟨min (y.2 : ℕ) j, by omega⟩,
               ⟨(y.1 : ℕ) + k, by have := y.1.isLt; omega⟩⟩)
    ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_
  · rintro ⟨i, i'⟩ hx
    simp only [Finset.mem_sigma, Finset.mem_univ, mem_after, true_and] at hx
    simp only [Finset.mem_sigma, Finset.mem_univ, mem_before, true_and]
    show (i : ℕ) < (i' : ℕ) - k
    omega
  · rintro ⟨s, t⟩ hy
    simp only [Finset.mem_sigma, Finset.mem_univ, mem_before, true_and] at hy
    have := s.isLt
    simp only [Finset.mem_sigma, Finset.mem_univ, mem_after, true_and]
    show min (t : ℕ) j + k < (s : ℕ) + k
    omega
  · rintro ⟨i, i'⟩ hx
    simp only [Finset.mem_sigma, Finset.mem_univ, mem_after, true_and] at hx
    have := i.isLt
    simp only [Sigma.mk.injEq, heq_iff_eq, Fin.ext_iff]
    omega
  · rintro ⟨s, t⟩ hy
    simp only [Finset.mem_sigma, Finset.mem_univ, mem_before, true_and] at hy
    have := s.isLt
    simp only [Sigma.mk.injEq, heq_iff_eq, Fin.ext_iff]
    omega
  · rintro ⟨i, i'⟩ hx
    simp only [Finset.mem_sigma, Finset.mem_univ, mem_after, true_and] at hx
    have hi' := i'.isLt
    dsimp only
    have h := compFin_assoc_par (R := R) i (⟨(i' : ℕ) - k, by omega⟩ : Fin (j + 1))
      (by show (i : ℕ) < (i' : ℕ) - k; omega) α β γ
    dsimp only at h
    conv_lhs =>
      rw [show i' = (⟨(i' : ℕ) - k + k, by omega⟩ : Fin (j + k + 1)) from
        Fin.ext (show (i' : ℕ) = (i' : ℕ) - k + k by omega)]
    exact h

name: Operad.disjointPart_symm
statement:
theorem disjointPart_symm {j k l : ℕ} (α : P (j + 1)) (β : P (k + 1)) (γ : P (l + 1)) :
    disjointPart (R := R) α β γ
      = reindex R P (by omega) (disjointPart (R := R) α γ β)
proof:
:= by
  unfold disjointPart
  rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => sum_compl_nested i _,
    Finset.sum_congr rfl fun s _ => sum_compl_nested s _,
    Finset.sum_add_distrib, Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  simp only [sum_before_eq α β γ, sum_after_eq α β γ, map_add, map_sum]
  exact add_comm _ _

name: Operad.star_assoc_symm
statement:
theorem star_assoc_symm {j k l : ℕ} (α : P (j + 1)) (β : P (k + 1)) (γ : P (l + 1)) :
    star (R := R) (star (R := R) α β) γ
        - reindex R P (by omega) (star (R := R) α (star (R := R) β γ))
      = reindex R P (by omega) (star (R := R) (star (R := R) α γ) β)
        - reindex R P (by omega) (star (R := R) α (star (R := R) γ β))
proof:
:= by
  rw [star_star_left_split, star_star_left_split α γ β]
  rw [map_add, disjointPart_symm α β γ]
  simp only [reindex_reindex, add_sub_cancel_left]

name: Operad.GrComposite.rsg_update_mul_after
statement:
lemma rsg_update_mul_after (L L' : LinOrd A) (c : A → Bool) (j : A) (q : Bool) :
    (∏ a, if ltB L j a then σ R (q && c a) else 1) * GrEnd.rsg R L L' (update c j (xor (c j) q))
      = GrEnd.rsg R L L' c * ∏ a, if ltB L' j a then σ R (q && c a) else 1
proof:
:= by
  simp only [ltB_eq_true]
  rw [rsg_update, ← Finset.prod_mul_distrib, mul_left_comm, ← Finset.prod_mul_distrib]
  congr 1
  refine Finset.prod_congr rfl fun a _ => ?_
  have hs : σ R (q && c a) * σ R (q && c a) = 1 := σ_mul_self R _
  by_cases haj : a = j
  · subst haj
    simp only [L.irrefl, L'.irrefl, and_false, if_false, mul_one]
  rcases L.total a j haj with h1 | h1 <;> rcases L'.total a j haj with h2 | h2 <;>
    simp only [h1, h2, GrEnd.lt_asymm _ h1, GrEnd.lt_asymm _ h2, and_true, and_false, if_true,
      if_false, mul_one, one_mul, hs]

name: Operad.GrComposite.actLin_eq
statement:
lemma actLin_eq (L : LinOrd A) (f : S → A) (i : S) (z : C Y) (q : Bool) (a : A) (h : f i = a)
    (x : C (Fib f a)) :
    actLin (R := R) L f i z q a x
      = GrOperad.map (R := R) (actEq f i a h) (GrOperad.comp (R := R) (⟨i, h⟩ : Fib f a) x z)
proof:
:= by
  rw [actLin, dif_pos h]
  rfl

name: Operad.GrComposite.actLin_ne
statement:
lemma actLin_ne (L : LinOrd A) (f : S → A) (i : S) (z : C Y) (q : Bool) (a : A) (h : f i ≠ a)
    (x : C (Fib f a)) :
    actLin (R := R) L f i z q a x = GrOperad.tw (R := R) (P := C) (q && ltB L (f i) a)
      (GrOperad.map (R := R) (actNe f i a h) x)
proof:
:= by
  rw [actLin, dif_neg h]
  rfl

name: Operad.GrComposite.actY_update
statement:
lemma actY_update (L : LinOrd A) (f : S → A) (y : ∀ a, C (Fib f a)) (i : S) (z : C Y)
    (q : Bool) (b : A) (w : C (Fib f b)) :
    actY (R := R) L f (update y b w) i z q
      = update (actY (R := R) L f y i z q) b (actLin (R := R) L f i z q b w)
proof:
:=
  funext fun a => apply_update (fun a => ⇑(actLin (R := R) L f i z q a)) y b w a

name: Operad.GrComposite.actOwn_add_m
statement:
lemma actOwn_add_m (L : LinOrd A) (m m' : V A) (f : S → A) (y : ∀ a, C (Fib f a)) (i : S)
    (z : C Y) : actOwn R L (m + m') f y i z = actOwn R L m f y i z + actOwn R L m' f y i z
proof:
:= by
  unfold actOwn
  rw [← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun q _ => ?_
  exact mk_add_m (actGen (R := R) L m f y i (GrOperad.par (R := R) q z) q) m'

name: Operad.GrComposite.actOwn_smul_m
statement:
lemma actOwn_smul_m (L : LinOrd A) (c : R) (m : V A) (f : S → A) (y : ∀ a, C (Fib f a)) (i : S)
    (z : C Y) : actOwn R L (c • m) f y i z = c • actOwn R L m f y i z
proof:
:= by
  unfold actOwn
  rw [Finset.smul_sum]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun q _ => ?_
  exact mk_smul_m (actGen (R := R) L m f y i (GrOperad.par (R := R) q z) q) c

name: Operad.GrComposite.actOwn_update_add
statement:
lemma actOwn_update_add (L : LinOrd A) (m : V A) (f : S → A) (y : ∀ a, C (Fib f a)) (i : S)
    (z : C Y) (b : A) (w w' : C (Fib f b)) :
    actOwn R L m f (update y b (w + w')) i z
      = actOwn R L m f (update y b w) i z + actOwn R L m f (update y b w') i z
proof:
:= by
  unfold actOwn
  rw [← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun q _ => ?_
  show mkY (actGen (R := R) L m f y i (GrOperad.par (R := R) q z) q)
      (actY (R := R) L f (update y b (w + w')) i (GrOperad.par (R := R) q z) q)
    = mkY (actGen (R := R) L m f y i (GrOperad.par (R := R) q z) q)
        (actY (R := R) L f (update y b w) i (GrOperad.par (R := R) q z) q)
      + mkY (actGen (R := R) L m f y i (GrOperad.par (R := R) q z) q)
        (actY (R := R) L f (update y b w') i (GrOperad.par (R := R) q z) q)
  rw [actY_update, actY_update, actY_update, map_add, MultilinearMap.map_update_add]

name: Operad.GrComposite.actOwn_update_smul
statement:
lemma actOwn_update_smul (L : LinOrd A) (m : V A) (f : S → A) (y : ∀ a, C (Fib f a)) (i : S)
    (z : C Y) (b : A) (c : R) (w : C (Fib f b)) :
    actOwn R L m f (update y b (c • w)) i z = c • actOwn R L m f (update y b w) i z
proof:
:= by
  unfold actOwn
  rw [Finset.smul_sum]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun q _ => ?_
  show mkY (actGen (R := R) L m f y i (GrOperad.par (R := R) q z) q)
      (actY (R := R) L f (update y b (c • w)) i (GrOperad.par (R := R) q z) q)
    = c • mkY (actGen (R := R) L m f y i (GrOperad.par (R := R) q z) q)
        (actY (R := R) L f (update y b w) i (GrOperad.par (R := R) q z) q)
  rw [actY_update, actY_update, map_smul, MultilinearMap.map_update_smul]

name: Operad.GrComposite.gmap_congr
statement:
lemma gmap_congr {X Z : Type} [Fintype X] [DecidableEq X] [Fintype Z] [DecidableEq Z]
    {e e' : X ≃ Z} (h : ∀ a, e a = e' a) (x : C X) :
    GrOperad.map (R := R) e x = GrOperad.map (R := R) e' x
proof:
:= by
  rw [Equiv.ext h]

name: Operad.GrComposite.gmap_comp_congr
statement:
lemma gmap_comp_congr {X X' Z : Type} [Fintype X] [DecidableEq X] [Fintype X'] [DecidableEq X']
    [Fintype Z] [DecidableEq Z] (e : X ≃ X') (f : X' ≃ Z) (g : X ≃ Z) (h : ∀ a, f (e a) = g a)
    (x : C X) :
    GrOperad.map (R := R) f (GrOperad.map (R := R) e x) = GrOperad.map (R := R) g x
proof:
:= by
  rw [← GrOperad.map_trans]
  exact gmap_congr h x

name: Operad.GrComposite.actOwner_comp
statement:
lemma actOwner_comp (σ : A' ≃ A) (f : S → A) (i : S) :
    σ.symm ∘ actOwner (Y := Y) f i = actOwner (σ.symm ∘ f) i
proof:
:=
  funext fun x => by cases x <;> rfl

name: Operad.GrComposite.ltB_map
statement:
lemma ltB_map (e : A ≃ A') (L : LinOrd A) (b b' : A') :
    ltB (LinOrd.map e L) b b' = ltB L (e.symm b) (e.symm b')
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.GrComposite.actOwn_outer
statement:
lemma actOwn_outer (σ : A' ≃ A) (L : LinOrd A) (m : V A') (f : S → A) (y : ∀ a, C (Fib f a))
    (i : S) (z : C Y) :
    actOwn R L (SymSpecies.map (R := R) σ m) f y i z
      = actOwn R (LinOrd.map σ.symm L) m (σ.symm ∘ f)
          (fun a' => GrOperad.map (R := R) (fibOuter σ f a') (y (σ a'))) i z
proof:
:= by
  unfold actOwn
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun q _ => ?_
  rw [mk_ownGen_outer σ L m (actOwner f i), mk_ownGen_congr _ m (actOwner_comp σ f i)]
  congr 2
  funext a'
  show GrOperad.map (R := R) _ (GrOperad.map (R := R) (fibOuter σ (actOwner f i) a')
      (actLin (R := R) L f i (GrOperad.par (R := R) q z) q (σ a') (y (σ a'))))
    = actLin (R := R) (LinOrd.map σ.symm L) (σ.symm ∘ f) i (GrOperad.par (R := R) q z) q a'
        (GrOperad.map (R := R) (fibOuter σ f a') (y (σ a')))
  by_cases h : f i = σ a'
  · have h' : (σ.symm ∘ f) i = a' := by simp [h]
    rw [actLin_eq _ _ _ _ _ _ h, actLin_eq _ _ _ _ _ _ h']
    have hc := GrOperad.map_comp (R := R) (fibOuter σ f a') (Equiv.refl Y) (⟨i, h⟩ : Fib f (σ a'))
      (y (σ a')) (GrOperad.par (R := R) q z)
    rw [GrOperad.map_refl] at hc
    show _ = GrOperad.map (R := R) (actEq (σ.symm ∘ f) i a' h')
      (GrOperad.comp (R := R) ((fibOuter σ f a') ⟨i, h⟩)
        (GrOperad.map (R := R) (fibOuter σ f a') (y (σ a'))) (GrOperad.par (R := R) q z))
    rw [← hc]
    simp only [← GrOperad.map_trans]
    refine (gmap_comp_congr _ _ _ ?_ _).symm
    rintro (⟨⟨t, ht⟩, hne⟩ | x) <;> rfl
  · have h' : (σ.symm ∘ f) i ≠ a' := fun e => h (by rw [← e]; simp)
    rw [actLin_ne _ _ _ _ _ _ h, actLin_ne _ _ _ _ _ _ h', ltB_map, Equiv.symm_symm,
      show σ ((σ.symm ∘ f) i) = f i by simp]
    rw [GrOperad.map_tw, GrOperad.map_tw]
    congr 1
    simp only [← GrOperad.map_trans]
    apply gmap_congr
    intro x
    exact Subtype.ext rfl

name: Operad.GrComposite.actOwn_congr
statement:
lemma actOwn_congr (L : LinOrd A) (m : V A) {f f' : S → A} (hf : f = f')
    (y : ∀ a, C (Fib f a)) (i : S) (z : C Y) :
    actOwn R L m f y i z = actOwn R L m f' (fun a =>
      GrOperad.map (R := R) (Equiv.subtypeEquivRight fun s => by rw [hf]) (y a)) i z
proof:
:= by
  subst hf
  congr 1
  funext a
  rw [show (Equiv.subtypeEquivRight _ : Fib f a ≃ Fib f a) = Equiv.refl _ from
    Equiv.ext fun _ => rfl, GrOperad.map_refl]

name: Operad.GrComposite.actY_hom
statement:
lemma actY_hom (L : LinOrd A) (f : S → A) (y : ∀ a, C (Fib f a)) (i : S) (z : C Y) (q : Bool)
    (c : A → Bool) (hy : ∀ a, GrOperad.par (R := R) (c a) (y a) = y a) (a : A) :
    actY (R := R) L f y i z q a
      = (if ltB L (f i) a then σ R (q && c a) else 1) • actY (R := R) L f y i z false a
proof:
:= by
  unfold actY
  by_cases h : f i = a
  · subst h
    rw [actLin_eq _ _ _ _ _ _ rfl, actLin_eq _ _ _ _ _ _ rfl, ltB_self, if_neg Bool.false_ne_true,
      one_smul]
  · rw [actLin_ne _ _ _ _ _ _ h, actLin_ne _ _ _ _ _ _ h, Bool.false_and, GrOperad.tw_false,
      GrOperad.tw_hom _ (c := c a) (by rw [← GrOperad.map_par, hy])]
    by_cases hl : ltB L (f i) a
    · simp [hl]
    · simp [hl]

name: Operad.GrComposite.actY_false_indep
statement:
lemma actY_false_indep (L L' : LinOrd A) (f : S → A) (y : ∀ a, C (Fib f a)) (i : S) (z : C Y) :
    actY (R := R) L f y i z false = actY (R := R) L' f y i z false
proof:
:= by
  funext a
  unfold actY actLin
  split_ifs <;> simp

name: Operad.GrComposite.actY_false_par
statement:
lemma actY_false_par (L : LinOrd A) (f : S → A) (y : ∀ a, C (Fib f a)) (i : S) (z : C Y)
    (q : Bool) (hz : GrOperad.par (R := R) q z = z) (c : A → Bool)
    (hy : ∀ a, GrOperad.par (R := R) (c a) (y a) = y a) (a : A) :
    GrOperad.par (R := R) (update c (f i) (xor (c (f i)) q) a) (actY (R := R) L f y i z false a)
      = actY (R := R) L f y i z false a
proof:
:= by
  unfold actY
  by_cases h : f i = a
  · subst h
    rw [actLin_eq _ _ _ _ _ _ rfl, update_self, ← GrOperad.map_par, ← hy, ← hz,
      GrOperad.comp_par, hy, hz]
  · rw [actLin_ne _ _ _ _ _ _ h, update_of_ne (Ne.symm h), Bool.false_and, GrOperad.tw_false,
      ← GrOperad.map_par, hy]

name: Operad.GrComposite.mk_actGen_reorder
statement:
lemma mk_actGen_reorder (L L' : LinOrd A) (m : V A) (f : S → A) (y : ∀ a, C (Fib f a)) (i : S)
    (z : C Y) (q : Bool) (hz : GrOperad.par (R := R) q z = z) (c : A → Bool)
    (hy : ∀ a, GrOperad.par (R := R) (c a) (y a) = y a) :
    mk R (actGen (R := R) L m f y i z q)
      = GrEnd.rsg R L L' c • mk R (actGen (R := R) L' m f y i z q)
proof:
:= by
  have hL : ∀ L₀ : LinOrd A, mk R (actGen (R := R) L₀ m f y i z q)
      = (∏ a, if ltB L₀ (f i) a then σ R (q && c a) else 1)
        • mk R (ownGen L₀ m (actOwner f i) (actY (R := R) L f y i z false)) := fun L₀ => by
    have := (mkY (R := R) (ownGen L₀ m (actOwner f i)
      (actY (R := R) L f y i z false))).map_smul_univ
      (fun a => if ltB L₀ (f i) a then σ R (q && c a) else 1) (actY (R := R) L f y i z false)
    refine Eq.trans ?_ this
    show mk R (ownGen L₀ m (actOwner f i) (actY (R := R) L₀ f y i z q)) = mk R (ownGen L₀ m
      (actOwner f i) fun a => (if ltB L₀ (f i) a then σ R (q && c a) else 1)
        • actY (R := R) L f y i z false a)
    rw [actY_false_indep L L₀]
    congr 2
    funext a
    exact actY_hom L₀ f y i z q c hy a
  rw [hL L, hL L', mk_reorder (ownGen L m (actOwner f i) (actY (R := R) L f y i z false)) L' _
    (actY_false_par L f y i z q hz c hy), smul_smul, smul_smul]
  congr 1
  exact rsg_update_mul_after L L' c (f i) q

name: Operad.GrComposite.ownY_update
proof:
:=
  funext fun a' => apply_update (fun a' => ⇑(GrOperad.map (R := R) (P := C) (fibEquiv g a'))) g.y
    a w a'

name: Operad.GrComposite.owner_outer
statement:
lemma owner_outer (g : GrCompGen V C S) {A : Type} [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] (σ : A ≃ g.A)
    (m : V A) :
    owner (⟨A, fun a => g.B (σ a), LinOrd.map σ.symm g.L, m, fun a => g.y (σ a),
      (Equiv.sigmaCongrLeft σ).trans g.e⟩ : GrCompGen V C S) = σ.symm ∘ owner g
proof:
:= by
  funext s
  show ((Equiv.sigmaCongrLeft σ).symm (g.e.symm s)).1 = σ.symm (g.e.symm s).1
  generalize g.e.symm s = p
  obtain ⟨⟨a', b⟩, rfl⟩ := (Equiv.sigmaCongrLeft σ).surjective p
  rw [Equiv.symm_apply_apply]
  show a' = σ.symm (σ a')
  rw [Equiv.symm_apply_apply]

name: Operad.GrComposite.actFun_respects
statement:
lemma actFun_respects (i : S) (z : C Y) :
    GrCompGen.Respects R (actFun (V := V) R i z) where
  add_m g m'
proof:
:= actOwn_add_m g.L g.m m' (owner g) (ownY (R := R) g) i z
  smul_m g c := actOwn_smul_m g.L c g.m (owner g) (ownY (R := R) g) i z
  add_y g a w w' := by
    show actOwn R g.L g.m (owner g) (ownY (R := R) { g with y := update g.y a (w + w') }) i z
      = actOwn R g.L g.m (owner g) (ownY (R := R) { g with y := update g.y a w }) i z
        + actOwn R g.L g.m (owner g) (ownY (R := R) { g with y := update g.y a w' }) i z
    rw [ownY_update, ownY_update, ownY_update, map_add, actOwn_update_add]
  smul_y g a c w := by
    show actOwn R g.L g.m (owner g) (ownY (R := R) { g with y := update g.y a (c • w) }) i z
      = c • actOwn R g.L g.m (owner g) (ownY (R := R) { g with y := update g.y a w }) i z
    rw [ownY_update, ownY_update, map_smul, actOwn_update_smul]
  outer := @fun g A _ _ σ m => by
    show actOwn R g.L (SymSpecies.map (R := R) σ m) (owner g) (ownY (R := R) g) i z = _
    rw [actOwn_outer, actFun, actOwn_congr _ m (owner_outer g σ m).symm]
    congr 1
    funext a'
    simp only [ownY, ← GrOperad.map_trans]
    apply gmap_congr
    intro b
    rfl
  inner := @fun g B _ _ τ => by
    show actOwn R g.L g.m _ (ownY (R := R) (⟨g.A, B, g.L, g.m,
      fun a => SymSpecies.map (R := R) (τ a) (g.y a),
      (Equiv.sigmaCongrRight τ).symm.trans g.e⟩ : GrCompGen V C S)) i z = actFun R i z g
    unfold actFun
    congr 1
    funext a
    apply gmap_comp_congr
    intro b
    exact Subtype.ext (show g.e ⟨a, (τ a).symm (τ a b)⟩ = g.e ⟨a, b⟩ by
      rw [Equiv.symm_apply_apply])
  reorder g L' c hy := by
    unfold actFun actOwn
    rw [Finset.smul_sum]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun q _ => ?_
    exact mk_actGen_reorder g.L L' g.m (owner g) (ownY (R := R) g) i (GrOperad.par (R := R) q z) q
      (by rw [GrOperad.par_par, if_pos rfl]) c fun a => by
        show GrOperad.par (R := R) (c a) (GrOperad.map (R := R) _ (g.y a)) = _
        rw [← GrOperad.map_par]
        exact congrArg _ (hy a)

name: Operad.GrComposite.act_mk
statement:
@[simp] lemma act_mk (i : S) (z : C Y) (g : GrCompGen V C S) :
    act R V i z (mk R g) = actFun R i z g
proof:
:=
  lift_mk _ _ g

name: Operad.GrComposite.actOwner_compEquiv
statement:
lemma actOwner_compEquiv (σ : S ≃ S') (τ : Y ≃ Y') (f : S → A) (i : S) :
    actOwner f i ∘ (compEquiv σ τ i).symm = actOwner (f ∘ σ.symm) (σ i)
proof:
:= by
  funext x
  rcases x with s | y
  · rfl
  · show f i = f (σ.symm (σ i))
    rw [Equiv.symm_apply_apply]

name: Operad.GrComposite.map_actOwn
statement:
lemma map_actOwn (σ : S ≃ S') (τ : Y ≃ Y') (L : LinOrd A) (m : V A) (f : S → A)
    (y : ∀ a, C (Fib f a)) (i : S) (z : C Y) :
    map (compEquiv σ τ i) (actOwn R L m f y i z)
      = actOwn R L m (f ∘ σ.symm) (fun a => GrOperad.map (R := R) (fibMap σ f a) (y a)) (σ i)
          (GrOperad.map (R := R) τ z)
proof:
:= by
  unfold actOwn
  rw [map_sum]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun q _ => ?_
  rw [map_mk_ownGen, mk_ownGen_congr _ m (actOwner_compEquiv σ τ f i)]
  congr 2
  funext a
  show GrOperad.map (R := R) _ (GrOperad.map (R := R) _
      (actLin (R := R) L f i (GrOperad.par (R := R) q z) q a (y a)))
    = actLin (R := R) L (f ∘ σ.symm) (σ i) (GrOperad.par (R := R) q (GrOperad.map (R := R) τ z))
        q a (GrOperad.map (R := R) (fibMap σ f a) (y a))
  rw [← GrOperad.map_par]
  by_cases h : f i = a
  · have h' : (f ∘ σ.symm) (σ i) = a := by simp [h]
    rw [actLin_eq _ _ _ _ _ _ h, actLin_eq _ _ _ _ _ _ h']
    have hc := GrOperad.map_comp (R := R) (fibMap σ f a) τ (⟨i, h⟩ : Fib f a) (y a)
      (GrOperad.par (R := R) q z)
    show _ = GrOperad.map (R := R) (actEq (f ∘ σ.symm) (σ i) a h')
      (GrOperad.comp (R := R) ((fibMap σ f a) ⟨i, h⟩)
        (GrOperad.map (R := R) (fibMap σ f a) (y a))
        (GrOperad.map (R := R) τ (GrOperad.par (R := R) q z)))
    rw [← hc]
    simp only [← GrOperad.map_trans]
    refine (gmap_comp_congr _ _ _ ?_ _).symm
    rintro (⟨⟨t, ht⟩, hne⟩ | x) <;> rfl
  · have h' : (f ∘ σ.symm) (σ i) ≠ a := by simpa using h
    rw [actLin_ne _ _ _ _ _ _ h, actLin_ne _ _ _ _ _ _ h',
      show (f ∘ σ.symm) (σ i) = f i by simp, GrOperad.map_tw, GrOperad.map_tw]
    congr 1
    simp only [← GrOperad.map_trans]
    apply gmap_congr
    intro b
    exact Subtype.ext rfl

name: Operad.GrComposite.map_act
statement:
lemma map_act (σ : S ≃ S') (τ : Y ≃ Y') (i : S) (z : C Y) (x : GrComposite R V C S) :
    map (compEquiv σ τ i) (act R V i z x)
      = act R V (σ i) (GrOperad.map (R := R) τ z) (map σ x)
proof:
:= by
  have h : (map (R := R) (M := V) (N := C) (compEquiv σ τ i)).comp (act R V i z)
      = (act R V (σ i) (GrOperad.map (R := R) τ z)).comp (map σ) := hom_ext fun g => by
    simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply, act_mk, map_mk, actFun]
    rw [map_actOwn]
    congr 1
    funext a
    show _ = GrOperad.map (R := R) (fibEquiv (g.relabel σ) a) (g.y a)
    simp only [ownY]
    apply gmap_comp_congr
    intro b
    rfl
  exact LinearMap.congr_fun h x

name: Operad.GrComposite.mk_actGen_zero
statement:
lemma mk_actGen_zero (L : LinOrd A) (m : V A) (f : S → A) (y : ∀ a, C (Fib f a)) (i : S)
    (q : Bool) : mk R (actGen (R := R) L m f y i (0 : C Y) q) = 0
proof:
:= by
  refine mk_of_y_eq_zero _ (a := f i) ?_
  show actLin (R := R) L f i 0 q (f i) (y (f i)) = 0
  rw [actLin_eq _ _ _ _ _ _ rfl, map_zero, map_zero]

name: Operad.GrComposite.actOwn_hom
statement:
lemma actOwn_hom (L : LinOrd A) (m : V A) (f : S → A) (y : ∀ a, C (Fib f a)) (i : S) (z : C Y)
    {q : Bool} (hz : GrOperad.par (R := R) q z = z) :
    actOwn R L m f y i z = mk R (actGen (R := R) L m f y i z q)
proof:
:= by
  unfold actOwn
  rw [Finset.sum_eq_single q]
  · rw [hz]
  · intro q' _ hq'
    rw [← hz, GrOperad.par_par, if_neg hq']
    exact mk_actGen_zero L m f y i q'
  · intro h
    exact absurd (Finset.mem_univ q) h

name: Operad.GrComposite.owner_ownGen
statement:
lemma owner_ownGen (L : LinOrd A) (m : V A) (f : S → A) (y : ∀ a, C (Fib f a)) :
    owner (ownGen L m f y) = f
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.GrComposite.actFun_ownGen
statement:
lemma actFun_ownGen (L : LinOrd A) (m : V A) (f : S → A) (y : ∀ a, C (Fib f a)) (i : S)
    (z : C Y) : actFun R i z (ownGen L m f y) = actOwn R L m f y i z
proof:
:= by
  unfold actFun
  congr 1
  funext a
  show GrOperad.map (R := R) (fibEquiv (ownGen L m f y) a) (y a) = y a
  rw [show fibEquiv (ownGen L m f y) a = Equiv.refl _ from Equiv.ext fun b => Subtype.ext rfl]
  exact GrOperad.map_refl (R := R) _

name: Operad.GrComposite.act_mk_ownGen
statement:
lemma act_mk_ownGen (L : LinOrd A) (m : V A) (f : S → A) (y : ∀ a, C (Fib f a)) (i : S)
    (z : C Y) : act R V i z (mk R (ownGen L m f y)) = actOwn R L m f y i z
proof:
:= by
  rw [act_mk, actFun_ownGen]

name: Operad.GrComposite.actOwner_rightUnit
statement:
lemma actOwner_rightUnit (f : S → A) (i : S) :
    actOwner (Y := Unit) f i ∘ (rightUnitEquiv i).symm = f
proof:
:= by
  funext s
  by_cases h : s = i
  · subst h
    simp [rightUnitEquiv, actOwner]
  · simp [rightUnitEquiv, actOwner, h]

name: Operad.GrComposite.map_actOwn_one
statement:
lemma map_actOwn_one (L : LinOrd A) (m : V A) (f : S → A) (y : ∀ a, C (Fib f a)) (i : S) :
    map (rightUnitEquiv i) (actOwn R L m f y i (GrOperad.one (R := R) (P := C)))
      = mk R (ownGen L m f y)
proof:
:= by
  rw [actOwn_hom L m f y i _ (GrOperad.par_one (R := R) (P := C)), map_mk_ownGen,
    mk_ownGen_congr _ m (actOwner_rightUnit f i)]
  congr 2
  funext a
  show GrOperad.map (R := R) _ (GrOperad.map (R := R) _
      (actLin (R := R) L f i (GrOperad.one (R := R)) false a (y a))) = y a
  by_cases h : f i = a
  · rw [actLin_eq _ _ _ _ _ _ h]
    have hc := GrOperad.comp_one (R := R) (⟨i, h⟩ : Fib f a) (y a)
    conv_rhs => rw [← hc]
    simp only [← GrOperad.map_trans]
    apply gmap_congr
    rintro (⟨⟨t, ht⟩, hne⟩ | ⟨⟩)
    · apply Subtype.ext
      show t = t
      rfl
    · apply Subtype.ext
      show (rightUnitEquiv i) (Sum.inr ()) = i
      rfl
  · rw [actLin_ne _ _ _ _ _ _ h, Bool.false_and, GrOperad.tw_false]
    simp only [← GrOperad.map_trans]
    conv_rhs => rw [← GrOperad.map_refl (R := R) (y a)]
    apply gmap_congr
    intro b
    exact Subtype.ext rfl

name: Operad.GrComposite.map_act_one
statement:
lemma map_act_one (i : S) (x : GrComposite R V C S) :
    map (rightUnitEquiv i) (act R V i (GrOperad.one (R := R) (P := C)) x) = x
proof:
:= by
  have h : (map (R := R) (M := V) (N := C) (rightUnitEquiv i)).comp
      (act R V i (GrOperad.one (R := R) (P := C))) = LinearMap.id := hom_ext fun g => by
    simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearMap.id_apply]
    rw [mk_eq_ownGen (R := R) g, act_mk_ownGen, map_actOwn_one]
  exact LinearMap.congr_fun h x

name: Operad.GrComposite.actY_par
statement:
lemma actY_par (L : LinOrd A) (f : S → A) (y : ∀ a, C (Fib f a)) (i : S) (z : C Y) (q : Bool)
    (hz : GrOperad.par (R := R) q z = z) (c : A → Bool)
    (hy : ∀ a, GrOperad.par (R := R) (c a) (y a) = y a) (a : A) :
    GrOperad.par (R := R) (update c (f i) (xor (c (f i)) q) a) (actY (R := R) L f y i z q a)
      = actY (R := R) L f y i z q a
proof:
:= by
  rw [actY_hom L f y i z q c hy, map_smul, actY_false_par L f y i z q hz c hy]

name: Operad.GrComposite.par_actGen
statement:
lemma par_actGen (b : Bool) (L : LinOrd A) (m : V A) (f : S → A) (y : ∀ a, C (Fib f a))
    (i : S) (z : C Y) {q : Bool} (hz : GrOperad.par (R := R) q z = z) {p : Bool}
    (hm : GrSpecies.par (R := R) p m = m) (c : A → Bool)
    (hy : ∀ a, GrOperad.par (R := R) (c a) (y a) = y a) :
    par R V C b (mk R (actGen (R := R) L m f y i z q))
      = if xor p (xor (GrEnd.tot c) q) = b then mk R (actGen (R := R) L m f y i z q) else 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [par_mk, parFun_hom (p := p) (c := update c (f i) (xor (c (f i)) q)) b _ hm
    (actY_par L f y i z q hz c hy), tot_update]
  congr 2
  cases c (f i) <;> cases q <;> simp

name: Operad.GrComposite.par_act
statement:
lemma par_act (b : Bool) (i : S) (z : C Y) {q : Bool} (hz : GrOperad.par (R := R) q z = z)
    (x : GrComposite R V C S) :
    par R V C b (act R V i z x) = act R V i z (par R V C (xor b q) x)
proof:
:= by
  have h : (par R V C (S := Without S i ⊕ Y) b).comp (act R V i z)
      = (act R V i z).comp (par R V C (xor b q)) := hom_ext fun g => by
    simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply]
    rw [mk_eq_sum (R := R) g]
    simp only [map_sum]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun p _ => Finset.sum_congr rfl fun c _ => ?_
    have hm : GrSpecies.par (R := R) p (parGen (R := R) g p c).m = (parGen (R := R) g p c).m := by
      show GrSpecies.par (R := R) p (GrSpecies.par (R := R) p g.m) = _
      rw [GrSpecies.par_par, if_pos rfl]
    have hy : ∀ a, GrSpecies.par (R := R) (c a) ((parGen (R := R) g p c).y a)
        = (parGen (R := R) g p c).y a := fun a => by
      show GrSpecies.par (R := R) (c a) (GrSpecies.par (R := R) (c a) (g.y a)) = _
      rw [GrSpecies.par_par, if_pos rfl]
    have hy' : ∀ a, GrOperad.par (R := R) (c a) (ownY (R := R) (parGen (R := R) g p c) a)
        = ownY (R := R) (parGen (R := R) g p c) a := fun a => by
      show GrOperad.par (R := R) (c a) (GrOperad.map (R := R) _ _) = _
      rw [← GrOperad.map_par]
      exact congrArg _ (hy a)
    rw [act_mk, actFun, actOwn_hom _ _ _ _ i z hz, par_actGen b _ _ _ _ i z hz hm c hy', par_mk,
      parFun_hom _ _ hm hy]
    split_ifs with h1 h2 h2
    · rw [act_mk, actFun, actOwn_hom _ _ _ _ i z hz]
    · exact absurd (by rw [← h1]; cases p <;> cases GrEnd.tot c <;> cases q <;> simp) h2
    · exact absurd (by rw [← Bool.xor_assoc, h2, Bool.xor_assoc, Bool.xor_self, Bool.xor_false]) h1
    · rw [map_zero]
  exact LinearMap.congr_fun h x

name: Operad.GrComposite.actY_eq_update
statement:
lemma actY_eq_update (L : LinOrd A) (f : S → A) (y : ∀ a, C (Fib f a)) (i : S) (z z₀ : C Y)
    (q : Bool) :
    actY (R := R) L f y i z q = update (actY (R := R) L f y i z₀ q) (f i)
      (actLin (R := R) L f i z q (f i) (y (f i)))
proof:
:= by
  funext a
  by_cases h : f i = a
  · subst h
    rw [update_self]
    rfl
  · rw [update_of_ne (Ne.symm h)]
    show actLin (R := R) L f i z q a (y a) = actLin (R := R) L f i z₀ q a (y a)
    rw [actLin_ne _ _ _ _ _ _ h, actLin_ne _ _ _ _ _ _ h]

name: Operad.GrComposite.actOwn_add_z
statement:
lemma actOwn_add_z (L : LinOrd A) (m : V A) (f : S → A) (y : ∀ a, C (Fib f a)) (i : S)
    (z z' : C Y) : actOwn R L m f y i (z + z') = actOwn R L m f y i z + actOwn R L m f y i z'
proof:
:= by
  unfold actOwn
  rw [← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun q _ => ?_
  show mkY (actGen (R := R) L m f y i 0 q) (actY (R := R) L f y i _ q)
    = mkY (actGen (R := R) L m f y i 0 q) (actY (R := R) L f y i _ q)
      + mkY (actGen (R := R) L m f y i 0 q) (actY (R := R) L f y i _ q)
  rw [actY_eq_update L f y i _ 0, actY_eq_update L f y i (GrOperad.par (R := R) q z) 0,
    actY_eq_update L f y i (GrOperad.par (R := R) q z') 0, map_add,
    actLin_eq _ _ _ _ _ _ rfl, actLin_eq _ _ _ _ _ _ rfl, actLin_eq _ _ _ _ _ _ rfl, map_add,
    map_add, MultilinearMap.map_update_add]

name: Operad.GrComposite.actOwn_smul_z
statement:
lemma actOwn_smul_z (L : LinOrd A) (m : V A) (f : S → A) (y : ∀ a, C (Fib f a)) (i : S)
    (c : R) (z : C Y) : actOwn R L m f y i (c • z) = c • actOwn R L m f y i z
proof:
:= by
  unfold actOwn
  rw [Finset.smul_sum]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun q _ => ?_
  show mkY (actGen (R := R) L m f y i 0 q) (actY (R := R) L f y i _ q)
    = c • mkY (actGen (R := R) L m f y i 0 q) (actY (R := R) L f y i _ q)
  rw [actY_eq_update L f y i _ 0, actY_eq_update L f y i (GrOperad.par (R := R) q z) 0, map_smul,
    actLin_eq _ _ _ _ _ _ rfl, actLin_eq _ _ _ _ _ _ rfl, map_smul, map_smul,
    MultilinearMap.map_update_smul]

name: Operad.GrComposite.actL_apply
statement:
@[simp] lemma actL_apply (i : S) (z : C Y) (x : GrComposite R V C S) :
    actL R V i z x = act R V i z x
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.GrComposite.actOwner_seq
statement:
lemma actOwner_seq (f : S → A) (i : S) (j : Y) :
    actOwner (Y := D) (actOwner (Y := Y) f i) (Sum.inr j) ∘ (seqEquiv i j D).symm
      = actOwner f i
proof:
:= by
  funext x
  rcases x with s | (y | d) <;> rfl

name: Operad.GrComposite.map_actOwn_seq
statement:
lemma map_actOwn_seq (L : LinOrd A) (m : V A) (f : S → A) (yy : ∀ a, C (Fib f a)) (i : S)
    (j : Y) {q r : Bool} (y : C Y) (z : C D) (hy : GrOperad.par (R := R) q y = y)
    (hz : GrOperad.par (R := R) r z = z) :
    map (seqEquiv i j D) (act R V (Sum.inr j) z (actOwn R L m f yy i y))
      = actOwn R L m f yy i (GrOperad.comp (R := R) j y z)
proof:
:= by
  have hyz : GrOperad.par (R := R) (xor q r) (GrOperad.comp (R := R) j y z)
      = GrOperad.comp (R := R) j y z := by
    rw [← hy, ← hz, GrOperad.comp_par]
  rw [actOwn_hom L m f yy i y hy, act_mk_ownGen, actOwn_hom _ m _ _ _ z hz,
    actOwn_hom L m f yy i _ hyz, map_mk_ownGen, mk_ownGen_congr _ m (actOwner_seq f i j)]
  congr 2
  funext a
  show GrOperad.map (R := R) _ (GrOperad.map (R := R) _ (actLin (R := R) L (actOwner f i)
      (Sum.inr j) z r a (actLin (R := R) L f i y q a (yy a))))
    = actLin (R := R) L f i (GrOperad.comp (R := R) j y z) (xor q r) a (yy a)
  by_cases h : f i = a
  · have h1 : actOwner (Y := Y) f i (Sum.inr j) = a := h
    rw [actLin_eq _ _ _ _ _ _ h, actLin_eq _ _ _ _ _ _ h1, actLin_eq _ _ _ _ _ _ h]
    have hc := GrOperad.map_comp (R := R) (actEq (Y := Y) f i a h) (Equiv.refl D)
      (Sum.inr j : Without (Fib f a) ⟨i, h⟩ ⊕ Y)
      (GrOperad.comp (R := R) (⟨i, h⟩ : Fib f a) (yy a) y) z
    rw [GrOperad.map_refl] at hc
    have hc' : GrOperad.comp (R := R) (⟨Sum.inr j, h1⟩ : Fib (actOwner (Y := Y) f i) a)
        (GrOperad.map (R := R) (actEq (Y := Y) f i a h)
          (GrOperad.comp (R := R) (⟨i, h⟩ : Fib f a) (yy a) y)) z
        = GrOperad.map (R := R) (compEquiv (actEq (Y := Y) f i a h) (Equiv.refl D)
            (Sum.inr j : Without (Fib f a) ⟨i, h⟩ ⊕ Y))
          (GrOperad.comp (R := R) (Sum.inr j : Without (Fib f a) ⟨i, h⟩ ⊕ Y)
            (GrOperad.comp (R := R) (⟨i, h⟩ : Fib f a) (yy a) y) z) := hc.symm
    have hs := GrOperad.comp_assoc_seq (R := R) (⟨i, h⟩ : Fib f a) j (yy a) y z
    rw [hc', ← hs]
    simp only [← GrOperad.map_trans]
    refine gmap_comp_congr _ _ _ ?_ _
    rintro (⟨(⟨⟨t, ht⟩, hne⟩ | t), hne'⟩ | d) <;> rfl
  · have h1 : actOwner (Y := Y) f i (Sum.inr j) ≠ a := h
    rw [actLin_ne _ _ _ _ _ _ h, actLin_ne _ _ _ _ _ _ h1, actLin_ne _ _ _ _ _ _ h]
    simp only [GrOperad.map_tw]
    rw [GrOperad.tw_tw', show actOwner (Y := Y) f i (Sum.inr j) = f i from rfl]
    congr 1
    · cases q <;> cases r <;> simp
    · simp only [← GrOperad.map_trans]
      apply gmap_congr
      intro b
      exact Subtype.ext rfl

name: Operad.GrComposite.map_act_seq
statement:
lemma map_act_seq {D : Type} [Fintype D] [DecidableEq D] (i : S) (j : Y) (y : C Y) (z : C D)
    (x : GrComposite R V C S) :
    map (seqEquiv i j D) (act R V (Sum.inr j) z (act R V i y x))
      = act R V i (GrOperad.comp (R := R) j y z) x
proof:
:= by
  have key : ∀ q r : Bool, map (seqEquiv i j D) (act R V (Sum.inr j) (GrOperad.par (R := R) r z)
      (act R V i (GrOperad.par (R := R) q y) x))
      = act R V i (GrOperad.comp (R := R) j (GrOperad.par (R := R) q y)
          (GrOperad.par (R := R) r z)) x := fun q r => by
    have h : (map (R := R) (M := V) (N := C) (seqEquiv i j D)).comp
        ((act R V (Sum.inr j) (GrOperad.par (R := R) r z)).comp
          (act R V i (GrOperad.par (R := R) q y)))
        = act R V i (GrOperad.comp (R := R) j (GrOperad.par (R := R) q y)
            (GrOperad.par (R := R) r z)) := hom_ext fun g => by
      simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply, act_mk, actFun]
      exact map_actOwn_seq _ _ _ _ i j _ _ (GrOperad.par_par_self (R := R) q y)
        (GrOperad.par_par_self (R := R) r z)
    exact LinearMap.congr_fun h x
  have hy : y = GrOperad.par (R := R) false y + GrOperad.par (R := R) true y :=
    (GrOperad.par_add (R := R) y).symm
  have hz : z = GrOperad.par (R := R) false z + GrOperad.par (R := R) true z :=
    (GrOperad.par_add (R := R) z).symm
  conv_lhs => rw [hy, hz]
  conv_rhs => rw [hy, hz]
  simp only [← actL_apply, map_add, LinearMap.add_apply]
  simp only [actL_apply, key]
  abel

name: Operad.GrComposite.actOwner_par
statement:
lemma actOwner_par (f : S → A) {i k : S} (hik : i ≠ k) :
    actOwner (Y := D) (actOwner (Y := Y) f i) (Sum.inl ⟨k, Ne.symm hik⟩)
        ∘ (parEquiv hik Y D).symm
      = actOwner (Y := Y) (actOwner (Y := D) f k) (Sum.inl ⟨i, hik⟩)
proof:
:= by
  funext x
  rcases x with ⟨(s | d), hs⟩ | y <;> rfl

name: Operad.GrComposite.ltB_swap
statement: lemma ltB_swap (L : LinOrd A) {a b : A} (h : a ≠ b) : ltB L b a = !ltB L a b
proof:
:= by
  rcases L.total a b h with h1 | h1
  · have h2 : ltB L b a = false := by
      rw [Bool.eq_false_iff, ne_eq, ltB_eq_true]
      exact GrEnd.lt_asymm L h1
    rw [h2, (ltB_eq_true L a b).2 h1]
    rfl
  · have h2 : ltB L a b = false := by
      rw [Bool.eq_false_iff, ne_eq, ltB_eq_true]
      exact GrEnd.lt_asymm L h1
    rw [h2, (ltB_eq_true L b a).2 h1]
    rfl

name: Operad.GrComposite.comp_tw_left
statement:
lemma comp_tw_left {X B : Type} [Fintype X] [DecidableEq X] [Fintype B] [DecidableEq B]
    (e : Bool) (j : X) (x : C X) {q : Bool} {y : C B} (hy : GrOperad.par (R := R) q y = y) :
    GrOperad.comp (R := R) j (GrOperad.tw (R := R) e x) y
      = σ R (e && q) • GrOperad.tw (R := R) e (GrOperad.comp (R := R) j x y)
proof:
:= by
  rw [GrOperad.tw_comp, GrOperad.tw_hom e hy, map_smul, smul_smul, σ_mul_self, one_smul]

name: Operad.GrComposite.map_actOwn_par
statement:
lemma map_actOwn_par (L : LinOrd A) (m : V A) (f : S → A) (yy : ∀ a, C (Fib f a))
    {i k : S} (hik : i ≠ k) {q r : Bool} (y : C Y) (z : C D)
    (hy : GrOperad.par (R := R) q y = y) (hz : GrOperad.par (R := R) r z = z) :
    map (parEquiv hik Y D) (act R V (Sum.inl ⟨k, Ne.symm hik⟩) z (actOwn R L m f yy i y))
      = σ R (q && r) • act R V (Sum.inl ⟨i, hik⟩) y (actOwn R L m f yy k z)
proof:
:= by
  rw [actOwn_hom L m f yy i y hy, act_mk_ownGen, actOwn_hom _ m _ _ _ z hz,
    actOwn_hom L m f yy k z hz, act_mk_ownGen, actOwn_hom _ m _ _ _ y hy, map_mk_ownGen,
    mk_ownGen_congr _ m (actOwner_par f hik)]
  set U := actY (R := R) L (actOwner (Y := D) f k) (actY (R := R) L f yy k z r)
    (Sum.inl ⟨i, hik⟩) y q
  set a₀ := if ltB L (f k) (f i) then f i else f k with ha₀
  have hS := (mkY (R := R) (ownGen L m (actOwner (Y := Y) (actOwner (Y := D) f k)
    (Sum.inl ⟨i, hik⟩)) U)).map_smul_univ (fun a => if a = a₀ then σ R (q && r) else 1) U
  rw [Finset.prod_ite_eq' Finset.univ a₀, if_pos (Finset.mem_univ _)] at hS
  refine Eq.trans ?_ hS
  show mk R (ownGen L m _ _) = mk R (ownGen L m _ fun a =>
    (if a = a₀ then σ R (q && r) else 1) • U a)
  congr 2
  funext a
  show GrOperad.map (R := R) _ (GrOperad.map (R := R) _ (actLin (R := R) L (actOwner f i)
      (Sum.inl ⟨k, Ne.symm hik⟩) z r a (actLin (R := R) L f i y q a (yy a))))
    = (if a = a₀ then σ R (q && r) else 1) • actLin (R := R) L (actOwner f k)
      (Sum.inl ⟨i, hik⟩) y q a (actLin (R := R) L f k z r a (yy a))
  by_cases hia : f i = a <;> by_cases hka : f k = a
  · subst hka
    have hik' : (⟨i, hia⟩ : Fib f (f k)) ≠ ⟨k, rfl⟩ := fun e => hik (congrArg Subtype.val e)
    rw [if_pos (show f k = a₀ by rw [ha₀, hia]; simp),
      actLin_eq L f i y q (f k) hia,
      actLin_eq L (actOwner f i) (Sum.inl ⟨k, Ne.symm hik⟩) z r (f k) rfl,
      actLin_eq L f k z r (f k) rfl,
      actLin_eq L (actOwner f k) (Sum.inl ⟨i, hik⟩) y q (f k) hia,
      GrOperad.comp_map_left (actEq (Y := Y) f i (f k) hia)
        (Sum.inl ⟨⟨k, rfl⟩, Ne.symm hik'⟩) ⟨Sum.inl ⟨k, Ne.symm hik⟩, rfl⟩ (Subtype.ext rfl),
      GrOperad.comp_map_left (actEq (Y := D) f k (f k) rfl)
        (Sum.inl ⟨⟨i, hia⟩, hik'⟩) ⟨Sum.inl ⟨i, hik⟩, hia⟩ (Subtype.ext rfl),
      GrOperad.comp_assoc_par' hik' (yy (f k)) hy hz, map_smul, map_smul, map_smul,
      map_smul]
    congr 1
    simp only [← GrOperad.map_trans]
    apply gmap_congr
    rintro (⟨(⟨⟨t, ht⟩, hne⟩ | d), hd⟩ | b) <;> rfl
  · have hs : (if a = a₀ then σ R (q && r) else 1) * σ R ((r && ltB L (f k) a) && q) = 1 := by
      subst hia
      by_cases hl : ltB L (f k) (f i)
      · rw [if_pos (by rw [ha₀, if_pos hl]), hl, Bool.and_true, Bool.and_comm r q, σ_mul_self]
      · rw [if_neg (by rw [ha₀, if_neg hl]; exact fun e => hka e.symm), Bool.eq_false_iff.2 hl]
        simp
    rw [actLin_eq L f i y q a hia,
      actLin_ne L (actOwner f i) (Sum.inl ⟨k, Ne.symm hik⟩) z r a hka,
      actLin_ne L f k z r a hka,
      actLin_eq L (actOwner f k) (Sum.inl ⟨i, hik⟩) y q a hia,
      comp_tw_left _ _ _ hy,
      GrOperad.comp_map_left (actNe (Y := D) f k a hka) ⟨i, hia⟩ ⟨Sum.inl ⟨i, hik⟩, hia⟩
        (Subtype.ext rfl)]
    simp only [GrOperad.map_tw, map_smul, smul_smul]
    rw [show actOwner (Y := Y) f i (Sum.inl ⟨k, Ne.symm hik⟩) = f k from rfl, hs, one_smul]
    simp only [← GrOperad.map_trans]
    congr 1
    apply gmap_congr
    rintro (⟨⟨t, ht⟩, hne⟩ | b) <;> rfl
  · have hs : σ R ((q && ltB L (f i) a) && r) = if a = a₀ then σ R (q && r) else 1 := by
      subst hka
      by_cases hl : ltB L (f k) (f i)
      · rw [if_neg (by rw [ha₀, if_pos hl]; exact fun e => hia e.symm), ltB_swap L
          (Ne.symm hia), hl]
        simp
      · rw [if_pos (by rw [ha₀, if_neg hl]), ltB_swap L (Ne.symm hia), Bool.eq_false_iff.2 hl]
        simp
    rw [actLin_ne L f i y q a hia,
      actLin_eq L (actOwner f i) (Sum.inl ⟨k, Ne.symm hik⟩) z r a hka,
      actLin_eq L f k z r a hka,
      actLin_ne L (actOwner f k) (Sum.inl ⟨i, hik⟩) y q a hia,
      comp_tw_left _ _ _ hz,
      GrOperad.comp_map_left (actNe (Y := Y) f i a hia) ⟨k, hka⟩
        ⟨Sum.inl ⟨k, Ne.symm hik⟩, hka⟩ (Subtype.ext rfl)]
    simp only [GrOperad.map_tw, map_smul]
    rw [hs, show actOwner (Y := D) f k (Sum.inl ⟨i, hik⟩) = f i from rfl]
    simp only [← GrOperad.map_trans]
    congr 1
    congr 1
    apply gmap_congr
    rintro (⟨⟨t, ht⟩, hne⟩ | d) <;> rfl
  · have ha : a ≠ a₀ := by
      rw [ha₀]
      split_ifs
      · exact Ne.symm hia
      · exact Ne.symm hka
    rw [actLin_ne L f i y q a hia,
      actLin_ne L (actOwner f i) (Sum.inl ⟨k, Ne.symm hik⟩) z r a hka,
      actLin_ne L f k z r a hka,
      actLin_ne L (actOwner f k) (Sum.inl ⟨i, hik⟩) y q a hia, if_neg ha, one_smul]
    simp only [GrOperad.map_tw, GrOperad.tw_tw', ← GrOperad.map_trans]
    rw [show actOwner (Y := Y) f i (Sum.inl ⟨k, Ne.symm hik⟩) = f k from rfl,
      show actOwner (Y := D) f k (Sum.inl ⟨i, hik⟩) = f i from rfl, Bool.xor_comm]
    congr 1
    apply gmap_congr
    intro b
    exact Subtype.ext rfl

name: Operad.GrComposite.map_act_par
statement:
lemma map_act_par {D : Type} [Fintype D] [DecidableEq D] {i k : S} (hik : i ≠ k) {q r : Bool}
    {y : C Y} {z : C D} (hy : GrOperad.par (R := R) q y = y)
    (hz : GrOperad.par (R := R) r z = z) (x : GrComposite R V C S) :
    map (parEquiv hik Y D) (act R V (Sum.inl ⟨k, Ne.symm hik⟩) z (act R V i y x))
      = σ R (q && r) • act R V (Sum.inl ⟨i, hik⟩) y (act R V k z x)
proof:
:= by
  have h : (map (R := R) (M := V) (N := C) (parEquiv hik Y D)).comp
      ((act R V (Sum.inl ⟨k, Ne.symm hik⟩) z).comp (act R V i y))
      = σ R (q && r) • (act R V (Sum.inl ⟨i, hik⟩) y).comp (act R V k z) := hom_ext fun g => by
    simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearMap.smul_apply, act_mk, actFun]
    exact map_actOwn_par _ _ _ _ hik y z hy hz
  exact LinearMap.congr_fun h x

name: Operad.kap_unit
statement:
lemma kap_unit {A D : Type} [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] [Fintype D] [DecidableEq D]
    (f : ConvOp R C P D) {g : ConvOp R C P A}
    (hg : ∀ x ∈ GrCooperad.unitSpan R C A, ConvOp.toLin g x = 0)
    (a : C D) {b : C A} (hb : b ∈ GrCooperad.unitSpan R C A) :
    ConvOp.kap f g (a ⊗ₜ b) = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp only [ConvOp.kap, LinearMap.coe_sum, Finset.sum_apply, TensorProduct.map_tmul]
  refine Finset.sum_eq_zero fun q _ => ?_
  rw [ConvOp.parC_apply]
  have : ∀ c : Bool, ConvOp.toLin g (GrSpecies.par (R := R) c b) = 0 := fun c =>
    hg _ (GrCooperad.unitSpan_le_comap_par c hb)
  simp [this]

name: Operad.star_unit
statement:
lemma star_unit (α β : GrOperad.Inv R (ConvOp R C P)) (hβ : KillsUnit R C P β)
    {A : Type} [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] {x : C A} (hx : x ∈ GrCooperad.unitSpan R C A) :
    ConvOp.toLin ((GrOperad.Inv.star R _ α β).1 A) x = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [GrOperad.Inv.star_apply, ConvOp.toLin_sum, LinearMap.coe_sum, Finset.sum_apply]
  refine Finset.sum_eq_zero fun S _ => ?_
  show ConvOp.toLin (ConvOp.mapC (splitEquiv S)
    (ConvOp.compC none (α.1 (SOut S)) (β.1 (SIn S)))) x = 0
  rw [ConvOp.mapC_apply, ConvOp.toLin_compC, LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearMap.comp_apply]
  have hmem : GrCooperad.decomp (R := R) (C := C) (none : SOut S)
      (SymSpecies.map (R := R) (splitEquiv S).symm x)
      ∈ Submodule.map₂ (TensorProduct.mk R (C (SOut S)) (C (SIn S)))
          (GrCooperad.unitSpan R C (SOut S)) (GrCooperad.unitSpan R C (SIn S)) := by
    have hx' := GrCooperad.unitSpan_le_comap_map (R := R) (C := C) (splitEquiv S).symm hx
    have key : GrCooperad.unitSpan R C (Without (SOut S) none ⊕ SIn S)
        ≤ Submodule.comap (GrCooperad.decomp (R := R) (C := C) (none : SOut S))
          (Submodule.map₂ (TensorProduct.mk R (C (SOut S)) (C (SIn S)))
            (GrCooperad.unitSpan R C (SOut S)) (GrCooperad.unitSpan R C (SIn S))) := by
      rw [GrCooperad.unitSpan, GrCooperad.unitSpanOf, Submodule.span_le]
      rintro _ ⟨e, rfl⟩
      exact GrCooperad.Coaug.decomp_mem none e
    exact key hx'
  have hk : ∀ t ∈ Submodule.map₂ (TensorProduct.mk R (C (SOut S)) (C (SIn S)))
      (GrCooperad.unitSpan R C (SOut S)) (GrCooperad.unitSpan R C (SIn S)),
      ConvOp.kap (α.1 (SOut S)) (β.1 (SIn S)) t = 0 := by
    intro t ht
    refine (Submodule.map₂_le.2 ?_ : Submodule.map₂ _ _ _ ≤ LinearMap.ker
      (ConvOp.kap (α.1 (SOut S)) (β.1 (SIn S)))) ht
    intro a _ b hb
    exact kap_unit _ (fun y hy => hβ _ y hy) a hb
  rw [hk _ hmem, map_zero, map_zero]

name: Operad.map_range_map_subtype_le
statement:
lemma map_range_map_subtype_le {M M' N N' : Type*} [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M]
    [AddCommGroup M'] [Module R M'] [AddCommGroup N] [Module R N] [AddCommGroup N']
    [Module R N'] (f : M →ₗ[R] M') (g : N →ₗ[R] N') (p : Submodule R M) (q : Submodule R N) :
    (LinearMap.range (TensorProduct.map p.subtype q.subtype)).map (TensorProduct.map f g)
      ≤ LinearMap.range (TensorProduct.map (p.map f).subtype (q.map g).subtype)
proof:
:= by
  rintro _ ⟨_, ⟨t, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
  refine ⟨TensorProduct.map (f.submoduleMap p) (g.submoduleMap q) t, ?_⟩
  rw [← LinearMap.comp_apply (TensorProduct.map _ _), ← TensorProduct.map_comp,
    ← LinearMap.comp_apply (TensorProduct.map f g), ← TensorProduct.map_comp]
  rfl

name: Operad.FreeGr.eq_leaf_of_vtx
statement: lemma eq_leaf_of_vtx {x : Reg (TreeOfArity T) A} (h : vtx x = 0) : treeOf x = .leaf
proof:
:= by
  unfold vtx FreeReg.cntR at h
  revert h
  cases treeOf x with
  | leaf => exact fun _ => rfl
  | node e fo =>
    intro h
    simp only [Tree.cnt_node] at h
    omega

name: Operad.FreeGr.wtZero_le_wtOne
statement: lemma wtZero_le_wtOne : wtZero R gp A ≤ wtOne R gp A
proof:
:=
  Submodule.span_mono fun _ ⟨x, hx, h⟩ => ⟨x, by omega, h⟩

name: Operad.FreeGr.wtZero_le_unitSpan
statement: lemma wtZero_le_unitSpan : wtZero R gp A ≤ GrCooperad.unitSpan R (FreeGr R gp) A
proof:
:= by
  rw [wtZero, Submodule.span_le]
  rintro _ ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨e, rfl⟩ := eq_map_one_of_leaf x (eq_leaf_of_vtx hx)
  rw [← SgnLin.map_bas]
  exact GrCooperad.map_one_mem (R := R) (C := FreeGr R gp) e

name: Operad.FreeGr.par_mem_wtOne
statement:
lemma par_mem_wtOne (b : Bool) {z : FreeGr R gp A} (hz : z ∈ wtOne R gp A) :
    GrOperad.par (R := R) b z ∈ wtOne R gp A
proof:
:= by
  refine (Submodule.span_le (p := (wtOne R gp A).comap (GrOperad.par (R := R) b))).2 ?_ hz
  rintro _ ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
  rw [SetLike.mem_coe, Submodule.mem_comap, par_bas_eq]
  split_ifs
  · exact Submodule.subset_span ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
  · exact zero_mem _

name: Operad.FreeGr.map_mem_wtOne
statement:
lemma map_mem_wtOne (e : A ≃ B) {z : FreeGr R gp A} (hz : z ∈ wtOne R gp A) :
    GrOperad.map (R := R) e z ∈ wtOne R gp B
proof:
:= by
  refine (Submodule.span_le (p := (wtOne R gp B).comap (GrOperad.map (R := R) e))).2 ?_ hz
  rintro _ ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
  rw [SetLike.mem_coe, Submodule.mem_comap, SgnLin.map_bas]
  exact Submodule.subset_span ⟨_, by rw [vtx, FreeReg.cntR_map]; exact hx, rfl⟩

name: Operad.FreeGr.decomp_bas_mem_wtOne
statement:
lemma decomp_bas_mem_wtOne (i : A) (x : Reg (TreeOfArity T) (Without A i ⊕ B))
    (hx : vtx x ≤ 1) :
    GrCooperad.decomp (R := R) (C := FreeGr R gp) i (SgnLin.bas (treeSgn gp) R x)
      ∈ LinearMap.range (TensorProduct.map (wtZero R gp A).subtype (wtOne R gp B).subtype)
        ⊔ LinearMap.range (TensorProduct.map (wtOne R gp A).subtype (wtZero R gp B).subtype)
proof:
:= by
  have e : GrCooperad.decomp (R := R) (C := FreeGr R gp) i (SgnLin.bas (treeSgn gp) R x)
      = ∑ pq ∈ (SetOperad.FiniteFact.finite i x).toFinset,
          σ R (SgnData.sgn i ((treeSgn gp).app A pq.1) ((treeSgn gp).app B pq.2)) •
            ((SgnLin.bas (treeSgn gp) R pq.1 : FreeGr R gp A) ⊗ₜ[R]
              (SgnLin.bas (treeSgn gp) R pq.2 : FreeGr R gp B)) := by
    have h := SgnLin.decompT_single (R := R) (δ := treeSgn gp) i x 1
    simp only [mul_one] at h
    exact h
  rw [e]
  refine Submodule.sum_mem _ fun pq hpq => Submodule.smul_mem _ _ ?_
  have h := (SgnLin.mem_fact_iff i x pq).1 hpq
  have hv : vtx pq.1 + vtx pq.2 ≤ 1 := by
    rw [vtx, vtx, ← FreeReg.cntR_comp, h]
    exact hx
  rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos (vtx pq.1) with h1 | h1
  · exact Submodule.mem_sup_left ⟨⟨_, Submodule.subset_span ⟨pq.1, h1, rfl⟩⟩ ⊗ₜ
      ⟨_, Submodule.subset_span ⟨pq.2, by omega, rfl⟩⟩, rfl⟩
  · exact Submodule.mem_sup_right ⟨⟨_, Submodule.subset_span ⟨pq.1, by omega, rfl⟩⟩ ⊗ₜ
      ⟨_, Submodule.subset_span ⟨pq.2, by omega, rfl⟩⟩, rfl⟩

name: Operad.FreeGr.decomp_mem_wtOne
statement:
lemma decomp_mem_wtOne (i : A) {z : FreeGr R gp (Without A i ⊕ B)}
    (hz : z ∈ wtOne R gp (Without A i ⊕ B)) :
    GrCooperad.decomp (R := R) (C := FreeGr R gp) i z
      ∈ LinearMap.range (TensorProduct.map (wtZero R gp A).subtype (wtOne R gp B).subtype)
        ⊔ LinearMap.range (TensorProduct.map (wtOne R gp A).subtype (wtZero R gp B).subtype)
proof:
:= by
  have key : wtOne R gp (Without A i ⊕ B)
      ≤ Submodule.comap (GrCooperad.decomp (R := R) (C := FreeGr R gp) i)
        (LinearMap.range (TensorProduct.map (wtZero R gp A).subtype (wtOne R gp B).subtype)
          ⊔ LinearMap.range (TensorProduct.map (wtOne R gp A).subtype
            (wtZero R gp B).subtype)) := by
    rw [wtOne, Submodule.span_le]
    rintro _ ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
    exact decomp_bas_mem_wtOne i x hx
  exact key hz

name: Operad.FreeGrL.wtZeroL_le_wtOneL
statement: lemma wtZeroL_le_wtOneL : wtZeroL R V A ≤ wtOneL R V A
proof:
:=
  Submodule.map_mono FreeGr.wtZero_le_wtOne

name: Operad.FreeGrL.wtZeroL_le_unitSpan
statement: lemma wtZeroL_le_unitSpan : wtZeroL R V A ≤ GrCooperad.unitSpan R (FreeGrL R V) A
proof:
:=
  (Submodule.map_mono FreeGr.wtZero_le_unitSpan).trans ((linCoideal R V).proj_unitSpan_le)

name: Operad.FreeGrL.decomp_mem_wtOneL
statement:
lemma decomp_mem_wtOneL (i : A) {y : FreeGrL R V (Without A i ⊕ B)}
    (hy : y ∈ wtOneL R V (Without A i ⊕ B)) :
    GrCooperad.decomp (R := R) (C := FreeGrL R V) i y
      ∈ LinearMap.range (TensorProduct.map (wtZeroL R V A).subtype (wtOneL R V B).subtype)
        ⊔ LinearMap.range (TensorProduct.map (wtOneL R V A).subtype (wtZeroL R V B).subtype)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨z, hz, rfl⟩ := hy
  have h := FreeGr.decomp_mem_wtOne i hz
  have hm := Submodule.mem_map_of_mem (f := TensorProduct.map
    ((GrOperadIdeal.span R (grLinRel R V)).proj A) ((GrOperadIdeal.span R (grLinRel R V)).proj B)) h
  rw [Submodule.map_sup] at hm
  have hle := sup_le_sup
    (map_range_map_subtype_le ((GrOperadIdeal.span R (grLinRel R V)).proj A)
      ((GrOperadIdeal.span R (grLinRel R V)).proj B) (FreeGr.wtZero R (grGenPar R V) A)
      (FreeGr.wtOne R (grGenPar R V) B))
    (map_range_map_subtype_le ((GrOperadIdeal.span R (grLinRel R V)).proj A)
      ((GrOperadIdeal.span R (grLinRel R V)).proj B) (FreeGr.wtOne R (grGenPar R V) A)
      (FreeGr.wtZero R (grGenPar R V) B))
  exact hle hm

name: Operad.FreeGrL.ι_mem_wtOneL
statement: lemma ι_mem_wtOneL (w : V A) : (ι R V).app A w ∈ wtOneL R V A
proof:
:= by
  have h : ∀ n (v : V (Fin n)), (ι R V).app (Fin n) v ∈ wtOneL R V (Fin n) := by
    intro n v
    rw [ι_app_fin]
    refine add_mem ⟨_, Submodule.subset_span ⟨_, ?_, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
      ⟨_, Submodule.subset_span ⟨_, ?_, rfl⟩, rfl⟩ <;>
    · rw [FreeGr.vtx, FreeReg.cntR_std]
  have e := Fintype.equivFin A
  have hw : w = SymSpecies.map (R := R) e.symm (SymSpecies.map (R := R) e w) := by
    rw [SymSpecies.map_symm_map]
  rw [hw, (ι R V).app_map]
  obtain ⟨z, hz, hz'⟩ := h _ (SymSpecies.map (R := R) e w)
  rw [← hz']
  exact ⟨_, FreeGr.map_mem_wtOne e.symm hz, rfl⟩

name: Operad.Koszul.kapL_ι
statement:
lemma kapL_ι {A : Type} [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] (w : E A) :
    kapL R E A ((FreeGrL.ι R (GrSpecies.Shift E R)).app A (GrSpecies.Shift.of A w))
      = (FreeGrL.ι R E).app A w
proof:
:= by
  rw [kapL, LinearMap.comp_apply, epsHom, FreeGrL.homEquiv_symm_ι]
  exact rfl

name: Operad.Koszul.kapL_map
statement:
lemma kapL_map {A B : Type} [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] [Fintype B] [DecidableEq B] (e : A ≃ B)
    (x : Cut R E A) :
    kapL R E B (GrOperad.map (R := R) e x) = GrOperad.map (R := R) e (kapL R E A x)
proof:
:= by
  rw [kapL, LinearMap.comp_apply, (epsHom R E).app_map]
  rfl

name: Operad.Koszul.kapL_par
statement:
lemma kapL_par {A : Type} [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] (c : Bool) (x : Cut R E A) :
    kapL R E A (GrOperad.par (R := R) c x) = GrOperad.par (R := R) (!c) (kapL R E A x)
proof:
:= by
  rw [kapL, LinearMap.comp_apply, (epsHom R E).app_par, ← Bool.xor_true]
  rfl

name: Operad.Koszul.kapL_one
statement: lemma kapL_one : kapL R E Unit (GrOperad.one (R := R)) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [kapL, LinearMap.comp_apply, (epsHom R E).app_one]
  rfl

name: Operad.Koszul.kapT_apply
statement:
lemma kapT_apply (A : Type) [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] :
    (kapT R E).1 A = ConvOp.of (kapL R E A)
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.Koszul.isPar_kapT
statement: lemma isPar_kapT : GrOperad.Inv.IsPar true (kapT R E)
proof:
:= by
  intro A _ _
  show ConvOp.parC true (ConvOp.of (kapL R E A)) = ConvOp.of (kapL R E A)
  rw [ConvOp.parC_eq_self_iff]
  intro c x
  rw [ConvOp.toLin_of, Bool.xor_true]
  exact kapL_par c x

name: Operad.Koszul.killsUnit_kapT
statement: lemma killsUnit_kapT : KillsUnit R (Cut R E) (FreeGrL R E) (kapT R E)
proof:
:= by
  intro A _ _ x hx
  rw [kapT_apply, ConvOp.toLin_of]
  refine Submodule.span_induction (p := fun x _ => kapL R E A x = 0) ?_ (map_zero _) ?_ ?_ hx
  · rintro _ ⟨e, rfl⟩
    show kapL R E A (GrOperad.map (R := R) e (GrOperad.one (R := R))) = 0
    rw [kapL_map, kapL_one, map_zero]
  · intro x y _ _ hx hy
    beta_reduce at hx hy ⊢
    rw [map_add, hx, hy, add_zero]
  · intro a x _ hx
    beta_reduce at hx ⊢
    rw [map_smul, hx, smul_zero]

name: Operad.Koszul.unitSub_le
statement: lemma unitSub_le : GrSubCooperad.unitSub R (Cut R E) ≤ dualSub R E r
proof:
:=
  GrSubCooperad.le_cogen _ fun A _ _ x hx => by
    show ConvOp.toLin ((GrOperad.Inv.star R _ (kapT R E) (kapT R E)).1 A) x
      ∈ (GrOperadIdeal.span R r).sub A
    rw [star_unit _ _ killsUnit_kapT hx]
    exact zero_mem _

name: Operad.Koszul.le_dualSub
statement:
lemma le_dualSub {K : GrSubCooperad R (Cut R E)}
    (hK : ∀ (A : Type) [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] (x : Cut R E A), x ∈ K.sub A →
      ConvOp.toLin ((GrOperad.Inv.star R _ (kapT R E) (kapT R E)).1 A) x
        ∈ (GrOperadIdeal.span R r).sub A) :
    K ≤ dualSub R E r
proof:
:=
  GrSubCooperad.le_cogen _ fun A _ _ x hx => hK A x hx

name: Operad.Koszul.kappa_apply
statement:
lemma kappa_apply {A : Type} [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] (x : Dual R E r A) :
    ConvOp.toLin ((kappa R E r).1 A) x
      = (GrOperadIdeal.span R r).proj A (kapL R E A ((dualSub R E r).incl A x))
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.Koszul.isPar_kappa
statement: lemma isPar_kappa : GrOperad.Inv.IsPar true (kappa R E r)
proof:
:= by
  intro A _ _
  show GrOperad.par (R := R) true ((ConvOp.postHom (C := Dual R E r)
      (GrOperadHom.toZeroDG (GrOperadIdeal.span R r).projHom)).app A
      ((ConvOp.preHom (P := FreeGrL R E) (dualSub R E r).inclHom).app A ((kapT R E).1 A))) = _
  rw [← GrOperadHom.app_par, ← GrOperadHom.app_par, isPar_kapT A]
  rfl

name: Operad.Koszul.incl_unitSpan
proof:
:= by
  refine Submodule.span_induction (p := fun x _ => (dualSub R E r).incl A x
      ∈ GrCooperad.unitSpan R (Cut R E) A) ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ hx
  · rintro _ ⟨e, rfl⟩
    exact GrCooperad.map_one_mem (R := R) (C := Cut R E) e
  · beta_reduce
    rw [map_zero]
    exact zero_mem _
  · intro x y _ _ hx hy
    beta_reduce at hx hy ⊢
    rw [map_add]
    exact add_mem hx hy
  · intro a x _ hx
    beta_reduce at hx ⊢
    rw [map_smul]
    exact Submodule.smul_mem _ a hx

name: Operad.Koszul.killsUnit_kappa
statement: lemma killsUnit_kappa : KillsUnit R (Dual R E r) (ZeroDG R (Pres R E r)) (kappa R E r)
proof:
:= by
  intro A _ _ x hx
  rw [kappa_apply]
  have h := killsUnit_kapT (R := R) (E := E) A _ (incl_unitSpan r hx)
  rw [kapT_apply, ConvOp.toLin_of] at h
  rw [h, map_zero]
  rfl

name: Operad.Koszul.mc_kappa
statement:
theorem mc_kappa :
    GrOperad.Inv.appDer (ConvOp.postDer (C := Dual R E r)
        (DGOperad.toDer (R := R) (P := ZeroDG R (Pres R E r)))) (kappa R E r)
      + GrOperad.Inv.star R _ (kappa R E r) (kappa R E r) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : GrOperad.Inv.appDer (ConvOp.postDer (C := Dual R E r)
      (DGOperad.toDer (R := R) (P := ZeroDG R (Pres R E r)))) (kappa R E r) = 0 :=
    Subtype.ext (funext fun A => funext fun _ => funext fun _ => ConvOp.ext fun x => by
      rw [ConvOp.appDer_postDer_apply]
      exact LinearMap.zero_apply _)
  have h2 : GrOperad.Inv.star R _ (kappa R E r) (kappa R E r) = 0 := by
    have e1 := GrOperad.Inv.appHom_star
      (ConvOp.preHom (P := FreeGrL R E) (dualSub R E r).inclHom) (kapT R E) (kapT R E)
    have e2 := GrOperad.Inv.appHom_star (ConvOp.postHom (C := Dual R E r)
      (GrOperadHom.toZeroDG (GrOperadIdeal.span R r).projHom))
      (GrOperad.Inv.appHom (ConvOp.preHom (P := FreeGrL R E) (dualSub R E r).inclHom)
        (kapT R E))
      (GrOperad.Inv.appHom (ConvOp.preHom (P := FreeGrL R E) (dualSub R E r).inclHom)
        (kapT R E))
    refine (e2.symm.trans ?_)
    rw [← e1]
    refine Subtype.ext (funext fun A => funext fun _ => funext fun _ => ConvOp.ext fun x => ?_)
    show (GrOperadIdeal.span R r).proj A (ConvOp.toLin
      ((GrOperad.Inv.star R _ (kapT R E) (kapT R E)).1 A) ((dualSub R E r).incl A x)) = 0
    rw [GrOperadIdeal.proj_eq_zero_iff]
    exact GrSubCooperad.cogen_le (admissible R E r) A x.2
  exact (congrArg₂ (· + ·) h1 h2).trans (add_zero 0)

name: Operad.Koszul.kap_unit_left
proof:
:= by
  simp only [ConvOp.kap, LinearMap.coe_sum, Finset.sum_apply, TensorProduct.map_tmul]
  refine Finset.sum_eq_zero fun q _ => ?_
  rw [LinearMap.comp_apply, hf, TensorProduct.zero_tmul]
  rw [GrSpecies.tw_apply]
  exact add_mem (GrCooperad.unitSpan_le_comap_par false ha)
    (Submodule.smul_mem _ _ (GrCooperad.unitSpan_le_comap_par true ha))

name: Operad.Koszul.star_wtOne
proof:
:= by
  rw [GrOperad.Inv.star_apply, ConvOp.toLin_sum, LinearMap.coe_sum, Finset.sum_apply]
  refine Finset.sum_eq_zero fun S _ => ?_
  show ConvOp.toLin (ConvOp.mapC (splitEquiv S)
    (ConvOp.compC none ((kapT R E).1 (SOut S)) ((kapT R E).1 (SIn S)))) x = 0
  rw [ConvOp.mapC_apply, ConvOp.toLin_compC, LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearMap.comp_apply]
  have hx' : SymSpecies.map (R := R) (splitEquiv S).symm x
      ∈ FreeGrL.wtOneL R (GrSpecies.Shift E R) _ :=
    (FreeGrL.wtOneSub R (GrSpecies.Shift E R)).map_mem _ hx
  have hk := FreeGrL.decomp_mem_wtOneL (none : SOut S) hx'
  have h1 : LinearMap.range (TensorProduct.map
      (FreeGrL.wtZeroL R (GrSpecies.Shift E R) (SOut S)).subtype
      (FreeGrL.wtOneL R (GrSpecies.Shift E R) (SIn S)).subtype) ≤ LinearMap.ker (ConvOp.kap
      ((kapT R E).1 (SOut S)) ((kapT R E).1 (SIn S))) := by
    rintro _ ⟨t, rfl⟩
    induction t using TensorProduct.induction_on with
    | zero => simp
    | tmul a b =>
      rw [LinearMap.mem_ker, TensorProduct.map_tmul]
      exact kap_unit_left (fun y hy => killsUnit_kapT _ y hy) _
        (FreeGrL.wtZeroL_le_unitSpan a.2) _
    | add t t' ht ht' =>
      rw [LinearMap.mem_ker, map_add, map_add]
      rw [LinearMap.mem_ker] at ht ht'
      rw [ht, ht', add_zero]
  have h2 : LinearMap.range (TensorProduct.map
      (FreeGrL.wtOneL R (GrSpecies.Shift E R) (SOut S)).subtype
      (FreeGrL.wtZeroL R (GrSpecies.Shift E R) (SIn S)).subtype) ≤ LinearMap.ker (ConvOp.kap
      ((kapT R E).1 (SOut S)) ((kapT R E).1 (SIn S))) := by
    rintro _ ⟨t, rfl⟩
    induction t using TensorProduct.induction_on with
    | zero => simp
    | tmul a b =>
      rw [LinearMap.mem_ker, TensorProduct.map_tmul]
      exact kap_unit _ (fun y hy => killsUnit_kapT _ y hy) _ (FreeGrL.wtZeroL_le_unitSpan b.2)
    | add t t' ht ht' =>
      rw [LinearMap.mem_ker, map_add, map_add]
      rw [LinearMap.mem_ker] at ht ht'
      rw [ht, ht', add_zero]
  rw [LinearMap.mem_ker.1 (sup_le h1 h2 hk), map_zero, map_zero]

name: Operad.Koszul.wtOneSub_le
statement: lemma wtOneSub_le : FreeGrL.wtOneSub R (GrSpecies.Shift E R) ≤ dualSub R E r
proof:
:=
  le_dualSub r fun A _ _ x hx => by
    rw [star_wtOne hx]
    exact zero_mem _

name: Operad.Koszul.ι_mem_dual
statement:
theorem ι_mem_dual {A : Type} [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] (w : E A) :
    (FreeGrL.ι R (GrSpecies.Shift E R)).app A (GrSpecies.Shift.of A w)
      ∈ (dualSub R E r).sub A
proof:
:=
  wtOneSub_le r A (FreeGrL.ι_mem_wtOneL _)

name: Operad.LTree.wt_leaf
statement: @[simp] lemma wt_leaf (l : E → K) (a : ℕ) : wt l (leaf a : LTree E) = 1
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.LTree.wt_node
statement:
@[simp] lemma wt_node (l : E → K) (e : E) (a b : LTree E) :
    wt l (node e a b) = l e * wt l a * wt l b
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.LTree.wt_mapDec
statement:
lemma wt_mapDec {F : Type*} (f : E → F) (l : F → K) :
    ∀ t : LTree E, wt l (t.mapDec f) = wt (l ∘ f) t
  | leaf _ => rfl
  | node e a b => by
    simp only [mapDec_node, wt_node, wt_mapDec f l a, wt_mapDec f l b, Function.comp_apply]

name: Operad.LTree.wt_plug
statement:
lemma wt_plug (l : E → K) (ins : ℕ → LTree E) :
    ∀ m : LTree E, wt l (m.plug ins) = wt l m * (m.labels.map fun a => wt l (ins a)).prod
  | leaf a => by simp [plug, labels]
