  | node e a b => by
    simp only [plug, wt_node, wt_plug l ins a, wt_plug l ins b, labels, List.map_append,
      List.prod_append]
    ring

name: Operad.LTree.wt_replaceAt
statement:
lemma wt_replaceAt (l : E → K) :
    ∀ (t : LTree E) (p : List Bool), (∃ e a b, t.subtreeAt p = node e a b) →
      ∃ c : K, ∀ u : LTree E, wt l (t.replaceAt p u) = c * wt l u
  | t, [], _ => ⟨1, fun u => by simp⟩
  | leaf _, _ :: _, h => by simp [subtreeAt] at h
  | node e a b, false :: p, h => by
    obtain ⟨c, hc⟩
proof:
:= wt_replaceAt l a p h
    exact ⟨l e * wt l b * c, fun u => by simp only [replaceAt, wt_node, hc]; ring⟩
  | node e a b, true :: p, h => by
    obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := wt_replaceAt l b p h
    exact ⟨l e * wt l a * c, fun u => by simp only [replaceAt, wt_node, hc]; ring⟩

name: Operad.LTree.wt_substAt
statement:
lemma wt_substAt (l : E → K) {t : LTree E} {p : List Bool} {s : Bool} (h : t.IsEdge p s) :
    ∃ c : K, ∀ m : LTree E, m.labels.Perm (List.range 3) →
      wt l (t.substAt p s m) = c * wt l m
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := wt_replaceAt l t p h.exists_node
  refine ⟨c * (wt l ((t.subtreeAt p).winIns s 0) * wt l ((t.subtreeAt p).winIns s 1)
    * wt l ((t.subtreeAt p).winIns s 2)), fun m hm => ?_⟩
  rw [substAt, hc, wt_plug, (hm.map _).prod_eq]
  simp only [List.range_succ, List.range_zero, List.nil_append, List.cons_append, List.map_cons,
    List.map_nil, List.prod_cons, List.prod_nil, mul_one]
  ring

name: Operad.ShuffleBar.wtB_eq
statement: lemma wtB_eq (l : E → K) (x : BarTree E) : wtB l x = wt l (x.mapDec Prod.fst)
proof:
:= by
  rw [wtB, wt_mapDec]

name: Operad.ShuffleBar.wt_mergeK
statement:
lemma wt_mergeK (l : E → K) : ∀ (x : BarTree E) (k : ℕ ×ₗ ℕ), wtB l (mergeK x k) = wtB l x
  | leaf _, _ => rfl
  | node d a b, k => by
    unfold mergeK
    split_ifs
    · rfl
    · have ha
proof:
:= wt_mergeK l a k
      have hb := wt_mergeK l b k
      simp only [wtB, wt_node] at ha hb ⊢
      rw [ha, hb]

name: Operad.ShuffleBar.wt_substBar
statement:
lemma wt_substBar (l : E → K) {x : BarTree E} {p : List Bool} {s : Bool} (h : x.IsEdge p s) :
    ∃ c : K, ∀ σ : LTree E, σ.labels.Perm (List.range 3) →
      wtB l (substBar x p s σ) = c * wt l σ
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := wt_substAt (l ∘ Prod.fst) h
  refine ⟨c, fun σ hσ => ?_⟩
  rw [wtB, substBar, hc _ (by rwa [labels_liftW])]
  congr 1
  rw [← wt_mapDec Prod.fst l, liftW_mapDec]

name: Operad.ShuffleBar.wt_mul
statement:
lemma wt_mul (l l' : E → K) : ∀ t : LTree E, wt (l * l') t = wt l t * wt l' t
  | leaf _ => by simp
  | node e a b => by
    simp only [wt_node, wt_mul l l' a, wt_mul l l' b, Pi.mul_apply]
    ring

name: Operad.ShuffleBar.wt_one
statement:
lemma wt_one : ∀ t : LTree E, wt (1 : E → K) t = 1
  | leaf _ => rfl
  | node e a b => by simp [wt_one a, wt_one b]

variable (K : Type u) [Field K]

                                                                                 
noncomputable def scaleBar (l : E → K) : (BarTree E →₀ K) →ₗ[K] (BarTree E →₀ K)
proof:
:=
  Finsupp.linearCombination K fun x => wtB l x • Finsupp.single x 1

name: Operad.ShuffleBar.scaleBar_single
statement:
lemma scaleBar_single (l : E → K) (x : BarTree E) (c : K) :
    scaleBar K l (Finsupp.single x c) = (c * wtB l x) • Finsupp.single x 1
proof:
:= by
  simp [scaleBar]

name: Operad.ShuffleBar.scaleBar_scaleBar
statement:
lemma scaleBar_scaleBar (l l' : E → K) (v : BarTree E →₀ K) :
    scaleBar K l (scaleBar K l' v) = scaleBar K (l * l') v
proof:
:= by
  induction v using Finsupp.induction_linear with
  | zero => simp
  | add v w hv hw => simp only [map_add, hv, hw]
  | single x c =>
    rw [scaleBar_single, map_smul, scaleBar_single, scaleBar_single, smul_smul, wtB, wtB, wtB,
      show ((l * l') ∘ Prod.fst : E × Bool → K) = (l ∘ Prod.fst) * (l' ∘ Prod.fst) from rfl,
      wt_mul]
    ring_nf

name: Operad.ShuffleBar.scaleBar_one
statement: lemma scaleBar_one (v : BarTree E →₀ K) : scaleBar K (1 : E → K) v = v
proof:
:= by
  induction v using Finsupp.induction_linear with
  | zero => simp
  | add v w hv hw => simp only [map_add, hv, hw]
  | single x c =>
    rw [scaleBar_single, wtB, show ((1 : E → K) ∘ Prod.fst : E × Bool → K) = 1 from rfl, wt_one,
      mul_one, Finsupp.smul_single, smul_eq_mul, mul_one]

name: Operad.ShuffleBar.d_scaleBar
statement:
theorem d_scaleBar (l : E → K) (v : BarTree E →₀ K) :
    d K (scaleBar K l v) = scaleBar K l (d K v)
proof:
:= by
  induction v using Finsupp.induction_linear with
  | zero => simp
  | add v w hv hw => simp only [map_add, hv, hw]
  | single x c =>
    rw [scaleBar_single, map_smul, d_single, one_smul, d_single, map_smul]
    simp only [dTree, map_sum, Finset.smul_sum, map_smul, scaleBar_single, wt_mergeK, smul_smul,
      one_mul]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun k _ => ?_
    ring_nf

name: Operad.ShuffleBar.scaleBar_inv
statement:
lemma scaleBar_inv (l : E → K) (hl : ∀ e, l e ≠ 0) (v : BarTree E →₀ K) :
    scaleBar K l (scaleBar K l⁻¹ v) = v
proof:
:= by
  rw [scaleBar_scaleBar, show l * l⁻¹ = 1 from funext fun e => mul_inv_cancel₀ (hl e),
    scaleBar_one]

name: Operad.ShuffleBar.scaleBar_inv'
statement:
lemma scaleBar_inv' (l : E → K) (hl : ∀ e, l e ≠ 0) (v : BarTree E →₀ K) :
    scaleBar K l⁻¹ (scaleBar K l v) = v
proof:
:= by
  rw [scaleBar_scaleBar, show l⁻¹ * l = 1 from funext fun e => inv_mul_cancel₀ (hl e),
    scaleBar_one]

name: Operad.ShuffleBar.rescale_rescale
statement:
lemma rescale_rescale (l l' : E → K) (r : Mono E 3 → K) :
    rescale K l (rescale K l' r) = rescale K (l * l') r
proof:
:= by
  funext σ
  simp only [rescale, LinearMap.coe_mk, AddHom.coe_mk, wt_mul]
  ring

name: Operad.ShuffleBar.rescale_one
statement: lemma rescale_one (r : Mono E 3 → K) : rescale K (1 : E → K) r = r
proof:
:= by
  funext σ
  simp [rescale, wt_one]

name: Operad.ShuffleBar.scaleBar_mem_C
statement:
lemma scaleBar_mem_C (l : E → K) {n s : ℕ} {v : BarTree E →₀ K} (hv : v ∈ C K n s) :
    scaleBar K l v ∈ C K n s
proof:
:= by
  rw [C, Finsupp.mem_supported] at hv ⊢
  intro x hx
  rw [Finset.mem_coe, Finsupp.mem_support_iff] at hx
  refine hv (Finset.mem_coe.2 (Finsupp.mem_support_iff.2 fun h0 => hx ?_))
  rw [scaleBar, Finsupp.linearCombination_apply, Finsupp.sum, Finset.sum_apply']
  refine Finset.sum_eq_zero fun y _ => ?_
  by_cases hxy : y = x
  · subst hxy
    simp [h0]
  · simp [hxy]

name: Operad.ShuffleBar.scaleBar_substRel
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := wt_substBar l h.1
  refine ⟨c, fun r => ?_⟩
  simp only [substRel, map_sum, map_smul, scaleBar_single, Finset.smul_sum, smul_smul]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun σ _ => ?_
  have hσ : σ.1.labels.Perm (List.range 3) := ((mem_monomials 3 σ.1).1 σ.2).2
  rw [hc σ.1 hσ]
  simp only [rescale, LinearMap.coe_mk, AddHom.coe_mk, one_mul]
  ring_nf

name: Operad.ShuffleBar.map_scaleBar_J_le
statement:
theorem map_scaleBar_J_le (l : E → K) (R : Submodule K (Mono E 3 → K)) :
    (J K R).map (scaleBar K l) ≤ J K (R.map (rescale K l))
proof:
:= by
  rw [Submodule.map_le_iff_le_comap, J, Submodule.span_le]
  rintro _ ⟨x, p, s, r, hx, h, hr, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := scaleBar_substRel K l h
  show scaleBar K l (substRel K x p s r) ∈ J K _
  rw [hc]
  exact Submodule.smul_mem _ _ (Submodule.subset_span
    ⟨x, p, s, rescale K l r, hx, h, Submodule.mem_map_of_mem hr, rfl⟩)

name: Operad.ShuffleBar.map_rescale_inv
statement:
lemma map_rescale_inv (l : E → K) (hl : ∀ e, l e ≠ 0) (R : Submodule K (Mono E 3 → K)) :
    (R.map (rescale K l)).map (rescale K l⁻¹) = R
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Submodule.map_comp, show (rescale K l⁻¹).comp (rescale K l) = LinearMap.id from
    LinearMap.ext fun r => by
      rw [LinearMap.comp_apply, rescale_rescale,
        show l⁻¹ * l = 1 from funext fun e => inv_mul_cancel₀ (hl e), rescale_one,
        LinearMap.id_apply],
    Submodule.map_id]

name: Operad.ShuffleBar.map_scaleBar_KD
statement:
theorem map_scaleBar_KD (l : E → K) (hl : ∀ e, l e ≠ 0) (R : Submodule K (Mono E 3 → K))
    (n : ℕ) : (KD K R n).map (scaleBar K l) = KD K (R.map (rescale K l)) n
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · rw [Submodule.map_le_iff_le_comap]
    intro v hv
    rw [KD, Submodule.mem_inf, Submodule.mem_comap] at hv
    refine Submodule.mem_comap.2 (Submodule.mem_inf.2 ⟨scaleBar_mem_C K l hv.1, ?_⟩)
    rw [Submodule.mem_comap, d_scaleBar]
    exact map_scaleBar_J_le K l R (Submodule.mem_map_of_mem hv.2)
  · intro w hw
    rw [KD, Submodule.mem_inf, Submodule.mem_comap] at hw
    refine ⟨scaleBar K l⁻¹ w, Submodule.mem_inf.2 ⟨scaleBar_mem_C K _ hw.1, ?_⟩,
      scaleBar_inv l hl w⟩
    rw [Submodule.mem_comap, d_scaleBar, ← map_rescale_inv l hl R]
    exact map_scaleBar_J_le K l⁻¹ _ (Submodule.mem_map_of_mem hw.2)

name: Operad.ShuffleBar.finrank_KD_rescale
statement:
theorem finrank_KD_rescale (l : E → K) (hl : ∀ e, l e ≠ 0) (R : Submodule K (Mono E 3 → K))
    (n : ℕ) : Module.finrank K (KD K (R.map (rescale K l)) n) = Module.finrank K (KD K R n)
proof:
:= by
  have hinj : Function.Injective (scaleBar K l) := fun v w h => by
    rw [← scaleBar_inv' l hl v, h, scaleBar_inv' l hl w]
  rw [← map_scaleBar_KD K l hl R n]
  exact LinearEquiv.finrank_eq (Submodule.equivMapOfInjective _ hinj _).symm

name: Operad.ShuffleBar.isKoszul_rescale
statement:
theorem isKoszul_rescale (l : E → K) (hl : ∀ e, l e ≠ 0) {R : Submodule K (Mono E 3 → K)}
    (hR : IsKoszul K R) : IsKoszul K (R.map (rescale K l))
proof:
:= by
  intro n s hs x hx hdx
  have hdx' : d K (scaleBar K l⁻¹ x) ∈ J K R := by
    rw [d_scaleBar, ← map_rescale_inv l hl R]
    exact map_scaleBar_J_le K l⁻¹ _ (Submodule.mem_map_of_mem hdx)
  obtain ⟨y, hy, hxy⟩ := hR n s hs _ (scaleBar_mem_C K l⁻¹ hx) hdx'
  refine ⟨scaleBar K l y, scaleBar_mem_C K l hy, ?_⟩
  have := map_scaleBar_J_le K l R (Submodule.mem_map_of_mem hxy)
  rwa [map_sub, scaleBar_inv l hl, ← d_scaleBar] at this

name: Operad.FreeGrL.derSp_mem_vx
statement:
lemma derSp_mem_vx {d : GrSpEnd R X true} {k : ℕ} {x : FreeGrL R X A} (hx : x ∈ vx R X k A) :
    (derSp d).app A x ∈ vx R X k A
proof:
:= by
  refine mem_eig.2 ?_
  rw [derSp_comm (a := GrSpEnd.id R X) (b := d) (fun A _ _ v => by
    rw [GrSpEnd.id_app, GrSpEnd.id_app, Bool.false_and, σ_false, one_smul]), Bool.false_and,
    σ_false, one_smul, mem_eig.1 hx, map_smul]

name: Operad.FreeGrL.vx_disjoint
statement: lemma vx_disjoint [Algebra ℚ R] (p : ℕ) : Disjoint (vx R X p A) (vxGe R X (p + 1) A)
proof:
:=
  (iSupIndep_eigenspace_nat _ p).mono_right
    (iSup_le fun k => le_iSup₂_of_le (f := fun (j : ℕ) (_ : j ≠ p) => vx R X j A) k.1
      (by have := k.2; omega) le_rfl)

name: Operad.FreeGrL.vxGe_eq
statement: lemma vxGe_eq (p : ℕ) : vxGe R X p A = vx R X p A ⊔ vxGe R X (p + 1) A
proof:
:= by
  refine le_antisymm (iSup_le fun k => ?_) (sup_le (le_iSup (fun k : {k : ℕ // p ≤ k} =>
    vx R X k.1 A) ⟨p, le_rfl⟩) (iSup_le fun k => le_iSup (fun k : {k : ℕ // p ≤ k} =>
    vx R X k.1 A) ⟨k.1, by have := k.2; omega⟩))
  rcases eq_or_lt_of_le k.2 with h | h
  · rw [← h]
    exact le_sup_left
  · exact le_sup_of_le_right (le_iSup (fun k : {k : ℕ // p + 1 ≤ k} => vx R X k.1 A) ⟨k.1, h⟩)

name: Operad.FreeGrL.vxGe_zero
statement: lemma vxGe_zero [Algebra ℚ R] : vxGe R X 0 A = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  refine eq_top_iff.2 ((iSup_eig_eq_top (a := GrSpEnd.id R X) (fun A _ _ v =>
    Submodule.mem_iSup_of_mem 1 (by
      rw [Module.End.mem_eigenspace_iff, Nat.cast_one, one_smul]
      rfl)) A).symm.le.trans (iSup_le fun k => ?_))
  exact le_iSup (fun k : {k : ℕ // 0 ≤ k} => vx R X k.1 A) ⟨k, Nat.zero_le k⟩

name: Operad.FreeGrL.vxGe_card
statement:
lemma vxGe_card [Algebra ℚ R]
    (hred : ∀ (B : Type) [Fintype B] [DecidableEq B], Fintype.card B ≤ 1 → ∀ v : X B, v = 0) :
    vxGe R X (Fintype.card A) A = ⊥
proof:
:=
  eq_bot_iff.2 (iSup_le fun k _ hx => (Submodule.mem_bot R).2 (eig_card_eq_bot hred k.2 hx))

name: Operad.FreeGrL.mem_vxGe
statement:
lemma mem_vxGe {p k : ℕ} (h : p ≤ k) {x : FreeGrL R X A} (hx : x ∈ vx R X k A) :
    x ∈ vxGe R X p A
proof:
:=
  Submodule.mem_iSup_of_mem (⟨k, h⟩ : {k : ℕ // p ≤ k}) hx

name: Operad.FreeGrL.ι_mem_vx
statement: lemma ι_mem_vx (v : X A) : (ι R X).app A v ∈ vx R X 1 A
proof:
:=
  mem_eig.2 (by
    rw [derSp_ι, Nat.cast_one, one_smul]
    rfl)

name: Operad.FreeGrL.mapSp_mem_vx
statement:
lemma mapSp_mem_vx {φ : GrSpeciesHom R X Y} {k : ℕ} {x : FreeGrL R X A} (hx : x ∈ vx R X k A) :
    (mapSp φ).app A x ∈ vx R Y k A
proof:
:=
  mem_eig.2 (by
    rw [derSp_mapSp (a := GrSpEnd.id R X) (b := GrSpEnd.id R Y) (fun _ _ _ _ => rfl),
      mem_eig.1 hx, map_smul])

name: Operad.FreeGrL.mapSp_mem_vxGe
statement:
lemma mapSp_mem_vxGe {φ : GrSpeciesHom R X Y} {p : ℕ} {x : FreeGrL R X A}
    (hx : x ∈ vxGe R X p A) : (mapSp φ).app A x ∈ vxGe R Y p A
proof:
:=
  (iSup_le (fun k _ hy => mem_vxGe k.2 (mapSp_mem_vx hy)) :
    vxGe R X p A ≤ (vxGe R Y p A).comap ((mapSp φ).app A)) hx

name: Operad.FreeGrL.totD_mem_vxGe
proof:
:=
  (iSup_le (fun k y hy => by
    rw [Submodule.mem_comap, totD, LinearMap.add_apply, LinearMap.neg_apply]
    exact add_mem (neg_mem (mem_vxGe k.2 (derSp_mem_vx hy)))
      (mem_vxGe (by have := k.2; omega) (hD k.1 y hy))) :
    vxGe R X p A ≤ (vxGe R X p A).comap (totD d D₁ A)) hx

name: Operad.FreeGrL.split_vx
proof:
:= vx_disjoint p
  dd x := hdd x
  mem₀ _ hu := neg_mem (derSp_mem_vx hu)
  mem₁ u hu := mem_vxGe le_rfl (hD p u hu)
  memW _ hw := totD_mem_vxGe hD hw

name: Operad.FreeGrL.der_vx_zero
statement:
lemma der_vx_zero [Algebra ℚ R] {e : Bool} {D : GrDer (GrOperadHom.id R (FreeGrL R X)) e}
    {x : FreeGrL R X A} (hx : x ∈ vx R X 0 A) : D.app A x = 0
proof:
:= by
  have h0 : D.compHom (mapSp (GrSpEnd.zero R X false).toHom) = GrDer.zero _ e :=
    der_eq_zero fun B _ _ v => by
      rw [GrDer.compHom_app, mapSp_ι, GrSpEnd.toHom_app, GrSpEnd.zero_app, map_zero, map_zero]
  have hx' : (mapSp (GrSpEnd.zero R X false).toHom).app A x = x :=
    mapSp_eq_self _ (fun _ _ _ _ => by rw [GrSpEnd.zero_app, GrSpEnd.zero_app]) (mem_eig.2 (by
      rw [derSp_congr (ψ := GrSpEnd.id R X) (fun _ _ _ v => by
        rw [GrSpEnd.compl_app, GrSpEnd.zero_app, sub_zero]
        rfl), mem_eig.1 hx]))
  rw [← hx', ← GrDer.compHom_app, h0]
  rfl

name: Operad.FreeGrL.comp_trunc_eq
statement:
private lemma comp_trunc_eq {g g' : GrSpeciesHom R X Y} {m : ℕ}
    (hg : ∀ (B : Type) [Fintype B] [DecidableEq B], Fintype.card B ≤ m →
      ∀ v : X B, g.app B v = g'.app B v)
    (B : Type) [Fintype B] [DecidableEq B] (v : X B) :
    (g.comp (GrSpEnd.trunc R X m).toHom).app B v
      = (g'.comp (GrSpEnd.trunc R X m).toHom).app B v
proof:
:= by
  rw [GrSpeciesHom.comp_app, GrSpeciesHom.comp_app, GrSpEnd.toHom_app, GrSpEnd.trunc_app]
  rcases le_or_gt (Fintype.card B) m with h | h
  · rw [if_pos h, one_smul, hg B h]
  · rw [if_neg (by omega), zero_smul, map_zero, map_zero]

name: Operad.FreeGrL.mapSp_eq_of_card_le
statement:
theorem mapSp_eq_of_card_le (hA : Fintype.card A ≤ m) (x : FreeGrL R X A) :
    (mapSp g).app A x = (mapSp g').app A x
proof:
:= by
  rw [← mapSp_trunc_of_card_le hred hA x, mapSp_comp, mapSp_comp]
  exact mapSp_congr (comp_trunc_eq hg) _

name: Operad.FreeGrL.mapSp_eq_of_two_le
statement:
theorem mapSp_eq_of_two_le (hm : 1 ≤ m) (hA : Fintype.card A = m + 1) {k : ℕ} (hk : 2 ≤ k)
    {x : FreeGrL R X A} (hx : x ∈ vx R X k A) : (mapSp g).app A x = (mapSp g').app A x
proof:
:= by
  rw [← mapSp_trunc_of_two_le hred hm hA hk hx, mapSp_comp, mapSp_comp]
  exact mapSp_congr (comp_trunc_eq hg) _

name: Operad.FreeGrL.CompareData.hom
statement:
lemma hom (p : ℕ) : QIso.SplitHom ((mapSp f).app A) (-(derSp dV).app A) (D₁.app A)
    (-(derSp dW).app A) (D₁'.app A) (vx R V p A) (vxGe R V (p + 1) A) (vx R W p A)
    (vxGe R W (p + 1) A) where
  memU _ hu
proof:
:= mapSp_mem_vx hu
  memW _ hw := mapSp_mem_vxGe hw
  comm₀ x := by
    rw [LinearMap.neg_apply, LinearMap.neg_apply, map_neg, derSp_mapSp (a := dV) hc.comm]
  comm₁ x := (hc.commD A x).symm

name: Operad.FreeGrL.CompareData.filt
statement:
lemma filt : QIso.FiltData (fun p => vx R V p A) (fun p => vxGe R V p A)
    (fun p => vx R W p A) (fun p => vxGe R W p A) (Fintype.card A) (-(derSp dV).app A)
    (D₁.app A) (-(derSp dW).app A) (D₁'.app A) ((mapSp f).app A) where
  split p
proof:
:= split_vx (hc.dd A) (hc.raise A) p
  split' p := split_vx (hc.dd' A) (hc.raise' A) p
  hom p := hc.hom A p
  sup p := vxGe_eq p
  sup' p := vxGe_eq p
  top := vxGe_card hc.redV
  top' := vxGe_card hc.redW

name: Operad.FreeGrL.CompareData.qiso_vx
statement:
theorem qiso_vx (s : Splitting dV) (s' : Splitting dW) (k : GrSpeciesHom R W V) (p : ℕ)
    (hGK : ∀ y ∈ vx R W p A, (mapSp (s'.p.toHom.comp (f.comp s.p.toHom))).app A
      ((mapSp k).app A y) = (mapSp s'.p.toHom).app A y)
    (hKG : ∀ x ∈ vx R V p A, (mapSp k).app A
      ((mapSp (s'.p.toHom.comp (f.comp s.p.toHom))).app A x) = (mapSp s.p.toHom).app A x) :
    QIso.Surj (vx R V p A) (vx R W p A) (-(derSp dV).app A) (-(derSp dW).app A)
        ((mapSp f).app A) ∧
      QIso.Inj (vx R V p A) (vx R W p A) (-(derSp dV).app A) (-(derSp dW).app A)
        ((mapSp f).app A)
proof:
:= by
  have hr := (s.retract (GrSpEnd.id R V) (fun _ _ _ _ => rfl) (fun _ _ _ _ => rfl)
    (fun _ _ _ _ => rfl) p A).neg
  have hr' := (s'.retract (GrSpEnd.id R W) (fun _ _ _ _ => rfl) (fun _ _ _ _ => rfl)
    (fun _ _ _ _ => rfl) p A).neg
  have hFD := (hc.hom A p).comm₀
  have hG : ∀ x, (mapSp s'.p.toHom).app A ((mapSp f).app A ((mapSp s.p.toHom).app A x))
      = (mapSp (s'.p.toHom.comp (f.comp s.p.toHom))).app A x := fun x =>
    (congrArg _ (mapSp_comp _ _ x)).trans (mapSp_comp _ _ _)
  exact ⟨QIso.surj_of_retract hr hr' (fun _ hx => mapSp_mem_vx hx) hFD hG
      (fun _ hy => mapSp_mem_vx hy) hGK,
    QIso.inj_of_retract hr hr' hFD hG hKG⟩

name: Operad.FreeGrL.CompareData.qiso_of_le
statement:
theorem qiso_of_le
    (hs : ∀ (B : Type) [Fintype B] [DecidableEq B], Fintype.card B ≤ Fintype.card A →
      SurjAt R dV dW f B)
    (hi : ∀ (B : Type) [Fintype B] [DecidableEq B], Fintype.card B ≤ Fintype.card A →
      InjAt R dV dW f B) :
    QIso.Surj ⊤ ⊤ (totD dV D₁ A) (totD dW D₁' A) ((mapSp f).app A) ∧
      QIso.Inj ⊤ ⊤ (totD dV D₁ A) (totD dW D₁' A) ((mapSp f).app A)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨s⟩ := Splitting.exists_of_field dV hc.ddV
  obtain ⟨s'⟩ := Splitting.exists_of_field dW hc.ddW
  obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := exists_compat f hc.comm s s' (· ≤ Fintype.card A)
    (fun n hn => hs (Fin n) (by rwa [Fintype.card_fin]))
    (fun n hn => hi (Fin n) (by rwa [Fintype.card_fin]))
  have hq := fun p => hc.qiso_vx A s s' k p
    (fun y _ => by
      rw [mapSp_comp]
      exact mapSp_eq_of_card_le hc.redW (fun B _ _ hB v => by exact (hk B hB).2 v) le_rfl y)
    (fun x _ => by
      rw [mapSp_comp]
      exact mapSp_eq_of_card_le hc.redV (fun B _ _ hB v => by exact (hk B hB).1 v) le_rfl x)
  have h := QIso.qiso_filt (hc.filt A) (fun p => (hq p).1) (fun p => (hq p).2) 0
  have e : vxGe R V 0 A = ⊤ := vxGe_zero
  have e' : vxGe R W 0 A = ⊤ := vxGe_zero
  simp only [e, e'] at h
  exact h

name: Operad.FreeGrL.CompareData.qiso_of_qiso
statement:
theorem qiso_of_qiso
    (hs : ∀ (B : Type) [Fintype B] [DecidableEq B], SurjAt R dV dW f B)
    (hi : ∀ (B : Type) [Fintype B] [DecidableEq B], InjAt R dV dW f B) :
    QIso.Surj ⊤ ⊤ (totD dV D₁ A) (totD dW D₁' A) ((mapSp f).app A) ∧
      QIso.Inj ⊤ ⊤ (totD dV D₁ A) (totD dW D₁' A) ((mapSp f).app A)
proof:
:=
  hc.qiso_of_le A (fun B _ _ _ => hs B) (fun B _ _ _ => hi B)

name: Operad.FreeGrL.CompareData.surjAt_of_vx
statement:
lemma surjAt_of_vx (hS : QIso.Surj (vx R V 1 A) (vx R W 1 A) (-(derSp dV).app A)
    (-(derSp dW).app A) ((mapSp f).app A)) : SurjAt R dV dW f A
proof:
:= by
  intro y hy
  obtain ⟨x, hx, hdx, z, hz, hxz⟩ := hS ((ι R W).app A y) (ι_mem_vx y)
    (by rw [LinearMap.neg_apply, derSp_ι, hy, map_zero, neg_zero])
  rw [eq_ι_genCoef hx] at hdx hxz
  rw [eq_ι_genCoef hz] at hxz
  rw [LinearMap.neg_apply, derSp_ι, neg_eq_zero, ← map_zero ((ι R V).app A)] at hdx
  refine ⟨genCoef R V A x, ι_injective hdx, -genCoef R W A z, ι_injective (R := R) (V := W) ?_⟩
  rw [map_sub, ← mapSp_ι, hxz, LinearMap.neg_apply, derSp_ι, map_neg, map_neg]

name: Operad.FreeGrL.CompareData.injAt_of_vx
statement:
lemma injAt_of_vx (hI : QIso.Inj (vx R V 1 A) (vx R W 1 A) (-(derSp dV).app A)
    (-(derSp dW).app A) ((mapSp f).app A)) : InjAt R dV dW f A
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx w hw
  obtain ⟨z, hz, hdz⟩ := hI ((ι R V).app A x) (ι_mem_vx x)
    (by rw [LinearMap.neg_apply, derSp_ι, hx, map_zero, neg_zero]) (-(ι R W).app A w)
    (neg_mem (ι_mem_vx w)) (by rw [mapSp_ι, hw, LinearMap.neg_apply, map_neg, derSp_ι, neg_neg])
  rw [eq_ι_genCoef hz, LinearMap.neg_apply, derSp_ι, ← map_neg] at hdz
  exact ⟨-genCoef R V A z, by rw [map_neg]; exact ι_injective hdz⟩

name: Operad.FreeGrL.CompareData.qiso_step
statement:
theorem qiso_step {m : ℕ} (hm : 1 ≤ m) (hA : Fintype.card A = m + 1)
    (hs_ : QIso.Surj ⊤ ⊤ (totD dV D₁ A) (totD dW D₁' A) ((mapSp f).app A))
    (hi_ : QIso.Inj ⊤ ⊤ (totD dV D₁ A) (totD dW D₁' A) ((mapSp f).app A))
    (hs : ∀ (B : Type) [Fintype B] [DecidableEq B], Fintype.card B ≤ m → SurjAt R dV dW f B)
    (hi : ∀ (B : Type) [Fintype B] [DecidableEq B], Fintype.card B ≤ m → InjAt R dV dW f B) :
    SurjAt R dV dW f A ∧ InjAt R dV dW f A
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨s⟩ := Splitting.exists_of_field dV hc.ddV
  obtain ⟨s'⟩ := Splitting.exists_of_field dW hc.ddW
  obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := exists_compat f hc.comm s s' (· ≤ m)
    (fun n hn => hs (Fin n) (by rwa [Fintype.card_fin]))
    (fun n hn => hi (Fin n) (by rwa [Fintype.card_fin]))
  have hq := fun p (hp : 2 ≤ p) => hc.qiso_vx A s s' k p
    (fun y hy => by
      rw [mapSp_comp]
      exact mapSp_eq_of_two_le hc.redW (fun B _ _ hB v => by exact (hk B hB).2 v) hm hA hp hy)
    (fun x hx => by
      rw [mapSp_comp]
      exact mapSp_eq_of_two_le hc.redV (fun B _ _ hB v => by exact (hk B hB).1 v) hm hA hp hx)
  have hd := hc.filt A
  
  have h2 := QIso.qiso_filt_ge hd (p₀ := 2) (fun p hp => (hq p hp).1) (fun p hp => (hq p hp).2)
    2 le_rfl
  
  have e0 : vxGe R V 0 A = vx R V 0 A ⊔ vxGe R V 1 A := vxGe_eq 0
  have e0' : vxGe R W 0 A = vx R W 0 A ⊔ vxGe R W 1 A := vxGe_eq 0
  have hs0 : QIso.Surj (vx R V 0 A ⊔ vxGe R V 1 A) (vx R W 0 A ⊔ vxGe R W 1 A)
      (-(derSp dV).app A + D₁.app A) (-(derSp dW).app A + D₁'.app A) ((mapSp f).app A) := by
    rw [← e0, ← e0', vxGe_zero, vxGe_zero]
    exact hs_
  have hi0 : QIso.Inj (vx R V 0 A ⊔ vxGe R V 1 A) (vx R W 0 A ⊔ vxGe R W 1 A)
      (-(derSp dV).app A + D₁.app A) (-(derSp dW).app A + D₁'.app A) ((mapSp f).app A) := by
    rw [← e0, ← e0', vxGe_zero, vxGe_zero]
    exact hi_
  have hs1 : QIso.Surj (vxGe R V 1 A) (vxGe R W 1 A)
      (-(derSp dV).app A + D₁.app A) (-(derSp dW).app A + D₁'.app A) ((mapSp f).app A) :=
    QIso.surj_of_sup_right (hd.split 0) (hd.split' 0) (hd.hom 0) (fun _ hu => der_vx_zero hu)
      (fun _ hu => der_vx_zero hu) hs0
  have hi1 : QIso.Inj (vxGe R V 1 A) (vxGe R W 1 A)
      (-(derSp dV).app A + D₁.app A) (-(derSp dW).app A + D₁'.app A) ((mapSp f).app A) :=
    QIso.inj_of_sup_right (hd.split 0) (fun _ hu => der_vx_zero hu) hi0
  
  have e1 : vxGe R V 1 A = vx R V 1 A ⊔ vxGe R V 2 A := vxGe_eq 1
  have e1' : vxGe R W 1 A = vx R W 1 A ⊔ vxGe R W 2 A := vxGe_eq 1
  rw [e1, e1'] at hs1 hi1
  exact ⟨surjAt_of_vx A (QIso.surj_of_sup (hd.split 1) (hd.split' 1) (hd.hom 1) h2.1 hs1 hi1),
    injAt_of_vx A (QIso.inj_of_sup (hd.split 1) (hd.split' 1) (hd.hom 1) h2.1 h2.2 hi1)⟩

name: Operad.FreeGrL.CompareData.qiso_of_qiso_free
statement:
theorem qiso_of_qiso_free
    (hs_ : ∀ (B : Type) [Fintype B] [DecidableEq B],
      QIso.Surj ⊤ ⊤ (totD dV D₁ B) (totD dW D₁' B) ((mapSp f).app B))
    (hi_ : ∀ (B : Type) [Fintype B] [DecidableEq B],
      QIso.Inj ⊤ ⊤ (totD dV D₁ B) (totD dW D₁' B) ((mapSp f).app B)) :
    SurjAt R dV dW f A ∧ InjAt R dV dW f A
proof:
:= by
  suffices h : ∀ n (B : Type) [Fintype B] [DecidableEq B], Fintype.card B = n →
      SurjAt R dV dW f B ∧ InjAt R dV dW f B from h _ A rfl
  intro n
  induction n using Nat.strong_induction_on with
  | _ n ih =>
    intro B _ _ hB
    rcases le_or_gt n 1 with hn | hn
    · exact ⟨fun y _ => ⟨0, map_zero _, 0, by
          rw [hc.redW B (by omega) y, map_zero, map_zero, sub_zero]⟩,
        fun x _ _ _ => ⟨0, by rw [map_zero, hc.redV B (by omega) x]⟩⟩
    · obtain ⟨m, rfl⟩ : ∃ m, n = m + 1 := ⟨n - 1, by omega⟩
      exact hc.qiso_step B (by omega) hB (hs_ B) (hi_ B)
        (fun C _ _ hC => (ih _ (by omega) C rfl).1) (fun C _ _ hC => (ih _ (by omega) C rfl).2)

name: Operad.Words.classify_le
statement:
theorem classify_le (hlead : ∀ r, G.lead r ≠ []) {r₁ r₂ : ρ} (A : G.Amb () r₁ r₂)
    {u₁ v₁ u₂ v₂ : List I} (h₁ : ∀ w, A.f₁ w = u₁ ++ w ++ v₁) (h₂ : ∀ w, A.f₂ w = u₂ ++ w ++ v₂)
    (hu : u₁.length ≤ u₂.length) :
    A.IsDisjoint ∨ ∃ B : G.Amb () r₁ r₂, Critical G B ∧ A.FactorsThrough B
proof:
:= by
  have heq : u₁ ++ G.lead r₁ ++ v₁ = u₂ ++ G.lead r₂ ++ v₂ := by
    rw [← h₁, ← h₂]
    exact A.eq
  obtain ⟨s, rfl⟩ : u₁ <+: u₂ := List.prefix_of_prefix_length_le
    ⟨G.lead r₁ ++ v₁, by rw [← List.append_assoc]⟩ ⟨G.lead r₂ ++ v₂, by
      rw [← List.append_assoc, heq]⟩ hu
  simp only [List.append_assoc, List.append_cancel_left_eq] at heq
  by_cases hs : (G.lead r₁).length ≤ s.length
  · 
    obtain ⟨mid, rfl⟩ : G.lead r₁ <+: s := List.prefix_of_prefix_length_le
      ⟨v₁, rfl⟩ ⟨G.lead r₂ ++ v₂, heq.symm⟩ hs
    simp only [List.append_assoc, List.append_cancel_left_eq] at heq
    subst heq
    left
    refine ⟨fun x y => u₁ ++ x ++ (mid ++ y ++ v₂), fun y => ⟨u₁, mid ++ y ++ v₂, fun _ => rfl⟩,
      fun x => ⟨u₁ ++ x ++ mid, v₂, fun _ => by simp⟩, ?_, ?_⟩
    · funext x
      rw [h₁]
      simp
    · funext y
      rw [h₂]
      simp
  · push Not at hs
    obtain ⟨x₀, hx₀⟩ : s <+: G.lead r₁ := List.prefix_of_prefix_length_le
      ⟨G.lead r₂ ++ v₂, heq.symm⟩ ⟨v₁, rfl⟩ hs.le
    have hx₀' : x₀ ++ v₁ = G.lead r₂ ++ v₂ := by
      rw [← hx₀, List.append_assoc] at heq
      exact List.append_cancel_left heq
    have hl₁ : (G.lead r₁).length = s.length + x₀.length := by
      rw [← hx₀, List.length_append]
    by_cases hx : (G.lead r₂).length ≤ x₀.length
    · 
      obtain ⟨s', rfl⟩ : G.lead r₂ <+: x₀ := List.prefix_of_prefix_length_le
        ⟨v₂, rfl⟩ ⟨v₁, hx₀'⟩ hx
      have hv : v₂ = s' ++ v₁ := by
        rw [List.append_assoc] at hx₀'
        exact (List.append_cancel_left hx₀').symm
      subst hv
      right
      refine ⟨⟨fun w => w, fun w => s ++ w ++ s', ⟨[], [], fun _ => by simp⟩,
        ⟨s, s', fun _ => rfl⟩, by simp only [← hx₀, List.append_assoc]⟩, ?_, ?_⟩
      · refine ⟨[], [], s, s', fun _ => by simp, fun _ => rfl, Or.inl rfl, Or.inl rfl, ?_⟩
        show (G.lead r₁).length < _
        have := List.length_pos_iff.2 (hlead r₂)
        omega
      · refine ⟨fun w => u₁ ++ w ++ v₁, ⟨u₁, v₁, fun _ => rfl⟩, ?_, ?_⟩
        · funext w
          rw [h₁]
          rfl
        · funext w
          rw [h₂]
          simp
    · 
      push Not at hx
      obtain ⟨y₀, hy₀⟩ : x₀ <+: G.lead r₂ := List.prefix_of_prefix_length_le
        ⟨v₁, rfl⟩ ⟨v₂, hx₀'.symm⟩ hx.le
      have hv : v₁ = y₀ ++ v₂ := by
        rw [← hy₀, List.append_assoc] at hx₀'
        exact List.append_cancel_left hx₀'
      subst hv
      right
      refine ⟨⟨fun w => w ++ y₀, fun w => s ++ w, ⟨[], y₀, fun _ => by simp⟩,
        ⟨s, [], fun _ => by simp⟩, by simp only [← hx₀, ← hy₀, List.append_assoc]⟩, ?_, ?_⟩
      · refine ⟨[], y₀, s, [], fun _ => by simp, fun _ => by simp, Or.inl rfl, Or.inr rfl, ?_⟩
        show (G.lead r₁ ++ y₀).length < _
        have hl₂ : (G.lead r₂).length = x₀.length + y₀.length := by
          rw [← hy₀, List.length_append]
        rw [List.length_append]
        omega
      · refine ⟨fun w => u₁ ++ w ++ v₂, ⟨u₁, v₂, fun _ => rfl⟩, ?_, ?_⟩
        · funext w
          rw [h₁]
          simp
        · funext w
          rw [h₂]
          simp

name: Operad.Words.classify
statement:
theorem classify (hlead : ∀ r, G.lead r ≠ []) {r₁ r₂ : ρ} (A : G.Amb () r₁ r₂) :
    A.IsDisjoint ∨ ∃ B : G.Amb () r₁ r₂, Critical G B ∧ A.FactorsThrough B
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨u₁, v₁, h₁⟩ := A.ctx₁
  obtain ⟨u₂, v₂, h₂⟩ := A.ctx₂
  rcases le_total u₁.length u₂.length with hu | hu
  · exact classify_le G hlead A h₁ h₂ hu
  · rcases classify_le G hlead A.swap h₂ h₁ hu with h | ⟨B, hB, h⟩
    · exact Or.inl (Rules.Amb.IsDisjoint.of_swap h)
    · exact Or.inr ⟨B.swap, hB.swap, Rules.Amb.FactorsThrough.of_swap h⟩

name: Operad.Words.resolvable_of_critical
statement:
theorem resolvable_of_critical (hlead : ∀ r, G.lead r ≠ [])
    (hcrit : ∀ {r₁ r₂ : ρ} (B : G.Amb () r₁ r₂), Critical G B → B.Res) :
    (G.rw ()).Resolvable
proof:
:=
  Rules.resolvable_of_crit (fun {_ r₁ r₂} (B : G.Amb () r₁ r₂) => Critical G B)
    (fun B hB => hcrit B hB)
    (fun A => classify G hlead A |>.imp id fun ⟨B, hB, h⟩ => ⟨(), B, hB, h⟩)
    ()

name: Operad.Words.isCompl_of_critical
statement:
theorem isCompl_of_critical (hlead : ∀ r, G.lead r ≠ [])
    (hcrit : ∀ {r₁ r₂ : ρ} (B : G.Amb () r₁ r₂), Critical G B → B.Res) :
    IsCompl (Finsupp.supported R R {w : List I | G.Normal (b := ()) w}) (G.rw ()).ideal
proof:
:= by
  rw [← G.irr_eq]
  exact (resolvable_of_critical G hlead hcrit).isCompl

name: Operad.NSOperadIso.inv_hom_apply
statement:
@[simp] lemma inv_hom_apply (e : NSOperadIso R P Q) (n : ℕ) (x : P n) :
    e.inv.app n (e.hom.app n x) = x
proof:
:=
  LinearMap.congr_fun (congrArg (fun φ => NSOperadHom.app φ n) e.hom_inv_id) x

name: Operad.NSOperadIso.hom_inv_apply
statement:
@[simp] lemma hom_inv_apply (e : NSOperadIso R P Q) (n : ℕ) (y : Q n) :

proof:
:=

name: Operad.NSOperadIso.bijective
statement: lemma bijective (e : NSOperadIso R P Q) (n : ℕ) : Function.Bijective (e.hom.app n)
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun x y h => by rw [← e.inv_hom_apply n x, h, e.inv_hom_apply],
    fun y => ⟨e.inv.app n y, e.hom_inv_apply n y⟩⟩

name: Operad.NSOperadHom.app_invOfBijective
statement:
lemma app_invOfBijective (φ : NSOperadHom R P Q) (h : ∀ n, Function.Bijective (φ.app n))
    (n : ℕ) (y : Q n) : φ.app n ((φ.invOfBijective h).app n y) = y
proof:
:=
  LinearEquiv.apply_ofBijective_symm_apply (φ.app n) (h := h n) y

name: Operad.NSOperadHom.invOfBijective_app
statement:
lemma invOfBijective_app (φ : NSOperadHom R P Q) (h : ∀ n, Function.Bijective (φ.app n))
    (n : ℕ) (x : P n) : (φ.invOfBijective h).app n (φ.app n x) = x
proof:
:=
  (h n).1 (app_invOfBijective φ h n (φ.app n x))

name: Operad.UndNS.symm_reindexS
statement:
@[simp] lemma UndNS.symm_reindexS {m n : ℕ} (h : m = n) (x : UndNS R Q m) :
    (UndNS.of R Q).symm (reindexS (UndNS R Q) h x) = reindex R Q h ((UndNS.of R Q).symm x)

statement: lemma UndNS.one_eq : (NSSetOperad.one : UndNS R Q 1) = UndNS.of R Q (NSOperad.one (R := R))

name: Operad.UndNS.comp_eq
statement:
lemma UndNS.comp_eq (a b : ℕ) {n : ℕ} (x : Q (a + 1 + b)) (y : Q n) :

name: Operad.linExtend_single
statement:
@[simp] lemma linExtend_single (φ : NSSetOperadHom S (UndNS R Q)) {n : ℕ} (s : S n) :
    (NSSetOperadHom.linExtend R φ).app n (Finsupp.single s 1) =
      (UndNS.of R Q).symm (φ.app n s)
proof:
:= by

name: Operad.NSOperadHom.ext_single
statement:
lemma NSOperadHom.ext_single {Φ Ψ : NSOperadHom R (LinNS R S) Q}
    (h : ∀ n (s : S n), Φ.app n (Finsupp.single s 1) = Ψ.app n (Finsupp.single s 1)) : Φ = Ψ
proof:

name: Operad.NSSetOperadHom.lin_single
statement:
@[simp] lemma NSSetOperadHom.lin_single (φ : NSSetOperadHom S T) {n : ℕ} (s : S n) (r : R) :

name: Operad.SetOperad.single_nsComp
statement:
lemma single_nsComp (a b : ℕ) {n : ℕ} (x : toNSSet S (a + 1 + b)) (y : toNSSet S n) (r r' : R) :
    NSOperad.comp (R := R) (P := SymOperad.toNS (Lin R S)) a b
        (Finsupp.single (α := S (Fin _)) x r) (Finsupp.single (α := S (Fin n)) y r')
      = Finsupp.single (α := S (Fin (a + n + b))) (nsCompSet a b x y) (r * r')
proof:
:= by
  rw [SymOperad.toNS_comp]
  show Lin.mapL R _ (Lin.compL R _ _ _) = _
  rw [Lin.compL_single, Lin.mapL_single]
  rfl

name: Operad.FreeGrL.mapF_gen
statement:
lemma mapF_gen {k : ℕ} (g : GrGen R V k) :
    (mapF f).app (Fin k) (gen g) = gen (genMap f k g)
proof:
:= by
  rw [mapF, SBVal.hom_gen]
  show σ R false • _ = _
  rw [σ_false, one_smul]
  rfl

name: Operad.FreeGrL.mapVal_ψ
statement: lemma mapVal_ψ : ((mapVal f).sbm R).ψ = relabel (genMap f)
proof:
:=
  regHom_ext fun k e => by

    rfl

name: Operad.FreeGrL.proj_mapF
statement:
lemma proj_mapF (x : FreeGr R (grGenPar R V) A) :
    (𝒥').proj A ((mapF f).app A x) = (mapSp f).app A ((𝒥).proj A x)
proof:
:= by
  have h : (𝒥').projHom.comp (mapF f) = (mapSp f).comp (𝒥).projHom :=
    FreeGr.hom_ext fun k g => by
      obtain ⟨⟨v, b⟩, hv⟩ := g
      show (𝒥').proj (Fin k) ((mapF f).app (Fin k) (gen _))
        = (mapSp f).app (Fin k) ((𝒥).proj (Fin k) (gen _))
      rw [mapF_gen]
      show FreeGr.presGen (grLinRel R W) _ = (mapSp f).app (Fin k) (FreeGr.presGen (grLinRel R V) _)
      rw [← ι_app_hom hv, mapSp_ι]
      exact (ι_app_hom (genMap f k ⟨(v, b), hv⟩).2).symm
  exact congrArg (fun φ : GrOperadHom R (FreeGr R (grGenPar R V)) (FreeGrL R W) => φ.app A x) h

name: Operad.FreeGrL.comp_proj_mapF
statement:
lemma comp_proj_mapF (A : Type) [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] :
    (𝒥').proj A ∘ₗ (mapF f).app A = (mapSp f).app A ∘ₗ (𝒥).proj A
proof:
:=
  LinearMap.ext (proj_mapF f)

name: Operad.FreeGrL.decomp_mapF
statement:
lemma decomp_mapF (i : A) :
    SgnLin.decompT R (treeSgn (grGenPar R W)) (B := B) i ∘ₗ (mapF f).app (Without A i ⊕ B)
      = TensorProduct.map ((mapF f).app A) ((mapF f).app B) ∘ₗ
          SgnLin.decompT R (treeSgn (grGenPar R V)) i
proof:
:=
  ((mapVal f).sbm R).decomp_app (by rw [mapVal_ψ]; exact relabel_factBij _) i

name: Operad.FreeGrL.counit_mapF
statement:
lemma counit_mapF :
    GrCooperad.counit (R := R) (C := FreeGr R (grGenPar R W)) ∘ₗ (mapF f).app Unit
      = GrCooperad.counit (R := R) (C := FreeGr R (grGenPar R V))
proof:
:= by
  refine Finsupp.lhom_ext fun t c => ?_
  have h1 : (Finsupp.single t c : FreeGr R (grGenPar R V) Unit)
      = c • SgnLin.bas (treeSgn (grGenPar R V)) R t :=
    (Finsupp.smul_single_one t c).symm
  show GrCooperad.counit (R := R) (C := FreeGr R (grGenPar R W))
      ((mapF f).app Unit (Finsupp.single t c : FreeGr R (grGenPar R V) Unit))
    = GrCooperad.counit (R := R) (C := FreeGr R (grGenPar R V))
      (Finsupp.single t c : FreeGr R (grGenPar R V) Unit)
  rw [h1, map_smul, map_smul, map_smul]
  congr 1
  cases ht : (treeOf t).isLeaf
  · have hne : ∀ {T : ℕ → Type v} (s : Reg (TreeOfArity T) Unit),
        (treeOf s).isLeaf = false → s ≠ SetOperad.one := by
      rintro T s hs rfl
      exact Bool.noConfusion hs
    have hψ : ((mapVal f).sbm R).ψ.app Unit t = relabelR (genMap f) t := by
      rw [mapVal_ψ]
      rfl
    rw [((mapVal f).sbm R).app_bas, hψ, map_smul]
    show σ R _ • (Finsupp.single (relabelR (genMap f) t) (1 : R)) SetOperad.one
      = (Finsupp.single t (1 : R)) SetOperad.one
    rw [Finsupp.single_eq_of_ne (hne t ht).symm, Finsupp.single_eq_of_ne, smul_zero]
    refine (hne _ ?_).symm
    rw [treeOf_relabelR]
    cases h : Tree.relabel (genMap f) (treeOf t) with
    | leaf => exact absurd (Tree.eq_leaf_of_relabel _ h) (by
        intro h'
        rw [h'] at ht
        exact Bool.noConfusion ht)
    | node _ _ => rfl
  · obtain ⟨e, rfl⟩ := eq_map_one_of_isLeaf ht
    rw [← SgnLin.map_bas, GrOperadHom.app_map]
    show GrCooperad.counit (R := R) (C := FreeGr R (grGenPar R W))
        (GrOperad.map (R := R) e ((mapF f).app Unit (GrOperad.one (R := R)))) = _
    obtain rfl : e = Equiv.refl Unit := Subsingleton.elim _ _
    rw [(mapF f).app_one, GrOperad.map_refl, GrOperad.map_refl]
    show (Finsupp.single (SetOperad.one : Reg (TreeOfArity (GrGen R W)) Unit) (1 : R))
        SetOperad.one
      = (Finsupp.single (SetOperad.one : Reg (TreeOfArity (GrGen R V)) Unit) (1 : R))
        SetOperad.one
    rw [Finsupp.single_eq_same, Finsupp.single_eq_same]

name: Operad.FreeGrL.mapCoop_app
statement: @[simp] lemma mapCoop_app (x : FreeGrL R V A) : (mapCoop f).app A x = (mapSp f).app A x
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.Homology.map_equiv_bijective
statement:
lemma Homology.map_equiv_bijective {dV : V →ₗ[R] V} {dW : W →ₗ[R] W} (α : V ≃ₗ[R] W)
    (hα : ∀ v, α (dV v) = dW (α v)) : Function.Bijective (Homology.map (α : V →ₗ[R] W) hα)
proof:
:= by
  have hα' : ∀ w, α.symm (dW w) = dV (α.symm w) := fun w => by
    apply α.injective
    rw [hα, LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply, LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply]
  refine Function.bijective_iff_has_inverse.2
    ⟨Homology.map (α.symm : W →ₗ[R] V) hα', fun h => ?_, fun h => ?_⟩
  · obtain ⟨z, rfl⟩ := Homology.mk_surjective _ h
    rw [Homology.map_mk, Homology.map_mk]
    congr 1
    exact Subtype.ext (α.symm_apply_apply z.1)
  · obtain ⟨z, rfl⟩ := Homology.mk_surjective _ h
    rw [Homology.map_mk, Homology.map_mk]
    congr 1
    exact Subtype.ext (α.apply_symm_apply z.1)

name: Operad.Homology.map_bijective_iff_of_equiv
proof:
:= by
  have hcomm : ⇑(Homology.map (β : W →ₗ[R] W') hβ) ∘ ⇑(Homology.map f hf)
      = ⇑(Homology.map f' hf') ∘ ⇑(Homology.map (α : V →ₗ[R] V') hα) := by
    funext h
    obtain ⟨z, rfl⟩ := Homology.mk_surjective _ h
    simp only [Function.comp_apply, Homology.map_mk]
    congr 1
    exact Subtype.ext (hsq z.1).symm
  rw [← (Homology.map_equiv_bijective β hβ).of_comp_iff' (Homology.map f hf), hcomm]
  exact (Homology.map_equiv_bijective α hα).of_comp_iff _

name: Operad.Homology.map_zero_bijective_iff
statement:
lemma Homology.map_zero_bijective_iff {dW : W →ₗ[R] W} (f : V →ₗ[R] W)
    (hf : ∀ v, f ((0 : V →ₗ[R] V) v) = dW (f v)) :
    Function.Bijective (Homology.map f hf) ↔
      (∀ v w, f v = dW w → v = 0) ∧ ∀ z, dW z = 0 → ∃ v w, z = f v + dW w
proof:
:= by
  have hmk : ∀ v : V, Homology.mk (0 : V →ₗ[R] V) ⟨v, by simp⟩ = 0 → v = 0 := fun v h => by
    rw [Homology.mk, Submodule.mkQ_apply, Submodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero] at h
    obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := h
    simpa using hu.symm
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hinj, hsurj⟩
    refine ⟨fun v w hvw => ?_, fun z hz => ?_⟩
    · have h0 : Homology.map f hf (Homology.mk _ ⟨v, by simp⟩) = 0 := by
        rw [Homology.map_mk, Homology.mk, Submodule.mkQ_apply, Submodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero]
        exact ⟨w, hvw.symm⟩
      rw [← map_zero (Homology.map f hf)] at h0
      exact hmk v (hinj h0)
    · obtain ⟨h, hh⟩ := hsurj (Homology.mk dW ⟨z, hz⟩)
      obtain ⟨⟨v, hv⟩, rfl⟩ := Homology.mk_surjective _ h
      rw [Homology.map_mk, Homology.mk_eq_mk_iff] at hh
      obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ := hh
      refine ⟨v, -w, ?_⟩
      have hw' : dW w = f v - z := hw
      rw [map_neg, hw']
      abel
  · rintro ⟨hinj, hsurj⟩
    refine ⟨fun h h' hh => ?_, fun h => ?_⟩
    · obtain ⟨⟨v, hv⟩, rfl⟩ := Homology.mk_surjective _ h
      obtain ⟨⟨v', hv'⟩, rfl⟩ := Homology.mk_surjective _ h'
      rw [Homology.map_mk, Homology.map_mk, Homology.mk_eq_mk_iff] at hh
      obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ := hh
      have hw' : f (v - v') = dW w := by
        rw [map_sub]
        exact hw.symm
      have := hinj _ _ hw'
      congr 1
      exact Subtype.ext (sub_eq_zero.1 this)
    · obtain ⟨⟨z, hz⟩, rfl⟩ := Homology.mk_surjective _ h
      obtain ⟨v, w, rfl⟩ := hsurj z hz
      refine ⟨Homology.mk _ ⟨v, by simp⟩, ?_⟩
      rw [Homology.map_mk, Homology.mk_eq_mk_iff]
      exact ⟨-w, by simp [Homology.cycleMap]⟩

name: Operad.FreeGrL.mem_vx_of_binary
statement:
theorem mem_vx_of_binary
    (hV : ∀ (B : Type) [Fintype B] [DecidableEq B], Fintype.card B ≠ 2 → ∀ v : V B, v = 0)
    {A : Type} [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] (hA : 1 ≤ Fintype.card A) (x : FreeGrL R V A) :
    x ∈ vx R V (Fintype.card A - 1) A
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_eig, derSp_lin (GrSpEnd.scalar R V fun n => (n : R) - 1) (GrSpEnd.id R V)
    (GrSpEnd.id R V) 1 0 (fun B _ _ v => ?_) x, derSp_excess, Nat.cast_sub hA]
  · simp
  · by_cases hB : Fintype.card B = 2
    · rw [GrSpEnd.scalar_app, hB]
      norm_num
    · rw [hV B hB v]
      simp

name: Operad.Bar.d_mem_iSup_ne
statement:
lemma d_mem_iSup_ne {n j t : ℕ} (hj : j ≠ t + 1) {y : FreeGrL K (BarGen I) (Fin n)}
    (hy : y ∈ 𝒱 j (Fin n)) : d I (Fin n) y ∈ ⨆ i, ⨆ (_ : i ≠ t), 𝒱 i (Fin n)
proof:
:= by
  rcases j with _ | j
  · rw [d_vx_zero hy]
    exact zero_mem _
  · exact Submodule.mem_iSup_of_mem j (Submodule.mem_iSup_of_mem (by omega) (d_vx_succ hy))

name: Operad.Bar.eq_zero_of_mem_iSup_ne
statement:
lemma eq_zero_of_mem_iSup_ne {n s : ℕ} {a : FreeGrL K (BarGen I) (Fin n)} (ha : a ∈ 𝒱 s (Fin n))
    (ha' : a ∈ ⨆ i, ⨆ (_ : i ≠ s), 𝒱 i (Fin n)) : a = 0
proof:
:=
  Submodule.disjoint_def.1 (iSupIndep_def.1 (iSupIndep_eigenspace_nat
    ((FreeGrL.derSp (GrSpEnd.id K (BarGen I))).app (Fin n))) s) a ha ha'

name: Operad.Bar.vx_eq_zero
statement:
lemma vx_eq_zero {n j : ℕ} (hj : n ≤ j) {y : FreeGrL K (BarGen I) (Fin n)}
    (hy : y ∈ 𝒱 j (Fin n)) : y = 0
proof:
:=
  FreeGrL.eig_card_eq_bot (R := K) (V := BarGen I)
    (fun B _ _ hB v => IdealSp.ext I (hI1 B hB _ (IdealSp.mem I v))) (by simpa using hj) hy

name: Operad.Bar.exists_decomp
statement:
lemma exists_decomp {n : ℕ} (z : FreeGrL K (BarGen I) (Fin n)) :
    ∃ c : ℕ → FreeGrL K (BarGen I) (Fin n), (∀ j, c j ∈ 𝒱 j (Fin n)) ∧
      z = ∑ j ∈ Finset.range n, c j
proof:
:= by
  have hz : z ∈ ⨆ j : ℕ, 𝒱 j (Fin n) :=
    (FreeGrL.iSup_vx (R := K) (V := BarGen I) (Fin n)).symm ▸ Submodule.mem_top
  induction hz using Submodule.iSup_induction' with
  | mem j y hy =>
    by_cases hj : j < n
    · refine ⟨fun i => if i = j then y else 0, fun i => ?_, ?_⟩
      · dsimp only
        split_ifs with h
        · exact h ▸ hy
        · exact zero_mem _
      · rw [Finset.sum_ite_eq' (Finset.range n) j, if_pos (Finset.mem_range.2 hj)]
    · refine ⟨0, fun _ => zero_mem _, ?_⟩
      rw [vx_eq_zero I hI1 (by omega) hy]
      simp
  | zero => exact ⟨0, fun _ => zero_mem _, by simp⟩
  | add y y' _ _ hy hy' =>
    obtain ⟨c, hc, rfl⟩ := hy
    obtain ⟨c', hc', rfl⟩ := hy'
    exact ⟨c + c', fun j => add_mem (hc j) (hc' j), by simp [Finset.sum_add_distrib]⟩

name: Operad.Bar.exists_d_sub
statement:
lemma exists_d_sub {n : ℕ} (s : ℕ) (w : FreeGrL K (BarGen I) (Fin n)) :
    ∃ w' ∈ 𝒱 (s + 1) (Fin n), d I (Fin n) w - d I (Fin n) w'
      ∈ ⨆ i, ⨆ (_ : i ≠ s), 𝒱 i (Fin n)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨c, hc, rfl⟩ := exists_decomp I hI1 w
  refine ⟨c (s + 1), hc _, ?_⟩
  rw [map_sum]
  by_cases hs : s + 1 ∈ Finset.range n
  · rw [← Finset.add_sum_erase _ _ hs, add_sub_cancel_left]
    exact Submodule.sum_mem _ fun j hj => d_mem_iSup_ne I (Finset.ne_of_mem_erase hj) (hc j)
  · rw [vx_eq_zero I hI1 (by simpa using hs) (hc (s + 1)), map_zero, sub_zero]
    exact Submodule.sum_mem _ fun j hj => d_mem_iSup_ne I (fun h => hs (h ▸ hj)) (hc j)

name: Operad.Bar.d_comp_eq_zero
statement:
lemma d_comp_eq_zero {n : ℕ} {c : ℕ → FreeGrL K (BarGen I) (Fin n)} (hc : ∀ j, c j ∈ 𝒱 j (Fin n))
    (hz : d I (Fin n) (∑ j ∈ Finset.range n, c j) = 0) (j : ℕ) : d I (Fin n) (c j) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rcases j with _ | t
  · exact d_vx_zero (hc 0)
  by_cases ht : t + 1 ∈ Finset.range n
  · refine eq_zero_of_mem_iSup_ne I (s := t) (d_vx_succ (hc _)) ?_
    have h2 : d I (Fin n) (c (t + 1))
        = -∑ j ∈ (Finset.range n).erase (t + 1), d I (Fin n) (c j) := by
      rw [map_sum, ← Finset.add_sum_erase _ _ ht] at hz
      exact eq_neg_of_add_eq_zero_left hz
    rw [h2]
    exact neg_mem (Submodule.sum_mem _ fun j hj => d_mem_iSup_ne I (Finset.ne_of_mem_erase hj)
      (hc j))
  · rw [vx_eq_zero I hI1 (by simpa using ht) (hc _), map_zero]

name: Operad.Bar.elem_iff_deg
statement:
theorem elem_iff_deg {n : ℕ} {V : Type*} [AddCommGroup V] [Module K V]
    (f : V →ₗ[K] FreeGrL K (BarGen I) (Fin n)) (hfv : ∀ v, f v ∈ 𝒱 (n - 1) (Fin n)) :
    ((∀ v w, f v = d I (Fin n) w → v = 0) ∧
      ∀ z, d I (Fin n) z = 0 → ∃ v w, z = f v + d I (Fin n) w) ↔ Function.Injective f ∧
      (∀ z ∈ 𝒱 (n - 1) (Fin n), d I (Fin n) z = 0 → ∃ v, f v = z) ∧
      ∀ s, s + 1 < n → ∀ z ∈ 𝒱 s (Fin n), d I (Fin n) z = 0 →
        ∃ w ∈ 𝒱 (s + 1) (Fin n), d I (Fin n) w = z
proof:
:= by
  
  have htopb : ∀ w, d I (Fin n) w ∈ 𝒱 (n - 1) (Fin n) → d I (Fin n) w = 0 := fun w hw => by
    obtain ⟨w', hw', hdiff⟩ := exists_d_sub I hI1 (n - 1) w
    rcases n with _ | m
    · exact vx_eq_zero I hI1 le_rfl hw
    · rw [vx_eq_zero I hI1 (by omega) hw', map_zero, sub_zero] at hdiff
      exact eq_zero_of_mem_iSup_ne I hw hdiff
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hinj, hsurj⟩
    refine ⟨fun v v' h => sub_eq_zero.1 (hinj (v - v') 0 (by rw [map_sub, h, sub_self,
      map_zero])), fun z hz hdz => ?_, fun s hs z hz hdz => ?_⟩
    · obtain ⟨v, w, rfl⟩ := hsurj z hdz
      have hw : d I (Fin n) w ∈ 𝒱 (n - 1) (Fin n) := by
        have := Submodule.sub_mem _ hz (hfv v)
        rwa [add_sub_cancel_left] at this
      exact ⟨v, by rw [htopb w hw, add_zero]⟩
    · obtain ⟨v, w, rfl⟩ := hsurj z hdz
      obtain ⟨w', hw', hdiff⟩ := exists_d_sub I hI1 s w
      refine ⟨w', hw', (sub_eq_zero.1 (eq_zero_of_mem_iSup_ne I (s := s)
        (Submodule.sub_mem _ hz (d_vx_succ hw')) ?_)).symm⟩
      have he : f v + d I (Fin n) w - d I (Fin n) w'
          = f v + (d I (Fin n) w - d I (Fin n) w') := by
        abel
      rw [he]
      exact add_mem (Submodule.mem_iSup_of_mem (n - 1)
        (Submodule.mem_iSup_of_mem (by omega) (hfv v))) hdiff
  · rintro ⟨hinj, htop, hlow⟩
    refine ⟨fun v w h => ?_, fun z hdz => ?_⟩
    · have h0 := htopb w (h ▸ hfv v)
      exact hinj (by rw [h, h0, map_zero])
    · obtain ⟨c, hc, rfl⟩ := exists_decomp I hI1 z
      have hcyc := d_comp_eq_zero I hI1 hc hdz
      have hj : ∀ j ∈ Finset.range n, ∃ v w, c j = f v + d I (Fin n) w := fun j hj => by
        rw [Finset.mem_range] at hj
        by_cases hjt : j + 1 = n
        · obtain ⟨v, hv⟩ := htop (c j) (by rw [show n - 1 = j by omega]; exact hc j) (hcyc j)
          exact ⟨v, 0, by rw [hv, map_zero, add_zero]⟩
        · obtain ⟨w, -, hw⟩ := hlow j (by omega) (c j) (hc j) (hcyc j)
          exact ⟨0, w, by rw [hw, map_zero, zero_add]⟩
      choose! v w hvw using hj
      refine ⟨∑ j ∈ Finset.range n, v j, ∑ j ∈ Finset.range n, w j, ?_⟩
      rw [map_sum, map_sum, ← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
      exact Finset.sum_congr rfl hvw

name: Operad.Bar.map_zero_bijective_iff_deg
statement:
theorem map_zero_bijective_iff_deg {n : ℕ} {V : Type*} [AddCommGroup V] [Module K V]
    (f : V →ₗ[K] FreeGrL K (BarGen I) (Fin n))
    (hf : ∀ v, f ((0 : V →ₗ[K] V) v) = d I (Fin n) (f v))
    (hfv : ∀ v, f v ∈ 𝒱 (n - 1) (Fin n)) :
    Function.Bijective (Homology.map f hf) ↔ Function.Injective f ∧
      (∀ z ∈ 𝒱 (n - 1) (Fin n), d I (Fin n) z = 0 → ∃ v, f v = z) ∧
      ∀ s, s + 1 < n → ∀ z ∈ 𝒱 s (Fin n), d I (Fin n) z = 0 →
        ∃ w ∈ 𝒱 (s + 1) (Fin n), d I (Fin n) w = z
proof:
:= by
  rw [Homology.map_zero_bijective_iff]
  exact elem_iff_deg I hI1 f hfv

name: Operad.GrOperadIdeal.atLeast_sub_of_le
statement:
lemma atLeast_sub_of_le {m : ℕ} {h0 : ∀ y : P (Fin 0), y = 0} {A : Type} [Fintype A]
    [DecidableEq A] (h : m ≤ Fintype.card A) : (atLeast R P m h0).sub A = ⊤
proof:
:=
  if_pos h

name: Operad.GrOperadIdeal.atLeast_sub_of_lt
statement:
lemma atLeast_sub_of_lt {m : ℕ} {h0 : ∀ y : P (Fin 0), y = 0} {A : Type} [Fintype A]
    [DecidableEq A] (h : Fintype.card A < m) : (atLeast R P m h0).sub A = ⊥
proof:
:=
  if_neg (by omega)

name: Operad.FreeGrL.genCoef_par
statement:
lemma genCoef_par {A : Type} [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] (b : Bool) (x : FreeGrL R V A) :
    genCoef R V A (GrOperad.par (R := R) b x) = GrSpecies.par (R := R) b (genCoef R V A x)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := (𝒥).proj_surjective A x
  exact genCoefF_par b y

name: Operad.ShuffleBarSym.gen_eq_zero
statement:
lemma gen_eq_zero {B : Type} [Fintype B] [DecidableEq B] (hB : Fintype.card B ≠ 2) (v : E B) :
    v = 0
proof:
:= by
  let e : B ≃ Fin (Fintype.card B) := Fintype.equivFin B
  have hk : ∀ k, k ≠ 2 → IsEmpty (BinGen G k) := fun k hk => ⟨fun b => by cases b; exact hk rfl⟩
  haveI := hk _ hB
  have h0 : SymSpecies.map (R := K) (V := E) e v = 0 :=
    (c (Fintype.card B)).repr.injective (Subsingleton.elim _ _)
  have := congrArg (SymSpecies.map (R := K) (V := E) e.symm) h0
  rwa [← SymSpecies.map_trans, Equiv.self_trans_symm, SymSpecies.map_refl, map_zero] at this

name: Operad.ShuffleBarSym.hEred
statement: lemma hEred (B : Type) [Fintype B] [DecidableEq B] (hB : Fintype.card B ≤ 1) (v : E B) : v = 0
proof:
:=
  gen_eq_zero c (by omega) v

name: Operad.ShuffleBarSym.pres_zero
statement: lemma pres_zero (y : Koszul.Pres K E r (Fin 0)) : y = 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := (𝒥).proj_surjective (Fin 0) y
  rw [free_zero c hc x, map_zero]

name: Operad.ShuffleBarSym.hE_pres
statement:
lemma hE_pres (A : Type) [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] (v : E A) :
    (𝒥).proj A ((FreeGrL.ι K E).app A v) ∈ (Ipres K E c hc r).sub A
proof:
:= by
  by_cases h : 2 ≤ Fintype.card A
  · rw [GrOperadIdeal.atLeastTwo_sub_of_le h]
    trivial
  · rw [hEred c A (by omega) v, map_zero, map_zero]
    exact zero_mem _

name: Operad.ShuffleBarSym.span_le_atLeast_three
statement:
lemma span_le_atLeast_three :
    𝒥 ≤ GrOperadIdeal.atLeast K (FreeGrL K E) 3 (free_zero c hc)
proof:
:=
  GrOperadIdeal.span_le.2 fun n x hx => by
    by_cases h : 3 ≤ n
    · rw [GrOperadIdeal.atLeast_sub_of_le (by simpa using h)]
      trivial
    · rw [hr2 n (by omega)] at hx
      exact hx.elim

name: Operad.ShuffleBarSym.eq_zero_of_mem_span
statement:
lemma eq_zero_of_mem_span {B : Type} [Fintype B] [DecidableEq B] (hB : Fintype.card B ≤ 2)
    {x : FreeGrL K E B} (hx : x ∈ (𝒥).sub B) : x = 0
proof:
:= by
  have h := span_le_atLeast_three c hc r hr2 _ hx
  rwa [GrOperadIdeal.atLeast_sub_of_lt (by omega), Submodule.mem_bot] at h

name: Operad.ShuffleBarSym.presCoef_proj
statement:
lemma presCoef_proj {A : Type} [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] (y : FreeGrL K E A) :
    presCoef c hc r hr2 A ((𝒥).proj A y) = FreeGrL.genCoef K E A y
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.ShuffleBarSym.barRet_barGen
statement:
lemma barRet_barGen {A : Type} [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] (v : GrSpecies.Shift E K A) :
    (barRet c hc r hr2).app A
      ((Koszul.barGen (Ipres K E c hc r) (hE_pres c hc r)).app A v) = v
proof:
:=
  FreeGrL.genCoef_ι (R := K) (V := E) v

name: Operad.ShuffleBarSym.dualToBar_injective
statement:
theorem dualToBar_injective (A : Type) [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] :
    Function.Injective ((Koszul.toBar (Ipres K E c hc r) (hE_pres c hc r)).app A)
proof:
:= by
  intro x y hxy
  have hid : ∀ z : Koszul.Cut K E A, (FreeGrL.mapSp (barRet c hc r hr2)).app A
      ((FreeGrL.mapSp (Koszul.barGen (Ipres K E c hc r) (hE_pres c hc r))).app A z) = z :=
    fun z => (FreeGrL.mapSp_comp _ _ z).trans ((FreeGrL.mapSp_congr
      (ψ := (GrSpEnd.id K (GrSpecies.Shift E K)).toHom)
      (fun B _ _ v => barRet_barGen c hc r hr2 v) z).trans (FreeGrL.mapSp_id z))
  refine (Koszul.dualSub K E r).incl_injective A ?_
  refine ((hid _).symm.trans ?_).trans (hid _)
  exact congrArg ((FreeGrL.mapSp (barRet c hc r hr2)).app A) hxy

name: Operad.ShuffleBarSym.mem_units_free
statement:
lemma mem_units_free {A : Type} [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] (hA : Fintype.card A ≤ 1)
    (x : FreeGrL K E A) : x ∈ Bar.unitsP (R := K) (FreeGrL K E) A
proof:
:=
  FreeGrL.mem_unitSpan_of_card_le (R := K) (V := E) (hEred c) hA x

name: Operad.ShuffleBarSym.hcompl_pres
statement:
lemma hcompl_pres (A : Type) [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] :
    IsCompl (Bar.unitsP (R := K) (Koszul.Pres K E r) A) ((Ipres K E c hc r).sub A)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases h : 2 ≤ Fintype.card A
  · rw [GrOperadIdeal.atLeastTwo_sub_of_le h]
    have hb : Bar.unitsP (R := K) (Koszul.Pres K E r) A = ⊥ := by
      rw [Bar.unitsP, Submodule.span_eq_bot]
      rintro _ ⟨e, rfl⟩
      have := Fintype.card_congr e
      rw [Fintype.card_unit] at this
      omega
    rw [hb]
    exact isCompl_bot_top
  · rw [GrOperadIdeal.atLeastTwo_sub_of_lt (by omega)]
    have ht : Bar.unitsP (R := K) (Koszul.Pres K E r) A = ⊤ := by
      refine eq_top_iff.2 fun y _ => ?_
      obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := (𝒥).proj_surjective A y
      have hx := Submodule.mem_map_of_mem (f := (𝒥).proj A) (mem_units_free c (by omega) x)
      rw [Bar.unitsP, Submodule.map_span] at hx
      refine Submodule.span_mono ?_ hx
      rintro _ ⟨_, ⟨e, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
      refine ⟨e, ?_⟩
      rw [← (𝒥).projHom_app, (𝒥).projHom.app_map, (𝒥).projHom.app_one]
    rw [ht]
    exact isCompl_top_bot

name: Operad.ShuffleBarSym.span_le_atLeastTwo
statement: lemma span_le_atLeastTwo (hr : ∀ n, n < 2 → r n = ∅) : 𝒥 ≤ Ibar K E c hc
proof:
:=
  GrOperadIdeal.span_le.2 fun n x hx => by
    by_cases h : 2 ≤ n
    · rw [GrOperadIdeal.atLeastTwo_sub_of_le (by simpa using h)]
      trivial
    · rw [hr n (by omega)] at hx
      exact hx.elim

name: Operad.ShuffleBarSym.one_ne_zero_free
statement: lemma one_ne_zero_free : GrOperad.one (R := K) (P := FreeGrL K E) ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro h0
  have hall : ∀ x : FreeGrL K E (Fin 1), x = 0 := by
    intro x
    have hx := mem_units_free c (by simp) x
    have hbot : Bar.unitsP (R := K) (FreeGrL K E) (Fin 1) = ⊥ := by
      rw [Bar.unitsP, Submodule.span_eq_bot]
      rintro _ ⟨e, rfl⟩
      dsimp only
      rw [h0]
      exact map_zero _
    rw [hbot, Submodule.mem_bot] at hx
    exact hx
  have hm : LTree.leaf 0 ∈ LTree.monomials (E := G) (Fintype.card (Fin 1)) := by
    simp [LTree.monomials]
  exact (tBasis c hc (Fin 1)).ne_zero ⟨_, hm⟩ (hall _)

name: Operad.ShuffleBarSym.hone_pres
statement:
lemma hone_pres (hr : ∀ n, n < 2 → r n = ∅) (a : K)
    (ha : a • GrOperad.one (R := K) (P := Koszul.Pres K E r) = 0) : a = 0
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : (𝒥).proj Unit (a • GrOperad.one (R := K) (P := FreeGrL K E)) = 0 := by
    rw [map_smul]
    exact ha
  rw [GrOperadIdeal.proj_eq_zero_iff] at h1
  have h2 := span_le_atLeastTwo c hc r hr _ h1
  rw [GrOperadIdeal.atLeastTwo_sub_of_lt (by simp), Submodule.mem_bot, smul_eq_zero] at h2
  exact h2.resolve_right (one_ne_zero_free c hc)

name: Operad.ShuffleBarSym.isKoszul_iff_toBar
statement:
theorem isKoszul_iff_toBar (hr : ∀ n, n < 2 → r n = ∅) :
    Koszul.IsKoszul K E r ↔ ∀ (B : Type) [Fintype B] [DecidableEq B], 2 ≤ Fintype.card B →
      Function.Bijective (Homology.map
        (dV := (0 : Koszul.Dual K E r B →ₗ[K] Koszul.Dual K E r B))
        (dW := DGCooperad.d (R := K) (C := BarCoop (Ipres K E c hc r)) (A := B))
        ((Koszul.toBar (Ipres K E c hc r) (hE_pres c hc r)).app B) fun x => by
          rw [LinearMap.zero_apply, map_zero,
            Koszul.d_toBar _ _ (GrOperadIdeal.atLeastTwo_hI1 (pres_zero c hc r)) x])
proof:
:=
  Koszul.isKoszul_iff (Ipres K E c hc r) (hE_pres c hc r)
    (GrOperadIdeal.atLeastTwo_hI1 (pres_zero c hc r)) (hEred c) (hcompl_pres c hc r)
    (hone_pres c hc r hr)

name: Operad.ShuffleBarSym.isKoszul_iff_toBar_fin
statement:
theorem isKoszul_iff_toBar_fin (hr : ∀ n, n < 2 → r n = ∅) :
    Koszul.IsKoszul K E r ↔ ∀ n, 2 ≤ n →
      Function.Bijective (Homology.map
        (dV := (0 : Koszul.Dual K E r (Fin n) →ₗ[K] Koszul.Dual K E r (Fin n)))
        (dW := DGCooperad.d (R := K) (C := BarCoop (Ipres K E c hc r)) (A := Fin n))
        ((Koszul.toBar (Ipres K E c hc r) (hE_pres c hc r)).app (Fin n)) fun x => by
          rw [LinearMap.zero_apply, map_zero,
            Koszul.d_toBar _ _ (GrOperadIdeal.atLeastTwo_hI1 (pres_zero c hc r)) x])
proof:
:= by
  rw [isKoszul_iff_toBar c hc r hr]
  refine ⟨fun h n hn => h (Fin n) (by simpa using hn), fun h B _ _ hB => ?_⟩
  have e : B ≃ Fin (Fintype.card B) := Fintype.equivFin B
  refine (Homology.map_bijective_iff_of_equiv (spMapEquiv e) (spMapEquiv e) (fun v => ?_)
    (fun w => DGCooperad.map_d e w) _ _ fun v => ?_).2 (h _ hB)
  · show SymSpecies.map (R := K) e 0 = 0
    exact map_zero _
  · exact (Koszul.toBar (Ipres K E c hc r) (hE_pres c hc r)).app_map e v

name: Operad.ShuffleBarSym.toBar_mem_vx
statement:
theorem toBar_mem_vx {n : ℕ} (hn : 1 ≤ n) (x : Koszul.Dual K E r (Fin n)) :
    (Koszul.toBar (Ipres K E c hc r) (hE_pres c hc r)).app (Fin n) x ∈ 𝒱P (n - 1) (Fin n)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Koszul.toBar_app]
  have h := FreeGrL.mem_vx_of_binary (R := K) (V := GrSpecies.Shift E K)
    (fun B _ _ hB v => gen_eq_zero c hB v) (by simpa using hn)
    ((Koszul.dualSub K E r).incl (Fin n) x)
  rw [Fintype.card_fin] at h
  exact FreeGrL.mapSp_mem_vx h

name: Operad.ShuffleBarSym.isKoszul_iff_deg
statement:
theorem isKoszul_iff_deg (hr : ∀ n, n < 2 → r n = ∅) :
    Koszul.IsKoszul K E r ↔ ∀ n, 2 ≤ n →
      Function.Injective ((Koszul.toBar (Ipres K E c hc r) (hE_pres c hc r)).app (Fin n)) ∧
      (∀ z ∈ 𝒱P (n - 1) (Fin n), Bar.d (Ipres K E c hc r) (Fin n) z = 0 →
        ∃ x, (Koszul.toBar (Ipres K E c hc r) (hE_pres c hc r)).app (Fin n) x = z) ∧
      ∀ s, s + 1 < n → ∀ z ∈ 𝒱P s (Fin n), Bar.d (Ipres K E c hc r) (Fin n) z = 0 →
        ∃ w ∈ 𝒱P (s + 1) (Fin n), Bar.d (Ipres K E c hc r) (Fin n) w = z
proof:
:= by
  refine (isKoszul_iff_toBar_fin c hc r hr).trans (forall_congr' fun n =>
    imp_congr_right fun hn => (Homology.map_zero_bijective_iff _ _).trans ?_)
  exact Bar.elem_iff_deg (Ipres K E c hc r) (GrOperadIdeal.atLeastTwo_hI1 (pres_zero c hc r))
    ((Koszul.toBar (Ipres K E c hc r) (hE_pres c hc r)).app (Fin n))
    (toBar_mem_vx c hc r (by omega))

name: Operad.ShuffleBarSym.isKoszul_iff_cycles
statement:
theorem isKoszul_iff_cycles :
    Koszul.IsKoszul K E r ↔ ∀ n, 2 ≤ n →
      (∀ z ∈ 𝒱P (n - 1) (Fin n), Bar.d (Ipres K E c hc r) (Fin n) z = 0 →
        ∃ x, (Koszul.toBar (Ipres K E c hc r) (hE_pres c hc r)).app (Fin n) x = z) ∧
      ∀ s, s + 1 < n → ∀ z ∈ 𝒱P s (Fin n), Bar.d (Ipres K E c hc r) (Fin n) z = 0 →
        ∃ w ∈ 𝒱P (s + 1) (Fin n), Bar.d (Ipres K E c hc r) (Fin n) w = z
proof:
:=
  (isKoszul_iff_deg c hc r fun n hn => hr2 n (by omega)).trans (forall_congr' fun n =>
    imp_congr_right fun _ => and_iff_right (dualToBar_injective c hc r hr2 (Fin n)))

name: Operad.SymOperadHom.id_app
statement:
@[simp] lemma id_app (A : Type) [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] (x : P A) :
    (SymOperadHom.id : SymOperadHom R P P).app A x = x
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.SymOperadHom.comp_id
statement: @[simp] lemma comp_id (φ : SymOperadHom R P Q) : φ.comp SymOperadHom.id = φ
proof:
:=
  ext fun _ _ _ _ => rfl

name: Operad.SymOperadHom.id_comp
statement: @[simp] lemma id_comp (φ : SymOperadHom R P Q) : SymOperadHom.id.comp φ = φ
proof:
:=
  ext fun _ _ _ _ => rfl

name: Operad.SymOperadHom.comp_assoc
statement:
lemma comp_assoc {T : (A : Type) → [Fintype A] → [DecidableEq A] → Type*}
    [∀ (A : Type) [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A], AddCommGroup (T A)]
    [∀ (A : Type) [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A], Module R (T A)] [SymOperad R T]
    (χ : SymOperadHom R S T) (ψ : SymOperadHom R Q S) (φ : SymOperadHom R P Q) :
    (χ.comp ψ).comp φ = χ.comp (ψ.comp φ)
proof:
:=
  ext fun _ _ _ _ => rfl

name: Operad.SymOperadIso.inv_hom_apply
statement:
@[simp] lemma inv_hom_apply (e : SymOperadIso R P Q) (A : Type) [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A]
    (x : P A) : e.inv.app A (e.hom.app A x) = x
proof:
:=
  congrArg (fun φ : SymOperadHom R P P => φ.app A x) e.hom_inv_id

name: Operad.SymOperadIso.hom_inv_apply
statement:
@[simp] lemma hom_inv_apply (e : SymOperadIso R P Q) (A : Type) [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A]
    (y : Q A) : e.hom.app A (e.inv.app A y) = y
proof:
:=
  congrArg (fun φ : SymOperadHom R Q Q => φ.app A y) e.inv_hom_id

name: Operad.SymOperadIso.linearEquiv_apply
statement:
@[simp] lemma linearEquiv_apply (e : SymOperadIso R P Q) (A : Type) [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A]
    (x : P A) : e.linearEquiv A x = e.hom.app A x
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.SymOperadIso.bijective
statement:
lemma bijective (e : SymOperadIso R P Q) (A : Type) [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] :
    Function.Bijective (e.hom.app A)
proof:
:=
  (e.linearEquiv A).bijective

name: Operad.SymOperadIso.ofBijective_hom
statement:
@[simp] lemma ofBijective_hom (φ : SymOperadHom R P Q)
    (h : ∀ (A : Type) [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A], Function.Bijective (φ.app A)) :
    (ofBijective φ h).hom = φ
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.FreeGrL.shEv_relabel
statement:
theorem shEv_relabel (f : ℕ → ℕ) : ∀ (t : STree B) (Y : Finset ℕ) (h : t.labels = Y.val)
    (Y' : Finset ℕ) (h' : (t.relabel f).labels = Y'.val) (e : Lab Y ≃ Lab Y')
    (_ : ∀ x, (e x).1 = f x.1),
    shEv b (t.relabel f) Y' h' = GrOperad.map (R := R) e (shEv b t Y h)
  | .leaf a, Y, h, Y', h', e, _ => by
    show shEv b (.leaf (f a)) Y' h' = _
    rw [shEv_leaf, shEv_leaf, map_unitL]
  | .node (k := k) β c, Y, h, Y', h', e, he => by
    have h'' : (STree.node β fun j => (c j).relabel f).labels = Y'.val
proof:
:= h'
    show shEv b (.node β fun j => (c j).relabel f) Y' h'' = _
    have hown : own h ∘ e.symm = own h'' := by
      funext s'
      refine (own_eq h'' ?_).symm
      have hs := mem_own h (e.symm s')
      have : f (e.symm s').1 = s'.1 := by rw [← he, Equiv.apply_symm_apply]
      rw [← this, labels_relabel]
      exact Multiset.mem_map_of_mem f hs
    rw [shEv_node, shEv_node, ← graft_map, map_mk_ownGen, mk_ownGen_congr _ _ hown]
    congr 3
    funext j
    let ej : Lab (cLab c j) ≃ Lab (cLab (fun j => (c j).relabel f) j) :=
      (childEquiv h j).trans ((fibMap e (own h) j).trans
        ((Equiv.subtypeEquivRight fun s => by rw [hown]).trans (childEquiv h'' j).symm))
    have hej : ∀ x, (ej x).1 = f x.1 := fun x => he _
    rw [shEv_relabel f (c j) (cLab c j) (labels_child h j) _ (labels_child h'' j) ej hej]
    simp only [GrOperad.toGrSpecies_map, ← GrOperad.map_trans]
    apply gmap_congr
    intro x
    simp only [ej, Equiv.trans_apply, Equiv.apply_symm_apply]

name: Operad.FreeGrL.exists_shEv_corolla
statement:
theorem exists_shEv_corolla {k : ℕ} (β : B k) (c : Fin k → STree B) (Y : Finset ℕ)
    (h : (STree.node β c).labels = Y.val) (hall : ∀ j, ∃ a, c j = .leaf a) :
    ∃ θ : Fin k ≃ Lab Y, (∀ j, c j = .leaf (θ j).1) ∧
      shEv b (.node β c) Y h = GrOperad.map (R := R) θ ((ι R W).app (Fin k) (b k β))
proof:
:= by
  choose a ha using hall
  have hnd : (STree.node β c).labels.Nodup := h ▸ Y.nodup
  have hmem : ∀ j, a j ∈ Y := fun j => by
    rw [← Finset.mem_val, ← h]
    exact mem_labels_node.2 ⟨j, by rw [ha j]; simp⟩
  have hinj : Injective a := fun i j hij => by
    by_contra hne
    have := disjoint_of_node hnd hne
    rw [ha i, ha j, hij] at this
    simp at this
  have hsurj : ∀ y : Lab Y, ∃ j, a j = y.1 := fun y => by
    have hy : y.1 ∈ (STree.node β c).labels := by rw [h]; exact y.2
    obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := mem_labels_node.1 hy
    rw [ha j] at hj
    exact ⟨j, (Multiset.mem_singleton.1 hj).symm⟩
  let θ : Fin k ≃ Lab Y := Equiv.ofBijective (fun j => ⟨a j, hmem j⟩)
    ⟨fun i j hij => hinj (congrArg Subtype.val hij), fun y => by
      obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := hsurj y
      exact ⟨j, Subtype.ext hj⟩⟩
  have hc : c = fun j => STree.leaf (θ j).1 := funext fun j => ha j
  refine ⟨θ, fun j => congrFun hc j, ?_⟩
  subst hc
  exact shEv_corolla b β Y θ h

name: Operad.FreeGrL.shEv_split
statement:
theorem shEv_split {k : ℕ} (β : B k) (c : Fin k → STree B) (ht : (STree.node β c).IsShuffle)
    (Y : Finset ℕ) (h : (STree.node β c).labels = Y.val) (j : Fin k) :
    ∃ (Y₁ Y₂ : Finset ℕ) (h₁ : (STree.node β (update c j (.leaf (c j).first))).labels = Y₁.val)
      (h₂ : (c j).labels = Y₂.val) (hm : (c j).first ∈ Y₁)
      (E : Lab Y ≃ Without (Lab Y₁) ⟨(c j).first, hm⟩ ⊕ Lab Y₂), (∀ x, sval (E x) = x.1) ∧
      GrOperad.comp (R := R) (⟨(c j).first, hm⟩ : Lab Y₁)
          (shEv b (.node β (update c j (.leaf (c j).first))) Y₁ h₁) (shEv b (c j) Y₂ h₂)
        = σ R (vpar p (c j) && vaft p (.node β (update c j (.leaf (c j).first))) (c j).first)
          • GrOperad.map (R := R) E (shEv b (.node β c) Y h)
proof:
:= by
  have hnd : (STree.node β c).labels.Nodup := h ▸ Y.nodup
  set t₂ := c j with ht₂
  set m := t₂.first with hm_def
  have hjs : t₂.IsShuffle := ht.child j
  have hmj : m ∈ t₂.labels := first_mem hjs
  let c₁ : Fin k → STree B := update c j (.leaf m)
  let t₁ : STree B := .node β c₁
  have hle : t₁.labels ≤ (STree.node β c).labels := by
    simp only [t₁, labels_node]
    refine Finset.sum_le_sum fun i _ => ?_
    by_cases hij : i = j
    · subst hij
      simp only [c₁, update_self, labels_leaf]
      exact Multiset.singleton_le.2 hmj
    · simp only [c₁, update_of_ne hij]
      exact le_rfl
  have hnd₁ : t₁.labels.Nodup := Multiset.nodup_of_le hle hnd
  have hnd₂ : t₂.labels.Nodup := nodup_of_node hnd j
  set Y₁ := t₁.labels.toFinset
  set Y₂ := t₂.labels.toFinset
  have h₁ : t₁.labels = Y₁.val := labels_eq_toFinset hnd₁
  have h₂ : t₂.labels = Y₂.val := labels_eq_toFinset hnd₂
  have hm₁ : m ∈ Y₁ := Multiset.mem_toFinset.2
    (mem_labels_node.2 ⟨j, by simp [c₁]⟩)
  have hother : ∀ i, i ≠ j → ∀ x ∈ (c i).labels, x ∉ t₂.labels := fun i hij x hx hx' =>
    Multiset.disjoint_left.1 (disjoint_of_node hnd hij) hx hx'
  have hsub : t₁.subst (update STree.leaf m t₂) = STree.node β c := by
    simp only [t₁, subst_node]
    congr 1
    funext i
    by_cases hij : i = j
    · subst hij
      simp [c₁, ht₂]
    · simp only [c₁, update_of_ne hij]
      rw [subst_congr (ys := STree.leaf) (c i) fun x hx => update_of_ne
        (fun hxm => hother i hij x hx (by rw [hxm]; exact hmj)) _ _, subst_leaf]
  have hY : ∀ x, x ∈ Y ↔ (x ∈ Y₁ ∧ x ≠ m) ∨ x ∈ Y₂ := fun x => by
    rw [← Finset.mem_val, ← h, ← hsub, labels_subst, h₁]
    simp only [Multiset.mem_bind, Finset.mem_val]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨y, hy, hxy⟩
      by_cases hym : y = m
      · subst hym
        rw [update_self] at hxy
        exact Or.inr (Multiset.mem_toFinset.2 hxy)
      · rw [update_of_ne hym, labels_leaf, Multiset.mem_singleton] at hxy
        subst hxy
        exact Or.inl ⟨hy, hym⟩
    · rintro (⟨hx, hxm⟩ | hx)
      · exact ⟨x, hx, by rw [update_of_ne hxm]; simp⟩
      · exact ⟨m, hm₁, by rw [update_self]; exact Multiset.mem_toFinset.1 hx⟩
  have hd : ∀ x ∈ Y₁, x ≠ m → x ∉ Y₂ := fun x hx hxm hx₂ => by
    obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := mem_labels_node.1 (Multiset.mem_toFinset.1 hx)
    by_cases hij : i = j
    · subst hij
      simp [c₁] at hi
      exact hxm hi
    · simp only [c₁, update_of_ne hij] at hi
      exact hother i hij x hi (Multiset.mem_toFinset.1 hx₂)
  have hh : (t₁.subst (update STree.leaf m t₂)).labels = Y.val := by rw [hsub, h]
  let E := labSplit hm₁ hY hd
  have hcomp := comp_shEv b hb t₂ Y₂ h₂ t₁ Y₁ h₁ m hm₁ Y hh E (sval_labSplit hm₁ hY hd)
  have hev := map_shEv b hsub rfl hh h (Equiv.refl _) fun _ => rfl
  rw [GrOperad.map_refl] at hev
  rw [hev] at hcomp
  exact ⟨Y₁, Y₂, h₁, h₂, hm₁, E, sval_labSplit hm₁ hY hd, hcomp⟩

name: Operad.Bar.d_map_ι
statement:
lemma d_map_ι {k : ℕ} {Y : Type} [Fintype Y] [DecidableEq Y] (θ : Fin k ≃ Y)
    (g : BarGen I (Fin k)) :
    d I Y (GrOperad.map (R := R) θ ((FreeGrL.ι R (BarGen I)).app (Fin k) g)) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [d_map, d_ι, map_zero]

name: Operad.Bar.mergeSp_fn_eq
statement:
lemma mergeSp_fn_eq {k l : ℕ} (g₁ : GrGen R (BarGen I) k) (g₂ : GrGen R (BarGen I) l)
    (q : Fin k) (N : ℕ) (hN : N + 1 = k + l) :
    (mergeSp I).fn k l g₁ q g₂ N
      = ⟨(msVal I g₁.1.2 g₁.1.1 q g₂.1.1 N hN, !(xor g₁.1.2 g₂.1.2)),
          (mergeSp I).par _ _ _ _ _ _ _ g₁.2 g₂.2⟩
proof:
:=
  Subtype.ext (Prod.ext ((mergeSp I).fn_val g₁ g₂ ⟨q.2, hN⟩) ((mergeSp I).fn_par g₁ g₂))

name: Operad.Bar.mc_map_ι
statement:
theorem mc_map_ι {k l : ℕ} {Y₁ Y₂ : Type} [Fintype Y₁] [DecidableEq Y₁] [Fintype Y₂]
    [DecidableEq Y₂] (θ₁ : Fin k ≃ Y₁) (θ₂ : Fin l ≃ Y₂) (q : Fin k) (g₁ : BarGen I (Fin k))
    (g₂ : BarGen I (Fin l)) (hg₁ : GrSpecies.par (R := R) true g₁ = g₁)
    (hg₂ : GrSpecies.par (R := R) true g₂ = g₂) (N : ℕ) (hN : N + 1 = k + l) :
    (mergeSp I).mc (θ₁ q) (GrOperad.map (R := R) θ₁ ((FreeGrL.ι R (BarGen I)).app (Fin k) g₁))
        (GrOperad.map (R := R) θ₂ ((FreeGrL.ι R (BarGen I)).app (Fin l) g₂))
      = GrOperad.map (R := R) ((posEquivF q l N hN).symm.trans (compEquiv θ₁ θ₂ q))
          ((FreeGrL.ι R (BarGen I)).app (Fin N) (msVal I true g₁ q g₂ N hN))
proof:
:= by
  rw [MergeSp.mc_map, FreeGrL.ι_app_hom hg₁, FreeGrL.ι_app_hom hg₂]
  erw [MergeSp.mc_gen (mergeSp I) ⟨(g₁, true), hg₁⟩ q ⟨(g₂, true), hg₂⟩ N hN]
  rw [mergeSp_fn_eq, GrOperad.map_trans]
  congr 2
  exact (FreeGrL.ι_app_hom _).symm

name: Operad.STree.vaft_corolla
statement:
lemma vaft_corolla {B : ℕ → Type w} (p : ∀ k, B k → Bool) {k : ℕ} (β : B k)
    (c : Fin k → STree B) (hall : ∀ j, ∃ a, c j = .leaf a) (m : ℕ) :
    vaft p (.node β c) m = false
proof:
:= by
  rw [vaft_node, GrEnd.tot]
  rw [Finset.sum_eq_zero fun j _ => by obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := hall j; simp [ha]]
  rfl

name: Operad.LTree.toBinSTree_plug
statement:
lemma toBinSTree_plug {G : Type*} (ins : ℕ → LTree G) : ∀ m : LTree G,
    toBinSTree (m.plug ins) = (toBinSTree m).subst fun a => toBinSTree (ins a)
  | leaf _ => rfl
  | node e l r => by
    simp only [plug, toBinSTree, STree.subst_node]
    congr 1
    funext i
    fin_cases i
    · exact toBinSTree_plug ins l
    · exact toBinSTree_plug ins r

end LTree

namespace ShuffleBarSym

open LTree

section CompT

variable {K : Type u} [CommRing K] {E : (A : Type) → [Fintype A] → [DecidableEq A] → Type u}
  [∀ (A : Type) [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A], AddCommGroup (E A)]
  [∀ (A : Type) [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A], Module K (E A)] [GrSpecies K E]
  {G : Type} [Fintype G] [DecidableEq G]
  (c : ∀ k, Module.Basis (BinGen G k) K (E (Fin k)))
  (hc : ∀ k (β : BinGen G k), GrSpecies.par (R := K) false (c k β) = c k β)

                                                                                                  
                                                                         
def mergeMono (m₁ : LTree G) (q : ℕ) (m₂ : LTree G) (f₁ f₂ : ℕ → ℕ) : LTree G
proof:
:=
  m₁.plug fun a => if a = q then m₂.plug (fun i => LTree.leaf (f₂ i)) else LTree.leaf (f₁ a)

name: Operad.ShuffleBarSym.val_map_of_equiv
statement:
lemma val_map_of_equiv {Y Y' : Finset ℕ} {f : ℕ → ℕ} (e : Lab Y ≃ Lab Y')
    (he : ∀ x, (e x).1 = f x.1) : Y.val.map f = Y'.val
proof:
:= by
  have hinj : ∀ x ∈ Y.val, ∀ y ∈ Y.val, f x = f y → x = y := fun x hx y hy hxy => by
    have : e ⟨x, hx⟩ = e ⟨y, hy⟩ := Subtype.ext (by rw [he, he]; exact hxy)
    exact congrArg Subtype.val (e.injective this)
  refine (Multiset.Nodup.ext (Multiset.Nodup.map_on hinj Y.nodup) Y'.nodup).2 fun x => ?_
  rw [Multiset.mem_map]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩
    rw [← he ⟨y, hy⟩]
    exact (e ⟨y, hy⟩).2
  · intro hx
    exact ⟨(e.symm ⟨x, hx⟩).1, (e.symm ⟨x, hx⟩).2, by rw [← he, Equiv.apply_symm_apply]⟩

name: Operad.ShuffleBarSym.labels_toBinSTree_mono
statement:
lemma labels_toBinSTree_mono {k : ℕ} (m : LTree G)
    (hm : m ∈ LTree.monomials (Fintype.card (Fin k))) :
    (toBinSTree m).labels = (Finset.range (Fintype.card (Fin k))).val
proof:
:=
  (binMonoEquiv _ ⟨m, hm⟩).2.2

name: Operad.ShuffleBarSym.val_symm_posEquiv
statement:
lemma val_symm_posEquiv {k : ℕ} (x : Lab (Finset.range (Fintype.card (Fin k)))) :
    ((FreeGrL.posEquiv (Fin k)).symm x : ℕ) = x.1
proof:
:= by
  conv_rhs => rw [← (FreeGrL.posEquiv (Fin k)).apply_symm_apply x]
  rw [FreeGrL.posEquiv_apply, opos_fin]

name: Operad.ShuffleBarSym.labels_relabel_mono
statement:
lemma labels_relabel_mono {k : ℕ} (m : LTree G) (hm : m ∈ LTree.monomials (Fintype.card (Fin k)))
    {Y : Finset ℕ} (θ : Fin k ≃ Lab Y) (f : ℕ → ℕ) (hf : ∀ j : Fin k, (θ j).1 = f j) :
    ((toBinSTree m).relabel f).labels = Y.val
proof:
:= by
  rw [STree.labels_relabel, labels_toBinSTree_mono m hm]
  exact val_map_of_equiv ((FreeGrL.posEquiv (Fin k)).symm.trans θ) fun x => by
    rw [Equiv.trans_apply, hf, val_symm_posEquiv]

name: Operad.ShuffleBarSym.map_tBasis
statement:
lemma map_tBasis {k : ℕ} (m : LTree G) (hm : m ∈ LTree.monomials (Fintype.card (Fin k)))
    {Y : Finset ℕ} (θ : Fin k ≃ Lab Y) (f : ℕ → ℕ) (hf : ∀ j : Fin k, (θ j).1 = f j)
    (h : ((toBinSTree m).relabel f).labels = Y.val) :
    GrOperad.map (R := K) θ (tBasis c hc (Fin k) ⟨m, hm⟩)
      = FreeGrL.shEv c ((toBinSTree m).relabel f) Y h
proof:
:= by
  rw [tBasis_apply, FreeGrL.shuffleBasis_apply, ← GrOperad.map_trans]
  refine (FreeGrL.shEv_relabel c f _ _ _ Y h _ fun x => ?_).symm
  rw [Equiv.trans_apply, hf, val_symm_posEquiv]

name: Operad.ShuffleBarSym.comp_tBasis
statement:
theorem comp_tBasis {k l : ℕ} (m₁ : LTree G) (hm₁ : m₁ ∈ LTree.monomials (Fintype.card (Fin k)))
    (m₂ : LTree G) (hm₂ : m₂ ∈ LTree.monomials (Fintype.card (Fin l))) {Y₁ Y₂ Y : Finset ℕ}
    (θ₁ : Fin k ≃ Lab Y₁) (θ₂ : Fin l ≃ Lab Y₂) (f₁ f₂ : ℕ → ℕ)
    (hf₁ : ∀ j : Fin k, (θ₁ j).1 = f₁ j) (hf₂ : ∀ i : Fin l, (θ₂ i).1 = f₂ i) (q : Fin k)
    (hY : (toBinSTree (mergeMono m₁ q m₂ f₁ f₂)).labels = Y.val)
    (E' : Lab Y ≃ Without (Lab Y₁) (θ₁ q) ⊕ Lab Y₂) (hE : ∀ x, FreeGrL.sval (E' x) = x.1) :
    GrOperad.comp (R := K) (θ₁ q) (GrOperad.map (R := K) θ₁ (tBasis c hc (Fin k) ⟨m₁, hm₁⟩))
        (GrOperad.map (R := K) θ₂ (tBasis c hc (Fin l) ⟨m₂, hm₂⟩))
      = GrOperad.map (R := K) E'
          (FreeGrL.shEv c (toBinSTree (mergeMono m₁ q m₂ f₁ f₂)) Y hY)
proof:
:= by
  have h₁ := labels_relabel_mono m₁ hm₁ θ₁ f₁ hf₁
  have h₂ := labels_relabel_mono m₂ hm₂ θ₂ f₂ hf₂
  rw [map_tBasis c hc m₁ hm₁ θ₁ f₁ hf₁ h₁, map_tBasis c hc m₂ hm₂ θ₂ f₂ hf₂ h₂]
  have hlt : ∀ a ∈ (toBinSTree m₁).labels, a < k := fun a ha => by
    rw [labels_toBinSTree_mono m₁ hm₁, Finset.mem_val, Finset.mem_range,
      Fintype.card_fin] at ha
    exact ha
  have hsub : ((toBinSTree m₁).relabel f₁).subst
      (Function.update STree.leaf (θ₁ q).1 ((toBinSTree m₂).relabel f₂))
        = toBinSTree (mergeMono m₁ q m₂ f₁ f₂) := by
    rw [mergeMono, toBinSTree_plug, STree.relabel, STree.subst_subst]
    refine STree.subst_congr _ fun a ha => ?_
    rw [STree.subst_leaf']
    by_cases haq : a = q
    · rw [if_pos haq, haq, ← hf₁ q, Function.update_self, toBinSTree_plug]
      rfl
    · rw [if_neg haq]
      have hne : f₁ a ≠ (θ₁ q).1 := fun h' => by
        have h'' : θ₁ ⟨a, hlt a ha⟩ = θ₁ q := Subtype.ext (by rw [hf₁]; exact h')
        exact haq (congrArg Fin.val (θ₁.injective h''))
      rw [Function.update_of_ne hne]
      rfl
  have hY' : (((toBinSTree m₁).relabel f₁).subst
      (Function.update STree.leaf (θ₁ q).1 ((toBinSTree m₂).relabel f₂))).labels = Y.val := by
    rw [hsub]
    exact hY
  have := FreeGrL.comp_shEv c (p := fun _ _ => false) hc ((toBinSTree m₂).relabel f₂) Y₂ h₂
    ((toBinSTree m₁).relabel f₁) Y₁ h₁ (θ₁ q).1 (θ₁ q).2 Y hY' E' hE
  rw [vpar_false, Bool.false_and, σ_false, one_smul] at this
  rw [this, ← FreeGrL.map_shEv c hsub rfl hY' hY (Equiv.refl _) fun _ => rfl, GrOperad.map_refl]

name: Operad.ShuffleBarSym.firstFn_fin
statement:
lemma firstFn_fin {B : ℕ → Type*} {k : ℕ} (ch : Fin k → STree B) (j : Fin k) :
    firstFn ch j = (ch j).first
proof:
:= by
  rw [firstFn, dif_pos j.2]

name: Operad.ShuffleBarSym.d_eq_of_comp_two
statement:
lemma d_eq_of_comp_two {k l N : ℕ} {Y₁ Y₂ : Finset ℕ} (m₁ : VMono G k) (m₂ : VMono G l)
    (θ₁ : Fin k ≃ Lab Y₁) (θ₂ : Fin l ≃ Lab Y₂) (j₀ : Fin k) (i : Lab Y₁) (hq : θ₁ j₀ = i)
    (f₁ f₂ : ℕ → ℕ) (hf₁ : ∀ j : Fin k, (θ₁ j).1 = f₁ j) (hf₂ : ∀ i : Fin l, (θ₂ i).1 = f₂ i)
    (hN : N + 1 = k + l) (hM : mergeMono m₁.1 j₀ m₂.1 f₁ f₂ ∈ LTree.monomials N ∧ 2 ≤ N)
    (X : FreeGrL K (BarGen (Ibar K E c hc)) (Lab (Finset.range (Fintype.card (Fin N)))))
    (E' : Lab (Finset.range (Fintype.card (Fin N))) ≃ Without (Lab Y₁) i ⊕ Lab Y₂)
    (hE : ∀ x, FreeGrL.sval (E' x) = x.1)
    (hcomp : GrOperad.comp (R := K) i
        (GrOperad.map (R := K) θ₁ ((FreeGrL.ι K (BarGen (Ibar K E c hc))).app (Fin k)
          (genBasis c hc k m₁)))
        (GrOperad.map (R := K) θ₂ ((FreeGrL.ι K (BarGen (Ibar K E c hc))).app (Fin l)
          (genBasis c hc l m₂)))
      = GrOperad.map (R := K) E' X) :
    Bar.d (Ibar K E c hc) _ X = GrOperad.map (R := K) (FreeGrL.posEquiv (Fin N))
      ((FreeGrL.ι K (BarGen (Ibar K E c hc))).app (Fin N) (genBasis c hc N ⟨_, hM⟩))
proof:
:= by
  subst hq
  have hA := Bar.d_map_ι (Ibar K E c hc) θ₁ (genBasis c hc k m₁)
  have hA' := Bar.d_map_ι (Ibar K E c hc) θ₂ (genBasis c hc l m₂)
  have hd := Bar.d_comp (Ibar K E c hc) (θ₁ j₀)
    (GrOperad.map (R := K) θ₁ ((FreeGrL.ι K (BarGen (Ibar K E c hc))).app (Fin k)
      (genBasis c hc k m₁)))
    (GrOperad.map (R := K) θ₂ ((FreeGrL.ι K (BarGen (Ibar K E c hc))).app (Fin l)
      (genBasis c hc l m₂)))
  have hdm := Bar.d_map (I := Ibar K E c hc) E' X
  have hmc := Bar.mc_map_ι _ θ₁ θ₂ j₀ (genBasis c hc k m₁) (genBasis c hc l m₂)
    (par_genBasis c hc k m₁) (par_genBasis c hc l m₂) N hN
  simp only [hcomp, hdm, hA, hA', hmc, map_zero, LinearMap.zero_apply, zero_add] at hd
  have hY : (toBinSTree (mergeMono m₁.1 j₀ m₂.1 f₁ f₂)).labels
      = (Finset.range (Fintype.card (Fin N))).val :=
    labels_toBinSTree_mono _ (by rw [Fintype.card_fin]; exact hM.1)
  have hB := comp_tBasis c hc m₁.1 (by simpa using m₁.2.1) m₂.1 (by simpa using m₂.2.1) θ₁ θ₂
    f₁ f₂ hf₁ hf₂ j₀ hY E' hE
  have hmerge : Bar.msVal (Ibar K E c hc) true (genBasis c hc k m₁) j₀ (genBasis c hc l m₂) N hN
      = SymSpecies.map (R := K) ((FreeGrL.posEquiv (Fin N)).trans (E'.trans
          ((compEquiv θ₁ θ₂ j₀).symm.trans (posEquivF j₀ l N hN)))) (genBasis c hc N ⟨_, hM⟩) := by
    refine IdealSp.ext _ ?_
    rw [Bar.val_msVal]
    show _ = GrOperad.map (R := K) _ (idealBasis c hc N ⟨_, hM⟩ : FreeGrL K E (Fin N))
    rw [Bool.not_true, σ_false, one_smul]
    show GrOperad.map (R := K) _ (GrOperad.comp (R := K) j₀
      (idealBasis c hc k m₁ : FreeGrL K E (Fin k)) (idealBasis c hc l m₂ : FreeGrL K E (Fin l)))
      = _
    rw [idealBasis_apply, idealBasis_apply, idealBasis_apply, tBasis_apply c hc (Fin N),
      FreeGrL.shuffleBasis_apply]
    have hc' := GrOperad.map_comp (R := K) (P := FreeGrL K E) θ₁ θ₂ j₀
      (tBasis c hc (Fin k) ⟨m₁.1, by simpa using m₁.2.1⟩)
      (tBasis c hc (Fin l) ⟨m₂.1, by simpa using m₂.2.1⟩)
    rw [hB] at hc'
    have hc'' := congrArg (GrOperad.map (R := K) (compEquiv θ₁ θ₂ j₀).symm) hc'
    rw [← GrOperad.map_trans, Equiv.self_trans_symm, GrOperad.map_refl] at hc''
    rw [hc'', ← GrOperad.map_trans, ← GrOperad.map_trans, ← GrOperad.map_trans]
    apply gmap_congr
    intro x
    simp only [Equiv.trans_apply, Equiv.apply_symm_apply]
  have happ := (FreeGrL.ι K (BarGen (Ibar K E c hc))).app_map ((FreeGrL.posEquiv (Fin N)).trans
    (E'.trans ((compEquiv θ₁ θ₂ j₀).symm.trans (posEquivF j₀ l N hN)))) (genBasis c hc N ⟨_, hM⟩)
  simp only [hmerge, happ] at hd
  have hd' := congrArg (GrOperad.map (R := K) E'.symm) hd
  simp only [GrOperad.toGrSpecies_map, ← GrOperad.map_trans, Equiv.self_trans_symm,
    GrOperad.map_refl] at hd'
  refine hd'.trans (gmap_congr (fun x => ?_) _)
  simp only [Equiv.trans_apply, Equiv.symm_apply_apply, Equiv.apply_symm_apply]

name: Operad.ShuffleBarSym.d_shEv_two
statement:
theorem d_shEv_two {k l N : ℕ} (m₁ : VMono G k) (ch : Fin k → STree (VMono G)) (j₀ : Fin k)
    (m₂ : VMono G l) (c₂ : Fin l → STree (VMono G)) (hj₀ : ch j₀ = .node m₂ c₂)
    (hl₁ : ∀ j, j ≠ j₀ → ∃ a, ch j = .leaf a) (hl₂ : ∀ i, ∃ a, c₂ i = .leaf a)
    (ht : (STree.node m₁ ch).IsShuffle)
    (h : (STree.node m₁ ch).labels = (Finset.range (Fintype.card (Fin N))).val)
    (hM : twoMono m₁ ch j₀ m₂ c₂ ∈ LTree.monomials N ∧ 2 ≤ N)
    (h' : (STree.node (⟨_, hM⟩ : VMono G N) fun j : Fin N => .leaf j.1).labels
      = (Finset.range (Fintype.card (Fin N))).val) :
    Bar.d (Ibar K E c hc) _ (FreeGrL.shEv (genBasis c hc) (.node m₁ ch) _ h)
      = FreeGrL.shEv (genBasis c hc) (.node (⟨_, hM⟩ : VMono G N) fun j : Fin N => .leaf j.1)
          _ h'
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨Y₁, Y₂, h₁, h₂, hm, E', hE, hcomp⟩ :=
    FreeGrL.shEv_split (genBasis c hc) (par_genBasis c hc) m₁ ch ht _ h j₀
  have hall₁ : ∀ j, ∃ a, Function.update ch j₀ (.leaf (ch j₀).first) j = .leaf a := fun j => by
    by_cases hj : j = j₀
    · subst hj
      exact ⟨_, Function.update_self _ _ _⟩
    · rw [Function.update_of_ne hj]
      exact hl₁ j hj
  have hv : STree.vaft (fun _ _ => true) (STree.node m₁ (Function.update ch j₀
      (.leaf (ch j₀).first))) (ch j₀).first = false := STree.vaft_corolla _ _ _ hall₁ _
  simp only [hv, Bool.and_false, σ_false, one_smul] at hcomp
  obtain ⟨θ₁, hθ₁, hev₁⟩ := FreeGrL.exists_shEv_corolla (genBasis c hc) m₁ _ Y₁ h₁ hall₁
  have h₂' : (STree.node m₂ c₂).labels = Y₂.val := hj₀ ▸ h₂
  obtain ⟨θ₂, hθ₂, hev₂⟩ := FreeGrL.exists_shEv_corolla (genBasis c hc) m₂ c₂ Y₂ h₂' hl₂
  have hev₂' : FreeGrL.shEv (genBasis c hc) (ch j₀) Y₂ h₂
      = FreeGrL.shEv (genBasis c hc) (.node m₂ c₂) Y₂ h₂' := by
    have := FreeGrL.map_shEv (genBasis c hc) hj₀ rfl h₂ h₂' (Equiv.refl _) fun _ => rfl
    rwa [GrOperad.map_refl] at this
  replace hcomp := (congrArg₂ (fun x y => GrOperad.comp (R := K) (⟨(ch j₀).first, hm⟩ : Lab Y₁) x y)
