    hev₁ (hev₂'.trans hev₂)).symm.trans hcomp
  have hq : θ₁ j₀ = ⟨(ch j₀).first, hm⟩ := Subtype.ext (by
    have := hθ₁ j₀
    rw [Function.update_self] at this
    exact (STree.leaf.inj this).symm)
  have hf₁ : ∀ j : Fin k, (θ₁ j).1 = firstFn ch j := fun j => by
    rw [firstFn_fin]
    by_cases hj : j = j₀
    · subst hj
      rw [hq]
    · have := hθ₁ j
      rw [Function.update_of_ne hj] at this
      rw [this]
      rfl
  have hf₂ : ∀ i : Fin l, (θ₂ i).1 = firstFn c₂ i := fun i => by
    rw [firstFn_fin, hθ₂ i]
    rfl
  have hN : N + 1 = k + l := by
    have h1 := Fintype.card_congr E'
    rw [Fintype.card_sum, Reg.card_without, ← Fintype.card_congr θ₁,
      ← Fintype.card_congr θ₂] at h1
    simp only [Fintype.card_coe, Finset.card_range, Fintype.card_fin] at h1
    have := j₀.pos
    omega
  refine (d_eq_of_comp_two c hc m₁ m₂ θ₁ θ₂ j₀ _ hq (firstFn ch) (firstFn c₂) hf₁ hf₂ hN hM _ E'
    hE hcomp).trans ?_
  have hπ : (fun j : Fin N => STree.leaf (FreeGrL.posEquiv (Fin N) j).1)
      = fun j : Fin N => (STree.leaf j.1 : STree (VMono G)) :=
    funext fun j => by rw [FreeGrL.posEquiv_apply, opos_fin]
  have h'' : (STree.node (E := VMono G) (k := N) ⟨_, hM⟩
      fun j : Fin N => STree.leaf (FreeGrL.posEquiv (Fin N) j).1).labels
        = (Finset.range (Fintype.card (Fin N))).val := by rw [hπ]; exact h'
  have e1 := FreeGrL.shEv_corolla (genBasis c hc) (⟨_, hM⟩ : VMono G N) _
    (FreeGrL.posEquiv (Fin N)) h''
  have e2 := FreeGrL.map_shEv (genBasis c hc) (congrArg (STree.node _) hπ) rfl h'' h'
    (Equiv.refl _) fun _ => rfl
  exact e1.symm.trans ((GrOperad.map_refl _).symm.trans e2)

name: Operad.ShuffleBarSym.length_preKeys
statement:
lemma length_preKeys {B : ℕ → Type*} : ∀ t : STree B, (preKeys t).length = t.weight
  | .leaf _ => rfl
  | .node _ ch => by
    simp only [preKeys, List.length_cons, List.length_flatten, List.map_ofFn, List.sum_ofFn,
      STree.weight, Function.comp_def, length_preKeys]
    omega

name: Operad.ShuffleBarSym.inv_eq_zero_of_length_le_one
statement:
lemma inv_eq_zero_of_length_le_one {α : Type*} [LinearOrder α] :
    ∀ {l : List α}, l.length ≤ 1 → inv l = 0
  | [], _ => rfl
  | [_], _ => rfl
  | _ :: _ :: _, h => by simp at h

name: Operad.ShuffleBarSym.sign_eq_one_of_weight_le_two
statement:
lemma sign_eq_one_of_weight_le_two (K : Type u) [CommRing K] {B : ℕ → Type*} (t : STree B)
    (h : t.weight ≤ 2) : sign K t = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [sign, inv_eq_zero_of_length_le_one, pow_zero]
  rw [List.length_tail, length_preKeys]
  omega

name: Operad.ShuffleBarSym.exists_leaf_of_weight_eq_zero
statement:
lemma exists_leaf_of_weight_eq_zero {B : ℕ → Type*} :
    ∀ {t : STree B}, t.weight = 0 → ∃ a, t = .leaf a
  | .leaf a, _ => ⟨a, rfl⟩
  | .node _ _, h => by simp [STree.weight] at h

omit [Fintype G] [DecidableEq G] in

name: Operad.ShuffleBarSym.exists_corolla_of_weight_eq_one
statement:
lemma exists_corolla_of_weight_eq_one {B : ℕ → Type*} :
    ∀ {t : STree B}, t.weight = 1 → ∃ (l : ℕ) (m : B l) (c : Fin l → STree B),
      t = .node m c ∧ ∀ i, ∃ a, c i = .leaf a
  | .leaf _, h => by simp [STree.weight] at h
  | .node m c, h => by
    simp only [STree.weight, add_eq_left, Finset.sum_eq_zero_iff, Finset.mem_univ,
      true_implies] at h
    exact ⟨_, m, c, rfl, fun i => exists_leaf_of_weight_eq_zero (h i)⟩

omit [Fintype G] [DecidableEq G] in

name: Operad.ShuffleBarSym.exists_two
statement:
lemma exists_two {B : ℕ → Type*} : ∀ {t : STree B}, t.weight = 2 →
    ∃ (k : ℕ) (m₁ : B k) (ch : Fin k → STree B) (j₀ : Fin k) (l : ℕ) (m₂ : B l)
      (c₂ : Fin l → STree B), t = .node m₁ ch ∧ ch j₀ = .node m₂ c₂ ∧
        (∀ j, j ≠ j₀ → ∃ a, ch j = .leaf a) ∧ ∀ i, ∃ a, c₂ i = .leaf a
  | .leaf _, h => by simp [STree.weight] at h
  | .node (k := k) m₁ ch, h => by
    have hs : ∑ j, (ch j).weight = 1
proof:
:= by
      simp only [STree.weight] at h
      omega
    obtain ⟨j₀, hj₀⟩ : ∃ j₀, (ch j₀).weight ≠ 0 := by
      by_contra hne
      push Not at hne
      rw [Finset.sum_eq_zero fun j _ => hne j] at hs
      exact zero_ne_one hs
    have hle : (ch j₀).weight ≤ 1 := by
      have := Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun j => (ch j).weight) (fun j _ => Nat.zero_le _)
        (Finset.mem_univ j₀)
      rw [hs] at this
      exact this
    have h1 : (ch j₀).weight = 1 := by omega
    have hrest : ∑ j ∈ Finset.univ.erase j₀, (ch j).weight = 0 := by
      rw [← Finset.add_sum_erase _ _ (Finset.mem_univ j₀), h1] at hs
      omega
    obtain ⟨l, m₂, c₂, hc, hl⟩ := exists_corolla_of_weight_eq_one h1
    refine ⟨k, m₁, ch, j₀, l, m₂, c₂, rfl, hc, fun j hj => ?_, hl⟩
    exact exists_leaf_of_weight_eq_zero
      ((Finset.sum_eq_zero_iff.1 hrest) j (Finset.mem_erase.2 ⟨hj, Finset.mem_univ j⟩))

name: Operad.ShuffleBarSym.liftW_false_eq
statement: lemma liftW_false_eq (x : LTree G) : liftW false x = unflag x
proof:
:= by
  cases x <;> rfl

name: Operad.ShuffleBarSym.liftW_false_plug
statement:
lemma liftW_false_plug (m : LTree G) (ins : ℕ → LTree G) :
    liftW false (m.plug ins) = (liftW false m).plug fun a => liftW false (ins a)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [liftW_false_eq]
  exact (plug_mapDec _ ins m).symm

name: Operad.ShuffleBarSym.plug_leaf_eq
statement:
lemma plug_leaf_eq {X : Type*} : ∀ t : LTree X, t.plug LTree.leaf = t
  | LTree.leaf _ => rfl
  | LTree.node e l r => by rw [plug, plug_leaf_eq l, plug_leaf_eq r]

name: Operad.ShuffleBarSym.toBar_corolla
statement:
lemma toBar_corolla {n : ℕ} (M : VMono G n) :
    toBar (STree.node M fun j : Fin n => .leaf j.1) = liftW false M.1
proof:
:= by
  rw [toBar_node]
  conv_rhs => rw [← plug_leaf_eq (liftW false M.1)]
  refine plug_congr fun a _ => ?_
  unfold kids
  split_ifs <;> rfl

name: Operad.ShuffleBarSym.kids_of_leaf
statement:
lemma kids_of_leaf {a : ℕ} (ha : a < k) {x : ℕ} (hx : ch ⟨a, ha⟩ = .leaf x) :
    kids ch a = LTree.leaf x
proof:
:= by
  rw [kids_of_lt ch ha, hx]
  rfl

name: Operad.ShuffleBarSym.firstFn_of_leaf
statement:
lemma firstFn_of_leaf {a : ℕ} (ha : a < k) {x : ℕ} (hx : ch ⟨a, ha⟩ = .leaf x) :
    firstFn ch a = x
proof:
:= by
  rw [firstFn, dif_pos ha, hx]
  rfl

name: Operad.ShuffleBarSym.kids_child_two
statement:
lemma kids_child_two :
    kids ch j₀ = (liftW true m₂.1).plug fun i => LTree.leaf (firstFn c₂ i)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨e₂, l₂, r₂, h₂⟩ := m₂.exists_node
  rw [kids_fin, hj₀, toBar_node, h₂]
  show (liftW true (LTree.node e₂ l₂ r₂)).plug (kids c₂) = _
  rw [← h₂]
  refine plug_congr fun a ha => ?_
  rw [labels_liftW] at ha
  have hal := m₂.lt ha
  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := hl₂ ⟨a, hal⟩
  rw [kids_of_leaf c₂ hal hx, firstFn_of_leaf c₂ hal hx]

name: Operad.ShuffleBarSym.mergeK_toBar_two
statement:
theorem mergeK_toBar_two (hl₁ : ∀ j, j ≠ j₀ → ∃ a, ch j = .leaf a) :
    mergeK (toBar (STree.node m₁ ch)) (twoKey ch j₀) = liftW false (twoMono m₁ ch j₀ m₂ c₂)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨e, l, r, h⟩ := m₁.exists_node
  obtain ⟨e₂, l₂, r₂, h₂⟩ := m₂.exists_node
  rw [toBar_node, twoMono, mergeMono, liftW_false_plug, h,
    mergeK_plug_liftW (kids ch) false e l r _ (by simp), ← h]
  refine plug_congr fun a ha => ?_
  rw [labels_liftW] at ha
  have hak := m₁.lt ha
  by_cases ha0 : a = j₀
  · subst ha0
    rw [if_pos rfl, kids_child_two hj₀ hl₂, liftW_false_plug, h₂,
      mergeK_plug_liftW_root _ true e₂ l₂ r₂ _ ⟨rfl, by rw [twoKey, kids_child_two hj₀ hl₂, h₂]⟩]
    rfl
  · rw [if_neg ha0]
    have hne : (⟨a, hak⟩ : Fin k) ≠ j₀ := fun h' => ha0 (by rw [← h'])
    obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := hl₁ _ hne
    rw [kids_of_leaf ch hak hx, firstFn_of_leaf ch hak hx]
    rfl

name: Operad.ShuffleBarSym.cutKeys_toBar_two
proof:
:= by
  have hc := card_cutKeys_toBar m₁ ch hnd
  rw [hw] at hc
  obtain ⟨κ, hκ⟩ := Finset.card_eq_one.1
    (show (ShuffleBar.cutKeys (toBar (STree.node m₁ ch))).card = 1 by omega)
  rw [hκ, Finset.singleton_inj]
  have hmem : twoKey ch j₀ ∈ ShuffleBar.cutKeys (toBar (STree.node m₁ ch)) := by
    rw [cutKeys_toBar_node]
    refine Finset.mem_biUnion.2 ⟨j₀, Finset.mem_range.2 j₀.2, ?_⟩
    rw [twoKey, kids_child_two hj₀ hl₂]
    obtain ⟨e₂, l₂, r₂, h₂⟩ := m₂.exists_node
    rw [h₂, cutKeys_plug_liftW, if_pos rfl]
    exact Finset.mem_union_left _ (Finset.mem_singleton_self _)
  rw [hκ] at hmem
  exact (Finset.mem_singleton.1 hmem).symm

name: Operad.ShuffleBarSym.strictOn_firstFn
statement:
lemma strictOn_firstFn {k' : ℕ} (m : VMono G k') {c : Fin k' → STree (VMono G)}
    (hmono : StrictMono fun j => (c j).first) : StrictOn (firstFn c) m.1
proof:
:= by
  intro a ha b hb hab
  rw [firstFn, dif_pos (m.lt ha), firstFn, dif_pos (m.lt hb)]
  exact hmono (show (⟨a, m.lt ha⟩ : Fin k') < ⟨b, m.lt hb⟩ from hab)

name: Operad.ShuffleBarSym.twoMono_mem
proof:
:= by
  have ht₂ : (STree.node m₂ c₂).IsShuffle := hj₀ ▸ ht.2.1 j₀
  have hs₂ : StrictOn (fun i => (LTree.leaf (firstFn c₂ i) : LTree G).minLabel) m₂.1 :=
    strictOn_firstFn m₂ ht₂.2.2
  have hmin : ∀ a ∈ m₁.1.labels, (if a = (j₀ : ℕ) then
      m₂.1.plug (fun i => LTree.leaf (firstFn c₂ i)) else LTree.leaf (firstFn ch a)).minLabel
        = firstFn ch a := fun a _ => by
    by_cases ha0 : a = j₀
    · subst ha0
      rw [if_pos rfl, minLabel_plug_of_strictOn _ hs₂, m₂.minLabel, firstFn_fin, hj₀,
        first_node _ _ ht₂.1]
      rw [firstFn, dif_pos ht₂.1]
      rfl
    · rw [if_neg ha0]
      rfl
  have hshuf : (twoMono m₁ ch j₀ m₂ c₂).IsShuffle := by
    refine isShuffle_plug_of_strictOn _ m₁.isShuffle (fun a ha b hb hab => ?_) fun a _ => ?_
    · beta_reduce
      rw [hmin a ha, hmin b hb]
      exact strictOn_firstFn m₁ ht.2.2 a ha b hb hab
    · beta_reduce
      split_ifs
      · exact isShuffle_plug_of_strictOn _ m₂.isShuffle hs₂ fun _ _ => trivial
      · trivial
  have hlabs : ((twoMono m₁ ch j₀ m₂ c₂).labels : Multiset ℕ) = (STree.node m₁ ch).labels := by
    rw [twoMono, mergeMono, labels_plug, ← Multiset.coe_bind, bind_kids m₁, STree.labels]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => ?_
    by_cases hj : j = j₀
    · subst hj
      rw [if_pos rfl, labels_plug_leaf, ← Multiset.map_coe, hj₀, STree.labels]
      rw [show Multiset.map (firstFn c₂) (m₂.1.labels : Multiset ℕ)
        = Multiset.bind (m₂.1.labels : Multiset ℕ) fun a => {firstFn c₂ a} by
          rw [Multiset.bind_singleton], bind_kids m₂]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
      obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := hl₂ i
      rw [firstFn_fin, hx]
      rfl
    · rw [if_neg (fun h' => hj (Fin.ext h'))]
      obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := hl₁ j hj
      rw [firstFn_fin, hx]
      rfl
  refine ⟨(LTree.mem_monomials n _).2 ⟨hshuf, Multiset.coe_eq_coe.1 ?_⟩, ?_⟩
  · rw [hlabs, hlab, Finset.range_val, Multiset.coe_range]
  · have hc := congrArg Multiset.card hlab
    rw [STree.labels, Multiset.card_sum, Finset.range_val, Multiset.card_range] at hc
    have hk : ∑ _j : Fin k, 1 ≤ ∑ j, Multiset.card (ch j).labels :=
      Finset.sum_le_sum fun j _ => Multiset.card_pos.2 (FreeGrL.labels_ne_zero (ht.2.1 j))
    rw [Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin, smul_eq_mul, mul_one] at hk
    have := m₁.2.2
    omega

name: Operad.ShuffleBarSym.labels_corolla
statement:
lemma labels_corolla {n : ℕ} (M : VMono G n) :
    (STree.node M fun j : Fin n => STree.leaf j.1).labels = (Finset.range n).val
proof:
:= by
  rw [STree.labels]
  simp only [STree.labels_leaf]
  rw [Fin.sum_univ_eq_sum_range (fun i => ({i} : Multiset ℕ)) n, Finset.sum_eq_multiset_sum,
    Multiset.sum_map_singleton]

name: Operad.ShuffleBarSym.isShuffle_corolla
statement:
lemma isShuffle_corolla {n : ℕ} (M : VMono G n) :
    (STree.node M fun j : Fin n => STree.leaf j.1).IsShuffle
proof:
:=
  ⟨by have := M.2.2; omega, fun _ => trivial, fun _ _ h => h⟩

name: Operad.ShuffleBarSym.barBasisN_eq_shEv
statement:
lemma barBasisN_eq_shEv (n : ℕ) (t : SMono (VMono G) (Finset.range n))
    (h : t.1.labels = (Finset.range (Fintype.card (Fin n))).val) :
    barBasisN c hc n t = GrOperad.map (R := K) (FreeGrL.posEquiv (Fin n)).symm
      (FreeGrL.shEv (genBasis c hc) t.1 _ h)
proof:
:= by
  rw [barBasisN_apply, barBasis]
  exact FreeGrL.shuffleBasis_apply (genBasis c hc) (par_genBasis c hc) (Fin n) _

name: Operad.ShuffleBarSym.d_barBasisN_two
statement:
theorem d_barBasisN_two {n : ℕ} {k l : ℕ} (m₁ : VMono G k) (ch : Fin k → STree (VMono G))
    (j₀ : Fin k) (m₂ : VMono G l) (c₂ : Fin l → STree (VMono G)) (hj₀ : ch j₀ = .node m₂ c₂)
    (hl₁ : ∀ j, j ≠ j₀ → ∃ a, ch j = .leaf a) (hl₂ : ∀ i, ∃ a, c₂ i = .leaf a)
    (ht : (STree.node m₁ ch).IsShuffle) (hlab : (STree.node m₁ ch).labels = (Finset.range n).val) :
    Bar.d (Ibar K E c hc) (Fin n) (barBasisN c hc n ⟨_, ht, hlab⟩)
      = barBasisN c hc n (corollaS ⟨_, twoMono_mem hj₀ hl₂ hl₁ ht hlab⟩)
proof:
:= by
  have hM := twoMono_mem hj₀ hl₂ hl₁ ht hlab
  have h₁ : (STree.node m₁ ch).labels = (Finset.range (Fintype.card (Fin n))).val := by
    rw [Fintype.card_fin]
    exact hlab
  have h₂ : (corollaS (⟨_, hM⟩ : VMono G n)).1.labels
      = (Finset.range (Fintype.card (Fin n))).val := by
    rw [Fintype.card_fin]
    exact labels_corolla _
  have e1 := barBasisN_eq_shEv c hc n ⟨_, ht, hlab⟩ h₁
  have e2 := barBasisN_eq_shEv c hc n (corollaS ⟨_, hM⟩) h₂
  have e3 := d_shEv_two c hc m₁ ch j₀ m₂ c₂ hj₀ hl₁ hl₂ ht h₁ hM h₂
  have e4 := Bar.d_map (I := Ibar K E c hc) (FreeGrL.posEquiv (Fin n)).symm
    (FreeGrL.shEv (genBasis c hc) (STree.node m₁ ch) _ h₁)
  refine (congrArg (Bar.d (Ibar K E c hc) (Fin n)) e1).trans (e4.trans ?_)
  exact (congrArg (GrOperad.map (R := K) (FreeGrL.posEquiv (Fin n)).symm) e3).trans e2.symm

name: Operad.ShuffleBarSym.ΦL_d_barBasisN_of_weight_two
statement:
theorem ΦL_d_barBasisN_of_weight_two {n : ℕ} (t : SMono (VMono G) (Finset.range n))
    (hw : t.1.weight = 2) :
    ΦL c hc n (Bar.d (Ibar K E c hc) (Fin n) (barBasisN c hc n t))
      = ShuffleBar.d K (ΦL c hc n (barBasisN c hc n t))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨t, ht, hlab⟩ := t
  obtain ⟨k, m₁, ch, j₀, l, m₂, c₂, rfl, hj₀, hl₁, hl₂⟩ := exists_two hw
  have hnd : (STree.node m₁ ch).labels.Nodup := by
    rw [hlab]
    exact Finset.nodup _
  have hs1 : sign K (STree.node m₁ ch) = 1 := sign_eq_one_of_weight_le_two K _ (le_of_eq hw)
  have hs2 : sign K (corollaS (⟨_, twoMono_mem hj₀ hl₂ hl₁ ht hlab⟩ : VMono G n)).1 = 1 :=
    sign_eq_one_of_weight_le_two K _ (by simp [corollaS, STree.weight])
  rw [d_barBasisN_two c hc m₁ ch j₀ m₂ c₂ hj₀ hl₁ hl₂ ht hlab, Φ_barBasisN, Φ_barBasisN, hs2]
  dsimp only
  rw [hs1, one_smul, one_smul, ShuffleBar.d_single, one_smul, ShuffleBar.dTree,
    cutKeys_toBar_two hj₀ hl₂ hnd hw, Finset.sum_singleton, ShuffleBar.sgn,
    cutKeys_toBar_two hj₀ hl₂ hnd hw, Finset.filter_singleton, if_neg (lt_irrefl _),
    Finset.card_empty, pow_zero, one_smul, mergeK_toBar_two hj₀ hl₂ hl₁]
  exact congrArg (fun x => Finsupp.single x (1 : K)) (toBar_corolla _)

name: Operad.ShuffleBarSym.d_barBasisN_of_weight_one
statement:
theorem d_barBasisN_of_weight_one {n : ℕ} (t : SMono (VMono G) (Finset.range n))
    (hw : t.1.weight = 1) :
    Bar.d (Ibar K E c hc) (Fin n) (barBasisN c hc n t) = (0 : BarCoop (Ibar K E c hc) (Fin n))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨t, ht, hlab⟩ := t
  obtain ⟨l, m, ch, rfl, hl⟩ := exists_corolla_of_weight_eq_one hw
  have h₁ : (STree.node m ch).labels = (Finset.range (Fintype.card (Fin n))).val := by
    rw [Fintype.card_fin]
    exact hlab
  obtain ⟨θ, -, hev⟩ := FreeGrL.exists_shEv_corolla (genBasis c hc) m ch _ h₁ hl
  have e1 := barBasisN_eq_shEv c hc n ⟨_, ht, hlab⟩ h₁
  have e2 := Bar.d_map (I := Ibar K E c hc) (FreeGrL.posEquiv (Fin n)).symm
    (FreeGrL.shEv (genBasis c hc) (STree.node m ch) _ h₁)
  refine (congrArg (Bar.d (Ibar K E c hc) (Fin n)) e1).trans (e2.trans ?_)
  rw [hev, Bar.d_map_ι, map_zero]
  rfl

name: Operad.ShuffleBarSym.ΦL_d_barBasisN_of_weight_one
statement:
theorem ΦL_d_barBasisN_of_weight_one {n : ℕ} (t : SMono (VMono G) (Finset.range n))
    (hw : t.1.weight = 1) :
    ΦL c hc n (Bar.d (Ibar K E c hc) (Fin n) (barBasisN c hc n t))
      = ShuffleBar.d K (ΦL c hc n (barBasisN c hc n t))
proof:
:= by
  rw [d_barBasisN_of_weight_one c hc t hw, map_zero, Φ_barBasisN, map_smul, ShuffleBar.d_single,
    one_smul]
  obtain ⟨t, ht, hlab⟩ := t
  obtain ⟨l, m, ch, rfl, hl⟩ := exists_corolla_of_weight_eq_one hw
  have hnd : (STree.node m ch).labels.Nodup := by
    rw [hlab]
    exact Finset.nodup _
  have hc0 := card_cutKeys_toBar m ch hnd
  have hw' : (STree.node m ch).weight = 1 := hw
  rw [hw', Nat.add_eq_right, Finset.card_eq_zero] at hc0
  dsimp only
  rw [ShuffleBar.dTree, hc0, Finset.sum_empty, smul_zero]

name: Operad.ShuffleBarSym.ΦL_d_of_mem_deg
proof:
:= by
  let D : BarCoop (Ibar K E c hc) (Fin n) →ₗ[K] BarCoop (Ibar K E c hc) (Fin n) :=
    Bar.d (Ibar K E c hc) (Fin n)
  have hle : deg c hc n s ≤
      LinearMap.eqLocus ((ΦL c hc n).comp D) ((ShuffleBar.d K).comp (ΦL c hc n)) := by
    rw [deg, Submodule.span_le]
    rintro _ ⟨t, ht, rfl⟩
    rcases hs with rfl | rfl
    · exact ΦL_d_barBasisN_of_weight_one c hc t ht
    · exact ΦL_d_barBasisN_of_weight_two c hc t ht
  exact hle hx

name: Operad.End.midIdx_val
statement: @[simp] lemma midIdx_val (a b : ℕ) {n : ℕ} (j : Fin n) : (midIdx a b j : ℕ) = a + j
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.End.slotPos_val
statement: @[simp] lemma slotPos_val (a b : ℕ) : (slotPos a b : ℕ) = a
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.End.outIdx_val_of_lt
statement:
lemma outIdx_val_of_lt (a b : ℕ) {n : ℕ} (k : Fin (a + b)) (h : (k : ℕ) < a) :
    (outIdx (n := n) a b k : ℕ) = (k : ℕ)
proof:
:= by
  unfold outIdx; rw [if_pos h]

name: Operad.End.outIdx_val_of_not_lt
statement:
lemma outIdx_val_of_not_lt (a b : ℕ) {n : ℕ} (k : Fin (a + b)) (h : ¬ (k : ℕ) < a) :
    (outIdx (n := n) a b k : ℕ) = (k : ℕ) + n
proof:
:= by
  unfold outIdx; rw [if_neg h]

name: Operad.End.outPos_val_of_lt
statement:
lemma outPos_val_of_lt (a b : ℕ) (k : Fin (a + b)) (h : (k : ℕ) < a) :
    (outPos a b k : ℕ) = (k : ℕ)
proof:
:= by
  unfold outPos; rw [if_pos h]

name: Operad.End.outPos_val_of_not_lt
statement:
lemma outPos_val_of_not_lt (a b : ℕ) (k : Fin (a + b)) (h : ¬ (k : ℕ) < a) :
    (outPos a b k : ℕ) = (k : ℕ) + 1
proof:
:= by
  unfold outPos; rw [if_neg h]

name: Operad.End.midIdx_injective
statement: lemma midIdx_injective (a b : ℕ) {n : ℕ} : Injective (midIdx (n := n) a b)
proof:
:= by
  intro j j' h
  have := congrArg Fin.val h
  simp only [midIdx_val] at this
  exact Fin.ext (by omega)

name: Operad.End.outIdx_injective
statement: lemma outIdx_injective (a b : ℕ) {n : ℕ} : Injective (outIdx (n := n) a b)
proof:
:= by
  intro k k' h
  have hv := congrArg Fin.val h
  have hk := k.isLt; have hk' := k'.isLt
  refine Fin.ext ?_
  by_cases h1 : (k : ℕ) < a <;> by_cases h2 : (k' : ℕ) < a
  · rw [outIdx_val_of_lt a b k h1, outIdx_val_of_lt a b k' h2] at hv; omega
  · rw [outIdx_val_of_lt a b k h1, outIdx_val_of_not_lt a b k' h2] at hv; omega
  · rw [outIdx_val_of_not_lt a b k h1, outIdx_val_of_lt a b k' h2] at hv; omega
  · rw [outIdx_val_of_not_lt a b k h1, outIdx_val_of_not_lt a b k' h2] at hv; omega

name: Operad.End.outPos_injective
statement: lemma outPos_injective (a b : ℕ) : Injective (outPos a b)
proof:
:= by
  intro k k' h
  have hv := congrArg Fin.val h
  have hk := k.isLt; have hk' := k'.isLt
  refine Fin.ext ?_
  by_cases h1 : (k : ℕ) < a <;> by_cases h2 : (k' : ℕ) < a
  · rw [outPos_val_of_lt a b k h1, outPos_val_of_lt a b k' h2] at hv; omega
  · rw [outPos_val_of_lt a b k h1, outPos_val_of_not_lt a b k' h2] at hv; omega
  · rw [outPos_val_of_not_lt a b k h1, outPos_val_of_lt a b k' h2] at hv; omega
  · rw [outPos_val_of_not_lt a b k h1, outPos_val_of_not_lt a b k' h2] at hv; omega

name: Operad.End.midIdx_ne_outIdx
statement:
lemma midIdx_ne_outIdx (a b : ℕ) {n : ℕ} (j : Fin n) (k : Fin (a + b)) :
    midIdx a b j ≠ outIdx a b k
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  have hv := congrArg Fin.val h
  have hj := j.isLt; have hk := k.isLt
  rw [midIdx_val] at hv
  by_cases h1 : (k : ℕ) < a
  · rw [outIdx_val_of_lt a b k h1] at hv; omega
  · rw [outIdx_val_of_not_lt a b k h1] at hv; omega

name: Operad.End.outPos_ne_slotPos
statement: lemma outPos_ne_slotPos (a b : ℕ) (k : Fin (a + b)) : outPos a b k ≠ slotPos a b
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  have hv := congrArg Fin.val h
  have hk := k.isLt
  rw [slotPos_val] at hv
  by_cases h1 : (k : ℕ) < a
  · rw [outPos_val_of_lt a b k h1] at hv; omega
  · rw [outPos_val_of_not_lt a b k h1] at hv; omega

name: Operad.End.idxCases
statement:
lemma idxCases (a b : ℕ) {n : ℕ} (i : Fin (a + n + b)) :
    (∃ j, i = midIdx a b j) ∨ ∃ k, i = outIdx a b k
proof:
:= by
  have hi := i.isLt
  by_cases h1 : (i : ℕ) < a
  · refine Or.inr ⟨⟨i, by omega⟩, Fin.ext ?_⟩
    rw [outIdx_val_of_lt a b _ (by exact h1)]
  · by_cases h2 : (i : ℕ) < a + n
    · refine Or.inl ⟨⟨(i : ℕ) - a, by omega⟩, Fin.ext ?_⟩
      rw [midIdx_val]
      show (i : ℕ) = a + ((i : ℕ) - a)
      omega
    · refine Or.inr ⟨⟨(i : ℕ) - n, by omega⟩, Fin.ext ?_⟩
      rw [outIdx_val_of_not_lt a b _ (by show ¬ ((i : ℕ) - n) < a; omega)]
      show (i : ℕ) = ((i : ℕ) - n) + n
      omega

name: Operad.End.posCases
statement:
lemma posCases (a b : ℕ) (i : Fin (a + 1 + b)) :
    i = slotPos a b ∨ ∃ k, i = outPos a b k
proof:
:= by
  have hi := i.isLt
  by_cases h1 : (i : ℕ) < a
  · refine Or.inr ⟨⟨i, by omega⟩, Fin.ext ?_⟩
    rw [outPos_val_of_lt a b _ (by exact h1)]
  · by_cases h2 : (i : ℕ) = a
    · exact Or.inl (Fin.ext (by rw [slotPos_val]; exact h2))
    · refine Or.inr ⟨⟨(i : ℕ) - 1, by omega⟩, Fin.ext ?_⟩
      rw [outPos_val_of_not_lt a b _ (by show ¬ ((i : ℕ) - 1) < a; omega)]
      show (i : ℕ) = ((i : ℕ) - 1) + 1
      omega

name: Operad.End.midTuple_apply
statement:
@[simp] lemma midTuple_apply (a b : ℕ) {n : ℕ} (v : Fin (a + n + b) → V) (j : Fin n) :
    midTuple a b v j = v (midIdx a b j)
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.End.insTuple_of_lt
statement:
lemma insTuple_of_lt (a b : ℕ) {n : ℕ} (x : V) (v : Fin (a + n + b) → V)
    (i : Fin (a + 1 + b)) (h : (i : ℕ) < a) :
    insTuple a b x v i = v ⟨i, by have
proof:
:= i.isLt; omega⟩ := by
  unfold insTuple; rw [dif_pos h]

name: Operad.End.insTuple_of_eq
statement:
lemma insTuple_of_eq (a b : ℕ) {n : ℕ} (x : V) (v : Fin (a + n + b) → V)
    (i : Fin (a + 1 + b)) (h : (i : ℕ) = a) :
    insTuple a b x v i = x
proof:
:= by
  unfold insTuple; rw [dif_neg (by omega), dif_pos h]

name: Operad.End.insTuple_of_gt
statement:
lemma insTuple_of_gt (a b : ℕ) {n : ℕ} (x : V) (v : Fin (a + n + b) → V)
    (i : Fin (a + 1 + b)) (h : a < (i : ℕ)) :
    insTuple a b x v i = v ⟨(i : ℕ) + n - 1, by have
proof:
:= i.isLt; omega⟩ := by
  unfold insTuple; rw [dif_neg (by omega), dif_neg (by omega)]

name: Operad.End.insTuple_slotPos
statement:
@[simp] lemma insTuple_slotPos (a b : ℕ) {n : ℕ} (x : V) (v : Fin (a + n + b) → V) :
    insTuple a b x v (slotPos a b) = x
proof:
:=
  insTuple_of_eq a b x v _ (slotPos_val a b)

name: Operad.End.insTuple_outPos
statement:
@[simp] lemma insTuple_outPos (a b : ℕ) {n : ℕ} (x : V) (v : Fin (a + n + b) → V)
    (k : Fin (a + b)) :
    insTuple a b x v (outPos a b k) = v (outIdx a b k)
proof:
:= by
  have hk := k.isLt
  by_cases h : (k : ℕ) < a
  · rw [insTuple_of_lt a b x v _ (by rw [outPos_val_of_lt a b k h]; exact h)]
    congr 1
    refine Fin.ext ?_
    rw [outIdx_val_of_lt a b k h]
    exact outPos_val_of_lt a b k h
  · rw [insTuple_of_gt a b x v _ (by rw [outPos_val_of_not_lt a b k h]; omega)]
    congr 1
    refine Fin.ext ?_
    
    
    have h1 : ((outPos a b k : Fin (a + 1 + b)) : ℕ) = (k : ℕ) + 1 :=
      outPos_val_of_not_lt a b k h
    have h2 : ((outIdx (n := n) a b k : Fin (a + n + b)) : ℕ) = (k : ℕ) + n :=
      outIdx_val_of_not_lt a b k h
    show ((outPos a b k : Fin (a + 1 + b)) : ℕ) + n - 1
        = ((outIdx (n := n) a b k : Fin (a + n + b)) : ℕ)
    omega

name: Operad.End.midTuple_update_outIdx
statement:
lemma midTuple_update_outIdx (a b : ℕ) {n : ℕ} [DecidableEq (Fin (a + n + b))]
    (v : Fin (a + n + b) → V) (k : Fin (a + b)) (z : V) :
    midTuple a b (Function.update v (outIdx a b k) z) = midTuple a b v
proof:
:= by
  funext j
  rw [midTuple_apply, midTuple_apply, Function.update_apply,
    if_neg (midIdx_ne_outIdx a b j k)]

name: Operad.End.midTuple_update_midIdx
statement:
lemma midTuple_update_midIdx (a b : ℕ) {n : ℕ} [DecidableEq (Fin (a + n + b))]
    [DecidableEq (Fin n)] (v : Fin (a + n + b) → V) (j : Fin n) (z : V) :
    midTuple a b (Function.update v (midIdx a b j) z)
      = Function.update (midTuple a b v) j z
proof:
:= by
  funext j'
  rw [midTuple_apply, Function.update_apply, Function.update_apply]
  by_cases h : j' = j
  · rw [if_pos h, if_pos (by rw [h])]
  · rw [if_neg h, if_neg (fun hh => h (midIdx_injective a b hh)), midTuple_apply]

name: Operad.End.insTuple_update_midIdx
statement:
lemma insTuple_update_midIdx (a b : ℕ) {n : ℕ} [DecidableEq (Fin (a + n + b))]
    (x : V) (v : Fin (a + n + b) → V) (j : Fin n) (z : V) :
    insTuple a b x (Function.update v (midIdx a b j) z) = insTuple a b x v
proof:
:= by
  funext i
  rcases posCases a b i with rfl | ⟨k, rfl⟩
  · rw [insTuple_slotPos, insTuple_slotPos]
  · rw [insTuple_outPos, insTuple_outPos, Function.update_apply,
      if_neg (fun hh => midIdx_ne_outIdx a b j k hh.symm)]

name: Operad.End.insTuple_update_outIdx
statement:
lemma insTuple_update_outIdx (a b : ℕ) {n : ℕ} [DecidableEq (Fin (a + n + b))]
    [DecidableEq (Fin (a + 1 + b))] (x : V) (v : Fin (a + n + b) → V)
    (k : Fin (a + b)) (z : V) :
    insTuple a b x (Function.update v (outIdx a b k) z)
      = Function.update (insTuple a b x v) (outPos a b k) z
proof:
:= by
  funext i
  rcases posCases a b i with rfl | ⟨k', rfl⟩
  · rw [insTuple_slotPos, Function.update_apply,
      if_neg (fun hh => outPos_ne_slotPos a b k hh.symm), insTuple_slotPos]
  · rw [insTuple_outPos, Function.update_apply, Function.update_apply]
    by_cases h : k' = k
    · rw [if_pos (by rw [h]), if_pos (by rw [h])]
    · rw [if_neg (fun hh => h (outIdx_injective a b hh)),
        if_neg (fun hh => h (outPos_injective a b hh)), insTuple_outPos]

name: Operad.End.insTuple_eq_update
statement:
lemma insTuple_eq_update (a b : ℕ) {n : ℕ} [DecidableEq (Fin (a + 1 + b))]
    (x y : V) (v : Fin (a + n + b) → V) :
    insTuple a b y v = Function.update (insTuple a b x v) (slotPos a b) y
proof:
:= by
  funext i
  rcases posCases a b i with rfl | ⟨k, rfl⟩
  · rw [insTuple_slotPos, Function.update_apply, if_pos rfl]
  · rw [insTuple_outPos, Function.update_apply,
      if_neg (outPos_ne_slotPos a b k), insTuple_outPos]

name: Operad.End.slot_add
statement:
lemma slot_add (a b : ℕ) {n : ℕ} [DecidableEq (Fin (a + 1 + b))]
    (α : End R V (a + 1 + b)) (x y : V) (v : Fin (a + n + b) → V) :
    α (insTuple a b (x + y) v) = α (insTuple a b x v) + α (insTuple a b y v)
proof:
:= by
  have e1 : insTuple a b (x + y) v
      = Function.update (insTuple a b x v) (slotPos a b) (x + y) := insTuple_eq_update a b x _ v
  have e2 : insTuple a b y v
      = Function.update (insTuple a b x v) (slotPos a b) y := insTuple_eq_update a b x y v
  have e3 : Function.update (insTuple a b x v) (slotPos a b) x = insTuple a b x v := by
    conv_rhs => rw [← Function.update_eq_self (slotPos a b) (insTuple a b x v)]
    rw [insTuple_slotPos]
  rw [e1, e2, α.map_update_add, e3]

name: Operad.End.slot_smul
statement:
lemma slot_smul (a b : ℕ) {n : ℕ} [DecidableEq (Fin (a + 1 + b))]
    (α : End R V (a + 1 + b)) (c : R) (x : V) (v : Fin (a + n + b) → V) :
    α (insTuple a b (c • x) v) = c • α (insTuple a b x v)
proof:
:= by
  have e1 : insTuple a b (c • x) v
      = Function.update (insTuple a b x v) (slotPos a b) (c • x) := insTuple_eq_update a b x _ v
  have e3 : Function.update (insTuple a b x v) (slotPos a b) x = insTuple a b x v := by
    conv_rhs => rw [← Function.update_eq_self (slotPos a b) (insTuple a b x v)]
    rw [insTuple_slotPos]
  rw [e1, α.map_update_smul, e3]

name: Operad.End.compMap_apply
statement:
@[simp] lemma compMap_apply (a b : ℕ) {n : ℕ} (α : End R V (a + 1 + b)) (β : End R V n)
    (v : Fin (a + n + b) → V) :
    compMap a b α β v = α (insTuple a b (β (midTuple a b v)) v)
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.End.idEnd_apply
statement: @[simp] lemma idEnd_apply (v : Fin 1 → V) : (idEnd (R := R) (V := V)) v = v 0
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.End.compL_apply
statement:
@[simp] lemma compL_apply (a b : ℕ) {n : ℕ} (α : End R V (a + 1 + b)) (β : End R V n)
    (v : Fin (a + n + b) → V) :
    compL a b α β v = α (insTuple a b (β (midTuple a b v)) v)
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.End.reindex_apply
statement:
lemma reindex_apply {m m' : ℕ} (h : m = m') (x : End R V m) (v : Fin m' → V) :
    reindex R (End R V) h x v = x (fun i => v (Fin.cast h i))
proof:
:= by
  subst h; rfl

name: Operad.End.outIdx_one_eq_outPos
statement:
lemma outIdx_one_eq_outPos (a b : ℕ) (k : Fin (a + b)) :
    outIdx (n := 1) a b k = outPos a b k
proof:
:= by
  refine Fin.ext ?_
  by_cases h : (k : ℕ) < a
  · rw [outIdx_val_of_lt a b k h, outPos_val_of_lt a b k h]
  · rw [outIdx_val_of_not_lt a b k h, outPos_val_of_not_lt a b k h]

name: Operad.End.midIdx_one
statement: lemma midIdx_one (a b : ℕ) : midIdx (n := 1) a b 0 = slotPos a b
proof:
:= by
  refine Fin.ext ?_
  rw [midIdx_val, slotPos_val]
  simp

name: Operad.End.comp_one_right'
statement:
lemma comp_one_right' (a b : ℕ) (α : End R V (a + 1 + b)) :
    compMap a b α (idEnd (R := R) (V := V)) = α
proof:
:= by
  refine MultilinearMap.ext fun v => ?_
  rw [compMap_apply]
  congr 1
  funext i
  rcases posCases a b i with rfl | ⟨k, rfl⟩
  · rw [insTuple_slotPos, idEnd_apply, midTuple_apply, midIdx_one]
  · rw [insTuple_outPos, outIdx_one_eq_outPos]

name: Operad.End.comp_one_left'
statement:
lemma comp_one_left' {n : ℕ} (α : End R V n) :
    reindex R (End R V) (by omega) (compMap 0 0 (idEnd (R := R) (V := V)) α) = α
proof:
:= by
  refine MultilinearMap.ext fun v => ?_
  rw [reindex_apply, compMap_apply, idEnd_apply,
    insTuple_of_eq 0 0 _ _ _ (by simp)]
  congr 1
  funext j
  rw [midTuple_apply]
  congr 1
  refine Fin.ext ?_
  simp

name: Operad.End.comp_assoc_seq'
statement:
lemma comp_assoc_seq' (a b c d : ℕ) {p : ℕ} (α : End R V (a + 1 + b)) (β : End R V (c + 1 + d))
    (γ : End R V p) :
    reindex R (End R V) (by omega)
        (compMap (a + c) (d + b) (reindex R (End R V) (by omega) (compMap a b α β)) γ)
      = compMap a b α (compMap c d β γ)
proof:
:= by
  refine MultilinearMap.ext fun v => ?_
  simp only [reindex_apply, compMap_apply]
  congr 1
  funext i
  rcases lt_trichotomy (i : ℕ) a with hi | hi | hi
  · 
    rw [insTuple_of_lt a b _ _ i hi, insTuple_of_lt a b _ _ i hi,
      insTuple_of_lt (a + c) (d + b) _ _ _ (by simp; omega)]
    congr 1
  · 
    rw [insTuple_of_eq a b _ _ i hi, insTuple_of_eq a b _ _ i hi]
    congr 1
    funext j
    rw [midTuple_apply]
    rcases lt_trichotomy (j : ℕ) c with hj | hj | hj
    · rw [insTuple_of_lt c d _ _ j hj,
        insTuple_of_lt (a + c) (d + b) _ _ _ (by simp; omega), midTuple_apply]
      congr 1
    · rw [insTuple_of_eq c d _ _ j hj,
        insTuple_of_eq (a + c) (d + b) _ _ _ (by simp; omega)]
      congr 1
      funext j'
      rw [midTuple_apply, midTuple_apply, midTuple_apply]
      congr 1
      exact Fin.ext (by simp; omega)
    · rw [insTuple_of_gt c d _ _ j hj,
        insTuple_of_gt (a + c) (d + b) _ _ _ (by simp; omega), midTuple_apply]
      congr 1
      exact Fin.ext (by simp; omega)
  · 
    rw [insTuple_of_gt a b _ _ i hi, insTuple_of_gt a b _ _ i hi,
      insTuple_of_gt (a + c) (d + b) _ _ _ (by simp; omega)]
    congr 1
    exact Fin.ext (by simp; omega)

name: Operad.End.comp_assoc_par'
statement:
lemma comp_assoc_par' (a b c : ℕ) {n p : ℕ} (α : End R V (a + 1 + b + 1 + c)) (β : End R V n)
    (γ : End R V p) :
    reindex R (End R V) (by omega)
        (compMap (a + n + b) c
          (reindex R (End R V) (by omega)
            (compMap a (b + 1 + c) (reindex R (End R V) (by omega) α) β)) γ)
      = compMap a (b + p + c) (reindex R (End R V) (by omega) (compMap (a + 1 + b) c α γ)) β
proof:
:= by
  refine MultilinearMap.ext fun v => ?_
  simp only [reindex_apply, compMap_apply]
  congr 1
  funext i
  rcases lt_trichotomy (i : ℕ) a with hi | hi | hi
  · 
    rw [insTuple_of_lt a (b + 1 + c) _ _ _ (by simp; omega),
      insTuple_of_lt (a + 1 + b) c _ _ i (by omega),
      insTuple_of_lt (a + n + b) c _ _ _ (by simp; omega),
      insTuple_of_lt a (b + p + c) _ _ _ (by simp; omega)]
    exact congrArg _ (Fin.ext (by simp))
  · 
    rw [insTuple_of_eq a (b + 1 + c) _ _ _ (by simp; omega),
      insTuple_of_lt (a + 1 + b) c _ _ i (by omega),
      insTuple_of_eq a (b + p + c) _ _ _ (by simp; omega)]
    refine congrArg _ (funext fun j => ?_)
    rw [midTuple_apply, midTuple_apply,
      insTuple_of_lt (a + n + b) c _ _ _ (by simp; omega)]
    exact congrArg _ (Fin.ext (by simp))
  · rcases lt_trichotomy (i : ℕ) (a + 1 + b) with hi2 | hi2 | hi2
    · 
      rw [insTuple_of_gt a (b + 1 + c) _ _ _ (by simp; omega),
        insTuple_of_lt (a + 1 + b) c _ _ i hi2,
        insTuple_of_lt (a + n + b) c _ _ _ (by simp; omega),
        insTuple_of_gt a (b + p + c) _ _ _ (by simp; omega)]
      exact congrArg _ (Fin.ext (by simp))
    · 
      rw [insTuple_of_gt a (b + 1 + c) _ _ _ (by simp; omega),
        insTuple_of_eq (a + 1 + b) c _ _ i hi2,
        insTuple_of_eq (a + n + b) c _ _ _ (by simp; omega)]
      refine congrArg _ (funext fun j => ?_)
      rw [midTuple_apply, midTuple_apply,
        insTuple_of_gt a (b + p + c) _ _ _ (by simp; omega)]
      exact congrArg _ (Fin.ext (by simp; omega))
    · 
      rw [insTuple_of_gt a (b + 1 + c) _ _ _ (by simp; omega),
        insTuple_of_gt (a + 1 + b) c _ _ i hi2,
        insTuple_of_gt (a + n + b) c _ _ _ (by simp; omega),
        insTuple_of_gt a (b + p + c) _ _ _ (by simp; omega)]
      exact congrArg _ (Fin.ext (by simp; omega))

name: Operad.End.operad_comp_apply
statement:
@[simp] lemma operad_comp_apply (a b : ℕ) {n : ℕ} (α : End R V (a + 1 + b)) (β : End R V n)
    (v : Fin (a + n + b) → V) :
    NSOperad.comp (R := R) a b α β v = α (insTuple a b (β (midTuple a b v)) v)
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.TreeOfArity.weight_def
statement:
lemma TreeOfArity.weight_def {n : ℕ} (t : TreeOfArity E n) :
    t.weight = t.val.weight
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.TreeOfArity.graft_weight
statement:
@[simp] lemma TreeOfArity.graft_weight (a b : ℕ) {n : ℕ} (t : TreeOfArity E (a + 1 + b))
    (s : TreeOfArity E n) :
    (TreeOfArity.graft a b t s).weight = t.weight + s.weight
proof:
:= by
  have ht := t.property
  exact Tree.weight_graft t.val a s.val (by omega)

name: Operad.Free.gen_mem_weightSpan
statement:
lemma Free.gen_mem_weightSpan {n : ℕ} (t : TreeOfArity E n) :
    Free.gen (R := R) t ∈ Free.weightSpan R E n t.weight
proof:
:=
  Submodule.subset_span ⟨t, rfl, rfl⟩

name: Operad.Free.comp_mem_weightSpan
statement:
theorem Free.comp_mem_weightSpan (a b : ℕ) {n w₁ w₂ : ℕ}
    {α : Free R E (a + 1 + b)} (hα : α ∈ Free.weightSpan R E (a + 1 + b) w₁)
    {β : Free R E n} (hβ : β ∈ Free.weightSpan R E n w₂) :
    comp (R := R) (P := Free R E) a b α β ∈ Free.weightSpan R E (a + n + b) (w₁ + w₂)
proof:
:= by
  induction hα using Submodule.span_induction with
  | mem x hx =>
      obtain ⟨t, ht, rfl⟩ := hx
      induction hβ using Submodule.span_induction with
      | mem y hy =>
          obtain ⟨s, hs, rfl⟩ := hy
          have : comp (R := R) (P := Free R E) a b (Free.gen t) (Free.gen s)
              = Free.gen (TreeOfArity.graft a b t s) := Free.compL_gen a b t s
          rw [this, ← ht, ← hs, ← TreeOfArity.graft_weight a b t s]
          exact Free.gen_mem_weightSpan _
      | zero => simp
      | add y z _ _ ihy ihz => simpa [map_add] using Submodule.add_mem _ ihy ihz
      | smul r y _ ihy => simpa [map_smul] using Submodule.smul_mem _ r ihy
  | zero => simp
  | add x y _ _ ihx ihy => simpa [map_add] using Submodule.add_mem _ ihx ihy
  | smul r x _ ihx => simpa [map_smul] using Submodule.smul_mem _ r ihx

name: Operad.Free.reindex_mem_weightSpan
proof:
:= by
  subst h
  simpa using hx

name: Operad.Free.compFin_mem_weightSpan
statement:
lemma Free.compFin_mem_weightSpan {m n w₁ w₂ : ℕ} (i : Fin m)
    {α : Free R E m} (hα : α ∈ Free.weightSpan R E m w₁)
    {β : Free R E n} (hβ : β ∈ Free.weightSpan R E n w₂) :
    compFin (R := R) i α β ∈ Free.weightSpan R E (m - 1 + n) (w₁ + w₂)
proof:
:= by
  unfold compFin
  exact Free.reindex_mem_weightSpan _
    (Free.comp_mem_weightSpan _ _ (Free.reindex_mem_weightSpan _ hα) hβ)

name: Operad.QIso.surj_bot
statement:
lemma surj_bot (D : M →ₗ[R] M) (D' : M' →ₗ[R] M') (F : M →ₗ[R] M') :
    Surj ⊥ ⊥ D D' F
proof:
:= fun y' hy' _ => by
  rw [Submodule.mem_bot] at hy'
  exact ⟨0, zero_mem _, map_zero D, 0, zero_mem _, by rw [hy', map_zero, map_zero, sub_zero]⟩

name: Operad.QIso.inj_bot
statement:
lemma inj_bot (D : M →ₗ[R] M) (D' : M' →ₗ[R] M') (F : M →ₗ[R] M') :
    Inj ⊥ ⊥ D D' F
proof:
:= fun x hx _ _ _ _ => by
  rw [Submodule.mem_bot] at hx
  exact ⟨0, zero_mem _, by rw [hx, map_zero]⟩

name: Operad.QIso.eq_zero_of_add
statement:
lemma eq_zero_of_add {U W : Submodule R M} (h : Disjoint U W) {u w : M} (hu : u ∈ U)
    (hw : w ∈ W) (hs : u + w = 0) : u = 0 ∧ w = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hu' : u = -w := eq_neg_of_add_eq_zero_left hs
  have h0 : u = 0 := Submodule.disjoint_def.1 h u hu (hu' ▸ W.neg_mem hw)
  exact ⟨h0, by rw [h0, zero_add] at hs; exact hs⟩

name: Operad.QIso.Split.memW'
statement: lemma memW' {w : M} (hw : w ∈ W) : D₀ w + D₁ w ∈ W
proof:
:= by
  have := hs.memW w hw
  rwa [LinearMap.add_apply] at this

name: Operad.QIso.Split.dd'
statement: lemma dd' (x : M) : D₀ (D₀ x) + D₁ (D₀ x) + (D₀ (D₁ x) + D₁ (D₁ x)) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have h := hs.dd x
  simpa only [LinearMap.add_apply, map_add] using h

name: Operad.QIso.Split.d₀_d₀
statement: lemma d₀_d₀ {u : M} (hu : u ∈ U) : D₀ (D₀ u) = 0
proof:
:=
  (eq_zero_of_add hs.disj (hs.mem₀ _ (hs.mem₀ u hu))
    (W.add_mem (hs.mem₁ _ (hs.mem₀ u hu)) (hs.memW' (hs.mem₁ u hu)))
    (by linear_combination (norm := module) hs.dd' u)).1

name: Operad.QIso.Split.d_d₁
statement: lemma d_d₁ {u : M} (hu : u ∈ U) : D₀ (D₁ u) + D₁ (D₁ u) = -D₁ (D₀ u)
proof:
:= by
  have := (eq_zero_of_add hs.disj (hs.mem₀ _ (hs.mem₀ u hu))
    (W.add_mem (hs.mem₁ _ (hs.mem₀ u hu)) (hs.memW' (hs.mem₁ u hu)))
    (by linear_combination (norm := module) hs.dd' u)).2
  linear_combination (norm := module) this

name: Operad.QIso.Split.comps
statement:
lemma comps {u w : M} (hu : u ∈ U) (hw : w ∈ W) (h : (D₀ + D₁) (u + w) = 0) :
    D₀ u = 0 ∧ D₁ u + (D₀ w + D₁ w) = 0
proof:
:=
  eq_zero_of_add hs.disj (hs.mem₀ u hu) (W.add_mem (hs.mem₁ u hu) (hs.memW' hw)) (by
    simp only [LinearMap.add_apply, map_add] at h
    linear_combination (norm := module) h)

name: Operad.QIso.surj_sup
statement:
theorem surj_sup (hUs : Surj U U' D₀ D₀' F) (hWs : Surj W W' (D₀ + D₁) (D₀' + D₁') F)
    (hWi : Inj W W' (D₀ + D₁) (D₀' + D₁') F) :
    Surj (U ⊔ W) (U' ⊔ W') (D₀ + D₁) (D₀' + D₁') F
proof:
:= by
  intro y' hy' hdy
  obtain ⟨u', hu', w', hw', rfl⟩ := Submodule.mem_sup.1 hy'
  obtain ⟨h0', h1'⟩ := hs'.comps hu' hw' hdy
  obtain ⟨u, hu, hdu, a', ha', hua⟩ := hUs u' hu' h0'
  have ea := hs'.d_d₁ ha'
  have ec := hF.comm₁ u
  have eh := congrArg D₁' hua
  rw [map_sub] at eh
  have hFd : F (D₁ u) = (D₀' + D₁') (-w' - D₁' a') := by
    simp only [LinearMap.add_apply, map_sub, map_neg]
    linear_combination (norm := module) ec + eh + h1' + ea
  have hdd : (D₀ + D₁) (D₁ u) = 0 := by
    rw [LinearMap.add_apply, hs.d_d₁ hu, hdu, map_zero, neg_zero]
  obtain ⟨z, hz, hdz⟩ := hWi _ (hs.mem₁ u hu) hdd _
    (W'.sub_mem (W'.neg_mem hw') (hs'.mem₁ a' ha')) hFd
  rw [LinearMap.add_apply] at hdz
  have hc'm : F (-z) - w' - D₁' a' ∈ W' := W'.sub_mem (W'.sub_mem (hF.memW _ (W.neg_mem hz)) hw')
    (hs'.mem₁ a' ha')
  have hdc : (D₀' + D₁') (F (-z) - w' - D₁' a') = 0 := by
    have eFz := congrArg F hdz
    rw [map_add] at eFz
    have ec0 := hF.comm₀ z
    have ec1 := hF.comm₁ z
    simp only [LinearMap.add_apply, map_sub, map_neg] at hFd ⊢
    linear_combination (norm := module) ec0 + ec1 - eFz - hFd
  obtain ⟨w₁, hw₁, hdw₁, b', hb', hwb⟩ := hWs _ hc'm hdc
  refine ⟨u + (-z - w₁), Submodule.mem_sup.2 ⟨u, hu, _, W.sub_mem (W.neg_mem hz) hw₁, rfl⟩, ?_,
    a' - b', Submodule.sub_mem _ (Submodule.mem_sup_left ha') (Submodule.mem_sup_right hb'), ?_⟩
  · simp only [LinearMap.add_apply, map_add, map_sub, map_neg] at hdw₁ ⊢
    linear_combination (norm := module) hdu - hdz - hdw₁
  · simp only [LinearMap.add_apply, map_add, map_sub, map_neg] at hwb ⊢
    linear_combination (norm := module) hua - hwb

name: Operad.QIso.inj_sup
statement:
theorem inj_sup (hUs : Surj U U' D₀ D₀' F) (hUi : Inj U U' D₀ D₀' F)
    (hWi : Inj W W' (D₀ + D₁) (D₀' + D₁') F) :
    Inj (U ⊔ W) (U' ⊔ W') (D₀ + D₁) (D₀' + D₁') F
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx hdx z' hz' hFx
  obtain ⟨u, hu, w, hw, rfl⟩ := Submodule.mem_sup.1 hx
  obtain ⟨a', ha', b', hb', rfl⟩ := Submodule.mem_sup.1 hz'
  obtain ⟨h0, h1⟩ := hs.comps hu hw hdx
  simp only [LinearMap.add_apply, map_add] at hFx
  obtain ⟨e1, e2⟩ := eq_zero_of_add hs'.disj (U'.sub_mem (hF.memU u hu) (hs'.mem₀ a' ha'))
    (W'.sub_mem (hF.memW w hw) (W'.add_mem (hs'.mem₁ a' ha') (hs'.memW' hb')))
    (by linear_combination (norm := module) hFx)
  rw [sub_eq_zero] at e1 e2
  obtain ⟨a, ha, hda⟩ := hUi u hu h0 a' ha' e1
  have hcy : D₀' (a' - F a) = 0 := by
    have ec := hF.comm₀ a
    have eFa := congrArg F hda
    rw [map_sub]
    linear_combination (norm := module) -e1 - eFa + ec
  obtain ⟨a₁, ha₁, hda₁, c', hc', hac⟩ := hUs _ (U'.sub_mem ha' (hF.memU a ha)) hcy
  have hw₂ : w - D₁ a - D₁ a₁ ∈ W := W.sub_mem (W.sub_mem hw (hs.mem₁ a ha)) (hs.mem₁ a₁ ha₁)
  have hdw₂ : (D₀ + D₁) (w - D₁ a - D₁ a₁) = 0 := by
    have ea := hs.d_d₁ ha
    have ea₁ := hs.d_d₁ ha₁
    have ed := congrArg D₁ hda
    have ed₁ : D₁ (D₀ a₁) = 0 := by rw [hda₁, map_zero]
    simp only [LinearMap.add_apply, map_sub]
    linear_combination (norm := module) h1 - ea - ea₁ + ed + ed₁
  have hFw₂ : F (w - D₁ a - D₁ a₁) = (D₀' + D₁') (D₁' c' + b') := by
    have c1 := hF.comm₁ a
    have c2 := hF.comm₁ a₁
    have h := congrArg D₁' hac
    have ec' := hs'.d_d₁ hc'
    simp only [map_sub] at h
    simp only [LinearMap.add_apply, map_sub, map_add]
    linear_combination (norm := module) e2 - c1 - c2 - h - ec'
  obtain ⟨e, he, hde⟩ := hWi _ hw₂ hdw₂ _ (W'.add_mem (hs'.mem₁ c' hc') hb') hFw₂
  refine ⟨a + a₁ + e, Submodule.add_mem _ (Submodule.add_mem _ (Submodule.mem_sup_left ha)
    (Submodule.mem_sup_left ha₁)) (Submodule.mem_sup_right he), ?_⟩
  simp only [LinearMap.add_apply, map_add] at hde ⊢
  linear_combination (norm := module) hda + hda₁ + hde

name: Operad.QIso.surj_of_sup
statement:
theorem surj_of_sup (hWs : Surj W W' (D₀ + D₁) (D₀' + D₁') F)
    (hs_ : Surj (U ⊔ W) (U' ⊔ W') (D₀ + D₁) (D₀' + D₁') F)
    (hi_ : Inj (U ⊔ W) (U' ⊔ W') (D₀ + D₁) (D₀' + D₁') F) : Surj U U' D₀ D₀' F
proof:
:= by
  intro u' hu' h0'
  have hcy : (D₀' + D₁') (D₁' u') = 0 := by
    rw [LinearMap.add_apply, hs'.d_d₁ hu', h0', map_zero, neg_zero]
  obtain ⟨w₀, hw₀, hdw₀, b', hb', hwb⟩ := hWs _ (hs'.mem₁ u' hu') hcy
  simp only [LinearMap.add_apply] at hwb
  have hFw₀ : F w₀ = (D₀' + D₁') (u' + b') := by
    simp only [LinearMap.add_apply, map_add]
    linear_combination (norm := module) hwb - h0'
  obtain ⟨z, hz, hdz⟩ := hi_ w₀ (Submodule.mem_sup_right hw₀) hdw₀ _
    (Submodule.add_mem _ (Submodule.mem_sup_left hu') (Submodule.mem_sup_right hb')) hFw₀
  obtain ⟨a, ha, c, hc, rfl⟩ := Submodule.mem_sup.1 hz
  simp only [LinearMap.add_apply, map_add] at hdz
  obtain ⟨hda, hdac⟩ := eq_zero_of_add hs.disj (hs.mem₀ a ha)
    (W.sub_mem (W.add_mem (hs.mem₁ a ha) (hs.memW' hc)) hw₀)
    (by linear_combination (norm := module) hdz)
  have ht : (D₀' + D₁') (F a - u' + (F c - b')) = 0 := by
    have c0a := hF.comm₀ a
    have c1a := hF.comm₁ a
    have c0c := hF.comm₀ c
    have c1c := hF.comm₁ c
    have eF := congrArg F hdac
    have hda' : F (D₀ a) = 0 := by rw [hda, map_zero]
    simp only [map_sub, map_add, map_zero] at eF
    simp only [LinearMap.add_apply, map_sub, map_add]
    linear_combination (norm := module) -c0a + hda' - h0' - c1a - c0c - c1c + eF + hwb
  obtain ⟨x₂, hx₂, hdx₂, g', hg', hxg⟩ := hs_ _ (Submodule.add_mem _
    (Submodule.mem_sup_left (U'.sub_mem (hF.memU a ha) hu'))
    (Submodule.mem_sup_right (W'.sub_mem (hF.memW c hc) hb'))) ht
  obtain ⟨a₂, ha₂, c₂, hc₂, rfl⟩ := Submodule.mem_sup.1 hx₂
  obtain ⟨e', he', h', hh', rfl⟩ := Submodule.mem_sup.1 hg'
  have hda₂ := (hs.comps ha₂ hc₂ hdx₂).1
  simp only [LinearMap.add_apply, map_add] at hxg
  have hU : F a₂ - (F a - u') - D₀' e' = 0 := (eq_zero_of_add hs'.disj
    (U'.sub_mem (U'.sub_mem (hF.memU a₂ ha₂) (U'.sub_mem (hF.memU a ha) hu')) (hs'.mem₀ e' he'))
    (W'.sub_mem (W'.sub_mem (hF.memW c₂ hc₂) (W'.sub_mem (hF.memW c hc) hb'))
      (W'.add_mem (hs'.mem₁ e' he') (hs'.memW' hh')))
    (by linear_combination (norm := module) hxg)).1
  refine ⟨a - a₂, U.sub_mem ha ha₂, by rw [map_sub, hda, hda₂, sub_zero], -e', U'.neg_mem he', ?_⟩
  simp only [map_sub, map_neg]
  linear_combination (norm := module) -hU

name: Operad.QIso.inj_of_sup
statement:
theorem inj_of_sup (hWs : Surj W W' (D₀ + D₁) (D₀' + D₁') F)
    (hWi : Inj W W' (D₀ + D₁) (D₀' + D₁') F)
    (hi_ : Inj (U ⊔ W) (U' ⊔ W') (D₀ + D₁) (D₀' + D₁') F) : Inj U U' D₀ D₀' F
proof:
:= by
  intro u hu h0 a' ha' hFu
  have hcy : (D₀ + D₁) (D₁ u) = 0 := by
    rw [LinearMap.add_apply, hs.d_d₁ hu, h0, map_zero, neg_zero]
  have hFd : F (D₁ u) = (D₀' + D₁') (-D₁' a') := by
    have c1 := hF.comm₁ u
    have eD := congrArg D₁' hFu
    have ea := hs'.d_d₁ ha'
    simp only [LinearMap.add_apply, map_neg]
    linear_combination (norm := module) c1 + eD + ea
  obtain ⟨w, hw, hdw⟩ := hWi _ (hs.mem₁ u hu) hcy _ (W'.neg_mem (hs'.mem₁ a' ha')) hFd
  rw [LinearMap.add_apply] at hdw
  have hdx : (D₀ + D₁) (u - w) = 0 := by
    simp only [LinearMap.add_apply, map_sub]
    linear_combination (norm := module) h0 - hdw
  have hc'm : F (u - w) - (D₀' + D₁') a' ∈ W' := by
    have : F (u - w) - (D₀' + D₁') a' = -(F w + D₁' a') := by
      simp only [LinearMap.add_apply, map_sub]
      linear_combination (norm := module) hFu
    rw [this]
    exact W'.neg_mem (W'.add_mem (hF.memW w hw) (hs'.mem₁ a' ha'))
  have hdc : (D₀' + D₁') (F (u - w) - (D₀' + D₁') a') = 0 := by
    have c0u := hF.comm₀ u
    have c1u := hF.comm₁ u
    have c0w := hF.comm₀ w
    have c1w := hF.comm₁ w
    have eFx := congrArg F hdx
    have edd := hs'.dd' a'
    simp only [LinearMap.add_apply, map_sub, map_add, map_zero] at eFx
    simp only [LinearMap.add_apply, map_sub, map_add]
    linear_combination (norm := module) -c0u - c1u + c0w + c1w + eFx - edd
  obtain ⟨w₁, hw₁, hdw₁, b', hb', hwb⟩ := hWs _ hc'm hdc
  have hFx₁ : F (u - w - w₁) = (D₀' + D₁') (a' - b') := by
    simp only [LinearMap.add_apply, map_sub] at hwb ⊢
    linear_combination (norm := module) -hwb
  obtain ⟨z, hz, hdz⟩ := hi_ _ (Submodule.sub_mem _ (Submodule.sub_mem _
    (Submodule.mem_sup_left hu) (Submodule.mem_sup_right hw)) (Submodule.mem_sup_right hw₁))
    (by rw [map_sub, hdx, hdw₁, sub_zero]) _
    (Submodule.sub_mem _ (Submodule.mem_sup_left ha') (Submodule.mem_sup_right hb')) hFx₁
  obtain ⟨a, ha, c, hc, rfl⟩ := Submodule.mem_sup.1 hz
  refine ⟨a, ha, ?_⟩
  simp only [LinearMap.add_apply, map_add] at hdz
  exact sub_eq_zero.1 (eq_zero_of_add hs.disj (U.sub_mem (hs.mem₀ a ha) hu)
    (W.add_mem (W.add_mem (W.add_mem (hs.mem₁ a ha) (hs.memW' hc)) hw) hw₁)
    (by linear_combination (norm := module) hdz)).1

name: Operad.QIso.surj_of_sup_right
statement:
theorem surj_of_sup_right (hU : ∀ u ∈ U, D₁ u = 0) (hU' : ∀ u ∈ U', D₁' u = 0)
    (hs_ : Surj (U ⊔ W) (U' ⊔ W') (D₀ + D₁) (D₀' + D₁') F) :
    Surj W W' (D₀ + D₁) (D₀' + D₁') F
proof:
:= by
  intro y' hy' hdy
  obtain ⟨x, hx, hdx, z', hz', hxz⟩ := hs_ y' (Submodule.mem_sup_right hy') hdy
  obtain ⟨u, hu, w, hw, rfl⟩ := Submodule.mem_sup.1 hx
  obtain ⟨a', ha', b', hb', rfl⟩ := Submodule.mem_sup.1 hz'
  obtain ⟨-, h1⟩ := hs.comps hu hw hdx
  rw [hU u hu, zero_add] at h1
  refine ⟨w, hw, by rw [LinearMap.add_apply]; exact h1, b', hb', ?_⟩
  simp only [LinearMap.add_apply, map_add] at hxz ⊢
  rw [hU' a' ha', add_zero] at hxz
  have := (eq_zero_of_add hs'.disj (U'.sub_mem (hF.memU u hu) (hs'.mem₀ a' ha'))
    (W'.sub_mem (W'.sub_mem (hF.memW w hw) hy') (hs'.memW' hb'))
    (by linear_combination (norm := module) hxz)).2
  linear_combination (norm := module) this

name: Operad.QIso.inj_of_sup_right
statement:
theorem inj_of_sup_right (hU : ∀ u ∈ U, D₁ u = 0)
    (hi_ : Inj (U ⊔ W) (U' ⊔ W') (D₀ + D₁) (D₀' + D₁') F) :
    Inj W W' (D₀ + D₁) (D₀' + D₁') F
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx hdx z' hz' hFx
  obtain ⟨z, hz, hdz⟩ := hi_ x (Submodule.mem_sup_right hx) hdx z' (Submodule.mem_sup_right hz') hFx
  obtain ⟨a, ha, c, hc, rfl⟩ := Submodule.mem_sup.1 hz
  refine ⟨c, hc, ?_⟩
  simp only [LinearMap.add_apply, map_add] at hdz ⊢
  rw [hU a ha, add_zero] at hdz
  have := (eq_zero_of_add hs.disj (hs.mem₀ a ha) (W.sub_mem (hs.memW' hc) hx)
    (by linear_combination (norm := module) hdz)).2
  linear_combination (norm := module) this

name: Operad.QIso.surj_sub
statement:
theorem surj_sub (hUs : Surj U U' D₀ D₀' F) (hUi : Inj U U' D₀ D₀' F)
    (hTs : Surj (U ⊔ W) (U' ⊔ W') (D₀ + D₁) (D₀' + D₁') F) :
    Surj W W' (D₀ + D₁) (D₀' + D₁') F
proof:
:= by
  intro y' hy' hdy
  obtain ⟨x, hx, hdx, z', hz', hxz⟩ := hTs y' (Submodule.mem_sup_right hy') hdy
  obtain ⟨u, hu, w, hw, rfl⟩ := Submodule.mem_sup.1 hx
  obtain ⟨a', ha', b', hb', rfl⟩ := Submodule.mem_sup.1 hz'
  have hdu := (hs.comps hu hw hdx).1
  simp only [LinearMap.add_apply, map_add] at hxz
  have hFu : F u - D₀' a' = 0 := (eq_zero_of_add hs'.disj
    (U'.sub_mem (hF.memU u hu) (hs'.mem₀ a' ha'))
    (W'.sub_mem (W'.sub_mem (W'.sub_mem (hF.memW w hw) hy') (hs'.mem₁ a' ha')) (hs'.memW' hb'))
    (by linear_combination (norm := module) hxz)).1
  obtain ⟨c, hc, hdc⟩ := hUi u hu hdu a' ha' (sub_eq_zero.1 hFu)
  have hda : D₀' (a' - F c) = 0 := by
    rw [map_sub, ← hF.comm₀, hdc]
    linear_combination (norm := module) -hFu
  obtain ⟨e, he, hde, f', hf', hef⟩ := hUs (a' - F c) (U'.sub_mem ha' (hF.memU c hc)) hda
  refine ⟨u + w - (D₀ + D₁) c - (D₀ + D₁) e, ?_, ?_, D₁' f' + b', W'.add_mem (hs'.mem₁ f' hf') hb',
    ?_⟩
  · have : u + w - (D₀ + D₁) c - (D₀ + D₁) e = w - D₁ c - D₁ e := by
      simp only [LinearMap.add_apply]
      rw [hdc, hde]
      abel
    rw [this]
    exact W.sub_mem (W.sub_mem hw (hs.mem₁ c hc)) (hs.mem₁ e he)
  · rw [map_sub, map_sub, hdx, hs.dd, hs.dd, sub_zero, sub_zero]
  · have c0c := hF.comm₀ c
    have c1c := hF.comm₁ c
    have c0e := hF.comm₀ e
    have c1e := hF.comm₁ e
    have hdd₀ := hs'.d₀_d₀ hf'
    have hdd₁ := hs'.d_d₁ hf'
    have hf2 := congrArg (D₀' + D₁') hef
    simp only [LinearMap.add_apply, map_sub, map_add] at hf2 ⊢
    linear_combination (norm := module) hxz - c0c - c1c - c0e - c1e - hf2 - hdd₀ - hdd₁

name: Operad.QIso.inj_sub
statement:
theorem inj_sub (hUi : Inj U U' D₀ D₀' F)
    (hTs : Surj (U ⊔ W) (U' ⊔ W') (D₀ + D₁) (D₀' + D₁') F)
    (hTi : Inj (U ⊔ W) (U' ⊔ W') (D₀ + D₁) (D₀' + D₁') F) :
    Inj W W' (D₀ + D₁) (D₀' + D₁') F
proof:
:= by
  intro w hw hdw z' hz' hFw
  obtain ⟨v, hv, hdv⟩ := hTi w (Submodule.mem_sup_right hw) hdw z' (Submodule.mem_sup_right hz')
    hFw
  obtain ⟨c, hc, d, hd, rfl⟩ := Submodule.mem_sup.1 hv
  simp only [LinearMap.add_apply, map_add] at hdv
  have hdc : D₀ c = 0 := (eq_zero_of_add hs.disj (hs.mem₀ c hc)
    (W.sub_mem (W.add_mem (hs.mem₁ c hc) (hs.memW' hd)) hw)
    (by linear_combination (norm := module) hdv)).1
  have hcyc : (D₀' + D₁') (F c + F d - z') = 0 := by
    have c0c := hF.comm₀ c
    have c1c := hF.comm₁ c
    have c0d := hF.comm₀ d
    have c1d := hF.comm₁ d
    have eFv := congrArg F hdv
    simp only [LinearMap.add_apply, map_sub, map_add] at hFw eFv ⊢
    linear_combination (norm := module) -c0c - c1c - c0d - c1d + eFv + hFw
  obtain ⟨x, hx, hdx, q', hq', hxq⟩ := hTs _ (Submodule.sub_mem _ (Submodule.add_mem _
    (Submodule.mem_sup_left (hF.memU c hc)) (Submodule.mem_sup_right (hF.memW d hd)))
    (Submodule.mem_sup_right hz')) hcyc
  obtain ⟨xu, hxu, xw, hxw, rfl⟩ := Submodule.mem_sup.1 hx
  obtain ⟨qu, hqu, qw, hqw, rfl⟩ := Submodule.mem_sup.1 hq'
  have hdxu := (hs.comps hxu hxw hdx).1
  simp only [LinearMap.add_apply, map_add] at hxq
  have hU : F xu - F c - D₀' qu = 0 := (eq_zero_of_add hs'.disj
    (U'.sub_mem (U'.sub_mem (hF.memU xu hxu) (hF.memU c hc)) (hs'.mem₀ qu hqu))
    (W'.sub_mem (W'.add_mem (W'.sub_mem (hF.memW xw hxw) (hF.memW d hd)) hz')
      (W'.add_mem (hs'.mem₁ qu hqu) (hs'.memW' hqw)))
    (by linear_combination (norm := module) hxq)).1
  obtain ⟨e, he, hde⟩ := hUi (xu - c) (U.sub_mem hxu hc) (by rw [map_sub, hdxu, hdc, sub_zero])
    qu hqu (by rw [map_sub]; linear_combination (norm := module) hU)
  refine ⟨c + d - (xu + xw) + (D₀ + D₁) e, ?_, ?_⟩
  · have : c + d - (xu + xw) + (D₀ + D₁) e = d - xw + D₁ e := by
      simp only [LinearMap.add_apply]
      rw [hde]
      abel
    rw [this]
    exact W.add_mem (W.sub_mem hd hxw) (hs.mem₁ e he)
  · have hdde := hs.dd e
    simp only [LinearMap.add_apply, map_add, map_sub] at hdx hdde ⊢
    linear_combination (norm := module) hdv - hdx + hdde

name: Operad.QIso.qiso_filt_ge
statement:
theorem qiso_filt_ge (hd : FiltData X S X' S' m D₀ D₁ D₀' D₁' F) {p₀ : ℕ}
    (hs : ∀ p, p₀ ≤ p → Surj (X p) (X' p) D₀ D₀' F)
    (hi : ∀ p, p₀ ≤ p → Inj (X p) (X' p) D₀ D₀' F) (p : ℕ) (hp : p₀ ≤ p) :
    Surj (S p) (S' p) (D₀ + D₁) (D₀' + D₁') F ∧ Inj (S p) (S' p) (D₀ + D₁) (D₀' + D₁') F
proof:
:= by
  suffices h : ∀ j p, p₀ ≤ p → p + j = m →
      Surj (S p) (S' p) (D₀ + D₁) (D₀' + D₁') F ∧ Inj (S p) (S' p) (D₀ + D₁) (D₀' + D₁') F by
    rcases le_or_gt p m with hpm | hpm
    · exact h (m - p) p hp (by omega)
    · have hb : ∀ k, S (m + k) = ⊥ ∧ S' (m + k) = ⊥ := by
        intro k
        induction k with
        | zero => exact ⟨hd.top, hd.top'⟩
        | succ k ih =>
          refine ⟨eq_bot_iff.2 ?_, eq_bot_iff.2 ?_⟩
          · rw [← ih.1, hd.sup (m + k)]; exact le_sup_right
          · rw [← ih.2, hd.sup' (m + k)]; exact le_sup_right
      obtain ⟨k, rfl⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_add_of_le hpm.le
      rw [(hb k).1, (hb k).2]
      exact ⟨surj_bot _ _ _, inj_bot _ _ _⟩
  intro j
  induction j with
  | zero =>
    intro p _ hp
    rw [add_zero] at hp
    subst hp
    rw [hd.top, hd.top']
    exact ⟨surj_bot _ _ _, inj_bot _ _ _⟩
  | succ j ih =>
    intro p hp₀ hp
    obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := ih (p + 1) (by omega) (by omega)
    rw [hd.sup p, hd.sup' p]
    exact ⟨surj_sup (hd.split p) (hd.split' p) (hd.hom p) (hs p hp₀) h1 h2,
      inj_sup (hd.split p) (hd.split' p) (hd.hom p) (hs p hp₀) (hi p hp₀) h2⟩

name: Operad.QIso.qiso_filt
statement:
theorem qiso_filt (hd : FiltData X S X' S' m D₀ D₁ D₀' D₁' F)
    (hs : ∀ p, Surj (X p) (X' p) D₀ D₀' F) (hi : ∀ p, Inj (X p) (X' p) D₀ D₀' F) (p : ℕ) :
    Surj (S p) (S' p) (D₀ + D₁) (D₀' + D₁') F ∧ Inj (S p) (S' p) (D₀ + D₁) (D₀' + D₁') F
proof:
:=
  qiso_filt_ge hd (p₀ := 0) (fun p _ => hs p) (fun p _ => hi p) p (Nat.zero_le p)

name: Operad.QIso.surj_of_retract
statement:
theorem surj_of_retract (hKS : ∀ y ∈ S', K y ∈ S) (hGK : ∀ y ∈ S', G (K y) = r' y) :
    Surj S S' D D' F
proof:
:= by
  intro y' hy' hdy
  have hx : r (K (r' y')) ∈ S := hr.mem _ (hKS _ (hr'.mem _ hy'))
  have h1 : r' (F (r (K (r' y'))) - y') = 0 := by
    rw [map_sub, hG, hGK _ (hr'.mem _ hy'), hr'.rr, sub_self]
  have h2 : D' (F (r (K (r' y'))) - y') = 0 := by rw [map_sub, ← hFD, hr.Dr, map_zero, hdy,
    sub_self]
  obtain ⟨z', hz', hdz⟩ := hr'.acyc _ (S'.sub_mem (hFS _ hx) hy') h2 h1
  exact ⟨_, hx, hr.Dr _, z', hz', hdz.symm⟩

name: Operad.QIso.inj_of_retract
statement: theorem inj_of_retract (hKG : ∀ x ∈ S, K (G x) = r x) : Inj S S' D D' F
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx hdx z' hz' hFx
  obtain ⟨w, hw, hdw⟩ := hr.acyc (x - r x) (S.sub_mem hx (hr.mem x hx))
    (by rw [map_sub, hdx, hr.Dr, sub_self]) (by rw [map_sub, hr.rr, sub_self])
  have h0 : G (r x) = 0 := by
    rw [← hG, hr.rr]
    have : F (r x) = D' z' - D' (F w) := by rw [← hFD, hdw, map_sub, hFx]; abel
    rw [this, map_sub, hr'.rD, hr'.rD, sub_self]
  have h1 : r x = 0 := by rw [← hr.rr x, ← hKG _ (hr.mem x hx), h0, map_zero]
  exact ⟨w, hw, by rw [hdw, h1, sub_zero]⟩

name: Operad.QIso.Retract.neg
statement:
lemma Retract.neg (hr : Retract S D r) : Retract S (-D) r where
  mem
proof:
:= hr.mem
  memD x hx := by rw [LinearMap.neg_apply]; exact S.neg_mem (hr.memD x hx)
  rr := hr.rr
  rD x := by rw [LinearMap.neg_apply, map_neg, hr.rD, neg_zero]
  Dr x := by rw [LinearMap.neg_apply, hr.Dr, neg_zero]
  acyc x hx hdx hrx := by
    rw [LinearMap.neg_apply, neg_eq_zero] at hdx
    obtain ⟨z, hz, hdz⟩ := hr.acyc x hx hdx hrx
    exact ⟨-z, S.neg_mem hz, by rw [LinearMap.neg_apply, map_neg, neg_neg, hdz]⟩

name: Operad.Tree.isLeaf_relabel
statement: @[simp] lemma isLeaf_relabel (t : Tree E) : (relabel f t).isLeaf = t.isLeaf
proof:
:= by
  cases t <;> rfl

name: Operad.Tree.weight_relabel
statement:
theorem weight_relabel : ∀ t : Tree E, (relabel f t).weight = t.weight
  | .leaf => rfl
  | .node _ fo => by simp only [relabel_node, weight_node, Forest.weightF_relabelF fo]

name: Operad.Forest.weightF_relabelF
statement:
theorem _root_.Operad.Forest.weightF_relabelF : ∀ {k : ℕ} (fo : Forest E k),
    (Forest.relabelF f fo).weightF = fo.weightF
  | _, .nil => rfl
  | _, .cons t fo => by
    simp only [relabelF_cons, weightF_cons, weight_relabel t, Forest.weightF_relabelF fo]

end

mutual

name: Operad.Tree.vb_relabel
statement:
theorem vb_relabel : ∀ (t : Tree E) (p : ℕ), (relabel f t).vb p = t.vb p
  | .leaf, _ => rfl
  | .node _ fo, p => by simp only [relabel_node, vb_node, Forest.vbF_relabelF fo p]

name: Operad.Forest.vbF_relabelF
statement:
theorem _root_.Operad.Forest.vbF_relabelF : ∀ {k : ℕ} (fo : Forest E k) (p : ℕ),
    (Forest.relabelF f fo).vbF p = fo.vbF p
  | _, .nil, _ => rfl
  | _, .cons t fo, p => by
    rw [relabelF_cons]
    by_cases h : p < t.arity
    · rw [vbF_cons_of_lt (by rwa [arity_relabel]), vbF_cons_of_lt h, vb_relabel t p]
    · rw [vbF_cons_of_ge (by rw [arity_relabel]; omega), vbF_cons_of_ge (by omega),
        arity_relabel, weight_relabel, Forest.vbF_relabelF fo]

end

name: Operad.Tree.cutV_relabel
statement:
theorem cutV_relabel {t y z : Tree E} {k p : ℕ} (hk : k < t.weight) (hc : t.cutV k = (y, z, p)) :
    (relabel f t).cutV k = (relabel f y, relabel f z, p)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨h1, h2, h3, h4⟩ := cutV_spec hk hc
  rw [← h1, relabel_graft, ← h3, ← vb_relabel f y p]
  exact cutV_graft _ _ _ (by rwa [arity_relabel]) (by rwa [isLeaf_relabel])

name: Operad.Tree.isDirect_relabelF
statement:
lemma isDirect_relabelF : ∀ {k : ℕ} (fo : Forest E k) (p : ℕ),
    (Forest.relabelF f fo).isDirect p = fo.isDirect p
  | _, .nil, _ => rfl
  | _, .cons t fo, p => by
    simp only [relabelF_cons, Forest.isDirect, arity_relabel, isLeaf_relabel,
      isDirect_relabelF fo]

name: Operad.Tree.childIdx_relabelF
statement:
lemma childIdx_relabelF : ∀ {k : ℕ} (fo : Forest E k) (p : ℕ),
    (Forest.relabelF f fo).childIdx p = fo.childIdx p
  | _, .nil, _ => rfl
  | _, .cons t fo, p => by
    simp only [relabelF_cons, Forest.childIdx, arity_relabel, childIdx_relabelF fo]

name: Operad.Tree.relabelF_append
statement:
lemma relabelF_append : ∀ {k l : ℕ} (g : Forest E l) (fo : Forest E k),
    Forest.relabelF f (g.append fo) = (Forest.relabelF f g).append (Forest.relabelF f fo)
  | _, _, .nil, _ => rfl
  | _, _, .cons t g, fo => congrArg (Forest.cons (relabel f t)) (relabelF_append g fo)

name: Operad.Tree.relabelF_splice
statement:
lemma relabelF_splice : ∀ {k l : ℕ} (fo : Forest E k) (j : ℕ) (g : Forest E l),
    Forest.relabelF f (fo.splice j g) = (Forest.relabelF f fo).splice j (Forest.relabelF f g)
  | _, _, .nil, _, _ => rfl
  | _, _, .cons _ fo, 0, g => relabelF_append f g fo
  | _, _, .cons t fo, j + 1, g => congrArg (Forest.cons (relabel f t)) (relabelF_splice fo j g)

variable {μ : MergeFn E} {μ' : MergeFn E'}

mutual

name: Operad.Tree.relabel_mgraft
statement:
theorem relabel_mgraft
    (hμ : ∀ k l (e : E k) j (e' : E l) m, f m (μ k l e j e' m) = μ' k l (f k e) j (f l e') m) :
    ∀ (s : Tree E) (p : ℕ) (u : Tree E),
    relabel f (s.mgraft μ p u) = (relabel f s).mgraft μ' p (relabel f u)
  | .leaf, _, _ => rfl
  | .node e fo, p, u => by
    rw [relabel_node, mgraft_node, mgraft_node, isDirect_relabelF]
    split_ifs with h
    · cases u with
      | leaf => rfl
      | node e' g =>
        simp only [relabel_node, mergeRoot, hμ, relabelF_splice]
        rw [childIdx_relabelF]
    · rw [relabel_node, Forest.relabelF_mgraftF hμ fo p u]

name: Operad.Forest.relabelF_mgraftF
statement:
theorem _root_.Operad.Forest.relabelF_mgraftF
    (hμ : ∀ k l (e : E k) j (e' : E l) m, f m (μ k l e j e' m) = μ' k l (f k e) j (f l e') m) :
    ∀ {k : ℕ} (fo : Forest E k) (p : ℕ)
    (u : Tree E),
    Forest.relabelF f (fo.mgraftF μ p u) = (Forest.relabelF f fo).mgraftF μ' p (relabel f u)
  | _, .nil, _, _ => rfl
  | _, .cons t fo, p, u => by
    simp only [Forest.mgraftF, relabelF_cons, arity_relabel]
    split_ifs
    · rw [relabelF_cons, relabel_mgraft hμ t p u]
    · rw [relabelF_cons, Forest.relabelF_mgraftF hμ fo]

end

name: Operad.Tree.relabel_contr
statement:
theorem relabel_contr
    (hμ : ∀ k l (e : E k) j (e' : E l) m, f m (μ k l e j e' m) = μ' k l (f k e) j (f l e') m)
    (t : Tree E) (k : ℕ) :
    relabel f (t.contr μ k) = (relabel f t).contr μ' k
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hk : k < t.weight
  · rcases hc : t.cutV k with ⟨y, z, p⟩
    rw [contr_eq μ hk hc, contr_eq μ' (by rwa [weight_relabel]) (cutV_relabel f hk hc),
      relabel_mgraft f hμ]
  · rw [contr, if_neg hk, contr, if_neg (by rwa [weight_relabel])]

name: Operad.Tree.rpar_relabel
statement:
lemma rpar_relabel (hgp : ∀ k e, gp' k (f k e) = gp k e) (t : Tree E) :
    rpar gp' (relabel f t) = rpar gp t
proof:
:= by
  cases t with
  | leaf => rfl
  | node e fo => exact hgp _ e

name: Operad.Tree.lpar_relabel
statement:
theorem lpar_relabel (hgp : ∀ k e, gp' k (f k e) = gp k e) :
    ∀ (t : Tree E) (p : ℕ), lpar gp' (relabel f t) p = lpar gp t p
  | .leaf, _ => rfl
  | .node e fo, p => by
    simp only [relabel_node, lpar_node, isDirect_relabelF, hgp, Forest.lparF_relabelF hgp fo p]

name: Operad.Forest.lparF_relabelF
statement:
theorem _root_.Operad.Forest.lparF_relabelF (hgp : ∀ k e, gp' k (f k e) = gp k e) :
    ∀ {k : ℕ} (fo : Forest E k) (p : ℕ),
    Forest.lparF gp' (Forest.relabelF f fo) p = Forest.lparF gp fo p
  | _, .nil, _ => rfl
  | _, .cons t fo, p => by
    rw [relabelF_cons]
    by_cases h : p < t.arity
    · rw [lparF_cons_of_lt _ _ _ (by rwa [arity_relabel]), lparF_cons_of_lt _ _ _ h,
        lpar_relabel hgp t p]
    · rw [lparF_cons_of_ge _ _ _ (by rw [arity_relabel]; omega), lparF_cons_of_ge _ _ _ (by omega),
        arity_relabel, tpar_relabel f hgp t, Forest.lparF_relabelF hgp fo]

end

mutual

name: Operad.Tree.mpar_relabel
statement:
theorem mpar_relabel (hgp : ∀ k e, gp' k (f k e) = gp k e) :
    ∀ (t : Tree E) (p : ℕ), mpar gp' (relabel f t) p = mpar gp t p
  | .leaf, _ => rfl
  | .node e fo, p => by
    simp only [relabel_node, mpar_node, isDirect_relabelF, Forest.tparF_relabelF f hgp,
      Forest.aparF_relabelF f hgp, Forest.mparF_relabelF hgp fo p]

name: Operad.Forest.mparF_relabelF
statement:
theorem _root_.Operad.Forest.mparF_relabelF (hgp : ∀ k e, gp' k (f k e) = gp k e) :
    ∀ {k : ℕ} (fo : Forest E k) (p : ℕ),
    Forest.mparF gp' (Forest.relabelF f fo) p = Forest.mparF gp fo p
  | _, .nil, _ => rfl
  | _, .cons t fo, p => by
    rw [relabelF_cons]
    by_cases h : p < t.arity
    · rw [mparF_cons_of_lt _ _ _ (by rwa [arity_relabel]), mparF_cons_of_lt _ _ _ h,
        mpar_relabel hgp t p]
    · rw [mparF_cons_of_ge _ _ _ (by rw [arity_relabel]; omega), mparF_cons_of_ge _ _ _ (by omega),
        arity_relabel, Forest.mparF_relabelF hgp fo]

end

name: Operad.Tree.contrSgn_relabel
proof:
:= by
  rcases hc : t.cutV k with ⟨y, z, p⟩
  rw [contrSgn_eq gp hc, contrSgn_eq gp' (cutV_relabel f hk hc), mgSgn, mgSgn,
    lpar_relabel f hgp, mpar_relabel f hgp, rpar_relabel f hgp]

name: Operad.FreeGr.relabelR_contrR
statement:
lemma relabelR_contrR
    (hμ : ∀ k l (e : T k) j (e' : T l) m, f m (μ k l e j e' m) = μ' k l (f k e) j (f l e') m)
    (x : Reg (TreeOfArity T) A) (k : ℕ) :
    relabelR f (contrR μ x k) = contrR μ' (relabelR f x) k
proof:
:=
  reg_ext rfl (by
    rw [treeOf_relabelR, treeOf_contrR, treeOf_contrR, treeOf_relabelR,
      Tree.relabel_contr f hμ])

name: Operad.FreeGrL.op_liftB
statement:
lemma op_liftB {A : Type} [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] (x : Reg (TreeOfArity (GrGen R V)) A) :
    ((mapVal f).liftB.app A x).op = relabelR (genMap f) x
proof:
:= by
  show ((mapVal f).sbm R).ψ.app A x = _
  rw [mapVal_ψ]
  rfl

name: Operad.FreeGrL.sg_liftB
statement:
lemma sg_liftB {A : Type} [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] (x : Reg (TreeOfArity (GrGen R V)) A) :
    ((mapVal f).liftB.app A x).sg = false
proof:
:= by
  refine FreeReg.induction (P := fun A _ _ x => ((mapVal f).liftB.app A x).sg = false)
    ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ x
  · intro A B _ _ _ _ e x hx
    rw [(mapVal f).liftB.app_map]
    exact hx
  · show ((mapVal f).liftB.app Unit SetOperad.one).sg = false
    rw [(mapVal f).liftB.app_one]
    rfl
  · intro A B _ _ _ _ i x y hx hy
    rw [(mapVal f).liftB.app_comp]
    show xor (xor ((mapVal f).liftB.app A x).sg ((mapVal f).liftB.app B y).sg)
      (xor (SgnData.sgn i ((mapVal f).liftB.app A x).dat ((mapVal f).liftB.app B y).dat)
        (SgnData.sgn i ((treeSgn (grGenPar R W)).app A ((mapVal f).liftB.app A x).op)
          ((treeSgn (grGenPar R W)).app B ((mapVal f).liftB.app B y).op))) = false
    rw [hx, hy, SBVal.dat_liftB, SBVal.dat_liftB, op_liftB, op_liftB,
      treeSgn_relabel (genMap f) (gp := grGenPar R V) (gp' := grGenPar R W) (fun _ _ => rfl),
      treeSgn_relabel (genMap f) (gp := grGenPar R V) (gp' := grGenPar R W) (fun _ _ => rfl)]
    simp
  · intro k e
    rw [SBVal.liftB_std]
    rfl

name: Operad.FreeGrL.mapF_bas
statement:
lemma mapF_bas {A : Type} [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] (x : Reg (TreeOfArity (GrGen R V)) A) :
    (mapF f).app A (SgnLin.bas (treeSgn (grGenPar R V)) R x)
      = SgnLin.bas (treeSgn (grGenPar R W)) R (relabelR (genMap f) x)
proof:
:= by
  rw [((mapVal f).sbm R).app_bas]
  show σ R ((mapVal f).liftB.app A x).sg • _ = _
  rw [sg_liftB, σ_false, one_smul, mapVal_ψ]
  rfl

name: Operad.FreeGrL.mapF_barD
statement:
lemma mapF_barD {μ : MergeFn (GrGen R V)} {μ' : MergeFn (GrGen R W)}
    (hμ : ∀ k l (e : GrGen R V k) j (e' : GrGen R V l) m,
      genMap f m (μ k l e j e' m) = μ' k l (genMap f k e) j (genMap f l e') m)
    {A : Type} [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] (x : FreeGr R (grGenPar R V) A) :
    (mapF f).app A (barD μ (grGenPar R V) R A x)
      = barD μ' (grGenPar R W) R A ((mapF f).app A x)
proof:
:= by
  have key : (mapF f).app A ∘ₗ barD μ (grGenPar R V) R A
      = barD μ' (grGenPar R W) R A ∘ₗ (mapF f).app A := Finsupp.lhom_ext fun a c => by
    have h1 : (Finsupp.single a c : FreeGr R (grGenPar R V) A)
        = c • SgnLin.bas (treeSgn (grGenPar R V)) R a :=
      (Finsupp.smul_single_one a c).symm
    show (mapF f).app A (barD μ _ R A (Finsupp.single a c : FreeGr R (grGenPar R V) A))
      = barD μ' _ R A ((mapF f).app A (Finsupp.single a c : FreeGr R (grGenPar R V) A))
    rw [h1, map_smul, map_smul, map_smul, map_smul]
    congr 1
    rw [barD_bas, mapF_bas, barD_bas, map_sum, treeOf_relabelR, Tree.weight_relabel]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun k hk => ?_
    rw [map_smul, mapF_bas, Tree.contrSgn_relabel (genMap f) (gp := grGenPar R V)
      (gp' := grGenPar R W) (fun _ _ => rfl) (Finset.mem_Ico.1 hk).2,
      relabelR_contrR _ hμ]
  exact LinearMap.congr_fun key x

name: Operad.Bar.val_mapGen
statement:
lemma val_mapGen {A : Type} [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] (w : BarGen I A) :
    IdealSp.val I' ((mapGen φ hφ).app A w) = φ.app A (IdealSp.val I w)
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.Bar.genMap_barMerge
statement:
lemma genMap_barMerge {k l : ℕ} (x : BarT I k) (j : ℕ) (y : BarT I l) (m : ℕ) :
    FreeGrL.genMap (mapGen φ hφ) m (barMerge I k l x j y m)
      = barMerge I' k l (FreeGrL.genMap (mapGen φ hφ) k x) j
          (FreeGrL.genMap (mapGen φ hφ) l y) m
proof:
:= by
  refine Subtype.ext (Prod.ext (IdealSp.ext I' ?_) ?_)
  · show φ.app (Fin m) (barMerge I k l x j y m).val
      = (barMerge I' k l (FreeGrL.genMap (mapGen φ hφ) k x) j
          (FreeGrL.genMap (mapGen φ hφ) l y) m).val
    by_cases h : j < k ∧ m + 1 = k + l
    · rw [barMerge_val _ _ h, barMerge_val _ _ h]
      unfold barVal
      rw [map_smul, φ.app_map, φ.app_comp]
      rfl
    · unfold barMerge
      rw [dif_neg h, dif_neg h]
      exact map_zero _
  · show (barMerge I k l x j y m).1.2
      = (barMerge I' k l (FreeGrL.genMap (mapGen φ hφ) k x) j
          (FreeGrL.genMap (mapGen φ hφ) l y) m).1.2
    rw [barMerge_par, barMerge_par]
    rfl

name: Operad.Bar.map_d
statement:
theorem map_d {A : Type} [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] (X : FreeGrL R (BarGen I) A) :
    (FreeGrL.mapSp (mapGen φ hφ)).app A (d I A X)
      = d I' A ((FreeGrL.mapSp (mapGen φ hφ)).app A X)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := (GrOperadIdeal.span R (grLinRel R (BarGen I))).proj_surjective A X
  rw [d_proj, ← FreeGrL.proj_mapF, FreeGrL.mapF_barD _
    (fun k l x j y m => genMap_barMerge φ hφ (k := k) (l := l) x j y m), ← d_proj,
    FreeGrL.proj_mapF]

name: Operad.FreeGrL.mapSp_surjective
statement:
theorem mapSp_surjective (A : Type) [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] :
    Function.Surjective ((mapSp f).app A)
proof:
:= by
  have h := submodule_eq_top (R := R) (V := W) (fun A _ _ => LinearMap.range ((mapSp f).app A))
    (fun A _ _ e => ⟨GrOperad.map (R := R) e (GrOperad.one (R := R) (P := FreeGrL R V)), by
      rw [(mapSp f).app_map, (mapSp f).app_one]⟩)
    (fun n w => by
      obtain ⟨v, rfl⟩ := hf (Fin n) w
      exact ⟨(ι R V).app (Fin n) v, mapSp_ι f v⟩)
    (fun A B _ _ _ _ e x hx => by
      obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := hx
      exact ⟨GrOperad.map (R := R) e y, (mapSp f).app_map e y⟩)
    (fun A B _ _ _ _ i x y hx hy => by
      obtain ⟨x', rfl⟩ := hx
      obtain ⟨y', rfl⟩ := hy
      exact ⟨GrOperad.comp (R := R) i x' y', (mapSp f).app_comp i x' y'⟩) A
  exact fun x => LinearMap.mem_range.1 (h ▸ Submodule.mem_top)

name: Operad.FreeGrL.ι_mem_kerSpan
statement:
lemma ι_mem_kerSpan {A : Type} [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] {v : V A} (hv : f.app A v = 0) :
    (ι R V).app A v ∈ (kerSpan R f).sub A
proof:
:= by
  let e : A ≃ Fin (Fintype.card A) := Fintype.equivFin A
  have h1 : (ι R V).app _ (SymSpecies.map (R := R) e v) ∈ (kerSpan R f).sub _ :=
    GrOperadIdeal.subset_span _ ⟨_, by
      show f.app _ (SymSpecies.map (R := R) e v) = 0
      rw [f.app_map, hv, map_zero], rfl⟩
  have h2 := (kerSpan R f).map_mem e.symm h1
  rwa [(ι R V).app_map, symMap_eq, ← GrOperad.map_trans, Equiv.self_trans_symm,
    GrOperad.map_refl] at h2

name: Operad.FreeGrL.kerLiftLin_apply
statement:
lemma kerLiftLin_apply {A : Type} [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] (v : V A) :
    kerLiftLin f hf A (f.app A v) = (kerSpan R f).proj A ((ι R V).app A v)
proof:
:= by
  have h : ((f.app A).quotKerEquivOfSurjective (hf A)).symm (f.app A v)
      = Submodule.Quotient.mk v :=
    ((f.app A).quotKerEquivOfSurjective (hf A)).symm_apply_eq.2
      (LinearMap.quotKerEquivOfSurjective_apply_mk _ _ v).symm
  unfold kerLiftLin
  rw [LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearEquiv.coe_coe, h, Submodule.liftQ_apply]
  rfl

name: Operad.FreeGrL.mem_kerSpan_iff
statement:
theorem mem_kerSpan_iff {A : Type} [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] (x : FreeGrL R V A) :
    x ∈ (kerSpan R f).sub A ↔ (mapSp f).app A x = 0
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hx
    have hle : kerSpan R f ≤ (mapSp f).ker := GrOperadIdeal.span_le.2 fun n y hy => by
      obtain ⟨v, hv, rfl⟩ := hy
      show (mapSp f).app _ ((ι R V).app _ v) = 0
      rw [mapSp_ι, LinearMap.mem_ker.1 hv, map_zero]
    exact hle A hx
  · intro hx
    have hcomp : (homEquiv.symm (kerLiftGen f hf)).comp (mapSp f) = (kerSpan R f).projHom :=
      hom_ext fun B _ _ v => by
        rw [GrOperadHom.comp_app, mapSp_ι, homEquiv_symm_ι]
        exact kerLiftLin_apply f hf v
    have h := congrArg (fun φ : GrOperadHom R (FreeGrL R V) (kerSpan R f).Quot => φ.app A x) hcomp
    simp only [GrOperadHom.comp_app, hx, map_zero, GrOperadIdeal.projHom_app] at h
    exact ((kerSpan R f).proj_eq_zero_iff x).1 h.symm

name: Operad.FreeGrL.span_le_noUnit
statement: lemma span_le_noUnit : 𝒥 ≤ noUnitIdeal (gp := grGenPar R V) (R := R)
proof:
:=
  (GrOperadIdeal.span_le (I := noUnitIdeal (gp := grGenPar R V) (R := R))).2
    fun _ _ hr => unitCoeff_of_linRel hr

name: Operad.FreeGrL.unitCoeffL_proj
statement:
lemma unitCoeffL_proj (x : FreeGr R (grGenPar R V) A) :
    unitCoeffL R V A ((𝒥).proj A x) = unitCoeff (grGenPar R V) R A x
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.FreeGrL.unitL_eq
statement:
lemma unitL_eq (e : Unit ≃ A) :
    unitL R V A = GrOperad.map (R := R) e (GrOperad.one (R := R) (P := FreeGrL R V))
proof:
:= by
  haveI : Subsingleton (Unit ≃ A) := ⟨fun e₁ e₂ => Equiv.ext fun u => by
    have hA : ∀ a a' : A, a = a' := fun a a' => by
      rw [← e.apply_symm_apply a, ← e.apply_symm_apply a']
    exact hA _ _⟩
  rw [unitL, Fintype.sum_subsingleton _ e]

name: Operad.FreeGrL.map_unitL
statement:
lemma map_unitL (σ' : A ≃ B) :
    GrOperad.map (R := R) σ' (unitL R V A) = unitL R V B
proof:
:= by
  rw [unitL, unitL, map_sum]
  refine Fintype.sum_equiv (Equiv.mk (fun e => e.trans σ') (fun e => e.trans σ'.symm)
    (fun e => by ext; simp) (fun e => by ext; simp)) _ _ fun e => ?_
  rw [← GrOperad.map_trans]
  rfl

name: Operad.FreeGrL.par_unitL
statement:
lemma par_unitL (b : Bool) :
    GrOperad.par (R := R) b (unitL R V A) = if b then 0 else unitL R V A
proof:
:= by
  rw [unitL, map_sum]
  cases b
  · refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun e _ => ?_
    rw [← GrOperad.map_par, GrOperad.par_one]
  · rw [if_pos rfl]
    refine Finset.sum_eq_zero fun e _ => ?_
    rw [← GrOperad.map_par, ← GrOperad.par_one (R := R) (P := FreeGrL R V), GrOperad.par_par,
      if_neg (by decide), map_zero]

name: Operad.FreeGrL.unitCoeffL_one
statement: lemma unitCoeffL_one : unitCoeffL R V Unit (GrOperad.one (R := R) (P := FreeGrL R V)) = 1
proof:
:= by
  show unitCoeff (grGenPar R V) R Unit (SgnLin.bas (treeSgn (grGenPar R V)) R SetOperad.one) = 1
  rw [unitCoeff_bas, if_pos (by rfl)]

name: Operad.FreeGrL.unitCoeffL_map
statement:
lemma unitCoeffL_map (σ' : A ≃ B) (x : FreeGrL R V A) :
    unitCoeffL R V B (GrOperad.map (R := R) σ' x) = unitCoeffL R V A x
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := (𝒥).proj_surjective A x
  exact unitCoeff_map σ' x

name: Operad.FreeGrL.unitCoeffL_par
statement:
lemma unitCoeffL_par (b : Bool) (x : FreeGrL R V A) :
    unitCoeffL R V A (GrOperad.par (R := R) b x) = if b then 0 else unitCoeffL R V A x
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := (𝒥).proj_surjective A x
  exact unitCoeff_par b x

name: Operad.FreeGrL.secC_apply
statement:
lemma secC_apply (x : FreeGrL R V A) :
    secC R V A x = x - unitCoeffL R V A x • unitL R V A
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.FreeGrL.secC_map
statement:
lemma secC_map (σ' : A ≃ B) (x : FreeGrL R V A) :
    secC R V B (GrOperad.map (R := R) σ' x) = GrOperad.map (R := R) σ' (secC R V A x)
proof:
:= by
  rw [secC_apply, secC_apply, map_sub, map_smul, unitCoeffL_map, map_unitL]

name: Operad.FreeGrL.secC_par
statement:
lemma secC_par (b : Bool) (x : FreeGrL R V A) :
    secC R V A (GrOperad.par (R := R) b x) = GrOperad.par (R := R) b (secC R V A x)
proof:
:= by
  rw [secC_apply, secC_apply, map_sub, map_smul, unitCoeffL_par, par_unitL]
  cases b <;> simp

name: Operad.FreeGrL.secC_unit
statement:
lemma secC_unit (e : Unit ≃ A) :
    secC R V A (GrOperad.map (R := R) e (GrOperad.one (R := R) (P := FreeGrL R V))) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [secC_apply, unitCoeffL_map, unitCoeffL_one, one_smul, ← unitL_eq, sub_self]

name: Operad.FreeGrL.secC_of_unitCoeff
statement: lemma secC_of_unitCoeff {x : FreeGrL R V A} (hx : unitCoeffL R V A x = 0) : secC R V A x = x
proof:
:= by
  rw [secC_apply, hx, zero_smul, sub_zero]

name: Operad.FreeGrL.unitCoeffL_secC
statement: lemma unitCoeffL_secC (x : FreeGrL R V A) : unitCoeffL R V A (secC R V A x) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [secC_apply, map_sub, map_smul]
  by_cases h : Nonempty (Unit ≃ A)
  · obtain ⟨e⟩ := h
    rw [unitL_eq e, unitCoeffL_map, unitCoeffL_one, smul_eq_mul, mul_one, sub_self]
  · have h0 : unitL R V A = 0 := by
      rw [unitL]
      exact Finset.sum_eq_zero fun e _ => absurd ⟨e⟩ h
    rw [h0, map_zero, smul_zero, sub_zero]
    
    obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := (𝒥).proj_surjective A x
    show unitCoeff (grGenPar R V) R A x = 0
    induction x using induction_bas with
    | zero => exact map_zero _
    | add x y hx hy => rw [map_add, hx, hy, add_zero]
    | bas c t =>
      rw [map_smul, unitCoeff_bas]
      split_ifs with ht
      · obtain ⟨e, -⟩ := eq_map_one_of_isLeaf ht
        exact absurd ⟨e⟩ h
      · exact smul_zero c

name: Operad.MergeSp.fn_odd
statement: lemma fn_odd : MergeFn.Odd (grGenPar R W) M.fn
proof:
:= by
  intro k l x j y m
  unfold fn
  split_ifs <;> rfl

name: Operad.MergeSp.fn_val
statement:
lemma fn_val {k l j m : ℕ} (x : GrGen R W k) (y : GrGen R W l) (h : j < k ∧ m + 1 = k + l) :
    (M.fn k l x j y m).1.1 = M.val x.1.2 x.1.1 ⟨j, h.1⟩ y.1.1 m h.2
proof:
:= by
  unfold fn
  rw [dif_pos h]

name: Operad.MergeSp.fn_par
statement:
lemma fn_par {k l j m : ℕ} (x : GrGen R W k) (y : GrGen R W l) :
    (M.fn k l x j y m).1.2 = !(xor x.1.2 y.1.2)
proof:
:= by
  unfold fn
  split_ifs <;> rfl

name: Operad.MergeSp.mcomp_gen
statement:
lemma mcomp_gen {k l : ℕ} (c : GrGen R W k) (i : Fin k) (g : GrGen R W l) (m : ℕ)
    (h : m + 1 = k + l) :
    mcomp M.fn (grGenPar R W) R i (gen (R := R) (gp := grGenPar R W) c) (gen g)
      = GrOperad.map (R := R) (posEquivF i l m h).symm (gen (M.fn k l c i g m))
proof:
:=
  mcomp_gen_gen M.fn c i g m h

name: Operad.MergeSp.gen_left
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ : ∃ m, m + 1 = k + n := ⟨k + n - 1, by have := i.2; omega⟩
  have hi : (i : ℕ) < k ∧ m + 1 = k + n := ⟨i.2, hm⟩
  rcases hr with (⟨b, v, w, hv, hw, rfl⟩ | ⟨b, a, v, hv, rfl⟩) | ⟨b, τ, v, hv, rfl⟩
  · simp only [map_sub, lgen, M.mcomp_gen c i _ m hm]
    rw [← map_sub, ← map_sub]
    refine (𝒥).map_mem _ (gen_sub_mem_add _ _ _ (by simp only [fn_par])
      (by simp only [fn_par]) ?_)
    rw [M.fn_val _ _ hi, M.fn_val _ _ hi, M.fn_val _ _ hi]
    exact M.add_right _ _ _ _ _ _ _
  · simp only [map_sub, map_smul, lgen, M.mcomp_gen c i _ m hm]
    rw [← map_smul, ← map_sub]
    refine (𝒥).map_mem _ (gen_sub_mem_smul _ _ a (by simp only [fn_par]) ?_)
    rw [M.fn_val _ _ hi, M.fn_val _ _ hi]
    exact M.smul_right _ _ _ _ _ _ _
  · rw [map_sub, mcomp_map_right]
    simp only [lgen, M.mcomp_gen c i _ m hm]
    have hρ : (posEquivF i n m hm).symm.trans (compEquiv (Equiv.refl (Fin k)) τ i)
        = ((posEquivF i n m hm).symm.trans ((compEquiv (Equiv.refl (Fin k)) τ i).trans
            (posEquivF i n m hm))).trans (posEquivF i n m hm).symm := by
      ext t
      exact (Equiv.symm_apply_apply (posEquivF i n m hm)
        (compEquiv (Equiv.refl (Fin k)) τ i ((posEquivF i n m hm).symm t))).symm
    have key : ∀ X : FreeGr R (grGenPar R W) (Fin m),
        GrOperad.map (R := R) (compEquiv (Equiv.refl (Fin k)) τ i)
            (GrOperad.map (R := R) (posEquivF i n m hm).symm X)
          = GrOperad.map (R := R) (posEquivF i n m hm).symm (GrOperad.map (R := R)
              ((posEquivF i n m hm).symm.trans ((compEquiv (Equiv.refl (Fin k)) τ i).trans
                (posEquivF i n m hm))) X) := by
      intro X
      rw [← GrOperad.map_trans, ← GrOperad.map_trans, hρ]
      rfl
    rw [key, ← map_sub]
    refine (𝒥).map_mem _ (map_gen_sub_mem _ _ _ (by simp only [fn_par]) ?_)
    rw [M.fn_val _ _ hi, M.fn_val _ _ hi]
    exact M.map_right _ _ _ _ _ _ _

name: Operad.MergeSp.gen_right
statement:
lemma gen_right {n : ℕ} {r : FreeGr R (grGenPar R W) (Fin n)} (hr : r ∈ grLinRel R W n)
    {k : ℕ} (c : GrGen R W k) (i : Fin n) :
    mcomp M.fn (grGenPar R W) R i r (gen (R := R) (gp := grGenPar R W) c) ∈ (𝒥).sub _
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ : ∃ m, m + 1 = n + k := ⟨n + k - 1, by have := i.2; omega⟩
  rcases hr with (⟨b, v, w, hv, hw, rfl⟩ | ⟨b, a, v, hv, rfl⟩) | ⟨b, τ, v, hv, rfl⟩
  · have hi : (i : ℕ) < n ∧ m + 1 = n + k := ⟨i.2, hm⟩
    simp only [map_sub, LinearMap.sub_apply, lgen, M.mcomp_gen _ i c m hm]
    rw [← map_sub, ← map_sub]
