    refine (𝒥).map_mem _ (gen_sub_mem_add _ _ _ (by simp only [fn_par])
      (by simp only [fn_par]) ?_)
    rw [M.fn_val _ _ hi, M.fn_val _ _ hi, M.fn_val _ _ hi]
    exact M.add_left _ _ _ _ _ _ _
  · have hi : (i : ℕ) < n ∧ m + 1 = n + k := ⟨i.2, hm⟩
    simp only [map_sub, map_smul, LinearMap.sub_apply, LinearMap.smul_apply, lgen,
      M.mcomp_gen _ i c m hm]
    rw [← map_smul, ← map_sub]
    refine (𝒥).map_mem _ (gen_sub_mem_smul _ _ a (by simp only [fn_par]) ?_)
    rw [M.fn_val _ _ hi, M.fn_val _ _ hi]
    exact M.smul_left _ _ _ _ _ _ _
  · obtain ⟨i', rfl⟩ := τ.surjective i
    have hi : ((τ i' : Fin n) : ℕ) < n ∧ m + 1 = n + k := ⟨(τ i').2, hm⟩
    have hi' : (i' : ℕ) < n ∧ m + 1 = n + k := ⟨i'.2, hm⟩
    rw [map_sub, LinearMap.sub_apply, mcomp_map_left]
    simp only [lgen, M.mcomp_gen _ _ c m hm]
    have key : ∀ X : FreeGr R (grGenPar R W) (Fin m),
        GrOperad.map (R := R) (compEquiv τ (Equiv.refl (Fin k)) i')
            (GrOperad.map (R := R) (posEquivF i' k m hm).symm X)
          = GrOperad.map (R := R) (posEquivF (τ i') k m hm).symm (GrOperad.map (R := R)
              ((posEquivF i' k m hm).symm.trans ((compEquiv τ (Equiv.refl (Fin k)) i').trans
                (posEquivF (τ i') k m hm))) X) := by
      intro X
      rw [← GrOperad.map_trans, ← GrOperad.map_trans]
      congr 2
      ext t
      simp
    rw [key, ← map_sub]
    refine (𝒥).map_mem _ (map_gen_sub_mem _ _ _ (by simp only [fn_par]) ?_)
    rw [M.fn_val _ _ hi, M.fn_val _ _ hi']
    exact M.map_left _ _ _ _ _ _ _

name: Operad.MergeSp.relHyp
statement:
theorem relHyp : RelHyp M.fn (grGenPar R W) R (grLinRel R W) where
  barD_eq _ _ hr
proof:
:= barD_of_linRel _ hr
  unitCoeff_eq _ _ hr := unitCoeff_of_linRel hr
  homog _ _ hr := par_of_linRel hr
  gen_left _ _ hr _ c i := M.gen_left hr c i
  gen_right _ _ hr _ c i := M.gen_right hr c i

name: Operad.MergeSp.d_proj
statement:
lemma d_proj (x : FreeGr R (grGenPar R W) A) :
    M.d A ((𝒥).proj A x) = (𝒥).proj A (barD M.fn (grGenPar R W) R A x)
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.MergeSp.mcRight_proj
statement:
lemma mcRight_proj (i : A) (x : FreeGr R (grGenPar R W) A) (y : FreeGr R (grGenPar R W) B) :
    M.mcRight i x ((𝒥).proj B y) = (𝒥).proj _ (mcomp M.fn (grGenPar R W) R i x y)
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.MergeSp.mc_proj
statement:
lemma mc_proj (i : A) (x : FreeGr R (grGenPar R W) A) (y : FreeGr R (grGenPar R W) B) :
    M.mc i ((𝒥).proj A x) ((𝒥).proj B y) = (𝒥).proj _ (mcomp M.fn (grGenPar R W) R i x y)
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: Operad.MergeSp.proj_comp'
statement:
lemma proj_comp' (i : A) (x : FreeGr R (grGenPar R W) A) (y : FreeGr R (grGenPar R W) B) :
    (𝒥).proj _ (GrOperad.comp (R := R) i x y)
      = GrOperad.comp (R := R) i ((𝒥).proj A x) ((𝒥).proj B y)
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.MergeSp.proj_map''
statement:
lemma proj_map'' (e : A ≃ B) (x : FreeGr R (grGenPar R W) A) :
    (𝒥).proj B (GrOperad.map (R := R) e x) = GrOperad.map (R := R) e ((𝒥).proj A x)
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.MergeSp.proj_par'
statement:
lemma proj_par' (b : Bool) (x : FreeGr R (grGenPar R W) A) :
    (𝒥).proj A (GrOperad.par (R := R) b x) = GrOperad.par (R := R) b ((𝒥).proj A x)
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.MergeSp.proj_tw'
statement:
lemma proj_tw' (e : Bool) (x : FreeGr R (grGenPar R W) A) :
    (𝒥).proj A (GrSpecies.tw (R := R) (V := FreeGr R (grGenPar R W)) e x)
      = GrOperad.tw (R := R) e ((𝒥).proj A x)
proof:
:= by
  rw [GrSpecies.tw_apply, GrOperad.tw_apply, map_add, map_smul]
  rfl

name: Operad.MergeSp.d_comp
statement:
theorem d_comp (i : A) (X : FreeGrL R W A) (Y : FreeGrL R W B) :
    M.d _ (GrOperad.comp (R := R) i X Y)
      = GrOperad.comp (R := R) i (M.d A X) Y
        + GrOperad.comp (R := R) i (GrOperad.tw (R := R) true X) (M.d B Y) + M.mc i X Y
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := (𝒥).proj_surjective A X
  obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := (𝒥).proj_surjective B Y
  rw [← proj_comp', d_proj, barD_comp M.fn_odd, map_add, map_add, ← proj_tw']
  rfl

name: Operad.MergeSp.d_gen
statement:
theorem d_gen {k : ℕ} (g : GrGen R W k) :
    M.d (Fin k) ((𝒥).proj _ (gen (R := R) (gp := grGenPar R W) g)) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [d_proj, barD_gen, map_zero]

name: Operad.MergeSp.map_d
statement:
theorem map_d (e : A ≃ B) (X : FreeGrL R W A) :
    GrOperad.map (R := R) e (M.d A X) = M.d B (GrOperad.map (R := R) e X)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := (𝒥).proj_surjective A X
  rw [d_proj, ← proj_map'', map_barD, ← proj_map'', d_proj]

name: Operad.MergeSp.par_d
statement:
theorem par_d (b : Bool) (X : FreeGrL R W A) :
    GrOperad.par (R := R) b (M.d A X) = M.d A (GrOperad.par (R := R) (!b) X)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := (𝒥).proj_surjective A X
  rw [d_proj, ← proj_par', par_barD M.fn_odd, ← proj_par', d_proj]

name: Operad.MergeSp.mc_map
statement:
theorem mc_map {A' B' : Type} [Fintype A'] [DecidableEq A'] [Fintype B'] [DecidableEq B']
    (σ' : A ≃ A') (τ : B ≃ B') (i : A) (X : FreeGrL R W A) (Y : FreeGrL R W B) :
    M.mc (σ' i) (GrOperad.map (R := R) σ' X) (GrOperad.map (R := R) τ Y)
      = GrOperad.map (R := R) (compEquiv σ' τ i) (M.mc i X Y)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := (𝒥).proj_surjective A X
  obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := (𝒥).proj_surjective B Y
  rw [← proj_map'', ← proj_map'', mc_proj, mc_proj, mcomp_map, proj_map'']

name: Operad.MergeSp.mc_map_left
statement:
theorem mc_map_left {A' : Type} [Fintype A'] [DecidableEq A'] (e : A ≃ A') (i : A)
    (X : FreeGrL R W A) (Y : FreeGrL R W B) :
    M.mc (e i) (GrOperad.map (R := R) e X) Y
      = GrOperad.map (R := R) (compEquiv e (Equiv.refl B) i) (M.mc i X Y)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := (𝒥).proj_surjective A X
  obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := (𝒥).proj_surjective B Y
  rw [← proj_map'', mc_proj, mc_proj, mcomp_map_left, proj_map'']

name: Operad.MergeSp.mc_map_right
statement:
theorem mc_map_right {B' : Type} [Fintype B'] [DecidableEq B'] (e : B ≃ B') (i : A)
    (X : FreeGrL R W A) (Y : FreeGrL R W B) :
    M.mc i X (GrOperad.map (R := R) e Y)
      = GrOperad.map (R := R) (compEquiv (Equiv.refl A) e i) (M.mc i X Y)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := (𝒥).proj_surjective A X
  obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := (𝒥).proj_surjective B Y
  rw [← proj_map'', mc_proj, mc_proj, mcomp_map_right]
  rfl

name: Operad.MergeSp.mc_comp_par
statement:
theorem mc_comp_par {i k : A} (hik : i ≠ k) (X : FreeGrL R W A) {q r : Bool}
    {Y : FreeGrL R W B} {Z : FreeGrL R W D} (hY : GrOperad.par (R := R) q Y = Y)
    (hZ : GrOperad.par (R := R) r Z = Z) :
    GrOperad.map (R := R) (parEquiv hik B D)
        (M.mc (Sum.inl ⟨k, Ne.symm hik⟩) (GrOperad.comp (R := R) i X Y) Z)
      = σ R (q && r) • GrOperad.comp (R := R) (Sum.inl ⟨i, hik⟩) (M.mc k X Z) Y
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := (𝒥).proj_surjective A X
  obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := (𝒥).proj_surjective B Y
  obtain ⟨z, rfl⟩ := (𝒥).proj_surjective D Z
  rw [← hY, ← hZ, ← proj_par', ← proj_par', ← proj_comp', mc_proj, ← proj_map'',
    mcomp_comp_par M.fn M.fn_odd hik x (GrOperad.par_par_self (R := R) q y)
      (GrOperad.par_par_self (R := R) r z), map_smul]
  rfl

name: Operad.MergeSp.mc_comp_inner
statement:
theorem mc_comp_inner (i : A) (j : B) (X : FreeGrL R W A) {Y : FreeGrL R W B}
    (hY : FreeGrL.unitCoeffL R W B Y = 0) (Z : FreeGrL R W D) :
    GrOperad.map (R := R) (seqEquiv i j D)
        (M.mc (Sum.inr j) (GrOperad.comp (R := R) i X Y) Z)
      = GrOperad.comp (R := R) i (GrOperad.tw (R := R) true X) (M.mc j Y Z)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := (𝒥).proj_surjective A X
  obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := (𝒥).proj_surjective B Y
  obtain ⟨z, rfl⟩ := (𝒥).proj_surjective D Z
  rw [← proj_comp', mc_proj, ← proj_map'', mcomp_comp_inner M.fn M.fn_odd i j x y z hY,
    ← proj_tw']
  rfl

name: Operad.MergeSp.comp_mc_outer
statement:
theorem comp_mc_outer (i : A) (j : B) (X : FreeGrL R W A) {Y : FreeGrL R W B}
    (hY : FreeGrL.unitCoeffL R W B Y = 0) (Z : FreeGrL R W D) :
    GrOperad.map (R := R) (seqEquiv i j D)
        (GrOperad.comp (R := R) (Sum.inr j) (M.mc i X Y) Z)
      = M.mc i X (GrOperad.comp (R := R) j Y Z)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := (𝒥).proj_surjective A X
  obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := (𝒥).proj_surjective B Y
  obtain ⟨z, rfl⟩ := (𝒥).proj_surjective D Z
  rw [mc_proj, ← proj_comp', ← proj_map'', comp_mcomp_outer M.fn i j x y z hY, ← proj_comp',
    mc_proj]

name: Operad.MergeSp.mc_gen
statement:
theorem mc_gen {k l : ℕ} (c : GrGen R W k) (i : Fin k) (g : GrGen R W l) (m : ℕ)
    (h : m + 1 = k + l) :
    M.mc i ((𝒥).proj _ (gen (R := R) (gp := grGenPar R W) c))
        ((𝒥).proj _ (gen (R := R) (gp := grGenPar R W) g))
      = GrOperad.map (R := R) (posEquivF i l m h).symm
          ((𝒥).proj _ (gen (R := R) (gp := grGenPar R W) (M.fn k l c i g m)))
proof:
:= by
  rw [mc_proj, M.mcomp_gen c i g m h, proj_map'']

name: Operad.MergeSp.mc_unit_left
statement:
theorem mc_unit_left (e : Unit ≃ A) (i : A) (Y : FreeGrL R W B) :
    M.mc i (GrOperad.map (R := R) e (GrOperad.one (R := R) (P := FreeGrL R W))) Y = 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := (𝒥).proj_surjective B Y
  show (𝒥).proj _ (mcomp M.fn (grGenPar R W) R i (GrOperad.map (R := R) e
    (SgnLin.bas (treeSgn (grGenPar R W)) R SetOperad.one)) y) = 0
  rw [SgnLin.map_bas, mcomp_leaf_left M.fn (by rfl) i y, map_zero]

name: Operad.MergeSp.mc_unit_right
statement:
theorem mc_unit_right (e : Unit ≃ B) (i : A) (X : FreeGrL R W A) :
    M.mc i X (GrOperad.map (R := R) e (GrOperad.one (R := R) (P := FreeGrL R W))) = 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := (𝒥).proj_surjective A X
  show (𝒥).proj _ (mcomp M.fn (grGenPar R W) R i x (GrOperad.map (R := R) e
    (SgnLin.bas (treeSgn (grGenPar R W)) R SetOperad.one))) = 0
  rw [SgnLin.map_bas, mcomp_leaf_right M.fn (by rfl) i x, map_zero]

name: Operad.isUnit_natCast_of_ne_zero
statement: lemma isUnit_natCast_of_ne_zero [Algebra ℚ R] {n : ℕ} (hn : n ≠ 0) : IsUnit (n : R)
proof:
:= by
  have h := (isUnit_iff_ne_zero.2 (Nat.cast_ne_zero.2 hn : (n : ℚ) ≠ 0)).map (algebraMap ℚ R)
  rwa [map_natCast] at h

name: Operad.isUnit_natCast_sub
statement: lemma isUnit_natCast_sub [Algebra ℚ R] {i j : ℕ} (h : i ≠ j) : IsUnit ((i : R) - j)
proof:
:= by
  have h' := (isUnit_iff_ne_zero.2 (sub_ne_zero.2 (Nat.cast_injective.ne h) :
    (i : ℚ) - j ≠ 0)).map (algebraMap ℚ R)
  rwa [map_sub, map_natCast, map_natCast] at h'

name: Operad.iSupIndep_eigenspace_nat
statement:
theorem iSupIndep_eigenspace_nat [Algebra ℚ R] (E : M →ₗ[R] M) :
    iSupIndep fun j : ℕ => Module.End.eigenspace E (j : R)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [iSupIndep_iff_finsetSum_eq_zero_imp_eq_zero]
  intro s
  induction s using Finset.induction_on with
  | empty => intro v _ _ i hi; exact absurd hi (Finset.notMem_empty i)
  | insert a s ha ih =>
    intro v hv hsum i hi
    have hE : ∀ j ∈ insert a s, E (v j) = (j : R) • v j := fun j hj =>
      Module.End.mem_eigenspace_iff.1 (hv j hj)
    have h0 : ∑ j ∈ insert a s, ((j : R) - a) • v j = 0 := by
      have e : ∀ j ∈ insert a s, ((j : R) - a) • v j = E (v j) - (a : R) • v j :=
        fun j hj => by rw [hE j hj, sub_smul]
      rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl e, Finset.sum_sub_distrib, ← map_sum, ← Finset.smul_sum, hsum,
        map_zero, smul_zero, sub_zero]
    rw [Finset.sum_insert ha, sub_self, zero_smul, zero_add] at h0
    have h1 := ih (fun j => ((j : R) - a) • v j)
      (fun j hj => (Module.End.eigenspace E (j : R)).smul_mem _
        (hv j (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem hj))) h0
    have h2 : ∀ j ∈ s, v j = 0 := fun j hj =>
      (isUnit_natCast_sub (fun h : j = a => ha (h ▸ hj))).smul_left_cancel.1
        ((h1 j hj).trans (smul_zero _).symm)
    rcases Finset.mem_insert.1 hi with rfl | hi
    · rw [Finset.sum_insert ha, Finset.sum_eq_zero h2, add_zero] at hsum
      exact hsum
    · exact h2 i hi

name: Operad.pr_add
statement:
private lemma pr_add (j : ℕ) (y z : M) :
    (decompose W (y + z) j : M) = (decompose W y j : M) + (decompose W z j : M)
proof:
:= by
  rw [decompose_add, DirectSum.add_apply, Submodule.coe_add]

name: Operad.pr_sub
statement:
private lemma pr_sub (j : ℕ) (y z : M) :
    (decompose W (y - z) j : M) = (decompose W y j : M) - (decompose W z j : M)
proof:
:= by
  rw [decompose_sub, DirectSum.sub_apply, Submodule.coe_sub]

name: Operad.pr_smul
statement:
private lemma pr_smul (j : ℕ) (c : R) (y : M) :
    (decompose W (c • y) j : M) = c • (decompose W y j : M)
proof:
:= by
  rw [decompose_smul, DirectSum.smul_apply, Submodule.coe_smul]

name: Operad.pr_zero
statement: private lemma pr_zero (j : ℕ) : (decompose W (0 : M) j : M) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [decompose_zero, DirectSum.zero_apply, ZeroMemClass.coe_zero]

name: Operad.pr_of_mem
statement:
private lemma pr_of_mem {i : ℕ} {y : M} (hy : y ∈ W i) (j : ℕ) :
    (decompose W y j : M) = if i = j then y else 0
proof:
:= by
  split_ifs with h
  · subst h
    exact decompose_of_mem_same W hy
  · exact decompose_of_mem_ne W hy h

name: Operad.pr_comm
statement:
private lemma pr_comm (φ : M →ₗ[R] M) (hφ : ∀ i, ∀ y ∈ W i, φ y ∈ W i) (j : ℕ) (y : M) :
    (decompose W (φ y) j : M) = φ (decompose W y j)
proof:
:= by
  refine Decomposition.inductionOn W (motive := fun y =>
    (decompose W (φ y) j : M) = φ (decompose W y j)) ?_ ?_ ?_ y
  · beta_reduce
    rw [map_zero, pr_zero, map_zero]
  · intro i m
    beta_reduce
    rw [pr_of_mem W (hφ i _ m.2), pr_of_mem W m.2]
    split_ifs
    · rfl
    · rw [map_zero]
  · intro m m' hm hm'
    beta_reduce at hm hm' ⊢
    rw [map_add, pr_add, pr_add, hm, hm', map_add]

name: Operad.pr_shift
proof:
:= by
  refine Decomposition.inductionOn W (motive := fun y =>
    (decompose W (φ y) j : M) = φ (decompose W y (j + 1))) ?_ ?_ ?_ y
  · beta_reduce
    rw [map_zero, pr_zero, pr_zero, map_zero]
  · intro i m
    beta_reduce
    cases i with
    | zero =>
      rw [hφ0 _ m.2, pr_zero, pr_of_mem W m.2, if_neg (Nat.succ_ne_zero j).symm, map_zero]
    | succ i =>
      rw [pr_of_mem W (hφ i _ m.2), pr_of_mem W m.2]
      by_cases h : i = j
      · rw [if_pos h, if_pos (congrArg (· + 1) h)]
      · rw [if_neg h, if_neg (fun h' => h (Nat.succ.inj h')), map_zero]
  · intro m m' hm hm'
    beta_reduce at hm hm' ⊢
    rw [map_add, pr_add, pr_add, hm, hm', map_add]

name: Operad.exists_top
statement: private lemma exists_top (y : M) : ∃ N : ℕ, ∀ j, N < j → (decompose W y j : M) = 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  refine ⟨(decompose W y).support.sup id, fun j hj => ?_⟩
  have h : j ∉ (decompose W y).support := fun h =>
    absurd (Finset.le_sup (f := id) h) (not_le.2 hj)
  rw [DFinsupp.notMem_support_iff.1 h, ZeroMemClass.coe_zero]

name: Operad.eq_low
statement:
private lemma eq_low (y : M) (h : ∀ j, 2 ≤ j → (decompose W y j : M) = 0) :
    y = (decompose W y 0 : M) + (decompose W y 1 : M)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  conv_lhs => rw [← sum_support_decompose W y]
  rw [← Finset.sum_pair (f := fun i => (decompose W y i : M)) zero_ne_one]
  refine Finset.sum_subset (fun i hi => ?_) (fun i _ hi => ?_)
  · by_contra hni
    have h2 : 2 ≤ i := by
      rw [Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_singleton] at hni
      omega
    exact DFinsupp.mem_support_iff.1 hi ((Submodule.coe_eq_zero).1 (h i h2))
  · rw [DFinsupp.notMem_support_iff.1 hi, ZeroMemClass.coe_zero]

name: Operad.exists_eq_D_of_weights
statement:
theorem exists_eq_D_of_weights [Algebra ℚ R] (E d h δ S : M →ₗ[R] M) (c : M →ₗ[R] Q)
    (hE : ∀ j, ∀ y ∈ W j, E y = (j : R) • y) (hd : ∀ j, ∀ y ∈ W j, d y ∈ W j)
    (hδ : ∀ j, ∀ y ∈ W (j + 1), δ y ∈ W j) (hδ0 : ∀ y ∈ W 0, δ y = 0)
    (hDD : ∀ y, d (d y - δ y) - δ (d y - δ y) = 0)
    (hK : ∀ y, d (h y) + h (d y) = E y - S y) (hS : ∀ y, S y - y ∈ W 0)
    (hc : ∀ y, c (d y - δ y) = 0)
    (hbase : ∀ y₀ ∈ W 0, ∀ y₁ ∈ W 1, c (y₀ + y₁) = 0 → y₀ + y₁ = 0)
    (y : M) (hy : d y - δ y = 0) (hcy : c y = 0) : ∃ z, d z - δ z = y
proof:
:= by
  suffices key : ∀ N : ℕ, ∀ y : M, (∀ j, N + 1 < j → (decompose W y j : M) = 0) →
      d y - δ y = 0 → c y = 0 → ∃ z, d z - δ z = y by
    obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := exists_top W y
    exact key N y (fun j hj => hN j (by omega)) hy hcy
  intro N
  induction N with
  | zero =>
    intro y hN _ hcy
    have hy := eq_low W y fun j hj => hN j (by omega)
    have hc' : c ((decompose W y 0 : M) + (decompose W y 1 : M)) = 0 := by
      rw [← hy]
      exact hcy
    refine ⟨0, ?_⟩
    rw [map_zero, map_zero, sub_zero, hy]
    exact (hbase _ (Submodule.coe_mem _) _ (Submodule.coe_mem _) hc').symm
  | succ N ih =>
    intro y hN hy hcy
    have hYn : (decompose W y (N + 2) : M) ∈ W (N + 2) := Submodule.coe_mem _
    
    have h1 : d (decompose W y (N + 2) : M) = 0 := by
      have e := congrArg (fun z => (decompose W z (N + 2) : M)) hy
      simp only at e
      rw [pr_sub, pr_comm W d hd, pr_shift W δ hδ hδ0, hN (N + 2 + 1) (by omega), map_zero,
        sub_zero, pr_zero] at e
      exact e
    
    have h2 : d (decompose W (h (decompose W y (N + 2))) (N + 2) : M)
        = ((N + 1 : ℕ) : R) • (decompose W y (N + 2) : M) := by
      rw [← pr_comm W d hd]
      have e : d (h (decompose W y (N + 2))) = E (decompose W y (N + 2))
          - S (decompose W y (N + 2)) := by
        have := hK (decompose W y (N + 2))
        rw [h1, map_zero, add_zero] at this
        exact this
      have e2 : (decompose W (S (decompose W y (N + 2))) (N + 2) : M)
          = (decompose W y (N + 2) : M) := by
        have := pr_add W (N + 2) (decompose W y (N + 2) : M)
          (S (decompose W y (N + 2)) - decompose W y (N + 2))
        rw [add_sub_cancel, pr_of_mem W hYn, if_pos rfl,
          pr_of_mem W (hS _), if_neg (by omega), add_zero] at this
        exact this
      rw [e, pr_sub, hE _ _ hYn, pr_smul, pr_of_mem W hYn, if_pos rfl, e2,
        show ((N + 2 : ℕ) : R) = ((N + 1 : ℕ) : R) + 1 by push_cast; ring, add_smul, one_smul,
        add_sub_cancel_right]
    obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := isUnit_natCast_of_ne_zero (R := R) (Nat.succ_ne_zero N)
    have hc1 : ((u⁻¹ : Rˣ) : R) * ((N + 1 : ℕ) : R) = 1 := by rw [← hu, Units.inv_mul]
    set Z := ((u⁻¹ : Rˣ) : R) • (decompose W (h (decompose W y (N + 2))) (N + 2) : M) with hZdef
    have hZ : Z ∈ W (N + 2) := (W (N + 2)).smul_mem _ (Submodule.coe_mem _)
    have hdZ : d Z = (decompose W y (N + 2) : M) := by
      rw [hZdef, map_smul, h2, smul_smul, hc1, one_smul]
    
    have htop : ∀ j, N + 1 < j → (decompose W (y - (d Z - δ Z)) j : M) = 0 := by
      intro j hj
      rw [pr_sub, pr_sub, pr_comm W d hd, pr_shift W δ hδ hδ0, pr_of_mem W hZ, pr_of_mem W hZ,
        if_neg (show N + 2 ≠ j + 1 by omega), map_zero, sub_zero]
      by_cases hj2 : N + 2 = j
      · subst hj2
        rw [if_pos rfl, hdZ, sub_self]
      · rw [if_neg hj2, map_zero, sub_zero, hN j (by omega)]
    obtain ⟨z', hz'⟩ := ih (y - (d Z - δ Z)) htop
      (by rw [map_sub d, map_sub δ, sub_sub_sub_comm, hy, hDD, sub_zero])
      (by rw [map_sub, hcy, hc, sub_zero])
    refine ⟨Z + z', ?_⟩
    rw [map_add, map_add, add_sub_add_comm, hz']
    abel

name: Operad.Cobar.alg_comm
statement:
private lemma alg_comm {M : Type*} [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] (d h E S : M →ₗ[R] M) (y : M)
    (h1 : d (h y) + h (d y) = E y - S y) (h2 : d (h (d y)) + h (d (d y)) = E (d y) - S (d y))
    (hdd : ∀ z, d (d z) = 0) (hs1 : d (S y) = d y) (hs2 : S (d y) = d y) :
    d (E y) = E (d y)
proof:
:= by
  have e1 : E y = d (h y) + h (d y) + S y := by rw [h1]; abel
  have e2 : E (d y) = d (h (d y)) + h (d (d y)) + S (d y) := by rw [h2]; abel
  rw [e1, e2, map_add, map_add, hdd, hdd, map_zero, hs1, hs2]
  abel

name: Operad.Cobar.d_unitL
statement: lemma d_unitL : (Cobar.d R 𝒞).app A (FreeGrL.unitL R (CobarGen R 𝒞) A) = 0
proof:
:=
  (map_sum _ _ _).trans (Finset.sum_eq_zero fun e _ => d_unit e)

name: Operad.Cobar.d_wtΩ
statement:
theorem d_wtΩ (hV0 : ∀ v : V (Fin 0), v = 0) (Y : CobarGr R 𝒞 A) :
    (Cobar.d R 𝒞).app A ((wtΩ R V).app A Y) = (wtΩ R V).app A ((Cobar.d R 𝒞).app A Y)
proof:
:= by
  have h1 := dh_hd hV0 Y
  have h2 := dh_hd hV0 ((Cobar.d R 𝒞).app A Y)
  have hz : (Cobar.d R 𝒞).app A (FreeGrL.unitCoeffL R (CobarGen R 𝒞) A Y
      • FreeGrL.unitL R (CobarGen R 𝒞) A) = 0 :=
    (map_smul _ _ _).trans ((congrArg _ d_unitL).trans (smul_zero _))
  have hs1 : (Cobar.d R 𝒞).app A (FreeGrL.secC R (CobarGen R 𝒞) A Y)
      = (Cobar.d R 𝒞).app A Y :=
    (congrArg ((Cobar.d R 𝒞).app A) (FreeGrL.secC_apply Y)).trans
      ((map_sub _ _ _).trans ((congrArg _ hz).trans (sub_zero _)))
  have hs2 := FreeGrL.secC_of_unitCoeff (unitCoeffL_d hV0 Y)
  have hdd : ∀ z : CobarGr R 𝒞 A, (Cobar.d R 𝒞).app A ((Cobar.d R 𝒞).app A z) = 0 :=
    fun z => Cobar.d_d R 𝒞 z
  exact alg_comm _ _ _ _ Y h1 h2 hdd hs1 hs2

name: Operad.Cobar.mem_wt
statement:
lemma mem_wt {j : ℕ} {Y : CobarGr R 𝒞 A} :
    Y ∈ wt R V j A ↔ (wtΩ R V).app A Y = (j : R) • Y
proof:
:=
  Module.End.mem_eigenspace_iff

name: Operad.Cobar.wtΩ_comp
statement:
lemma wtΩ_comp (r : A) (P : CobarGr R 𝒞 A) (Q : CobarGr R 𝒞 B) :
    (wtΩ R V).app _ (GrOperad.comp (R := R) r P Q)
      = GrOperad.comp (R := R) r ((wtΩ R V).app A P) Q
        + GrOperad.comp (R := R) r P ((wtΩ R V).app B Q)
proof:
:=
  ((wtΩ R V).app_comp r P Q).trans (congrArg (fun z => GrOperad.comp (R := R) r
    ((wtΩ R V).app A P) Q + GrOperad.comp (R := R) r z ((wtΩ R V).app B Q))
      (GrOperad.tw_false P))

name: Operad.Cobar.wtΩ_tw
statement:
lemma wtΩ_tw (X : CobarGr R 𝒞 A) :
    (wtΩ R V).app A (GrOperad.tw (R := R) true X)
      = GrOperad.tw (R := R) true ((wtΩ R V).app A X)
proof:
:=
  ((wtΩ R V).app_tw true X).trans (one_smul R _)

name: Operad.Cobar.unit_mem_wt
statement:
lemma unit_mem_wt (e : Unit ≃ A) :
    GrOperad.map (R := R) e (GrOperad.one (R := R) (P := CobarGr R 𝒞)) ∈ wt R V 0 A
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_wt, Nat.cast_zero, zero_smul]
  exact ((wtΩ R V).app_map e _).trans ((congrArg _ (wtΩ R V).app_one).trans (map_zero _))

name: Operad.Cobar.map_mem_wt
statement:
lemma map_mem_wt {A' : Type} [Fintype A'] [DecidableEq A'] (e : A ≃ A') {j : ℕ}
    {Y : CobarGr R 𝒞 A} (hY : Y ∈ wt R V j A) : GrOperad.map (R := R) e Y ∈ wt R V j A'
proof:
:=
  mem_wt.2 (((wtΩ R V).app_map e Y).trans ((congrArg _ (mem_wt.1 hY)).trans (map_smul _ _ _)))

name: Operad.Cobar.comp_mem_wt
proof:
:= by
  refine mem_wt.2 (((wtΩ R V).app_comp r P Q).trans ?_)
  have h1 : GrOperad.comp (R := R) r ((wtΩ R V).app A P) Q
      = (i : R) • GrOperad.comp (R := R) r P Q :=
    (congrArg (fun z => GrOperad.comp (R := R) r z Q) (mem_wt.1 hP)).trans
      (LinearMap.map_smul₂ _ _ _ _)
  have h2 : GrOperad.comp (R := R) r (GrOperad.tw (R := R) false P) ((wtΩ R V).app B Q)
      = (j : R) • GrOperad.comp (R := R) r P Q :=
    (congrArg₂ (fun a b => GrOperad.comp (R := R) r a b) (GrOperad.tw_false P)
      (mem_wt.1 hQ)).trans (map_smul _ _ _)
  refine (congrArg₂ (· + ·) h1 h2).trans ((add_smul _ _ _).symm.trans ?_)
  rw [Nat.cast_add]

name: Operad.Cobar.ιL_bas_mem_wt
statement:
lemma ιL_bas_mem_wt (t : Reg (TreeOfArity (GrGen R V)) A) :
    Cobar.ιL R 𝒞 A ((𝒥).proj A (𝔟 t)) ∈ wt R V (treeOf t).weight A
proof:
:=
  mem_wt.2 ((wtΩ_ιL _).trans ((congrArg (Cobar.ιL R 𝒞 A) (FreeGrL.wtD_proj_bas t)).trans
    (map_smul _ _ _)))

name: Operad.Cobar.d_mem_wt
statement:
lemma d_mem_wt (hV0 : ∀ v : V (Fin 0), v = 0) {j : ℕ} {Y : CobarGr R 𝒞 A}
    (hY : Y ∈ wt R V j A) : (Cobar.d R 𝒞).app A Y ∈ wt R V j A
proof:
:=
  mem_wt.2 ((d_wtΩ hV0 Y).symm.trans ((congrArg _ (mem_wt.1 hY)).trans (map_smul _ _ _)))

name: Operad.Cobar.unitL_mem_wt
statement: lemma unitL_mem_wt : FreeGrL.unitL R (CobarGen R 𝒞) A ∈ wt R V 0 A
proof:
:=
  Submodule.sum_mem _ fun e _ => unit_mem_wt e

name: Operad.Cobar.secC_sub_mem_wt
statement:
lemma secC_sub_mem_wt (Y : CobarGr R 𝒞 A) :
    FreeGrL.secC R (CobarGen R 𝒞) A Y - Y ∈ wt R V 0 A
proof:
:= by
  rw [FreeGrL.secC_apply, sub_sub_cancel_left]
  exact Submodule.neg_mem _ (Submodule.smul_mem _ _ unitL_mem_wt)

name: Operad.Cobar.unitsΩ_le
statement: lemma unitsΩ_le : unitsΩ R V A ≤ wt R V 0 A
proof:
:=
  Submodule.span_le.2 (by rintro _ ⟨e, rfl⟩; exact unit_mem_wt e)

name: Operad.Cobar.corGen_le
statement: lemma corGen_le : corGen R V A ≤ wt R V 1 A
proof:
:= by
  rintro _ ⟨v, rfl⟩
  refine mem_wt.2 (((wtΩ_ιL ((FreeGrL.ι R V).app A v)).trans
    (congrArg (Cobar.ιL R 𝒞 A) (FreeGrL.wtD_ι v))).trans ?_)
  rw [Nat.cast_one, one_smul]
  rfl

name: Operad.Cobar.low_le_ne0
statement: private lemma low_le_ne0 : corGen R V A ⊔ wtTwo R V A ≤ ⨆ (j : ℕ) (_ : j ≠ 0), wt R V j A
proof:
:=
  sup_le (corGen_le.trans (le_iSup₂_of_le 1 one_ne_zero le_rfl))
    (iSup_le fun j => le_iSup₂_of_le (j + 2) (by omega) le_rfl)

name: Operad.Cobar.wtTwo_le_ne1
statement: private lemma wtTwo_le_ne1 : wtTwo R V A ≤ ⨆ (j : ℕ) (_ : j ≠ 1), wt R V j A
proof:
:=
  iSup_le fun j => le_iSup₂_of_le (j + 2) (by omega) le_rfl

name: Operad.Cobar.unitsΩ_le_ne1
statement: private lemma unitsΩ_le_ne1 : unitsΩ R V A ≤ ⨆ (j : ℕ) (_ : j ≠ 1), wt R V j A
proof:
:=
  unitsΩ_le.trans (le_iSup₂_of_le 0 zero_ne_one le_rfl)

name: Operad.Cobar.map_mem_corGen
statement:
lemma map_mem_corGen {A' : Type} [Fintype A'] [DecidableEq A'] (e : A ≃ A')
    {Y : CobarGr R 𝒞 A} (hY : Y ∈ corGen R V A) : GrOperad.map (R := R) e Y ∈ corGen R V A'
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨v, rfl⟩ := hY
  refine ⟨SymSpecies.map (R := R) e v, ?_⟩
  show Cobar.ιL R 𝒞 A' ((FreeGrL.ι R V).app A' (SymSpecies.map (R := R) e v))
    = GrOperad.map (R := R) e (Cobar.ιL R 𝒞 A ((FreeGrL.ι R V).app A v))
  rw [(FreeGrL.ι R V).app_map, FreeGrL.symMap_eq, ιL_map']

name: Operad.Cobar.map_mem_wtTwo
statement:
lemma map_mem_wtTwo {A' : Type} [Fintype A'] [DecidableEq A'] (e : A ≃ A')
    {Y : CobarGr R 𝒞 A} (hY : Y ∈ wtTwo R V A) : GrOperad.map (R := R) e Y ∈ wtTwo R V A'
proof:
:=
  Submodule.iSup_induction _ (motive := fun Y => GrOperad.map (R := R) e Y ∈ wtTwo R V A') hY
    (fun j Y hY => Submodule.mem_iSup_of_mem j (map_mem_wt e hY))
    (by beta_reduce; rw [map_zero (GrOperad.map (R := R) (P := CobarGr R 𝒞) e)]; exact zero_mem _)
    (fun Y Y' hY hY' => by beta_reduce at hY hY' ⊢; rw [map_add]; exact add_mem hY hY')

name: Operad.Cobar.map_mem_low
statement:
lemma map_mem_low {A' : Type} [Fintype A'] [DecidableEq A'] (e : A ≃ A')
    {Y : CobarGr R 𝒞 A} (hY : Y ∈ corGen R V A ⊔ wtTwo R V A) :
    GrOperad.map (R := R) e Y ∈ corGen R V A' ⊔ wtTwo R V A'
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨y, hy, z, hz, rfl⟩ := Submodule.mem_sup.1 hY
  rw [map_add]
  exact Submodule.add_mem_sup (map_mem_corGen e hy) (map_mem_wtTwo e hz)

name: Operad.Cobar.comp_mem_wtTwo
proof:
:= by
  refine Submodule.iSup_induction _
    (motive := fun P => GrOperad.comp (R := R) r P Q ∈ wtTwo R V _) hP (fun i P hP => ?_) ?_ ?_
  · refine Submodule.iSup_induction _
      (motive := fun Q => GrOperad.comp (R := R) r P Q ∈ wtTwo R V _) hQ (fun j Q hQ => ?_) ?_ ?_
    · have h := comp_mem_wt r hP hQ
      rw [show i + 1 + (j + 1) = i + j + 2 by omega] at h
      exact Submodule.mem_iSup_of_mem (i + j) h
    · beta_reduce
      rw [map_zero (GrOperad.comp (R := R) (P := CobarGr R 𝒞) r P)]
      exact zero_mem _
    · intro Q Q' hQ hQ'
      beta_reduce at hQ hQ' ⊢
      rw [map_add]
      exact add_mem hQ hQ'
  · beta_reduce
    rw [LinearMap.map_zero₂ (GrOperad.comp (R := R) (P := CobarGr R 𝒞) r) Q]
    exact zero_mem _
  · intro P P' hP hP'
    beta_reduce at hP hP' ⊢
    rw [map_add, LinearMap.add_apply]
    exact add_mem hP hP'

name: Operad.Cobar.low_le_pos
statement: lemma low_le_pos : corGen R V A ⊔ wtTwo R V A ≤ ⨆ i : ℕ, wt R V (i + 1) A
proof:
:=
  sup_le (corGen_le.trans (le_iSup (fun i : ℕ => wt R V (i + 1) A) 0))
    (iSup_le fun j => le_iSup (fun i : ℕ => wt R V (i + 1) A) (j + 1))

name: Operad.Cobar.mem_of_single
statement:
private lemma mem_of_single {α : Type*} {M : Type*} [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M]
    {S : Submodule R M} (f : (α →₀ R) →ₗ[R] M) (h : ∀ a, f (Finsupp.single a 1) ∈ S)
    (x : α →₀ R) : f x ∈ S
proof:
:= by
  induction x using Finsupp.induction_linear with
  | zero => rw [map_zero]; exact S.zero_mem
  | add x y hx hy => rw [map_add]; exact S.add_mem hx hy
  | single a b =>
    rw [← Finsupp.smul_single_one, map_smul]
    exact S.smul_mem b (h a)

name: Operad.Cobar.ιL_bas_mem_low
statement:
private lemma ιL_bas_mem_low (t : Reg (TreeOfArity (GrGen R V)) B) :
    Cobar.ιL R 𝒞 B ((𝒥).proj B (𝔟 t)) ∈ corGen R V B ⊔ wtTwo R V B
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hl : (treeOf t).isLeaf = true
  · exact (ιL_bas_leaf hl).symm ▸ zero_mem _
  have hw := Tree.one_le_weight (by simpa using hl : (treeOf t).isLeaf = false)
  rcases Nat.lt_or_ge (treeOf t).weight 2 with h2 | h2
  · obtain ⟨k, g, hg⟩ := eq_corolla_of_nVert (x := t) (by rw [nVert_eq]; omega)
    obtain ⟨e, he⟩ := exists_map_eq (x := Reg.std (corolla g)) (y := t) hg.symm
    have ht : (𝒥).proj B (𝔟 t) = (FreeGrL.ι R V).app B (SymSpecies.map (R := R) e g.1.1) := by
      rw [← he, FreeGrL.proj_bas_map, FreeGrL.proj_bas_corolla, (FreeGrL.ι R V).app_map,
        FreeGrL.symMap_eq]
    rw [ht]
    exact Submodule.mem_sup_left ⟨_, rfl⟩
  · refine Submodule.mem_sup_right (Submodule.mem_iSup_of_mem ((treeOf t).weight - 2) ?_)
    rw [Nat.sub_add_cancel h2]
    exact ιL_bas_mem_wt t

name: Operad.Cobar.ιL_mem_low
statement:
private lemma ιL_mem_low (y : FreeGr R (grGenPar R V) B) :
    Cobar.ιL R 𝒞 B ((𝒥).proj B y) ∈ corGen R V B ⊔ wtTwo R V B
proof:
:=
  mem_of_single ((Cobar.ιL R 𝒞 B).comp ((𝒥).proj B)) (fun t => ιL_bas_mem_low t) y

name: Operad.Cobar.bas_mem_corolla
statement:
private lemma bas_mem_corolla {k : ℕ} (g : GrGen R (CobarGen R 𝒞) k) (e : Fin k ≃ A) :
    (𝒥Ω).proj A (𝔅 (SetOperad.map e (Reg.std (corolla g)))) ∈ corGen R V A ⊔ wtTwo R V A
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := exists_ιL_eq (R := R) (V := V) g.1.1
  have hZ : (𝒥Ω).proj A (𝔅 (SetOperad.map e (Reg.std (corolla g))))
      = GrOperad.map (R := R) e (Cobar.ιL R 𝒞 (Fin k) ((𝒥).proj (Fin k) y)) :=
    (FreeGrL.proj_bas_map e _).trans (congrArg (GrOperad.map (R := R) e)
      ((FreeGrL.proj_bas_corolla g).trans hy.symm))
  rw [hZ]
  exact map_mem_low e (ιL_mem_low y)

name: Operad.Cobar.bas_mem_comp
statement:
private lemma bas_mem_comp {A₁ B₁ : Type} [Fintype A₁] [DecidableEq A₁] [Fintype B₁]
    [DecidableEq B₁] (r : A₁) (p : Reg (TreeOfArity (GrGen R (CobarGen R 𝒞))) A₁)
    (q : Reg (TreeOfArity (GrGen R (CobarGen R 𝒞))) B₁) (e : Without A₁ r ⊕ B₁ ≃ A)
    (hp : (𝒥Ω).proj A₁ (𝔅 p) ∈ corGen R V A₁ ⊔ wtTwo R V A₁)
    (hq : (𝒥Ω).proj B₁ (𝔅 q) ∈ corGen R V B₁ ⊔ wtTwo R V B₁) :
    (𝒥Ω).proj A (𝔅 (SetOperad.map e (SetOperad.comp r p q))) ∈ corGen R V A ⊔ wtTwo R V A
proof:
:= by
  have hX : (𝒥Ω).proj A (𝔅 (SetOperad.map e (SetOperad.comp r p q)))
      = GrOperad.map (R := R) e (σ R (cSgn (grGenPar R (CobarGen R 𝒞)) r p q) •
          GrOperad.comp (R := R) r ((𝒥Ω).proj A₁ (𝔅 p)) ((𝒥Ω).proj B₁ (𝔅 q))) :=
    (FreeGrL.proj_bas_map e _).trans (congrArg (GrOperad.map (R := R) e)
      (FreeGrL.proj_bas_comp r p q))
  rw [hX]
  exact Submodule.mem_sup_right (map_mem_wtTwo e (Submodule.smul_mem _ _
    (comp_mem_wtTwo r (low_le_pos hp) (low_le_pos hq))))

name: Operad.Cobar.bas_mem_low
statement:
private theorem bas_mem_low (x : Reg (TreeOfArity (GrGen R (CobarGen R 𝒞))) A) :
    (treeOf x).isLeaf = false → (𝒥Ω).proj A (𝔅 x) ∈ corGen R V A ⊔ wtTwo R V A
proof:
:=
  tree_induction (motive := fun A _ _ x => (treeOf x).isLeaf = false →
      (𝒥Ω).proj A (𝔅 x) ∈ corGen R V A ⊔ wtTwo R V A)
    (fun _ _ _ _ hl hl' => absurd (hl.symm.trans hl') (by decide))
    (fun _ _ _ _ g e _ => bas_mem_corolla g e)
    (fun _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ r p q e hpl hql hp hq _ => bas_mem_comp r p q e (hp hpl) (hq hql)) A x

name: Operad.Cobar.mem_units_sup
statement:
theorem mem_units_sup (Y : CobarGr R 𝒞 A) :
    Y ∈ unitsΩ R V A ⊔ (corGen R V A ⊔ wtTwo R V A)
proof:
:= by
  have h := Function.surjInv_eq ((𝒥Ω).proj_surjective A) Y
  rw [← h]
  refine mem_of_single ((𝒥Ω).proj A) (fun x => ?_) _
  by_cases hl : (treeOf x).isLeaf = true
  · obtain ⟨e, he⟩ := FreeGrL.proj_bas_leaf hl
    exact (congrArg (fun z => z ∈ unitsΩ R V A ⊔ (corGen R V A ⊔ wtTwo R V A)) he).mpr
      (Submodule.mem_sup_left (Submodule.subset_span ⟨e, rfl⟩))
  · exact Submodule.mem_sup_right (bas_mem_low x (by simpa using hl))

name: Operad.Cobar.iSup_wt_eq_top
statement: theorem iSup_wt_eq_top : ⨆ j : ℕ, wt R V j A = ⊤
proof:
:=
  eq_top_iff.2 fun Y _ => (sup_le (unitsΩ_le.trans (le_iSup (fun j : ℕ => wt R V j A) 0))
    (sup_le (corGen_le.trans (le_iSup (fun j : ℕ => wt R V j A) 1))
      (iSup_le fun j => le_iSup (fun j : ℕ => wt R V j A) (j + 2)))) (mem_units_sup Y)

name: Operad.Cobar.isInternal_wt
statement: theorem isInternal_wt [Algebra ℚ R] : DirectSum.IsInternal fun j : ℕ => wt R V j A
proof:
:=
  DirectSum.isInternal_submodule_of_iSupIndep_of_iSup_eq_top
    (iSupIndep_eigenspace_nat ((wtΩ R V).app A)) iSup_wt_eq_top

name: Operad.Cobar.mem_unitsΩ_of_mem_wt
statement:
theorem mem_unitsΩ_of_mem_wt [Algebra ℚ R] {Y : CobarGr R 𝒞 A} (hY : Y ∈ wt R V 0 A) :
    Y ∈ unitsΩ R V A
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨u, hu, z, hz, rfl⟩ := Submodule.mem_sup.1 (mem_units_sup Y)
  have hz0 : z ∈ wt R V 0 A := by
    have := Submodule.sub_mem _ hY (unitsΩ_le hu)
    rwa [add_sub_cancel_left] at this
  have h0 : z = 0 := Submodule.disjoint_def.1
    (iSupIndep_eigenspace_nat ((wtΩ R V).app A) 0) z hz0 (low_le_ne0 hz)
  have e : u + z = u := (congrArg (u + ·) h0).trans (add_zero u)
  exact e.symm ▸ hu

name: Operad.Cobar.mem_corGen_of_mem_wt
statement:
theorem mem_corGen_of_mem_wt [Algebra ℚ R] {Y : CobarGr R 𝒞 A} (hY : Y ∈ wt R V 1 A) :
    Y ∈ corGen R V A
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨u, hu, w, hw, rfl⟩ := Submodule.mem_sup.1 (mem_units_sup Y)
  obtain ⟨c, hc, z, hz, rfl⟩ := Submodule.mem_sup.1 hw
  have h1 : u + z ∈ wt R V 1 A := by
    have := Submodule.sub_mem _ hY (corGen_le hc)
    rwa [add_left_comm, add_sub_cancel_left] at this
  have h0 : u + z = 0 := Submodule.disjoint_def.1
    (iSupIndep_eigenspace_nat ((wtΩ R V).app A) 1) _ h1
    (Submodule.add_mem _ (unitsΩ_le_ne1 hu) (wtTwo_le_ne1 hz))
  have e : u + (c + z) = c :=
    (add_left_comm u c z).trans ((congrArg (c + ·) h0).trans (add_zero c))
  exact e.symm ▸ hc

name: Operad.alg_Eδ
statement:
private lemma alg_Eδ (c : M →ₗ[R] N →ₗ[R] Q) (EM δM tM : M →ₗ[R] M) (EN δN : N →ₗ[R] N)
    (EQ δQ : Q →ₗ[R] Q) (hδc : ∀ x y, δQ (c x y) = c (δM x) y + c (tM x) (δN y))
    (hEc : ∀ x y, EQ (c x y) = c (EM x) y + c x (EN y)) (hEt : ∀ x, EM (tM x) = tM (EM x))
    (x : M) (y : N) (hx : EM (δM x) = δM (EM x) - δM x) (hy : EN (δN y) = δN (EN y) - δN y) :
    EQ (δQ (c x y)) = δQ (EQ (c x y)) - δQ (c x y)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [hδc, hEc, map_add, map_sub, LinearMap.sub_apply, hx, hy, hEt]
  abel

name: Operad.alg_of_dft
statement: private lemma alg_of_dft {a b c : M} (h : a - b + c = 0) : a = b - c
proof:
:= by
  rw [← sub_eq_zero, ← h]
  abel

name: Operad.alg_to_dft
statement: private lemma alg_to_dft {a b c : M} (h : a = b - c) : a - b + c = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [h]
  abel

name: Operad.alg_succ
statement: private lemma alg_succ (j : ℕ) (z : M) : ((j + 1 : ℕ) : R) • z - z = (j : R) • z
proof:
:= by
  rw [Nat.cast_succ, add_smul, one_smul, add_sub_cancel_right]

name: Operad.Cobar.dft_apply
statement:
private lemma dft_apply (Y : CobarGr R 𝒞 A) :
    dft δ A Y = (wtΩ R V).app A (δ.app A Y) - δ.app A ((wtΩ R V).app A Y) + δ.app A Y
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.Cobar.dft_map
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : (wtΩ R V).app A' (δ.app A' (GrOperad.map (R := R) e Y))
      = GrOperad.map (R := R) e ((wtΩ R V).app A (δ.app A Y)) :=
    (congrArg _ (δ.app_map e Y)).trans ((wtΩ R V).app_map e _)
  have h2 : δ.app A' ((wtΩ R V).app A' (GrOperad.map (R := R) e Y))
      = GrOperad.map (R := R) e (δ.app A ((wtΩ R V).app A Y)) :=
    (congrArg _ ((wtΩ R V).app_map e Y)).trans (δ.app_map e _)
  exact (dft_apply δ _).trans ((congrArg₂ (· + ·) (congrArg₂ (· - ·) h1 h2) (δ.app_map e Y)).trans
    (((congrArg₂ (· + ·) (map_sub (GrOperad.map (R := R) e) _ _).symm rfl).trans
      (map_add (GrOperad.map (R := R) e) _ _).symm).trans
        (congrArg (GrOperad.map (R := R) e) (dft_apply δ Y)).symm))

name: Operad.Cobar.dft_ιL
statement:
private lemma dft_ιL (hδ : ∀ (A : Type) [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] (c : 𝒞 A),
      δ.app A (Cobar.ιL R 𝒞 A c) = Cobar.ιL R 𝒞 A (ϑ A c))
    (hϑ : ∀ (A : Type) [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] (c : 𝒞 A),
      (FreeGrL.wtD R V).app A (ϑ A c) = ϑ A ((FreeGrL.wtD R V).app A c) - ϑ A c)
    (c : 𝒞 A) : dft δ A (Cobar.ιL R 𝒞 A c) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : (wtΩ R V).app A (δ.app A (Cobar.ιL R 𝒞 A c))
      = Cobar.ιL R 𝒞 A ((FreeGrL.wtD R V).app A (ϑ A c)) :=
    (congrArg _ (hδ A c)).trans (wtΩ_ιL _)
  have h2 : δ.app A ((wtΩ R V).app A (Cobar.ιL R 𝒞 A c))
      = Cobar.ιL R 𝒞 A (ϑ A ((FreeGrL.wtD R V).app A c)) :=
    (congrArg _ (wtΩ_ιL c)).trans (hδ A _)
  have h4 : (FreeGrL.wtD R V).app A (ϑ A c) - ϑ A ((FreeGrL.wtD R V).app A c) + ϑ A c = 0 :=
    alg_to_dft (hϑ A c)
  exact (dft_apply δ _).trans ((congrArg₂ (· + ·) (congrArg₂ (· - ·) h1 h2) (hδ A c)).trans
    ((congrArg₂ (· + ·) (map_sub (Cobar.ιL R 𝒞 A) _ _).symm rfl).trans
      ((map_add (Cobar.ιL R 𝒞 A) _ _).symm.trans ((congrArg _ h4).trans (map_zero _)))))

name: Operad.Cobar.dft_unit
statement:
private lemma dft_unit (e : Unit ≃ A) :
    dft δ A (GrOperad.map (R := R) e (GrOperad.one (R := R) (P := CobarGr R 𝒞))) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hE : (wtΩ R V).app A
      (GrOperad.map (R := R) e (GrOperad.one (R := R) (P := CobarGr R 𝒞))) = 0 :=
    ((wtΩ R V).app_map e _).trans ((congrArg _ (wtΩ R V).app_one).trans (map_zero _))
  have hδ : δ.app A (GrOperad.map (R := R) e (GrOperad.one (R := R) (P := CobarGr R 𝒞))) = 0 :=
    (δ.app_map e _).trans ((congrArg _ δ.app_one).trans (map_zero _))
  exact (dft_apply δ _).trans ((congrArg₂ (· + ·) (congrArg₂ (· - ·)
    ((congrArg _ hδ).trans (map_zero _)) ((congrArg _ hE).trans (map_zero _))) hδ).trans
      ((add_zero _).trans (sub_self 0)))

name: Operad.Cobar.dft_comp
statement:
private lemma dft_comp (r : A) {X : CobarGr R 𝒞 A} {Y : CobarGr R 𝒞 B} (hX : dft δ A X = 0)
    (hY : dft δ B Y = 0) : dft δ _ (GrOperad.comp (R := R) r X Y) = 0
proof:
:=
  (dft_apply δ _).trans (alg_to_dft (alg_Eδ (GrOperad.comp (R := R) r)
    ((wtΩ R V).app A) (δ.app A) (GrOperad.tw (R := R) true) ((wtΩ R V).app B) (δ.app B)
    ((wtΩ R V).app _) (δ.app _) (fun x y => δ.app_comp r x y) (wtΩ_comp r) wtΩ_tw X Y
    (alg_of_dft ((dft_apply δ X).symm.trans hX)) (alg_of_dft ((dft_apply δ Y).symm.trans hY))))

name: Operad.Cobar.dft_corolla
statement:
private lemma dft_corolla (hδ : ∀ (A : Type) [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] (c : 𝒞 A),
      δ.app A (Cobar.ιL R 𝒞 A c) = Cobar.ιL R 𝒞 A (ϑ A c))
    (hϑ : ∀ (A : Type) [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] (c : 𝒞 A),
      (FreeGrL.wtD R V).app A (ϑ A c) = ϑ A ((FreeGrL.wtD R V).app A c) - ϑ A c)
    {k : ℕ} (g : GrGen R (CobarGen R 𝒞) k) (e : Fin k ≃ A) :
    dft δ A ((𝒥Ω).proj A (𝔅 (SetOperad.map e (Reg.std (corolla g))))) = 0
proof:
:=
  (exists_ιL_eq (R := R) (V := V) g.1.1).elim fun _ hy =>
    (congrArg (dft δ A) ((FreeGrL.proj_bas_map e _).trans (congrArg (GrOperad.map (R := R) e)
      ((FreeGrL.proj_bas_corolla g).trans hy.symm)))).trans
      ((dft_map δ e _).trans ((congrArg _ (dft_ιL δ ϑ hδ hϑ _)).trans (map_zero _)))

name: Operad.Cobar.dft_comp_bas
statement:
private lemma dft_comp_bas {A₁ B₁ : Type} [Fintype A₁] [DecidableEq A₁] [Fintype B₁]
    [DecidableEq B₁] (r : A₁) (p : Reg (TreeOfArity (GrGen R (CobarGen R 𝒞))) A₁)
    (q : Reg (TreeOfArity (GrGen R (CobarGen R 𝒞))) B₁) (e : Without A₁ r ⊕ B₁ ≃ A)
    (hp : dft δ A₁ ((𝒥Ω).proj A₁ (𝔅 p)) = 0) (hq : dft δ B₁ ((𝒥Ω).proj B₁ (𝔅 q)) = 0) :
    dft δ A ((𝒥Ω).proj A (𝔅 (SetOperad.map e (SetOperad.comp r p q)))) = 0
proof:
:=
  (congrArg (dft δ A) ((FreeGrL.proj_bas_map e _).trans (congrArg (GrOperad.map (R := R) e)
    (FreeGrL.proj_bas_comp r p q)))).trans ((dft_map δ e _).trans ((congrArg _
      ((map_smul _ _ _).trans ((congrArg _ (dft_comp δ r hp hq)).trans (smul_zero _)))).trans
        (map_zero _)))

name: Operad.Cobar.dft_bas
statement:
private theorem dft_bas (hδ : ∀ (A : Type) [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] (c : 𝒞 A),
      δ.app A (Cobar.ιL R 𝒞 A c) = Cobar.ιL R 𝒞 A (ϑ A c))
    (hϑ : ∀ (A : Type) [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] (c : 𝒞 A),
      (FreeGrL.wtD R V).app A (ϑ A c) = ϑ A ((FreeGrL.wtD R V).app A c) - ϑ A c)
    (x : Reg (TreeOfArity (GrGen R (CobarGen R 𝒞))) A) :
    dft δ A ((𝒥Ω).proj A (𝔅 x)) = 0
proof:
:=
  tree_induction (motive := fun A _ _ x => dft δ A ((𝒥Ω).proj A (𝔅 x)) = 0)
    (fun _ _ _ _ hl => (FreeGrL.proj_bas_leaf hl).elim fun e he =>
      (congrArg _ he).trans (dft_unit δ e))
    (fun _ _ _ _ g e => dft_corolla δ ϑ hδ hϑ g e)
    (fun _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ r p q e _ _ hp hq => dft_comp_bas δ r p q e hp hq) A x

name: Operad.Cobar.wtΩ_δ
statement:
theorem wtΩ_δ (hδ : ∀ (A : Type) [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] (c : 𝒞 A),
      δ.app A (Cobar.ιL R 𝒞 A c) = Cobar.ιL R 𝒞 A (ϑ A c))
    (hϑ : ∀ (A : Type) [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] (c : 𝒞 A),
      (FreeGrL.wtD R V).app A (ϑ A c) = ϑ A ((FreeGrL.wtD R V).app A c) - ϑ A c)
    (Y : CobarGr R 𝒞 A) :
    (wtΩ R V).app A (δ.app A Y) = δ.app A ((wtΩ R V).app A Y) - δ.app A Y
proof:
:= by
  refine alg_of_dft ((dft_apply δ Y).symm.trans ?_)
  have h := Function.surjInv_eq ((𝒥Ω).proj_surjective A) Y
  rw [← h]
  exact lin_eq_zero_of_single (dft δ A ∘ₗ (𝒥Ω).proj A) (fun x => dft_bas δ ϑ hδ hϑ x) _

name: Operad.Cobar.δ_mem_wt
statement:
lemma δ_mem_wt {j : ℕ} {Y : CobarGr R 𝒞 A} (hY : Y ∈ wt R V (j + 1) A) :
    δ.app A Y ∈ wt R V j A
proof:
:=
  mem_wt.2 ((wtΩ_δ δ ϑ hδ hϑ Y).trans ((congrArg (fun z => δ.app A z - δ.app A Y)
    (mem_wt.1 hY)).trans ((congrArg (· - δ.app A Y) (map_smul _ _ _)).trans (alg_succ _ _))))

name: Operad.Cobar.δ_wt0
statement: lemma δ_wt0 [Algebra ℚ R] {Y : CobarGr R 𝒞 A} (hY : Y ∈ wt R V 0 A) : δ.app A Y = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hu := mem_unitsΩ_of_mem_wt hY
  clear hY
  induction hu using Submodule.span_induction with
  | mem y hy =>
    obtain ⟨e, rfl⟩ := hy
    exact (δ.app_map e _).trans ((congrArg _ δ.app_one).trans (map_zero _))
  | zero => exact map_zero _
  | add y z _ _ hy hz => exact (map_add _ _ _).trans ((congrArg₂ (· + ·) hy hz).trans (add_zero 0))
  | smul a y _ hy => exact (map_smul _ _ _).trans ((congrArg _ hy).trans (smul_zero _))

name: Operad.Cobar.base_of
statement:
private lemma base_of [Algebra ℚ R]
    (hbase : ∀ u ∈ unitsΩ R V A, ∀ v : V A,
      c (u + Cobar.ιL R 𝒞 A ((FreeGrL.ι R V).app A v)) = 0 →
        u + Cobar.ιL R 𝒞 A ((FreeGrL.ι R V).app A v) = 0)
    {y₀ y₁ : CobarGr R 𝒞 A} (h₀ : y₀ ∈ wt R V 0 A) (h₁ : y₁ ∈ wt R V 1 A)
    (h : c (y₀ + y₁) = 0) : y₀ + y₁ = 0
proof:
:=
  (mem_corGen_of_mem_wt h₁).elim fun v hv => by
    have hv' : Cobar.ιL R 𝒞 A ((FreeGrL.ι R V).app A v) = y₁ := hv
    rw [← hv'] at h ⊢
    exact hbase y₀ (mem_unitsΩ_of_mem_wt h₀) v h

name: Operad.Cobar.exists_sub_eq
statement:
theorem exists_sub_eq [Algebra ℚ R] (hV0 : ∀ v : V (Fin 0), v = 0)
    (hDD : ∀ y : CobarGr R 𝒞 A, (Cobar.d R 𝒞).app A ((Cobar.d R 𝒞).app A y - δ.app A y)
      - δ.app A ((Cobar.d R 𝒞).app A y - δ.app A y) = 0)
    (hc : ∀ y, c ((Cobar.d R 𝒞).app A y - δ.app A y) = 0)
    (hbase : ∀ u ∈ unitsΩ R V A, ∀ v : V A,
      c (u + Cobar.ιL R 𝒞 A ((FreeGrL.ι R V).app A v)) = 0 →
        u + Cobar.ιL R 𝒞 A ((FreeGrL.ι R V).app A v) = 0)
    (y : CobarGr R 𝒞 A) (hy : (Cobar.d R 𝒞).app A y - δ.app A y = 0) (hcy : c y = 0) :
    ∃ z, (Cobar.d R 𝒞).app A z - δ.app A z = y
proof:
:= by
  letI := (isInternal_wt (R := R) (V := V) (A := A)).chooseDecomposition
  exact exists_eq_D_of_weights (fun j => wt R V j A) ((wtΩ R V).app A) ((Cobar.d R 𝒞).app A)
    (hM R V A) (δ.app A) (FreeGrL.secC R (CobarGen R 𝒞) A) c
    (fun _ _ hy => mem_wt.1 hy) (fun _ _ hy => d_mem_wt hV0 hy)
    (fun _ _ hy => δ_mem_wt δ ϑ hδ hϑ hy) (fun _ hy => δ_wt0 δ hy) hDD
    (fun y => dh_hd hV0 y) (fun y => secC_sub_mem_wt y) hc
    (fun _ h₀ _ h₁ h => base_of c hbase h₀ h₁ h) y hy hcy

name: Operad.Cobar.sub_eq_zero_of_low
statement:
theorem sub_eq_zero_of_low [Algebra ℚ R] (hV0 : ∀ v : V (Fin 0), v = 0)
    (hc : ∀ y, c ((Cobar.d R 𝒞).app A y - δ.app A y) = 0)
    (hbase : ∀ u ∈ unitsΩ R V A, ∀ v : V A,
      c (u + Cobar.ιL R 𝒞 A ((FreeGrL.ι R V).app A v)) = 0 →
        u + Cobar.ιL R 𝒞 A ((FreeGrL.ι R V).app A v) = 0)
    {u : CobarGr R 𝒞 A} (hu : u ∈ unitsΩ R V A) (v : V A) :
    (Cobar.d R 𝒞).app A (u + Cobar.ιL R 𝒞 A ((FreeGrL.ι R V).app A v))
      - δ.app A (u + Cobar.ιL R 𝒞 A ((FreeGrL.ι R V).app A v)) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have h₀ : u ∈ wt R V 0 A := unitsΩ_le hu
  have h₁ : Cobar.ιL R 𝒞 A ((FreeGrL.ι R V).app A v) ∈ wt R V 1 A := corGen_le ⟨v, rfl⟩
  have hD : (Cobar.d R 𝒞).app A (u + Cobar.ιL R 𝒞 A ((FreeGrL.ι R V).app A v))
      - δ.app A (u + Cobar.ιL R 𝒞 A ((FreeGrL.ι R V).app A v))
      = ((Cobar.d R 𝒞).app A u - δ.app A (Cobar.ιL R 𝒞 A ((FreeGrL.ι R V).app A v)))
        + (Cobar.d R 𝒞).app A (Cobar.ιL R 𝒞 A ((FreeGrL.ι R V).app A v)) :=
    (congrArg₂ (· - ·) (map_add ((Cobar.d R 𝒞).app A) _ _) ((map_add (δ.app A) _ _).trans
      ((congrArg (· + δ.app A (Cobar.ιL R 𝒞 A ((FreeGrL.ι R V).app A v))) (δ_wt0 δ h₀)).trans
        (zero_add _)))).trans (add_sub_right_comm _ _ _)
  refine hD.trans (base_of c hbase (Submodule.sub_mem _ (d_mem_wt hV0 h₀)
    (δ_mem_wt δ ϑ hδ hϑ h₁)) (d_mem_wt hV0 h₁) ?_)
  exact (congrArg c hD).symm.trans (hc _)

name: Operad.Cobar.map_mem_of_unitsΩ
statement:
lemma map_mem_of_unitsΩ {N : Type*} [AddCommGroup N] [Module R N]
    (φ : CobarGr R 𝒞 A →ₗ[R] N) {S : Submodule R N}
    (h : ∀ e : Unit ≃ A,
      φ (GrOperad.map (R := R) e (GrOperad.one (R := R) (P := CobarGr R 𝒞))) ∈ S)
    {Y : CobarGr R 𝒞 A} (hY : Y ∈ unitsΩ R V A) : φ Y ∈ S
proof:
:= by
  induction hY using Submodule.span_induction with
  | mem y hy =>
    obtain ⟨e, rfl⟩ := hy
    exact h e
  | zero => exact (congrArg (· ∈ S) (map_zero φ)).mpr (zero_mem _)
  | add y z _ _ hy hz => exact (congrArg (· ∈ S) (map_add φ y z)).mpr (add_mem hy hz)
  | smul a y _ hy => exact (congrArg (· ∈ S) (map_smul φ a y)).mpr (Submodule.smul_mem _ a hy)

name: Operad.Cobar.eq_zero_of_unitsΩ
statement:
lemma eq_zero_of_unitsΩ {N : Type*} [AddCommGroup N] [Module R N]
    (φ : CobarGr R 𝒞 A →ₗ[R] N)
    (h : ∀ (e : Unit ≃ A) (a : R),
      a • φ (GrOperad.map (R := R) e (GrOperad.one (R := R) (P := CobarGr R 𝒞))) = 0 → a = 0)
    {Y : CobarGr R 𝒞 A} (hY : Y ∈ unitsΩ R V A) (hφ : φ Y = 0) : Y = 0
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hA : Nonempty (Unit ≃ A)
  · obtain ⟨e₀⟩ := hA
    haveI : Unique (Unit ≃ A) := @uniqueOfSubsingleton _ ⟨fun e₁ e₂ => Equiv.ext fun u => by
      have hA : ∀ a a' : A, a = a' := fun a a' => by
        rw [← e₀.apply_symm_apply a, ← e₀.apply_symm_apply a']
      exact hA _ _⟩ e₀
    rw [unitsΩ, Set.range_unique] at hY
    obtain ⟨a, rfl⟩ := Submodule.mem_span_singleton.1 hY
    exact (congrArg (· • GrOperad.map (R := R) (default : Unit ≃ A)
      (GrOperad.one (R := R) (P := CobarGr R 𝒞)))
        (h default a ((map_smul φ a _).symm.trans hφ))).trans (zero_smul R _)
  · have hb : Set.range (fun e : Unit ≃ A =>
        GrOperad.map (R := R) e (GrOperad.one (R := R) (P := CobarGr R 𝒞))) = ∅ :=
      Set.range_eq_empty_iff.2 (not_nonempty_iff.1 hA)
    rw [unitsΩ, hb, Submodule.span_empty, Submodule.mem_bot] at hY
    exact hY

name: Operad.Sym.feed_self
statement: @[simp] lemma feed_self (i : A) (v : Without A i ⊕ B → V) (w : V) : feed i v w i = w
proof:
:=
  dif_pos rfl

name: Operad.Sym.feed_of_ne
statement:
lemma feed_of_ne {i a : A} (h : a ≠ i) (v : Without A i ⊕ B → V) (w : V) :
    feed i v w a = v (Sum.inl ⟨a, h⟩)
proof:
:=
  dif_neg h

name: Operad.Sym.feed_val
statement:
@[simp] lemma feed_val (i : A) (v : Without A i ⊕ B → V) (w : V) (a : Without A i) :
    feed i v w a.1 = v (Sum.inl a)
proof:
:=
  dif_neg a.2

name: Operad.Sym.feed_eq_update
statement:
lemma feed_eq_update [Zero V] (i : A) (v : Without A i ⊕ B → V) (w : V) :
    feed i v w = Function.update (feed i v 0) i w
proof:
:= by
  funext a
  by_cases h : a = i
  · subst h
    simp
  · rw [Function.update_of_ne h, feed_of_ne h, feed_of_ne h]

name: Operad.Sym.feed_update_inl
statement:
lemma feed_update_inl (i : A) (v : Without A i ⊕ B → V) (w : V) (a : Without A i) (z : V) :
    feed i (Function.update v (Sum.inl a) z) w = Function.update (feed i v w) a.1 z
proof:
:= by
  funext c
  by_cases h : c = i
  · subst h
    rw [feed_self, Function.update_of_ne (Ne.symm a.2), feed_self]
  · rw [feed_of_ne h]
    by_cases hc : c = a.1
    · subst hc
      simp
    · rw [Function.update_of_ne (fun e => hc (congrArg Subtype.val (Sum.inl_injective e))),
        Function.update_of_ne hc, feed_of_ne h]

name: Operad.Sym.feed_update_inr
statement:
lemma feed_update_inr (i : A) (v : Without A i ⊕ B → V) (w : V) (b : B) (z : V) :
    feed i (Function.update v (Sum.inr b) z) w = feed i v w
proof:
:= by
  funext c
  by_cases h : c = i
  · subst h
    simp
  · rw [feed_of_ne h, feed_of_ne h, Function.update_of_ne Sum.inl_ne_inr]

name: Operad.Sym.inr_update_inl
statement:
private lemma inr_update_inl {i : A} (v : Without A i ⊕ B → V) (a : Without A i) (z : V) :
    (fun b => Function.update v (Sum.inl a) z (Sum.inr b)) = fun b => v (Sum.inr b)
proof:
:=
  funext fun _ => Function.update_of_ne Sum.inr_ne_inl _ _

name: Operad.Sym.inr_update_inr
proof:
:=
  Function.update_comp_eq_of_injective v Sum.inr_injective b z

name: Operad.Sym.EndOp.compML_apply
statement:
@[simp] lemma EndOp.compML_apply (i : A) (f : EndOp R V A) (g : EndOp R V B)
    (v : Without A i ⊕ B → V) :
    EndOp.compML R V i f g v = f (feed i v (g fun b => v (Sum.inr b)))
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.Sym.EndOp.mapL_apply
statement:
@[simp] lemma EndOp.mapL_apply (e : A ≃ A') (f : EndOp R V A) (v : A' → V) :
    EndOp.mapL R V e f v = f fun a => v (e a)
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.Sym.EndOp.one_apply
statement: @[simp] lemma EndOp.one_apply (v : Unit → V) : EndOp.one R V v = v ()
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.Sym.SymAlgebra.act_comp
statement:
lemma SymAlgebra.act_comp (α : SymAlgebra R P V) (i : A) (x : P A) (y : P B)
    (v : Without A i ⊕ B → V) :
    α.act (SymOperad.comp (R := R) i x y) v
      = α.act x (feed i v (α.act y fun b => v (Sum.inr b)))
proof:
:= by
  unfold SymAlgebra.act
  rw [α.app_comp]
  rfl

name: Operad.Sym.SymAlgebra.act_map
statement:
lemma SymAlgebra.act_map (α : SymAlgebra R P V) (e : A ≃ A') (x : P A) (v : A' → V) :
    α.act (SymOperad.map (R := R) e x) v = α.act x fun a => v (e a)
proof:
:= by
  unfold SymAlgebra.act
  rw [α.app_map]
  rfl

name: Operad.Sym.SymAlgebra.act_one
statement:
lemma SymAlgebra.act_one (α : SymAlgebra R P V) (v : Unit → V) :
    α.act (SymOperad.one R) v = v ()
proof:
:= by
  unfold SymAlgebra.act
  rw [α.app_one]
  rfl

name: Operad.FreeGr.ιP_pt
statement:
lemma ιP_pt {n : ℕ} (t : TreeOfArity T n) :
    ιP gp R n (pt t) = SgnLin.bas (treeSgn gp) R (Reg.std t)
proof:
:=
  (Finsupp.linearCombination_single R _ _).trans (one_smul R _)

name: Operad.FreeGr.std_injective
statement: lemma std_injective {n : ℕ} : Function.Injective (Reg.std : TreeOfArity T n → _)
proof:
:= by
  intro s t h
  have h2 := congrArg (fun x : Reg (TreeOfArity T) (Fin n) => x.2.1) h
  simp only [Reg.std] at h2
  exact eq_of_heq (Sigma.mk.inj h2).2

name: Operad.FreeGr.ιP_apply
statement:
lemma ιP_apply {n : ℕ} (x : Pl (T := T) R n) :
    (ιP gp R n x : Reg (TreeOfArity T) (Fin n) →₀ R) = Finsupp.mapDomain Reg.std x
proof:
:= by
  induction x using Finsupp.induction_linear with
  | zero => rw [map_zero, Finsupp.mapDomain_zero]; rfl
  | add x y hx hy => rw [map_add, Finsupp.mapDomain_add, ← hx, ← hy]; rfl
  | single t c =>
    rw [Finsupp.mapDomain_single, ← Finsupp.smul_single_one t c, map_smul]
    show c • ιP gp R n (pt t) = _
    rw [ιP_pt]
    exact Finsupp.smul_single_one _ c

name: Operad.FreeGr.ιP_injective
statement: lemma ιP_injective {n : ℕ} : Function.Injective (ιP gp R n)
proof:
:= by
  intro x y h
  have h' : Finsupp.mapDomain Reg.std x = Finsupp.mapDomain Reg.std y := by
    rw [← ιP_apply, ← ιP_apply]
    exact congrArg (fun z : FreeGr R gp (Fin n) => (z : Reg (TreeOfArity T) (Fin n) →₀ R)) h
  exact Finsupp.mapDomain_injective std_injective h'

name: Operad.FreeGr.map_toRank
statement:
lemma map_toRank {X : Type} [Fintype X] [DecidableEq X] (L : LinOrd X) {m : ℕ}
    (h : Fintype.card X = m) : LinOrd.map (L.toRank.trans (finCongr h)) L = LinOrd.std m
proof:
:= by
  ext a b
  simp only [LinOrd.map_lt, LinOrd.std_lt, Fin.lt_def]
  rw [L.lt_iff_rank_lt, ← LinOrd.toRank_apply, ← LinOrd.toRank_apply]
  simp

name: Operad.FreeGr.map_posEquiv_comp
statement:
lemma map_posEquiv_comp {n a l m : ℕ} (h : a < n ∧ m + 1 = n + l) :
    LinOrd.map (posEquiv n a l m h)
      (LinOrd.comp (⟨a, h.1⟩ : Fin n) (LinOrd.std n) (LinOrd.std l)) = LinOrd.std m
proof:
:=
  map_toRank _ _

name: Operad.FreeGr.contrT_val
statement:
@[simp] lemma contrT_val {n : ℕ} (t : TreeOfArity T n) (k : ℕ) :
    (contrT μ t k).1 = t.1.contr μ k
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.FreeGr.graftT_val
statement:
@[simp] lemma graftT_val {n l m : ℕ} (s : TreeOfArity T n) (a : ℕ) (u : TreeOfArity T l)
    (h : a < n ∧ m + 1 = n + l) : (graftT s a u h).1 = s.1.graft a u.1
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.FreeGr.mgraftT_val
statement:
@[simp] lemma mgraftT_val {n l m : ℕ} (s : TreeOfArity T n) (a : ℕ) (u : TreeOfArity T l)
    (h : a < n ∧ m + 1 = n + l) : (mgraftT μ s a u h).1 = s.1.mgraft μ a u.1
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.FreeGr.twF_pt
statement:
lemma twF_pt {n : ℕ} (t : TreeOfArity T n) :
    twF gp R n (pt t) = σ R (Tree.tpar gp t.1) • pt t
proof:
:=
  (Finsupp.linearCombination_single R _ _).trans (one_smul R _)

name: Operad.FreeGr.dF_pt
statement:
lemma dF_pt {n : ℕ} (t : TreeOfArity T n) :
    dF μ gp R n (pt t)
      = ∑ k ∈ Finset.Ico 1 t.1.weight, σ R (Tree.contrSgn gp t.1 k) • pt (contrT μ t k)
proof:
:=
  (Finsupp.linearCombination_single R _ _).trans (one_smul R _)

name: Operad.FreeGr.gF_pt
statement:
lemma gF_pt (a : ℕ) {n l m : ℕ} (s : TreeOfArity T n) (u : TreeOfArity T l) :
    gF gp R a m (pt s) (pt u)
      = if h : a < n ∧ m + 1 = n + l then
          σ R (Tree.tpar gp u.1 && Tree.apar gp s.1 a) • pt (graftT s a u h) else 0
proof:
:= by
  unfold gF
  exact (LinearMap.congr_fun
    ((Finsupp.linearCombination_single R (1 : R) s).trans (one_smul R _)) _).trans
      ((Finsupp.linearCombination_single R (1 : R) u).trans (one_smul R _))

name: Operad.FreeGr.mF_pt
statement:
lemma mF_pt (a : ℕ) {n l m : ℕ} (s : TreeOfArity T n) (u : TreeOfArity T l) :
    mF μ gp R a m (pt s) (pt u)
      = if h : a < n ∧ m + 1 = n + l then
          (if s.1.isLeaf = false ∧ u.1.isLeaf = false then
            σ R (Tree.mSgn gp s.1 a u.1) • pt (mgraftT μ s a u h) else 0) else 0
proof:
:= by
  unfold mF
  exact (LinearMap.congr_fun
    ((Finsupp.linearCombination_single R (1 : R) s).trans (one_smul R _)) _).trans
      ((Finsupp.linearCombination_single R (1 : R) u).trans (one_smul R _))

name: Operad.FreeGr.gF_pt_of
statement:
lemma gF_pt_of {a n l m : ℕ} (h : a < n ∧ m + 1 = n + l) (s : TreeOfArity T n)
    (u : TreeOfArity T l) :
    gF gp R a m (pt s) (pt u)
      = σ R (Tree.tpar gp u.1 && Tree.apar gp s.1 a) • pt (graftT s a u h)
proof:
:=
  (gF_pt a s u).trans (dif_pos h)

name: Operad.FreeGr.mF_pt_of
proof:
:= by
  rw [mF_pt, dif_pos h, if_pos ⟨hs, hu⟩]

name: Operad.FreeGr.mF_pt_leaf_right
statement:
lemma mF_pt_leaf_right (a : ℕ) {n l m : ℕ} (s : TreeOfArity T n) {u : TreeOfArity T l}
    (hu : u.1.isLeaf = true) : mF μ gp R a m (pt s) (pt u) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [mF_pt]
  split_ifs with h1 h2
  · exact absurd h2.2 (by rw [hu]; decide)
  · rfl
  · rfl

name: Operad.FreeGr.mF_pt_leaf_left
statement:
lemma mF_pt_leaf_left (a : ℕ) {n l m : ℕ} {s : TreeOfArity T n} (hs : s.1.isLeaf = true)
    (u : TreeOfArity T l) : mF μ gp R a m (pt s) (pt u) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [mF_pt]
  split_ifs with h1 h2
  · exact absurd h2.1 (by rw [hs]; decide)
  · rfl
  · rfl

name: Operad.FreeGr.gF_of_not
statement:
lemma gF_of_not {a n l m : ℕ} (h : ¬ (a < n ∧ m + 1 = n + l)) (x : Pl (T := T) R n)
    (y : Pl (T := T) R l) : gF gp R a m x y = 0
proof:
:= by
  have : gF gp R a m (n := n) (l := l) = 0 :=
    Finsupp.lhom_ext' fun s => LinearMap.ext_ring
      (Finsupp.lhom_ext' fun u => LinearMap.ext_ring ((gF_pt a s u).trans (dif_neg h)))
  rw [this, LinearMap.zero_apply, LinearMap.zero_apply]

name: Operad.FreeGr.mF_of_not
statement:
lemma mF_of_not {a n l m : ℕ} (h : ¬ (a < n ∧ m + 1 = n + l)) (x : Pl (T := T) R n)
    (y : Pl (T := T) R l) : mF μ gp R a m x y = 0
proof:
:= by
  have : mF μ gp R a m (n := n) (l := l) = 0 :=
    Finsupp.lhom_ext' fun s => LinearMap.ext_ring
      (Finsupp.lhom_ext' fun u => LinearMap.ext_ring ((mF_pt a s u).trans (dif_neg h)))
  rw [this, LinearMap.zero_apply, LinearMap.zero_apply]

name: Operad.FreeGr.map_posEquiv_std_comp
statement:
lemma map_posEquiv_std_comp {a n l m : ℕ} (h : a < n ∧ m + 1 = n + l) (s : TreeOfArity T n)
    (u : TreeOfArity T l) :
    SetOperad.map (posEquiv n a l m h) (SetOperad.comp (⟨a, h.1⟩ : Fin n) (Reg.std s) (Reg.std u))
      = Reg.std (graftT s a u h)
proof:
:= by
  refine reg_ext (map_posEquiv_comp h) ?_
  rw [treeOf_map, treeOf_comp]
  show s.1.graft ((LinOrd.std n).rank ⟨a, h.1⟩) u.1 = s.1.graft a u.1
  rw [LinOrd.rank_std]

name: Operad.FreeGr.map_posEquiv_std_mcomp
statement:
lemma map_posEquiv_std_mcomp {a n l m : ℕ} (h : a < n ∧ m + 1 = n + l) (s : TreeOfArity T n)
    (u : TreeOfArity T l) :
    SetOperad.map (posEquiv n a l m h) (mcompR μ (⟨a, h.1⟩ : Fin n) (Reg.std s) (Reg.std u))
      = Reg.std (mgraftT μ s a u h)
proof:
:= by
  refine reg_ext (map_posEquiv_comp h) ?_
  rw [treeOf_map, treeOf_mcompR]
  show s.1.mgraft μ ((LinOrd.std n).rank ⟨a, h.1⟩) u.1 = s.1.mgraft μ a u.1
  rw [LinOrd.rank_std]

name: Operad.FreeGr.contrR_std
statement:
lemma contrR_std {n : ℕ} (t : TreeOfArity T n) (k : ℕ) :
    contrR μ (Reg.std t) k = Reg.std (contrT μ t k)
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.FreeGr.ιP_twF
statement:
lemma ιP_twF {n : ℕ} (x : Pl (T := T) R n) :
    ιP gp R n (twF gp R n x) = GrSpecies.tw (R := R) (V := FreeGr R gp) true (ιP gp R n x)
proof:
:= by
  have h := Lin.induction₁ (S := fun _ _ _ => TreeOfArity T n) (A := Unit)
    (ιP gp R n ∘ₗ twF gp R n) (GrSpecies.tw (R := R) (V := FreeGr R gp) true ∘ₗ ιP gp R n)
    (fun t => ?_) x
  · simpa using h
  show ιP gp R n (twF gp R n (pt t)) = GrSpecies.tw (R := R) (V := FreeGr R gp) true
    (ιP gp R n (pt t))
  rw [twF_pt, map_smul, ιP_pt, tw_bas]
  rfl

name: Operad.FreeGr.ιP_dF
statement:
lemma ιP_dF {n : ℕ} (x : Pl (T := T) R n) :
    ιP gp R n (dF μ gp R n x) = barD μ gp R (Fin n) (ιP gp R n x)
proof:
:= by
  have h := Lin.induction₁ (S := fun _ _ _ => TreeOfArity T n) (A := Unit)
    (ιP gp R n ∘ₗ dF μ gp R n) (barD μ gp R (Fin n) ∘ₗ ιP gp R n) (fun t => ?_) x
  · simpa using h
  show ιP gp R n (dF μ gp R n (pt t)) = barD μ gp R (Fin n) (ιP gp R n (pt t))
  rw [dF_pt, map_sum, ιP_pt, barD_bas]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun k _ => ?_
  rw [map_smul, ιP_pt, contrR_std]
  rfl

name: Operad.FreeGr.ιP_gF
statement:
lemma ιP_gF {a n l m : ℕ} (h : a < n ∧ m + 1 = n + l) (x : Pl (T := T) R n)
    (y : Pl (T := T) R l) :
    ιP gp R m (gF gp R a m x y) = GrOperad.map (R := R) (posEquiv n a l m h)
      (GrOperad.comp (R := R) (⟨a, h.1⟩ : Fin n) (ιP gp R n x) (ιP gp R l y))
proof:
:= by
  have key : (gF gp R a m (n := n) (l := l)).compr₂ (ιP gp R m)
      = ((GrOperad.comp (R := R) (P := FreeGr R gp) (B := Fin l) (⟨a, h.1⟩ : Fin n)).compr₂
          (GrOperad.map (R := R) (posEquiv n a l m h))).compl₁₂ (ιP gp R n) (ιP gp R l) := by
    refine Finsupp.lhom_ext' fun s => LinearMap.ext_ring
      (Finsupp.lhom_ext' fun u => LinearMap.ext_ring ?_)
    show ιP gp R m (gF gp R a m (pt s) (pt u)) = GrOperad.map (R := R) (posEquiv n a l m h)
      (GrOperad.comp (R := R) (⟨a, h.1⟩ : Fin n) (ιP gp R n (pt s)) (ιP gp R l (pt u)))
    rw [gF_pt_of h, map_smul, ιP_pt, ιP_pt, ιP_pt, comp_bas_eq, map_smul, SgnLin.map_bas,
      map_posEquiv_std_comp]
    congr 1
    show σ R (Tree.tpar gp u.1 && Tree.apar gp s.1 a)
      = σ R (Tree.tpar gp u.1 && Tree.apar gp s.1 ((LinOrd.std n).rank ⟨a, h.1⟩))
    rw [LinOrd.rank_std]
  exact LinearMap.congr_fun (LinearMap.congr_fun key x) y

name: Operad.FreeGr.ιP_mF
statement:
lemma ιP_mF {a n l m : ℕ} (h : a < n ∧ m + 1 = n + l) (x : Pl (T := T) R n)
    (y : Pl (T := T) R l) :
    ιP gp R m (mF μ gp R a m x y) = GrOperad.map (R := R) (posEquiv n a l m h)
      (mcomp μ gp R (⟨a, h.1⟩ : Fin n) (ιP gp R n x) (ιP gp R l y))
proof:
:= by
  have key : (mF μ gp R a m (n := n) (l := l)).compr₂ (ιP gp R m)
      = ((mcomp μ gp R (B := Fin l) (⟨a, h.1⟩ : Fin n)).compr₂
          (GrOperad.map (R := R) (posEquiv n a l m h))).compl₁₂ (ιP gp R n) (ιP gp R l) := by
    refine Finsupp.lhom_ext' fun s => LinearMap.ext_ring
      (Finsupp.lhom_ext' fun u => LinearMap.ext_ring ?_)
    show ιP gp R m (mF μ gp R a m (pt s) (pt u)) = GrOperad.map (R := R) (posEquiv n a l m h)
      (mcomp μ gp R (⟨a, h.1⟩ : Fin n) (ιP gp R n (pt s)) (ιP gp R l (pt u)))
    rw [mF_pt, dif_pos h, ιP_pt, ιP_pt, mcomp_bas]
    have hrank : (LinOrd.std n).rank (⟨a, h.1⟩ : Fin n) = a := LinOrd.rank_std n _
    split_ifs with h1 h2 h2
    · rw [map_smul, ιP_pt, map_smul, SgnLin.map_bas, map_posEquiv_std_mcomp]
      congr 1
      show σ R (Tree.mSgn gp s.1 a u.1) = σ R (Tree.mSgn gp s.1 ((LinOrd.std n).rank ⟨a, h.1⟩) u.1)
      rw [hrank]
    · exact absurd h1 h2
    · exact absurd h2 h1
    · rw [map_zero, map_zero]
  exact LinearMap.congr_fun (LinearMap.congr_fun key x) y

name: Operad.FreeGr.dF_gF
statement:
theorem dF_gF (hμ : MergeFn.Odd gp μ) (a : ℕ) {n l : ℕ} (m : ℕ) (x : Pl (T := T) R n)
    (y : Pl (T := T) R l) :
    dF μ gp R m (gF gp R a m x y)
      = gF gp R a m (dF μ gp R n x) y + gF gp R a m (twF gp R n x) (dF μ gp R l y)
        + mF μ gp R a m x y
proof:
:= by
  by_cases h : a < n ∧ m + 1 = n + l
  · apply ιP_injective (gp := gp)
    rw [ιP_dF, ιP_gF h, ← map_barD, barD_comp hμ, map_add, map_add, map_add, map_add, ιP_gF h,
      ιP_gF h, ιP_mF h, ιP_dF, ιP_dF, ιP_twF]
  · rw [gF_of_not h, gF_of_not h, gF_of_not h, mF_of_not h, map_zero, add_zero, add_zero]

name: Operad.FreeGr.isLeaf_of_lt
statement: lemma isLeaf_of_lt {n : ℕ} (s : TreeOfArity T n) (h : 1 < n) : s.1.isLeaf = false
proof:
:= by
  by_contra h'
  have hl : s.1.isLeaf = true := by simpa using h'
  have := s.2
  rw [Tree.eq_leaf_of_isLeaf hl, Tree.arity_leaf] at this
  omega

name: Operad.FreeGr.pt_eq
statement: lemma pt_eq {n : ℕ} {s t : TreeOfArity T n} (h : s.1 = t.1) : (pt s : Pl (T := T) R n) = pt t
proof:
:= by
  rw [Subtype.ext h]

name: Operad.FreeGr.mF_gF_after
statement:
theorem mF_gF_after {p q q' n lu lv m₁ m₂ m : ℕ} (hpq : p < q) (hq : q < n)
    (hq' : q' + 1 = q + lv) (h₁ : m₁ + 1 = n + lu) (h₂ : m₂ + 1 = n + lv) (hm : m + 1 = m₁ + lv)
    (x : Pl (T := T) R n) (u : TreeOfArity T lu) (v : TreeOfArity T lv) :
    mF μ gp R p m (gF gp R q m₁ x (pt u)) (pt v)
      = σ R (Tree.tpar gp u.1 && Tree.tpar gp v.1) •
          gF gp R q' m (mF μ gp R p m₂ x (pt v)) (pt u)
proof:
:= by
  induction x using Finsupp.induction_linear with
  | zero => simp
  | add x y hx hy => simp only [map_add, LinearMap.add_apply, hx, hy, smul_add]
  | single s c =>
    rw [← Finsupp.smul_single_one s c,
      show (Finsupp.single s (1 : R) : Pl (T := T) R n) = pt s from rfl]
    simp only [map_smul, LinearMap.smul_apply]
    rw [smul_comm]
    congr 1
    have hs := isLeaf_of_lt s (by omega)
    have ha : q < s.1.arity := by rw [s.2]; exact hq
    by_cases hv : v.1.isLeaf = true
    · rw [gF_pt_of ⟨hq, h₁⟩, map_smul, LinearMap.smul_apply, mF_pt_leaf_right _ _ hv,
        mF_pt_leaf_right _ _ hv, map_zero, LinearMap.zero_apply, smul_zero, smul_zero]
    · have hv' : v.1.isLeaf = false := by simpa using hv
      have hG : (graftT s q u ⟨hq, h₁⟩).1.isLeaf = false := Tree.isLeaf_graft_left hs _ _
      have hM : q' < m₂ ∧ m + 1 = m₂ + lu := by omega
      rw [gF_pt_of ⟨hq, h₁⟩, map_smul, LinearMap.smul_apply,
        mF_pt_of (μ := μ) ⟨by omega, hm⟩ hG hv', mF_pt_of (μ := μ) ⟨by omega, h₂⟩ hs hv',
        map_smul, LinearMap.smul_apply, gF_pt_of hM, smul_smul, smul_smul, smul_smul]
      have htree : (mgraftT μ (graftT s q u ⟨hq, h₁⟩) p v ⟨by omega, hm⟩).1
          = (graftT (mgraftT μ s p v ⟨by omega, h₂⟩) q' u hM).1 := by
        simp only [mgraftT_val, graftT_val]
        rw [Tree.graft_mgraft_after μ s.1 p v.1 q u.1 hpq ha, v.2]
        congr 1
        omega
      rw [pt_eq htree]
      congr 1
      simp only [graftT_val, mgraftT_val, ← σ_xor]
      congr 1
      have e := Tree.mSgn_graft_after μ gp (s := s.1) (b := u.1) (u := v.1) hpq ha
      rw [v.2, show q - 1 + lv = q' by omega] at e
      rw [e, Bool.xor_assoc]

name: Operad.FreeGr.mF_gF_before
statement:
theorem mF_gF_before (hμ : MergeFn.Odd gp μ) {p p' q n lu lv m₁ m₂ m : ℕ} (hqp : q < p)
    (hp : p < n) (hp' : p' + 1 = p + lu) (h₁ : m₁ + 1 = n + lu) (h₂ : m₂ + 1 = n + lv)
    (hm : m + 1 = m₁ + lv) (x : Pl (T := T) R n) (u : TreeOfArity T lu) (v : TreeOfArity T lv) :
    mF μ gp R p' m (gF gp R q m₁ x (pt u)) (pt v)
      = σ R (Tree.tpar gp u.1 && Tree.tpar gp v.1) •
          gF gp R q m (mF μ gp R p m₂ x (pt v)) (pt u)
proof:
:= by
  induction x using Finsupp.induction_linear with
  | zero => simp
  | add x y hx hy => simp only [map_add, LinearMap.add_apply, hx, hy, smul_add]
  | single s c =>
    rw [← Finsupp.smul_single_one s c,
      show (Finsupp.single s (1 : R) : Pl (T := T) R n) = pt s from rfl]
    simp only [map_smul, LinearMap.smul_apply]
    rw [smul_comm]
    congr 1
    have hs := isLeaf_of_lt s (by omega)
    have ha : p < s.1.arity := by rw [s.2]; exact hp
    by_cases hv : v.1.isLeaf = true
    · rw [gF_pt_of ⟨by omega, h₁⟩, map_smul, LinearMap.smul_apply, mF_pt_leaf_right _ _ hv,
        mF_pt_leaf_right _ _ hv, map_zero, LinearMap.zero_apply, smul_zero, smul_zero]
    · have hv' : v.1.isLeaf = false := by simpa using hv
      have hG : (graftT s q u ⟨by omega, h₁⟩).1.isLeaf = false := Tree.isLeaf_graft_left hs _ _
      have hM : q < m₂ ∧ m + 1 = m₂ + lu := by omega
      rw [gF_pt_of ⟨by omega, h₁⟩, map_smul, LinearMap.smul_apply,
        mF_pt_of (μ := μ) ⟨by omega, hm⟩ hG hv', mF_pt_of (μ := μ) ⟨hp, h₂⟩ hs hv',
        map_smul, LinearMap.smul_apply, gF_pt_of hM, smul_smul, smul_smul, smul_smul]
      have htree : (mgraftT μ (graftT s q u ⟨by omega, h₁⟩) p' v ⟨by omega, hm⟩).1
          = (graftT (mgraftT μ s p v ⟨hp, h₂⟩) q u hM).1 := by
        simp only [mgraftT_val, graftT_val]
        rw [← Tree.graft_mgraft_before μ s.1 q u.1 p v.1 hqp ha, u.2]
        congr 1
        omega
      rw [pt_eq htree]
      congr 1
      simp only [graftT_val, mgraftT_val, ← σ_xor]
      congr 1
      have e := Tree.mSgn_graft_before μ gp hμ (s := s.1) (b := u.1) (u := v.1) hqp ha hv'
      rw [u.2, show p - 1 + lu = p' by omega] at e
      rw [e, Bool.xor_assoc]

name: Operad.FreeGr.mF_gF_inner
statement:
theorem mF_gF_inner (hμ : MergeFn.Odd gp μ) {p q r n lu lv m₁ m₂ m : ℕ} (hq : q < n)
    (hr : r < lu) (hp : p = q + r) (h₁ : m₁ + 1 = n + lu) (h₂ : m₂ + 1 = lu + lv)
    (hm : m + 1 = m₁ + lv) (x : Pl (T := T) R n) {u : TreeOfArity T lu} (hu : u.1.isLeaf = false)
    (v : TreeOfArity T lv) :
    mF μ gp R p m (gF gp R q m₁ x (pt u)) (pt v)
      = gF gp R q m (twF gp R n x) (mF μ gp R r m₂ (pt u) (pt v))
proof:
:= by
  subst hp
  induction x using Finsupp.induction_linear with
  | zero => simp
  | add x y hx hy => simp only [map_add, LinearMap.add_apply, hx, hy]
  | single s c =>
    rw [← Finsupp.smul_single_one s c,
      show (Finsupp.single s (1 : R) : Pl (T := T) R n) = pt s from rfl]
    simp only [map_smul, LinearMap.smul_apply]
    congr 1
    have ha : q < s.1.arity := by rw [s.2]; exact hq
    by_cases hv : v.1.isLeaf = true
    · rw [gF_pt_of ⟨hq, h₁⟩, map_smul, LinearMap.smul_apply, mF_pt_leaf_right _ _ hv,
        mF_pt_leaf_right _ _ hv, map_zero, smul_zero]
    · have hv' : v.1.isLeaf = false := by simpa using hv
      have hG : (graftT s q u ⟨hq, h₁⟩).1.isLeaf = false := Tree.isLeaf_graft hu
      have hM : q < n ∧ m + 1 = n + m₂ := by omega
      rw [gF_pt_of ⟨hq, h₁⟩, map_smul, LinearMap.smul_apply,
        mF_pt_of (μ := μ) ⟨by omega, hm⟩ hG hv', mF_pt_of (μ := μ) ⟨hr, h₂⟩ hu hv', twF_pt,
        map_smul, map_smul, LinearMap.smul_apply, gF_pt_of hM, smul_smul, smul_smul, smul_smul]
      have htree : (mgraftT μ (graftT s q u ⟨hq, h₁⟩) (q + r) v ⟨by omega, hm⟩).1
          = (graftT s q (mgraftT μ u r v ⟨hr, h₂⟩) hM).1 := by
        simp only [mgraftT_val, graftT_val]
        exact Tree.mgraft_graft_inner μ s.1 q u.1 r v.1 ha (by rw [u.2]; exact hr) hu
      rw [pt_eq htree]
      congr 1
      simp only [graftT_val, mgraftT_val, ← σ_xor]
      congr 1
      rw [Tree.mSgn_graft_inner μ gp hμ ha (by rw [u.2]; exact hr) hu hv']
      cases Tree.tpar gp s.1 <;> cases Tree.mSgn gp u.1 r v.1 <;>
        cases Tree.tpar gp (Tree.mgraft μ u.1 r v.1) && Tree.apar gp s.1 q <;> rfl

name: Operad.FreeGr.mF_corolla
statement:
theorem mF_corolla {a k l m : ℕ} (h : a < k ∧ m + 1 = k + l) (g : T k) (c : T l) :
    mF μ gp R a m (pt (corolla g)) (pt (corolla c)) = pt (corolla (μ k l g a c m))
proof:
:= by
  rw [mF_pt_of (μ := μ) h rfl rfl]
  have hs : Tree.mSgn gp (corolla g).1 a (corolla c).1 = false := mSgn_corolla gp g c h.1
  rw [hs, σ_false, one_smul]
  refine pt_eq ?_
  show (Tree.node g (TreeOfArity.leaves k)).mgraft μ a (Tree.node c (TreeOfArity.leaves l))
    = Tree.node (μ k l g a c m) (TreeOfArity.leaves m)
  rw [corolla_mgraft μ g c h.1]
  have : Forest.spliceLen k a l = m := by have := spliceLen_eq (k := k) (j := a) l h.1; omega
  rw [this]

name: Operad.FreeGr.dF_corolla
statement: lemma dF_corolla {k : ℕ} (g : T k) : dF μ gp R k (pt (corolla g)) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [dF_pt]
  have : (corolla g).1.weight = 1 := by
    show (Tree.node g (TreeOfArity.leaves k)).weight = 1
    rw [Tree.weight_node, weightF_leaves]
  rw [this, Finset.Ico_self, Finset.sum_empty]

name: Operad.FreeGr.twF_twF
statement: lemma twF_twF {n : ℕ} (x : Pl (T := T) R n) : twF gp R n (twF gp R n x) = x
proof:
:= by
  induction x using Finsupp.induction_linear with
  | zero => simp
  | add x y hx hy => rw [map_add, map_add, hx, hy]
  | single s c =>
    rw [← Finsupp.smul_single_one s c,
      show (Finsupp.single s (1 : R) : Pl (T := T) R n) = pt s from rfl, map_smul, map_smul,
      twF_pt, map_smul, twF_pt, smul_smul, smul_smul, mul_assoc, σ_mul_self, mul_one]

name: Operad.FreeGr.dF_twF
statement:
lemma dF_twF (hμ : MergeFn.Odd gp μ) {n : ℕ} (x : Pl (T := T) R n) :
    dF μ gp R n (twF gp R n x) = -twF gp R n (dF μ gp R n x)
proof:
:= by
  induction x using Finsupp.induction_linear with
  | zero => simp
  | add x y hx hy => rw [map_add, map_add, hx, hy, map_add, map_add, neg_add]
  | single s c =>
    rw [← Finsupp.smul_single_one s c,
      show (Finsupp.single s (1 : R) : Pl (T := T) R n) = pt s from rfl, map_smul, map_smul,
      map_smul, map_smul, ← smul_neg]
    congr 1
    rw [twF_pt, map_smul, dF_pt, map_sum, Finset.smul_sum, ← Finset.sum_neg_distrib]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun k hk => ?_
    rw [Finset.mem_Ico] at hk
    rw [map_smul, twF_pt, contrT_val, Tree.tpar_contr μ gp hμ hk.1 hk.2, smul_smul, smul_smul,
      ← neg_smul]
    congr 1
    cases Tree.tpar gp s.1 <;> simp [mul_comm]

name: Operad.FreeGr.twF_mF_pt
statement:
lemma twF_mF_pt (hμ : MergeFn.Odd gp μ) (a : ℕ) {n l m : ℕ} (s : TreeOfArity T n)
    (u : TreeOfArity T l) :
    twF gp R m (mF μ gp R a m (pt s) (pt u))
      = -(σ R (Tree.tpar gp s.1) * σ R (Tree.tpar gp u.1)) • mF μ gp R a m (pt s) (pt u)
proof:
:= by
  rw [mF_pt]
  split_ifs with h1 h2
  · rw [map_smul, twF_pt, mgraftT_val, Tree.tpar_mgraft μ gp hμ _ _ _
      (by rw [s.2]; exact h1.1) h2.1 h2.2, smul_smul, smul_smul]
    congr 1
    cases Tree.tpar gp s.1 <;> cases Tree.tpar gp u.1 <;> simp
  · simp
  · simp

name: Operad.FreeGr.twF_mF
statement:
lemma twF_mF (hμ : MergeFn.Odd gp μ) (a : ℕ) {n l m : ℕ} (x : Pl (T := T) R n)
    (y : Pl (T := T) R l) :
    twF gp R m (mF μ gp R a m x y) = -mF μ gp R a m (twF gp R n x) (twF gp R l y)
proof:
:= by
  induction x using Finsupp.induction_linear with
  | zero => simp
  | add x x' hx hx' => simp only [map_add, LinearMap.add_apply, hx, hx', neg_add]
  | single s c =>
    induction y using Finsupp.induction_linear with
    | zero => simp
    | add y y' hy hy' => simp only [map_add, hy, hy', neg_add]
    | single u d =>
      rw [← Finsupp.smul_single_one s c, ← Finsupp.smul_single_one u d,
        show (Finsupp.single s (1 : R) : Pl (T := T) R n) = pt s from rfl,
        show (Finsupp.single u (1 : R) : Pl (T := T) R l) = pt u from rfl]
      simp only [map_smul, LinearMap.smul_apply, twF_pt]
      rw [twF_mF_pt hμ]
      module

name: Operad.FreeGr.twF_gF
statement:
lemma twF_gF (a : ℕ) {n l m : ℕ} (x : Pl (T := T) R n) (y : Pl (T := T) R l) :
    twF gp R m (gF gp R a m x y) = gF gp R a m (twF gp R n x) (twF gp R l y)
proof:
:= by
  induction x using Finsupp.induction_linear with
  | zero => simp
  | add x x' hx hx' => simp only [map_add, LinearMap.add_apply, hx, hx']
  | single s c =>
    induction y using Finsupp.induction_linear with
    | zero => simp
    | add y y' hy hy' => simp only [map_add, hy, hy']
    | single u d =>
      rw [← Finsupp.smul_single_one s c, ← Finsupp.smul_single_one u d,
        show (Finsupp.single s (1 : R) : Pl (T := T) R n) = pt s from rfl,
        show (Finsupp.single u (1 : R) : Pl (T := T) R l) = pt u from rfl]
      simp only [map_smul, LinearMap.smul_apply, twF_pt]
      rw [gF_pt]
      split_ifs with h
      · rw [map_smul, twF_pt, graftT_val, Tree.tpar_graft gp _ _ _ (by rw [s.2]; exact h.1),
          σ_xor]
        module
      · simp

name: Operad.FreeGr.eq_leaves_of_weightF
statement:
lemma eq_leaves_of_weightF : ∀ {k : ℕ} (f : Forest T k), f.weightF = 0 →
    f = TreeOfArity.leaves k
  | 0, .nil, _ => rfl
  | _, .cons t f, h => by
    simp only [Tree.weightF_cons] at h
    have ht : t.weight = 0
proof:
:= by omega
    have hf := eq_leaves_of_weightF f (by omega)
    cases t with
    | leaf =>
      rw [hf]
      rfl
    | node e g => simp at ht

name: Operad.FreeGr.eq_corolla_of_weight
statement:
lemma eq_corolla_of_weight {t : Tree T} (h : t.weight = 1) :
    ∃ (k : ℕ) (g : T k), t = Tree.node g (TreeOfArity.leaves k)
proof:
:= by
  cases t with
  | leaf => simp at h
  | node g f =>
    simp only [Tree.weight_node] at h
    exact ⟨_, g, by rw [eq_leaves_of_weightF f (by omega)]⟩

name: Operad.FreeGr.exists_graft_corolla
statement:
lemma exists_graft_corolla {t : Tree T} (h : 2 ≤ t.weight) :
    ∃ (s : Tree T) (p k : ℕ) (g : T k), p < s.arity ∧ s.weight + 1 = t.weight ∧
      t = s.graft p (Tree.node g (TreeOfArity.leaves k))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨h1, h2, h3, h4⟩ := Tree.cutV_spec (t := t) (k := t.weight - 1) (by omega) rfl
  set s := (t.cutV (t.weight - 1)).1
  set u := (t.cutV (t.weight - 1)).2.1
  set p := (t.cutV (t.weight - 1)).2.2
  have hw := Tree.weight_graft s p u h2
  rw [h1] at hw
  have hv := Tree.vb_le_weight s p
  have hu := Tree.weight_pos h4
  obtain ⟨k, g, hg⟩ := eq_corolla_of_weight (t := u) (by omega)
  exact ⟨s, p, k, g, h2, by omega, by rw [← hg, h1]⟩

name: Operad.FreeGr.gF_mem_left
statement:
lemma gF_mem_left {a n l m : ℕ} {x : Pl (T := T) R n} (hx : x ∈ JF J n) (y : Pl (T := T) R l) :
    gF gp R a m x y ∈ JF J m
proof:
:= by
  by_cases h : a < n ∧ m + 1 = n + l
  · show ιP gp R m (gF gp R a m x y) ∈ J.sub (Fin m)
    rw [ιP_gF h]
    exact J.map_mem _ (J.comp_mem_left _ _ hx)
  · rw [gF_of_not h]
    exact zero_mem _

name: Operad.FreeGr.gF_mem_right
statement:
lemma gF_mem_right {a n l m : ℕ} (x : Pl (T := T) R n) {y : Pl (T := T) R l} (hy : y ∈ JF J l) :
    gF gp R a m x y ∈ JF J m
proof:
:= by
  by_cases h : a < n ∧ m + 1 = n + l
  · show ιP gp R m (gF gp R a m x y) ∈ J.sub (Fin m)
    rw [ιP_gF h]
    exact J.map_mem _ (J.comp_mem_right _ _ hy)
  · rw [gF_of_not h]
    exact zero_mem _

name: Operad.FreeGr.ιP_corolla
statement:
lemma ιP_corolla {k : ℕ} (g : T k) :
    ιP gp R k (pt (corolla g)) = gen (R := R) (gp := gp) g
proof: := ιP_pt _

name: Operad.FreeGr.SF_smul
statement:
lemma SF_smul (p j m₁ m₂ m : ℕ) {n lg lh : ℕ} (c : R) (x : Pl (T := T) R n)
    (g : TreeOfArity T lg) (h : TreeOfArity T lh) :
    SF μ gp R p j m₁ m₂ m (c • x) g h = c • SF μ gp R p j m₁ m₂ m x g h
proof:
:= by
  simp only [SF, map_smul, LinearMap.smul_apply, smul_add]

name: Operad.FreeGr.twF_gF_pt
statement:
lemma twF_gF_pt (a : ℕ) {n l m : ℕ} (x : Pl (T := T) R n) (c : TreeOfArity T l) :
    twF gp R m (gF gp R a m x (pt c))
      = σ R (Tree.tpar gp c.1) • gF gp R a m (twF gp R n x) (pt c)
proof:
:= by
  rw [twF_gF, twF_pt, map_smul]

name: Operad.FreeGr.tpar_corolla'
statement: lemma tpar_corolla' {k : ℕ} (g : T k) : Tree.tpar gp (corolla g).1 = gp k g
proof:
:=
  Tree.tpar_corolla gp g

name: Operad.FreeGr.isLeaf_corolla
statement: lemma isLeaf_corolla {k : ℕ} (g : T k) : (corolla g).1.isLeaf = false
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.FreeGr.σ_and_not_xor
statement:
lemma σ_and_not_xor (a b c : Bool) :
    σ R a * σ R (a && !(xor b c)) = σ R (a && xor b c)
proof:
:= by
  cases a <;> cases b <;> cases c <;> simp

name: Operad.FreeGr.σ_and_and
statement:
lemma σ_and_and (a b c : Bool) :
    σ R (a && b) * σ R (a && c) = σ R (a && xor b c)
proof:
:= by
  cases a <;> cases b <;> cases c <;> simp

name: Operad.FreeGr.SF_gF_after
statement:
theorem SF_gF_after (hμ : MergeFn.Odd gp μ) {p j r r' n n₁ lc lg lh m₁ m₂ m mA mB : ℕ}
    (hpr : p < r) (hr : r < n₁) (hn : n + 1 = n₁ + lc) (hj : j < lg) (hm₁ : m₁ + 1 = lg + lh)
    (hm₂ : m₂ + 1 = n + lg) (hm : m + 1 = n + m₁) (hr' : r' + 1 = r + m₁)
    (hmA : mA + 1 = n₁ + m₁) (hmB : mB + 1 = n₁ + lg) (X : Pl (T := T) R n₁) (c : T lc)
    (g : T lg) (h : T lh) :
    SF μ gp R p j m₁ m₂ m (gF gp R r n X (pt (corolla c))) (corolla g) (corolla h)
      = σ R (gp lc c && xor (gp lg g) (gp lh h)) •
          gF gp R r' m (SF μ gp R p j m₁ mB mA X (corolla g) (corolla h)) (pt (corolla c))
proof:
:= by
  have hY := mF_corolla (μ := μ) (gp := gp) (R := R) ⟨hj, hm₁⟩ g h
  obtain ⟨rB, hrB⟩ : ∃ rB, rB + 1 = r + lg := ⟨r + lg - 1, by omega⟩
  unfold SF
  rw [twF_gF_pt, hY, map_smul, LinearMap.smul_apply,
    mF_gF_after (μ := μ) hpr hr hr' hn hmA hm _ (corolla c) (corolla (μ lg lh g j h m₁)),
    mF_gF_after (μ := μ) hpr hr hrB hn hmB hm₂ X (corolla c) (corolla g), map_smul,
    LinearMap.smul_apply,
    mF_gF_after (μ := μ) (show p + j < rB by omega) (show rB < mB by omega)
      (show r' + 1 = rB + lh by omega) (show m₂ + 1 = mB + lc by omega)
      (show mA + 1 = mB + lh by omega) (show m + 1 = m₂ + lh by omega) _ (corolla c) (corolla h),
    map_add, LinearMap.add_apply, smul_add]
  simp only [tpar_corolla', hμ, smul_smul, σ_and_not_xor, σ_and_and]

name: Operad.FreeGr.SF_gF_inner
statement:
theorem SF_gF_inner (hμ : MergeFn.Odd gp μ) {p p' j r n n₁ lc lg lh m₁ m₂ m mD mE : ℕ}
    (hr : r < n₁) (hp : p = r + p') (hp' : p' < lc) (hn : n + 1 = n₁ + lc) (hj : j < lg)
    (hm₁ : m₁ + 1 = lg + lh) (hm₂ : m₂ + 1 = n + lg) (hm : m + 1 = n + m₁)
    (hmD : mD + 1 = lc + lg) (hmE : mE + 1 = lc + m₁) (X : Pl (T := T) R n₁) (c : T lc)
    (g : T lg) (h : T lh) :
    SF μ gp R p j m₁ m₂ m (gF gp R r n X (pt (corolla c))) (corolla g) (corolla h)
      = gF gp R r m X (SF μ gp R p' j m₁ mD mE (pt (corolla c)) (corolla g) (corolla h))
proof:
:= by
  have hY := mF_corolla (μ := μ) (gp := gp) (R := R) ⟨hj, hm₁⟩ g h
  have hW := mF_corolla (μ := μ) (gp := gp) (R := R) ⟨hp', hmD⟩ c g
  unfold SF
  rw [twF_gF_pt, hY, map_smul, LinearMap.smul_apply,
    mF_gF_inner (μ := μ) hμ hr hp' hp hn hmE hm _ (isLeaf_corolla c) (corolla (μ lg lh g j h m₁)),
    twF_twF, mF_gF_inner (μ := μ) hμ hr hp' hp hn hmD hm₂ X (isLeaf_corolla c) (corolla g), hW,
    mF_gF_inner (μ := μ) hμ hr (show p' + j < mD by omega) (show p + j = r + (p' + j) by omega)
      (show m₂ + 1 = n₁ + mD by omega) (show mE + 1 = mD + lh by omega)
      (show m + 1 = m₂ + lh by omega) _ (isLeaf_corolla _) (corolla h),
    twF_twF, twF_pt, map_smul, LinearMap.smul_apply, map_add, map_smul]

name: Operad.FreeGr.SF_gF_before
statement:
theorem SF_gF_before (hμ : MergeFn.Odd gp μ) {p p₁ j r n n₁ lc lg lh m₁ m₂ m mA mB : ℕ}
    (hrp : r < p₁) (hp₁ : p₁ < n₁) (hp : p + 1 = p₁ + lc) (hn : n + 1 = n₁ + lc) (hj : j < lg)
    (hm₁ : m₁ + 1 = lg + lh) (hm₂ : m₂ + 1 = n + lg) (hm : m + 1 = n + m₁)
    (hmA : mA + 1 = n₁ + m₁) (hmB : mB + 1 = n₁ + lg) (X : Pl (T := T) R n₁) (c : T lc)
    (g : T lg) (h : T lh) :
    SF μ gp R p j m₁ m₂ m (gF gp R r n X (pt (corolla c))) (corolla g) (corolla h)
      = σ R (gp lc c && xor (gp lg g) (gp lh h)) •
          gF gp R r m (SF μ gp R p₁ j m₁ mB mA X (corolla g) (corolla h)) (pt (corolla c))
