proof:
:= by
  have hY := mF_corolla (μ := μ) (gp := gp) (R := R) ⟨hj, hm₁⟩ g h
  unfold SF
  rw [twF_gF_pt, hY, map_smul, LinearMap.smul_apply,
    mF_gF_before (μ := μ) hμ hrp hp₁ hp hn hmA hm _ (corolla c) (corolla (μ lg lh g j h m₁)),
    mF_gF_before (μ := μ) hμ hrp hp₁ hp hn hmB hm₂ X (corolla c) (corolla g), map_smul,
    LinearMap.smul_apply,
    mF_gF_before (μ := μ) hμ (show r < p₁ + j by omega) (show p₁ + j < mB by omega)
      (show p + j + 1 = p₁ + j + lc by omega) (show m₂ + 1 = mB + lc by omega)
      (show mA + 1 = mB + lh by omega) (show m + 1 = m₂ + lh by omega) _ (corolla c) (corolla h),
    map_add, LinearMap.add_apply, smul_add]
  simp only [tpar_corolla', hμ, smul_smul, σ_and_not_xor, σ_and_and]

name: Operad.FreeGr.pt_eq_gF
statement:
lemma pt_eq_gF {n : ℕ} (s : TreeOfArity T n) (h2 : 2 ≤ s.1.weight) :
    ∃ (n₁ r lc : ℕ) (s₁ : TreeOfArity T n₁) (c : T lc), r < n₁ ∧ n + 1 = n₁ + lc ∧
      s₁.1.weight + 1 = s.1.weight ∧
      (pt s : Pl (T := T) R n) = σ R (gp lc c && Tree.apar gp s₁.1 r) •
        gF gp R r n (pt s₁) (pt (corolla c))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨s₁, r, lc, c, hr, hw, hs⟩ := exists_graft_corolla h2
  have hn : n + 1 = s₁.arity + lc := by
    have h1 := Tree.arity_graft s₁ r (Tree.node c (TreeOfArity.leaves lc)) hr
    rw [← hs, s.2, Tree.arity_node, arityF_leaves] at h1
    omega
  refine ⟨s₁.arity, r, lc, ⟨s₁, rfl⟩, c, hr, hn, hw, ?_⟩
  rw [gF_pt_of ⟨hr, hn⟩, smul_smul, ← tpar_corolla' (gp := gp) c, σ_mul_self, one_smul]
  exact pt_eq (by rw [graftT_val]; exact hs)

name: Operad.FreeGr.SF_mem
statement:
theorem SF_mem (hμ : MergeFn.Odd gp μ) (hA : AssocHyp μ gp R J) : ∀ (w n : ℕ)
    (s : TreeOfArity T n), s.1.weight ≤ w → ∀ {lg lh : ℕ} (g : T lg) (h : T lh)
    (p j m₁ m₂ m : ℕ), p < n → j < lg → m₁ + 1 = lg + lh → m₂ + 1 = n + lg → m + 1 = n + m₁ →
      SF μ gp R p j m₁ m₂ m (pt s) (corolla g) (corolla h) ∈ JF J m
proof:
:= by
  intro w
  induction w with
  | zero =>
    intro n s hw lg lh g h p j m₁ m₂ m hp hj hm₁ hm₂ hm
    have hl : s.1.isLeaf = true := by
      cases hs : s.1 with
      | leaf => rfl
      | node e f => rw [hs] at hw; simp at hw
    unfold SF
    rw [mF_corolla (μ := μ) ⟨hj, hm₁⟩, twF_pt, map_smul, LinearMap.smul_apply,
      mF_pt_leaf_left _ hl, mF_pt_leaf_left _ hl, map_zero, LinearMap.zero_apply, smul_zero,
      add_zero]
    exact zero_mem _
  | succ w ih =>
    intro n s hw lg lh g h p j m₁ m₂ m hp hj hm₁ hm₂ hm
    rcases Nat.lt_or_ge s.1.weight 2 with hw2 | hw2
    · by_cases hw0 : s.1.weight = 0
      · exact ih n s (by omega) g h p j m₁ m₂ m hp hj hm₁ hm₂ hm
      · 
        obtain ⟨k, x, hx⟩ := eq_corolla_of_weight (t := s.1) (by omega)
        have hk : k = n := by
          have := s.2
          rw [hx, Tree.arity_node, arityF_leaves] at this
          exact this
        subst hk
        have hs : s = corolla x := Subtype.ext hx
        subst hs
        unfold SF
        rw [mF_corolla (μ := μ) ⟨hj, hm₁⟩, twF_pt, map_smul, LinearMap.smul_apply,
          mF_corolla (μ := μ) ⟨hp, hm⟩, mF_corolla (μ := μ) ⟨hp, hm₂⟩,
          mF_corolla (μ := μ) ⟨by omega, by omega⟩, tpar_corolla']
        show ιP gp R m _ ∈ J.sub (Fin m)
        rw [map_add, map_smul, ιP_corolla, ιP_corolla]
        exact hA.series _ _ _ x g h p j m₁ m₂ m hp hj hm₁ hm₂ hm
    · obtain ⟨n₁, r, lc, s₁, c, hr, hn, hw₁, hs⟩ := pt_eq_gF (R := R) (gp := gp) s hw2
      rw [hs, SF_smul]
      refine Submodule.smul_mem _ _ ?_
      rcases Nat.lt_or_ge p r with hpr | hpr
      · obtain ⟨r', hr'⟩ : ∃ r', r' + 1 = r + m₁ := ⟨r + m₁ - 1, by omega⟩
        obtain ⟨mA, hmA⟩ : ∃ mA, mA + 1 = n₁ + m₁ := ⟨n₁ + m₁ - 1, by omega⟩
        obtain ⟨mB, hmB⟩ : ∃ mB, mB + 1 = n₁ + lg := ⟨n₁ + lg - 1, by omega⟩
        rw [SF_gF_after (μ := μ) hμ hpr hr hn hj hm₁ hm₂ hm hr' hmA hmB]
        exact Submodule.smul_mem _ _ (gF_mem_left
          (ih n₁ s₁ (by omega) g h p j m₁ mB mA (by omega) hj hm₁ hmB hmA) _)
      · rcases Nat.lt_or_ge p (r + lc) with hpc | hpc
        · obtain ⟨mD, hmD⟩ : ∃ mD, mD + 1 = lc + lg := ⟨lc + lg - 1, by omega⟩
          obtain ⟨mE, hmE⟩ : ∃ mE, mE + 1 = lc + m₁ := ⟨lc + m₁ - 1, by omega⟩
          rw [SF_gF_inner (μ := μ) hμ hr (show p = r + (p - r) by omega) (show p - r < lc by omega)
            hn hj hm₁ hm₂ hm hmD hmE]
          refine gF_mem_right _ (ih lc (corolla c) ?_ g h (p - r) j m₁ mD mE (by omega) hj hm₁
            hmD hmE)
          show (Tree.node c (TreeOfArity.leaves lc)).weight ≤ w
          rw [Tree.weight_node, weightF_leaves]
          omega
        · obtain ⟨mA, hmA⟩ : ∃ mA, mA + 1 = n₁ + m₁ := ⟨n₁ + m₁ - 1, by omega⟩
          obtain ⟨mB, hmB⟩ : ∃ mB, mB + 1 = n₁ + lg := ⟨n₁ + lg - 1, by omega⟩
          rw [SF_gF_before (μ := μ) hμ (show r < p + 1 - lc by omega)
            (show p + 1 - lc < n₁ by omega) (show p + 1 = (p + 1 - lc) + lc by omega) hn hj hm₁
            hm₂ hm hmA hmB]
          exact Submodule.smul_mem _ _ (gF_mem_left
            (ih n₁ s₁ (by omega) g h (p + 1 - lc) j m₁ mB mA (by omega) hj hm₁ hmB hmA) _)

name: Operad.FreeGr.PF_smul
statement:
lemma PF_smul (p₁ p₂ p₂' m₁ m₂ m : ℕ) {n l₁ l₂ : ℕ} (c : R) (x : Pl (T := T) R n)
    (a₁ : TreeOfArity T l₁) (a₂ : TreeOfArity T l₂) :
    PF μ gp R p₁ p₂ p₂' m₁ m₂ m (c • x) a₁ a₂ = c • PF μ gp R p₁ p₂ p₂' m₁ m₂ m x a₁ a₂
proof:
:= by
  simp only [PF, map_smul, LinearMap.smul_apply, smul_add, smul_comm c]

name: Operad.FreeGr.PF_gF_before_before
statement:
theorem PF_gF_before_before {p₁ p₂ p₂' r n n₁ lc l₁ l₂ m₁ m₂ m r₁ r₂ r₁₂ mA mB mC : ℕ}
    (h12 : p₁ < p₂) (h2r : p₂ < r) (hr : r < n₁) (hn : n + 1 = n₁ + lc)
    (hp₂' : p₂' + 1 = p₂ + l₁) (hm₁ : m₁ + 1 = n + l₁) (hm₂ : m₂ + 1 = n + l₂)
    (hm : m + 1 = m₁ + l₂) (hr₁ : r₁ + 1 = r + l₁) (hr₂ : r₂ + 1 = r + l₂)
    (hr₁₂ : r₁₂ + 1 = r₁ + l₂) (hmA : mA + 1 = n₁ + l₁) (hmB : mB + 1 = n₁ + l₂)
    (hmC : mC + 1 = mA + l₂) (X : Pl (T := T) R n₁) (c : T lc) (a₁ : T l₁) (a₂ : T l₂) :
    PF μ gp R p₁ p₂ p₂' m₁ m₂ m (gF gp R r n X (pt (corolla c))) (corolla a₁) (corolla a₂)
      = (σ R (gp lc c && gp l₁ a₁) * σ R (gp lc c && gp l₂ a₂)) •
          gF gp R r₁₂ m (PF μ gp R p₁ p₂ p₂' mA mB mC X (corolla a₁) (corolla a₂))
            (pt (corolla c))
proof:
:= by
  unfold PF
  rw [mF_gF_after (μ := μ) (by omega) hr hr₁ hn hmA hm₁ X (corolla c) (corolla a₁), map_smul,
    LinearMap.smul_apply,
    mF_gF_after (μ := μ) (show p₂' < r₁ by omega) (show r₁ < mA by omega) hr₁₂
      (show m₁ + 1 = mA + lc by omega) hmC (show m + 1 = m₁ + l₂ by omega) _ (corolla c)
      (corolla a₂),
    mF_gF_after (μ := μ) h2r hr hr₂ hn hmB hm₂ X (corolla c) (corolla a₂), map_smul,
    LinearMap.smul_apply,
    mF_gF_after (μ := μ) (show p₁ < r₂ by omega) (show r₂ < mB by omega)
      (show r₁₂ + 1 = r₂ + l₁ by omega) (show m₂ + 1 = mB + lc by omega)
      (show mC + 1 = mB + l₁ by omega) (show m + 1 = m₂ + l₁ by omega) _ (corolla c)
      (corolla a₁)]
  simp only [tpar_corolla', map_add, map_smul, LinearMap.add_apply, LinearMap.smul_apply,
    smul_add, smul_smul]
  congr 1
  · ring_nf
  · ring_nf

name: Operad.FreeGr.PF_gF_after_after
statement:
theorem PF_gF_after_after (hμ : MergeFn.Odd gp μ)
    {p₁ p₂ p₂' q₁ q₂ q₂' r n n₁ lc l₁ l₂ m₁ m₂ m mA mB mC : ℕ}
    (h12 : q₁ < q₂) (hrq : r < q₁) (hq₂ : q₂ < n₁) (hn : n + 1 = n₁ + lc)
    (hp₁ : p₁ + 1 = q₁ + lc) (hp₂ : p₂ + 1 = q₂ + lc) (hp₂' : p₂' + 1 = p₂ + l₁)
    (hq₂' : q₂' + 1 = q₂ + l₁) (hm₁ : m₁ + 1 = n + l₁) (hm₂ : m₂ + 1 = n + l₂)
    (hm : m + 1 = m₁ + l₂) (hmA : mA + 1 = n₁ + l₁) (hmB : mB + 1 = n₁ + l₂)
    (hmC : mC + 1 = mA + l₂) (X : Pl (T := T) R n₁) (c : T lc) (a₁ : T l₁) (a₂ : T l₂) :
    PF μ gp R p₁ p₂ p₂' m₁ m₂ m (gF gp R r n X (pt (corolla c))) (corolla a₁) (corolla a₂)
      = (σ R (gp lc c && gp l₁ a₁) * σ R (gp lc c && gp l₂ a₂)) •
          gF gp R r m (PF μ gp R q₁ q₂ q₂' mA mB mC X (corolla a₁) (corolla a₂))
            (pt (corolla c))
proof:
:= by
  unfold PF
  rw [mF_gF_before (μ := μ) hμ hrq (by omega) hp₁ hn hmA hm₁ X (corolla c) (corolla a₁),
    map_smul, LinearMap.smul_apply,
    mF_gF_before (μ := μ) hμ (show r < q₂' by omega) (show q₂' < mA by omega)
      (show p₂' + 1 = q₂' + lc by omega) (show m₁ + 1 = mA + lc by omega) hmC hm _ (corolla c)
      (corolla a₂),
    mF_gF_before (μ := μ) hμ (by omega) hq₂ hp₂ hn hmB hm₂ X (corolla c) (corolla a₂), map_smul,
    LinearMap.smul_apply,
    mF_gF_before (μ := μ) hμ hrq (show q₁ < mB by omega) hp₁ (show m₂ + 1 = mB + lc by omega)
      (show mC + 1 = mB + l₁ by omega) (show m + 1 = m₂ + l₁ by omega) _ (corolla c)
      (corolla a₁)]
  simp only [tpar_corolla', map_add, map_smul, LinearMap.add_apply, LinearMap.smul_apply,
    smul_add, smul_smul]
  congr 1
  · ring_nf
  · ring_nf

name: Operad.FreeGr.PF_gF_before_after
statement:
theorem PF_gF_before_after (hμ : MergeFn.Odd gp μ)
    {p₁ p₂ p₂' q₂ q₂' r r₁ n n₁ lc l₁ l₂ m₁ m₂ m mA mB mC : ℕ}
    (h1r : p₁ < r) (hrq : r < q₂) (hq₂ : q₂ < n₁) (hn : n + 1 = n₁ + lc)
    (hp₂ : p₂ + 1 = q₂ + lc) (hp₂' : p₂' + 1 = p₂ + l₁) (hq₂' : q₂' + 1 = q₂ + l₁)
    (hr₁ : r₁ + 1 = r + l₁) (hm₁ : m₁ + 1 = n + l₁) (hm₂ : m₂ + 1 = n + l₂)
    (hm : m + 1 = m₁ + l₂) (hmA : mA + 1 = n₁ + l₁) (hmB : mB + 1 = n₁ + l₂)
    (hmC : mC + 1 = mA + l₂) (X : Pl (T := T) R n₁) (c : T lc) (a₁ : T l₁) (a₂ : T l₂) :
    PF μ gp R p₁ p₂ p₂' m₁ m₂ m (gF gp R r n X (pt (corolla c))) (corolla a₁) (corolla a₂)
      = (σ R (gp lc c && gp l₁ a₁) * σ R (gp lc c && gp l₂ a₂)) •
          gF gp R r₁ m (PF μ gp R p₁ q₂ q₂' mA mB mC X (corolla a₁) (corolla a₂))
            (pt (corolla c))
proof:
:= by
  unfold PF
  rw [mF_gF_after (μ := μ) h1r (by omega) hr₁ hn hmA hm₁ X (corolla c) (corolla a₁), map_smul,
    LinearMap.smul_apply,
    mF_gF_before (μ := μ) hμ (show r₁ < q₂' by omega) (show q₂' < mA by omega)
      (show p₂' + 1 = q₂' + lc by omega) (show m₁ + 1 = mA + lc by omega) hmC hm _ (corolla c)
      (corolla a₂),
    mF_gF_before (μ := μ) hμ hrq hq₂ hp₂ hn hmB hm₂ X (corolla c) (corolla a₂), map_smul,
    LinearMap.smul_apply,
    mF_gF_after (μ := μ) h1r (show r < mB by omega) hr₁ (show m₂ + 1 = mB + lc by omega)
      (show mC + 1 = mB + l₁ by omega) (show m + 1 = m₂ + l₁ by omega) _ (corolla c)
      (corolla a₁)]
  simp only [tpar_corolla', map_add, map_smul, LinearMap.add_apply, LinearMap.smul_apply,
    smul_add, smul_smul]
  congr 1
  · ring_nf
  · ring_nf

name: Operad.FreeGr.PF_gF_inner_inner
statement:
theorem PF_gF_inner_inner (hμ : MergeFn.Odd gp μ)
    {p₁ p₂ p₂' j₁ j₂ j₂' r n n₁ lc l₁ l₂ m₁ m₂ m mD mD' mE : ℕ}
    (h12 : j₁ < j₂) (hj₂ : j₂ < lc) (hr : r < n₁) (hn : n + 1 = n₁ + lc)
    (hp₁ : p₁ = r + j₁) (hp₂ : p₂ = r + j₂) (hp₂' : p₂' + 1 = p₂ + l₁)
    (hj₂' : j₂' + 1 = j₂ + l₁) (hm₁ : m₁ + 1 = n + l₁) (hm₂ : m₂ + 1 = n + l₂)
    (hm : m + 1 = m₁ + l₂) (hmD : mD + 1 = lc + l₁) (hmD' : mD' + 1 = lc + l₂)
    (hmE : mE + 1 = mD + l₂) (X : Pl (T := T) R n₁) (c : T lc) (a₁ : T l₁) (a₂ : T l₂) :
    PF μ gp R p₁ p₂ p₂' m₁ m₂ m (gF gp R r n X (pt (corolla c))) (corolla a₁) (corolla a₂)
      = gF gp R r m X (PF μ gp R j₁ j₂ j₂' mD mD' mE (pt (corolla c)) (corolla a₁)
          (corolla a₂))
proof:
:= by
  have hW₁ := mF_corolla (μ := μ) (gp := gp) (R := R) ⟨show j₁ < lc by omega, hmD⟩ c a₁
  have hW₂ := mF_corolla (μ := μ) (gp := gp) (R := R) ⟨hj₂, hmD'⟩ c a₂
  unfold PF
  rw [mF_gF_inner (μ := μ) hμ hr (show j₁ < lc by omega) hp₁ hn hmD hm₁ X (isLeaf_corolla c)
      (corolla a₁), hW₁,
    mF_gF_inner (μ := μ) hμ hr (show j₂' < mD by omega) (show p₂' = r + j₂' by omega)
      (show m₁ + 1 = n₁ + mD by omega) hmE hm _ (isLeaf_corolla _) (corolla a₂), twF_twF,
    mF_gF_inner (μ := μ) hμ hr hj₂ hp₂ hn hmD' hm₂ X (isLeaf_corolla c) (corolla a₂), hW₂,
    mF_gF_inner (μ := μ) hμ hr (show j₁ < mD' by omega) hp₁ (show m₂ + 1 = n₁ + mD' by omega)
      (show mE + 1 = mD' + l₁ by omega) (show m + 1 = m₂ + l₁ by omega) _ (isLeaf_corolla _)
      (corolla a₁), twF_twF, map_add, map_smul]

name: Operad.FreeGr.σ_par_zero
statement:
lemma σ_par_zero (c a₁ a₂ : Bool) :
    σ R (a₁ && a₂) * σ R (c && a₁) * σ R a₁ = σ R ((!(xor c a₂)) && a₁)
proof:
:= by
  cases c <;> cases a₁ <;> cases a₂ <;> simp

name: Operad.FreeGr.PF_gF_before_inner
statement:
theorem PF_gF_before_inner (hμ : MergeFn.Odd gp μ)
    {p₁ p₂ p₂' j₂ r r₁ n n₁ lc l₁ l₂ m₁ m₂ m mA mD : ℕ}
    (h1r : p₁ < r) (hr : r < n₁) (hj₂ : j₂ < lc) (hn : n + 1 = n₁ + lc) (hp₂ : p₂ = r + j₂)
    (hp₂' : p₂' + 1 = p₂ + l₁) (hr₁ : r₁ + 1 = r + l₁) (hm₁ : m₁ + 1 = n + l₁)
    (hm₂ : m₂ + 1 = n + l₂) (hm : m + 1 = m₁ + l₂) (hmA : mA + 1 = n₁ + l₁)
    (hmD : mD + 1 = lc + l₂) (X : Pl (T := T) R n₁) (c : T lc) (a₁ : T l₁) (a₂ : T l₂) :
    PF μ gp R p₁ p₂ p₂' m₁ m₂ m (gF gp R r n X (pt (corolla c))) (corolla a₁) (corolla a₂)
      = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hW := mF_corolla (μ := μ) (gp := gp) (R := R) ⟨hj₂, hmD⟩ c a₂
  unfold PF
  rw [mF_gF_after (μ := μ) h1r hr hr₁ hn hmA hm₁ X (corolla c) (corolla a₁), map_smul,
    LinearMap.smul_apply,
    mF_gF_inner (μ := μ) hμ (show r₁ < mA by omega) hj₂ (show p₂' = r₁ + j₂ by omega)
      (show m₁ + 1 = mA + lc by omega) hmD hm _ (isLeaf_corolla c) (corolla a₂), hW,
    twF_mF hμ, twF_pt,
    mF_gF_inner (μ := μ) hμ hr hj₂ hp₂ hn hmD hm₂ X (isLeaf_corolla c) (corolla a₂), hW,
    mF_gF_after (μ := μ) h1r hr hr₁ (show m₂ + 1 = n₁ + mD by omega) hmA
      (show m + 1 = m₂ + l₁ by omega) _ (corolla (μ lc l₂ c j₂ a₂ mD)) (corolla a₁)]
  simp only [tpar_corolla', hμ, map_neg, map_smul, LinearMap.neg_apply, LinearMap.smul_apply,
    smul_neg, smul_smul]
  rw [← σ_par_zero, neg_add_eq_zero]
  congr 1
  ring

name: Operad.FreeGr.PF_gF_inner_after
statement:
theorem PF_gF_inner_after (hμ : MergeFn.Odd gp μ)
    {p₁ p₂ p₂' j₁ q₂ r n n₁ lc l₁ l₂ m₁ m₂ m mB mD : ℕ}
    (hj₁ : j₁ < lc) (hrq : r < q₂) (hq₂ : q₂ < n₁) (hn : n + 1 = n₁ + lc) (hp₁ : p₁ = r + j₁)
    (hp₂ : p₂ + 1 = q₂ + lc) (hp₂' : p₂' + 1 = p₂ + l₁) (hm₁ : m₁ + 1 = n + l₁)
    (hm₂ : m₂ + 1 = n + l₂) (hm : m + 1 = m₁ + l₂) (hmB : mB + 1 = n₁ + l₂)
    (hmD : mD + 1 = lc + l₁) (X : Pl (T := T) R n₁) (c : T lc) (a₁ : T l₁) (a₂ : T l₂) :
    PF μ gp R p₁ p₂ p₂' m₁ m₂ m (gF gp R r n X (pt (corolla c))) (corolla a₁) (corolla a₂)
      = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hW := mF_corolla (μ := μ) (gp := gp) (R := R) ⟨hj₁, hmD⟩ c a₁
  unfold PF
  rw [mF_gF_inner (μ := μ) hμ (by omega) hj₁ hp₁ hn hmD hm₁ X (isLeaf_corolla c) (corolla a₁),
    hW,
    mF_gF_before (μ := μ) hμ hrq hq₂ (show p₂' + 1 = q₂ + mD by omega)
      (show m₁ + 1 = n₁ + mD by omega) hmB hm _ (corolla (μ lc l₁ c j₁ a₁ mD)) (corolla a₂),
    mF_gF_before (μ := μ) hμ hrq hq₂ hp₂ hn hmB hm₂ X (corolla c) (corolla a₂), map_smul,
    LinearMap.smul_apply,
    mF_gF_inner (μ := μ) hμ (show r < mB by omega) hj₁ hp₁ (show m₂ + 1 = mB + lc by omega) hmD
      (show m + 1 = m₂ + l₁ by omega) _ (isLeaf_corolla c) (corolla a₁), hW, twF_mF hμ, twF_pt]
  simp only [tpar_corolla', hμ, map_neg, map_smul, LinearMap.neg_apply, LinearMap.smul_apply,
    smul_neg, smul_smul]
  rw [add_neg_eq_zero]
  congr 1
  have key : σ R (gp l₁ a₁ && gp l₂ a₂) * σ R (!(xor (gp lc c) (gp l₁ a₁)) && gp l₂ a₂)
      = σ R (gp lc c && gp l₂ a₂) * σ R (gp l₂ a₂) := by
    cases gp lc c <;> cases gp l₁ a₁ <;> cases gp l₂ a₂ <;> simp
  linear_combination key

name: Operad.FreeGr.weight_corolla_le
statement: lemma weight_corolla_le {k w : ℕ} (c : T k) (hw : 1 ≤ w) : (corolla c).1.weight ≤ w
proof:
:= by
  show (Tree.node c (TreeOfArity.leaves k)).weight ≤ w
  rw [Tree.weight_node, weightF_leaves]
  omega

name: Operad.FreeGr.PF_mem
statement:
theorem PF_mem (hμ : MergeFn.Odd gp μ) (hA : AssocHyp μ gp R J) : ∀ (w n : ℕ)
    (s : TreeOfArity T n), s.1.weight ≤ w → ∀ {l₁ l₂ : ℕ} (a₁ : T l₁) (a₂ : T l₂)
    (p₁ p₂ p₂' m₁ m₂ m : ℕ), p₁ < p₂ → p₂ < n → p₂' + 1 = p₂ + l₁ → m₁ + 1 = n + l₁ →
      m₂ + 1 = n + l₂ → m + 1 = m₁ + l₂ →
      PF μ gp R p₁ p₂ p₂' m₁ m₂ m (pt s) (corolla a₁) (corolla a₂) ∈ JF J m
proof:
:= by
  intro w
  induction w with
  | zero =>
    intro n s hw l₁ l₂ a₁ a₂ p₁ p₂ p₂' m₁ m₂ m h12 h2 _ _ _ _
    have hl : s.1 = Tree.leaf := by
      cases hs : s.1 with
      | leaf => rfl
      | node e f => rw [hs] at hw; simp at hw
    have := s.2
    rw [hl, Tree.arity_leaf] at this
    omega
  | succ w ih =>
    intro n s hw l₁ l₂ a₁ a₂ p₁ p₂ p₂' m₁ m₂ m h12 h2 hp₂' hm₁ hm₂ hm
    rcases Nat.lt_or_ge s.1.weight 2 with hw2 | hw2
    · by_cases hw0 : s.1.weight = 0
      · exact ih n s (by omega) a₁ a₂ p₁ p₂ p₂' m₁ m₂ m h12 h2 hp₂' hm₁ hm₂ hm
      · obtain ⟨k, x, hx⟩ := eq_corolla_of_weight (t := s.1) (by omega)
        have hk : k = n := by
          have := s.2
          rw [hx, Tree.arity_node, arityF_leaves] at this
          exact this
        subst hk
        have hs : s = corolla x := Subtype.ext hx
        subst hs
        unfold PF
        rw [mF_corolla (μ := μ) ⟨by omega, hm₁⟩, mF_corolla (μ := μ) ⟨by omega, hm⟩,
          mF_corolla (μ := μ) ⟨h2, hm₂⟩, mF_corolla (μ := μ) ⟨by omega, by omega⟩,
          tpar_corolla', tpar_corolla']
        show ιP gp R m _ ∈ J.sub (Fin m)
        rw [map_add, map_smul, ιP_corolla, ιP_corolla]
        exact hA.parallel _ _ _ x a₁ a₂ p₁ p₂ p₂' m₁ m₂ m h12 h2 hp₂' hm₁ hm₂ hm
    · obtain ⟨n₁, r, lc, s₁, c, hr, hn, hw₁, hs⟩ := pt_eq_gF (R := R) (gp := gp) s hw2
      rw [hs, PF_smul]
      refine Submodule.smul_mem _ _ ?_
      have hn₁ : 1 ≤ n₁ := by omega
      obtain ⟨mA, hmA⟩ : ∃ mA, mA + 1 = n₁ + l₁ := ⟨n₁ + l₁ - 1, by omega⟩
      obtain ⟨mB, hmB⟩ : ∃ mB, mB + 1 = n₁ + l₂ := ⟨n₁ + l₂ - 1, by omega⟩
      rcases Nat.lt_or_ge p₂ r with h2r | h2r
      · 
        obtain ⟨mC, hmC⟩ : ∃ mC, mC + 1 = mA + l₂ := ⟨mA + l₂ - 1, by omega⟩
        obtain ⟨r₁, hr₁⟩ : ∃ r₁, r₁ + 1 = r + l₁ := ⟨r + l₁ - 1, by omega⟩
        obtain ⟨r₂, hr₂⟩ : ∃ r₂, r₂ + 1 = r + l₂ := ⟨r + l₂ - 1, by omega⟩
        obtain ⟨r₁₂, hr₁₂⟩ : ∃ r₁₂, r₁₂ + 1 = r₁ + l₂ := ⟨r₁ + l₂ - 1, by omega⟩
        rw [PF_gF_before_before (μ := μ) h12 h2r hr hn hp₂' hm₁ hm₂ hm hr₁ hr₂ hr₁₂ hmA hmB hmC]
        exact Submodule.smul_mem _ _ (gF_mem_left
          (ih n₁ s₁ (by omega) a₁ a₂ p₁ p₂ p₂' mA mB mC h12 (by omega) hp₂' hmA hmB hmC) _)
      rcases Nat.lt_or_ge p₁ r with h1r | h1r
      · obtain ⟨r₁, hr₁⟩ : ∃ r₁, r₁ + 1 = r + l₁ := ⟨r + l₁ - 1, by omega⟩
        rcases Nat.lt_or_ge p₂ (r + lc) with h2c | h2c
        · 
          obtain ⟨mD, hmD⟩ : ∃ mD, mD + 1 = lc + l₂ := ⟨lc + l₂ - 1, by omega⟩
          rw [PF_gF_before_inner (μ := μ) hμ h1r hr (show p₂ - r < lc by omega) hn
            (show p₂ = r + (p₂ - r) by omega) hp₂' hr₁ hm₁ hm₂ hm hmA hmD]
          exact zero_mem _
        · 
          obtain ⟨mC, hmC⟩ : ∃ mC, mC + 1 = mA + l₂ := ⟨mA + l₂ - 1, by omega⟩
          obtain ⟨q₂', hq₂'⟩ : ∃ q₂', q₂' + 1 = (p₂ + 1 - lc) + l₁ := ⟨p₂ - lc + l₁, by omega⟩
          rw [PF_gF_before_after (μ := μ) hμ h1r (show r < p₂ + 1 - lc by omega)
            (show p₂ + 1 - lc < n₁ by omega) hn (show p₂ + 1 = (p₂ + 1 - lc) + lc by omega)
            hp₂' hq₂' hr₁ hm₁ hm₂ hm hmA hmB hmC]
          exact Submodule.smul_mem _ _ (gF_mem_left (ih n₁ s₁ (by omega) a₁ a₂ p₁ (p₂ + 1 - lc)
            q₂' mA mB mC (by omega) (by omega) hq₂' hmA hmB hmC) _)
      · rcases Nat.lt_or_ge p₂ (r + lc) with h2c | h2c
        · 
          obtain ⟨mD, hmD⟩ : ∃ mD, mD + 1 = lc + l₁ := ⟨lc + l₁ - 1, by omega⟩
          obtain ⟨mD', hmD'⟩ : ∃ mD', mD' + 1 = lc + l₂ := ⟨lc + l₂ - 1, by omega⟩
          obtain ⟨mE, hmE⟩ : ∃ mE, mE + 1 = mD + l₂ := ⟨mD + l₂ - 1, by omega⟩
          obtain ⟨j₂', hj₂'⟩ : ∃ j₂', j₂' + 1 = (p₂ - r) + l₁ := ⟨p₂ - r + l₁ - 1, by omega⟩
          rw [PF_gF_inner_inner (μ := μ) hμ (show p₁ - r < p₂ - r by omega)
            (show p₂ - r < lc by omega) hr hn (show p₁ = r + (p₁ - r) by omega)
            (show p₂ = r + (p₂ - r) by omega) hp₂' hj₂' hm₁ hm₂ hm hmD hmD' hmE]
          exact gF_mem_right _ (ih lc (corolla c) (weight_corolla_le c (by omega)) a₁ a₂
            (p₁ - r) (p₂ - r) j₂' mD mD' mE (by omega) (by omega) hj₂' hmD hmD' hmE)
        · rcases Nat.lt_or_ge p₁ (r + lc) with h1c | h1c
          · 
            obtain ⟨mD, hmD⟩ : ∃ mD, mD + 1 = lc + l₁ := ⟨lc + l₁ - 1, by omega⟩
            rw [PF_gF_inner_after (μ := μ) hμ (show p₁ - r < lc by omega)
              (show r < p₂ + 1 - lc by omega) (show p₂ + 1 - lc < n₁ by omega) hn
              (show p₁ = r + (p₁ - r) by omega) (show p₂ + 1 = (p₂ + 1 - lc) + lc by omega) hp₂'
              hm₁ hm₂ hm hmB hmD]
            exact zero_mem _
          · 
            obtain ⟨mC, hmC⟩ : ∃ mC, mC + 1 = mA + l₂ := ⟨mA + l₂ - 1, by omega⟩
            obtain ⟨q₂', hq₂'⟩ : ∃ q₂', q₂' + 1 = (p₂ + 1 - lc) + l₁ := ⟨p₂ - lc + l₁, by omega⟩
            rw [PF_gF_after_after (μ := μ) hμ (show p₁ + 1 - lc < p₂ + 1 - lc by omega)
              (show r < p₁ + 1 - lc by omega) (show p₂ + 1 - lc < n₁ by omega) hn
              (show p₁ + 1 = (p₁ + 1 - lc) + lc by omega)
              (show p₂ + 1 = (p₂ + 1 - lc) + lc by omega) hp₂' hq₂' hm₁ hm₂ hm hmA hmB hmC]
            exact Submodule.smul_mem _ _ (gF_mem_left (ih n₁ s₁ (by omega) a₁ a₂ (p₁ + 1 - lc)
              (p₂ + 1 - lc) q₂' mA mB mC (by omega) (by omega) hq₂' hmA hmB hmC) _)

name: Operad.FreeGr.NF_smul
statement:
lemma NF_smul (q m : ℕ) {n lh : ℕ} (c : R) (x : Pl (T := T) R n) (h : TreeOfArity T lh) :
    NF μ gp R q m (c • x) h = c • NF μ gp R q m x h
proof:
:= by
  simp only [NF, map_smul, LinearMap.smul_apply, smul_add]

name: Operad.FreeGr.dF_gF_corolla
statement:
lemma dF_gF_corolla (hμ : MergeFn.Odd gp μ) (a : ℕ) {n lc : ℕ} (m : ℕ) (x : Pl (T := T) R n)
    (c : T lc) :
    dF μ gp R m (gF gp R a m x (pt (corolla c)))
      = gF gp R a m (dF μ gp R n x) (pt (corolla c)) + mF μ gp R a m x (pt (corolla c))
proof:
:= by
  rw [dF_gF μ hμ, dF_corolla, map_zero, add_zero]

name: Operad.FreeGr.NF_gF_after
statement:
theorem NF_gF_after (hμ : MergeFn.Odd gp μ) {q r r' n n₁ lc lh m mA : ℕ} (hqr : q < r)
    (hr : r < n₁) (hn : n + 1 = n₁ + lc) (hm : m + 1 = n + lh) (hr' : r' + 1 = r + lh)
    (hmA : mA + 1 = n₁ + lh) (X : Pl (T := T) R n₁) (c : T lc) (h : T lh) :
    NF μ gp R q m (gF gp R r n X (pt (corolla c))) (corolla h)
      = σ R (gp lc c && gp lh h) • gF gp R r' m (NF μ gp R q mA X (corolla h)) (pt (corolla c))
        + PF μ gp R q r r' mA n m X (corolla h) (corolla c)
proof:
:= by
  unfold NF PF
  rw [mF_gF_after (μ := μ) hqr hr hr' hn hmA hm X (corolla c) (corolla h), map_smul,
    dF_gF_corolla hμ, dF_gF_corolla hμ, map_add, LinearMap.add_apply,
    mF_gF_after (μ := μ) hqr hr hr' hn hmA hm _ (corolla c) (corolla h)]
  simp only [tpar_corolla', map_add, LinearMap.add_apply, smul_add, Bool.and_comm (gp lh h)]
  abel

name: Operad.FreeGr.NF_gF_before
statement:
theorem NF_gF_before (hμ : MergeFn.Odd gp μ) {q q₁ r n n₁ lc lh m mA : ℕ} (hrq : r < q₁)
    (hq₁ : q₁ < n₁) (hq : q + 1 = q₁ + lc) (hn : n + 1 = n₁ + lc) (hm : m + 1 = n + lh)
    (hmA : mA + 1 = n₁ + lh) (X : Pl (T := T) R n₁) (c : T lc) (h : T lh) :
    NF μ gp R q m (gF gp R r n X (pt (corolla c))) (corolla h)
      = σ R (gp lc c && gp lh h) • gF gp R r m (NF μ gp R q₁ mA X (corolla h)) (pt (corolla c))
        + σ R (gp lc c && gp lh h) • PF μ gp R r q₁ q n mA m X (corolla c) (corolla h)
proof:
:= by
  unfold NF PF
  rw [mF_gF_before (μ := μ) hμ hrq hq₁ hq hn hmA hm X (corolla c) (corolla h), map_smul,
    dF_gF_corolla hμ, dF_gF_corolla hμ, map_add, LinearMap.add_apply,
    mF_gF_before (μ := μ) hμ hrq hq₁ hq hn hmA hm _ (corolla c) (corolla h)]
  simp only [tpar_corolla', map_add, LinearMap.add_apply, smul_add, smul_smul, σ_mul_self,
    one_smul]
  abel

name: Operad.FreeGr.NF_gF_inner
statement:
theorem NF_gF_inner (hμ : MergeFn.Odd gp μ) {q j r n n₁ lc lh m mD : ℕ} (hr : r < n₁)
    (hj : j < lc) (hq : q = r + j) (hn : n + 1 = n₁ + lc) (hm : m + 1 = n + lh)
    (hmD : mD + 1 = lc + lh) (X : Pl (T := T) R n₁) (c : T lc) (h : T lh) :
    NF μ gp R q m (gF gp R r n X (pt (corolla c))) (corolla h)
      = SF μ gp R r j mD n m X (corolla c) (corolla h)
proof:
:= by
  have hW := mF_corolla (μ := μ) (gp := gp) (R := R) ⟨hj, hmD⟩ c h
  unfold NF SF
  rw [mF_gF_inner (μ := μ) hμ hr hj hq hn hmD hm X (isLeaf_corolla c) (corolla h), hW,
    dF_gF_corolla hμ, dF_gF_corolla hμ, map_add, LinearMap.add_apply,
    mF_gF_inner (μ := μ) hμ hr hj hq hn hmD hm _ (isLeaf_corolla c) (corolla h), hW,
    dF_twF hμ, ← hq]
  simp only [map_neg, LinearMap.neg_apply]
  abel

name: Operad.FreeGr.NF_mem
statement:
theorem NF_mem (hμ : MergeFn.Odd gp μ) (hA : AssocHyp μ gp R J) : ∀ (w n : ℕ)
    (s : TreeOfArity T n), s.1.weight ≤ w → ∀ {lh : ℕ} (h : T lh) (q m : ℕ), q < n →
      m + 1 = n + lh → NF μ gp R q m (pt s) (corolla h) ∈ JF J m
proof:
:= by
  intro w
  induction w with
  | zero =>
    intro n s hw lh h q m hq hm
    have hl : s.1.isLeaf = true := by
      cases hs : s.1 with
      | leaf => rfl
      | node e f => rw [hs] at hw; simp at hw
    have hd : dF μ gp R n (pt s) = 0 := by
      rw [dF_pt, show s.1.weight = 0 by omega, Finset.Ico_eq_empty_of_le zero_le_one,
        Finset.sum_empty]
    unfold NF
    rw [mF_pt_leaf_left _ hl, hd, map_zero, map_zero, LinearMap.zero_apply, add_zero]
    exact zero_mem _
  | succ w ih =>
    intro n s hw lh h q m hq hm
    rcases Nat.lt_or_ge s.1.weight 2 with hw2 | hw2
    · have hd : dF μ gp R n (pt s) = 0 := by
        rw [dF_pt, Finset.Ico_eq_empty_of_le (by omega), Finset.sum_empty]
      by_cases hw0 : s.1.weight = 0
      · exact ih n s (by omega) h q m hq hm
      · obtain ⟨k, x, hx⟩ := eq_corolla_of_weight (t := s.1) (by omega)
        have hk : k = n := by
          have := s.2
          rw [hx, Tree.arity_node, arityF_leaves] at this
          exact this
        subst hk
        have hs : s = corolla x := Subtype.ext hx
        subst hs
        unfold NF
        rw [hd, map_zero, LinearMap.zero_apply, add_zero, mF_corolla (μ := μ) ⟨hq, hm⟩,
          dF_corolla]
        exact zero_mem _
    · obtain ⟨n₁, r, lc, s₁, c, hr, hn, hw₁, hs⟩ := pt_eq_gF (R := R) (gp := gp) s hw2
      rw [hs, NF_smul]
      refine Submodule.smul_mem _ _ ?_
      obtain ⟨mA, hmA⟩ : ∃ mA, mA + 1 = n₁ + lh := ⟨n₁ + lh - 1, by omega⟩
      rcases Nat.lt_or_ge q r with hqr | hqr
      · obtain ⟨r', hr'⟩ : ∃ r', r' + 1 = r + lh := ⟨r + lh - 1, by omega⟩
        rw [NF_gF_after (μ := μ) hμ hqr hr hn hm hr' hmA]
        exact add_mem (Submodule.smul_mem _ _ (gF_mem_left
            (ih n₁ s₁ (by omega) h q mA (by omega) hmA) _))
          (PF_mem J hμ hA w n₁ s₁ (by omega) h c q r r' mA n m hqr hr hr' hmA hn
            (by omega))
      · rcases Nat.lt_or_ge q (r + lc) with hqc | hqc
        · obtain ⟨mD, hmD⟩ : ∃ mD, mD + 1 = lc + lh := ⟨lc + lh - 1, by omega⟩
          rw [NF_gF_inner (μ := μ) hμ hr (show q - r < lc by omega) (show q = r + (q - r) by omega)
            hn hm hmD]
          exact SF_mem J hμ hA w n₁ s₁ (by omega) c h r (q - r) mD n m hr (by omega) hmD hn
            (by omega)
        · rw [NF_gF_before (μ := μ) hμ (show r < q + 1 - lc by omega)
            (show q + 1 - lc < n₁ by omega) (show q + 1 = (q + 1 - lc) + lc by omega) hn hm hmA]
          exact add_mem (Submodule.smul_mem _ _ (gF_mem_left
              (ih n₁ s₁ (by omega) h (q + 1 - lc) mA (by omega) hmA) _))
            (Submodule.smul_mem _ _ (PF_mem J hμ hA w n₁ s₁ (by omega) c h r (q + 1 - lc) q n mA
              m (by omega) (by omega) (by omega) hn hmA (by omega)))

name: Operad.FreeGr.dF_dF_mem
statement:
theorem dF_dF_mem (hμ : MergeFn.Odd gp μ) (hA : AssocHyp μ gp R J) : ∀ (w n : ℕ)
    (s : TreeOfArity T n), s.1.weight ≤ w → dF μ gp R n (dF μ gp R n (pt s)) ∈ JF J n
proof:
:= by
  intro w
  induction w with
  | zero =>
    intro n s hw
    rw [dF_pt, Finset.Ico_eq_empty_of_le (by omega), Finset.sum_empty, map_zero]
    exact zero_mem _
  | succ w ih =>
    intro n s hw
    rcases Nat.lt_or_ge s.1.weight 2 with hw2 | hw2
    · rw [dF_pt, Finset.Ico_eq_empty_of_le (by omega), Finset.sum_empty, map_zero]
      exact zero_mem _
    · obtain ⟨n₁, r, lc, s₁, c, hr, hn, hw₁, hs⟩ := pt_eq_gF (R := R) (gp := gp) s hw2
      rw [hs, map_smul, map_smul]
      refine Submodule.smul_mem _ _ ?_
      rw [dF_gF_corolla hμ, map_add, dF_gF_corolla hμ, add_assoc]
      refine add_mem (gF_mem_left (ih n₁ s₁ (by omega)) _) ?_
      rw [add_comm]
      exact NF_mem J hμ hA w n₁ s₁ (by omega) c r n hr (by omega)

name: Operad.FreeGr.barD_barD_mem
statement:
theorem barD_barD_mem (hμ : MergeFn.Odd gp μ) (hA : AssocHyp μ gp R J) {A : Type} [Fintype A]
    [DecidableEq A] (x : FreeGr R gp A) : barD μ gp R A (barD μ gp R A x) ∈ J.sub A
proof:
:= by
  induction x using induction_bas with
  | zero => rw [map_zero, map_zero]; exact zero_mem _
  | add x y hx hy => rw [map_add, map_add]; exact add_mem hx hy
  | bas c t =>
    rw [map_smul, map_smul]
    refine Submodule.smul_mem _ c ?_
    have ht : SgnLin.bas (treeSgn gp) R t = GrOperad.map (R := R)
        ((finCongr t.2.2).trans t.1.toRank.symm) (ιP gp R _ (pt t.2.1.2)) := by
      rw [ιP_pt, SgnLin.map_bas]
      exact congrArg _ (Reg.eq_map_std t)
    rw [ht, ← map_barD, ← map_barD, ← ιP_dF, ← ιP_dF]
    exact J.map_mem _ (dF_dF_mem J hμ hA _ _ t.2.1.2 le_rfl)

name: Operad.FreeGr.mcomp_gen_gen
statement:
theorem mcomp_gen_gen {k l : ℕ} (c : T k) (i : Fin k) (g : T l) (m : ℕ) (h : m + 1 = k + l) :
    mcomp μ gp R i (gen c) (gen g)
      = GrOperad.map (R := R) (posEquiv k i l m ⟨i.2, h⟩).symm
          (gen (R := R) (gp := gp) (μ k l c i g m))
proof:
:= by
  have e := ιP_mF (μ := μ) (gp := gp) (R := R) ⟨i.2, h⟩ (pt (corolla c)) (pt (corolla g))
  rw [mF_corolla (μ := μ) ⟨i.2, h⟩, ιP_corolla, ιP_corolla, ιP_corolla] at e
  rw [e, ← GrOperad.map_trans, Equiv.self_trans_symm, GrOperad.map_refl]

name: Operad.AInf.acast_of_eq
statement:
lemma acast_of_eq {a b : ℕ} (h : a = b) (x : End R V a) :
    (acast x : End R V b) = reindex R (End R V) h x
proof: := dif_pos h

name: Operad.AInf.acast_self
statement: @[simp] lemma acast_self {a : ℕ} (x : End R V a) : (acast x : End R V a) = x
proof:
:= by
  rw [acast_of_eq rfl, reindex_rfl]

name: Operad.AInf.acast_reindex
statement:
lemma acast_reindex {a b c : ℕ} (h : a = b) (x : End R V a) :
    (acast (reindex R (End R V) h x) : End R V c) = acast x
proof:
:= by
  subst h
  rw [reindex_rfl]

name: Operad.AInf.acast_acast
statement:
lemma acast_acast {a b c : ℕ} (h : a = b) (x : End R V a) :
    (acast (acast x : End R V b) : End R V c) = acast x
proof:
:= by
  rw [acast_of_eq h, acast_reindex]

name: Operad.AInf.acast_zero
statement: @[simp] lemma acast_zero {a b : ℕ} : (acast (0 : End R V a) : End R V b) = 0
proof:
:= by
  unfold acast
  split_ifs <;> simp

name: Operad.AInf.acast_add
statement:
lemma acast_add {a b : ℕ} (x y : End R V a) :
    (acast (x + y) : End R V b) = acast x + acast y
proof:
:= by
  unfold acast
  split_ifs <;> simp

name: Operad.AInf.acast_smul
statement:
lemma acast_smul {a b : ℕ} (c : R) (x : End R V a) :
    (acast (c • x) : End R V b) = c • acast x
proof:
:= by
  unfold acast
  split_ifs <;> simp

name: Operad.AInf.acast_neg
statement: lemma acast_neg {a b : ℕ} (x : End R V a) : (acast (-x) : End R V b) = -acast x
proof:
:= by
  unfold acast
  split_ifs <;> simp

name: Operad.AInf.acast_sub
statement:
lemma acast_sub {a b : ℕ} (x y : End R V a) :
    (acast (x - y) : End R V b) = acast x - acast y
proof:
:= by
  rw [sub_eq_add_neg, acast_add, acast_neg, ← sub_eq_add_neg]

name: Operad.AInf.acast_sum
statement:
lemma acast_sum {a b : ℕ} {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι) (x : ι → End R V a) :
    (acast (∑ i ∈ s, x i) : End R V b) = ∑ i ∈ s, acast (x i)
proof:
:= by
  unfold acast
  split_ifs <;> simp

name: Operad.AInf.tstar_apply
statement:
lemma tstar_apply (q : ℕ) (f g : Fam R V) (m : ℕ) :
    tstar ε q f g m = ∑ j ∈ range (m + 1), acast (kstar ε q (f j) (g (m - j)))
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.AInf.kstar_sum_left
statement:
lemma kstar_sum_left (q : ℕ) {j k : ℕ} {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι) (f : ι → End R V (j + 1))
    (β : End R V (k + 1)) : kstar ε q (∑ x ∈ s, f x) β = ∑ x ∈ s, kstar ε q (f x) β
proof:
:= by
  unfold kstar
  simp only [kcompFin_sum_left]
  exact Finset.sum_comm

name: Operad.AInf.kstar_sum_right
statement:
lemma kstar_sum_right (q : ℕ) {j k : ℕ} {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι) (α : End R V (j + 1))
    (g : ι → End R V (k + 1)) : kstar ε q α (∑ x ∈ s, g x) = ∑ x ∈ s, kstar ε q α (g x)
proof:
:= by
  unfold kstar
  simp only [kcompFin_sum_right]
  exact Finset.sum_comm

name: Operad.AInf.kstar_add_left
statement:
lemma kstar_add_left (q : ℕ) {j k : ℕ} (α α' : End R V (j + 1)) (β : End R V (k + 1)) :
    kstar ε q (α + α') β = kstar ε q α β + kstar ε q α' β
proof:
:= by
  have := kstar_sum_left ε q Finset.univ ![α, α'] β
  simpa using this

name: Operad.AInf.kstar_add_right
statement:
lemma kstar_add_right (q : ℕ) {j k : ℕ} (α : End R V (j + 1)) (β β' : End R V (k + 1)) :
    kstar ε q α (β + β') = kstar ε q α β + kstar ε q α β'
proof:
:= by
  have := kstar_sum_right ε q Finset.univ α ![β, β']
  simpa using this

name: Operad.AInf.kstar_smul_left
statement:
lemma kstar_smul_left (q : ℕ) {j k : ℕ} (c : R) (α : End R V (j + 1)) (β : End R V (k + 1)) :
    kstar ε q (c • α) β = c • kstar ε q α β
proof:
:= by
  unfold kstar kcompFin
  rw [Finset.smul_sum]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
  rw [map_smul, compFin_smul_left]
  rfl

name: Operad.AInf.kstar_smul_right
statement:
lemma kstar_smul_right (q : ℕ) {j k : ℕ} (c : R) (α : End R V (j + 1)) (β : End R V (k + 1)) :
    kstar ε q α (c • β) = c • kstar ε q α β
proof:
:= by
  unfold kstar kcompFin
  rw [Finset.smul_sum]
  exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => compFin_smul_right _ _ _ _

name: Operad.AInf.kstar_zero_left
statement:
@[simp] lemma kstar_zero_left (q : ℕ) {j k : ℕ} (β : End R V (k + 1)) :
    kstar ε q (0 : End R V (j + 1)) β = 0
proof:
:= by
  simpa using kstar_smul_left ε q (0 : R) 0 β

name: Operad.AInf.kstar_zero_right
statement:
@[simp] lemma kstar_zero_right (q : ℕ) {j k : ℕ} (α : End R V (j + 1)) :
    kstar ε q α (0 : End R V (k + 1)) = 0
proof:
:= by
  simpa using kstar_smul_right ε q (0 : R) α 0

name: Operad.AInf.kstar_acast_left
statement:
lemma kstar_acast_left (q : ℕ) {j j' k : ℕ} (h : j' = j) (α : End R V (j' + 1))
    (β : End R V (k + 1)) :
    kstar ε q (acast α : End R V (j + 1)) β = acast (kstar ε q α β)
proof:
:= by
  subst h
  simp

name: Operad.AInf.kstar_acast_right
statement:
lemma kstar_acast_right (q : ℕ) {j k k' : ℕ} (h : k' = k) (α : End R V (j + 1))
    (β : End R V (k' + 1)) :
    kstar ε q α (acast β : End R V (k + 1)) = acast (kstar ε q α β)
proof:
:= by
  subst h
  simp

name: Operad.AInf.kstar_sub_left
statement:
lemma kstar_sub_left (q : ℕ) {j k : ℕ} (α α' : End R V (j + 1)) (β : End R V (k + 1)) :
    kstar ε q (α - α') β = kstar ε q α β - kstar ε q α' β
proof:
:= by
  rw [sub_eq_add_neg, kstar_add_left, ← neg_one_smul R α', kstar_smul_left, neg_one_smul,
    ← sub_eq_add_neg]

name: Operad.AInf.kstar_sub_right
statement:
lemma kstar_sub_right (q : ℕ) {j k : ℕ} (α : End R V (j + 1)) (β β' : End R V (k + 1)) :
    kstar ε q α (β - β') = kstar ε q α β - kstar ε q α β'
proof:
:= by
  rw [sub_eq_add_neg, kstar_add_right, ← neg_one_smul R β', kstar_smul_right, neg_one_smul,
    ← sub_eq_add_neg]

name: Operad.AInf.tstar_sub_left
statement:
lemma tstar_sub_left (q : ℕ) (f f' g : Fam R V) :
    tstar ε q (f - f') g = tstar ε q f g - tstar ε q f' g
proof:
:= by
  funext m
  simp only [tstar_apply, Pi.sub_apply, ← Finset.sum_sub_distrib, kstar_sub_left, acast_sub]

name: Operad.AInf.tstar_sub_right
statement:
lemma tstar_sub_right (q : ℕ) (f g g' : Fam R V) :
    tstar ε q f (g - g') = tstar ε q f g - tstar ε q f g'
proof:
:= by
  funext m
  simp only [tstar_apply, Pi.sub_apply, ← Finset.sum_sub_distrib, kstar_sub_right, acast_sub]

name: Operad.AInf.tstar_smul_left
statement:
lemma tstar_smul_left (q : ℕ) (c : R) (f g : Fam R V) :
    tstar ε q (c • f) g = c • tstar ε q f g
proof:
:= by
  funext m
  simp only [tstar_apply, Pi.smul_apply, kstar_smul_left, acast_smul, Finset.smul_sum]

name: Operad.AInf.tstar_smul_right
statement:
lemma tstar_smul_right (q : ℕ) (c : R) (f g : Fam R V) :
    tstar ε q f (c • g) = c • tstar ε q f g
proof:
:= by
  funext m
  simp only [tstar_apply, Pi.smul_apply, kstar_smul_right, acast_smul, Finset.smul_sum]

name: Operad.AInf.tstar_zero_left
statement: @[simp] lemma tstar_zero_left (q : ℕ) (g : Fam R V) : tstar ε q 0 g = 0
proof:
:= by
  funext m
  simp [tstar_apply]

name: Operad.AInf.tstar_zero_right
statement: @[simp] lemma tstar_zero_right (q : ℕ) (f : Fam R V) : tstar ε q f 0 = 0
proof:
:= by
  funext m
  simp [tstar_apply]

name: Operad.AInf.sum_triangle
statement:
lemma sum_triangle {M : Type*} [AddCommMonoid M] (m : ℕ) (F : ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → M) :
    ∑ a ∈ range (m + 1), ∑ j ∈ range (a + 1), F j (a - j) (m - a)
      = ∑ j ∈ range (m + 1), ∑ k ∈ range (m - j + 1), F j k (m - j - k)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Finset.sum_sigma', Finset.sum_sigma']
  refine Finset.sum_nbij' (fun x => ⟨x.2, x.1 - x.2⟩) (fun y => ⟨y.1 + y.2, y.1⟩) ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_
  · rintro ⟨a, j⟩ hx
    simp only [Finset.mem_sigma, Finset.mem_range] at hx ⊢
    omega
  · rintro ⟨j, k⟩ hy
    simp only [Finset.mem_sigma, Finset.mem_range] at hy ⊢
    omega
  · rintro ⟨a, j⟩ hx
    simp only [Finset.mem_sigma, Finset.mem_range] at hx
    dsimp only
    simp only [Sigma.mk.injEq, heq_iff_eq, and_true]
    omega
  · rintro ⟨j, k⟩ hy
    simp only [Finset.mem_sigma, Finset.mem_range] at hy
    dsimp only
    simp only [Sigma.mk.injEq, heq_iff_eq, true_and]
    omega
  · rintro ⟨a, j⟩ hx
    simp only [Finset.mem_sigma, Finset.mem_range] at hx
    dsimp only
    congr 1
    omega

name: Operad.AInf.tstar_assoc_eq_defect
statement:
lemma tstar_assoc_eq_defect (q r : ℕ) (f g h : Fam R V) (m : ℕ) :
    tstar ε r (tstar ε q f g) h m - tstar ε (q + r) f (tstar ε r g h) m
      = defect ε q r f g h m
proof:
:= by
  have hL : tstar ε r (tstar ε q f g) h m
      = ∑ a ∈ range (m + 1), ∑ j ∈ range (a + 1),
          acast (kstar ε r (kstar ε q (f j) (g (a - j))) (h (m - a))) := by
    rw [tstar_apply]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun a ha => ?_
    rw [tstar_apply, kstar_sum_left, acast_sum]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j hj => ?_
    have hj' : j ≤ a := by simp only [Finset.mem_range] at hj; omega
    rw [kstar_acast_left ε r (show j + (a - j) = a by omega), acast_acast]
    omega
  have hR : tstar ε (q + r) f (tstar ε r g h) m
      = ∑ j ∈ range (m + 1), ∑ k ∈ range (m - j + 1),
          acast (kstar ε (q + r) (f j) (kstar ε r (g k) (h (m - j - k)))) := by
    rw [tstar_apply]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j hj => ?_
    rw [tstar_apply, kstar_sum_right, acast_sum]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun k hk => ?_
    have hj' : j ≤ m := by simp only [Finset.mem_range] at hj; omega
    have hk' : k ≤ m - j := by simp only [Finset.mem_range] at hk; omega
    rw [kstar_acast_right ε (q + r) (show k + (m - j - k) = m - j by omega), acast_acast]
    omega
  rw [hL, hR, sum_triangle m (fun j k l =>
    (acast (kstar ε r (kstar ε q (f j) (g k)) (h l)) : End R V (m + 1))), defect,
    ← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => ?_
  rw [← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun k _ => ?_
  rw [kstar_kstar_left_split, acast_add, acast_reindex]
  abel

name: Operad.AInf.defect_symm
statement:
lemma defect_symm (q r : ℕ) (f : Fam R V) {g h : Fam R V} (hg : ∀ n, IsHomog ε q (g n))
    (hh : ∀ n, IsHomog ε r (h n)) (m : ℕ) :
    defect ε q r f g h m = (-1 : R) ^ (q * r) • defect ε r q f h g m
proof:
:= by
  unfold defect
  rw [Finset.smul_sum]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j hj => ?_
  rw [Finset.smul_sum]
  conv_rhs => rw [← Finset.sum_range_reflect]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun k hk => ?_
  simp only [Finset.mem_range] at hj hk
  rw [kdisjointPart_symm hε q r (f j) (hg k) (hh (m - j - k)), acast_smul, acast_reindex,
    show m - j + 1 - 1 - k = m - j - k by omega, show m - j - (m - j - k) = k by omega]

name: Operad.AInf.tstar_assoc_symm
statement:
theorem tstar_assoc_symm (q r : ℕ) (f : Fam R V) {g h : Fam R V} (hg : ∀ n, IsHomog ε q (g n))
    (hh : ∀ n, IsHomog ε r (h n)) :
    tstar ε r (tstar ε q f g) h - tstar ε (q + r) f (tstar ε r g h)
      = (-1 : R) ^ (q * r) • (tstar ε q (tstar ε r f h) g - tstar ε (r + q) f (tstar ε q h g))
proof:
:= by
  funext m
  rw [Pi.sub_apply, tstar_assoc_eq_defect, Pi.smul_apply, Pi.sub_apply, tstar_assoc_eq_defect,
    defect_symm ε hε q r f hg hh]

name: Operad.AInf.tstar_tstar_odd
statement:
theorem tstar_tstar_odd (f : Fam R V) {b : Fam R V} (hb : ∀ n, IsHomog ε 1 (b n)) :
    tstar ε 1 (tstar ε 1 f b) b = tstar ε (1 + 1) f (tstar ε 1 b b)
proof:
:= by
  funext m
  rw [← sub_eq_zero, tstar_assoc_eq_defect, defect]
  refine Finset.sum_eq_zero fun j hj => ?_
  simp only [kdisjointPart_eq, acast_add, Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  rw [add_eq_zero_iff_eq_neg, ← Finset.sum_neg_distrib]
  conv_rhs => rw [← Finset.sum_range_reflect]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun k hk => ?_
  simp only [Finset.mem_range] at hj hk
  rw [kbefore_eq hε 1 1 (f j) (b k) (hb (m - j - k)), acast_smul, acast_reindex]
  simp only [mul_one, pow_one, neg_one_smul]
  rw [show m - j + 1 - 1 - k = m - j - k by omega, show m - j - (m - j - k) = k by omega]

name: Operad.AInf.hoch_hoch
statement:
theorem hoch_hoch {b : Fam R V} (hb : IsAInf ε b) (p : ℕ) {f : Fam R V}
    (hf : ∀ n, IsHomog ε p (f n)) : hoch ε b (p + 1) (hoch ε b p f) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hpl := tstar_assoc_symm ε hε 1 p b hb.odd hf
  rw [hb.mc, tstar_zero_left, zero_sub, add_comm 1 p, one_mul] at hpl
  have hodd := tstar_tstar_odd ε hε f hb.odd
  rw [hb.mc, tstar_zero_right] at hodd
  unfold hoch
  rw [tstar_sub_right, tstar_smul_right, tstar_sub_left, tstar_smul_left, hodd, smul_zero,
    sub_zero]
  linear_combination (norm := module) (-1 : R) • hpl

name: Operad.AInf.kstar_apply_11
statement:
lemma kstar_apply_11 (d d' : End R V 1) (v : Fin 1 → V) :
    kstar ε 1 d d' v = d ![d' ![v 0]]
proof:
:= by
  rw [kstar, Fin.sum_univ_one, kcompFin, compFin_apply, twist_apply]
  congr 1
  funext s
  fin_cases s
  simp only [Fin.zero_eta, Fin.isValue, Matrix.cons_val_fin_one]
  rw [twistFn_of_ge _ _ _ _ le_rfl, LinearMap.id_apply, cfTuple_of_eq _ _ _ _ rfl]
  congr 1
  funext t
  fin_cases t
  rfl

name: Operad.AInf.kstar_apply_12
statement:
lemma kstar_apply_12 (d : End R V 1) (μ : End R V 2) (v : Fin 2 → V) :
    kstar ε 1 d μ v = d ![μ ![v 0, v 1]]
proof:
:= by
  rw [kstar, Fin.sum_univ_one, kcompFin, compFin_apply, twist_apply]
  congr 1
  funext s
  fin_cases s
  simp only [Fin.zero_eta, Fin.isValue, Matrix.cons_val_fin_one]
  rw [twistFn_of_ge _ _ _ _ le_rfl, LinearMap.id_apply, cfTuple_of_eq _ _ _ _ rfl]
  congr 1
  funext t
  fin_cases t <;> rfl

name: Operad.AInf.kstar_apply_21
statement:
lemma kstar_apply_21 (μ : End R V 2) (d : End R V 1) (v : Fin 2 → V) :
    kstar ε 1 μ d v = μ ![d ![v 0], v 1] + μ ![ε (v 0), d ![v 1]]
proof:
:= by
  rw [kstar, Fin.sum_univ_two, MultilinearMap.add_apply]
  congr 1
  · rw [kcompFin, compFin_apply, twist_apply]
    congr 1
    funext s
    fin_cases s
    · simp only [Fin.zero_eta, Fin.isValue, Matrix.cons_val_zero]
      rw [twistFn_of_ge _ _ _ _ le_rfl, LinearMap.id_apply, cfTuple_of_eq _ _ _ _ rfl]
      congr 1
      funext t
      fin_cases t
      rfl
    · simp only [Fin.mk_one, Fin.isValue, Matrix.cons_val_one, Matrix.cons_val_fin_one]
      rw [twistFn_of_ge _ _ _ _ (by simp), LinearMap.id_apply,
        cfTuple_of_gt _ _ _ _ (by simp)]
      rfl
  · rw [kcompFin, compFin_apply, twist_apply]
    congr 1
    funext s
    fin_cases s
    · simp only [Fin.zero_eta, Fin.isValue, Matrix.cons_val_zero]
      rw [twistFn_of_lt _ _ _ _ (by simp), pow_one, cfTuple_of_lt _ _ _ _ (by simp)]
    · simp only [Fin.mk_one, Fin.isValue, Matrix.cons_val_one, Matrix.cons_val_fin_one]
      rw [twistFn_of_ge _ _ _ _ le_rfl, LinearMap.id_apply, cfTuple_of_eq _ _ _ _ rfl]
      congr 1
      funext t
      fin_cases t
      rfl

name: Operad.AInf.kstar_apply_22
statement:
lemma kstar_apply_22 (μ ν : End R V 2) (v : Fin 3 → V) :
    kstar ε 1 μ ν v = μ ![ν ![v 0, v 1], v 2] + μ ![ε (v 0), ν ![v 1, v 2]]
proof:
:= by
  rw [kstar, Fin.sum_univ_two, MultilinearMap.add_apply]
  congr 1
  · rw [kcompFin, compFin_apply, twist_apply]
    congr 1
    funext s
    fin_cases s
    · simp only [Fin.zero_eta, Fin.isValue, Matrix.cons_val_zero]
      rw [twistFn_of_ge _ _ _ _ le_rfl, LinearMap.id_apply, cfTuple_of_eq _ _ _ _ rfl]
      congr 1
      funext t
      fin_cases t <;> rfl
    · simp only [Fin.mk_one, Fin.isValue, Matrix.cons_val_one, Matrix.cons_val_fin_one]
      rw [twistFn_of_ge _ _ _ _ (by simp), LinearMap.id_apply,
        cfTuple_of_gt _ _ _ _ (by simp)]
      rfl
  · rw [kcompFin, compFin_apply, twist_apply]
    congr 1
    funext s
    fin_cases s
    · simp only [Fin.zero_eta, Fin.isValue, Matrix.cons_val_zero]
      rw [twistFn_of_lt _ _ _ _ (by simp), pow_one, cfTuple_of_lt _ _ _ _ (by simp)]
      rfl
    · simp only [Fin.mk_one, Fin.isValue, Matrix.cons_val_one, Matrix.cons_val_fin_one]
      rw [twistFn_of_ge _ _ _ _ le_rfl, LinearMap.id_apply, cfTuple_of_eq _ _ _ _ rfl]
      congr 1
      funext t
      fin_cases t <;> rfl

name: Operad.AInf.isAInf_dga_iff
statement:
theorem isAInf_dga_iff {d : End R V 1} {μ : End R V 2} (hd : IsHomog ε 1 d)
    (hμ : IsHomog ε 1 μ) :
    IsAInf ε (dga R V d μ) ↔
      (∀ x, d ![d ![x]] = 0) ∧
      (∀ x y, d ![μ ![x, y]] + μ ![d ![x], y] + μ ![ε x, d ![y]] = 0) ∧
      (∀ x y z, μ ![μ ![x, y], z] + μ ![ε x, μ ![y, z]] = 0)
proof:
:= by
  have h0 : tstar ε 1 (dga R V d μ) (dga R V d μ) 0 = kstar ε 1 d d := by
    simp [tstar_apply, dga]
  have h1 : tstar ε 1 (dga R V d μ) (dga R V d μ) 1 = kstar ε 1 d μ + kstar ε 1 μ d := by
    simp [tstar_apply, Finset.sum_range_succ, dga]
  have h2 : tstar ε 1 (dga R V d μ) (dga R V d μ) 2 = kstar ε 1 μ μ := by
    simp [tstar_apply, Finset.sum_range_succ, dga]
  have h3 : ∀ m, tstar ε 1 (dga R V d μ) (dga R V d μ) (m + 3) = 0 := by
    intro m
    rw [tstar_apply]
    refine Finset.sum_eq_zero fun j hj => ?_
    simp only [Finset.mem_range] at hj
    rcases j with _ | _ | j
    · simp [dga]
    · simp [dga]
    · simp [dga]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨-, hmc⟩
    refine ⟨fun x => ?_, fun x y => ?_, fun x y z => ?_⟩
    · have := congrArg (fun F => F 0 ![x]) hmc
      simpa [h0, kstar_apply_11] using this
    · have := congrArg (fun F => F 1 ![x, y]) hmc
      simp only [h1, Pi.zero_apply, MultilinearMap.zero_apply, MultilinearMap.add_apply,
        kstar_apply_12, kstar_apply_21] at this
      simpa [add_assoc] using this
    · have := congrArg (fun F => F 2 ![x, y, z]) hmc
      simpa [h2, kstar_apply_22] using this
  · rintro ⟨e1, e2, e3⟩
    refine ⟨fun n => ?_, ?_⟩
    · rcases n with _ | _ | n
      · exact hd
      · exact hμ
      · intro v
        simp [dga]
    · funext m
      rcases m with _ | _ | _ | m
      · ext v
        rw [h0, kstar_apply_11]
        exact e1 (v 0)
      · ext v
        rw [h1, MultilinearMap.add_apply, kstar_apply_12, kstar_apply_21, ← add_assoc]
        exact e2 (v 0) (v 1)
      · ext v
        rw [h2, kstar_apply_22]
        exact e3 (v 0) (v 1) (v 2)
      · exact h3 m

name: Operad.FinBij.hom_refl
statement:
@[simp] lemma FinBij.hom_refl {S : FintypeCat.{u}} :
    FinBij.hom (Equiv.refl S) = 𝟙 (⟨S⟩ : FinBij.{u})
proof:
:=
  Core.hom_ext rfl

name: Operad.FinBij.hom_trans
statement:
lemma FinBij.hom_trans {S T U : FintypeCat.{u}} (e : S ≃ T) (e' : T ≃ U) :
    FinBij.hom (e.trans e') = FinBij.hom e ≫ FinBij.hom e'
proof:
:=
  Core.hom_ext rfl

name: Operad.Species.act_refl
statement:
@[simp] lemma act_refl (F : Species R) {S : Type u} [Finite S] :
    F.act (Equiv.refl S) = 𝟙 _
proof:
:= by
  rw [act, FinBij.hom_refl, F.map_id]

name: Operad.Species.act_trans
statement:
lemma act_trans (F : Species R) {S T U : Type u} [Finite S] [Finite T] [Finite U]
    (e : S ≃ T) (e' : T ≃ U) : F.act (e.trans e') = F.act e ≫ F.act e'
proof:
:= by
  rw [act, act, act, ← F.map_comp]
  exact congrArg F.map (FinBij.hom_trans (S := FintypeCat.of S) (T := FintypeCat.of T)
    (U := FintypeCat.of U) e e')

name: Operad.HyperCom.wEquiv_inr
statement:
@[simp] lemma wEquiv_inr {n : ℕ} (S : Finset (Fin n)) (t : Fin S.card) :
    wEquiv S (Sum.inr t) = S.orderEmbOfFin rfl t
proof:
:= by
  simp [wEquiv, Finset.coe_orderIsoOfFin_apply]

name: Operad.HyperCom.wEquiv_inl
statement:
@[simp] lemma wEquiv_inl {n : ℕ} (S : Finset (Fin n)) (x : Without (Fin (Sᶜ.card + 1)) 0) :
    wEquiv S (Sum.inl x) = Sᶜ.orderEmbOfFin rfl (withoutZero _ x)
proof:
:= by
  simp [wEquiv, Finset.coe_orderIsoOfFin_apply]

name: Operad.HyperCom.freeHCEquiv_symm
statement:
lemma freeHCEquiv_symm (μ : ∀ n, 2 ≤ n → EndOp R V (Fin n)) :
    (freeHCEquiv V).symm μ = hcHom V μ
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: Operad.HyperCom.hcHom_single
statement:
lemma hcHom_single (μ : ∀ n, 2 ≤ n → EndOp R V (Fin n)) {A : Type} [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A]
    (x : Syn HCGen A) :
    (hcHom V μ).app A (Finsupp.single (Pres.mk x) 1)
      = (Und.of R (EndOp R V)).symm (Syn.eval (hcVal V μ) x)
proof:
:= by
  show Finsupp.lift (EndOp R V A) R (FreeSet HCGen A) _ (Finsupp.single (Pres.mk x) 1) = _
  simp
  rfl

name: Operad.HyperCom.hcHom_mono
statement:
lemma hcHom_mono (μ : ∀ n, 2 ≤ n → EndOp R V (Fin n)) {n : ℕ} (h : 2 ≤ n)
    (σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin n)) (v : Fin n → V) :
    (hcHom V μ).app (Fin n) (mono n h σ) v = μ n h fun a => v (σ a)
proof:
:= by
  rw [mono, hcHom_single]
  rfl

name: Operad.HyperCom.hcHom_wTerm
statement:
lemma hcHom_wTerm (μ : ∀ n, 2 ≤ n → EndOp R V (Fin n)) {n : ℕ} (S : Finset (Fin n))
    (v : Fin n → V) : (hcHom V μ).app (Fin n) (wTerm S) v = wVal V μ S v
proof:
:= by
  unfold wTerm wVal
  split_ifs with h
  · rw [hcHom_single]
    show EndOp.ap (map (wEquiv S) (comp 0 (Und.of R (EndOp R V) (μ _ _))
      (Und.of R (EndOp R V) (μ _ _)))) v = _
    rw [EndOp.ap_map, EndOp.ap_comp]
    show μ _ _ _ = μ _ _ _
    congr 1
    funext t
    refine Fin.cases ?_ (fun t => ?_) t
    · rw [feed_self, Fin.cons_zero]
      show μ _ _ _ = μ _ _ _
      congr 1
    · rw [feed_of_ne (Fin.succ_ne_zero t), Fin.cons_succ, wEquiv_inl]
      rfl
  · rfl

name: Operad.HyperCom.rel_iff
statement:
lemma rel_iff (μ : ∀ n, 2 ≤ n → EndOp R V (Fin n)) :
    (∀ n, ∀ x ∈ hcRel R n, (hcHom V μ).app (Fin n) x = 0) ↔ IsHC R V μ
proof:
:= by
  have hsym : ∀ n (h : 2 ≤ n) (σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin n)),
      (hcHom V μ).app (Fin n) (mono n h σ - mono n h 1) = 0 ↔
        ∀ v : Fin n → V, μ n h (fun a => v (σ a)) = μ n h v := by
    intro n h σ
    rw [map_sub, sub_eq_zero]
    refine ⟨fun H v => ?_, fun H => MultilinearMap.ext fun v => ?_⟩
    · have := congrArg (fun F : EndOp R V (Fin n) => F v) H
      simpa only [hcHom_mono, Equiv.Perm.one_apply] using this
    · rw [hcHom_mono, hcHom_mono, H]
      rfl
  have hw : ∀ n (i j k : Fin n), (hcHom V μ).app (Fin n) (wdvv i j k) = 0 ↔
      ∀ v : Fin n → V, ∑ S ∈ univ.filter (fun S => i ∈ S ∧ j ∈ S ∧ k ∉ S), wVal V μ S v
        = ∑ S ∈ univ.filter (fun S => i ∈ S ∧ k ∈ S ∧ j ∉ S), wVal V μ S v := by
    intro n i j k
    rw [wdvv, map_sub, sub_eq_zero]
    refine ⟨fun H v => ?_, fun H => MultilinearMap.ext fun v => ?_⟩
    · have := congrArg (fun F : EndOp R V (Fin n) => F v) H
      simpa only [map_sum, MultilinearMap.sum_apply, hcHom_wTerm] using this
    · simp only [map_sum, MultilinearMap.sum_apply, hcHom_wTerm]
      exact H v
  constructor
  · intro H
    refine ⟨fun n h σ => (hsym n h σ).1 (H n _ (Or.inl ⟨h, σ, rfl⟩)),
      fun n i j k hij hik hjk => (hw n i j k).1 (H n _ (Or.inr ⟨i, j, k, hij, hik, hjk, rfl⟩))⟩
  · rintro ⟨H₁, H₂⟩ n x (⟨h, σ, rfl⟩ | ⟨i, j, k, hij, hik, hjk, rfl⟩)
    · exact (hsym n h σ).2 (H₁ n h σ)
    · exact (hw n i j k).2 (H₂ n i j k hij hik hjk)

name: Operad.HyperCom.μ_congr
statement:
lemma μ_congr (μ : ∀ n, 2 ≤ n → EndOp R V (Fin n)) {m m' : ℕ} (h : m = m') (hm : 2 ≤ m)
    (hm' : 2 ≤ m') {w : Fin m → V} {w' : Fin m' → V} (hw : ∀ i, w i = w' (Fin.cast h i)) :
    μ m hm w = μ m' hm' w'
proof:
:= by
  subst h
  congr 1
  funext i
  exact hw i

name: Operad.HyperCom.min'_pair
statement:
lemma min'_pair {p q : Fin 3} {S : Finset (Fin 3)} (hS : S = {p, q}) (hpq : p < q)
    (hne : S.Nonempty) : S.min' hne = p
proof:
:=
  le_antisymm (Finset.min'_le S p (by rw [hS]; simp)) (Finset.le_min' S hne p fun y hy => by
    rw [hS] at hy
    simp only [Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_singleton] at hy
    rcases hy with rfl | rfl
    exacts [le_rfl, hpq.le])

name: Operad.HyperCom.max'_pair
statement:
lemma max'_pair {p q : Fin 3} {S : Finset (Fin 3)} (hS : S = {p, q}) (hpq : p < q)
    (hne : S.Nonempty) : S.max' hne = q
proof:
:=
  le_antisymm (Finset.max'_le S hne q fun y hy => by
    rw [hS] at hy
    simp only [Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_singleton] at hy
    rcases hy with rfl | rfl
    exacts [hpq.le, le_rfl]) (Finset.le_max' S q (by rw [hS]; simp))

name: Operad.HyperCom.wVal_pair
proof:
:= by
  have hc : S.card = 2 := by rw [hS]; exact Finset.card_pair hpq.ne
  have hc' : Sᶜ.card = 1 := by rw [hr]; rfl
  unfold wVal
  rw [dif_pos ⟨hc.ge, hc'.ge⟩]
  refine μ_congr μ (by omega) _ _ fun t => ?_
  refine Fin.cases ?_ (fun t => ?_) t
  · rw [Fin.cons_zero]
    refine (μ_congr μ hc _ _ fun s => ?_).trans rfl
    obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := s
    have hs' : s = 0 ∨ s = 1 := by omega
    rcases hs' with rfl | rfl
    · rw [Finset.orderEmbOfFin_zero rfl (by omega), min'_pair hS hpq]
      rfl
    · have h1 : (⟨1, hs⟩ : Fin S.card) = ⟨S.card - 1, by omega⟩ := Fin.ext (by simp; omega)
      rw [h1, Finset.orderEmbOfFin_last rfl (by omega), max'_pair hS hpq,
        show Fin.cast hc (⟨S.card - 1, by omega⟩ : Fin S.card) = 1 from Fin.ext (by simp; omega)]
      rfl
  · rw [Fin.cons_succ]
    obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := t
    obtain rfl : t = 0 := by omega
    rw [Finset.orderEmbOfFin_zero rfl (by omega)]
    have hm : Sᶜ.min' (Finset.card_pos.mp (by omega)) = r := by
      have hall : ∀ y ∈ Sᶜ, y = r := fun y hy => by
        rw [hr] at hy
        exact Finset.mem_singleton.mp hy
      exact hall _ (Finset.min'_mem _ _)
    rw [hm]
    rfl

name: Operad.HCAlg.mul_comm
statement: theorem mul_comm (x y : V) : a.mul x y = a.mul y x
proof:
:= by
  have h := a.symm 2 le_rfl (Equiv.swap 0 1) ![x, y]
  rw [EndOp.vec_swap] at h
  exact h.symm

name: Operad.HCAlg.wdvv_three
statement: lemma wdvv_three (x y z : V) : a.mul (a.mul x y) z = a.mul (a.mul x z) y
proof:
:= by
  have h := a.wdvv 3 0 1 2 (by decide) (by decide) (by decide) ![x, y, z]
  rw [show (univ.filter fun S : Finset (Fin 3) => 0 ∈ S ∧ 1 ∈ S ∧ 2 ∉ S) = {{0, 1}} by decide,
    show (univ.filter fun S : Finset (Fin 3) => 0 ∈ S ∧ 2 ∈ S ∧ 1 ∉ S) = {{0, 2}} by decide,
    Finset.sum_singleton, Finset.sum_singleton,
    wVal_pair (p := 0) (q := 1) (r := 2) _ _ rfl (by decide) (by decide),
    wVal_pair (p := 0) (q := 2) (r := 1) _ _ rfl (by decide) (by decide)] at h
  exact h

name: Operad.HCAlg.mul_assoc
statement: theorem mul_assoc (x y z : V) : a.mul (a.mul x y) z = a.mul x (a.mul y z)
proof:
:= by
  rw [a.mul_comm x (a.mul y z), a.wdvv_three y z x, a.mul_comm y x]

name: Operad.HCAlg.comOps_two
statement: lemma comOps_two (v : Fin 2 → A) : comOps R A 2 le_rfl v = v 0 * v 1
proof:
:= by
  simp [comOps, MultilinearMap.mkPiAlgebra_apply, Fin.prod_univ_two]

name: Operad.HCAlg.comOps_of_ne
statement: lemma comOps_of_ne {n : ℕ} (h : 2 ≤ n) (hn : n ≠ 2) : comOps R A n h = 0
proof: := if_neg hn

name: Operad.HCAlg.wVal_comOps_eq_zero
statement:
lemma wVal_comOps_eq_zero {n : ℕ} (hn : 4 ≤ n) (S : Finset (Fin n)) (v : Fin n → A) :
    wVal A (comOps R A) S v = 0
proof:
:= by
  unfold wVal
  split_ifs with h
  · by_cases hc : Sᶜ.card + 1 = 2
    · have hS : S.card ≠ 2 := by
        have := Finset.card_add_card_compl S
        simp only [Fintype.card_fin] at this
        omega
      rw [comOps_of_ne R A h.1 hS]
      exact MultilinearMap.map_coord_zero _ 0 (by rw [Fin.cons_zero]; rfl)
    · rw [comOps_of_ne R A _ hc]
      rfl
  · rfl

name: Operad.iSupIndep_finsupp_eq_zero
statement:
lemma iSupIndep_finsupp_eq_zero {p : ℕ → Submodule R M} (hp : iSupIndep p) (f : ℕ →₀ M)
    (hf : ∀ j, f j ∈ p j) (hs : f.sum (fun _ v => v) = 0) (j : ℕ) : f j = 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_cases hj : j ∈ f.support
  · exact ((iSupIndep_iff_finsetSum_eq_zero_imp_eq_zero p).1 hp) f.support f
      (fun i _ => hf i) hs j hj
  · exact Finsupp.notMem_support_iff.1 hj

name: Operad.exists_eq_of_contract
statement:
theorem exists_eq_of_contract [Algebra ℚ R] (N δ D Nv : M →ₗ[R] M) (k : R)
    (hNδ : ∀ x, N (δ x) = δ (N x))
    (hNNv : ∀ x, N (Nv x) = Nv (N x)) (hNvD : ∀ x, Nv (D x) = D (Nv x))
    (hc : ∀ x, δ (D x) + D (δ x) = N x) {x : M}
    (hx : x ∈ ⨆ j : ℕ, Module.End.eigenspace N ((j + 1 : ℕ) : R)) (hδx : δ x = 0)
    (hNv : Nv x = k • x) : ∃ z, Nv z = k • z ∧ δ z = x
proof:
:= by
  have hind : iSupIndep fun j : ℕ => Module.End.eigenspace N ((j + 1 : ℕ) : R) :=
    iSupIndep.comp (t := fun j : ℕ => Module.End.eigenspace N (j : R))
      (iSupIndep_eigenspace_nat N) (f := fun j => j + 1) (fun a b h => Nat.succ_injective h)
  obtain ⟨f, hf, rfl⟩ := (Submodule.mem_iSup_iff_exists_finsupp _ x).1 hx
  have hmem : ∀ (φ : M →ₗ[R] M), (∀ y, N (φ y) = φ (N y)) → ∀ j,
      φ (f j) ∈ Module.End.eigenspace N ((j + 1 : ℕ) : R) := fun φ hφ j => by
    rw [Module.End.mem_eigenspace_iff, hφ, Module.End.mem_eigenspace_iff.1 (hf j), map_smul]
  
  have hδf : ∀ j, δ (f j) = 0 := iSupIndep_finsupp_eq_zero hind (f.mapRange δ (map_zero δ))
    (fun j => by rw [Finsupp.mapRange_apply]; exact hmem δ hNδ j)
    (by rw [Finsupp.sum_mapRange_index (fun _ => rfl), ← map_finsuppSum]; exact hδx)
  let φ : M →ₗ[R] M := Nv - k • LinearMap.id
  have hφ : ∀ y, N (φ y) = φ (N y) := fun y => by
    simp only [φ, LinearMap.sub_apply, LinearMap.smul_apply, LinearMap.id_apply, map_sub,
      map_smul, hNNv]
  have hNvf : ∀ j, Nv (f j) = k • f j := fun j => by
    have h := iSupIndep_finsupp_eq_zero hind (f.mapRange φ (map_zero φ))
      (fun j => by rw [Finsupp.mapRange_apply]; exact hmem φ hφ j)
      (by
        rw [Finsupp.sum_mapRange_index (fun _ => rfl), ← map_finsuppSum]
        simp only [φ, LinearMap.sub_apply, LinearMap.smul_apply, LinearMap.id_apply, hNv,
          sub_self]) j
    rw [Finsupp.mapRange_apply] at h
    simpa only [φ, LinearMap.sub_apply, LinearMap.smul_apply, LinearMap.id_apply,
      sub_eq_zero] using h
  let c : ℕ → R := fun j => algebraMap ℚ R ((j + 1 : ℕ) : ℚ)⁻¹
  have hc1 : ∀ j, c j * ((j + 1 : ℕ) : R) = 1 := fun j => by
    rw [show ((j + 1 : ℕ) : R) = algebraMap ℚ R ((j + 1 : ℕ) : ℚ) from (map_natCast _ _).symm,
      ← map_mul, inv_mul_cancel₀ (by positivity), map_one]
  refine ⟨f.sum fun j v => c j • D v, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [map_finsuppSum, Finsupp.smul_sum]
    refine Finsupp.sum_congr fun j _ => ?_
    rw [map_smul, hNvD, hNvf, map_smul, smul_comm]
  · rw [map_finsuppSum]
    refine Finsupp.sum_congr fun j _ => ?_
    have := hc (f j)
    rw [hδf, map_zero, add_zero, Module.End.mem_eigenspace_iff.1 (hf j)] at this
    rw [map_smul, this, smul_smul, hc1, one_smul]

name: Operad.FreeGrL.derSp_comm
statement:
lemma derSp_comm {a : GrSpEnd R V e} {b : GrSpEnd R V e'}
    (h : ∀ (A : Type) [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] (x : V A),
      a.app A (b.app A x) = σ R (e && e') • b.app A (a.app A x))
    {A : Type} [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] (x : FreeGrL R V A) :
    (derSp a).app A ((derSp b).app A x) = σ R (e && e') • (derSp b).app A ((derSp a).app A x)
proof:
:= by
  have h0 := derSp_gcomm_app a b x
  rw [derSp_congr (ψ := GrSpEnd.zero R V (xor e e')) (fun A _ _ x => by
    rw [GrSpEnd.gcomm_app, h, sub_self, GrSpEnd.zero_app]), derSp_zero_app] at h0
  exact sub_eq_zero.1 h0

name: Operad.FreeGrL.mapSp_derSp_comm
statement:
lemma mapSp_derSp_comm {a : GrSpEnd R V false} {φ : GrSpEnd R V false}
    (h : ∀ (A : Type) [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] (x : V A),
      a.app A (φ.app A x) = φ.app A (a.app A x))
    {A : Type} [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] (x : FreeGrL R V A) :
    (derSp a).app A ((mapSp φ.toHom).app A x) = (mapSp φ.toHom).app A ((derSp a).app A x)
proof:
:=
  derSp_mapSp (fun A _ _ v => h A v) x

name: Operad.Splitting.mapSp_derSp
statement:
lemma mapSp_derSp {A : Type} [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] (x : FreeGrL R V A) :
    (mapSp s.p.toHom).app A ((derSp d).app A x) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [← derSp_mapSp (b := GrSpEnd.zero R V true) (fun A _ _ v => by
    rw [GrSpEnd.zero_app, GrSpEnd.toHom_app, s.pd]), derSp_zero_app]

name: Operad.Splitting.derSp_mapSp
statement:
lemma derSp_mapSp {A : Type} [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] (x : FreeGrL R V A) :
    (derSp d).app A ((mapSp s.p.toHom).app A x) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [FreeGrL.derSp_mapSp (a := GrSpEnd.zero R V true) (fun A _ _ v => by
    rw [GrSpEnd.toHom_app, s.dp, GrSpEnd.zero_app, map_zero]), derSp_zero_app, map_zero]

name: Operad.Splitting.mapSp_mapSp
statement:
lemma mapSp_mapSp {A : Type} [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] (x : FreeGrL R V A) :
    (mapSp s.p.toHom).app A ((mapSp s.p.toHom).app A x) = (mapSp s.p.toHom).app A x
proof:
:= by
  rw [mapSp_comp]
  exact mapSp_congr (fun A _ _ v => s.pp A v) x

name: Operad.Splitting.contract
statement:
lemma contract {A : Type} [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] (x : FreeGrL R V A) :
    (derSp d).app A ((derSp s.h).app A x) + (derSp s.h).app A ((derSp d).app A x)
      = (derSp (GrSpEnd.compl R V s.p)).app A x
proof:
:= by
  have h0 := derSp_gcomm_app d s.h x
  rw [Bool.and_self, σ_true, neg_one_smul, sub_neg_eq_add] at h0
  rw [h0]
  exact derSp_congr (fun A _ _ v => by
    rw [GrSpEnd.gcomm_app, Bool.and_self, σ_true, neg_one_smul, sub_neg_eq_add, s.dh]; rfl) x

name: Operad.Splitting.retract
statement:
theorem retract [Algebra ℚ R] (k : ℕ) (A : Type) [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] :
    QIso.Retract (eig R V c k A) ((derSp d).app A) ((mapSp s.p.toHom).app A) where
  mem x hx
proof:
:= mem_eig.2 (by rw [mapSp_derSp_comm hcp, mem_eig.1 hx, map_smul])
  memD x hx := mem_eig.2 (by
    rw [derSp_comm (e := false) (e' := true) (fun A _ _ x => by rw [hcd, Bool.false_and, σ_false,
      one_smul]), Bool.false_and, σ_false, one_smul, mem_eig.1 hx, map_smul])
  rr x := s.mapSp_mapSp x
  rD x := s.mapSp_derSp x
  Dr x := s.derSp_mapSp x
  acyc x hx hδx hpx := by
    have hpos := sub_mapSp_mem s.p s.pp x
    rw [hpx, sub_zero] at hpos
    have hcompl : ∀ (A : Type) [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] (y : V A),
        (GrSpEnd.compl R V s.p).app A (c.app A y) = c.app A ((GrSpEnd.compl R V s.p).app A y) :=
      fun A _ _ y => by rw [GrSpEnd.compl_app, GrSpEnd.compl_app, map_sub, hcp]
    obtain ⟨z, hz, hδz⟩ := exists_eq_of_contract ((derSp (GrSpEnd.compl R V s.p)).app A)
      ((derSp d).app A) ((derSp s.h).app A) ((derSp c).app A) (k : R)
      (fun y => by
        rw [derSp_comm (e := false) (e' := true) (fun A _ _ y => by
          rw [GrSpEnd.compl_app, GrSpEnd.compl_app, map_sub, s.pd, s.dp, Bool.false_and,
            σ_false, one_smul])]
        rw [Bool.false_and, σ_false, one_smul])
      (fun y => by
        rw [derSp_comm (e := false) (e' := false) (fun A _ _ y => by
          rw [hcompl, Bool.false_and, σ_false, one_smul])]
        rw [Bool.false_and, σ_false, one_smul])
      (fun y => by
        rw [derSp_comm (e := false) (e' := true) (fun A _ _ y => by
          rw [hch, Bool.false_and, σ_false, one_smul])]
        rw [Bool.false_and, σ_false, one_smul])
      (fun y => s.contract y) hpos hδx (mem_eig.1 hx)
    exact ⟨z, mem_eig.2 hz, hδz⟩

name: Operad.FreeBin.Cert3.coeff_nil
statement: @[simp] lemma coeff_nil (m : Mono3 G) : coeff [] m = 0
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.FreeBin.Cert3.coeff_cons
statement:
lemma coeff_cons (p : Mono3 G × ℤ) (l : Cert3 G) (m : Mono3 G) :
    coeff (p :: l) m = (if p.1 = m then p.2 else 0) + coeff l m
proof:
:= by
  simp [coeff]

name: Operad.FreeBin.Cert3.coeff_append
statement: lemma coeff_append (l l' : Cert3 G) (m : Mono3 G) : coeff (l ++ l') m = coeff l m + coeff l' m
proof:
:= by
  simp [coeff]

name: Operad.FreeBin.Cert3.coeff_smul
statement: lemma coeff_smul (c : ℤ) (l : Cert3 G) (m : Mono3 G) : coeff (smul c l) m = c * coeff l m
proof:
:= by
  induction l with
  | nil => simp [smul]
  | cons p l ih =>
    simp only [smul, List.map_cons] at ih ⊢
    rw [coeff_cons, coeff_cons, ih, mul_add]
    split_ifs <;> simp

name: Operad.FreeBin.Cert3.val_nil
statement: @[simp] lemma val_nil : val K ([] : Cert3 G) = 0
proof: := by simp [val]

name: Operad.FreeBin.Cert3.val_cons
statement:
@[simp] lemma val_cons (p : Mono3 G × ℤ) (l : Cert3 G) :
    val K (p :: l) = (p.2 : K) • mono3 K p.1 + val K l
proof:
:= by
  simp [val]

name: Operad.FreeBin.Cert3.val_append
statement: lemma val_append (l l' : Cert3 G) : val K (l ++ l') = val K l + val K l'
proof:
:= by
  simp [val]

name: Operad.FreeBin.Cert3.val_smul
statement: lemma val_smul (c : ℤ) (l : Cert3 G) : val K (smul c l) = (c : K) • val K l
proof:
:= by
  induction l with
  | nil => simp [smul]
  | cons p l ih =>
    simp only [smul, List.map_cons] at ih ⊢
    rw [val_cons, val_cons, ih, smul_add, smul_smul]
    push_cast
    rfl

name: Operad.FreeBin.Cert3.map_val
statement:
lemma map_val (τ : Equiv.Perm (Fin 3)) (l : Cert3 G) :
    SymOperad.map (R := K) τ (val K l) = val K (act τ l)
proof:
:= by
  induction l with
  | nil => simp [act]
  | cons p l ih =>
    simp only [act, List.map_cons] at ih ⊢
    rw [val_cons, val_cons, map_add, map_smul, map_mono3, ih]

name: Operad.FreeBin.Cert3.repr_val
statement: lemma repr_val (l : Cert3 G) (m : Mono3 G) : (basis3 K).repr (val K l) m = (coeff l m : K)
proof:
:= by
  induction l with
  | nil => simp
  | cons p l ih =>
    rw [val_cons, map_add, map_smul, Finsupp.add_apply, Finsupp.smul_apply, ← basis3_apply,
      Module.Basis.repr_self, ih, coeff_cons, Finsupp.single_apply]
    split_ifs <;> simp

name: Operad.FreeBin.Cert3.val_eq_of_coeff
statement: lemma val_eq_of_coeff {l l' : Cert3 G} (h : ∀ m, coeff l m = coeff l' m) : val K l = val K l'
proof:
:=
  (basis3 K).repr.injective (Finsupp.ext fun m => by rw [repr_val, repr_val, h])

name: Operad.FreeBin.Cert3.signZ_cast
statement: lemma signZ_cast {K : Type u} [Field K] (m : Mono3 G) : ((signZ m : ℤ) : K) = sign3 K m
proof:
:= by
  simp only [signZ, sign3]
  split_ifs <;> push_cast <;> ring

name: Operad.FreeBin.Cert3.pair_cons
statement:
lemma pair_cons (p : Mono3 G × ℤ) (l l' : Cert3 G) :
    pair (p :: l) l'
      = p.2 * (l'.map fun q => if p.1 = q.1 then signZ p.1 * q.2 else 0).sum + pair l l'
proof:
:= by
  simp [pair]

name: Operad.FreeBin.Cert3.pair3_mono3_val
statement:
lemma pair3_mono3_val {K : Type u} [Field K] (m : Mono3 G) (l : Cert3 G) :
    pair3 G K (mono3 K m) (val K l)
      = (((l.map fun q => if m = q.1 then signZ m * q.2 else 0).sum : ℤ) : K)
proof:
:= by
  induction l with
  | nil => simp
  | cons q l ih =>
    rw [val_cons, map_add, map_smul, ih, pair3_mono3, List.map_cons, List.sum_cons]
    push_cast
    split_ifs with h <;> simp [h, signZ_cast, mul_comm]

name: Operad.FreeBin.Cert3.pair3_val
statement:
lemma pair3_val {K : Type u} [Field K] (l l' : Cert3 G) :
    pair3 G K (val K l) (val K l') = (pair l l' : K)
proof:
:= by
  induction l with
  | nil => simp [pair]
  | cons p l ih =>
    rw [val_cons, map_add, map_smul, LinearMap.add_apply, LinearMap.smul_apply, ih,
      pair3_mono3_val, pair_cons]
    push_cast
    rw [smul_eq_mul]

name: Operad.FreeBin.Cert3.image_val_cons
statement:
lemma image_val_cons (a : Cert3 G) (l : List (Cert3 G)) :
    val K '' {r | r ∈ a :: l} = insert (val K a) (val K '' {r | r ∈ l})
proof:
:= by
  rw [show {r | r ∈ a :: l} = insert a {r | r ∈ l} from Set.ext fun _ => List.mem_cons,
    Set.image_insert_eq]

name: Operad.FreeBin.Cert3.image_val_nil
statement: lemma image_val_nil : val K '' {r | r ∈ ([] : List (Cert3 G))} = ∅
proof: := by simp

name: Operad.FreeBin.Cert2.val_nil
statement: @[simp] lemma val_nil : val K ([] : Cert2 G) = 0
proof: := by simp [val]

name: Operad.FreeBin.Cert2.val_cons
statement:
@[simp] lemma val_cons (p : (G × Equiv.Perm (Fin 2)) × ℤ) (l : Cert2 G) :
    val K (p :: l) = (p.2 : K) • bin2 p.1.1 p.1.2 + val K l
proof:
:= by
  simp [val]

name: Operad.FreeBin.Cert2.image_val_singleton
statement: lemma image_val_singleton (a : Cert2 G) : val K '' {r | r ∈ [a]} = {val K a}
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  simp [eq_comm]

name: Operad.FreeBin.Cert2.mono3_mono0
statement:
lemma mono3_mono0 (a b : G × Equiv.Perm (Fin 2)) :
    SymOperad.map (R := K) e0 (SymOperad.comp (R := K) 0 (bin2 a.1 a.2) (bin2 b.1 b.2))
      = mono3 K (mono0 a b)
proof:
:= by
  rw [comp_e0_bin2, mono0]
  split_ifs <;> rfl

name: Operad.FreeBin.Cert2.mono3_mono1
statement:
lemma mono3_mono1 (a b : G × Equiv.Perm (Fin 2)) :
    SymOperad.map (R := K) e1 (SymOperad.comp (R := K) 1 (bin2 a.1 a.2) (bin2 b.1 b.2))
      = mono3 K (mono1 a b)
proof:
:= by
  rw [comp_e1_bin2, mono1]
  split_ifs <;> rfl

name: Operad.FreeBin.Cert2.comp0_single
statement:
lemma comp0_single (p : (G × Equiv.Perm (Fin 2)) × ℤ) (b : Cert2 G) :
    SymOperad.map (R := K) e0 (SymOperad.comp (R := K) 0 ((p.2 : K) • bin2 p.1.1 p.1.2) (val K b))
      = Cert3.val K (b.map fun q => (mono0 p.1 q.1, p.2 * q.2))
proof:
:= by
  induction b with
  | nil => simp
  | cons q b ih =>
    rw [val_cons, map_add, map_add, ih, List.map_cons, Cert3.val_cons]
    congr 1
    simp only [map_smul, LinearMap.smul_apply, mono3_mono0, smul_smul, Int.cast_mul, mul_comm]

name: Operad.FreeBin.Cert2.comp1_single
statement:
lemma comp1_single (p : (G × Equiv.Perm (Fin 2)) × ℤ) (b : Cert2 G) :
    SymOperad.map (R := K) e1 (SymOperad.comp (R := K) 1 ((p.2 : K) • bin2 p.1.1 p.1.2) (val K b))
      = Cert3.val K (b.map fun q => (mono1 p.1 q.1, p.2 * q.2))
proof:
:= by
  induction b with
  | nil => simp
  | cons q b ih =>
    rw [val_cons, map_add, map_add, ih, List.map_cons, Cert3.val_cons]
    congr 1
    simp only [map_smul, LinearMap.smul_apply, mono3_mono1, smul_smul, Int.cast_mul, mul_comm]

name: Operad.FreeBin.Cert2.comp0_val
statement:
lemma comp0_val (a b : Cert2 G) :
    SymOperad.map (R := K) e0 (SymOperad.comp (R := K) 0 (val K a) (val K b))
      = Cert3.val K (comp0 a b)
proof:
:= by
  induction a with
  | nil => simp [comp0]
  | cons p a ih =>
    have h : comp0 (p :: a) b = (b.map fun q => (mono0 p.1 q.1, p.2 * q.2)) ++ comp0 a b := by
      simp [comp0]
    rw [h, Cert3.val_append, ← ih, ← comp0_single, ← map_add, ← LinearMap.add_apply, ← map_add,
      val_cons]

name: Operad.FreeBin.Cert2.comp1_val
statement:
lemma comp1_val (a b : Cert2 G) :
    SymOperad.map (R := K) e1 (SymOperad.comp (R := K) 1 (val K a) (val K b))
      = Cert3.val K (comp1 a b)
proof:
:= by
  induction a with
  | nil => simp [comp1]
  | cons p a ih =>
    have h : comp1 (p :: a) b = (b.map fun q => (mono1 p.1 q.1, p.2 * q.2)) ++ comp1 a b := by
      simp [comp1]
    rw [h, Cert3.val_append, ← ih, ← comp1_single, ← map_add, ← LinearMap.add_apply, ← map_add,
      val_cons]

name: Operad.FreeBin.val_memCertSum
statement:
lemma val_memCertSum {W : Submodule K (FreeBin K G (Fin 3))} (gens : List (Cert3 G))
    (hgens : ∀ g ∈ gens, ∀ τ, val K (act τ g) ∈ W) (c : MemCert) :
    val K (MemCert.sum gens c) ∈ W
proof:
:= by
  induction c with
  | nil => simp [MemCert.sum]
  | cons x c ih =>
    rw [MemCert.sum, List.flatMap_cons, val_append, ← MemCert.sum, val_smul]
    refine add_mem (Submodule.smul_mem _ _ ?_) ih
    rcases lt_or_ge x.2.2 gens.length with h | h
    · rw [List.getD_eq_getElem _ _ h]
      exact hgens _ (List.getElem_mem h) _
    · rw [List.getD_eq_default _ _ h]
      simp [act]

name: Operad.FreeBin.val_mem_of_cert
statement:
theorem val_mem_of_cert {W : Submodule K (FreeBin K G (Fin 3))} (gens : List (Cert3 G))
    (hgens : ∀ g ∈ gens, ∀ τ, val K (act τ g) ∈ W) (v : Cert3 G) (d : ℤ) (hd : (d : K) ≠ 0)
    (c : MemCert) (hv : ∀ m, d * coeff v m = coeff (MemCert.sum gens c) m) : val K v ∈ W
proof:
:= by
  have h : (d : K) • val K v = val K (MemCert.sum gens c) := by
    rw [← val_smul]
    exact val_eq_of_coeff K fun m => by rw [coeff_smul, hv]
  have hmem := val_memCertSum K gens hgens c
  rw [← h] at hmem
  simpa [smul_smul, inv_mul_cancel₀ hd] using Submodule.smul_mem W (d : K)⁻¹ hmem

name: Operad.FreeBin.bin2_eq_val
statement: lemma bin2_eq_val (g : G) (σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin 2)) : bin2 g σ = Cert2.val K [((g, σ), 1)]
proof:
:= by
  simp

name: Operad.FreeBin.gens23_mem
statement:
theorem gens23_mem (gs : List G) (r₂ : List (Cert2 G)) (r₃ : List (Cert3 G)) :
    ∀ g ∈ gens23 gs r₂ r₃, ∀ τ : Equiv.Perm (Fin 3), val K (act τ g) ∈
      ideal3Of K (Cert2.val K '' {a | a ∈ r₂}) ⊔
        Submodule.span K (orbit3 K (Cert3.val K '' {r | r ∈ r₃}))
proof:
:= by
  intro g hg τ
  rw [← map_val]
  rw [gens23, List.mem_append, List.mem_flatMap] at hg
  rcases hg with ⟨a, ha, hg⟩ | hg
  · refine Submodule.mem_sup_left (ideal3Of_map_mem τ ?_)
    simp only [List.mem_flatMap, List.mem_cons, List.not_mem_nil, or_false] at hg
    obtain ⟨g', -, σ, -, hg⟩ := hg
    have ha' : Cert2.val K a ∈ Cert2.val K '' {a | a ∈ r₂} := ⟨a, ha, rfl⟩
    rcases hg with rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl
    · rw [← comp0_val]
      exact Submodule.subset_span ⟨0, e0, _, _, Or.inl ha', rfl⟩
    · rw [← comp1_val]
      exact Submodule.subset_span ⟨1, e1, _, _, Or.inl ha', rfl⟩
    · rw [← comp0_val]
      exact Submodule.subset_span ⟨0, e0, _, _, Or.inr ha', rfl⟩
    · rw [← comp1_val]
      exact Submodule.subset_span ⟨1, e1, _, _, Or.inr ha', rfl⟩
  · exact Submodule.mem_sup_right
      (mem_orbit3 K (r := Cert3.val K '' {r | r ∈ r₃}) ⟨g, hg, rfl⟩ τ)

name: Operad.FreeBin.val_mem_dualRel23
statement:
theorem val_mem_dualRel23 (r₂ : List (Cert2 G)) (r₃ : List (Cert3 G)) (u : Cert3 G)
    (h₂ : ∀ τ : Equiv.Perm (Fin 3), ∀ a ∈ r₂, ∀ g : G, ∀ σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin 2),
      pair (act τ u) (comp0 a [((g, σ), 1)]) = 0 ∧ pair (act τ u) (comp1 a [((g, σ), 1)]) = 0 ∧
      pair (act τ u) (comp0 [((g, σ), 1)] a) = 0 ∧ pair (act τ u) (comp1 [((g, σ), 1)] a) = 0)
    (h₃ : ∀ τ : Equiv.Perm (Fin 3), ∀ r ∈ r₃, pair (act τ u) r = 0) :
    val K u ∈ dualRel23 K (Cert2.val K '' {a | a ∈ r₂}) (Cert3.val K '' {r | r ∈ r₃})
proof:
:= by
  let S : Submodule K (FreeBin K G (Fin 3)) :=
    ⨅ τ : Equiv.Perm (Fin 3), LinearMap.ker (pair3 G K (val K (act τ u)))
  have hS : ∀ w, w ∈ S ↔ ∀ τ : Equiv.Perm (Fin 3), pair3 G K (val K (act τ u)) w = 0 := by
    intro w
    simp [S]
  have hSmap : ∀ (σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin 3)) w, w ∈ S → SymOperad.map (R := K) σ w ∈ S := by
    intro σ w hw
    rw [hS] at hw ⊢
    intro τ
    have h := pair3_map K σ (SymOperad.map (R := K) σ⁻¹ (val K (act τ u))) w
    rw [SymOperad.map_map, show σ⁻¹.trans σ = Equiv.refl _ by ext; simp, SymOperad.map_refl,
      map_val, show act σ⁻¹ (act τ u) = act (τ.trans σ⁻¹) u by
        simp only [act, List.map_map]; rfl, hw, mul_zero] at h
    exact h
  have hW : ideal3Of K (Cert2.val K '' {a | a ∈ r₂}) ⊔
      Submodule.span K (orbit3 K (Cert3.val K '' {r | r ∈ r₃})) ≤ S := by
    refine sup_le (ideal3Of_le K hSmap fun a ha g σ => ?_) ?_
    · obtain ⟨a, ha, rfl⟩ := ha
      have h := h₂
      simp only [hS, bin2_eq_val K, comp0_val, comp1_val, pair3_val] at h ⊢
      exact ⟨fun τ => by simp [(h τ a ha g σ).1], fun τ => by simp [(h τ a ha g σ).2.1],
        fun τ => by simp [(h τ a ha g σ).2.2.1], fun τ => by simp [(h τ a ha g σ).2.2.2]⟩
    · rw [Submodule.span_le]
      rintro _ ⟨σ, _, ⟨r, hr, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
      refine hSmap σ _ ((hS _).2 fun τ => ?_)
      rw [pair3_val, h₃ τ r hr, Int.cast_zero]
  have hW' : Submodule.span K (orbit3 K ((ideal3Of K (Cert2.val K '' {a | a ∈ r₂}) ⊔
      Submodule.span K (orbit3 K (Cert3.val K '' {r | r ∈ r₃})) : Submodule K _) :
        Set (FreeBin K G (Fin 3)))) ≤ S := by
    rw [Submodule.span_le]
    rintro _ ⟨σ, w, hw, rfl⟩
    exact hSmap σ w (hW hw)
  intro n hn
  have h := (hS n).1 (hW' hn) 1
  rw [show act 1 u = u by simp [act, act3]] at h
  show pair3 G K n (val K u) = 0
  rw [pair3_comm]
  exact h

name: Operad.FreeBin.le_finrank_of_cert
statement:
theorem le_finrank_of_cert {W : Submodule K (FreeBin K G (Fin 3))} (l : List (Cert3 G × Mono3 G))
    (hl : ∀ x ∈ l, val K x.1 ∈ W)
    (h : ∀ i j : Fin l.length, coeff (l.get j).1 (l.get i).2 ≠ 0 ↔ j = i) :
    l.length ≤ Module.finrank K W
proof:
:= by
  have := le_finrank_of_private K (fun i : Fin l.length => val K (l.get i).1)
    (fun i => hl _ (List.get_mem l i)) (fun i => (l.get i).2)
    (fun i j => by rw [repr_val, Int.cast_ne_zero]; exact h i j)
  simpa using this

name: Operad.FreeBin.sup_map_mem'
statement:
lemma sup_map_mem' {W W' : Submodule K (FreeBin K G (Fin 3))}
    (hW : ∀ τ : Equiv.Perm (Fin 3), ∀ x ∈ W, SymOperad.map (R := K) τ x ∈ W)
    (hW' : ∀ τ : Equiv.Perm (Fin 3), ∀ x ∈ W', SymOperad.map (R := K) τ x ∈ W')
    (τ : Equiv.Perm (Fin 3)) {x : FreeBin K G (Fin 3)} (hx : x ∈ W ⊔ W') :
    SymOperad.map (R := K) τ x ∈ W ⊔ W'
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, ha, b, hb, rfl⟩ := Submodule.mem_sup.1 hx
  rw [map_add]
  exact add_mem (Submodule.mem_sup_left (hW τ a ha)) (Submodule.mem_sup_right (hW' τ b hb))

name: Operad.FreeBin.rel3_map_mem
statement:
lemma rel3_map_mem (r₂ : Set (FreeBin K G (Fin 2))) (r₃ : Set (FreeBin K G (Fin 3)))
    (τ : Equiv.Perm (Fin 3)) {x : FreeBin K G (Fin 3)}
    (hx : x ∈ ideal3Of K r₂ ⊔ Submodule.span K (orbit3 K r₃)) :
    SymOperad.map (R := K) τ x ∈ ideal3Of K r₂ ⊔ Submodule.span K (orbit3 K r₃)
proof:
:=
  sup_map_mem' K (fun τ _ hx => ideal3Of_map_mem τ hx) (fun τ _ hx => map_mem_span_orbit3 K τ hx)
    τ hx

name: Operad.FreeBin.dualRel23_eq_span_of_cert
statement:
theorem dualRel23_eq_span_of_cert (gs : List G) (r₂ : List (Cert2 G)) (r₃ : List (Cert3 G))
    (dim : List (MemCert × Mono3 G)) (U : List (Cert3 G × Mono3 G))
    (hcard : 12 * Fintype.card G ^ 2 ≤ dim.length + U.length)
    (hdim : ∀ i j : Fin dim.length,
      coeff (MemCert.sum (gens23 gs r₂ r₃) (dim.get j).1) (dim.get i).2 ≠ 0 ↔ j = i)
    (hU : ∀ i j : Fin U.length, coeff (U.get j).1 (U.get i).2 ≠ 0 ↔ j = i)
    (h₂ : ∀ u ∈ U, ∀ τ : Equiv.Perm (Fin 3), ∀ a ∈ r₂, ∀ g : G, ∀ σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin 2),
      pair (act τ u.1) (comp0 a [((g, σ), 1)]) = 0 ∧ pair (act τ u.1) (comp1 a [((g, σ), 1)]) = 0 ∧
      pair (act τ u.1) (comp0 [((g, σ), 1)] a) = 0 ∧ pair (act τ u.1) (comp1 [((g, σ), 1)] a) = 0)
    (h₃ : ∀ u ∈ U, ∀ τ : Equiv.Perm (Fin 3), ∀ r ∈ r₃, pair (act τ u.1) r = 0) :
    dualRel23 K (Cert2.val K '' {a | a ∈ r₂}) (Cert3.val K '' {r | r ∈ r₃})
      = Submodule.span K (Cert3.val K '' {u | u ∈ U.map Prod.fst})
proof:
:= by
  set W := ideal3Of K (Cert2.val K '' {a | a ∈ r₂}) ⊔
    Submodule.span K (orbit3 K (Cert3.val K '' {r | r ∈ r₃}))
  have hle : Submodule.span K (Cert3.val K '' {u | u ∈ U.map Prod.fst})
      ≤ dualRel23 K (Cert2.val K '' {a | a ∈ r₂}) (Cert3.val K '' {r | r ∈ r₃}) := by
    rw [Submodule.span_le]
    rintro _ ⟨u, hu, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.1 hu
    exact val_mem_dualRel23 K r₂ r₃ x.1 (h₂ x hx) (h₃ x hx)
  have hdimW : dim.length ≤ Module.finrank K W := by
    have := le_finrank_of_cert K (W := W)
      (dim.map fun x => (MemCert.sum (gens23 gs r₂ r₃) x.1, x.2))
      (fun x hx => by
        obtain ⟨y, -, rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.1 hx
        exact val_memCertSum K _ (gens23_mem K gs r₂ r₃) y.1)
      (fun i j => by simpa using hdim (i.cast (by simp)) (j.cast (by simp)))
    simpa using this
  have hdimU : U.length ≤ Module.finrank K
      (Submodule.span K (Cert3.val K '' {u | u ∈ U.map Prod.fst})) :=
    le_finrank_of_cert K U (fun x hx => Submodule.subset_span ⟨x.1, List.mem_map_of_mem hx, rfl⟩)
      hU
  refine (Submodule.eq_of_le_of_finrank_le hle ?_).symm
  have hspan : Submodule.span K (orbit3 K (W : Set (FreeBin K G (Fin 3)))) = W :=
    span_orbit3_eq K fun τ _ hx => rel3_map_mem K _ _ τ hx
  have hfin := finrank_dualRel K (W : Set (FreeBin K G (Fin 3)))
  rw [hspan] at hfin
  rw [dualRel23, hfin]
  omega

name: Operad.FreeBin.dual23_span_eq_of_cert
statement:
theorem dual23_span_eq_of_cert (gs : List G) (r₂ : List (Cert2 G)) (r₃ : List (Cert3 G))
    (s₂ : List (Cert2 G)) (s₃ : List (Cert3 G)) (U : List (Cert3 G × Mono3 G))
    (hU : dualRel23 K (Cert2.val K '' {a | a ∈ r₂}) (Cert3.val K '' {r | r ∈ r₃})
      = Submodule.span K (Cert3.val K '' {u | u ∈ U.map Prod.fst}))
    (htwist : twist2 K '' (Cert2.val K '' {a | a ∈ r₂}) = Cert2.val K '' {a | a ∈ s₂})
    (memU : List MemCert) (hmemU : ∀ x ∈ U.zip memU, ∀ m,
      coeff x.1.1 m = coeff (MemCert.sum (gens23 gs s₂ s₃) x.2) m)
    (hlenU : U.length ≤ memU.length)
    (memS : List (ℤ × MemCert)) (hmemS : ∀ x ∈ s₃.zip memS, x.2.1 ≠ 0 ∧ ∀ m,
