      x.2.1 * coeff x.1 m = coeff (MemCert.sum (gens23 gs s₂ (U.map Prod.fst)) x.2.2) m)
    (hlenS : s₃.length ≤ memS.length) :
    SymOperadIdeal.span K (rel23 (twist2 K '' (Cert2.val K '' {a | a ∈ r₂}))
        (dualRel23 K (Cert2.val K '' {a | a ∈ r₂}) (Cert3.val K '' {r | r ∈ r₃}) :
          Set (FreeBin K G (Fin 3))))
      = SymOperadIdeal.span K (rel23 (Cert2.val K '' {a | a ∈ s₂})
          (Cert3.val K '' {r | r ∈ s₃}))
proof:
:= by
  rw [htwist]
  set Ws := ideal3Of K (Cert2.val K '' {a | a ∈ s₂}) ⊔
    Submodule.span K (orbit3 K (Cert3.val K '' {r | r ∈ s₃}))
  set Wd := ideal3Of K (Cert2.val K '' {a | a ∈ s₂}) ⊔ Submodule.span K (orbit3 K
    (dualRel23 K (Cert2.val K '' {a | a ∈ r₂}) (Cert3.val K '' {r | r ∈ r₃}) :
      Set (FreeBin K G (Fin 3))))
  have hself : ∀ x ∈ Cert2.val K '' {a | a ∈ s₂},
      x ∈ Submodule.span K (orbit2 K (Cert2.val K '' {a | a ∈ s₂})) := fun x hx =>
    Submodule.subset_span ⟨1, x, hx, by
      rw [show (1 : Equiv.Perm (Fin 2)) = Equiv.refl _ from rfl, SymOperad.map_refl]⟩
  
  have hUWs : ∀ u ∈ U.map Prod.fst, Cert3.val K u ∈ Ws := by
    intro u hu
    obtain ⟨i, hi, rfl⟩ := List.mem_iff_getElem.1 hu
    have hi' : i < U.length := by simpa using hi
    have hx : (U[i], memU[i]'(by omega)) ∈ U.zip memU := by
      rw [List.mem_iff_getElem]
      exact ⟨i, by simp; omega, by simp⟩
    rw [List.getElem_map]
    exact val_mem_of_cert K (gens23 gs s₂ s₃) (gens23_mem K gs s₂ s₃) _ 1 (by simp) _
      fun m => by rw [one_mul]; exact hmemU _ hx m
  have hdWs : (dualRel23 K (Cert2.val K '' {a | a ∈ r₂}) (Cert3.val K '' {r | r ∈ r₃}) :
      Set (FreeBin K G (Fin 3))) ⊆ Ws := by
    rw [hU]
    intro x hx
    refine (Submodule.span_le.2 ?_) hx
    rintro _ ⟨u, hu, rfl⟩
    exact hUWs u hu
  
  have hUd : ∀ u ∈ U.map Prod.fst, Cert3.val K u ∈
      dualRel23 K (Cert2.val K '' {a | a ∈ r₂}) (Cert3.val K '' {r | r ∈ r₃}) := fun u hu => by
    rw [hU]
    exact Submodule.subset_span ⟨u, hu, rfl⟩
  have hs₃ : ∀ r ∈ s₃, Cert3.val K r ∈ Wd := by
    intro r hr
    obtain ⟨i, hi, rfl⟩ := List.mem_iff_getElem.1 hr
    have hx : (s₃[i], memS[i]'(by omega)) ∈ s₃.zip memS := by
      rw [List.mem_iff_getElem]
      exact ⟨i, by simp; omega, by simp⟩
    obtain ⟨hd, hm⟩ := hmemS _ hx
    have hsub : ideal3Of K (Cert2.val K '' {a | a ∈ s₂}) ⊔
        Submodule.span K (orbit3 K (Cert3.val K '' {u | u ∈ U.map Prod.fst})) ≤ Wd := by
      refine sup_le_sup_left (Submodule.span_mono ?_) _
      rintro _ ⟨τ, _, ⟨u, hu, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
      exact ⟨τ, _, hUd u hu, rfl⟩
    exact hsub (val_mem_of_cert K (gens23 gs s₂ (U.map Prod.fst))
      (gens23_mem K gs s₂ (U.map Prod.fst)) _ _ (by exact_mod_cast hd) _ hm)
  apply le_antisymm
  · refine span_le_23 hself fun x hx => ?_
    exact hdWs hx
  · refine span_le_23 hself fun x hx => ?_
    obtain ⟨r, hr, rfl⟩ := hx
    exact hs₃ r hr

name: Operad.STree.first_leaf
statement: @[simp] lemma first_leaf (a : ℕ) : (leaf a : STree E).first = a
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.STree.first_node
statement:
lemma first_node {k : ℕ} (e : E k) (c : Fin k → STree E) (h : 0 < k) :
    (node e c).first = (c ⟨0, h⟩).first
proof:
:= by
  simp only [first, dif_pos h]

name: Operad.STree.labels_leaf
statement: @[simp] lemma labels_leaf (a : ℕ) : (leaf a : STree E).labels = {a}
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.STree.labels_node
statement:
@[simp] lemma labels_node {k : ℕ} (e : E k) (c : Fin k → STree E) :
    (node e c).labels = ∑ i, (c i).labels
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.STree.weight_leaf
statement: @[simp] lemma weight_leaf (a : ℕ) : (leaf a : STree E).weight = 0
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.STree.weight_node
statement:
@[simp] lemma weight_node {k : ℕ} (e : E k) (c : Fin k → STree E) :
    (node e c).weight = 1 + ∑ i, (c i).weight
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.STree.isShuffle_leaf
statement: @[simp] lemma isShuffle_leaf (a : ℕ) : (leaf a : STree E).IsShuffle
proof: := trivial

name: Operad.STree.isShuffle_node
statement:
lemma isShuffle_node {k : ℕ} {e : E k} {c : Fin k → STree E} :
    (node e c).IsShuffle ↔ 0 < k ∧ (∀ i, (c i).IsShuffle) ∧ StrictMono fun i => (c i).first
proof:
:=
  Iff.rfl

name: Operad.STree.mem_labels_node
statement:
lemma mem_labels_node {k : ℕ} {e : E k} {c : Fin k → STree E} {a : ℕ} :
    a ∈ (node e c).labels ↔ ∃ i, a ∈ (c i).labels
proof:
:= by
  simp [Multiset.mem_sum]

name: Operad.STree.labels_le_node
statement:
lemma labels_le_node {k : ℕ} (e : E k) (c : Fin k → STree E) (i : Fin k) :
    (c i).labels ≤ (node e c).labels
proof:
:=
  Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun j => (c j).labels) (fun _ _ => Multiset.zero_le _)
    (Finset.mem_univ i)

name: Operad.STree.nodup_of_node
statement:
lemma nodup_of_node {k : ℕ} {e : E k} {c : Fin k → STree E} (h : (node e c).labels.Nodup)
    (i : Fin k) : (c i).labels.Nodup
proof:
:=
  Multiset.nodup_of_le (labels_le_node e c i) h

name: Operad.STree.disjoint_of_node
statement:
lemma disjoint_of_node {k : ℕ} {e : E k} {c : Fin k → STree E} (h : (node e c).labels.Nodup)
    {i j : Fin k} (hij : i ≠ j) : Disjoint (c i).labels (c j).labels
proof:
:= by
  have hle : (c i).labels + (c j).labels ≤ (node e c).labels := by
    rw [labels_node, ← Finset.sum_pair (f := fun x => (c x).labels) hij]
    exact Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg (Finset.subset_univ _)
      fun _ _ _ => Multiset.zero_le _
  exact (Multiset.nodup_add.1 (Multiset.nodup_of_le hle h)).2.2

name: Operad.STree.not_mem_of_node
statement:
lemma not_mem_of_node {k : ℕ} {e : E k} {c : Fin k → STree E} (h : (node e c).labels.Nodup)
    {i j : Fin k} (hij : i ≠ j) {a : ℕ} (ha : a ∈ (c i).labels) : a ∉ (c j).labels
proof:
:=
  Multiset.disjoint_left.1 (disjoint_of_node h hij) ha

name: Operad.STree.IsShuffle.pos
statement: lemma IsShuffle.pos {k : ℕ} {e : E k} {c : Fin k → STree E} (h : (node e c).IsShuffle) : 0 < k

name: Operad.STree.IsShuffle.child
statement:
lemma IsShuffle.child {k : ℕ} {e : E k} {c : Fin k → STree E} (h : (node e c).IsShuffle)
    (i : Fin k) : (c i).IsShuffle

name: Operad.STree.IsShuffle.mono
statement:
lemma IsShuffle.mono {k : ℕ} {e : E k} {c : Fin k → STree E} (h : (node e c).IsShuffle) :
    StrictMono fun i => (c i).first

name: Operad.STree.first_mem
statement:
theorem first_mem : ∀ {t : STree E}, t.IsShuffle → t.first ∈ t.labels
  | leaf _, _ => Multiset.mem_singleton_self _
  | @node _ k e c, h => by
    rw [first_node e c h.pos]
    exact Multiset.mem_of_le (labels_le_node e c _) (first_mem (h.child _))

name: Operad.STree.first_le
statement:
theorem first_le : ∀ {t : STree E}, t.IsShuffle → ∀ a ∈ t.labels, t.first ≤ a
  | leaf _, _, a, ha => by rw [Multiset.mem_singleton.1 ha]; rfl
  | @node _ k e c, h, a, ha => by
    obtain ⟨i, hi⟩
proof:
:= mem_labels_node.1 ha
    rw [first_node e c h.pos]
    exact (h.mono.monotone (show (⟨0, h.pos⟩ : Fin k) ≤ i from Nat.zero_le _)).trans
      (first_le (h.child i) a hi)

name: Operad.STree.first_eq_of_labels_eq
statement:
theorem first_eq_of_labels_eq {s t : STree E} (hs : s.IsShuffle) (ht : t.IsShuffle)
    (h : s.labels = t.labels) : s.first = t.first
proof:
:=
  le_antisymm (first_le hs _ (h ▸ first_mem ht)) (first_le ht _ (h.symm ▸ first_mem hs))

name: Operad.STree.subst_leaf'
statement: @[simp] lemma subst_leaf' (a : ℕ) (xs : ℕ → STree E) : (leaf a).subst xs = xs a
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.STree.subst_node
statement:
@[simp] lemma subst_node {k : ℕ} (e : E k) (c : Fin k → STree E) (xs : ℕ → STree E) :
    (node e c).subst xs = node e fun i => (c i).subst xs
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.STree.subst_leaf
statement:
theorem subst_leaf : ∀ t : STree E, t.subst leaf = t
  | leaf _ => rfl
  | node e c => by
    rw [subst_node]
    congr 1
    funext i
    exact subst_leaf (c i)

name: Operad.STree.subst_subst
statement:
theorem subst_subst : ∀ (t : STree E) (xs ys : ℕ → STree E),
    (t.subst xs).subst ys = t.subst fun a => (xs a).subst ys
  | leaf _, _, _ => rfl
  | node e c, xs, ys => by
    simp only [subst_node]
    congr 1
    funext i
    exact subst_subst (c i) xs ys

name: Operad.STree.subst_congr
statement:
theorem subst_congr : ∀ (t : STree E) {xs ys : ℕ → STree E}, (∀ a ∈ t.labels, xs a = ys a) →
    t.subst xs = t.subst ys
  | leaf a, _, _, h => h a (Multiset.mem_singleton_self a)
  | node e c, _, _, h => by
    simp only [subst_node]
    congr 1
    funext i
    exact subst_congr (c i) fun a ha => h a (mem_labels_node.2 ⟨i, ha⟩)

name: Operad.STree.sum_bind
statement:
lemma sum_bind {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι) (g : ι → Multiset ℕ) (f : ℕ → Multiset ℕ) :
    (∑ i ∈ s, g i).bind f = ∑ i ∈ s, (g i).bind f
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction s using Finset.induction_on with
  | empty => simp
  | insert i s hi ih => rw [Finset.sum_insert hi, Finset.sum_insert hi, Multiset.add_bind, ih]

name: Operad.STree.labels_subst
statement:
theorem labels_subst : ∀ (t : STree E) (xs : ℕ → STree E),
    (t.subst xs).labels = t.labels.bind fun a => (xs a).labels
  | leaf a, xs => by simp
  | node e c, xs => by
    simp only [subst_node, labels_node, sum_bind]
    exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => labels_subst (c i) xs

name: Operad.STree.first_subst
statement:
theorem first_subst : ∀ {t : STree E}, t.IsShuffle → ∀ xs : ℕ → STree E,
    (t.subst xs).first = (xs t.first).first
  | leaf _, _, _ => rfl
  | @node _ k e c, h, xs => by
    rw [subst_node, first_node _ _ h.pos, first_node _ _ h.pos]
    exact first_subst (h.child _) xs

name: Operad.STree.isShuffle_subst
statement:
theorem isShuffle_subst : ∀ {t : STree E}, t.IsShuffle → ∀ {xs : ℕ → STree E},
    (∀ a ∈ t.labels, (xs a).IsShuffle) →
    StrictMonoOn (fun a => (xs a).first) {a | a ∈ t.labels} → (t.subst xs).IsShuffle
  | leaf a, _, _, hx, _ => hx a (Multiset.mem_singleton_self a)
  | @node _ k e c, h, xs, hx, hm => by
    refine ⟨h.pos, fun i => isShuffle_subst (h.child i)
      (fun a ha => hx a (mem_labels_node.2 ⟨i, ha⟩))
      (fun a ha b hb hab => hm (mem_labels_node.2 ⟨i, ha⟩) (mem_labels_node.2 ⟨i, hb⟩) hab),
      fun i j hij => ?_⟩
    simp only [first_subst (h.child _)]
    exact hm (mem_labels_node.2 ⟨i, first_mem (h.child i)⟩)
      (mem_labels_node.2 ⟨j, first_mem (h.child j)⟩) (h.mono hij)

                   

                                                              
def get? : STree E → List ℕ → Option (STree E)
  | t, [] => some t
  | leaf _, _ :: _ => none
  | @node _ k _ c, i :: p => if h : i < k then (c ⟨i, h⟩).get? p else none

                                                                                            
             
def replace : STree E → List ℕ → STree E → STree E
  | _, [], u => u
  | leaf a, _ :: _, _ => leaf a
  | node e c, i :: p, u => node e fun j => if (j : ℕ) = i then (c j).replace p u else c j

@[simp] lemma get?_nil (t : STree E) : t.get? [] = some t
proof: := by cases t <;> rfl

name: Operad.STree.get?_nil
statement: @[simp] lemma get?_nil (t : STree E) : t.get? [] = some t
proof: := by cases t <;> rfl

name: Operad.STree.get?_leaf_cons
statement: @[simp] lemma get?_leaf_cons (a i : ℕ) (p : List ℕ) : (leaf a : STree E).get? (i :: p) = none
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: Operad.STree.get?_node_cons
statement:
lemma get?_node_cons {k : ℕ} (e : E k) (c : Fin k → STree E) (i : ℕ) (p : List ℕ) :
    (node e c).get? (i :: p) = if h : i < k then (c ⟨i, h⟩).get? p else none
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.STree.get?_node_cons_fin
statement:
lemma get?_node_cons_fin {k : ℕ} (e : E k) (c : Fin k → STree E) (i : Fin k) (p : List ℕ) :
    (node e c).get? (i.1 :: p) = (c i).get? p
proof:
:= by
  rw [get?_node_cons, dif_pos i.2]

name: Operad.STree.get?_node_cons_eq_some
proof:
:= by
  rw [get?_node_cons]
  split_ifs with hi
  · exact ⟨fun h => ⟨hi, h⟩, fun ⟨_, h⟩ => h⟩
  · exact ⟨fun h => absurd h (by simp), fun ⟨h', _⟩ => absurd h' hi⟩

name: Operad.STree.get?_node_cons_isSome
statement:
lemma get?_node_cons_isSome {k : ℕ} {e : E k} {c : Fin k → STree E} {i : ℕ} {p : List ℕ} :
    ((node e c).get? (i :: p)).isSome ↔ ∃ hi : i < k, ((c ⟨i, hi⟩).get? p).isSome
proof:
:= by
  rw [get?_node_cons]
  split_ifs with hi
  · exact ⟨fun h => ⟨hi, h⟩, fun ⟨_, h⟩ => h⟩
  · exact ⟨fun h => absurd h (by simp), fun ⟨h', _⟩ => absurd h' hi⟩

name: Operad.STree.replace_nil
statement: @[simp] lemma replace_nil (t u : STree E) : t.replace [] u = u
proof: := by cases t <;> rfl

name: Operad.STree.replace_leaf_cons
statement:
@[simp] lemma replace_leaf_cons (a i : ℕ) (p : List ℕ) (u : STree E) :
    (leaf a : STree E).replace (i :: p) u = leaf a
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.STree.replace_node_cons
statement:
lemma replace_node_cons {k : ℕ} (e : E k) (c : Fin k → STree E) (i : ℕ) (p : List ℕ)
    (u : STree E) :
    (node e c).replace (i :: p) u =
      node e fun j => if (j : ℕ) = i then (c j).replace p u else c j
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: Operad.STree.get?_append
statement:
theorem get?_append : ∀ (t : STree E) (p q : List ℕ),
    t.get? (p ++ q) = (t.get? p).bind fun u => u.get? q
  | t, [], q => by simp
  | leaf _, _ :: _, _ => rfl
  | @node _ k e c, i :: p, q => by
    simp only [List.cons_append, get?_node_cons]
    split_ifs
    · exact get?_append _ p q
    · rfl

name: Operad.STree.get?_append_of
statement:
lemma get?_append_of {t u : STree E} {p : List ℕ} (h : t.get? p = some u) (q : List ℕ) :
    t.get? (p ++ q) = u.get? q
proof:
:= by
  rw [get?_append, h, Option.bind_some]

name: Operad.STree.replace_self
statement:
theorem replace_self : ∀ {t u : STree E} {p : List ℕ}, t.get? p = some u → t.replace p u = t
  | t, u, [], h => by rw [get?_nil, Option.some_inj] at h; rw [replace_nil, h]
  | leaf _, _, _ :: _, h => by simp at h
  | @node _ k e c, u, i :: p, h => by
    obtain ⟨hi, h⟩
proof:
:= get?_node_cons_eq_some.1 h
    rw [replace_node_cons]
    congr 1
    funext j
    split_ifs with hj
    · have : j = ⟨i, hi⟩ := Fin.ext hj
      subst this
      exact replace_self h
    · rfl

name: Operad.STree.get?_replace
statement:
theorem get?_replace : ∀ {t : STree E} {p : List ℕ}, (t.get? p).isSome → ∀ u : STree E,
    (t.replace p u).get? p = some u
  | t, [], _, u => by simp
  | leaf _, _ :: _, h, _ => by simp at h
  | @node _ k e c, i :: p, h, u => by
    obtain ⟨hi, h⟩
proof:
:= get?_node_cons_isSome.1 h
    rw [replace_node_cons, get?_node_cons, dif_pos hi]
    show STree.get? (if i = i then _ else _) p = _
    rw [if_pos rfl]
    exact get?_replace h u

name: Operad.STree.replace_replace
statement:
theorem replace_replace : ∀ (t : STree E) (p : List ℕ) (u v : STree E),
    (t.replace p u).replace p v = t.replace p v
  | t, [], u, v => by simp
  | leaf _, _ :: _, _, _ => rfl
  | node e c, i :: p, u, v => by
    simp only [replace_node_cons]
    congr 1
    funext j
    split_ifs with hj
    · exact replace_replace _ p u v
    · rfl

name: Operad.STree.replace_append
statement:
theorem replace_append : ∀ {t w : STree E} {p : List ℕ}, t.get? p = some w →
    ∀ (q : List ℕ) (v : STree E), t.replace (p ++ q) v = t.replace p (w.replace q v)
  | t, w, [], h, q, v => by
    rw [get?_nil, Option.some_inj] at h
    subst h
    simp
  | leaf _, _, _ :: _, h, _, _ => by simp at h
  | @node _ k e c, w, i :: p, h, q, v => by
    obtain ⟨hi, h⟩
proof:
:= get?_node_cons_eq_some.1 h
    simp only [List.cons_append, replace_node_cons]
    congr 1
    funext j
    split_ifs with hj
    · have : j = ⟨i, hi⟩ := Fin.ext hj
      subst this
      exact replace_append h q v
    · rfl

name: Operad.STree.get?_replace_append
statement:
theorem get?_replace_append {t : STree E} {p : List ℕ} (h : (t.get? p).isSome) (u : STree E)
    (q : List ℕ) : (t.replace p u).get? (p ++ q) = u.get? q
proof:
:=
  get?_append_of (get?_replace h u) q

name: Operad.STree.Incomp.symm
statement: lemma Incomp.symm {p q : List ℕ} (h : Incomp p q) : Incomp q p
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨r, i, j, p', q', hij, rfl, rfl⟩ := h
  exact ⟨r, j, i, q', p', hij.symm, rfl, rfl⟩

name: Operad.STree.prefix_or_incomp
statement:
theorem prefix_or_incomp : ∀ p q : List ℕ, p <+: q ∨ q <+: p ∨ Incomp p q
  | [], _ => Or.inl (List.nil_prefix)
  | _ :: _, [] => Or.inr (Or.inl List.nil_prefix)
  | i :: p, j :: q => by
    by_cases hij : i = j
    · subst hij
      rcases prefix_or_incomp p q with h | h | ⟨r, a, b, p', q', hab, rfl, rfl⟩
      · exact Or.inl (List.cons_prefix_cons.2 ⟨rfl, h⟩)
      · exact Or.inr (Or.inl (List.cons_prefix_cons.2 ⟨rfl, h⟩))
      · exact Or.inr (Or.inr ⟨i :: r, a, b, p', q', hab, rfl, rfl⟩)
    · exact Or.inr (Or.inr ⟨[], i, j, p, q, hij, rfl, rfl⟩)

name: Operad.STree.get?_replace_of_incomp
statement:
theorem get?_replace_of_incomp : ∀ (r : List ℕ) {i j : ℕ}, i ≠ j → ∀ (t : STree E)
    (p' q' : List ℕ) (u : STree E),
    (t.replace (r ++ i :: p') u).get? (r ++ j :: q') = t.get? (r ++ j :: q')
  | [], i, j, hij, leaf _, _, _, _ => rfl
  | [], i, j, hij, @node _ k e c, p', q', u => by
    rw [List.nil_append, List.nil_append, replace_node_cons, get?_node_cons, get?_node_cons]
    split_ifs with hj h <;> first | rfl | exact absurd h (Ne.symm hij)
  | _ :: _, _, _, _, leaf _, _, _, _ => rfl
  | a :: r, i, j, hij, @node _ k e c, p', q', u => by
    rw [List.cons_append, List.cons_append, replace_node_cons, get?_node_cons, get?_node_cons]
    split_ifs <;> first | rfl | exact get?_replace_of_incomp r hij _ p' q' u

name: Operad.STree.get?_replace_of_incomp'
statement:
lemma get?_replace_of_incomp' {p q : List ℕ} (h : Incomp p q) (t u : STree E) :
    (t.replace p u).get? q = t.get? q
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨r, i, j, p', q', hij, rfl, rfl⟩ := h
  exact get?_replace_of_incomp r hij t p' q' u

name: Operad.STree.replace_comm_of_incomp
statement:
theorem replace_comm_of_incomp : ∀ (r : List ℕ) {i j : ℕ}, i ≠ j → ∀ (t : STree E)
    (p' q' : List ℕ) (u v : STree E),
    (t.replace (r ++ i :: p') u).replace (r ++ j :: q') v =
      (t.replace (r ++ j :: q') v).replace (r ++ i :: p') u
  | [], i, j, hij, leaf _, _, _, _, _ => rfl
  | [], i, j, hij, node e c, p', q', u, v => by
    simp only [List.nil_append, replace_node_cons]
    congr 1
    funext l
    split_ifs <;> first | rfl | (exfalso; omega)
  | _ :: _, _, _, _, leaf _, _, _, _, _ => rfl
  | a :: r, i, j, hij, node e c, p', q', u, v => by
    simp only [List.cons_append, replace_node_cons]
    congr 1
    funext l
    split_ifs with ha
    · exact replace_comm_of_incomp r hij _ p' q' u v
    · rfl

name: Operad.STree.replace_comm
statement:
lemma replace_comm {p q : List ℕ} (h : Incomp p q) (t u v : STree E) :
    (t.replace p u).replace q v = (t.replace q v).replace p u
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨r, i, j, p', q', hij, rfl, rfl⟩ := h
  exact replace_comm_of_incomp r hij t p' q' u v

name: Operad.STree.isShuffle_get?
statement:
lemma isShuffle_get? : ∀ {t u : STree E} {p : List ℕ}, t.IsShuffle → t.get? p = some u →
    u.IsShuffle
  | t, u, [], ht, h => by rw [get?_nil, Option.some_inj] at h; exact h ▸ ht
  | leaf _, _, _ :: _, _, h => by simp at h
  | @node _ k e c, u, i :: p, ht, h => by
    obtain ⟨hi, h⟩
proof:
:= get?_node_cons_eq_some.1 h
    exact isShuffle_get? (ht.child _) h

name: Operad.STree.labels_get?_le
statement:
lemma labels_get?_le : ∀ {t u : STree E} {p : List ℕ}, t.get? p = some u →
    u.labels ≤ t.labels
  | t, u, [], h => by rw [get?_nil, Option.some_inj] at h; exact h ▸ le_rfl
  | leaf _, _, _ :: _, h => by simp at h
  | @node _ k e c, u, i :: p, h => by
    obtain ⟨hi, h⟩
proof:
:= get?_node_cons_eq_some.1 h
    exact (labels_get?_le h).trans (labels_le_node e c _)

name: Operad.STree.first_replace
statement:
theorem first_replace : ∀ {t u : STree E} {p : List ℕ}, t.get? p = some u → ∀ {v : STree E},
    v.first = u.first → (t.replace p v).first = t.first
  | t, u, [], h, v, hv => by
    rw [get?_nil, Option.some_inj] at h
    subst h
    simpa using hv
  | leaf _, _, _ :: _, h, _, _ => by simp at h
  | @node _ k e c, u, i :: p, h, v, hv => by
    obtain ⟨hi, h⟩
proof:
:= get?_node_cons_eq_some.1 h
    have hk : 0 < k := by omega
    rw [replace_node_cons, first_node _ _ hk, first_node _ _ hk]
    show STree.first (if 0 = i then _ else _) = _
    by_cases h0 : 0 = i
    · subst h0
      rw [if_pos rfl]
      exact first_replace h hv
    · rw [if_neg h0]

name: Operad.STree.isShuffle_replace
statement:
theorem isShuffle_replace : ∀ {t u : STree E} {p : List ℕ}, t.IsShuffle → t.get? p = some u →
    ∀ {v : STree E}, v.IsShuffle → v.first = u.first → (t.replace p v).IsShuffle
  | t, u, [], _, _, v, hv, _ => by simpa using hv
  | leaf _, _, _ :: _, _, h, _, _, _ => by simp at h
  | @node _ k e c, u, i :: p, ht, h, v, hv, hvu => by
    obtain ⟨hi, h⟩
proof:
:= get?_node_cons_eq_some.1 h
    rw [replace_node_cons]
    refine ⟨ht.pos, fun j => ?_, ?_⟩
    · dsimp only
      split_ifs with hj
      · have : j = ⟨i, hi⟩ := Fin.ext hj
        subst this
        exact isShuffle_replace (ht.child _) h hv hvu
      · exact ht.child j
    · have : (fun j : Fin k => (if (j : ℕ) = i then (c j).replace p v else c j).first) =
          fun j => (c j).first := by
        funext j
        split_ifs with hj
        · have : j = ⟨i, hi⟩ := Fin.ext hj
          subst this
          exact first_replace h hvu
        · rfl
      rw [this]
      exact ht.mono

name: Operad.STree.labels_replace
statement:
theorem labels_replace : ∀ {t u : STree E} {p : List ℕ}, t.get? p = some u → ∀ v : STree E,
    (t.replace p v).labels + u.labels = t.labels + v.labels
  | t, u, [], h, v => by
    rw [get?_nil, Option.some_inj] at h
    subst h
    simp [add_comm]
  | leaf _, _, _ :: _, h, _ => by simp at h
  | @node _ k e c, u, i :: p, h, v => by
    obtain ⟨hi, h⟩
proof:
:= get?_node_cons_eq_some.1 h
    have key := labels_replace h v
    let c' : Fin k → STree E := fun j => if (j : ℕ) = i then (c j).replace p v else c j
    have h1 : ∀ j ∈ Finset.univ.erase (⟨i, hi⟩ : Fin k), (c' j).labels = (c j).labels :=
      fun j hj => by
        simp only [c']
        rw [if_neg fun h' => (Finset.mem_erase.1 hj).1 (Fin.ext h')]
    have h2 : c' ⟨i, hi⟩ = (c ⟨i, hi⟩).replace p v := if_pos rfl
    rw [replace_node_cons, labels_node, labels_node]
    change ∑ j, (c' j).labels + u.labels = ∑ j, (c j).labels + v.labels
    rw [← Finset.add_sum_erase _ _ (Finset.mem_univ (⟨i, hi⟩ : Fin k)),
      ← Finset.add_sum_erase _ _ (Finset.mem_univ (⟨i, hi⟩ : Fin k)), Finset.sum_congr rfl h1, h2,
      add_right_comm, key, add_right_comm]

name: Operad.STree.labels_replace_of_eq
statement:
lemma labels_replace_of_eq {t u v : STree E} {p : List ℕ} (h : t.get? p = some u)
    (huv : v.labels = u.labels) : (t.replace p v).labels = t.labels
proof:
:= by
  have := labels_replace h v
  rw [huv] at this
  exact add_right_cancel this

name: Operad.STree.exists_get?_leaf
statement:
theorem exists_get?_leaf : ∀ {t : STree E} {a : ℕ}, a ∈ t.labels → ∃ q, t.get? q = some (leaf a)
  | leaf b, a, h => ⟨[], by rw [Multiset.mem_singleton.1 h]; rfl⟩
  | @node _ k e c, a, h => by
    obtain ⟨i, hi⟩
proof:
:= mem_labels_node.1 h
    obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ := exists_get?_leaf hi
    exact ⟨i.1 :: q, by rw [get?_node_cons_fin]; exact hq⟩

name: Operad.STree.mem_labels_of_get?
statement:
lemma mem_labels_of_get? {t : STree E} {q : List ℕ} {a : ℕ} (h : t.get? q = some (leaf a)) :
    a ∈ t.labels
proof:
:=
  Multiset.mem_of_le (labels_get?_le h) (Multiset.mem_singleton_self a)

name: Operad.STree.get?_leaf_unique
statement:
theorem get?_leaf_unique : ∀ {t : STree E}, t.labels.Nodup → ∀ {a : ℕ} {q q' : List ℕ},
    t.get? q = some (leaf a) → t.get? q' = some (leaf a) → q = q'
  | leaf b, _, a, [], [], _, _ => rfl
  | leaf b, _, a, _ :: _, _, h, _ => by simp at h
  | leaf b, _, a, [], _ :: _, _, h => by simp at h
  | @node _ k e c, _, a, [], _, h, _ => by simp at h
  | @node _ k e c, _, a, _ :: _, [], _, h => by simp at h
  | @node _ k e c, hn, a, i :: q, j :: q', h, h' => by
    rw [get?_node_cons] at h h'
    split_ifs at h with hi
    split_ifs at h' with hj
    by_cases hij : (⟨i, hi⟩ : Fin k) = ⟨j, hj⟩
    · cases Fin.mk.inj_iff.1 hij
      rw [get?_leaf_unique (nodup_of_node hn _) h h']
    · exact absurd (mem_labels_of_get? h')
        (not_mem_of_node hn hij (mem_labels_of_get? h))

open Classical in
                                                                   
noncomputable def pos (t : STree E) (a : ℕ) : List ℕ
proof:
:=
  if h : ∃ q, t.get? q = some (leaf a) then h.choose else []

name: Operad.STree.get?_pos
statement: lemma get?_pos {t : STree E} {a : ℕ} (h : a ∈ t.labels) : t.get? (t.pos a) = some (leaf a)
proof:
:= by
  have h' := exists_get?_leaf h
  rw [pos, dif_pos h']
  exact h'.choose_spec

name: Operad.STree.pos_eq
statement:
lemma pos_eq {t : STree E} (hn : t.labels.Nodup) {a : ℕ} {q : List ℕ}
    (h : t.get? q = some (leaf a)) : t.pos a = q
proof:
:=
  get?_leaf_unique hn (get?_pos (mem_labels_of_get? h)) h

name: Operad.STree.get?_subst
statement:
theorem get?_subst : ∀ {t u : STree E} {q : List ℕ}, t.get? q = some u → ∀ xs : ℕ → STree E,
    (t.subst xs).get? q = some (u.subst xs)
  | t, u, [], h, xs => by rw [get?_nil, Option.some_inj] at h; subst h; simp
  | leaf _, _, _ :: _, h, _ => by simp at h
  | @node _ k e c, u, i :: q, h, xs => by
    obtain ⟨hi, h⟩
proof:
:= get?_node_cons_eq_some.1 h
    rw [subst_node, get?_node_cons, dif_pos hi]
    exact get?_subst h xs

name: Operad.STree.get?_subst_cases
statement:
theorem get?_subst_cases : ∀ {t w : STree E} {xs : ℕ → STree E} {q : List ℕ},
    (t.subst xs).get? q = some w →
    (∃ u, t.get? q = some u ∧ w = u.subst xs) ∨
      ∃ q₀ i q' a, q = q₀ ++ i :: q' ∧ t.get? q₀ = some (leaf a) ∧ (xs a).get? (i :: q') = some w
  | t, w, xs, [], h => by
    rw [get?_nil, Option.some_inj] at h
    exact Or.inl ⟨t, get?_nil t, h.symm⟩
  | leaf a, w, xs, i :: q, h => Or.inr ⟨[], i, q, a, rfl, rfl, h⟩
  | @node _ k e c, w, xs, i :: q, h => by
    rw [subst_node, get?_node_cons] at h
    split_ifs at h with hi
    rcases get?_subst_cases h with ⟨u, hu, rfl⟩ | ⟨q₀, j, q', a, rfl, h₀, h'⟩
    · exact Or.inl ⟨u, by rw [get?_node_cons, dif_pos hi]; exact hu, rfl⟩
    · exact Or.inr ⟨i :: q₀, j, q', a, rfl, by rw [get?_node_cons, dif_pos hi]; exact h₀, h'⟩

name: Operad.STree.replace_subst
statement:
theorem replace_subst : ∀ {t : STree E} {p : List ℕ}, (t.get? p).isSome →
    ∀ (u : STree E) (xs : ℕ → STree E),
    (t.replace p u).subst xs = (t.subst xs).replace p (u.subst xs)
  | t, [], _, u, xs => by simp
  | leaf _, _ :: _, h, _, _ => by simp at h
  | @node _ k e c, i :: p, h, u, xs => by
    obtain ⟨hi, h⟩
proof:
:= get?_node_cons_isSome.1 h
    simp only [replace_node_cons, subst_node]
    congr 1
    funext j
    split_ifs with hj
    · have : j = ⟨i, hi⟩ := Fin.ext hj
      subst this
      exact replace_subst h u xs
    · rfl

name: Operad.STree.subst_update
statement:
theorem subst_update : ∀ {t : STree E}, t.labels.Nodup → ∀ {q : List ℕ} {a : ℕ},
    t.get? q = some (leaf a) → ∀ (xs : ℕ → STree E) (w : STree E),
    t.subst (Function.update xs a w) = (t.subst xs).replace q w
  | t, _, [], a, h, xs, w => by
    rw [get?_nil, Option.some_inj] at h
    subst h
    simp
  | leaf _, _, _ :: _, _, h, _, _ => by simp at h
  | @node _ k e c, hn, i :: q, a, h, xs, w => by
    obtain ⟨hi, h⟩
proof:
:= get?_node_cons_eq_some.1 h
    simp only [subst_node, replace_node_cons]
    congr 1
    funext j
    split_ifs with hj
    · have : j = ⟨i, hi⟩ := Fin.ext hj
      subst this
      exact subst_update (nodup_of_node hn _) h xs w
    · refine subst_congr _ fun b hb => Function.update_of_ne ?_ _ _
      rintro rfl
      exact not_mem_of_node hn (fun h' => hj (by rw [← h'])) (mem_labels_of_get? h) hb

name: Operad.STree.mem_shift
statement: @[simp] lemma mem_shift {V : Set (List ℕ)} {p q : List ℕ} : q ∈ shift V p ↔ p ++ q ∈ V
proof: := Iff.rfl

name: Operad.STree.shift_nil
statement: lemma shift_nil (V : Set (List ℕ)) : shift V [] = V
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.STree.shift_shift
statement: lemma shift_shift (V : Set (List ℕ)) (p q : List ℕ) : shift (shift V p) q = shift V (p ++ q)
proof:
:= by
  ext r
  simp [List.append_assoc]

name: Operad.STree.trunc_leaf
statement: @[simp] lemma trunc_leaf (a : ℕ) (V : Set (List ℕ)) : (leaf a : STree E).trunc V = leaf a
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.STree.trunc_node_of_mem
statement:
lemma trunc_node_of_mem {k : ℕ} (e : E k) (c : Fin k → STree E) {V : Set (List ℕ)}
    (h : [] ∈ V) : (node e c).trunc V = node e fun i => (c i).trunc (shift V [i])
proof:
:= by
  rw [trunc, if_pos h]
  rfl

name: Operad.STree.trunc_node_of_not_mem
statement:
lemma trunc_node_of_not_mem {k : ℕ} (e : E k) (c : Fin k → STree E) {V : Set (List ℕ)}
    (h : [] ∉ V) : (node e c).trunc V = leaf (node e c).first
proof:
:= by
  rw [trunc, if_neg h]

name: Operad.STree.first_trunc
statement:
theorem first_trunc : ∀ {t : STree E}, t.IsShuffle → ∀ V : Set (List ℕ), (t.trunc V).first = t.first
  | leaf _, _, _ => rfl
  | @node _ k e c, h, V => by
    by_cases hV : [] ∈ V
    · rw [trunc_node_of_mem e c hV, first_node _ _ h.pos, first_node _ _ h.pos]
      exact first_trunc (h.child _) _
    · rw [trunc_node_of_not_mem e c hV]
      rfl

name: Operad.STree.isShuffle_trunc
statement:
theorem isShuffle_trunc : ∀ {t : STree E}, t.IsShuffle → ∀ V : Set (List ℕ), (t.trunc V).IsShuffle
  | leaf _, _, _ => trivial
  | @node _ k e c, h, V => by
    by_cases hV : [] ∈ V
    · rw [trunc_node_of_mem e c hV]
      refine ⟨h.pos, fun i => isShuffle_trunc (h.child i) _, ?_⟩
      simp only [first_trunc (h.child _)]
      exact h.mono
    · rw [trunc_node_of_not_mem e c hV]
      trivial

name: Operad.STree.labels_trunc_le
statement:
theorem labels_trunc_le : ∀ {t : STree E}, t.IsShuffle → ∀ V : Set (List ℕ),
    (t.trunc V).labels ≤ t.labels
  | leaf _, _, _ => le_rfl
  | @node _ k e c, h, V => by
    by_cases hV : [] ∈ V
    · rw [trunc_node_of_mem e c hV, labels_node, labels_node]
      exact Finset.sum_le_sum fun i _ => labels_trunc_le (h.child i) _
    · rw [trunc_node_of_not_mem e c hV, labels_leaf, Multiset.singleton_le]
      exact first_mem h

name: Operad.STree.get?_trunc_node
statement:
theorem get?_trunc_node : ∀ {t : STree E} {V : Set (List ℕ)} {q : List ℕ} {k : ℕ} {e : E k}
    {c : Fin k → STree E}, (t.trunc V).get? q = some (node e c) → q ∈ V
  | leaf _, V, [], _, _, _, h => by simp at h
  | leaf _, V, _ :: _, _, _, _, h => by simp at h
  | @node _ k' e' c', V, q, k, e, c, h => by
    by_cases hV : [] ∈ V
    · rw [trunc_node_of_mem e' c' hV] at h
      cases q with
      | nil => exact hV
      | cons i q =>
        obtain ⟨hi, h⟩
proof:
:= get?_node_cons_eq_some.1 h
        have := get?_trunc_node h
        exact this
    · rw [trunc_node_of_not_mem e' c' hV] at h
      cases q with
      | nil => simp at h
      | cons i q => simp at h

name: Operad.STree.get?_trunc
statement:
theorem get?_trunc : ∀ {t u : STree E} {q : List ℕ}, t.get? q = some u → ∀ {V : Set (List ℕ)},
    (∀ q', q' <+: q → q' ≠ q → q' ∈ V) → (t.trunc V).get? q = some (u.trunc (shift V q))
  | t, u, [], h, V, _ => by
    rw [get?_nil, Option.some_inj] at h
    subst h
    rw [get?_nil, shift_nil]
  | leaf _, _, _ :: _, h, _, _ => by simp at h
  | @node _ k e c, u, i :: q, h, V, hV => by
    obtain ⟨hi, h⟩
proof:
:= get?_node_cons_eq_some.1 h
    rw [trunc_node_of_mem e c (hV [] List.nil_prefix (List.cons_ne_nil i q).symm), get?_node_cons,
      dif_pos hi]
    rw [show shift V (i :: q) = shift (shift V [i]) q by rw [shift_shift]; rfl]
    refine get?_trunc h fun q' hq' hne => ?_
    exact hV (i :: q') (List.cons_prefix_cons.2 ⟨rfl, hq'⟩) fun h' => hne (List.cons_injective h')

name: Operad.STree.trunc_subst
statement:
theorem trunc_subst : ∀ {t : STree E}, t.labels.Nodup → ∀ (xs : ℕ → STree E) {V : Set (List ℕ)},
    (∀ q k (e : E k) c, t.get? q = some (node e c) → q ∈ V) →
    (t.subst xs).trunc V = t.subst fun a => (xs a).trunc (shift V (t.pos a))
  | leaf a, _, xs, V, _ => by
    simp only [subst_leaf']
    rw [pos_eq (t := leaf a) (Multiset.nodup_singleton a) (get?_nil _), shift_nil]
  | @node _ k e c, hn, xs, V, hV => by
    rw [subst_node, trunc_node_of_mem _ _ (hV [] k e c (get?_nil _)), subst_node]
    congr 1
    funext i
    rw [trunc_subst (nodup_of_node hn i) xs fun q k' e' c' hq => by
      have := hV (i.1 :: q) k' e' c' (by rw [get?_node_cons_fin]; exact hq)
      exact this]
    refine subst_congr _ fun a ha => ?_
    rw [shift_shift]
    congr 2
    exact (pos_eq hn (by rw [List.singleton_append, get?_node_cons_fin]; exact get?_pos ha)).symm

name: Operad.STree.exists_subst_trunc
statement:
theorem exists_subst_trunc : ∀ {t : STree E}, t.IsShuffle → t.labels.Nodup →
    ∀ V : Set (List ℕ), ∃ zs : ℕ → STree E, (t.trunc V).subst zs = t ∧
      ∀ a ∈ (t.trunc V).labels, (zs a).IsShuffle ∧ (zs a).first = a ∧
        (zs a).labels ≤ t.labels
  | leaf b, _, _, V => ⟨leaf, rfl, fun a ha => by
      rw [trunc_leaf, labels_leaf, Multiset.mem_singleton] at ha
      subst ha
      exact ⟨trivial, rfl, le_rfl⟩⟩
  | @node _ k e c, h, hn, V => by
    by_cases hV : [] ∈ V
    · choose zs hzs hzs' using fun i => exists_subst_trunc (h.child i) (nodup_of_node hn i)
        (shift V [(i : ℕ)])
      classical
      let Z : ℕ → STree E
proof:
:= fun a =>
        if hi : ∃ i, a ∈ ((c i).trunc (shift V [(i : ℕ)])).labels then zs hi.choose a else leaf a
      have hZ : ∀ i, ∀ a ∈ ((c i).trunc (shift V [(i : ℕ)])).labels, Z a = zs i a := by
        intro i a ha
        have hex : ∃ i, a ∈ ((c i).trunc (shift V [(i : ℕ)])).labels := ⟨i, ha⟩
        simp only [Z, dif_pos hex]
        congr 1
        by_contra hne
        exact not_mem_of_node hn hne
          (Multiset.mem_of_le (labels_trunc_le (h.child _) _) hex.choose_spec)
          (Multiset.mem_of_le (labels_trunc_le (h.child _) _) ha)
      refine ⟨Z, ?_, fun a ha => ?_⟩
      · rw [trunc_node_of_mem e c hV, subst_node]
        congr 1
        funext i
        rw [subst_congr _ (hZ i)]
        exact hzs i
      · rw [trunc_node_of_mem e c hV, labels_node] at ha
        obtain ⟨i, -, hi⟩ := Multiset.mem_sum.1 ha
        rw [hZ i a hi]
        obtain ⟨h1, h2, h3⟩ := hzs' i a hi
        exact ⟨h1, h2, h3.trans (labels_le_node e c i)⟩
    · refine ⟨fun _ => node e c, ?_, fun a ha => ?_⟩
      · rw [trunc_node_of_not_mem e c hV]
        rfl
      · rw [trunc_node_of_not_mem e c hV, labels_leaf, Multiset.mem_singleton] at ha
        subst ha
        exact ⟨h, rfl, le_rfl⟩

name: Operad.Sym.snocEquiv_inl
statement: @[simp] lemma snocEquiv_inl (n : ℕ) (k : Fin n) : snocEquiv n (Sum.inl k) = k.castSucc
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.Sym.snocEquiv_inr
statement: @[simp] lemma snocEquiv_inr (n : ℕ) (u : Unit) : snocEquiv n (Sum.inr u) = Fin.last n
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.Sym.snocEquiv_symm_castSucc
statement:
@[simp] lemma snocEquiv_symm_castSucc (n : ℕ) (k : Fin n) :
    (snocEquiv n).symm k.castSucc = Sum.inl k
proof:
:=
  (snocEquiv n).symm_apply_eq.mpr rfl

name: Operad.Sym.snocEquiv_symm_last
statement: @[simp] lemma snocEquiv_symm_last (n : ℕ) : (snocEquiv n).symm (Fin.last n) = Sum.inr ()
proof:
:=
  (snocEquiv n).symm_apply_eq.mpr rfl

name: Operad.SetOperad.comb_succ
statement: lemma comb_succ (n : ℕ) : comb m (n + 1) = map (snocEquiv (n + 1)) (bin m (comb m n) one)
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.SetOperad.comb_one
statement:
lemma comb_one :
    comb m 1 = map ((Equiv.sumCongr unitFinOne (Equiv.refl Unit)).trans (snocEquiv 1))
      (bin m one one)
proof:
:= by
  rw [comb_succ, comb, bin_map_left, map_map]

name: Operad.SetOperad.comb_succ_succ
statement:
lemma comb_succ_succ (ha : IsAssoc m) (n : ℕ) :
    comb m (n + 2) = map ((Equiv.sumAssoc _ _ _).symm.trans
      ((Equiv.sumCongr (snocEquiv (n + 1)) (Equiv.refl Unit)).trans (snocEquiv (n + 2))))
      (bin m (comb m n) (bin m one one))
proof:
:= by
  rw [comb_succ, comb_succ, bin_map_left, eq_map_symm_of_map_eq (bin_assoc_of ha _ _ _)]
  simp only [map_map]
  exact map_congr (fun _ => rfl) _

name: Operad.SetOperad.bin_one_one_comm
statement:
lemma bin_one_one_comm (hc : IsComm m) :
    map (Equiv.sumComm Unit Unit) (bin m one one) = bin m one one
proof:
:=
  (bin_comm_of hc one one).symm

name: Operad.SetOperad.comb_perm
statement:
theorem comb_perm (hc : IsComm m) (ha : IsAssoc m) :
    ∀ (n : ℕ) (σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin (n + 1))), map σ (comb m n) = comb m n
  | 0, σ => map_eq_self (fun k => Fin.ext (by have := (σ k).isLt; have := k.isLt; omega)) _
  | n + 1, σ => by
    have key : ∀ i : Fin (n + 1),
        map (Equiv.swap i.castSucc i.succ) (comb m (n + 1)) = comb m (n + 1)
proof:
:= by
      intro i
      by_cases hi : (i : ℕ) < n
      · 
        have e : ∀ c, (Equiv.swap i.castSucc i.succ) (snocEquiv (n + 1) c)
            = snocEquiv (n + 1) (Equiv.sumCongr
              (Equiv.swap (⟨i, by omega⟩ : Fin (n + 1)) ⟨i + 1, by omega⟩)
              (Equiv.refl Unit) c) := by
          have h1 : i.castSucc = (⟨i, by omega⟩ : Fin (n + 1)).castSucc := Fin.ext rfl
          have h2 : i.succ = (⟨i + 1, by omega⟩ : Fin (n + 1)).castSucc := Fin.ext rfl
          rintro (k | ⟨⟩)
          · rw [h1, h2]
            exact (Fin.castSucc_injective _).swap_apply _ _ _
          · refine Equiv.swap_apply_of_ne_of_ne ?_ ?_ <;>
              simp only [snocEquiv_inr, ne_eq, Fin.ext_iff, Fin.val_last, Fin.val_castSucc,
                Fin.val_succ] <;> omega
        rw [comb_succ, map_map, map_congr (f := (Equiv.sumCongr
          (Equiv.swap (⟨i, by omega⟩ : Fin (n + 1)) ⟨i + 1, by omega⟩) (Equiv.refl Unit)).trans
          (snocEquiv (n + 1))) e, ← map_map, ← bin_map_left, comb_perm hc ha n]
      · 
        rcases n with _ | n
        · obtain rfl : i = 0 := Fin.ext (by have := i.isLt; omega)
          rw [comb_one, map_map]
          conv_rhs => rw [← bin_one_one_comm hc, map_map]
          exact map_congr (fun c => by rcases c with u | u <;> cases u <;> rfl) _
        · obtain rfl : i = Fin.last (n + 1) := Fin.ext (by simp only [Fin.val_last]; omega)
          rw [comb_succ_succ ha, map_map]
          conv_rhs => rw [← bin_one_one_comm hc, bin_map_right, map_map]
          refine map_congr (fun c => ?_) _
          rcases c with k | (⟨⟩ | ⟨⟩)
          · refine Equiv.swap_apply_of_ne_of_ne ?_ ?_ <;>
              simp [snocEquiv, Fin.ext_iff] <;> omega
          · simp [snocEquiv]
          · simp [snocEquiv]
    have hσ : σ ∈ Submonoid.closure
        (Set.range fun i : Fin (n + 1) => Equiv.swap i.castSucc i.succ) := by
      rw [Equiv.Perm.mclosure_swap_castSucc_succ]
      exact Submonoid.mem_top σ
    induction hσ using Submonoid.closure_induction with
    | mem x hx =>
      obtain ⟨i, rfl⟩ := hx
      exact key i
    | one => exact map_refl _
    | mul x y _ _ hx hy => rw [Equiv.Perm.mul_def, map_trans, hy, hx]

name: Operad.SetOperad.map_comb_eq
statement:
lemma map_comb_eq (hc : IsComm m) (ha : IsAssoc m) {A : Type} [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A]
    {n : ℕ} (e f : Fin (n + 1) ≃ A) : map e (comb m n) = map f (comb m n)
proof:
:= by
  conv_rhs => rw [← comb_perm hc ha n (e.trans f.symm)]
  rw [map_map]
  exact map_congr (fun k => by simp) _

name: Operad.SetOperad.map_comb_eq'
statement:
lemma map_comb_eq' (hc : IsComm m) (ha : IsAssoc m) {A : Type} [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A]
    {n n' : ℕ} (e : Fin (n + 1) ≃ A) (f : Fin (n' + 1) ≃ A) :
    map e (comb m n) = map f (comb m n')
proof:
:= by
  obtain rfl : n = n' := by
    have := (Fintype.card_congr e).trans (Fintype.card_congr f).symm
    simp only [Fintype.card_fin, add_left_inj] at this
    exact this
  exact map_comb_eq hc ha e f

name: Operad.SetOperad.exists_equiv_fin
statement:
lemma exists_equiv_fin {A : Type} [Fintype A] (hA : Nonempty A) :
    ∃ n : ℕ, Nonempty (A ≃ Fin (n + 1))
proof:
:=
  ⟨Fintype.card A - 1, ⟨(Fintype.equivFin A).trans (finCongr
    (Nat.sub_add_cancel (Fintype.card_pos_iff.mpr hA)).symm)⟩⟩

name: Operad.SetOperad.prod_eq
statement:
lemma prod_eq {A : Type} [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] (hA : Nonempty A) {n : ℕ}
    (e : A ≃ Fin (n + 1)) : prod hc ha A hA = map e.symm (comb m n)
proof:
:= by
  unfold prod
  induction Fintype.truncEquivFin A using Trunc.induction_on with
  | h f => exact map_comb_eq' hc ha _ _

name: Operad.SetOperad.map_prod
statement:
lemma map_prod {A A' : Type} [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] [Fintype A'] [DecidableEq A']
    (hA : Nonempty A) (σ : A ≃ A') :
    map σ (prod hc ha A hA) = prod hc ha A' (hA.map σ)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨n, ⟨e⟩⟩ := exists_equiv_fin hA
  rw [prod_eq hA e, prod_eq _ (σ.symm.trans e), map_map]
  exact map_congr (fun _ => rfl) _

name: Operad.SetOperad.prod_unit
statement: lemma prod_unit : prod hc ha Unit ⟨()⟩ = one
proof:
:= by
  rw [prod_eq _ unitFinOne, comb, map_symm_map]

name: Operad.SetOperad.prod_fin_two
statement: lemma prod_fin_two : prod hc ha (Fin 2) ⟨0⟩ = m
proof:
:= by
  rw [prod_eq _ (Equiv.refl _), comb_one, bin_one_one, map_map, map_map]
  exact map_eq_self (fun k => by fin_cases k <;> rfl) _

name: Operad.SetOperad.bin_prod_one
statement:
lemma bin_prod_one {A : Type} [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] (hA : Nonempty A) :
    bin m (prod hc ha A hA) one = prod hc ha (A ⊕ Unit) (hA.map Sum.inl)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨n, ⟨e⟩⟩ := exists_equiv_fin hA
  rw [prod_eq hA e, prod_eq _ ((Equiv.sumCongr e (Equiv.refl Unit)).trans (snocEquiv (n + 1))),
    comb_succ, bin_map_left, map_map]
  exact map_congr (fun c => by rcases c with a | ⟨⟩ <;> simp) _

name: Operad.SetOperad.bin_prod
statement:
theorem bin_prod : ∀ (k : ℕ) {B : Type} [Fintype B] [DecidableEq B] (hB : Nonempty B),
    Fintype.card B = k + 1 → ∀ {A : Type} [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] (hA : Nonempty A),
    bin m (prod hc ha A hA) (prod hc ha B hB) = prod hc ha (A ⊕ B) (hA.map Sum.inl)
  | 0, B, _, _, hB, hcard, A, _, _, hA => by
    obtain ⟨b⟩
proof:
:= hB
    have e : Unit ≃ B :=
      { toFun := fun _ => b
        invFun := fun _ => ()
        left_inv := fun _ => rfl
        right_inv := fun b' => Fintype.card_le_one_iff.mp hcard.le _ _ }
    rw [← map_prod ⟨()⟩ e, prod_unit, bin_map_right, bin_prod_one, map_prod]
  | k + 1, B, _, _, hB, hcard, A, _, _, hA => by
    obtain ⟨b⟩ := hB
    have hcard' : Fintype.card (Without B b) = k + 1 := by
      have := Fintype.card_congr (rightUnitEquiv b)
      simp only [Fintype.card_sum, Fintype.card_unit, hcard] at this
      omega
    have hB' : Nonempty (Without B b) := Fintype.card_pos_iff.mp (by omega)
    rw [← map_prod (hB'.map Sum.inl) (rightUnitEquiv b), ← bin_prod_one hB', bin_map_right,
      ← bin_assoc_of ha, bin_prod k hB' hcard' hA, bin_prod_one, map_map, map_prod]

name: Operad.SetOperad.bin_prod'
statement:
theorem bin_prod' {A B : Type} [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] [Fintype B] [DecidableEq B]
    (hA : Nonempty A) (hB : Nonempty B) :
    bin m (prod hc ha A hA) (prod hc ha B hB) = prod hc ha (A ⊕ B) (hA.map Sum.inl)
proof:
:=
  bin_prod (Fintype.card B - 1) hB (by have := Fintype.card_pos_iff.mpr hB; omega) hA

name: Operad.SetOperad.comp_prod
statement:
theorem comp_prod {A B : Type} [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] [Fintype B] [DecidableEq B]
    (hA : Nonempty A) (hB : Nonempty B) (i : A) :
    comp i (prod hc ha A hA) (prod hc ha B hB) = prod hc ha (Without A i ⊕ B) (hB.map Sum.inr)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases h : Nonempty (Without A i)
  · rw [← map_prod (h.map Sum.inl) (rightUnitEquiv i), ← bin_prod_one h,
      comp_map_left_of _ (i := Sum.inr ()) ?h1, comp_inr_bin, one_comp', bin_map_right,
      bin_prod' h hB, map_map, map_map, map_prod]
    · rfl
  · obtain ⟨e, he⟩ : ∃ e : Unit ≃ A, e () = i :=
      ⟨{ toFun := fun _ => i
         invFun := fun _ => ()
         left_inv := fun _ => rfl
         right_inv := fun a => by
           by_contra hne
           exact h ⟨⟨a, fun hai => hne hai.symm⟩⟩ }, rfl⟩
    rw [← map_prod ⟨()⟩ e, prod_unit, comp_map_left_of _ (i := ()) ?h2, one_comp', map_map,
      map_prod]
    · exact he

name: Operad.SetOperad.comp_prod_of_nonempty
statement:
lemma comp_prod_of_nonempty {W : Type} [Fintype W] [DecidableEq W] (hW : Nonempty W) (j : W)
    (h : Nonempty (Without W j)) (y : S B) :
    comp j (prod hc ha W hW) y = bin m (prod hc ha (Without W j) h) y
proof:
:= by
  rw [← SetOperad.map_prod (h.map Sum.inl) (rightUnitEquiv j), ← bin_prod_one h,
    comp_map_left_of _ (i := Sum.inr ()) ?h1, comp_inr_bin, one_comp', bin_map_right, map_map,
    map_map]
  · exact map_eq_self (fun c => by rcases c with w | b <;> rfl) _
  · rfl

name: Operad.SetOperad.comp_prod_of_isEmpty
statement:
lemma comp_prod_of_isEmpty {W : Type} [Fintype W] [DecidableEq W] (hW : Nonempty W) (j : W)
    [IsEmpty (Without W j)] (y : S B) :
    comp j (prod hc ha W hW) y = map (Equiv.emptySum (Without W j) B).symm y
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨e, he⟩ : ∃ e : Unit ≃ W, e () = j :=
    ⟨{ toFun := fun _ => j
       invFun := fun _ => ()
       left_inv := fun _ => rfl
       right_inv := fun w => by
         by_contra hne
         exact IsEmpty.false (⟨w, fun h => hne h.symm⟩ : Without W j) }, rfl⟩
  rw [← SetOperad.map_prod ⟨()⟩ e, prod_unit, comp_map_left_of _ (i := ()) he, one_comp',
    map_map]
  exact map_congr (fun b => by rfl) _

name: Operad.SetOperad.prod_of_unique
statement:
lemma prod_of_unique {W : Type} [Fintype W] [DecidableEq W] (hW : Nonempty W) (e : Unit ≃ W) :
    prod hc ha W hW = map e one
proof:
:= by
  rw [← SetOperad.map_prod ⟨()⟩ e, prod_unit]

name: Operad.ComSet.lift_mu
statement:
@[simp] lemma lift_mu (m : S (Fin 2)) (hc : IsComm m) (ha : IsAssoc m) :
    (lift m hc ha).app (Fin 2) mu = m
proof:
:=
  prod_fin_two (hc := hc) (ha := ha)

name: Operad.ComSet.isComm_mu
statement: lemma isComm_mu : IsComm (S := ComSet) mu
proof: := Subsingleton.elim _ _

name: Operad.ComSet.isAssoc_mu
statement: lemma isAssoc_mu : IsAssoc (S := ComSet) mu
proof: := Subsingleton.elim _ _

name: Operad.ComSet.isComm_app
statement: lemma isComm_app (φ : SetOperadHom ComSet S) : IsComm (φ.app _ mu)
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [IsComm, SetOperadHom.app_map] using congrArg (φ.app _) isComm_mu

name: Operad.ComSet.isAssoc_app
statement: lemma isAssoc_app (φ : SetOperadHom ComSet S) : IsAssoc (φ.app _ mu)
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [IsAssoc, SetOperadHom.app_map, SetOperadHom.app_bin, SetOperadHom.app_one]
    using congrArg (φ.app _) isAssoc_mu

name: Operad.ComSet.hom_ext
statement: theorem hom_ext {φ ψ : SetOperadHom ComSet S} (h : φ.app _ mu = ψ.app _ mu) : φ = ψ
proof:
:= by
  suffices key : ∀ (k : ℕ) (A : Type) [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A], Fintype.card A = k + 1 →
      ∀ x : ComSet A, φ.app A x = ψ.app A x by
    ext A _ _ x
    obtain ⟨n, ⟨e⟩⟩ := exists_equiv_fin x.down
    exact key n A (by simpa using Fintype.card_congr e) x
  intro k
  induction k with
  | zero =>
    intro A _ _ hcard x
    obtain ⟨a⟩ := x.down
    have e : Unit ≃ A :=
      { toFun := fun _ => a
        invFun := fun _ => ()
        left_inv := fun _ => rfl
        right_inv := fun b => Fintype.card_le_one_iff.mp hcard.le _ _ }
    obtain rfl : x = map e one := Subsingleton.elim _ _
    rw [φ.app_map, ψ.app_map, φ.app_one, ψ.app_one]
  | succ k ih =>
    intro A _ _ hcard x
    obtain ⟨a⟩ := x.down
    have hcard' : Fintype.card (Without A a) = k + 1 := by
      have := Fintype.card_congr (rightUnitEquiv a)
      simp only [Fintype.card_sum, Fintype.card_unit, hcard] at this
      omega
    have hA' : Nonempty (Without A a) := Fintype.card_pos_iff.mp (by omega)
    obtain rfl : x = map (rightUnitEquiv a) (bin mu (⟨hA'⟩ : ComSet (Without A a)) one) :=
      Subsingleton.elim _ _
    rw [φ.app_map, ψ.app_map, φ.app_bin, ψ.app_bin, φ.app_one, ψ.app_one, h,
      ih _ hcard' ⟨hA'⟩]

name: Operad.SetOperad.isComm_app
statement:
lemma isComm_app {m : S (Fin 2)} (hc : IsComm m) (φ : SetOperadHom S T) :
    IsComm (φ.app _ m)
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [IsComm, SetOperadHom.app_map] using congrArg (φ.app _) hc

name: Operad.SetOperad.isAssoc_app
statement:
lemma isAssoc_app {m : S (Fin 2)} (ha : IsAssoc m) (φ : SetOperadHom S T) :
    IsAssoc (φ.app _ m)
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [IsAssoc, SetOperadHom.app_map, SetOperadHom.app_bin, SetOperadHom.app_one]
    using congrArg (φ.app _) ha

name: Operad.SetOperad.app_prod
statement:
theorem app_prod {m : S (Fin 2)} (hc : IsComm m) (ha : IsAssoc m) (φ : SetOperadHom S T)
    (A : Type) [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] (hA : Nonempty A) :
    φ.app A (prod hc ha A hA) = prod (isComm_app hc φ) (isAssoc_app ha φ) A hA
proof:
:= by
  have h : φ.comp (ComSet.lift m hc ha) = ComSet.lift (φ.app _ m) (isComm_app hc φ)
      (isAssoc_app ha φ) :=
    ComSet.hom_ext (by rw [ComSet.lift_mu]; exact congrArg (φ.app _) (ComSet.lift_mu m hc ha))
  exact congrArg (fun ψ : SetOperadHom ComSet T => ψ.app A ⟨hA⟩) h

name: Operad.ComSet.respects_iff
statement:
lemma respects_iff {S : (A : Type) → [Fintype A] → [DecidableEq A] → Type v} [SetOperad S]
    (f : ∀ n, ComGen n → S (Fin n)) :
    Pres.Respects ComRel f ↔ IsComm (f 2 .mu) ∧ IsAssoc (f 2 .mu)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    exact ⟨h _ _ .comm, h _ _ .assoc⟩
  · rintro ⟨hc, ha⟩ A _ _ x y hxy
    cases hxy with
    | comm => exact hc
    | assoc => exact ha

name: Operad.Sym.eq_slotOne
statement: lemma eq_slotOne (j : Without (Fin 2) 0) : j = slotOne
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := j
  have hk' : (k : ℕ) ≠ 0 := fun h => hk (Fin.ext h)
  have : k = 1 := Fin.ext (by have := k.isLt; simp only [Fin.isValue, Fin.val_one]; omega)
  subst this
  rfl

name: Operad.Sym.ne_slotOne
statement:
lemma ne_slotOne {A : Type} {j : Without (Fin 2) 0}
    (h : (Sum.inl j : Without (Fin 2) 0 ⊕ A) ≠ Sum.inl slotOne) : False
proof:
:=
  h (congrArg Sum.inl (eq_slotOne j))

name: Operad.Sym.binEquiv_inl_inr
statement:
@[simp] lemma binEquiv_inl_inr (A B : Type) [DecidableEq A] (a : A) (h) :
    binEquiv A B (Sum.inl ⟨Sum.inr a, h⟩) = Sum.inl a
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.Sym.binEquiv_inr
statement:
@[simp] lemma binEquiv_inr (A B : Type) [DecidableEq A] (b : B) :
    binEquiv A B (Sum.inr b) = Sum.inr b
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.Sym.subst3_absurd
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨k, rfl⟩ := ℓ.surjective l
  fin_cases k
  · exact h0 rfl
  · exact h1 rfl
  · exact h2 rfl

name: Operad.Sym.fin3Right_eq
statement: lemma fin3Right_eq : fin3Right = fin3Left.trans (Equiv.sumAssoc Unit Unit Unit)
proof:
:= by
  ext k
  fin_cases k <;> rfl

name: Operad.SetOperad.map_map
statement: lemma map_map (e : A ≃ B) (f : B ≃ C) (x : S A) : map f (map e x) = map (e.trans f) x
proof:
:=
  (map_trans e f x).symm

name: Operad.SetOperad.map_congr
statement: lemma map_congr {e f : A ≃ B} (h : ∀ a, e a = f a) (x : S A) : map e x = map f x
proof:
:= by
  rw [Equiv.ext h]

name: Operad.SetOperad.map_eq_self
statement: lemma map_eq_self {e : A ≃ A} (h : ∀ a, e a = a) (x : S A) : map e x = x
proof:
:= by
  rw [map_congr (f := Equiv.refl A) h, map_refl]

name: Operad.SetOperad.eq_map_symm_of_map_eq
statement:
lemma eq_map_symm_of_map_eq {e : A ≃ B} {x : S A} {y : S B} (h : map e x = y) :
    x = map e.symm y
proof:
:= by
  rw [← h, map_symm_map]

name: Operad.SetOperad.comp_one'
statement: lemma comp_one' (i : A) (x : S A) : comp i x one = map (rightUnitEquiv i).symm x
proof:
:=
  eq_map_symm_of_map_eq (comp_one i x)

name: Operad.SetOperad.one_comp'
statement: lemma one_comp' (y : S B) : comp () one y = map (leftUnitEquiv B).symm y
proof:
:=
  eq_map_symm_of_map_eq (one_comp y)

name: Operad.SetOperad.comp_map_left
statement:
lemma comp_map_left (σ : A ≃ A') (i : A) (x : S A) (y : S B) :
    comp (σ i) (map σ x) y = map (compEquiv σ (Equiv.refl B) i) (comp i x y)
proof:
:= by
  rw [map_comp, map_refl]

name: Operad.SetOperad.comp_map_right
statement:
lemma comp_map_right (τ : B ≃ B') (i : A) (x : S A) (y : S B) :
    comp i x (map τ y) = map (Equiv.sumCongr (Equiv.refl (Without A i)) τ) (comp i x y)
proof:
:= by
  have h := map_comp (S := S) (Equiv.refl A) τ i x y
  rw [map_refl] at h
  have e : compEquiv (Equiv.refl A) τ i = Equiv.sumCongr (Equiv.refl (Without A i)) τ := by
    ext c; rcases c with a | b <;> rfl
  rw [e] at h
  exact h.symm

name: Operad.SetOperad.comp_slot
statement:
lemma comp_slot {i i' : A} (h : i = i') (x : S A) (y : S B) :
    comp i' x y = map (slotEquiv h) (comp i x y)
proof:
:= by
  subst h
  exact (map_eq_self (fun c => by rcases c with a | b <;> rfl) _).symm

name: Operad.SetOperad.comp_map_left_of
statement:
lemma comp_map_left_of (σ : A ≃ A') {i : A} {i' : A'} (h : σ i = i') (x : S A) (y : S B) :
    comp i' (map σ x) y
      = map ((compEquiv σ (Equiv.refl B) i).trans (slotEquiv h)) (comp i x y)
proof:
:= by
  subst h
  rw [comp_map_left]
  exact map_congr (fun c => by rcases c with a | b <;> rfl) _

name: Operad.SetOperad.bin_map_left
statement:
lemma bin_map_left (g : S (Fin 2)) (σ : A ≃ A') (x : S A) (y : S B) :
    bin g (map σ x) y = map (Equiv.sumCongr σ (Equiv.refl B)) (bin g x y)
proof:
:= by
  unfold bin
  rw [comp_map_right, comp_map_left_of _ (i := Sum.inl slotOne) ?h]
  · simp only [map_map]
    refine map_congr (fun c => ?_) _
    rcases c with ⟨j | a, hj⟩ | b
    · exact (ne_slotOne hj).elim
    · rfl
    · rfl
  · rfl

name: Operad.SetOperad.bin_map_right
statement:
lemma bin_map_right (g : S (Fin 2)) (τ : B ≃ B') (x : S A) (y : S B) :
    bin g x (map τ y) = map (Equiv.sumCongr (Equiv.refl A) τ) (bin g x y)
proof:
:= by
  unfold bin
  rw [comp_map_right]
  simp only [map_map]
  refine map_congr (fun c => ?_) _
  rcases c with ⟨j | a, hj⟩ | b
  · exact (ne_slotOne hj).elim
  · rfl
  · rfl

name: Operad.SetOperad.bin_map
statement:
lemma bin_map (g : S (Fin 2)) (σ : A ≃ A') (τ : B ≃ B') (x : S A) (y : S B) :
    bin g (map σ x) (map τ y) = map (Equiv.sumCongr σ τ) (bin g x y)
proof:
:= by
  rw [bin_map_left, bin_map_right, map_map]
  exact map_congr (fun c => by rcases c with a | b <;> rfl) _

name: Operad.SetOperad.bin_one_one
statement: lemma bin_one_one (g : S (Fin 2)) : bin g one one = map finTwoSum g
proof:
:= by
  unfold bin
  rw [comp_one', comp_one']
  simp only [map_map]
  exact map_congr (fun k => by fin_cases k <;> rfl) _

name: Operad.SetOperad.bin_swap
statement:
lemma bin_swap (g : S (Fin 2)) (x : S A) (y : S B) :
    bin (map (Equiv.swap 0 1) g) x y = map (Equiv.sumComm B A) (bin g y x)
proof:
:= by
  unfold bin
  rw [comp_map_left_of _ (i := (1 : Fin 2)) ?h1,
    comp_map_left_of _ (i := Sum.inl (⟨0, by decide⟩ : Without (Fin 2) 1)) ?h2,
    eq_map_symm_of_map_eq (comp_assoc_par (show (1 : Fin 2) ≠ 0 by decide) g x y)]
  · simp only [map_map]
    refine map_congr (fun c => ?_) _
    rcases c with ⟨j | b, hj⟩ | a
    · exact (ne_slotOne hj).elim
    · rfl
    · rfl
  · rfl
  · rfl

name: Operad.SetOperad.comp_inl_bin
statement:
lemma comp_inl_bin (g : S (Fin 2)) (a : A) (u : S A) (v : S B) (y : S C) :
    comp (Sum.inl a) (bin g u v) y = map (binLeftEquiv a) (bin g (comp a u y) v)
proof:
:= by
  unfold bin
  rw [comp_map_left_of _ (i := Sum.inl ⟨Sum.inr a, by simp⟩) ?h1,
    eq_map_symm_of_map_eq (comp_assoc_par
      (show (Sum.inl slotOne : Without (Fin 2) 0 ⊕ A) ≠ Sum.inr a by simp) (comp 0 g u) v y),
    eq_map_symm_of_map_eq (comp_assoc_seq (0 : Fin 2) a g u y),
    comp_map_left_of _ (i := Sum.inl slotOne) ?h2]
  · simp only [map_map]
    refine map_congr (fun c => ?_) _
    rcases c with ⟨j | (a' | c), hj⟩ | b
    · exact (ne_slotOne hj).elim
    · rfl
    · rfl
    · rfl
  · rfl
  · rfl

name: Operad.SetOperad.comp_inr_bin
statement:
lemma comp_inr_bin (g : S (Fin 2)) (b : B) (u : S A) (v : S B) (y : S C) :
    comp (Sum.inr b) (bin g u v) y = map (binRightEquiv b) (bin g u (comp b v y))
proof:
:= by
  unfold bin
  rw [comp_map_left_of _ (i := Sum.inr b) ?h1,
    eq_map_symm_of_map_eq (comp_assoc_seq (Sum.inl slotOne) b (comp 0 g u) v y)]
  · simp only [map_map]
    refine map_congr (fun c => ?_) _
    rcases c with ⟨j | a, hj⟩ | (b' | c)
    · exact (ne_slotOne hj).elim
    · rfl
    · rfl
    · rfl
  · rfl

name: Operad.SetOperad.subst3_map
statement:
lemma subst3_map (σ : L ≃ L') (P : S L) (ℓ : Fin 3 ≃ L) (x : S A) (y : S B) (z : S C) :
    subst3 (map σ P) (ℓ.trans σ) x y z = subst3 P ℓ x y z
proof:
:= by
  unfold subst3
  rw [comp_map_left_of σ (i := ℓ 0) ?h1, comp_map_left_of _ (i := subst3Slot₂ ℓ A) ?h2,
    comp_map_left_of _ (i := subst3Slot₃ ℓ A B) ?h3]
  · simp only [map_map]
    refine map_congr (fun c => ?_) _
    rcases c with ⟨⟨⟨l, h0⟩ | a, h1⟩ | b, h2⟩ | c
    · exact (subst3_absurd ℓ h2).elim
    · rfl
    · rfl
    · rfl
  all_goals rfl

name: Operad.SetOperad.subst3_bin_left
statement:
lemma subst3_bin_left (p q : S (Fin 2)) (x : S A) (y : S B) (z : S C) :
    subst3 (bin p (bin q one one) one) fin3Left x y z = bin p (bin q x y) z
proof:
:= by
  unfold subst3
  rw [comp_slot (i := Sum.inl (Sum.inl ())) (i' := fin3Left 0) rfl,
    comp_inl_bin p (Sum.inl ()) (bin q one one) one x, comp_inl_bin q () one one x, one_comp']
  simp only [bin_map_left, map_map]
  rw [comp_map_left_of _ (i := Sum.inl (Sum.inr ())) ?h1,
    comp_inl_bin p (Sum.inr ()) (bin q x one) one y, comp_inr_bin q () x one y, one_comp']
  simp only [bin_map_left, bin_map_right, map_map]
  rw [comp_map_left_of _ (i := Sum.inr ()) ?h2, comp_inr_bin p () (bin q x y) one z, one_comp']
  simp only [bin_map_right, map_map]
  · exact map_eq_self (fun c => by rcases c with (a | b) | c <;> rfl) _
  all_goals rfl

name: Operad.SetOperad.subst3_bin_right
statement:
lemma subst3_bin_right (p q : S (Fin 2)) (x : S A) (y : S B) (z : S C) :
    subst3 (bin p one (bin q one one)) fin3Right x y z
      = map (Equiv.sumAssoc A B C).symm (bin p x (bin q y z))
proof:
:= by
  unfold subst3
  rw [comp_slot (i := Sum.inl ()) (i' := fin3Right 0) rfl,
    comp_inl_bin p () one (bin q one one) x, one_comp']
  simp only [bin_map_left, map_map]
  rw [comp_map_left_of _ (i := Sum.inr (Sum.inl ())) ?h1,
    comp_inr_bin p (Sum.inl ()) x (bin q one one) y, comp_inl_bin q () one one y, one_comp']
  simp only [bin_map_left, bin_map_right, map_map]
  rw [comp_map_left_of _ (i := Sum.inr (Sum.inr ())) ?h2,
    comp_inr_bin p (Sum.inr ()) x (bin q y one) z, comp_inr_bin q () y one z, one_comp']
  simp only [bin_map_right, map_map]
  · exact map_congr (fun c => by rcases c with a | (b | c) <;> rfl) _
  all_goals rfl

name: Operad.SetOperad.bin_assoc_of
statement:
theorem bin_assoc_of {p q p' q' : S (Fin 2)}
    (h : map (Equiv.sumAssoc Unit Unit Unit) (bin p (bin q one one) one)
      = bin p' one (bin q' one one))
    (x : S A) (y : S B) (z : S C) :
    map (Equiv.sumAssoc A B C) (bin p (bin q x y) z) = bin p' x (bin q' y z)
proof:
:= by
  have h1 := subst3_bin_right p' q' x y z
  rw [← h, fin3Right_eq, subst3_map, subst3_bin_left] at h1
  rw [h1, map_map_symm]

name: Operad.SetOperad.bin_right_of
statement:
theorem bin_right_of {p q p' q' : S (Fin 2)}
    (h : bin p one (bin q one one) = bin p' one (bin q' one one))
    (x : S A) (y : S B) (z : S C) :
    bin p x (bin q y z) = bin p' x (bin q' y z)
proof:
:= by
  have h1 := subst3_bin_right p q x y z
  rw [h, subst3_bin_right] at h1
  exact (map_injective _ h1).symm

name: Operad.SetOperad.bin_left_of
statement:
theorem bin_left_of {p q p' q' : S (Fin 2)}
    (h : bin p (bin q one one) one = bin p' (bin q' one one) one)
    (x : S A) (y : S B) (z : S C) :
    bin p (bin q x y) z = bin p' (bin q' x y) z
proof:
:= by
  have h1 := subst3_bin_left p q x y z
  rw [h, subst3_bin_left] at h1
  exact h1.symm

name: Operad.SetOperad.bin_comm_of
statement:
theorem bin_comm_of {g : S (Fin 2)} (h : map (Equiv.swap 0 1) g = g) (x : S A) (y : S B) :
    bin g y x = map (Equiv.sumComm A B) (bin g x y)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← bin_swap, h]

name: Operad.SetOperadHom.app_bin
statement:
lemma _root_.Operad.SetOperadHom.app_bin
    {T₁ : (A : Type) → [Fintype A] → [DecidableEq A] → Type w₁} [SetOperad T₁]
    {T₂ : (A : Type) → [Fintype A] → [DecidableEq A] → Type w₂} [SetOperad T₂]
    {A B : Type} [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] [Fintype B] [DecidableEq B]
    (φ : SetOperadHom T₁ T₂) (g : T₁ (Fin 2)) (x : T₁ A) (y : T₁ B) :
    φ.app (A ⊕ B) (bin g x y) = bin (φ.app _ g) (φ.app A x) (φ.app B y)
proof:
:= by
  unfold bin
  rw [φ.app_map, φ.app_comp, φ.app_comp]

name: Operad.Syn.eval_bin
statement:
@[simp] lemma eval_bin {S : (A : Type) → [Fintype A] → [DecidableEq A] → Type v} [SetOperad S]
    (f : ∀ n, T n → S (Fin n)) (g : Syn T (Fin 2)) (x : Syn T A) (y : Syn T B) :
    eval f (bin g x y) = SetOperad.bin (eval f g) (eval f x) (eval f y)
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.Pres.mk_bin
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.GrComposite.rsg_false
statement: lemma rsg_false (L L' : LinOrd A) : GrEnd.rsg R L L' (fun _ => false) = 1
proof:
:= by
  unfold GrEnd.rsg
  simp

name: Operad.GrComposite.mk_corGen_reorder
statement:
lemma mk_corGen_reorder (L L' : LinOrd A) (w : W A) (e : A ≃ S) [Fintype S] [DecidableEq S] :
    mk R (corGen (C := C) (R := R) L w e) = mk R (corGen (C := C) (R := R) L' w e)
proof:
:= by
  rw [mk_reorder (corGen (C := C) (R := R) L w e) L' (fun _ => false)
    (fun _ => GrOperad.par_one), rsg_false, one_smul]

name: Operad.GrComposite.mk_corGen_outer
statement:
lemma mk_corGen_outer {B : Type} [Fintype B] [DecidableEq B] (σ : A ≃ B) (L : LinOrd B)
    (L' : LinOrd A) (w : W A) (e : B ≃ S) :
    mk R (corGen (C := C) (R := R) L (SymSpecies.map (R := R) σ w) e)
      = mk R (corGen (C := C) (R := R) L' w (σ.trans e))
proof:
:= by
  rw [mk_outer (corGen (C := C) (R := R) L (SymSpecies.map (R := R) σ w) e) σ w]
  refine Eq.trans ?_ (mk_corGen_reorder (C := C) (R := R) (LinOrd.map σ.symm L) L' w _)
  congr 2

name: Operad.GrComposite.corolla_apply
statement:
lemma corolla_apply (w : W A) :
    corolla R C A w = mk R (corGen (C := C) (R := R) (ordOf A) w (Equiv.refl A))
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.GrComposite.map_corolla
statement:
lemma map_corolla {B : Type} [Fintype B] [DecidableEq B] (σ : A ≃ B) (w : W A) :
    map σ (corolla R C A w) = corolla R C B (SymSpecies.map (R := R) σ w)
proof:
:= by
  rw [corolla_apply, corolla_apply, map_mk, mk_corGen_outer σ _ (ordOf A)]
  rfl

name: Operad.GrComposite.par_corolla
statement:
lemma par_corolla (b : Bool) (w : W A) :
    par R W C b (corolla R C A w) = corolla R C A (GrSpecies.par (R := R) b w)
proof:
:= by
  rw [corolla_apply, par_mk, parFun_of_hy b _ (c := fun _ => false) (fun _ => GrOperad.par_one),
    Fintype.sum_bool]
  have ht : GrEnd.tot (fun _ : A => false) = false := by
    unfold GrEnd.tot
    simp
  cases b <;> simp [ht] <;> rfl

name: Operad.FreeGrL.unitCoeffL_eq_zero
statement:
lemma unitCoeffL_eq_zero {A : Type} [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] (h : IsEmpty (Unit ≃ A))
    (x : FreeGrL R W A) : unitCoeffL R W A x = 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := (𝒥).proj_surjective A x
  have h0 := Lin.induction₁ (S := Reg (TreeOfArity (GrGen R W)))
    (FreeGr.unitCoeff (grGenPar R W) R A) 0 (fun t => ?_) x
  · simpa using h0
  show FreeGr.unitCoeff (grGenPar R W) R A (SgnLin.bas (treeSgn (grGenPar R W)) R t) = 0
  rw [FreeGr.unitCoeff_bas, if_neg]
  intro hl
  have h1 := treeOf_arity t
  rw [Tree.eq_leaf_of_isLeaf hl, Tree.arity_leaf] at h1
  exact h.false (Fintype.equivOfCardEq (by rw [Fintype.card_unit, ← t.2.2, ← h1]))

name: Operad.FreeGrL.aug_u
statement:
@[simp] lemma aug_u {A : Type} [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] (x : FreeGrL R W A) :
    (aug R W).u A x = unitCoeffL R W A x
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.FreeGrL.fst_rootHom
statement:
lemma fst_rootHom {A : Type} [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] (x : FreeGrL R W A) :
    SqExt.fst ((rootHom R W).app A x) = x
proof:
:= by
  have h : (SqExt.fstHom R W (FreeGrL R W) (aug R W)).comp (rootHom R W) = GrOperadHom.id R _ :=
    hom_ext fun A _ _ w => by
      rw [GrOperadHom.comp_app, rootHom, homEquiv_symm_ι]
      rfl
  exact congrArg (fun φ : GrOperadHom R (FreeGrL R W) (FreeGrL R W) => φ.app A x) h

name: Operad.FreeGrL.rootHom_app
statement:
lemma rootHom_app {A : Type} [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] (x : FreeGrL R W A) :
    (rootHom R W).app A x = SqExt.mk x (root R W A x)
proof:
:=
  SqExt.ext (fst_rootHom x) rfl

name: Operad.FreeGrL.root_ι
statement:
@[simp] lemma root_ι {A : Type} [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] (w : W A) :
    root R W A ((ι R W).app A w) = corolla R (FreeGrL R W) A w
proof:
:= by
  show SqExt.snd ((rootHom R W).app A _) = _
  rw [rootHom, homEquiv_symm_ι]
  rfl

name: Operad.FreeGrL.root_one
statement: @[simp] lemma root_one : root R W Unit (GrOperad.one (R := R)) = 0
proof:
:= by
  show SqExt.snd ((rootHom R W).app Unit _) = _
  rw [(rootHom R W).app_one]
  rfl

name: Operad.FreeGrL.root_comp
statement:
lemma root_comp {A B : Type} [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] [Fintype B] [DecidableEq B] (i : A)
    (x : FreeGrL R W A) (y : FreeGrL R W B) :
    root R W _ (GrOperad.comp (R := R) i x y)
      = act R W i y (root R W A x) + lact R W (aug R W) i x (root R W B y)
proof:
:= by
  show SqExt.snd ((rootHom R W).app _ _) = _
  rw [(rootHom R W).app_comp, rootHom_app, rootHom_app]
  rfl

name: Operad.FreeGrL.root_map
statement:
lemma root_map {A B : Type} [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] [Fintype B] [DecidableEq B] (σ : A ≃ B)
    (x : FreeGrL R W A) :
    root R W B (GrOperad.map (R := R) σ x) = GrComposite.map σ (root R W A x)
proof:
:= by
  show SqExt.snd ((rootHom R W).app _ _) = _
  rw [(rootHom R W).app_map, rootHom_app]
  rfl

name: Operad.FreeGrL.root_par
statement:
lemma root_par {A : Type} [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] (b : Bool) (x : FreeGrL R W A) :
    root R W A (GrOperad.par (R := R) b x)
      = GrComposite.par R W (FreeGrL R W) b (root R W A x)
proof:
:= by
  show SqExt.snd ((rootHom R W).app _ _) = _
  rw [(rootHom R W).app_par, rootHom_app]
  rfl

name: Operad.DGCooperad.decomp_d_tw
statement:
lemma decomp_d_tw {A B : Type} [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] [Fintype B] [DecidableEq B] (i : A)
    (x : C (Without A i ⊕ B)) :
    GrCooperad.decomp (R := R) (C := C) i (d (R := R) x)
      = TensorProduct.map (d (R := R)) LinearMap.id (GrCooperad.decomp (R := R) (C := C) i x)
        + TensorProduct.map (GrSpecies.tw (R := R) (V := C) true) (d (R := R))
            (GrCooperad.decomp (R := R) (C := C) i x)
proof:
:= by
  have h : GrSpecies.tw (R := R) (V := C) (A := A) true
      = GrSpecies.par (R := R) false - GrSpecies.par (R := R) true :=
    LinearMap.ext fun y => by
      rw [GrSpecies.tw_apply, σ_true, neg_one_smul, ← sub_eq_add_neg]
      rfl
  rw [decomp_d, h]

name: Operad.DGCooperad.d_unitSpan
statement:
lemma d_unitSpan [GrCooperad.Coaug R C] [DOne R C] {A : Type} [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A]
    {x : C A} (hx : x ∈ GrCooperad.unitSpan R C A) : d (R := R) x = 0
proof:
:= by
  refine Submodule.span_induction (p := fun x _ => d (R := R) x = 0) ?_ (map_zero _) ?_ ?_ hx
  · rintro _ ⟨e, rfl⟩
    rw [← map_d, DOne.d_one, map_zero]
  · intro x y _ _ hx hy
    rw [map_add, hx, hy, add_zero]
  · intro a x _ hx
    rw [map_smul, hx, smul_zero]

name: Operad.compFin_assoc_seq
statement:
lemma compFin_assoc_seq {m n p : ℕ} (i : Fin m) (j : Fin n) (α : P m) (β : P n) (γ : P p) :
    reindex R P (by have := i.isLt; have := j.isLt; omega)
        (compFin (R := R)
          (⟨(i : ℕ) + (j : ℕ), by have := i.isLt; have := j.isLt; omega⟩ : Fin (m - 1 + n))
          (compFin (R := R) i α β) γ)
      = compFin (R := R) i α (compFin (R := R) j β γ)
proof:
:= by
  have hi := i.isLt
  have hj := j.isLt
  simp only [compFin, reindex_reindex]
  
  rw [← reindex_reindex
      (show (i : ℕ) + n + (m - (i : ℕ) - 1)
          = ((i : ℕ) + (j : ℕ)) + 1 + ((n - (j : ℕ) - 1) + (m - (i : ℕ) - 1)) by omega)
      (show ((i : ℕ) + (j : ℕ)) + 1 + ((n - (j : ℕ) - 1) + (m - (i : ℕ) - 1))
          = ((i : ℕ) + (j : ℕ)) + 1 + (m - 1 + n - ((i : ℕ) + (j : ℕ)) - 1) by omega),
    comp_index_congr ((i : ℕ) + (j : ℕ))
      (show (n - (j : ℕ) - 1) + (m - (i : ℕ) - 1)
          = m - 1 + n - ((i : ℕ) + (j : ℕ)) - 1 by omega)]
  
  
  rw [← reindex_reindex
      (show (i : ℕ) + n + (m - (i : ℕ) - 1)
          = (i : ℕ) + ((j : ℕ) + 1 + (n - (j : ℕ) - 1)) + (m - (i : ℕ) - 1) by omega)
      (show (i : ℕ) + ((j : ℕ) + 1 + (n - (j : ℕ) - 1)) + (m - (i : ℕ) - 1)
          = ((i : ℕ) + (j : ℕ)) + 1 + ((n - (j : ℕ) - 1) + (m - (i : ℕ) - 1)) by omega)]
  
  rw [← comp_arity_congr (i : ℕ) (m - (i : ℕ) - 1)
      (show n = (j : ℕ) + 1 + (n - (j : ℕ) - 1) by omega)]
  
  simp only [reindex_reindex]
  rw [← reindex_reindex
      (show ((i : ℕ) + (j : ℕ)) + p + ((n - (j : ℕ) - 1) + (m - (i : ℕ) - 1))
          = (i : ℕ) + ((j : ℕ) + p + (n - (j : ℕ) - 1)) + (m - (i : ℕ) - 1) by omega)
      (show (i : ℕ) + ((j : ℕ) + p + (n - (j : ℕ) - 1)) + (m - (i : ℕ) - 1)
          = m - 1 + (n - 1 + p) by omega)]
  rw [comp_assoc_seq]
  
  rw [comp_arity_congr]
  simp only [reindex_reindex]

name: Operad.compFin_assoc_par
statement:
lemma compFin_assoc_par {m n p : ℕ} (i i' : Fin m) (hlt : (i : ℕ) < (i' : ℕ))
    (α : P m) (β : P n) (γ : P p) :
    compFin (R := R)
        (⟨(i' : ℕ) + n - 1, by have := i'.isLt; omega⟩ : Fin (m - 1 + n))
        (compFin (R := R) i α β) γ
      = reindex R P (by have := i'.isLt; omega)
          (compFin (R := R) (⟨(i : ℕ), by have := i'.isLt; omega⟩ : Fin (m - 1 + p))
            (compFin (R := R) i' α γ) β)
proof:
:= by
  have hi := i.isLt
  have hi' := i'.isLt
  
  rw [show (⟨(i' : ℕ) + n - 1, by omega⟩ : Fin (m - 1 + n))
      = ⟨(i : ℕ) + n + ((i' : ℕ) - (i : ℕ) - 1), by omega⟩ from
    Fin.ext (show (i' : ℕ) + n - 1 = (i : ℕ) + n + ((i' : ℕ) - (i : ℕ) - 1) by omega)]
  simp only [compFin, reindex_reindex]
  
  
  rw [← reindex_reindex
      (show m = (i : ℕ) + 1 + ((i' : ℕ) - (i : ℕ) - 1) + 1 + (m - (i' : ℕ) - 1) by omega)
      (show (i : ℕ) + 1 + ((i' : ℕ) - (i : ℕ) - 1) + 1 + (m - (i' : ℕ) - 1)
          = (i : ℕ) + 1 + (m - (i : ℕ) - 1) by omega)]
  rw [← reindex_reindex
      (show m = (i : ℕ) + 1 + ((i' : ℕ) - (i : ℕ) - 1) + 1 + (m - (i' : ℕ) - 1) by omega)
      (show (i : ℕ) + 1 + ((i' : ℕ) - (i : ℕ) - 1) + 1 + (m - (i' : ℕ) - 1)
          = (i' : ℕ) + 1 + (m - (i' : ℕ) - 1) by omega)]
  set A := reindex R P
    (show m = (i : ℕ) + 1 + ((i' : ℕ) - (i : ℕ) - 1) + 1 + (m - (i' : ℕ) - 1) by omega) α with hA
  
  rw [← reindex_reindex
      (show (i : ℕ) + 1 + ((i' : ℕ) - (i : ℕ) - 1) + 1 + (m - (i' : ℕ) - 1)
          = (i : ℕ) + 1 + (((i' : ℕ) - (i : ℕ) - 1) + 1 + (m - (i' : ℕ) - 1)) by omega)
      (show (i : ℕ) + 1 + (((i' : ℕ) - (i : ℕ) - 1) + 1 + (m - (i' : ℕ) - 1))
          = (i : ℕ) + 1 + (m - (i : ℕ) - 1) by omega)]
  rw [comp_index_congr (i : ℕ)
    (show ((i' : ℕ) - (i : ℕ) - 1) + 1 + (m - (i' : ℕ) - 1) = m - (i : ℕ) - 1 by omega)]
  simp only [reindex_reindex]
  
  rw [← reindex_reindex
      (show (i : ℕ) + n + (((i' : ℕ) - (i : ℕ) - 1) + 1 + (m - (i' : ℕ) - 1))
          = ((i : ℕ) + n + ((i' : ℕ) - (i : ℕ) - 1)) + 1 + (m - (i' : ℕ) - 1) by omega)
      (show ((i : ℕ) + n + ((i' : ℕ) - (i : ℕ) - 1)) + 1 + (m - (i' : ℕ) - 1)
          = ((i : ℕ) + n + ((i' : ℕ) - (i : ℕ) - 1)) + 1
            + (m - 1 + n - ((i : ℕ) + n + ((i' : ℕ) - (i : ℕ) - 1)) - 1) by omega)]
  rw [comp_index_congr ((i : ℕ) + n + ((i' : ℕ) - (i : ℕ) - 1))
      (show (m - (i' : ℕ) - 1) = m - 1 + n - ((i : ℕ) + n + ((i' : ℕ) - (i : ℕ) - 1)) - 1 by omega)]
  
  rw [comp_leading_congr (show (i : ℕ) + 1 + ((i' : ℕ) - (i : ℕ) - 1) = (i' : ℕ) by omega)
    (m - (i' : ℕ) - 1)]
  simp only [reindex_reindex]
  rw [← reindex_reindex
      (show ((i : ℕ) + 1 + ((i' : ℕ) - (i : ℕ) - 1)) + p + (m - (i' : ℕ) - 1)
          = (i : ℕ) + 1 + (((i' : ℕ) - (i : ℕ) - 1) + p + (m - (i' : ℕ) - 1)) by omega)
      (show (i : ℕ) + 1 + (((i' : ℕ) - (i : ℕ) - 1) + p + (m - (i' : ℕ) - 1))
          = (i : ℕ) + 1 + (m - 1 + p - (i : ℕ) - 1) by omega)]
  rw [comp_index_congr (i : ℕ)
    (show ((i' : ℕ) - (i : ℕ) - 1) + p + (m - (i' : ℕ) - 1) = m - 1 + p - (i : ℕ) - 1 by omega)]
  simp only [reindex_reindex]
  
  rw [← reindex_reindex
      (show ((i : ℕ) + n + ((i' : ℕ) - (i : ℕ) - 1)) + p + (m - (i' : ℕ) - 1)
          = (i : ℕ) + n + (((i' : ℕ) - (i : ℕ) - 1) + p + (m - (i' : ℕ) - 1)) by omega)
      (show (i : ℕ) + n + (((i' : ℕ) - (i : ℕ) - 1) + p + (m - (i' : ℕ) - 1))
          = m - 1 + n - 1 + p by omega)]
  rw [comp_assoc_par]

name: Operad.ShuffleOperadIdeal.mem_comap
statement:
@[simp] lemma mem_comap (ψ : ShuffleOperadHom R Q P) (I : ShuffleOperadIdeal R P) {A : Type}
    [Fintype A] [LinearOrder A] {x : Q A} : x ∈ (I.comap ψ).sub A ↔ ψ.app A x ∈ I.sub A
proof:
:=
  Iff.rfl

name: Operad.ShuffleOperadIdeal.quotHom_proj
statement:
@[simp] lemma quotHom_proj (φ : ShuffleOperadHom R P Q) (I : ShuffleOperadIdeal R P)
    (J : ShuffleOperadIdeal R Q) (h : I ≤ J.comap φ) (A : Type) [Fintype A] [LinearOrder A]
    (x : P A) : (quotHom φ I J h).app A (I.proj A x) = J.proj A (φ.app A x)
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.FreeSet.span_relabel_le
statement:
lemma span_relabel_le : ShuffleOperadIdeal.span R (SymOperadIdeal.relabelSet (R := R) r) ≤
    (ShuffleOperadIdeal.span R (shuffleRel R r)).comap (toSh R T)
proof:
:=
  ShuffleOperadIdeal.span_le.2 fun A _ _ x hx => ShuffleOperadIdeal.subset_span A ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩

name: Operad.FreeSet.span_shuffleRel_le
statement:
lemma span_shuffleRel_le : ShuffleOperadIdeal.span R (shuffleRel R r) ≤
    (ShuffleOperadIdeal.span R (SymOperadIdeal.relabelSet (R := R) r)).comap (fromSh R T)
proof:
:=
  ShuffleOperadIdeal.span_le.2 fun A _ _ y hy => by
    obtain ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩ := hy
    show (fromSh R T).app A ((toSh R T).app A x) ∈
      (ShuffleOperadIdeal.span R (SymOperadIdeal.relabelSet (R := R) r)).sub A
    rw [fromSh_toSh]
    exact ShuffleOperadIdeal.subset_span A hx

name: Operad.FreeSet.presToSh_proj
statement:
lemma presToSh_proj (A : Type) [Fintype A] [LinearOrder A] (x : Lin R (FreeSet T) A) :
    (presToSh R r).app A ((SymOperadIdeal.span R r).proj A x) =
      (ShuffleOperadIdeal.span R (shuffleRel R r)).proj A ((toSh R T).app A x)
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.FreeSet.sub_eq_relabel
statement:
lemma sub_eq_relabel (A : Type) [Fintype A] [LinearOrder A] :
    (SymOperadIdeal.span R r).sub A =
      (ShuffleOperadIdeal.span R (SymOperadIdeal.relabelSet (R := R) r)).sub A
proof:
:= by
  rw [← SymOperadIdeal.toShuffle_span r]
  rfl

name: Operad.FreeSet.map_shuffleEquiv
statement:
lemma map_shuffleEquiv (A : Type) [Fintype A] [LinearOrder A] :
    ((ShuffleOperadIdeal.span R (SymOperadIdeal.relabelSet (R := R) r)).sub A).map
      ((shuffleEquiv R A : Lin R (FreeSet T) A ≃ₗ[R] FreeSh R (SGen T) A) :
        Lin R (FreeSet T) A →ₗ[R] FreeSh R (SGen T) A) =
      (ShuffleOperadIdeal.span R (shuffleRel R r)).sub A
proof:
:= by
  refine le_antisymm (Submodule.map_le_iff_le_comap.2 fun x hx => span_relabel_le R r A hx)
    fun y hy => ⟨(fromSh R T).app A y, span_shuffleRel_le R r A hy, toSh_fromSh R A y⟩

name: Operad.FreeSet.presEquiv_apply
statement:
lemma presEquiv_apply (A : Type) [Fintype A] [LinearOrder A]
    (q : (SymOperadIdeal.span R r).Quot A) :
    presEquiv R r A q = (presToSh R r).app A q
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := (SymOperadIdeal.span R r).proj_surjective A q
  rfl

name: Operad.FreeSet.presBasis_apply
statement:
theorem presBasis_apply {ρ : Type*} {O : AdmOrder (SGen T)} (G : Rules R ρ O.toCtxOrder)
    (hG : ShuffleOperadIdeal.span R (shuffleRel R r) = G.shuffleIdeal)
    (hres : ∀ C, (G.rw C).Resolvable) (A : Type) [Fintype A] [LinearOrder A]
    (m : (G.rw (Finset.range (Fintype.card A))).Irr) :
    presBasis R r G hG hres A m =
      (SymOperadIdeal.span R r).proj A ((fromSh R T).app A (Finsupp.single (m : SMono _ _) 1))
proof:
:= by
  have key : ((presEquiv R r A).trans (Submodule.quotEquivOfEq _ _ (by rw [hG])))
      ((SymOperadIdeal.span R r).proj A ((fromSh R T).app A (Finsupp.single (m : SMono _ _) 1))) =
      G.presentedBasis hres A m := by
    rw [Rules.presentedBasis_apply, LinearEquiv.trans_apply, presEquiv_apply, presToSh_proj,
      toSh_fromSh]
    rfl
  rw [presBasis, Module.Basis.map_apply, ← key]
  exact LinearEquiv.symm_apply_apply _ _

name: Operad.FreeSet.finrank_le_card_irr
statement:
theorem finrank_le_card_irr {K : Type u} [Field K]
    (r : ∀ n : ℕ, Set (Lin K (FreeSet T) (Fin n))) {ρ : Type*} {O : AdmOrder (SGen T)}
    (G : Rules K ρ O.toCtxOrder) (hG : G.shuffleIdeal ≤ ShuffleOperadIdeal.span K (shuffleRel K r))
    (A : Type) [Fintype A] [LinearOrder A] [Finite (G.rw (Finset.range (Fintype.card A))).Irr] :
    Module.Finite K ((SymOperadIdeal.span K r).Quot A) ∧
      Module.finrank K ((SymOperadIdeal.span K r).Quot A) ≤
        Nat.card (G.rw (Finset.range (Fintype.card A))).Irr
proof:
:= by
  set S := G.rw (Finset.range (Fintype.card A))
  set J := ShuffleOperadIdeal.span K (shuffleRel K r)
  have : Fintype S.Irr := Fintype.ofFinite _
  have htop : Submodule.map (J.proj A) (Finsupp.supported K K S.Irr) = ⊤ := by
    refine eq_top_iff.2 fun q _ => ?_
    obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := J.proj_surjective A q
    have hx : x ∈ Finsupp.supported K K S.Irr ⊔ S.ideal := by
      rw [S.sup_eq_top]
      trivial
    obtain ⟨a, ha, b, hb, rfl⟩ := Submodule.mem_sup.1 hx
    refine ⟨a, ha, ?_⟩
    rw [map_add, show J.proj A b = 0 from (Submodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero _).2 (hG A hb), add_zero]
  let g := J.proj A ∘ₗ (Finsupp.supported K K S.Irr).subtype
  have hg : LinearMap.range g = ⊤ := by
    rw [LinearMap.range_comp, Submodule.range_subtype, htop]
  have hfin : Module.Finite K (Finsupp.supported K K S.Irr) :=
    Module.Finite.equiv (Finsupp.supportedEquivFinsupp S.Irr).symm
  have hQ : Module.Finite K (J.Quot A) :=
    Module.Finite.of_surjective g (LinearMap.range_eq_top.1 hg)
  have hle : Module.finrank K (J.Quot A) ≤ Nat.card S.Irr := by
    have h1 := LinearMap.finrank_range_le g
    rw [hg, finrank_top, (Finsupp.supportedEquivFinsupp S.Irr).finrank_eq,
      Module.finrank_finsupp_self] at h1
    rwa [Nat.card_eq_fintype_card]
  exact ⟨Module.Finite.equiv (presEquiv K r A).symm, (presEquiv K r A).finrank_eq ▸ hle⟩

name: Operad.FreeGr.eq_map_one_of_isLeaf
statement:
lemma eq_map_one_of_isLeaf {t : Reg (TreeOfArity T) B} (ht : (treeOf t).isLeaf = true) :
    ∃ e : Unit ≃ B, t = SetOperad.map e SetOperad.one
proof:
:= by
  have h1 := treeOf_arity t
  rw [Tree.eq_leaf_of_isLeaf ht, Tree.arity_leaf, t.2.2] at h1
  obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := Fintype.card_eq_one_iff.1 h1.symm
  let e : Unit ≃ B := ⟨fun _ => b, fun _ => (), fun _ => rfl, fun b' => (hb b').symm⟩
  exact ⟨e, eq_of_isLeaf ht rfl⟩

name: Operad.FreeGr.comp_one_eq
statement:
lemma comp_one_eq (j : A) (z : FreeGr R gp A) :
    GrOperad.comp (R := R) j z (GrOperad.one (R := R) (P := FreeGr R gp))
      = GrOperad.map (R := R) (rightUnitEquiv j).symm z
proof:
:= by
  conv_rhs => rw [← GrOperad.comp_one (R := R) j z]
  rw [← GrOperad.map_trans, Equiv.self_trans_symm, GrOperad.map_refl]

name: Operad.FreeGr.one_comp_eq
statement:
lemma one_comp_eq (z : FreeGr R gp D) :
    GrOperad.comp (R := R) () (GrOperad.one (R := R) (P := FreeGr R gp)) z
      = GrOperad.map (R := R) (leftUnitEquiv D).symm z
proof:
:= by
  conv_rhs => rw [← GrOperad.one_comp (R := R) z]
  rw [← GrOperad.map_trans, Equiv.self_trans_symm, GrOperad.map_refl]

name: Operad.FreeGr.comp_bas_leaf
statement:
lemma comp_bas_leaf (j : A) (z : FreeGr R gp A) {t : Reg (TreeOfArity T) B}
    (ht : (treeOf t).isLeaf = true) :
    ∃ E : A ≃ Without A j ⊕ B,
      GrOperad.comp (R := R) j z (SgnLin.bas (treeSgn gp) R t) = GrOperad.map (R := R) E z
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨e, rfl⟩ := eq_map_one_of_isLeaf ht
  refine ⟨(rightUnitEquiv j).symm.trans (compEquiv (Equiv.refl A) e j), ?_⟩
  have h := GrOperad.map_comp (R := R) (P := FreeGr R gp) (Equiv.refl A) e j z
    (GrOperad.one (R := R))
  rw [GrOperad.map_refl] at h
  rw [← SgnLin.map_bas]
  refine (h.symm.trans ?_)
  rw [comp_one_eq, GrOperad.map_trans]
  rfl

name: Operad.FreeGr.comp_leaf_bas
statement:
lemma comp_leaf_bas {t : Reg (TreeOfArity T) B} (ht : (treeOf t).isLeaf = true) (j : B)
    (z : FreeGr R gp D) :
    ∃ E : D ≃ Without B j ⊕ D,
      GrOperad.comp (R := R) j (SgnLin.bas (treeSgn gp) R t) z = GrOperad.map (R := R) E z
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨e, rfl⟩ := eq_map_one_of_isLeaf ht
  obtain ⟨u, rfl⟩ := e.surjective j
  cases u
  refine ⟨(leftUnitEquiv D).symm.trans (compEquiv e (Equiv.refl D) ()), ?_⟩
  have h := GrOperad.map_comp (R := R) (P := FreeGr R gp) e (Equiv.refl D) ()
    (GrOperad.one (R := R)) z
  rw [GrOperad.map_refl] at h
  rw [← SgnLin.map_bas]
  refine (h.symm.trans ?_)
  rw [one_comp_eq, GrOperad.map_trans]

name: Operad.FreeGr.mcomp_map_left
statement:
lemma mcomp_map_left {A' : Type} [Fintype A'] [DecidableEq A'] (e : A ≃ A') (i : A)
    (x : FreeGr R gp A) (y : FreeGr R gp B) :
    mcomp μ gp R (e i) (GrOperad.map (R := R) e x) y
      = GrOperad.map (R := R) (compEquiv e (Equiv.refl B) i) (mcomp μ gp R i x y)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← mcomp_map μ e (Equiv.refl B) i x y, GrOperad.map_refl]

name: Operad.FreeGr.mcomp_map_right
statement:
lemma mcomp_map_right {B' : Type} [Fintype B'] [DecidableEq B'] (e : B ≃ B') (i : A)
