    (x : FreeGr R gp A) (y : FreeGr R gp B) :
    mcomp μ gp R i x (GrOperad.map (R := R) e y)
      = GrOperad.map (R := R) (compEquiv (Equiv.refl A) e i) (mcomp μ gp R i x y)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← mcomp_map μ (Equiv.refl A) e i x y, GrOperad.map_refl]
  rfl

name: Operad.FreeGr.mcomp_leaf_left
statement:
lemma mcomp_leaf_left {x : Reg (TreeOfArity T) A} (hx : (treeOf x).isLeaf = true) (i : A)
    (y : FreeGr R gp B) : mcomp μ gp R i (SgnLin.bas (treeSgn gp) R x) y = 0
proof:
:= by
  induction y using induction_bas with
  | zero => simp
  | add y y' hy hy' => rw [map_add, hy, hy', add_zero]
  | bas c t => rw [map_smul, mcomp_bas_of_left μ _ hx, smul_zero]

name: Operad.FreeGr.mcomp_leaf_right
statement:
lemma mcomp_leaf_right {y : Reg (TreeOfArity T) B} (hy : (treeOf y).isLeaf = true) (i : A)
    (x : FreeGr R gp A) : mcomp μ gp R i x (SgnLin.bas (treeSgn gp) R y) = 0
proof:
:= by
  induction x using induction_bas with
  | zero => simp
  | add x x' hx hx' => rw [map_add, LinearMap.add_apply, hx, hx', add_zero]
  | bas c s => rw [map_smul, LinearMap.smul_apply, mcomp_bas_of_right μ _ hy, smul_zero]

name: Operad.FreeGr.bas_comp
statement:
lemma bas_comp (i : A) (x : Reg (TreeOfArity T) A) (y : Reg (TreeOfArity T) B) :
    SgnLin.bas (treeSgn gp) R (SetOperad.comp i x y)
      = σ R (Tree.tpar gp (treeOf y) && Tree.apar gp (treeOf x) (x.1.rank i)) •
          GrOperad.comp (R := R) i (SgnLin.bas (treeSgn gp) R x) (SgnLin.bas (treeSgn gp) R y)
proof:
:= by
  rw [comp_bas_eq, smul_smul, σ_mul_self, one_smul]

name: Operad.FreeGr.par_bas_self
statement:
lemma par_bas_self (x : Reg (TreeOfArity T) A) :
    GrOperad.par (R := R) (Tree.tpar gp (treeOf x)) (SgnLin.bas (treeSgn gp) R x)
      = SgnLin.bas (treeSgn gp) R x
proof:
:=
  SgnLin.par_bas x

name: Operad.FreeGr.unitCoeff_bas_of
statement:
lemma unitCoeff_bas_of {x : Reg (TreeOfArity T) A} (hx : (treeOf x).isLeaf = false) :
    unitCoeff gp R A (SgnLin.bas (treeSgn gp) R x) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [unitCoeff_bas, hx]
  rfl

name: Operad.FreeGr.mem_of_map_mem
statement:
lemma mem_of_map_mem {A' : Type} [Fintype A'] [DecidableEq A'] (e : A ≃ A') {x : FreeGr R gp A}
    (h : GrOperad.map (R := R) e x ∈ I.sub A') : x ∈ I.sub A
proof:
:= by
  have := I.map_mem e.symm h
  rwa [← GrOperad.map_trans, Equiv.self_trans_symm, GrOperad.map_refl] at this

name: Operad.FreeGr.tw_mem
statement:
lemma tw_mem {x : FreeGr R gp A} (h : x ∈ I.sub A) (e : Bool) :
    GrSpecies.tw (R := R) (V := FreeGr R gp) e x ∈ I.sub A
proof:
:= by
  rw [GrSpecies.tw_apply]
  exact add_mem (I.par_mem false h) (Submodule.smul_mem _ _ (I.par_mem true h))

name: Operad.FreeGr.mcomp_map_left_mem
statement:
lemma mcomp_map_left_mem {A' : Type} [Fintype A'] [DecidableEq A'] (E : A ≃ A')
    {z : FreeGr R gp A} {y : FreeGr R gp B}
    (h : ∀ a, mcomp μ gp R a z y ∈ I.sub (Without A a ⊕ B)) (i : A') :
    mcomp μ gp R i (GrOperad.map (R := R) E z) y ∈ I.sub _
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, rfl⟩ := E.surjective i
  rw [mcomp_map_left]
  exact I.map_mem _ (h a)

name: Operad.FreeGr.mcomp_map_right_mem
statement:
lemma mcomp_map_right_mem {B' : Type} [Fintype B'] [DecidableEq B'] (E : B ≃ B') (i : A)
    {x : FreeGr R gp A} {z : FreeGr R gp B} (h : mcomp μ gp R i x z ∈ I.sub _) :
    mcomp μ gp R i x (GrOperad.map (R := R) E z) ∈ I.sub _
proof:
:= by
  rw [mcomp_map_right]
  exact I.map_mem _ h

name: Operad.FreeGr.mcomp_par_right
statement:
lemma mcomp_par_right (i : A) (c a : Bool) (x : FreeGr R gp A) (z : FreeGr R gp B) :
    mcomp μ gp R i (GrOperad.par (R := R) a x) (GrOperad.par (R := R) c z)
      = GrOperad.par (R := R) (!(xor a c)) (mcomp μ gp R i (GrOperad.par (R := R) a x) z)
proof:
:= by
  conv_rhs => rw [← GrOperad.par_add (R := R) z]
  rw [map_add, map_add, par_mcomp μ hμ, par_mcomp μ hμ]
  cases a <;> cases c <;> simp

name: Operad.FreeGr.mcomp_par_left
statement:
lemma mcomp_par_left (i : A) (c a : Bool) (z : FreeGr R gp A) (y : FreeGr R gp B) :
    mcomp μ gp R i (GrOperad.par (R := R) c z) (GrOperad.par (R := R) a y)
      = GrOperad.par (R := R) (!(xor c a)) (mcomp μ gp R i z (GrOperad.par (R := R) a y))
proof:
:= by
  conv_rhs => rw [← GrOperad.par_add (R := R) z]
  rw [map_add, LinearMap.add_apply, map_add, par_mcomp μ hμ, par_mcomp μ hμ]
  cases a <;> cases c <;> simp

name: Operad.FreeGr.mcomp_par_mem_right
statement:
lemma mcomp_par_mem_right {z : FreeGr R gp B} (i : A)
    (h : ∀ x : FreeGr R gp A, mcomp μ gp R i x z ∈ I.sub _) (c : Bool) (x : FreeGr R gp A) :
    mcomp μ gp R i x (GrOperad.par (R := R) c z) ∈ I.sub _
proof:
:= by
  rw [← GrOperad.par_add (R := R) x, map_add, LinearMap.add_apply, mcomp_par_right μ hμ,
    mcomp_par_right μ hμ]
  exact add_mem (I.par_mem _ (h _)) (I.par_mem _ (h _))

name: Operad.FreeGr.mcomp_par_mem_left
statement:
lemma mcomp_par_mem_left {z : FreeGr R gp A} (i : A)
    (h : ∀ y : FreeGr R gp B, mcomp μ gp R i z y ∈ I.sub _) (c : Bool) (y : FreeGr R gp B) :
    mcomp μ gp R i (GrOperad.par (R := R) c z) y ∈ I.sub _
proof:
:= by
  rw [← GrOperad.par_add (R := R) y, map_add, mcomp_par_left μ hμ, mcomp_par_left μ hμ]
  exact add_mem (I.par_mem _ (h _)) (I.par_mem _ (h _))

name: Operad.FreeGr.unitCoeff_of_mem
statement: lemma unitCoeff_of_mem {z : FreeGr R gp A} (hz : z ∈ (𝒥).sub A) : unitCoeff gp R A z = 0
proof:
:=
  LinearMap.mem_ker.1 ((GrOperadIdeal.span_le (I := noUnitIdeal gp R)).2
    (fun n r hr => LinearMap.mem_ker.2 (hS.unitCoeff_eq n r hr)) A hz)

name: Operad.FreeGr.mcomp_rel_left
statement:
lemma mcomp_rel_left {n : ℕ} {r : FreeGr R gp (Fin n)} (hr : r ∈ S n)
    (x : Reg (TreeOfArity T) A) (i : A) :
    mcomp μ gp R i (SgnLin.bas (treeSgn gp) R x) r ∈ (𝒥).sub _
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := hS.homog n r hr
  revert i
  refine FreeReg.induction (P := fun A _ _ x => ∀ i : A,
    mcomp μ gp R i (SgnLin.bas (treeSgn gp) R x) r ∈ (𝒥).sub _) ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ x
  · intro A B _ _ _ _ e x hx i
    rw [← SgnLin.map_bas]
    exact mcomp_map_left_mem μ 𝒥 e hx i
  · intro i
    rw [mcomp_leaf_left μ rfl]
    exact zero_mem _
  · intro A B _ _ _ _ q x y hx hy i
    rw [bas_comp, map_smul, LinearMap.smul_apply]
    refine Submodule.smul_mem _ _ ?_
    rcases i with i₀ | j
    · refine mem_of_map_mem 𝒥 (parEquiv (Ne.symm i₀.2) B (Fin n)) ?_
      rw [mcomp_comp_par μ hμ (Ne.symm i₀.2) _ (par_bas_self y) hb]
      exact Submodule.smul_mem _ _ ((𝒥).comp_mem_left _ _ (hx i₀.1))
    · by_cases hy0 : (treeOf y).isLeaf = true
      · obtain ⟨E, hE⟩ := comp_bas_leaf q (SgnLin.bas (treeSgn gp) R x) hy0
        rw [hE]
        exact mcomp_map_left_mem μ 𝒥 E hx _
      · refine mem_of_map_mem 𝒥 (seqEquiv q j (Fin n)) ?_
        rw [mcomp_comp_inner μ hμ q j _ _ r (unitCoeff_bas_of (by simpa using hy0))]
        exact (𝒥).comp_mem_right _ _ (hy j)
  · intro k c i
    exact hS.gen_left n r hr k c i

name: Operad.FreeGr.mcomp_rel_right
statement:
lemma mcomp_rel_right {n : ℕ} {r : FreeGr R gp (Fin n)} (hr : r ∈ S n)
    (y : Reg (TreeOfArity T) B) (i : Fin n) :
    mcomp μ gp R i r (SgnLin.bas (treeSgn gp) R y) ∈ (𝒥).sub _
proof:
:= by
  refine FreeReg.induction (P := fun B _ _ y =>
    mcomp μ gp R i r (SgnLin.bas (treeSgn gp) R y) ∈ (𝒥).sub _) ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ y
  · intro A B _ _ _ _ e y hy
    rw [← SgnLin.map_bas]
    exact mcomp_map_right_mem μ 𝒥 e i hy
  · show mcomp μ gp R i r (SgnLin.bas (treeSgn gp) R (SetOperad.one : Reg (TreeOfArity T) Unit))
      ∈ (𝒥).sub _
    rw [mcomp_leaf_right μ (y := (SetOperad.one : Reg (TreeOfArity T) Unit)) rfl]
    exact zero_mem _
  · intro A B _ _ _ _ q y₁ y₂ h1 h2
    rw [bas_comp, map_smul]
    refine Submodule.smul_mem _ _ ?_
    by_cases hy1 : (treeOf y₁).isLeaf = true
    · obtain ⟨E, hE⟩ := comp_leaf_bas hy1 q (SgnLin.bas (treeSgn gp) R y₂)
      rw [hE]
      exact mcomp_map_right_mem μ 𝒥 E i h2
    · rw [← comp_mcomp_outer μ i q r _ _ (unitCoeff_bas_of (by simpa using hy1))]
      exact (𝒥).map_mem _ ((𝒥).comp_mem_left _ _ h1)
  · intro k c
    exact hS.gen_right n r hr k c i

name: Operad.FreeGr.span_le_mergeIdeal
statement: lemma span_le_mergeIdeal : GrOperadIdeal.span R S ≤ mergeIdeal μ hμ hS
proof:
:= by
  refine GrOperadIdeal.span_le.2 fun n r hr =>
    ⟨GrOperadIdeal.subset_span n hr, fun B _ _ x i => ?_, fun B _ _ y i => ?_⟩
  · induction x using induction_bas with
    | zero => rw [map_zero, LinearMap.zero_apply]; exact zero_mem _
    | add x x' hx hx' => rw [map_add, LinearMap.add_apply]; exact add_mem hx hx'
    | bas c s =>
      rw [map_smul, LinearMap.smul_apply]
      exact Submodule.smul_mem _ c (mcomp_rel_left μ hμ hS hr s i)
  · induction y using induction_bas with
    | zero => rw [map_zero]; exact zero_mem _
    | add y y' hy hy' => rw [map_add]; exact add_mem hy hy'
    | bas c t =>
      rw [map_smul]
      exact Submodule.smul_mem _ c (mcomp_rel_right μ hS hr t i)

name: Operad.FreeGr.mcomp_mem_right
statement:
theorem mcomp_mem_right (x : FreeGr R gp A) {z : FreeGr R gp B} (hz : z ∈ (𝒥).sub B) (i : A) :
    mcomp μ gp R i x z ∈ (𝒥).sub _
proof:
:=
  (span_le_mergeIdeal μ hμ hS B hz).2.1 A x i

name: Operad.FreeGr.mcomp_mem_left
statement:
theorem mcomp_mem_left {z : FreeGr R gp A} (hz : z ∈ (𝒥).sub A) (y : FreeGr R gp B) (i : A) :
    mcomp μ gp R i z y ∈ (𝒥).sub _
proof:
:=
  (span_le_mergeIdeal μ hμ hS A hz).2.2 B y i

name: Operad.FreeGr.barD_mem
statement: theorem barD_mem {z : FreeGr R gp A} (hz : z ∈ (𝒥).sub A) : barD μ gp R A z ∈ (𝒥).sub A
proof:
:=
  ((GrOperadIdeal.span_le (I := barDIdeal μ hμ hS)).2 (fun n r hr =>
    ⟨GrOperadIdeal.subset_span n hr, by
      show barD μ gp R (Fin n) r ∈ (𝒥).sub (Fin n)
      rw [hS.barD_eq n r hr]
      exact zero_mem _⟩) A hz).2

name: Operad.reindexS_self
statement: @[simp] lemma reindexS_self {n : ℕ} (h : n = n) (x : S n) : reindexS S h x = x
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.reindexS_reindexS
statement:
@[simp] lemma reindexS_reindexS {l m n : ℕ} (h₁ : l = m) (h₂ : m = n) (x : S l) :
    reindexS S h₂ (reindexS S h₁ x) = reindexS S (h₁.trans h₂) x
proof:
:= by
  subst h₁; subst h₂; rfl

name: Operad.reindexS_injective
statement: lemma reindexS_injective {m n : ℕ} (h : m = n) : Function.Injective (reindexS S h)
proof:
:= by
  subst h; exact fun _ _ h => h

name: Operad.reindexS_symm_eq
statement:
lemma reindexS_symm_eq {m n : ℕ} (h : m = n) (x : S m) (y : S n) :
    reindexS S h x = y ↔ x = reindexS S h.symm y
proof:
:= by
  subst h; exact Iff.rfl

name: Operad.NSSetOperadHom.ext
statement:
@[ext] lemma ext {φ ψ : NSSetOperadHom S T} (h : ∀ n (x : S n), φ.app n x = ψ.app n x) :
    φ = ψ
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨φa, _, _⟩ := φ
  obtain ⟨ψa, _, _⟩ := ψ
  have : φa = ψa := funext fun n => funext (h n)
  subst this
  rfl

name: Operad.NSSetOperadHom.app_reindexS
statement:
lemma app_reindexS (φ : NSSetOperadHom S T) {m n : ℕ} (h : m = n) (x : S m) :
    φ.app n (reindexS S h x) = reindexS T h (φ.app m x)
proof:
:= by
  subst h; rfl

name: Operad.LinNS.compL_single
statement:
@[simp] lemma compL_single (a b : ℕ) {n : ℕ} (s : S (a + 1 + b)) (t : S n) (r r' : R) :
    compL R a b (Finsupp.single s r) (Finsupp.single t r')
      = Finsupp.single (NSSetOperad.comp a b s t) (r * r')
proof:
:= by
  simp [compL, Finsupp.mapDomain_single, Finsupp.smul_single, smul_eq_mul]

name: Operad.LinNS.reindex_single
statement:
@[simp] lemma reindex_single {m n : ℕ} (h : m = n) (s : S m) (r : R) :
    reindex R (LinNS R S) h (Finsupp.single s r) = Finsupp.single (reindexS S h s) r
proof:
:= by
  subst h; rfl

name: Operad.SetOperad.single_nsCompSet
statement:
lemma single_nsCompSet (a b : ℕ) {n : ℕ} (x : toNSSet S (a + 1 + b)) (y : toNSSet S n) :
    (Finsupp.single (α := S (Fin (a + n + b))) (nsCompSet a b x y) (1 : ℤ))
      = SymOperad.nsComp (R := ℤ) (P := Lin ℤ S) a b (Finsupp.single (α := S (Fin _)) x 1)
          (Finsupp.single (α := S (Fin n)) y 1)
proof:
:= by
  rw [SymOperad.nsComp_apply]
  show _ = Lin.mapL ℤ _ (Lin.compL ℤ _ _ _)
  rw [Lin.compL_single, Lin.mapL_single, mul_one]
  rfl

name: Operad.SetOperad.single_nsOneSet
statement:
lemma single_nsOneSet :
    (Finsupp.single (α := S (Fin 1)) (nsOneSet (S := S)) (1 : ℤ))
      = SymOperad.nsOne (R := ℤ) (P := Lin ℤ S)
proof:
:= by
  show _ = Lin.mapL ℤ _ (Finsupp.single one 1)
  rw [Lin.mapL_single]
  rfl

name: Operad.SetOperad.single_reindexS
statement:
lemma single_reindexS {m n : ℕ} (h : m = n) (x : toNSSet S m) :
    (Finsupp.single (α := S (Fin n)) (reindexS (toNSSet S) h x) (1 : ℤ))
      = reindex ℤ (SymOperad.toNS (Lin ℤ S)) h (Finsupp.single (α := S (Fin m)) x 1)
proof:
:= by
  subst h
  rfl

name: Operad.SetOperad.single_inj
proof:
:=
  Finsupp.single_left_injective one_ne_zero h

name: Operad.SetOperad.toNSSet_comp
statement:
@[simp] lemma toNSSet_comp (a b : ℕ) {n : ℕ} (x : toNSSet S (a + 1 + b)) (y : toNSSet S n) :
    NSSetOperad.comp a b x y = nsCompSet (S := S) a b x y
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.SetOperad.toNSSet_one
statement: @[simp] lemma toNSSet_one : (NSSetOperad.one : toNSSet S 1) = nsOneSet (S := S)
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.sum_antidiagonal_reidx_left
statement:
lemma sum_antidiagonal_reidx_left (m : ℕ) (G : ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → β) :
    ∑ p ∈ antidiagonal m, ∑ q ∈ antidiagonal p.2, ∑ r ∈ antidiagonal q.1,
      ∑ s ∈ antidiagonal r.2, G p.1 r.1 s.1 s.2 q.2
    = ∑ p ∈ antidiagonal m, ∑ q ∈ antidiagonal p.2, ∑ r ∈ antidiagonal q.2,
      ∑ s ∈ antidiagonal p.1, G s.1 s.2 q.1 r.1 r.2
proof:
:= by
  simp only [Finset.sum_sigma']
  apply Finset.sum_nbij'
    (fun ⟨⟨a, _⟩, ⟨_, c⟩, ⟨a', _⟩, ⟨b', c'⟩⟩ =>
      ⟨⟨a + a', b' + c' + c⟩, ⟨b', c' + c⟩, ⟨c', c⟩, ⟨a, a'⟩⟩)
    (fun ⟨⟨_, _⟩, ⟨b', _⟩, ⟨c', c⟩, ⟨a, a'⟩⟩ =>
      ⟨⟨a, a' + b' + c' + c⟩, ⟨a' + b' + c', c⟩, ⟨a', b' + c'⟩, ⟨b', c'⟩⟩)
  all_goals aesop (add simp [Finset.mem_sigma, Finset.mem_antidiagonal]) (add safe (by omega))

name: Operad.sum_antidiagonal_reidx_right
statement:
lemma sum_antidiagonal_reidx_right (m : ℕ) (H : ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → β) :
    ∑ p ∈ antidiagonal m, ∑ q ∈ antidiagonal p.2, ∑ r ∈ antidiagonal q.2,
      ∑ s ∈ antidiagonal r.2, H p.1 q.1 r.1 s.1 s.2
    = ∑ p ∈ antidiagonal m, ∑ q ∈ antidiagonal p.2, ∑ r ∈ antidiagonal q.2,
      ∑ s ∈ antidiagonal p.1, H s.1 q.1 s.2 r.1 r.2
proof:
:= by
  simp only [Finset.sum_sigma']
  apply Finset.sum_nbij'
    (fun ⟨⟨a, _⟩, ⟨b, _⟩, ⟨a'', _⟩, ⟨b'', c''⟩⟩ =>
      ⟨⟨a + a'', b + b'' + c''⟩, ⟨b, b'' + c''⟩, ⟨b'', c''⟩, ⟨a, a''⟩⟩)
    (fun ⟨⟨_, _⟩, ⟨b, _⟩, ⟨b'', c''⟩, ⟨a, a''⟩⟩ =>
      ⟨⟨a, b + a'' + b'' + c''⟩, ⟨b, a'' + b'' + c''⟩, ⟨a'', b'' + c''⟩, ⟨b'', c''⟩⟩)
  all_goals aesop (add simp [Finset.mem_sigma, Finset.mem_antidiagonal]) (add safe (by omega))

name: Operad.FormalDeformation.coeff_apply
statement: @[simp] lemma coeff_apply (m : ℕ) (x : μ.Series A) : μ.coeff m x = x m
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.FormalDeformation.ext'
statement: @[ext] lemma ext' {x y : μ.Series A} (h : ∀ m, x m = y m) : x = y
proof: := funext h

name: Operad.FormalDeformation.add_apply'
statement: @[simp] lemma add_apply' (x y : μ.Series A) (m : ℕ) : (x + y) m = x m + y m
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.FormalDeformation.smul_apply'
statement: @[simp] lemma smul_apply' (c : R) (x : μ.Series A) (m : ℕ) : (c • x) m = c • x m
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.FormalDeformation.zero_apply'
statement: @[simp] lemma zero_apply' (m : ℕ) : (0 : μ.Series A) m = 0
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.FormalDeformation.smap_apply
statement:
@[simp] lemma smap_apply (e : A ≃ B) (x : μ.Series A) (m : ℕ) :
    μ.smap e x m = SymOperad.map (R := R) e (x m)
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.FormalDeformation.scomp_apply
statement:
lemma scomp_apply (i : A) (x : μ.Series A) (y : μ.Series B) (m : ℕ) :
    μ.scomp i x y m
      = ∑ p ∈ antidiagonal m, ∑ q ∈ antidiagonal p.2, μ.μ p.1 i (x q.1) (y q.2)
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.FormalDeformation.sum_comp_sone
statement:
lemma sum_comp_sone (i : A) (x : μ.Series A) (a k : ℕ) :
    ∑ q ∈ antidiagonal k, μ.μ a i (x q.1) (μ.sone q.2) = μ.μ a i (x k) (SymOperad.one R)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Finset.sum_eq_single (k, 0)]
  · rfl
  · intro q hq hne
    have : q.2 ≠ 0 := by
      intro h
      apply hne
      rw [Finset.mem_antidiagonal] at hq
      ext <;> simp <;> omega
    simp [sone, this]
  · intro h
    exact absurd (Finset.mem_antidiagonal.mpr (by simp)) h

name: Operad.FormalDeformation.sum_sone_comp
statement:
lemma sum_sone_comp (y : μ.Series B) (a k : ℕ) :
    ∑ q ∈ antidiagonal k, μ.μ a () (μ.sone q.1) (y q.2) = μ.μ a () (SymOperad.one R) (y k)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Finset.sum_eq_single (0, k)]
  · rfl
  · intro q hq hne
    have : q.1 ≠ 0 := by
      intro h
      apply hne
      rw [Finset.mem_antidiagonal] at hq
      ext <;> simp <;> omega
    simp [sone, this]
  · intro h
    exact absurd (Finset.mem_antidiagonal.mpr (by simp)) h

name: Operad.FormalDeformation.sum_antidiagonal_fst_zero
statement:
lemma sum_antidiagonal_fst_zero {M : Type*} [AddCommMonoid M] (m : ℕ) (f : ℕ → ℕ → M)
    (hf : ∀ a b, a ≠ 0 → f a b = 0) : ∑ p ∈ antidiagonal m, f p.1 p.2 = f 0 m
proof:
:= by
  rw [Finset.sum_eq_single (0, m)]
  · intro p _ hne
    apply hf
    intro h
    apply hne
    have := Finset.mem_antidiagonal.mp ‹_›
    ext <;> simp <;> omega
  · intro h
    exact absurd (Finset.mem_antidiagonal.mpr (by simp)) h

name: Operad.FormalDeformation.proj_eq_of_coeff
statement:
lemma proj_eq_of_coeff {n : ℕ} {x y : μ.Series A} (h : ∀ m ≤ n, x m = y m) :
    (μ.truncIdeal n).proj A x = (μ.truncIdeal n).proj A y
proof:
:= by
  rw [← sub_eq_zero, ← map_sub, SymOperadIdeal.proj_eq_zero_iff]
  intro m hm
  show (x - y) m = 0
  rw [show (x - y) m = x m - y m from rfl, h m hm, sub_self]

name: Operad.FormalDeformation.obstruction_apply
statement:
lemma obstruction_apply (φ : ℕ → SymEndo R P) (n : ℕ) (i : A) (x : P A) (y : P B) :
    μ.obstruction φ n i x y
      = ∑ p ∈ antidiagonal n, ∑ q ∈ lowPairs n p.2,
          μ.μ p.1 i ((φ q.1).app A x) ((φ q.2).app B y)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [obstruction, LinearMap.coe_sum, Finset.sum_apply, LinearMap.compl₁₂_apply]

name: Operad.FormalDeformation.sum_split
statement:
lemma sum_split {n : ℕ} (hn : 1 ≤ n) (i : A) (X : ℕ → P A) (Y : ℕ → P B) :
    ∑ p ∈ antidiagonal n, ∑ q ∈ antidiagonal p.2, μ.μ p.1 i (X q.1) (Y q.2)
      = SymOperad.comp (R := R) i (X n) (Y 0) + SymOperad.comp (R := R) i (X 0) (Y n)
        + ∑ p ∈ antidiagonal n, ∑ q ∈ lowPairs n p.2, μ.μ p.1 i (X q.1) (Y q.2)
proof:
:= by
  have hsplit : ∀ p : ℕ × ℕ, ∑ q ∈ antidiagonal p.2, μ.μ p.1 i (X q.1) (Y q.2)
      = ∑ q ∈ lowPairs n p.2, μ.μ p.1 i (X q.1) (Y q.2)
        + ∑ q ∈ (antidiagonal p.2).filter (fun q => ¬ (q.1 < n ∧ q.2 < n)),
            μ.μ p.1 i (X q.1) (Y q.2) := fun p =>
    (Finset.sum_filter_add_sum_filter_not _ _ _).symm
  simp only [hsplit, Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  rw [add_comm]
  congr 1
  rw [Finset.sum_eq_single (0, n)]
  · have hf : (antidiagonal n).filter (fun q => ¬ (q.1 < n ∧ q.2 < n)) = {(n, 0), (0, n)} := by
      ext q
      simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_antidiagonal, Finset.mem_insert,
        Finset.mem_singleton, Prod.ext_iff]
      omega
    rw [hf, Finset.sum_pair (by simp; omega), μ.μ_zero, μ.μ_zero]
  · intro p hp hne
    rw [Finset.mem_antidiagonal] at hp
    have hp1 : p.1 ≠ 0 := fun h => hne (Prod.ext h (by simp; omega))
    refine Finset.sum_eq_zero fun q hq => absurd hq ?_
    rw [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_antidiagonal]
    omega
  · intro h
    exact absurd (Finset.mem_antidiagonal.mpr (by simp)) h

name: Operad.FormalDeformation.isMorAt_iff
statement:
lemma isMorAt_iff (φ : ℕ → SymEndo R P)
    (hφ0 : ∀ (A : Type) [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] (x : P A), (φ 0).app A x = x) {n : ℕ}
    (hn : 1 ≤ n) :
    μ.IsMorAt φ n ↔ ∀ {A B : Type} [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] [Fintype B] [DecidableEq B]
      (i : A) (x : P A) (y : P B), μ.obstruction φ n i x y = (φ n).coboundary i x y
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h A B _ _ _ _ i x y
    rw [SymEndo.coboundary_apply, h, μ.sum_split hn i (fun k => (φ k).app A x)
      (fun k => (φ k).app B y), hφ0, hφ0, obstruction_apply]
    abel
  · intro h A B _ _ _ _ i x y
    have := h i x y
    rw [SymEndo.coboundary_apply, obstruction_apply] at this
    rw [μ.sum_split hn i (fun k => (φ k).app A x) (fun k => (φ k).app B y), hφ0, hφ0, this]
    abel

name: Operad.SymCochain.isCocycle_of_injective
statement:
theorem isCocycle_of_injective {ω : SymCochain R P}
    (Ψ : ∀ (A : Type) [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A], Deformed ω A →ₗ[R] Q A)
    (hinj : ∀ (A : Type) [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A], Function.Injective (Ψ A))
    (hmap : ∀ {A B : Type} [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] [Fintype B] [DecidableEq B] (e : A ≃ B)
      (z : Deformed ω A), Ψ B (Deformed.map ω e z) = SymOperad.map (R := R) e (Ψ A z))
    (hone : Ψ Unit (Deformed.mk (SymOperad.one R) 0) = SymOperad.one R)
    (hcomp : ∀ {A B : Type} [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] [Fintype B] [DecidableEq B] (i : A)
      (z : Deformed ω A) (z' : Deformed ω B),
      Ψ _ (Deformed.comp ω i z z') = SymOperad.comp (R := R) i (Ψ A z) (Ψ B z')) :
    ω.IsCocycle
proof:
:= by
  let S : SymOperad R (Deformed ω) :=
    { map := fun e => Deformed.map ω e
      map_refl := fun z => hinj _ (by rw [hmap, SymOperad.map_refl])
      map_trans := fun e f z => hinj _ (by rw [hmap, hmap, hmap, SymOperad.map_trans])
      one := Deformed.mk (SymOperad.one R) 0
      comp := fun i => Deformed.comp ω i
      map_comp := fun σ τ i z z' => hinj _ (by
        rw [hmap, hcomp, hcomp, hmap, hmap, SymOperad.map_comp])
      comp_one := fun i z => hinj _ (by rw [hmap, hcomp, hone, SymOperad.comp_one])
      one_comp := fun z => hinj _ (by rw [hmap, hcomp, hone, SymOperad.one_comp])
      comp_assoc_seq := fun i j x y z => hinj _ (by
        simp only [hmap, hcomp]
        exact SymOperad.comp_assoc_seq (R := R) i j _ _ _)
      comp_assoc_par := fun hik x y z => hinj _ (by
        simp only [hmap, hcomp]
        exact SymOperad.comp_assoc_par (R := R) hik _ _ _) }
  exact Deformed.isCocycle_of_symOperad S (fun _ => rfl) rfl (fun _ => rfl)

name: Operad.FormalDeformation.ser_apply
statement:
lemma ser_apply (φ : ℕ → SymEndo R P) (n : ℕ) (ω : SymCochain R P) (z : Deformed ω A) (m : ℕ) :
    μ.ser φ n ω A z m
      = if m < n then (φ m).app A (Deformed.fst z) else if m = n then Deformed.snd z else 0
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.FormalDeformation.ser_lt
statement:
lemma ser_lt (φ : ℕ → SymEndo R P) {n : ℕ} (ω : SymCochain R P) (z : Deformed ω A) {m : ℕ}
    (hm : m < n) : μ.ser φ n ω A z m = (φ m).app A (Deformed.fst z)
proof:
:= by
  rw [ser_apply, if_pos hm]

name: Operad.FormalDeformation.ser_self
statement:
lemma ser_self (φ : ℕ → SymEndo R P) (n : ℕ) (ω : SymCochain R P) (z : Deformed ω A) :
    μ.ser φ n ω A z n = Deformed.snd z
proof:
:= by
  rw [ser_apply, if_neg (lt_irrefl n), if_pos rfl]

name: Operad.FormalDeformation.isCocycle_obstruction
statement:
theorem isCocycle_obstruction (φ : ℕ → SymEndo R P)
    (hφ0 : ∀ (A : Type) [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] (x : P A), (φ 0).app A x = x)
    (hφ1 : ∀ k, k ≠ 0 → (φ k).app Unit (SymOperad.one R) = 0) {n : ℕ} (hn : 1 ≤ n)
    (hmor : ∀ m < n, μ.IsMorAt φ m) : (μ.obstruction φ n).IsCocycle
proof:
:= by
  set ω := μ.obstruction φ n
  refine SymCochain.isCocycle_of_injective (Q := (μ.truncIdeal n).Quot)
    (fun A _ _ => ((μ.truncIdeal n).proj A).comp (μ.ser φ n ω A)) ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_
  · intro A _ _
    refine (injective_iff_map_eq_zero _).mpr fun z hz => ?_
    rw [LinearMap.comp_apply, SymOperadIdeal.proj_eq_zero_iff] at hz
    have h0 := hz 0 (Nat.zero_le _)
    have hn' := hz n le_rfl
    rw [ser_lt _ _ _ _ (by omega), hφ0] at h0
    rw [ser_self] at hn'
    exact Deformed.ext h0 hn'
  · intro A B _ _ _ _ e z
    simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply]
    rw [show SymOperad.map (R := R) e ((μ.truncIdeal n).proj A (μ.ser φ n ω A z))
        = (μ.truncIdeal n).proj B (μ.smap e (μ.ser φ n ω A z)) from rfl]
    refine μ.proj_eq_of_coeff fun m _ => ?_
    simp only [ser_apply, smap_apply, Deformed.fst_map, Deformed.snd_map, (φ m).app_map]
    split_ifs <;> simp
  · simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply]
    refine μ.proj_eq_of_coeff fun m hm => ?_
    simp only [ser_apply, Deformed.fst_mk, Deformed.snd_mk]
    show _ = μ.sone m
    simp only [sone]
    rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos m with rfl | hm0
    · rw [if_pos (show 0 < n by omega), hφ0, if_pos rfl]
    · rw [if_neg (show ¬ m = 0 by omega)]
      split_ifs with h
      · exact hφ1 m (by omega)
      · rfl
      · rfl
  · intro A B _ _ _ _ i z z'
    simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply]
    rw [show SymOperad.comp (R := R) i ((μ.truncIdeal n).proj A (μ.ser φ n ω A z))
        ((μ.truncIdeal n).proj B (μ.ser φ n ω B z'))
        = (μ.truncIdeal n).proj _ (μ.scomp i (μ.ser φ n ω A z) (μ.ser φ n ω B z')) from rfl]
    refine μ.proj_eq_of_coeff fun m hm => ?_
    rw [scomp_apply]
    rcases lt_or_eq_of_le hm with hlt | rfl
    · rw [ser_lt _ _ _ _ hlt, Deformed.fst_comp, hmor m hlt]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun p hp => Finset.sum_congr rfl fun q hq => ?_
      have h1 := Finset.mem_antidiagonal.mp hp
      have h2 := Finset.mem_antidiagonal.mp hq
      rw [ser_lt _ _ _ _ (by omega), ser_lt _ _ _ _ (by omega)]
    · rw [ser_self, Deformed.snd_comp, μ.sum_split hn, ser_self, ser_self,
        ser_lt _ _ _ _ (show 0 < m by omega), ser_lt _ _ _ _ (show 0 < m by omega), hφ0, hφ0,
        obstruction_apply]
      congr 1
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun p _ => Finset.sum_congr rfl fun q hq => ?_
      have := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hq).2
      rw [ser_lt _ _ _ _ this.1, ser_lt _ _ _ _ this.2]

name: Operad.FormalDeformation.idEndo_app
statement: @[simp] lemma idEndo_app (x : P A) : (idEndo : SymEndo R P).app A x = x
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.FormalDeformation.zeroEndo_app
statement: @[simp] lemma zeroEndo_app (x : P A) : (zeroEndo : SymEndo R P).app A x = 0
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.FormalDeformation.triv0_zero
statement:
lemma triv0_zero (A : Type) [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] (x : P A) :
    (triv0 0 : SymEndo R P).app A x = x
proof:
:= by
  simp [triv0]

name: Operad.FormalDeformation.triv0_ne
statement: lemma triv0_ne {k : ℕ} (hk : k ≠ 0) : (triv0 k : SymEndo R P) = zeroEndo
proof:
:= by
  simp [triv0, hk]

name: Operad.FormalDeformation.isMorAt_congr
statement:
lemma isMorAt_congr {φ ψ : ℕ → SymEndo R P} {n : ℕ} (h : ∀ k ≤ n, φ k = ψ k)
    (hφ : μ.IsMorAt φ n) : μ.IsMorAt ψ n
proof:
:= by
  intro A B _ _ _ _ i x y
  rw [← h n le_rfl, hφ]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun p hp => Finset.sum_congr rfl fun q hq => ?_
  have h1 := Finset.mem_antidiagonal.mp hp
  have h2 := Finset.mem_antidiagonal.mp hq
  rw [h q.1 (by omega), h q.2 (by omega)]

name: Operad.FormalDeformation.obstruction_congr
statement:
lemma obstruction_congr {φ ψ : ℕ → SymEndo R P} {n : ℕ} (h : ∀ k < n, φ k = ψ k) (i : A)
    (x : P A) (y : P B) : μ.obstruction φ n i x y = μ.obstruction ψ n i x y
proof:
:= by
  rw [obstruction_apply, obstruction_apply]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun p _ => Finset.sum_congr rfl fun q hq => ?_
  have := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hq).2
  rw [h q.1 this.1, h q.2 this.2]

name: Operad.FormalDeformation.isMorAt_zero
statement:
lemma isMorAt_zero (φ : ℕ → SymEndo R P)
    (hφ0 : ∀ (A : Type) [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] (x : P A), (φ 0).app A x = x) :
    μ.IsMorAt φ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro A B _ _ _ _ i x y
  simp [hφ0, μ.μ_zero]

name: Operad.FormalDeformation.exists_step
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hφ0, hφ1, hmor⟩ := hφ
  have hcoc := μ.isCocycle_obstruction φ hφ0 hφ1 (Nat.succ_pos N) fun m hm =>
    hmor m (by omega)
  obtain ⟨ψ, hψ⟩ := hH2 _ hcoc
  have hψ1 := SymCochain.app_one_eq_zero hcoc ψ hψ
  refine ⟨ψ, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro A _ _ x
    rw [Function.update_of_ne (by omega)]
    exact hφ0 A x
  · intro k hk
    by_cases h : k = N + 1
    · subst h
      rw [Function.update_self]
      exact hψ1
    · rw [Function.update_of_ne h]
      exact hφ1 k hk
  · intro n hn
    rcases (show n ≤ N ∨ n = N + 1 by omega) with h | rfl
    · exact μ.isMorAt_congr
        (fun k hk => (Function.update_of_ne (show k ≠ N + 1 by omega) ψ φ).symm) (hmor n h)
    · have h0 : ∀ (A : Type) [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] (x : P A),
          (Function.update φ (N + 1) ψ 0).app A x = x := fun A _ _ x => by
        rw [Function.update_of_ne (by omega)]
        exact hφ0 A x
      rw [μ.isMorAt_iff _ h0 (Nat.succ_pos N)]
      intro A B _ _ _ _ i x y
      rw [μ.obstruction_congr (ψ := φ)
        (fun k hk => Function.update_of_ne (show k ≠ N + 1 by omega) ψ φ), Function.update_self]
      exact hψ i x y

name: Operad.FormalDeformation.build_stable
statement:
lemma build_stable (hH2 : ∀ ω : SymCochain R P, ω.IsCocycle → ω.IsCoboundary) :
    ∀ N k, k ≤ N → (μ.build hH2 N).1 k = (μ.build hH2 k).1 k
  | 0, k, hk => by obtain rfl : k = 0
proof:
:= by omega
                   rfl
  | N + 1, k, hk => by
      rcases (show k ≤ N ∨ k = N + 1 by omega) with h | rfl
      · show Function.update _ _ _ k = _
        rw [Function.update_of_ne (by omega)]
        exact build_stable hH2 N k h
      · rfl

name: Operad.FormalDeformation.exists_trivialization
statement:
theorem exists_trivialization (hH2 : ∀ ω : SymCochain R P, ω.IsCocycle → ω.IsCoboundary) :
    ∃ φ : ℕ → SymEndo R P, μ.PartialTriv 0 φ ∧ ∀ n, μ.IsMorAt φ n
proof:
:= by
  have hstab := μ.build_stable hH2
  refine ⟨fun k => (μ.build hH2 k).1 k, ⟨(μ.build hH2 0).2.1,
    fun k hk => (μ.build hH2 k).2.2.1 k hk, fun n hn => ?_⟩, fun n => ?_⟩
  · obtain rfl : n = 0 := by omega
    exact μ.isMorAt_zero _ (μ.build hH2 0).2.1
  · exact μ.isMorAt_congr (fun k hk => hstab n k hk) ((μ.build hH2 n).2.2.2 n le_rfl)

name: Operad.FormalDeformation.antidiagonal_ne_zero
statement:
lemma antidiagonal_ne_zero {n : ℕ} {p : ℕ × ℕ} (hp : p ∈ antidiagonal (n + 1)) :
    p.1 ≠ 0 ∨ p.2 ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  have := Finset.mem_antidiagonal.mp hp
  omega

name: Operad.FormalDeformation.trivial_scomp
statement:
lemma trivial_scomp (i : A) (x : (trivial R P).Series A) (y : (trivial R P).Series B) (m : ℕ) :
    (trivial R P).scomp i x y m
      = ∑ q ∈ antidiagonal m, SymOperad.comp (R := R) i (x q.1) (y q.2)
proof:
:= by
  rw [scomp_apply, sum_antidiagonal_fst_zero m
    (fun a b => ∑ q ∈ antidiagonal b, (trivial R P).μ a i (x q.1) (y q.2))
    (fun a b ha => Finset.sum_eq_zero fun q _ => by simp [trivial, ha])]
  simp [trivial]

name: Operad.FormalDeformation.sum_antidiagonal_reidx_hom
statement:
lemma sum_antidiagonal_reidx_hom {β : Type*} [AddCommMonoid β] (m : ℕ)
    (G : ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → β) :
    ∑ p ∈ antidiagonal m, ∑ q ∈ antidiagonal p.2, ∑ r ∈ antidiagonal p.1,
      ∑ s ∈ antidiagonal r.2, G r.1 s.1 q.1 s.2 q.2
    = ∑ p ∈ antidiagonal m, ∑ q ∈ antidiagonal p.2, ∑ s ∈ antidiagonal q.2,
      ∑ r ∈ antidiagonal q.1, G p.1 r.1 r.2 s.1 s.2
proof:
:= by
  simp only [Finset.sum_sigma']
  apply Finset.sum_nbij'
    (fun ⟨⟨_, _⟩, ⟨u, v⟩, ⟨c, _⟩, ⟨e, f⟩⟩ => ⟨⟨c, e + u + f + v⟩, ⟨e + u, f + v⟩, ⟨f, v⟩, ⟨e, u⟩⟩)
    (fun ⟨⟨c, _⟩, ⟨_, _⟩, ⟨f, v⟩, ⟨e, u⟩⟩ => ⟨⟨c + e + f, u + v⟩, ⟨u, v⟩, ⟨c, e + f⟩, ⟨e, f⟩⟩)
  all_goals aesop (add simp [Finset.mem_sigma, Finset.mem_antidiagonal]) (add safe (by omega))

name: Operad.FormalDeformation.trivHomApp_apply
statement:
lemma trivHomApp_apply (φ : ℕ → SymEndo R P) (x : (trivial R P).Series A) (m : ℕ) :
    μ.trivHomApp φ A x m = ∑ p ∈ antidiagonal m, (φ p.1).app A (x p.2)
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.FormalDeformation.trivHomApp_eq
statement:
lemma trivHomApp_eq (φ : ℕ → SymEndo R P) (hφ0 : ∀ (A : Type) [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A]
    (x : P A), (φ 0).app A x = x) (x : (trivial R P).Series A) (m : ℕ) :
    μ.trivHomApp φ A x m
      = x m + ∑ p ∈ (antidiagonal m).filter (fun p => p.1 ≠ 0), (φ p.1).app A (x p.2)
proof:
:= by
  rw [trivHomApp_apply, ← Finset.sum_filter_add_sum_filter_not (antidiagonal m) (fun p => p.1 ≠ 0),
    add_comm]
  congr 1
  rw [Finset.sum_eq_single (0, m)]
  · exact hφ0 A (x m)
  · intro p hp hne
    rw [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_antidiagonal, not_not] at hp
    exact absurd (Prod.ext hp.2 (by simp; omega)) hne
  · intro h
    exact absurd (Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_antidiagonal.mpr (by simp), by simp⟩) h

name: Operad.FormalDeformation.trivHomApp_bijective
statement:
theorem trivHomApp_bijective (φ : ℕ → SymEndo R P) (hφ0 : ∀ (A : Type) [Fintype A]
    [DecidableEq A] (x : P A), (φ 0).app A x = x) (A : Type) [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] :
    Function.Bijective (μ.trivHomApp φ A)
proof:
:= by
  have hsum : ∀ (x : ℕ → P A) (m : ℕ),
      ∑ p ∈ (antidiagonal m).filter (fun p => p.1 ≠ 0), (φ p.1).app A (x p.2)
        = ∑ p ∈ (antidiagonal m).attach,
          if h : p.1.1 = 0 then 0 else (φ p.1.1).app A (x p.1.2) := fun x m => by
    rw [Finset.sum_filter, ← Finset.sum_attach]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun p _ => ?_
    by_cases h : p.1.1 = 0 <;> simp [h]
  constructor
  · refine (injective_iff_map_eq_zero _).mpr fun x hx => funext fun m => ?_
    induction m using Nat.strong_induction_on with
    | _ m ih =>
      have := congrFun hx m
      rw [trivHomApp_eq μ φ hφ0, zero_apply'] at this
      rw [Finset.sum_eq_zero fun p hp => ?_, add_zero] at this
      · exact this
      · rw [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_antidiagonal] at hp
        rw [ih p.2 (by omega), zero_apply', map_zero]
  · intro y
    refine ⟨fun m => μ.pre φ y m, funext fun m => ?_⟩
    rw [trivHomApp_eq μ φ hφ0, hsum, pre]
    abel

name: Operad.FormalDeformation.exists_iso_trivial
statement:
theorem exists_iso_trivial (hH2 : ∀ ω : SymCochain R P, ω.IsCocycle → ω.IsCoboundary) :
    ∃ Φ : SymOperadHom R (trivial R P).Series μ.Series,
      (∀ (A : Type) [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A], Function.Bijective (Φ.app A)) ∧
        ∀ (A : Type) [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] (x : (trivial R P).Series A),
          Φ.app A x 0 = x 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨φ, hφ, hmor⟩ := μ.exists_trivialization hH2
  refine ⟨μ.trivHom φ hφ hmor, fun A _ _ => μ.trivHomApp_bijective φ hφ.1 A, fun A _ _ x => ?_⟩
  show μ.trivHomApp φ A x 0 = x 0
  rw [trivHomApp_apply, Finset.Nat.antidiagonal_zero, Finset.sum_singleton]
  exact hφ.1 A (x 0)

name: Operad.extend_genOf
statement:
theorem extend_genOf (f : ∀ k, E k → Q k) {k : ℕ} (e : E k) :
    extend (R := R) f (corolla e) = reindex R Q (arity_corolla e).symm (f k e)
proof:
:=
  extend_corolla f e

name: Operad.assocRel_eq_zero
statement:
theorem assocRel_eq_zero (R : Type u) [CommRing R] :
    (generated (R := R) (assocRels R)).proj 3 (assocRel R) = 0
proof:
:=
  (Submodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero _).2 (subset_generated _ (by simp [assocRels]))

name: Operad.extendHom_assocRel
statement:
theorem extendHom_assocRel (R : Type u) [CommRing R] :
    (extendHom (R := R) (magToAss R)).app 3 (assocRel R) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have h0 := (extendHom (R := R) (magToAss R)).app_compFin
    (⟨0, by omega⟩ : Fin 2) (magOp R) (magOp R)
  have h1 := (extendHom (R := R) (magToAss R)).app_compFin
    (⟨1, by omega⟩ : Fin 2) (magOp R) (magOp R)
  unfold assocRel
  rw [map_sub, sub_eq_zero, h0, h1]
  rfl

name: Operad.magOp_mem_weightSpan
statement:
lemma magOp_mem_weightSpan (R : Type u) [CommRing R] :
    magOp R ∈ Free.weightSpan R MagGen 2 1
proof:
:= by
  have h := Free.gen_mem_weightSpan (R := R) ⟨corolla magMul, arity_corolla magMul⟩
  simpa [magOp, genOf, TreeOfArity.weight] using h

name: Operad.assocRel_mem_weightSpan
statement:
theorem assocRel_mem_weightSpan (R : Type u) [CommRing R] :
    assocRel R ∈ Free.weightSpan R MagGen 3 2
proof:
:=
  Submodule.sub_mem _
    (Free.compFin_mem_weightSpan _ (magOp_mem_weightSpan R) (magOp_mem_weightSpan R))
    (Free.compFin_mem_weightSpan _ (magOp_mem_weightSpan R) (magOp_mem_weightSpan R))

name: Operad.Schur.rel_mem
statement:
lemma rel_mem {n : ℕ} {x : SchurGen P V n →₀ R} (hx : x ∈ schurRelSet R P V n) :
    lof R ℕ (fun n => SchurGen P V n →₀ R) n x ∈ schurRel R P V
proof:
:=
  Submodule.subset_span (Set.mem_iUnion.2 ⟨n, x, hx, rfl⟩)

name: Operad.Schur.mk_sub_eq
statement:
lemma mk_sub_eq {n : ℕ} {x : SchurGen P V n →₀ R} (hx : x ∈ schurRelSet R P V n) :
    (schurRel R P V).mkQ (lof R ℕ (fun n => SchurGen P V n →₀ R) n x) = 0
proof:
:=
  (Submodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero _).2 (rel_mem hx)

name: Operad.Schur.mk_add
statement:
lemma mk_add (n : ℕ) (p p' : P (Fin n)) (v : Fin n → V) :
    mk R n (p + p') v = mk R n p v + mk R n p' v
proof:
:= by
  have := mk_sub_eq (R := R) (Or.inl (Or.inl (Or.inl (Or.inl ⟨p, p', v, rfl⟩))))
  rw [map_sub, map_sub, map_sub, map_sub, sub_sub, sub_eq_zero] at this
  exact this

name: Operad.Schur.mk_smul
statement:
lemma mk_smul (n : ℕ) (c : R) (p : P (Fin n)) (v : Fin n → V) :
    mk R n (c • p) v = c • mk R n p v
proof:
:= by
  have := mk_sub_eq (R := R) (Or.inl (Or.inl (Or.inl (Or.inr ⟨c, p, v, rfl⟩))))
  rw [map_sub, map_sub, map_smul, map_smul, sub_eq_zero] at this
  exact this

name: Operad.Schur.mk_update_add
statement:
lemma mk_update_add (n : ℕ) (p : P (Fin n)) (v : Fin n → V) (i : Fin n) (a b : V) :
    mk R n p (update v i (a + b)) = mk R n p (update v i a) + mk R n p (update v i b)
proof:
:= by
  have := mk_sub_eq (R := R) (Or.inl (Or.inl (Or.inr ⟨p, v, i, a, b, rfl⟩)))
  rw [map_sub, map_sub, map_sub, map_sub, sub_sub, sub_eq_zero] at this
  exact this

name: Operad.Schur.mk_update_smul
statement:
lemma mk_update_smul (n : ℕ) (p : P (Fin n)) (v : Fin n → V) (i : Fin n) (c : R) (a : V) :
    mk R n p (update v i (c • a)) = c • mk R n p (update v i a)
proof:
:= by
  have := mk_sub_eq (R := R) (Or.inl (Or.inr ⟨p, v, i, c, a, rfl⟩))
  rw [map_sub, map_sub, map_smul, map_smul, sub_eq_zero] at this
  exact this

name: Operad.Schur.mk_map
statement:
lemma mk_map (n : ℕ) (σ : Fin n ≃ Fin n) (p : P (Fin n)) (v : Fin n → V) :
    mk R n (SymSpecies.map (R := R) σ p) v = mk R n p (v ∘ σ)
proof:
:= by
  have := mk_sub_eq (R := R) (Or.inr ⟨σ, p, v, rfl⟩)
  rw [map_sub, map_sub, sub_eq_zero] at this
  exact this

name: Operad.Schur.mkA_chart
statement:
lemma mkA_chart {A : Type} [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] {n : ℕ} (φ : A ≃ Fin n) (p : P A)
    (v : A → V) : mkA R p v = mk R n (SymSpecies.map (R := R) φ p) (v ∘ φ.symm)
proof:
:= by
  have hn : n = Fintype.card A := by simpa using (Fintype.card_congr φ).symm
  subst hn
  set ψ := Fintype.equivFin A
  have : SymSpecies.map (R := R) φ p = SymSpecies.map (R := R) (ψ.symm.trans φ)
      (SymSpecies.map (R := R) ψ p) := by
    rw [← SymSpecies.map_trans (R := R), ← Equiv.trans_assoc, Equiv.self_trans_symm,
      Equiv.refl_trans]
  rw [mkA, this, mk_map]
  congr 1
  funext k
  simp [ψ]

name: Operad.Schur.mkA_fin
statement: lemma mkA_fin {n : ℕ} (p : P (Fin n)) (v : Fin n → V) : mkA R p v = mk R n p v
proof:
:= by
  rw [mkA_chart (Equiv.refl _), SymSpecies.map_refl (R := R)]
  rfl

name: Operad.Schur.mkA_map
statement:
lemma mkA_map {A B : Type} [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] [Fintype B] [DecidableEq B] (e : A ≃ B)
    (p : P A) (v : B → V) : mkA R (SymSpecies.map (R := R) e p) v = mkA R p (v ∘ e)
proof:
:= by
  rw [mkA, ← SymSpecies.map_trans (R := R), mkA_chart (e.trans (Fintype.equivFin B))]
  congr 1
  funext k
  simp

name: Operad.Schur.mkA_add
statement:
lemma mkA_add {A : Type} [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] (p p' : P A) (v : A → V) :
    mkA R (p + p') v = mkA R p v + mkA R p' v
proof:
:= by
  rw [mkA, mkA, mkA, map_add, mk_add]

name: Operad.Schur.mkA_smul
statement:
lemma mkA_smul {A : Type} [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] (c : R) (p : P A) (v : A → V) :
    mkA R (c • p) v = c • mkA R p v
proof:
:= by
  rw [mkA, mkA, map_smul, mk_smul]

name: Operad.Schur.mkA_update_add
statement:
lemma mkA_update_add {A : Type} [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] (p : P A) (v : A → V) (a : A)
    (x y : V) : mkA R p (update v a (x + y)) = mkA R p (update v a x) + mkA R p (update v a y)
proof:
:= by
  have e : ∀ z : V, update v a z ∘ (Fintype.equivFin A).symm
      = update (v ∘ (Fintype.equivFin A).symm) (Fintype.equivFin A a) z := fun z => by
    funext k
    by_cases hk : k = Fintype.equivFin A a
    · subst hk
      rw [comp_apply, Equiv.symm_apply_apply, update_self, update_self]
    · rw [comp_apply, update_of_ne hk, update_of_ne (fun h => hk (by rw [← h]; simp))]
      rfl
  rw [mkA, mkA, mkA, e, e, e, mk_update_add]

name: Operad.Schur.mkA_update_smul
statement:
lemma mkA_update_smul {A : Type} [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] (p : P A) (v : A → V) (a : A)
    (c : R) (x : V) : mkA R p (update v a (c • x)) = c • mkA R p (update v a x)
proof:
:= by
  have e : ∀ z : V, update v a z ∘ (Fintype.equivFin A).symm
      = update (v ∘ (Fintype.equivFin A).symm) (Fintype.equivFin A a) z := fun z => by
    funext k
    by_cases hk : k = Fintype.equivFin A a
    · subst hk
      rw [comp_apply, Equiv.symm_apply_apply, update_self, update_self]
    · rw [comp_apply, update_of_ne hk, update_of_ne (fun h => hk (by rw [← h]; simp))]
      rfl
  rw [mkA, mkA, e, e, mk_update_smul]

name: Operad.Schur.liftPre_gen
statement:
lemma liftPre_gen (f : ∀ n : ℕ, P (Fin n) →ₗ[R] MultilinearMap R (fun _ : Fin n => V) W)
    (n : ℕ) (p : P (Fin n)) (v : Fin n → V) (c : R) :
    liftPre f (lof R ℕ (fun n => SchurGen P V n →₀ R) n (Finsupp.single (p, v) c))
      = c • f n p v
proof:
:= by
  simp [liftPre]

name: Operad.Schur.lift_mk
statement:
@[simp] lemma lift_mk (f : ∀ n : ℕ, P (Fin n) →ₗ[R] MultilinearMap R (fun _ : Fin n => V) W)
    (hf : Compatible f) (n : ℕ) (p : P (Fin n)) (v : Fin n → V) :
    lift f hf (mk R n p v) = f n p v
proof:
:= by
  simp [lift, mk, liftPre]

name: Operad.Schur.hom_ext
statement:
theorem hom_ext {φ ψ : Schur R P V →ₗ[R] W} (h : ∀ (n : ℕ) (p : P (Fin n)) (v : Fin n → V),
    φ (mk R n p v) = ψ (mk R n p v)) : φ = ψ
proof:
:= by
  refine Submodule.linearMap_qext _ (DirectSum.linearMap_ext R fun n => ?_)
  exact Finsupp.lhom_ext fun g c => by
    have := h n g.1 g.2
    simp only [mk, Submodule.mkQ_apply] at this
    simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply, Submodule.mkQ_apply]
    rw [← mul_one c, ← smul_eq_mul, ← Finsupp.smul_single, map_smul,
      Submodule.Quotient.mk_smul, map_smul, map_smul, this]

name: Operad.PoisBin.ev_toS
statement:
theorem ev_toS : ∀ t : LTree (PoisShGen 2), ev K t = PoisShGen.ev K (toS t)
  | .leaf _ => rfl
  | .node e l r => by
    rw [ev, toS_node, PoisShGen.ev, evAt_node, ev_toS l, ev_toS r]
    rfl

                                                                    
noncomputable def evL (n : ℕ) : (Mono (PoisShGen 2) n → K) →ₗ[K] PoisDim.W K
proof:
:=
  ∑ σ, (LinearMap.proj σ).smulRight (ev K σ.1)

name: Operad.PoisBin.evL_apply
statement:
lemma evL_apply {n : ℕ} (v : Mono (PoisShGen 2) n → K) :
    evL K n v = ∑ σ, v σ • ev K σ.1
proof:
:= by
  simp [evL]

name: Operad.PoisBin.evL_eq
statement:
theorem evL_eq (n : ℕ) (v : Mono (PoisShGen 2) n → K) :
    PoisShGen.evL K (Finset.range n) (vecEquiv PoisShGen K n v) = evL K n v
proof:
:= by
  rw [vecEquiv_eq_sum, map_sum, evL_apply]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun x _ => ?_
  rw [map_smul, PoisShGen.evL, Finsupp.linearCombination_single, one_smul, monoEquiv_val,
    ev_toS]

name: Operad.PoisBin.evL_comp
statement:
lemma evL_comp (n : ℕ) :
    PoisShGen.evL K (Finset.range n) ∘ₗ (vecEquiv PoisShGen K n).toLinearMap = evL K n
proof:
:=
  LinearMap.ext (evL_eq n)

name: Operad.PoisBin.src_rules
statement: lemma src_rules (r : Rule) : (PoisShGen.rules K).src r = Finset.range 3
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.PoisBin.eq_lead_of_not_normal
statement:
lemma eq_lead_of_not_normal {g : SMono PoisShGen (Finset.range 3)}
    (h : ¬ (PoisShGen.rules K).Normal g) : ∃ r : Rule, g.1 = r.lead.1
proof:
:= by
  rw [normal_iff (PoisShGen.rules K) (src_rules K) (L := Set.range fun r : Rule => ofS r.lead.1)
    rfl g] at h
  have hm := (mem_monomials 3 (ofS g.1)).1 (ofS_mem g)
  have hw : (ofS g.1).windows = [ofS g.1] := by
    obtain ⟨e, f, h' | h' | h'⟩ := mono3_cases hm.1 hm.2 <;> rw [h'] <;> rfl
  obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ : ofS g.1 ∈ Set.range fun r : Rule => ofS r.lead.1 := by
    by_contra hL
    exact h fun w hw' => by
      rw [hw, List.mem_singleton] at hw'
      exact hw' ▸ hL
  refine ⟨r, ?_⟩
  rw [← toS_ofS g.1, ← hr, toS_ofS]

name: Operad.PoisBin.lead_inj
statement: lemma lead_inj {r r' : Rule} (h : r.lead.1 = r'.lead.1) : r = r'
proof:
:= by
  have h' := congrArg ofS h
  cases r <;> cases r' <;> first | rfl | exact absurd h' (by decide)

name: Operad.PoisBin.tail_ne_lead
statement:
lemma tail_ne_lead {r : Rule} {m : SMono PoisShGen three} (hm : m ∈ (Rule.tail K r).support)
    (r' : Rule) : m.1 ≠ r'.lead.1
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  have h' := congrArg ofS h
  cases r <;> simp only [Rule.tail] at hm
  · rcases mem_support₂ hm with rfl | rfl <;> cases r' <;> exact absurd h' (by decide)
  · rcases mem_support₂ hm with rfl | rfl <;> cases r' <;> exact absurd h' (by decide)
  · rcases mem_support_sub hm with rfl | rfl <;> cases r' <;> exact absurd h' (by decide)
  · rcases mem_support₂ hm with rfl | rfl <;> cases r' <;> exact absurd h' (by decide)
  · rcases mem_support₁ hm with rfl
    cases r' <;> exact absurd h' (by decide)
  · rcases mem_support₁ hm with rfl
    cases r' <;> exact absurd h' (by decide)

name: Operad.PoisBin.ruleVec_lead
statement:
lemma ruleVec_lead (r r' : Rule) :
    ruleVec (PoisShGen.rules K) (src_rules K) r' (SMono.cast (src_rules K r) r.lead) =
      if r' = r then 1 else 0
proof:
:= by
  have hinj : Function.Injective (SMono.cast (E := PoisShGen) (src_rules K r')) :=
    fun a b h => Subtype.ext (congrArg Subtype.val h)
  have hc : SMono.cast (src_rules K r) r.lead = SMono.cast (src_rules K r') r.lead :=
    Subtype.ext rfl
  rw [ruleVec, hc, Finsupp.mapDomain_apply hinj, Finsupp.sub_apply]
  have ht : (PoisShGen.rules K).tail r' r.lead = 0 := by
    by_contra h0
    exact tail_ne_lead (Finsupp.mem_support_iff.2 h0) r rfl
  rw [ht, sub_zero]
  show Finsupp.single r'.lead (1 : K) r.lead = _
  classical
  by_cases hrr : r' = r
  · rw [hrr, Finsupp.single_eq_same, if_pos rfl]
  · rw [Finsupp.single_apply, if_neg (fun h => hrr (lead_inj (congrArg Subtype.val h))),
      if_neg hrr]

name: Operad.PoisBin.ker_evL_three
statement:
theorem ker_evL_three : LinearMap.ker (PoisShGen.evL K (Finset.range 3)) =
    Submodule.span K (Set.range (ruleVec (PoisShGen.rules K) (src_rules K)))
proof:
:= by
  have hrv : ∀ r, ruleVec (PoisShGen.rules K) (src_rules K) r ∈
      LinearMap.ker (PoisShGen.evL K (Finset.range 3)) := fun r =>
    PoisShGen.ideal_le_ker _ (ruleVec_mem _ _ r)
  refine le_antisymm (fun w hw => ?_) (Submodule.span_le.2 (by rintro _ ⟨r, rfl⟩; exact hrv r))
  set ℓ : Rule → SMono PoisShGen (Finset.range 3) := fun r => SMono.cast (src_rules K r) r.lead
  set u := w - ∑ r : Rule, w (ℓ r) • ruleVec (PoisShGen.rules K) (src_rules K) r
  have hspan : ∑ r : Rule, w (ℓ r) • ruleVec (PoisShGen.rules K) (src_rules K) r ∈
      Submodule.span K (Set.range (ruleVec (PoisShGen.rules K) (src_rules K))) :=
    Submodule.sum_mem _ fun r _ => Submodule.smul_mem _ _ (Submodule.subset_span ⟨r, rfl⟩)
  have hu : u ∈ LinearMap.ker (PoisShGen.evL K (Finset.range 3)) :=
    Submodule.sub_mem _ hw (Submodule.sum_mem _ fun r _ => Submodule.smul_mem _ _ (hrv r))
  have hN : u ∈ Finsupp.supported K K {t | (PoisShGen.rules K).Normal t} := by
    intro g hg
    by_contra hn
    obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := eq_lead_of_not_normal hn
    have hg' : g = ℓ r := Subtype.ext hr
    refine Finsupp.mem_support_iff.1 hg ?_
    rw [hg']
    simp only [u, Finsupp.sub_apply, Finsupp.finsetSum_apply, Finsupp.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul,
      ℓ, ruleVec_lead, mul_ite, mul_one, mul_zero, Finset.sum_ite_eq', Finset.mem_univ, if_true,
      sub_self]
  have h0 := PoisShGen.eq_zero_of_evL hN hu
  rw [sub_eq_zero.1 h0]
  exact hspan

name: Operad.PoisBin.map_rel
statement:
theorem map_rel :
    (rel K).map (vecEquiv PoisShGen K 3).toLinearMap =
      Submodule.span K (Set.range (ruleVec (PoisShGen.rules K) (src_rules K)))
proof:
:= by
  rw [rel, ← evL_comp, LinearMap.ker_comp, ← ker_evL_three]
  exact Submodule.map_comap_eq_of_surjective (vecEquiv PoisShGen K 3).surjective _

name: Operad.PoisBin.rel_eq_span
statement:
theorem rel_eq_span : rel K = Submodule.span K (Set.range fun r =>
    (vecEquiv PoisShGen K 3).symm (ruleVec (PoisShGen.rules K) (src_rules K) r))
proof:
:= by
  have h := congrArg (Submodule.comap (vecEquiv PoisShGen K 3).toLinearMap) map_rel
  rw [Submodule.comap_map_eq_of_injective (vecEquiv PoisShGen K 3).injective,
    Submodule.comap_equiv_eq_map_symm, Submodule.map_span, ← Set.range_comp] at h
  exact h

name: Operad.PoisBin.isKoszul
statement: theorem isKoszul : ShuffleBar.IsKoszul K (rel K)
proof:
:=
  shuffleBar_isKoszul_of_isKoszul _ (src_rules K) map_rel (PoisShGen.isKoszul K)

name: Operad.PoisBin.isKoszul_and
statement: theorem isKoszul_and : ShuffleBar.IsKoszul K (rel K) ∧ (PoisShGen.rules K).IsKoszul
proof:
:=
  ⟨isKoszul K, PoisShGen.isKoszul K⟩

name: Operad.PoisBin.isKoszul_iff
statement: theorem isKoszul_iff : ShuffleBar.IsKoszul K (rel K) ↔ (PoisShGen.rules K).IsKoszul
proof:
:=
  ShuffleBridge.isKoszul_iff _ (src_rules K) map_rel

name: Operad.PoisBin.map_idealOf_rel
statement:
theorem map_idealOf_rel (n : ℕ) :
    (LTree.idealOf K (rel K) n).map (vecEquiv PoisShGen K n).toLinearMap =
      ((PoisShGen.rules K).rw (Finset.range n)).ideal
proof:
:=
  ShuffleBridge.map_idealOf _ (src_rules K) _ map_rel n

name: Operad.PoisBin.finrank_quotient
statement:
theorem finrank_quotient {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) :
    Module.finrank K ((Mono (PoisShGen 2) n → K) ⧸ LTree.idealOf K (rel K) n) = n.factorial
proof:
:= by
  rw [(quotEquiv _ (src_rules K) _ map_rel n).finrank_eq,
    PoisShGen.finrank_eq_factorial ⟨0, Finset.mem_range.2 hn⟩, Finset.card_range]

name: Operad.PoisBin.three_eq
statement: lemma three_eq : (three : Finset ℕ) = Finset.range 3
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.PoisBin.bL_mem
statement: lemma bL_mem (e f : PoisShGen 2) : bL e f ∈ monomials 3
proof:
:=
  (mem_monomials 3 _).2 ⟨by cases e <;> cases f <;> decide, by cases e <;> cases f <;> decide⟩

name: Operad.PoisBin.bT_mem
statement: lemma bT_mem (e f : PoisShGen 2) : bT e f ∈ monomials 3
proof:
:=
  (mem_monomials 3 _).2 ⟨by cases e <;> cases f <;> decide, by cases e <;> cases f <;> decide⟩

name: Operad.PoisBin.bR_mem
statement: lemma bR_mem (e f : PoisShGen 2) : bR e f ∈ monomials 3
proof:
:=
  (mem_monomials 3 _).2 ⟨by cases e <;> cases f <;> decide, by cases e <;> cases f <;> decide⟩

name: Operad.PoisBin.vecEquiv_bL
statement:
lemma vecEquiv_bL (e f : PoisShGen 2) : vecEquiv PoisShGen K 3 (vecOf K 3 (bL e f)) =
    Finsupp.single (SMono.cast three_eq (lcomb e f)) 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [vecEquiv_vecOf K (bL_mem e f)]
  rfl

name: Operad.PoisBin.vecEquiv_bT
statement:
lemma vecEquiv_bT (e f : PoisShGen 2) : vecEquiv PoisShGen K 3 (vecOf K 3 (bT e f)) =
    Finsupp.single (SMono.cast three_eq (tcomb e f)) 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [vecEquiv_vecOf K (bT_mem e f)]
  rfl

name: Operad.PoisBin.vecEquiv_bR
statement:
lemma vecEquiv_bR (e f : PoisShGen 2) : vecEquiv PoisShGen K 3 (vecOf K 3 (bR e f)) =
    Finsupp.single (SMono.cast three_eq (rcomb e f)) 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [vecEquiv_vecOf K (bR_mem e f)]
  rfl

name: Operad.PoisBin.ruleVec_eq'
statement:
lemma ruleVec_eq' (r : Rule) : ruleVec (PoisShGen.rules K) (src_rules K) r =
    Finsupp.lmapDomain K K (SMono.cast (E := PoisShGen) three_eq)
      (Finsupp.single r.lead 1 - r.tail K)
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.PoisBin.vecEquiv_relB
statement:
lemma vecEquiv_relB (r : Rule) :
    vecEquiv PoisShGen K 3 (relB K r) = ruleVec (PoisShGen.rules K) (src_rules K) r
proof:
:= by
  rw [ruleVec_eq']
  cases r <;>
    simp only [relB, combo, relList, List.map_cons, List.map_nil, List.sum_cons, List.sum_nil,
      Int.cast_one, Int.cast_neg, one_smul, neg_one_smul, map_add, map_neg, map_sub, add_zero,
      vecEquiv_bL, vecEquiv_bT, vecEquiv_bR, Rule.lead, Rule.tail, Finsupp.lmapDomain_apply,
      Finsupp.mapDomain_single] <;>
    abel

name: Operad.PoisBin.rel_eq_span_relB
statement: theorem rel_eq_span_relB : rel K = Submodule.span K (Set.range (relB K))
proof:
:= by
  rw [rel_eq_span]
  congr 1
  ext v
  simp only [Set.mem_range]
  refine exists_congr fun r => ?_
  rw [← vecEquiv_relB, LinearEquiv.symm_apply_apply]

name: Operad.PoisBin.combo_apply
statement:
lemma combo_apply (l : List (ℤ × LTree (PoisShGen 2))) (τ : Mono (PoisShGen 2) 3) :
    combo K l τ = (((l.map fun y => if τ.1 = y.2 then y.1 else 0).sum : ℤ) : K)
proof:
:= by
  induction l with
  | nil => simp [combo]
  | cons y l ih =>
    simp only [combo, List.map_cons, List.sum_cons, Pi.add_apply, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul,
      vecOf, Int.cast_add] at ih ⊢
    rw [ih]
    split_ifs <;> simp

name: Operad.PoisBin.pair_combo
statement:
lemma pair_combo (l l' : List (ℤ × LTree (PoisShGen 2))) (hl : ∀ x ∈ l, x.2 ∈ monomials 3) :
    ∑ σ, (chi3 σ.1 : K) * combo K l σ * combo K l' σ = (pairZ l l' : K)
proof:
:= by
  induction l with
  | nil => simp [combo, pairZ]
  | cons x l ih =>
    have hx := hl x (List.mem_cons_self ..)
    have h1 : ∀ σ : Mono (PoisShGen 2) 3, (chi3 σ.1 : K) * combo K (x :: l) σ * combo K l' σ =
        (x.1 : K) * (vecOf K 3 x.2 σ * ((chi3 σ.1 : K) * combo K l' σ)) +
          (chi3 σ.1 : K) * combo K l σ * combo K l' σ := fun σ => by
      simp only [combo, List.map_cons, List.sum_cons, Pi.add_apply, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
      ring
    rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl fun σ _ => h1 σ, Finset.sum_add_distrib, ← Finset.mul_sum,
      sum_vecOf_mul' hx, ih fun y hy => hl y (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hy), combo_apply, pairZ,
      pairZ, List.map_cons, List.sum_cons]
    push_cast
    ring

name: Operad.PoisBin.relabelVec_combo
statement:
lemma relabelVec_combo (l : List (ℤ × LTree (PoisShGen 2))) :
    relabelVec K swap 3 (combo K l) = combo K (swapList l)
proof:
:= by
  induction l with
  | nil => simp [combo, swapList]
  | cons y l ih =>
    simp only [combo, swapList, List.map_cons, List.sum_cons, map_add, map_smul,
      relabelVec_vecOf] at ih ⊢
    rw [ih]

name: Operad.PoisBin.pairZ_swap
statement: lemma pairZ_swap : ∀ r r' : Rule, pairZ (relList r) (swapList (relList r')) = 0
proof:
:= by
  decide

name: Operad.PoisBin.relList_mem
statement: lemma relList_mem (r : Rule) : ∀ x ∈ relList r, x.2 ∈ monomials 3
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx
  cases r <;> simp only [relList, List.mem_cons, List.not_mem_nil, or_false] at hx <;>
    rcases hx with rfl | rfl | rfl <;>
    first | exact bL_mem _ _ | exact bT_mem _ _ | exact bR_mem _ _

name: Operad.PoisBin.finrank_rel
statement: lemma finrank_rel : Module.finrank K (rel K) = 6
proof:
:= by
  have h1 := Submodule.finrank_quotient_add_finrank (rel K)
  have h2 := finrank_quotient K (n := 3) (by norm_num)
  rw [ShuffleBar.idealOf_three] at h2
  have h3 : Module.finrank K (Mono (PoisShGen 2) 3 → K) = 12 := by
    rw [Module.finrank_fintype_fun_eq_card, Fintype.card_coe,
      show (3 : ℕ) = 2 + 1 from rfl, card_monomials]
    rfl
  rw [h2, h3] at h1
  simp only [Nat.factorial] at h1
  omega

name: Operad.PoisBin.dualRel_rel
statement:
theorem dualRel_rel :
    dualRel K (rel K) = (rel K).map (relabelVec K swap 3).toLinearMap
proof:
:= by
  symm
  refine Submodule.eq_of_le_of_finrank_eq ?_ ?_
  · rw [Submodule.map_le_iff_le_comap]
    nth_rewrite 1 [rel_eq_span_relB]
    rw [Submodule.span_le]
    rintro _ ⟨r', rfl⟩
    show relabelVec K swap 3 (relB K r') ∈ dualRel K (rel K)
    rw [mem_dualRel, relB, relabelVec_combo]
    intro y hy
    rw [rel_eq_span_relB] at hy
    induction hy using Submodule.span_induction with
    | mem y hy =>
      obtain ⟨r, rfl⟩ := hy
      rw [relB, pair_combo _ _ (relList_mem r), pairZ_swap, Int.cast_zero]
    | zero => simp
    | add a b _ _ ha hb =>
      simp only [Pi.add_apply, mul_add, add_mul, Finset.sum_add_distrib, ha, hb, add_zero]
    | smul c a _ ha =>
      simp only [Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
      rw [← mul_zero c, ← ha, Finset.mul_sum]
      exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun σ _ => by ring
  · rw [finrank_dualRel, LinearEquiv.finrank_map_eq, finrank_rel,
      Module.finrank_fintype_fun_eq_card, Fintype.card_coe,
      show (3 : ℕ) = 2 + 1 from rfl, card_monomials]
    rfl

name: Operad.PoisBin.isKoszul_dualRel
statement: theorem isKoszul_dualRel : ShuffleBar.IsKoszul K (dualRel K (rel K))
proof:
:= by
  rw [dualRel_rel]
  exact ShuffleBar.isKoszul_relabel swap (isKoszul K)

name: Operad.PoisBin.finrank_quotient_dualRel
statement:
theorem finrank_quotient_dualRel {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) :
    Module.finrank K ((Mono (PoisShGen 2) n → K) ⧸ LTree.idealOf K (dualRel K (rel K)) n) =
      n.factorial
proof:
:= by
  rw [← (quotDualEquiv K n).finrank_eq, finrank_quotient K hn]

name: Operad.TConv.projHom_app_eq_iff
statement:
lemma projHom_app_eq_iff {n : ℕ} (f g : TConv R E Q n) :
    (ann Q hC).projHom.app n f = (ann Q hC).projHom.app n g ↔
      ∀ x ∈ C n, eval f x = eval g x
proof:
:= by
  show Submodule.Quotient.mk f = Submodule.Quotient.mk g ↔ _
  rw [Submodule.Quotient.eq]
  constructor
  · intro h x hx
    have h' : eval (f - g) x = 0 := h x hx
    rwa [eval_sub, sub_eq_zero] at h'
  · intro h x hx
    show eval (f - g) x = 0
    rw [eval_sub, h x hx, sub_self]

name: Operad.TConv.eval_gbracket_congr
proof:
:= by
  rw [← projHom_app_eq_iff hC] at h ⊢
  rw [NSOperadHom.app_gbracket, NSOperadHom.app_gbracket, h]

name: Operad.TConv.eval_gbracket_gbracket_eq_zero
statement:
theorem eval_gbracket_gbracket_eq_zero (T : TConv R E Q 2)
    (hT : ∀ x ∈ C 3, eval (sstar (R := R) (j := 1) (k := 1) T T) x = 0) (m : ℕ)
    (ψ : TConv R E Q (m + 1)) :
    ∀ x ∈ C (1 + (1 + m) + 1), eval (gbracket (R := R) (j := 1) (k := 1 + m) T
      (gbracket (R := R) (j := 1) (k := m) T ψ)) x = 0
proof:
:= by
  set π := (ann Q hC).projHom
  have hMC : sstar (R := R) (P := HomOp Q hC) (j := 1) (k := 1) (π.app 2 T) (π.app 2 T) = 0 := by
    rw [← NSOperadHom.app_sstar]
    show Submodule.Quotient.mk _ = 0
    rw [Submodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero]
    exact hT
  have key := dLin_dLin (R := R) (P := HomOp Q hC) (π.app 2 T) hMC m (π.app (m + 1) ψ)
  simp only [dLin_apply] at key
  rw [← NSOperadHom.app_gbracket, ← NSOperadHom.app_gbracket] at key
  intro x hx
  exact (Submodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero _).1 key x hx

name: Operad.alg_δι
statement: private lemma alg_δι (a b : M) : -a - (-a - b) = b
proof: := by abel

name: Operad.alg_wtd
statement:
private lemma alg_wtd (E d : M →ₗ[R] M) (x : M) {ι : Type*} (S : Finset ι) (s : ι → R)
    (z : ι → M) (w : R) (hdx : d x = ∑ k ∈ S, s k • z k)
    (hz : ∀ k ∈ S, E (z k) = (w - 1) • z k) (hx : E x = w • x) :
    E (d x) = d (E x) - d x
proof:
:= by
  have e : ∀ k ∈ S, E (s k • z k) = (w - 1) • (s k • z k) := fun k hk => by
    rw [map_smul, hz k hk, smul_comm]
  rw [hx, map_smul, hdx, map_sum, Finset.sum_congr rfl e, ← Finset.smul_sum, sub_smul, one_smul]

name: Operad.lin_eq_of_single'
proof:
:=
  LinearMap.congr_fun (Finsupp.lhom_ext' fun a => LinearMap.ext_ring (h a) :
    F.comp f = G.comp f) x

name: Operad.GrDer.sub_app
statement:
lemma GrDer.sub_app (D D' : GrDer f e) {A : Type} [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] (x : P A) :
    (D.sub D').app A x = D.app A x - D'.app A x
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.Bar.wtD_d_bas
statement:
private lemma wtD_d_bas (t : Reg (TreeOfArity (BarT I)) A) :
    (FreeGrL.wtD R (BarGen I)).app A (Bar.d I A ((𝒥).proj A (𝔟 t)))
      = Bar.d I A ((FreeGrL.wtD R (BarGen I)).app A ((𝒥).proj A (𝔟 t)))
        - Bar.d I A ((𝒥).proj A (𝔟 t))
proof:
:= by
  refine alg_wtd ((FreeGrL.wtD R (BarGen I)).app A) (Bar.d I A) ((𝒥).proj A (𝔟 t))
    (Finset.Ico 1 (treeOf t).weight)
    (fun k => σ R (Tree.contrSgn (grGenPar R (BarGen I)) (treeOf t) k))
    (fun k => (𝒥).proj A (𝔟 (contrR (barMerge I) t k))) ((treeOf t).weight : R) ?_ ?_
    (FreeGrL.wtD_proj_bas t)
  · exact (Bar.d_proj _).trans ((congrArg _
      (barD_bas (barMerge I) (grGenPar R (BarGen I)) R t)).trans ((map_sum _ _ _).trans
        (Finset.sum_congr rfl fun k _ => map_smul _ _ _)))
  · intro k hk
    rw [Finset.mem_Ico] at hk
    have hw := Tree.weight_contr (barMerge I) hk.1 hk.2
    rw [FreeGrL.wtD_proj_bas, treeOf_contrR, ← hw, Nat.cast_succ, add_sub_cancel_right]

name: Operad.Bar.wtD_d
statement:
theorem wtD_d (c : 𝒞 A) :
    (FreeGrL.wtD R (BarGen I)).app A (Bar.d I A c)
      = Bar.d I A ((FreeGrL.wtD R (BarGen I)).app A c) - Bar.d I A c
proof:
:= by
  have h := Function.surjInv_eq ((𝒥).proj_surjective A) c
  rw [← h]
  exact lin_eq_of_single' ((FreeGrL.wtD R (BarGen I)).app A ∘ₗ Bar.d I A)
    (Bar.d I A ∘ₗ (FreeGrL.wtD R (BarGen I)).app A - Bar.d I A) ((𝒥).proj A)
    (fun t => wtD_d_bas t) _

name: Operad.Bar.DB_DB
statement: private lemma DB_DB (Y : CobarGr R 𝒞 A) : (DB I).app A ((DB I).app A Y) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have h : ∀ Y' : CobarGr R (BarCoop I) A,
      (CobarDG.d R (BarCoop I)).app A ((CobarDG.d R (BarCoop I)).app A Y') = 0 :=
    fun Y' => CobarDG.d_d R (BarCoop I) Y'
  exact h Y

name: Operad.Bar.d_sub_δI
statement:
private lemma d_sub_δI (Y : CobarGr R 𝒞 A) :
    (Cobar.d R 𝒞).app A Y - (δI I).app A Y = (DB I).app A Y
proof:
:=
  sub_sub_cancel _ _

name: Operad.Bar.δB_ιL
statement:
private lemma δB_ιL (c : BarCoop I A) :
    (Cobar.d R (BarCoop I)).app A (Cobar.ιL R (BarCoop I) A c)
      - (CobarDG.d R (BarCoop I)).app A (Cobar.ιL R (BarCoop I) A c)
      = Cobar.ιL R (BarCoop I) A (DGCooperad.d (R := R) c)
proof:
:=
  (congrArg₂ (· - ·) (Cobar.d_ιL R (BarCoop I) c) (CobarDG.d_ιL R (BarCoop I) c)).trans
    (alg_δι _ _)

name: Operad.Bar.δI_ιL
statement:
private lemma δI_ιL (c : 𝒞 A) :
    (δI I).app A (Cobar.ιL R 𝒞 A c) = Cobar.ιL R 𝒞 A (Bar.d I A c)
proof:
:= by
  have h : ∀ c' : BarCoop I A,
      (Cobar.d R (BarCoop I)).app A (Cobar.ιL R (BarCoop I) A c')
        - (CobarDG.d R (BarCoop I)).app A (Cobar.ιL R (BarCoop I) A c')
        = Cobar.ιL R (BarCoop I) A (DGCooperad.d (R := R) c') := fun c' => δB_ιL c'
  exact h c

name: Operad.Bar.barGen_zero
statement: lemma barGen_zero (hI0 : ∀ x ∈ I.sub (Fin 0), x = 0) (v : BarGen I (Fin 0)) : v = 0
proof:
:=
  IdealSp.ext I ((hI0 _ (IdealSp.mem I v)).trans (IdealSp.val_zero (I := I)).symm)

name: Operad.Bar.cΩ_DB
statement:
private lemma cΩ_DB (hI0 : ∀ x ∈ I.sub (Fin 0), x = 0) (Y : CobarGr R 𝒞 A) :
    cΩ I hI0 A ((DB I).app A Y) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have h : ∀ Y' : CobarGr R (BarCoop I) A,
      (counit I hI0).1.app A ((CobarDG.d R (BarCoop I)).app A Y') = 0 :=
    fun Y' => ((counit I hI0).2 A Y').trans (LinearMap.zero_apply _)
  exact h Y

name: Operad.Bar.cΩ_unit
proof:
:= by
  have h : (counit I hI0).1.app A (GrOperad.map (R := R) e
      (GrOperad.one (R := R) (P := CobarGr R (BarCoop I))))
      = GrOperad.map (R := R) e (GrOperad.one (R := R) (P := ZeroDG R P)) :=
    ((counit I hI0).1.app_map e _).trans (congrArg _ (counit I hI0).1.app_one)
  exact h

name: Operad.Bar.cΩ_ιL
statement:
private lemma cΩ_ιL (hI0 : ∀ x ∈ I.sub (Fin 0), x = 0) (v : BarGen I A) :
    cΩ I hI0 A (Cobar.ιL R 𝒞 A ((FreeGrL.ι R (BarGen I)).app A v)) = IdealSp.val I v
proof:
:= by
  have h : ∀ v' : BarGen I A, (counit I hI0).1.app A
      (Cobar.ιL R (BarCoop I) A ((FreeGrL.ι R (BarGen I)).app A v')) = IdealSp.val I v' :=
    fun v' => (counit_ιL hI0 _).trans (piL_ι v')
  exact h v

name: Operad.Bar.smul_one_eq_zero
proof:
:= by
  have h3 := congrArg (GrOperad.map (R := R) e.symm) h
  rwa [map_smul, ← GrOperad.map_trans, Equiv.self_trans_symm, GrOperad.map_refl, map_zero] at h3

name: Operad.Bar.base
statement:
private lemma base (hI0 : ∀ x ∈ I.sub (Fin 0), x = 0) (hcompl : IsCompl (unitsP P A) (I.sub A))
    (hone : ∀ a : R, a • GrOperad.one (R := R) (P := P) = 0 → a = 0) :
    ∀ u ∈ Cobar.unitsΩ R (BarGen I) A, ∀ v : BarGen I A,
      cΩ I hI0 A (u + Cobar.ιL R 𝒞 A ((FreeGrL.ι R (BarGen I)).app A v)) = 0 →
        u + Cobar.ιL R 𝒞 A ((FreeGrL.ι R (BarGen I)).app A v) = 0
proof:
:= by
  intro u hu v hc
  have hsum : cΩ I hI0 A u + IdealSp.val I v = 0 :=
    (congrArg (cΩ I hI0 A u + ·) (cΩ_ιL hI0 v)).symm.trans ((map_add _ _ _).symm.trans hc)
  have hmem : cΩ I hI0 A u ∈ I.sub A :=
    (congrArg (· ∈ I.sub A) (eq_neg_of_add_eq_zero_left hsum)).mpr
      (Submodule.neg_mem _ (IdealSp.mem I v))
  have hunit : ∀ e : Unit ≃ A, cΩ I hI0 A
      (GrOperad.map (R := R) e (GrOperad.one (R := R) (P := CobarGr R 𝒞))) ∈ unitsP P A :=
    fun e => (congrArg (· ∈ unitsP P A) (cΩ_unit hI0 e)).mpr
      (Submodule.subset_span ⟨e, rfl⟩ :
        GrOperad.map (R := R) e (GrOperad.one (R := R) (P := P)) ∈ unitsP P A)
  have h0 : cΩ I hI0 A u = 0 :=
    Submodule.disjoint_def.1 hcompl.disjoint _ (Cobar.map_mem_of_unitsΩ _ hunit hu) hmem
  have hval : IdealSp.val I v = 0 :=
    (zero_add _).symm.trans ((congrArg (· + IdealSp.val I v) h0).symm.trans hsum)
  have hv0 : v = 0 := IdealSp.ext I (hval.trans (IdealSp.val_zero (I := I)).symm)
  have hu0 : u = 0 := Cobar.eq_zero_of_unitsΩ (cΩ I hI0 A)
    (fun e a h => hone a (smul_one_eq_zero e ((congrArg (a • ·) (cΩ_unit hI0 e)).symm.trans h)))
    hu h0
  exact (congrArg₂ (· + ·) hu0 ((congrArg (fun w => Cobar.ιL R 𝒞 A
    ((FreeGrL.ι R (BarGen I)).app A w)) hv0).trans ((congrArg _ (map_zero _)).trans
      (map_zero _)))).trans (add_zero 0)

name: Operad.Bar.hDD
proof:
:=
  (d_sub_δI _).trans ((congrArg _ (d_sub_δI Y)).trans (DB_DB Y))

name: Operad.Bar.exists_DB_eq
proof:
:=
  (Cobar.exists_sub_eq (δI I) (Bar.d I) (fun _ _ _ c => δI_ιL c) (fun _ _ _ c => wtD_d c)
    (cΩ I hI0 A) (barGen_zero hI0) hDD
    (fun y => (congrArg _ (d_sub_δI y)).trans (cΩ_DB hI0 y)) (base hI0 hcompl hone) Y
    ((d_sub_δI Y).trans hY) hc).elim fun Z hZ => ⟨Z, (d_sub_δI Z).symm.trans hZ⟩

name: Operad.Bar.exists_DB_eq_zero_cΩ_eq
statement:
private theorem exists_DB_eq_zero_cΩ_eq [Algebra ℚ R] (hI0 : ∀ x ∈ I.sub (Fin 0), x = 0)
    (hcompl : IsCompl (unitsP P A) (I.sub A))
    (hone : ∀ a : R, a • GrOperad.one (R := R) (P := P) = 0 → a = 0) (p : P A) :
    ∃ Y : CobarGr R 𝒞 A, (DB I).app A Y = 0 ∧ cΩ I hI0 A Y = p
proof:
:= by
  have hp : p ∈ unitsP P A ⊔ I.sub A := by
    rw [hcompl.sup_eq_top]
    exact Submodule.mem_top
  have hle : unitsP P A ≤ (Cobar.unitsΩ R (BarGen I) A).map (cΩ I hI0 A) :=
    Submodule.span_le.2 fun _ ⟨e, he⟩ => he ▸ Submodule.mem_map.2
      ⟨_, Submodule.subset_span ⟨e, rfl⟩, cΩ_unit hI0 e⟩
  exact (Submodule.mem_sup.1 hp).elim fun u hu => hu.2.elim fun a ha =>
    (Submodule.mem_map.1 (hle hu.1)).elim fun û hû =>
      ⟨û + Cobar.ιL R 𝒞 A ((FreeGrL.ι R (BarGen I)).app A (IdealSp.mk I a ha.1)),
        (d_sub_δI _).symm.trans (Cobar.sub_eq_zero_of_low (δI I) (Bar.d I)
          (fun _ _ _ c => δI_ιL c) (fun _ _ _ c => wtD_d c) (cΩ I hI0 A) (barGen_zero hI0)
          (fun y => (congrArg _ (d_sub_δI y)).trans (cΩ_DB hI0 y)) (base hI0 hcompl hone)
          hû.1 (IdealSp.mk I a ha.1)),
        ((map_add _ _ _).trans (congrArg₂ (· + ·) hû.2 (cΩ_ιL hI0 _))).trans ha.2⟩

name: Operad.Bar.exists_d_eq_of_counit_eq_zero
statement:
theorem exists_d_eq_of_counit_eq_zero [Algebra ℚ R] (hI0 : ∀ x ∈ I.sub (Fin 0), x = 0)
    (hcompl : IsCompl (unitsP P A) (I.sub A))
    (hone : ∀ a : R, a • GrOperad.one (R := R) (P := P) = 0 → a = 0)
    {Y : CobarGr R (BarCoop I) A} (hY : (CobarDG.d R (BarCoop I)).app A Y = 0)
    (hc : (counit I hI0).1.app A Y = 0) :
    ∃ Z : CobarGr R (BarCoop I) A, (CobarDG.d R (BarCoop I)).app A Z = Y
proof:
:=
  exists_DB_eq hI0 hcompl hone hY hc

name: Operad.Bar.exists_cycle_counit_eq
statement:
theorem exists_cycle_counit_eq [Algebra ℚ R] (hI0 : ∀ x ∈ I.sub (Fin 0), x = 0)
    (hcompl : IsCompl (unitsP P A) (I.sub A))
    (hone : ∀ a : R, a • GrOperad.one (R := R) (P := P) = 0 → a = 0) (p : P A) :
    ∃ Y : CobarGr R (BarCoop I) A,
      (CobarDG.d R (BarCoop I)).app A Y = 0 ∧ (counit I hI0).1.app A Y = p
proof:
:=
  exists_DB_eq_zero_cΩ_eq hI0 hcompl hone p

name: Operad.Bar.ker_counitCycles
statement:
private lemma ker_counitCycles [Algebra ℚ R] (hI0 : ∀ x ∈ I.sub (Fin 0), x = 0)
    (hcompl : IsCompl (unitsP P A) (I.sub A))
    (hone : ∀ a : R, a • GrOperad.one (R := R) (P := P) = 0 → a = 0) :
    LinearMap.ker (counitCycles I hI0 A)
      = (LinearMap.range ((CobarDG.d R (BarCoop I)).app A)).comap
          (LinearMap.ker ((CobarDG.d R (BarCoop I)).app A)).subtype
proof:
:= by
  ext ⟨y, hy⟩
  rw [LinearMap.mem_ker, Submodule.mem_comap, Submodule.subtype_apply, LinearMap.mem_range]
  constructor
  · exact fun hc => exists_d_eq_of_counit_eq_zero hI0 hcompl hone hy hc
  · rintro ⟨Z, rfl⟩
    exact ((counit I hI0).2 A Z).trans (LinearMap.zero_apply _)

name: Operad.Bar.counitCycles_surjective
statement:
private lemma counitCycles_surjective [Algebra ℚ R] (hI0 : ∀ x ∈ I.sub (Fin 0), x = 0)
    (hcompl : IsCompl (unitsP P A) (I.sub A))
    (hone : ∀ a : R, a • GrOperad.one (R := R) (P := P) = 0 → a = 0) :
    Function.Surjective (counitCycles I hI0 A)
proof:
:= fun p =>
  (exists_cycle_counit_eq hI0 hcompl hone p).elim fun Y hY => ⟨⟨Y, hY.1⟩, hY.2⟩

name: Operad.Bar.homologyEquiv_mk
statement:
lemma homologyEquiv_mk [Algebra ℚ R] (hI0 : ∀ x ∈ I.sub (Fin 0), x = 0)
    (hcompl : IsCompl (unitsP P A) (I.sub A))
    (hone : ∀ a : R, a • GrOperad.one (R := R) (P := P) = 0 → a = 0)
    (y : LinearMap.ker ((CobarDG.d R (BarCoop I)).app A)) :
    homologyEquiv I hI0 hcompl hone (Submodule.Quotient.mk y) = (counit I hI0).1.app A y
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: Operad.Bar.counit_bijective
statement:
theorem counit_bijective [Algebra ℚ R] (hI0 : ∀ x ∈ I.sub (Fin 0), x = 0)
    (hcompl : IsCompl (unitsP P A) (I.sub A))
    (hone : ∀ a : R, a • GrOperad.one (R := R) (P := P) = 0 → a = 0) :
    Function.Bijective (Operad.Homology.map (dV := (CobarDG.d R (BarCoop I)).app A)
      (dW := DGOperad.d (R := R) (P := ZeroDG R P) (A := A))
      ((counit I hI0).1.app A) ((counit I hI0).2 A))
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨(injective_iff_map_eq_zero _).2 fun z hz => ?_, fun w => ?_⟩
  · refine (Operad.Homology.mk_surjective _ z).elim fun y hy => ?_
    subst hy
    have h0 : (counit I hI0).1.app A y.1 = 0 := by
      have h1 := (Operad.Homology.mk_eq_mk_iff
        (d := DGOperad.d (R := R) (P := ZeroDG R P) (A := A)) _ 0).1 (hz.trans (map_zero _).symm)
      exact h1.elim fun v hv => (sub_zero _).symm.trans (hv.symm.trans (LinearMap.zero_apply v))
    refine (exists_d_eq_of_counit_eq_zero hI0 hcompl hone y.2 h0).elim fun Z hZ => ?_
    exact (Submodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero _).2 ⟨Z, hZ⟩
  · refine (Operad.Homology.mk_surjective _ w).elim fun p hp => ?_
    subst hp
    refine (exists_cycle_counit_eq hI0 hcompl hone p.1).elim fun Y hY =>
      ⟨Operad.Homology.mk _ ⟨Y, hY.1⟩, ?_⟩
    exact congrArg (Operad.Homology.mk _) (Subtype.ext hY.2)

name: Operad.PoisDim.μ_apply
statement: lemma μ_apply (g : PoisOp) (y z : W K) : μ K g ![y, z] = βL K g y z
proof:
:= by
  cases g <;> rfl

name: Operad.PoisDim.sval_one
statement: lemma sval_one (w : Unit → W K) : sval Syn.one w = w ()
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.PoisDim.sval_map
statement:
lemma sval_map {A B : Type} [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] [Fintype B] [DecidableEq B] (e : A ≃ B)
    (x : Syn (BinGen PoisOp) A) (w : B → W K) :
    sval (Syn.map e x) w = sval x fun a => w (e a)
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.PoisDim.sval_bin
statement:
lemma sval_bin {A B : Type} [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] [Fintype B] [DecidableEq B]
    (g : PoisOp) (x : Syn (BinGen PoisOp) A) (y : Syn (BinGen PoisOp) B) (w : A ⊕ B → W K) :
    sval (Syn.bin (Syn.gen (BinGen.op g)) x y) w
      = βL K g (sval x fun a => w (Sum.inl a)) (sval y fun b => w (Sum.inr b))
proof:
:= by
  rw [sval, Syn.eval_bin, EndOp.ap_bin, ← μ_apply]
  rfl

name: Operad.PoisDim.sval_mem_Tsp
statement:
lemma sval_mem_Tsp (s : Finset ℕ) (x : Syn (BinGen PoisOp) s) :
    (sval x fun a => X [a.1]) ∈ Tsp K s
proof:
:=
  Submodule.subset_span ⟨x, rfl⟩

name: Operad.PoisDim.X_mem_Tsp
statement: lemma X_mem_Tsp (a : ℕ) : (X [a] : W K) ∈ Tsp K {a}
proof:
:= by
  let e : Unit ≃ ({a} : Finset ℕ) :=
    ⟨fun _ => ⟨a, Finset.mem_singleton_self a⟩, fun _ => (), fun _ => rfl,
      fun x => Subtype.ext (Finset.mem_singleton.1 x.2).symm⟩
  exact Submodule.subset_span ⟨Syn.map e Syn.one, rfl⟩

name: Operad.PoisDim.binop_mem_Tsp
statement:
theorem binop_mem_Tsp (g : PoisOp) {s t : Finset ℕ} (h : Disjoint s t) {y z : W K}
    (hy : y ∈ Tsp K s) (hz : z ∈ Tsp K t) : βL K g y z ∈ Tsp K (s ∪ t)
proof:
:= by
  have hm := Submodule.apply_mem_map₂ (βL K g) hy hz
  rw [Tsp, Tsp, Submodule.map₂_span_span] at hm
  refine (Submodule.span_le.2 ?_) hm
  rintro _ ⟨_, ⟨x, rfl⟩, _, ⟨x', rfl⟩, rfl⟩
  refine Submodule.subset_span ⟨Syn.map (Equiv.Finset.union s t h)
    (Syn.bin (Syn.gen (BinGen.op g)) x x'), ?_⟩
  show sval (Syn.map _ _) _ = _
  rw [sval_map, sval_bin]
  rfl

name: Operad.PoisDim.comb_single
statement: lemma comb_single (a : ℕ) : comb K [a] = X [a]
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.PoisDim.comb_append_single
statement:
lemma comb_append_single {w : List ℕ} (hw : w ≠ []) (c : ℕ) :
    comb K (w ++ [c]) = bracket (wordBracket K) (comb K w) (X [c])
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, rest, rfl⟩ := List.exists_cons_of_ne_nil hw
  simp only [List.cons_append, comb, List.foldl_append, List.foldl_cons, List.foldl_nil]

name: Operad.PoisDim.comb_mem_Tsp
statement: theorem comb_mem_Tsp : ∀ (w : List ℕ), w.Nodup → w ≠ [] → comb K w ∈ Tsp K w.toFinset
proof:
:= by
  intro w
  induction w using List.reverseRecOn with
  | nil => intro _ h; exact absurd rfl h
  | append_singleton w c ih =>
    intro hnd _
    by_cases hw : w = []
    · subst hw
      simpa [comb_single] using X_mem_Tsp (K := K) c
    · have hc : c ∉ w := by
        have := (List.nodup_append.1 hnd).2.2
        exact fun h => this c h c (List.mem_singleton_self c) rfl
      rw [comb_append_single hw, List.toFinset_append, List.toFinset_cons, List.toFinset_nil,
        insert_empty_eq]
      exact binop_mem_Tsp (K := K) .bracket
        (Finset.disjoint_singleton_right.2 (by simpa using hc))
        (ih (List.nodup_append.1 hnd).1 hw) (X_mem_Tsp c)

name: Operad.PoisDim.prodB_mem_Tsp
statement:
theorem prodB_mem_Tsp : ∀ (bs : List (List ℕ)), bs ≠ [] → bs.flatten.Nodup → (∀ B ∈ bs, B ≠ []) →
    prodB K bs ∈ Tsp K bs.flatten.toFinset
  | [], h, _, _ => absurd rfl h
  | [B], _, hnd, hne => by
    simpa [prodB] using comb_mem_Tsp B (by simpa using hnd) (hne B (List.mem_singleton_self B))
  | B :: B' :: bs, _, hnd, hne => by
    rw [prodB, List.map_cons, List.prod_cons, List.flatten_cons, List.toFinset_append]
    have h1
proof:
:= List.nodup_append.1 (List.flatten_cons ▸ hnd)
    refine binop_mem_Tsp (K := K) .mul ?_ (comb_mem_Tsp B h1.1 (hne B (by simp)))
      (prodB_mem_Tsp (B' :: bs) (by simp) h1.2.1 fun C hC => hne C (by simp [hC]))
    rw [List.disjoint_toFinset_iff_disjoint]
    exact fun a ha hb => h1.2.2 a ha a hb rfl

name: Operad.PoisDim.killBad_badSpan
statement: lemma killBad_badSpan {w : List ℕ} {p : W K} (hp : p ∈ badSpan K w) : killBad K p = 0
proof:
:= by
  induction hp using Submodule.span_induction with
  | mem x hx =>
    obtain ⟨u, _, hu, rfl⟩ := hx
    rw [killBad, aeval_X, if_pos hu]
  | zero => exact map_zero _
  | add x y _ _ hx hy => rw [map_add, hx, hy, add_zero]
  | smul a x _ hx => rw [map_smul, hx, smul_zero]

name: Operad.PoisDim.bracket_X_X_word
statement:
lemma bracket_X_X_word (u v : List ℕ) :
    bracket (wordBracket K) (X u) (X v) = X (u ++ v) - X (v ++ u)
proof:
:= by
  rw [bracket_X_X, wordBracket]

name: Operad.PoisDim.comb_sub_mem
statement:
theorem comb_sub_mem : ∀ (w : List ℕ), w.Nodup → w ≠ [] → (∀ a ∈ w, w.headI ≤ a) →
    comb K w - X w ∈ badSpan K w
proof:
:= by
  intro w
  induction w using List.reverseRecOn with
  | nil => intro _ h; exact absurd rfl h
  | append_singleton w c ih =>
    intro hnd _ hmin
    by_cases hw : w = []
    · subst hw
      rw [List.nil_append, comb_single, sub_self]
      exact zero_mem _
    · have hc : c ∉ w := by
        have := (List.nodup_append.1 hnd).2.2
        exact fun h => this c h c (List.mem_singleton_self c) rfl
      have hhead : (w ++ [c]).headI = w.headI := by
        obtain ⟨a, rest, rfl⟩ := List.exists_cons_of_ne_nil hw
        rfl
      have hmin' : ∀ a ∈ w, w.headI ≤ a := fun a ha => hhead ▸ hmin a (by simp [ha])
      have hlt : w.headI < c := by
        have hle := hhead ▸ hmin c (by simp)
        refine lt_of_le_of_ne hle fun h => hc ?_
        rw [← h]
        obtain ⟨a, rest, rfl⟩ := List.exists_cons_of_ne_nil hw
        simp
      have ih' := ih (List.nodup_append.1 hnd).1 hw hmin'
      have key : comb K (w ++ [c]) - X (w ++ [c]) =
          bracket (wordBracket K) (comb K w - X w) (X [c]) - X ([c] ++ w) := by
        rw [comb_append_single hw, show bracket (wordBracket K) (comb K w - X w) (X [c]) =
          bracket (wordBracket K) (comb K w) (X [c]) - bracket (wordBracket K) (X w) (X [c])
          from map_sub _ _ _,
          bracket_X_X_word]
        abel
      rw [key]
      refine sub_mem ?_ (Submodule.subset_span ⟨[c] ++ w, List.perm_append_comm,
        ⟨w.headI, ?_, hlt⟩, rfl⟩)
      · 
        refine Submodule.span_induction (p := fun p _ =>
          bracket (wordBracket K) p (X [c]) ∈ badSpan K (w ++ [c])) ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ih'
        · rintro _ ⟨u, hu, ⟨a, ha, hau⟩, rfl⟩
          have hune : u ≠ [] := fun h => hw (List.perm_nil.1 (h ▸ hu).symm)
          rw [bracket_X_X_word]
          refine sub_mem (Submodule.subset_span ⟨u ++ [c], hu.append_right _, ⟨a, by simp [ha],
            ?_⟩, rfl⟩) (Submodule.subset_span ⟨[c] ++ u, ?_, ⟨w.headI, ?_, hlt⟩, rfl⟩)
          · obtain ⟨b, rest, rfl⟩ := List.exists_cons_of_ne_nil hune
            exact hau
          · exact List.perm_append_comm.trans (hu.append_right _)
          · obtain ⟨b, rest, rfl⟩ := List.exists_cons_of_ne_nil hw
            exact List.mem_append_right _ (hu.symm.subset (List.mem_cons_self))
        · show bracket (wordBracket K) (0 : W K) (X [c]) ∈ _
          rw [show bracket (wordBracket K) (0 : W K) (X [c]) = 0 from map_zero _]
          exact zero_mem _
        · intro x y _ _ hx hy
          rw [bracket_add_left]
          exact add_mem hx hy
        · intro a x _ hx
          rw [bracket_smul_left]
          exact Submodule.smul_mem _ a hx
      · obtain ⟨b, rest, rfl⟩ := List.exists_cons_of_ne_nil hw
        simp

name: Operad.PoisDim.killBad_comb
statement:
theorem killBad_comb (w : List ℕ) (hnd : w.Nodup) (hne : w ≠ []) (hmin : ∀ a ∈ w, w.headI ≤ a) :
    killBad K (comb K w) = X w
proof:
:= by
  have h := killBad_badSpan (K := K) (comb_sub_mem w hnd hne hmin)
  rw [map_sub, sub_eq_zero, killBad, aeval_X, if_neg] at h
  · exact h
  · rintro ⟨a, ha, hlt⟩
    exact absurd (hmin a ha) (not_le.2 hlt)

name: Operad.PoisDim.flatten_cut
statement:
theorem flatten_cut : ∀ l : List ℕ, (cut l).flatten = l
  | [] => by simp [cut]
  | a :: rest => by
    rw [cut, List.flatten_cons, flatten_cut (rest.dropWhile _), List.cons_append,
      List.takeWhile_append_dropWhile]
termination_by l => l.length
decreasing_by
  simp only [List.length_cons]
  exact Nat.lt_succ_of_le (List.length_dropWhile_le _ _)

name: Operad.PoisDim.mem_cut
statement:
theorem mem_cut : ∀ (l : List ℕ), ∀ B ∈ cut l, B ≠ [] ∧ ∀ x ∈ B, B.headI ≤ x
  | [] => by simp [cut]
  | a :: rest => by
    intro B hB
    rw [cut, List.mem_cons] at hB
    rcases hB with rfl | hB
    · refine ⟨List.cons_ne_nil _ _, fun x hx => ?_⟩
      rcases List.mem_cons.1 hx with rfl | hx
      · exact le_rfl
      · have h1 : decide (a < x) = true
proof:
:= List.mem_takeWhile_imp (p := fun b => decide (a < b)) hx
        exact (of_decide_eq_true h1).le
    · exact mem_cut _ B hB

name: Operad.PoisDim.pairwise_cut
statement:
theorem pairwise_cut : ∀ (l : List ℕ), l.Nodup →
    (cut l).Pairwise (fun B C => C.headI < B.headI) ∧ ∀ B ∈ cut l, B.headI ≤ l.headI
  | [] => by simp [cut]
  | a :: rest => by
    intro hnd
    set d
proof:
:= rest.dropWhile fun b => decide (a < b) with hd
    have hdnd : d.Nodup := (List.nodup_cons.1 hnd).2.sublist (List.dropWhile_sublist _)
    obtain ⟨ih₁, ih₂⟩ := pairwise_cut d hdnd
    have hlt : ∀ C ∈ cut d, C.headI < a := by
      intro C hC
      refine lt_of_le_of_lt (ih₂ C hC) ?_
      cases hdc : d with
      | nil => rw [hdc, cut] at hC; simp at hC
      | cons b d' =>
        have hb : ¬ a < b := by
          have := List.head_dropWhile_not (fun b => decide (a < b)) (l := rest)
            (by rw [← hd, hdc]; exact List.cons_ne_nil _ _)
          simp only [← hd, hdc, List.head_cons] at this
          simpa using this
        have hba : b ≠ a := by
          rintro rfl
          have : b ∈ rest := (List.dropWhile_sublist _).subset (by rw [← hd, hdc]; simp)
          exact (List.nodup_cons.1 hnd).1 this
        show b < a
        omega
    rw [cut, List.pairwise_cons]
    refine ⟨⟨fun C hC => hlt C hC, ih₁⟩, fun B hB => ?_⟩
    rcases List.mem_cons.1 hB with rfl | hB
    · exact le_rfl
    · exact (hlt B hB).le

name: Operad.PoisDim.cut_injective
statement:
theorem cut_injective {l l' : List ℕ} (hl : l.Nodup) (hl' : l'.Nodup)
