      rw [show toLin ((liftFam ε β).1 (SIn T)) y = (inclHom C ε).app _ (toLin (β.1 (SIn T)) y)
        from rfl, fst_inclHom, snd_inclHom, map_zero, add_zero]
      refine act_mem_outerSpanP _ _ (outerSpanP_mono (P := (· = Fintype.card (SOut T)))
        (fun _ h => h ▸ hlt) ?_)
      exact corolla_mem_outerSpan _
    | add a b ha hb =>
      rw [map_add, map_add, map_add]
      exact add_mem ha hb

name: Operad.GrComposite.twD_mem_outerLt
statement:
theorem twD_mem_outerLt {β : GrOperad.Inv R (ConvOp R C P)} {p : Bool}
    (hβ : GrOperad.Inv.IsPar p β)
    (hβ1 : ∀ (A : Type) [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A], Fintype.card A = 1 →
      ∀ x : C A, toLin (β.1 A) x = 0)
    {k : ℕ} {x : GrComposite R C P S} (hx : x ∈ outerSpan R C P S k) :
    twD ε β S x ∈ outerLt R C P S k
proof:
:=
  map_mem_outerSpanP (twD ε β S) _ (fun g hg =>
    induction_card (fun S _ _ w => twD ε β S w ∈ outerLt R C P S k)
      (fun S _ _ => by beta_reduce; simp)
      (fun S _ _ x y hx hy => by beta_reduce at hx hy ⊢; rw [map_add]; exact add_mem hx hy)
      (fun S _ _ r x hx => by
        beta_reduce at hx ⊢; rw [map_smul]; exact Submodule.smul_mem _ r hx)
      (fun S S' _ _ _ _ σ x hx => by
        beta_reduce at hx ⊢
        rw [twD, twF_map]
        exact relabel_mem_outerSpanP σ hx)
      (fun S Y _ _ _ _ i z x hx => by
        beta_reduce at hx ⊢
        rw [twD, twF_act]
        exact act_mem_outerSpanP i z hx)
      (fun A _ _ w hA => by
        beta_reduce
        rw [← hA]
        exact twD_corolla_mem ε hβ hβ1 w) g hg) hx

name: Operad.GrComposite.twD_mem_outerLt_of_lt
statement:
lemma twD_mem_outerLt_of_lt {β : GrOperad.Inv R (ConvOp R C P)} {p : Bool}
    (hβ : GrOperad.Inv.IsPar p β)
    (hβ1 : ∀ (A : Type) [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A], Fintype.card A = 1 →
      ∀ x : C A, toLin (β.1 A) x = 0)
    {k : ℕ} {x : GrComposite R C P S} (hx : x ∈ outerLt R C P S k) :
    twD ε β S x ∈ outerLt R C P S k
proof:
:=
  map_mem_outerSpanP (twD ε β S) _ (fun g hg => outerSpanP_mono (P := (· < Fintype.card g.A))
    (fun _ h => h.trans hg) (twD_mem_outerLt ε hβ hβ1 (mk_mem_outerSpanP g rfl))) hx

name: Operad.GrComposite.map₂_corolla
statement:
lemma map₂_corolla {A : Type} [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] (c : C A) :
    (map₂ idSpHom g.toGrSpeciesHom).app A (corolla R P' A c) = corolla R P A c
proof:
:= by
  rw [corolla_apply, corolla_apply, map₂_mk]
  show mk R ⟨A, fun _ => Unit, ordOf A, c, fun _ => g.app Unit (GrOperad.one (R := R)),
    (Equiv.sigmaPUnit A).trans (Equiv.refl A)⟩ = _
  simp only [g.app_one]

name: Operad.GrComposite.isPar_appHom
proof:
:= fun A _ _ => by
  show GrOperad.par (R := R) p ((postHom (C := C) g).app A (β.1 A)) = _
  rw [← GrOperadHom.app_par, hβ A]
  rfl

name: Operad.GrComposite.map₂_twD
statement:
theorem map₂_twD {β : GrOperad.Inv R (ConvOp R C P')} {p : Bool} (hβ : GrOperad.Inv.IsPar p β)
    (w : GrComposite R C P' S) :
    (map₂ idSpHom g.toGrSpeciesHom).app S (twD ε' β S w)
      = twD ε (GrOperad.Inv.appHom (postHom (C := C) g) β) S
          ((map₂ idSpHom g.toGrSpeciesHom).app S w)
proof:
:= by
  refine induction_act (fun S _ _ w => (map₂ idSpHom g.toGrSpeciesHom).app S (twD ε' β S w)
      = twD ε (GrOperad.Inv.appHom (postHom (C := C) g) β) S
          ((map₂ idSpHom g.toGrSpeciesHom).app S w))
    (fun S _ _ => by simp) (fun S _ _ x y hx hy => by simp only [map_add, hx, hy])
    (fun S _ _ r x hx => by simp only [map_smul, hx])
    (fun S S' _ _ _ _ σ x hx => ?_) (fun S Y _ _ _ _ i z x hx => ?_) (fun A _ _ c => ?_) w
  · beta_reduce at hx ⊢
    rw [twD, twF_map, show (map₂ idSpHom g.toGrSpeciesHom).app S' (map σ x)
      = map σ ((map₂ idSpHom g.toGrSpeciesHom).app S x) from
        (map₂ idSpHom g.toGrSpeciesHom).app_map σ x,
      show (map₂ idSpHom g.toGrSpeciesHom).app S' (map σ (twF ε' _ S x))
        = map σ ((map₂ idSpHom g.toGrSpeciesHom).app S (twF ε' _ S x)) from
        (map₂ idSpHom g.toGrSpeciesHom).app_map σ _, twD, twF_map]
    exact congrArg (map σ) hx
  · beta_reduce at hx ⊢
    rw [twD, twF_act, map₂_act, map₂_act, twD, twF_act]
    exact congrArg _ hx
  · beta_reduce
    rw [map₂_corolla, twD_corolla, twD_corolla, toLin_star, toLin_star, map_sum, map_sum,
      map_sum]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun T _ => ?_
    rw [toLin_term, toLin_term, SqExt.map_def, SqExt.map_def, SqExt.snd_mapE, SqExt.snd_mapE,
      show (map₂ idSpHom g.toGrSpeciesHom).app A (map (splitEquiv T) _)
        = map (splitEquiv T) ((map₂ idSpHom g.toGrSpeciesHom).app _ _) from
        (map₂ idSpHom g.toGrSpeciesHom).app_map _ _]
    congr 1
    generalize GrCooperad.decomp (R := R) (C := C) none
      (SymSpecies.map (R := R) (splitEquiv T).symm c) = t
    rw [kap_hom _ (isParC_of_isPar (isPar_liftFam ε' hβ) (SIn T)),
      kap_hom _ (isParC_of_isPar (isPar_liftFam ε (isPar_appHom g hβ)) (SIn T))]
    induction t using TensorProduct.induction_on with
    | zero => simp
    | tmul x y =>
      simp only [TensorProduct.map_tmul, mu_tmul, LinearMap.comp_apply, SqExt.comp_def,
        SqExt.snd_compE]
      rw [show toLin ((liftFam ε' β).1 (SIn T)) y
          = (inclHom C ε').app _ (toLin (β.1 (SIn T)) y) from rfl,
        show toLin ((liftFam ε (GrOperad.Inv.appHom (postHom (C := C) g) β)).1 (SIn T)) y
          = (inclHom C ε).app _ (g.app _ (toLin (β.1 (SIn T)) y)) from rfl,
        fst_inclHom, snd_inclHom, fst_inclHom, snd_inclHom, map_zero, add_zero, map_zero,
        add_zero, map₂_act]
      congr 1
      exact map₂_corolla g _
    | add a b ha hb => simp only [map_add, ha, hb]

name: Operad.GrComposite.filt_sup
statement:
lemma filt_sup (P₀ : (A : Type) → [Fintype A] → [DecidableEq A] → Type w)
    [∀ (A : Type) [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A], AddCommGroup (P₀ A)]
    [∀ (A : Type) [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A], Module R (P₀ A)] [GrOperad R P₀] {S : Type}
    [Fintype S] [DecidableEq S] (p : ℕ) :
    outerLt R C P₀ S (Fintype.card S + 1 - p)
      = filtX P₀ S p ⊔ outerLt R C P₀ S (Fintype.card S + 1 - (p + 1))
proof:
:= by
  unfold filtX
  split_ifs with hp
  · rw [show Fintype.card S + 1 - p = (Fintype.card S - p) + 1 by omega,
      show Fintype.card S + 1 - (p + 1) = Fintype.card S - p by omega, outerLt_succ]
  · rw [show Fintype.card S + 1 - p = 0 by omega, show Fintype.card S + 1 - (p + 1) = 0 by omega,
      bot_sup_eq]

name: Operad.GrComposite.TwCompareGen.lower_of_lt
statement:
lemma TwCompareGen.lower_of_lt {k : ℕ} {x : GrComposite R C P S} (hx : x ∈ outerLt R C P S k) :
    T S x ∈ outerLt R C P S k
proof:
:=
  map_mem_outerSpanP (T S) _ (fun g hg => outerSpanP_mono (P := (· < Fintype.card g.A))
    (fun _ h => h.trans hg) (hd.lower S _ _ (mk_mem_outerSpanP g rfl))) hx

name: Operad.GrComposite.TwCompareGen.lower_of_lt'
statement:
lemma TwCompareGen.lower_of_lt' {k : ℕ} {x : GrComposite R C P' S}
    (hx : x ∈ outerLt R C P' S k) : T' S x ∈ outerLt R C P' S k
proof:
:=
  map_mem_outerSpanP (T' S) _ (fun g hg => outerSpanP_mono (P := (· < Fintype.card g.A))
    (fun _ h => h.trans hg) (hd.lower' S _ _ (mk_mem_outerSpanP g rfl))) hx

name: Operad.GrComposite.TwCompareGen.leaf_comm
statement:
lemma TwCompareGen.leaf_comm (x : GrComposite R C P' S) :
    (map₂ idSpHom g.toGrSpeciesHom).app S (leafD R C D' S x)
      = leafD R C D S ((map₂ idSpHom g.toGrSpeciesHom).app S x)
proof:
:=
  map₂_leafMap idSpHom (fun _ _ _ _ => rfl) g.toGrSpeciesHom D'.toSpEnd D.toSpEnd
    (fun A _ _ y => hd.hg A y) x

name: Operad.GrComposite.TwCompareGen.filtData
statement:
lemma TwCompareGen.filtData :
    QIso.FiltData (filtX P' S) (fun p => outerLt R C P' S (Fintype.card S + 1 - p))
      (filtX P S) (fun p => outerLt R C P S (Fintype.card S + 1 - p)) (Fintype.card S + 1)
      (leafD R C D' S) (T' S) (leafD R C D S) (T S)
      ((map₂ idSpHom g.toGrSpeciesHom).app S) where
  split p
proof:
:= by
    refine ⟨?_, fun x => ?_, fun u hu => ?_, fun u hu => ?_, fun w hw => ?_⟩
    · unfold filtX
      split_ifs with hp
      · rw [show Fintype.card S + 1 - (p + 1) = Fintype.card S - p by omega]
        exact disjoint_outerSpan_outerLt _
      · exact disjoint_bot_left
    · have := hd.dd' S x
      rwa [add_comm] at this
    · unfold filtX at hu ⊢
      split_ifs at hu ⊢ with hp
      · exact leafMap_mem_outerSpanP _ hu
      · rw [Submodule.mem_bot] at hu ⊢
        rw [hu, map_zero]
    · unfold filtX at hu
      split_ifs at hu with hp
      · rw [show Fintype.card S + 1 - (p + 1) = Fintype.card S - p by omega]
        exact hd.lower' S _ _ hu
      · rw [Submodule.mem_bot] at hu
        rw [hu, map_zero]
        exact zero_mem _
    · rw [LinearMap.add_apply]
      exact add_mem (leafMap_mem_outerSpanP _ hw) (hd.lower_of_lt' hw)
  split' p := by
    refine ⟨?_, fun x => ?_, fun u hu => ?_, fun u hu => ?_, fun w hw => ?_⟩
    · unfold filtX
      split_ifs with hp
      · rw [show Fintype.card S + 1 - (p + 1) = Fintype.card S - p by omega]
        exact disjoint_outerSpan_outerLt _
      · exact disjoint_bot_left
    · have := hd.dd S x
      rwa [add_comm] at this
    · unfold filtX at hu ⊢
      split_ifs at hu ⊢ with hp
      · exact leafMap_mem_outerSpanP _ hu
      · rw [Submodule.mem_bot] at hu ⊢
        rw [hu, map_zero]
    · unfold filtX at hu
      split_ifs at hu with hp
      · rw [show Fintype.card S + 1 - (p + 1) = Fintype.card S - p by omega]
        exact hd.lower S _ _ hu
      · rw [Submodule.mem_bot] at hu
        rw [hu, map_zero]
        exact zero_mem _
    · rw [LinearMap.add_apply]
      exact add_mem (leafMap_mem_outerSpanP _ hw) (hd.lower_of_lt hw)
  hom p := by
    refine ⟨fun u hu => ?_, fun w hw => map₂_mem_outerSpanP _ hw, fun x => hd.leaf_comm x,
      fun x => hd.nat S x⟩
    unfold filtX at hu ⊢
    split_ifs at hu ⊢ with hp
    · exact map₂_mem_outerSpanP _ hu
    · rw [Submodule.mem_bot] at hu ⊢
      rw [hu, map_zero]
  sup p := filt_sup P' p
  sup' p := filt_sup P p
  top := by rw [Nat.sub_self, outerLt_zero]
  top' := by rw [Nat.sub_self, outerLt_zero]

name: Operad.GrComposite.TwCompareGen.qiso
statement:
theorem TwCompareGen.qiso
    (hs : ∀ (A : Type) [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A], Fintype.card A ≤ Fintype.card S →
      FreeGrL.SurjAt R D'.toSpEnd D.toSpEnd g.toGrSpeciesHom A)
    (hi : ∀ (A : Type) [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A], Fintype.card A ≤ Fintype.card S →
      FreeGrL.InjAt R D'.toSpEnd D.toSpEnd g.toGrSpeciesHom A) :
    QIso.Surj ⊤ ⊤ (T' S + leafD R C D' S) (T S + leafD R C D S)
        ((map₂ idSpHom g.toGrSpeciesHom).app S)
      ∧ QIso.Inj ⊤ ⊤ (T' S + leafD R C D' S) (T S + leafD R C D S)
        ((map₂ idSpHom g.toGrSpeciesHom).app S)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨s'⟩ := Splitting.exists_of_field D'.toSpEnd (fun A _ _ x => hd.hD' A x)
  obtain ⟨s⟩ := Splitting.exists_of_field D.toSpEnd (fun A _ _ x => hd.hD A x)
  obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := exists_compat g.toGrSpeciesHom (fun A _ _ x => (hd.hg A x).symm) s' s
    (· ≤ Fintype.card S) (fun n hn => hs (Fin n) (by simpa using hn))
    (fun n hn => hi (Fin n) (by simpa using hn))
  have hpiece : ∀ p, QIso.Surj (filtX P' S p) (filtX P S p) (leafD R C D' S) (leafD R C D S)
        ((map₂ idSpHom g.toGrSpeciesHom).app S)
      ∧ QIso.Inj (filtX P' S p) (filtX P S p) (leafD R C D' S) (leafD R C D S)
        ((map₂ idSpHom g.toGrSpeciesHom).app S) := fun p => by
    unfold filtX
    split_ifs with hp
    · have hX := le_antisymm (outerSpanP_le_outerEig (R := R) (M := C) (N := P') (S := S)
        (Fintype.card S - p)) (outerEig_le_outerSpan _)
      have hX' := le_antisymm (outerSpanP_le_outerEig (R := R) (M := C) (N := P) (S := S)
        (Fintype.card S - p)) (outerEig_le_outerSpan _)
      rw [hX, hX']
      refine qiso_leaf s' s g.toGrSpeciesHom (fun A _ _ y => hd.hg A y) k _
        (fun x _ => ?_) (fun y _ => ?_)
      · rw [map₂_map₂ k (s.p.toHom.comp (g.toGrSpeciesHom.comp s'.p.toHom))
          (k.comp (s.p.toHom.comp (g.toGrSpeciesHom.comp s'.p.toHom))) (fun _ _ _ _ => rfl)]
        exact map₂_eq_of_card_le _ _ (fun B _ _ hB y => (hk B hB).1 y) x
      · rw [map₂_map₂ (s.p.toHom.comp (g.toGrSpeciesHom.comp s'.p.toHom)) k
          ((s.p.toHom.comp (g.toGrSpeciesHom.comp s'.p.toHom)).comp k) (fun _ _ _ _ => rfl)]
        exact map₂_eq_of_card_le _ _ (fun B _ _ hB y => (hk B hB).2 y) y
    · exact ⟨QIso.surj_bot _ _ _, QIso.inj_bot _ _ _⟩
  have h := QIso.qiso_filt hd.filtData (fun p => (hpiece p).1) (fun p => (hpiece p).2) 0
  rw [Nat.sub_zero, outerLt_eq_top hd.hP0', outerLt_eq_top hd.hP0] at h
  have e1 : leafD R C D' S + T' S = T' S + leafD R C D' S := add_comm _ _
  have e2 : leafD R C D S + T S = T S + leafD R C D S := add_comm _ _
  rwa [e1, e2] at h

name: Operad.GrComposite.TwCompareData.toGen
statement:
lemma TwCompareData.toGen :
    TwCompareGen D D' g (fun S _ _ => twD ε β S) (fun S _ _ => twD ε' β' S) where
  hD
proof:
:= hd.hD
  hD' := hd.hD'
  hg := hd.hg
  lower _ _ _ _ _ hx := twD_mem_outerLt ε hd.hβ hd.hβ1 hx
  lower' _ _ _ _ _ hx := twD_mem_outerLt ε' hd.hβ' hd.hβ1' hx
  nat := hd.nat
  dd := hd.dd
  dd' := hd.dd'
  hP0 := hd.hP0
  hP0' := hd.hP0'

name: Operad.GrComposite.TwCompareData.leaf_comm
statement:
lemma TwCompareData.leaf_comm (x : GrComposite R C P' S) :
    (map₂ idSpHom g.toGrSpeciesHom).app S (leafD R C D' S x)
      = leafD R C D S ((map₂ idSpHom g.toGrSpeciesHom).app S x)
proof:
:=
  hd.toGen.leaf_comm x

name: Operad.GrComposite.TwCompareData.filtData
statement:
lemma TwCompareData.filtData :
    QIso.FiltData (filtX P' S) (fun p => outerLt R C P' S (Fintype.card S + 1 - p))
      (filtX P S) (fun p => outerLt R C P S (Fintype.card S + 1 - p)) (Fintype.card S + 1)
      (leafD R C D' S) (twD ε' β' S) (leafD R C D S) (twD ε β S)
      ((map₂ idSpHom g.toGrSpeciesHom).app S)
proof:
:=
  hd.toGen.filtData

name: Operad.GrComposite.TwCompareData.qiso
statement:
theorem TwCompareData.qiso
    (hs : ∀ (A : Type) [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A], Fintype.card A ≤ Fintype.card S →
      FreeGrL.SurjAt R D'.toSpEnd D.toSpEnd g.toGrSpeciesHom A)
    (hi : ∀ (A : Type) [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A], Fintype.card A ≤ Fintype.card S →
      FreeGrL.InjAt R D'.toSpEnd D.toSpEnd g.toGrSpeciesHom A) :
    QIso.Surj ⊤ ⊤ (twDiff R C ε' D' β' S) (twDiff R C ε D β S)
        ((map₂ idSpHom g.toGrSpeciesHom).app S)
      ∧ QIso.Inj ⊤ ⊤ (twDiff R C ε' D' β' S) (twDiff R C ε D β S)
        ((map₂ idSpHom g.toGrSpeciesHom).app S)
proof:
:=
  hd.toGen.qiso hs hi

name: Operad.PoisShGen.node_eq_bin
statement:
lemma node_eq_bin (e : PoisShGen 2) (c : Fin 2 → STree PoisShGen) :
    node e c = bin e (c 0) (c 1)
proof:
:= by
  rw [bin]
  congr 1
  funext i
  fin_cases i <;> rfl

name: Operad.PoisShGen.first_bin
statement:
@[simp] lemma first_bin (e : PoisShGen 2) (x y : STree PoisShGen) :
    (bin e x y).first = x.first
proof:
:= by
  rw [bin]
  exact first_node (k := 2) e ![x, y] (by norm_num)

name: Operad.PoisShGen.labels_bin
statement:
@[simp] lemma labels_bin (e : PoisShGen 2) (x y : STree PoisShGen) :
    (bin e x y).labels = x.labels + y.labels
proof:
:= by
  simp [bin, Fin.sum_univ_two]

name: Operad.PoisShGen.subst_bin
statement:
@[simp] lemma subst_bin (e : PoisShGen 2) (x y : STree PoisShGen) (xs : ℕ → STree PoisShGen) :
    (bin e x y).subst xs = bin e (x.subst xs) (y.subst xs)
proof:
:= by
  rw [bin, bin, subst_node]
  congr 1
  funext i
  fin_cases i <;> rfl

name: Operad.PoisShGen.isShuffle_bin
statement:
lemma isShuffle_bin {e : PoisShGen 2} {x y : STree PoisShGen} :
    (bin e x y).IsShuffle ↔ x.IsShuffle ∧ y.IsShuffle ∧ x.first < y.first
proof:
:= by
  rw [bin, isShuffle_node, Fin.forall_fin_two]
  refine ⟨fun ⟨_, ⟨hx, hy⟩, hm⟩ => ⟨hx, hy, hm (show (0 : Fin 2) < 1 by decide)⟩,
    fun ⟨hx, hy, hxy⟩ => ⟨by norm_num, ⟨hx, hy⟩, Fin.strictMono_iff_lt_succ.2 fun i => ?_⟩⟩
  fin_cases i
  exact hxy

name: Operad.PoisShGen.evAt_node
statement:
lemma evAt_node (φ : ℕ → PoisDim.W K) (e : PoisShGen 2) (c : Fin 2 → STree PoisShGen) :
    evAt φ (node e c) = PoisDim.βL K (op e) (evAt φ (c 0)) (evAt φ (c 1))
proof:
:= by
  cases e <;> rfl

name: Operad.PoisShGen.evAt_bin
statement:
lemma evAt_bin (φ : ℕ → PoisDim.W K) (e : PoisShGen 2) (x y : STree PoisShGen) :
    evAt φ (bin e x y) = PoisDim.βL K (op e) (evAt φ x) (evAt φ y)
proof:
:=
  evAt_node φ e ![x, y]

name: Operad.PoisShGen.evAt_leaf
statement: @[simp] lemma evAt_leaf (φ : ℕ → PoisDim.W K) (a : ℕ) : evAt φ (leaf a) = φ a
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.PoisShGen.ev_subst
statement:
theorem ev_subst : ∀ (t : STree PoisShGen) (xs : ℕ → STree PoisShGen),
    ev K (t.subst xs) = evAt (fun a => ev K (xs a)) t
  | leaf a, xs => rfl
  | node mul c, xs => by
    rw [subst_node]
    simp only [ev, evAt] at ev_subst ⊢
    rw [ev_subst (c 0), ev_subst (c 1)]
  | node br c, xs => by
    rw [subst_node]
    simp only [ev, evAt] at ev_subst ⊢
    rw [ev_subst (c 0), ev_subst (c 1)]

name: Operad.PoisShGen.lin_node
statement:
lemma lin_node (e : PoisShGen 2) (c : Fin 2 → STree PoisShGen) (i : Fin 2) (p : List ℕ)
    {L : PoisDim.W K →ₗ[K] PoisDim.W K} (hL : ∀ u, ev K ((c i).replace p u) = L (ev K u)) :
    ∃ L' : PoisDim.W K →ₗ[K] PoisDim.W K,
      ∀ u, ev K ((node e c).replace (i.1 :: p) u) = L' (ev K u)
proof:
:= by
  fin_cases i
  · refine ⟨(PoisDim.βL K (op e)).flip (ev K (c 1)) ∘ₗ L, fun u => ?_⟩
    rw [replace_node_cons, ev, evAt_node]
    simp only [Fin.isValue, Fin.coe_ofNat_eq_mod, Nat.zero_mod, ↓reduceIte, Nat.mod_succ,
      one_ne_zero, LinearMap.coe_comp, Function.comp_apply, LinearMap.flip_apply]
    exact congrArg (fun z => PoisDim.βL K (op e) z (ev K (c 1))) (hL u)
  · refine ⟨PoisDim.βL K (op e) (ev K (c 0)) ∘ₗ L, fun u => ?_⟩
    rw [replace_node_cons, ev, evAt_node]
    simp only [Fin.isValue, Fin.coe_ofNat_eq_mod, Nat.zero_mod, zero_ne_one, ↓reduceIte,
      Nat.mod_succ, LinearMap.coe_comp, Function.comp_apply]
    exact congrArg (PoisDim.βL K (op e) (ev K (c 0))) (hL u)

name: Operad.PoisShGen.exists_lin_replace
statement:
theorem exists_lin_replace : ∀ (T : STree PoisShGen) (p : List ℕ), (T.get? p).isSome →
    ∃ L : PoisDim.W K →ₗ[K] PoisDim.W K, ∀ u, ev K (T.replace p u) = L (ev K u)
  | _, [], _ => ⟨LinearMap.id, fun u => by rw [replace_nil]; rfl⟩
  | leaf _, _ :: _, h => by simp at h
  | node mul c, i :: p, h => by
    rw [get?_node_cons] at h
    split_ifs at h with hi
    · obtain ⟨L, hL⟩
proof:
:= exists_lin_replace (c ⟨i, hi⟩) p h
      exact lin_node mul c ⟨i, hi⟩ p hL
    · simp at h
  | node br c, i :: p, h => by
    rw [get?_node_cons] at h
    split_ifs at h with hi
    · obtain ⟨L, hL⟩ := exists_lin_replace (c ⟨i, hi⟩) p h
      exact lin_node br c ⟨i, hi⟩ p hL
    · simp at h

name: Operad.PoisShGen.evAt_bin_mul
statement:
@[simp] lemma evAt_bin_mul (φ : ℕ → PoisDim.W K) (x y : STree PoisShGen) :
    evAt φ (bin mul x y) = evAt φ x * evAt φ y
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.PoisShGen.evAt_bin_br
statement:
@[simp] lemma evAt_bin_br (φ : ℕ → PoisDim.W K) (x y : STree PoisShGen) :
    evAt φ (bin br x y) = 𝔟 (evAt φ x) (evAt φ y)
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.PoisShGen.brw_neg_right
statement: lemma brw_neg_right (f g : PoisDim.W K) : 𝔟 f (-g) = -𝔟 f g
proof:
:= by
  rw [← neg_one_smul K g, bracket_smul_right, neg_one_smul]

name: Operad.PoisShGen.brw_anti
statement: lemma brw_anti (f g : PoisDim.W K) : 𝔟 f g = -𝔟 g f
proof:
:=
  bracket_antisymm wordBracket_antisymm f g

name: Operad.PoisShGen.brw_jac
statement: lemma brw_jac (f g h : PoisDim.W K) : 𝔟 f (𝔟 g h) + 𝔟 g (𝔟 h f) + 𝔟 h (𝔟 f g) = 0
proof:
:=
  KK.jacobi wordBracket_antisymm wordBracket_jac f g h

name: Operad.PoisShGen.length_pathWord_le
statement:
theorem length_pathWord_le : ∀ (t : STree PoisShGen) (q : List ℕ),
    (pathWord letter t q).length ≤ t.weight
  | leaf _, _ => by simp [pathWord]
  | node _ _, [] => by simp
  | @node _ k e c, i :: q => by
    rw [pathWord_node_cons]
    split_ifs with h
    · have h1
proof:
:= length_pathWord_le (c ⟨i, h⟩) q
      have h2 := Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun j => (c j).weight) (fun j _ => Nat.zero_le _)
        (Finset.mem_univ ⟨i, h⟩)
      beta_reduce at h2
      simp only [List.length_cons, weight_node]
      omega
    · simp

name: Operad.PoisShGen.weight_add_one
statement:
theorem weight_add_one : ∀ t : STree PoisShGen, t.weight + 1 = Multiset.card t.labels
  | leaf _ => rfl
  | node mul c => by
    rw [weight_node, labels_node, Fin.sum_univ_two, Fin.sum_univ_two, Multiset.card_add,
      ← weight_add_one (c 0), ← weight_add_one (c 1)]
    omega
  | node br c => by
    rw [weight_node, labels_node, Fin.sum_univ_two, Fin.sum_univ_two, Multiset.card_add,
      ← weight_add_one (c 0), ← weight_add_one (c 1)]
    omega

name: Operad.PoisShGen.length_word_le
statement:
lemma length_word_le {A : Finset ℕ} (x : SMono PoisShGen A) (a : ℕ) :
    (word letter x.1 a).length ≤ A.card
proof:
:= by
  have h1 := length_pathWord_le x.1 (x.1.pos a)
  have h2 := weight_add_one x.1
  rw [x.labels_eq] at h2
  rw [STree.word]
  have : Multiset.card A.val = A.card := rfl
  omega

name: Operad.PoisShGen.pathLexBy_PW_wf
statement:
theorem pathLexBy_PW_wf (A : Finset ℕ) :
    WellFounded (pathLexBy letter PoisDim.PW (A := A) (E := PoisShGen))
proof:
:= by
  let F : SMono PoisShGen A → (A → PoisDim.BW A.card) :=
    fun x a => ⟨STree.word letter x.1 a, length_word_le x a⟩
  have hwf : WellFounded (Pi.Lex (· < ·) (fun {_} => PoisDim.bwRel A.card) :
      (A → PoisDim.BW A.card) → _ → Prop) :=
    Pi.Lex.wellFounded _ fun _ => Finite.wellFounded_of_trans_of_irrefl _
  refine Subrelation.wf (fun {x y} h => ?_) (InvImage.wf F hwf)
  obtain ⟨i, hi, hlt⟩ := h
  exact ⟨i, fun j hj => Subtype.ext (hi j hj), hlt⟩

name: Operad.PoisShGen.words_l
statement:
lemma words_l (e f : PoisShGen 2) :
    word letter (lcomb e f).1 0 = [letter 2 e 0, letter 2 f 0] ∧
    word letter (lcomb e f).1 1 = [letter 2 e 0, letter 2 f 1] ∧
    word letter (lcomb e f).1 2 = [letter 2 e 1]
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [word, pos_eq (lcomb e f).nodup (q := [0, 0]) rfl]; rfl
  · rw [word, pos_eq (lcomb e f).nodup (q := [0, 1]) rfl]; rfl
  · rw [word, pos_eq (lcomb e f).nodup (q := [1]) rfl]; rfl

name: Operad.PoisShGen.words_t
statement:
lemma words_t (e f : PoisShGen 2) :
    word letter (tcomb e f).1 0 = [letter 2 e 0, letter 2 f 0] ∧
    word letter (tcomb e f).1 1 = [letter 2 e 1] ∧
    word letter (tcomb e f).1 2 = [letter 2 e 0, letter 2 f 1]
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [word, pos_eq (tcomb e f).nodup (q := [0, 0]) rfl]; rfl
  · rw [word, pos_eq (tcomb e f).nodup (q := [1]) rfl]; rfl
  · rw [word, pos_eq (tcomb e f).nodup (q := [0, 1]) rfl]; rfl

name: Operad.PoisShGen.words_r
statement:
lemma words_r (e f : PoisShGen 2) :
    word letter (rcomb e f).1 0 = [letter 2 e 0] ∧
    word letter (rcomb e f).1 1 = [letter 2 e 1, letter 2 f 0] ∧
    word letter (rcomb e f).1 2 = [letter 2 e 1, letter 2 f 1]
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [word, pos_eq (rcomb e f).nodup (q := [0]) rfl]; rfl
  · rw [word, pos_eq (rcomb e f).nodup (q := [1, 0]) rfl]; rfl
  · rw [word, pos_eq (rcomb e f).nodup (q := [1, 1]) rfl]; rfl

name: Operad.PoisShGen.lt_at0
statement:
lemma lt_at0 {x y : SMono PoisShGen three}
    (h : PoisDim.PW (word letter x.1 0) (word letter y.1 0)) : order.lt x y
proof:
:=
  ⟨⟨0, by simp⟩, fun j hj => (Nat.not_lt_zero _ hj).elim, h⟩

name: Operad.PoisShGen.lt_at1
statement:
lemma lt_at1 {x y : SMono PoisShGen three} (h0 : word letter x.1 0 = word letter y.1 0)
    (h : PoisDim.PW (word letter x.1 1) (word letter y.1 1)) : order.lt x y
proof:
:=
  ⟨⟨1, by simp⟩, fun j hj => by
    have : j.1 = 0 := by
      have : j.1 < 1 := hj
      omega
    show word letter x.1 j.1 = word letter y.1 j.1
    rw [this]
    exact h0, h⟩

name: Operad.PoisShGen.mem_support₂
statement:
lemma mem_support₂ {A : Finset ℕ} {a b m : SMono PoisShGen A} {c d : K}
    (h : m ∈ (Finsupp.single a c + Finsupp.single b d).support) : m = a ∨ m = b
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rcases Finset.mem_union.1 (Finsupp.support_add h) with h | h
  · exact Or.inl (Finset.mem_singleton.1 (Finsupp.support_single_subset h))
  · exact Or.inr (Finset.mem_singleton.1 (Finsupp.support_single_subset h))

name: Operad.PoisShGen.mem_support₁
statement:
lemma mem_support₁ {A : Finset ℕ} {a m : SMono PoisShGen A} {c : K}
    (h : m ∈ (Finsupp.single a c).support) : m = a
proof:
:= by
  classical
  exact Finset.mem_singleton.1 (Finsupp.support_single_subset h)

name: Operad.PoisShGen.mem_support_sub
statement:
lemma mem_support_sub {A : Finset ℕ} {a b m : SMono PoisShGen A} {c d : K}
    (h : m ∈ (Finsupp.single a c - Finsupp.single b d).support) : m = a ∨ m = b
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rcases Finset.mem_union.1 (Finsupp.support_sub h) with h | h
  · exact Or.inl (Finset.mem_singleton.1 (Finsupp.support_single_subset h))
  · exact Or.inr (Finset.mem_singleton.1 (Finsupp.support_single_subset h))

name: Operad.PoisShGen.Rule.tail_lt
statement:
theorem Rule.tail_lt : ∀ r : Rule, ∀ m ∈ (r.tail K).support, order.lt m r.lead
  | .jac, m, hm => by
    dsimp only [Rule.lead]
    simp only [Rule.tail] at hm
    rcases mem_support₂ hm with rfl | rfl
    · refine lt_at1 ((words_t _ _).1.trans (words_l _ _).1.symm) ?_
      rw [(words_t _ _).2.1, (words_l _ _).2.1]
      exact Or.inl (by decide)
    · refine lt_at0 ?_
      rw [(words_r _ _).1, (words_l _ _).1]
      exact Or.inl (by decide)
  | .leib₁, m, hm => by
    dsimp only [Rule.lead]
    simp only [Rule.tail] at hm
    rcases mem_support₂ hm with rfl | rfl
    · refine lt_at0 ?_
      rw [(words_l _ _).1, (words_r _ _).1]
      exact Or.inr ⟨by decide, Or.inl (by decide)⟩
    · refine lt_at0 ?_
      rw [(words_t _ _).1, (words_r _ _).1]
      exact Or.inr ⟨by decide, Or.inl (by decide)⟩
  | .leib₂, m, hm => by
    dsimp only [Rule.lead]
    simp only [Rule.tail] at hm
    rcases mem_support_sub hm with rfl | rfl
    · refine lt_at0 ?_
      rw [(words_l _ _).1, (words_t _ _).1]
      exact Or.inr ⟨by decide, Or.inr ⟨by decide, by decide⟩⟩
    · refine lt_at0 ?_
      rw [(words_r _ _).1, (words_t _ _).1]
      exact Or.inl (by decide)
  | .leib₃, m, hm => by
    dsimp only [Rule.lead]
    simp only [Rule.tail] at hm
    rcases mem_support₂ hm with rfl | rfl
    · refine lt_at0 ?_
      rw [(words_t _ _).1, (words_l _ _).1]
      exact Or.inr ⟨by decide, Or.inr ⟨by decide, by decide⟩⟩
    · refine lt_at0 ?_
      rw [(words_r _ _).1, (words_l _ _).1]
      exact Or.inl (by decide)
  | .as₁, m, hm => by
    dsimp only [Rule.lead]
    simp only [Rule.tail] at hm
    rcases mem_support₁ hm with rfl
    refine lt_at0 ?_
    rw [(words_l _ _).1, (words_r _ _).1]
    exact Or.inr ⟨by decide, Or.inl (by decide)⟩
  | .as₂, m, hm => by
    dsimp only [Rule.lead]
    simp only [Rule.tail] at hm
    rcases mem_support₁ hm with rfl
    refine lt_at1 ((words_l _ _).1.trans (words_t _ _).1.symm) ?_
    rw [(words_l _ _).2.1, (words_t _ _).2.1]
    exact Or.inr ⟨by decide, Or.inl (by decide)⟩

variable (K) in
                                                             
noncomputable def rules : Rules K Rule order.toCtxOrder where
  src _
proof:
:= three
  lead := Rule.lead
  tail := Rule.tail K
  tail_lt := Rule.tail_lt

name: Operad.PoisShGen.evLAt_rel
statement:
theorem evLAt_rel (φ : ℕ → PoisDim.W K) (r : Rule) :
    evLAt K φ three (Finsupp.single r.lead 1 - r.tail K) = 0
proof:
:= by
  cases r <;>
    simp only [evLAt, Rule.lead, Rule.tail, map_sub, map_add, Finsupp.linearCombination_single,
      one_smul, lcomb, tcomb, rcomb, evAt_bin_mul, evAt_bin_br, evAt_leaf]
  · have h1 := brw_anti (𝔟 (φ 0) (φ 1)) (φ 2)
    have h2 := brw_anti (𝔟 (φ 0) (φ 2)) (φ 1)
    have h3 : 𝔟 (φ 1) (𝔟 (φ 0) (φ 2)) = -𝔟 (φ 1) (𝔟 (φ 2) (φ 0)) := by
      rw [brw_anti (φ 0) (φ 2), brw_neg_right]
    have h4 := brw_jac (φ 2) (φ 0) (φ 1)
    linear_combination h1 - h2 + h3 - h4
  · rw [bracket_mul_right]
    ring
  · rw [bracket_mul_left, brw_anti (φ 2) (φ 1)]
    ring
  · rw [bracket_mul_left]
    ring
  · ring
  · ring

name: Operad.PoisShGen.ideal_le_ker
statement:
theorem ideal_le_ker (A : Finset ℕ) :
    ((rules K).rw A).ideal ≤ LinearMap.ker (evL K A)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Rules.ideal_eq_span]
  refine Submodule.span_le.2 ?_
  rintro _ ⟨r, f, hf, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨T, p, xs, hp, -, hfe⟩ := hf
  obtain ⟨L, hL⟩ := exists_lin_replace (K := K) T p hp
  have hc : (fun t : SMono PoisShGen A => ev K t.1) ∘ f =
      L ∘ fun g : SMono PoisShGen three => evAt (fun a => ev K (xs a)) g.1 := funext fun g => by
    simp only [Function.comp_apply]
    rw [hfe g, hL, ev_subst]
  rw [SetLike.mem_coe, LinearMap.mem_ker, evL, Finsupp.linearCombination_mapDomain, hc]
  have := evLAt_rel (fun a => ev K (xs a)) r
  rw [evLAt] at this
  exact (LinearMap.map_finsupp_linearCombination L _).symm.trans
    ((congrArg L this).trans (map_zero L))

name: Operad.PoisShGen.toPE_bin
statement:
lemma toPE_bin (e : PoisShGen 2) (x y : STree PoisShGen) :
    toPE (bin e x y) = PoisDim.nd (op e) (toPE x) (toPE y)
proof:
:= by
  cases e <;> rfl

name: Operad.PoisShGen.first_toPE
statement:
@[simp] lemma first_toPE : ∀ t : STree PoisShGen, (toPE t).first = t.first
  | leaf _ => rfl
  | node mul c => by rw [node_eq_bin, toPE_bin, PoisDim.first_nd, first_bin, first_toPE (c 0)]
  | node br c => by rw [node_eq_bin, toPE_bin, PoisDim.first_nd, first_bin, first_toPE (c 0)]

@[simp] lemma labels_toPE : ∀ t : STree PoisShGen, (toPE t).labels = t.labels
  | leaf _ => rfl
  | node mul c => by
    rw [node_eq_bin, toPE_bin, PoisDim.labels_nd, labels_bin, labels_toPE (c 0),
      labels_toPE (c 1)]
  | node br c => by
    rw [node_eq_bin, toPE_bin, PoisDim.labels_nd, labels_bin, labels_toPE (c 0),
      labels_toPE (c 1)]

name: Operad.PoisShGen.labels_toPE
statement:
@[simp] lemma labels_toPE : ∀ t : STree PoisShGen, (toPE t).labels = t.labels
  | leaf _ => rfl
  | node mul c => by
    rw [node_eq_bin, toPE_bin, PoisDim.labels_nd, labels_bin, labels_toPE (c 0),
      labels_toPE (c 1)]
  | node br c => by
    rw [node_eq_bin, toPE_bin, PoisDim.labels_nd, labels_bin, labels_toPE (c 0),
      labels_toPE (c 1)]

name: Operad.PoisShGen.isShuffle_toPE
statement:
lemma isShuffle_toPE : ∀ {t : STree PoisShGen}, t.IsShuffle → (toPE t).IsShuffle
  | leaf _, _ => trivial
  | node mul c, h => by
    rw [node_eq_bin] at h ⊢
    obtain ⟨h0, h1, h01⟩
proof:
:= isShuffle_bin.1 h
    rw [toPE_bin]
    exact PoisDim.isShuffle_nd (isShuffle_toPE h0) (isShuffle_toPE h1) (by simpa using h01)
  | node br c, h => by
    rw [node_eq_bin] at h ⊢
    obtain ⟨h0, h1, h01⟩ := isShuffle_bin.1 h
    rw [toPE_bin]
    exact PoisDim.isShuffle_nd (isShuffle_toPE h0) (isShuffle_toPE h1) (by simpa using h01)

name: Operad.PoisShGen.op_injective
statement: lemma op_injective : Function.Injective op
proof:
:= by
  intro a b h
  cases a <;> cases b <;> first | rfl | exact absurd h (by decide)

name: Operad.PoisShGen.kids_toPE
proof:
:= by
  cases t with
  | leaf _ => exact absurd h (by simp [toPE, PoisDim.kids])
  | node e c =>
    cases e <;> rw [node_eq_bin, toPE_bin, PoisDim.nd_eq, PoisDim.kids_ndσ, Option.some.injEq,
      Prod.mk.injEq, Prod.mk.injEq] at h <;> obtain ⟨rfl, rfl, rfl⟩ := h
    · exact ⟨mul, c 0, c 1, node_eq_bin _ _, rfl, rfl, rfl⟩
    · exact ⟨br, c 0, c 1, node_eq_bin _ _, rfl, rfl, rfl⟩

name: Operad.PoisShGen.toPE_injective
statement:
theorem toPE_injective : ∀ {t t' : STree PoisShGen}, toPE t = toPE t' → t = t'
  | leaf a, leaf b, h => by cases h; rfl
  | leaf a, node e c, h => by
    cases e <;> rw [node_eq_bin, toPE_bin] at h <;> cases h
  | node mul c, t', h => by
    have hk : PoisDim.kids (toPE t') = some (.mul, toPE (c 0), toPE (c 1))
proof:
:= by rw [← h]; rfl
    obtain ⟨e', a, b, rfl, he, ha, hb⟩ := kids_toPE hk
    obtain rfl := op_injective (show op e' = op mul from he.symm)
    rw [node_eq_bin, toPE_injective ha, toPE_injective hb]
  | node br c, t', h => by
    have hk : PoisDim.kids (toPE t') = some (.bracket, toPE (c 0), toPE (c 1)) := by
      rw [← h]; rfl
    obtain ⟨e', a, b, rfl, he, ha, hb⟩ := kids_toPE hk
    obtain rfl := op_injective (show op e' = op br from he.symm)
    rw [node_eq_bin, toPE_injective ha, toPE_injective hb]

name: Operad.PoisShGen.strictMonoOn_ins
statement:
lemma strictMonoOn_ins {x y z : STree PoisShGen} (hxy : x.first < y.first)
    (hyz : y.first < z.first) :
    StrictMonoOn (fun a => (ins x y z a).first) ((three : Finset ℕ) : Set ℕ)
proof:
:= by
  intro a ha b hb hab
  simp only [Finset.coe_insert, Finset.coe_singleton, Set.mem_insert_iff,
    Set.mem_singleton_iff] at ha hb
  rcases ha with rfl | rfl | rfl <;> rcases hb with rfl | rfl | rfl <;>
    first | omega | (simp only [ins]; omega)

statement:
lemma subst_l (e f : PoisShGen 2) (x y z : STree PoisShGen) :

proof:
:= by

statement:
lemma subst_t (e f : PoisShGen 2) (x y z : STree PoisShGen) :

statement:
lemma subst_r (e f : PoisShGen 2) (x y z : STree PoisShGen) :

name: Operad.PoisShGen.not_normal
statement:
lemma not_normal {B : Finset ℕ} {U : SMono PoisShGen B} {p : List ℕ} (r : Rule)
    {xs : ℕ → STree PoisShGen} (hU : U.1.get? p = some (r.lead.1.subst xs))
    (hm : StrictMonoOn (fun a => (xs a).first) ((three : Finset ℕ) : Set ℕ)) :
    ¬ (rules K).Normal U
proof:
:=
  fun h => h r _ (isSCtx_ctxOf U p r.lead xs hU hm) (ctxOf_self U p _ xs hU hm)

name: Operad.PoisShGen.first_ne
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hab, hc, -⟩ := isShuffle_bin.1 hs
  obtain ⟨-, hb, -⟩ := isShuffle_bin.1 hab
  intro he
  rw [labels_bin, labels_bin] at hn
  have hd := (Multiset.nodup_add.1 hn).2.2
  exact Multiset.disjoint_left.1 hd (Multiset.mem_add.2 (Or.inr (first_mem hb)))
    (he ▸ first_mem hc)

name: Operad.PoisShGen.nf_of_normal
statement:
theorem nf_of_normal {A : Finset ℕ} {U : SMono PoisShGen A} (hU : (rules K).Normal U) :
    ∀ (t : STree PoisShGen) (p : List ℕ), U.1.get? p = some t → PoisDim.NF (toPE t)
proof:
:= by
  intro t
  induction t with
  | leaf _ => intro _ _; trivial
  | node e c ih =>
    intro p hp
    cases e
    · have hc : ∀ i : Fin 2, U.1.get? (p ++ [i.1]) = some (c i) := fun i => by
        rw [get?_append_of hp, get?_node_cons_fin, get?_nil]
      have h0 := ih 0 _ (hc 0)
      have h1 := ih 1 _ (hc 1)
      have hs := isShuffle_get? U.isShuffle hp
      have hn := Multiset.nodup_of_le (labels_get?_le hp) U.nodup
      rw [node_eq_bin] at hp hs hn ⊢
      generalize c 0 = X at hp hs hn h0 ⊢
      generalize c 1 = Y at hp hs hn h1 ⊢
      obtain ⟨hX, hY, h01⟩ := isShuffle_bin.1 hs
      rw [toPE_bin, PoisDim.nd_eq, PoisDim.NF_ndσ]
      refine ⟨rfl, h0, h1, ?_⟩
      refine ⟨fun A' B' hk => ?_, fun g' A' B' hk => ?_⟩
      · obtain ⟨e', a, b, rfl, he, -, rfl⟩ := kids_toPE hk
        obtain rfl := op_injective (show op e' = op mul from he.symm)
        have hab := (isShuffle_bin.1 hX).2.2
        rw [first_bin] at h01
        rw [first_toPE, first_toPE]
        rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne (first_ne hs hn) with hlt | hgt
        · exact hlt
        · exact absurd hU (not_normal (K := K) .as₂ (xs := ins a Y b)
            (by rw [hp]; exact congrArg some (subst_t _ _ a b Y).symm)
            (strictMonoOn_ins h01 hgt))
      · obtain ⟨e', a, b, rfl, rfl, -, -⟩ := kids_toPE hk
        have hab := (isShuffle_bin.1 hY).2.2
        rw [first_bin] at h01
        cases e'
        · exact absurd hU (not_normal (K := K) .as₁ (xs := ins X a b)
            (by rw [hp]; exact congrArg some (subst_r _ _ X a b).symm)
            (strictMonoOn_ins h01 hab))
        · rfl
    · have hc : ∀ i : Fin 2, U.1.get? (p ++ [i.1]) = some (c i) := fun i => by
        rw [get?_append_of hp, get?_node_cons_fin, get?_nil]
      have h0 := ih 0 _ (hc 0)
      have h1 := ih 1 _ (hc 1)
      have hs := isShuffle_get? U.isShuffle hp
      have hn := Multiset.nodup_of_le (labels_get?_le hp) U.nodup
      rw [node_eq_bin] at hp hs hn ⊢
      generalize c 0 = X at hp hs hn h0 ⊢
      generalize c 1 = Y at hp hs hn h1 ⊢
      obtain ⟨hX, hY, h01⟩ := isShuffle_bin.1 hs
      rw [toPE_bin, PoisDim.nd_eq, PoisDim.NF_ndσ]
      refine ⟨rfl, h0, h1, ?_⟩
      refine ⟨fun g' A' B' hk => ?_, fun g' A' B' hk => ?_⟩
      · obtain ⟨e', a, b, rfl, rfl, -, rfl⟩ := kids_toPE hk
        have hab := (isShuffle_bin.1 hX).2.2
        rw [first_bin] at h01
        rw [first_toPE, first_toPE]
        rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne (first_ne hs hn) with hlt | hgt
        · exfalso
          cases e'
          · exact not_normal (K := K) .leib₃ (xs := ins a b Y)
              (by rw [hp]; exact congrArg some (subst_l _ _ a b Y).symm)
              (strictMonoOn_ins hab hlt) hU
          · exact not_normal (K := K) .jac (xs := ins a b Y)
              (by rw [hp]; exact congrArg some (subst_l _ _ a b Y).symm)
              (strictMonoOn_ins hab hlt) hU
        · cases e'
          · exact absurd hU (not_normal (K := K) .leib₂ (xs := ins a Y b)
              (by rw [hp]; exact congrArg some (subst_t _ _ a b Y).symm)
              (strictMonoOn_ins h01 hgt))
          · exact ⟨rfl, hgt⟩
      · obtain ⟨e', a, b, rfl, rfl, -, -⟩ := kids_toPE hk
        have hab := (isShuffle_bin.1 hY).2.2
        rw [first_bin] at h01
        cases e'
        · exact absurd hU (not_normal (K := K) .leib₁ (xs := ins X a b)
            (by rw [hp]; exact congrArg some (subst_r _ _ X a b).symm)
            (strictMonoOn_ins h01 hab))
        · rfl

name: Operad.PoisShGen.card_irr_le
statement:
theorem card_irr_le (A : Finset ℕ) :
    Finite ((rules K).rw A).Irr ∧ Nat.card ((rules K).rw A).Irr ≤ A.card.factorial
proof:
:= by
  have hmem : ∀ U : SMono PoisShGen A, PoisDim.read (toPE U.1) ∈ AssShGen.arr A := fun U =>
    AssShGen.mem_arr.2 (by rw [PoisDim.coe_read, labels_toPE, U.labels_eq])
  let f : ((rules K).rw A).Irr → AssShGen.arr A := fun U => ⟨_, hmem U.1⟩
  have hf : Function.Injective f := by
    rintro ⟨U, hU⟩ ⟨U', hU'⟩ h
    have h' : PoisDim.read (toPE U.1) = PoisDim.read (toPE U'.1) := congrArg Subtype.val h
    rw [(rules K).mem_irr_iff] at hU hU'
    have hn : ∀ V : SMono PoisShGen A, (toPE V.1).labels.Nodup := fun V => by
      rw [labels_toPE]
      exact V.nodup
    exact Subtype.ext (Subtype.ext (toPE_injective (PoisDim.read_injective _ _
      (nf_of_normal hU U.1 [] (get?_nil _)) (nf_of_normal hU' U'.1 [] (get?_nil _))
      (isShuffle_toPE U.isShuffle) (isShuffle_toPE U'.isShuffle) (hn U) (hn U') h')))
  refine ⟨Finite.of_injective f hf, (Nat.card_le_card_of_injective f hf).trans ?_⟩
  rw [Nat.card_eq_fintype_card, Fintype.card_coe, AssShGen.card_arr]

name: Operad.PoisShGen.βL_mul
statement: lemma βL_mul (y z : PoisDim.W K) : PoisDim.βL K (op mul) y z = y * z
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.PoisShGen.βL_br
statement: lemma βL_br (y z : PoisDim.W K) : PoisDim.βL K (op br) y z = 𝔟 y z
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.PoisShGen.range_evL
statement: lemma range_evL (A : Finset ℕ) : LinearMap.range (evL K A) = Tsp K A
proof:
:= by
  rw [evL, Finsupp.range_linearCombination]
  rfl

name: Operad.PoisShGen.X_mem_Tsp
statement: lemma X_mem_Tsp (a : ℕ) : (X [a] : PoisDim.W K) ∈ Tsp K {a}
proof:
:=
  Submodule.subset_span ⟨⟨leaf a, trivial, rfl⟩, rfl⟩

name: Operad.PoisShGen.binop_mem_Tsp
statement:
theorem binop_mem_Tsp (e : PoisShGen 2) {s t : Finset ℕ} (h : Disjoint s t) {y z : PoisDim.W K}
    (hy : y ∈ Tsp K s) (hz : z ∈ Tsp K t) : PoisDim.βL K (op e) y z ∈ Tsp K (s ∪ t)
proof:
:= by
  have hm := Submodule.apply_mem_map₂ (PoisDim.βL K (op e)) hy hz
  rw [Tsp, Tsp, Submodule.map₂_span_span] at hm
  refine (Submodule.span_le.2 ?_) hm
  rintro _ ⟨_, ⟨x, rfl⟩, _, ⟨x', rfl⟩, rfl⟩
  have hval : (s ∪ t).val = s.val + t.val := by rw [← Finset.disjUnion_eq_union s t h]; rfl
  have hne : x.1.first ≠ x'.1.first := fun he => Finset.disjoint_left.1 h
    (x.mem_labels.1 (first_mem x.isShuffle)) (x'.mem_labels.1 (he ▸ first_mem x'.isShuffle))
  rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne hne with hlt | hgt
  · exact Submodule.subset_span ⟨⟨bin e x.1 x'.1, isShuffle_bin.2 ⟨x.isShuffle, x'.isShuffle, hlt⟩,
      by rw [labels_bin, x.labels_eq, x'.labels_eq, hval]⟩, evAt_bin _ _ _ _⟩
  · have hm' : ev K (bin e x'.1 x.1) ∈ Tsp K (s ∪ t) := Submodule.subset_span
      ⟨⟨bin e x'.1 x.1, isShuffle_bin.2 ⟨x'.isShuffle, x.isShuffle, hgt⟩,
        by rw [labels_bin, x.labels_eq, x'.labels_eq, hval, add_comm]⟩, rfl⟩
    rw [ev, evAt_bin] at hm'
    show PoisDim.βL K (op e) (ev K x.1) (ev K x'.1) ∈ (Tsp K (s ∪ t) : Set (PoisDim.W K))
    rw [SetLike.mem_coe]
    cases e
    · rw [βL_mul] at hm' ⊢
      rw [mul_comm]
      exact hm'
    · rw [βL_br] at hm' ⊢
      rw [brw_anti]
      exact Submodule.neg_mem _ hm'

name: Operad.PoisShGen.comb_mem_Tsp
statement: theorem comb_mem_Tsp : ∀ (w : List ℕ), w.Nodup → w ≠ [] → PoisDim.comb K w ∈ Tsp K w.toFinset
proof:
:= by
  intro w
  induction w using List.reverseRecOn with
  | nil => intro _ h; exact absurd rfl h
  | append_singleton w c ih =>
    intro hnd _
    by_cases hw : w = []
    · subst hw
      simpa [PoisDim.comb_single] using X_mem_Tsp (K := K) c
    · have hc : c ∉ w := by
        have := (List.nodup_append.1 hnd).2.2
        exact fun h => this c h c (List.mem_singleton_self c) rfl
      rw [PoisDim.comb_append_single hw, List.toFinset_append, List.toFinset_cons,
        List.toFinset_nil, insert_empty_eq, ← βL_br]
      exact binop_mem_Tsp br (Finset.disjoint_singleton_right.2 (by simpa using hc))
        (ih (List.nodup_append.1 hnd).1 hw) (X_mem_Tsp c)

name: Operad.PoisShGen.prodB_mem_Tsp
statement:
theorem prodB_mem_Tsp : ∀ (bs : List (List ℕ)), bs ≠ [] → bs.flatten.Nodup →
    (∀ b ∈ bs, b ≠ []) → PoisDim.prodB K bs ∈ Tsp K bs.flatten.toFinset
  | [], h, _, _ => absurd rfl h
  | [b], _, hnd, hne => by
    simpa [PoisDim.prodB] using comb_mem_Tsp b (by simpa using hnd)
      (hne b (List.mem_singleton_self b))
  | b :: b' :: bs, _, hnd, hne => by
    rw [PoisDim.prodB, List.map_cons, List.prod_cons, List.flatten_cons, List.toFinset_append,
      ← PoisDim.prodB, ← βL_mul]
    have h1
proof:
:= List.nodup_append.1 (List.flatten_cons ▸ hnd)
    refine binop_mem_Tsp mul ?_ (comb_mem_Tsp b h1.1 (hne b (by simp)))
      (prodB_mem_Tsp (b' :: bs) (by simp) h1.2.1 fun d hd => hne d (by simp [hd]))
    rw [List.disjoint_toFinset_iff_disjoint]
    exact fun a ha hb => h1.2.2 a ha a hb rfl

name: Operad.PoisShGen.nodup_of_arr
statement: lemma nodup_of_arr {A : Finset ℕ} (w : AssShGen.arr A) : w.1.Nodup
proof:
:= by
  have := AssShGen.mem_arr.1 w.2
  rw [← Multiset.coe_nodup, this]
  exact A.nodup

name: Operad.PoisShGen.linearIndependent_leadA
statement: theorem linearIndependent_leadA (A : Finset ℕ) : LinearIndependent K (leadA K A)
proof:
:= by
  refine LinearIndependent.of_comp (PoisDim.killBad K).toLinearMap ?_
  have hf : (PoisDim.killBad K).toLinearMap ∘ leadA K A = fun w =>
      (basisMonomials (List ℕ) K)
        (Multiset.toFinsupp (PoisDim.cut w.1 : Multiset (List ℕ))) := by
    funext w
    rw [Function.comp_apply, AlgHom.toLinearMap_apply, leadA, PoisDim.killBad_prodB _
      (PoisDim.block_props (nodup_of_arr w)), PoisDim.prod_X_eq_monomial, coe_basisMonomials]
  rw [hf]
  exact (basisMonomials (List ℕ) K).linearIndependent.comp _ fun w w' h =>
    Subtype.ext (PoisDim.cut_injective (nodup_of_arr w) (nodup_of_arr w')
      (Multiset.toFinsupp.injective h))

name: Operad.PoisShGen.leadA_mem_Tsp
statement:
theorem leadA_mem_Tsp {A : Finset ℕ} (hA : A.Nonempty) (w : AssShGen.arr A) :
    leadA K A w ∈ Tsp K A
proof:
:= by
  have hl := nodup_of_arr w
  have hw' := AssShGen.mem_arr.1 w.2
  have hw : w.1.toFinset = A := by
    ext a
    rw [List.mem_toFinset, ← Multiset.mem_coe, hw']
    rfl
  have h := prodB_mem_Tsp (K := K) (PoisDim.cut w.1) (fun h => by
      have h' := PoisDim.flatten_cut w.1
      rw [h, List.flatten_nil] at h'
      rw [← h', Multiset.coe_nil] at hw'
      exact hA.ne_empty (Finset.val_eq_zero.1 hw'.symm))
    (by rw [PoisDim.flatten_cut]; exact hl) fun b hb => (PoisDim.mem_cut w.1 b hb).1
  rwa [PoisDim.flatten_cut, hw] at h

name: Operad.PoisShGen.factorial_le_finrank
statement:
theorem factorial_le_finrank {A : Finset ℕ} (hA : A.Nonempty) [FiniteDimensional K (Tsp K A)] :
    A.card.factorial ≤ Module.finrank K (Tsp K A)
proof:
:= by
  have li : LinearIndependent K fun w => (⟨leadA K A w, leadA_mem_Tsp hA w⟩ : Tsp K A) :=
    LinearIndependent.of_comp (Tsp K A).subtype (linearIndependent_leadA A)
  have := li.fintype_card_le_finrank
  rwa [Fintype.card_coe, AssShGen.card_arr] at this

name: Operad.PoisShGen.isEmpty_smono_empty
statement: lemma isEmpty_smono_empty : IsEmpty (SMono PoisShGen ∅)
proof:
:= ⟨fun t => by
  have := first_mem t.isShuffle
  rw [t.labels_eq] at this
  simp at this⟩

name: Operad.PoisShGen.eq_zero_of_evL
proof:
:= by
  rcases A.eq_empty_or_nonempty with rfl | hA
  · ext t
    exact (isEmpty_smono_empty.false t).elim
  obtain ⟨hfin, hcard⟩ := card_irr_le (K := K) A
  set S := (rules K).rw A
  have : Fintype S.Irr := Fintype.ofFinite _
  set N := Finsupp.supported K K S.Irr
  have hN : N = Finsupp.supported K K {t | (rules K).Normal t} := by
    simp only [N, S]
    rw [(rules K).irr_eq]
  let φ := evL K A ∘ₗ N.subtype
  haveI : FiniteDimensional K N :=
    Module.Finite.equiv (Finsupp.supportedEquivFinsupp S.Irr).symm
  have hNr : Module.finrank K N = Nat.card S.Irr := by
    rw [(Finsupp.supportedEquivFinsupp S.Irr).finrank_eq, Module.finrank_finsupp_self,
      Nat.card_eq_fintype_card]
  have hrange : LinearMap.range φ = Tsp K A := by
    rw [← range_evL]
    refine le_antisymm (LinearMap.range_comp_le_range _ _) ?_
    rintro _ ⟨x, rfl⟩
    have hx : x ∈ N ⊔ S.ideal := by
      rw [S.sup_eq_top]
      trivial
    obtain ⟨n, hn, i, hi, rfl⟩ := Submodule.mem_sup.1 hx
    refine ⟨⟨n, hn⟩, ?_⟩
    simp only [φ, LinearMap.coe_comp, Function.comp_apply, Submodule.coe_subtype, map_add,
      LinearMap.mem_ker.1 (ideal_le_ker A hi), add_zero]
  haveI : FiniteDimensional K (Tsp K A) := by
    rw [← hrange]
    infer_instance
  have hle := factorial_le_finrank (K := K) hA
  rw [← hrange] at hle
  have hker := LinearMap.finrank_range_add_finrank_ker φ
  have hk : LinearMap.ker φ = ⊥ := Submodule.finrank_eq_zero.1 (by omega)
  have hvN : v ∈ N := by rw [hN]; exact hv
  have hmem : (⟨v, hvN⟩ : N) ∈ LinearMap.ker φ := h0
  rw [hk, Submodule.mem_bot] at hmem
  exact congrArg Subtype.val hmem

name: Operad.PoisShGen.disjoint_normal
statement:
theorem disjoint_normal (A : Finset ℕ) :
    Disjoint (Finsupp.supported K K {t : SMono PoisShGen A | (rules K).Normal t})
      ((rules K).rw A).ideal
proof:
:= by
  rw [Submodule.disjoint_def]
  exact fun v hv hI => eq_zero_of_evL hv (ideal_le_ker A hI)

name: Operad.PoisShGen.res_amb
statement: theorem res_amb {C : Finset ℕ} {r₁ r₂ : Rule} (B : (rules K).Amb C r₁ r₂) : B.Res
proof:
:=
  B.res_of_isCompl (disjoint_normal C)

name: Operad.PoisShGen.weight_lead
statement: lemma weight_lead (r : Rule) : ((rules K).lead r).1.weight = 2
proof:
:= by
  cases r <;> rfl

name: Operad.PoisShGen.weight_tail
statement: lemma weight_tail (r : Rule) : ∀ m ∈ ((rules K).tail r).support, m.1.weight = 2
proof:
:= by
  intro m hm
  cases r
  · rcases mem_support₂ hm with rfl | rfl <;> rfl
  · rcases mem_support₂ hm with rfl | rfl <;> rfl
  · rcases mem_support_sub hm with rfl | rfl <;> rfl
  · rcases mem_support₂ hm with rfl | rfl <;> rfl
  · rcases mem_support₁ hm with rfl; rfl
  · rcases mem_support₁ hm with rfl; rfl

name: Operad.PoisShGen.isKoszul
statement: theorem isKoszul : (rules K).IsKoszul
proof:
:=
  (rules K).isKoszul_of_critical weight_lead weight_tail fun B _ => res_amb B

name: Operad.PoisShGen.ideal_eq_ker
statement: theorem ideal_eq_ker (A : Finset ℕ) : ((rules K).rw A).ideal = LinearMap.ker (evL K A)
proof:
:= by
  refine le_antisymm (ideal_le_ker A) fun v hv => ?_
  have hc := STree.isCompl_of_critical (rules K) ((rules K).hlead_of_quad weight_lead)
    (fun B _ => res_amb B) A
  have hv' : v ∈ Finsupp.supported K K {t : SMono PoisShGen A | (rules K).Normal t} ⊔
      ((rules K).rw A).ideal := by
    rw [hc.sup_eq_top]
    exact Submodule.mem_top
  obtain ⟨n, hn, i, hi, rfl⟩ := Submodule.mem_sup.1 hv'
  rw [LinearMap.mem_ker, map_add, LinearMap.mem_ker.1 (ideal_le_ker A hi), add_zero] at hv
  rw [eq_zero_of_evL hn hv, zero_add]
  exact hi

name: Operad.PoisShGen.finrank_eq_factorial
statement:
theorem finrank_eq_factorial {A : Finset ℕ} (hA : A.Nonempty) :
    Module.finrank K ((SMono PoisShGen A →₀ K) ⧸ ((rules K).rw A).ideal) = A.card.factorial
proof:
:= by
  have e := (Submodule.quotEquivOfEq _ _ (ideal_eq_ker A)).trans
    (LinearMap.quotKerEquivRange (evL K A))
  rw [range_evL] at e
  obtain ⟨hfin, hcard⟩ := card_irr_le (K := K) A
  have hb := basis K A
  haveI : Module.Finite K ((SMono PoisShGen A →₀ K) ⧸ ((rules K).rw A).ideal) :=
    Module.Finite.of_basis hb
  haveI : FiniteDimensional K (Tsp K A) := Module.Finite.equiv e
  refine le_antisymm ?_ ?_
  · rw [Module.finrank_eq_nat_card_basis hb]
    exact hcard
  · rw [e.finrank_eq]
    exact factorial_le_finrank hA

name: Operad.ShuffleOperadIdeal.proj_surjective
statement: lemma proj_surjective (A : Type) [Fintype A] [LinearOrder A] : Function.Surjective (I.proj A)
proof:
:=
  Submodule.mkQ_surjective _

name: Operad.ShuffleOperadIdeal.mapQ_proj
statement:
lemma mapQ_proj (e : A ≃o B) (x : P A) :
    I.mapQ e (I.proj A x) = I.proj B (ShuffleOperad.map (R := R) e x)
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.ShuffleOperadIdeal.compQ_proj
statement:
lemma compQ_proj (i : A) (e : Without A i ⊕ B ≃ C) (he : IsShuffle i e) (x : P A) (y : P B) :
    I.compQ i e he (I.proj A x) (I.proj B y)
      = I.proj C (ShuffleOperad.comp (R := R) i e he x y)
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.ShuffleOperadIdeal.liftHom_proj
statement:
@[simp] lemma liftHom_proj (ψ : ShuffleOperadHom R P Q)
    (h : ∀ (A : Type) [Fintype A] [LinearOrder A], ∀ x ∈ I.sub A, ψ.app A x = 0)
    (A : Type) [Fintype A] [LinearOrder A] (x : P A) :
    (I.liftHom ψ h).app A (I.proj A x) = ψ.app A x
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.ShuffleOperadIdeal.hom_ext_proj
statement:
lemma hom_ext_proj {ψ₁ ψ₂ : ShuffleOperadHom R I.Quot Q}
    (h : ∀ (A : Type) [Fintype A] [LinearOrder A] (x : P A),
      ψ₁.app A (I.proj A x) = ψ₂.app A (I.proj A x))
    (A : Type) [Fintype A] [LinearOrder A] (q : I.Quot A) : ψ₁.app A q = ψ₂.app A q
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := I.proj_surjective A q
  exact h A x

name: Operad.SymOperad.comp_map_left'
statement:
lemma comp_map_left' {A A' B : Type} [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] [Fintype A'] [DecidableEq A']
    [Fintype B] [DecidableEq B] (σ : A ≃ A') (i : A) (x : P A) (y : P B) :
    comp (R := R) (σ i) (map (R := R) σ x) y
      = map (R := R) (compEquiv σ (Equiv.refl B) i) (comp (R := R) i x y)
proof:
:= by
  rw [map_comp, map_refl]

name: Operad.SymOperad.map_congr'
statement:
lemma map_congr' {A B : Type} [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] [Fintype B] [DecidableEq B]
    {e e' : A ≃ B} (h : ∀ a, e a = e' a) (x : P A) : map (R := R) e x = map (R := R) e' x
proof:
:= by
  rw [Equiv.ext h]

name: Operad.SymOperad.comp_map_right'
statement:
lemma comp_map_right' {A B B' : Type} [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] [Fintype B] [DecidableEq B]
    [Fintype B'] [DecidableEq B'] (τ : B ≃ B') (i : A) (x : P A) (y : P B) :
    comp (R := R) i x (map (R := R) τ y)
      = map (R := R) (Equiv.sumCongr (Equiv.refl (Without A i)) τ) (comp (R := R) i x y)
proof:
:= by
  have h := map_comp (R := R) (Equiv.refl A) τ i x y
  rw [map_refl] at h
  refine h.symm.trans ?_
  exact map_congr' (fun s => by rcases s with s | s <;> rfl) _

name: Operad.SymOperad.map_map'
statement:
lemma map_map' {A B C : Type} [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] [Fintype B] [DecidableEq B]
    [Fintype C] [DecidableEq C] (e : A ≃ B) (f : B ≃ C) (x : P A) :
    map (R := R) f (map (R := R) e x) = map (R := R) (e.trans f) x
proof:
:=
  (map_trans e f x).symm

name: Operad.SymOperad.eq_map_symm
statement:
lemma eq_map_symm {A B : Type} [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] [Fintype B] [DecidableEq B]
    (e : A ≃ B) {x : P A} {y : P B} (h : map (R := R) e x = y) : x = map (R := R) e.symm y
proof:
:= by
  rw [← h, map_map', Equiv.self_trans_symm, map_refl]

name: Operad.SymOperad.toShuffle_map
statement:
lemma toShuffle_map {A B : Type} [Fintype A] [LinearOrder A] [Fintype B] [LinearOrder B]
    (e : A ≃o B) (x : P A) :
    ShuffleOperad.map (R := R) (P := Shuf P) e x = map (R := R) e.toEquiv x
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: Operad.SymOperad.toShuffle_comp
statement:
lemma toShuffle_comp {A B C : Type} [Fintype A] [LinearOrder A] [Fintype B] [LinearOrder B]
    [Fintype C] [LinearOrder C] (i : A) (e : Without A i ⊕ B ≃ C) (he : IsShuffle i e) (x : P A)
    (y : P B) :
    ShuffleOperad.comp (R := R) (P := Shuf P) i e he x y = map (R := R) e (comp (R := R) i x y)
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: Operad.SymOperadIdeal.toShuffleQuot_bijective
statement:
lemma toShuffleQuot_bijective (A : Type) [Fintype A] [LinearOrder A] :
    Function.Bijective (I.toShuffleQuot.app A)
proof:
:=
  Function.bijective_id

name: Operad.extend_leaf
statement:
@[simp] lemma extend_leaf (f : ∀ k, E k → Q k) :
    extend (R := R) f .leaf = one (R := R) (P := Q)
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.arityF_corollaF
statement: @[simp] lemma arityF_corollaF (k : ℕ) : (corollaF E k).arityF = k
proof:
:= by
  induction k with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ k ih =>
      simp only [corollaF, Tree.arityF_cons, Tree.arity_leaf, ih]
      omega

name: Operad.arity_corolla
statement: @[simp] lemma arity_corolla {k : ℕ} (e : E k) : (corolla e).arity = k
proof:
:= by
  simp only [corolla, Tree.arity_node, arityF_corollaF]

name: Operad.weightF_corollaF
statement: @[simp] lemma weightF_corollaF (k : ℕ) : (corollaF E k).weightF = 0
proof:
:= by
  induction k with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ k ih => simp only [corollaF, Tree.weightF_cons, Tree.weight_leaf, ih]

name: Operad.weight_corolla
statement: @[simp] lemma weight_corolla {k : ℕ} (e : E k) : (corolla e).weight = 1
proof:
:= by
  simp only [corolla, Tree.weight_node, weightF_corollaF]

name: Operad.substF_corollaF
statement:
lemma substF_corollaF (f : ∀ k, E k → Q k) : ∀ (k a : ℕ) (α : Q (a + k)),
    substF (R := R) f a α (corollaF E k)
      = reindex R Q (by rw [arityF_corollaF]) α
  | 0, a, α => by
      simp only [corollaF, substF]
      exact (reindex_self (R := R) (P := Q) _ _).symm
  | (k + 1), a, α => by
      simp only [corollaF, substF, Tree.arity_leaf]
      rw [substF_corollaF f k (a + 1)]
      have h : (comp (R := R) a k
            ((reindex R Q (show a + (k + 1) = a + 1 + k by omega)) α))
              (extend (R := R) f Tree.leaf)
          = (reindex R Q (show a + (k + 1) = a + 1 + k by omega)) α
proof:
:=
        comp_one_right a k _
      refine (congrArg _ (congrArg _ h)).trans ?_
      refine (congrArg _ (reindex_reindex (R := R) (P := Q) _ _ α)).trans ?_
      exact reindex_reindex (R := R) (P := Q) _ _ α

name: Operad.extend_corolla
statement:
theorem extend_corolla (f : ∀ k, E k → Q k) {k : ℕ} (e : E k) :
    extend (R := R) f (corolla e) = reindex R Q (arity_corolla e).symm (f k e)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [corolla, extend]
  rw [substF_corollaF]
  simp only [reindex_reindex]
  rfl

name: Operad.Homology.mk_eq_mk_iff
statement:
lemma mk_eq_mk_iff {d : V →ₗ[R] V} (z z' : LinearMap.ker d) :
    mk d z = mk d z' ↔ ∃ v, d v = z.1 - z'.1
proof:
:= by
  rw [mk, Submodule.mkQ_apply, Submodule.mkQ_apply, Submodule.Quotient.eq]
  simp [boundariesIn, Submodule.mem_comap, LinearMap.mem_range]

name: Operad.Homology.mk_surjective
statement: lemma mk_surjective (d : V →ₗ[R] V) : Function.Surjective (mk d)
proof:
:=
  Submodule.mkQ_surjective _

name: Operad.Homology.mk_boundary
statement:
lemma mk_boundary {d : V →ₗ[R] V} (hd : ∀ v, d (d v) = 0) (v : V) :
    mk d ⟨d v, hd v⟩ = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [mk, Submodule.mkQ_apply, Submodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero]
  exact ⟨v, rfl⟩

name: Operad.Homology.map_mk
statement:
@[simp] lemma map_mk {dV : V →ₗ[R] V} {dW : W →ₗ[R] W} (f : V →ₗ[R] W)
    (hf : ∀ v, f (dV v) = dW (f v)) (z : LinearMap.ker dV) :
    map f hf (mk dV z) = mk dW (cycleMap f hf z)
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.Homology.map_id
statement: lemma map_id (dV : V →ₗ[R] V) : map (dV := dV) LinearMap.id (fun _ => rfl) = LinearMap.id
proof:
:= by
  ext z
  rfl

name: Operad.Homology.map_comp
statement:
lemma map_comp {dV : V →ₗ[R] V} {dW : W →ₗ[R] W} {dU : U →ₗ[R] U} (f : V →ₗ[R] W)
    (hf : ∀ v, f (dV v) = dW (f v)) (g : W →ₗ[R] U) (hg : ∀ w, g (dW w) = dU (g w)) :
    map (g ∘ₗ f) (fun v => by simp [hf, hg]) = map g hg ∘ₗ map f hf
proof:
:= by
  ext z
  rfl

name: Operad.Homology.map_eq_of_homotopy
statement:
theorem map_eq_of_homotopy {dV : V →ₗ[R] V} {dW : W →ₗ[R] W} (f g : V →ₗ[R] W)
    (hf : ∀ v, f (dV v) = dW (f v)) (hg : ∀ v, g (dV v) = dW (g v)) (s : V →ₗ[R] W)
    (hs : ∀ v, f v - g v = dW (s v) + s (dV v)) : map f hf = map g hg
proof:
:= by
  ext z
  show map f hf (mk dV z) = map g hg (mk dV z)
  rw [map_mk, map_mk, mk_eq_mk_iff]
  refine ⟨s z.1, ?_⟩
  have hz : dV z.1 = 0 := z.2
  rw [show (cycleMap f hf z).1 = f z.1 from rfl, show (cycleMap g hg z).1 = g z.1 from rfl, hs,
    hz, map_zero, add_zero]

name: Operad.Contraction.pA_eq_left
statement: lemma pA_eq_left (v : V) : pA δ κ v = δ v + δ (c.h (pA δ κ v))
proof:
:=
  sub_eq_iff_eq_add.mp (hκ₂ (δ v))

name: Operad.Contraction.pA_eq_right
statement: lemma pA_eq_right (v : V) : pA δ κ v = δ v + pA δ κ (c.h (δ v))
proof:
:= by
  have := hκ₁ (δ v)
  rw [map_sub] at this
  exact sub_eq_iff_eq_add.mp this

name: Operad.Contraction.perturb_key
statement:
theorem perturb_key (v : V) :
    dV (pA δ κ v) + pA δ κ (dV v) + pA δ κ (c.ι (c.π (pA δ κ v))) = 0
proof:
:= by
  set A := pA δ κ with hAdef
  have hL : ∀ z, A z - δ (c.h (A z)) = δ z := fun z => by
    have := pA_eq_left (c := c) hκ₂ z
    linear_combination (norm := module) this
  set M : V → V := fun z => dV (A z) + A (dV z) + A (c.ι (c.π (A z))) with hMdef
  
  have h1 : ∀ x, M (x - c.h (δ x)) - δ (c.h (M (x - c.h (δ x)))) = 0 := by
    intro x
    have hAy : A (x - c.h (δ x)) = δ x := by
      rw [map_sub, pA_eq_right (c := c) hκ₁ x]
      abel
    calc M (x - c.h (δ x)) - δ (c.h (M (x - c.h (δ x))))
        = dV (δ x) - δ (c.h (dV (δ x)))
          + (A (dV (x - c.h (δ x))) - δ (c.h (A (dV (x - c.h (δ x))))))
          + (A (c.ι (c.π (δ x))) - δ (c.h (A (c.ι (c.π (δ x)))))) := by
            simp only [hMdef, hAy, map_add]
            abel
      _ = dV (δ x) - δ (c.h (dV (δ x))) + δ (dV (x - c.h (δ x))) + δ (c.ι (c.π (δ x))) := by
            rw [hL, hL]
      _ = dV (δ x) + δ (dV x) + δ (δ x) := by
            rw [c.ι_π]
            simp only [map_add, map_sub]
            abel
      _ = 0 := by
            have := hδ x
            rw [hdV] at this
            linear_combination (norm := module) this
  
  have hw : (v + c.h (κ (δ v))) - c.h (δ (v + c.h (κ (δ v)))) = v := by
    have e := congrArg c.h (hκ₂ (δ v))
    simp only [map_add, map_sub] at e ⊢
    linear_combination (norm := module) e
  have h2 := h1 (v + c.h (κ (δ v)))
  rw [hw] at h2
  have h3 := congrArg κ h2
  rw [hκ₁, map_zero] at h3
  exact h3

name: Operad.Contraction.perturb_dW_dW
statement:
theorem perturb_dW_dW (hdW : ∀ w, dW (dW w) = 0) (w : W) :
    (dW + c.π ∘ₗ pA δ κ ∘ₗ c.ι) ((dW + c.π ∘ₗ pA δ κ ∘ₗ c.ι) w) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have key := congrArg c.π (perturb_key hκ₁ hκ₂ hdV hδ (c.ι w))
  simp only [LinearMap.add_apply, LinearMap.coe_comp, Function.comp_apply, map_add, hdW,
    ← c.π_comm, ← c.ι_comm, map_zero] at key ⊢
  linear_combination (norm := module) key

name: TensorProduct.mem_range_map_ker
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨u, rfl⟩ := ((Module.Flat.rTensor_exact N g.exact_subtype_ker_map).linearMap_ker_eq ▸
    (LinearMap.mem_ker.2 h1) : t ∈ LinearMap.range _)
  have hu : LinearMap.lTensor (LinearMap.ker g) h u = 0 := by
    refine Module.Flat.rTensor_preserves_injective_linearMap (M := N') _
      (LinearMap.ker g).injective_subtype ?_
    rw [map_zero, ← h2, ← LinearMap.comp_apply, ← LinearMap.comp_apply,
      LinearMap.rTensor_comp_lTensor, LinearMap.lTensor_comp_rTensor]
  obtain ⟨v, rfl⟩ := ((Module.Flat.lTensor_exact (LinearMap.ker g)
    h.exact_subtype_ker_map).linearMap_ker_eq ▸ (LinearMap.mem_ker.2 hu) : u ∈ LinearMap.range _)
  refine ⟨v, ?_⟩
  rw [← LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearMap.rTensor_comp_lTensor]

name: TensorProduct.mem_range_of_coderiv
statement:
theorem TensorProduct.mem_range_of_coderiv {K : Type*} [Field K] {M N M' N' : Type*}
    [AddCommGroup M] [Module K M] [AddCommGroup N] [Module K N] [AddCommGroup M'] [Module K M']
    [AddCommGroup N'] [Module K N'] (fA : M →ₗ[K] M') (fB : N →ₗ[K] N') (dA W τ : M' →ₗ[K] M')
    (dB : N' →ₗ[K] N') (τ' : M →ₗ[K] M) (a : K) (hfA : Function.Injective fA)
    (hfB : Function.Injective fB) (hτ' : ∀ y, τ' (τ' y) = y) (hτ : ∀ y, τ (fA y) = fA (τ' y))
    (hW1 : ∀ y, W (dA (fA y)) = (a - 2) • dA (fA y)) (hW2 : ∀ y, W (fA y) = (a - 1) • fA y)
    {t : M ⊗[K] N}
    (h0 : TensorProduct.map dA LinearMap.id (TensorProduct.map fA fB t)
      + TensorProduct.map τ dB (TensorProduct.map fA fB t) = 0) :
    t ∈ LinearMap.range (TensorProduct.map (LinearMap.ker (dA ∘ₗ fA)).subtype
      (LinearMap.ker (dB ∘ₗ fB)).subtype)
proof:
:= by
  have hk : τ ∘ₗ fA = fA ∘ₗ τ' := LinearMap.ext hτ
  rw [← LinearMap.comp_apply (TensorProduct.map dA _),
    ← LinearMap.comp_apply (TensorProduct.map τ _), ← TensorProduct.map_comp,
    ← TensorProduct.map_comp, hk, LinearMap.id_comp] at h0
  have hW1' : W ∘ₗ (dA ∘ₗ fA) = (a - 2) • (dA ∘ₗ fA) := LinearMap.ext hW1
  have hW2' : W ∘ₗ (fA ∘ₗ τ') = (a - 1) • (fA ∘ₗ τ') := LinearMap.ext fun y => hW2 (τ' y)
  have h3 := congrArg (LinearMap.rTensor N' W) h0
  rw [map_add, map_zero, ← LinearMap.comp_apply (LinearMap.rTensor _ _),
    ← LinearMap.comp_apply (LinearMap.rTensor _ _), LinearMap.rTensor_comp_map,
    LinearMap.rTensor_comp_map, hW1', hW2', TensorProduct.map_smul_left,
    TensorProduct.map_smul_left, LinearMap.smul_apply, LinearMap.smul_apply,
    eq_neg_of_add_eq_zero_right h0, smul_neg, ← sub_eq_add_neg, ← sub_smul,
    show (a - 2) - (a - 1) = -1 by ring, neg_one_smul, neg_eq_zero] at h3
  have hV := eq_neg_of_add_eq_zero_right h0
  rw [h3, neg_zero] at hV
  have hinj : Function.Injective (fA ∘ₗ τ') := fun y y' h => by
    have := congrArg τ' (hfA h)
    rwa [hτ', hτ'] at this
  refine TensorProduct.mem_range_map_ker _ _ ?_ ?_
  · refine Module.Flat.lTensor_preserves_injective_linearMap (M := M') _ hfB ?_
    rw [map_zero, ← h3, ← LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearMap.lTensor_comp_rTensor]
  · refine Module.Flat.rTensor_preserves_injective_linearMap (M := N') _ hinj ?_
    rw [map_zero, ← hV, ← LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearMap.rTensor_comp_lTensor]

name: Operad.FreeGrL.mapSp_trunc_of_top
statement:
theorem mapSp_trunc_of_top {A : Type} [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] (hA : 1 ≤ Fintype.card A)
    {x : FreeGrL R V A} (hx : x ∈ vx R V (Fintype.card A - 1) A) :
    (mapSp (GrSpEnd.trunc R V 2).toHom).app A x = x
proof:
:= by
  set τ := GrSpEnd.trunc R V 2
  have hτ : ∀ (A : Type) [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] (x : V A), τ.app A (τ.app A x) = τ.app A x :=
    GrSpEnd.trunc_trunc 2
  have hBN : ∀ y, (derSp (GrSpEnd.compl R V τ)).app A ((derSp (GrSpEnd.id R V)).app A y)
      = (derSp (GrSpEnd.id R V)).app A ((derSp (GrSpEnd.compl R V τ)).app A y) := fun y => by
    have := derSp_comm (a := GrSpEnd.compl R V τ) (b := GrSpEnd.id R V)
      (fun A _ _ v => by simp only [GrSpEnd.id_app, Bool.false_and, σ_false, one_smul]) y
    rwa [Bool.false_and, σ_false, one_smul] at this
  have htopB := iSup_eig_eq_top (a := GrSpEnd.compl R V τ) (fun A _ _ v => mem_iSup_compl τ hτ v) A
  have hy : (derSp (GrSpEnd.id R V)).app A (x - (mapSp τ.toHom).app A x)
      = ((Fintype.card A - 1 : ℕ) : R) • (x - (mapSp τ.toHom).app A x) := by
    rw [map_sub, mapSp_derSp_comm (a := GrSpEnd.id R V) (φ := τ) (fun A _ _ v => rfl), mem_eig.1 hx,
      map_smul, smul_sub]
  obtain ⟨f, hf, hfN, hfs⟩ := exists_finsupp_eig_inf _ _ hBN htopB _ hy
  have hf0 : ∀ j, j ≠ 0 → f j = 0 := fun j hj => by
    have htopQ := iSup_eig_scalar hred
      (fun n => ((n : R) - 2) - (1 - if n ≤ 2 then 1 else 0))
      (fun n hn => by
        by_cases h : n ≤ 2
        · exact ⟨n - 2, by
            beta_reduce
            rw [if_pos h, Nat.cast_sub hn]
            ring⟩
        · exact ⟨n - 3, by
            beta_reduce
            rw [if_neg h, Nat.cast_sub (by omega)]
            push_cast
            ring⟩) A
    refine eq_zero_of_eigen_neg R _ htopQ (m := j) hj ?_
    rw [derSp_lin (GrSpEnd.scalar R V fun n => (n : R) - 2) (GrSpEnd.compl R V τ) _ 1 (-1)
      (fun A _ _ v => by
        simp only [GrSpEnd.scalar_app, GrSpEnd.compl_app, τ, GrSpEnd.trunc_app]
        module) (f j),
      derSp_lin (GrSpEnd.scalar R V fun n => (n : R) - 1) (GrSpEnd.id R V) _ 1 (-1)
        (fun A _ _ v => by simp only [GrSpEnd.scalar_app, GrSpEnd.id_app]; module) (f j),
      derSp_excess, hfN j, Module.End.mem_eigenspace_iff.1 (hf j), Nat.cast_sub hA]
    push_cast
    module
  have hyf : x - (mapSp τ.toHom).app A x = f 0 := by
    rw [← hfs]
    exact Finsupp.sum_eq_single 0 (fun j _ hj => hf0 j hj) (fun _ => rfl)
  have h0 : x - (mapSp τ.toHom).app A x
      ∈ Module.End.eigenspace ((derSp (GrSpEnd.compl R V τ)).app A) ((0 : ℕ) : R) :=
    hyf ▸ hf 0
  have h1 : x - (mapSp τ.toHom).app A x
      ∈ ⨆ (j : ℕ) (_ : j ≠ 0), eig R V (GrSpEnd.compl R V τ) j A :=
    (iSup_le fun j => le_iSup₂_of_le (f := fun (i : ℕ) (_ : i ≠ 0) =>
      eig R V (GrSpEnd.compl R V τ) i A) (j + 1) (by omega) le_rfl) (sub_mapSp_mem τ hτ x)
  have := Submodule.disjoint_def.1 (iSupIndep_eigenspace_nat _ 0) _ h0 h1
  exact (sub_eq_zero.1 this).symm

name: Operad.FreeGrL.mapSp_eq_of_top
statement:
theorem mapSp_eq_of_top {W : (A : Type) → [Fintype A] → [DecidableEq A] → Type*}
    [∀ (A : Type) [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A], AddCommGroup (W A)]
    [∀ (A : Type) [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A], Module R (W A)] [GrSpecies R W]
    {g g' : GrSpeciesHom R V W}
    (hg : ∀ (B : Type) [Fintype B] [DecidableEq B], Fintype.card B ≤ 2 →
      ∀ v : V B, g.app B v = g'.app B v)
    {A : Type} [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] (hA : 1 ≤ Fintype.card A)
    {x : FreeGrL R V A} (hx : x ∈ vx R V (Fintype.card A - 1) A) :
    (mapSp g).app A x = (mapSp g').app A x
proof:
:= by
  rw [← mapSp_trunc_of_top hred hA hx, mapSp_comp, mapSp_comp]
  refine mapSp_congr (fun B _ _ v => ?_) _
  rw [GrSpeciesHom.comp_app, GrSpeciesHom.comp_app, GrSpEnd.toHom_app, GrSpEnd.trunc_app]
  rcases le_or_gt (Fintype.card B) 2 with h | h
  · rw [if_pos h, one_smul, hg B h]
  · rw [if_neg (by omega), zero_smul, map_zero, map_zero]

name: Operad.Bar.wtD_d_app
statement:
lemma wtD_d_app {A : Type} [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] (hA : 1 ≤ Fintype.card A) (y : C A) :
    (FreeGrL.wtD R (BarGen I)).app A (d I A (f.app A y))
      = ((Fintype.card A : R) - 2) • d I A (f.app A y)
proof:
:= by
  have h := FreeGrL.mem_eig.1 (hdeg A hA y)
  rw [wtD_d, Cobar.wtD_eq_derSp, h, map_smul, Nat.cast_sub hA, Nat.cast_one]
  module

name: Operad.Bar.app_tw
statement:
lemma app_tw {A : Type} [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] (y : C A) :
    f.app A (GrSpecies.tw (R := R) true y)
      = ((GrSpecies.par (R := R) (V := FreeGrL R (BarGen I)) (A := A) false
        - GrSpecies.par (R := R) (V := FreeGrL R (BarGen I)) (A := A) true :
          FreeGrL R (BarGen I) A →ₗ[R] FreeGrL R (BarGen I) A) (f.app A y))
proof:
:= by
  rw [GrSpecies.tw_apply, σ_true, neg_one_smul, map_add, map_neg, f.app_par, f.app_par,
    LinearMap.sub_apply, sub_eq_add_neg]

name: Operad.Bar.decomp_mem_cyc
statement:
theorem decomp_mem_cyc {A B : Type} [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] [Fintype B] [DecidableEq B]
    (i : A) {x : C (Without A i ⊕ B)} (hx : d I _ (f.app _ x) = 0) :
    GrCooperad.decomp (R := R) i x ∈ LinearMap.range (TensorProduct.map
      (LinearMap.ker (d I A ∘ₗ f.app A)).subtype (LinearMap.ker (d I B ∘ₗ f.app B)).subtype)
proof:
:= by
  have hA : 1 ≤ Fintype.card A := Fintype.card_pos_iff.2 ⟨i⟩
  have e : GrCooperad.decomp (R := R) (C := 𝒞) i (d I _ (f.app _ x))
      = TensorProduct.map (d I A) LinearMap.id (GrCooperad.decomp (R := R) (C := 𝒞) i (f.app _ x))
        + TensorProduct.map (GrSpecies.par (R := R) (V := 𝒞) false
          - GrSpecies.par (R := R) (V := 𝒞) true) (d I B)
            (GrCooperad.decomp (R := R) (C := 𝒞) i (f.app _ x)) :=
    (instDGCooperad I).decomp_d i (f.app _ x)
  have e2 := LinearMap.congr_fun (f.decomp_app i) x
  simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply] at e2
  refine TensorProduct.mem_range_of_coderiv (f.app A) (f.app B) (d I A)
    ((FreeGrL.wtD R (BarGen I)).app A) (GrSpecies.par (R := R) (V := 𝒞) false
      - GrSpecies.par (R := R) (V := 𝒞) true) (d I B) (GrSpecies.tw (R := R) (V := C) true)
    (Fintype.card A : R) (hf A) (hf B) (fun y => ?_) (fun y => (app_tw I f y).symm)
    (wtD_d_app I f hdeg hA) (fun y => ?_) ?_
  · rw [GrSpecies.tw_tw, Bool.xor_self, GrSpecies.tw_false]
  · rw [Cobar.wtD_eq_derSp, FreeGrL.mem_eig.1 (hdeg A hA _), Nat.cast_sub hA, Nat.cast_one]
  · rw [← e2, ← e, hx, map_zero]

name: Operad.Bar.toLin_star_pi_of_d
statement:
lemma toLin_star_pi_of_d (hI0 : ∀ x ∈ I.sub (Fin 0), x = 0) {A : Type} [Fintype A]
    [DecidableEq A] (z : 𝒞 A) (hz : d I A z = 0) :
    ConvOp.toLin ((GrOperad.Inv.star R _ (pi I) (pi I)).1 A) z = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hmc := congrArg (fun q : GrOperad.Inv R (ConvOp R (BarCoop I) (ZeroDG R P)) =>
    ConvOp.toLin (q.1 A) z) (mc_pi I hI0)
  have hz' : DGCooperad.d (R := R) (C := BarCoop I) z = 0 := hz
  have key : (0 : ZeroDG R P A) - ConvOp.toLin (GrOperad.tw (R := R) true ((pi I).1 A))
      (DGCooperad.d (R := R) (C := BarCoop I) z)
      + ConvOp.toLin ((GrOperad.Inv.star R _ (pi I) (pi I)).1 A) z = 0 := hmc
  rw [hz', map_zero, sub_zero, zero_add] at key
  exact key

name: Operad.Koszul.cutBar_app
statement:
lemma cutBar_app {A : Type} [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] (y : Cut R E A) :
    (cutBar I hE).app A y = (FreeGrL.mapSp (barGen I hE)).app A y
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.Koszul.pi_cutBar
statement:
lemma pi_cutBar :
    GrOperad.Inv.appHom (ConvOp.preHom (P := ZeroDG R (Pres R E r)) (cutBar I hE)) (Bar.pi I)
      = GrOperad.Inv.appHom (ConvOp.postHom (C := Cut R E)
        (GrOperadHom.toZeroDG (𝒥).projHom)) (kapT R E)
proof:
:=
  Subtype.ext (funext fun A => funext fun _ => funext fun _ => by
    rw [GrOperad.Inv.appHom_apply, GrOperad.Inv.appHom_apply]
    ext x
    exact piL_mapSp I hE x)

name: Operad.Koszul.star_mem_of_d
statement:
theorem star_mem_of_d (hI0 : ∀ x ∈ I.sub (Fin 0), x = 0) {A : Type} [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A]
    (y : Cut R E A) (hy : Bar.d I A ((FreeGrL.mapSp (barGen I hE)).app A y) = 0) :
    ConvOp.toLin ((GrOperad.Inv.star R _ (kapT R E) (kapT R E)).1 A) y ∈ (𝒥).sub A
proof:
:= by
  rw [← GrOperadIdeal.proj_eq_zero_iff]
  have h : ConvOp.toLin ((GrOperad.Inv.star R _ (Bar.pi I) (Bar.pi I)).1 A)
      ((cutBar I hE).app A y) = 0 := Bar.toLin_star_pi_of_d I hI0 _ hy
  have e1 := GrOperad.Inv.appHom_star (ConvOp.preHom (P := ZeroDG R (Pres R E r))
    (cutBar I hE)) (Bar.pi I) (Bar.pi I)
  have e2 := GrOperad.Inv.appHom_star (ConvOp.postHom (C := Cut R E)
    (GrOperadHom.toZeroDG (𝒥).projHom)) (kapT R E) (kapT R E)
  have e3 := e1.trans ((congrArg₂ (fun a b : GrOperad.Inv R
    (ConvOp R (Cut R E) (ZeroDG R (Pres R E r))) => GrOperad.Inv.star R _ a b) (pi_cutBar I hE)
    (pi_cutBar I hE)).trans e2.symm)
  have h2 := congrArg (fun q : GrOperad.Inv R (ConvOp R (Cut R E) (ZeroDG R (Pres R E r))) =>
    ConvOp.toLin (q.1 A) y) e3
  have hl : ConvOp.toLin ((GrOperad.Inv.appHom (ConvOp.preHom (P := ZeroDG R (Pres R E r))
      (cutBar I hE)) (GrOperad.Inv.star R _ (Bar.pi I) (Bar.pi I))).1 A) y
      = ConvOp.toLin ((GrOperad.Inv.star R _ (Bar.pi I) (Bar.pi I)).1 A)
        ((cutBar I hE).app A y) := rfl
  have hr : ConvOp.toLin ((GrOperad.Inv.appHom (ConvOp.postHom (C := Cut R E)
      (GrOperadHom.toZeroDG (𝒥).projHom)) (GrOperad.Inv.star R _ (kapT R E) (kapT R E))).1 A) y
      = (𝒥).proj A (ConvOp.toLin ((GrOperad.Inv.star R _ (kapT R E) (kapT R E)).1 A) y) := rfl
  exact hr.symm.trans (h2.symm.trans (hl.trans h))

name: Operad.ShuffleBarSym.cutBarP_injective
statement:
lemma cutBarP_injective (A : Type) [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] :
    Function.Injective ((cutBarP c hc r).app A)
proof:
:= fun x y hxy => by
  have hid : ∀ z : Koszul.Cut K E A, (FreeGrL.mapSp (barRet c hc r hr2)).app A
      ((FreeGrL.mapSp (Koszul.barGen (Ipres K E c hc r) (hE_pres c hc r))).app A z) = z :=
    fun z => (FreeGrL.mapSp_comp _ _ z).trans ((FreeGrL.mapSp_congr
      (ψ := (GrSpEnd.id K (GrSpecies.Shift E K)).toHom)
      (fun B _ _ v => barRet_barGen c hc r hr2 v) z).trans (FreeGrL.mapSp_id z))
  exact ((hid x).symm.trans (congrArg _ hxy)).trans (hid y)

name: Operad.ShuffleBarSym.cutBarP_mem_vx
statement:
lemma cutBarP_mem_vx {A : Type} [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] (hA : 1 ≤ Fintype.card A)
    (y : Koszul.Cut K E A) : (cutBarP c hc r).app A y ∈ 𝒱P (Fintype.card A - 1) A
proof:
:=
  FreeGrL.mapSp_mem_vx (FreeGrL.mem_vx_of_binary (R := K) (V := GrSpecies.Shift E K)
    (fun _ _ _ hB v => gen_eq_zero c hB v) hA y)

name: Operad.ShuffleBarSym.cutCyc_le
statement: theorem cutCyc_le : cutCyc K E c hc r hr2 ≤ Koszul.dualSub K E r
proof:
:=
  Koszul.le_dualSub r fun _ _ _ x hx => Koszul.star_mem_of_d _ (hE_pres c hc r)
    (GrOperadIdeal.atLeastTwo_hI1 (pres_zero c hc r) (Fin 0) (by simp)) x hx

name: Operad.ShuffleBarSym.barGen_red
statement:
lemma barGen_red (B : Type) [Fintype B] [DecidableEq B] (hB : Fintype.card B ≤ 1)
    (v : BarGen (Ipres K E c hc r) B) : v = 0
proof:
:=
  IdealSp.ext _ (GrOperadIdeal.atLeastTwo_hI1 (pres_zero c hc r) B hB _ (IdealSp.mem _ v))

name: Operad.ShuffleBarSym.barGen_barRet
statement:
lemma barGen_barRet {B : Type} [Fintype B] [DecidableEq B] (hB : Fintype.card B ≤ 2)
    (v : BarGen (Ipres K E c hc r) B) :
    (Koszul.barGen (Ipres K E c hc r) (hE_pres c hc r)).app B ((barRet c hc r hr2).app B v)
      = v
proof:
:= by
  rcases Nat.lt_or_ge (Fintype.card B) 2 with h | h
  · rw [barGen_red c hc r B (by omega) v, map_zero, map_zero]
  · refine IdealSp.ext _ ?_
    obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := (𝒥).proj_surjective B (IdealSp.val _ v)
    have hy1 : y ∈ FreeGrL.vx K E 1 B := by
      have := FreeGrL.mem_vx_of_binary (R := K) (V := E) (fun B _ _ hB v => gen_eq_zero c hB v)
        (by omega) y
      rwa [show Fintype.card B - 1 = 1 by omega] at this
    show (𝒥).proj B ((FreeGrL.ι K E).app B (presCoef c hc r hr2 B (IdealSp.val _ v)))
      = IdealSp.val _ v
    rw [← hy, presCoef_proj, ← FreeGrL.eq_ι_genCoef hy1]

name: Operad.ShuffleBarSym.toBar_surj_top
proof:
:= by
  have hzy : (FreeGrL.mapSp (Koszul.barGen (Ipres K E c hc r) (hE_pres c hc r))).app (Fin n)
      ((FreeGrL.mapSp (barRet c hc r hr2)).app (Fin n) z) = z := by
    rw [FreeGrL.mapSp_comp]
    refine (FreeGrL.mapSp_eq_of_top (barGen_red c hc r)
      (g' := (GrSpEnd.id K (BarGen (Ipres K E c hc r))).toHom) (fun B _ _ hB v => ?_)
      (by rw [Fintype.card_fin]; exact hn) (by rw [Fintype.card_fin]; exact hz)).trans
      (FreeGrL.mapSp_id z)
    exact barGen_barRet c hc r hr2 hB v
  have hy : (FreeGrL.mapSp (barRet c hc r hr2)).app (Fin n) z
      ∈ (cutCyc K E c hc r hr2).sub (Fin n) :=
    LinearMap.mem_ker.2 ((congrArg (Bar.d (Ipres K E c hc r) (Fin n)) hzy).trans hdz)
  have hx : (FreeGrL.mapSp (barRet c hc r hr2)).app (Fin n) z
      ∈ (Koszul.dualSub K E r).sub (Fin n) := cutCyc_le c hc r hr2 (Fin n) hy
  exact ⟨⟨_, hx⟩, hzy⟩

name: Operad.ShuffleBarSym.isKoszul_iff_free_lower
statement:
theorem isKoszul_iff_free_lower (hr2 : ∀ n, n < 3 → r n = ∅) :
    Koszul.IsKoszul K E r ↔ ∀ n, 2 ≤ n → ∀ s, s + 1 < n → ∀ x ∈ 𝒱T s (Fin n),
        Bar.d (Ibar K E c hc) (Fin n) x ∈ (Krel K E c hc r).sub (Fin n) →
        ∃ y ∈ 𝒱T (s + 1) (Fin n),
          x - Bar.d (Ibar K E c hc) (Fin n) y ∈ (Krel K E c hc r).sub (Fin n)
proof:
:=
  (isKoszul_iff_free c hc hr2).trans (forall_congr' fun _ => imp_congr_right fun hn =>
    and_iff_right fun _ hz hdz => toBar_surj_top c hc r hr2 (by omega) hz hdz)

name: Operad.ShuffleBarSym.isKoszul_iff_shuffle_of_J
statement:
theorem isKoszul_iff_shuffle_of_J (hr2 : ∀ n, n < 3 → r n = ∅)
    (R : Submodule K (LTree.Mono G 3 → K))
    (hJ : ∀ n, 2 ≤ n → Submodule.map (ΦL c hc n) ((Krel K E c hc r).sub (Fin n))
      = ShuffleBar.J K R ⊓ Finsupp.supported K K (barSet G n)) :
    Koszul.IsKoszul K E r ↔ ShuffleBar.IsKoszul K R
proof:
:=
  isKoszul_iff_shuffle_of c hc hr2 R hJ fun _ hn _ hz hdz =>
    toBar_surj_top c hc r hr2 (by omega) hz hdz

name: Operad.Graded.coeffVec_isBelowF
statement: lemma coeffVec_isBelowF (N : ℕ) (f : α → K[X]) : IsBelowF K W N (coeffVec W N f)
proof:
:=
  fun a ha => by simp [coeffVec, not_le.2 ha]

name: Operad.Graded.coeffVec_add
statement:
lemma coeffVec_add (N : ℕ) (f g : α → K[X]) :
    coeffVec W N (f + g) = coeffVec W N f + coeffVec W N g
proof:
:= by
  funext a
  simp only [coeffVec, Pi.add_apply, coeff_add]
  split_ifs <;> simp

name: Operad.Graded.coeffVec_X_smul_succ
statement:
lemma coeffVec_X_smul_succ (N : ℕ) (f : α → K[X]) :
    coeffVec W (N + 1) ((X : K[X]) • f) = coeffVec W N f
proof:
:= by
  funext a
  simp only [coeffVec, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
  by_cases h : W a ≤ N
  · rw [if_pos (by omega), if_pos h, show N + 1 - W a = (N - W a) + 1 by omega, coeff_X_mul]
  · by_cases h' : W a = N + 1
    · rw [if_pos (by omega), if_neg h, show N + 1 - W a = 0 by omega, mul_coeff_zero, coeff_X_zero,
        zero_mul]
    · rw [if_neg (by omega), if_neg h]

name: Operad.Graded.coeffVec_X_smul_zero
statement: lemma coeffVec_X_smul_zero (f : α → K[X]) : coeffVec W 0 ((X : K[X]) • f) = 0
proof:
:= by
  funext a
  simp only [coeffVec, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, Pi.zero_apply]
  split_ifs
  · rw [show 0 - W a = 0 by omega, mul_coeff_zero, coeff_X_zero, zero_mul]
  · rfl

name: Operad.Graded.coeffVec_C_smul
statement:
lemma coeffVec_C_smul (N : ℕ) (c : K) (f : α → K[X]) :
    coeffVec W N (C c • f) = c • coeffVec W N f
proof:
:= by
  funext a
  simp only [coeffVec, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, coeff_C_mul]
  split_ifs <;> simp

name: Operad.Graded.mem_rees
statement:
lemma mem_rees {V : Submodule K (α → K)} {f : α → K[X]} :
    f ∈ rees K W V ↔ ∀ N, coeffVec W N f ∈ V
proof: := Iff.rfl

name: Operad.Graded.coeffVec_homog
statement:
lemma coeffVec_homog {N M : ℕ} {v : α → K} (hv : IsBelowF K W N v) :
    coeffVec W M (homog W N v) = if M = N then v else 0
proof:
:= by
  funext a
  have hva : ¬ W a ≤ N → v a = 0 := fun h => hv a (by omega)
  by_cases hMN : M = N
  · subst hMN
    simp only [coeffVec, homog, coeff_monomial, if_true]
    by_cases h : W a ≤ M
    · simp [h]
    · simp [h, hva h]
  · simp only [coeffVec, homog, coeff_monomial, if_neg hMN, Pi.zero_apply]
    by_cases h1 : W a ≤ M
    · rw [if_pos h1]
      by_cases h2 : N - W a = M - W a
      · rw [if_pos h2]
        exact hva (by omega)
      · rw [if_neg h2]
    · rw [if_neg h1]

name: Operad.Graded.homog_mem_rees
statement:
lemma homog_mem_rees {V : Submodule K (α → K)} {N : ℕ} {v : α → K} (hvV : v ∈ V)
    (hv : IsBelowF K W N v) : homog W N v ∈ rees K W V
proof:
:= fun M => by
  rw [coeffVec_homog hv]
  split_ifs
  · exact hvV
  · exact zero_mem _

name: Operad.Graded.eq_sum_homog
statement:
lemma eq_sum_homog (f : α → K[X]) {T : ℕ} (hT : ∀ a, (f a).natDegree + W a ≤ T) :
    f = ∑ N ∈ Finset.range (T + 1), homog W N (coeffVec W N f)
proof:
:= by
  funext a
  ext k
  simp only [Finset.sum_apply, finsetSum_coeff, homog, coeff_monomial, coeffVec]
  rw [Finset.sum_eq_single (k + W a)]
  · simp
  · intro N _ hN
    by_cases h1 : N - W a = k
    · rw [if_pos h1]
      by_cases h2 : W a ≤ N
      · omega
      · rw [if_neg h2]
    · rw [if_neg h1]
  · intro hk
    rw [Finset.mem_range, not_lt] at hk
    have : (f a).natDegree < k := by have := hT a; omega
    simp [coeff_eq_zero_of_natDegree_lt this]

name: Operad.Graded.exists_bound
statement: lemma exists_bound (f : α → K[X]) : ∃ T, ∀ a, (f a).natDegree + W a ≤ T
proof:
:=
  ⟨Finset.univ.sup fun a => (f a).natDegree + W a, fun a =>
    Finset.le_sup (f := fun a => (f a).natDegree + W a) (Finset.mem_univ a)⟩

name: Operad.Graded.evalAt_apply
statement: lemma evalAt_apply (c : K) (f : α → K[X]) (a : α) : evalAt K c f a = (f a).eval c
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.Graded.evalAt_homog
statement:
lemma evalAt_homog (c : K) (N : ℕ) (v : α → K) (a : α) :
    evalAt K c (homog W N v) a = c ^ (N - W a) * v a
proof:
:= by
  simp [evalAt_apply, homog, eval_monomial, mul_comm]

name: Operad.Graded.evalAt_eq_sum
statement:
lemma evalAt_eq_sum (c : K) (f : α → K[X]) {T : ℕ} (hT : ∀ a, (f a).natDegree + W a ≤ T) :
    evalAt K c f = ∑ N ∈ Finset.range (T + 1), evalAt K c (homog W N (coeffVec W N f))
proof:
:= by
  conv_lhs => rw [eq_sum_homog f hT]
  rw [map_sum]
