name: Operad.Graded.evalAt_rees_one
statement: theorem evalAt_rees_one (V : Submodule K (α → K)) : fiber (W := W) V 1 = V
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · rintro _ ⟨f, hf, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨T, hT⟩ := exists_bound (W := W) f
    rw [evalAt_eq_sum 1 f hT]
    refine Submodule.sum_mem _ fun N _ => ?_
    have : evalAt K 1 (homog W N (coeffVec W N f)) = coeffVec W N f := by
      funext a
      rw [evalAt_homog, one_pow, one_mul]
    rw [this]
    exact hf N
  · intro v hv
    refine ⟨homog W (Finset.univ.sup W) v,
      homog_mem_rees hv fun a ha => absurd (Finset.le_sup (Finset.mem_univ a)) (not_le.2 ha), ?_⟩
    funext a
    rw [evalAt_homog, one_pow, one_mul]

name: Operad.Graded.evalAt_rees_zero
statement: theorem evalAt_rees_zero (V : Submodule K (α → K)) : fiber (W := W) V 0 = grF K W V
proof:
:= by
  have hproj : ∀ (N : ℕ) (v : α → K), IsBelowF K W N v →
      evalAt K 0 (homog W N v) = projF K W N v := by
    intro N v hv
    funext a
    rw [evalAt_homog, projF_apply]
    by_cases ha : W a = N
    · rw [if_pos ha, show N - W a = 0 by omega, pow_zero, one_mul]
    · rw [if_neg ha]
      by_cases hlt : W a < N
      · rw [zero_pow (by omega), zero_mul]
      · rw [hv a (by omega), mul_zero]
  apply le_antisymm
  · rintro _ ⟨f, hf, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨T, hT⟩ := exists_bound (W := W) f
    rw [evalAt_eq_sum 0 f hT]
    refine Submodule.sum_mem _ fun N _ => ?_
    rw [hproj N _ (coeffVec_isBelowF W N f)]
    exact projF_mem_grF (hf N) (coeffVec_isBelowF W N f)
  · refine grF_le fun N v hv hN => ?_
    rw [← hproj N v hN]
    exact ⟨_, homog_mem_rees hv hN, rfl⟩

name: Operad.Graded.evalAt_rees_of_ne_zero
statement:
theorem evalAt_rees_of_ne_zero (V : Submodule K (α → K)) {c : K} (hc : c ≠ 0) :
    fiber (W := W) V c = V.map (scaleInv W c)
proof:
:= by
  have hscale : ∀ (N : ℕ) (v : α → K), IsBelowF K W N v →
      evalAt K c (homog W N v) = c ^ N • scaleInv W c v := by
    intro N v hv
    funext a
    rw [evalAt_homog, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
    show c ^ (N - W a) * v a = c ^ N * (c⁻¹ ^ W a * v a)
    by_cases ha : W a ≤ N
    · rw [pow_sub₀ c hc ha, inv_pow]
      ring
    · rw [hv a (by omega), mul_zero, mul_zero, mul_zero]
  apply le_antisymm
  · rintro _ ⟨f, hf, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨T, hT⟩ := exists_bound (W := W) f
    rw [evalAt_eq_sum c f hT]
    refine Submodule.sum_mem _ fun N _ => ?_
    rw [hscale N _ (coeffVec_isBelowF W N f)]
    exact Submodule.smul_mem _ _ (Submodule.mem_map_of_mem (hf N))
  · rintro _ ⟨v, hv, rfl⟩
    have hB : IsBelowF K W (Finset.univ.sup W) v := fun a ha =>
      absurd (Finset.le_sup (Finset.mem_univ a)) (not_le.2 ha)
    refine ⟨(c ^ Finset.univ.sup W)⁻¹ • homog W (Finset.univ.sup W) v,
      Submodule.smul_of_tower_mem _ _ (homog_mem_rees hv hB), ?_⟩
    rw [LinearMap.map_smul_of_tower, hscale _ v hB, smul_smul, inv_mul_cancel₀ (pow_ne_zero _ hc),
      one_smul]

name: Operad.Graded.X_pow_smul_homog
statement:
lemma X_pow_smul_homog {N T : ℕ} (hNT : N ≤ T) {v : α → K} (hv : IsBelowF K W N v) :
    (X : K[X]) ^ (T - N) • homog W N v = homog W T v
proof:
:= by
  funext a
  simp only [Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, homog]
  by_cases ha : W a ≤ N
  · rw [X_pow_mul_monomial, show N - W a + (T - N) = T - W a by omega]
  · rw [hv a (by omega), monomial_zero_right, monomial_zero_right, mul_zero]

name: Operad.Graded.homog_add
statement: lemma homog_add (N : ℕ) (v w : α → K) : homog W N (v + w) = homog W N v + homog W N w
proof:
:= by
  funext a
  simp [homog]

name: Operad.Graded.homog_smul
statement: lemma homog_smul (N : ℕ) (r : K) (v : α → K) : homog W N (r • v) = C r • homog W N v
proof:
:= by
  funext a
  simp [homog, C_mul_monomial]

name: Operad.Graded.homog_sum
statement:
lemma homog_sum {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι) (N : ℕ) (v : ι → α → K) :
    homog W N (∑ i ∈ s, v i) = ∑ i ∈ s, homog W N (v i)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction s using Finset.induction_on with
  | empty =>
    funext a
    simp [homog]
  | insert i s hi ih => rw [Finset.sum_insert hi, Finset.sum_insert hi, homog_add, ih]

name: Operad.Graded.scaleInv_injective
statement: lemma scaleInv_injective {c : K} (hc : c ≠ 0) : Function.Injective (scaleInv W c)
proof:
:= by
  intro v w h
  funext a
  have := congrFun h a
  simp only [scaleInv, LinearMap.coe_mk, AddHom.coe_mk] at this
  exact mul_left_cancel₀ (pow_ne_zero _ (inv_ne_zero hc)) this

name: Operad.Graded.exists_eq_smul_of_evalAt_eq_zero
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hc : c = 0
  · subst hc
    have h0a : ∀ a, (f a).coeff 0 = 0 := fun a => by
      rw [coeff_zero_eq_eval_zero, ← evalAt_apply, h0]
      rfl
    refine ⟨fun a => (f a).divX, fun N => ?_, ?_⟩
    · have : coeffVec W N (fun a => (f a).divX) = coeffVec W (N + 1) f := by
        funext a
        simp only [coeffVec, coeff_divX]
        by_cases h : W a ≤ N
        · rw [if_pos h, if_pos (by omega), show N + 1 - W a = N - W a + 1 by omega]
        · by_cases h' : W a = N + 1
          · rw [if_neg h, if_pos (by omega), show N + 1 - W a = 0 by omega, h0a]
          · rw [if_neg h, if_neg (by omega)]
      rw [this]
      exact hf (N + 1)
    · funext a
      simp only [Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, map_zero, sub_zero]
      conv_lhs => rw [← X_mul_divX_add (f a), h0a, map_zero, add_zero]
  · obtain ⟨T, hT⟩ := exists_bound (W := W) f
    have hv : ∀ N, IsBelowF K W N (coeffVec W N f) := fun N => coeffVec_isBelowF W N f
    have hscale : ∀ (N : ℕ) (v : α → K), IsBelowF K W N v →
        evalAt K c (homog W N v) = c ^ N • scaleInv W c v := by
      intro N v hv
      funext a
      rw [evalAt_homog, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
      show c ^ (N - W a) * v a = c ^ N * (c⁻¹ ^ W a * v a)
      by_cases ha : W a ≤ N
      · rw [pow_sub₀ c hc ha, inv_pow]
        ring
      · rw [hv a (by omega), mul_zero, mul_zero, mul_zero]
    have hsum : ∑ N ∈ Finset.range (T + 1), c ^ N • coeffVec W N f = 0 := by
      have h1 := evalAt_eq_sum c f hT
      rw [h0] at h1
      rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl fun N _ => hscale N _ (hv N)] at h1
      apply scaleInv_injective (W := W) hc
      rw [map_sum, map_zero]
      simpa only [map_smul] using h1.symm
    
    set q : ℕ → K[X] := fun N => -C (c ^ (T - N))⁻¹ *
      ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (T - N), X ^ i * C c ^ (T - N - 1 - i) with hq
    have hqX : ∀ N, (X - C c) * q N = 1 - C (c ^ (T - N))⁻¹ * X ^ (T - N) := by
      intro N
      have hg := geom_sum₂_mul (X : K[X]) (C c) (T - N)
      rw [mul_comm] at hg
      have hu : C (c ^ (T - N))⁻¹ * C c ^ (T - N) = (1 : K[X]) := by
        rw [← C_pow, ← C_mul, inv_mul_cancel₀ (pow_ne_zero _ hc), C_1]
      rw [hq]
      dsimp only
      linear_combination (-C (c ^ (T - N))⁻¹) * hg + hu
    have hzero : ∑ N ∈ Finset.range (T + 1),
        C (c ^ (T - N))⁻¹ • (X : K[X]) ^ (T - N) • homog W N (coeffVec W N f) = 0 := by
      have : ∀ N ∈ Finset.range (T + 1),
          C (c ^ (T - N))⁻¹ • (X : K[X]) ^ (T - N) • homog W N (coeffVec W N f) =
            homog W T ((c ^ T)⁻¹ • c ^ N • coeffVec W N f) := by
        intro N hN
        rw [Finset.mem_range] at hN
        rw [X_pow_smul_homog (by omega) (hv N), ← homog_smul, smul_smul,
          pow_sub₀ c hc (by omega : N ≤ T), mul_inv, inv_inv]
      rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl this, ← homog_sum, ← Finset.smul_sum, hsum, smul_zero]
      funext a
      simp [homog]
    have hterm : ∀ N, (X - C c) • q N • homog W N (coeffVec W N f) = homog W N (coeffVec W N f) -
        C (c ^ (T - N))⁻¹ • (X : K[X]) ^ (T - N) • homog W N (coeffVec W N f) := by
      intro N
      rw [smul_smul, hqX, sub_smul, one_smul, mul_smul]
    refine ⟨∑ N ∈ Finset.range (T + 1), q N • homog W N (coeffVec W N f),
      Submodule.sum_mem _ fun N _ => Submodule.smul_mem _ _ (homog_mem_rees (hf N) (hv N)), ?_⟩
    rw [Finset.smul_sum, Finset.sum_congr rfl fun N _ => hterm N, Finset.sum_sub_distrib, hzero,
      sub_zero]
    exact eq_sum_homog f hT

name: Operad.Graded.evalAt_smul
statement:
lemma evalAt_smul (c : K) (p : K[X]) (f : α → K[X]) :
    evalAt K c (p • f) = p.eval c • evalAt K c f
proof:
:= by
  funext a
  simp [evalAt_apply]

name: Operad.Graded.free_rees
statement: theorem free_rees (V : Submodule K (α → K)) : Module.Free K[X] (rees K W V)
proof:
:=
  inferInstance

name: Operad.Graded.finrank_rees
statement:
theorem finrank_rees (V : Submodule K (α → K)) (c : K) :
    Module.finrank K[X] (rees K W V) = Module.finrank K (fiber (W := W) V c)
proof:
:= by
  set M := rees K W V
  let b := Module.finBasis K[X] M
  let v : Fin (Module.finrank K[X] M) → (α → K) := fun i => evalAt K c (b i : α → K[X])
  have hspan : Submodule.span K (Set.range v) = fiber (W := W) V c := by
    apply le_antisymm
    · rw [Submodule.span_le]
      rintro _ ⟨i, rfl⟩
      exact ⟨b i, (b i).2, rfl⟩
    · rintro _ ⟨f, hf, rfl⟩
      have hf' : f = ∑ i, b.repr ⟨f, hf⟩ i • (b i : α → K[X]) := by
        have h := congrArg Subtype.val (b.sum_repr ⟨f, hf⟩)
        rw [Submodule.coe_sum] at h
        simp only [Submodule.coe_smul] at h
        exact h.symm
      rw [hf', map_sum]
      refine Submodule.sum_mem _ fun i _ => ?_
      rw [evalAt_smul]
      exact Submodule.smul_mem _ _ (Submodule.subset_span ⟨i, rfl⟩)
  have hli : LinearIndependent K v := by
    rw [Fintype.linearIndependent_iff]
    intro a ha i
    have hmem : (∑ i, C (a i) • (b i : α → K[X])) ∈ M :=
      Submodule.sum_mem _ fun i _ => Submodule.smul_mem _ _ (b i).2
    have h0 : evalAt K c (∑ i, C (a i) • (b i : α → K[X])) = 0 := by
      rw [map_sum]
      simpa [evalAt_smul, v] using ha
    obtain ⟨g, hg, hfg⟩ := exists_eq_smul_of_evalAt_eq_zero hmem c h0
    have hM : (∑ i, C (a i) • b i : M) = (X - C c) • (⟨g, hg⟩ : M) :=
      Subtype.ext (by simpa using hfg)
    have hrepr := congrArg (fun m => b.repr m i) hM
    simp only [b.repr_sum_self, map_smul, Finsupp.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul] at hrepr
    simpa using congrArg (eval c) hrepr
  rw [← hspan, finrank_span_eq_card hli, Fintype.card_fin]

name: Operad.Graded.mem_sections
statement:
lemma mem_sections {U : K → Submodule K (α → K)} {f : α → K[X]} :
    f ∈ sections K U ↔ ∀ c, evalAt K c f ∈ U c
proof: := Iff.rfl

name: Operad.Graded.coeff_mem_of_evalAt_mem
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_contra hN
  obtain ⟨φ, hφ, hV⟩ := Submodule.exists_dual_map_eq_bot_of_notMem hN inferInstance
  have hφV : ∀ v ∈ V, φ v = 0 := fun v hv => by
    have : φ v ∈ V.map φ := Submodule.mem_map_of_mem hv
    rwa [hV, Submodule.mem_bot] at this
  set P : K[X] := ∑ a, C (φ fun j => if a = j then 1 else 0) * g a with hP
  have hevalP : ∀ c, P.eval c = φ (evalAt K c g) := fun c => by
    rw [LinearMap.pi_apply_eq_sum_univ, hP, eval_finsetSum]
    exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun a _ => by
      rw [eval_mul, eval_C, evalAt_apply, smul_eq_mul, mul_comm]
  have hP0 : P = 0 := by
    refine eq_zero_of_infinite_isRoot P (hS.mono fun c hc => ?_)
    show P.eval c = 0
    rw [hevalP]
    exact hφV _ (h c hc)
  have hcoeffP : P.coeff N = φ (fun a => (g a).coeff N) := by
    rw [LinearMap.pi_apply_eq_sum_univ, hP, finsetSum_coeff]
    exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun a _ => by rw [coeff_C_mul, smul_eq_mul, mul_comm]
  apply hφ
  rw [← hcoeffP, hP0, coeff_zero]

name: Operad.Graded.mem_rees_iff_evalAt
statement:
theorem mem_rees_iff_evalAt [Infinite K] {V : Submodule K (α → K)} {f : α → K[X]} :
    f ∈ rees K W V ↔ ∀ c : K, c ≠ 0 → evalAt K c f ∈ V.map (scaleInv W c)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hf c hc
    rw [← evalAt_rees_of_ne_zero V hc]
    exact ⟨f, hf, rfl⟩
  · intro h N
    have hcoeff : coeffVec W N f = fun a => ((X : K[X]) ^ W a * f a).coeff N := by
      funext a
      rw [coeff_X_pow_mul']
      rfl
    rw [hcoeff]
    refine coeff_mem_of_evalAt_mem (Set.finite_singleton (0 : K)).infinite_compl
      (fun c hc => ?_) N
    obtain ⟨v, hv, hvf⟩ := h c (Set.mem_compl_singleton_iff.1 hc)
    have hcg : evalAt K c (fun a => (X : K[X]) ^ W a * f a) = v := by
      funext a
      have h1 := congrFun hvf a
      simp only [scaleInv, LinearMap.coe_mk, AddHom.coe_mk] at h1
      rw [evalAt_apply, eval_mul, eval_pow, eval_X, ← evalAt_apply, ← h1, ← mul_assoc, ← mul_pow,
        mul_inv_cancel₀ (Set.mem_compl_singleton_iff.1 hc), one_pow, one_mul]
    rw [hcg]
    exact hv

name: Operad.Graded.sections_fiber
statement:
theorem sections_fiber [Infinite K] (V : Submodule K (α → K)) :
    sections K (fun c => fiber (W := W) V c) = rees K W V
proof:
:= by
  ext f
  constructor
  · intro hf
    refine mem_rees_iff_evalAt.2 fun c hc => ?_
    rw [← evalAt_rees_of_ne_zero V hc]
    exact hf c
  · intro hf c
    exact ⟨f, hf, rfl⟩

name: Operad.ShuffleOperadHom.app_eq_zero_of_mem_span
proof:
:=
  LinearMap.mem_ker.1 (ShuffleOperadIdeal.span_le (I := φ.ker).2
    (fun A _ _ y hy => LinearMap.mem_ker.2 (hφ A y hy)) A hx)

name: Operad.LTree.ofBinSTree_toBinSTree
statement:
lemma ofBinSTree_toBinSTree : ∀ t : LTree G, ofBinSTree (toBinSTree t) = t
  | leaf _ => rfl
  | node e l r => by
    show node e (ofBinSTree (toBinSTree l)) (ofBinSTree (toBinSTree r)) = node e l r
    rw [ofBinSTree_toBinSTree l, ofBinSTree_toBinSTree r]

name: Operad.LTree.toBinSTree_ofBinSTree
statement:
lemma toBinSTree_ofBinSTree : ∀ m : STree (BinGen G), toBinSTree (ofBinSTree m) = m
  | STree.leaf _ => rfl
  | STree.node (BinGen.op g) c => by
    show STree.node (BinGen.op g) ![toBinSTree (ofBinSTree (c 0)), toBinSTree (ofBinSTree (c 1))] =
      STree.node (BinGen.op g) c
    rw [toBinSTree_ofBinSTree (c 0), toBinSTree_ofBinSTree (c 1)]
    congr 1
    funext j
    fin_cases j <;> rfl

name: Operad.LTree.labels_toBinSTree
statement:
lemma labels_toBinSTree : ∀ t : LTree G, (toBinSTree t).labels = (t.labels : Multiset ℕ)
  | leaf _ => rfl
  | node e l r => by
    show (STree.node (BinGen.op e) ![toBinSTree l, toBinSTree r]).labels = _
    rw [STree.labels_node, Fin.sum_univ_two, labels_node, ← Multiset.coe_add]
    exact congrArg₂ (· + ·) (labels_toBinSTree l) (labels_toBinSTree r)

name: Operad.LTree.first_toBinSTree
statement:
lemma first_toBinSTree : ∀ t : LTree G, t.IsShuffle → (toBinSTree t).first = t.minLabel
  | leaf _, _ => rfl
  | node e l r, h => by
    show (STree.node (BinGen.op e) ![toBinSTree l, toBinSTree r]).first = _
    rw [STree.first_node _ _ (by omega), minLabel_node_of_shuffle h]
    exact first_toBinSTree l h.2.1

name: Operad.LTree.isShuffle_toBinSTree
statement:
lemma isShuffle_toBinSTree : ∀ t : LTree G, t.IsShuffle → (toBinSTree t).IsShuffle
  | leaf _, _ => trivial
  | node e l r, h => by
    refine ⟨by omega, fun i => ?_, Fin.strictMono_iff_lt_succ.2 fun i => ?_⟩
    · fin_cases i
      · exact isShuffle_toBinSTree l h.2.1
      · exact isShuffle_toBinSTree r h.2.2
    · fin_cases i
      show (toBinSTree l).first < (toBinSTree r).first
      rw [first_toBinSTree l h.2.1, first_toBinSTree r h.2.2]
      exact h.1

name: Operad.LTree.isShuffle_of_toBinSTree
statement:
lemma isShuffle_of_toBinSTree : ∀ t : LTree G, (toBinSTree t).IsShuffle → t.IsShuffle
  | leaf _, _ => trivial
  | node e l r, h => by
    have hl
proof:
:= isShuffle_of_toBinSTree l (h.child 0)
    have hr := isShuffle_of_toBinSTree r (h.child 1)
    refine ⟨?_, hl, hr⟩
    have := h.mono (show (0 : Fin 2) < 1 by decide)
    change (toBinSTree l).first < (toBinSTree r).first at this
    rwa [first_toBinSTree l hl, first_toBinSTree r hr] at this

name: Operad.FreeL.expSym_basis
statement:
@[simp] lemma expSym_basis {k : ℕ} (β : B k) :
    expSym b k (b k β) = Finsupp.single (Pres.gen β) 1
proof:
:=
  (b k).constr_basis R _ β

name: Operad.FreeL.map_single_gen
statement:
lemma map_single_gen {n : ℕ} (τ : Equiv.Perm (Fin n)) (β : B n) :
    SymOperad.map (R := R) (P := Lin R (FreeSet B)) τ (Finsupp.single (Pres.gen β) (1 : R)) =
      Finsupp.single (SetOperad.map τ (Pres.gen β)) 1
proof:
:=
  Lin.mapL_single _ _ _

name: Operad.FreeL.proj_single_map
statement:
lemma proj_single_map (n : ℕ) (σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin n)) (β : B n) :
    (SymOperadIdeal.span R (basisRel b)).proj (Fin n)
        (Finsupp.single (SetOperad.map σ (Pres.gen β)) 1) =
      (SymOperadIdeal.span R (basisRel b)).proj (Fin n)
        (expSym b n (SymSpecies.map (R := R) σ (b n β)))
proof:
:= by
  rw [← sub_eq_zero, ← map_sub, SymOperadIdeal.proj_eq_zero_iff]
  exact SymOperadIdeal.subset_span n ⟨σ, β, rfl⟩

name: Operad.FreeL.proj_expSym_map
statement:
lemma proj_expSym_map (n : ℕ) (σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin n)) (v : V (Fin n)) :
    (SymOperadIdeal.span R (basisRel b)).proj (Fin n) (expSym b n (SymSpecies.map (R := R) σ v)) =
      SymOperad.map (R := R) σ
        ((SymOperadIdeal.span R (basisRel b)).proj (Fin n) (expSym b n v))
proof:
:= by
  set I := SymOperadIdeal.span R (basisRel b)
  have h : I.proj (Fin n) ∘ₗ expSym b n ∘ₗ SymSpecies.map (R := R) σ =
      SymOperad.map (R := R) σ ∘ₗ I.proj (Fin n) ∘ₗ expSym b n := by
    refine (b n).ext fun β => ?_
    simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply, expSym_basis]
    rw [← proj_single_map, ← SymOperadIdeal.projHom_app, ← SymOperadIdeal.projHom_app,
      ← SymOperadHom.app_map]
    congr 1
    exact (Lin.mapL_single _ _ _).symm
  exact LinearMap.congr_fun h v

name: Operad.FreeL.respects_genVal
statement: lemma respects_genVal : Pres.Respects (spRel (UndSp R V)) (genVal b)
proof:
:=
  (respects_spRel_iff (X := UndSp R V) _).2 fun n σ v => proj_expSym_map b n σ v

name: Operad.FreeL.toBPLin_gen
statement:
lemma toBPLin_gen {n : ℕ} (v : V (Fin n)) :
    (toBPLin b).app (Fin n) (linGen R V v) =
      (SymOperadIdeal.span R (basisRel b)).proj (Fin n) (expSym b n v)
proof:
:= by
  show Finsupp.lift _ R _ _ (Finsupp.single _ 1) = _
  simp
  rfl

name: Operad.FreeL.toBPLin_kills
statement: lemma toBPLin_kills (n : ℕ) : ∀ x ∈ linRel R V n, (toBPLin b).app (Fin n) x = 0
proof:
:= by
  rintro x (⟨v, w, rfl⟩ | ⟨c, v, rfl⟩)
  · rw [map_sub, map_sub, toBPLin_gen, toBPLin_gen, toBPLin_gen, map_add, map_add]
    abel
  · rw [map_sub, map_smul, toBPLin_gen, toBPLin_gen, map_smul, map_smul, sub_self]

name: Operad.FreeL.fromBPLin_gen
statement:
lemma fromBPLin_gen {n : ℕ} (β : B n) :
    (fromBPLin b).app (Fin n) (Finsupp.single (Pres.gen β) 1) = (ι R V).app (Fin n) (b n β)
proof:
:= by
  show Finsupp.lift _ R _ _ (Finsupp.single _ 1) = _
  simp
  rfl

name: Operad.FreeL.fromBPLin_expSym
statement:
lemma fromBPLin_expSym {n : ℕ} (v : V (Fin n)) :
    (fromBPLin b).app (Fin n) (expSym b n v) = (ι R V).app (Fin n) v
proof:
:= by
  have h : (fromBPLin b).app (Fin n) ∘ₗ expSym b n = (ι R V).app (Fin n) :=
    (b n).ext fun β => by
      rw [LinearMap.comp_apply, expSym_basis]
      exact fromBPLin_gen b β
  exact LinearMap.congr_fun h v

name: Operad.FreeL.fromBPLin_kills
statement: lemma fromBPLin_kills (n : ℕ) : ∀ x ∈ basisRel b n, (fromBPLin b).app (Fin n) x = 0
proof:
:= by
  rintro x ⟨σ, β, rfl⟩
  rw [map_sub, fromBPLin_expSym, sub_eq_zero, (ι R V).app_map, ← fromBPLin_expSym, expSym_basis]
  refine Eq.trans ?_ ((fromBPLin b).app_map σ _)
  congr 1
  exact (Lin.mapL_single _ _ _).symm

name: Operad.FreeL.ι_app_fin
statement:
lemma ι_app_fin {n : ℕ} (v : V (Fin n)) :
    (ι R V).app (Fin n) v = (SymOperadIdeal.span R (linRel R V)).proj (Fin n) (linGen R V v)
proof:
:= by
  rw [ι_app, FreeSp.ι_app_fin]
  rfl

name: Operad.FreeL.fromBP_comp_toBP
statement: theorem fromBP_comp_toBP : (fromBP b).comp (toBP b) = SymOperadHom.id
proof:
:=
  presLin_hom_ext fun n v => by
    show (fromBP b).app _ ((toBPLin b).app _ (linGen R V v)) = _
    rw [toBPLin_gen]
    show (fromBPLin b).app _ (expSym b n v) = _
    rw [fromBPLin_expSym, ι_app_fin]
    rfl

name: Operad.FreeL.toBP_comp_fromBP
statement: theorem toBP_comp_fromBP : (toBP b).comp (fromBP b) = SymOperadHom.id
proof:
:=
  presLin_hom_ext fun n β => by
    show (toBP b).app _ ((fromBPLin b).app _ (Finsupp.single (Pres.gen β) 1)) = _
    rw [fromBPLin_gen, ι_app_fin]
    show (toBPLin b).app _ (linGen R V (b n β)) = _
    rw [toBPLin_gen, expSym_basis]
    rfl

name: Operad.FreeL.pos_of_basis
statement: lemma pos_of_basis {k : ℕ} (β : B k) : 0 < k
proof:
:=
  Nat.pos_of_ne_zero fun h => by
    subst h
    exact isEmptyElim β

name: Operad.FreeL.expSh_basis
statement:
@[simp] lemma expSh_basis {k : ℕ} (β : B k) :
    expSh b k (b k β) = Finsupp.single (FreeSh.genM (pos_of_basis β) β) 1
proof:
:=
  (b k).constr_basis R _ β

name: Operad.FreeL.coordSh_toSh_map
statement:
lemma coordSh_toSh_map (n : ℕ) (τ : Equiv.Perm (Fin n)) (v : V (Fin n)) :
    (coordSh b).app (Fin n) ((FreeSet.toSh R B).app (Fin n)
      (SymOperad.map (R := R) τ (expSym b n v))) = expSh b n (SymSpecies.map (R := R) τ v)
proof:
:= by
  have h : (coordSh b).app (Fin n) ∘ₗ (FreeSet.toSh R B).app (Fin n) ∘ₗ
      SymOperad.map (R := R) τ ∘ₗ expSym b n = expSh b n ∘ₗ SymSpecies.map (R := R) τ :=
    (b n).ext fun β => by
      simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply, expSym_basis]
      erw [map_single_gen]
      rw [FreeSet.toSh_gen R (pos_of_basis β), coordSh, FreeSh.lift_gen, Equiv.symm_symm]
  exact LinearMap.congr_fun h v

name: Operad.FreeL.coordSh_toSh
statement:
lemma coordSh_toSh (n : ℕ) (v : V (Fin n)) :
    (coordSh b).app (Fin n) ((FreeSet.toSh R B).app (Fin n) (expSym b n v)) = expSh b n v
proof:
:= by
  have h := coordSh_toSh_map b n (Equiv.refl _) v
  rwa [SymOperad.map_refl, SymSpecies.map_refl] at h

name: Operad.FreeL.coordSh_kills
statement:
lemma coordSh_kills (A : Type) [Fintype A] [LinearOrder A] :
    ∀ y ∈ FreeSet.shuffleRel R (basisRel b) A, (coordSh b).app A y = 0
proof:
:= by
  rintro _ ⟨_, ⟨n, e, _, ⟨σ, β, rfl⟩, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
  let o : Fin n ≃o A := FreeSh.isoOfCard (by rw [Fintype.card_congr e])
  let τ : Equiv.Perm (Fin n) := e.trans o.symm.toEquiv
  have he : SymOperad.map (R := R) e (Finsupp.single (SetOperad.map σ (Pres.gen β)) 1 -
      expSym b n (SymSpecies.map (R := R) σ (b n β))) =
      ShuffleOperad.map (R := R) (P := Shuf (Lin R (FreeSet B))) o
        (SymOperad.map (R := R) τ (SymOperad.map (R := R) σ (expSym b n (b n β)) -
          expSym b n (SymSpecies.map (R := R) σ (b n β)))) := by
    show _ = SymOperad.map (R := R) o.toEquiv _
    rw [SymOperad.map_map', expSym_basis, map_single_gen]
    exact SymOperad.map_congr' (fun a => by simp [τ]) _
  have h1 : (coordSh b).app (Fin n) ((FreeSet.toSh R B).app (Fin n) (SymOperad.map (R := R) τ
      (SymOperad.map (R := R) σ (expSym b n (b n β))))) =
      expSh b n (SymSpecies.map (R := R) τ (SymSpecies.map (R := R) σ (b n β))) := by
    rw [SymOperad.map_map', coordSh_toSh_map, SymSpecies.map_trans]
  have hz : (coordSh b).app (Fin n) ((FreeSet.toSh R B).app (Fin n) (SymOperad.map (R := R) τ
      (SymOperad.map (R := R) σ (expSym b n (b n β)) -
        expSym b n (SymSpecies.map (R := R) σ (b n β))))) = 0 := by
    have := map_sub ((coordSh b).app (Fin n) ∘ₗ (FreeSet.toSh R B).app (Fin n) ∘ₗ
      SymOperad.map (R := R) τ) (SymOperad.map (R := R) σ (expSym b n (b n β)))
      (expSym b n (SymSpecies.map (R := R) σ (b n β)))
    simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply] at this
    refine this.trans (sub_eq_zero.2 (h1.trans (coordSh_toSh_map b n τ _).symm))
  rw [he, (FreeSet.toSh R B).app_map, (coordSh b).app_map, hz, map_zero]

name: Operad.FreeL.bpToSh_expSym
statement:
lemma bpToSh_expSym (n : ℕ) (v : V (Fin n)) :
    (bpToSh b).app (Fin n) ((SymOperadIdeal.span R (basisRel b)).proj (Fin n) (expSym b n v)) =
      expSh b n v
proof:
:=
  coordSh_toSh b n v

name: Operad.FreeL.shToBP_expSh
statement:
lemma shToBP_expSh (n : ℕ) (v : V (Fin n)) :
    (shToBP b).app (Fin n) (expSh b n v) =
      (SymOperadIdeal.span R (basisRel b)).proj (Fin n) (expSym b n v)
proof:
:= by
  have h : (shToBP b).app (Fin n) ∘ₗ expSh b n =
      (SymOperadIdeal.span R (basisRel b)).proj (Fin n) ∘ₗ expSym b n :=
    (b n).ext fun β => by
      show (shToBP b).app (Fin n) (expSh b n (b n β)) =
        (SymOperadIdeal.span R (basisRel b)).proj (Fin n) (expSym b n (b n β))
      rw [expSym_basis, expSh_basis, shToBP, FreeSh.lift_gen]
  exact LinearMap.congr_fun h v

name: Operad.FreeL.bpToSh_comp_shToBP
statement: theorem bpToSh_comp_shToBP : (bpToSh b).comp (shToBP b) = ShuffleOperadHom.id
proof:
:=
  ShuffleOperadHom.ext fun A _ _ x => FreeSh.hom_ext (fun k hk β => by
    show (bpToSh b).app (Fin k) ((shToBP b).app (Fin k) (Finsupp.single (FreeSh.genM hk β) 1)) = _
    rw [shToBP, FreeSh.lift_gen, ← expSym_basis b β, bpToSh_expSym, expSh_basis]
    rfl) A x

name: Operad.FreeL.shToBP_comp_bpToSh
statement: theorem shToBP_comp_bpToSh : (shToBP b).comp (bpToSh b) = ShuffleOperadHom.id
proof:
:=
  SymOperadIdeal.shuffle_hom_ext _ fun n β σ => by
    show (shToBP b).app (Fin n) ((bpToSh b).app (Fin n) _) = _
    rw [proj_single_map, bpToSh_expSym, shToBP_expSh]
    rfl

name: Operad.FreeL.toFreeSh_ι
statement:
theorem toFreeSh_ι {k : ℕ} (v : V (Fin k)) :
    (toFreeSh b).app (Fin k) ((ι R V).app (Fin k) v) = expSh b k v
proof:
:= by
  show (bpToSh b).app (Fin k) ((toBP b).app (Fin k) ((ι R V).app (Fin k) v)) = _
  rw [ι_app_fin]
  show (bpToSh b).app (Fin k) ((toBPLin b).app (Fin k) (linGen R V v)) = _
  rw [toBPLin_gen, bpToSh_expSym]

name: Operad.FreeL.toFreeSh_ι_basis
statement:
theorem toFreeSh_ι_basis {k : ℕ} (hk : 0 < k) (β : B k) :
    (toFreeSh b).app (Fin k) ((ι R V).app (Fin k) (b k β)) =
      Finsupp.single (FreeSh.genM hk β) 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [toFreeSh_ι, expSh_basis]

name: Operad.FreeL.ofFreeSh_genM
statement:
theorem ofFreeSh_genM {k : ℕ} (hk : 0 < k) (β : B k) :
    (ofFreeSh b).app (Fin k) (Finsupp.single (FreeSh.genM hk β) 1) =
      (ι R V).app (Fin k) (b k β)
proof:
:= by
  show (fromBP b).app (Fin k) ((shToBP b).app (Fin k) _) = _
  rw [shToBP, FreeSh.lift_gen]
  exact fromBPLin_gen b β

name: Operad.FreeL.toFreeSh_comp_ofFreeSh
statement: theorem toFreeSh_comp_ofFreeSh : (toFreeSh b).comp (ofFreeSh b) = ShuffleOperadHom.id
proof:
:=
  ShuffleOperadHom.ext fun A _ _ x => by
    show (bpToSh b).app A ((toBP b).app A ((fromBP b).app A ((shToBP b).app A x))) = x
    rw [show (toBP b).app A ((fromBP b).app A ((shToBP b).app A x)) = (shToBP b).app A x from
      congrArg (fun φ : SymOperadHom R (BPres b) (BPres b) => φ.app A ((shToBP b).app A x))
        (toBP_comp_fromBP b)]
    exact congrArg (fun φ : ShuffleOperadHom R (FreeSh R B) (FreeSh R B) => φ.app A x)
      (bpToSh_comp_shToBP b)

name: Operad.FreeL.ofFreeSh_comp_toFreeSh
statement: theorem ofFreeSh_comp_toFreeSh : (ofFreeSh b).comp (toFreeSh b) = ShuffleOperadHom.id
proof:
:=
  ShuffleOperadHom.ext fun A _ _ x => by
    show (fromBP b).app A ((shToBP b).app A ((bpToSh b).app A ((toBP b).app A x))) = x
    rw [show (shToBP b).app A ((bpToSh b).app A ((toBP b).app A x)) = (toBP b).app A x from
      congrArg (fun φ : ShuffleOperadHom R (Shuf (BPres b)) (Shuf (BPres b)) =>
        φ.app A ((toBP b).app A x)) (shToBP_comp_bpToSh b)]
    exact congrArg (fun φ : SymOperadHom R (FreeL R V) (FreeL R V) => φ.app A x)
      (fromBP_comp_toBP b)

name: Operad.FreeL.shuffleBasis_apply
statement:
theorem shuffleBasis_apply (A : Type) [Fintype A] [LinearOrder A]
    (m : SMono B (Finset.range (Fintype.card A))) :
    shuffleBasis b A m = (ofFreeSh b).app A (Finsupp.single m 1)
proof:
:= by
  rw [shuffleBasis, Module.Basis.map_apply, Finsupp.coe_basisSingleOne]
  rfl

name: Operad.FreeL.finrank_eq_card
statement:
theorem finrank_eq_card [Nontrivial R] (A : Type) [Fintype A] [LinearOrder A]
    [Finite (SMono B (Finset.range (Fintype.card A)))] :
    Module.finrank R (FreeL R V A) = Nat.card (SMono B (Finset.range (Fintype.card A)))
proof:
:=
  Module.finrank_eq_nat_card_basis (shuffleBasis b A)

name: Operad.FreeL.binBasisOf_op
statement:
@[simp] lemma binBasisOf_op (b₂ : Module.Basis G R (V (Fin 2)))
    (h : ∀ k, k ≠ 2 → Subsingleton (V (Fin k))) (g : G) :
    binBasisOf b₂ h 2 (BinGen.op g) = b₂ g
proof:
:= by
  rw [binBasisOf, dif_pos rfl]
  exact (b₂.reindex_apply binGenEquiv (BinGen.op g)).trans rfl

name: Operad.FreeL.binBasis_apply
statement:
theorem binBasis_apply (A : Type) [Fintype A] [LinearOrder A]
    (t : {t // t ∈ LTree.monomials (E := G) (Fintype.card A)}) :
    binBasis c A t = (ofFreeSh c).app A (Finsupp.single (LTree.binMonoEquiv _ t) 1)
proof:
:= by
  rw [binBasis, Module.Basis.reindex_apply, Equiv.symm_symm, shuffleBasis_apply]

name: Operad.FreeL.finrank_eq_doubleFactorial
statement:
theorem finrank_eq_doubleFactorial [Nontrivial R] (A : Type) [Fintype A] [LinearOrder A] (n : ℕ)
    (hA : Fintype.card A = n + 1) :
    Module.finrank R (FreeL R V A) = (2 * n - 1)‼ * Fintype.card G ^ n
proof:
:= by
  rw [Module.finrank_eq_card_basis (binBasis c A), Fintype.card_coe, hA, LTree.card_monomials]

name: Operad.GrSubCooperad.ext
statement:
lemma ext {K L : GrSubCooperad R C}
    (h : ∀ (A : Type) [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A], K.sub A = L.sub A) : K = L
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨K, _, _, _⟩ := K
  obtain ⟨L, _, _, _⟩ := L
  have : @K = @L := by
    funext A _ _
    exact h A
  subst this
  rfl

name: Operad.GrSubCooperad.range_map_subtype_mono
statement:
lemma range_map_subtype_mono {p p' : Submodule R (C A)} {q q' : Submodule R (C B)}
    (hp : p ≤ p') (hq : q ≤ q') :
    LinearMap.range (TensorProduct.map p.subtype q.subtype)
      ≤ LinearMap.range (TensorProduct.map p'.subtype q'.subtype)
proof:
:= by
  have h : TensorProduct.map p.subtype q.subtype = TensorProduct.map p'.subtype q'.subtype ∘ₗ
      TensorProduct.map (Submodule.inclusion hp) (Submodule.inclusion hq) := by
    rw [← TensorProduct.map_comp, Submodule.subtype_comp_inclusion,
      Submodule.subtype_comp_inclusion]
  rw [h]
  exact LinearMap.range_comp_le_range _ _

name: Operad.GrSubCooperad.le_sSup
statement:
lemma le_sSup {S : Set (GrSubCooperad R C)} {K : GrSubCooperad R C} (hK : K ∈ S) :
    K ≤ sSup S
proof:
:=
  fun A _ _ => le_iSup (fun K : S => K.1.sub A) ⟨K, hK⟩

name: Operad.GrSubCooperad.cogen_le
statement:
lemma cogen_le (N : ∀ (A : Type) [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A], Submodule R (C A))
    (A : Type) [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] : (cogen N).sub A ≤ N A
proof:
:=
  iSup_le fun K => K.2 A

name: Operad.GrSubCooperad.le_cogen
statement:
lemma le_cogen (N : ∀ (A : Type) [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A], Submodule R (C A))
    {K : GrSubCooperad R C} (hK : ∀ (A : Type) [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A], K.sub A ≤ N A) :
    K ≤ cogen N
proof:
:=
  le_sSup hK

name: Operad.GrSubCooperad.map₂_eq_range
statement:
lemma map₂_eq_range (p : Submodule R (C A)) (q : Submodule R (C B)) :
    Submodule.map₂ (TensorProduct.mk R (C A) (C B)) p q
      = LinearMap.range (TensorProduct.map p.subtype q.subtype)
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · rw [Submodule.map₂_le]
    intro a ha b hb
    exact ⟨⟨a, ha⟩ ⊗ₜ ⟨b, hb⟩, rfl⟩
  · rintro _ ⟨z, rfl⟩
    induction z using TensorProduct.induction_on with
    | zero => rw [map_zero]; exact zero_mem _
    | tmul a b => exact Submodule.apply_mem_map₂ _ a.2 b.2
    | add z z' hz hz' => rw [map_add]; exact add_mem hz hz'

name: Operad.GrSubCooperad.map_subtype_injective
statement:
lemma map_subtype_injective (p : Submodule R (C A)) (q : Submodule R (C B)) :
    Function.Injective (TensorProduct.map p.subtype q.subtype)
proof:
:=
  TensorProduct.map_injective_of_flat_flat _ _ p.subtype_injective q.subtype_injective

name: Operad.GrSubCooperad.incl_injective
statement: lemma incl_injective (A : Type) [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] : Function.Injective (K.incl A)
proof:
:=
  (K.sub A).subtype_injective

name: Operad.GrSubCooperad.map_incl_injective
statement: lemma map_incl_injective : Function.Injective (TensorProduct.map (K.incl A) (K.incl B))
proof:
:=
  map_subtype_injective _ _

name: Operad.GrSubCooperad.incl_map
statement:
lemma incl_map (e : A ≃ B) (x : K.Sub A) :
    K.incl B (SymSpecies.map (R := R) e x) = SymSpecies.map (R := R) e (K.incl A x)
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.GrSubCooperad.incl_par
statement:
lemma incl_par (b : Bool) (x : K.Sub A) :
    K.incl A (GrSpecies.par (R := R) b x) = GrSpecies.par (R := R) b (K.incl A x)
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.GrSubCooperad.incl_comp_par
statement:
lemma incl_comp_par (b : Bool) :
    K.incl A ∘ₗ GrSpecies.par (R := R) (V := K.Sub) b
      = GrSpecies.par (R := R) (V := C) b ∘ₗ K.incl A
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.GrSubCooperad.map_incl_decompS
statement:
@[simp] lemma map_incl_decompS (i : A) (x : K.Sub (Without A i ⊕ B)) :
    TensorProduct.map (K.incl A) (K.incl B) (K.decompS i x)
      = GrCooperad.decomp (R := R) i (K.incl _ x)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [decompS, LinearEquiv.coe_coe, LinearEquiv.ofInjective_symm_apply,
    LinearMap.codRestrict_apply, LinearMap.comp_apply]

name: Operad.GrSubCooperad.map3_injective_right
statement:
lemma map3_injective_right :
    Function.Injective (TensorProduct.map (K.incl A)
      (TensorProduct.map (K.incl B) (K.incl D)))
proof:
:=
  TensorProduct.map_injective_of_flat_flat _ _ (K.incl_injective A) K.map_incl_injective

name: Operad.GrSubCooperad.map3_injective_left
statement:
lemma map3_injective_left :
    Function.Injective (TensorProduct.map (TensorProduct.map (K.incl A) (K.incl B))
      (K.incl D))
proof:
:=
  TensorProduct.map_injective_of_flat_flat _ _ K.map_incl_injective (K.incl_injective D)

name: Operad.GrSubCooperad.lTensor_decompS
statement:
lemma lTensor_decompS (j : B) (t : K.Sub A ⊗[R] K.Sub (Without B j ⊕ D)) :
    TensorProduct.map (K.incl A) (TensorProduct.map (K.incl B) (K.incl D))
        (LinearMap.lTensor (K.Sub A) (K.decompS j) t)
      = LinearMap.lTensor (C A) (GrCooperad.decomp (R := R) j)
          (TensorProduct.map (K.incl A) (K.incl _) t)
proof:
:= by
  induction t using TensorProduct.induction_on with
  | zero => simp
  | tmul a w => simp
  | add t t' ht ht' => simp only [map_add, ht, ht']

name: Operad.GrSubCooperad.rTensor_decompS
statement:
lemma rTensor_decompS (i : A) (t : K.Sub (Without A i ⊕ B) ⊗[R] K.Sub D) :
    TensorProduct.map (TensorProduct.map (K.incl A) (K.incl B)) (K.incl D)
        (LinearMap.rTensor (K.Sub D) (K.decompS i) t)
      = LinearMap.rTensor (C D) (GrCooperad.decomp (R := R) i)
          (TensorProduct.map (K.incl _) (K.incl D) t)
proof:
:= by
  induction t using TensorProduct.induction_on with
  | zero => simp
  | tmul w a => simp
  | add t t' ht ht' => simp only [map_add, ht, ht']

name: Operad.GrSubCooperad.decompS_par
statement:
lemma decompS_par (i : A) (b : Bool) :
    K.decompS (B := B) i ∘ₗ GrSpecies.par (R := R) (V := K.Sub) b
      = tpar R (fun c => GrSpecies.par (R := R) (V := K.Sub) c)
          (fun c => GrSpecies.par (R := R) (V := K.Sub) c) b ∘ₗ K.decompS i
proof:
:= by
  refine LinearMap.ext fun x => K.map_incl_injective ?_
  have h := LinearMap.congr_fun (GrCooperad.decomp_par (R := R) (C := C) (B := B) i b) (K.incl _ x)
  have hn := LinearMap.congr_fun (map_tpar (pX := fun c => GrSpecies.par (R := R) (V := K.Sub) c)
    (pX' := fun c => GrSpecies.par (R := R) (V := C) c)
    (pY := fun c => GrSpecies.par (R := R) (V := K.Sub) c)
    (pY' := fun c => GrSpecies.par (R := R) (V := C) c) (K.incl A) (K.incl B)
    (fun c => K.incl_comp_par c) (fun c => K.incl_comp_par c) b) (K.decompS i x)
  simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply] at h hn ⊢
  rw [map_incl_decompS, incl_par, h, hn, map_incl_decompS]

name: Operad.GrSubCooperad.decompS_map
statement:
lemma decompS_map (σ' : A ≃ A') (τ : B ≃ B') (i : A) :
    K.decompS (σ' i) ∘ₗ SymSpecies.map (R := R) (V := K.Sub) (compEquiv σ' τ i)
      = TensorProduct.map (SymSpecies.map (R := R) (V := K.Sub) σ')
          (SymSpecies.map (R := R) (V := K.Sub) τ) ∘ₗ K.decompS i
proof:
:= by
  refine LinearMap.ext fun x => K.map_incl_injective ?_
  have h := LinearMap.congr_fun (GrCooperad.decomp_map (R := R) (C := C) σ' τ i) (K.incl _ x)
  simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply] at h ⊢
  rw [map_incl_decompS, incl_map, h, ← map_incl_decompS]
  induction K.decompS (B := B) i x using TensorProduct.induction_on with
  | zero => simp
  | tmul a b =>
    simp only [TensorProduct.map_tmul]
    rfl
  | add t t' ht ht' => simp only [map_add, ht, ht']

name: Operad.GrSubCooperad.decompS_counit_right
statement:
lemma decompS_counit_right (i : A) :
    (TensorProduct.rid R (K.Sub A)).toLinearMap ∘ₗ LinearMap.lTensor (K.Sub A) K.counitS ∘ₗ
        K.decompS i ∘ₗ SymSpecies.map (R := R) (V := K.Sub) (rightUnitEquiv i).symm
      = LinearMap.id
proof:
:= by
  refine LinearMap.ext fun x => K.incl_injective A ?_
  have h := LinearMap.congr_fun (GrCooperad.counit_right (R := R) (C := C) i) (K.incl A x)
  simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearEquiv.coe_coe, LinearMap.id_apply] at h ⊢
  conv_rhs => rw [← h]
  rw [← incl_map, ← map_incl_decompS]
  induction K.decompS (B := Unit) i (SymSpecies.map (R := R) (rightUnitEquiv i).symm x)
    using TensorProduct.induction_on with
  | zero => simp
  | tmul a u => simp [counitS]
  | add t t' ht ht' => simp only [map_add, ht, ht']

name: Operad.GrSubCooperad.decompS_counit_left
statement:
lemma decompS_counit_left :
    (TensorProduct.lid R (K.Sub B)).toLinearMap ∘ₗ LinearMap.rTensor (K.Sub B) K.counitS ∘ₗ
        K.decompS () ∘ₗ SymSpecies.map (R := R) (V := K.Sub) (leftUnitEquiv B).symm
      = LinearMap.id
proof:
:= by
  refine LinearMap.ext fun x => K.incl_injective B ?_
  have h := LinearMap.congr_fun (GrCooperad.counit_left (R := R) (C := C) (B := B)) (K.incl B x)
  simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearEquiv.coe_coe, LinearMap.id_apply] at h ⊢
  conv_rhs => rw [← h]
  rw [← incl_map, ← map_incl_decompS]
  induction K.decompS (B := B) () (SymSpecies.map (R := R) (leftUnitEquiv B).symm x)
    using TensorProduct.induction_on with
  | zero => simp
  | tmul u b => simp [counitS]
  | add t t' ht ht' => simp only [map_add, ht, ht']

name: Operad.GrSubCooperad.decompS_assoc_seq
statement:
lemma decompS_assoc_seq (i : A) (j : B) :
    LinearMap.lTensor (K.Sub A) (K.decompS (B := D) j) ∘ₗ K.decompS i
      = (TensorProduct.assoc R (K.Sub A) (K.Sub B) (K.Sub D)).toLinearMap ∘ₗ
          LinearMap.rTensor (K.Sub D) (K.decompS i) ∘ₗ K.decompS (Sum.inr j) ∘ₗ
            SymSpecies.map (R := R) (V := K.Sub) (seqEquiv i j D).symm
proof:
:= by
  refine LinearMap.ext fun x => K.map3_injective_right ?_
  have h := LinearMap.congr_fun (GrCooperad.decomp_assoc_seq (R := R) (C := C) (D := D) i j)
    (K.incl _ x)
  have ha := LinearMap.congr_fun (TensorProduct.map_map_comp_assoc_eq (R := R) (K.incl A)
    (K.incl B) (K.incl D))
  simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearEquiv.coe_coe] at h ha ⊢
  rw [lTensor_decompS, map_incl_decompS, h, ha, rTensor_decompS, map_incl_decompS, incl_map]

name: Operad.GrSubCooperad.decompS_assoc_par
statement:
lemma decompS_assoc_par {i k : A} (hik : i ≠ k) :
    LinearMap.rTensor (K.Sub B) (K.decompS (B := D) k) ∘ₗ K.decompS (Sum.inl ⟨i, hik⟩)
      = sswapLast R (fun c => GrSpecies.par (R := R) (V := K.Sub) c)
          (fun c => GrSpecies.par (R := R) (V := K.Sub) c) ∘ₗ
          LinearMap.rTensor (K.Sub D) (K.decompS i) ∘ₗ
            K.decompS (Sum.inl ⟨k, Ne.symm hik⟩) ∘ₗ
              SymSpecies.map (R := R) (V := K.Sub) (parEquiv hik B D).symm
proof:
:= by
  refine LinearMap.ext fun x => K.map3_injective_left ?_
  have h := LinearMap.congr_fun (GrCooperad.decomp_assoc_par (R := R) (C := C) (B := B)
    (D := D) hik) (K.incl _ x)
  have hs := LinearMap.congr_fun (map_sswapLast
    (pY := fun c => GrSpecies.par (R := R) (V := K.Sub) c)
    (pY' := fun c => GrSpecies.par (R := R) (V := C) c)
    (pZ := fun c => GrSpecies.par (R := R) (V := K.Sub) c)
    (pZ' := fun c => GrSpecies.par (R := R) (V := C) c) (K.incl A) (K.incl B) (K.incl D)
    (fun c => K.incl_comp_par c) (fun c => K.incl_comp_par c))
  simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply] at h hs ⊢
  rw [rTensor_decompS, map_incl_decompS, h, hs, rTensor_decompS, map_incl_decompS, incl_map]

name: Operad.GrSubCooperad.counitS_par
statement: lemma counitS_par : K.counitS ∘ₗ GrSpecies.par (R := R) (V := K.Sub) true = 0
proof:
:=
  LinearMap.ext fun x => LinearMap.congr_fun (GrCooperad.counit_par (R := R) (C := C)) (K.incl _ x)

name: Operad.GrSubCooperad.one_mem
statement: lemma one_mem (h : unitSub R C ≤ K) : GrCooperad.Coaug.one (R := R) (C := C) ∈ K.sub Unit
proof:
:= by
  have := h Unit (GrCooperad.map_one_mem (R := R) (C := C) (Equiv.refl Unit))
  rwa [SymSpecies.map_refl] at this

name: Operad.ConvOp.toLin_preL
statement:
@[simp] lemma toLin_preL (ψ : C' A →ₗ[R] C A) (f : ConvOp R C P A) :
    toLin (preL ψ f) = toLin f ∘ₗ ψ
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.ConvOp.preHom_app
statement:
@[simp] lemma preHom_app (ψ : GrCooperadHom R C' C) (f : ConvOp R C P A) :
    toLin ((preHom (P := P) ψ).app A f) = toLin f ∘ₗ ψ.app A
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.Tree.tpar_leaf
statement: @[simp] lemma tpar_leaf : tpar gp (.leaf : Tree E) = false
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.Tree.tpar_node
statement:
@[simp] lemma tpar_node {k : ℕ} (e : E k) (f : Forest E k) :
    tpar gp (.node e f) = xor (gp _ e) (Forest.tparF gp f)
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.Tree.apar_leaf
statement: @[simp] lemma apar_leaf (p : ℕ) : apar gp (.leaf : Tree E) p = false
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.Tree.apar_node
statement:
@[simp] lemma apar_node {k : ℕ} (e : E k) (f : Forest E k) (p : ℕ) :
    apar gp (.node e f) p = Forest.aparF gp f p
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.Tree.aparF_cons_of_lt
statement:
lemma aparF_cons_of_lt {k : ℕ} (t : Tree E) (f : Forest E k) {p : ℕ} (h : p < t.arity) :
    Forest.aparF gp (.cons t f) p = xor (apar gp t p) (Forest.tparF gp f)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Forest.aparF, if_pos h]

name: Operad.Tree.aparF_cons_of_ge
statement:
lemma aparF_cons_of_ge {k : ℕ} (t : Tree E) (f : Forest E k) {p : ℕ} (h : t.arity ≤ p) :
    Forest.aparF gp (.cons t f) p = Forest.aparF gp f (p - t.arity)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Forest.aparF, if_neg (by omega)]

name: Operad.Tree.tparF_cons
statement:
@[simp] lemma tparF_cons {k : ℕ} (t : Tree E) (f : Forest E k) :
    Forest.tparF gp (.cons t f) = xor (tpar gp t) (Forest.tparF gp f)
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.Tree.tpar_graft
statement:
theorem tpar_graft : ∀ (t : Tree E) (p : ℕ) (s : Tree E), p < t.arity →
    tpar gp (t.graft p s) = xor (tpar gp t) (tpar gp s)
  | .leaf, p, s, _ => by simp
  | .node e f, p, s, h => by
      simp only [graft_node, tpar_node]
      rw [Forest.tparF_graftF f p s h, Bool.xor_assoc]

name: Operad.Forest.tparF_graftF
statement:
theorem _root_.Operad.Forest.tparF_graftF : ∀ {k : ℕ} (f : Forest E k) (p : ℕ) (s : Tree E),
    p < f.arityF → Forest.tparF gp (f.graftF p s) = xor (Forest.tparF gp f) (tpar gp s)
  | _, .nil, _, _, h => by simp at h
  | _, .cons t f, p, s, h => by
      simp only [arityF_cons] at h
      by_cases hlt : p < t.arity
      · rw [graftF_cons_of_lt s hlt, tparF_cons, tparF_cons, tpar_graft t p s hlt]
        cases tpar gp t <;> cases tpar gp s <;> cases Forest.tparF gp f <;> rfl
      · rw [graftF_cons_of_ge s (by omega), tparF_cons, tparF_cons,
          Forest.tparF_graftF f (p - t.arity) s (by omega), Bool.xor_assoc]

end

mutual

name: Operad.Tree.apar_graft_inner
statement:
theorem apar_graft_inner : ∀ (t : Tree E) (p : ℕ) (s : Tree E) (j : ℕ), p < t.arity →
    j < s.arity → apar gp (t.graft p s) (p + j) = xor (apar gp s j) (apar gp t p)
  | .leaf, p, s, j, h, _ => by
      obtain rfl : p = 0
proof:
:= by simpa using h
      simp
  | .node e f, p, s, j, h, hj => by
      simp only [graft_node, apar_node]
      exact Forest.aparF_graftF_inner f p s j h hj

name: Operad.Forest.aparF_graftF_inner
statement:
theorem _root_.Operad.Forest.aparF_graftF_inner : ∀ {k : ℕ} (f : Forest E k) (p : ℕ)
    (s : Tree E) (j : ℕ), p < f.arityF → j < s.arity →
    Forest.aparF gp (f.graftF p s) (p + j) = xor (apar gp s j) (Forest.aparF gp f p)
  | _, .nil, _, _, _, h, _ => by simp at h
  | _, .cons t f, p, s, j, h, hj => by
      simp only [arityF_cons] at h
      by_cases hlt : p < t.arity
      · have harity
proof:
:= arity_graft t p s hlt
        rw [graftF_cons_of_lt s hlt, aparF_cons_of_lt gp _ _ (by omega),
          apar_graft_inner t p s j hlt hj, aparF_cons_of_lt gp _ _ hlt, Bool.xor_assoc]
      · rw [graftF_cons_of_ge s (by omega), aparF_cons_of_ge gp _ _ (by omega),
          aparF_cons_of_ge gp _ _ (by omega), show p + j - t.arity = p - t.arity + j by omega,
          Forest.aparF_graftF_inner f (p - t.arity) s j (by omega) hj]

name: Operad.Tree.apar_graft_before
statement:
theorem apar_graft_before : ∀ (t : Tree E) (p : ℕ) (s : Tree E) (q : ℕ), q < p →
    p < t.arity → apar gp (t.graft p s) q = xor (apar gp t q) (tpar gp s)
  | .leaf, p, s, q, hq, h => by
      have : p = 0
proof:
:= by simpa using h
      omega
  | .node e f, p, s, q, hq, h => by
      simp only [graft_node, apar_node]
      exact Forest.aparF_graftF_before f p s q hq h

name: Operad.Forest.aparF_graftF_before
statement:
theorem _root_.Operad.Forest.aparF_graftF_before : ∀ {k : ℕ} (f : Forest E k) (p : ℕ)
    (s : Tree E) (q : ℕ), q < p → p < f.arityF →
    Forest.aparF gp (f.graftF p s) q = xor (Forest.aparF gp f q) (tpar gp s)
  | _, .nil, _, _, _, _, h => by simp at h
  | _, .cons t f, p, s, q, hq, h => by
      simp only [arityF_cons] at h
      by_cases hlt : p < t.arity
      · have harity
proof:
:= arity_graft t p s hlt
        rw [graftF_cons_of_lt s hlt, aparF_cons_of_lt gp _ _ (by omega),
          apar_graft_before t p s q hq hlt, aparF_cons_of_lt gp _ _ (by omega)]
        cases apar gp t q <;> cases tpar gp s <;> cases Forest.tparF gp f <;> rfl
      · rw [graftF_cons_of_ge s (by omega)]
        by_cases hqa : q < t.arity
        · rw [aparF_cons_of_lt gp _ _ hqa, aparF_cons_of_lt gp _ _ hqa,
            Forest.tparF_graftF gp f (p - t.arity) s (by omega), Bool.xor_assoc]
        · rw [aparF_cons_of_ge gp _ _ (by omega), aparF_cons_of_ge gp _ _ (by omega),
            Forest.aparF_graftF_before f (p - t.arity) s (q - t.arity) (by omega) (by omega)]

name: Operad.Tree.apar_graft_after
statement:
theorem apar_graft_after : ∀ (t : Tree E) (p : ℕ) (s : Tree E) (q : ℕ), p < q →
    q < t.arity → apar gp (t.graft p s) (q + s.arity - 1) = apar gp t q
  | .leaf, p, s, q, hpq, hq => by
      have : q = 0
proof:
:= by simpa using hq
      omega
  | .node e f, p, s, q, hpq, hq => by
      simp only [graft_node, apar_node]
      exact Forest.aparF_graftF_after f p s q hpq hq

name: Operad.Forest.aparF_graftF_after
statement:
theorem _root_.Operad.Forest.aparF_graftF_after : ∀ {k : ℕ} (f : Forest E k) (p : ℕ)
    (s : Tree E) (q : ℕ), p < q → q < f.arityF →
    Forest.aparF gp (f.graftF p s) (q + s.arity - 1) = Forest.aparF gp f q
  | _, .nil, _, _, _, _, h => by simp at h
  | _, .cons t f, p, s, q, hpq, h => by
      simp only [arityF_cons] at h
      by_cases hlt : p < t.arity
      · have harity
proof:
:= arity_graft t p s hlt
        rw [graftF_cons_of_lt s hlt]
        by_cases hqa : q < t.arity
        · rw [aparF_cons_of_lt gp _ _ (by omega), apar_graft_after t p s q hpq hqa,
            aparF_cons_of_lt gp _ _ hqa]
        · rw [aparF_cons_of_ge gp _ _ (by omega), aparF_cons_of_ge gp _ _ (by omega)]
          congr 1
          omega
      · rw [graftF_cons_of_ge s (by omega), aparF_cons_of_ge gp _ _ (by omega),
          aparF_cons_of_ge gp _ _ (by omega),
          show q + s.arity - 1 - t.arity = q - t.arity + s.arity - 1 by omega,
          Forest.aparF_graftF_after f (p - t.arity) s (q - t.arity) (by omega) (by omega)]

name: Operad.Tree.SgnData.map_ord
statement: @[simp] lemma map_ord (e : A ≃ B) (x : SgnData A) : (map e x).ord = LinOrd.map e x.ord

name: Operad.Tree.SgnData.map_aft
statement: @[simp] lemma map_aft (e : A ≃ B) (x : SgnData A) (b : B) : (map e x).aft b = x.aft (e.symm b)

:=
  rfl

name: Operad.Tree.SgnData.map_tot
