@[simp] lemma comp_dat (i : A) (z : SgnBas δ' A) (z' : SgnBas δ' B) :
    (SetOperad.comp i z z').dat = SgnData.comp i z.dat z'.dat
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.FreeGr.SBVal.liftB_std
statement:
lemma liftB_std {k : ℕ} (e : T k) :
    v.liftB.app (Fin k) (Reg.std (corolla e))
      = SgnBas.mk (v.sg k e) (v.tree k e) ((treeSgn gp).app _ (Reg.std (corolla e)))
          (by rw [v.tot_eq, treeSgn_tot])
proof:
:= by
  rw [liftB, Reg.lift_std]
  exact TreeOfArity.lift_corolla (S := SetOperad.toNSSet (SgnBas (treeSgn gp'))) _ e

name: Operad.FreeGr.SBVal.projDat_liftB
statement: lemma projDat_liftB : (SgnBas.projDat (treeSgn gp')).comp v.liftB = treeSgn gp
proof:
:=
  FreeReg.regHom_ext fun k e => by
    show (v.liftB.app _ (Reg.std (corolla e))).dat = _
    rw [liftB_std]
    rfl

name: Operad.FreeGr.SBVal.dat_liftB
statement:
lemma dat_liftB {A : Type} [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] (x : Reg (TreeOfArity T) A) :
    (v.liftB.app A x).dat = (treeSgn gp).app A x
proof:
:=
  congrArg (fun φ : SetOperadHom _ SgnD => φ.app A x) v.projDat_liftB

name: Operad.FreeGr.SBVal.proj_toSO_liftB
statement:
lemma proj_toSO_liftB :
    (SgnOp.proj R (SgnLin R (treeSgn gp'))).comp ((SgnBas.toSO (treeSgn gp') R).comp v.liftB)
      = treeSgn gp
proof:
:=
  SetOperadHom.ext fun _ _ _ x => v.dat_liftB x

name: Operad.FreeGr.SBVal.hom_bas
statement:
lemma hom_bas {A : Type} [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] (x : Reg (TreeOfArity T) A) :
    (v.hom R).app A (SgnLin.bas _ R x)
      = σ R (v.liftB.app A x).sg • SgnLin.bas (treeSgn gp') R (v.liftB.app A x).op
proof:
:=
  (SgnLin.ofSOApp_single _ x 1).trans (one_smul R _)

name: Operad.FreeGr.SBVal.hom_gen
statement:
lemma hom_gen {k : ℕ} (e : T k) :
    (v.hom R).app (Fin k) (gen e) = σ R (v.sg k e) • SgnLin.bas (treeSgn gp') R (v.tree k e)
proof:
:= by
  show (v.hom R).app (Fin k) (SgnLin.bas _ R (Reg.std (corolla e))) = _
  rw [hom_bas, liftB_std]
  rfl

name: Operad.FreeGr.SBVal.eq_hom
proof:
:=
  FreeGr.hom_ext fun k e => by rw [h, hom_gen]

name: Operad.FreeGr.SBVal.sbm_ψ_std
statement:
lemma sbm_ψ_std {k : ℕ} (e : T k) :
    (v.sbm R).ψ.app (Fin k) (Reg.std (corolla e)) = v.tree k e
proof:
:= by
  show (v.liftB.app (Fin k) (Reg.std (corolla e))).op = v.tree k e
  rw [liftB_std]
  rfl

name: Operad.neg_one_pow_add_two_mul
statement: private lemma neg_one_pow_add_two_mul (a b : ℕ) : ((-1 : R)) ^ (a + 2 * b) = (-1) ^ a
proof:
:= by
  rw [pow_add, pow_mul]
  norm_num

name: Operad.neg_one_pow_eq
statement:
private lemma neg_one_pow_eq {a b : ℕ} (c : ℕ) (h : a = b + 2 * c) :
    ((-1 : R)) ^ a = (-1) ^ b
proof:
:= by
  subst h; exact neg_one_pow_add_two_mul b c

name: Operad.sstar_sstar_left
statement:
lemma sstar_sstar_left {j k l : ℕ} (α : P (j + 1)) (β : P (k + 1)) (γ : P (l + 1)) :
    sstar (R := R) (sstar (R := R) α β) γ
      = ∑ i' : Fin (j + k + 1), ∑ i : Fin (j + 1),
          ((-1 : R) ^ ((i' : ℕ) * l + (i : ℕ) * k))
            • compFin (R := R) i' (compFin (R := R) i α β) γ
proof:
:= by
  rw [sstar_def]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i' _ => ?_
  have hinner : compFin (R := R) i' (sstar (R := R) α β) γ
      = ∑ i : Fin (j + 1), ((-1 : R) ^ ((i : ℕ) * k))
          • compFin (R := R) i' (compFin (R := R) i α β) γ := by
    rw [sstar_def]
    refine (map_sum (compFinLeftHom (R := R) i' γ) _ _).trans ?_
    exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => compFin_smul_left i' _ _ γ
  rw [hinner]
  refine (map_sum (LinearMap.lsmul R (P (j + k + l + 1))
    ((-1 : R) ^ ((i' : ℕ) * l))) _ _).trans ?_
  exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => by rw [LinearMap.lsmul_apply, pow_add, mul_smul]; rfl

name: Operad.sstar_sstar_right
statement:
lemma sstar_sstar_right {j k l : ℕ} (α : P (j + 1)) (β : P (k + 1)) (γ : P (l + 1)) :
    sstar (R := R) α (sstar (R := R) β γ)
      = ∑ i : Fin (j + 1), ∑ i'' : Fin (k + 1),
          ((-1 : R) ^ ((i : ℕ) * (k + l) + (i'' : ℕ) * l))
            • compFin (R := R) i α (compFin (R := R) i'' β γ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [sstar_def]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
  have hinner : compFin (R := R) i α (sstar (R := R) β γ)
      = ∑ i'' : Fin (k + 1), ((-1 : R) ^ ((i'' : ℕ) * l))
          • compFin (R := R) i α (compFin (R := R) i'' β γ) := by
    rw [sstar_def]
    refine (map_sum (compFinRightHom (R := R) i α) _ _).trans ?_
    exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i'' _ => compFin_smul_right i _ α _
  rw [hinner]
  refine (map_sum (LinearMap.lsmul R (P (j + (k + l) + 1))
    ((-1 : R) ^ ((i : ℕ) * (k + l)))) _ _).trans ?_
  exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i'' _ => by rw [LinearMap.lsmul_apply, pow_add, mul_smul]; rfl

name: Operad.sum_nested_s
statement:
lemma sum_nested_s {j k l : ℕ} (α : P (j + 1)) (β : P (k + 1)) (γ : P (l + 1))
    (i : Fin (j + 1)) :
    reindex R P (by omega)
        (∑ i' ∈ nested (k := k) i, ((-1 : R) ^ ((i' : ℕ) * l + (i : ℕ) * k))
          • compFin (R := R) i' (compFin (R := R) i α β) γ)
      = ∑ i'' : Fin (k + 1), ((-1 : R) ^ ((i : ℕ) * (k + l) + (i'' : ℕ) * l))
          • compFin (R := R) i α (compFin (R := R) i'' β γ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [nested, Finset.sum_map, map_sum]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i'' _ => ?_
  rw [map_smul]
  congr 1
  · exact congrArg _ (by simp only [nestedEmb, Function.Embedding.coeFn_mk]; ring)
  · exact compFin_assoc_seq i i'' α β γ

name: Operad.sstar_sstar_left_split
statement:
lemma sstar_sstar_left_split {j k l : ℕ} (α : P (j + 1)) (β : P (k + 1)) (γ : P (l + 1)) :
    sstar (R := R) (sstar (R := R) α β) γ
      = reindex R P (by omega) (sstar (R := R) α (sstar (R := R) β γ))
        + disjointPartS (R := R) α β γ
proof:
:= by
  have key : ∀ i : Fin (j + 1),
      (∑ i' : Fin (j + k + 1), ((-1 : R) ^ ((i' : ℕ) * l + (i : ℕ) * k))
          • compFin (R := R) i' (compFin (R := R) i α β) γ)
        = reindex R P (by omega)
            (∑ i'' : Fin (k + 1), ((-1 : R) ^ ((i : ℕ) * (k + l) + (i'' : ℕ) * l))
              • compFin (R := R) i α (compFin (R := R) i'' β γ))
          + ∑ i' ∈ (nested (k := k) i)ᶜ, ((-1 : R) ^ ((i' : ℕ) * l + (i : ℕ) * k))
              • compFin (R := R) i' (compFin (R := R) i α β) γ := by
    intro i
    rw [← Finset.sum_add_sum_compl (nested (k := k) i)]
    congr 1
    rw [← sum_nested_s α β γ i, reindex_reindex, reindex_self]
  rw [sstar_sstar_left, Finset.sum_comm, disjointPartS,
    Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => key i, Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  congr 1
  rw [sstar_sstar_right]
  exact (map_sum _ _ _).symm

name: Operad.sum_before_eq_s
statement:
lemma sum_before_eq_s {j k l : ℕ} (α : P (j + 1)) (β : P (k + 1)) (γ : P (l + 1)) :
    ((∑ i : Fin (j + 1), ∑ i' ∈ before (k := k) i,
        ((-1 : R) ^ ((i' : ℕ) * l + (i : ℕ) * k))
          • compFin (R := R) i' (compFin (R := R) i α β) γ) : P (j + k + l + 1))
      = ∑ s : Fin (j + 1), ∑ t ∈ after (k := l) s,
          ((-1 : R) ^ (k * l + (t : ℕ) * k + (s : ℕ) * l))
            • reindex R P (by omega) (compFin (R := R) t (compFin (R := R) s α γ) β)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Finset.sum_sigma', Finset.sum_sigma']
  refine Finset.sum_nbij'
    (fun x => ⟨⟨min (x.2 : ℕ) j, by omega⟩, ⟨(x.1 : ℕ) + l, by have := x.1.isLt; omega⟩⟩)
    (fun y => ⟨⟨(y.2 : ℕ) - l, by have := y.2.isLt; omega⟩,
               ⟨(y.1 : ℕ), by have := y.1.isLt; omega⟩⟩)
    ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_
  · rintro ⟨i, i'⟩ hx
    simp only [Finset.mem_sigma, Finset.mem_univ, mem_before, true_and] at hx
    have := i.isLt
    simp only [Finset.mem_sigma, Finset.mem_univ, mem_after, true_and]
    show min (i' : ℕ) j + l < (i : ℕ) + l
    omega
  · rintro ⟨s, t⟩ hy
    simp only [Finset.mem_sigma, Finset.mem_univ, mem_after, true_and] at hy
    have := s.isLt
    simp only [Finset.mem_sigma, Finset.mem_univ, mem_before, true_and]
    show (s : ℕ) < (t : ℕ) - l
    omega
  · rintro ⟨i, i'⟩ hx
    simp only [Finset.mem_sigma, Finset.mem_univ, mem_before, true_and] at hx
    have := i.isLt
    simp only [Sigma.mk.injEq, heq_iff_eq, Fin.ext_iff]
    omega
  · rintro ⟨s, t⟩ hy
    simp only [Finset.mem_sigma, Finset.mem_univ, mem_after, true_and] at hy
    have := s.isLt
    simp only [Sigma.mk.injEq, heq_iff_eq, Fin.ext_iff]
    omega
  · rintro ⟨i, i'⟩ hx
    simp only [Finset.mem_sigma, Finset.mem_univ, mem_before, true_and] at hx
    have hij := i.isLt
    have hmin : min (i' : ℕ) j = (i' : ℕ) := by omega
    dsimp only
    congr 1
    · simp only [hmin]
      refine (neg_one_pow_eq (R := R) (k * l) ?_).symm
      ring
    · have key : compFin (R := R) (⟨(i : ℕ) + l, by omega⟩ : Fin (j + l + 1))
            (compFin (R := R) (⟨min (i' : ℕ) j, by omega⟩ : Fin (j + 1)) α γ) β
          = reindex R P (by omega)
              (compFin (R := R) (⟨min (i' : ℕ) j, by omega⟩ : Fin (j + k + 1))
                (compFin (R := R) i α β) γ) :=
        compFin_assoc_par _ _ (by show min (i' : ℕ) j < (i : ℕ); omega) α γ β
      rw [key, show (⟨min (i' : ℕ) j, by omega⟩ : Fin (j + k + 1)) = i' from Fin.ext hmin,
        reindex_reindex]
      exact (reindex_self (R := R) (P := P) _ _).symm

name: Operad.sum_after_eq_s
statement:
lemma sum_after_eq_s {j k l : ℕ} (α : P (j + 1)) (β : P (k + 1)) (γ : P (l + 1)) :
    ((∑ i : Fin (j + 1), ∑ i' ∈ after (k := k) i,
        ((-1 : R) ^ ((i' : ℕ) * l + (i : ℕ) * k))
          • compFin (R := R) i' (compFin (R := R) i α β) γ) : P (j + k + l + 1))
      = ∑ s : Fin (j + 1), ∑ t ∈ before (k := l) s,
          ((-1 : R) ^ (k * l + (t : ℕ) * k + (s : ℕ) * l))
            • reindex R P (by omega) (compFin (R := R) t (compFin (R := R) s α γ) β)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Finset.sum_sigma', Finset.sum_sigma']
  refine Finset.sum_nbij'
    (fun x => ⟨⟨(x.2 : ℕ) - k, by have := x.2.isLt; omega⟩,
               ⟨(x.1 : ℕ), by have := x.1.isLt; omega⟩⟩)
    (fun y => ⟨⟨min (y.2 : ℕ) j, by omega⟩,
               ⟨(y.1 : ℕ) + k, by have := y.1.isLt; omega⟩⟩)
    ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_
  · rintro ⟨i, i'⟩ hx
    simp only [Finset.mem_sigma, Finset.mem_univ, mem_after, true_and] at hx
    simp only [Finset.mem_sigma, Finset.mem_univ, mem_before, true_and]
    show (i : ℕ) < (i' : ℕ) - k
    omega
  · rintro ⟨s, t⟩ hy
    simp only [Finset.mem_sigma, Finset.mem_univ, mem_before, true_and] at hy
    have := s.isLt
    simp only [Finset.mem_sigma, Finset.mem_univ, mem_after, true_and]
    show min (t : ℕ) j + k < (s : ℕ) + k
    omega
  · rintro ⟨i, i'⟩ hx
    simp only [Finset.mem_sigma, Finset.mem_univ, mem_after, true_and] at hx
    have := i.isLt
    simp only [Sigma.mk.injEq, heq_iff_eq, Fin.ext_iff]
    omega
  · rintro ⟨s, t⟩ hy
    simp only [Finset.mem_sigma, Finset.mem_univ, mem_before, true_and] at hy
    have := s.isLt
    simp only [Sigma.mk.injEq, heq_iff_eq, Fin.ext_iff]
    omega
  · rintro ⟨i, i'⟩ hx
    simp only [Finset.mem_sigma, Finset.mem_univ, mem_after, true_and] at hx
    have hi' := i'.isLt
    dsimp only
    congr 1
    · refine congrArg (fun e => ((-1 : R)) ^ e) ?_
      obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ : ∃ m, (i' : ℕ) = m + k := ⟨(i' : ℕ) - k, by omega⟩
      rw [hm]
      simp only [Nat.add_sub_cancel]
      ring
    · have h := compFin_assoc_par (R := R) i (⟨(i' : ℕ) - k, by omega⟩ : Fin (j + 1))
        (by show (i : ℕ) < (i' : ℕ) - k; omega) α β γ
      dsimp only at h
      conv_lhs =>
        rw [show i' = (⟨(i' : ℕ) - k + k, by omega⟩ : Fin (j + k + 1)) from
          Fin.ext (show (i' : ℕ) = (i' : ℕ) - k + k by omega)]
      exact h

name: Operad.smul_sum_comm
statement:
private lemma smul_sum_comm {M : Type*} [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] {ι : Type w}
    (s : Finset ι) (c : R) (f : ι → M) : c • ∑ x ∈ s, f x = ∑ x ∈ s, c • f x
proof:
:=
  map_sum (LinearMap.lsmul R M c) f s

name: Operad.disjointPartS_symm
statement:
theorem disjointPartS_symm {j k l : ℕ} (α : P (j + 1)) (β : P (k + 1)) (γ : P (l + 1)) :
    disjointPartS (R := R) α β γ
      = ((-1 : R) ^ (k * l)) • reindex R P (by omega) (disjointPartS (R := R) α γ β)
proof:
:= by
  have hR : ((((-1 : R) ^ (k * l)) • reindex R P (show j + l + k + 1 = j + k + l + 1 by omega)
        (disjointPartS (R := R) α γ β)) : P (j + k + l + 1))
      = ∑ s : Fin (j + 1), ∑ t ∈ (nested (k := l) s)ᶜ,
          ((-1 : R) ^ (k * l + (t : ℕ) * k + (s : ℕ) * l))
            • reindex R P (show j + l + k + 1 = j + k + l + 1 by omega)
              (compFin (R := R) t (compFin (R := R) s α γ) β) := by
    unfold disjointPartS
    rw [map_sum]
    refine (smul_sum_comm _ _ _).trans ?_
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun s _ => ?_
    rw [map_sum]
    refine (smul_sum_comm _ _ _).trans ?_
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun t _ => ?_
    rw [show (reindex R P (show j + l + k + 1 = j + k + l + 1 by omega))
          (((-1 : R) ^ ((t : ℕ) * k + (s : ℕ) * l))
            • compFin (R := R) t (compFin (R := R) s α γ) β)
        = ((-1 : R) ^ ((t : ℕ) * k + (s : ℕ) * l))
          • (reindex R P (show j + l + k + 1 = j + k + l + 1 by omega))
            (compFin (R := R) t (compFin (R := R) s α γ) β) from map_smul _ _ _,
      ← mul_smul, ← pow_add, ← Nat.add_assoc]
  rw [hR]
  unfold disjointPartS
  rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => sum_compl_nested i _, Finset.sum_add_distrib,
    sum_before_eq_s α β γ, sum_after_eq_s α β γ, ← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun s _ => ?_
  rw [sum_compl_nested s _]
  exact add_comm _ _

name: Operad.sstar_assoc_symm
statement:
theorem sstar_assoc_symm {j k l : ℕ} (α : P (j + 1)) (β : P (k + 1)) (γ : P (l + 1)) :
    sstar (R := R) (sstar (R := R) α β) γ
        - reindex R P (by omega) (sstar (R := R) α (sstar (R := R) β γ))
      = ((-1 : R) ^ (k * l))
          • (reindex R P (by omega) (sstar (R := R) (sstar (R := R) α γ) β)
            - reindex R P (by omega) (sstar (R := R) α (sstar (R := R) γ β)))
proof:
:= by
  rw [sstar_sstar_left_split, sstar_sstar_left_split α γ β, map_add, disjointPartS_symm α β γ]
  simp only [reindex_reindex, add_sub_cancel_left]

name: Operad.disjointPartS_self_one
statement:
theorem disjointPartS_self_one {j : ℕ} (α : P (j + 1)) (T : P (1 + 1)) :
    disjointPartS (R := R) α T T = 0
proof:
:= by
  unfold disjointPartS
  rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => sum_compl_nested i _, Finset.sum_add_distrib,
    sum_before_eq_s α T T, ← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  refine Finset.sum_eq_zero fun s _ => ?_
  rw [← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  refine Finset.sum_eq_zero fun t _ => ?_
  erw [reindex_self, ← add_smul]
  convert zero_smul R _
  rw [pow_add, pow_add]
  simp [mul_one, one_mul]
  ring_nf

name: Operad.sstar_sstar_self_one
statement:
theorem sstar_sstar_self_one {j : ℕ} (α : P (j + 1)) (T : P (1 + 1)) :
    sstar (R := R) (sstar (R := R) α T) T
      = reindex R P (by omega) (sstar (R := R) α (sstar (R := R) T T))
proof:
:= by
  rw [sstar_sstar_left_split, disjointPartS_self_one, add_zero]

name: Operad.End.cfTuple_of_lt
statement:
lemma cfTuple_of_lt {m n : ℕ} (i : Fin m) (β : End R V n) (v : Fin (m - 1 + n) → V)
    (s : Fin m) (h : (s : ℕ) < i) :
    cfTuple i β v s = v ⟨s, by have
proof:
:= s.isLt; have := i.isLt; omega⟩ := by
  rw [cfTuple, dif_pos h]

name: Operad.End.cfTuple_of_eq
statement:
lemma cfTuple_of_eq {m n : ℕ} (i : Fin m) (β : End R V n) (v : Fin (m - 1 + n) → V)
    (s : Fin m) (h : (s : ℕ) = i) :
    cfTuple i β v s = β (fun t => v ⟨i + t, by have := t.isLt; have := i.isLt; omega⟩)
proof:
:= by
  rw [cfTuple, dif_neg (by omega), dif_pos h]

name: Operad.End.cfTuple_of_gt
statement:
lemma cfTuple_of_gt {m n : ℕ} (i : Fin m) (β : End R V n) (v : Fin (m - 1 + n) → V)
    (s : Fin m) (h : (i : ℕ) < s) :
    cfTuple i β v s = v ⟨s + n - 1, by have
proof:
:= s.isLt; have := i.isLt; omega⟩ := by
  rw [cfTuple, dif_neg (by omega), dif_neg (by omega)]

name: Operad.End.compFin_apply
statement:
lemma compFin_apply {m n : ℕ} (i : Fin m) (α : End R V m) (β : End R V n)
    (v : Fin (m - 1 + n) → V) : compFin (R := R) i α β v = α (cfTuple i β v)
proof:
:= by
  unfold compFin
  rw [reindex_apply, operad_comp_apply, reindex_apply]
  rfl

name: Operad.End.twist_apply
statement:
@[simp] lemma twist_apply (q i : ℕ) {n : ℕ} (α : End R V n) (v : Fin n → V) :
    twist ε q i α v = α (fun t => twistFn ε q i t (v t))
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.End.twistFn_of_lt
statement:
lemma twistFn_of_lt (q i : ℕ) {n : ℕ} (t : Fin n) (h : (t : ℕ) < i) :
    twistFn ε q i t = ε ^ q
proof: := if_pos h

name: Operad.End.twistFn_of_ge
statement:
lemma twistFn_of_ge (q i : ℕ) {n : ℕ} (t : Fin n) (h : i ≤ (t : ℕ)) :
    twistFn ε q i t = LinearMap.id
proof: := if_neg (by omega)

name: Operad.End.twist_twist
statement:
lemma twist_twist (q r i : ℕ) {n : ℕ} (α : End R V n) :
    twist ε r i (twist ε q i α) = twist ε (q + r) i α
proof:
:= by
  ext v
  simp only [twist_apply]
  congr 1
  funext t
  by_cases h : (t : ℕ) < i
  · simp only [twistFn_of_lt ε _ _ t h, pow_add, Module.End.mul_apply]
  · simp only [twistFn_of_ge ε _ _ t (not_lt.mp h), LinearMap.id_apply]

name: Operad.End.twist_comm
statement:
lemma twist_comm (q r i i' : ℕ) {n : ℕ} (α : End R V n) :
    twist ε r i' (twist ε q i α) = twist ε q i (twist ε r i' α)
proof:
:= by
  ext v
  simp only [twist_apply]
  congr 1
  funext t
  simp only [twistFn]
  split_ifs <;> simp only [← Module.End.mul_apply, ← pow_add, add_comm, ← Module.End.one_eq_id,
    one_mul, mul_one]

name: Operad.End.reindex_twist
statement:
lemma reindex_twist {m m' : ℕ} (h : m = m') (q i : ℕ) (α : End R V m) :
    reindex R (End R V) h (twist ε q i α) = twist ε q i (reindex R (End R V) h α)
proof:
:= by
  subst h
  rfl

name: Operad.End.compFin_twist_left
statement:
lemma compFin_twist_left (q i' : ℕ) {m n : ℕ} (i : Fin m) (hi : i' ≤ (i : ℕ)) (α : End R V m)
    (β : End R V n) :
    compFin (R := R) i (twist ε q i' α) β = twist ε q i' (compFin (R := R) i α β)
proof:
:= by
  ext v
  rw [compFin_apply, twist_apply, twist_apply, compFin_apply]
  congr 1
  funext s
  have hs := s.isLt
  have hm := i.isLt
  rcases lt_trichotomy (s : ℕ) i with h | h | h
  · rw [cfTuple_of_lt i β _ s h, cfTuple_of_lt i β _ s h]
    simp only [twistFn]
  · rw [cfTuple_of_eq i β _ s h, cfTuple_of_eq i β _ s h,
      twistFn_of_ge ε _ _ s (by omega), LinearMap.id_apply]
    congr 1
    funext t
    rw [twistFn_of_ge ε _ _ _ (by simp; omega), LinearMap.id_apply]
  · rw [cfTuple_of_gt i β _ s h, cfTuple_of_gt i β _ s h, twistFn_of_ge ε _ _ s (by omega),
      twistFn_of_ge ε _ _ _ (by simp; omega)]

name: Operad.End.twist_compFin_nested
statement:
lemma twist_compFin_nested (r : ℕ) {m n : ℕ} (i : Fin m) (j : ℕ) (hj : j ≤ n) (α : End R V m)
    (β : End R V n) :
    twist ε r (i + j) (compFin (R := R) i α β)
      = compFin (R := R) i (twist ε r i α) (twist ε r j β)
proof:
:= by
  ext v
  rw [compFin_apply, twist_apply, twist_apply, compFin_apply]
  congr 1
  funext s
  have hs := s.isLt
  have hm := i.isLt
  rcases lt_trichotomy (s : ℕ) i with h | h | h
  · rw [cfTuple_of_lt i β _ s h, cfTuple_of_lt i _ _ s h, twistFn_of_lt ε _ _ s h,
      twistFn_of_lt ε _ _ _ (by simp; omega)]
  · rw [cfTuple_of_eq i β _ s h, cfTuple_of_eq i _ _ s h, twistFn_of_ge ε _ _ s (by omega),
      LinearMap.id_apply, twist_apply]
    congr 1
    funext t
    simp only [twistFn]
    split_ifs <;> first | rfl | omega
  · rw [cfTuple_of_gt i β _ s h, cfTuple_of_gt i _ _ s h, twistFn_of_ge ε _ _ s (by omega),
      twistFn_of_ge ε _ _ _ (by simp; omega)]

name: Operad.End.pow_pow_apply
statement: lemma pow_pow_apply (hε : ∀ x, ε (ε x) = x) (r : ℕ) (x : V) : (ε ^ r) ((ε ^ r) x) = x
proof:
:= by
  have h2 : ε * ε = 1 := LinearMap.ext hε
  rw [← Module.End.mul_apply, ← (Commute.refl ε).mul_pow, h2, one_pow, Module.End.one_apply]

name: Operad.End.twist_compFin_par
statement:
lemma twist_compFin_par (hε : ∀ x, ε (ε x) = x) (r : ℕ) {m n : ℕ} (i : Fin m) (i' : ℕ)
    (hii' : (i : ℕ) < i') (α : End R V m) (β : End R V n) :
    twist ε r (i' + n - 1) (compFin (R := R) i α β)
      = compFin (R := R) i (twist ε r i' α)
          ((ε ^ r).compMultilinearMap (twist ε r n β))
proof:
:= by
  ext v
  rw [compFin_apply, twist_apply, twist_apply, compFin_apply]
  congr 1
  funext s
  have hs := s.isLt
  have hm := i.isLt
  rcases lt_trichotomy (s : ℕ) i with h | h | h
  · rw [cfTuple_of_lt i β _ s h, cfTuple_of_lt i _ _ s h, twistFn_of_lt ε _ _ s (by omega),
      twistFn_of_lt ε _ _ _ (by simp; omega)]
  · rw [cfTuple_of_eq i β _ s h, cfTuple_of_eq i _ _ s h, twistFn_of_lt ε _ _ s (by omega),
      LinearMap.compMultilinearMap_apply, pow_pow_apply hε, twist_apply]
    congr 1
    funext t
    have ht := t.isLt
    rw [twistFn_of_lt ε _ _ _ (by simp; omega), twistFn_of_lt ε _ _ t ht]
  · rw [cfTuple_of_gt i β _ s h, cfTuple_of_gt i _ _ s h]
    simp only [twistFn]
    split_ifs <;> first | rfl | omega

name: Operad.End.IsHomog.conj
proof:
:= by
  have key : ∀ v : Fin n → V, β (fun t => (ε ^ r) (v t)) = (-1 : R) ^ (q * r) • (ε ^ r) (β v) := by
    induction r with
    | zero => intro v; simp
    | succ r ih =>
      intro v
      have h1 := hβ (fun t => (ε ^ r) (v t))
      simp only [pow_succ', Module.End.mul_apply] at h1 ⊢
      rw [h1, ih, map_smul, smul_smul, mul_add, mul_one, pow_add, mul_comm]
  ext v
  simp only [LinearMap.compMultilinearMap_apply, twist_apply, MultilinearMap.smul_apply]
  rw [show (fun t => twistFn ε r n t (v t)) = fun t => (ε ^ r) (v t) from
    funext fun t => by rw [twistFn_of_lt ε _ _ t t.isLt], key, map_smul, pow_pow_apply hε]

name: Operad.End.kcompFin_assoc_seq
statement:
theorem kcompFin_assoc_seq (q r : ℕ) {m n p : ℕ} (i : Fin m) (j : Fin n) (α : End R V m)
    (β : End R V n) (γ : End R V p) :
    reindex R (End R V) (by have := i.isLt; have := j.isLt; omega)
        (kcompFin ε r
          (⟨(i : ℕ) + (j : ℕ), by have := i.isLt; have := j.isLt; omega⟩ : Fin (m - 1 + n))
          (kcompFin ε q i α β) γ)
      = kcompFin ε (q + r) i α (kcompFin ε r j β γ)
proof:
:= by
  unfold kcompFin
  rw [show twist ε r ((i : ℕ) + (j : ℕ)) (compFin (R := R) i (twist ε q i α) β)
      = compFin (R := R) i (twist ε r i (twist ε q i α)) (twist ε r j β) from
    twist_compFin_nested ε r i j j.isLt.le _ β, compFin_assoc_seq, twist_twist]

name: Operad.End.kcompFin_assoc_par
statement:
theorem kcompFin_assoc_par (hε : ∀ x, ε (ε x) = x) (q r : ℕ) {m n p : ℕ} (i i' : Fin m)
    (hlt : (i : ℕ) < (i' : ℕ)) (α : End R V m) {β : End R V n} (hβ : IsHomog ε q β)
    (γ : End R V p) :
    kcompFin ε r (⟨(i' : ℕ) + n - 1, by have := i'.isLt; omega⟩ : Fin (m - 1 + n))
        (kcompFin ε q i α β) γ
      = (-1 : R) ^ (q * r) • reindex R (End R V) (by have := i'.isLt; omega)
          (kcompFin ε q (⟨(i : ℕ), by have := i'.isLt; omega⟩ : Fin (m - 1 + p))
            (kcompFin ε r i' α γ) β)
proof:
:= by
  unfold kcompFin
  rw [twist_compFin_par ε hε r i i' hlt, hβ.conj hε, compFin_smul_right, compFin_smul_left,
    compFin_assoc_par i i' hlt, ← compFin_twist_left ε q (i : ℕ) i' hlt.le (twist ε r i' α) γ,
    twist_comm]

name: Operad.End.kcompFin_sum_left
statement:
lemma kcompFin_sum_left (q : ℕ) {m n : ℕ} {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι) (i : Fin m)
    (f : ι → End R V m) (β : End R V n) :
    kcompFin ε q i (∑ x ∈ s, f x) β = ∑ x ∈ s, kcompFin ε q i (f x) β
proof:
:= by
  unfold kcompFin
  rw [map_sum, compFin_sum_left]

name: Operad.End.kcompFin_sum_right
statement:
lemma kcompFin_sum_right (q : ℕ) {m n : ℕ} {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι) (i : Fin m)
    (α : End R V m) (g : ι → End R V n) :
    kcompFin ε q i α (∑ x ∈ s, g x) = ∑ x ∈ s, kcompFin ε q i α (g x)
proof:
:=
  compFin_sum_right _ _ _ _

name: Operad.End.kstar_kstar_left
statement:
lemma kstar_kstar_left (q r : ℕ) {j k l : ℕ} (α : End R V (j + 1)) (β : End R V (k + 1))
    (γ : End R V (l + 1)) :
    kstar ε r (kstar ε q α β) γ
      = ∑ i' : Fin (j + k + 1), ∑ i : Fin (j + 1), kcompFin ε r i' (kcompFin ε q i α β) γ
proof:
:= by
  unfold kstar
  exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i' _ => kcompFin_sum_left _ _ _ _ _

name: Operad.End.kstar_kstar_right
statement:
lemma kstar_kstar_right (q r : ℕ) {j k l : ℕ} (α : End R V (j + 1)) (β : End R V (k + 1))
    (γ : End R V (l + 1)) :
    kstar ε (q + r) α (kstar ε r β γ)
      = ∑ i : Fin (j + 1), ∑ i'' : Fin (k + 1),
          kcompFin ε (q + r) i α (kcompFin ε r i'' β γ)
proof:
:= by
  unfold kstar
  exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => kcompFin_sum_right _ _ _ _ _

name: Operad.End.sum_nested_k
statement:
lemma sum_nested_k (q r : ℕ) {j k l : ℕ} (α : End R V (j + 1)) (β : End R V (k + 1))
    (γ : End R V (l + 1)) (i : Fin (j + 1)) :
    reindex R (End R V) (by omega)
        (∑ i' ∈ nested (k := k) i, kcompFin ε r i' (kcompFin ε q i α β) γ)
      = ∑ i'' : Fin (k + 1), kcompFin ε (q + r) i α (kcompFin ε r i'' β γ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [nested, Finset.sum_map, map_sum]
  exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i'' _ => kcompFin_assoc_seq q r i i'' α β γ

name: Operad.End.kstar_kstar_left_split
statement:
lemma kstar_kstar_left_split (q r : ℕ) {j k l : ℕ} (α : End R V (j + 1)) (β : End R V (k + 1))
    (γ : End R V (l + 1)) :
    kstar ε r (kstar ε q α β) γ
      = reindex R (End R V) (by omega) (kstar ε (q + r) α (kstar ε r β γ))
        + kdisjointPart ε q r α β γ
proof:
:= by
  have key : ∀ i : Fin (j + 1),
      (∑ i' : Fin (j + k + 1), kcompFin ε r i' (kcompFin ε q i α β) γ)
        = reindex R (End R V) (by omega)
            (∑ i'' : Fin (k + 1), kcompFin ε (q + r) i α (kcompFin ε r i'' β γ))
          + ∑ i' ∈ (nested (k := k) i)ᶜ, kcompFin ε r i' (kcompFin ε q i α β) γ := by
    intro i
    rw [← Finset.sum_add_sum_compl (nested (k := k) i)]
    congr 1
    rw [← sum_nested_k q r α β γ i, reindex_reindex, reindex_self]
  rw [kstar_kstar_left, Finset.sum_comm, kdisjointPart,
    Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => key i, Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  congr 1
  rw [kstar_kstar_right]
  exact (map_sum _ _ _).symm

name: Operad.End.neg_one_pow_mul_self
statement: lemma neg_one_pow_mul_self (n : ℕ) : ((-1 : R) ^ n) * (-1 : R) ^ n = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [← pow_add, ← two_mul, pow_mul, neg_one_sq, one_pow]

name: Operad.End.kdisjointPart_eq
statement:
lemma kdisjointPart_eq (q r : ℕ) {j k l : ℕ} (α : End R V (j + 1)) (β : End R V (k + 1))
    (γ : End R V (l + 1)) :
    kdisjointPart ε q r α β γ = kbefore ε q r α β γ + kafter ε q r α β γ
proof:
:= by
  unfold kdisjointPart kbefore kafter
  rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => sum_compl_nested i _, Finset.sum_add_distrib]

name: Operad.End.sum_before_eq_k
statement:
lemma sum_before_eq_k (q r : ℕ) {j k l : ℕ} (α : End R V (j + 1)) (β : End R V (k + 1))
    {γ : End R V (l + 1)} (hγ : IsHomog ε r γ) :
    ((∑ i : Fin (j + 1), ∑ i' ∈ before (k := k) i,
        kcompFin ε r i' (kcompFin ε q i α β) γ) : End R V (j + k + l + 1))
      = ∑ s : Fin (j + 1), ∑ t ∈ after (k := l) s,
          (-1 : R) ^ (q * r) • reindex R (End R V) (by omega)
            (kcompFin ε q t (kcompFin ε r s α γ) β)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Finset.sum_sigma', Finset.sum_sigma']
  refine Finset.sum_nbij'
    (fun x => ⟨⟨min (x.2 : ℕ) j, by omega⟩, ⟨(x.1 : ℕ) + l, by have := x.1.isLt; omega⟩⟩)
    (fun y => ⟨⟨(y.2 : ℕ) - l, by have := y.2.isLt; omega⟩,
               ⟨(y.1 : ℕ), by have := y.1.isLt; omega⟩⟩)
    ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_
  · rintro ⟨i, i'⟩ hx
    simp only [Finset.mem_sigma, Finset.mem_univ, mem_before, true_and] at hx
    have := i.isLt
    simp only [Finset.mem_sigma, Finset.mem_univ, mem_after, true_and]
    show min (i' : ℕ) j + l < (i : ℕ) + l
    omega
  · rintro ⟨s, t⟩ hy
    simp only [Finset.mem_sigma, Finset.mem_univ, mem_after, true_and] at hy
    have := s.isLt
    simp only [Finset.mem_sigma, Finset.mem_univ, mem_before, true_and]
    show (s : ℕ) < (t : ℕ) - l
    omega
  · rintro ⟨i, i'⟩ hx
    simp only [Finset.mem_sigma, Finset.mem_univ, mem_before, true_and] at hx
    have := i.isLt
    simp only [Sigma.mk.injEq, heq_iff_eq, Fin.ext_iff]
    omega
  · rintro ⟨s, t⟩ hy
    simp only [Finset.mem_sigma, Finset.mem_univ, mem_after, true_and] at hy
    have := s.isLt
    simp only [Sigma.mk.injEq, heq_iff_eq, Fin.ext_iff]
    omega
  · rintro ⟨i, i'⟩ hx
    simp only [Finset.mem_sigma, Finset.mem_univ, mem_before, true_and] at hx
    have hij := i.isLt
    have hmin : min (i' : ℕ) j = (i' : ℕ) := by omega
    dsimp only
    have key : kcompFin ε q (⟨(i : ℕ) + l, by omega⟩ : Fin (j + l + 1))
          (kcompFin ε r (⟨min (i' : ℕ) j, by omega⟩ : Fin (j + 1)) α γ) β
        = (-1 : R) ^ (r * q) • reindex R (End R V) (by omega)
            (kcompFin ε r (⟨min (i' : ℕ) j, by omega⟩ : Fin (j + k + 1))
              (kcompFin ε q i α β) γ) :=
      kcompFin_assoc_par hε r q _ _ (by show min (i' : ℕ) j < (i : ℕ); omega) α hγ β
    rw [key, show (⟨min (i' : ℕ) j, by omega⟩ : Fin (j + k + 1)) = i' from Fin.ext hmin,
      map_smul, reindex_reindex, smul_smul, Nat.mul_comm r q, neg_one_pow_mul_self, one_smul]
    exact (reindex_self _ _).symm

name: Operad.End.sum_after_eq_k
statement:
lemma sum_after_eq_k (q r : ℕ) {j k l : ℕ} (α : End R V (j + 1)) {β : End R V (k + 1)}
    (hβ : IsHomog ε q β) (γ : End R V (l + 1)) :
    ((∑ i : Fin (j + 1), ∑ i' ∈ after (k := k) i,
        kcompFin ε r i' (kcompFin ε q i α β) γ) : End R V (j + k + l + 1))
      = ∑ s : Fin (j + 1), ∑ t ∈ before (k := l) s,
          (-1 : R) ^ (q * r) • reindex R (End R V) (by omega)
            (kcompFin ε q t (kcompFin ε r s α γ) β)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Finset.sum_sigma', Finset.sum_sigma']
  refine Finset.sum_nbij'
    (fun x => ⟨⟨(x.2 : ℕ) - k, by have := x.2.isLt; omega⟩,
               ⟨(x.1 : ℕ), by have := x.1.isLt; omega⟩⟩)
    (fun y => ⟨⟨min (y.2 : ℕ) j, by omega⟩,
               ⟨(y.1 : ℕ) + k, by have := y.1.isLt; omega⟩⟩)
    ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_
  · rintro ⟨i, i'⟩ hx
    simp only [Finset.mem_sigma, Finset.mem_univ, mem_after, true_and] at hx
    simp only [Finset.mem_sigma, Finset.mem_univ, mem_before, true_and]
    show (i : ℕ) < (i' : ℕ) - k
    omega
  · rintro ⟨s, t⟩ hy
    simp only [Finset.mem_sigma, Finset.mem_univ, mem_before, true_and] at hy
    have := s.isLt
    simp only [Finset.mem_sigma, Finset.mem_univ, mem_after, true_and]
    show min (t : ℕ) j + k < (s : ℕ) + k
    omega
  · rintro ⟨i, i'⟩ hx
    simp only [Finset.mem_sigma, Finset.mem_univ, mem_after, true_and] at hx
    have := i.isLt
    simp only [Sigma.mk.injEq, heq_iff_eq, Fin.ext_iff]
    omega
  · rintro ⟨s, t⟩ hy
    simp only [Finset.mem_sigma, Finset.mem_univ, mem_before, true_and] at hy
    have := s.isLt
    simp only [Sigma.mk.injEq, heq_iff_eq, Fin.ext_iff]
    omega
  · rintro ⟨i, i'⟩ hx
    simp only [Finset.mem_sigma, Finset.mem_univ, mem_after, true_and] at hx
    have hi' := i'.isLt
    dsimp only
    have h := kcompFin_assoc_par hε q r i (⟨(i' : ℕ) - k, by omega⟩ : Fin (j + 1))
      (by show (i : ℕ) < (i' : ℕ) - k; omega) α hβ γ
    dsimp only at h
    conv_lhs =>
      rw [show i' = (⟨(i' : ℕ) - k + k, by omega⟩ : Fin (j + k + 1)) from
        Fin.ext (show (i' : ℕ) = (i' : ℕ) - k + k by omega)]
    exact h

name: Operad.End.kbefore_eq
statement:
lemma kbefore_eq (q r : ℕ) {j k l : ℕ} (α : End R V (j + 1)) (β : End R V (k + 1))
    {γ : End R V (l + 1)} (hγ : IsHomog ε r γ) :
    kbefore ε q r α β γ
      = (-1 : R) ^ (q * r) • reindex R (End R V) (by omega) (kafter ε r q α γ β)
proof:
:= by
  unfold kbefore kafter
  rw [sum_before_eq_k hε q r α β hγ, map_sum, Finset.smul_sum]
  simp only [map_sum, Finset.smul_sum]
  rfl

name: Operad.End.kdisjointPart_symm
statement:
theorem kdisjointPart_symm (q r : ℕ) {j k l : ℕ} (α : End R V (j + 1)) {β : End R V (k + 1)}
    (hβ : IsHomog ε q β) {γ : End R V (l + 1)} (hγ : IsHomog ε r γ) :
    kdisjointPart ε q r α β γ
      = (-1 : R) ^ (q * r) • reindex R (End R V) (by omega) (kdisjointPart ε r q α γ β)
proof:
:= by
  unfold kdisjointPart
  rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => sum_compl_nested i _,
    Finset.sum_congr rfl fun s _ => sum_compl_nested s _,
    Finset.sum_add_distrib, Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  rw [sum_before_eq_k hε q r α β hγ, sum_after_eq_k hε q r α hβ γ, map_add, smul_add,
    map_sum, map_sum, Finset.smul_sum, Finset.smul_sum]
  simp only [map_sum, Finset.smul_sum]
  exact add_comm _ _

name: Operad.End.kstar_assoc_symm
statement:
theorem kstar_assoc_symm (q r : ℕ) {j k l : ℕ} (α : End R V (j + 1)) {β : End R V (k + 1)}
    (hβ : IsHomog ε q β) {γ : End R V (l + 1)} (hγ : IsHomog ε r γ) :
    kstar ε r (kstar ε q α β) γ
        - reindex R (End R V) (by omega) (kstar ε (q + r) α (kstar ε r β γ))
      = (-1 : R) ^ (q * r) • (reindex R (End R V) (by omega) (kstar ε q (kstar ε r α γ) β)
        - reindex R (End R V) (by omega) (kstar ε (r + q) α (kstar ε q γ β)))
proof:
:= by
  rw [kstar_kstar_left_split q r α β γ, kstar_kstar_left_split r q α γ β, map_add,
    kdisjointPart_symm hε q r α hβ hγ]
  simp only [reindex_reindex, add_sub_cancel_left]

name: Operad.End.kstar_kstar_odd
statement:
theorem kstar_kstar_odd {j k : ℕ} (α : End R V (j + 1)) {β : End R V (k + 1)}
    (hβ : IsHomog ε 1 β) :
    kstar ε 1 (kstar ε 1 α β) β
      = reindex R (End R V) (by omega) (kstar ε (1 + 1) α (kstar ε 1 β β))
proof:
:= by
  rw [kstar_kstar_left_split, add_eq_left]
  unfold kdisjointPart
  rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => sum_compl_nested i _, Finset.sum_add_distrib,
    sum_before_eq_k hε 1 1 α β hβ, ← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  refine Finset.sum_eq_zero fun s _ => ?_
  rw [← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  refine Finset.sum_eq_zero fun t _ => ?_
  erw [reindex_self]
  simp

name: Operad.ListInv.inv_nil
statement: @[simp] lemma inv_nil : inv [] = 0
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.ListInv.inv_cons
statement: @[simp] lemma inv_cons (a : ℕ) (l : List ℕ) : inv (a :: l) = l.countP (· < a) + inv l
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.ListInv.cross_nil_left
statement: @[simp] lemma cross_nil_left (l : List ℕ) : cross [] l = 0
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.ListInv.cross_cons_left
statement:
@[simp] lemma cross_cons_left (a : ℕ) (l₁ l₂ : List ℕ) :
    cross (a :: l₁) l₂ = l₂.countP (· < a) + cross l₁ l₂
proof:
:= by
  simp [cross]

name: Operad.ListInv.inv_append
statement:
lemma inv_append : ∀ l₁ l₂ : List ℕ, inv (l₁ ++ l₂) = inv l₁ + inv l₂ + cross l₁ l₂
  | [], l₂ => by simp
  | a :: l₁, l₂ => by
    simp only [List.cons_append, inv_cons, List.countP_append, inv_append l₁ l₂, cross_cons_left]
    ring

name: Operad.ListInv.cross_perm_right
statement:
lemma cross_perm_right (l₁ : List ℕ) {l₂ l₂' : List ℕ} (h : l₂.Perm l₂') :
    cross l₁ l₂ = cross l₁ l₂'
proof:
:= by
  simp only [cross, h.countP_eq]

name: Operad.ListInv.cross_cons_right
statement:
lemma cross_cons_right (l₁ : List ℕ) (x : ℕ) (l₂ : List ℕ) :
    cross l₁ (x :: l₂) = l₁.countP (x < ·) + cross l₁ l₂
proof:
:= by
  induction l₁ with
  | nil => simp
  | cons a l₁ ih =>
    simp only [cross_cons_left, List.countP_cons, ih]
    by_cases h : x < a <;> simp [h] <;> ring

name: Operad.ListInv.countP_lt_add_countP_gt
statement:
lemma countP_lt_add_countP_gt {x : ℕ} : ∀ {l : List ℕ}, x ∉ l →
    l.countP (· < x) + l.countP (x < ·) = l.length
  | [], _ => rfl
  | a :: l, h => by
    rw [List.mem_cons, not_or] at h
    have ih
proof:
:= countP_lt_add_countP_gt h.2
    simp only [List.countP_cons, List.length_cons]
    rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne (Ne.symm h.1) with hax | hax
    · simp [hax, not_lt_of_gt hax]
      omega
    · simp [hax, not_lt_of_gt hax]
      omega

name: Operad.ListInv.inv_move
statement:
lemma inv_move {x : ℕ} {l₁ : List ℕ} (hx : x ∉ l₁) (l₂ : List ℕ) :
    inv (l₁ ++ x :: l₂) + 2 * l₁.countP (· < x) = inv (x :: (l₁ ++ l₂)) + l₁.length
proof:
:= by
  rw [inv_append, inv_cons, cross_cons_right, inv_cons, List.countP_append, inv_append,
    ← countP_lt_add_countP_gt hx]
  ring

name: Operad.ListInv.neg_one_pow_eq_of_add
statement:
lemma neg_one_pow_eq_of_add {a b c d : ℕ} (h : a + 2 * c = b + d) :
    (-1 : ℤ) ^ a = (-1) ^ d * (-1) ^ b
proof:
:= by
  rw [← pow_add, add_comm d b, ← h, pow_add, pow_mul]
  simp

name: Operad.ListInv.sgn_move
statement:
lemma sgn_move {x : ℕ} {l₁ : List ℕ} (hx : x ∉ l₁) (l₂ : List ℕ) :
    sgn (l₁ ++ x :: l₂) = (-1) ^ l₁.length * sgn (x :: (l₁ ++ l₂))
proof:
:=
  neg_one_pow_eq_of_add (inv_move hx l₂)

name: Operad.ListInv.sgn_mul_self
statement: lemma sgn_mul_self (l : List ℕ) : sgn l * sgn l = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [sgn, ← pow_add, ← two_mul, pow_mul]
  norm_num

name: Operad.ListInv.sgn_cons
statement: lemma sgn_cons (a : ℕ) (l : List ℕ) : sgn (a :: l) = (-1) ^ l.countP (· < a) * sgn l
proof:
:= by
  rw [sgn, inv_cons, pow_add, sgn]

name: Operad.ListInv.sgn_cons_perm
statement:
lemma sgn_cons_perm (a : ℕ) {l l' : List ℕ} (h : l.Perm l') (hs : sgn l = sgn l') :
    sgn (a :: l) = sgn (a :: l')
proof:
:= by
  rw [sgn_cons, sgn_cons, h.countP_eq, hs]

name: Operad.ListInv.sgn_swap
statement:
lemma sgn_swap {β γ : ℕ} (hβγ : β ≠ γ) {l₂ l₃ : List ℕ} (hγ : γ ∉ l₂) (hβ : β ∉ l₂) :
    sgn (β :: (l₂ ++ γ :: l₃)) = -sgn (γ :: (l₂ ++ β :: l₃))
proof:
:= by
  rw [sgn_cons, sgn_cons, sgn_move hγ, sgn_move hβ, sgn_cons, sgn_cons]
  have h1 : (l₂ ++ γ :: l₃).countP (· < β) = (γ :: (l₂ ++ l₃)).countP (· < β) :=
    List.Perm.countP_eq _ List.perm_middle
  have h2 : (l₂ ++ β :: l₃).countP (· < γ) = (β :: (l₂ ++ l₃)).countP (· < γ) :=
    List.Perm.countP_eq _ List.perm_middle
  rw [h1, h2, List.countP_cons, List.countP_cons]
  rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne hβγ with h | h
  · simp only [h, not_lt_of_gt h, decide_true, decide_false, if_true, Bool.false_eq_true,
      if_false, add_zero, pow_add, pow_one]
    ring
  · simp only [h, not_lt_of_gt h, decide_true, decide_false, if_true, Bool.false_eq_true,
      if_false, add_zero, pow_add, pow_one]
    ring

name: Operad.respects_spRel_iff
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h n σ g
    have := h _ _ ⟨n, σ, Equiv.refl _, g, rfl, rfl⟩
    simp only [Syn.eval_map, Syn.eval_gen, SetOperad.map_refl] at this
    exact this.symm
  · rintro h A _ _ x y ⟨n, σ, e, g, rfl, rfl⟩
    simp only [Syn.eval_map, Syn.eval_gen]
    exact congrArg (SetOperad.map e) (h n σ g).symm

name: Operad.FreeSp.gen_equivariant
statement:
lemma gen_equivariant : SetSpeciesHom.Equivariant (X := X) (Y := FreeSp X)
    (fun _ g => Pres.gen g)
proof:
:= by
  intro n σ g
  have h := Pres.mk_eq_mk_of_rel (ρ := spRel X)
    (show spRel X (Syn.map (Equiv.refl _) (Syn.map σ (Syn.gen g)))
      (Syn.map (Equiv.refl _) (Syn.gen (SetSpecies.map σ g))) from
      ⟨n, σ, Equiv.refl _, g, rfl, rfl⟩)
  simp only [← Pres.map_mk, SetOperad.map_refl] at h
  exact h.symm

name: Operad.FreeSp.ι_app_fin
statement: @[simp] lemma ι_app_fin (n : ℕ) (g : X (Fin n)) : ι.app (Fin n) g = Pres.gen g
proof:
:=
  SetSpeciesHom.extend_app_fin gen_equivariant n g

name: Operad.FreeSp.homEquiv_app_fin
statement:
lemma homEquiv_app_fin (φ : SetOperadHom (FreeSp X) S) (n : ℕ) (g : X (Fin n)) :
    (homEquiv φ).app (Fin n) g = φ.app (Fin n) (Pres.gen g)
proof:
:=
  SetSpeciesHom.extend_app_fin ((respects_spRel_iff _).1 (Pres.respects_app φ)) n g

name: Operad.FreeSp.homEquiv_apply
statement:
lemma homEquiv_apply (φ : SetOperadHom (FreeSp X) S) {A : Type} [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A]
    (x : X A) : (homEquiv φ).app A x = φ.app A (ι.app A x)
proof:
:= by
  rw [SetSpeciesHom.app_eq_chart (homEquiv φ) (Fintype.equivFin A).symm,
    SetSpeciesHom.app_eq_chart (ι (X := X)) (Fintype.equivFin A).symm, ι_app_fin,
    homEquiv_app_fin]
  show _ = φ.app A (SetOperad.map _ _)
  rw [φ.app_map]
  rfl

name: Operad.FreeSp.homEquiv_symm_ι
statement:
@[simp] lemma homEquiv_symm_ι (f : SetSpeciesHom X S) {A : Type} [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A]
    (x : X A) : (homEquiv.symm f).app A (ι.app A x) = f.app A x
proof:
:= by
  rw [← homEquiv_apply, Equiv.apply_symm_apply]

name: Operad.FreeSp.hom_ext
proof:
:=
  homEquiv.injective (SetSpeciesHom.ext fun A _ _ x => by
    rw [homEquiv_apply, homEquiv_apply, h])

name: Operad.FreeL.kills_iff
statement:
lemma kills_iff (ψ : SetOperadHom (FreeSp (UndSp R V)) (Und R Q)) :
    (∀ n, ∀ x ∈ linRel R V n, (linHomEquiv R ψ).app (Fin n) x = 0)
      ↔ LinFin (FreeSp.homEquiv ψ)
proof:
:= by
  have hgen : ∀ n (v : V (Fin n)), (linHomEquiv R ψ).app (Fin n) (linGen R V v)
      = (Und.of R Q).symm ((FreeSp.homEquiv ψ).app (Fin n) (UndSp.of R V v)) := by
    intro n v
    rw [FreeSp.homEquiv_app_fin]
    show Finsupp.lift (Q _) R _ _ (Finsupp.single _ 1) = _
    simp
  simp only [linRel, Set.mem_union, Set.mem_setOf_eq]
  constructor
  · intro h n
    refine ⟨fun v w => ?_, fun c v => ?_⟩
    · have := h n _ (Or.inl ⟨v, w, rfl⟩)
      rw [map_sub, map_sub, hgen, hgen, hgen, sub_sub, sub_eq_zero] at this
      exact this
    · have := h n _ (Or.inr ⟨c, v, rfl⟩)
      rw [map_sub, map_smul, hgen, hgen, sub_eq_zero] at this
      exact this
  · rintro h n x (⟨v, w, rfl⟩ | ⟨c, v, rfl⟩)
    · rw [map_sub, map_sub, hgen, hgen, hgen, sub_sub, sub_eq_zero]
      exact (h n).1 v w
    · rw [map_sub, map_smul, hgen, hgen, sub_eq_zero]
      exact (h n).2 c v

name: Operad.FreeL.isLinear_iff
statement:
lemma isLinear_iff (F : SetSpeciesHom (UndSp R V) (Und R Q)) :
    SymSpeciesHom.IsLinear (undSpEquiv F) ↔ LinFin F
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h n
    exact ⟨(h (Fin n)).1, (h (Fin n)).2⟩
  · intro h A _ _
    have key : ∀ z : V A, (Und.of R Q).symm (F.app A (UndSp.of R V z))
        = SymOperad.map (R := R) (Fintype.equivFin A).symm ((Und.of R Q).symm (F.app _
          (UndSp.of R V (SymSpecies.map (R := R) (Fintype.equivFin A) z)))) := fun z =>
      congrArg (Und.of R Q).symm
        (SetSpeciesHom.app_eq_chart F (Fintype.equivFin A).symm (UndSp.of R V z))
    refine ⟨fun v w => ?_, fun c v => ?_⟩
    · apply (Und.of R Q).symm.injective
      show (Und.of R Q).symm (F.app A (UndSp.of R V (v + w)))
        = (Und.of R Q).symm (F.app A (UndSp.of R V v))
          + (Und.of R Q).symm (F.app A (UndSp.of R V w))
      rw [key, key v, key w, map_add, (h _).1, map_add]
    · apply (Und.of R Q).symm.injective
      show (Und.of R Q).symm (F.app A (UndSp.of R V (c • v)))
        = c • (Und.of R Q).symm (F.app A (UndSp.of R V v))
      rw [key, key v, map_smul, (h _).2, map_smul]

name: Operad.FreeL.homEquiv_apply
statement:
lemma homEquiv_apply (φ : SymOperadHom R (FreeL R V) Q) {A : Type} [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A]
    (v : V A) : (homEquiv φ).app A v = φ.app A ((SymOperadIdeal.span R (linRel R V)).proj A
      (Finsupp.single (FreeSp.ι.app A (UndSp.of R V v)) 1))
proof:
:= by
  show (Und.of R Q).symm ((FreeSp.homEquiv _).app A (UndSp.of R V v)) = _
  rw [FreeSp.homEquiv_apply]
  rfl

name: Operad.FreeL.ι_app
statement:
lemma ι_app {A : Type} [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] (v : V A) :
    (ι R V).app A v = (SymOperadIdeal.span R (linRel R V)).proj A
      (Finsupp.single (FreeSp.ι.app A (UndSp.of R V v)) 1)
proof:
:=
  homEquiv_apply _ v

name: Operad.FreeL.homEquiv_apply'
statement:
lemma homEquiv_apply' (φ : SymOperadHom R (FreeL R V) Q) {A : Type} [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A]
    (v : V A) : (homEquiv φ).app A v = φ.app A ((ι R V).app A v)
proof:
:= by
  rw [homEquiv_apply, ι_app]

name: Operad.FreeL.homEquiv_symm_ι
statement:
@[simp] lemma homEquiv_symm_ι (f : SymSpeciesHom R V Q) {A : Type} [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A]
    (v : V A) : (homEquiv.symm f).app A ((ι R V).app A v) = f.app A v
proof:
:= by
  rw [← homEquiv_apply', Equiv.apply_symm_apply]

name: Operad.FreeL.hom_ext
proof:
:=
  homEquiv.injective (SymSpeciesHom.ext fun A _ _ v => by
    rw [homEquiv_apply', homEquiv_apply', h])

name: Operad.LTree.wt_intCast
statement:
lemma wt_intCast {K : Type*} [CommRing K] (l : E → ℤ) :
    ∀ t : LTree E, wt (fun e => (l e : K)) t = ((wt l t : ℤ) : K)
  | leaf _ => by simp
  | node e a b => by simp [wt_intCast l a, wt_intCast l b]

end LTree

namespace ShuffleBar

open LTree

variable {E : Type v} [Fintype E] [DecidableEq E] {K : Type u} [Field K]

name: Operad.ShuffleBar.sum_vecOf_mul'
statement:
lemma sum_vecOf_mul' {n : ℕ} {t : LTree E} (ht : t ∈ monomials n) (f : Mono E n → K) :
    ∑ σ, vecOf K n t σ * f σ = f ⟨t, ht⟩
proof:
:= by
  rw [sum_vecOf_mul, monoVal_of_mem]

name: Operad.ShuffleBar.chi3_cast_mul_self
statement: lemma chi3_cast_mul_self (t : LTree E) : (chi3 t : K) * (chi3 t : K) = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Int.cast_mul, chi3_sq, Int.cast_one]

name: Operad.ShuffleBar.scaleMono_vecOf
statement:
lemma scaleMono_vecOf (l : E → K) (n : ℕ) (t : LTree E) :
    scaleMono K l n (vecOf K n t) = wt l t • vecOf K n t
proof:
:= by
  funext m
  show wt l m.1 * vecOf K n t m = wt l t * vecOf K n t m
  by_cases h : m.1 = t
  · rw [h]
  · simp [vecOf, h]

name: Operad.ShuffleBar.scaleMono_scaleMono
statement:
lemma scaleMono_scaleMono (l l' : E → K) (n : ℕ) (x : Mono E n → K) :
    scaleMono K l n (scaleMono K l' n x) = scaleMono K (l * l') n x
proof:
:= by
  funext m
  show wt l m.1 * (wt l' m.1 * x m) = wt (l * l') m.1 * x m
  rw [wt_mul]
  ring

name: Operad.ShuffleBar.scaleMono_one
statement: lemma scaleMono_one (n : ℕ) (x : Mono E n → K) : scaleMono K (1 : E → K) n x = x
proof:
:= by
  funext m
  show wt (1 : E → K) m.1 * x m = x m
  rw [wt_one, one_mul]

name: Operad.ShuffleBar.scaleMono_substVec
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := wt_substAt l he
  refine ⟨c, fun r => ?_⟩
  simp only [substVec, map_sum, map_smul, scaleMono_vecOf, Finset.smul_sum, smul_smul]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun σ _ => ?_
  rw [hc σ.1 ((mem_monomials 3 σ.1).1 σ.2).2]
  simp only [rescale, LinearMap.coe_mk, AddHom.coe_mk]
  congr 1
  ring

name: Operad.ShuffleBar.map_scaleMono_idealOf_le
statement:
theorem map_scaleMono_idealOf_le (l : E → K) (R : Submodule K (Mono E 3 → K)) (n : ℕ) :
    (idealOf K R n).map (scaleMono K l n) ≤ idealOf K (R.map (rescale K l)) n
proof:
:= by
  rw [Submodule.map_le_iff_le_comap, idealOf, Submodule.span_le]
  rintro _ ⟨t, p, s, r, hr, he, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := scaleMono_substVec l n he
  rw [SetLike.mem_coe, Submodule.mem_comap, hc]
  exact Submodule.smul_mem _ _ (substVec_mem_idealOf K _ t he (Submodule.mem_map_of_mem hr))

name: Operad.ShuffleBar.map_scaleMono_idealOf
statement:
theorem map_scaleMono_idealOf (l : E → K) (hl : ∀ e, l e ≠ 0) (R : Submodule K (Mono E 3 → K))
    (n : ℕ) : (idealOf K R n).map (scaleMono K l n) = idealOf K (R.map (rescale K l)) n
proof:
:= by
  refine le_antisymm (map_scaleMono_idealOf_le l R n) fun v hv => ⟨scaleMono K l⁻¹ n v, ?_, ?_⟩
  · have h := map_scaleMono_idealOf_le l⁻¹ (R.map (rescale K l)) n (Submodule.mem_map_of_mem hv)
    rwa [map_rescale_inv l hl R] at h
  · rw [scaleMono_scaleMono, show l * l⁻¹ = 1 from funext fun e => mul_inv_cancel₀ (hl e),
      scaleMono_one]

name: Operad.ShuffleBar.quotRescaleEquiv_mk
statement:
lemma quotRescaleEquiv_mk (l : E → K) (hl : ∀ e, l e ≠ 0) (R : Submodule K (Mono E 3 → K))
    (n : ℕ) (x : Mono E n → K) :
    quotRescaleEquiv l hl R n (Submodule.Quotient.mk x) =
      Submodule.Quotient.mk (scaleMono K l n x)
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.AssBin.ruleLead_inj
statement: lemma ruleLead_inj : ∀ r r' : Rule, ruleLead r = ruleLead r' → r = r'
proof: := by decide

name: Operad.AssBin.ruleTail_inj
statement: lemma ruleTail_inj : ∀ r r' : Rule, ruleTail r = ruleTail r' → r = r'
proof: := by decide

name: Operad.AssBin.ruleLead_ne_ruleTail
statement: lemma ruleLead_ne_ruleTail : ∀ r r' : Rule, ruleLead r ≠ ruleTail r'
proof: := by decide

name: Operad.AssBin.sign_rule
statement:
lemma sign_rule : ∀ r : Rule,
    chi3 (ruleLead r) * wt opSgn (ruleLead r) + chi3 (ruleTail r) * wt opSgn (ruleTail r) = 0
proof:
:= by
  decide

name: Operad.AssBin.cover3
statement:
lemma cover3 : ∀ e f : AssShGen 2,
    (∃ r : Rule, node e (node f (leaf 0) (leaf 1)) (leaf 2) = ruleLead r ∨
      node e (node f (leaf 0) (leaf 1)) (leaf 2) = ruleTail r) ∧
    (∃ r : Rule, node e (node f (leaf 0) (leaf 2)) (leaf 1) = ruleLead r ∨
      node e (node f (leaf 0) (leaf 2)) (leaf 1) = ruleTail r) ∧
    (∃ r : Rule, node e (leaf 0) (node f (leaf 1) (leaf 2)) = ruleLead r ∨
      node e (leaf 0) (node f (leaf 1) (leaf 2)) = ruleTail r)
proof:
:= by
  decide

name: Operad.AssBin.exists_rule
statement: lemma exists_rule (σ : Mono (AssShGen 2) 3) : ∃ r : Rule, σ.1 = ruleLead r ∨ σ.1 = ruleTail r
proof:
:= by
  have hm := (mem_monomials 3 σ.1).1 σ.2
  obtain ⟨e, f, h | h | h⟩ := mono3_cases hm.1 hm.2 <;> rw [h]
  · exact (cover3 e f).1
  · exact (cover3 e f).2.1
  · exact (cover3 e f).2.2

name: Operad.AssBin.opScale_ne_zero
statement: lemma opScale_ne_zero (e : AssShGen 2) : opScale K e ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  cases e <;> simp [opScale, opSgn]

name: Operad.AssBin.opScale_mul_self
statement: lemma opScale_mul_self : opScale K * opScale K = 1
proof:
:=
  funext fun e => by cases e <;> simp [opScale, opSgn]

name: Operad.AssBin.rel_eq_span_ruleVec
statement: lemma rel_eq_span_ruleVec : rel K = Submodule.span K (Set.range (ruleVec K))
proof: := rel_eq_span

name: Operad.AssBin.ruleLead_mem
statement: lemma ruleLead_mem (r : Rule) : ruleLead r ∈ monomials 3
proof: := lead3_mem _ _ _

name: Operad.AssBin.ruleTail_mem
statement: lemma ruleTail_mem (r : Rule) : ruleTail r ∈ monomials 3
proof: := tail3_mem _ _ _

name: Operad.AssBin.ruleVec_lead
statement:
lemma ruleVec_lead (r r' : Rule) :
    ruleVec K r ⟨ruleLead r', ruleLead_mem r'⟩ = if r' = r then 1 else 0
proof:
:= by
  by_cases h : r' = r
  · subst h
    simp [ruleVec, vecOf, ruleLead_ne_ruleTail]
  · have h' : ruleLead r' ≠ ruleLead r := fun h' => h (ruleLead_inj _ _ h')
    simp [ruleVec, vecOf, h, h', ruleLead_ne_ruleTail]

name: Operad.AssBin.ruleVec_tail
statement:
lemma ruleVec_tail (r r' : Rule) :
    ruleVec K r ⟨ruleTail r', ruleTail_mem r'⟩ = if r' = r then -1 else 0
proof:
:= by
  by_cases h : r' = r
  · subst h
    have h' : ruleTail r' ≠ ruleLead r' := fun h' => ruleLead_ne_ruleTail r' r' h'.symm
    simp [ruleVec, vecOf, h']
  · have h' : ruleTail r' ≠ ruleLead r := fun h' => ruleLead_ne_ruleTail r r' h'.symm
    have h'' : ruleTail r' ≠ ruleTail r := fun h'' => h (ruleTail_inj _ _ h'')
    simp [ruleVec, vecOf, h, h', h'']

name: Operad.AssBin.pair_ruleVec
statement:
lemma pair_ruleVec (r : Rule) (y : Mono (AssShGen 2) 3 → K) :
    ∑ σ, (chi3 σ.1 : K) * ruleVec K r σ * y σ =
      (chi3 (ruleLead r) : K) * y ⟨_, ruleLead_mem r⟩ -
        (chi3 (ruleTail r) : K) * y ⟨_, ruleTail_mem r⟩
proof:
:= by
  have h : ∀ σ, (chi3 σ.1 : K) * ruleVec K r σ * y σ =
      vecOf K 3 (ruleLead r) σ * ((chi3 σ.1 : K) * y σ) -
        vecOf K 3 (ruleTail r) σ * ((chi3 σ.1 : K) * y σ) := fun σ => by
    simp only [ruleVec, Pi.sub_apply]
    ring
  rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl fun σ _ => h σ, Finset.sum_sub_distrib,
    sum_vecOf_mul' (ruleLead_mem r), sum_vecOf_mul' (ruleTail_mem r)]

name: Operad.AssBin.sign_rule_cast
statement:
lemma sign_rule_cast (r : Rule) :
    (chi3 (ruleLead r) : K) * wt (opScale K) (ruleLead r) +
      (chi3 (ruleTail r) : K) * wt (opScale K) (ruleTail r) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have h := congrArg (fun z : ℤ => (z : K)) (sign_rule r)
  push_cast at h
  rw [show opScale K = fun e => (opSgn e : K) from rfl, wt_intCast, wt_intCast]
  exact h

name: Operad.AssBin.dualRel_rel
statement: theorem dualRel_rel : dualRel K (rel K) = (rel K).map (rescale K (opScale K))
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · intro ρ hρ
    have hρ' : ∀ r, (chi3 (ruleLead r) : K) * ρ ⟨_, ruleLead_mem r⟩ -
        (chi3 (ruleTail r) : K) * ρ ⟨_, ruleTail_mem r⟩ = 0 := fun r => by
      rw [← pair_ruleVec]
      refine hρ _ ?_
      rw [rel_eq_span_ruleVec]
      exact Submodule.subset_span ⟨r, rfl⟩
    set w := rescale K (opScale K) ρ with hw_def
    have hwv : ∀ σ, w σ = wt (opScale K) σ.1 * ρ σ := fun σ => rfl
    have hsum : w = ∑ r, w ⟨_, ruleLead_mem r⟩ • ruleVec K r := by
      funext σ
      rw [Finset.sum_apply]
      simp only [Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
      obtain ⟨r0, h | h⟩ := exists_rule σ
      · obtain rfl : σ = ⟨ruleLead r0, ruleLead_mem r0⟩ := Subtype.ext h
        simp only [ruleVec_lead, mul_ite, mul_one, mul_zero, Finset.sum_ite_eq, Finset.mem_univ,
          if_true]
      · obtain rfl : σ = ⟨ruleTail r0, ruleTail_mem r0⟩ := Subtype.ext h
        simp only [ruleVec_tail, mul_ite, mul_neg, mul_one, mul_zero, Finset.sum_ite_eq,
          Finset.mem_univ, if_true, hwv]
        have h1 := hρ' r0
        have h2 := sign_rule_cast (K := K) r0
        have h4 := chi3_cast_mul_self (K := K) (ruleLead r0)
        have h5 := chi3_cast_mul_self (K := K) (ruleTail r0)
        linear_combination (-(wt (opScale K) (ruleLead r0) * ρ ⟨_, ruleLead_mem r0⟩)) * h4 +
          (wt (opScale K) (ruleLead r0) * (chi3 (ruleLead r0) : K)) * h1 +
          ((chi3 (ruleTail r0) : K) * ρ ⟨_, ruleTail_mem r0⟩) * h2 -
          (wt (opScale K) (ruleTail r0) * ρ ⟨_, ruleTail_mem r0⟩) * h5
    have hw : w ∈ rel K := by
      rw [hsum, rel_eq_span_ruleVec]
      exact Submodule.sum_mem _ fun r _ =>
        Submodule.smul_mem _ _ (Submodule.subset_span ⟨r, rfl⟩)
    refine ⟨w, hw, ?_⟩
    show rescale K (opScale K) (rescale K (opScale K) ρ) = ρ
    rw [rescale_rescale, opScale_mul_self, rescale_one]
  · rw [Submodule.map_le_iff_le_comap]
    nth_rewrite 1 [rel_eq_span_ruleVec]
    rw [Submodule.span_le]
    rintro _ ⟨r', rfl⟩
    show rescale K (opScale K) (ruleVec K r') ∈ dualRel K (rel K)
    rw [mem_dualRel]
    intro y hy
    rw [rel_eq_span_ruleVec] at hy
    induction hy using Submodule.span_induction with
    | mem y hy =>
      obtain ⟨r, rfl⟩ := hy
      rw [pair_ruleVec]
      simp only [rescale, LinearMap.coe_mk, AddHom.coe_mk, ruleVec_lead, ruleVec_tail]
      by_cases h : r = r'
      · subst h
        simp only [if_true, mul_one, mul_neg]
        linear_combination sign_rule_cast (K := K) r
      · simp [h]
    | zero => simp
    | add a b _ _ ha hb =>
      simp only [Pi.add_apply, mul_add, add_mul, Finset.sum_add_distrib, ha, hb, add_zero]
    | smul c a _ ha =>
      simp only [Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
      rw [← mul_zero c, ← ha, Finset.mul_sum]
      exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun σ _ => by ring

name: Operad.LTree.labels_leftComb
statement:
lemma labels_leftComb (a : ℕ) :
    ∀ l : List (E × ℕ), (leftComb a l).labels = a :: (l.map Prod.snd).reverse
  | [] => rfl
  | (e, b) :: l => by simp [leftComb, labels_leftComb a l]

name: Operad.LTree.isLeftCombShape_leftComb
statement:
lemma isLeftCombShape_leftComb (a : ℕ) : ∀ l : List (E × ℕ), (leftComb a l).IsLeftCombShape
  | [] => trivial
  | (_, _) :: l => isLeftCombShape_leftComb a l

name: Operad.LTree.exists_leftComb
statement:
lemma exists_leftComb : ∀ t : LTree E, t.IsLeftCombShape → ∃ a l, t = leftComb a l
  | leaf a, _ => ⟨a, [], rfl⟩
  | node e t (leaf b), h => by
    obtain ⟨a, l, rfl⟩
proof:
:= exists_leftComb t h
    exact ⟨a, (e, b) :: l, rfl⟩
  | node _ _ (node _ _ _), h => h.elim

name: Operad.LTree.minLabel_leftComb
statement:
lemma minLabel_leftComb (a : ℕ) :
    ∀ l : List (E × ℕ), (∀ p ∈ l, a < p.2) → (leftComb a l).minLabel = a
  | [], _ => rfl
  | (e, b) :: l, h => by
    simp only [leftComb, minLabel_node, minLabel_leaf,
      minLabel_leftComb a l fun p hp => h p (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hp)]
    exact min_eq_left (h _ List.mem_cons_self).le

name: Operad.LTree.isShuffle_leftComb
statement:
lemma isShuffle_leftComb (a : ℕ) :
    ∀ l : List (E × ℕ), (∀ p ∈ l, a < p.2) → (leftComb a l).IsShuffle
  | [], _ => trivial
  | (e, b) :: l, h => by
    have h' : ∀ p ∈ l, a < p.2
proof:
:= fun p hp => h p (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hp)
    exact ⟨by rw [minLabel_leftComb a l h']; exact h _ List.mem_cons_self,
      isShuffle_leftComb a l h', trivial⟩

name: Operad.LTree.lt_of_isShuffle_leftComb
statement:
lemma lt_of_isShuffle_leftComb (a : ℕ) :
    ∀ l : List (E × ℕ), (leftComb a l).IsShuffle → ∀ p ∈ l, a < p.2
  | [], _ => by simp
  | (e, b) :: l, h => by
    have ih
proof:
:= lt_of_isShuffle_leftComb a l h.2.1
    have h1 := h.1
    rw [minLabel_leftComb a l ih, minLabel_leaf] at h1
    intro p hp
    rcases List.mem_cons.1 hp with rfl | hp
    · exact h1
    · exact ih p hp

name: Operad.LTree.windows_mem_of_leftCombShape
statement:
theorem windows_mem_of_leftCombShape {L : Set (LTree E)}
    (hL : ∀ e f : E, node e (node f (leaf 0) (leaf 1)) (leaf 2) ∈ L ∧
      node e (node f (leaf 0) (leaf 2)) (leaf 1) ∈ L) :
    ∀ t : LTree E, t.IsShuffle → t.labels.Nodup → t.IsLeftCombShape → ∀ w ∈ t.windows, w ∈ L
  | leaf _, _, _, _ => by simp [windows]
  | node e l (leaf b), hs, hnd, hsh => by
    intro w hw
    simp only [windows, List.mem_append, List.not_mem_nil, or_false] at hw
    rcases hw with hw | hw
    · cases l with
      | leaf _ => simp at hw
      | node f x y =>
        rw [List.mem_singleton] at hw
        subst hw
        rcases window_left_shape hs hnd with h | h <;> rw [h]
        · exact (hL e f).1
        · exact (hL e f).2
    · exact windows_mem_of_leftCombShape hL l hs.2.1 (List.nodup_append.1 hnd).1 hsh w hw
  | node _ _ (node _ _ _), _, _, hsh => hsh.elim

name: Operad.LTree.isLeftCombShape_of_windows_mem
statement:
theorem isLeftCombShape_of_windows_mem {L : Set (LTree E)}
    (hR : ∀ e f : E, node e (leaf 0) (node f (leaf 1) (leaf 2)) ∉ L) :
    ∀ t : LTree E, t.IsShuffle → (∀ w ∈ t.windows, w ∈ L) → t.IsLeftCombShape
  | leaf _, _, _ => trivial
  | node e l (leaf b), hs, h => isLeftCombShape_of_windows_mem hR l hs.2.1 fun w hw =>
      h w (by
        simp only [windows, List.mem_append]
        exact Or.inl (Or.inr hw))
  | node e l (node f x y), hs, h => by
    have hw
proof:
:= h (window e f true x.minLabel y.minLabel l.minLabel) (by simp [windows])
    rw [window_right_eq hs] at hw
    exact (hR e f hw).elim

name: Operad.ComBin.jac_eq
statement: theorem jac_eq : jac K = vecOf K 3 lcomb - vecOf K 3 tcomb - vecOf K 3 rcomb
proof:
:= by
  funext σ
  simp only [jac, Pi.sub_apply]
  rcases mono3_eq σ with h | h | h <;>
    simp [h, vecOf, lcomb, tcomb, rcomb, chi3]

name: Operad.ComBin.dualRel_rel
statement: theorem dualRel_rel : dualRel K (rel K) = K ∙ jac K
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · intro ρ hρ
    rw [mem_dualRel] at hρ
    have hpair : ∀ σ τ : Mono (ComGen 2) 3, (chi3 σ.1 : K) * ρ σ = chi3 τ.1 * ρ τ := by
      intro σ τ
      have h := hρ (vecOf K 3 σ.1 - vecOf K 3 τ.1) (by
        rw [rel, LinearMap.mem_ker, map_sub, aug_vecOf σ.2, aug_vecOf τ.2, sub_self])
      have e : ∀ x : Mono (ComGen 2) 3, (chi3 x.1 : K) * (vecOf K 3 σ.1 - vecOf K 3 τ.1) x * ρ x =
          vecOf K 3 σ.1 x * ((chi3 x.1 : K) * ρ x) - vecOf K 3 τ.1 x * ((chi3 x.1 : K) * ρ x) :=
        fun x => by
          simp only [Pi.sub_apply]
          ring
      rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl fun x _ => e x, Finset.sum_sub_distrib, sum_vecOf_mul' σ.2,
        sum_vecOf_mul' τ.2] at h
      exact sub_eq_zero.1 h
    set τ₀ : Mono (ComGen 2) 3 := ⟨rcomb, rcomb_mem⟩
    refine Submodule.mem_span_singleton.2 ⟨(chi3 τ₀.1 : K) * ρ τ₀, funext fun σ => ?_⟩
    show (chi3 τ₀.1 : K) * ρ τ₀ * (chi3 σ.1 : K) = ρ σ
    rw [← hpair σ τ₀, mul_comm, ← mul_assoc, chi3_cast_mul_self, one_mul]
  · rw [Submodule.span_singleton_le_iff_mem, mem_dualRel]
    intro r hr
    rw [rel, LinearMap.mem_ker, aug_apply] at hr
    rw [← hr]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun σ _ => ?_
    simp only [jac]
    linear_combination r σ * chi3_cast_mul_self (K := K) σ.1

name: Operad.ComBin.labels_lcombOf
statement: lemma labels_lcombOf (l : List ℕ) : (lcombOf l).labels = 0 :: l.reverse
proof:
:= by
  simp [lcombOf, labels_leftComb, Function.comp_def]

name: Operad.ComBin.lcombOf_injective
statement: lemma lcombOf_injective : Function.Injective lcombOf
proof:
:= fun l l' h => by
  have := congrArg labels h
  rw [labels_lcombOf, labels_lcombOf, List.cons_inj_right, List.reverse_inj] at this
  exact this

name: Operad.ComBin.leads_rcomb
statement: lemma leads_rcomb (e f : ComGen 2) : node e (leaf 0) (node f (leaf 1) (leaf 2)) ∉ leads
proof:
:= by
  cases e
  cases f
  simp [leads, lcomb, tcomb]

name: Operad.ComBin.range_eq_cons
statement: lemma range_eq_cons {n : ℕ} (hn : 1 ≤ n) : List.range n = 0 :: List.range' 1 (n - 1)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨k, rfl⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_add_of_le' hn
  rw [List.range_eq_range', List.range'_succ]
  simp

name: Operad.ComBin.full_eq_image
proof:
:= by
  ext m
  simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq, Set.mem_image, mem_monomials, isFull_iff_windows]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨⟨hs, hl⟩, hw⟩
    obtain ⟨a, l', rfl⟩ := exists_leftComb m (isLeftCombShape_of_windows_mem leads_rcomb m hs hw)
    have hlt := lt_of_isShuffle_leftComb a l' hs
    rw [labels_leftComb, range_eq_cons hn] at hl
    have ha : a = 0 := by
      have h0 : 0 ∈ a :: (l'.map Prod.snd).reverse := hl.symm.subset List.mem_cons_self
      rcases List.mem_cons.1 h0 with h0 | h0
      · exact h0.symm
      · obtain ⟨p, hp, hp0⟩ := List.mem_map.1 (List.mem_reverse.1 h0)
        exact absurd (hp0 ▸ hlt p hp) (Nat.not_lt_zero a)
    subst ha
    refine ⟨l'.map Prod.snd, (List.reverse_perm _).symm.trans ((List.perm_cons 0).1 hl), ?_⟩
    rw [lcombOf, List.map_map]
    congr 1
    conv_rhs => rw [← List.map_id l']
    exact List.map_congr_left fun p _ => Prod.ext (Subsingleton.elim _ _) rfl
  · rintro ⟨l, hl, rfl⟩
    have hpos : ∀ p ∈ l.map (fun b => ((.mu : ComGen 2), b)), 0 < p.2 := by
      intro p hp
      obtain ⟨b, hb, rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.1 hp
      have := List.mem_range'.1 (hl.subset hb)
      simp only
      omega
    have hs : (lcombOf l).IsShuffle := isShuffle_leftComb 0 _ hpos
    have hl' : (lcombOf l).labels.Perm (List.range n) := by
      rw [labels_lcombOf, range_eq_cons hn]
      exact (List.perm_cons 0).2 ((List.reverse_perm _).trans hl)
    exact ⟨⟨hs, hl'⟩, windows_mem_of_leftCombShape leads_spec _ hs
      (hl'.nodup_iff.2 List.nodup_range) (isLeftCombShape_leftComb _ _)⟩

name: Operad.ComBin.ncard_full
statement:
theorem ncard_full {n : ℕ} (hn : 1 ≤ n) :
    {m | m ∈ monomials (E := ComGen 2) n ∧ ShuffleBar.IsFull leads m}.ncard =
      (n - 1).factorial
proof:
:= by
  rw [full_eq_image hn, Set.ncard_image_of_injective _ lcombOf_injective,
    show {l : List ℕ | l.Perm (List.range' 1 (n - 1))} =
      ↑(List.range' 1 (n - 1)).permutations.toFinset from by
        ext l
        simp [List.mem_permutations],
    Set.ncard_coe_finset, List.toFinset_card_of_nodup (List.nodup_permutations _ List.nodup_range'),
    List.length_permutations, List.length_range']

name: Operad.ComBin.finrank_quotient_dualRel
statement:
theorem finrank_quotient_dualRel {n : ℕ} (hn : 2 ≤ n) :
    Module.finrank K ((Mono (ComGen 2) n → K) ⧸ idealOf K (dualRel K (rel K)) n) =
      (n - 1).factorial
proof:
:= by
  rw [ShuffleBar.finrank_quotient_dualRel_eq_ncard rk (isGroebner K) hn, ncard_full (by omega)]

name: Operad.ComBin.finrank_quotient_jac
statement:
theorem finrank_quotient_jac {n : ℕ} (hn : 2 ≤ n) :
    Module.finrank K ((Mono (ComGen 2) n → K) ⧸ idealOf K (K ∙ jac K) n) = (n - 1).factorial
proof:
:= by
  rw [← dualRel_rel, finrank_quotient_dualRel K hn]

name: Operad.ComBin.isKoszul_jac
statement: theorem isKoszul_jac : ShuffleBar.IsKoszul K (K ∙ jac K)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← dualRel_rel]
  exact isKoszul_dualRel K

name: Operad.ComBin.eq_zero_of_aug
statement:
lemma eq_zero_of_aug {n : ℕ} {v : Mono (ComGen 2) n → K}
    (hN : v ∈ supportedOn K (normalSet leads n)) (h0 : aug K n v = 0) : v = 0
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hne
  obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ : ∃ y, v y ≠ 0 := by
    by_contra h
    push Not at h
    exact hne (funext h)
  have hyN : IsNormal leads y.1 := by
    by_contra h
    exact hy (hN y h)
  rw [aug_apply, Finset.sum_eq_single y (fun σ _ hσ => ?_) (by simp)] at h0
  · exact hy h0
  · by_contra h
    exact hσ (normal_unique (by by_contra h'; exact h (hN σ h')) hyN)

name: Operad.ComBin.idealOf_eq_ker
statement: theorem idealOf_eq_ker (n : ℕ) : idealOf K (rel K) n = LinearMap.ker (aug K n)
proof:
:= by
  refine le_antisymm (idealOf_le_ker n) fun v hv => ?_
  have hv' : v ∈ idealOf K (rel K) n ⊔ supportedOn K (normalSet leads n) := by
    rw [((isGroebner K).isCompl n).sup_eq_top]
    exact Submodule.mem_top
  obtain ⟨i, hi, w, hw, rfl⟩ := Submodule.mem_sup.1 hv'
  rw [LinearMap.mem_ker, map_add, LinearMap.mem_ker.1 (idealOf_le_ker n hi), zero_add] at hv
  rw [eq_zero_of_aug hw hv, add_zero]
  exact hi

name: Operad.ComBin.lcombOf_mem
statement: lemma lcombOf_mem {n : ℕ} (hn : 1 ≤ n) : lcombOf (List.range' 1 (n - 1)) ∈ monomials n
proof:
:= by
  have h : lcombOf (List.range' 1 (n - 1)) ∈ lcombOf '' {l | l.Perm (List.range' 1 (n - 1))} :=
    ⟨_, List.Perm.refl _, rfl⟩
  rw [← full_eq_image hn] at h
  exact h.1

name: Operad.ComBin.aug_surjective
statement: lemma aug_surjective {n : ℕ} (hn : 1 ≤ n) : Function.Surjective (aug K n)
proof:
:= fun c =>
  ⟨c • vecOf K n (lcombOf (List.range' 1 (n - 1))), by
    rw [map_smul, aug_vecOf (lcombOf_mem hn), smul_eq_mul, mul_one]⟩

name: Operad.ComBin.quotEquiv_mk
statement:
lemma quotEquiv_mk {n : ℕ} (hn : 1 ≤ n) (v : Mono (ComGen 2) n → K) :
    quotEquiv K hn (Submodule.Quotient.mk v) = aug K n v
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.ComBin.finrank_quotient
statement:
theorem finrank_quotient {n : ℕ} (hn : 1 ≤ n) :
    Module.finrank K ((Mono (ComGen 2) n → K) ⧸ idealOf K (rel K) n) = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [(quotEquiv K hn).finrank_eq, Module.finrank_self]

name: Operad.AssBin.idealOf_eq_ker
statement: theorem idealOf_eq_ker (n : ℕ) : idealOf K (rel K) n = LinearMap.ker (evL K n)
proof:
:= by
  refine le_antisymm (idealOf_le_ker n) fun v hv => ?_
  have hv' : v ∈ idealOf K (rel K) n ⊔ supportedOn K (normalSet leads n) := by
    rw [((isGroebner K).isCompl n).sup_eq_top]
    exact Submodule.mem_top
  obtain ⟨i, hi, w, hw, rfl⟩ := Submodule.mem_sup.1 hv'
  rw [LinearMap.mem_ker, map_add, LinearMap.mem_ker.1 (idealOf_le_ker n hi), zero_add] at hv
  rw [eq_zero_of_evL hw hv, add_zero]
  exact hi

name: Operad.AssBin.mem_arrs
statement: lemma mem_arrs {n : ℕ} {w : List ℕ} : w ∈ arrs n ↔ w.Perm (List.range n)
proof:
:= by
  rw [arrs, List.mem_toFinset, List.mem_permutations]

name: Operad.AssBin.card_arrs
statement: lemma card_arrs (n : ℕ) : (arrs n).card = n.factorial
proof:
:= by
  rw [arrs, List.toFinset_card_of_nodup (List.nodup_permutations _ List.nodup_range),
    List.length_permutations, List.length_range]

name: Operad.AssBin.ev_mem_arrs
statement: lemma ev_mem_arrs {n : ℕ} (σ : Mono (AssShGen 2) n) : ev σ.1 ∈ arrs n
proof:
:=
  mem_arrs.2 ((perm_ev σ.1).trans ((mem_monomials n σ.1).1 σ.2).2)

name: Operad.AssBin.ev_leftComb_mu
statement:
lemma ev_leftComb_mu (a : ℕ) :
    ∀ l : List ℕ, ev (leftComb a (l.map fun b => (mu, b))) = a :: l.reverse
  | [] => rfl
  | b :: l => by simp [leftComb, ev, ap, ev_leftComb_mu a l]

name: Operad.AssBin.ev_leftComb_op
statement:
lemma ev_leftComb_op (a : ℕ) (rest : List (AssShGen 2 × ℕ)) :
    ∀ A : List ℕ, ev (leftComb a (A.map (fun b => (op, b)) ++ rest)) = A ++ ev (leftComb a rest)
  | [] => rfl
  | b :: A => by simp [leftComb, ev, ap, ev_leftComb_op a rest A]

name: Operad.AssBin.exists_ev_eq
statement:
theorem exists_ev_eq {n : ℕ} (hn : 1 ≤ n) {w : List ℕ} (hw : w.Perm (List.range n)) :
    ∃ σ : Mono (AssShGen 2) n, ev σ.1 = w
proof:
:= by
  have h0 : 0 ∈ w := hw.symm.subset (List.mem_range.2 (by omega))
  obtain ⟨A, B, rfl⟩ := List.append_of_mem h0
  set m : LTree (AssShGen 2) :=
    leftComb 0 (A.map (fun b => (op, b)) ++ B.reverse.map fun b => (mu, b))
  have hev : ev m = A ++ 0 :: B := by
    rw [ev_leftComb_op, ev_leftComb_mu, List.reverse_reverse]
  have hnd : (0 :: (A ++ B)).Nodup := List.nodup_middle.1 (hw.nodup_iff.2 List.nodup_range)
  have hpos : ∀ p ∈ A.map (fun b => (op, b)) ++ B.reverse.map (fun b => (mu, b)), 0 < p.2 := by
    intro p hp
    have hmem : p.2 ∈ A ++ B := by
      rcases List.mem_append.1 hp with hp | hp
      · obtain ⟨b, hb, rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.1 hp
        exact List.mem_append_left _ hb
      · obtain ⟨b, hb, rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.1 hp
        exact List.mem_append_right _ (List.mem_reverse.1 hb)
    exact Nat.pos_of_ne_zero fun h => (List.nodup_cons.1 hnd).1 (h ▸ hmem)
  refine ⟨⟨m, (mem_monomials n m).2 ⟨isShuffle_leftComb 0 _ hpos, ?_⟩⟩, hev⟩
  exact (perm_ev m).symm.trans (hev ▸ hw)

name: Operad.AssBin.range_evL
statement:
theorem range_evL {n : ℕ} (hn : 1 ≤ n) :
    LinearMap.range (evL K n) = Finsupp.supported K K (arrs n : Set (List ℕ))
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · rintro _ ⟨v, rfl⟩
    rw [evL_apply]
    exact Submodule.sum_mem _ fun σ _ =>
      Submodule.smul_mem _ _ (Finsupp.single_mem_supported K _ (ev_mem_arrs σ))
  · rw [Finsupp.supported_eq_span_single, Submodule.span_le]
    rintro _ ⟨w, hw, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨σ, hσ⟩ := exists_ev_eq hn (mem_arrs.1 hw)
    exact ⟨vecOf K n σ.1, by rw [evL_vecOf σ.2, hσ]⟩

name: Operad.AssBin.finrank_quotient
statement:
theorem finrank_quotient {n : ℕ} (hn : 1 ≤ n) :
    Module.finrank K ((Mono (AssShGen 2) n → K) ⧸ idealOf K (rel K) n) = n.factorial
proof:
:= by
  rw [(quotEquiv K hn).finrank_eq, (Finsupp.supportedEquivFinsupp _).finrank_eq,
    Module.finrank_finsupp_self]
  simp [card_arrs]

name: Operad.AssBin.finrank_quotient_eq_sym
statement:
theorem finrank_quotient_eq_sym {n : ℕ} (hn : 1 ≤ n) :
    Module.finrank K ((Mono (AssShGen 2) n → K) ⧸ idealOf K (rel K) n) =
      Module.finrank K (Sym.Ass K (Fin n))
proof:
:= by
  rw [finrank_quotient K hn, Sym.Ass.finrank, Fintype.card_fin]

name: Operad.AssBin.finrank_quotient_dualRel
statement:
theorem finrank_quotient_dualRel {n : ℕ} (hn : 1 ≤ n) :
    Module.finrank K ((Mono (AssShGen 2) n → K) ⧸ idealOf K (dualRel K (rel K)) n) =
      n.factorial
proof:
:= by
  rw [← (quotDualEquiv K n).finrank_eq, finrank_quotient K hn]

name: Operad.SymOperadIdeal.proj_apply
statement: @[simp] lemma proj_apply (x : P A) : I.proj A x = Submodule.Quotient.mk x
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.SymOperadIdeal.proj_surjective
statement: lemma proj_surjective (A : Type) [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] : Function.Surjective (I.proj A)
proof:
:=
  Submodule.mkQ_surjective _

name: Operad.SymOperadIdeal.proj_eq_zero_iff
statement: lemma proj_eq_zero_iff (x : P A) : I.proj A x = 0 ↔ x ∈ I.sub A
proof:
:=
  Submodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero _

name: Operad.SymOperadIdeal.mapQ_proj
statement:
lemma mapQ_proj (e : A ≃ B) (x : P A) :
    I.mapQ e (I.proj A x) = I.proj B (SymOperad.map (R := R) e x)
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.SymOperadIdeal.mapQ_mk
statement:
@[simp] lemma mapQ_mk (e : A ≃ B) (x : P A) :
    I.mapQ e (Submodule.Quotient.mk x) = Submodule.Quotient.mk (SymOperad.map (R := R) e x)
proof:
:=

lemma compRight_proj (i : A) (x : P A) (y : P B) :
    I.compRight i x (I.proj B y) = I.proj _ (SymOperad.comp (R := R) i x y)
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.SymOperadIdeal.compRight_mk
statement:
@[simp] lemma compRight_mk (i : A) (x : P A) (y : P B) :
    I.compRight i x (Submodule.Quotient.mk y) =
      Submodule.Quotient.mk (SymOperad.comp (R := R) i x y)
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.SymOperadIdeal.compQ_proj
statement:
lemma compQ_proj (i : A) (x : P A) (y : P B) :
    I.compQ i (I.proj A x) (I.proj B y) = I.proj _ (SymOperad.comp (R := R) i x y)
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.SymOperadIdeal.compQ_mk
statement:
@[simp] lemma compQ_mk (i : A) (x : P A) (y : P B) :
    I.compQ i (Submodule.Quotient.mk x) (Submodule.Quotient.mk y) =
      Submodule.Quotient.mk (SymOperad.comp (R := R) i x y)
