name: Operad.SymOperadIdeal.projHom_app
statement: @[simp] lemma projHom_app (x : P A) : I.projHom.app A x = I.proj A x
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.SymOperadIdeal.mem_ker_projHom
statement: lemma mem_ker_projHom (x : P A) : x ∈ I.projHom.ker.sub A ↔ x ∈ I.sub A
proof:
:= by
  rw [SymOperadHom.mem_ker, projHom_app, proj_eq_zero_iff]

name: Operad.SymOperadIdeal.liftHom_proj
statement:
lemma liftHom_proj (φ : SymOperadHom R P Q)
    (h : ∀ (A : Type) [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A], ∀ x ∈ I.sub A, φ.app A x = 0) (x : P A) :
    (I.liftHom φ h).app A (I.proj A x) = φ.app A x
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.SymOperadIdeal.liftHom_mk
statement:
@[simp] lemma liftHom_mk (φ : SymOperadHom R P Q)
    (h : ∀ (A : Type) [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A], ∀ x ∈ I.sub A, φ.app A x = 0) (x : P A) :
    (I.liftHom φ h).app A (Submodule.Quotient.mk x) = φ.app A x
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.SymOperadIdeal.liftHom_comp_projHom
statement:
lemma liftHom_comp_projHom (φ : SymOperadHom R P Q)
    (h : ∀ (A : Type) [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A], ∀ x ∈ I.sub A, φ.app A x = 0) :
    (I.liftHom φ h).comp I.projHom = φ
proof:
:=
  SymOperadHom.ext fun _ _ _ _ => rfl

name: Operad.SymOperadIdeal.liftHom_unique
statement:
lemma liftHom_unique (φ : SymOperadHom R P Q)
    (h : ∀ (A : Type) [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A], ∀ x ∈ I.sub A, φ.app A x = 0)
    (ψ : SymOperadHom R I.Quot Q) (hψ : ψ.comp I.projHom = φ) : ψ = I.liftHom φ h
proof:
:= by
  refine SymOperadHom.ext fun A _ _ x => ?_
  obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := I.proj_surjective _ x
  rw [liftHom_proj, ← hψ]
  rfl

name: Operad.SymOperadHom.kerLift_proj
statement:
lemma kerLift_proj (φ : SymOperadHom R P Q) {A : Type} [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A]
    (x : P A) : φ.kerLift.app A (φ.ker.proj A x) = φ.app A x
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.SymOperadHom.kerLift_mk
statement:
@[simp] lemma kerLift_mk (φ : SymOperadHom R P Q) {A : Type} [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A]
    (x : P A) : φ.kerLift.app A (Submodule.Quotient.mk x) = φ.app A x
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.SymOperadHom.kerLift_injective
statement:
lemma kerLift_injective (φ : SymOperadHom R P Q) (A : Type) [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] :
    Function.Injective (φ.kerLift.app A)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← LinearMap.ker_eq_bot, Submodule.eq_bot_iff]
  intro z hz
  obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := φ.ker.proj_surjective _ z
  rw [LinearMap.mem_ker, kerLift_proj] at hz
  exact (φ.ker.proj_eq_zero_iff x).2 hz

name: Operad.SymOperadHom.kerLift_bijective
statement:
lemma kerLift_bijective (φ : SymOperadHom R P Q)
    (hφ : ∀ (A : Type) [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A], Function.Surjective (φ.app A))
    (A : Type) [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] : Function.Bijective (φ.kerLift.app A)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨φ.kerLift_injective A, fun y => ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := hφ A y
  exact ⟨φ.ker.proj A x, rfl⟩

name: Operad.FreeGrL.wtEqL_eq_vx
statement: theorem wtEqL_eq_vx [Algebra ℚ R] (n : ℕ) : wtEqL R V n A = vx R V n A
proof:
:= by
  refine le_antisymm (wtEqL_le_vx n) fun x hx => ?_
  have hx' : x ∈ wtEqL R V n A ⊔ ⨆ (m : ℕ) (_ : m ≠ n), wtEqL R V m A := by
    rw [← iSup_split_single (fun m => wtEqL R V m A) n, iSup_wtEqL]
    exact Submodule.mem_top
  obtain ⟨y, hy, z, hz, rfl⟩ := Submodule.mem_sup.1 hx'
  have hz' : z ∈ ⨆ (m : ℕ) (_ : m ≠ n), vx R V m A :=
    (iSup₂_mono fun m _ => wtEqL_le_vx m) hz
  have hz2 : z ∈ vx R V n A := by
    simpa using sub_mem hx (wtEqL_le_vx n hy)
  rw [Submodule.disjoint_def.1
    (iSupIndep_eigenspace_nat ((derSp (GrSpEnd.id R V)).app A) n) z hz2 hz', add_zero]
  exact hy

name: Operad.FreeGrL.star_eq_zero_of_wtEqL
statement:
theorem star_eq_zero_of_wtEqL {f g : GrOperad.Inv R (ConvOp R (FreeGrL R V) Q)} {n : ℕ}
    (h : ∀ a b : ℕ, a + b = n →
      (∀ (A : Type) [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] (x : FreeGrL R V A), x ∈ wtEqL R V a A →
        ConvOp.toLin (f.1 A) x = 0) ∨
      (∀ (B : Type) [Fintype B] [DecidableEq B] (x : FreeGrL R V B), x ∈ wtEqL R V b B →
        ConvOp.toLin (g.1 B) x = 0))
    {x : FreeGrL R V A} (hx : x ∈ wtEqL R V n A) :
    ConvOp.toLin ((GrOperad.Inv.star R _ f g).1 A) x = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [GrOperad.Inv.star_apply, ConvOp.toLin_sum, LinearMap.coe_sum, Finset.sum_apply]
  refine Finset.sum_eq_zero fun S _ => ?_
  show ConvOp.toLin (ConvOp.mapC (splitEquiv S)
    (ConvOp.compC none (f.1 (SOut S)) (g.1 (SIn S)))) x = 0
  rw [ConvOp.mapC_apply, ConvOp.toLin_compC, LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearMap.comp_apply]
  have hx' : SymSpecies.map (R := R) (splitEquiv S).symm x ∈ wtEqL R V n _ := by
    rw [symMap_eq]
    exact map_mem_wtEqL _ hx
  have hk := decomp_mem_wtEqL (none : SOut S) hx'
  have hle : (⨆ (a : ℕ) (b : ℕ) (_ : a + b = n), LinearMap.range (TensorProduct.map
      (wtEqL R V a (SOut S)).subtype (wtEqL R V b (SIn S)).subtype))
      ≤ LinearMap.ker (ConvOp.kap (f.1 (SOut S)) (g.1 (SIn S))) := by
    refine iSup_le fun a => iSup_le fun b => iSup_le fun hab => ?_
    rintro _ ⟨t, rfl⟩
    induction t using TensorProduct.induction_on with
    | zero => simp
    | tmul p q =>
      rw [LinearMap.mem_ker, TensorProduct.map_tmul]
      simp only [ConvOp.kap, LinearMap.coe_sum, Finset.sum_apply, TensorProduct.map_tmul]
      refine Finset.sum_eq_zero fun c _ => ?_
      rw [Submodule.subtype_apply, Submodule.subtype_apply, LinearMap.comp_apply]
      rcases h a b hab with hf | hg
      · have hp : GrSpecies.tw (R := R) c p.1 ∈ wtEqL R V a (SOut S) := by
          rw [GrSpecies.tw_apply]
          exact add_mem (par_mem_wtEqL false p.2) (Submodule.smul_mem _ _ (par_mem_wtEqL true p.2))
        rw [hf _ _ hp, TensorProduct.zero_tmul]
      · have hq : ∀ c' : Bool, ConvOp.toLin (g.1 (SIn S)) (GrSpecies.par (R := R) c' q.1) = 0 :=
          fun c' => hg _ _ (par_mem_wtEqL (V := V) c' q.2)
        rw [ConvOp.parC_apply, Finset.sum_eq_zero fun c' _ => by rw [hq c', map_zero],
          TensorProduct.tmul_zero]
    | add t t' ht ht' =>
      rw [LinearMap.mem_ker, map_add, map_add]
      rw [LinearMap.mem_ker] at ht ht'
      rw [ht, ht', add_zero]
  rw [LinearMap.mem_ker.1 (hle hk), map_zero, map_zero]

name: Operad.FreeGrL.star_eq_of_wtEqL_two
statement:
theorem star_eq_of_wtEqL_two {f f' : GrOperad.Inv R (ConvOp R (FreeGrL R V) Q)}
    (h0 : ∀ (A : Type) [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] (x : FreeGrL R V A), x ∈ wtEqL R V 0 A →
      ConvOp.toLin (f.1 A) x = 0)
    (h0' : ∀ (A : Type) [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] (x : FreeGrL R V A), x ∈ wtEqL R V 0 A →
      ConvOp.toLin (f'.1 A) x = 0)
    (h1 : ∀ (A : Type) [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] (x : FreeGrL R V A), x ∈ wtEqL R V 1 A →
      ConvOp.toLin (f.1 A) x = ConvOp.toLin (f'.1 A) x)
    {x : FreeGrL R V A} (hx : x ∈ wtEqL R V 2 A) :
    ConvOp.toLin ((GrOperad.Inv.star R _ f f).1 A) x
      = ConvOp.toLin ((GrOperad.Inv.star R _ f' f').1 A) x
proof:
:= by
  have hδ : ∀ (A : Type) [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] (x : FreeGrL R V A),
      ConvOp.toLin ((f - f').1 A) x = ConvOp.toLin (f.1 A) x - ConvOp.toLin (f'.1 A) x :=
    fun _ _ _ _ => rfl
  have hδ0 : ∀ (A : Type) [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] (x : FreeGrL R V A), x ∈ wtEqL R V 0 A →
      ConvOp.toLin ((f - f').1 A) x = 0 := fun _ _ _ _ hx => by
    rw [hδ, h0 _ _ hx, h0' _ _ hx, sub_zero]
  have hδ1 : ∀ (A : Type) [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] (x : FreeGrL R V A), x ∈ wtEqL R V 1 A →
      ConvOp.toLin ((f - f').1 A) x = 0 := fun _ _ _ _ hx => by
    rw [hδ, h1 _ _ hx, sub_self]
  have e1 : ConvOp.toLin ((GrOperad.Inv.star R _ (f - f') f).1 A) x = 0 :=
    star_eq_zero_of_wtEqL (fun a b hab => by
      rcases a with _ | _ | a
      · exact Or.inl hδ0
      · exact Or.inl hδ1
      · have hb : b = 0 := by omega
        subst hb
        exact Or.inr h0) hx
  have e2 : ConvOp.toLin ((GrOperad.Inv.star R _ f' (f - f')).1 A) x = 0 :=
    star_eq_zero_of_wtEqL (fun a b hab => by
      rcases b with _ | _ | b
      · exact Or.inr hδ0
      · exact Or.inr hδ1
      · have ha : a = 0 := by omega
        subst ha
        exact Or.inl h0') hx
  have k1 : ConvOp.toLin ((GrOperad.Inv.star R _ (f - f') f).1 A) x
      = ConvOp.toLin ((GrOperad.Inv.star R _ f f).1 A) x
        - ConvOp.toLin ((GrOperad.Inv.star R _ f' f).1 A) x := by
    rw [LinearMap.map_sub₂]
    rfl
  have k2 : ConvOp.toLin ((GrOperad.Inv.star R _ f' (f - f')).1 A) x
      = ConvOp.toLin ((GrOperad.Inv.star R _ f' f).1 A) x
        - ConvOp.toLin ((GrOperad.Inv.star R _ f' f').1 A) x := by
    rw [map_sub]
    rfl
  rw [k1] at e1
  rw [k2] at e2
  exact (sub_eq_zero.1 e1).trans (sub_eq_zero.1 e2)

name: Operad.Cobar.exists_eq_ιL
statement:
lemma exists_eq_ιL [Algebra ℚ R] {W : CobarGr R 𝒞 A} (hW : W ∈ vx R (CobarGen R 𝒞) 1 A) :
    ∃ c : 𝒞 A, W = Cobar.ιL R 𝒞 A c
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := GrCooperad.Red.proj_surjective (R := R) (C := 𝒞) A
    ((GrSpecies.Shift.of (R := R) (V := GrCooperad.Red R 𝒞) A).symm
      (genCoef R (CobarGen R 𝒞) A W))
  have hc' : GrSpecies.Shift.of (R := R) (V := GrCooperad.Red R 𝒞) A (GrCooperad.Red.proj R 𝒞 A c)
      = genCoef R (CobarGen R 𝒞) A W :=
    (congrArg _ hc).trans (LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply _ _)
  exact ⟨c, (eq_ι_genCoef hW).trans
    ((congrArg ((FreeGrL.ι R (CobarGen R 𝒞)).app A) hc'.symm).trans (Cobar.ιL_apply R 𝒞 c).symm)⟩

name: Operad.Cobar.mem_vx_one_sup
statement:
lemma mem_vx_one_sup (W : CobarGr R 𝒞 A) :
    W ∈ vx R (CobarGen R 𝒞) 1 A ⊔ ⨆ (m : ℕ) (_ : m ≠ 1), vx R (CobarGen R 𝒞) m A
proof:
:= by
  have htop : (⨆ m, vx R (CobarGen R 𝒞) m A) = ⊤ := iSup_vx A
  exact ((htop.symm.trans (iSup_split_single (fun m => vx R (CobarGen R 𝒞) m A) 1)).le :
    (⊤ : Submodule R (CobarGr R 𝒞 A)) ≤ _) Submodule.mem_top

name: Operad.Cobar.d_mem_iSup_ne
proof:
:=
  (iSup₂_le fun m hm w hw => Submodule.mem_iSup_of_mem (m + 1)
      (Submodule.mem_iSup_of_mem (by omega) (CobarMap.d_mem_vx R 𝒞 m hw)) :
    (⨆ (m : ℕ) (_ : m ≠ 1), vx R (CobarGen R 𝒞) m A)
      ≤ (⨆ (j : ℕ) (_ : j ≠ 2), vx R (CobarGen R 𝒞) j A).comap ((Cobar.d R 𝒞).app A)) hW

name: Operad.Cobar.exists_eq_d_ιL
statement:
theorem exists_eq_d_ιL [Algebra ℚ R] {Y W : CobarGr R 𝒞 A} (hY : Y ∈ vx R (CobarGen R 𝒞) 2 A)
    (hW : Y = (Cobar.d R 𝒞).app A W) :
    ∃ c : 𝒞 A, Y = (Cobar.d R 𝒞).app A (Cobar.ιL R 𝒞 A c)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨W₁, hW₁, W', hW', hWe⟩ := Submodule.mem_sup.1 (mem_vx_one_sup W)
  have hY' : Y = (Cobar.d R 𝒞).app A W₁ + (Cobar.d R 𝒞).app A W' :=
    hW.trans ((congrArg _ hWe.symm).trans (map_add _ _ _))
  have e : (Cobar.d R 𝒞).app A W' = Y - (Cobar.d R 𝒞).app A W₁ :=
    (add_sub_cancel_left _ _).symm.trans (congrArg (· - _) hY'.symm)
  have h0 : (Cobar.d R 𝒞).app A W' = 0 :=
    Submodule.disjoint_def.1
      (iSupIndep_eigenspace_nat ((derSp (GrSpEnd.id R (CobarGen R 𝒞))).app A) 2) _
      ((congrArg (fun t => t ∈ vx R (CobarGen R 𝒞) 2 A) e).mpr
        (sub_mem hY (CobarMap.d_mem_vx R 𝒞 1 hW₁))) (d_mem_iSup_ne hW')
  obtain ⟨c, e1⟩ := exists_eq_ιL hW₁
  exact ⟨c, hY'.trans ((congrArg₂ (· + ·) (congrArg ((Cobar.d R 𝒞).app A) e1) h0).trans
    (add_zero _))⟩

name: Operad.eq_tmul_of_mem_range_left
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨t, rfl⟩ := hs
  induction t using TensorProduct.induction_on with
  | zero => simp
  | tmul p q =>
    obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := Submodule.mem_span_singleton.1 (hP p.2)
    simp only [TensorProduct.map_tmul, LinearMap.rTensor_tmul, TensorProduct.lid_tmul,
      Submodule.subtype_apply, ← hc, map_smul, hu, smul_eq_mul, mul_one]
    exact ⟨Q.smul_mem c q.2, TensorProduct.smul_tmul c u q.1⟩
  | add t t' ht ht' =>
    simp only [map_add]
    exact ⟨add_mem ht.1 ht'.1, by rw [TensorProduct.tmul_add]; exact congrArg₂ (· + ·) ht.2 ht'.2⟩

name: Operad.eq_tmul_of_mem_range_right
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨t, rfl⟩ := hs
  induction t using TensorProduct.induction_on with
  | zero => simp
  | tmul p q =>
    obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := Submodule.mem_span_singleton.1 (hQ q.2)
    simp only [TensorProduct.map_tmul, LinearMap.lTensor_tmul, TensorProduct.rid_tmul,
      Submodule.subtype_apply, ← hc, map_smul, hu, smul_eq_mul, mul_one]
    exact ⟨P.smul_mem c p.2, (TensorProduct.smul_tmul c p.1 u).symm⟩
  | add t t' ht ht' =>
    simp only [map_add]
    exact ⟨add_mem ht.1 ht'.1, by rw [TensorProduct.add_tmul]; exact congrArg₂ (· + ·) ht.2 ht'.2⟩

name: Operad.rTensor_eq_zero_of_le_ker
statement:
lemma rTensor_eq_zero_of_le_ker {ε : M →ₗ[R] R} {P : Submodule R M} (hP : P ≤ LinearMap.ker ε)
    {Q : Submodule R N} {s : M ⊗[R] N}
    (hs : s ∈ LinearMap.range (TensorProduct.map P.subtype Q.subtype)) :
    LinearMap.rTensor N ε s = 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨t, rfl⟩ := hs
  induction t using TensorProduct.induction_on with
  | zero => simp
  | tmul p q =>
    rw [TensorProduct.map_tmul, LinearMap.rTensor_tmul, Submodule.subtype_apply,
      LinearMap.mem_ker.1 (hP p.2), TensorProduct.zero_tmul]
  | add t t' ht ht' => rw [map_add, map_add, ht, ht', add_zero]

name: Operad.lTensor_eq_zero_of_le_ker
statement:
lemma lTensor_eq_zero_of_le_ker {ε : N →ₗ[R] R} {Q : Submodule R N} (hQ : Q ≤ LinearMap.ker ε)
    {P : Submodule R M} {s : M ⊗[R] N}
    (hs : s ∈ LinearMap.range (TensorProduct.map P.subtype Q.subtype)) :
    LinearMap.lTensor M ε s = 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨t, rfl⟩ := hs
  induction t using TensorProduct.induction_on with
  | zero => simp
  | tmul p q =>
    rw [TensorProduct.map_tmul, LinearMap.lTensor_tmul, Submodule.subtype_apply,
      Submodule.subtype_apply, LinearMap.mem_ker.1 (hQ q.2), TensorProduct.tmul_zero]
  | add t t' ht ht' => rw [map_add, map_add, ht, ht', add_zero]

name: Operad.eq_zero_of_mem_range_bot_left
statement:
lemma eq_zero_of_mem_range_bot_left {P : Submodule R M} (hP : P = ⊥) {Q : Submodule R N}
    {s : M ⊗[R] N} (hs : s ∈ LinearMap.range (TensorProduct.map P.subtype Q.subtype)) : s = 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨t, rfl⟩ := hs
  induction t using TensorProduct.induction_on with
  | zero => simp
  | tmul p q =>
    have hp : (p : M) = 0 := (Submodule.mem_bot R).1 (hP ▸ p.2)
    rw [TensorProduct.map_tmul, Submodule.subtype_apply, hp, TensorProduct.zero_tmul]
  | add t t' ht ht' => rw [map_add, ht, ht', add_zero]

name: Operad.eq_zero_of_mem_range_bot_right
statement:
lemma eq_zero_of_mem_range_bot_right {Q : Submodule R N} (hQ : Q = ⊥) {P : Submodule R M}
    {s : M ⊗[R] N} (hs : s ∈ LinearMap.range (TensorProduct.map P.subtype Q.subtype)) : s = 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨t, rfl⟩ := hs
  induction t using TensorProduct.induction_on with
  | zero => simp
  | tmul p q =>
    have hq : (q : N) = 0 := (Submodule.mem_bot R).1 (hQ ▸ q.2)
    rw [TensorProduct.map_tmul, Submodule.subtype_apply (p := Q), hq, TensorProduct.tmul_zero]
  | add t t' ht ht' => rw [map_add, ht, ht', add_zero]

name: Operad.GrCooperad.exists_lid_counit_decomp
statement:
lemma exists_lid_counit_decomp (i : A) (hA : ∀ a : A, a = i) (x : C (Without A i ⊕ B)) :
    ∃ τ : Without A i ⊕ B ≃ B, TensorProduct.lid R (C B) (LinearMap.rTensor (C B)
      (GrCooperad.counit (R := R) (C := C) ∘ₗ SymSpecies.map (R := R) (unitEquivOf i hA).symm)
      (GrCooperad.decomp (R := R) (C := C) i x)) = SymSpecies.map (R := R) τ x
proof:
:= by
  set e := unitEquivOf i hA
  set σ := compEquiv e (Equiv.refl B) ()
  refine ⟨σ.symm.trans (leftUnitEquiv B), ?_⟩
  have hnat : GrCooperad.decomp (R := R) (C := C) i x
      = TensorProduct.map (SymSpecies.map (R := R) e) (SymSpecies.map (R := R) (Equiv.refl B))
        (GrCooperad.decomp (R := R) (C := C) () (SymSpecies.map (R := R) σ.symm x)) := by
    have h := LinearMap.congr_fun (GrCooperad.decomp_map (R := R) (C := C) e (Equiv.refl B) ())
      (SymSpecies.map (R := R) σ.symm x)
    rw [LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearMap.comp_apply, SymSpecies.map_map_symm] at h
    exact h
  have hcl := LinearMap.congr_fun (GrCooperad.counit_left (R := R) (C := C) (B := B))
    (SymSpecies.map (R := R) (leftUnitEquiv B) (SymSpecies.map (R := R) σ.symm x))
  simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearEquiv.coe_coe, SymSpecies.map_symm_map,
    LinearMap.id_apply] at hcl
  refine Eq.trans ?_ ((SymSpecies.map_trans (R := R) σ.symm (leftUnitEquiv B) x).trans
    hcl.symm).symm
  rw [hnat]
  generalize GrCooperad.decomp (R := R) (C := C) () (SymSpecies.map (R := R) σ.symm x) = s
  induction s using TensorProduct.induction_on with
  | zero => simp
  | tmul a b =>
    simp only [TensorProduct.map_tmul, LinearMap.rTensor_tmul, LinearMap.comp_apply,
      TensorProduct.lid_tmul, SymSpecies.map_symm_map, SymSpecies.map_refl]
  | add s s' hs hs' => simp only [map_add, hs, hs']

name: Operad.GrCooperad.exists_rid_counit_decomp
statement:
lemma exists_rid_counit_decomp (i : A) (j : B) (hB : ∀ b : B, b = j)
    (x : C (Without A i ⊕ B)) :
    ∃ τ : Without A i ⊕ B ≃ A, TensorProduct.rid R (C A) (LinearMap.lTensor (C A)
      (GrCooperad.counit (R := R) (C := C) ∘ₗ SymSpecies.map (R := R) (unitEquivOf j hB).symm)
      (GrCooperad.decomp (R := R) (C := C) i x)) = SymSpecies.map (R := R) τ x
proof:
:= by
  set e := unitEquivOf j hB
  set σ := compEquiv (Equiv.refl A) e i
  refine ⟨σ.symm.trans (rightUnitEquiv i), ?_⟩
  have hnat : GrCooperad.decomp (R := R) (C := C) i x
      = TensorProduct.map (SymSpecies.map (R := R) (Equiv.refl A)) (SymSpecies.map (R := R) e)
        (GrCooperad.decomp (R := R) (C := C) i (SymSpecies.map (R := R) σ.symm x)) := by
    have h := LinearMap.congr_fun (GrCooperad.decomp_map (R := R) (C := C) (Equiv.refl A) e i)
      (SymSpecies.map (R := R) σ.symm x)
    rw [LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearMap.comp_apply, SymSpecies.map_map_symm] at h
    exact h
  have hcl := LinearMap.congr_fun (GrCooperad.counit_right (R := R) (C := C) i)
    (SymSpecies.map (R := R) (rightUnitEquiv i) (SymSpecies.map (R := R) σ.symm x))
  simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearEquiv.coe_coe, SymSpecies.map_symm_map,
    LinearMap.id_apply] at hcl
  refine Eq.trans ?_ ((SymSpecies.map_trans (R := R) σ.symm (rightUnitEquiv i) x).trans
    hcl.symm).symm
  rw [hnat]
  generalize GrCooperad.decomp (R := R) (C := C) i (SymSpecies.map (R := R) σ.symm x) = s
  induction s using TensorProduct.induction_on with
  | zero => simp
  | tmul a b =>
    simp only [TensorProduct.map_tmul, LinearMap.lTensor_tmul, LinearMap.comp_apply,
      TensorProduct.rid_tmul, SymSpecies.map_symm_map, SymSpecies.map_refl]
  | add s s' hs hs' => simp only [map_add, hs, hs']

name: Operad.GrOperad.Inv.toLin_map
statement:
lemma GrOperad.Inv.toLin_map {C : (A : Type) → [Fintype A] → [DecidableEq A] → Type v}
    [∀ (A : Type) [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A], AddCommGroup (C A)]
    [∀ (A : Type) [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A], Module R (C A)] [GrCooperad R C]
    {P : (A : Type) → [Fintype A] → [DecidableEq A] → Type w}
    [∀ (A : Type) [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A], AddCommGroup (P A)]
    [∀ (A : Type) [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A], Module R (P A)] [GrOperad R P]
    (q : GrOperad.Inv R (ConvOp R C P)) (e : A ≃ B) (y : C A) :
    ConvOp.toLin (q.1 B) (SymSpecies.map (R := R) e y)
      = GrOperad.map (R := R) e (ConvOp.toLin (q.1 A) y)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← GrOperad.Inv.map_apply q e]
  show GrOperad.map (R := R) e (ConvOp.toLin (q.1 A)
    (SymSpecies.map (R := R) e.symm (SymSpecies.map (R := R) e y))) = _
  rw [SymSpecies.map_symm_map]

name: Operad.FreeGrL.wtEqL_le_wtOneL
statement: lemma wtEqL_le_wtOneL {n : ℕ} (hn : n ≤ 1) : wtEqL R V n A ≤ wtOneL R V A
proof:
:=
  Submodule.map_mono (Submodule.span_mono fun _ ⟨x, hx, h⟩ => ⟨x, by omega, h⟩)

name: Operad.FreeGrL.unitCoeffL_wtEqL
statement:
lemma unitCoeffL_wtEqL {n : ℕ} (hn : n ≠ 0) {x : FreeGrL R V A} (hx : x ∈ wtEqL R V n A) :
    unitCoeffL R V A x = 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨z, hz, rfl⟩ := hx
  refine Submodule.span_induction (p := fun z _ => unitCoeffL R V A ((𝒥).proj A z) = 0)
    ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ hz
  · rintro _ ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩
    refine unitCoeffL_proj_bas (Bool.eq_false_iff.2 fun h => hn ?_)
    have hw : FreeGr.vtx y = (FreeGr.treeOf y).weight := Tree.cnt_one _
    rw [← hy, hw, Tree.eq_leaf_of_isLeaf h, Tree.weight_leaf]
  · simp
  · intro a b _ _ ha hb
    rw [map_add, map_add, ha, hb, add_zero]
  · intro c a _ ha
    rw [map_smul, map_smul, ha, smul_zero]

name: Operad.FreeGrL.counit_map_wtEqL
proof:
:= by
  rw [counit_eq_unitCoeffL, symMap_eq, unitCoeffL_map]
  exact unitCoeffL_wtEqL hn hx

name: Operad.FreeGrL.counit_map_map_one
statement:
lemma counit_map_map_one (e : Unit ≃ A) :
    GrCooperad.counit (R := R) (C := FreeGrL R V) (SymSpecies.map (R := R) e.symm
      (SymSpecies.map (R := R) e (GrCooperad.Coaug.one (R := R) (C := FreeGrL R V)))) = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [SymSpecies.map_symm_map]
  exact GrCooperad.Coaug.counit_one

name: Operad.FreeGrL.wtEqL_zero_le_span
statement:
lemma wtEqL_zero_le_span (i : A) (hA : ∀ a : A, a = i) :
    wtEqL R V 0 A ≤ R ∙ SymSpecies.map (R := R) (unitEquivOf i hA)
      (GrCooperad.Coaug.one (R := R) (C := FreeGrL R V))
proof:
:= by
  refine wtEqL_zero_le_unitSpan.trans ?_
  rw [GrCooperad.unitSpan, GrCooperad.unitSpanOf, Submodule.span_le]
  rintro _ ⟨e, rfl⟩
  have he : e = unitEquivOf i hA := Equiv.ext fun u => hA (e u)
  rw [he]
  exact Submodule.mem_span_singleton_self _

name: Operad.FreeGrL.wtEqL_zero_eq_bot
statement: lemma wtEqL_zero_eq_bot (h : IsEmpty (Unit ≃ A)) : wtEqL R V 0 A = ⊥
proof:
:= by
  refine eq_bot_iff.2 (wtEqL_zero_le_unitSpan.trans ?_)
  rw [GrCooperad.unitSpan, GrCooperad.unitSpanOf, Submodule.span_le]
  rintro _ ⟨e, rfl⟩
  exact h.elim e

name: Operad.FreeGrL.exists_split_two
statement:
lemma exists_split_two {t : FreeGrL R V A ⊗[R] FreeGrL R V B}
    (ht : t ∈ ⨆ (a : ℕ) (b : ℕ) (_ : a + b = 2),
      LinearMap.range (TensorProduct.map (wtEqL R V a A).subtype (wtEqL R V b B).subtype)) :
    ∃ t₀ ∈ LinearMap.range (TensorProduct.map (wtEqL R V 0 A).subtype (wtEqL R V 2 B).subtype),
    ∃ t₁ ∈ LinearMap.range (TensorProduct.map (wtEqL R V 1 A).subtype (wtEqL R V 1 B).subtype),
    ∃ t₂ ∈ LinearMap.range (TensorProduct.map (wtEqL R V 2 A).subtype (wtEqL R V 0 B).subtype),
      t = t₀ + t₁ + t₂
proof:
:= by
  have hle : (⨆ (a : ℕ) (b : ℕ) (_ : a + b = 2),
      LinearMap.range (TensorProduct.map (wtEqL R V a A).subtype (wtEqL R V b B).subtype))
      ≤ LinearMap.range (TensorProduct.map (wtEqL R V 0 A).subtype (wtEqL R V 2 B).subtype)
        ⊔ LinearMap.range (TensorProduct.map (wtEqL R V 1 A).subtype (wtEqL R V 1 B).subtype)
        ⊔ LinearMap.range (TensorProduct.map (wtEqL R V 2 A).subtype (wtEqL R V 0 B).subtype) := by
    refine iSup_le fun a => iSup_le fun b => iSup_le fun hab => ?_
    rcases a with _ | _ | _ | a
    · have hb : b = 2 := by omega
      subst hb
      exact le_sup_left.trans le_sup_left
    · have hb : b = 1 := by omega
      subst hb
      exact le_sup_right.trans le_sup_left
    · have hb : b = 0 := by omega
      subst hb
      exact le_sup_right
    · omega
  obtain ⟨t', ht', t₂, ht₂, rfl⟩ := Submodule.mem_sup.1 (hle ht)
  obtain ⟨t₀, ht₀, t₁, ht₁, rfl⟩ := Submodule.mem_sup.1 ht'
  exact ⟨t₀, ht₀, t₁, ht₁, t₂, ht₂, rfl⟩

name: Operad.Koszul.lamHom_ι
statement:
lemma lamHom_ι (v : E A) :
    (lamHom R E).app A ((FreeGrL.ι R E).app A v)
      = Cobar.ιL R 𝒞 A ((FreeGrL.ι R 𝒱).app A (GrSpecies.Shift.of A v))
proof:
:= by
  rw [lamHom, mapSp_ι]
  rfl

name: Operad.Koszul.kapL_unitSpan
statement: lemma kapL_unitSpan {x : Cut R E A} (hx : x ∈ GrCooperad.unitSpan R 𝒞 A) : kapL R E A x = 0
proof:
:= by
  have h := killsUnit_kapT (R := R) (E := E) A x hx
  rwa [kapT_apply, ConvOp.toLin_of] at h

name: Operad.Koszul.kapHom_ιL
statement: lemma kapHom_ιL (x : Cut R E A) : (kapHom R E).app A (Cobar.ιL R 𝒞 A x) = kapL R E A x
proof:
:=
  FreeGrL.homEquiv_symm_ι (kapGen R E) _

name: Operad.Koszul.kapHom_lamHom
statement: lemma kapHom_lamHom (z : FreeGrL R E A) : (kapHom R E).app A ((lamHom R E).app A z) = z
proof:
:= by
  have h : (kapHom R E).comp (lamHom R E) = GrOperadHom.id R (FreeGrL R E) :=
    hom_ext fun A _ _ v => by
      rw [GrOperadHom.comp_app, lamHom_ι, kapHom_ιL, kapL_ι]
      rfl
  exact congrArg (fun g : GrOperadHom R (FreeGrL R E) (FreeGrL R E) => g.app A z) h

name: Operad.Koszul.kapHom_ιι
statement:
lemma kapHom_ιι (x : Cut R E A) :
    (kapHom R E).app A (ConvOp.toLin ((Cobar.ιι R 𝒞).1 A) x) = starKap R E A x
proof:
:= by
  have e2 := GrOperad.Inv.appHom_star (ConvOp.postHom (C := 𝒞) (kapHom R E))
    (Cobar.ι R 𝒞) (Cobar.ι R 𝒞)
  have e3 : GrOperad.Inv.appHom (ConvOp.postHom (C := 𝒞) (kapHom R E)) (Cobar.ι R 𝒞)
      = kapT R E :=
    Subtype.ext (funext fun A => funext fun _ => funext fun _ =>
      ConvOp.ext fun x => kapHom_ιL x)
  have e := congrArg (fun q : GrOperad.Inv R (ConvOp R 𝒞 (FreeGrL R E)) =>
    ConvOp.toLin (q.1 A) x) (e2.trans (congrArg₂ (fun a b =>
      GrOperad.Inv.star R (ConvOp R 𝒞 (FreeGrL R E)) a b) e3 e3))
  simp only [GrOperad.Inv.appHom_apply, ConvOp.postHom_app, LinearMap.comp_apply] at e
  exact e

name: Operad.Koszul.lamKap_apply
statement:
lemma lamKap_apply (x : Cut R E A) :
    ConvOp.toLin ((lamKap R E).1 A) x = (lamHom R E).app A (kapL R E A x)
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.Koszul.lamHom_starKap
statement:
lemma lamHom_starKap (x : Cut R E A) :
    (lamHom R E).app A (starKap R E A x)
      = ConvOp.toLin ((GrOperad.Inv.star R _ (lamKap R E) (lamKap R E)).1 A) x
proof:
:= by
  have e := congrArg (fun q : GrOperad.Inv R (ConvOp R 𝒞 (CobarGr R 𝒞)) =>
    ConvOp.toLin (q.1 A) x) (GrOperad.Inv.appHom_star
      (ConvOp.postHom (C := 𝒞) (lamHom R E)) (kapT R E) (kapT R E))
  simp only [GrOperad.Inv.appHom_apply, ConvOp.postHom_app, LinearMap.comp_apply] at e
  exact e

name: Operad.Koszul.lamKap_wtEqL_zero
statement:
lemma lamKap_wtEqL_zero {x : Cut R E A} (hx : x ∈ wtEqL R 𝒱 0 A) :
    ConvOp.toLin ((lamKap R E).1 A) x = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [lamKap_apply, kapL_unitSpan (wtEqL_zero_le_unitSpan hx), map_zero]

name: Operad.Koszul.ι_wtEqL_zero
statement:
lemma ι_wtEqL_zero {x : Cut R E A} (hx : x ∈ wtEqL R 𝒱 0 A) :
    ConvOp.toLin ((Cobar.ι R 𝒞).1 A) x = 0
proof:
:=
  Cobar.ιL_unitSpan R 𝒞 (wtEqL_zero_le_unitSpan hx)

name: Operad.Koszul.lamKap_wtEqL_one
statement:
lemma lamKap_wtEqL_one [CharZero R] {y : Cut R E A} (hy : y ∈ wtEqL R 𝒱 1 A) :
    ConvOp.toLin ((lamKap R E).1 A) y = ConvOp.toLin ((Cobar.ι R 𝒞).1 A) y
proof:
:= by
  have hy' : y = (FreeGrL.ι R 𝒱).app A (GrSpecies.Shift.of A
      ((GrSpecies.Shift.of (R := R) (V := E) A).symm (genCoef R 𝒱 A y))) := by
    rw [LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply]
    exact eq_ι_genCoef (wtEqL_le_vx 1 hy)
  show (lamHom R E).app A (kapL R E A y) = Cobar.ιL R 𝒞 A y
  rw [hy', kapL_ι, lamHom_ι]

name: Operad.Koszul.ιι_ι
statement:
lemma ιι_ι [CharZero R] (w : 𝒱 A) :
    ConvOp.toLin ((Cobar.ιι R 𝒞).1 A) ((FreeGrL.ι R 𝒱).app A w) = 0
proof:
:=
  star_eq_zero_of_wtEqL (f := Cobar.ι R 𝒞) (g := Cobar.ι R 𝒞) (n := 1) (fun a b hab => by
    rcases a with _ | a
    · refine Or.inl ?_
      intro B _ _ x hx
      exact ι_wtEqL_zero hx
    · have hb : b = 0 := by omega
      subst hb
      refine Or.inr ?_
      intro B _ _ x hx
      exact ι_wtEqL_zero hx)
    ((wtEqL_eq_vx 1).ge (ι_mem_vx w))

name: Operad.Koszul.star_lamKap
statement:
lemma star_lamKap [CharZero R] {y : Cut R E A} (hy : y ∈ wtEqL R 𝒱 2 A) :
    ConvOp.toLin ((GrOperad.Inv.star R _ (lamKap R E) (lamKap R E)).1 A) y
      = ConvOp.toLin ((Cobar.ιι R 𝒞).1 A) y
proof:
:=
  star_eq_of_wtEqL_two (f := lamKap R E) (f' := Cobar.ι R 𝒞)
    (fun _ _ _ _ hx => lamKap_wtEqL_zero hx) (fun _ _ _ _ hx => ι_wtEqL_zero hx)
    (fun _ _ _ _ hx => lamKap_wtEqL_one hx) hy

name: Operad.Koszul.eq_zero_of_starKap_eq_zero
statement:
theorem eq_zero_of_starKap_eq_zero [CharZero R] (hE0 : ∀ v : E (Fin 0), v = 0) {y : Cut R E A}
    (hy : y ∈ wtEqL R 𝒱 2 A) (h0 : starKap R E A y = 0) : y = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hV0 : ∀ v : 𝒱 (Fin 0), v = 0 := hE0
  have hι : ConvOp.toLin ((Cobar.ιι R 𝒞).1 A) y = 0 := by
    rw [← star_lamKap hy, ← lamHom_starKap, h0, map_zero]
  have hd : (Cobar.d R 𝒞).app A (Cobar.ιL R 𝒞 A y) = 0 := by
    rw [Cobar.d_ιL, hι, neg_zero]
  exact Cobar.eq_zero_of_ιL (by norm_num) (wtEqL_le_vx 2 hy)
    (Cobar.eq_zero_of_d_ιL hV0 le_rfl (wtEqL_le_vx 2 hy) hd)

name: Operad.Koszul.lamHom_mem_vx
statement:
lemma lamHom_mem_vx {n : ℕ} {z : FreeGrL R E A} (hz : z ∈ vx R E n A) :
    (lamHom R E).app A z ∈ vx R (CobarGen R 𝒞) n A
proof:
:= by
  refine mem_eig.2 ?_
  have e := derSp_mapSp (a := GrSpEnd.id R E) (b := GrSpEnd.id R (CobarGen R 𝒞))
    (φ := lamGen R E) (fun _ _ _ v => rfl) z
  exact e.trans ((congrArg ((mapSp (lamGen R E)).app A) (mem_eig.1 hz)).trans (map_smul _ _ _))

name: Operad.Koszul.d_lamHom
statement:
lemma d_lamHom [CharZero R] (z : FreeGrL R E A) :
    (Cobar.d R 𝒞).app A ((lamHom R E).app A z) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have h : (Cobar.d R 𝒞).compHom (lamHom R E) = GrDer.zero (lamHom R E) true :=
    der_eq_zero fun A _ _ v => by
      rw [GrDer.compHom_app, lamHom_ι, Cobar.d_ιL, ιι_ι, neg_zero]
  exact congrArg (fun D : GrDer (lamHom R E) true => D.app A z) h

name: Operad.Koszul.wtΩ_lamHom
statement:
lemma wtΩ_lamHom (z : FreeGrL R E A) :
    (Cobar.wtΩ R 𝒱).app A ((lamHom R E).app A z)
      = (lamHom R E).app A ((FreeGrL.wtD R E).app A z)
proof:
:= by
  have h : (Cobar.wtΩ R 𝒱).compHom (lamHom R E)
      = GrDer.homComp (lamHom R E) (FreeGrL.wtD R E) :=
    der_ext fun A _ _ v => by
      show (Cobar.wtΩ R 𝒱).app A ((lamHom R E).app A ((FreeGrL.ι R E).app A v))
        = (lamHom R E).app A ((FreeGrL.wtD R E).app A ((FreeGrL.ι R E).app A v))
      have e1 := FreeGrL.wtD_ι (R := R) (V := E) v
      have e2 := lamHom_ι (R := R) (E := E) v
      have e3 := Cobar.wtΩ_ιL (R := R) (V := 𝒱) ((FreeGrL.ι R 𝒱).app A (GrSpecies.Shift.of A v))
      have e4 := FreeGrL.wtD_ι (R := R) (V := 𝒱) (GrSpecies.Shift.of A v)
      exact (congrArg _ e2).trans (e3.trans ((congrArg _ e4).trans
        (e2.symm.trans (congrArg _ e1.symm))))
  exact congrArg (fun D : GrDer (lamHom R E) false => D.app A z) h

name: Operad.Koszul.lamHom_eq_d_hM
proof:
:= by
  have hV0 : ∀ v : 𝒱 (Fin 0), v = 0 := hE0
  have hc := Cobar.dh_hd hV0 ((lamHom R E).app A z)
  have h0 : Cobar.hM R 𝒱 A ((Cobar.d R 𝒞).app A ((lamHom R E).app A z)) = 0 :=
    (congrArg (Cobar.hM R 𝒱 A) (d_lamHom z)).trans (map_zero _)
  have h1 := (add_zero _).symm.trans
    ((congrArg (fun t => (Cobar.d R 𝒞).app A (Cobar.hM R 𝒱 A ((lamHom R E).app A z)) + t)
      h0).symm.trans hc)
  have hw : (Cobar.wtΩ R 𝒱).app A ((lamHom R E).app A z) = (2 : R) • (lamHom R E).app A z :=
    (wtΩ_lamHom z).trans ((congrArg ((lamHom R E).app A)
      ((congrArg (fun D : GrDer (GrOperadHom.id R (FreeGrL R E)) false => D.app A z)
        Cobar.wtD_eq_derSp).trans ((mem_eig.1 hz).trans (by norm_num)))).trans (map_smul _ _ _))
  have hu0 : (0 : R) = 2 * FreeGrL.unitCoeffL R (CobarGen R 𝒞) A ((lamHom R E).app A z) :=
    calc (0 : R) = FreeGrL.unitCoeffL R (CobarGen R 𝒞) A
          ((Cobar.d R 𝒞).app A (Cobar.hM R 𝒱 A ((lamHom R E).app A z))) :=
          (Cobar.unitCoeffL_d hV0 _).symm
      _ = _ := congrArg _ h1
      _ = _ := map_sub _ _ _
      _ = FreeGrL.unitCoeffL R (CobarGen R 𝒞) A ((2 : R) • (lamHom R E).app A z) - 0 :=
          congrArg₂ (· - ·) (congrArg _ hw) (FreeGrL.unitCoeffL_secC _)
      _ = _ := (sub_zero _).trans ((map_smul _ _ _).trans (smul_eq_mul _ _))
  have hu : FreeGrL.unitCoeffL R (CobarGen R 𝒞) A ((lamHom R E).app A z) = 0 :=
    (mul_eq_zero.1 hu0.symm).resolve_left two_ne_zero
  have hS := FreeGrL.secC_of_unitCoeff hu
  linear_combination (norm := module) -h1 - hw + hS

name: Operad.Koszul.exists_wtEqL_two_starKap
statement:
lemma exists_wtEqL_two_starKap [CharZero R] (c : Cut R E A) :
    ∃ c₂ ∈ wtEqL R 𝒱 2 A, starKap R E A c₂ = starKap R E A c
proof:
:= by
  have htop : (⨆ n, wtEqL R 𝒱 n A) = ⊤ := iSup_wtEqL A
  have hc2 := ((htop.symm.trans (iSup_split_single (fun n => wtEqL R 𝒱 n A) 2)).le :
    (⊤ : Submodule R (Cut R E A)) ≤ _) (Submodule.mem_top (x := c))
  obtain ⟨c₂, hc₂, c', hc', hce⟩ := Submodule.mem_sup.1 hc2
  have hk : starKap R E A c' = 0 :=
    (iSup₂_le fun n hn w hw => LinearMap.mem_ker.2 (star_wtEqL hn hw) :
      (⨆ (n : ℕ) (_ : n ≠ 2), wtEqL R 𝒱 n A) ≤ LinearMap.ker (starKap R E A)) hc'
  exact ⟨c₂, hc₂, ((add_zero _).symm.trans (congrArg (_ + ·) hk.symm)).trans
    ((map_add _ _ _).symm.trans (congrArg _ hce))⟩

name: Operad.Koszul.exists_starKap
statement:
theorem exists_starKap [CharZero R] (hE0 : ∀ v : E (Fin 0), v = 0) {z : FreeGrL R E A}
    (hz : z ∈ vx R E 2 A) : ∃ y ∈ wtEqL R 𝒱 2 A, starKap R E A y = z
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := Cobar.exists_eq_d_ιL (lamHom_mem_vx hz) (lamHom_eq_d_hM hE0 hz)
  obtain ⟨c₂, hc₂, he⟩ := exists_wtEqL_two_starKap (-c)
  refine ⟨c₂, hc₂, he.trans ?_⟩
  calc starKap R E A (-c) = -starKap R E A c := map_neg _ _
    _ = -(kapHom R E).app A (ConvOp.toLin ((Cobar.ιι R 𝒞).1 A) c) :=
        congrArg Neg.neg (kapHom_ιι c).symm
    _ = (kapHom R E).app A (-ConvOp.toLin ((Cobar.ιι R 𝒞).1 A) c) := (map_neg _ _).symm
    _ = (kapHom R E).app A ((Cobar.d R 𝒞).app A (Cobar.ιL R 𝒞 A c)) :=
        congrArg _ (Cobar.d_ιL R 𝒞 c).symm
    _ = (kapHom R E).app A ((lamHom R E).app A z) := congrArg _ hc.symm
    _ = z := kapHom_lamHom z

name: Operad.Koszul.starKap_mem_wtEqL
statement: lemma starKap_mem_wtEqL [CharZero R] (x : Cut R E A) : starKap R E A x ∈ wtEqL R E 2 A
proof:
:=
  (wtEqL_eq_vx 2).ge (star_mem_vx x)

name: Operad.Koszul.starEquiv_apply
statement:
lemma starEquiv_apply [CharZero R] (hE0 : ∀ v : E (Fin 0), v = 0)
    (y : wtEqL R 𝒱 2 A) : (starEquiv R E hE0 A y : FreeGrL R E A) = starKap R E A y
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.Koszul.bijOn_starKap
statement:
theorem bijOn_starKap [CharZero R] (hE0 : ∀ v : E (Fin 0), v = 0) :
    Set.BijOn (starKap R E A) (wtEqL R 𝒱 2 A) (wtEqL R E 2 A)
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun y _ => starKap_mem_wtEqL y,
   fun y hy y' hy' h => sub_eq_zero.1 (eq_zero_of_starKap_eq_zero hE0 (sub_mem hy hy')
     ((map_sub _ _ _).trans (sub_eq_zero.2 h))),
   fun z hz => by
    obtain ⟨y, hy, he⟩ := exists_starKap hE0 (wtEqL_le_vx 2 hz)
    exact ⟨y, hy, he⟩⟩

name: Operad.Koszul.map_coRel
statement:
theorem map_coRel [CharZero R] (hq : IsQuadratic R E r) (hE0 : ∀ v : E (Fin 0), v = 0) :
    (coRel R E r A).map (starKap R E A) = relSp R E r A
proof:
:= by
  refine le_antisymm ?_ fun ρ hρ => ?_
  · rintro _ ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
    exact hx.2
  · obtain ⟨y, hy, he⟩ := exists_starKap hE0 (relSp_le_vx hq hρ)
    refine ⟨y, ⟨hy, ?_⟩, he⟩
    show starKap R E A y ∈ relSp R E r A
    rw [he]
    exact hρ

name: Operad.Koszul.coRelEquiv_apply
statement:
lemma coRelEquiv_apply [CharZero R] (hq : IsQuadratic R E r)
    (hE0 : ∀ v : E (Fin 0), v = 0) (y : coRel R E r A) :
    (coRelEquiv R E r hq hE0 A y : FreeGrL R E A) = starKap R E A y
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.Koszul.starKap_par
statement:
lemma starKap_par (b : Bool) (x : Cut R E A) :
    starKap R E A (GrSpecies.par (R := R) b x) = GrOperad.par (R := R) b (starKap R E A x)
proof:
:= by
  have h := ConvOp.parC_eq_self_iff.1 (GrOperad.Inv.isPar_star (isPar_kapT (R := R) (E := E))
    (isPar_kapT (R := R) (E := E)) A) b x
  exact h.trans (by cases b <;> rfl)

name: Operad.Koszul.par_mem_coRel
statement:
lemma par_mem_coRel (b : Bool) {x : Cut R E A} (hx : x ∈ coRel R E r A) :
    GrSpecies.par (R := R) b x ∈ coRel R E r A
proof:
:=
  ⟨par_mem_wtEqL b hx.1, show starKap R E A (GrSpecies.par (R := R) b x) ∈ relSp R E r A by
    rw [starKap_par]
    exact par_mem_relSp b hx.2⟩

name: Operad.Koszul.map_mem_coRel
statement:
lemma map_mem_coRel {B : Type} [Fintype B] [DecidableEq B] (σ' : A ≃ B) {x : Cut R E A}
    (hx : x ∈ coRel R E r A) : SymSpecies.map (R := R) σ' x ∈ coRel R E r B
proof:
:=
  ⟨by rw [symMap_eq]; exact map_mem_wtEqL σ' hx.1,
   show starKap R E B (SymSpecies.map (R := R) σ' x) ∈ relSp R E r B by
    rw [starKap, GrOperad.Inv.toLin_map]
    exact map_mem_relSp σ' hx.2⟩

name: Operad.Koszul.decomp_left_mem
statement:
lemma decomp_left_mem [CharZero R] {B : Type} [Fintype B] [DecidableEq B] (i : A)
    {x : Cut R E (Without A i ⊕ B)} (hx : x ∈ coRel R E r _)
    {t₀ t₁ t₂ : Cut R E A ⊗[R] Cut R E B}
    (h₀ : t₀ ∈ LinearMap.range (TensorProduct.map (wtEqL R 𝒱 0 A).subtype
      (wtEqL R 𝒱 2 B).subtype))
    (h₁ : t₁ ∈ LinearMap.range (TensorProduct.map (wtEqL R 𝒱 1 A).subtype
      (wtEqL R 𝒱 1 B).subtype))
    (h₂ : t₂ ∈ LinearMap.range (TensorProduct.map (wtEqL R 𝒱 2 A).subtype
      (wtEqL R 𝒱 0 B).subtype))
    (ht : GrCooperad.decomp (R := R) (C := 𝒞) i x = t₀ + t₁ + t₂) :
    t₀ ∈ LinearMap.range (TensorProduct.map (wtOneL R 𝒱 A ⊔ coRel R E r A).subtype
      (wtOneL R 𝒱 B ⊔ coRel R E r B).subtype)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hA : ∀ a : A, a = i
  · obtain ⟨τ, hτ⟩ := GrCooperad.exists_lid_counit_decomp (R := R) (C := 𝒞) i hA x
    set u := SymSpecies.map (R := R) (unitEquivOf i hA)
      (GrCooperad.Coaug.one (R := R) (C := 𝒞))
    set ε := GrCooperad.counit (R := R) (C := 𝒞) ∘ₗ
      SymSpecies.map (R := R) (unitEquivOf i hA).symm
    have hu : ε u = 1 := counit_map_map_one _
    obtain ⟨hy, hte⟩ := eq_tmul_of_mem_range_left hu (wtEqL_zero_le_span i hA) h₀
    have k₁ : LinearMap.rTensor _ ε t₁ = 0 := rTensor_eq_zero_of_le_ker (ε := ε)
      (fun p hp => LinearMap.mem_ker.2 (counit_map_wtEqL one_ne_zero _ hp)) h₁
    have k₂ : LinearMap.rTensor _ ε t₂ = 0 := rTensor_eq_zero_of_le_ker (ε := ε)
      (fun p hp => LinearMap.mem_ker.2 (counit_map_wtEqL two_ne_zero _ hp)) h₂
    have hy' : TensorProduct.lid R _ (LinearMap.rTensor _ ε t₀) ∈ coRel R E r B := by
      have e : TensorProduct.lid R _ (LinearMap.rTensor _ ε t₀) = SymSpecies.map (R := R) τ x := by
        rw [← hτ, ht]
        simp only [map_add, k₁, k₂, add_zero]
      rw [e]
      exact map_mem_coRel r τ hx
    have hu' : u ∈ wtOneL R 𝒱 A ⊔ coRel R E r A :=
      Submodule.mem_sup_left (wtEqL_le_wtOneL (n := 0) zero_le_one
        ((wtEqL_eq_vx 0).ge (Cobar.unitSpan_le_vx (GrCooperad.map_one_mem _))))
    rw [hte]
    exact ⟨⟨u, hu'⟩ ⊗ₜ ⟨_, Submodule.mem_sup_right hy'⟩, rfl⟩
  · have hE : IsEmpty (Unit ≃ A) := ⟨fun e => hA fun a =>
      e.symm.injective (Subsingleton.elim _ _)⟩
    rw [eq_zero_of_mem_range_bot_left (wtEqL_zero_eq_bot hE) h₀]
    exact zero_mem _

name: Operad.Koszul.decomp_right_mem
statement:
lemma decomp_right_mem [CharZero R] {B : Type} [Fintype B] [DecidableEq B] (i : A)
    {x : Cut R E (Without A i ⊕ B)} (hx : x ∈ coRel R E r _)
    {t₀ t₁ t₂ : Cut R E A ⊗[R] Cut R E B}
    (h₀ : t₀ ∈ LinearMap.range (TensorProduct.map (wtEqL R 𝒱 0 A).subtype
      (wtEqL R 𝒱 2 B).subtype))
    (h₁ : t₁ ∈ LinearMap.range (TensorProduct.map (wtEqL R 𝒱 1 A).subtype
      (wtEqL R 𝒱 1 B).subtype))
    (h₂ : t₂ ∈ LinearMap.range (TensorProduct.map (wtEqL R 𝒱 2 A).subtype
      (wtEqL R 𝒱 0 B).subtype))
    (ht : GrCooperad.decomp (R := R) (C := 𝒞) i x = t₀ + t₁ + t₂) :
    t₂ ∈ LinearMap.range (TensorProduct.map (wtOneL R 𝒱 A ⊔ coRel R E r A).subtype
      (wtOneL R 𝒱 B ⊔ coRel R E r B).subtype)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hB : Nonempty (Unit ≃ B)
  · obtain ⟨e₀⟩ := hB
    have hB' : ∀ b : B, b = e₀ () := fun b => e₀.symm.injective (Subsingleton.elim _ _)
    obtain ⟨τ, hτ⟩ := GrCooperad.exists_rid_counit_decomp (R := R) (C := 𝒞) i (e₀ ()) hB' x
    set u := SymSpecies.map (R := R) (unitEquivOf (e₀ ()) hB')
      (GrCooperad.Coaug.one (R := R) (C := 𝒞))
    set ε := GrCooperad.counit (R := R) (C := 𝒞) ∘ₗ
      SymSpecies.map (R := R) (unitEquivOf (e₀ ()) hB').symm
    have hu : ε u = 1 := counit_map_map_one _
    obtain ⟨hy, hte⟩ := eq_tmul_of_mem_range_right hu (wtEqL_zero_le_span (e₀ ()) hB') h₂
    have k₀ : LinearMap.lTensor _ ε t₀ = 0 := lTensor_eq_zero_of_le_ker (ε := ε)
      (fun p hp => LinearMap.mem_ker.2 (counit_map_wtEqL two_ne_zero _ hp)) h₀
    have k₁ : LinearMap.lTensor _ ε t₁ = 0 := lTensor_eq_zero_of_le_ker (ε := ε)
      (fun p hp => LinearMap.mem_ker.2 (counit_map_wtEqL one_ne_zero _ hp)) h₁
    have hy' : TensorProduct.rid R _ (LinearMap.lTensor _ ε t₂) ∈ coRel R E r A := by
      have e : TensorProduct.rid R _ (LinearMap.lTensor _ ε t₂) = SymSpecies.map (R := R) τ x := by
        rw [← hτ, ht]
        simp only [map_add, k₀, k₁, zero_add]
      rw [e]
      exact map_mem_coRel r τ hx
    have hu' : u ∈ wtOneL R 𝒱 B ⊔ coRel R E r B :=
      Submodule.mem_sup_left (wtEqL_le_wtOneL (n := 0) zero_le_one
        ((wtEqL_eq_vx 0).ge (Cobar.unitSpan_le_vx (GrCooperad.map_one_mem _))))
    rw [hte]
    exact ⟨⟨_, Submodule.mem_sup_right hy'⟩ ⊗ₜ ⟨u, hu'⟩, rfl⟩
  · rw [eq_zero_of_mem_range_bot_right (wtEqL_zero_eq_bot (not_nonempty_iff.1 hB)) h₂]
    exact zero_mem _

name: Operad.Koszul.decomp_mem_coRel
statement:
lemma decomp_mem_coRel [CharZero R] {B : Type} [Fintype B] [DecidableEq B] (i : A)
    {x : Cut R E (Without A i ⊕ B)} (hx : x ∈ coRel R E r _) :
    GrCooperad.decomp (R := R) (C := 𝒞) i x
      ∈ LinearMap.range (TensorProduct.map (wtOneL R 𝒱 A ⊔ coRel R E r A).subtype
        (wtOneL R 𝒱 B ⊔ coRel R E r B).subtype)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨t₀, h₀, t₁, h₁, t₂, h₂, ht⟩ := exists_split_two (decomp_mem_wtEqL i hx.1)
  rw [ht]
  refine add_mem (add_mem (decomp_left_mem r i hx h₀ h₁ h₂ ht) ?_)
    (decomp_right_mem r i hx h₀ h₁ h₂ ht)
  exact GrSubCooperad.range_map_subtype_mono (C := 𝒞)
    ((wtEqL_le_wtOneL le_rfl).trans le_sup_left) ((wtEqL_le_wtOneL le_rfl).trans le_sup_left) h₁

name: Operad.Koszul.coRel_le_dual
statement: theorem coRel_le_dual [CharZero R] : coRel R E r A ≤ (dualSub R E r).sub A
proof:
:=
  le_sup_right.trans (le_dualSub r (K := coRelSub R E r) (fun A _ _ x hx => by
    obtain ⟨y, hy, z, hz, rfl⟩ := Submodule.mem_sup.1 hx
    show starKap R E A (y + z) ∈ (GrOperadIdeal.span R r).sub A
    rw [map_add]
    exact add_mem ((star_wtOne hy).symm ▸ zero_mem _) (relSp_le_ideal hz.2)) A)

name: Operad.Koszul.dual_inf_wtEqL
statement:
theorem dual_inf_wtEqL [CharZero R] (hq : IsQuadratic R E r) :
    (dualSub R E r).sub A ⊓ wtEqL R 𝒱 2 A = coRel R E r A
proof:
:=
  le_antisymm (dual_inf_wtEqL_le hq) (le_inf (coRel_le_dual r) inf_le_left)

name: Operad.GrOperad.par_par_self
statement: lemma par_par_self (c : Bool) (x : P A) : par (R := R) c (par (R := R) c x) = par (R := R) c x
proof:
:=
  by rw [par_par, if_pos rfl]

name: Operad.GrOperad.tw_apply
statement:
lemma tw_apply (e : Bool) (x : P A) :
    tw (R := R) e x = par (R := R) false x + σ R e • par (R := R) true x
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.GrOperad.tw_hom
statement:
lemma tw_hom (e : Bool) {c : Bool} {x : P A} (h : par (R := R) c x = x) :
    tw (R := R) e x = σ R (e && c) • x
proof:
:= by
  rw [tw_apply, ← h, par_par, par_par]
  cases c <;> cases e <;> simp

name: Operad.GrOperad.tw_false
statement: @[simp] lemma tw_false (x : P A) : tw (R := R) false x = x
proof:
:= by
  rw [tw_apply, σ_false, one_smul, par_add]

name: Operad.GrOperad.tw_true
statement: lemma tw_true (x : P A) : tw (R := R) true x = par (R := R) false x - par (R := R) true x
proof:
:= by
  rw [tw_apply, σ_true, neg_one_smul, sub_eq_add_neg]

name: Operad.GrOperad.par_tw
statement:
lemma par_tw (e c : Bool) (x : P A) :
    par (R := R) c (tw (R := R) e x) = tw (R := R) e (par (R := R) c x)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [tw_apply, map_add, map_smul, par_par]
  cases c <;> simp

name: Operad.GrOperad.tw_tw
statement: @[simp] lemma tw_tw (e : Bool) (x : P A) : tw (R := R) e (tw (R := R) e x) = x
proof:
:= by
  cases e
  · rw [tw_false, tw_false]
  · simp only [tw_true, map_sub, par_par]
    simp only [if_true, Bool.false_eq_true, if_false, Bool.true_eq_false, sub_zero, zero_sub,
      sub_neg_eq_add]
    exact par_add x

name: Operad.GrOperad.map_tw
statement:
lemma map_tw (e : Bool) (σ' : A ≃ B) (x : P A) :
    map (R := R) σ' (tw (R := R) e x) = tw (R := R) e (map (R := R) σ' x)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [tw_apply, map_add, map_smul, map_par]

name: Operad.GrOperad.tw_one
statement: @[simp] lemma tw_one (e : Bool) : tw (R := R) e (one (R := R) (P := P)) = one (R := R)
proof:
:= by
  rw [tw_hom e par_one, Bool.and_false, σ_false, one_smul]

name: Operad.GrOperad.par_comp_hom
proof:
:= by
  subst hc
  rw [← hx, ← hy]
  exact comp_par i p q x y

name: Operad.GrOperad.tw_comp
statement:
lemma tw_comp (e : Bool) (i : A) (x : P A) (y : P B) :
    tw (R := R) e (comp (R := R) i x y)
      = comp (R := R) i (tw (R := R) e x) (tw (R := R) e y)
proof:
:= by
  have key : ∀ p q : Bool,
      tw (R := R) e (comp (R := R) i (par (R := R) p x) (par (R := R) q y))
        = σ R (e && p) • σ R (e && q) • comp (R := R) i (par (R := R) p x) (par (R := R) q y) := by
    intro p q
    rw [tw_hom e (comp_par i p q x y), Bool.and_xor_distrib_left, σ_xor, mul_smul]
  have hx : tw (R := R) e x
      = σ R (e && false) • par (R := R) false x + σ R (e && true) • par (R := R) true x := by
    rw [tw_apply, Bool.and_false, Bool.and_true, σ_false, one_smul]
  have hy : tw (R := R) e y
      = σ R (e && false) • par (R := R) false y + σ R (e && true) • par (R := R) true y := by
    rw [tw_apply, Bool.and_false, Bool.and_true, σ_false, one_smul]
  conv_lhs => rw [← par_add (R := R) x, ← par_add (R := R) y]
  rw [hx, hy]
  simp only [map_add, LinearMap.add_apply, map_smul, LinearMap.smul_apply, key, smul_add,
    Bool.and_false, Bool.and_true, σ_false, one_smul]

name: Operad.GrOperadHom.id_app
statement:
@[simp] lemma id_app {A : Type} [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] (x : P A) :
    (GrOperadHom.id R P).app A x = x
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.GrOperadHom.app_tw
statement:
lemma app_tw (g : GrOperadHom R P Q) (e : Bool) {A : Type} [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A]
    (x : P A) : g.app A (GrOperad.tw (R := R) e x) = GrOperad.tw (R := R) e (g.app A x)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [GrOperad.tw_apply, map_add, map_smul, g.app_par]

name: Operad.DualExt.fst_mk
statement: @[simp] lemma fst_mk (x x' : Q A) : fst (mk (R := R) (e := e) x x') = x
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.DualExt.snd_mk
statement: @[simp] lemma snd_mk (x x' : Q A) : snd (mk (R := R) (e := e) x x') = x'
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.DualExt.ext
statement: @[ext] lemma ext {X Y : DualExt R Q e A} (h1 : fst X = fst Y) (h2 : snd X = snd Y) : X = Y
proof:
:=
  Prod.ext h1 h2

name: Operad.DualExt.fst_parE
statement:
@[simp] lemma fst_parE (c : Bool) (X : DualExt R Q e A) :
    fst (parE c X) = GrOperad.par (R := R) c (fst X)
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.DualExt.snd_parE
statement:
@[simp] lemma snd_parE (c : Bool) (X : DualExt R Q e A) :
    snd (parE c X) = GrOperad.par (R := R) (xor c e) (snd X)
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.DualExt.fst_mapE
statement:
@[simp] lemma fst_mapE (σ' : A ≃ B) (X : DualExt R Q e A) :
    fst (mapE σ' X) = GrOperad.map (R := R) σ' (fst X)
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.DualExt.snd_mapE
statement:
@[simp] lemma snd_mapE (σ' : A ≃ B) (X : DualExt R Q e A) :
    snd (mapE σ' X) = GrOperad.map (R := R) σ' (snd X)
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.DualExt.fst_compE
statement:
@[simp] lemma fst_compE (i : A) (X : DualExt R Q e A) (Y : DualExt R Q e B) :
    fst (compE i X Y) = GrOperad.comp (R := R) i (fst X) (fst Y)
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.DualExt.snd_compE
statement:
@[simp] lemma snd_compE (i : A) (X : DualExt R Q e A) (Y : DualExt R Q e B) :
    snd (compE i X Y) = GrOperad.comp (R := R) i (snd X) (fst Y)
      + GrOperad.comp (R := R) i (GrOperad.tw (R := R) e (fst X)) (snd Y)
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.DualExt.fst_oneE
statement: @[simp] lemma fst_oneE : fst (oneE (R := R) (Q := Q) (e := e)) = GrOperad.one (R := R)
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.DualExt.snd_oneE
statement: @[simp] lemma snd_oneE : snd (oneE (R := R) (Q := Q) (e := e)) = 0
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.DualExt.parE_add
statement: lemma parE_add (X : DualExt R Q e A) : parE false X + parE true X = X
proof:
:= by
  ext
  · simp only [map_add, fst_parE, GrOperad.par_add]
  · simp only [map_add, snd_parE]
    cases e
    · exact GrOperad.par_add _
    · exact (add_comm _ _).trans (GrOperad.par_add _)

name: Operad.DualExt.parE_parE
statement:
lemma parE_parE (c c' : Bool) (X : DualExt R Q e A) :
    parE c (parE c' X) = if c = c' then parE c' X else 0
proof:
:= by
  by_cases h : c = c'
  · subst h
    rw [if_pos rfl]
    ext
    · simp only [fst_parE, GrOperad.par_par_self]
    · simp only [snd_parE, GrOperad.par_par_self]
  · rw [if_neg h]
    ext
    · simp only [fst_parE, GrOperad.par_par, if_neg h, map_zero]
    · simp only [snd_parE, GrOperad.par_par, Bool.xor_left_inj, if_neg h, map_zero]

name: Operad.DualExt.compE_par
statement:
lemma compE_par (i : A) (p q : Bool) (X : DualExt R Q e A) (Y : DualExt R Q e B) :
    parE (xor p q) (compE i (parE p X) (parE q Y)) = compE i (parE p X) (parE q Y)
proof:
:= by
  ext
  · exact GrOperad.comp_par i p q _ _
  · simp only [snd_compE, fst_parE, snd_parE, map_add]
    congr 1
    · exact GrOperad.par_comp_hom i (by cases p <;> cases q <;> cases e <;> rfl)
        (GrOperad.par_par_self _ _) (GrOperad.par_par_self _ _)
    · rw [GrOperad.tw_hom e (GrOperad.par_par_self p _), map_smul, LinearMap.smul_apply,
        map_smul]
      congr 1
      exact GrOperad.par_comp_hom i (by cases p <;> cases q <;> cases e <;> rfl)
        (GrOperad.par_par_self _ _) (GrOperad.par_par_self _ _)

name: Operad.DualExt.mapE_compE
statement:
lemma mapE_compE {A' B' : Type} [Fintype A'] [DecidableEq A'] [Fintype B'] [DecidableEq B']
    (σ' : A ≃ A') (τ : B ≃ B') (i : A) (X : DualExt R Q e A) (Y : DualExt R Q e B) :
    mapE (compEquiv σ' τ i) (compE i X Y) = compE (σ' i) (mapE σ' X) (mapE τ Y)
proof:
:= by
  ext
  · exact GrOperad.map_comp σ' τ i _ _
  · simp only [snd_mapE, snd_compE, fst_mapE, map_add, GrOperad.map_comp, GrOperad.map_tw]

name: Operad.DualExt.compE_one
statement:
lemma compE_one (i : A) (X : DualExt R Q e A) :
    mapE (rightUnitEquiv i) (compE i X oneE) = X
proof:
:= by
  ext
  · exact GrOperad.comp_one i _
  · simp only [snd_mapE, snd_compE, fst_oneE, snd_oneE, map_zero, add_zero, GrOperad.comp_one]

name: Operad.DualExt.one_compE
statement: lemma one_compE (Y : DualExt R Q e B) : mapE (leftUnitEquiv B) (compE () oneE Y) = Y
proof:
:= by
  ext
  · exact GrOperad.one_comp _
  · simp only [snd_mapE, snd_compE, fst_oneE, snd_oneE, map_zero, LinearMap.zero_apply,
      zero_add, GrOperad.tw_one, GrOperad.one_comp]

name: Operad.DualExt.compE_assoc_seq
statement:
lemma compE_assoc_seq {D : Type} [Fintype D] [DecidableEq D] (i : A) (j : B)
    (X : DualExt R Q e A) (Y : DualExt R Q e B) (Z : DualExt R Q e D) :
    mapE (seqEquiv i j D) (compE (Sum.inr j) (compE i X Y) Z) = compE i X (compE j Y Z)
proof:
:= by
  ext
  · exact GrOperad.comp_assoc_seq i j _ _ _
  · simp only [snd_mapE, snd_compE, fst_compE, map_add, LinearMap.add_apply,
      GrOperad.comp_assoc_seq, GrOperad.tw_comp]
    abel

name: Operad.DualExt.compE_assoc_par
statement:
lemma compE_assoc_par {D : Type} [Fintype D] [DecidableEq D] {i k : A} (hik : i ≠ k)
    (X : DualExt R Q e A) {q r : Bool} {Y : DualExt R Q e B} {Z : DualExt R Q e D}
    (hy : parE q Y = Y) (hz : parE r Z = Z) :
    mapE (parEquiv hik B D) (compE (Sum.inl ⟨k, Ne.symm hik⟩) (compE i X Y) Z)
      = σ R (q && r) • compE (Sum.inl ⟨i, hik⟩) (compE k X Z) Y
proof:
:= by
  have hy1 : GrOperad.par (R := R) q (fst Y) = fst Y := congrArg fst hy
  have hy2 : GrOperad.par (R := R) (xor q e) (snd Y) = snd Y := congrArg snd hy
  have hz1 : GrOperad.par (R := R) r (fst Z) = fst Z := congrArg fst hz
  have hz2 : GrOperad.par (R := R) (xor r e) (snd Z) = snd Z := congrArg snd hz
  ext
  · exact GrOperad.comp_assoc_par hik _ hy1 hz1
  · have t1 : GrOperad.tw (R := R) e (GrOperad.comp (R := R) i (fst X) (fst Y))
        = σ R (e && q) • GrOperad.comp (R := R) i (GrOperad.tw (R := R) e (fst X)) (fst Y) := by
      rw [GrOperad.tw_comp, GrOperad.tw_hom e hy1, map_smul]
    have t2 : GrOperad.tw (R := R) e (GrOperad.comp (R := R) k (fst X) (fst Z))
        = σ R (e && r) • GrOperad.comp (R := R) k (GrOperad.tw (R := R) e (fst X)) (fst Z) := by
      rw [GrOperad.tw_comp, GrOperad.tw_hom e hz1, map_smul]
    have h1 : σ R (e && q) * σ R (q && xor r e) = σ R (q && r) := by
      cases q <;> cases r <;> cases e <;> simp
    have h2 : σ R (xor q e && r) = σ R (q && r) * σ R (e && r) := by
      cases q <;> cases r <;> cases e <;> simp
    simp only [snd_mapE, snd_compE, fst_compE, map_smul, map_add, LinearMap.add_apply,
      LinearMap.smul_apply, t1, t2, GrOperad.comp_assoc_par hik _ hy1 hz1,
      GrOperad.comp_assoc_par hik _ hy2 hz1, GrOperad.comp_assoc_par hik _ hy1 hz2, smul_add,
      smul_smul, h1, h2]
    abel

name: Operad.DualExt.par_def
statement: lemma par_def (c : Bool) (X : DualExt R Q e A) : GrOperad.par (R := R) c X = parE c X
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.DualExt.map_def
statement: lemma map_def (σ' : A ≃ B) (X : DualExt R Q e A) : GrOperad.map (R := R) σ' X = mapE σ' X
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: Operad.DualExt.one_def
statement: lemma one_def : (GrOperad.one (R := R) : DualExt R Q e Unit) = oneE
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.DualExt.comp_def
statement:
lemma comp_def (i : A) (X : DualExt R Q e A) (Y : DualExt R Q e B) :
    GrOperad.comp (R := R) i X Y = compE i X Y
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.DualExt.fstHom_app
statement: @[simp] lemma fstHom_app (X : DualExt R Q e A) : (fstHom R Q e).app A X = fst X
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.GrDer.ext
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨Da, _, _, _, _⟩ := D
  obtain ⟨Da', _, _, _, _⟩ := D'
  have : @Da = @Da' := by
    funext A _ _
    exact LinearMap.ext (h A)
  subst this
  rfl

name: Operad.GrDer.app_tw
statement:
lemma app_tw (D : GrDer f e) (e' : Bool) {A : Type} [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] (x : P A) :
    D.app A (GrOperad.tw (R := R) e' x) = σ R (e' && e) • GrOperad.tw (R := R) e' (D.app A x)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [GrOperad.tw_apply, map_add, map_smul, D.app_par, smul_add, smul_smul]
  cases e <;> cases e' <;> simp [add_comm]

name: Operad.GrDer.fst_toHom
statement:
@[simp] lemma fst_toHom (D : GrDer f e) {A : Type} [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] (x : P A) :
    DualExt.fst (D.toHom.app A x) = f.app A x
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.GrDer.snd_toHom
statement:
@[simp] lemma snd_toHom (D : GrDer f e) {A : Type} [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] (x : P A) :
    DualExt.snd (D.toHom.app A x) = D.app A x
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.GrDer.compHom_app
statement:
@[simp] lemma compHom_app {P' : (A : Type) → [Fintype A] → [DecidableEq A] → Type w}
    [∀ (A : Type) [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A], AddCommGroup (P' A)]
    [∀ (A : Type) [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A], Module R (P' A)] [GrOperad R P']
    (D : GrDer (GrOperadHom.id R P) e) (g : GrOperadHom R P' P) {A : Type} [Fintype A]
    [DecidableEq A] (x : P' A) : (D.compHom g).app A x = D.app A (g.app A x)
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.GrDer.homComp_app
statement:
@[simp] lemma homComp_app (g : GrOperadHom R P Q) (D : GrDer (GrOperadHom.id R P) e)
    {A : Type} [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] (x : P A) :
    (homComp g D).app A x = g.app A (D.app A x)
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.GrDer.sq_app
statement:
@[simp] lemma sq_app (D : GrDer (GrOperadHom.id R P) true) {A : Type} [Fintype A]
    [DecidableEq A] (x : P A) : D.sq.app A x = D.app A (D.app A x)
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.FreeGrL.der_ext
proof:
:=
  GrDer.equiv.injective (Subtype.ext (hom_ext fun A _ _ v => DualExt.ext rfl (h A v)))

name: Operad.FreeGrL.der_eq_zero
proof:
:=
  der_ext h

name: Operad.FreeGrL.sq_eq_zero
statement:
theorem sq_eq_zero {D : GrDer (GrOperadHom.id R (FreeGrL R V)) true}
    (h : ∀ (A : Type) [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] (v : V A),
      D.app A (D.app A ((ι R V).app A v)) = 0)
    {A : Type} [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] (x : FreeGrL R V A) : D.app A (D.app A x) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have := der_eq_zero (D := D.sq) h
  exact congrArg (fun D' : GrDer _ false => D'.app A x) this

name: Operad.FreeGrL.fst_derHom
statement:
lemma fst_derHom (f : GrOperadHom R (FreeGrL R V) Q) (F : SymSpeciesHom R V Q)
    (hF : IsShift F e) {A : Type} [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] (x : FreeGrL R V A) :
    DualExt.fst ((derHom f F hF).app A x) = f.app A x
proof:
:= by
  have : (DualExt.fstHom R Q e).comp (derHom f F hF) = f := hom_ext fun A _ _ v => by
    rw [GrOperadHom.comp_app, derHom, homEquiv_symm_ι]
    rfl
  exact congrArg (fun g : GrOperadHom R (FreeGrL R V) Q => g.app A x) this

name: Operad.FreeGrL.derOf_ι
statement:
@[simp] lemma derOf_ι (f : GrOperadHom R (FreeGrL R V) Q) (F : SymSpeciesHom R V Q)
    (hF : IsShift F e) {A : Type} [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] (v : V A) :
    (derOf f F hF).app A ((ι R V).app A v) = F.app A v
proof:
:= by
  show DualExt.snd ((derHom f F hF).app A ((ι R V).app A v)) = _
  rw [derHom, homEquiv_symm_ι]
  rfl

name: Operad.LTree.mapDec_leaf
statement: @[simp] lemma mapDec_leaf (f : E → F) (a : ℕ) : (leaf a : LTree E).mapDec f = leaf a
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.LTree.mapDec_node
statement:
@[simp] lemma mapDec_node (f : E → F) (e : E) (l r : LTree E) :
    (node e l r).mapDec f = node (f e) (l.mapDec f) (r.mapDec f)
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.LTree.labels_mapDec
statement:
@[simp] lemma labels_mapDec (f : E → F) : ∀ t : LTree E, (t.mapDec f).labels = t.labels
  | leaf _ => rfl
  | node _ l r => by simp [labels_mapDec f l, labels_mapDec f r]

@[simp] lemma minLabel_mapDec (f : E → F) : ∀ t : LTree E, (t.mapDec f).minLabel = t.minLabel
  | leaf _ => rfl
  | node _ l r => by simp [minLabel_mapDec f l, minLabel_mapDec f r]

@[simp] lemma arity_mapDec (f : E → F) : ∀ t : LTree E, (t.mapDec f).arity = t.arity
  | leaf _ => rfl
  | node _ l r => by simp [arity, arity_mapDec f l, arity_mapDec f r]

@[simp] lemma size_mapDec (f : E → F) : ∀ t : LTree E, (t.mapDec f).size = t.size
  | leaf _ => rfl
  | node _ l r => by simp [size_mapDec f l, size_mapDec f r]

@[simp] lemma isShuffle_mapDec (f : E → F) : ∀ t : LTree E, (t.mapDec f).IsShuffle ↔ t.IsShuffle
  | leaf _ => Iff.rfl
  | node _ l r => by simp [isShuffle_mapDec f l, isShuffle_mapDec f r]

name: Operad.LTree.minLabel_mapDec
statement:
@[simp] lemma minLabel_mapDec (f : E → F) : ∀ t : LTree E, (t.mapDec f).minLabel = t.minLabel
  | leaf _ => rfl
  | node _ l r => by simp [minLabel_mapDec f l, minLabel_mapDec f r]

  | leaf _ => rfl
  | node _ l r => by simp [arity, arity_mapDec f l, arity_mapDec f r]

name: Operad.LTree.size_mapDec

@[simp] lemma size_mapDec (f : E → F) : ∀ t : LTree E, (t.mapDec f).size = t.size
  | leaf _ => rfl
  | node _ l r => by simp [size_mapDec f l, size_mapDec f r]

name: Operad.LTree.mapDec_mapDec
statement:
lemma mapDec_mapDec {G : Type*} (f : E → F) (g : F → G) :
    ∀ t : LTree E, (t.mapDec f).mapDec g = t.mapDec (g ∘ f)
  | leaf _ => rfl
  | node _ l r => by simp [mapDec_mapDec f g l, mapDec_mapDec f g r]

name: Operad.LTree.mapDec_id
statement:
lemma mapDec_id : ∀ t : LTree E, t.mapDec id = t
  | leaf _ => rfl
  | node _ l r => by simp [mapDec_id l, mapDec_id r]

name: Operad.LTree.path_mapDec
statement:
lemma path_mapDec (f : E → F) (i : ℕ) : ∀ t : LTree E, (t.mapDec f).path i = (t.path i).map f
  | leaf _ => rfl
  | node _ l r => by
    simp only [mapDec_node, path, labels_mapDec, List.map_cons]
    split_ifs
    · rw [path_mapDec f i l]
    · rw [path_mapDec f i r]

name: Operad.LTree.subtreeAt_append
statement:
lemma subtreeAt_append : ∀ (t : LTree E) (p q : List Bool),
    t.subtreeAt (p ++ q) = (t.subtreeAt p).subtreeAt q
  | leaf _, [], _ => by simp
  | leaf _, _ :: _, [] => by simp [subtreeAt]
  | leaf _, _ :: _, _ :: _ => by simp [subtreeAt]
  | node _ _ _, [], _ => by simp
  | node _ l _, false :: p, q => subtreeAt_append l p q
  | node _ _ r, true :: p, q => subtreeAt_append r p q

name: Operad.LTree.subtreeAt_mapDec
statement:
lemma subtreeAt_mapDec (f : E → F) :
    ∀ (t : LTree E) (p : List Bool), (t.mapDec f).subtreeAt p = (t.subtreeAt p).mapDec f
  | leaf _, [] => rfl
  | leaf _, _ :: _ => rfl
  | node _ _ _, [] => rfl
  | node _ l _, false :: p => subtreeAt_mapDec f l p
  | node _ _ r, true :: p => subtreeAt_mapDec f r p

name: Operad.LTree.replaceAt_mapDec
statement:
lemma replaceAt_mapDec (f : E → F) : ∀ (t : LTree E) (p : List Bool) (u : LTree E),
    (t.mapDec f).replaceAt p (u.mapDec f) = (t.replaceAt p u).mapDec f
  | leaf _, [], _ => rfl
  | leaf _, _ :: _, _ => rfl
  | node _ _ _, [], _ => rfl
  | node e l r, false :: p, u => by
    simp only [mapDec_node, replaceAt, replaceAt_mapDec f l p u]
  | node e l r, true :: p, u => by
    simp only [mapDec_node, replaceAt, replaceAt_mapDec f r p u]

name: Operad.LTree.plug_mapDec
statement:
lemma plug_mapDec (f : E → F) (ins : ℕ → LTree E) :
    ∀ m : LTree E, (m.mapDec f).plug (fun k => (ins k).mapDec f) = (m.plug ins).mapDec f
  | leaf _ => rfl
  | node e l r => by simp only [mapDec_node, plug, plug_mapDec f ins l, plug_mapDec f ins r]

name: Operad.LTree.isEdgeRoot_mapDec
statement:
lemma isEdgeRoot_mapDec (f : E → F) :
    ∀ (u : LTree E) (s : Bool), (u.mapDec f).IsEdgeRoot s ↔ u.IsEdgeRoot s
  | leaf _, _ => Iff.rfl
  | node _ (leaf _) (leaf _), _ => by cases ‹Bool› <;> exact Iff.rfl
  | node _ (node _ _ _) (leaf _), _ => by cases ‹Bool› <;> exact Iff.rfl
  | node _ (leaf _) (node _ _ _), _ => by cases ‹Bool› <;> exact Iff.rfl
  | node _ (node _ _ _) (node _ _ _), _ => by cases ‹Bool› <;> exact Iff.rfl

name: Operad.LTree.isEdge_mapDec
statement:
lemma isEdge_mapDec (f : E → F) (t : LTree E) (p : List Bool) (s : Bool) :
    (t.mapDec f).IsEdge p s ↔ t.IsEdge p s
proof:
:= by
  unfold IsEdge
  rw [subtreeAt_mapDec, isEdgeRoot_mapDec]

name: Operad.LTree.windowRoot_mapDec
statement:
lemma windowRoot_mapDec (f : E → F) :
    ∀ (u : LTree E) (s : Bool), u.IsEdgeRoot s →
      (u.mapDec f).windowRoot s = (u.windowRoot s).mapDec f
  | node e (node g a b) c, false, _ => by
    simp [windowRoot, window]
  | node e c (node g a b), true, _ => by
    cases c <;> simp [windowRoot, window]

name: Operad.LTree.windowAt_mapDec
statement:
lemma windowAt_mapDec (f : E → F) (t : LTree E) (p : List Bool) (s : Bool) (h : t.IsEdge p s) :
    (t.mapDec f).windowAt p s = (t.windowAt p s).mapDec f
proof:
:= by
  unfold windowAt
  rw [subtreeAt_mapDec, windowRoot_mapDec f _ s h]

name: Operad.LTree.winInputs_mapDec
statement:
lemma winInputs_mapDec (f : E → F) :
    ∀ (u : LTree E) (s : Bool), u.IsEdgeRoot s →
      (u.mapDec f).winInputs s = ((u.winInputs s).1.mapDec f, (u.winInputs s).2.1.mapDec f,
        (u.winInputs s).2.2.mapDec f)
  | node e (node g a b) c, false, _ => by
    simp only [mapDec_node, winInputs, minLabel_mapDec]
    split_ifs <;> rfl
  | node e c (node g a b), true, _ => by
    cases c <;> rfl

name: Operad.LTree.winIns_mapDec
statement:
lemma winIns_mapDec (f : E → F) (u : LTree E) (s : Bool) (h : u.IsEdgeRoot s) (k : ℕ) :
    (u.mapDec f).winIns s k = (u.winIns s k).mapDec f
proof:
:= by
  simp only [winIns, winInputs_mapDec f u s h, ins3]
  split_ifs <;> rfl

name: Operad.LTree.substAt_mapDec
statement:
lemma substAt_mapDec (f : E → F) (t : LTree E) (p : List Bool) (s : Bool) (h : t.IsEdge p s)
    (m : LTree E) : (t.mapDec f).substAt p s (m.mapDec f) = (t.substAt p s m).mapDec f
proof:
:= by
  unfold substAt
  rw [subtreeAt_mapDec, ← replaceAt_mapDec, ← plug_mapDec]
  congr 2
  funext k
  exact winIns_mapDec f _ s h k

name: Operad.LTree.key_node
statement:
lemma key_node (d : X) (l r : LTree X) :
    key (node d l r) = toLex (min l.minLabel r.minLabel, l.arity + r.arity)
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.LTree.mem_nodeKeys_labels
statement:
lemma mem_nodeKeys_labels : ∀ (t : LTree X) {k : ℕ ×ₗ ℕ}, k ∈ t.nodeKeys →
    (ofLex k).1 ∈ t.labels ∧ (ofLex k).2 ≤ t.arity
  | leaf _, k, hk => by simp [nodeKeys] at hk
  | node d l r, k, hk => by
    simp only [nodeKeys, Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_union] at hk
    rcases hk with rfl | hk | hk
    · exact ⟨by simpa [key] using minLabel_mem (node d l r), le_rfl⟩
    · have
proof:
:= mem_nodeKeys_labels l hk
      exact ⟨by simp [this.1], by simp only [arity]; omega⟩
    · have := mem_nodeKeys_labels r hk
      exact ⟨by simp [this.1], by simp only [arity]; omega⟩

name: Operad.LTree.key_not_mem_left
statement: lemma key_not_mem_left (d : X) (l r : LTree X) : key (node d l r) ∉ l.nodeKeys
proof:
:= fun h => by
  have := (mem_nodeKeys_labels l h).2
  have := arity_pos r
  simp only [key, arity, ofLex_toLex] at *
  omega

name: Operad.LTree.key_not_mem_right
statement: lemma key_not_mem_right (d : X) (l r : LTree X) : key (node d l r) ∉ r.nodeKeys
proof:
:= fun h => by
  have := (mem_nodeKeys_labels r h).2
  have := arity_pos l
  simp only [key, arity, ofLex_toLex] at *
  omega

name: Operad.LTree.disjoint_nodeKeys
statement:
lemma disjoint_nodeKeys {d : X} {l r : LTree X} (h : (node d l r).labels.Nodup) :
    Disjoint l.nodeKeys r.nodeKeys
proof:
:= by
  rw [Finset.disjoint_left]
  intro k hl hr
  simp only [labels_node] at h
  exact ne_of_nodup_append h (mem_nodeKeys_labels l hl).1 (mem_nodeKeys_labels r hr).1 rfl

name: Operad.LTree.key_mapDec
statement: lemma key_mapDec {Y : Type*} (f : X → Y) (t : LTree X) : key (t.mapDec f) = key t
proof:
:= by
  simp [key]

name: Operad.LTree.exists_of_mem_edgeWins
statement:
theorem exists_of_mem_edgeWins {k : ℕ ×ₗ ℕ} {w : LTree X} : ∀ t : LTree X, (k, w) ∈ t.edgeWins →
    ∃ p s, t.IsEdge p s ∧ key (t.subtreeAt (p ++ [s])) = k ∧ t.windowAt p s = w
  | leaf _, h => by simp [edgeWins] at h
  | node e l r, h => by
    simp only [edgeWins, List.mem_append] at h
    rcases h with ((h | h) | h) | h
    · match l, h with
      | node f a b, h =>
        simp only [List.mem_singleton, Prod.mk.injEq] at h
        exact ⟨[], false, trivial, by simp [subtreeAt, h.1],
          by simp [windowAt, windowRoot, h.2]⟩
    · match r, h with
      | node f a b, h =>
        simp only [List.mem_singleton, Prod.mk.injEq] at h
        refine ⟨[], true, ?_, by simp [subtreeAt, h.1], ?_⟩
        · show IsEdgeRoot (node e l (node f a b)) true
          cases l <;> trivial
        · show windowRoot (node e l (node f a b)) true = w
          cases l <;> simp [windowRoot, h.2]
    · obtain ⟨p, s, hp, hk, hw⟩
proof:
:= exists_of_mem_edgeWins l h
      exact ⟨false :: p, s, hp, hk, hw⟩
    · obtain ⟨p, s, hp, hk, hw⟩ := exists_of_mem_edgeWins r h
      exact ⟨true :: p, s, hp, hk, hw⟩

name: Operad.LTree.mem_edgeWins_key
statement:
lemma mem_edgeWins_key {k : ℕ ×ₗ ℕ} {w : LTree X} : ∀ t : LTree X, (k, w) ∈ t.edgeWins →
    k ∈ t.nodeKeys ∧ (ofLex k).2 < t.arity
  | leaf _, h => by simp [edgeWins] at h
  | node e l r, h => by
    have hl
proof:
:= arity_pos l
    have hr := arity_pos r
    simp only [edgeWins, List.mem_append] at h
    rcases h with ((h | h) | h) | h
    · match l, h with
      | node f a b, h =>
        simp only [List.mem_singleton, Prod.mk.injEq] at h
        obtain ⟨rfl, -⟩ := h
        refine ⟨by simp [nodeKeys], ?_⟩
        simp only [key, ofLex_toLex, arity] at *
        omega
    · match r, h with
      | node f a b, h =>
        simp only [List.mem_singleton, Prod.mk.injEq] at h
        obtain ⟨rfl, -⟩ := h
        refine ⟨by simp [nodeKeys], ?_⟩
        simp only [key, ofLex_toLex, arity] at *
        omega
    · obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := mem_edgeWins_key l h
      refine ⟨by simp [nodeKeys, h1], ?_⟩
      simp only [arity]
      omega
    · obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := mem_edgeWins_key r h
      refine ⟨by simp [nodeKeys, h1], ?_⟩
      simp only [arity]
      omega

name: Operad.LTree.mem_keyList_iff
statement:
lemma mem_keyList_iff : ∀ (t : LTree X) (k : ℕ ×ₗ ℕ), k ∈ t.keyList ↔ k ∈ t.nodeKeys
  | leaf _, k => by simp [keyList, nodeKeys]
  | node d l r, k => by
    simp [keyList, nodeKeys, mem_keyList_iff l, mem_keyList_iff r]

name: Operad.LTree.nodup_keyList
statement:
lemma nodup_keyList : ∀ t : LTree X, t.labels.Nodup → t.keyList.Nodup
  | leaf _, _ => by simp [keyList]
  | node d l r, hnd => by
    rw [keyList, List.nodup_cons, List.mem_append, mem_keyList_iff, mem_keyList_iff]
    refine ⟨fun h => h.elim (key_not_mem_left d l r) (key_not_mem_right d l r),
      List.nodup_append.2 ⟨nodup_keyList l (List.nodup_append.1 hnd).1,
        nodup_keyList r (List.nodup_append.1 hnd).2.1, fun a ha b hb hab => ?_⟩⟩
    subst hab
    rw [mem_keyList_iff] at ha hb
    exact Finset.disjoint_left.1 (disjoint_nodeKeys hnd) ha hb

                                              
def rootKey : LTree X → List (ℕ ×ₗ ℕ)
  | leaf _ => []
  | node d l r => [key (node d l r)]

name: Operad.LTree.edgeWins_keys
statement:
lemma edgeWins_keys (e : X) (l r : LTree X) : (node e l r).edgeWins.map Prod.fst =
    l.rootKey ++ r.rootKey ++ l.edgeWins.map Prod.fst ++ r.edgeWins.map Prod.fst
proof:
:= by
  cases l <;> cases r <;> simp [edgeWins, rootKey]

name: Operad.LTree.perm_keyList
statement:
lemma perm_keyList : ∀ t : LTree X, t.keyList.Perm (t.rootKey ++ t.edgeWins.map Prod.fst)
  | leaf _ => by simp [keyList, rootKey, edgeWins]
  | node e l r => by
    rw [edgeWins_keys]
    simp only [keyList, rootKey, List.singleton_append]
    refine List.Perm.cons _ (((perm_keyList l).append (perm_keyList r)).trans ?_)
    simp only [List.append_assoc]
    refine List.Perm.append_left _ ?_
    rw [← List.append_assoc, ← List.append_assoc]
    exact List.perm_append_comm.append_right _

                                                                                     
def edgeKeys (t : LTree X) : Finset (ℕ ×ₗ ℕ)
proof: := (t.edgeWins.map Prod.fst).toFinset

name: Operad.LTree.length_keyList
statement:
lemma length_keyList : ∀ t : LTree X, t.keyList.length + 1 = t.arity
  | leaf _ => rfl
  | node d l r => by
    have
proof:
:= length_keyList l
    have := length_keyList r
    simp only [keyList, List.length_cons, List.length_append, arity]
    omega

name: Operad.LTree.card_edgeKeys
statement:
lemma card_edgeKeys {e : X} {l r : LTree X} (hnd : (node e l r).labels.Nodup) :
    (node e l r).edgeKeys.card + 2 = (node e l r).arity
proof:
:= by
  have hp : (l.keyList ++ r.keyList).Perm ((node e l r).edgeWins.map Prod.fst) := by
    have := perm_keyList (node e l r)
    simp only [keyList, rootKey, List.singleton_append] at this
    exact this.cons_inv
  have hnd' : (l.keyList ++ r.keyList).Nodup := by
    have := nodup_keyList (node e l r) hnd
    rw [keyList, List.nodup_cons] at this
    exact this.2
  rw [edgeKeys, List.toFinset_card_of_nodup (hp.nodup_iff.1 hnd'), ← hp.length_eq,
    List.length_append]
  have := length_keyList l
  have := length_keyList r
  simp only [arity]
  omega

name: Operad.LTree.mem_edgeKeys
statement: lemma mem_edgeKeys {t : LTree X} {k : ℕ ×ₗ ℕ} : k ∈ t.edgeKeys ↔ ∃ w, (k, w) ∈ t.edgeWins
proof:
:= by
  simp [edgeKeys]

name: Operad.LTree.edgeKeys_node
statement:
lemma edgeKeys_node (e : X) (l r : LTree X) :
    (node e l r).edgeKeys = l.nodeKeys ∪ r.nodeKeys
proof:
:= by
  have hp : (l.keyList ++ r.keyList).Perm ((node e l r).edgeWins.map Prod.fst) := by
    have := perm_keyList (node e l r)
    simp only [keyList, rootKey, List.singleton_append] at this
    exact this.cons_inv
  ext k
  rw [edgeKeys, ← List.toFinset_eq_of_perm _ _ hp]
  simp [mem_keyList_iff]

name: Operad.LTree.nodeKeys_mapDec
statement:
lemma nodeKeys_mapDec {Y : Type*} (f : X → Y) : ∀ t : LTree X, (t.mapDec f).nodeKeys = t.nodeKeys
  | leaf _ => rfl
  | node d l r => by
    simp only [mapDec_node, nodeKeys, nodeKeys_mapDec f l, nodeKeys_mapDec f r]
    rw [show key (node (f d) (l.mapDec f) (r.mapDec f)) = key (node d l r) from
      key_mapDec f (node d l r)]

end Keys

end LTree

name: Operad.ShuffleBar.cutKeys_subset
statement:
lemma cutKeys_subset : ∀ x : BarTree E, cutKeys x ⊆ x.nodeKeys
  | leaf _ => by simp [cutKeys]

    rw [cutKeys, nodeKeys]
    refine Finset.union_subset ?_ (Finset.union_subset ?_ ?_)
    · split_ifs <;> simp
    · exact (cutKeys_subset l).trans fun k hk =>
        Finset.mem_insert_of_mem (Finset.mem_union_left _ hk)
    · exact (cutKeys_subset r).trans fun k hk =>
        Finset.mem_insert_of_mem (Finset.mem_union_right _ hk)

name: Operad.ShuffleBar.mergeK_of_not_mem
statement:
lemma mergeK_of_not_mem {k : ℕ ×ₗ ℕ} : ∀ x : BarTree E, k ∉ cutKeys x → mergeK x k = x
  | leaf _, _ => rfl
  | node d l r, hk => by
    simp only [cutKeys, Finset.mem_union, not_or] at hk
    have hroot : ¬(d.2 ∧ key (node d l r) = k)
proof:
:= by
      rintro ⟨h1, rfl⟩
      exact hk.1 (by simp [h1])
    simp only [mergeK, hroot, if_false, mergeK_of_not_mem l hk.2.1, mergeK_of_not_mem r hk.2.2]

name: Operad.ShuffleBar.cutKeys_mergeK
statement:
theorem cutKeys_mergeK {k : ℕ ×ₗ ℕ} : ∀ x : BarTree E, x.labels.Nodup → k ∈ cutKeys x →
    cutKeys (mergeK x k) = (cutKeys x).erase k
  | leaf _, _, hk => by simp [cutKeys] at hk
  | node d l r, hnd, hk => by
    have hl : k ∈ cutKeys l → k ∉ cutKeys r
proof:
:= fun h h' =>
      Finset.disjoint_left.1 (disjoint_nodeKeys hnd) (cutKeys_subset l h) (cutKeys_subset r h')
    have hkl : key (node d l r) ∉ cutKeys l := fun h => key_not_mem_left d l r (cutKeys_subset l h)
    have hkr : key (node d l r) ∉ cutKeys r := fun h => key_not_mem_right d l r (cutKeys_subset r h)
    have hndl : l.labels.Nodup := (List.nodup_append.1 hnd).1
    have hndr : r.labels.Nodup := (List.nodup_append.1 hnd).2.1
    by_cases hroot : d.2 ∧ key (node d l r) = k
    · obtain ⟨h1, rfl⟩ := hroot
      simp only [mergeK, h1, and_self, if_true, cutKeys, Bool.false_eq_true, if_false,
        Finset.empty_union, Finset.singleton_union]
      rw [Finset.erase_insert (by simp [hkl, hkr])]
    · simp only [mergeK, hroot, if_false, cutKeys]
      rw [key_node_mergeK]
      simp only [cutKeys, Finset.mem_union] at hk
      have hk0 : k ∉ (if d.2 then ({key (node d l r)} : Finset (ℕ ×ₗ ℕ)) else ∅) := by
        split_ifs with h1
        · exact fun h => hroot ⟨h1, (Finset.mem_singleton.1 h).symm⟩
        · simp
      rcases hk with hk | hk | hk
      · exact absurd hk hk0
      · rw [cutKeys_mergeK l hndl hk, mergeK_of_not_mem r (hl hk), Finset.erase_union_distrib,
          Finset.erase_union_distrib, Finset.erase_eq_of_notMem hk0,
          Finset.erase_eq_of_notMem (hl hk)]
      · have hk' : k ∉ cutKeys l := fun h => hl h hk
        rw [cutKeys_mergeK r hndr hk, mergeK_of_not_mem l hk', Finset.erase_union_distrib,
          Finset.erase_union_distrib, Finset.erase_eq_of_notMem hk0,
          Finset.erase_eq_of_notMem hk']

name: Operad.ShuffleBar.mergeK_comm
statement:
theorem mergeK_comm {k k' : ℕ ×ₗ ℕ} (hkk : k ≠ k') :
    ∀ x : BarTree E, mergeK (mergeK x k) k' = mergeK (mergeK x k') k
  | leaf _ => rfl
  | node d l r => by
    by_cases h : d.2 ∧ key (node d l r) = k
    · have h' : ¬(d.2 ∧ key (node d l r) = k')
proof:
:= fun h' => hkk (h.2.symm.trans h'.2)
      have e1 : mergeK (node d l r) k = node (d.1, false) l r := by rw [mergeK, if_pos h]
      have e2 : mergeK (node d l r) k' = node d (mergeK l k') (mergeK r k') := by
        rw [mergeK, if_neg h']
      have e3 : mergeK (node (d.1, false) l r) k' =
          node (d.1, false) (mergeK l k') (mergeK r k') := by
        rw [mergeK, if_neg (by simp)]
      have e4 : mergeK (node d (mergeK l k') (mergeK r k')) k =
          node (d.1, false) (mergeK l k') (mergeK r k') := by
        rw [mergeK, if_pos (by rw [key_node_mergeK]; exact h)]
      rw [e1, e2, e3, e4]
    · by_cases h' : d.2 ∧ key (node d l r) = k'
      · have e1 : mergeK (node d l r) k' = node (d.1, false) l r := by rw [mergeK, if_pos h']
        have e2 : mergeK (node d l r) k = node d (mergeK l k) (mergeK r k) := by
          rw [mergeK, if_neg h]
        have e3 : mergeK (node (d.1, false) l r) k =
            node (d.1, false) (mergeK l k) (mergeK r k) := by
          rw [mergeK, if_neg (by simp)]
        have e4 : mergeK (node d (mergeK l k) (mergeK r k)) k' =
            node (d.1, false) (mergeK l k) (mergeK r k) := by
          rw [mergeK, if_pos (by rw [key_node_mergeK]; exact h')]
        rw [e1, e2, e3, e4]
      · have e1 : mergeK (node d l r) k = node d (mergeK l k) (mergeK r k) := by
          rw [mergeK, if_neg h]
        have e2 : mergeK (node d l r) k' = node d (mergeK l k') (mergeK r k') := by
          rw [mergeK, if_neg h']
        have e3 : mergeK (node d (mergeK l k) (mergeK r k)) k' =
            node d (mergeK (mergeK l k) k') (mergeK (mergeK r k) k') := by
          rw [mergeK, if_neg (by rw [key_node_mergeK]; exact h')]
        have e4 : mergeK (node d (mergeK l k') (mergeK r k')) k =
            node d (mergeK (mergeK l k') k) (mergeK (mergeK r k') k) := by
          rw [mergeK, if_neg (by rw [key_node_mergeK]; exact h)]
        rw [e1, e2, e3, e4, mergeK_comm hkk l, mergeK_comm hkk r]

name: Operad.ShuffleBar.d_single
statement: @[simp] lemma d_single (x : BarTree E) (c : K) : d K (Finsupp.single x c) = c • dTree K x
proof:
:= by
  simp [d]

name: Operad.ShuffleBar.sgn_mergeK
statement:
lemma sgn_mergeK {x : BarTree E} (hx : x.labels.Nodup) {k k' : ℕ ×ₗ ℕ} (hk : k ∈ cutKeys x) :
    sgn K (mergeK x k) k' = (if k < k' then -1 else 1) * sgn K x k'
proof:
:= by
  unfold sgn
  rw [cutKeys_mergeK x hx hk, Finset.filter_erase]
  split_ifs with h
  · have hmem : k ∈ (cutKeys x).filter (· < k') := Finset.mem_filter.2 ⟨hk, h⟩
    rw [← Finset.card_erase_add_one hmem, pow_succ]
    ring
  · have hnot : k ∉ (cutKeys x).filter (· < k') := fun h' => h (Finset.mem_filter.1 h').2
    rw [Finset.erase_eq_of_notMem hnot, one_mul]

name: Operad.ShuffleBar.d_dTree
statement: theorem d_dTree (x : BarTree E) (hx : x.labels.Nodup) : d K (dTree K x) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have key1 : d K (dTree K x) = ∑ p ∈ (cutKeys x).offDiag,
      (sgn K x p.1 * sgn K (mergeK x p.1) p.2) • Finsupp.single (mergeK (mergeK x p.1) p.2) 1 := by
    rw [Finset.sum_finset_product (cutKeys x).offDiag (cutKeys x) (fun k => (cutKeys x).erase k)
      (fun p => by simp [Finset.mem_offDiag, and_comm, ne_comm])]
    rw [dTree, map_sum]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun k hk => ?_
    rw [map_smul, d_single, one_smul, dTree, cutKeys_mergeK x hx hk, Finset.smul_sum]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun k' _ => ?_
    rw [smul_smul]
  rw [key1]
  refine Finset.sum_involution (fun p _ => (p.2, p.1)) (fun p hp => ?_) (fun p hp _ => ?_)
    (fun p hp => ?_) (fun p _ => rfl)
  · obtain ⟨h1, h2, h12⟩ := Finset.mem_offDiag.1 hp
    simp only
    rw [mergeK_comm h12, sgn_mergeK K hx h1, sgn_mergeK K hx h2, ← add_smul]
    have : ¬(p.1 < p.2 ∧ p.2 < p.1) := fun h => lt_asymm h.1 h.2
    rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne h12 with h | h
    · simp [h, not_lt_of_gt h]
      ring_nf
      simp
    · simp [h, not_lt_of_gt h]
      ring_nf
      simp
  · obtain ⟨_, _, h12⟩ := Finset.mem_offDiag.1 hp
    exact fun h => h12 (by rw [Prod.ext_iff] at h; exact h.1.symm)
  · obtain ⟨h1, h2, h12⟩ := Finset.mem_offDiag.1 hp
    exact Finset.mem_offDiag.2 ⟨h2, h1, Ne.symm h12⟩

name: Operad.ShuffleBar.liftW_mapDec
statement:
@[simp] lemma liftW_mapDec (c : Bool) : ∀ σ : LTree E, (liftW c σ).mapDec Prod.fst = σ
  | leaf _ => rfl
  | node e l r => by
    simp only [liftW, mapDec_node, mapDec_mapDec]
    exact congrArg₂ _ (mapDec_id l) (mapDec_id r)

@[simp] lemma labels_liftW (c : Bool) (σ : LTree E) : (liftW c σ).labels = σ.labels
proof:
:= by
  rw [← labels_mapDec Prod.fst, liftW_mapDec]

name: Operad.ShuffleBar.labels_liftW
statement: @[simp] lemma labels_liftW (c : Bool) (σ : LTree E) : (liftW c σ).labels = σ.labels
proof:
:= by
  rw [← labels_mapDec Prod.fst, liftW_mapDec]

name: Operad.ShuffleBar.isShuffle_liftW
statement: @[simp] lemma isShuffle_liftW (c : Bool) (σ : LTree E) : (liftW c σ).IsShuffle ↔ σ.IsShuffle
proof:
:= by
  rw [← isShuffle_mapDec Prod.fst, liftW_mapDec]

name: Operad.ShuffleBar.full_substBar
statement:
lemma full_substBar {x : BarTree E} {p : List Bool} {s : Bool} (h : x.IsEdge p s) (σ : LTree E) :
    (substBar x p s σ).mapDec Prod.fst = (x.mapDec Prod.fst).substAt p s σ
proof:
:= by
  rw [substBar, ← substAt_mapDec Prod.fst x p s h, liftW_mapDec]

name: Operad.ShuffleBar.windowRoot_of_uncut
statement:
lemma windowRoot_of_uncut : ∀ (u : BarTree E) (s : Bool), u.IsEdgeRoot s →
    rootFlag (u.subtreeAt [s]) = false →
    u.windowRoot s = liftW (rootFlag u) ((u.mapDec Prod.fst).windowRoot s)
  | node (e, c) (node (f, c') a b) d, false, _, hc => by
    simp only [subtreeAt, rootFlag] at hc
    subst hc
    simp [windowRoot, window, rootFlag, liftW]
  | node (e, c) d (node (f, c') a b), true, _, hc => by
    simp only [subtreeAt, rootFlag] at hc
    subst hc
    cases d <;> simp [windowRoot, window, rootFlag, liftW]

name: Operad.ShuffleBar.windowAt_of_uncut
statement:
lemma windowAt_of_uncut {x : BarTree E} {p : List Bool} {s : Bool} (h : IsUncut x p s) :
    x.windowAt p s = liftW (flagAt x p) ((x.mapDec Prod.fst).windowAt p s)
proof:
:= by
  unfold windowAt flagAt
  rw [subtreeAt_mapDec]
  refine windowRoot_of_uncut _ s h.1 ?_
  have := h.2
  unfold flagAt at this
  rwa [subtreeAt_append] at this

name: Operad.ShuffleBar.key_eq_of_perm
statement: lemma key_eq_of_perm {X : Type*} {t u : LTree X} (h : t.labels.Perm u.labels) : key t = key u
proof:
:= by
  simp only [key, minLabel_eq_of_perm h, ← length_labels, h.length_eq]

name: Operad.ShuffleBar.arity_subtreeAt_le
statement:
lemma arity_subtreeAt_le {X : Type*} :
