    ∀ (t : LTree X) (p : List Bool), (t.subtreeAt p).arity ≤ t.arity
  | leaf _, [] => le_rfl
  | leaf _, _ :: _ => le_rfl
  | node _ _ _, [] => le_rfl
  | node _ l r, false :: p => by
    have
proof:
:= arity_subtreeAt_le l p
    simp only [subtreeAt, arity]
    omega
  | node _ l r, true :: p => by
    have := arity_subtreeAt_le r p
    simp only [subtreeAt, arity]
    omega

name: Operad.ShuffleBar.not_mem_cutKeys_of_arity
statement:
lemma not_mem_cutKeys_of_arity {k : ℕ ×ₗ ℕ} {u : BarTree E} (h : u.arity < (ofLex k).2) :
    k ∉ cutKeys u
proof:
:= fun hk => by
  have := (mem_nodeKeys_labels u (cutKeys_subset u hk)).2
  omega

name: Operad.ShuffleBar.cutKeys_plug_unflag
statement:
lemma cutKeys_plug_unflag (ins : ℕ → BarTree E) : ∀ m : LTree E,
    cutKeys ((unflag m).plug ins) = m.labels.toFinset.biUnion fun a => cutKeys (ins a)
  | leaf a => by simp [plug]
  | node e l r => by
    simp only [mapDec_node, plug, cutKeys, Bool.false_eq_true, if_false, Finset.empty_union,
      labels_node, List.toFinset_append]
    rw [cutKeys_plug_unflag ins l, cutKeys_plug_unflag ins r, Finset.union_biUnion]

name: Operad.ShuffleBar.cutKeys_plug_liftW
statement:
lemma cutKeys_plug_liftW (ins : ℕ → BarTree E) (c : Bool) (e : E) (l r : LTree E) :
    cutKeys ((liftW c (node e l r)).plug ins) =
      (if c then {key ((liftW c (node e l r)).plug ins)} else ∅) ∪
        (node e l r).labels.toFinset.biUnion fun a => cutKeys (ins a)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [liftW, plug, cutKeys, labels_node, List.toFinset_append]
  rw [cutKeys_plug_unflag ins l, cutKeys_plug_unflag ins r, Finset.union_biUnion]

name: Operad.ShuffleBar.mergeK_plug_unflag
statement:
lemma mergeK_plug_unflag (ins : ℕ → BarTree E) (k : ℕ ×ₗ ℕ) : ∀ m : LTree E,
    mergeK ((unflag m).plug ins) k = (unflag m).plug fun a => mergeK (ins a) k
  | leaf _ => rfl
  | node e l r => by
    simp only [mapDec_node, plug, mergeK, Bool.false_eq_true, false_and, if_false]
    rw [mergeK_plug_unflag ins k l, mergeK_plug_unflag ins k r]

name: Operad.ShuffleBar.mergeK_plug_liftW
statement:
lemma mergeK_plug_liftW (ins : ℕ → BarTree E) (c : Bool) (e : E) (l r : LTree E) (k : ℕ ×ₗ ℕ)
    (hk : ¬(c ∧ key ((liftW c (node e l r)).plug ins) = k)) :
    mergeK ((liftW c (node e l r)).plug ins) k =
      (liftW c (node e l r)).plug fun a => mergeK (ins a) k
proof:
:= by
  change mergeK (node (e, c) ((unflag l).plug ins) ((unflag r).plug ins)) k = _
  rw [mergeK]
  split_ifs with h'
  · exact absurd h' hk
  · rw [mergeK_plug_unflag, mergeK_plug_unflag]
    rfl

name: Operad.ShuffleBar.mergeK_plug_liftW_root
statement:
lemma mergeK_plug_liftW_root (ins : ℕ → BarTree E) (c : Bool) (e : E) (l r : LTree E)
    (k : ℕ ×ₗ ℕ) (hk : c ∧ key ((liftW c (node e l r)).plug ins) = k) :
    mergeK ((liftW c (node e l r)).plug ins) k = (liftW false (node e l r)).plug ins
proof:
:= by
  change mergeK (node (e, c) ((unflag l).plug ins) ((unflag r).plug ins)) k = _
  rw [mergeK]
  split_ifs with h'
  · rfl
  · exact absurd hk h'

name: Operad.ShuffleBar.subtreeAt_mergeK
statement:
lemma subtreeAt_mergeK (k : ℕ ×ₗ ℕ) :
    ∀ (x : BarTree E) (p : List Bool), (mergeK x k).subtreeAt p = mergeK (x.subtreeAt p) k
  | leaf _, [] => rfl
  | leaf _, _ :: _ => rfl
  | node _ _ _, [] => by simp
  | node d l r, b :: p => by
    by_cases h : d.2 ∧ key (node d l r) = k
    · have hk : ∀ t : BarTree E, t.arity < (node d l r).arity → mergeK t k = t
proof:
:= fun t ht =>
        mergeK_of_not_mem t (not_mem_cutKeys_of_arity (by
          rw [← h.2]
          simpa [key] using ht))
      rw [mergeK, if_pos h]
      cases b
      · simp only [subtreeAt]
        rw [hk]
        have := arity_subtreeAt_le l p
        have := arity_pos r
        simp only [arity]
        omega
      · simp only [subtreeAt]
        rw [hk]
        have := arity_subtreeAt_le r p
        have := arity_pos l
        simp only [arity]
        omega
    · rw [mergeK, if_neg h]
      cases b
      · exact subtreeAt_mergeK k l p
      · exact subtreeAt_mergeK k r p

name: Operad.ShuffleBar.mergeK_replaceAt
statement:
lemma mergeK_replaceAt (k : ℕ ×ₗ ℕ) : ∀ (x : BarTree E) (p : List Bool) (U : BarTree E),
    (∃ e l r, x.subtreeAt p = node e l r) → U.labels.Perm (x.subtreeAt p).labels →
    mergeK (x.replaceAt p U) k = (mergeK x k).replaceAt p (mergeK U k)
  | leaf _, [], _, _, _ => by simp
  | leaf _, _ :: _, _, ⟨_, _, _, h⟩, _ => by simp [subtreeAt] at h
  | node _ _ _, [], _, _, _ => by simp
  | node d l r, b :: p, U, hv, hU => by
    have hUa : U.arity = (subtreeAt (node d l r) (b :: p)).arity
proof:
:= by
      rw [← length_labels, ← length_labels, hU.length_eq]
    cases b
    · have hkey : key (node d (l.replaceAt p U) r) = key (node d l r) :=
        key_eq_of_perm (by simpa using (labels_replaceAt_perm l p U hv hU).append_right _)
      by_cases h : d.2 ∧ key (node d l r) = k
      · have hUk : mergeK U k = U := mergeK_of_not_mem U (not_mem_cutKeys_of_arity (by
          rw [← h.2, hUa]
          have := arity_subtreeAt_le l p
          have := arity_pos r
          simp only [key, subtreeAt, arity, ofLex_toLex]
          omega))
        rw [replaceAt, mergeK, if_pos (by rw [hkey]; exact h), mergeK, if_pos h, hUk]
        rfl
      · rw [replaceAt, mergeK, if_neg (by rw [hkey]; exact h), mergeK, if_neg h,
          mergeK_replaceAt k l p U hv hU]
        rfl
    · have hkey : key (node d l (r.replaceAt p U)) = key (node d l r) :=
        key_eq_of_perm (by simpa using (labels_replaceAt_perm r p U hv hU).append_left _)
      by_cases h : d.2 ∧ key (node d l r) = k
      · have hUk : mergeK U k = U := mergeK_of_not_mem U (not_mem_cutKeys_of_arity (by
          rw [← h.2, hUa]
          have := arity_subtreeAt_le r p
          have := arity_pos l
          simp only [key, subtreeAt, arity, ofLex_toLex]
          omega))
        rw [replaceAt, mergeK, if_pos (by rw [hkey]; exact h), mergeK, if_pos h, hUk]
        rfl
      · rw [replaceAt, mergeK, if_neg (by rw [hkey]; exact h), mergeK, if_neg h,
          mergeK_replaceAt k r p U hv hU]
        rfl

name: Operad.ShuffleBar.cutKeys_replaceAt
statement:
lemma cutKeys_replaceAt : ∀ (x : BarTree E) (p : List Bool) (U : BarTree E),
    (∃ e l r, x.subtreeAt p = node e l r) → U.labels.Perm (x.subtreeAt p).labels →
    cutKeys U = cutKeys (x.subtreeAt p) → cutKeys (x.replaceAt p U) = cutKeys x
  | leaf _, [], _, _, _, h => by simpa using h
  | leaf _, _ :: _, _, ⟨_, _, _, h⟩, _, _ => by simp [subtreeAt] at h
  | node _ _ _, [], _, _, _, h => by simpa using h
  | node d l r, false :: p, U, hv, hU, h => by
    have hkey : key (node d (l.replaceAt p U) r) = key (node d l r)
proof:
:=
      key_eq_of_perm (by simpa using (labels_replaceAt_perm l p U hv hU).append_right _)
    simp only [replaceAt, cutKeys, hkey, cutKeys_replaceAt l p U hv hU h]
  | node d l r, true :: p, U, hv, hU, h => by
    have hkey : key (node d l (r.replaceAt p U)) = key (node d l r) :=
      key_eq_of_perm (by simpa using (labels_replaceAt_perm r p U hv hU).append_left _)
    simp only [replaceAt, cutKeys, hkey, cutKeys_replaceAt r p U hv hU h]

name: Operad.ShuffleBar.windowRoot_shape
statement:
lemma windowRoot_shape {X : Type*} : ∀ (u : LTree X) (s : Bool), u.IsEdgeRoot s → u.IsShuffle →
    u.labels.Nodup → (u.windowRoot s).IsShuffle ∧ (u.windowRoot s).labels.Perm (List.range 3) ∧
      ∃ e l r, u.windowRoot s = node e l r
  | node e (node f a b) c, false, _, hs, hnd => by
    rcases window_left_shape hs hnd with h | h <;> simp only [windowRoot, h]
    · exact ⟨by simp, (by decide : ([0, 1, 2] : List ℕ).Perm (List.range 3)), _, _, _, rfl⟩
    · exact ⟨by simp, (by decide : ([0, 2, 1] : List ℕ).Perm (List.range 3)), _, _, _, rfl⟩
  | node e c (node f a b), true, _, hs, _ => by
    have h
proof:
:= window_right_eq hs
    have hw : windowRoot (node e c (node f a b)) true = window e f true a.minLabel b.minLabel
        c.minLabel := by cases c <;> rfl
    rw [hw, h]
    exact ⟨by simp, (by decide : ([0, 1, 2] : List ℕ).Perm (List.range 3)), _, _, _, rfl⟩

name: Operad.ShuffleBar.winIns_root
statement:
lemma winIns_root {X : Type*} (d d' : X) (l r : LTree X) (s : Bool)
    (he : (node d l r).IsEdgeRoot s) : (node d l r).winIns s = (node d' l r).winIns s
proof:
:= by
  cases s <;> cases l <;> cases r <;> first | rfl | exact absurd he (by simp [IsEdgeRoot])

name: Operad.ShuffleBar.winIns_mergeK
statement:
lemma winIns_mergeK (k : ℕ ×ₗ ℕ) : ∀ (d : E × Bool) (l r : BarTree E) (s : Bool),
    (node d l r).IsEdgeRoot s → rootFlag ((node d l r).subtreeAt [s]) = false →
    (node d (mergeK l k) (mergeK r k)).winIns s = fun a => mergeK ((node d l r).winIns s a) k
  | d, node f a b, c, false, _, hf => by
    simp only [subtreeAt, rootFlag] at hf
    have : mergeK (node f a b) k = node f (mergeK a k) (mergeK b k)
proof:
:= by
      rw [mergeK, if_neg (by simp [hf])]
    funext i
    simp only [winIns, this, winInputs, minLabel_mergeK]
    split_ifs <;> simp only [ins3] <;> split_ifs <;> rfl
  | d, c, node f a b, true, _, hf => by
    simp only [subtreeAt, rootFlag] at hf
    have : mergeK (node f a b) k = node f (mergeK a k) (mergeK b k) := by
      rw [mergeK, if_neg (by simp [hf])]
    funext i
    have e1 : (node d (mergeK c k) (node f (mergeK a k) (mergeK b k))).winInputs true =
        (mergeK c k, mergeK a k, mergeK b k) := by cases mergeK c k <;> rfl
    have e2 : (node d c (node f a b)).winInputs true = (c, a, b) := by cases c <;> rfl
    simp only [winIns, this, e1, e2, ins3]
    split_ifs <;> rfl

name: Operad.ShuffleBar.subtreeAt_eq_plug
statement:
lemma subtreeAt_eq_plug (hs : x.IsShuffle) (hnd : x.labels.Nodup) (h : IsUncut x p s) :
    x.subtreeAt p =
      (liftW (flagAt x p) ((x.mapDec Prod.fst).windowAt p s)).plug ((x.subtreeAt p).winIns s)
proof:
:= by
  have hw := winSpec h.1 (isShuffle_subtreeAt x p hs) (nodup_subtreeAt x p hnd)
  rw [← windowAt_of_uncut h]
  exact hw.window.symm

name: Operad.ShuffleBar.window_full_shape
statement:
lemma window_full_shape (hs : x.IsShuffle) (hnd : x.labels.Nodup) (h : IsUncut x p s) :
    ((x.mapDec Prod.fst).windowAt p s).IsShuffle ∧
      ((x.mapDec Prod.fst).windowAt p s).labels.Perm (List.range 3) ∧
      ∃ e l r, (x.mapDec Prod.fst).windowAt p s = node e l r
proof:
:= by
  unfold windowAt
  rw [subtreeAt_mapDec]
  exact windowRoot_shape _ s ((isEdgeRoot_mapDec _ _ s).2 h.1)
    (by simpa using isShuffle_subtreeAt x p hs) (by simpa using nodup_subtreeAt x p hnd)

name: Operad.ShuffleBar.perm_labels_plug_liftW
statement:
lemma perm_labels_plug_liftW (hs : x.IsShuffle) (hnd : x.labels.Nodup) (h : IsUncut x p s)
    (hσ : σ.labels.Perm (List.range 3)) (c : Bool) :
    ((liftW c σ).plug ((x.subtreeAt p).winIns s)).labels.Perm (x.subtreeAt p).labels
proof:
:=
  ((perm_labels_plug (by simpa using hσ) _).trans
    (winSpec h.1 (isShuffle_subtreeAt x p hs) (nodup_subtreeAt x p hnd)).perm.symm)

name: Operad.ShuffleBar.cutKeys_substBar
statement:
theorem cutKeys_substBar (hs : x.IsShuffle) (hnd : x.labels.Nodup) (h : IsUncut x p s)
    (hσ : σ.labels.Perm (List.range 3)) (hσn : ∃ e l r, σ = node e l r) :
    cutKeys (substBar x p s σ) = cutKeys x
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨e', l', r', rfl⟩ := hσn
  obtain ⟨-, hwl, e, l, r, hw⟩ := window_full_shape hs hnd h
  have hu := subtreeAt_eq_plug hs hnd h
  have hperm := perm_labels_plug_liftW hs hnd h hσ (flagAt x p)
  refine cutKeys_replaceAt x p _ h.1.exists_node hperm ?_
  rw [hw] at hu hwl
  have hk : key ((liftW (flagAt x p) (node e' l' r')).plug ((x.subtreeAt p).winIns s)) =
      key ((liftW (flagAt x p) (node e l r)).plug ((x.subtreeAt p).winIns s)) :=
    (key_eq_of_perm hperm).trans (congrArg key hu)
  conv_rhs => rw [hu]
  rw [cutKeys_plug_liftW, cutKeys_plug_liftW, List.toFinset_eq_of_perm _ _ hσ,
    List.toFinset_eq_of_perm _ _ hwl, hk]

name: Operad.ShuffleBar.mergeK_substBar
statement:
theorem mergeK_substBar (hs : x.IsShuffle) (hnd : x.labels.Nodup) (h : IsUncut x p s)
    (hσ : σ.labels.Perm (List.range 3)) (hσn : ∃ e l r, σ = node e l r) (k : ℕ ×ₗ ℕ) :
    mergeK (substBar x p s σ) k = substBar (mergeK x k) p s σ
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨e', l', r', rfl⟩ := hσn
  have hperm := perm_labels_plug_liftW hs hnd h hσ (flagAt x p)
  unfold substBar substAt
  rw [mergeK_replaceAt k x p _ h.1.exists_node hperm]
  simp only [flagAt, subtreeAt_mergeK]
  congr 1
  obtain ⟨d, L, R, hu⟩ := h.1.exists_node
  have hflag : flagAt x p = d.2 := by simp [flagAt, hu, rootFlag]
  have hkey : key ((liftW (flagAt x p) (node e' l' r')).plug ((x.subtreeAt p).winIns s)) =
      key (node d L R) := by rw [← hu]; exact key_eq_of_perm hperm
  rw [hflag, hu] at hkey
  rw [hu]
  simp only [rootFlag]
  by_cases hroot : d.2 ∧ key (node d L R) = k
  · have e1 : mergeK (node d L R) k = node (d.1, false) L R := by rw [mergeK, if_pos hroot]
    have he : (node d L R).IsEdgeRoot s := by rw [← hu]; exact h.1
    rw [e1, ← winIns_root d (d.1, false) L R s he,
      mergeK_plug_liftW_root _ _ _ _ _ _ ⟨hroot.1, hkey.trans hroot.2⟩]
  · have e1 : mergeK (node d L R) k = node d (mergeK L k) (mergeK R k) := by
      rw [mergeK, if_neg hroot]
    have he : (node d L R).IsEdgeRoot s := by rw [← hu]; exact h.1
    have hf : rootFlag ((node d L R).subtreeAt [s]) = false := by
      have := h.2
      rwa [flagAt, subtreeAt_append, hu] at this
    rw [e1, winIns_mergeK k d L R s he hf,
      mergeK_plug_liftW _ _ _ _ _ _ (fun h' => hroot ⟨h'.1, hkey.symm.trans h'.2⟩)]

name: Operad.ShuffleBar.isEdgeRoot_mergeK
statement:
lemma isEdgeRoot_mergeK (k : ℕ ×ₗ ℕ) (u : BarTree E) (s : Bool) :
    (mergeK u k).IsEdgeRoot s ↔ u.IsEdgeRoot s
proof:
:= by
  rw [← isEdgeRoot_mapDec Prod.fst, full_mergeK, isEdgeRoot_mapDec]

name: Operad.ShuffleBar.IsUncut.mergeK
statement: lemma IsUncut.mergeK (h : IsUncut x p s) (k : ℕ ×ₗ ℕ) : IsUncut (mergeK x k) p s
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · unfold IsEdge
    rw [subtreeAt_mergeK, isEdgeRoot_mergeK]
    exact h.1
  · unfold flagAt
    rw [subtreeAt_mergeK]
    exact rootFlag_mergeK_le k _ h.2

name: Operad.ShuffleBar.isShuffle_substBar
statement:
lemma isShuffle_substBar (hs : x.IsShuffle) (hnd : x.labels.Nodup) (h : IsUncut x p s)
    (hσs : σ.IsShuffle) (hσ : σ.labels.Perm (List.range 3)) : (substBar x p s σ).IsShuffle
proof:
:=
  isShuffle_substAt h.1 hs hnd (by simpa using hσs) (by simpa using hσ)

name: Operad.ShuffleBar.perm_labels_substBar
statement:
lemma perm_labels_substBar (hs : x.IsShuffle) (hnd : x.labels.Nodup) (h : IsUncut x p s)
    (hσ : σ.labels.Perm (List.range 3)) : (substBar x p s σ).labels.Perm x.labels
proof:
:=
  perm_labels_substAt h.1 hs hnd (by simpa using hσ)

name: Operad.ShuffleBar.rootFlag_substBar
statement:
lemma rootFlag_substBar (hs : x.IsShuffle) (hnd : x.labels.Nodup) (h : IsUncut x p s)
    (hσn : ∃ e l r, σ = node e l r) : rootFlag (substBar x p s σ) = rootFlag x
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨e, l, r, rfl⟩ := hσn
  obtain ⟨d, L, R, hu⟩ := h.1.exists_node
  unfold substBar substAt
  cases p with
  | nil =>
    simp only [replaceAt_nil, flagAt, subtreeAt_nil]
    simp [liftW, plug, rootFlag]
  | cons b p =>
    cases x with
    | leaf => simp [subtreeAt] at hu
    | node d' L' R' => cases b <;> rfl

name: Operad.ShuffleBar.Valid.mergeK
statement: lemma Valid.mergeK {x : BarTree E} (hx : Valid x) (k : ℕ ×ₗ ℕ) : Valid (mergeK x k)
proof:
:=
  ⟨(isShuffle_mergeK k x).2 hx.shuffle, by simpa using hx.nodup, rootFlag_mergeK_le k x hx.root⟩

name: Operad.ShuffleBar.sgn_congr
statement:
lemma sgn_congr {x y : BarTree E} (h : cutKeys x = cutKeys y) (k : ℕ ×ₗ ℕ) :
    sgn K x k = sgn K y k
proof:
:= by
  simp [sgn, h]

name: Operad.ShuffleBar.mono_shape
statement:
lemma mono_shape (σ : Mono E 3) :
    σ.1.IsShuffle ∧ σ.1.labels.Perm (List.range 3) ∧ ∃ e l r, σ.1 = node e l r
proof:
:= by
  have h := (mem_monomials 3 σ.1).1 σ.2
  refine ⟨h.1, h.2, ?_⟩
  match hσ : σ.1 with
  | leaf a =>
    have := h.2.length_eq
    rw [hσ] at this
    simp at this
  | node e l r => exact ⟨e, l, r, rfl⟩

name: Operad.ShuffleBar.Valid.substBar
statement:
lemma Valid.substBar {x : BarTree E} (hx : Valid x) {p : List Bool} {s : Bool} (h : IsUncut x p s)
    (σ : Mono E 3) : Valid (substBar x p s σ.1)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hσs, hσ, hσn⟩ := mono_shape σ
  exact ⟨isShuffle_substBar hx.shuffle hx.nodup h hσs hσ,
    (perm_labels_substBar hx.shuffle hx.nodup h hσ).nodup_iff.2 hx.nodup,
    (rootFlag_substBar hx.shuffle hx.nodup h hσn).trans hx.root⟩

name: Operad.ShuffleBar.d_substRel
statement:
theorem d_substRel {x : BarTree E} (hx : Valid x) {p : List Bool} {s : Bool} (h : IsUncut x p s)
    (r : Mono E 3 → K) :
    d K (substRel K x p s r) = ∑ k ∈ cutKeys x, sgn K x k • substRel K (mergeK x k) p s r
proof:
:= by
  simp only [substRel, map_sum, map_smul, d_single, one_smul, Finset.smul_sum]
  rw [Finset.sum_comm]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun σ _ => ?_
  obtain ⟨-, hσ, hσn⟩ := mono_shape σ
  rw [dTree, cutKeys_substBar hx.shuffle hx.nodup h hσ hσn, Finset.smul_sum]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun k _ => ?_
  rw [sgn_congr K (cutKeys_substBar hx.shuffle hx.nodup h hσ hσn),
    mergeK_substBar hx.shuffle hx.nodup h hσ hσn, smul_comm]

name: Operad.ShuffleBar.d_mem_J
statement:
theorem d_mem_J (R : Submodule K (Mono E 3 → K)) {v : BarTree E →₀ K} (hv : v ∈ J K R) :
    d K v ∈ J K R
proof:
:= by
  induction hv using Submodule.span_induction with
  | mem v hv =>
    obtain ⟨x, p, s, r, hx, h, hr, rfl⟩ := hv
    rw [d_substRel K hx h]
    exact Submodule.sum_mem _ fun k _ => Submodule.smul_mem _ _
      (Submodule.subset_span ⟨_, p, s, r, hx.mergeK k, h.mergeK k, hr, rfl⟩)
  | zero => simp
  | add v w _ _ hv hw => rw [map_add]; exact add_mem hv hw
  | smul c v _ hv => rw [map_smul]; exact Submodule.smul_mem _ c hv

name: Operad.ShuffleBar.normalBar_mergeK
statement:
lemma normalBar_mergeK {L : Set (LTree E)} {x : BarTree E} (hnd : x.labels.Nodup)
    {k : ℕ ×ₗ ℕ} (hk : k ∈ cutKeys x) :
    NormalBar L (mergeK x k) ↔
      NormalBar L x ∧ ∀ w, (k, w) ∈ (x.mapDec Prod.fst).edgeWins → w ∉ L
proof:
:= by
  unfold NormalBar
  rw [full_mergeK, cutKeys_mergeK x hnd hk]
  constructor
  · intro h
    exact ⟨fun kw hkw hc => h kw hkw fun h' => hc (Finset.mem_of_mem_erase h'),
      fun w hw => h (k, w) hw (Finset.notMem_erase k _)⟩
  · rintro ⟨h1, h2⟩ ⟨k', w⟩ hkw hc
    by_cases hkk : k' = k
    · subst hkk
      exact h2 w hkw
    · exact h1 _ hkw fun h => hc (Finset.mem_erase.2 ⟨hkk, h⟩)

name: Operad.ShuffleBar.key_mem_cutKeys
statement:
lemma key_mem_cutKeys : ∀ (x : BarTree E) (q : List Bool) (d : E × Bool) (l r : BarTree E),
    x.subtreeAt q = node d l r → d.2 = true → key (node d l r) ∈ cutKeys x
  | leaf _, [], _, _, _, h, _ => by simp at h
  | leaf _, _ :: _, _, _, _, h, _ => by simp [subtreeAt] at h
  | node d' l' r', [], d, l, r, h, hd => by
    simp only [subtreeAt_nil, node.injEq] at h
    obtain ⟨rfl, rfl, rfl⟩
proof:
:= h
    simp [cutKeys, hd]
  | node d' l' r', false :: q, d, l, r, h, hd => by
    have := key_mem_cutKeys l' q d l r h hd
    simp [cutKeys, this]
  | node d' l' r', true :: q, d, l, r, h, hd => by
    have := key_mem_cutKeys r' q d l r h hd
    simp [cutKeys, this]

name: Operad.ShuffleBar.cutKeys_subset_insert
statement:
lemma cutKeys_subset_insert : ∀ x : BarTree E,
    cutKeys x ⊆ insert (key x) (x.mapDec Prod.fst).edgeKeys
  | leaf _ => by simp [cutKeys]
  | node d l r => by
    rw [cutKeys, mapDec_node, edgeKeys_node, nodeKeys_mapDec, nodeKeys_mapDec]
    refine Finset.union_subset ?_ (Finset.union_subset ?_ ?_)
    · split_ifs <;> simp
    · exact (cutKeys_subset l).trans fun k hk =>
        Finset.mem_insert_of_mem (Finset.mem_union_left _ hk)
    · exact (cutKeys_subset r).trans fun k hk =>
        Finset.mem_insert_of_mem (Finset.mem_union_right _ hk)

name: Operad.ShuffleBar.cutKeys_subset_edgeKeys
statement:
lemma cutKeys_subset_edgeKeys {x : BarTree E} (hx : rootFlag x = false) :
    cutKeys x ⊆ (x.mapDec Prod.fst).edgeKeys
proof:
:= by
  cases x with
  | leaf => simp [cutKeys]
  | node d l r =>
    simp only [rootFlag] at hx
    rw [cutKeys, mapDec_node, edgeKeys_node, nodeKeys_mapDec, nodeKeys_mapDec,
      if_neg (by simp [hx]), Finset.empty_union]
    exact Finset.union_subset_union (cutKeys_subset l) (cutKeys_subset r)

name: Operad.ShuffleBar.full_cutAux
statement:
@[simp] lemma full_cutAux (k : ℕ ×ₗ ℕ) :
    ∀ x : BarTree E, (cutAux x k).mapDec Prod.fst = x.mapDec Prod.fst
  | leaf _ => rfl
  | node d l r => by
    simp only [cutAux]
    split_ifs
    · rfl
    · simp only [mapDec_node]
      exact congrArg₂ _ (full_cutAux k l) (full_cutAux k r)

@[simp] lemma full_cutK (k : ℕ ×ₗ ℕ) (x : BarTree E) :
    (cutK x k).mapDec Prod.fst = x.mapDec Prod.fst
proof:
:= by
  cases x with
  | leaf => rfl
  | node d l r =>
    simp only [cutK, mapDec_node]
    exact congrArg₂ _ (full_cutAux k l) (full_cutAux k r)

name: Operad.ShuffleBar.full_cutK
statement:
@[simp] lemma full_cutK (k : ℕ ×ₗ ℕ) (x : BarTree E) :
    (cutK x k).mapDec Prod.fst = x.mapDec Prod.fst
proof:
:= by
  cases x with
  | leaf => rfl
  | node d l r =>
    simp only [cutK, mapDec_node]
    exact congrArg₂ _ (full_cutAux k l) (full_cutAux k r)

name: Operad.ShuffleBar.labels_cutK
statement: @[simp] lemma labels_cutK (k : ℕ ×ₗ ℕ) (x : BarTree E) : (cutK x k).labels = x.labels
proof:
:= by
  rw [← labels_mapDec Prod.fst, full_cutK, labels_mapDec]

name: Operad.ShuffleBar.isShuffle_cutK
statement: lemma isShuffle_cutK (k : ℕ ×ₗ ℕ) (x : BarTree E) : (cutK x k).IsShuffle ↔ x.IsShuffle
proof:
:= by
  rw [← isShuffle_mapDec Prod.fst, full_cutK, isShuffle_mapDec]

name: Operad.ShuffleBar.rootFlag_cutK
statement: lemma rootFlag_cutK (k : ℕ ×ₗ ℕ) (x : BarTree E) : rootFlag (cutK x k) = rootFlag x
proof:
:= by
  cases x <;> rfl

name: Operad.ShuffleBar.key_cutAux
statement: lemma key_cutAux (k : ℕ ×ₗ ℕ) (x : BarTree E) : key (cutAux x k) = key x
proof:
:= by
  rw [← key_mapDec Prod.fst, full_cutAux, key_mapDec]

name: Operad.ShuffleBar.cutAux_of_not_mem
statement:
lemma cutAux_of_not_mem {k : ℕ ×ₗ ℕ} : ∀ x : BarTree E, k ∉ x.nodeKeys → cutAux x k = x
  | leaf _, _ => rfl
  | node d l r, hk => by
    simp only [nodeKeys, Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_union, not_or] at hk
    simp only [cutAux, if_neg (Ne.symm hk.1), cutAux_of_not_mem l hk.2.1,
      cutAux_of_not_mem r hk.2.2]

name: Operad.ShuffleBar.minLabel_cutAux
statement: lemma minLabel_cutAux (k : ℕ ×ₗ ℕ) (x : BarTree E) : (cutAux x k).minLabel = x.minLabel
proof:
:= by
  rw [← minLabel_mapDec Prod.fst, full_cutAux, minLabel_mapDec]

name: Operad.ShuffleBar.arity_cutAux
statement: lemma arity_cutAux (k : ℕ ×ₗ ℕ) (x : BarTree E) : (cutAux x k).arity = x.arity
proof:
:= by
  rw [← arity_mapDec Prod.fst, full_cutAux, arity_mapDec]

name: Operad.ShuffleBar.key_node_cutAux
statement:
lemma key_node_cutAux (d : E × Bool) (l r : BarTree E) (k : ℕ ×ₗ ℕ) :
    key (node d (cutAux l k) (cutAux r k)) = key (node d l r)
proof:
:= by
  simp [key_node, minLabel_cutAux, arity_cutAux]

name: Operad.ShuffleBar.cutKeys_cutAux
statement:
lemma cutKeys_cutAux {k : ℕ ×ₗ ℕ} : ∀ x : BarTree E, x.labels.Nodup → k ∈ x.nodeKeys →
    cutKeys (cutAux x k) = insert k (cutKeys x)
  | leaf _, _, hk => by simp [nodeKeys] at hk
  | node d l r, hnd, hk => by
    have hdisj
proof:
:= disjoint_nodeKeys hnd
    by_cases hroot : key (node d l r) = k
    · subst hroot
      have hkey : key (node (d.1, true) l r) = key (node d l r) := rfl
      rw [cutAux, if_pos rfl, cutKeys, cutKeys, hkey, if_pos rfl]
      ext k'
      simp only [Finset.mem_union, Finset.mem_singleton, Finset.mem_insert]
      split_ifs <;> simp
    · simp only [nodeKeys, Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_union] at hk
      rw [cutAux, if_neg hroot, cutKeys, cutKeys, key_node_cutAux]
      rcases hk with hk | hk | hk
      · exact absurd hk.symm hroot
      · have hk' : k ∉ r.nodeKeys := fun h => Finset.disjoint_left.1 hdisj hk h
        rw [cutKeys_cutAux l (List.nodup_append.1 hnd).1 hk, cutAux_of_not_mem r hk']
        ext k'
        simp only [Finset.mem_union, Finset.mem_insert]
        tauto
      · have hk' : k ∉ l.nodeKeys := fun h => Finset.disjoint_left.1 hdisj h hk
        rw [cutKeys_cutAux r (List.nodup_append.1 hnd).2.1 hk, cutAux_of_not_mem l hk']
        ext k'
        simp only [Finset.mem_union, Finset.mem_insert]
        tauto

name: Operad.ShuffleBar.cutKeys_cutK
statement:
lemma cutKeys_cutK {x : BarTree E} (hnd : x.labels.Nodup) {k : ℕ ×ₗ ℕ}
    (hk : k ∈ (x.mapDec Prod.fst).edgeKeys) : cutKeys (cutK x k) = insert k (cutKeys x)
proof:
:= by
  cases x with
  | leaf => simp [edgeKeys, edgeWins] at hk
  | node d l r =>
    have hdisj := disjoint_nodeKeys hnd
    rw [mapDec_node, edgeKeys_node, nodeKeys_mapDec, nodeKeys_mapDec, Finset.mem_union] at hk
    rw [cutK, cutKeys, cutKeys, key_node_cutAux]
    rcases hk with hk | hk
    · rw [cutKeys_cutAux l (List.nodup_append.1 hnd).1 hk,
        cutAux_of_not_mem r fun h => Finset.disjoint_left.1 hdisj hk h]
      ext k'
      simp only [Finset.mem_union, Finset.mem_insert]
      tauto
    · rw [cutKeys_cutAux r (List.nodup_append.1 hnd).2.1 hk,
        cutAux_of_not_mem l fun h => Finset.disjoint_left.1 hdisj h hk]
      ext k'
      simp only [Finset.mem_union, Finset.mem_insert]
      tauto

name: Operad.ShuffleBar.mergeK_cutAux
statement:
lemma mergeK_cutAux {k : ℕ ×ₗ ℕ} : ∀ y : BarTree E, k ∉ cutKeys y → mergeK (cutAux y k) k = y
  | leaf _, _ => rfl
  | node d l r, hk => by
    have hkl : k ∉ cutKeys l
proof:
:= fun h => hk (by rw [cutKeys]; simp [h])
    have hkr : k ∉ cutKeys r := fun h => hk (by rw [cutKeys]; simp [h])
    by_cases hroot : key (node d l r) = k
    · have hd : d.2 = false := by
        by_contra hd
        exact hk (by rw [cutKeys]; simp [hd, hroot])
      rw [cutAux, if_pos hroot, mergeK, if_pos ⟨rfl, hroot⟩]
      obtain ⟨e, c⟩ := d
      simp only at hd
      subst hd
      rfl
    · rw [cutAux, if_neg hroot, mergeK, if_neg (by rw [key_node_cutAux]; exact fun h => hroot h.2),
        mergeK_cutAux l hkl, mergeK_cutAux r hkr]

name: Operad.ShuffleBar.cutAux_mergeK
statement:
lemma cutAux_mergeK {k : ℕ ×ₗ ℕ} : ∀ y : BarTree E, y.labels.Nodup → k ∈ cutKeys y →
    cutAux (mergeK y k) k = y
  | leaf _, _, hk => by simp [cutKeys] at hk
  | node d l r, hnd, hk => by
    have hdisj
proof:
:= disjoint_nodeKeys hnd
    by_cases hroot : d.2 ∧ key (node d l r) = k
    · rw [mergeK, if_pos hroot, cutAux,
        if_pos (show key (node (d.1, false) l r) = k from hroot.2)]
      obtain ⟨e, c⟩ := d
      obtain ⟨h1, -⟩ := hroot
      simp only at h1
      subst h1
      rfl
    · have hlr : k ∈ cutKeys l ∨ k ∈ cutKeys r := by
        rw [cutKeys, Finset.mem_union, Finset.mem_union] at hk
        rcases hk with hk | hk | hk
        · split_ifs at hk with hd
          · exact absurd ⟨hd, (Finset.mem_singleton.1 hk).symm⟩ hroot
          · simp at hk
        · exact Or.inl hk
        · exact Or.inr hk
      have hne : key (node d l r) ≠ k := by
        rintro rfl
        rcases hlr with h | h
        · exact key_not_mem_left d l r (cutKeys_subset l h)
        · exact key_not_mem_right d l r (cutKeys_subset r h)
      rw [mergeK, if_neg hroot, cutAux, if_neg (by rw [key_node_mergeK]; exact hne)]
      rcases hlr with h | h
      · have hr : k ∉ r.nodeKeys := fun h' => Finset.disjoint_left.1 hdisj (cutKeys_subset l h) h'
        rw [cutAux_mergeK l (List.nodup_append.1 hnd).1 h,
          mergeK_of_not_mem r fun h' => hr (cutKeys_subset r h'), cutAux_of_not_mem r hr]
      · have hl : k ∉ l.nodeKeys := fun h' => Finset.disjoint_left.1 hdisj h' (cutKeys_subset r h)
        rw [cutAux_mergeK r (List.nodup_append.1 hnd).2.1 h,
          mergeK_of_not_mem l fun h' => hl (cutKeys_subset l h'), cutAux_of_not_mem l hl]

name: Operad.ShuffleBar.mergeK_cutK
statement:
lemma mergeK_cutK {x : BarTree E} (hx : rootFlag x = false) {k : ℕ ×ₗ ℕ} (hk : k ∉ cutKeys x) :
    mergeK (cutK x k) k = x
proof:
:= by
  cases x with
  | leaf => rfl
  | node d l r =>
    simp only [rootFlag] at hx
    have hkl : k ∉ cutKeys l := fun h => hk (by rw [cutKeys]; simp [h])
    have hkr : k ∉ cutKeys r := fun h => hk (by rw [cutKeys]; simp [h])
    rw [cutK, mergeK, if_neg (by simp [hx]), mergeK_cutAux l hkl, mergeK_cutAux r hkr]

name: Operad.ShuffleBar.cutK_mergeK
statement:
lemma cutK_mergeK {x : BarTree E} (hnd : x.labels.Nodup) (hx : rootFlag x = false)
    {k : ℕ ×ₗ ℕ} (hk : k ∈ cutKeys x) : cutK (mergeK x k) k = x
proof:
:= by
  cases x with
  | leaf => simp [cutKeys] at hk
  | node d l r =>
    simp only [rootFlag] at hx
    have hdisj := disjoint_nodeKeys hnd
    rw [cutKeys, if_neg (by simp [hx]), Finset.empty_union, Finset.mem_union] at hk
    rw [mergeK, if_neg (by simp [hx]), cutK]
    rcases hk with h | h
    · have hr : k ∉ r.nodeKeys := fun h' => Finset.disjoint_left.1 hdisj (cutKeys_subset l h) h'
      rw [cutAux_mergeK l (List.nodup_append.1 hnd).1 h,
        mergeK_of_not_mem r fun h' => hr (cutKeys_subset r h'), cutAux_of_not_mem r hr]
    · have hl : k ∉ l.nodeKeys := fun h' => Finset.disjoint_left.1 hdisj h' (cutKeys_subset r h)
      rw [cutAux_mergeK r (List.nodup_append.1 hnd).2.1 h,
        mergeK_of_not_mem l fun h' => hl (cutKeys_subset l h'), cutAux_of_not_mem l hl]

name: Operad.ShuffleBar.mergeK_cutAux_comm
statement:
lemma mergeK_cutAux_comm {k k₀ : ℕ ×ₗ ℕ} (hkk : k ≠ k₀) :
    ∀ y : BarTree E, mergeK (cutAux y k₀) k = cutAux (mergeK y k) k₀
  | leaf _ => rfl
  | node d l r => by
    by_cases h0 : key (node d l r) = k₀
    · have h1 : ¬(d.2 ∧ key (node d l r) = k)
proof:
:= fun h => hkk (h.2.symm.trans h0)
      rw [cutAux, if_pos h0, mergeK, if_neg (fun h => hkk (h.2.symm.trans h0)), mergeK,
        if_neg h1, cutAux, if_pos (by rw [key_node_mergeK]; exact h0)]
    · by_cases h1 : d.2 ∧ key (node d l r) = k
      · rw [cutAux, if_neg h0, mergeK, if_pos (by rw [key_node_cutAux]; exact h1), mergeK,
          if_pos h1, cutAux, if_neg (show ¬key (node (d.1, false) l r) = k₀ from h0)]
      · rw [cutAux, if_neg h0, mergeK, if_neg (by rw [key_node_cutAux]; exact h1), mergeK,
          if_neg h1, cutAux, if_neg (by rw [key_node_mergeK]; exact h0),
          mergeK_cutAux_comm hkk l, mergeK_cutAux_comm hkk r]

name: Operad.ShuffleBar.mergeK_cutK_comm
statement:
lemma mergeK_cutK_comm {k k₀ : ℕ ×ₗ ℕ} (hkk : k ≠ k₀) (x : BarTree E) :
    mergeK (cutK x k₀) k = cutK (mergeK x k) k₀
proof:
:= by
  cases x with
  | leaf => rfl
  | node d l r =>
    by_cases h1 : d.2 ∧ key (node d l r) = k
    · rw [cutK, mergeK, if_pos (by rw [key_node_cutAux]; exact h1), mergeK, if_pos h1, cutK]
    · rw [cutK, mergeK, if_neg (by rw [key_node_cutAux]; exact h1), mergeK, if_neg h1, cutK,
        mergeK_cutAux_comm hkk l, mergeK_cutAux_comm hkk r]

name: Operad.ShuffleBar.normalBar_cutK
statement:
lemma normalBar_cutK {L : Set (LTree E)} {x : BarTree E} (hnd : x.labels.Nodup) {k : ℕ ×ₗ ℕ}
    (hk : k ∈ (x.mapDec Prod.fst).edgeKeys) (h : NormalBar L x) : NormalBar L (cutK x k)
proof:
:= by
  unfold NormalBar at h ⊢
  rw [full_cutK, cutKeys_cutK hnd hk]
  exact fun kw hkw hc => h kw hkw fun h' => hc (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem h')

name: Operad.STree.mapV_replace
statement:
lemma mapV_replace (g : ∀ k, B k → B' k) :
    ∀ (q : List ℕ) (t u : STree B), (t.replace q u).mapV g = (t.mapV g).replace q (u.mapV g)
  | [], t, u => by simp
  | _ :: _, leaf _, _ => rfl
  | i :: q, node β c, u => by
    rw [replace_node_cons, mapV_node, mapV_node, replace_node_cons]
    congr 1
    funext j
    split_ifs
    · exact mapV_replace g q (c j) u
    · rfl

end STree

namespace ShuffleBarSym

open LTree ShuffleBar

                                                 

section Sign

variable {B : ℕ → Type w} {B' : ℕ → Type x}

name: Operad.ShuffleBarSym.vkey_mapV
statement: lemma vkey_mapV (g : ∀ k, B k → B' k) (t : STree B) : vkey (t.mapV g) = vkey t
proof:
:= by
  simp only [vkey, first_mapV, labels_mapV]

name: Operad.ShuffleBarSym.preKeys_mapV
statement:
lemma preKeys_mapV (g : ∀ k, B k → B' k) : ∀ t : STree B, preKeys (t.mapV g) = preKeys t
  | .leaf _ => rfl
  | .node β c => by
    rw [mapV_node, preKeys_node, preKeys_node, ← mapV_node, vkey_mapV]
    exact congrArg _ (congrArg _ (List.ofFn_inj.2 (funext fun j => preKeys_mapV g (c j))))

variable (K : Type u) [CommRing K]

name: Operad.ShuffleBarSym.sign_mapV
statement: lemma sign_mapV (g : ∀ k, B k → B' k) (t : STree B) : sign K (t.mapV g) = sign K t
proof:
:= by
  rw [sign, sign, preKeys_mapV]

name: Operad.ShuffleBarSym.sign_replace
statement:
lemma sign_replace {k : ℕ} (q : List ℕ) (t : STree B) (β β' : B k) (ch : Fin k → STree B) :
    sign K (t.replace q (.node β ch)) = sign K (t.replace q (.node β' ch))
proof:
:= by
  rw [← sign_mapV K (fun _ _ => ()) (t.replace q _),
    ← sign_mapV K (fun _ _ => ()) (t.replace q (.node β' ch)), mapV_replace, mapV_replace]
  rfl

name: Operad.ShuffleBarSym.nS_node
statement:
lemma nS_node {k : ℕ} (m : VMono G k) (ch : Fin k → STree (VMono G)) :
    nS S (.node m ch) = (if m ∈ S k then 0 else 1) + ∑ j, nS S (ch j)
proof:
:= by
  rw [nS]

name: Operad.ShuffleBarSym.mem_of_nS_node
statement:
lemma mem_of_nS_node {k : ℕ} {m : VMono G k} {ch : Fin k → STree (VMono G)}
    (h : nS S (.node m ch) = 0) : m ∈ S k
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [nS_node] at h
  by_contra hm
  rw [if_neg hm] at h
  omega

name: Operad.ShuffleBarSym.nS_child
statement:
lemma nS_child {k : ℕ} {m : VMono G k} {ch : Fin k → STree (VMono G)}
    (h : nS S (.node m ch) = 0) (j : Fin k) : nS S (ch j) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [nS_node] at h
  exact (Finset.sum_eq_zero_iff.1 (Nat.add_eq_zero_iff.1 h).2) j (Finset.mem_univ j)

name: Operad.ShuffleBarSym.nS_replace
statement:
lemma nS_replace {k : ℕ} (m m' : VMono G k) (ch : Fin k → STree (VMono G)) :
    ∀ (q : List ℕ) (t : STree (VMono G)), t.get? q = some (.node m ch) →
      nS S (t.replace q (.node m' ch)) + (if m ∈ S k then 0 else 1)
        = nS S t + (if m' ∈ S k then 0 else 1)
  | [], t, ht => by
    rw [get?_nil, Option.some_inj] at ht
    subst ht
    rw [replace_nil, nS_node, nS_node]
    omega
  | _ :: _, .leaf _, ht => by simp at ht
  | i :: q, .node (k := k') γ c, ht => by
    obtain ⟨hi, hc⟩
proof:
:= get?_node_cons_eq_some.1 ht
    have ih := nS_replace m m' ch q _ hc
    rw [replace_node_cons, nS_node, nS_node]
    rw [← Finset.add_sum_erase _ _ (Finset.mem_univ (⟨i, hi⟩ : Fin k')),
      ← Finset.add_sum_erase _ (fun j => nS S (c j)) (Finset.mem_univ (⟨i, hi⟩ : Fin k'))]
    have hrest : ∑ j ∈ Finset.univ.erase (⟨i, hi⟩ : Fin k'), nS S (if (j : ℕ) = i then
        (c j).replace q (.node m' ch) else c j)
          = ∑ j ∈ Finset.univ.erase (⟨i, hi⟩ : Fin k'), nS S (c j) :=
      Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j hj => by
        rw [if_neg fun h => Finset.ne_of_mem_erase hj (Fin.ext h)]
    rw [hrest, if_pos rfl]
    omega

name: Operad.ShuffleBarSym.exists_get?_not_mem
statement:
lemma exists_get?_not_mem : ∀ t : STree (VMono G), nS S t ≠ 0 →
    ∃ (q : List ℕ) (k : ℕ) (m : VMono G k) (ch : Fin k → STree (VMono G)),
      t.get? q = some (.node m ch) ∧ m ∉ S k
  | .leaf _, h => absurd rfl h
  | .node (k := k) m ch, h => by
    by_cases hm : m ∈ S k
    · obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ : ∃ j, nS S (ch j) ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
        by_contra hall
        exact h (by
          classical
          rw [nS_node, if_pos hm, Finset.sum_eq_zero fun j _ => not_not.1 fun hj => hall ⟨j, hj⟩]
          rfl)
      obtain ⟨q, k', m', ch', hq, hm'⟩ := exists_get?_not_mem (ch j) hj
      exact ⟨j.1 :: q, k', m', ch', by rw [get?_node_cons_fin]; exact hq, hm'⟩
    · exact ⟨[], k, m, ch, get?_nil _, hm⟩

name: Operad.ShuffleBarSym.mapV_liftS
statement:
lemma mapV_liftS : ∀ (t : STree (VMono G)) (h : nS S t = 0),
    (liftS S t h).mapV (fun _ m => m.1) = t
  | .leaf _, _ => rfl
  | .node m ch, h => by
    show STree.node m (fun j => (liftS S (ch j) (nS_child S h j)).mapV _) = _
    congr 1
    funext j
    exact mapV_liftS (ch j) _

end Count

end ShuffleBarSym

namespace ShuffleBarSym

open LTree ShuffleBar

                                                                       

section BarPath

variable {G : Type}

name: Operad.ShuffleBarSym.isEdgeRoot_cutRoot
statement:
lemma isEdgeRoot_cutRoot (y : BarTree G) (s : Bool) :
    (cutRoot y).IsEdgeRoot s ↔ y.IsEdgeRoot s
proof:
:= by
  rcases y with _ | ⟨d, l, r⟩
  · exact Iff.rfl
  · rcases l with _ | _ <;> rcases r with _ | _ <;> rcases s with _ | _ <;> exact Iff.rfl

name: Operad.ShuffleBarSym.subtreeAt_cutRoot
statement:
lemma subtreeAt_cutRoot (y : BarTree G) {P : List Bool} (hP : P ≠ []) :
    (cutRoot y).subtreeAt P = y.subtreeAt P
proof:
:= by
  rcases y with _ | ⟨d, l, r⟩
  · rfl
  · rcases P with _ | ⟨_ | _, P⟩
    · exact absurd rfl hP
    · rfl
    · rfl

name: Operad.ShuffleBarSym.isEdge_cutRoot
statement:
lemma isEdge_cutRoot (y : BarTree G) (P : List Bool) (s : Bool) :
    (cutRoot y).IsEdge P s ↔ y.IsEdge P s
proof:
:= by
  unfold IsEdge
  rcases P with _ | P
  · rw [subtreeAt_nil, subtreeAt_nil, isEdgeRoot_cutRoot]
  · rw [subtreeAt_cutRoot y (List.cons_ne_nil _ _)]

name: Operad.ShuffleBarSym.isUncut_cutRoot
statement:
lemma isUncut_cutRoot {y : BarTree G} {P : List Bool} {s : Bool} :
    IsUncut (cutRoot y) P s ↔ IsUncut y P s
proof:
:= by
  unfold IsUncut flagAt
  rw [isEdge_cutRoot, subtreeAt_cutRoot y (by simp)]

name: Operad.ShuffleBarSym.winIns_cutRoot
statement:
lemma winIns_cutRoot {y : BarTree G} {s : Bool} (h : y.IsEdgeRoot s) :
    (cutRoot y).winIns s = y.winIns s
proof:
:= by
  match y, s, h with
  | LTree.node d (LTree.node f a b) c, false, _ => rfl
  | LTree.node d c (LTree.node f a b), true, _ => cases c <;> rfl

name: Operad.ShuffleBarSym.rootFlag_liftW_node
statement:
lemma rootFlag_liftW_node (c : Bool) {σ : LTree G} (hσ : ∃ e l r, σ = node e l r) :
    rootFlag (liftW c σ) = c
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨e, l, r, rfl⟩ := hσ
  rfl

name: Operad.ShuffleBarSym.cutRoot_substBar
statement:
lemma cutRoot_substBar {y : BarTree G} {P : List Bool} {s : Bool} (he : y.IsEdge P s)
    {σ : LTree G} (hσ : ∃ e l r, σ = node e l r) :
    cutRoot (substBar y P s σ) = substBar (cutRoot y) P s σ
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨d, l, r, hy⟩ : ∃ d l r, y = node d l r := by
    rcases y with _ | ⟨d, l, r⟩
    · exfalso
      unfold IsEdge at he
      rw [subtreeAt_leaf] at he
      rcases s <;> exact he
    · exact ⟨d, l, r, rfl⟩
  subst hy
  obtain ⟨e, a, b, rfl⟩ := hσ
  rcases P with _ | ⟨_ | _, P⟩
  · have hw := winIns_cutRoot (y := node d l r) (s := s) he
    simp only [substBar, substAt, flagAt, subtreeAt_nil, replaceAt_nil, hw]
    rfl
  · rfl
  · rfl

name: Operad.ShuffleBarSym.flagAt_plug_liftW
statement:
lemma flagAt_plug_liftW {m : LTree G} {P : List Bool} (F : ℕ → BarTree G)
    (h : ∃ e l r, m.subtreeAt P = node e l r) : flagAt ((liftW false m).plug F) P = false
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨e, l, r, h⟩ := h
  have hv : ValidPath (liftW false m) P := validPath_of_node _ P (by
    rw [liftW_false_eq, unflag, subtreeAt_mapDec, h]
    exact ⟨_, _, _, rfl⟩)
  unfold flagAt
  rw [subtreeAt_plug F _ P hv, liftW_false_eq, unflag, subtreeAt_mapDec, h]
  rfl

name: Operad.ShuffleBarSym.exists_node_slot
statement:
lemma exists_node_slot {u : LTree G} {s : Bool} (h : u.IsEdgeRoot s) :
    ∃ e l r, u.subtreeAt [s] = node e l r
proof:
:= by
  match u, s, h with
  | LTree.node _ (LTree.node e l r) _, false, _ => exact ⟨e, l, r, rfl⟩
  | LTree.node _ _ (LTree.node e l r), true, _ => exact ⟨e, l, r, rfl⟩

name: Operad.ShuffleBarSym.nodup_liftW
statement: lemma nodup_liftW {k : ℕ} (m : VMono G k) : (liftW false m.1).labels.Nodup
proof:
:= by
  rw [labels_liftW]
  exact m.perm.nodup_iff.2 List.nodup_range

name: Operad.ShuffleBarSym.toBar_replace_substAt
statement:
theorem toBar_replace_substAt {k : ℕ} (m : VMono G k) (ch : Fin k → STree (VMono G))
    {p : List Bool} {s : Bool} (he : m.1.IsEdge p s) :
    ∀ (q : List ℕ) (t : STree (VMono G)), t.IsShuffle → t.get? q = some (.node m ch) →
      IsUncut (toBar t) (barPath t q p) s ∧ ∀ σ : Mono G 3,
        toBar (t.replace q (.node (m.substAt he σ) ch)) = substBar (toBar t) (barPath t q p) s σ.1
  | [], t, ht, hq => by
    rw [get?_nil, Option.some_inj] at hq
    subst hq
    have hmono
proof:
:= strictOn_kids m (fun j => minLabel_toBar (ch j) (ht.child j)) ht.mono
    have he' : (liftW false m.1).IsEdge p s := by
      rw [liftW_false_eq, unflag, isEdge_mapDec]
      exact he
    have hslot : ∃ e l r, m.1.subtreeAt (p ++ [s]) = node e l r := by
      rw [subtreeAt_append]
      exact exists_node_slot he
    show IsUncut ((liftW false m.1).plug (kids ch)) p s ∧ ∀ σ : Mono G 3,
      (liftW false (m.1.substAt p s σ.1)).plug (kids ch)
        = substBar ((liftW false m.1).plug (kids ch)) p s σ.1
    refine ⟨⟨by simpa using isEdge_ctx (M := LTree.leaf 0) (q := []) trivial (kids ch) he',
      flagAt_plug_liftW _ hslot⟩, fun σ => ?_⟩
    rw [substBar, flagAt_plug_liftW _ he.exists_node]
    have := substAt_ctx (M := LTree.leaf 0) (q := []) trivial (kids ch) he' hmono
      (liftW false σ.1)
    simp only [replaceAt_nil, List.nil_append] at this
    rw [this, liftW_false_eq, liftW_false_eq, liftW_false_eq, unflag, unflag, unflag,
      substAt_mapDec _ _ _ _ he]
  | _ :: _, .leaf _, _, hq => by simp at hq
  | i :: q, .node (k := k') γ c, ht, hq => by
    obtain ⟨hi, hc⟩ := get?_node_cons_eq_some.1 hq
    let ii : Fin k' := ⟨i, hi⟩
    obtain ⟨hU, heq⟩ := toBar_replace_substAt m ch he q (c ii) (ht.child ii) hc
    have hP : barPath (.node γ c) (i :: q) p = leafPos i (liftW false γ.1) ++ barPath (c ii) q p :=
      dif_pos hi
    have hj : i ∈ (liftW false γ.1).labels := by
      rw [labels_liftW]
      exact γ.mem hi
    have hki : kids c i = cutRoot (toBar (c ii)) := kids_of_lt c hi
    rw [hP]
    show IsUncut ((liftW false γ.1).plug (kids c)) _ s ∧ ∀ σ : Mono G 3,
      toBar (.node γ fun j => if (j : ℕ) = i then (c j).replace q _ else c j) = _
    have hU' : IsUncut (kids c i) (barPath (c ii) q p) s := by
      rw [hki, isUncut_cutRoot]
      exact hU
    refine ⟨⟨by simpa using isEdge_ctx_ins (M := LTree.leaf 0) (q := []) trivial (kids c) hj hU'.1,
      ?_⟩, fun σ => ?_⟩
    · unfold flagAt
      rw [List.append_assoc, subtreeAt_plug_leafPos (kids c) hj]
      exact hU'.2
    · simp only [toBar_node, substBar]
      have hfl : flagAt ((liftW false γ.1).plug (kids c))
          (leafPos i (liftW false γ.1) ++ barPath (c ii) q p)
            = flagAt (kids c i) (barPath (c ii) q p) := by
        unfold flagAt
        rw [subtreeAt_plug_leafPos (kids c) hj]
      have := substAt_ctx_ins (M := LTree.leaf 0) (q := []) trivial (kids c) (nodup_liftW γ) hj
        (barPath (c ii) q p) s (liftW (flagAt (kids c i) (barPath (c ii) q p)) σ.1)
      simp only [replaceAt_nil, List.nil_append] at this
      rw [hfl, this]
      refine LTree.plug_congr fun a ha => ?_
      rw [labels_liftW] at ha
      have ha' := γ.lt ha
      by_cases hai : a = i
      · subst hai
        rw [update_self, kids_of_lt _ ha', if_pos rfl, heq σ, hki,
          cutRoot_substBar hU.1 (ShuffleBar.mono_shape σ).2.2]
        rfl
      · rw [update_of_ne hai, kids_of_lt _ ha', kids_of_lt _ ha', if_neg hai]

name: Operad.ShuffleBarSym.isEdgeRoot_false_iff
statement:
lemma isEdgeRoot_false_iff {X : Type*} (e : X) (l r : LTree X) :
    (LTree.node e l r).IsEdgeRoot false ↔ ∃ e' a b, l = LTree.node e' a b
proof:
:= by
  rcases l with _ | ⟨e', a, b⟩
  · rcases r with _ | _ <;> simp [IsEdgeRoot]
  · simp [IsEdgeRoot]

name: Operad.ShuffleBarSym.isEdgeRoot_true_iff
statement:
lemma isEdgeRoot_true_iff {X : Type*} (e : X) (l r : LTree X) :
    (LTree.node e l r).IsEdgeRoot true ↔ ∃ e' a b, r = LTree.node e' a b
proof:
:= by
  rcases r with _ | ⟨e', a, b⟩
  · rcases l with _ | _ <;> simp [IsEdgeRoot]
  · exact iff_of_true (isEdgeRoot_true _ _ _ _ _) ⟨e', a, b, rfl⟩

name: Operad.ShuffleBarSym.rootFlag_kids
statement:
lemma rootFlag_kids {k : ℕ} (ch : Fin k → STree (VMono G)) (j : ℕ)
    (h : ∃ e a b, kids ch j = LTree.node e a b) : rootFlag (kids ch j) = true
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨e, a, b, h⟩ := h
  unfold kids at h ⊢
  by_cases hj : j < k
  · rw [dif_pos hj] at h ⊢
    revert h
    rcases toBar (ch ⟨j, hj⟩) with _ | ⟨d, l, r⟩
    · intro h
      simp [cutRoot] at h
    · intro _
      rfl
  · rw [dif_neg hj] at h
    cases h

name: Operad.ShuffleBarSym.exists_of_isUncut
statement:
theorem exists_of_isUncut : ∀ (t : STree (VMono G)), t.IsShuffle → ∀ {P : List Bool} {s : Bool},
    IsUncut (toBar t) P s → ∃ (q : List ℕ) (k : ℕ) (m : VMono G k)
      (ch : Fin k → STree (VMono G)) (p : List Bool),
      t.get? q = some (.node m ch) ∧ m.1.IsEdge p s ∧ P = barPath t q p
  | .leaf _, _, P, s, h => by
    exfalso
    have
proof:
:= h.1
    unfold IsEdge at this
    rw [show toBar (STree.leaf _ : STree (VMono G)) = LTree.leaf _ from rfl, subtreeAt_leaf]
      at this
    rcases s <;> exact this
  | .node (k := k) m ch, ht, P, s, h => by
    rw [toBar_node] at h
    have hnd := nodup_liftW m
    rcases pos_cases (liftW false m.1) P hnd with ⟨e, l, r, hPn⟩ | ⟨j, hj, d, rfl⟩
    · refine ⟨[], k, m, ch, P, get?_nil _, ?_, rfl⟩
      have hv : ValidPath (liftW false m.1) P := validPath_of_node _ P ⟨e, l, r, hPn⟩
      have hX : ((liftW false m.1).plug (kids ch)).subtreeAt P
          = LTree.node e (l.plug (kids ch)) (r.plug (kids ch)) := by
        rw [subtreeAt_plug _ _ P hv, hPn]
        rfl
      have hE := h.1
      unfold IsEdge at hE
      rw [hX] at hE
      have hfl := h.2
      unfold flagAt at hfl
      rw [subtreeAt_append, hX] at hfl
      rw [← isEdge_mapDec (·, false), ← unflag, ← liftW_false_eq]
      unfold IsEdge
      rw [hPn]
      have hslot : ∀ w : BarTree G, (∃ e' a b, w.plug (kids ch) = LTree.node e' a b) →
          rootFlag (w.plug (kids ch)) = false → ∃ e' a b, w = LTree.node e' a b := by
        intro w hw hf
        rcases w with ⟨a⟩ | ⟨e', a, b⟩
        · have h1 : rootFlag (kids ch a) = true := rootFlag_kids ch a hw
          have h2 : rootFlag (kids ch a) = false := hf
          rw [h1] at h2
          exact absurd h2 (by decide)
        · exact ⟨e', a, b, rfl⟩
      rcases s with _ | _
      · rw [isEdgeRoot_false_iff] at hE ⊢
        exact hslot l hE (by simpa [subtreeAt] using hfl)
      · rw [isEdgeRoot_true_iff] at hE ⊢
        exact hslot r hE (by simpa [subtreeAt] using hfl)
    · rw [labels_liftW] at hj
      have hjk := m.lt hj
      let jj : Fin k := ⟨j, hjk⟩
      have hj' : j ∈ (liftW false m.1).labels := by rwa [labels_liftW]
      have hU : IsUncut (kids ch j) d s := by
        refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
        · have := h.1
          unfold IsEdge at this ⊢
          rwa [subtreeAt_plug_leafPos _ hj'] at this
        · have := h.2
          unfold flagAt at this ⊢
          rwa [List.append_assoc, subtreeAt_plug_leafPos _ hj'] at this
      rw [kids_of_lt ch hjk, isUncut_cutRoot] at hU
      obtain ⟨q, k', m', ch', p, hq, he, hd⟩ := exists_of_isUncut (ch jj) (ht.child jj) hU
      refine ⟨j :: q, k', m', ch', p, by rw [get?_node_cons, dif_pos hjk]; exact hq, he, ?_⟩
      show _ = (if h : j < k then _ else _)
      rw [dif_pos hjk, hd]

name: Operad.ShuffleBarSym.get?_replT
statement: lemma get?_replT (m : VMono G k) : (replT t hq m).1.get? q = some (.node m ch)
proof:
:=
  get?_replace (by rw [hq]; rfl) _

name: Operad.ShuffleBarSym.replT_replT
statement:
lemma replT_replT (m m' : VMono G k) :
    replT (replT t hq m) (get?_replT t hq m) m' = replT t hq m'
proof:
:=
  Subtype.ext (replace_replace _ _ _ _)

name: Operad.ShuffleBarSym.Tq_tBasis
statement:
lemma Tq_tBasis (m : VMono G k) :
    Tq c hc t hq (tBasis c hc (Fin k) (tIdx m)) = barBasisN c hc n (replT t hq m)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Tq, Module.Basis.constr_basis]

name: Operad.ShuffleBarSym.Tq_mem_Krel
statement:
theorem Tq_mem_Krel {y : FreeGrL K E (Fin k)} (hy : y ∈ (𝒥).sub (Fin k)) :
    Tq c hc t hq y ∈ (Krel K E c hc r).sub (Fin n)
proof:
:= by
  refine (mem_Krel_iff c hc r (A := Fin n) (Tq c hc t hq y)).2 ?_
  let βs : {t // t ∈ LTree.monomials (E := G) (Fintype.card (Fin k))} → VMono G k :=
    fun i => ⟨i.1, by simpa using i.2, m₀.2.2⟩
  let a := fun i => (tBasis c hc (Fin k)).repr y i
  have hlab : ∀ i, (t.1.replace q (.node (βs i) ch)).labels
      = (Finset.range (Fintype.card (Fin n))).val := fun i =>
    (replT t hq (βs i)).2.2.trans (by rw [Fintype.card_fin])
  have hsum : Tq c hc t hq y = ∑ i, a i • GrOperad.map (R := K) (FreeGrL.posEquiv (Fin n)).symm
      (FreeGrL.shEv (genBasis c hc) (t.1.replace q (.node (βs i) ch)) _ (hlab i)) := by
    rw [Tq, Module.Basis.constr_apply_fintype]
    exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => congrArg₂ _
      (congrFun ((tBasis c hc (Fin k)).equivFun_apply y) i) (barBasisN_eq_shEv c hc n _ (hlab i))
  have hz : IdealSp.val _ (∑ i, a i • genBasis c hc k (βs i)) = y := by
    show ((∑ i, a i • idealBasis c hc k (βs i) : (Ibar K E c hc).sub (Fin k)) :
      FreeGrL K E (Fin k)) = y
    rw [Submodule.coe_sum]
    simp only [Submodule.coe_smul, idealBasis_apply]
    exact (tBasis c hc (Fin k)).sum_repr y
  have hv : ∑ i ∈ Finset.univ, a i • (barProjGen c hc r).app (Fin k) (genBasis c hc k (βs i))
      = 0 := by
    simp only [← map_smul, ← map_sum]
    rw [barProjGen_eq_zero_iff]
    convert hy using 1
  exact (congrArg ((FreeGrL.mapSp (barProjGen c hc r)).app (Fin n)) hsum).trans
    (FreeGrL.mapSp_sum_shEv_replace (genBasis c hc) (barProjGen c hc r) Finset.univ a βs ch hv q
      t.1 m₀ hq _ hlab)

name: Operad.ShuffleBarSym.ΦL_Tq_relator
statement:
theorem ΦL_Tq_relator (u : VMono G k) {p : List Bool} {s : Bool} (he : u.1.IsEdge p s)
    (ρ : Mono G 3 → K) :
    ΦL c hc n (Tq c hc t hq (∑ σ : Mono G 3, ρ σ • tBasis c hc (Fin k) (tIdx (u.substAt he σ))))
      = sign K (replT t hq u).1 • substRel K (toBar (replT t hq u).1)
        (barPath (replT t hq u).1 q p) s ρ
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨-, heq⟩ := toBar_replace_substAt u ch he q (replT t hq u).1 (replT t hq u).2.1
    (get?_replT t hq u)
  have hL : ΦL c hc n (Tq c hc t hq (∑ σ : Mono G 3, ρ σ • tBasis c hc (Fin k)
      (tIdx (u.substAt he σ)))) = ((ΦL c hc n).comp (Tq c hc t hq)) (∑ σ : Mono G 3,
        ρ σ • tBasis c hc (Fin k) (tIdx (u.substAt he σ))) := rfl
  rw [hL, map_sum, substRel, Finset.smul_sum]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun σ _ => ?_
  rw [map_smul, LinearMap.comp_apply, Tq_tBasis, Φ_barBasisN]
  have hs : sign K (replT t hq (u.substAt he σ)).1 = sign K (replT t hq u).1 :=
    sign_replace K q t.1 _ _ ch
  have hb : toBar (replT t hq (u.substAt he σ)).1
      = substBar (toBar (replT t hq u).1) (barPath (replT t hq u).1 q p) s σ.1 := by
    rw [← heq σ]
    exact congrArg toBar (replace_replace _ _ _ _).symm
  rw [hs, hb, smul_comm]

name: Operad.ShuffleBarSym.ΦL_Tq_relator_mem
statement:
lemma ΦL_Tq_relator_mem (u : VMono G k) {p : List Bool} {s : Bool} (he : u.1.IsEdge p s)
    {ρ : Mono G 3 → K} (hρ : ρ ∈ Rsh c hc r) :
    ΦL c hc n (Tq c hc t hq (∑ σ : Mono G 3, ρ σ • tBasis c hc (Fin k) (tIdx (u.substAt he σ))))
      ∈ ShuffleBar.J K (Rsh c hc r)
proof:
:= by
  rw [ΦL_Tq_relator]
  obtain ⟨hU, -⟩ := toBar_replace_substAt u ch he q (replT t hq u).1 (replT t hq u).2.1
    (get?_replT t hq u)
  exact Submodule.smul_mem _ _ (Submodule.subset_span ⟨_, _, s, ρ, valid_toBar _, hU, hρ, rfl⟩)

name: Operad.ShuffleBarSym.mem_monomials_of_isMonY
statement:
lemma mem_monomials_of_isMonY [Fintype G] [DecidableEq G] {u : LTree G}
    (hu : IsMonY (Finset.range (Fintype.card (Fin k))) u) : u ∈ LTree.monomials k
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_monomials]
  refine ⟨hu.1, ?_⟩
  have := hu.2
  rw [Finset.range_val, Fintype.card_fin, ← Multiset.coe_range, Multiset.coe_eq_coe] at this
  exact this

name: Operad.ShuffleBarSym.map_relGen
statement:
lemma map_relGen {u : LTree G} (hu : IsMonY (Finset.range (Fintype.card (Fin k))) u)
    (hk : 2 ≤ k) {p : List Bool} {s : Bool} (he : u.IsEdge p s) (ρ : Mono G 3 → K) :
    GrOperad.map (R := K) (FreeGrL.posEquiv (Fin k)).symm (relGen c hc hu he ρ)
      = ∑ σ : Mono G 3, ρ σ • tBasis c hc (Fin k) (tIdx ((vmonoOf hu hk).substAt he σ))
proof:
:= by
  simp only [relGen, map_sum, map_smul]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun σ _ => congrArg _ ?_
  rw [labBasis, FreeGrL.shBasisLab_apply, tBasis_apply, FreeGrL.shuffleBasis_apply]
  rfl

name: Operad.ShuffleBarSym.ΦL_Tq_mem_J
statement:
theorem ΦL_Tq_mem_J (hr3 : ∀ n ≠ 3, r n = ∅)
    (hrS : ∀ σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin 3), ∀ x ∈ r 3,
      GrOperad.map (R := K) σ x ∈ Submodule.span K (r 3))
    {y : FreeGrL K E (Fin k)} (hy : y ∈ (𝒥).sub (Fin k)) :
    ΦL c hc n (Tq c hc t hq y) ∈ ShuffleBar.J K (Rsh c hc r)
proof:
:= by
  have h1 := (mem_relIdeal c hc r).1 (span_le_relIdeal hr3 hrS (Fin k) hy) _
    (FreeGrL.posEquiv (Fin k))
  have hy' : y = GrOperad.map (R := K) (FreeGrL.posEquiv (Fin k)).symm
      (GrOperad.map (R := K) (FreeGrL.posEquiv (Fin k)) y) := by
    rw [← GrOperad.map_trans, Equiv.self_trans_symm, GrOperad.map_refl]
  rw [hy']
  have hle : ShIT c hc r (Finset.range (Fintype.card (Fin k))) ≤ (ShuffleBar.J K (Rsh c hc r)).comap
      ((ΦL c hc n).comp ((Tq c hc t hq).comp
        (GrOperad.map (R := K) (FreeGrL.posEquiv (Fin k)).symm))) := by
    rw [ShIT, Submodule.span_le]
    rintro _ ⟨u, hu, p, s, he, ρ, hρ, rfl⟩
    show ΦL c hc n (Tq c hc t hq (GrOperad.map (R := K) (FreeGrL.posEquiv (Fin k)).symm
      (relGen c hc hu he ρ))) ∈ ShuffleBar.J K (Rsh c hc r)
    rw [map_relGen c hc hu m₀.2.2 he ρ]
    exact ΦL_Tq_relator_mem c hc r t hq _ he hρ
  exact hle h1

name: Operad.FreeGrL.mapSp_map_shEv_mapV
statement:
theorem mapSp_map_shEv_mapV {B : ℕ → Type x} {B' : ℕ → Type*}
    (b : ∀ k, Module.Basis (B k) R (V (Fin k))) (b' : ∀ k, Module.Basis (B' k) R (W (Fin k)))
    (g : ∀ k, B' k → B k) (f : GrSpeciesHom R V W)
    (hf : ∀ k β, f.app (Fin k) (b k (g k β)) = b' k β)
    (t' : STree B') {Y : Finset ℕ} {A : Type} [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] (e : Lab Y ≃ A)
    (h : (t'.mapV g).labels = Y.val) (h' : t'.labels = Y.val) :
    (mapSp f).app A (GrOperad.map (R := R) e (shEv b (t'.mapV g) Y h))
      = GrOperad.map (R := R) e (shEv b' t' Y h')
proof:
:= by
  rw [GrOperadHom.app_map, shEv_eq_shEvF, mapSp_shEvF, shEvF_mapV _ g t' Y h' h, shEv_eq_shEvF]
  congr 2
  funext k β
  exact hf k β

name: Operad.ShuffleBarSym.exists_sel
statement:
lemma exists_sel (k : ℕ) : ∃ S : Set (VMono G k),
    LinearIndependent K (fun m : S => projGen c hc r k m.1) ∧
      ⊤ ≤ Submodule.span K (Set.range fun m : S => projGen c hc r k m.1)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨κ, a, ha, hsp, hli⟩ := exists_linearIndependent' K (projGen c hc r k)
  refine ⟨Set.range a, (linearIndependent_equiv (Equiv.ofInjective a ha)
    (f := fun m : Set.range a => projGen c hc r k m.1)).1 hli, ?_⟩
  have hr : (Set.range fun m : Set.range a => projGen c hc r k m.1)
      = Set.range (projGen c hc r k ∘ a) := by
    ext x
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨⟨_, y, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
      exact ⟨y, rfl⟩
    · rintro ⟨y, rfl⟩
      exact ⟨⟨a y, y, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
  rw [hr, hsp, show (projGen c hc r k) = (barProjGen c hc r).app (Fin k) ∘ genBasis c hc k from rfl,
    Set.range_comp, Submodule.span_image, (genBasis c hc k).span_eq, Submodule.map_top,
    LinearMap.range_eq_top.2 (barProjGen_surjective c hc r (Fin k))]

name: Operad.ShuffleBarSym.selBasis_apply
statement: lemma selBasis_apply (k : ℕ) (j : S k) : selBasis c hc r S hli hsp k j = projGen c hc r k j.1
proof:
:=
  Module.Basis.mk_apply _ _ _

name: Operad.ShuffleBarSym.par_selBasis
statement:
lemma par_selBasis (k : ℕ) (j : S k) :
    GrSpecies.par (R := K) ((fun _ _ => true) k j) (selBasis c hc r S hli hsp k j)
      = selBasis c hc r S hli hsp k j
proof:
:= by
  rw [selBasis_apply, projGen, ← (barProjGen c hc r).app_par]
  exact congrArg _ (par_genBasis c hc k j.1)

name: Operad.eq_zero_of_linearIndependent_comp
statement:
lemma _root_.Operad.eq_zero_of_linearIndependent_comp {R M N ι : Type*} [CommRing R]
    [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] [AddCommGroup N] [Module R N] (π : M →ₗ[R] N) (v : ι → M)
    (h : LinearIndependent R (π ∘ v)) {x : M} (hx : x ∈ Submodule.span R (Set.range v))
    (hπ : π x = 0) : x = 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨l, rfl⟩ := Finsupp.mem_span_range_iff_exists_finsupp.1 hx
  have hl : l = 0 := linearIndependent_iff.1 h l (by
    rw [Finsupp.linearCombination_apply, ← hπ, map_finsuppSum]
    simp only [map_smul, Function.comp_apply])
  rw [hl, Finsupp.sum_zero_index]

name: Operad.ShuffleBarSym.eq_zero_of_mem_sel
statement:
theorem eq_zero_of_mem_sel {n : ℕ} {x : BarCoop (Ibar K E c hc) (Fin n)}
    (hx : x ∈ Submodule.span K (Set.range fun t : {t : SMono (VMono G) (Finset.range n) //
      nS S t.1 = 0} => barBasisN c hc n t.1))
    (hπ : (FreeGrL.mapSp (barProjGen c hc r)).app (Fin n) x = 0) : x = 0
proof:
:= by
  haveI : IsEmpty (S 0) := ⟨fun m => isEmptyElim m.1⟩
  let φ : {t : SMono (VMono G) (Finset.range n) // nS S t.1 = 0} →
      SMono (fun k => S k) (Finset.range (Fintype.card (Fin n))) := fun t =>
    ⟨liftS S t.1.1 t.2, (isShuffle_mapV _ _).1 (by rw [mapV_liftS]; exact t.1.2.1), by
      rw [← labels_mapV (fun _ m => m.1), mapV_liftS, t.1.2.2, Fintype.card_fin]⟩
  have hφ : Function.Injective φ := fun t t' h => by
    have h' := congrArg (fun T => T.1.mapV (fun _ m => m.1)) h
    simp only [φ, mapV_liftS] at h'
    exact Subtype.ext (Subtype.ext h')
  have hπb : ∀ t, (FreeGrL.mapSp (barProjGen c hc r)).app (Fin n) (barBasisN c hc n t.1)
      = FreeGrL.shuffleBasis (selBasis c hc r S hli hsp) (par_selBasis c hc r S hli hsp) (Fin n)
        (φ t) := fun t => by
    have h₁ : t.1.1.labels = (Finset.range (Fintype.card (Fin n))).val := by
      rw [t.1.2.2, Fintype.card_fin]
    have h₂ : ((liftS S t.1.1 t.2).mapV fun _ m => m.1).labels
        = (Finset.range (Fintype.card (Fin n))).val := by
      rw [mapV_liftS]
      exact h₁
    exact (congrArg ((FreeGrL.mapSp (barProjGen c hc r)).app (Fin n))
      (barBasisN_eq_shEv c hc n _ h₁)).trans ((congrArg (fun z =>
        (FreeGrL.mapSp (barProjGen c hc r)).app (Fin n)
          (GrOperad.map (R := K) (FreeGrL.posEquiv (Fin n)).symm z))
        (shEv_congr c hc (mapV_liftS S t.1.1 t.2).symm _ h₁ h₂)).trans
        ((FreeGrL.mapSp_map_shEv_mapV (genBasis c hc) (selBasis c hc r S hli hsp)
          (fun _ m => m.1) (barProjGen c hc r)
          (fun k j => (selBasis_apply c hc r S hli hsp k j).symm) _ _ h₂ (φ t).2.2).trans
          (FreeGrL.shuffleBasis_apply _ _ _ (φ t)).symm))
  have hli' : LinearIndependent K fun t : {t : SMono (VMono G) (Finset.range n) // nS S t.1 = 0}
      => (FreeGrL.mapSp (barProjGen c hc r)).app (Fin n) (barBasisN c hc n t.1) := by
    rw [show (fun t : {t : SMono (VMono G) (Finset.range n) // nS S t.1 = 0} =>
        (FreeGrL.mapSp (barProjGen c hc r)).app (Fin n) (barBasisN c hc n t.1))
      = (FreeGrL.shuffleBasis (selBasis c hc r S hli hsp) (par_selBasis c hc r S hli hsp) (Fin n))
        ∘ φ from funext hπb]
    exact (Module.Basis.linearIndependent _).comp φ hφ
  exact eq_zero_of_linearIndependent_comp _ _ hli' hx hπ

name: Operad.ShuffleBarSym.barBasisN_mem_sup
statement:
theorem barBasisN_mem_sup {n : ℕ} : ∀ (N : ℕ) (t : SMono (VMono G) (Finset.range n)),
    nS S t.1 ≤ N → barBasisN c hc n t ∈ Submodule.span K (relTrees c hc r n) ⊔
      Submodule.span K (Set.range fun t : {t : SMono (VMono G) (Finset.range n) //
        nS S t.1 = 0} => barBasisN c hc n t.1)
proof:
:= by
  intro N
  induction N with
  | zero =>
    intro t ht
    exact Submodule.mem_sup_right (Submodule.subset_span ⟨⟨t, by omega⟩, rfl⟩)
  | succ N ih =>
    intro t ht
    by_cases h0 : nS S t.1 = 0
    · exact Submodule.mem_sup_right (Submodule.subset_span ⟨⟨t, h0⟩, rfl⟩)
    obtain ⟨q, k, m, ch, hq, hm⟩ := exists_get?_not_mem S t.1 h0
    let d := (selBasis c hc r S hli hsp k).repr (projGen c hc r k m)
    have hfm : projGen c hc r k m = d.sum fun j a => a • projGen c hc r k j.1 := by
      conv_lhs => rw [← (selBasis c hc r S hli hsp k).linearCombination_repr (projGen c hc r k m)]
      rw [Finsupp.linearCombination_apply]
      simp only [selBasis_apply]
      rfl
    let y : FreeGrL K E (Fin k) := tBasis c hc (Fin k) (tIdx m) -
      d.sum fun j a => a • tBasis c hc (Fin k) (tIdx j.1)
    have hy : y ∈ (𝒥).sub (Fin k) := by
      let z : BarGen (Ibar K E c hc) (Fin k) := genBasis c hc k m -
        d.sum fun j a => a • genBasis c hc k j.1
      have hz : IdealSp.val _ z = y := by
        show ((idealBasis c hc k m - d.sum fun j a => a • idealBasis c hc k j.1 :
          (Ibar K E c hc).sub (Fin k)) : FreeGrL K E (Fin k)) = y
        rw [Submodule.coe_sub, idealBasis_apply, Finsupp.sum, Submodule.coe_sum]
        simp only [Submodule.coe_smul, idealBasis_apply]
        rfl
      rw [← hz, ← barProjGen_eq_zero_iff, map_sub, map_finsuppSum]
      simp only [map_smul]
      rw [← hfm]
      exact sub_self _
    have hTq : Tq c hc t hq y = barBasisN c hc n t
        - d.sum fun j a => a • barBasisN c hc n (replT t hq j.1) := by
      simp only [y, map_sub, map_finsuppSum, map_smul, Tq_tBasis]
      rw [show replT t hq m = t from Subtype.ext (replace_self hq)]
    have hdecomp : barBasisN c hc n t = Tq c hc t hq y
        + d.sum fun j a => a • barBasisN c hc n (replT t hq j.1) := by
      rw [hTq, sub_add_cancel]
    rw [hdecomp]
    refine add_mem (Submodule.mem_sup_left (Submodule.subset_span
      ⟨t, q, k, m, ch, hq, y, hy, rfl⟩)) (Submodule.sum_mem _ fun j _ =>
        Submodule.smul_mem _ _ (ih _ ?_))
    classical
    have := nS_replace S m j.1 ch q t.1 hq
    rw [if_neg hm, if_pos j.2] at this
    show nS S (t.1.replace q (.node j.1 ch)) ≤ N
    omega

name: Operad.ShuffleBarSym.map_ΦL_Krel
statement:
theorem map_ΦL_Krel (hr3 : ∀ n ≠ 3, r n = ∅)
    (hrS : ∀ σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin 3), ∀ x ∈ r 3,
      GrOperad.map (R := K) σ x ∈ Submodule.span K (r 3)) (n : ℕ) :
    Submodule.map (ΦL c hc n) ((Krel K E c hc r).sub (Fin n))
      = ShuffleBar.J K (Rsh c hc r) ⊓ Finsupp.supported K K (barSet G n)
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · rintro _ ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
    refine ⟨?_, by rw [← ΦL_range c hc n]; exact LinearMap.mem_range_self _ x⟩
    choose S hli hsp using exists_sel c hc r
    have htop : ⊤ ≤ Submodule.span K (relTrees c hc r n) ⊔
        Submodule.span K (Set.range fun t : {t : SMono (VMono G) (Finset.range n) //
          nS S t.1 = 0} => barBasisN c hc n t.1) := by
      rw [← (barBasisN c hc n).span_eq, Submodule.span_le]
      rintro _ ⟨t, rfl⟩
      exact barBasisN_mem_sup c hc r S hli hsp _ t le_rfl
    obtain ⟨q₁, hq₁, s₁, hs₁, hqs⟩ := Submodule.mem_sup.1 (htop Submodule.mem_top (x := x))
    have hQK : Submodule.span K (relTrees c hc r n) ≤ (Krel K E c hc r).sub (Fin n) := by
      rw [Submodule.span_le]
      rintro _ ⟨t, q, k, m₀, ch, hq, y, hy, rfl⟩
      exact Tq_mem_Krel c hc r t hq hy
    have hQJ : Submodule.span K (relTrees c hc r n) ≤
        (ShuffleBar.J K (Rsh c hc r)).comap (ΦL c hc n) := by
      rw [Submodule.span_le]
      rintro _ ⟨t, q, k, m₀, ch, hq, y, hy, rfl⟩
      exact ΦL_Tq_mem_J c hc r t hq hr3 hrS hy
    have hsK : s₁ ∈ (Krel K E c hc r).sub (Fin n) := by
      have := sub_mem hx (hQK hq₁)
      rwa [← hqs, add_sub_cancel_left] at this
    have hs0 : s₁ = 0 := eq_zero_of_mem_sel c hc r S hli hsp hs₁
      ((mem_Krel_iff c hc r (A := Fin n) s₁).1 hsK)
    rw [← hqs, hs0, add_zero]
    exact hQJ hq₁
  · rw [J_inf_supported K (Rsh c hc r) (barSet G n) fun x y _ hy hxy hx => ⟨hy,
      hxy.symm.trans hx.2⟩, Submodule.span_le]
    rintro _ ⟨x, P, s, ρ, hx, hxS, hU, hρ, rfl⟩
    let t := (treeEquiv n).symm ⟨x, hxS⟩
    have ht : toBar t.1 = x := congrArg Subtype.val ((treeEquiv n).apply_symm_apply ⟨x, hxS⟩)
    rw [← ht] at hU ⊢
    obtain ⟨q, k, m, ch, p, hq, he, rfl⟩ := exists_of_isUncut t.1 t.2.1 hU
    have hu : IsMonY (Finset.range (Fintype.card (Fin k))) m.1 := by
      have h := (LTree.mem_monomials k m.1).1 m.2.1
      refine ⟨h.1, ?_⟩
      rw [Finset.range_val, Fintype.card_fin, ← Multiset.coe_range, Multiset.coe_eq_coe]
      exact h.2
    have hrel : ∑ σ : Mono G 3, ρ σ • tBasis c hc (Fin k) (tIdx (m.substAt he σ))
        ∈ (𝒥).sub (Fin k) := by
      have h1 := ShIT_le c hc (GrOperadIdeal.span K r) r (fun y hy =>
        GrOperadIdeal.subset_span (R := K) 3 hy) _ (relGen_mem_ShIT c hc r hu he hρ)
      have h2 := (GrOperadIdeal.span K r).map_mem (FreeGrL.posEquiv (Fin k)).symm h1
      rwa [map_relGen c hc hu m.2.2 he ρ] at h2
    refine ⟨sign K t.1 • Tq c hc t hq (∑ σ : Mono G 3, ρ σ • tBasis c hc (Fin k)
      (tIdx (m.substAt he σ))), Submodule.smul_mem _ _ (Tq_mem_Krel c hc r t hq hrel), ?_⟩
    have hself : replT t hq m = t := Subtype.ext (replace_self hq)
    rw [map_smul, ΦL_Tq_relator, hself, smul_smul, sign_mul_self, one_smul]

name: Operad.ShuffleBarSym.isKoszul_iff_shuffle
statement:
theorem isKoszul_iff_shuffle [CharZero K] (hr3 : ∀ n ≠ 3, r n = ∅)
    (hrS : ∀ σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin 3), ∀ x ∈ r 3,
      GrOperad.map (R := K) σ x ∈ Submodule.span K (r 3)) :
    Koszul.IsKoszul K E r ↔ ShuffleBar.IsKoszul K (Rsh c hc r)
proof:
:=
  isKoszul_iff_shuffle_of_J c hc (fun n hn => hr3 n (by omega)) (Rsh c hc r)
    fun n _ => map_ΦL_Krel c hc hr3 hrS n

name: Operad.NSSyn.Rel.reindexS
statement:
lemma Rel.reindexS {ρ : ∀ n : ℕ, NSSyn T n → NSSyn T n → Prop} {m n : ℕ} (h : m = n)
    {x y : NSSyn T m} (hxy : Rel ρ x y) :
    Rel ρ (reindexS (NSSyn T) h x) (reindexS (NSSyn T) h y)
proof:
:= by
  subst h
  exact hxy

name: Operad.NSSyn.eval_one
statement: @[simp] lemma eval_one : eval f (one : NSSyn T 1) = NSSetOperad.one
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.NSSyn.eval_gen
statement: @[simp] lemma eval_gen {n : ℕ} (g : T n) : eval f (gen g) = f n g
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.NSSyn.eval_comp
statement:
@[simp] lemma eval_comp (a b : ℕ) {n : ℕ} (x : NSSyn T (a + 1 + b)) (y : NSSyn T n) :
    eval f (comp a b x y) = NSSetOperad.comp a b (eval f x) (eval f y)
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.NSSyn.eval_reindexS
statement:
lemma eval_reindexS {m n : ℕ} (h : m = n) (x : NSSyn T m) :
    eval f (reindexS (NSSyn T) h x) = reindexS S h (eval f x)
proof:
:= by
  subst h
  rfl

name: Operad.NSSyn.eval_eq_of_rel
proof:
:= by
  induction h with
  | of h => exact hf _ _ h
  | refl => rfl
  | symm _ ih => exact ih.symm
  | trans _ _ ih ih' => exact ih.trans ih'
  | comp a b _ _ ih ih' => simp only [eval_comp, ih, ih']
  | comp_one_right a b x => exact NSSetOperad.comp_one_right a b (eval f x)
  | comp_one_left x =>
    rw [eval_reindexS]
    exact NSSetOperad.comp_one_left (eval f x)
  | assoc_seq a b c d x y z =>
    simp only [eval_reindexS, eval_comp]
    exact NSSetOperad.comp_assoc_seq a b c d (eval f x) (eval f y) (eval f z)
  | assoc_par a b c x y z =>
    simp only [eval_reindexS, eval_comp]
    exact NSSetOperad.comp_assoc_par a b c (eval f x) (eval f y) (eval f z)

name: Operad.NSPres.mk_surjective
statement: lemma mk_surjective {n : ℕ} : Function.Surjective (mk (ρ := ρ) (n := n))
proof: := Quot.exists_rep

name: Operad.NSPres.mk_eq_mk_of_rel
statement: lemma mk_eq_mk_of_rel {n : ℕ} {x y : NSSyn T n} (h : ρ n x y) : mk (ρ := ρ) x = mk y
proof:
:=
  Quot.sound (.of h)

name: Operad.NSPres.reindexS_mk
statement:
lemma reindexS_mk {m n : ℕ} (h : m = n) (x : NSSyn T m) :
    reindexS (NSPres T ρ) h (mk x) = mk (reindexS (NSSyn T) h x)
proof:
:= by
  subst h
  rfl

name: Operad.NSPres.compFn_mk
statement:
@[simp] lemma compFn_mk (a b : ℕ) {n : ℕ} (x : NSSyn T (a + 1 + b)) (y : NSSyn T n) :
    compFn (ρ := ρ) a b (mk x) (mk y) = mk (.comp a b x y)
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.NSPres.comp_mk
statement:
@[simp] lemma comp_mk (a b : ℕ) {n : ℕ} (x : NSSyn T (a + 1 + b)) (y : NSSyn T n) :
    NSSetOperad.comp a b (mk (ρ := ρ) x) (mk y) = mk (.comp a b x y)
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.NSPres.lift_mk
statement:
@[simp] lemma lift_mk (f : ∀ n, T n → S n) (hf : Respects ρ f) {n : ℕ} (x : NSSyn T n) :
    (lift f hf).app n (mk x) = NSSyn.eval f x
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.NSPres.lift_gen
statement:
@[simp] lemma lift_gen (f : ∀ n, T n → S n) (hf : Respects ρ f) {n : ℕ} (g : T n) :
    (lift f hf).app n (gen g) = f n g
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.NSPres.app_mk
statement:
lemma app_mk (φ : NSSetOperadHom (NSPres T ρ) S) {n : ℕ} (x : NSSyn T n) :
    φ.app n (mk x) = NSSyn.eval (fun _ g => φ.app _ (gen g)) x
proof:
:= by
  induction x with
  | one => exact φ.app_one
  | gen g => rfl
  | comp a b x y ihx ihy => rw [NSSyn.eval_comp, ← ihx, ← ihy, ← φ.app_comp]; rfl

name: Operad.NSPres.hom_ext
statement:
theorem hom_ext {φ ψ : NSSetOperadHom (NSPres T ρ) S}
    (h : ∀ (n : ℕ) (g : T n), φ.app _ (gen g) = ψ.app _ (gen g)) : φ = ψ
proof:
:= by
  ext n x
  obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := mk_surjective x
  rw [app_mk, app_mk]
  congr 1
  funext n g
  exact h n g

name: Operad.NSPres.respects_app
statement:
lemma respects_app (φ : NSSetOperadHom (NSPres T ρ) S) :
    Respects ρ (fun _ g => φ.app _ (gen g))
proof:
:= by
  intro n x y h
  rw [← app_mk, ← app_mk, mk_eq_mk_of_rel h]

name: Operad.GrOperadHom.sgnHom_op
statement:
@[simp] lemma sgnHom_op (φ : GrOperadHom R P Q) {A : Type} [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A]
    (p : SgnOp R P A) : ((sgnHom φ).app A p).op = φ.app A p.op
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.GrOperadHom.sgnHom_cor
statement:
lemma sgnHom_cor (φ : GrOperadHom R P Q) {A : Type} [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] (L : LinOrd A)
    (q : Bool) (y : P A) :
    (sgnHom φ).app A (SgnOp.cor (R := R) L q y) = SgnOp.cor (R := R) L q (φ.app A y)
proof:
:=
  SgnOp.ext (φ.app_par q y) rfl

name: Operad.STree.mapV_leaf
statement: @[simp] lemma mapV_leaf (a : ℕ) : (leaf a : STree B).mapV g = leaf a
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.STree.mapV_node
statement:
lemma mapV_node {k : ℕ} (β : B k) (c : Fin k → STree B) :
    (node β c).mapV g = node (g _ β) fun j => (c j).mapV g
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.STree.labels_mapV
statement:
@[simp] lemma labels_mapV : ∀ t : STree B, (t.mapV g).labels = t.labels
  | leaf _ => rfl
  | node β c => by
    rw [mapV_node, labels_node, labels_node]
    exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => labels_mapV (c j)

@[simp] lemma first_mapV : ∀ t : STree B, (t.mapV g).first = t.first
  | leaf _ => rfl
  | @node _ k β c => by
    rw [mapV_node]
    by_cases hk : 0 < k
    · rw [first_node _ _ hk, first_node _ _ hk, first_mapV]
    · simp only [first, dif_neg hk]

name: Operad.STree.first_mapV
statement:
@[simp] lemma first_mapV : ∀ t : STree B, (t.mapV g).first = t.first
  | leaf _ => rfl
  | @node _ k β c => by
    rw [mapV_node]
    by_cases hk : 0 < k
    · rw [first_node _ _ hk, first_node _ _ hk, first_mapV]
    · simp only [first, dif_neg hk]

name: Operad.STree.isShuffle_mapV
statement:
lemma isShuffle_mapV : ∀ t : STree B, (t.mapV g).IsShuffle ↔ t.IsShuffle
  | leaf _ => Iff.rfl
  | node β c => by
    rw [mapV_node, isShuffle_node, isShuffle_node]
    simp only [first_mapV, isShuffle_mapV]

end STree

namespace FreeGrL

variable {R : Type u} [CommRing R]
  {V : (A : Type) → [Fintype A] → [DecidableEq A] → Type v}
  [∀ (A : Type) [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A], AddCommGroup (V A)]
  [∀ (A : Type) [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A], Module R (V A)] [GrSpecies R V]
  {W : (A : Type) → [Fintype A] → [DecidableEq A] → Type w}
  [∀ (A : Type) [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A], AddCommGroup (W A)]
  [∀ (A : Type) [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A], Module R (W A)] [GrSpecies R W]

name: Operad.FreeGrL.mapSp_graft_mk
statement:
theorem mapSp_graft_mk (f : GrSpeciesHom R V W) {S : Type} [Fintype S] [DecidableEq S]
    (g : GrCompGen V (FreeGrL R V) S) :
    (mapSp f).app S (graft R V S (mk R g)) = graft R W S (mk R
      ⟨g.A, g.B, g.L, f.app g.A g.m, fun a => (mapSp f).app (g.B a) (g.y a), g.e⟩)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [graft, total_mk, totalFun, map_sum]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun p _ => Finset.sum_congr rfl fun c _ => ?_
  simp only [totalGen]
  rw [GrOperadHom.app_map]
  congr 1
  have h := congrArg SgnOp.op (May.app_total (GrOperadHom.sgnHom (mapSp f))
    (SgnOp.cor (R := R) g.L p ((ι R V).toSymSpeciesHom.app g.A g.m))
    fun a => SgnOp.cor (R := R) (ordOf (g.B a)) (c a) (g.y a))
  refine h.trans ?_
  simp only [GrOperadHom.sgnHom_cor]
  congr 3
  exact mapSp_ι f g.m

name: Operad.FreeGrL.app_unitL
statement:
lemma app_unitL (φ : GrOperadHom R (FreeGrL R V) (FreeGrL R W)) (A : Type) [Fintype A]
    [DecidableEq A] : φ.app A (unitL R V A) = unitL R W A
proof:
:= by
  rw [unitL, unitL, map_sum]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun e _ => ?_
  rw [φ.app_map, φ.app_one]

name: Operad.FreeGrL.shEvF_leaf
statement:
lemma shEvF_leaf (a : ℕ) (Y : Finset ℕ) (h : (STree.leaf a : STree B).labels = Y.val) :
    shEvF (R := R) v (.leaf a) Y h = unitL R W (Lab Y)
proof:
:= by
  rw [shEvF]

name: Operad.FreeGrL.shEvF_node
statement:
lemma shEvF_node {k : ℕ} (β : B k) (c : Fin k → STree B) (Y : Finset ℕ)
    (h : (STree.node β c).labels = Y.val) :
    shEvF (R := R) v (.node β c) Y h = graft R W (Lab Y) (mk R (ownGen (LinOrd.std _) (v _ β)
      (own h) fun j => GrOperad.map (R := R) (childEquiv h j) (shEvF v (c j) (cLab c j)
        (labels_child h j))))
proof:
:= by
  rw [shEvF]

name: Operad.FreeGrL.shEvF_congr
statement:
lemma shEvF_congr {t t' : STree B} (ht : t = t') (Y : Finset ℕ) (h : t.labels = Y.val)
    (h' : t'.labels = Y.val) : shEvF (R := R) v t Y h = shEvF v t' Y h'
proof:
:= by
  subst ht
  rfl

name: Operad.FreeGrL.map_shEvF
statement:
lemma map_shEvF {t : STree B} {Y Y' : Finset ℕ} (hY : Y = Y') (h : t.labels = Y.val)
    (h' : t.labels = Y'.val) (e : Lab Y ≃ Lab Y') (he : ∀ x, (e x).1 = x.1) :
    GrOperad.map (R := R) e (shEvF v t Y h) = shEvF (R := R) v t Y' h'
proof:
:= by
  subst hY
  rw [show e = Equiv.refl _ from Equiv.ext fun x => Subtype.ext (he x), GrOperad.map_refl]

name: Operad.FreeGrL.shEv_eq_shEvF
statement:
theorem shEv_eq_shEvF {B : ℕ → Type x} (b : ∀ k, Module.Basis (B k) R (W (Fin k))) :
    ∀ (t : STree B) (Y : Finset ℕ) (h : t.labels = Y.val),
      shEv b t Y h = shEvF (fun k => ⇑(b k)) t Y h
  | .leaf a, Y, h => by rw [shEv_leaf, shEvF_leaf]
  | .node β c, Y, h => by
    rw [shEv_node, shEvF_node]
    congr 4
    funext j
    rw [shEv_eq_shEvF b (c j)]

name: Operad.FreeGrL.shEvF_node_congr
statement:
theorem shEvF_node_congr {B₀ : ℕ → Type*} {k : ℕ} (γ : B k) (c' : Fin k → STree B) (β₀ : B₀ k)
    (c : Fin k → STree B₀) (hc : ∀ j, (c' j).labels = (c j).labels) (Y : Finset ℕ)
    (h : (STree.node β₀ c).labels = Y.val) (h' : (STree.node γ c').labels = Y.val) :
    shEvF (R := R) v (.node γ c') Y h' = graft R W (Lab Y) (mk R (ownGen (LinOrd.std _) (v _ γ)
      (own h) fun j => GrOperad.map (R := R) (childEquiv h j) (shEvF v (c' j) (cLab c j)
        ((hc j).trans (labels_child h j)))))
proof:
:= by
  have hown : own h' = own h := funext fun s => own_eq h' (by rw [hc]; exact mem_own h s)
  rw [shEvF_node, mk_ownGen_congr _ _ hown]
  congr 4
  funext j
  have hY : cLab c' j = cLab c j := by simp only [cLab, hc]
  rw [← map_shEvF v hY (labels_child h' j) _ (Equiv.subtypeEquivRight fun x => by rw [hY])
    fun _ => rfl]
  show GrOperad.map (R := R) _ (GrOperad.map (R := R) _ _) = _
  simp only [← GrOperad.map_trans]
  apply gmap_congr
  intro x
  rfl

name: Operad.FreeGrL.mapSp_shEvF
statement:
theorem mapSp_shEvF {V : (A : Type) → [Fintype A] → [DecidableEq A] → Type v}
    [∀ (A : Type) [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A], AddCommGroup (V A)]
    [∀ (A : Type) [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A], Module R (V A)] [GrSpecies R V]
    (u : ∀ k, B k → V (Fin k)) (f : GrSpeciesHom R V W) :
    ∀ (t : STree B) (Y : Finset ℕ) (h : t.labels = Y.val),
      (mapSp f).app (Lab Y) (shEvF u t Y h)
        = shEvF (fun k β => f.app (Fin k) (u k β)) t Y h
  | .leaf a, Y, h => by rw [shEvF_leaf, shEvF_leaf, app_unitL]
  | .node β c, Y, h => by
    rw [shEvF_node, shEvF_node, mapSp_graft_mk]
    congr 3
    funext j
    rw [GrOperadHom.app_map, mapSp_shEvF u f (c j)]

name: Operad.FreeGrL.shEvF_mapV
statement:
theorem shEvF_mapV {B' : ℕ → Type*} (g : ∀ k, B' k → B k) :
    ∀ (t : STree B') (Y : Finset ℕ) (h : t.labels = Y.val) (h' : (t.mapV g).labels = Y.val),
      shEvF (R := R) v (t.mapV g) Y h' = shEvF (fun k β => v k (g k β)) t Y h
  | .leaf a, Y, h, h' => (shEvF_leaf v a Y h').trans (shEvF_leaf _ a Y h).symm
  | .node β c, Y, h, h' => by
    rw [shEvF_congr v (mapV_node g β c) Y h' h',
      shEvF_node_congr v (g _ β) (fun j => (c j).mapV g) β c (fun j => labels_mapV g (c j)) Y h h',
      shEvF_node]
    congr 4
    funext j
    rw [shEvF_mapV g (c j)]

name: Operad.FreeGrL.sum_shEvF_replace
statement:
theorem sum_shEvF_replace {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι) (a : ι → R) {k : ℕ} (βs : ι → B k)
    (ch : Fin k → STree B) (hv : ∑ i ∈ s, a i • v k (βs i) = 0) :
    ∀ (q : List ℕ) (t : STree B) (β₀ : B k), t.get? q = some (.node β₀ ch) → ∀ (Y : Finset ℕ)
      (h : ∀ i, (t.replace q (.node (βs i) ch)).labels = Y.val),
      ∑ i ∈ s, a i • shEvF (R := R) v (t.replace q (.node (βs i) ch)) Y (h i) = 0
  | [], t, β₀, ht, Y, h => by
    rw [get?_nil, Option.some_inj] at ht
    subst ht
    rcases s.eq_empty_or_nonempty with hs | ⟨i₀, -⟩
    · rw [hs, Finset.sum_empty]
    have h₀ : (STree.node β₀ ch).labels = Y.val
proof:
:= h i₀
    let g : GrCompGen W (FreeGrL R W) (Lab Y) := ownGen (LinOrd.std _) (0 : W (Fin k)) (own h₀)
      fun j => GrOperad.map (R := R) (childEquiv h₀ j) (shEvF v (ch j) (cLab ch j)
        (labels_child h₀ j))
    have hterm : ∀ i, shEvF (R := R) v ((STree.node β₀ ch).replace [] (.node (βs i) ch)) Y (h i)
        = graft R W (Lab Y) (mkM g (v k (βs i))) := fun i => by
      rw [mkM_apply]
      exact shEvF_node v (βs i) ch Y (h i)
    simp only [hterm, ← map_smul, ← map_sum, hv, map_zero]
  | _ :: _, .leaf _, _, ht, _, _ => by simp at ht
  | j :: q', .node (k := k') γ c, β₀, ht, Y, h => by
    obtain ⟨hj, hc⟩ := get?_node_cons_eq_some.1 ht
    rcases s.eq_empty_or_nonempty with hs | ⟨i₀, -⟩
    · rw [hs, Finset.sum_empty]
    let jj : Fin k' := ⟨j, hj⟩
    let ci : ι → Fin k' → STree B := fun i l =>
      if (l : ℕ) = j then (c l).replace q' (.node (βs i) ch) else c l
    have hci : ∀ i l, (ci i l).labels = (c l).labels := fun i l => by
      simp only [ci]
      split_ifs with hl
      · have hl' : l = jj := Fin.ext hl
        subst hl'
        exact labels_replace_of_eq (v := .node (βs i) ch) hc rfl
      · rfl
    have h₀ : (STree.node γ c).labels = Y.val := by
      rw [← h i₀, replace_node_cons, labels_node, labels_node]
      exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun l _ => (hci i₀ l).symm
    let ys₀ : ∀ l, FreeGrL R W (Fib (own h₀) l) := fun l =>
      GrOperad.map (R := R) (childEquiv h₀ l) (shEvF v (c l) (cLab c l) (labels_child h₀ l))
    let g : GrCompGen W (FreeGrL R W) (Lab Y) := ownGen (LinOrd.std _) (v _ γ) (own h₀) ys₀
    let Ψ : FreeGrL R W (Lab (cLab c jj)) →ₗ[R] FreeGrL R W (Lab Y) :=
      (graft R W (Lab Y)).comp (((mkY g).toLinearMap ys₀ jj).comp
        (GrOperad.map (R := R) (childEquiv h₀ jj)))
    have hjl : ∀ i, ((c jj).replace q' (.node (βs i) ch)).labels = (cLab c jj).val := fun i =>
      (labels_replace_of_eq (v := .node (βs i) ch) hc rfl).trans (labels_child h₀ jj)
    have hterm : ∀ i, shEvF (R := R) v ((STree.node γ c).replace (j :: q') (.node (βs i) ch)) Y
        (h i) = Ψ (shEvF v ((c jj).replace q' (.node (βs i) ch)) (cLab c jj) (hjl i)) := by
      intro i
      rw [shEvF_congr v (replace_node_cons γ c j q' _) Y (h i) (by rw [← h i]; rfl),
        shEvF_node_congr v γ (ci i) γ c (hci i) Y h₀]
      show _ = graft R W (Lab Y) (mk R { g with y := update ys₀ jj _ })
      congr 4
      funext l
      by_cases hl : l = jj
      · subst hl
        rw [update_self]
        congr 1
        exact shEvF_congr v (if_pos rfl) _ _ _
      · rw [update_of_ne hl]
        congr 1
        exact shEvF_congr v (if_neg fun h' => hl (Fin.ext h')) _ _ _
    simp only [hterm, ← map_smul, ← map_sum]
    rw [sum_shEvF_replace s a βs ch hv q' (c jj) β₀ hc (cLab c jj) hjl, map_zero]

name: Operad.FreeGrL.mapSp_sum_shEv_replace
statement:
theorem mapSp_sum_shEv_replace {V : (A : Type) → [Fintype A] → [DecidableEq A] → Type v}
    [∀ (A : Type) [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A], AddCommGroup (V A)]
    [∀ (A : Type) [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A], Module R (V A)] [GrSpecies R V]
    (b : ∀ k, Module.Basis (B k) R (V (Fin k))) (f : GrSpeciesHom R V W) {ι : Type*}
    (s : Finset ι) (a : ι → R) {k : ℕ} (βs : ι → B k) (ch : Fin k → STree B)
    (hv : ∑ i ∈ s, a i • f.app (Fin k) (b k (βs i)) = 0) (q : List ℕ) (t : STree B) (β₀ : B k)
    (hq : t.get? q = some (.node β₀ ch)) {Y : Finset ℕ} {A : Type} [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A]
    (e : Lab Y ≃ A) (h : ∀ i, (t.replace q (.node (βs i) ch)).labels = Y.val) :
    (mapSp f).app A (∑ i ∈ s, a i • GrOperad.map (R := R) e
      (shEv b (t.replace q (.node (βs i) ch)) Y (h i))) = 0
proof:
:= by
