  have h1 : f.compLinearMap (fun a => (Submodule.span R {x | CompRel R N L (B a) x}).mkQ)
      = g.compLinearMap (fun a => (Submodule.span R {x | CompRel R N L (B a) x}).mkQ) :=
    ML.finsupp_ext' fun t => h t
  exact ML.quot_ext' (fun a => Submodule.span R {x | CompRel R N L (B a) x}) fun x =>
    congrArg (fun F : MultilinearMap R (fun a => CompGen N L (B a) →₀ R) W => F x) h1

name: Operad.Composite.ML.reindex_apply
statement:
lemma ML.reindex_apply {ι ι' : Type*} [DecidableEq ι] [DecidableEq ι'] {X : ι → Type*}
    [∀ i, AddCommGroup (X i)] [∀ i, Module R (X i)] {W : Type*} [AddCommGroup W] [Module R W]
    (σ : ι' ≃ ι) (f : MultilinearMap R (fun i' => X (σ i')) W) (w : ∀ i, X i) :
    ML.reindex σ f w = f fun i' => w (σ i')
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: Operad.Composite.assocInvFun_respects
statement:
lemma assocInvFun_respects : CompGen.Respects R (assocInvFun R M N L (S := S)) where
  add_m g m'
proof:
:= by
    have h : phiML R (N := N) (L := L) (g.m + m') g.e = phiML R g.m g.e + phiML R m' g.e :=
      slots_ext fun t => by
      rw [MultilinearMap.add_apply, phiML_mk, phiML_mk, phiML_mk]
      have hx : (mk R ⟨g.A, fun a => (t a).A, g.m + m', fun a => (t a).m, Equiv.refl _⟩ :
          Composite R M N _) = mk R ⟨g.A, fun a => (t a).A, g.m, fun a => (t a).m, Equiv.refl _⟩
            + mk R ⟨g.A, fun a => (t a).A, m', fun a => (t a).m, Equiv.refl _⟩ :=
        mk_add_m (R := R) (⟨g.A, fun a => (t a).A, g.m, fun a => (t a).m, Equiv.refl _⟩ :
          CompGen M N _) m'
      show mk R ⟨_, _, mk R ⟨g.A, fun a => (t a).A, g.m + m', fun a => (t a).m,
        Equiv.refl _⟩, _, _⟩ = _
      rw [hx]
      exact mk_add_m (phiGen R g.m g.e t) _
    exact congrArg (fun F : MultilinearMap R _ _ => F g.y) h
  smul_m g c := by
    have h : phiML R (N := N) (L := L) (c • g.m) g.e = c • phiML R g.m g.e :=
      slots_ext fun t => by
      rw [MultilinearMap.smul_apply, phiML_mk, phiML_mk]
      have hx : (mk R ⟨g.A, fun a => (t a).A, c • g.m, fun a => (t a).m, Equiv.refl _⟩ :
          Composite R M N _)
            = c • mk R ⟨g.A, fun a => (t a).A, g.m, fun a => (t a).m, Equiv.refl _⟩ :=
        mk_smul_m (R := R) (⟨g.A, fun a => (t a).A, g.m, fun a => (t a).m, Equiv.refl _⟩ :
          CompGen M N _) c
      show mk R ⟨_, _, mk R ⟨g.A, fun a => (t a).A, c • g.m, fun a => (t a).m,
        Equiv.refl _⟩, _, _⟩ = _
      rw [hx]
      exact mk_smul_m (phiGen R g.m g.e t) c
    exact congrArg (fun F : MultilinearMap R _ _ => F g.y) h
  add_y g a z z' := (phiML R g.m g.e).map_update_add g.y a z z'
  smul_y g a c z := (phiML R g.m g.e).map_update_smul g.y a c z
  outer := @fun g A' _ _ σ m' => by
    have h : phiML R (N := N) (L := L) (SymSpecies.map (R := R) σ m') g.e
        = ML.reindex σ (phiML R (B := fun a' => g.B (σ a')) m'
          ((Equiv.sigmaCongrLeft σ).trans g.e)) := slots_ext fun t => by
      rw [ML.reindex_apply, phiML_mk, phiML_mk (B := fun a' => g.B (σ a'))]
      exact phi_reindex σ m' g.e t
    exact congrArg (fun F : MultilinearMap R _ _ => F g.y) h
  inner := @fun g B' _ _ τ => by
    have h : (phiML R (N := N) (L := L) (B := B') g.m
        ((Equiv.sigmaCongrRight τ).symm.trans g.e)).compLinearMap
        (fun a => SymSpecies.map (R := R) (V := Composite R N L) (τ a)) = phiML R g.m g.e :=
      slots_ext fun t => by
        rw [MultilinearMap.compLinearMap_apply]
        simp only [symSpecies_map_mk]
        rw [phiML_mk (B := B'), phiML_mk]
        exact (mk_congr_e _ _ fun ⟨⟨a, c⟩, d⟩ => by
          show g.e ((Equiv.sigmaCongrRight τ).symm ⟨a, τ a ((t a).e ⟨c, d⟩)⟩)
            = g.e ⟨a, (t a).e ⟨c, d⟩⟩
          rw [Equiv.sigmaCongrRight_symm, Equiv.sigmaCongrRight_apply, Equiv.symm_apply_apply])
    exact congrArg (fun F : MultilinearMap R _ _ => F g.y) h

name: Operad.Composite.assocInvApp_mk
statement:
lemma assocInvApp_mk (g : CompGen M (Composite R N L) S) :
    assocInvApp S (mk R g) = phiML R g.m g.e g.y
proof:
:=
  lift_mk _ _ g

name: Operad.Composite.assocInvApp_assocApp
statement:
theorem assocInvApp_assocApp (z : Composite R (Composite R M N) L S) :
    assocInvApp S (assocApp S z) = z
proof:
:= by
  have h : (assocInvApp (R := R) (M := M) (N := N) (L := L) S).comp (assocApp S)
      = LinearMap.id :=
    hom_ext fun h => by
      rw [LinearMap.comp_apply, assocApp_mk, LinearMap.id_apply]
      show assocInvApp S (assocLin h.B h.e h.m h.y) = mkM h h.m
      induction h.m using induction_on with
      | h0 => simp only [map_zero, MultilinearMap.zero_apply]
      | hadd x y hx hy => simp only [map_add, MultilinearMap.add_apply, hx, hy]
      | hsmul c x hx => simp only [map_smul, MultilinearMap.smul_apply, hx]
      | hmk k =>
        rw [assocLin_mk, assocInvApp_mk, phiML_mk, mkM_apply]
        have hk : (mk R k : Composite R M N h.A)
            = SymSpecies.map (R := R) (V := Composite R M N) k.e
              (mk R ⟨k.A, k.B, k.m, k.y, Equiv.refl _⟩) := by
          rw [symSpecies_map_mk]
          rfl
        rw [hk]
        refine Eq.trans ?_ (mk_outer h k.e _).symm
        exact mk_congr_e _ _ fun ⟨⟨_, _⟩, _⟩ => rfl
  exact LinearMap.congr_fun h z

name: Operad.Composite.assocApp_assocInvApp
statement:
theorem assocApp_assocInvApp (z : Composite R M (Composite R N L) S) :
    assocApp S (assocInvApp S z) = z
proof:
:= by
  have h : (assocApp (R := R) (M := M) (N := N) (L := L) S).comp (assocInvApp S)
      = LinearMap.id :=
    hom_ext fun g => by
      rw [LinearMap.comp_apply, assocInvApp_mk, LinearMap.id_apply]
      show (assocApp S).compMultilinearMap (phiML R g.m g.e) g.y = mkY g g.y
      congr 1
      refine slots_ext fun t => ?_
      rw [LinearMap.compMultilinearMap_apply, phiML_mk, assocApp_mk, assocLin_mk, mkY_apply]
      let k₀ : CompGen M N (Σ a, (t a).A) :=
        ⟨g.A, fun a => (t a).A, g.m, fun a => (t a).m, Equiv.refl _⟩
      have ht : (fun a => mk R (t a)) = fun a => SymSpecies.map (R := R) (V := Composite R N L)
          (t a).e (mk R (assocInner k₀ (fun p => (t p.1).B p.2) (fun p => (t p.1).y p.2) a)) :=
        funext fun a => by
          rw [symSpecies_map_mk]
          rfl
      rw [ht]
      have h3 := mk_inner (R := R) (assocGen R k₀ (fun p => (t p.1).B p.2)
        (fun p => (t p.1).y p.2) (phiE g.e t)) (B := g.B) fun a => (t a).e
      rw [Equiv.symm_trans_eq_of _ _ g.e (fun ⟨_, _, _⟩ => rfl)] at h3
      exact h3.symm
  exact LinearMap.congr_fun h z

name: Operad.Composite.assocEquiv_apply
statement:
@[simp] lemma assocEquiv_apply (z : Composite R (Composite R M N) L S) :
    assocEquiv S z = assoc.app S z
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: Operad.GrOperad.lcomp_apply
statement:
lemma lcomp_apply (D : P Unit) (x : P A) :
    lcomp R D x = map (R := R) (leftUnitEquiv A) (comp (R := R) () D x)
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.GrOperad.rcomp_apply
statement:
lemma rcomp_apply (D : P Unit) (a : A) (x : P A) :
    rcomp R D a x = map (R := R) (rightUnitEquiv a) (comp (R := R) a x D)
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.GrOperad.lcomp_comp
statement:
lemma lcomp_comp (D : P Unit) (i : A) (x : P A) (y : P B) :
    lcomp R D (comp (R := R) i x y) = comp (R := R) i (lcomp R D x) y
proof:
:= by
  rw [lcomp_apply, lcomp_apply, comp_map_left (leftUnitEquiv A) (Sum.inr i) i rfl,
    ← comp_assoc_seq () i D x y, ← map_trans]
  refine congrArg (fun e => map (R := R) e _) (Equiv.ext fun z => ?_)
  rcases z with (⟨(⟨u, hu⟩ | a), ha⟩ | b)
  · exact absurd (Subsingleton.elim u ()) hu
  · rfl
  · rfl

name: Operad.GrOperad.rcomp_comp_inr
statement:
lemma rcomp_comp_inr (D : P Unit) (i : A) (b : B) (x : P A) (y : P B) :
    rcomp R D (Sum.inr b : Without A i ⊕ B) (comp (R := R) i x y)
      = comp (R := R) i x (rcomp R D b y)
proof:
:= by
  rw [rcomp_apply, rcomp_apply, comp_map_right, comp_assoc_seq' i b x y D, ← map_trans]
  refine congrArg (fun e => map (R := R) e _) (Equiv.ext fun z => ?_)
  rcases z with (a | (b' | u))
  · rfl
  · rfl
  · rfl

name: Operad.GrOperad.rcomp_comp_inl_hom
statement:
lemma rcomp_comp_inl_hom (D : P Unit) (hD : par (R := R) true D = D) {i a : A} (hai : a ≠ i)
    (x : P A) {q : Bool} {y : P B} (hy : par (R := R) q y = y) :
    rcomp R D (Sum.inl ⟨a, hai⟩ : Without A i ⊕ B) (comp (R := R) i x y)
      = σ R (q && true) • comp (R := R) i (rcomp R D a x) y
proof:
:= by
  rw [rcomp_apply, rcomp_apply, comp_assoc_par' (Ne.symm hai) x hy hD, map_smul, ← map_trans,
    comp_map_left (rightUnitEquiv a) (Sum.inl ⟨i, Ne.symm hai⟩) i rfl]
  congr 1
  refine congrArg (fun e => map (R := R) e _) (Equiv.ext fun z => ?_)
  rcases z with (⟨(⟨c, hc⟩ | u), hc'⟩ | b)
  · rfl
  · rfl
  · rfl

name: Operad.GrOperad.rcomp_comp_inl
statement:
lemma rcomp_comp_inl (D : P Unit) (hD : par (R := R) true D = D) {i a : A} (hai : a ≠ i)
    (x : P A) (y : P B) :
    rcomp R D (Sum.inl ⟨a, hai⟩ : Without A i ⊕ B) (comp (R := R) i x y)
      = comp (R := R) i (rcomp R D a x) (tw (R := R) true y)
proof:
:= by
  conv_lhs => rw [← par_add (R := R) y]
  rw [map_add, map_add, rcomp_comp_inl_hom D hD hai x (par_par_self false y),
    rcomp_comp_inl_hom D hD hai x (par_par_self true y), tw_apply, map_add, map_smul]
  simp

name: Operad.GrOperad.comp_rcomp_self
statement:
lemma comp_rcomp_self (D : P Unit) (i : A) (x : P A) (y : P B) :
    comp (R := R) i (rcomp R D i x) y = comp (R := R) i x (lcomp R D y)
proof:
:= by
  rw [rcomp_apply, lcomp_apply, comp_map_left (rightUnitEquiv i) (Sum.inr ()) i rfl,
    comp_assoc_seq' i () x D y, ← map_trans, comp_map_right]
  refine congrArg (fun e => map (R := R) e _) (Equiv.ext fun z => ?_)
  rcases z with (a | (⟨u, hu⟩ | b))
  · rfl
  · exact absurd (Subsingleton.elim u ()) hu
  · rfl

name: Operad.GrOperad.lcomp_map
statement:
lemma lcomp_map (D : P Unit) (e : A ≃ B) (x : P A) :
    lcomp R D (map (R := R) e x) = map (R := R) e (lcomp R D x)
proof:
:= by
  rw [lcomp_apply, lcomp_apply, comp_map_right, ← map_trans, ← map_trans]
  refine congrArg (fun e => map (R := R) e _) (Equiv.ext fun z => ?_)
  rcases z with (⟨u, hu⟩ | a)
  · exact absurd (Subsingleton.elim u ()) hu
  · rfl

name: Operad.GrOperad.rcomp_map
statement:
lemma rcomp_map (D : P Unit) (e : A ≃ B) (a : A) (x : P A) :
    rcomp R D (e a) (map (R := R) e x) = map (R := R) e (rcomp R D a x)
proof:
:= by
  rw [rcomp_apply, rcomp_apply, comp_map_left e a (e a) rfl, ← map_trans, ← map_trans]
  refine congrArg (fun e => map (R := R) e _) (Equiv.ext fun z => ?_)
  rcases z with (⟨c, hc⟩ | u)
  · rfl
  · rfl

name: Operad.GrOperad.lcomp_rcomp
statement:
lemma lcomp_rcomp (D : P Unit) (b : A) (x : P A) :
    lcomp R D (rcomp R D b x) = rcomp R D b (lcomp R D x)
proof:
:= by
  rw [rcomp_apply, rcomp_apply, lcomp_map, lcomp_comp]

name: Operad.GrOperad.lcomp_lcomp
statement:
lemma lcomp_lcomp (D : P Unit) (hDD : comp (R := R) () D D = 0) (x : P A) :
    lcomp R D (lcomp R D x) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [lcomp_apply, lcomp_apply, comp_map_right, ← comp_assoc_seq () () D D x, hDD]
  simp only [map_zero, LinearMap.zero_apply]

name: Operad.GrOperad.rcomp_rcomp_self
statement:
lemma rcomp_rcomp_self (D : P Unit) (hDD : comp (R := R) () D D = 0) (a : A) (x : P A) :
    rcomp R D a (rcomp R D a x) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [rcomp_apply, rcomp_apply, comp_map_left (rightUnitEquiv a) (Sum.inr ()) a rfl,
    comp_assoc_seq' a () x D D, hDD]
  simp only [map_zero]

name: Operad.GrOperad.rcomp_rcomp_ne
statement:
lemma rcomp_rcomp_ne (D : P Unit) (hD : par (R := R) true D = D) {a b : A} (hab : a ≠ b)
    (x : P A) : rcomp R D a (rcomp R D b x) = -rcomp R D b (rcomp R D a x)
proof:
:= by
  rw [rcomp_apply, rcomp_apply, rcomp_apply, rcomp_apply,
    comp_map_left (rightUnitEquiv b) (Sum.inl ⟨a, hab⟩) a rfl,
    comp_map_left (rightUnitEquiv a) (Sum.inl ⟨b, Ne.symm hab⟩) b rfl,
    comp_assoc_par' (Ne.symm hab) x hD hD, Bool.and_self, σ_true, neg_one_smul, map_neg,
    map_neg]
  simp only [← map_trans]
  congr 1
  refine congrArg (fun e => map (R := R) e _) (Equiv.ext fun z => ?_)
  rcases z with (⟨(⟨c, hc⟩ | u), hc'⟩ | u')
  · rfl
  · rfl
  · rfl

name: Operad.GrOperad.innerL_apply
statement:
lemma innerL_apply (D : P Unit) (x : P A) :
    innerL R D x = lcomp R D x - ∑ a : A, rcomp R D a (tw (R := R) true x)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [innerL, LinearMap.sub_apply, LinearMap.coe_sum, Finset.sum_apply,
    LinearMap.comp_apply]

name: Operad.GrOperad.innerL_comp
statement:
theorem innerL_comp (D : P Unit) (hD : par (R := R) true D = D) (i : A) (x : P A) (y : P B) :
    innerL R D (comp (R := R) i x y)
      = comp (R := R) i (innerL R D x) y + comp (R := R) i (tw (R := R) true x) (innerL R D y)
proof:
:= by
  have h : ∀ a : Without A i, rcomp R D (Sum.inl a : Without A i ⊕ B)
      (comp (R := R) i (tw (R := R) true x) (tw (R := R) true y))
        = comp (R := R) i (rcomp R D a.1 (tw (R := R) true x)) y := by
    rintro ⟨a, ha⟩
    rw [rcomp_comp_inl D hD ha, tw_tw]
  rw [innerL_apply, innerL_apply, innerL_apply, tw_comp, lcomp_comp, Fintype.sum_sum_type]
  simp only [h, rcomp_comp_inr, map_sub, LinearMap.sub_apply, map_sum, LinearMap.coe_sum,
    Finset.sum_apply]
  rw [Fintype.sum_eq_add_sum_subtype_ne
    (fun a => comp (R := R) i (rcomp R D a (tw (R := R) true x)) y) i, comp_rcomp_self]
  abel

name: Operad.GrOperad.innerL_hom
statement:
lemma innerL_hom (D : P Unit) (hD : par (R := R) true D = D) {p : Bool} {x : P A}
    (hx : par (R := R) p x = x) : par (R := R) (!p) (innerL R D x) = innerL R D x
proof:
:= by
  rw [innerL_apply, map_sub, map_sum]
  congr 1
  · rw [lcomp_apply, ← map_par, par_comp_hom () (Bool.true_xor p) hD hx]
  · refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun a _ => ?_
    have htx : par (R := R) p (tw (R := R) true x) = tw (R := R) true x := by
      rw [par_tw, hx]
    rw [rcomp_apply, ← map_par, par_comp_hom a (Bool.xor_true p) htx hD]

name: Operad.GrOperad.innerL_par
statement:
lemma innerL_par (D : P Unit) (hD : par (R := R) true D = D) (c : Bool) (x : P A) :
    innerL R D (par (R := R) c x) = par (R := R) (xor c true) (innerL R D x)
proof:
:= by
  have h : ∀ b, par (R := R) (xor c true) (innerL R D (par (R := R) b x))
      = if c = b then innerL R D (par (R := R) b x) else 0 := by
    intro b
    rw [← innerL_hom D hD (par_par_self b x), par_par]
    cases b <;> cases c <;> simp
  conv_rhs => rw [← par_add (R := R) x, map_add, map_add, h, h]
  cases c <;> simp

name: Operad.GrOperad.innerL_map
statement:
lemma innerL_map (D : P Unit) (e : A ≃ B) (x : P A) :
    innerL R D (map (R := R) e x) = map (R := R) e (innerL R D x)
proof:
:= by
  rw [innerL_apply, innerL_apply, map_sub, map_sum, lcomp_map, ← map_tw, ← Equiv.sum_comp e]
  simp only [rcomp_map]

name: Operad.GrOperad.innerL_one
statement: lemma innerL_one (D : P Unit) : innerL R D (one (R := R) (P := P)) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have he : leftUnitEquiv Unit = rightUnitEquiv () :=
    Equiv.ext fun _ => Subsingleton.elim _ _
  rw [innerL_apply, tw_one, Fintype.sum_unique, lcomp_apply, rcomp_apply, he, comp_one, ← he,
    one_comp, sub_self]

name: Operad.GrOperad.tw_lcomp
statement:
lemma tw_lcomp (D : P Unit) (hD : par (R := R) true D = D) (x : P A) :
    tw (R := R) true (lcomp R D x) = -lcomp R D (tw (R := R) true x)
proof:
:= by
  rw [lcomp_apply, lcomp_apply, ← map_tw, tw_comp, tw_hom true hD, Bool.and_self, σ_true,
    neg_one_smul, map_neg, LinearMap.neg_apply, map_neg]

name: Operad.GrOperad.tw_rcomp
statement:
lemma tw_rcomp (D : P Unit) (hD : par (R := R) true D = D) (a : A) (x : P A) :
    tw (R := R) true (rcomp R D a x) = -rcomp R D a (tw (R := R) true x)
proof:
:= by
  rw [rcomp_apply, rcomp_apply, ← map_tw, tw_comp, tw_hom true hD, Bool.and_self, σ_true,
    neg_one_smul, map_neg, map_neg]

name: Operad.GrOperad.innerL_innerL
statement:
theorem innerL_innerL (D : P Unit) (hD : par (R := R) true D = D)
    (hDD : comp (R := R) () D D = 0) (x : P A) : innerL R D (innerL R D x) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hsum : ∑ a : A, ∑ b : A, rcomp R D a (rcomp R D b x) = 0 := by
    rw [← Fintype.sum_prod_type']
    refine Finset.sum_involution (fun p _ => p.swap) ?_ ?_ ?_ (fun _ _ => rfl)
    · rintro ⟨a, b⟩ _
      show rcomp R D a (rcomp R D b x) + rcomp R D b (rcomp R D a x) = 0
      by_cases hab : a = b
      · subst hab
        rw [rcomp_rcomp_self D hDD, add_zero]
      · rw [rcomp_rcomp_ne D hD hab, neg_add_cancel]
    · rintro ⟨a, b⟩ _ hne heq
      have hab : a = b := (Prod.ext_iff.1 heq).2
      subst hab
      exact hne (rcomp_rcomp_self D hDD a x)
    · intro p _
      exact Finset.mem_univ _
  rw [innerL_apply D (innerL R D x), innerL_apply D x]
  simp only [map_sub, map_add, map_neg, map_sum, lcomp_lcomp D hDD, tw_lcomp D hD,
    tw_rcomp D hD, tw_tw, lcomp_rcomp, Finset.sum_neg_distrib, sub_neg_eq_add,
    Finset.sum_add_distrib, hsum]
  abel

name: Operad.EndGr.dML_apply
statement: lemma dML_apply (x : Unit → V) : dML R V x = DGSuperMod.d (R := R) (x ())
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.EndGr.parML_dML
statement: lemma parML_dML : parML R V true (dML R V) = dML R V
proof:
:= by
  refine ext_inp fun c => ?_
  have hc : tot c = c () := by
    unfold tot
    rw [Fintype.sum_unique, bodd_toNat]
  rw [inp_parML, hc]
  refine MultilinearMap.ext fun x => ?_
  rw [out_apply, inp_apply, dML_apply, DGSuperMod.d_pr, Bool.true_xor, pr_self]

name: Operad.EndGr.dE_odd
statement: lemma dE_odd : GrOperad.par (R := R) true (dE R V) = dE R V
proof:
:= by
  show parE true (dE R V) = dE R V
  rw [dE, parE_ofFam, parML_dML]

name: Operad.EndGr.dE_comp_dE
statement: lemma dE_comp_dE : GrOperad.comp (R := R) () (dE R V) (dE R V) = 0
proof:
:= by
  show compE () (dE R V) (dE R V) = 0
  refine ext (LinOrd.comp () LinOrd.one LinOrd.one) ?_
  have ht : ∀ q : Bool, twist R V (bsg R LinOrd.one () q) (dML R V) = dML R V := fun q => by
    rw [twist_congr (fun c => bsg_one q c), twist_one]
  have hs : ∑ q, parML R V q (dML R V) = dML R V := by
    rw [Fintype.sum_bool, add_comm, parML_add]
  rw [compE_fam, compFam_comp, dE, ofFam_fam, zero_fam, kcomp_apply]
  simp only [ht]
  rw [← map_sum, hs]
  refine MultilinearMap.ext fun x => ?_
  rw [compL_apply, dML_apply, feed_self, dML_apply, DGSuperMod.d_d, MultilinearMap.zero_apply]

name: Operad.EndGr.d_eq
statement:
lemma d_eq {A : Type} [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] (F : EndGr R V A) :
    DGOperad.d (R := R) F = GrOperad.innerL R (dE R V) F
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.HoAlgebra.equivTwisting_apply
statement:
lemma HoAlgebra.equivTwisting_apply (φ : HoAlgebra R C V) {A : Type} [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A]
    (x : C A) :
    ConvOp.toLin ((HoAlgebra.equivTwisting φ).1.1 A) x = φ.1.app A (Cobar.ιL R C A x)
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.GrOperadHom.comp_app
statement:
@[simp] lemma comp_app (ψ : GrOperadHom R Q S) (φ : GrOperadHom R P Q) {A : Type} [Fintype A]
    [DecidableEq A] (x : P A) : (ψ.comp φ).app A x = ψ.app A (φ.app A x)
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.GrOperadHom.mem_ker
statement:
@[simp] lemma GrOperadHom.mem_ker (f : GrOperadHom R P Q) {A : Type} [Fintype A]
    [DecidableEq A] (x : P A) : x ∈ f.ker.sub A ↔ f.app A x = 0
proof:
:=
  LinearMap.mem_ker

name: Operad.GrOperadIdeal.proj_surjective
statement: lemma proj_surjective (A : Type) [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] : Function.Surjective (I.proj A)
proof:
:=
  Submodule.mkQ_surjective _

name: Operad.GrOperadIdeal.proj_eq_zero_iff
statement: lemma proj_eq_zero_iff (x : P A) : I.proj A x = 0 ↔ x ∈ I.sub A
proof:
:=
  Submodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero _

name: Operad.GrOperadIdeal.compRight_proj
statement:
lemma compRight_proj (i : A) (x : P A) (y : P B) :
    I.compRight i x (I.proj B y) = I.proj _ (GrOperad.comp (R := R) i x y)
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.GrOperadIdeal.compQ_proj
statement:
lemma compQ_proj (i : A) (x : P A) (y : P B) :
    I.compQ i (I.proj A x) (I.proj B y) = I.proj _ (GrOperad.comp (R := R) i x y)
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.GrOperadIdeal.projHom_app
statement: @[simp] lemma projHom_app (x : P A) : I.projHom.app A x = I.proj A x
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.GrOperadIdeal.mem_ker_projHom
statement: lemma mem_ker_projHom (x : P A) : x ∈ I.projHom.ker.sub A ↔ x ∈ I.sub A
proof:
:= by
  rw [GrOperadHom.mem_ker, projHom_app, proj_eq_zero_iff]

name: Operad.GrOperadIdeal.liftHom_proj
statement:
lemma liftHom_proj (φ : GrOperadHom R P Q)
    (h : ∀ (A : Type) [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A], ∀ x ∈ I.sub A, φ.app A x = 0) (x : P A) :
    (I.liftHom φ h).app A (I.proj A x) = φ.app A x
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.GrOperadIdeal.liftHom_comp_projHom
statement:
lemma liftHom_comp_projHom (φ : GrOperadHom R P Q)
    (h : ∀ (A : Type) [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A], ∀ x ∈ I.sub A, φ.app A x = 0) :
    (I.liftHom φ h).comp I.projHom = φ
proof:
:=
  GrOperadHom.ext fun _ _ _ _ => rfl

name: Operad.GrOperadIdeal.liftHom_unique
statement:
lemma liftHom_unique (φ : GrOperadHom R P Q)
    (h : ∀ (A : Type) [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A], ∀ x ∈ I.sub A, φ.app A x = 0)
    (ψ : GrOperadHom R I.Quot Q) (hψ : ψ.comp I.projHom = φ) : ψ = I.liftHom φ h
proof:
:= by
  refine GrOperadHom.ext fun A _ _ X => ?_
  obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := I.proj_surjective _ X
  rw [liftHom_proj, ← hψ]
  rfl

name: Operad.GrOperadHom.kerLift_proj
statement:
lemma kerLift_proj (φ : GrOperadHom R P Q) {A : Type} [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A]
    (x : P A) : φ.kerLift.app A (φ.ker.proj A x) = φ.app A x
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.GrOperadHom.kerLift_injective
statement:
lemma kerLift_injective (φ : GrOperadHom R P Q) (A : Type) [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] :
    Function.Injective (φ.kerLift.app A)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← LinearMap.ker_eq_bot, Submodule.eq_bot_iff]
  intro z hz
  obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := φ.ker.proj_surjective _ z
  rw [LinearMap.mem_ker, kerLift_proj] at hz
  exact (φ.ker.proj_eq_zero_iff x).2 hz

name: Operad.GrOperadIdeal.ext
statement:
lemma ext {I J : GrOperadIdeal R P}
    (h : ∀ (A : Type) [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A], I.sub A = J.sub A) : I = J
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨I, _, _, _, _⟩ := I
  obtain ⟨J, _, _, _, _⟩ := J
  have : @I = @J := by
    funext A _ _
    exact h A
  subst this
  rfl

name: Operad.GrOperadIdeal.mem_sInf
statement:
lemma mem_sInf {S : Set (GrOperadIdeal R P)} {A : Type} [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] {x : P A} :
    x ∈ (sInf S).sub A ↔ ∀ I ∈ S, x ∈ I.sub A
proof:
:= by
  simp only [sInf, Submodule.mem_iInf]

name: Operad.GrOperadIdeal.sInf_le
statement:
lemma sInf_le {S : Set (GrOperadIdeal R P)} {I : GrOperadIdeal R P} (h : I ∈ S) :
    sInf S ≤ I
proof:
:=
  fun _ _ _ _ hx => mem_sInf.1 hx I h

name: Operad.GrOperadIdeal.subset_span
statement: lemma subset_span (n : ℕ) : r n ⊆ (span R r).sub (Fin n)
proof:
:=
  fun _ hx => mem_sInf.2 fun _ hI => hI n hx

name: Operad.GrOperadIdeal.span_le
statement: lemma span_le {I : GrOperadIdeal R P} : span R r ≤ I ↔ ∀ n, r n ⊆ I.sub (Fin n)
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun h n _ hx => h _ (subset_span n hx), fun h => sInf_le h⟩

name: Operad.GrOperadIdeal.app_eq_zero_of_mem_span
proof:
:=
  (GrOperadHom.mem_ker φ x).1 (span_le.2 (fun n y hy => (GrOperadHom.mem_ker φ y).2 (hφ n y hy))
    A hx)

name: Operad.GrOperadIdeal.presHomEquiv_symm_proj
statement:
lemma presHomEquiv_symm_proj (φ : {φ : GrOperadHom R P Q // ∀ n, ∀ x ∈ r n,
    φ.app (Fin n) x = 0}) {A : Type} [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] (x : P A) :
    (presHomEquiv.symm φ).app A ((span R r).proj A x) = φ.1.app A x
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.FreeGr.presHomEquiv_symm_gen
proof:
:=
  homEquiv_symm_gen f.1 e

name: Operad.FreeGr.pres_hom_ext
statement:
theorem pres_hom_ext {φ ψ : GrOperadHom R (GrOperadIdeal.span R r).Quot Q}
    (h : ∀ k (e : T k), φ.app (Fin k) (presGen r e) = ψ.app (Fin k) (presGen r e)) : φ = ψ
proof:
:=
  presHomEquiv.injective (Subtype.ext (congrArg homEquiv (hom_ext fun k e => h k e)))

name: Operad.finsetOrderIso_apply
statement:
@[simp] lemma finsetOrderIso_apply (e : α ≃ β) (s : Finset α) :
    finsetOrderIso e s = s.map e.toEmbedding
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.map_univ_equiv
statement: lemma map_univ_equiv (e : α ≃ β) : (univ : Finset α).map e.toEmbedding = univ
proof:
:= by
  ext b
  simp only [Finset.mem_map, Finset.mem_univ, true_and, iff_true]
  exact ⟨e.symm b, by simp⟩

name: Operad.partMap_parts
statement:
@[simp] lemma partMap_parts (e : α ≃ β) (P : Finpartition (univ : Finset α)) :
    (partMap e P).parts = P.parts.map (finsetOrderIso e).toEquiv.toEmbedding
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.finsetOrderIso_toEquiv
statement: lemma finsetOrderIso_toEquiv (e : α ≃ β) : (finsetOrderIso e).toEquiv = e.finsetCongr
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.partMap_refl
statement:
@[simp] lemma partMap_refl (P : Finpartition (univ : Finset α)) :
    partMap (Equiv.refl α) P = P
proof:
:= by
  apply Finpartition.ext
  rw [partMap_parts, finsetOrderIso_toEquiv, Equiv.finsetCongr_refl]
  simp

name: Operad.partMap_trans
statement:
lemma partMap_trans (e : α ≃ β) (f : β ≃ γ) (P : Finpartition (univ : Finset α)) :
    partMap (e.trans f) P = partMap f (partMap e P)
proof:
:= by
  apply Finpartition.ext
  simp only [partMap_parts, finsetOrderIso_toEquiv, Finset.map_map]
  refine congrArg (fun g => P.parts.map g) ?_
  refine Function.Embedding.ext fun s => ?_
  ext x
  simp [Equiv.finsetCongr_apply]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨a, ha, rfl⟩
    simpa using ha
  · intro h
    exact ⟨e.symm (f.symm x), h, by simp⟩

name: Operad.ShuffleBar.pairL_single
statement:
@[simp] lemma pairL_single (x : BarTree E) (a : K) (w : BarTree E →₀ K) :
    pairL K (Finsupp.single x a) w = a * w x
proof:
:= by
  simp [pairL]

name: Operad.ShuffleBar.pairL_single_right
statement:
@[simp] lemma pairL_single_right (v : BarTree E →₀ K) (x : BarTree E) (a : K) :
    pairL K v (Finsupp.single x a) = v x * a
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction v using Finsupp.induction_linear with
  | zero => simp
  | add v v' hv hv' => rw [map_add, LinearMap.add_apply, hv, hv', Finsupp.add_apply, add_mul]
  | single y b =>
    rw [pairL_single, Finsupp.single_apply, Finsupp.single_apply]
    split_ifs with h h' h'
    · rw [mul_comm]
    · exact absurd h.symm h'
    · exact absurd h'.symm h
    · simp

name: Operad.ShuffleBar.δ_single
statement: @[simp] lemma δ_single (x : BarTree E) (c : K) : δ K (Finsupp.single x c) = c • δTree K x
proof:
:= by
  simp [δ]

name: Operad.ShuffleBar.dTree_apply_eq
statement:
lemma dTree_apply_eq {x y : BarTree E} (hx : Valid x) (hy : Valid y) :
    dTree K y x = δTree K x y
proof:
:= by
  classical
  simp only [dTree, δTree, Finsupp.finsetSum_apply, Finsupp.smul_apply, Finsupp.single_apply,
    smul_eq_mul, mul_ite, mul_one, mul_zero]
  rw [← Finset.sum_filter, ← Finset.sum_filter]
  have hset : (cutKeys y).filter (fun k => mergeK y k = x) =
      ((x.mapDec Prod.fst).edgeKeys \ cutKeys x).filter (fun k => cutK x k = y) := by
    ext k
    simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_sdiff]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨hk, rfl⟩
      refine ⟨⟨?_, ?_⟩, cutK_mergeK hy.nodup hy.root hk⟩
      · rw [full_mergeK]
        exact cutKeys_subset_edgeKeys hy.root hk
      · rw [cutKeys_mergeK y hy.nodup hk]
        exact Finset.notMem_erase k _
    · rintro ⟨⟨hkE, hkc⟩, rfl⟩
      refine ⟨?_, mergeK_cutK hx.root hkc⟩
      rw [cutKeys_cutK hx.nodup hkE]
      exact Finset.mem_insert_self k _
  rw [hset]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun k hk => ?_
  rw [(Finset.mem_filter.1 hk).2]

name: Operad.ShuffleBar.valid_of_supported
statement:
lemma valid_of_supported {v : BarTree E →₀ K} (hv : v ∈ Finsupp.supported K K {x | Valid x})
    {x : BarTree E} (hx : v x ≠ 0) : Valid x
proof:
:=
  (Finsupp.mem_supported K v).1 hv (Finsupp.mem_support_iff.2 hx)

name: Operad.ShuffleBar.δ_mem_valid
statement:
lemma δ_mem_valid {v : BarTree E →₀ K} (hv : v ∈ Finsupp.supported K K {x | Valid x}) :
    δ K v ∈ Finsupp.supported K K {x | Valid x}
proof:
:= by
  refine map_mem_of_supported K (δ K) (fun y hy => ?_) hv
  rw [δ_single, one_smul, δTree]
  refine Submodule.sum_mem _ fun k _ => Submodule.smul_mem _ _
    (Finsupp.single_mem_supported K _ ?_)
  exact ⟨(isShuffle_cutK _ _).2 hy.shuffle, by simpa using hy.nodup,
    (rootFlag_cutK _ _).trans hy.root⟩

name: Operad.ShuffleBar.d_mem_valid
statement:
lemma d_mem_valid {v : BarTree E →₀ K} (hv : v ∈ Finsupp.supported K K {x | Valid x}) :
    d K v ∈ Finsupp.supported K K {x | Valid x}
proof:
:= by
  refine map_mem_of_supported K (d K) (fun y hy => ?_) hv
  rw [d_single, one_smul, dTree]
  exact Submodule.sum_mem _ fun k _ => Submodule.smul_mem _ _
    (Finsupp.single_mem_supported K _ (Valid.mergeK hy k))

name: Operad.ShuffleBar.C_valid
statement:
lemma C_valid {n s : ℕ} {v : BarTree E →₀ K} (hv : v ∈ C K n s) :
    v ∈ Finsupp.supported K K {x | Valid x}
proof:
:=
  Finsupp.supported_mono (fun _ hx => hx.1) hv

name: Operad.ShuffleBar.pairL_d_δ
statement:
theorem pairL_d_δ {v w : BarTree E →₀ K} (hv : v ∈ Finsupp.supported K K {x | Valid x})
    (hw : w ∈ Finsupp.supported K K {x | Valid x}) :
    pairL K (d K w) v = pairL K w (δ K v)
proof:
:= by
  have hsingle : ∀ y, Valid y → pairL K (d K (Finsupp.single y 1)) v =
      pairL K (Finsupp.single y 1) (δ K v) := fun y hy => by
    have := map_mem_of_supported K (P := ⊥)
      ((pairL K (d K (Finsupp.single y 1))) - (pairL K (Finsupp.single y 1)) ∘ₗ δ K)
      (fun x hx => by
        simp only [LinearMap.sub_apply, LinearMap.comp_apply, d_single, δ_single, one_smul,
          pairL_single_right, pairL_single, Submodule.mem_bot, mul_one, one_mul]
        rw [dTree_apply_eq hx hy, sub_self]) hv
    simpa [sub_eq_zero] using this
  have := map_mem_of_supported K (P := ⊥)
    ((pairL K).flip v ∘ₗ d K - (pairL K).flip (δ K v)) (fun y hy => by
      simp only [LinearMap.sub_apply, LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearMap.flip_apply,
        Submodule.mem_bot]
      rw [hsingle y hy, sub_self]) hw
  simpa [sub_eq_zero] using this

name: Operad.ShuffleBar.δ_δ
statement:
theorem δ_δ {v : BarTree E →₀ K} (hv : v ∈ Finsupp.supported K K {x | Valid x}) :
    δ K (δ K v) = 0
proof:
:= by
  ext y
  by_cases hy : Valid y
  · have hy1 : Finsupp.single y (1 : K) ∈ Finsupp.supported K K {x | Valid x} :=
      Finsupp.single_mem_supported K _ hy
    have h1 := pairL_d_δ (δ_mem_valid hv) hy1
    have h2 := pairL_d_δ hv (d_mem_valid hy1)
    rw [d_single, one_smul] at h1 h2
    rw [d_dTree K y hy.nodup, map_zero, LinearMap.zero_apply] at h2
    rw [Finsupp.zero_apply, ← one_mul (δ K (δ K v) y), ← pairL_single, ← h1, ← h2]
  · rw [Finsupp.zero_apply]
    by_contra h
    exact hy (valid_of_supported (δ_mem_valid (δ_mem_valid hv)) h)

name: Operad.ShuffleBar.δ_mem_C
statement: lemma δ_mem_C {n s : ℕ} {v : BarTree E →₀ K} (hv : v ∈ C K n s) : δ K v ∈ C K n (s + 1)
proof:
:= by
  refine map_mem_of_supported K (δ K) (fun y hy => ?_) hv
  rw [δ_single, one_smul, δTree]
  refine Submodule.sum_mem _ fun k hk => Submodule.smul_mem _ _
    (Finsupp.single_mem_supported K _ ?_)
  obtain ⟨hkE, hkc⟩ := Finset.mem_sdiff.1 hk
  refine ⟨⟨(isShuffle_cutK _ _).2 hy.1.shuffle, by simpa using hy.1.nodup,
    (rootFlag_cutK _ _).trans hy.1.root⟩, by simpa using hy.2.1, ?_⟩
  rw [cutKeys_cutK hy.1.nodup hkE, Finset.card_insert_of_notMem hkc, hy.2.2]

name: Operad.ShuffleBar.exists_comp_eq_of_ker_le
statement:
lemma exists_comp_eq_of_ker_le {V W : Type*} [AddCommGroup V] [Module K V] [AddCommGroup W]
    [Module K W] (θ : V →ₗ[K] W) (ψ : V →ₗ[K] K) (h : LinearMap.ker θ ≤ LinearMap.ker ψ) :
    ∃ φ : W →ₗ[K] K, ∀ x, φ (θ x) = ψ x
proof:
:= by
  let φ₀ : LinearMap.range θ →ₗ[K] K :=
    (LinearMap.ker θ).liftQ ψ h ∘ₗ θ.quotKerEquivRange.symm.toLinearMap
  obtain ⟨φ, hφ⟩ := LinearMap.exists_extend φ₀
  refine ⟨φ, fun x => ?_⟩
  have := LinearMap.congr_fun hφ ⟨θ x, LinearMap.mem_range_self θ x⟩
  rw [LinearMap.comp_apply, Submodule.coe_subtype] at this
  rw [this]
  simp [φ₀]

name: Operad.ShuffleBar.exists_form_of_ker
statement:
lemma exists_form_of_ker {M : Type*} [AddCommGroup M] [Module K M] (B Q : Submodule K M)
    (f : M →ₗ[K] M) (g : M →ₗ[K] K) (h : ∀ x ∈ B, ∀ j ∈ Q, f x + j = 0 → g x = 0) :
    ∃ φ : M →ₗ[K] K, (∀ x ∈ B, φ (f x) = g x) ∧ ∀ j ∈ Q, φ j = 0
proof:
:= by
  let θ : (B × Q) →ₗ[K] M :=
    f ∘ₗ B.subtype ∘ₗ LinearMap.fst K B Q + Q.subtype ∘ₗ LinearMap.snd K B Q
  let ψ : (B × Q) →ₗ[K] K := g ∘ₗ B.subtype ∘ₗ LinearMap.fst K B Q
  have hker : LinearMap.ker θ ≤ LinearMap.ker ψ := by
    rintro ⟨x, j⟩ hxj
    exact h x x.2 j j.2 hxj
  obtain ⟨φ, hφ⟩ := exists_comp_eq_of_ker_le θ ψ hker
  refine ⟨φ, fun x hx => ?_, fun j hj => ?_⟩
  · simpa [θ, ψ] using hφ (⟨x, hx⟩, 0)
  · simpa [θ, ψ] using hφ (0, ⟨j, hj⟩)

name: Operad.ShuffleBar.δ_mem_cobarOf
statement:
theorem δ_mem_cobarOf {n s : ℕ} {v : BarTree E →₀ K} (hv : v ∈ CobarOf K R' n s) :
    δ K v ∈ CobarOf K R' n (s + 1)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨δ_mem_C hv.1, fun j hj => ?_⟩
  rw [← pairL_d_δ (C_valid hv.1) (C_valid hj.2)]
  exact hv.2 _ ⟨d_mem_J K R' hj.1, d_mem_C K hj.2⟩

name: Operad.ShuffleBar.exists_δ_eq
statement:
theorem exists_δ_eq {n s : ℕ} {v : BarTree E →₀ K} (hvC : v ∈ C K n (s + 1))
    (hv : ∀ x ∈ C K n (s + 1), d K x ∈ J K R' → pairL K x v = 0) :
    ∃ u ∈ CobarOf K R' n s, δ K u = v
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨φ, hφd, hφJ⟩ := exists_form_of_ker (C (E := E) K n (s + 1)) (J K R' ⊓ C K n s) (d K)
    ((pairL K).flip v) fun x hx j hj hxj => by
      rw [LinearMap.flip_apply]
      refine hv x hx ?_
      rw [eq_neg_of_add_eq_zero_left hxj]
      exact neg_mem hj.1
  set T := (barTrees (E := E) n).filter fun z => Adm n s z with hT
  set u : BarTree E →₀ K := ∑ z ∈ T, φ (Finsupp.single z 1) • Finsupp.single z 1 with hu
  have huA : u ∈ C K n s := Submodule.sum_mem _ fun z hz =>
    Submodule.smul_mem _ _ (Finsupp.single_mem_supported K _ (Finset.mem_filter.1 hz).2)
  
  have hpair : ∀ c ∈ C K n s, pairL K c u = φ c := fun c hc => by
    have := map_mem_of_supported K (P := ⊥) ((pairL K).flip u - φ) (fun z hz => by
      have hzT : z ∈ T := Finset.mem_filter.2 ⟨mem_barTrees hz, hz⟩
      simp only [LinearMap.sub_apply, LinearMap.flip_apply, pairL_single, one_mul,
        Submodule.mem_bot, hu, Finsupp.finsetSum_apply, Finsupp.smul_apply,
        Finsupp.single_apply, smul_eq_mul, mul_ite, mul_one, mul_zero]
      rw [Finset.sum_ite_eq' T z, if_pos hzT, sub_self]) hc
    simpa [sub_eq_zero] using this
  refine ⟨u, ⟨huA, fun j hj => ?_⟩, ?_⟩
  · rw [hpair j hj.2, hφJ j hj]
  · ext x
    by_cases hx : Adm n (s + 1) x
    · have hx1 : Finsupp.single x (1 : K) ∈ C K n (s + 1) := Finsupp.single_mem_supported K _ hx
      have h1 := pairL_d_δ (C_valid huA) (C_valid hx1)
      rw [pairL_single, one_mul] at h1
      rw [← h1, hpair _ (d_mem_C K hx1), hφd _ hx1, LinearMap.flip_apply, pairL_single, one_mul]
    · have h1 : δ K u x = 0 := by
        by_contra h
        exact hx ((Finsupp.mem_supported K _).1 (δ_mem_C huA) (Finsupp.mem_support_iff.2 h))
      have h2 : v x = 0 := by
        by_contra h
        exact hx ((Finsupp.mem_supported K _).1 hvC (Finsupp.mem_support_iff.2 h))
      rw [h1, h2]

name: Operad.ShuffleBar.exact_cobarOf
statement:
theorem exact_cobarOf (hK : IsKoszul K R') {n s : ℕ} (hs : s + 2 < n) {v : BarTree E →₀ K}
    (hv : v ∈ CobarOf K R' n (s + 1)) (hδ : δ K v = 0) : ∃ u ∈ CobarOf K R' n s, δ K u = v
proof:
:= by
  refine exists_δ_eq hv.1 fun x hx hdx => ?_
  obtain ⟨y, hy, hxy⟩ := hK n (s + 1) (by omega) x hx hdx
  have h1 : pairL K (d K y) v = 0 := by
    rw [pairL_d_δ (C_valid hv.1) (C_valid hy), hδ, map_zero]
  have h2 : pairL K (x - d K y) v = 0 :=
    hv.2 _ ⟨hxy, Submodule.sub_mem _ hx (d_mem_C K hy)⟩
  rw [map_sub, LinearMap.sub_apply, h1, sub_zero] at h2
  exact h2

name: Operad.ShuffleBar.pairL_ofMono
statement:
lemma pairL_ofMono {n : ℕ} (x : BarTree E →₀ K) (f : Mono E n → K) :
    pairL K x (ofMono K n f) = ∑ m, toMono K n x m * f m
proof:
:= by
  show pairL K x (∑ m, ((tauS m.1 : K) * f m) • Finsupp.single (fullBar m.1) 1) = _
  rw [map_sum]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun m _ => ?_
  rw [map_smul, pairL_single_right, smul_eq_mul]
  show (tauS m.1 : K) * f m * (x (fullBar m.1) * 1) = (tauS m.1 : K) * x (fullBar m.1) * f m
  ring

name: Operad.ShuffleBar.exists_δ_eq_top_iff
statement:
theorem exists_δ_eq_top_iff {n : ℕ} (hn : 2 ≤ n) {c : BarTree E →₀ K} (hc : c ∈ C K n (n - 1)) :
    (∃ u ∈ CobarOf K R' n (n - 2), δ K u = c) ↔ ∀ x ∈ KD K R' n, pairL K x c = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hn1 : n - 2 + 1 = n - 1 := by omega
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨u, hu, rfl⟩ x hx
    rw [← pairL_d_δ (C_valid hu.1) (C_valid hx.1)]
    exact hu.2 _ ⟨hx.2, d_mem_C K (by rw [hn1]; exact hx.1)⟩
  · intro h
    exact exists_δ_eq (by rw [hn1]; exact hc) fun x hx hdx => h x ⟨by rw [← hn1]; exact hx, hdx⟩

name: Operad.ShuffleBar.map_δ_cobar_top
statement:
theorem map_δ_cobar_top (R : Submodule K (Mono E 3 → K)) {n : ℕ} (hn : 2 ≤ n) :
    (Cobar K R n (n - 2)).map (toMono K n ∘ₗ δ K) = idealOf K R n
proof:
:= by
  have hn1 : n - 2 + 1 = n - 1 := by omega
  rw [← dualRel_dualRel R, idealOf_dualRel_eq_orthogonal, dualRel_dualRel]
  ext f
  rw [Submodule.mem_map, LinearMap.BilinForm.mem_orthogonal_iff]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨u, hu, rfl⟩ g hg
    rw [KDmono_eq_map _ hn] at hg
    obtain ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩ := hg
    have hδ : δ K u ∈ C K n (n - 1) := by rw [← hn1]; exact δ_mem_C hu.1
    show diagForm _ _ _ = 0
    rw [diagForm_apply]
    simp only [one_mul, LinearMap.comp_apply]
    rw [← pairL_ofMono, ofMono_toMono hδ]
    exact (exists_δ_eq_top_iff hn hδ).1 ⟨u, hu, rfl⟩ x hx
  · intro h
    obtain ⟨u, hu, hδu⟩ := (exists_δ_eq_top_iff (R' := dualRel K R) hn (ofMono_mem_C hn f)).2
      fun x hx => by
        rw [pairL_ofMono]
        have := h (toMono K n x) (by rw [KDmono_eq_map _ hn]; exact ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩)
        rw [LinearMap.BilinForm.IsOrtho, diagForm_apply] at this
        simpa only [one_mul] using this
    exact ⟨u, hu, by rw [LinearMap.comp_apply, hδu, toMono_ofMono]⟩

name: Operad.ShuffleBar.exact_cobar
statement:
theorem exact_cobar (hG : IsGroebner K rk L R) {n s : ℕ} (hs : s + 2 < n) {v : BarTree E →₀ K}
    (hv : v ∈ Cobar K R n (s + 1)) (hδ : δ K v = 0) : ∃ u ∈ Cobar K R n s, δ K u = v
proof:
:=
  exact_cobarOf (isKoszul_dualRel hG) hs hv hδ

name: Operad.ShuffleBar.cobar_top_eq
statement:
theorem cobar_top_eq (hG : IsGroebner K rk L R) (n : ℕ) :
    Cobar K R n (n - 1) = C K n (n - 1)
proof:
:= by
  refine le_antisymm (fun v hv => hv.1) fun v hv => ⟨hv, fun j hj => ?_⟩
  have hjN : j ∈ Finsupp.supported K K (Nrm {w | w ∉ L} n (n - 1)) :=
    Finsupp.supported_mono (fun x (hx : Adm n (n - 1) x) =>
      (⟨hx, adm_top_normal _ hx⟩ : x ∈ Nrm {w | w ∉ L} n (n - 1))) hj.2
  have hj0 : j = 0 := by
    rw [← ΦL_normal K (dualData hG) hjN, ΦL_J K (dualData hG) hj.1]
  rw [hj0, map_zero, LinearMap.zero_apply]

name: Operad.ShuffleBar.cobar_resolution
statement:
theorem cobar_resolution (hG : IsGroebner K rk L R) {n : ℕ} (hn : 2 ≤ n) :
    (∀ s, s + 2 < n → ∀ v ∈ Cobar K R n (s + 1), δ K v = 0 → ∃ u ∈ Cobar K R n s, δ K u = v) ∧
      Cobar K R n (n - 1) = C K n (n - 1) ∧
      (Cobar K R n (n - 2)).map (toMono K n ∘ₗ δ K) = idealOf K R n
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun _ hs _ hv hδ => exact_cobar hG hs hv hδ, cobar_top_eq hG n, map_δ_cobar_top R hn⟩

name: Operad.Sym.LinOrd.pairwise_toList
statement: lemma pairwise_toList (ℓ : LinOrd A) : ℓ.toList.Pairwise ℓ.lt
proof:
:= by
  rw [toList, List.pairwise_ofFn]
  intro i j hij
  rw [ℓ.lt_iff_rank_lt, ← toRank_apply, ← toRank_apply, Equiv.apply_symm_apply,
    Equiv.apply_symm_apply]
  exact hij

name: Operad.Sym.LinOrd.mem_toList
statement: lemma mem_toList (ℓ : LinOrd A) (a : A) : a ∈ ℓ.toList
proof:
:= by
  rw [toList, List.mem_ofFn]
  exact ⟨ℓ.toRank a, Equiv.symm_apply_apply _ _⟩

name: Operad.Sym.LinOrd.nodup_of_pairwise
statement: lemma nodup_of_pairwise (ℓ : LinOrd A) {l : List A} (hl : l.Pairwise ℓ.lt) : l.Nodup
proof:
:= by
  refine hl.imp fun {a b} h => ?_
  rintro rfl
  exact ℓ.irrefl a h

name: Operad.Sym.LinOrd.eq_toList
statement:
lemma eq_toList (ℓ : LinOrd A) {l : List A} (hl : l.Pairwise ℓ.lt) (hm : ∀ a, a ∈ l) :
    l = ℓ.toList
proof:
:=
  List.Perm.eq_of_pairwise (fun a _ _ _ h h' => absurd (ℓ.trans _ _ _ h h') (ℓ.irrefl a)) hl
    ℓ.pairwise_toList ((List.perm_ext_iff_of_nodup (ℓ.nodup_of_pairwise hl)
      (ℓ.nodup_of_pairwise ℓ.pairwise_toList)).2 fun a => ⟨fun _ => ℓ.mem_toList a, fun _ => hm a⟩)

name: Operad.Sym.LinOrd.toList_map
statement: lemma toList_map (e : A ≃ B) (ℓ : LinOrd A) : (map e ℓ).toList = ℓ.toList.map e
proof:
:= by
  refine (eq_toList _ ?_ fun b => ?_).symm
  · rw [List.pairwise_map]
    refine ℓ.pairwise_toList.imp fun {a a'} h => ?_
    show ℓ.lt (e.symm (e a)) (e.symm (e a'))
    rwa [e.symm_apply_apply, e.symm_apply_apply]
  · exact List.mem_map.2 ⟨e.symm b, ℓ.mem_toList _, e.apply_symm_apply b⟩

name: Operad.Sym.LinOrd.toList_one
statement: lemma toList_one : (LinOrd.one : LinOrd Unit).toList = [()]
proof:
:=
  (eq_toList _ (List.pairwise_singleton _ _) fun u => by
    cases u
    exact List.mem_singleton_self _).symm

name: Operad.Sym.LinOrd.toList_eq_nil
statement: lemma toList_eq_nil [IsEmpty A] (ℓ : LinOrd A) : ℓ.toList = []
proof:
:=
  (eq_toList _ List.Pairwise.nil fun a => isEmptyElim a).symm

name: Operad.Sym.LinOrd.toList_std
statement: lemma toList_std (n : ℕ) : (std n).toList = List.finRange n
proof:
:=
  (eq_toList _ (List.pairwise_lt_finRange n) fun k => List.mem_finRange k).symm

name: Operad.Sym.LinOrd.toList_comp
statement:
lemma toList_comp (i : A) (ℓ : LinOrd A) (ℓ' : LinOrd B) :
    (comp i ℓ ℓ').toList = insList i ℓ.toList ℓ'.toList
proof:
:= by
  refine (eq_toList _ ?_ fun u => ?_).symm
  · rw [insList, List.pairwise_flatMap]
    refine ⟨fun a _ => ?_, ℓ.pairwise_toList.imp fun {a a'} h => ?_⟩
    · split_ifs with ha
      · rw [List.pairwise_map]
        exact ℓ'.pairwise_toList.imp fun h => h
      · exact List.pairwise_singleton _ _
    · intro x hx y hy
      by_cases ha : a = i <;> by_cases ha' : a' = i
      · subst ha
        subst ha'
        exact absurd h (ℓ.irrefl _)
      · rw [dif_pos ha] at hx
        rw [dif_neg ha', List.mem_singleton] at hy
        obtain ⟨b, -, rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.1 hx
        subst hy
        subst ha
        exact h
      · rw [dif_neg ha, List.mem_singleton] at hx
        rw [dif_pos ha'] at hy
        obtain ⟨b, -, rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.1 hy
        subst hx
        subst ha'
        exact h
      · rw [dif_neg ha, List.mem_singleton] at hx
        rw [dif_neg ha', List.mem_singleton] at hy
        subst hx
        subst hy
        exact h
  · rcases u with a | b
    · refine List.mem_flatMap.2 ⟨a.1, ℓ.mem_toList _, ?_⟩
      rw [dif_neg a.2]
      exact List.mem_singleton_self _
    · refine List.mem_flatMap.2 ⟨i, ℓ.mem_toList _, ?_⟩
      rw [dif_pos rfl]
      exact List.mem_map_of_mem (ℓ'.mem_toList b)

name: Operad.Sym.LinOrd.oprod_map
statement:
lemma oprod_map {B : Type} [Fintype B] (e : A ≃ B) (ℓ : LinOrd A) (s : B → M) :
    oprod (map e ℓ) s = oprod ℓ fun a => s (e a)
proof:
:= by
  rw [oprod, oprod, toList_map, List.map_map]
  rfl

name: Operad.Sym.LinOrd.oprod_comp
statement:
lemma oprod_comp (i : A) (ℓ : LinOrd A) (ℓ' : LinOrd B) (s : Without A i ⊕ B → M) :
    oprod (comp i ℓ ℓ') s = oprod ℓ (feed i s (oprod ℓ' fun b => s (Sum.inr b)))
proof:
:= by
  rw [oprod, oprod, toList_comp, insList, List.map_flatMap, List.flatMap_def, List.prod_flatten,
    List.map_map]
  congr 1
  refine List.map_congr_left fun a _ => ?_
  rw [Function.comp_apply]
  by_cases ha : a = i
  · subst ha
    rw [dif_pos rfl, feed_self, List.map_map]
    rfl
  · rw [dif_neg ha, feed_of_ne ha, List.map_singleton, List.prod_singleton]

name: Operad.Sym.LinOrd.oprod_one
statement: lemma oprod_one (s : Unit → M) : oprod LinOrd.one s = s ()
proof:
:= by
  rw [oprod, toList_one, List.map_singleton, List.prod_singleton]

name: Operad.Sym.LinOrd.eq_map_split
statement:
lemma eq_map_split (ℓ : LinOrd A) {a₀ : A} (h : ∀ b, b ≠ a₀ → ℓ.lt a₀ b) :
    ℓ = map (ComAlg.splitEquiv a₀) (comp 1 (std 2) (ℓ.restrict a₀))
proof:
:= by
  refine LinOrd.ext fun b b' => ?_
  have hsymm : ∀ c : A, (ComAlg.splitEquiv a₀).symm c =
      if hc : c = a₀ then Sum.inl ⟨0, by decide⟩ else Sum.inr ⟨c, hc⟩ := fun _ => rfl
  rw [map_lt, hsymm, hsymm, comp_lt]
  by_cases hb : b = a₀ <;> by_cases hb' : b' = a₀
  · rw [dif_pos hb, dif_pos hb', hb, hb']
    exact ⟨fun h' => absurd h' (ℓ.irrefl _), fun h' => absurd h' (lt_irrefl _)⟩
  · rw [dif_pos hb, dif_neg hb', hb]
    exact ⟨fun _ => (by decide : (0 : Fin 2) < 1), fun _ => h b' hb'⟩
  · rw [dif_neg hb, dif_pos hb', hb']
    exact ⟨fun h' => absurd (ℓ.trans _ _ _ h' (h b hb)) (ℓ.irrefl _),
      fun h' => absurd h' (by decide : ¬ ((1 : Fin 2) < 0))⟩
  · rw [dif_neg hb, dif_neg hb']
    rfl

name: Operad.Sym.LinOrd.toList_split
statement:
lemma toList_split (ℓ : LinOrd A) {a₀ : A} (h : ∀ b, b ≠ a₀ → ℓ.lt a₀ b) :
    ℓ.toList = a₀ :: (ℓ.restrict a₀).toList.map Subtype.val
proof:
:= by
  conv_lhs => rw [ℓ.eq_map_split h]
  rw [toList_map, toList_comp, toList_std,
    show List.finRange 2 = [0, 1] by decide, insList, List.flatMap_cons, List.flatMap_cons,
    List.flatMap_nil, dif_neg (by decide), dif_pos rfl, List.append_nil, List.map_append,
    List.map_map]
  rfl

name: Operad.Sym.LinOrd.least_lt
statement:
lemma least_lt (ℓ : LinOrd A) (h : 0 < Fintype.card A) :
    ∀ b, b ≠ ℓ.least h → ℓ.lt (ℓ.least h) b
proof:
:= fun b hb => by
  rw [ℓ.lt_iff_rank_lt, ← toRank_apply, ← toRank_apply, least, Equiv.apply_symm_apply]
  refine Nat.pos_of_ne_zero fun h0 => hb ?_
  apply ℓ.toRank.injective
  rw [least, Equiv.apply_symm_apply]
  exact Fin.ext h0

name: Operad.Sym.AssAlg.oact_map
statement:
lemma oact_map {A B : Type} [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] [Fintype B] [DecidableEq B] (e : A ≃ B)
    (ℓ : LinOrd A) (s : B → V) : oact α (LinOrd.map e ℓ) s = oact α ℓ fun a => s (e a)
proof:
:= by
  rw [oact, oact, ← SymAlgebra.act_map]
  congr 1
  exact (Lin.mapL_single (R := R) (S := fun A _ _ => LinOrd A) e ℓ 1).symm

name: Operad.Sym.AssAlg.oact_comp
statement:
lemma oact_comp {A B : Type} [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] [Fintype B] [DecidableEq B] (i : A)
    (ℓ : LinOrd A) (ℓ' : LinOrd B) (s : Without A i ⊕ B → V) :
    oact α (LinOrd.comp i ℓ ℓ') s = oact α ℓ (feed i s (oact α ℓ' fun b => s (Sum.inr b)))
proof:
:= by
  rw [oact, oact, oact, ← SymAlgebra.act_comp]
  congr 1
  show Finsupp.single (LinOrd.comp i ℓ ℓ') (1 : R) =
    Lin.compL R (S := fun A _ _ => LinOrd A) i (Finsupp.single ℓ (1 : R))
      (Finsupp.single ℓ' (1 : R))
  rw [Lin.compL_single, mul_one]
  rfl

name: Operad.Sym.AssAlg.oact_one
statement: lemma oact_one (s : Unit → V) : oact α LinOrd.one s = s ()
proof:
:=
  SymAlgebra.act_one α s

name: Operad.Sym.AssAlg.oact_unique
statement:
lemma oact_unique {A : Type} [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] (a₀ : A) (h : ∀ a, a = a₀)
    (ℓ : LinOrd A) (s : A → V) : oact α ℓ s = s a₀
proof:
:= by
  let e : Unit ≃ A := ⟨fun _ => a₀, fun _ => (), fun _ => rfl, fun a => (h a).symm⟩
  haveI : Subsingleton A := ⟨fun a b => (h a).trans (h b).symm⟩
  rw [LinOrd.eq_of_subsingleton ℓ (LinOrd.map e LinOrd.one), oact_map, oact_one]
  rfl

name: Operad.Sym.AssAlg.oact_empty
statement:
lemma oact_empty {A : Type} [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] [IsEmpty A] (ℓ : LinOrd A)
    (s : A → V) : oact α ℓ s = one α
proof:
:= by
  let e : Fin 0 ≃ A := Equiv.equivOfIsEmpty _ _
  haveI : Subsingleton A := ⟨fun a => isEmptyElim a⟩
  rw [LinOrd.eq_of_subsingleton ℓ (LinOrd.map e (LinOrd.std 0)), oact_map, one]
  congr 1
  funext k
  exact k.elim0

name: Operad.Sym.AssAlg.oact_eq_foldr
statement:
theorem oact_eq_foldr : ∀ (n : ℕ) {A : Type} [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A],
    Fintype.card A = n → ∀ (ℓ : LinOrd A) (s : A → V),
      oact α ℓ s = (ℓ.toList.map s).foldr (mul α) (one α)
  | 0, A, _, _, hA, ℓ, s => by
    haveI : IsEmpty A
proof:
:= Fintype.card_eq_zero_iff.1 hA
    rw [toList_eq_nil, List.map_nil, List.foldr_nil, oact_empty]
  | n + 1, A, _, _, hA, ℓ, s => by
    have hpos : 0 < Fintype.card A := by omega
    have hmin := ℓ.least_lt hpos
    have hcard : Fintype.card (Without A (ℓ.least hpos)) = n := by
      rw [Fintype.card_subtype_compl, Fintype.card_subtype_eq, hA]
      rfl
    rw [ℓ.toList_split hmin, List.map_cons, List.foldr_cons, List.map_map,
      ← oact_eq_foldr n hcard (ℓ.restrict (ℓ.least hpos))]
    conv_lhs => rw [ℓ.eq_map_split hmin]
    rw [oact_map, oact_comp, mul]
    congr 1
    funext k
    fin_cases k
    · rfl
    · rfl

name: Operad.Sym.AssAlg.one_mul'
statement: lemma one_mul' (x : V) : mul α (one α) x = x
proof:
:= by
  have h := oact_comp α (B := Fin 0) (0 : Fin 2) (LinOrd.std 2) (LinOrd.std 0) fun _ => x
  have hu : ∀ c : Without (Fin 2) 0 ⊕ Fin 0, c = Sum.inl ⟨1, by decide⟩ := by decide
  rw [oact_unique α _ hu] at h
  refine Eq.trans ?_ h.symm
  rw [mul]
  congr 1
  funext k
  fin_cases k
  · exact (oact_empty α _ _).symm
  · rfl

name: Operad.Sym.AssAlg.mul_one'
statement: lemma mul_one' (x : V) : mul α x (one α) = x
proof:
:= by
  have h := oact_comp α (B := Fin 0) (1 : Fin 2) (LinOrd.std 2) (LinOrd.std 0) fun _ => x
  have hu : ∀ c : Without (Fin 2) 1 ⊕ Fin 0, c = Sum.inl ⟨0, by decide⟩ := by decide
  rw [oact_unique α _ hu] at h
  refine Eq.trans ?_ h.symm
  rw [mul]
  congr 1
  funext k
  fin_cases k
  · rfl
  · exact (oact_empty α _ _).symm

name: Operad.Sym.AssAlg.mul_assoc'
statement: lemma mul_assoc' (x y z : V) : mul α (mul α x y) z = mul α x (mul α y z)
proof:
:= by
  set v₀ : Without (Fin 2) 0 ⊕ Fin 2 → V := Sum.elim (fun _ => z) ![x, y] with hv₀
  set v₁ : Without (Fin 2) 1 ⊕ Fin 2 → V := Sum.elim (fun _ => x) ![y, z] with hv₁
  have h₀ := oact_comp α (0 : Fin 2) (LinOrd.std 2) (LinOrd.std 2) v₀
  have h₁ := oact_comp α (1 : Fin 2) (LinOrd.std 2) (LinOrd.std 2) v₁
  rw [oact_eq_foldr α _ rfl, toList_comp, toList_std, show List.finRange 2 = [0, 1] by decide]
    at h₀ h₁
  have e₀ : mul α (mul α x y) z = oact α (LinOrd.std 2) (feed 0 v₀
      (oact α (LinOrd.std 2) fun b => v₀ (Sum.inr b))) := by
    rw [mul, mul]
    congr 1
    funext k
    fin_cases k
    · rfl
    · rfl
  have e₁ : mul α x (mul α y z) = oact α (LinOrd.std 2) (feed 1 v₁
      (oact α (LinOrd.std 2) fun b => v₁ (Sum.inr b))) := by
    rw [mul, mul]
    congr 1
    funext k
    fin_cases k
    · rfl
    · rfl
  rw [e₀, e₁, ← h₀, ← h₁]
  rfl

name: Operad.Sym.AssAlg.mul_add'
statement: lemma mul_add' (x y z : V) : mul α x (y + z) = mul α x y + mul α x z
proof:
:= by
  unfold mul oact SymAlgebra.act
  have h := (α.app (Fin 2) (Finsupp.single (LinOrd.std 2) 1)).map_update_add ![x, y] 1 y z
  simp only [show ∀ t : V, Function.update ![x, y] 1 t = ![x, t] from fun t => by
    funext k
    fin_cases k <;> rfl] at h
  exact h

name: Operad.Sym.AssAlg.add_mul'
statement: lemma add_mul' (x y z : V) : mul α (x + y) z = mul α x z + mul α y z
proof:
:= by
  unfold mul oact SymAlgebra.act
  have h := (α.app (Fin 2) (Finsupp.single (LinOrd.std 2) 1)).map_update_add ![x, z] 0 x y
  simp only [show ∀ t : V, Function.update ![x, z] 0 t = ![t, z] from fun t => by
    funext k
    fin_cases k <;> rfl] at h
  exact h

name: Operad.Sym.AssAlg.mul_smul'
statement: lemma mul_smul' (c : R) (x y : V) : mul α x (c • y) = c • mul α x y
proof:
:= by
  unfold mul oact SymAlgebra.act
  have h := (α.app (Fin 2) (Finsupp.single (LinOrd.std 2) 1)).map_update_smul ![x, y] 1 c y
  simp only [show ∀ t : V, Function.update ![x, y] 1 t = ![x, t] from fun t => by
    funext k
    fin_cases k <;> rfl] at h
  exact h

name: Operad.Sym.AssAlg.smul_mul'
statement: lemma smul_mul' (c : R) (x y : V) : mul α (c • x) y = c • mul α x y
proof:
:= by
  unfold mul oact SymAlgebra.act
  have h := (α.app (Fin 2) (Finsupp.single (LinOrd.std 2) 1)).map_update_smul ![x, y] 0 c x
  simp only [show ∀ t : V, Function.update ![x, y] 0 t = ![t, y] from fun t => by
    funext k
    fin_cases k <;> rfl] at h
  exact h

name: Operad.Sym.AssAlg.act_eq
statement:
theorem act_eq {A : Type} [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] (ℓ : LinOrd A) (s : A → V) :
    letI
proof:
:= toRing α
    α.act (Finsupp.single ℓ 1) s = ℓ.oprod s := by
  letI := toRing α
  rw [LinOrd.oprod, List.prod_eq_foldr]
  exact oact_eq_foldr α _ rfl ℓ s

name: Operad.Sym.AssAlg.ordML_apply
statement:
lemma ordML_apply {B : Type} [Fintype B] [DecidableEq B] (ℓ : LinOrd B) (s : B → A') :
    ordML (R := R) A' ℓ s = ℓ.oprod s
proof:
:= by
  rw [ordML, MultilinearMap.domDomCongr_apply, MultilinearMap.mkPiAlgebraFin_apply,
    LinOrd.oprod, LinOrd.toList, List.map_ofFn]
  rfl

name: Operad.Sym.AssAlg.ordML_comp
statement:
lemma ordML_comp {B C : Type} [Fintype B] [DecidableEq B] [Fintype C] [DecidableEq C] (i : B)
    (ℓ : LinOrd B) (ℓ' : LinOrd C) :
    ordML (R := R) A' (LinOrd.comp i ℓ ℓ') =
      EndOp.compL R A' i (ordML (R := R) A' ℓ) (ordML (R := R) A' ℓ')
proof:
:=
  MultilinearMap.ext fun s => by
    show ordML (R := R) A' (LinOrd.comp i ℓ ℓ') s =
      ordML (R := R) A' ℓ (feed i s (ordML (R := R) A' ℓ' fun b => s (Sum.inr b)))
    rw [ordML_apply, ordML_apply, ordML_apply, LinOrd.oprod_comp]

name: Operad.Sym.AssAlg.ofAlgebra_act
statement:
lemma ofAlgebra_act {B : Type} [Fintype B] [DecidableEq B] (ℓ : LinOrd B) (s : B → A') :
    (ofAlgebra R A').act (Finsupp.single ℓ 1) s = ℓ.oprod s
proof:
:= by
  show (Finsupp.linearCombination R fun ℓ : LinOrd B => ordML (R := R) A' ℓ)
    (Finsupp.single ℓ (1 : R)) s = _
  rw [Finsupp.linearCombination_single, one_smul, ordML_apply]

name: Operad.Sym.AssAlg.ofAlgebra_act_smul
statement:
lemma ofAlgebra_act_smul {B : Type} [Fintype B] [DecidableEq B] (ℓ : LinOrd B) (c : R)
    (s : B → A') : (ofAlgebra R A').act (Finsupp.single ℓ c) s = c • ℓ.oprod s
proof:
:= by
  show (Finsupp.linearCombination R fun ℓ : LinOrd B => ordML (R := R) A' ℓ)
    (Finsupp.single ℓ c) s = _
  rw [Finsupp.linearCombination_single, MultilinearMap.smul_apply, ordML_apply]

name: Operad.Sym.AssAlg.mul_ofAlgebra
statement: lemma mul_ofAlgebra (x y : A') : mul (ofAlgebra R A') x y = x * y
proof:
:= by
  rw [mul, oact, ofAlgebra_act, LinOrd.oprod, LinOrd.toList_std,
    show List.finRange 2 = [0, 1] by decide]
  simp

name: Operad.Sym.AssAlg.one_ofAlgebra
statement: lemma one_ofAlgebra : one (ofAlgebra R A') = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [one, oact, ofAlgebra_act, LinOrd.oprod, LinOrd.toList_std]
  rfl

name: Operad.Sym.AssAlg.ofAlgebra_toRing
statement: theorem ofAlgebra_toRing : toRing (ofAlgebra R A') = ‹Ring A'›
proof:
:= by
  refine Ring.ext rfl ?_
  funext x y
  exact mul_ofAlgebra (R := R) A' x y

name: Operad.Sym.AssAlg.toAlgebra_ofAlgebra
statement:
theorem toAlgebra_ofAlgebra :
    letI
proof:
:= toRing α
    letI := toAlgebra α
    ofAlgebra R V = α := by
  letI := toRing α
  letI := toAlgebra α
  refine SymOperadHom.ext fun B _ _ p => ?_
  induction p using Finsupp.induction_linear with
  | zero => rw [map_zero, map_zero]
  | add p q hp hq => rw [map_add, map_add, hp, hq]
  | single ℓ c =>
    refine MultilinearMap.ext fun s => ?_
    rw [show Finsupp.single ℓ c = c • Finsupp.single ℓ (1 : R) by
      rw [Finsupp.smul_single, smul_eq_mul, mul_one], map_smul, map_smul,
      MultilinearMap.smul_apply, MultilinearMap.smul_apply]
    exact congrArg (c • ·) ((ofAlgebra_act V ℓ s).trans (act_eq α ℓ s).symm)

name: Operad.Sym.AssAlg.map_oprod
statement:
lemma map_oprod (f : A' →ₐ[R] B') {C : Type} [Fintype C] (ℓ : LinOrd C) (s : C → A') :
    f (ℓ.oprod s) = ℓ.oprod fun c => f (s c)
proof:
:= by
  rw [LinOrd.oprod, LinOrd.oprod, map_list_prod, List.map_map]
  rfl

name: Operad.Schur.act_ass
statement:
lemma act_ass {A : Type} [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] (ℓ : LinOrd A) (c : R)
    (s : A → Schur R (Sym.Ass R) V) : act (Finsupp.single ℓ c) s = c • ℓ.oprod s
proof:
:= by
  rw [show Finsupp.single ℓ c = c • Finsupp.single ℓ (1 : R) by
    rw [Finsupp.smul_single, smul_eq_mul, mul_one], act_smul]
  exact congrArg (c • ·) (AssAlg.act_eq (algebra R (Sym.Ass R) V) ℓ s)

name: Operad.Schur.toTensorAlgebra_ι
statement: lemma toTensorAlgebra_ι (v : V) : toTensorAlgebra (ι R (Sym.Ass R) V v) = TensorAlgebra.ι R v
proof:
:=
  liftHom_ι _ _ v

name: Operad.Schur.lift_comp_toTensorAlgebra
statement:
theorem lift_comp_toTensorAlgebra :
    (TensorAlgebra.lift R (ι R (Sym.Ass R) V)).comp toTensorAlgebra = AlgHom.id R _
proof:
:= by
  have h := algHom_ext (F := assHom ((TensorAlgebra.lift R (ι R (Sym.Ass R) V)).comp
      toTensorAlgebra)) (G := assHom (AlgHom.id R _)) fun v => by
    show TensorAlgebra.lift R (ι R (Sym.Ass R) V) (toTensorAlgebra (ι R (Sym.Ass R) V v)) =
      ι R (Sym.Ass R) V v
    rw [toTensorAlgebra_ι, TensorAlgebra.lift_ι_apply]
  exact AlgHom.ext fun x => congrArg (fun F => F.toLinearMap x) h

name: Operad.Schur.toTensorAlgebra_comp_lift
statement:
theorem toTensorAlgebra_comp_lift :
    toTensorAlgebra.comp (TensorAlgebra.lift R (ι R (Sym.Ass R) V)) = AlgHom.id R _
proof:
:= by
  refine TensorAlgebra.hom_ext (LinearMap.ext fun v => ?_)
  show toTensorAlgebra (TensorAlgebra.lift R (ι R (Sym.Ass R) V) (TensorAlgebra.ι R v)) =
    TensorAlgebra.ι R v
  rw [TensorAlgebra.lift_ι_apply, toTensorAlgebra_ι]

name: Operad.Schur.tensorAlgebraEquiv_ι
statement:
lemma tensorAlgebraEquiv_ι (v : V) :
    tensorAlgebraEquiv (TensorAlgebra.ι R v) = ι R (Sym.Ass R) V v
proof:
:=
  TensorAlgebra.lift_ι_apply _ _

name: Operad.STree.weight_replace_add
statement:
theorem weight_replace_add : ∀ {t u : STree E} {p : List ℕ}, t.get? p = some u →
    ∀ v : STree E, (t.replace p v).weight + u.weight = t.weight + v.weight
  | t, u, [], h, v => by
    rw [get?_nil, Option.some_inj] at h
    subst h
    rw [replace_nil, add_comm]
  | leaf _, _, _ :: _, h, _ => by simp at h
  | @node _ k e c, u, i :: p, h, v => by
    obtain ⟨hi, h⟩
proof:
:= get?_node_cons_eq_some.1 h
    have key := weight_replace_add h v
    let c' : Fin k → STree E := fun j => if (j : ℕ) = i then (c j).replace p v else c j
    have h1 : ∀ j ∈ Finset.univ.erase (⟨i, hi⟩ : Fin k), (c' j).weight = (c j).weight :=
      fun j hj => by
        simp only [c']
        rw [if_neg fun h' => (Finset.mem_erase.1 hj).1 (Fin.ext h')]
    have h2 : c' ⟨i, hi⟩ = (c ⟨i, hi⟩).replace p v := if_pos rfl
    rw [replace_node_cons, weight_node, weight_node]
    change 1 + ∑ j, (c' j).weight + u.weight = 1 + ∑ j, (c j).weight + v.weight
    rw [← Finset.add_sum_erase _ _ (Finset.mem_univ (⟨i, hi⟩ : Fin k)),
      ← Finset.add_sum_erase _ _ (Finset.mem_univ (⟨i, hi⟩ : Fin k)), Finset.sum_congr rfl h1,
      h2]
    omega

name: Operad.STree.IsSCtx.weight_add
statement:
theorem IsSCtx.weight_add {A B : Finset ℕ} {f : SMono E A → SMono E B} (hf : IsSCtx f)
    (g g' : SMono E A) : (f g).1.weight + g'.1.weight = (f g').1.weight + g.1.weight
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨T, p, xs, hp, -, hf⟩ := hf
  obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ := Option.isSome_iff_exists.1 hp
  have e := fun h : SMono E A => weight_replace_add hw (h.1.subst xs)
  have e₁ := e g
  have e₂ := e g'
  rw [← hf, weight_subst, g.labels_eq] at e₁
  rw [← hf, weight_subst, g'.labels_eq] at e₂
  omega

name: Operad.STree.AdmOrder.byWeight_weight
statement:
lemma AdmOrder.byWeight_weight (O : AdmOrder E) {A : Finset ℕ} {x y : SMono E A}
    (h : O.byWeight.lt x y) : x.1.weight ≤ y.1.weight
proof:
:= by
  rcases h with h | ⟨h, -⟩
  · exact h.le
  · exact h.le

name: Operad.filter_mapDomain
statement:
lemma filter_mapDomain {X Y : Type*} (f : X → Y) (v : X →₀ K) (p : Y → Prop)
    [DecidablePred p] [DecidablePred (p ∘ f)] :
    (Finsupp.mapDomain f v).filter p = Finsupp.mapDomain f (v.filter (p ∘ f))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction v using Finsupp.induction_linear with
  | zero => rw [Finsupp.mapDomain_zero, Finsupp.filter_zero, Finsupp.filter_zero,
      Finsupp.mapDomain_zero]
  | add v w hv hw => rw [Finsupp.mapDomain_add, Finsupp.filter_add, hv, hw, Finsupp.filter_add,
      Finsupp.mapDomain_add]
  | single x c =>
    rw [Finsupp.mapDomain_single]
    by_cases h : p (f x)
    · rw [Finsupp.filter_single_of_pos p h,
        Finsupp.filter_single_of_pos (p ∘ f) h, Finsupp.mapDomain_single]
    · rw [Finsupp.filter_single_of_neg p h,
        Finsupp.filter_single_of_neg (p ∘ f) h, Finsupp.mapDomain_zero]

name: Operad.filter_congr_support
statement:
lemma filter_congr_support {X : Type*} {v : X →₀ K} {p q : X → Prop} [DecidablePred p]
    [DecidablePred q] (h : ∀ x ∈ v.support, p x ↔ q x) : v.filter p = v.filter q
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  rw [Finsupp.filter_apply, Finsupp.filter_apply]
  by_cases hx : x ∈ v.support
  · by_cases hp : p x
    · rw [if_pos hp, if_pos ((h x hx).1 hp)]
    · rw [if_neg hp, if_neg fun hq => hp ((h x hx).2 hq)]
  · rw [Finsupp.notMem_support_iff.1 hx, ite_self, ite_self]

name: Operad.filter_eq_zero_of
statement:
lemma filter_eq_zero_of {X : Type*} {v : X →₀ K} {p : X → Prop} [DecidablePred p]
    (h : ∀ x ∈ v.support, ¬ p x) : v.filter p = 0
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  rw [Finsupp.filter_apply, Finsupp.coe_zero, Pi.zero_apply]
  by_cases hx : x ∈ v.support
  · rw [if_neg (h x hx)]
  · rw [Finsupp.notMem_support_iff.1 hx, ite_self]

name: Operad.wpart_single_of_eq
statement:
lemma wpart_single_of_eq {n : ℕ} {m : SMono E A} (h : m.1.weight = n) (c : K) :
    wpart n (Finsupp.single m c) = Finsupp.single m c
proof:
:= by
  classical
  exact Finsupp.filter_single_of_pos _ h

name: Operad.wpart_single_of_ne
statement:
lemma wpart_single_of_ne {n : ℕ} {m : SMono E A} (h : m.1.weight ≠ n) (c : K) :
    wpart n (Finsupp.single m c) = 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  exact Finsupp.filter_single_of_neg _ h

name: Operad.wpart_mapDomain
statement:
lemma wpart_mapDomain {B : Finset ℕ} (n : ℕ) (f : SMono E B → SMono E A) (v : SMono E B →₀ K) :
    wpart n (Finsupp.mapDomain f v) =
      Finsupp.mapDomain f (v.filter fun m => (f m).1.weight = n)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  exact filter_mapDomain f v _

name: Operad.wpart_tail_eq
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [wpart_mapDomain]
  congr 1
  refine filter_congr_support fun m _ => ?_
  have e := IsSCtx.weight_add hf m (G.lead r)
  constructor <;> intro h' <;> omega

name: Operad.wpart_tail_lt
statement:
lemma wpart_tail_lt {r : ρ} {f : SMono E (G.src r) → SMono E A} (hf : IsSCtx f) {n : ℕ}
    (h : (f (G.lead r)).1.weight < n) : wpart n (Finsupp.mapDomain f (G.tail r)) = 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [wpart_mapDomain, filter_eq_zero_of fun m hm => ?_, Finsupp.mapDomain_zero]
  have e := IsSCtx.weight_add hf m (G.lead r)
  have := hwt r m hm
  omega

name: Operad.red_weight_le
statement:
lemma red_weight_le {X : SMono E A} {u : SMono E A →₀ K} (hu : u ∈ (G.rw A).red X) :
    u ∈ Finsupp.supported K K {Y | Y.1.weight ≤ X.1.weight}
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨r, f, hf, rfl, rfl⟩ := hu
  intro Y hY
  obtain ⟨m, hm, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.1 (Finsupp.mapDomain_support hY)
  have e := IsSCtx.weight_add hf m (G.lead r)
  have := hwt r m hm
  show (f m).1.weight ≤ (f (G.lead r)).1.weight
  omega

name: Operad.Rules.tail_weight_le
statement: lemma Rules.tail_weight_le : ∀ r, ∀ m ∈ (G.tail r).support, m.1.weight ≤ (G.lead r).1.weight
proof:
:=
  fun r m hm => hO (G.tail_lt r m hm)

name: Operad.Rules.top_resolvable
statement: theorem Rules.top_resolvable (hres : (G.rw A).Resolvable) : (G.top.rw A).Resolvable
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hwt := G.tail_weight_le hO
  refine Rules.resolvable_iff.2 fun r₁ r₂ B => ?_
  let B' : G.Amb A r₁ r₂ := ⟨B.f₁, B.f₂, B.ctx₁, B.ctx₂, B.eq⟩
  have hB' := Rules.resolvable_iff.1 hres r₁ r₂ B'
  set n := B.top.1.weight with hn
  have key : ∀ x ∈ (G.rw A).idealOn ((G.rw A).below B'.top),
      wpart n x ∈ (G.top.rw A).idealOn ((G.top.rw A).below B.top) := by
    intro x hx
    induction hx using Submodule.span_induction with
    | mem x hx =>
      obtain ⟨m, hm, u, ⟨r, g, hg, rfl, rfl⟩, rfl⟩ := hx
      have hle : (g (G.lead r)).1.weight ≤ n := hO hm
      rcases hle.lt_or_eq with hlt | heq
      · rw [map_sub, wpart_single_of_ne hlt.ne, wpart_tail_lt G hwt hg hlt, sub_zero]
        exact Submodule.zero_mem _
      · rw [map_sub, wpart_single_of_eq heq, wpart_tail_eq G hg heq]
        exact (G.top.rw A).sub_mem_idealOn hm ⟨r, g, hg, rfl, rfl⟩
    | zero => rw [map_zero]; exact Submodule.zero_mem _
    | add x y _ _ hx hy => rw [map_add]; exact Submodule.add_mem _ hx hy
    | smul a x _ hx => rw [map_smul]; exact Submodule.smul_mem _ _ hx
  have h := key _ hB'
  have h₁ : wpart n (Finsupp.mapDomain B'.f₁ (G.tail r₁)) =
      Finsupp.mapDomain B.f₁ (G.top.tail r₁) := wpart_tail_eq G B.ctx₁ rfl
  have h₂ : wpart n (Finsupp.mapDomain B'.f₂ (G.tail r₂)) =
      Finsupp.mapDomain B.f₂ (G.top.tail r₂) :=
    wpart_tail_eq G B.ctx₂ (by rw [hn]; exact congrArg (fun X => X.1.weight) B.eq.symm)
  rw [map_sub, h₁, h₂] at h
  exact h

name: Operad.Rules.wpart_nf
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hwt := G.tail_weight_le hO
  set S := G.rw A
  set S' := G.top.rw A
  have hS' : S'.Resolvable := G.top_resolvable hO hres
  have hlt : ∀ u ∈ Finsupp.supported K K {m : SMono E A | m.1.weight < n},
      wpart n (S.nf u) = 0 := fun u hu => by
    have hcl : ∀ X ∈ {m : SMono E A | m.1.weight < n}, ∀ w ∈ S.red X,
        w ∈ Finsupp.supported K K {m : SMono E A | m.1.weight < n} := fun X hX w hw => by
      have hsub : {Y : SMono E A | Y.1.weight ≤ X.1.weight} ⊆ {m | m.1.weight < n} :=
        fun Y hY => show Y.1.weight < n from lt_of_le_of_lt hY hX
      exact Finsupp.supported_mono hsub (red_weight_le G hwt hw)
    have h := S.nf_mem_of_closed hcl hu
    show (S.nf u).filter _ = 0
    exact filter_eq_zero_of fun Y hY => ((Finsupp.mem_supported K _).1 h hY).ne
  suffices hm : ∀ m : SMono E A, m.1.weight = n → wpart n (S.nfMono m) = S'.nfMono m by
    refine eq_of_supported (f := wpart n ∘ₗ S.nf) (g := S'.nf) (fun m hm' => ?_) hv
    rw [LinearMap.comp_apply, Rewriting.nf_single, Rewriting.nf_single, one_smul, one_smul]
    exact hm m hm'
  intro m
  induction m using (O.wf A).induction with
  | _ m ih =>
  intro hmn
  by_cases hred : (S.red m).Nonempty
  · obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := hred
    obtain ⟨r, f, hf, hfm, rfl⟩ := hu
    have hu' : Finsupp.mapDomain f (G.top.tail r) ∈ S'.red m := ⟨r, f, hf, hfm, rfl⟩
    rw [← (G.top_resolvable hO hres).nf_red m _ hu', ← hres.nf_red m _ ⟨r, f, hf, hfm, rfl⟩]
    have hsplit : G.tail r =
        (G.tail r).filter (fun m' => m'.1.weight = (G.lead r).1.weight) +
        (G.tail r).filter fun m' => ¬ m'.1.weight = (G.lead r).1.weight :=
      (Finsupp.filter_add_filter_not _ _).symm
    have hfL : (f (G.lead r)).1.weight = n := by rw [hfm]; exact hmn
    rw [hsplit, Finsupp.mapDomain_add, map_add, map_add, hlt (Finsupp.mapDomain f
      ((G.tail r).filter fun m' => ¬ m'.1.weight = (G.lead r).1.weight)) ?_, add_zero]
    · refine eq_of_supported (f := wpart n ∘ₗ S.nf) (g := S'.nf)
        (s := {Y | Y.1.weight = n ∧ O.lt Y m}) (fun Y hY => ?_) ?_
      · rw [LinearMap.comp_apply, Rewriting.nf_single, Rewriting.nf_single, one_smul, one_smul]
        exact ih Y hY.2 hY.1
      · intro Y hY
        obtain ⟨m', hm', rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.1 (Finsupp.mapDomain_support hY)
        have hm'' := hm'
        simp only [Finsupp.support_filter, Finset.mem_filter] at hm''
        have e := IsSCtx.weight_add hf m' (G.lead r)
        refine ⟨by omega, ?_⟩
        rw [← hfm]
        exact O.lt_ctx hf (G.tail_lt r m' hm''.1)
    · intro Y hY
      obtain ⟨m', hm', rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.1 (Finsupp.mapDomain_support hY)
      rw [Finsupp.support_filter, Finset.mem_filter] at hm'
      have e := IsSCtx.weight_add hf m' (G.lead r)
      have := hwt r m' hm'.1
      show (f m').1.weight < n
      omega
  · have hirr : m ∈ S.Irr := S.mem_irr_iff.2 hred
    have hirr' : m ∈ S'.Irr := by
      rw [G.top.mem_irr_iff]
      exact (G.mem_irr_iff.1 hirr : G.Normal m)
    rw [S.nfMono_of_irr hirr, S'.nfMono_of_irr hirr', wpart_single_of_eq hmn]

name: Operad.Rules.pbw
statement:
theorem Rules.pbw (hres : (G.rw A).Resolvable) {n : ℕ} {v : SMono E A →₀ K}
    (hv : v ∈ Finsupp.supported K K {m : SMono E A | m.1.weight = n}) :
    (∃ u ∈ Finsupp.supported K K {m : SMono E A | m.1.weight < n}, v - u ∈ (G.rw A).ideal) ↔
      v ∈ (G.top.rw A).ideal
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hwt := G.tail_weight_le hO
  have hS' := G.top_resolvable hO hres
  have hle : ∀ X ∈ {m : SMono E A | m.1.weight ≤ n}, ∀ w ∈ (G.rw A).red X,
      w ∈ Finsupp.supported K K {m : SMono E A | m.1.weight ≤ n} := fun X hX w hw => by
    have hsub : {Y : SMono E A | Y.1.weight ≤ X.1.weight} ⊆ {m | m.1.weight ≤ n} :=
      fun Y hY => show Y.1.weight ≤ n from le_trans hY hX
    exact Finsupp.supported_mono hsub (red_weight_le G hwt hw)
  have hlt : ∀ X ∈ {m : SMono E A | m.1.weight < n}, ∀ w ∈ (G.rw A).red X,
      w ∈ Finsupp.supported K K {m : SMono E A | m.1.weight < n} := fun X hX w hw => by
    have hsub : {Y : SMono E A | Y.1.weight ≤ X.1.weight} ⊆ {m | m.1.weight < n} :=
      fun Y hY => show Y.1.weight < n from lt_of_le_of_lt hY hX
    exact Finsupp.supported_mono hsub (red_weight_le G hwt hw)
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨u, hu, hvu⟩
    rw [← hS'.nf_eq_zero_iff, ← G.wpart_nf hO hres hv, (hres.nf_eq_nf_iff).2 hvu]
    have h := (G.rw A).nf_mem_of_closed hlt hu
    show ((G.rw A).nf u).filter _ = 0
    exact filter_eq_zero_of fun Y hY =>
      (show Y.1.weight < n from (Finsupp.mem_supported K _).1 h hY).ne
  · intro hv'
    refine ⟨(G.rw A).nf v, ?_, ?_⟩
    · have hsub : {m : SMono E A | m.1.weight = n} ⊆ {m | m.1.weight ≤ n} :=
        fun Y hY => show Y.1.weight ≤ n from (show Y.1.weight = n from hY).le
      have h1 := (G.rw A).nf_mem_of_closed hle (Finsupp.supported_mono hsub hv)
      have h2 : wpart n ((G.rw A).nf v) = 0 := by
        rw [G.wpart_nf hO hres hv]
        exact hS'.ideal_le_ker hv'
      intro Y hY
      have hY' : Y.1.weight ≤ n := (Finsupp.mem_supported K _).1 h1 hY
      show Y.1.weight < n
      rcases hY'.lt_or_eq with h | h
      · exact h
      · exfalso
        have : wpart n ((G.rw A).nf v) Y = ((G.rw A).nf v) Y := by
          show ((G.rw A).nf v).filter _ Y = _
          rw [Finsupp.filter_apply, if_pos h]
        rw [h2, Finsupp.coe_zero, Pi.zero_apply] at this
        exact (Finsupp.mem_support_iff.1 hY) this.symm
    · rw [← neg_sub]
      exact Submodule.neg_mem _ ((G.rw A).nf_sub_mem v)

name: Operad.Rules.toGr_surjective
statement: theorem Rules.toGr_surjective : Function.Surjective (G.toGr A n)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  intro x
  obtain ⟨⟨y, hy⟩, rfl⟩ := Submodule.Quotient.mk_surjective _ x
  obtain ⟨w, hw, rfl⟩ := hy
  have hwn : wpart n w ∈ Finsupp.supported K K {m : SMono E A | m.1.weight = n} := by
    intro Y hY
    rw [Finset.mem_coe] at hY
    have := Finsupp.support_filter (p := fun m : SMono E A => m.1.weight = n) w ▸ hY
    exact (Finset.mem_filter.1 this).2
  refine ⟨⟨wpart n w, hwn⟩, (Submodule.Quotient.eq _).2 ?_⟩
  rw [Submodule.mem_comap, Submodule.coe_subtype]
  refine ⟨wpart n w - w, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro Y hY
    have hle : Y.1.weight ≤ n := by
      by_contra h
      have h1 : (wpart n w - w) Y = 0 := by
        rw [Finsupp.sub_apply]
        show w.filter _ Y - w Y = 0
        rw [Finsupp.filter_apply, if_neg (by omega), Finsupp.notMem_support_iff.1
          fun h' => h ((Finsupp.mem_supported K w).1 hw h'), sub_zero]
      exact (Finsupp.mem_support_iff.1 hY) h1
    show Y.1.weight < n
    rcases hle.lt_or_eq with h | h
    · exact h
    · exfalso
      apply Finsupp.mem_support_iff.1 hY
      rw [Finsupp.sub_apply]
      show w.filter _ Y - w Y = 0
      rw [Finsupp.filter_apply, if_pos h, sub_self]
  · rw [LinearMap.map_sub]
    rfl

name: Operad.Rules.ker_toGr
statement:
theorem Rules.ker_toGr : LinearMap.ker (G.toGr A n) =
    (G.top.rw A).ideal.comap (Finsupp.supported K K {m : SMono E A | m.1.weight = n}).subtype
proof:
:= by
  ext ⟨v, hv⟩
  rw [LinearMap.mem_ker, Submodule.mem_comap, Submodule.coe_subtype]
  show Submodule.Quotient.mk _ = 0 ↔ v ∈ _
  rw [Submodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero, Submodule.mem_comap, Submodule.coe_subtype,
    ← G.pbw hO hres hv]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨u, hu, hu'⟩
    refine ⟨u, hu, ?_⟩
    have := (Submodule.Quotient.eq _).1 hu'
    rw [← neg_sub]
    exact Submodule.neg_mem _ this
  · rintro ⟨u, hu, hu'⟩
    refine ⟨u, hu, (Submodule.Quotient.eq _).2 ?_⟩
    rw [← neg_sub]
    exact Submodule.neg_mem _ hu'

name: Operad.Rules.top_isKoszul
statement:
theorem Rules.top_isKoszul (hquad : ∀ r, (G.lead r).1.weight = 2)
    (hO : ∀ {A : Finset ℕ} {x y : SMono E A}, O.lt x y → x.1.weight ≤ y.1.weight)
    (hres : ∀ C, (G.rw C).Resolvable) : G.top.IsKoszul
proof:
:= by
  classical
  refine G.top.isKoszul_of_resolvable hquad (fun r m hm => ?_)
    fun C => G.top_resolvable hO (hres C)
  simp only [Rules.top, Finsupp.support_filter] at hm
  have h2 := (Finset.mem_filter (s := (G.tail r).support)
    (p := fun x => x.1.weight = (G.lead r).1.weight) (a := m)).1 hm
  rw [h2.2]
  exact hquad r

name: Operad.sfinComap_apply
statement:
@[simp] lemma sfinComap_apply {X Y : Type*} (s : X → R) (c : X → Y)
    (hc : ∀ y, (c ⁻¹' {y}).Finite) (x : Y →₀ R) (a : X) :
    sfinComap s c hc x a = s a * x (c a)
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: Operad.tens_map_diag
statement:
lemma tens_map_diag {X Y : Type*} (f : (X →₀ R) →ₗ[R] (X →₀ R)) (g : (Y →₀ R) →ₗ[R] (Y →₀ R))
    (u : X → R) (w : Y → R) (hf : ∀ x a, f x a = u a * x a) (hg : ∀ y b, g y b = w b * y b)
    (t : (X →₀ R) ⊗[R] (Y →₀ R)) (a : X) (b : Y) :
    tens R X Y (TensorProduct.map f g t) (a, b) = u a * w b * tens R X Y t (a, b)
proof:
:= by
  induction t using TensorProduct.induction_on with
  | zero => simp
  | tmul x y =>
    simp only [TensorProduct.map_tmul, tens_tmul_apply, hf, hg]
    ring
  | add t t' ht ht' => simp only [map_add, Finsupp.add_apply, ht, ht', mul_add]

name: Operad.tens3'_sswapLast
statement:
lemma tens3'_sswapLast {X Y Z : Type w} (pY : Bool → (Y →₀ R) →ₗ[R] (Y →₀ R))
    (pZ : Bool → (Z →₀ R) →ₗ[R] (Z →₀ R)) (cY : Y → Bool) (cZ : Z → Bool)
    (hY : ∀ q y b, pY q y b = if cY b = q then y b else 0)
    (hZ : ∀ r z d, pZ r z d = if cZ d = r then z d else 0)
    (t : ((X →₀ R) ⊗[R] (Y →₀ R)) ⊗[R] (Z →₀ R)) (a : X) (b : Y) (d : Z) :
    tens3' R X Z Y (sswapLast R pY pZ t) ((a, d), b)
      = σ R (cY b && cZ d) * tens3' R X Y Z t ((a, b), d)
proof:
:= by
  have : (Finsupp.lapply ((a, d), b)) ∘ₗ (tens3' R X Z Y).toLinearMap ∘ₗ sswapLast R pY pZ
      = σ R (cY b && cZ d) • ((Finsupp.lapply ((a, b), d)) ∘ₗ (tens3' R X Y Z).toLinearMap) :=
    TensorProduct.ext_threefold fun x y z => by
      simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearEquiv.coe_coe, sswapLast_tmul, Fintype.sum_bool,
        map_add, map_smul, Finsupp.lapply_apply, tens3'_tmul_apply, smul_eq_mul,
        LinearMap.smul_apply]
      simp only [hY, hZ]
      cases cY b <;> cases cZ d <;> simp <;> ring
  exact LinearMap.congr_fun this t

name: Operad.tens3_lTensor_s
statement:
lemma tens3_lTensor_s {X Y Y₁ Y₂ : Type*} (g : (Y →₀ R) →ₗ[R] (Y₁ →₀ R) ⊗[R] (Y₂ →₀ R))
    (s : Y₁ × Y₂ → R) (c : Y₁ × Y₂ → Y) (hg : ∀ y p, tens R Y₁ Y₂ (g y) p = s p * y (c p))
    (t : (X →₀ R) ⊗[R] (Y →₀ R)) (a : X) (p : Y₁ × Y₂) :
    tens3 R X Y₁ Y₂ (LinearMap.lTensor (X →₀ R) g t) (a, p) = s p * tens R X Y t (a, c p)
proof:
:= by
  induction t using TensorProduct.induction_on with
  | zero => simp
  | tmul x y =>
    obtain ⟨b, d⟩ := p
    have h := hg y (b, d)
    simp only [LinearMap.lTensor_tmul, tens_tmul_apply, tens3, LinearEquiv.trans_apply,
      TensorProduct.congr_tmul, LinearEquiv.refl_apply, h]
    ring
  | add t t' ht ht' => simp only [map_add, Finsupp.add_apply, ht, ht', mul_add]

name: Operad.tens3'_rTensor_s
statement:
lemma tens3'_rTensor_s {X X₁ X₂ Z : Type*} (g : (X →₀ R) →ₗ[R] (X₁ →₀ R) ⊗[R] (X₂ →₀ R))
    (s : X₁ × X₂ → R) (c : X₁ × X₂ → X) (hg : ∀ x p, tens R X₁ X₂ (g x) p = s p * x (c p))
    (t : (X →₀ R) ⊗[R] (Z →₀ R)) (p : X₁ × X₂) (d : Z) :
    tens3' R X₁ X₂ Z (LinearMap.rTensor (Z →₀ R) g t) (p, d) = s p * tens R X Z t (c p, d)
proof:
:= by
  induction t using TensorProduct.induction_on with
  | zero => simp
  | tmul x z =>
    obtain ⟨a, b⟩ := p
    have h := hg x (a, b)
    simp only [LinearMap.rTensor_tmul, tens_tmul_apply, tens3', LinearEquiv.trans_apply,
      TensorProduct.congr_tmul, LinearEquiv.refl_apply, h]
    ring
  | add t t' ht ht' => simp only [map_add, Finsupp.add_apply, ht, ht', mul_add]

name: Operad.SgnLin.decompT_apply
statement:
lemma decompT_apply (i : A) (x : S (Without A i ⊕ B) →₀ R) (pq : S A × S B) :
    tens R (S A) (S B) (decompT R δ i x) pq
      = σ R (SgnData.sgn i (δ.app A pq.1) (δ.app B pq.2)) * x (SetOperad.comp i pq.1 pq.2)
proof:
:= by
  simp [decompT]

name: Operad.SgnLin.parT_apply
statement:
lemma parT_apply (b : Bool) (x : S A →₀ R) (a : S A) :
    parT R δ b x a = if (δ.app A a).tot = b then x a else 0
proof:
:= by
  induction x using Finsupp.induction_linear with
  | zero => simp
  | add x x' hx hx' =>
    rw [map_add, Finsupp.add_apply, hx, hx', Finsupp.add_apply]
    split_ifs <;> simp
  | single s r =>
    rw [parT_single]
    by_cases h : (δ.app A s).tot = b
    · rw [if_pos h]
      by_cases hs : s = a
      · subst hs
        rw [if_pos h]
      · rw [Finsupp.single_eq_of_ne (Ne.symm hs)]
        split_ifs <;> simp
    · rw [if_neg h, Finsupp.zero_apply]
      by_cases hs : s = a
      · subst hs
        rw [if_neg h]
      · split_ifs <;> simp [Finsupp.single_eq_of_ne (Ne.symm hs)]

name: Operad.SgnLin.decompT_parT
statement:
lemma decompT_parT (i : A) (b : Bool) :
    decompT R δ (B := B) i ∘ₗ parT R δ b
      = tpar R (fun c => parT R δ c) (fun c => parT R δ c) b ∘ₗ decompT R δ i
proof:
:= by
  refine LinearMap.ext fun x => (tens R (S A) (S B)).injective (Finsupp.ext fun ⟨p, q⟩ => ?_)
  have hd : ∀ c (y : S A →₀ R) a, parT R δ c y a
      = (if (δ.app A a).tot = c then 1 else 0) * y a := fun c y a => by
    rw [parT_apply]
    split_ifs <;> simp
  have hd' : ∀ c (y : S B →₀ R) a, parT R δ c y a
      = (if (δ.app B a).tot = c then 1 else 0) * y a := fun c y a => by
    rw [parT_apply]
    split_ifs <;> simp
  rw [LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearMap.comp_apply, decompT_apply, parT_apply, tpar,
    LinearMap.add_apply, map_add, Finsupp.add_apply, tens_map_diag _ _ _ _ (hd false) (hd' b),
    tens_map_diag _ _ _ _ (hd true) (hd' (!b)), decompT_apply, δ.app_comp, SgnData.comp_def,
    SgnData.comp_tot]
  cases (δ.app A p).tot <;> cases (δ.app B q).tot <;> cases b <;> simp

name: Operad.SgnLin.decompT_map
statement:
lemma decompT_map (σ' : A ≃ A') (τ : B ≃ B') (i : A) :
    decompT R δ (σ' i) ∘ₗ Lin.mapL R (compEquiv σ' τ i)
      = TensorProduct.map (Lin.mapL R σ') (Lin.mapL R τ) ∘ₗ decompT R δ i
proof:
:=
  LinearMap.ext fun x => (tens R (S A') (S B')).injective (Finsupp.ext fun ⟨p, q⟩ => by
    rw [LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearMap.comp_apply, decompT_apply, Lin.mapL_apply,
      tens_map _ _ _ _ (Lin.mapL_apply σ') (Lin.mapL_apply τ), decompT_apply]
    have hs : SgnData.sgn (σ' i) (δ.app A' p) (δ.app B' q)
        = SgnData.sgn i (δ.app A (SetOperad.map σ'.symm p)) (δ.app B (SetOperad.map τ.symm q)) := by
      rw [δ.app_map, δ.app_map, SgnData.map_def, SgnData.map_def]
      have h := SgnData.sgn_map σ'.symm τ.symm (σ' i) (δ.app A' p) (δ.app B' q)
      rw [Equiv.symm_apply_apply] at h
      exact h.symm
    rw [hs]
    congr 2
    rw [← SetOperad.map_symm_map (compEquiv σ' τ i) (SetOperad.comp i _ _),
      SetOperad.map_comp, SetOperad.map_map_symm, SetOperad.map_map_symm])

name: Operad.SgnLin.decompT_counit_right
statement:
lemma decompT_counit_right (i : A) :
    (TensorProduct.rid R (S A →₀ R)).toLinearMap ∘ₗ
        LinearMap.lTensor (S A →₀ R) (Finsupp.lapply SetOperad.one) ∘ₗ
          decompT R δ (B := Unit) i ∘ₗ Lin.mapL R (rightUnitEquiv i).symm
      = LinearMap.id
proof:
:=
  LinearMap.ext fun x => Finsupp.ext fun a => by
    simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearEquiv.coe_coe, rid_lTensor_lapply, decompT_apply,
      Lin.mapL_apply, Equiv.symm_symm, SetOperad.comp_one, LinearMap.id_apply, δ.app_one,
      SgnData.one_def, SgnData.sgn_one_right, σ_false, one_mul]

name: Operad.SgnLin.decompT_counit_left
statement:
lemma decompT_counit_left :
    (TensorProduct.lid R (S B →₀ R)).toLinearMap ∘ₗ
        LinearMap.rTensor (S B →₀ R) (Finsupp.lapply SetOperad.one) ∘ₗ decompT R δ () ∘ₗ
          Lin.mapL R (leftUnitEquiv B).symm
      = LinearMap.id
proof:
:=
  LinearMap.ext fun x => Finsupp.ext fun b => by
    simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearEquiv.coe_coe, lid_rTensor_lapply, decompT_apply,
      Lin.mapL_apply, Equiv.symm_symm, SetOperad.one_comp, LinearMap.id_apply, δ.app_one,
      SgnData.one_def, SgnData.sgn_one_left, σ_false, one_mul]

name: Operad.SgnLin.decompT_assoc_seq
statement:
lemma decompT_assoc_seq (i : A) (j : B) :
    LinearMap.lTensor (S A →₀ R) (decompT R δ (B := D) j) ∘ₗ decompT R δ i
      = (TensorProduct.assoc R (S A →₀ R) (S B →₀ R) (S D →₀ R)).toLinearMap ∘ₗ
          LinearMap.rTensor (S D →₀ R) (decompT R δ i) ∘ₗ decompT R δ (Sum.inr j) ∘ₗ
            Lin.mapL R (seqEquiv i j D).symm
proof:
:=
