  LinearMap.ext fun x => (tens3 R (S A) (S B) (S D)).injective (Finsupp.ext fun ⟨a, b, d⟩ => by
    simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearEquiv.coe_coe]
    rw [tens3_lTensor_s _ _ _ (decompT_apply δ j), decompT_apply, tens3_assoc,
      tens3'_rTensor_s _ _ _ (decompT_apply δ i), decompT_apply, Lin.mapL_apply,
      Equiv.symm_symm, SetOperad.comp_assoc_seq]
    have key := congrArg (σ R) (SgnData.sgn_seq i j (δ.app A a) (δ.app B b) (δ.app D d))
    rw [σ_xor, σ_xor, ← SgnData.comp_def, ← SgnData.comp_def, ← δ.app_comp,
      ← δ.app_comp] at key
    linear_combination (-x (SetOperad.comp i a (SetOperad.comp j b d))) * key)

name: Operad.SgnLin.decompT_assoc_par
statement:
lemma decompT_assoc_par {i k : A} (hik : i ≠ k) :
    LinearMap.rTensor (S B →₀ R) (decompT R δ (B := D) k) ∘ₗ decompT R δ (Sum.inl ⟨i, hik⟩)
      = sswapLast R (fun c => parT R δ c) (fun c => parT R δ c) ∘ₗ
          LinearMap.rTensor (S D →₀ R) (decompT R δ i) ∘ₗ
            decompT R δ (Sum.inl ⟨k, Ne.symm hik⟩) ∘ₗ Lin.mapL R (parEquiv hik B D).symm
proof:
:=
  LinearMap.ext fun x => (tens3' R (S A) (S D) (S B)).injective
    (Finsupp.ext fun ⟨⟨a, d⟩, b⟩ => by
      simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply]
      rw [tens3'_rTensor_s _ _ _ (decompT_apply δ k), decompT_apply,
        tens3'_sswapLast _ _ (fun b => (δ.app B b).tot) (fun d => (δ.app D d).tot)
          (fun q y b => parT_apply δ q y b) (fun r z d => parT_apply δ r z d),
        tens3'_rTensor_s _ _ _ (decompT_apply δ i), decompT_apply, Lin.mapL_apply,
        Equiv.symm_symm, SetOperad.comp_assoc_par]
      have key := congrArg (σ R) (SgnData.sgn_par hik (δ.app A a) (δ.app B b) (δ.app D d))
      rw [σ_xor, σ_xor, σ_xor, ← SgnData.comp_def, ← SgnData.comp_def, ← δ.app_comp,
        ← δ.app_comp] at key
      have msq := σ_mul_self R ((δ.app B b).tot && (δ.app D d).tot)
      linear_combination (-σ R ((δ.app B b).tot && (δ.app D d).tot)
          * x (SetOperad.comp (Sum.inl ⟨i, hik⟩) (SetOperad.comp k a d) b)) * key
        - (σ R (SgnData.sgn k (δ.app A a) (δ.app D d))
          * σ R (SgnData.sgn (Sum.inl ⟨i, hik⟩) (δ.app _ (SetOperad.comp k a d)) (δ.app B b))
          * x (SetOperad.comp (Sum.inl ⟨i, hik⟩) (SetOperad.comp k a d) b)) * msq)

name: Operad.SgnLin.counit_parT
statement: lemma counit_parT : Finsupp.lapply (R := R) (SetOperad.one : S Unit) ∘ₗ parT R δ true = 0
proof:
:=
  LinearMap.ext fun x => by
    rw [LinearMap.comp_apply, Finsupp.lapply_apply, parT_apply, δ.app_one, SgnData.one_def,
      SgnData.one_tot]
    rfl

name: Operad.SgnLin.map_single_one
statement:
lemma map_single_one (e : Unit ≃ A) :
    SymSpecies.map (R := R) (V := SgnLin R δ) e (Finsupp.single SetOperad.one 1)
      = Finsupp.single (SetOperad.map e SetOperad.one) 1
proof:
:=
  Lin.mapL_single e _ 1

name: Operad.SgnLin.mem_fact_iff
statement:
lemma mem_fact_iff (i : A) (t : S (Without A i ⊕ B)) (pq : S A × S B) :
    pq ∈ (SetOperad.FiniteFact.finite i t).toFinset ↔ SetOperad.comp i pq.1 pq.2 = t
proof:
:= by
  rw [Set.Finite.mem_toFinset, Set.mem_preimage, Set.mem_singleton_iff]

name: Operad.SgnLin.decompT_single
statement:
lemma decompT_single (i : A) (t : S (Without A i ⊕ B)) (r : R) :
    decompT R δ i (Finsupp.single t r)
      = ∑ pq ∈ (SetOperad.FiniteFact.finite i t).toFinset,
          (σ R (SgnData.sgn i (δ.app A pq.1) (δ.app B pq.2)) * r)
            • (Finsupp.single pq.1 1 ⊗ₜ[R] Finsupp.single pq.2 (1 : R))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  refine (tens R (S A) (S B)).injective (Finsupp.ext fun ⟨p, q⟩ => ?_)
  rw [decompT_apply, map_sum, Finsupp.finsetSum_apply]
  simp only [map_smul, Finsupp.smul_apply, tens_tmul_apply, Finsupp.single_apply, smul_eq_mul]
  by_cases h : SetOperad.comp i p q = t
  · rw [if_pos h.symm, Finset.sum_eq_single (p, q)]
    · simp
    · rintro ⟨p', q'⟩ _ hne
      by_cases h1 : p' = p
      · subst h1
        have h2 : ¬ q' = q := fun h2 => hne (by rw [h2])
        simp [h2]
      · simp [h1]
    · intro hn
      exact absurd ((mem_fact_iff i t (p, q)).2 h) hn
  · rw [if_neg (Ne.symm h), mul_zero]
    refine (Finset.sum_eq_zero fun pq hpq => ?_).symm
    have hpq' : SetOperad.comp i pq.1 pq.2 = t := (mem_fact_iff i t pq).1 hpq
    by_cases h1 : pq.1 = p
    · by_cases h2 : pq.2 = q
      · exact absurd (by rw [← h1, ← h2]; exact hpq') h
      · simp [h2]
    · simp [h1]

name: Operad.FreeGr.graft_eq_leaf
statement:
lemma graft_eq_leaf {s u : Tree T} {p : ℕ} (h : s.graft p u = .leaf) :
    s = .leaf ∧ u = .leaf
proof:
:= by
  cases s with
  | leaf => exact ⟨rfl, by simpa using h⟩
  | node e f => simp at h

name: Operad.FreeGr.eq_map_one_of_leaf
statement:
lemma eq_map_one_of_leaf {A : Type} [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] (x : Reg (TreeOfArity T) A)
    (hx : treeOf x = .leaf) :
    ∃ e : Unit ≃ A, x = SetOperad.map e (SetOperad.one : Reg (TreeOfArity T) Unit)
proof:
:= by
  have hcard : Fintype.card A = 1 := by
    rw [← x.2.2, ← treeOf_arity, hx]
    rfl
  have hsub : Subsingleton A := Fintype.card_le_one_iff_subsingleton.1 hcard.le
  refine ⟨Fintype.equivOfCardEq (by rw [hcard]; rfl), Reg.ext (LinOrd.eq_of_subsingleton _ _)
    (arr_ext ?_)⟩
  exact hx

name: Operad.GrCooperad.filtTarget_mono
proof:
:=
  sup_le_sup_left (Submodule.map₂_le_map₂ (h B) (h D)) _

name: Operad.GrCooperad.mem_filt_succ
statement:
lemma mem_filt_succ {n : ℕ} {c : C A} :
    c ∈ filt R C (n + 1) A ↔ ∀ (B D : Type) [Fintype B] [DecidableEq B] [Fintype D]
      [DecidableEq D] (i : B) (e : Without B i ⊕ D ≃ A),
      decomp (R := R) i (SymSpecies.map (R := R) e.symm c) ∈ filtTarget R C (filt R C n) B D
proof:
:=
  Iff.rfl

name: Operad.GrCooperad.filt_zero
statement: lemma filt_zero : filt R C 0 A = unitSpan R C A
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: Operad.GrCooperad.decomp_mem_unitSpan
proof:
:= by
  induction hc using Submodule.span_induction with
  | mem x hx =>
    obtain ⟨e, rfl⟩ := hx
    exact Coaug.decomp_mem i e
  | zero => simp
  | add x y _ _ hx hy => simpa only [map_add] using add_mem hx hy
  | smul r x _ hx => simpa only [map_smul] using Submodule.smul_mem _ r hx

name: Operad.GrCooperad.unitSpan_le_filt
statement:
lemma unitSpan_le_filt (n : ℕ) (A : Type) [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] :
    unitSpan R C A ≤ filt R C n A
proof:
:= by
  induction n generalizing A with
  | zero => exact le_rfl
  | succ n ih =>
    intro c hc B D _ _ _ _ i e
    have := decomp_mem_unitSpan (R := R) (C := C) i (unitSpan_le_comap_map e.symm hc)
    exact Submodule.mem_sup_right ((Submodule.map₂_le_map₂ (ih B) (ih D)) this)

name: Operad.GrCooperad.filt_mono
statement:
lemma filt_mono (n : ℕ) (A : Type) [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] :
    filt R C n A ≤ filt R C (n + 1) A
proof:
:= by
  induction n generalizing A with
  | zero => exact unitSpan_le_filt 1 A
  | succ n ih =>
    intro c hc B D _ _ _ _ i e
    exact filtTarget_mono (fun A _ _ => ih A) (hc B D i e)

name: Operad.FreeGrL.genLift_L_eq_zero
proof:
:= by
  induction hc using Submodule.span_induction with
  | mem x hx =>
    obtain ⟨e, rfl⟩ := hx
    exact hℓ k e
  | zero => exact map_zero _
  | add x y _ _ hx hy => rw [map_add, hx, hy, add_zero]
  | smul r x _ hx => rw [map_smul, hx, smul_zero]

name: Operad.FreeGrL.coefF_eq_zero_of_unitSpan
statement:
lemma coefF_eq_zero_of_unitSpan (ℓ : GenLift₀ φ)
    (hℓ : ∀ (k : ℕ) (e : Unit ≃ Fin k), ℓ.L k (SymSpecies.map (R := R) e 𝟙) = 0)
    (x : Reg (TreeOfArity (GrGen R V)) A) (hx : FreeGr.vcnt x ≠ 0) {c : C A}
    (hc : c ∈ GrCooperad.unitSpan R C A) : FreeGr.coefF (liftOp ℓ) x c = 0
proof:
:= by
  refine FreeReg.induction (P := fun A _ _ x => FreeGr.vcnt x ≠ 0 → ∀ c : C A,
    c ∈ GrCooperad.unitSpan R C A → FreeGr.coefF (liftOp ℓ) x c = 0) ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ x hx c hc
  · intro A B _ _ _ _ e x ih hv c hc
    rw [FreeGr.coefF_map]
    exact ih (by rwa [FreeGr.vcnt_map] at hv) _ (GrCooperad.unitSpan_le_comap_map e.symm hc)
  · intro hv
    exact absurd FreeGr.vcnt_one hv
  · intro A B _ _ _ _ i x y ihx ihy hv c hc
    rw [FreeGr.coefF_comp]
    refine mul_eq_zero_of_right _ (SymCooperad.pair_eq_zero_of_mem ?_
      (GrCooperad.decomp_mem_unitSpan i hc))
    rw [FreeGr.vcnt_comp] at hv
    by_cases h0 : FreeGr.vcnt x = 0
    · exact Or.inr (ihy (by omega))
    · exact Or.inl (ihx h0)
  · intro k g _ c hc
    rw [coefF_std, genLift_L_eq_zero ℓ hℓ hc, Finsupp.coe_zero, Pi.zero_apply, mul_zero]

name: Operad.FreeGrL.coefFinite_of_conil
statement:
theorem coefFinite_of_conil (hC : GrCooperad.Conilpotent R C) (ℓ : GenLift₀ φ)
    (hℓ : ∀ (k : ℕ) (e : Unit ≃ Fin k), ℓ.L k (SymSpecies.map (R := R) e 𝟙) = 0) :
    FreeGr.CoefFinite (liftOp ℓ)
proof:
:= by
  have hunit : ∀ {A : Type} [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] (t : Reg (TreeOfArity (GrGen R V)) A),
      FreeGr.vcnt t ≠ 0 → ∀ c ∈ GrCooperad.unitSpan R C A, FreeGr.coefF (liftOp ℓ) t c = 0 :=
    fun t ht _ hc => coefF_eq_zero_of_unitSpan ℓ hℓ t ht hc
  suffices h : ∀ n (A : Type) [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A], ∀ c ∈ GrCooperad.filt R C n A,
      (Function.support fun t : Reg (TreeOfArity (GrGen R V)) A =>
        FreeGr.coefF (liftOp ℓ) t c).Finite by
    intro A _ _ c
    obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := hC A c
    exact h n A c hn
  intro n
  induction n with
  | zero =>
    intro A _ _ c hc
    refine (Set.finite_range fun e : Unit ≃ A =>
      (SetOperad.map e SetOperad.one : Reg (TreeOfArity (GrGen R V)) A)).subset fun t ht => ?_
    by_contra hne
    refine ht (hunit t (fun h0 => hne ?_) c hc)
    obtain ⟨e, he⟩ := FreeGr.eq_map_one_of_vcnt h0
    exact ⟨e, he.symm⟩
  | succ n ih =>
    intro A _ _ c hc
    have hV : ∀ (a b : ℕ) (i : Fin a) (e : Without (Fin a) i ⊕ Fin b ≃ A),
        {pq : Reg (TreeOfArity (GrGen R V)) (Fin a) × Reg (TreeOfArity (GrGen R V)) (Fin b) |
          FreeGr.vcnt pq.1 ≠ 0 ∧ FreeGr.vcnt pq.2 ≠ 0 ∧
          SymCooperad.pair (FreeGr.coefF (liftOp ℓ) pq.1) (FreeGr.coefF (liftOp ℓ) pq.2)
            (GrCooperad.decomp (R := R) i (SymSpecies.map (R := R) e.symm c)) ≠ 0}.Finite := by
      intro a b i e
      obtain ⟨w₁₂, hw₁₂, w₃, hw₃, hsum⟩ := Submodule.mem_sup.1 (hc (Fin a) (Fin b) i e)
      obtain ⟨w₁, hw₁, w₂, hw₂, rfl⟩ := Submodule.mem_sup.1 hw₁₂
      refine (SymCooperad.finite_support_pair (fun p => FreeGr.coefF (liftOp ℓ) p)
        (fun q => FreeGr.coefF (liftOp ℓ) q) (fun m hm => ih (Fin a) m hm)
        (fun m hm => ih (Fin b) m hm) hw₃).subset fun pq ⟨hp, hq, hne⟩ => ?_
      rw [← hsum, map_add, map_add,
        SymCooperad.pair_eq_zero_of_mem (Or.inl (hunit pq.1 hp)) hw₁,
        SymCooperad.pair_eq_zero_of_mem (Or.inr (hunit pq.2 hq)) hw₂, zero_add, zero_add] at hne
      exact hne
    let U₀ : Set (Reg (TreeOfArity (GrGen R V)) A) :=
      Set.range fun e : Unit ≃ A => SetOperad.map e SetOperad.one
    let U₁ : Set (Reg (TreeOfArity (GrGen R V)) A) := ⋃ e : Fin (Fintype.card A) ≃ A,
      (fun g => SetOperad.map e (Reg.std (corolla g))) ''
        ↑(ℓ.L (Fintype.card A) (SymSpecies.map (R := R) e.symm c)).support
    let U₂ : Set (Reg (TreeOfArity (GrGen R V)) A) := ⋃ a ∈ Finset.range (Fintype.card A + 2),
      ⋃ b ∈ Finset.range (Fintype.card A + 1), ⋃ i : Fin a,
        ⋃ e : Without (Fin a) i ⊕ Fin b ≃ A,
        (fun pq : Reg (TreeOfArity (GrGen R V)) (Fin a) ×
            Reg (TreeOfArity (GrGen R V)) (Fin b) =>
          SetOperad.map e (SetOperad.comp i pq.1 pq.2)) ''
          {pq | FreeGr.vcnt pq.1 ≠ 0 ∧ FreeGr.vcnt pq.2 ≠ 0 ∧
            SymCooperad.pair (FreeGr.coefF (liftOp ℓ) pq.1) (FreeGr.coefF (liftOp ℓ) pq.2)
              (GrCooperad.decomp (R := R) i (SymSpecies.map (R := R) e.symm c)) ≠ 0}
    have h₀ : U₀.Finite := Set.finite_range _
    have h₁ : U₁.Finite := Set.finite_iUnion fun e => (Finset.finite_toSet _).image _
    have h₂ : U₂.Finite :=
      Set.Finite.biUnion (Finset.finite_toSet _) fun a _ =>
        Set.Finite.biUnion (Finset.finite_toSet _) fun b _ =>
          Set.finite_iUnion fun i => Set.finite_iUnion fun e => (hV _ _ i e).image _
    refine ((h₀.union h₁).union h₂).subset fun t ht => ?_
    rw [Function.mem_support] at ht
    rcases FreeGr.shapeR t with ⟨e, rfl⟩ | ⟨k, g, e, rfl⟩ | ⟨a, b, i, p, q, e, hp, hq, rfl⟩
    · exact Or.inl (Or.inl ⟨e, rfl⟩)
    · obtain rfl : k = Fintype.card A := by simpa using Fintype.card_congr e
      rw [FreeGr.coefF_map, coefF_std] at ht
      refine Or.inl (Or.inr (Set.mem_iUnion.2 ⟨e, g, Finsupp.mem_support_iff.2 ?_, rfl⟩))
      exact right_ne_zero_of_mul ht
    · have hcard := Fintype.card_congr e
      rw [Fintype.card_sum, Reg.card_without, Fintype.card_fin, Fintype.card_fin] at hcard
      have ha := i.pos
      rw [FreeGr.coefF_map, FreeGr.coefF_comp] at ht
      refine Or.inr (Set.mem_iUnion₂.2 ⟨a, ?_, Set.mem_iUnion₂.2 ⟨b, ?_, Set.mem_iUnion.2 ⟨i,
        Set.mem_iUnion.2 ⟨e, ⟨(p, q), ⟨hp, hq, right_ne_zero_of_mul ht⟩, rfl⟩⟩⟩⟩⟩)
      · exact Finset.mem_coe.2 (Finset.mem_range.2 (by omega))
      · exact Finset.mem_coe.2 (Finset.mem_range.2 (by omega))

name: Operad.FreeGrL.liftOf_app_one
statement:
theorem liftOf_app_one (ℓ : GenLift₀ φ)
    (hℓ : ∀ (k : ℕ) (e : Unit ≃ Fin k), ℓ.L k (SymSpecies.map (R := R) e 𝟙) = 0)
    (hΨ : FreeGr.CoefFinite (liftOp ℓ)) :
    (liftOf ℓ hΨ).app Unit 𝟙 = GrCooperad.Coaug.one (R := R) (C := FreeGrL R V)
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : 𝟙 ∈ GrCooperad.unitSpan R C Unit := by
    have := GrCooperad.map_one_mem (R := R) (C := C) (Equiv.refl Unit)
    rwa [SymSpecies.map_refl] at this
  have h : FreeGr.ofCoefL (liftOp ℓ) hΨ Unit 𝟙
      = GrCooperad.Coaug.one (R := R) (C := FreeGr R (grGenPar R V)) := by
    refine Finsupp.ext fun t => ?_
    rw [FreeGr.ofCoefL_apply]
    show _ = (Finsupp.single (SetOperad.one : Reg (TreeOfArity (GrGen R V)) Unit) (1 : R)) t
    by_cases ht : t = SetOperad.one
    · subst ht
      rw [FreeGr.coefF_one, GrCooperad.Coaug.counit_one, Finsupp.single_eq_same]
    · have hw : FreeGr.vcnt t ≠ 0 := fun h0 => ht (by
        obtain ⟨e, he⟩ := FreeGr.eq_map_one_of_vcnt h0
        rw [he, Subsingleton.elim e (Equiv.refl Unit), SetOperad.map_refl])
      rw [Finsupp.single_eq_of_ne ht]
      exact coefF_eq_zero_of_unitSpan ℓ hℓ t hw h1
  show (projHom R V).app Unit (FreeGr.ofCoefL (liftOp ℓ) hΨ Unit 𝟙) = _
  rw [h]
  rfl

name: Operad.FreeGrL.genCoef_one
statement:
lemma genCoef_one :
    genCoef R V Unit (GrCooperad.Coaug.one (R := R) (C := FreeGrL R V)) = 0
proof:
:= by
  show genCoef R V Unit ((GrOperadIdeal.span R (grLinRel R V)).proj Unit
    (SgnLin.bas (treeSgn (grGenPar R V)) R SetOperad.one)) = 0
  rw [genCoef_proj, genCoefF_bas, coefReg_of_weight_ne]
  exact Nat.zero_ne_one

name: Operad.FreeGrL.genCoef_app_unitSpan
statement:
lemma genCoef_app_unitSpan (f : GrCooperadHom R C (FreeGrL R V))
    (hf : f.app Unit 𝟙 = GrCooperad.Coaug.one (R := R) (C := FreeGrL R V)) :
    GrCooperad.unitSpan R C A ≤ LinearMap.ker (genCoef R V A ∘ₗ f.app A)
proof:
:=
  Submodule.span_le.2 fun _ ⟨e, he⟩ => LinearMap.mem_ker.2 (by
    rw [← he, LinearMap.comp_apply, f.app_map, hf]
    show genCoef R V A (GrOperad.map (R := R) e _) = 0
    rw [genCoef_map, genCoef_one, map_zero])

name: Operad.FreeGrL.redLift_app_proj
statement:
@[simp] lemma redLift_app_proj
    (hφ : ∀ (A : Type) [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A],
      GrCooperad.unitSpan R C A ≤ LinearMap.ker (φ.app A)) (x : C A) :
    (redLift φ hφ).app A (GrCooperad.Red.proj R C A x) = φ.app A x
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: Operad.FreeGrL.redGenLift_one
statement:
lemma redGenLift_one (ψ : GrSpeciesHom R (GrCooperad.Red R C) V)
    (hproj : ∀ k, Module.Projective R (GrCooperad.Red R C (Fin k)) ∨
      Module.Projective R (V (Fin k))) (k : ℕ) (e : Unit ≃ Fin k) :
    (redGenLift ψ hproj).L k (SymSpecies.map (R := R) e 𝟙) = 0
proof:
:= by
  show liftLOf ψ k (hproj k) (GrCooperad.Red.proj R C (Fin k) (SymSpecies.map (R := R) e 𝟙)) = 0
  rw [GrCooperad.Red.proj_map_one, map_zero]

name: Operad.FreeGrL.liftConil_app_one
statement:
lemma liftConil_app_one (hC : GrCooperad.Conilpotent R C)
    (ψ : GrSpeciesHom R (GrCooperad.Red R C) V)
    (hproj : ∀ k, Module.Projective R (GrCooperad.Red R C (Fin k)) ∨
      Module.Projective R (V (Fin k))) :
    (liftConil hC ψ hproj).app Unit 𝟙 = GrCooperad.Coaug.one (R := R) (C := FreeGrL R V)
proof:
:=
  liftOf_app_one _ (redGenLift_one ψ hproj) _

name: Operad.FreeGrL.genCoef_liftConil
statement:
lemma genCoef_liftConil (hC : GrCooperad.Conilpotent R C)
    (ψ : GrSpeciesHom R (GrCooperad.Red R C) V)
    (hproj : ∀ k, Module.Projective R (GrCooperad.Red R C (Fin k)) ∨
      Module.Projective R (V (Fin k))) (x : C A) :
    genCoef R V A ((liftConil hC ψ hproj).app A x) = ψ.app A (GrCooperad.Red.proj R C A x)
proof:
:=
  genCoef_liftOf _ _ x

name: Operad.FreeGrL.cofreeHomEquivConil_apply
statement:
lemma cofreeHomEquivConil_apply (hV0 : ∀ v : V (Fin 0), v = 0)
    (hC : GrCooperad.Conilpotent R C)
    (hproj : ∀ k, Module.Projective R (GrCooperad.Red R C (Fin k)) ∨
      Module.Projective R (V (Fin k)))
    (f : {f : GrCooperadHom R C (FreeGrL R V) //
      f.app Unit 𝟙 = GrCooperad.Coaug.one (R := R) (C := FreeGrL R V)}) (x : C A) :
    (cofreeHomEquivConil hV0 hC hproj f).app A (GrCooperad.Red.proj R C A x)
      = genCoef R V A (f.1.app A x)
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: Operad.FreeGrL.existsUnique_liftConil
statement:
theorem existsUnique_liftConil (hV0 : ∀ v : V (Fin 0), v = 0)
    (hC : GrCooperad.Conilpotent R C)
    (hproj : ∀ k, Module.Projective R (GrCooperad.Red R C (Fin k)) ∨
      Module.Projective R (V (Fin k)))
    (hφ : ∀ (A : Type) [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A],
      GrCooperad.unitSpan R C A ≤ LinearMap.ker (φ.app A)) :
    ∃! f : GrCooperadHom R C (FreeGrL R V), ∀ (A : Type) [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] (x : C A),
      genCoef R V A (f.app A x) = φ.app A x
proof:
:=
  ⟨liftConil hC (redLift φ hφ) hproj, fun _ _ _ x => genCoef_liftConil hC (redLift φ hφ) hproj x,
    fun _ hf => GrCooperadHom.ext (app_eq_of_genCoef₀ hV0 fun A _ _ x =>
      (hf A x).trans (genCoef_liftConil hC (redLift φ hφ) hproj x).symm)⟩

name: Operad.GrSpEnd.scalar_app
statement:
@[simp] lemma GrSpEnd.scalar_app (f : ℕ → R) {A : Type} [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] (x : V A) :
    (GrSpEnd.scalar R V f).app A x = f (Fintype.card A) • x
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.FreeGrL.derSp_lin
statement:
theorem derSp_lin {e : Bool} (a b c : GrSpEnd R V e) (α β : R)
    (h : ∀ (A : Type) [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] (x : V A),
      c.app A x = α • a.app A x + β • b.app A x)
    {A : Type} [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] (x : FreeGrL R V A) :
    (derSp c).app A x = α • (derSp a).app A x + β • (derSp b).app A x
proof:
:= by
  have key := submodule_eq_top (R := R) (V := V)
    (fun A _ _ => LinearMap.ker ((derSp c).app A - α • (derSp a).app A - β • (derSp b).app A))
    (fun A _ _ e => by
      simp only [LinearMap.mem_ker, LinearMap.sub_apply, LinearMap.smul_apply, GrDer.app_map,
        GrDer.app_one, map_zero, smul_zero, sub_zero])
    (fun n v => by
      simp only [LinearMap.mem_ker, LinearMap.sub_apply, LinearMap.smul_apply, derSp_ι, h,
        map_add, map_smul]
      abel)
    (fun A B _ _ _ _ σ' x hx => by
      simp only [LinearMap.mem_ker, LinearMap.sub_apply, LinearMap.smul_apply, GrDer.app_map]
        at hx ⊢
      rw [sub_sub, sub_eq_zero] at hx ⊢
      rw [hx, map_add, map_smul, map_smul])
    (fun A B _ _ _ _ r x y hx hy => by
      simp only [LinearMap.mem_ker, LinearMap.sub_apply, sub_sub, sub_eq_zero,
        LinearMap.add_apply, LinearMap.smul_apply] at hx hy ⊢
      rw [(derSp c).app_comp, (derSp a).app_comp, (derSp b).app_comp, GrOperadHom.id_app,
        GrOperadHom.id_app, hx, hy]
      simp only [map_add, map_smul, LinearMap.add_apply, LinearMap.smul_apply, smul_add]
      abel) A
  have hx : x ∈ (⊤ : Submodule R (FreeGrL R V A)) := Submodule.mem_top
  rw [← key, LinearMap.mem_ker, LinearMap.sub_apply, LinearMap.sub_apply, LinearMap.smul_apply,
    LinearMap.smul_apply, sub_sub, sub_eq_zero] at hx
  exact hx

name: Operad.FreeGrL.derSp_excess
statement:
theorem derSp_excess {A : Type} [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] (x : FreeGrL R V A) :
    (derSp (GrSpEnd.scalar R V fun n => (n : R) - 1)).app A x
      = ((Fintype.card A : R) - 1) • x
proof:
:= by
  set E := derSp (GrSpEnd.scalar R V fun n => (n : R) - 1)
  have key := submodule_eq_top (R := R) (V := V)
    (fun A _ _ => LinearMap.ker (E.app A - ((Fintype.card A : R) - 1) • LinearMap.id))
    (fun A _ _ e => by
      have hA : Fintype.card A = 1 := by rw [← Fintype.card_congr e, Fintype.card_unit]
      rw [LinearMap.mem_ker, LinearMap.sub_apply, LinearMap.smul_apply, LinearMap.id_apply,
        GrDer.app_map, GrDer.app_one, map_zero, hA, Nat.cast_one, sub_self, zero_smul, sub_zero])
    (fun n v => by
      simp only [LinearMap.mem_ker, LinearMap.sub_apply, LinearMap.smul_apply,
        LinearMap.id_apply, E, derSp_ι, GrSpEnd.scalar_app, map_smul, Fintype.card_fin,
        sub_self])
    (fun A B _ _ _ _ σ' x hx => by
      simp only [LinearMap.mem_ker, LinearMap.sub_apply, LinearMap.smul_apply,
        LinearMap.id_apply, sub_eq_zero] at hx ⊢
      rw [GrDer.app_map, hx, map_smul, Fintype.card_congr σ'])
    (fun A B _ _ _ _ r x y hx hy => by
      simp only [LinearMap.mem_ker, LinearMap.sub_apply, LinearMap.smul_apply,
        LinearMap.id_apply, sub_eq_zero] at hx hy ⊢
      rw [E.app_comp, GrOperadHom.id_app, GrOperadHom.id_app, GrOperad.tw_false, hx, hy,
        LinearMap.map_smul₂, map_smul, ← add_smul]
      congr 1
      have h1 : 1 ≤ Fintype.card A := Fintype.card_pos_iff.2 ⟨r⟩
      rw [Fintype.card_sum, Reg.card_without, Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_sub h1, Nat.cast_one]
      ring) A
  have hx : x ∈ (⊤ : Submodule R (FreeGrL R V A)) := Submodule.mem_top
  rw [← key, LinearMap.mem_ker, LinearMap.sub_apply, LinearMap.smul_apply, LinearMap.id_apply,
    sub_eq_zero] at hx
  exact hx

name: Operad.FreeGrL.iSup_eig_scalar
statement:
theorem iSup_eig_scalar (hred : ∀ (B : Type) [Fintype B] [DecidableEq B],
      Fintype.card B ≤ 1 → ∀ v : V B, v = 0)
    (f : ℕ → R) (hf : ∀ n, 2 ≤ n → ∃ j : ℕ, f n = j) (A : Type) [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] :
    ⨆ j : ℕ, eig R V (GrSpEnd.scalar R V f) j A = ⊤
proof:
:=
  iSup_eig_eq_top (fun B _ _ v => by
    rcases le_or_gt (Fintype.card B) 1 with h | h
    · rw [hred B h v]; exact zero_mem _
    · obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := hf _ h
      exact Submodule.mem_iSup_of_mem j (by
        rw [Module.End.mem_eigenspace_iff, GrSpEnd.scalar_app, hj])) A

name: Operad.exists_finsupp_eig_inf
statement:
lemma _root_.Operad.exists_finsupp_eig_inf [Algebra ℚ R] {M : Type*} [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M]
    (B N : M →ₗ[R] M) (hc : ∀ x, B (N x) = N (B x))
    (htop : ⨆ j : ℕ, Module.End.eigenspace B (j : R) = ⊤) (k : R) {y : M} (hy : N y = k • y) :
    ∃ f : ℕ →₀ M, (∀ j : ℕ, f j ∈ Module.End.eigenspace B (j : R)) ∧
      (∀ j : ℕ, N (f j) = k • f j) ∧
      f.sum (fun _ v => v) = y
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨f, hf, rfl⟩ := (Submodule.mem_iSup_iff_exists_finsupp _ y).1
    (htop ▸ Submodule.mem_top : y ∈ ⨆ j : ℕ, Module.End.eigenspace B (j : R))
  let φ : M →ₗ[R] M := N - k • LinearMap.id
  have hφ : ∀ j : ℕ, φ (f j) ∈ Module.End.eigenspace B (j : R) := fun j => by
    rw [Module.End.mem_eigenspace_iff]
    simp only [φ, LinearMap.sub_apply, LinearMap.smul_apply, LinearMap.id_apply, map_sub,
      map_smul]
    rw [hc, Module.End.mem_eigenspace_iff.1 (hf j), map_smul]
    module
  refine ⟨f, hf, fun j => ?_, rfl⟩
  have h := iSupIndep_finsupp_eq_zero (iSupIndep_eigenspace_nat B) (f.mapRange φ (map_zero φ))
    (fun j => by rw [Finsupp.mapRange_apply]; exact hφ j)
    (by
      rw [Finsupp.sum_mapRange_index (fun _ => rfl), ← map_finsuppSum]
      simp only [φ, LinearMap.sub_apply, LinearMap.smul_apply, LinearMap.id_apply, hy,
        sub_self]) j
  rw [Finsupp.mapRange_apply] at h
  simpa only [φ, LinearMap.sub_apply, LinearMap.smul_apply, LinearMap.id_apply,
    sub_eq_zero] using h

name: Operad.GrSpEnd.trunc_app
statement:
lemma _root_.Operad.GrSpEnd.trunc_app (m : ℕ) {A : Type} [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] (x : V A) :
    (GrSpEnd.trunc R V m).app A x = (if Fintype.card A ≤ m then 1 else 0 : R) • x
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.GrSpEnd.trunc_trunc
statement:
lemma _root_.Operad.GrSpEnd.trunc_trunc (m : ℕ) (A : Type) [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] (x : V A) :
    (GrSpEnd.trunc R V m).app A ((GrSpEnd.trunc R V m).app A x)
      = (GrSpEnd.trunc R V m).app A x
proof:
:= by
  simp only [GrSpEnd.trunc_app, smul_smul]
  split_ifs <;> simp

name: Operad.FreeGrL.eig_card_eq_bot
proof:
:= by
  have htop := iSup_eig_scalar hred (fun n => (n : R) - 2)
    (fun n hn => ⟨n - 2, by rw [Nat.cast_sub hn]; norm_num⟩) A
  refine eq_zero_of_eigen_neg R _ htop (m := k + 1 - Fintype.card A) (by omega) ?_
  rw [derSp_lin (GrSpEnd.scalar R V fun n => (n : R) - 1) (GrSpEnd.id R V) _ 1 (-1)
    (fun A _ _ v => by simp only [GrSpEnd.scalar_app, GrSpEnd.id_app]; module) x,
    derSp_excess, mem_eig.1 hx, Nat.cast_sub (by omega), Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one]
  module

name: Operad.FreeGrL.mapSp_trunc_of_card_le
statement:
theorem mapSp_trunc_of_card_le {m : ℕ} {A : Type} [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A]
    (hA : Fintype.card A ≤ m) (x : FreeGrL R V A) :
    (mapSp (GrSpEnd.trunc R V m).toHom).app A x = x
proof:
:= by
  set τ := GrSpEnd.trunc R V m
  have hτ : ∀ (A : Type) [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] (x : V A), τ.app A (τ.app A x) = τ.app A x :=
    GrSpEnd.trunc_trunc m
  have hbot : ∀ j : ℕ, ∀ z ∈ eig R V (GrSpEnd.compl R V τ) (j + 1) A, z = 0 := fun j z hz => by
    have htop := iSup_eig_scalar hred
      (fun n => ((n : R) - 1) + (-(m : R)) * (1 - if n ≤ m then 1 else 0))
      (fun n hn => by
        by_cases h : n ≤ m
        · exact ⟨n - 1, by
            beta_reduce
            rw [if_pos h, Nat.cast_sub (by omega)]
            ring⟩
        · exact ⟨n - 1 - m, by
            beta_reduce
            rw [if_neg h, Nat.cast_sub (by omega), Nat.cast_sub (by omega)]
            ring⟩) A
    have hmj : Fintype.card A ≤ m * (j + 1) := le_trans hA (Nat.le_mul_of_pos_right _ (by omega))
    refine eq_zero_of_eigen_neg R _ htop (m := m * (j + 1) + 1 - Fintype.card A)
      (by omega) ?_
    rw [derSp_lin (GrSpEnd.scalar R V fun n => (n : R) - 1) (GrSpEnd.compl R V τ) _ 1 (-(m : R))
      (fun A _ _ v => by
        simp only [GrSpEnd.scalar_app, GrSpEnd.compl_app, τ, GrSpEnd.trunc_app]
        module) z,
      derSp_excess, mem_eig.1 hz, Nat.cast_sub (by omega)]
    push_cast
    module
  have hpos := sub_mapSp_mem τ hτ x
  have hle : ⨆ j : ℕ, eig R V (GrSpEnd.compl R V τ) (j + 1) A ≤ ⊥ :=
    iSup_le fun j z hz => (Submodule.mem_bot R).2 (hbot j z hz)
  exact (sub_eq_zero.1 ((Submodule.mem_bot R).1 (hle hpos))).symm

name: Operad.FreeGrL.mapSp_trunc_of_two_le
statement:
theorem mapSp_trunc_of_two_le {m : ℕ} (hm : 1 ≤ m) {A : Type} [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A]
    (hA : Fintype.card A = m + 1) {k : ℕ} (hk : 2 ≤ k) {x : FreeGrL R V A}
    (hx : x ∈ eig R V (GrSpEnd.id R V) k A) :
    (mapSp (GrSpEnd.trunc R V m).toHom).app A x = x
proof:
:= by
  set τ := GrSpEnd.trunc R V m
  have hτ : ∀ (A : Type) [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] (x : V A), τ.app A (τ.app A x) = τ.app A x :=
    GrSpEnd.trunc_trunc m
  have hBN : ∀ y, (derSp (GrSpEnd.compl R V τ)).app A ((derSp (GrSpEnd.id R V)).app A y)
      = (derSp (GrSpEnd.id R V)).app A ((derSp (GrSpEnd.compl R V τ)).app A y) := fun y => by
    have := derSp_comm (a := GrSpEnd.compl R V τ) (b := GrSpEnd.id R V)
      (fun A _ _ v => by simp only [GrSpEnd.id_app, Bool.false_and, σ_false, one_smul]) y
    rwa [Bool.false_and, σ_false, one_smul] at this
  have htopB := iSup_eig_eq_top (a := GrSpEnd.compl R V τ) (fun A _ _ v => mem_iSup_compl τ hτ v) A
  have hy : (derSp (GrSpEnd.id R V)).app A (x - (mapSp τ.toHom).app A x)
      = (k : R) • (x - (mapSp τ.toHom).app A x) := by
    rw [map_sub, mapSp_derSp_comm (a := GrSpEnd.id R V) (φ := τ) (fun A _ _ v => rfl), mem_eig.1 hx,
      map_smul, smul_sub]
  obtain ⟨f, hf, hfN, hfs⟩ := exists_finsupp_eig_inf _ _ hBN htopB (k : R) hy
  have hf0 : ∀ j, j ≠ 0 → f j = 0 := fun j hj => by
    have htopQ := iSup_eig_scalar hred
      (fun n => ((n : R) - 2) + (1 - (m : R)) * (1 - if n ≤ m then 1 else 0))
      (fun n hn => by
        by_cases h : n ≤ m
        · exact ⟨n - 2, by
            beta_reduce
            rw [if_pos h, Nat.cast_sub hn]
            ring⟩
        · exact ⟨n - 1 - m, by
            beta_reduce
            rw [if_neg h, Nat.cast_sub (by omega), Nat.cast_sub (by omega)]
            ring⟩) A
    have hmj : m + j ≤ m * j + 1 := by
      obtain ⟨m', rfl⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_add_of_le hm
      obtain ⟨j', rfl⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_add_of_le (Nat.one_le_iff_ne_zero.2 hj)
      ring_nf
      omega
    refine eq_zero_of_eigen_neg R _ htopQ (m := k + m * j - m - j) (by omega) ?_
    rw [derSp_lin (GrSpEnd.scalar R V fun n => (n : R) - 2) (GrSpEnd.compl R V τ) _ 1
      (1 - (m : R)) (fun A _ _ v => by
        simp only [GrSpEnd.scalar_app, GrSpEnd.compl_app, τ, GrSpEnd.trunc_app]
        module) (f j),
      derSp_lin (GrSpEnd.scalar R V fun n => (n : R) - 1) (GrSpEnd.id R V) _ 1 (-1)
        (fun A _ _ v => by simp only [GrSpEnd.scalar_app, GrSpEnd.id_app]; module) (f j),
      derSp_excess, hfN j, Module.End.mem_eigenspace_iff.1 (hf j), hA,
      Nat.cast_sub (show j ≤ k + m * j - m by omega), Nat.cast_sub (show m ≤ k + m * j by omega)]
    push_cast
    module
  have hyf : x - (mapSp τ.toHom).app A x = f 0 := by
    rw [← hfs]
    exact Finsupp.sum_eq_single 0 (fun j _ hj => hf0 j hj) (fun _ => rfl)
  have h0 : x - (mapSp τ.toHom).app A x
      ∈ Module.End.eigenspace ((derSp (GrSpEnd.compl R V τ)).app A) ((0 : ℕ) : R) :=
    hyf ▸ hf 0
  have h1 : x - (mapSp τ.toHom).app A x
      ∈ ⨆ (j : ℕ) (_ : j ≠ 0), eig R V (GrSpEnd.compl R V τ) j A :=
    (iSup_le fun j => le_iSup₂_of_le (f := fun (i : ℕ) (_ : i ≠ 0) =>
      eig R V (GrSpEnd.compl R V τ) i A) (j + 1) (by omega) le_rfl) (sub_mapSp_mem τ hτ x)
  have := Submodule.disjoint_def.1 (iSupIndep_eigenspace_nat _ 0) _ h0 h1
  exact (sub_eq_zero.1 this).symm

name: Operad.Sym.insertEquiv_inl_val
statement:
lemma insertEquiv_inl_val (a b n : ℕ) (k : Without (Fin (a + 1 + b)) ⟨a, by omega⟩) :
    ((insertEquiv a b n (Sum.inl k) : Fin (a + n + b)) : ℕ)
      = if (k.1 : ℕ) < a then (k.1 : ℕ) else (k.1 : ℕ) + n - 1
proof:
:= by
  show ((if h : (k.1 : ℕ) < a then _ else _ : Fin (a + n + b)) : ℕ) = _
  split_ifs <;> rfl

name: Operad.Sym.insertEquiv_inr_val
statement:
@[simp] lemma insertEquiv_inr_val (a b n : ℕ) (j : Fin n) :
    ((insertEquiv a b n (Sum.inr j) : Fin (a + n + b)) : ℕ) = a + j
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.SymOperad.comp_map_left
statement:
lemma comp_map_left (σ : A ≃ A') (i : A) (x : P A) (y : P B) :
    comp (R := R) (σ i) (map (R := R) σ x) y
      = map (R := R) (compEquiv σ (Equiv.refl B) i) (comp (R := R) i x y)
proof:
:= by
  rw [map_comp (R := R), map_refl (R := R)]

name: Operad.SymOperad.comp_map_right
statement:
lemma comp_map_right (τ : B ≃ B') (i : A) (x : P A) (y : P B) :
    comp (R := R) i x (map (R := R) τ y)
      = map (R := R) (Equiv.sumCongr (Equiv.refl (Without A i)) τ) (comp (R := R) i x y)
proof:
:= by
  have h := map_comp (R := R) (P := P) (Equiv.refl A) τ i x y
  rw [map_refl (R := R)] at h
  have e : compEquiv (Equiv.refl A) τ i = Equiv.sumCongr (Equiv.refl (Without A i)) τ := by
    ext c; rcases c with a | b <;> rfl
  rw [e] at h
  exact h.symm

name: Operad.SymOperad.comp_slot
statement:
lemma comp_slot {i i' : A} (h : i = i') (x : P A) (y : P B) :
    comp (R := R) i' x y = map (R := R) (slotEquiv h) (comp (R := R) i x y)
proof:
:= by
  subst h
  have e : slotEquiv (B := B) (rfl : i = i) = Equiv.refl _ := by
    ext c; rcases c with ⟨a, ha⟩ | b <;> rfl
  rw [e, map_refl (R := R)]

name: Operad.SymOperad.nsComp_apply
statement:
lemma nsComp_apply (a b : ℕ) {n : ℕ} (x : P (Fin (a + 1 + b))) (y : P (Fin n)) :
    nsComp (R := R) a b x y
      = map (R := R) (insertEquiv a b n) (comp (R := R) (⟨a, by omega⟩ : Fin (a + 1 + b)) x y)
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: Operad.SymOperad.reindex_toNS
statement:
lemma reindex_toNS {m n : ℕ} (h : m = n) (x : P (Fin m)) :
    reindex R (toNS P) h x = map (R := R) (finCongr h) x
proof:
:= by
  subst h
  rw [finCongr_refl, map_refl (R := R)]
  rfl

name: Operad.SymOperad.map_eq_of_equiv_eq
statement:
lemma map_eq_of_equiv_eq {A B : Type} [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] [Fintype B] [DecidableEq B]
    {e f : A ≃ B} (h : ∀ a, e a = f a) (x : P A) : map (R := R) e x = map (R := R) f x
proof:
:= by
  rw [Equiv.ext h]

name: Operad.SymOperad.nsComp_one_right
statement:
theorem nsComp_one_right (a b : ℕ) (x : P (Fin (a + 1 + b))) :
    nsComp (R := R) a b x (nsOne (R := R)) = x
proof:
:= by
  rw [nsComp_apply, nsOne, comp_map_right, comp_one', map_map, map_map]
  conv_rhs => rw [← map_refl (R := R) x]
  refine map_eq_of_equiv_eq (fun k => Fin.ext ?_) x
  simp only [Equiv.trans_apply, Equiv.refl_apply]
  by_cases hk : k = ⟨a, by omega⟩
  · subst hk
    rw [rightUnitEquiv_symm_self]
    simp [unitFinOne]
  · have hka : (k : ℕ) ≠ a := fun e => hk (Fin.ext e)
    rw [rightUnitEquiv_symm_of_ne hk, Equiv.sumCongr_apply, Sum.map_inl, Equiv.refl_apply,
      insertEquiv_inl_val]
    dsimp only
    split_ifs <;> omega

name: Operad.SymOperad.nsComp_one_left
statement:
theorem nsComp_one_left {n : ℕ} (x : P (Fin n)) :
    reindex R (toNS P) (by omega) (nsComp (R := R) 0 0 (nsOne (R := R)) x) = x
proof:
:= by
  rw [reindex_toNS, nsComp_apply, nsOne]
  have hc : comp (R := R) (⟨0, by omega⟩ : Fin (0 + 1 + 0)) (map (R := R) unitFinOne (one R)) x
      = map (R := R) (compEquiv unitFinOne (Equiv.refl (Fin n)) ())
          (comp (R := R) () (one R) x) :=
    comp_map_left (R := R) unitFinOne () (one R) x
  rw [hc, one_comp', map_map, map_map]
  erw [map_map]
  conv_rhs => rw [← map_refl (R := R) x]
  refine map_eq_of_equiv_eq (fun k => Fin.ext ?_) x
  show 0 + (k : ℕ) = k
  omega

name: Operad.SymOperad.comp_assoc_seq'
statement:
lemma comp_assoc_seq' {A B D : Type} [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] [Fintype B] [DecidableEq B]
    [Fintype D] [DecidableEq D] (i : A) (j : B) (x : P A) (y : P B) (z : P D) :
    comp (R := R) (Sum.inr j) (comp (R := R) i x y) z
      = map (R := R) (seqEquiv i j D).symm (comp (R := R) i x (comp (R := R) j y z))
proof:
:= by
  rw [← comp_assoc_seq (R := R) i j x y z, map_symm_map]

name: Operad.SymOperad.comp_assoc_par'
statement:
lemma comp_assoc_par' {A B D : Type} [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] [Fintype B] [DecidableEq B]
    [Fintype D] [DecidableEq D] {i k : A} (hik : i ≠ k) (x : P A) (y : P B) (z : P D) :
    comp (R := R) (Sum.inl ⟨k, Ne.symm hik⟩) (comp (R := R) i x y) z
      = map (R := R) (parEquiv hik B D).symm
          (comp (R := R) (Sum.inl ⟨i, hik⟩) (comp (R := R) k x z) y)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← comp_assoc_par (R := R) hik x y z, map_symm_map]

name: Operad.SymOperad.nsComp_assoc_seq
statement:
theorem nsComp_assoc_seq (a b c d : ℕ) {p : ℕ} (α : P (Fin (a + 1 + b)))
    (β : P (Fin (c + 1 + d))) (γ : P (Fin p)) :
    reindex R (toNS P) (by omega)
        (nsComp (R := R) (a + c) (d + b)
          (reindex R (toNS P) (by omega) (nsComp (R := R) a b α β)) γ)
      = nsComp (R := R) a b α (nsComp (R := R) c d β γ)
proof:
:= by
  have h2 : a + (c + 1 + d) + b = a + c + 1 + (d + b) := by omega
  rw [reindex_toNS, reindex_toNS, nsComp_apply, nsComp_apply,
    map_map (insertEquiv a b (c + 1 + d)) (finCongr h2)]
  have hs : ((insertEquiv a b (c + 1 + d)).trans (finCongr h2)) (Sum.inr ⟨c, by omega⟩)
      = (⟨a + c, by omega⟩ : Fin (a + c + 1 + (d + b))) := Fin.ext rfl
  rw [comp_slot hs, comp_map_left, comp_assoc_seq', nsComp_apply, nsComp_apply,
    comp_map_right]
  simp only [map_map]
  refine map_eq_of_equiv_eq (fun y => Fin.ext ?_) _
  rcases y with ⟨⟨k, hk⟩, hne⟩ | ⟨⟨l, hl⟩, hne⟩ | q
  · have hka : k ≠ a := fun e => hne (Fin.ext e)
    simp only [Equiv.trans_apply, seqEquiv_symm_inl, compEquiv, slotEquiv, Equiv.coe_fn_mk,
      Equiv.sumCongr_apply, Sum.map_inl, Equiv.subtypeEquivRight_apply_coe, insertEquiv_inl_val,
      finCongr_apply, Fin.val_cast, Equiv.refl_apply]
    split_ifs <;> omega
  · have hlc : l ≠ c := fun e => hne (Fin.ext e)
    simp only [Equiv.trans_apply, seqEquiv_symm_inr_inl, compEquiv, slotEquiv, Equiv.coe_fn_mk,
      Equiv.sumCongr_apply, Sum.map_inl, Sum.map_inr, Equiv.subtypeEquivRight_apply_coe,
      insertEquiv_inl_val, insertEquiv_inr_val, finCongr_apply, Fin.val_cast, Equiv.refl_apply]
    split_ifs <;> omega
  · simp only [Equiv.trans_apply, seqEquiv_symm_inr_inr, compEquiv, slotEquiv, Equiv.coe_fn_mk,
      Equiv.sumCongr_apply, Sum.map_inr, insertEquiv_inr_val, finCongr_apply, Fin.val_cast,
      Equiv.refl_apply]
    omega

name: Operad.SymOperad.nsComp_map_left
statement:
lemma nsComp_map_left {A : Type} [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] (a b : ℕ) {n : ℕ}
    (e : A ≃ Fin (a + 1 + b)) (i : A) (h : e i = ⟨a, by omega⟩) (x : P A) (y : P (Fin n)) :
    nsComp (R := R) a b (map (R := R) e x) y
      = map (R := R) ((compEquiv e (Equiv.refl (Fin n)) i).trans
          ((slotEquiv h).trans (insertEquiv a b n))) (comp (R := R) i x y)
proof:
:= by
  rw [nsComp_apply, comp_slot h, comp_map_left, map_map, map_map]

name: Operad.SymOperad.nsComp_assoc_par
statement:
theorem nsComp_assoc_par (a b c : ℕ) {n p : ℕ} (α : P (Fin (a + 1 + b + 1 + c)))
    (β : P (Fin n)) (γ : P (Fin p)) :
    reindex R (toNS P) (by omega)
        (nsComp (R := R) (a + n + b) c
          (reindex R (toNS P) (by omega)
            (nsComp (R := R) a (b + 1 + c) (reindex R (toNS P) (by omega) α) β)) γ)
      = nsComp (R := R) a (b + p + c)
          (reindex R (toNS P) (by omega) (nsComp (R := R) (a + 1 + b) c α γ)) β
proof:
:= by
  have k2 : a + n + (b + 1 + c) = a + n + b + 1 + c := by omega
  have k3 : a + 1 + b + 1 + c = a + 1 + (b + 1 + c) := by omega
  have k4 : a + 1 + b + p + c = a + 1 + (b + p + c) := by omega
  
  let s₁ : Fin (a + 1 + b + 1 + c) := ⟨a, by omega⟩
  let s₂ : Fin (a + 1 + b + 1 + c) := ⟨a + 1 + b, by omega⟩
  have hik : s₁ ≠ s₂ := fun e => by
    have := congrArg Fin.val e
    simp only [s₁, s₂] at this
    omega
  rw [reindex_toNS, reindex_toNS, reindex_toNS, reindex_toNS]
  have h₁ : (finCongr k3) s₁ = (⟨a, by omega⟩ : Fin (a + 1 + (b + 1 + c))) := Fin.ext rfl
  rw [nsComp_map_left a (b + 1 + c) (finCongr k3) s₁ h₁, map_map]
  have h₂ : (((compEquiv (finCongr k3) (Equiv.refl (Fin n)) s₁).trans ((slotEquiv h₁).trans
      (insertEquiv a (b + 1 + c) n))).trans (finCongr k2)) (Sum.inl ⟨s₂, Ne.symm hik⟩)
      = (⟨a + n + b, by omega⟩ : Fin (a + n + b + 1 + c)) := by
    refine Fin.ext ?_
    simp only [Equiv.trans_apply, compEquiv, slotEquiv, Equiv.coe_fn_mk, Equiv.sumCongr_apply,
      Sum.map_inl, Equiv.subtypeEquivRight_apply_coe, insertEquiv_inl_val, finCongr_apply,
      Fin.val_cast, s₂]
    split_ifs <;> omega
  rw [nsComp_map_left (a + n + b) c _ (Sum.inl ⟨s₂, Ne.symm hik⟩) h₂, comp_assoc_par' hik,
    nsComp_apply (a + 1 + b) c, map_map (insertEquiv (a + 1 + b) c p) (finCongr k4)]
  have h₃ : ((insertEquiv (a + 1 + b) c p).trans (finCongr k4)) (Sum.inl ⟨s₁, hik⟩)
      = (⟨a, by omega⟩ : Fin (a + 1 + (b + p + c))) := by
    refine Fin.ext ?_
    simp only [Equiv.trans_apply, insertEquiv_inl_val, finCongr_apply, Fin.val_cast, s₁]
    split_ifs <;> omega
  rw [nsComp_map_left a (b + p + c) _ (Sum.inl ⟨s₁, hik⟩) h₃]
  simp only [map_map]
  refine map_eq_of_equiv_eq (fun y => Fin.ext ?_) _
  rcases y with ⟨(⟨⟨k, hk⟩, hne₂⟩ | q), hne₁⟩ | j
  · have hk₂ : k ≠ a + 1 + b := fun e => hne₂ (Fin.ext e)
    have hk₁ : k ≠ a := fun e => hne₁ (by
      simp only [Sum.inl.injEq, Subtype.mk.injEq]; exact Fin.ext e)
    simp only [Equiv.trans_apply, parEquiv_symm_inl_inl, compEquiv, slotEquiv, Equiv.coe_fn_mk,
      Equiv.sumCongr_apply, Sum.map_inl, Equiv.subtypeEquivRight_apply_coe, insertEquiv_inl_val,
      finCongr_apply, Fin.val_cast, Equiv.refl_apply]
    split_ifs <;> omega
  · simp only [Equiv.trans_apply, parEquiv_symm_inl_inr, compEquiv, slotEquiv, Equiv.coe_fn_mk,
      Equiv.sumCongr_apply, Sum.map_inl, Sum.map_inr, Equiv.subtypeEquivRight_apply_coe,
      insertEquiv_inl_val, insertEquiv_inr_val, finCongr_apply, Fin.val_cast, Equiv.refl_apply]
    split_ifs <;> omega
  · simp only [Equiv.trans_apply, parEquiv_symm_inr, compEquiv, slotEquiv, Equiv.coe_fn_mk,
      Equiv.sumCongr_apply, Sum.map_inl, Sum.map_inr, Equiv.subtypeEquivRight_apply_coe,
      insertEquiv_inl_val, insertEquiv_inr_val, finCongr_apply, Fin.val_cast, Equiv.refl_apply]
    split_ifs <;> omega

name: Operad.SymOperad.toNS_comp
statement:
lemma toNS_comp (a b : ℕ) {n : ℕ} (x : toNS P (a + 1 + b)) (y : toNS P n) :
    NSOperad.comp (R := R) a b x y
      = map (R := R) (insertEquiv a b n) (comp (R := R) (⟨a, by omega⟩ : Fin (a + 1 + b)) x y)
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: Operad.SymOperad.toNS_one
statement: lemma toNS_one : (NSOperad.one R : toNS P 1) = map (R := R) unitFinOne (one R)
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.Sym.Perm.toNS_comp_eq_permComp
statement:
theorem toNS_comp_eq_permComp (a b : ℕ) {n : ℕ} (x : Fin (a + 1 + b) → R) (y : Fin n → R) :
    NSOperad.comp (R := R) (P := SymOperad.toNS (Sym.Perm R)) a b x y
      = Operad.Perm.permComp a b x y
proof:
:= by
  funext m
  rw [SymOperad.toNS_comp]
  show compFun (⟨a, by omega⟩ : Fin (a + 1 + b)) x y ((insertEquiv a b n).symm m) = _
  have hm := m.isLt
  by_cases h1 : (m : ℕ) < a
  · rw [Operad.Perm.permComp_apply_lt a b x y m h1 (by omega)]
    have : (insertEquiv a b n).symm m = Sum.inl ⟨⟨m, by omega⟩, fun e => by
        have := congrArg Fin.val e; simp only at this; omega⟩ := by
      simp [insertEquiv, h1]
    rw [this, compFun_inl, mul_comm]
  · by_cases h2 : (m : ℕ) < a + n
    · rw [Operad.Perm.permComp_apply_mid a b x y m (by omega) h2 (by omega) (by omega)]
      have : (insertEquiv a b n).symm m = Sum.inr ⟨m - a, by omega⟩ := by
        simp [insertEquiv, h1, h2]
      rw [this, compFun_inr]
    · rw [Operad.Perm.permComp_apply_ge a b x y m (by omega) (by omega)]
      have : (insertEquiv a b n).symm m = Sum.inl ⟨⟨m - n + 1, by omega⟩, fun e => by
          have := congrArg Fin.val e; simp only at this; omega⟩ := by
        simp [insertEquiv, h1, h2]
      rw [this, compFun_inl, mul_comm]

name: Operad.Graded.projF_apply
statement:
lemma projF_apply (N : ℕ) (x : α → K) (a : α) :
    projF K W N x a = if W a = N then x a else 0
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.Graded.linearEquivFunOnFinite_wproj
statement:
lemma linearEquivFunOnFinite_wproj (N : ℕ) (v : α →₀ K) :
    Finsupp.linearEquivFunOnFinite K K α (wproj K W N v) =
      projF K W N (Finsupp.linearEquivFunOnFinite K K α v)
proof:
:= by
  funext a
  simp [wproj_apply, projF_apply]

name: Operad.Graded.isBelow_iff_isBelowF
statement:
lemma isBelow_iff_isBelowF {N : ℕ} {v : α →₀ K} :
    IsBelow (K := K) (W := W) N v ↔ IsBelowF K W N (Finsupp.linearEquivFunOnFinite K K α v)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h a ha
    have := congrArg (fun f => f a) (h (W a) ha)
    simpa [wproj_apply] using this
  · intro h k hk
    ext a
    rw [wproj_apply]
    split_ifs with ha
    · simpa using h a (ha ▸ hk)
    · rfl

name: Operad.Graded.projF_mem_grF
statement:
lemma projF_mem_grF {U : Submodule K (α → K)} {N : ℕ} {x : α → K} (hx : x ∈ U)
    (hN : IsBelowF K W N x) : projF K W N x ∈ grF K W U
proof:
:= by
  set e := Finsupp.linearEquivFunOnFinite K K α
  refine ⟨wproj K W N (e.symm x), wproj_mem_grW ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩ ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [isBelow_iff_isBelowF, LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply]
    exact hN
  · show e (wproj K W N (e.symm x)) = _
    rw [linearEquivFunOnFinite_wproj, LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply]

name: Operad.Graded.grF_le
statement:
lemma grF_le {U P : Submodule K (α → K)}
    (h : ∀ N, ∀ x ∈ U, IsBelowF K W N x → projF K W N x ∈ P) : grF K W U ≤ P
proof:
:= by
  set e := Finsupp.linearEquivFunOnFinite K K α
  refine Submodule.map_le_iff_le_comap.2 (grW_le fun N v hv hN => ?_)
  obtain ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩ := hv
  rw [Submodule.mem_comap]
  show e (wproj K W N (e.symm x)) ∈ P
  rw [linearEquivFunOnFinite_wproj, LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply]
  rw [isBelow_iff_isBelowF] at hN
  change IsBelowF K W N (e (e.symm x)) at hN
  rw [LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply] at hN
  exact h N x hx hN

name: Operad.Graded.le_sup_univ
statement: lemma le_sup_univ (a : α) : W a ≤ Finset.univ.sup W
proof: := Finset.le_sup (Finset.mem_univ a)

name: Operad.Graded.finrank_grF
statement: theorem finrank_grF (U : Submodule K (α → K)) : finrank K (grF K W U) = finrank K U
proof:
:= by
  set e := Finsupp.linearEquivFunOnFinite K K α
  rw [grF, LinearEquiv.finrank_map_eq]
  rw [finrank_grW (U.map e.symm.toLinearMap) (B := Finset.univ.sup W) fun v _ k hk => ?_]
  · exact LinearEquiv.finrank_map_eq e.symm U
  · ext a
    rw [wproj_apply]
    split_ifs with ha
    · have := le_sup_univ (W := W) a
      omega
    · rfl

name: Operad.Graded.orthogonal_grF
statement:
theorem orthogonal_grF {c : α → K} (hc : ∀ a, c a ≠ 0) (U : Submodule K (α → K)) :
    (diagForm c).orthogonal (grF K W U) = grF K (revW W) ((diagForm c).orthogonal U)
proof:
:= by
  set B := Finset.univ.sup W with hB
  have hle : grF K (revW W) ((diagForm c).orthogonal U) ≤ (diagForm c).orthogonal (grF K W U) := by
    refine grF_le fun N' x' hx' hN' => ?_
    rw [LinearMap.BilinForm.mem_orthogonal_iff]
    intro z hz
    revert z
    show grF K W U ≤ LinearMap.ker (LinearMap.flip (diagForm c) (projF K (revW W) N' x'))
    refine grF_le fun M x hx hM => ?_
    rw [LinearMap.mem_ker, LinearMap.flip_apply, diagForm_apply]
    have hxx' : ∑ a, c a * x a * x' a = 0 :=
      (LinearMap.BilinForm.mem_orthogonal_iff.1 hx') x hx
    have hterm : ∀ a, c a * projF K W M x a * projF K (revW W) N' x' a =
        if M + N' = B then c a * x a * x' a else 0 := by
      intro a
      have haB := le_sup_univ (W := W) a
      simp only [projF_apply, revW]
      by_cases h1 : W a = M
      · by_cases h2 : B - W a = N'
        · rw [if_pos h1, if_pos h2, if_pos (by omega)]
        · rw [if_neg h2, mul_zero]
          split_ifs with h3
          · exact absurd (by omega) h2
          · rfl
      · rw [if_neg h1, mul_zero, zero_mul]
        split_ifs with h3
        · rcases Nat.lt_or_gt_of_ne h1 with h4 | h4
          · rw [hN' a (by simp only [revW]; omega), mul_zero]
          · rw [hM a h4, mul_zero, zero_mul]
        · rfl
    rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl fun a _ => hterm a]
    split_ifs
    · exact hxx'
    · simp
  have hnd := diagForm_nondegenerate hc
  refine (Submodule.eq_of_le_of_finrank_eq hle ?_).symm
  rw [finrank_grF, LinearMap.BilinForm.finrank_orthogonal hnd,
    LinearMap.BilinForm.finrank_orthogonal hnd, finrank_grF]

name: Operad.ShuffleBar.wdegB_fullBar
statement: lemma wdegB_fullBar (w : E → ℕ) (m : LTree E) : wdegB w (fullBar m) = wdeg w m
proof:
:= by
  rw [wdegB, ← wdeg_mapDec Prod.fst w, full_fullBar]

name: Operad.ShuffleBar.toMono_wproj
statement:
lemma toMono_wproj (w : E → ℕ) (n N : ℕ) (v : BarTree E →₀ K) :
    toMono K n (wproj K (wdegB w) N v) = projF K (wMono w n) N (toMono K n v)
proof:
:= by
  funext m
  show (tauS m.1 : K) * wproj K (wdegB w) N v (fullBar m.1) = _
  rw [wproj_apply, wdegB_fullBar, projF_apply]
  show _ = if wdeg w m.1 = N then (tauS m.1 : K) * v (fullBar m.1) else 0
  split_ifs <;> simp

name: Operad.ShuffleBar.isBelowF_toMono
statement:
lemma isBelowF_toMono (w : E → ℕ) {n N : ℕ} {v : BarTree E →₀ K}
    (hv : IsBelow (K := K) (W := wdegB w) N v) : IsBelowF K (wMono w n) N (toMono K n v)
proof:
:= by
  intro m hm
  have h := congrArg (fun f => f (fullBar m.1)) (hv (wMono w n m) hm)
  simp only [wproj_apply, wdegB_fullBar, wMono, if_true, Finsupp.coe_zero, Pi.zero_apply] at h
  show (tauS m.1 : K) * v (fullBar m.1) = 0
  rw [h, mul_zero]

name: Operad.ShuffleBar.isBelow_of_isBelowF_toMono
proof:
:= by
  intro k hk
  ext b
  rw [wproj_apply]
  split_ifs with hb
  · by_contra h0
    have hA : Adm n (n - 1) b := hvC (Finsupp.mem_support_iff.2 h0)
    have hm := full_mem_monomials hA
    have hb' := eq_fullBar_of_adm hA
    have h1 := hv ⟨_, hm⟩ (by
      show N < wdeg w (b.mapDec Prod.fst)
      rw [← wdegB_fullBar, ← hb']
      omega)
    change (tauS (b.mapDec Prod.fst) : K) * v (fullBar (b.mapDec Prod.fst)) = 0 at h1
    rw [← hb'] at h1
    have h2 := congrArg (fun z => (tauS (b.mapDec Prod.fst) : K) * z) h1
    simp only [mul_zero, ← mul_assoc, tauS_cast_mul_self, one_mul] at h2
    exact h0 h2
  · rfl

name: Operad.ShuffleBar.map_toMono_grW
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · refine Submodule.map_le_iff_le_comap.2 (grW_le fun N v hv hN => ?_)
    rw [Submodule.mem_comap, toMono_wproj]
    exact projF_mem_grF ⟨v, hv, rfl⟩ (isBelowF_toMono w hN)
  · refine grF_le fun N x hx hN => ?_
    obtain ⟨v, hv, rfl⟩ := hx
    rw [← toMono_wproj]
    exact Submodule.mem_map_of_mem
      (wproj_mem_grW hv (isBelow_of_isBelowF_toMono w (hV hv) hN))

name: Operad.ShuffleBar.KDmono_eq_map
statement:
lemma KDmono_eq_map (R : Submodule K (Mono E 3 → K)) {n : ℕ} (hn : 2 ≤ n) :
    KDmono K R n = (KD K R n).map (toMono K n)
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  constructor
  · intro hx
    exact ⟨((kdEquivKDmono R hn).symm ⟨x, hx⟩).1, ((kdEquivKDmono R hn).symm ⟨x, hx⟩).2,
      congrArg Subtype.val ((kdEquivKDmono R hn).apply_symm_apply ⟨x, hx⟩)⟩
  · rintro ⟨v, hv, rfl⟩
    exact ((kdEquivKDmono R hn) ⟨v, hv⟩).2

name: Operad.ShuffleBar.KDmono_eq_grF
statement:
theorem KDmono_eq_grF (w : E → ℕ) {R R₀ : Submodule K (Mono E 3 → K)} {n : ℕ} (hn : 2 ≤ n)
    (h : KD K R₀ n = grW K (wdegB w) (KD K R n)) :
    KDmono K R₀ n = grF K (wMono w n) (KDmono K R n)
proof:
:= by
  rw [KDmono_eq_map R₀ hn, h,
    map_toMono_grW w (show KD K R n ≤ C K n (n - 1) from inf_le_left), ← KDmono_eq_map R hn]

name: Operad.ShuffleBar.idealOf_dualRel_eq_orthogonal
statement:
theorem idealOf_dualRel_eq_orthogonal (R : Submodule K (Mono E 3 → K)) (n : ℕ) :
    idealOf K (dualRel K R) n =
      (diagForm fun _ : Mono E n => (1 : K)).orthogonal (KDmono K R n)
proof:
:= by
  rw [KDmono_eq_orthogonal, LinearMap.BilinForm.orthogonal_orthogonal
    (diagForm_nondegenerate fun _ => one_ne_zero) (diagForm_isRefl _)]

name: Operad.ShuffleBar.idealOf_dualRel_eq_grF
proof:
:= by
  rw [idealOf_dualRel_eq_orthogonal, KDmono_eq_grF w hn h,
    orthogonal_grF (fun _ => one_ne_zero), ← idealOf_dualRel_eq_orthogonal]

name: Operad.ShuffleBar.three_le_arity_of_isEdgeRoot
statement:
lemma three_le_arity_of_isEdgeRoot : ∀ {u : LTree E} {s : Bool}, u.IsEdgeRoot s → 3 ≤ u.arity
  | node _ (node _ a b) c, false, _ => by
    have
proof:
:= arity_pos a
    have := arity_pos b
    have := arity_pos c
    simp only [arity]
    omega
  | node _ c (node _ a b), true, _ => by
    have := arity_pos a
    have := arity_pos b
    have := arity_pos c
    simp only [arity]
    omega

name: Operad.ShuffleBar.plug_leaf
statement:
lemma plug_leaf : ∀ t : LTree E, t.plug leaf = t
  | leaf _ => rfl
  | node e l r => by rw [plug, plug_leaf l, plug_leaf r]

name: Operad.ShuffleBar.substAt_of_mem_monomials_three
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hts, htl⟩ := (mem_monomials 3 t).1 ht
  have key : ∀ ins : ℕ → LTree E, (∀ i < 3, ins i = leaf i) → σ.plug ins = σ := fun ins hins => by
    conv_rhs => rw [← plug_leaf σ]
    exact plug_congr fun a ha => hins a (lt_three_of_perm hσ a ha)
  have h3 : t.arity = 3 := arity_of_mem_monomials ht
  have hp : p = [] := by
    rcases p with _ | ⟨b, q⟩
    · rfl
    · exfalso
      have h1 := three_le_arity_of_isEdgeRoot he
      cases t with
      | leaf => simp [arity] at h3
      | node e l r =>
        have h2 := arity_subtreeAt_cons_lt e l r b q
        omega
  subst hp
  obtain ⟨e, f, rfl | rfl | rfl⟩ := mono3_cases hts htl <;> cases s <;>
    first
    | (simp [IsEdge, IsEdgeRoot] at he; done)
    | (simp only [substAt, replaceAt_nil, subtreeAt_nil]
       refine key _ fun i hi => ?_
       interval_cases i <;> rfl)

name: Operad.ShuffleBar.idealOf_three
statement: theorem idealOf_three (R' : Submodule K (Mono E 3 → K)) : idealOf K R' 3 = R'
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · rw [idealOf, Submodule.span_le]
    rintro _ ⟨t, p, s, r, hr, he, rfl⟩
    have : substVec K 3 t.1 p s r = r := by
      funext σ'
      simp only [substVec, Finset.sum_apply, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, vecOf]
      rw [Finset.sum_eq_single σ']
      · rw [substAt_of_mem_monomials_three t.2 he (mono_shape σ').2.1, if_pos rfl, mul_one]
      · intro σ _ hσ
        rw [substAt_of_mem_monomials_three t.2 he (mono_shape σ).2.1,
          if_neg fun h => hσ (Subtype.ext h).symm, mul_zero]
      · simp
    rw [SetLike.mem_coe, this]
    exact hr
  · intro r hr
    by_cases hne : Nonempty (Mono E 3)
    · obtain ⟨t⟩ := hne
      obtain ⟨-, -, e, l, r', ht⟩ := mono_shape t
      have hs := (mem_monomials 3 t.1).1 t.2
      have he : t.1.IsEdge [] (side3 t.1) := by
        obtain ⟨e', f', h | h | h⟩ := mono3_cases hs.1 hs.2 <;> rw [h] <;> trivial
      have : substVec K 3 t.1 [] (side3 t.1) r = r := by
        funext σ'
        simp only [substVec, Finset.sum_apply, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, vecOf]
        rw [Finset.sum_eq_single σ']
        · rw [substAt_of_mem_monomials_three t.2 he (mono_shape σ').2.1, if_pos rfl, mul_one]
        · intro σ _ hσ
          rw [substAt_of_mem_monomials_three t.2 he (mono_shape σ).2.1,
            if_neg fun h => hσ (Subtype.ext h).symm, mul_zero]
        · simp
      rw [← this]
      exact substVec_mem_idealOf K R' t he hr
    · have : r = 0 := funext fun σ => absurd ⟨σ⟩ hne
      rw [this]
      exact zero_mem _

name: Operad.ShuffleBar.dualRel_eq_grF
proof:
:= by
  have := idealOf_dualRel_eq_grF w (by norm_num) h
  rwa [idealOf_three, idealOf_three] at this

name: Operad.ShuffleBar.idealOf_dualRel_eq_grF_of_isGroebner
proof:
:=
  idealOf_dualRel_eq_grF w hn (KD_eq_grW_of_isGroebner rk w sr N hs hG hG₀ hsR hR₀ hn)

name: Operad.ShuffleBridge.toS_leaf
statement: @[simp] lemma toS_leaf (a : ℕ) : toS (.leaf a : LTree (F 2)) = .leaf a
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.ShuffleBridge.toS_node
statement:
@[simp] lemma toS_node (e : F 2) (l r : LTree (F 2)) :
    toS (.node e l r) = .node e ![toS l, toS r]
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.ShuffleBridge.ofS_leaf
statement: @[simp] lemma ofS_leaf (a : ℕ) : ofS (.leaf a : STree F) = .leaf a
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.ShuffleBridge.ofS_node
statement:
lemma ofS_node (e : F 2) (c : Fin 2 → STree F) :
    ofS (.node e c) = .node e (ofS (c 0)) (ofS (c 1))
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.ShuffleBridge.ofS_toS
statement:
@[simp] lemma ofS_toS : ∀ t : LTree (F 2), ofS (toS t) = t
  | .leaf _ => rfl
  | .node e l r => by
    rw [toS_node, ofS_node]
    simp only [Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one, ofS_toS l, ofS_toS r]

name: Operad.ShuffleBridge.toS_injective
statement: lemma toS_injective : Function.Injective (toS : LTree (F 2) → STree F)
proof:
:=
  Function.LeftInverse.injective ofS_toS

name: Operad.ShuffleBridge.node_eq_of_two
statement: lemma node_eq_of_two (e : F 2) (c : Fin 2 → STree F) : STree.node e c = .node e ![c 0, c 1]
proof:
:= by
  congr 1
  funext i
  fin_cases i <;> rfl

name: Operad.ShuffleBridge.toS_ofS
statement:
@[simp] lemma toS_ofS [BinaryGens F] : ∀ t : STree F, toS (ofS t) = t
  | .leaf _ => rfl
  | @STree.node _ k e c => by
    have ih : ∀ i, toS (ofS (c i)) = c i
proof:
:= fun i => toS_ofS (c i)
    by_cases hk : k = 2
    · subst hk
      rw [ofS_node, toS_node, ih 0, ih 1, ← node_eq_of_two]
    · exact ((BinaryGens.isEmpty_of_ne k hk).false e).elim

name: Operad.ShuffleBridge.ofS_injective
statement: lemma ofS_injective [BinaryGens F] : Function.Injective (ofS : STree F → LTree (F 2))
proof:
:=
  Function.LeftInverse.injective toS_ofS

name: Operad.ShuffleBridge.labels_toS
statement:
lemma labels_toS : ∀ t : LTree (F 2), (toS t).labels = (t.labels : Multiset ℕ)
  | .leaf _ => rfl
  | .node e l r => by
    rw [toS_node, STree.labels_node, Fin.sum_univ_two, LTree.labels_node, ← Multiset.coe_add]
    exact congrArg₂ (· + ·) (labels_toS l) (labels_toS r)

name: Operad.ShuffleBridge.weight_toS
statement:
lemma weight_toS : ∀ t : LTree (F 2), (toS t).weight + 1 = t.arity
  | .leaf _ => rfl
  | .node e l r => by
    have hl
proof:
:= weight_toS l
    have hr := weight_toS r
    rw [toS_node, STree.weight_node, Fin.sum_univ_two]
    simp only [Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one, LTree.arity]
    omega

name: Operad.ShuffleBridge.first_toS
statement:
lemma first_toS : ∀ t : LTree (F 2), t.IsShuffle → (toS t).first = t.minLabel
  | .leaf _, _ => rfl
  | .node e l r, h => by
    rw [toS_node, STree.first_node _ _ (by omega), LTree.minLabel_node_of_shuffle h]
    exact first_toS l h.2.1

name: Operad.ShuffleBridge.isShuffle_toS_iff
statement:
lemma isShuffle_toS_iff : ∀ t : LTree (F 2), (toS t).IsShuffle ↔ t.IsShuffle
  | .leaf _ => Iff.rfl
  | .node e l r => by
    rw [toS_node, STree.isShuffle_node, LTree.isShuffle_node, Fin.forall_fin_two,
      Fin.strictMono_iff_lt_succ]
    simp only [Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one, isShuffle_toS_iff l,
      isShuffle_toS_iff r, Fin.forall_fin_one]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨-, ⟨hl, hr⟩, h⟩
      refine ⟨?_, hl, hr⟩
      have h' : (toS l).first < (toS r).first
proof:
:= h
      rwa [first_toS l hl, first_toS r hr] at h'
    · rintro ⟨h, hl, hr⟩
      refine ⟨by omega, ⟨hl, hr⟩, ?_⟩
      show (toS l).first < (toS r).first
      rwa [first_toS l hl, first_toS r hr]

name: Operad.ShuffleBridge.toS_plug
statement:
lemma toS_plug (ins : ℕ → LTree (F 2)) :
    ∀ m : LTree (F 2), toS (m.plug ins) = (toS m).subst fun a => toS (ins a)
  | .leaf _ => rfl
  | .node e l r => by
    show STree.node e ![toS (l.plug ins), toS (r.plug ins)] = _
    rw [toS_node, STree.subst_node, toS_plug ins l, toS_plug ins r]
    congr 1
    funext j
    fin_cases j <;> rfl

                                                                                       
def bpath (p : List Bool) : List ℕ
proof: := p.map Bool.toNat

name: Operad.ShuffleBridge.bpath_nil
statement: @[simp] lemma bpath_nil : bpath [] = []
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.ShuffleBridge.bpath_cons
statement: @[simp] lemma bpath_cons (b : Bool) (p : List Bool) : bpath (b :: p) = b.toNat :: bpath p
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.ShuffleBridge.toS_replaceAt
statement:
lemma toS_replaceAt : ∀ (t : LTree (F 2)) (p : List Bool) (u : LTree (F 2)),
    toS (t.replaceAt p u) = (toS t).replace (bpath p) (toS u)
  | t, [], u => by rw [LTree.replaceAt_nil, bpath_nil, STree.replace_nil]
  | .leaf _, _ :: _, _ => rfl
  | .node e l r, false :: p, u => by
    show STree.node e ![toS (l.replaceAt p u), toS r] = _
    rw [toS_node, bpath_cons, STree.replace_node_cons, toS_replaceAt l p u]
    congr 1
    funext j
    fin_cases j <;> rfl
  | .node e l r, true :: p, u => by
    show STree.node e ![toS l, toS (r.replaceAt p u)] = _
    rw [toS_node, bpath_cons, STree.replace_node_cons, toS_replaceAt r p u]
    congr 1
    funext j
    fin_cases j <;> rfl

name: Operad.ShuffleBridge.get?_toS
statement:
lemma get?_toS : ∀ (t : LTree (F 2)) (p : List Bool) {e : F 2} {l r : LTree (F 2)},
    t.subtreeAt p = .node e l r → (toS t).get? (bpath p) = some (toS (.node e l r))
  | t, [], _, _, _, h => by
    rw [LTree.subtreeAt_nil] at h
    rw [h]
    rfl
  | .leaf _, _ :: _, _, _, _, h => by cases h
  | .node _ l' _, false :: p, _, _, _, h => by
    rw [toS_node, bpath_cons, STree.get?_node_cons, dif_pos (by decide)]
    exact get?_toS l' p h
  | .node _ _ r', true :: p, _, _, _, h => by
    rw [toS_node, bpath_cons, STree.get?_node_cons, dif_pos (by decide)]
    exact get?_toS r' p h

name: Operad.ShuffleBridge.exists_path
statement:
lemma exists_path : ∀ (t : LTree (F 2)) (q : List ℕ) {w : STree F}, (toS t).get? q = some w →
    ∃ p, bpath p = q ∧ toS (t.subtreeAt p) = w
  | t, [], w, h => by
    rw [STree.get?_nil, Option.some_inj] at h
    exact ⟨[], rfl, by rw [LTree.subtreeAt_nil, h]⟩
  | .leaf _, _ :: _, _, h => by simp at h
  | .node e l r, i :: q, w, h => by
    rw [toS_node, STree.get?_node_cons_eq_some] at h
    obtain ⟨hi, h⟩
proof:
:= h
    match i, hi, h with
    | 0, _, h =>
      obtain ⟨p, hp, hw⟩ := exists_path l q h
      exact ⟨false :: p, by rw [bpath_cons, hp]; rfl, hw⟩
    | 1, _, h =>
      obtain ⟨p, hp, hw⟩ := exists_path r q h
      exact ⟨true :: p, by rw [bpath_cons, hp]; rfl, hw⟩

name: Operad.ShuffleBridge.toS_substAt
statement:
lemma toS_substAt (t : LTree (F 2)) (p : List Bool) (s : Bool) (m : LTree (F 2)) :
    toS (t.substAt p s m) =
      (toS t).replace (bpath p) ((toS m).subst fun a => toS ((t.subtreeAt p).winIns s a))
proof:
:= by
  rw [LTree.substAt, toS_replaceAt, toS_plug]

name: Operad.LTree.exists_window_plug
statement:
lemma exists_window_plug {m : LTree E} (hm : m ∈ monomials 3) {ys : ℕ → LTree E}
    (h01 : (ys 0).minLabel < (ys 1).minLabel) (h12 : (ys 1).minLabel < (ys 2).minLabel) :
    ∃ s, (m.plug ys).IsEdgeRoot s ∧ (m.plug ys).windowRoot s = m ∧
      ∀ a < 3, (m.plug ys).winIns s a = ys a
proof:
:= by
  have hm' := (mem_monomials 3 m).1 hm
  obtain ⟨e, f, h | h | h⟩ := mono3_cases hm'.1 hm'.2 <;> subst h
  · refine ⟨false, trivial, ?_, fun a ha => ?_⟩
    · have e0 : rank3 (ys 0).minLabel (ys 1).minLabel (ys 2).minLabel (ys 0).minLabel = 0 := by
        simp only [rank3]; split_ifs <;> omega
      have e1 : rank3 (ys 0).minLabel (ys 1).minLabel (ys 2).minLabel (ys 1).minLabel = 1 := by
        simp only [rank3]; split_ifs <;> omega
      have e2 : rank3 (ys 0).minLabel (ys 1).minLabel (ys 2).minLabel (ys 2).minLabel = 2 := by
        simp only [rank3]; split_ifs <;> omega
      simp [plug, windowRoot, window, e0, e1, e2]
    · interval_cases a <;> simp [plug, winIns, winInputs, ins3, h12]
  · refine ⟨false, trivial, ?_, fun a ha => ?_⟩
    · have e0 : rank3 (ys 0).minLabel (ys 2).minLabel (ys 1).minLabel (ys 0).minLabel = 0 := by
        simp only [rank3]; split_ifs <;> omega
      have e1 : rank3 (ys 0).minLabel (ys 2).minLabel (ys 1).minLabel (ys 2).minLabel = 2 := by
        simp only [rank3]; split_ifs <;> omega
      have e2 : rank3 (ys 0).minLabel (ys 2).minLabel (ys 1).minLabel (ys 1).minLabel = 1 := by
        simp only [rank3]; split_ifs <;> omega
      simp [plug, windowRoot, window, e0, e1, e2]
    · have h21 : ¬ (ys 2).minLabel < (ys 1).minLabel := by omega
      interval_cases a <;> simp [plug, winIns, winInputs, ins3, h21]
  · have hw : winInputs (node e (ys 0) (node f (ys 1) (ys 2))) true = (ys 0, ys 1, ys 2) := by
      cases ys 0 <;> rfl
    have hwr : windowRoot (node e (ys 0) (node f (ys 1) (ys 2))) true =
        window e f true (ys 1).minLabel (ys 2).minLabel (ys 0).minLabel := by
      cases ys 0 <;> rfl
    refine ⟨true, ?_, ?_, fun a ha => ?_⟩
    · show IsEdgeRoot (node e (ys 0) (node f (ys 1) (ys 2))) true
      cases ys 0 <;> trivial
    · show windowRoot (node e (ys 0) (node f (ys 1) (ys 2))) true = _
      have e0 : rank3 (ys 1).minLabel (ys 2).minLabel (ys 0).minLabel (ys 0).minLabel = 0 := by
        simp only [rank3]; split_ifs <;> omega
      have e1 : rank3 (ys 1).minLabel (ys 2).minLabel (ys 0).minLabel (ys 1).minLabel = 1 := by
        simp only [rank3]; split_ifs <;> omega
      have e2 : rank3 (ys 1).minLabel (ys 2).minLabel (ys 0).minLabel (ys 2).minLabel = 2 := by
        simp only [rank3]; split_ifs <;> omega
      rw [hwr]
      simp [window, e0, e1, e2]
    · change winIns (node e (ys 0) (node f (ys 1) (ys 2))) true a = ys a
      rw [winIns, hw]
      interval_cases a <;> rfl

name: Operad.ShuffleBridge.toS_mem
statement:
lemma toS_mem {n : ℕ} (t : LTree.Mono (F 2) n) :
    (toS t.1).IsShuffle ∧ (toS t.1).labels = (Finset.range n).val
proof:
:= by
  have h := (LTree.mem_monomials n t.1).1 t.2
  refine ⟨(isShuffle_toS_iff _).2 h.1, ?_⟩
  rw [labels_toS, Finset.range_val, ← Multiset.coe_range]
  exact Multiset.coe_eq_coe.2 h.2

name: Operad.ShuffleBridge.ofS_mem
statement:
lemma ofS_mem [BinaryGens F] {n : ℕ} (g : SMono F (Finset.range n)) :
    ofS g.1 ∈ LTree.monomials n
proof:
:= by
  rw [LTree.mem_monomials]
  have hs : (toS (ofS g.1)).IsShuffle := by
    rw [toS_ofS]
    exact g.isShuffle
  refine ⟨(isShuffle_toS_iff _).1 hs, ?_⟩
  have h1 : ((ofS g.1).labels : Multiset ℕ) = Multiset.range n := by
    rw [← labels_toS, toS_ofS]
    exact g.labels_eq
  exact Multiset.coe_eq_coe.1 (h1.trans (Multiset.coe_range n).symm)

name: Operad.ShuffleBridge.monoEquiv_val
statement:
@[simp] lemma monoEquiv_val [BinaryGens F] {n : ℕ} (t : LTree.Mono (F 2) n) :
    (monoEquiv F n t).1 = toS t.1
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.ShuffleBridge.monoEquiv_symm_val
statement:
@[simp] lemma monoEquiv_symm_val [BinaryGens F] {n : ℕ} (g : SMono F (Finset.range n)) :
    ((monoEquiv F n).symm g).1 = ofS g.1
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.ShuffleBridge.exists_ctx_of_edge
statement:
theorem exists_ctx_of_edge [BinaryGens F] {n : ℕ} (t : LTree.Mono (F 2) n) {p : List Bool}
    {s : Bool} (he : t.1.IsEdge p s) :
    ∃ f : SMono F (Finset.range 3) → SMono F (Finset.range n), IsSCtx f ∧
      ∀ σ : LTree.Mono (F 2) 3, f (monoEquiv F 3 σ) =
        monoEquiv F n ⟨t.1.substAt p s σ.1, LTree.substAt_mem_monomials t.2 he σ.2⟩
proof:
:= by
  have ht := (LTree.mem_monomials n t.1).1 t.2
  have hnd : t.1.labels.Nodup := ht.2.nodup_iff.2 List.nodup_range
  have hw := LTree.winSpec_of_edge he ht.1 hnd
  refine ⟨fun g => monoEquiv F n ⟨t.1.substAt p s (ofS g.1),
      LTree.substAt_mem_monomials t.2 he (ofS_mem g)⟩,
    ⟨toS t.1, bpath p, fun a => toS ((t.1.subtreeAt p).winIns s a), ?_, ⟨fun a _ => ?_,
      fun a ha b hb => ?_, fun a ha b hb hab => ?_⟩, fun g => ?_⟩, fun σ => ?_⟩
  · obtain ⟨e, l, r, h⟩ := he.exists_node
    rw [get?_toS t.1 p h]
    rfl
  · exact (isShuffle_toS_iff _).2 (hw.shuffle a)
  · rw [labels_toS, Multiset.mem_coe] at hb
    have ha3 : a < 3 := Finset.mem_range.1 ha
    have hb' : b ∈ (t.1.subtreeAt p).labels := by
      refine hw.perm.symm.subset ?_
      simp only [List.mem_append]
      interval_cases a
      · exact Or.inl (Or.inl hb)
      · exact Or.inl (Or.inr hb)
      · exact Or.inr hb
    exact Finset.mem_range.2
      (List.mem_range.1 (ht.2.subset (LTree.labels_subtreeAt_subset _ _ hb')))
  · simp only
    rw [first_toS _ (hw.shuffle a), first_toS _ (hw.shuffle b)]
    exact hw.mono a b hab (Finset.mem_range.1 hb)
  · show toS (t.1.substAt p s (ofS g.1)) = _
    rw [toS_substAt, toS_ofS]
  · apply Subtype.ext
    show toS (t.1.substAt p s (ofS (toS σ.1))) = toS (t.1.substAt p s σ.1)
    rw [ofS_toS]

name: Operad.ShuffleBridge.exists_edge_of_ctx
statement:
theorem exists_edge_of_ctx [BinaryGens F] {B : Finset ℕ}
    {f : SMono F (Finset.range 3) → SMono F B} (hf : IsSCtx f)
    (σ₀ : SMono F (Finset.range 3)) :
    ∃ p s, (ofS (f σ₀).1).IsEdge p s ∧ (ofS (f σ₀).1).windowAt p s = ofS σ₀.1 ∧
      ∀ g, ofS (f g).1 = (ofS (f σ₀).1).substAt p s (ofS g.1)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨q, xs, hget, hin, hrep⟩ := IsSCtx.normal hf σ₀
  have hTS : toS (ofS (f σ₀).1) = (f σ₀).1 := toS_ofS _
  rw [← hTS] at hget
  obtain ⟨p, rfl, hp⟩ := exists_path _ q hget
  have hxs : ∀ a ∈ Finset.range 3, toS (ofS (xs a)) = xs a := fun a _ => toS_ofS _
  have hsub : (ofS (f σ₀).1).subtreeAt p = (ofS σ₀.1).plug fun a => ofS (xs a) := by
    apply toS_injective
    rw [hp, toS_plug, toS_ofS]
    exact subst_congr _ fun a ha => (hxs a (σ₀.mem_labels.1 ha)).symm
  have hmin : ∀ a ∈ Finset.range 3, (ofS (xs a)).minLabel = (xs a).first := fun a ha => by
    have hs : (ofS (xs a)).IsShuffle := by
      rw [← isShuffle_toS_iff, hxs a ha]
      exact hin.shuffle a ha
    rw [← first_toS _ hs, hxs a ha]
  have h3 : ∀ a < 3, a ∈ Finset.range 3 := fun a ha => Finset.mem_range.2 ha
  have h01 : (ofS (xs 0)).minLabel < (ofS (xs 1)).minLabel := by
    rw [hmin 0 (h3 0 (by norm_num)), hmin 1 (h3 1 (by norm_num))]
    exact hin.mono (h3 0 (by norm_num)) (h3 1 (by norm_num)) (by norm_num)
  have h12 : (ofS (xs 1)).minLabel < (ofS (xs 2)).minLabel := by
    rw [hmin 1 (h3 1 (by norm_num)), hmin 2 (h3 2 (by norm_num))]
    exact hin.mono (h3 1 (by norm_num)) (h3 2 (by norm_num)) (by norm_num)
  obtain ⟨s, hedge, hwin, hins⟩ :=
    LTree.exists_window_plug (ys := fun a => ofS (xs a)) (ofS_mem σ₀) h01 h12
  refine ⟨p, s, ?_, ?_, fun g => ?_⟩
  · show ((ofS (f σ₀).1).subtreeAt p).IsEdgeRoot s
    rw [hsub]
    exact hedge
  · show ((ofS (f σ₀).1).subtreeAt p).windowRoot s = _
    rw [hsub]
    exact hwin
  · apply toS_injective
    rw [toS_ofS, hrep g, toS_substAt, hTS, hsub, toS_ofS]
    congr 1
    refine subst_congr _ fun a ha => ?_
    have ha3 := Finset.mem_range.1 (g.mem_labels.1 ha)
    rw [hins a ha3, hxs a (h3 a ha3)]

name: Operad.ShuffleBridge.vecEquiv_apply
statement:
lemma vecEquiv_apply {n : ℕ} (v : LTree.Mono (F 2) n → K) (g : SMono F (Finset.range n)) :
    vecEquiv F K n v g = v ((monoEquiv F n).symm g)
proof:
:= by
  simp [vecEquiv, Finsupp.domLCongr_apply, Finsupp.equivMapDomain_apply]

name: Operad.ShuffleBridge.vecEquiv_symm_apply
statement:
lemma vecEquiv_symm_apply {n : ℕ} (w : SMono F (Finset.range n) →₀ K) (x : LTree.Mono (F 2) n) :
    (vecEquiv F K n).symm w x = w (monoEquiv F n x)
proof:
:= by
  have := vecEquiv_apply K ((vecEquiv F K n).symm w) (monoEquiv F n x)
  rw [LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply, Equiv.symm_apply_apply] at this
  exact this.symm

name: Operad.ShuffleBridge.vecEquiv_eq_sum
statement:
lemma vecEquiv_eq_sum {n : ℕ} (v : LTree.Mono (F 2) n → K) :
    vecEquiv F K n v = ∑ x, v x • Finsupp.single (monoEquiv F n x) 1
proof:
:= by
  classical
  ext g
  rw [vecEquiv_apply, Finsupp.finsetSum_apply,
    Finset.sum_eq_single ((monoEquiv F n).symm g) (fun x _ hx => ?_) (by simp)]
  · simp
  · rw [Finsupp.smul_apply, Finsupp.single_apply, if_neg, smul_zero]
    intro h
    exact hx (by rw [← h, Equiv.symm_apply_apply])

name: Operad.ShuffleBridge.vecEquiv_vecOf
statement:
lemma vecEquiv_vecOf {n : ℕ} {t : LTree (F 2)} (ht : t ∈ LTree.monomials n) :
    vecEquiv F K n (LTree.vecOf K n t) = Finsupp.single (monoEquiv F n ⟨t, ht⟩) 1
proof:
:= by
  classical
  ext g
  rw [vecEquiv_apply, Finsupp.single_apply, LTree.vecOf]
  by_cases h : monoEquiv F n ⟨t, ht⟩ = g
  · rw [if_pos h, if_pos]
    rw [← h, Equiv.symm_apply_apply]
  · rw [if_neg h, if_neg]
    intro h'
    apply h
    rw [← Equiv.apply_symm_apply (monoEquiv F n) g]
    exact congrArg _ (Subtype.ext h'.symm)

name: Operad.ShuffleBridge.vecEquiv_substVec
proof:
:= by
  rw [vecEquiv_eq_sum K (n := 3), Finsupp.mapDomain_finsetSum, LTree.substVec, map_sum]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun σ _ => ?_
  rw [map_smul, vecEquiv_vecOf K (LTree.substAt_mem_monomials t.2 he σ.2),
    Finsupp.mapDomain_smul, Finsupp.mapDomain_single, hf σ]

name: Operad.ShuffleBridge.ruleVec_mem
statement:
lemma ruleVec_mem (hsrc : ∀ r, G.src r = Finset.range 3) (r : ρ) :
    ruleVec G hsrc r ∈ (G.rw (Finset.range 3)).ideal
proof:
:=
  G.ideal_cast (hsrc r) ((G.rw (G.src r)).sub_mem_ideal
    ⟨r, id, O.toCtxOrder.ctx_id _, rfl, (Finsupp.mapDomain_id).symm⟩)

name: Operad.ShuffleBridge.cast_rfl
statement: lemma cast_rfl {A : Finset ℕ} : (SMono.cast (rfl : A = A) : SMono F A → SMono F A) = id
proof:
:=
  funext fun _ => Subtype.ext rfl

name: Operad.ShuffleBridge.mapDomain_mem_map_idealOf
proof:
:= by
  subst hC
  rw [cast_rfl, Finsupp.mapDomain_id] at hv
  obtain ⟨w, hw, rfl⟩ := hv
  by_cases hne : Nonempty (SMono F (Finset.range 3))
  · obtain ⟨σ₀⟩ := hne
    obtain ⟨p, s, he, -, hall⟩ := exists_edge_of_ctx hf σ₀
    set t : LTree.Mono (F 2) n := (monoEquiv F n).symm (f σ₀)
    have hfσ : ∀ σ : LTree.Mono (F 2) 3, f (monoEquiv F 3 σ) =
        monoEquiv F n ⟨t.1.substAt p s σ.1, LTree.substAt_mem_monomials t.2 he σ.2⟩ :=
      fun σ => Subtype.ext (ofS_injective (by
        rw [hall]
        simp only [monoEquiv_val, ofS_toS]
        rfl))
    show Finsupp.mapDomain f (vecEquiv F K 3 w) ∈ _
    rw [← vecEquiv_substVec K t he w hfσ]
    exact Submodule.mem_map_of_mem (LTree.substVec_mem_idealOf K R t he hw)
  · have : vecEquiv F K 3 w = 0 := by
      ext g
      exact (hne ⟨g⟩).elim
    show Finsupp.mapDomain f (vecEquiv F K 3 w) ∈ _
    rw [this, Finsupp.mapDomain_zero]
    exact Submodule.zero_mem _

name: Operad.ShuffleBridge.map_idealOf
statement:
theorem map_idealOf (hsrc : ∀ r, G.src r = Finset.range 3)
    (R : Submodule K (LTree.Mono (F 2) 3 → K))
    (hR : R.map (vecEquiv F K 3).toLinearMap = Submodule.span K (Set.range (ruleVec G hsrc)))
    (n : ℕ) :
    (LTree.idealOf K R n).map (vecEquiv F K n).toLinearMap = (G.rw (Finset.range n)).ideal
proof:
:= by
  refine le_antisymm (Submodule.map_le_iff_le_comap.2 (Submodule.span_le.2 ?_)) ?_
  · rintro _ ⟨t, p, s, r, hr, he, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨f, hf, hfσ⟩ := exists_ctx_of_edge t he
    rw [SetLike.mem_coe, Submodule.mem_comap]
    show vecEquiv F K n (LTree.substVec K n t.1 p s r) ∈ (G.rw (Finset.range n)).ideal
    rw [vecEquiv_substVec K t he r hfσ]
    refine G.mapDomain_mem_ideal hf ?_
    have h3 : vecEquiv F K 3 r ∈ R.map (vecEquiv F K 3).toLinearMap :=
      Submodule.mem_map_of_mem hr
    rw [hR] at h3
    exact Submodule.span_le.2 (by rintro _ ⟨r', rfl⟩; exact ruleVec_mem G hsrc r') h3
  · rw [Rules.ideal_eq_span]
    refine Submodule.span_le.2 ?_
    rintro _ ⟨r, f, hf, rfl⟩
    refine mapDomain_mem_map_idealOf R (hsrc r) hf ?_
    rw [hR]
    exact Submodule.subset_span ⟨r, rfl⟩

name: Operad.ShuffleBridge.isSCtx_relabelM
statement:
lemma isSCtx_relabelM {A B : Finset ℕ} (φ : ℕ → ℕ) (hφ : StrictMonoOn φ A)
    (himg : A.image φ = B) : IsSCtx (relabelM (E := E) φ hφ himg)
proof:
:=
  ⟨leaf 0, [], fun a => leaf (φ a), rfl,
    ⟨fun _ _ => trivial, fun a ha b hb => by
      rw [labels_leaf, Multiset.mem_singleton] at hb
      rw [hb, ← himg]
      exact Finset.mem_image_of_mem φ ha, fun _ ha _ hb hab => hφ ha hb hab⟩,
    fun _ => by rw [replace_nil]; rfl⟩

name: Operad.ShuffleBridge.posIn_lt
statement: lemma posIn_lt {C : Finset ℕ} {a : ℕ} (ha : a ∈ C) : posIn C a < C.card
proof:
:= by
  rw [posIn, dif_pos ha]
  exact Fin.is_lt _

name: Operad.ShuffleBridge.eltIn_mem
statement: lemma eltIn_mem {C : Finset ℕ} {b : ℕ} (hb : b < C.card) : eltIn C b ∈ C
proof:
:= by
  rw [eltIn, dif_pos hb]
  exact Subtype.prop _

name: Operad.ShuffleBridge.eltIn_posIn
statement: lemma eltIn_posIn {C : Finset ℕ} {a : ℕ} (ha : a ∈ C) : eltIn C (posIn C a) = a
proof:
:= by
  rw [eltIn, dif_pos (posIn_lt ha)]
  simp only [posIn, dif_pos ha, Fin.eta, OrderIso.apply_symm_apply]

name: Operad.ShuffleBridge.posIn_eltIn
statement: lemma posIn_eltIn {C : Finset ℕ} {b : ℕ} (hb : b < C.card) : posIn C (eltIn C b) = b
proof:
:= by
  rw [posIn, dif_pos (eltIn_mem hb)]
  simp only [eltIn, dif_pos hb, Subtype.coe_eta, OrderIso.symm_apply_apply]

name: Operad.ShuffleBridge.strictMonoOn_posIn
statement: lemma strictMonoOn_posIn (C : Finset ℕ) : StrictMonoOn (posIn C) C
proof:
:= by
  intro a ha a' ha' h
  simp only [posIn, dif_pos (show a ∈ C from ha), dif_pos (show a' ∈ C from ha')]
  exact (C.orderIsoOfFin rfl).symm.lt_iff_lt.2 (Subtype.mk_lt_mk.2 h)

name: Operad.ShuffleBridge.strictMonoOn_eltIn
statement:
lemma strictMonoOn_eltIn (C : Finset ℕ) :
    StrictMonoOn (eltIn C) (Finset.range C.card : Set ℕ)
proof:
:= by
  intro b hb b' hb' h
  have hb₁ : b < C.card := Finset.mem_range.1 hb
  have hb₂ : b' < C.card := Finset.mem_range.1 hb'
  simp only [eltIn, dif_pos hb₁, dif_pos hb₂]
  exact Subtype.mk_lt_mk.1 ((C.orderIsoOfFin rfl).lt_iff_lt.2 (Fin.mk_lt_mk.2 h))

name: Operad.ShuffleBridge.image_posIn
statement: lemma image_posIn (C : Finset ℕ) : C.image (posIn C) = Finset.range C.card
proof:
:= by
  ext b
  simp only [Finset.mem_image, Finset.mem_range]
  exact ⟨fun ⟨a, ha, hab⟩ => hab ▸ posIn_lt ha, fun hb => ⟨_, eltIn_mem hb, posIn_eltIn hb⟩⟩

name: Operad.ShuffleBridge.image_eltIn
statement: lemma image_eltIn (C : Finset ℕ) : (Finset.range C.card).image (eltIn C) = C
proof:
:= by
  ext a
  simp only [Finset.mem_image, Finset.mem_range]
  exact ⟨fun ⟨b, hb, hab⟩ => hab ▸ eltIn_mem hb, fun ha => ⟨_, posIn_lt ha, eltIn_posIn ha⟩⟩

name: Operad.ShuffleBridge.normal_of_leftInverse
proof:
:=
  fun r h hh heq => ht r (β ∘ h) (isSCtx_comp hβ hh) (by rw [Function.comp_apply, heq, hβα])

name: Operad.ShuffleBridge.disjoint_of_leftInverse
statement:
lemma disjoint_of_leftInverse {A B : Finset ℕ} {α : SMono E A → SMono E B}
    {β : SMono E B → SMono E A} (hα : IsSCtx α) (hβ : IsSCtx β) (hβα : ∀ t, β (α t) = t)
    (h : Disjoint (Finsupp.supported K K {t : SMono E B | G.Normal t}) (G.rw B).ideal) :
    Disjoint (Finsupp.supported K K {t : SMono E A | G.Normal t}) (G.rw A).ideal
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [Submodule.disjoint_def] at h ⊢
  intro w hw₁ hw₂
  apply Finsupp.mapDomain_injective (Function.LeftInverse.injective hβα)
  rw [Finsupp.mapDomain_zero]
  refine h _ ((Finsupp.mem_supported K _).2 fun y hy => ?_) (G.mapDomain_mem_ideal hα hw₂)
  obtain ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.1 (Finsupp.mapDomain_support hy)
  exact normal_of_leftInverse G hβ hβα ((Finsupp.mem_supported K w).1 hw₁ hx)

name: Operad.ShuffleBridge.disjoint_of_range
statement:
theorem disjoint_of_range
    (h : ∀ n, Disjoint (Finsupp.supported K K {t : SMono E (Finset.range n) | G.Normal t})
      (G.rw (Finset.range n)).ideal) (C : Finset ℕ) :
    Disjoint (Finsupp.supported K K {t : SMono E C | G.Normal t}) (G.rw C).ideal
proof:
:=
  disjoint_of_leftInverse G (isSCtx_relabelM _ (strictMonoOn_posIn C) (image_posIn C))
    (isSCtx_relabelM _ (strictMonoOn_eltIn C) (image_eltIn C))
    (fun t => Subtype.ext (by
      show (t.1.relabel (posIn C)).relabel (eltIn C) = t.1
      rw [relabel_relabel]
      exact relabel_id fun a ha => eltIn_posIn (t.mem_labels.1 ha)))
    (h C.card)

name: Operad.ShuffleBridge.isSCtx_cast
statement:
lemma isSCtx_cast {A B : Finset ℕ} (h : A = B) :
    IsSCtx (SMono.cast h : SMono F A → SMono F B)
proof:
:= by
  subst h
  rw [cast_rfl]
  exact isSCtx_id _

name: Operad.ShuffleBridge.normal_iff
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hg
    by_contra hn
    obtain ⟨p, s, he, hw⟩ := LTree.not_isNormal_iff.1 hn
    rw [hL] at hw
    obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := hw
    obtain ⟨f, hf, hfσ⟩ := exists_ctx_of_edge ((monoEquiv F n).symm g) he
    refine hg r (f ∘ SMono.cast (hsrc r)) (isSCtx_comp hf (isSCtx_cast _)) ?_
    have hσ : SMono.cast (hsrc r) (G.lead r) =
        monoEquiv F 3 ⟨ofS (G.lead r).1, ofS_mem (SMono.cast (hsrc r) (G.lead r))⟩ :=
      Subtype.ext (toS_ofS _).symm
    have hm := (LTree.mem_monomials n (ofS g.1)).1 (ofS_mem g)
    rw [Function.comp_apply, hσ, hfσ]
    apply Subtype.ext
    show toS ((ofS g.1).substAt p s (ofS (G.lead r).1)) = g.1
    have hr' : ofS (G.lead r).1 = (ofS g.1).windowAt p s := hr
    rw [hr', LTree.substAt_windowAt he hm.1 (hm.2.nodup_iff.2 List.nodup_range), toS_ofS]
  · intro hn r f hf hfg
    have hf' : IsSCtx (f ∘ SMono.cast (hsrc r).symm) := isSCtx_comp hf (isSCtx_cast _)
    have h0 : (f ∘ SMono.cast (hsrc r).symm) (SMono.cast (hsrc r) (G.lead r)) = g := hfg
    obtain ⟨p, s, he, hw, -⟩ := exists_edge_of_ctx hf' (SMono.cast (hsrc r) (G.lead r))
    rw [h0] at he hw
    exact LTree.not_isNormal_iff.2 ⟨p, s, he, by rw [hL, hw]; exact ⟨r, rfl⟩⟩ hn

name: Operad.ShuffleBridge.disjoint_range
statement:
theorem disjoint_range {rk : F 2 → ℕ} {L : Set (LTree (F 2))}
    {R : Submodule K (LTree.Mono (F 2) 3 → K)} (hG : LTree.IsGroebner K rk L R)
    (hsrc : ∀ r, G.src r = Finset.range 3)
    (hR : R.map (vecEquiv F K 3).toLinearMap = Submodule.span K (Set.range (ruleVec G hsrc)))
    (hL : L = Set.range fun r => ofS (G.lead r).1) (n : ℕ) :
    Disjoint (Finsupp.supported K K {t : SMono F (Finset.range n) | G.Normal t})
      (G.rw (Finset.range n)).ideal
proof:
:= by
  rw [Submodule.disjoint_def]
  intro w hw₁ hw₂
  rw [← map_idealOf G hsrc R hR n] at hw₂
  obtain ⟨v, hv, rfl⟩ := hw₂
  have hv0 : v = 0 := hG.indep n v hv fun x hx => by
    have h : (vecEquiv F K n v) (monoEquiv F n x) = 0 := by
      by_contra h
      have hN := (Finsupp.mem_supported K _).1 hw₁ (Finsupp.mem_support_iff.2 h)
      rw [Set.mem_setOf_eq, normal_iff G hsrc hL, monoEquiv_val, ofS_toS] at hN
      exact hx hN
    rwa [vecEquiv_apply, Equiv.symm_apply_apply] at h
  rw [hv0, map_zero]

name: Operad.ShuffleBridge.weight_eq_two
statement:
lemma weight_eq_two {C : Finset ℕ} (hC : C = Finset.range 3) (g : SMono F C) :
    g.1.weight = 2
proof:
:= by
  have h1 := weight_toS (ofS g.1)
  rw [toS_ofS] at h1
  have h2 : (ofS g.1).arity = 3 := by
    rw [← LTree.length_labels, ← Multiset.coe_card, ← labels_toS, toS_ofS, g.labels_eq, hC]
    rfl
  omega

name: Operad.ShuffleBridge.isKoszul_of_isGroebner
statement:
theorem isKoszul_of_isGroebner {rk : F 2 → ℕ} {L : Set (LTree (F 2))}
    {R : Submodule K (LTree.Mono (F 2) 3 → K)} (hG : LTree.IsGroebner K rk L R)
    (hsrc : ∀ r, G.src r = Finset.range 3)
    (hR : R.map (vecEquiv F K 3).toLinearMap = Submodule.span K (Set.range (ruleVec G hsrc)))
