    (hL : L = Set.range fun r => ofS (G.lead r).1) : G.IsKoszul
proof:
:=
  G.isKoszul_of_critical (fun r => weight_eq_two (hsrc r) _)
    (fun r m _ => weight_eq_two (hsrc r) m)
    fun B _ => B.res_of_isCompl (disjoint_of_range G (disjoint_range G hG hsrc hR hL) _)

name: Operad.ShuffleBridge.indep_of_disjoint
statement:
theorem indep_of_disjoint {L : Set (LTree (F 2))} {R : Submodule K (LTree.Mono (F 2) 3 → K)}
    (hsrc : ∀ r, G.src r = Finset.range 3)
    (hR : R.map (vecEquiv F K 3).toLinearMap = Submodule.span K (Set.range (ruleVec G hsrc)))
    (hL : L = Set.range fun r => ofS (G.lead r).1) {n : ℕ}
    (h : Disjoint (Finsupp.supported K K {t : SMono F (Finset.range n) | G.Normal t})
      (G.rw (Finset.range n)).ideal)
    (v : LTree.Mono (F 2) n → K) (hv : v ∈ LTree.idealOf K R n)
    (hs : v ∈ supportedOn K (LTree.normalSet L n)) : v = 0
proof:
:= by
  have h0 : vecEquiv F K n v = 0 := by
    refine Submodule.disjoint_def.1 h _ ((Finsupp.mem_supported K _).2 fun y hy => ?_) ?_
    · have hy' : v ((monoEquiv F n).symm y) ≠ 0 := by
        rwa [Finset.mem_coe, Finsupp.mem_support_iff, vecEquiv_apply] at hy
      have hN : LTree.IsNormal L ((monoEquiv F n).symm y).1 := by
        by_contra hN
        exact hy' (hs _ hN)
      rw [monoEquiv_symm_val, ← normal_iff G hsrc hL] at hN
      exact hN
    · rw [← map_idealOf G hsrc R hR n]
      exact Submodule.mem_map_of_mem hv
  exact (vecEquiv F K n).map_eq_zero_iff.1 h0

name: Operad.ShuffleBridge.resolvable_of_isGroebner
statement:
theorem resolvable_of_isGroebner {rk : F 2 → ℕ} {L : Set (LTree (F 2))}
    {R : Submodule K (LTree.Mono (F 2) 3 → K)} (hG : LTree.IsGroebner K rk L R)
    (hsrc : ∀ r, G.src r = Finset.range 3)
    (hR : R.map (vecEquiv F K 3).toLinearMap = Submodule.span K (Set.range (ruleVec G hsrc)))
    (hL : L = Set.range fun r => ofS (G.lead r).1) (C : Finset ℕ) : (G.rw C).Resolvable
proof:
:=
  Rewriting.resolvable_of_disjoint (by
    rw [G.irr_eq]
    exact disjoint_of_range G (disjoint_range G hG hsrc hR hL) C)

name: Operad.ShuffleBridge.isGroebner_of_resolvable
statement:
theorem isGroebner_of_resolvable {rk : F 2 → ℕ} {L : Set (LTree (F 2))}
    {R : Submodule K (LTree.Mono (F 2) 3 → K)} (hsrc : ∀ r, G.src r = Finset.range 3)
    (hR : R.map (vecEquiv F K 3).toLinearMap = Submodule.span K (Set.range (ruleVec G hsrc)))
    (hL : L = Set.range fun r => ofS (G.lead r).1) (hmem : ∀ ℓ ∈ L, ℓ ∈ LTree.monomials 3)
    (hlead : ∀ ℓ (hℓ : ℓ ∈ L), ∃ r ∈ R, r ⟨ℓ, hmem ℓ hℓ⟩ ≠ 0 ∧
      ∀ σ : LTree.Mono (F 2) 3, σ.1 ≠ ℓ → r σ ≠ 0 → LTree.pathKey rk 3 σ.1 < LTree.pathKey rk 3 ℓ)
    (hres : ∀ C, (G.rw C).Resolvable) : LTree.IsGroebner K rk L R where
  mem
proof:
:= hmem
  lead := hlead
  indep n v hv hs := indep_of_disjoint G hsrc hR hL (by
    rw [← G.irr_eq]
    exact (hres _).isCompl.disjoint) v hv hs

name: Operad.ShuffleBridge.isKoszul_and_of_isGroebner
statement:
theorem isKoszul_and_of_isGroebner {rk : F 2 → ℕ} {L : Set (LTree (F 2))}
    {R : Submodule K (LTree.Mono (F 2) 3 → K)} (hG : LTree.IsGroebner K rk L R)
    (hsrc : ∀ r, G.src r = Finset.range 3)
    (hR : R.map (vecEquiv F K 3).toLinearMap = Submodule.span K (Set.range (ruleVec G hsrc)))
    (hL : L = Set.range fun r => ofS (G.lead r).1) : ShuffleBar.IsKoszul K R ∧ G.IsKoszul
proof:
:=
  ⟨ShuffleBar.isKoszul K rk hG, isKoszul_of_isGroebner G hG hsrc hR hL⟩

name: Operad.ShuffleBridge.shuffleBar_isKoszul_of_resolvable
statement:
theorem shuffleBar_isKoszul_of_resolvable {rk : F 2 → ℕ} {L : Set (LTree (F 2))}
    {R : Submodule K (LTree.Mono (F 2) 3 → K)} (hsrc : ∀ r, G.src r = Finset.range 3)
    (hR : R.map (vecEquiv F K 3).toLinearMap = Submodule.span K (Set.range (ruleVec G hsrc)))
    (hL : L = Set.range fun r => ofS (G.lead r).1) (hmem : ∀ ℓ ∈ L, ℓ ∈ LTree.monomials 3)
    (hlead : ∀ ℓ (hℓ : ℓ ∈ L), ∃ r ∈ R, r ⟨ℓ, hmem ℓ hℓ⟩ ≠ 0 ∧
      ∀ σ : LTree.Mono (F 2) 3, σ.1 ≠ ℓ → r σ ≠ 0 → LTree.pathKey rk 3 σ.1 < LTree.pathKey rk 3 ℓ)
    (hres : ∀ C, (G.rw C).Resolvable) : ShuffleBar.IsKoszul K R
proof:
:=
  ShuffleBar.isKoszul K rk (isGroebner_of_resolvable G hsrc hR hL hmem hlead hres)

name: Operad.ShuffleBridge.ruleVec_eq
statement:
lemma ruleVec_eq (hsrc : ∀ r, G.src r = Finset.range 3) (r : ρ) {a b : LTree (F 2)}
    (ha : a ∈ LTree.monomials 3) (hb : b ∈ LTree.monomials 3) (hlead : ofS (G.lead r).1 = a)
    {τ : SMono F (G.src r)} (htail : G.tail r = Finsupp.single τ 1) (hτ : ofS τ.1 = b) :
    ruleVec G hsrc r = vecEquiv F K 3 (LTree.vecOf K 3 a - LTree.vecOf K 3 b)
proof:
:= by
  rw [map_sub, vecEquiv_vecOf K ha, vecEquiv_vecOf K hb, ruleVec, htail, Finsupp.mapDomain_sub,
    Finsupp.mapDomain_single, Finsupp.mapDomain_single]
  congr 2
  · exact Subtype.ext (by
      show (G.lead r).1 = toS a
      rw [← hlead, toS_ofS])
  · exact Subtype.ext (by
      show τ.1 = toS b
      rw [← hτ, toS_ofS])

name: Operad.ComBin.src_rules
statement: lemma src_rules (r : Bool) : (ComGen.rules K).src r = Finset.range 3
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.ComBin.leads_eq
statement: lemma leads_eq : leads = Set.range fun r => ofS ((ComGen.rules K).lead r).1
proof:
:= by
  ext ℓ
  constructor
  · rintro (rfl | rfl)
    exacts [⟨true, rfl⟩, ⟨false, rfl⟩]
  · rintro ⟨_ | _, rfl⟩
    exacts [Or.inr rfl, Or.inl rfl]

name: Operad.ComBin.map_rel
statement:
lemma map_rel :
    (rel K).map (vecEquiv ComGen K 3).toLinearMap =
      Submodule.span K (Set.range (ruleVec (ComGen.rules K) (src_rules K)))
proof:
:= by
  have hl : ruleVec (ComGen.rules K) (src_rules K) true =
      vecEquiv ComGen K 3 (LTree.vecOf K 3 lcomb - LTree.vecOf K 3 rcomb) :=
    ruleVec_eq _ _ true lcomb_mem rcomb_mem rfl rfl rfl
  have ht : ruleVec (ComGen.rules K) (src_rules K) false =
      vecEquiv ComGen K 3 (LTree.vecOf K 3 tcomb - LTree.vecOf K 3 rcomb) :=
    ruleVec_eq _ _ false tcomb_mem rcomb_mem rfl rfl rfl
  rw [rel_eq_span, Submodule.map_span, Set.image_pair]
  congr 1
  ext v
  simp only [Set.mem_insert_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff, Set.mem_range, Bool.exists_bool, ← hl,
    ← ht, LinearEquiv.coe_coe]
  exact ⟨fun h => h.elim (fun h => Or.inr h.symm) fun h => Or.inl h.symm,
    fun h => h.elim (fun h => Or.inr h.symm) fun h => Or.inl h.symm⟩

name: Operad.ComBin.isKoszul_and_bridge
statement: theorem isKoszul_and_bridge : ShuffleBar.IsKoszul K (rel K) ∧ (ComGen.rules K).IsKoszul
proof:
:=
  isKoszul_and_of_isGroebner _ (isGroebner K) (src_rules K) (map_rel K) (leads_eq K)

name: Operad.ComBin.map_idealOf_rel
statement:
theorem map_idealOf_rel (n : ℕ) :
    (LTree.idealOf K (rel K) n).map (vecEquiv ComGen K n).toLinearMap =
      ((ComGen.rules K).rw (Finset.range n)).ideal
proof:
:=
  ShuffleBridge.map_idealOf _ (src_rules K) _ (map_rel K) n

name: Operad.AssBin.src_rules
statement: lemma src_rules (r : Rule) : (AssShGen.rules K).src r = Finset.range 3
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.AssBin.ofS_leadOf
statement: lemma ofS_leadOf (e f : AssShGen 2) (s : Bool) : ofS (leadOf e f s).1 = lead3 e f s
proof:
:= by
  cases s <;> rfl

name: Operad.AssBin.ofS_tailOf
statement: lemma ofS_tailOf (e f : AssShGen 2) (s : Bool) : ofS (tailOf e f s).1 = tail3 e f s
proof:
:= by
  cases e <;> cases f <;> cases s <;> rfl

name: Operad.AssBin.leads_eq
statement: lemma leads_eq : leads = Set.range fun r => ofS ((AssShGen.rules K).lead r).1
proof:
:= by
  ext ℓ
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨e, f, s, hef, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨(⟨(e, f), hef⟩, s), ofS_leadOf e f s⟩
  · rintro ⟨⟨⟨⟨e, f⟩, hef⟩, s⟩, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨e, f, s, hef, ofS_leadOf e f s⟩

name: Operad.AssBin.map_rel
statement:
lemma map_rel :
    (rel K).map (vecEquiv AssShGen K 3).toLinearMap =
      Submodule.span K (Set.range (ruleVec (AssShGen.rules K) (src_rules K)))
proof:
:= by
  rw [rel_eq_span, Submodule.map_span, ← Set.range_comp]
  refine congrArg (Submodule.span K) (congrArg Set.range (funext fun r => ?_))
  exact (ruleVec_eq _ _ r (lead3_mem _ _ _) (tail3_mem _ _ _)
    (ofS_leadOf r.1.1.1 r.1.1.2 r.2) rfl (ofS_tailOf r.1.1.1 r.1.1.2 r.2)).symm

name: Operad.AssBin.isKoszul_and_bridge
statement: theorem isKoszul_and_bridge : ShuffleBar.IsKoszul K (rel K) ∧ (AssShGen.rules K).IsKoszul
proof:
:=
  isKoszul_and_of_isGroebner _ (isGroebner K) (src_rules K) (map_rel K) (leads_eq K)

name: Operad.AssBin.map_idealOf_rel
statement:
theorem map_idealOf_rel (n : ℕ) :
    (LTree.idealOf K (rel K) n).map (vecEquiv AssShGen K n).toLinearMap =
      ((AssShGen.rules K).rw (Finset.range n)).ideal
proof:
:=
  ShuffleBridge.map_idealOf _ (src_rules K) _ (map_rel K) n

name: Operad.Algebra.act_def
statement:
lemma act_def (A : Algebra R P V) {n : ℕ} (α : P n) (v : Fin n → V) :
    A.act α v = A.app n α v
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.Algebra.act_one
statement:
@[simp] lemma act_one (A : Algebra R P V) (v : Fin 1 → V) :
    A.act (one (R := R) (P := P)) v = v 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [act, A.app_one]; rfl

name: Operad.Algebra.act_comp
statement:
lemma act_comp (A : Algebra R P V) (a b : ℕ) {n : ℕ} (α : P (a + 1 + b)) (β : P n)
    (v : Fin (a + n + b) → V) :
    A.act (comp (R := R) a b α β) v
      = A.act α (End.insTuple a b (A.act β (End.midTuple a b v)) v)
proof:
:= by
  rw [act, A.app_comp]; rfl

name: Operad.Algebra.act_add
statement:
@[simp] lemma act_add (A : Algebra R P V) {n : ℕ} (α α' : P n) (v : Fin n → V) :
    A.act (α + α') v = A.act α v + A.act α' v
proof:
:= by
  rw [act, map_add]; rfl

name: Operad.Algebra.act_smul
statement:
@[simp] lemma act_smul (A : Algebra R P V) {n : ℕ} (r : R) (α : P n) (v : Fin n → V) :
    A.act (r • α) v = r • A.act α v
proof:
:= by
  rw [act, map_smul]; rfl

name: Operad.Algebra.act_zero
statement:
@[simp] lemma act_zero (A : Algebra R P V) {n : ℕ} (v : Fin n → V) :
    A.act (0 : P n) v = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [act, map_zero]; rfl

name: Operad.Algebra.self_act
statement:
@[simp] lemma self_act {n : ℕ} (α : End R V n) (v : Fin n → V) :
    (Algebra.self R V).act α v = α v
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.Algebra.comap_act
statement:
@[simp] lemma comap_act (f : NSOperadHom R P Q) (A : Algebra R Q V) {n : ℕ} (α : P n)
    (v : Fin n → V) :
    (A.comap f).act α v = A.act (f.app n α) v
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.Tree.mSgn_graft_after
statement:
theorem mSgn_graft_after {s b u : Tree E} {p q : ℕ} (hpq : p < q) (hq : q < s.arity) :
    xor (tpar gp b && apar gp s q) (mSgn gp (s.graft q b) p u)
      = xor (tpar gp b && tpar gp u)
          (xor (mSgn gp s p u) (tpar gp b && apar gp (s.mgraft μ p u) (q - 1 + u.arity)))
proof:
:= by
  simp only [mSgn, mgSgn, apar_graft_before gp s q b p hpq hq, lpar_graft_after gp s q b p hpq hq,
    mpar_graft_after gp s q b p hpq hq, apar_mgraft_after μ gp s p u q hpq hq]
  cases tpar gp b <;> cases tpar gp u <;> cases apar gp s p <;> cases apar gp s q <;>
    cases lpar gp s p <;> cases rpar gp u <;> cases mpar gp s p <;> rfl

name: Operad.Tree.mSgn_graft_before
statement:
theorem mSgn_graft_before (hμ : MergeFn.Odd gp μ) {s b u : Tree E} {p q : ℕ} (hqp : q < p)
    (hp : p < s.arity) (hu : u.isLeaf = false) :
    xor (tpar gp b && apar gp s q) (mSgn gp (s.graft q b) (p - 1 + b.arity) u)
      = xor (tpar gp b && tpar gp u)
          (xor (mSgn gp s p u) (tpar gp b && apar gp (s.mgraft μ p u) q))
proof:
:= by
  have ha : apar gp (s.graft q b) (p - 1 + b.arity) = apar gp s p := by
    rw [show p - 1 + b.arity = p + b.arity - 1 by omega]
    exact apar_graft_after gp s q b p hqp hp
  simp only [mSgn, mgSgn, ha, lpar_graft_before gp s q b p hqp hp,
    mpar_graft_before gp s q b p hqp hp, apar_mgraft_before μ gp hμ s q p u hqp hp hu]
  cases tpar gp b <;> cases tpar gp u <;> cases apar gp s p <;> cases apar gp s q <;>
    cases lpar gp s p <;> cases rpar gp u <;> cases mpar gp s p <;> cases qbp s q p <;> rfl

name: Operad.Tree.mSgn_graft_inner
statement:
theorem mSgn_graft_inner (hμ : MergeFn.Odd gp μ) {s b u : Tree E} {q r : ℕ} (hq : q < s.arity)
    (hr : r < b.arity) (hb : b.isLeaf = false) (hu : u.isLeaf = false) :
    xor (tpar gp b && apar gp s q) (mSgn gp (s.graft q b) (q + r) u)
      = xor (tpar gp s) (xor (mSgn gp b r u) (tpar gp (b.mgraft μ r u) && apar gp s q))
proof:
:= by
  simp only [mSgn, mgSgn, apar_graft_inner gp s q b r hq hr, lpar_graft_inner gp s q b r hq hr hb,
    mpar_graft_inner gp s q b r hq hr hb, tpar_mgraft μ gp hμ b r u hr hb hu]
  cases tpar gp b <;> cases tpar gp u <;> cases tpar gp s <;> cases apar gp s q <;>
    cases apar gp b r <;> cases lpar gp b r <;> cases rpar gp u <;> cases mpar gp b r <;> rfl

name: Operad.Tree.mSgn_graft_outer
statement:
theorem mSgn_graft_outer {s b u : Tree E} {p q : ℕ} (hp : p < s.arity) (hq : q < b.arity)
    (hb : b.isLeaf = false) :
    xor (mSgn gp s p b) (tpar gp u && apar gp (s.mgraft μ p b) (p + q))
      = xor (tpar gp u && apar gp b q) (mSgn gp s p (b.graft q u))
proof:
:= by
  simp only [mSgn, mgSgn, apar_mgraft_inner μ gp s p b q hp hq hb, tpar_graft gp b q u hq,
    rpar_graft gp hb]
  cases tpar gp b <;> cases tpar gp u <;> cases apar gp s p <;> cases apar gp b q <;>
    cases lpar gp s p <;> cases rpar gp b <;> cases mpar gp s p <;> rfl

name: Operad.FreeGr.treeOf_map
statement:
lemma treeOf_map (e : A ≃ B) (x : Reg (TreeOfArity T) A) :
    treeOf (SetOperad.map e x) = treeOf x
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.FreeGr.map_fst
statement:
lemma map_fst (e : A ≃ B) (x : Reg (TreeOfArity T) A) :
    (SetOperad.map e x).1 = LinOrd.map e x.1
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.FreeGr.mcompR_map
statement:
lemma mcompR_map {A' B' : Type} [Fintype A'] [DecidableEq A'] [Fintype B'] [DecidableEq B']
    (σ' : A ≃ A') (τ : B ≃ B') (i : A) (x : Reg (TreeOfArity T) A)
    (y : Reg (TreeOfArity T) B) :
    SetOperad.map (compEquiv σ' τ i) (mcompR μ i x y)
      = mcompR μ (σ' i) (SetOperad.map σ' x) (SetOperad.map τ y)
proof:
:= by
  refine reg_ext ?_ ?_
  · show (SetOperad.map (compEquiv σ' τ i) (SetOperad.comp i x y)).1
      = (SetOperad.comp (σ' i) (SetOperad.map σ' x) (SetOperad.map τ y)).1
    rw [SetOperad.map_comp]
  · simp only [treeOf_map, treeOf_mcompR, map_fst, LinOrd.rank_map, Equiv.symm_apply_apply]

name: Operad.FreeGr.mcompR_comp_par
statement:
lemma mcompR_comp_par {i k : A} (hik : i ≠ k) (x : Reg (TreeOfArity T) A)
    (y : Reg (TreeOfArity T) B) (z : Reg (TreeOfArity T) D) :
    SetOperad.map (parEquiv hik B D)
        (mcompR μ (Sum.inl ⟨k, Ne.symm hik⟩) (SetOperad.comp i x y) z)
      = SetOperad.comp (Sum.inl ⟨i, hik⟩) (mcompR μ k x z) y
proof:
:= by
  refine reg_ext ?_ ?_
  · exact SetOperad.comp_assoc_par (S := fun A _ _ => LinOrd A) hik x.1 y.1 z.1
  · simp only [treeOf_map, treeOf_mcompR, treeOf_comp, mcompR_fst, comp_fst]
    have hy : Fintype.card B = (treeOf y).arity := by rw [treeOf_arity]; exact y.2.2.symm
    have hz : Fintype.card D = (treeOf z).arity := by rw [treeOf_arity]; exact z.2.2.symm
    rcases x.1.total i k hik with h | h
    · rw [LinOrd.rank_comp_inl_of_gt _ _ _ _ h, LinOrd.rank_comp_inl_of_lt _ _ _ _ h, hy]
      exact Tree.graft_mgraft_before μ _ _ _ _ _ (x.1.rank_lt_rank h) (rank_lt_arity x k)
    · rw [LinOrd.rank_comp_inl_of_lt _ _ _ _ h, LinOrd.rank_comp_inl_of_gt _ _ _ _ h, hz]
      exact Tree.graft_mgraft_after μ _ _ _ _ _ (x.1.rank_lt_rank h) (rank_lt_arity x i)

name: Operad.FreeGr.mcompR_comp_inner
statement:
lemma mcompR_comp_inner (i : A) (j : B) (x : Reg (TreeOfArity T) A)
    (y : Reg (TreeOfArity T) B) (z : Reg (TreeOfArity T) D) (hy : (treeOf y).isLeaf = false) :
    SetOperad.map (seqEquiv i j D) (mcompR μ (Sum.inr j) (SetOperad.comp i x y) z)
      = SetOperad.comp i x (mcompR μ j y z)
proof:
:= by
  refine reg_ext ?_ ?_
  · exact SetOperad.comp_assoc_seq (S := fun A _ _ => LinOrd A) i j x.1 y.1 z.1
  · simp only [treeOf_map, treeOf_mcompR, treeOf_comp, comp_fst, LinOrd.rank_comp_inr]
    exact Tree.mgraft_graft_inner μ _ _ _ _ _ (rank_lt_arity x i) (rank_lt_arity y j) hy

name: Operad.FreeGr.comp_mcompR_outer
statement:
lemma comp_mcompR_outer (i : A) (j : B) (x : Reg (TreeOfArity T) A)
    (y : Reg (TreeOfArity T) B) (z : Reg (TreeOfArity T) D) (hy : (treeOf y).isLeaf = false) :
    SetOperad.map (seqEquiv i j D) (SetOperad.comp (Sum.inr j) (mcompR μ i x y) z)
      = mcompR μ i x (SetOperad.comp j y z)
proof:
:= by
  refine reg_ext ?_ ?_
  · exact SetOperad.comp_assoc_seq (S := fun A _ _ => LinOrd A) i j x.1 y.1 z.1
  · simp only [treeOf_map, treeOf_mcompR, treeOf_comp, mcompR_fst, comp_fst,
      LinOrd.rank_comp_inr]
    exact (Tree.mgraft_graft_outer μ _ _ _ _ _ (rank_lt_arity x i) (rank_lt_arity y j) hy).symm

name: Operad.FreeGr.mcompSgn_eq
statement:
lemma mcompSgn_eq (i : A) (x : Reg (TreeOfArity T) A) (y : Reg (TreeOfArity T) B) :
    mcompSgn gp i x y = Tree.mSgn gp (treeOf x) (x.1.rank i) (treeOf y)
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.FreeGr.mcompSgn_map
statement:
lemma mcompSgn_map {A' B' : Type} [Fintype A'] [DecidableEq A'] [Fintype B'] [DecidableEq B']
    (σ' : A ≃ A') (τ : B ≃ B') (i : A) (x : Reg (TreeOfArity T) A)
    (y : Reg (TreeOfArity T) B) :
    mcompSgn gp (σ' i) (SetOperad.map σ' x) (SetOperad.map τ y) = mcompSgn gp i x y
proof:
:= by
  simp only [mcompSgn, treeOf_map, map_fst, LinOrd.rank_map, Equiv.symm_apply_apply]

name: Operad.FreeGr.mcomp_bas_of
statement:
lemma mcomp_bas_of {i : A} {x : Reg (TreeOfArity T) A} {y : Reg (TreeOfArity T) B}
    (hx : (treeOf x).isLeaf = false) (hy : (treeOf y).isLeaf = false) :
    mcomp μ gp R i (SgnLin.bas (treeSgn gp) R x) (SgnLin.bas (treeSgn gp) R y)
      = σ R (mcompSgn gp i x y) • SgnLin.bas (treeSgn gp) R (mcompR μ i x y)
proof:
:= by
  rw [mcomp_bas, if_pos ⟨hx, hy⟩]

name: Operad.FreeGr.mcomp_bas_of_left
statement:
lemma mcomp_bas_of_left {i : A} {x : Reg (TreeOfArity T) A} (y : Reg (TreeOfArity T) B)
    (hx : (treeOf x).isLeaf = true) :
    mcomp μ gp R i (SgnLin.bas (treeSgn gp) R x) (SgnLin.bas (treeSgn gp) R y) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [mcomp_bas, if_neg (fun h => by rw [h.1] at hx; exact Bool.false_ne_true hx)]

name: Operad.FreeGr.mcomp_bas_of_right
proof:
:= by
  rw [mcomp_bas, if_neg (fun h => by rw [h.2] at hy; exact Bool.false_ne_true hy)]

name: Operad.FreeGr.isLeaf_of_ne
statement:
lemma isLeaf_of_ne {i k : A} (hik : i ≠ k) (x : Reg (TreeOfArity T) A) :
    (treeOf x).isLeaf = false
proof:
:= by
  by_contra h
  have hl : (treeOf x).isLeaf = true := by simpa using h
  have h1 := treeOf_arity x
  rw [Tree.eq_leaf_of_isLeaf hl, Tree.arity_leaf, x.2.2] at h1
  exact hik (Fintype.card_le_one_iff.1 h1.symm.le i k)

name: Operad.FreeGr.mcomp_map
statement:
theorem mcomp_map {A' B' : Type} [Fintype A'] [DecidableEq A'] [Fintype B'] [DecidableEq B']
    (σ' : A ≃ A') (τ : B ≃ B') (i : A) (x : FreeGr R gp A) (y : FreeGr R gp B) :
    mcomp μ gp R (σ' i) (GrOperad.map (R := R) σ' x) (GrOperad.map (R := R) τ y)
      = GrOperad.map (R := R) (compEquiv σ' τ i) (mcomp μ gp R i x y)
proof:
:= by
  have h : (mcomp μ gp R (σ' i)).compl₁₂ (GrOperad.map (R := R) (P := FreeGr R gp) σ')
        (GrOperad.map (R := R) (P := FreeGr R gp) τ)
      = (mcomp μ gp R i).compr₂ (GrOperad.map (R := R) (P := FreeGr R gp) (compEquiv σ' τ i)) := by
    refine Finsupp.lhom_ext' fun s => LinearMap.ext_ring
      (Finsupp.lhom_ext' fun t => LinearMap.ext_ring ?_)
    show mcomp μ gp R (σ' i) (GrOperad.map (R := R) σ' (SgnLin.bas (treeSgn gp) R s))
        (GrOperad.map (R := R) τ (SgnLin.bas (treeSgn gp) R t))
      = GrOperad.map (R := R) (compEquiv σ' τ i)
          (mcomp μ gp R i (SgnLin.bas (treeSgn gp) R s) (SgnLin.bas (treeSgn gp) R t))
    rw [SgnLin.map_bas, SgnLin.map_bas, mcomp_bas, mcomp_bas]
    simp only [treeOf_map]
    split_ifs
    · rw [map_smul, SgnLin.map_bas, mcompR_map, mcompSgn_map]
    · rw [map_zero]
  exact LinearMap.congr_fun (LinearMap.congr_fun h x) y

name: Operad.FreeGr.mcomp_comp_par_bas
statement:
theorem mcomp_comp_par_bas (hμ : MergeFn.Odd gp μ) {i k : A} (hik : i ≠ k)
    (x : Reg (TreeOfArity T) A) (y : Reg (TreeOfArity T) B) (z : Reg (TreeOfArity T) D) :
    GrOperad.map (R := R) (parEquiv hik B D)
        (mcomp μ gp R (Sum.inl ⟨k, Ne.symm hik⟩)
          (GrOperad.comp (R := R) i (SgnLin.bas (treeSgn gp) R x) (SgnLin.bas (treeSgn gp) R y))
          (SgnLin.bas (treeSgn gp) R z))
      = σ R (Tree.tpar gp (treeOf y) && Tree.tpar gp (treeOf z)) •
          GrOperad.comp (R := R) (Sum.inl ⟨i, hik⟩)
            (mcomp μ gp R k (SgnLin.bas (treeSgn gp) R x) (SgnLin.bas (treeSgn gp) R z))
            (SgnLin.bas (treeSgn gp) R y)
proof:
:= by
  have hx := isLeaf_of_ne hik x
  rw [comp_bas_eq, map_smul, LinearMap.smul_apply]
  by_cases hz : (treeOf z).isLeaf = false
  · have hxy : (treeOf (SetOperad.comp i x y)).isLeaf = false := by
      rw [treeOf_comp]
      exact Tree.isLeaf_graft_left hx _ _
    rw [mcomp_bas_of μ hxy hz, mcomp_bas_of μ hx hz, map_smul, map_smul, SgnLin.map_bas,
      mcompR_comp_par, map_smul, LinearMap.smul_apply, comp_bas_eq, smul_smul, smul_smul,
      smul_smul]
    congr 1
    simp only [mcompSgn_eq, ← σ_xor]
    congr 1
    simp only [treeOf_comp, comp_fst, treeOf_mcompR, mcompR_fst]
    have hy : Fintype.card B = (treeOf y).arity := by rw [treeOf_arity]; exact y.2.2.symm
    have hz' : Fintype.card D = (treeOf z).arity := by rw [treeOf_arity]; exact z.2.2.symm
    rcases x.1.total i k hik with h | h
    · rw [LinOrd.rank_comp_inl_of_gt _ _ _ _ h, LinOrd.rank_comp_inl_of_lt _ _ _ _ h, hy,
        Bool.xor_assoc (Tree.tpar gp (treeOf y) && Tree.tpar gp (treeOf z))]
      exact Tree.mSgn_graft_before μ gp hμ (x.1.rank_lt_rank h) (rank_lt_arity x k) hz
    · rw [LinOrd.rank_comp_inl_of_lt _ _ _ _ h, LinOrd.rank_comp_inl_of_gt _ _ _ _ h, hz',
        Bool.xor_assoc (Tree.tpar gp (treeOf y) && Tree.tpar gp (treeOf z))]
      exact Tree.mSgn_graft_after μ gp (x.1.rank_lt_rank h) (rank_lt_arity x i)
  · have hz : (treeOf z).isLeaf = true := by simpa using hz
    rw [mcomp_bas_of_right μ _ hz, mcomp_bas_of_right μ _ hz, smul_zero, map_zero,
      LinearMap.map_zero₂, smul_zero]

name: Operad.FreeGr.mcomp_comp_inner_bas
statement:
theorem mcomp_comp_inner_bas (hμ : MergeFn.Odd gp μ) (i : A) (j : B)
    (x : Reg (TreeOfArity T) A) (y : Reg (TreeOfArity T) B) (z : Reg (TreeOfArity T) D)
    (hy : (treeOf y).isLeaf = false) :
    GrOperad.map (R := R) (seqEquiv i j D)
        (mcomp μ gp R (Sum.inr j)
          (GrOperad.comp (R := R) i (SgnLin.bas (treeSgn gp) R x) (SgnLin.bas (treeSgn gp) R y))
          (SgnLin.bas (treeSgn gp) R z))
      = σ R (Tree.tpar gp (treeOf x)) •
          GrOperad.comp (R := R) i (SgnLin.bas (treeSgn gp) R x)
            (mcomp μ gp R j (SgnLin.bas (treeSgn gp) R y) (SgnLin.bas (treeSgn gp) R z))
proof:
:= by
  rw [comp_bas_eq, map_smul, LinearMap.smul_apply]
  by_cases hz : (treeOf z).isLeaf = false
  · have hxy : (treeOf (SetOperad.comp i x y)).isLeaf = false := by
      rw [treeOf_comp]
      exact Tree.isLeaf_graft hy
    rw [mcomp_bas_of μ hxy hz, mcomp_bas_of μ hy hz, map_smul, map_smul, SgnLin.map_bas,
      mcompR_comp_inner μ i j x y z hy, map_smul, comp_bas_eq, smul_smul, smul_smul, smul_smul]
    congr 1
    simp only [mcompSgn_eq, ← σ_xor]
    congr 1
    simp only [treeOf_comp, comp_fst, treeOf_mcompR, LinOrd.rank_comp_inr]
    rw [Bool.xor_assoc (Tree.tpar gp (treeOf x))]
    exact Tree.mSgn_graft_inner μ gp hμ (rank_lt_arity x i) (rank_lt_arity y j) hy hz
  · have hz : (treeOf z).isLeaf = true := by simpa using hz
    rw [mcomp_bas_of_right μ _ hz, mcomp_bas_of_right μ _ hz, smul_zero, map_zero, map_zero,
      smul_zero]

name: Operad.FreeGr.comp_mcomp_outer_bas
statement:
theorem comp_mcomp_outer_bas (i : A) (j : B) (x : Reg (TreeOfArity T) A)
    (y : Reg (TreeOfArity T) B) (z : Reg (TreeOfArity T) D) (hy : (treeOf y).isLeaf = false) :
    GrOperad.map (R := R) (seqEquiv i j D)
        (GrOperad.comp (R := R) (Sum.inr j)
          (mcomp μ gp R i (SgnLin.bas (treeSgn gp) R x) (SgnLin.bas (treeSgn gp) R y))
          (SgnLin.bas (treeSgn gp) R z))
      = mcomp μ gp R i (SgnLin.bas (treeSgn gp) R x)
          (GrOperad.comp (R := R) j (SgnLin.bas (treeSgn gp) R y)
            (SgnLin.bas (treeSgn gp) R z))
proof:
:= by
  rw [comp_bas_eq (i := j), map_smul]
  by_cases hx : (treeOf x).isLeaf = false
  · have hyz : (treeOf (SetOperad.comp j y z)).isLeaf = false := by
      rw [treeOf_comp]
      exact Tree.isLeaf_graft_left hy _ _
    rw [mcomp_bas_of μ hx hy, mcomp_bas_of μ hx hyz, map_smul, LinearMap.smul_apply,
      comp_bas_eq, map_smul, map_smul, SgnLin.map_bas, comp_mcompR_outer μ i j x y z hy,
      smul_smul, smul_smul]
    congr 1
    simp only [mcompSgn_eq, ← σ_xor]
    congr 1
    simp only [treeOf_comp, treeOf_mcompR, mcompR_fst, comp_fst, LinOrd.rank_comp_inr]
    exact Tree.mSgn_graft_outer μ gp (rank_lt_arity x i) (rank_lt_arity y j) hy
  · have hx : (treeOf x).isLeaf = true := by simpa using hx
    rw [mcomp_bas_of_left μ _ hx, mcomp_bas_of_left μ _ hx, LinearMap.map_zero₂, map_zero,
      smul_zero]

name: Operad.FreeGr.unitCoeff_bas
statement:
lemma unitCoeff_bas (x : Reg (TreeOfArity T) A) :
    unitCoeff gp R A (SgnLin.bas (treeSgn gp) R x) = if (treeOf x).isLeaf then 1 else 0
proof:
:=
  (Finsupp.linearCombination_single R _ _).trans (one_smul R _)

name: Operad.FreeGr.bas_eq_single
statement:
lemma bas_eq_single (x : Reg (TreeOfArity T) A) (c : R) :
    (Finsupp.single x c : FreeGr R gp A) = c • SgnLin.bas (treeSgn gp) R x
proof:
:=
  (Finsupp.smul_single_one x c).symm

name: Operad.FreeGr.par_bas_eq
statement:
lemma par_bas_eq (b : Bool) (x : Reg (TreeOfArity T) A) :
    GrOperad.par (R := R) b (SgnLin.bas (treeSgn gp) R x)
      = if Tree.tpar gp (treeOf x) = b then SgnLin.bas (treeSgn gp) R x else 0
proof:
:=
  SgnLin.parT_single b x 1

name: Operad.FreeGr.isLeaf_graft_iff
statement:
lemma isLeaf_graft_iff {s : Tree T} {r : ℕ} (hr : r < s.arity) (t : Tree T) :
    (s.graft r t).isLeaf = (s.isLeaf && t.isLeaf)
proof:
:= by
  cases s with
  | leaf =>
    obtain rfl : r = 0 := by simpa using hr
    rfl
  | node e f => rfl

name: Operad.FreeGr.unitCoeff_comp
statement:
lemma unitCoeff_comp (i : A) (x : FreeGr R gp A) (y : FreeGr R gp B) :
    unitCoeff gp R _ (GrOperad.comp (R := R) i x y) = unitCoeff gp R A x * unitCoeff gp R B y
proof:
:= by
  have h : (GrOperad.comp (R := R) (P := FreeGr R gp) (B := B) i).compr₂ (unitCoeff gp R _)
      = (LinearMap.mul R R).compl₁₂ (unitCoeff gp R A) (unitCoeff gp R B) := by
    refine Finsupp.lhom_ext' fun s => LinearMap.ext_ring
      (Finsupp.lhom_ext' fun t => LinearMap.ext_ring ?_)
    show unitCoeff gp R _ (GrOperad.comp (R := R) i (SgnLin.bas (treeSgn gp) R s)
        (SgnLin.bas (treeSgn gp) R t))
      = unitCoeff gp R A (SgnLin.bas (treeSgn gp) R s) * unitCoeff gp R B
          (SgnLin.bas (treeSgn gp) R t)
    rw [comp_bas_eq, map_smul, unitCoeff_bas, unitCoeff_bas, unitCoeff_bas, treeOf_comp,
      isLeaf_graft_iff (rank_lt_arity s i)]
    by_cases hs : (treeOf s).isLeaf = true <;> by_cases ht : (treeOf t).isLeaf = true
    · rw [Tree.eq_leaf_of_isLeaf ht]
      simp [hs]
    · simp [hs, ht]
    · simp [hs, ht]
    · simp [hs, ht]
  exact LinearMap.congr_fun (LinearMap.congr_fun h x) y

name: Operad.FreeGr.unitCoeff_map
statement:
lemma unitCoeff_map {A' : Type} [Fintype A'] [DecidableEq A'] (e : A ≃ A') (x : FreeGr R gp A) :
    unitCoeff gp R A' (GrOperad.map (R := R) e x) = unitCoeff gp R A x
proof:
:= by
  have h := Lin.induction₁ (S := Reg (TreeOfArity T))
    (unitCoeff gp R A' ∘ₗ GrOperad.map (R := R) (P := FreeGr R gp) e) (unitCoeff gp R A)
    (fun s => ?_) x
  · simpa using h
  show unitCoeff gp R A' (GrOperad.map (R := R) e (SgnLin.bas (treeSgn gp) R s))
    = unitCoeff gp R A (SgnLin.bas (treeSgn gp) R s)
  rw [SgnLin.map_bas, unitCoeff_bas, unitCoeff_bas, treeOf_map]

name: Operad.FreeGr.unitCoeff_par
statement:
lemma unitCoeff_par (b : Bool) (x : FreeGr R gp A) :
    unitCoeff gp R A (GrOperad.par (R := R) b x) = if b then 0 else unitCoeff gp R A x
proof:
:= by
  have h := Lin.induction₁ (S := Reg (TreeOfArity T))
    (unitCoeff gp R A ∘ₗ GrOperad.par (R := R) (P := FreeGr R gp) b)
    (if b then 0 else unitCoeff gp R A) (fun s => ?_) x
  · exact h.trans (by split_ifs <;> rfl)
  show unitCoeff gp R A (GrOperad.par (R := R) b (SgnLin.bas (treeSgn gp) R s))
    = (if b then 0 else unitCoeff gp R A) (SgnLin.bas (treeSgn gp) R s)
  rw [par_bas_eq]
  by_cases hs : (treeOf s).isLeaf = true
  · have h0 : Tree.tpar gp (treeOf s) = false := by
      rw [Tree.eq_leaf_of_isLeaf hs]; rfl
    cases b <;> simp [h0, unitCoeff_bas, hs]
  · split_ifs <;> simp [unitCoeff_bas, hs]

name: Operad.FreeGr.eq_of_isLeaf
statement:
lemma eq_of_isLeaf {x y : Reg (TreeOfArity T) A} (hx : (treeOf x).isLeaf = true)
    (hy : (treeOf y).isLeaf = true) : x = y
proof:
:= by
  have h1 := treeOf_arity x
  rw [Tree.eq_leaf_of_isLeaf hx, Tree.arity_leaf, x.2.2] at h1
  haveI : Subsingleton A := Fintype.card_le_one_iff_subsingleton.1 h1.symm.le
  exact reg_ext (LinOrd.eq_of_subsingleton _ _)
    ((Tree.eq_leaf_of_isLeaf hx).trans (Tree.eq_leaf_of_isLeaf hy).symm)

name: Operad.FreeGr.eq_sum_nonleaf
statement:
lemma eq_sum_nonleaf (y : Reg (TreeOfArity T) A →₀ R) (hy : unitCoeff gp R A y = 0) :
    (y : FreeGr R gp A) = ∑ t ∈ y.support.filter (fun t => (treeOf t).isLeaf = false),
      y t • SgnLin.bas (treeSgn gp) R t
proof:
:= by
  have hsum : (y : FreeGr R gp A) = ∑ t ∈ y.support, y t • SgnLin.bas (treeSgn gp) R t := by
    conv_lhs => rw [← Finsupp.sum_single y]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun t _ => ?_
    exact (Finsupp.smul_single_one t (y t)).symm
  have hu : unitCoeff gp R A y = ∑ t ∈ y.support.filter (fun t => (treeOf t).isLeaf = true),
      y t := by
    conv_lhs => rw [hsum]
    rw [map_sum, Finset.sum_filter]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun t _ => ?_
    rw [map_smul, unitCoeff_bas, smul_eq_mul]
    split_ifs <;> simp
  rw [← Finset.sum_filter_add_sum_filter_not y.support (fun t => (treeOf t).isLeaf = true)] at hsum
  have h0 : ∑ t ∈ y.support.filter (fun t => (treeOf t).isLeaf = true),
      y t • SgnLin.bas (treeSgn gp) R t = 0 := by
    refine Finset.sum_eq_zero fun t ht => ?_
    have hfil : y.support.filter (fun t => (treeOf t).isLeaf = true) = {t} := by
      refine Finset.eq_singleton_iff_unique_mem.2 ⟨ht, fun t' ht' => ?_⟩
      exact eq_of_isLeaf (Finset.mem_filter.1 ht').2 (Finset.mem_filter.1 ht).2
    rw [hfil, Finset.sum_singleton] at hu
    rw [← hu, hy, zero_smul]
  rw [h0, zero_add] at hsum
  conv_lhs => rw [hsum]
  refine Finset.sum_congr ?_ fun _ _ => rfl
  ext t
  simp

name: Operad.FreeGr.induction_bas
statement:
theorem induction_bas {motive : FreeGr R gp A → Prop} (x : FreeGr R gp A) (zero : motive 0)
    (add : ∀ x y, motive x → motive y → motive (x + y))
    (bas : ∀ (c : R) (s : Reg (TreeOfArity T) A), motive (c • SgnLin.bas (treeSgn gp) R s)) :
    motive x
proof:
:=
  Finsupp.induction_linear (motive := motive) x zero add fun s c => by
    have h := bas c s
    rwa [← bas_eq_single] at h

name: Operad.FreeGr.tw_bas
statement:
lemma tw_bas (x : Reg (TreeOfArity T) A) :
    GrSpecies.tw (R := R) (V := FreeGr R gp) true (SgnLin.bas (treeSgn gp) R x)
      = σ R (Tree.tpar gp (treeOf x)) • SgnLin.bas (treeSgn gp) R x
proof:
:=
  (GrSpecies.tw_hom true (SgnLin.par_bas x)).trans (by rw [Bool.true_and]; rfl)

name: Operad.FreeGr.mcomp_comp_par
statement:
theorem mcomp_comp_par (hμ : MergeFn.Odd gp μ) {i k : A} (hik : i ≠ k) (x : FreeGr R gp A)
    {q r : Bool} {y : FreeGr R gp B} {z : FreeGr R gp D} (hy : GrOperad.par (R := R) q y = y)
    (hz : GrOperad.par (R := R) r z = z) :
    GrOperad.map (R := R) (parEquiv hik B D)
        (mcomp μ gp R (Sum.inl ⟨k, Ne.symm hik⟩) (GrOperad.comp (R := R) i x y) z)
      = σ R (q && r) • GrOperad.comp (R := R) (Sum.inl ⟨i, hik⟩) (mcomp μ gp R k x z) y
proof:
:= by
  rw [← hy, ← hz]
  clear hy hz
  induction x using induction_bas with
  | zero => simp
  | add x x' hx hx' => simp only [map_add, LinearMap.add_apply, hx, hx', smul_add]
  | bas c s =>
    induction y using induction_bas with
    | zero => simp
    | add y y' hy hy' => simp only [map_add, LinearMap.add_apply, hy, hy', smul_add]
    | bas c' t =>
      induction z using induction_bas with
      | zero => simp
      | add z z' hz hz' => simp only [map_add, LinearMap.add_apply, hz, hz', smul_add]
      | bas c'' u =>
        simp only [map_smul, LinearMap.smul_apply, par_bas_eq]
        by_cases h1 : Tree.tpar gp (treeOf t) = q
        · by_cases h2 : Tree.tpar gp (treeOf u) = r
          · rw [if_pos h1, if_pos h2, mcomp_comp_par_bas μ hμ hik s t u, h1, h2]
            module
          · rw [if_neg h2]
            simp
        · rw [if_neg h1]
          simp

name: Operad.FreeGr.mcomp_comp_inner
statement:
theorem mcomp_comp_inner (hμ : MergeFn.Odd gp μ) (i : A) (j : B) (x : FreeGr R gp A)
    (y : FreeGr R gp B) (z : FreeGr R gp D) (hy : unitCoeff gp R B y = 0) :
    GrOperad.map (R := R) (seqEquiv i j D)
        (mcomp μ gp R (Sum.inr j) (GrOperad.comp (R := R) i x y) z)
      = GrOperad.comp (R := R) i (GrSpecies.tw (R := R) (V := FreeGr R gp) true x)
          (mcomp μ gp R j y z)
proof:
:= by
  have key : ∀ t : Reg (TreeOfArity T) B, (treeOf t).isLeaf = false →
      GrOperad.map (R := R) (seqEquiv i j D) (mcomp μ gp R (Sum.inr j)
          (GrOperad.comp (R := R) i x (SgnLin.bas (treeSgn gp) R t)) z)
        = GrOperad.comp (R := R) i (GrSpecies.tw (R := R) (V := FreeGr R gp) true x)
          (mcomp μ gp R j (SgnLin.bas (treeSgn gp) R t) z) := by
    intro t ht
    induction x using induction_bas with
    | zero => simp
    | add x x' hx hx' => simp only [map_add, LinearMap.add_apply, hx, hx']
    | bas c s =>
      induction z using induction_bas with
      | zero => simp
      | add z z' hz hz' => simp only [map_add, hz, hz']
      | bas c'' u =>
        simp only [map_smul, LinearMap.smul_apply, tw_bas]
        rw [mcomp_comp_inner_bas μ hμ i j s t u ht]
  rw [eq_sum_nonleaf (y : Reg (TreeOfArity T) B →₀ R) hy]
  simp only [map_sum, map_smul, LinearMap.coe_sum, Finset.sum_apply, LinearMap.smul_apply]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun t ht => ?_
  rw [key t (Finset.mem_filter.1 ht).2]

name: Operad.FreeGr.comp_mcomp_outer
statement:
theorem comp_mcomp_outer (i : A) (j : B) (x : FreeGr R gp A) (y : FreeGr R gp B)
    (z : FreeGr R gp D) (hy : unitCoeff gp R B y = 0) :
    GrOperad.map (R := R) (seqEquiv i j D)
        (GrOperad.comp (R := R) (Sum.inr j) (mcomp μ gp R i x y) z)
      = mcomp μ gp R i x (GrOperad.comp (R := R) j y z)
proof:
:= by
  have key : ∀ t : Reg (TreeOfArity T) B, (treeOf t).isLeaf = false →
      GrOperad.map (R := R) (seqEquiv i j D)
          (GrOperad.comp (R := R) (Sum.inr j) (mcomp μ gp R i x (SgnLin.bas (treeSgn gp) R t)) z)
        = mcomp μ gp R i x (GrOperad.comp (R := R) j (SgnLin.bas (treeSgn gp) R t) z) := by
    intro t ht
    induction x using induction_bas with
    | zero => simp
    | add x x' hx hx' => simp only [map_add, LinearMap.add_apply, hx, hx']
    | bas c s =>
      induction z using induction_bas with
      | zero => simp
      | add z z' hz hz' => simp only [map_add, hz, hz']
      | bas c'' u =>
        simp only [map_smul, LinearMap.smul_apply]
        rw [comp_mcomp_outer_bas μ i j s t u ht]
  rw [eq_sum_nonleaf (y : Reg (TreeOfArity T) B →₀ R) hy]
  simp only [map_sum, map_smul, LinearMap.coe_sum, Finset.sum_apply, LinearMap.smul_apply]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun t ht => ?_
  rw [key t (Finset.mem_filter.1 ht).2]

name: Operad.FreeGr.par_mcomp
statement:
theorem par_mcomp (hμ : MergeFn.Odd gp μ) (c a b : Bool) (i : A) (x : FreeGr R gp A)
    (y : FreeGr R gp B) :
    GrOperad.par (R := R) c (mcomp μ gp R i (GrOperad.par (R := R) a x)
        (GrOperad.par (R := R) b y))
      = if c = !(xor a b) then mcomp μ gp R i (GrOperad.par (R := R) a x)
          (GrOperad.par (R := R) b y) else 0
proof:
:= by
  induction x using induction_bas with
  | zero => simp
  | add x x' hx hx' =>
    simp only [map_add, LinearMap.add_apply, hx, hx']
    split_ifs <;> simp
  | bas c₁ s =>
    induction y using induction_bas with
    | zero => simp
    | add y y' hy hy' =>
      simp only [map_add, hy, hy']
      split_ifs <;> simp
    | bas c₂ t =>
      simp only [map_smul, LinearMap.smul_apply, par_bas_eq]
      by_cases h1 : Tree.tpar gp (treeOf s) = a
      · by_cases h2 : Tree.tpar gp (treeOf t) = b
        · rw [if_pos h1, if_pos h2]
          by_cases hs : (treeOf s).isLeaf = false
          · by_cases ht : (treeOf t).isLeaf = false
            · rw [mcomp_bas_of μ hs ht]
              simp only [map_smul, par_bas_eq, treeOf_mcompR,
                Tree.tpar_mgraft μ gp hμ _ _ _ (rank_lt_arity s i) hs ht, h1, h2]
              split_ifs <;> simp_all
            · rw [mcomp_bas_of_right μ _ (by simpa using ht)]
              simp
          · rw [mcomp_bas_of_left μ _ (by simpa using hs)]
            simp
        · rw [if_neg h2]
          simp
      · rw [if_neg h1]
        simp

name: Operad.FreeGr.isDirect_leaves
statement:
lemma isDirect_leaves : ∀ {k : ℕ} (p : ℕ), p < k →
    (TreeOfArity.leaves (E := T) k).isDirect p = true
  | 0, _, h => absurd h (Nat.not_lt_zero _)
  | k + 1, p, h => by
    rw [TreeOfArity.leaves, Forest.isDirect]
    split_ifs with hp
    · rfl
    · exact isDirect_leaves (p - Tree.arity (Tree.leaf : Tree T)) (by simp at hp ⊢; omega)

name: Operad.FreeGr.childIdx_leaves
statement:
lemma childIdx_leaves : ∀ {k : ℕ} (p : ℕ), p < k →
    (TreeOfArity.leaves (E := T) k).childIdx p = p
  | 0, _, h => absurd h (Nat.not_lt_zero _)
  | k + 1, p, h => by
    rw [TreeOfArity.leaves, Forest.childIdx]
    split_ifs with hp
    · simp at hp; omega
    · rw [childIdx_leaves (p - Tree.arity (Tree.leaf : Tree T)) (by simp at hp ⊢; omega)]
      simp at hp ⊢
      omega

name: Operad.FreeGr.append_leaves
statement:
lemma append_leaves (k : ℕ) : ∀ l : ℕ,
    Forest.append (TreeOfArity.leaves (E := T) l) (TreeOfArity.leaves k)
      = TreeOfArity.leaves (k + l)
  | 0 => rfl
  | l + 1 => by
    show Forest.cons Tree.leaf (Forest.append (TreeOfArity.leaves l) (TreeOfArity.leaves k)) = _
    rw [append_leaves k l]
    rfl

name: Operad.FreeGr.splice_leaves
statement:
lemma splice_leaves : ∀ (k j l : ℕ),
    (TreeOfArity.leaves (E := T) k).splice j (TreeOfArity.leaves l)
      = TreeOfArity.leaves (Forest.spliceLen k j l)
  | 0, _, _ => rfl
  | k + 1, 0, l => append_leaves k l
  | k + 1, j + 1, l => by
    show Forest.cons Tree.leaf ((TreeOfArity.leaves k).splice j (TreeOfArity.leaves l)) = _
    rw [splice_leaves k j l]
    rfl

name: Operad.FreeGr.spliceLen_eq
statement:
lemma spliceLen_eq : ∀ {k j : ℕ} (l : ℕ), j < k → Forest.spliceLen k j l + 1 = k + l
  | 0, _, _, h => absurd h (Nat.not_lt_zero _)
  | k + 1, 0, l, _ => by simp [Forest.spliceLen]; omega
  | k + 1, j + 1, l, h => by
    have
proof:
:= spliceLen_eq (k := k) (j := j) l (by omega)
    simp only [Forest.spliceLen]
    omega

name: Operad.FreeGr.aparF_leaves
statement:
lemma aparF_leaves (gp : ∀ k, T k → Bool) : ∀ (k p : ℕ),
    Forest.aparF gp (TreeOfArity.leaves (E := T) k) p = false
  | 0, _ => rfl
  | k + 1, p => by
    rw [TreeOfArity.leaves, Forest.aparF]
    split_ifs
    · rw [Tree.tparF_leaves]
      rfl
    · exact aparF_leaves gp k _

name: Operad.FreeGr.corolla_mgraft
statement:
lemma corolla_mgraft {k l : ℕ} (g : T k) (h : T l) {i : ℕ} (hi : i < k) :
    (Tree.node g (TreeOfArity.leaves k)).mgraft μ i (Tree.node h (TreeOfArity.leaves l))
      = Tree.node (μ k l g i h (Forest.spliceLen k i l))
          (TreeOfArity.leaves (Forest.spliceLen k i l))
proof:
:= by
  rw [Tree.mgraft_node, if_pos (isDirect_leaves i hi)]
  show Tree.mergeRoot μ g _ _ h _ = _
  rw [Tree.mergeRoot, childIdx_leaves i hi, splice_leaves]

name: Operad.FreeGr.mSgn_corolla
statement:
lemma mSgn_corolla (gp : ∀ k, T k → Bool) {k l : ℕ} (g : T k) (h : T l) {i : ℕ} (hi : i < k) :
    Tree.mSgn gp (Tree.node g (TreeOfArity.leaves k)) i (Tree.node h (TreeOfArity.leaves l))
      = false
proof:
:= by
  simp only [Tree.mSgn, Tree.mgSgn, Tree.apar, Tree.lpar_node, Tree.mpar_node,
    if_pos (isDirect_leaves (T := T) i hi), aparF_leaves, Tree.tparF_leaves, Bool.and_false,
    Bool.xor_false]

name: Operad.Perm.compFin_2_2_zero
statement:
lemma compFin_2_2_zero : compFin (R := R) (P := Perm R) (0 : Fin 2) x y
    = ![x 0 * y 0, x 0 * y 1, x 1 * (y 0 + y 1)]
proof:
:= by
  funext j
  rw [show (0 : Fin 2) = ⟨0, by omega⟩ from rfl, compFin_eq_comp 0 1 (P := Perm R) x y,
    reindex_apply, comp_eq]
  fin_cases j <;> simp [permComp, Fin.sum_univ_two] <;> ring

name: Operad.Perm.compFin_2_2_one
statement:
lemma compFin_2_2_one : compFin (R := R) (P := Perm R) (1 : Fin 2) x y
    = ![x 0 * (y 0 + y 1), x 1 * y 0, x 1 * y 1]
proof:
:= by
  funext j
  rw [show (1 : Fin 2) = ⟨1, by omega⟩ from rfl, compFin_eq_comp 1 0 (P := Perm R) x y,
    reindex_apply, comp_eq]
  fin_cases j <;> simp [permComp, Fin.sum_univ_two] <;> ring

name: Operad.Perm.compFin_2_3_zero
statement:
lemma compFin_2_3_zero : compFin (R := R) (P := Perm R) (0 : Fin 2) x z
    = ![x 0 * z 0, x 0 * z 1, x 0 * z 2, x 1 * (z 0 + z 1 + z 2)]
proof:
:= by
  funext j
  rw [show (0 : Fin 2) = ⟨0, by omega⟩ from rfl, compFin_eq_comp 0 1 (P := Perm R) x z,
    reindex_apply, comp_eq]
  fin_cases j <;> simp [permComp, Fin.sum_univ_three] <;> ring

name: Operad.Perm.compFin_2_3_one
statement:
lemma compFin_2_3_one : compFin (R := R) (P := Perm R) (1 : Fin 2) x z
    = ![x 0 * (z 0 + z 1 + z 2), x 1 * z 0, x 1 * z 1, x 1 * z 2]
proof:
:= by
  funext j
  rw [show (1 : Fin 2) = ⟨1, by omega⟩ from rfl, compFin_eq_comp 1 0 (P := Perm R) x z,
    reindex_apply, comp_eq]
  fin_cases j <;> simp [permComp, Fin.sum_univ_three] <;> ring

name: Operad.Perm.compFin_3_2_zero
statement:
lemma compFin_3_2_zero : compFin (R := R) (P := Perm R) (0 : Fin 3) z x
    = ![z 0 * x 0, z 0 * x 1, z 1 * (x 0 + x 1), z 2 * (x 0 + x 1)]
proof:
:= by
  funext j
  rw [show (0 : Fin 3) = ⟨0, by omega⟩ from rfl, compFin_eq_comp 0 2 (P := Perm R) z x,
    reindex_apply, comp_eq]
  fin_cases j <;> simp [permComp, Fin.sum_univ_two] <;> ring

name: Operad.Perm.compFin_3_2_one
statement:
lemma compFin_3_2_one : compFin (R := R) (P := Perm R) (1 : Fin 3) z x
    = ![z 0 * (x 0 + x 1), z 1 * x 0, z 1 * x 1, z 2 * (x 0 + x 1)]
proof:
:= by
  funext j
  rw [show (1 : Fin 3) = ⟨1, by omega⟩ from rfl, compFin_eq_comp 1 1 (P := Perm R) z x,
    reindex_apply, comp_eq]
  fin_cases j <;> simp [permComp, Fin.sum_univ_two] <;> ring

name: Operad.Perm.compFin_3_2_two
statement:
lemma compFin_3_2_two : compFin (R := R) (P := Perm R) (2 : Fin 3) z x
    = ![z 0 * (x 0 + x 1), z 1 * (x 0 + x 1), z 2 * x 0, z 2 * x 1]
proof:
:= by
  funext j
  rw [show (2 : Fin 3) = ⟨2, by omega⟩ from rfl, compFin_eq_comp 2 0 (P := Perm R) z x,
    reindex_apply, comp_eq]
  fin_cases j <;> simp [permComp, Fin.sum_univ_two] <;> ring

name: Operad.Perm.mem_sumZero
statement: lemma mem_sumZero {n : ℕ} (x : Perm R n) : x ∈ (sumZero (R := R)).carrier n ↔ ∑ j, x j = 0
proof:
:=
  Iff.rfl

name: Operad.STree.vpar_leaf
statement: @[simp] lemma vpar_leaf (a : ℕ) : vpar p (leaf a : STree B) = false
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.STree.vpar_node
statement:
lemma vpar_node {k : ℕ} (β : B k) (c : Fin k → STree B) :
    vpar p (node β c) = xor (p k β) (GrEnd.tot fun j => vpar p (c j))
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.STree.vaft_leaf
statement: @[simp] lemma vaft_leaf (a m : ℕ) : vaft p (leaf a : STree B) m = false
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.STree.vaft_node
statement:
lemma vaft_node {k : ℕ} (β : B k) (c : Fin k → STree B) (m : ℕ) :
    vaft p (node β c) m = GrEnd.tot fun j => if m ∈ (c j).labels then vaft p (c j) m
      else if ∃ j', j' < j ∧ m ∈ (c j').labels then vpar p (c j) else false
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.STree.exists_child
statement: lemma exists_child (h : (node β c).labels = Y.val) (s : Lab Y) : ∃ j, s.1 ∈ (c j).labels
proof:
:=
  mem_labels_node.1 (by rw [h]; exact s.2)

name: Operad.STree.mem_own
statement: lemma mem_own (h : (node β c).labels = Y.val) (s : Lab Y) : s.1 ∈ (c (own h s)).labels
proof:
:=
  (exists_child h s).choose_spec

name: Operad.STree.nodup_node
statement: lemma nodup_node (h : (node β c).labels = Y.val) : (node β c).labels.Nodup
proof: := h ▸ Y.nodup

name: Operad.STree.child_eq
statement:
lemma child_eq (h : (node β c).labels = Y.val) {j j' : Fin k} {x : ℕ} (hx : x ∈ (c j).labels)
    (hx' : x ∈ (c j').labels) : j = j'
proof:
:=
  by_contra fun hne => not_mem_of_node (nodup_node h) hne hx hx'

name: Operad.STree.own_eq
statement:
lemma own_eq (h : (node β c).labels = Y.val) {s : Lab Y} {j : Fin k} (hs : s.1 ∈ (c j).labels) :
    own h s = j
proof:
:=
  child_eq h (mem_own h s) hs

name: Operad.STree.mem_of_child
statement:
lemma mem_of_child (h : (node β c).labels = Y.val) {j : Fin k} {x : ℕ} (hx : x ∈ (c j).labels) :
    x ∈ Y
proof:
:= by
  have hx' : x ∈ (node β c).labels := mem_labels_node.2 ⟨j, hx⟩
  rw [h] at hx'
  exact hx'

name: Operad.STree.labels_child
statement:
lemma labels_child (h : (node β c).labels = Y.val) (j : Fin k) :
    (c j).labels = (cLab c j).val
proof:
:= by
  rw [Multiset.toFinset_val, Multiset.Nodup.dedup (nodup_of_node (nodup_node h) j)]

name: Operad.STree.childEquiv_val
statement:
@[simp] lemma childEquiv_val (h : (node β c).labels = Y.val) (j : Fin k) (x : Lab (cLab c j)) :
    (childEquiv h j x).1.1 = x.1
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.FreeGrL.shEv_leaf
statement:
lemma shEv_leaf (a : ℕ) (Y : Finset ℕ) (h : (STree.leaf a : STree B).labels = Y.val) :
    shEv b (.leaf a) Y h = unitL R W (Lab Y)
proof:
:= by
  rw [shEv]

name: Operad.FreeGrL.shEv_node
statement:
lemma shEv_node {k : ℕ} (β : B k) (c : Fin k → STree B) (Y : Finset ℕ)
    (h : (STree.node β c).labels = Y.val) :
    shEv b (.node β c) Y h = graft R W (Lab Y) (mk R (ownGen (LinOrd.std _) (b _ β) (own h)
      fun j => GrOperad.map (R := R) (childEquiv h j) (shEv b (c j) (cLab c j)
        (labels_child h j))))
proof:
:= by
  rw [shEv]

name: Operad.FreeGrL.map_shEv
statement:
lemma map_shEv {t t' : STree B} (ht : t = t') {Y Y' : Finset ℕ} (hY : Y = Y')
    (h : t.labels = Y.val) (h' : t'.labels = Y'.val) (e : Lab Y ≃ Lab Y')
    (he : ∀ x, (e x).1 = x.1) :
    GrOperad.map (R := R) e (shEv b t Y h) = shEv b t' Y' h'
proof:
:= by
  subst ht hY
  rw [show e = Equiv.refl _ from Equiv.ext fun x => Subtype.ext (he x), GrOperad.map_refl]

name: Operad.FreeGrL.par_graft
statement:
lemma par_graft {S : Type} [Fintype S] [DecidableEq S] (q : Bool)
    (ω : GrComposite R W (FreeGrL R W) S) :
    GrOperad.par (R := R) q (graft R W S ω) = graft R W S (GrComposite.par R W (FreeGrL R W) q ω)
proof:
:= by
  have hu : unitCoeffL R W S (GrOperad.par (R := R) q (graft R W S ω)) = 0 := by
    rw [unitCoeffL_par, unitCoeffL_graft]
    cases q <;> rfl
  rw [← secC_of_unitCoeff hu, ← graft_root, root_par, root_graft]

name: Operad.FreeGrL.par_shEv
statement:
theorem par_shEv : ∀ (t : STree B) (Y : Finset ℕ) (h : t.labels = Y.val),
    GrOperad.par (R := R) (vpar p t) (shEv b t Y h) = shEv b t Y h
  | .leaf _, Y, h => by
    rw [vpar_leaf, shEv_leaf, par_unitL]
    rfl
  | .node β c, Y, h => by
    rw [vpar_node, shEv_node, par_graft, par_mk, parFun_hom _ _ (hb _ β)
      (c := fun j => vpar p (c j)) (fun j => ?_), if_pos rfl]
    show GrOperad.par (R := R) _ (GrOperad.map (R := R) _ _) = _
    rw [← GrOperad.map_par, par_shEv (c j)]

end Par

name: Operad.FreeGrL.prod_update_add
statement:
lemma prod_update_add {ι : Type} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] {M : ι → Type*} [∀ i, Add (M i)]
    (F : ∀ i, M i → R) (y : ∀ i, M i) (i : ι) (z z' : M i)
    (hF : F i (z + z') = F i z + F i z') :
    ∏ j, F j (update y i (z + z') j) = ∏ j, F j (update y i z j) + ∏ j, F j (update y i z' j)
proof:
:= by
  have hu : ∀ w : M i, (fun j => F j (update y i w j)) = update (fun j => F j (y j)) i (F i w) :=
    fun w => funext fun j => apply_update F y i w j
  rw [hu, hu, hu, Finset.prod_update_of_mem (Finset.mem_univ i),
    Finset.prod_update_of_mem (Finset.mem_univ i), Finset.prod_update_of_mem (Finset.mem_univ i),
    hF, add_mul]

name: Operad.FreeGrL.prod_update_smul
statement:
lemma prod_update_smul {ι : Type} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] {M : ι → Type*} [∀ i, SMul R (M i)]
    (F : ∀ i, M i → R) (y : ∀ i, M i) (i : ι) (r : R) (z : M i) (hF : F i (r • z) = r * F i z) :
    ∏ j, F j (update y i (r • z) j) = r * ∏ j, F j (update y i z j)
proof:
:= by
  have hu : ∀ w : M i, (fun j => F j (update y i w j)) = update (fun j => F j (y j)) i (F i w) :=
    fun w => funext fun j => apply_update F y i w j
  rw [hu, hu, Finset.prod_update_of_mem (Finset.mem_univ i),
    Finset.prod_update_of_mem (Finset.mem_univ i), hF, mul_assoc]

name: Operad.FreeGrL.compOwn_add_m
statement:
lemma compOwn_add_m (L : LinOrd A) (m m' : W A) (f : Lab Y → A) (y : ∀ a, FreeGrL R W (Fib f a)) :
    compOwn b p h ψ L (m + m') f y = compOwn b p h ψ L m f y + compOwn b p h ψ L m' f y
proof:
:= by
  unfold compOwn
  rw [← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun ν _ => ?_
  split_ifs with hν
  · rw [map_add, map_add]
    ring
  · rw [add_zero]

name: Operad.FreeGrL.compOwn_smul_m
statement:
lemma compOwn_smul_m (L : LinOrd A) (r : R) (m : W A) (f : Lab Y → A)
    (y : ∀ a, FreeGrL R W (Fib f a)) :
    compOwn b p h ψ L (r • m) f y = r • compOwn b p h ψ L m f y
proof:
:= by
  unfold compOwn
  rw [Finset.smul_sum]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun ν _ => ?_
  split_ifs with hν
  · rw [map_smul, map_smul, smul_eq_mul, smul_eq_mul]
    ring
  · rw [smul_zero]

name: Operad.FreeGrL.compOwn_update_add
statement:
lemma compOwn_update_add (L : LinOrd A) (m : W A) (f : Lab Y → A)
    (y : ∀ a, FreeGrL R W (Fib f a)) (a : A) (w w' : FreeGrL R W (Fib f a)) :
    compOwn b p h ψ L m f (update y a (w + w'))
      = compOwn b p h ψ L m f (update y a w) + compOwn b p h ψ L m f (update y a w')
proof:
:= by
  unfold compOwn
  rw [← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun ν _ => ?_
  split_ifs with hν
  · have key := prod_update_add (fun a' x => childCoord p h ψ (ν a')
      (GrOperad.map (R := R) (fibNu h f ν hν a') x)) y a w w' (by simp only [map_add])
    beta_reduce at key
    rw [key]
    ring
  · rw [add_zero]

name: Operad.FreeGrL.compOwn_update_smul
statement:
lemma compOwn_update_smul (L : LinOrd A) (m : W A) (f : Lab Y → A)
    (y : ∀ a, FreeGrL R W (Fib f a)) (a : A) (r : R) (w : FreeGrL R W (Fib f a)) :
    compOwn b p h ψ L m f (update y a (r • w)) = r • compOwn b p h ψ L m f (update y a w)
proof:
:= by
  unfold compOwn
  rw [Finset.smul_sum]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun ν _ => ?_
  split_ifs with hν
  · have key := prod_update_smul (fun a' x => childCoord p h ψ (ν a')
      (GrOperad.map (R := R) (fibNu h f ν hν a') x)) y a r w
      (by simp only [map_smul, smul_eq_mul])
    beta_reduce at key
    rw [key, smul_eq_mul]
    ring
  · rw [smul_zero]

name: Operad.FreeGrL.linOrd_map_trans
statement:
lemma linOrd_map_trans {A' A'' : Type} (e : A ≃ A') (e' : A' ≃ A'') (L : LinOrd A) :
    LinOrd.map (e.trans e') L = LinOrd.map e' (LinOrd.map e L)
proof:
:=
  LinOrd.ext fun _ _ => Iff.rfl

name: Operad.FreeGrL.compOwn_outer
statement:
lemma compOwn_outer {A' : Type} [Fintype A'] [DecidableEq A'] (σ : A' ≃ A) (L : LinOrd A)
    (m : W A') (f : Lab Y → A) (y : ∀ a, FreeGrL R W (Fib f a)) :
    compOwn b p h ψ L (SymSpecies.map (R := R) σ m) f y
      = compOwn b p h ψ (LinOrd.map σ.symm L) m (σ.symm ∘ f)
          (fun a' => GrOperad.map (R := R) (fibOuter σ f a') (y (σ a')))
proof:
:= by
  unfold compOwn
  refine Fintype.sum_equiv ⟨fun ν => σ.trans ν, fun ν' => σ.symm.trans ν',
    fun ν => by ext; simp, fun ν' => by ext; simp⟩ _ _ fun ν => ?_
  have hiff : (∀ s, ν (f s) = own h s) ↔ ∀ s, (σ.trans ν) ((σ.symm ∘ f) s) = own h s := by
    simp
  by_cases hν : ∀ s, ν (f s) = own h s
  · rw [dif_pos hν]
    erw [dif_pos (hiff.1 hν)]
    have h1 : GrEnd.rsg R (LinOrd.map σ.symm L) (LinOrd.map (σ.trans ν).symm (LinOrd.std k))
        (fun a' => vpar p (c ((σ.trans ν) a')))
        = GrEnd.rsg R L (LinOrd.map ν.symm (LinOrd.std k)) (fun a => vpar p (c (ν a))) := by
      rw [show (σ.trans ν).symm = ν.symm.trans σ.symm from rfl, linOrd_map_trans, GrEnd.rsg_map]
      simp only [Equiv.trans_apply, Equiv.apply_symm_apply]
    have h2 : SymSpecies.map (R := R) (σ.trans ν) m
        = SymSpecies.map (R := R) ν (SymSpecies.map (R := R) σ m) := SymSpecies.map_trans _ _ _
    have h3 : ∏ a', childCoord p h ψ ((σ.trans ν) a')
        (GrOperad.map (R := R) (fibNu h (σ.symm ∘ f) (σ.trans ν) (hiff.1 hν) a')
          (GrOperad.map (R := R) (fibOuter σ f a') (y (σ a'))))
        = ∏ a, childCoord p h ψ (ν a) (GrOperad.map (R := R) (fibNu h f ν hν a) (y a)) :=
      Fintype.prod_equiv σ _ _ fun a' => by
        show childCoord p h ψ (ν (σ a')) _ = _
        rw [← GrOperad.map_trans]
        exact congrArg _ (gmap_congr (fun x => Subtype.ext rfl) _)
    refine Eq.trans ?_ (congrArg₂ (· * ·) h1.symm (congrArg₂ (· * ·)
      (congrArg ((b k).coord β) h2.symm) h3.symm))
    rfl
  · rw [dif_neg hν]
    erw [dif_neg (fun h' => hν (hiff.2 h'))]

name: Operad.FreeGrL.compOwn_reorder
statement:
lemma compOwn_reorder (L L' : LinOrd A) (m : W A) (f : Lab Y → A)
    (y : ∀ a, FreeGrL R W (Fib f a)) (cc : A → Bool)
    (hy : ∀ a, GrOperad.par (R := R) (cc a) (y a) = y a) :
    compOwn b p h ψ L m f y = GrEnd.rsg R L L' cc • compOwn b p h ψ L' m f y
proof:
:= by
  unfold compOwn
  rw [Finset.smul_sum]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun ν _ => ?_
  split_ifs with hν
  · by_cases hc : ∀ a, cc a = vpar p (c (ν a))
    · rw [show cc = fun a => vpar p (c (ν a)) from funext hc, smul_eq_mul,
        ← GrEnd.rsg_trans L L' (LinOrd.map ν.symm (LinOrd.std k))]
      ring
    · push Not at hc
      obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := hc
      have h0 : childCoord p h ψ (ν a) (GrOperad.map (R := R) (fibNu h f ν hν a) (y a)) = 0 := by
        simp only [childCoord, LinearMap.coe_comp, Function.comp_apply]
        rw [← hy a]
        simp only [GrOperad.map_par, GrOperad.par_par, if_neg (Ne.symm ha), map_zero]
      rw [Finset.prod_eq_zero (Finset.mem_univ a) h0, mul_zero, mul_zero, mul_zero, smul_zero]
  · rw [smul_zero]

name: Operad.FreeGrL.compOwn_congr
statement:
lemma compOwn_congr (L : LinOrd A) (m : W A) {f f' : Lab Y → A} (hf : f = f')
    (y : ∀ a, FreeGrL R W (Fib f a)) :
    compOwn b p h ψ L m f y = compOwn b p h ψ L m f' (fun a =>
      GrOperad.map (R := R) (Equiv.subtypeEquivRight fun s => by rw [hf]) (y a))
proof:
:= by
  subst hf
  congr 1
  funext a
  rw [show (Equiv.subtypeEquivRight _ : Fib f a ≃ Fib f a) = Equiv.refl _ from
    Equiv.ext fun _ => rfl, GrOperad.map_refl]

name: Operad.FreeGrL.childCoord_map
statement:
lemma childCoord_map {k' : ℕ} {β' : B k'} {c' : Fin k' → STree B}
    (h' : (STree.node β' c').labels = Y.val) (j' : Fin k') (i : Fin k)
    (E : Fib (own h') j' ≃ Fib (own h) i) (hE : ∀ s, (E s).1.1 = s.1.1)
    (hsh : (c' j').labels = (cLab c i).val) :
    childCoord p h ψ i (GrOperad.map (R := R) E (GrOperad.map (R := R) (childEquiv h' j')
      (shEv b (c' j') (cLab c' j') (labels_child h' j'))))
      = ψ i (GrOperad.par (R := R) (vpar p (c i)) (shEv b (c' j') (cLab c i) hsh))
proof:
:= by
  have hcl : cLab c' j' = cLab c i := by rw [cLab, hsh, Finset.val_toFinset]
  simp only [childCoord, LinearMap.coe_comp, Function.comp_apply]
  rw [← GrOperad.map_par, ← GrOperad.map_par, ← GrOperad.map_trans, ← GrOperad.map_trans,
    GrOperad.map_par, map_shEv b rfl hcl _ hsh _ (fun x => hE (childEquiv h' j' x))]

name: Operad.FreeGrL.compFun_ownGen
statement:
lemma compFun_ownGen (L : LinOrd A) (m : W A) (f : Lab Y → A) (y : ∀ a, FreeGrL R W (Fib f a)) :
    compFun b p h ψ (ownGen L m f y) = compOwn b p h ψ L m f y
proof:
:= by
  unfold compFun
  congr 1
  funext a
  show GrOperad.map (R := R) (fibEquiv (ownGen L m f y) a) (y a) = y a
  rw [show fibEquiv (ownGen L m f y) a = Equiv.refl _ from Equiv.ext fun _ => Subtype.ext rfl]
  exact GrOperad.map_refl (R := R) _

name: Operad.FreeGrL.compFun_respects
statement:
lemma compFun_respects : GrCompGen.Respects R (compFun b p h ψ) where
  add_m g m'
proof:
:= compOwn_add_m b p h ψ g.L g.m m' (owner g) (ownY (R := R) g)
  smul_m g r := compOwn_smul_m b p h ψ g.L r g.m (owner g) (ownY (R := R) g)
  add_y g a w w' := by
    show compOwn b p h ψ g.L g.m (owner g) (ownY (R := R) { g with y := update g.y a (w + w') })
      = compOwn b p h ψ g.L g.m (owner g) (ownY (R := R) { g with y := update g.y a w })
        + compOwn b p h ψ g.L g.m (owner g) (ownY (R := R) { g with y := update g.y a w' })
    rw [ownY_update, ownY_update, ownY_update, map_add, compOwn_update_add]
  smul_y g a r w := by
    show compOwn b p h ψ g.L g.m (owner g) (ownY (R := R) { g with y := update g.y a (r • w) })
      = r • compOwn b p h ψ g.L g.m (owner g) (ownY (R := R) { g with y := update g.y a w })
    rw [ownY_update, ownY_update, map_smul, compOwn_update_smul]
  outer := @fun g A _ _ σ m => by
    show compOwn b p h ψ g.L (SymSpecies.map (R := R) σ m) (owner g) (ownY (R := R) g) = _
    rw [compOwn_outer, compFun, compOwn_congr b p h ψ _ m (owner_outer g σ m).symm]
    congr 1
    funext a'
    simp only [ownY, ← GrOperad.map_trans]
    apply gmap_congr
    intro x
    rfl
  inner := @fun g B _ _ τ => by
    show compOwn b p h ψ g.L g.m _ (ownY (R := R) (⟨g.A, B, g.L, g.m,
      fun a => SymSpecies.map (R := R) (τ a) (g.y a),
      (Equiv.sigmaCongrRight τ).symm.trans g.e⟩ : GrCompGen W (FreeGrL R W) (Lab Y)))
      = compFun b p h ψ g
    unfold compFun
    congr 1
    funext a
    apply gmap_comp_congr
    intro x
    exact Subtype.ext (show g.e ⟨a, (τ a).symm (τ a x)⟩ = g.e ⟨a, x⟩ by
      rw [Equiv.symm_apply_apply])
  reorder g L' cc hy := compOwn_reorder b p h ψ g.L L' g.m (owner g) (ownY (R := R) g) cc
    fun a => by
      show GrOperad.par (R := R) (cc a) (GrOperad.map (R := R) _ (g.y a)) = _
      rw [← GrOperad.map_par]
      exact congrArg _ (hy a)

name: Operad.FreeGrL.shCoord_leaf
statement:
lemma shCoord_leaf (a : ℕ) (Y : Finset ℕ) (h : (STree.leaf a : STree B).labels = Y.val) :
    shCoord b p (.leaf a) Y h = unitCoeffL R W (Lab Y)
proof:
:= by
  rw [shCoord]

name: Operad.FreeGrL.shCoord_node
statement:
lemma shCoord_node {k : ℕ} (β : B k) (c : Fin k → STree B) (Y : Finset ℕ)
    (h : (STree.node β c).labels = Y.val) :
    shCoord b p (.node β c) Y h = lift (compFun b p h fun j => shCoord b p (c j) (cLab c j)
      (labels_child h j)) (compFun_respects b p h _) ∘ₗ root R W (Lab Y)
proof:
:= by
  rw [shCoord]

name: Operad.STree.eq_refl_of_strictMono
statement:
lemma eq_refl_of_strictMono {n : ℕ} (ν : Fin n ≃ Fin n) (hν : StrictMono ν) :
    ν = Equiv.refl _
proof:
:= by
  have hν' : StrictMono ν.symm := fun a b hab => by
    by_contra hle
    have := hν.monotone (not_lt.1 hle)
    rw [Equiv.apply_symm_apply, Equiv.apply_symm_apply] at this
    exact absurd hab (not_lt.2 this)
  refine Equiv.ext fun i => le_antisymm ?_ (hν.le_apply)
  have := hν'.le_apply (x := ν i)
  rwa [Equiv.symm_apply_apply] at this

name: Operad.STree.labels_eq_of_own
statement:
lemma labels_eq_of_own (h : (node β c).labels = Y.val) (h' : (node β' c').labels = Y.val)
    (ν : Fin k' ≃ Fin k) (hν : ∀ s, ν (own h' s) = own h s) (j : Fin k') :
    (c' j).labels = (c (ν j)).labels
proof:
:= by
  refine (Multiset.Nodup.ext (nodup_of_node (nodup_node h') j)
    (nodup_of_node (nodup_node h) (ν j))).2 fun x => ⟨fun hx => ?_, fun hx => ?_⟩
  · have hs := own_eq h' (s := ⟨x, mem_of_child h' hx⟩) hx
    have hm := mem_own h ⟨x, mem_of_child h' hx⟩
    rwa [← hν, hs] at hm
  · have hs := own_eq h (s := ⟨x, mem_of_child h hx⟩) hx
    rw [← hν] at hs
    have hm := mem_own h' ⟨x, mem_of_child h hx⟩
    rwa [ν.injective hs] at hm

name: Operad.STree.strictMono_of_own
statement:
lemma strictMono_of_own (ht : (node β c).IsShuffle) (ht' : (node β' c').IsShuffle)
    (h : (node β c).labels = Y.val) (h' : (node β' c').labels = Y.val) (ν : Fin k' ≃ Fin k)
    (hν : ∀ s, ν (own h' s) = own h s) : StrictMono ν
proof:
:= by
  have hf : ∀ j, (c' j).first = (c (ν j)).first := fun j =>
    first_eq_of_labels_eq (ht'.child j) (ht.child (ν j)) (labels_eq_of_own h h' ν hν j)
  intro j₁ j₂ hj
  have hlt := ht'.mono hj
  simp only [hf] at hlt
  exact ht.mono.lt_iff_lt.1 hlt

name: Operad.FreeGrL.unitCoeffL_unitL_of
statement:
lemma unitCoeffL_unitL_of {Y : Finset ℕ} {a : ℕ} (hY : Y.val = {a}) :
    unitCoeffL R W (Lab Y) (unitL R W (Lab Y)) = 1
proof:
:= by
  have ha : a ∈ Y := by
    rw [← Finset.mem_val, hY]
    exact Multiset.mem_singleton_self a
  let e : Unit ≃ Lab Y := ⟨fun _ => ⟨a, ha⟩, fun _ => (), fun _ => rfl, fun x => Subtype.ext (by
    have hx := x.2
    rw [← Finset.mem_val, hY, Multiset.mem_singleton] at hx
    exact hx.symm)⟩
  rw [unitL_eq e, unitCoeffL_map, unitCoeffL_one]

name: Operad.FreeGrL.root_unitL
statement: lemma root_unitL (A : Type) [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] : root R W A (unitL R W A) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [unitL, map_sum]
  exact Finset.sum_eq_zero fun e _ => by rw [root_map, root_one, map_zero]

name: Operad.FreeGrL.linOrd_map_refl
statement: lemma linOrd_map_refl {A : Type} (L : LinOrd A) : LinOrd.map (Equiv.refl A) L = L
proof:
:=
  LinOrd.ext fun _ _ => Iff.rfl

name: Operad.FreeGrL.shCoord_shEv
statement:
theorem shCoord_shEv [DecidableEq (STree B)] :
    ∀ (t : STree B) (Y : Finset ℕ) (h : t.labels = Y.val), t.IsShuffle →
    ∀ (t' : STree B) (h' : t'.labels = Y.val), t'.IsShuffle →
      shCoord b p t Y h (shEv b t' Y h') = if t = t' then 1 else 0
  | .leaf a, Y, h, _, .leaf a', h', _ => by
    rw [shCoord_leaf, shEv_leaf, unitCoeffL_unitL_of h.symm]
    have haa : a = a'
proof:
:= Multiset.singleton_inj.1 (h.trans h'.symm)
    subst haa
    rw [if_pos rfl]
  | .leaf a, Y, h, _, .node β' c', h', _ => by
    rw [shCoord_leaf, shEv_node, unitCoeffL_graft, if_neg (by simp)]
  | .node β c, Y, h, _, .leaf a', h', _ => by
    rw [shCoord_node, shEv_leaf, LinearMap.comp_apply, root_unitL, map_zero, if_neg (by simp)]
  | @STree.node _ k β c, Y, h, ht, @STree.node _ k' β' c', h', ht' => by
    rw [shCoord_node, shEv_node, LinearMap.comp_apply, root_graft, lift_mk, compFun_ownGen]
    unfold compOwn
    by_cases hm : ∃ ν : Fin k' ≃ Fin k, ∀ s, ν (own h' s) = own h s
    · obtain ⟨ν₀, hν₀⟩ := hm
      have hk : k' = k := by simpa using Fintype.card_congr ν₀
      subst hk
      have hrefl : ∀ ν : Fin k' ≃ Fin k', (∀ s, ν (own h' s) = own h s) → ν = Equiv.refl _ :=
        fun ν hν => eq_refl_of_strictMono ν (strictMono_of_own ht ht' h h' ν hν)
      have hown : ∀ s, (Equiv.refl (Fin k')) (own h' s) = own h s := by
        rw [← hrefl ν₀ hν₀]
        exact hν₀
      rw [Finset.sum_eq_single (Equiv.refl _) (fun ν _ hne => dif_neg fun hν =>
        hne (hrefl ν hν)) (fun h0 => absurd (Finset.mem_univ _) h0)]
      set y' : ∀ j, FreeGrL R W (Fib (own h') j) := fun j => GrOperad.map (R := R)
        (childEquiv h' j) (shEv b (c' j) (cLab c' j) (labels_child h' j)) with hy'
      have e1 : GrEnd.rsg R (LinOrd.std k') (LinOrd.map (Equiv.refl (Fin k')).symm
          (LinOrd.std k')) (fun a => vpar p (c ((Equiv.refl (Fin k')) a))) = 1 := by
        rw [show (Equiv.refl (Fin k')).symm = Equiv.refl _ from rfl, linOrd_map_refl,
          GrEnd.rsg_self]
      have e2 : (b k').coord β (SymSpecies.map (R := R) (Equiv.refl (Fin k')) (b k' β'))
          = Finsupp.single β' (1 : R) β := by
        rw [SymSpecies.map_refl, Module.Basis.coord_apply, Module.Basis.repr_self]
      have e3 : ∀ j, childCoord p h (fun j => shCoord b p (c j) (cLab c j) (labels_child h j))
          ((Equiv.refl (Fin k')) j) (GrOperad.map (R := R) (fibNu h (own h') (Equiv.refl _) hown j)
            (y' j)) = if c j = c' j then 1 else 0 := fun j => by
        have hl : (c' j).labels = (c j).labels := labels_eq_of_own h h' _ hown j
        have hsh : (c' j).labels = (cLab c j).val := hl.trans (labels_child h j)
        refine (childCoord_map b p h _ h' j ((Equiv.refl _) j) _ (fun s => rfl) hsh).trans ?_
        show shCoord b p (c j) (cLab c j) (labels_child h j)
          (GrOperad.par (R := R) (vpar p (c j)) (shEv b (c' j) (cLab c j) hsh)) = _
        rw [← par_shEv b hb (c' j) (cLab c j) hsh, GrOperad.par_par]
        by_cases hv : vpar p (c j) = vpar p (c' j)
        · rw [if_pos hv, par_shEv b hb]
          exact shCoord_shEv (c j) (cLab c j) (labels_child h j) (ht.child j) (c' j) hsh
            (ht'.child j)
        · rw [if_neg hv, map_zero, if_neg (fun he => hv (by rw [he]))]
      rw [dif_pos hown]
      refine Eq.trans (congrArg₂ (· * ·) e1 (congrArg₂ (· * ·) e2
        (Finset.prod_congr rfl fun j _ => e3 j))) ?_
      beta_reduce
      by_cases hn : STree.node β c = STree.node β' c'
      · cases hn
        simp
      · rw [if_neg hn]
        by_cases hβ : β' = β
        · subst hβ
          have hc : ∃ j, c j ≠ c' j := by
            by_contra hc
            push Not at hc
            exact hn (by rw [show c = c' from funext hc])
          obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := hc
          rw [Finset.prod_eq_zero (Finset.mem_univ j) (if_neg hj), mul_zero, mul_zero]
        · rw [Finsupp.single_eq_of_ne (Ne.symm hβ), zero_mul, mul_zero]
    · rw [Finset.sum_eq_zero fun ν _ => dif_neg fun hν => hm ⟨ν, hν⟩, if_neg]
      intro heq
      cases heq
      exact hm ⟨Equiv.refl _, fun s => rfl⟩

name: Operad.FreeGrL.sval_inl
statement:
@[simp] lemma sval_inl {Y₁ Y₂ : Finset ℕ} {i : Lab Y₁} (x : Without (Lab Y₁) i) :
    sval (Y₂ := Y₂) (Sum.inl x) = x.1.1
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.FreeGrL.sval_inr
statement:
@[simp] lemma sval_inr {Y₁ Y₂ : Finset ℕ} {i : Lab Y₁} (x : Lab Y₂) :
    sval (i := i) (Sum.inr x) = x.1
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.FreeGrL.sval_injective
statement:
lemma sval_injective {Y₁ Y₂ Y : Finset ℕ} {i : Lab Y₁} (E : Lab Y ≃ Without (Lab Y₁) i ⊕ Lab Y₂)
    (hE : ∀ x, sval (E x) = x.1) : Function.Injective (sval (Y₂ := Y₂) (i := i))
proof:
:= by
  intro u v huv
  have huv' : E.symm u = E.symm v := Subtype.ext (by
    rw [← hE (E.symm u), ← hE (E.symm v), Equiv.apply_symm_apply, Equiv.apply_symm_apply, huv])
  exact E.symm.injective huv'

name: Operad.FreeGrL.mem_labels_subst
statement:
lemma mem_labels_subst {t : STree B} {xs : ℕ → STree B} {a x : ℕ} (ha : a ∈ t.labels)
    (hx : x ∈ (xs a).labels) : x ∈ (t.subst xs).labels
proof:
:= by
  rw [labels_subst]
  exact Multiset.mem_bind.2 ⟨a, ha, hx⟩

name: Operad.FreeGrL.comp_shEv
statement:
theorem comp_shEv (t' : STree B) (Y₂ : Finset ℕ) (h₂ : t'.labels = Y₂.val) :
    ∀ (t : STree B) (Y₁ : Finset ℕ) (h₁ : t.labels = Y₁.val) (m : ℕ) (hm : m ∈ Y₁)
      (Y : Finset ℕ) (h : (t.subst (update STree.leaf m t')).labels = Y.val)
      (E : Lab Y ≃ Without (Lab Y₁) ⟨m, hm⟩ ⊕ Lab Y₂) (_ : ∀ x, sval (E x) = x.1),
      GrOperad.comp (R := R) (⟨m, hm⟩ : Lab Y₁) (shEv b t Y₁ h₁) (shEv b t' Y₂ h₂)
        = σ R (vpar p t' && vaft p t m)
          • GrOperad.map (R := R) E (shEv b (t.subst (update STree.leaf m t')) Y h)
  | .leaf a, Y₁, h₁, m, hm, Y, h, E, hE => by
    have hY₁ : Y₁.val = {a}
proof:
:= h₁.symm
    have hma : m = a := by
      have hm' := hm
      rw [← Finset.mem_val, hY₁, Multiset.mem_singleton] at hm'
      exact hm'
    subst hma
    have hs : (STree.leaf m : STree B).subst (update STree.leaf m t') = t' := by
      rw [subst_leaf', update_self]
    have hY : Y = Y₂ := Finset.val_inj.1 (h.symm.trans ((congrArg labels hs).trans h₂))
    subst hY
    have hone : ∀ x : Lab Y₁, x = ⟨m, hm⟩ := fun x => Subtype.ext (by
      have hx := x.2
      rw [← Finset.mem_val, hY₁, Multiset.mem_singleton] at hx
      exact hx)
    let e₀ : Unit ≃ Lab Y₁ := ⟨fun _ => ⟨m, hm⟩, fun _ => (), fun _ => rfl, fun x => (hone x).symm⟩
    rw [vaft_leaf, Bool.and_false, σ_false, one_smul, shEv_leaf, comp_unitL,
      Finset.sum_eq_single e₀ (fun e _ hne => absurd (Equiv.ext fun u => (hone _).trans
        (hone _).symm) hne) (fun h0 => absurd (Finset.mem_univ _) h0),
      ← map_shEv b hs.symm rfl h₂ h (Equiv.refl _) (fun _ => rfl), ← GrOperad.map_trans]
    refine gmap_congr (fun x => sval_injective E hE ?_) _
    rw [Equiv.trans_apply, hE]
    rfl
  | @STree.node _ k β c, Y₁, h₁, m, hm, Y, h, E, hE => by
    have hinj := sval_injective E hE
    have hu : ∀ u, (E.symm u).1 = sval u := fun u => by rw [← hE (E.symm u), Equiv.apply_symm_apply]
    have h' : (STree.node β fun j => (c j).subst (update STree.leaf m t')).labels = Y.val := h
    have hR : shEv b ((STree.node β c).subst (update STree.leaf m t')) Y h
        = graft R W (Lab Y) (mk R (ownGen (LinOrd.std k) (b k β) (own h') fun j =>
          GrOperad.map (R := R) (childEquiv h' j) (shEv b ((c j).subst (update STree.leaf m t'))
            (cLab (fun j => (c j).subst (update STree.leaf m t')) j) (labels_child h' j)))) :=
      shEv_node b β _ Y h'
    have hmj : m ∈ (c (own h₁ ⟨m, hm⟩)).labels := mem_own h₁ ⟨m, hm⟩
    have hz := par_shEv b hb t' Y₂ h₂
    have hy : ∀ j, GrOperad.par (R := R) (vpar p (c j)) (GrOperad.map (R := R) (childEquiv h₁ j)
        (shEv b (c j) (cLab c j) (labels_child h₁ j))) = GrOperad.map (R := R) (childEquiv h₁ j)
        (shEv b (c j) (cLab c j) (labels_child h₁ j)) := fun j => by
      rw [← GrOperad.map_par, par_shEv b hb]
    have hF : actOwner (Y := Lab Y₂) (own h₁) ⟨m, hm⟩ = own h' ∘ E.symm := by
      funext u
      rcases u with s | y
      · show own h₁ s.1 = own h' (E.symm (Sum.inl s))
        refine (own_eq h' ?_).symm
        rw [hu, sval_inl]
        refine mem_labels_subst (mem_own h₁ s.1) ?_
        rw [update_of_ne (fun e => s.2 (Subtype.ext e)), labels_leaf]
        exact Multiset.mem_singleton_self _
      · show own h₁ ⟨m, hm⟩ = own h' (E.symm (Sum.inr y))
        refine (own_eq h' ?_).symm
        rw [hu, sval_inr]
        refine mem_labels_subst hmj ?_
        rw [update_self, h₂]
        exact y.2
    have hsmul : ∀ (F' : Without (Lab Y₁) ⟨m, hm⟩ ⊕ Lab Y₂ → Fin k) (s' : Fin k → R)
        (Y' : ∀ a, FreeGrL R W (Fib F' a)),
        mk R (ownGen (LinOrd.std k) (b k β) F' fun a => s' a • Y' a)
          = (∏ a, s' a) • mk R (ownGen (LinOrd.std k) (b k β) F' Y') :=
      fun F' s' Y' => (mkY (R := R) (ownGen (LinOrd.std k) (b k β) F' Y')).map_smul_univ s' Y'
    rw [hR, ← graft_map, map_mk_ownGen, shEv_node, ← graft_act, act_mk_ownGen,
      actOwn_hom _ _ _ _ _ _ hz, ← map_smul]
    congr 1
    have hY0 := funext (actY_hom (R := R) (LinOrd.std k) (own h₁) _ ⟨m, hm⟩ (shEv b t' Y₂ h₂)
      (vpar p t') (fun j => vpar p (c j)) hy)
    show mk R (ownGen (LinOrd.std k) (b k β) (actOwner (own h₁) ⟨m, hm⟩)
      (actY (R := R) (LinOrd.std k) (own h₁) _ ⟨m, hm⟩ (shEv b t' Y₂ h₂) (vpar p t'))) = _
    rw [hY0, hsmul, mk_ownGen_congr _ _ hF]
    have hinner : ∀ a, SymSpecies.map (R := R) (Equiv.subtypeEquivRight fun s => by rw [hF])
        (actY (R := R) (LinOrd.std k) (own h₁) (fun j => GrOperad.map (R := R) (childEquiv h₁ j)
          (shEv b (c j) (cLab c j) (labels_child h₁ j))) ⟨m, hm⟩ (shEv b t' Y₂ h₂) false a)
        = (if a = own h₁ ⟨m, hm⟩ then σ R (vpar p t' && vaft p (c a) m) else 1)
          • SymSpecies.map (R := R) (fibMap E (own h') a) (GrOperad.map (R := R) (childEquiv h' a)
            (shEv b ((c a).subst (update STree.leaf m t'))
              (cLab (fun j => (c j).subst (update STree.leaf m t')) a) (labels_child h' a))) := by
      intro a
      by_cases ha : own h₁ ⟨m, hm⟩ = a
      · subst ha
        rw [if_pos rfl]
        show SymSpecies.map (R := R) _ (actLin (R := R) (LinOrd.std k) (own h₁) ⟨m, hm⟩
          (shEv b t' Y₂ h₂) false _ _) = _
        rw [actLin_eq _ _ _ _ _ _ rfl]
        let θ := childEquiv h₁ (own h₁ ⟨m, hm⟩)
        let i' : Lab (cLab c (own h₁ ⟨m, hm⟩)) := ⟨m, Multiset.mem_toFinset.2 hmj⟩
        have hθ : θ i' = ⟨⟨m, hm⟩, rfl⟩ := Subtype.ext (Subtype.ext rfl)
        let Φ := ((compEquiv θ (Equiv.refl (Lab Y₂)) i').trans (slotEquiv hθ)).trans
          ((actEq (Y := Lab Y₂) (own h₁) ⟨m, hm⟩ _ rfl).trans
            (Equiv.subtypeEquivRight fun s => by rw [hF]))
        have hΦ : ∀ u, sval (Φ u).1 = sval u := by
          rintro (⟨⟨x, hx⟩, hne⟩ | y) <;> rfl
        let E₀ := (childEquiv h' (own h₁ ⟨m, hm⟩)).trans ((fibMap E (own h') _).trans Φ.symm)
        have hE₀ : ∀ x, sval (E₀ x) = x.1 := fun x => by
          rw [← hΦ (E₀ x)]
          show sval (Φ (Φ.symm _)).1 = _
          rw [Equiv.apply_symm_apply]
          exact hE _
        rw [GrOperad.comp_map_left θ i' _ hθ,
          comp_shEv t' Y₂ h₂ (c (own h₁ ⟨m, hm⟩)) _ (labels_child h₁ _) m
            (Multiset.mem_toFinset.2 hmj) _ (labels_child h' (own h₁ ⟨m, hm⟩)) E₀ hE₀]
        simp only [map_smul, GrOperad.toGrSpecies_map]
        congr 1
        simp only [← GrOperad.map_trans]
        apply gmap_congr
        intro x
        show Φ (E₀ x) = _
        simp only [E₀, Equiv.trans_apply, Equiv.apply_symm_apply]
      · rw [if_neg (Ne.symm ha), one_smul]
        show SymSpecies.map (R := R) _ (actLin (R := R) (LinOrd.std k) (own h₁) ⟨m, hm⟩
          (shEv b t' Y₂ h₂) false a _) = _
        rw [actLin_ne _ _ _ _ _ _ ha, Bool.false_and, GrOperad.tw_false]
        have hma : m ∉ (c a).labels := fun hmem => ha (child_eq h₁ hmj hmem)
        have hsa : (c a).subst (update STree.leaf m t') = c a :=
          (subst_congr (c a) fun a' ha' =>
            update_of_ne (fun e : a' = m => hma (e ▸ ha')) t' STree.leaf).trans
            (subst_leaf (c a))
        have hcl : cLab (fun j => (c j).subst (update STree.leaf m t')) a = cLab c a := by
          show ((c a).subst _).labels.toFinset = (c a).labels.toFinset
          rw [hsa]
        rw [← map_shEv b hsa.symm hcl.symm (labels_child h₁ a) (labels_child h' a)
          (Equiv.subtypeEquivRight fun x => by rw [hcl]) (fun _ => rfl)]
        simp only [GrOperad.toGrSpecies_map, ← GrOperad.map_trans]
        apply gmap_congr
        intro x
        refine Subtype.ext (hinj ?_)
        show x.1 = sval (E _)
        rw [hE]
        rfl
    rw [funext hinner, hsmul, smul_smul]
    congr 1
    rw [vaft_node, ← GrEnd.prod_σ_tot, ← Finset.prod_mul_distrib]
    refine Finset.prod_congr rfl fun a _ => ?_
    by_cases ha : a = own h₁ ⟨m, hm⟩
    · subst ha
      rw [if_pos rfl, ltB_self, if_neg Bool.false_ne_true, one_mul, if_pos hmj]
    · have hma : m ∉ (c a).labels := fun hmem => ha (child_eq h₁ hmem hmj)
      rw [if_neg ha, mul_one, if_neg hma]
      by_cases hlt : own h₁ ⟨m, hm⟩ < a
      · rw [if_pos ((ltB_eq_true _ _ _).2 hlt),
          if_pos (show ∃ j', j' < a ∧ m ∈ (c j').labels from ⟨_, hlt, hmj⟩)]
      · rw [if_neg (fun hl => hlt ((ltB_eq_true _ _ _).1 hl)),
          if_neg (show ¬ ∃ j', j' < a ∧ m ∈ (c j').labels from fun ⟨j', hj', hmem⟩ =>
            hlt (by rw [child_eq h₁ hmj hmem]; exact hj')), Bool.and_false, σ_false]

name: Operad.FreeGrL.labels_ne_zero
statement: lemma labels_ne_zero {t : STree B} (ht : t.IsShuffle) : t.labels ≠ 0
proof:
:= fun h0 => by
  have hm := first_mem ht
  rw [h0] at hm
  exact Multiset.notMem_zero _ hm

name: Operad.FreeGrL.labels_subst_update
statement:
lemma labels_subst_update {t₁ t₂ : STree B} {Y₁ Y₂ : Finset ℕ} {m : ℕ} (h₁ : t₁.labels = Y₁.val)
    (h₂ : t₂.labels = Y₂.val) (hm : m ∈ Y₁) (hd : Disjoint (Y₁.erase m) Y₂) :
    (t₁.subst (update STree.leaf m t₂)).labels = ((Y₁.erase m).disjUnion Y₂ hd).val
proof:
:= by
  have hY₁ : Y₁.val = m ::ₘ (Y₁.erase m).val := by
    rw [← Finset.insert_val_of_notMem (Finset.notMem_erase m Y₁), Finset.insert_erase hm]
  rw [labels_subst, h₁, hY₁, Multiset.cons_bind, update_self, h₂, Finset.disjUnion_val, add_comm]
  congr 1
  rw [Multiset.bind_congr (g := fun a => {a}) fun a ha => by
    rw [update_of_ne (Finset.ne_of_mem_erase ha), labels_leaf],
    Multiset.bind_singleton, Multiset.map_id']

name: Operad.FreeGrL.isShuffle_subst_update
statement:
lemma isShuffle_subst_update {t₁ t₂ : STree B} {m : ℕ} (ht₁ : t₁.IsShuffle) (ht₂ : t₂.IsShuffle)
    (hf : t₂.first = m) : (t₁.subst (update STree.leaf m t₂)).IsShuffle
proof:
:= by
  have hfirst : ∀ a, (update STree.leaf m t₂ a).first = a := fun a => by
    by_cases ha : a = m
    · subst ha
      rw [update_self, hf]
    · rw [update_of_ne ha, first_leaf]
  refine isShuffle_subst ht₁ (fun a _ => ?_) (fun a _ a' _ hlt => by simp only [hfirst]; exact hlt)
  by_cases ha : a = m
  · subst ha
    rw [update_self]
    exact ht₂
  · rw [update_of_ne ha]
    trivial

name: Operad.FreeGrL.shEv_corolla
statement:
lemma shEv_corolla {n : ℕ} (β : B n) (Y : Finset ℕ) (θ : Fin n ≃ Lab Y)
    (h : (STree.node β fun j => STree.leaf (θ j).1).labels = Y.val) :
    shEv b (.node β fun j => .leaf (θ j).1) Y h
      = GrOperad.map (R := R) θ ((ι R W).app (Fin n) (b n β))
proof:
:= by
  have hmem : ∀ j, (θ j).1 ∈ cLab (fun j => (STree.leaf (θ j).1 : STree B)) j := fun j => by
    simp [cLab]
  have hone : ∀ j (x : Lab (cLab (fun j => (STree.leaf (θ j).1 : STree B)) j)),
      x.1 = (θ j).1 := fun j x => by
    exact Multiset.mem_singleton.1 (Multiset.mem_toFinset.1 x.2)
  let e : ∀ j, Unit ≃ Lab (cLab (fun j => (STree.leaf (θ j).1 : STree B)) j) := fun j =>
    ⟨fun _ => ⟨(θ j).1, hmem j⟩, fun _ => (), fun _ => rfl, fun x => Subtype.ext (hone j x).symm⟩
  rw [shEv_node, ← graft_corolla, ← graft_map, map_corolla, corolla_apply,
    mk_corGen_outer θ (ordOf _) (LinOrd.std n) (b n β) (Equiv.refl _),
    ← mk_inner (corGen (C := FreeGrL R W) (R := R) (LinOrd.std n) (b n β) (θ.trans (Equiv.refl _)))
      (fun j => (e j).trans (childEquiv h j))]
  congr 2
  show (⟨Fin n, Fib (own h), LinOrd.std n, b n β, _, Equiv.sigmaFiberEquiv (own h)⟩ :
    GrCompGen W (FreeGrL R W) (Lab Y)) = ⟨Fin n, Fib (own h), LinOrd.std n, b n β, _, _⟩
  congr 1
  · funext j
    rw [shEv_leaf, unitL_eq (e j), ← GrOperad.map_trans]
    rfl
  · refine Equiv.ext ?_
    rintro ⟨j, s, hs⟩
    have hsm := mem_own h s
    rw [hs] at hsm
    exact Subtype.ext (Multiset.mem_singleton.1 hsm)

name: Operad.FreeGrL.mem_shSpanFam
statement:
lemma mem_shSpanFam {A : Type} [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] {x : FreeGrL R W A} :
    x ∈ shSpanFam b A ↔
      ∀ (Y : Finset ℕ) (e : A ≃ Lab Y), GrOperad.map (R := R) e x ∈ shSpan b Y
proof:
:= by
  simp only [shSpanFam, Submodule.mem_iInf, Submodule.mem_comap]

name: Operad.FreeGrL.shEv_mem_shSpan
statement:
lemma shEv_mem_shSpan {t : STree B} (ht : t.IsShuffle) {Y : Finset ℕ} (h : t.labels = Y.val) :
    shEv b t Y h ∈ shSpan b Y
proof:
:=
  Submodule.subset_span ⟨⟨t, ht, h⟩, rfl⟩

name: Operad.FreeGrL.shSpan_eq_top
statement: theorem shSpan_eq_top (Y : Finset ℕ) : shSpan b Y = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  have hunit : ∀ (A : Type) [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] (e : Unit ≃ A),
      GrOperad.map (R := R) e (GrOperad.one (R := R) (P := FreeGrL R W)) ∈ shSpanFam b A := by
    intro A _ _ e
    rw [mem_shSpanFam]
    intro Y' e'
    rw [← GrOperad.map_trans, ← unitL_eq (e.trans e')]
    have hY' : Y' = {(e' (e ())).1} := Finset.eq_singleton_iff_unique_mem.2 ⟨(e' (e ())).2,
      fun x hx => by
        have hu : (e.trans e').symm ⟨x, hx⟩ = () := rfl
        have hv := congrArg Subtype.val ((e.trans e').apply_symm_apply ⟨x, hx⟩)
        rw [hu] at hv
        exact hv.symm⟩
    have hl : (STree.leaf (e' (e ())).1 : STree B).labels = Y'.val :=
      (Finset.val_eq_singleton_iff.2 hY').symm
    rw [← shEv_leaf b _ Y' hl]
    exact shEv_mem_shSpan b (isShuffle_leaf _) hl
  have hgen : ∀ (n : ℕ) (v : W (Fin n)), (ι R W).app (Fin n) v ∈ shSpanFam b (Fin n) := by
    intro n v
    rw [mem_shSpanFam]
    intro Y' e
    have hcard : Y'.card = n := by simpa using (Fintype.card_congr e).symm
    let θ : Fin n ≃ Lab Y' := (Finset.orderIsoOfFin Y' hcard).toEquiv
    have hθ : StrictMono fun j => (θ j).1 := fun a a' h =>
      (Finset.orderIsoOfFin Y' hcard).strictMono h
    show SymSpecies.map (R := R) e ((ι R W).app (Fin n) v) ∈ shSpan b Y'
    have hw : SymSpecies.map (R := R) e v = SymSpecies.map (R := R) θ
        (SymSpecies.map (R := R) θ.symm (SymSpecies.map (R := R) e v)) := by
      rw [← SymSpecies.map_trans, Equiv.symm_trans_self, SymSpecies.map_refl]
    rw [← (ι R W).app_map, hw, (ι R W).app_map]
    refine Submodule.span_induction (p := fun w _ =>
      SymSpecies.map (R := R) θ ((ι R W).app (Fin n) w) ∈ shSpan b Y') ?_ (by simp)
      (fun x y _ _ hx hy => by simp only [map_add]; exact add_mem hx hy)
      (fun r x _ hx => by simp only [map_smul]; exact Submodule.smul_mem _ r hx)
      ((b n).mem_span _)
    rintro _ ⟨β, rfl⟩
    have hn : 0 < n := Nat.pos_of_ne_zero fun h0 => by
      subst h0
      exact isEmptyElim β
    have hsum : (∑ j : Fin n, ({(θ j).1} : Multiset ℕ))
        = Finset.univ.val.map fun j => (θ j).1 := by
      rw [Finset.sum_eq_multiset_sum]
      conv_rhs => rw [← Multiset.sum_map_singleton (Finset.univ.val.map fun j => (θ j).1)]
      rw [Multiset.map_map]
      rfl
