    have hl : (STree.node β fun j => STree.leaf (θ j).1).labels = Y'.val := by
      rw [labels_node]
      simp only [labels_leaf]
      rw [hsum]
      refine (Multiset.Nodup.ext (Finset.univ.nodup.map hθ.injective) Y'.nodup).2 fun x => ?_
      rw [Multiset.mem_map]
      refine ⟨?_, fun hx => ⟨θ.symm ⟨x, hx⟩, by simp, by simp⟩⟩
      rintro ⟨j, _, rfl⟩
      exact (θ j).2
    show GrOperad.map (R := R) θ _ ∈ _
    rw [← shEv_corolla b β Y' θ hl]
    exact shEv_mem_shSpan b (show (STree.node β fun j => STree.leaf (θ j).1 : STree B).IsShuffle
      from ⟨hn, fun _ => trivial, hθ⟩) hl
  have hmap : ∀ (A A' : Type) [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] [Fintype A'] [DecidableEq A']
      (e : A ≃ A') (x : FreeGrL R W A), x ∈ shSpanFam b A →
        GrOperad.map (R := R) e x ∈ shSpanFam b A' := by
    intro A A' _ _ _ _ e x hx
    rw [mem_shSpanFam] at hx ⊢
    intro Y' e'
    rw [← GrOperad.map_trans]
    exact hx Y' (e.trans e')
  have hcomp : ∀ (A B' : Type) [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] [Fintype B'] [DecidableEq B'] (i : A)
      (x : FreeGrL R W A) (y : FreeGrL R W B'), x ∈ shSpanFam b A → y ∈ shSpanFam b B' →
        GrOperad.comp (R := R) i x y ∈ shSpanFam b (Without A i ⊕ B') := by
    intro A B' _ _ _ _ i x y hx hy
    rw [mem_shSpanFam] at hx hy ⊢
    intro Y e
    rcases isEmpty_or_nonempty B' with hB | ⟨⟨b₀⟩⟩
    · have hy0 : y = 0 := by
        have h0 := hy ∅ (Equiv.equivOfIsEmpty B' (Lab ∅))
        have hbot : shSpan b (∅ : Finset ℕ) = ⊥ := by
          rw [shSpan, Submodule.span_eq_bot]
          rintro _ ⟨t, rfl⟩
          exact absurd t.2.2 (labels_ne_zero t.2.1)
        rw [hbot, Submodule.mem_bot] at h0
        have h1 := congrArg (GrOperad.map (R := R) (Equiv.equivOfIsEmpty B' (Lab ∅)).symm) h0
        rwa [← GrOperad.map_trans, Equiv.self_trans_symm, GrOperad.map_refl, map_zero] at h1
      rw [hy0, map_zero, map_zero]
      exact zero_mem _
    let v₁ : Without A i → ℕ := fun a => (e (Sum.inl a)).1
    let v₂ : B' → ℕ := fun b' => (e (Sum.inr b')).1
    have hv₁ : Function.Injective v₁ := fun a a' h =>
      Sum.inl_injective (e.injective (Subtype.ext h))
    have hv₂ : Function.Injective v₂ := fun d d' h =>
      Sum.inr_injective (e.injective (Subtype.ext h))
    have hv₁₂ : ∀ a b', v₁ a ≠ v₂ b' := fun a b' h => Sum.inl_ne_inr (e.injective (Subtype.ext h))
    let Y₂ : Finset ℕ := Finset.univ.image v₂
    have hY₂ : Y₂.Nonempty := ⟨v₂ b₀, Finset.mem_image_of_mem _ (Finset.mem_univ _)⟩
    let m := Y₂.min' hY₂
    have hm₂ : m ∈ Y₂ := Finset.min'_mem _ _
    let Y₁ : Finset ℕ := insert m (Finset.univ.image v₁)
    have hm : m ∈ Y₁ := Finset.mem_insert_self _ _
    have hmv : ∀ a, v₁ a ≠ m := fun a ham => by
      obtain ⟨b', _, hb'⟩ := Finset.mem_image.1 hm₂
      exact hv₁₂ a b' (ham.trans hb'.symm)
    let f₂ : B' → Lab Y₂ := fun b' => ⟨v₂ b', Finset.mem_image_of_mem _ (Finset.mem_univ _)⟩
    have hf₂ : Function.Bijective f₂ := ⟨fun d d' h => by
        have h' := congrArg Subtype.val h
        exact hv₂ h',
      fun ⟨z, hz⟩ => by
        obtain ⟨b', _, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.1 hz
        exact ⟨b', rfl⟩⟩
    let e₂ := Equiv.ofBijective f₂ hf₂
    let f₁ : A → Lab Y₁ := fun a => if ha : a = i then ⟨m, hm⟩ else
      ⟨v₁ ⟨a, ha⟩, Finset.mem_insert_of_mem (Finset.mem_image_of_mem _ (Finset.mem_univ _))⟩
    have hf₁ : Function.Bijective f₁ := by
      refine ⟨fun a a' h => ?_, fun ⟨z, hz⟩ => ?_⟩
      · by_cases ha : a = i <;> by_cases ha' : a' = i
        · rw [ha, ha']
        · simp only [f₁, dif_pos ha, dif_neg ha'] at h
          exact absurd (congrArg Subtype.val h).symm (hmv _)
        · simp only [f₁, dif_neg ha, dif_pos ha'] at h
          exact absurd (congrArg Subtype.val h) (hmv _)
        · simp only [f₁, dif_neg ha, dif_neg ha'] at h
          have h' := congrArg Subtype.val h
          exact congrArg Subtype.val (hv₁ h')
      · rcases Finset.mem_insert.1 hz with rfl | hz'
        · exact ⟨i, by simp [f₁]⟩
        · obtain ⟨a, _, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.1 hz'
          exact ⟨a.1, by simp [f₁, dif_neg a.2]⟩
    let e₁ := Equiv.ofBijective f₁ hf₁
    have he₁i : e₁ i = ⟨m, hm⟩ := by simp [e₁, f₁]
    have he₁a : ∀ a : Without A i, (e₁ a.1).1 = v₁ a := fun a => by simp [e₁, f₁, dif_neg a.2]
    have hd : Disjoint (Y₁.erase m) Y₂ := Finset.disjoint_left.2 fun z hz hz₂ => by
      have hz₁ := Finset.mem_of_mem_erase hz
      rcases Finset.mem_insert.1 hz₁ with rfl | hz'
      · exact Finset.ne_of_mem_erase hz rfl
      · obtain ⟨a, _, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.1 hz'
        obtain ⟨b', _, hb'⟩ := Finset.mem_image.1 hz₂
        exact hv₁₂ a b' hb'.symm
    have hYeq : (Y₁.erase m).disjUnion Y₂ hd = Y := by
      ext z
      rw [Finset.mem_disjUnion]
      constructor
      · rintro (hz | hz)
        · have hz₁ := Finset.mem_of_mem_erase hz
          rcases Finset.mem_insert.1 hz₁ with rfl | hz'
          · exact absurd rfl (Finset.ne_of_mem_erase hz)
          · obtain ⟨a, _, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.1 hz'
            exact (e (Sum.inl a)).2
        · obtain ⟨b', _, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.1 hz
          exact (e (Sum.inr b')).2
      · intro hz
        rcases hu : e.symm ⟨z, hz⟩ with a | b'
        · left
          have hz' : z = v₁ a := by
            rw [show v₁ a = (e (Sum.inl a)).1 from rfl, ← hu, Equiv.apply_symm_apply]
          rw [hz']
          exact Finset.mem_erase.2 ⟨hmv a,
            Finset.mem_insert_of_mem (Finset.mem_image_of_mem _ (Finset.mem_univ _))⟩
        · right
          have hz' : z = v₂ b' := by
            rw [show v₂ b' = (e (Sum.inr b')).1 from rfl, ← hu, Equiv.apply_symm_apply]
          rw [hz']
          exact Finset.mem_image_of_mem _ (Finset.mem_univ _)
    let Ψ : Without (Lab Y₁) ⟨m, hm⟩ ⊕ Lab Y₂ ≃ Lab Y :=
      ((compEquiv (Equiv.refl _) (Equiv.refl _) (e₁ i)).trans (slotEquiv he₁i)).symm.trans
        ((compEquiv e₁ e₂ i).symm.trans e)
    have hΨ : ∀ u, (Ψ u).1 = sval u := by
      rintro (⟨⟨z, hz⟩, hne⟩ | ⟨z, hz⟩)
      · show (e (Sum.inl ⟨e₁.symm ⟨z, hz⟩, _⟩)).1 = z
        exact (he₁a ⟨_, _⟩).symm.trans (congrArg Subtype.val (e₁.apply_symm_apply ⟨z, hz⟩))
      · show (e (Sum.inr (e₂.symm ⟨z, hz⟩))).1 = z
        exact congrArg Subtype.val (e₂.apply_symm_apply ⟨z, hz⟩)
    have hcomp_eq : GrOperad.map (R := R) e (GrOperad.comp (R := R) i x y)
        = GrOperad.map (R := R) Ψ (GrOperad.comp (R := R) (⟨m, hm⟩ : Lab Y₁)
          (GrOperad.map (R := R) e₁ x) (GrOperad.map (R := R) e₂ y)) := by
      have h1 := GrOperad.map_comp (R := R) (P := FreeGrL R W) e₁ e₂ i x y
      have h2 := GrOperad.comp_map_left (R := R) (Q := FreeGrL R W) (Equiv.refl (Lab Y₁)) (e₁ i)
        ⟨m, hm⟩ he₁i (GrOperad.map (R := R) e₁ x) (GrOperad.map (R := R) e₂ y)
      rw [GrOperad.map_refl] at h2
      rw [h2, ← h1, ← GrOperad.map_trans, ← GrOperad.map_trans]
      exact gmap_congr (fun u => by simp [Ψ]) _
    rw [hcomp_eq]
    refine Submodule.span_induction (p := fun X' _ => GrOperad.map (R := R) Ψ
      (GrOperad.comp (R := R) (⟨m, hm⟩ : Lab Y₁) X' (GrOperad.map (R := R) e₂ y)) ∈ shSpan b Y)
      ?_ (by simp) (fun _ _ _ _ h1 h2 => by
        simp only [map_add, LinearMap.add_apply]
        exact add_mem h1 h2)
      (fun r _ _ h1 => by
        simp only [map_smul, LinearMap.smul_apply]
        exact Submodule.smul_mem _ r h1) (hx Y₁ e₁)
    rintro _ ⟨t₁, rfl⟩
    refine Submodule.span_induction (p := fun Y' _ => GrOperad.map (R := R) Ψ
      (GrOperad.comp (R := R) (⟨m, hm⟩ : Lab Y₁) (shEv b t₁.1 Y₁ t₁.2.2) Y') ∈ shSpan b Y)
      ?_ (by simp) (fun _ _ _ _ h1 h2 => by
        simp only [map_add]
        exact add_mem h1 h2)
      (fun r _ _ h1 => by
        simp only [map_smul]
        exact Submodule.smul_mem _ r h1) (hy Y₂ e₂)
    rintro _ ⟨t₂, rfl⟩
    have hf : t₂.1.first = m := le_antisymm (first_le t₂.2.1 m (t₂.mem_labels.2 hm₂))
      (Finset.min'_le _ _ (t₂.mem_labels.1 (first_mem t₂.2.1)))
    have hl : (t₁.1.subst (update STree.leaf m t₂.1)).labels = Y.val := by
      rw [labels_subst_update t₁.2.2 t₂.2.2 hm hd, hYeq]
    rw [comp_shEv b hb t₂.1 Y₂ t₂.2.2 t₁.1 Y₁ t₁.2.2 m hm Y hl Ψ.symm
      (fun z => by rw [← hΨ, Equiv.apply_symm_apply]), map_smul, ← GrOperad.map_trans,
      Equiv.symm_trans_self, GrOperad.map_refl]
    exact Submodule.smul_mem _ _ (shEv_mem_shSpan b (isShuffle_subst_update t₁.2.1 t₂.2.1 hf) hl)
  refine eq_top_iff.2 fun x _ => ?_
  have hx : x ∈ shSpanFam b (Lab Y) := by
    rw [submodule_eq_top (R := R) (V := W) (shSpanFam b) hunit hgen hmap hcomp (Lab Y)]
    exact Submodule.mem_top
  have hx' := (mem_shSpanFam b).1 hx Y (Equiv.refl _)
  rwa [GrOperad.map_refl] at hx'

name: Operad.FreeGrL.posEquiv_apply
statement:
lemma posEquiv_apply (A : Type) [Fintype A] [LinearOrder A] (a : A) :
    (posEquiv A a).1 = opos a
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.FreeGrL.linearIndependent_shEv
statement:
theorem linearIndependent_shEv (Y : Finset ℕ) :
    LinearIndependent R (fun t : SMono B Y => shEv b t.1 Y t.2.2)
proof:
:= by
  haveI : DecidableEq (STree B) := Classical.decEq _
  refine linearIndependent_iff'.2 fun s g hg t ht => ?_
  have h0 := congrArg (shCoord b p t.1 Y t.2.2) hg
  rw [map_sum, map_zero] at h0
  simp only [map_smul, smul_eq_mul] at h0
  rw [Finset.sum_eq_single t (fun t' _ ht' => by
    rw [shCoord_shEv b hb t.1 Y t.2.2 t.2.1 t'.1 t'.2.2 t'.2.1,
      if_neg (fun h => ht' (Subtype.ext h).symm), mul_zero]) (fun h => absurd ht h),
    shCoord_shEv b hb t.1 Y t.2.2 t.2.1 t.1 t.2.2 t.2.1, if_pos rfl, mul_one] at h0
  exact h0

name: Operad.FreeGrL.shBasisLab_apply
statement:
theorem shBasisLab_apply (Y : Finset ℕ) (t : SMono B Y) :
    shBasisLab b hb Y t = shEv b t.1 Y t.2.2
proof:
:=
  Module.Basis.mk_apply _ _ t

name: Operad.FreeGrL.shuffleBasis_apply
statement:
theorem shuffleBasis_apply (A : Type) [Fintype A] [LinearOrder A]
    (t : SMono B (Finset.range (Fintype.card A))) :
    shuffleBasis b hb A t = GrOperad.map (R := R) (posEquiv A).symm (shEv b t.1 _ t.2.2)
proof:
:= by
  rw [shuffleBasis, Module.Basis.map_apply, shBasisLab_apply]
  rfl

name: Operad.FreeGrL.par_shuffleBasis
statement:
theorem par_shuffleBasis (A : Type) [Fintype A] [LinearOrder A]
    (t : SMono B (Finset.range (Fintype.card A))) :
    GrOperad.par (R := R) (vpar p t.1) (shuffleBasis b hb A t) = shuffleBasis b hb A t
proof:
:= by
  rw [shuffleBasis_apply, ← GrOperad.map_par, par_shEv b hb]

name: Operad.FreeGrL.finrank_eq_card
statement:
theorem finrank_eq_card [Nontrivial R] (A : Type) [Fintype A] [LinearOrder A]
    [Finite (SMono B (Finset.range (Fintype.card A)))] :
    Module.finrank R (FreeGrL R W A) = Nat.card (SMono B (Finset.range (Fintype.card A)))
proof:
:=
  Module.finrank_eq_nat_card_basis (shuffleBasis b hb A)

name: Operad.FreeGrL.comp_shBasisLab
statement:
theorem comp_shBasisLab {Y₁ Y₂ : Finset ℕ} (t₁ : SMono B Y₁) (t₂ : SMono B Y₂) {m : ℕ}
    (hm : m ∈ Y₁) (hf : t₂.1.first = m) (hd : Disjoint (Y₁.erase m) Y₂)
    (E : Lab ((Y₁.erase m).disjUnion Y₂ hd) ≃ Without (Lab Y₁) ⟨m, hm⟩ ⊕ Lab Y₂)
    (hE : ∀ x, sval (E x) = x.1) :
    GrOperad.comp (R := R) (⟨m, hm⟩ : Lab Y₁) (shBasisLab b hb Y₁ t₁) (shBasisLab b hb Y₂ t₂)
      = σ R (vpar p t₂.1 && vaft p t₁.1 m) • GrOperad.map (R := R) E
        (shBasisLab b hb _ ⟨t₁.1.subst (update STree.leaf m t₂.1),
          isShuffle_subst_update t₁.2.1 t₂.2.1 hf, labels_subst_update t₁.2.2 t₂.2.2 hm hd⟩)
proof:
:= by
  rw [shBasisLab_apply, shBasisLab_apply, shBasisLab_apply]
  exact comp_shEv b hb t₂.1 Y₂ t₂.2.2 t₁.1 Y₁ t₁.2.2 m hm _ _ E hE

name: Operad.AssShGen.node_eq_bin
statement: lemma node_eq_bin (e : AssShGen 2) (c : Fin 2 → STree AssShGen) : node e c = bin e (c 0) (c 1)
proof:
:= by
  rw [bin]
  congr 1
  funext i
  fin_cases i <;> rfl

name: Operad.AssShGen.first_bin
statement: @[simp] lemma first_bin (e : AssShGen 2) (x y : STree AssShGen) : (bin e x y).first = x.first
proof:
:= by
  rw [bin]
  exact first_node (k := 2) e ![x, y] (by norm_num)

name: Operad.AssShGen.labels_bin
statement:
@[simp] lemma labels_bin (e : AssShGen 2) (x y : STree AssShGen) :
    (bin e x y).labels = x.labels + y.labels
proof:
:= by
  simp [bin, Fin.sum_univ_two]

name: Operad.AssShGen.subst_bin
statement:
@[simp] lemma subst_bin (e : AssShGen 2) (x y : STree AssShGen) (xs : ℕ → STree AssShGen) :
    (bin e x y).subst xs = bin e (x.subst xs) (y.subst xs)
proof:
:= by
  rw [bin, bin, subst_node]
  congr 1
  funext i
  fin_cases i <;> rfl

name: Operad.AssShGen.isShuffle_bin
statement:
lemma isShuffle_bin {e : AssShGen 2} {x y : STree AssShGen} :
    (bin e x y).IsShuffle ↔ x.IsShuffle ∧ y.IsShuffle ∧ x.first < y.first
proof:
:= by
  rw [bin, isShuffle_node, Fin.forall_fin_two]
  refine ⟨fun ⟨_, ⟨hx, hy⟩, hm⟩ => ⟨hx, hy, hm (show (0 : Fin 2) < 1 by decide)⟩,
    fun ⟨hx, hy, hxy⟩ => ⟨by norm_num, ⟨hx, hy⟩, Fin.strictMono_iff_lt_succ.2 fun i => ?_⟩⟩
  fin_cases i
  exact hxy

name: Operad.AssShGen.ev_leaf
statement: @[simp] lemma ev_leaf (a : ℕ) : ev (leaf a) = [a]
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.AssShGen.ev_bin
statement:
@[simp] lemma ev_bin (e : AssShGen 2) (x y : STree AssShGen) :
    ev (bin e x y) = ap e (ev x) (ev y)
proof:
:= by
  cases e <;> rfl

name: Operad.AssShGen.ev_node_congr
statement:
lemma ev_node_congr {k : ℕ} (e : AssShGen k) {c c' : Fin k → STree AssShGen}
    (h : ∀ i, ev (c i) = ev (c' i)) : ev (node e c) = ev (node e c')
proof:
:= by
  cases e <;> simp only [ev, h]

name: Operad.AssShGen.coe_ev
statement:
theorem coe_ev : ∀ t : STree AssShGen, (ev t : Multiset ℕ) = t.labels
  | leaf a => rfl
  | node mu c => by
    rw [node_eq_bin, ev_bin, labels_bin, ap, ← Multiset.coe_add, coe_ev (c 0), coe_ev (c 1)]
  | node op c => by
    rw [node_eq_bin, ev_bin, labels_bin, ap, ← Multiset.coe_add, coe_ev (c 0), coe_ev (c 1),
      add_comm]

name: Operad.AssShGen.ev_ne_nil
statement:
theorem ev_ne_nil : ∀ t : STree AssShGen, ev t ≠ []
  | leaf _ => List.cons_ne_nil _ _
  | node mu c => by
    simp only [ev, ne_eq, List.append_eq_nil_iff, not_and]
    exact fun h => absurd h (ev_ne_nil (c 0))
  | node op c => by
    simp only [ev, ne_eq, List.append_eq_nil_iff, not_and]
    exact fun h => absurd h (ev_ne_nil (c 1))

name: Operad.AssShGen.ev_replace
statement:
theorem ev_replace : ∀ (T : STree AssShGen) (p : List ℕ) {u u' : STree AssShGen},
    ev u = ev u' → ev (T.replace p u) = ev (T.replace p u')
  | _, [], _, _, h => by rwa [replace_nil, replace_nil]
  | leaf _, _ :: _, _, _, _ => rfl
  | node e c, i :: p, _, _, h => by
    rw [replace_node_cons, replace_node_cons]
    refine ev_node_congr e fun j => ?_
    split_ifs
    · exact ev_replace (c j) p h
    · rfl

name: Operad.AssShGen.ev_subst
statement:
theorem ev_subst : ∀ (t : STree AssShGen) (xs : ℕ → STree AssShGen),
    ev (t.subst xs) = (ev t).flatMap fun a => ev (xs a)
  | leaf a, xs => by simp
  | node mu c, xs => by
    rw [subst_node]
    simp only [ev, List.flatMap_append, ev_subst (c 0), ev_subst (c 1)]
  | node op c, xs => by
    rw [subst_node]
    simp only [ev, List.flatMap_append, ev_subst (c 0), ev_subst (c 1)]

name: Operad.AssShGen.ev_ctx
statement:
theorem ev_ctx {A B : Finset ℕ} {f : SMono AssShGen A → SMono AssShGen B} (hf : IsSCtx f)
    {g h : SMono AssShGen A} (hgh : ev g.1 = ev h.1) : ev (f g).1 = ev (f h).1
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨T, p, xs, -, -, hfe⟩ := hf
  rw [hfe, hfe]
  exact ev_replace T p (by rw [ev_subst, ev_subst, hgh])

name: Operad.AssShGen.word_lcomb
statement:
lemma word_lcomb (e f : AssShGen 2) :
    word letter (lcomb e f).1 0 = [letter 2 e 0, letter 2 f 0]
proof:
:= by
  rw [word, pos_eq (lcomb e f).nodup (q := [0, 0]) rfl]
  rfl

name: Operad.AssShGen.word_tcomb
statement:
lemma word_tcomb (e f : AssShGen 2) :
    word letter (tcomb e f).1 0 = [letter 2 e 0, letter 2 f 0]
proof:
:= by
  rw [word, pos_eq (tcomb e f).nodup (q := [0, 0]) rfl]
  rfl

name: Operad.AssShGen.word_rcomb
statement: lemma word_rcomb (e f : AssShGen 2) : word letter (rcomb e f).1 0 = [letter 2 e 0]
proof:
:= by
  rw [word, pos_eq (rcomb e f).nodup (q := [0]) rfl]
  rfl

name: Operad.AssShGen.pathLex_of_word
statement:
lemma pathLex_of_word {x y : SMono AssShGen three}
    (h : DegLex (word letter x.1 0) (word letter y.1 0)) : pathLex letter x y
proof:
:=
  ⟨⟨0, by simp⟩, fun j hj => (Nat.not_lt_zero _ hj).elim, h⟩

name: Operad.AssShGen.ev_leadOf_eq
statement:
lemma ev_leadOf_eq {e f : AssShGen 2} (hef : (e, f) ≠ (mu, op)) (s : Bool) :
    ev (leadOf e f s).1 = ev (tailOf e f s).1
proof:
:= by
  cases e <;> cases f <;> cases s <;> first | rfl | exact absurd rfl hef

name: Operad.AssShGen.tailOf_lt
statement:
lemma tailOf_lt {e f : AssShGen 2} (hef : (e, f) ≠ (mu, op)) (s : Bool) :
    pathLex letter (tailOf e f s) (leadOf e f s)
proof:
:= by
  refine pathLex_of_word ?_
  cases e <;> cases f <;> cases s <;>
    simp only [tailOf, leadOf, word_lcomb, word_tcomb, word_rcomb]
  all_goals first
    | exact absurd rfl hef
    | exact Or.inl (by decide)
    | exact Or.inr ⟨rfl, List.Lex.rel (by decide)⟩

name: Operad.AssShGen.strictMonoOn_ins
statement:
lemma strictMonoOn_ins {x y z : STree AssShGen} (hxy : x.first < y.first)
    (hyz : y.first < z.first) :
    StrictMonoOn (fun a => (ins x y z a).first) ((three : Finset ℕ) : Set ℕ)
proof:
:= by
  intro a ha b hb hab
  simp only [Finset.coe_insert, Finset.coe_singleton, Set.mem_insert_iff,
    Set.mem_singleton_iff] at ha hb
  rcases ha with rfl | rfl | rfl <;> rcases hb with rfl | rfl | rfl <;>
    first | omega | (simp only [ins]; omega)

name: Operad.AssShGen.eq_of_get?
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hne'
  have hne : (e, f) ≠ (mu, op) := fun h => hne' (Prod.mk.inj h)
  have hu := isShuffle_get? t.isShuffle hp
  have hn : (bin e (bin f x y) z).labels.Nodup := Multiset.nodup_of_le (labels_get?_le hp) t.nodup
  rw [isShuffle_bin, isShuffle_bin, first_bin] at hu
  obtain ⟨⟨hx, hy, hxy⟩, hz, hxz⟩ := hu
  rw [labels_bin, labels_bin, Multiset.nodup_add] at hn
  have hyz : y.first ≠ z.first := fun h => Multiset.disjoint_left.1 hn.2.2
    (Multiset.mem_add.2 (Or.inr (first_mem hy))) (h ▸ first_mem hz)
  rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne hyz with h | h
  · have hU : t.1.get? p = some (((rules K).lead (⟨(e, f), hne⟩, true)).1.subst (ins x y z)) := by
      rw [hp]
      show _ = some ((bin e (bin f (leaf 0) (leaf 1)) (leaf 2)).subst _)
      rw [subst_bin, subst_bin]
      rfl
    exact hN _ _ (isSCtx_ctxOf t p _ _ hU (strictMonoOn_ins hxy h))
      (ctxOf_self t p _ _ hU (strictMonoOn_ins hxy h))
  · have hU : t.1.get? p = some (((rules K).lead (⟨(e, f), hne⟩, false)).1.subst (ins x z y)) := by
      rw [hp]
      show _ = some ((bin e (bin f (leaf 0) (leaf 2)) (leaf 1)).subst _)
      rw [subst_bin, subst_bin]
      rfl
    exact hN _ _ (isSCtx_ctxOf t p _ _ hU (strictMonoOn_ins hxz h))
      (ctxOf_self t p _ _ hU (strictMonoOn_ins hxz h))

name: Operad.AssShGen.good_of_normal
statement: lemma good_of_normal {A : Finset ℕ} {t : SMono AssShGen A} (h : (rules K).Normal t) : Good t.1
proof:
:=
  fun _ _ _ _ _ _ hp => eq_of_get? t hp h

name: Operad.AssShGen.Good.left
statement: lemma Good.left {e : AssShGen 2} {x y : STree AssShGen} (h : Good (bin e x y)) : Good x
proof:
:=
  fun p e' f' a b c hp => h (0 :: p) e' f' a b c ((get?_node_cons_fin e ![x, y] 0 p).trans hp)

name: Operad.AssShGen.Good.right
statement: lemma Good.right {e : AssShGen 2} {x y : STree AssShGen} (h : Good (bin e x y)) : Good y
proof:
:=
  fun p e' f' a b c hp => h (1 :: p) e' f' a b c ((get?_node_cons_fin e ![x, y] 1 p).trans hp)

name: Operad.AssShGen.Good.root
statement:
lemma Good.root {e f : AssShGen 2} {x y z : STree AssShGen} (h : Good (bin e (bin f x y) z)) :
    e = mu ∧ f = op
proof:
:=
  h [] e f x y z rfl

name: Operad.AssShGen.exists_split
statement:
theorem exists_split {e : AssShGen 2} {l r : STree AssShGen} (hg : Good (bin e l r)) :
    ∃ A B, ev (bin e l r) = A ++ l.first :: B ∧
      (e = mu ∧ l = leaf l.first ∧ A = [] ∧ B = ev r ∨
        e = op ∧ l = leaf l.first ∧ A = ev r ∧ B = [] ∨
        e = mu ∧ ev l = A ++ [l.first] ∧ A ≠ [] ∧ B = ev r)
proof:
:= by
  cases l with
  | leaf a =>
    cases e
    · exact ⟨[], ev r, rfl, Or.inl ⟨rfl, rfl, rfl, rfl⟩⟩
    · exact ⟨ev r, [], by simp [ap], Or.inr (Or.inl ⟨rfl, rfl, rfl, rfl⟩)⟩
  | node g d =>
    cases g
    · rw [node_eq_bin] at hg
      exact absurd hg.root.2 (fun h => by cases h)
    · rw [node_eq_bin] at hg ⊢
      obtain ⟨rfl, -⟩ := hg.root
      cases h0 : d 0 with
      | leaf a =>
        refine ⟨ev (d 1), ev r, ?_, Or.inr (Or.inr ⟨rfl, ?_, ev_ne_nil _, rfl⟩)⟩
        · simp [ap]
        · simp [ap]
      | node g d' =>
        exfalso
        have hl := hg.left
        rw [h0] at hl
        cases g
        · rw [node_eq_bin] at hl
          exact absurd hl.root.1 (fun h => by cases h)
        · rw [node_eq_bin] at hl
          exact absurd hl.root.1 (fun h => by cases h)

name: Operad.AssShGen.ev_node_ne
statement:
lemma ev_node_ne {k : ℕ} (e : AssShGen k) (c : Fin k → STree AssShGen) (a : ℕ) :
    ev (node e c) ≠ [a]
proof:
:= by
  cases e <;> intro h <;> have h' := congrArg List.length h <;>
    have h0 := List.length_pos_iff.2 (ev_ne_nil (c 0)) <;>
    have h1 := List.length_pos_iff.2 (ev_ne_nil (c 1)) <;>
    simp only [ev, List.length_append, List.length_singleton] at h' <;> omega

name: Operad.AssShGen.ev_inj_bin
statement:
theorem ev_inj_bin {e e' : AssShGen 2} {l r l' r' : STree AssShGen}
    (ihl : ∀ {y : STree AssShGen}, l.IsShuffle → y.IsShuffle → l.labels.Nodup →
      y.labels.Nodup → Good l → Good y → ev l = ev y → l = y)
    (ihr : ∀ {y : STree AssShGen}, r.IsShuffle → y.IsShuffle → r.labels.Nodup →
      y.labels.Nodup → Good r → Good y → ev r = ev y → r = y)
    (hs : (bin e l r).IsShuffle) (hs' : (bin e' l' r').IsShuffle)
    (hn : (bin e l r).labels.Nodup) (hn' : (bin e' l' r').labels.Nodup)
    (hg : Good (bin e l r)) (hg' : Good (bin e' l' r'))
    (h : ev (bin e l r) = ev (bin e' l' r')) : bin e l r = bin e' l' r'
proof:
:= by
  have hm : l.first = l'.first := by
    have := first_eq_of_labels_eq hs hs' (by rw [← coe_ev, ← coe_ev, h])
    simpa using this
  obtain ⟨hl, hr, -⟩ := isShuffle_bin.1 hs
  obtain ⟨hl', hr', -⟩ := isShuffle_bin.1 hs'
  have hnd : (ev (bin e l r)).Nodup := by rw [← Multiset.coe_nodup, coe_ev]; exact hn
  rw [labels_bin, Multiset.nodup_add] at hn hn'
  obtain ⟨A, B, hA, hx⟩ := exists_split hg
  obtain ⟨A', B', hA', hy⟩ := exists_split hg'
  rw [hA, List.nodup_middle, List.nodup_cons, List.mem_append, not_or, hm] at hnd
  obtain ⟨rfl, -, rfl⟩ :=
    (List.append_cons_inj_of_notMem hnd.1.1 hnd.1.2).1 (hA.symm.trans (h.trans hA'))
  have hR : ∀ {y : STree AssShGen}, (bin e' y r').IsShuffle → ev r = ev r' → r = r' :=
    fun hy hrr => ihr hr (isShuffle_bin.1 hy).2.1 hn.2.1 hn'.2.1 hg.right hg'.right hrr
  rcases hx with ⟨rfl, hl1, rfl, rfl⟩ | ⟨rfl, hl1, rfl, rfl⟩ | ⟨rfl, hl1, hA0, rfl⟩ <;>
    rcases hy with ⟨rfl, hl1', hA0', hB'⟩ | ⟨rfl, hl1', hA0', hB'⟩ | ⟨rfl, hl1', hA0', hB'⟩
  · rw [hR hs' hB', hl1, hl1', hm]
  · exact absurd hA0'.symm (ev_ne_nil r')
  · exact absurd rfl hA0'
  · exact absurd hA0' (ev_ne_nil r)
  · rw [hR hs' hA0', hl1, hl1', hm]
  · exact absurd hB'.symm (ev_ne_nil r')
  · exact absurd hA0' hA0
  · exact absurd hB' (ev_ne_nil r)
  · rw [hR hs' hB', ihl hl hl' hn.1 hn'.1 hg.left hg'.left (by rw [hl1, hl1', hm])]

name: Operad.AssShGen.ev_inj
statement:
theorem ev_inj (x : STree AssShGen) : ∀ {y : STree AssShGen}, x.IsShuffle → y.IsShuffle →
    x.labels.Nodup → y.labels.Nodup → Good x → Good y → ev x = ev y → x = y
proof:
:= by
  induction x with
  | leaf a =>
    intro y _ _ _ _ _ _ h
    cases y with
    | leaf b =>
      rw [ev_leaf, ev_leaf, List.singleton_inj] at h
      rw [h]
    | node e c => exact absurd h.symm (ev_node_ne e c a)
  | node e c ih =>
    intro y hs hs' hn hn' hg hg' h
    cases y with
    | leaf b => exact absurd h (ev_node_ne e c b)
    | node e' c' =>
      cases e <;> cases e' <;> rw [node_eq_bin] at hs hn hg h ⊢ <;>
        rw [node_eq_bin] at hs' hn' hg' h ⊢ <;>
        exact ev_inj_bin (ih 0) (ih 1) hs hs' hn hn' hg hg' h

name: Operad.AssShGen.ideal_le_ker
statement:
theorem ideal_le_ker (A : Finset ℕ) :
    ((rules K).rw A).ideal ≤ LinearMap.ker (evL K A)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Rules.ideal_eq_span]
  refine Submodule.span_le.2 ?_
  rintro _ ⟨r, f, hf, rfl⟩
  have ht : (rules K).tail r = Finsupp.single (tailOf r.1.1.1 r.1.1.2 r.2) 1 := rfl
  rw [SetLike.mem_coe, LinearMap.mem_ker, evL, Finsupp.lmapDomain_apply,
    ← Finsupp.mapDomain_comp, Finsupp.mapDomain_sub, Finsupp.mapDomain_single, ht]
  erw [Finsupp.mapDomain_single]
  rw [sub_eq_zero, Function.comp_apply, Function.comp_apply]
  exact congrArg (Finsupp.single · 1) (ev_ctx hf (ev_leadOf_eq r.1.2 r.2))

name: Operad.AssShGen.eq_zero_of_evL
proof:
:= by
  have hs := (Finsupp.mem_supported K v).1 hv
  have hinj : Set.InjOn (fun t : SMono AssShGen A => ev t.1) {t | (rules K).Normal t} :=
    fun s hs' t ht h => Subtype.ext (ev_inj s.1 s.isShuffle t.isShuffle s.nodup t.nodup
      (good_of_normal hs') (good_of_normal ht) h)
  ext m
  by_cases hm : (rules K).Normal m
  · rw [Finsupp.zero_apply, ← Finsupp.mapDomain_apply' _ v hs hinj hm]
    exact congrArg (· (ev m.1)) h0
  · exact Finsupp.notMem_support_iff.1 fun h => hm (hs h)

name: Operad.AssShGen.disjoint_normal
statement:
theorem disjoint_normal (A : Finset ℕ) :
    Disjoint (Finsupp.supported K K {t : SMono AssShGen A | (rules K).Normal t})
      ((rules K).rw A).ideal
proof:
:= by
  rw [Submodule.disjoint_def]
  exact fun v hv hI => eq_zero_of_evL hv (ideal_le_ker A hI)

name: Operad.AssShGen.res_amb
statement: theorem res_amb {C : Finset ℕ} {r₁ r₂ : Rule} (B : (rules K).Amb C r₁ r₂) : B.Res
proof:
:=
  B.res_of_isCompl (disjoint_normal C)

name: Operad.AssShGen.weight_lead
statement: lemma weight_lead (r : Rule) : ((rules K).lead r).1.weight = 2
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨⟨⟨e, f⟩, -⟩, s⟩ := r
  cases s <;> rfl

name: Operad.AssShGen.weight_tail
statement: lemma weight_tail (r : Rule) : ∀ m ∈ ((rules K).tail r).support, m.1.weight = 2
proof:
:= fun m hm => by
  rw [Finset.mem_singleton.1 (Finsupp.support_single_subset hm)]
  obtain ⟨⟨⟨e, f⟩, -⟩, s⟩ := r
  cases e <;> cases f <;> cases s <;> rfl

name: Operad.AssShGen.isKoszul
statement: theorem isKoszul : (rules K).IsKoszul
proof:
:=
  (rules K).isKoszul_of_critical weight_lead weight_tail fun B _ => res_amb B

name: Operad.AssShGen.ideal_eq_ker
statement: theorem ideal_eq_ker (A : Finset ℕ) : ((rules K).rw A).ideal = LinearMap.ker (evL K A)
proof:
:= by
  refine le_antisymm (ideal_le_ker A) fun v hv => ?_
  have hc := STree.isCompl_of_critical (rules K) ((rules K).hlead_of_quad weight_lead)
    (fun B _ => res_amb B) A
  have hv' : v ∈ Finsupp.supported K K {t : SMono AssShGen A | (rules K).Normal t} ⊔
      ((rules K).rw A).ideal := by
    rw [hc.sup_eq_top]
    exact Submodule.mem_top
  obtain ⟨n, hn, i, hi, rfl⟩ := Submodule.mem_sup.1 hv'
  rw [LinearMap.mem_ker, map_add, LinearMap.mem_ker.1 (ideal_le_ker A hi), add_zero] at hv
  rw [eq_zero_of_evL hn hv, zero_add]
  exact hi

name: Operad.AssShGen.exists_ev
statement:
theorem exists_ev : ∀ (n : ℕ) (w : List ℕ), w.length ≤ n → w ≠ [] → w.Nodup →
    ∃ t : STree AssShGen, t.IsShuffle ∧ ev t = w
  | 0, w, hl, hw, _ => absurd (List.length_eq_zero_iff.1 (Nat.le_zero.1 hl)) hw
  | n + 1, w, hl, hw, hnd => by
    have hne : w.toFinset.Nonempty
proof:
:= ⟨_, List.mem_toFinset.2 (List.head_mem hw)⟩
    obtain ⟨m, hm, hmin⟩ : ∃ m ∈ w, ∀ a ∈ w, m ≤ a :=
      ⟨_, List.mem_toFinset.1 (w.toFinset.min'_mem hne),
        fun a ha => w.toFinset.min'_le a (List.mem_toFinset.2 ha)⟩
    obtain ⟨P, Q, rfl⟩ := List.append_of_mem hm
    rw [List.nodup_middle, List.nodup_cons, List.mem_append, not_or] at hnd
    obtain ⟨⟨hmP, hmQ⟩, hPQ⟩ := hnd
    have hlt : ∀ a ∈ P ++ Q, m < a := fun a ha => lt_of_le_of_ne
      (hmin a (List.mem_append.2 ((List.mem_append.1 ha).imp id (List.mem_cons_of_mem m))))
      fun h => by
        rcases List.mem_append.1 ha with ha | ha
        · exact hmP (h ▸ ha)
        · exact hmQ (h ▸ ha)
    simp only [List.length_append, List.length_cons] at hl
    have key : ∀ u : List ℕ, u.length ≤ n → u ≠ [] → u.Nodup → (∀ a ∈ u, m < a) →
        ∃ t : STree AssShGen, t.IsShuffle ∧ ev t = u ∧ m < t.first := fun u hu hu' hun hum => by
      obtain ⟨t, hts, hte⟩ := exists_ev n u hu hu' hun
      refine ⟨t, hts, hte, hum _ ?_⟩
      rw [← Multiset.mem_coe, ← hte, coe_ev]
      exact first_mem hts
    have hP := (List.nodup_append.1 hPQ).1
    have hQ := (List.nodup_append.1 hPQ).2.1
    have hltP : ∀ a ∈ P, m < a := fun a ha => hlt a (List.mem_append_left Q ha)
    have hltQ : ∀ a ∈ Q, m < a := fun a ha => hlt a (List.mem_append_right P ha)
    rcases eq_or_ne P [] with rfl | hP0 <;> rcases eq_or_ne Q [] with rfl | hQ0
    · exact ⟨leaf m, trivial, rfl⟩
    · obtain ⟨tQ, hsQ, heQ, hfQ⟩ := key Q (by simp at hl; omega) hQ0 hQ hltQ
      exact ⟨bin mu (leaf m) tQ, isShuffle_bin.2 ⟨trivial, hsQ, hfQ⟩, by simp [ap, heQ]⟩
    · obtain ⟨tP, hsP, heP, hfP⟩ := key P (by simp at hl; omega) hP0 hP hltP
      exact ⟨bin op (leaf m) tP, isShuffle_bin.2 ⟨trivial, hsP, hfP⟩, by simp [ap, heP]⟩
    · obtain ⟨tP, hsP, heP, hfP⟩ := key P (by omega) hP0 hP hltP
      obtain ⟨tQ, hsQ, heQ, hfQ⟩ := key Q (by omega) hQ0 hQ hltQ
      refine ⟨bin mu (bin op (leaf m) tP) tQ,
        isShuffle_bin.2 ⟨isShuffle_bin.2 ⟨trivial, hsP, hfP⟩, hsQ, by simpa using hfQ⟩, ?_⟩
      simp [ap, heP, heQ]

name: Operad.AssShGen.mem_arr
statement: lemma mem_arr {A : Finset ℕ} {w : List ℕ} : w ∈ arr A ↔ (w : Multiset ℕ) = A.val
proof:
:= by
  rw [arr, List.mem_toFinset, List.mem_permutations, ← Multiset.coe_eq_coe, Finset.coe_toList]

name: Operad.AssShGen.card_arr
statement: lemma card_arr (A : Finset ℕ) : (arr A).card = A.card.factorial
proof:
:= by
  rw [arr, List.toFinset_card_of_nodup (List.nodup_permutations _ A.nodup_toList),
    List.length_permutations, Finset.length_toList]

name: Operad.AssShGen.range_evL
statement:
theorem range_evL {A : Finset ℕ} (hA : A.Nonempty) :
    LinearMap.range (evL K A) = Finsupp.supported K K (arr A : Set (List ℕ))
proof:
:= by
  rw [LinearMap.range_eq_map, ← Finsupp.supported_univ, evL, Finsupp.lmapDomain_supported,
    Set.image_univ]
  congr 1
  ext w
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨t, rfl⟩
    exact mem_arr.2 (by rw [coe_ev, t.labels_eq])
  · intro hw
    have hw' := mem_arr.1 (Finset.mem_coe.1 hw)
    have hnd : w.Nodup := by rw [← Multiset.coe_nodup, hw']; exact A.nodup
    have hne : w ≠ [] := by
      rintro rfl
      exact hA.ne_empty (Finset.val_eq_zero.1 hw'.symm)
    obtain ⟨t, hs, he⟩ := exists_ev w.length w le_rfl hne hnd
    exact ⟨⟨t, hs, by rw [← coe_ev, he, hw']⟩, he⟩

name: Operad.AssShGen.finrank_eq_factorial
statement:
theorem finrank_eq_factorial [Nontrivial K] {A : Finset ℕ} (hA : A.Nonempty) :
    Module.finrank K ((SMono AssShGen A →₀ K) ⧸ ((rules K).rw A).ideal) = A.card.factorial
proof:
:= by
  have e := (Submodule.quotEquivOfEq _ _ (ideal_eq_ker A)).trans
    (LinearMap.quotKerEquivRange (evL K A))
  rw [e.finrank_eq, range_evL hA, (Finsupp.supportedEquivFinsupp _).finrank_eq,
    Module.finrank_finsupp_self]
  simp [card_arr]

name: Operad.SymCooperad.pair_tmul
statement:
@[simp] lemma pair_tmul {X Y : Type*} [AddCommGroup X] [Module R X] [AddCommGroup Y]
    [Module R Y] (f : Module.Dual R X) (g : Module.Dual R Y) (x : X) (y : Y) :
    pair f g (x ⊗ₜ[R] y) = f x * g y
proof:
:= by
  simp [pair]

name: Operad.SymCooperad.dualComp_apply
statement:
@[simp] lemma dualComp_apply (i : A) (f : Dual R C A) (g : Dual R C B)
    (c : C (Without A i ⊕ B)) : dualComp i f g c = pair f g (decomp (R := R) i c)
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: Operad.SymCooperad.dualMap_apply
statement:
@[simp] lemma dualMap_apply {A B : Type} [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] [Fintype B] [DecidableEq B]
    (e : A ≃ B) (f : Dual R C A) (c : C B) : dualMap e f c = f (map (R := R) e.symm c)
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: Operad.SymCooperad.pair_map
statement:
lemma pair_map {X Y X' Y' : Type*} [AddCommGroup X] [Module R X] [AddCommGroup Y] [Module R Y]
    [AddCommGroup X'] [Module R X'] [AddCommGroup Y'] [Module R Y'] (f : Module.Dual R X')
    (g : Module.Dual R Y') (φ : X →ₗ[R] X') (ψ : Y →ₗ[R] Y') :
    pair f g ∘ₗ TensorProduct.map φ ψ = pair (f ∘ₗ φ) (g ∘ₗ ψ)
proof:
:=
  TensorProduct.ext' fun x y => by simp

name: Operad.SymCooperad.map_symm_map
statement:
lemma map_symm_map {A B : Type} [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] [Fintype B] [DecidableEq B]
    (e : A ≃ B) (x : C A) : map (R := R) e.symm (map (R := R) e x) = x
proof:
:= by
  rw [← map_trans, Equiv.self_trans_symm, map_refl]

name: Operad.SymCooperad.map_map_symm
statement:
lemma map_map_symm {A B : Type} [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] [Fintype B] [DecidableEq B]
    (e : A ≃ B) (x : C B) : map (R := R) e (map (R := R) e.symm x) = x
proof:
:= by
  rw [← map_trans, Equiv.symm_trans_self, map_refl]

name: Operad.SymCooperad.pair_counit_right
statement:
lemma pair_counit_right {X Y : Type*} [AddCommGroup X] [Module R X] [AddCommGroup Y] [Module R Y]
    (f : Module.Dual R X) (ε : Module.Dual R Y) :
    pair f ε = f ∘ₗ (TensorProduct.rid R X).toLinearMap ∘ₗ LinearMap.lTensor X ε
proof:
:=
  TensorProduct.ext' fun x y => by simp [mul_comm]

name: Operad.SymCooperad.pair_counit_left
statement:
lemma pair_counit_left {X Y : Type*} [AddCommGroup X] [Module R X] [AddCommGroup Y] [Module R Y]
    (ε : Module.Dual R X) (g : Module.Dual R Y) :
    pair ε g = g ∘ₗ (TensorProduct.lid R Y).toLinearMap ∘ₗ LinearMap.rTensor Y ε
proof:
:=
  TensorProduct.ext' fun x y => by simp

name: Operad.SymCooperad.pair_assoc
statement:
lemma pair_assoc {X Y Z : Type*} [AddCommGroup X] [Module R X] [AddCommGroup Y] [Module R Y]
    [AddCommGroup Z] [Module R Z] (f : Module.Dual R X) (g : Module.Dual R Y)
    (h : Module.Dual R Z) :
    pair f (pair g h) ∘ₗ (TensorProduct.assoc R X Y Z).toLinearMap = pair (pair f g) h
proof:
:=
  TensorProduct.ext_threefold fun x y z => by simp [mul_assoc]

name: Operad.SymCooperad.pair_swapLast
statement:
lemma pair_swapLast {X Y Z : Type v} [AddCommGroup X] [Module R X] [AddCommGroup Y] [Module R Y]
    [AddCommGroup Z] [Module R Z] (f : Module.Dual R X) (g : Module.Dual R Y)
    (h : Module.Dual R Z) :
    pair (pair f h) g ∘ₗ (swapLast R X Y Z).toLinearMap = pair (pair f g) h
proof:
:=
  TensorProduct.ext_threefold fun x y z => by simp [swapLast, mul_right_comm]

name: Operad.SymCooperad.pair_comp_decomp
statement:
lemma pair_comp_decomp (i : A) (f : Dual R C A) (g : Dual R C B) :
    dualComp i f g = pair f g ∘ₗ decomp (R := R) i
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: Operad.SymCooperad.pair_comp_left
statement:
lemma pair_comp_left {X X' Y : Type*} [AddCommGroup X] [Module R X] [AddCommGroup X']
    [Module R X'] [AddCommGroup Y] [Module R Y] (F : Module.Dual R X') (φ : X →ₗ[R] X')
    (G : Module.Dual R Y) : pair (F ∘ₗ φ) G = pair F G ∘ₗ LinearMap.rTensor Y φ
proof:
:= by
  rw [LinearMap.rTensor, pair_map, LinearMap.comp_id]

name: Operad.SymCooperad.pair_comp_right
statement:
lemma pair_comp_right {X Y Y' : Type*} [AddCommGroup X] [Module R X] [AddCommGroup Y]
    [Module R Y] [AddCommGroup Y'] [Module R Y'] (F : Module.Dual R X) (G : Module.Dual R Y')
    (ψ : Y →ₗ[R] Y') : pair F (G ∘ₗ ψ) = pair F G ∘ₗ LinearMap.lTensor X ψ
proof:
:= by
  rw [LinearMap.lTensor, pair_map, LinearMap.comp_id]

name: Operad.SymCooperad.dual_map_apply
statement:
@[simp] lemma dual_map_apply {A B : Type} [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] [Fintype B]
    [DecidableEq B] (e : A ≃ B) (f : Dual R C A) (c : C B) :
    SymOperad.map (R := R) (P := Dual R C) e f c = f (map (R := R) e.symm c)
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: Operad.SymCooperad.dual_comp_apply
statement:
@[simp] lemma dual_comp_apply (i : A) (f : Dual R C A) (g : Dual R C B)
    (c : C (Without A i ⊕ B)) :
    SymOperad.comp (R := R) (P := Dual R C) i f g c = pair f g (decomp (R := R) i c)
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: Operad.SymCooperad.dual_one
statement: lemma dual_one : SymOperad.one R (P := Dual R C) = counit
proof:
:=

name: Operad.STree.mapG_leaf
statement: @[simp] lemma mapG_leaf (a : ℕ) : (leaf a : STree E).mapG φ = leaf a
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.STree.mapG_node
statement:
@[simp] lemma mapG_node {k : ℕ} (e : E k) (c : Fin k → STree E) :
    (node e c).mapG φ = node (φ k e) fun i => (c i).mapG φ
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.STree.mapG_mapG
statement:
lemma mapG_mapG (ψ : ∀ k, F k → G k) :
    ∀ t : STree E, (t.mapG φ).mapG ψ = t.mapG fun k e => ψ k (φ k e)
  | leaf _ => rfl
  | node e c => by
    simp only [mapG_node]
    congr 1
    funext i
    exact mapG_mapG ψ (c i)

name: Operad.STree.mapG_id
statement:
lemma mapG_id : ∀ t : STree E, t.mapG (fun _ e => e) = t
  | leaf _ => rfl
  | node e c => by
    simp only [mapG_node]
    congr 1
    funext i
    exact mapG_id (c i)

@[simp] lemma first_mapG : ∀ t : STree E, (t.mapG φ).first = t.first
  | leaf _ => rfl
  | @node _ k e c => by
    by_cases h : 0 < k
    · rw [mapG_node, first_node _ _ h, first_node _ _ h]
      exact first_mapG (c _)
    · simp only [mapG_node, first, dif_neg h]

@[simp] lemma labels_mapG : ∀ t : STree E, (t.mapG φ).labels = t.labels
  | leaf _ => rfl
  | node e c => by
    simp only [mapG_node, labels_node]
    exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => labels_mapG (c i)

@[simp] lemma weight_mapG : ∀ t : STree E, (t.mapG φ).weight = t.weight
  | leaf _ => rfl
  | node e c => by
    simp only [mapG_node, weight_node]
    rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => weight_mapG (c i)]

@[simp] lemma isShuffle_mapG : ∀ t : STree E, (t.mapG φ).IsShuffle ↔ t.IsShuffle
  | leaf _ => Iff.rfl
  | node e c => by
    rw [mapG_node, isShuffle_node, isShuffle_node]
    simp only [first_mapG]
    exact and_congr Iff.rfl (and_congr (forall_congr' fun i => isShuffle_mapG (c i)) Iff.rfl)

    (t.subst xs).mapG φ = (t.mapG φ).subst fun a => (xs a).mapG φ
  | leaf _, _ => rfl
  | node e c, xs => by
    simp only [subst_node, mapG_node]
    congr 1
    funext i
    exact subst_mapG (c i) xs

name: Operad.STree.get?_mapG
statement:
lemma get?_mapG : ∀ (t : STree E) (p : List ℕ), (t.mapG φ).get? p = (t.get? p).map (mapG φ)
  | t, [] => by simp
  | leaf _, _ :: _ => rfl
  | @node _ k e c, i :: p => by
    rw [mapG_node, get?_node_cons, get?_node_cons]
    split_ifs with h
    · exact get?_mapG (c ⟨i, h⟩) p
    · rfl

name: Operad.STree.replace_mapG
statement:
lemma replace_mapG : ∀ (t : STree E) (p : List ℕ) (u : STree E),
    (t.replace p u).mapG φ = (t.mapG φ).replace p (u.mapG φ)
  | _, [], _ => by rw [replace_nil, replace_nil]
  | leaf _, _ :: _, _ => rfl
  | @node _ k e c, i :: p, u => by
    rw [replace_node_cons, mapG_node, mapG_node, replace_node_cons]
    congr 1
    funext j
    split_ifs
    · exact replace_mapG (c j) p u
    · rfl

end MapG

              

                                                                        
def key (t : STree E) : ℕ ×ₗ ℕ
proof: := toLex (t.first, t.weight)

name: Operad.STree.vkeys_leaf
statement: @[simp] lemma vkeys_leaf (a : ℕ) : (leaf a : STree E).vkeys = 0
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.STree.vkeys_node
statement:
@[simp] lemma vkeys_node {k : ℕ} (e : E k) (c : Fin k → STree E) :
    (node e c).vkeys = key (node e c) ::ₘ ∑ i, (c i).vkeys
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.STree.edgeKeys_leaf

name: Operad.STree.edgeKeys_node
statement:
@[simp] lemma edgeKeys_node {k : ℕ} (e : E k) (c : Fin k → STree E) :

proof: := rfl

name: Operad.STree.key_mapG
statement: @[simp] lemma key_mapG (φ : ∀ k, E k → F k) (t : STree E) : (t.mapG φ).key = t.key
proof:
:= by
  rw [key, key, first_mapG, weight_mapG]

name: Operad.STree.vkeys_mapG
statement:
@[simp] lemma vkeys_mapG (φ : ∀ k, E k → F k) : ∀ t : STree E, (t.mapG φ).vkeys = t.vkeys
  | leaf _ => rfl
  | node e c => by
    rw [mapG_node, vkeys_node, vkeys_node, ← mapG_node, key_mapG]
    congr 1
    exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => vkeys_mapG φ (c i)

@[simp] lemma edgeKeys_mapG (φ : ∀ k, E k → F k) : ∀ t : STree E, (t.mapG φ).edgeKeys = t.edgeKeys
  | leaf _ => rfl

    rw [mapG_node, edgeKeys_node, edgeKeys_node]
    simp only [vkeys_mapG]

name: Operad.STree.mem_vkeys_node
statement:
lemma mem_vkeys_node {k : ℕ} {e : E k} {c : Fin k → STree E} {x : ℕ ×ₗ ℕ} :
    x ∈ (node e c).vkeys ↔ x = key (node e c) ∨ ∃ i, x ∈ (c i).vkeys
proof:
:= by
  simp [Multiset.mem_sum]

name: Operad.STree.mem_edgeKeys_node
statement:
lemma mem_edgeKeys_node {k : ℕ} {e : E k} {c : Fin k → STree E} {x : ℕ ×ₗ ℕ} :
    x ∈ (node e c).edgeKeys ↔ ∃ i, x ∈ (c i).vkeys
proof:
:= by
  simp [Multiset.mem_sum]

name: Operad.STree.weight_lt_node
statement:
lemma weight_lt_node {k : ℕ} (e : E k) (c : Fin k → STree E) (i : Fin k) :
    (c i).weight < (node e c).weight
proof:
:= by
  rw [weight_node]
  have := Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun j => (c j).weight) (fun _ _ => Nat.zero_le _)
    (Finset.mem_univ i)
  simp only at this
  omega

name: Operad.STree.mem_vkeys
statement:
theorem mem_vkeys : ∀ {t : STree E}, t.IsShuffle → ∀ {x : ℕ ×ₗ ℕ}, x ∈ t.vkeys →
    (ofLex x).1 ∈ t.labels ∧ (ofLex x).2 ≤ t.weight
  | leaf _, _, _, hx => absurd hx (Multiset.notMem_zero _)
  | node e c, h, x, hx => by
    rcases mem_vkeys_node.1 hx with rfl | ⟨i, hi⟩
    · exact ⟨first_mem h, le_rfl⟩
    · obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩
proof:
:= mem_vkeys (h.child i) hi
      exact ⟨Multiset.mem_of_le (labels_le_node e c i) h1, h2.trans (weight_lt_node e c i).le⟩

name: Operad.STree.nodup_sum_fin
statement:
lemma nodup_sum_fin {α : Type*} {k : ℕ} (f : Fin k → Multiset α) (h₁ : ∀ i, (f i).Nodup)
    (h₂ : ∀ i j, i ≠ j → Disjoint (f i) (f j)) : (∑ i, f i).Nodup
proof:
:= by
  classical
  suffices ∀ s : Finset (Fin k), (∑ i ∈ s, f i).Nodup from this _
  intro s
  induction s using Finset.induction_on with
  | empty => simp
  | insert i s hi ih =>
    rw [Finset.sum_insert hi, Multiset.nodup_add]
    exact ⟨h₁ i, ih, Multiset.disjoint_finsetSum_right.2 fun j hj =>
      h₂ i j fun h => hi (h ▸ hj)⟩

name: Operad.STree.nodup_vkeys
statement:
theorem nodup_vkeys : ∀ {t : STree E}, t.IsShuffle → t.labels.Nodup → t.vkeys.Nodup
  | leaf _, _, _ => Multiset.nodup_zero
  | node e c, h, hn => by
    rw [vkeys_node, Multiset.nodup_cons]
    refine ⟨fun hk => ?_, nodup_sum_fin _ (fun i => nodup_vkeys (h.child i) (nodup_of_node hn i))
      fun i j hij => Multiset.disjoint_left.2 fun hx hx' => ?_⟩
    · obtain ⟨i, hi⟩
proof:
:= (Multiset.mem_sum (s := Finset.univ)).1 hk
      have := (mem_vkeys (h.child i) hi.2).2
      simp only [key, ofLex_toLex] at this
      exact absurd (weight_lt_node e c i) (not_lt.2 this)
    · exact not_mem_of_node hn hij (mem_vkeys (h.child i) hx).1 (mem_vkeys (h.child j) hx').1

statement: lemma key_eq_of_forget {s t : STree (BE E)} (h : forget s = forget t) : s.key = t.key

    congr 1
    funext i

name: Operad.STree.rootF_setF_node
statement:
lemma rootF_setF_node {k : ℕ} (d : BE E k) (c : Fin k → STree (BE E)) :
    rootF (setF x b (node d c)) = if key (node d c) = x then b else d.2
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.STree.mem_cutKeys_node
statement:
lemma mem_cutKeys_node {k : ℕ} {d : BE E k} {c : Fin k → STree (BE E)} {y : ℕ ×ₗ ℕ} :
    y ∈ cutKeys (node d c) ↔ (d.2 = true ∧ y = key (node d c)) ∨ ∃ i, y ∈ cutKeys (c i)
proof:
:= by
  rw [cutKeys, Finset.mem_union, Finset.mem_biUnion]
  split_ifs with h <;> simp [h]

name: Operad.STree.mem_vkeys_of_mem_cutKeys
statement:
theorem mem_vkeys_of_mem_cutKeys : ∀ {t : STree (BE E)} {y : ℕ ×ₗ ℕ}, y ∈ cutKeys t →
    y ∈ t.vkeys
  | leaf _, _, h => absurd h (Finset.notMem_empty _)
  | node d c, y, h => by
    rw [mem_vkeys_node]
    rcases mem_cutKeys_node.1 h with ⟨-, rfl⟩ | ⟨i, hi⟩
    · exact Or.inl rfl
    · exact Or.inr ⟨i, mem_vkeys_of_mem_cutKeys hi⟩

name: Operad.STree.mem_cutKeys_setF_false
statement:
theorem mem_cutKeys_setF_false (x : ℕ ×ₗ ℕ) : ∀ (t : STree (BE E)) (y : ℕ ×ₗ ℕ),
    y ∈ cutKeys (setF x false t) ↔ y ≠ x ∧ y ∈ cutKeys t
  | leaf _, y => by simp [cutKeys]
  | node d c, y => by
    rw [setF_node, mem_cutKeys_node, mem_cutKeys_node, key_node_setF]
    simp only [mem_cutKeys_setF_false x]
    by_cases hk : key (node d c) = x
    · subst hk
      simp only [if_true, Bool.false_eq_true, false_and, false_or]
      constructor
      · rintro ⟨i, hne, hi⟩
        exact ⟨hne, Or.inr ⟨i, hi⟩⟩
      · rintro ⟨hne, ⟨-, rfl⟩ | ⟨i, hi⟩⟩
        · exact absurd rfl hne
        · exact ⟨i, hne, hi⟩
    · simp only [hk, if_false]
      constructor
      · rintro (⟨h, rfl⟩ | ⟨i, hne, hi⟩)
        · exact ⟨hk, Or.inl ⟨h, rfl⟩⟩
        · exact ⟨hne, Or.inr ⟨i, hi⟩⟩
      · rintro ⟨hne, ⟨h, rfl⟩ | ⟨i, hi⟩⟩
        · exact Or.inl ⟨h, rfl⟩
        · exact Or.inr ⟨i, hne, hi⟩

name: Operad.STree.cutKeys_setF_false
statement:
theorem cutKeys_setF_false (x : ℕ ×ₗ ℕ) (t : STree (BE E)) :
    cutKeys (setF x false t) = (cutKeys t).erase x
proof:
:= by
  ext y
  rw [mem_cutKeys_setF_false, Finset.mem_erase]

name: Operad.STree.mem_cutKeys_setF_true
statement:
theorem mem_cutKeys_setF_true (x : ℕ ×ₗ ℕ) : ∀ (t : STree (BE E)) (y : ℕ ×ₗ ℕ),
    y ∈ cutKeys (setF x true t) ↔ (y = x ∧ x ∈ t.vkeys) ∨ y ∈ cutKeys t
  | leaf _, y => by simp [cutKeys]
  | node d c, y => by
    rw [setF_node, mem_cutKeys_node, mem_cutKeys_node, key_node_setF, mem_vkeys_node]
    simp only [mem_cutKeys_setF_true x]
    by_cases hk : key (node d c) = x
    · simp only [hk, if_true]
      aesop
    · simp only [hk, if_false]
      aesop

name: Operad.STree.cutKeys_setF_true
statement:
theorem cutKeys_setF_true {x : ℕ ×ₗ ℕ} {t : STree (BE E)} (hx : x ∈ t.vkeys) :
    cutKeys (setF x true t) = insert x (cutKeys t)
proof:
:= by
  ext y
  rw [mem_cutKeys_setF_true, Finset.mem_insert]
  exact or_congr (and_iff_left hx) Iff.rfl

name: Operad.STree.setF_comm
statement:
theorem setF_comm {x y : ℕ ×ₗ ℕ} (hxy : x ≠ y) (b b' : Bool) :
    ∀ t : STree (BE E), setF x b (setF y b' t) = setF y b' (setF x b t)
  | leaf _ => rfl
  | node d c => by
    rw [setF_node, setF_node, setF_node, setF_node, key_node_setF, key_node_setF]
    congr 1
    · by_cases hx : key (node d c) = x
      · have hy : key (node d c) ≠ y
proof:
:= hx ▸ hxy
        simp only [hx, if_true, if_neg (hx ▸ hy)]
      · by_cases hy : key (node d c) = y
        · simp only [hy, if_true, if_neg (hy ▸ hx)]
        · simp only [if_neg hx, if_neg hy]
    · funext i
      exact setF_comm hxy b b' (c i)

name: Operad.STree.setF_setF_self
statement:
theorem setF_setF_self (x : ℕ ×ₗ ℕ) (b b' : Bool) :
    ∀ t : STree (BE E), setF x b (setF x b' t) = setF x b t
  | leaf _ => rfl
  | node d c => by
    rw [setF_node, setF_node, setF_node, key_node_setF]
    congr 1
    · by_cases hx : key (node d c) = x
      · simp only [hx, if_true]
      · simp only [if_neg hx]
    · funext i
      exact setF_setF_self x b b' (c i)

name: Operad.STree.setF_of_notMem
statement:
theorem setF_of_notMem {x : ℕ ×ₗ ℕ} (b : Bool) :
    ∀ {t : STree (BE E)}, x ∉ t.vkeys → setF x b t = t
  | leaf _, _ => rfl
  | node d c, h => by
    rw [mem_vkeys_node, not_or, not_exists] at h
    rw [setF_node, if_neg (Ne.symm h.1)]
    congr 1
    funext i
    exact setF_of_notMem b (h.2 i)

name: Operad.STree.setF_false_of_notMem
statement:
theorem setF_false_of_notMem : ∀ {x : ℕ ×ₗ ℕ} {t : STree (BE E)}, x ∉ cutKeys t →
    setF x false t = t
  | _, leaf _, _ => rfl
  | x, node d c, h => by
    rw [mem_cutKeys_node, not_or, not_exists] at h
    rw [setF_node]
    have hd : (if key (node d c) = x then false else d.2) = d.2
proof:
:= by
      split_ifs with hk
      · cases hd2 : d.2
        · rfl
        · exact absurd ⟨hd2, hk.symm⟩ h.1
      · rfl
    rw [hd]
    congr 1
    funext i
    exact setF_false_of_notMem (h.2 i)

name: Operad.STree.setF_true_of_mem
statement:
theorem setF_true_of_mem : ∀ {x : ℕ ×ₗ ℕ} {t : STree (BE E)}, t.vkeys.Nodup →
    x ∈ cutKeys t → setF x true t = t
  | _, leaf _, _, h => absurd h (Finset.notMem_empty _)
  | x, @node _ k d c, hn, h => by
    rw [vkeys_node, Multiset.nodup_cons] at hn
    have hnc : ∀ i, (c i).vkeys.Nodup
proof:
:= fun i =>
      Multiset.nodup_of_le (Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun j => (c j).vkeys)
        (fun _ _ => Multiset.zero_le _) (Finset.mem_univ i)) hn.2
    have hdisj : ∀ i j, i ≠ j → Disjoint (c i).vkeys (c j).vkeys := fun i j hij => by
      have hle : (c i).vkeys + (c j).vkeys ≤ ∑ l, (c l).vkeys := by
        rw [← Finset.sum_pair (f := fun l => (c l).vkeys) hij]
        exact Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg (Finset.subset_univ _)
          fun _ _ _ => Multiset.zero_le _
      exact (Multiset.nodup_add.1 (Multiset.nodup_of_le hle hn.2)).2.2
    rw [setF_node]
    by_cases hk : key (node d c) = x
    · 
      subst hk
      have hc : ∀ i, key (node d c) ∉ (c i).vkeys := fun i hi =>
        hn.1 ((Multiset.mem_sum (s := Finset.univ)).2 ⟨i, Finset.mem_univ i, hi⟩)
      rcases mem_cutKeys_node.1 h with ⟨hd, -⟩ | ⟨i, hi⟩
      · rw [if_pos rfl]
        obtain ⟨d₁, d₂⟩ := d
        simp only at hd
        subst hd
        congr 1
        funext i
        exact setF_of_notMem true (hc i)
      · exact absurd (mem_vkeys_of_mem_cutKeys hi) (hc i)
    · rw [if_neg hk]
      rcases mem_cutKeys_node.1 h with ⟨-, rfl⟩ | ⟨i, hi⟩
      · exact absurd rfl hk
      · congr 1
        funext j
        by_cases hij : j = i
        · subst hij
          exact setF_true_of_mem (hnc j) hi
        · exact setF_of_notMem true fun hj =>
            Multiset.disjoint_left.1 (hdisj i j (Ne.symm hij)) (mem_vkeys_of_mem_cutKeys hi) hj

name: Operad.STree.sum_map_finsetSum
statement:
lemma sum_map_finsetSum {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι) (g : ι → Multiset ℕ) (f : ℕ → ℕ) :
    ((∑ i ∈ s, g i).map f).sum = ∑ i ∈ s, ((g i).map f).sum
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction s using Finset.induction_on with
  | empty => simp
  | insert i s hi ih =>
    rw [Finset.sum_insert hi, Finset.sum_insert hi, Multiset.map_add, Multiset.sum_add, ih]

name: Operad.STree.weight_subst
statement:
theorem weight_subst : ∀ (t : STree E) (xs : ℕ → STree E),
    (t.subst xs).weight = t.weight + (t.labels.map fun a => (xs a).weight).sum
  | leaf a, xs => by simp
  | node e c, xs => by
    simp only [subst_node, weight_node, labels_node, sum_map_finsetSum]
    rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => weight_subst (c i) xs, Finset.sum_add_distrib]
    ring

name: Operad.STree.weight_replace
statement:
theorem weight_replace : ∀ {t u : STree E} {p : List ℕ}, t.get? p = some u → ∀ {v : STree E},
    v.weight = u.weight → (t.replace p v).weight = t.weight
  | t, u, [], h, v, hv => by
    rw [get?_nil, Option.some_inj] at h
    subst h
    simpa using hv
  | leaf _, _, _ :: _, h, _, _ => by simp at h
  | @node _ k e c, u, i :: p, h, v, hv => by
    obtain ⟨hi, h⟩
proof:
:= get?_node_cons_eq_some.1 h
    rw [replace_node_cons, weight_node, weight_node]
    congr 1
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => ?_
    split_ifs with hj
    · have : j = ⟨i, hi⟩ := Fin.ext hj
      subst this
      exact weight_replace h hv
    · rfl

name: Operad.STree.key_replace
statement:
theorem key_replace {t u : STree E} {p : List ℕ} (h : t.get? p = some u) {v : STree E}
    (hf : v.first = u.first) (hw : v.weight = u.weight) : (t.replace p v).key = t.key
proof:
:= by
  rw [key, key, first_replace h hf, weight_replace h hw]

name: Operad.STree.rootF_replace
statement:
lemma rootF_replace : ∀ (t : STree (BE E)) {p : List ℕ}, p ≠ [] → ∀ u : STree (BE E),
    rootF (t.replace p u) = rootF t
  | _, [], h, _ => absurd rfl h
  | leaf _, _ :: _, _, _ => rfl
  | node _ _, _ :: _, _, _ => rfl

name: Operad.STree.get?_setF
statement:
lemma get?_setF (x : ℕ ×ₗ ℕ) (b : Bool) : ∀ (t : STree (BE E)) (p : List ℕ),
    (setF x b t).get? p = (t.get? p).map (setF x b)
  | t, [] => by simp
  | leaf _, _ :: _ => rfl
  | @node _ k d c, i :: p => by
    rw [setF_node, get?_node_cons, get?_node_cons]
    split_ifs with h
    · exact get?_setF x b (c ⟨i, h⟩) p
    · rfl

name: Operad.STree.setF_replace
statement:
theorem setF_replace (x : ℕ ×ₗ ℕ) (b : Bool) : ∀ {t w : STree (BE E)} {p : List ℕ},
    t.get? p = some w → ∀ {u : STree (BE E)}, u.first = w.first → u.weight = w.weight →
    setF x b (t.replace p u) = (setF x b t).replace p (setF x b u)
  | t, w, [], _, u, _, _ => by rw [replace_nil, replace_nil]
  | leaf _, _, _ :: _, h, _, _, _ => by simp at h
  | @node _ k d c, w, i :: p, h, u, hf, hw => by
    have h'
proof:
:= h
    obtain ⟨hi, h⟩ := get?_node_cons_eq_some.1 h
    rw [replace_node_cons, setF_node, setF_node, replace_node_cons,
      ← replace_node_cons, key_replace h' hf hw]
    congr 1
    funext j
    split_ifs with hj
    · have : j = ⟨i, hi⟩ := Fin.ext hj
      subst this
      exact setF_replace x b h hf hw
    · rfl

name: Operad.STree.cutKeys_replace_congr
statement:
theorem cutKeys_replace_congr : ∀ {t w : STree (BE E)} {p : List ℕ}, t.get? p = some w →
    ∀ {u u' : STree (BE E)}, u.first = w.first → u.weight = w.weight → u'.first = w.first →
    u'.weight = w.weight → cutKeys u = cutKeys u' →
    cutKeys (t.replace p u) = cutKeys (t.replace p u')
  | t, w, [], _, u, u', _, _, _, _, h => by rw [replace_nil, replace_nil, h]
  | leaf _, _, _ :: _, h, _, _, _, _, _, _, _ => by simp at h
  | @node _ k d c, w, i :: p, h, u, u', hf, hw, hf', hw', hc => by
    have h'
proof:
:= h
    obtain ⟨hi, h⟩ := get?_node_cons_eq_some.1 h
    have hk : key (node d c |>.replace (i :: p) u) = key (node d c |>.replace (i :: p) u') := by
      rw [key_replace h' hf hw, key_replace h' hf' hw']
    rw [replace_node_cons, replace_node_cons] at hk ⊢
    rw [cutKeys, cutKeys, hk]
    congr 1
    refine Finset.biUnion_congr rfl fun j _ => ?_
    split_ifs with hj
    · have : j = ⟨i, hi⟩ := Fin.ext hj
      subst this
      exact cutKeys_replace_congr h hf hw hf' hw' hc
    · rfl

name: Operad.STree.mem_cutKeys_allF_subst
statement:
theorem mem_cutKeys_allF_subst : ∀ (g : STree E) (xs : ℕ → STree (BE E)) (y : ℕ ×ₗ ℕ),
    y ∈ cutKeys ((allF g).subst xs) ↔ ∃ a ∈ g.labels, y ∈ cutKeys (xs a)
  | leaf a, xs, y => by simp
  | node e c, xs, y => by
    rw [allF_node, subst_node, mem_cutKeys_node]
    simp only [Bool.false_eq_true, false_and, false_or, mem_cutKeys_allF_subst, labels_node,
      Multiset.mem_sum, Finset.mem_univ, true_and]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨i, a, ha, hy⟩
      exact ⟨a, ⟨i, ha⟩, hy⟩
    · rintro ⟨a, ⟨i, ha⟩, hy⟩
      exact ⟨i, a, ha, hy⟩

name: Operad.STree.mem_cutKeys_fl_subst
statement:
theorem mem_cutKeys_fl_subst {k : ℕ} (b : Bool) (e : E k) (c : Fin k → STree E)
    (xs : ℕ → STree (BE E)) (y : ℕ ×ₗ ℕ) :
    y ∈ cutKeys ((fl b (node e c)).subst xs) ↔
      (b = true ∧ y = key ((fl b (node e c)).subst xs)) ∨
        ∃ a ∈ (node e c).labels, y ∈ cutKeys (xs a)
proof:
:= by
  rw [fl_node, subst_node, mem_cutKeys_node]
  simp only [mem_cutKeys_allF_subst, labels_node, Multiset.mem_sum, Finset.mem_univ, true_and]
  refine or_congr Iff.rfl ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · rintro ⟨i, a, ha, hy⟩
    exact ⟨a, ⟨i, ha⟩, hy⟩
  · rintro ⟨a, ⟨i, ha⟩, hy⟩
    exact ⟨i, a, ha, hy⟩

name: Operad.STree.setF_false_allF_subst
statement:
theorem setF_false_allF_subst (x : ℕ ×ₗ ℕ) : ∀ (g : STree E) (xs : ℕ → STree (BE E)),
    setF x false ((allF g).subst xs) = (allF g).subst fun a => setF x false (xs a)
  | leaf _, _ => rfl
  | node e c, xs => by
    rw [allF_node, subst_node, subst_node, setF_node]
    simp only [ite_self]
    congr 1
    funext i
    exact setF_false_allF_subst x (c i) xs

name: Operad.STree.setF_false_fl_subst
statement:
theorem setF_false_fl_subst (x : ℕ ×ₗ ℕ) (b : Bool) (g : STree E) (xs : ℕ → STree (BE E)) :
    setF x false ((fl b g).subst xs) =
      (fl (if key ((fl b g).subst xs) = x then false else b) g).subst
        fun a => setF x false (xs a)
proof:
:= by
  cases g with
  | leaf a => rfl
  | node e c =>
    rw [fl_node, subst_node, setF_node, fl_node, subst_node]
    congr 1
    funext i
    exact setF_false_allF_subst x (c i) xs

name: Operad.STree.forgetM_val
statement: @[simp] lemma forgetM_val (X : SMono (BE E) A) : (forgetM X).1 = forget X.1
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.STree.flM_val
statement: @[simp] lemma flM_val (b : Bool) (g : SMono E A) : (flM b g).1 = fl b g.1
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.STree.setM_val
statement:
@[simp] lemma setM_val (x : ℕ ×ₗ ℕ) (b : Bool) (X : SMono (BE E) A) :
    (setM x b X).1 = setF x b X.1
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.STree.forgetM_flM
statement: @[simp] lemma forgetM_flM (b : Bool) (g : SMono E A) : forgetM (flM b g) = g
proof:
:=
  Subtype.ext (forget_fl b g.1)

name: Operad.STree.forgetM_setM
statement:
@[simp] lemma forgetM_setM (x : ℕ ×ₗ ℕ) (b : Bool) (X : SMono (BE E) A) :
    forgetM (setM x b X) = forgetM X
proof:
:=
  Subtype.ext (forget_setF x b X.1)

name: Operad.STree.IsSCtx.forget
statement:
theorem IsSCtx.forget {B : Finset ℕ} {f : SMono (BE E) A → SMono (BE E) B} (hf : IsSCtx f) :
    ∃ f₀ : SMono E A → SMono E B, IsSCtx f₀ ∧ ∀ X, forgetM (f X) = f₀ (forgetM X)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨T, p, xs, hp, hxs, hf⟩ := hf
  have key : ∀ X : SMono (BE E) A, (forgetM (f X)).1 =
      (STree.forget T).replace p ((forgetM X).1.subst fun a => (xs a).forget) := by
    intro X
    rw [forgetM_val, hf, forget_replace, forget_subst, forgetM_val]
  refine ⟨fun g => forgetM (f (flM false g)), ⟨STree.forget T, p, fun a => (xs a).forget, ?_,
    ⟨fun a ha => (isShuffle_forget _).2 (hxs.shuffle a ha),
      fun a ha b hb => hxs.labels a ha b (by rwa [labels_forget] at hb),
      fun a ha a' ha' h => by simpa only [first_forget] using hxs.mono ha ha' h⟩,
    fun g => by rw [key, forgetM_flM]⟩, fun X => Subtype.ext ?_⟩
  · rw [get?_forget]
    cases h : T.get? p
    · rw [h] at hp
      exact absurd hp (by simp)
    · rfl
  · rw [key, key, forgetM_flM]

name: Operad.STree.Bar.d_d
statement: theorem d_d (v : SMono (BE E) A →₀ K) : d K (d K v) = 0
proof:
:=
  CutComplex.d_d _ _ (fun X k _ => cutKeys_setF_false k X.1) (fun X k _ k' _ => by
    by_cases h : k = k'
    · rw [h]
    · exact Subtype.ext (setF_comm h false false X.1)) v

name: Operad.STree.first_fl_subst_eq
statement:
lemma first_fl_subst_eq {C : Finset ℕ} (m L : SMono E C) (b : Bool) (xs : ℕ → STree (BE E)) :
    ((fl b m.1).subst xs).first = ((fl b L.1).subst xs).first
proof:
:= by
  rw [first_subst ((isShuffle_fl b _).2 m.isShuffle),
    first_subst ((isShuffle_fl b _).2 L.isShuffle), first_fl, first_fl, m.first_eq L]

name: Operad.STree.rootF_fl_subst
statement:
lemma rootF_fl_subst {g : STree E} (hg : ∀ a, g ≠ leaf a) (b : Bool) (xs : ℕ → STree (BE E)) :
    rootF ((fl b g).subst xs) = b
proof:
:= by
  cases g with
  | leaf a => exact absurd rfl (hg a)
  | node e c => rfl

name: Operad.STree.weight_fl_subst_eq
statement: lemma weight_fl_subst_eq : ((fl b m.1).subst xs).weight = ((fl b L.1).subst xs).weight
proof:
:= by
  rw [weight_subst, weight_subst, weight_fl, weight_fl, labels_fl, labels_fl, hw, m.labels_eq,
    L.labels_eq]

name: Operad.STree.key_fl_subst_eq
statement: lemma key_fl_subst_eq : ((fl b m.1).subst xs).key = ((fl b L.1).subst xs).key
proof:
:= by
  rw [key, key, first_fl_subst_eq m L b xs, weight_fl_subst_eq hw b xs]

name: Operad.STree.not_leaf_of_weight
statement: lemma not_leaf_of_weight (hL : ∀ a, L.1 ≠ leaf a) : ∀ a, m.1 ≠ leaf a
proof:
:= by
  intro a ha
  rcases hL' : L.1 with a' | ⟨e, c⟩
  · exact absurd hL' (hL a')
  have := hw
  rw [ha, hL', weight_leaf, weight_node] at this
  omega

name: Operad.STree.cutKeys_fl_subst_eq
statement:
lemma cutKeys_fl_subst_eq (hL : ∀ a, L.1 ≠ leaf a) :
    cutKeys ((fl b m.1).subst xs) = cutKeys ((fl b L.1).subst xs)
proof:
:= by
  have hm := not_leaf_of_weight hw hL
  have hk := key_fl_subst_eq hw b xs
  ext y
  rcases hL' : L.1 with a | ⟨e, c⟩
  · exact absurd hL' (hL a)
  rcases hm' : m.1 with a | ⟨e', c'⟩
  · exact absurd hm' (hm a)
  rw [hL', hm'] at hk
  rw [mem_cutKeys_fl_subst, mem_cutKeys_fl_subst, hk, ← hL', ← hm', m.labels_eq, L.labels_eq]

name: Operad.STree.exists_merge_ctx
statement:
theorem exists_merge_ctx {f : SMono (BE E) C → SMono (BE E) A} (hf : IsSCtx f) (L : SMono E C)
    (hL : ∀ a, L.1 ≠ leaf a) (b : Bool) :
    ∃ (fk : (ℕ ×ₗ ℕ) → SMono (BE E) C → SMono (BE E) A) (b' : ℕ ×ₗ ℕ → Bool),
      (∀ k, IsSCtx (fk k)) ∧ ∀ m : SMono E C, m.1.weight = L.1.weight →
        cuts (f (flM b m)) = cuts (f (flM b L)) ∧
          rootF (f (flM b m)).1 = rootF (f (flM b L)).1 ∧
          (f (flM b m)).1.weight = (f (flM b L)).1.weight ∧
          ∀ k, setM k false (f (flM b m)) = fk k (flM (b' k) m)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨p, xs, hget, hin, hrep⟩ := IsSCtx.normal hf (flM b L)
  set Tt := (f (flM b L)).1 with hTt
  let b' : ℕ ×ₗ ℕ → Bool := fun k => if key ((fl b L.1).subst xs) = k then false else b
  have hget' : ∀ k, (setM k false (f (flM b L))).1.get? p =
      some ((flM (b' k) L).1.subst fun a => setF k false (xs a)) := fun k => by
    rw [setM_val, get?_setF, hget]
    exact congrArg some (setF_false_fl_subst k b L.1 xs)
  have hmono : ∀ k, StrictMonoOn (fun a => (setF k false (xs a)).first) (C : Set ℕ) :=
    fun k a ha a' ha' h => by simpa only [first_setF] using hin.mono ha ha' h
  refine ⟨fun k => ctxOf (setM k false (f (flM b L))) p (flM (b' k) L) _ (hget' k) (hmono k),
    b', fun k => isSCtx_ctxOf _ _ _ _ _ _, fun m hw => ?_⟩
  have hm : (f (flM b m)).1 = Tt.replace p ((fl b m.1).subst xs) := hrep (flM b m)
  have hTt' : Tt = Tt.replace p ((fl b L.1).subst xs) := (replace_self hget).symm
  have hf1 := first_fl_subst_eq m L b xs
  have hw1 := weight_fl_subst_eq hw b xs
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, fun k => ?_⟩
  · show cutKeys (f (flM b m)).1 = cutKeys Tt
    rw [hm]
    conv_rhs => rw [hTt']
    exact cutKeys_replace_congr hget hf1 hw1 rfl rfl (cutKeys_fl_subst_eq hw b xs hL)
  · rw [hm]
    rcases p with _ | ⟨i, p⟩
    · rw [replace_nil, hTt', replace_nil, rootF_fl_subst hL b xs,
        rootF_fl_subst (not_leaf_of_weight hw hL) b xs]
    · rw [rootF_replace _ (List.cons_ne_nil i p), hTt',
        rootF_replace _ (List.cons_ne_nil i p)]
  · rw [hm, weight_replace hget hw1]
  · apply Subtype.ext
    rw [setM_val, ctxOf_val, hm, setF_replace k false hget hf1 hw1, setF_false_fl_subst,
      key_fl_subst_eq hw b xs]
    rfl

name: Operad.Rules.bar_red_inv
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨⟨r, b⟩, f, hf, rfl, rfl⟩ := hv
  obtain ⟨fk, b', -, H⟩ := exists_merge_ctx hf (G.lead r) (hlead r) b
  intro Y hY
  have hY' : Y ∈ (Finsupp.mapDomain (f ∘ flM b) (G.tail r)).support := by
    rw [Finsupp.mapDomain_comp]
    exact hY
  obtain ⟨m, hm, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.1 (Finsupp.mapDomain_support hY')
  obtain ⟨h1, h2, h3, -⟩ := H m (hom r m hm)
  exact ⟨h1, h2, h3⟩

name: Operad.Rules.bar_d_mem_ideal
statement:
theorem Rules.bar_d_mem_ideal (hlead : ∀ r a, (G.lead r).1 ≠ leaf a)
    (hom : ∀ r, ∀ m ∈ (G.tail r).support, m.1.weight = (G.lead r).1.weight)
    {A : Finset ℕ} {v : SMono (BE E) A →₀ K} (hv : v ∈ (G.bar.rw A).ideal) :
    Bar.d K v ∈ (G.bar.rw A).ideal
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [Rules.ideal_eq_span] at hv ⊢
  induction hv using Submodule.span_induction with
  | mem x hx =>
    obtain ⟨⟨r, b⟩, f, hf, rfl⟩ := hx
    obtain ⟨fk, b', hfk, H⟩ := exists_merge_ctx hf (G.lead r) (hlead r) b
    set w := Finsupp.single (G.lead r) (1 : K) - G.tail r with hw
    have hx : Finsupp.mapDomain f (Finsupp.single (G.bar.lead (r, b)) 1 - G.bar.tail (r, b)) =
        Finsupp.mapDomain (f ∘ flM b) w := by
      rw [Finsupp.mapDomain_comp]
      congr 1
      rw [hw]
      have := Finsupp.mapDomain_sub (f := flM b) (v₁ := Finsupp.single (G.lead r) (1 : K))
        (v₂ := G.tail r)
      rw [Finsupp.mapDomain_single] at this
      exact this.symm
    have hwm : ∀ m ∈ w.support, m.1.weight = (G.lead r).1.weight := by
      intro m hm
      rcases Finset.mem_union.1 (Finsupp.support_sub hm) with h | h
      · rw [Finset.mem_singleton.1 (Finsupp.support_single_subset h)]
      · exact hom r m h
    set S := cuts (f (flM b (G.lead r)))
    have hdX : ∀ m ∈ w.support, CutComplex.dX cuts (fun x => setM x false) (f (flM b m)) =
        ∑ k ∈ S, CutComplex.sgn K S k • Finsupp.single (fk k (flM (b' k) m)) (1 : K) := by
      intro m hm
      obtain ⟨h1, -, -, h4⟩ := H m (hwm m hm)
      rw [CutComplex.dX, h1]
      exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun k _ => by rw [h4 k]
    rw [hx, Bar.d, CutComplex.d, Finsupp.linearCombination_mapDomain,
      Finsupp.linearCombination_apply, Finsupp.sum,
      Finset.sum_congr rfl fun m hm => by rw [Function.comp_apply, Function.comp_apply, hdX m hm]]
    simp_rw [Finset.smul_sum]
    rw [Finset.sum_comm]
    refine Submodule.sum_mem _ fun k _ => ?_
    have e : ∑ m ∈ w.support, w m • CutComplex.sgn K S k • Finsupp.single (fk k (flM (b' k) m)) 1 =
        CutComplex.sgn K S k • Finsupp.mapDomain (fk k ∘ flM (b' k)) w := by
      rw [Finsupp.mapDomain, Finsupp.sum, Finset.smul_sum]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun m _ => ?_
      rw [smul_comm, Finsupp.smul_single_one]
      rfl
    have hk : Finsupp.mapDomain (fk k ∘ flM (b' k)) w = Finsupp.mapDomain (fk k)
        (Finsupp.single (G.bar.lead (r, b' k)) 1 - G.bar.tail (r, b' k)) := by
      rw [Finsupp.mapDomain_comp]
      congr 1
      rw [hw]
      have := Finsupp.mapDomain_sub (f := flM (b' k)) (v₁ := Finsupp.single (G.lead r) (1 : K))
        (v₂ := G.tail r)
      rw [Finsupp.mapDomain_single] at this
      exact this
    have key : CutComplex.sgn K S k • Finsupp.mapDomain (fk k ∘ flM (b' k)) w ∈ Submodule.span K
        {x | ∃ r f, O.bar.toCtxOrder.IsCtx f ∧
          x = Finsupp.mapDomain f (Finsupp.single (G.bar.lead r) 1 - G.bar.tail r)} := by
      rw [hk]
      exact Submodule.smul_mem _ _ (Submodule.subset_span ⟨(r, b' k), fk k, hfk k, rfl⟩)
    rw [← e] at key
    exact key
  | zero => rw [map_zero]; exact Submodule.zero_mem _
  | add x y _ _ hx hy => rw [map_add]; exact Submodule.add_mem _ hx hy
  | smul a x _ hx => rw [map_smul]; exact Submodule.smul_mem _ _ hx

name: Operad.MSer.congr
statement:
lemma congr (p : MSer R V W) {m n : ℕ} (h : m = n) {v : Fin m → V} {w : Fin n → V}
    (hv : ∀ (i : ℕ) (him : i < m) (hin : i < n), v ⟨i, him⟩ = w ⟨i, hin⟩) : p m v = p n w
proof:
:= by
  subst h
  congr 1
  funext i
  exact hv i i.2 i.2

name: Operad.MSer.applyComp_update
statement:
lemma applyComp_update (p : MSer R V W) {n : ℕ} (c : Composition n) (j : Fin n) (v : Fin n → V)
    (z : V) :
    applyComp p c (Function.update v j z) =
      Function.update (applyComp p c v) (c.index j)
        (p (c.blocksFun (c.index j))
          (Function.update (v ∘ c.embedding (c.index j)) (c.invEmbedding j) z))
proof:
:= by
  ext k
  by_cases h : k = c.index j
  · rw [h]
    let r : Fin (c.blocksFun (c.index j)) → Fin n := c.embedding (c.index j)
    simp only [Function.update_self]
    change p (c.blocksFun (c.index j)) (Function.update v j z ∘ r) = _
    let j' := c.invEmbedding j
    suffices B : Function.update v j z ∘ r = Function.update (v ∘ r) j' z by rw [B]
    suffices C : Function.update v (r j') z ∘ r = Function.update (v ∘ r) j' z by
      convert C using 3
      exact (c.embedding_comp_inv j).symm
    exact Function.update_comp_eq_of_injective _ (c.embedding _).injective _ _
  · simp only [h, Function.update_of_ne, Ne, not_false_iff]
    let r : Fin (c.blocksFun k) → Fin n := c.embedding k
    change p (c.blocksFun k) (Function.update v j z ∘ r) = p (c.blocksFun k) (v ∘ r)
    suffices B : Function.update v j z ∘ r = v ∘ r by rw [B]
    apply Function.update_comp_eq_of_notMem_range
    rwa [c.mem_range_embedding_iff']

name: Operad.MSer.applyComp_ones
statement:
lemma applyComp_ones (p : MSer R V W) (n : ℕ) :
    applyComp p (Composition.ones n) =
      fun v i => p 1 fun _ => v (Fin.castLE (Composition.length_le _) i)
proof:
:= by
  funext v i
  apply p.congr (Composition.ones_blocksFun _ _)
  intro j hjn hj1
  obtain rfl : j = 0 := by omega
  refine congr_arg v ?_
  rw [Fin.ext_iff, Fin.val_castLE, Composition.ones_embedding, Fin.val_mk]

name: Operad.MSer.compAlong_apply
statement:
@[simp] lemma compAlong_apply (q : MSer R W X) (p : MSer R V W) {n : ℕ} (c : Composition n)
    (v : Fin n → V) : compAlong q p c v = q c.length (applyComp p c v)
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: Operad.MSer.comp_apply
statement:
lemma comp_apply (q : MSer R W X) (p : MSer R V W) (n : ℕ) (v : Fin n → V) :
    comp q p n v = ∑ c : Composition n, q c.length (applyComp p c v)
proof:
:= by
  simp [comp, MultilinearMap.sum_apply]

name: Operad.MSer.comp_assoc
statement:
theorem comp_assoc (r : MSer R X Y) (q : MSer R W X) (p : MSer R V W) :
    comp (comp r q) p = comp r (comp q p)
proof:
:= by
  funext n
  ext v
  let f : (Σ a : Composition n, Composition a.length) → Y := fun c =>
    r c.2.length (applyComp q c.2 (applyComp p c.1 v))
  let g : (Σ c : Composition n, ∀ i : Fin c.length, Composition (c.blocksFun i)) → Y := fun c =>
    r c.1.length fun i : Fin c.1.length =>
      q (c.2 i).length (applyComp p (c.2 i) (v ∘ c.1.embedding i))
  suffices ∑ c, f c = ∑ c, g c by
    simpa +unfoldPartialApp only [comp, MultilinearMap.sum_apply, compAlong_apply,
      Finset.sum_sigma', applyComp, MultilinearMap.map_sum]
  rw [← Equiv.sum_comp (Composition.sigmaEquivSigmaPi n) g]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  rintro ⟨a, b⟩ _
  dsimp [Composition.sigmaEquivSigmaPi]
  apply r.congr (Composition.length_gather a b).symm
  intro i hi1 hi2
  apply q.congr (Composition.length_sigmaCompositionAux a b _).symm
  intro j hj1 hj2
  apply p.congr (Composition.blocksFun_sigmaCompositionAux a b _ _).symm
  intro k hk1 hk2
  refine congr_arg v (Fin.ext ?_)
  dsimp [Composition.embedding]
  rw [← add_assoc, ← Composition.sizeUpTo_sizeUpTo_add _ _ hi1 hj1]
  rfl

name: Operad.MSer.id_apply_one
statement: @[simp] lemma id_apply_one (v : Fin 1 → V) : id R V 1 v = v 0
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: Operad.MSer.id_apply_one'
statement:
lemma id_apply_one' {n : ℕ} (h : n = 1) (v : Fin n → V) :
    id R V n v = v ⟨0, h.symm ▸ zero_lt_one⟩
proof:
:= by
  subst h
  rfl

name: Operad.MSer.id_of_ne_one
statement: lemma id_of_ne_one {n : ℕ} (h : n ≠ 1) : id R V n = 0
proof:
:= by
  match n, h with
  | 0, _ => rfl
  | n + 2, _ => rfl

name: Operad.MSer.comp_id
statement: @[simp] theorem comp_id (p : MSer R V W) : comp p (id R V) = p
proof:
:= by
  funext n
  rw [comp, Finset.sum_eq_single (Composition.ones n)]
  · ext v
    rw [compAlong_apply]
    apply p.congr (Composition.ones_length n)
    intros
    rw [applyComp_ones]
    refine congr_arg v ?_
    rw [Fin.ext_iff, Fin.val_castLE, Fin.val_mk]
  · intro b _ hb
    obtain ⟨k, hk, lt_k⟩ : ∃ (k : ℕ), k ∈ Composition.blocks b ∧ 1 < k :=
      Composition.ne_ones_iff.1 hb
    obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ : ∃ (i : Fin b.blocks.length), b.blocks[i] = k :=
      List.get_of_mem hk
    let j : Fin b.length := ⟨i.val, b.blocks_length ▸ i.prop⟩
    have A : b.blocksFun j ≠ 1 := by
      have : b.blocksFun j = k := hi
      omega
    ext v
    rw [compAlong_apply, MultilinearMap.zero_apply]
    apply MultilinearMap.map_coord_zero _ j
    dsimp [applyComp]
    rw [id_of_ne_one A, MultilinearMap.zero_apply]
  · simp

name: Operad.MSer.id_comp
statement: theorem id_comp (p : MSer R V W) (h : p 0 = 0) : comp (id R W) p = p
proof:
:= by
  funext n
  obtain rfl | n_pos := n.eq_zero_or_pos
  · ext v
    rw [comp_apply, h, MultilinearMap.zero_apply]
    refine Finset.sum_eq_zero fun c _ => ?_
    have : c.length = 0 := Nat.le_zero.mp c.length_le
    rw [id_of_ne_one (by omega), MultilinearMap.zero_apply]
  · rw [comp, Finset.sum_eq_single (Composition.single n n_pos)]
    · ext v
      rw [compAlong_apply, id_apply_one' (Composition.single_length n_pos)]
      dsimp [applyComp]
      refine p.congr rfl fun i him hin => congr_arg v (Fin.ext ?_)
      simp
    · intro b _ hb
      have A : b.length ≠ 1 := by simpa [Composition.eq_single_iff_length] using hb
      ext v
      rw [compAlong_apply, id_of_ne_one A, MultilinearMap.zero_apply,
        MultilinearMap.zero_apply]
    · simp

name: Operad.MSer.embedding_lt_embedding
statement:
lemma embedding_lt_embedding {n : ℕ} (c : Composition n) {i r : Fin c.length} (h : i < r)
    (j : Fin (c.blocksFun i)) (s : Fin (c.blocksFun r)) : c.embedding i j < c.embedding r s
proof:
:= by
  rw [Fin.lt_def, Composition.coe_embedding, Composition.coe_embedding]
  have h1 := c.sizeUpTo_succ' i
  have h2 : c.sizeUpTo ((i : ℕ) + 1) ≤ c.sizeUpTo r := c.monotone_sizeUpTo (Nat.succ_le_of_lt h)
  have := j.isLt
  omega

name: Operad.MSer.hatFn_of_lt
statement:
lemma hatFn_of_lt {n : ℕ} {s t : Fin n} (h : t < s) :
    hatFn εV s t = εV ∘ₗ LinearMap.fst R V V
proof: := if_pos h

name: Operad.MSer.hatFn_self
statement: lemma hatFn_self {n : ℕ} (s : Fin n) : hatFn εV s s = LinearMap.snd R V V
proof:
:= by
  rw [hatFn, if_neg (lt_irrefl s), if_pos rfl]

name: Operad.MSer.hatFn_of_gt
statement: lemma hatFn_of_gt {n : ℕ} {s t : Fin n} (h : s < t) : hatFn εV s t = LinearMap.fst R V V
proof:
:= by
  rw [hatFn, if_neg (not_lt.mpr h.le), if_neg (ne_of_gt h)]

name: Operad.MSer.hat_apply
statement:
lemma hat_apply (f : MSer R V W) (n : ℕ) (v : Fin n → V × V) :
    hat εV f n v = (f n fun t => (v t).1, ∑ s : Fin n, f n fun t => hatFn εV s t (v t))
proof:
:= by
  simp [hat, MultilinearMap.sum_apply]

name: Operad.MSer.hat_comp
statement:
theorem hat_comp {f : MSer R V W} (hf : IsEven εV εW f) (g : MSer R W X) :
    hat εV (comp g f) = comp (hat εW g) (hat εV f)
proof:
:= by
  funext n
  ext v
  · simp only [hat_apply, comp_apply, applyComp, Prod.fst_sum]
    rfl
  · rw [comp_apply (hat εW g) (hat εV f), Prod.snd_sum, hat_apply]
    dsimp only
    simp only [comp_apply]
    rw [Finset.sum_comm]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun c _ => ?_
    rw [hat_apply, ← c.blocksFinEquiv.sum_comp, Fintype.sum_sigma]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun r _ => ?_
    have key : (fun i => hatFn εW r i (applyComp (hat εV f) c v i)) =
        Function.update (fun i => if i < r
            then εW (f (c.blocksFun i) fun j => (v (c.embedding i j)).1)
            else f (c.blocksFun i) fun j => (v (c.embedding i j)).1) r
          (∑ s' : Fin (c.blocksFun r),
            f (c.blocksFun r) fun j => hatFn εV s' j (v (c.embedding r j))) := by
      funext i
      simp only [applyComp, hat_apply]
      rcases lt_trichotomy i r with h | rfl | h
      · rw [Function.update_of_ne (ne_of_lt h), if_pos h, hatFn_of_lt εW h]
        rfl
      · rw [Function.update_self, hatFn_self εW]
        rfl
      · rw [Function.update_of_ne (ne_of_gt h), if_neg (not_lt.mpr h.le), hatFn_of_gt εW h]
        rfl
    rw [key, MultilinearMap.map_update_sum]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun s' _ => ?_
    rw [show c.blocksFinEquiv ⟨r, s'⟩ = c.embedding r s' from rfl]
    congr 1
    funext i
    simp only [applyComp]
    rcases lt_trichotomy i r with h | rfl | h
    · rw [Function.update_of_ne (ne_of_lt h), if_pos h, ← hf]
      congr 1
      funext j
      rw [Function.comp_apply, hatFn_of_lt εV (embedding_lt_embedding c h j s')]
      rfl
    · rw [Function.update_self]
      congr 1
      funext j
      rw [Function.comp_apply]
      rcases lt_trichotomy j s' with h | rfl | h
      · rw [hatFn_of_lt εV h, hatFn_of_lt εV ((c.embedding i).strictMono h)]
      · rw [hatFn_self εV, hatFn_self εV]
      · rw [hatFn_of_gt εV h, hatFn_of_gt εV ((c.embedding i).strictMono h)]
    · rw [Function.update_of_ne (ne_of_gt h), if_neg (not_lt.mpr h.le)]
      congr 1
      funext j
      rw [Function.comp_apply, hatFn_of_gt εV (embedding_lt_embedding c h s' j)]
      rfl

name: Operad.MSer.hat_id
statement: @[simp] theorem hat_id : hat εV (id R V) = id R (V × V)
proof:
:= by
  funext n
  by_cases hn : n = 1
  · subst hn
    ext v
    · simp [hat_apply]
    · simp [hat_apply, hatFn_self]
  · have h1 : hat εV (id R V) n = 0 := by
      ext v
      · simp [hat_apply, id_of_ne_one (V := V) hn]
      · simp [hat_apply, id_of_ne_one (V := V) hn]
    rw [h1, id_of_ne_one hn]

name: Operad.MSer.id_even
statement: lemma id_even : IsEven εV εV (id R V)
proof:
:= fun n v => by
  by_cases hn : n = 1
  · subst hn
    rfl
  · simp [id_of_ne_one hn]

name: Operad.MSer.comp_even
statement:
lemma comp_even {εX : X →ₗ[R] X} {f : MSer R V W} {g : MSer R W X} (hf : IsEven εV εW f)
    (hg : IsEven εW εX g) : IsEven εV εX (comp g f)
proof:
:= fun n v => by
  rw [comp_apply, comp_apply, map_sum]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun c _ => ?_
  rw [← hg]
  congr 1
  funext i
  exact hf _ _

name: Operad.MSer.composition_one
statement: lemma composition_one (c : Composition 1) : c = Composition.ones 1
proof:
:=
  Composition.eq_ones_iff_le_length.2 ((Composition.length_pos_iff c).2 one_pos)

name: Operad.MSer.composition_two
statement:
lemma composition_two (c : Composition 2) :
    c = Composition.ones 2 ∨ c = Composition.single 2 two_pos
proof:
:= by
  have h1 := c.length_le
  have h2 := (Composition.length_pos_iff c).2 (two_pos : 0 < 2)
  rcases (show c.length = 1 ∨ c.length = 2 by omega) with h | h
  · exact Or.inr ((Composition.eq_single_iff_length two_pos).2 h)
  · exact Or.inl (Composition.eq_ones_iff_length.2 h)

name: Operad.MSer.comp_apply_one
statement:
lemma comp_apply_one (q : MSer R W X) (p : MSer R V W) (v : Fin 1 → V) :
    comp q p 1 v = q 1 ![p 1 v]
proof:
:= by
  rw [comp_apply, Fintype.sum_eq_single (Composition.ones 1)
    (fun c hc => absurd (composition_one c) hc)]
  apply q.congr (Composition.ones_length 1)
  intro i hi1 hi2
  obtain rfl : i = 0 := by omega
  rw [applyComp_ones]
  show p 1 _ = p 1 _
  congr 1
  funext t
  fin_cases t
  exact congr_arg v (Fin.ext rfl)

name: Operad.MSer.comp_apply_two
statement:
lemma comp_apply_two (q : MSer R W X) (p : MSer R V W) (v : Fin 2 → V) :
    comp q p 2 v = q 2 ![p 1 ![v 0], p 1 ![v 1]] + q 1 ![p 2 v]
proof:
:= by
  have hne : Composition.ones 2 ≠ Composition.single 2 two_pos := fun h => by
    have := congrArg Composition.length h
    simp at this
  rw [comp_apply, Fintype.sum_eq_add (Composition.ones 2) (Composition.single 2 two_pos) hne
    (fun c ⟨h1, h2⟩ => by rcases composition_two c with h | h <;> contradiction)]
  congr 1
  · apply q.congr (Composition.ones_length 2)
    intro i hi1 hi2
    rw [applyComp_ones]
    show p 1 _ = _
    obtain rfl | rfl : i = 0 ∨ i = 1 := by omega
    · show p 1 _ = p 1 _
      congr 1
      funext t
      fin_cases t
      exact congr_arg v (Fin.ext (by simp))
    · show p 1 _ = p 1 _
      congr 1
      funext t
      fin_cases t
      exact congr_arg v (Fin.ext (by simp))
  · apply q.congr (Composition.single_length two_pos)
    intro i hi1 hi2
    obtain rfl : i = 0 := by omega
    show p _ _ = p 2 v
    apply p.congr (Composition.single_blocksFun two_pos _)
    intro j hj1 hj2
    exact congr_arg v (Fin.ext (by rw [Composition.coe_embedding]; simp))

name: Operad.MSer.hat_apply_one_snd
statement:
lemma hat_apply_one_snd (εV : V →ₗ[R] V) (f : MSer R V W) (w : Fin 1 → V × V) :
    (hat εV f 1 w).2 = f 1 ![(w 0).2]
proof:
:= by
  rw [hat_apply, Fin.sum_univ_one]
  dsimp only
  congr 1
  funext t
  fin_cases t
  simp [hatFn_self]

name: Operad.MSer.hat_apply_two_snd
statement:
lemma hat_apply_two_snd (εV : V →ₗ[R] V) (f : MSer R V W) (w : Fin 2 → V × V) :
    (hat εV f 2 w).2 = f 2 ![(w 0).2, (w 1).1] + f 2 ![εV (w 0).1, (w 1).2]
proof:
:= by
  rw [hat_apply, Fin.sum_univ_two]
  dsimp only
  congr 1
  · congr 1
    funext t
    fin_cases t
    · simp [hatFn_self]
    · simp [hatFn_of_gt εV (show (0 : Fin 2) < 1 by decide)]
  · congr 1
    funext t
    fin_cases t
    · simp [hatFn_of_lt εV (show (0 : Fin 2) < 1 by decide)]
    · simp [hatFn_self]

name: Operad.MSer.lin_apply_one
statement: @[simp] lemma lin_apply_one (φ : V →ₗ[R] W) (v : Fin 1 → V) : lin φ 1 v = φ (v 0)
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: Operad.MSer.lin_apply_one'
statement:
lemma lin_apply_one' (φ : V →ₗ[R] W) {n : ℕ} (h : n = 1) (v : Fin n → V) :
    lin φ n v = φ (v ⟨0, h.symm ▸ zero_lt_one⟩)
proof:
:= by
  subst h
  rfl

name: Operad.MSer.lin_of_ne_one
statement: lemma lin_of_ne_one (φ : V →ₗ[R] W) {n : ℕ} (h : n ≠ 1) : lin φ n = 0
proof:
:= by
  match n, h with
  | 0, _ => rfl
  | n + 2, _ => rfl

name: Operad.MSer.comp_lin_right
statement:
theorem comp_lin_right (p : MSer R W X) (φ : V →ₗ[R] W) :
    comp p (lin φ) = fun n => (p n).compLinearMap fun _ => φ
proof:
:= by
  funext n
  rw [comp, Finset.sum_eq_single (Composition.ones n)]
  · ext v
    rw [compAlong_apply, MultilinearMap.compLinearMap_apply]
    apply p.congr (Composition.ones_length n)
    intros
    rw [applyComp_ones]
    refine congr_arg φ (congr_arg v ?_)
    rw [Fin.ext_iff, Fin.val_castLE, Fin.val_mk]
  · intro b _ hb
    obtain ⟨k, hk, lt_k⟩ : ∃ (k : ℕ), k ∈ Composition.blocks b ∧ 1 < k :=
      Composition.ne_ones_iff.1 hb
    obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ : ∃ (i : Fin b.blocks.length), b.blocks[i] = k :=
      List.get_of_mem hk
