name: Operad.FreeBin.jacobi_mem_uPerp
statement: lemma jacobi_mem_uPerp : BinRel.jacobi K () ∈ uPerp K
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_uPerp, show BinRel.jacobi K () = cL K 1 + cL K (perm3 1 2 0) + cL K (perm3 2 0 1)
    from rfl]
  intro τ
  rcases perm3_enum τ with rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl <;>
    simp (config := { decide := true }) [uDiff, map_add, map_sub, map_mono3, act3, pair3_mono3,
      sign3, sign_perm3_201, sign_perm3_120]

name: Operad.FreeBin.lieRel3_le_uPerp
statement: lemma lieRel3_le_uPerp : lieRel3 K ≤ uPerp K
proof:
:= by
  refine sup_le (ideal3Of_le K (fun τ x hx => uPerp_map K τ hx) fun a ha g σ => ?_) ?_
  · rw [Set.mem_singleton_iff] at ha
    subst ha
    cases g
    exact ⟨antisymm_left0_mem K σ, antisymm_left1_mem K σ, antisymm_right0_mem K σ,
      antisymm_right1_mem K σ⟩
  · rw [Submodule.span_le]
    rintro _ ⟨τ, y, hy, rfl⟩
    rw [Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hy
    subst hy
    exact uPerp_map K τ (jacobi_mem_uPerp K)

name: Operad.FreeBin.uDiff_mem_dualRel
statement: lemma uDiff_mem_dualRel : uDiff K ∈ dualRel23 K {BinRel.antisymm K ()} {BinRel.jacobi K ()}
proof:
:= by
  have hle : Submodule.span K (orbit3 K ((lieRel3 K : Submodule K _) :
      Set (FreeBin K Unit (Fin 3)))) ≤ uPerp K := by
    rw [Submodule.span_le]
    rintro _ ⟨τ, y, hy, rfl⟩
    exact uPerp_map K τ (lieRel3_le_uPerp K hy)
  rw [dualRel23, dualRel, LinearMap.BilinForm.mem_orthogonal_iff]
  intro n hn
  have := (mem_uPerp K).1 (hle hn) 1
  rwa [show (1 : Equiv.Perm (Fin 3)) = Equiv.refl _ from rfl, SymOperad.map_refl] at this

name: Operad.FreeBin.dualRel_lie_le
statement: lemma dualRel_lie_le : dualRel23 K {BinRel.antisymm K ()} {BinRel.jacobi K ()} ≤ comRel3 K
proof:
:= by
  intro w hw
  rw [comRel3_eq_ker, LinearMap.mem_ker, ← pair3_asym3, pair3_comm]
  rw [dualRel23, dualRel, LinearMap.BilinForm.mem_orthogonal_iff] at hw
  refine hw _ (Submodule.subset_span ⟨1, _, asym3_mem_lieRel3 K, ?_⟩)
  rw [show (1 : Equiv.Perm (Fin 3)) = Equiv.refl _ from rfl, SymOperad.map_refl]

name: Operad.FreeBin.four_assoc
statement:
lemma four_assoc : (4 : K) • BinRel.assoc K () = uDiff K
    + ((2 : K) • (cL K 1 - cL K (perm3 1 0 2)) + (cL K 1 - cR K (perm3 2 0 1))
      + (cL K (perm3 1 0 2) - cR K (perm3 2 1 0)) + (2 : K) • (cL K (perm3 1 2 0) - cR K 1)
      - (cL K (perm3 1 2 0) - cL K (perm3 2 1 0)) - (cR K 1 - cR K (perm3 0 2 1)))
proof:
:= by
  rw [show BinRel.assoc K () = cL K 1 - cR K 1 from rfl, uDiff]
  module

name: Operad.FreeBin.BinPres.dual23_lie_eq
statement:
theorem BinPres.dual23_lie_eq (h2 : (2 : K) ≠ 0) :
    SymOperadIdeal.span K (rel23 (twist2 K '' {BinRel.antisymm K ()})
        (dualRel23 K {BinRel.antisymm K ()} {BinRel.jacobi K ()} :
          Set (FreeBin K Unit (Fin 3))))
      = SymOperadIdeal.span K (rel23 {BinRel.comm K ()} {BinRel.assoc K ()})
proof:
:= by
  have h2set : twist2 K '' {BinRel.antisymm K ()} = {BinRel.comm K ()} := by
    rw [Set.image_singleton, twist2_antisymm]
  rw [h2set]
  have hself : ∀ x ∈ ({BinRel.comm K ()} : Set (FreeBin K Unit (Fin 2))),
      x ∈ Submodule.span K (orbit2 K {BinRel.comm K ()}) := fun x hx =>
    Submodule.subset_span ⟨1, x, hx, by
      rw [show (1 : Equiv.Perm (Fin 2)) = Equiv.refl _ from rfl, SymOperad.map_refl]⟩
  apply le_antisymm
  · exact span_le_23 hself fun x hx => dualRel_lie_le K hx
  · refine span_le_23 hself fun x hx => ?_
    rw [Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hx
    subst hx
    have h4 : (4 : K) ≠ 0 := by
      rw [show (4 : K) = 2 * 2 by norm_num]
      exact mul_ne_zero h2 h2
    have hc : (2 : K) • (cL K 1 - cL K (perm3 1 0 2)) + (cL K 1 - cR K (perm3 2 0 1))
        + (cL K (perm3 1 0 2) - cR K (perm3 2 1 0)) + (2 : K) • (cL K (perm3 1 2 0) - cR K 1)
        - (cL K (perm3 1 2 0) - cL K (perm3 2 1 0)) - (cR K 1 - cR K (perm3 0 2 1))
          ∈ ideal3Of K {BinRel.comm K ()} := by
      have hP1 := mem_ideal_P K 1
      have hPt := mem_ideal_P K (perm3 1 0 2)
      have hPk := mem_ideal_P K (perm3 1 2 0)
      have hQ1 := mem_ideal_Q K 1
      have hQk := mem_ideal_Q K (perm3 1 2 0)
      rw [one_mul] at hP1 hQ1
      rw [show perm3 1 0 2 * perm3 2 0 1 = perm3 2 1 0 by decide] at hPt
      rw [show perm3 1 2 0 * perm3 2 0 1 = 1 by decide] at hPk
      rw [show perm3 1 2 0 * perm3 1 0 2 = perm3 2 1 0 by decide] at hQk
      exact sub_mem (sub_mem (add_mem (add_mem (add_mem (Submodule.smul_mem _ _ hQ1) hP1) hPt)
        (Submodule.smul_mem _ _ hPk)) hQk) (mem_ideal_S K)
    have hu : uDiff K ∈ Submodule.span K (orbit3 K ((dualRel23 K {BinRel.antisymm K ()}
        {BinRel.jacobi K ()} : Submodule K _) : Set (FreeBin K Unit (Fin 3)))) :=
      Submodule.subset_span ⟨1, _, uDiff_mem_dualRel K, by
        rw [show (1 : Equiv.Perm (Fin 3)) = Equiv.refl _ from rfl, SymOperad.map_refl]⟩
    have := congrArg (fun x => (4 : K)⁻¹ • x) (four_assoc K)
    simp only [inv_smul_smul₀ h4] at this
    rw [this]
    exact Submodule.smul_mem _ _ (add_mem (Submodule.mem_sup_right hu)
      (Submodule.mem_sup_left hc))

name: Operad.FreeBin.BinCom.dual
statement:
theorem BinCom.dual (K : Type u) [Field K] (h2 : (2 : K) ≠ 0) :
    BinPres.dual23 K {BinRel.comm K ()} {BinRel.assoc K ()} = Lie K
proof:
:=
  congrArg SymOperadIdeal.Quot (BinPres.dual23_com_eq K h2)

name: Operad.FreeBin.Lie.dual
statement:
theorem Lie.dual (K : Type u) [Field K] (h2 : (2 : K) ≠ 0) :
    BinPres.dual23 K {BinRel.antisymm K ()} {BinRel.jacobi K ()} = BinCom K
proof:
:=
  congrArg SymOperadIdeal.Quot (BinPres.dual23_lie_eq K h2)

name: Operad.Composite.mk_rel
statement:
lemma mk_rel {x : CompGen M N S →₀ R} (hx : CompRel R M N S x) :
    (Submodule.Quotient.mk x : (CompGen M N S →₀ R) ⧸ Submodule.span R {x | CompRel R M N S x})
      = 0
proof:
:=
  (Submodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero _).2 (Submodule.subset_span hx)

name: Operad.Composite.mk_add_m
statement:
lemma mk_add_m (g : CompGen M N S) (m' : M g.A) :
    mk R { g with m := g.m + m' } = mk R g + mk R { g with m := m' }
proof:
:= by
  have h := mk_rel (CompRel.add_m (R := R) g m')
  rw [Submodule.Quotient.mk_sub, Submodule.Quotient.mk_sub, sub_sub, sub_eq_zero] at h
  exact h

name: Operad.Composite.mk_smul_m
statement: lemma mk_smul_m (g : CompGen M N S) (c : R) : mk R { g with m := c • g.m } = c • mk R g
proof:
:= by
  have h := mk_rel (CompRel.smul_m g c)
  rw [Submodule.Quotient.mk_sub, Submodule.Quotient.mk_smul, sub_eq_zero] at h
  exact h

name: Operad.Composite.mk_add_y
proof:
:= by
  have h := mk_rel (CompRel.add_y (R := R) g a z z')
  rw [Submodule.Quotient.mk_sub, Submodule.Quotient.mk_sub, sub_sub, sub_eq_zero] at h
  exact h

name: Operad.Composite.mk_smul_y
statement:
lemma mk_smul_y (g : CompGen M N S) (a : g.A) (c : R) (z : N (g.B a)) :
    mk R { g with y := update g.y a (c • z) } = c • mk R { g with y := update g.y a z }
proof:
:= by
  have h := mk_rel (CompRel.smul_y g a c z)
  rw [Submodule.Quotient.mk_sub, Submodule.Quotient.mk_smul, sub_eq_zero] at h
  exact h

name: Operad.Composite.mk_outer
statement:
lemma mk_outer (g : CompGen M N S) {A : Type} [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] (σ : A ≃ g.A)
    (m : M A) :
    mk R { g with m := SymSpecies.map (R := R) σ m }
      = mk R ⟨A, fun a => g.B (σ a), m, fun a => g.y (σ a),
          (Equiv.sigmaCongrLeft σ).trans g.e⟩
proof:
:= by
  have h := mk_rel (CompRel.outer (R := R) g σ m)
  rw [Submodule.Quotient.mk_sub, sub_eq_zero] at h
  exact h

name: Operad.Composite.mk_inner
statement:
lemma mk_inner (g : CompGen M N S) {B : g.A → Type} [∀ a, Fintype (B a)]
    [∀ a, DecidableEq (B a)] (τ : ∀ a, g.B a ≃ B a) :
    mk R ⟨g.A, B, g.m, fun a => SymSpecies.map (R := R) (τ a) (g.y a),
        (Equiv.sigmaCongrRight τ).symm.trans g.e⟩ = mk R g
proof:
:= by
  have h := mk_rel (CompRel.inner (R := R) g τ)
  rw [Submodule.Quotient.mk_sub, sub_eq_zero] at h
  exact h

name: Operad.Composite.mkM_apply
statement: lemma mkM_apply (g : CompGen M N S) (m : M g.A) : mkM g m = mk R { g with m := m }
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.Composite.mkY_apply
statement: lemma mkY_apply (g : CompGen M N S) (y : ∀ a, N (g.B a)) : mkY g y = mk R { g with y := y }
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: Operad.Composite.mk_congr_e
statement:
lemma mk_congr_e (g : CompGen M N S) (e' : (Σ a, g.B a) ≃ S) (h : ∀ p, g.e p = e' p) :
    mk R g = mk R { g with e := e' }
proof:
:= by
  rw [show e' = g.e from (Equiv.ext h).symm]

name: Operad.Finsupp.lift_single'
statement:
lemma Finsupp.lift_single' {X W : Type*} [AddCommGroup W] [Module R W] (F : X → W) (x : X)
    (c : R) : Finsupp.lift W R X F (Finsupp.single x c) = c • F x
proof:
:= by
  rw [Finsupp.lift_apply, Finsupp.sum_single_index]
  rw [zero_smul]

name: Operad.Composite.lift_mk
statement:
@[simp] lemma lift_mk (F : CompGen M N S → W) (hF : CompGen.Respects R F) (g : CompGen M N S) :
    lift F hF (mk R g) = F g
proof:
:= by
  show Submodule.liftQ _ _ _ (Submodule.Quotient.mk (Finsupp.single g 1)) = F g
  rw [Submodule.liftQ_apply, Finsupp.lift_single', one_smul]

name: Operad.Composite.hom_ext
statement: theorem hom_ext {φ ψ : Composite R M N S →ₗ[R] W} (h : ∀ g, φ (mk R g) = ψ (mk R g)) : φ = ψ
proof:
:=
  Submodule.linearMap_qext _ (Finsupp.lhom_ext' fun g => LinearMap.ext_ring (h g))

name: Operad.Composite.induction_on
statement:
@[elab_as_elim]
theorem induction_on [Fintype S] [DecidableEq S] {P : Composite R M N S → Prop}
    (z : Composite R M N S) (h0 : P 0) (hadd : ∀ x y, P x → P y → P (x + y))
    (hsmul : ∀ (c : R) x, P x → P (c • x)) (hmk : ∀ g, P (mk R g)) : P z
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := Submodule.Quotient.mk_surjective
    (Submodule.span R {x | CompRel R M N S x}) z
  induction x using Finsupp.induction_linear with
  | zero => exact h0
  | add x y hx hy => exact hadd _ _ hx hy
  | single g c =>
    rw [← mul_one c, ← smul_eq_mul, ← Finsupp.smul_single, Submodule.Quotient.mk_smul]
    exact hsmul c _ (hmk g)

name: Operad.Composite.map_mk
statement:
@[simp] lemma map_mk {S' : Type} [Fintype S'] [DecidableEq S'] (f : S ≃ S') (g : CompGen M N S) :
    map f (mk R g) = mk R (g.relabel f)
proof:
:=
  lift_mk _ _ g

name: Operad.Composite.symSpecies_map_mk
statement:
lemma symSpecies_map_mk {S' : Type} [Fintype S'] [DecidableEq S'] (f : S ≃ S')
    (g : CompGen M N S) :
    SymSpecies.map (R := R) (V := Composite R M N) f (mk R g) = mk R (g.relabel f)
proof:
:=
  map_mk f g

name: Operad.Composite.app_update
statement:
lemma app_update (ψ : SymSpeciesHom R N N') {S : Type} (g : CompGen M N S) (a : g.A)
    (z : N (g.B a)) :
    (fun a' => ψ.app _ (update g.y a z a')) = update (fun a' => ψ.app _ (g.y a')) a (ψ.app _ z)
proof:
:=
  funext fun a' => apply_update (fun a' => ⇑(ψ.app (g.B a'))) g.y a z a'

name: Operad.Composite.map₂App_mk
proof:
:=
  lift_mk _ _ g

name: Operad.Composite.map₂_mk
proof:
:=
  map₂App_mk φ ψ g

name: Operad.UnitSp.map_apply
statement:
lemma UnitSp.map_apply {S S' : Type} [Fintype S] [DecidableEq S] [Fintype S'] [DecidableEq S']
    (f : S ≃ S') (x : UnitSp R S) :
    SymSpecies.map (R := R) (V := UnitSp R) f x = Finsupp.mapDomain (fun u => u.trans f) x
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: Operad.UnitSp.single_eq_map
statement:
lemma UnitSp.single_eq_map {S : Type} [Fintype S] [DecidableEq S] (u : Unit ≃ S) (c : R) :
    (Finsupp.single u c : UnitSp R S)
      = SymSpecies.map (R := R) (V := UnitSp R) u (Finsupp.single (Equiv.refl Unit) c)
proof:
:= by
  rw [UnitSp.map_apply, Finsupp.mapDomain_single]
  rfl

name: Operad.unitSigma_apply
statement:
@[simp] lemma unitSigma_apply {A : Type} (u : Unit ≃ A) (B : A → Type) (b : B (u ())) :
    unitSigma u B b = ⟨u (), b⟩
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: Operad.eq_unit_apply
statement: lemma eq_unit_apply {A : Type} (u : Unit ≃ A) (a : A) : a = u ()
proof:
:=
  (u.apply_symm_apply a).symm.trans (congrArg u (Subsingleton.elim _ _))

name: Operad.Finsupp.lift_add_fun
proof:
:= by
  rw [← LinearMap.add_apply, ← map_add, show f = f₁ + f₂ from funext h]

name: Operad.Finsupp.lift_smul_fun
statement:
lemma Finsupp.lift_smul_fun {X W : Type*} [AddCommGroup W] [Module R W] {f f₁ : X → W} (c : R)
    (h : ∀ x, f x = c • f₁ x) (p : X →₀ R) :
    Finsupp.lift W R X f p = c • Finsupp.lift W R X f₁ p
proof:
:= by
  rw [Finsupp.lift_apply, Finsupp.lift_apply, Finsupp.smul_sum]
  exact Finsupp.sum_congr fun x _ => by rw [h, smul_comm]

name: Operad.Finsupp.lift_mapDomain'
statement:
lemma Finsupp.lift_mapDomain' {X Y W : Type*} [AddCommGroup W] [Module R W] (f : Y → W)
    (h : X → Y) (p : X →₀ R) :
    Finsupp.lift W R Y f (Finsupp.mapDomain h p) = Finsupp.lift W R X (fun x => f (h x)) p
proof:
:= by
  rw [Finsupp.lift_apply, Finsupp.lift_apply, Finsupp.sum_mapDomain_index]
  · exact fun _ => zero_smul R _
  · exact fun _ _ _ => add_smul _ _ _

name: Operad.Finsupp.linear_lift
statement:
lemma Finsupp.linear_lift {X W W' : Type*} [AddCommGroup W] [Module R W] [AddCommGroup W']
    [Module R W'] (φ : W →ₗ[R] W') (f : X → W) (p : X →₀ R) :
    φ (Finsupp.lift W R X f p) = Finsupp.lift W' R X (fun x => φ (f x)) p
proof:
:= by
  rw [Finsupp.lift_apply, Finsupp.lift_apply, map_finsuppSum]
  simp only [map_smul]

name: Operad.Finsupp.lift_congr_fun
proof:
:= by
  rw [funext h]

name: Operad.map_congr_equiv
statement:
lemma map_congr_equiv {A B : Type} [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] [Fintype B] [DecidableEq B]
    {e e' : A ≃ B} (h : ∀ a, e a = e' a) (x : M A) :
    SymSpecies.map (R := R) e x = SymSpecies.map (R := R) e' x
proof:
:= by
  rw [Equiv.ext h]

name: Operad.SymSpecies.map_symm_map'
statement:
lemma SymSpecies.map_symm_map' {V : (A : Type) → [Fintype A] → [DecidableEq A] → Type*}
    [∀ (A : Type) [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A], AddCommGroup (V A)]
    [∀ (A : Type) [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A], Module R (V A)] [SymSpecies R V]
    {A B : Type} [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] [Fintype B] [DecidableEq B] (e : A ≃ B) (x : V A) :
    SymSpecies.map (R := R) e.symm (SymSpecies.map (R := R) e x) = x
proof:
:= by
  rw [← SymSpecies.map_trans, Equiv.self_trans_symm, SymSpecies.map_refl]

name: Operad.Composite.leftUnitorFun_respects
statement:
lemma leftUnitorFun_respects : CompGen.Respects R (leftUnitorFun (R := R) (M := M) (S := S)) where
  add_m g m'
proof:
:= map_add _ _ _
  smul_m g c := map_smul _ _ _
  add_y g a z z' := Finsupp.lift_add_fun (fun u => by
    obtain rfl := eq_unit_apply u a
    simp only [update_self, map_add]) g.m
  smul_y g a c z := Finsupp.lift_smul_fun c (fun u => by
    obtain rfl := eq_unit_apply u a
    simp only [update_self, map_smul]) g.m
  outer := @fun g _ _ _ σ m => by
    show Finsupp.lift (M S) R _ _ (Finsupp.mapDomain _ m) = Finsupp.lift (M S) R _ _ m
    rw [Finsupp.lift_mapDomain']
    refine Finsupp.lift_congr_fun (fun u => ?_) m
    apply map_congr_equiv
    intro b
    rfl
  inner := @fun g B _ _ τ => by
    show Finsupp.lift (M S) R _ _ g.m = Finsupp.lift (M S) R _ _ g.m
    refine Finsupp.lift_congr_fun (fun u => ?_) g.m
    rw [← SymSpecies.map_trans]
    apply map_congr_equiv
    intro b
    simp only [Equiv.trans_apply, unitSigma_apply]
    congr 1
    rw [Equiv.symm_apply_eq]
    rfl

name: Operad.Composite.leftUnitorApp_mk
statement:
lemma leftUnitorApp_mk (g : CompGen (UnitSp R) M S) :
    leftUnitorApp S (mk R g) = leftUnitorFun g
proof:
:=
  lift_mk _ _ g

name: Operad.Composite.leftUnitorInvApp_apply
statement: lemma leftUnitorInvApp_apply (x : M S) : leftUnitorInvApp (R := R) S x = mk R (unitGen x)
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.Composite.leftUnitorApp_inv
statement: theorem leftUnitorApp_inv (x : M S) : leftUnitorApp S (leftUnitorInvApp (R := R) S x) = x
proof:
:= by
  rw [leftUnitorInvApp_apply, leftUnitorApp_mk, leftUnitorFun]
  show Finsupp.lift (M S) R (Unit ≃ Unit) _ (Finsupp.single (Equiv.refl Unit) 1) = x
  rw [Finsupp.lift_single', one_smul]
  refine (map_congr_equiv ?_ x).trans (SymSpecies.map_refl (R := R) (V := M) x)
  intro b
  rfl

name: Operad.Composite.leftUnitorInvApp_leftUnitorApp
statement:
theorem leftUnitorInvApp_leftUnitorApp (z : Composite R (UnitSp R) M S) :
    leftUnitorInvApp S (leftUnitorApp S z) = z
proof:
:= by
  have h : (leftUnitorInvApp (R := R) S).comp (leftUnitorApp (M := M) S) = LinearMap.id :=
    hom_ext fun g => by
      rw [LinearMap.comp_apply, leftUnitorApp_mk g, LinearMap.id_apply, leftUnitorFun,
        Finsupp.linear_lift]
      suffices H : Finsupp.lift (Composite R (UnitSp R) M S) R (Unit ≃ g.A)
          (fun u => leftUnitorInvApp S
          (SymSpecies.map (R := R) ((unitSigma u g.B).trans g.e) (g.y (u ())))) = mkM g by
        rw [H]
        rfl
      refine Finsupp.lhom_ext' fun u => LinearMap.ext_ring ?_
      rw [LinearMap.comp_apply, Finsupp.lsingle_apply, Finsupp.lift_single', one_smul,
        LinearMap.comp_apply, Finsupp.lsingle_apply, mkM_apply]
      have hE : (Equiv.sigmaCongrRight fun _ : Unit => (unitSigma u g.B).trans g.e).symm.trans
          ((Equiv.sigmaCongrLeft u).trans g.e) = Equiv.uniqueSigma fun _ : Unit => S := by
        ext ⟨⟨⟩, s⟩
        show g.e ⟨u (), (unitSigma u g.B).symm (g.e.symm s)⟩ = s
        rw [show (⟨u (), (unitSigma u g.B).symm (g.e.symm s)⟩ : Σ a, g.B a)
          = unitSigma u g.B ((unitSigma u g.B).symm (g.e.symm s)) from rfl,
          Equiv.apply_symm_apply, Equiv.apply_symm_apply]
      calc leftUnitorInvApp S (SymSpecies.map (R := R) ((unitSigma u g.B).trans g.e) (g.y (u ())))
          = mk R ⟨Unit, fun _ => S, Finsupp.single (Equiv.refl Unit) 1,
              fun x => SymSpecies.map (R := R) ((unitSigma u g.B).trans g.e) (g.y (u x)),
              (Equiv.sigmaCongrRight fun _ : Unit => (unitSigma u g.B).trans g.e).symm.trans
                ((Equiv.sigmaCongrLeft u).trans g.e)⟩ := by
            rw [leftUnitorInvApp_apply, hE]
            rfl
        _ = mk R ⟨Unit, fun x => g.B (u x), Finsupp.single (Equiv.refl Unit) 1,
              fun x => g.y (u x), (Equiv.sigmaCongrLeft u).trans g.e⟩ :=
            mk_inner (R := R) (M := UnitSp R) (N := M) (B := fun _ => S) ⟨Unit, fun x => g.B (u x),
              Finsupp.single (Equiv.refl Unit) (1 : R), fun x => g.y (u x),
              (Equiv.sigmaCongrLeft u).trans g.e⟩ fun _ => (unitSigma u g.B).trans g.e
        _ = mk R { g with m := Finsupp.single u (1 : R) } := by
            rw [UnitSp.single_eq_map u, mk_outer]
  exact LinearMap.congr_fun h z

name: Operad.Composite.unitsEquiv_apply
statement:
@[simp] lemma unitsEquiv_apply {A : Type} {B : A → Type} (u : ∀ a, Unit ≃ B a) (a : A) :
    unitsEquiv u a = ⟨a, u a ()⟩
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: Operad.Composite.prod_update_apply
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Finset.mul_prod_erase Finset.univ _ (Finset.mem_univ a), update_self]
  congr 1
  refine Finset.prod_congr rfl fun a' ha' => ?_
  rw [update_of_ne (Finset.ne_of_mem_erase ha')]

name: Operad.Composite.rightUnitorFun_respects
statement:
lemma rightUnitorFun_respects :
    CompGen.Respects R (rightUnitorFun (R := R) (M := M) (S := S)) where
  add_m g m'
proof:
:= by
    simp only [rightUnitorFun, map_add, smul_add, Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  smul_m g c := by
    simp only [rightUnitorFun, map_smul, Finset.smul_sum]
    exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun u _ => smul_comm _ _ _
  add_y g a z z' := by
    simp only [rightUnitorFun, prod_update_apply, Finsupp.add_apply, add_mul, add_smul,
      Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  smul_y g a c z := by
    simp only [rightUnitorFun, prod_update_apply, Finsupp.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, mul_assoc,
      mul_smul, Finset.smul_sum]
  outer := @fun g A _ _ σ m => by
    simp only [rightUnitorFun]
    rw [← (Equiv.piCongrLeft (fun a => Unit ≃ g.B a) σ).sum_comp]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun u _ => ?_
    rw [← Equiv.prod_comp σ, ← SymSpecies.map_trans]
    congr 1
    · exact Finset.prod_congr rfl fun a _ => by rw [Equiv.piCongrLeft_apply_apply]
    · apply map_congr_equiv
      intro a
      show g.e ⟨σ a, (Equiv.piCongrLeft (fun a => Unit ≃ g.B a) σ u) (σ a) ()⟩
        = g.e ⟨σ a, u a ()⟩
      rw [Equiv.piCongrLeft_apply_apply]
  inner := @fun g B _ _ τ => by
    simp only [rightUnitorFun]
    let T : (∀ a, Unit ≃ g.B a) ≃ ∀ a, Unit ≃ B a :=
      Equiv.piCongrRight fun a => (Equiv.refl Unit).equivCongr (τ a)
    rw [← T.sum_comp]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun u _ => ?_
    congr 1
    · refine Finset.prod_congr rfl fun a _ => ?_
      show Finsupp.mapDomain (fun v => v.trans (τ a)) (g.y a) ((u a).trans (τ a)) = g.y a (u a)
      exact Finsupp.mapDomain_apply (fun v w h => Equiv.ext fun x =>
        (τ a).injective (Equiv.congr_fun h x)) _ _
    · apply map_congr_equiv
      intro a
      show g.e ((Equiv.sigmaCongrRight τ).symm ⟨a, τ a (u a ())⟩) = g.e ⟨a, u a ()⟩
      congr 1
      rw [Equiv.symm_apply_eq]
      rfl

name: Operad.Composite.rightUnitorApp_mk
statement:
lemma rightUnitorApp_mk (g : CompGen M (UnitSp R) S) :
    rightUnitorApp S (mk R g) = rightUnitorFun g
proof:
:=
  lift_mk _ _ g

name: Operad.Composite.rightUnitorInvApp_apply
statement:
lemma rightUnitorInvApp_apply (x : M S) :
    rightUnitorInvApp (R := R) S x = mk R (unitsGen x)
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: Operad.Composite.rightUnitorApp_inv
statement:
theorem rightUnitorApp_inv (x : M S) :
    rightUnitorApp S (rightUnitorInvApp (R := R) S x) = x
proof:
:= by
  rw [rightUnitorInvApp_apply, rightUnitorApp_mk, rightUnitorFun]
  show ∑ u : (S → Unit ≃ Unit), (∏ s, (Finsupp.single (Equiv.refl Unit) (1 : R)) (u s)) •
    SymSpecies.map (R := R) ((unitsEquiv u).trans (Equiv.sigmaPUnit S)) x = x
  rw [Fintype.sum_eq_single (fun _ => Equiv.refl Unit) fun u hu =>
      absurd (funext fun _ => Subsingleton.elim _ _) hu]
  simp only [Finsupp.single_eq_same, Finset.prod_const_one, one_smul]
  refine (map_congr_equiv ?_ x).trans (SymSpecies.map_refl (R := R) (V := M) x)
  intro b
  rfl

name: Operad.Composite.mk_eq_sum_units
proof:
:= by
  have hy : g.y = fun a => ∑ v : Unit ≃ g.B a, g.y a v • Finsupp.single v (1 : R) := by
    funext a
    conv_lhs => rw [← Finsupp.univ_sum_single (g.y a)]
    simp only [Finsupp.smul_single, smul_eq_mul, mul_one]
  have h := (mkY (R := R) g).map_sum fun a v => g.y a v • Finsupp.single v (1 : R)
  rw [← hy] at h
  rw [show mk R g = mkY (R := R) g g.y from rfl, h]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun u _ => ?_
  rw [MultilinearMap.map_smul_univ]
  rfl

name: Operad.Composite.rightUnitorInvApp_rightUnitorApp
statement:
theorem rightUnitorInvApp_rightUnitorApp (z : Composite R M (UnitSp R) S) :
    rightUnitorInvApp S (rightUnitorApp S z) = z
proof:
:= by
  have h : (rightUnitorInvApp (R := R) S).comp (rightUnitorApp (M := M) S) = LinearMap.id :=
    hom_ext fun g => by
      rw [LinearMap.comp_apply, rightUnitorApp_mk g, LinearMap.id_apply, rightUnitorFun, map_sum,
        mk_eq_sum_units g]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun u _ => ?_
      rw [map_smul]
      congr 1
      have hE : (Equiv.sigmaCongrRight u).symm.trans ((Equiv.sigmaCongrRight u).trans g.e) = g.e :=
        Equiv.ext fun p => by simp
      calc rightUnitorInvApp S (SymSpecies.map (R := R) ((unitsEquiv u).trans g.e) g.m)
          = mk R ⟨g.A, fun _ => Unit, g.m, fun _ => Finsupp.single (Equiv.refl Unit) (1 : R),
              (Equiv.sigmaCongrRight u).trans g.e⟩ := by
            rw [rightUnitorInvApp_apply]
            refine (mk_outer (unitsGen (R := R) (0 : M S)) ((unitsEquiv u).trans g.e) g.m).trans ?_
            exact congrArg (fun e => mk R (⟨g.A, fun _ => Unit, g.m,
              fun _ => Finsupp.single (Equiv.refl Unit) (1 : R), e⟩ : CompGen M (UnitSp R) S))
              (Equiv.ext fun p => rfl)
        _ = mk R ⟨g.A, g.B, g.m, fun a => SymSpecies.map (R := R) (V := UnitSp R) (u a)
              (Finsupp.single (Equiv.refl Unit) (1 : R)),
              (Equiv.sigmaCongrRight u).symm.trans ((Equiv.sigmaCongrRight u).trans g.e)⟩ :=
            (mk_inner (R := R) (M := M) (N := UnitSp R) (B := g.B) ⟨g.A, fun _ => Unit, g.m,
              fun _ => Finsupp.single (Equiv.refl Unit) (1 : R),
              (Equiv.sigmaCongrRight u).trans g.e⟩ u).symm
        _ = mk R { g with y := fun a => Finsupp.single (u a) (1 : R) } := by
            rw [hE]
            congr 2
            funext a
            rw [← UnitSp.single_eq_map]
  exact LinearMap.congr_fun h z

name: Operad.Equiv.symm_trans_eq_of
statement:
lemma Equiv.symm_trans_eq_of {α β γ : Type*} (f : α ≃ β) (g : α ≃ γ) (h : β ≃ γ)
    (H : ∀ q, g q = h (f q)) : f.symm.trans g = h
proof:
:=
  Equiv.ext fun x => by
    obtain ⟨q, rfl⟩ := f.surjective x
    rw [Equiv.trans_apply, Equiv.symm_apply_apply, H]

name: Operad.Composite.map_cast
statement:
lemma map_cast {T : Type} {D : T → Type} [∀ t, Fintype (D t)] [∀ t, DecidableEq (D t)]
    (l : ∀ t, L (D t)) {t t' : T} (h : t = t') :
    SymSpecies.map (R := R) (Equiv.cast (congrArg D h)) (l t) = l t'
proof:
:= by
  subst h
  rw [Equiv.cast_refl, SymSpecies.map_refl]

name: Operad.Composite.assocInner_update
statement:
lemma assocInner_update (k : CompGen M N U) (D : U → Type) [∀ t, Fintype (D t)]
    [∀ t, DecidableEq (D t)] (l : ∀ t, L (D t)) (a : k.A) (b : k.B a)
    (w : L (D (k.e ⟨a, b⟩))) :
    (fun a' => mk R (assocInner k D (update l (k.e ⟨a, b⟩) w) a'))
      = update (fun a' => mk R (assocInner k D l a')) a
          (mkY (assocInner k D l a) (update (assocInner k D l a).y b w))
proof:
:= by
  funext a'
  by_cases h : a' = a
  · subst h
    rw [update_self]
    have hinj : Function.Injective fun b' : k.B a' => k.e ⟨a', b'⟩ :=
      fun b₁ b₂ hb => sigma_mk_injective (k.e.injective hb)
    have := update_comp_eq_of_injective' l hinj b w
    simp only [assocInner] at this ⊢
    rw [this]
    rfl
  · rw [update_of_ne h]
    have : (fun b' => update l (k.e ⟨a, b⟩) w (k.e ⟨a', b'⟩)) = fun b' => l (k.e ⟨a', b'⟩) :=
      funext fun b' => update_of_ne (fun hb => h (congrArg Sigma.fst (k.e.injective hb))) _ _
    simp only [assocInner, this]

name: Operad.Composite.assocML_apply
statement:
lemma assocML_apply (k : CompGen M N U) (D : U → Type) [∀ t, Fintype (D t)]
    [∀ t, DecidableEq (D t)] (e : (Σ t, D t) ≃ S) (l : ∀ t, L (D t)) :
    assocML k D e l = mk R (assocGen R k D l e)
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: Operad.Composite.assocInner_update_y
statement:
lemma assocInner_update_y (k : CompGen M N U) (D : U → Type) [∀ t, Fintype (D t)]
    [∀ t, DecidableEq (D t)] (l : ∀ t, L (D t)) (a : k.A) (z : N (k.B a)) :
    (fun a' => mk R (assocInner { k with y := update k.y a z } D l a'))
      = update (fun a' => mk R (assocInner k D l a')) a (mkM (assocInner k D l a) z)
proof:
:= by
  funext a'
  exact apply_update (fun a' (n : N (k.B a')) => mk R (⟨k.B a', fun b => D (k.e ⟨a', b⟩), n,
    fun b => l (k.e ⟨a', b⟩), Equiv.refl _⟩ : CompGen N L _)) k.y a z a'

name: Operad.Composite.assocLin_mk
statement:
lemma assocLin_mk (k : CompGen M N U) (D : U → Type) [∀ t, Fintype (D t)]
    [∀ t, DecidableEq (D t)] (e : (Σ t, D t) ≃ S) (l : ∀ t, L (D t)) :
    assocLin D e (mk R k) l = mk R (assocGen R k D l e)
proof:
:= by
  rw [assocLin, lift_mk]
  rfl

name: Operad.Composite.assocFun_respects
statement:
lemma assocFun_respects : CompGen.Respects R (assocFun R M N L (S := S)) where
  add_m h x'
proof:
:= by
    show assocLin h.B h.e (h.m + x') h.y = assocLin h.B h.e h.m h.y + assocLin h.B h.e x' h.y
    rw [map_add]
    rfl
  smul_m h c := by
    show assocLin h.B h.e (c • h.m) h.y = c • assocLin h.B h.e h.m h.y
    rw [map_smul]
    rfl
  add_y h t v v' := (assocLin h.B h.e h.m).map_update_add h.y t v v'
  smul_y h t c v := (assocLin h.B h.e h.m).map_update_smul h.y t c v
  outer := @fun h U' _ _ σ x => by
    show assocLin h.B h.e (SymSpecies.map (R := R) σ x) h.y
      = assocLin (fun t => h.B (σ t)) ((Equiv.sigmaCongrLeft σ).trans h.e) x fun t => h.y (σ t)
    induction x using induction_on with
    | h0 => simp only [map_zero, MultilinearMap.zero_apply]
    | hadd x y hx hy => simp only [map_add, MultilinearMap.add_apply, hx, hy]
    | hsmul c x hx => simp only [map_smul, MultilinearMap.smul_apply, hx]
    | hmk k =>
      rw [symSpecies_map_mk, assocLin_mk, assocLin_mk]
      exact mk_congr_e _ _ fun ⟨_, _, _⟩ => rfl
  inner := @fun h D' _ _ τ => by
    show assocLin D' ((Equiv.sigmaCongrRight τ).symm.trans h.e) h.m
      (fun t => SymSpecies.map (R := R) (τ t) (h.y t)) = assocLin h.B h.e h.m h.y
    induction h.m using induction_on with
    | h0 => simp only [map_zero, MultilinearMap.zero_apply]
    | hadd x y hx hy => simp only [map_add, MultilinearMap.add_apply, hx, hy]
    | hsmul c x hx => simp only [map_smul, MultilinearMap.smul_apply, hx]
    | hmk k =>
      rw [assocLin_mk, assocLin_mk]
      let Ξ : ∀ a, (Σ b, h.B (k.e ⟨a, b⟩)) ≃ Σ b, D' (k.e ⟨a, b⟩) := fun a =>
        Equiv.sigmaCongrRight fun b => τ (k.e ⟨a, b⟩)
      have hC : ∀ a, mk R (assocInner k D' (fun t => SymSpecies.map (R := R) (τ t) (h.y t)) a)
          = SymSpecies.map (R := R) (V := Composite R N L) (Ξ a)
            (mk R (assocInner k h.B h.y a)) := by
        intro a
        rw [symSpecies_map_mk]
        have h1 := mk_inner (R := R) (M := N) (N := L) ⟨k.B a, fun b => h.B (k.e ⟨a, b⟩), k.y a,
          fun b => h.y (k.e ⟨a, b⟩), Ξ a⟩ (B := fun b => D' (k.e ⟨a, b⟩))
          fun b => τ (k.e ⟨a, b⟩)
        rw [Equiv.symm_trans_self] at h1
        exact h1
      have h3 := mk_inner (R := R) (assocGen R k h.B h.y h.e)
        (B := fun a => Σ b, D' (k.e ⟨a, b⟩)) Ξ
      rw [Equiv.symm_trans_eq_of (Equiv.sigmaCongrRight Ξ) (assocE k h.B h.e)
        (assocE k D' ((Equiv.sigmaCongrRight τ).symm.trans h.e))
        (fun ⟨a, b, d⟩ => by
          show h.e ⟨k.e ⟨a, b⟩, d⟩
            = h.e ⟨k.e ⟨a, b⟩, (τ (k.e ⟨a, b⟩)).symm (τ (k.e ⟨a, b⟩) d)⟩
          rw [Equiv.symm_apply_apply])] at h3
      refine Eq.trans ?_ h3
      exact congrArg (fun y => mk R (⟨k.A, fun a => Σ b, D' (k.e ⟨a, b⟩), k.m, y,
        assocE k D' ((Equiv.sigmaCongrRight τ).symm.trans h.e)⟩ :
          CompGen M (Composite R N L) S)) (funext hC)

name: Operad.Composite.assocApp_mk
statement:
lemma assocApp_mk (h : CompGen (Composite R M N) L S) :
    assocApp S (mk R h) = assocLin h.B h.e h.m h.y
proof:
:=
  lift_mk _ _ h

name: Operad.Composite.assoc_app
statement:
@[simp] lemma assoc_app (z : Composite R (Composite R M N) L S) :
    (assoc (M := M) (N := N) (L := L)).app S z = assocApp S z
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: Operad.TreeOfArity.ext
statement: @[ext] lemma ext {n : ℕ} {s t : TreeOfArity E n} (h : s.val = t.val) : s = t
proof: := Subtype.ext h

name: Operad.TreeOfArity.graft_val
statement:
@[simp] lemma graft_val (a b : ℕ) {n : ℕ} (t : TreeOfArity E (a + 1 + b)) (s : TreeOfArity E n) :
    (graft a b t s).val = t.val.graft a s.val
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.Free.smul_gen
statement:
lemma smul_gen {n : ℕ} (t : TreeOfArity E n) (r : R) :
    r • gen (R := R) t = Finsupp.single t r
proof:
:= by
  rw [gen, Finsupp.smul_single, smul_eq_mul, mul_one]

name: Operad.Free.gen_def
statement: lemma gen_def {n : ℕ} (t : TreeOfArity E n) : gen (R := R) t = Finsupp.single t 1
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.Free.compL_gen
statement:
@[simp] lemma compL_gen (a b : ℕ) {n : ℕ} (t : TreeOfArity E (a + 1 + b))
    (s : TreeOfArity E n) :
    compL (R := R) a b (gen t) (gen s) = gen (TreeOfArity.graft a b t s)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [compL, gen, Finsupp.lsum_single, LinearMap.toSpanSingleton_apply_one]

name: Operad.Free.reindex_gen
statement:
lemma reindex_gen {m n : ℕ} (h : m = n) (x : TreeOfArity E m) :
    reindex R (Free R E) h (gen x) = gen ⟨x.val, by rw [x.property, h]⟩
proof:
:= by
  subst h
  rw [reindex_self]
  exact congrArg gen (Subtype.ext rfl)

name: Operad.Free.compL_single
statement:
lemma compL_single (a b : ℕ) {n : ℕ} (t : TreeOfArity E (a + 1 + b)) (r : R)
    (s : TreeOfArity E n) (r' : R) :
    compL (R := R) a b (Finsupp.single t r) (Finsupp.single s r')
      = Finsupp.single (TreeOfArity.graft a b t s) (r * r')
proof:
:= by
  rw [← smul_gen, ← smul_gen, map_smul, map_smul, LinearMap.smul_apply, compL_gen, smul_smul,
    smul_gen, mul_comm]

name: Operad.Free.reindex_single
statement:
lemma reindex_single {m n : ℕ} (h : m = n) (x : TreeOfArity E m) (r : R) :
    reindex R (Free R E) h (Finsupp.single x r)
      = Finsupp.single ⟨x.val, by rw [x.property, h]⟩ r
proof:
:= by
  subst h
  rw [reindex_self]
  exact congrArg (fun y => Finsupp.single y r) (Subtype.ext rfl)

name: Operad.GrComposite.fibEquiv_apply
statement:
@[simp] lemma fibEquiv_apply (g : GrCompGen M N S) (a : g.A) (b : g.B a) :
    (fibEquiv g a b).1 = g.e ⟨a, b⟩
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.GrComposite.mk_eq_ownGen
statement:
lemma mk_eq_ownGen (g : GrCompGen M N S) :
    mk R g = mk R (ownGen g.L g.m (owner g) fun a => SymSpecies.map (R := R) (fibEquiv g a) (g.y a))
proof:
:= by
  refine (mk_inner g (fibEquiv g)).symm.trans ?_
  congr 2
  ext ⟨a, s, hs⟩
  subst hs
  show g.e ((fibEquiv g (owner g s)).symm ⟨s, rfl⟩ |> fun b => (⟨owner g s, b⟩ : Σ a, g.B a)) = s
  have : (⟨owner g s, (fibEquiv g (owner g s)).symm ⟨s, rfl⟩⟩ : Σ a, g.B a) = g.e.symm s := by
    apply g.e.injective
    rw [Equiv.apply_symm_apply]
    exact congrArg Subtype.val ((fibEquiv g (owner g s)).apply_symm_apply ⟨s, rfl⟩)
  simp only [this, Equiv.apply_symm_apply]

name: Operad.GrComposite.fibMap_apply
statement:
@[simp] lemma fibMap_apply {S' A : Type} (e : S ≃ S') (f : S → A) (a : A) (s : Fib f a) :
    (fibMap e f a s).1 = e s.1
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.GrComposite.map_mk_ownGen
statement:
lemma map_mk_ownGen {S' : Type} [Fintype S'] [DecidableEq S'] (e : S ≃ S') {A : Type}
    [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] (L : LinOrd A) (m : M A) (f : S → A) (y : ∀ a, N (Fib f a)) :
    map e (mk R (ownGen L m f y))
      = mk R (ownGen L m (f ∘ e.symm) fun a => SymSpecies.map (R := R) (fibMap e f a) (y a))
proof:
:= by
  rw [map_mk]
  refine (mk_inner (GrCompGen.relabel (ownGen L m f y) e) (fibMap e f)).symm.trans ?_
  congr 2
  ext ⟨a, s, hs⟩
  subst hs
  exact e.apply_symm_apply s

name: Operad.GrComposite.mk_ownGen_outer
statement:
lemma mk_ownGen_outer {A A' : Type} [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] [Fintype A'] [DecidableEq A']
    (σ : A' ≃ A) (L : LinOrd A) (m : M A') (f : S → A) (y : ∀ a, N (Fib f a)) :
    mk R (ownGen L (SymSpecies.map (R := R) σ m) f y)
      = mk R (ownGen (LinOrd.map σ.symm L) m (σ.symm ∘ f)
          fun a' => SymSpecies.map (R := R) (fibOuter σ f a') (y (σ a')))
proof:
:= by
  refine (mk_outer (ownGen L (SymSpecies.map (R := R) σ m) f y) σ m).trans ?_
  refine (mk_inner (⟨A', fun a => Fib f (σ a), LinOrd.map σ.symm L, m, fun a => y (σ a),
    (Equiv.sigmaCongrLeft σ).trans (Equiv.sigmaFiberEquiv f)⟩ : GrCompGen M N S)
    (fibOuter σ f)).symm.trans ?_
  congr 2
  ext ⟨a', s, hs⟩
  rfl

name: Operad.GrComposite.mk_ownGen_congr
statement:
lemma mk_ownGen_congr {A : Type} [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] (L : LinOrd A) (m : M A)
    {f f' : S → A} (hf : f = f') (y : ∀ a, N (Fib f a)) :
    mk R (ownGen L m f y) = mk R (ownGen L m f' fun a =>
      SymSpecies.map (R := R) (Equiv.subtypeEquivRight fun s => by rw [hf]) (y a))
proof:
:= by
  subst hf
  congr 2
  funext a
  rw [show (Equiv.subtypeEquivRight _ : Fib f a ≃ Fib f a) = Equiv.refl _ from
    Equiv.ext fun _ => rfl, SymSpecies.map_refl]

name: Operad.LTree.ofSTree_toSTree
statement:
lemma ofSTree_toSTree : ∀ t : LTree (G × Equiv.Perm (Fin 2)), ofSTree (toSTree t) = t
  | leaf _ => rfl
  | node e l r => by
    show node (e.1, e.2) (ofSTree (toSTree l)) (ofSTree (toSTree r)) = node e l r
    rw [ofSTree_toSTree l, ofSTree_toSTree r]

name: Operad.LTree.toSTree_ofSTree
statement:
lemma toSTree_ofSTree : ∀ m : STree (SGen (BinGen G)), toSTree (ofSTree m) = m
  | STree.leaf _ => rfl
  | STree.node (BinGen.op g, σ) c => by
    show STree.node (BinGen.op g, σ) ![toSTree (ofSTree (c 0)), toSTree (ofSTree (c 1))] =
      STree.node (BinGen.op g, σ) c
    rw [toSTree_ofSTree (c 0), toSTree_ofSTree (c 1)]
    congr 1
    funext j
    fin_cases j <;> rfl

name: Operad.LTree.labels_toSTree
statement:
lemma labels_toSTree : ∀ t : LTree (G × Equiv.Perm (Fin 2)),
    (toSTree t).labels = (t.labels : Multiset ℕ)
  | leaf _ => rfl
  | node e l r => by
    show (STree.node (BinGen.op e.1, e.2) ![toSTree l, toSTree r]).labels = _
    rw [STree.labels_node, Fin.sum_univ_two, labels_node, ← Multiset.coe_add]
    exact congrArg₂ (· + ·) (labels_toSTree l) (labels_toSTree r)

name: Operad.LTree.first_toSTree
statement:
lemma first_toSTree : ∀ t : LTree (G × Equiv.Perm (Fin 2)), t.IsShuffle →
    (toSTree t).first = t.minLabel
  | leaf _, _ => rfl
  | node e l r, h => by
    show (STree.node (BinGen.op e.1, e.2) ![toSTree l, toSTree r]).first = _
    rw [STree.first_node _ _ (by omega), minLabel_node_of_shuffle h]
    exact first_toSTree l h.2.1

name: Operad.LTree.isShuffle_toSTree
statement:
lemma isShuffle_toSTree : ∀ t : LTree (G × Equiv.Perm (Fin 2)), t.IsShuffle →
    (toSTree t).IsShuffle
  | leaf _, _ => trivial
  | node e l r, h => by
    refine ⟨by omega, fun i => ?_, Fin.strictMono_iff_lt_succ.2 fun i => ?_⟩
    · fin_cases i
      · exact isShuffle_toSTree l h.2.1
      · exact isShuffle_toSTree r h.2.2
    · fin_cases i
      show (toSTree l).first < (toSTree r).first
      rw [first_toSTree l h.2.1, first_toSTree r h.2.2]
      exact h.1

name: Operad.LTree.isShuffle_of_toSTree
statement:
lemma isShuffle_of_toSTree : ∀ t : LTree (G × Equiv.Perm (Fin 2)), (toSTree t).IsShuffle →
    t.IsShuffle
  | leaf _, _ => trivial
  | node e l r, h => by
    have hl
proof:
:= isShuffle_of_toSTree l (h.child 0)
    have hr := isShuffle_of_toSTree r (h.child 1)
    refine ⟨?_, hl, hr⟩
    have := h.mono (show (0 : Fin 2) < 1 by decide)
    change (toSTree l).first < (toSTree r).first at this
    rwa [first_toSTree l hl, first_toSTree r hr] at this

name: Operad.FreeBin.finrank_eq_doubleFactorial
statement:
theorem finrank_eq_doubleFactorial [Nontrivial R] [Fintype G] [DecidableEq G] (A : Type)
    [Fintype A] [LinearOrder A] (n : ℕ) (hA : Fintype.card A = n + 1) :
    Module.finrank R (FreeBin R G A) =
      Nat.doubleFactorial (2 * n - 1) * (Fintype.card G * 2) ^ n
proof:
:= by
  haveI : Fintype (STree.SMono (SGen (BinGen G)) (Finset.range (Fintype.card A))) :=
    Fintype.ofEquiv _ (LTree.monoEquiv (G := G) (Fintype.card A))
  rw [Module.finrank_eq_card_basis (shuffleBasis R G A),
    ← Fintype.card_congr (LTree.monoEquiv (G := G) (Fintype.card A)), Fintype.card_coe, hA,
    LTree.card_monomials, Fintype.card_prod, Fintype.card_perm, Fintype.card_fin]
  rfl

name: Operad.GrOperad.par_of_hom
statement:
lemma par_of_hom {c d : Bool} {z : P A} (h : par (R := R) d z = z) :
    par (R := R) c z = if c = d then z else 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [← h, par_par, h]

name: Operad.GrOperad.par_comp_par_left
statement:
lemma par_comp_par_left (i : A) (c p : Bool) (x : P A) (y : P B) :
    par (R := R) c (comp (R := R) i (par (R := R) p x) y)
      = comp (R := R) i (par (R := R) p x) (par (R := R) (xor c p) y)
proof:
:= by
  conv_lhs => rw [← par_add (R := R) y]
  rw [map_add, map_add, par_of_hom (comp_par i p false x y), par_of_hom (comp_par i p true x y)]
  cases c <;> cases p <;> simp

name: Operad.ConvOp.toLin_of
statement: @[simp] lemma toLin_of (f : C A →ₗ[R] P A) : toLin (of f) = f
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.ConvOp.of_toLin
statement: @[simp] lemma of_toLin (f : ConvOp R C P A) : of (toLin f) = f
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.ConvOp.toLin_add
statement: @[simp] lemma toLin_add (f g : ConvOp R C P A) : toLin (f + g) = toLin f + toLin g
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.ConvOp.toLin_smul
statement: @[simp] lemma toLin_smul (a : R) (f : ConvOp R C P A) : toLin (a • f) = a • toLin f
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.ConvOp.toLin_zero
statement: @[simp] lemma toLin_zero : toLin (0 : ConvOp R C P A) = 0
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.ConvOp.toLin_sub
statement: @[simp] lemma toLin_sub (f g : ConvOp R C P A) : toLin (f - g) = toLin f - toLin g
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.ConvOp.toLin_neg
statement: @[simp] lemma toLin_neg (f : ConvOp R C P A) : toLin (-f) = -toLin f
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.ConvOp.toLin_sum
statement:
@[simp] lemma toLin_sum {I : Type} (s : Finset I) (f : I → ConvOp R C P A) :
    toLin (∑ i ∈ s, f i) = ∑ i ∈ s, toLin (f i)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction s using Finset.induction_on with
  | empty => rfl
  | insert a s ha ih => simp only [Finset.sum_insert ha, toLin_add, ih]

name: Operad.ConvOp.ext
statement: @[ext] lemma ext {f g : ConvOp R C P A} (h : ∀ x, toLin f x = toLin g x) : f = g
proof:
:=
  LinearMap.ext h

name: Operad.ConvOp.parC_apply
statement:
lemma parC_apply (b : Bool) (f : ConvOp R C P A) (x : C A) :
    toLin (parC b f) x = ∑ c : Bool,
      GrOperad.par (R := R) (xor c b) (toLin f (GrSpecies.par (R := R) c x))
proof:
:= by
  simp only [parC, LinearMap.coe_mk, AddHom.coe_mk, toLin_of, LinearMap.coe_sum,
    Finset.sum_apply, LinearMap.comp_apply]

name: Operad.ConvOp.parC_eq_self_iff
statement: lemma parC_eq_self_iff {p : Bool} {f : ConvOp R C P A} : parC p f = f ↔ IsParC p f
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h c x
    have key : ∀ y, toLin f y
        = ∑ d : Bool, GrOperad.par (R := R) (xor d p) (toLin f (GrSpecies.par (R := R) d y)) :=
      fun y => by
        conv_lhs => rw [← h]
        exact parC_apply p f y
    rw [key (GrSpecies.par (R := R) c x), key x, map_sum]
    cases c <;> cases p <;> simp [GrSpecies.par_par, GrOperad.par_par]
  · intro h
    ext x
    have h' : ∀ c, toLin f (GrSpecies.par (R := R) c x)
        = GrOperad.par (R := R) (xor c p) (toLin f x) := fun c => h c x
    rw [parC_apply]
    simp only [h', GrOperad.par_par, if_true, Fintype.sum_bool]
    cases p
    · rw [Bool.true_xor, Bool.false_xor, Bool.not_false, add_comm]
      exact GrOperad.par_add _
    · rw [Bool.true_xor, Bool.false_xor, Bool.not_true]
      exact GrOperad.par_add _

name: Operad.ConvOp.isParC_parC
statement: lemma isParC_parC (p : Bool) (f : ConvOp R C P A) : IsParC p (parC p f)
proof:
:= by
  intro c x
  rw [parC_apply, parC_apply, map_sum]
  cases c <;> cases p <;> simp [GrSpecies.par_par, GrOperad.par_par]

name: Operad.ConvOp.parC_add
statement: lemma parC_add (f : ConvOp R C P A) : parC false f + parC true f = f
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  rw [toLin_add, LinearMap.add_apply, parC_apply, parC_apply, ← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  have : ∀ c : Bool, GrOperad.par (R := R) (xor c false) (toLin f (GrSpecies.par (R := R) c x))
      + GrOperad.par (R := R) (xor c true) (toLin f (GrSpecies.par (R := R) c x))
      = toLin f (GrSpecies.par (R := R) c x) := fun c => by
    cases c
    · exact GrOperad.par_add _
    · exact (add_comm _ _).trans (GrOperad.par_add _)
  rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun c _ => this c), ← map_sum, Fintype.sum_bool, add_comm,
    GrSpecies.par_add]

name: Operad.ConvOp.toLin_comp_tw
statement:
lemma toLin_comp_tw {p : Bool} {f : ConvOp R C P A} (hf : IsParC p f) (e : Bool) :
    toLin f ∘ₗ GrSpecies.tw (R := R) e = σ R (e && p) • (GrOperad.tw (R := R) e ∘ₗ toLin f)
proof:
:= by
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro x
  simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearMap.smul_apply, GrSpecies.tw_apply, GrOperad.tw_apply,
    map_add, map_smul]
  rw [hf false x, hf true x]
  cases e <;> cases p <;> simp <;> abel

name: Operad.ConvOp.parC_parC
statement:
lemma parC_parC (b b' : Bool) (f : ConvOp R C P A) :
    parC b (parC b' f) = if b = b' then parC b' f else 0
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  by_cases h : b = b'
  · subst h
    rw [if_pos rfl]
    simp only [parC_apply, map_sum, GrSpecies.par_par, GrOperad.par_par]
    cases b <;> simp
  · rw [if_neg h, toLin_zero, LinearMap.zero_apply]
    simp only [parC_apply, map_sum, GrSpecies.par_par, GrOperad.par_par]
    cases b <;> cases b' <;> simp_all

name: Operad.ConvOp.parC_of_isParC
statement:
lemma parC_of_isParC {p : Bool} {f : ConvOp R C P A} (hf : IsParC p f) (b : Bool) :
    parC b f = if b = p then f else 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [← parC_eq_self_iff.2 hf, parC_parC]

name: Operad.ConvOp.mapC_apply
statement:
lemma mapC_apply (σ' : A ≃ B) (f : ConvOp R C P A) (x : C B) :
    toLin (mapC σ' f) x
      = GrOperad.map (R := R) σ' (toLin f (SymSpecies.map (R := R) σ'.symm x))
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.ConvOp.oneC_apply
statement:
lemma oneC_apply (x : C Unit) :
    toLin (oneC R C P) x = GrCooperad.counit (R := R) x • GrOperad.one (R := R) (P := P)
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.ConvOp.mu_tmul
statement:
@[simp] lemma mu_tmul (i : A) (x : P A) (y : P B) :
    mu (R := R) i (x ⊗ₜ y) = GrOperad.comp (R := R) i x y
proof:
:=
  TensorProduct.lift.tmul _ _

name: Operad.ConvOp.kap_hom
statement:
lemma kap_hom {q : Bool} (f : ConvOp R C P A) {g : ConvOp R C P B} (hg : IsParC q g) :
    kap f g = TensorProduct.map (toLin f ∘ₗ GrSpecies.tw (R := R) q) (toLin g)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [kap, Fintype.sum_bool, parC_of_isParC hg]
  cases q <;> simp

name: Operad.ConvOp.kap_tmul
statement:
lemma kap_tmul {q : Bool} (f : ConvOp R C P A) {g : ConvOp R C P B} (hg : IsParC q g) (x : C A)
    (y : C B) : kap f g (x ⊗ₜ y) = toLin f (GrSpecies.tw (R := R) q x) ⊗ₜ toLin g y
proof:
:= by
  rw [kap_hom f hg]
  rfl

name: Operad.ConvOp.kap_add_left
statement:
lemma kap_add_left (f f' : ConvOp R C P A) (g : ConvOp R C P B) :
    kap (f + f') g = kap f g + kap f' g
proof:
:= by
  simp only [kap, toLin_add, LinearMap.add_comp, TensorProduct.map_add_left,
    Finset.sum_add_distrib]

name: Operad.ConvOp.kap_smul_left
statement:
lemma kap_smul_left (a : R) (f : ConvOp R C P A) (g : ConvOp R C P B) :
    kap (a • f) g = a • kap f g
proof:
:= by
  simp only [kap, toLin_smul, LinearMap.smul_comp, TensorProduct.map_smul_left, Finset.smul_sum]

name: Operad.ConvOp.kap_add_right
statement:
lemma kap_add_right (f : ConvOp R C P A) (g g' : ConvOp R C P B) :
    kap f (g + g') = kap f g + kap f g'
proof:
:= by
  simp only [kap, map_add, toLin_add, TensorProduct.map_add_right, Finset.sum_add_distrib]

name: Operad.ConvOp.kap_smul_right
statement:
lemma kap_smul_right (a : R) (f : ConvOp R C P A) (g : ConvOp R C P B) :
    kap f (a • g) = a • kap f g
proof:
:= by
  simp only [kap, map_smul, toLin_smul, TensorProduct.map_smul_right, Finset.smul_sum]

name: Operad.ConvOp.toLin_compC
statement:
lemma toLin_compC (i : A) (f : ConvOp R C P A) (g : ConvOp R C P B) :
    toLin (compC i f g) = mu i ∘ₗ kap f g ∘ₗ GrCooperad.decomp (R := R) (C := C) i
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.ConvOp.mapC_refl
statement: lemma mapC_refl (f : ConvOp R C P A) : mapC (Equiv.refl A) f = f
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  rw [mapC_apply, Equiv.refl_symm, SymSpecies.map_refl, GrOperad.map_refl]

name: Operad.ConvOp.mapC_trans
statement:
lemma mapC_trans (σ' : A ≃ B) (τ : B ≃ D) (f : ConvOp R C P A) :
    mapC (σ'.trans τ) f = mapC τ (mapC σ' f)
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  rw [mapC_apply, mapC_apply, mapC_apply,
    show (σ'.trans τ).symm = τ.symm.trans σ'.symm from rfl, SymSpecies.map_trans,
    GrOperad.map_trans]

name: Operad.ConvOp.mapC_parC
statement:
lemma mapC_parC (σ' : A ≃ B) (b : Bool) (f : ConvOp R C P A) :
    mapC σ' (parC b f) = parC b (mapC σ' f)
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  simp only [mapC_apply, parC_apply, map_sum, GrOperad.map_par, GrSpecies.map_par]

name: Operad.ConvOp.counit_par_false
statement:
lemma counit_par_false (x : C Unit) :
    GrCooperad.counit (R := R) (GrSpecies.par (R := R) false x) = GrCooperad.counit (R := R) x
proof:
:= by
  have h := LinearMap.congr_fun (GrCooperad.counit_par (R := R) (C := C)) x
  simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearMap.zero_apply] at h
  conv_rhs => rw [← GrSpecies.par_add (R := R) x, map_add, h, add_zero]

name: Operad.ConvOp.isParC_oneC
statement: lemma isParC_oneC : IsParC false (oneC R C P)
proof:
:= by
  intro c x
  simp only [oneC_apply, map_smul, Bool.xor_false]
  have h := LinearMap.congr_fun (GrCooperad.counit_par (R := R) (C := C)) x
  simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearMap.zero_apply] at h
  cases c
  · rw [counit_par_false, GrOperad.par_one]
  · rw [h, zero_smul, ← GrOperad.par_one (R := R) (P := P), GrOperad.par_par, if_neg (by decide),
      smul_zero]

name: Operad.ConvOp.parC_oneC
statement: lemma parC_oneC : parC false (oneC R C P) = oneC R C P
proof:
:=
  parC_eq_self_iff.2 isParC_oneC

name: Operad.ConvOp.tw_par
statement:
lemma tw_par (e d : Bool) (x : C A) :
    GrSpecies.tw (R := R) e (GrSpecies.par (R := R) d x)
      = σ R (e && d) • GrSpecies.par (R := R) d x
proof:
:=
  GrSpecies.tw_hom e (GrSpecies.par_par_self d x)

name: Operad.ConvOp.isParC_compC
statement:
lemma isParC_compC {p q : Bool} (i : A) {f : ConvOp R C P A} {g : ConvOp R C P B} (hf : IsParC p f)
    (hg : IsParC q g) : IsParC (xor p q) (compC i f g)
proof:
:= by
  intro c x
  have hd := LinearMap.congr_fun (GrCooperad.decomp_par (R := R) (C := C) (B := B) i c) x
  simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply] at hd
  rw [toLin_compC, LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearMap.comp_apply, hd, LinearMap.comp_apply,
    LinearMap.comp_apply]
  induction GrCooperad.decomp (R := R) (C := C) i x using TensorProduct.induction_on with
  | zero => simp
  | tmul a b =>
    have hf' : ∀ (c : Bool) (y : C A), toLin f (GrSpecies.par (R := R) c y)
        = GrOperad.par (R := R) (xor c p) (toLin f y) := hf
    have hg' : ∀ (c : Bool) (y : C B), toLin g (GrSpecies.par (R := R) c y)
        = GrOperad.par (R := R) (xor c q) (toLin g y) := hg
    rw [tpar_tmul, map_add, map_add, kap_tmul f hg, kap_tmul f hg, kap_tmul f hg, mu_tmul,
      mu_tmul, mu_tmul]
    conv_rhs => rw [← GrSpecies.par_add (R := R) a]
    simp only [map_add, LinearMap.add_apply, tw_par, map_smul, LinearMap.smul_apply, hf', hg',
      GrOperad.par_comp_par_left]
    cases c <;> cases p <;> cases q <;> simp
  | add a b ha hb =>
    rw [map_add, map_add, map_add, ha, hb, map_add, map_add, map_add]

name: Operad.ConvOp.parC_compC
statement:
lemma parC_compC (i : A) (p q : Bool) (f : ConvOp R C P A) (g : ConvOp R C P B) :
    parC (xor p q) (compC i (parC p f) (parC q g)) = compC i (parC p f) (parC q g)
proof:
:=
  parC_eq_self_iff.2 (isParC_compC i (isParC_parC p f) (isParC_parC q g))

name: Operad.ConvOp.mapC_compC
statement:
lemma mapC_compC {A' B' : Type} [Fintype A'] [DecidableEq A'] [Fintype B'] [DecidableEq B']
    (σ' : A ≃ A') (τ : B ≃ B') (i : A) (f : ConvOp R C P A) (g : ConvOp R C P B) :
    mapC (compEquiv σ' τ i) (compC i f g) = compC (σ' i) (mapC σ' f) (mapC τ g)
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ : ∃ y, x = SymSpecies.map (R := R) (compEquiv σ' τ i) y :=
    ⟨SymSpecies.map (R := R) (compEquiv σ' τ i).symm x, by rw [SymSpecies.map_map_symm]⟩
  have hd := LinearMap.congr_fun (GrCooperad.decomp_map (R := R) (C := C) σ' τ i) y
  simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply] at hd
  rw [mapC_apply, SymSpecies.map_symm_map, toLin_compC, toLin_compC, LinearMap.comp_apply,
    LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearMap.comp_apply, hd]
  induction GrCooperad.decomp (R := R) (C := C) i y using TensorProduct.induction_on with
  | zero => simp
  | tmul a b =>
    simp only [TensorProduct.map_tmul, kap, LinearMap.coe_sum, Finset.sum_apply,
      LinearMap.comp_apply, map_sum, mu_tmul, ← mapC_parC, mapC_apply, GrSpecies.map_tw,
      SymSpecies.map_symm_map]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun q _ => ?_
    rw [← GrOperad.map_comp]
  | add a b ha hb =>
    rw [map_add, map_add, map_add, ha, hb, map_add, map_add, map_add]

name: Operad.ConvOp.oneC_comp_tw
statement:
lemma oneC_comp_tw (e : Bool) :
    toLin (oneC R C P) ∘ₗ GrSpecies.tw (R := R) e = toLin (oneC R C P)
proof:
:= by
  rw [toLin_comp_tw isParC_oneC e, Bool.and_false, σ_false, one_smul]
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro x
  simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply, oneC_apply, map_smul]
  rw [GrOperad.tw_hom e GrOperad.par_one, Bool.and_false, σ_false, one_smul]

name: Operad.ConvOp.compC_oneC
statement:
lemma compC_oneC (i : A) (f : ConvOp R C P A) :
    mapC (rightUnitEquiv i) (compC i f (oneC R C P)) = f
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  have hc := LinearMap.congr_fun (GrCooperad.counit_right (R := R) (C := C) i) x
  simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearEquiv.coe_coe, LinearMap.id_apply] at hc
  rw [mapC_apply, toLin_compC, kap_hom f isParC_oneC, GrSpecies.tw_false_eq_id,
    LinearMap.comp_id]
  have key : ∀ t, GrOperad.map (R := R) (rightUnitEquiv i)
      (mu i (TensorProduct.map (toLin f) (toLin (oneC R C P)) t))
      = toLin f ((TensorProduct.rid R (C A)) (LinearMap.lTensor (C A)
          (GrCooperad.counit (R := R) (C := C)) t)) := fun t => by
    induction t using TensorProduct.induction_on with
    | zero => simp
    | tmul a u =>
      simp only [TensorProduct.map_tmul, oneC_apply, mu_tmul, map_smul, GrOperad.comp_one,
        LinearMap.lTensor_tmul, TensorProduct.rid_tmul]
    | add a b ha hb => rw [map_add, map_add, map_add, ha, hb, map_add, map_add, map_add]
  conv_rhs => rw [← hc]
  exact key _

name: Operad.ConvOp.oneC_compC
statement:
lemma oneC_compC (g : ConvOp R C P B) :
    mapC (leftUnitEquiv B) (compC () (oneC R C P) g) = g
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  have hc := LinearMap.congr_fun (GrCooperad.counit_left (R := R) (C := C) (B := B)) x
  simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearEquiv.coe_coe, LinearMap.id_apply] at hc
  have hk : kap (oneC R C P) g = TensorProduct.map (toLin (oneC R C P)) (toLin g) := by
    simp only [kap, oneC_comp_tw, Fintype.sum_bool, ← TensorProduct.map_add_right, ← toLin_add,
      add_comm (parC true g), parC_add]
  rw [mapC_apply, toLin_compC, hk]
  have key : ∀ t, GrOperad.map (R := R) (leftUnitEquiv B)
      (mu () (TensorProduct.map (toLin (oneC R C P)) (toLin g) t))
      = toLin g ((TensorProduct.lid R (C B)) (LinearMap.rTensor (C B)
          (GrCooperad.counit (R := R) (C := C)) t)) := fun t => by
    induction t using TensorProduct.induction_on with
    | zero => simp
    | tmul u b =>
      simp only [TensorProduct.map_tmul, oneC_apply, mu_tmul, map_smul, LinearMap.smul_apply,
        GrOperad.one_comp, LinearMap.rTensor_tmul, TensorProduct.lid_tmul]
    | add a b ha hb => rw [map_add, map_add, map_add, ha, hb, map_add, map_add, map_add]
  conv_rhs => rw [← hc]
  exact key _

name: Operad.ConvOp.decomp_tw_apply
statement:
lemma decomp_tw_apply (e : Bool) (i : A) (u : C (Without A i ⊕ B)) :
    GrCooperad.decomp (R := R) (C := C) i (GrSpecies.tw (R := R) e u)
      = TensorProduct.map (GrSpecies.tw (R := R) e) (GrSpecies.tw (R := R) e)
          (GrCooperad.decomp (R := R) (C := C) i u)
proof:
:=
  LinearMap.congr_fun (GrCooperad.decomp_tw e i) u

name: Operad.ConvOp.compC_assoc_seq_hom
proof:
:= by
  have hgh := isParC_compC j hg hh
  ext x
  set w := SymSpecies.map (R := R) (V := C) (seqEquiv i j D).symm x
  have hco := LinearMap.congr_fun (GrCooperad.decomp_assoc_seq (R := R) (C := C) (D := D) i j) x
  simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearEquiv.coe_coe] at hco
  have hL : toLin (mapC (seqEquiv i j D) (compC (Sum.inr j) (compC i f g) h)) x
      = GrOperad.map (R := R) (seqEquiv i j D) (mu (Sum.inr j)
          (TensorProduct.map (mu i ∘ₗ TensorProduct.map (toLin f ∘ₗ GrSpecies.tw (R := R) q)
            (toLin g) ∘ₗ TensorProduct.map (GrSpecies.tw (R := R) r) (GrSpecies.tw (R := R) r))
            (toLin h)
            (LinearMap.rTensor (C D) (GrCooperad.decomp (R := R) (C := C) i)
              (GrCooperad.decomp (R := R) (C := C) (Sum.inr j) w)))) := by
    rw [mapC_apply, toLin_compC, kap_hom _ hh, toLin_compC, kap_hom f hg]
    simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply]
    congr 2
    induction GrCooperad.decomp (R := R) (C := C) (Sum.inr j) w using TensorProduct.induction_on
      with
    | zero => simp
    | tmul u z =>
      simp only [TensorProduct.map_tmul, LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearMap.rTensor_tmul,
        decomp_tw_apply]
    | add a b ha hb => simp only [map_add, ha, hb]
  have hR : toLin (compC i f (compC j g h)) x
      = mu i (TensorProduct.map (toLin f ∘ₗ GrSpecies.tw (R := R) (xor q r))
          (mu j ∘ₗ TensorProduct.map (toLin g ∘ₗ GrSpecies.tw (R := R) r) (toLin h))
          (TensorProduct.assoc R (C A) (C B) (C D)
            (LinearMap.rTensor (C D) (GrCooperad.decomp (R := R) (C := C) i)
              (GrCooperad.decomp (R := R) (C := C) (Sum.inr j) w)))) := by
    rw [toLin_compC, kap_hom f hgh, toLin_compC, kap_hom g hh]
    simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply]
    rw [← hco]
    congr 1
    induction GrCooperad.decomp (R := R) (C := C) i x using TensorProduct.induction_on with
    | zero => simp
    | tmul a v => simp only [TensorProduct.map_tmul, LinearMap.lTensor_tmul, LinearMap.comp_apply]
    | add a b ha hb => simp only [map_add, ha, hb]
  rw [hL, hR]
  induction LinearMap.rTensor (C D) (GrCooperad.decomp (R := R) (C := C) i)
      (GrCooperad.decomp (R := R) (C := C) (Sum.inr j) w) using TensorProduct.induction_on with
  | zero => simp
  | tmul t z =>
    induction t using TensorProduct.induction_on with
    | zero => simp
    | tmul a b =>
      simp only [TensorProduct.map_tmul, LinearMap.comp_apply, mu_tmul,
        TensorProduct.assoc_tmul, GrOperad.comp_assoc_seq, GrSpecies.tw_tw]
    | add a b ha hb => simp only [map_add, TensorProduct.add_tmul, ha, hb]
  | add a b ha hb => simp only [map_add, ha, hb]

name: Operad.ConvOp.compC_assoc_seq
statement:
lemma compC_assoc_seq (i : A) (j : B) (f : ConvOp R C P A) (g : ConvOp R C P B)
    (h : ConvOp R C P D) :
    mapC (seqEquiv i j D) (compC (Sum.inr j) (compC i f g) h) = compC i f (compC j g h)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← parC_add g, ← parC_add h]
  simp only [map_add, LinearMap.add_apply]
  rw [compC_assoc_seq_hom i j f (isParC_parC false g) (isParC_parC false h),
    compC_assoc_seq_hom i j f (isParC_parC false g) (isParC_parC true h),
    compC_assoc_seq_hom i j f (isParC_parC true g) (isParC_parC false h),
    compC_assoc_seq_hom i j f (isParC_parC true g) (isParC_parC true h)]

name: Operad.ConvOp.par_of_hom_C
statement:
lemma par_of_hom_C {c d : Bool} {z : C A} (h : GrSpecies.par (R := R) d z = z) :
    GrSpecies.par (R := R) c z = if c = d then z else 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [← h, GrSpecies.par_par, h]

name: Operad.ConvOp.sswapLast_hom
statement:
lemma sswapLast_hom (x : C A) {y : C B} {z : C D} {sy sz : Bool}
    (hy : GrSpecies.par (R := R) sy y = y) (hz : GrSpecies.par (R := R) sz z = z) :
    sswapLast R (fun c => GrSpecies.par (R := R) (V := C) (A := B) c)
        (fun c => GrSpecies.par (R := R) (V := C) (A := D) c) ((x ⊗ₜ y) ⊗ₜ z)
      = σ R (sy && sz) • ((x ⊗ₜ z) ⊗ₜ y)
proof:
:= by
  rw [sswapLast_tmul]
  simp only [Fintype.sum_bool, par_of_hom_C hy, par_of_hom_C hz]
  cases sy <;> cases sz <;> simp

name: Operad.ConvOp.compC_assoc_par
statement:
lemma compC_assoc_par {i k : A} (hik : i ≠ k) (f : ConvOp R C P A) {q r : Bool}
    {g : ConvOp R C P B} {h : ConvOp R C P D} (hg : parC q g = g) (hh : parC r h = h) :
    mapC (parEquiv hik B D) (compC (Sum.inl ⟨k, Ne.symm hik⟩) (compC i f g) h)
      = σ R (q && r) • compC (Sum.inl ⟨i, hik⟩) (compC k f h) g
proof:
:= by
  have hg' := parC_eq_self_iff.1 hg
  have hh' := parC_eq_self_iff.1 hh
  ext x
  set w := SymSpecies.map (R := R) (V := C) (parEquiv hik B D).symm x
  have hco := LinearMap.congr_fun
    (GrCooperad.decomp_assoc_par (R := R) (C := C) (B := B) (D := D) hik) x
  simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply] at hco
  have hL : toLin (mapC (parEquiv hik B D) (compC (Sum.inl ⟨k, Ne.symm hik⟩) (compC i f g) h)) x
      = GrOperad.map (R := R) (parEquiv hik B D) (mu (Sum.inl ⟨k, Ne.symm hik⟩)
          (TensorProduct.map (mu i ∘ₗ TensorProduct.map (toLin f ∘ₗ GrSpecies.tw (R := R) q)
            (toLin g) ∘ₗ TensorProduct.map (GrSpecies.tw (R := R) r) (GrSpecies.tw (R := R) r))
            (toLin h)
            (LinearMap.rTensor (C D) (GrCooperad.decomp (R := R) (C := C) i)
              (GrCooperad.decomp (R := R) (C := C)
              (Sum.inl ⟨k, Ne.symm hik⟩ : Without A i ⊕ B) w)))) := by
    rw [mapC_apply, toLin_compC, kap_hom _ hh', toLin_compC, kap_hom f hg']
    simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply]
    congr 2
    induction GrCooperad.decomp (R := R) (C := C)
              (Sum.inl ⟨k, Ne.symm hik⟩ : Without A i ⊕ B) w
      using TensorProduct.induction_on with
    | zero => simp
    | tmul u z =>
      simp only [TensorProduct.map_tmul, LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearMap.rTensor_tmul,
        decomp_tw_apply]
    | add a b ha hb => simp only [map_add, ha, hb]
  have hR : toLin (σ R (q && r) • compC (Sum.inl ⟨i, hik⟩) (compC k f h) g) x
      = σ R (q && r) • mu (Sum.inl ⟨i, hik⟩)
          (TensorProduct.map (mu k ∘ₗ TensorProduct.map (toLin f ∘ₗ GrSpecies.tw (R := R) r)
            (toLin h) ∘ₗ TensorProduct.map (GrSpecies.tw (R := R) q) (GrSpecies.tw (R := R) q))
            (toLin g)
            (LinearMap.rTensor (C B) (GrCooperad.decomp (R := R) (C := C) k)
              (GrCooperad.decomp (R := R) (C := C)
              (Sum.inl ⟨i, hik⟩ : Without A k ⊕ D) x))) := by
    rw [toLin_smul, LinearMap.smul_apply, toLin_compC, kap_hom _ hg', toLin_compC,
      kap_hom f hh']
    simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply]
    congr 2
    induction GrCooperad.decomp (R := R) (C := C)
              (Sum.inl ⟨i, hik⟩ : Without A k ⊕ D) x
      using TensorProduct.induction_on with
    | zero => simp
    | tmul u z =>
      simp only [TensorProduct.map_tmul, LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearMap.rTensor_tmul,
        decomp_tw_apply]
    | add a b ha hb => simp only [map_add, ha, hb]
  rw [hL, hR, hco]
  have H : GrOperad.map (R := R) (parEquiv hik B D) ∘ₗ
      mu (Sum.inl ⟨k, Ne.symm hik⟩ : Without A i ⊕ B) ∘ₗ
      TensorProduct.map (mu i ∘ₗ TensorProduct.map (toLin f ∘ₗ GrSpecies.tw (R := R) q)
        (toLin g) ∘ₗ TensorProduct.map (GrSpecies.tw (R := R) r) (GrSpecies.tw (R := R) r))
        (toLin h)
      = σ R (q && r) • (mu (Sum.inl ⟨i, hik⟩ : Without A k ⊕ D) ∘ₗ
          TensorProduct.map (mu k ∘ₗ TensorProduct.map (toLin f ∘ₗ GrSpecies.tw (R := R) r)
            (toLin h) ∘ₗ TensorProduct.map (GrSpecies.tw (R := R) q) (GrSpecies.tw (R := R) q))
            (toLin g) ∘ₗ sswapLast R (fun c => GrSpecies.par (R := R) (V := C) (A := B) c)
              (fun c => GrSpecies.par (R := R) (V := C) (A := D) c)) := by
    apply TensorProduct.ext_threefold
    intro a b d
    have key : ∀ (b' : C B) (d' : C D) (sb sd : Bool), GrSpecies.par (R := R) sb b' = b' →
        GrSpecies.par (R := R) sd d' = d' →
        (GrOperad.map (R := R) (parEquiv hik B D) ∘ₗ
          mu (Sum.inl ⟨k, Ne.symm hik⟩ : Without A i ⊕ B) ∘ₗ
          TensorProduct.map (mu i ∘ₗ TensorProduct.map (toLin f ∘ₗ GrSpecies.tw (R := R) q)
            (toLin g) ∘ₗ TensorProduct.map (GrSpecies.tw (R := R) r)
              (GrSpecies.tw (R := R) r)) (toLin h)) ((a ⊗ₜ b') ⊗ₜ d')
        = (σ R (q && r) • (mu (Sum.inl ⟨i, hik⟩ : Without A k ⊕ D) ∘ₗ
            TensorProduct.map (mu k ∘ₗ TensorProduct.map (toLin f ∘ₗ GrSpecies.tw (R := R) r)
              (toLin h) ∘ₗ TensorProduct.map (GrSpecies.tw (R := R) q)
                (GrSpecies.tw (R := R) q)) (toLin g) ∘ₗ
              sswapLast R (fun c => GrSpecies.par (R := R) (V := C) (A := B) c)
                (fun c => GrSpecies.par (R := R) (V := C) (A := D) c))) ((a ⊗ₜ b') ⊗ₜ d') := by
      intro b' d' sb sd hb hd
      have hgb : GrOperad.par (R := R) (xor sb q) (toLin g b') = toLin g b' := by
        rw [← hg' sb b', hb]
      have hhd : GrOperad.par (R := R) (xor sd r) (toLin h d') = toLin h d' := by
        rw [← hh' sd d', hd]
      simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearMap.smul_apply, TensorProduct.map_tmul, mu_tmul,
        sswapLast_hom a hb hd, map_smul, GrSpecies.tw_hom r hb, GrSpecies.tw_hom q hd,
        LinearMap.smul_apply, TensorProduct.smul_tmul', TensorProduct.tmul_smul]
      rw [GrOperad.comp_assoc_par hik _ hgb hhd, GrSpecies.tw_tw, GrSpecies.tw_tw,
        Bool.xor_comm r q, smul_smul, smul_smul, smul_smul]
      congr 1
      cases sb <;> cases sd <;> cases q <;> cases r <;> simp
    rw [← GrSpecies.par_add (R := R) b, ← GrSpecies.par_add (R := R) d]
    simp only [TensorProduct.tmul_add, TensorProduct.add_tmul, map_add]
    rw [key _ _ _ _ (GrSpecies.par_par_self _ _) (GrSpecies.par_par_self _ _),
      key _ _ _ _ (GrSpecies.par_par_self _ _) (GrSpecies.par_par_self _ _),
      key _ _ _ _ (GrSpecies.par_par_self _ _) (GrSpecies.par_par_self _ _),
      key _ _ _ _ (GrSpecies.par_par_self _ _) (GrSpecies.par_par_self _ _)]
  exact LinearMap.congr_fun H _

name: Operad.ConvOp.par_def
statement: lemma par_def (b : Bool) (f : ConvOp R C P A) : GrOperad.par (R := R) b f = parC b f
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.ConvOp.map_def
statement: lemma map_def (σ' : A ≃ B) (f : ConvOp R C P A) : GrOperad.map (R := R) σ' f = mapC σ' f
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.ConvOp.comp_def
statement:
lemma comp_def (i : A) (f : ConvOp R C P A) (g : ConvOp R C P B) :
    GrOperad.comp (R := R) i f g = compC i f g
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.ConvOp.one_def
statement: lemma one_def : (GrOperad.one (R := R) : ConvOp R C P Unit) = oneC R C P
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.ConvOp.tw_apply
statement:
lemma tw_apply (e : Bool) (f : ConvOp R C P A) (y : C A) :
    toLin (GrOperad.tw (R := R) e f) y
      = GrOperad.tw (R := R) e (toLin f (GrSpecies.tw (R := R) e y))
proof:
:= by
  rw [GrOperad.tw_apply, par_def, par_def, toLin_add, toLin_smul, LinearMap.add_apply,
    LinearMap.smul_apply, parC_apply, parC_apply, GrSpecies.tw_apply, map_add, map_smul]
  simp only [Fintype.sum_bool, GrOperad.tw_apply, map_add, map_smul]
  cases e <;> simp <;> abel

name: Operad.ConvOp.toLin_postL
statement:
@[simp] lemma toLin_postL (φ : P A →ₗ[R] P' A) (f : ConvOp R C P A) :
    toLin (postL φ f) = φ ∘ₗ toLin f

name: Operad.ConvOp.postHom_app

@[simp] lemma postHom_app (φ : GrOperadHom R P P') (f : ConvOp R C P A) :

name: Operad.ConvOp.postDer_app
statement:
@[simp] lemma postDer_app {e : Bool} (D : GrDer (GrOperadHom.id R P) e) (f : ConvOp R C P A) :
    toLin ((postDer (C := C) D).app A f) = D.app A ∘ₗ toLin f
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.ConvOp.appDer_postDer_apply
statement:
lemma appDer_postDer_apply {e : Bool} (D : GrDer (GrOperadHom.id R P) e)
    (q : GrOperad.Inv R (ConvOp R C P)) (x : C A) :
    toLin ((GrOperad.Inv.appDer (postDer (C := C) D) q).1 A) x = D.app A (toLin (q.1 A) x)

  rfl

name: Operad.ConvOp.appHom_postHom_apply

lemma appHom_postHom_apply (φ : GrOperadHom R P P') (q : GrOperad.Inv R (ConvOp R C P))
    (x : C A) :
    toLin ((GrOperad.Inv.appHom (postHom (C := C) φ) q).1 A) x = φ.app A (toLin (q.1 A) x)

name: Operad.ComGen.node_eq_bin
statement: lemma node_eq_bin (c : Fin 2 → STree ComGen) : node mu c = bin (c 0) (c 1)
proof:
:= by
  rw [bin]
  congr 1
  funext i
  fin_cases i <;> rfl

name: Operad.ComGen.first_bin
statement: @[simp] lemma first_bin (x y : STree ComGen) : (bin x y).first = x.first
proof:
:= by
  rw [bin]
  exact first_node (k := 2) mu ![x, y] (by norm_num)

name: Operad.ComGen.labels_bin
statement: @[simp] lemma labels_bin (x y : STree ComGen) : (bin x y).labels = x.labels + y.labels
proof:
:= by
  simp [bin, Fin.sum_univ_two]

name: Operad.ComGen.subst_bin
statement:
@[simp] lemma subst_bin (x y : STree ComGen) (xs : ℕ → STree ComGen) :
    (bin x y).subst xs = bin (x.subst xs) (y.subst xs)
proof:
:= by
  rw [bin, bin, subst_node]
  congr 1
  funext i
  fin_cases i <;> rfl

name: Operad.ComGen.isShuffle_bin
statement:
lemma isShuffle_bin {x y : STree ComGen} :
    (bin x y).IsShuffle ↔ x.IsShuffle ∧ y.IsShuffle ∧ x.first < y.first
proof:
:= by
  rw [bin, isShuffle_node, Fin.forall_fin_two]
  refine ⟨fun ⟨_, ⟨hx, hy⟩, hm⟩ => ⟨hx, hy, hm (show (0 : Fin 2) < 1 by decide)⟩,
    fun ⟨hx, hy, hxy⟩ => ⟨by norm_num, ⟨hx, hy⟩, Fin.strictMono_iff_lt_succ.2 fun i => ?_⟩⟩
  fin_cases i
  exact hxy

name: Operad.ComGen.isComb_or_occ
statement:
theorem isComb_or_occ : ∀ t : STree ComGen,
    IsComb t ∨ ∃ p x y z, t.get? p = some (bin (bin x y) z)
  | leaf _ => Or.inl trivial
  | node mu c => by
    cases h0 : c 0 with
    | leaf a =>
      rcases isComb_or_occ (c 1) with h | ⟨p, x, y, z, hp⟩
      · exact Or.inl ⟨⟨a, h0⟩, h⟩
      · exact Or.inr ⟨1 :: p, x, y, z, by rw [get?_node_cons, dif_pos (by norm_num)]; exact hp⟩
    | node e d =>
      cases e
      exact Or.inr ⟨[], d 0, d 1, c 1, by rw [get?_nil, node_eq_bin c, h0, node_eq_bin d]⟩

name: Operad.ComGen.IsComb.leaf_of_get?
statement:
theorem IsComb.leaf_of_get? : ∀ {t : STree ComGen} {p : List ℕ} {c : Fin 2 → STree ComGen},
    IsComb t → t.get? p = some (node mu c) → ∃ a, c 0 = leaf a
  | leaf _, [], _, _, h => by simp at h
  | leaf _, _ :: _, _, _, h => by simp at h
  | node mu d, [], c, hd, h => by
    rw [get?_nil, Option.some_inj] at h
    cases h
    exact hd.1
  | node mu d, 0 :: p, c, hd, h => by
    obtain ⟨a, ha⟩
proof:
:= hd.1
    rw [get?_node_cons, dif_pos (by norm_num)] at h
    change (d 0).get? p = _ at h
    rw [ha] at h
    cases p <;> simp at h
  | node mu d, 1 :: p, c, hd, h => by
    rw [get?_node_cons, dif_pos (by norm_num)] at h
    exact IsComb.leaf_of_get? hd.2 h
  | node mu d, (i + 2) :: p, c, hd, h => by
    rw [get?_node_cons, dif_neg (by omega)] at h
    simp at h

name: Operad.ComGen.eq_of_isComb
statement:
theorem eq_of_isComb : ∀ {s t : STree ComGen}, s.IsShuffle → t.IsShuffle → IsComb s →
    IsComb t → s.labels = t.labels → s = t
  | leaf a, leaf b, _, _, _, _, h => by
    rw [labels_leaf, labels_leaf, Multiset.singleton_inj] at h
    rw [h]
  | leaf a, node mu d, _, ht, _, hct, h => by
    obtain ⟨⟨b, hb⟩, -⟩
proof:
:= hct
    have := congrArg Multiset.card h
    simp only [node_eq_bin d, labels_bin, hb, labels_leaf, Multiset.card_add,
      Multiset.card_singleton] at this
    have hne := Multiset.card_pos_iff_exists_mem.2 ⟨_, first_mem (ht.child 1)⟩
    omega
  | node mu c, leaf b, hs, _, hcs, _, h => by
    obtain ⟨⟨a, ha⟩, -⟩ := hcs
    have := congrArg Multiset.card h
    simp only [node_eq_bin c, labels_bin, ha, labels_leaf, Multiset.card_add,
      Multiset.card_singleton] at this
    have hne := Multiset.card_pos_iff_exists_mem.2 ⟨_, first_mem (hs.child 1)⟩
    omega
  | node mu c, node mu d, hs, ht, hcs, hct, h => by
    obtain ⟨⟨a, ha⟩, hs1⟩ := hcs
    obtain ⟨⟨b, hb⟩, ht1⟩ := hct
    have hab : a = b := by
      have := first_eq_of_labels_eq hs ht h
      rwa [node_eq_bin c, node_eq_bin d, first_bin, first_bin, ha, hb, first_leaf,
        first_leaf] at this
    subst hab
    have hl : (c 1).labels = (d 1).labels := by
      rw [node_eq_bin c, node_eq_bin d, labels_bin, labels_bin, ha, hb] at h
      exact add_left_cancel h
    rw [node_eq_bin c, node_eq_bin d, ha, hb, eq_of_isComb (hs.child 1) (ht.child 1) hs1 ht1 hl]

name: Operad.ComGen.combL_spec
statement:
theorem combL_spec : ∀ (a : ℕ) (l : List ℕ), (a :: l).Pairwise (· < ·) →
    (combL (a :: l)).IsShuffle ∧ (combL (a :: l)).first = a ∧
      (combL (a :: l)).labels = ↑(a :: l) ∧ IsComb (combL (a :: l))
  | a, [], _ => ⟨trivial, rfl, rfl, trivial⟩
  | a, b :: l, h => by
    obtain ⟨h1, h2, h3, h4⟩
proof:
:= combL_spec b l (List.pairwise_cons.1 h).2
    refine ⟨isShuffle_bin.2 ⟨trivial, h1, ?_⟩, first_bin _ _, ?_, ⟨a, rfl⟩, h4⟩
    · rw [first_leaf, h2]
      exact (List.pairwise_cons.1 h).1 b List.mem_cons_self
    · show (bin (leaf a) (combL (b :: l))).labels = _
      rw [labels_bin, h3, labels_leaf, Multiset.singleton_add, Multiset.cons_coe]

name: Operad.ComGen.exists_isComb
statement: theorem exists_isComb {A : Finset ℕ} (hA : A.Nonempty) : ∃ t : SMono ComGen A, IsComb t.1
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, l, hl⟩ : ∃ a l, A.sort (· ≤ ·) = a :: l := by
    cases h : A.sort (· ≤ ·) with
    | nil =>
      have := Finset.length_sort (s := A) (r := (· ≤ ·))
      rw [h, List.length_nil] at this
      exact absurd this.symm (Finset.card_pos.2 hA).ne'
    | cons a l => exact ⟨a, l, rfl⟩
  have hp : (a :: l).Pairwise (· < ·) := hl ▸ (Finset.sortedLT_sort A).pairwise
  obtain ⟨h1, -, h3, h4⟩ := combL_spec a l hp
  exact ⟨⟨combL (a :: l), h1, by rw [h3, ← hl, Finset.sort_eq]⟩, h4⟩

name: Operad.ComGen.rcomb_lt_lcomb
statement: lemma rcomb_lt_lcomb : pathLex letter rcomb lcomb
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨⟨0, by simp⟩, fun j hj => (Nat.not_lt_zero _ hj).elim, ?_⟩
  show DegLex (word letter rcomb.1 0) (word letter lcomb.1 0)
  rw [word, word, pos_eq rcomb.nodup (q := [0]) rfl, pos_eq lcomb.nodup (q := [0, 0]) rfl]
  exact Or.inl (by decide)

name: Operad.ComGen.rcomb_lt_tcomb
statement: lemma rcomb_lt_tcomb : pathLex letter rcomb tcomb
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨⟨0, by simp⟩, fun j hj => (Nat.not_lt_zero _ hj).elim, ?_⟩
  show DegLex (word letter rcomb.1 0) (word letter tcomb.1 0)
  rw [word, word, pos_eq rcomb.nodup (q := [0]) rfl, pos_eq tcomb.nodup (q := [0, 0]) rfl]
  exact Or.inl (by decide)

name: Operad.ComGen.strictMonoOn_ins
statement:
lemma strictMonoOn_ins {x y z : STree ComGen} (hxy : x.first < y.first)
    (hyz : y.first < z.first) :
    StrictMonoOn (fun a => (ins x y z a).first) ((three : Finset ℕ) : Set ℕ)
proof:
:= by
  intro a ha b hb hab
  simp only [Finset.coe_insert, Finset.coe_singleton, Set.mem_insert_iff,
    Set.mem_singleton_iff] at ha hb
  rcases ha with rfl | rfl | rfl <;> rcases hb with rfl | rfl | rfl <;>
    first | omega | (simp only [ins]; omega)

name: Operad.ComGen.not_normal_of_get?
proof:
:= by
  have hu := isShuffle_get? t.isShuffle hp
  have hn : (bin (bin x y) z).labels.Nodup := Multiset.nodup_of_le (labels_get?_le hp) t.nodup
  rw [isShuffle_bin, isShuffle_bin, first_bin] at hu
  obtain ⟨⟨hx, hy, hxy⟩, hz, hxz⟩ := hu
  rw [labels_bin, labels_bin, Multiset.nodup_add] at hn
  have hyz : y.first ≠ z.first := fun h => Multiset.disjoint_left.1 hn.2.2
    (Multiset.mem_add.2 (Or.inr (first_mem hy))) (h ▸ first_mem hz)
  intro hN
  rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne hyz with h | h
  · have hU : t.1.get? p = some (((rules K).lead true).1.subst (ins x y z)) := by
      rw [hp]
      show _ = some ((bin (bin (leaf 0) (leaf 1)) (leaf 2)).subst _)
      rw [subst_bin, subst_bin]
      rfl
    exact hN true _ (isSCtx_ctxOf t p _ _ hU (strictMonoOn_ins hxy h))
      (ctxOf_self t p _ _ hU (strictMonoOn_ins hxy h))
  · have hU : t.1.get? p = some (((rules K).lead false).1.subst (ins x z y)) := by
      rw [hp]
      show _ = some ((bin (bin (leaf 0) (leaf 2)) (leaf 1)).subst _)
      rw [subst_bin, subst_bin]
      rfl
    exact hN false _ (isSCtx_ctxOf t p _ _ hU (strictMonoOn_ins hxz h))
      (ctxOf_self t p _ _ hU (strictMonoOn_ins hxz h))

name: Operad.ComGen.isComb_of_normal
statement:
theorem isComb_of_normal {A : Finset ℕ} {t : SMono ComGen A} (h : (rules K).Normal t) :
    IsComb t.1
proof:
:=
  (isComb_or_occ t.1).resolve_right fun ⟨_, _, _, _, hp⟩ => not_normal_of_get? t hp h

name: Operad.ComGen.normal_of_isComb
statement:
theorem normal_of_isComb {A : Finset ℕ} {t : SMono ComGen A} (h : IsComb t.1) :
    (rules K).Normal t
proof:
:= by
  intro r f hf hft
  obtain ⟨p, xs, hp, -, -⟩ := IsSCtx.normal hf ((rules K).lead r)
  rw [hft] at hp
  cases r <;> obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := h.leaf_of_get? hp <;> cases ha

name: Operad.ComGen.normal_iff
statement: theorem normal_iff {A : Finset ℕ} {t : SMono ComGen A} : (rules K).Normal t ↔ IsComb t.1
proof:
:=
  ⟨isComb_of_normal, normal_of_isComb⟩

name: Operad.ComGen.normal_unique
statement:
theorem normal_unique {A : Finset ℕ} {s t : SMono ComGen A} (hs : (rules K).Normal s)
    (ht : (rules K).Normal t) : s = t
proof:
:=
  Subtype.ext (eq_of_isComb s.isShuffle t.isShuffle (isComb_of_normal hs) (isComb_of_normal ht)
    (s.labels_eq.trans t.labels_eq.symm))

name: Operad.ComGen.existsUnique_normal
statement:
theorem existsUnique_normal {A : Finset ℕ} (hA : A.Nonempty) :
    ∃! t : SMono ComGen A, (rules K).Normal t
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := exists_isComb hA
  exact ⟨t, normal_of_isComb ht, fun s hs => normal_unique hs (normal_of_isComb ht)⟩

name: Operad.ComGen.ideal_le_ker_aug
statement:
theorem ideal_le_ker_aug (A : Finset ℕ) :
    ((rules K).rw A).ideal ≤ LinearMap.ker (aug K A)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Rules.ideal_eq_span]
  refine Submodule.span_le.2 ?_
  rintro _ ⟨r, f, -, rfl⟩
  rw [SetLike.mem_coe, LinearMap.mem_ker, aug, Finsupp.linearCombination_mapDomain, map_sub,
    Finsupp.linearCombination_single]
  show _ - Finsupp.linearCombination K _ (Finsupp.single rcomb 1) = 0
  rw [Finsupp.linearCombination_single]
  exact sub_self _

name: Operad.ComGen.disjoint_normal
statement:
theorem disjoint_normal (A : Finset ℕ) :
    Disjoint (Finsupp.supported K K {t : SMono ComGen A | (rules K).Normal t})
      ((rules K).rw A).ideal
proof:
:= by
  rw [Submodule.disjoint_def]
  intro v hv hI
  have hv' := (Finsupp.mem_supported K v).1 hv
  have h0 : aug K A v = 0 := ideal_le_ker_aug A hI
  ext m
  by_cases hm : m ∈ v.support
  · have hs : v.support ⊆ {m} := fun n hn =>
      Finset.mem_singleton.2 (normal_unique (hv' hn) (hv' hm))
    rw [Finsupp.support_subset_singleton.1 hs] at h0
    simpa [aug] using h0
  · rw [Finsupp.notMem_support_iff.1 hm, Finsupp.zero_apply]

name: Operad.ComGen.res_amb
statement: theorem res_amb {C : Finset ℕ} {r₁ r₂ : Bool} (B : (rules K).Amb C r₁ r₂) : B.Res
proof:
:=
  B.res_of_isCompl (disjoint_normal C)

name: Operad.ComGen.weight_lead
statement: lemma weight_lead (r : Bool) : ((rules K).lead r).1.weight = 2
proof:
:= by
  cases r <;> rfl

name: Operad.ComGen.weight_tail
statement: lemma weight_tail (r : Bool) : ∀ m ∈ ((rules K).tail r).support, m.1.weight = 2
proof:
:=
  fun m hm => by
    rw [Finset.mem_singleton.1 (Finsupp.support_single_subset hm)]
    rfl

name: Operad.ComGen.isKoszul
statement: theorem isKoszul : (rules K).IsKoszul
proof:
:=
  (rules K).isKoszul_of_critical weight_lead weight_tail fun B _ => res_amb B

name: Operad.ComGen.finrank_eq_one
statement:
theorem finrank_eq_one [Nontrivial K] {A : Finset ℕ} (hA : A.Nonempty) :
    Module.finrank K ((SMono ComGen A →₀ K) ⧸ ((rules K).rw A).ideal) = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [Module.finrank_eq_nat_card_basis (basis A), Nat.card_eq_one_iff_exists]
  obtain ⟨t, ht, hu⟩ := existsUnique_normal (K := K) hA
  exact ⟨⟨t, (rules K).mem_irr_iff.2 ht⟩,
    fun y => Subtype.ext (hu y.1 ((rules K).mem_irr_iff.1 y.2))⟩

name: Operad.May.app_fill
statement:
lemma app_fill (x : S A) (y : (a : A) → S (B a)) (l : List A) (hl : l.Nodup) :
    φ.app _ (fill x y l hl) = fill (φ.app A x) (fun a => φ.app _ (y a)) l hl
proof:
:= by
  induction l with
  | nil => rw [fill_nil, fill_nil, φ.app_map]
  | cons a l ih => rw [fill_cons, fill_cons, φ.app_map, φ.app_comp, ih]

name: Operad.May.app_total
statement:
lemma app_total (x : S A) (y : (a : A) → S (B a)) :
    φ.app _ (SetOperad.total x y) = SetOperad.total (φ.app A x) (fun a => φ.app _ (y a))
proof:
:= by
  rw [SetOperad.total, SetOperad.total, φ.app_map, app_fill]

name: Operad.SgnData.fill_ord_inl
statement:
lemma fill_ord_inl (D : SgnData A) (d : (a : A) → SgnData (B a)) (l : List A) (hl : l.Nodup)
    (a b : {a : A // a ∉ l}) :
    (fill (S := SgnD) D d l hl).ord.lt (Sum.inl a) (Sum.inl b) ↔ D.ord.lt a.1 b.1
proof:
:= by
  induction l with
  | nil => exact Iff.rfl
  | cons a₀ l ih =>
    exact ih (List.nodup_cons.1 hl).2 ⟨a.1, fun h => a.2 (List.mem_cons_of_mem a₀ h)⟩
      ⟨b.1, fun h => b.2 (List.mem_cons_of_mem a₀ h)⟩

name: Operad.SgnData.fill_ord_inr_inl
statement:
lemma fill_ord_inr_inl (D : SgnData A) (d : (a : A) → SgnData (B a)) (l : List A)
    (hl : l.Nodup) (a : {a : A // a ∈ l}) (b : B a.1) (a' : {a : A // a ∉ l}) :
    (fill (S := SgnD) D d l hl).ord.lt (Sum.inr ⟨a, b⟩) (Sum.inl a') ↔ D.ord.lt a.1 a'.1
proof:
:= by
  induction l with
  | nil => exact absurd a.2 (List.not_mem_nil)
  | cons a₀ l ih =>
    obtain ⟨ha₀, hl'⟩ := List.nodup_cons.1 hl
    have ha' : a'.1 ∉ l := fun h => a'.2 (List.mem_cons_of_mem a₀ h)
    by_cases h : a.1 = a₀
    · obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := a
      simp only at h
      subst h
      show (LinOrd.comp _ _ _).lt _ _ ↔ _
      simp only [stepEquiv, Equiv.coe_fn_symm_mk, dif_pos, LinOrd.comp_lt,
        LinOrd.compLt_inr_inl]
      exact fill_ord_inl D d l hl' _ ⟨a'.1, ha'⟩
    · have hal : a.1 ∈ l := (List.mem_cons.1 a.2).resolve_left h
      show (LinOrd.comp _ _ _).lt _ _ ↔ _
      simp only [stepEquiv, Equiv.coe_fn_symm_mk, dif_neg h, LinOrd.comp_lt]
      exact ih hl' ⟨a.1, hal⟩ b ⟨a'.1, ha'⟩

name: Operad.SgnData.fill_aft_inl
statement:
lemma fill_aft_inl (D : SgnData A) (d : (a : A) → SgnData (B a)) (l : List A) (hl : l.Nodup)
    (a : {a : A // a ∉ l}) :
    (fill (S := SgnD) D d l hl).aft (Sum.inl a)
      = xor (D.aft a.1) (aftL D.ord (fun a => (d a).tot) a.1 l)
proof:
:= by
  induction l with
  | nil => exact (Bool.xor_false _).symm
  | cons a₀ l ih =>
    obtain ⟨ha₀, hl'⟩ := List.nodup_cons.1 hl
    have ha : a.1 ∉ l := fun h => a.2 (List.mem_cons_of_mem a₀ h)
    have hne : a.1 ≠ a₀ := fun h => a.2 (by rw [h]; exact List.mem_cons_self)
    rw [fill_cons]
    show (SgnData.map _ (SgnData.comp _ _ _)).aft _ = _
    rw [SgnData.map_aft, show (stepEquiv (B := B) a₀ l ha₀).symm (Sum.inl a)
        = Sum.inl ⟨Sum.inl ⟨a.1, ha⟩, fun h => hne (congrArg Subtype.val (Sum.inl_injective h))⟩
        from rfl, SgnData.comp_aft_inl, ih hl' ⟨a.1, ha⟩, aftL]
