  LinearMap.ext fun _ => rfl

name: Operad.FreeGr.ofCoef_app
statement:
@[simp] lemma ofCoef_app (hΨ : CoefFinite Ψ) :
    (ofCoef Ψ hΨ).app A = ofCoefL Ψ hΨ A
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: Operad.FreeGr.vcnt_map
statement: lemma vcnt_map (e : A ≃ B) (x : Reg (TreeOfArity T) A) : vcnt (SetOperad.map e x) = vcnt x
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: Operad.FreeGr.vcnt_comp
statement:
lemma vcnt_comp (i : A) (x : Reg (TreeOfArity T) A) (y : Reg (TreeOfArity T) B) :
    vcnt (SetOperad.comp i x y) = vcnt x + vcnt y
proof:
:=
  cntR_comp _ i x y

name: Operad.FreeGr.vcnt_one
statement: lemma vcnt_one : vcnt (SetOperad.one : Reg (TreeOfArity T) Unit) = 0
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: Operad.FreeGr.vcnt_std
statement: lemma vcnt_std {k : ℕ} (e : T k) : vcnt (Reg.std (corolla e)) = 1
proof:
:=
  cntR_std _ e

name: Operad.FreeGr.eq_map_one_of_vcnt
statement:
lemma eq_map_one_of_vcnt {x : Reg (TreeOfArity T) A} (hx : vcnt x = 0) :
    ∃ e : Unit ≃ A, x = SetOperad.map e SetOperad.one
proof:
:= by
  refine eq_map_one_of_leaf x ?_
  cases h : treeOf x with
  | leaf => rfl
  | node e fo =>
    have : vcnt x = 1 + Forest.cntF (fun _ _ => 1) fo := by
      show Tree.cnt _ (treeOf x) = _
      rw [h, Tree.cnt_node]
    omega

name: Operad.FreeGr.ShapeR.map
statement:
lemma ShapeR.map {t : Reg (TreeOfArity T) A} (h : ShapeR t) (E : A ≃ B) :
    ShapeR (SetOperad.map E t)
proof:
:= by
  rcases h with ⟨e, rfl⟩ | ⟨k, g, e, rfl⟩ | ⟨a, b, i, p, q, e, hp, hq, rfl⟩
  · exact Or.inl ⟨e.trans E, (SetOperad.map_trans _ _ _).symm⟩
  · exact Or.inr (Or.inl ⟨k, g, e.trans E, (SetOperad.map_trans _ _ _).symm⟩)
  · exact Or.inr (Or.inr ⟨a, b, i, p, q, e.trans E, hp, hq, (SetOperad.map_trans _ _ _).symm⟩)

name: Operad.FreeGr.shapeR
statement: theorem shapeR (t : Reg (TreeOfArity T) A) : ShapeR t
proof:
:= by
  refine FreeReg.induction (P := fun A _ _ t => ShapeR t) ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ t
  · intro A B _ _ _ _ e x hx
    exact hx.map e
  · exact Or.inl ⟨Equiv.refl _, (SetOperad.map_refl _).symm⟩
  · intro A₁ B₁ _ _ _ _ i x y hx hy
    by_cases h1 : vcnt x = 0
    · obtain ⟨e₁, rfl⟩ := eq_map_one_of_vcnt h1
      obtain ⟨E, hE⟩ := SetOperad.comp_unit_left i e₁ y
      rw [hE]
      exact hy.map E
    by_cases h2 : vcnt y = 0
    · obtain ⟨e₂, rfl⟩ := eq_map_one_of_vcnt h2
      obtain ⟨E, hE⟩ := SetOperad.comp_unit_right i x e₂
      rw [hE]
      exact hx.map E
    let σ' := Fintype.equivFin A₁
    let τ := Fintype.equivFin B₁
    refine Or.inr (Or.inr ⟨_, _, σ' i, SetOperad.map σ' x, SetOperad.map τ y,
      (compEquiv σ' τ i).symm, h1, h2, ?_⟩)
    rw [← SetOperad.map_comp, SetOperad.map_symm_map]
  · intro k g
    exact Or.inr (Or.inl ⟨k, g, Equiv.refl _, (SetOperad.map_refl _).symm⟩)

name: Operad.SymCooperad.finite_support_pair_all
proof:
:= by
  induction t using TensorProduct.induction_on with
  | zero => simp
  | tmul x y =>
    refine ((hF x).prod (hG y)).subset fun pq hpq => ?_
    simp only [Function.mem_support, SymCooperad.pair_tmul] at hpq
    exact ⟨left_ne_zero_of_mul hpq, right_ne_zero_of_mul hpq⟩
  | add x y hx hy =>
    refine (hx.union hy).subset fun pq hpq => ?_
    by_contra hc
    simp only [Set.mem_union, Function.mem_support, not_or, not_not] at hc
    exact hpq (by show SymCooperad.pair (F pq.1) (G pq.2) (x + y) = 0
                  rw [map_add, hc.1, hc.2, add_zero])

name: Operad.FreeGrL.factorial_mul_wk
statement: lemma factorial_mul_wk [Algebra ℚ R] (k : ℕ) : (k.factorial : R) * wk R k = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [wk, ← map_natCast (algebraMap ℚ R), ← map_mul, mul_inv_cancel₀ (by positivity), map_one]

name: Operad.FreeGrL.liftOp_gen
statement:
lemma liftOp_gen (ℓ : GenLift₀ φ) {k : ℕ} (g : GrGen R V k) :
    (liftOp ℓ).app (Fin k) (𝔟 (Reg.std (corolla g))) = (liftVal ℓ).1 k g
proof:
:=
  FreeGr.homEquiv_symm_gen _ g

name: Operad.FreeGrL.bsgn_std
statement:
lemma bsgn_std {k : ℕ} (g : GrGen R V k) :
    FreeGr.bsgn (grGenPar R V) R (Reg.std (corolla g) : Reg (TreeOfArity (GrGen R V)) (Fin k))
      = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [FreeGr.bsgn, FreeGr.oddCnt, cntR_std]
  cases grGenPar R V k g <;> rfl

name: Operad.FreeGrL.coefF_std
statement:
lemma coefF_std (ℓ : GenLift₀ φ) {k : ℕ} (g : GrGen R V k) (c : C (Fin k)) :
    FreeGr.coefF (liftOp ℓ) (Reg.std (corolla g)) c = wk R k * ℓ.L k c g
proof:
:= by
  rw [FreeGr.coefF_apply, bsgn_std, one_mul, liftOp_gen]
  rfl

name: Operad.FreeGrL.liftOp_bas
statement:
lemma liftOp_bas (ℓ : GenLift φ) (x : Reg (TreeOfArity (GrGen R V)) A) :
    (liftOp ℓ.toGenLift₀).app A (𝔟 x) = 0 ∨ FreeGr.vcnt x + 1 ≤ Fintype.card A
proof:
:= by
  refine FreeReg.induction (P := fun A _ _ x => (liftOp ℓ.toGenLift₀).app A (𝔟 x) = 0 ∨
    FreeGr.vcnt x + 1 ≤ Fintype.card A) ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ x
  · intro A B _ _ _ _ e x hx
    rcases hx with h | h
    · left
      rw [← SgnLin.map_bas, (liftOp ℓ.toGenLift₀).app_map, h, map_zero]
    · right
      rw [FreeGr.vcnt_map, ← Fintype.card_congr e]
      exact h
  · right
    rw [FreeGr.vcnt_one]
    rfl
  · intro A B _ _ _ _ i x y hx hy
    rcases hx with h | hx
    · left
      rw [app_bas_comp, h, map_zero, LinearMap.zero_apply, smul_zero]
    rcases hy with h | hy
    · left
      rw [app_bas_comp, h, map_zero, smul_zero]
    right
    have hA : 0 < Fintype.card A := Fintype.card_pos_iff.2 ⟨i⟩
    rw [FreeGr.vcnt_comp, Fintype.card_sum, Reg.card_without]
    omega
  · intro k g
    by_cases hk : k ≤ 1
    · left
      rw [liftOp_gen]
      refine LinearMap.ext fun c => ?_
      show wk R k • ℓ.L k c g = 0
      rw [ℓ.low k hk, LinearMap.zero_apply, Finsupp.coe_zero, Pi.zero_apply, smul_zero]
    · right
      rw [FreeGr.vcnt_std, Fintype.card_fin]
      omega

name: Operad.FreeGrL.coefF_ne_zero
proof:
:= by
  rcases liftOp_bas ℓ x with h0 | h0
  · refine absurd ?_ h
    rw [FreeGr.coefF_apply, h0]
    exact mul_zero _
  · exact h0

name: Operad.FreeGrL.ne_zero_of_pair_ne_zero
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨fun hf => h ?_, fun hg => h ?_⟩
  · rw [hf, map_zero, LinearMap.zero_apply, LinearMap.zero_apply]
  · rw [hg, map_zero, LinearMap.zero_apply]

name: Operad.FreeGrL.two_le_of_coefF
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ : ∃ c, FreeGr.coefF (liftOp ℓ.toGenLift₀) x c ≠ 0 := by
    by_contra hn
    exact h (LinearMap.ext fun c => not_not.1 fun hc => hn ⟨c, hc⟩)
  have := coefF_ne_zero ℓ hc
  omega

name: Operad.FreeGrL.coefFinite
statement: theorem coefFinite (ℓ : GenLift φ) : FreeGr.CoefFinite (liftOp ℓ.toGenLift₀)
proof:
:= by
  suffices h : ∀ n (A : Type) [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A], Fintype.card A = n → ∀ c : C A,
      (Function.support fun x : Reg (TreeOfArity (GrGen R V)) A =>
        FreeGr.coefF (liftOp ℓ.toGenLift₀) x c).Finite from fun A _ _ c => h _ A rfl c
  intro n
  induction n using Nat.strong_induction_on with
  | _ n ih =>
  intro A _ _ hn c
  have hV : ∀ (a b : ℕ) (i : Fin a) (e : Without (Fin a) i ⊕ Fin b ≃ A),
      {pq : Reg (TreeOfArity (GrGen R V)) (Fin a) × Reg (TreeOfArity (GrGen R V)) (Fin b) |
        FreeGr.vcnt pq.1 ≠ 0 ∧ FreeGr.vcnt pq.2 ≠ 0 ∧
        SymCooperad.pair (FreeGr.coefF (liftOp ℓ.toGenLift₀) pq.1)
          (FreeGr.coefF (liftOp ℓ.toGenLift₀) pq.2)
          (GrCooperad.decomp (R := R) i (SymSpecies.map (R := R) e.symm c)) ≠ 0}.Finite := by
    intro a b i e
    have hcard := Fintype.card_congr e
    rw [Fintype.card_sum, Reg.card_without, Fintype.card_fin, Fintype.card_fin] at hcard
    have ha := i.pos
    by_cases hab : 2 ≤ a ∧ 2 ≤ b
    · refine (SymCooperad.finite_support_pair_all
        (fun p => FreeGr.coefF (liftOp ℓ.toGenLift₀) p)
        (fun q => FreeGr.coefF (liftOp ℓ.toGenLift₀) q) (fun x => ih a (by omega) (Fin a)
          (Fintype.card_fin a) x) (fun y => ih b (by omega) (Fin b) (Fintype.card_fin b) y)
        _).subset fun pq hpq => hpq.2.2
    · refine Set.finite_empty.subset fun pq ⟨hp, hq, hne⟩ => absurd ?_ hab
      obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := ne_zero_of_pair_ne_zero hne
      have := two_le_of_coefF ℓ hp h1
      have := two_le_of_coefF ℓ hq h2
      rw [Fintype.card_fin] at *
      exact ⟨by assumption, by assumption⟩
  let U₀ : Set (Reg (TreeOfArity (GrGen R V)) A) :=
    Set.range fun e : Unit ≃ A => SetOperad.map e SetOperad.one
  let U₁ : Set (Reg (TreeOfArity (GrGen R V)) A) := ⋃ e : Fin (Fintype.card A) ≃ A,
    (fun g => SetOperad.map e (Reg.std (corolla g))) ''
      ↑(ℓ.L (Fintype.card A) (SymSpecies.map (R := R) e.symm c)).support
  let U₂ : Set (Reg (TreeOfArity (GrGen R V)) A) := ⋃ a ∈ Finset.range (Fintype.card A + 2),
    ⋃ b ∈ Finset.range (Fintype.card A + 1), ⋃ i : Fin a, ⋃ e : Without (Fin a) i ⊕ Fin b ≃ A,
      (fun pq : Reg (TreeOfArity (GrGen R V)) (Fin a) × Reg (TreeOfArity (GrGen R V)) (Fin b) =>
        SetOperad.map e (SetOperad.comp i pq.1 pq.2)) ''
        {pq | FreeGr.vcnt pq.1 ≠ 0 ∧ FreeGr.vcnt pq.2 ≠ 0 ∧
          SymCooperad.pair (FreeGr.coefF (liftOp ℓ.toGenLift₀) pq.1)
            (FreeGr.coefF (liftOp ℓ.toGenLift₀) pq.2)
            (GrCooperad.decomp (R := R) i (SymSpecies.map (R := R) e.symm c)) ≠ 0}
  have h₀ : U₀.Finite := Set.finite_range _
  have h₁ : U₁.Finite := Set.finite_iUnion fun e => (Finset.finite_toSet _).image _
  have h₂ : U₂.Finite :=
    Set.Finite.biUnion (Finset.finite_toSet _) fun a _ =>
      Set.Finite.biUnion (Finset.finite_toSet _) fun b _ =>
        Set.finite_iUnion fun i => Set.finite_iUnion fun e => (hV _ _ i e).image _
  refine ((h₀.union h₁).union h₂).subset fun t ht => ?_
  rw [Function.mem_support] at ht
  rcases FreeGr.shapeR t with ⟨e, rfl⟩ | ⟨k, g, e, rfl⟩ | ⟨a, b, i, p, q, e, hp, hq, rfl⟩
  · exact Or.inl (Or.inl ⟨e, rfl⟩)
  · obtain rfl : k = Fintype.card A := by simpa using Fintype.card_congr e
    rw [FreeGr.coefF_map, coefF_std ℓ.toGenLift₀] at ht
    refine Or.inl (Or.inr (Set.mem_iUnion.2 ⟨e, g, Finsupp.mem_support_iff.2 ?_, rfl⟩))
    exact right_ne_zero_of_mul ht
  · have hcard := Fintype.card_congr e
    rw [Fintype.card_sum, Reg.card_without, Fintype.card_fin, Fintype.card_fin] at hcard
    have ha := i.pos
    rw [FreeGr.coefF_map, FreeGr.coefF_comp] at ht
    refine Or.inr (Set.mem_iUnion₂.2 ⟨a, ?_, Set.mem_iUnion₂.2 ⟨b, ?_, Set.mem_iUnion.2 ⟨i,
      Set.mem_iUnion.2 ⟨e, ⟨(p, q), ⟨hp, hq, right_ne_zero_of_mul ht⟩, rfl⟩⟩⟩⟩⟩)
    · exact Finset.mem_coe.2 (Finset.mem_range.2 (by omega))
    · exact Finset.mem_coe.2 (Finset.mem_range.2 (by omega))

name: Operad.FreeGrL.map_std_injective
statement:
lemma map_std_injective {k : ℕ} :
    Function.Injective (fun x : (Σ _ : Fin k ≃ A, GrGen R V k) =>
      (SetOperad.map x.1 (Reg.std (corolla x.2)) : Reg (TreeOfArity (GrGen R V)) A))
proof:
:= by
  rintro ⟨e, g⟩ ⟨e', g'⟩ h
  have h1 := congrArg Prod.fst h
  have h2 := congrArg FreeGr.treeOf h
  simp only [FreeGr.map_fst, FreeGr.treeOf_map] at h1 h2
  have he : e = e' := by
    refine Equiv.symm_bijective.injective (Equiv.ext fun a => Fin.ext ?_)
    have hs : ∀ g'' : GrGen R V k,
        (Reg.std (corolla g'') : Reg (TreeOfArity (GrGen R V)) (Fin k)).1 = LinOrd.std k :=
      fun _ => rfl
    have := congrArg (fun L : LinOrd A => L.rank a) h1
    beta_reduce at this
    rwa [LinOrd.rank_map, LinOrd.rank_map, hs g, hs g', LinOrd.rank_std, LinOrd.rank_std] at this
  subst he
  have hg : g = g' := by
    have h3 : Tree.node g (TreeOfArity.leaves k) = Tree.node g' (TreeOfArity.leaves k) := h2
    simpa using h3
  rw [hg]

name: Operad.FreeGrL.weight_ne_zero
statement:
lemma weight_ne_zero {T : ℕ → Type v} {x : Reg (TreeOfArity T) A} (hx : FreeGr.vcnt x ≠ 0) :
    (FreeGr.treeOf x).weight ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  apply hx
  cases ht : FreeGr.treeOf x with
  | leaf =>
    show Tree.cnt _ (FreeGr.treeOf x) = 0
    rw [ht]
    rfl
  | node e fo =>
    rw [ht, Tree.weight_node] at h
    omega

name: Operad.FreeGrL.eq_std_of_weight
statement:
lemma eq_std_of_weight {t : Reg (TreeOfArity (GrGen R V)) A}
    (ht : (FreeGr.treeOf t).weight = 1) :
    ∃ (e : Fin (Fintype.card A) ≃ A) (g : GrGen R V (Fintype.card A)),
      t = SetOperad.map e (Reg.std (corolla g))
proof:
:= by
  rcases FreeGr.shapeR t with ⟨e, rfl⟩ | ⟨k, g, e, rfl⟩ | ⟨a, b, i, p, q, e, hp, hq, rfl⟩
  · exact absurd ht (by rw [FreeGr.treeOf_map]; exact Nat.zero_ne_one)
  · obtain rfl : k = Fintype.card A := by simpa using Fintype.card_congr e
    exact ⟨e, g, rfl⟩
  · rw [FreeGr.treeOf_map, FreeGr.treeOf_comp, Tree.weight_graft _ _ _
      (FreeGr.rank_lt_arity p i)] at ht
    have := weight_ne_zero hp
    have := weight_ne_zero hq
    omega

name: Operad.FreeGrL.genCoef_liftOf
statement:
theorem genCoef_liftOf (ℓ : GenLift₀ φ) (hΨ : FreeGr.CoefFinite (liftOp ℓ)) (c : C A) :
    genCoef R V A ((liftOf ℓ hΨ).app A c) = φ.app A c
proof:
:= by
  haveI : DecidableEq (Reg (TreeOfArity (GrGen R V)) A) := Classical.decEq _
  set k := Fintype.card A with hk
  set y : Reg (TreeOfArity (GrGen R V)) A →₀ R :=
    FreeGr.ofCoefL (liftOp ℓ) hΨ A c with hy
  let f : Reg (TreeOfArity (GrGen R V)) A → V A := fun t =>
    FreeGr.coefF (liftOp ℓ) t c • coefReg R V t
  have h1 : genCoef R V A ((liftOf ℓ hΨ).app A c) = ∑ t ∈ y.support, f t := by
    show genCoefF R V A y = _
    rw [genCoefF]
    erw [Finsupp.linearCombination_apply]
    rfl
  let ι : (Σ _ : Fin k ≃ A, GrGen R V k) → Reg (TreeOfArity (GrGen R V)) A :=
    fun x => SetOperad.map x.1 (Reg.std (corolla x.2))
  let G : Finset (Σ _ : Fin k ≃ A, GrGen R V k) :=
    Finset.univ.sigma fun e => (ℓ.L k (SymSpecies.map (R := R) e.symm c)).support
  have hf : ∀ x : Σ _ : Fin k ≃ A, GrGen R V k, f (ι x) =
      (wk R k * ℓ.L k (SymSpecies.map (R := R) x.1.symm c) x.2) •
        SymSpecies.map (R := R) x.1 x.2.1.1 := by
    rintro ⟨e, g⟩
    show FreeGr.coefF (liftOp ℓ) (SetOperad.map e (Reg.std (corolla g))) c •
      coefReg R V (SetOperad.map e (Reg.std (corolla g))) = _
    rw [FreeGr.coefF_map, coefF_std, coefReg_map, coefReg_std_corolla]
  have h2 : ∑ x ∈ G, f (ι x) = φ.app A c := by
    rw [Finset.sum_sigma]
    have he : ∀ e : Fin k ≃ A,
        ∑ g ∈ (ℓ.L k (SymSpecies.map (R := R) e.symm c)).support, f (ι ⟨e, g⟩)
          = wk R k • φ.app A c := by
      intro e
      rw [φ.app_eq_chart e c, ← ℓ.lc, Finsupp.linearCombination_apply, Finsupp.sum, map_sum,
        Finset.smul_sum]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun g _ => ?_
      rw [hf, map_smul, smul_smul]
    rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl fun e _ => he e, Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ,
      Fintype.card_equiv (Fintype.equivFin A).symm, Fintype.card_fin, ← Nat.cast_smul_eq_nsmul R,
      smul_smul, factorial_mul_wk, one_smul]
  rw [h1, ← h2, ← Finset.sum_image (fun x _ x' _ h => map_std_injective h)]
  have hsub1 : y.support ⊆ y.support ∪ G.image ι := Finset.subset_union_left
  have hsub2 : G.image ι ⊆ y.support ∪ G.image ι := Finset.subset_union_right
  rw [Finset.sum_subset hsub1 (fun t _ ht => ?_), ← Finset.sum_subset hsub2 (fun t _ ht => ?_)]
  · by_cases hw : (FreeGr.treeOf t).weight = 1
    · obtain ⟨e, g, rfl⟩ := eq_std_of_weight hw
      have hg : g ∉ (ℓ.L k (SymSpecies.map (R := R) e.symm c)).support := fun hg =>
        ht (Finset.mem_image.2 ⟨(⟨e, g⟩ : Σ _ : Fin k ≃ A, GrGen R V k),
          Finset.mem_sigma.2 ⟨Finset.mem_univ _, hg⟩, rfl⟩)
      show f (ι (⟨e, g⟩ : Σ _ : Fin k ≃ A, GrGen R V k)) = 0
      rw [hf, Finsupp.notMem_support_iff.1 hg, mul_zero, zero_smul]
    · show FreeGr.coefF (liftOp ℓ) t c • coefReg R V t = 0
      rw [coefReg_of_weight_ne hw, smul_zero]
  · show FreeGr.coefF (liftOp ℓ) t c • coefReg R V t = 0
    rw [show FreeGr.coefF (liftOp ℓ) t c = y t from rfl, Finsupp.notMem_support_iff.1 ht,
      zero_smul]

name: Operad.FreeGrL.genCoef_lift
statement:
theorem genCoef_lift (ℓ : GenLift φ) (c : C A) :
    genCoef R V A ((lift ℓ).app A c) = φ.app A c
proof:
:=
  genCoef_liftOf ℓ.toGenLift₀ (coefFinite ℓ) c

name: Operad.FreeGrL.genOf_mem
statement:
lemma genOf_mem (k : ℕ) (b : Bool) (g : GenOf R V k b) :
    g.1.1.1 ∈ LinearMap.range (GrSpecies.par (R := R) (V := V) (A := Fin k) b)
proof:
:=
  ⟨g.1.1.1, by have h := g.1.2; rwa [g.2] at h⟩

name: Operad.FreeGrL.parValMap_surjective
statement: lemma parValMap_surjective (k : ℕ) (b : Bool) : Function.Surjective (parValMap R V k b)
proof:
:= by
  rintro ⟨v, w, hw⟩
  have hv : GrSpecies.par (R := R) b v = v := by rw [← hw, GrSpecies.par_par_self]
  refine ⟨Finsupp.single ⟨⟨(v, b), hv⟩, rfl⟩ 1, ?_⟩
  rw [parValMap, Finsupp.linearCombination_single, one_smul]

name: Operad.FreeGrL.coe_parValMap
statement:
lemma coe_parValMap (k : ℕ) (b : Bool) (F : GenOf R V k b →₀ R) :
    (parValMap R V k b F : V (Fin k))
      = Finsupp.linearCombination R (fun g : GrGen R V k => g.1.1)
          (Finsupp.mapDomain Subtype.val F)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Finsupp.linearCombination_mapDomain, parValMap, Finsupp.linearCombination_apply,
    Finsupp.linearCombination_apply, Finsupp.sum, Finsupp.sum, Submodule.coe_sum]
  rfl

name: Operad.FreeGrL.mapDomain_val_apply
statement:
lemma mapDomain_val_apply {k : ℕ} {b : Bool} (F : GenOf R V k b →₀ R) (g : GrGen R V k) :
    Finsupp.mapDomain Subtype.val F g = if h : g.1.2 = b then F ⟨g, h⟩ else 0
proof:
:= by
  split_ifs with h
  · exact Finsupp.mapDomain_apply Subtype.val_injective F ⟨g, h⟩
  · exact Finsupp.mapDomain_notin_range F g fun ⟨g', hg'⟩ => h (hg' ▸ g'.2)

name: Operad.FreeGrL.exists_lift_par_of
statement:
lemma exists_lift_par_of (φ : GrSpeciesHom R X V) (k : ℕ) (b : Bool)
    (hk : Module.Projective R (X (Fin k)) ∨ Module.Projective R (V (Fin k))) :
    ∃ h : X (Fin k) →ₗ[R] (GenOf R V k b →₀ R), parValMap R V k b ∘ₗ h = parImg φ k b
proof:
:= by
  rcases hk with hk | hk
  · exact Module.projective_lifting_property _ _ (parValMap_surjective k b)
  · obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := Module.projective_lifting_property (parValMap R V k b)
      (LinearMap.codRestrict _ (GrSpecies.par (R := R) (V := V) (A := Fin k) b) fun v => ⟨v, rfl⟩)
      (parValMap_surjective k b)
    refine ⟨s ∘ₗ φ.app (Fin k), LinearMap.ext fun x => ?_⟩
    rw [← LinearMap.comp_assoc, hs]
    rfl

name: Operad.FreeGrL.parValMap_liftParOf
statement:
lemma parValMap_liftParOf (φ : GrSpeciesHom R X V) (k : ℕ) (b : Bool)
    (hk : Module.Projective R (X (Fin k)) ∨ Module.Projective R (V (Fin k))) (x : X (Fin k)) :
    (parValMap R V k b (liftParOf φ k b hk x) : V (Fin k))
      = GrSpecies.par (R := R) b (φ.app (Fin k) x)
proof:
:=
  congrArg Subtype.val
    (LinearMap.congr_fun (Classical.choose_spec (exists_lift_par_of φ k b hk)) x)

name: Operad.FreeGrL.liftLOf_apply
statement:
lemma liftLOf_apply (φ : GrSpeciesHom R X V) {k : ℕ}
    (hk : Module.Projective R (X (Fin k)) ∨ Module.Projective R (V (Fin k))) (x : X (Fin k))
    (g : GrGen R V k) :
    liftLOf φ k hk x g = liftParOf φ k g.1.2 hk (GrSpecies.par (R := R) g.1.2 x) ⟨g, rfl⟩
proof:
:= by
  rw [liftLOf, LinearMap.coe_sum, Finset.sum_apply, Finsupp.finsetSum_apply, Fintype.sum_bool]
  simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply, Finsupp.lmapDomain_apply, mapDomain_val_apply]
  obtain ⟨⟨v, c⟩, hv⟩ := g
  cases c <;> simp

name: Operad.FreeGrL.lc_liftLOf
statement:
lemma lc_liftLOf (φ : GrSpeciesHom R X V) {k : ℕ}
    (hk : Module.Projective R (X (Fin k)) ∨ Module.Projective R (V (Fin k))) (x : X (Fin k)) :
    Finsupp.linearCombination R (fun g : GrGen R V k => g.1.1) (liftLOf φ k hk x)
      = φ.app (Fin k) x
proof:
:= by
  rw [liftLOf, LinearMap.coe_sum, Finset.sum_apply, map_sum, Fintype.sum_bool]
  simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply, Finsupp.lmapDomain_apply, ← coe_parValMap,
    parValMap_liftParOf, ← φ.app_par, GrSpecies.par_par_self]
  rw [add_comm, ← map_add, GrSpecies.par_add]

name: Operad.FreeGrL.liftLOf_par
statement:
lemma liftLOf_par (φ : GrSpeciesHom R X V) {k : ℕ}
    (hk : Module.Projective R (X (Fin k)) ∨ Module.Projective R (V (Fin k))) (b : Bool)
    (x : X (Fin k)) (g : GrGen R V k) :
    liftLOf φ k hk (GrSpecies.par (R := R) b x) g
      = if g.1.2 = b then liftLOf φ k hk x g else 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨⟨v, c⟩, hv⟩ := g
  rw [liftLOf_apply φ hk, liftLOf_apply φ hk]
  show liftParOf φ k c hk (GrSpecies.par (R := R) c (GrSpecies.par (R := R) b x)) _
    = if c = b then liftParOf φ k c hk (GrSpecies.par (R := R) c x) _ else 0
  by_cases h : c = b
  · subst h
    rw [GrSpecies.par_par_self, if_pos rfl]
  · rw [GrSpecies.par_par_ne h, map_zero, if_neg h]
    rfl

name: Operad.FreeGrL.exists_genLift_of
statement:
theorem exists_genLift_of
    (hred : ∀ (B : Type) [Fintype B] [DecidableEq B], Fintype.card B ≤ 1 → ∀ v : V B, v = 0)
    (hproj : ∀ k, 2 ≤ k → Module.Projective R (C (Fin k)) ∨ Module.Projective R (V (Fin k)))
    (φ : GrSpeciesHom R C V) : Nonempty (GenLift φ)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨⟨⟨fun k => if h : 2 ≤ k then liftLOf φ k (hproj k h) else 0, fun k x => ?_,
    fun k b x g => ?_⟩, fun k hk => ?_⟩⟩
  · beta_reduce
    by_cases hk : 2 ≤ k
    · rw [dif_pos hk]
      exact lc_liftLOf φ _ x
    · rw [dif_neg hk]
      exact (hred (Fin k) (by rw [Fintype.card_fin]; omega) _).trans
        (hred (Fin k) (by rw [Fintype.card_fin]; omega) _).symm
  · by_cases hk : 2 ≤ k
    · simp only [dif_pos hk]
      exact liftLOf_par φ _ b x g
    · simp only [dif_neg hk, LinearMap.zero_apply, Finsupp.coe_zero, Pi.zero_apply, ite_self]
  · exact dif_neg (by omega)

name: Operad.FreeGrL.exists_lift_par
statement:
lemma exists_lift_par (φ : GrSpeciesHom R C V) (k : ℕ) (b : Bool) :
    ∃ h : C (Fin k) →ₗ[R] (GenOf R V k b →₀ R), parValMap R V k b ∘ₗ h = parImg φ k b
proof:
:=
  Module.projective_lifting_property _ _ (parValMap_surjective k b)

name: Operad.FreeGrL.parValMap_liftPar
statement:
lemma parValMap_liftPar (φ : GrSpeciesHom R C V) (k : ℕ) (b : Bool) (x : C (Fin k)) :
    (parValMap R V k b (liftPar φ k b x) : V (Fin k))
      = GrSpecies.par (R := R) b (φ.app (Fin k) x)
proof:
:=
  congrArg Subtype.val (LinearMap.congr_fun (Classical.choose_spec (exists_lift_par φ k b)) x)

name: Operad.FreeGrL.liftL_apply
statement:
lemma liftL_apply (φ : GrSpeciesHom R C V) {k : ℕ} (hk : 2 ≤ k) (x : C (Fin k))
    (g : GrGen R V k) :
    liftL φ k x g = liftPar φ k g.1.2 (GrSpecies.par (R := R) g.1.2 x) ⟨g, rfl⟩
proof:
:= by
  rw [liftL, if_pos hk, LinearMap.coe_sum, Finset.sum_apply, Finsupp.finsetSum_apply,
    Fintype.sum_bool]
  simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply, Finsupp.lmapDomain_apply, mapDomain_val_apply]
  obtain ⟨⟨v, c⟩, hv⟩ := g
  cases c <;> simp

name: Operad.FreeGrL.exists_genLift
statement:
theorem exists_genLift
    (hred : ∀ (B : Type) [Fintype B] [DecidableEq B], Fintype.card B ≤ 1 → ∀ v : V B, v = 0)
    (φ : GrSpeciesHom R C V) : Nonempty (GenLift φ)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨⟨⟨liftL φ, fun k x => ?_, fun k b x g => ?_⟩, fun k hk => ?_⟩⟩
  · by_cases hk : 2 ≤ k
    · rw [liftL, if_pos hk, LinearMap.coe_sum, Finset.sum_apply, map_sum, Fintype.sum_bool]
      simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply, Finsupp.lmapDomain_apply, ← coe_parValMap, parValMap_liftPar,
        ← φ.app_par, GrSpecies.par_par_self]
      rw [add_comm, ← map_add, GrSpecies.par_add]
    · exact (hred (Fin k) (by rw [Fintype.card_fin]; omega) _).trans
        (hred (Fin k) (by rw [Fintype.card_fin]; omega) _).symm
  · by_cases hk : 2 ≤ k
    · obtain ⟨⟨v, c⟩, hv⟩ := g
      rw [liftL_apply φ hk, liftL_apply φ hk]
      show liftPar φ k c (GrSpecies.par (R := R) c (GrSpecies.par (R := R) b x)) _
        = if c = b then liftPar φ k c (GrSpecies.par (R := R) c x) _ else 0
      by_cases h : c = b
      · subst h
        rw [GrSpecies.par_par_self, if_pos rfl]
      · rw [GrSpecies.par_par_ne h, map_zero, if_neg h]
        rfl
    · rw [liftL, if_neg hk]
      simp
  · show liftL φ k = 0
    rw [liftL, if_neg (by omega)]

name: Operad.FreeGrL.counit_eq_unitCoeffL
statement:
lemma counit_eq_unitCoeffL (z : FreeGrL R V Unit) :
    GrCooperad.counit (R := R) z = unitCoeffL R V Unit z
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨w, rfl⟩ := (𝒥).proj_surjective Unit z
  refine Lin.induction₁ (S := Reg (TreeOfArity (GrGen R V)))
    (GrCooperad.counit (R := R) (C := FreeGrL R V) ∘ₗ (𝒥).proj Unit)
    (unitCoeffL R V Unit ∘ₗ (𝒥).proj Unit) (fun t => ?_) w
  show (Finsupp.single t (1 : R)) SetOperad.one
    = FreeGr.unitCoeff (grGenPar R V) R Unit (𝔟 t)
  rw [FreeGr.unitCoeff_bas]
  by_cases ht : (FreeGr.treeOf t).isLeaf = true
  · rw [if_pos ht, FreeGr.eq_of_isLeaf ht (rfl : (FreeGr.treeOf
      (SetOperad.one : Reg (TreeOfArity (GrGen R V)) Unit)).isLeaf = true),
      Finsupp.single_eq_same]
  · rw [if_neg ht, Finsupp.single_eq_of_ne]
    rintro rfl
    exact ht rfl

name: Operad.FreeGrL.sub_ι_genCoef_mem
statement:
lemma sub_ι_genCoef_mem {z : FreeGrL R V A} (hz : unitCoeffL R V A z = 0) :
    z - (ι R V).app A (genCoef R V A z) ∈ vxGe R V 2 A
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨w, rfl⟩ := (𝒥).proj_surjective A z
  let L : FreeGr R (grGenPar R V) A →ₗ[R] (FreeGrL R V A ⧸ vxGe R V 2 A) :=
    (vxGe R V 2 A).mkQ ∘ₗ ((𝒥).proj A - (ι R V).app A ∘ₗ genCoef R V A ∘ₗ (𝒥).proj A)
  have h := eq_zero_of_unitCoeff L (fun p hp => ?_) hz
  · rwa [LinearMap.comp_apply, Submodule.mkQ_apply, Submodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero] at h
  show (vxGe R V 2 A).mkQ ((𝒥).proj A (𝔟 p)
    - (ι R V).app A (genCoef R V A ((𝒥).proj A (𝔟 p)))) = 0
  rw [Submodule.mkQ_apply, Submodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero]
  have hmem : (𝒥).proj A (𝔟 p) ∈ vx R V (FreeGr.treeOf p).weight A :=
    mem_eig.2 (by rw [← Cobar.wtD_eq_derSp, wtD_proj_bas])
  by_cases hw : (FreeGr.treeOf p).weight = 1
  · rw [hw] at hmem
    rw [← eq_ι_genCoef hmem, sub_self]
    exact zero_mem _
  · have h1 := Tree.one_le_weight hp
    rw [genCoef_proj, genCoefF_bas, coefReg_of_weight_ne hw, map_zero, sub_zero]
    exact mem_vxGe (by omega) hmem

name: Operad.FreeGrL.toLin_appHom_ι
statement:
lemma toLin_appHom_ι (f : GrCooperadHom R C 𝒞) (x : C A) :
    ConvOp.toLin ((GrOperad.Inv.appHom (ConvOp.preHom (P := CobarGr R 𝒞) f)
      (Cobar.ι R 𝒞)).1 A) x = Cobar.ιL R 𝒞 A (f.app A x)
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.FreeGrL.toLin_ιι_app
statement:
lemma toLin_ιι_app (f : GrCooperadHom R C 𝒞) (x : C A) :
    ConvOp.toLin ((Cobar.ιι R 𝒞).1 A) (f.app A x)
      = ConvOp.toLin ((GrOperad.Inv.star R _
        (GrOperad.Inv.appHom (ConvOp.preHom (P := CobarGr R 𝒞) f) (Cobar.ι R 𝒞))
        (GrOperad.Inv.appHom (ConvOp.preHom (P := CobarGr R 𝒞) f) (Cobar.ι R 𝒞))).1 A) x
proof:
:= by
  have h := congrArg (fun q : GrOperad.Inv R (ConvOp R C (CobarGr R 𝒞)) => ConvOp.toLin (q.1 A) x)
    (GrOperad.Inv.appHom_star (ConvOp.preHom (P := CobarGr R 𝒞) f) (Cobar.ι R 𝒞) (Cobar.ι R 𝒞))
  simp only [GrOperad.Inv.appHom_apply, ConvOp.preHom_app, LinearMap.comp_apply] at h
  exact h

name: Operad.FreeGrL.toLin_sub_inv
statement:
lemma toLin_sub_inv (q q' : GrOperad.Inv R (ConvOp R C (CobarGr R 𝒞))) (x : C A) :
    ConvOp.toLin ((q - q').1 A) x = ConvOp.toLin (q.1 A) x - ConvOp.toLin (q'.1 A) x
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: Operad.FreeGrL.star_sub_star_mem
statement:
lemma star_sub_star_mem {q q' : GrOperad.Inv R (ConvOp R C (CobarGr R 𝒞))} {k : ℕ}
    (hd : ∀ (A' : Type) [Fintype A'] [DecidableEq A'] (x' : C A'),
      ConvOp.toLin ((q - q').1 A') x' ∈ Cobar.wtGe (V := V) k A')
    (h1 : ∀ (A' : Type) [Fintype A'] [DecidableEq A'] (x' : C A'),
      ConvOp.toLin (q.1 A') x' ∈ Cobar.wtGe (V := V) 1 A')
    (h1' : ∀ (A' : Type) [Fintype A'] [DecidableEq A'] (x' : C A'),
      ConvOp.toLin (q'.1 A') x' ∈ Cobar.wtGe (V := V) 1 A')
    (A : Type) [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] (x : C A) :
    ConvOp.toLin ((GrOperad.Inv.star R _ q q - GrOperad.Inv.star R _ q' q').1 A) x
      ∈ Cobar.wtGe (V := V) (k + 1) A
proof:
:= by
  have hs : GrOperad.Inv.star R _ q q - GrOperad.Inv.star R _ q' q'
      = GrOperad.Inv.star R _ (q - q') q + GrOperad.Inv.star R _ q' (q - q') := by
    simp only [map_sub, LinearMap.sub_apply]
    abel
  refine (congrArg (fun y => y ∈ Cobar.wtGe (V := V) (k + 1) A)
    (congrArg (fun r : GrOperad.Inv R (ConvOp R C (CobarGr R 𝒞)) =>
      ConvOp.toLin (r.1 A) x) hs)).mpr ?_
  exact add_mem
    (ConvOp.toLin_star_mem (F := fun A _ _ => Cobar.wtGe (V := V) k A)
      (G := fun A _ _ => Cobar.wtGe (V := V) 1 A) (H := fun A _ _ => Cobar.wtGe (V := V) (k + 1) A)
      (Cobar.wtGe_par_all 1) (Cobar.wtGe_map_all (k + 1))
      (Cobar.wtGe_comp_all k 1 (k + 1) le_rfl) hd h1 A x)
    (ConvOp.toLin_star_mem (F := fun A _ _ => Cobar.wtGe (V := V) 1 A)
      (G := fun A _ _ => Cobar.wtGe (V := V) k A) (H := fun A _ _ => Cobar.wtGe (V := V) (k + 1) A)
      (Cobar.wtGe_par_all k) (Cobar.wtGe_map_all (k + 1))
      (Cobar.wtGe_comp_all 1 k (k + 1) (by omega)) h1' hd A x)

name: Operad.FreeGrL.toLin_ιι_sub
statement:
lemma toLin_ιι_sub (f f' : GrCooperadHom R C 𝒞) (x : C A) :
    ConvOp.toLin ((Cobar.ιι R 𝒞).1 A) (f.app A x - f'.app A x)
      = ConvOp.toLin ((GrOperad.Inv.star R _
          (GrOperad.Inv.appHom (ConvOp.preHom (P := CobarGr R 𝒞) f) (Cobar.ι R 𝒞))
          (GrOperad.Inv.appHom (ConvOp.preHom (P := CobarGr R 𝒞) f) (Cobar.ι R 𝒞))
        - GrOperad.Inv.star R _
          (GrOperad.Inv.appHom (ConvOp.preHom (P := CobarGr R 𝒞) f') (Cobar.ι R 𝒞))
          (GrOperad.Inv.appHom (ConvOp.preHom (P := CobarGr R 𝒞) f') (Cobar.ι R 𝒞))).1 A) x
proof:
:=
  (map_sub (ConvOp.toLin ((Cobar.ιι R 𝒞).1 A)) _ _).trans
    ((congrArg₂ (· - ·) (toLin_ιι_app f x) (toLin_ιι_app f' x)).trans
      (toLin_sub_inv _ _ x).symm)

name: Operad.FreeGrL.toLin_sub_appHom_mem
statement:
lemma toLin_sub_appHom_mem (f f' : GrCooperadHom R C 𝒞) {k : ℕ}
    (hk : ∀ (A' : Type) [Fintype A'] [DecidableEq A'] (x' : C A'),
      f.app A' x' - f'.app A' x' ∈ vxGe R V k A') (A' : Type) [Fintype A'] [DecidableEq A']
    (x' : C A') :
    ConvOp.toLin ((GrOperad.Inv.appHom (ConvOp.preHom (P := CobarGr R 𝒞) f) (Cobar.ι R 𝒞)
      - GrOperad.Inv.appHom (ConvOp.preHom (P := CobarGr R 𝒞) f') (Cobar.ι R 𝒞)).1 A') x'
      ∈ Cobar.wtGe (V := V) k A'
proof:
:=
  (congrArg (fun y => y ∈ Cobar.wtGe (V := V) k A')
      ((toLin_sub_inv (GrOperad.Inv.appHom (ConvOp.preHom (P := CobarGr R 𝒞) f) (Cobar.ι R 𝒞))
        (GrOperad.Inv.appHom (ConvOp.preHom (P := CobarGr R 𝒞) f') (Cobar.ι R 𝒞)) x').trans
        (map_sub (Cobar.ιL R 𝒞 A') (f.app A' x') (f'.app A' x')).symm)).mpr
      (Cobar.ιL_mem_wtGe (hk A' x'))

name: Operad.FreeGrL.toLin_appHom_ι_mem
statement:
lemma toLin_appHom_ι_mem (g : GrCooperadHom R C 𝒞) (A' : Type) [Fintype A'] [DecidableEq A']
    (x' : C A') :
    ConvOp.toLin ((GrOperad.Inv.appHom (ConvOp.preHom (P := CobarGr R 𝒞) g)
      (Cobar.ι R 𝒞)).1 A') x' ∈ Cobar.wtGe (V := V) 1 A'
proof:
:=
  Cobar.ιL_mem_wtGe_one _

name: Operad.FreeGrL.ιι_sub_mem
statement:
lemma ιι_sub_mem {f f' : GrCooperadHom R C 𝒞} {k : ℕ}
    (hk : ∀ (A' : Type) [Fintype A'] [DecidableEq A'] (x' : C A'),
      f.app A' x' - f'.app A' x' ∈ vxGe R V k A') (A : Type) [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A]
    (x : C A) :
    ConvOp.toLin ((Cobar.ιι R 𝒞).1 A) (f.app A x - f'.app A x)
      ∈ Cobar.wtGe (V := V) (k + 1) A
proof:
:=
  (congrArg (fun y => y ∈ Cobar.wtGe (V := V) (k + 1) A) (toLin_ιι_sub f f' x)).mpr
    (star_sub_star_mem
      (q := GrOperad.Inv.appHom (ConvOp.preHom (P := CobarGr R 𝒞) f) (Cobar.ι R 𝒞))
      (q' := GrOperad.Inv.appHom (ConvOp.preHom (P := CobarGr R 𝒞) f') (Cobar.ι R 𝒞))
      (toLin_sub_appHom_mem f f' hk) (toLin_appHom_ι_mem f) (toLin_appHom_ι_mem f') A x)

name: Operad.FreeGrL.eq_zero_of_forall_mem_vxGe
statement: lemma eq_zero_of_forall_mem_vxGe {z : FreeGrL R V A} (hz : ∀ p, z ∈ vxGe R V p A) : z = 0
proof:
:= by
  have htop : z ∈ ⨆ j : ℕ, vx R V j A := by
    rw [iSup_vx]
    exact Submodule.mem_top
  obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := Submodule.mem_iSup_iff_exists_finset.1 htop
  have hst : Disjoint (s : Set ℕ) (Set.Ici (s.sup id + 1)) := by
    refine Set.disjoint_left.2 fun j hj hj' => ?_
    have h1 : j ≤ s.sup id := Finset.le_sup (f := id) (Finset.mem_coe.1 hj)
    have h2 : s.sup id + 1 ≤ j := hj'
    omega
  have hd := (iSupIndep_eigenspace_nat ((derSp (GrSpEnd.id R V)).app A)).disjoint_biSup_biSup hst
  refine Submodule.disjoint_def.1 hd z (by simpa only [Finset.mem_coe] using hs) ?_
  refine (iSup_le fun k => ?_ : vxGe R V (s.sup id + 1) A ≤ ⨆ i ∈ Set.Ici (s.sup id + 1),
    vx R V i A) (hz _)
  exact le_biSup (fun j => vx R V j A) (Set.mem_Ici.2 k.2)

name: Operad.FreeGrL.app_eq_of_genCoef₀
statement:
theorem app_eq_of_genCoef₀ (hV0 : ∀ v : V (Fin 0), v = 0) {f f' : GrCooperadHom R C 𝒞}
    (h : ∀ (A : Type) [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] (x : C A),
      genCoef R V A (f.app A x) = genCoef R V A (f'.app A x))
    (A : Type) [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] (x : C A) : f.app A x = f'.app A x
proof:
:= by
  have hu : ∀ (A : Type) [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] (x : C A),
      unitCoeffL R V A (f.app A x - f'.app A x) = 0 := by
    intro A _ _ x
    by_cases hA : Nonempty (Unit ≃ A)
    · obtain ⟨e⟩ := hA
      have hx : x = SymSpecies.map (R := R) e (SymSpecies.map (R := R) e.symm x) :=
        (SymSpecies.map_map_symm e x).symm
      rw [hx, f.app_map, f'.app_map, ← map_sub]
      show unitCoeffL R V A (GrOperad.map (R := R) e _) = 0
      rw [unitCoeffL_map, ← counit_eq_unitCoeffL, map_sub,
        ← LinearMap.comp_apply (GrCooperad.counit (R := R) (C := 𝒞)),
        ← LinearMap.comp_apply (GrCooperad.counit (R := R) (C := 𝒞)), f.counit_app,
        f'.counit_app, sub_self]
    · exact unitCoeffL_eq_zero (not_nonempty_iff.1 hA) _
  have key : ∀ k, 2 ≤ k → ∀ (A' : Type) [Fintype A'] [DecidableEq A'] (x' : C A'),
      f.app A' x' - f'.app A' x' ∈ vxGe R V k A' := by
    intro k hk
    induction k, hk using Nat.le_induction with
    | base =>
      intro A' _ _ x'
      have := sub_ι_genCoef_mem (hu A' x')
      rwa [map_sub, h, sub_self, map_zero, sub_zero] at this
    | succ k hk ih =>
      exact fun A' _ _ x' => Cobar.mem_vxGe_succ hV0 hk (ih A' x') (ιι_sub_mem ih A' x')
  exact sub_eq_zero.1 (eq_zero_of_forall_mem_vxGe fun p =>
    vxGe_anti (le_max_left p 2) (key _ (le_max_right p 2) A x))

name: Operad.FreeGrL.app_eq_of_genCoef
statement:
theorem app_eq_of_genCoef
    (hred : ∀ (B : Type) [Fintype B] [DecidableEq B], Fintype.card B ≤ 1 → ∀ v : V B, v = 0)
    {f f' : GrCooperadHom R C 𝒞}
    (h : ∀ (A : Type) [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] (x : C A),
      genCoef R V A (f.app A x) = genCoef R V A (f'.app A x))
    (A : Type) [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] (x : C A) : f.app A x = f'.app A x
proof:
:=
  app_eq_of_genCoef₀ (hred (Fin 0) (by simp)) h A x

name: Operad.FreeGrL.genCoefHom_app
statement: @[simp] lemma genCoefHom_app (x : FreeGrL R V A) : (genCoefHom R V).app A x = genCoef R V A x
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: Operad.FreeGrL.cofreeHomEquiv'_apply
statement:
@[simp] lemma cofreeHomEquiv'_apply
    (hred : ∀ (B : Type) [Fintype B] [DecidableEq B], Fintype.card B ≤ 1 → ∀ v : V B, v = 0)
    (hproj : ∀ k, 2 ≤ k → Module.Projective R (C (Fin k)) ∨ Module.Projective R (V (Fin k)))
    (f : GrCooperadHom R C (FreeGrL R V)) (x : C A) :
    (cofreeHomEquiv' hred hproj f).app A x = genCoef R V A (f.app A x)
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: Operad.FreeGrL.existsUnique_lift'
statement:
theorem existsUnique_lift'
    (hred : ∀ (B : Type) [Fintype B] [DecidableEq B], Fintype.card B ≤ 1 → ∀ v : V B, v = 0)
    (hproj : ∀ k, 2 ≤ k → Module.Projective R (C (Fin k)) ∨ Module.Projective R (V (Fin k)))
    (φ : GrSpeciesHom R C V) :
    ∃! f : GrCooperadHom R C (FreeGrL R V), ∀ (A : Type) [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] (x : C A),
      genCoef R V A (f.app A x) = φ.app A x
proof:
:=
  ⟨lift (Classical.choice (exists_genLift_of hred hproj φ)), fun _ _ _ x => genCoef_lift _ x,
    fun _ hf => GrCooperadHom.ext (app_eq_of_genCoef hred fun A _ _ x =>
      (hf A x).trans (genCoef_lift _ x).symm)⟩

name: Operad.FreeGrL.cofreeHomEquiv_apply
statement:
@[simp] lemma cofreeHomEquiv_apply
    (hred : ∀ (B : Type) [Fintype B] [DecidableEq B], Fintype.card B ≤ 1 → ∀ v : V B, v = 0)
    (f : GrCooperadHom R C (FreeGrL R V)) (x : C A) :
    (cofreeHomEquiv hred f).app A x = genCoef R V A (f.app A x)
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: Operad.FreeGrL.existsUnique_lift
statement:
theorem existsUnique_lift
    (hred : ∀ (B : Type) [Fintype B] [DecidableEq B], Fintype.card B ≤ 1 → ∀ v : V B, v = 0)
    (φ : GrSpeciesHom R C V) :
    ∃! f : GrCooperadHom R C (FreeGrL R V), ∀ (A : Type) [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] (x : C A),
      genCoef R V A (f.app A x) = φ.app A x
proof:
:=
  ⟨lift (Classical.choice (exists_genLift hred φ)), fun _ _ _ x => genCoef_lift _ x,
    fun _ hf => GrCooperadHom.ext (app_eq_of_genCoef hred fun A _ _ x =>
      (hf A x).trans (genCoef_lift _ x).symm)⟩

name: Operad.FreeGrL.unitSpan_le_ker
statement:
lemma unitSpan_le_ker
    (hred : ∀ (B : Type) [Fintype B] [DecidableEq B], Fintype.card B ≤ 1 → ∀ v : V B, v = 0)
    (φ : GrSpeciesHom R C V) (A : Type) [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] :
    GrCooperad.unitSpan R C A ≤ LinearMap.ker (φ.app A)
proof:
:=
  Submodule.span_le.2 fun _ ⟨e, he⟩ => LinearMap.mem_ker.2
    (hred A (by rw [← Fintype.card_congr e, Fintype.card_unit]) _)

name: Operad.FreeGrL.cofreeHomEquivRed_apply
statement:
lemma cofreeHomEquivRed_apply
    (hred : ∀ (B : Type) [Fintype B] [DecidableEq B], Fintype.card B ≤ 1 → ∀ v : V B, v = 0)
    (f : GrCooperadHom R C (FreeGrL R V)) (x : C A) :
    (cofreeHomEquivRed hred f).app A (GrCooperad.Red.proj R C A x)
      = genCoef R V A (f.app A x)
proof:
:= by
  rw [cofreeHomEquivRed, Equiv.trans_apply]
  rfl

name: Operad.GrOperad.Inv.parI_apply
statement:
@[simp] lemma parI_apply (b : Bool) (q : Inv R Q) (A : Type) [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] :
    (parI b q).1 A = par (R := R) b (q.1 A)
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.GrOperad.Inv.isPar_parI
statement: lemma isPar_parI (b : Bool) (q : Inv R Q) : IsPar b (parI b q)
proof:
:= fun A _ _ => by
  show par (R := R) b (par (R := R) b (q.1 A)) = par (R := R) b (q.1 A)
  rw [par_par, if_pos rfl]

name: Operad.GrOperad.Inv.parI_add
statement: lemma parI_add (q : Inv R Q) : parI false q + parI true q = q
proof:
:=
  Subtype.ext (funext fun A => funext fun _ => funext fun _ => par_add (R := R) (q.1 A))

name: Operad.GrOperad.Inv.parI_eq
statement:
lemma parI_eq {b : Bool} {q : Inv R Q} (hq : IsPar b q) (c : Bool) :
    parI c q = if c = b then q else 0
proof:
:= by
  refine Subtype.ext (funext fun A => funext fun _ => funext fun _ => ?_)
  show par (R := R) c (q.1 A) = (if c = b then q else 0 : Inv R Q).1 A
  by_cases h : c = b
  · subst h
    rw [if_pos rfl]
    exact hq A
  · rw [if_neg h, ← hq A, par_par, if_neg h]
    rfl

name: Operad.GrOperad.Inv.IsPar.add
statement:
lemma IsPar.add {b : Bool} {q q' : Inv R Q} (hq : IsPar b q) (hq' : IsPar b q') :
    IsPar b (q + q')
proof:
:= fun A _ _ => by
  show par (R := R) b (q.1 A + q'.1 A) = q.1 A + q'.1 A
  rw [map_add, hq A, hq' A]

name: Operad.GrOperad.Inv.IsPar.sub
statement:
lemma IsPar.sub {b : Bool} {q q' : Inv R Q} (hq : IsPar b q) (hq' : IsPar b q') :
    IsPar b (q - q')
proof:
:= fun A _ _ => by
  show par (R := R) b (q.1 A - q'.1 A) = q.1 A - q'.1 A
  rw [map_sub, hq A, hq' A]

name: Operad.GrOperad.Inv.IsPar.smul
statement: lemma IsPar.smul {b : Bool} {q : Inv R Q} (c : R) (hq : IsPar b q) : IsPar b (c • q)
proof:
:=
  fun A _ _ => by
    show par (R := R) b (c • q.1 A) = c • q.1 A
    rw [map_smul, hq A]

name: Operad.GrOperad.Inv.isPar_zero
statement: lemma isPar_zero (b : Bool) : IsPar b (0 : Inv R Q)
proof:
:= fun A _ _ => by
  show par (R := R) b 0 = 0
  rw [map_zero]

name: Operad.GrOperad.Inv.bracket_apply
statement:
lemma bracket_apply (q q' : Inv R Q) :
    bracket R Q q q' = star R Q q q'
      - ∑ b : Bool, ∑ b' : Bool, σ R (b && b') • star R Q (parI b' q') (parI b q)
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.GrOperad.Inv.bracket_hom
statement:
theorem bracket_hom {p p' : Bool} {q q' : Inv R Q} (hq : IsPar p q) (hq' : IsPar p' q') :
    bracket R Q q q' = star R Q q q' - σ R (p && p') • star R Q q' q
proof:
:= by
  rw [bracket_apply, Fintype.sum_bool, Fintype.sum_bool, Fintype.sum_bool]
  simp only [parI_eq hq, parI_eq hq']
  cases p <;> cases p' <;> simp

name: Operad.GrOperad.Inv.isPar_bracket
statement:
theorem isPar_bracket {p p' : Bool} {q q' : Inv R Q} (hq : IsPar p q) (hq' : IsPar p' q') :
    IsPar (xor p p') (bracket R Q q q')
proof:
:= by
  rw [bracket_hom hq hq']
  refine (isPar_star hq hq').sub ((Bool.xor_comm p' p) ▸ (isPar_star hq' hq).smul _)

name: Operad.GrOperad.Inv.bracket_swap
statement:
theorem bracket_swap {p p' : Bool} {q q' : Inv R Q} (hq : IsPar p q) (hq' : IsPar p' q') :
    bracket R Q q q' = -(σ R (p && p') • bracket R Q q' q)
proof:
:= by
  rw [bracket_hom hq hq', bracket_hom hq' hq, Bool.and_comm p' p, smul_sub, smul_smul,
    σ_mul_self, one_smul]
  abel

name: Operad.GrOperad.Inv.jacobi
statement:
theorem jacobi {p p' p'' : Bool} {q q' q'' : Inv R Q} (hq : IsPar p q) (hq' : IsPar p' q')
    (hq'' : IsPar p'' q'') :
    σ R (p && p'') • bracket R Q q (bracket R Q q' q'')
      + σ R (p' && p) • bracket R Q q' (bracket R Q q'' q)
      + σ R (p'' && p') • bracket R Q q'' (bracket R Q q q') = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [bracket_hom hq (isPar_bracket hq' hq''), bracket_hom hq' (isPar_bracket hq'' hq),
    bracket_hom hq'' (isPar_bracket hq hq'), bracket_hom hq' hq'', bracket_hom hq'' hq,
    bracket_hom hq hq']
  have h1 := preLie q q' q'' hq' hq''
  have h2 := preLie q' q'' q hq'' hq
  have h3 := preLie q'' q q' hq hq'
  simp only [map_sub, map_smul, LinearMap.sub_apply, LinearMap.smul_apply] at h1 h2 h3 ⊢
  linear_combination (norm := skip)
    (-σ R (p && p'')) • h1 - σ R (p' && p) • h2 - σ R (p'' && p') • h3
  cases p <;> cases p' <;> cases p'' <;>
    simp only [Bool.and_true, Bool.and_false, Bool.xor_true, Bool.xor_false, Bool.not_true,
      Bool.not_false, σ_true, σ_false] <;> module

name: Operad.GrOperad.Inv.appHom_parI
statement:
lemma appHom_parI (φ : GrOperadHom R Q Q') (b : Bool) (q : Inv R Q) :
    appHom φ (parI b q) = parI b (appHom φ q)
proof:
:=
  Subtype.ext (funext fun A => funext fun _ => funext fun _ => φ.app_par b (q.1 A))

name: Operad.GrOperad.Inv.appHom_bracket
statement:
theorem appHom_bracket (φ : GrOperadHom R Q Q') (q q' : Inv R Q) :
    appHom φ (bracket R Q q q') = bracket R Q' (appHom φ q) (appHom φ q')
proof:
:= by
  simp only [bracket_apply, map_sub, map_sum, map_smul, appHom_star, appHom_parI]

name: Operad.GrOperad.Inv.appDer_bracket
statement:
theorem appDer_bracket {e p p' : Bool} (D : GrDer (GrOperadHom.id R Q) e) {q q' : Inv R Q}
    (hq : IsPar p q) (hq' : IsPar p' q') :
    appDer D (bracket R Q q q')
      = bracket R Q (appDer D q) q' + σ R (e && p) • bracket R Q q (appDer D q')
proof:
:= by
  rw [bracket_hom hq hq', bracket_hom (isPar_appDer D hq) hq',
    bracket_hom hq (isPar_appDer D hq'), map_sub, map_smul, appDer_star D hq,
    appDer_star D hq']
  cases e <;> cases p <;> cases p' <;>
    simp only [Bool.and_true, Bool.and_false, Bool.xor_true, Bool.xor_false, Bool.not_true,
      Bool.not_false, σ_true, σ_false] <;> module

name: Operad.GrOperad.Inv.bracket_self_odd
statement:
theorem bracket_self_odd {α : Inv R Q} (hα : IsPar true α) :
    bracket R Q α α = (2 : R) • star R Q α α
proof:
:= by
  rw [bracket_hom hα hα, Bool.and_self, σ_true, neg_one_smul_inv, sub_neg_eq_add, two_smul]

name: Operad.GrOperad.Inv.bracket_bracket_odd
proof:
:= by
  rw [bracket_hom hα (isPar_bracket hα hx), bracket_hom hα hx,
    bracket_hom (isPar_star hα hα) hx]
  have h1 := preLie α α x hα hx
  have h2 := assoc_odd x α hα
  simp only [map_sub, map_smul, LinearMap.sub_apply, LinearMap.smul_apply] at h1 ⊢
  linear_combination (norm := skip) -h1 - h2
  cases p <;>
    simp only [Bool.and_true, Bool.and_false, Bool.xor_true, Bool.xor_false, Bool.not_true,
      σ_true, σ_false] <;> module

name: Operad.GrOperad.Inv.twD_apply
statement:
lemma twD_apply (D : GrDer (GrOperadHom.id R Q) true) (α x : Inv R Q) :
    twD D α x = appDer D x + bracket R Q α x
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.GrOperad.Inv.isPar_twD
statement:
theorem isPar_twD (D : GrDer (GrOperadHom.id R Q) true) {α : Inv R Q} (hα : IsPar true α)
    {p : Bool} {x : Inv R Q} (hx : IsPar p x) : IsPar (!p) (twD D α x)
proof:
:= by
  rw [twD_apply]
  have h1 := isPar_appDer D hx
  have h2 := isPar_bracket hα hx
  rw [Bool.xor_true] at h1
  rw [Bool.true_xor] at h2
  exact h1.add h2

name: Operad.GrOperad.Inv.twD_twD_hom
statement:
theorem twD_twD_hom (D : GrDer (GrOperadHom.id R Q) true)
    (hD : ∀ x : Inv R Q, appDer D (appDer D x) = 0) {α : Inv R Q} (hα : IsPar true α)
    (hmc : appDer D α + star R Q α α = 0) {p : Bool} {x : Inv R Q} (hx : IsPar p x) :
    twD D α (twD D α x) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have h : bracket R Q (appDer D α) x + bracket R Q (star R Q α α) x = 0 := by
    rw [← LinearMap.add_apply, ← map_add, hmc, map_zero, LinearMap.zero_apply]
  rw [twD_apply, twD_apply, map_add, map_add, hD, appDer_bracket D hα hx,
    bracket_bracket_odd hα hx, Bool.and_self, σ_true, neg_one_smul_inv]
  linear_combination (norm := module) h

name: Operad.GrOperad.Inv.twD_twD
statement:
theorem twD_twD (D : GrDer (GrOperadHom.id R Q) true)
    (hD : ∀ x : Inv R Q, appDer D (appDer D x) = 0) {α : Inv R Q} (hα : IsPar true α)
    (hmc : appDer D α + star R Q α α = 0) (x : Inv R Q) : twD D α (twD D α x) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [← parI_add x, map_add, map_add, twD_twD_hom D hD hα hmc (isPar_parI false x),
    twD_twD_hom D hD hα hmc (isPar_parI true x), add_zero]

name: Operad.Twisting.convD_convD
statement:
lemma convD_convD (x : GrOperad.Inv R (ConvOp R C P)) :
    GrOperad.Inv.appDer (convD R C P) (GrOperad.Inv.appDer (convD R C P) x) = 0
proof:
:= by
  refine Subtype.ext (funext fun A => funext fun _ => funext fun _ => ConvOp.ext fun y => ?_)
  rw [ConvOp.appDer_postDer_apply, ConvOp.appDer_postDer_apply]
  exact DGOperad.d_d _

name: Operad.Twisting.twD_twD
statement:
theorem twD_twD (α : Twisting R C P) (x : GrOperad.Inv R (ConvOp R C P)) :
    GrOperad.Inv.twD (convD R C P) α.1 (GrOperad.Inv.twD (convD R C P) α.1 x) = 0
proof:
:=
  GrOperad.Inv.twD_twD _ convD_convD α.2.1 α.2.2.2 x

name: Operad.Twisting.mc_bracket
statement:
theorem mc_bracket [Invertible (2 : R)] {α : GrOperad.Inv R (ConvOp R C P)}
    (hα : GrOperad.Inv.IsPar true α) :
    GrOperad.Inv.appDer (convD R C P) α + GrOperad.Inv.star R _ α α = 0
      ↔ GrOperad.Inv.appDer (convD R C P) α
          + ⅟(2 : R) • GrOperad.Inv.bracket R _ α α = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [GrOperad.Inv.bracket_self_odd hα, smul_smul, invOf_mul_self, one_smul]

name: Operad.GrOperad.tw_tw'
statement:
lemma tw_tw' (e e' : Bool) (x : P A) :
    tw (R := R) e (tw (R := R) e' x) = tw (R := R) (xor e e') x
proof:
:= by
  cases e <;> cases e' <;> simp

name: Operad.GrDer.gcomm_app
statement:
@[simp] lemma gcomm_app (D : GrDer (GrOperadHom.id R P) e) (D' : GrDer (GrOperadHom.id R P) e')
    {A : Type} [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] (x : P A) :
    (D.gcomm D').app A x = D.app A (D'.app A x) - σ R (e && e') • D'.app A (D.app A x)
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.GrSpEnd.ext
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨φa, _, _⟩ := φ
  obtain ⟨ψa, _, _⟩ := ψ
  have : @φa = @ψa := by
    funext A _ _
    exact LinearMap.ext (h A)
  subst this
  rfl

name: Operad.GrSpEnd.id_app
statement:
@[simp] lemma id_app {A : Type} [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] (x : V A) :
    (id R V).app A x = x
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.GrSpEnd.zero_app
statement:
@[simp] lemma zero_app {A : Type} [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] (x : V A) :
    (zero R V e).app A x = 0
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.GrSpEnd.comp_app
statement:
@[simp] lemma comp_app (φ : GrSpEnd R V e) (ψ : GrSpEnd R V e') {A : Type} [Fintype A]
    [DecidableEq A] (x : V A) : (φ.comp ψ).app A x = φ.app A (ψ.app A x)
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.GrSpEnd.sub_app
statement:
@[simp] lemma sub_app (φ ψ : GrSpEnd R V e) {A : Type} [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] (x : V A) :
    (φ.sub ψ).app A x = φ.app A x - ψ.app A x
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.GrSpEnd.add_app
statement:
@[simp] lemma add_app (φ ψ : GrSpEnd R V e) {A : Type} [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] (x : V A) :
    (φ.add ψ).app A x = φ.app A x + ψ.app A x
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.GrSpEnd.smul_app
statement:
@[simp] lemma smul_app (a : R) (φ : GrSpEnd R V e) {A : Type} [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A]
    (x : V A) : (φ.smul a).app A x = a • φ.app A x
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.GrSpEnd.gcomm_app
statement:
@[simp] lemma gcomm_app (φ : GrSpEnd R V e) (ψ : GrSpEnd R V e') {A : Type} [Fintype A]
    [DecidableEq A] (x : V A) :
    (φ.gcomm ψ).app A x = φ.app A (ψ.app A x) - σ R (e && e') • ψ.app A (φ.app A x)
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.GrSpEnd.toHom_app
statement:
@[simp] lemma toHom_app (φ : GrSpEnd R V false) {A : Type} [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A]
    (x : V A) : φ.toHom.app A x = φ.app A x
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.GrSpeciesHom.comp_app
statement:
@[simp] lemma GrSpeciesHom.comp_app {U : (A : Type) → [Fintype A] → [DecidableEq A] → Type*}
    [∀ (A : Type) [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A], AddCommGroup (U A)]
    [∀ (A : Type) [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A], Module R (U A)] [GrSpecies R U]
    (ψ : GrSpeciesHom R W U) (φ : GrSpeciesHom R V W) {A : Type} [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A]
    (x : V A) : (ψ.comp φ).app A x = ψ.app A (φ.app A x)
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.FreeGrL.isShift_genSp
statement: lemma isShift_genSp (φ : GrSpEnd R V e) : IsShift (genSp φ) e
proof:
:= by
  intro A _ _ c v
  show (ι R V).app A (φ.app A (GrSpecies.par (R := R) c v)) = _
  rw [φ.app_par]
  exact (ι R V).app_par _ _

name: Operad.FreeGrL.derSp_ι
statement:
@[simp] lemma derSp_ι (φ : GrSpEnd R V e) {A : Type} [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] (v : V A) :
    (derSp φ).app A ((ι R V).app A v) = (ι R V).app A (φ.app A v)
proof:
:=
  derOf_ι _ _ _ v

name: Operad.FreeGrL.derSp_gcomm
statement:
theorem derSp_gcomm (φ : GrSpEnd R V e) (ψ : GrSpEnd R V e') :
    (derSp φ).gcomm (derSp ψ) = derSp (φ.gcomm ψ)
proof:
:=
  der_ext fun A _ _ v => by
    rw [GrDer.gcomm_app, derSp_ι, derSp_ι, derSp_ι, derSp_ι, derSp_ι, GrSpEnd.gcomm_app,
      map_sub, map_smul]

name: Operad.FreeGrL.derSp_gcomm_app
statement:
lemma derSp_gcomm_app (φ : GrSpEnd R V e) (ψ : GrSpEnd R V e') {A : Type} [Fintype A]
    [DecidableEq A] (x : FreeGrL R V A) :
    (derSp φ).app A ((derSp ψ).app A x) - σ R (e && e') • (derSp ψ).app A ((derSp φ).app A x)
      = (derSp (φ.gcomm ψ)).app A x
proof:
:= by
  rw [← derSp_gcomm]
  rfl

name: Operad.FreeGrL.derSp_zero_app
statement:
lemma derSp_zero_app {A : Type} [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] (x : FreeGrL R V A) :
    (derSp (GrSpEnd.zero R V e)).app A x = 0
proof:
:= by
  have : derSp (GrSpEnd.zero R V e) = GrDer.zero _ e :=
    der_eq_zero fun A _ _ v => by rw [derSp_ι, GrSpEnd.zero_app, map_zero]
  rw [this]
  rfl

name: Operad.FreeGrL.derSp_congr
statement:
lemma derSp_congr {φ ψ : GrSpEnd R V e}
    (h : ∀ (A : Type) [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] (x : V A), φ.app A x = ψ.app A x)
    {A : Type} [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] (x : FreeGrL R V A) :
    (derSp φ).app A x = (derSp ψ).app A x
proof:
:= by
  rw [GrSpEnd.ext h]

name: Operad.FreeGrL.mapSp_ι
statement:
@[simp] lemma mapSp_ι (φ : GrSpeciesHom R V W) {A : Type} [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] (v : V A) :
    (mapSp φ).app A ((ι R V).app A v) = (ι R W).app A (φ.app A v)
proof:
:=
  homEquiv_symm_ι _ v

name: Operad.FreeGrL.mapSp_comp
statement:
lemma mapSp_comp {U : (A : Type) → [Fintype A] → [DecidableEq A] → Type*}
    [∀ (A : Type) [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A], AddCommGroup (U A)]
    [∀ (A : Type) [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A], Module R (U A)] [GrSpecies R U]
    (ψ : GrSpeciesHom R W U) (φ : GrSpeciesHom R V W) {A : Type} [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A]
    (x : FreeGrL R V A) : (mapSp ψ).app A ((mapSp φ).app A x) = (mapSp (ψ.comp φ)).app A x
proof:
:= by
  have : (mapSp ψ).comp (mapSp φ) = mapSp (ψ.comp φ) := hom_ext fun A _ _ v => by
    rw [GrOperadHom.comp_app, mapSp_ι, mapSp_ι, mapSp_ι, GrSpeciesHom.comp_app]
  exact congrArg (fun g : GrOperadHom R (FreeGrL R V) (FreeGrL R U) => g.app A x) this

name: Operad.FreeGrL.mapSp_congr
statement:
lemma mapSp_congr {φ ψ : GrSpeciesHom R V W}
    (h : ∀ (A : Type) [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] (x : V A), φ.app A x = ψ.app A x)
    {A : Type} [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] (x : FreeGrL R V A) :
    (mapSp φ).app A x = (mapSp ψ).app A x
proof:
:= by
  rw [GrSpeciesHom.ext h]

name: Operad.FreeGrL.mapSp_id
statement:
lemma mapSp_id {A : Type} [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] (x : FreeGrL R V A) :
    (mapSp (GrSpEnd.id R V).toHom).app A x = x
proof:
:= by
  have : mapSp (GrSpEnd.id R V).toHom = GrOperadHom.id R (FreeGrL R V) := hom_ext fun A _ _ v => by
    rw [mapSp_ι]
    rfl
  rw [this]
  rfl

name: Operad.FreeGrL.derSp_mapSp
statement:
theorem derSp_mapSp {a : GrSpEnd R V e} {b : GrSpEnd R W e} {φ : GrSpeciesHom R V W}
    (h : ∀ (A : Type) [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] (v : V A),
      b.app A (φ.app A v) = φ.app A (a.app A v))
    {A : Type} [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] (x : FreeGrL R V A) :
    (derSp b).app A ((mapSp φ).app A x) = (mapSp φ).app A ((derSp a).app A x)
proof:
:= by
  have : (derSp b).compHom (mapSp φ) = GrDer.homComp (mapSp φ) (derSp a) :=
    der_ext fun A _ _ v => by
      rw [GrDer.compHom_app, GrDer.homComp_app, mapSp_ι, derSp_ι, derSp_ι, mapSp_ι, h]
  exact congrArg (fun D : GrDer (mapSp φ) e => D.app A x) this

name: Operad.FreeGrL.mem_of_single'
statement:
private lemma mem_of_single' {α : Type*} {M : Type*} [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M]
    {S : Submodule R M} (f : (α →₀ R) →ₗ[R] M) (h : ∀ a, f (Finsupp.single a 1) ∈ S)
    (x : α →₀ R) : f x ∈ S
proof:
:= by
  induction x using Finsupp.induction_linear with
  | zero => rw [map_zero]; exact S.zero_mem
  | add x y hx hy => rw [map_add]; exact S.add_mem hx hy
  | single a b =>
    rw [← Finsupp.smul_single_one, map_smul]
    exact S.smul_mem b (h a)

name: Operad.FreeGrL.submodule_eq_top
statement:
theorem submodule_eq_top (S : ∀ (A : Type) [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A], Submodule R (FreeGrL R V A))
    (hunit : ∀ (A : Type) [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] (e : Unit ≃ A),
      GrOperad.map (R := R) e (GrOperad.one (R := R) (P := FreeGrL R V)) ∈ S A)
    (hgen : ∀ (n : ℕ) (v : V (Fin n)), (ι R V).app (Fin n) v ∈ S (Fin n))
    (hmap : ∀ (A B : Type) [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] [Fintype B] [DecidableEq B] (e : A ≃ B)
      (x : FreeGrL R V A), x ∈ S A → GrOperad.map (R := R) e x ∈ S B)
    (hcomp : ∀ (A B : Type) [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] [Fintype B] [DecidableEq B] (i : A)
      (x : FreeGrL R V A) (y : FreeGrL R V B), x ∈ S A → y ∈ S B →
        GrOperad.comp (R := R) i x y ∈ S (Without A i ⊕ B))
    (A : Type) [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] : S A = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  have hbas : ∀ (X : Type) [Fintype X] [DecidableEq X] (x : Reg (TreeOfArity (GrGen R V)) X),
      (𝒥).proj X (𝔟 x) ∈ S X :=
    tree_induction (motive := fun X _ _ x => (𝒥).proj X (𝔟 x) ∈ S X)
      (fun X _ _ x hl => by
        beta_reduce
        obtain ⟨e, he⟩ := proj_bas_leaf hl
        rw [he]
        exact hunit X e)
      (fun X _ _ k g e => by
        beta_reduce
        rw [proj_bas_map, proj_bas_corolla]
        exact hmap _ _ e _ (hgen k _))
      (fun X A B _ _ _ _ _ _ r p q e _ _ hp hq => by
        beta_reduce at hp hq ⊢
        rw [proj_bas_map, proj_bas_comp]
        exact hmap _ _ e _ (Submodule.smul_mem _ _ (hcomp _ _ r _ _ hp hq)))
  refine eq_top_iff.2 fun Y _ => ?_
  have h := Function.surjInv_eq ((𝒥).proj_surjective A) Y
  rw [← h]
  exact mem_of_single' ((𝒥).proj A) (fun x => hbas A x) _

name: Operad.eq_zero_of_eigen_neg
statement:
lemma _root_.Operad.eq_zero_of_eigen_neg [Algebra ℚ R] {M : Type*} [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M]
    (E : M →ₗ[R] M) (htop : ⨆ j : ℕ, Module.End.eigenspace E (j : R) = ⊤) {m : ℕ} (hm : m ≠ 0)
    {x : M} (hx : E x = -(m : R) • x) : x = 0
proof:
:= by
  set E' : M →ₗ[R] M := E + (m : R) • LinearMap.id
  have h0 : x ∈ Module.End.eigenspace E' ((0 : ℕ) : R) := by
    rw [Module.End.mem_eigenspace_iff, Nat.cast_zero, zero_smul]
    show E x + (m : R) • x = 0
    rw [hx, neg_smul, neg_add_cancel]
  have h1 : x ∈ ⨆ (j : ℕ) (_ : j ≠ 0), Module.End.eigenspace E' (j : R) := by
    have hle : (⨆ j : ℕ, Module.End.eigenspace E (j : R))
        ≤ ⨆ (j : ℕ) (_ : j ≠ 0), Module.End.eigenspace E' (j : R) := iSup_le fun j => by
      intro y hy
      have hy' : y ∈ Module.End.eigenspace E' ((j + m : ℕ) : R) := by
        rw [Module.End.mem_eigenspace_iff] at hy ⊢
        show E y + (m : R) • y = _
        rw [hy, Nat.cast_add, add_smul]
      exact Submodule.mem_iSup_of_mem (j + m) (Submodule.mem_iSup_of_mem (by omega) hy')
    exact hle (htop ▸ Submodule.mem_top)
  exact Submodule.disjoint_def.1 (iSupIndep_eigenspace_nat E' 0) x h0 h1

name: Operad.FreeGrL.mem_eig
statement:
lemma mem_eig {j : ℕ} {A : Type} [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] {x : FreeGrL R V A} :
    x ∈ eig R V a j A ↔ (derSp a).app A x = (j : R) • x
proof:
:=
  Module.End.mem_eigenspace_iff

name: Operad.FreeGrL.unit_mem_eig
statement:
lemma unit_mem_eig {A : Type} [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] (e : Unit ≃ A) :
    GrOperad.map (R := R) e (GrOperad.one (R := R) (P := FreeGrL R V)) ∈ eig R V a 0 A
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_eig, Nat.cast_zero, zero_smul]
  exact ((derSp a).app_map e _).trans ((congrArg _ (derSp a).app_one).trans (map_zero _))

name: Operad.FreeGrL.map_mem_eig
statement:
lemma map_mem_eig {A B : Type} [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] [Fintype B] [DecidableEq B]
    (e : A ≃ B) {j : ℕ} {x : FreeGrL R V A} (hx : x ∈ eig R V a j A) :
    GrOperad.map (R := R) e x ∈ eig R V a j B
proof:
:=
  mem_eig.2 (((derSp a).app_map e x).trans ((congrArg _ (mem_eig.1 hx)).trans (map_smul _ _ _)))

name: Operad.FreeGrL.comp_mem_eig
statement:
lemma comp_mem_eig {A B : Type} [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] [Fintype B] [DecidableEq B] (r : A)
    {i j : ℕ} {x : FreeGrL R V A} {y : FreeGrL R V B} (hx : x ∈ eig R V a i A)
    (hy : y ∈ eig R V a j B) : GrOperad.comp (R := R) r x y ∈ eig R V a (i + j) _
proof:
:= by
  refine mem_eig.2 (((derSp a).app_comp r x y).trans ?_)
  rw [GrOperadHom.id_app, GrOperadHom.id_app, GrOperad.tw_false, mem_eig.1 hx, mem_eig.1 hy,
    LinearMap.map_smul₂, map_smul, ← add_smul, Nat.cast_add]

name: Operad.FreeGrL.comp_mem_of_iSup
proof:
:= by
  refine Submodule.iSup_induction p (motive := fun x => GrOperad.comp (R := R) r x y ∈ T) hx
    (fun i x hx => ?_) (by beta_reduce; rw [LinearMap.map_zero₂]; exact T.zero_mem)
    (fun x x' hx hx' => by beta_reduce at hx hx' ⊢; rw [LinearMap.map_add₂]; exact T.add_mem hx hx')
  exact Submodule.iSup_induction q (motive := fun y => GrOperad.comp (R := R) r x y ∈ T) hy
    (fun k y hy => h i k x hx y hy) (by beta_reduce; rw [map_zero]; exact T.zero_mem)
    (fun y y' hy hy' => by beta_reduce at hy hy' ⊢; rw [map_add]; exact T.add_mem hy hy')

name: Operad.FreeGrL.map_mem_iSup
statement:
lemma map_mem_iSup {A B : Type} [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] [Fintype B] [DecidableEq B]
    (e : A ≃ B) (f : ℕ → ℕ) {x : FreeGrL R V A} (hx : x ∈ ⨆ j, eig R V a (f j) A) :
    GrOperad.map (R := R) e x ∈ ⨆ j, eig R V a (f j) B
proof:
:=
  Submodule.iSup_induction _ (motive := fun x => GrOperad.map (R := R) e x ∈ _) hx
    (fun j x hx => Submodule.mem_iSup_of_mem j (map_mem_eig e hx))
    (by beta_reduce; rw [map_zero]; exact zero_mem _)
    (fun x x' hx hx' => by beta_reduce at hx hx' ⊢; rw [map_add]; exact add_mem hx hx')

name: Operad.FreeGrL.ι_mem_iSup_eig
proof:
:=
  Submodule.iSup_induction _ (motive := fun v => (ι R V).app A v ∈ _) hv
    (fun j v hv => Submodule.mem_iSup_of_mem j (mem_eig.2 (by
      rw [derSp_ι, Module.End.mem_eigenspace_iff.1 hv, map_smul])))
    (by beta_reduce; rw [map_zero]; exact zero_mem _)
    (fun x x' hx hx' => by beta_reduce at hx hx' ⊢; rw [map_add]; exact add_mem hx hx')

name: Operad.FreeGrL.iSup_eig_eq_top
statement:
theorem iSup_eig_eq_top
    (hgen : ∀ (A : Type) [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] (v : V A),
      v ∈ ⨆ j : ℕ, Module.End.eigenspace (a.app A) (j : R))
    (A : Type) [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] : ⨆ j : ℕ, eig R V a j A = ⊤
proof:
:=
  submodule_eq_top (fun A _ _ => ⨆ j : ℕ, eig R V a j A)
    (fun _ _ _ e => Submodule.mem_iSup_of_mem 0 (unit_mem_eig e))
    (fun _ v => ι_mem_iSup_eig (hgen _ v))
    (fun _ _ _ _ _ _ e _ hx => map_mem_iSup e id hx)
    (fun _ _ _ _ _ _ r _ _ hx hy => comp_mem_of_iSup r
      (fun i k _ hx _ hy => Submodule.mem_iSup_of_mem (i + k) (comp_mem_eig r hx hy)) hx hy) A

name: Operad.FreeGrL.isInternal_eig
statement:
theorem isInternal_eig [Algebra ℚ R]
    (hgen : ∀ (A : Type) [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] (v : V A),
      v ∈ ⨆ j : ℕ, Module.End.eigenspace (a.app A) (j : R))
    (A : Type) [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] : DirectSum.IsInternal fun j : ℕ => eig R V a j A
proof:
:=
  DirectSum.isInternal_submodule_of_iSupIndep_of_iSup_eq_top
    (iSupIndep_eigenspace_nat ((derSp a).app A)) (iSup_eig_eq_top hgen A)

name: Operad.FreeGrL.GrSpEnd.compl_app
statement:
@[simp] lemma GrSpEnd.compl_app {A : Type} [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] (x : V A) :
    (GrSpEnd.compl R V π).app A x = x - π.app A x
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.FreeGrL.mem_iSup_compl
statement:
lemma mem_iSup_compl {A : Type} [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] (v : V A) :
    v ∈ ⨆ j : ℕ, Module.End.eigenspace ((GrSpEnd.compl R V π).app A) (j : R)
proof:
:= by
  have h0 : π.app A v ∈ Module.End.eigenspace ((GrSpEnd.compl R V π).app A) ((0 : ℕ) : R) := by
    rw [Module.End.mem_eigenspace_iff, GrSpEnd.compl_app, hπ, sub_self, Nat.cast_zero, zero_smul]
  have h1 : v - π.app A v
      ∈ Module.End.eigenspace ((GrSpEnd.compl R V π).app A) ((1 : ℕ) : R) := by
    rw [Module.End.mem_eigenspace_iff, GrSpEnd.compl_app, map_sub, hπ, sub_self, sub_zero,
      Nat.cast_one, one_smul]
  have : v = π.app A v + (v - π.app A v) := by abel
  rw [this]
  exact add_mem (Submodule.mem_iSup_of_mem 0 h0) (Submodule.mem_iSup_of_mem 1 h1)

name: Operad.FreeGrL.derSp_compl_mapSp
statement:
lemma derSp_compl_mapSp {A : Type} [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] (x : FreeGrL R V A) :
    (derSp (GrSpEnd.compl R V π)).app A ((mapSp π.toHom).app A x) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [derSp_mapSp (a := GrSpEnd.zero R V false) (fun A _ _ v => by
    rw [GrSpEnd.compl_app, GrSpEnd.toHom_app, hπ, sub_self, GrSpEnd.zero_app, map_zero]),
    derSp_zero_app, map_zero]

name: Operad.FreeGrL.mapSp_derSp_compl
statement:
lemma mapSp_derSp_compl {A : Type} [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] (x : FreeGrL R V A) :
    (mapSp π.toHom).app A ((derSp (GrSpEnd.compl R V π)).app A x) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [← derSp_mapSp (b := GrSpEnd.zero R V false) (fun A _ _ v => by
    simp only [GrSpEnd.compl_app, GrSpEnd.toHom_app, map_sub, hπ, sub_self, GrSpEnd.zero_app]),
    derSp_zero_app]

name: Operad.FreeGrL.sub_mapSp_mem
statement:
lemma sub_mapSp_mem {A : Type} [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] (x : FreeGrL R V A) :
    x - (mapSp π.toHom).app A x ∈ ⨆ j : ℕ, eig R V (GrSpEnd.compl R V π) (j + 1) A
proof:
:= by
  set T := mapSp (R := R) (V := V) π.toHom
  have htop := iSup_eig_eq_top (a := GrSpEnd.compl R V π) (fun A _ _ v => mem_iSup_compl π hπ v)
  have hT0 : ∀ (A : Type) [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] (x : FreeGrL R V A),
      T.app A x ∈ eig R V (GrSpEnd.compl R V π) 0 A := fun A _ _ x =>
    mem_eig.2 (by rw [derSp_compl_mapSp π hπ, Nat.cast_zero, zero_smul])
  have h := submodule_eq_top (R := R) (V := V)
    (fun A _ _ => (⨆ j : ℕ, eig R V (GrSpEnd.compl R V π) (j + 1) A).comap
      (LinearMap.id - T.app A))
    (fun A _ _ e => by
      rw [Submodule.mem_comap, LinearMap.sub_apply, LinearMap.id_apply, T.app_map, T.app_one,
        sub_self]
      exact zero_mem _)
    (fun n v => by
      rw [Submodule.mem_comap, LinearMap.sub_apply, LinearMap.id_apply, mapSp_ι,
        GrSpEnd.toHom_app, ← map_sub]
      refine Submodule.mem_iSup_of_mem 0 (mem_eig.2 ?_)
      rw [derSp_ι]
      simp only [GrSpEnd.compl_app, map_sub, hπ, sub_self, sub_zero, zero_add, Nat.cast_one,
        one_smul])
    (fun A B _ _ _ _ e x hx => by
      rw [Submodule.mem_comap, LinearMap.sub_apply, LinearMap.id_apply, T.app_map, ← map_sub]
      exact map_mem_iSup e (· + 1) hx)
    (fun A B _ _ _ _ r x y hx hy => by
      rw [Submodule.mem_comap] at hx hy ⊢
      rw [LinearMap.sub_apply, LinearMap.id_apply, T.app_comp]
      have e : GrOperad.comp (R := R) r x y - GrOperad.comp (R := R) r (T.app A x) (T.app B y)
          = GrOperad.comp (R := R) r (x - T.app A x) y
            + GrOperad.comp (R := R) r (T.app A x) (y - T.app B y) := by
        rw [LinearMap.map_sub₂, map_sub]
        abel
      rw [e]
      refine add_mem (comp_mem_of_iSup r (fun i k x hx y hy => ?_) hx
        (htop B ▸ Submodule.mem_top : y ∈ ⨆ j : ℕ, eig R V (GrSpEnd.compl R V π) j B))
        (comp_mem_of_iSup (p := fun _ : Unit => eig R V (GrSpEnd.compl R V π) 0 A) r
          (fun _ k x hx y hy => ?_) (Submodule.mem_iSup_of_mem () (hT0 A x)) hy)
      · exact Submodule.mem_iSup_of_mem (i + k) (by
          rw [show i + k + 1 = i + 1 + k by omega]; exact comp_mem_eig r hx hy)
      · exact Submodule.mem_iSup_of_mem k (by
          rw [show k + 1 = 0 + (k + 1) by omega]; exact comp_mem_eig r hx hy)) A
  have hx : x ∈ (⊤ : Submodule R (FreeGrL R V A)) := Submodule.mem_top
  rw [← h] at hx
  exact hx

name: Operad.FreeGrL.mapSp_eq_self
statement:
theorem mapSp_eq_self [Algebra ℚ R] {A : Type} [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] {x : FreeGrL R V A}
    (hx : x ∈ eig R V (GrSpEnd.compl R V π) 0 A) : (mapSp π.toHom).app A x = x
proof:
:= by
  have h0 : x - (mapSp π.toHom).app A x ∈ eig R V (GrSpEnd.compl R V π) 0 A :=
    sub_mem hx (mem_eig.2 (by rw [derSp_compl_mapSp π hπ, Nat.cast_zero, zero_smul]))
  have h1 : x - (mapSp π.toHom).app A x
      ∈ ⨆ (j : ℕ) (_ : j ≠ 0), eig R V (GrSpEnd.compl R V π) j A :=
    (iSup_le fun j => le_iSup₂_of_le (f := fun (k : ℕ) (_ : k ≠ 0) =>
      eig R V (GrSpEnd.compl R V π) k A) (j + 1) (by omega) le_rfl) (sub_mapSp_mem π hπ x)
  have := Submodule.disjoint_def.1 (iSupIndep_eigenspace_nat _ 0) _ h0 h1
  exact (sub_eq_zero.1 this).symm

name: Operad.FreeGrL.mapSp_eq_zero
statement:
theorem mapSp_eq_zero [Algebra ℚ R] {A : Type} [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] {j : ℕ} (hj : j ≠ 0)
    {x : FreeGrL R V A} (hx : x ∈ eig R V (GrSpEnd.compl R V π) j A) :
    (mapSp π.toHom).app A x = 0
proof:
:= by
  have h := mapSp_derSp_compl π hπ x
  rw [mem_eig.1 hx, map_smul] at h
  exact (isUnit_natCast_of_ne_zero hj).smul_left_cancel.1 (h.trans (smul_zero _).symm)

name: Operad.BTree.OfArity.arity_eq_one_iff
statement: private lemma arity_eq_one_iff {t : BTree E} : t.arity = 1 ↔ t = leaf
proof:
:=
  ⟨eq_leaf_of_arity_eq_one, fun h => h ▸ rfl⟩

name: Operad.BTree.OfArity.eq_cor
statement: lemma eq_cor (t : OfArity E 2) : ∃ e, t = cor e
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := t
  cases t with
  | leaf => simp [arity] at ht
  | node e l r =>
    simp only [arity_node] at ht
    have hl := arity_pos l
    have hr := arity_pos r
    obtain rfl := eq_leaf_of_arity_eq_one (show l.arity = 1 by omega)
    obtain rfl := eq_leaf_of_arity_eq_one (show r.arity = 1 by omega)
    exact ⟨e, rfl⟩

name: Operad.BTree.OfArity.eq_lc_or_rc
statement: lemma eq_lc_or_rc (t : OfArity E 3) : (∃ e e', t = lc e e') ∨ ∃ e e', t = rc e e'
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := t
  cases t with
  | leaf => simp [arity] at ht
  | node e l r =>
    simp only [arity_node] at ht
    have hl := arity_pos l
    have hr := arity_pos r
    by_cases h : l.arity = 1
    · obtain rfl := eq_leaf_of_arity_eq_one h
      obtain ⟨e', he'⟩ := eq_cor (⟨r, by simp at ht; omega⟩ : OfArity E 2)
      have : r = node e' leaf leaf := congrArg Subtype.val he'
      subst this
      exact Or.inr ⟨e, e', rfl⟩
    · obtain rfl := eq_leaf_of_arity_eq_one (show r.arity = 1 by omega)
      obtain ⟨e', he'⟩ := eq_cor (⟨l, by omega⟩ : OfArity E 2)
      have : l = node e' leaf leaf := congrArg Subtype.val he'
      subst this
      exact Or.inl ⟨e, e', rfl⟩

name: Operad.BTree.OfArity.cases_four
statement:
lemma cases_four (t : OfArity E 4) :
    (∃ e₁ e₂ e₃, t = ll e₁ e₂ e₃) ∨ (∃ e₁ e₂ e₃, t = lr e₁ e₂ e₃) ∨
    (∃ e₁ e₂ e₃, t = bl e₁ e₂ e₃) ∨ (∃ e₁ e₂ e₃, t = rl e₁ e₂ e₃) ∨
    (∃ e₁ e₂ e₃, t = rr e₁ e₂ e₃)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := t
  cases t with
  | leaf => simp [arity] at ht
  | node e₁ l r =>
    simp only [arity_node] at ht
    have hl := arity_pos l
    have hr := arity_pos r
    by_cases h1 : l.arity = 1
    · obtain rfl := eq_leaf_of_arity_eq_one h1
      rcases eq_lc_or_rc (⟨r, by simp at ht; omega⟩ : OfArity E 3) with ⟨e₂, e₃, h⟩ | ⟨e₂, e₃, h⟩
      · have : r = (lc e₂ e₃).1 := congrArg Subtype.val h
        subst this
        exact Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inl ⟨e₁, e₂, e₃, rfl⟩)))
      · have : r = (rc e₂ e₃).1 := congrArg Subtype.val h
        subst this
        exact Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inr ⟨e₁, e₂, e₃, rfl⟩)))
    · by_cases h2 : l.arity = 2
      · obtain ⟨e₂, he₂⟩ := eq_cor (⟨l, h2⟩ : OfArity E 2)
        obtain ⟨e₃, he₃⟩ := eq_cor (⟨r, by omega⟩ : OfArity E 2)
        have hl' : l = node e₂ leaf leaf := congrArg Subtype.val he₂
        have hr' : r = node e₃ leaf leaf := congrArg Subtype.val he₃
        subst hl' hr'
        exact Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inl ⟨e₁, e₂, e₃, rfl⟩))
      · obtain rfl := eq_leaf_of_arity_eq_one (show r.arity = 1 by omega)
        rcases eq_lc_or_rc (⟨l, by omega⟩ : OfArity E 3) with ⟨e₂, e₃, h⟩ | ⟨e₂, e₃, h⟩
        · have : l = (lc e₂ e₃).1 := congrArg Subtype.val h
          subst this
          exact Or.inl ⟨e₁, e₂, e₃, rfl⟩
        · have : l = (rc e₂ e₃).1 := congrArg Subtype.val h
          subst this
          exact Or.inr (Or.inl ⟨e₁, e₂, e₃, rfl⟩)

name: Operad.TConv.compFin_apply_graft
statement:
lemma compFin_apply_graft {m n : ℕ} (i : Fin m) (f : TConv R E Q m) (g : TConv R E Q n)
    (t₁ : OfArity E m) (t₂ : OfArity E n) (t : OfArity E (m - 1 + n))
    (h : t₁.1.graft i t₂.1 = t.1) :
    compFin (R := R) i f g t = compFin (R := R) (P := Q) i (f t₁) (g t₂)
proof:
:= by
  have hi := i.isLt
  unfold compFin
  rw [reindex_apply, comp_apply]
  rw [compFun_eq (i : ℕ) (m - i - 1) _ g (OfArity.cast (by omega) t₁) t₂
    (by rw [OfArity.cast_val, OfArity.cast_val]; exact h), reindex_apply]
  simp only [OfArity.cast_cast, OfArity.cast_self]

name: Operad.TConv.compFin_apply_eq_zero
statement:
lemma compFin_apply_eq_zero {m n : ℕ} (i : Fin m) (f : TConv R E Q m) (g : TConv R E Q n)
    (t : OfArity E (m - 1 + n))
    (h : ∀ (t₁ : OfArity E m) (t₂ : OfArity E n), t₁.1.graft i t₂.1 ≠ t.1) :
    compFin (R := R) i f g t = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hi := i.isLt
  unfold compFin
  rw [reindex_apply, comp_apply]
  rw [compFun_eq_zero (i : ℕ) (m - i - 1) _ g (fun t₁ t₂ h' =>
    h (OfArity.cast (by omega) t₁) t₂ (by simpa using h')), map_zero]

name: Operad.TConv.sstar_apply
statement:
lemma sstar_apply {j k : ℕ} (f : TConv R E Q (j + 1)) (g : TConv R E Q (k + 1))
    (t : OfArity E (j + k + 1)) :
    sstar (R := R) f g t
      = ∑ a : Fin (j + 1), ((-1 : R) ^ ((a : ℕ) * k)) • compFin (R := R) a f g t
proof:
:= by
  rw [sstar_def, Finset.sum_apply]
  rfl

name: Operad.TConv.compFin_sum_left
statement:
lemma compFin_sum_left {m n : ℕ} (i : Fin m) {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι) (F : ι → Q m) (y : Q n) :
    compFin (R := R) i (∑ k ∈ s, F k) y = ∑ k ∈ s, compFin (R := R) i (F k) y
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction s using Finset.induction_on with
  | empty => simp
  | insert k s hk ih => rw [Finset.sum_insert hk, Finset.sum_insert hk, compFin_add_left, ih]

name: Operad.TConv.compFin_sum_right
statement:
lemma compFin_sum_right {m n : ℕ} (i : Fin m) (x : Q m) {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι) (F : ι → Q n) :
    compFin (R := R) i x (∑ k ∈ s, F k) = ∑ k ∈ s, compFin (R := R) i x (F k)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction s using Finset.induction_on with
  | empty => simp
  | insert k s hk ih => rw [Finset.sum_insert hk, Finset.sum_insert hk, compFin_add_right, ih]

name: Operad.TConv.graftPair_injective
statement:
lemma graftPair_injective {m n : ℕ} (i : Fin m) :
    Function.Injective (graftPair (E := E) (n := n) i)
proof:
:=
  fun p q h => by
    have h' := BTree.graft_inj p.1.1 q.1.1 i p.2.1 q.2.1 (by rw [p.1.2]; exact i.isLt)
      (by rw [q.1.2]; exact i.isLt) (by rw [p.2.2, q.2.2]) (congrArg Subtype.val h)
    exact Prod.ext (Subtype.ext h'.1) (Subtype.ext h'.2)

name: Operad.TConv.eval_compFin_pairs
statement:
lemma eval_compFin_pairs {m n : ℕ} (i : Fin m) (f : TConv R E Q m) (g : TConv R E Q n)
    (x : Chain R E (m - 1 + n)) :
    eval (compFin (R := R) i f g) x = ∑ p : OfArity E m × OfArity E n,
      sliceOut i p.2 x p.1 • compFin (R := R) (P := Q) i (f p.1) (g p.2)
proof:
:= by
  rw [eval_apply]
  refine (Fintype.sum_of_injective (graftPair i) (graftPair_injective i) _ _ (fun t ht => ?_)
    (fun p => ?_)).symm
  · rw [compFin_apply_eq_zero i f g t (fun t₁ t₂ h => ht ⟨(t₁, t₂), Subtype.ext h⟩), smul_zero]
  · rw [compFin_apply_graft i f g p.1 p.2 _ rfl]
    rfl

name: Operad.TConv.eval_compFin_in
statement:
theorem eval_compFin_in {m n : ℕ} (i : Fin m) (f : TConv R E Q m) (g : TConv R E Q n)
    (x : Chain R E (m - 1 + n)) :
    eval (compFin (R := R) i f g) x
      = ∑ t₁, compFin (R := R) (P := Q) i (f t₁) (eval g (sliceIn i t₁ x))
proof:
:= by
  rw [eval_compFin_pairs, Fintype.sum_prod_type]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun t₁ _ => ?_
  rw [eval_apply, compFin_sum_right]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun t₂ _ => ?_
  rw [compFin_smul_right]
  rfl

name: Operad.TConv.eval_compFin_out
statement:
theorem eval_compFin_out {m n : ℕ} (i : Fin m) (f : TConv R E Q m) (g : TConv R E Q n)
    (x : Chain R E (m - 1 + n)) :
    eval (compFin (R := R) i f g) x
      = ∑ t₂, compFin (R := R) (P := Q) i (eval f (sliceOut i t₂ x)) (g t₂)
proof:
:= by
  rw [eval_compFin_pairs, Fintype.sum_prod_type_right]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun t₂ _ => ?_
  rw [eval_apply, compFin_sum_left]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun t₁ _ => ?_
  rw [compFin_smul_left]

name: Operad.TConv.eval_sum
statement:
lemma eval_sum {n : ℕ} {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι) (F : ι → TConv R E Q n) (x : Chain R E n) :
    eval (∑ k ∈ s, F k) x = ∑ k ∈ s, eval (F k) x
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction s using Finset.induction_on with
  | empty => simp
  | insert k s hk ih => rw [Finset.sum_insert hk, Finset.sum_insert hk, eval_add, ih]

name: Operad.TConv.eval_sstar
statement:
theorem eval_sstar {j k : ℕ} (f : TConv R E Q (j + 1)) (g : TConv R E Q (k + 1))
    (x : Chain R E (j + k + 1)) :
    eval (sstar (R := R) f g) x
      = ∑ a : Fin (j + 1), ((-1 : R) ^ ((a : ℕ) * k)) • eval (compFin (R := R) a f g) x
proof:
:= by
  rw [sstar_def]
  show eval (∑ a : Fin (j + 1), ((-1 : R) ^ ((a : ℕ) * k)) •
    (compFin (R := R) a f g : TConv R E Q (j + k + 1))) x = _
  rw [eval_sum]
  exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun a _ => eval_smul _ _ _

name: Operad.TConv.sum_ofArity_two
statement:
lemma sum_ofArity_two {M : Type*} [AddCommMonoid M] (F : OfArity E 2 → M) :
    ∑ t, F t = ∑ e, F (cor e)
proof:
:= by
  refine (Fintype.sum_bijective cor ⟨fun a b h => ?_, fun t => ?_⟩ _ _ fun _ => rfl).symm
  · have := congrArg Subtype.val h
    simpa [cor, corolla] using this
  · obtain ⟨e, rfl⟩ := eq_cor t
    exact ⟨e, rfl⟩

name: Operad.TConv.sstar_apply_lc
statement:
lemma sstar_apply_lc :
    sstar (R := R) (j := 1) (k := 1) f g (lc e e')
      = compFin (R := R) (P := Q) (0 : Fin 2) (f (cor e)) (g (cor e'))
proof:
:= by
  rw [sstar_apply, Fin.sum_univ_two, compFin_apply_graft 0 f g (cor e) (cor e') _ rfl,
    compFin_apply_eq_zero 1 f g _ (fun t₁ t₂ h => ?_)]
  · simp
  · obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := eq_cor t₁
    simp [lc, cor, corolla, graft_node] at h

name: Operad.TConv.sstar_apply_rc
statement:
lemma sstar_apply_rc :
    sstar (R := R) (j := 1) (k := 1) f g (rc e e')
      = -compFin (R := R) (P := Q) (1 : Fin 2) (f (cor e)) (g (cor e'))
proof:
:= by
  rw [sstar_apply, Fin.sum_univ_two, compFin_apply_graft 1 f g (cor e) (cor e') _ rfl,
    compFin_apply_eq_zero 0 f g _ (fun t₁ t₂ h => ?_)]
  · simp
  · obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := eq_cor t₁
    obtain ⟨t₂, ht₂⟩ := t₂
    simp only [cor, corolla, Fin.val_zero, graft_node, arity_leaf, Nat.lt_one_iff, if_true,
      graft_leaf, rc, node.injEq] at h
    obtain ⟨_, rfl, _⟩ := h
    simp at ht₂

name: Operad.TConv.sstar12_apply_ll
statement:
lemma sstar12_apply_ll :
    sstar (R := R) (j := 1) (k := 2) f θ (ll e₁ e₂ e₃)
      = compFin (R := R) (P := Q) (0 : Fin 2) (f (cor e₁)) (θ (lc e₂ e₃))
proof:
:= by
  rw [sstar_apply, Fin.sum_univ_two, compFin_apply_graft 0 f θ (cor e₁) (lc e₂ e₃) _ rfl,
    compFin_apply_eq_zero 1 f θ _ (fun t₁ t₂ h => ?_)]
  · simp
  · obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := eq_cor t₁
    rw [Fin.val_one, graft_cor_one] at h
    simp [ll] at h

name: Operad.TConv.sstar12_apply_lr
statement:
lemma sstar12_apply_lr :
    sstar (R := R) (j := 1) (k := 2) f θ (lr e₁ e₂ e₃)
      = compFin (R := R) (P := Q) (0 : Fin 2) (f (cor e₁)) (θ (rc e₂ e₃))
proof:
:= by
  rw [sstar_apply, Fin.sum_univ_two, compFin_apply_graft 0 f θ (cor e₁) (rc e₂ e₃) _ rfl,
    compFin_apply_eq_zero 1 f θ _ (fun t₁ t₂ h => ?_)]
  · simp
  · obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := eq_cor t₁
    rw [Fin.val_one, graft_cor_one] at h
    simp [lr] at h

name: Operad.TConv.sstar12_apply_bl
statement: lemma sstar12_apply_bl : sstar (R := R) (j := 1) (k := 2) f θ (bl e₁ e₂ e₃) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [sstar_apply, Fin.sum_univ_two, compFin_apply_eq_zero 0 f θ _ (fun t₁ t₂ h => ?_),
    compFin_apply_eq_zero 1 f θ _ (fun t₁ t₂ h => ?_)]
  · simp
  all_goals
    obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := eq_cor t₁
    simp only [Fin.val_zero, Fin.val_one, graft_cor_zero, graft_cor_one] at h
    simp [bl] at h

name: Operad.TConv.sstar12_apply_rl
statement:
lemma sstar12_apply_rl :
    sstar (R := R) (j := 1) (k := 2) f θ (rl e₁ e₂ e₃)
      = compFin (R := R) (P := Q) (1 : Fin 2) (f (cor e₁)) (θ (lc e₂ e₃))
proof:
:= by
  rw [sstar_apply, Fin.sum_univ_two, compFin_apply_graft 1 f θ (cor e₁) (lc e₂ e₃) _ rfl,
    compFin_apply_eq_zero 0 f θ _ (fun t₁ t₂ h => ?_)]
  · simp
  · obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := eq_cor t₁
    rw [Fin.val_zero, graft_cor_zero] at h
    simp [rl] at h

name: Operad.TConv.sstar12_apply_rr
statement:
lemma sstar12_apply_rr :
    sstar (R := R) (j := 1) (k := 2) f θ (rr e₁ e₂ e₃)
      = compFin (R := R) (P := Q) (1 : Fin 2) (f (cor e₁)) (θ (rc e₂ e₃))
proof:
:= by
  rw [sstar_apply, Fin.sum_univ_two, compFin_apply_graft 1 f θ (cor e₁) (rc e₂ e₃) _ rfl,
    compFin_apply_eq_zero 0 f θ _ (fun t₁ t₂ h => ?_)]
  · simp
  · obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := eq_cor t₁
    rw [Fin.val_zero, graft_cor_zero] at h
    simp [rr] at h

name: Operad.TConv.graft_lc
proof:
:= by
  rcases i with _ | _ | i <;> simp [lc, cor, corolla, graft_node, ll, lr, bl]

name: Operad.TConv.graft_rc
proof:
:= by
  rcases i with _ | _ | i <;> simp [rc, cor, corolla, graft_node, bl, rl, rr]

name: Operad.TConv.factor_cherry
proof:
:= by
  rcases eq_lc_or_rc t₁ with ⟨x, y, rfl⟩ | ⟨x, y, rfl⟩
  · exact Or.inl ⟨x, y, rfl, graft_lc x y e i⟩
  · exact Or.inr ⟨x, y, rfl, graft_rc x y e i⟩

name: Operad.TConv.sstar21_apply_ll
statement:
lemma sstar21_apply_ll :
    sstar (R := R) (j := 2) (k := 1) θ f (ll e₁ e₂ e₃)
      = compFin (R := R) (P := Q) (0 : Fin 3) (θ (lc e₁ e₂)) (f (cor e₃))
proof:
:= by
  rw [sstar_apply, Fin.sum_univ_three, compFin_apply_graft 0 θ f (lc e₁ e₂) (cor e₃) _ rfl]
  rw [compFin_apply_eq_zero 1 θ f _ (fun t₁ t₂ h => ?_),
    compFin_apply_eq_zero 2 θ f _ (fun t₁ t₂ h => ?_)]
  · simp
  all_goals
    obtain ⟨e, rfl⟩ := eq_cor t₂
    rcases factor_cherry _ t₁ e with ⟨x, y, rfl, hg⟩ | ⟨x, y, rfl, hg⟩ <;>
      rw [hg] at h <;> simp [ll, lr, bl, rl, rr] at h

name: Operad.TConv.sstar21_apply_lr
statement:
lemma sstar21_apply_lr :
    sstar (R := R) (j := 2) (k := 1) θ f (lr e₁ e₂ e₃)
      = -compFin (R := R) (P := Q) (1 : Fin 3) (θ (lc e₁ e₂)) (f (cor e₃))
proof:
:= by
  rw [sstar_apply, Fin.sum_univ_three, compFin_apply_graft 1 θ f (lc e₁ e₂) (cor e₃) _ rfl]
  rw [compFin_apply_eq_zero 0 θ f _ (fun t₁ t₂ h => ?_),
    compFin_apply_eq_zero 2 θ f _ (fun t₁ t₂ h => ?_)]
  · simp
  all_goals
    obtain ⟨e, rfl⟩ := eq_cor t₂
    rcases factor_cherry _ t₁ e with ⟨x, y, rfl, hg⟩ | ⟨x, y, rfl, hg⟩ <;>
      rw [hg] at h <;> simp [ll, lr, bl, rl, rr] at h

name: Operad.TConv.sstar21_apply_bl
statement:
lemma sstar21_apply_bl :
    sstar (R := R) (j := 2) (k := 1) θ f (bl e₁ e₂ e₃)
      = compFin (R := R) (P := Q) (0 : Fin 3) (θ (rc e₁ e₃)) (f (cor e₂))
        + compFin (R := R) (P := Q) (2 : Fin 3) (θ (lc e₁ e₂)) (f (cor e₃))
proof:
:= by
  rw [sstar_apply, Fin.sum_univ_three, compFin_apply_graft 0 θ f (rc e₁ e₃) (cor e₂) _ rfl,
    compFin_apply_graft 2 θ f (lc e₁ e₂) (cor e₃) _ rfl]
  rw [compFin_apply_eq_zero 1 θ f _ (fun t₁ t₂ h => ?_)]
  · simp
  · obtain ⟨e, rfl⟩ := eq_cor t₂
    rcases factor_cherry _ t₁ e with ⟨x, y, rfl, hg⟩ | ⟨x, y, rfl, hg⟩ <;>
      rw [hg] at h <;> simp [ll, lr, bl, rl, rr] at h

name: Operad.TConv.sstar21_apply_rl
statement:
lemma sstar21_apply_rl :
    sstar (R := R) (j := 2) (k := 1) θ f (rl e₁ e₂ e₃)
      = -compFin (R := R) (P := Q) (1 : Fin 3) (θ (rc e₁ e₂)) (f (cor e₃))
proof:
:= by
  rw [sstar_apply, Fin.sum_univ_three, compFin_apply_graft 1 θ f (rc e₁ e₂) (cor e₃) _ rfl]
  rw [compFin_apply_eq_zero 0 θ f _ (fun t₁ t₂ h => ?_),
    compFin_apply_eq_zero 2 θ f _ (fun t₁ t₂ h => ?_)]
  · simp
  all_goals
