  rw [cobarΦ_apply, cobarHs_ιL, Cobar.d_ιL, map_neg, cobarD_corolla_eq hred, u_ιL, zero_smul,
    add_zero]
  abel

name: Operad.GrComposite.cobarD_cobarHs
statement:
theorem cobarD_cobarHs
    (hred : ∀ (A : Type) [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A], Fintype.card A ≤ 1 →
      ∀ x : C A, x ∈ unitSpan R C A) {B : Type} [Fintype B] [DecidableEq B] (z : Ω B) :
    cobarD R C B (cobarHs R C B z) + cobarHs R C B ((Cobar.d R C).app B z)
      = unitCor R C B z - (εΩ).u B z • unitTerm R C B
proof:
:= by
  have h : cobarΦ R C B z = 0 := LinearMap.mem_ker.1 (FreeGrL.mem_of_ι (cobarΦSub R C)
    (fun k v b _ => by
      obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := exists_ιL (R := R) (C := C) v
      show _ ∈ LinearMap.ker (cobarΦ R C (Fin k))
      rw [hc, LinearMap.mem_ker]
      exact cobarΦ_ιL hred c) z)
  rw [cobarΦ_apply] at h
  rw [eq_sub_iff_add_eq, ← sub_eq_zero, ← h]
  abel

name: Operad.GrComposite.u_cobarE_cobarD
statement:
lemma u_cobarE_cobarD (w : GrComposite R C Ω S) :
    (εΩ).u S (cobarE R C S (cobarD R C S w)) = 0
proof:
:= by
  refine induction_act (fun S _ _ w => (εΩ).u S (cobarE R C S (cobarD R C S w)) = 0)
    (fun S _ _ => by simp) (fun S _ _ x y hx hy => by simp only [map_add, hx, hy, add_zero])
    (fun S _ _ r x hx => by simp only [map_smul, hx, smul_zero])
    (fun S S' _ _ _ _ σ x hx => ?_) (fun S Y _ _ _ _ i z x hx => ?_) (fun A _ _ c => ?_) w
  · beta_reduce at hx ⊢
    rw [cobarD_map, cobarE_map, (εΩ).u_map, hx]
  · beta_reduce at hx ⊢
    rw [cobarD_act, map_add, cobarE_act, cobarE_act, map_add, (εΩ).u_comp, (εΩ).u_comp, hx,
      u_d, zero_mul, mul_zero, add_zero]
  · beta_reduce
    by_cases hA : Nonempty A
    · rw [cobarE_cobarD_corolla, u_ιL]
    · exact (εΩ).u_eq_zero ⟨fun e => hA ⟨e ()⟩⟩ _

name: Operad.GrComposite.cobarH_apply
statement:
lemma cobarH_apply (w : GrComposite R C Ω S) :
    cobarH R C S w = cobarHs R C S (cobarE R C S w)
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.GrComposite.cobarH_act
statement:
lemma cobarH_act {Y : Type} [Fintype Y] [DecidableEq Y] (i : S) (z : Ω Y)
    (w : GrComposite R C Ω S) :
    cobarH R C _ (act R C i z w)
      = act R C i z (cobarH R C S w) + lact R C εΩ i (cobarE R C S w) (cobarHs R C Y z)
proof:
:= by
  show cobarHs R C _ (cobarE R C _ (act R C i z w))
    = act R C i z (cobarHs R C S (cobarE R C S w)) + _
  rw [cobarE_act, cobarHs_comp]

name: Operad.GrComposite.cobarH_tw
statement:
lemma cobarH_tw (w : GrComposite R C Ω S) :
    cobarH R C S (GrSpecies.tw (R := R) true w) = -GrSpecies.tw (R := R) true (cobarH R C S w)
proof:
:= by
  show cobarHs R C S (cobarE R C S _) = -GrSpecies.tw (R := R) true (cobarHs R C S (cobarE R C S w))
  rw [cobarE_tw, cobarHs_tw]

name: Operad.GrComposite.cobarH_corolla
statement:
lemma cobarH_corolla {A : Type} [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] (c : C A) :
    cobarH R C A (corolla R Ω A c) = 0
proof:
:= by
  show cobarHs R C A (cobarE R C A _) = 0
  rw [cobarE_corolla, cobarEps_apply, map_sum]
  refine Finset.sum_eq_zero fun e _ => ?_
  rw [map_smul, cobarHs_map, cobarHs_one, map_zero, smul_zero]

name: Operad.GrComposite.cobarT_apply
statement:
lemma cobarT_apply (w : GrComposite R C Ω S) :
    cobarT R C S w = cobarD R C S (cobarH R C S w) + cobarH R C S (cobarD R C S w) - w
      + (εΩ).u S (cobarE R C S w) • unitTerm R C S
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.GrComposite.cobarT_map
statement:
lemma cobarT_map {S' : Type} [Fintype S'] [DecidableEq S'] (σ : S ≃ S')
    (w : GrComposite R C Ω S) : cobarT R C S' (map σ w) = map σ (cobarT R C S w)
proof:
:= by
  have hH : cobarH R C S' (map σ w) = map σ (cobarH R C S w) := by
    show cobarHs R C S' (cobarE R C S' _) = map σ (cobarHs R C S (cobarE R C S w))
    rw [cobarE_map, cobarHs_map]
  have hH' : cobarH R C S' (map σ (cobarD R C S w)) = map σ (cobarH R C S (cobarD R C S w)) := by
    show cobarHs R C S' (cobarE R C S' _) = map σ (cobarHs R C S (cobarE R C S _))
    rw [cobarE_map, cobarHs_map]
  rw [cobarT_apply, cobarT_apply]
  simp only [cobarE_map, (εΩ).u_map, cobarD_map, hH, hH']
  rw [← unitTerm_map σ]
  simp only [map_add, map_sub, map_smul]

name: Operad.GrComposite.cobarT_act
statement:
lemma cobarT_act
    (hred : ∀ (A : Type) [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A], Fintype.card A ≤ 1 →
      ∀ x : C A, x ∈ unitSpan R C A) {Y : Type} [Fintype Y] [DecidableEq Y] (i : S) (z : Ω Y)
    (w : GrComposite R C Ω S) :
    cobarT R C _ (act R C i z w) = act R C i z (cobarT R C S w)
proof:
:= by
  have e3 : lact R C εΩ i (cobarE R C S w) (cobarD R C Y (cobarHs R C Y z))
      + lact R C εΩ i (cobarE R C S w) (cobarHs R C Y ((Cobar.d R C).app Y z))
      = (εΩ).u S (cobarE R C S w) • act R C i z (unitTerm R C S)
        - (εΩ).u Y z • ((εΩ).u S (cobarE R C S w) • unitTerm R C (Without S i ⊕ Y)) := by
    rw [← map_add, cobarD_cobarHs hred, map_sub, map_smul, lact_unitCor, lact_unitTerm]
  rw [cobarT_apply, cobarT_apply]
  simp only [cobarH_act, map_add, cobarD_act, cobarD_lact, cobarH_tw, cobarE_tw, lact_tw,
    cobarE_act, (εΩ).u_comp, map_neg, map_sub, map_smul,
    lact_of_u εΩ _ (u_cobarE_cobarD w), LinearMap.zero_apply, add_zero]
  linear_combination (norm := module) e3

name: Operad.GrComposite.cobarT_corolla
statement:
lemma cobarT_corolla
    (hred : ∀ (A : Type) [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A], Fintype.card A ≤ 1 →
      ∀ x : C A, x ∈ unitSpan R C A) {A : Type} [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] (c : C A) :
    cobarT R C A (corolla R Ω A c) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [cobarT_apply, cobarH_corolla, map_zero, zero_add, cobarE_corolla, cobarH_apply]
  by_cases hA : Fintype.card A ≤ 1
  · by_cases hne : Nonempty A
    · have e : Unit ≃ A := (Fintype.equivOfCardEq (by
        have := Fintype.card_pos_iff.2 hne
        rw [Fintype.card_unit]
        omega))
      haveI := subsingleton_of_unit e
      have hc := eq_counit_smul (hred A hA) e c
      have hcor : corolla R Ω A c = GrCooperad.counit (R := R) (SymSpecies.map (R := R) e.symm c)
          • corolla R Ω A (SymSpecies.map (R := R) e (Coaug.one (R := R) (C := C))) := by
        conv_lhs => rw [hc]
        rw [map_smul]
      simp only [cobarE_cobarD_corolla]
      rw [Cobar.ιL_unitSpan R C (hred A hA c), map_zero, zero_sub, hcor,
        cobarEps_apply, Fintype.sum_subsingleton _ e, map_smul, (εΩ).u_map, (εΩ).u_one,
        smul_eq_mul, mul_one, unitTerm, FreeGrL.unitL_eq e, unitCor_map, unitCor_one,
        map_corolla, neg_add_cancel]
    · have hE : IsEmpty (Unit ≃ A) := ⟨fun e => hne ⟨e ()⟩⟩
      have hc : c = 0 := by
        have := hred A hA c
        rwa [unitSpan_eq_bot hE, Submodule.mem_bot] at this
      subst hc
      simp
  · have hE : IsEmpty (Unit ≃ A) := ⟨fun e => hA (by rw [card_eq_one_of_unit e])⟩
    haveI : Nonempty A := Fintype.card_pos_iff.1 (by omega)
    simp only [cobarE_cobarD_corolla, cobarHs_ιL, Red.sec_proj hE, sub_self, zero_add,
      cobarEps_apply, Finset.univ_eq_empty, Finset.sum_empty, map_zero, zero_smul]

name: Operad.GrComposite.cobar_contraction
statement:
theorem cobar_contraction
    (hred : ∀ (A : Type) [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A], Fintype.card A ≤ 1 →
      ∀ x : C A, x ∈ unitSpan R C A) (w : GrComposite R C Ω S) :
    cobarD R C S (cobarH R C S w) + cobarH R C S (cobarD R C S w)
      = w - (εΩ).u S (cobarE R C S w) • unitTerm R C S
proof:
:= by
  have h := eq_of_corolla (fun S _ _ => cobarT R C S) (fun S _ _ => 0)
    (fun S S' _ _ _ _ σ w => cobarT_map σ w) (fun S S' _ _ _ _ σ w => by simp)
    (fun S Y _ _ _ _ i z w => cobarT_act hred i z w) (fun S Y _ _ _ _ i z w => by simp)
    (fun A _ _ c => cobarT_corolla hred c) w
  rw [LinearMap.zero_apply, cobarT_apply] at h
  rw [eq_sub_iff_add_eq, ← sub_eq_zero, ← h]
  abel

name: Operad.GrComposite.cobar_acyclic
statement:
theorem cobar_acyclic
    (hred : ∀ (A : Type) [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A], Fintype.card A ≤ 1 →
      ∀ x : C A, x ∈ unitSpan R C A) {w : GrComposite R C Ω S} (hw : cobarD R C S w = 0)
    (hu : (εΩ).u S (cobarE R C S w) = 0) : cobarD R C S (cobarH R C S w) = w
proof:
:= by
  have h := cobar_contraction hred w
  rwa [hw, map_zero, add_zero, hu, zero_smul, sub_zero] at h

name: Operad.AssAlgebra.mul_def
statement:
lemma mul_def (A : Algebra R (Ass R) V) (x y : V) :
    mul A x y = A.app 2 (1 : Ass R 2) ![x, y]
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.AssAlgebra.midTuple_left
statement:
lemma midTuple_left (v : Fin 3 → V) :
    End.midTuple (V := V) 0 1 (n := 2) v = ![v 0, v 1]
proof:
:= by
  funext j
  fin_cases j <;> rfl

name: Operad.AssAlgebra.insTuple_left
statement:
lemma insTuple_left (w : V) (v : Fin 3 → V) :
    End.insTuple (V := V) 0 1 (n := 2) w v = ![w, v 2]
proof:
:= by
  funext i
  fin_cases i
  · show End.insTuple (V := V) 0 1 (n := 2) w v ⟨0, by omega⟩ = ![w, v 2] ⟨0, by omega⟩
    exact End.insTuple_of_eq (n := 2) 0 1 w v ⟨0, by omega⟩ rfl
  · show End.insTuple (V := V) 0 1 (n := 2) w v ⟨1, by omega⟩ = ![w, v 2] ⟨1, by omega⟩
    rw [End.insTuple_of_gt (n := 2) 0 1 w v ⟨1, by omega⟩ (by norm_num)]
    rfl

name: Operad.AssAlgebra.midTuple_right
statement:
lemma midTuple_right (v : Fin 3 → V) :
    End.midTuple (V := V) 1 0 (n := 2) v = ![v 1, v 2]
proof:
:= by
  funext j
  fin_cases j <;> rfl

name: Operad.AssAlgebra.insTuple_right
statement:
lemma insTuple_right (w : V) (v : Fin 3 → V) :
    End.insTuple (V := V) 1 0 (n := 2) w v = ![v 0, w]
proof:
:= by
  funext i
  fin_cases i
  · show End.insTuple (V := V) 1 0 (n := 2) w v ⟨0, by omega⟩ = ![v 0, w] ⟨0, by omega⟩
    rw [End.insTuple_of_lt (n := 2) 1 0 w v ⟨0, by omega⟩ (by norm_num)]
    rfl
  · show End.insTuple (V := V) 1 0 (n := 2) w v ⟨1, by omega⟩ = ![v 0, w] ⟨1, by omega⟩
    exact End.insTuple_of_eq (n := 2) 1 0 w v ⟨1, by omega⟩ rfl

name: Operad.AssAlgebra.ass_comp_eq
statement:
lemma ass_comp_eq :
    comp (R := R) (P := Ass R) 0 1 (1 : Ass R 2) (1 : Ass R 2)
      = comp (R := R) (P := Ass R) 1 0 (1 : Ass R 2) (1 : Ass R 2)
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.AssAlgebra.mul_assoc
statement:
theorem mul_assoc (A : Algebra R (Ass R) V) (x y z : V) :
    mul A (mul A x y) z = mul A x (mul A y z)
proof:
:= by
  
  have key : NSOperad.comp (R := R) (P := End R V) 0 1
        (A.app 2 (1 : Ass R 2)) (A.app 2 (1 : Ass R 2))
      = NSOperad.comp (R := R) (P := End R V) 1 0
        (A.app 2 (1 : Ass R 2)) (A.app 2 (1 : Ass R 2)) := by
    have h0 := congrArg (A.app 3) (ass_comp_eq (R := R))
    rw [A.app_comp (n := 2) 0 1 (1 : Ass R 2) (1 : Ass R 2),
      A.app_comp (n := 2) 1 0 (1 : Ass R 2) (1 : Ass R 2)] at h0
    exact h0
  
  have h : NSOperad.comp (R := R) (P := End R V) 0 1
        (A.app 2 (1 : Ass R 2)) (A.app 2 (1 : Ass R 2)) ![x, y, z]
      = NSOperad.comp (R := R) (P := End R V) 1 0
        (A.app 2 (1 : Ass R 2)) (A.app 2 (1 : Ass R 2)) ![x, y, z] := by
    rw [key]
  rw [End.operad_comp_apply (n := 2) 0 1 _ _ ![x, y, z],
    End.operad_comp_apply (n := 2) 1 0 _ _ ![x, y, z],
    midTuple_left, insTuple_left, midTuple_right, insTuple_right] at h
  simpa [mul_def] using h

name: Operad.DayMonoid.laxMonoidal_ext
proof:
:= by
  rcases L with ⟨ε, μ, _, _, _, _, _⟩
  rcases L' with ⟨ε', μ', _, _, _, _, _⟩
  obtain rfl : ε = ε' := hε
  obtain rfl : μ = μ' := funext fun x => funext fun y => hμ x y
  rfl

name: Operad.DayMonoid.mul_naturality
statement:
@[reassoc]
lemma mul_naturality {a b : C} (f : a ⟶ b) :
    (F ⊗ F).functor.map f ≫ (MonObj.mul : F ⊗ F ⟶ F).natTrans.app b =
      (MonObj.mul : F ⊗ F ⟶ F).natTrans.app a ≫ F.functor.map f
proof:
:=
  (MonObj.mul : F ⊗ F ⟶ F).natTrans.naturality f

name: Operad.DayMonoid.μF_natural_left
statement:
lemma μF_natural_left {x x' : C} (f : x ⟶ x') (y : C) :
    F.functor.map f ▷ F.functor.obj y ≫ μF F x' y = μF F x y ≫ F.functor.map (f ▷ y)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [μF, η_naturality_right_assoc, mul_naturality, Category.assoc]

name: Operad.DayMonoid.μF_natural_right
statement:
lemma μF_natural_right (x : C) {y y' : C} (g : y ⟶ y') :
    F.functor.obj x ◁ F.functor.map g ≫ μF F x y' = μF F x y ≫ F.functor.map (x ◁ g)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [μF, η_naturality_left_assoc, mul_naturality, Category.assoc]

name: Operad.DayMonoid.μF_assoc
statement:
lemma μF_assoc (x y z : C) :
    μF F x y ▷ F.functor.obj z ≫ μF F (x ⊗ y) z ≫ F.functor.map (α_ x y z).hom =
      (α_ _ _ _).hom ≫ F.functor.obj x ◁ μF F y z ≫ μF F x (y ⊗ z)
proof:
:= by
  have hassoc := congrArg (fun φ => φ.natTrans.app ((x ⊗ y) ⊗ z)) (MonObj.mul_assoc F)
  simp only [comp_natTrans, NatTrans.comp_app] at hassoc
  have hnat := (((F ◁ (MonObj.mul : F ⊗ F ⟶ F)) ≫ MonObj.mul).natTrans.naturality
    (α_ x y z).inv)
  simp only [comp_natTrans, NatTrans.comp_app] at hnat
  calc μF F x y ▷ F.functor.obj z ≫ μF F (x ⊗ y) z ≫ F.functor.map (α_ x y z).hom
      = ηa F F x y ▷ F.functor.obj z ≫ ηa (F ⊗ F) F (x ⊗ y) z ≫
          ((MonObj.mul : F ⊗ F ⟶ F) ▷ F).natTrans.app ((x ⊗ y) ⊗ z) ≫
          (MonObj.mul : F ⊗ F ⟶ F).natTrans.app ((x ⊗ y) ⊗ z) ≫
          F.functor.map (α_ x y z).hom := by
        rw [η_whiskerRight_assoc]
        simp only [μF, comp_whiskerRight, Category.assoc]
    _ = (α_ _ _ _).hom ≫ F.functor.obj x ◁ ηa F F y z ≫ ηa F (F ⊗ F) x (y ⊗ z) ≫
          (F ⊗ F ⊗ F).functor.map (α_ x y z).inv ≫
          (F ◁ (MonObj.mul : F ⊗ F ⟶ F)).natTrans.app ((x ⊗ y) ⊗ z) ≫
          (MonObj.mul : F ⊗ F ⟶ F).natTrans.app ((x ⊗ y) ⊗ z) ≫
          F.functor.map (α_ x y z).hom := by
        rw [reassoc_of% hassoc, η_associator_assoc]
    _ = (α_ _ _ _).hom ≫ F.functor.obj x ◁ ηa F F y z ≫ ηa F (F ⊗ F) x (y ⊗ z) ≫
          (F ◁ (MonObj.mul : F ⊗ F ⟶ F)).natTrans.app (x ⊗ y ⊗ z) ≫
          (MonObj.mul : F ⊗ F ⟶ F).natTrans.app (x ⊗ y ⊗ z) := by
        rw [reassoc_of% hnat]
        simp only [← F.functor.map_comp, Iso.inv_hom_id, F.functor.map_id, Category.comp_id]
    _ = _ := by
        rw [η_whiskerLeft_assoc]
        simp only [μF, MonoidalCategory.whiskerLeft_comp, Category.assoc]

name: Operad.DayMonoid.μF_left_unitality
statement:
lemma μF_left_unitality (y : C) :
    (λ_ (F.functor.obj y)).hom = εF F ▷ F.functor.obj y ≫ μF F (𝟙_ C) y ≫
      F.functor.map (λ_ y).hom
proof:
:= by
  have hone := congrArg (fun φ => φ.natTrans.app (𝟙_ C ⊗ y)) (MonObj.one_mul F)
  simp only [comp_natTrans, NatTrans.comp_app] at hone
  calc (λ_ (F.functor.obj y)).hom =
      ((λ_ (F.functor.obj y)).hom ≫ F.functor.map (λ_ y).inv) ≫ F.functor.map (λ_ y).hom := by
        rw [Category.assoc, ← F.functor.map_comp, Iso.inv_hom_id, F.functor.map_id,
          Category.comp_id]
    _ = _ := by
        rw [← ν_leftUnitor, ← hone]
        simp only [εF, μF, comp_whiskerRight, Category.assoc, η_whiskerRight_assoc]

name: Operad.DayMonoid.μF_right_unitality
statement:
lemma μF_right_unitality (y : C) :
    (ρ_ (F.functor.obj y)).hom = F.functor.obj y ◁ εF F ≫ μF F y (𝟙_ C) ≫
      F.functor.map (ρ_ y).hom
proof:
:= by
  have hone := congrArg (fun φ => φ.natTrans.app (y ⊗ 𝟙_ C)) (MonObj.mul_one F)
  simp only [comp_natTrans, NatTrans.comp_app] at hone
  calc (ρ_ (F.functor.obj y)).hom =
      ((ρ_ (F.functor.obj y)).hom ≫ F.functor.map (ρ_ y).inv) ≫ F.functor.map (ρ_ y).hom := by
        rw [Category.assoc, ← F.functor.map_comp, Iso.inv_hom_id, F.functor.map_id,
          Category.comp_id]
    _ = _ := by
        rw [← ν_rightUnitor, ← hone]
        simp only [εF, μF, MonoidalCategory.whiskerLeft_comp, Category.assoc,
          η_whiskerLeft_assoc]

name: Operad.DayMonoid.tensorRight_ext
proof:
:= by
  have hP := (isPointwiseLeftKanExtensionConvolutionExtensionUnit (C := C) (V := V) F G) a
  have hQ := Limits.isColimitOfPreserves (tensorRight v) hP
  refine hQ.hom_ext fun j => ?_
  simpa [ηa] using H j.left.1 j.left.2 j.hom

name: Operad.DayMonoid.tensor₂_ext
statement:
lemma tensor₂_ext {F G H K : C ⊛⥤ V} {α β : (F ⊗ G) ⊗ H ⟶ K}
    (h : ∀ x y z, ηa F G x y ▷ H.functor.obj z ≫ ηa (F ⊗ G) H (x ⊗ y) z ≫
        α.natTrans.app ((x ⊗ y) ⊗ z) =
      ηa F G x y ▷ H.functor.obj z ≫ ηa (F ⊗ G) H (x ⊗ y) z ≫
        β.natTrans.app ((x ⊗ y) ⊗ z)) : α = β
proof:
:= by
  refine tensor_ext fun a z => tensorRight_ext a (H.functor.obj z) fun x y u => ?_
  rw [comp_whiskerRight_assoc, comp_whiskerRight_assoc, η_naturality_right_assoc,
    η_naturality_right_assoc, α.natTrans.naturality, β.natTrans.naturality, reassoc_of% (h x y z)]

name: Operad.DayMonoid.ηa_mulL
statement:
@[reassoc]
lemma ηa_mulL (x y : C) :
    ηa F F x y ≫ (mulL F).natTrans.app (x ⊗ y) = Functor.LaxMonoidal.μ F.functor x y
proof:
:=
  ηa_tensorDesc _ x y

name: Operad.DayMonoid.ν_oneL
statement:
@[reassoc]
lemma ν_oneL : ν C V ≫ (oneL F).natTrans.app (𝟙_ C) = Functor.LaxMonoidal.ε F.functor
proof:
:=
  ν_comp_unitDesc _

name: Operad.DayMonoid.oneL_mul
statement: lemma oneL_mul : oneL F ▷ F ≫ mulL F = (λ_ F).hom
proof:
:= by
  ext y
  simp only [comp_natTrans, NatTrans.comp_app]
  set s := (λ_ (F.functor.obj y)).inv ≫ ν C V ▷ F.functor.obj y ≫
    ηa (𝟙_ (C ⊛⥤ V)) F (𝟙_ C) y ≫ (𝟙_ (C ⊛⥤ V) ⊗ F).functor.map (λ_ y).hom with hsdef
  have hl : (λ_ F).hom.natTrans.app y ≫ (λ_ F).inv.natTrans.app y = 𝟙 _ := by
    rw [← NatTrans.comp_app, ← comp_natTrans, Iso.hom_inv_id]
    rfl
  have hs : s ≫ (λ_ F).hom.natTrans.app y = 𝟙 _ := by
    rw [hsdef]
    simp only [Category.assoc]
    rw [(λ_ F).hom.natTrans.naturality (λ_ y).hom, ν_leftUnitor_assoc, ← F.functor.map_comp,
      Iso.inv_hom_id, F.functor.map_id, Category.comp_id, Iso.inv_hom_id]
  have hs' : s = (λ_ F).inv.natTrans.app y := by
    rw [← Category.comp_id s, ← hl, ← Category.assoc, hs, Category.id_comp]
  have hg : s ≫ (oneL F ▷ F).natTrans.app y ≫ (mulL F).natTrans.app y = 𝟙 _ := by
    have hnat := ((oneL F ▷ F) ≫ mulL F).natTrans.naturality (λ_ y).hom
    simp only [comp_natTrans, NatTrans.comp_app] at hnat
    rw [hsdef]
    simp only [Category.assoc]
    rw [hnat]
    simp only [Category.assoc]
    rw [η_whiskerRight_assoc, ηa_mulL_assoc, ← comp_whiskerRight_assoc, ν_oneL,
      ← Functor.LaxMonoidal.left_unitality, Iso.inv_hom_id]
  calc (oneL F ▷ F).natTrans.app y ≫ (mulL F).natTrans.app y
      = ((λ_ F).hom.natTrans.app y ≫ s) ≫ (oneL F ▷ F).natTrans.app y ≫
          (mulL F).natTrans.app y := by rw [hs', hl, Category.id_comp]
    _ = (λ_ F).hom.natTrans.app y := by rw [Category.assoc, hg, Category.comp_id]

name: Operad.DayMonoid.mul_oneL
statement: lemma mul_oneL : F ◁ oneL F ≫ mulL F = (ρ_ F).hom
proof:
:= by
  ext y
  simp only [comp_natTrans, NatTrans.comp_app]
  set s := (ρ_ (F.functor.obj y)).inv ≫ F.functor.obj y ◁ ν C V ≫
    ηa F (𝟙_ (C ⊛⥤ V)) y (𝟙_ C) ≫ (F ⊗ 𝟙_ (C ⊛⥤ V)).functor.map (ρ_ y).hom with hsdef
  have hρ : (ρ_ F).hom.natTrans.app y ≫ (ρ_ F).inv.natTrans.app y = 𝟙 _ := by
    rw [← NatTrans.comp_app, ← comp_natTrans, Iso.hom_inv_id]
    rfl
  have hs : s ≫ (ρ_ F).hom.natTrans.app y = 𝟙 _ := by
    rw [hsdef]
    simp only [Category.assoc]
    rw [(ρ_ F).hom.natTrans.naturality (ρ_ y).hom, ν_rightUnitor_assoc, ← F.functor.map_comp,
      Iso.inv_hom_id, F.functor.map_id, Category.comp_id, Iso.inv_hom_id]
  have hs' : s = (ρ_ F).inv.natTrans.app y := by
    rw [← Category.comp_id s, ← hρ, ← Category.assoc, hs, Category.id_comp]
  have hg : s ≫ (F ◁ oneL F).natTrans.app y ≫ (mulL F).natTrans.app y = 𝟙 _ := by
    have hnat := ((F ◁ oneL F) ≫ mulL F).natTrans.naturality (ρ_ y).hom
    simp only [comp_natTrans, NatTrans.comp_app] at hnat
    rw [hsdef]
    simp only [Category.assoc]
    rw [hnat]
    simp only [Category.assoc]
    rw [η_whiskerLeft_assoc, ηa_mulL_assoc, ← MonoidalCategory.whiskerLeft_comp_assoc,
      ν_oneL, ← Functor.LaxMonoidal.right_unitality, Iso.inv_hom_id]
  calc (F ◁ oneL F).natTrans.app y ≫ (mulL F).natTrans.app y
      = ((ρ_ F).hom.natTrans.app y ≫ s) ≫ (F ◁ oneL F).natTrans.app y ≫
          (mulL F).natTrans.app y := by rw [hs', hρ, Category.id_comp]
    _ = (ρ_ F).hom.natTrans.app y := by rw [Category.assoc, hg, Category.comp_id]

name: Operad.DayMonoid.mulL_assoc
statement: lemma mulL_assoc : mulL F ▷ F ≫ mulL F = (α_ F F F).hom ≫ F ◁ mulL F ≫ mulL F
proof:
:= by
  refine tensor₂_ext fun x y z => ?_
  have hnat := ((F ◁ mulL F) ≫ mulL F).natTrans.naturality (α_ x y z).inv
  simp only [comp_natTrans, NatTrans.comp_app] at hnat ⊢
  rw [η_whiskerRight_assoc, ← comp_whiskerRight_assoc, ηa_mulL, ηa_mulL, η_associator_assoc,
    hnat]
  simp only [Category.assoc]
  rw [η_whiskerLeft_assoc, ← MonoidalCategory.whiskerLeft_comp_assoc, ηa_mulL, ηa_mulL_assoc,
    ← Functor.LaxMonoidal.associativity_assoc, ← F.functor.map_comp, Iso.hom_inv_id,
    F.functor.map_id, Category.comp_id]

name: Operad.DayMonoid.monObj_ext
proof:
:= by
  rcases M with ⟨one, mul, _, _, _⟩
  rcases M' with ⟨one', mul', _, _, _⟩
  obtain rfl : one = one' := hone
  obtain rfl : mul = mul' := hmul
  rfl

proof: := rfl

name: Operad.DayMonoid.monObjEquivLaxMonoidal_ε
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.DayMonoid.isMonHom_iff
statement:
theorem isMonHom_iff {M N : C ⊛⥤ V} [MonObj M] [MonObj N] (f : M ⟶ N) :
    IsMonHom f ↔ @NatTrans.IsMonoidal _ _ _ _ _ _ M.functor N.functor f.natTrans
      (laxMonoidalOfMonObj M) (laxMonoidalOfMonObj N)
proof:
:= by
  letI := laxMonoidalOfMonObj M
  letI := laxMonoidalOfMonObj N
  constructor
  · intro hf
    refine ⟨?_, fun x y => ?_⟩
    · show (ν C V ≫ (MonObj.one : 𝟙_ (C ⊛⥤ V) ⟶ M).natTrans.app (𝟙_ C)) ≫
          f.natTrans.app (𝟙_ C) = ν C V ≫ (MonObj.one : 𝟙_ (C ⊛⥤ V) ⟶ N).natTrans.app (𝟙_ C)
      rw [Category.assoc, ← NatTrans.comp_app, ← comp_natTrans, IsMonHom.one_hom]
    · show (ηa M M x y ≫ (MonObj.mul : M ⊗ M ⟶ M).natTrans.app (x ⊗ y)) ≫
          f.natTrans.app (x ⊗ y) = (f.natTrans.app x ⊗ₘ f.natTrans.app y) ≫
          ηa N N x y ≫ (MonObj.mul : N ⊗ N ⟶ N).natTrans.app (x ⊗ y)
      rw [Category.assoc, ← NatTrans.comp_app, ← comp_natTrans, IsMonHom.mul_hom,
        comp_natTrans, NatTrans.comp_app, η_tensorHom_assoc]
  · intro hf
    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · refine unit_hom_ext ?_
      have h := hf.unit
      change (ν C V ≫ (MonObj.one : 𝟙_ (C ⊛⥤ V) ⟶ M).natTrans.app (𝟙_ C)) ≫
          f.natTrans.app (𝟙_ C) = ν C V ≫ (MonObj.one : 𝟙_ (C ⊛⥤ V) ⟶ N).natTrans.app (𝟙_ C) at h
      simpa only [comp_natTrans, NatTrans.comp_app, Category.assoc] using h
    · refine tensor_ext fun x y => ?_
      have h := hf.tensor x y
      change (ηa M M x y ≫ (MonObj.mul : M ⊗ M ⟶ M).natTrans.app (x ⊗ y)) ≫
          f.natTrans.app (x ⊗ y) = (f.natTrans.app x ⊗ₘ f.natTrans.app y) ≫
          ηa N N x y ≫ (MonObj.mul : N ⊗ N ⟶ N).natTrans.app (x ⊗ y) at h
      simp only [comp_natTrans, NatTrans.comp_app, Category.assoc] at h ⊢
      rw [h, η_tensorHom_assoc]

name: Operad.DayMonoid.ηa_dayBraiding
statement:
@[reassoc]
lemma ηa_dayBraiding (F : C ⊛⥤ V) (x y : C) :
    ηa F F x y ≫ (dayBraiding F).hom.app (x ⊗ y) =
      (β_ _ _).hom ≫ ηa F F y x ≫ (F ⊗ F).functor.map (β_ y x).hom

name: Operad.DayMonoid.ηa_dayBraiding_mul
statement:
lemma ηa_dayBraiding_mul (F : C ⊛⥤ V) [MonObj F] (x y : C) :
    ηa F F x y ≫ (dayBraiding F).hom.app (x ⊗ y) ≫
        (MonObj.mul : F ⊗ F ⟶ F).natTrans.app (x ⊗ y) =
      (β_ _ _).hom ≫ μF F y x ≫ F.functor.map (β_ y x).hom
proof:
:= by
  rw [ηa_dayBraiding_assoc, mul_naturality, μF]
  simp only [Category.assoc]

name: Operad.DayMonoid.isCommDay_iff
statement:
theorem isCommDay_iff (F : C ⊛⥤ V) [MonObj F] :
    IsCommDay F ↔ ∀ x y : C,
      μF F x y ≫ F.functor.map (β_ x y).hom = (β_ _ _).hom ≫ μF F y x
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h x y
    have hxy := congrArg (fun φ => ηa F F x y ≫ φ.app (x ⊗ y)) h
    simp only [NatTrans.comp_app] at hxy
    rw [ηa_dayBraiding_mul] at hxy
    rw [← show ηa F F x y ≫ (MonObj.mul : F ⊗ F ⟶ F).natTrans.app (x ⊗ y) = μF F x y from rfl,
      ← hxy]
    simp only [Category.assoc, ← F.functor.map_comp, SymmetricCategory.symmetry,
      F.functor.map_id, Category.comp_id]
  · intro h
    have key : (DayFunctor.Hom.mk ((dayBraiding F).hom ≫ (MonObj.mul : F ⊗ F ⟶ F).natTrans) :
        F ⊗ F ⟶ F) = (MonObj.mul : F ⊗ F ⟶ F) := by
      refine tensor_ext fun x y => ?_
      show ηa F F x y ≫ ((dayBraiding F).hom ≫ (MonObj.mul : F ⊗ F ⟶ F).natTrans).app (x ⊗ y) =
        _
      rw [NatTrans.comp_app, ηa_dayBraiding_mul, ← Category.assoc, ← h x y, Category.assoc,
        ← F.functor.map_comp, SymmetricCategory.symmetry, F.functor.map_id, Category.comp_id]
      rfl
    exact congrArg DayFunctor.Hom.natTrans key

name: Operad.DayMonoid.isCommDay_of_laxBraided
statement:
theorem isCommDay_of_laxBraided (F : C ⊛⥤ V) [L : F.functor.LaxBraided] :
    letI
proof:
:= monObjOfLaxMonoidal F
    IsCommDay F := by
  letI := monObjOfLaxMonoidal F
  refine (isCommDay_iff F).2 fun x y => ?_
  have h1 : μF F x y = Functor.LaxMonoidal.μ F.functor x y := ηa_tensorDesc _ x y
  have h2 : μF F y x = Functor.LaxMonoidal.μ F.functor y x := ηa_tensorDesc _ y x
  rw [h1, h2]
  exact Functor.LaxBraided.braided x y

name: Operad.SymOperad.map_refl'
statement: @[simp] lemma map_refl' (x : P A) : map (R := R) (Equiv.refl A) x = x

name: Operad.SymOperad.map_map
statement:
lemma map_map (e : A ≃ B) (f : B ≃ C) (x : P A) :
    map (R := R) f (map (R := R) e x) = map (R := R) (e.trans f) x
proof:
:=
  (map_trans (R := R) e f x).symm

name: Operad.SymOperad.map_symm_map
statement:
@[simp] lemma map_symm_map (e : A ≃ B) (x : P A) :
    map (R := R) e.symm (map (R := R) e x) = x
proof:
:= by
  rw [map_map, Equiv.self_trans_symm, map_refl (R := R)]

name: Operad.SymOperad.map_map_symm

:= by

name: Operad.SymOperad.map_injective
statement: lemma map_injective (e : A ≃ B) : Function.Injective (map (R := R) (P := P) e)

  fun x y h => by simpa using congrArg (map (R := R) e.symm) h

name: Operad.SymOperad.mapEquiv_apply

proof: := rfl

name: Operad.SymOperad.map_comp_outer
statement:
lemma map_comp_outer (σ : Equiv.Perm A) (i : A) (x : P A) (y : P B) :
    map (R := R) (compEquiv σ (Equiv.refl B) i) (comp (R := R) i x y)
      = comp (R := R) (σ i) (map (R := R) σ x) y
proof:
:= by
  rw [map_comp (R := R), map_refl (R := R)]

name: Operad.SymOperad.map_comp_inner
statement:
lemma map_comp_inner (τ : Equiv.Perm B) (i : A) (x : P A) (y : P B) :
    map (R := R) (compEquiv (Equiv.refl A) τ i) (comp (R := R) i x y)
      = comp (R := R) i x (map (R := R) τ y)
proof:
:= by
  rw [map_comp (R := R), map_refl (R := R)]
  rfl

name: Operad.SymOperad.comp_one'

    comp (R := R) i x (one R) = map (R := R) (rightUnitEquiv i).symm x
proof:
:= by
  apply map_injective (R := R) (rightUnitEquiv i)
  rw [comp_one (R := R), map_map_symm]

name: Operad.SymOperad.one_comp'
statement:
lemma one_comp' (y : P B) :
    comp (R := R) () (one R) y = map (R := R) (leftUnitEquiv B).symm y
proof:
:= by
  apply map_injective (R := R) (leftUnitEquiv B)
  rw [one_comp (R := R), map_map_symm]

name: Operad.SymOperadHom.ext
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨φa, _, _, _⟩ := φ
  obtain ⟨ψa, _, _, _⟩ := ψ
  have : @φa = @ψa := by
    funext A _ _
    exact LinearMap.ext (h A)
  subst this
  rfl

name: Operad.SymOperadHom.comp_app
statement:
@[simp] lemma comp_app (ψ : SymOperadHom R Q S) (φ : SymOperadHom R P Q)
    (A : Type) [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] (x : P A) :
    (ψ.comp φ).app A x = ψ.app A (φ.app A x)
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.SymOperadHom.app_invOfBijective
statement:
lemma app_invOfBijective (φ : SymOperadHom R P Q)
    (h : ∀ (A : Type) [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A], Function.Bijective (φ.app A))
    (A : Type) [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] (y : Q A) :
    φ.app A ((φ.invOfBijective h).app A y) = y
proof:
:=
  LinearEquiv.apply_ofBijective_symm_apply (φ.app A) (h := h A) y

name: Operad.SymOperadHom.invOfBijective_app
statement:
lemma invOfBijective_app (φ : SymOperadHom R P Q)
    (h : ∀ (A : Type) [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A], Function.Bijective (φ.app A))
    (A : Type) [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] (x : P A) :
    (φ.invOfBijective h).app A (φ.app A x) = x
proof:
:=
  (h A).1 (app_invOfBijective φ h A (φ.app A x))

name: Operad.Sym.com_map
statement:
@[simp] lemma com_map (R : Type u) [CommRing R] {A B : Type} [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A]
    [Fintype B] [DecidableEq B] (e : A ≃ B) (x : Com R A) :
    SymOperad.map (R := R) (P := Com R) e x = x
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.Sym.com_comp
statement:
@[simp] lemma com_comp (R : Type u) [CommRing R] {A B : Type} [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A]
    [Fintype B] [DecidableEq B] (i : A) (x : Com R A) (y : Com R B) :
    SymOperad.comp (R := R) (P := Com R) i x y = x * y
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.Sym.com_one
statement: @[simp] lemma com_one (R : Type u) [CommRing R] : (SymOperad.one R : Com R Unit) = (1 : R)
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.Sym.Perm.mapL_apply
statement: @[simp] lemma mapL_apply (e : A ≃ B) (x : A → R) (b : B) : mapL e x b = x (e.symm b)
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.Sym.Perm.compFun_inl
statement:
@[simp] lemma compFun_inl [DecidableEq A] [Fintype B] (i : A) (x : A → R) (y : B → R)
    (a : Without A i) :
    compFun i x y (Sum.inl a) = x a.1 * ∑ b, y b
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.Sym.Perm.compFun_inr
statement:
@[simp] lemma compFun_inr [DecidableEq A] [Fintype B] (i : A) (x : A → R) (y : B → R) (b : B) :
    compFun i x y (Sum.inr b) = x i * y b
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.Sym.Perm.compL_apply
statement:
@[simp] lemma compL_apply [DecidableEq A] [Fintype B] (i : A) (x : A → R) (y : B → R) :
    compL i x y = compFun i x y
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.Sym.Perm.sum_compFun
statement:
theorem sum_compFun [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] [Fintype B] (i : A) (x : A → R) (y : B → R) :
    ∑ c, compFun i x y c = (∑ a, x a) * ∑ b, y b
proof:
:= by
  rw [Fintype.sum_sum_type, Fintype.sum_eq_add_sum_subtype_ne x i, add_mul, add_comm]
  simp only [compFun_inl, compFun_inr, ← Finset.mul_sum, ← Finset.sum_mul]

name: Operad.tpar_tmul
statement:
lemma tpar_tmul (pX : Bool → X →ₗ[R] X) (pY : Bool → Y →ₗ[R] Y) (b : Bool) (x : X) (y : Y) :
    tpar R pX pY b (x ⊗ₜ y) = pX false x ⊗ₜ pY b y + pX true x ⊗ₜ pY (!b) y
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.sswapLast_tmul
statement:
lemma sswapLast_tmul (pY : Bool → Y →ₗ[R] Y) (pZ : Bool → Z →ₗ[R] Z) (x : X) (y : Y) (z : Z) :
    sswapLast R pY pZ ((x ⊗ₜ y) ⊗ₜ z)
      = ∑ q : Bool, ∑ r : Bool, σ R (q && r) • ((x ⊗ₜ pZ r z) ⊗ₜ pY q y)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [sswapLast, LinearMap.coe_sum, Finset.sum_apply, LinearMap.smul_apply,
    LinearMap.comp_apply, TensorProduct.map_tmul, LinearMap.lTensor_tmul, LinearEquiv.coe_coe]
  rfl

name: Operad.SymSpecies.map_symm_map
statement:
@[simp] lemma map_symm_map (e : A ≃ B) (x : V A) :
    map (R := R) e.symm (map (R := R) e x) = x
proof:
:= by
  rw [← map_trans, Equiv.self_trans_symm, map_refl]

name: Operad.SymSpecies.map_map_symm
statement:
@[simp] lemma map_map_symm (e : A ≃ B) (y : V B) :
    map (R := R) e (map (R := R) e.symm y) = y
proof:
:= by
  rw [← map_trans, Equiv.symm_trans_self, map_refl]

name: Operad.GrSpecies.tw_apply
statement:
lemma tw_apply (e : Bool) (x : V A) :
    tw (R := R) e x = par (R := R) false x + σ R e • par (R := R) true x
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.GrSpecies.tw_hom
statement:
lemma tw_hom (e : Bool) {c : Bool} {x : V A} (h : par (R := R) c x = x) :
    tw (R := R) e x = σ R (e && c) • x
proof:
:= by
  rw [tw_apply, ← h, par_par, par_par]
  cases c <;> cases e <;> simp

name: Operad.GrSpecies.par_tw
statement:
lemma par_tw (e c : Bool) (x : V A) :
    par (R := R) c (tw (R := R) e x) = tw (R := R) e (par (R := R) c x)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [tw_apply, map_add, map_smul, par_par]
  cases c <;> simp

name: Operad.GrSpecies.map_tw
statement:
lemma map_tw (e : Bool) (σ' : A ≃ B) (x : V A) :
    SymSpecies.map (R := R) σ' (tw (R := R) e x) = tw (R := R) e (SymSpecies.map (R := R) σ' x)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [tw_apply, map_add, map_smul, map_par]

name: Operad.GrSpecies.tw_false
statement: @[simp] lemma tw_false (x : V A) : tw (R := R) false x = x
proof:
:= by
  rw [tw_apply, σ_false, one_smul, par_add]

name: Operad.GrSpecies.tw_false_eq_id
statement: lemma tw_false_eq_id : tw (R := R) (V := V) (A := A) false = LinearMap.id
proof:
:=
  LinearMap.ext tw_false

name: Operad.GrSpecies.tw_tw
statement:
lemma tw_tw (e e' : Bool) (x : V A) :
    tw (R := R) e (tw (R := R) e' x) = tw (R := R) (xor e e') x
proof:
:= by
  simp only [tw_apply, map_add, map_smul, par_par]
  cases e <;> cases e' <;> simp

name: Operad.GrSpecies.Shift.par_of
statement:
@[simp] lemma Shift.par_of (b : Bool) (x : V A) :
    par (R := R) (V := Shift V R) b (Shift.of A x) = Shift.of A (par (R := R) (!b) x)
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.GrSpecies.Shift.map_of
statement:
@[simp] lemma Shift.map_of (e : A ≃ B) (x : V A) :
    SymSpecies.map (R := R) (V := Shift V R) e (Shift.of A x)
      = Shift.of B (SymSpecies.map (R := R) e x)
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.GrCooperad.decomp_tw
statement:
lemma decomp_tw (e : Bool) (i : A) :
    decomp (R := R) (C := C) (B := B) i ∘ₗ GrSpecies.tw (R := R) e
      = TensorProduct.map (GrSpecies.tw (R := R) e) (GrSpecies.tw (R := R) e) ∘ₗ
          decomp (R := R) i
proof:
:= by
  have h0 := decomp_par (R := R) (C := C) (B := B) i false
  have h1 := decomp_par (R := R) (C := C) (B := B) i true
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro x
  have e0 := LinearMap.congr_fun h0 x
  have e1 := LinearMap.congr_fun h1 x
  simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply] at e0 e1
  rw [LinearMap.comp_apply, GrSpecies.tw_apply, map_add, map_smul, e0, e1, LinearMap.comp_apply]
  induction decomp (R := R) i x using TensorProduct.induction_on with
  | zero => simp
  | tmul a b =>
    simp only [tpar_tmul, TensorProduct.map_tmul, GrSpecies.tw_apply, Bool.not_false,
      Bool.not_true, TensorProduct.tmul_add, TensorProduct.add_tmul, TensorProduct.tmul_smul,
      TensorProduct.smul_tmul', smul_add, smul_smul]
    cases e <;> simp only [σ_false, σ_true, one_smul, mul_one, mul_neg, neg_neg, neg_smul] <;>
      abel
  | add a b ha hb =>
    rw [map_add, map_add, map_add, smul_add, ← ha, ← hb]
    abel

name: Operad.GrCooperad.map_one_mem
statement:
lemma map_one_mem (e : Unit ≃ A) :
    SymSpecies.map (R := R) e (Coaug.one (R := R) (C := C)) ∈ unitSpan R C A
proof:
:=
  Submodule.subset_span ⟨e, rfl⟩

name: Operad.GrCooperad.unitSpan_le_comap_map
statement:
lemma unitSpan_le_comap_map (σ' : A ≃ B) :
    unitSpan R C A ≤ (unitSpan R C B).comap (SymSpecies.map (R := R) σ')
proof:
:= by
  rw [unitSpan, unitSpanOf, Submodule.span_le]
  rintro _ ⟨e, rfl⟩
  show SymSpecies.map (R := R) σ' (SymSpecies.map (R := R) e _) ∈ unitSpan R C B
  rw [← SymSpecies.map_trans]
  exact map_one_mem _

name: Operad.GrCooperad.unitSpan_le_comap_par
statement:
lemma unitSpan_le_comap_par (b : Bool) :
    unitSpan R C A ≤ (unitSpan R C A).comap (GrSpecies.par (R := R) b)
proof:
:= by
  rw [unitSpan, unitSpanOf, Submodule.span_le]
  rintro _ ⟨e, rfl⟩
  show GrSpecies.par (R := R) b (SymSpecies.map (R := R) e _) ∈ unitSpan R C A
  rw [← GrSpecies.map_par, ← Coaug.par_one (R := R) (C := C), GrSpecies.par_par]
  cases b
  · rw [if_pos rfl, Coaug.par_one]
    exact map_one_mem _
  · rw [if_neg (by decide), map_zero]
    exact Submodule.zero_mem _

name: Operad.GrCooperad.Red.proj_surjective
statement:
lemma Red.proj_surjective (A : Type) [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] :
    Function.Surjective (Red.proj R C A)
proof:
:=
  Submodule.mkQ_surjective _

name: Operad.GrCooperad.Red.proj_map_one
statement:
lemma Red.proj_map_one (e : Unit ≃ A) :
    Red.proj R C A (SymSpecies.map (R := R) e (Coaug.one (R := R) (C := C))) = 0
proof:
:=
  (Submodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero _).2 (map_one_mem e)

name: Operad.GrCooperad.Red.map_proj
statement:
@[simp] lemma Red.map_proj (σ' : A ≃ B) (x : C A) :
    SymSpecies.map (R := R) σ' (Red.proj R C A x)
      = Red.proj R C B (SymSpecies.map (R := R) σ' x)
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.GrCooperad.Red.par_proj
statement:
@[simp] lemma Red.par_proj (b : Bool) (x : C A) :
    GrSpecies.par (R := R) b (Red.proj R C A x)
      = Red.proj R C A (GrSpecies.par (R := R) b x)
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.Sym.SymAlgebra.act_fill
proof:
:= by
  induction l with
  | nil =>
    rw [SymOperad.fill_nil, SymAlgebra.act_map]
    congr 1
  | cons a l ih =>
    have ha := (List.nodup_cons.1 hl).1
    rw [SymOperad.fill_cons, SymAlgebra.act_map, SymAlgebra.act_comp, ih]
    congr 1
    funext c
    by_cases hc : c ∈ l
    · rw [dif_pos hc, dif_pos (List.mem_cons_of_mem a hc)]
      congr 1
    · rw [dif_neg hc]
      by_cases hca : c = a
      · subst hca
        rw [dif_pos List.mem_cons_self, feed_self]
        rfl
      · rw [dif_neg (by simp [hca, hc]), feed_of_ne (show (Sum.inl ⟨c, hc⟩ : Stage B l)
          ≠ Sum.inl ⟨a, ha⟩ from fun h => hca (congrArg Subtype.val (Sum.inl_injective h)))]
        rfl

name: Operad.Sym.SymAlgebra.act_total
statement:
theorem SymAlgebra.act_total (α : SymAlgebra R P V) (p : P A) (q : ∀ a, P (B a))
    (v : (Σ a, B a) → V) :
    α.act (SymOperad.total R p q) v = α.act p fun a => α.act (q a) fun b => v ⟨a, b⟩
proof:
:= by
  have hc : ∀ a, a ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset A).toList :=
    fun a => Finset.mem_toList.2 (Finset.mem_univ a)
  rw [SymOperad.total_eq_fill p q _ (Finset.nodup_toList _) hc, SymAlgebra.act_map,
    SymAlgebra.act_fill]
  congr 1
  funext a
  rw [dif_pos (hc a)]
  rfl

name: Operad.Sym.SymAlgebraHom.ext
statement: @[ext] lemma ext {F G : SymAlgebraHom α β} (h : F.toLinearMap = G.toLinearMap) : F = G
proof:
:= by
  cases F
  cases G
  congr

name: Operad.Sym.SymAlgebraHom.id_toLinearMap
statement: @[simp] lemma id_toLinearMap : (id α).toLinearMap = LinearMap.id
proof: := rfl

name: Operad.Sym.SymAlgebraHom.comp_toLinearMap
statement:
@[simp] lemma comp_toLinearMap {U : Type*} [AddCommGroup U] [Module R U]
    {γ : SymAlgebra R P U} (G : SymAlgebraHom β γ) (F : SymAlgebraHom α β) :
    (G.comp F).toLinearMap = G.toLinearMap ∘ₗ F.toLinearMap
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: Operad.SymOperad.comp_eq_total
statement:
theorem comp_eq_total (i : A) (x : P A) (y : P B) :
    comp (R := R) i x y = map (R := R) (padEquiv i B) (total R x (pad R i y))
proof:
:=
  (MaySetOperad.comp_toMaySetOperad (S := Und R P) i x y).symm

name: Operad.SymOperad.eq_map_symm_of_map_eq
statement:
lemma eq_map_symm_of_map_eq (e : A ≃ B) {x : P A} {y : P B} (h : map (R := R) e x = y) :
    x = map (R := R) e.symm y
proof:
:= by
  rw [← h, ← map_trans, Equiv.self_trans_symm, map_refl]

name: Operad.Schur.ml_ext
statement:
theorem ml_ext {W : Type x} [AddCommGroup W] [Module R W]
    {f g : MultilinearMap R (fun _ : A => Schur R P V) W}
    (h : ∀ (n : A → ℕ) (q : ∀ a, P (Fin (n a))) (w : ∀ a, Fin (n a) → V),
      f (fun a => mk R (n a) (q a) (w a)) = g (fun a => mk R (n a) (q a) (w a))) : f = g
proof:
:= by
  refine ML.quot_ext (schurRel R P V) fun x => ?_
  have := ML.ds_ext (f := f.compLinearMap fun _ => (schurRel R P V).mkQ)
    (g := g.compLinearMap fun _ => (schurRel R P V).mkQ) fun n t =>
      h n (fun a => (t a).1) (fun a => (t a).2)
  exact congrArg (fun F => F x) this

name: Operad.Schur.actGen_update
statement:
lemma actGen_update (p : P A) (n : A → ℕ) (t : ∀ a, SchurGen P V (n a)) (i : A)
    (q : P (Fin (n i))) (w : Fin (n i) → V) :
    actGen p n (update t i (q, w))
      = mkA R (SymOperad.total R p (update (fun a => (t a).1) i q))
          (fun x => update (fun a => (t a).2) i w x.1 x.2)
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : (fun a => (update t i (q, w) a).1) = update (fun a => (t a).1) i q :=
    funext fun a => apply_update (fun a (y : SchurGen P V (n a)) => y.1) t i (q, w) a
  have h2 : (fun x : Σ a, Fin (n a) => (update t i (q, w) x.1).2 x.2)
      = fun x => update (fun a => (t a).2) i w x.1 x.2 :=
    funext fun x => congrFun
      (apply_update (fun a (y : SchurGen P V (n a)) => y.2) t i (q, w) x.1) x.2
  unfold actGen
  rw [h1, h2]

name: Operad.Schur.sigmaCongr_mk
statement:
lemma sigmaCongr_mk {A' : Type} {B : A → Type} {B' : A' → Type} (f : A ≃ A')
    (F : ∀ a, B a ≃ B' (f a)) (a : A) (b : B a) : Equiv.sigmaCongr f F ⟨a, b⟩ = ⟨f a, F a b⟩
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: Operad.Schur.mkA_map'
statement:
lemma mkA_map' {A B : Type} [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] [Fintype B] [DecidableEq B] (e : A ≃ B)
    (p : P A) (v : B → V) : mkA R (SymOperad.map (R := R) e p) v = mkA R p (v ∘ e)
proof:
:=
  mkA_map e p v

name: Operad.Schur.sigma_update
statement:
lemma sigma_update {B : A → Type} [∀ a, DecidableEq (B a)] (W : ∀ a, B a → V) (i : A)
    (w : B i → V) (j : B i) (c : V) :
    (fun x : Σ a, B a => update W i (update w j c) x.1 x.2)
      = update (fun x : Σ a, B a => update W i w x.1 x.2) ⟨i, j⟩ c
proof:
:= by
  funext ⟨a, b⟩
  by_cases ha : a = i
  · subst ha
    by_cases hb : b = j
    · subst hb
      simp
    · rw [update_of_ne (fun h => hb (eq_of_heq (Sigma.mk.inj h).2))]
      simp [update_of_ne hb]
  · rw [update_of_ne (fun h => ha (congrArg Sigma.fst h))]
    simp [update_of_ne ha]

name: Operad.Schur.lift_single_one
statement:
lemma lift_single_one {X W : Type*} [AddCommGroup W] [Module R W] (f : X → W) (x : X) :
    Finsupp.lift W R X f (Finsupp.single x 1) = f x
proof:
:= by
  simp

name: Operad.Schur.actGen_rel
statement:
lemma actGen_rel (p : P A) (n : A → ℕ) (t : ∀ a, SchurGen P V (n a)) (i : A) :
    schurRelSet R P V (n i) ⊆ LinearMap.ker
      (Finsupp.lift (Schur R P V) R (SchurGen P V (n i)) fun y => actGen p n (update t i y))
proof:
:= by
  rintro r ((((⟨q, q', w, rfl⟩ | ⟨c, q, w, rfl⟩) | ⟨q, w, j, y, y', rfl⟩) |
    ⟨q, w, j, c, y, rfl⟩) | ⟨σ, q, w, rfl⟩) <;>
    simp only [SetLike.mem_coe, LinearMap.mem_ker, map_sub, map_smul, lift_single_one,
      actGen_update]
  · rw [SymOperad.total_update_add, mkA_add]
    abel
  · rw [SymOperad.total_update_smul, mkA_smul, sub_self]
  · rw [sigma_update, sigma_update, sigma_update, mkA_update_add]
    abel
  · rw [sigma_update, sigma_update, mkA_update_smul, sub_self]
  · rw [sub_eq_zero]
    let τ : ∀ a, Fin (n a) ≃ Fin (n a) := update (fun a => Equiv.refl (Fin (n a))) i σ
    have hτ := SymOperad.total_map (R := R) (Equiv.refl A) τ p (update (fun a => (t a).1) i q)
      (update (fun a => (t a).1) i (SymOperad.map (R := R) σ q)) fun a => by
        by_cases ha : a = i
        · subst ha
          simp only [τ, Equiv.refl_apply, update_self]
          rfl
        · simp only [τ, Equiv.refl_apply, update_of_ne ha]
          exact (SymOperad.map_refl _).symm
    rw [SymOperad.map_refl] at hτ
    rw [show SymSpecies.map (R := R) σ q = SymOperad.map (R := R) σ q from rfl, ← hτ, mkA_map']
    congr 1
    funext ⟨a, b⟩
    simp only [comp_apply, sigmaCongr_mk, Equiv.refl_apply]
    by_cases ha : a = i
    · subst ha
      simp only [τ, update_self, comp_apply]
      rfl
    · simp only [τ, update_of_ne ha]
      rfl

name: Operad.Schur.act_mk
statement:
lemma act_mk (p : P A) (n : A → ℕ) (q : ∀ a, P (Fin (n a))) (w : ∀ a, Fin (n a) → V) :
    act p (fun a => mk R (n a) (q a) (w a))
      = mkA R (SymOperad.total R p q) fun x => w x.1 x.2
proof:
:= by
  unfold act actPre
  exact (ML.liftQ_mkQ _ _ _ _).trans (ML.dsLift_lof_single (R := R) (X := SchurGen P V)
    (fun n t => actGen p n t) n fun a => (q a, w a))

name: Operad.Schur.act_mkA
statement:
lemma act_mkA {B : A → Type} [∀ a, Fintype (B a)] [∀ a, DecidableEq (B a)] (p : P A)
    (q : ∀ a, P (B a)) (w : ∀ a, B a → V) :
    act p (fun a => mkA R (q a) (w a)) = mkA R (SymOperad.total R p q) fun x => w x.1 x.2
proof:
:= by
  let φ : ∀ a, B a ≃ Fin (Fintype.card (B a)) := fun a => Fintype.equivFin (B a)
  have h := SymOperad.total_map (R := R) (Equiv.refl A) φ p q
    (fun a => SymOperad.map (R := R) (φ a) (q a)) fun a => rfl
  rw [SymOperad.map_refl] at h
  show act p (fun a => mk R _ (SymOperad.map (R := R) (φ a) (q a)) (w a ∘ (φ a).symm)) = _
  rw [act_mk, ← h, mkA_map']
  congr 1
  funext ⟨a, b⟩
  show w a ((φ a).symm (φ a b)) = w a b
  rw [Equiv.symm_apply_apply]

name: Operad.Schur.act_add
statement:
lemma act_add (p p' : P A) : act (p + p') = (act p + act p' :
    MultilinearMap R (fun _ : A => Schur R P V) (Schur R P V))
proof:
:=
  ml_ext fun n q w => by
    rw [MultilinearMap.add_apply, act_mk, act_mk, act_mk, SymOperad.total_add, mkA_add]

name: Operad.Schur.act_smul
statement:
lemma act_smul (c : R) (p : P A) : act (c • p) = (c • act p :
    MultilinearMap R (fun _ : A => Schur R P V) (Schur R P V))
proof:
:=
  ml_ext fun n q w => by
    rw [MultilinearMap.smul_apply, act_mk, act_mk, SymOperad.total_smul, mkA_smul]

name: Operad.Schur.act_map
statement:
lemma act_map {A' : Type} [Fintype A'] [DecidableEq A'] (e : A ≃ A') (p : P A)
    (s : A' → Schur R P V) : act (SymOperad.map (R := R) e p) s = act p fun a => s (e a)
proof:
:= by
  have := ml_ext (f := act (R := R) (V := V) (SymOperad.map (R := R) e p))
    (g := (act (R := R) (V := V) p).domDomCongr e)
    fun n q w => by
      rw [MultilinearMap.domDomCongr_apply, act_mk, act_mk]
      rw [← SymOperad.total_map (R := R) e (fun a => Equiv.refl (Fin (n (e a)))) p
        (fun a => q (e a)) q fun a => (SymOperad.map_refl _).symm, mkA_map']
      rfl
  exact congrArg (fun F => F s) this

name: Operad.Schur.act_one
statement: lemma act_one (s : Unit → Schur R P V) : act (SymOperad.one R : P Unit) s = s ()
proof:
:= by
  have := ml_ext (f := act (R := R) (V := V) (SymOperad.one R : P Unit))
    (g := EndOp.one R (Schur R P V)) fun n q w => by
      rw [EndOp.one_apply, act_mk, SymOperad.eq_map_symm_of_map_eq _
        (SymOperad.total_one_left (R := R) q), mkA_map', ← mkA_fin]
      rfl
  exact congrArg (fun F => F s) this

name: Operad.Schur.act_total_mk
statement:
lemma act_total_mk {B : A → Type} [∀ a, Fintype (B a)] [∀ a, DecidableEq (B a)] (p : P A)
    (q : ∀ a, P (B a)) (m : (Σ a, B a) → ℕ) (Q : ∀ z, P (Fin (m z)))
    (W : ∀ z, Fin (m z) → V) :
    act (SymOperad.total R p q) (fun z => mk R (m z) (Q z) (W z))
      = act p fun a => act (q a) fun b => mk R (m ⟨a, b⟩) (Q ⟨a, b⟩) (W ⟨a, b⟩)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [act_mk]
  rw [act_mkA, ← SymOperad.total_assoc (R := R) p q fun a b => Q ⟨a, b⟩, mkA_map']
  rfl

name: Operad.Schur.act_comp
statement:
lemma act_comp {B : Type} [Fintype B] [DecidableEq B] (i : A) (x : P A) (y : P B)
    (s : Without A i ⊕ B → Schur R P V) :
    act (SymOperad.comp (R := R) i x y) s = act x (feed i s (act y fun b => s (Sum.inr b)))
proof:
:= by
  have := ml_ext (f := act (R := R) (V := V) (SymOperad.comp (R := R) i x y))
    (g := EndOp.compML R (Schur R P V) i (act x) (act y)) fun n q w => by
      rw [EndOp.compML_apply, SymOperad.comp_eq_total, act_map, act_total_mk]
      congr 1
      funext a
      by_cases ha : a = i
      · subst ha
        rw [feed_self, SymOperad.pad, dif_pos rfl, act_map]
        rfl
      · rw [feed_of_ne ha, SymOperad.pad, dif_neg ha, act_map, act_one]
        rfl
  exact congrArg (fun F => F s) this

name: Operad.Schur.algebra_act
statement:
@[simp] lemma algebra_act (p : P A) (s : A → Schur R P V) :
    (algebra R P V).act p s = act p s
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: Operad.Schur.unit_fun
statement: lemma unit_fun (z : V) : (fun _ : Unit => z) = update (fun _ : Unit => (0 : V)) () z
proof:
:= by
  funext u
  cases u
  simp

name: Operad.Schur.ι_apply
statement: lemma ι_apply (v : V) : ι R P V v = mkA R (SymOperad.one R : P Unit) fun _ => v
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: Operad.Schur.mk_eq_act
statement:
lemma mk_eq_act (n : ℕ) (q : P (Fin n)) (w : Fin n → V) :
    mk R n q w = act q fun k => ι R P V (w k)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [ι_apply]
  rw [act_mkA, SymOperad.eq_map_symm_of_map_eq _ (SymOperad.total_one_right (R := R) q),
    mkA_map', ← mkA_fin]
  rfl

name: Operad.Schur.liftFam_apply
statement:
lemma liftFam_apply (β : SymAlgebra R P W) (φ : V →ₗ[R] W) (n : ℕ) (q : P (Fin n))
    (v : Fin n → V) : liftFam β φ n q v = β.act q fun k => φ (v k)
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: Operad.Schur.liftFam_compatible
statement:
lemma liftFam_compatible (β : SymAlgebra R P W) (φ : V →ₗ[R] W) :
    Compatible (liftFam β φ)
proof:
:= fun n σ q v => by
  rw [liftFam_apply, liftFam_apply]
  exact SymAlgebra.act_map β σ q _

name: Operad.Schur.lift_liftFam_mkA
statement:
lemma lift_liftFam_mkA (β : SymAlgebra R P W) (φ : V →ₗ[R] W) (p : P A) (v : A → V) :
    lift (liftFam β φ) (liftFam_compatible β φ) (mkA R p v) = β.act p fun a => φ (v a)
proof:
:= by
  rw [mkA, lift_mk, liftFam_apply]
  exact (SymAlgebra.act_map β _ p _).trans (by simp)

name: Operad.Schur.liftHom_ι
statement:
@[simp] lemma liftHom_ι (β : SymAlgebra R P W) (φ : V →ₗ[R] W) (v : V) :
    (liftHom β φ).toLinearMap (ι R P V v) = φ v
proof:
:= by
  show lift (liftFam β φ) (liftFam_compatible β φ) (mkA R (SymOperad.one R : P Unit) fun _ => v)
    = φ v
  rw [lift_liftFam_mkA, SymAlgebra.act_one]

name: Operad.Schur.algHom_ext
statement:
theorem algHom_ext {β : SymAlgebra R P W} {F G : SymAlgebraHom (algebra R P V) β}
    (h : ∀ v, F.toLinearMap (ι R P V v) = G.toLinearMap (ι R P V v)) : F = G
proof:
:= by
  refine SymAlgebraHom.ext (hom_ext fun n q w => ?_)
  rw [mk_eq_act, ← algebra_act, F.map_act, G.map_act]
  simp only [h]

name: Operad.Schur.liftEquiv_apply
statement:
@[simp] lemma liftEquiv_apply (β : SymAlgebra R P W) (F : SymAlgebraHom (algebra R P V) β) :
    liftEquiv β F = F.toLinearMap ∘ₗ ι R P V
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: Operad.Schur.liftEquiv_symm_apply
statement:
@[simp] lemma liftEquiv_symm_apply (β : SymAlgebra R P W) (φ : V →ₗ[R] W) :
    (liftEquiv β).symm φ = liftHom β φ
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: Operad.AlgVal.val_mem_Tsp
proof:
:=
  Submodule.subset_span ⟨q, b, L, hq, rfl⟩

name: Operad.AlgVal.isHom_w
statement:
lemma isHom_w {A : Type} [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] (f : A → ℕ) :
    IsHom (R := K) (fun _ => true) fun a => w (f a)
proof:
:=
  fun a => hw (f a)

name: Operad.AlgVal.Tsp_le
statement: lemma Tsp_le (s : Finset ℕ) : Tsp φ w s ≤ LinearMap.range (ev φ w s)
proof:
:= by
  refine Submodule.span_le.2 ?_
  rintro _ ⟨q, b, L, -, rfl⟩
  refine ⟨rsg K (dord ↥s) L (fun _ => true) • q, ?_⟩
  rw [map_smul, fam_change _ (dord ↥s) L (isHom_w hw _)]
  rfl

name: Operad.AlgVal.unary_mem_Tsp
proof:
:= by
  let e : Fin 1 ≃ ({a} : Finset ℕ) :=
    ⟨fun _ => ⟨a, Finset.mem_singleton_self a⟩, fun _ => 0, fun i => Subsingleton.elim _ _,
      fun x => Subtype.ext (Finset.mem_singleton.1 x.2).symm⟩
  have hq : GrOperad.par (R := K) b (GrOperad.map (R := K) e g) = GrOperad.map (R := K) e g := by
    rw [← GrOperad.map_par, hg]
  have h := val_mem_Tsp (φ := φ) (w := w) hq (LinOrd.map e (LinOrd.std 1))
  rw [GrOperadHom.app_map, map_fam_apply] at h
  rw [← hβ]
  convert h using 2
  funext i
  fin_cases i
  rfl

name: Operad.AlgVal.input_mem_Tsp
statement: lemma input_mem_Tsp (a : ℕ) : w a ∈ Tsp φ w {a}
proof:
:= by
  let e : Unit ≃ ({a} : Finset ℕ) :=
    ⟨fun _ => ⟨a, Finset.mem_singleton_self a⟩, fun _ => (), fun _ => rfl,
      fun x => Subtype.ext (Finset.mem_singleton.1 x.2).symm⟩
  have hq : GrOperad.par (R := K) false (GrOperad.map (R := K) e (GrOperad.one (R := K)))
      = (GrOperad.map (R := K) e (GrOperad.one (R := K)) :
          (GrOperadIdeal.span K r).Quot ↥({a} : Finset ℕ)) := by
    rw [← GrOperad.map_par, GrOperad.par_one]
  have h := val_mem_Tsp (φ := φ) (w := w) hq (dord _)
  rwa [GrOperadHom.app_map, GrOperadHom.app_one] at h

name: Operad.AlgVal.binop_mem_Tsp
statement:
theorem binop_mem_Tsp {g : (GrOperadIdeal.span K r).Quot (Fin 2)} {b₀ : Bool}
    (hg : GrOperad.par (R := K) b₀ g = g) (β : V →ₗ[K] V →ₗ[K] V)
    (hβ : ∀ y z, EndGr.sv (φ.app _ g) ![y, z] = β y z)
    {s t : Finset ℕ} (h : Disjoint s t) {y z : V} (hy : y ∈ Tsp φ w s) (hz : z ∈ Tsp φ w t) :
    β y z ∈ Tsp φ w (s ∪ t)
proof:
:= by
  have hm := Submodule.apply_mem_map₂ β hy hz
  rw [Tsp, Tsp, Submodule.map₂_span_span] at hm
  refine (Submodule.span_le.2 ?_) hm
  rintro _ ⟨_, ⟨q₁, b₁, L₁, hq₁, rfl⟩, _, ⟨q₂, b₂, L₂, hq₂, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
  have hq₁' : GrOperad.par (R := K) b₁ (φ.app _ q₁) = φ.app _ q₁ := by
    rw [← GrOperadHom.app_par, hq₁]
  have hq₂' : GrOperad.par (R := K) b₂ (φ.app _ q₂) = φ.app _ q₂ := by
    rw [← GrOperadHom.app_par, hq₂]
  have hQ : GrOperad.par (R := K) (xor (xor b₀ b₁) b₂)
      (GrOperad.map (R := K) (Equiv.Finset.union s t h) (gbin K g q₁ q₂))
      = GrOperad.map (R := K) (Equiv.Finset.union s t h) (gbin K g q₁ q₂) := by
    rw [← GrOperad.map_par, gbin_par hg hq₁ hq₂]
  obtain ⟨c, hc, hv⟩ := gbin_fam_apply (φ.app _ g) hq₁' hq₂' L₁ L₂
    (isHom_w hw fun a : ↥s ⊕ ↥t => (Equiv.Finset.union s t h a).1)
  have hval := val_mem_Tsp (φ := φ) (w := w) hQ (LinOrd.map (Equiv.Finset.union s t h)
    (LinOrd.map (binEquiv _ _)
      (LinOrd.comp (Sum.inl slotOne) (LinOrd.comp 0 (LinOrd.std 2) L₁) L₂)))
  rw [GrOperadHom.app_map, app_gbin, map_fam_apply] at hval
  rw [hv] at hval
  have := Submodule.smul_mem _ c hval
  rw [smul_smul, hc, one_smul] at this
  convert this using 1
  exact (hβ _ _).symm
